kikuyu: Jalqabatti Waaqni samiiwwanii fi lafa uume.
english: In the beginning, God created the heavens and the earth.

kikuyu: Lafti kan bifa hin qabnee fi duwwaa turte; dukkannis tuujuba irra ture; Hafuurri Waaqaas bishaan irra sosochoʼa ture.
english: The earth was formless and empty. Darkness was on the surface of the deep and God’s Spirit was hovering over the surface of the waters.

kikuyu: Waaqnis, “Ifni haa taʼu” jedhe; ifnis ni taʼe.
english: God said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.

kikuyu: Waaqnis akka ifni sun gaarii taʼe arge; ifaa fi dukkanas gargar baase.
english: God saw the light, and saw that it was good. God divided the light from the darkness.

kikuyu: Waaqnis ifa sanaan “Guyyaa” jedhe; dukkana sanaan immoo “Halkan” jedhee moggaase. Galgalas taʼe; ganamas taʼe; guyyaa tokkoffaa.
english: God called the light “day”, and the darkness he called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.

kikuyu: Waaqnis, “Bishaanii fi bishaan gargar baasuuf bantiin bishaanota gidduu haa jiraatu” jedhe.
english: God said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqni bantii tolchee bishaan bantii jalaatii fi kan bantiin olii gargar baase. Akkasumas taʼe.
english: God made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.

kikuyu: Waaqnis bantii sana “samii” jedhee moggaase. Galgalas taʼe; ganamas taʼe; guyyaa lammaffaa.
english: God called the expanse “sky”. There was evening and there was morning, a second day.

kikuyu: Waaqnis, “Bishaan samiidhaa gad jiru iddoo tokkotti walitti haa qabamu; lafti gogaanis haa mulʼatu” jedhe. Akkasumas taʼe.
english: God said, “Let the waters under the sky be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Waaqni lafa gogaa sanaan “lafa” jedhe; bishaanicha walitti qabameen immoo “galaana” jedhee moggaase. Waaqnis wanni kun akka gaarii taʼe arge.
english: God called the dry land “earth”, and the gathering together of the waters he called “seas”. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Ammas Waaqni, “Lafti biqiltuuwwan haa baastu; biqiltuuwwan akkuma gosa gosa isaaniitti sanyii baasan, mukkeen ija kennanii iji isaanii immoo sanyii of keessaa qabu adduma addaan akkuma gosa gosa isaaniitti lafa irratti haa argaman” jedhe. Akkasumas taʼe.
english: God said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Laftis biqiltuu akkuma gosa isaatti sanyii baasu, muka ija kennu, kan iji isaas sanyii of keessaa qabu adduma addaan akkuma gosa isaatti baaste. Waaqnis wanni kun akka gaarii taʼe arge.
english: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Galgalas taʼe; ganamas taʼe; guyyaa sadaffaa.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

kikuyu: Waaqnis akkana jedhe; “Guyyaa fi halkan gargar baasuuf bantii samii irratti ifawwan haa taʼan; isaanis mallattoowwan waqtiileen, guyyoonnii fi waggoonni ittiin beekaman haa taʼan;
english: God said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the sky to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

kikuyu: isaanis ifawwan bantii samii irraa kan lafaaf ifa kennan haa taʼan.” Akkasumas taʼe.
english: and let them be for lights in the expanse of the sky to give light on the earth;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Waaqni ifa gurguddaa lama uume; kunis akka ifni guddaan guyyaa, inni xinnaan immoo halkan moʼuuf. Akkasuma urjiiwwan illee uume.
english: God made the two great lights: the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night. He also made the stars.

kikuyu: Waaqnis akka isaan lafaaf ifa kennaniif bantii samii irra isaan kaaʼe;
english: God set them in the expanse of the sky to give light to the earth,

kikuyu: kunis akka isaan guyyaa fi halkan moʼanii fi akka ifa sana dukkana irraa gargar baasaniif. Waaqnis wanni kun akka gaarii taʼe arge.
english: and to rule over the day and over the night, and to divide the light from the darkness. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Galgalas taʼe; ganamas taʼe; guyyaa afuraffaa.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

kikuyu: Waaqnis, “Bishaan uumamawwan lubbu qabeeyyii munyuuqaniin haa guutamu; simbirroonnis lafaa olitti, bantii samii keessa haa barrisan” jedhe.
english: God said, “Let the waters abound with living creatures, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the sky.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqni uumamawwan galaanaa gurguddaa, lubbu qabeeyyii munyuuqan kanneen galaana keessa jiraatan hundaa fi simbirroota qoochoo qaban hunda akkuma gosa isaaniitti uume. Waaqnis wanni kun akka gaarii taʼe arge.
english: God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Waaqnis, “Horaa; baayʼadhaa; bishaan galaanotaas guutaa; simbirroonnis lafa irratti haa baayʼatan” jedhee isaan eebbise.
english: God blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

kikuyu: Galgalas taʼe; ganamas taʼe; guyyaa shanaffaa.
english: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

kikuyu: Waaqnis, “Lafti akkuma gosa gosa isaaniitti uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyii jechuunis horii, uumamawwan lafa irra mumunyuuqan, bineensota akkuma gosa gosa isaaniitti haa kennitu” jedhe. Akkasumas taʼe.
english: God said, “Let the earth produce living creatures after their kind, livestock, creeping things, and animals of the earth after their kind;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Waaqni bineensota akkuma gosa gosa isaaniitti, horii akkuma gosa gosa isaaniitti, uumamawwan lafa irra mumunyuuqanis akkuma gosa gosa isaaniitti uume. Waaqni wanni kun akka gaarii taʼe arge.
english: God made the animals of the earth after their kind, and the livestock after their kind, and everything that creeps on the ground after its kind. God saw that it was good.

kikuyu: Waaqnis, “Kottaa akka bifa keenyaatti, akka fakkeenya keenyaattis nama uumnaa; isaanis qurxummii galaanaa irratti, simbirroo samii irratti, horii irratti, lafa hundumaa fi uumamawwan lafa irra munyuuqan hundumaa irratti aangoo haa qabaatan” jedhe.
english: God said, “Let’s make man in our image, after our likeness. Let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the sky, and over the livestock, and over all the earth, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the earth.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqni akka bifa isaatti nama uume; akka bifa Waaqaatti isa uume; innis dhiiraa fi dubartii taasisee isaan uume.
english: God created man in his own image. In God’s image he created him; male and female he created them.

kikuyu: Waaqnis isaan eebbisee, “Horaa, baayʼadhaas; lafa guutaatii harka keessan jalattis bulfadhaa. Qurxummii galaanaa irratti, simbirroota samii irratti, uumama lafa irra munyuuqu hunda irratti aangoo qabaadhaa” jedheen.
english: God blessed them. God said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the earth, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the sky, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Waaqni akkana jedhe; “Kunoo ani akka isaan nyaata isinii taʼaniif biqiltuu lafa hunda irratti sanyii kennu hundaa fi muka iji isaa sanyii of keessaa qabu gosa hunda isinii kenneera.
english: God said, “Behold, I have given you every herb yielding seed, which is on the surface of all the earth, and every tree, which bears fruit yielding seed. It will be your food.

kikuyu: Anis bineensa lafaa hundaaf, simbirroota samii hundaaf, uumama lafa irra munyuuqu hundaaf jechuunis waan hafuura jireenyaa of keessaa qabu hundaaf akka nyaata isaanii taʼuuf biqiltuu lalisaa hunda nan kenna.” Akkasumas taʼe.
english: To every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the sky, and to everything that creeps on the earth, in which there is life, I have given every green herb for food;” and it was so.

kikuyu: Waaqnis waan hojjete hunda ilaale; wanni sunis dhugumaan gaarii ture. Galgalas taʼe; ganamas taʼe; guyyaa jaʼaffaa.
english: God saw everything that he had made, and, behold, it was very good. There was evening and there was morning, a sixth day.

kikuyu: Uumamni samiitii fi lafaa, kan waan isaan keessa jiru hundaas haala kanaan xumurame.
english: The heavens, the earth, and all their vast array were finished.

kikuyu: Waaqni hojii hojjechaa ture hunda guyyaa torbaffaatti fixe; kanaafuu inni guyyaa torbaffaatti hojii isaa hundumaa irraa boqote.
english: On the seventh day God finished his work which he had done; and he rested on the seventh day from all his work which he had done.

kikuyu: Waaqni sababii gaafa sana hojii waa uumuu kan hojjechaa ture hunda irraa boqoteef guyyaa torbaffaa eebbisee qulqulleesse.
english: God blessed the seventh day, and made it holy, because he rested in it from all his work of creation which he had done.

kikuyu: Seenaan samiiwwaniitii fi lafaa kan yeroo isaan uumamanii, yeroo Waaqayyo Waaqni lafaa fi samiiwwan uumee kanaa dha.
english: This is the history of the generations of the heavens and of the earth when they were created, in the day that the LORD God made the earth and the heavens.

kikuyu: Sababii Waaqayyo Waaqni bokkaa hin roobsiniif, namni lafa qotus waan hin jiraatiniif margi tokko iyyuu lafa irratti hin mulʼanne; biqiltuunis lafa qotiisaa irratti hin biqille ture.
english: No plant of the field was yet on the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for the LORD God had not caused it to rain on the earth. There was not a man to till the ground,

kikuyu: Garuu bishaan lafa keessaa burqee lafa hunda obaasa ture.
english: but a mist went up from the earth, and watered the whole surface of the ground.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni biyyoo lafaa irraa nama tolche; hafuura jireenyaas funyaan isaatti baafate; namnis uumama jiraataa taʼe.
english: The LORD God formed man from the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqnis Eeden keessatti gama baʼa biiftuutti iddoo biqiltuu qopheesse; nama tolche sanas achi keessa kaaʼe.
english: The LORD God planted a garden eastward, in Eden, and there he put the man whom he had formed.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni mukkeen gosa hundaa lafa keessaa biqilche; inni mukkeen ija namaatti tolanii fi nyaataafis gaarii taʼan biqilche. Iddoo biqiltuu sana keessas muka jireenyaatii fi muka waan gaarii fi waan hamaa nama beeksisutu ture.
english: Out of the ground the LORD God made every tree to grow that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food, including the tree of life in the middle of the garden and the tree of the knowledge of good and evil.

kikuyu: Lagni iddoo biqiltuu sana obaasu tokkos Eeden keessaa burqa ture; lagni sun Eedenii kaʼee gargar baʼee laga afur taʼe.
english: A river went out of Eden to water the garden; and from there it was parted, and became the source of four rivers.

kikuyu: Maqaan laga tokkoffaa Phiishoon; innis guutummaa biyya Hawiilaa, iddoo warqeen jirutti naannaʼee yaaʼa.
english: The name of the first is Pishon: it flows through the whole land of Havilah, where there is gold;

kikuyu: Warqeen biyya sanaa gaarii dha; hapheen urgaaʼuu fi sardooniksiin achitti argamu.
english: and the gold of that land is good. Bdellium and onyx stone are also there.

kikuyu: Maqaan isa lammaffaa Giihooni; innis guutummaa lafa Itoophiyaatti naannaʼee yaaʼa.
english: The name of the second river is Gihon. It is the same river that flows through the whole land of Cush.

kikuyu: Maqaan laga sadaffaa Xegroosi; innis karaa baʼa biiftuutiin Asoor cina yaaʼa. Lagni afuraffaan immoo Efraaxiis jedhama.
english: The name of the third river is Hiddekel. This is the one which flows in front of Assyria. The fourth river is the Euphrates.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni akka inni isa misoomsuu fi akka inni isa eeguuf jedhee nama fuudhee Iddoo Biqiltuu Eeden keessa kaaʼe.
english: The LORD God took the man, and put him into the garden of Eden to cultivate and keep it.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqnis akkana jedhee nama ajaje; “Muka iddoo biqiltuu kana keessa jiru hunda irraa nyaachuu ni dandeessa;
english: The LORD God commanded the man, saying, “You may freely eat of every tree of the garden;

kikuyu: garuu muka waan gaarii fi waan hamaa nama beeksisu sana irraa hin nyaatin; gaafa isa irraa nyaatte dhugumaan ni duutaatii.”
english: but you shall not eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil; for in the day that you eat of it, you will surely die.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni, “Namni kophaa isaa taʼuun gaarii miti; gargaartuu isatti toltu nan tolchaaf” jedhe.
english: The LORD God said, “It is not good for the man to be alone. I will make him a helper comparable to him.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqnis bineensaa fi simbirroota samii hundumaa lafa irraa tolche. Maqaa inni isaaniif baasu ilaaluuf jedhees gara namichaatti isaan fide; wanni namichi sun tokkoo tokkoo uumamawwan lubbu qabeeyyii ittiin waame kam iyyuu maqaa taʼeef.
english: Out of the ground the LORD God formed every animal of the field, and every bird of the sky, and brought them to the man to see what he would call them. Whatever the man called every living creature became its name.

kikuyu: Namichi sunis horii qeʼee hundaaf, simbirroota samii hundaaf, bineensa hundaaf maqaa baase. Addaamiif garuu gargaartuun isatti toltu hin argamne.
english: The man gave names to all livestock, and to the birds of the sky, and to every animal of the field; but for man there was not found a helper comparable to him.

kikuyu: Kanaafis Waaqayyo Waaqni akka namichi hirribaan of wallaalu godhe; utuma inni rafaa jiruu lafee cinaacha isaa keessaa tokko fuudhee iddoo sana fooniin duuche.
english: The LORD God caused the man to fall into a deep sleep. As the man slept, he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh in its place.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni lafee cinaachaa kan namicha keessaa fuudhe sana irraa dubartii tolchee gara namichaatti geesse.
english: The LORD God made a woman from the rib which he had taken from the man, and brought her to the man.

kikuyu: Namichis akkana jedhe; “Egaa lafeen kun lafee lafee kootii ti; foon kunis foon foon kootii ti; isheen waan dhiira irraa argamteef ‘dubartii’ jedhamti.”
english: The man said, “This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh. She will be called ‘woman,’ because she was taken out of Man.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namni abbaa fi haadha isaa ni dhiisa; niitii isaatti ni maxxana; isaanis foon tokko taʼu.
english: Therefore a man will leave his father and his mother, and will join with his wife, and they will be one flesh.

kikuyu: Namichii fi niitiin isaa qullaa isaanii turan; garuu wal hin qaanaʼan ture.
english: The man and his wife were both naked, and they were not ashamed.

kikuyu: Bineensa Waaqayyo Waaqni uume hunda keessaa bofti haxxee ture. Dubartittiidhaanis, “Dhuguma Waaqni, ‘Muka iddoo biqiltuu keessa jiru kam irraa iyyuu hin nyaatinaa’ isiniin jedheeraa?” jedhe.
english: Now the serpent was more subtle than any animal of the field which the LORD God had made. He said to the woman, “Has God really said, ‘You shall not eat of any tree of the garden’?”

kikuyu: Dubartittiinis deebiftee bofa sanaan akkana jette; “Ija mukkeen iddoo biqiltuu keessa jiranii nyaachuu ni dandeenya;
english: The woman said to the serpent, “We may eat fruit from the trees of the garden,

kikuyu: garuu Waaqni, ‘Muka walakkaa iddoo biqiltuu sanaa keessa jiru irraa ija hin nyaatinaa; ittis hin buʼinaa; yoo kanaa achii ni duutuu’ jedheera.”
english: but not the fruit of the tree which is in the middle of the garden. God has said, ‘You shall not eat of it. You shall not touch it, lest you die.’”

kikuyu: Bofichis deebisee dubartittiidhaan akkana jedhe; “Isin dhugumaan hin duutan.
english: The serpent said to the woman, “You won’t really die,

kikuyu: Waaqni akka yommuu isin ija mukichaa nyaattan iji keessan banamu, akka isin waan gaarii fi waan hamaa beekuudhaan akka Waaqaa taatan ni beekaatii.”
english: for God knows that in the day you eat it, your eyes will be opened, and you will be like God, knowing good and evil.”

kikuyu: Dubartittiinis yommuu akka iji mukichaa nyaataaf gaarii, kan ija namaatti tolu, ogummaa argachuufis akka nama gojomaasisu argitetti fudhattee nyaatte. Dhirsi ishees ishee wajjin ture; isaafis ni laatte; innis ni nyaate.
english: When the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was a delight to the eyes, and that the tree was to be desired to make one wise, she took some of its fruit, and ate. Then she gave some to her husband with her, and he ate it, too.

kikuyu: Iji lachan isaaniis ni baname; qullaa hafuu isaaniis beekan; kanaafis baala harbuu hodhanii marxoo tolfatan.
english: Their eyes were opened, and they both knew that they were naked. They sewed fig leaves together, and made coverings for themselves.

kikuyu: Akkuma aduun qabbanoofteenis namichii fi niitiin isaa utuu Waaqayyo Waaqni iddoo biqiltuu sana keessa deemuu sagalee isaa dhagaʼan; isaanis mukkeen iddoo biqiltuu keessa Waaqayyo Waaqa duraa dhokatan.
english: They heard the LORD God’s voice walking in the garden in the cool of the day, and the man and his wife hid themselves from the presence of the LORD God among the trees of the garden.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni garuu namicha waamee, “Ati eessa jirta?” jedheen.
english: The LORD God called to the man, and said to him, “Where are you?”

kikuyu: Namichis deebisee, “Ani utuu ati iddoo biqiltuu keessa deemtuu nan dhagaʼe; waan qullaa koo tureefis nan sodaadhe; nan dhokadhes” jedheen.
english: The man said, “I heard your voice in the garden, and I was afraid, because I was naked; so I hid myself.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Eenyutu akka ati qullaa taate sitti hime? Muka ani ija isaa hin nyaatin jedhee si ajaje sana irraa nyaatte moo?” jedheen.
english: God said, “Who told you that you were naked? Have you eaten from the tree that I commanded you not to eat from?”

kikuyu: Namichis, “Dubartittii ati akka isheen na wajjin jiraattuuf naa kennite sanatu ija mukichaa irraa naa kenne; anis nan nyaadhe” jedhe.
english: The man said, “The woman whom you gave to be with me, she gave me fruit from the tree, and I ate it.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqnis dubartittiidhaan, “Wanni ati hojjette kun maali?” jedhe. Dubartittiin immoo, “Bofti na gowwoomsinaanan nyaadhe” jette.
english: The LORD God said to the woman, “What have you done?” The woman said, “The serpent deceived me, and I ate.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqayyo Waaqni bofichaan akkana jedhe; “Ati sababii waan kana gooteef, “Horii hundumaa keessaa, bineensa hundumaa keessaas kan abaaramte ni taata! Bara jireenya keetii guutuu garaa keetiin lafa irra loota; biyyoo illee ni nyaatta.
english: The LORD God said to the serpent, “Because you have done this, you are cursed above all livestock, and above every animal of the field. You shall go on your belly and you shall eat dust all the days of your life.

kikuyu: Siʼii fi dubartittii, sanyii keetii fi sanyii ishee gidduutti diinummaa nan uuma; inni mataa kee ni tuma; atis koomee isaa ni iddita.”
english: I will put hostility between you and the woman, and between your offspring and her offspring. He will bruise your head, and you will bruise his heel.”

kikuyu: Dubartittiidhaanis akkana jedhe; “Yommuu ati mucaa deessutti ani dhiphina kee akka malee nan baayʼisa; ciniinsuudhaanis ijoollee ni deessa. Fedhiin kee garuma dhirsa keetii taʼa; innis sirratti ol aantummaa qabaata.”
english: To the woman he said, “I will greatly multiply your pain in childbirth. You will bear children in pain. Your desire will be for your husband, and he will rule over you.”

kikuyu: Addaamiin immoo akkana jedhe; “Waan ati dubbii niitii keetii dhageessee muka ani ija isaa irraa, ‘hin nyaatin’ jedhe irraa nyaatteef, “Lafti sababii keetiif kan abaaramte taati; atis bara jireenya keetii guutuu dadhabbiidhaan ishee irraa nyaatta.
english: To Adam he said, “Because you have listened to your wife’s voice, and have eaten from the tree, about which I commanded you, saying, ‘You shall not eat of it,’ the ground is cursed for your sake. You will eat from it with much labor all the days of your life.

kikuyu: Isheen qoraattii fi sokorruu sitti biqilchiti; atis biqiltuu lafaa ni nyaatta.
english: It will yield thorns and thistles to you; and you will eat the herb of the field.

kikuyu: Ati waan lafa irraa argamteef, hamma lafatti deebitutti dafqa fuula keetiitiin buddeena nyaatta; waan biyyoo taateefis, gara biyyootti deebita.”
english: You will eat bread by the sweat of your face until you return to the ground, for you were taken out of it. For you are dust, and you shall return to dust.”

kikuyu: Addaamis sababii isheen haadha jiraatoo hundaa taateef niitii isaa “Hewaan” jedhee moggaase.
english: The man called his wife Eve because she would be the mother of all the living.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni Addaamii fi Hewaaniif gogaa irraa uffata hojjetee isaanitti uffise.
english: The LORD God made garments of animal skins for Adam and for his wife, and clothed them.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqnis, “Kunoo namni waan gaarii fi waan hamaa beekuudhaan nu keessaa akka isa tokkoo taʼeera. Ammas harka isaa hiixatee, ija muka jireenyaa ciratee nyaachuun, bara baraanis jiraachuun isaaf eeyyamamuu hin qabu” jedhe.
english: The LORD God said, “Behold, the man has become like one of us, knowing good and evil. Now, lest he reach out his hand, and also take of the tree of life, and eat, and live forever—”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqayyo Waaqni lafa biqiltuu Eeden keessaa namicha baasee akka inni lafuma irraa argame sana misoomsu godhe.
english: Therefore the LORD God sent him out from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from which he was taken.

kikuyu: Erga nama achii baasee booddee karaa muka jireenyaatti geessu eegsisuuf jedhee kiirubeelotaa fi goraadee bobaʼu kan asii fi achi gaggaragalu tokko Iddoo Biqiltuu Eedeniitiin gama baʼa biiftuu kaaʼe.
english: So he drove out the man; and he placed cherubim at the east of the garden of Eden, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to guard the way to the tree of life.

kikuyu: Addaam niitii isaa Hewaan bira gaʼe; isheenis ulfooftee Qaayinin deesse. Isheenis, “Ani gargaarsa Waaqayyootiin ilma tokko argadheera” jette.
english: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with the LORD’s help.”

kikuyu: Itti aansitees obboleessa isaa Abeelin deesse. Abeel tiksee hoolotaa ture; Qaayin immoo lafa qota ture.
english: Again she gave birth, to Cain’s brother Abel. Abel was a keeper of sheep, but Cain was a tiller of the ground.

kikuyu: Yeroo muraasa keessatti Qaayin waan lafti baafteef keessaa Waaqayyoof aarsaa dhiʼeesse.
english: As time passed, Cain brought an offering to the LORD from the fruit of the ground.

kikuyu: Abeel immoo hangafoota hoolota isaa keessaa cooma cooma isaa dhiʼeesse. Waaqayyo faara tolaadhaan gara Abeelii fi gara aarsaa inni dhiʼeesse sanaa ilaale.
english: Abel also brought some of the firstborn of his flock and of its fat. The LORD respected Abel and his offering,

kikuyu: Gara Qaayinii fi gara aarsaa isaa garuu hin ilaalle. Kanaafuu Qaayin akka malee aaree fuulli isaa gurraachaʼe.
english: but he didn’t respect Cain and his offering. Cain was very angry, and the expression on his face fell.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Qaayiniin akkana jedhe; “Ati maaliif aarte? Fuulli kees maaliif gurraachaʼe?
english: The LORD said to Cain, “Why are you angry? Why has the expression of your face fallen?

kikuyu: Utuu waan qajeelaa hojjettee silaa ati fudhatama argatta mitii? Garuu yoo waan qajeelaa hojjechuu baatte cubbuun balbala kee duratti riphee si eeggata; si qabachuu barbaadas; ati garuu isa moʼachuu qabda.”
english: If you do well, won’t it be lifted up? If you don’t do well, sin crouches at the door. Its desire is for you, but you are to rule over it.”

kikuyu: Qaayinis ergasii obboleessa isaa Abeeliin, “Kottu mee dirreetti baanaa” jedhe. Utuma dirree irra jiranuus Qaayin obboleessa isaa Abeelitti kaʼee isa ajjeese.
english: Cain said to Abel, his brother, “Let’s go into the field.” While they were in the field, Cain rose up against Abel, his brother, and killed him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos, “Obboleessi kee Abeel eessa jira?” jedhee Qaayin gaafate. Qaayin immoo, “Ani hin beeku; ani eegduu obboleessa kootiitii?” jedhee deebise.
english: The LORD said to Cain, “Where is Abel, your brother?” He said, “I don’t know. Am I my brother’s keeper?”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akkana jedhe; “Ati maal goote? Dhiigni obboleessa keetii lafaa natti iyyaa jira.
english: The LORD said, “What have you done? The voice of your brother’s blood cries to me from the ground.

kikuyu: Ati amma abaaramaa dha; lafa dhiiga obboleessa keetii si harkaa fudhachuuf afaan banatte irraas ni ariʼamta.
english: Now you are cursed because of the ground, which has opened its mouth to receive your brother’s blood from your hand.

kikuyu: Yeroo ati lafa qotattutti lafti deebitee midhaan siif hin kennitu. Ati lafa irratti joortuu boqonnaa hin qabne taata.”
english: From now on, when you till the ground, it won’t yield its strength to you. You will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth.”

kikuyu: Qaayin immoo Waaqayyoon akkana jedhe; “Adabamuun koo waan ani baachuu dandaʼuun ol.
english: Cain said to the LORD, “My punishment is greater than I can bear.

kikuyu: Kunoo ati harʼa biyyaa na ariʼaa jirta; anis fuula kee duraa nan dhokadha; lafa irratti joortuu boqonnaa hin qabne nan taʼa; namni na argatu kam iyyuus na ajjeesa.”
english: Behold, you have driven me out today from the surface of the ground. I will be hidden from your face, and I will be a fugitive and a wanderer on the earth. Whoever finds me will kill me.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu, “Akkana miti; namni Qaayinin ajjeesu kam iyyuu dachaa torba haaloo baafama” jedheen. Waaqayyos akka namni isa argatu tokko iyyuu isa hin ajjeefneef Qaayinitti mallattoo godhe.
english: The LORD said to him, “Therefore whoever slays Cain, vengeance will be taken on him sevenfold.” The LORD appointed a sign for Cain, so that anyone finding him would not strike him.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Qaayin fuula Waaqayyoo duraa baʼee Eeden irraa karaa baʼa biiftuutiin biyya Noodi keessa jiraate.
english: Cain left the LORD’s presence, and lived in the land of Nod, east of Eden.

kikuyu: Qaayin niitii isaa beeke; isheenis ulfooftee Henookin deesse. Qaayinis magaalaa tokko hundeesse; magaalaa sanas Henook jedhee maqaa ilma isaatiin waame.
english: Cain knew his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Enoch. He built a city, and named the city after the name of his son, Enoch.

kikuyu: Henook Iiraadin dhalche; Iiraadi Meʼeelin dhalche; Mehuuyaaʼeel Matusaaʼelin dhalche; Matusaaʼel immoo Laamehin dhalche.
english: Irad was born to Enoch. Irad became the father of Mehujael. Mehujael became the father of Methushael. Methushael became the father of Lamech.

kikuyu: Laameh dubartoota maqaan isaanii Aadaa fi Xiilaa jedhamu lamaan fuudhe.
english: Lamech took two wives: the name of the first one was Adah, and the name of the second one was Zillah.

kikuyu: Aadaan Yaabaalin deesse; Yaabaalis abbaa warra dunkaana keessa jiraatanii horii horsiisanii ture.
english: Adah gave birth to Jabal, who was the father of those who dwell in tents and have livestock.

kikuyu: Maqaan obboleessa isaa Yuubaal ture; inni immoo abbaa warra kiraara rukutaniitii fi ulullee afuufanii ti.
english: His brother’s name was Jubal, who was the father of all who handle the harp and pipe.

kikuyu: Xiilaan immoo ilma Tuubaal Qaayin jedhamu kan naasii fi sibiila tumee meeshaawwan garaa garaa hojjetu deesse; obboleettiin Tuubaal Qaayinis Naʼamaa turte.
english: Zillah also gave birth to Tubal Cain, the forger of every cutting instrument of bronze and iron. Tubal Cain’s sister was Naamah.

kikuyu: Laameh niitota isaatiin akkana jedhe; “Aadaa fi Xiilaan na dhagaʼaa; yaa niitota Laamehii dubbii koo dhaggeeffadhaa. Nama tokko waan inni na madeesseef, dargaggeessa tokko waan inni na miidheef ani isa ajjeeseera.
english: Lamech said to his wives, “Adah and Zillah, hear my voice. You wives of Lamech, listen to my speech, for I have slain a man for wounding me, a young man for bruising me.

kikuyu: Yoo Qaayiniif dachaa torba haaloon baafame Laamehiif immoo dachaa torbaatamii torba ni baafama.”
english: If Cain will be avenged seven times, truly Lamech seventy-seven times.”

kikuyu: Addaam ammas niitii isaa beeke; isheenis ilma deesse; maqaa isaas, “Erga Qaayin Abeelin ajjeesee as Waaqni iddoo Abeel daaʼima biraa naa kenneera” jettee “Seeti” jettee moggaafte.
english: Adam knew his wife again. She gave birth to a son, and named him Seth, saying, “for God has given me another child instead of Abel, for Cain killed him.”

kikuyu: Seetiifis ilmi ni dhalate; innis Enoosh jedhee isa moggaase. Bara sana namoonni maqaa Waaqayyoo waammachuu jalqaban.
english: A son was also born to Seth, and he named him Enosh. At that time men began to call on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Kun galmee sanyii Addaam. Waaqni yeroo nama uumetti akka fakkeenya Waaqaatti isa tolche.
english: This is the book of the generations of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him in God’s likeness.

kikuyu: Innis dhiiraa fi dubartii taasisee isaan uume; isaan eebbises. Yeroo uumamanis “Nama” jedhee isaan waame.
english: He created them male and female, and blessed them. On the day they were created, he named them Adam.

kikuyu: Addaam waggaa 130 jiraate; innis akka fakkaattii isaatti, akka bifa isaattis ilma dhalchee Seeti jedhee maqaa baaseef.
english: Adam lived one hundred thirty years, and became the father of a son in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

kikuyu: Addaam erga Seeti dhalatee booddee waggaa 800 jiraate; innis ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: The days of Adam after he became the father of Seth were eight hundred years, and he became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Walumatti Addaam waggaa 930 jiraatee duʼe.
english: All the days that Adam lived were nine hundred thirty years, then he died.

kikuyu: Seeti waggaa 105 jiraatee Enooshin dhalche.
english: Seth lived one hundred five years, then became the father of Enosh.

kikuyu: Erga Enooshin dhalchee booddees Seeti waggaa 807 jiraate; innis ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Seth lived after he became the father of Enosh eight hundred seven years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Walumatti Seeti waggaa 912 jiraatee duʼe.
english: All of the days of Seth were nine hundred twelve years, then he died.

kikuyu: Enoosh waggaa 90 jiraatee Qeenaanin dhalche.
english: Enosh lived ninety years, and became the father of Kenan.

kikuyu: Erga Qeenaanin dhalchee booddees Enoosh waggaa 815 jiraate; innis ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Enosh lived after he became the father of Kenan eight hundred fifteen years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Walumatti Enoosh waggaa 905 jiraatee duʼe.
english: All of the days of Enosh were nine hundred five years, then he died.

kikuyu: Qeenaan waggaa 70 jiraatee Mahalaleelin dhalche.
english: Kenan lived seventy years, then became the father of Mahalalel.

kikuyu: Erga Mahalaleeliin dhalchee booddee Qeenaan waggaa 840 jiraate; innis ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Kenan lived after he became the father of Mahalalel eight hundred forty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters

kikuyu: Walumatti Qeenaan waggaa 910 jiraatee duʼe.
english: and all of the days of Kenan were nine hundred ten years, then he died.

kikuyu: Mahalaleel waggaa 65 jiraatee Yaaredin dhalche.
english: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Jared.

kikuyu: Erga Yaaredin dhalchee booddee Mahalaleel waggaa 830 jiraate; innis ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Mahalalel lived after he became the father of Jared eight hundred thirty years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Walumatti Mahalaleel waggaa 895 jiraatee duʼe.
english: All of the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred ninety-five years, then he died.

kikuyu: Yaared waggaa 162 jiraatee Henookin dhalche.
english: Jared lived one hundred sixty-two years, then became the father of Enoch.

kikuyu: Erga Henookin dhalchee booddee Yaared waggaa 800 jiraate; innis ilmaanii fi intallan biraa qaba ture.
english: Jared lived after he became the father of Enoch eight hundred years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Walumatti Yaared waggaa 962 jiraatee duʼe.
english: All of the days of Jared were nine hundred sixty-two years, then he died.

kikuyu: Henook waggaa 65 jiraatee Matuuselaa dhalche.
english: Enoch lived sixty-five years, then became the father of Methuselah.

kikuyu: Henook erga Matuuselaa dhalchee booddee waggaa 300 Waaqa wajjin deddeebiʼe; innis ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: After Methuselah’s birth, Enoch walked with God for three hundred years, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Walumatti Henook waggaa 365 jiraate.
english: All the days of Enoch were three hundred sixty-five years.

kikuyu: Henook Waaqa wajjin deddeebiʼe; waan Waaqni isa fudhateef inni deebiʼee hin argamne.
english: Enoch walked with God, and he was not found, for God took him.

kikuyu: Matuuselaan waggaa 187 jiraatee Laamehin dhalche.
english: Methuselah lived one hundred eighty-seven years, then became the father of Lamech.

kikuyu: Erga Laamehin dhalchee booddee Matuuselaan waggaa 782 jiraate; innis ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Methuselah lived after he became the father of Lamech seven hundred eighty-two years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Walumatti Matuuselaan waggaa 969 jiraatee duʼe.
english: All the days of Methuselah were nine hundred sixty-nine years, then he died.

kikuyu: Laameh waggaa 182 jiraatee ilma dhalche.
english: Lamech lived one hundred eighty-two years, then became the father of a son.

kikuyu: Innis, “Hojii nu lafa Waaqayyo abaare kana irratti hojjennuu fi dadhabbii harka keenyaa kana keessatti nu jajjabeessa” jechuudhaan maqaa isaa Nohi jedhee moggaase.
english: He named him Noah, saying, “This one will comfort us in our work and in the toil of our hands, caused by the ground which the LORD has cursed.”

kikuyu: Laameh erga Nohin dhalchee booddee waggaa 595 jiraate; innis ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Lamech lived after he became the father of Noah five hundred ninety-five years, and became the father of other sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Walumatti Laameh 777 jiraatee duʼe.
english: All the days of Lamech were seven hundred seventy-seven years, then he died.

kikuyu: Nohi erga waggaa 500 jiraatee booddee Seem, Haamii fi Yaafetin dhalche.
english: Noah was five hundred years old, then Noah became the father of Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

kikuyu: Yeroo namoonni biyya lafaa irratti baayʼachuu jalqabanii intallan dhalataniifitti,
english: When men began to multiply on the surface of the ground, and daughters were born to them,

kikuyu: Ilmaan Waaqaa akka intallan namootaa babbareedoo taʼan argan; isaan keessaas abbuma filatan fuudhan.
english: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.

kikuyu: Yommus Waaqayyo, “Namni waan foon taʼeef Hafuurri koo bara baraan isa keessa hin jiraatu; barri jireenya isaas waggaa dhibba tokkoo fi digdama taʼa” jedhe.
english: The LORD said, “My Spirit will not strive with man forever, because he also is flesh; so his days will be one hundred twenty years.”

kikuyu: Bara sanaa fi ergasiis Nefiiliimonni lafa irra turan; ilmaan Waaqaas yommuu gara intallan namaa dhaqanitti ijoollee dhalchan. Isaanis gootota durii warra beekamoo turan.
english: The Nephilim were on the earth in those days, and also after that, when God’s sons came in to men’s daughters and had children with them. Those were the mighty men who were of old, men of renown.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos akka jalʼinni namaa lafa irratti baayʼatee, wanni namni yeroo hunda garaa isaatti yaadu hundinuus jalʼaa qofa taʼe arge.
english: The LORD saw that the wickedness of man was great on the earth, and that every imagination of the thoughts of man’s heart was continually only evil.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos waan lafa irratti nama uumeef ni gaabbe; garaan isaas ni gadde.
english: The LORD was sorry that he had made man on the earth, and it grieved him in his heart.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqayyo, “Ani sanyii namaa kan ofii kootiin uume lafa irraa nan balleessa. Namaa fi horii, uumama lafa irra munyuuqu, simbirroota samii nan balleessa; ani isaan uumuu kootti gaabbeeraatii” jedhe.
english: The LORD said, “I will destroy man whom I have created from the surface of the ground—man, along with animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky—for I am sorry that I have made them.”

kikuyu: Nohi garuu fuula Waaqayyoo duratti surraa argate.
english: But Noah found favor in the LORD’s eyes.

kikuyu: Seenaan Nohii fi maatii isaa kanaa dha. Nohi namoota bara isaa turan gidduutti nama qajeelaa, nama hirʼina hin qabne kan Waaqa wajjin deddeebiʼu ture.
english: This is the history of the generations of Noah: Noah was a righteous man, blameless among the people of his time. Noah walked with God.

kikuyu: Nohi ilmaan sadii dhalche; isaanis: Seem, Haamii fi Yaafet.
english: Noah became the father of three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

kikuyu: Lafti fuula Waaqaa duratti faalamtee jeequmsaan guutamte turte.
english: The earth was corrupt before God, and the earth was filled with violence.

kikuyu: Sababii namoonni lafa irraa hundinuu karaa isaanii faalaniif, Waaqni akka lafti faalamte arge.
english: God saw the earth, and saw that it was corrupt, for all flesh had corrupted their way on the earth.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqni Nohiin akkana jedhe; “Waan lafti sababii isaaniitiin jeequmsaan guutamteef, ani nama hunda nan balleessa; kunoo ani dhugumaan lafaa fi isaan nan barbadeessa.
english: God said to Noah, “I will bring an end to all flesh, for the earth is filled with violence through them. Behold, I will destroy them and the earth.

kikuyu: Ati muka Goofar irraa doonii tolfadhu; keessa isaattis kutaa garaa garaa qopheessi; keessaa fi duuba isaas hapheedhaan duuchi.
english: Make a ship of gopher wood. You shall make rooms in the ship, and shall seal it inside and outside with pitch.

kikuyu: Haalli ati ittiin doonicha tolchitu kanaa dha; dheerina isaa dhundhuma dhibbaa sadii, balʼina isaa dhundhuma shantama, ol dheerina isaa dhundhuma soddoma godhi.
english: This is how you shall make it. The length of the ship shall be three hundred cubits, its width fifty cubits, and its height thirty cubits.

kikuyu: Doonichaaf bantii dhundhuma tokko ol kaʼu hojjedhu; cinaacha isaa irrattis balbala baasi; kanas abbaa darbii sadii jechuunis kan gadii, kan gidduutii fi kan gubbaa godhii hojjedhu.
english: You shall make a roof in the ship, and you shall finish it to a cubit upward. You shall set the door of the ship in its side. You shall make it with lower, second, and third levels.

kikuyu: Kunoo, ani uumamawwan lubbu qabeeyyii hunda samii jalaa balleessuuf bishaan badiisaa lafatti nan fida; wanni lafa irra jiraatu hundinuus ni bada.
english: I, even I, will bring the flood of waters on this earth, to destroy all flesh having the breath of life from under the sky. Everything that is on the earth will die.

kikuyu: Si wajjin garuu kakuu nan gala; atis doonii seenta; atii fi ilmaan kee, niitiin keetii fi niitonni ilmaan keetiis ni seentu.
english: But I will establish my covenant with you. You shall come into the ship, you, your sons, your wife, and your sons’ wives with you.

kikuyu: Uumamawwan lubbu qabeeyyii hundumaa keessaa akka isaan si wajjin jiraataniif lama lama, kormaa fi dhalaa doonichatti galchi.
english: Of every living thing of all flesh, you shall bring two of every sort into the ship, to keep them alive with you. They shall be male and female.

kikuyu: Simbirroota keessaa akkuma gosa gosa isaaniitti, horii keessaa akkuma gosa gosa isaaniitti, uumamawwan lafa irra munyuuqan keessaas akkuma gosa gosa isaaniitti, lama lama taʼanii jiraachuuf gara kee dhufu.
english: Of the birds after their kind, of the livestock after their kind, of every creeping thing of the ground after its kind, two of every sort will come to you, to keep them alive.

kikuyu: Waan nyaatamu hunda keessaa waa fuudhii of biratti walitti qabi! Kunis nyaata keetii fi nyaata isaanii ni taʼa.”
english: Take with you some of all food that is eaten, and gather it to yourself; and it will be for food for you, and for them.”

kikuyu: Nohi akkuma Waaqni isa ajajetti waan hunda hojjete.
english: Thus Noah did. He did all that God commanded him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Nohiin akkana jedhe; “Ani akka ati dhaloota kana keessaa na duratti qajeelaa taate argeeraatii maatii kee hundumaa wajjin doonicha seeni.
english: The LORD said to Noah, “Come with all of your household into the ship, for I have seen your righteousness before me in this generation.

kikuyu: Bineensa qulqulluu gosa hunda keessaa kormaa fi dhalaa cimdii torba, bineensa qulqulluu hin taʼin gosa hunda keessaa cimdii tokko,
english: You shall take seven pairs of every clean animal with you, the male and his female. Of the animals that are not clean, take two, the male and his female.

kikuyu: gosa simbirrootaa hunda keessaa illee akka sanyiin lafa hunda irratti hafee jiraatuuf kormaa fi dhalaa cimdii torba fudhadhuu seeni.
english: Also of the birds of the sky, seven and seven, male and female, to keep seed alive on the surface of all the earth.

kikuyu: Ani guyyaa torba booddee halkan afurtamaa fi guyyaa afurtama bokkaa nan roobsa; uumama jiraataa ani mataan koo uume hunda lafa irraa nan haxaaʼa.”
english: In seven days, I will cause it to rain on the earth for forty days and forty nights. I will destroy every living thing that I have made from the surface of the ground.”

kikuyu: Nohis waan Waaqayyo isa ajaje hunda ni hojjete.
english: Noah did everything that the LORD commanded him.

kikuyu: Yeroo bishaan badiisaa dhufetti Nohi nama waggaa dhibba jaʼa ture.
english: Noah was six hundred years old when the flood of waters came on the earth.

kikuyu: Nohii fi ilmaan isaa, niitii isaatii fi niitonni ilmaan isaa bishaan badiisaa jalaa baʼuuf doonii seenan.
english: Noah went into the ship with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives, because of the floodwaters.

kikuyu: Bineensonni qulqulluu fi kan qulqulluu hin taʼin, simbirroonnii fi uumamawwan lafa irra munyuuqan hundi, cimdii cimdiidhaan,
english: Clean animals, unclean animals, birds, and everything that creeps on the ground

kikuyu: kormaa fi dhalaan gara Nohi dhufanii akkuma Waaqni Nohiin ajajetti doonicha seenan.
english: went by pairs to Noah into the ship, male and female, as God commanded Noah.

kikuyu: Guyyaa torba booddee bishaan badiisaa lolaʼee lafa guute.
english: After the seven days, the floodwaters came on the earth.

kikuyu: Bara jireenya Nohi waggaa dhibba jaʼaffaa keessa, jiʼa lammaffaatti, jiʼa sana keessaas guyyaa kudha torbaffaatti burqaawwan tuujuba gurguddaa hundi ni dhoʼan; foddaawwan bishaan samiis ni banaman.
english: In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on that day all the fountains of the great deep burst open, and the sky’s windows opened.

kikuyu: Bokkaanis guyyaa afurtamaa fi halkan afurtama lafatti roobe.
english: It rained on the earth forty days and forty nights.

kikuyu: Guyyuma sana Nohii fi ilmaan isaa, Seem, Haamii fi Yaafet, niitii isaatii fi niitota ilmaan isaa sadanii wajjin doonicha seenan.
english: In the same day Noah, and Shem, Ham, and Japheth—the sons of Noah—and Noah’s wife and the three wives of his sons with them, entered into the ship—

kikuyu: Isaanis bineensota hunda, akkuma gosa isaaniitti, horii hunda akkuma gosa isaaniitti, uumamawwan lafa irra munyuuqan hundaa fi simbirroota hunda akkuma gosa isaaniitti, waan qoochoo qabu hundas of faana fudhatanii seenan.
english: they, and every animal after its kind, all the livestock after their kind, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth after its kind, and every bird after its kind, every bird of every sort.

kikuyu: Uumamawwan hafuura jireenyaa of keessaa qaban hundinuus cimdii cimdiidhaan gara Nohi dhufanii doonicha seenan.
english: Pairs from all flesh with the breath of life in them went into the ship to Noah.

kikuyu: Bineensonni akkuma Waaqni Nohin ajajetti dooniitti galan kormaa fi dhalaa uumamawwan lubbu qabeeyyii hundaa turan; ergasii immoo Waaqayyo alaan itti cufe.
english: Those who went in, went in male and female of all flesh, as God commanded him; then the LORD shut him in.

kikuyu: Bishaan badiisaas ittuma fufee guyyaa afurtamaaf lafa irra ture; bishaan sunis dabalaa deemee doonii sana lafa irraa ol kaase.
english: The flood was forty days on the earth. The waters increased, and lifted up the ship, and it was lifted up above the earth.

kikuyu: Bishaanichis ol kaʼee lafa irratti akka malee baayʼate; dooniin sunis bishaanicha irra deeme.
english: The waters rose, and increased greatly on the earth; and the ship floated on the surface of the waters.

kikuyu: Bishaanichis akka malee ol kaʼaa deemee tulluuwwan samii jala jiran hunda haguuge.
english: The waters rose very high on the earth. All the high mountains that were under the whole sky were covered.

kikuyu: Bishaanichi dhundhuma kudha shan caalaa ol kaʼuudhaan tulluuwwan dhokse.
english: The waters rose fifteen cubits higher, and the mountains were covered.

kikuyu: Uumamawwan lubbu qabeeyyiin lafa irra jiraatan hundi jechuunis, simbirroonni, horiin, bineensonni, uumamawwan lafa irra munyuuqan hundii fi namoonni hundi ni barbadaaʼan.
english: All flesh died that moved on the earth, including birds, livestock, animals, every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, and every man.

kikuyu: Wanni lafa gogaa irra jiraatu kan funyaan isaatiin hafuura jireenyaa baafatu hundinuu ni duʼe.
english: All on the dry land, in whose nostrils was the breath of the spirit of life, died.

kikuyu: Uumamawwan lubbu qabeeyyiin lafa irra jiraatan hundinuu ni haxaaʼaman; namnii fi horiin, uumamawwan lafa irra munyuuqanii fi simbirroonni samii, lafa irraa ni haxaaʼaman. Nohii fi warra isa wajjin doonii keessa turan qofattu hafe.
english: Every living thing was destroyed that was on the surface of the ground, including man, livestock, creeping things, and birds of the sky. They were destroyed from the earth. Only Noah was left, and those who were with him in the ship.

kikuyu: Bishaan sunis bultii dhibba tokkoo fi shantama lafa irra lolaʼe.
english: The waters flooded the earth one hundred fifty days.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu Nohin, bineensotaa fi horii isa wajjin doonii keessa turan hunda yaadate. Innis bubbee lafatti erge; bishaanichis gad gale.
english: God remembered Noah, all the animals, and all the livestock that were with him in the ship; and God made a wind to pass over the earth. The waters subsided.

kikuyu: Burqaawwan tuujubawwaniitii fi foddaawwan samiiwwanii ni cufaman; bokkaan samii keessaa gad roobus ni caame.
english: The deep’s fountains and the sky’s windows were also stopped, and the rain from the sky was restrained.

kikuyu: Bishaan sunis suutuma suuta lafa irraa hirʼachaa deemee dhuma bultii dhibba tokkoo fi shantamaatti gad buʼe.
english: The waters continually receded from the earth. After the end of one hundred fifty days the waters receded.

kikuyu: Dooniin sunis guyyaa kudha torbaffaa jiʼa torbaffaatti tulluu Araaraati gubbaa qubate.
english: The ship rested in the seventh month, on the seventeenth day of the month, on Ararat’s mountains.

kikuyu: Bishaanichi hamma jiʼa kurnaffaatti gaduma galaa deeme. Guyyaa jalqaba jiʼa kurnaffaattis mataawwan tulluuwwanii mulʼatan.
english: The waters receded continually until the tenth month. In the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the tops of the mountains were visible.

kikuyu: Guyyaa afurtama booddee Nohi foddaa dooniitti baasee ture sana bane;
english: At the end of forty days, Noah opened the window of the ship which he had made,

kikuyu: innis arraagessa tokko gad dhiise; arraagessi sunis hamma bishaanichi lafa irraa gogutti asii fi achi deddeebiʼaa ture.
english: and he sent out a raven. It went back and forth, until the waters were dried up from the earth.

kikuyu: Ergasii immoo akka bishaanichi lafa irraa hirʼate hubachuuf gugee tokko erge.
english: He himself sent out a dove to see if the waters were abated from the surface of the ground,

kikuyu: Garuu sababii bishaan lafa hunda irra guutee jiruuf gugeen sun iddoo qubatu dhabdee gara Nohi dooniitti deebite. Innis harka isaa gad hiixatee gugee sana gara dooniitti iddoo ofii jirutti ol galche.
english: but the dove found no place to rest her foot, and she returned into the ship to him, for the waters were on the surface of the whole earth. He put out his hand, and took her, and brought her to him into the ship.

kikuyu: Ammas guyyaa torba turee gugee sana doonii keessaa gad baasee erge.
english: He waited yet another seven days; and again he sent the dove out of the ship.

kikuyu: Gugeen sunis galgala yommuu gara isaatti deebitetti kunoo, baala ejersaa kan amma kutame afaanitti qabattee turte. Kanaanis Nohi akka bishaanichi gad hirʼate beeke.
english: The dove came back to him at evening and, behold, in her mouth was a freshly plucked olive leaf. So Noah knew that the waters were abated from the earth.

kikuyu: Ammas guyyaa biraa torba turee gugee sana deebisee erge; gugeen sun garuu lammata gara isaatti hin deebine.
english: He waited yet another seven days, and sent out the dove; and she didn’t return to him any more.

kikuyu: Umurii Nohii waggaa dhibba jaʼaa fi tokkoffaatti, guyyaa tokkoffaa jiʼa jalqabaatti, bishaanichi lafa irraa goge. Nohis qadaada doonii sanaa irraa fuudhee ilaalee kunoo akka lafti gogde arge.
english: In the six hundred first year, in the first month, the first day of the month, the waters were dried up from the earth. Noah removed the covering of the ship, and looked. He saw that the surface of the ground was dry.

kikuyu: Guyyaa digdamii torbaffaa jiʼa lammaffaatti lafti guutummaan guutuutti gogde.
english: In the second month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, the earth was dry.

kikuyu: Waaqnis Nohiin akkana jedhe;
english: God spoke to Noah, saying,

kikuyu: “Atii fi niitiin kee, ilmaan keetii fi niitonni ilmaan keetii kottaa doonii keessaa baʼaa.
english: “Go out of the ship, you, your wife, your sons, and your sons’ wives with you.

kikuyu: Akka isaan lafa irratti baayʼataniif, akka isaan horanii lafa irratti baayʼataniif, gosa uumamawwan lubbu qabeeyyii si wajjin jiran hunda jechuunis simbirroota, bineensotaa fi uumamawwan lafa irra munyuuqan hunda gad baasi.”
english: Bring out with you every living thing that is with you of all flesh, including birds, livestock, and every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, that they may breed abundantly on the earth, and be fruitful, and multiply on the earth.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Nohi ilmaan isaatii fi niitii isaa, niitota ilmaan isaa wajjin gad baʼe.
english: Noah went out, with his sons, his wife, and his sons’ wives with him.

kikuyu: Bineensonni hundii fi uumamawwan lafa irra munyuuqan hundinuu, simbirroonni hundi jechuunis wanni lafa irra jiraatu hundi gosuma gosaan doonii sana keessaa gad baʼan.
english: Every animal, every creeping thing, and every bird, whatever moves on the earth, after their families, went out of the ship.

kikuyu: Nohis Waaqayyoof iddoo aarsaa ijaare; horii fi simbirroota qulqulluu hunda keessaa fuudhee iddoo aarsaa sana irratti aarsaa gubamu dhiʼeesse.
english: Noah built an altar to the LORD, and took of every clean animal, and of every clean bird, and offered burnt offerings on the altar.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos foolii tolaa sana urgeeffatee garaa isaa keessatti akkana jedhe; “Yoo wanni namni ijoollummaa isaatii jalqabee garaa isaatti yaadu hammina taʼe illee ani sababii namaatiif jedhee lammata lafa hin abaaru. Ani akkan kanaan dura godhe sana deebiʼee uumamawwan jiraatoo hunda hin balleessu.
english: The LORD smelled the pleasant aroma. The LORD said in his heart, “I will not again curse the ground any more for man’s sake because the imagination of man’s heart is evil from his youth. I will never again strike every living thing, as I have done.

kikuyu: “Hamma lafti jirtutti, midhaan facaasuu fi walitti qabuun, dhaamochii fi hoʼi, bonnii fi ganni, halkanii fi guyyaan gonkumaa hin hafan.”
english: While the earth remains, seed time and harvest, and cold and heat, and summer and winter, and day and night will not cease.”

kikuyu: Waaqni akkana jedhee Nohii fi ilmaan isaa eebbise; “Horaa, baayʼadhaa, lafas guutaa.
english: God blessed Noah and his sons, and said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, and replenish the earth.

kikuyu: Sodaachisuu fi naasisuun keessan bineensota lafaa hundumaa fi simbirroota samii hundumaa, uumamawwan lafa irra munyuuqan hundumaa fi qurxummiiwwan galaanaa hundumaa irra haa buʼu; isaan harka keessanitti kennamaniiru.
english: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.

kikuyu: Wanni jiraatuu fi wanni munyuuqu hundi nyaata isiniif ni taʼa. Ani akkuman biqila lalisaa isinii kenne sana ammas waan hunda isiniif nan kenna.
english: Every moving thing that lives will be food for you. As I gave you the green herb, I have given everything to you.

kikuyu: “Isin garuu foon lubbuu isaa wajjin jechuunis dhiiga isaa wajjin hin nyaatinaa.
english: But flesh with its life, that is, its blood, you shall not eat.

kikuyu: Ani dhugumaan dhiiga keessan kan lubbuun keessan keessa jirtu nan barbaada. Bineensa hunda irraa nan barbaada. Obboleessa nama hundaa irraas lubbuu namaa nan barbaada.
english: I will surely require accounting for your life’s blood. At the hand of every animal I will require it. At the hand of man, even at the hand of every man’s brother, I will require the life of man.

kikuyu: “Nama dhiiga namaa dhangalaasu, dhiigni isaa harka namaatiin dhangalaafama; Waaqni bifa Waaqaatiin nama uumeetii.
english: Whoever sheds man’s blood, his blood will be shed by man, for God made man in his own image.

kikuyu: Isinis horaa, baayʼadhaa; lafa guutaa, irrattis baayʼadhaa.”
english: Be fruitful and multiply. Increase abundantly on the earth, and multiply in it.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Waaqni Nohii fi ilmaan isaa warra isaa wajjin turaniin akkana jedhe;
english: God spoke to Noah and to his sons with him, saying,

kikuyu: “Kunoo ani isinii fi sanyii keessan warra isin booddee wajjin kakuu koo nan hundeessa.
english: “As for me, behold, I establish my covenant with you, and with your offspring after you,

kikuyu: Akkasumas uumamawwan lubbu qabeeyyii isin wajjin turan hunda jechuunis simbirroota, horii fi bineensota lafaa hunda, waan isin wajjin doonii keessaa baʼe hunda, uumamawwan lafa irra jiraatan hunda wajjinis kakuu koo nan hundeessa.
english: and with every living creature that is with you: the birds, the livestock, and every animal of the earth with you, of all that go out of the ship, even every animal of the earth.

kikuyu: Akka siʼachi wanni lubbuu qabu hundi deebiʼee bishaan badiisaatiin hin badneef, siʼachi bishaan badiisaa lafa balleessuuf gonkumaa akka hin dhufneef ani isin wajjin kakuu koo nan hundeessa.”
english: I will establish my covenant with you: All flesh will not be cut off any more by the waters of the flood. There will never again be a flood to destroy the earth.”

kikuyu: Waaqni akkana jedhe; “Mallattoon kakuu kan ani ofii kootii fi isin gidduutti, uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyii isin bira jiran hunda gidduutti, dhaloota dhufuuf jiru hundaaf galu kanaa dha.
english: God said, “This is the token of the covenant which I make between me and you and every living creature that is with you, for perpetual generations:

kikuyu: Ani sabbata koo duumessa keessa dhaabeera; innis kakuu anaa fi lafa gidduu jiruuf mallattoo taʼa.
english: I set my rainbow in the cloud, and it will be a sign of a covenant between me and the earth.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani lafa irratti duumessa fidee sabbanni koo duumessa keessaan mulʼatutti,
english: When I bring a cloud over the earth, that the rainbow will be seen in the cloud,

kikuyu: ani kakuu koo kan ofii kootii fi isin gidduu, uumamawwan lubbu qabeeyyii gosa hundaa gidduus jiru sana nan yaadadha. Bishaanonnis deebiʼanii lubbuu hunda balleessuuf gonkumaa bishaan badiisaa hin taʼan.
english: I will remember my covenant, which is between me and you and every living creature of all flesh, and the waters will no more become a flood to destroy all flesh.

kikuyu: Yeroo sabbanni koo duumessa keessaan mulʼatutti, ani isa ilaalee kakuu bara baraa kan Waaqaa fi uumamawwan lubbu qabeeyyii gosa hundaa kanneen lafa irra jiraatan gidduu jiru sana nan yaadadha.”
english: The rainbow will be in the cloud. I will look at it, that I may remember the everlasting covenant between God and every living creature of all flesh that is on the earth.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqni Nohiin, “Kun mallattoo kakuu ani ofii kootii fi lubbuu lafa irra jiraatu hunda gidduu dhaabe sanaa ti” jedhe.
english: God said to Noah, “This is the token of the covenant which I have established between me and all flesh that is on the earth.”

kikuyu: Ilmaan Nohi warri doonii keessaa baʼan Seem, Haamii fi Yaafet turan. Haam abbaa Kanaʼaanii ti.
english: The sons of Noah who went out from the ship were Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Ham is the father of Canaan.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Nohi jara kana sadan turan; sanyiin namaa kan lafa hunda irra bittinneeffames isaanuma irraa argame.
english: These three were the sons of Noah, and from these the whole earth was populated.

kikuyu: Nohi qonnaan bulaa taʼee wayinii dhaabuutti nama jalqabaa ture.
english: Noah began to be a farmer, and planted a vineyard.

kikuyu: Innis daadhii wayinii sanaa dhugee machaaʼe; qullaa isaas dunkaana isaa keessa ciise.
english: He drank of the wine and got drunk. He was uncovered within his tent.

kikuyu: Haam abbaan Kanaʼaan qullaa abbaa isaa argee obboloota isaa lamaan ala turanitti hime.
english: Ham, the father of Canaan, saw the nakedness of his father, and told his two brothers outside.

kikuyu: Seemii fi Yaafeti garuu wayyaa fuudhanii gatiittii isaanii lamaan irra buufatanii dugda duubaan deemanii qullaa abbaa isaaniitti uffisan. Waan fuulli isaanii achi garagalee tureef isaan qullaa abbaa isaanii hin argine.
english: Shem and Japheth took a garment, and laid it on both their shoulders, went in backwards, and covered the nakedness of their father. Their faces were backwards, and they didn’t see their father’s nakedness.

kikuyu: Nohis yeroo machiin isaa irraa galetti waan ilmi isaa inni xinnaan isatti hojjete beekee
english: Noah awoke from his wine, and knew what his youngest son had done to him.

kikuyu: akkana jedhe; “Kanaʼaan abaaramaa haa taʼu! Inni obboloota isaatiif garba garbootaa haa taʼu.”
english: He said, “Canaan is cursed. He will be a servant of servants to his brothers.”

kikuyu: Akkanas jedhe; “Waaqayyo Waaqni Seem haa eebbifamu! Kanaʼaan immoo garbicha Seem haa taʼu.
english: He said, “Blessed be the LORD, the God of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.

kikuyu: Waaqni biyya Yaafet haa balʼisu; Yaafet dunkaanota Seem keessa haa jiraatu; Kanaʼaan immoo garbicha isaa haa taʼu.”
english: May God enlarge Japheth. Let him dwell in the tents of Shem. Let Canaan be his servant.”

kikuyu: Bishaan badiisaa booddee Nohi waggaa 350 jiraate.
english: Noah lived three hundred fifty years after the flood.

kikuyu: Walumatti Nohi waggaa 950 jiraatee duʼe.
english: All the days of Noah were nine hundred fifty years, and then he died.

kikuyu: Seenaan ilmaan Nohi jechuunis kan Seem, kan Haamii fi kan Yaafet kana; isaanis bishaan badiisaa booddee ilmaan dhalchan.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of the sons of Noah and of Shem, Ham, and Japheth. Sons were born to them after the flood.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yaafet: Goomer, Maagoog, Meedee, Yaawaan, Tuubaal, Meshekii fi Tiiraas turan.
english: The sons of Japheth were: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Goomer: Ashkenas, Riifaatii fi Toogarmaa turan.
english: The sons of Gomer were: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yaawaan: Eliishaa, Tarshiish, Kitiimii fi Roodaanota turan.
english: The sons of Javan were: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

kikuyu: Uummanni qarqara galaanaas tokkoon tokkoon isaanii akkuma afaan isaaniittii fi akkuma saba isaaniitti gara biyyoota isaaniitti bibittinnaaʼan.
english: Of these were the islands of the nations divided in their lands, everyone after his language, after their families, in their nations.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Haam: Kuushi, Misrayim, Fuuxii fi Kanaʼaan turan.
english: The sons of Ham were: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Kuushi: Saabaa, Hawiilaa, Sabtaa, Raʼimaa fi Sabtekaa turan. Ilmaan Raʼimaa: Shebaa fi Dedaan turan.
english: The sons of Cush were: Seba, Havilah, Sabtah, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah were: Sheba and Dedan.

kikuyu: Kuushi abbaa Naamruud; Naamruudis lafa irratti loltuu jabaa taʼe.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

kikuyu: Innis fuula Waaqayyoo duratti adamsaa jabaa ture; kanaafuu, “Fuula Waaqayyoo duratti adamsaa jabaa akka Naamruudi” jedhame.
english: He was a mighty hunter before the LORD. Therefore it is said, “like Nimrod, a mighty hunter before the LORD”.

kikuyu: Jalqabni mootummaa isaa Shineʼaar keessatti Baabilon, Ereki, Akaadii fi Kaalnee ture.
english: The beginning of his kingdom was Babel, Erech, Accad, and Calneh, in the land of Shinar.

kikuyu: Innis biyya sanaa baʼee Asoor dhaqe; achittis Nanawwee, Rehoobootii fi Kaalahi ijaare;
english: Out of that land he went into Assyria, and built Nineveh, Rehoboth Ir, Calah,

kikuyu: akkasumas Resen ishee Nanawwee fi Kaalah gidduutti argamtu ni ijaare; Resen kunis magaalaa guddoo dha.
english: and Resen between Nineveh and the great city Calah.

kikuyu: Misrayim immoo abbaa Luudiimootaa, Anaamiimotaa, Lehaabiimotaa, Naftahiimootaa,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

kikuyu: Fatrusiimotaa, Kaseluhiimotaa, jechuunis warra Filisxeemonni irraa dhalatanii fi Kaftooriimotaa ti.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (which the Philistines descended from), and Caphtorim.

kikuyu: Kanaʼaan abbaa Siidoon ilma isaa hangaftichaa, akkasumas kan Heetotaa,
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon (his firstborn), Heth,

kikuyu: Yebuusotaa, Amoorotaa, Girgaashotaa,
english: the Jebusites, the Amorites, the Girgashites,

kikuyu: Hiiwotaa, Arkaawotaa, Siinotaa,
english: the Hivites, the Arkites, the Sinites,

kikuyu: Arwaadewotaa, Zemaarotaatii fi Hamaatotaa ture. Ergasii gosoonni Kanaʼaan ni bibittinnaaʼan;
english: the Arvadites, the Zemarites, and the Hamathites. Afterward the families of the Canaanites were spread abroad.

kikuyu: daariin Kanaʼaanis Siidoonii kaʼee karaa Geraaraatiin hamma Gaazaatti balʼate; karaa Sodoom, Gomoraa, Adimaatii fi Zebooʼiimiitiinis hamma Leshaatti balʼate.
english: The border of the Canaanites was from Sidon—as you go toward Gerar—to Gaza—as you go toward Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim—to Lasha.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Haam akkuma gosaa fi afaan isaaniitti, akkuma biyyaa fi saba isaaniitti kanneenii dha.
english: These are the sons of Ham, after their families, according to their languages, in their lands and their nations.

kikuyu: Seemiifis ilmaan ni dhalatan; obboleessi Seem hangafti Yaafet ture; Seemis abbaa ilmaan Eeber hundaa ture.
english: Children were also born to Shem (the elder brother of Japheth), the father of all the children of Eber.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Seem Eelaam, Ashuur, Arfaakshad, Luudii fi Arraam turan.
english: The sons of Shem were: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, and Aram.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Arraam Uuzi, Huuli, Geterii fi Meshek turan.
english: The sons of Aram were: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Mash.

kikuyu: Arfaakshad Sheelaa dhalche; Sheelaan immoo Eeberin dhalche.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.

kikuyu: Eeberiifis ilmaan lamatu dhalate; sababii bara isaa keessa lafti gargar qoodamteef maqaan isa tokkoo Felegi jedhamee moggaafame; maqaan obboleessa isaa immoo Yooqxaan jedhamee moggaafame.
english: To Eber were born two sons. The name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided. His brother’s name was Joktan.

kikuyu: Yooqxaan immoo Almoodaad, Sheleef, Hazarmaawet, Yaaraa,
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

kikuyu: Hadooraam, Uuzaal, Diqlaa,
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

kikuyu: Oobaal, Abiimaaʼeel, Shebaa,
english: Obal, Abimael, Sheba,

kikuyu: Oofiir, Hawiilaa fi Yoobaabin dhalche. Warri kunneen hundinuu ilmaan Yooqxaanii ti.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

kikuyu: Lafti jireenya isaanii Meeshaa kaʼee karaa Sefaariitiin hamma gaarran baʼa biiftuutti balʼata.
english: Their dwelling extended from Mesha, as you go toward Sephar, the mountain of the east.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Seemi akkuma gosaa fi afaan isaaniitti, akkuma biyyaa fi saba isaaniitti kanneenii dha.
english: These are the sons of Shem, by their families, according to their languages, lands, and nations.

kikuyu: Warri kun gosoota ilmaan Nohi kanneen akkuma dhaloota isaaniitti saba isaanii keessa jiranii dha; bishaan badiisaatiin booddee saboonni warruma kana irraa lafa irra faffacaʼan.
english: These are the families of the sons of Noah, by their generations, according to their nations. The nations divided from these on the earth after the flood.

kikuyu: Bara sana addunyaan guutuun afaan tokkoo fi haasaa tokko qaba ture.
english: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.

kikuyu: Namoonni akkuma gara baʼa biiftuutti godaananiin, Shineʼaar keessatti lafa diriiraa argatanii achi qubatan.
english: As they traveled east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Kottaa mee xuubii hojjennee ibiddaan gubnaa” waliin jedhan. Isaanis qooda dhagaa, xuubiitti fayyadaman; hapheedhaaf immoo leeleetti fayyadaman.
english: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.

kikuyu: Ergasii, “Kottaa mee akka ofii keenyaa maqaa argannuu fi akka addunyaa guutuu irra hin bibittinnoofneef magaalaa gamoon isaa samii qaqqabu tokko ijaarrannaa” jedhan.
english: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu magaalaa fi gamoo isaan ijaaraa turan sana ilaaluuf gad buʼe.
english: The LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos akkana jedhe; “Erga isaan akka saba tokko kan afaanuma tokko dubbatuutti waan kana hojjechuu jalqabanii, yoos amma wanni isaan hojjechuuf karoorfatan kan isaaniif hin dandaʼamne tokko iyyuu hin jiraatu.
english: The LORD said, “Behold, they are one people, and they all have one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.

kikuyu: Kottaa mee gad buunee, akka isaan wal hin hubanneef afaan isaanii waliin dhoofnaa!”
english: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqayyo achii isaan baasee lafa hunda irra isaan bittinneesse; isaanis magaalaa ijaaruu dhiisan.
english: So the LORD scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.

kikuyu: Waan Waaqayyo achitti afaan addunyaa hunda waliin makeef iddoon sun Baabilon jedhame; Waaqayyo iddoo sanaa isaan baasee lafa hunda irra isaan bittinneesse.
english: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there the LORD confused the language of all the earth. From there, the LORD scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.

kikuyu: Seenaan maatii Seem kana. Bishaan badiisaa booddee waggaa lamatti Seem yeroo umuriin isaa waggaa 100 guutetti Arfaakshadin dhalche.
english: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.

kikuyu: Seem erga Arfaakshadin dhalchee booddee waggaa 500 jiraatee ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Arfaakshad waggaa 35 jiraatee Sheelaa dhalche.
english: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

kikuyu: Arfaakshad erga Sheelaa dhalchee booddee waggaa 403 jiraatee ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Sheelaan waggaa 30 jiraatee Eeberin dhalche.
english: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.

kikuyu: Sheelaan erga Eeberin dhalchee booddee waggaa 403 jiraatee ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Eeber waggaa 34 jiraatee Felegin dhalche.
english: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.

kikuyu: Eeber erga Felegin dhalchee booddee waggaa 430 jiraatee ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Felegi waggaa 30 jiraatee Reʼuu dhalche.
english: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.

kikuyu: Felegi erga Reʼuu dhalchee booddee waggaa 209 jiraatee ilmaanii fi intallan biraas dhalche.
english: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Reʼuun waggaa 32 jiraatee Seruugin dhalche.
english: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.

kikuyu: Reʼuun erga Seruugin dhalchee booddee waggaa 207 jiraatee ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Seruugi waggaa 30 jiraatee Naahoorin dhalche.
english: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.

kikuyu: Seruugi erga Naahoorin dhalchee booddee waggaa 200 jiraatee ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Naahoor waggaa 29 jiraatee Taaraa dhalche.
english: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.

kikuyu: Naahoor erga Taaraa dhalchee booddee waggaa 119 jiraatee ilmaanii fi intallan biraa dhalche.
english: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Taaraan waggaa 70 jiraatee Abraam, Naahoorii fi Haaraanin dhalche.
english: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

kikuyu: Seenaan maatii Taaraa kana. Taaraan Abraam, Naahoorii fi Haaraanin dhalche. Haaraan immoo Looxin dhalche.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.

kikuyu: Haaraan utuma abbaan isaa Taaraan jiruu Uuri biyya Kaldootaa keessatti lafuma itti dhalatetti duʼe.
english: Haran died in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees, while his father Terah was still alive.

kikuyu: Abraamii fi Naahoor niitii fuudhan. Maqaan niitii Abraam Saaraa, maqaan niitii Naahoor immoo Miilkaa ture. Miilkaan intala Haaraan. Haaraan kun immoo abbaa Miikaatii fi Yiskaa ture.
english: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, who was also the father of Iscah.

kikuyu: Saaraan dhabduu turte; ijoollees hin deenye.
english: Sarai was barren. She had no child.

kikuyu: Taaraan ilma isaa Abraamin, ilma ilma isaa jechuunis Loox ilma Haaraanii fi niitii ilma isaa jechuunis Saaraa niitii Abraam fudhatee Kanaʼaan dhaquuf, Uuri biyya Kaldootaatii walii wajjin baʼan; garuu yeroo Kaaraan gaʼanitti achuma qubatan.
english: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.

kikuyu: Taaraan waggaa 205 jiraatee Kaaraanitti duʼe.
english: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Abraamiin akkana jedhe; “Biyya kee, saba keetii fi mana abbaa keetii dhiisiitii gara biyya ani si argisiisuu dhaqi.
english: Now the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, and your relatives, and your father’s house, and go to the land that I will show you.

kikuyu: “Ani saba guddaa sin taasisa; sin eebbisas; maqaa kee illee guddaa nan taasisa; atis eebba taataa.
english: I will make of you a great nation. I will bless you and make your name great. You will be a blessing.

kikuyu: Ani warra si eebbisan nan eebbisa; warra si abaaran nan abaara; sabni lafa irraa hundinuu karaa keetiin eebbifama.”
english: I will bless those who bless you, and I will curse him who treats you with contempt. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Abraam akkuma Waaqayyo isatti himetti kaʼee deeme; Looxis isa wajjin deeme. Abraam yeroo Kaaraanii baʼetti nama waggaa torbaatamii shan ture.
english: So Abram went, as the LORD had told him. Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he departed from Haran.

kikuyu: Innis niitii isaa Saaraa, ilma obboleessa isaa Loox, qabeenya walitti kuufatan hundumaa fi namoota Kaaraanitti argatan hundumaa qabatee Kanaʼaan dhaquuf kaʼe; isaanis achi gaʼan.
english: Abram took Sarai his wife, Lot his brother’s son, all their possessions that they had gathered, and the people whom they had acquired in Haran, and they went to go into the land of Canaan. They entered into the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Abraamis hamma qilxuu Mooree kan Sheekem keessatti argamuutti biyyattii keessa deeme. Yeroo sana warri Kanaʼaan biyya sana keessa turan.
english: Abram passed through the land to the place of Shechem, to the oak of Moreh. At that time, Canaanites were in the land.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Abraamitti mulʼatee, “Ani biyya kana sanyii keetiif nan kenna” jedheen. Kanaafuu inni achitti Waaqayyo isatti mulʼate sanaaf iddoo aarsaa ijaare.
english: The LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” He built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.

kikuyu: Achii kaʼee gara gaarran Beetʼeel irraa gara baʼa biiftuutti argamanii deemee Beetʼeelin gara lixa biiftuutti, Aayin immoo gara baʼa biiftuutti hambisee dunkaana isaa dhaabbate. Achitti Waaqayyoof iddoo aarsaa ijaaree maqaa Waaqayyoo waammate.
english: He left from there to go to the mountain on the east of Bethel and pitched his tent, having Bethel on the west, and Ai on the east. There he built an altar to the LORD and called on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Abraam ergasii kaʼee gara Negeebitti karaa isaa itti fufe.
english: Abram traveled, still going on toward the South.

kikuyu: Bara sana beelli biyya sanatti buʼee ture; beelli sun waan hammaateef Abraam achi jiraachuuf jedhee Gibxitti gad buʼe.
english: There was a famine in the land. Abram went down into Egypt to live as a foreigner there, for the famine was severe in the land.

kikuyu: Innis yeroo Gibxi seenuu gaʼetti niitii isaa Saaraan akkana jedhe; “Ani akka ati dubartii bareedduu taate nan beeka.
english: When he had come near to enter Egypt, he said to Sarai his wife, “See now, I know that you are a beautiful woman to look at.

kikuyu: Warri Gibxi yommuu si argan, ‘Kun niitii isaa ti’ jedhanii na ajjeesu; siʼi immoo ni hambisu.
english: It will happen that when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ They will kill me, but they will save you alive.

kikuyu: Akka isaan siif jedhanii haala tolaan na ilaalanii fi akka lubbuun koos sababii keetiin duʼa ooltuuf maaloo, ‘Ani obboleettii isaa ti’ jedhi.”
english: Please say that you are my sister, that it may be well with me for your sake, and that my soul may live because of you.”

kikuyu: Yeroo Abraam Gibxi seenettis warri Gibxi akka Sooraan dubartii baayʼee bareedduu taate argan.
english: When Abram had come into Egypt, some Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.

kikuyu: Qondaaltonni Faraʼooniis yommuu ishee arganitti ishee jajanii Faraʼoonitti himan; isheenis masaraa mootummaa Faraʼooniitti geeffamte.
english: The princes of Pharaoh saw her, and praised her to Pharaoh; and the woman was taken into Pharaoh’s house.

kikuyu: Faraʼoon sababii isheetiif jedhee Abraamin haala tolaadhaan ilaale; Abraamis hoolotaa fi loon, harroota korommii fi dhaltuu, tajaajiltoota dhiiraa dubartii, gaalas argate.
english: He dealt well with Abram for her sake. He had sheep, cattle, male donkeys, male servants, female servants, female donkeys, and camels.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu sababii niitii Abraam, sababii Saaraatiif jedhee Faraʼoonii fi warra mana isaa jiraatan dhukkuba hamaan dhaʼe.
english: The LORD afflicted Pharaoh and his house with great plagues because of Sarai, Abram’s wife.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Faraʼoon Abraamin ofitti waamee akkana jedheen; “Ati maal natti hojjette? Akka isheen niitii kee taate maaliif natti hin himin?
english: Pharaoh called Abram and said, “What is this that you have done to me? Why didn’t you tell me that she was your wife?

kikuyu: Ati maaliif, ‘Isheen obboleettii koo ti’ jettee, akka ani niitummaaf ishee fudhadhu na goote? Ammas niitiin kee kunoo ti; ishee fudhadhuu deemi!”
english: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her to be my wife? Now therefore, see your wife, take her, and go your way.”

kikuyu: Faraʼoonis waaʼee Abraam irratti namoota isaa ajaje; isaanis Abraamii fi niitii isaa, waan inni qabu hunda wajjin geggeessan.
english: Pharaoh commanded men concerning him, and they escorted him away with his wife and all that he had.

kikuyu: Abraam niitii isaatii fi waan qabu hunda wajjin Gibxii kaʼee Negeebitti ol baʼe; Looxis isa wajjin deeme.
english: Abram went up out of Egypt—he, his wife, all that he had, and Lot with him—into the South.

kikuyu: Abraamis horiin, meetii fi warqeedhaan akka malee soorome.
english: Abram was very rich in livestock, in silver, and in gold.

kikuyu: Innis Negeebii kaʼee hamma Beetʼeel, iddoo Beetʼeelii fi Aayi gidduu, lafa dunkaanni isaa jalqabatti ture sana gaʼutti iddoo tokkoo gara iddoo biraatti deemsa isaa itti fufe;
english: He went on his journeys from the South as far as Bethel, to the place where his tent had been at the beginning, between Bethel and Ai,

kikuyu: iddoon sunis lafa inni yeroo jalqabaatiif iddoo aarsaa itti ijaaree dha. Abraamis achitti maqaa Waaqayyoo waammate.
english: to the place of the altar, which he had made there at the first. There Abram called on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Loox namichi Abraam wajjin deemaa ture suni akkasuma bushaayee, saawwanii fi dunkaanota qaba ture.
