english: Lot also, who went with Abram, had flocks, herds, and tents.

kikuyu: Yeroo isaan walii wajjin jiraatanitti lafti isaanitti dhiphatte; sababii qabeenyi isaanii akka malee guddateefis isaan wal bira jiraachuu hin dandeenye.
english: The land was not able to bear them, that they might live together; for their possessions were so great that they couldn’t live together.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu tiksoota Abraamii fi tiksoota Loox gidduutti lolli uumame. Yeroo sanatti Kanaʼaanonnii fi Feerzonnis biyya sana keessa jiraachaa turan.
english: There was strife between the herdsmen of Abram’s livestock and the herdsmen of Lot’s livestock. The Canaanites and the Perizzites lived in the land at that time.

kikuyu: Abraamis Looxiin akkana jedhe; “Nu waan obboloota taaneef, siʼii fi ana gidduu yookaan tiksoota keetii fi tiksoota koo gidduu lolli hin jiraatin.
english: Abram said to Lot, “Please, let there be no strife between you and me, and between your herdsmen and my herdsmen; for we are relatives.

kikuyu: Lafti hundi fuula kee dura jirti mitii? Kottu gargari godaannaa. Yoo ati gara bitaatti deemte, ani gara mirgaatti nan deema; yoo ati gara mirgaatti deemte immoo ani gara bitaatti nan deema.”
english: Isn’t the whole land before you? Please separate yourself from me. If you go to the left hand, then I will go to the right. Or if you go to the right hand, then I will go to the left.”

kikuyu: Looxis ol jedhee ilaalee akka hurufni Yordaanos hundi akkuma iddoo biqiltuu Waaqayyoo akkuma biyya Gibxi kan karaa Zoʼaar irra jiru sanaa bishaan baayʼee qabu arge. Kunis utuu Waaqayyo Sodoomii fi Gomoraa hin balleessiniin dura ture.
english: Lot lifted up his eyes, and saw all the plain of the Jordan, that it was well-watered everywhere, before the LORD destroyed Sodom and Gomorrah, like the garden of the LORD, like the land of Egypt, as you go to Zoar.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Loox hurufa Yordaanos guutummaatti ofii isaatii filatee gara baʼa biiftuutti godaane. Jarri lamaanis akkasitti gargari baʼan.
english: So Lot chose the Plain of the Jordan for himself. Lot traveled east, and they separated themselves from one another.

kikuyu: Abraam biyya Kanaʼaan keessa jiraate; Loox immoo magaalaawwan dirree irra jiran gidduu jiraatee dunkaana isaa Sodoom bira dhaabbate.
english: Abram lived in the land of Canaan, and Lot lived in the cities of the plain, and moved his tent as far as Sodom.

kikuyu: Warri Sodoom jalʼoota fuula Waaqayyoo duratti akka malee cubbuu hojjetan turan.
english: Now the men of Sodom were exceedingly wicked and sinners against the LORD.

kikuyu: Erga Loox isa biraa godaanee booddee Waaqayyo Abraamiin akkana jedhe; “Iddoo amma jirtu kanaa ija kee ol fudhadhuutii gara kaabaa fi kibbaa, gara baʼa biiftuutii fi lixa biiftuu ilaali.
english: The LORD said to Abram, after Lot was separated from him, “Now, lift up your eyes, and look from the place where you are, northward and southward and eastward and westward,

kikuyu: Anis biyya ati argitu kana hunda bara baraan siʼii fi sanyii keetiif nan kenna.
english: for I will give all the land which you see to you and to your offspring forever.

kikuyu: Ani sanyii kee akkuma biyyoo lafaa nan baayʼisa; yoo namni biyyoo lafaa lakkaaʼuu dandaʼe, sanyiin kee akkasuma lakkaaʼamuu dandaʼa.
english: I will make your offspring as the dust of the earth, so that if a man can count the dust of the earth, then your offspring may also be counted.

kikuyu: Kaʼiitii dheerinaa fi balʼina lafa kanaa keessa dedeemi; ani isa siifin kennaatii.”
english: Arise, walk through the land in its length and in its width; for I will give it to you.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Abraam dunkaana isaa buqqifatee qilxuuwwan Mamree kanneen Kebroonitti argaman bira jiraachuu dhaqe; achittis iddoo aarsaa Waaqayyoof tolche.
english: Abram moved his tent, and came and lived by the oaks of Mamre, which are in Hebron, and built an altar there to the LORD.

kikuyu: Bara sana keessa Amraafel mootiin Shineʼaar, Ariyook mootiin Elaasaar, Kedoorlaaʼomer mootiin Eelaamii fi Tidiʼaal mootiin Sabootaa kaʼanii,
english: In the days of Amraphel, king of Shinar; Arioch, king of Ellasar; Chedorlaomer, king of Elam; and Tidal, king of Goiim,

kikuyu: Beraa mooticha Sodoom, Birishaa mooticha Gomoraa, Shinaab mooticha Adimaa, Shemeeber mooticha Zebooʼiimii fi mooticha Belaa ishee Zoʼaar jedhamtu sanaa loluu dhaqan.
english: they made war with Bera, king of Sodom; Birsha, king of Gomorrah; Shinab, king of Admah; Shemeber, king of Zeboiim; and the king of Bela (also called Zoar).

kikuyu: Mootonni shanan kunneen hundi sulula Siidiim isa Galaana Soogiddaa jedhamu keessatti wal gaʼanii humna tokkummaa uummatan.
english: All these joined together in the valley of Siddim (also called the Salt Sea).

kikuyu: Isaanis waggaa kudha shan Kedoorlaaʼomer jalatti bulan; waggaa kudha sadaffaatti garuu ni fincilan.
english: They served Chedorlaomer for twelve years, and in the thirteenth year they rebelled.

kikuyu: Waggaa kudha afuraffaatti Kedoorlaaʼomerii fi mootonni isa wajjin turan baʼanii warra Refaayiim Ashteroot Qaarnaayimiitti, warra Zuuziim Haamitti, warra Eemiim Shaawii Kiriyaataayimiitti,
english: In the fourteenth year Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him came and struck the Rephaim in Ashteroth Karnaim, the Zuzim in Ham, the Emim in Shaveh Kiriathaim,

kikuyu: warra Hoori immoo lafa gaara Seeʼiiriitii jalqabanii hamma Eel Phaaraan kan gammoojjiitti dhiʼoo jiru sanaatti moʼatan.
english: and the Horites in their Mount Seir, to El Paran, which is by the wilderness.

kikuyu: Ergasii of irra deebiʼanii Een Mishiphaati jechuunis Qaadesh dhaqanii biyya warra Amaaleq hundaa fi warra Amoor kanneen Hazezoon Taamaar keessa jiraatan humnaan qabatan.
english: They returned, and came to En Mishpat (also called Kadesh), and struck all the country of the Amalekites, and also the Amorites, that lived in Hazazon Tamar.

kikuyu: Mootichi Sodoom, mootichi Gomoraa, mootichi Adimaa, mootichi Zebooʼiimii fi mootichi Belaa jechuunis Zoʼaar baʼanii Sulula Siidiim keessatti loluuf hiriiran.
english: The king of Sodom, and the king of Gomorrah, the king of Admah, the king of Zeboiim, and the king of Bela (also called Zoar) went out; and they set the battle in array against them in the valley of Siddim

kikuyu: Isaanis Kedoorlaaʼomer mootii Eelaam, Tidiʼaal mootii Sabootaa, Amraafel mootii Shineʼaariitii fi Ariyook mootii Elaasaar lolan; mootonni afran kunneen mootota shananiin morman.
english: against Chedorlaomer king of Elam, Tidal king of Goiim, Amraphel king of Shinar, and Arioch king of Ellasar; four kings against the five.

kikuyu: Sululli Siidiim boolla leeleetiin guutamee ture; mootonni Sodoomii fi mootonni Gomoraas baqatanii namoonni tokko tokko boolla sana keessa buʼan; warri hafan immoo gara gaarraniitti baqatan.
english: Now the valley of Siddim was full of tar pits; and the kings of Sodom and Gomorrah fled, and some fell there. Those who remained fled to the hills.

kikuyu: Mootonni afran sun miʼaa fi nyaata warra Sodoomii fi Gomoraa hunda saamanii sokkan.
english: They took all the goods of Sodom and Gomorrah, and all their food, and went their way.

kikuyu: Waan Loox ilmi obboleessa Abraam Sodoom keessa jiraachaa tureef mootonni sun isa illee qabeenyuma isaa wajjin boojiʼanii deeman.
english: They took Lot, Abram’s brother’s son, who lived in Sodom, and his goods, and departed.

kikuyu: Namichi baqatee baʼe tokko dhufee oduu kana Abraam Ibrichatti hime. Abraamis qilxuuwwan Mamree kan namicha Amoorii sana bira jiraachaa ture; Mamreen kun obboleessa Eshkoolii fi Aaneer ture; isaan Abraam wajjin kakuu galanii turan.
english: One who had escaped came and told Abram, the Hebrew. At that time, he lived by the oaks of Mamre, the Amorite, brother of Eshcol and brother of Aner. They were allies of Abram.

kikuyu: Abraam akka firri isaa boojiʼame dhageenyaan namoota mana isaatti dhalatanii leenjifaman 318 walitti waammatee hidhachiisee hamma Daaniitti faana buʼe.
english: When Abram heard that his relative was taken captive, he led out his three hundred eighteen trained men, born in his house, and pursued as far as Dan.

kikuyu: Abraamis isaan loluuf jedhee halkaniin namoota isaa gargari qoode; hamma Hoobaa ishee kaaba Damaasqootti argamtu sanaattis faana buʼee isaan dhaʼe.
english: He divided himself against them by night, he and his servants, and struck them, and pursued them to Hobah, which is on the left hand of Damascus.

kikuyu: Innis miʼa hunda deebifate; fira ofii isaa Looxii fi qabeenya isaa, dubartootaa fi namoota kaanis deebifate.
english: He brought back all the goods, and also brought back his relative Lot and his goods, and the women also, and the other people.

kikuyu: Abraam Kedoorlaaʼomeri fi mootota isa wajjin turan moʼatee deebinaan mootiin Sodoom Sulula Shaawii kan Sulula Mootii jedhamu keessatti isa simachuu baʼe.
english: The king of Sodom went out to meet him after his return from the slaughter of Chedorlaomer and the kings who were with him, at the valley of Shaveh (that is, the King’s Valley).

kikuyu: Malkiiseedeq mootiin Saaleemis buddeenaa fi daadhii wayinii fideef; innis luba Waaqayyo Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii ture;
english: Melchizedek king of Salem brought out bread and wine. He was priest of God Most High.

kikuyu: innis akkana jedhee Abraamin eebbise; “Abraam, Waaqayyo Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii, isa samii fi lafa uume sanaan haa eebbifamu.
english: He blessed him, and said, “Blessed be Abram of God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni Waan Hundaa Olii, inni diinota kee dabarsee harka keetti kenne sun haa eebbifamu.” Ergasii Abraam waan hunda irraa kudhan keessaa tokko isaaf kenne.
english: Blessed be God Most High, who has delivered your enemies into your hand.” Abram gave him a tenth of all.

kikuyu: Mootiin Sodoomis Abraamiin, “Namoota naa kenniitii qabeenya immoo ofii keetii fudhadhu” jedhe.
english: The king of Sodom said to Abram, “Give me the people, and take the goods for yourself.”

kikuyu: Abraam garuu mootii Sodoomiitiin akkana jedhe; “Ani harka koo gara Waaqayyo, Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii, Uumaa samiitii fi lafaatti ol fudhadhee kakadheen jira;
english: Abram said to the king of Sodom, “I have lifted up my hand to the LORD, God Most High, possessor of heaven and earth,

kikuyu: akka ati, ‘Anatu Abraamin sooromse’ hin jenneef ani waan kan kee taʼe keessaa tokko iyyuu, foʼaa yookaan teepha ittiin kophee hidhatan iyyuu hin fudhadhu.
english: that I will not take a thread nor a sandal strap nor anything that is yours, lest you should say, ‘I have made Abram rich.’

kikuyu: Waan namoonni koo nyaatanii fi qooda namoota ana wajjin deemanii jechuunis qooda Aaneer, kan Eshkooliitii fi kan Mamree malee ani ofii koo homaa hin fudhadhu; isaan qooda isaanii haa fudhatan.”
english: I will accept nothing from you except that which the young men have eaten, and the portion of the men who went with me: Aner, Eshcol, and Mamre. Let them take their portion.”

kikuyu: Kana booddee dubbiin Waaqayyoo mulʼataan gara Abraam dhufee akkana jedhe; “Yaa Abraam hin sodaatin; ani gaachana keetii fi gatii kee guddicha.”
english: After these things the LORD’s word came to Abram in a vision, saying, “Don’t be afraid, Abram. I am your shield, your exceedingly great reward.”

kikuyu: Abraam garuu, “Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa, waan ani ijoollee hin qabneef namni qabeenya koo dhaaluuf jiru Eliiʼezer namicha Damaasqoo kana; egaa ati maal naa kennita?” jedhe.
english: Abram said, “Lord GOD, what will you give me, since I go childless, and he who will inherit my estate is Eliezer of Damascus?”

kikuyu: Abraam, “Kunoo ati ijoollee tokko illee naa hin kennine; hojjetaan mana koo jiraatu tokko kunoo na dhaaluuf jira” jedhe.
english: Abram said, “Behold, you have given no children to me: and, behold, one born in my house is my heir.”

kikuyu: Kunoo dubbiin Waaqayyoo gara isaa dhufee, “Ilma gudeeda keetiitu dhaaltuu kee taʼa malee namichi kun dhaaltuu kee hin taʼu” jedhe.
english: Behold, the LORD’s word came to him, saying, “This man will not be your heir, but he who will come out of your own body will be your heir.”

kikuyu: Innis Abraamin gad baasee, “Samiiwwan ol ilaaliitii yoo urjiiwwan lakkaaʼuu dandeesse lakkaaʼi” jedhe. Itti fufees, “Sanyiin kees akkanuma baayʼata” jedheen.
english: The LORD brought him outside, and said, “Look now toward the sky, and count the stars, if you are able to count them.” He said to Abram, “So your offspring will be.”

kikuyu: Abraam Waaqayyotti amane; innis qajeelummaatti lakkaaʼeef.
english: He believed in the LORD, who credited it to him for righteousness.

kikuyu: Innis, “Ani Waaqayyo isa akka ati ishee dhaaltuuf biyya kana siif kennuuf jedhee Uuri biyya Kaldootaa keessaa si baasee dha” jedheen.
english: He said to Abram, “I am the LORD who brought you out of Ur of the Chaldees, to give you this land to inherit it.”

kikuyu: Abraam garuu, “Yaa Waaqayyoo Gooftaa, ani biyya kana dhaaluu koo akkamittin beeka?” jedhe.
english: He said, “Lord GOD, how will I know that I will inherit it?”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqayyo, “Goromsa tokko, reʼee tokkoo fi korbeessa hoolaa tokko kanneen tokkoon tokkoon isaanii waggaa sadii sadii guutan, akkasumas gugee tokkoo fi gugee sookkee tokko naa fidi” jedheen.
english: He said to him, “Bring me a heifer three years old, a female goat three years old, a ram three years old, a turtledove, and a young pigeon.”

kikuyu: Abraamis warra kana hunda gara isaatti fidee, qixxee lamaanitti kukkute; warra qixxee lamaanitti kukkutamanis gamaa gamana kaaʼe; simbirroota garuu qixxee lamaanitti hin kukkunne.
english: He brought him all these, and divided them in the middle, and laid each half opposite the other; but he didn’t divide the birds.

kikuyu: Ergasii allaattiin foon sanatti gad buute; Abraam garuu irraa ariʼe.
english: The birds of prey came down on the carcasses, and Abram drove them away.

kikuyu: Utuma aduun dhiʼaa jirtuu hirribni guddaan Abraamin qabe; kunoo dukkanni guddaanii fi sodaachisaan isa irra buʼe.
english: When the sun was going down, a deep sleep fell on Abram. Now terror and great darkness fell on him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos akkana isaan jedhe; “Akka sanyiin kee biyya kan isaa hin taʼin keessatti alagaa taʼee waggaa dhibba afuris achitti garboomfamee cunqurfamu dhugumaan beeki.
english: He said to Abram, “Know for sure that your offspring will live as foreigners in a land that is not theirs, and will serve them. They will afflict them four hundred years.

kikuyu: Ani garuu saba isaan akkuma garbootaatti tajaajilan sana nan adaba; ergasii immoo isaan qabeenya guddaa fudhatanii achii baʼu.
english: I will also judge that nation, whom they will serve. Afterward they will come out with great wealth;

kikuyu: Ati garuu nagaan gara abbootii keetii dhaqxa; bara dheeraas jiraattee awwaalamta.
english: but you will go to your fathers in peace. You will be buried at a good old age.

kikuyu: Sanyiin kee dhaloota afuraffaatti as deebiʼa; cubbuun Amoorotaa amma iyyuu hin guunneetii.”
english: In the fourth generation they will come here again, for the iniquity of the Amorite is not yet full.”

kikuyu: Yommuu aduun lixxee dukkanaaʼettis kunoo barbadaan ibiddaa aaru guca tokko wajjin mulʼatee foon kukkutame sana gidduu darbe.
english: It came to pass that, when the sun went down, and it was dark, behold, a smoking furnace and a flaming torch passed between these pieces.

kikuyu: Gaafa sanas Waaqayyo akkana jedhee Abraam wajjin kakuu gale; “Ani biyya laga Gibxii jalqabee hamma laga Efraaxiis guddichaatti jiru kana sanyii keetiif nan kenna;
english: In that day the LORD made a covenant with Abram, saying, “I have given this land to your offspring, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the river Euphrates:

kikuyu: kunis biyya Qeenotaa, Qeneezotaa, Qadmoonotaas,
english: the land of the Kenites, the Kenizzites, the Kadmonites,

kikuyu: kan Heetotaa, Feerzotaa, Refaayimootaa,
english: the Hittites, the Perizzites, the Rephaim,

kikuyu: Amoorotaa, Kanaʼaanotaa Girgaashotaatii fi kan Yebuusotaa jechuu dha.”
english: the Amorites, the Canaanites, the Girgashites, and the Jebusites.”

kikuyu: Saaraan niitiin Abraam ijoollee isaaf hin deenye turte. Garuu isheen garbittii Aggaar jedhamtu tokko qabdi turte; Aggaaris nama biyya Gibxi turte;
english: Now Sarai, Abram’s wife, bore him no children. She had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Hagar.

kikuyu: Saaraanis Abraamiin, “Kunoo Waaqayyo ijoollee na dhowwateera. Dhaqiitii garbittii koo wajjin ciisi; tarii ani karaa isheetiin ijoollee nan argadhan taʼaatii” jette. Abraamis waan Sooraan jette fudhate.
english: Sarai said to Abram, “See now, the LORD has restrained me from bearing. Please go in to my servant. It may be that I will obtain children by her.” Abram listened to the voice of Sarai.

kikuyu: Erga Abraam waggaa kudhan Kanaʼaan keessa jiraatee booddee niitiin isaa Saaraan garbittii ishee Aggaar kan nama biyya Gibxi turte sana fuutee akka isheen niitii isaa taatuuf dhirsa isheetiif kennite.
english: Sarai, Abram’s wife, took Hagar the Egyptian, her servant, after Abram had lived ten years in the land of Canaan, and gave her to Abram her husband to be his wife.

kikuyu: Abraamis Aggaar wajjin ciise; isheenis ni ulfoofte. Yommuu akka ulfoofte of irratti beektetti giiftii ishee tuffachuu jalqabde.
english: He went in to Hagar, and she conceived. When she saw that she had conceived, her mistress was despised in her eyes.

kikuyu: Saaraan immoo Abraamiin, “Miidhaa na mudate kanatti situ gaafatama. Garbittii koo anattu bobaa kee jala siif galche; amma garuu isheen akka ulfoofte of irratti beeknaan na tuffatte. Egaa Waaqayyo sii fi ana gidduutti murtii haa kennu” jette.
english: Sarai said to Abram, “This wrong is your fault. I gave my servant into your bosom, and when she saw that she had conceived, she despised me. May the LORD judge between me and you.”

kikuyu: Abraamis, “Garbittiin kee keessa harkuma kee jirti; waanuma feete ishee godhi” jedheen. Saaraanis akka malee ishee cunqursite; kanaafuu Aggaar fuula ishee duraa sokkite.
english: But Abram said to Sarai, “Behold, your maid is in your hand. Do to her whatever is good in your eyes.” Sarai dealt harshly with her, and she fled from her face.

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqayyoo gammoojjii keessatti, burqaa bishaanii tokko biratti Aggaarin arge; burqaan bishaanii sunis karaa Shuuritti geessu irra ture.
english: The LORD’s angel found her by a fountain of water in the wilderness, by the fountain on the way to Shur.

kikuyu: Ergamaan sunis, “Yaa Aggaar, garbittii Saaraa, ati eessaa dhufte? Eessa dhaquutti jirta?” jedhe. Isheenis, “Giiftii koo Saaraa baqachuuttin jira” jetteen.
english: He said, “Hagar, Sarai’s servant, where did you come from? Where are you going?” She said, “I am fleeing from the face of my mistress Sarai.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti ergamaan Waaqayyoo sun, “Gara giiftii keetiitti deebiʼi; gad of qabiitii isheef buli” jedheen.
english: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Return to your mistress, and submit yourself under her hands.”

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqayyoo sunis itti dabalee, “Ani sanyii kee akka malee nan baayʼisa; sababii baayʼina isaatiifis namni tokko iyyuu lakkaaʼuu hin dandaʼu” jedhe.
english: The LORD’s angel said to her, “I will greatly multiply your offspring, that they will not be counted for multitude.”

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqayyoo sun amma illee akkana isheen jedhe; “Kunoo ati ulfoofteerta; ilmas ni deessa. Maqaa isaas Ishmaaʼeel jedhii moggaasi; Waaqayyo dhiphachuu kee dhagaʼeeraatii.
english: The LORD’s angel said to her, “Behold, you are with child, and will bear a son. You shall call his name Ishmael, because the LORD has heard your affliction.

kikuyu: Inni nama akka harree diidaa taʼa; harki isaa nama hunda irratti kaʼa; harki nama hundaas isa irratti kaʼa; obboloota isaa hundaanis jibbamaa jiraata.”
english: He will be like a wild donkey among men. His hand will be against every man, and every man’s hand against him. He will live opposed to all of his brothers.”

kikuyu: Isheenis maqaa Waaqayyo isheetti dubbate sanaa, “Elrooʼii” jettee waamte. Isheen, “Ani dhugumaan Isa na argu sana argeera” jetteertiitii.
english: She called the name of the LORD who spoke to her, “You are a God who sees,” for she said, “Have I even stayed alive after seeing him?”

kikuyu: Sababiin boolli bishaanii sun, “Beʼeer Lahaayirooʼii” jedhameefis kanuma. Innis hamma harʼaatti illee Qaadeshii fi Bereed gidduu jira.
english: Therefore the well was called Beer Lahai Roi. Behold, it is between Kadesh and Bered.

kikuyu: Aggaaris Abraamiif ilma deesse; Abraamis ilma isheen deesse sana Ishmaaʼeel jedhee moggaase.
english: Hagar bore a son for Abram. Abram called the name of his son, whom Hagar bore, Ishmael.

kikuyu: Yeroo Aggaar Ishmaaʼeelin isaaf deessetti Abraam nama waggaa saddeettamii jaʼaa ture.
english: Abram was eighty-six years old when Hagar bore Ishmael to Abram.

kikuyu: Yeroo Abraam nama waggaa sagaltamii sagalii turetti Waaqayyo isatti mulʼatee akkana jedheen; “Ani Waaqa Waan Hundumaa Dandaʼuu dha; ati fuula koo dura amanamummaan deddeebiʼi; hirʼinas hin qabaatin.
english: When Abram was ninety-nine years old, the LORD appeared to Abram and said to him, “I am God Almighty. Walk before me and be blameless.

kikuyu: Ani kakuu koo anaa fi si gidduu nan dhaaba; guddaas sin baayʼisa.”
english: I will make my covenant between me and you, and will multiply you exceedingly.”

kikuyu: Abraamis adda isaatiin lafatti gombifame; Waaqnis akkana isaan jedhe;
english: Abram fell on his face. God talked with him, saying,

kikuyu: “Kunoo, kakuun ani si wajjin galu kana: ati abbaa saba baayʼee taata.
english: “As for me, behold, my covenant is with you. You will be the father of a multitude of nations.

kikuyu: Ati siʼachi Abraam jedhamtee hin waamamtu; waan ani abbaa saboota baayʼee si taasiseef maqaan kee Abrahaam taʼa.
english: Your name will no more be called Abram, but your name will be Abraham; for I have made you the father of a multitude of nations.

kikuyu: Ani akka ati guddaa baayʼattu nan godha; akka sabni hedduun si keessaa argamu nan godha; mootonnis si keessaa ni argamu.
english: I will make you exceedingly fruitful, and I will make nations of you. Kings will come out of you.

kikuyu: Ani Waaqa keetii fi Waaqa sanyii kee kan si duubaan dhufuu taʼuuf jedhee kakuu koo anaa, sii fi sanyii kee kan si duubaa, dhaloota dhufuuf jiru gidduutti kakuu bara baraa godhee nan dhaaba.
english: I will establish my covenant between me and you and your offspring after you throughout their generations for an everlasting covenant, to be a God to you and to your offspring after you.

kikuyu: Biyya Kanaʼaan guutuu lafa ati amma orma taatee jiraattu kana ani dhaala bara baraa godhee siʼii fi sanyiiwwan kee warra si booddeetiif nan kenna; anis Waaqa isaanii nan taʼa.”
english: I will give to you, and to your offspring after you, the land where you are traveling, all the land of Canaan, for an everlasting possession. I will be their God.”

kikuyu: Waaqni Abrahaamiin akkana jedhe; “Ati immoo kakuu koo eeguu qabda; ati, sanyiin kee warri si duubaas dhaloota isaanii keessatti kakuu koo eeguu qabdu.
english: God said to Abraham, “As for you, you shall keep my covenant, you and your offspring after you throughout their generations.

kikuyu: Kakuun koo kan isin anaa fi siʼi gidduutti, sanyii kee kan siʼi duubaan dhufu gidduuttis eeguu qabdan kanaa dha; innis isin keessaa dhiirri hundinuu dhagna haa qabatu.
english: This is my covenant, which you shall keep, between me and you and your offspring after you. Every male among you shall be circumcised.

kikuyu: Qola keessan dhagna qabadhaa; kunis kakuu anaa fi isin gidduu jiruuf mallattoo taʼa.
english: You shall be circumcised in the flesh of your foreskin. It will be a token of the covenant between me and you.

kikuyu: Isin keessaa dhiirri guyyaa saddeet guute dhagna haa qabatu; dhaloota keessan hunda keessatti dhiirri mana keetti dhalate yookaan kan nama biyya ormaa irraa maallaqa keetiin bitame hundi kan sanyii kee hin taʼin dhagna haa qabatu.
english: He who is eight days old shall be circumcised among you, every male throughout your generations, he who is born in the house, or bought with money from any foreigner who is not of your offspring.

kikuyu: Mana keetti dhalatanis yookaan maallaqa keetiin bitamanis isaan dhagna haa qabatan. Kakuun koo kan foon keessan irratti godhame kun kakuu bara baraa taʼa.
english: He who is born in your house, and he who is bought with your money, must be circumcised. My covenant shall be in your flesh for an everlasting covenant.

kikuyu: Dhiirri dhagna hin qabatin, kan qola foon isaa dhagna hin qabatin kam iyyuu saba ofii isaa keessaa balleeffama; inni kakuu koo cabseeraatii.”
english: The uncircumcised male who is not circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin, that soul shall be cut off from his people. He has broken my covenant.”

kikuyu: Waaqni ammas Abrahaamiin akkana jedhe; “Ati siʼachi niitii kee Sooraadhaan, Sooraa hin jettu; maqaan ishee Saaraa taʼa.
english: God said to Abraham, “As for Sarai your wife, you shall not call her name Sarai, but her name shall be Sarah.

kikuyu: Ani ishee nan eebbisa; ishee irraas ilma siif nan kenna. Akka isheen haadha sabootaa taatuufis ishee nan eebbisa; mootonni sabootaas ishee keessaa argamu.”
english: I will bless her, and moreover I will give you a son by her. Yes, I will bless her, and she will be a mother of nations. Kings of peoples will come from her.”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis addaan gombifame; kolfees, “Nama waggaa dhibbaatiif ilmi ni dhalataa? Saaraanis waggaa sagaltamatti mucaa deessii?” jedhee yaade.
english: Then Abraham fell on his face, and laughed, and said in his heart, “Will a child be born to him who is one hundred years old? Will Sarah, who is ninety years old, give birth?”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis Waaqaan, “Maaloo utuu Ishmaaʼeel fuula kee dura naa jiraatee!” jedhe.
english: Abraham said to God, “Oh that Ishmael might live before you!”

kikuyu: Waaqnis akkana jedhe; “Tole; garuu niitiin kee Saaraan ilma siif deessi; maqaa isaas Yisihaaq jedhii moggaasi. Anis kakuu koo sanyii isaa kan isa duubaan dhufuuf kakuu bara baraa godhee isa wajjin nan dhaaba.
english: God said, “No, but Sarah, your wife, will bear you a son. You shall call his name Isaac. I will establish my covenant with him for an everlasting covenant for his offspring after him.

kikuyu: Waaʼee Ishmaaʼeel immoo ani si dhagaʼeera; kunoo ani, isa nan eebbisa; akka inni baayʼatu nan godha; guddaa isa nan baayʼisa. Inni abbaa bulchitoota kudha lamaa taʼa; anis saba guddaa isa nan godha.
english: As for Ishmael, I have heard you. Behold, I have blessed him, and will make him fruitful, and will multiply him exceedingly. He will become the father of twelve princes, and I will make him a great nation.

kikuyu: Kakuu koo garuu Yisihaaq isa Saaraan waggaa dhufu keessa yeroo kanatti siif deessu wajjin nan dhaaba.”
english: But I will establish my covenant with Isaac, whom Sarah will bear to you at this set time next year.”

kikuyu: Waaqni erga Abrahaam wajjin haasaʼee fixatee booddee isa biraa ol baʼe.
english: When he finished talking with him, God went up from Abraham.

kikuyu: Abrahaamis guyyuma sana ilmaan isaa Ishmaaʼeelii fi warra mana isaatti dhalatan yookaan warra maallaqa isaatiin bitaman hunda, dhiira mana isaa hundumaas fuudhee akkuma Waaqni isatti himetti dhagna qabe.
english: Abraham took Ishmael his son, all who were born in his house, and all who were bought with his money: every male among the men of Abraham’s house, and circumcised the flesh of their foreskin in the same day, as God had said to him.

kikuyu: Abrahaam yeroo dhagna qabatetti nama waggaa sagaltamii sagalii ture.
english: Abraham was ninety-nine years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

kikuyu: Ilmi isaa Ishmaaʼeel immoo yeroo dhagna qabatetti nama waggaa kudha sadii ture.
english: Ishmael, his son, was thirteen years old when he was circumcised in the flesh of his foreskin.

kikuyu: Abrahaamii fi ilmi isaa Ishmaaʼeel guyyuma sana dhagna qabatan.
english: In the same day both Abraham and Ishmael, his son, were circumcised.

kikuyu: Dhiirri mana Abrahaam hundinuu, warri mana isaatti dhalatan yookaan warri orma irraa maallaqaan bitamanis isa wajjin dhagna qabatan.
english: All the men of his house, those born in the house, and those bought with money from a foreigner, were circumcised with him.

kikuyu: Utuma Abrahaam guyyaa saafaadhaan qilxuu Mamree bira balbala dunkaana isaa dura taaʼee jiruu Waaqayyo isatti mulʼate.
english: The LORD appeared to him by the oaks of Mamre, as he sat in the tent door in the heat of the day.

kikuyu: Abrahaamis ol ilaalee namoota isa bira dhadhaabatan sadii arge. Innis akkuma isaan argeen balbala dunkaana isaa duraa kaʼee isaan simachuudhaaf itti fiige; hamma lafa gaʼuttis gad jedhee harka fuudhe.
english: He lifted up his eyes and looked, and saw that three men stood near him. When he saw them, he ran to meet them from the tent door, and bowed himself to the earth,

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedheen; “Gooftaa ko, yoo ani si duratti fudhatama argadhe, garbicha kee bira hin darbin.
english: and said, “My lord, if now I have found favor in your sight, please don’t go away from your servant.

kikuyu: Bishaan xinnoo isiniif haa fidan; miilla dhiqadhaatii muka kana jala boqodhaa.
english: Now let a little water be fetched, wash your feet, and rest yourselves under the tree.

kikuyu: Erga isin gara garbicha keessanii dhuftanii, ani akka isin dadhabbii baatanii karaa keessan itti fuftaniif waan isin nyaattan isiniifin kenna.” Isaanis, “Akkuma jette sana godhi” jedhanii deebisan.
english: I will get a piece of bread so you can refresh your heart. After that you may go your way, now that you have come to your servant.” They said, “Very well, do as you have said.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Abrahaam dafee Saaraatti dunkaana seenee, “Dafii daakuu bullaaʼaa safartuu sadii sukkuumiitii maxinoo tolchi” jedheen.
english: Abraham hurried into the tent to Sarah, and said, “Quickly prepare three seahs of fine meal, knead it, and make cakes.”

kikuyu: Innis gara saawwaniitti fiigee jabbii gabbatee itti tole tokko filatee hojjetaa tokkotti kenne; hojjetaan sunis qopheessuuf ariifate.
english: Abraham ran to the herd, and fetched a tender and good calf, and gave it to the servant. He hurried to dress it.

kikuyu: Abrahaamis itittuu fi aannan, foon jabbii qopheeffame sanas geessee isaanii dhiʼeesse; yeroo isaan nyaachaa turanittis Abrahaam muka tokko jala isaan bira dhaabachaa ture.
english: He took butter, milk, and the calf which he had dressed, and set it before them. He stood by them under the tree, and they ate.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Niitiin kee Saaraan eessa jirti?” jedhanii isa gaafatan. Innis, “Kuunnoo dunkaana keessa jirti” jedheen.
english: They asked him, “Where is Sarah, your wife?” He said, “There, in the tent.”

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa tokko, “Ani dhugumaan bara dhufu keessa yeroo akkanaatti deebiʼee gara kee nan dhufa; niitiin kee Saaraanis ilma ni deessi” jedhe. Yeroo sana Saaraan balbala dunkaanaa kan isa duubaan jiru keessaan dhaggeeffachaa turte.
english: He said, “I will certainly return to you at about this time next year; and behold, Sarah your wife will have a son.” Sarah heard in the tent door, which was behind him.

kikuyu: Abrahaamii fi Saaraan umuriin isaanii dheeratee dulloomanii turan; Saaraanis umurii itti mucaa daʼuu dandeessu dabartee turte.
english: Now Abraham and Sarah were old, well advanced in age. Sarah had passed the age of childbearing.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Saaraan, “Ani erga jaaree bututee, gooftaan koos erga dulloomee booddee, gammachuu kana qabaachuu nan dandaʼaa?” jettee of keessatti kolfite.
english: Sarah laughed within herself, saying, “After I have grown old will I have pleasure, my lord being old also?”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Waaqayyo Abrahaamiin akkana jedhe; “Saaraan maaliif, ‘Ani ergan dulloomee booddee amma dhugumaan mucaa nan daʼaa?’ jettee kolfite?
english: The LORD said to Abraham, “Why did Sarah laugh, saying, ‘Will I really bear a child when I am old?’

kikuyu: Wanni Waaqayyoof hin dandaʼamne tokko iyyuu jiraa? Ani bara dhufu keessa yeroo murteeffametti deebiʼee gara kee nan dhufa; Saaraanis ilma ni deessi.”
english: Is anything too hard for the LORD? At the set time I will return to you, when the season comes around, and Sarah will have a son.”

kikuyu: Saaraanis waan sodaatteef sobdee, “Ani hin kolfine” jette. Inni garuu, “Lakkii kolfiteertaa” jedhe.
english: Then Sarah denied it, saying, “I didn’t laugh,” for she was afraid. He said, “No, but you did laugh.”

kikuyu: Namoonni sun yommuu deemuuf kaʼanitti gara Sodoom gad ilaalan; Abrahaamis isaan geggeessuuf jedhee isaan wajjin baʼe.
english: The men rose up from there, and looked toward Sodom. Abraham went with them to see them on their way.

kikuyu: Ergasii Waaqayyo akkana jedhe; “Ani waanan gochuuf jiru Abrahaamin nan dhoksaa?
english: The LORD said, “Will I hide from Abraham what I do,

kikuyu: Abrahaam dhugumaan saba guddaa fi jabaa taʼa; sabni lafa irraa hundinuu karaa isaatiin eebbifama.
english: since Abraham will surely become a great and mighty nation, and all the nations of the earth will be blessed in him?

kikuyu: Akka inni ijoollee isaatii fi sanyii isaa warra isa duubaan dhufan, akka isaan waan qajeelaa fi sirrii taʼe hojjechuudhaan karaa Waaqayyoo eegan ajajuuf ani isa filadheeraatii; kunis akka Waaqayyo waan Abrahaamiif kakate sana isaaf guutuuf.”
english: For I have known him, to the end that he may command his children and his household after him, that they may keep the way of the LORD, to do righteousness and justice; to the end that the LORD may bring on Abraham that which he has spoken of him.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos akkana jedhe; “Iyyi Sodoomii fi Gomoraa irratti iyyame guddaa dha; cubbuun isaaniis waan akka malee hamaa taʼeef
english: The LORD said, “Because the cry of Sodom and Gomorrah is great, and because their sin is very grievous,

kikuyu: ani gad buʼee akka wanni isaan hojjetan akkuma iyya na qaqqabe sanaa hamaa taʼe nan ilaala. Yoo akkas taʼuu baate immoo natu beeka.”
english: I will go down now, and see whether their deeds are as bad as the reports which have come to me. If not, I will know.”

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis garagalanii Sodoomitti qajeelan; Abrahaam garuu Waaqayyo dura dhaabatee hafe.
english: The men turned from there, and went toward Sodom, but Abraham stood yet before the LORD.

kikuyu: Abrahaamis isatti dhiʼaatee akkana jedhe; “Ati nama qajeelaa nama jalʼaa wajjin ni balleessitaa?
english: Abraham came near, and said, “Will you consume the righteous with the wicked?

kikuyu: Yoo namoonni qajeeloon shantamni magaalattii keessa jiraatan hoo? Ati dhugumaan ishee ni balleessitaa? Sababii qajeelota shantamman ishee keessa jiraatan sanaatiif jettee ishee hin oolchituu?
english: What if there are fifty righteous within the city? Will you consume and not spare the place for the fifty righteous who are in it?

kikuyu: Qajeelaa fi hamaa wal qixxee ilaaluudhaan nama qajeelaa nama hamaa wajjin balleessuun sirraa haa fagaatu. Kun sirraa haa fagaatu! Abbaan murtii lafa hundaa waan qajeelaa hin hojjetuu?”
english: May it be far from you to do things like that, to kill the righteous with the wicked, so that the righteous should be like the wicked. May that be far from you. Shouldn’t the Judge of all the earth do right?”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos, “Ani yoo magaalaa Sodoom keessatti qajeeltota shantama argadhe, isaaniif jedhee iddoo sana guutuu nan oolcha” jedhe.
english: The LORD said, “If I find in Sodom fifty righteous within the city, then I will spare the whole place for their sake.”

kikuyu: Abrahaam ammas akkana jedhe; “Kunoo ani utuman awwaaraa fi daaraa taʼee jiruu Gooftaatti dubbachuuf ija jabaadheera;
english: Abraham answered, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord, although I am dust and ashes.

kikuyu: yoo baayʼinni qajeeltotaa shantama irraa shan hirʼate hoo? Ati sababii namoota shanan sanaatiif jettee magaalaa sana guutuu ni balleessitaa?” Innis, “Ani yoo nama afurtamii shan achitti argadhe ishee hin balleessu” jedhe.
english: What if there will lack five of the fifty righteous? Will you destroy all the city for lack of five?” He said, “I will not destroy it if I find forty-five there.”

kikuyu: Abrahaam amma illee, “Yoo qajeeltonni afurtamni qofti achitti argaman hoo?” jedhee isatti dubbate. Gooftaanis, “Ani warra afurtama sanaaf jedhee nan dhiisa” jedhe.
english: He spoke to him yet again, and said, “What if there are forty found there?” He said, “I will not do it for the forty’s sake.”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis, “Mee nan dubbadhaatii Gooftaan, hin aarin. Yoo namoonni soddomni qofti achitti argaman hoo?” jedhe. Gooftaanis, “Ani yoon nama soddoma achitti argadhe ishee hin balleessu” jedhee deebise.
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak. What if there are thirty found there?” He said, “I will not do it if I find thirty there.”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis, “Kunoo amma erga ani Gooftaatti dubbachuuf ija jabaadhe, yoo namoonni digdamni qofti achitti argaman hoo?” jedhe. Gooftaanis, “Ani sababii namoota digdama sanaatiif jedhee ishee hin balleessu” jedhe.
english: He said, “See now, I have taken it on myself to speak to the Lord. What if there are twenty found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the twenty’s sake.”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis, “Yaa Gooftaa amma illee yeroo tokko waa sin gaafadhaatii maaloo hin aarin; yoo namni kudhan qofti achitti argame hoo?” jedhe. Gooftaan immoo, “Ani sababii namoota kurnan sanaatiif jedhee ishee hin balleessu” jedhe.
english: He said, “Oh don’t let the Lord be angry, and I will speak just once more. What if ten are found there?” He said, “I will not destroy it for the ten’s sake.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos erga Abrahaam wajjin dubbatee fixee booddee achii deeme. Abrahaam immoo iddoo ofii isaatti deebiʼe.
english: The LORD went his way as soon as he had finished communing with Abraham, and Abraham returned to his place.

kikuyu: Ergamoonni Waaqayyoo sun lamaan galgala sana Sodoom gaʼan; Looxis karra Sodoomii dura taaʼaa ture. Innis yeroo jara argetti, isaan simachuuf kaʼee isaanitti deeme; gad jedhees adda isaatiin lafatti gombifame.
english: The two angels came to Sodom at evening. Lot sat in the gate of Sodom. Lot saw them, and rose up to meet them. He bowed himself with his face to the earth,

kikuyu: Innis, “Yaa gooftota ko, maaloo mana garbicha keessaniitti goraatii miilla dhiqadhaa bulaa; barii barraaqaan kaatanii karaa keessan itti fufuu dandeessu” jedhe. Isaan immoo, “Hin taʼu; nu waltajjii karaa irra bullaa” jedhaniin.
english: and he said, “See now, my lords, please come into your servant’s house, stay all night, wash your feet, and you can rise up early, and go on your way.” They said, “No, but we will stay in the street all night.”

kikuyu: Inni garuu akka malee isaan dirqisiise; kanaafuu goranii mana isaa seenan; innis maxinoo tolchee nyaata qopheesseef; isaanis ni nyaatan.
english: He urged them greatly, and they came in with him, and entered into his house. He made them a feast, and baked unleavened bread, and they ate.

kikuyu: Utuu isaan hin rafin namoonni kutaalee magaalaa Sodoom hunda keessaa dhufan hundi dargaggoonnii fi jaarsoliin mana sana marsan.
english: But before they lay down, the men of the city, the men of Sodom, surrounded the house, both young and old, all the people from every quarter.

kikuyu: Isaanis Looxin waamanii, “Namoonni galgala kana gara kee dhufan eessa jiru? Akka nu isaan wajjin ciifnuuf gad nuu yaasi” jedhan.
english: They called to Lot, and said to him, “Where are the men who came in to you this night? Bring them out to us, that we may have sex with them.”

kikuyu: Looxis jara sanatti gad baʼee balbala of duubaan cufe;
english: Lot went out to them through the door, and shut the door after himself.

kikuyu: Akkanas jedhe; “Yaa obboloota ko, waan hamaa kana hin hojjetinaa!
english: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.

kikuyu: Kunoo ani intallan lama kanneen takkumaa dhiira wajjin hin ciisin qaba. Lamaanuu gad isinii nan baasa; isinis waan feetan isaan gochuu dandeessu. Namoota kanneen garuu waan isaan bantii mana koo jala jiraniif homaa isaan hin godhinaa.”
english: See now, I have two virgin daughters. Please let me bring them out to you, and you may do to them what seems good to you. Only don’t do anything to these men, because they have come under the shadow of my roof.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Badi asii!” jedhaniin. Ittuma fufaniis, “Namichi kun nama ormaa kan nu keessa jiraachuu dhufee dha; amma immoo abbaa murtii nutti taʼuu fedha! Nu waan hamaa jara irratti hojjennu caalaa sirratti hojjenna” jedhaniin. Isaanis Looxin humnaan dhiibanii balbala sana cabsuu gaʼan.
english: They said, “Stand back!” Then they said, “This one fellow came in to live as a foreigner, and he appoints himself a judge. Now we will deal worse with you than with them!” They pressed hard on the man Lot, and came near to break the door.

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis hiixatanii Looxin harkisanii manatti ol deebisan; balbalichas ni cufan.
english: But the men reached out their hand, and brought Lot into the house to them, and shut the door.

kikuyu: Ergasii immoo namoota balbala manaa dura turan sana akka isaan balbalicha hin argineef xinnaa fi guddaa isaanii dhaʼichaan ija jaamsan.
english: They struck the men who were at the door of the house with blindness, both small and great, so that they wearied themselves to find the door.

kikuyu: Namoonni lamaan sun Looxiin akkana jedhan; “Ati nama biraa tokko illee jechuunis soddoota, ilmaan yookaan intallan yookaan nama kan kee taʼe tokko illee magaalaa kana keessaa qabdaa? Asi keessa isaan baafadhu;
english: The men said to Lot, “Do you have anybody else here? Sons-in-law, your sons, your daughters, and whomever you have in the city, bring them out of the place:

kikuyu: nu iddoo kana balleessuuf deemnaatii. Sababii iyyi saba ishee irratti iyyame fuula Waaqayyoo duratti guddaa taʼeef, Waaqni akka nu ishee balleessinuuf nu ergeera.”
english: for we will destroy this place, because the outcry against them has grown so great before the LORD that the LORD has sent us to destroy it.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Loox gad baʼee soddoota isaa warra intallan isaa fuudhuuf jiraniin, “Sababii Waaqayyo magaalaa kana balleessuuf kaʼeef, dafaatii asii baʼaa!” jedhe. Soddoonni isaa garuu waan inni qoosu seʼan.
english: Lot went out, and spoke to his sons-in-law, who were pledged to marry his daughters, and said, “Get up! Get out of this place, for the LORD will destroy the city!” But he seemed to his sons-in-law to be joking.

kikuyu: Yeroo boruun diimatetti ergamoonni Waaqayyoo sun Looxin jarjarsanii, “Niitii keetii fi intallan kee lamaan as jiran fudhadhuutii dafii baʼi! Yoo kanaa achii yeroo magaalattiin adabamtutti atis ni baddaa” jedhaniin.
english: When the morning came, then the angels hurried Lot, saying, “Get up! Take your wife and your two daughters who are here, lest you be consumed in the iniquity of the city.”

kikuyu: Inni garuu duubatti harkifate; waan Waaqayyo isaaniif garaa laafeef namoonni sun harka isaatii fi harka niitii isaa, intallan isaa lamaanis harka qabanii magaalattii keessaa isaan baasan.
english: But he lingered; and the men grabbed his hand, his wife’s hand, and his two daughters’ hands, the LORD being merciful to him; and they took him out, and set him outside of the city.

kikuyu: Akkuma gad isaan baasaniinis ergamoota sana keessaa inni tokko, “Lubbuu kee oolfachuuf baqadhu! Of duuba hin milʼatin! Dirree irra iddoo tokko illee hin dhaabatin! Tulluuwwanitti ol baqadhu; yoo kanaa achii ni baddaa!” jedhe.
english: It came to pass, when they had taken them out, that he said, “Escape for your life! Don’t look behind you, and don’t stay anywhere in the plain. Escape to the mountains, lest you be consumed!”

kikuyu: Loox garuu akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Yaa gooftota ko, maaloo akkas miti!
english: Lot said to them, “Oh, not so, my lord.

kikuyu: Kunoo garbichi kee fuula kee duratti fudhatama argateera; ati lubbuu koo oolchitee gara laafina guddaa na argisiifteerta. Ani garuu gara tulluutti ol baqachuu hin dandaʼu; balaan kun na argata; anis nan duʼa.
english: See now, your servant has found favor in your sight, and you have magnified your loving kindness, which you have shown to me in saving my life. I can’t escape to the mountain, lest evil overtake me, and I die.

kikuyu: Kunoo, magaalaan itti baqachuun dandaʼamu tokko as dhiʼoo jirti; isheen xinnoo dha. Ani gara isheetti nan baqadha; isheen baayʼee xinnoo dha mitii? Akkasitti lubbuun koo ni baraaramti.”
english: See now, this city is near to flee to, and it is a little one. Oh let me escape there (isn’t it a little one?), and my soul will live.”

kikuyu: Ergamaan sunis akkana jedheen; “Kunoo, ani kadhaa kana siif nan dhagaʼa; magaalaa ati waaʼee ishee dubbattu kana ani hin balleessu.
english: He said to him, “Behold, I have granted your request concerning this thing also, that I will not overthrow the city of which you have spoken.

kikuyu: Garuu sababii ani hamma ati achi geessutti homaa gochuu hin dandeenyeef dafii achitti baqadhu!” Wanni magaalaan sun Zoʼaar jedhamteefis kanuma.
english: Hurry, escape there, for I can’t do anything until you get there.” Therefore the name of the city was called Zoar.

kikuyu: Yeroo Loox Zoʼaar gaʼetti aduun baatee turte.
english: The sun had risen on the earth when Lot came to Zoar.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo samiiwwan keessaa Waaqayyo biraa, dinyii bobaʼu Sodoomii fi Gomoraa irratti roobse.
english: Then the LORD rained on Sodom and on Gomorrah sulfur and fire from the LORD out of the sky.

kikuyu: Innis akkasiin magaalaawwan kanneenii fi dirreewwan sana guutuu, warra magaalaawwan sana keessa jiraatan hundaa fi biqiltuu biyya sanaa balleesse.
english: He overthrew those cities, all the plain, all the inhabitants of the cities, and that which grew on the ground.

kikuyu: Niitiin Looxi garuu of duuba ilaaltee utubaa soogiddaa taatee hafte.
english: But Lot’s wife looked back from behind him, and she became a pillar of salt.

kikuyu: Abrahaamis guyyaa itti aanu ganama obboroon kaʼee iddoo duraan fuula Waaqayyoo dura dhaabachaa ture sanatti deebiʼe.
english: Abraham went up early in the morning to the place where he had stood before the LORD.

kikuyu: Innis gara magaalaawwan Sodoomii fi Gomoraa, gara lafa dirree sanaa hundaas ilaalee aara akka aara boolla ibiddaa keessaa baʼuu tokko isaa biyya sana keessaa ol kaʼu arge.
english: He looked toward Sodom and Gomorrah, and toward all the land of the plain, and saw that the smoke of the land went up as the smoke of a furnace.

kikuyu: Waaqni yeroo magaalaawwan dirree sanaa balleessetti Abrahaamin yaadate; kanaafuu yommuu magaalaawwan Loox keessa jiraachaa ture balleessetti Looxin balaa sana keessaa baase.
english: When God destroyed the cities of the plain, God remembered Abraham, and sent Lot out of the middle of the overthrow, when he overthrew the cities in which Lot lived.

kikuyu: Loox waan Zoʼaar keessa jiraachuu sodaateef intallan isaa lamaan wajjin Zoʼaarii baʼee gaarran irra qubate. Innis intallan isaa lamaan wajjin holqa tokko keessa jiraate.
english: Lot went up out of Zoar, and lived in the mountain, and his two daughters with him; for he was afraid to live in Zoar. He lived in a cave with his two daughters.

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko intalli isaa isheen hangafti ishee quxisuudhaan akkana jette; “Abbaan keenya dulloomeera; akka bartee lafa hunda irra jiruutti dhiirri nu wajjin ciisu tokko iyyuu naannoo kan hin jiru.
english: The firstborn said to the younger, “Our father is old, and there is not a man on the earth to come in to us in the way of all the earth.

kikuyu: Kottu mee abbaa keenya daadhii wayinii obaasnee isa wajjin ciifnaa; akkasiin sanyiin abbaa keenyaa lafa irratti akka hafu goona.”
english: Come, let’s make our father drink wine, and we will lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

kikuyu: Isaanis halkan sana abbaa isaanii daadhii wayinii obaasan; intalli isheen hangafti ol seentee isa wajjin ciifte. Inni yeroo isheen ciiste yookaan yeroo isheen kaate hin beekne.
english: They made their father drink wine that night: and the firstborn went in, and lay with her father. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she arose.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti intalli hangafti ishee quxisuudhaan akkana jette; “Kunoo ani eda abbaa koo wajjin ciiseera. Kottu edanas daadhii wayinii isa obaasnaa; atis ol seenii isa wajjin ciisi; akkasitti sanyiin abbaa keenyaa akka hafu goona.”
english: It came to pass on the next day, that the firstborn said to the younger, “Behold, I lay last night with my father. Let’s make him drink wine again tonight. You go in, and lie with him, that we may preserve our father’s family line.”

kikuyu: Isaan halkan sanas abbaa isaanii daadhii wayinii obaasan; intalli quxisuun dhaqxee isa wajjin ciiste. Inni ammas yeroo isheen ciiste yookaan yeroo isheen kaate hin beekne.
english: They made their father drink wine that night also. The younger went and lay with him. He didn’t know when she lay down, nor when she got up.

kikuyu: Akkasiin intallan Loox lamaanuu abbaa isaaniitiif ulfaaʼan.
english: Thus both of Lot’s daughters were with child by their father.

kikuyu: Intalli isheen hangafti ilma deessee maqaa isaa Moʼaab jettee moggaafte. Inni abbaa Moʼaabota harʼaa ti.
english: The firstborn bore a son, and named him Moab. He is the father of the Moabites to this day.

kikuyu: Intalli isheen quxisuunis ilma deessee maqaa isaa Ben-Amii jettee moggaafte; inni immoo abbaa Amoonota harʼaa ti.
english: The younger also bore a son, and called his name Ben Ammi. He is the father of the children of Ammon to this day.

kikuyu: Abrahaam achii kaʼee Negeebitti godaanee Qaadeshii fi Shuuri gidduu jiraate. Innis yeroodhaaf Geraaraa keessa ture.
english: Abraham traveled from there toward the land of the South, and lived between Kadesh and Shur. He lived as a foreigner in Gerar.

kikuyu: Achittis Abrahaam, “Isheen obboleettii koo ti” jedhee waaʼee niitii isaa, waaʼee Saaraa dubbate. Abiimelek mootiin Geraaraas nama itti ergee Saaraa fudhate.
english: Abraham said about Sarah his wife, “She is my sister.” Abimelech king of Gerar sent, and took Sarah.

kikuyu: Waaqni immoo halkan abjuudhaan Abiimelekitti dhufee, “Kunoo sababii dubartii sana fuudhatteef ati nama duʼee dha; isheen dhirsa qabdiitii” jedheen.
english: But God came to Abimelech in a dream of the night, and said to him, “Behold, you are a dead man, because of the woman whom you have taken; for she is a man’s wife.”

kikuyu: Abiimelek garuu isheetti hin dhiʼaanne ture; kanaafuu inni akkana jedhe; “Yaa Gooftaa ati saba qajeelaa balleessitaa?
english: Now Abimelech had not come near her. He said, “Lord, will you kill even a righteous nation?

kikuyu: Inni mataan isaa, ‘Isheen obboleettii koo ti’ naan hin jennee? Isheenis akkasuma, ‘Inni obboleessa koo ti’ hin jennee? Anis sammuu qulqulluu fi harka qulqulluudhaan waan kana hojjedhe.”
english: Didn’t he tell me, ‘She is my sister’? She, even she herself, said, ‘He is my brother.’ I have done this in the integrity of my heart and the innocence of my hands.”

kikuyu: Waaqni abjuu sana keessa akkana isaan jedhe; “Eeyyee! Ani akka ati sammuu qulqulluudhaan waan kana hojjette beeka; kanaafuu ani akka ati cubbuu natti hin hojjenneef si dhowween jira. Sababiin ani akka ati ishee bira geessu si hin dhiisiniifis kanuma.
english: God said to him in the dream, “Yes, I know that in the integrity of your heart you have done this, and I also withheld you from sinning against me. Therefore I didn’t allow you to touch her.

kikuyu: Egaa amma niitii namichaa deebisiif; inni waan raajii taʼeef, Waaqa siif kadhata; atis ni jiraatta. Garuu yoo ishee deebisuu baatte, ati akka duutu, warri kan kee taʼan hundis akka duʼan dhugumaan beeki.”
english: Now therefore, restore the man’s wife. For he is a prophet, and he will pray for you, and you will live. If you don’t restore her, know for sure that you will die, you, and all who are yours.”

kikuyu: Abiimelek guyyaa itti aanu ganama obboroon kaʼee qondaaltota isaa hunda walitti waamee waan taʼe hunda isaanitti hime; isaanis akka malee sodaatan.
english: Abimelech rose early in the morning, and called all his servants, and told all these things in their ear. The men were very scared.

kikuyu: Abiimelekis Abrahaamin ofitti waamee akkana jedheen; “Ati maaliif akkana nu goote? Ani maal si goonaan ati cubbuu guddaa akkanaa anaa fi mootummaa kootti fidde? Ati waan namni hin hojjenne anatti hojjette.”
english: Then Abimelech called Abraham, and said to him, “What have you done to us? How have I sinned against you, that you have brought on me and on my kingdom a great sin? You have done deeds to me that ought not to be done!”

kikuyu: Abiimelekis “Ati maaliif waan kana hojjette?” jedhee Abrahaamin gaafate.
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What did you see, that you have done this thing?”

kikuyu: Abrahaam immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Ani, ‘Biyya kana keessa dhugumaan Waaqa sodaachuun hin jiru; isaan sababii niitii kootiif jedhanii na ajjeesu’ jedheen yaadee ture.
english: Abraham said, “Because I thought, ‘Surely the fear of God is not in this place. They will kill me for my wife’s sake.’

kikuyu: Taʼus isheen dhugumaan obboleettii koo ti; yoo haadha koo irraa dhalachuu baatte iyyuu isheen intaluma abbaa koo ti; isheenis niitii koo taate.
english: Besides, she is indeed my sister, the daughter of my father, but not the daughter of my mother; and she became my wife.

kikuyu: Anis yeroo Waaqni mana abbaa kootii na baase sana isheedhaan, ‘Haalli ati ittiin jaalala naaf qabdu mulʼiftu kanaa dha; lafa nu dhaqnu hundumaatti, “Inni obboleessa koo ti” jedhiitii waaʼee koo dubbadhun’ jedhe.”
english: When God caused me to wander from my father’s house, I said to her, ‘This is your kindness which you shall show to me. Everywhere that we go, say of me, “He is my brother.”’”

kikuyu: Abiimelek ergasii hoolaa fi loon, garboota dhiiraa fi nadheenii fidee Abrahaamiif kenne; niitii isaa Saaraas ni deebiseef.
english: Abimelech took sheep and cattle, male servants and female servants, and gave them to Abraham, and restored Sarah, his wife, to him.

kikuyu: Abiimelekis, “Kunoo biyyi koo fuula kee dura jira; idduma feete jiraadhu” jedheen.
english: Abimelech said, “Behold, my land is before you. Dwell where it pleases you.”

kikuyu: Saaraadhaanis, “Kunoo ani meetii saqilii kuma tokko obboleessa keetiifin kenna. Kunis akka dhugaa qabaachuun kee fuula warra si wajjin jiranii duratti beekamuuf; ati guutumaan guutuutti dhugaa argatteerta” jedhe.
english: To Sarah he said, “Behold, I have given your brother a thousand pieces of silver. Behold, it is for you a covering of the eyes to all that are with you. In front of all you are vindicated.”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis Waaqa kadhate; Waaqni immoo Abiimelek, niitii isaatii fi garboota isaa dubartoota fayyise; isaanis ijoollee godhatan.
english: Abraham prayed to God. So God healed Abimelech, his wife, and his female servants, and they bore children.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo sababii niitii Abrahaam sababii Saaraatiif jedhee gadameessa dubartoota mana Abiimelek jiraatanii hunda cufee tureetii.
english: For the LORD had closed up tight all the wombs of the house of Abimelech, because of Sarah, Abraham’s wife.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akkuma dubbate sana Saaraa yaadate; Waaqayyo waan waadaa galeef sana ni raawwateef.
english: The LORD visited Sarah as he had said, and the LORD did to Sarah as he had spoken.

kikuyu: Saaraan ulfooftee bara dulluma isaa keessa yeruma Waaqni waadaa isaaf seene sanatti Abrahaamiif ilma deesse.
english: Sarah conceived, and bore Abraham a son in his old age, at the set time of which God had spoken to him.

kikuyu: Abrahaamis ilma Saaraan isaaf deesse sana Yisihaaq jedhee moggaase.
english: Abraham called his son who was born to him, whom Sarah bore to him, Isaac.

kikuyu: Abrahaam akkuma Waaqni isa ajaje sanatti Yisihaaq dhalatee guyyaa saddeetitti dhagna isa qabe.
english: Abraham circumcised his son, Isaac, when he was eight days old, as God had commanded him.

kikuyu: Yeroo ilmi isaa Yisihaaq dhalateefitti Abrahaam nama waggaa dhibbaa ture.
english: Abraham was one hundred years old when his son, Isaac, was born to him.

kikuyu: Saaraanis, “Waaqni kolfa naa kenneera; namni waan kana dhagaʼu hundis na wajjin kolfa” jette.
english: Sarah said, “God has made me laugh. Everyone who hears will laugh with me.”

kikuyu: Ittuma fuftees, “Silaa eenyutu Abrahaamiin, ‘Saaraan daaʼima hoosisti’ jedha ture? Garuu ani bara dulluma isaa keessa ilma nan daʼeef” jette.
english: She said, “Who would have said to Abraham that Sarah would nurse children? For I have borne him a son in his old age.”

kikuyu: Mucichi guddatee harma guufame; Abrahaam gaafa Yisihaaq harma guufame sana cidha guddaa qopheesse.
english: The child grew and was weaned. Abraham made a great feast on the day that Isaac was weaned.

kikuyu: Saaraan garuu yeroo ilmi Aggaar Gibxittiin Abrahaamiif deesse sun Yisihaaqitti qoosu argite;
english: Sarah saw the son of Hagar the Egyptian, whom she had borne to Abraham, mocking.

kikuyu: isheenis Abrahaamiin, “Garbittii kanaa fi ilma ishee ariʼi; ilmi garbittii kanaa kun ilma koo Yisihaaq wajjin hin dhaaluutii” jette.
english: Therefore she said to Abraham, “Cast out this servant and her son! For the son of this servant will not be heir with my son, Isaac.”

kikuyu: Wanni kunis sababii ilma isaatiif Abrahaamin akka malee rakkise.
english: The thing was very grievous in Abraham’s sight on account of his son.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu akkana jedheen; “Waaʼee garbittii keetiitii fi waaʼee mucichaa hin yaaddaʼin. Sababii sanyiin kee Yisihaaqiin siif waamamuuf waan Saaraan siin jettu hunda dhagaʼi.
english: God said to Abraham, “Don’t let it be grievous in your sight because of the boy, and because of your servant. In all that Sarah says to you, listen to her voice. For your offspring will be named through Isaac.

kikuyu: Inni sanyii kee waan taʼeef ani ilma garbittii sanaa saba nan taasisa.”
english: I will also make a nation of the son of the servant, because he is your child.”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis guyyaa itti aanu ganama obboroon kaʼee nyaata muraasaa fi bishaan qalqala tokko fuudhee Aggaariif kenne. Waan kanas gatiittii ishee irra kaaʼeefii mucaa wajjin ariʼe; isheenis achii baatee Gammoojjii Bersheebaa keessa joorte.
english: Abraham rose up early in the morning, and took bread and a container of water, and gave it to Hagar, putting it on her shoulder; and gave her the child, and sent her away. She departed, and wandered in the wilderness of Beersheba.

kikuyu: Yommuu bishaan qalqala keessaa dhumetti, isheen mucaa ishee daggala tokko jala keesse.
english: The water in the container was spent, and she put the child under one of the shrubs.

kikuyu: Isheenis, “Mucaa kana isaa duʼu ani hin ilaalu” jettee garaa isheetti waan yaaddeef gara darba xiyyaa tokko xinnoo achi hiiqxee naannoo isaa teesse; achi teessees sagalee ishee ol fudhattee boosse.
english: She went and sat down opposite him, a good way off, about a bow shot away. For she said, “Don’t let me see the death of the child.” She sat opposite him, and lifted up her voice, and wept.

kikuyu: Waaqni booʼicha mucichaa ni dhagaʼe; ergamaan Waaqayyoo samii keessaa Aggaarin waamee akkana jedheen; “Yaa Aggaar ati maal taate? Hin sodaatin; Waaqni booʼicha mucichaa iddoo inni ciisee jiruu dhagaʼeeraatii.
english: God heard the voice of the boy. The angel of God called to Hagar out of the sky, and said to her, “What troubles you, Hagar? Don’t be afraid. For God has heard the voice of the boy where he is.

kikuyu: Sababii ani saba guddaa isa godhuuf kaʼiitii harka keetiin mucicha ol fuudhi; jabeessiitii isa qabi.”
english: Get up, lift up the boy, and hold him with your hand. For I will make him a great nation.”

kikuyu: Waaqni ija ishee baneefii jennaan boolla bishaanii tokko argite. Kanaafuu dhaqxee qalqala sana bishaaniin guuttee, waan inni dhugu mucichaaf kennite.
english: God opened her eyes, and she saw a well of water. She went, filled the container with water, and gave the boy a drink.

kikuyu: Waaqnis mucicha wajjin ture; mucichis ni guddate. Innis gammoojjii keessa jiraate; xiyya darbachuudhaanis beekamaa ture.
english: God was with the boy, and he grew. He lived in the wilderness, and as he grew up, he became an archer.

kikuyu: Innis gammoojjii Phaaraan keessa jiraate; haati isaas biyya Gibxiitii niitii argatteef.
english: He lived in the wilderness of Paran. His mother got a wife for him out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana Abiimelekii fi Fiikool ajajaan loltoota isaa Abrahaamiin akkana jedhan; “Waan ati hojjettu hunda keessatti Waaqni si wajjin jira.
english: At that time, Abimelech and Phicol the captain of his army spoke to Abraham, saying, “God is with you in all that you do.

kikuyu: Ati akka ana yookaan ijoollee koo yookaan sanyii koo hin gowwoomsine amma as fuula Waaqaa duratti naa kakadhu. Akkuma ani garaa siif laafe sana atis anaa fi biyya amma orma taatee keessa jiraattu kanaaf garaa laafi.”
english: Now, therefore, swear to me here by God that you will not deal falsely with me, nor with my son, nor with my son’s son. But according to the kindness that I have done to you, you shall do to me, and to the land in which you have lived as a foreigner.”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis, “Ani nan kakadha” jedhe.
english: Abraham said, “I will swear.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Abrahaam waaʼee boolla bishaanii garboonni Abiimelek isa irraa fudhatan tokkoo Abiimelekitti himate.
english: Abraham complained to Abimelech because of a water well, which Abimelech’s servants had violently taken away.

kikuyu: Abiimelek immoo, “Ani nama waan kana hojjete hin beeku. Atis natti hin himne; ani waaʼee isaa harʼuman dhagaʼe” jedhe.
english: Abimelech said, “I don’t know who has done this thing. You didn’t tell me, and I didn’t hear of it until today.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Abrahaam hoolaa fi loon fidee Abiimelekiif kenne; jarri lamaanis walii galtee uummatan.
english: Abraham took sheep and cattle, and gave them to Abimelech. Those two made a covenant.

kikuyu: Abrahaam gorommii hoolaa torba bushaayee keessaa kophaatti baase;
english: Abraham set seven ewe lambs of the flock by themselves.

kikuyu: Abiimelekis, “Hiikkaan gorommii hoolaa torban ati kophaa isaanii baafte kanneenii maali?” jedhee Abrahaamin gaafate.
english: Abimelech said to Abraham, “What do these seven ewe lambs, which you have set by themselves, mean?”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis, “Akka ani boolla bishaanii kana qotadhe akka ragaa taʼuuf, gorommii hoolaa torban kanneen na harkaa fudhadhu” jedhee deebise.
english: He said, “You shall take these seven ewe lambs from my hand, that it may be a witness to me, that I have dug this well.”

kikuyu: Sababii jarri lamaan sun achitti walii kakataniif iddoon sun Bersheebaa jedhamee waamame.
english: Therefore he called that place Beersheba, because they both swore an oath there.

kikuyu: Erga walii galteen sun Bersheebaatti taʼee booddee Abiimelekii fi Fiikool ajajaan loltoota isaa gara biyya Filisxeemotaatti deebiʼan.
english: So they made a covenant at Beersheba. Abimelech rose up with Phicol, the captain of his army, and they returned into the land of the Philistines.

kikuyu: Abrahaamis Bersheebaa keessa muka tamirii dhaabe; innis achitti maqaa Waaqayyo Waaqa Bara Baraa waammate.
english: Abraham planted a tamarisk tree in Beersheba, and there he called on the name of the LORD, the Everlasting God.

kikuyu: Abrahaam biyya Filisxeemotaa keessa bara dheeraa jiraate.
english: Abraham lived as a foreigner in the land of the Philistines many days.

kikuyu: Yeroo muraasa booddee Waaqni Abrahaamin qore. Innis, “Abrahaam!” jedhee isa waame. Abrahaamis, “Kunoo asan jira” jedhee deebise.
english: After these things, God tested Abraham, and said to him, “Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: Waaqnis akkana jedheen; “Ilma kee Yisihaaq, ilma kee tokkicha isa jaallattu sana fudhiitii biyya Mooriyaa dhaqi. Tulluu ani sitti himu irratti qalma gubamu godhiitii isa dhiʼeessi.”
english: He said, “Now take your son, your only son, Isaac, whom you love, and go into the land of Moriah. Offer him there as a burnt offering on one of the mountains which I will tell you of.”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis guyyaa itti aanu ganama barraaqaan kaʼee harree isaa feʼate. Innis hojjettoota isaa keessaa nama lamaa fi ilma isaa Yisihaaqin fudhatee qoraan qalma gubamuuf gaʼu cabsatee gara iddoo Waaqni isatti hime sanaatti qajeele.
english: Abraham rose early in the morning, and saddled his donkey; and took two of his young men with him, and Isaac his son. He split the wood for the burnt offering, and rose up, and went to the place of which God had told him.

kikuyu: Guyyaa sadaffaattis Abrahaam ol ilaalee iddoo sana fagootti arge.
english: On the third day Abraham lifted up his eyes, and saw the place far off.

kikuyu: Innis hojjettoota isaatiin, “Isin harree wajjin asuma turaa. Anii fi mucichi duuba sana dhaqnaa; achittis waaqeffannee gara keessanitti deebinaa” jedhe.
english: Abraham said to his young men, “Stay here with the donkey. The boy and I will go over there. We will worship, and come back to you.”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis qoraan aarsaa gubamuuf taʼu fuudhee ilma isaa Yisihaaqin baachise; ofii isaatii immoo ibiddaa fi billaa harkatti qabate. Isaan lamaan utuu walumaan deemaa jiranuu,
english: Abraham took the wood of the burnt offering and laid it on Isaac his son. He took in his hand the fire and the knife. They both went together.

kikuyu: Yisihaaq, “Yaa abbaa koo” jedhee abbaa isaa Abrahaamitti dubbate. Abrahaamis, “Asan jira ilma koo” jedhee deebise. Yisihaaqis deebisee, “Ibiddii fi qoraan kunoo ti; hoolaan qalma gubamuuf taʼu immoo eessa jira?” jedhe.
english: Isaac spoke to Abraham his father, and said, “My father?” He said, “Here I am, my son.” He said, “Here is the fire and the wood, but where is the lamb for a burnt offering?”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis deebisee, “Yaa ilma ko, Waaqni mataan isaa hoolaa qalma gubamuuf taʼu ni kenna” jedhe. Isaan lamaanis walumaan karaa isaanii itti fufan.
english: Abraham said, “God will provide himself the lamb for a burnt offering, my son.” So they both went together.

kikuyu: Yeroo iddoo Waaqni isatti hime sana gaʼanitti, Abrahaam iddoo aarsaa achitti ijaaree iddoo aarsaa sana irra qoraan naqe; ilma isaa Yisihaaqin hidhees iddoo aarsaa sana irra qoraan gubbaa ciibse.
english: They came to the place which God had told him of. Abraham built the altar there, and laid the wood in order, bound Isaac his son, and laid him on the altar, on the wood.

kikuyu: Ergasii inni ilma isaa qaluuf jedhee harka isaa hiixatee billaa fudhate.
english: Abraham stretched out his hand, and took the knife to kill his son.

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqayyoo garuu, “Abrahaam! Abrahaam!” jedhee samii keessaa isa waame. Abrahaamis, “Kunoo asan jira” jedhee deebise.
english: The LORD’s angel called to him out of the sky, and said, “Abraham, Abraham!” He said, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Ati harka keetiin gurbicha hin tuqin; waan tokko illee isa hin godhin. Waan ati ilma kee, ilmuma tokkicha anaaf jettee hin mararfatiniif, ani akka ati Waaqa sodaattu amma beekeera” jedhe.
english: He said, “Don’t lay your hand on the boy or do anything to him. For now I know that you fear God, since you have not withheld your son, your only son, from me.”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis ol ilaalee kunoo korbeessa hoolaa kan gaanfi isaa daggala keessatti qabamee jiru tokko arge; innis dhaqee hoolaa sana fuudhee qooda ilma isaa qalma gubamu godhee dhiʼeesse.
english: Abraham lifted up his eyes, and looked, and saw that behind him was a ram caught in the thicket by his horns. Abraham went and took the ram, and offered him up for a burnt offering instead of his son.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Abrahaam iddoo sana “Waaqayyo ni kenna” jedhee moggaase; hamma harʼaatti illee, “Tulluu Waaqayyoo irratti, ni kennama” jedhama.
english: Abraham called the name of that place “The LORD Will Provide”. As it is said to this day, “On the LORD’s mountain, it will be provided.”

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqayyoo sunis samii keessaa lammata Abrahaamin waamee
english: The LORD’s angel called to Abraham a second time out of the sky,

kikuyu: akkana jedheen; “Waaqayyo akkana jedha; sababii ati waan kana gootee fi ilma kee, ilmuma kee tokkicha illee na hin dhowwatiniif ani maqaa kootiin nan kakadha;
english: and said, “‘I have sworn by myself,’ says the LORD, ‘because you have done this thing, and have not withheld your son, your only son,

kikuyu: ani dhugumaan eebba, sin eebbisa; sanyii kees akkuma urjii samiitii fi akkuma cirracha qarqara galaanaa nan baayʼisa. Sanyiiwwan kees magaalaawwan diina isaanii ni dhuunfatu.
english: that I will bless you greatly, and I will multiply your offspring greatly like the stars of the heavens, and like the sand which is on the seashore. Your offspring will possess the gate of his enemies.

kikuyu: Waan ati naa ajajamteef sabni lafa irraa hundinuu karaa sanyii keetiin eebbifama.”
english: All the nations of the earth will be blessed by your offspring, because you have obeyed my voice.’”

kikuyu: Ergasii Abrahaam tajaajiltoota isaatti deebiʼe; isaanis walumaan Bersheebaatti qajeelan; Abrahaamis Bersheebaa keessa jiraate.
english: So Abraham returned to his young men, and they rose up and went together to Beersheba. Abraham lived at Beersheba.

kikuyu: Yeroo muraasa booddee akkana jedhamee Abrahaamitti himame; “Kunoo, Miilkaan obboleessa kee Naahooriif ilmaan deesseerti;
english: After these things, Abraham was told, “Behold, Milcah, she also has borne children to your brother Nahor:

kikuyu: ilmaan isheen deesses inni hangafni Uuzi, obboleessi isaa Buuz, abbaan Arraam immoo Qamuʼeel,
english: Uz his firstborn, Buz his brother, Kemuel the father of Aram,

kikuyu: Keseedi, Hazoo, Fiildaas, Yiidlaafii fi Betuuʼeel jedhamu.”
english: Chesed, Hazo, Pildash, Jidlaph, and Bethuel.”

kikuyu: Betuuʼeel Ribqaa dhalche.
english: Bethuel became the father of Rebekah. These eight Milcah bore to Nahor, Abraham’s brother.

kikuyu: Naahor saajjatoo Reʼuumaa jedhamtu tokko qaba ture; isheen ilmaan Xebaa, Gaham, Tahaashii fi Maʼakaa jedhaman deesseef.
english: His concubine, whose name was Reumah, also bore Tebah, Gaham, Tahash, and Maacah.

kikuyu: Saaraan waggaa dhibba tokkoo fi digdamii torba jiraatte; barri jireenya Saaraas kanuma ture.
english: Sarah lived one hundred twenty-seven years. This was the length of Sarah’s life.

kikuyu: Isheenis Kiriyaati Arbaaq jechuunis Kebroon biyya Kanaʼaan keessaa sanatti duute; Abrahaamis Saaraadhaaf gadduu fi booʼuudhaaf jedhee dhaqe.
english: Sarah died in Kiriath Arba (also called Hebron), in the land of Canaan. Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her.

kikuyu: Abrahaam reeffa niitii isaa biraa kaʼee Heetotaan akkana jedhe;
english: Abraham rose up from before his dead and spoke to the children of Heth, saying,

kikuyu: “Ani gidduu keessanitti ormaa fi keessummaa dha. Akka ani duʼaa koo itti awwaalladhuuf lafa awwaalaaf taʼu natti gurguraa.”
english: “I am a stranger and a foreigner living with you. Give me a possession of a burying-place with you, that I may bury my dead out of my sight.”

kikuyu: Heetonnis akkana jedhanii Abrahaamii fi deebii kennan;
english: The children of Heth answered Abraham, saying to him,

kikuyu: “Gooftaa, nu dhagaʼi. Ati nu gidduutti shuumii jabaa dha. Duʼaa kee iddoo awwaala keenyaa keessaa kan akka malee filatamaa taʼetti awwaalladhu. Nu keessaa namni iddoo awwaala isaatti duʼaa kee awwaallachuu si dhowwatu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.”
english: “Hear us, my lord. You are a prince of God among us. Bury your dead in the best of our tombs. None of us will withhold from you his tomb. Bury your dead.”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis ol kaʼee fuula namoota biyya sanaa fuula Heetotaa duratti gad jedhee harka fuudhe.
english: Abraham rose up, and bowed himself to the people of the land, to the children of Heth.

kikuyu: Akkanas isaaniin jedhe; “Ani duʼaa koo akkan awwaalladhu fedhii yoo qabaattan na dhagaʼaatii Efroon ilma Zoohar sana naa kadhadhaa.
english: He talked with them, saying, “If you agree that I should bury my dead out of my sight, hear me, and entreat for me to Ephron the son of Zohar,

kikuyu: Innis holqa Makfelaa jedhamu kan qarqara lafa qotiisaa isaatti argamu sana natti ni gurgura. Inni iddoo awwaalaa sana gatii guutuudhaan fuula keessan duratti akka natti gurguruuf naa gaafadhaa.”
english: that he may sell me the cave of Machpelah, which he has, which is in the end of his field. For the full price let him sell it to me among you as a possession for a burial place.”

kikuyu: Efroon Heetichi saba isaa gidduu taaʼaa ture; innis utuma Heetonni gara karra magaalaa isaa dhufan sun hundi dhagaʼanuu akkana jedhee Abrahaamiif deebii kenne;
english: Now Ephron was sitting in the middle of the children of Heth. Ephron the Hittite answered Abraham in the hearing of the children of Heth, even of all who went in at the gate of his city, saying,

kikuyu: “Gooftaa ko, akkana miti; mee na dhaggeeffadhu; ani lafa qotiisaa kana siif nan kenna; holqa achi jirus siif nan kenna; ani fuula saba koo duratti holqa kana siifin kenna; duʼaa kee itti awwaalladhu.”
english: “No, my lord, hear me. I give you the field, and I give you the cave that is in it. In the presence of the children of my people I give it to you. Bury your dead.”

kikuyu: Abrahaam amma illee fuula saba biyya sanaa duratti gad jedhee harka fuudhee,
english: Abraham bowed himself down before the people of the land.

kikuyu: utuma isaan dhagaʼanuu Efrooniin, “Yoo fedhii kee taʼe, na dhagaʼi. Ani gatii lafa qotiisaa kanaa nan kaffala. Akka ani duʼaa koo achitti awwaalladhuuf gatii kana na harkaa fudhadhu” jedhe.
english: He spoke to Ephron in the audience of the people of the land, saying, “But if you will, please hear me. I will give the price of the field. Take it from me, and I will bury my dead there.”

kikuyu: Efroonis akkana jedhee Abrahaamiif deebii kenne;
english: Ephron answered Abraham, saying to him,

kikuyu: “Gooftaa ko, mee na dhagaʼi; gatiin lafa kanaa meetii saqilii dhibba afur taʼa; garuu kun anaa fi si gidduutti maali? Duʼaa kee itti awwaalladhu.”
english: “My lord, listen to me. What is a piece of land worth four hundred shekels of silver between me and you? Therefore bury your dead.”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis waan Efroon dubbate sana fudhatee gatii inni utuma Heetonni dhagaʼanuu himate sana madaaleef; gatiin sunis akka madaalii daldaltoota yeroo sanaatti meetii saqilii dhibba afur ture.
english: Abraham listened to Ephron. Abraham weighed to Ephron the silver which he had named in the hearing of the children of Heth, four hundred shekels of silver, according to the current merchants’ standard.

kikuyu: Akkasitti lafti qotiisaa Efroon kan fuula Mamree dura, Makfelaa keessa jiru sun jechuunis lafti qotiisaatii fi holqi isa keessa jiru, mukni daangaa lafa qotiisaa sana keessa jiru hundi,
english: So the field of Ephron, which was in Machpelah, which was before Mamre, the field, the cave which was in it, and all the trees that were in the field, that were in all of its borders, were deeded

kikuyu: fuula Heetota gara karra magaalaa dhufan hundaa duratti akka dhaalaatti Abrahaamitti dabarfame.
english: to Abraham for a possession in the presence of the children of Heth, before all who went in at the gate of his city.

kikuyu: Ergasii Abrahaam biyya Kanaʼaan keessa, holqa Makfelaa kan Mamree bira jechuunis Kebroon bira jiru sanatti niitii isaa Saaraa Awwaallate.
english: After this, Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah before Mamre (that is, Hebron), in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Akkasitti lafa qotiisaa sunii fi holqi achi keessaa akka lafa awwaalaa taʼuuf Heetota irraa akka dhaalaatti Abrahaamitti dabarfame.
english: The field, and the cave that is in it, were deeded to Abraham by the children of Heth as a possession for a burial place.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana Abrahaam dulloomee, umuriin isaa akka malee dheeratee ture; Waaqayyos waan hundumaan isa eebbise.
english: Abraham was old, and well advanced in age. The LORD had blessed Abraham in all things.

kikuyu: Innis tajaajilaa mana isaa hangafa kan waan inni qabu hunda irratti itti gaafatamaa taʼeen akkana jedhe; “Mee harka kee gudeeda koo jala kaaʼi.
english: Abraham said to his servant, the elder of his house, who ruled over all that he had, “Please put your hand under my thigh.

kikuyu: Ani akka ati intallan warra Kanaʼaan kanneen ani gidduu isaanii jiraadhuu keessaa ilma kootiif niitii hin fidneef Waaqayyo Waaqa samiitii fi Waaqa lafaatiin kakattu nan barbaada;
english: I will make you swear by the LORD, the God of heaven and the God of the earth, that you shall not take a wife for my son of the daughters of the Canaanites, among whom I live.

kikuyu: garuu gara biyya kootii fi gara firoota koo dhaqiitii ilma koo Yisihaaqiif niitii barbaadi.”
english: But you shall go to my country, and to my relatives, and take a wife for my son Isaac.”

kikuyu: Tajaajilaan sun immoo, “Yoo dubartiin sun na wajjin gara biyya kanaa dhufuuf fedhii qabaachuu baatte hoo? Ani ilma kee gara biyya ati keessaa dhufte sanaatti deebisee geessuun qabaa?” jedhee isa gaafate.
english: The servant said to him, “What if the woman isn’t willing to follow me to this land? Must I bring your son again to the land you came from?”

kikuyu: Abrahaamis akkana isaan jedhe; “Ati akka ilma koo deebiftee biyya sanatti hin geessine of eeggadhu.
english: Abraham said to him, “Beware that you don’t bring my son there again.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni samii inni mana abbaa kootii fi biyya ani itti dhaladhe keessaa na fidee, ‘Ani biyya kana sanyii keetiif nan kenna’ jechuudhaan natti dubbatee kakatee waadaa naa seene sun akka ati achii ilma kootiif niitii fidduuf ergamaa isaa fuula kee dura ni erga.
english: The LORD, the God of heaven—who took me from my father’s house, and from the land of my birth, who spoke to me, and who swore to me, saying, ‘I will give this land to your offspring—he will send his angel before you, and you shall take a wife for my son from there.

kikuyu: Yoo dubartiin sun si wajjin dhufuuf fedhii qabaachuu baatte immoo ati kakuu koo kana irraa bilisa taata. Ilma koo garuu gonkumaa achi hin deebisin.”
english: If the woman isn’t willing to follow you, then you shall be clear from this oath to me. Only you shall not bring my son there again.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu tajaajilaan sun harka isaa gudeeda gooftaa isaa Abrahaam jala kaaʼee waaʼee waan kanaa kakateef.
english: The servant put his hand under the thigh of Abraham his master, and swore to him concerning this matter.

kikuyu: Tajaajilaan sunis gaala gooftaa isaa keessaa kudhan fudhatee gooftaa isaa biraa immoo kennaawwan filatamoo gosa hundaa feʼatee qajeele; innis magaalaa Naahoor ishee kaaba dhiʼa Phaadaan Arraam keessatti argamtuu dhaqe.
english: The servant took ten of his master’s camels, and departed, having a variety of good things of his master’s with him. He arose, and went to Mesopotamia, to the city of Nahor.

kikuyu: Innis akka gaalawwan sun magaalattiin alatti boolla bishaanii cina jijilbeenfatan godhe; yeroon sun gara galgalaa yeroo itti dubartoonni bishaan waraabbachuu baʼan ture.
english: He made the camels kneel down outside the city by the well of water at the time of evening, the time that women go out to draw water.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee kadhate; “Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa gooftaa koo Abrahaam, harʼa na milkeessiitii gooftaa koo Abrahaamiif garaa laafi.
english: He said, “LORD, the God of my master Abraham, please give me success today, and show kindness to my master Abraham.

kikuyu: Kunoo, ani burqaa kana bira dhaabadheen jira; intallan warra magaalaa kanaas bishaan waraabbachuuf as baʼaa jiru.
english: Behold, I am standing by the spring of water. The daughters of the men of the city are coming out to draw water.
