kikuyu: Yaaqoob yeroo Laabaan isa qaqqabetti, biyya gaaraa Giliʼaad keessa dunkaana isaa dhaabbatee ture; Laabaa fi firoonni isaas achi qubatan.
english: Laban caught up with Jacob. Now Jacob had pitched his tent in the mountain, and Laban with his relatives encamped in the mountain of Gilead.

kikuyu: Laabaanis Yaaqoobiin akkana jedhe; “Ati na gowwoomsitee intallan koo akka boojiʼamtoota waraanaatti fudhattee deemuun kee maal gochuu kee ti?
english: Laban said to Jacob, “What have you done, that you have deceived me, and carried away my daughters like captives of the sword?

kikuyu: Ati maaliif dhoksaan baqatte? Maaliifis na gowwoomsite? Akka ani gammachuu fi faarfannaadhaan, dibbee fi baganaadhaan si geggeessuuf maaliif natti himuu didde?
english: Why did you flee secretly, and deceive me, and didn’t tell me, that I might have sent you away with mirth and with songs, with tambourine and with harp;

kikuyu: Ati akka ani ijoollee ijoollee kootiitii fi intallan koo dhungadhee nagaatti jedhu naaf hin eeyyamne. Ati hojii gowwummaa hojjete.
english: and didn’t allow me to kiss my sons and my daughters? Now you have done foolishly.

kikuyu: Ani isin miidhuuf humna qaba; garuu eda Waaqni abbaa keessanii, ‘Ati waan gaariis taʼu hamaa tokko illee Yaaqoobitti akka hin dubbanne of eeggadhu’ naan jedhe.
english: It is in the power of my hand to hurt you, but the God of your father spoke to me last night, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t speak to Jacob either good or bad.’

kikuyu: Ati sababii mana abbaa keetiitti deebiʼuu akka malee hawwiteef deemteerta; garuu maaliif waaqota koo hatte?”
english: Now, you want to be gone, because you greatly longed for your father’s house, but why have you stolen my gods?”

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis akkana jedhee Laabaaf deebii kenne; “Ati intallan kee humnaan narraa fudhatta jedhee waanan sodaadheef nan deeme.
english: Jacob answered Laban, “Because I was afraid, for I said, ‘Lest you should take your daughters from me by force.’

kikuyu: Namni ati waaqota kee isa biratti argattu jiraachuu hin qabu. Akka wanni kan kee taʼe na bira jiruu fi akka hin jirre atuu fuula firoota keenyaa duratti sakattaʼi; yoo jiraate immoo fudhadhu.” Yaaqoob Raahel waaqota sana hattuu ishee Yaaqoob hin beeku ture.
english: Anyone you find your gods with shall not live. Before our relatives, discern what is yours with me, and take it.” For Jacob didn’t know that Rachel had stolen them.

kikuyu: Laabaanis dunkaana Yaaqoob, dunkaana Liyaatii fi dunkaana xomboreewwan lamaanii seenee homaa dhabe. Erga dunkaana Liyaatii baʼee booddees dunkaana Raahel seene.
english: Laban went into Jacob’s tent, into Leah’s tent, and into the tent of the two female servants; but he didn’t find them. He went out of Leah’s tent, and entered into Rachel’s tent.

kikuyu: Raahel immoo waaqota mana keessaa hatte sana kooraa gaalawwan ishee jala keessee irra taaʼaa turte. Laabaanis waan dunkaanicha keessa jiru hunda keessa barbaade; garuu homaa hin arganne.
english: Now Rachel had taken the teraphim, put them in the camel’s saddle, and sat on them. Laban felt around all the tent, but didn’t find them.

kikuyu: Raahelis abbaa isheetiin, “Yaa gooftaa ko, sababii ani kaʼee fuula kee dura dhaabachuu dadhabeef hin aarin; ani xuriin of irraa qabaa” jette. Innis ni sakattaʼe malee waaqota sana hin arganne.
english: She said to her father, “Don’t let my lord be angry that I can’t rise up before you; for I’m having my period.” He searched, but didn’t find the teraphim.

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis Laabaatti aaree isatti dheekkame. Innis akkana jedhee gaafate; “Yakki koo maali? Wanni ati akkana na adamsituuf ani cubbuu maalii hojjedheeti?
english: Jacob was angry, and argued with Laban. Jacob answered Laban, “What is my trespass? What is my sin, that you have hotly pursued me?

kikuyu: Ati miʼa koo hunda sakattaateerta; egaa miʼa mana keetii keessaa maal argatte? Yoo jiraate firoota keetii fi firoota koo duratti dhiʼeessiitii isaan nu lamaan gidduutti murtii haa kennan.
english: Now that you have felt around in all my stuff, what have you found of all your household stuff? Set it here before my relatives and your relatives, that they may judge between us two.

kikuyu: “Ani waggoota digdaman kana si wajjin jiraadheera. Hoolonnii fi reʼoonni kee tokko iyyuu hin gatanne; ani bushaayee kee keessaas korbeeyyii hin nyaanne.
english: “These twenty years I have been with you. Your ewes and your female goats have not cast their young, and I haven’t eaten the rams of your flocks.

kikuyu: Ani horii bineensi cabse gara keetti hin fidne; horii bades anatu kaffalaa ture. Waan guyyaas taʼu halkan hatame hundaaf ati na kaffalchiifatta turte.
english: That which was torn of animals, I didn’t bring to you. I bore its loss. Of my hand you required it, whether stolen by day or stolen by night.

kikuyu: Haalli ani keessa jiraadhe kana ture; guyyaa hoʼa, halkan immoo dhaamochatu na waxala ture; hirribnis ija koo irraa bade.
english: This was my situation: in the day the drought consumed me, and the frost by night; and my sleep fled from my eyes.

kikuyu: Akkasiin ani waggoota digdamman kana mana kee ture. Ani waggaa kudha afur intallan kee lamaaniif jedhee, waggaa jaʼa immoo bushaayee keetiif jedhee siif hojjedheera; ati immoo yeroo kudhan mindaa koo geeddarte.
english: These twenty years I have been in your house. I served you fourteen years for your two daughters, and six years for your flock, and you have changed my wages ten times.

kikuyu: Waaqni abbaa ko, Waaqni Abrahaam, Sodaan Yisihaaq utuu na wajjin jiraachuu baate ati silaa harka duwwaa na baasta turte. Waaqni garuu rakkina koo fi dadhabbii koo argee eda sitti dheekkame.”
english: Unless the God of my father, the God of Abraham, and the fear of Isaac, had been with me, surely now you would have sent me away empty. God has seen my affliction and the labor of my hands, and rebuked you last night.”

kikuyu: Laabaan akkana jedhee Yaaqoobiif deebise; “Dubartoonni kunneen intallan koo ti; ijoolleen kunneenis ijoolluma koo ti; bushaayeen kunneenis bushaayee koo ti. Wanni ati argitu hundi kanuma koo ti. Yoos ani waaʼee intallan koo kanneeniitii fi waaʼee ijoollee isaan daʼanii harʼa maal gochuun dandaʼa?
english: Laban answered Jacob, “The daughters are my daughters, the children are my children, the flocks are my flocks, and all that you see is mine! What can I do today to these my daughters, or to their children whom they have borne?

kikuyu: Kottu mee anii fi ati amma walii kakannaa; kakuun kunis anaa fi si gidduutti ragaa haa taʼu.”
english: Now come, let’s make a covenant, you and I. Let it be for a witness between me and you.”

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis dhagaa tokko fuudhee akka utubaatti dhaabe.
english: Jacob took a stone, and set it up for a pillar.

kikuyu: Innis firoota isaatiin, “Dhagaa walitti qabaa” jedhe. Isaanis dhagaa walitti qabanii tuulan; jarris tuullaa sana biratti nyaata nyaatan.
english: Jacob said to his relatives, “Gather stones.” They took stones, and made a heap. They ate there by the heap.

kikuyu: Laabaan tuullaa sanaan “Yigaarsahaadutaa” jedhee moggaase; Yaaqoob immoo “Giliʼaad” jedheen.
english: Laban called it Jegar Sahadutha, but Jacob called it Galeed.

kikuyu: Laabaanis, “Tuullaan kun anaa fi si gidduutti ragaa dha” jedhe. Gaalaʼaad jedhamuun isaa kanumaaf.
english: Laban said, “This heap is witness between me and you today.” Therefore it was named Galeed

kikuyu: Akkasumas Miisphaa jedhame; Laabaan akkana jedhee tureetii; “Yeroo nu gargar baanutti Waaqayyo sii fi ana gidduutti eegduu haa taʼu.
english: and Mizpah, for he said, “The LORD watch between me and you, when we are absent one from another.

kikuyu: Yoo ati intallan koo rakkifte yookaan yoo ati intallan koo irratti niitota biraa fuute, yoo namni tokko iyyuu nu bira hin jirre kunoo Waaqni anaa fi siʼi gidduutti ragaa dha.”
english: If you afflict my daughters, or if you take wives in addition to my daughters, no man is with us; behold, God is witness between me and you.”

kikuyu: Laabaan ammas Yaaqoobiin akkana jedhe; “Tuullaa kanaa fi utubaa ani sii fi ana gidduu dhaabe kana ilaali.
english: Laban said to Jacob, “See this heap, and see the pillar, which I have set between me and you.

kikuyu: Akka ani si miidhuuf jedhee tuullaa kana darbee gara keetti hin ceene, akka atis na miidhuuf jettee tuullaa kanaa fi utubaa kana dabartee gara kootti hin ceene tuullaan kun ragaa dha; utubaan kunis ragaa dha.
english: May this heap be a witness, and the pillar be a witness, that I will not pass over this heap to you, and that you will not pass over this heap and this pillar to me, for harm.

kikuyu: Waaqni Abrahaam, Waaqni Naahoor, Waaqni abbootii isaanii nu gidduutti murtii haa kennu.” Yaaqoobis akkasitti maqaa Sodaa abbaa isaa Yisihaaqiin kakate.
english: The God of Abraham, and the God of Nahor, the God of their father, judge between us.” Then Jacob swore by the fear of his father, Isaac.

kikuyu: Innis biyya gaaraa sanatti aarsaa dhiʼeessee firoota isaa nyaatatti waame. Isaanis erga nyaatanii booddee achuma bulan.
english: Jacob offered a sacrifice in the mountain, and called his relatives to eat bread. They ate bread, and stayed all night in the mountain.

kikuyu: Laabaanis guyyaa itti aanu ganama bariidhaan kaʼee ijoollee ijoollee isaatii fi intallan isaa dhungatee isaan eebbise. Ergasiis achii kaʼee gara iddoo isaatti deebiʼe.
english: Early in the morning, Laban rose up, and kissed his sons and his daughters, and blessed them. Laban departed and returned to his place.

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis karaa isaa itti fufe; ergamoonni Waaqayyoos isatti dhufan.
english: Jacob went on his way, and the angels of God met him.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu isaan argetti, “Kun buufata Waaqaa ti” jedhe; iddoo sanas Mahanayiim jedhee moggaase.
english: When he saw them, Jacob said, “This is God’s army.” He called the name of that place Mahanaim.

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis gara obboleessa isaa Esaawu kan biyya Edoom lafa Seeʼiir jedhamu keessa jiraatuutti ergamoota of dura erge.
english: Jacob sent messengers in front of him to Esau, his brother, to the land of Seir, the field of Edom.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee isaan ajaje: “Isin gooftaa koo Esaawuun akkana jedhaa: ‘Garbichi kee Yaaqoob akkana jedha; ani Laabaa bira jiraadhee hamma ammaattis isuma biran ture.
english: He commanded them, saying, “This is what you shall tell my lord, Esau: ‘This is what your servant, Jacob, says. I have lived as a foreigner with Laban, and stayed until now.

kikuyu: Ani loonii fi harroota, hoolotaa fi reʼoota, hojjettoota dhiiraatii fi dubartootas qaba. Ammas ani fuula kee duratti surraa akkan argadhuuf ergaa kana gooftaa kootti nan erga.’ ”
english: I have cattle, donkeys, flocks, male servants, and female servants. I have sent to tell my lord, that I may find favor in your sight.’”

kikuyu: Ergamoonni sunis gara Yaaqoobitti deebiʼanii, “Nu obboleessa kee Esaawu bira dhaqneerra; innis si simachuuf dhufaa jira; namoonni dhibba afur isa wajjin jiru” jedhaniin.
english: The messengers returned to Jacob, saying, “We came to your brother Esau. He is coming to meet you, and four hundred men are with him.”

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis akka malee sodaatee dhiphate; namoota isa wajjin turanis garee lamatti qoode; bushaayee, loowwanii fi gaalawwan illee akkasuma garee lamatti qoode.
english: Then Jacob was greatly afraid and was distressed. He divided the people who were with him, along with the flocks, the herds, and the camels, into two companies.

kikuyu: Innis, “Yoo Esaawu dhufee garee tokko dhaʼe, gareen kaan jalaa baʼa” jedhee yaade.
english: He said, “If Esau comes to the one company, and strikes it, then the company which is left will escape.”

kikuyu: Yaaqoob akkana jedhee kadhate; “Yaa Waaqa abbaa koo Abrahaam, Waaqa abbaa koo Yisihaaq, yaa Waaqayyo, isa ‘Ati gara biyya keetii fi gara firoota keetiitti deebiʼi, ani waan gaarii siifin godhaa’ naan jette sun,
english: Jacob said, “God of my father Abraham, and God of my father Isaac, the LORD, who said to me, ‘Return to your country, and to your relatives, and I will do you good,’

kikuyu: ani gaarummaa fi amanamummaa ati ana garbicha kee argisiifte kana hundaaf hin malu. Ani yeroo Yordaanos kana ceʼetti ulee koo qofa qaban ture; amma garuu garee lama taʼeen jira.
english: I am not worthy of the least of all the loving kindnesses, and of all the truth, which you have shown to your servant; for with just my staff I crossed over this Jordan; and now I have become two companies.

kikuyu: Ani akka ati harka obboleessa koo Esaawu jalaa na baastu sin kadhadha. Ani, ‘Inni dhufee na ajjeesa; haadhotas ijoollee isaanii wajjin ni ajjeesa’ jedhee sodaadheeraatii.
english: Please deliver me from the hand of my brother, from the hand of Esau; for I fear him, lest he come and strike me and the mothers with the children.

kikuyu: Ati garuu, ‘Ani dhugumaan waan gaarii siifin godha; sanyii kees akka cirracha galaanaa kan lakkaaʼamuu hin dandeenye sanaa nan godha’ jetteerta.”
english: You said, ‘I will surely do you good, and make your offspring as the sand of the sea, which can’t be counted because there are so many.’”

kikuyu: Inni halkan sana achuma bule; waan of biraa qabu keessaas kennaa obboleessa isaa Esaawuuf kennu filate;
english: He stayed there that night, and took from that which he had with him a present for Esau, his brother:

kikuyu: isaanis reʼoota dhaltuu dhibba lama, korbeeyyii reʼee digdama, hoolota dhaltuu dhibba lama, korbeeyyii hoolaa digdama,
english: two hundred female goats and twenty male goats, two hundred ewes and twenty rams,

kikuyu: gaalawwan dhalaa soddoma ilmaan isaanii wajjin, saawwan afurtama, jiboota loonii kudhan, harroota dhaltuu digdama, wadala harrootaa kudhan turan.
english: thirty milk camels and their colts, forty cows, ten bulls, twenty female donkeys and ten foals.

kikuyu: Innis karra karraan addaan baasee tajaajiltoota isaatti kennee, “Na dura darbaa deemaa; karrawwan horii gidduuttis lafa hambisaa” jedhee tajaajiltoota isaa ajaje.
english: He delivered them into the hands of his servants, every herd by itself, and said to his servants, “Pass over before me, and put a space between herd and herd.”

kikuyu: Namicha fuula duraan jiru sanaanis akkana jedhe: “Yoo Esaaw obboleessi koo sitti dhufe, ‘Ati kan eenyuu ti? Eessa dhaqxa? Horiin fuula kee dura jiru kun kan eenyuu ti?’ jedhee si gaafate,
english: He commanded the foremost, saying, “When Esau, my brother, meets you, and asks you, saying, ‘Whose are you? Where are you going? Whose are these before you?’

kikuyu: ati, ‘Kan garbicha kee Yaaqoob. Isaanis kennaa gooftaa koo Esaawuuf ergamanii dha; kunoo, Yaaqoobis nu duubaan dhufaa jira’ jechuu qabda.”
english: Then you shall say, ‘They are your servant, Jacob’s. It is a present sent to my lord, Esau. Behold, he also is behind us.’”

kikuyu: Namicha lammaffaa, sadaffaa fi warra karrawwan sana faana deeman hundas akkana jedhee ajaje; “Isinis yoo Esaawun argitan waanuma kana isatti himaa.
english: He commanded also the second, and the third, and all that followed the herds, saying, “This is how you shall speak to Esau, when you find him.

kikuyu: Akkasumas, ‘Kunoo garbichi kee Yaaqoob nu duubaan dhufaa jira’ jedhaa.” Inni, “Ani kennaa of dura ergeef kanaan isa nan araarfadha; ergasii immoo ani yommuun isa argutti tarii inni na simata taʼa” jedhee yaadee tureetii.
english: You shall say, ‘Not only that, but behold, your servant, Jacob, is behind us.’” For, he said, “I will appease him with the present that goes before me, and afterward I will see his face. Perhaps he will accept me.”

kikuyu: Kennaan Yaaqoobiis isa dura darbe; Yaaqoob garuu halkan sana qubata sana keessa bule.
english: So the present passed over before him, and he himself stayed that night in the camp.

kikuyu: Halkanuma sana Yaaqoob kaʼee niitota isaa lamaan, xomboreewwan isaa lamaanii fi ilmaan isaa kudha tokko fudhatee malkaa Yaaboq ceʼe.
english: He rose up that night, and took his two wives, and his two servants, and his eleven sons, and crossed over the ford of the Jabbok.

kikuyu: Innis erga laga isaan ceesisee booddee qabeenya isaa hunda erge.
english: He took them, and sent them over the stream, and sent over that which he had.

kikuyu: Yaaqoob immoo kophaa isaa hafe; namichi tokkos hamma lafti bariitutti walʼaansoo isa qabe.
english: Jacob was left alone, and wrestled with a man there until the breaking of the day.

kikuyu: Namichis yommuu akka Yaaqoobin moʼachuu hin dandeenye argetti, buusaa luqqeettuu Yaaqoob tuqe; yeroo inni namicha wajjin walʼaansoo qabettis luqqeettuun Yaaqoob ni adoode.
english: When he saw that he didn’t prevail against him, the man touched the hollow of his thigh, and the hollow of Jacob’s thigh was strained as he wrestled.

kikuyu: Namichis, “Waan bariʼuu gaʼeef gad na dhiisi” jedhe. Yaaqoob garuu, “Yoo ati na eebbifte malee ani gad si hin dhiisu” jedhee deebise.
english: The man said, “Let me go, for the day breaks.” Jacob said, “I won’t let you go unless you bless me.”

kikuyu: Namichis, “Maqaan kee eenyu” jedhee isa gaafate. Inni immoo, “Yaaqoob” jedhee deebise.
english: He said to him, “What is your name?” He said, “Jacob”.

kikuyu: Namichis, “Ati sababii Waaqaa fi namoota wajjin walʼaansoo qabdee moʼatteef siʼachi Israaʼel jedhamta malee Yaaqoob hin jedhamtu” jedhe.
english: He said, “Your name will no longer be called Jacob, but Israel; for you have fought with God and with men, and have prevailed.”

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis, “Maaloo maqaa kee natti himi” jedheen. Inni garuu, “Ati maaliif maqaa koo gaafatta?” jedheen. Ergasiis inni achumatti isa eebbise.
english: Jacob asked him, “Please tell me your name.” He said, “Why is it that you ask what my name is?” So he blessed him there.

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis, “Ani ifaan ifatti Waaqa argeeraatii; lubbuun koo garuu oolfamteerti” jedhee iddoo sana Pheniiʼeel jedhee moggaase.
english: Jacob called the name of the place Peniel; for he said, “I have seen God face to face, and my life is preserved.”

kikuyu: Akkuma inni Phenuuʼeelin darbeen aduun isatti baate; innis sababii luqqeettuu isaatiif okkolaa ture.
english: The sun rose on him as he passed over Peniel, and he limped because of his thigh.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Israaʼeloonni hamma harʼaatti ribuu tafaa hin nyaatan; inni buusaa luqqeettuu Yaaqoob kan tafaan wal qabatu tuqee tureetii.
english: Therefore the children of Israel don’t eat the sinew of the hip, which is on the hollow of the thigh, to this day, because he touched the hollow of Jacob’s thigh in the sinew of the hip.

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis ol jedhee ilaalee kunoo Esaawu namoota dhibba afur wajjin utuu dhufaa jiruu arge; innis Liyaatti, Raahelii fi xomboreewwan lamaanitti ijoollee gargari hire.
english: Jacob lifted up his eyes, and looked, and, behold, Esau was coming, and with him four hundred men. He divided the children between Leah, Rachel, and the two servants.

kikuyu: Xomboreewwanii fi ijoollee isaanii dura aanse; Liyaa fi ijoollee ishee itti aansee, Raahelii fi Yoosefin immoo dugda duuba buuse.
english: He put the servants and their children in front, Leah and her children after, and Rachel and Joseph at the rear.

kikuyu: Ofii isaatii immoo isaan dura darbee hamma obboleessa isaa bira gaʼutti yeroo torba lafatti gad jedhee harka fuudhe.
english: He himself passed over in front of them, and bowed himself to the ground seven times, until he came near to his brother.

kikuyu: Esaawu garuu Yaaqoobin simachuuf itti fiigee isa hammate; morma isaattis marmee isa dhungate. Isaan lachanuu walitti booʼan.
english: Esau ran to meet him, embraced him, fell on his neck, kissed him, and they wept.

kikuyu: Esaawus ol jedhee ilaalee dubartootaa fi ijoollee argee, “Warri si wajjin jiran kunneen eenyu?” jedhee gaafate. Yaaqoobis deebise, “Isaan ijoollee Waaqni arjummaadhaan ana garbicha keetiif kennee dha” jedhe.
english: He lifted up his eyes, and saw the women and the children; and said, “Who are these with you?” He said, “The children whom God has graciously given your servant.”

kikuyu: Xomboreewwanii fi ijoolleen isaanii dhiʼaatanii gad jedhanii harka fuudhan.
english: Then the servants came near with their children, and they bowed themselves.

kikuyu: Itti aansaniis Liyaa fi ijoolleen ishee dhufanii gad jedhanii harka fuudhan. Dhuma irratti immoo Yoosefii fi Raahel dhufanii gad jedhani harka fuudhan.
english: Leah also and her children came near, and bowed themselves. After them, Joseph came near with Rachel, and they bowed themselves.

kikuyu: Esaawu, “Bushaayee fi loon ani argu kun hundi maali?” jedhee gaafate. Yaaqoobis, “Ani fuula kee fuula gooftaa koo duratti fudhatama argachuuf jedhee ti” jedhe.
english: Esau said, “What do you mean by all this company which I met?” Jacob said, “To find favor in the sight of my lord.”

kikuyu: Esaawu immoo, “Yaa obboleessa koo ani waan na gaʼu qaba. Ati waan qabdu ofuma keetii hambifadhu” jedheen.
english: Esau said, “I have enough, my brother; let that which you have be yours.”

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis akkana jedhe; “Maaloo akkas miti! Yoo ani fuula kee duratti fudhatama argadhee jiraadhe, kennaa kana na harkaa fudhadhu. Egaa amma ati fuula tolaadhaan na simatteerta; fuula kee arguun anaaf akkuma fuula Waaqaa arguutii.
english: Jacob said, “Please, no, if I have now found favor in your sight, then receive my present at my hand, because I have seen your face, as one sees the face of God, and you were pleased with me.

kikuyu: Sababii Waaqni natti arjoomee anis waan na barbaachisu hunda qabuuf maaloo kennaa ani siif fide kana fudhadhu.” Esaawus waan Yaaqoob cimsee isa kadhateef kennaa sana ni fudhate.
english: Please take the gift that I brought to you, because God has dealt graciously with me, and because I have enough.” He urged him, and he took it.

kikuyu: Esaawus, “Kottu karaa keenya itti fufnee haa deemnu; ani si dura nan buʼaa” jedhe.
english: Esau said, “Let’s take our journey, and let’s go, and I will go before you.”

kikuyu: Yaaqoob garuu akkana isaan jedhe; “Akka ijoolleen dadhaboo taʼanii fi akka anis hoolotaa fi saawwan hoosisaniif kunuunsa gochuu qabu ati gooftaan koo ni beekta. Horiin kunneen yoo guyyuma tokkoon jarjarsuudhaan oofaman hundi isaanii ni dhumu.
english: Jacob said to him, “My lord knows that the children are tender, and that the flocks and herds with me have their young, and if they overdrive them one day, all the flocks will die.

kikuyu: Gooftaan koo garbicha isaa dura darbee haa deemu; ani immoo hamman Seeʼiiritti gooftaa koo qaqqabutti akkuma humna bushaayee fuula koo dura jirutii fi akkuma humna ijoolleetti suuta jedhee nan deema.”
english: Please let my lord pass over before his servant, and I will lead on gently, according to the pace of the livestock that are before me and according to the pace of the children, until I come to my lord to Seir.”

kikuyu: Esaawus, “Yoos namoota koo keessaa muraasa si biratti nan dhiisa” jedhe. Yaaqoob immoo, “Kun maaliif barbaachisaa? Fuula gooftaa koo duratti fudhatama argachuun qofti na gaʼa” jedhe.
english: Esau said, “Let me now leave with you some of the people who are with me.” He said, “Why? Let me find favor in the sight of my lord.”

kikuyu: Esaawus guyyuma sana karaa isaa irra Seeʼiiritti deebiʼe.
english: So Esau returned that day on his way to Seir.

kikuyu: Yaaqoob garuu Sukooti dhaqee achitti ofii isaatiif mana ijaarrate; horii isaatiif immoo daasii ijaare. Kanaafuu iddoon sun Suukooti jedhame.
english: Jacob traveled to Succoth, built himself a house, and made shelters for his livestock. Therefore the name of the place is called Succoth.

kikuyu: Yaaqoob erga kaaba dhiʼa Phaadaan Arraamiitii deebiʼee booddee nagaan magaalaa Sheekem ishee biyya Kanaʼaan keessaa sana gaʼee fuula magaalattii dura qubate.
english: Jacob came in peace to the city of Shechem, which is in the land of Canaan, when he came from Paddan Aram; and encamped before the city.

kikuyu: Innis lafa dunkaana isaa irra dhaabate sana ilmaan Hamoor irraa meetii dhibbaan bitate; Hamoor immoo abbaa Sheekem.
english: He bought the parcel of ground where he had spread his tent, at the hand of the children of Hamor, Shechem’s father, for one hundred pieces of money.

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis achitti iddoo aarsaa ijaaree El Elohee Israaʼel jedhee moggaase.
english: He erected an altar there, and called it El Elohe Israel.

kikuyu: Diinaan intalli Liyaan Yaaqoobiif deesse sun dubartoota biyyattii ilaaluudhaaf gad baate.
english: Dinah, the daughter of Leah, whom she bore to Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.

kikuyu: Sheekem ilmi Hamoor namicha gosa Hiiwii kan bulchaa biyya sanaa ture ishee arge; innis qabee humnaan ishee gudeede.
english: Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, the prince of the land, saw her. He took her, lay with her, and humbled her.

kikuyu: Qalbiin isaas Diinaa intala Yaaqoobiin fudhatame; innis ishee jaallatee afaan tolaa itti dubbate.
english: His soul joined to Dinah, the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the young lady, and spoke kindly to the young lady.

kikuyu: Sheekemis abbaa isaa Hamooriin, “Intala kana na fuusisi” jedhe.
english: Shechem spoke to his father, Hamor, saying, “Get me this young lady as a wife.”

kikuyu: Yaaqoob yommuu intalli isaa Diinaan akka gudeedamte dhagaʼetti, ilmaan isaa dirree irra horii tiksu turan; kanaafuu Yaaqoob hamma isaan galanitti ni calʼise.
english: Now Jacob heard that he had defiled Dinah, his daughter; and his sons were with his livestock in the field. Jacob held his peace until they came.

kikuyu: Hamoor abbaan Sheekemis Yaaqoob wajjin dubbachuu dhaqe.
english: Hamor the father of Shechem went out to Jacob to talk with him.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yaaqoobis akkuma waan uumame sana dhagaʼaniin dirreedhaa dhufan. Isaanis sababii Sheekem intala Yaaqoob wajjin ciisuudhaan Israaʼel keessatti waan jibbisiisaa hojjeteef ni gaddan; akka malees aaran.
english: The sons of Jacob came in from the field when they heard it. The men were grieved, and they were very angry, because he had done folly in Israel in lying with Jacob’s daughter, a thing that ought not to be done.

kikuyu: Hamoor garuu akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Qalbiin ilma koo Sheekem intala keessan irra buʼeera. Maaloo isatti ishee heerumsiisaa.
english: Hamor talked with them, saying, “The soul of my son, Shechem, longs for your daughter. Please give her to him as a wife.

kikuyu: Fuudhaa fi heerumaan walitti firoomnaa; intallan keessan nuu kennaa; intallan keenyas fuudhaa.
english: Make marriages with us. Give your daughters to us, and take our daughters for yourselves.

kikuyu: Nu wajjin jiraadhaa; biyyattiin fuula keessan dura jirti; keessa jiraadhaatii itti daldalaa; qabeenyas itti horadhaa.”
english: You shall dwell with us, and the land will be before you. Live and trade in it, and get possessions in it.”

kikuyu: Sheekemis abbaa Diinaatii fi obboloota isheetiin akkana jedhe; “Ani fuula keessan duratti fudhatama argannaan waanuma isin naan jettan isiniif nan kenna.
english: Shechem said to her father and to her brothers, “Let me find favor in your eyes, and whatever you will tell me I will give.

kikuyu: Isinis gabbara misirrittiitii fi kennaa ani fiduu qabu hamma feetan natti muraa; anis waan isin naan jettan nan baasa. Intalattii qofa natti heerumsiisaa.”
english: Ask me a great amount for a dowry, and I will give whatever you ask of me, but give me the young lady as a wife.”

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yaaqoob immoo waan Sheekem obboleettii isaanii Diinaa gudeedeef yeroo Sheekemii fi abbaa isaa Hamooriif deebii kennanitti haxxummaadhaan dubbatan.
english: The sons of Jacob answered Shechem and Hamor his father with deceit when they spoke, because he had defiled Dinah their sister,

kikuyu: Isaanis akkana isaaniin jedhan; “Nu waan akkanaa gochuu hin dandeenyu; nu nama dhagna hin qabatiniif intala keenya kennuu hin dandeenyu. Kun nuuf salphina.
english: and said to them, “We can’t do this thing, to give our sister to one who is uncircumcised; for that is a reproach to us.

kikuyu: Nu waan tokko qofaan tole isiniin jenna; kunis yoo isin dhiira keessan hunda dhagna qabdanii akkuma keenya taatanii dha.
english: Only on this condition will we consent to you. If you will be as we are, that every male of you be circumcised,

kikuyu: Ergasii nu intallan keenya isinii kennina; intallan keessan immoo ni fuuna. Gidduu keessan ni jiraanna; isin wajjinis saba tokko ni taana.
english: then will we give our daughters to you; and we will take your daughters to us, and we will dwell with you, and we will become one people.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo isin dhagna qabachuu diddan nu obboleettii keenya fudhannee deemna.”
english: But if you will not listen to us and be circumcised, then we will take our sister, and we will be gone.”

kikuyu: Dubbiin isaanii Hamoorii fi Sheekem ilma Hamoor ni gammachiise.
english: Their words pleased Hamor and Shechem, Hamor’s son.

kikuyu: Sheekem namoota mana abbaa isaa jiraatan hunda caalaa kabajamaa ture; inni sababii intala Yaaqoobitti gammadeef waan kana lafa irra hin harkifne;
english: The young man didn’t wait to do this thing, because he had delight in Jacob’s daughter, and he was honored above all the house of his father.

kikuyu: Hamoorii fi ilmi isaa Sheekem gara karra magaalaa isaanii dhufanii namoota magaalaa isaaniitiin akkana jedhan;
english: Hamor and Shechem, his son, came to the gate of their city, and talked with the men of their city, saying,

kikuyu: “Jarri kun nuuf warra nagaa ti; kanaafuu biyyattii keessa jiraatanii itti haa daldalatan. Biyyattiin isaaniif lafa balʼaa qabdi; nu intallan isaanii haa fuunu; isaanis intallan keenya haa fuudhan.
english: “These men are peaceful with us. Therefore let them live in the land and trade in it. For behold, the land is large enough for them. Let’s take their daughters to us for wives, and let’s give them our daughters.

kikuyu: Garuu namoonni kunneen akka saba tokkootti nu wajjin jiraachuuf tole kan jedhan yoo dhiironni keenya akkuma isaanii dhagna qabatan qofa.
english: Only on this condition will the men consent to us to live with us, to become one people, if every male among us is circumcised, as they are circumcised.

kikuyu: Loon isaanii, qabeenyi isaaniitii fi horiin isaanii kaan hundinuu kanuma keenya hin taʼanii? Kanaafuu kottaa tole isaaniin jennaa; isaanis nu wajjin ni jiraatu.”
english: Won’t their livestock and their possessions and all their animals be ours? Only let’s give our consent to them, and they will dwell with us.”

kikuyu: Namoonni karra magaalaa sanaatiin gad baʼan hundinuu Hamoorii fi ilma isaa Sheekemiin walii galan; dhiironni karra magaalaa sanaatiin gad baʼan hundinuus dhagna qabatan.
english: All who went out of the gate of his city listened to Hamor, and to Shechem his son; and every male was circumcised, all who went out of the gate of his city.

kikuyu: Guyyaa sadii booddee utuma isaan dhukkubsachaa jiranuu, ilmaan Yaaqoobii keessaa namni lama Simiʼoonii fi Lewwiin, obboloonni Diinaa, goraadee isaanii fudhatanii magaalaa homaa quba hin qabne sana dhaʼanii dhiira hunda ajjeesan.
english: On the third day, when they were sore, two of Jacob’s sons, Simeon and Levi, Dinah’s brothers, each took his sword, came upon the unsuspecting city, and killed all the males.

kikuyu: Isaanis goraadeedhaan Hamoorii fi ilma isaa Sheekemin ajjeesanii Diinaa immoo mana Sheekemiitii fudhatanii qajeelan.
english: They killed Hamor and Shechem, his son, with the edge of the sword, and took Dinah out of Shechem’s house, and went away.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yaaqoobis reeffawwan irra darbanii magaalaa obboleettiin isaanii itti gudeedamte sana saaman.
english: Jacob’s sons came on the dead, and plundered the city, because they had defiled their sister.

kikuyu: Isaanis bushaayee isaanii, loon isaanii, harroota isaaniitii fi waan isaan magaalaa keessaa fi alaa qaban hunda fudhatan.
english: They took their flocks, their herds, their donkeys, that which was in the city, that which was in the field,

kikuyu: Qabeenya isaanii hunda, dubartootaa fi ijoollee isaanii hunda fudhatanii deeman; waan mana keessa jiru hundas ni boojiʼan.
english: and all their wealth. They took captive all their little ones and their wives, and took as plunder everything that was in the house.

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis Simiʼoonii fi Lewwiidhaan akkana jedhe; “Isin akka ani Kanaʼaanotaa fi Feerzota biyya kana jiraatanitti xireeffatamu gochuudhaan rakkoo natti fiddan. Nu baayʼinaan xinnoo dha; yoo isaan humna walitti dabalatanii na lolan anii fi warri mana koo hundinuu ni dhumna.”
english: Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, “You have troubled me, to make me odious to the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites. I am few in number. They will gather themselves together against me and strike me, and I will be destroyed, I and my house.”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu, “Yoos inni akkuma sagaagaltuu tokkootti obboleettii keenyatti haa taphatuu ree?” jedhanii deebisan.
english: They said, “Should he deal with our sister as with a prostitute?”

kikuyu: Waaqni Yaaqoobiin, “Kaʼiitii Beetʼeelitti ol baʼii achi jiraadhu; achittis Waaqa yeroo ati obboleessa kee Esaawun baqatetti sitti mulʼate sanaaf iddoo aarsaa tolchi” jedhe.
english: God said to Jacob, “Arise, go up to Bethel, and live there. Make there an altar to God, who appeared to you when you fled from the face of Esau your brother.”

kikuyu: Yaaqoob warra mana isaa jiranii fi warra isa wajjin turan hundaan akkana jedhe; “Waaqota ormaa kanneen isin of biraa qabdan irraa fagaadhaa; of qulqulleessaa; uffata keessanis geeddaradhaa.
english: Then Jacob said to his household, and to all who were with him, “Put away the foreign gods that are among you, purify yourselves, and change your garments.

kikuyu: Kottaa kaanee Beetʼeelitti ol baanaa; anis achitti Waaqa gaafa rakkina kootii deebii naa kenne isa iddoo ani dhaqe hundumatti na wajjin ture sanaaf iddoo aarsaa nan tolcha.”
english: Let’s arise, and go up to Bethel. I will make there an altar to God, who answered me in the day of my distress, and was with me on the way which I went.”

kikuyu: Isaanis waaqota ormaa kanneen isaan of biraa qaban hundaa fi lootii gurra isaanii Yaaqoobitti kennan; Yaaqoobis fuudhee qilxuu Sheekemii jalatti awwaale.
english: They gave to Jacob all the foreign gods which were in their hands, and the rings which were in their ears; and Jacob hid them under the oak which was by Shechem.

kikuyu: Isaanis kaʼanii qajeelan; akka namni tokko iyyuu isaan duukaa hin buuneef naasisuun Waaqaa magaalaawwan naannoo isaanii jiran irra buʼe.
english: They traveled, and a terror of God was on the cities that were around them, and they didn’t pursue the sons of Jacob.

kikuyu: Yaaqoobii fi namoonni isa wajjin turan hundi gara Luuzi kan Beetʼeel jedhamtuu ishee biyya Kanaʼaan keessatti argamtu sanaa dhufan.
english: So Jacob came to Luz (that is, Bethel), which is in the land of Canaan, he and all the people who were with him.

kikuyu: Innis achitti iddoo aarsaa tolchee sababii yeroo inni obboleessa isaa jalaa baqachaa turetti Waaqni achitti isatti of mulʼiseef iddoo sana El Beetʼeel jedhee waame.
english: He built an altar there, and called the place El Beth El; because there God was revealed to him, when he fled from the face of his brother.

kikuyu: Debooraan guddiftuun Ribqaa duutee Beetʼeelii gaditti qilxuu jalatti awwaalamte. Maqaan isaas Aloonbaakut jedhame.
english: Deborah, Rebekah’s nurse, died, and she was buried below Bethel under the oak; and its name was called Allon Bacuth.

kikuyu: Erga Yaaqoob kaaba dhiʼa Phaadaan Arraamiitii deebiʼee booddee Waaqni ammas isatti mulʼatee isa eebbise.
english: God appeared to Jacob again, when he came from Paddan Aram, and blessed him.

kikuyu: Waaqni, “Maqaan kee Yaaqoob; siʼachi garuu ati Yaaqoob hin jedhamtu; maqaan kee Israaʼel jedhama” jedheen. Maqaan isaas Israaʼel jedhame.
english: God said to him, “Your name is Jacob. Your name shall not be Jacob any more, but your name will be Israel.” He named him Israel.

kikuyu: Waaqni akkana isaan jedhe; “Ani Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu dha; hori; baayʼadhus. Sabnii fi waldaan sabootaa sirraa argamu; mootonnis mudhii kee keessaa baʼu.
english: God said to him, “I am God Almighty. Be fruitful and multiply. A nation and a company of nations will be from you, and kings will come out of your body.

kikuyu: Ani biyya Abrahaamii fi Yisihaaqiif kenne siifis nan kenna; ani biyya kana sanyii kee warra si booddeetiifis nan kenna.”
english: The land which I gave to Abraham and Isaac, I will give it to you, and to your offspring after you I will give the land.”

kikuyu: Waaqnis iddoo itti isa wajjin haasaʼaa ture sanatti isa dhiisee ol baʼe.
english: God went up from him in the place where he spoke with him.

kikuyu: Yaaqoob iddoo itti Waaqni isa wajjin dubbate sana utubaa dhagaa tokko dhaabee kennaa dhugaatii irratti dhangalaase; zayitiis irratti dhangalaase.
english: Jacob set up a pillar in the place where he spoke with him, a pillar of stone. He poured out a drink offering on it, and poured oil on it.

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis iddoo itti Waaqni isa wajjin dubbate sana Beetʼeel jedhee moggaase.
english: Jacob called the name of the place where God spoke with him “Bethel”.

kikuyu: Isaanis Beetʼeelii kaʼanii adeemsa isaanii itti fufan. Akkuma isaan Efraataatti dhiʼaataniinis Raahel ciniinsuun qabamtee akka malee muddamte.
english: They traveled from Bethel. There was still some distance to come to Ephrath, and Rachel travailed. She had hard labor.

kikuyu: Utuu isheen daʼuuf ciniinsuu jabaa keessa jirtuus deessiftuun, “Ati waan ilma biraa deessuuf hin sodaatin” jetteen.
english: When she was in hard labor, the midwife said to her, “Don’t be afraid, for now you will have another son.”

kikuyu: Raahel garuu waan duʼuu geesseef utuma lubbuun ishee baʼaa jirtuu Ben-Oonii jettee ilma ishee moggaafte. Abbaan isaa garuu Beniyaam jedhee isa moggaase.
english: As her soul was departing (for she died), she named him Benoni, but his father named him Benjamin.

kikuyu: Akkasiin Raahel duutee karaa Efraataatti geessu irratti awwaalamte; Efraataan kun immoo Beetlihem.
english: Rachel died, and was buried on the way to Ephrath (also called Bethlehem).

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis awwaala ishee irra soodduu dhaabe; soodduun sunis hamma harʼaattuu awwaala Raahel argisiisa.
english: Jacob set up a pillar on her grave. The same is the Pillar of Rachel’s grave to this day.

kikuyu: Israaʼel ammas achii kaʼee Migdaal Eederiin gamatti dunkaana isaa dhaabbate.
english: Israel traveled, and spread his tent beyond the tower of Eder.

kikuyu: Utuu Israaʼel biyya sana jiraatuu Ruubeen ol seenee saajjatoo abbaa isaa Bilihaa wajjin ciise; Israaʼelis waan kana dhagaʼe.
english: While Israel lived in that land, Reuben went and lay with Bilhah, his father’s concubine, and Israel heard of it. Now the sons of Jacob were twelve.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Liyaa: Ruubeen jechuunis ilma Yaaqoob isa hangafa, Simiʼoon, Lewwii, Yihuudaa, Yisaakorii fi Zebuuloon.
english: The sons of Leah: Reuben (Jacob’s firstborn), Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Raahel: Yoosefii fi Beniyaam.
english: The sons of Rachel: Joseph and Benjamin.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Bilihaa jechuunis xomboree Raahel: Daanii fi Niftaalem.
english: The sons of Bilhah (Rachel’s servant): Dan and Naphtali.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Zilfaa jechuunis xomboree Liyaa: Gaadii fi Aasheer.
english: The sons of Zilpah (Leah’s servant): Gad and Asher. These are the sons of Jacob, who were born to him in Paddan Aram.

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis gara abbaa isaa, gara Yisihaaq, gara magaalaa Mamree ishee Kiriyaati Arbaaq kan Kebroon jedhamtuu, iddoo Abrahaamii fi Yisihaaq alagoota taʼanii jiraachaa turan sanaa dhufe.
english: Jacob came to Isaac his father, to Mamre, to Kiriath Arba (which is Hebron), where Abraham and Isaac lived as foreigners.

kikuyu: Yisihaaq waggaa dhibba tokkoo fi saddeettama jiraate.
english: The days of Isaac were one hundred eighty years.

kikuyu: Innis umurii quufee, dulloomee hafuura isaa kan dhumaa baafatee duʼe; gara saba isaattis dabalame. Ilmaan isaa Esaawuu fi Yaaqoobis isa awwaalan.
english: Isaac gave up the spirit and died, and was gathered to his people, old and full of days. Esau and Jacob, his sons, buried him.

kikuyu: Seenaan maatii Esaawu kan Edoom jedhamu sanaa kana.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Esau (that is, Edom).

kikuyu: Esaaw niitota isaa dubartootaa Kanaʼaan keessaa fuudhe; isaanis Aadaa intala Eeloon namicha gosa Heetii fi Oholiibaamaa intala Aannaa ilma Zibeʼoon namicha gosa Hiiwii,
english: Esau took his wives from the daughters of Canaan: Adah the daughter of Elon, the Hittite; and Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, the Hivite;

kikuyu: akkasumas Baasmati intala Ishmaaʼeel obboleettii Nabaayoti.
english: and Basemath, Ishmael’s daughter, sister of Nebaioth.

kikuyu: Aadaan Eliifaazin Esaawuuf deesse; Baasmati immoo Reʼuuʼeelin deesse.
english: Adah bore to Esau Eliphaz. Basemath bore Reuel.

kikuyu: Oholiibaamaanis Yeʼuushi, Yaʼilaamii fi Qooraahi deesse. Isaan kunneen ilmaan Esaawu kanneen Kanaʼaanitti isaaf dhalatanii dha.
english: Oholibamah bore Jeush, Jalam, and Korah. These are the sons of Esau, who were born to him in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Esaawu niitota isaa, ilmaan isaa, intallan isaatii fi warra mana isaa jiraatan hunda, akkasumas karra loon isaa, horii isaa kaan hundaa fi qabeenya biyya Kanaʼaanitti horate hunda fudhatee obboleessa isaa Yaaqoob biraa kaʼee biyya biraa dhaqe.
english: Esau took his wives, his sons, his daughters, and all the members of his household, with his livestock, all his animals, and all his possessions, which he had gathered in the land of Canaan, and went into a land away from his brother Jacob.

kikuyu: Waan qabeenyi isaanii akka malee baayʼateef isaan walii wajjin jiraachuu dadhaban; lafti isaan jiraachaa turanis sababii baayʼina horii isaaniitiif isaan gaʼuu hin dandeenye.
english: For their substance was too great for them to dwell together, and the land of their travels couldn’t bear them because of their livestock.

kikuyu: Esaawu biyya gaara Seeʼiir keessa jiraate; Esaawu jechuun Edoomii dha.
english: Esau lived in the hill country of Seir. Esau is Edom.

kikuyu: Seenaan maatii Esaawu abbaa Edoomotaa kan warra biyya gaara Seeʼiir keessa jiraatanii kana.
english: This is the history of the generations of Esau the father of the Edomites in the hill country of Seir:

kikuyu: Maqaan ilmaan Esaawu: Eliifaaz, ilma Aadaa niitii Esaawuutii fi Reʼuuʼeel ilma Baasmati niitii Esaawuu ti.
english: these are the names of Esau’s sons: Eliphaz, the son of Adah, the wife of Esau; and Reuel, the son of Basemath, the wife of Esau.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Eliifaaz: Teemaan, Oomaar, Zefoo, Gaataamii fi Qenaz.
english: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zepho, and Gatam, and Kenaz.

kikuyu: Eliifaaz ilmi Esaawus saajjatoo Tiimnaa jedhamtu qaba ture; isheenis Amaaleqin Eliifaaziif deesse. Isaan kunneen ilmaan ilmaan Aadaa niitii Esaawu.
english: Timna was concubine to Eliphaz, Esau’s son; and she bore to Eliphaz Amalek. These are the descendants of Adah, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Reʼuuʼeel: Nahaati, Zeraa, Shamaa fi Miizaah. Isaan kunneen ilmaan ilmaan Baasmati niitii Esaawu.
english: These are the sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah. These were the descendants of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Oholiibaamaan niitiin Esaawu intalli Aannaa ilma Zibeʼoon Esaawuuf: Yeʼuushi, Yaʼilaamii fi Qooraahi deesse.
english: These were the sons of Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah, the daughter of Zibeon, Esau’s wife: she bore to Esau Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen sanyiiwwan Esaawu keessaa hangafoota turan: Ilmaan Eliifaaz ilma Esaawu isa hangafaa: Teemaan hangafticha, Oomaar hangafticha, Zefoo hangafticha, Qenaz hangafticha,
english: These are the chiefs of the sons of Esau: the sons of Eliphaz the firstborn of Esau: chief Teman, chief Omar, chief Zepho, chief Kenaz,

kikuyu: Qooraahi hangafticha, Gaataam hangaftichaa fi Amaaleq hangafticha. Isaan kunneen hangafoota biyya Edoom keessatti Eliifaaz irraa dhalatanii dha; isaanis ilmaan Aadaa ti.
english: chief Korah, chief Gatam, chief Amalek. These are the chiefs who came of Eliphaz in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Adah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Reʼuuʼeel ilma Esaawu: Nahaati hangafticha, Zeraa hangafticha, Shamaa hangaftichaa fi Miizaah hangafticha. Isaan kunneen hangafoota biyya Edoomitti Raaquʼel irraa dhalatanii dha; isaanis ilmaan Baasmati niitii Esaawu.
english: These are the sons of Reuel, Esau’s son: chief Nahath, chief Zerah, chief Shammah, chief Mizzah. These are the chiefs who came of Reuel in the land of Edom. These are the sons of Basemath, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Oholiibaamaa niitii Esaawu: Yeʼuushi hangafticha, Yaʼilaamaa hangaftichaa fi Qooraahi hangafticha. Isaan kunneen hangafoota Ahiliibaamaa niitii Esaawu intala Aannaa irraa dhalatanii dha.
english: These are the sons of Oholibamah, Esau’s wife: chief Jeush, chief Jalam, chief Korah. These are the chiefs who came of Oholibamah the daughter of Anah, Esau’s wife.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen ilmaan Esaawu Edoom jedhamu sanaa turan; isaan kunneenis hangafoota isaanii turan.
english: These are the sons of Esau (that is, Edom), and these are their chiefs.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen ilmaan Seeʼiir namicha gosa Hoorii kanneen biyya sana keessa jiraachaa turanii dha; isaanis: Looxaan, Sobaal, Zibeʼoon, Aannaa,
english: These are the sons of Seir the Horite, the inhabitants of the land: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah,

kikuyu: Diishoon, Eezerii fi Diishaan. Ilmaan Seeʼiir kanneen biyya Edoom keessaa kunneen hangafoota hoorotaa turan.
english: Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, the children of Seir in the land of Edom.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Looxaan: Hoorii fi Hoomaam. Tiimnaa obboleettii Looxaan.
english: The children of Lotan were Hori and Heman. Lotan’s sister was Timna.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Sobaal: Aliwaan, Maanahaat, Eebaal, Shefoo fi Oonaami.
english: These are the children of Shobal: Alvan, Manahath, Ebal, Shepho, and Onam.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Zibeʼoon: Ayyaa fi Aannaa. Aannaan kunis namicha utuu harroota abbaa isaa Zibeʼoon tiksuu gammoojjii keessatti burqaa bishaan danfaa argatee dha.
english: These are the children of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah. This is Anah who found the hot springs in the wilderness, as he fed the donkeys of Zibeon his father.

kikuyu: Ijoollee Aannaa: Diishoonii fi Oholiibaamaa intala Aannaa.
english: These are the children of Anah: Dishon and Oholibamah, the daughter of Anah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Diishoon: Hemdaan, Eshbaan, Yitraanii fi Keraan.
english: These are the children of Dishon: Hemdan, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Eezeri: Bilhaan, Zaawaanii fi Aqaan.
english: These are the children of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Akan.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Diishaan: Uuzii fi Araan.
english: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen hangafoota Hoorotaa ti: Looxaan, Sobaali, Zibeʼoon, Aannaa,
english: These are the chiefs who came of the Horites: chief Lotan, chief Shobal, chief Zibeon, chief Anah,

kikuyu: Diishoon, Eezerii fi Diishaan.
english: chief Dishon, chief Ezer, and chief Dishan. These are the chiefs who came of the Horites, according to their chiefs in the land of Seir.

kikuyu: Mootonni utuu mootiin Israaʼel tokko iyyuu hin moʼin dura Edoom keessatti moʼan kanneen turan:
english: These are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Belaa ilmi Beʼoor mootii Edoom taʼe. Magaalaan isaa Diinhaabaa jedhamee moggaafame.
english: Bela, the son of Beor, reigned in Edom. The name of his city was Dinhabah.

kikuyu: Belaa duunaan Yoobaab ilmi Zeraa namichi Bozraa iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe.
english: Bela died, and Jobab, the son of Zerah of Bozrah, reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Yoobaab duunaan Hushaam namichi biyya Teemaan iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe.
english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Hushaam duunaan Hadaad ilmi Bedad inni biyya Moʼaabitti Midiyaanin moʼate sun iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe. Maqaan magaalaa isaa Aawiit jedhame.
english: Husham died, and Hadad, the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place. The name of his city was Avith.

kikuyu: Hadaad duunaan Samlaan namichi Masreeqaa iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe.
english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Samlaan duunaan Shaawul namichi biyya Rehoobooti ishee laga bira jirtu sanaa iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe.
english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the river, reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Shaawul duunaan Baʼaal-Haanaan ilmi Akboor iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe.
english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Baʼaal-Haanaan ilmi Akboor duunaan immoo Hadaad iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe. Magaalaan isaas Faaʼuu jedhame. Maqaan niitii isaa immoo Maheexabiʼeel jedhama ture. Isheenis intala Maxreed intala Mee-Zaahaab turte.
english: Baal Hanan the son of Achbor died, and Hadar reigned in his place. The name of his city was Pau. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

kikuyu: Hangafoonni Esaawu irraa dhalatan akkuma gosa gosa isaaniittii fi akkuma naannoo jireenya isaaniitti maqaa maqaan kanneenii dha: Tiimnaa, Aalwaa, Yeteeti,
english: These are the names of the chiefs who came from Esau, according to their families, after their places, and by their names: chief Timna, chief Alvah, chief Jetheth,

kikuyu: Oholiibaamaa, Eelaa, Phiinoon,
english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

kikuyu: Qenaz, Teemaan, Mibzaar,
english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

kikuyu: Magidiiʼeelii fi Iiraam.
english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom, according to their habitations in the land of their possession. This is Esau, the father of the Edomites.

kikuyu: Yaaqoob biyya abbaan isaa ture, Kanaʼaan keessa jiraate.
english: Jacob lived in the land of his father’s travels, in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Seenaan maatii Yaaqoob kana. Yoosef yeroo dargaggeessa waggaa kudha torba turetti obboloota isaa, ilmaan niitota abbaa isaa jechuunis ilmaan Bilihaatii fi Zilfaa wajjin bushaayee tiksa ture; innis waaʼee obboloota isaa oduu hamaa abbaa isaatiif fide.
english: This is the history of the generations of Jacob. Joseph, being seventeen years old, was feeding the flock with his brothers. He was a boy with the sons of Bilhah and Zilpah, his father’s wives. Joseph brought an evil report of them to their father.

kikuyu: Israaʼel waan bara dullumaa keessa isa dhalcheef ilmaan isaa hunda caalaa Yoosefin jaallata ture; innis qoloo faayeffame hojjeteef.
english: Now Israel loved Joseph more than all his children, because he was the son of his old age, and he made him a tunic of many colors.

kikuyu: Obboloonni isaas yommuu akka abbaan isaanii isaan hunda caalaa isa jaallate hubatanitti Yoosefin jibban; afaan nagaas itti dubbachuu hin dandeenye.
english: His brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, and they hated him, and couldn’t speak peaceably to him.

kikuyu: Yoosef abjuu abjootee obboloota isaatti hime; isaanis ittuma caalchisanii isa jibban.
english: Joseph dreamed a dream, and he told it to his brothers, and they hated him all the more.

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Mee abjuu ani arge kana dhagaʼaa:
english: He said to them, “Please hear this dream which I have dreamed:

kikuyu: Nu lafa qotiisaa keessatti bissii midhaanii hidhaa ture; kunoo, bissiin koo ol jedhee dhaabate; bissiiwwan keessan immoo bissii kootti naannaʼanii gad jedhanii sagadaniif.”
english: for behold, we were binding sheaves in the field, and behold, my sheaf arose and also stood upright; and behold, your sheaves came around, and bowed down to my sheaf.”

kikuyu: Obboloonni isaas, “Ati nu irratti mootii taʼuu barbaaddaa? Dhugumaan situ nu bulchaa?” jedhaniin. Isaanis sababii abjuu isaatii fi sababii waan inni dubbateetiif ittuma caalchisanii isa jibban.
english: His brothers asked him, “Will you indeed reign over us? Will you indeed have dominion over us?” They hated him all the more for his dreams and for his words.

kikuyu: Ergasiis abjuu biraa abjootee obboloota isaatti hime. Akkanas jedheen; “Kunoo, ani abjuu biraa abjoodheera; aduu fi jiʼi, urjiiwwan kudha tokkos gad jedhanii naa sagadu.”
english: He dreamed yet another dream, and told it to his brothers, and said, “Behold, I have dreamed yet another dream: and behold, the sun and the moon and eleven stars bowed down to me.”

kikuyu: Yommuu inni waan kana abbaa isaatii fi obboloota isaatti himetti abbaan isaa, “Abjuun ati abjootte kun maali? Ani, haati keetii fi obboloonni kee dhugumaan dhufnee fuula kee duratti gad jennee siif sagadnaa?” jedhee isatti dheekkame.
english: He told it to his father and to his brothers. His father rebuked him, and said to him, “What is this dream that you have dreamed? Will I and your mother and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves down to the earth before you?”

kikuyu: Obboloonni isaa isatti hinaafan; abbaan isaa garuu waan kana garaatti qabate.
english: His brothers envied him, but his father kept this saying in mind.

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko obboloonni isaa bushaayee abbaa isaanii Sheekem bira dheechisuu dhaqan;
english: His brothers went to feed their father’s flock in Shechem.

kikuyu: Israaʼelis Yoosefiin, “Akkuma ati beektu obboloonni kee Sheekem bira bushaayee dheechisaa jiru. Mee kottu ani gara isaaniitti si ergaa” jedhe. Yoosefis, “Kunoo asan jira” jedheen.
english: Israel said to Joseph, “Aren’t your brothers feeding the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them.” He said to him, “Here I am.”

kikuyu: Israaʼel immoo, “Mee dhaqiitii akka obboloonni kee, bushaayeenis nagaa taʼanii fi akka hin taʼin ilaaliitii deebiʼii natti himi” jedheen. Innis akkasiin Sulula Kebrooniitii Sheekemitti isa erge. Yoosefis Sheekem gaʼe;
english: He said to him, “Go now, see whether it is well with your brothers, and well with the flock; and bring me word again.” So he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

kikuyu: namichi tokko isa arge; kunoo inni dirree irra jooraa ture; namichi sunis, “Ati maal barbaadda?” jedhee isa gaafate.
english: A certain man found him, and behold, he was wandering in the field. The man asked him, “What are you looking for?”

kikuyu: Yoosefis deebisee, “Ani obboloota koon barbaada. Ati iddoo isaan bushaayee isaanii dheechisan mee natti himi” jedheen.
english: He said, “I am looking for my brothers. Tell me, please, where they are feeding the flock.”

kikuyu: Namichis deebisee, “Isaan asii deemaniiru; ani ‘Gara Dootaan haa dhaqnu’ jechuu isaanii dhagaʼeera” jedhe. Yoosefis obboloota isaa duukaa buʼee Dotaayin biratti isaan argate.
english: The man said, “They have left here, for I heard them say, ‘Let’s go to Dothan.’” Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu fagootti isa arganii isa ajjeesuuf utuu inni isaan bira hin gaʼin mariʼatan.
english: They saw him afar off, and before he came near to them, they conspired against him to kill him.

kikuyu: Isaanis akkana waliin jedhan; “Kunoo abbaan abjuu sun dhufaa jira!
english: They said to one another, “Behold, this dreamer comes.

kikuyu: Kottaa ajjeefnee boollawwan as jiran keessaa tokkotti isa gannee bineensa hamaatu isa nyaate jenna. Ergasii immoo abjuun isaa maal akka taʼu ilaalla.”
english: Come now therefore, and let’s kill him, and cast him into one of the pits, and we will say, ‘An evil animal has devoured him.’ We will see what will become of his dreams.”

kikuyu: Ruubeen waan kana dhageenyaan isaan harkaa isa baase. Innis akkana jedhe; “Lakkii isa hin ajjeefnu;
english: Reuben heard it, and delivered him out of their hand, and said, “Let’s not take his life.”

kikuyu: dhiiga hin dhangalaasinaa. Gammoojjii keessatti boolla kana keessa isa buusaa malee harka keessaniin isa hin tuqinaa.” Ruubeen isaan harkaa isa baasee gara abbaa isaatti isa deebisuuf akkana jedhe.
english: Reuben said to them, “Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit that is in the wilderness, but lay no hand on him”—that he might deliver him out of their hand, to restore him to his father.

kikuyu: Yeroo Yoosef obboloota isaa bira gaʼetti isaan qoloo inni uffate, qoloo miidhagaa sana isa irraa baasanii,
english: When Joseph came to his brothers, they stripped Joseph of his tunic, the tunic of many colors that was on him;

kikuyu: isa fuudhanii boollatti gad darbatan. Boolli sunis duwwaa ture; bishaanis hin qabu ture.
english: and they took him, and threw him into the pit. The pit was empty. There was no water in it.

kikuyu: Obboloonni isaa buddeena nyaachuuf tataaʼan; ol jedhaniis kunoo, daldaltoota warra Ishmaaʼeel kanneen Giliʼaadii dhufaa jiran argan. Isaanis urgooftuu, haphee dibataatii fi qumbii gaalawwan isaaniitti feʼatanii Gibxitti geessaa turan.
english: They sat down to eat bread, and they lifted up their eyes and looked, and saw a caravan of Ishmaelites coming from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

kikuyu: Yihuudaanis obboloota isaatiin akkana jedhe; “Obboleessa keenya ajjeefnee dhiiga isaa dhoksuun buʼaa maalii nuu qaba?
english: Judah said to his brothers, “What profit is it if we kill our brother and conceal his blood?

kikuyu: Kottaa Ishmaaʼeelootatti isa gurgurra malee harka keenyaan isa hin tuqnuu; inni obboleessa keenyaa fi foon keenya.” Obboloonni isaas yaada kana fudhatan.
english: Come, and let’s sell him to the Ishmaelites, and not let our hand be on him; for he is our brother, our flesh.” His brothers listened to him.

kikuyu: Yommuu daldaltoonni Midiyaan achiin darbuuf dhufanittis obboloonni Yoosef boolla keessaa harkisanii ol isa baasanii meetii saqilii digdamaatti Ishmaaʼeelootatti isa gurguratan; jarris Gibxitti isa geessan.
english: Midianites who were merchants passed by, and they drew and lifted up Joseph out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty pieces of silver. The merchants brought Joseph into Egypt.

kikuyu: Ruubeen gara boolla sanaatti deebiʼe; Yoosef boolla sana keessa hin turre; innis uffata ofii isaa tarsaase.
english: Reuben returned to the pit, and saw that Joseph wasn’t in the pit; and he tore his clothes.

kikuyu: Innis gara obboloota isaa dhaqee, “Gurbichi achi hin jiru! Egaa ani eessan dhaqa?” jedheen.
english: He returned to his brothers, and said, “The child is no more; and I, where will I go?”

kikuyu: Isaanis qoloo Yoosef fuudhanii reʼee tokko qalanii qoloo sana dhiiga keessa cuuphan.
english: They took Joseph’s tunic, and killed a male goat, and dipped the tunic in the blood.

kikuyu: Qoloo miidhagaa sanas abbaa isaaniitti geessanii, “Nu qoloo kana arganneerra; mee qoloo ilma keetii taʼuu fi taʼuu baachuu isaa ilaali” jedhan.
english: They took the tunic of many colors, and they brought it to their father, and said, “We have found this. Examine it, now, and see if it is your son’s tunic or not.”

kikuyu: Innis qoloo sana beekee, “Kun qoloo ilma kootii ti! Bineensa hamaatu isa nyaate. Dhugumaan Yoosef ciccirameera” jedhe.
english: He recognized it, and said, “It is my son’s tunic. An evil animal has devoured him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Yaaqoob uffata ofii isaa tarsaase; wayyaa gaddaa mudhiitti hidhatee guyyaa baayʼee ilma isaatiif gadde.
english: Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth on his waist, and mourned for his son many days.

kikuyu: Ilmaan isaatii fi intallan isaa hundinuu isa jajjabeessuuf kaʼan; inni garuu jajjabaachuu didee, “Lakkii ani gaddaa gara ilma koo siiʼoolitti gad buʼa” jedhe. Akkasiin abbaan isaa ni booʼeef.
english: All his sons and all his daughters rose up to comfort him, but he refused to be comforted. He said, “For I will go down to Sheol to my son, mourning.” His father wept for him.

kikuyu: Gidduu sana warri Midiyaan sun Gibxi keessatti Phoxiifaaraa namicha qondaaltota Faraʼoon keessaa tokko ture kan ajajaa waardiyyaa taʼe tokkotti Yoosefin gurguratan.
english: The Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard.

kikuyu: Yeroo kanatti Yihuudaan obboloota isaa biraa deemee namicha Adulaam kan Hiiraam jedhamu tokko bira jiraachuuf gad buʼe.
english: At that time, Judah went down from his brothers, and visited a certain Adullamite, whose name was Hirah.

kikuyu: Achittis Yihuudaan intala namicha Kanaʼaan kan Shuuwaan jedhamu tokkoo arge; innis ishee fuudhee ishee bira gaʼe;
english: There, Judah saw the daughter of a certain Canaanite man named Shua. He took her, and went in to her.

kikuyu: isheenis ulfooftee ilma deesse; maqaan isaas Eer jedhame.
english: She conceived, and bore a son; and he named him Er.

kikuyu: Ammas ulfooftee ilma deesse; maqaa isaas Oonaan jettee moggaafte.
english: She conceived again, and bore a son; and she named him Onan.

kikuyu: Ammas ittuma dabaltee ulfooftee ilma biraa deessee maqaa isaa Sheelaa jettee moggaafte. Isheenis Kiziibitti isa deesse.
english: She yet again bore a son, and named him Shelah. He was at Chezib when she bore him.

kikuyu: Yihuudaanis Eer ilma isaa hangafticha niitii fuusise; maqaan ishee Taamaar jedhama ture.
english: Judah took a wife for Er, his firstborn, and her name was Tamar.

kikuyu: Garuu Eer ilmi Yihuudaa hangaftichi sun fuula Waaqayyoo duratti hamaa ture; kanaafuu Waaqayyo isa ajjeese.
english: Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight. So the LORD killed him.

kikuyu: Yihuudaanis Oonaaniin, “Obboleessa keetiif sanyii dhaabuuf jedhiitii niitii obboleessa keetii bira gaʼiitii dirqama waarsummaa keetii isheef guuti” jedhe.
english: Judah said to Onan, “Go in to your brother’s wife, and perform the duty of a husband’s brother to her, and raise up offspring for your brother.”

kikuyu: Oonaan garuu akka ijoolleen dhalattu sun kan isaa hin taane beeke; kanaafuu akka obboleessa isaatiif sanyii hin dhaabneef jedhee yeroo niitii obboleessa isaa bira gaʼu hunda afeetaa lafatti dhangalaasa ture.
english: Onan knew that the offspring wouldn’t be his; and when he went in to his brother’s wife, he spilled his semen on the ground, lest he should give offspring to his brother.

kikuyu: Wanni inni hojjete sun fuula Waaqayyoo duratti hamaa ture; kanaafuu Waaqayyo isas ni ajjeese.
english: The thing which he did was evil in the LORD’s sight, and he killed him also.

kikuyu: Ergasii Yihuudaan niitii ilma isaa Taamaariin, “Hamma ilmi koo Sheelaa guddatutti haadha hiyyeessaa taʼiitii mana abbaa keetii jiraadhu” jedhe. Inni, “Mucaan kunis akkuma obboloota isaa duʼaa laata” jedhee yaadee tureetii. Kanaafuu Taamaar mana abbaa ishee jiraachuu dhaqxe.
english: Then Judah said to Tamar, his daughter-in-law, “Remain a widow in your father’s house, until Shelah, my son, is grown up;” for he said, “Lest he also die, like his brothers.” Tamar went and lived in her father’s house.

kikuyu: Bara dheeraa booddees intalli Shuuwaa niitiin Yihuudaa duute. Yihuudaanis gadda isaa irraa bayyanannaan gara Tiimnaahitti lafa warra hoolota isaa irraa rifeensa murmuraniitti ol baʼe; michuun isaa Hiiraam namichi Adulaam isa wajjin deeme.
english: After many days, Shua’s daughter, the wife of Judah, died. Judah was comforted, and went up to his sheep shearers to Timnah, he and his friend Hirah, the Adullamite.

kikuyu: Taamaaris, “Kunoo abbaan dhirsa keetii hoolota isaa irraa rifeensa murmuruuf jedhee Tiimnaahitti ol baʼaa jira” jedhanii yeroo itti himanitti,
english: Tamar was told, “Behold, your father-in-law is going up to Timnah to shear his sheep.”

kikuyu: wayyaa haadha hiyyeessaa of irraa baaftee of dhoksuuf haguuggii haguuggatte; ergasiis balbala Enaayimitti ol galchu kan daandii Tiimnaahitti geessu irra jiru dura teesse. Sheelaa guddatu iyyuu isheen akka niitummaadhaan isaaf hin kennamin beektee turteetii.
english: She took off the garments of her widowhood, and covered herself with her veil, and wrapped herself, and sat in the gate of Enaim, which is on the way to Timnah; for she saw that Shelah was grown up, and she wasn’t given to him as a wife.

kikuyu: Yihuudaan yommuu ishee argetti sababii isheen fuula ishee haguuggattee turteef sagaagaltuu ishee seʼe.
english: When Judah saw her, he thought that she was a prostitute, for she had covered her face.

kikuyu: Innis utuu akka isheen niitii ilma isaa taate hin beekin karaa cina iddoo isheen jirtu ishee bira dhaqee, “Mee kottu si wajjin nan ciisaa” jedheen. Isheenis, “Ati na wajjin ciisuuf maal naa kennita?” jettee isa gaafatte.
english: He turned to her by the way, and said, “Please come, let me come in to you,” for he didn’t know that she was his daughter-in-law. She said, “What will you give me, that you may come in to me?”

kikuyu: Inni immoo, “Ani bushaayee koo keessaa ilmoo reʼee tokko siifin erga” jedheen. Isheenis, “Hamma ilmoo sana naa ergitutti waan biraa qabsiisa naa kennitaa?” jetteen.
english: He said, “I will send you a young goat from the flock.” She said, “Will you give me a pledge, until you send it?”

kikuyu: Innis, “Ani qabsiisa maalin siif kenna?” jedheen. Isheenis deebiftee, “Chaappaa kee hidhaa isaa wajjin, ulee qabattee deemtus naa kenni” jetteen. Innis wantoota kanneen kenneefii ishee wajjin ciise; isheenis ni ulfoofte.
english: He said, “What pledge will I give you?” She said, “Your signet and your cord, and your staff that is in your hand.” He gave them to her, and came in to her, and she conceived by him.

kikuyu: Erga achii deemtee booddee haguuggii ishee of irraa baaftee wayyaa dhirsi ishee irraa duunaan uffattee turte sana deebiftee uffatte.
english: She arose, and went away, and put off her veil from her, and put on the garments of her widowhood.

kikuyu: Yihuudaan waan qabsiisa kenne dubartii sana irraa deebifachuuf jedhee karaa michuu isaa namicha Adulaam sanaatiin ilmoo reʼee ergeef; namichi garuu ishee hin argine.
english: Judah sent the young goat by the hand of his friend, the Adullamite, to receive the pledge from the woman’s hand, but he didn’t find her.

kikuyu: Namichis, “Sagaagaltuun Enaayim bira, daandii irra taaʼaa turte sun eessa jirti?” jedhee warra achi jiraatan gaafate. Jarri immoo deebisanii, “Sagaagaltuun tokko iyyuu as hin turre” jedhan.
english: Then he asked the men of her place, saying, “Where is the prostitute, that was at Enaim by the road?” They said, “There has been no prostitute here.”

kikuyu: Innis gara Yihuudaatti deebiʼee, “Ani dubartittii arguu hin dandeenye. Akkasumas warri iddoo sana jiraatan, ‘Sagaagaltuun tokko iyyuu as hin turre’ jedhan” jedheen.
english: He returned to Judah, and said, “I haven’t found her; and also the men of the place said, ‘There has been no prostitute here.’”

kikuyu: Yihuudaanis, “Isheen waan qabatte sana haa hambifattu; yoo kanaa achii nu waan kolfaa taanaa. Kunoo ani ilmoo reʼee kana isheef ergeera; ati garuu ishee dhabde” jedhe.
english: Judah said, “Let her keep it, lest we be shamed. Behold, I sent this young goat, and you haven’t found her.”

kikuyu: Gara jiʼa sadii booddee, “Taamaar niitiin ilma keetii sagaagaltuu taateerti; kanaanis isheen amma ulfoofteerti” jedhanii Yihuudaatti himan. Yihuudaan immoo, “Gadi baasaatii ibiddaan gubaa ishee ajjeesaa!” jedhe.
english: About three months later, Judah was told, “Tamar, your daughter-in-law, has played the prostitute. Moreover, behold, she is with child by prostitution.” Judah said, “Bring her out, and let her be burned.”

kikuyu: Isheenis utuma gad baafamaa jirtuu, “Ani abbaa miʼa kanaa irraa ulfaaʼeera” jettee abbaa dhirsa isheetti ergaa ergite. Akkasumas, “Chaappaa fi kirriin isaa, uleen kunis kan eenyuu akka taʼe mee ilaalii addaan baafadhu” jetteen.
english: When she was brought out, she sent to her father-in-law, saying, “I am with child by the man who owns these.” She also said, “Please discern whose these are—the signet, and the cords, and the staff.”

kikuyu: Yihuudaanis miʼa kana beekee, “Sababii ani ilma koo Sheelaatti ishee hin heerumsiisiniif, isheen na caalaa qajeeltuu dha” jedhe. Innis deebiʼee ishee bira hin geenye.
english: Judah acknowledged them, and said, “She is more righteous than I, because I didn’t give her to Shelah, my son.” He knew her again no more.

kikuyu: Yommuu yeroon daʼumsa ishee gaʼetti, kunoo, ilmaan lakkuutu gadameessa ishee keessa ture.
english: In the time of her travail, behold, twins were in her womb.

kikuyu: Utuu isheen daʼumsa irra jirtuu inni tokko harka isaa gad baafate; deessiftuunis qabdee, “Isa kanatu dura lafa gaʼe” jettee kirrii diimaa harka isaatti hiite.
english: When she travailed, one put out a hand, and the midwife took and tied a scarlet thread on his hand, saying, “This came out first.”

kikuyu: Akkuma inni harka isaa ol deebifateen kunoo obboleessi isaa dhalate; deessiftuunis, “Ati akkamiin ofuma keetiin cabsitee baate?” jette. Maqaan isaas Faares jedhame.
english: As he drew back his hand, behold, his brother came out, and she said, “Why have you made a breach for yourself?” Therefore his name was called Perez.

kikuyu: Obboleessi isaa kan kirrii diimaa harka irraa qabu sunis ni dhalate; innis Zaaraa jedhamee moggaafame.
english: Afterward his brother came out, who had the scarlet thread on his hand, and his name was called Zerah.

kikuyu: Yeroo kanatti Yoosef Gibxitti geeffamee ture. Phoxiifaaraan namichi Gibxi qondaalli Faraʼoon kan ajajaa waardiyyaa ture sun Ishmaaʼeeloota achi isa geessan irraa isa bitate.
english: Joseph was brought down to Egypt. Potiphar, an officer of Pharaoh’s, the captain of the guard, an Egyptian, bought him from the hand of the Ishmaelites that had brought him down there.

kikuyu: Yoosefis waan Waaqayyo isa wajjin tureef nama milkaaʼaa taʼe; innis mana gooftaa isaa namicha biyya Gibxi sanaa jiraate.
english: The LORD was with Joseph, and he was a prosperous man. He was in the house of his master the Egyptian.

kikuyu: Gooftaan isaas akka Waaqayyo isa wajjin jiruu fi akka Waaqayyo waan inni hojjetu hunda keessatti isa milkoomse arge;
english: His master saw that the LORD was with him, and that the LORD made all that he did prosper in his hand.

kikuyu: Yoosefis fuula gooftaa isaa duratti fudhatama argatee hojjetaa isaa amanamaa taʼe. Phoxiifaaraanis mana isaa irratti isa muude; waan qabu hundumas akka inni eeguuf imaanaa itti kenne.
english: Joseph found favor in his sight. He ministered to him, and Potiphar made him overseer over his house, and all that he had he put into his hand.

kikuyu: Gaafa inni mana isaatii fi waan inni qabu hunda irratti isa muudee jalqabee Waaqayyo sababii Yoosefiif jedhee mana namicha Gibxi sanaa eebbise. Eebbi Waaqayyoos waan Phoxiifaaraan manaa fi alaa qabu hunda irra ture.
english: From the time that he made him overseer in his house, and over all that he had, the LORD blessed the Egyptian’s house for Joseph’s sake. The LORD’s blessing was on all that he had, in the house and in the field.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Phoxiifaaraan waan qabu hunda harka Yoosef jala galche; innis waan nyaatu qofa malee qabeenya isaa tokko illee hin beeku ture. Yoosef dhaaba toleessaa fi miidhagaa ture;
english: He left all that he had in Joseph’s hand. He didn’t concern himself with anything, except for the food which he ate. Joseph was well-built and handsome.

kikuyu: niitiin gooftaa isaas waan kana booddee ija ishee Yoosef irra buufattee, “Kottuu na bira gaʼi!” jetteen.
english: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”

kikuyu: Inni garuu didee akkana isheen jedhe; “Kunoo, gooftaan koo waan mana keessa jiru tokko illee hin beeku; inni waan qabu hunda natti kenneera.
english: But he refused, and said to his master’s wife, “Behold, my master doesn’t know what is with me in the house, and he has put all that he has into my hand.

kikuyu: Mana kana keessatti namni na caalu tokko iyyuu hin jiru. Sababii ati niitii isaa taateef siʼi malee wanni gooftaan koo natti hin kennin tokko iyyuu hin jiru. Yoos ani akkamittan waan hamaa akkasii raawwachuudhaan Waaqatti cubbuu hojjedha ree?”
english: No one is greater in this house than I am, and he has not kept back anything from me but you, because you are his wife. How then can I do this great wickedness, and sin against God?”

kikuyu: Isheen guyyuma guyyaan Yoosefitti dubbattu iyyuu, inni ishee bira gaʼuu yookaan ishee biratti argamuu illee ni dide.
english: As she spoke to Joseph day by day, he didn’t listen to her, to lie by her, or to be with her.

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko Yoosef hojii isaa hojjechuuf mana seene; tajaajiltoota warra mana sanaa keessaas namni tokko iyyuu achi hin turre.
english: About this time, he went into the house to do his work, and there were none of the men of the house inside.

kikuyu: Isheenis wayyaa isaa qabattee, “Kottuutii na bira gaʼi!” jetteen. Inni garuu wayyaa isaa isheetti gad lakkisee fiigee manaa baʼe.
english: She caught him by his garment, saying, “Lie with me!” He left his garment in her hand, and ran outside.

kikuyu: Isheenis yommuu akka inni wayyaa isaa isheetti gad lakkisee fiigee manaa baʼe argitetti,
english: When she saw that he had left his garment in her hand, and had run outside,

kikuyu: hojjettoota mana ishee waamtee akkana jetteen; “Kunoo, inni Ibricha kana akka nutti taphatuuf fide! Inni na bira gaʼuuf natti ol seennaan ani sagalee guddaan iyye.
english: she called to the men of her house, and spoke to them, saying, “Behold, he has brought a Hebrew in to us to mock us. He came in to me to lie with me, and I cried with a loud voice.

kikuyu: Innis gargaarsa barbaachaaf iyyuu koo dhageenyaan wayyaa isaa na biratti dhiisee fiigee manaa baʼe.”
english: When he heard that I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

kikuyu: Isheen hamma gooftaan isaa galutti wayyaa isaa of bira keesse.
english: She laid up his garment by her, until his master came home.

kikuyu: Akkana jettees oduu kana isatti himte: “Garbichi Ibrichi ati nuu fidde sun natti taphachuuf natti ol seene.
english: She spoke to him according to these words, saying, “The Hebrew servant, whom you have brought to us, came in to me to mock me,

kikuyu: Garuu akkuma ani gargaarsa barbaachaaf iyyeen inni wayyaa isaa na biratti dhiisee fiigee manaa baʼe.”
english: and as I lifted up my voice and cried, he left his garment by me, and ran outside.”

kikuyu: Gooftaan isaa yommuu oduu niitiin isaa, “Wanni garbichi kee na godhe kana” jettee itti himte sana dhagaʼetti aaree gubate.
english: When his master heard the words of his wife, which she spoke to him, saying, “This is what your servant did to me,” his wrath was kindled.

kikuyu: Gooftaan isaas Yoosefin fuudhee mana hidhaa iddoo hidhamtoonni mootichaa itti eegaman keessa buuse. Taʼus yeroo Yoosef mana hidhaa keessa turetti,
english: Joseph’s master took him, and put him into the prison, the place where the king’s prisoners were bound, and he was there in custody.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo isa wajjin ture; fuula ajajaa mana hidhaa sanaa durattis gaarummaa isaa itti argisiise; akka fudhatamas argatu godhe.
english: But the LORD was with Joseph, and showed kindness to him, and gave him favor in the sight of the keeper of the prison.

kikuyu: Ajajaan mana hidhaa sunis namoota mana hidhaa jiran hunda irratti Yoosefin muude; waan achitti hojjetamu hunda irrattis itti gaafatamaa isa godhe.
english: The keeper of the prison committed to Joseph’s hand all the prisoners who were in the prison. Whatever they did there, he was responsible for it.

kikuyu: Sababii Waaqayyo isa wajjin turee fi waan inni hojjetu kam iyyuu isaa milkeesseef ajajaan mana hidhaa sun waan itti gaafatama Yoosef jala jiru hundaaf yaaddoo tokko illee hin qabu ture.
english: The keeper of the prison didn’t look after anything that was under his hand, because the LORD was with him; and that which he did, the LORD made it prosper.

kikuyu: Kana booddee namichi mootii Gibxiitiif dhugaatii dhiʼeessuu fi namichi buddeena tolchu gooftaa isaanii mootii Gibxi sana gaddisiisan.
english: After these things, the butler of the king of Egypt and his baker offended their lord, the king of Egypt.

kikuyu: Faraʼoonis qondaaltota isaa lamaanitti jechuunis itti gaafatamaa dhugaatiitii fi itti gaafatamaa tolchaa buddeenaatti aare;
english: Pharaoh was angry with his two officers, the chief cup bearer and the chief baker.

kikuyu: innis mana ajajaa waardiyyaa keessa mana hidhaa iddoo Yoosef itti hidhamee ture keessa isaan buuse.
english: He put them in custody in the house of the captain of the guard, into the prison, the place where Joseph was bound.

kikuyu: Ajajaan waardiyyaa Yoosefitti isaan kenne; Yoosefis isaan tajaajilaa ture. Jarris guyyaa baayʼee mana hidhaa turan;
english: The captain of the guard assigned them to Joseph, and he took care of them. They stayed in prison many days.

kikuyu: isaan lachanuu jechuunis namichi mootii Gibxiitiif dhugaatii dhiʼeessuu fi namichi buddeena tolchu tokkoon tokkoon isaanii halkanuma tokko keessatti abjuu abjootan; tokkoon tokkoon abjuu sanaas hiikkaa mataa isaa qaba ture.
english: They both dreamed a dream, each man his dream, in one night, each man according to the interpretation of his dream, the cup bearer and the baker of the king of Egypt, who were bound in the prison.

kikuyu: Yoosef guyyaa itti aanu ganama isaan bira dhaqe; kunoo utuu gaddanii jiranuus isaan arge.
english: Joseph came in to them in the morning, and saw them, and saw that they were sad.

kikuyu: Innis, “Fuulli keessan harʼa maaliif akkana dukkanaaʼa?” jedhee qondaaltota Faraʼoon warra isa wajjin mana gooftaa isaa keessa mana hidhaa turan sana gaafate.
english: He asked Pharaoh’s officers who were with him in custody in his master’s house, saying, “Why do you look so sad today?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Nu lachuu abjuu abjoonnee nama nuu hiiku dhabne” jedhaniin. Kana irratti Yoosef, “Hiikkaan kan Waaqaa ti mitii? Mee abjuu keessan natti himaa” jedheen.
english: They said to him, “We have dreamed a dream, and there is no one who can interpret it.” Joseph said to them, “Don’t interpretations belong to God? Please tell it to me.”

kikuyu: Itti gaafatamaan dhugaatii sun akkana jedhee abjuu isaa Yoosefitti himate; “Abjuu koo keessatti kunoo muka wayinii tokkotu fuula koo dura ture;
english: The chief cup bearer told his dream to Joseph, and said to him, “In my dream, behold, a vine was in front of me,

kikuyu: mukti wayinii sunis damee sadii qaba ture. Innis akkuma lateen daraare; hurbuun ija isaas ni bilchaatte.
english: and in the vine were three branches. It was as though it budded, it blossomed, and its clusters produced ripe grapes.

kikuyu: Xoofoon Faraʼoon na harka ture; anis ija wayinii fuudhee xoofoo Faraʼoonitti cuunfee xoofoo sana harka Faraʼoonitti kenne.”
english: Pharaoh’s cup was in my hand; and I took the grapes, and pressed them into Pharaoh’s cup, and I gave the cup into Pharaoh’s hand.”

kikuyu: Yoosefis akkana jedheen; “Hiikkaan isaa kana; dameewwan sadan sun guyyaa sadii.
english: Joseph said to him, “This is its interpretation: the three branches are three days.

kikuyu: Guyyaa sadii keessatti Faraʼoon mataa kee ol qaba; taayitaa keettis si deebisa; akkuma yeroo dhugaatii dhiʼeessaafii turte sana atis xoofoo Faraʼoon harka isaatti ni kennita.
english: Within three more days, Pharaoh will lift up your head, and restore you to your office. You will give Pharaoh’s cup into his hand, the way you did when you were his cup bearer.

kikuyu: Garuu yeroo sitti tolutti na yaadadhu; waan gaariis naa godhi. Waaʼee koo Faraʼoonitti himiitii mana hidhaa kanaa na baasi.
english: But remember me when it is well with you. Please show kindness to me, and make mention of me to Pharaoh, and bring me out of this house.

kikuyu: Ana biyya Ibrootaatii hatanii na fidaniitii; biyya kana keessattis ani waan boolla kana keessa na buusisu tokko illee hin hojjenne.”
english: For indeed, I was stolen away out of the land of the Hebrews, and here also I have done nothing that they should put me into the dungeon.”
