kikuyu: Ergasii Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Akka wanni kun yaadatamuuf kitaabatti barreessi; Iyyaasuun waan kana dhagaʼuu isaa mirkaneessi; ani guutumaan guutuutti yaadannoo Amaaleqootaa samii jalaa nan balleessaatii.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”

kikuyu: Museenis iddoo aarsaa ijaaree, “Waaqayyo Faajjii koo ti” jedhee moggaase.
english: Moses built an altar, and called its name “The LORD our Banner”.

kikuyu: Innis, “Harki gara teessoo Waaqayyootti ol kaafameera. Waaqayyos dhaloota tokkoo gara dhaloota kaaniitti Amaaleqoota ni lola” jedhe.
english: He said, “The LORD has sworn: ‘The LORD will have war with Amalek from generation to generation.’”

kikuyu: Yetroo lubichi Midiyaaniitii fi abbaan niitii Musee sun waan Waaqni Musee fi saba isaa Israaʼeliif godhe hunda, akkasumas akka Waaqayyo itti Israaʼelin Gibxii baase dhagaʼe.
english: Now Jethro, the priest of Midian, Moses’ father-in-law, heard of all that God had done for Moses and for Israel his people, how the LORD had brought Israel out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Erga Museen niitii isaa Ziphooraa ergee booddee Yetroo abbaan niitii Musee, ishee fi
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, received Zipporah, Moses’ wife, after he had sent her away,

kikuyu: ilmaan ishee lamaan simate. Maqaan ilma isaa tokkoo Geershoom jedhame; Museen, “Ani biyya ormaa keessatti alagaa taʼeera” jedheeraatii.
english: and her two sons. The name of one son was Gershom, for Moses said, “I have lived as a foreigner in a foreign land”.

kikuyu: Kaan immoo, “Waaqni abbaa kootii gargaaraa kooti; inni goraadee Faraʼoon jalaa na baaseera” jechuudhaan Eliiʼezer jedhee moggaase.
english: The name of the other was Eliezer, for he said, “My father’s God was my help and delivered me from Pharaoh’s sword.”

kikuyu: Yetroon abbaan niitii Musees niitii Museetii fi ilmaan Musee wajjin gammoojjii keessatti gara tulluu Waaqaa iddoo Museen qubatee jirutti isa bira dhufe.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, came with Moses’ sons and his wife to Moses into the wilderness where he was encamped, at the Mountain of God.

kikuyu: Yetroonis, “Ani abbaan niitii keetii Yootoor niitii keetii fi ilmaan ishee lamaan wajjin gara kee dhufaa jira” jedhee dhaamsa itti ergee ture.
english: He said to Moses, “I, your father-in-law Jethro, have come to you with your wife, and her two sons with her.”

kikuyu: Museenis abbaa niitii isaa simachuuf gad baʼe; gad jedhees harka fuudhee isa dhungate. Isaanis nagaa wal gaafatanii dunkaana seenan.
english: Moses went out to meet his father-in-law, and bowed and kissed him. They asked each other of their welfare, and they came into the tent.

kikuyu: Museen waan Waaqayyo sababii saba Israaʼeliif jedhee Faraʼoonii fi warra Gibxi irratti hojjete, rakkina karaa irratti isaan mudate hundaa fi akka itti Waaqayyo isaan oolche abbaa niitii isaatti hime.
english: Moses told his father-in-law all that the LORD had done to Pharaoh and to the Egyptians for Israel’s sake, all the hardships that had come on them on the way, and how the LORD delivered them.

kikuyu: Yetroonis waan gaarii Waaqayyo harka warra Gibxi keessaa isaan baasuudhaan saba Israaʼeliif godhe hundaaf ni gammade.
english: Jethro rejoiced for all the goodness which the LORD had done to Israel, in that he had delivered them out of the hand of the Egyptians.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhe; “Waaqayyo harka warra Gibxii fi harka Faraʼoon keessaa isin baasee fi inni saba sana harka warra Gibxiitii baase sun haa eebbifamu.
english: Jethro said, “Blessed be the LORD, who has delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of Pharaoh; who has delivered the people from under the hand of the Egyptians.

kikuyu: Ani amma akka Waaqayyo waaqota kaan hunda caalaa guddaa taʼe nan beeka; inni warra of tuulummaadhaan Israaʼelin rakkisan irratti waan kana raawwateeraatii.”
english: Now I know that the LORD is greater than all gods because of the way that they treated people arrogantly.”

kikuyu: Yommus Yetroon abbaan niitii Musee sun aarsaa gubamuu fi aarsaa biraa Waaqaaf fide; Aroonis fuula Waaqaa duratti Musee fi abbaa niitii Musee wajjin buddeena nyaachuuf maanguddoota Israaʼel hunda wajjin dhufe.
english: Jethro, Moses’ father-in-law, took a burnt offering and sacrifices for God. Aaron came with all the elders of Israel, to eat bread with Moses’ father-in-law before God.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti Museen sabaaf murtii kennuuf taaʼe; sabni sunis ganamaa hamma galgalaatti naannoo isaa dhaabate.
english: On the next day, Moses sat to judge the people, and the people stood around Moses from the morning to the evening.

kikuyu: Abbaan niitii isaas yommuu waan Museen sabaaf hojjetu hunda argetti, “Wanni ati sabaaf hojjettu kun maali? Ati maaliif kophaa kee teessee sabni kun immoo ganamaa hamma galgalaatti naannoo kee dhadhaabata?” jedhe.
english: When Moses’ father-in-law saw all that he did to the people, he said, “What is this thing that you do for the people? Why do you sit alone, and all the people stand around you from morning to evening?”

kikuyu: Museen immoo akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Sabni kun fedhii Waaqaa barbaacha gara koo dhufaatii.
english: Moses said to his father-in-law, “Because the people come to me to inquire of God.

kikuyu: Isaan yommuu falmii qabaatanitti dhimma isaanii natti dhiʼeeffatu; anis abbootii dhimmaa gidduutti murtii nan kenna; sirnaa fi seera Waaqaas isaanitti nan hima.”
english: When they have a matter, they come to me, and I judge between a man and his neighbor, and I make them know the statutes of God, and his laws.”

kikuyu: Abbaan niitii Musee akkana jedhee deebise; “Wanni ati gootu kun gaarii miti.
english: Moses’ father-in-law said to him, “The thing that you do is not good.

kikuyu: Atii fi sabni si bira dhufu kun akkasumaan of dadhabsiiftu. Hojiin kunis akka malee sitti ulfaata; ati kophaa kee hojjechuu hin dandeessu.
english: You will surely wear away, both you, and this people that is with you; for the thing is too heavy for you. You are not able to perform it yourself alone.

kikuyu: Ani gorsa siif kennaatii amma na dhagaʼi; Waaqni si wajjin haa taʼu. Ati fuula Waaqaa duratti iddoo buʼaa sabaa taatee dhimma isaanii Waaqatti fiduu qabda.
english: Listen now to my voice. I will give you counsel, and God be with you. You represent the people before God, and bring the causes to God.

kikuyu: Sirnaa fi seera isaan barsiisi; akka isaan itti jiraachuu qabanii fi waan isaan hojjechuu qaban isaanitti argisiisi.
english: You shall teach them the statutes and the laws, and shall show them the way in which they must walk, and the work that they must do.

kikuyu: Kana malees ati saba hunda keessaa namoota dandeetii qaban jechuunis, namoota Waaqa sodaatan, namoota amanamoo kanneen mattaʼaa jibban filadhuutii ajajjuuwwan kumaa, ajajjuuwwan dhibbaa, ajajjuuwwan shantamaatii fi ajajjuuwwan kudhanii godhii muudadhu.
english: Moreover you shall provide out of all the people able men which fear God: men of truth, hating unjust gain; and place such over them, to be rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

kikuyu: Isaan yeroo hunda sabaaf murtii haa kennan; dubbii cimaa hunda garuu sitti haa fidan; dubbii laayyoo immoo ofumaan haa murteessan. Kun baʼaa kee siif salphisa; isaan si wajjin baʼaa ni baatuutii.
english: Let them judge the people at all times. It shall be that every great matter they shall bring to you, but every small matter they shall judge themselves. So shall it be easier for you, and they shall share the load with you.

kikuyu: Yoo ati waan kana goote, yoo Waaqnis waanuma kana si ajaje ati jabaattee dhaabachuu dandeessa; sabni kun hundis nagaadhaan mana ofii isaatti gala.”
english: If you will do this thing, and God commands you so, then you will be able to endure, and all these people also will go to their place in peace.”

kikuyu: Museenis abbaa niitii isaa dhagaʼee waan inni jedhe hunda godhe.
english: So Moses listened to the voice of his father-in-law, and did all that he had said.

kikuyu: Innis Israaʼel hunda keessaa namoota dandeettii qaban filatee hooggantoota sabaa, ajajjuuwwan kumaa, ajajjuuwwan dhibbaa, ajajjuuwwan shantamaatii fi ajajjuuwwan kudhanii isaan godhate.
english: Moses chose able men out of all Israel, and made them heads over the people, rulers of thousands, rulers of hundreds, rulers of fifties, and rulers of tens.

kikuyu: Isaanis abbootii murtii taʼanii yeroo hunda saba sana tajaajilan; dubbii jabaa Museetti fidan; dubbii laayyoo taʼe hunda immoo ofumaan murteessan.
english: They judged the people at all times. They brought the hard cases to Moses, but every small matter they judged themselves.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Museen abbaa niitii isaa geggeesse; Yootooris deebiʼee biyya isaatti gale.
english: Moses let his father-in-law depart, and he went his way into his own land.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni erga Gibxii baʼanii as jiʼa sadaffaa keessa guyyuma itti Gibxii baʼan sana Gammoojjii Siinaa gaʼan.
english: In the third month after the children of Israel had gone out of the land of Egypt, on that same day they came into the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Isaanis erga Refiidiimii kaʼanii booddee Gammoojjii Siinaa seenan; sabni Israaʼelis Gammoojjii sana keessa fuullee tulluu sanaa qubatan.
english: When they had departed from Rephidim, and had come to the wilderness of Sinai, they encamped in the wilderness; and there Israel encamped before the mountain.

kikuyu: Museenis gara Waaqaatti ol baʼe; Waaqayyos tulluu irraa isa waamee akkana jedheen; “Ati mana Yaaqoobiin akkana jetta; saba Israaʼelittis waan kana himi:
english: Moses went up to God, and the LORD called to him out of the mountain, saying, “This is what you shall tell the house of Jacob, and tell the children of Israel:

kikuyu: ‘Waan ani warra Gibxi godhee fi akka ani itti qoochoo risaa irratti isin baadhee gara kootti isin fide isin mataan keessan iyyuu argitaniirtu.
english: ‘You have seen what I did to the Egyptians, and how I bore you on eagles’ wings, and brought you to myself.

kikuyu: Ammas isin yoo naaf ajajamtan, yoo kakuu koo eegdan isin saboota hunda keessaa qabeenya addaa naaf taatu. Yoo lafti hundinuu kan koo taʼe illee,
english: Now therefore, if you will indeed obey my voice and keep my covenant, then you shall be my own possession from among all peoples; for all the earth is mine;

kikuyu: isin mootummaa lubootaatii fi saba qulqulluu naaf taatu.’ Dubbiin ati saba Israaʼelitti himuu qabdus kanuma.”
english: and you shall be to me a kingdom of priests and a holy nation.’ These are the words which you shall speak to the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Museen deebiʼee maanguddoota sabaa walitti waamee, dubbii akka inni dubbatuuf Waaqayyo isa ajaje sana hunda fuula isaanii duratti dhiʼeesse.
english: Moses came and called for the elders of the people, and set before them all these words which the LORD commanded him.

kikuyu: Jarri hundinuus afaan tokkoon, “Nu waan Waaqayyo jedhe hundumaa ni goona” jedhanii deebisan; Museen immoo waan jarri jedhan deebisee Waaqayyotti fide.
english: All the people answered together, and said, “All that the LORD has spoken we will do.” Moses reported the words of the people to the LORD.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Akka sabni kun anaa si wajjin dubbatu dhagaʼee yeroo hunda si amanatuuf kunoo ani duumessa yabbuu keessaan gara kee nan dhufa.” Ergasiis Museen waan sabni sun jedhe Waaqayyotti hime.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, I come to you in a thick cloud, that the people may hear when I speak with you, and may also believe you forever.” Moses told the words of the people to the LORD.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Gara sabaa dhaqiitii harʼaa fi bori isaan qulqulleessi. Akka isaan wayyaa isaanii miiccatanii
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go to the people, and sanctify them today and tomorrow, and let them wash their garments,

kikuyu: guyyaa sadaffaaf qophaaʼan godhi; gaafa sana utuma sabni hundi ilaaluu Waaqayyo Tulluu Siinaa irratti gad ni buʼaatii.
english: and be ready for the third day; for on the third day the LORD will come down in the sight of all the people on Mount Sinai.

kikuyu: Naannoo tullichaatti saba sanaaf daangaa tolchiitii akkana jedhiin; ‘Isin akka tulluu sanatti ol hin baane yookaan akka qarqara isaa illee hin tuqne of eeggadhaa. Namni tulluu sana tuqu kam iyyuu haa ajjeefamu.
english: You shall set bounds to the people all around, saying, ‘Be careful that you don’t go up onto the mountain, or touch its border. Whoever touches the mountain shall be surely put to death.

kikuyu: Inni dhagaadhaan haa tumamu yookaan xiyyaan haa waraanamu; harki tokko iyyuu isa hin tuqin; horiis taʼu namni akka jiraatu hin eeyyamamuuf.’ Isaan yeroo malakanni utuu gargar hin citin afuufamu qofa tulluutti ol baʼuu dandaʼu.”
english: No hand shall touch him, but he shall surely be stoned or shot through; whether it is animal or man, he shall not live.’ When the trumpet sounds long, they shall come up to the mountain.”

kikuyu: Museen tulluu irraa gara sabaatti gad buʼee saba sana qulqulleesse; isaanis uffata isaanii miiccatan.
english: Moses went down from the mountain to the people, and sanctified the people; and they washed their clothes.

kikuyu: Innis saba sanaan, “Guyyaa sadaffaaf of qopheessaa; dubartii biras hin gaʼinaa” jedhe.
english: He said to the people, “Be ready by the third day. Don’t have sexual relations with a woman.”

kikuyu: Ganama guyyaa sadaffaa sana tulluu sana irra bakakkaa, balaqqeessaa fi duumessa yabbuu, akkasumas sagalee malakataa guddaatu dhagaʼame. Warri iddoo qubataa sana keessa jiraatan hundis ni hollatan.
english: On the third day, when it was morning, there were thunders and lightnings, and a thick cloud on the mountain, and the sound of an exceedingly loud trumpet; and all the people who were in the camp trembled.

kikuyu: Museenis saba sana iddoo qubannaatii baasee gara Waaqaatti fide; jarris miilla tulluu sanaa jala dhadhaabatan.
english: Moses led the people out of the camp to meet God; and they stood at the lower part of the mountain.

kikuyu: Tulluun Siinaa hundis sababii Waaqayyo ibiddaan irratti gad buʼeef aaraan haguugame. Aarri sunis akkuma aara boolla ibiddaatii baʼuutti ol baʼe; tulluun sunis guutumaan guutuutti akka malee raafame;
english: All of Mount Sinai smoked, because the LORD descended on it in fire; and its smoke ascended like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked greatly.

kikuyu: sagaleen malakataa ittuma guddachaa deeme. Museenis ni dubbate; sagaleen Waaqaas deebii kenneef.
english: When the sound of the trumpet grew louder and louder, Moses spoke, and God answered him by a voice.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo fiixee Tulluu Siinaa irratti gad buʼee Musee gara fiixee tulluu sanaatti ol waame. Museenis ol baʼe;
english: The LORD came down on Mount Sinai, to the top of the mountain. The LORD called Moses to the top of the mountain, and Moses went up.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo immoo akkana isaan jedhe; “Akka isaan Waaqayyo ilaaluuf jedhanii daarii hin dabarree fi akka isaan keessaas namni baayʼeen hin duuneef gad buʼiitii isaan akeekkachiisi.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go down, warn the people, lest they break through to the LORD to gaze, and many of them perish.

kikuyu: Akka Waaqayyo isaan hin balleessineef luboonni Waaqayyotti dhiʼaatan iyyuu of haa qulqulleessan.”
english: Let the priests also, who come near to the LORD, sanctify themselves, lest the LORD break out on them.”

kikuyu: Museen immoo Waaqayyoon, “Sababii ati mataan kee, ‘Naannoo Tullichaatti daangaa dhaabiitii isa qulqulleessiitii addaan baasi’ jettee akeekkachiisa nuu kenniteef sabni kun Tulluu Siinaatti ol baʼuu hin dandaʼu” jedhe.
english: Moses said to the LORD, “The people can’t come up to Mount Sinai, for you warned us, saying, ‘Set bounds around the mountain, and sanctify it.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos, “Gadi buʼiitii Aroonin fidii kottu. Garuu luboonnii fi uummanni gara Waaqayyootti ol dhufuuf jedhanii daangaa hin darbin; yoo kanaa achii inni isaan balleessa” jedhee deebise.
english: The LORD said to him, “Go down! You shall bring Aaron up with you, but don’t let the priests and the people break through to come up to the LORD, lest he break out against them.”

kikuyu: Museenis gad buʼee waan kana uummatatti hime.
english: So Moses went down to the people, and told them.

kikuyu: Waaqni akkana jedhee dubbii kana hunda dubbate:
english: God spoke all these words, saying,

kikuyu: “Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa kee kan Gibxii, biyya garbummaatii si baasee dha.
english: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

kikuyu: “Ati ana malee waaqota biraa tokko illee hin qabaatin.
english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

kikuyu: Ati bifa waan ol samii gubbaa yookaan gad lafa irra yookaan bishaan lafa jalaa keessa jiru kamiitiin iyyuu Waaqa tolfamaa ofii keetiif hin tolfatin.
english: “You shall not make for yourselves an idol, nor any image of anything that is in the heavens above, or that is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth:

kikuyu: Isaaniif hin sagadin yookaan isaan hin waaqeffatin; ani Waaqayyo Waaqni kee Waaqa hinaafu kan sababii cubbuu abbootiitiif jedhee ijoollee warra na jibbanii hamma dhaloota sadii fi afuriitti adabee
english: you shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me,

kikuyu: warra na jaallatanii ajajawwan koo eegan immoo hamma dhaloota kumaatti jaallatuu dha.
english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

kikuyu: Maqaa Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii akkasumaan hin dhaʼin; Waaqayyo warra akkuma argan maqaa isaa dhaʼan utuu hin adabin hin dhiisuutii.
english: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God, for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

kikuyu: Guyyaa Sanbataa qulqulleessuudhaan yaadadhu.
english: “Remember the Sabbath day, to keep it holy.

kikuyu: Guyyoota jaʼa hojjedhu; hojii kee hundas hojjetadhu;
english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work,

kikuyu: guyyaan torbaffaan garuu sanbata Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii ti. Gaafas hojii tokko illee hin hojjetin; ati yookaan ilmi kee yookaan intalli kee yookaan hojjetaan kee yookaan xomboreen kee yookaan horiin kee yookaan alagaan magaalaa kee keessa jiraatu tokko iyyuu homaa hin hojjetin.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God. You shall not do any work in it, you, nor your son, nor your daughter, your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates;

kikuyu: Waaqayyo guyyaa jaʼa keessatti samii fi lafa, galaanaa fi waan isaan keessa jiru hunda uumee guyyaa torbaffaatti boqoteetii. Kanaafuu Waaqayyo Sanbata eebbisee qulqulleesse.
english: for in six days the LORD made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them, and rested the seventh day; therefore the LORD blessed the Sabbath day, and made it holy.

kikuyu: Akka biyya Waaqayyo Waaqni kee siif kennu keessa bara dheeraa jiraattuuf abbaa keetii fi haadha keetiif ulfina kenni.
english: “Honor your father and your mother, that your days may be long in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

kikuyu: Hin ajjeesin.
english: “You shall not murder.

kikuyu: Hin ejjin.
english: “You shall not commit adultery.

kikuyu: Hin hatin.
english: “You shall not steal.

kikuyu: Ollaa keetti sobaan dhugaa hin baʼin.
english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

kikuyu: Mana namaa hin hawwin. Niitii namaa yookaan hojjetaa isaa yookaan xomboree isaa yookaan qotiyyoo isaa yookaan harree isaa yookaan waan namaa kam iyyuu hin hawwin.”
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s house. You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife, nor his male servant, nor his female servant, nor his ox, nor his donkey, nor anything that is your neighbor’s.”

kikuyu: Jarri hundinuus yommuu bakakkaa fi balaqqeessa, sagalee malakataatii fi tulluu aaru hubatanitti sodaadhaan hollatan. Isaan fagoo dhaabatanii
english: All the people perceived the thunderings, the lightnings, the sound of the trumpet, and the mountain smoking. When the people saw it, they trembled, and stayed at a distance.

kikuyu: Museedhaan, “Ati mataan kee nutti dubbadhu; nu ni dhaggeeffannaa. Garuu Waaqni nutti hin dubbatin. Yoo kanaa achii nu ni dhumnaa” jedhan.
english: They said to Moses, “Speak with us yourself, and we will listen; but don’t let God speak with us, lest we die.”

kikuyu: Museen immoo saba sanaan, “Hin sodaatinaa. Akka Waaqa sodaachuun isin wajjin jiraatee cubbuu hojjechuu irraa isin eeguuf jedhee Waaqni isin qoruuf dhufeera” jedhe.
english: Moses said to the people, “Don’t be afraid, for God has come to test you, and that his fear may be before you, that you won’t sin.”

kikuyu: Yeroo Museen dukkana limixii iddoo Waaqni turetti dhiʼaatetti, namoonni fagoo dhaabatan.
english: The people stayed at a distance, and Moses came near to the thick darkness where God was.

kikuyu: Ergasii Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Saba Israaʼelitti waan kana himi: ‘Akka ani samii irraa isinitti dubbadhe isin mataan keessan argitaniirtu;
english: The LORD said to Moses, “This is what you shall tell the children of Israel: ‘You yourselves have seen that I have talked with you from heaven.

kikuyu: ana biratti waaqota kam iyyuu hin tolfatinaa. Waaqota meetii yookaan waaqota warqee hin tolfatinaa.
english: You shall most certainly not make gods of silver or gods of gold for yourselves to be alongside me.

kikuyu: “ ‘Biyyoo lafaa irraa iddoo aarsaa naa tolchiitii isa irratti qalma gubamu, aarsaa nagaa, hoolota kee, reʼoota keetii fi loon kee aarsaa dhiʼeessi. Ani iddoo akka maqaan koo itti yaadatamu godhu hundatti gara kee dhufee sin eebbisa.
english: You shall make an altar of earth for me, and shall sacrifice on it your burnt offerings and your peace offerings, your sheep and your cattle. In every place where I record my name I will come to you and I will bless you.

kikuyu: Yoo dhagaa irraa iddoo aarsaa naa ijaarte immoo dhagaa soofame irraa hin ijaarin; yoo meeshaadhaan isa tuqxe ni xureessitaatii.
english: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.

kikuyu: Akka qullaan kee isa irratti hin mulʼanneef gulantaadhaan iddoo aarsaa kootti ol hin baʼin.’
english: You shall not go up by steps to my altar, that your nakedness may not be exposed to it.’

kikuyu: “Seerawwan ati isaan dura keessu kanneenii dha:
english: “Now these are the ordinances which you shall set before them:

kikuyu: “Ati yoo Ibroota keessaa garbicha bitatte inni waggaa jaʼa siif haa hojjetu. Waggaa torbaffaatti garuu inni kaffaltii malee bilisa haa baʼu.
english: “If you buy a Hebrew servant, he shall serve six years, and in the seventh he shall go out free without paying anything.

kikuyu: Inni yoo kophaa isaa dhufee jiraate kophaa isaa bilisoomee haa deemu; yeroo dhufutti inni yoo niitii qabaate isheenis isa wajjin haa deemtu.
english: If he comes in by himself, he shall go out by himself. If he is married, then his wife shall go out with him.

kikuyu: Yoo gooftaan isaa niitii isa fuusisee isheenis ilmaan yookaan intallan deesseefii jiraatte, ishee fi ijoolleen ishee kan gooftaa ishee taʼu; namichi qofti bilisa taʼee haa deemu.
english: If his master gives him a wife and she bears him sons or daughters, the wife and her children shall be her master’s, and he shall go out by himself.

kikuyu: “Garuu garbichi sun, ‘Ani gooftaa koo fi niitii koo, ijoollee koos nan jaalladha; ani bilisa baʼee deemuu hin barbaadu’ yoo jedhe,
english: But if the servant shall plainly say, ‘I love my master, my wife, and my children. I will not go out free;’

kikuyu: gooftaan isaa fuula abbootii murtii duratti isa haa dhiʼeessu; gara balbalaatti yookaan gara michichila balbalaatti geessees mutaadhaan gurra isaa haa uru. Ergasii inni bara jireenya isaa guutuu isa tajaajila.
english: then his master shall bring him to God, and shall bring him to the door or to the doorpost, and his master shall bore his ear through with an awl, and he shall serve him forever.

kikuyu: “Namni yoo intala isaa akka garbittiitti gurgurate, isheen akka garbichi tokko itti bilisa baʼutti bilisa hin baʼin.
english: “If a man sells his daughter to be a female servant, she shall not go out as the male servants do.

kikuyu: Yoo isheen goofticha ofii isaatiif ishee filate sanatti toluu baatte inni akka isheen furamtuu haa godhu. Inni waan isheef amanamuu dhabeef dabarsee ormatti ishee gurguruuf mirga hin qabu.
english: If she doesn’t please her master, who has married her to himself, then he shall let her be redeemed. He shall have no right to sell her to a foreign people, since he has dealt deceitfully with her.

kikuyu: Yoo ilma isaatiif ishee filate immoo mirga intala ofii isaatiif kennu isheefis haa kennu.
english: If he marries her to his son, he shall deal with her as a daughter.

kikuyu: Yoo niitii biraa fuudhe immoo niitii isaa kan jalqabaa sana nyaata, uffataa fi mirga niitiif malu itti hin hirʼisin.
english: If he takes another wife to himself, he shall not diminish her food, her clothing, and her marital rights.

kikuyu: Yoo inni wantoota sadan kanneen isheef gochuu dide garuu isheen kaffaltii maallaqaa tokko malee bilisa baʼuu qabdi.
english: If he doesn’t do these three things for her, she may go free without paying any money.

kikuyu: “Namni nama rukutee ajjeesu innis haa ajjeefamu.
english: “One who strikes a man so that he dies shall surely be put to death,

kikuyu: Inni riphee utuu hin eeggatin Waaqatu harka isaa buuse yoo taʼe garuu iddoo ani ramadutti haa baqatu.
english: but not if it is unintentional, but God allows it to happen; then I will appoint you a place where he shall flee.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo namni tokko ittuma yaadee dabaan nama ajjeese iddoo aarsaa koo biraa fuudhaatii ajjeesaa.
english: If a man schemes and comes presumptuously on his neighbor to kill him, you shall take him from my altar, that he may die.

kikuyu: “Namni abbaa isaa yookaan haadha isaa rukutu haa ajjeefamu.
english: “Anyone who attacks his father or his mother shall be surely put to death.

kikuyu: “Namni nama hatee yoo gurgurate yookaan namichi hatame sun harka isaatti yoo argame hattichi haa ajjeefamu.
english: “Anyone who kidnaps someone and sells him, or if he is found in his hand, he shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: “Namni abbaa isaa yookaan haadha isaa arrabsu haa ajjeefamu.
english: “Anyone who curses his father or his mother shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: “Yoo namoonni wal lolanii inni tokko isa kaan dhagaadhaan yookaan abootteedhaan rukutee namichi rukutame sun duʼuu baatee garuu siree irratti hafe,
english: “If men quarrel and one strikes the other with a stone, or with his fist, and he doesn’t die, but is confined to bed;

kikuyu: ergasii immoo yoo inni kaʼee ulee isaa dhadhaabachaa asii fi achi ala keessa deddeeme namichi isa dhaʼe sun itti hin gaafatamu; sababii yeroo namicha miidhame sanaa jalaa balleesseef garuu gatii haa baasu; hamma inni guutumaan guutuutti fayyuttis isa haa walʼaanu.
english: if he rises again and walks around with his staff, then he who struck him shall be cleared; only he shall pay for the loss of his time, and shall provide for his healing until he is thoroughly healed.

kikuyu: “Yoo namni tokko uleedhaan garbicha isaa yookaan garbittii isaa dhaʼee garbichi sunis harka isaatti duʼe namichi haa adabamu;
english: “If a man strikes his servant or his maid with a rod, and he dies under his hand, the man shall surely be punished.

kikuyu: garuu sababii garbichi sun qabeenya isaa taʼeef yoo garbichi sun bultii tokko yookaan bultii lama booddee kaʼe, namichi hin adabamu.
english: Notwithstanding, if his servant gets up after a day or two, he shall not be punished, for the servant is his property.

kikuyu: “Yoo namoonni wal lolaa jiran dubartii ulfoofte tokkotti buʼanii ulfii garaadhaa baʼee garuu miidhamni hamaan ishee hin qaqqabin, namichi ishee miidhe sun waan dhirsi dubartittii isa gaafatee fi waan abbootiin murtii murteessan baasuu qaba.
english: “If men fight and hurt a pregnant woman so that she gives birth prematurely, and yet no harm follows, he shall be surely fined as much as the woman’s husband demands and the judges allow.

kikuyu: Yoo miidhamni hamaan jiraate garuu, qooda lubbuu, lubbuu;
english: But if any harm follows, then you must take life for life,

kikuyu: qooda ijaa, ija; qooda ilkaanii, ilkaan; qooda harkaa, harka; qooda miillaa, miilla;
english: eye for eye, tooth for tooth, hand for hand, foot for foot,

kikuyu: qooda gubuu, gubuu; qooda madaa, madaa; qooda buruqsuu, buruqsuu baafta.
english: burning for burning, wound for wound, and bruise for bruise.

kikuyu: “Namni tokko yoo ija garbicha isaa yookaan ija garbittii isaa rukutee jaamse, inni qooda ija sanaa garba sana bilisa haa baasu.
english: “If a man strikes his servant’s eye, or his maid’s eye, and destroys it, he shall let him go free for his eye’s sake.

kikuyu: Inni yoo ilkaan garbicha isaa yookaan ilkaan garbittii isaa rukutee cabse, qooda ilkaan sanaa garba sana bilisa haa baasu.
english: If he strikes out his male servant’s tooth, or his female servant’s tooth, he shall let the servant go free for his tooth’s sake.

kikuyu: “Qotiyyoon tokko yoo dhiira yookaan dubartii waraanee ajjeese qotiyyoon sun dhagaadhaan tumamee haa ajjeefamu; foon isaas hin nyaatamin. Garuu abbaan qotiyyoo sanaa itti hin gaafatamu.
english: “If a bull gores a man or a woman to death, the bull shall surely be stoned, and its meat shall not be eaten; but the owner of the bull shall not be held responsible.

kikuyu: Yoo qotiyyoon sun durumaanuu amala nama waraanuu qabaachuun isaa beekamee abbaan isaas akka isa eeggatu gorfamee garuu waan inni isa eeggachuu dideef qotiyyoon sun dhiira yookaan dubartii ajjeese, qotiyyoon sun dhagaadhaan rukutamee haa ajjeefamu; abbaan qotiyyoo sanaas haa ajjeefamu.
english: But if the bull had a habit of goring in the past, and this has been testified to its owner, and he has not kept it in, but it has killed a man or a woman, the bull shall be stoned, and its owner shall also be put to death.

kikuyu: Taʼus inni yoo gumaa gaafatame waan gaafatame hunda kaffalee lubbuu isaa haa oolfatu.
english: If a ransom is imposed on him, then he shall give for the redemption of his life whatever is imposed.

kikuyu: Yoo qotiyyoon sun ilma yookaan intala tokko waraane illee seeruma kanatu hojjeta.
english: Whether it has gored a son or has gored a daughter, according to this judgment it shall be done to him.

kikuyu: Yoo qotiyyoon sun garbicha yookaan garbittii waraane abbaan qotiyyoo sanaa gooftaa garba sanaatiif meetii saqilii soddoma haa kaffalu; qotiyyoon sunis dhagaan rukutamee haa ajjeefamu.
english: If the bull gores a male servant or a female servant, thirty shekels of silver shall be given to their master, and the ox shall be stoned.

kikuyu: “Namni tokko yoo boolla afaan banaa dhiise yookaan yoo boolla qotee utuu hin duuchin dhiisee sangaan yookaan harreen boolla sana keessa buʼe,
english: “If a man opens a pit, or if a man digs a pit and doesn’t cover it, and a bull or a donkey falls into it,

kikuyu: abbaan boolla sanaa abbaa horii sanaatiif maallaqa haa baasu; horiin duʼe sun immoo kan isaa haa taʼu.
english: the owner of the pit shall make it good. He shall give money to its owner, and the dead animal shall be his.

kikuyu: “Yoo qotiyyoon nama tokkoo qotiyyoo nama biraa miidhee duʼaan gaʼe jarri qotiyyoo fayyaa sana haa gurgurani; gatii qotiyyoo sanaatii fi qotiyyoo duʼe sana qixxeetti haa qooddatani.
english: “If one man’s bull injures another’s, so that it dies, then they shall sell the live bull, and divide its price; and they shall also divide the dead animal.

kikuyu: Yoo qotiyyoon sun durumaanuu amala horii waraanuu qabaachuun isaa beekamee garuu waan abbaan isaa isa eeggachuu dideef abbaan qotiyyoo sanaa qooda qotiyyoo, qotiyyoo haa baasu; qotiyyoon duʼe sun immoo kan isaa haa taʼu.
english: Or if it is known that the bull was in the habit of goring in the past, and its owner has not kept it in, he shall surely pay bull for bull, and the dead animal shall be his own.

kikuyu: “Namni tokko yoo sangaa yookaan hoolaa hatee qalate yookaan gurgurate, qooda qotiyyoo tokkoo sangaa shan, qooda hoolaa tokkoo immoo hoolaa afur haa baasu.
english: “If a man steals an ox or a sheep, and kills it or sells it, he shall pay five oxen for an ox, and four sheep for a sheep.

kikuyu: “Hattuun tokko utuu cabsee seenuu yoo qabamee tumamee kanumaan duʼe, namichi isa ajjeese sun dhiiga isaatti yakkaan hin gaafatamu;
english: If the thief is found breaking in, and is struck so that he dies, there shall be no guilt of bloodshed for him.

kikuyu: garuu yoo wanni kun erga aduun baatee taʼe, namichi dhiiga sanatti yakkaan ni gaafatama. “Hattuun waan hate haa deebisu; homaa hin qabu yoo taʼe garuu hanna isaatiif gatii baasuudhaaf haa gurguramu.
english: If the sun has risen on him, he is guilty of bloodshed. He shall make restitution. If he has nothing, then he shall be sold for his theft.

kikuyu: Horiin hatame sun sangaa yookaan harree yookaan hoolaa taanaan yoo utuu lubbuun jiruu harka isaatti argame hattuun sun dachaa baasuu qaba.
english: If the stolen property is found in his hand alive, whether it is ox, donkey, or sheep, he shall pay double.

kikuyu: “Namni tokko yoo utuu lafa qotiisaa yookaan dhaabaa wayinii keessa horii tikfatuu horii isaa gad lakkisee horiin sun dhaqee kaloo nama biraa dheede, inni lafa qotiisaa ofii isaa irraa yookaan dhaabaa wayinii ofii isaa irraa kan waan hunda caalu iddoo haa buusuuf.
english: “If a man causes a field or vineyard to be eaten by letting his animal loose, and it grazes in another man’s field, he shall make restitution from the best of his own field, and from the best of his own vineyard.

kikuyu: “Yoo ibiddi kaʼee daggala seenee akkasiin midhaan tuulame yookaan midhaan dhaabatu yookaan lafa qotiisaa gube, namichi ibidda qabsiise sun gatii baasuu qaba.
english: “If fire breaks out, and catches in thorns so that the shocks of grain, or the standing grain, or the field are consumed; he who kindled the fire shall surely make restitution.

kikuyu: “Namni tokko yoo maallaqa yookaan miʼa imaanaa namatti kennatee, wanni sun mana namichaatii hatamee hattuun sun qabame, hattichi dachaa kaffaluu qaba.
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor money or stuff to keep, and it is stolen out of the man’s house, if the thief is found, he shall pay double.

kikuyu: Yoo hattuun sun hin argamin garuu abbaan mana sanaa akka miʼa nama kaanii tuqee fi akka hin tuqin mirkaneessuuf fuula abbootii murtii duratti haa dhiʼeeffamu.
english: If the thief isn’t found, then the master of the house shall come near to God, to find out whether or not he has put his hand on his neighbor’s goods.

kikuyu: Namni tokko yoo qotiyyoo, harree, hoolaa, uffata yookaan miʼa bade tokko miliqsee namni tokko dhufee, ‘Kun kan koo ti’ jedhe, falmiin isaanii fuula abbootii murtii duratti haa dhiʼeeffamu. Namichi abbootiin murtii itti muran sunis ollaa isaatiif harka lama haa baasu.
english: For every matter of trespass, whether it is for ox, for donkey, for sheep, for clothing, or for any kind of lost thing, about which one says, ‘This is mine,’ the cause of both parties shall come before God. He whom God condemns shall pay double to his neighbor.

kikuyu: “Yoo namni tokko ollaa isaatiif harree, qotiyyoo, hoolaa yookaan horii biraa imaanaa kennatee horiin suni utuu namni hin argin duʼe yookaan miidhame yookaan hatame,
english: “If a man delivers to his neighbor a donkey, an ox, a sheep, or any animal to keep, and it dies or is injured, or driven away, no man seeing it;

kikuyu: namichi sun akka qabeenya ollaa isaa hin tuqin mirkaneessuuf fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa kakatu; abbaan qabeenyaa sunis kakuu kana fudhachuu qaba; gatiis hin gaafatu.
english: the oath of the LORD shall be between them both, he has not put his hand on his neighbor’s goods; and its owner shall accept it, and he shall not make restitution.

kikuyu: Yoo horiin sun isa jalaa hatamee jiraate garuu namichi abbaa horii sanaatiif baasuu qaba.
english: But if it is stolen from him, the one who stole shall make restitution to its owner.

kikuyu: Yoo horii sana bineensatu nyaate taʼe immoo akka ragaa taʼuuf waan bineensa irraa hafe haa dhiʼeessu malee horii nyaatame sanaaf gatii hin baasin.
english: If it is torn in pieces, let him bring it for evidence. He shall not make good that which was torn.

kikuyu: “Namni tokko yoo ollaa isaa irraa horii ergifatee horiin sun iddoo abbaan horii hin jirretti miidhame yookaan duʼe, namichi ergifate sun gatii haa baasu.
english: “If a man borrows anything of his neighbor’s, and it is injured, or dies, its owner not being with it, he shall surely make restitution.

kikuyu: Yoo abbaan horii sanaa achi jiraate garuu namichi ergifate sun gatii baasuu hin qabu. Yoo horiin sun kireeffamee jiraate immoo maallaqni baafame sun kiraa horii duʼe sanaa haa taʼu.
english: If its owner is with it, he shall not make it good. If it is a leased thing, it came for its lease.

kikuyu: “Namni tokko yoo durba hin kaadhimatamin gowwoomsee ishee wajjin ciise, inni gabbara misirrittiif malu baaseefii ishee haa fuudhu.
english: “If a man entices a virgin who isn’t pledged to be married, and lies with her, he shall surely pay a dowry for her to be his wife.

kikuyu: Yoo abbaan ishee intalattii namichaaf kennuu dide immoo namichi sun gabbara durbaaf malu baasuu qaba.
english: If her father utterly refuses to give her to him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.

kikuyu: “Ati akka dubartiin falfaltuun lubbuun jiraattu hin eeyyamin.
english: “You shall not allow a sorceress to live.

kikuyu: “Namni horii wajjin ciisu kam iyyuu ajjeefamuu qaba.
english: “Whoever has sex with an animal shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: “Namni Waaqayyo tokkichaaf malee Waaqa biraatiif aarsaa dhiʼeessu galaafatamuu qaba.
english: “He who sacrifices to any god, except to the LORD only, shall be utterly destroyed.

kikuyu: “Isinis waan biyya Gibxii keessatti alagoota turtaniif alagaatti daba hin hojjetinaa; hin cunqursinaas.
english: “You shall not wrong an alien or oppress him, for you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: “Haadha hiyyeessaatii fi ijoollee abbaan irraa duʼe hin hacuucinaa.
english: “You shall not take advantage of any widow or fatherless child.

kikuyu: Yoo isin isaan miitanii isaan immoo natti booʼan ani dhugumaan booʼicha isaanii nan dhagaʼa.
english: If you take advantage of them at all, and they cry at all to me, I will surely hear their cry;

kikuyu: Aariin koo ni bobaʼa; anis goraadeedhaanan isin fixa; niitonni keessan haadhota hiyyeessaa taʼu; ijoolleen keessanis kanneen abbaa hin qabne taʼu.
english: and my wrath will grow hot, and I will kill you with the sword; and your wives shall be widows, and your children fatherless.

kikuyu: “Ati yoo saba koo keessaa hiyyeessa si bira jiraatu tokkoof maallaqa liqeessite, akka nama hiiqii argachuuf kennuu hin taʼin; dhalas hin gaafatin.
english: “If you lend money to any of my people with you who is poor, you shall not be to him as a creditor. You shall not charge him interest.

kikuyu: Ati yoo wayyaa nama biraa qabdii qabatte, utuu aduun hin dhiʼin deebisiif;
english: If you take your neighbor’s garment as collateral, you shall restore it to him before the sun goes down,

kikuyu: wanni inni dhagna isaatti uffatu wayuma sanaatii. Wanni inni uffatee rafu biraa maali? Ani waanan gara laafessa taʼeef, yoo inni natti ol iyyate nan dhagaʼa.
english: for that is his only covering, it is his garment for his skin. What would he sleep in? It will happen, when he cries to me, that I will hear, for I am gracious.

kikuyu: “Waaqa hin arrabsin; bulchaa saba keetiis hin abaarin.
english: “You shall not blaspheme God, nor curse a ruler of your people.

kikuyu: “Mataa midhaan keetiitii fi dhangalaʼaa wayinii keetii irraa aarsaa dhiʼeessuu hin tursin. “Ilmaan kee keessaas hangafa naa kennuu qabda.
english: “You shall not delay to offer from your harvest and from the outflow of your presses. “You shall give the firstborn of your sons to me.

kikuyu: Loon keetii fi hoolota kee akkanuma godhi. Isaanis bultii torba haadha isaanii bira haa turan; guyyaa saddeettaffaatti garuu naa kenni.
english: You shall do likewise with your cattle and with your sheep. It shall be with its mother seven days, then on the eighth day you shall give it to me.

kikuyu: “Isin saba koo qulqulluu ni taatu. Kanaafuu foon horii bineensi alatti cabsee kam iyyuu hin nyaatinaa; foon akkanaa saree dura buusaa.
english: “You shall be holy men to me, therefore you shall not eat any meat that is torn by animals in the field. You shall cast it to the dogs.

kikuyu: “Oduu sobaa hin odeessin; dhuga baʼuu jalʼaa kennuudhaan nama balleessaa hojjete hin gargaarin.
english: “You shall not spread a false report. Don’t join your hand with the wicked to be a malicious witness.

kikuyu: “Waan hamaa hojjechuuf jettee nama baayʼee faana hin buʼin. Fuula seeraa duratti yommuu dhugaa baatu, gara nama baayʼee gortee murtii hin jalʼisin;
english: “You shall not follow a crowd to do evil. You shall not testify in court to side with a multitude to pervert justice.

kikuyu: murtii irratti hiyyeessaaf hin loogin.
english: You shall not favor a poor man in his cause.

kikuyu: “Yoo sangaa yookaan harree diina keetii kan baduutti jiru argite deebisii geessiif.
english: “If you meet your enemy’s ox or his donkey going astray, you shall surely bring it back to him again.

kikuyu: Yoo harree nama si jibbu tokkoo utuu isheen baʼaa baattee kuftee jirtuu argite achitti hin dhiisin; isa gargaarii ol kaasi.
english: If you see the donkey of him who hates you fallen down under his burden, don’t leave him. You shall surely help him with it.

kikuyu: “Murtii irratti hiyyeessa saba keetii jalaa murtii hin dabsin.
english: “You shall not deny justice to your poor people in their lawsuits.

kikuyu: Himata sobaa keessatti hin hirmaatin; waan ani nama balleessaa hojjete hin qulqulleessineef nama yakka hin qabne yookaan nama qajeelaa hin ajjeesin.
english: “Keep far from a false charge, and don’t kill the innocent and righteous; for I will not justify the wicked.

kikuyu: “Ati mattaʼaa hin fudhatin; mattaʼaan ogeeyyii ni jaamsaatii; dubbii qajeeltotaas jalʼisa.
english: “You shall take no bribe, for a bribe blinds those who have sight and perverts the words of the righteous.

kikuyu: “Alagaa hin cunqursin; isin waan biyya Gibxiitti alagaa turtaniif alagaa taʼuun maal akka taʼe isin mataan keessan ni beektuutii.
english: “You shall not oppress an alien, for you know the heart of an alien, since you were aliens in the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: “Waggaa jaʼa lafa qotiisaa kee facaafadhu; midhaanis galfadhu;
english: “For six years you shall sow your land, and shall gather in its increase,

kikuyu: waggaa torbaffaatti garuu lafa sana boqochiisi malee hin qotin. Akkasiin hiyyeeyyiin saba keetii laficha irraa nyaata argatu; waan isaan irraa hafe immoo bineensi haa nyaatu. Muka wayinii keetiitii fi muka ejersa keetiis akkasuma godhi.
english: but the seventh year you shall let it rest and lie fallow, that the poor of your people may eat; and what they leave the animal of the field shall eat. In the same way, you shall deal with your vineyard and with your olive grove.

kikuyu: “Guyyaa jaʼa hojii kee hojjetadhu; akka sangaan keetii fi harreen kee boqotaniif, akka garbichi mana keetti dhalatee fi alagaan aara galfataniif guyyaa torbafaatti hin hojjetin.
english: “Six days you shall do your work, and on the seventh day you shall rest, that your ox and your donkey may have rest, and the son of your servant, and the alien may be refreshed.

kikuyu: “Waan ani isinitti hime hunda eegaa; maqaa waaqota biraa hin waammatinaa; afaan keessanii iyyuu hin baʼin.
english: “Be careful to do all things that I have said to you; and don’t invoke the name of other gods or even let them be heard out of your mouth.

kikuyu: “Ati waggaatti yeroo sadii ayyaana naa ayyaaneffadhu.
english: “You shall observe a feast to me three times a year.

kikuyu: “Ayyaana Maxinoo Ayyaaneffadhu; akkuma ani si ajaje sana bultii torba Maxinoo nyaadhu. Waan kanas jiʼa Abiibii keessa yeroo murtaaʼetti godhi; ati jiʼa sana keessa Gibxii baateetii. “Namni tokko iyyuu harka duwwaa fuula koo duratti hin dhiʼaatin.
english: You shall observe the feast of unleavened bread. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread, as I commanded you, at the time appointed in the month Abib (for in it you came out of Egypt), and no one shall appear before me empty.

kikuyu: “Mataa midhaan keetii kan lafa qotiisaa keetti facaafatteen Ayyaana Galchaa Midhaanii ayyaaneffadhu. “Dhuma waggaatti yeroo midhaan kee lafa qotiisaa irraa walitti qabattutti Ayyaana Galchaa Midhaanii ayyaaneffadhu.
english: And the feast of harvest, the first fruits of your labors, which you sow in the field; and the feast of ingathering, at the end of the year, when you gather in your labors out of the field.

kikuyu: “Dhiirri hundi waggaatti yeroo sadii fuula Waaqayyoo Gooftaa duratti haa dhiʼaatu.
english: Three times in the year all your males shall appear before the Lord GOD.

kikuyu: “Dhiiga aarsaa waan raacitii qabu wajjin naa hin dhiʼeessin. “Coomni aarsaa ayyaana koos hamma bariitti hin turin.
english: “You shall not offer the blood of my sacrifice with leavened bread. The fat of my feast shall not remain all night until the morning.

kikuyu: “Mataa midhaan lafa keetii keessaa filatamaa isaa gara mana Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii fidi. “Ilmoo reʼee aannan haadha isheetiin hin affeelin.
english: You shall bring the first of the first fruits of your ground into the house of the LORD your God. “You shall not boil a young goat in its mother’s milk.

kikuyu: “Akka inni karaa irratti si eegee iddoo ani qopheessetti si galchuuf kunoo ani fuula kee dura ergamaa koo tokko nan erga.
english: “Behold, I send an angel before you, to keep you by the way, and to bring you into the place which I have prepared.

kikuyu: Xiyyeeffadhuutii waan inni jedhu dhaggeeffadhu. Isatti hin fincilin; inni waan Maqaa koo of irraa qabuuf fincila kee siif hin dhiisuutii.
english: Pay attention to him, and listen to his voice. Don’t provoke him, for he will not pardon your disobedience, for my name is in him.

kikuyu: Yoo ati waan inni jedhu akka gaarii dhaggeeffatee waan ani dubbadhu hunda goote, ani diinota keetti diina nan taʼa; warra siin mormaniinis nan morma.
english: But if you indeed listen to his voice, and do all that I speak, then I will be an enemy to your enemies, and an adversary to your adversaries.

kikuyu: Ergamaan koos fuula kee dura deemee biyya Amoorotaatti, Heetotaatti, Feerzotaatti, Kanaʼaanotaatti, Hiiwotaattii fi Yebuusotaatti si galcha; anis jara nan balleessa.
english: For my angel shall go before you, and bring you in to the Amorite, the Hittite, the Perizzite, the Canaanite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite; and I will cut them off.

kikuyu: Waaqota isaaniitiif hin sagadin; hin waaqeffatinis; hojii isaanii faanas hin buʼin. Ati isaan balleessitee soodduu waaqeffannaa isaanii illee caccabsuu qabda.
english: You shall not bow down to their gods, nor serve them, nor follow their practices, but you shall utterly overthrow them and demolish their pillars.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqa kee waaqeffadhu; innis midhaan keetii fi bishaan kee ni eebbisa. Dhukkubas isin gidduudhaa nan balleessa;
english: You shall serve the LORD your God, and he will bless your bread and your water, and I will take sickness away from among you.

kikuyu: biyya kee keessatti dubartiin ulfi irraa baʼu yookaan dhabduun tokko iyyuu hin argamtu. Jireenya guutuus siif nan kenna.
english: No one will miscarry or be barren in your land. I will fulfill the number of your days.

kikuyu: “Ani sodaachisuu koo si dura ergee saba ati itti dhuftu hunda nan burjaajessa. Akka diinonni kee hundinuu dugda sitti galanii baqatanis nan godha.
english: I will send my terror before you, and will confuse all the people to whom you come, and I will make all your enemies turn their backs to you.

kikuyu: Akka inni Hiiwota, Kanaʼaanotaa fi Heetota karaa kee irraa ariʼuuf ani si duraan sonsa nan erga.
english: I will send the hornet before you, which will drive out the Hivite, the Canaanite, and the Hittite, from before you.

kikuyu: Akka lafti onee bineensi wal horee sitti hin baayʼanneef ani waggaa tokko keessatti saba kana si duraa ariʼee hin baasu.
english: I will not drive them out from before you in one year, lest the land become desolate, and the animals of the field multiply against you.

kikuyu: Hamma ati baayʼattee biyyattii dhaaltutti ani xinnoo xinnoon fuula kee duraa isaan nan baasa.
english: Little by little I will drive them out from before you, until you have increased and inherit the land.

kikuyu: “Anis daarii kee Galaana Diimaadhaa jalqabee hamma Galaana Filisxeemiitti, lafa alootii jalqabee hamma Laga Efraaxiisiitti siifin dhaaba. Namoota biyya sana jiraatanis dabarsee harka keetti nan kenna; ati immoo of duraa ariitee isaan baafta.
english: I will set your border from the Red Sea even to the sea of the Philistines, and from the wilderness to the River; for I will deliver the inhabitants of the land into your hand, and you shall drive them out before you.

kikuyu: Ati isaan wajjin yookaan waaqota isaanii wajjin kakuu tokko illee hin galin.
english: You shall make no covenant with them, nor with their gods.

kikuyu: Akka isaan biyya kee keessa jiraatan hin eeyyamaniif; yoo akkas taʼe isaan akka ati cubbuu natti hojjettu si godhu; ati waaqota isaanii waaqeffannaan kun dhugumaan kiyyoo sitti taʼaatii.”
english: They shall not dwell in your land, lest they make you sin against me, for if you serve their gods, it will surely be a snare to you.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Atii fi Aroon, Naadaabii fi Abiihuu, maanguddoota Israaʼel keessaas namoonni torbaatamni gara Waaqayyotti ol baʼaa; alaalatti sagadaa;
english: He said to Moses, “Come up to the LORD, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and worship from a distance.

kikuyu: garuu Museen qofti Waaqayyotti haa dhiʼaatu; warri kaan immoo hin dhiʼaatin. Sabni isa wajjin ol hin baʼin.”
english: Moses alone shall come near to the LORD, but they shall not come near. The people shall not go up with him.”

kikuyu: Museenis dhaqee dubbii fi seera Waaqayyoo hunda saba sanatti hime; sabni sunis, “Nu waan Waaqayyo jedhe hunda ni goona” jedhee afaan tokkoon deebise.
english: Moses came and told the people all the LORD’s words, and all the ordinances; and all the people answered with one voice, and said, “All the words which the LORD has spoken will we do.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Museen waan Waaqayyo dubbatte hunda barreesse. Guyyaa itti aanu ganamaanis kaʼee miilla tulluu jalatti iddoo aarsaa ijaare; utubaa dhagaa kudha lama kanneen gosoota Israaʼel kudha lamaan iddoo buʼanis dhaabe.
english: Moses wrote all the LORD’s words, then rose up early in the morning and built an altar at the base of the mountain, with twelve pillars for the twelve tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Innis dargaggoota Israaʼel erge; isaanis aarsaa gubamuu fi jiboota aarsaa nagaa godhanii Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessan.
english: He sent young men of the children of Israel, who offered burnt offerings and sacrificed peace offerings of cattle to the LORD.

kikuyu: Museenis walakkaa dhiiga sanaa waciitiitti naqe; walakkaa hafe immoo iddoo aarsaa irratti faffacaase.
english: Moses took half of the blood and put it in basins, and half of the blood he sprinkled on the altar.

kikuyu: Innis kitaaba kakuu fuudhee saba sanaaf dubbise. Isaanis, “Nu waan Waaqayyo jedhe hunda ni goona; ni ajajamnas” jedhanii deebisan.
english: He took the book of the covenant and read it in the hearing of the people, and they said, “We will do all that the LORD has said, and be obedient.”

kikuyu: Yommus Museen dhiiga sana fuudhee sabatti faffacaasee, “Kunoo kun dhiiga kakuu kan Waaqayyo akkuma dubbii kana hundaatti isinii dhaabee dha” jedhe.
english: Moses took the blood, and sprinkled it on the people, and said, “Look, this is the blood of the covenant, which the LORD has made with you concerning all these words.”

kikuyu: Musee fi Aroon, Naadaabii fi Abiihuu, maanguddoonni Israaʼel torbaatamnis ol baʼanii
english: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

kikuyu: Waaqa Israaʼel argan. Miilla isaa jalattis waan akka afaa dhagaa Sanpeer kan akkuma samiitti qulqullaaʼe tokkotu afamee ture.
english: They saw the God of Israel. Under his feet was like a paved work of sapphire stone, like the skies for clearness.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu qondaaltota saba Israaʼel kanneenitti harka isaa ol itti hin kaafne; isaan Waaqa argan; ni nyaatan; ni dhuganis.
english: He didn’t lay his hand on the nobles of the children of Israel. They saw God, and ate and drank.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Museedhaan, “Gara kootti tulluutti ol baʼi; asis turi; anis gabateewwan dhagaa kanneen ani akka qajeelfama isaanii taʼuuf seeraa fi ajajawwan itti barreesse siif nan kenna” jedhe.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Come up to me on the mountain, and stay here, and I will give you the stone tablets with the law and the commands that I have written, that you may teach them.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Museen gargaaraa isaa Iyyaasuu wajjin kaʼee deeme; Museenis tulluu Waaqaatti ol baʼe.
english: Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.

kikuyu: Innis maanguddoota sanaan akkana jedhe; “Hamma nu gara keessanitti deebinutti asitti nu eegaa. Kunoo Aroonii fi Huuri isin bira jiran; namni falmii qabu isaan bira dhaquu dandaʼa.”
english: He said to the elders, “Wait here for us, until we come again to you. Behold, Aaron and Hur are with you. Whoever is involved in a dispute can go to them.”

kikuyu: Yeroo Museen tulluutti ol baʼetti duumessi tulluu sana haguuge;
english: Moses went up on the mountain, and the cloud covered the mountain.

kikuyu: ulfinni Waaqayyoos Tulluu Siinaa irra buʼe. Duumessi sunis guyyaa jaʼa tulluu sana haguuge; guyyaa torbaffaatti immoo Waaqayyo duumessicha keessaa Musee waame.
english: The LORD’s glory settled on Mount Sinai, and the cloud covered it six days. The seventh day he called to Moses out of the middle of the cloud.

kikuyu: Ulfinni Waaqayyoos ibidda waa gubu fakkaatee fiixee tulluu irraa saba Israaʼelitti mulʼachaa ture.
english: The appearance of the LORD’s glory was like devouring fire on the top of the mountain in the eyes of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Museen tulluutti ol baʼee duumessa keessa seene. Innis guyyaa afurtamaa fi halkan afurtama tulluu sana irra ture.
english: Moses entered into the middle of the cloud, and went up on the mountain; and Moses was on the mountain forty days and forty nights.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akka isaan kennaa naa fidaniif saba Israaʼelitti himi. Nama garaa isaa guutuudhaan kennuu fedhu hunda harkaa kennaa naa fuudhaa.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, that they take an offering for me. From everyone whose heart makes him willing you shall take my offering.

kikuyu: “Kennaan isaan harkaa fuutanis: “Warqee, meetii fi naasii;
english: This is the offering which you shall take from them: gold, silver, bronze,

kikuyu: kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi wayyaa haphii quncee talbaa irraa hojjetame; rifeensa reʼee;
english: blue, purple, scarlet, fine linen, goats’ hair,

kikuyu: gogaa korbeessa hoolaa kan halluu diimaa cuuphame, gogaa duugame, muka laaftoo,
english: rams’ skins dyed red, sea cow hides, acacia wood,

kikuyu: ibsaadhaaf, zayitii ejersaa, urgooftuuwwan immoo zayitii dibatamuu fi ixaana urgaaʼuuf;
english: oil for the light, spices for the anointing oil and for the sweet incense,

kikuyu: dhagaawwan sardooniksii, dooqa gati jabeessa, dirataa fi qomee irratti kaaʼatamuu dha.
english: onyx stones, and stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate.

kikuyu: “Ergasii akka isaan iddoo qulqulluu naa qopheessan godhi; anis gidduu isaanii nan jiraadha.
english: Let them make me a sanctuary, that I may dwell among them.

kikuyu: Dunkaana qulqulluu kanaa fi miʼa isaa hunda akkuma bifa ani sitti argisiisuutti hojjedhaa.
english: According to all that I show you, the pattern of the tabernacle, and the pattern of all of its furniture, even so you shall make it.

kikuyu: “Isaan muka laaftoo irraa taabota haa tolchan; taabonni sunis dhundhuma lamaa fi walakkaa dheerata; dhundhuma tokkoo fi walakkaa balʼata; dhundhuma tokkoo fi walakkaa ol dheerata ture.
english: “They shall make an ark of acacia wood. Its length shall be two and a half cubits, its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

kikuyu: Keessaa fi duuba isaatti warqee qulqulluu uffisi; naannoo isaattis marsaa faaya warqee naannessii tolchi.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold. You shall overlay it inside and outside, and you shall make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Taabota sanaafis qubeelaa warqee afur tolchiitii miilla isaa afranitti jechuunis lama gama tokkoon, lama immoo gama kaaniin itti kaaʼi.
english: You shall cast four rings of gold for it, and put them in its four feet. Two rings shall be on the one side of it, and two rings on the other side of it.

kikuyu: Muka laaftoo irraa danqaraawwan tolchiitii warqee itti uffisi.
english: You shall make poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold.

kikuyu: Taaboticha ittiin baachuudhaaf danqaraawwan sana qubeelaawwan keessa loosi.
english: You shall put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark to carry the ark.

kikuyu: Danqaraawwan kunneen qubeelaawwan taabotichaa keessa haa turan; keessaa baafamuus hin qaban.
english: The poles shall be in the rings of the ark. They shall not be taken from it.

kikuyu: Atis dhuga baʼumsa ani sitti kennu Taaboticha keessa kaaʼi.
english: You shall put the covenant which I shall give you into the ark.

kikuyu: “Warqee qulqulluu irraa teessoo araaraa tolchi; dheerinni isaas dhundhuma lamaa fi walakkaa, balʼinni isaa immoo dhundhuma tokkoo fi walakkaa haa taʼu.
english: You shall make a mercy seat of pure gold. Two and a half cubits shall be its length, and a cubit and a half its width.

kikuyu: Moggaa lamaan teessoo araaraa irratti warqee tumame irraa Kiirubeelii lama tolchi.
english: You shall make two cherubim of hammered gold. You shall make them at the two ends of the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Kiirubii tokko moggaa tokko irratti, kiirubii lammaffaa immoo moggaa kaan irratti tolchi; kiirubeelii sanas teessoo araaraa wajjin kutaa warqee tokkicha irraa moggaa lamaan irratti tolchi.
english: Make one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. You shall make the cherubim on its two ends of one piece with the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Kiirubeeliin sun qoochoo isaanii ol balʼifatanii teessoo araaraa ittiin haa gaaddiseessan; Kiirubeeliin kunneen fuula isaanii walitti garagalfatanii teessoo araaraa haa ilaalan.
english: The cherubim shall spread out their wings upward, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim shall be toward the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Teessoo araaraa sana taaboticha irra kaaʼi; dhuga baʼuu ani sitti kennu immoo taaboticha keessa kaaʼi.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on top of the ark, and in the ark you shall put the covenant that I will give you.

kikuyu: Ani achitti si arga; teessoo araaraa irraa, kiirubeelii lamaan taabota kakuu seeraa irra jiran gidduudhaa waaʼee ajajawwan ani saba Israaʼeliitiif sitti kennu hundaa sittin hima.
english: There I will meet with you, and I will tell you from above the mercy seat, from between the two cherubim which are on the ark of the covenant, all that I command you for the children of Israel.

kikuyu: “Muka laaftoo irraa minjaala dhundhuma lama dalga dheeratu, kan dhundhuma tokko balʼatee ol dheerinni isaa immoo dhundhuma tokkoo fi walakkaa taʼe tolchi.
english: “You shall make a table of acacia wood. Its length shall be two cubits, and its width a cubit, and its height one and a half cubits.

kikuyu: Warqee qulqulluu itti uffisiitii naannoo isaatti marsaa warqee tolchi.
english: You shall overlay it with pure gold, and make a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Naannoo isaa irrattis hidhii hamma balʼina harkaa gaʼuu fi faaya warqee tolchi.
english: You shall make a rim of a hand width around it. You shall make a golden molding on its rim around it.

kikuyu: Minjaala kanaafis qubeelaa warqee afur hojjedhuutii goleewwan afranitti iddoo miilli afran jiranitti kaaʼi.
english: You shall make four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that are on its four feet.

kikuyu: Qubeelaawwan kunneenis akka danqaraa ittiin minjaala baatan qabataniif xiyyoo sanatti dhiʼaachuu qabu.
english: The rings shall be close to the rim, for places for the poles to carry the table.

kikuyu: Muka laaftoo irraa loosawwan tolchi; warqee itti uffisiitii minjaala sana ittiin baadhu.
english: You shall make the poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with gold, that the table may be carried with them.

kikuyu: Dhibaayyuu dhiʼeessuufis caabiiwwan isaa, waciitiiwwan isaa, okkoteewwan isaatii fi waciitiiwwan isaa warqee qulqulluu irraa tolchi.
english: You shall make its dishes, its spoons, its ladles, and its bowls with which to pour out offerings. You shall make them of pure gold.

kikuyu: Buddeena ilaalchaas yeroo hunda fuula koo dura minjaala kana irra kaaʼi.
english: You shall set bread of the presence on the table before me always.

kikuyu: “Baattuu ibsaas warqee qulqulluu irraa tolchi; baattuun ibsaa kunis tumamee haa tolfamu; somaa isaa, damee isaa, waciitii isaa, hudhaa isaatii fi daraaraa isaa warqeedhuma sana irraa tolchi.
english: “You shall make a lamp stand of pure gold. The lamp stand shall be made of hammered work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers shall be of one piece with it.

kikuyu: Bitaa mirga baattuu ibsaa sana keessaas dameewwan jaʼa jechuunis sadii gama tokkoon, sadii immoo gama kaaniin haa baafaman.
english: There shall be six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side;

kikuyu: Xoofoowwan lawuzii fakkaatan kanneen tokkoon tokkoon isaanii hudhaa fi daraaraa qaban sadii damee tokko irratti, waciitiiwwan lawuzii fakkaatan kanneen tokkoon tokkoon isaanii hudhaa fi daraaraa qaban sadii immoo damee kaan irratti tolchi; dameewwan jaʼaan baattuu ibsaa irraa babbaʼan hunda irrattis akkasuma tolchi.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower; and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower, so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand;

kikuyu: Xoofoowwan hudhaa fi daraaraa qaban kanneen bifa lawuziitiin hojjetaman afur baattuu ibsaa sana irra haa jiraatan.
english: and in the lamp stand four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

kikuyu: Hudhaan tokko cimdii jalqabaa kan dameewwan baattuu ibsaa irraa babbaʼan jala, hudhaan lammaffaan cimdii lammaffaa jala, hudhaan sadaffaan immoo cimdii sadaffaa jala ture. Walumaa galatti dameewwan jaʼatu ture.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

kikuyu: Hudhaawwanii fi dameewwan hundinuu baattuu ibsaa sana wajjin warqeedhuma qulqulluu tumame tokko irraa haa tolfaman.
english: Their buds and their branches shall be of one piece with it, all of it one beaten work of pure gold.

kikuyu: “Atis ibsaawwan torba tolchiif; akka lafa fuula isaanii dura jiru ibsaniifis baattuu ibsaa irra isaan dhadhaabi.
english: You shall make its lamps seven, and they shall light its lamps to give light to the space in front of it.

kikuyu: Wanni ittiin daaraa isaa dhadhaʼanii fi caabiin daaraa sana baattu warqee qulqulluu irraa haa hojjetaman.
english: Its snuffers and its snuff dishes shall be of pure gold.

kikuyu: Baattuun ibsaatii fi miʼi isaa hundi warqee qulqulluu taalaantii tokkootiin haa hojjetamani.
english: It shall be made of a talent of pure gold, with all these accessories.

kikuyu: Atis akkuma fakkeenya tulluu irratti sitti argisiifame sanaatti hojjechuu kee mirkaneeffadhu.
english: See that you make them after their pattern, which has been shown to you on the mountain.

kikuyu: “Golgaawwan kudhan kanneen quncee talbaa gaarii foʼamee fi kan kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee fi bildiimaa irraa hojjetamaniin dunkaana qulqulluu hojjedhu; golgaawwan sana irrattis ogeessi harka qajeelu tokko kiirubeelii haa hojjetu.
english: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with cherubim. You shall make them with the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Golgaawwan hundinuu wal qixxee haa taʼan; dheerinni tokkoo tokkoo golgaawwanii dhundhuma digdamii saddeeti, balʼinni isaa immoo dhundhuma afur haa taʼu.
english: The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains shall have one measure.

kikuyu: Golgaawwan shan walitti qabsiisi; golgaawwan hafan shanan kaan illee akkasuma walitti qabsiisi.
english: Five curtains shall be coupled together to one another, and the other five curtains shall be coupled to one another.

kikuyu: Golgaawwan walitti qabsiifaman kanneen jalqabaa keessaa handaara isa moggaa irratti huccuu bifa cuquliisaa irraa gurroowwan tolchi; golgaawwan walitti qabsiifaman lammaffaa irrattis akkasuma tolchi.
english: You shall make loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling, and you shall do likewise on the edge of the curtain that is outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Gurroowwan shantama golgaa tokko irratti tolchi; gurroowwan shantama immoo golgaawwan walitti qabsiifaman lammaffaa keessaa moggaa isa tokkootti tolchi. Gurroowwan sunis gamaa gamanatti haa tolfaman.
english: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that is in the second coupling. The loops shall be opposite one another.

kikuyu: Akka dunkaanni qulqulluun sun tokko taʼuufis hokkoowwan warqee shantama tolchiitii golgaawwan sana ittiin walitti qabsiisi.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and couple the curtains to one another with the clasps. The tabernacle shall be a unit.

kikuyu: “Haguuggii gubbaa dunkaana qulqulluu irra jiru haguuguufis golgaawwan rifeensa reʼootaa kudha tokko hojjedhu.
english: “You shall make curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

kikuyu: Golgaawwan kudha tokkoon sun hundi wal qixxee haa taʼan; dheerinni isaanii dhundhuma soddoma, balʼinni isaanii immoo dhundhuma afur haa taʼu.
english: The length of each curtain shall be thirty cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: the eleven curtains shall have one measure.

kikuyu: Golgaawwan shan iddoo tokkotti walitti qabsiisi; golgaawwan jaʼan kaan immoo iddoo tokkotti walitti qabsiisi; golgaa jaʼaffaa sanas fuula dunkaanichaa duraan iddoo lamatti ol dachaasi.
english: You shall couple five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves, and shall double over the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tent.

kikuyu: Golgaawwan gama tokkoon walitti qabsiifaman keessaa handaara isa moggaa irratti gurroowwan shantama tolchi; golgaawwan gama kaan irratti walitti qabsiifaman keessaas handaara isa moggaa irratti gurroowwan shantama tolchi.
english: You shall make fifty loops on the edge of the one curtain that is outermost in the coupling, and fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which is outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Ergasiis qabduuwwan naasii shantama tolchi; qabduuwwan sanas akka inni tokko taʼuuf ittiin walitti qabsiisuuf gurroowwan keessa galchi.
english: You shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, that it may be one.

kikuyu: Wanni golgaawwan dunkaanichaa irraa hafe, walakkaan golgaa hafe sanaa dugda dunkaana qulqulluu irraan gad haa rarraʼu.
english: The overhanging part that remains of the curtains of the tent—the half curtain that remains—shall hang over the back of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Akka dunkaana qulqulluu sana haguuguufis dheerina golgaawwan dunkaanicha irraa hafe keessaa dhundhumni tokko gama tokkoon, dhundhumni tokko immoo gama kaaniin bitaa fi mirgaan dunkaana qulqulluu irraan gad haa rarraʼu.
english: The cubit on the one side and the cubit on the other side, of that which remains in the length of the curtains of the tent, shall hang over the sides of the tabernacle on this side and on that side, to cover it.

kikuyu: Dunkaana sanaafis irra buusaa kaldhee korbeessa hoolaa kan halluu diimaa cuuphame, isa irraan immoo irra buusaa gogaa duugamee hojjedhu.
english: You shall make a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

kikuyu: “Dunkaana qulqulluu sanaafis muka laaftoo irraa tuggeewwan qaqqajeeloo hojjedhu.
english: “You shall make the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing upright.

kikuyu: Dheerinni tokkoo tokkoo tuggeewwan sanaas dhundhuma kudhan, balʼinni isaa immoo dhundhuma tokkoo fi walakkaa haa taʼu;
english: Ten cubits shall be the length of a board, and one and a half cubits the width of each board.

kikuyu: tokkoon tokkoon tuggeewwan sanaas akka wal keessa galuu dandaʼuuf mucha lama lama haa qabaatu; tuggeewwan dunkaana qulqulluu sanaa hunda akkasitti tolchi.
english: There shall be two tenons in each board, joined to one another: thus you shall make for all the boards of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Gama kibba dunkaana qulqulluu sanaatiifis tuggeewwan digdama hojjedhu;
english: You shall make twenty boards for the tabernacle, for the south side southward.

kikuyu: tuggeewwan digdamman sana jalatti miilla meetii afurtama jechuunis tuggee tokko jalatti miilla lama gurra isaa lamaaniif, tuggee kaan jalattis miilla lama gurra isaa lamaaniif tolchi.
english: You shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards; two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

kikuyu: Gama dunkaana qulqulluu sanaa kaaniifis karaa kaabaatiin tuggeewwan digdama tolchi;
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, twenty boards,

kikuyu: miilla meetiis afurtama jechuunis tuggee tokko jalatti miilla lama, tuggee kaan jalattis miilla lama tolchi.
english: and their forty sockets of silver; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

kikuyu: Karaa lixa biiftuutiin, dugda duuba dunkaana qulqulluu sanaatiif tuggee jaʼa tolchi;
english: For the far side of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

kikuyu: karaa dugda duubaas golee dunkaana qulqulluu sanaatiif utubaa lama tolchi.
english: You shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far side.

kikuyu: Tuggeewwan golee kunneen jalaa hamma gubbaatti walitti fayyifamanii bantii irratti qubeelaa tokkoon walitti haa qabsiifaman; tuggeewwan golee lamaaniis akkasuma taʼuu qabu.
english: They shall be double beneath, and in the same way they shall be whole to its top to one ring: thus shall it be for them both; they shall be for the two corners.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu tuggeewwan saddeeti kanneen miilla meetii kudha jaʼa qabanitu jira; tokkoon tokkoon tuggee sanaas miilla lama lama qaba.
english: There shall be eight boards, and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets; two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

kikuyu: “Akkasumas muka laaftoo irraa dagaleewwan tolchi; tuggeewwan dunkaana qulqulluu sana irra gama tokkoon jiraniif dagaleewwan shan,
english: “You shall make bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

kikuyu: tuggeewwan gama kaaniin jiraniif dagaleewwan shan, shan tuggeewwan dugda duubaan karaa lixa biiftuutiin jiraniif immoo dagaleewwan shan tolchi.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the side of the tabernacle, for the far side westward.

kikuyu: Dagalee walakkaa jiru sana akka inni gidduu tuggeewwaniitiin moggaa tokkoo hamma moggaa kaaniitti fullaʼu godhi.
english: The middle bar in the middle of the boards shall pass through from end to end.

kikuyu: Tuggeewwan sana irras warqee itti uffisi. Akka dagaleewwan baataniif qubeelaawwan warqee itti tolchi; dagaleewwan sanas akkasuma warqee itti uffisi.
english: You shall overlay the boards with gold, and make their rings of gold for places for the bars. You shall overlay the bars with gold.

kikuyu: “Dunkaana qulqulluu kana akkuma karoora tulluu irratti sitti argisiifame sanaatti dhaabi.
english: You shall set up the tabernacle according to the way that it was shown to you on the mountain.

kikuyu: “Kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa haphii irraa golgaa tulchi; golgaa kana irrattis ogeessi harka qajeelu tokko fakkii kiirubeelii haa tolchu.
english: “You shall make a veil of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. It shall be the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Golgaa kana hokkoo warqeetiin utubaawwan muka laaftoo kanneen warqeen itti uffifamee miilla meetii afur irra dhadhaabatan afuritti rarraasi.
english: You shall hang it on four pillars of acacia overlaid with gold; their hooks shall be of gold, on four sockets of silver.

kikuyu: Golgaa sana hokkoowwanitti rarraasiitii taabota kakuu seeraa immoo dugda isaa duubaan kaaʼi. Golgaan sunis Iddoo qulqulluu, Iddoo Iddoo Hunda Caalaa Qulqulluu taʼe sana irraa addaan baasa.
english: You shall hang up the veil under the clasps, and shall bring the ark of the covenant in there within the veil. The veil shall separate the holy place from the most holy for you.

kikuyu: Teessoo araaraas Iddoo Iddoo Hunda Caalaa Qulqulluu taʼe sana keessa taabota kakuu seeraa irra kaaʼi.
english: You shall put the mercy seat on the ark of the covenant in the most holy place.

kikuyu: Minjaala sanas golgaadhaan ala, gama kaaba dunkaana qulqulluutiin dhaabi; baattuu ibsaa immoo fuullee minjaala sanaa gama kibba dunkaanichatiin dhaabi.
english: You shall set the table outside the veil, and the lamp stand opposite the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. You shall put the table on the north side.

kikuyu: “Balbala dunkaanichaatiif immoo golgaa kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼamee harkaan irratti hodhame tokko faayessii tolchi.
english: “You shall make a screen for the door of the Tent, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of the embroiderer.

kikuyu: Golgaa kanaafis hokkoo warqeetii fi utubaa muka laaftoo kan warqeen itti uffifame shan tolchi. Naasii tumiitii miilla shan tolchiif.
english: You shall make for the screen five pillars of acacia, and overlay them with gold. Their hooks shall be of gold. You shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.

kikuyu: “Muka laaftoo irraa iddoo aarsaa dhundhuma sadii ol dheeratu ijaari; iddoon aarsaa kunis dheerina dhundhuma shanii fi balʼina dhundhuma shanii qabaatee gama afraniinuu wal qixxee haa taʼu.
english: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height shall be three cubits.

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo goleewwan afraniitti gaanfa tolchi; gaanfaa fi iddoon aarsaa sun mukuma tokko irraa haa taʼu; iddoo aarsaa sana irrattis naasii uffisi.
english: You shall make its horns on its four corners. Its horns shall be of one piece with it. You shall overlay it with bronze.

kikuyu: Miʼa isaa hunda jechuunis waan ittiin daaraa haran, waan ittiin daaraa hammaaran, waciitii, hokkoo fooniitii fi baattuu ibiddaa naasii irraa tolchi.
english: You shall make its pots to take away its ashes; and its shovels, its basins, its meat hooks, and its fire pans. You shall make all its vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: Naasii wal keessa xaxameen gingilchaa hojjedhuutii tokkoo tokkoo rogawwan gingilchaa sanaa afraniif qubeelaawwan naasii tolchi.
english: You shall make a grating for it of network of bronze. On the net you shall make four bronze rings in its four corners.

kikuyu: Gingilchaa sanas akka inni hamma walakkaa iddoo aarsaatti ol kaʼuuf qarqara iddoo aarsaa jalaan kaaʼi.
english: You shall put it under the ledge around the altar beneath, that the net may reach halfway up the altar.

kikuyu: Iddoo aarsaa sanaafis danqaraawwan muka laaftoo tolchiitii naasii itti uffisi.
english: You shall make poles for the altar, poles of acacia wood, and overlay them with bronze.

kikuyu: Danqaraawwan sunis akka yeroo iddoon aarsaa baatamutti gama lamaaniin oolaniif qubeelaawwan keessa haa loofaman.
english: Its poles shall be put into the rings, and the poles shall be on the two sides of the altar when carrying it.

kikuyu: Akkuma tulluu irratti sitti argisiifame sanatti iddoo aarsaa kan keessi isaa duwwaa taʼe saanqaa irraa hojjedhu.
english: You shall make it hollow with planks. They shall make it as it has been shown you on the mountain.

kikuyu: “Dunkaana qulqulluu sanaaf oobdii hojjedhu. Oobdichis gama kibbaatiin dhundhuma dhibba tokko haa dheeratu; innis golgaa quncee talbaa gaarii foʼame irraa hojjetamee
english: “You shall make the court of the tabernacle: for the south side southward there shall be hangings for the court of fine twined linen one hundred cubits long for one side.

kikuyu: utubaawwan digdamaa fi miilla naasii digdama qaban haa qabaatu; hokkoowwanii fi somaawwan utubaawwan kanneenis meetii irraa haa hojjetaman.
english: Its pillars shall be twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets shall be of silver.

kikuyu: Gama kaabaatiinis akkasuma dhundhuma dhibba tokko dheeratee golgaawwan utubaawwan digdamaa fi miilla naasii digdama qaban haa qabaatu; hokkoowwanii fi somaawwan utubaawwan kanaas meetii irraa haa tolfaman.
english: Likewise for the length of the north side, there shall be hangings one hundred cubits long, and its pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: “Oobdiin kun gama lixaatiin dhundhuma shantama balʼatee golgaawwan, utubaa kudhanii fi miilla kudhan qaban haa qabaatu.
english: For the width of the court on the west side shall be hangings of fifty cubits; their pillars ten, and their sockets ten.

kikuyu: Oobdiin kun fiixee baʼaatiin karaa baʼa biiftuutiin akkasuma dhundhuma shantama haa balʼatu.
english: The width of the court on the east side eastward shall be fifty cubits.

kikuyu: Golgaawwan dhundhuma kudha shan dhedheeratanii utubaa sadii fi miilla sadii qabanis karaa balbala tokkoo irra haa jiraatan.
english: The hangings for the one side of the gate shall be fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

kikuyu: Golgaawwan dhundhuma kudha shan dhedheeratanii utubaa sadii fi miilla sadii qabanis gama kaaniin haa jiraatan.
english: For the other side shall be hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

kikuyu: “Balbala oobdii sanaatiifis golgaa dhundhuma digdama dheeratee utubaa afurii fi miilla afur qabu kan kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼameen dhaʼamee irratti faayeffamee hojjetame tokko tolchi.
