kikuyu: Dubartoonni fedhii fi ogummaa qaban hundinuus rifeensa reʼee foʼan.
english: All the women whose heart stirred them up in wisdom spun the goats’ hair.

kikuyu: Bulchitoonni dhagaawwan sardooniksii fi dhagaawwan gati jabeeyyii biraa dirataa fi kiisii qomaatti akka kaaʼatamuuf fidan.
english: The rulers brought the onyx stones and the stones to be set for the ephod and for the breastplate;

kikuyu: Akkasumas urgooftuu fi zayitii ibsaadhaaf, zayitii ittiin dibanii fi ixaana urgaaʼus fidan.
english: with the spice and the oil for the light, for the anointing oil, and for the sweet incense.

kikuyu: Dhiironnii fi dubartoonni Israaʼel warri fedhii qaban hundi hojii akka isaan hojjetaniif Waaqayyo karaa Museetiin isaan ajaje sana hundaaf fedhii isaaniitiin Waaqayyoof kennaa fidan.
english: The children of Israel brought a free will offering to the LORD; every man and woman whose heart made them willing to bring for all the work, which the LORD had commanded to be made by Moses.

kikuyu: Yommus Museen saba Israaʼeliin akkana jedhe; “Ilaa Waaqayyo gosa Yihuudaa keessaa Bezaliʼeel ilma Uuri ilma Huuri filateera;
english: Moses said to the children of Israel, “Behold, the LORD has called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.

kikuyu: Hafuura Waaqaatiin, ogummaadhaan, dandeettii fi beekumsa hojii harkaa gosa hundumaan isa guuteera.
english: He has filled him with the Spirit of God, in wisdom, in understanding, in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship;

kikuyu: Kunis akka inni warqeedhaan, meetii fi naasiidhaan hojii ogummaa hojjetuuf,
english: and to make skillful works, to work in gold, in silver, in bronze,

kikuyu: akka dhagaawwan muree qopheessuuf, akka muka soofuu fi akka hojii ogummaa harkaa kan gosa hundaa keessatti hirmaatuuf.
english: in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of skillful workmanship.

kikuyu: Waaqnis Bezaliʼeelii fi Oholiiyaab ilma Ahiisaamaak kan gosa Daan sanaaf dandeettii isaan ittiin warra kaan barsiisan kenne.
english: He has put in his heart that he may teach, both he and Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan.

kikuyu: Akka isaan ogeeyyii hojii harkaa, bifa baastotaa fi warra kirrii bifa cuquliisaatiin, dhiilgeen, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa baʼeessaan miidhagsanii fi wayyaa dhooftota hundi isaanii ogeeyyii hojii harkaatii fi bifa baastota taʼaniif ogummaa hojii gosa hundaa hojjechuutiin isaan guute.
english: He has filled them with wisdom of heart to work all kinds of workmanship, of the engraver, of the skillful workman, and of the embroiderer, in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen, and of the weaver, even of those who do any workmanship, and of those who make skillful works.

kikuyu: Bezaliʼeel, Oholiiyaabii fi namni Waaqayyo ogummaa fi dandeettii isaan ittiin hojii ijaarsa iddoo qulqulluu sanaa hunda beekan kenneef hundi akkuma Waaqayyo ajajetti hojii kana haa hojjetan.”
english: “Bezalel and Oholiab shall work with every wise-hearted man, in whom the LORD has put wisdom and understanding to know how to do all the work for the service of the sanctuary, according to all that the LORD has commanded.”

kikuyu: Museen Bezaliʼeel, Oholiiyaabii fi ogeessa Waaqayyo dandeettii kenneef kan dhufee hojii sana hojjechuuf fedhii qabu hunda waame.
english: Moses called Bezalel and Oholiab, and every wise-hearted man, in whose heart the LORD had put wisdom, even everyone whose heart stirred him up to come to the work to do it.

kikuyu: Isaanis kennaawwan Israaʼeloonni ijaarsa iddoo qulqulluu sanaatiif jedhanii fidan hunda Musee harkaa fuudhan. Namoonni Israaʼelis fedhii isaaniitiin ganama ganama kennaa isaanii fiduu itti fufan.
english: They received from Moses all the offering which the children of Israel had brought for the work of the service of the sanctuary, with which to make it. They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

kikuyu: Ogeeyyiin hojii harkaa kanneen iddoo qulqulluu sana hojjetan hundi hojii isaanii dhiisanii dhufanii
english: All the wise men, who performed all the work of the sanctuary, each came from his work which he did.

kikuyu: Museedhaan, “Sabni kun waan hojii Waaqayyo akka hojjetamuuf ajaje sanaaf barbaachisu caalaa fidaa jira” jedhan.
english: They spoke to Moses, saying, “The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which the LORD commanded to make.”

kikuyu: Museenis ajaja kenne; isaanis, “Dhiirri yookaan dubartiin tokko iyyuu waan biraa tokko illee kennaa godhee iddoo qulqulluu sanaaf hin dhiʼeessin” jedhanii iddoo qubataa sana keessatti labsan. Kanaafuu namoonni itti fufanii waa fiduu dhowwaman.
english: Moses gave a commandment, and they caused it to be proclaimed throughout the camp, saying, “Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary.” So the people were restrained from bringing.

kikuyu: Wanti isaan duraanuu qaban hojii hunda hojjechuuf gaʼaa fi irraa hafaa tureetii.
english: For the stuff they had was sufficient to do all the work, and too much.

kikuyu: Hojjettoota sana keessaas ogeeyyiin hundi golgaawwan kudhan kanneen quncee talbaa gaarii foʼamee fi kan kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee fi bildiimaa irraa hojjetamaniin dunkaana qulqulluu haa hojjetan; golgaawwan sana irrattis ogeeyyiin harka qajeelan kiirubeelii hojjetan.
english: All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet. They made them with cherubim, the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Golgaawwan sun hundinuu wal qixxee taʼanii tokkoon tokkoon isaanii dheerina dhundhuma digdamii saddeetiitii fi balʼina dhundhuma afur qabu ture.
english: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits. All the curtains had one measure.

kikuyu: Isaanis golgaawwan shan walitti qabsiisan; shanan kaan illee akkasuma walitti qabsiisan.
english: He coupled five curtains to one another, and the other five curtains he coupled to one another.

kikuyu: Isaanis golgaawwan walitti qabsiifaman kanneen jalqabaa keessaa handaara isa moggaa irratti huccuu bifa cuquliisaa irraa gurroowwan tolchan; golgaawwan walitti qabsiifaman lammaffaa irrattis akkasuma tolfaman.
english: He made loops of blue on the edge of the one curtain from the edge in the coupling. Likewise he made in the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Isaanis golgaa tokko irratti gurroowwan shantama tolchan; gurroowwan shantama immoo golgaawwan walitti qabsiifaman lammaffaa keessaa isa moggaa irratti tolchan; gurroowwan sunis gamaa gamanaan turan.
english: He made fifty loops in the one curtain, and he made fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that was in the second coupling. The loops were opposite to one another.

kikuyu: Akka dunkaanni qulqulluun sun tokko taʼuufis hokkoowwan warqee shantama tolchanii golgaawwan sana ittiin walitti qabsiisan.
english: He made fifty clasps of gold, and coupled the curtains to one another with the clasps: so the tabernacle was a unit.

kikuyu: Isaanis haguuggii gubbaa dunkaana qulqulluu sanaa irra jiru haguuguuf golgaawwan rifeensa reʼee kudha tokko hojjetan.
english: He made curtains of goats’ hair for a covering over the tabernacle. He made them eleven curtains.

kikuyu: Golgaawwan kudha tokkoon sun hundi wal qixxee turan; dheerinni isaanii dhundhuma soddoma, balʼinni isaanii immoo dhundhuma afur ture.
english: The length of each curtain was thirty cubits, and four cubits the width of each curtain. The eleven curtains had one measure.

kikuyu: Isaanis golgaawwan shan iddoo tokkotti walitti qabsiisan; golgaawwan kaan jaʼaan immoo iddoo tokkotti walitti qabsiisan.
english: He coupled five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves.

kikuyu: Ergasiis golgaawwan gama tokkoon walitti qabsiifaman keessaa handaara isa moggaa irratti gurroowwan shantama tolchan; golgaawwan gama kaan irratti walitti qabsiifaman keessaas handaara isa moggaa irratti gurroowwan shantama tolchan.
english: He made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain that was outermost in the coupling, and he made fifty loops on the edge of the curtain which was outermost in the second coupling.

kikuyu: Akka dunkaanni sun tokko taʼuuf ittiin walitti qabsiisuuf qabduuwwan naasii shantama tolchan.
english: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

kikuyu: Dunkaana sanaafis irra buusaa kaldhee korbeessa hoolaa kan halluu diimaa cuuphame, isa irraan immoo irra buusaa gogaa duugamee hojjetan.
english: He made a covering for the tent of rams’ skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

kikuyu: Dunkaana qulqulluu sanaafis muka laaftoo irraa tuggeewwan qaqqajeeloo hojjetan.
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle of acacia wood, standing up.

kikuyu: Dheerinni tokkoo tokkoo tuggeewwan sanaas dhundhuma kudhan, balʼinni isaa immoo dhundhuma tokkoo fi walakkaa ture.
english: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon tuggeewwan sanaas akka wal keessa galuu dandaʼuuf mucha lama lama qaba ture. Tuggeewwan dunkaana qulqulluu sanaa hunda akkasitti tolchan.
english: Each board had two tenons, joined to one another. He made all the boards of the tabernacle this way.

kikuyu: Gama kibba dunkaana qulqulluu sanaatiifis tuggeewwan digdama hojjetan;
english: He made the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards for the south side southward.

kikuyu: tuggeewwan digdamman sana jalatti miilla meetii afurtama jechuunis tuggee tokko jalatti miilla lama gurra isaa lamaaniif, tuggee kaan jalattis miilla lama gurra isaa lamaaniif tolchan.
english: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards: two sockets under one board for its two tenons, and two sockets under another board for its two tenons.

kikuyu: Gama dunkaana qulqulluu sanaa kaaniifis karaa kaabaatiin tuggeewwan digdama tolchan.
english: For the second side of the tabernacle, on the north side, he made twenty boards

kikuyu: Isaaniifis miilla meetiis afurtama jechuunis tuggee tokko jalatti miilla lama, tuggee kaan jalattis miilla lama tolchan.
english: and their forty sockets of silver: two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

kikuyu: Karaa lixa biiftuutiin, dugda duuba dunkaana qulqulluu sanaatiif tuggee jaʼa hojjetan.
english: For the far part of the tabernacle westward he made six boards.

kikuyu: Karaa dugda duubaas golee dunkaana qulqulluu sanaatiif utubaa lama tolchan.
english: He made two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the far part.

kikuyu: Tuggeewwan golee kunneen jalaa hamma gubbaatti walitti fayyifamanii bantii irratti qubeelaa tokkoon walitti qabsiifaman; tuggeewwan golee lamaaniis akkanuma hojjetan.
english: They were double beneath, and in the same way they were all the way to its top to one ring. He did this to both of them in the two corners.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu tuggeewwan saddeeti kanneen miilla meetii kudha jaʼa qabanitu ture; tokkoon tokkoon tuggee sanaas miilla lama lama qaba ture.
english: There were eight boards and their sockets of silver, sixteen sockets—under every board two sockets.

kikuyu: Akkasumas muka laaftoo irraa dagaleewwan tolchan; tuggeewwan dunkaana qulqulluu sana irra gama tokkoon jiraniif dagaleewwan shan,
english: He made bars of acacia wood: five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

kikuyu: tuggeewwan gama kaaniin jiraniif shan, tuggeewwan dugda duubaan karaa lixa biiftuutiin jiraniif immoo dagaleewwan shan tolchan.
english: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle, and five bars for the boards of the tabernacle for the hinder part westward.

kikuyu: Dagalee walakkaa jiru sana akka inni gidduu tuggeewwaniitiin moggaa tokkoo hamma moggaa kaaniitti fullaʼu godhan.
english: He made the middle bar to pass through in the middle of the boards from the one end to the other.

kikuyu: Tuggeewwan sanaattis warqee dibanii akka dagaleewwan baataniif qubeelaawwan warqee itti tolchan. Dagaleewwan sanaattis akkasuma warqee uffisan.
english: He overlaid the boards with gold, and made their rings of gold as places for the bars, and overlaid the bars with gold.

kikuyu: Isaanis kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa haphii irraa golgaa tolchan; golgaa kana irrattis ogeessi harka qajeelu tokko fakkii kiirubeelii tolche.
english: He made the veil of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, with cherubim. He made it the work of a skillful workman.

kikuyu: Golgaa sanaafis utubaawwan muka laaftoo afur tolchanii warqee itti uffisan; utubaa sanaafis hokkoowwan warqee hojjetanii miilla meetii afur itti tolchan.
english: He made four pillars of acacia for it, and overlaid them with gold. Their hooks were of gold. He cast four sockets of silver for them.

kikuyu: Isaanis balbala dunkaanichaatiif golgaa kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼamee harkaan irratti hodhame tokko faayessanii tolchan.
english: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer;

kikuyu: Isaanis utuboota hokkoo qaban shan hojjetanii, fiixee fi somaawwan utubootaatti warqee uffisan; miilla isaanii shananis naasii irraa tolchan.
english: and the five pillars of it with their hooks. He overlaid their capitals and their fillets with gold, and their five sockets were of bronze.

kikuyu: Bezaliʼeel muka laaftoo irraa taabota tolche; taabonni sunis dhundhuma lamaa fi walakkaa dheerata; dhundhuma tokkoo fi walakkaa balʼata; dhundhuma tokkoo fi walakkaa ol dheerata ture.
english: Bezalel made the ark of acacia wood. Its length was two and a half cubits, and its width a cubit and a half, and a cubit and a half its height.

kikuyu: Innis keessaa fi duuba isaatti warqee qulqulluu uffise; naannoo isaattis marsaa faaya warqee naannessee tolche.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold inside and outside, and made a molding of gold for it around it.

kikuyu: Qubeelaa warqee afur tolcheefii miilla isaa afranitti qabsiise; qubeelaa lama gama tokkoon, qubeelaa kaan immoo gama kaaniin itti kaaʼe.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it in its four feet—two rings on its one side, and two rings on its other side.

kikuyu: Ergasiis muka laaftoo irraa danqaraawwan tolchee warqee itti uffise.
english: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with gold.

kikuyu: Innis taabota sana ittiin baachuudhaaf danqaraawwan sana qubeelaawwan keessa loose.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the ark, to bear the ark.

kikuyu: Innis warqee qulqulluu irraa teessoo araaraa tolche; teessoon sunis dheerina dhundhuma lamaa fi walakkaa fi balʼina dhundhuma tokkoo fi walakkaa qaba ture.
english: He made a mercy seat of pure gold. Its length was two and a half cubits, and a cubit and a half its width.

kikuyu: Moggaa lamaan teessoo araaraa irratti warqee tumame irraa Kiirubeelii lama tolche.
english: He made two cherubim of gold. He made them of beaten work, at the two ends of the mercy seat:

kikuyu: Innis Kiirubii tokko moggaa tokko irratti, Kiirubii lammaffaa moggaa kaan irratti tolche; kiirubeelii lamaan sana moggaa teessoo araaraa lamaan irratti teessoo araaraa wajjin mukuma tokko irraa tolche.
english: one cherub at the one end, and one cherub at the other end. He made the cherubim of one piece with the mercy seat at its two ends.

kikuyu: Kiirubeeliin sun qoochoo isaanii ol balʼifatanii teessoo araaraa sanatti gaaddiseessu turan. Kiirubeeliin kunneen fuula isaanii walitti garagalfatanii gara teessoo araaraa ilaalu turan.
english: The cherubim spread out their wings above, covering the mercy seat with their wings, with their faces toward one another. The faces of the cherubim were toward the mercy seat.

kikuyu: Isaanis muka laaftoo irraa minjaala dalga dheerinni isaa dhundhuma lama, balʼinni isaa dhundhuma tokko, ol dheerinni isaa dhundhuma tokkoo fi walakkaa tolchan.
english: He made the table of acacia wood. Its length was two cubits, and its width was a cubit, and its height was a cubit and a half.

kikuyu: Isaanis warqee qulqulluu itti uffisanii naannoo isaatti marsaa warqee tolchan.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold, and made a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Naannoo isaa irrattis hidhii hamma balʼina harkaa gaʼuu fi faaya warqee tolchan.
english: He made a border of a hand’s width around it, and made a golden molding on its border around it.

kikuyu: Isaanis qubeelaa warqee afur minjaala sanaaf hojjetanii iddoo miilli afran turetti goleewwan afranitti qabsiisan.
english: He cast four rings of gold for it, and put the rings in the four corners that were on its four feet.

kikuyu: Qubeelaawwan sunis akka danqaraa minjaalli sun ittiin baatamu qabaniif xiyyoo sanatti dhiʼeeffamanii kaaʼaman.
english: The rings were close by the border, the places for the poles to carry the table.

kikuyu: Danqaraawwan minjaalli ittiin baatamu sun muka laaftoo irraa hojjetamanii warqeen itti uffifamee ture.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold, to carry the table.

kikuyu: Miʼoota minjaala sana irra kaaʼaman jechuunis caabiiwwan isaa, waciitiiwwan isaa, waciitiiwwan isaatii fi okkoteewwan isaa kanneen ittiin dhibaayyuu dhibaafatan warqee qulqulluu irraa tolchan.
english: He made the vessels which were on the table, its dishes, its spoons, its bowls, and its pitchers with which to pour out, of pure gold.

kikuyu: Baattuu ibsaa, somaa isaatii fi damee isaa wajjin warqee qulqulluu irraa tumanii tolchan; waciitii isaa, hudhaa isaatii fi daraaraa isaa illee warqeedhuma tokko irraa tolchan.
english: He made the lamp stand of pure gold. He made the lamp stand of beaten work. Its base, its shaft, its cups, its buds, and its flowers were of one piece with it.

kikuyu: Bitaa mirga baattuu ibsaa sana keessaas dameewwan jaʼa jechuunis sadii gama tokkoon sadii immoo gama kaaniin baafaman.
english: There were six branches going out of its sides: three branches of the lamp stand out of its one side, and three branches of the lamp stand out of its other side:

kikuyu: Xoofoowwan lawuzii fakkaatan kanneen tokkoon tokkoon isaanii hudhaa fi daraaraa qaban sadii damee tokko irratti, waciitiiwwan lawuzii fakkaatan kanneen tokkoon tokkoon isaanii hudhaa fi daraaraa qaban sadii immoo damee kaan irratti tolchan. Dameewwan jaʼaan baattuu ibsaa irraa babbaʼan hunda irrattis akkasuma tolchan.
english: three cups made like almond blossoms in one branch, a bud and a flower, and three cups made like almond blossoms in the other branch, a bud and a flower; so for the six branches going out of the lamp stand.

kikuyu: Xoofoowwan hudhaa fi daraaraa qaban kanneen bifa lawuziitiin tolfaman afur baattuu ibsaa sana irra turan.
english: In the lamp stand were four cups made like almond blossoms, its buds and its flowers;

kikuyu: Hudhaan tokko cimdii jalqabaa kan dameewwan baattuu ibsaa irraa babbaʼan jala, hudhaan lammaffaan cimdii lammaffaa jala, hudhaan sadaffaan immoo cimdii sadaffaa jala ture; walumaa galatti dameewwan jaʼatu ture.
english: and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, and a bud under two branches of one piece with it, for the six branches going out of it.

kikuyu: Hudhaawwanii fi dameewwan hundinuu baattuu ibsaa sana wajjin warqeedhuma qulqulluu tumame tokko irraa tolfaman.
english: Their buds and their branches were of one piece with it. The whole thing was one beaten work of pure gold.

kikuyu: Ibsaa torban sana, waan ittiin daaraa isaa dhadhaʼanii fi baattuu daaraa sana baattu illee warqee qulqulluu irraa tolchan.
english: He made its seven lamps, and its snuffers, and its snuff dishes, of pure gold.

kikuyu: Baattuu ibsaatii fi miʼa isaa hunda warqee qulqulluu taalaantii tokko irraa tolchan.
english: He made it of a talent of pure gold, with all its vessels.

kikuyu: Isaanis muka laaftoo irraa iddoo aarsaa ixaanaa tolchan; iddoon aarsaa kunis dalga dheerina dhundhuma tokko, balʼina dhundhuma tokkoo fi ol dheerina dhundhuma lamaa qabaatee gama afraniinuu wal qixxee ture. Gaanfawwan isaas iddoo aarsaa sanaan walumatti hojjetaman.
english: He made the altar of incense of acacia wood. It was square: its length was a cubit, and its width a cubit. Its height was two cubits. Its horns were of one piece with it.

kikuyu: Isaanis gubbaa isaa irra, cinaacha isaa hundumaa fi gaanfawwan isaatti warqee qulqulluu uffisanii naannoo isaatti marsaa warqee naannessanii tolchan.
english: He overlaid it with pure gold: its top, its sides around it, and its horns. He made a gold molding around it.

kikuyu: Iddoo aarsaa sanaafis marsaawwan warqee isaatii gaditti qubeelaawwan warqee lama tolchan; qubeelaawwan kanas akka isaan danqaraawwan ittiin iddoo aarsaa baatan qabataniif gamaa gamanaan cinaacha lamaanitti tolchan.
english: He made two golden rings for it under its molding crown, on its two ribs, on its two sides, for places for poles with which to carry it.

kikuyu: Isaanis danqaraawwan muka laaftoo tolchanii warqee itti uffisan.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with gold.

kikuyu: Akkasumas akkuma ogeessa urgooftuu qopheessu tokkootti zayitii ittiin diban qulqulluu fi ixaana urgaaʼaa makaa hin qabne tolchan.
english: He made the holy anointing oil and the pure incense of sweet spices, after the art of the perfumer.

kikuyu: Isaanis muka laaftoo irraa iddoo aarsaa qalma gubamuu kan dhundhuma sadii ol dheeratu ijaaran; iddoon aarsaa kunis dheerina dhundhuma shanii fi balʼina dhundhuma shanii qabaatee gama afraniinuu wal qixxee ture.
english: He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five cubits, and its height was three cubits.

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo goleewwan afraniitti gaanfa tolchan; gaanfaa fi iddoo aarsaa sana mukuma tokko irraa tolchan; iddoo aarsaa sana irrattis naasii uffisan.
english: He made its horns on its four corners. Its horns were of one piece with it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

kikuyu: Isaanis miʼa isaa hunda jechuunis waan ittiin daaraa haran, waan ittiin daaraa hammaaran, waciitii, hokkoo fooniitii fi baattuu ibiddaa naasii irraa tolchan.
english: He made all the vessels of the altar: the pots, the shovels, the basins, the forks, and the fire pans. He made all its vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: Iddoo aarsaa sanaafis naasii wal keessa xaxameen gingilchaa hojjetanii akka inni hamma walakkaa iddoo aarsaatti ol baʼee marsaa isaa jalaan jiraatu godhan.
english: He made for the altar a grating of a network of bronze, under the ledge around it beneath, reaching halfway up.

kikuyu: Akka isaan danqaraawwan qabataniifis goleewwan gingilchaa naasii sanaa afraniif qubeelaawwan naasii hojjetan.
english: He cast four rings for the four corners of bronze grating, to be places for the poles.

kikuyu: Danqaraawwan muka laaftoos tolchanii naasii itti uffisan.
english: He made the poles of acacia wood, and overlaid them with bronze.

kikuyu: Iddoo aarsaa sana ittiin baachuufis danqaraawwan sana qubeelaawwan gamaa gamanaan iddoo aarsaa irra jiran keessa galchan. Iddoo aarsaa sanas keessa isaa duwwaa godhanii saanqaa irraa tolchan.
english: He put the poles into the rings on the sides of the altar, with which to carry it. He made it hollow with planks.

kikuyu: Isaanis gabatee itti dhiqatan kan naasii miilla isaa kan naasii irraa hojjetame wajjin of ilaaleewwan dubartoota balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii dura tajaajilanii irraa tolchan.
english: He made the basin of bronze, and its base of bronze, out of the mirrors of the ministering women who ministered at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Kanatti aansanii oobdii tolchan. Oobdichis gama kibbaatiin dhundhuma dhibba tokko dheeratee golgaa quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼame irraa hojjetames qaba ture;
english: He made the court: for the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, one hundred cubits;

kikuyu: utubaawwan digdamaa fi miilla naasii digdama qaba ture; utubaawwan kunneenis hokkoowwanii fi somaawwan meetii irraa hojjetaman qabu ture.
english: their pillars were twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

kikuyu: Gama kaabaatiinis akkasuma dhundhuma dhibba tokko dheeratee utubaawwan digdamaa fi miilla naasii digdama qaba ture; utubaawwan sunis hokkoowwanii fi somaawwan meetii irraa tolfaman qabu turan.
english: For the north side one hundred cubits, their pillars twenty, and their sockets twenty, of bronze; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: Gama lixaatiin dhundhuma shantama balʼatee golgaawwan utubaa kudhanii fi miilla kudhan qaba ture; hokkoowwanii fi somaawwan utuboota sanaas meetii irraa hojjetaman.
english: For the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: Fiixee baʼaatiin, karaa baʼa biiftuutiin dhundhuma shantama balʼata ture.
english: For the east side eastward fifty cubits,

kikuyu: Golgaawwan dhundhuma kudha shan dhedheeratanii utubaa sadii fi miilla sadii qabanis karaa balbala tokkoo irra turan.
english: the hangings for the one side were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three;

kikuyu: Golgaawwan dhundhuma kudha shan dhedheeratanii utubaa sadii fi miilla sadii qabanis balbala oobdii sana irra gama kaaniin turan.
english: and so for the other side: on this hand and that hand by the gate of the court were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

kikuyu: Golgaawwan naannoo oobdii sanaa hundi quncee talbaa kan qaldhifamee foʼame irraa tolfaman.
english: All the hangings around the court were of fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Miillawwan utuboota sanaa naasii irraa tolfaman. Hokkoowwanii fi somaawwan utubootaa immoo meetii irraa tolfamanii fiixee utuboota sanaatti meetii uffisan. Utuboonni oobdii sanaa hundinuus somaawwan meetii qabu turan.
english: The sockets for the pillars were of bronze. The hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver. Their capitals were overlaid with silver. All the pillars of the court had silver bands.

kikuyu: Golgaan balbala oobdii sanaa kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼameen dhaʼamee irratti faayeffamee hojjetame tolfame. Innis dhundhuma digdama dalga dheeratee akkuma oobdichaa dhundhuma shan ol dheerata ture;
english: The screen for the gate of the court was the work of the embroiderer, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen. Twenty cubits was the length, and the height along the width was five cubits, like the hangings of the court.

kikuyu: utubaa afurii fi miilla naasii afuris qaba ture. Hokkoowwanii fi somaawwan isaanii meetii irraa tolfamanii fiixee isaaniitti meetiin uffifamee ture.
english: Their pillars were four, and their sockets four, of bronze; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their capitals, and their fillets, of silver.

kikuyu: Qofoon dunkaana qulqulluutii fi qofoon naannoo oobdii sanaa hundi naasii irraa tolfaman.
english: All the pins of the tabernacle, and around the court, were of bronze.

kikuyu: Baayʼinni miʼa dunkaanni qulqulluun jechuunis dunkaanni dhuga baʼumsaa ittiin hojjetamee kan Lewwonni ajaja Museetiin qajeelfama Iitaamaar ilma Aroon lubichaatiin galmeessan kanaa dha.
english: These are the amounts of materials used for the tabernacle, even the Tabernacle of the Testimony, as they were counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, the son of Aaron the priest.

kikuyu: Bezaliʼeel ilmi Uuri jechuunis ilmi ilma Huur namichi gosa Yihuudaa sun waan Waaqayyo Musee ajaje hunda hojjete.
english: Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Oholiiyaab ilmi Ahiisaamaak namichi gosa Daan sunis isa wajjin ture; innis ogeessa hojii harkaa, ogeessa bifa baasuu fi kan kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼameen waa faayessu ture.
english: With him was Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a skillful workman, and an embroiderer in blue, in purple, in scarlet, and in fine linen.

kikuyu: Baayʼinni warqee aarsaa sochoofamuu kan hojii iddoo qulqulluu sanaa hunda irra oole walumaa galatti akka madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti taalaantii 29 fi saqilii 730 ture.
english: All the gold that was used for the work in all the work of the sanctuary, even the gold of the offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Meetiin namoota waldaa keessaa lakkaaʼaman irraa argames akka madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti taalaantii 100 fi saqilii 1,775 ture.
english: The silver of those who were counted of the congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary:

kikuyu: Namoonni warra duraan lakkaaʼamanii jiranitti dabalaman kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa digdama yookaan hammanaa ol taʼe 603,550 turan. Isaan kunneenis akka madaalii iddoo qulqulluutti matuma mataan beekaa tokko tokko jechuun walakkaa saqilii tokko tokkoo baasan.
english: a beka a head, that is, half a shekel, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, for everyone who passed over to those who were counted, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty men.

kikuyu: Meetii taalaantii 100 sanaan miillawwan iddoo qulqulluutii fi miillawwan golgaatu hojjetame; taalaantii 100 fi miilla 100 hojjetame; miilla tokkoof taalaantii tokkotu barbaachise jechuu dha.
english: The one hundred talents of silver were for casting the sockets of the sanctuary and the sockets of the veil: one hundred sockets for the one hundred talents, one talent per socket.

kikuyu: Isaanis saqilii 1,775 sana hokkoo utubaawwanii tolchuuf, fiixee utubaawwaniitti uffisuu fi somaawwan isaanii tolchuuf itti fayyadaman.
english: From the one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, overlaid their capitals, and made fillets for them.

kikuyu: Naasiin aarsaa sochoofamuus taalaantii 70 fi saqilii 2,400 ture.
english: The bronze of the offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

kikuyu: Isas miilla balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii, iddoo aarsaa kan naasii irraa hojjetame, gingilchaa isaa kan naasii irraa hojjetamee fi miʼa isaa hunda tolchuuf itti fayyadaman;
english: With this he made the sockets to the door of the Tent of Meeting, the bronze altar, the bronze grating for it, all the vessels of the altar,

kikuyu: akkasumas miilli naannoo oobdii, miilli balbala oobdii, qofoowwan dunkaana qulqulluu hundii fi qofoowwan naannoo oobdii hundi naasii irraa hojjetaman.
english: the sockets around the court, the sockets of the gate of the court, all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins around the court.

kikuyu: Isaanis uffata kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee fi bildiimaan dhaʼame kan iddoo qulqulluu keessa tajaajiluuf fayyadu hojjetan. Akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajettis uffata qulqulluu Arooniif hojjetan.
english: Of the blue, purple, and scarlet, they made finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, and made the holy garments for Aaron, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Isaanis warqee fi kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼameen dirata hojjetan.
english: He made the ephod of gold, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Isaanis kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa qalʼaa isaa tolchuuf jedhanii warqee sana ogummaa harkaatiin tumanii akka baalaatti haphisanii foʼaa foʼaatti gargar kukkutan.
english: They beat the gold into thin plates, and cut it into wires, to work it in with the blue, the purple, the scarlet, and the fine linen, the work of the skillful workman.

kikuyu: Isaanis akka inni walitti guduunfamuu dandaʼuuf funyoo gatiittii kan golee isaa lamaanitti hidhamee ture dirata sanaaf tolchan.
english: They made shoulder straps for it, joined together. It was joined together at the two ends.

kikuyu: Sabbanni isaa kan ogummaadhaan dhaʼames akkuma isaa dirata wajjin tokko taʼee warqeedhaan, kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼameen akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti hojjetame.
english: The skillfully woven band that was on it, with which to fasten it on, was of the same piece, like its work: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Isaanis dhagaawwan sardooniksii qopheessanii marsaa faaya warqee naannoo isaatti tolchan; maqaa ilmaan Israaʼelis akka chaappaatti isaan irratti soofan.
english: They worked the onyx stones, enclosed in settings of gold, engraved with the engravings of a signet, according to the names of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ergasiis akka ilmaan Israaʼeliif dhagaa yaadannoo taʼuuf akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti dhagaawwan sana funyoo gatiittii dirata sanatti qabsiisan.
english: He put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, to be stones of memorial for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Isaanis akkuma dirata sanaatti warqeedhaan, kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼameen ogummaadhaan kiisii qomaa tolchan.
english: He made the breastplate, the work of a skillful workman, like the work of the ephod: of gold, of blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twined linen.

kikuyu: Kiisiin qomaa kun gama afraniinuu wal qixxee ture; innis walitti dachaa taʼee dheerina taakkuu tokkoo fi balʼina taakkuu tokkoo qaba ture.
english: It was square. They made the breastplate double. Its length was a span, and its width a span, being double.

kikuyu: Dhagaawwan gati jabeeyyiis toora afuriin irratti maxxansan. Toora jalqabaa irratti sardiyoon, tophaaziyoonii fi biiralee,
english: They set in it four rows of stones. A row of ruby, topaz, and beryl was the first row;

kikuyu: toora lammaffaa irratti baluur, sanpeerii fi almaaz,
english: and the second row, a turquoise, a sapphire, and an emerald;

kikuyu: toora sadaffaa irratti yaakinti, kelqedoonii fi yaakinti,
english: and the third row, a jacinth, an agate, and an amethyst;

kikuyu: toora afuraffaa irratti biiralee, sardooniksii fi yaasphiidi maxxansan. Dhagaawwan kanneenittis marsaa faaya warqee tolchan.
english: and the fourth row, a chrysolite, an onyx, and a jasper. They were enclosed in gold settings.

kikuyu: Dhagaawwan kudha lama kanneen tokkoo tokkoo isaanii irratti maqaa gosoota kudha lama keessaa maqaan tokko akkuma chaappaatti soofame ni turan; tokkoon tokkoon dhagaawwan sanaas maqaa ilmaan Israaʼel tokko tokkoof dhaabate.
english: The stones were according to the names of the children of Israel, twelve, according to their names; like the engravings of a signet, everyone according to his name, for the twelve tribes.

kikuyu: Kiisii qomaatiifis foncaa warqee qulqulluu akka funyootti foʼanii tolchan.
english: They made on the breastplate chains like cords, of braided work of pure gold.

kikuyu: Isaanis marsaa faaya warqee lamaa fi qubeelaa warqee lama tolchanii qubeelaawwan sana rogawwan kiisii qomaa keessaa lamatti guduunfan.
english: They made two settings of gold, and two gold rings, and put the two rings on the two ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: Foncaa warqee sana lamaanis qubeelaawwan rogawwan kiisii qomaa sanatti guduunfan.
english: They put the two braided chains of gold in the two rings at the ends of the breastplate.

kikuyu: Mataa lamaan foncaa lamaan sanaa kaan immoo marsaawwan faayaa lamaanitti guduunfanii karaa fuula duraatiin foncaa dirataa kan gatiittiitti qabsiisan.
english: The other two ends of the two braided chains they put on the two settings, and put them on the shoulder straps of the ephod, in its front.

kikuyu: Qubeelaawwan warqee lama tolchanii rogawwan kiisii qomaa biraa kanneen karaa moggaa keessaatiin diratatti aananii jiran lamaanitti qabsiisan.
english: They made two rings of gold, and put them on the two ends of the breastplate, on its edge, which was toward the side of the ephod inward.

kikuyu: Ergasiis qubeelaawwan warqee lama biraa tolchanii sabbata mudhiitii olitti garjalee funyoo gatiittii lamaan, fuula dirataa duraan jiru sanaatti qabsiisan.
english: They made two more rings of gold, and put them on the two shoulder straps of the ephod underneath, in its front, close by its coupling, above the skillfully woven band of the ephod.

kikuyu: Isaanis akka kiisiin qomaa dirata irraa hin sosochooneef qubeelaawwan kiisii qomaa sana sabbata mudhiitiin walitti qabsiisanii akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti funyoo bifa cuquliisaatiin qubeelaawwan diratatti qabsiisan.
english: They bound the breastplate by its rings to the rings of the ephod with a lace of blue, that it might be on the skillfully woven band of the ephod, and that the breastplate might not come loose from the ephod, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Isaanis huccuu guutumaan guutuutti bifti isaa cuquliisa taʼe irraa wandaboo dirataa tolchan;
english: He made the robe of the ephod of woven work, all of blue.

kikuyu: walakkaa gubbaa wandaboo sanaattis afaan ittiin mataa seensifatan tolchan; akka inni hin tarsaaneefis qarqara afaan isaa irra waa naannessanii hodhan.
english: The opening of the robe in the middle of it was like the opening of a coat of mail, with a binding around its opening, that it should not be torn.

kikuyu: Isaanis xiyyoo wandaboo sanaatti kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee, bildiimaa fi quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼameen roomaanii hojjetan.
english: They made on the skirts of the robe pomegranates of blue, purple, scarlet, and twined linen.

kikuyu: Warqee qulqulluu irraas bilbila hojjetanii roomaanota gidduudhaan naannoo xiyyoo wandabootti qabsiisan.
english: They made bells of pure gold, and put the bells between the pomegranates around the skirts of the robe, between the pomegranates;

kikuyu: Bilbillii fi roomaaniin sun akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti tokko tokkoon wal keessa makamanii naannoo xiyyoo wandaboo tajaajilaaf uffatamu sanaatti qabsiifaman.
english: a bell and a pomegranate, a bell and a pomegranate, around the skirts of the robe, to minister in, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Aroonii fi ilmaan isaatiif immoo kittaa quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼameen dhoofsisanii hojjetan;
english: They made the tunics of fine linen of woven work for Aaron and for his sons,

kikuyu: akkasumas quncee talbaa qalʼaa isaatiin marata mataa, quncee talbaatiin gonfoo, quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼameen immoo uffata wayyaa jalaa hojjetaniif.
english: the turban of fine linen, the linen headbands of fine linen, the linen trousers of fine twined linen,

kikuyu: Sabbannis quncee talbaa kan qalʼifamee foʼamee fi kirrii bifa cuquliisaa, dhiilgee fi bildiimaan faayeffame akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti hojjetame.
english: the sash of fine twined linen, blue, purple, and scarlet, the work of the embroiderer, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Isaanis warqee qulqulluu irraa faaya gonfoo qulqulluu tolchanii akkuma waan chaappaa irratti qirixamuutti: Kan Waaqayyoof Qulqulleeffame, jedhanii irratti barreessan.
english: They made the plate of the holy crown of pure gold, and wrote on it an inscription, like the engravings of a signet: “HOLY TO THE LORD”.

kikuyu: Ergasiis faaya sana marata mataatiin wal qabsiisuuf jedhanii akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti funyoo bifa cuquliisaa itti hidhan.
english: They tied to it a lace of blue, to fasten it on the turban above, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Akkasiin hojiin dunkaana qulqulluu kan dunkaana wal gaʼii hundi xumurame. Israaʼeloonnis akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti waan hunda hojjetan.
english: Thus all the work of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting was finished. The children of Israel did according to all that the LORD commanded Moses; so they did.

kikuyu: Isaanis dunkaana qulqulluu sana Museetti fidan: dunkaanaa fi miʼa isaa hunda, hokkoowwan isaa, tuggeewwan isaa, dagaleewwan isaa, utuboota isaatii fi miillawwan isaa;
english: They brought the tabernacle to Moses: the tent, with all its furniture, its clasps, its boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

kikuyu: irra buusa kalʼee korbeessa hoolaa kan halluu diimaa cuuphame, irra buusa gogaa duugameetii fi golgaa daʼeessu;
english: the covering of rams’ skins dyed red, the covering of sea cow hides, the veil of the screen,

kikuyu: taabota kakuu seeraa, danqaraa isaatii fi teessoo araaraa wajjin;
english: the ark of the covenant with its poles, the mercy seat,

kikuyu: minjaala miʼa isaa hundaa fi buddeena ilaalchaa wajjin;
english: the table, all its vessels, the show bread,

kikuyu: baattuu ibsaa kan warqee qulqulluu irraa hojjetame, ibsaawwan tarree galanii fi miʼa isaa hunda wajjin, zayitii ibsaa;
english: the pure lamp stand, its lamps, even the lamps to be set in order, all its vessels, the oil for the light,

kikuyu: iddoo aarsaa kan warqee irraa hojjetame, zayitii ittiin diban, ixaana urgaaʼu, golgaa balbala dunkaanaa;
english: the golden altar, the anointing oil, the sweet incense, the screen for the door of the Tent,

kikuyu: iddoo aarsaa kan naasii irraa hojjetame, gingilchaa isaa kan naasii irraa hojjetame wajjin, danqaraawwan isaatii fi miʼa isaa hunda, caabii miilla isaa wajjin;
english: the bronze altar, its grating of bronze, its poles, all of its vessels, the basin and its base,

kikuyu: golgaawwan oobdii utubaawwanii fi miillawwan isaanii wajjin, golgaa karra oobdii sanaa, funyoowwanii fi qofoowwan oobdii, miʼa dunkaana qulqulluu kan dunkaana wal gaʼii hunda;
english: the hangings of the court, its pillars, its sockets, the screen for the gate of the court, its cords, its pins, and all the instruments of the service of the tabernacle, for the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: wayyaawwan foʼamanii dhaʼaman kanneen yeroo iddoo qulqulluu keessa tajaajilan uffataman, jechuunis wayyaawwan Aroon lubichaaf qulqulleeffamanii fi wayyaawwan ilmaan isaa yeroo lubummaadhaan tajaajilanitti uffatan feʼa.
english: the finely worked garments for ministering in the holy place, the holy garments for Aaron the priest, and the garments of his sons, to minister in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonnis akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti hojii hunda hojjetan.
english: According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.

kikuyu: Museenis hojii sana toʼatee akkuma Waaqayyo ajajetti hojjechuu isaanii arge. Museenis isaan eebbise.
english: Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as the LORD had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Guyyaa jalqaba jiʼa jalqabaatti dunkaana qulqulluu jechuunis dunkaana wal gaʼii dhaabi.
english: “On the first day of the first month you shall raise up the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Taabota kakuu seeraa isa keessa kaaʼiitii taaboticha golgaadhaan daʼeessi.
english: You shall put the ark of the covenant in it, and you shall screen the ark with the veil.

kikuyu: Minjaala ol galchiitii miʼa isaa tottolchi. Ergasiis baattuu ibsaa ol galchiitii ibsaa isaa irra dhaabi.
english: You shall bring in the table, and set in order the things that are on it. You shall bring in the lamp stand, and light its lamps.

kikuyu: Iddoo aarsaa ixaanaa kan warqee irraa hojjetame fuula taabota kakuu seeraa dura dhaabiitii balbala dunkaana qulqulluutti immoo golgaa fannisi.
english: You shall set the golden altar for incense before the ark of the covenant, and put the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

kikuyu: “Iddoo aarsaa qalma gubamuu sanas fuula balbala dunkaana qulqulluu jechuunis dunkaana wal gaʼii dura dhaabi;
english: “You shall set the altar of burnt offering before the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: gabatee itti dhiqatanis dunkaana wal gaʼiitii fi iddoo aarsaa gidduu dhaabiitii bishaan itti naqi.
english: You shall set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and shall put water therein.

kikuyu: Naannoo isaattis oobdii hojjedhuutii balbala isaatti golgaa kaaʼi.
english: You shall set up the court around it, and hang up the screen of the gate of the court.

kikuyu: “Zayitii ittiin diban fuudhiitii dunkaana qulqulluu fi waan isa keessa jiru hunda dibi; dunkaanichaa fi miʼa isaa hunda qulqulleessi; innis ni qulqullaaʼa.
english: “You shall take the anointing oil, and anoint the tabernacle and all that is in it, and shall make it holy, and all its furniture, and it will be holy.

kikuyu: Ergasiis iddoo aarsaa qalma gubamuutii fi miʼa isaa hunda dibi; iddoo aarsaa sana qulqulleessi; innis waan hunda caalaa qulqullaaʼaa taʼa.
english: You shall anoint the altar of burnt offering, with all its vessels, and sanctify the altar, and the altar will be most holy.

kikuyu: Gabatee itti dhiqatanii fi miilla isaa dibiitii isaan qulqulleessi.
english: You shall anoint the basin and its base, and sanctify it.

kikuyu: “Aroonii fi ilmaan isaa gara balbala dunkaana wal gaʼiitti fidiitii bishaaniin isaan dhiqi.
english: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.

kikuyu: Ergasii Aroonitti wayyaa qulqulluu uffisi; akka inni lubummaadhaan na tajaajiluufis dibiitii isa qulqulleessi.
english: You shall put on Aaron the holy garments; and you shall anoint him, and sanctify him, that he may minister to me in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Ilmaan isaas fidiitii kittaa itti uffisi.
english: You shall bring his sons, and put tunics on them.

kikuyu: Akka isaan lubummaadhaan na tajaajilaniifis akkuma abbaa isaanii dibde sanatti isaan dibi; dibamuun isaanii kunis dhaloota dhufu hunda keessatti lubummaa itti fufu taʼa.”
english: You shall anoint them, as you anointed their father, that they may minister to me in the priest’s office. Their anointing shall be to them for an everlasting priesthood throughout their generations.”

kikuyu: Museenis akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajajetti waan hunda hojjete.
english: Moses did so. According to all that the LORD commanded him, so he did.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu dunkaanni qulqulluun sun waggaa lamaffaa keessa guyyaa jalqabaa kan jiʼa jalqabaatti dhaabame.
english: In the first month in the second year, on the first day of the month, the tabernacle was raised up.

kikuyu: Museen yeroo dunkaana qulqulluu sana dhaabetti miillawwan dunkaanichaa itti kaaʼe; tuggeewwan isaa dhadhaabe; dagaleewwan isaa loose; utuboota isaa dhadhaabe.
english: Moses raised up the tabernacle, and laid its sockets, and set up its boards, and put in its bars, and raised up its pillars.

kikuyu: Innis akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajajetti dunkaana qulqulluu irraan dunkaana diriirsee dunkaana sanatti immoo irra buusa uffise.
english: He spread the covering over the tent, and put the roof of the tabernacle above on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Dhuga baʼumsa sana fuudhee taabota keessa kaaʼe; danqaraawwanis taabotatti hidhe; teessoo araaraa immoo taabota gubbaa kaaʼe.
english: He took and put the covenant into the ark, and set the poles on the ark, and put the mercy seat above on the ark.

kikuyu: Museen akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajajetti taabota sana dunkaana qulqulluutti ol galchee golgaa daʼeessu fanniseef; taabota kakuu seeraa sanas daʼeesse.
english: He brought the ark into the tabernacle, and set up the veil of the screen, and screened the ark of the covenant, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Museenis minjaala sana gama kaaba dunkaana qulqulluutiin dunkaana wal gaʼii keessa golgaa sanaan ala kaaʼe.
english: He put the table in the Tent of Meeting, on the north side of the tabernacle, outside of the veil.

kikuyu: Akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajajettis fuula Waaqayyoo duratti buddeena achi irra kaaʼe.
english: He set the bread in order on it before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Baattuu ibsaa immoo gama kibbaa dunkaana qulqulluutiin dunkaana wal gaʼii keessa fuullee minjaalaatiin kaaʼe.
english: He put the lamp stand in the Tent of Meeting, opposite the table, on the south side of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajajettis ibsaawwan sana fuula Waaqayyoo dura dhadhaabe.
english: He lit the lamps before the LORD, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Museenis iddoo aarsaa kan warqee irraa hojjetame sana fuula golgaa duraan dunkaana wal gaʼii keessa dhaabe.
english: He put the golden altar in the Tent of Meeting before the veil;

kikuyu: Akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajajettis ixaana urgaaʼaa isa irratti aarse.
english: and he burned incense of sweet spices on it, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Balbala dunkaana qulqulluu irrattis golgaa fannise.
english: He put up the screen of the door to the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Inni akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajajetti iddoo aarsaa qalma gubamuu sana balbala dunkaana qulqulluu kan dunkaana wal gaʼii bira dhaabee qalma gubamuu fi kennaa midhaanii isa irratti dhiʼeesse.
english: He set the altar of burnt offering at the door of the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting, and offered on it the burnt offering and the meal offering, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Gabatee sanas dunkaana wal gaʼiitii fi iddoo aarsaa gidduu kaaʼee bishaan dhiqataa itti naqe;
english: He set the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water therein, with which to wash.

kikuyu: Museen, Aroonii fi ilmaan Arooniis harka isaaniitii fi miilla isaanii dhiqachuuf itti fayyadamu turan.
english: Moses, Aaron, and his sons washed their hands and their feet there.

kikuyu: Isaanis akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti yeroo dunkaana wal gaʼii seenan yookaan yeroo iddoo aarsaatti dhiʼaatan hunda ni dhiqatu turan.
english: When they went into the Tent of Meeting, and when they came near to the altar, they washed, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Museenis naannoo dunkaana qulqulluutii fi iddoo aarsaatti oobdii hojjetee balbala waltajjichaa irra golgaa dhaabe; akkasiin Museen hojii sana hojjetee fixe.
english: He raised up the court around the tabernacle and the altar, and set up the screen of the gate of the court. So Moses finished the work.

kikuyu: Ergasiis duumessi dunkaana wal gaʼii haguuge; ulfinni Waaqayyoos dunkaana qulqulluu sana guute.
english: Then the cloud covered the Tent of Meeting, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Museenis sababii duumessi sun dunkaana wal gaʼii irra buʼee fi sababii ulfinni Waaqayyoo dunkaana qulqulluu guuteef dunkaana wal gaʼii seenuu hin dandeenye.
english: Moses wasn’t able to enter into the Tent of Meeting, because the cloud stayed on it, and the LORD’s glory filled the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni karaa isaanii hunda keessatti yommuu duumessi dunkaana qulqulluu irraa kaʼu hunda kaʼanii deemsa isaanii itti fufu turan.
english: When the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle, the children of Israel went onward, throughout all their journeys;

kikuyu: Yoo duumessi irraa kaʼuu baate garuu hamma gaafa duumessi sun irraa kaʼuutti hin deeman ture.
english: but if the cloud wasn’t taken up, then they didn’t travel until the day that it was taken up.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu karaa isaanii hunda keessatti fuula saba Israaʼel hundaa duratti guyyaa guyyaa duumessi Waaqayyoo dunkaana qulqulluu irra ture; halkan halkan immoo ibiddi duumessa sana keessa ture.
english: For the cloud of the LORD was on the tabernacle by day, and there was fire in the cloud by night, in the sight of all the house of Israel, throughout all their journeys.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Musee waamee dunkaana wal gaʼii keessaa akkana jedhee itti dubbate;
english: The LORD called to Moses, and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

kikuyu: “Israaʼelootatti dubbadhu; akkanas jedhiin: ‘Isin keessaa namni kam iyyuu yommuu horii keessaa Waaqayyoof kennaa dhiʼeessutti karra loonii yookaan bushaayee keessaa haa dhiʼeessu.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When anyone of you offers an offering to the LORD, you shall offer your offering of the livestock, from the herd and from the flock.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo kennaan sun qalma gubamu kan karra loonii taʼe, namichi sun korma hirʼina hin qabne haa dhiʼeessu. Akka aarsaan sun fuula Waaqayyoo duratti fudhatama argatuufis balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti haa dhiʼeessu.
english: “‘If his offering is a burnt offering from the herd, he shall offer a male without defect. He shall offer it at the door of the Tent of Meeting, that he may be accepted before the LORD.

kikuyu: Namichis mataa horii aarsaa gubamuuf dhiʼeeffamu sanaa irra harka isaa haa kaaʼu; kunis araara isaaf buusuuf qooda isaa fudhatama argata.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the burnt offering, and it shall be accepted for him to make atonement for him.

kikuyu: Innis fuula Waaqayyoo duratti korma haa qalu; ilmaan Aroon luboonni dhiiga sana fuudhanii iddoo aarsaa kan balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii dura jirutti gama hundaan haa facaasan.
english: He shall kill the bull before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall present the blood and sprinkle the blood around on the altar that is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Innis aarsaa gubamu sana irraa gogaa baasee kutaa kutaatti murmura.
english: He shall skin the burnt offering and cut it into pieces.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Aroon lubichaa immoo iddoo aarsaa irratti ibidda qabsiisanii qoraan irra haa naqan.
english: The sons of Aaron the priest shall put fire on the altar, and lay wood in order on the fire;

kikuyu: Ergasiis ilmaan Aroon luboonni kutaa murmurame, mataa fi cooma isaas qoraan iddoo aarsaa irratti bobaʼu irra tarree haa naqan.
english: and Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall lay the pieces, the head, and the fat in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;

kikuyu: Innis miʼa garaatii fi miilla qalma sanaa bishaaniin haa dhiqu; lubichis hunda isaa iddoo aarsaa irratti haa gubu. Kunis aarsaa gubamu kan ibiddaan dhiʼaatuu fi kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti toluu dha.
english: but he shall wash its innards and its legs with water. The priest shall burn all of it on the altar, for a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo aarsaan sun qalma gubamu kan bushaayee jechuunis hoolaa yookaan reʼee taʼe namichi dhiʼeessu sun korma hirʼina hin qabne haa dhiʼeessu.
english: “‘If his offering is from the flock, from the sheep or from the goats, for a burnt offering, he shall offer a male without defect.

kikuyu: Innis gama kaaba iddoo aarsaatiin fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa qalu; ilmaan Aroon luboonni immoo gama hundaan dhiiga isaa iddoo aarsaatti haa facaasan.
english: He shall kill it on the north side of the altar before the LORD. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Namichi sunis kutaa kutaatti haa murmuru; lubichi immoo mataa fi cooma isaa qoraan iddoo aarsaa irratti bobaʼaa jiru irra tarree haa naqu.
english: He shall cut it into its pieces, with its head and its fat. The priest shall lay them in order on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar,

kikuyu: Innis miʼa garaatii fi miilla qalma sanaa bishaaniin haa dhiqu; lubichi immoo hunda isaa fidee iddoo aarsaa irratti haa gubu. Kunis aarsaa gubamu kan ibiddaan dhiʼaatuu fi kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti toluu dha.
english: but the innards and the legs he shall wash with water. The priest shall offer the whole, and burn it on the altar. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo aarsaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼaatu sun qalma gubamu kan simbirrootaa taʼe namichi sun gugee yookaan gugee sookkee haa dhiʼeessu.
english: “‘If his offering to the LORD is a burnt offering of birds, then he shall offer his offering from turtledoves or of young pigeons.

kikuyu: Lubichi sun gara iddoo aarsaatti haa fidu; mataa isaas micciiree irraa haa kutu; ergasii immoo iddoo aarsaa irratti haa gubu; dhiigni isaa immoo iddoo aarsaa cinatti haa coccobu.
english: The priest shall bring it to the altar, and wring off its head, and burn it on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out on the side of the altar;

kikuyu: Miʼa garaa isaa baallee isaa wajjin baasee karaa baʼa biiftuutiin iddoo aarsaa cinatti lafa daaraan jirutti haa gatu.
english: and he shall take away its crop and its feathers, and cast it beside the altar on the east part, in the place of the ashes.

kikuyu: Karaa qoochoo isaatiin haa baqaqsu; garuu guutumaan guutuutti gargar hin baasin; ergasii lubichi iddoo aarsaa irratti qoraan bobaʼaa jiru irratti haa gubu. Kunis aarsaa gubamu kan ibiddaan dhiʼaatuu fi kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti toluu dha.
english: He shall tear it by its wings, but shall not divide it apart. The priest shall burn it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Namni tokko yommuu kennaa midhaanii Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessutti, kennaan isaa daakuu bullaaʼaa haa taʼu. Innis zayitii itti haa naqu; ixaanas itti dabalee,
english: “‘When anyone offers an offering of a meal offering to the LORD, his offering shall be of fine flour. He shall pour oil on it, and put frankincense on it.

kikuyu: ilmaan Aroon luboota sanatti haa fidu. Lubichis daakuu bullaaʼaa zayitiin itti naqame sana irraa konyee tokko ixaana hunda wajjin haa fuudhu; kanas kutaa yaadannoo aarsaa gubamu kan ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamu kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti toluu godhee iddoo aarsaa irratti haa gubu.
english: He shall bring it to Aaron’s sons, the priests. He shall take his handful of its fine flour, and of its oil, with all its frankincense, and the priest shall burn its memorial on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kennaan midhaanii hafe immoo kan Aroonii fi ilmaan isaa ti; kunis kutaa aarsaawwan hunda caalaa qulqulluu kan ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamuu dha.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yeroo ati kennaa midhaanii barbadaa ibiddaa irratti tolfamee dhiʼeessitutti, kennaan sun daakuu bullaaʼaa jechuunis maxinoo zayitiin itti makame yookaan bixxillee raacitii malee tolfamee zayitiin irra dibame haa taʼu.
english: “‘When you offer an offering of a meal offering baked in the oven, it shall be unleavened cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, or unleavened wafers anointed with oil.

kikuyu: Kennaan kee kennaa midhaanii kan eelee irratti qopheeffame taanaan kennaan sun daakuu bullaaʼaa hin bukaaʼin kan zayitiin itti makame irraa haa taʼu.
english: If your offering is a meal offering made on a griddle, it shall be of unleavened fine flour, mixed with oil.

kikuyu: Isa caccabsiitii gubbaa isaatti zayitii naqi; inni kennaa midhaanii ti.
english: You shall cut it in pieces, and pour oil on it. It is a meal offering.

kikuyu: Kennaan midhaan keetii yoo eelee irratti qopheeffame, kennaan sun daakuu bullaaʼaa fi zayitii irraa haa qopheeffamu.
english: If your offering is a meal offering of the pan, it shall be made of fine flour with oil.

kikuyu: Kennaa midhaanii kan wantoota kanneen irraa qopheeffame Waaqayyoof fidi; kanas luba iddoo aarsaatti geessutti kenni.
english: You shall bring the meal offering that is made of these things to the LORD. It shall be presented to the priest, and he shall bring it to the altar.

kikuyu: Innis Kennaa midhaanii sana irraa kutaa yaadannoo fuudhee kennaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamu kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti tolu godhee iddoo aarsaa irratti haa gubu.
english: The priest shall take from the meal offering its memorial, and shall burn it on the altar, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kennaan midhaanii hafe immoo kan Aroonii fi ilmaan isaa ti; kunis kutaa aarsaawwan hunda caalaa qulqulluu kan ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamuu dha.
english: That which is left of the meal offering shall be Aaron’s and his sons’. It is a most holy part of the offerings of the LORD made by fire.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kennaan midhaanii kan isin Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessitan hundinuu utuu raacitiin itti hin makamin qopheeffamuu qaba; isin kennaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu tokko keessatti raacitii yookaan damma tokko illee gubuu hin qabdaniitii.
english: “‘No meal offering which you shall offer to the LORD shall be made with yeast; for you shall burn no yeast, nor any honey, as an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kennaa kanas akka mataa midhaaniitti Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessu dandeessu; garuu akka kennaa urgaaʼaa tokkootti iddoo aarsaa irratti dhiʼaachuu hin qabu.
english: As an offering of first fruits you shall offer them to the LORD, but they shall not rise up as a pleasant aroma on the altar.

kikuyu: Kennaa midhaan keetii hunda soogiddaan miʼeessi; soogidda kakuu Waaqa keetii kennaa midhaan keetii keessaa hin hambisin; kennaa kee hundatti soogidda dabali.
english: Every offering of your meal offering you shall season with salt. You shall not allow the salt of the covenant of your God to be lacking from your meal offering. With all your offerings you shall offer salt.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ati yoo mataa midhaanii keessaa kennaa midhaanii Waaqayyoof fidde, mataa midhaan asheetee ibiddaan waadamee sukkuumamee dhiʼeessi.
english: “‘If you offer a meal offering of first fruits to the LORD, you shall offer for the meal offering of your first fruits fresh heads of grain parched with fire and crushed.

kikuyu: Zayitii itti naqiitii ixaanas itti dabali; kun kennaa midhaanii ti.
english: You shall put oil on it and lay frankincense on it. It is a meal offering.

kikuyu: Lubni sunis kutaa yaadannoo midhaan sukkuumamee sanaatii fi zayitii sana ixaana hunda wajjin kennaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu godhee haa gubu.
english: The priest shall burn as its memorial part of its crushed grain and part of its oil, along with all its frankincense. It is an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kennaan nama tokkoo yoo aarsaa nagaa taʼe, namichi sunis karra loonii keessaa horii tokko, korma yookaan dhalaa yoo dhiʼeesse, inni horii hirʼina hin qabne fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa dhiʼeessu.
english: “‘If his offering is a sacrifice of peace offerings, if he offers it from the herd, whether male or female, he shall offer it without defect before the LORD.

kikuyu: Namichi sun mataa kennaa isaa irra harka isaa haa kaaʼu; balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii durattis haa qalu. Ergasii immoo ilmaan Aroon luboonni sun dhiiga horii sana iddoo aarsaa sanatti gama hundaan haa facaasan.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it at the door of the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons, the priests, shall sprinkle the blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Innis aarsaa nagaa irraa aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu haa fidu; kunis moora miʼa garaa haguuguu fi kan itti maxxanu hunda,
english: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD. The fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

kikuyu: kalee lamaanii fi moora isaan irra jiru kan mudhiitti dhiʼaatu, haguuggii tiruu kan namichi kaleedhaan walitti qabee baasu faʼa.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

kikuyu: Ergasiis ilmaan Aroon waan kana aarsaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamu kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti tolu godhanii iddoo aarsaa irratti aarsaa gubamu kan qoraan bobaʼu irra jiru irratti haa guban.
english: Aaron’s sons shall burn it on the altar on the burnt offering, which is on the wood that is on the fire: it is an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Inni yoo bushaayee keessaa horii tokko akka aarsaa nagaatti Waaqayyoof dhiʼeesse, korma yookaan dhalaa hirʼina hin qabne haa dhiʼeessu.
english: “‘If his offering for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD is from the flock, either male or female, he shall offer it without defect.

kikuyu: Inni yoo xobbaallaa hoolaa dhiʼeesse, fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa dhiʼeessu.
english: If he offers a lamb for his offering, then he shall offer it before the LORD;

kikuyu: Namichi sunis mataa kennaa isaa irra harka isaa kaaʼee balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti haa qalu. Ergasii immoo ilmaan Aroon dhiiga horii sanaa iddoo aarsaa irratti gama hundaan haa facaasan.
english: and he shall lay his hand on the head of his offering, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting. Aaron’s sons shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Innis aarsaa nagaa sana irraa qalma ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu haa fidu; kunis cooma isaa, duboo isaa kan lafee dugdaatti dhiʼeeffamee kutame hunda, moora miʼa garaa haguuguu fi kan itti maxxanu hunda,
english: He shall offer from the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to the LORD; its fat, the entire tail fat, he shall take away close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the entrails, and all the fat that is on the entrails,

kikuyu: kalee lamaanii fi moora isaan irra jiru kan mudhiitti dhiʼaatu, haguuggii tiruu kan namichi kaleedhaan walitti qabee baasu faʼi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

kikuyu: Lubni sunis waan kana nyaata godhee iddoo aarsaa irratti haa gubu; nyaanni kunis aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamuu dha.
english: The priest shall burn it on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo kennaan isaa reʼee taʼe, inni fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa dhiʼeessu.
english: “‘If his offering is a goat, then he shall offer it before the LORD.

kikuyu: Namichi sun mataa reʼee sanaa irra harka isaa kaaʼee fuula dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti haa qalu. Ergasii immoo ilmaan Aroon dhiiga horii sanaa iddoo aarsaa irratti gama hundaan haa facaasan.
english: He shall lay his hand on its head, and kill it before the Tent of Meeting; and the sons of Aaron shall sprinkle its blood around on the altar.

kikuyu: Innis waan dhiʼeessu keessaa kennaa kana kennaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu godhee haa dhiʼeessu; kunis moora miʼa garaa haguuguu fi kan itti maxxanu hunda,
english: He shall offer from it as his offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

kikuyu: kalee lamaanii fi moora isaan irra jiru kan mudhiitti dhiʼaatu, haguuggii tiruu kan namichi kaleedhaan walitti qabee baasu faʼi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away.

kikuyu: Lubni sunis waan kana nyaata godhee iddoo aarsaa irratti haa gubu; kunis aarsaa urgaaʼaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamuu dha. Coomni hundinuu kan Waaqayyoo ti.
english: The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat is the LORD’s.

kikuyu: “ ‘Isin cooma tokko illee yookaan dhiiga tokko illee hin sooratinaa; wanni kun lafa isin jiraattan hundatti dhaloota dhufuuf jiru keessatti seera hin geeddaramnee dha.’ ”
english: “‘It shall be a perpetual statute throughout your generations in all your dwellings, that you shall eat neither fat nor blood.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akkana jedhee Museetti dubbate;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Israaʼelootaan akkana jedhi; ‘Yoo namni utuu hin beekin waan Waaqayyo dhowwe cabsuudhaan cubbuu hojjete.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and does any one of them,

kikuyu: “ ‘Lubichi dibame yoo cubbuu hojjetee akkasiin sabatti cubbuu fide, inni cubbuu hojjete sanaaf dibicha hirʼina hin qabne tokko aarsaa cubbuu godhee Waaqayyoof haa dhiʼeessu.
english: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin which he has sinned a young bull without defect to the LORD for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Innis dibicha sana balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii irratti fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa dhiʼeessu. Mataa dibicha sanaa irras harka isaa kaaʼee fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa qalu.
english: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before the LORD; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull, and kill the bull before the LORD.

kikuyu: Lubni dibame sun dhiiga dibicha sanaa irraa fuudhee dunkaana wal gaʼiitti qabatee haa seenu.
english: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Lubni sunis quba isaa dhiiga keessa cuphee dhiiga sana irraa golgaa iddoo qulqulluu duratti yeroo torba fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa facaasu.
english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the LORD, before the veil of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Ergasiis lubni sun dhiiga sana irraa gaanfawwan iddoo aarsaa ixaana urgaaʼu kan dunkaana wal gaʼii keessa fuula Waaqayyoo dura jiru sana irratti haa naqu. Dhiiga dibicha sanaa kan hafe hunda immoo balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii irratti miilla iddoo aarsaa gubamuu jalatti haa dhangalaasu.
english: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before the LORD, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out the rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Innis dibicha aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeeffame sana irraa cooma hunda haa baasu; kunis moora miʼa garaa haguuguu fi kan itti maxxanu hunda,
english: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering from it: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

kikuyu: kalee lamaanii fi moora isaan irra jiru kan mudhiitti dhiʼaatu, haguuggii tiruu kan inni kaleedhaan walitti qabee baasu faʼi;
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall remove,

kikuyu: waan kanas akkuma loon aarsaa nagaatiif dhiʼeeffamu irraa moorri baafamu sanatti haa baasu. Lubnis iddoo aarsaa kan aarsaa gubamuu irratti haa gubu.
english: as it is removed from the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

kikuyu: Garuu gogaa dibicha sanaatii fi foon isaa hunda, mataa fi miilla isaa, miʼa garaatii fi cumaa isaa,
english: He shall carry the bull’s skin, all its meat, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung

kikuyu: jechuunis waan dibicha sanaa kan hafe hunda qubata keessaa gad baasee gara iddoo seeraan qulqulluu taʼe kan daaraan itti gatamuutti haa geessu; daaraa tuulame irrattis ibidda qoraaniitiin haa gubu.
english: —all the rest of the bull—outside of the camp to a clean place where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. It shall be burned where the ashes are poured out.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo waldaan Israaʼel hundi utuu hin beekin cubbamee waan ajaja Waaqayyoo keessatti dhowwame hojjete waldaan sun waaʼee waan sanaa beekuu baatu illee yakka qabeessa taʼa.
english: “‘If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and are guilty;

kikuyu: Yommuu cubbuun isaan hojjetan beekamutti waldaan sun dibicha tokko aarsaa cubbuu godhee dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti fidee haa dhiʼeessu.
english: when the sin in which they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Maanguddoonni waldaa fuula Waaqayyoo duratti mataa dibicha sanaa irra harka isaanii haa kaaʼan; dibichi sunis fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa qalamu.
english: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before the LORD; and the bull shall be killed before the LORD.

kikuyu: Lubni dibame sun dhiiga dibicha sanaa irraa fuudhee gara dunkaana wal gaʼiitti haa fidu.
english: The anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Innis quba isaa dhiiga keessa cuuphee golgaa duratti yeroo torba fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa facaasu.
english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle it seven times before the LORD, before the veil.

kikuyu: Lubni sunis dhiiga sana irraa gaanfawwan iddoo aarsaa kan dunkaana wal gaʼii keessa fuula Waaqayyoo dura jiru sana irratti haa naqu. Dhiiga dibicha sanaa kan hafe hunda immoo balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii irratti miilla iddoo aarsaa gubamuu jalatti haa dhangalaasu.
english: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before the LORD, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Inni cooma hunda irraa baasee iddoo aarsaa irratti haa gubu;
english: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.

kikuyu: dibicha kanas akkuma dibicha aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeeffame sana godhe haa godhu; lubnis haaluma kanaan araara isaaniif buusa; isaanis dhiifama argatu.
english: He shall do this with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so he shall do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.

kikuyu: Innis ergasii dibicha sana qubata keessaa gad baasee akkuma dibicha jalqabaa gube sana haa gubu; kunis aarsaa cubbuu waldaa ti.
english: He shall carry the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bulchaan tokko yoo utuu hin beekin cubbuu hojjetee waan ajaja Waaqayyo Waaqa isaa keessatti dhowwame hojjete inni yakka qabeessa taʼa.
english: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which the LORD his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

kikuyu: Inni yommuu cubbuu hojjete sana beeketti korma reʼee kan hirʼina hin qabne tokko aarsaa ofii isaatiif haa fidu.
english: if his sin in which he has sinned is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without defect.

kikuyu: Mataa reʼee sanaa irra harka isaa kaaʼee iddoo aarsaan gubamu itti qalamutti fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa qalu; kunis aarsaa cubbuu ti.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before the LORD. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Lubni sunis ergasii dhiiga aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeeffame irraa quba isaatiin fuudhee gaanfa iddoo aarsaa kan aarsaan gubamu irratti dhiʼeeffamutti haa naqu; dhiiga hafe immoo miilla iddoo aarsaa jalatti haa dhangalaasu.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering. He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

kikuyu: Innis akkuma cooma aarsaa nagaatiif dhiʼeeffame gube sana moora hunda iddoo aarsaa irratti haa gubu; lubichi haala kanaan namichaaf araara cubbuu buusa; innis dhiifama argata.
english: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: “ ‘Saba keessaa namni tokko yoo utuu hin beekin waan ajaja Waaqayyoo keessatti dhowwame keessaa tokko illee cabsuudhaan cubbuu hojjete inni yakka qabeessa taʼa.
english: “‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which the LORD has commanded not to be done, and is guilty,

kikuyu: Inni yommuu akka cubbuu hojjete beeketti cubbuu hojjete sanaaf reʼee dhaltuu hirʼina hin qabne tokko aarsaa ofii isaatiif haa fidu.
english: if his sin which he has sinned is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without defect, for his sin which he has sinned.

kikuyu: Mataa reʼee aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeeffamte sanaa irras harka isaa kaaʼee iddoo aarsaa gubamuutti haa qalu.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

kikuyu: Lubni sunis ergasii dhiiga sana irraa quba isaatiin fuudhee gaanfa iddoo aarsaa kan aarsaan gubamu irratti dhiʼeeffamutti haa naqu; dhiiga hafe hunda immoo miilla iddoo aarsaa jalatti haa dhangalaasu.
english: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

kikuyu: Akkuma moorri itti aarsaa nagaa irraa baafamutti inni moora hunda haa baasu; lubni immoo aarsaa urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti tolu godhee iddoo aarsaa irratti haa gubu. Akkasiinis lubni araara buusaaf; innis dhiifama argata.
english: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to the LORD; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: “ ‘Inni yoo hoolaa tokko aarsaa cubbuu ofii isaatiif fide, dhaltuu hirʼina hin qabne haa fidu.
english: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without defect.

kikuyu: Mataa hoolaa sanaa irras harka isaa kaaʼee iddoo aarsaan gubamu itti qalamutti aarsaa cubbuutiif haa qalu.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

kikuyu: Lubni sunis ergasii dhiiga aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeeffame irraa quba isaatiin fuudhee gaanfa iddoo aarsaa kan aarsaa gubamuutti haa naqu; dhiiga hafe hunda immoo miilla iddoo aarsaa jalatti haa dhangalaasu.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

kikuyu: Akkuma moorri itti hoolaa aarsaa nagaatiif dhiʼeeffamu irraa baafamutti inni moora hunda haa baasu; lubni immoo aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu gubbaatti iddoo aarsaa irratti haa gubu. Lubnis akkasiin cubbuu namichi hojjeteef araara buusaaf; innis dhiifama argata.
english: He shall remove all its fat, like the fat of the lamb is removed from the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of the LORD made by fire. The priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: “ ‘Namni tokko yoo waan nama kakachiisu dhagaʼee waaʼee waan arge yookaan beeku sanaa dhugaa baʼuu diduudhaan cubbuu hojjete inni itti gaafatama.
english: “‘If anyone sins, in that he hears a public adjuration to testify, he being a witness, whether he has seen or known, if he doesn’t report it, then he shall bear his iniquity.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yookaan namni tokko yoo waan akka seeraatti xuraaʼaa taʼe jechuunis raqa bineensa xuraaʼaa yookaan horii xuraaʼaa yookaan uumamawwan xuraaʼoo kanneen lafa irra munyuuqanii utuu hin beekin tuqe inni xuraaʼeera; yakka qabeessas taʼa.
english: “‘Or if anyone touches any unclean thing, whether it is the carcass of an unclean animal, or the carcass of unclean livestock, or the carcass of unclean creeping things, and it is hidden from him, and he is unclean, then he shall be guilty.

kikuyu: Yookaan inni yoo xuraaʼummaa namaa jechuunis waan isa xureessu kam iyyuu utuu hin beekin tuqe, yommuu waan sana beeketti yakka qabeessa taʼa.
english: “‘Or if he touches the uncleanness of man, whatever his uncleanness is with which he is unclean, and it is hidden from him; when he knows of it, then he shall be guilty.
