english: They shall be holy to their God, and not profane the name of their God, for they offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire, the bread of their God. Therefore they shall be holy.

kikuyu: “ ‘Luboonni sababii Waaqa isaaniitiif qulqulloota taʼaniif isaan dubartoota sagaagalummaadhaan xuraaʼan yookaan kanneen dhirsoota isaanii hiikan fuudhuu hin qaban.
english: “‘They shall not marry a woman who is a prostitute, or profane. A priest shall not marry a woman divorced from her husband; for he is holy to his God.

kikuyu: Ati isa qulqulleessi; inni nyaata Waaqa keetii dhiʼeessaatii. Inni siif haa qulqullaaʼu; ani Waaqayyo inni isin qulqulleessu qulqulluudhaatii.
english: Therefore you shall sanctify him, for he offers the bread of your God. He shall be holy to you, for I the LORD, who sanctify you, am holy.

kikuyu: “ ‘Intalli luba tokkoo yoo sagaagalummaadhaan of xureessite isheen abbaa ishee salphifti; isheen ibiddaan haa gubamtu.
english: “‘The daughter of any priest, if she profanes herself by playing the prostitute, she profanes her father. She shall be burned with fire.

kikuyu: “ ‘Lubni obboloota isaa keessaa luba ol aanaa taʼee zayitiin ittiin diban mataa isaa irratti naqame kan akka uffata lubummaa uffatuuf muudame tokko mataa isaa filachuu hin dhiisin yookaan uffata ofii hin tarsaasin.
english: “‘He who is the high priest among his brothers, upon whose head the anointing oil is poured, and who is consecrated to put on the garments, shall not let the hair of his head hang loose, or tear his clothes.

kikuyu: Inni iddoo reeffi jiru hin seenin. Abbaa isaatiif yookaan haadha isaatiif iyyuu jedhee of hin xureessin;
english: He must not go in to any dead body, or defile himself for his father or for his mother.

kikuyu: yookaan sababii zayitiin ittiin diban kan Waaqa isaa isa irra jiruuf inni iddoo qulqulluu sana keessaa hin baʼin yookaan iddoo qulqulluu Waaqa isaa hin xureessin. Ani Waaqayyo.
english: He shall not go out of the sanctuary, nor profane the sanctuary of his God; for the crown of the anointing oil of his God is upon him. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Dubartiin inni fuudhu durba taʼuu qabdi.
english: “‘He shall take a wife in her virginity.

kikuyu: Inni haadha hiyyeessaa, niitii dhirsi hiike yookaan niitii sagaagalummaadhaan xuroofte hin fuudhin; garuu gosa isaa keessaa durba haa fuudhu;
english: He shall not marry a widow, or one divorced, or a woman who has been defiled, or a prostitute. He shall take a virgin of his own people as a wife.

kikuyu: kunis akka inni gosa isaa keessatti sanyii isaa hin xureessineef. Ani Waaqayyo isa qulqulleessuu dha.’ ”
english: He shall not profane his offspring among his people, for I am the LORD who sanctifies him.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Arooniin akkana jedhi: ‘Dhaloota itti aanu keessatti sanyii kee keessaa namni hirʼina qabu kam iyyuu nyaata Waaqa isaa dhiʼeessuuf hin dhiʼaatin.
english: “Say to Aaron, ‘None of your offspring throughout their generations who has a defect may approach to offer the bread of his God.

kikuyu: Namni hirʼina kam iyyuu qabu tokko iyyuu jechuunis namni jaamaan yookaan naafni, namni bifaa fi dhagna hin tolle,
english: For whatever man he is that has a defect, he shall not draw near: a blind man, or a lame, or he who has a flat nose, or any deformity,

kikuyu: namni miilla yookaan harka cabaa qabu,
english: or a man who has an injured foot, or an injured hand,

kikuyu: yookaan namni dugda goophoo yookaan ooluun yookaan namni dhibee ijaa qabu yookaan namni madaa malaʼu qabu, yookaan namni cittoo qabuu fi namni kolaafame hin dhiʼaatin.
english: or hunchbacked, or a dwarf, or one who has a defect in his eye, or an itching disease, or scabs, or who has damaged testicles.

kikuyu: Sanyii Aroon lubichaa keessaa namni hirʼina qabu kam iyyuu aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu dhiʼeessuuf hin dhiʼaatin. Inni waan hirʼina qabuuf nyaata Waaqa isaa dhiʼeessuuf hin dhiʼaatin.
english: No man of the offspring of Aaron the priest who has a defect shall come near to offer the offerings of the LORD made by fire. Since he has a defect, he shall not come near to offer the bread of his God.

kikuyu: Innis nyaata Waaqa isaa kan nyaata hunda caalaa qulqulluu taʼee fi nyaata qulqulluu nyaachuu dandaʼa.
english: He shall eat the bread of his God, both of the most holy, and of the holy.

kikuyu: Garuu inni sababii hirʼina qabuuf akka iddoo qulqulluu koo hin xureessineef golgaa keessa hin seenin yookaan iddoo aarsaatti hin dhiʼaatin. Ani Waaqayyo isa isaan qulqulleessuu dha.’ ”
english: He shall not come near to the veil, nor come near to the altar, because he has a defect; that he may not profane my sanctuaries, for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

kikuyu: Museen Aroonitti, ilmaan Aroonittii fi Israaʼeloota hundatti waan kana hime.
english: So Moses spoke to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akka isaan maqaa koo qulqullicha hin xureessineef, akka isaan aarsaa qulqulluu Israaʼeloonni addaan baasanii naa fidan sana akka gaariitti eeganiif Aroonii fi ilmaan isaatti himi. Ani Waaqayyo.
english: “Tell Aaron and his sons to separate themselves from the holy things of the children of Israel, which they make holy to me, and that they not profane my holy name. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: “Akkanas Isaaniin jedhi: ‘Dhaloota dhufu keessa yoo sanyii kee keessaa namni tokko illee utuu akka seeraatti hin qulqullaaʼin aarsaa Israaʼeloonni Waaqayyoof addaan baasanitti dhiʼaate namni sun fuula koo duraa haa balleeffamu. Ani Waaqayyo.
english: “Tell them, ‘If anyone of all your offspring throughout your generations approaches the holy things which the children of Israel make holy to the LORD, having his uncleanness on him, that soul shall be cut off from before me. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Sanyii Aroon keessaa namni tokko yoo lamxii yookaan dhangalaʼaa saala isaa keessaa baʼu qabaate inni hamma qulqullaaʼutti aarsaa qulqulluu sana hin nyaatin. Akkasumas yoo waan reeffaan xuraaʼe yookaan nama afeetaa saala isaa keessaa dangalaʼu tuqe,
english: “‘Whoever of the offspring of Aaron is a leper or has a discharge shall not eat of the holy things until he is clean. Whoever touches anything that is unclean by the dead, or a man who has a seminal emission,

kikuyu: yookaan yoo waan lafa irra looʼu kan isa xureessu yookaan nama isa xureessu kam iyyuu tuqe, xuraaʼummaa kam iyyuu taanaan,
english: or whoever touches any creeping thing by which he may be made unclean, or a man from whom he may become unclean, whatever uncleanness he has—

kikuyu: namni waan akkasii kam iyyuu tuqu hamma galgalaatti xuraaʼaa taʼa. Inni yoo dhagna isaa bishaaniin dhiqate malee aarsaa qulqulluu sana keessaa tokko illee hin nyaatin.
english: the person that touches any such shall be unclean until the evening, and shall not eat of the holy things unless he bathes his body in water.

kikuyu: Inni yeroo aduun lixxutti ni qulqullaaʼa; ergasii immoo sababii wanni sun nyaata isaa taʼeef aarsaa qulqulluu sana nyaachuu dandaʼa.
english: When the sun is down, he shall be clean; and afterward he shall eat of the holy things, because it is his bread.

kikuyu: Inni waan duʼee argame yookaan waan bineensi ciccire nyaachuudhaan of hin xurreessin. Ani Waaqayyo.
english: He shall not eat that which dies of itself or is torn by animals, defiling himself by it. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Luboonni akka ajaja koo tuffachuudhaan cubbuu hojjetanii hin duuneef ajaja koo haa eegan. Ani Waaqayyo isaan qulqulleessuu dha.
english: “‘They shall therefore follow my commandment, lest they bear sin for it and die in it, if they profane it. I am the LORD who sanctifies them.

kikuyu: “ ‘Namni maatii lubaa hin taʼin yookaan keessummaan lubaa yookaan namni lubichaaf qaxaramee hojjetu tokko illee aarsaa qulqulluu sana nyaachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: “‘No stranger shall eat of the holy thing: a foreigner living with the priests, or a hired servant, shall not eat of the holy thing.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo lubni maallaqaan garbicha bitate, yookaan yoo garbichi mana isaatti dhalate, garbichi sun nyaata lubichaa nyaachuu dandaʼu.
english: But if a priest buys a slave, purchased by his money, he shall eat of it; and those who are born in his house shall eat of his bread.

kikuyu: Intalli lubaa yoo nama luba hin taʼinitti heerumte, isheen aarsaa qulqulluu sana irraa nyaachuu hin dandeessu.
english: If a priest’s daughter is married to an outsider, she shall not eat of the heave offering of the holy things.

kikuyu: Taʼus intalli lubaa yoo haadha hiyyeessaa taate yookaan dhirsaan wal hiiktee utuu ijoollee hin qabaatin akkuma yeroo ijoollummaa isheetti mana abbaa ishee jiraachuuf deebite, isheen nyaata abbaa ishee irraa nyaachuu ni dandeessi. Ormi garuu nyaachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: But if a priest’s daughter is a widow, or divorced, and has no child, and has returned to her father’s house as in her youth, she may eat of her father’s bread; but no stranger shall eat any of it.

kikuyu: “ ‘Namni yoo utuu hin beekin aarsaa qulqulluu tokko nyaate, inni waan sana iddoo buusee gatii waan sanaa harka shan keessaa harka tokko itti dabalee lubichaaf haa kennu.
english: “‘If a man eats something holy unwittingly, then he shall add the fifth part of its value to it, and shall give the holy thing to the priest.

kikuyu: Luboonnis aarsaa qulqulluu Israaʼeloonni Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessan hin xureessin
english: The priests shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, which they offer to the LORD,

kikuyu: yookaan akka sabni sun aarsaa qulqulluu sana nyaatu eeyyamuufiidhaan yakka gatii baasisu isaanitti hin fidin. Ani Waaqayyo isaan qulqulleessuu dha.’ ”
english: and so cause them to bear the iniquity that brings guilt when they eat their holy things; for I am the LORD who sanctifies them.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Aroonitti, ilmaan isaattii fi Israaʼeloota hundatti akkana jedhii himi; ‘Yeroo saba Israaʼel keessaa namni tokko yookaan alagaan Israaʼel keessa jiraatu kam iyyuu aarsaa gubamu godhee wareega isaa yookaan aarsaa fedhiidhaan dhiʼaatu Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessutti,
english: “Speak to Aaron, and to his sons, and to all the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘Whoever is of the house of Israel, or of the foreigners in Israel, who offers his offering, whether it is any of their vows or any of their free will offerings, which they offer to the LORD for a burnt offering:

kikuyu: isin akka wanni sun fudhatama isiniif argatuuf loon, hoolota yookaan reʼoota keessaa korma hirʼina hin qabne tokko dhiʼeessuu qabdu.
english: that you may be accepted, you shall offer a male without defect, of the bulls, of the sheep, or of the goats.

kikuyu: Sababii inni isinii hin fudhatamneef waan hirʼina qabu kam iyyuu hin dhiʼeessinaa
english: But you shall not offer whatever has a defect, for it shall not be acceptable for you.

kikuyu: Yeroo namni loon yookaan bushaayee keessaa wareega guuttachuuf aarsaa fedhiidhaan dhiʼeeffamu godhee aarsaa nagaa Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessutti akka wanni sun fudhatama argatuuf wanni sun waan fayyaalessa yookaan waan hirʼina hin qabne haa taʼu.
english: Whoever offers a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD to accomplish a vow, or for a free will offering of the herd or of the flock, it shall be perfect to be accepted. It shall have no defect.

kikuyu: Horii jaamaa yookaan cabaa yookaan dooluu yookaan kormommuu yookaan kan dhangalaʼaan dhagna isaa keessaa baʼu yookaan kan madaa malaʼu qabu Waaqayyoof hin dhiʼeessinaa. Kanneen akkasii keessaa tokko iyyuu aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu gootanii iddoo aarsaa irra hin kaaʼinaa.
english: You shall not offer what is blind, is injured, is maimed, has a wart, is festering, or has a running sore to the LORD, nor make an offering by fire of them on the altar to the LORD.

kikuyu: Taʼus sangaa yookaan hoolaa gar malee dheeraa yookaan gar malee gabaabaa taʼe aarsaa fedhiidhaan dhiʼaatu gootanii dhiʼeessuu ni dandeessu; garuu wanni kun wareega keessan guutuuf fudhatama hin argatu.
english: Either a bull or a lamb that has any deformity or lacking in his parts, that you may offer for a free will offering; but for a vow it shall not be accepted.

kikuyu: Horii kolaafame yookaan kan tumame, kan kolaan isaa baqaqfame yookaan irraa murame tokko Waaqayyoof hin dhiʼeessinaa; isin waan akkasii biyya keessan keessatti hin godhinaa;
english: You must not offer to the LORD that which has its testicles bruised, crushed, broken, or cut. You must not do this in your land.

kikuyu: horii akkasii nama ormaa harkaa fuutanii nyaata Waaqa keessanii gootanii hin dhiʼeessinaa. Horiin sun waan kolaafamee hirʼina qabuuf isiniif hin fudhatamu.’ ”
english: You must not offer any of these as the bread of your God from the hand of a foreigner, because their corruption is in them. There is a defect in them. They shall not be accepted for you.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Dibichi yookaan hoolaan yookaan reʼeen yommuu dhalatutti hamma bultii torbaatti haadha isaa wajjin haa turu. Guyyaa saddeettaffaadhaa jalqabee immoo aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu taʼee fudhatama ni argata.
english: “When a bull, a sheep, or a goat is born, it shall remain seven days with its mother. From the eighth day on it shall be accepted for the offering of an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Guyyuma tokkotti, saʼa yookaan hoolaa ilmoo isaa wajjin hin qalinaa.
english: Whether it is a cow or ewe, you shall not kill it and its young both in one day.

kikuyu: “Gaafa aarsaa galataa Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessitanitti akka isiniif fudhatamuuf haala kanaan dhiʼeessaa.
english: “When you sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving to the LORD, you shall sacrifice it so that you may be accepted.

kikuyu: Aarsaan kunis gaafuma sana nyaatamuu qaba; waan tokko illee hin bulchinaa. Ani Waaqayyo.
english: It shall be eaten on the same day; you shall leave none of it until the morning. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: “Ajajawwan koo eegaa; duukaa buʼaas. Ani Waaqayyo.
english: “Therefore you shall keep my commandments, and do them. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Maqaa koo qulqullicha hin xureessinaa. Akka ani qulqulluu taʼe Israaʼeloonni haa beeksisan. Ani Waaqayyo kan isin qulqulleessu
english: You shall not profane my holy name, but I will be made holy among the children of Israel. I am the LORD who makes you holy,

kikuyu: kanan Waaqa keessan taʼuudhaaf biyya Gibxii isin baasee dha. Ani Waaqayyo.”
english: who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God. I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akkana jedhiitii Israaʼelootatti dubbadhu; ‘Kunneen ayyaanota koo murtaaʼoo, ayyaanota Waaqayyoo kanneen isin guyyoota wal gaʼii qulqulluu jettanii labsitanii dha.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘The set feasts of the LORD, which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my set feasts.

kikuyu: “ ‘Guyyoonni isin hojii itti hojjettan jaʼatu jira; guyyaan torbaffaan garuu sanbata boqonnaa, guyyaa wal gaʼii qulqulluu ti. Isin hojii tokko illee hin hojjetinaa; iddoo isin jiraattan kamitti iyyuu kun sanbata Waaqayyoo ti.
english: “‘Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, a holy convocation; you shall do no kind of work. It is a Sabbath to the LORD in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: “ ‘Isaan kunneen ayyaanota Waaqayyoo murteeffamoo, waldaawwan qulqulluu isin yeroo isaaniitti labsitanii dha;
english: “‘These are the set feasts of the LORD, even holy convocations, which you shall proclaim in their appointed season.

kikuyu: Faasiikaan Waaqayyoo galgala bultii kudha afuraffaa jiʼa jalqabaatti jalqabama.
english: In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month in the evening, is the LORD’s Passover.

kikuyu: Guyyaa kudha shanaffaa jiʼa jalqabaatti Ayyaana Waaqayyoo kan maxinootu jalqabama; isinis guyyaa torba buddeena raacitii hin qabne nyaadhaa.
english: On the fifteenth day of the same month is the feast of unleavened bread to the LORD. Seven days you shall eat unleavened bread.

kikuyu: Guyyaa jalqabaatti wal gaʼii qulqulluu qabaadhaa; hojii idilees hin hojjetinaa.
english: In the first day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: Bultii torba aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu dhiʼeessaa. Bultii torbaffaatti wal gaʼii qulqulluu qabaadhaa; hojii idilees hin hojjetinaa.’ ”
english: But you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD seven days. In the seventh day is a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akkana jedhii Israaʼelootatti dubbadhu; ‘Yommuu biyya ani isiniif kennutti galtanii oomisha walitti qabdanitti bissii mataa midhaan walitti qabdan sanaa lubatti fidaa.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land which I give to you, and shall reap its harvest, then you shall bring the sheaf of the first fruits of your harvest to the priest.

kikuyu: Innis akka bissiin sun fudhatama isiniif argatuuf fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa sochoosu; lubichis guyyaa Sanbata booddee jirutti haa sochoosu.
english: He shall wave the sheaf before the LORD, to be accepted for you. On the next day after the Sabbath the priest shall wave it.

kikuyu: Guyyaa bissii sana sochooftanitti, xobbaallaa hoolaa waggaa tokkoo kan hirʼina hin qabne aarsaa gubamu godhaatii Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessaa;
english: On the day when you wave the sheaf, you shall offer a male lamb without defect a year old for a burnt offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: kana wajjinis aarsaa midhaanii daakuu bullaaʼaa zayitiidhaan sukkuumame iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessaa harka lama aarsaa urgaaʼaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamuu fi dhibaayyuu daadhii wayinii iinii tokko irraa harka afur keessaa harka tokko dhiʼeessaa.
english: The meal offering with it shall be two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with oil, an offering made by fire to the LORD for a pleasant aroma; and the drink offering with it shall be of wine, the fourth part of a hin.

kikuyu: Isin hamma gaafa kennaa kana Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessitanitti buddeena yookaan akaayii yookaan asheetii hin nyaatinaa. Kunis iddoo isin jiraattan hundatti dhaloota dhufuuf seera bara baraa haa taʼu.
english: You must not eat bread, or roasted grain, or fresh grain, until this same day, until you have brought the offering of your God. This is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: “ ‘Guyyaa Sanbata booddee jiru, gaafa bissii aarsaa sochoofamu fiddanii jalqabaatii torbanoota torba guutuu lakkaaʼaa.
english: “‘You shall count from the next day after the Sabbath, from the day that you brought the sheaf of the wave offering: seven Sabbaths shall be completed.

kikuyu: Hamma guyyaa Sanbata torbaffaa booddee jiruutti guyyaa shantama lakkaaʼaa; ergasii immoo aarsaa midhaan haaraa Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessaa.
english: The next day after the seventh Sabbath you shall count fifty days; and you shall offer a new meal offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Iddoo jiraattan hundatti buddeena lama kan daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii tokkoo irraa harka kudhan keessaa harka lamaa kan raacitiin itti makamee tolfame kennaa hangafa kan sochoofamu godhaatii Waaqayyoof fidaa.
english: You shall bring out of your habitations two loaves of bread for a wave offering made of two tenths of an ephah of fine flour. They shall be baked with yeast, for first fruits to the LORD.

kikuyu: Buddeena kana wajjinis xobbaallaawwan hoolaa torba kanneen hirʼina hin qabnee fi kanneen waggaa tokko tokkoo, dibicha tokkoo fi korbeeyyii hoolaa lama dhiʼeessaa. Isaanis aarsaa midhaan isaaniitii fi aarsaa dhibaayyuu isaanii wajjin Waaqayyoof aarsaa gubamu taʼu; kunis aarsaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamu kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti toluu dha.
english: You shall present with the bread seven lambs without defect a year old, one young bull, and two rams. They shall be a burnt offering to the LORD, with their meal offering and their drink offerings, even an offering made by fire, of a sweet aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Ergasiis aarsaa cubbuutiif korma reʼee tokko akkasumas xobbaallaa hoolaa lama kanneen waggaa tokko tokkoo aarsaa nagaatiif qalaa.
english: You shall offer one male goat for a sin offering, and two male lambs a year old for a sacrifice of peace offerings.

kikuyu: Lubni immoo xobbaallaa hoolaa sana lamaan aarsaa sochoofamu godhee buddeena jalqabaa wajjin fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa sochoosu. Isaan kunneenis kan Waaqayyoof qulqulleeffamanii dha; qooda lubootaatis.
english: The priest shall wave them with the bread of the first fruits for a wave offering before the LORD, with the two lambs. They shall be holy to the LORD for the priest.

kikuyu: Isin gaafuma sana wal gaʼii qulqulluu labsaa; hojii idilees hin hojjetinaa. Kunis iddoo isin jiraattan hundatti dhaloota dhufuuf seera bara baraa haa taʼu.
english: You shall make proclamation on the same day that there shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall do no regular work. This is a statute forever in all your dwellings throughout your generations.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yommuu oomisha lafa keessanii walitti qabdanitti hamma qarqaraatti hin haaminaa yookaan qarmii isaa hin funaaninaa; waan kana hiyyeeyyii fi alagootaaf hambisaa. Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan.’ ”
english: “‘When you reap the harvest of your land, you must not wholly reap into the corners of your field. You must not gather the gleanings of your harvest. You must leave them for the poor and for the foreigner. I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Israaʼelootaan akkana jedhi; ‘Isin guyyaa jalqaba jiʼa torbaffaatti sanbata boqonnaa qabaadhaa; yaaʼii qulqulluu sagalee malakataatiin ayyaaneffamus qabaadhaa.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, there shall be a solemn rest for you, a memorial of blowing of trumpets, a holy convocation.

kikuyu: Aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu dhiʼeessaa malee hojii idilee hin hojjetinaa.’ ”
english: You shall do no regular work. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Guyyaan kurnaffaan jiʼa torbaffaa guyyaa araarri buʼuu dha. Wal gaʼii qulqulluu qabaadhaa; gad ofi deebisaa; Waaqayyoofis aarsaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamu dhiʼeessaa.
english: “However on the tenth day of this seventh month is the day of atonement. It shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall afflict yourselves and you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Sababii guyyaan sun Guyyaa Araarri Buʼu, yeroo itti fuula Waaqayyo Waaqa keessanii duratti araarri isiniif buʼu taʼeef hojii tokko illee hin hojjetinaa.
english: You shall do no kind of work in that same day, for it is a day of atonement, to make atonement for you before the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Namni gaafuma sana gad of hin deebifne kam iyyuu saba isaa keessaa baafamee ni balleeffama.
english: For whoever it is who shall not deny himself in that same day shall be cut off from his people.

kikuyu: Nama gaafa sana hojii tokko illee hojjetu kam iyyuus ani saba isaa gidduudhaa nan balleessa.
english: Whoever does any kind of work in that same day, I will destroy that person from among his people.

kikuyu: Isin hojii tokko iyyuu hin hojjetinaa. Kunis lafa isin jiraattan hundatti dhaloota dhufuuf seera bara baraa haa taʼu.
english: You shall do no kind of work: it is a statute forever throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: Kun isiniif sanbata boqonnaa ti; isinis gad of deebisuu qabdu. Galgala bultii saglaffaa jiʼa sanaatii jalqabaatii hamma galgala itti aanutti sanbata keessan ayyaaneffadhaa.”
english: It shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for you, and you shall deny yourselves. In the ninth day of the month at evening, from evening to evening, you shall keep your Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Israaʼelootaan akkana jedhi; ‘Bultii kudha shanaffaa jiʼa torbaffaatti Ayyaana Dunkaana Qulqulluu Waaqayyootu jalqabama; kunis bultii torba tura.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say, ‘On the fifteenth day of this seventh month is the feast of booths for seven days to the LORD.

kikuyu: Guyyaan jalqabaa wal gaʼii qulqulluu dha; hojii idilees hin hojjetinaa.
english: On the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: Guyyaa torba aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu dhiʼeessaa; guyyaa saddeettaffaatti immoo wal gaʼii qulqulluu godhadhaatii aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu dhiʼeessaa; kun guyyaa wal gaʼiin qulqulluun itti xumuramuu dha; hojii idilees hin hojjetinaa.
english: Seven days you shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. On the eighth day shall be a holy convocation to you. You shall offer an offering made by fire to the LORD. It is a solemn assembly; you shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kunneen ayyaanota Waaqayyoo murtaaʼoo isin aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu, aarsaa gubamu, aarsaa midhaanii, qalmaa fi dhibaayyuu guyyaa kamiif iyyuu barbaachisu dhiʼeessuuf wal gaʼiiwwan qulqulluu itti labsitanii dha.
english: “‘These are the appointed feasts of the LORD which you shall proclaim to be holy convocations, to offer an offering made by fire to the LORD, a burnt offering, a meal offering, a sacrifice, and drink offerings, each on its own day—

kikuyu: Aarsaawwan kunneen kennaawwan isin Sanbata Waaqayyootiif dhiʼeessitanii fi kennaawwan keessan, kennaawwan wareega keessanii fi kennaawwan isin fedhiidhaan kennitan hunda irratti dabaltanii Waaqayyoof fiddanii dha.
english: in addition to the Sabbaths of the LORD, and in addition to your gifts, and in addition to all your vows, and in addition to all your free will offerings, which you give to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Erga oomisha lafa keessanii walitti qabdanii booddee bultii kudha shanaffaa jiʼa torbaffaatii jalqabaatii bultii torba Waaqayyoof ayyaana ayyaaneffadhaa; guyyaan jalqabaa sanbata boqonnaa ti; guyyaan saddeettaffaanis akkasuma sanbata boqonnaa ti.
english: “‘So on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, when you have gathered in the fruits of the land, you shall keep the feast of the LORD seven days. On the first day shall be a solemn rest, and on the eighth day shall be a solemn rest.

kikuyu: Guyyaa jalqabaa ija muka gaarii, damee meexxii, damee muka baala qabuutii fi alaltuu qabadhaatii guyyaa torba fuula Waaqayyo Waaqa keessanii duratti gammadaa.
english: You shall take on the first day the fruit of majestic trees, branches of palm trees, and boughs of thick trees, and willows of the brook; and you shall rejoice before the LORD your God seven days.

kikuyu: Wagguma waggaan ayyaana Waaqayyoo guyyaa torba ayyaaneffadhaa. Kunis dhaloota dhufuuf seera bara baraa haa taʼu; jiʼa torbaffaattis isa ayyaaneffadhaa.
english: You shall keep it as a feast to the LORD seven days in the year. It is a statute forever throughout your generations. You shall keep it in the seventh month.

kikuyu: Bultii torba daasii keessa turaa; dhalataan Israaʼel hundinuu daasii keessa haa turu;
english: You shall dwell in temporary shelters for seven days. All who are native-born in Israel shall dwell in temporary shelters,

kikuyu: ijoolleen keessanis akkasiin akka ani yeroo biyya Gibxiitii Israaʼeloota baasetti daasii keessa isaan turse ni beeku. Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan.’ ”
english: that your generations may know that I made the children of Israel to dwell in temporary shelters when I brought them out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: Museenis ayyaanota Waaqayyoo murtaaʼoo Israaʼelootatti labse.
english: So Moses declared to the children of Israel the appointed feasts of the LORD.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akka ibsaan ittuma fufee bobaʼuuf akka isaan zayitii ejersaa kan cuunfamee taliila taʼe siif fidaniif ijoollee Israaʼel ajaji.
english: “Command the children of Israel, that they bring to you pure olive oil beaten for the light, to cause a lamp to burn continually.

kikuyu: Aroonis ibsaawwan sana golgaa taabota kakuu seeraa kan dunkaana wal gaʼii keessa jiru sanaan alatti fuula Waaqayyoo duratti galgalaa hamma ganamaatti ittuma fufee haa qopheessu. Kunis dhaloota keessaniif seera bara baraa haa taʼu.
english: Outside of the veil of the Testimony, in the Tent of Meeting, Aaron shall keep it in order from evening to morning before the LORD continually. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations.

kikuyu: Ibsaawwan baattuu ibsaa kan warqee qulqulluu irraa hojjetaman irra fuula Waaqayyoo dura jiran sun ittuma fufanii qopheeffamuu qabu.
english: He shall keep in order the lamps on the pure gold lamp stand before the LORD continually.

kikuyu: “Daakuu bullaaʼaa fuudhiitii buddeena kudha lama tolchi; tokkoon tokkoon buddeena sanaas daakuu iifii tokkoo irraa harka kudhan keessaa harka lama lamaan haa tolfamu.
english: “You shall take fine flour, and bake twelve cakes of it: two tenths of an ephah shall be in one cake.

kikuyu: Buddeena kanas toora tokko keessa jaʼa jaʼa godhiitii minjaala warqee qulqulluu irraa hojjetamee fuula Waaqayyoo dura jiru irra toora lamaan kaaʼi.
english: You shall set them in two rows, six on a row, on the pure gold table before the LORD.

kikuyu: Akka inni qooda buddeena sanaa kutaa yaadannootii fi aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu taʼuuf tokkoo tokkoo toora sanaa irra ixaana qulqulluu kaaʼi.
english: You shall put pure frankincense on each row, that it may be to the bread for a memorial, even an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Buddeenni kunis akka kakuu bara baraa taʼee saba Israaʼel iddoo buʼuuf yeroo hunda Sanbatuma Sanbataan fuula Waaqayyoo dura haa kaaʼamu.
english: Every Sabbath day he shall set it in order before the LORD continually. It is an everlasting covenant on the behalf of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Buddeenni kun qooda Arooniitii fi ilmaan isaa ti; isaanis sababii buddeenni kun qooda isaanii kan bara baraa kan aarsaa ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffame keessaa kutaa waan hunda caalaa qulqullaaʼe taʼeef iddoo qulqulluutti isa haa nyaatan.”
english: It shall be for Aaron and his sons. They shall eat it in a holy place; for it is most holy to him of the offerings of the LORD made by fire by a perpetual statute.”

kikuyu: Namichi haati isaa gosa Israaʼelii fi abbaan isaa immoo nama biyya Gibxii taʼe tokko Israaʼeloota gidduu baʼe; lollis qubata keessatti isaa fi Israaʼelicha tokko gidduutti kaʼe.
english: The son of an Israelite woman, whose father was an Egyptian, went out among the children of Israel; and the son of the Israelite woman and a man of Israel strove together in the camp.

kikuyu: Ilmi dubartii Israaʼel sunis Maqaa Waaqaa arrabse; ni abaares; kanaafuu Museetti isa fidan. Maqaan haadha namicha sanaas Sheloomiit jedhama; isheen immoo intala namicha gosa Daanii kan Dibraayi jedhamuu ti.
english: The son of the Israelite woman blasphemed the Name, and cursed; and they brought him to Moses. His mother’s name was Shelomith, the daughter of Dibri, of the tribe of Dan.

kikuyu: Isaanis hamma fedhiin Waaqayyoo isaanii ifutti eegumsa jala isa tursan.
english: They put him in custody until the LORD’s will should be declared to them.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Museedhaan akkana jedhe:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Namicha Waaqa arrabse sana qubata keessaa gad baasi. Warri isa dhagaʼan hundinuu harka isaanii mataa isaa irra haa kaaʼan; waldaan hundi immoo dhagaadhaan isa haa tumu.
english: “Bring him who cursed out of the camp; and let all who heard him lay their hands on his head, and let all the congregation stone him.

kikuyu: Israaʼelootaan akkana jedhi; ‘Namni kam iyyuu yoo Waaqa isaa abaare inni cubbuu hojjeteef itti gaafatama;
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Whoever curses his God shall bear his sin.

kikuyu: namni Maqaa Waaqayyoo arrabsu haa ajjeefamu. Waldaan hundi dhagaadhaan isa haa tumu. Alagaas taʼu dhalataan biyyaa yoo Maqaa Waaqaa arrabse haa ajjeefamu.
english: He who blasphemes the LORD’s name, he shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall certainly stone him. The foreigner as well as the native-born shall be put to death when he blasphemes the Name.

kikuyu: “ ‘Namni nama ajjeese kam iyyuu haa ajjeefamu.
english: “‘He who strikes any man mortally shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Namni horii namaa ajjeese horii sana iddoo haa buusu.
english: He who strikes an animal mortally shall make it good, life for life.

kikuyu: Namni tokko yoo ollaa isaa miidhe, wanni inni nama sana godhe isa irrattis haa godhamu;
english: If anyone injures his neighbor, it shall be done to him as he has done:

kikuyu: kunis qooda cabaa cabaa, qooda ijaa ija, qooda ilkaanii ilkaan jechuu dha. Innis akkuma nama miidhe sana isa irrattis haa godhamu.
english: fracture for fracture, eye for eye, tooth for tooth. It shall be done to him as he has injured someone.

kikuyu: Namni horii ajjeese horii sana iddoo haa buusu; namni nama ajjeese garuu haa ajjeefamu.
english: He who kills an animal shall make it good; and he who kills a man shall be put to death.

kikuyu: Alagaas taʼu dhalataa biyyaatiif seera tokkicha qabaadhaa. Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan.’ ”
english: You shall have one kind of law for the foreigner as well as the native-born; for I am the LORD your God.’”

kikuyu: Museen waan kana Israaʼelootatti hime; isaanis namicha Waaqa arrabse sana qubata keessaa gad baasanii dhagaadhaan tuman; Israaʼeloonni akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajaje godhan.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and they brought him who had cursed out of the camp, and stoned him with stones. The children of Israel did as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Gaara Siinaa irratti Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD said to Moses on Mount Sinai,

kikuyu: “Akkana jedhii Israaʼelootatti himi: ‘Yommuu biyya ani isinii kennutti galtan, biyyattiin mataan ishee sanbata Waaqayyoo haa kabajju.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land which I give you, then the land shall keep a Sabbath to the LORD.

kikuyu: Waggaa jaʼa lafa qotiisaa kee facaafadhu; waggaa jaʼa immoo wayinii kee irraa qori; ija isaas walitti qabadhu.
english: You shall sow your field six years, and you shall prune your vineyard six years, and gather in its fruits;

kikuyu: Waggaa torbaffaatti garuu lafti sanbata boqonnaa haa qabaatu; kunis sanbata Waaqayyoof kabajamuu dha. Lafa qotiisaa kee hin facaafatin yookaan wayinii kee irraa hin qorin.
english: but in the seventh year there shall be a Sabbath of solemn rest for the land, a Sabbath to the LORD. You shall not sow your field or prune your vineyard.

kikuyu: Waan ofiin biqile hin haammatin yookaan wayinii hin qoramin irraa ija walitti hin qabatin. Lafti boqonnaa waggaa tokkoo haa argattu.
english: What grows of itself in your harvest you shall not reap, and you shall not gather the grapes of your undressed vine. It shall be a year of solemn rest for the land.

kikuyu: Wanni lafti waggaa sanbataatti kennitu nyaata kee haa taʼu jechuunis siʼi mataa keetiif, garboota kee dhiiraa fi dubartiidhaaf, warra qaxaramanii hojjetanii fi alagoota yeroodhaaf si wajjin jiraataniif nyaata haa taʼu;
english: The Sabbath of the land shall be for food for you; for yourself, for your servant, for your maid, for your hired servant, and for your stranger, who lives as a foreigner with you.

kikuyu: akkasumas horii keetii fi bineensa daggalaa kanneen biyya kee keessa jiraataniif nyaata haa taʼu. Wanni lafti baaftu kam iyyuu haa nyaatamu.
english: For your livestock also, and for the animals that are in your land, shall all its increase be for food.

kikuyu: “ ‘Waggoota sanbataa torba jechuunis waggoota torba yeroo torba lakkaaʼi; waggoonni sanbataa torban waggoota afurtamii sagal taʼu.
english: “‘You shall count off seven Sabbaths of years, seven times seven years; and there shall be to you the days of seven Sabbaths of years, even forty-nine years.

kikuyu: Guyyaa kurnaffaa jiʼa torbaffaatti immoo guutummaa biyya keessanii keessatti malakata dhageessisi; Guyyaa Araarri Buʼuttis guutummaa biyyaa keessatti malakata dhageessisaa.
english: Then you shall sound the loud trumpet on the tenth day of the seventh month. On the Day of Atonement you shall sound the trumpet throughout all your land.

kikuyu: Waggaa shantamaffaa qulqulleessaatii guutummaa biyyattii keessatti jiraattota hundaaf bilisummaa labsaa. Kunis iyyoobeeliyyuu isinii taʼa; tokkoon tokkoon namaa deebiʼee gara qabeenya isaattii fi gara maatii isaatti haa galu.
english: You shall make the fiftieth year holy, and proclaim liberty throughout the land to all its inhabitants. It shall be a jubilee to you; and each of you shall return to his own property, and each of you shall return to his family.

kikuyu: Waggaan shantamaffaan iyyoobeeliyyuu isiniif haa taʼu; hin facaafatinaa; waan ofiin biqile hin haammatinaa; wayinii hin qoramin irraas ija isaa walitti hin qabatinaa.
english: That fiftieth year shall be a jubilee to you. In it you shall not sow, neither reap that which grows of itself, nor gather from the undressed vines.

kikuyu: Kun sababii iyyoobeeliyyuu taʼeef qulqulluu isiniif haa taʼu; waan lafa qotiisaa irraa galfamu nyaadhaa.
english: For it is a jubilee; it shall be holy to you. You shall eat of its increase out of the field.

kikuyu: “ ‘Waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuu kana keessa tokkoon tokkoon namaa gara qabeenya isaatti haa deebiʼu.
english: “‘In this Year of Jubilee each of you shall return to his property.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo nama saba kee taʼetti lafa gurgurte yookaan waan tokko isa irraa bitte, wal hin gowwoomsinaa.
english: “‘If you sell anything to your neighbor, or buy from your neighbor, you shall not wrong one another.

kikuyu: Ati waggoota waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuu booddee jiran irratti hundooftee nama saba keetii irraa bitadhu. Innis baayʼina waggoota galchaa midhaanii lakkaaʼee sitti haa gurguru.
english: According to the number of years after the Jubilee you shall buy from your neighbor. According to the number of years of the crops he shall sell to you.

kikuyu: Yoo waggaan baayʼee taʼe gatii isaa dabaliif; yoo waggaan isaa gabaabaa taʼe immoo gatii isaa hirʼisi; sababiin isaa wanni inni sitti gurguru baayʼina midhaanii ti.
english: According to the length of the years you shall increase its price, and according to the shortness of the years you shall diminish its price; for he is selling the number of the crops to you.

kikuyu: Wal hin cunqursinaa; garuu Waaqa sodaadhaa. Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan.
english: You shall not wrong one another, but you shall fear your God; for I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ajaja koo duukaa buʼaa; seera koo illee eegaa; isinis biyyattii keessa nagaan ni jiraattu.
english: “‘Therefore you shall do my statutes, and keep my ordinances and do them; and you shall dwell in the land in safety.

kikuyu: Lafti ija ni kenniti; isinis hamma quuftanitti nyaattu; nagaadhaanis ni jiraattu.
english: The land shall yield its fruit, and you shall eat your fill, and dwell therein in safety.

kikuyu: Isinis, “Nu yoo facaafachuu yookaan midhaan keenya walitti qabachuu baanne waggaa torbaffaatti maal nyaanna?” jettanii gaafattu taʼa.
english: If you said, “What shall we eat the seventh year? Behold, we shall not sow, nor gather in our increase;”

kikuyu: Akka lafti midhaan waggaa sadiif gaʼu isinii kennituuf ani waggaa jaʼaffaatti eebba koo isiniif nan erga.
english: then I will command my blessing on you in the sixth year, and it shall bear fruit for the three years.

kikuyu: Yeroo waggaa saddeettaffaatti facaafattanittis waanuma duraan galfattan irraa nyaattu; hamma midhaan waggaa saglaffaa walitti qabattanitti midhaanuma kana nyaattu.
english: You shall sow the eighth year, and eat of the fruits from the old store until the ninth year. Until its fruits come in, you shall eat the old store.

kikuyu: “ ‘Lafti sababii kanuma koo taateef bara baraan hin gurguramin; isin anaaf alagaa fi keessummoota.
english: “‘The land shall not be sold in perpetuity, for the land is mine; for you are strangers and live as foreigners with me.

kikuyu: Biyya akka dhaalaatti qabattan guutuu keessatti waan ittiin lafa furtan baasaa.
english: In all the land of your possession you shall grant a redemption for the land.

kikuyu: “ ‘Obboleessi kee tokko hiyyoomee lafa isaa yoo gurgure, namni fira isaa kan dhiʼoo taʼe dhufee waan firri isaa gurgure sana haa furuuf.
english: “‘If your brother becomes poor, and sells some of his possessions, then his kinsman who is next to him shall come, and redeem that which his brother has sold.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo namichi sun fira lafa isaa furuuf dhabee inni mataan isaa waan ittiin lafa isaa furatu argate,
english: If a man has no one to redeem it, and he becomes prosperous and finds sufficient means to redeem it,

kikuyu: waggoota yeroo inni lafa isaa gurgure sanaa as jiran lakkaaʼee namicha itti gurgure sanaaf maallaqa isaa haa deebisu; innis gara lafa ofiitti haa deebiʼu.
english: then let him reckon the years since its sale, and restore the surplus to the man to whom he sold it; and he shall return to his property.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo waan namicha sanaaf deebisu dhabee, wanni inni gurgure sun hamma waggaa iyyoobeeliyyuutti harkuma namicha bite sanaa haa turu. Waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuu keessa ni deebiʼaaf; innis gara qabeenya isaatti ni deebiʼa.
english: But if he isn’t able to get it back for himself, then what he has sold shall remain in the hand of him who has bought it until the Year of Jubilee. In the Jubilee it shall be released, and he shall return to his property.

kikuyu: “ ‘Namni yoo magaalaa dallaa qabdu keessatti mana jireenyaa gurgurate, gaafa gurguratee jalqabee waggaa tokko keessatti furachuu dandaʼa. Mirgi furachuu isaas hamma waggaa tokkootti tura.
english: “‘If a man sells a dwelling house in a walled city, then he may redeem it within a whole year after it has been sold. For a full year he shall have the right of redemption.

kikuyu: Yoo utuu waggaan tokko hin guutin furamuu baate manni magaalaa dallaa qabdu keessatti argamu sun qabeenya namicha biteetii fi kan sanyii isaa taʼee hafa. Waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuuttis hin deebiʼu.
english: If it isn’t redeemed within the space of a full year, then the house that is in the walled city shall be made sure in perpetuity to him who bought it, throughout his generations. It shall not be released in the Jubilee.

kikuyu: Manneen gandoota dallaan itti hin ijaaramin keessa jiran garuu waan akka lafa baadiyyaatti hedamaniif furamuu dandaʼu. Bara Iyyoobeeliyyuuttis ni deebifamu.
english: But the houses of the villages which have no wall around them shall be accounted for with the fields of the country: they may be redeemed, and they shall be released in the Jubilee.

kikuyu: “ ‘Lewwonni garuu manneen isaanii kanneen magaalaawwan isaanii keessatti argaman furachuuf yeroo kam iyyuu mirga qabu.
english: “‘Nevertheless, in the cities of the Levites, the Levites may redeem the houses in the cities of their possession at any time.

kikuyu: Qabeenyi Lewwotaa furamuu ni dandaʼa; manneen magaalaa isaan qabatan keessatti gurguraman bara Iyyoobeeliyyuutti ni deebifamu; manneen magaalaa Lewwotaa keessatti argaman Israaʼeloota gidduutti qabeenya Lewwotaatii.
english: The Levites may redeem the house that was sold, and the city of his possession, and it shall be released in the Jubilee; for the houses of the cities of the Levites are their possession among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Lafti dheedaa kan naannoo magaalaa isaaniitti argamu garuu sababii qabeenya isaanii kan bara baraa taʼeef hin gurguramin.
english: But the field of the pasture lands of their cities may not be sold, for it is their perpetual possession.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo obboleessi kee tokko hiyyoomee isin gidduutti of gargaaruu dadhabe, akka inni isin gidduu jiraachuu dandaʼuuf akkuma alagaa yookaan keessummaa tokko gargaartutti isa gargaar.
english: “‘If your brother has become poor, and his hand can’t support himself among you, then you shall uphold him. He shall live with you like an alien and a temporary resident.

kikuyu: Akka namni sun si wajjin jiraachuu dandaʼuuf Waaqa kee sodaadhu malee dhala tokko iyyuu isa irraa hin fudhatin.
english: Take no interest from him or profit; but fear your God, that your brother may live among you.

kikuyu: Maallaqa kee dhalaan hin liqeessiniif yookaan nyaata kee buʼaa itti herregattee hin kenniniif.
english: You shall not lend him your money at interest, nor give him your food for profit.

kikuyu: Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan kan biyya Kanaʼaan isiniif kennuu fi Waaqa keessan taʼuuf biyya Gibxii isin baasee dha.
english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to give you the land of Canaan, and to be your God.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo obboleessi kee tokko hiyyoomee sitti of gurgure akka garbichaatti isa hin hojjechiifatin.
english: “‘If your brother has grown poor among you, and sells himself to you, you shall not make him to serve as a slave.

kikuyu: Inni akka hojjetaa qaxaramaa yookaan nama yeroodhaaf isin wajjin jiraatuu haa taʼu; inni hamma Waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuutti siif haa hojjetu.
english: As a hired servant, and as a temporary resident, he shall be with you; he shall serve with you until the Year of Jubilee.

kikuyu: Ergasii inni ijoollee isaa wajjin gad haa lakkifamu; inni gara maatii isaatii fi qabeenya abbootii isaatti haa deebiʼu.
english: Then he shall go out from you, he and his children with him, and shall return to his own family, and to the possession of his fathers.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni sababii garboota koo warra ani biyya Gibxiitii baasee fide taʼaniif akka garbootaatti hin gurguramin.
english: For they are my servants, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. They shall not be sold as slaves.

kikuyu: Waaqa kee sodaadhu malee gara jabinaan isaan hin bulchin.
english: You shall not rule over him with harshness, but shall fear your God.

kikuyu: “ ‘Garboonni kee dhiironnii fi dubartoonni saboota naannoo kee jiraatan gidduudhaa haa dhufan; isin isaan keessaa garboota bitachuu dandeessu.
english: “‘As for your male and your female slaves, whom you may have from the nations that are around you, from them you may buy male and female slaves.

kikuyu: Akkasumas keessummoota isin gidduu jiraatanii fi maatii isaanii warra biyya keessanitti dhalatan keessaa garboota bitachuu dandeessu; isaanis qabeenya keessan haa taʼan.
english: Moreover, of the children of the aliens who live among you, of them you may buy, and of their families who are with you, which they have conceived in your land; and they will be your property.

kikuyu: Akka qabeenya dhaalamuutti ijoollee keessanitti dabarsuu dandeessu; bara jireenya isaanii guutuus isaan garboomfachuu dandeessu; Israaʼeloota obboloota keessan taʼan garuu gara jabinaan hin bulchinaa.
english: You may make them an inheritance for your children after you, to hold for a possession. Of them you may take your slaves forever, but over your brothers the children of Israel you shall not rule, one over another, with harshness.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo alagaan yookaan keessummaan si wajjin jiraatu tokko sooromee obboleessi kee immoo hiyyoomee alagaa si wajjin jiraatutti yookaan maatii alagaa sanaatti of gurgure,
english: “‘If an alien or temporary resident with you becomes rich, and your brother beside him has grown poor, and sells himself to the stranger or foreigner living among you, or to a member of the stranger’s family,

kikuyu: inni erga of gurguree booddee furamuuf mirga qaba. Firoota isaa keessaas namni tokko isa furuu dandaʼa.
english: after he is sold he may be redeemed. One of his brothers may redeem him;

kikuyu: Obboleessi abbaa isaa yookaan ilmi obboleessa abbaa isaa yookaan aantee isaa keessaa firri dhiigaa isa furuu dandaʼa. Yookaan inni iyyuu yoo soorome of furuu dandaʼa.
english: or his uncle, or his uncle’s son, may redeem him, or any who is a close relative to him of his family may redeem him; or if he has grown rich, he may redeem himself.

kikuyu: Innii fi namichi isa bite sun waggaa inni itti of gurguree jalqabee hamma waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuutti haa lakkaaʼan. Gatiin furii isaas baayʼina waggoota sanaa irratti hundaaʼa; yeroon inni namicha isa bitate sana bira ture immoo akka nama qacaramee hojjete tokkootti herregama.
english: He shall reckon with him who bought him from the year that he sold himself to him to the Year of Jubilee. The price of his sale shall be according to the number of years; he shall be with him according to the time of a hired servant.

kikuyu: Yoo akka herrega isaaniitti waggoonni baayʼeen hafan inni gatii ittiin bitame sana keessaa harka baayʼee namicha sanaaf deebisuu qaba.
english: If there are yet many years, according to them he shall give back the price of his redemption out of the money that he was bought for.

kikuyu: Yoo waggoonni hamma Waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuutti hafan muraasa taʼan inni waggoota hafan sana herregatee gatii furama isaa haa kaffalu.
english: If there remain but a few years to the year of jubilee, then he shall reckon with him; according to his years of service he shall give back the price of his redemption.

kikuyu: Inni akkuma nama waggaa waggaatti qaxaramu tokkootti isa wajjin haa jiraatu; fuula kee durattis inni gara jabinaan isa hin bulchin.
english: As a servant hired year by year shall he be with him. He shall not rule with harshness over him in your sight.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo inni karaa kanneeniin furamuu baates innii fi ijoolleen isaa Waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuutti furamuu qabu;
english: If he isn’t redeemed by these means, then he shall be released in the Year of Jubilee: he and his children with him.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni garboota kootii. Isaan garboota koo kanneen ani biyya Gibxii baasee fidee dha. Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan.
english: For to me the children of Israel are servants; they are my servants whom I brought out of the land of Egypt. I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: “ ‘Waaqota tolfamoo hin tolfatinaa; fakkii yookaan dhagaa waaqeffannaa hin dhaabbatinaa; fuula isaanii duratti sagaduuf jettaniis biyya keessan keessatti dhagaa soofame hin dhaabinaa. Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan.
english: “‘You shall make for yourselves no idols, and you shall not raise up a carved image or a pillar, and you shall not place any figured stone in your land, to bow down to it; for I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: “ ‘Sanbatoota koo eegaa; iddoo qulqulluu koos kabajaa. Ani Waaqayyo.
english: “‘You shall keep my Sabbaths, and have reverence for my sanctuary. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo isin sirna koo duukaa buutanii ajajawwan koos eegdanii hojii irra oolchitan,
english: “‘If you walk in my statutes and keep my commandments, and do them,

kikuyu: ani yeroo isaatti bokkaa isiniifan kenna; lafti midhaan ishee, mukkeen dirrees ija isaanii ni kennu.
english: then I will give you your rains in their season, and the land shall yield its increase, and the trees of the field shall yield their fruit.

kikuyu: Midhaan dhaʼachuun keessan hamma yeroo ija wayinii cirattaniitti itti fufa; ija wayinii cirachuun keessan hamma yeroo facaasaatti ittuma fufa; isinis nyaata keessan hamma quuftanitti nyaattanii lafa keessan irra nagaadhaan jiraattu.
english: Your threshing shall continue until the vintage, and the vintage shall continue until the sowing time. You shall eat your bread to the full, and dwell in your land safely.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ani biyyattii keessa nagaa nan buusa; isin ni raftu; wanni tokko iyyuu isin hin sodaachisu. Biyyattii keessaa bineensota hamoo nan baasa; goraadeenis biyya keessan keessa hin darbu.
english: “‘I will give peace in the land, and you shall lie down, and no one will make you afraid. I will remove evil animals out of the land, neither shall the sword go through your land.

kikuyu: Isin diinota keessan ni ariitu; isaan immoo goraadeedhaan fuula keessan duratti dhumu.
english: You shall chase your enemies, and they shall fall before you by the sword.

kikuyu: Isin nama shan taatanii nama dhibba tokko ariitu; dhibba tokko taatanii immoo kuma kudhan ariitu; diinonni keessan goraadeedhaan fuula keessan duratti dhumu.
english: Five of you shall chase a hundred, and a hundred of you shall chase ten thousand; and your enemies shall fall before you by the sword.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ani fuula tolaadhaan gara keessan ilaalee akka isin hortanii baayʼattan nan godha; kakuu isin wajjin qabus nan jabeessa.
english: “‘I will have respect for you, make you fruitful, multiply you, and will establish my covenant with you.

kikuyu: Isin midhaan bara darbee nyaachaa utuu inni gombisaa keessaa hin dhumin, midhaan haaraadhaaf iddoo qopheessuuf jettanii midhaan bara darbee sana gad baaftu.
english: You shall eat old supplies long kept, and you shall move out the old because of the new.

kikuyu: Iddoo jireenya kootii isin gidduu nan godhadha; lubbuun koos isin hin balfitu.
english: I will set my tent among you, and my soul won’t abhor you.

kikuyu: Ani isin gidduu jiraadhee Waaqa keessan nan taʼa; isinis saba koo ni taatu.
english: I will walk among you, and will be your God, and you will be my people.

kikuyu: Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan kan akka isin lammata garboota warra Gibxi hin taaneef biyya Gibxii baasee isin fidee dha; ani hidhaa waanjoo keessanii kutee akka isin mataa ol qabattanii deemtan godheera.
english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, that you should not be their slaves. I have broken the bars of your yoke, and made you walk upright.

kikuyu: “ ‘Garuu yoo na dhagaʼuu diddanii ajajawwan kanneen hunda eeguu baattan,
english: “‘But if you will not listen to me, and will not do all these commandments,

kikuyu: yoo sirna koo tuffattanii seera koo balfitan, yoo ajajawwan kanneen hunda eeguu baattanii kakuu koo cabsitan,
english: and if you shall reject my statutes, and if your soul abhors my ordinances, so that you will not do all my commandments, but break my covenant,

kikuyu: ani wantoota kanneen isinittin fida: Isaanis naasuu, dhukkuba nama huqqisu, dhukkuba dhagna nama gubu kan agartuu namaa balleessee jireenya namaa gogsu isinitti nan fida. Isin akkasumaan midhaan facaafattu; diinota keessantu nyaataatii.
english: I also will do this to you: I will appoint terror over you, even consumption and fever, that shall consume the eyes, and make the soul to pine away. You will sow your seed in vain, for your enemies will eat it.

kikuyu: Akka isin diinota keessaniin moʼamtaniif ani fuula isinittan hammaadha; warri isin jibban isin bulchu; isin utuu eenyu iyyuu isin hin ariʼin ni baqattu.
english: I will set my face against you, and you will be struck before your enemies. Those who hate you will rule over you; and you will flee when no one pursues you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo isin wantoota kanneen hunda booddee naa ajajamuu diddan ani cubbuu keessaniif dachaa torba isin adaba.
english: “‘If you in spite of these things will not listen to me, then I will chastise you seven times more for your sins.

kikuyu: Of tuulummaa humna keessanii nan cabsa; samii keessan akka sibiilaa, lafa keessan immoo akka naasii nan godha.
english: I will break the pride of your power, and I will make your sky like iron, and your soil like bronze.

kikuyu: Humni keessan akkasumaan bada; lafti keessan midhaan isaa, mukkeenis ija isaanii hin kennaniitii.
english: Your strength will be spent in vain; for your land won’t yield its increase, neither will the trees of the land yield their fruit.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo isin naan mormitanii na dhagaʼuu diddan, ani akkuma cubbuu keessaniitti dhaʼicha dachaa torba isinitti nan fida.
english: “‘If you walk contrary to me, and won’t listen to me, then I will bring seven times more plagues on you according to your sins.

kikuyu: Anis bineensota bosonaa isinittan erga; isaanis ijoollee keessan isin jalaa ni butatu; horii keessan ni barbadeessu; baayʼinni keessan ni xinnaata; daandiiwwan keessanis duwwaa hafu.
english: I will send the wild animals among you, which will rob you of your children, destroy your livestock, and make you few in number. Your roads will become desolate.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo isin waan kanneeniin deebiʼuu diddanii naan mormuu keessan itti fuftan garuu,
english: “‘If by these things you won’t be turned back to me, but will walk contrary to me,

kikuyu: ani mataan koo isiniinan morma; sababii cubbuu keessaniitiifis dachaa torba isin nan miidha.
english: then I will also walk contrary to you; and I will strike you, even I, seven times for your sins.

kikuyu: Kakuu cabsuu keessaniifis goraadee isinitti fidee haaloo isin nan baafadha. Yommuu isin gara magaalaawwan keessaniitti baqattanitti ani gidduu keessanitti dhaʼicha nan erga; isinis dabarfamtanii harka diinotaatti kennamtu.
english: I will bring a sword upon you that will execute the vengeance of the covenant. You will be gathered together within your cities, and I will send the pestilence among you. You will be delivered into the hand of the enemy.

kikuyu: Yommuu ani madda buddeena keessanii gogsutti, dubartoonni kudhan eelee tokkotti buddeena tolchu, isaanis buddeena sana madaalanii isinii kennu; isin ni nyaattu; garuu hin quuftan.
english: When I break your staff of bread, ten women shall bake your bread in one oven, and they shall deliver your bread again by weight. You shall eat, and not be satisfied.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo isin waan kanaanis na dhagaʼuu diddanii garuu naan mormuutti fuftan,
english: “‘If you in spite of this won’t listen to me, but walk contrary to me,

kikuyu: anis aaree isiniin nan morma; ani mataan koo sababii cubbuu keessaniitiif dachaa torba isiniinan adaba.
english: then I will walk contrary to you in wrath. I will also chastise you seven times for your sins.

kikuyu: Isin foon ilmaan keessaniitii fi foon intallan keessanii ni nyaattu.
english: You will eat the flesh of your sons, and you will eat the flesh of your daughters.

kikuyu: Iddoowwan sagadaa keessan barbadeessee iddoowwan aarsaa ixaanaa keessan nan caccabsa; reeffa keessanis waaqota keessan warra lubbuu hin qabne sana irra nan tuula; isinis nan balfa.
english: I will destroy your high places, and cut down your incense altars, and cast your dead bodies upon the bodies of your idols; and my soul will abhor you.

kikuyu: Magaalaawwan keessan nan diiga; iddoowwan qulqulluu keessan nan onsa; urgaa keessan gammachiisaas hin urgeeffadhu.
english: I will lay your cities waste, and will bring your sanctuaries to desolation. I will not take delight in the sweet fragrance of your offerings.

kikuyu: Ani akka diinonni keessan kanneen achi jiraatan rifataniif biyyattii nan onsa;
english: I will bring the land into desolation, and your enemies who dwell in it will be astonished at it.

kikuyu: ani saboota gidduu isin nan bittinneessa; goraadee koo luqqifadhees isin nan ariʼa. Biyyi keessan ni ona; magaalaawwan keessan immoo ni diigamu.
english: I will scatter you among the nations, and I will draw out the sword after you. Your land will be a desolation, and your cities shall be a waste.

kikuyu: Biyyattiinis yeroo ontee isin biyya diinota keessanii keessa jiraattanitti sanbata isheetti ni gammaddi; laftis boqottee sanbata isheetti gammaddi.
english: Then the land will enjoy its Sabbaths as long as it lies desolate and you are in your enemies’ land. Even then the land will rest and enjoy its Sabbaths.

kikuyu: Biyyattiin yeroo onte kana hunda boqonnaa sanbatootaa kan yeroo isin ishee irra jiraattanitti hin argatin ni argatti.
english: As long as it lies desolate it shall have rest, even the rest which it didn’t have in your Sabbaths when you lived on it.

kikuyu: “ ‘Warra isin keessaa hafan, ani utuma isaan biyya diinota isaanii jiranuu garaa isaaniitti naasuu nan buusa. Sagaleen baala qilleensi raasuu isaan ariʼa; utuma namni isaan ariʼu tokko illee hin jiraatin isaan akkuma waan goraadee jalaa baqataniitti fiigu; ni kukkufus.
english: “‘As for those of you who are left, I will send a faintness into their hearts in the lands of their enemies. The sound of a driven leaf will put them to flight; and they shall flee, as one flees from the sword. They will fall when no one pursues.

kikuyu: Namni isaan ariʼu jiraachuu baatu illee isaan akkuma waan goraadee jalaa baqataniitti wal gufachiisu. Isin fuula diinota keessanii dura dhaabachuu hin dandeessan.
english: They will stumble over one another, as it were before the sword, when no one pursues. You will have no power to stand before your enemies.

kikuyu: Isin saboota ormaa gidduutti dhumtu; lafti diinota keessaniis isin liqimsiti.
english: You will perish among the nations. The land of your enemies will eat you up.

kikuyu: Warri isin keessaa hafan immoo sababii cubbuu isaaniitiif lafa diinota isaanii keessatti badu; sababii cubbuu abbootii isaaniitiinis ni badu.
english: Those of you who are left will pine away in their iniquity in your enemies’ lands; and also in the iniquities of their fathers they shall pine away with them.

kikuyu: “ ‘Garuu yoo isaan cubbuu isaaniitii fi cubbuu abbootii isaanii jechuunis gantummaa fi daba isaan natti hojjetan
english: “‘If they confess their iniquity and the iniquity of their fathers, in their trespass which they trespassed against me; and also that because they walked contrary to me,

kikuyu: kan akka ani isaaniin mormuu fi akka ani biyya diinota isaaniitti isaan ergu himatan, yoo garaan isaanii kan dhagna hin qabatin sun gad of deebisee isaan gatii cubbuu isaaniitiif malu baasan,
english: I also walked contrary to them, and brought them into the land of their enemies; if then their uncircumcised heart is humbled, and they then accept the punishment of their iniquity,

kikuyu: ani kakuu koo kanan Yaaqoob wajjin gale, kakuu koo kanan Yisihaaq wajjin gale, kakuu koo kanan Abrahaam wajjin gale sana nan yaadadha; biyyattiis nan yaadadha.
english: then I will remember my covenant with Jacob, my covenant with Isaac, and also my covenant with Abraham; and I will remember the land.

kikuyu: Lafti isaan malee hafti; yeroo isaan malee haftuttis sanbatoota isheetti ni gammaddi. Isaan sababii seera koo tuffatanii ajaja koos balfaniif gatii cubbuu isaanii ni baasu.
english: The land also will be left by them, and will enjoy its Sabbaths while it lies desolate without them; and they will accept the punishment of their iniquity because they rejected my ordinances, and their soul abhorred my statutes.

kikuyu: Taʼus utuu isaan biyya diinota isaanii keessa jiranuu ani kakuu koo kanan isaan wajjin gale sana cabsee guutumaan guutuutti isaan balleessuuf jedhee isaan hin tuffadhu yookaan isaan hin balfu. Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa isaanii ti.
english: Yet for all that, when they are in the land of their enemies, I will not reject them, neither will I abhor them, to destroy them utterly and to break my covenant with them; for I am the LORD their God.

kikuyu: Garuu ani isaaniif jedhee kakuu ani abbootii isaanii warra ani Waaqa isaanii taʼuuf utuu saboonni arganuu biyya Gibxiitii baasee fide sana wajjin gale nan yaadadha. Ani Waaqayyo.’ ”
english: But I will for their sake remember the covenant of their ancestors, whom I brought out of the land of Egypt in the sight of the nations, that I might be their God. I am the LORD.’”

kikuyu: Kunneen labsiiwwan, seerawwanii fi qajeelcha Waaqayyo Gaara Siinaa irratti harka Museetiin ofii isaatii fi Israaʼeloota gidduutti baasee dha.
english: These are the statutes, ordinances, and laws, which the LORD made between him and the children of Israel in Mount Sinai by Moses.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akkana jedhii Israaʼelootatti himi: ‘Namni yoo gatii wal madaalu kennuudhaan Waaqayyoof nama kennuuf wareega addaa godhe,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and say to them, ‘When a man consecrates a person to the LORD in a vow, according to your valuation,

kikuyu: dhiira umuriin isaa waggaa digdamaa hamma jaatamaa taʼeef, akka safartuu saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti herregni isaa meetii saqilii shantama haa taʼu.
english: your valuation of a male from twenty years old to sixty years old shall be fifty shekels of silver, according to the shekel of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Yoo dubartii taate immoo herregni ishee meetii saqilii soddoma haa taʼu.
english: If she is a female, then your valuation shall be thirty shekels.

kikuyu: Yoo nama umuriin isaa waggaa shanii fi digdama gidduu taʼe, herregni dhiiraa meetii saqilii digdamatti, kan dubartii immoo meetii saqilii kudhanitti haa herregamu.
english: If the person is from five years old to twenty years old, then your valuation shall be for a male twenty shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

kikuyu: Nama umuriin isaa jiʼa tokkoo hamma waggaa shanii taʼe immoo herregni isaa, dhiiraaf meetii saqilii shan, durbaaf immoo meetii saqilii sadii haa taʼu.
english: If the person is from a month old to five years old, then your valuation shall be for a male five shekels of silver, and for a female your valuation shall be three shekels of silver.

kikuyu: Namni umuriin isaa waggaa jaatama yookaan sanaa ol taʼe dhiirri meetii saqilii kudha shanitti, dubartiin immoo meetii saqilii kudhanitti haa herregamu.
english: If the person is from sixty years old and upward; if he is a male, then your valuation shall be fifteen shekels, and for a female ten shekels.

kikuyu: Namni wareega wareegu hiyyoomee gatii murtaaʼe sana yoo baasuu dadhabe, Museen nama sana lubatti haa fidu; lubni immoo akkuma dandeettii namicha wareega wareege sanaatti gatii isaa haa herreguuf.
english: But if he is poorer than your valuation, then he shall be set before the priest, and the priest shall assign a value to him. The priest shall assign a value according to his ability to pay.

kikuyu: “ ‘Wanni namichi sun wareege horii fuula Waaqayyoo duratti aarsaa fudhatama qabu yoo taʼe horiin Waaqayyoof kenname kan akkasii hundi ni qulqullaaʼa.
english: “‘If it is an animal of which men offer an offering to the LORD, all that any man gives of such to the LORD becomes holy.

kikuyu: Namichis horii sana geeddaruu yookaan horii gaarii horii jibbamaan yookaan horii jibbamaa horii gaarii iddoo hin buusin; yoo inni horii tokko horii biraa iddoo buuse horiin lamaanuu qulqulluu taʼu.
english: He shall not alter it, nor exchange it, a good for a bad, or a bad for a good. If he shall at all exchange animal for animal, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy.

kikuyu: Yoo horiin inni wareege sun akka seeraatti xuraaʼaa jechuunis kan Waaqayyoof aarsaa taʼee dhiʼaachuu hin dandeenye taʼe namichi sun horii sana gara lubatti haa fidu;
english: If it is any unclean animal, of which they do not offer as an offering to the LORD, then he shall set the animal before the priest;

kikuyu: lubichis akka horiin sun gaarii yookaan jibbamaa taʼe haa madaalu. Gatiin lubni madaale akkasuma haa taʼu.
english: and the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall be.

kikuyu: Namichi sun yoo horii sana furachuu barbaade gatii herregame sanatti harka shan keessaa harka tokko itti dabaluu qaba.
english: But if he will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of it to its valuation.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo namni tokko mana ofii Waaqayyoof qulqulleesse, akka manni sun gaarii yookaan gadhee taʼe lubichi gatii isaa haa herregu. Gatiin lubni madaale akkasuma haa taʼu.
english: “‘When a man dedicates his house to be holy to the LORD, then the priest shall evaluate it, whether it is good or bad. As the priest evaluates it, so it shall stand.

kikuyu: Namichi mana isaa Waaqaaf qulqulleesse sun yoo mana ofii furachuu barbaade, gatii herregame sanatti harka shan keessaa harka tokko itti dabaluu qaba; manni sunis deebiʼee kan isaa taʼa.
english: If he who dedicates it will redeem his house, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall be his.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo namni lafa dhaalaan argate irraa Waaqayyoof qulqulleesse gatiin lafa sanaa akkuma baayʼina sanyii lafa sanaaf barbaachisuutti jechuunis garbuun safartuun homeerii tokko meetii saqilii shantamatti herregama.
english: “‘If a man dedicates to the LORD part of the field of his possession, then your valuation shall be according to the seed for it. The sowing of a homer of barley shall be valued at fifty shekels of silver.

kikuyu: Yoo inni lafa qotiisaa isaa Waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuu keessa qulqulleesse gatiin duraan hedame sun hin geeddaramu.
english: If he dedicates his field from the Year of Jubilee, according to your valuation it shall stand.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo inni waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuu booddee lafa qotiisaa isaa qulqulleesse lubichi akkuma baayʼina waggoota hamma waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuu itti aanuutti jiraniitti herrega; gatiin shallagame gad buʼa.
english: But if he dedicates his field after the Jubilee, then the priest shall reckon to him the money according to the years that remain to the Year of Jubilee; and an abatement shall be made from your valuation.

kikuyu: Yoo namichi lafa qotiisaa isaa Waaqaaf addaan baasu sun lafa qotiisaa isaa furachuu barbaade, inni gatii hedametti harka shan keessaa harka tokko haa dabalu; lafti qotiisaa sunis deebiʼee kan isaa taʼa.
english: If he who dedicated the field will indeed redeem it, then he shall add the fifth part of the money of your valuation to it, and it shall remain his.

kikuyu: Taʼus yoo inni lafa qotiisaa sana furachuu baate, yookaan dabarsee nama biraatti gurgure, lafti qotiisaa sun deebiʼee furamuu hin dandaʼu.
english: If he will not redeem the field, or if he has sold the field to another man, it shall not be redeemed any more;

kikuyu: Lafti qotiisaa sun yommuu Waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuu keessa gad dhiifamutti akkuma lafa qotiisaa Waaqayyoof kennameetti addaan baafama; kunis qabeenya lubootaa taʼa.
english: but the field, when it goes out in the Jubilee, shall be holy to the LORD, as a devoted field. It shall be owned by the priests.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo namni tokko lafa qotiisaa dhaalaan hin argatin kan ofii isaatii bitate Waaqayyoof qulqulleesse,
english: “‘If he dedicates a field to the LORD which he has bought, which is not of the field of his possession,

kikuyu: lubni gatii lafa qotiisaa sanaa hamma Waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuutti herrega; namichis gatii herregame sana gaafuma sana kan Waaqayyoof qulqulleeffame godhee haa baasu.
english: then the priest shall reckon to him the worth of your valuation up to the Year of Jubilee; and he shall give your valuation on that day, as a holy thing to the LORD.

kikuyu: Waggaa Iyyoobeeliyyuuttis lafti qotiisaa sun namichuma irraa bitame kan abbaa lafa qotiisaa sanaa tureef ni deebiʼa.
english: In the Year of Jubilee the field shall return to him from whom it was bought, even to him to whom the possession of the land belongs.

kikuyu: Gatiin hundinuu akka madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti jechuunis geeraan digdamni saqilii tokkootti herregama.
english: All your valuations shall be according to the shekel of the sanctuary: twenty gerahs to the shekel.

kikuyu: “ ‘Taʼus namni tokko iyyuu horii hangafa qulqulleessuu hin dandaʼu; hangafti duraanuu Waaqayyoof qulqulleeffameeraatii; sangaas taʼu hoolaan hangafni kan Waaqayyoo ti.
english: “‘However the firstborn among animals, which belongs to the LORD as a firstborn, no man may dedicate, whether an ox or a sheep. It is the LORD’s.

kikuyu: Yoo horiin sun xuraaʼaa taʼe inni gatii herregame irratti harka shan keessaa harka tokko dabalee deebisee bitachuu dandaʼa. Yoo inni furachuu baate immoo horiin sun gatii isaaf herregametti gurgurama.
english: If it is an unclean animal, then he shall buy it back according to your valuation, and shall add to it the fifth part of it; or if it isn’t redeemed, then it shall be sold according to your valuation.

kikuyu: “ ‘Garuu wanni namni qabu kan inni Waaqayyoof qulqulleessu tokko illee jechuunis namas taʼu horiin yookaan lafti dhaalaan argame hin gurguramu yookaan hin furamu. Wanni akkasiin qulqulleeffame hundinuu akka malee Waaqayyoof qulqulluudhaatii.
english: “‘Notwithstanding, no devoted thing that a man devotes to the LORD of all that he has, whether of man or animal, or of the field of his possession, shall be sold or redeemed. Everything that is permanently devoted is most holy to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Namni akka ajjeefamuuf murteeffame tokko illee hin furamu; inni ajjeefamuu qaba.
english: “‘No one devoted to destruction, who shall be devoted from among men, shall be ransomed. He shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: “ ‘Wanni lafti baaftu kam iyyuu sanyiis taʼu ija mukaa harka kudhan keessaa harki tokko kan Waaqayyoo ti; kun waan Waaqayyoof qulqulleeffamee dha.
english: “‘All the tithe of the land, whether of the seed of the land or of the fruit of the trees, is the LORD’s. It is holy to the LORD.

kikuyu: Namni yoo kennaa isaa kan harka kudhan keessaa harka tokko taʼe sana furachuu barbaade inni gatii kennaa sanaaf herregame irratti harka shan keessaa harka tokko dabalee haa baasu.
english: If a man redeems anything of his tithe, he shall add a fifth part to it.

kikuyu: Kennaan karra loonii fi bushaayee guutuu keessaa harka kudhan keessaa harka tokko taʼe jechuunis horiin ulee tiksee jala baʼee darbu hunda keessaa harka kudhan keessaa harki tokko Waaqayyoof qulqullaaʼa.
english: All the tithe of the herds or the flocks, whatever passes under the rod, the tenth shall be holy to the LORD.

kikuyu: Inni horii jibbamaa keessaa horii gaarii hin filatin yookaan iddoo hin buusin; yoo inni iddoo buuse horiin lamaanuu qulqulluu taʼu; furamuus hin dandaʼu.’ ”
english: He shall not examine whether it is good or bad, neither shall he exchange it. If he exchanges it at all, then both it and that for which it is exchanged shall be holy. It shall not be redeemed.’”

kikuyu: Kunneen ajajawwan Waaqayyo Gaara Siinaa irratti karaa Museetiin Israaʼelootaaf kennee dha.
english: These are the commandments which the LORD commanded Moses for the children of Israel on Mount Sinai.

kikuyu: Erga sabni Israaʼel biyya Gibxiitii baʼee booddee waggaa lammaffaa keessaa, guyyaa jalqaba jiʼa lammaffaatti Waaqayyo dunkaana wal gaʼii keessatti, Gammoojjii Siinaa keessatti Museetti dubbate. Innis akkana jedheen;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the Tent of Meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

kikuyu: “Waldaa saba Israaʼel hunda lakkaaʼaatii balbala balbalaanii fi maatii maatiidhaan maqaa dhiirotaa tokko tokkoon barreessaa.
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, every male, one by one,

kikuyu: Namoota Israaʼel keessaa dhiirota umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hunda atii fi Aroon kutaa kutaa isaaniitiin lakkaaʼaa.
english: from twenty years old and upward, all who are able to go out to war in Israel. You and Aaron shall count them by their divisions.

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo gosaa keessaa namni hangafa maatii ofii isaa taʼe isin gargaaruu qaba.
english: With you there shall be a man of every tribe, each one head of his fathers’ house.

kikuyu: “Maqaan namoota isin gargaaruu qabanii kanneenii dha: “Gosa Ruubeen keessaa Eliizuur ilma Shedeeʼuur;
english: These are the names of the men who shall stand with you: Of Reuben: Elizur the son of Shedeur.

kikuyu: gosa Simiʼoon keessaa Shilumiiʼeel ilma Zuriishadaayi;
english: Of Simeon: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

kikuyu: gosa Yihuudaa keessaa Nahishoon ilma Amiinaadaab;
english: Of Judah: Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

kikuyu: gosa Yisaakor keessaa Naatnaaʼel ilma Zuuwaar;
english: Of Issachar: Nethanel the son of Zuar.

kikuyu: gosa Zebuuloon keessaa Eliiyaab ilma Heeloon;
english: Of Zebulun: Eliab the son of Helon.

kikuyu: ilmaan Yoosef keessaa: gosa Efreem keessaa Eliishaamaa ilma Amiihuud; gosa Minaasee keessaa Gamaaliʼeel ilma Phedaasuur;
english: Of the children of Joseph: of Ephraim: Elishama the son of Ammihud; of Manasseh: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

kikuyu: gosa Beniyaam keessaa Abiidaan ilma Gaadeyoon,
english: Of Benjamin: Abidan the son of Gideoni.

kikuyu: gosa Daan keessaa Ahiiʼezer ilma Amiishadaay;
english: Of Dan: Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

kikuyu: gosa Aasheer keessaa Fagiʼeel ilma Okraan;
english: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.

kikuyu: gosa Gaad keessaa Eliyaasaaf ilma Deʼuuʼeel;
english: Of Gad: Eliasaph the son of Deuel.

kikuyu: gosa Niftaalem keessaa Ahiiraa ilma Eenaan.”
english: Of Naphtali: Ahira the son of Enan.”

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen warra dura buʼoota gosoota abbootii isaanii taʼanii waldaa sana keessaa filatamanii dha. Isaanis hangafoota balbalawwan Israaʼel turan.
english: These are those who were called of the congregation, the princes of the tribes of their fathers; they were the heads of the thousands of Israel.

kikuyu: Musee fi Aroon namoota maqaan isaanii eerame kanneen fudhatanii,
english: Moses and Aaron took these men who are mentioned by name.

kikuyu: guyyaa jalqaba jiʼa lammaffaatti waldaa hunda walitti waaman. Namoonni sunis akkuma balbalaa fi maatii isaaniitti hidda dhaloota isaanii himatan; dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii maqaan isaanii tokko tokkoon galmeeffame;
english: They assembled all the congregation together on the first day of the second month; and they declared their ancestry by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, one by one.

kikuyu: innis akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti Gammoojjii Siinaa keessatti saba sana lakkaaʼe.
english: As the LORD commanded Moses, so he counted them in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Sanyii Ruubeen ilma Israaʼel hangaftichaa keessaa: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma galmee balbalaa fi maatii isaaniitti tokko tokkoon maqaa maqaadhaan barreeffaman.
english: The children of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Baayʼinni gosa Ruubeen nama 46,500 ture.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Sanyii Simiʼoon keessaa: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma galmee balbalaa fi maatii isaaniitti tokko tokkoon maqaa maqaadhaan barreeffaman.
english: Of the children of Simeon, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, those who were counted of it, according to the number of the names, one by one, every male from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Baayʼinni gosa Simiʼoon nama 59,300 ture.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

kikuyu: Sanyii Gaad keessaa: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma galmee balbalaa fi maatii isaaniitti maqaa maqaadhaan barreeffaman.
english: Of the children of Gad, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Baayʼinni gosa Gaad nama 45,650 ture.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
