kikuyu: Sanyii Yihuudaa keessaa: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma galmee balbalaa fi maatii isaaniitti maqaa maqaadhaan barreeffaman.
english: Of the children of Judah, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Baayʼinni gosa Yihuudaa nama 74,600 ture.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Sanyii Yisaakor keessaa: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma galmee balbalaa fi maatii isaaniitti maqaa maqaadhaan barreeffaman.
english: Of the children of Issachar, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Baayʼinni gosa Yisaakor nama 54,400 ture.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Sanyii Zebuuloon keessaa: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma galmeewwan balbalaa fi maatii isaaniitti maqaa maqaadhaan barreeffaman.
english: Of the children of Zebulun, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Baayʼinni gosa Zebuuloon nama 57,400 ture.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yoosef keessaa: Sanyii Efreem keessaa: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma galmee balbalaa fi maatii isaaniitti maqaa maqaadhaan barreeffaman.
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the children of Ephraim, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Baayʼinni gosa Efreem nama 40,500 ture.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Sanyii Minaasee keessaa: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma galmee balbalaa fi maatii isaaniitti maqaa maqaadhaan barreeffaman.
english: Of the children of Manasseh, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Baayʼinni gosa Minaasee nama 32,200 ture.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Sanyii Beniyaam keessaa: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma galmee balbalaa fi maatii isaaniitti maqaa maqaadhaan barreeffaman.
english: Of the children of Benjamin, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Baayʼinni gosa Beniyaam nama 35,400 ture.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Sanyii Daan keessaa: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma galmee balbalaa fi maatii isaaniitti maqaa maqaadhaan barreeffaman.
english: Of the children of Dan, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Baayʼinni gosa Daan nama 62,700 ture.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

kikuyu: Sanyii Aasheer keessaa: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma galmee balbalaa fi maatii isaaniitti maqaa maqaadhaan barreeffaman.
english: Of the children of Asher, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Baayʼinni gosa Aasheer nama 41,500 ture.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Sanyii Niftaalem keessaa: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen lola dhaquu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma galmee balbalaa fi maatii isaanitti maqaa maqaadhaan barreeffaman.
english: Of the children of Naphtali, their generations, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war:

kikuyu: Baayʼinni gosa Niftaalem nama 53,400 ture.
english: those who were counted of them, of the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Dhiironni kunneen warra Musee fi Aroon hangafoota Israaʼel kudha lamaaniin lakkaaʼaman turan; hangafoonni kunneenis tokkoon tokkoon isaanii iddoo buʼoota maatii isaanii turan.
english: These are those who were counted, whom Moses and Aaron counted, and the twelve men who were princes of Israel, each one for his fathers’ house.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen Israaʼel keessatti lolaaf baʼuu dandaʼan hundinuu akkuma maatii isaaniitti lakkaaʼaman.
english: So all those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses, from twenty years old and upward, all who were able to go out to war in Israel—

kikuyu: Walumaa galatti baayʼinni namaa 603,550 ture.
english: all those who were counted were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Lewwonni garuu akka gosa abbootii isaaniitti warra kaan wajjin hin lakkaaʼamne.
english: But the Levites after the tribe of their fathers were not counted among them.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhee ture:
english: For the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Ati gosa Lewwii hin lakkaaʼin yookaan lakkoobsa saba Israaʼeloota kaaniitti hin dabalin.
english: “Only the tribe of Levi you shall not count, neither shall you take a census of them among the children of Israel;

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa akka Lewwonni itti gaafatamtoota dunkaana dhuga baʼumsaa, miʼa isaa hundaa fi waan inni qabu hundaa taʼaniif isaan muudi. Isaanis dunkaana qulqulluu fi miʼa isaa hunda haa baatan; dunkaanicha haa tajaajilan; naannoo isaas haa qubatan.
english: but appoint the Levites over the Tabernacle of the Testimony, and over all its furnishings, and over all that belongs to it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its furnishings; and they shall take care of it, and shall encamp around it.

kikuyu: Yeroo dunkaanni qulqulluun deemuu qabutti Lewwonni dunkaana sana haa buqqisan; yeroo dunkaanichi dhaabamus Lewwonni haa dhaaban. Namni dunkaanichatti dhiʼaatu biraa haa ajjeefamu.
english: When the tabernacle is to move, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be set up, the Levites shall set it up. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonnis tokkoon tokkoon namaa qubata isaa keessaa fi faajjii isaa jalatti kutaa kutaadhaan dunkaana isaanii haa dhaabbatan.
english: The children of Israel shall pitch their tents, every man by his own camp, and every man by his own standard, according to their divisions.

kikuyu: Taʼus Lewwonni akka dheekkamsi Waaqayyoo waldaa Israaʼelitti gad hin buuneef dunkaanota isaanii naannoo dunkaana dhuga baʼumsaa haa dhadhaabatan. Lewwonni eegumsa dunkaana dhuga baʼumsaatti itti gaafatamtoota taʼuu qabu.”
english: But the Levites shall encamp around the Tabernacle of the Testimony, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the children of Israel. The Levites shall be responsible for the Tabernacle of the Testimony.”

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajaje sanatti waan kana hunda hojjetan.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they did.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Musee fi Arooniin akkana jedhe:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: “Israaʼeloonnis tokkoon tokkoon namaa faajjii ofii isaanii jalatti faajjii maatii isaa wajjin dunkaana irraa xinnuma fagaatee naannoo dunkaana wal gaʼii haa qubatu.”
english: “The children of Israel shall encamp every man by his own standard, with the banners of their fathers’ houses. They shall encamp around the Tent of Meeting at a distance from it.

kikuyu: Gama baʼaatiin, karaa baʼa biiftuutiin: kutaawwan qubata Yihuudaa faajjii isaanii jala haa qubatan. Hoogganaan ijoollee Yihuudaa Nahishoon ilma Amiinaadaabii ti.
english: “Those who encamp on the east side toward the sunrise shall be of the standard of the camp of Judah, according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Judah shall be Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi kutaa isaas namoota 74,600.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Gosti Yisaakor isaanitti aanee haa qubatu. Hoogganaan ijoollee Yisaakor Naatnaaʼel ilma Zuuwaar ture.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar. The prince of the children of Issachar shall be Nethanel the son of Zuar.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi kutaa isaas namoota 54,400.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Gosti Zebuuloon kanatti haa aanu. Hoogganaan ijoollee Zebuuloon Eliiyaab ilma Heeloonii ti.
english: “The tribe of Zebulun: the prince of the children of Zebulun shall be Eliab the son of Helon.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi kutaa isaas namoota 57,400.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Namoonni qubata Yihuudaatti lakkaaʼaman hundis akkuma kutaa kutaa isaaniitti 186,400 turan. Isaanis duraan dursanii qajeelu.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Judah were one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out first.

kikuyu: Gama kibbaatiin: kutaawwan qubata Ruubeen faajjii isaanii jalaan haa qubatan. Hoogganaan ijoollee Ruubeen Eliizuur ilma Shedeeʼuurii ti.
english: “On the south side shall be the standard of the camp of Reuben according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Reuben shall be Elizur the son of Shedeur.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi kutaa isaas namoota 46,500.
english: His division, and those who were counted of it, were forty-six thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Gosti Simiʼoon isaanitti aanee haa qubatu. Hoogganaan gosa Simiʼoon Shilumiiʼeel ilma Zuriishadaayii ti.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon. The prince of the children of Simeon shall be Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi kutaa isaas namoota 59,300.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.

kikuyu: Gosti Gaad isaanitti haa aanu. Hoogganaan gosa Gaad Eliyaasaaf ilma Deʼuuʼeelii ti.
english: “The tribe of Gad: the prince of the children of Gad shall be Eliasaph the son of Reuel.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi kutaa isaas namoota 45,650.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Namoonni qubata Ruubeenitti lakkaaʼaman hundis akkuma kutaa kutaa isaaniitti 151,450 turan. Isaan kunneenis warra duraatti aananii deemu.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Reuben were one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty, according to their armies. They shall set out second.

kikuyu: Ergasiis dunkaanni wal gaʼiitii fi qubanni Lewwotaa qubatawwan gidduu haa deeman. Isaanis akkuma toora qubata isaaniitti tokkoon tokkoon isaanii iddoo isaanii eeggatanii faajjii isaanii jala haa deeman.
english: “Then the Tent of Meeting shall set out, with the camp of the Levites in the middle of the camps. As they encamp, so shall they set out, every man in his place, by their standards.

kikuyu: Gama dhiʼaatiin gareen qubata Efreem faajjii isaanii jalaan haa qubatan. Hoogganaan ilmaan Efreem Eliishaamaa ilma Amiihuudii ti.
english: “On the west side shall be the standard of the camp of Ephraim according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Ephraim shall be Elishama the son of Ammihud.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi kutaa isaas namoota 40,500:
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Gosti Minaasee isaanitti haa aanu. Hoogganaan ijoollee Minaasee Gamaaliʼeel ilma Phedaasuurii ti.
english: “Next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh. The prince of the children of Manasseh shall be Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi kutaa isaas namoota 32,200.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Gosti Beniyaam itti haa aanu. Hoogganaan ilmaan Beniyaam Abiidaan ilma Gaadeyoonii ti.
english: “The tribe of Benjamin: the prince of the children of Benjamin shall be Abidan the son of Gideoni.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi kutaa isaas namoota 35,400:
english: His army, and those who were counted of them, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Namoonni qubata Efreemitti lakkaaʼaman hundis kutaa kutaa isaaniitti 108,100 turan. Isaan kunneen immoo kutaa sadaffaa taʼanii deeman.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Ephraim were one hundred eight thousand one hundred, according to their divisions. They shall set out third.

kikuyu: Gama kaabaatiin kutaawwan qubata Daan faajjii isaanii jalaan haa qubatan. Hoogganaan gosa Daan Ahiiʼezer ilma Amiishadaayii ti.
english: “On the north side shall be the standard of the camp of Dan according to their divisions. The prince of the children of Dan shall be Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi kutaa isaas namoota 62,700.
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.

kikuyu: Gosti Aasheer isaanitti aanee haa qubatu. Hoogganaan ijoollee Aseer Fagiʼeel ilma Okraanii ti.
english: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi kutaa isaas namoota 41,500:
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were forty-one thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Gosti Niftaalemitti haa aanu. Hoogganaan ijoollee Niftaalem Ahiiraa ilma Eenaanii ti.
english: “The tribe of Naphtali: the prince of the children of Naphtali shall be Ahira the son of Enan.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi kutaa isaas namoota 53,400:
english: His division, and those who were counted of them, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Namoonni qubata Daaniitti lakkaaʼaman hundis 157,600 turan. Isaanis dhuma irratti faajjii isaanii jalaan haa deeman.
english: “All who were counted of the camp of Dan were one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last by their standards.”

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen saba Israaʼel warra akkuma maatii isaaniitti lakkaaʼamanii dha. Lakkoobsi warra qubata keessaa kanneen kutaa kutaa isaaniitiin lakkaaʼaman hundaa 603,550.
english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel by their fathers’ houses. All who were counted of the camps according to their armies were six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Lewwonni garuu akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajaje sanatti Israaʼeloota kaan wajjin hin lakkaaʼamne.
english: But the Levites were not counted among the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Akkasiin Israaʼeloonni waan Waaqayyo Musee ajaje hunda hojjetan; isaanis haaluma kanaan faajjii isaanii jala haa qubatan; haaluma kanaanis tokkoon tokkoon isaanii balbalaa fi maatii isaanii wajjin baʼanii haa deeman.
english: Thus the children of Israel did. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so they encamped by their standards, and so they set out, everyone by their families, according to their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Yeroo Waaqayyo Tulluu Siinaa irratti Museetti dubbatetti seenaan sanyii Aroonii fi Musee kanaa dha.
english: Now this is the history of the generations of Aaron and Moses in the day that the LORD spoke with Moses in Mount Sinai.

kikuyu: Maqaan ilmaan Aroon: Naadaab hangafticha, Abiihuu, Eleʼaazaarii fi Iitaamaar.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron: Nadab the firstborn, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Kunneen maqaawwan ilmaan Aroon jechuunis luboota muudaman kanneen akka luboota taʼanii tajaajilaniif dibaman sanaa ti.
english: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the priests who were anointed, whom he consecrated to minister in the priest’s office.

kikuyu: Naadaabii fi Abiihuu garuu yeroo Gammoojjii Siinaa keessatti ibidda hin eeyyamamin fuula Waaqayyoo duratti dhiʼeessanitti fuuluma isaa duratti duʼan. Isaan ilmaan tokko illee hin qaban ture. Kanaafuu Eleʼaazaarii fi Iitaamaar bara abbaan isaanii Aroon lubbuun jiraatetti luboota taʼanii tajaajilan.
english: Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they offered strange fire before the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no children. Eleazar and Ithamar ministered in the priest’s office in the presence of Aaron their father.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Gosa Lewwii fidiitii akka isaan Aroon lubicha gargaaraniif isa dura dhaabi.
english: “Bring the tribe of Levi near, and set them before Aaron the priest, that they may minister to him.

kikuyu: Isaanis hojii dunkaana qulqulluu hojjechuudhaan waan isa irraa barbaadamuu fi waan waldaa hunda irraa barbaadamu fuula dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti haa raawwatan.
english: They shall keep his requirements, and the requirements of the whole congregation before the Tent of Meeting, to do the service of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Isaan hojii dunkaana qulqulluu hojjetanii dirqama Israaʼelootaa guutuudhaan miʼa dunkaana wal gaʼii hunda haa eegan.
english: They shall keep all the furnishings of the Tent of Meeting, and the obligations of the children of Israel, to do the service of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Lewwota sana Aroonii fi ilmaan isaatti kenni; isaan warra saba Israaʼel keessaa guutumaan guutuutti isatti kennamanii dha.
english: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons. They are wholly given to him on the behalf of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ati akka isaan luboota taʼanii tajaajilaniif Aroonii fi ilmaan isaa muudi; namni biraa kan iddoo qulqulluu sanatti dhiʼaatu garuu ajjeefamuu qaba.”
english: You shall appoint Aaron and his sons, and they shall keep their priesthood, but the stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Kunoo ani Israaʼeloota keessaa qooda dhiira hangafa dubartoota Israaʼel hundaa Lewwota fudhadheera. Lewwonni kan koo ti;
english: “Behold, I have taken the Levites from among the children of Israel instead of all the firstborn who open the womb among the children of Israel; and the Levites shall be mine,

kikuyu: hangafti hundinuu kan kootii. Ani yeroo biyya Gibxi keessatti hangafa hunda ajjeesetti hangafa Israaʼel hunda jechuunis namas taʼu horii ofii kootiif addaan baafadheera. Isaan kan koo taʼan. Ani Waaqayyo.”
english: for all the firstborn are mine. On the day that I struck down all the firstborn in the land of Egypt I made holy to me all the firstborn in Israel, both man and animal. They shall be mine. I am the LORD.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Gammoojjii Siinaa keessatti Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,

kikuyu: “Lewwota maatii isaaniitii fi balbala isaaniitiin lakkaaʼi. Dhiira jiʼa tokkoo yookaan hammasii olii hunda lakkaaʼi.”
english: “Count the children of Levi by their fathers’ houses, by their families. You shall count every male from a month old and upward.”

kikuyu: Museen akkuma dubbiin Waaqayyoo isa ajajetti isaan lakkaaʼe.
english: Moses counted them according to the LORD’s word, as he was commanded.

kikuyu: Kunneen maqaawwan ilmaan Lewwii ti: Geershoon, Qohaatii fi Meraarii.
english: These were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Kunneen maqaawwan ilmaan Geershoonii ti: Loobeenii fi Shimeʼii.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershon by their families: Libni and Shimei.

kikuyu: Balbalawwan Qohaatotaa: Amraam, Yizihaar, Kebroonii fi Uziiʼeel.
english: The sons of Kohath by their families: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kikuyu: Balbalawwan Meraarotaa: Mahilii fi Muusii.
english: The sons of Merari by their families: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Balbalawwan Liibnii fi Shimeʼii kan Geershoon turan; isaanis balbalawwan Geershoonotaa ti.
english: Of Gershon was the family of the Libnites, and the family of the Shimeites. These are the families of the Gershonites.

kikuyu: Baayʼinni dhiirota umuriin isaanii jiʼa tokkoo fi hammasii olii kanneen lakkaaʼaman hundaa 7,500 ture.
english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, even those who were counted of them were seven thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Balbalawwan Geershoonotaa karaa lixa biiftuutiin dunkaana qulqulluu dugda duubaan qubatan.
english: The families of the Gershonites shall encamp behind the tabernacle westward.

kikuyu: Hoogganaan balbalawwan Geershoonotaas Eliyaasaaf ilma Laaʼel ture.
english: Eliasaph the son of Lael shall be the prince of the fathers’ house of the Gershonites.

kikuyu: Itti gaafatamni Geershoononni dunkaana wal gaʼii keessatti qabanis dunkaana qulqulluu, dunkaanaa fi irra buusaa isaa, golgaa balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii irra jiru,
english: The duty of the sons of Gershon in the Tent of Meeting shall be the tabernacle, the tent, its covering, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: golgaawwan oobdii, golgaa balbala dallaa kan dunkaana qulqulluu fi iddoo aarsaatti naannaʼee jiru, funyoo fi tajaajila akkanaa kennu hunda eeguu ture.
english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all of its service.

kikuyu: Balbalawwan Amraamotaa, Yizihaarotaa, Kebroonotaa fi Uziiʼeelotaa balbalawwan Qohaatii ti; isaanis balbalawwan Qohaatotaa turan.
english: Of Kohath was the family of the Amramites, the family of the Izharites, the family of the Hebronites, and the family of the Uzzielites. These are the families of the Kohathites.

kikuyu: Baayʼinni dhiirota jiʼa tokkoo fi hammasii olii hundaa 8,600 ture. Qohaatonni iddoo qulqulluu sana eeguutti itti gaafatamtoota turan.
english: According to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred keeping the requirements of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Balbalawwan Qohaatotaa karaa kibba dunkaana qulqulluutiin qubatan.
english: The families of the sons of Kohath shall encamp on the south side of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Hoogganaan maatiiwwan balbalawwan Qohaatotaas Eliisaafaan ilma Uziiʼeel ture.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of the Kohathites shall be Elizaphan the son of Uzziel.

kikuyu: Isaanis taabota, minjaala, baattuu ibsaa, iddoowwan aarsaa, miʼa iddoo qulqulluu ittiin tajaajilan, golgaa fi wantoota tajaajila akkanaa kennan hunda eeguutti itti gaafatamtoota turan.
english: Their duty shall be the ark, the table, the lamp stand, the altars, the vessels of the sanctuary with which they minister, the screen, and all its service.

kikuyu: Hoogganaan Lewwotaa hangafti Eleʼaazaar ilma Aroon lubichaa ture. Innis warra itti gaafatamtoota eegumsa iddoo qulqulluu turan sana irratti dibame.
english: Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be prince of the princes of the Levites, with the oversight of those who keep the requirements of the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Balbalawwan Mahelootaa fi Muusotaa kan Meraarii turan; isaanis balbalawwan Meraarotaa ti.
english: Of Merari was the family of the Mahlites and the family of the Mushites. These are the families of Merari.

kikuyu: Baayʼinni dhiirota umuriin isaanii jiʼa tokkoo fi hammasii olii kanneen lakkaaʼaman hundaa 6,200 ture.
english: Those who were counted of them, according to the number of all the males from a month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Hoogganaan maatiiwwan balbalawwan Meraarotaas Zuriiʼel ilma Abiihaayilii ti; isaanis karaa kaaba dunkaana qulqullummaatiin qubatan.
english: The prince of the fathers’ house of the families of Merari was Zuriel the son of Abihail. They shall encamp on the north side of the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Meraaronnis tuggeewwan dunkaana qulqulluu, dagaleewwan isaa, utubaawwan isaa, miillawwan isaa, miʼa isaa hundaa fi wantoota tajaajila akkanaa kennan hunda,
english: The appointed duty of the sons of Merari shall be the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets, all its instruments, all its service,

kikuyu: akkasumas utubaawwan oobdii sanatti naannaʼanii jiran, miillawwan isaanii, qofoo dunkaanaa fi funyoowwan isaa eeguuf muudaman.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, and their cords.

kikuyu: Museen, Aroonii fi ilmaan Aroon dunkaana qulqulluu irraa karaa baʼaa, qixa baʼa biiftuutiin fuula dunkaana wal gaʼii dura qubatan. Isaanis iddoo Israaʼelootaa buʼanii iddoo qulqulluu eeguutti itti gaafatamtoota turan. Namni biraa kan iddoo qulqulluu sanatti dhiʼaatu haa ajjeefamu.
english: Those who encamp before the tabernacle eastward, in front of the Tent of Meeting toward the sunrise, shall be Moses, with Aaron and his sons, keeping the requirements of the sanctuary for the duty of the children of Israel. The outsider who comes near shall be put to death.

kikuyu: Lewwonni lakkaaʼaman hundi kanneen Musee fi Aroon ajaja Waaqayyootiin akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti lakkaaʼan, dhiironni jiʼa tokkoo fi hammasii olii hundi 22,000 turan.
english: All who were counted of the Levites, whom Moses and Aaron counted at the commandment of the LORD, by their families, all the males from a month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Dhiirota Israaʼel hangafoota kanneen jiʼa tokkootii fi hammasii olii hunda lakkaaʼii maqaa isaanii barreessi.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Count all the firstborn males of the children of Israel from a month old and upward, and take the number of their names.

kikuyu: Qooda ijoollee Israaʼel kanneen hangafa taʼan hundaa Lewwota naa fudhadhu; qooda ilmaan hangafa horii Israaʼelootaa hundaas horii Lewwotaa naa fudhadhu. Ani Waaqayyo.”
english: You shall take the Levites for me—I am the LORD—instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel; and the livestock of the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the livestock of the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Museen akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajajetti hangafoota Israaʼel hunda lakkaaʼe.
english: Moses counted, as the LORD commanded him, all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Dhiironni hangafoonni jiʼa tokkoo fi hammasii olii kanneen maqaa maqaan barreeffaman hundii 22,273 turan.
english: All the firstborn males according to the number of names from a month old and upward, of those who were counted of them, were twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Qooda ijoollee Israaʼel kanneen hangafa taʼan hundaa Lewwota fudhadhu; qooda horii Israaʼelootaas horii Lewwotaa fudhadhu. Lewwonni kan koo ti. Ani Waaqayyo.
english: “Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites instead of their livestock; and the Levites shall be mine. I am the LORD.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloota hangafoota 273 kanneen baayʼina Lewwotaa caalan furuuf,
english: For the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three of the firstborn of the children of Israel who exceed the number of the Levites,

kikuyu: tokkoo tokkoo isaaniitiif akkuma madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti saqilii shan shan fuudhi; saqiliin tokko geeraa digdama.
english: you shall take five shekels apiece for each one; according to the shekel of the sanctuary you shall take them (the shekel is twenty gerahs);

kikuyu: Maallaqa Israaʼeloota dabalaman furuuf fuudhame sanas Aroonii fi ilmaan isaatti kenni.”
english: and you shall give the money, with which their remainder is redeemed, to Aaron and to his sons.”

kikuyu: Museen maallaqa sana Israaʼeloota lakkoobsaan warra Lewwotaan furamaniin ol taʼan sana irraa fuudhe.
english: Moses took the redemption money from those who exceeded the number of those who were redeemed by the Levites;

kikuyu: Innis akka madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti meetii saqilii 1,365 ulfaattu Israaʼeloota hangafa irraa fuudhe.
english: from the firstborn of the children of Israel he took the money, one thousand three hundred sixty-five shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

kikuyu: Museenis akkuma dubbii Waaqayyootti, akkuma Waaqni Musee ajajetti maallaqa furii sana Aroonii fi ilmaan isaatti kenne.
english: and Moses gave the redemption money to Aaron and to his sons, according to the LORD’s word, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Musee fi Arooniin akkana jedhe:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: “Lewwota keessaa gosa Qohaatotaa balbala balbalaa fi maatii maatii isaaniitiin lakkaaʼi.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

kikuyu: Dhiirota umuriin isaanii waggaa soddomaa hamma shantamaa kanneen hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii hojjechuuf dhufan hunda lakkaaʼi.
english: from thirty years old and upward even until fifty years old, all who enter into the service to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: “Hojiin Qohaatonni wantoota waan hunda caalaa qulqulluu taʼaniin wal qabatee dunkaana wal gaʼii keessatti hojjetan kanaa dha.
english: “This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the Tent of Meeting, regarding the most holy things.

kikuyu: Yommuu qubanni deemuuf kaʼutti Aroonii fi ilmaan isaa ol galanii golgaa daʼeessu sana gad haa buusan; golgaa sanaanis taabota kakuu seeraatti haa haguugan.
english: When the camp moves forward, Aaron shall go in with his sons; and they shall take down the veil of the screen, cover the ark of the Testimony with it,

kikuyu: Waan kanattis gogaa duugame uffisanii huccuu bifti isaa guutumaan guutuutti cuquliisa taʼe irraan haa afan. Danqaraawwanis iddoo iddoo isaanii keessa haa galchan.
english: put a covering of sealskin on it, spread a blue cloth over it, and put in its poles.

kikuyu: “Isaanis huccuu bifa cuquliisaa tokko minjaala Buddeena Ilaalchaatti uffisanii gabatee, caabii fi waciitii akkasumas okkotee ittiin dhibaayyuu dhiʼeessan isa irra haa kaaʼan; buddeenni yeroo hunda achii hin dhabamne sunis isa irra haa kaaʼamu.
english: “On the table of show bread they shall spread a blue cloth, and put on it the dishes, the spoons, the bowls, and the cups with which to pour out; and the continual bread shall be on it.

kikuyu: Huccuu bildiimaa isaan irra haa diriirsan; gogaa duugame itti haa uwwisan; danqaraawwan isaas iddoo isaanii keessa haa galchan.
english: They shall spread on them a scarlet cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

kikuyu: “Huccuu bifti isaa cuquliisaa fuudhanii baattuu ibsaa kan ibsuuf tolchame ibsaa isaa wajjin, waan ittiin foʼaa ibsaa kutanii fi baattuu daaraa, meeshaawwan zayitii kanneen hojii kanaaf oolan hundas ittiin haa haguugan.
english: “They shall take a blue cloth and cover the lamp stand of the light, its lamps, its snuffers, its snuff dishes, and all its oil vessels, with which they minister to it.

kikuyu: Ergasiis waan kanaa fi miʼa isaa hunda gogaa duugameen maranii wasaasaa ittiin waa baatan irra haa kaaʼan.
english: They shall put it and all its vessels within a covering of sealskin, and shall put it on the frame.

kikuyu: “Huccuu biftii isaa cuquliisa taʼes iddoo aarsaa kan warqee irraa hojjetametti uffisanii gogaa duugame itti haa haguugan; danqaraawwan isaas iddoo isaanii keessa haa galchan.
english: “On the golden altar they shall spread a blue cloth, and cover it with a covering of sealskin, and shall put in its poles.

kikuyu: “Meeshaawwan ittiin iddoo qulqulluu keessa tajaajilan hundas fuudhanii huccuu bifa cuquliisaatiin maranii gogaa duugameen haguuganii wasaasaa ittiin waa baatan irra haa kaaʼan.
english: “They shall take all the vessels of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, and put them in a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of sealskin, and shall put them on the frame.

kikuyu: “Isaanis iddoo aarsaa irraa daaraa haranii huccuu diimaa dhiilgee itti haa uffisan.
english: “They shall take away the ashes from the altar, and spread a purple cloth on it.

kikuyu: Ergasiis miʼa iddoo aarsaa ittiin tajaajilan hunda, baattuu ibiddaa, qabduuwwan foonii, meeshaa ittiin daaraa hammaaranii fi waciitii isa irra haa kaaʼan. Gogaa duugamee isa irraan haa afan; danqaraawwan isaas iddoo isaanii keessa haa galchan.
english: They shall put on it all its vessels with which they minister about it, the fire pans, the meat hooks, the shovels, and the basins—all the vessels of the altar; and they shall spread on it a covering of sealskin, and put in its poles.

kikuyu: “Erga Aroonii fi ilmaan isaa meeshaawwan qulqulluu sanaa fi miʼa qulqulluu hunda haguuganii fixanii booddee yeroo qubanni sun godaanuuf kaʼutti Qohaatonni miʼa kana baachuudhaaf haa dhufan. Isaan garuu miʼa qulqulluu sana hin tuqin; yoo tuqan ni duʼuutii. Qohaatonni waan dunkaana wal gaʼii keessa jiru hunda haa baatan.
english: “When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sanctuary and all the furniture of the sanctuary, as the camp moves forward; after that, the sons of Kohath shall come to carry it; but they shall not touch the sanctuary, lest they die. The sons of Kohath shall carry these things belonging to the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: “Eleʼaazaar ilmi Aroon lubichaa itti gaafatamaa zayitii ibsaa, ixaana urgaaʼaa, kennaa midhaanii kan yeroo baayʼee dhiʼeeffamuu fi zayitii ittiin dibanii haa taʼu. Inni dunkaana qulqulluu hundaa fi waan isa keessa jiru hundatti, miʼaa fi meeshaawwan isaa qulqulluuttis itti gaafatamaa haa taʼu.”
english: “The duty of Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest shall be the oil for the light, the sweet incense, the continual meal offering, and the anointing oil, the requirements of all the tabernacle, and of all that is in it, the sanctuary, and its furnishings.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Musee fi Arooniin akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: “Balbalawwan gosa Qohaatii Lewwota keessaa hin balleessinaa.
english: “Don’t cut off the tribe of the families of the Kohathites from among the Levites;

kikuyu: Akka isaan yommuu wantoota waan hunda caalaa qulqulluu taʼanitti dhiʼaatanitti, akka lubbuun jiraatan malee hin duuneef waan kana isaaniif godhaa: Aroonii fi ilmaan isaa iddoo qulqulluu seenanii waan tokkoon tokkoon namaa hojjetuu fi baatu haa qoqqoodan.
english: but do this to them, that they may live, and not die, when they approach the most holy things: Aaron and his sons shall go in and appoint everyone to his service and to his burden;

kikuyu: Qohaatonni garuu akka hin duuneef yeroo xinnaaf illee wantoota qulqulluu ilaaluudhaaf ol seenuu hin qaban.”
english: but they shall not go in to see the sanctuary even for a moment, lest they die.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museen akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Geershoonotas maatii maatii isaanii fi balbala balbala isaaniitiin lakkaaʼi.
english: “Take a census of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers’ houses, by their families;

kikuyu: Dhiirota umuriin isaanii waggaa soddomaa hamma shantamaa kanneen hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii hojjechuu dhufan hunda lakkaaʼi.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward until fifty years old: all who enter in to wait on the service, to do the work in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: “Tajaajilli balbalawwan Geershoonotaa hojii hojjechuu fi baʼaa baachuudhaan tajaajilan kanaa dha:
english: “This is the service of the families of the Gershonites, in serving and in bearing burdens:

kikuyu: Isaan golgaa dunkaana qulqulluu, dunkaana wal gaʼii, uffata isaa fi irra buusaa isaa kan gogaa duugame irraa hojjetame, golgaa balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii,
english: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle and the Tent of Meeting, its covering, the covering of sealskin that is on it, the screen for the door of the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: golgaawwan dallaa dunkaana qulqulluu fi iddoo aarsaatti naannaʼee jiru sanaa, golgaa balbala isaa, funyoo fi miʼa tajaajila kanaaf fayyadu hunda baatu. Geershoononni waan wantoota kanaan hojjetamuu qabu hunda haa hojjetan.
english: the hangings of the court, the screen for the door of the gate of the court which is by the tabernacle and around the altar, their cords, and all the instruments of their service, and whatever shall be done with them. They shall serve in there.

kikuyu: Tajaajilli Geershoonotaa hundi baʼaa baachuus taʼu hojiin biraa ajaja Aroonii fi ilmaan isaa kennaniin haa adeemsifamu. Waan isaan baachuu qaban hundas akkuma itti gaafatama isaaniitti qoqoodaafii.
english: At the commandment of Aaron and his sons shall be all the service of the sons of the Gershonites, in all their burden and in all their service; and you shall appoint their duty to them in all their responsibilities.

kikuyu: Tajaajilli balbalawwan Geershoonotaa dunkaana wal gaʼiitti kennan kanaa dha. Hojiin isaaniis Iitaamaar ilma Aroon lubichaatiin haa qajeelfamu.
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of the Gershonites in the Tent of Meeting. Their duty shall be under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

kikuyu: “Meraarota balbala balbalaa fi maatii maatii isaaniitiin lakkaaʼi.
english: “As for the sons of Merari, you shall count them by their families, by their fathers’ houses;

kikuyu: Dhiirota umuriin isaanii waggaa soddomaa hamma shantamaa kanneen hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii hojjechuuf dhufan hunda lakkaaʼi.
english: you shall count them from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who enters on the service, to do the work of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Wanni isaan yeroo hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii hojjetanitti godhan kanaa dha: kunis tuggeewwan dunkaana qulqulluu, dagaleewwan isaa, utubootaa fi miillawwan isaanii,
english: This is the duty of their burden, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting: the tabernacle’s boards, its bars, its pillars, its sockets,

kikuyu: utuboota oobdiitti naannaʼanii jiran miillawwan isaanii wajjin, qofoowwan dunkaanaa, funyoowwan, miʼa isaanii hundaa fi wantoota hojii kanaaf fayyadan hunda baachuu dha. Isinis waan tokkoon tokkoon namaa baatu addaan baasaatii ramadaafii.
english: the pillars of the court around it, their sockets, their pins, their cords, with all their instruments, and with all their service. You shall appoint the instruments of the duty of their burden to them by name.

kikuyu: Tajaajilli balbalawwan Meraarotaa qajeelfama Iitaamaar ilma Aroon lubichaa jala dunkaana wal gaʼii keessatti kennan kanaa dha.”
english: This is the service of the families of the sons of Merari, according to all their service in the Tent of Meeting, under the hand of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.”

kikuyu: Museen, Aroonii fi hooggantoonni waldaas Qohaatota balbala balbalaa fi maatii maatii isaaniitiin lakkaaʼan.
english: Moses and Aaron and the princes of the congregation counted the sons of the Kohathites by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

kikuyu: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa soddomaa hamma shantamaa kanneen hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii keessaa sana keessa hojjechuuf dhufan hundi
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: balbala balbalaan lakkaaʼamanii 2,750 turan.
english: Those who were counted of them by their families were two thousand seven hundred fifty.

kikuyu: Kun lakkoobsa balbalawwan Qohaatota warra dunkaana wal gaʼii keessa hojjechaa turanii ti. Musee fi Aroon akkuma ajaja Waaqayyoo kan karaa Museetiin kennameetiin isaan lakkaaʼan.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the Kohathites, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

kikuyu: Geershoononni balbala balbalaa fi maatii maatii isaaniitiin lakkaaʼaman.
english: Those who were counted of the sons of Gershon, by their families, and by their fathers’ houses,

kikuyu: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa soddomaa hamma shantamaa kanneen hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii keessa hojjechuuf dhufan hundi
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: balbala balbalaa fi maatii maatii isaaniitiin lakkaaʼamanii 2,630 turan.
english: even those who were counted of them, by their families, by their fathers’ houses, were two thousand six hundred thirty.

kikuyu: Balbalawwan Geershoonotaa, warri hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii keessa hojjetan kanneen Musee fi Aroon akkuma ajaja Waaqayyootti lakkaaʼan hundi kanneenii dha.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Gershon, all who served in the Tent of Meeting, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD.

kikuyu: Meraaronnis balbala balbalaa fi maatii maatii isaaniitiin lakkaaʼaman.
english: Those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, by their families, by their fathers’ houses,

kikuyu: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa soddomaa hamma shantamaa kanneen hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii keessa tajaajiluu dhufan hundi
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old—everyone who entered into the service for work in the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: balbala balbala isaaniitiin lakkaaʼamanii 3,200 turan.
english: even those who were counted of them by their families, were three thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Warri balbalawwan Meraarotaa keessaa lakkaaʼaman kanneen Musee fi Aroon akkuma ajaja Waaqayyoo kan karaa Museetiin kenname sanaatti lakkaaʼan kanneenii dha.
english: These are those who were counted of the families of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron counted according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

kikuyu: Museen, Aroonii fi hooggantoonni Israaʼel Lewwota hunda balbala balbalaa fi maatii maatii isaaniitiin lakkaaʼan.
english: All those who were counted of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron and the princes of Israel counted, by their families and by their fathers’ houses,

kikuyu: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa soddomaa hamma shantamaa kanneen hojii tajaajilaa hojjechuu fi dunkaana wal gaʼii baachuu dhufanii
english: from thirty years old and upward even to fifty years old, everyone who entered in to do the work of service and the work of bearing burdens in the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: lakkaaʼaman hundi 8,580 turan.
english: even those who were counted of them, were eight thousand five hundred eighty.

kikuyu: Isaanis akkuma ajaja Waaqayyoo kan karaa Museetiin kennameetiin tokkoon tokkoon isaanii waan hojjechuu qabanitti ramadaman; wanni isaan baachuu qabanis isaanitti himame. Akkasiin isaan akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti lakkaaʼaman.
english: According to the commandment of the LORD they were counted by Moses, everyone according to his service and according to his burden. Thus they were counted by him, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Nama dhukkuba gogaa kan namatti darbu qabu yookaan nama dhangalaʼaa dhagnaa qabu yookaan nama sababii waan duʼe tokkootiin xuraaʼaa taʼe kam iyyuu akka qubata keessaa baasaniif saba Israaʼel ajaji.
english: “Command the children of Israel that they put out of the camp every leper, everyone who has a discharge, and whoever is unclean by a corpse.

kikuyu: Dhiiras dubartiis gad baasaa; akka isaan qubata isaanii iddoo ani gidduu isaanii jiraadhu sana hin xureessineef qubata keessaa isaan baasaa.”
english: You shall put both male and female outside of the camp so that they don’t defile their camp, in the midst of which I dwell.”

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonnis akkanuma godhanii qubata keessaa isaan baasan. Isaanis akkuma Waaqayyo Museetti hime sana godhan.
english: The children of Israel did so, and put them outside of the camp; as the LORD spoke to Moses, so the children of Israel did.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Warra Israaʼeliin akkana jedhi: ‘Yoo dhiirri yookaan dubartiin tokko karaa kamiin iyyuu nama kaanitti balleessa hojjechuudhaan Waaqayyo duratti amanamummaa dhabe, namni sun yakkamaa dha;
english: “Speak to the children of Israel: ‘When a man or woman commits any sin that men commit, so as to trespass against the LORD, and that soul is guilty,

kikuyu: cubbuu hojjetes himachuu qaba. Yakka isaatiifis guutumaan guutuutti haa kiisu. Kiisii sana irrattis harka shan keessaa harka tokko dabalee namicha miidhame sanaaf haa kennu.
english: then he shall confess his sin which he has done; and he shall make restitution for his guilt in full, add to it the fifth part of it, and give it to him in respect of whom he has been guilty.

kikuyu: Namni yakki isa irratti hojjetame sun yoo fira aantee kan kiisii sana isaaf fuudhu qabaachuu baate garuu kiisiin sun kan Waaqayyoo ti; korbeessa hoolaa ittiin araarri isaaf buufamu wajjin lubaaf haa kennamu.
english: But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to the LORD shall be the priest’s, in addition to the ram of the atonement, by which atonement shall be made for him.

kikuyu: Buusiiwwan qulqulluun Israaʼeloonni lubatti fidan hundi kan isaa ti.
english: Every heave offering of all the holy things of the children of Israel, which they present to the priest, shall be his.

kikuyu: Wantoonni qulqulluun kanuma abbootii isaanii ti; wanni isaan lubichaaf kennan garuu kanuma lubichaa ti.’ ”
english: Every man’s holy things shall be his; whatever any man gives the priest, it shall be his.’”

kikuyu: Ergasii Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akkana jedhiitii saba Israaʼelitti dubbadhu: ‘Yoo niitiin nama kamii iyyuu karaa irraa baduudhaan isaaf amanamuu baattee
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘If any man’s wife goes astray and is unfaithful to him,

kikuyu: dhiira biraa wajjin ciifte, yoo dhirsi ishees waan kana beekuu baate, yoo xuraaʼummaan ishee akkuma dhokatetti hafe, yoo namni ishee irratti dhugaa baʼu hin argamin, isheen yoo waan kana irratti hin qabamin,
english: and a man lies with her carnally, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband and this is kept concealed, and she is defiled, there is no witness against her, and she isn’t taken in the act;

kikuyu: yoo dhirsa ishee hafuurri hinaaffaa qabatee inni niitii isaa shakke, yoo isheen xurooftuu taate yookaan yoo inni hinaafee ishee shakkee isheen xurooftuu hin taʼin,
english: and the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she is defiled; or if the spirit of jealousy comes on him, and he is jealous of his wife and she isn’t defiled;

kikuyu: inni niitii isaa lubatti haa geessu. Akkasumas inni kennaa daakuu garbuu iifii harka kudhan keessaa harka tokko qooda ishee haa geessu. Kennaan midhaanii kan sababii hinaaffaatiif dhiʼeeffamu kun waan kennaa yaadannoo kan yakka yaadachiisu taʼeef, inni zayitii fi ixaana itti naquu hin qabu.
english: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest, and shall bring her offering for her: one tenth of an ephah of barley meal. He shall pour no oil on it, nor put frankincense on it, for it is a meal offering of jealousy, a meal offering of memorial, bringing iniquity to memory.

kikuyu: “ ‘Lubichis ishee fidee fuula Waaqayyoo dura ishee haa dhaabu.
english: The priest shall bring her near, and set her before the LORD.

kikuyu: Ergasii inni bishaan qulqulluu okkotee supheetti haa naqu; lafa dunkaana qulqulluu irraa biyyoo fuudhee bishaan sana keessa haa buusu.
english: The priest shall take holy water in an earthen vessel; and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.

kikuyu: Lubichis erga dubartii sana fuula Waaqayyoo dura dhaabee booddee rifeensa mataa ishee hiikee kennaa yaadannoo jechuunis kennaa midhaanii kan hinaaffaaf dhiʼeeffamu sana harka ishee keessa kaaʼa; bishaan hadhaaʼaa abaarsa fidu sanas harka ofiitti qabata.
english: The priest shall set the woman before the LORD, and let the hair of the woman’s head go loose, and put the meal offering of memorial in her hands, which is the meal offering of jealousy. The priest shall have in his hand the water of bitterness that brings a curse.

kikuyu: Lubichis dubartii sana ni kakachiisa; akkanas jedhaan; “Yoo utuu ati dhirsa qabduu namni biraa si wajjin hin ciisinii fi yoo ati karaa irraa baddee hin xuraaʼin bishaan hadhaaʼaan abaarsa fidu kun si hin miidhin.
english: The priest shall cause her to take an oath and shall tell the woman, “If no man has lain with you, and if you haven’t gone aside to uncleanness, being under your husband’s authority, be free from this water of bitterness that brings a curse.

kikuyu: Garuu ati yoo karaa irraa baddee utuu dhirsa qabduu nama dhirsa kee hin taʼin wajjin ciiftee of xureessitee argamte;”
english: But if you have gone astray, being under your husband’s authority, and if you are defiled, and some man has lain with you besides your husband—”

kikuyu: kana irratti lubichi kakaa abaarsaa ishee kakachiisa; akkanas jedhaan; “Waaqayyo gudeeda kee tortorsee garaa kee illee bokoksee saba kee gidduutti kakaa fi abaarsaaf si haa godhu.
english: then the priest shall cause the woman to swear with the oath of cursing, and the priest shall tell the woman, “May the LORD make you a curse and an oath among your people, when the LORD allows your thigh to fall away, and your body to swell;

kikuyu: Akka garaan kee bokokuu fi akka gudeedni kee tortoruuf bishaan abaarsa fidu kun dhagna kee haa seenu.” “ ‘Dubartiin sunis, “Ameen, ameen” haa jettu.
english: and this water that brings a curse will go into your bowels, and make your body swell, and your thigh fall away.” The woman shall say, “Amen, Amen.”

kikuyu: “ ‘Lubichis abaarsawwan sana kitaaba maramaa irratti haa barreessu; ergasiis bishaan hadhaaʼaa sanatti irraa haa dhiqu.
english: “‘The priest shall write these curses in a book, and he shall wipe them into the water of bitterness.

kikuyu: Innis akka dubartiin sun bishaan hadhaaʼaa abaarsa fidu sana dhugdu haa godhu; bishaan abaarsaa fi dhiphina hamaa fidu sunis ishee seena.
english: He shall make the woman drink the water of bitterness that causes the curse; and the water that causes the curse shall enter into her and become bitter.

kikuyu: Lubichis kennaa midhaanii kan hinaaffaa sana ishee harkaa fuudhee fuula Waaqayyoo duratti sochoosee gara iddoo aarsaa fida.
english: The priest shall take the meal offering of jealousy out of the woman’s hand, and shall wave the meal offering before the LORD, and bring it to the altar.

kikuyu: Lubni sunis kennaa midhaanii sana irraa konyee tokko kennaa yaadannootiif fuudhee iddoo aarsaa irratti haa gubu; ergasiis akka dubartiin sun bishaan sana dhugdu haa godhu.
english: The priest shall take a handful of the meal offering, as its memorial portion, and burn it on the altar, and afterward shall make the woman drink the water.

kikuyu: Yoo isheen of xureessitee dhirsa isheetiif amanamuu baatte, yommuu isheen bishaan abaarsa fidu sana dhugdutti bishaan sun ishee seenee dhiphina hamaa isheetti fida; garaan ishee ni bokoka; gudeedni ishee ni tortora; isheenis saba ishee biratti abaaramtuu taati.
english: When he has made her drink the water, then it shall happen, if she is defiled and has committed a trespass against her husband, that the water that causes the curse will enter into her and become bitter, and her body will swell, and her thigh will fall away; and the woman will be a curse among her people.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo dubartiin sun of xureessuu baattee fi yoo qulqulluu taate isheen yakka irraa bilisa taati; daʼuus ni dandeessi.
english: If the woman isn’t defiled, but is clean; then she shall be free, and shall conceive offspring.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo dubartiin utuma dhirsa qabduu karaa irraa gortee of xureessite
english: “‘This is the law of jealousy, when a wife, being under her husband, goes astray, and is defiled,

kikuyu: yookaan yoo dhiirri sababii niitii ofii shakkuuf hafuurri hinaaffaa isa qabate, seerri hinaaffaaf kenname kanaa dha. Lubichi dubartii sana fuula Waaqayyoo dura dhaabee seera kana hunda ishee irratti haa raawwatu.
english: or when the spirit of jealousy comes on a man, and he is jealous of his wife; then he shall set the woman before the LORD, and the priest shall execute on her all this law.

kikuyu: Dhirsi sun balleessaa irraa bilisa taʼa; dubartiin sun garuu gatii cubbuu ishee argatti.’ ”
english: The man shall be free from iniquity, and that woman shall bear her iniquity.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akkana jedhii saba Israaʼelitti dubbadhu: ‘Dhiirri yookaan dubartiin tokko yoo Waaqayyoof addaan of baasuuf wareega addaa yookaan wareega Naazirummaa wareegan,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them: ‘When either man or woman shall make a special vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to separate himself to the LORD,

kikuyu: daadhii wayinii fi dhugaatii nama macheessu irraa of haa eeggatan; namni sun dhangaggaaʼaa daadhii wayinii irraa hojjetame yookaan dhangaggaaʼaa dhugaatii nama macheessuu biraa hin dhugin. Inni cuunfaa gumaa wayinii dhuguu yookaan ija wayinii asheetii yookaan goggogaa isaa nyaachuu hin qabu.
english: he shall separate himself from wine and strong drink. He shall drink no vinegar of wine, or vinegar of fermented drink, neither shall he drink any juice of grapes, nor eat fresh grapes or dried.

kikuyu: Innis bara Naazirummaa isaa hunda keessa waan gumaa wayinii irraa argamu kam iyyuu sanyii isaas taʼu qola isaa nyaachuu hin qabu.
english: All the days of his separation he shall eat nothing that is made of the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skins.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bara wareega addaan baafamuu isaa hunda keessa qarabaan tokko iyyuu mataa isaa hin tuqin. Hamma yeroon inni itti Waaqayyoof addaan baafame sun xumuramutti inni qulqulluu haa taʼu; akka rifeensi mataa isaa guddatuufis gad haa dhiisu.
english: “‘All the days of his vow of separation no razor shall come on his head, until the days are fulfilled in which he separates himself to the LORD. He shall be holy. He shall let the locks of the hair of his head grow long.

kikuyu: “ ‘Naazirichi bara Waaqayyoof addaan of baase hunda keessa reeffatti dhiʼaachuu hin qabu.
english: “‘All the days that he separates himself to the LORD he shall not go near a dead body.

kikuyu: Sababii mallattoon inni ittiin Waaqayyoof addaan baafame mataa isaa irra jiruuf yoo abbaan isaa yookaan haati isaa, obboleessi isaa yookaan obboleettiin isaa duʼan illee isaaniif jedhee akka seeraatti of hin xureessin.
english: He shall not make himself unclean for his father, or for his mother, for his brother, or for his sister, when they die, because his separation to God is on his head.

kikuyu: Inni bara itti addaan baafame sana hunda keessa kan Waaqayyoof qulqulleeffamee dha.
english: All the days of his separation he is holy to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo namni tokko iddoo Naazirichi jirutti akka tasaa duʼee akkasiin rifeensa inni addaan baase sana xureesse, inni guyyaa itti qulqulleeffamutti jechuunis guyyaa torbaffaatti mataa isaa haa haaddatu.
english: “‘If any man dies very suddenly beside him, and he defiles the head of his separation, then he shall shave his head in the day of his cleansing. On the seventh day he shall shave it.

kikuyu: Ergasiis inni guyyaa saddeettaffaatti gugee lama yookaan gugee sosookkee lama balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii irratti lubatti haa fidu.
english: On the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Sababii inni iddoo reeffi jirutti argamuudhaan cubbuu hojjeteef lubichi isa tokko aarsaa cubbuu, isa kaan immoo aarsaa gubamu godhee araara buusuuf haa dhiʼeessuuf. Guyyuma sanas rifeensa mataa isaa addaan haa baasu.
english: The priest shall offer one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering, and make atonement for him, because he sinned by reason of the dead, and shall make his head holy that same day.

kikuyu: Inni yeroo itti addaan baafame keessa ammas Waaqayyoof addaan of haa baasu; xobbaallaa hoolaa kan umuriin isaa waggaa tokko taʼes aarsaa yakkaa godhee haa fidu. Garuu sababii inni yeroo addaan baʼiisa isaa keessa xureeffameef guyyoonni darban hin lakkaaʼaman.
english: He shall separate to the LORD the days of his separation, and shall bring a male lamb a year old for a trespass offering; but the former days shall be void, because his separation was defiled.

kikuyu: “ ‘Egaa yeroo addaan baʼumsi isaa xumuramutti seerri Naazirichaa kanaa dha: Inni gara karra dunkaana wal gaʼiitti haa fidamu.
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite: when the days of his separation are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the door of the Tent of Meeting,

kikuyu: Achitti aarsaa isaa Waaqayyoof haa dhiʼeessu; kunis xobbaallaa korbeessa hoolaa hirʼina hin qabnee kan umuriin isaa waggaa tokko taʼe aarsaa gubamuuf, xobbaallaa hoolaa dhaltuu hirʼina hin qabne kan umuriin ishee waggaa tokko taʼe aarsaa cubbuutiif, korbeessa hoolaa hirʼina hin qabne aarsaa nagaatiif,
english: and he shall offer his offering to the LORD: one male lamb a year old without defect for a burnt offering, one ewe lamb a year old without defect for a sin offering, one ram without defect for peace offerings,

kikuyu: kana wajjinis Maxinoo gundoo tokko, Maxinoo daakuu bullaaʼaa irraa tolfame kan zayitiidhaan sukkuumame, bixxillee zayitiin irra dibame akkasumas kennaa midhaanii fi dhibaayyuu isaanii haa dhiʼeessu.
english: a basket of unleavened bread, cakes of fine flour mixed with oil, and unleavened wafers anointed with oil with their meal offering and their drink offerings.

kikuyu: “ ‘Lubichis fuula Waaqayyoo duratti isaan fidee aarsaa cubbuutii fi aarsaa gubamu haa dhiʼeessu.
english: The priest shall present them before the LORD, and shall offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.

kikuyu: Innis korbeessa hoolaa sana Maxinoo gundoo irra jiru sana wajjin aarsaa nagaa godhee Waaqayyoof haa dhiʼeessu; akkasumas lubichi kennaa midhaaniitii fi dhibaayyuu isaa haa dhiʼeessu.
english: He shall offer the ram for a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, with the basket of unleavened bread. The priest shall offer also its meal offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ergasii Naazirichi balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti rifeensa addaan baase sana haa haaddatu. Rifeensa sanas fuudhee ibidda aarsaa nagaa jalaan jiru sana keessa haa buusu.
english: The Nazirite shall shave the head of his separation at the door of the Tent of Meeting, take the hair of the head of his separation, and put it on the fire which is under the sacrifice of peace offerings.

kikuyu: “ ‘Erga Naazirichi rifeensa ittiin addaan baafame sana haaddatee booddee lubni sun foon gatiittii korbeessa hoolaa kan affeelamee fi Maxinoo fi bixxillee hin bukaaʼin gundoo sana irraa fuudhee harka namichaa irra haa kaaʼu.
english: The priest shall take the boiled shoulder of the ram, one unleavened cake out of the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and shall put them on the hands of the Nazirite after he has shaved the head of his separation;

kikuyu: Ergasiis lubichi aarsaa sochoofamu godhee fuula Waaqayyoo duratti isaan haa sochoosu; isaanis handaraafa sochoofamee fi tafa dhiʼeeffame sana wajjin lubichaaf kan qulqulleeffamanii dha. Ergasii Naazirichi daadhii wayinii dhuguu ni dandaʼa.
english: and the priest shall wave them for a wave offering before the LORD. They are holy for the priest, together with the breast that is waved and the thigh that is offered. After that the Nazirite may drink wine.

kikuyu: “ ‘Seerri Naaziricha waan kennuu dandaʼu kaan dabalatee akkuma addaan baʼumsa isaatti kennaa isaa Waaqayyoof wareegu tokkoo kanaa dha. Innis akkuma seera Naazirichaatti waan wareege sana raawwachuu qaba.’ ”
english: “‘This is the law of the Nazirite who vows and of his offering to the LORD for his separation, in addition to that which he is able to afford. According to his vow which he vows, so he must do after the law of his separation.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Aroonii fi ilmaan isaatti akkana jedhii himi; ‘Akki isin itti Israaʼeloota eebbiftan kanaa dha. Akkana jedhaanii:
english: “Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, ‘This is how you shall bless the children of Israel.’ You shall tell them,

kikuyu: “ ‘ “Waaqayyo si haa eebbisu; si haa eegus;
english: ‘The LORD bless you, and keep you.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo fuula isaa siif haa ibsu; garaa siif haa laafu.
english: The LORD make his face to shine on you, and be gracious to you.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo fuula isaa gara keetti haa deebisu; nagaas siif haa kennu.” ’
english: The LORD lift up his face toward you, and give you peace.’

kikuyu: “Akkasitti isaan maqaa koo saba Israaʼel irra kaaʼu; anis isaan nan eebbisa.”
english: “So they shall put my name on the children of Israel; and I will bless them.”

kikuyu: Museen erga dunkaana qulqulluu sana dhaabee fixatee booddee, dunkaanichaa fi miʼa isaa hunda dibe; ni qulqulleesses. Akkasumas iddoo aarsaatii fi miʼa isaa hunda dibee qulqulleesse.
english: On the day that Moses had finished setting up the tabernacle, and had anointed it and sanctified it with all its furniture, and the altar with all its vessels, and had anointed and sanctified them;

kikuyu: Ergasii hooggantoonni Israaʼel, hangafoonni maatiiwwanii kanneen hooggantoota gosootaa taʼanii warra lakkaaʼaman sana qajeelchanis kennaa dhiʼeessan.
english: the princes of Israel, the heads of their fathers’ houses, gave offerings. These were the princes of the tribes. These are they who were over those who were counted;

kikuyu: Isaanis gaariiwwan haguugaman jaʼaa fi sangoota kudha lama jechuunis tokkoo tokkoo hooggantootaa irraa sangaa tokko, lama lama taʼanii immoo gaarii tokko kennaa ofii godhanii fuula Waaqayyoo duratti fidan. Kennaawwan kanneenis dunkaana qulqulluu sana duratti dhiʼeessan.
english: and they brought their offering before the LORD, six covered wagons and twelve oxen; a wagon for every two of the princes, and for each one an ox. They presented them before the tabernacle.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akka isaan hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii hojjechuu keessatti fayyadaniif kennaawwan kanneen isaan harkaa fuudhi. Waan kana akkuma hojiin tokkoo tokkoo namaa barbaaddutti Lewwotatti kenni.”
english: “Accept these from them, that they may be used in doing the service of the Tent of Meeting; and you shall give them to the Levites, to every man according to his service.”

kikuyu: Museenis gaariiwwanii fi sangoota sana fuudhee Lewwotatti kenne.
english: Moses took the wagons and the oxen, and gave them to the Levites.

kikuyu: Innis akkuma hojii isaaniitiif malutti gaariiwwan lamaa fi sangoota afur ilmaan Geershoonitti kenne;
english: He gave two wagons and four oxen to the sons of Gershon, according to their service.

kikuyu: gaariiwwan afurii fi sangoota saddeet akkuma hojii isaaniitiif malutti ilmaan Meraaritti kenne. Isaan hundinuu qajeelfama Iitaamaar ilma Aroon lubichaa jala turan.
english: He gave four wagons and eight oxen to the sons of Merari, according to their service, under the direction of Ithamar the son of Aaron the priest.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Qohaati garuu sababii miʼa qulqulluu gatiittiitti baachuun hojii isaanii taʼeef Museen homaa isaaniitti hin kennine.
english: But to the sons of Kohath he gave none, because the service of the sanctuary belonged to them; they carried it on their shoulders.

kikuyu: Yeroo iddoon aarsaa dibametti hooggantoonni kennaawwan isaanii eebba iddoo aarsaatiif fidanii iddoo aarsaa duratti dhiʼeessan.
english: The princes gave offerings for the dedication of the altar in the day that it was anointed. The princes gave their offerings before the altar.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan, “Dura buʼaan tokko guyyuma tokko kennaa isaa sirna eebba iddoo aarsaa sanaatiif haa dhiʼeessu” jedhee tureetii.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “They shall offer their offering, each prince on his day, for the dedication of the altar.”

kikuyu: Namni guyyaa jalqabaatti kennaa ofii fide Nahishoon ilma Amiinaadaab kan gosa Yihuudaa ture.
english: He who offered his offering the first day was Nahshon the son of Amminadab, of the tribe of Judah,

kikuyu: Kennaan isaas gabatee meetii kan akka madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti saqilii dhibba tokkoo fi soddoma ulfaatu tokkoo fi waciitii meetii kan akka madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti saqilii torbaatama ulfaatu kan tokkoon tokkoon isaanii akka kennaa midhaaniitti daakuu bullaaʼaa zayitiidhaan sukkuumameen guutaman,
english: and his offering was: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: cilfaa warqee kan saqilii kudhan ulfaatee ixaanaan guutame tokko,
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

kikuyu: aarsaa gubamuufis dibicha loonii tokko, korbeessa hoolaa tokkoo fi xobbaallaa hoolaa kan umuriin isaa waggaa tokko taʼe tokko,
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

kikuyu: aarsaa cubbuutiif immoo korbeessa reʼee tokko,
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

kikuyu: aarsaa nagaatiif qaluufis sangoota lama, korbeeyyii hoolaa shan, korbeeyyii reʼee shanii fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa shan kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼe ture.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nahshon the son of Amminadab.

kikuyu: Guyyaa lammaffaattis Naatnaaʼel ilma Zuuwaar dura buʼaa Yisaakoritu kennaa isaa fide.
english: On the second day Nethanel the son of Zuar, prince of Issachar, gave his offering.

kikuyu: Kennaan inni fides gabatee meetii kan akka madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti saqilii dhibba tokkoo fi soddoma ulfaatu tokko, waciitii meetii kan akka madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti saqilii torbaatama ulfaatu tokko kan tokkoon tokkoon isaanii akkuma kennaa midhaaniitti daakuu bullaaʼaa zayitiidhaan sukkuumameen guutaman,
english: He offered for his offering: one silver platter, the weight of which was one hundred thirty shekels, one silver bowl of seventy shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, both of them full of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering;

kikuyu: caabii warqee kan saqilii kudhan ulfaatee ixaanaan guutame tokko,
english: one golden ladle of ten shekels, full of incense;

kikuyu: aarsaa gubamuufis dibicha loonii tokko, korbeessa hoolaa tokkoo fi xobbaallaa hoolaa kan umuriin isaa waggaa tokko taʼe tokko,
english: one young bull, one ram, one male lamb a year old, for a burnt offering;

kikuyu: aarsaa cubbuutiif immoo korbeessa reʼee tokko,
english: one male goat for a sin offering;

kikuyu: aarsaa nagaatiif qaluufis sangoota lama, korbeeyyii hoolaa shan, korbeeyyii reʼee shanii fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa shan kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokkoo ture.
english: and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, five male lambs a year old. This was the offering of Nethanel the son of Zuar.

kikuyu: Guyyaa sadaffaatti Eliiyaab ilma Heeloon hangafa ijoollee Zebuuloonitu kennaa isaa fide.
english: On the third day Eliab the son of Helon, prince of the children of Zebulun,

kikuyu: Kennaan isaas gabatee meetii kan akka madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti saqilii dhibba tokkoo fi soddoma ulfaatu tokko, waciitii meetii kan akka madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti saqilii torbaatama ulfaatu tokko kanneen tokkoon tokkoon isaanii akkuma kennaa midhaaniitti daakuu bullaaʼaa zayitiidhaan sukkuumameen guutaman,

kikuyu: Kennaan hooggantoonni Israaʼel gaafa iddoon aarsaa dibame sana sirna eebbaatiif dhiʼeessan kana ture; isaanis gabatee meetii kudha lama, waciitii meetii kudha lamaa fi xuwwee warqee kudha lama:
english: This was the dedication offering of the altar, on the day when it was anointed, by the princes of Israel: twelve silver platters, twelve silver bowls, twelve golden ladles;

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon isaanii meetii saqilii dhibba tokkoo fi soddoma ulfaatu ture; tokkoon tokkoon waciitii meetii saqilii torbaatama ulfaata ture. Miʼi meetii kun akka madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti walumaa galatti saqilii kuma lamaa fi dhibbaa afur ulfaata ture.
english: each silver platter weighing one hundred thirty shekels, and each bowl seventy; all the silver of the vessels two thousand four hundred shekels, according to the shekel of the sanctuary;

kikuyu: Xuwweewwan warqee kudha lamaan kanneen ixaanaan guutamanis tokkoon tokkoon isaanii akka madaalii saqilii iddoo qulqulluutti saqilii kudhan ulfaatu turan. Xuwweewwan warqee walumaa galatti saqilii dhibba tokkoo fi digdama ulfaatu turan.
english: the twelve golden ladles, full of incense, weighing ten shekels apiece, according to the shekel of the sanctuary; all the gold of the ladles weighed one hundred twenty shekels;

kikuyu: Baayʼinni horii aarsaa gubamuuf dhiʼeeffamanii walumaa galatti jiboota loonii kudha lama, korbeeyyii hoolaa kudha lama, xobbaallaawwan hoolaa kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko taʼe kudha lama ture; kennaan midhaaniis isaan wajjin dhiʼeeffameera. Korbeeyyiin reʼee kudha lama aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeeffamanii turan.
english: all the cattle for the burnt offering twelve bulls, the rams twelve, the male lambs a year old twelve, and their meal offering; and twelve male goats for a sin offering;

kikuyu: Baayʼinni horii aarsaa nagaatiif dhiʼeeffamanii walumaa galatti sangoota digdamii afur, korbeeyyii hoolaa jaatama, korbeeyyii reʼee jaatamaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko ture.
english: and all the cattle for the sacrifice of peace offerings: twenty-four bulls, sixty rams, sixty male goats, and sixty male lambs a year old. This was the dedication offering of the altar, after it was anointed.

kikuyu: Museen yommuu Waaqayyo wajjin dubbachuuf dunkaana wal gaʼii ol seenetti teessoo araaraa kan taabota kakuu seeraa irra jiruun olitti kiirubeelii lamaan gidduudhaa sagalee isatti dubbatu dhagaʼe. Waaqayyo isa wajjin dubbate.
english: When Moses went into the Tent of Meeting to speak with the LORD, he heard his voice speaking to him from above the mercy seat that was on the ark of the Testimony, from between the two cherubim; and he spoke to him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Aroonitti akkana jedhii dubbadhu; ‘Yeroo ati ibsaawwan torban qabsiiftutti isaan iddoo baattuu ibsaa fuula dura jiru haa ibsan.’ ”
english: “Speak to Aaron, and tell him, ‘When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lamp stand.’”

kikuyu: Aroonis akkasuma godhe; innis akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti akka isaan fuula baattuu ibsaa duraan ifa kennaniif ibsaawwan sana qabsiise.
english: Aaron did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lamp stand, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Akki itti baattuun ibsaa tolfame akkana: Miilla isaa irraa jalqabee hamma daraaraa isaatti warqee tumame irraa hojjetame. Baattuun ibsaa sun akkuma fakkeenya Waaqayyo Museetti argisiise sanaatti hojjetame.
english: This was the workmanship of the lamp stand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work. He made the lamp stand according to the pattern which the LORD had shown Moses.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Saba Israaʼel keessaa Lewwota fuudhii qulqulleessi.
english: “Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.

kikuyu: Isaan qulqulleessuufis waan kana godhi: bishaan qulqullaaʼummaa isaanitti facaasi; akka isaan dhagna isaanii guutuu haaddatanii akkasiin uffata ofii miiccatanii of qulqulleessan godhi.
english: You shall do this to them to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.

kikuyu: Isaanis dibicha loonii tokko kennaa midhaanii kan daakuu bullaaʼaa zayitiidhaan sukkuumame wajjin haa fuudhan; atis dibicha loonii lammaffaa aarsaa cubbuutiif fuudhi.
english: Then let them take a young bull and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Lewwota fuula dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti dhiʼeessiitii waldaa Israaʼelootaa guutuu walitti qabi.
english: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Lewwotas fuula Waaqayyoo duratti dhiʼeessi; sabni Israaʼel harka isaanii Lewwota irra haa kaaʼan.
english: You shall present the Levites before the LORD. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,

kikuyu: Aroonis akka Lewwonni Waaqayyo tajaajiluu dandaʼaniif saba Israaʼel keessaa aarsaa sochoofamu godhee fuula Waaqayyoo duratti isaan haa dhiʼeessu.
english: and Aaron shall offer the Levites before the LORD for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of the LORD.

kikuyu: “Erga Lewwonni harka isaanii mataa jiboota sanaa irra kaaʼanii booddee ati Lewwotaaf araaraa buusuudhaaf dibicha tokko aarsaa cubbuu, kaan immoo aarsaa gubamu godhiitii Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessi.
english: “The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to the LORD, to make atonement for the Levites.

kikuyu: Akka Lewwonni fuula Aroonii fi fuula ilmaan isaa dura dhaabatan godhi; ergasiis aarsaa sochoofamu godhiitii Waaqayyotti isaan dhiʼeessi.
english: You shall set the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Haala kanaan Israaʼeloota kaan keessaa Lewwota addaan baasi; Lewwonnis kan koo haa taʼan.
english: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.

kikuyu: “Erga ati Lewwota qulqulleessitee aarsaa sochoofamu gootee isaan dhiʼeessitee booddees isaan hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii hojjechuuf haa dhufan.
english: “After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting. You shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.

kikuyu: Isaan Israaʼeloota keessaa guutumaan guutuutti naaf kennamuu qabu. Ani qooda hangafa saba Israaʼel kan gadameessa saaqu hundaa Lewwota ofii kootiif fudhadheera.
english: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.

kikuyu: Israaʼel keessaa dhiirri hangafni hundi namas taʼu horiin kan koo ti. Ani yeroon biyya Gibxi keessatti hangafa hunda ajjeese sana ofii kootiifan addaan isaan baafadhe.
english: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Egypt, I sanctified them for myself.

kikuyu: Ani qooda ilmaan Israaʼel hangafoota hundaa Lewwota fudhadheera.
english: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Yommuu Israaʼeloonni iddoo qulqulluutti dhiʼaatanitti akka dhaʼichi isaan hin arganneef, akka isaan Israaʼelootaaf araara buusanii fi akka isaan tajaajila Israaʼelootaa dunkaana wal gaʼii keessatti raawwataniif ani Lewwota saba Israaʼel hunda keessaa Aroonii fi ilmaan isaatiif kennaa godhee kenneera.”
english: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aaron and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the children of Israel when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary.”

kikuyu: Museen, Aroonii fi waldaan Israaʼel guutuun akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajaje sana Lewwotas godhan.
english: Moses, and Aaron, and all the congregation of the children of Israel did so to the Levites. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.

kikuyu: Lewwonnis of qulqulleessanii wayyaa ofii miiccatan. Aroonis akkuma aarsaa sochoofamuutti fuula Waaqayyoo duratti isaan dhiʼeesse; isaan qulqulleessuufis araara isaaniif buuse.
english: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they washed their clothes; and Aaron offered them for a wave offering before the LORD and Aaron made atonement for them to cleanse them.

kikuyu: Ergasii Lewwonni qajeelcha Aroonii fi ilmaan isaatiin hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii hojjechuudhaaf dhufan. Isaanis akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajaje sana Lewwotas godhan.
english: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aaron and before his sons: as the LORD had commanded Moses concerning the Levites, so they did to them.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Kun seera Lewwotaaf kennamee dha: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamii shanii fi hammasii olii hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii keessatti hirmaachuuf haa dhufan;
english: “This is what is assigned to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;

kikuyu: umurii waggaa shantamaatti garuu tajaajila isaanii haa dhaaban; deebiʼaniis hin tajaajilin.
english: and from the age of fifty years they shall retire from doing the work, and shall serve no more,

kikuyu: Hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii irratti obboloota ofii gargaaruu ni dandaʼu; ofii isaaniitii garuu hojii sana hin hojjetin. Egaa kun haala itti ati itti gaafatama Lewwotaa ramadduu dha.”
english: but shall assist their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to perform the duty, and shall perform no service. This is how you shall have the Levites do their duties.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo erga isaan Gibxii baʼanii booddee jiʼa jalqabaa kan waggaa lammaffaatti Gammoojjii Siinaa keessatti akkana jedhee Museetti dubbate;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying,

kikuyu: “Israaʼeloonni yeroo murtaaʼetti Faasiikaa haa ayyaaneffatan.
english: “Let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.

kikuyu: Isin akkuma seeraa fi dambii ayyaana kanaa hundaatti yeroo murtaaʼetti jiʼa sana keessa, dimimmisa galgala guyyaa kudha afuraffaatti ayyaaneffadhaa.”
