english: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season. You shall keep it according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances.”

kikuyu: Museen akka isaan Faasiikaa ayyaaneffatan Israaʼelootatti hime;
english: Moses told the children of Israel that they should keep the Passover.

kikuyu: isaanis jiʼa jalqabaa keessa dimimmisa galgala guyyaa kudha afuraffaatti Gammoojjii Siinaa keessatti ayyaaneffatan. Sabni Israaʼel akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti waan hunda godhe.
english: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that the LORD commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa namoonni tokko tokko sababii reeffa tuqanii xuraaʼaniif guyyaa sana Faasiikaa ayyaaneffachuu hin dandeenye. Isaan guyyuma sana gara Musee fi Aroonii dhufanii,
english: There were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a man, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moses and Aaron on that day.

kikuyu: Museedhaan akkana jedhan; “Nu sababii reeffa namaa tuqneef xuroofneerra; garuu maaliif yeroo murtaaʼe sanatti Israaʼeloota kaan wajjin aarsaa Waaqayyoo dhiʼeessuu dhowwamne?”
english: Those men said to him, “We are unclean because of the dead body of a man. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season among the children of Israel?”

kikuyu: Museenis, “Hamma ani waan Waaqayyo waaʼee keessan ajaju dhagaʼutti turaa” jedheen.
english: Moses answered them, “Wait, that I may hear what the LORD will command concerning you.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Israaʼelootaan akkana jedhi: ‘Isin keessaa yookaan ilmaan keessan keessaa namni tokko yoo reeffa tuqee xuraaʼe yookaan karaa fagoo deeme, inni amma iyyuu Faasiikaa Waaqayyoo ayyaaneffachuu ni dandaʼa.
english: “Say to the children of Israel, ‘If any man of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, he shall still keep the Passover to the LORD.

kikuyu: Isaanis jiʼa lammaffaa keessa guyyaa kudha afuraffaa dimimmisa galgala Faasiikaa haa ayyaaneffatan. Faasiikaa sanas Maxinoo fi baala hadhaaʼaa wajjin haa nyaatan.
english: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.

kikuyu: Isaanis wantoota kanneen keessaa tokko iyyuu hamma ganamaatti hambisuu yookaan lafee isaa keessaa tokko iyyuu cabsuu hin qaban. Isaan yommuu Faasiikaa ayyaaneffatanitti dambiiwwan hunda duukaa buʼuu qabu.
english: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.

kikuyu: Garuu namni qulqulluu taʼee karaa hin deemin yoo Faasiikaa ayyaaneffachuu baate inni sababii yeroo murtaaʼetti aarsaa Waaqayyoo hin dhiʼeessiniif saba isaa keessaa haa balleeffamu. Namichi sun gatii cubbuu isaa ni argata.
english: But the man who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from his people. Because he didn’t offer the offering of the LORD in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.

kikuyu: “ ‘Alagaan isin gidduu jiraatu kan Faasiikaa Waaqayyoo ayyaaneffachuu fedhu tokko akkuma seeraa fi dambii Faasiikaatti haa ayyaaneffatu. Isinis alagaa fi dhalataa biyyaatiif seeruma tokkicha qabaadhaa.’ ”
english: “‘If a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the Passover to the LORD, then he shall do so according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner and for him who is born in the land.’”

kikuyu: Gaafa dunkaanni qulqulluun dhaabame sana duumessi dunkaana sana jechuunis dunkaana dhuga baʼumsaa haguuge. Duumessi dunkaana qulqulluudhaan olii sunis galgalaa hamma ganamaatti ibidda fakkaata ture.
english: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony. At evening it was over the tabernacle, as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.

kikuyu: Wanni kunis yeroo hunda akkanuma ture; guyyaa duumessi isa haguuga ture; halkan immoo duumessi sun ibidda fakkaata ture.
english: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.

kikuyu: Yeroo duumessi sun dunkaana irraa kaʼu Israaʼeloonni kaʼanii deemu turan; lafa duumessi buʼu immoo Israaʼeloonni ni qubatu.
english: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni ajaja Waaqayyootiin kaʼanii deemu; ajajuma isaatiinis qubatu. Yeroo duumessi dunkaana qulqulluun ol jiru isaanis qubata keessa turan.
english: At the commandment of the LORD, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of the LORD they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.

kikuyu: Yoo duumessi sun guyyaa hedduu dunkaana gubbaa tures Israaʼeloonni seera Waaqayyootiif waan ajajamaniif iddoo sanaa kaʼanii hin deeman ture.
english: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the LORD’s command, and didn’t travel.

kikuyu: Yeroo tokko tokko duumessi sun guyyaa xinnaadhaaf dunkaana qulqulluu gubbaa oolee bula ture; isaanis ajaja Waaqayyootiin qubatu; ajajuma isaatiinis kaʼanii deemu.
english: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of the LORD they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of the LORD they traveled.

kikuyu: Yeroo tokko tokko duumessi sun galgalaa hamma ganamaatti jiraata ture; yommuu duumessi ganamaan kaʼu isaanis kaʼanii deemu. Guyyaas taʼu halkan, yeroo duumessi kaʼu isaanis kaʼanii deemu.
english: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled; or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.

kikuyu: Yeroo duumessi sun guyyaa lamas taʼu jiʼa tokko yookaan waggaa tokko dunkaana qulqulluu irra turutti Israaʼeloonni qubatuma keessa turu malee kaʼanii hin deeman ture; yeroo duumessichi kaʼutti garuu kaʼanii deemu.
english: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn’t travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.

kikuyu: Isaan ajaja Waaqayyootiin qubatu; ajajuma Waaqayyootiinis kaʼanii deemu. Akkuma ajaja Waaqayyo karaa Museetiin kenne sanaattis seera isaatiif ajajamu.
english: At the commandment of the LORD they encamped, and at the commandment of the LORD they traveled. They kept the LORD’s command, at the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Meetii tumame irraa malakata lama tolfadhuutii hawaasa walitti waamuu fi akka qubanni kaʼee deemu gochuuf itti fayyadami.
english: “Make two trumpets of silver. You shall make them of beaten work. You shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps.

kikuyu: Yeroo malakanni lamaan afuufamanitti hawaasni hundi balbala dunkaana wal gaʼiitti fuula kee duratti walitti haa qabamu.
english: When they blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Yoo malakanni tokko qofti afuufame garuu hooggantoonni jechuunis abbootiin gosoota Israaʼel fuula kee duratti walitti haa qabaman.
english: If they blow just one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.

kikuyu: Yeroo malakanni afuufamutti gosoonni gama baʼa biiftuutiin qubatan kaʼanii haa deeman.
english: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall go forward.

kikuyu: Yeroo malakanni siʼa lammaffaa afuufamutti immoo gosoonni gama kibbaatiin qubatan kaʼanii haa deeman. Malakanni afuufamu sun mallattoo isaan ittiin qubata keessaa baʼanii dha.
english: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall go forward. They shall blow an alarm for their journeys.

kikuyu: Hawaasa walitti qabuudhaaf malakata afuufi; garuu mallattoo wal fakkaatuun hin afuufin.
english: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.

kikuyu: “Ilmaan Aroon luboonni malakatawwan sana haa afuufan. Kunis isinii fi dhaloota dhufuuf seera bara baraa haa taʼu.
english: “The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets. This shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.

kikuyu: Isin yommuu biyya keessan keessatti diina isin cunqursu tokkotti duuluuf baatanitti malakatawwan sana afuufaa. Yoos Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan isin yaadatee diina keessan jalaa isin baasa.
english: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets. Then you will be remembered before the LORD your God, and you will be saved from your enemies.

kikuyu: Akkasumas guyyaa gammachuu keessanii jechuunis gaafa ayyaana beekamaa fi Ayyaana Baatii Haaraatti aarsaa keessan kan gubamuu fi aarsaa keessan kan nagaa irratti malakatawwan afuufaa; wanni kunis fuula Waaqa keessanii duratti yaadannoo isiniif taʼa. Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan.”
english: “Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God. I am the LORD your God.”

kikuyu: Jiʼa lammaffaa waggaa lammaffaa keessa guyyaa digdammaffaatti duumessi sun dunkaana dhuga Baʼumsaa irraa kaʼe.
english: In the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, the cloud was taken up from over the tabernacle of the covenant.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonnis Gammoojjii Siinaatii kaʼanii hamma duumessi sun Gammoojjii Phaaraanii keessa qubatutti iddoo tokko irraa gara iddoo biraatti deeman.
english: The children of Israel went forward on their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud stayed in the wilderness of Paran.

kikuyu: Isaan yeroo jalqabaa kanatti ajaja Waaqayyo karaa Museetiin kenneen kaʼanii deeman.
english: They first went forward according to the commandment of the LORD by Moses.

kikuyu: Kutaan qubata ijoollee Yihuudaa faajjii isaanii jalaan jalqabatti deeman. Nahishoon ilmi Amiinaadaab ajajaa isaanii ture.
english: First, the standard of the camp of the children of Judah went forward according to their armies. Nahshon the son of Amminadab was over his army.

kikuyu: Naatnaaʼel ilmi Zuuwaar ajajaa kutaa gosa Yisaakor ture;
english: Nethanel the son of Zuar was over the army of the tribe of the children of Issachar.

kikuyu: Eliiyaab ilmi Heeloon ajajaa kutaa gosa Zebuuloon ture.
english: Eliab the son of Helon was over the army of the tribe of the children of Zebulun.

kikuyu: Dunkaanni qulqulluun sunis achii buqqifame; akkasiin Geershoononnii fi Meraaronni warri dunkaana baatan kaʼanii deeman.
english: The tabernacle was taken down; and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari, who bore the tabernacle, went forward.

kikuyu: Kutaan qubata Ruubeenis faajjii isaanii jalaan itti aananii deeman. Eliizuur ilmi Shedeeʼuur ajajaa isaanii ture.
english: The standard of the camp of Reuben went forward according to their armies. Elizur the son of Shedeur was over his army.

kikuyu: Shilumiiʼeel ilmi Zuriishadaayi ajajaa kutaa gosa Simiʼoon ture;
english: Shelumiel the son of Zurishaddai was over the army of the tribe of the children of Simeon.

kikuyu: Eliyaasaaf ilmi Deʼuuʼeel ajajaa kutaa gosa Gaad ture.
english: Eliasaph the son of Deuel was over the army of the tribe of the children of Gad.

kikuyu: Ergasii Qohaatonni miʼa qulqulluu baatanii kaʼanii deeman. Dunkaanni qulqulluun sun immoo utuu isaan achi hin gaʼin dhaabamee ture.
english: The Kohathites set forward, bearing the sanctuary. The others set up the tabernacle before they arrived.

kikuyu: Kutaan qubata Efreemis faajjii isaanii jalaan itti aananii deeman. Eliishaamaan ilmi Amiihuud ajajaa isaanii ture.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Ephraim set forward according to their armies. Elishama the son of Ammihud was over his army.

kikuyu: Gamaaliʼeel ilmi Phedaasuur ajajaa kutaa gosa Minaasee ture;
english: Gamaliel the son of Pedahzur was over the army of the tribe of the children of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Abiidaan ilmi Gaadeyoon ajajaa kutaa gosa Beniyaam ture.
english: Abidan the son of Gideoni was over the army of the tribe of the children of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Dhuma irratti kutaan qubata Daan eegduu karaa duubaa kan kutaawwan hundaa taʼanii faajjii isaanii jalaan kaʼanii deeman. Ahiiʼezer ilmi Amiishadaay ajajaa isaanii ture.
english: The standard of the camp of the children of Dan, which was the rear guard of all the camps, set forward according to their armies. Ahiezer the son of Ammishaddai was over his army.

kikuyu: Fagiʼeel ilmi Okraan ajajaa kutaa gosa Aasheer ture;
english: Pagiel the son of Ochran was over the army of the tribe of the children of Asher.

kikuyu: Ahiiraan ilmi Eenaan ajajaa kutaa gosa Niftaalem ture.
english: Ahira the son of Enan was over the army of the tribe of the children of Naphtali.

kikuyu: Egaa kutaawwan saba Israaʼel yommuu kaʼanii deemanitti tartiiba kanaan sochoʼan.
english: Thus were the travels of the children of Israel according to their armies; and they went forward.

kikuyu: Ergasii Museen Hoobaab ilma Reʼuuʼeel, namicha Midiyaan abbaa niitii Musee sanaan akkana jedhe; “Nu biyya Waaqayyo, ‘Ani isinii kenna’ nuun jedhe sana dhaquuf deemaa jirra. Nu waan gaarii siif goonaatii kottuu nu wajjin deemi; Waaqayyo waan gaarii Israaʼelootaaf kakateeraatii.”
english: Moses said to Hobab, the son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses’ father-in-law, “We are journeying to the place of which the LORD said, ‘I will give it to you.’ Come with us, and we will treat you well; for the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel.”

kikuyu: Inni immoo, “Lakki ani hin deemuu; ani biyyuma kootti gara saba kootti nan deebiʼa” jedhee deebise.
english: He said to him, “I will not go; but I will depart to my own land, and to my relatives.”

kikuyu: Museen garuu akkana jedheen; “Maaloo nu dhiistee hin deemin. Ati gammoojjii keessatti iddoo nu qubannu ni beekta; ijas nuu taʼuu dandeessa.
english: Moses said, “Don’t leave us, please; because you know how we are to encamp in the wilderness, and you can be our eyes.

kikuyu: Yoo ati nu wajjin deemte nu waan gaarii Waaqayyo nuu kennu si wajjin qoodanna.”
english: It shall be, if you go with us—yes, it shall be—that whatever good the LORD does to us, we will do the same to you.”

kikuyu: Isaan tulluu Waaqayyoo irraa kaʼanii guyyaa sadii deeman. Taabonni kakuu Waaqayyoos iddoo isaan boqotan isaaniif barbaaduuf jedhee guyyaa sadanuu isaan dura deeme.
english: They set forward from the Mount of the LORD three days’ journey. The ark of the LORD’s covenant went before them three days’ journey, to seek out a resting place for them.

kikuyu: Duumessi Waaqayyoo sun yeroo isaan qubata keessaa baʼan guyyaa guyyaa isaan irra ture.
english: The cloud of the LORD was over them by day, when they set forward from the camp.

kikuyu: Yeroo taabonni sun kaʼee deemu Museen akkana jedha ture; “Yaa Waaqayyo, kaʼi! Diinonni kee haa bittinneeffaman; warri si jibbanis fuula kee duraa haa baqatan.”
english: When the ark went forward, Moses said, “Rise up, LORD, and let your enemies be scattered! Let those who hate you flee before you!”

kikuyu: Yeroo inni boqochuuf dhufu akkana jedha ture; “Yaa Waaqayyo, gara kumaatama Israaʼel hedduutti deebiʼi.”
english: When it rested, he said, “Return, LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel.”

kikuyu: Sabni sun utuma Waaqayyo isa dhagaʼuu waaʼee rakkina isaa guungume; innis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti ni aare. Kana irratti ibiddi Waaqayyoo isaan gidduutti bobaʼee qarqara qubata isaanii gube.
english: The people were complaining in the ears of the LORD. When the LORD heard it, his anger burned; and the LORD’s fire burned among them, and consumed some of the outskirts of the camp.

kikuyu: Sabni Museetti iyye; Museen immoo Waaqayyoon kadhatee ibiddi sun dhaame.
english: The people cried to Moses; and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire abated.

kikuyu: Sababii ibiddi Waaqayyo biraa gad buʼee gidduu isaaniitti bobaʼeef, iddoon sun “Tabeeraa” jedhamee waamame.
english: The name of that place was called Taberah, because the LORD’s fire burned among them.

kikuyu: Sabni wal makaan isaan wajjin tures nyaata biraa dharraʼe; Israaʼeloonni ammas akkana jedhanii booʼuu jalqaban; “Nu utuu foon nyaannu argannee!
english: The mixed multitude that was among them lusted exceedingly; and the children of Israel also wept again, and said, “Who will give us meat to eat?

kikuyu: Nu biyya Gibxi keessatti qurxummii toluma nyaanne; akkasumas dabaaqula, habaabii, goodarree, qullubbii diimaa fi qullubbii adii nyaanne sana ni yaadanna.
english: We remember the fish, which we ate in Egypt for nothing; the cucumbers, and the melons, and the leeks, and the onions, and the garlic;

kikuyu: Amma garuu fedhiin nyaataa nurraa badeera; mannaa kana malees waan tokko illee hin arginu!”
english: but now we have lost our appetite. There is nothing at all except this manna to look at.”

kikuyu: Mannaan sun akka sanyii dinbilaalaa taʼee bifti isaa haphee fakkaata ture.
english: The manna was like coriander seed, and it looked like bdellium.

kikuyu: Namoonnis mannaa sana nanaannaʼanii walitti qabanii dhagaa daakuutti daakachaa yookaan mooyyeetti tumachaa turan. Isaanis mannaa sana okkoteetti affeelu yookaan maxinoo isaa tolfatu turan. Innis akka waan zayitii ejersaatiin qopheeffameetti miʼaawa ture.
english: The people went around, gathered it, and ground it in mills, or beat it in mortars, and boiled it in pots, and made cakes of it. Its taste was like the taste of fresh oil.

kikuyu: Galgala yommuu fixeensi qubata irra buʼetti mannaan sunis gad buʼe.
english: When the dew fell on the camp in the night, the manna fell on it.

kikuyu: Museen utuu namoonni maatii hundaa balbala dunkaana ofii isaa duratti booʼanuu dhagaʼe. Waaqayyos akka malee aare; Museen immoo ni dhiphate.
english: Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, every man at the door of his tent; and the LORD’s anger burned greatly; and Moses was displeased.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee Waaqayyoon gaafate; “Ati maaliif dhiphina kana garbicha keetti fidde? Ati kan baʼaa saba kanaa hunda narra keesse ani maal balleessee si gaddisiiseeti?
english: Moses said to the LORD, “Why have you treated your servant so badly? Why haven’t I found favor in your sight, that you lay the burden of all this people on me?

kikuyu: Saba kana hunda anatu ulfaaʼee? Anatu isaan daʼee? Ati maaliif akka ani akkuma guddiftuun daaʼima baattutti gara biyya ati abbootii isaaniitiif kakuudhaan waadaa galteetti irree kootti baadhee isaan geessuudhaaf na ajajja?
english: Have I conceived all this people? Have I brought them out, that you should tell me, ‘Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant, to the land which you swore to their fathers’?

kikuyu: Ani saba kana hundaaf foon eessaan argadha? Isaan, ‘Foon nyaannu nuu kenni!’ jedhanii natti booʼu.
english: Where could I get meat to give all these people? For they weep before me, saying, ‘Give us meat, that we may eat.’

kikuyu: Ani kophaa koo saba kana hunda baachuu hin dandaʼu; baʼaan kun akka malee natti ulfaata.
english: I am not able to bear all this people alone, because it is too heavy for me.

kikuyu: Ati yoo akkana na goota taʼe, yoo ani fuula kee duratti fudhatama argadhee jiraadhe, maaloo ammuma na ajjeesi; akka ani gidiraa natti dhufu argus na hin godhin.”
english: If you treat me this way, please kill me right now, if I have found favor in your sight; and don’t let me see my wretchedness.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Maanguddoota Israaʼel keessaa nama torbaatama kanneen hooggantootaa fi qondaaltota sabaa taʼuu isaanii beektu naa fidi. Akka isaan gara dunkaana wal gaʼii dhufanii si wajjin achi dhadhaabatan godhi.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Gather to me seventy men of the elders of Israel, whom you know to be the elders of the people and officers over them; and bring them to the Tent of Meeting, that they may stand there with you.

kikuyu: Ani gad buʼee achitti si wajjin nan dubbadha; Hafuura sirra jiru irraas fuudhee isaan irra nan kaaʼa; isaanis akka ati kophaa kee baʼaa sana hin baanneef baʼaa saba sanaa si wajjin baatu.
english: I will come down and talk with you there. I will take of the Spirit which is on you, and will put it on them; and they shall bear the burden of the people with you, that you don’t bear it yourself alone.

kikuyu: “Saba kanaan akkana jedhi: ‘Isin bori foon nyaattuutii of qulqulleessaa qophaaʼaa. Waaqayyo yeroo isin, “Nu utuu foonuma nyaannu argannee! Yeroo nu biyya Gibxi keessa jirru nuu wayya ture!” jettanii boossan dhagaʼeeraatii. Waaqayyo amma foon isinii kenna; isinis ni nyaattu.
english: “Say to the people, ‘Sanctify yourselves in preparation for tomorrow, and you will eat meat; for you have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, “Who will give us meat to eat? For it was well with us in Egypt.” Therefore the LORD will give you meat, and you will eat.

kikuyu: Isin hamma guyyaa tokkoo, yookaan lamaa, yookaan shanii, kudhanii, yookaan digdamaa qofa hin nyaattan;
english: You will not eat just one day, or two days, or five days, or ten days, or twenty days,

kikuyu: garuu jiʼa tokko guutuu hamma funyaaniin isin baʼutti, hamma nuffitanittis nyaattu; isin Waaqayyo gidduu keessan jiru sana diddanii, “Nu maaliif biyya Gibxi keessaa baane?” jettanii fuula isaa duratti boossanii turtaniitii.’ ”
english: but a whole month, until it comes out at your nostrils, and it is loathsome to you; because you have rejected the LORD who is among you, and have wept before him, saying, “Why did we come out of Egypt?”’”

kikuyu: Museen garuu akkana jedhe; “Kunoo ani namoota lafoo kuma dhibba jaʼa gidduun jira; ati immoo, ‘Ani foon isaan jiʼa guutuu nyaatan kennaaf!’ jetta.
english: Moses said, “The people, among whom I am, are six hundred thousand men on foot; and you have said, ‘I will give them meat, that they may eat a whole month.’

kikuyu: Utuma bushaayee fi karri loonii isaaniif qalamanii iyyuu gaʼaa laata? Utuma qurxummiin galaana keessaa hundi isaanii qabamee iyyuu gaʼaa laata?”
english: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them, to be sufficient for them? Shall all the fish of the sea be gathered together for them, to be sufficient for them?”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Harki Waaqayyoo gabaabaadhaa? Ati akka wanni ani siin jedhu siif guutamuu fi akka siif hin guutamne amma ni argita.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Has the LORD’s hand grown short? Now you will see whether my word will happen to you or not.”

kikuyu: Museen dhaqee waan Waaqayyo jedhe sana sabatti hime. Innis saba sana keessaa maanguddoota torbaatama walitti qabee akka isaan naannoo dunkaanaa dhadhaabatan godhe.
english: Moses went out, and told the people the LORD’s words; and he gathered seventy men of the elders of the people, and set them around the Tent.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Waaqayyo duumessaan gad buʼee isatti dubbate; Hafuura isa irra jirus fuudhee maanguddoota torbaatamman sana irra buuse. Isaanis yeroo Hafuurri sun isaan irra boqotetti raajii dubbatan; ergasii immoo deebiʼanii raajii sana hin dubbanne.
english: The LORD came down in the cloud, and spoke to him, and took of the Spirit that was on him, and put it on the seventy elders. When the Spirit rested on them, they prophesied, but they did so no more.

kikuyu: Taʼu illee namoonni lama kanneen maqaan isaanii Eldaadii fi Meedaad jedhaman qubata keessatti hafanii turan. Isaanis maanguddoota sana keessatti galmeeffamanii turan malee gad baʼanii gara dunkaanaa hin dhaqne ture. Hafuurri immoo isaan irra illee buʼe; isaanis qubata keessatti raajii dubbatan.
english: But two men remained in the camp. The name of one was Eldad, and the name of the other Medad; and the Spirit rested on them. They were of those who were written, but had not gone out to the Tent; and they prophesied in the camp.

kikuyu: Dargaggeessi tokko fiigee dhaqee, “Eldaadii fi Meedaad raajii dubbachuutti jiru” jedhee Museetti hime.
english: A young man ran, and told Moses, and said, “Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp!”

kikuyu: Iyyaasuun ilmi Nuuni kan ijoollummaa ofiitii jalqabee gargaartuu Musee ture sun kaʼee, “Yaa Musee, yaa gooftaa ko, isaan dhowwi!” jedhee dubbate.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”

kikuyu: Museen garuu akkana jedhee deebise; “Ati anaaf hinaaftaa? Ani utuu sabni Waaqayyoo hundinuu raajota taʼanii Waaqayyos Hafuura isaa isaan irra kaaʼee nan hawwa!”
english: Moses said to him, “Are you jealous for my sake? I wish that all the LORD’s people were prophets, that the LORD would put his Spirit on them!”

kikuyu: Ergasiis Musee fi maanguddoonni Israaʼel gara qubataatti deebiʼan.
english: Moses went into the camp, he and the elders of Israel.

kikuyu: Bubbeen tokkos Waaqayyo biraa baʼee galaana keessaa dimbiriqqee gara qubataatti oofe. Bubbeen sunis dimbiriqqee sana naannoo qubata sanaatti gama hundaan hamma deemsa guyyaa tokkoo fagaatu harcaasee hamma dhundhuma lamaa oli tuule.
english: A wind from the LORD went out and brought quails from the sea, and let them fall by the camp, about a day’s journey on this side, and a day’s journey on the other side, around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the earth.

kikuyu: Guyyaa sana guutuu fi halkan sana guutuu, guyyaa itti aanu guutuus sabni sun gad baʼee dimbiriqqee sana walitti qabate; isaan keessaas namni homeerii kudhanii gad walitti qabate hin turre. Ergasii dimbiriqqee sana naannoo qubata sanaa afatan.
english: The people rose up all that day, and all of that night, and all the next day, and gathered the quails. He who gathered least gathered ten homers; and they spread them all out for themselves around the camp.

kikuyu: Garuu utuma foon sun amma illee gidduu ilkaan isaanii jiruu, utuu hin alanfatin Waaqayyo isaanitti aaree dhaʼicha hamaadhaan isaan dhaʼe.
english: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the LORD’s anger burned against the people, and the LORD struck the people with a very great plague.

kikuyu: Sababii isaan namoota nyaata biraa dharraʼan achitti awwaalaniif maqaan iddoo sanaa, “Qiibrooti Haataaʼabaa” jedhame.
english: The name of that place was called Kibroth Hattaavah, because there they buried the people who lusted.

kikuyu: Sabni sunis Qiibrooti Haataaʼabaadhaa kaʼee gara Haxerooti dhaqee achi jiraate.
english: From Kibroth Hattaavah the people traveled to Hazeroth; and they stayed at Hazeroth.

kikuyu: Miiriyaamii fi Aroon sababii Museen dubartii Itoophiyaa fuudheef isaan mormuudhaan dubbachuu jalqaban; inni dubartii Itoophiyaa fuudhee tureetii.
english: Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses because of the Cushite woman whom he had married; for he had married a Cushite woman.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Waaqayyo karaa Musee qofaan dubbatee? Inni karaa keenyaanis dubbatee ture mitii?” jedhan. Waaqayyos dubbii kana dhagaʼe.
english: They said, “Has the LORD indeed spoken only with Moses? Hasn’t he spoken also with us?” And the LORD heard it.

kikuyu: Museen namoota lafa irra jiraatan hunda caalaa nama akka malee gad of qabu ture.
english: Now the man Moses was very humble, more than all the men who were on the surface of the earth.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos yommusuma Museen, Aroonii fi Miiriyaamiin, “Isin sadanuu gara dunkaana wal gaʼiitti gad baʼaa” jedhe. Isaan sadanuus gad baʼan.
english: The LORD spoke suddenly to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, “You three come out to the Tent of Meeting!” The three of them came out.

kikuyu: Ergasii Waaqayyo utubaa duumessaa keessaan gad buʼee balbala dunkaanaa irra dhaabatee Aroonii fi Miiriyaamin waame. Jarri lachuu isatti dhiʼaannaan,
english: The LORD came down in a pillar of cloud, and stood at the door of the Tent, and called Aaron and Miriam; and they both came forward.

kikuyu: inni akkana jedheen; “Dubbii koo dhagaʼaa: “Yoo raajiin Waaqayyoo gidduu keessan jiraate, ani mulʼata keessa isatti of nan mulʼisa; abjuudhaanis isatti nan dubbadha.
english: He said, “Now hear my words. If there is a prophet among you, I, the LORD, will make myself known to him in a vision. I will speak with him in a dream.

kikuyu: Garuu garbichi koo Museen akkana miti; inni mana koo hunda keessatti amanamaa dha.
english: My servant Moses is not so. He is faithful in all my house.

kikuyu: Ani utuu dhoksaadhaan hin taʼin, ifaan ifatti isatti nan dubbadha; inni bifa Waaqayyoo ni arga. Yoos isin maaliif garbicha koo Museedhaan mormuudhaan dubbachuu hin sodaanne ree?”
english: With him, I will speak mouth to mouth, even plainly, and not in riddles; and he shall see the LORD’s form. Why then were you not afraid to speak against my servant, against Moses?”

kikuyu: Aariin Waaqayyos isaan irratti bobaʼe; innis isaan dhiisee deeme.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against them; and he departed.

kikuyu: Yommuu duumessi sun dunkaana gubbaadhaa ol kaʼetti kunoo, Miiriyaam lamxooftee akkuma cabbii addaattee turte. Aroonis gara isheetti garagalee akka isheen lamxii qabdu arge;
english: The cloud departed from over the Tent; and behold, Miriam was leprous, as white as snow. Aaron looked at Miriam, and behold, she was leprous.

kikuyu: innis Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Maaloo yaa gooftaa ko, cubbuu nu gowwummaadhaan hojjenne sana nutti hin lakkaaʼin.
english: Aaron said to Moses, “Oh, my lord, please don’t count this sin against us, in which we have done foolishly, and in which we have sinned.

kikuyu: Akka gatata foon isaa gariin nyaatamee gadameessa haadha isaa keessaa baʼu tokkoo ishee hin godhin.”
english: Let her not, I pray, be as one dead, of whom the flesh is half consumed when he comes out of his mother’s womb.”

kikuyu: Museen Waaqayyotti booʼee, “Yaa Waaqayyo, maaloo ishee fayyisi!” jedhe.
english: Moses cried to the LORD, saying, “Heal her, God, I beg you!”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akkana jedhee Museedhaaf deebii kenne; “Utuu abbaan ishee fuula isheetti tufee silaa isheen bultii torba salphina keessa turti mitii ree? Isheen bultii torba qubataan ala haa turtu; ergasii deebitee dhufuu dandeessi.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “If her father had but spit in her face, shouldn’t she be ashamed seven days? Let her be shut up outside of the camp seven days, and after that she shall be brought in again.”

kikuyu: Miiriyaam bultii torba qubataan ala turte; sabni sunis hamma isheen deebitutti deemsa itti hin fufne.
english: Miriam was shut up outside of the camp seven days, and the people didn’t travel until Miriam was brought in again.

kikuyu: Ergasii sabni sun Haxerootii kaʼee Gammoojjii Phaaraan keessa qubate.
english: Afterward the people traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akka isaan dhaqanii biyya Kanaʼaan ishee ani Israaʼelootaaf kennuuf jiru sana basaasaniif namoota ergi. Tokkoo tokkoo abbootii gosaa keessaa hoogganaa tokko ergi.”
english: “Send men, that they may spy out the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel. Of every tribe of their fathers, you shall send a man, every one a prince among them.”

kikuyu: Museen ajaja Waaqayyootiin Gammoojjii Phaaraan keessaa isaan erge. Hundi isaanii hooggantoota Israaʼelootaa turan.
english: Moses sent them from the wilderness of Paran according to the commandment of the LORD. All of them were men who were heads of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Maqaan isaanii kanneenii dha: Gosa Ruubeen keessaa Shamuuʼaa ilma Zakuur;
english: These were their names: Of the tribe of Reuben, Shammua the son of Zaccur.

kikuyu: gosa Simiʼoon keessaa Shaafaaxi ilma Hoorii;
english: Of the tribe of Simeon, Shaphat the son of Hori.

kikuyu: gosa Yihuudaa keessaa Kaaleb ilma Yefunee;
english: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

kikuyu: gosa Yisaakor keessaa Yigiʼaal ilma Yoosef;
english: Of the tribe of Issachar, Igal the son of Joseph.

kikuyu: gosa Efreem keessaa Hoosheeʼaa ilma Nuuni;
english: Of the tribe of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Nun.

kikuyu: gosa Beniyaam keessaa Phaaltii ilma Raaphuu;
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Palti the son of Raphu.

kikuyu: gosa Zebuuloon keessaa Gadiiʼeel ilma Soodii;
english: Of the tribe of Zebulun, Gaddiel the son of Sodi.

kikuyu: gosa Minaasee jechuunis gosa Yoosef keessaa Gadii ilma Suus;
english: Of the tribe of Joseph, of the tribe of Manasseh, Gaddi the son of Susi.

kikuyu: gosa Daan keessaa Amiiʼeel ilma Gemaal;
english: Of the tribe of Dan, Ammiel the son of Gemalli.

kikuyu: gosa Aasheer keessaa Sexuur ilma Miikaaʼel;
english: Of the tribe of Asher, Sethur the son of Michael.

kikuyu: gosa Niftaalem keessaa Naahibii ilma Wofsii;
english: Of the tribe of Naphtali, Nahbi the son of Vophsi.

kikuyu: gosa Gaad keessaa Geʼuuʼeel ilma Maakii ti.
english: Of the tribe of Gad, Geuel the son of Machi.

kikuyu: Egaa maqaawwan kunneen maqaawwan namoota akka isaan biyya sana basaasaniif jedhee Museen ergee dha. Museenis Hoosheeʼaa ilma Nuuni sana, “Iyyaasuu” jedhee moggaase.
english: These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.

kikuyu: Museen yommuu akka isaan biyya Kanaʼaanii basaasaniif isaan ergetti akkana jedheen; “Karaa Negeeb darbaatii gara biyya gaaraatti ol baʼaa.
english: Moses sent them to spy out the land of Canaan, and said to them, “Go up this way by the South, and go up into the hill country.

kikuyu: Biyyi sun maal akka fakkaattu, namoonni achi jiraatanis jajjaboo yookaan dadhaboo, muraasa yookaan hedduu taʼuu isaanii ilaalaa.
english: See the land, what it is; and the people who dwell therein, whether they are strong or weak, whether they are few or many;

kikuyu: Isaan biyya akkamii keessa jiraatu? Gaarii yookaan gadhee? Magaalaawwan akkamii keessa jiraatu? Dallaa dhagaa hin qaban moo daʼoo jabaa qabu?
english: and what the land is that they dwell in, whether it is good or bad; and what cities they are that they dwell in, whether in camps, or in strongholds;

kikuyu: Lafti isaa gabbataa dha moo gabbataa miti? Muka qaba moo hin qabu. Jabaadhaatii ija biyyattii keessaa muraasa fidaa.” Waqtiin sun yeroo iji wayinii kan jalqabaa itti bilchaatu ture.
english: and what the land is, whether it is fertile or poor, whether there is wood therein, or not. Be courageous, and bring some of the fruit of the land.” Now the time was the time of the first-ripe grapes.

kikuyu: Isaan ol baʼanii Gammoojjii Siin irraa jalqabanii hamma Rehoobitti gara Leeboo Hamaatitti biyyattii basaasan.
english: So they went up, and spied out the land from the wilderness of Zin to Rehob, to the entrance of Hamath.

kikuyu: Isaanis karaa Negeeb ol baʼanii gara Kebroon lafa Ahiiman, Sheeshaayii fi Talmaayi ilmaan Anaaq sun jiraataniitti dhufan. Kebroon kunis utuu Zooʼaan isheen biyya Gibxi sun hin ijaaramin waggaa torbaan dura ijaaramte.
english: They went up by the South, and came to Hebron; and Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the children of Anak, were there. (Now Hebron was built seven years before Zoan in Egypt.)

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu Sulula Eshkool gaʼanitti hurbuu ija wayinii tokko kutan. Wayinii sanas roomaanii fi harbuu wajjin nama lama taʼanii danqaraadhaan baatan.
english: They came to the valley of Eshcol, and cut down from there a branch with one cluster of grapes, and they bore it on a staff between two. They also brought some of the pomegranates and figs.

kikuyu: Iddoon sun sababii hurbuu ija wayinii kan warri Israaʼel kutan sanaatiif Sulula Eshkool jedhame.
english: That place was called the valley of Eshcol, because of the cluster which the children of Israel cut down from there.

kikuyu: Jarris dhuma bultii afurtamaatti biyya sana basaasanii deebiʼan.
english: They returned from spying out the land at the end of forty days.

kikuyu: Isaanis gara Qaadesh ishee Gammoojjii Phaaraan keessaa gara Musee fi Aroon, gara waldaa Israaʼel guutuu deebiʼanii dhufan. Achittis gabaasa isaaniif dhiʼeessan; ija biyyattiis isaan argisiisan.
english: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, to Kadesh; and brought back word to them and to all the congregation. They showed them the fruit of the land.

kikuyu: Isaanis akkana jedhanii Museetti himan: “Nu gara biyya ati itti nu ergite sanaa dhaqneerra; biyyattiin aannanii fi damma baafti! Iji ishees kunoo kana.
english: They told him, and said, “We came to the land where you sent us. Surely it flows with milk and honey, and this is its fruit.

kikuyu: Garuu namoonni achi jiraatan jajjaboo dha; magaalaawwan ishee dallaa jabaa qabu; gurguddaa dhas. Nu sanyii Anaaq iyyuu achitti argineerra.
english: However, the people who dwell in the land are strong, and the cities are fortified and very large. Moreover, we saw the children of Anak there.

kikuyu: Amaaleqoonni Negeeb keessa jiraatu; Heetonni, Yebuusonnii fi Amooronni biyya gaaraa keessa jiraatu; Kanaʼaanonni immoo galaana biraa fi qarqara Yordaanos jiraatu.”
english: Amalek dwells in the land of the South. The Hittite, the Jebusite, and the Amorite dwell in the hill country. The Canaanite dwells by the sea, and along the side of the Jordan.”

kikuyu: Kaalebis fuula Musee duratti saba calʼisiisee, “Nu dafnee ol baanee biyyattii haa dhaallu; moʼachuu ni dandeenyaatii” jedhe.
english: Caleb stilled the people before Moses, and said, “Let’s go up at once, and possess it; for we are well able to overcome it!”

kikuyu: Namoonni isa wajjin ol baʼanii turan garuu, “Nu warra sana dhaʼuu hin dandeenyu; isaan nurra jajjaboo dha” jedhan.
english: But the men who went up with him said, “We aren’t able to go up against the people; for they are stronger than we.”

kikuyu: Isaanis waaʼee biyya basaasan sanaa saba Israaʼel gidduutti oduu gadhee tamsaasan. Akkanas jedhan; “Biyyi nu basaasne sun biyya warra ishee keessa jiraatu iyyuu nyaattuu dha. Namoonni nu achitti argine hundinuu dhedheeroo dha.
english: They brought up an evil report of the land which they had spied out to the children of Israel, saying, “The land, through which we have gone to spy it out, is a land that eats up its inhabitants; and all the people who we saw in it are men of great stature.

kikuyu: Achitti Nefiiliimota argine; ilmaan Anaaq Nefiiliimota irraa dhufan. Nu ofuma keenyatti iyyuu korophisa fakkaanne; fuula isaanii durattis akkasuma taane.”
english: There we saw the Nephilim, the sons of Anak, who come from the Nephilim. We were in our own sight as grasshoppers, and so we were in their sight.”

kikuyu: Halkan sana namoonni waldaa sanaa hundinuu sagalee isaanii ol fudhatanii booʼan.
english: All the congregation lifted up their voice, and cried; and the people wept that night.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni hundinuu Musee fi Aroonitti guunguman; waldaan guutuunis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Nu utuu biyyuma Gibxitti dhumnee jiraannee! Yookaan utuu gammoojjii kana keessatti dhumnee jiraannee!
english: All the children of Israel murmured against Moses and against Aaron. The whole congregation said to them, “We wish that we had died in the land of Egypt, or that we had died in this wilderness!

kikuyu: Waaqayyo maaliif akka nu goraadeedhaan dhumnuuf jedhee biyya kanatti nu fida? Niitonni keenyaa fi ijoolleen keenya ni boojiʼamu. Biyya Gibxitti deebiʼuun nuu hin wayyuu?”
english: Why does the LORD bring us to this land, to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be captured or killed! Wouldn’t it be better for us to return into Egypt?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Amma hoogganaa filannee biyya Gibxitti haa deebinu” waliin jedhan.
english: They said to one another, “Let’s choose a leader, and let’s return into Egypt.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Musee fi Aroon fuula guutummaa yaaʼii Israaʼel kanneen achitti walitti qabamanii duratti addaan lafatti gombifaman.
english: Then Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before all the assembly of the congregation of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Jarreen biyyattii keessa deemanii basaasan keessaa Iyyaasuun ilmi Nuuniitii fi Kaaleb ilmi Yefunee uffata ofii tarsaasanii,
english: Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.

kikuyu: guutummaa yaaʼii Israaʼelootaatiin akkana jedhan; “Biyyi nu keessa deemnee basaasne sun akka malee gaarii dha.
english: They spoke to all the congregation of the children of Israel, saying, “The land, which we passed through to spy it out, is an exceedingly good land.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo yoo nutti gammade biyya sanatti nu galchee biyyattii aannanii fi damma baaftu sana nuu kenna.
english: If the LORD delights in us, then he will bring us into this land, and give it to us: a land which flows with milk and honey.

kikuyu: Isin garuu Waaqayyotti hin fincilinaa. Waan nu isaan lilliqimsinuuf namoota biyya sanaa hin sodaatinaa. Gaaddisni isaan irraa kaʼeera; Waaqayyo nu wajjin jira. Isaan hin sodaatinaa.”
english: Only don’t rebel against the LORD, neither fear the people of the land; for they are bread for us. Their defense is removed from over them, and the LORD is with us. Don’t fear them.”

kikuyu: Waldaan guutuun garuu dhagaan isaan tumuudhaaf mariʼate. Ulfinni Waaqayyoos fuula dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti Israaʼeloota hundatti mulʼate.
english: But all the congregation threatened to stone them with stones. The LORD’s glory appeared in the Tent of Meeting to all the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Sabni kun hamma yoomiitti akkana na tuffata? Utuma ani mallattoowwan kanneen hunda gidduu isaaniitti hojjedhuu isaan hamma yoomiitti na amanuu didu?
english: The LORD said to Moses, “How long will this people despise me? How long will they not believe in me, for all the signs which I have worked among them?

kikuyu: Ani golfaadhaan dhaʼee isaan nan balleessa; siʼi garuu saba isaan caalaa guddaa fi jabaa sin godha.”
english: I will strike them with the pestilence, and disinherit them, and will make of you a nation greater and mightier than they.”

kikuyu: Museen Waaqayyoon akkana jedhe; “Warri Gibxi waaʼee waan kanaa ni dhagaʼu! Ati humna keetiin saba kana gidduu isaaniitii baaftee fiddeertaatii.
english: Moses said to the LORD, “Then the Egyptians will hear it; for you brought up this people in your might from among them.

kikuyu: Isaanis waaʼee waan kanaa saba biyya sana keessa jiraatutti ni odeessu. Yaa Waaqayyo, isaan akka ati saba kana gidduu jirtu dhagaʼaniiru; yaa Waaqayyo isaan akka ati fuuluma isaaniitti mulʼatu, akka duumessi kee isaaniin ol jiruu fi akka ati guyyaa utubaa duumessaatiin, halkan immoo utubaa ibiddaatiin isaan dura deemtu dhagaʼanii jiru.
english: They will tell it to the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that you LORD are among this people; for you LORD are seen face to face, and your cloud stands over them, and you go before them, in a pillar of cloud by day, and in a pillar of fire by night.

kikuyu: Yoo ati saba kana yeruma tokkotti barbadeessite, saboonni oduu waaʼee keetii dhagaʼan,
english: Now if you killed this people as one man, then the nations which have heard the fame of you will speak, saying,

kikuyu: ‘Waaqayyo biyya kakuudhaan waadaa isaaniif gale sanatti saba kana galchuu hin dandeenye; inni kanumaaf gammoojjii keessatti isaan gogorraʼe’ jedhu.
english: ‘Because the LORD was not able to bring this people into the land which he swore to them, therefore he has slain them in the wilderness.’

kikuyu: “Egaa akkuma ati akkana jettee dubbatte sanatti jabinni Gooftaa haa argisiifamu:
english: Now please let the power of the Lord be great, according as you have spoken, saying,

kikuyu: ‘Waaqayyo dafee hin aaru; jaalalli isaa immoo guddaa dha; inni cubbuu fi fincila namaaf dhiisa. Taʼu illee inni nama yakka hojjetu adabu malee hin dhiisu; inni hamma dhaloota sadaffaa fi afuraffaatti sababii cubbuu abbootii isaaniitiif jedhee ijoollee ni adaba.’
english: ‘The LORD is slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness, forgiving iniquity and disobedience; and he will by no means clear the guilty, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children, on the third and on the fourth generation.’

kikuyu: Akkuma yeroo isaan biyya Gibxii baʼanii jalqabdee hamma ammaatti dhiifama isaaniif goote sana akkuma jaalala kee guddaa sanaatti cubbuu saba kanaa dhiisiif.”
english: Please pardon the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of your loving kindness, and just as you have forgiven this people, from Egypt even until now.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Ani akkuma ati kadhatte sana isaaniif dhiiseera.
english: The LORD said, “I have pardoned according to your word;

kikuyu: Taʼu illee akkuma ani dhugumaan jiraataa taʼee fi akkuma ulfinni Waaqayyoo dhugumaan lafa hunda guute sana,
english: but in very deed—as I live, and as all the earth shall be filled with the LORD’s glory—

kikuyu: namoota ulfina koo arganii, mallattoowwan ani biyya Gibxiitii fi gammoojjii keessatti hojjedhe arganii garuu naa ajajamuu didanii yeroo kudhan na qoran sana keessaa namni tokko iyyuu,
english: because all those men who have seen my glory and my signs, which I worked in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet have tempted me these ten times, and have not listened to my voice;

kikuyu: tokkoon isaanii biyya ani kakuudhaan abbootii isaaniitiif waadaa gale sana hin argan. Namni na tuffate tokko biyya sana hin argu.
english: surely they shall not see the land which I swore to their fathers, neither shall any of those who despised me see it.

kikuyu: Garbicha koo Kaaleb garuu sababii inni hafuura addaa qabuu fi sababii garaa guutuudhaan na duukaa buʼaa jiruuf, ani biyya inni dhaqe sanatti isa galcha; sanyiin isaas biyya sana ni dhaala.
english: But my servant Caleb, because he had another spirit with him, and has followed me fully, him I will bring into the land into which he went. His offspring shall possess it.

kikuyu: Sababii Amaaleqoonnii fi Kanaʼaanonni Sululoota keessa jiraataniif, isin bor deebiʼaatii karaa Galaana Diimaatiin gammoojjiitti qajeelaa.”
english: Since the Amalekite and the Canaanite dwell in the valley, tomorrow turn and go into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Musee fi Arooniin akkana jedhe:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: “Waldaan hamaan kun hamma yoomiitti natti guunguma? Ani guungummii Israaʼeloota guungumtoota sanaa dhagaʼeera.
english: “How long shall I bear with this evil congregation that complain against me? I have heard the complaints of the children of Israel, which they complain against me.

kikuyu: Akkana jedhii isaanitti himi; ‘Waaqayyo akkana jedha; ani jiraataadhaatii, akkuma isin gurra kootti dubbattan sana anis isinitti godha:
english: Tell them, ‘As I live, says the LORD, surely as you have spoken in my ears, so I will do to you.

kikuyu: Reeffi keessan jechuunis reeffi warra umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaa fi digdamaa olii kanneen lakkoobsa uummataa keessatti lakkaaʼamanii natti guunguman hundaa gammoojjii kana keessatti harcaʼee hafa.
english: Your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness; and all who were counted of you, according to your whole number, from twenty years old and upward, who have complained against me,

kikuyu: Kaaleb ilma Yefuneetii fi Iyyaasuu ilma Nuuni malee tokkoon keessan iyyuu biyya ani keessa isin qubachiisuuf kakadhe sanatti hin galtan.
english: surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Ani garuu ijoollee keessan warra isin ni boojiʼamu jettan sana itti nan galcha; isaanis biyya isin tuffattan sana ni beeku.
english: But I will bring in your little ones that you said should be captured or killed, and they shall know the land which you have rejected.

kikuyu: Isin garuu, reeffi keessan gammoojjuma kana keessatti harcaʼa.
english: But as for you, your dead bodies shall fall in this wilderness.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen keessan waggaa afurtama gammoojjii kana keessa ni jooru; hamma isin hundi gammoojjii keessatti dhumtanitti isaan sababii amanamummaa dhabuu keessaniitiif achitti rakkatu.
english: Your children shall be wanderers in the wilderness forty years, and shall bear your prostitution, until your dead bodies are consumed in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Isin akkuma bultii afurtama biyya sana basaastan, akkasuma bultiin tokko akka waggaa tokkootti lakkaaʼamee waggaa afurtama cubbuu keessaniif dhiphattu; yeroo sana isin akka ani isiniin mormu ni beektu.’
english: After the number of the days in which you spied out the land, even forty days, for every day a year, you will bear your iniquities, even forty years, and you will know my alienation.’

kikuyu: Ani Waaqayyo waan kana dubbadheen jira; ani dhugumaan waan kana waldaa hamaa naan mormuuf walitti gurmaaʼe kana guutuutti nan fida. Isaan gammoojjii kana keessatti dhumu; asumattis ni duʼu.”
english: I, the LORD, have spoken. I will surely do this to all this evil congregation who are gathered together against me. In this wilderness they shall be consumed, and there they shall die.”

kikuyu: Namoonni Museen akka isaan biyyattii basaasaniif erge yommuu achii deebiʼanitti waaʼee biyya sanaa gabaasa hamaa waldaatti gabaasanii akka waldaan Museetti guungumu godhan jechuunis
english: The men whom Moses sent to spy out the land, who returned and made all the congregation to murmur against him by bringing up an evil report against the land,

kikuyu: namoonni waaʼee biyyattii gabaasa hamaa gabaasuutti gaafataman sun dhaʼichaan fuula Waaqayyoo duratti dhuman.
english: even those men who brought up an evil report of the land, died by the plague before the LORD.

kikuyu: Namoota biyyattii basaasuu dhaqan keessaa Iyyaasuu ilma Nuunitii fi Kaaleb ilma Yefunee qofatu duʼa oole.
english: But Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh remained alive of those men who went to spy out the land.

kikuyu: Museen waan kana hunda Israaʼelootatti himnaan isaan akka malee booʼan.
english: Moses told these words to all the children of Israel, and the people mourned greatly.

kikuyu: Isaanis guyyaa itti aanu ganamaan fiixee biyya gaaraatti ol baʼanii, “Nu cubbuu hojjenneerra; nu amma gara lafa Waaqayyo waadaa nuu gale sanaa dhaqna” jedhan.
english: They rose up early in the morning and went up to the top of the mountain, saying, “Behold, we are here, and will go up to the place which the LORD has promised; for we have sinned.”

kikuyu: Museen garuu akkana jedhe; “Isin maaliif ajaja Waaqayyoo cabsitu? Wanni kun isiniif hin milkaaʼu!
english: Moses said, “Why now do you disobey the commandment of the LORD, since it shall not prosper?

kikuyu: Akka diinota keessaniin hin moʼatamneef ol hin baʼinaa; Waaqayyo isin wajjin hin jiruutii;
english: Don’t go up, for the LORD isn’t among you; that way you won’t be struck down before your enemies.

kikuyu: Amaaleqoonnii fi Kanaʼaanonni achitti isinitti dhufuutii. Sababii isin Waaqayyo irraa garagaltaniif inni isin wajjin hin jiraatu; goraadeedhaan barbadeeffamtu.”
english: For there the Amalekite and the Canaanite are before you, and you will fall by the sword because you turned back from following the LORD; therefore the LORD will not be with you.”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu utuu Musee fi taabonni kakuu Waaqayyoo qubata keessaa gad hin baʼin yaaduma isaaniitiin kaʼanii fiixee biyya gaaraatti ol baʼan.
english: But they presumed to go up to the top of the mountain. Nevertheless, the ark of the LORD’s covenant and Moses didn’t depart out of the camp.

kikuyu: Yommus Amaaleqoonnii fi Kanaʼaanonni gaara sana irra jiraatan gad buʼanii isaan dhaʼanii hamma Hormaatti isaan ariʼan.
english: Then the Amalekites came down, and the Canaanites who lived in that mountain, and struck them and beat them down even to Hormah.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Saba Israaʼelitti akkana jedhii dubbadhu: ‘Yommuu biyya ani akka isin keessa jiraattaniif isiniif kennu sana seentanii
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you have come into the land of your habitations, which I give to you,

kikuyu: aarsaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamu kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti tolu, loon keessaa yookaan bushaayee keessaa fuutanii aarsaa gubamu yookaan qalma wareega addaatiif yookaan aarsaa fedhii keessanii yookaan aarsaa ayyaana waggaa Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessitu,
english: and will make an offering by fire to the LORD—a burnt offering, or a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or as a free will offering, or in your set feasts, to make a pleasant aroma to the LORD, of the herd, or of the flock—

kikuyu: namni aarsaa dhiʼeessu sun daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii harka kudhan keessaa harka tokko kan zayitii iinii harka afur keessa harka tokkootiin sukkuumame kennaa midhaanii godhee Waaqayyoof haa dhiʼeessu.
english: then he who offers his offering shall offer to the LORD a meal offering of one tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with one fourth of a hin of oil.

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo xobbaallaa hoolaa kan aarsaa gubamuuf yookaan qalmaaf dhiʼeeffamu wajjinis daadhii wayinii iinii harka afur keessaa harka tokko dhibaayyuudhaaf qopheessi.
english: You shall prepare wine for the drink offering, one fourth of a hin, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.

kikuyu: “ ‘Korbeessa hoolaa tokko wajjinis daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii harka kudhan keessaa harka lama kan zayitii iinii harka sadii keessaa harka tokkoon sukkumameen kennaa midhaanii qopheessi.
english: “‘For a ram, you shall prepare for a meal offering two tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with the third part of a hin of oil;

kikuyu: Daadhii wayinii iinii harka sadii keessaa harka tokko dhibaayyuu urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti tolu godhii dhiʼeessi.
english: and for the drink offering you shall offer the third part of a hin of wine, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ati yommuu dibicha loonii tokko aarsaa gubamu yookaan qalma wareega addaatiif yookaan aarsaa nagaatiif Waaqayyoof qopheessitutti,
english: When you prepare a bull for a burnt offering or for a sacrifice, to accomplish a vow, or for peace offerings to the LORD,

kikuyu: dibicha sana wajjin kennaa midhaanii fidi; kennaan sunis daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii harka kudhan keessaa harka sadii kan zayitii walakkaa iiniitiin sukkuumame haa taʼu.
english: then he shall offer with the bull a meal offering of three tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;

kikuyu: Akkasumas daadhii wayinii iinii walakkaa dhibaayyuu godhii fidi. Wanni kunis aarsaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamu kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti tolu taʼa.
english: and you shall offer for the drink offering half a hin of wine, for an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon dibicha loonii yookaan korbeessa hoolaa, tokkoon tokkoon xobbaallaa hoolaa yookaan korbeessa reʼee xinnaa haaluma kanaan haa qopheeffaman.
english: Thus it shall be done for each bull, for each ram, for each of the male lambs, or of the young goats.

kikuyu: Akkuma baayʼina waan qopheessitan sanaatti akkuma lakkoobsa isaaniitti, tokkoo tokkoo isaaniitiif akkanuma godhaa.
english: According to the number that you shall prepare, so you shall do to everyone according to their number.

kikuyu: “ ‘Namni dhalataa biyya sanaa taʼe hundinuu yeroo aarsaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamu kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti tolu fidutti wantoota kanneen haaluma kanaan haa hojjetu.
english: “‘All who are native-born shall do these things in this way, in offering an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Dhaloota dhufu keessattis alagaan yookaan namni gidduu keessan jiraatu yeroo aarsaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamu kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti tolu dhiʼeessutti akkuma isin gootan kana haa godhu.
english: If a stranger lives as a foreigner with you, or whoever may be among you throughout your generations, and will offer an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD, as you do, so he shall do.

kikuyu: Yaaʼiin sun isinii fi alagaa isin gidduu jiraatuuf illee seeruma tokko haa qabaatu; kunis dhaloota dhufuuf seera bara baraa ti. Atii fi alagaan sun fuula Waaqayyoo duratti wal qixxee dha.
english: For the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner, a statute forever throughout your generations. As you are, so the foreigner shall be before the LORD.

kikuyu: Isiniifis alagaa isin gidduu jiraatuufis seerrii fi dambiin tokkuma haa taʼu.’ ”
english: One law and one ordinance shall be for you and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner with you.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akkana jedhii Israaʼelootatti dubbadhu: ‘Isin yeroo biyya ani itti isin galchu sana seentanii
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land where I bring you,

kikuyu: midhaan ishee nyaattanitti, nyaata sana irraa Waaqayyoof kennaa dhiʼeessaa.
english: then it shall be that when you eat of the bread of the land, you shall offer up a wave offering to the LORD.

kikuyu: Bukoo keessan kan jalqabaa irraa maxinoo tokko kennaa dhiʼeessaa; isas akka aarsaa oobdii irraa fuudhameetti dhiʼeessaa.
english: Of the first of your dough you shall offer up a cake for a wave offering. As the wave offering of the threshing floor, so you shall heave it.

kikuyu: Dhaloota dhufu hundumaa keessatti bukoo keessan kan jalqabaa irraa Waaqayyoof kennaa kennuu qabdu.
english: Of the first of your dough, you shall give to the LORD a wave offering throughout your generations.

kikuyu: “ ‘Yoo isin utuu hin beekin ajajawwan Waaqayyo Museetti kenne kanneen keessaa tokko illee
english: “‘When you err, and don’t observe all these commandments which the LORD has spoken to Moses—

kikuyu: jechuunis yoo isin ajaja Waaqayyoo kan gaafa Waaqayyo ajaja kana kennee jalqabee dhaloota dhufu keessa illee ittuma fufuudhaan karaa Museetiin isin ajaje kam iyyuu cabsitan,
english: even all that the LORD has commanded you by Moses, from the day that the LORD gave commandment and onward throughout your generations—

kikuyu: yoo wanti kun dogoggoraan utuu waldaan hin beekin hojjetamee jiraate waldaan sun hundi dibicha loonii aarsaa gubamu kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti tolu, kennaa midhaaniitii fi dhibaayyuu ajajame wajjin, aarsaa cubbuutiif immoo korbeessa reʼee haa dhiʼeessan.
english: then it shall be, if it was done unwittingly, without the knowledge of the congregation, that all the congregation shall offer one young bull for a burnt offering, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD, with its meal offering and its drink offering, according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Lubnis waldaa saba Israaʼel hundaaf araara haa buusu; isaanis waan utuu hin beekin cubbuu hojjetaniif, balleessaa isaaniitiifis waan aarsaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamuu fi aarsaa cubbuu Waaqayyoof fidaniif dhiifama ni argatu.
english: The priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the children of Israel, and they shall be forgiven; for it was an error, and they have brought their offering, an offering made by fire to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD, for their error.

kikuyu: Sababii sabni hundi balleessaa dogoggoraan hojjetame sana keessatti hirmaateefis waldaan saba Israaʼel hundii fi alagaawwan isaan gidduu jiraatan dhiifama ni argatu.
english: All the congregation of the children of Israel shall be forgiven, as well as the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them; for with regard to all the people, it was done unwittingly.

kikuyu: “ ‘Garuu yoo namni tokko qofti utuu hin beekin cubbuu hojjete inni goromtii reʼee kan umuriin ishee waggaa tokkoo aarsaa cubbuutiif haa fidu.
english: “‘If a person sins unwittingly, then he shall offer a female goat a year old for a sin offering.

kikuyu: Lubni sunis namicha utuu itti hin yaadin cubbuu hojjete sanaaf fuula Waaqayyoo duratti araara haa buusu; erga araarri isaaf buʼee booddee immoo namichi sun dhiifama ni argata.
english: The priest shall make atonement for the soul who errs when he sins unwittingly before the LORD. He shall make atonement for him; and he shall be forgiven.

kikuyu: Dhalataa Israaʼeliifis taʼu yookaan alagaa isin gidduu jiraatuuf, nama utuu itti hin yaadin cubbuu hojjete hundaaf seerri tokkuma haa taʼu.
english: You shall have one law for him who does anything unwittingly, for him who is native-born among the children of Israel, and for the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them.

kikuyu: “ ‘Garuu dhalataa biyyaas taʼu yookaan alagaan, namni beekaa cubbuu hojjetu Waaqayyoon arrabsuu isaa ti; namichi sun saba isaa keessaa haa balleeffamu.
english: “‘But the soul who does anything with a high hand, whether he is native-born or a foreigner, blasphemes the LORD. That soul shall be cut off from among his people.

kikuyu: Namichi sun sababii dubbii Waaqayyoo tuffatee fi sababii ajaja isaa cabseef inni haa balleeffamu; balleessaa isaattis isatu gaafatama.’ ”
english: Because he has despised the LORD’s word, and has broken his commandment, that soul shall be utterly cut off. His iniquity shall be on him.’”

kikuyu: Yeroo sabni Israaʼel gammoojjii keessa turetti, namni tokko utuu guyyaa Sanbataatiin qoraan walitti qabatuu argame.
english: While the children of Israel were in the wilderness, they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.

kikuyu: Warri utuu inni qoraan walitti qabatuu arganis Museetti, Arooniitii fi waldaa guutuutti isa geessan;
english: Those who found him gathering sticks brought him to Moses and Aaron, and to all the congregation.

kikuyu: sababii wanni isa godhan hin beekaminiif hidhanii isa tursan.
english: They put him in custody, because it had not been declared what should be done to him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan, “Namichi duʼuu qaba. Waldaan sun guutuun qubataan alatti dhagaadhaan isa haa tumu” jedhe.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “The man shall surely be put to death. All the congregation shall stone him with stones outside of the camp.”

kikuyu: Waldaan sun akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti namicha sana qubata keessaa gad baasee dhagaadhaan tumee ajjeese.
english: All the congregation brought him outside of the camp, and stoned him to death with stones, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akkana jedhii Israaʼelootatti dubbadhu: ‘Dhaloota dhufu hunda keessa qarqara wayyaa keessanii irratti handaara tolfadhaa; tokkoon tokkoon handaara sanaas foʼaa bifa cuquliisaa haa qabaatu.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them that they should make themselves fringes on the borders of their garments throughout their generations, and that they put on the fringe of each border a cord of blue.

kikuyu: Isin handaara kana ilaaltanii ajaja Waaqayyoo hunda yaadattu; kunis akka ajaja kana eegdanii hawwii garaa keessaniitii fi hawwii ija keessanii duukaa buʼuudhaan hin sagaagalleef.
english: It shall be to you for a fringe, that you may see it, and remember all the LORD’s commandments, and do them; and that you don’t follow your own heart and your own eyes, after which you used to play the prostitute;

kikuyu: Yoos isin ajaja koo hunda yaadattanii ni eegdu; Waaqa keessaniifis qulqulloota ni taatu.
english: so that you may remember and do all my commandments, and be holy to your God.

kikuyu: Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan kan Waaqa isinii taʼuuf jedhee biyya Gibxii isin baasee dha. Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan.’ ”
english: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, to be your God: I am the LORD your God.”

kikuyu: Qooraahi ilmi Yizihaar, ilmi Qohaati, ilmi Lewwii, gosa Ruubeen keessaa immoo ilmaan Eliiyaab, Daataanii fi Abiiraam akkasumas Ooni ilmi Phelet kaʼanii
english: Now Korah, the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, with Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, and On, the son of Peleth, sons of Reuben, took some men.

kikuyu: Museedhaan morman. Isaan wajjinis namoota Israaʼel jechuunis hooggantoota waldaa bebeekamoo kanneen miseensa yaaʼii taʼanii muudamanii turan 250 gaʼantu ture.
english: They rose up before Moses, with some of the children of Israel, two hundred fifty princes of the congregation, called to the assembly, men of renown.

kikuyu: Isaanis Musee fi Arooniin mormuuf jedhanii tokkummaadhaan walitti qabamanii dhufanii akkana isaaniin jedhan; “Isin dubbii baayʼiftaniirtu! Waldaan kun guutummaatti tokkoon tokkoon isaanii iyyuu qulqulluu dha; Waaqayyos isaan wajjin jira. Yoos isin maaliif waldaa Waaqayyoo irratti of tuultu ree?”
english: They assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron, and said to them, “You take too much on yourself, since all the congregation are holy, everyone of them, and the LORD is among them! Why do you lift yourselves up above the LORD’s assembly?”

kikuyu: Museen dubbii kana dhageenyaan addaan lafatti gombifame.
english: When Moses heard it, he fell on his face.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Qooraahii fi warra isa duukaa buʼan hundaan akkana jedhe: “Bori ganama Waaqayyo nama kan isaa taʼee fi nama qulqulluu taʼe ni argisiisa; akka namni sun gara isaatti dhiʼaatu illee ni godha. Inni nama filate sana akka inni itti dhiʼaatu godha.
english: He said to Korah and to all his company, “In the morning, the LORD will show who are his, and who is holy, and will cause him to come near to him. Even him whom he shall choose, he will cause to come near to him.

kikuyu: Qooraahi, atii fi warri si duukaa buʼan hundi waan kana godhaa: Girgiraawwan fudhadhaatii
english: Do this: have Korah and all his company take censers,

kikuyu: bori fuula Waaqayyoo duratti ibiddaa fi ixaana itti naqaa. Namni Waaqayyo filatu inni nama qulqulluu taʼa. Isin Lewwonni dubbii baayʼiftaniirtu!”
english: put fire in them, and put incense on them before the LORD tomorrow. It shall be that the man whom the LORD chooses, he shall be holy. You have gone too far, you sons of Levi!”

kikuyu: Museenis Qooraahiidhaan akkana jedhe; “Isin Lewwonni mee dhagaʼaa!
english: Moses said to Korah, “Hear now, you sons of Levi!

kikuyu: Waaqni Israaʼel waldaa Israaʼel kaan keessaa isin filatee akka isin hojii dunkaana qulqulluu Waaqayyoo hojjettanii fi akka isin fuula waldaa dura dhaabatanii isaan tajaajiltaniif jedhee ofitti isin dhiʼeessuun isaa isin hin gaʼuu?
english: Is it a small thing to you that the God of Israel has separated you from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to himself, to do the service of the LORD’s tabernacle, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them;

kikuyu: Inni siʼii fi Lewwota si wajjin jiran hunda ofitti dhiʼeesseera; isin garuu lubummaa illee fudhachuu barbaaddan.
english: and that he has brought you near, and all your brothers the sons of Levi with you? Do you seek the priesthood also?

kikuyu: Kanaafuu atii fi miiltonni kee hundinuu walitti qabamtanii Waaqayyoon mormitan. Aroon isin itti guungumtan kun eenyuu dha?”
english: Therefore you and all your company have gathered together against the LORD! What is Aaron that you complain against him?”

kikuyu: Museenis ergasii ilmaan Eliiyaab Daataanii fi Abiiraam waamsise. Isaan garuu akkana jedhan; “Nu hin dhufnu!
english: Moses sent to call Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab; and they said, “We won’t come up!

kikuyu: Ati gammoojjii keessatti nu fixuuf jettee biyya aannanii fi damma baasu keessaa nu baasuun kee si hin gaʼuu? Amma immoo gooftaa nutti taʼuu feetaa?
english: Is it a small thing that you have brought us up out of a land flowing with milk and honey, to kill us in the wilderness, but you must also make yourself a prince over us?

kikuyu: Kana malee iyyuu ati biyya aannanii fi damma baasutti nu hin galchine yookaan dhaala lafa qotiisaatii fi iddoo dhaabaa wayinii nuu hin kennine. Ati ija namoota kanaa ni baaftaa? Lakkii, nu hin dhufnu!”
english: Moreover you haven’t brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor given us inheritance of fields and vineyards. Will you put out the eyes of these men? We won’t come up.”

kikuyu: Museen akka malee aaree Waaqayyoon, “Aarsaa isaanii hin fudhatin. Ani harree tokko illee isaan irraa hin fudhanne yookaan isaan keessaa nama tokko illee hin miine” jedhe.
english: Moses was very angry, and said to the LORD, “Don’t respect their offering. I have not taken one donkey from them, neither have I hurt one of them.”

kikuyu: Museen Qooraahiidhaan akkana jedhe; “Atii fi miiltonni kee hundinuu akkasumas ati, isaanii fi Aroon bori fuula Waaqayyoo duratti argamaa.
english: Moses said to Korah, “You and all your company go before the LORD, you, and they, and Aaron, tomorrow.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon namaa girgiraa isaa fudhatee, ixaana itti naqatee fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa dhiʼeessu; girgiraawwan kunneenis walumaa galatti 250 taʼu. Akkasumas atii fi Aroon girgiraa keessan dhiʼeessuu qabdu.”
english: Each man take his censer and put incense on it, and each man bring before the LORD his censer, two hundred fifty censers; you also, and Aaron, each with his censer.”

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon namaa girgiraa isaa fudhatee, ibiddaa fi ixaana itti naqatee Musee fi Aroon wajjin balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii dura dhaabate.
english: They each took his censer, and put fire in it, and laid incense on it, and stood at the door of the Tent of Meeting with Moses and Aaron.

kikuyu: Yeroo Qooraahi isaaniin mormuuf jedhee duukaa buutota isaa hunda balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti walitti qabetti, ulfinni Waaqayyoo waldaa guutuutti mulʼate.
english: Korah assembled all the congregation opposite them to the door of the Tent of Meeting. The LORD’s glory appeared to all the congregation.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Musee fi Arooniin akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: “Akka ani yeruma tokkoon isaan fixuuf waldaa kana irraa gargar baʼaa.”
english: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”

kikuyu: Musee fi Aroon garuu addaan lafatti gombifamanii akkana jedhanii iyyan; “Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa hafuurota sanyii nama hundaa, ati yoo namni tokko yakke waldaa guutuutti dheekkamtaa?”
english: They fell on their faces, and said, “God, the God of the spirits of all flesh, shall one man sin, and will you be angry with all the congregation?”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Waldaa kanaan, ‘Dunkaanota Qooraahi, kan Daataaniitii fi Abiiraam irraa fagaadhaa’ jedhi.”
english: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’”

kikuyu: Museenis kaʼee gara Daataanii fi Abiiraam dhaqe; maanguddoonni Israaʼelis isa duukaa buʼan.
english: Moses rose up and went to Dathan and Abiram; and the elders of Israel followed him.

kikuyu: Innis waldaa sanaan, “Dunkaana namoota hamoo kanneenii irraa fagaadhaa! Isin akka sababii cubbuu isaanii hundaan hin barbadeeffamneef waan kan isaanii taʼe kam iyyuu hin tuqinaa” jedhe.
english: He spoke to the congregation, saying, “Depart, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and touch nothing of theirs, lest you be consumed in all their sins!”

kikuyu: Isaan dunkaanota Qooraahi, kan Daataanii fi kan Abiiraamiis irraa fagaatan. Daataanii fi Abiiraamiis gad baʼanii niitota, ijoollee fi daaʼimman isaanii wajjin balbala dunkaanota isaanii dura dhadhaabachaa turan.
english: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.

kikuyu: Ergasii Museen akkana jedhe; “Ani wantoota kanneen hunda akkan hojjedhuuf Waaqayyo akka na erge, kunis yaada koo akka hin taʼin isin kanaan ni beektu:
english: Moses said, “Hereby you shall know that the LORD has sent me to do all these works; for they are not from my own mind.

kikuyu: Yoo namoonni kunneen duʼuma uumamaan dhufu duʼanii fi wanni nama hundatti dhufu isaanitti dhufe Waaqayyo na hin ergine.
english: If these men die the common death of all men, or if they experience what all men experience, then the LORD hasn’t sent me.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo Waaqayyo waan guutummaan guutuutti haaraa taʼe tokko isaanitti fidee lafti afaan bantee waan isaan qaban hunda wajjin isaan liqimsite, yoo isaanis utuma lubbuun jiranuu boolla buʼan, isin akka namoonni kunneen Waaqayyoon tuffatan ni beektan.”
english: But if the LORD makes a new thing, and the ground opens its mouth, and swallows them up with all that belong to them, and they go down alive into Sheol, then you shall understand that these men have despised the LORD.”

kikuyu: Akkuma inni waan kana hunda dubbatee fixateen lafti isaan jalaa baqaqxe;
english: As he finished speaking all these words, the ground that was under them split apart.

kikuyu: lafti sunis afaan bantee warra mana isaanii, namoota Qooraahi hundaa fi qabeenya isaanii hunda wajjin isaan liqimsite.
english: The earth opened its mouth and swallowed them up with their households, all of Korah’s men, and all their goods.

kikuyu: Isaanis waan qaban hunda wajjin jiraatti boolla buʼan; laftis isaan irratti afaan walitti deebifatte; isaanis akkasiin waldaa keessaa balleeffaman.
english: So they, and all that belonged to them went down alive into Sheol. The earth closed on them, and they perished from among the assembly.

kikuyu: Isaan iyyinaan Israaʼeloonni naannoo isaanii turan hundinuu, “Lafti kun nuunis ni liqimsiti!” jedhanii iyyaa baqatan.
english: All Israel that were around them fled at their cry; for they said, “Lest the earth swallow us up!”

kikuyu: Ibiddi Waaqayyo biraa gad buʼee namoota 250 kanneen aarsaa ixaanaa dhiʼeessaa turan sana fixe.
english: Fire came out from the LORD, and devoured the two hundred fifty men who offered the incense.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akka inni girgiraawwan sana lafa jarri itti gubamanii fuudhee cilee isaanii kan bobaʼu achi fageessee keessaa bittinneessuuf Eleʼaazaar ilma Aroon lubichaatti himi; girgiraawwan sun qulqulluudhaatii.
english: “Speak to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, that he take up the censers out of the burning, and scatter the fire away from the camp; for they are holy,

kikuyu: Girgiraawwan kunneenis girgiraawwan namoota lubbuu isaaniitti muruudhaan cubbuu hojjetanii ti. Girgiraawwan sanas iddoo aarsaatti uffisuudhaaf tumii haphisi; isaan fuula Waaqayyoo duratti dhiʼeeffamanii qulqulluu taʼaniiruutii. Isaanis Israaʼelootaaf mallattoo haa taʼan.”
english: even the censers of those who sinned against their own lives. Let them be beaten into plates for a covering of the altar, for they offered them before the LORD. Therefore they are holy. They shall be a sign to the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Eleʼaazaar lubichi girgiraawwan naasii kanneen namoonni gubaman sun dhiʼeessan sana iddoo aarsaatti uffisuudhaaf jedhee walitti qabee tume.
english: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

kikuyu: Kanas akkuma Waaqayyo karaa Museetiin isa ajajetti hojjete. Kunis akka sanyii Aroon malee namni tokko iyyuu ixaana aarsuuf fuula Waaqayyoo duratti hin dhiʼaanne, yoo kanaa achii akka inni akkuma Qooraahiitii fi miiltota isaa sanaa taʼu Israaʼeloota yaadataniif.
english: to be a memorial to the children of Israel, to the end that no stranger who isn’t of the offspring of Aaron, would come near to burn incense before the LORD, that he not be as Korah and as his company; as the LORD spoke to him by Moses.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti waldaan Israaʼel hundi, “Isin saba Waaqayyoo fixxan” jedhanii Musee fi Aroonitti guunguman.
english: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed the LORD’s people!”

kikuyu: Garuu yeroo waldaan sun Musee fi Arooniin mormuudhaaf walitti qabamee gara dunkaana wal gaʼii ilaaletti, kunoo duumessi dunkaana sana haguuge; ulfinni Waaqayyoos ni mulʼate.
english: When the congregation was assembled against Moses and against Aaron, they looked toward the Tent of Meeting. Behold, the cloud covered it, and the LORD’s glory appeared.

kikuyu: Musee fi Aroon gara fuuldura dunkaana wal gaʼii dhaqan;
english: Moses and Aaron came to the front of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akka ani yommusuma isaan balleessuuf, waldaa kana biraa fagaadhu.” Isaanis addaan lafatti gombifaman.
english: “Get away from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!” They fell on their faces.

kikuyu: Ergasii Museen Arooniin akkana jedhe; “Girgiraa kee fudhadhuutii iddoo aarsaa irraa ixaana ibidda wajjin itti naqadhuutii araara isaaniif buusuudhaaf gara waldaatti fiigi. Dheekkamsi Waaqayyo biraa dhufeera; dhaʼichi jalqabeera.”
english: Moses said to Aaron, “Take your censer, put fire from the altar in it, lay incense on it, carry it quickly to the congregation, and make atonement for them; for wrath has gone out from the LORD! The plague has begun.”

kikuyu: Aroon akkuma Museen jedhe sana fiigee gidduu waldaa seene. Yeroo kanatti dhaʼichi gidduu waldaatti jalqabee ture. Aroon garuu ixaana dhiʼeessee araara isaaniif buuse.
english: Aaron did as Moses said, and ran into the middle of the assembly. The plague had already begun among the people. He put on the incense, and made atonement for the people.

kikuyu: Innis warra jiruu fi warra duʼe gidduu ijaajje; dhaʼichi sunis ni dhaabate.
english: He stood between the dead and the living; and the plague was stayed.

kikuyu: Garuu namoota sababii Qooraahiitiif dhuman malee namoota 14,700 gaʼantu dhaʼicha sanaan dhume.
english: Now those who died by the plague were fourteen thousand seven hundred, in addition to those who died about the matter of Korah.

kikuyu: Aroon sababii dhaʼichi sun dhaabateef gara balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii gara Museetti deebiʼe.
english: Aaron returned to Moses to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and the plague was stopped.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Israaʼelootatti dubbadhuutii hooggantoota gosa abbootii isaanii harkaa ulee tokko tokko, walumaa galatti uleewwan kudha lama fuudhi. Maqaa tokkoo tokkoo namaas ulee isaa irratti barreessi.
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and take rods from them, one for each fathers’ house, of all their princes according to their fathers’ houses, twelve rods. Write each man’s name on his rod.

kikuyu: Sababii tokkoo tokkoo hoogganaa gosa abbootiitiif uleen tokko jiraachuu qabuuf maqaa Aroon ulee Lewwii irratti barreessi.
english: You shall write Aaron’s name on Levi’s rod. There shall be one rod for each head of their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Uleewwan kanneenis dunkaana wal gaʼii keessa fuula taabota kakuu seeraa dura iddoo ani itti isiniin wal argu sana kaaʼi.
english: You shall lay them up in the Tent of Meeting before the covenant, where I meet with you.

kikuyu: Uleen nama ani filadhuu ni lata; anis guungummii Israaʼeloonni yeroo hunda isinitti guunguman of irraa nan kuta.”
