english: It shall happen that the rod of the man whom I shall choose shall bud. I will make the murmurings of the children of Israel, which they murmur against you, cease from me.”

kikuyu: Museen Israaʼelootatti dubbate; hooggantoonni isaaniis uleewwan kudha lama jechuunis hooggantoota tokkoo tokkoo gosa abbootii isaaniitiif ulee tokko tokko isatti kennan; uleen Aroonis uleewwan sana keessa ture.
english: Moses spoke to the children of Israel; and all their princes gave him rods, for each prince one, according to their fathers’ houses, a total of twelve rods. Aaron’s rod was among their rods.

kikuyu: Museenis uleewwan sana dunkaana dhuga baʼumsaa keessa fuula Waaqayyoo dura kaaʼe.
english: Moses laid up the rods before the LORD in the Tent of the Testimony.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti Museen dunkaana dhuga baʼumsaa seenee uleen Aroon kan gosa Lewwii iddoo buʼu sun isaa latu qofa utuu hin taʼin hudhee daraaree lawuzii naqate arge.
english: On the next day, Moses went into the Tent of the Testimony; and behold, Aaron’s rod for the house of Levi had sprouted, budded, produced blossoms, and bore ripe almonds.

kikuyu: Museen ulee sana hunda fuula Waaqayyoo duraa alatti gad baasee Israaʼeloota hundatti fide. Isaanis ilaalanii tokkoon tokkoon namaa ulee ofii isaa fudhate.
english: Moses brought out all the rods from before the LORD to all the children of Israel. They looked, and each man took his rod.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Ulee Aroon fuudhiitii akka inni finciltootaaf mallattoo taʼuuf fuula taabota kakuu seeraa dura deebisii kaaʼi. Kun akka isaan hin dhumneef natti guungumuu isaanii sana dhaabachiisa.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Put back the rod of Aaron before the covenant, to be kept for a token against the children of rebellion; that you may make an end of their complaining against me, that they not die.”

kikuyu: Museenis akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajaje sana godhe.
english: Moses did so. As the LORD commanded him, so he did.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni Museedhaan akkana jedhan; “Nu ni duuna! Nu badneerra; nu hundinuu badneerra!
english: The children of Israel spoke to Moses, saying, “Behold, we perish! We are undone! We are all undone!

kikuyu: Namni dunkaana qulqulluu Waaqayyootti dhiʼaatu kam iyyuu ni duʼa. Nu amma duʼuuf jirraa?”
english: Everyone who keeps approaching the LORD’s tabernacle, dies! Will we all perish?”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Arooniin akkana jedhe; “Ati, ilmaan keetii fi maatiin abbaa keetii si wajjin yakka iddoo qulqulluutti hojjetametti ni gaafatamtu. Yakka lubummaatti hojjetame siʼii fi ilmaan kee qofatu itti gaafatama.
english: The LORD said to Aaron, “You and your sons and your fathers’ house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary; and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.

kikuyu: Akka isaan yeroo atii fi ilmaan kee fuula dunkaana dhuga baʼumsaa duratti tajaajiltanitti sitti dabalamanii si gargaaraniif obboloota kee warra gosa Lewwii, warra gosa abbaa keetii sana fidi.
english: Bring your brothers also, the tribe of Levi, the tribe of your father, near with you, that they may be joined to you, and minister to you; but you and your sons with you shall be before the Tent of the Testimony.

kikuyu: Isaanis ajaja kee dhagaʼuudhaan hojiiwwan dunkaana keessaa hunda haa hojjetan; garuu miʼa iddoo qulqulluutti yookaan iddoo aarsaatti dhiʼaachuu hin qaban. Yoo akkas taʼe isaanis, atis ni duutu.
english: They shall keep your commands and the duty of the whole Tent; only they shall not come near to the vessels of the sanctuary and to the altar, that they not die, neither they nor you.

kikuyu: Isaanis dunkaana wal gaʼii eeguudhaaf isinitti dabalamuu qabu; hojii dunkaana sanaa hundas haa hojjetan. Namni biraa iddoo isin jirtanitti dhiʼaachuu hin qabu.
english: They shall be joined to you and keep the responsibility of the Tent of Meeting, for all the service of the Tent. A stranger shall not come near to you.

kikuyu: “Isin akka dheekkamsi ammas Israaʼeloota irra hin buuneef eegumsa iddoo qulqulluutii fi eegumsa iddoo aarsaatti ni gaafatamtu.
english: “You shall perform the duty of the sanctuary and the duty of the altar, that there be no more wrath on the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ani mataan koo obboloota keessan Lewwota kennaawwan isinii kennaman godhee saba Israaʼel keessaa filadheera; isaanis akka hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii keessaa hojjetaniif Waaqayyoof kennamanii jiru.
english: Behold, I myself have taken your brothers the Levites from among the children of Israel. They are a gift to you, dedicated to the LORD, to do the service of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Garuu hojii iddoo aarsaatii fi hojii golgaa keessaa hunda siʼii fi ilmaan kee qofatu hojjeta. Ani hojii lubummaa kennaa godhee isiniif nan kenna. Namni biraa kan iddoo qulqulluutti dhiʼaatu haa ajjeefamu.”
english: You and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for everything of the altar, and for that within the veil. You shall serve. I give you the service of the priesthood as a gift. The stranger who comes near shall be put to death.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Arooniin akkana jedhe; “Ani mataan koo itti gaafatamaa aarsaawwan naa dhiʼeeffamanii si godheera; ani aarsaawwan qulqulluu Israaʼeloonni naaf dhiʼeessan hunda akka isaan bara baraan qoodaa fi gaʼee keessan taʼaniif siʼii fi ilmaan keetiif kenneera.
english: The LORD spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of the children of Israel. I have given them to you by reason of the anointing, and to your sons, as a portion forever.

kikuyu: Kunis aarsaawwan waan hunda caalaa qulqulluu taʼan kanneen ibiddi hin tuqin keessaa qooda kee taʼa. Kennaawwan isaan aarsaawwan waan hunda caalaa qulqulluu taʼan godhanii naaf fidan jechuunis aarsaawwan midhaanii yookaan aarsaawwan cubbuu yookaan aarsaawwan yakkaa hunda keessaa qoodni sun kan keetii fi kan ilmaan keetii ti.
english: This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of theirs, and every sin offering of theirs, and every trespass offering of theirs, which they shall give to me, shall be most holy for you and for your sons.

kikuyu: Isas iddoo iddoo hunda caalaa qulqulluu taʼetti nyaadhu; dhiirri hundi haa nyaatu; innis qulqulluu siif haa taʼu.
english: You shall eat of it like the most holy things. Every male shall eat of it. It shall be holy to you.

kikuyu: “Wanni kunis kanuma kee ti; aarsaan sochoofamu kan kennaa saba Israaʼel hunda irraa addaan baafame kanuma kee ti. Anis waan kana siʼii fi ilmaan keetii fi intallan kee kanneen si wajjin jiraataniif qooda bara baraa godhee kenneera. Mana kee keessaa namni akka seeraatti qulqulluu taʼe kam iyyuu waan kana nyaachuu ni dandaʼa.
english: “This is yours, too: the wave offering of their gift, even all the wave offerings of the children of Israel. I have given them to you, and to your sons and to your daughters with you, as a portion forever. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

kikuyu: “Zayitii ejersaa filatamaa hunda, daadhii wayinii filatamaa hundaa fi waan galfatan keessaa mataa midhaanii kan isaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessan siif nan kenna.
english: “I have given to you all the best of the oil, all the best of the vintage, and of the grain, the first fruits of them which they give to the LORD.

kikuyu: Mataan midhaanii kan isaan waan biyyattii irraa argatan hunda keessaa Waaqayyoof fidan kan kee haa taʼu; mana kee keessaa namni akka seeraatti qulqulluu taʼe kam iyyuu waan kana nyaachuu ni dandaʼa.
english: The first-ripe fruits of all that is in their land, which they bring to the LORD, shall be yours. Everyone who is clean in your house shall eat of it.

kikuyu: “Israaʼel keessatti wanni qulqulleeffamee Waaqayyoof kenname hundinuu kee ti.
english: “Everything devoted in Israel shall be yours.

kikuyu: Wanni gadameessa saaqu kam iyyuu namas taʼu horiin Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu hundi kan kee ti. Ati garuu ilma hangafa, horii qulqulluu hin taʼin keessaa immoo korma hangafa furuu qabda.
english: Everything that opens the womb, of all flesh which they offer to the LORD, both of man and animal, shall be yours. Nevertheless, you shall surely redeem the firstborn of man, and you shall redeem the firstborn of unclean animals.

kikuyu: Yeroo umuriin isaanii jiʼa tokko taʼutti akka saqilii iddoo qulqulluu kan geeraa digdama ulfaatu sanaatti gatii furii murtaaʼe meetii saqilii shaniin isaan furi.
english: You shall redeem those who are to be redeemed of them from a month old, according to your estimation, for five shekels of money, according to the shekel of the sanctuary, which weighs twenty gerahs.

kikuyu: “Garuu sangaa hangafa, hoolaa hangafaa fi reʼee hangafa hin furin; isaan qulqulluu dha. Dhiiga isaanii iddoo aarsaa irratti facaasi; cooma isaanii immoo aarsaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamu kan urgaan isaa Waaqayyotti tolu godhiitii gubi.
english: “But you shall not redeem the firstborn of a cow, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat. They are holy. You shall sprinkle their blood on the altar, and shall burn their fat for an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: Akkuma handaraafni aarsaa sochoofamuutii fi tafni mirgaa kan kee taʼe sana foon isaaniis kan kee taʼa.
english: Their meat shall be yours, as the wave offering breast and as the right thigh, it shall be yours.

kikuyu: Ani waan aarsaa qulqulluu Israaʼeloonni Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessan irraa addaan baafame hunda siif, ilmaan keetii fi intallan keetiif qooda bara baraa godhee nan kenna. Innis fuula Waaqayyoo duratti siʼii fi sanyii keetiif kakuu soogiddaa kan bara baraa ti.”
english: All the wave offerings of the holy things which the children of Israel offer to the LORD, I have given you and your sons and your daughters with you, as a portion forever. It is a covenant of salt forever before the LORD to you and to your offspring with you.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Arooniin akkana jedhe; “Ati biyya isaanii keessatti dhaala tokko illee yookaan qooda tokko illee isaan gidduudhaa hin qabaattu; ani saba Israaʼel keessatti qooda keetii fi dhaala kee ti.
english: The LORD said to Aaron, “You shall have no inheritance in their land, neither shall you have any portion among them. I am your portion and your inheritance among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: “Kunoo ani kennaa Israaʼel keessa jiru kudhan keessaa tokko hunda waan isaan tajaajila dunkaana wal gaʼii tajaajilaniif dhaala godhee Lewwotaaf kenneera.
english: “To the children of Levi, behold, I have given all the tithe in Israel for an inheritance, in return for their service which they serve, even the service of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Siʼachi Israaʼeloonni akka cubbuu hin baannee fi akka hin duuneef dunkaana wal gaʼiitti hin dhiʼaatin.
english: Henceforth the children of Israel shall not come near the Tent of Meeting, lest they bear sin, and die.

kikuyu: Kan hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii hojjetuu fi kan itti gaafatama yakka achitti hojjetamuu fudhatu Lewwotuma. Kunis dhaloota dhufuuf seera bara baraa ti. Isaan saba Israaʼel keessatti dhaala tokko illee hin argatan.
english: But the Levites shall do the service of the Tent of Meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity. It shall be a statute forever throughout your generations. Among the children of Israel, they shall have no inheritance.

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa ani waan Israaʼeloonni kudhan keessaa tokko aarsaa godhanii Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessan sana dhaala isaanii godhee Lewwotaaf kenneera. Sababiin ani, ‘Isaan saba Israaʼel keessatti dhaala tokko illee hin qabaatan’ jedhee waaʼee isaanii dubbadheefis kanuma.”
english: For the tithe of the children of Israel, which they offer as a wave offering to the LORD, I have given to the Levites for an inheritance. Therefore I have said to them, ‘Among the children of Israel they shall have no inheritance.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akkana jedhii Lewwotatti dubbadhu: ‘Yommuu kennaa harka kudhan keessaa harka tokko kan ani dhaala keessan godhee isiniif kenne sana Israaʼeloota irraa fudhatanitti isin kennaa sana harka kudhan keessaa harka tokko aarsaa Waaqayyoo godhaa dhiʼeessaa.
english: “Moreover you shall speak to the Levites, and tell them, ‘When you take of the children of Israel the tithe which I have given you from them for your inheritance, then you shall offer up a wave offering of it for the LORD, a tithe of the tithe.

kikuyu: Aarsaan keessanis akkuma midhaan oobdii irraa yookaan akkuma cuunfaa iddoo ija wayinii itti cuunfanii keessaa baʼeetti isiniif herregama.
english: Your wave offering shall be credited to you, as though it were the grain of the threshing floor, and as the fullness of the wine press.

kikuyu: Isinis haaluma kanaan kennaa harka kudhan keessaa harka tokko kan Israaʼeloota irraa argatan hunda keessaa Waaqayyoof aarsaa ni dhiʼeessitu; kennaawwan kanneen keessaas waan qooda Waaqayyoo taʼe Aroon lubichaaf kennaa.
english: Thus you also shall offer a wave offering to the LORD of all your tithes, which you receive of the children of Israel; and of it you shall give the LORD’s wave offering to Aaron the priest.

kikuyu: Waan isinii kenname hunda keessaa kutaa waan hunda caalaa gaarii fi qulqulluu taʼe qooda Waaqayyoo godhaatii dhiʼeessaa.’
english: Out of all your gifts, you shall offer every wave offering to the LORD, of all its best parts, even the holy part of it.’

kikuyu: “Lewwotaan akkana jedhi: ‘Yommuu isin kutaa waan hunda caalaa gaarii taʼe dhiʼeessitanitti kutaan sun akka midhaan oobdii irraa yookaan akka cuunfaa iddoo ija wayinii itti cuunfan keessaa baʼeetti isinii herregama.
english: “Therefore you shall tell them, ‘When you heave its best from it, then it shall be credited to the Levites as the increase of the threshing floor, and as the increase of the wine press.

kikuyu: Sababii wanni kun mindaa hojii dunkaana wal gaʼii kan isin hojjettanii taʼeef isinii fi namoonni mana keessan jiraatan waan hafe sana iddoo barbaadan kamitti iyyuu nyaachuu dandeessu.
english: You may eat it anywhere, you and your households, for it is your reward in return for your service in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Qooda isaa kan waan hunda caalu sana dhiʼeessuudhaan isin waan kana keessatti yakka hin qabaattan; yoos isin aarsaa Israaʼelootaa qulqulluu sana hin xureessitan; hin duutanis.’ ”
english: You shall bear no sin by reason of it, when you have heaved from it its best. You shall not profane the holy things of the children of Israel, that you not die.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Musee fi Arooniin akkana jedhe:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,

kikuyu: “Seerri Waaqayyo ajaje kana: Akka Israaʼeloonni goromsa diimtuu hirʼina yookaan hanqina hin qabne kan takkumaa waanjoon morma ishee hin tuqin tokko siif fidan itti himi.
english: “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer without spot, in which is no defect, and which was never yoked.

kikuyu: Goromsa sanas Eleʼaazaar lubichatti kennaa; raaddi sunis qubata keessaa gad baafamtee fuula isaa duratti haa qalamtu.
english: You shall give her to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring her outside of the camp, and one shall kill her before his face.

kikuyu: Eleʼaazaar lubichi quba isaatiin dhiiga goromsa sanaa irraa xinnoo fuudhee dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti yeroo torba haa facaasu.
english: Eleazar the priest shall take some of her blood with his finger, and sprinkle her blood toward the front of the Tent of Meeting seven times.

kikuyu: Utuma inni ilaaluu gogaan, foon, dhiignii fi cumaan goromsa sanaa haa gubamu.
english: One shall burn the heifer in his sight; her skin, and her meat, and her blood, with her dung, shall he burn.

kikuyu: Lubni sun qoraan birbirsaa, hiisophii fi kirrii bildiimaa goromsa gubamtu sanatti haa darbatu.
english: The priest shall take cedar wood, hyssop, and scarlet, and cast it into the middle of the burning of the heifer.

kikuyu: Lubni sun ergasii wayyaa ofii isaa miiccatee dhagna ofii isaa illee bishaaniin dhiqachuu qaba. Innis qubatatti galuu dandaʼa; garuu hamma galgalaatti akka seeraatti xuraaʼaa taʼee tura.
english: Then the priest shall wash his clothes, and he shall bathe his flesh in water, and afterward he shall come into the camp, and the priest shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: Namichi goromsa sana gubus wayyaa isaa miiccatee dhagna isaa bishaaniin haa dhiqatu; innis hamma galgalaatti xuraaʼee tura.
english: He who burns her shall wash his clothes in water, and bathe his flesh in water, and shall be unclean until the evening.

kikuyu: “Namni qulqulluun tokko daaraa goromsa sanaa walitti haree qubata keessaa baasee iddoo seeraan qulqulluu taʼe tokko haa kaaʼu. Daaraa kanas waldaan Israaʼel bishaan ittiin qulqulleessan wajjin itti fayyadamuudhaaf ol kaaʼata; innis cubbuu irraa qulqulleeffamuuf fayyada.
english: “A man who is clean shall gather up the ashes of the heifer, and lay them up outside of the camp in a clean place; and it shall be kept for the congregation of the children of Israel for use in water for cleansing impurity. It is a sin offering.

kikuyu: Namni daaraa goromsa sanaa walitti haru sunis wayyaa ofii isaa miiccachuu qaba; innis akkasuma hamma galgalaatti xuraaʼaa taʼa. Kunis Israaʼelootaa fi alagoota gidduu isaanii jiraataniif seera bara baraa taʼa.
english: He who gathers the ashes of the heifer shall wash his clothes, and be unclean until the evening. It shall be to the children of Israel, and to the stranger who lives as a foreigner among them, for a statute forever.

kikuyu: “Namni reeffa nama kamii iyyuu tuqu bultii torba xuraaʼaa taʼa.
english: “He who touches the dead body of any man shall be unclean seven days.

kikuyu: Inni guyyaa sadaffaa fi guyyaa torbaffaatti bishaaniin of qulqulleessuu qaba; ergasii qulqulluu taʼa. Garuu yoo guyyaa sadaffaa fi torbaffaatti of qulqulleessuu baate inni hin qulqullaaʼu.
english: He shall purify himself with water on the third day, and on the seventh day he shall be clean; but if he doesn’t purify himself the third day, then the seventh day he shall not be clean.

kikuyu: Namni reeffa nama kamii iyyuu tuqee of hin qulqulleessin hundi dunkaana Waaqayyoo qulqullicha sana xureessa. Namni sun saba Israaʼel keessaa ni balleeffama. Sababii bishaan ittiin qulqulleessan isatti hin facaafaminiif inni xuraaʼaa dha; xuraaʼummaan isaas isuma irratti hafa.
english: Whoever touches a dead person, the body of a man who has died, and doesn’t purify himself, defiles the LORD’s tabernacle; and that soul shall be cut off from Israel; because the water for impurity was not sprinkled on him, he shall be unclean. His uncleanness is yet on him.

kikuyu: “Yeroo namni tokko dunkaana keessatti duʼutti seerri kana: Namni dunkaana sana seenu hundii fi namni dunkaana keessa jiru hundi bultii torbaaf xuraaʼaa taʼa;
english: “This is the law when a man dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent, and everyone who is in the tent, shall be unclean seven days.

kikuyu: qodaan afaan banaa kan qadaadni jabeeffamee itti hin qadaadamin hundi xuraaʼaa taʼa.
english: Every open vessel, which has no covering bound on it, is unclean.

kikuyu: “Namni alatti nama goraadeedhaan ajjeefame yookaan nama ofumaan duʼe tuqu kam iyyuu yookaan namni lafee namaa yookaan awwaala tuqu kam iyyuu bultii torbaaf xuraaʼaa taʼa.
english: “Whoever in the open field touches one who is slain with a sword, or a dead body, or a bone of a man, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.

kikuyu: “Nama xuraaʼaaf aarsaa ittiin qulqulleessuuf gubame sana irraa daaraa xinnaa isaa fuudhii okkotee tokkotti naqiitii bishaan yaaʼu itti dhangalaasi.
english: “For the unclean, they shall take of the ashes of the burning of the sin offering; and running water shall be poured on them in a vessel.

kikuyu: Ergasiis namni akka seeraatti qulqulluu taʼe hiisophii xinnaa isaa fuudhee bishaan sana keessa cuuphee dunkaanaa fi miʼa isaa hundatti, namoota achi turanittis haa faffacaasu. Akkasumas nama lafee namaa yookaan awwaala yookaan nama ajjeefame yookaan nama ofumaan duʼe tuqetti haa faffacaasu.
english: A clean person shall take hyssop, dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent, on all the vessels, on the persons who were there, and on him who touched the bone, or the slain, or the dead, or the grave.

kikuyu: Namichi qulqulluun sun guyyaa sadaffaa fi torbaffaatti namicha xuraaʼaa sanatti haa faffacaasu; guyyaa torbaffaatti immoo isa qulqulleessuu qaba. Namichi qulqulleefamu sun wayyaa ofii isaa miiccachuu, dhagna ofii isaas bishaaniin dhiqachuu qaba; innis galgala sana qulqulluu taʼa.
english: The clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean on the third day, and on the seventh day. On the seventh day, he shall purify him. He shall wash his clothes and bathe himself in water, and shall be clean at evening.

kikuyu: Garuu namni xuraaʼaan yoo of qulqulleessuu baate, inni sababii iddoo qulqulluu Waaqayyo xureesseef waldaa keessaa ni balleeffama. Bishaan ittiin qulqulleessan sun isatti hin facaafamneetii inni xuraaʼaa dha.
english: But the man who shall be unclean, and shall not purify himself, that soul shall be cut off from among the assembly, because he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD. The water for impurity has not been sprinkled on him. He is unclean.

kikuyu: Kun isaaniif seera bara baraa ti. “Namichi bishaan ittiin qulqulleessan faffacaasu sun wayyaa ofii isaa haa miiccatu; namni bishaan ittiin qulqulleessan tuqu hamma galgalaatti xuraaʼaa taʼa.
english: It shall be a perpetual statute to them. He who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his clothes, and he who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.

kikuyu: Wanni namni xuraaʼaan tokko tuqu kam iyyuu xuraaʼaa taʼa; namni waan sana tuqu hamma galgalaatti xuraaʼaa taʼa.”
english: “Whatever the unclean person touches shall be unclean; and the soul that touches it shall be unclean until evening.”

kikuyu: Jiʼa jalqabaatti waldaan Israaʼelootaa guutuun Gammoojjii Siin gaʼe; isaanis Qaadesh keessa turan. Miiriyaamis achitti duutee awwaalamte.
english: The children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came into the wilderness of Zin in the first month. The people stayed in Kadesh. Miriam died there, and was buried there.

kikuyu: Waldaan sun bishaan hin qabu ture; kanaafuu waldaan sun Musee fi Arooniin mormuuf walitti qabame.
english: There was no water for the congregation; and they assembled themselves together against Moses and against Aaron.

kikuyu: Isaanis akkana jedhanii Musee fi Arooniin lolan; “Maaloo utuu nus gaafuma obboloonni keenya fuula Waaqayyoo duratti duʼan sana duunee jiraannee!
english: The people quarreled with Moses, and spoke, saying, “We wish that we had died when our brothers died before the LORD!

kikuyu: Isin maaliif waldaa Waaqayyoo gammoojjii kanatti fiddan? Akka nuu fi horiin keenya asitti dhumnuufii?
english: Why have you brought the LORD’s assembly into this wilderness, that we should die there, we and our animals?

kikuyu: Maaliif biyya Gibxiitii iddoo hamaa kanatti gad nu baaftan? Iddoon kun midhaan yookaan harbuu yookaan ija wayinii yookaan roomaanii hin qabu. Bishaan dhugaatiis hin jiru!”
english: Why have you made us to come up out of Egypt, to bring us in to this evil place? It is no place of seed, or of figs, or of vines, or of pomegranates; neither is there any water to drink.”

kikuyu: Musee fi Aroon waldaa biraa gara balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii deemanii addaan lafatti gombifaman; ulfinni Waaqayyoos isaanitti mulʼate.
english: Moses and Aaron went from the presence of the assembly to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and fell on their faces. The LORD’s glory appeared to them.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Ulee sana fuudhiitii, atii fi obboleessi kee Aroonis waldaa walitti qabaa. Fuuluma isaanii durattis kattaa sanatti dubbadhaa; kattaan sunis bishaan baasa. Atis kattaa sana keessaa waldaadhaaf bishaan baafta; akkasiin isaanii fi horiin isaanii bishaan dhuguu dandaʼu.”
english: “Take the rod, and assemble the congregation, you, and Aaron your brother, and speak to the rock before their eyes, that it pour out its water. You shall bring water to them out of the rock; so you shall give the congregation and their livestock drink.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Museen akkuma inni isa ajaje sanatti ulee fuula Waaqayyoo dura jiru sana fuudhe.
english: Moses took the rod from before the LORD, as he commanded him.

kikuyu: Musee fi Aroon kattaa sana duratti waldaa walitti qaban; Museenis waldaa sanaan, “Finciltoota nana, mee dhagaʼaa; nu kattaa kana keessaa bishaan isinii baasuu qabnaa?” jedhe.
english: Moses and Aaron gathered the assembly together before the rock, and he said to them, “Hear now, you rebels! Shall we bring water out of this rock for you?”

kikuyu: Museen harka ol fudhatee ulee isaa sanaan yeroo lama kattaa sana dhaʼe. Bishaan achi keessaa lolaanaan waldaa fi horiin isaanii dhugan.
english: Moses lifted up his hand, and struck the rock with his rod twice, and water came out abundantly. The congregation and their livestock drank.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu Musee fi Arooniin akkana jedhe; “Sababii isin fuula Israaʼelootaa duratti akka qulqullummaa kootiitti na kabajjanii natti amanuu diddaniif, isin biyya ani isaanii kenne sanatti waldaa kana hin galchitan.”
english: The LORD said to Moses and Aaron, “Because you didn’t believe in me, to sanctify me in the eyes of the children of Israel, therefore you shall not bring this assembly into the land which I have given them.”

kikuyu: Kun bishaan Mariibaa, lafa Israaʼeloonni itti Waaqayyoon wal dhabanii fi lafa inni itti akka qulqulluu taʼe gidduu isaaniitti of argisiisee ti.
english: These are the waters of Meribah; because the children of Israel strove with the LORD, and he was sanctified in them.

kikuyu: Museen akkana jedhee Qaadesh irraa mootii Edoomiitti ergamoota erge: “Obboleessi kee Israaʼel akkana jedha: Ati waaʼee rakkina nutti dhufe hundaa ni beekta.
english: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom, saying: “Your brother Israel says: You know all the travail that has happened to us;

kikuyu: Abbootiin keenya Gibxitti gad buʼan; nus waggaa hedduu achi jiraanne. Warri Gibxis nuu fi abbootii keenya cunqursan;
english: how our fathers went down into Egypt, and we lived in Egypt a long time. The Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.

kikuyu: garuu nu Waaqayyotti iyyaannaan, inni nu dhagaʼee ergamaa isaa ergee biyya Gibxii nu baase. “Nu amma as Qaadeshitti jechuunis magaalaa daarii biyya keetii irra jiru tokko keessa jirra.
english: When we cried to the LORD, he heard our voice, sent an angel, and brought us out of Egypt. Behold, we are in Kadesh, a city in the edge of your border.

kikuyu: Maaloo mee akka biyya kee keessa baanee dabarru nuu eeyyami. Nu lafa qotiisaa yookaan iddoo dhaabaa wayinii tokko keessa iyyuu hin yaanu yookaan bishaan boolla bishaanii tokkoo iyyuu si duraa hin dhugnu. Nu karaa mootichaa irra godaanna malee hamma daarii kee keessaa baanutti bitaa mirgatti hin gorru.”
english: “Please let us pass through your land. We will not pass through field or through vineyard, neither will we drink from the water of the wells. We will go along the king’s highway. We will not turn away to the right hand nor to the left, until we have passed your border.”

kikuyu: Edoom immoo akkana jedhee deebii kenne: “Isin asiin darbuu hin dandeessan; yoo darbuu yaaltan immoo nu isinitti kaanee goraadeedhaan isin dhoofna.”
english: Edom said to him, “You shall not pass through me, lest I come out with the sword against you.”

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonnis akkana jedhanii deebii kennan: “Nu karuma guddicha irra yaana; yoo nu yookaan horiin keenya bishaan keessan kam iyyuu dhuge, nu gatii isiniif kaffalla. Nu miilla qofaan yaanee darbuu feena; kana malee waan biraa hin feenu.”
english: The children of Israel said to him, “We will go up by the highway; and if we drink your water, I and my livestock, then I will give its price. Only let me, without doing anything else, pass through on my feet.”

kikuyu: Isaan amma illee akkana jedhanii deebisan: “Isin asiin hin dabartan.” Edoomis loltoota baayʼee fi jajjaboo fudhatee isaanitti gad baʼe.
english: He said, “You shall not pass through.” Edom came out against him with many people, and with a strong hand.

kikuyu: Sababii Edoom biyya ofii isaa keessaan darbuu isaan dhowweef Israaʼeloonni isaan irraa deebiʼan.
english: Thus Edom refused to give Israel passage through his border, so Israel turned away from him.

kikuyu: Sabni Israaʼel hundinuu Qaadeshii kaʼee Tulluu Hoori gaʼe.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and the children of Israel, even the whole congregation, came to Mount Hor.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Tulluu Hoori cinatti daangaa Edoom biratti Musee fi Arooniin akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron in Mount Hor, by the border of the land of Edom, saying,

kikuyu: “Aroon gara abbootii isaatti walitti qabama. Sababii isin lachuu bishaan Mariibaa biratti ajaja kootti finciltaniif, inni biyya ani Israaʼelootaaf kennutti hin galu.
english: “Aaron shall be gathered to his people; for he shall not enter into the land which I have given to the children of Israel, because you rebelled against my word at the waters of Meribah.

kikuyu: Aroonii fi ilma isaa Eleʼaazaar fuudhiitii Tulluu Hooritti ol baasi.
english: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up to Mount Hor;

kikuyu: Aroon irraa uffata isaa baasiitii ilma isaa Eleʼaazaaritti uffisi; Aroon gara abbootii isaatti walitti qabamaatii. Inni achitti duʼa.”
english: and strip Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron shall be gathered, and shall die there.”

kikuyu: Museen akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajaje sana godhe: Isaanis utuma waldaan Israaʼel guutuun ilaaluu Tulluu Hooritti ol baʼan.
english: Moses did as the LORD commanded. They went up onto Mount Hor in the sight of all the congregation.

kikuyu: Museenis uffata Aroon irraa baasee ilma isaa Eleʼaazaaritti uffise. Aroonis achuma tulluu sana gubbaatti duʼe. Musee fi Eleʼaazaaris tulluu sana irraa gad buʼan;
english: Moses stripped Aaron of his garments, and put them on Eleazar his son. Aaron died there on the top of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar came down from the mountain.

kikuyu: yommuu waldaan Israaʼel hundi akka Aroon duʼe dhagaʼetti manni Israaʼel guutuun bultii soddoma booʼeef.
english: When all the congregation saw that Aaron was dead, they wept for Aaron thirty days, even all the house of Israel.

kikuyu: Mootiin Aaraad namichi Kanaʼaan kan Negeeb keessa jiraatu sun akka Israaʼel karaa Ataariim irra dhufaa jiru dhageenyaan Israaʼeloota lolee isaan keessaa nama tokko tokko boojiʼe.
english: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South, heard that Israel came by the way of Atharim. He fought against Israel, and took some of them captive.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonnis, “Yoo ati saba kana dabarsitee harka keenyatti kennite, nu guutumaan guutuutti magaalaa isaanii barbadeessina” jedhanii Waaqayyoof wareegan.
english: Israel vowed a vow to the LORD, and said, “If you will indeed deliver this people into my hand, then I will utterly destroy their cities.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos iyya Israaʼel dhagaʼee warra Kanaʼaan dabarsee harka isaaniitti kenne. Israaʼeloonnis isaanii fi magaalaawwan isaanii illee guutumaan guutuutti barbadeessan; kanaafuu iddoon sun Hormaa jedhamee waamame.
english: The LORD listened to the voice of Israel, and delivered up the Canaanites; and they utterly destroyed them and their cities. The name of the place was called Hormah.

kikuyu: Isaanis Edoom duubaan darbanii deemuuf jedhanii Gaara Hoorii kaʼanii karaa Galaana Diimaatti geessu irra qajeelan. Sabni sun garuu karumatti obsa fixate;
english: They traveled from Mount Hor by the way to the Red Sea, to go around the land of Edom. The soul of the people was very discouraged because of the journey.

kikuyu: isaanis Waaqaa fi Museedhaan mormanii akkana jechuudhaan dubbatan; “Isin maaliif akka gammoojjii keessatti dhumnuuf biyya Gibxii nu baaftan? Buddeenni hin jiru! Bishaan hin jiru! Nus nyaata balfamaa kana jibbineerra!”
english: The people spoke against God and against Moses: “Why have you brought us up out of Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread, there is no water, and our soul loathes this disgusting food!”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos bofawwan hadhaa qaban gidduu isaaniitti erge; bofawwan sunis isaan iddanii Israaʼeloonni baayʼeen dhuman.
english: The LORD sent venomous snakes among the people, and they bit the people. Many people of Israel died.

kikuyu: Sabni sunis gara Musee dhufee akkana jedhe; “Nu yeroo Waaqayyoo fi sitti afaan dabarre sana cubbuu hojjenne. Akka Waaqayyo bofawwan kanneen nurraa fageessuuf nuuf kadhadhu.” Museen saba sanaaf kadhate.
english: The people came to Moses, and said, “We have sinned, because we have spoken against the LORD and against you. Pray to the LORD, that he take away the serpents from us.” Moses prayed for the people.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Bofa tokko tolchiitii utubaatti fannisi; namni bofni idde kam iyyuu bofa ati tolchite sana ilaalee jiraachuu dandaʼa.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Make a venomous snake, and set it on a pole. It shall happen that everyone who is bitten, when he sees it, shall live.”

kikuyu: Museen bofa naasii tokko tolchee utubaatti fannise. Ergasiis namni bofti idde kam iyyuu yeroo bofa naasii sana ilaalu ni jiraata ture.
english: Moses made a serpent of bronze, and set it on the pole. If a serpent had bitten any man, when he looked at the serpent of bronze, he lived.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni fuula duratti qajeelanii Oobooti keessa qubatan.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in Oboth.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Oobootii kaʼanii Iyyee Abaariim lafa karaa baʼa biiftuutiin fuullee Moʼaabitti gammoojjii keessatti argamu qubatan.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped at Iyeabarim, in the wilderness which is before Moab, toward the sunrise.

kikuyu: Achiis kaʼanii Sulula Zered keessa qubatan.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped in the valley of Zered.

kikuyu: Achii kaʼaniis daarii Arnoon lafa gammoojjii keessaa kan bulchiinsa Amoorotaa keessa seentu sana irra qubatan. Arnoon lafa daarii Moʼaab irraa kan Moʼaabii fi Amoor gidduu jirtuu dha.
english: From there they traveled, and encamped on the other side of the Arnon, which is in the wilderness that comes out of the border of the Amorites; for the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.

kikuyu: Sababiin Kitaabni Waraana Waaqayyoo akkana jedhuuf kana: “Waaheb Suufaa keessaa fi lageen, Arnoonii fi
english: Therefore it is said in The Book of the Wars of the LORD, “Vaheb in Suphah, the valleys of the Arnon,

kikuyu: irraan-gadee sululaa kan gara Aaritti geessuu fi daarii Moʼaab irratti argamu.”
english: the slope of the valleys that incline toward the dwelling of Ar, leans on the border of Moab.”

kikuyu: Achii kaʼanii gara Biʼeer boolla bishaanii kan Waaqayyo Museedhaan, “Saba walitti qabi; ani bishaan kennaafii” jedhe sanaa karaa isaanii itti fufan.
english: From there they traveled to Beer; that is the well of which the LORD said to Moses, “Gather the people together, and I will give them water.”

kikuyu: Israaʼelis faarfannaa kana faarfate: “Yaa boolla bishaanii nana, burqi! Isinis waaʼee isaa faarfadhaa;
english: Then Israel sang this song: “Spring up, well! Sing to it,

kikuyu: Boolla bishaanii ilmaan mootii qotan, kan kabajamoonni sabaa, qajeelcha warra seera kennuutiin ulee isaaniitiin qotan faarfadhaa.” Isaan ergasii gammoojjii sana keessaa baʼanii Mataanaa dhaqan;
english: the well, which the princes dug, which the nobles of the people dug, with the scepter, and with their poles.” From the wilderness they traveled to Mattanah;

kikuyu: Mataanaadhaa kaʼanii Nahaaliʼeel dhaqan; Nahaaliʼeelii kaʼanii Baamooti dhaqan;
english: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel; and from Nahaliel to Bamoth;

kikuyu: Baamootii immoo kaʼanii sulula Moʼaab, iddoo itti fiixeen Phisgaa gammoojjiitti garagaltu qubatan.
english: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the field of Moab, to the top of Pisgah, which looks down on the desert.

kikuyu: Israaʼelis Sihoon mooticha Amoorotaatiin akkana jechuuf ergamoota ergate:
english: Israel sent messengers to Sihon king of the Amorites, saying,

kikuyu: “Akka nu biyya kee keessaan darbinu nuuf eeyyami. Nu lafa qotiisaa yookaan iddoo dhaabaa wayinii tokkotti iyyuu hin gorru yookaan bishaan boolla bishaanii tokkoo illee hin dhugnu. Nu hamma biyya kee keessaa baanutti karaa mootichaa irra yaana.”
english: “Let me pass through your land. We will not turn away into field or vineyard. We will not drink of the water of the wells. We will go by the king’s highway, until we have passed your border.”

kikuyu: Sihoon garuu akka Israaʼel biyya isaa keessa baʼee darbu hin eeyyamne. Innis loltoota ofii guutuu walitti qabatee Israaʼelin loluuf gammoojjiitti gad baʼe. Yommuu Yaahazi gaʼettis Israaʼeliin wal lole.
english: Sihon would not allow Israel to pass through his border, but Sihon gathered all his people together, and went out against Israel into the wilderness, and came to Jahaz. He fought against Israel.

kikuyu: Israaʼel garuu goraadeedhaan isa ajjeesee Arnoonii jalqabee hamma Yaaboq gaʼutti biyya isaa qabate; garuu sababii dallaan daangaa Amoorotaa jabaa tureef inni hamma daangaa Amoonotaa qofatti deemuu dandaʼe.
english: Israel struck him with the edge of the sword, and possessed his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, even to the children of Ammon; for the border of the children of Ammon was fortified.

kikuyu: Israaʼelis magaalaawwan Amoorotaa hunda, Heshboonii fi qubatawwan naannoo ishee jiran hunda qabatee keessa qubate.
english: Israel took all these cities. Israel lived in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon, and in all its villages.

kikuyu: Heshboon kun magaalaa Sihoon mootii Amoorotaa isa mooticha Moʼaab kan duraa lolee biyya isaa hunda hamma Arnoonitti irraa fudhate sanaa ture.
english: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon the king of the Amorites, who had fought against the former king of Moab, and taken all his land out of his hand, even to the Arnon.

kikuyu: Sababiin weellistoonni akkana jedhaniif kana: “Gara Heshboon kottaa; isheen deebitee haa ijaaramtu; Magaalaan Sihoonis haa haaromfamtu.
english: Therefore those who speak in proverbs say, “Come to Heshbon. Let the city of Sihon be built and established;

kikuyu: “Heshboon keessaa ibiddi, magaalaa Sihoon keessaa arrabni ibiddaa baʼe. Ibiddi sun Aari magaalaa Moʼaab, jiraattota gaara Arnooniis gubee barbadeesse.
english: for a fire has gone out of Heshbon, a flame from the city of Sihon. It has devoured Ar of Moab, The lords of the high places of the Arnon.

kikuyu: Yaa Moʼaab, siif wayyoo! Yaa warra Kemoosh, isin barbadooftaniirtu! Inni ilmaan isaa akka baqattootaatti, intallan isaa immoo akka boojiʼamtootaatti, Sihoon mootii Amoorotaatti dabarsee kenneera.
english: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.

kikuyu: “Nu garuu isaan garagalchineerra; Heshboon hamma Diiboonitti barbadoofteerti. Nus hamma Noofaa ishee gara Meedebaatti diriirtu sanaatti isaan barbadeessineerra.”
english: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”

kikuyu: Akkasiin Israaʼel biyya Amoor keessa qubate.
english: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.

kikuyu: Museen Yaʼizeeritti basaastota erge; isaanis qubatawwan naannoo ishee qabatanii Amoorota achi keessa jiraachaa turan ariʼanii baasan.
english: Moses sent to spy out Jazer. They took its villages, and drove out the Amorites who were there.

kikuyu: Isaanis ergasii deebiʼanii karaa Baashaan qabatanii ol baʼan; Oogi mootichi Baashaaniitii fi loltoonni isaa guutuun Edreyiitti isaaniin wal loluuf itti gad baʼan.
english: They turned and went up by the way of Bashan. Og the king of Bashan went out against them, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Sababii ani guutuu loltoota isaatii fi biyya isaa illee dabarsee harka keetti kenneef isa hin sodaatin. Waanuma Sihoon mootiin Amoorotaa kan Heshboon bulchaa ture sana goote isa illee godhi.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Don’t fear him, for I have delivered him into your hand, with all his people, and his land. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

kikuyu: Isaan isa, ilmaan isaatii fi loltoota isaa hunda utuu nama tokko illee hin hambisiniif dhaʼanii biyya isaa illee irraa fudhatan.
english: So they struck him, with his sons and all his people, until there were no survivors; and they possessed his land.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni gara dirree Moʼaabitti qajeelanii Yerikoon gama qarqara Yordaanos qubatan.
english: The children of Israel traveled, and encamped in the plains of Moab beyond the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Baalaaq ilmi Ziphoori waan Israaʼel Amoorotatti hojjete hunda arge;
english: Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

kikuyu: Moʼaabis waan sabni sun akka malee baayʼee taʼeef ni sodaate. Moʼaabis sababii Israaʼelootaatiif raafame.
english: Moab was very afraid of the people, because they were many. Moab was distressed because of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Warri Moʼaabis maanguddoota Midiyaaniin, “Namoonni baayʼeen kunneen akkuma qotiyyoon marga bakkee dheedee fixu sana waan naannoo keenya jiru dheedee fixa” jedhan. Kana irratti Baalaaq ilmi Ziphoori kan yeroo sana mootii Moʼaab ture sun,
english: Moab said to the elders of Midian, “Now this multitude will lick up all that is around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field.” Balak the son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.

kikuyu: akka isaan Balaʼaam ilma Beʼoor kan biyyuma itti dhalate keessa laga Efraaxiis bira Phetoori keessa jiraachaa ture sana waamaniif ergamoota erge. Baalaaqis akkana jedhe: “Kunoo, sabni tokko biyya Gibxii baʼee dhufeera; kunoo isaan lafa guutanii natti aananii qubataniiru.
english: He sent messengers to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, which is by the River, to the land of the children of his people, to call him, saying, “Behold, there is a people who came out of Egypt. Behold, they cover the surface of the earth, and they are staying opposite me.

kikuyu: Sababii isaan na caalaa humna qabaniif amma kottuutii isaan abaari. Yoos ani isaan moʼadhee biyya keessaa ariʼee isaan baasuu nan dandaʼa taʼa. Ani akka warri ati eebbiftu eebbifaman, warri ati abaartus abaaraman nan beekaatii.”
english: Please come now therefore, and curse this people for me; for they are too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail, that we may strike them, and that I may drive them out of the land; for I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.”

kikuyu: Maanguddoonni Moʼaabii fi Midiyaan sun kaʼanii kaffaltii mortuu sanaa fudhatanii deeman. Isaanis yommuu Balaʼaam bira gaʼanitti waan Baalaaq jedheen sana itti himan.
english: The elders of Moab and the elders of Midian departed with the rewards of divination in their hand. They came to Balaam, and spoke to him the words of Balak.

kikuyu: Balaʼaamis, “Halkan kana asuma bulaa; anis deebii Waaqayyo naaf kennu isinitti nan hima” jedheen. Qondaaltonni Moʼaab sun isuma bira turan.
english: He said to them, “Lodge here this night, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak to me.” The princes of Moab stayed with Balaam.

kikuyu: Waaqni gara Balaʼaam dhufee, “Namoonni si wajjin jiran kunneen eenyu?” jedhee gaafate.
english: God came to Balaam, and said, “Who are these men with you?”

kikuyu: Balaʼaamis akkana jedhee Waaqaaf deebii kenne; “Baalaaq ilmi Ziphoori, mootichi Moʼaab akkana jedhee ergaa kana natti erge:
english: Balaam said to God, “Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has said to me,

kikuyu: ‘Kunoo, sabni biyya Gibxii baʼee dhufe tokko lafa guuteera; ati amma kottuutii isaan naaf abaari. Yoos ani isaan lolee ariʼee biyyaa baasuu nan dandaʼa taʼaatii.’ ”
english: ‘Behold, the people that has come out of Egypt covers the surface of the earth. Now, come curse them for me. Perhaps I shall be able to fight against them, and shall drive them out.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu Balaʼaamiin, “Isaan wajjin hin deemin. Sababii isaan eebbifamoo taʼaniif ati saba sana hin abaarin” jedhe.
english: God said to Balaam, “You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they are blessed.”

kikuyu: Balaʼaam ganama itti aanu kaʼee qondaaltota Baalaaqiin, “Sababii Waaqayyo isin wajjin deemuu na dhowweef, isin amma kaʼaa biyya keessanitti deebiʼaa” jedhe.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and said to the princes of Balak, “Go to your land; for the LORD refuses to permit me to go with you.”

kikuyu: Qondaaltonni Moʼaab gara Baalaaqitti deebiʼanii, “Balaʼaam nu wajjin dhufuu dide” jedhaniin.
english: The princes of Moab rose up, and they went to Balak, and said, “Balaam refuses to come with us.”

kikuyu: Baalaaqis qondaaltota warra duraa sana caalaa baayʼee fi caalaa bebeekamoo kan biraa erge.
english: Balak again sent princes, more, and more honorable than they.

kikuyu: Isaanis dhufanii Balaʼaamiin akkana jedhan: “Wanni Baalaaq ilmi Ziphoori jedhu kunoo kana: ‘Maaloo wanni tokko iyyuu gara koo dhufuu si hin dhowwin;
english: They came to Balaam, and said to him, “Balak the son of Zippor says, ‘Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me,

kikuyu: ani ulfina guddaa siif nan kennaatii; waan ati jettu hundas nan guuta. Kottuu saba kana naa abaari.’ ”
english: for I will promote you to very great honor, and whatever you say to me I will do. Please come therefore, and curse this people for me.’”

kikuyu: Balaʼaam garuu akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Utuu Baalaaq masaraa isaa kan meetii fi warqeen guutame sana naaf kenne illee, ani ajaja Waaqayyo Waaqa kootiin alatti waan xinnaa yookaan guddaa tokko illee hojjechuu hin dandaʼu.
english: Balaam answered the servants of Balak, “If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

kikuyu: Akka ani waan Waaqayyo natti himu kan biraa beekuu dandaʼuuf isinis akkuma warra kaanii as bulaa.”
english: Now therefore please stay here tonight as well, that I may know what else the LORD will speak to me.”

kikuyu: Halkan sana Waaqayyo gara Balaʼaam dhufee, “Sababii namoonni kunneen si waamuu dhufaniif, isaan wajjin deemi; garuu waanuma ani sitti himu qofa hojjedhu” jedheen.
english: God came to Balaam at night, and said to him, “If the men have come to call you, rise up, go with them; but only the word which I speak to you, that you shall do.”

kikuyu: Balaʼaam ganamaan kaʼee harree isaa irra kooraa kaaʼatee qondaaltota Moʼaab sana wajjin deeme.
english: Balaam rose up in the morning, and saddled his donkey, and went with the princes of Moab.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu inni deemnaan itti aare; ergamaan Waaqayyoo tokkos isaan mormuuf jedhee karaa irra dhaabate. Balaʼaamis harree isaa yaabbatee deemaa ture; tajaajiltoonni isaa lamaan isa wajjin turan.
english: God’s anger burned because he went; and the LORD’s angel placed himself in the way as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two servants were with him.

kikuyu: Harreen sun immoo ergamaa Waaqayyoo kan goraadee luqqifatee harkatti qabatee karaa irra dhaabatu arginaan of irra gara galtee karaa irraa gortee lafa qotiisaa seente. Balaʼaamis karaatti ishee deebisuudhaaf harree sana rukute.
english: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and the donkey turned out of the path, and went into the field. Balaam struck the donkey, to turn her into the path.

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqayyoo sun garuu daandii dhiphoo, iddoo dhaabaa wayinii lama kanneen gama lamaan dallaa qaban gidduu baatu irra dhaabate.
english: Then the LORD’s angel stood in a narrow path between the vineyards, a wall being on this side, and a wall on that side.

kikuyu: Harreen sun ergamaa Waaqayyoo arginaan, dallaatti maxxantee miilla Balaʼaam dallaatti buufte. Inni ammas harree sana rukute.
english: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she thrust herself to the wall, and crushed Balaam’s foot against the wall. He struck her again.

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqayyoos fuula duratti hiiqee daandii dhiphaa iddoo ittiin mirgatti yookaan bitaatti goran hin qabne tokko irra dhaabate.
english: The LORD’s angel went further, and stood in a narrow place, where there was no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

kikuyu: Harreen sun ergamaa Waaqayyoo arginaan Balaʼaam jalaa gad ciifte; innis aaree ulee ofiitiin harree sana rukute.
english: The donkey saw the LORD’s angel, and she lay down under Balaam. Balaam’s anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.

kikuyu: Kana irratti Waaqayyo afaan harree sanaa banee harreen sun Balaʼaamiin, “Ani maal si yakkinaan ati akkas yeroo sadii na rukutte?” jette.
english: The LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, “What have I done to you, that you have struck me these three times?”

kikuyu: Balaʼaamis harree sanaan, “Ati na gowwoomsite; ani utuu goraadee of harkaa qabaadhee silaa ammuman si ajjeesa” jedhe.
english: Balaam said to the donkey, “Because you have mocked me, I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would have killed you.”

kikuyu: Harreen sun amma illee Balaʼaamiin akkana jette; “Ani harree kee kan ati hamma harʼaatti guyyaa hunda yaabbattu mitii? Ani takkumaa waan akkasii sitti hojjedhee beekaa?” Innis, “Lakkii” jedhee deebiseef.
english: The donkey said to Balaam, “Am I not your donkey, on which you have ridden all your life long until today? Was I ever in the habit of doing so to you?” He said, “No.”

kikuyu: Yommus Waaqayyo ija Balaʼaam bane; Balaʼaamis ergamaa Waaqayyoo kan goraadee luqqifatee karaa irra dhaabatu arge. Kana irratti inni addaan lafatti gombifamee sagade.
english: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the LORD’s angel standing in the way, with his sword drawn in his hand; and he bowed his head, and fell on his face.

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqayyoo sun akkana jedhee isa gaafate; “Ati maaliif yeroo sadan kana harree kee rukutte? Kunoo ani waan karaan kee fuula koo duratti jalʼaa taʼeef siin mormuudhaafan dhufe.
english: The LORD’s angel said to him, “Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Behold, I have come out as an adversary, because your way is perverse before me.

kikuyu: Harreen kun na argitee yeroo kana sadanuu narraa gorte. Utuu isheen narraa goruu baattee silaa ani yoona si ajjeesee ishee immoo hambisa ture.”
english: The donkey saw me, and turned away before me these three times. Unless she had turned away from me, surely now I would have killed you, and saved her alive.”

kikuyu: Balaʼaamis ergamaa Waaqayyootiin, “Ani cubbuu hojjedheera. Ani akka ati naan mormuuf jettee karaa irra dhaabatte hin hubanne. Ammas yoo sitti hin tolin ani nan deebiʼa” jedhe.
english: Balaam said to the LORD’s angel, “I have sinned; for I didn’t know that you stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases you, I will go back again.”

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqayyoo sunis Balaʼaamiin, “Namoota kana wajjin deemi; garuu waanuma ani sitti himu qofa dubbadhu” jedhe. Akkasiin Balaʼaam qondaaltota Baalaaq sana wajjin deeme.
english: The LORD’s angel said to Balaam, “Go with the men; but you shall only speak the word that I shall speak to you.” So Balaam went with the princes of Balak.

kikuyu: Baalaaqis akka Balaʼaam dhufaa jiru dhageenyaan, magaalaa Moʼaab kan daarii Arnoon irratti argamtutti isa simachuudhaaf kaʼee deeme.
english: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him to the City of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, which is in the utmost part of the border.

kikuyu: Baalaaqis Balaʼaamiin akkana jedhe; “Ani dhaamsa ariifachiisaa sitti hin erginee? Ati maaliif na bira hin dhufne? Ani dhugumaan ulfina siif kennuu hin dandaʼuu?”
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Didn’t I earnestly send for you to summon you? Why didn’t you come to me? Am I not able indeed to promote you to honor?”

kikuyu: Balaʼaamis, “Kunoo ani si bira dhufeera. Garuu ani waanuman arge dubbachuu nan dandaʼaa? Ani waanuma Waaqni afaan koo keessa kaaʼu qofan dubbachuu qaba” jedhee deebise.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Behold, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to speak anything? I will speak the word that God puts in my mouth.”

kikuyu: Balaʼaamis kaʼee Baalaaq wajjin Qiiriyaati Haxoti dhaqe.
english: Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath Huzoth.

kikuyu: Baalaaq loonii fi hoolaa aarsaa dhiʼeessee gara tokko Balaʼaamii fi qondaaltota isa wajjin turaniif kenne.
english: Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent to Balaam, and to the princes who were with him.

kikuyu: Ganama itti aanus Baalaaq, Balaʼaamin Baamooti Baʼaalitti ol baase; innis achi dhaabatee saba Israaʼel warra daangaa gamaa irra jiran arge.
english: In the morning, Balak took Balaam, and brought him up into the high places of Baal; and he saw from there part of the people.

kikuyu: Balaʼaamis Baalaaqiin, “Iddoo aarsaa torba asitti naaf ijaari; amma illee korommii loonii torbaa fi korbeeyyii hoolaa torba naa qopheessi” jedhe.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build here seven altars for me, and prepare here seven bulls and seven rams for me.”

kikuyu: Baalaaqis akkuma Balaʼaam jedhe sana godhe; isaan lamaan tokkoo tokkoo iddoo aarsaa irratti korma looniitii fi korbeessa hoolaa tokko tokko aarsaa dhiʼeessan.
english: Balak did as Balaam had spoken; and Balak and Balaam offered on every altar a bull and a ram.

kikuyu: Ergasii Balaʼaam Baalaaqiin akkana jedhe; “Ani xinnoo achi sirraa nan siqa; ati immoo asuma aarsaa kee bira turi. Tarii Waaqayyo anaa wajjin wal arguuf ni dhufa taʼa. Waan inni natti mulʼisu kam iyyuu ani sittin hima.” Innis gara gaara tokkoo dhaqe.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Stand by your burnt offering, and I will go. Perhaps the LORD will come to meet me. Whatever he shows me I will tell you.” He went to a bare height.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo isaan wal arginaan Balaʼaam, “Ani iddoo aarsaa torba qopheessee tokkoo tokkoo isaa irratti korma loonii tokkoo fi korbeessa hoolaa tokko qopheesseera” jedhe.
english: God met Balaam, and he said to him, “I have prepared the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo ergaa tokko afaan Balaʼaam keessa kaaʼee, “Baalaaqitti deebiʼiitii ergaa kana itti himi” jedheen.
english: The LORD put a word in Balaam’s mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and thus you shall speak.”

kikuyu: Balaʼaam Baalaaqitti deebiʼee isaa qondaaltota Moʼaab wajjin aarsaa isaa bira dhaabatu arge.
english: He returned to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, he, and all the princes of Moab.

kikuyu: Balaʼaam ergaa isaa akkana jedhee dubbate: “Baalaaq Arraam irraa, mootichi Moʼaab gaarran baʼaa irraa na fide. Innis, ‘Kottuutii Yaaqoobin naa abaari; kottuutii Israaʼelin naa balaaleffadhu’ jedhe.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “From Aram has Balak brought me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the East. Come, curse Jacob for me. Come, defy Israel.

kikuyu: Ani akkamittan warra Waaqni hin abaarin abaaruu dandaʼa? Ani akkamittan warra Waaqayyo hin balaaleffatin balaaleffachuu dandaʼa?
english: How shall I curse whom God has not cursed? How shall I defy whom the LORD has not defied?

kikuyu: Fiixee gaarranii irraa ani isa nan arga; tulluuwwan irraas isa nan ilaala. Saba kophaa isaa jiraatu, kan saba kaan keessatti of hin lakkoofne nan arga.
english: For from the top of the rocks I see him. From the hills I see him. Behold, it is a people that dwells alone, and shall not be listed among the nations.

kikuyu: Eenyutu awwaara Yaaqoob lakkaaʼuu dandaʼa? Eenyutu Israaʼel keessaa kurmaana isaa illee lakkaaʼa? Ani duʼa nama qajeelaa haa duʼu; dhumni koos akkuma dhuma isaa haa taʼu!”
english: Who can count the dust of Jacob, or count the fourth part of Israel? Let me die the death of the righteous! Let my last end be like his!”

kikuyu: Baalaaqis Balaʼaamiin, “Wanni ati na goote kun maali? Ani akka ati diina koo naa abaartuufin si fide; ati kunoo isaan eebbifte malee waan tokko iyyuu isaan hin goone!” jedhe.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and behold, you have blessed them altogether.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Ani waan Waaqayyo afaan koo keessa kaaʼu hin dubbadhuu?” jedhee deebii kenneef.
english: He answered and said, “Must I not take heed to speak that which the LORD puts in my mouth?”

kikuyu: Baalaaq, “Mee gara lafa itti isaan arguu dandeessu biraa na wajjin kottu; ati gara tokko qofa malee hunduma isaanii arguu hin dandeessu. Achiis isaan naa abaari” jedheen.
english: Balak said to him, “Please come with me to another place, where you may see them. You shall see just part of them, and shall not see them all. Curse them from there for me.”

kikuyu: Inni gara dirree Xoofiim kan fiixee Phisgaa irratti argamuutti isa geesse; achittis iddoo aarsaa torba ijaaree tokkoo tokkoo iddoo aarsaa sanaa irratti korma loonii tokkoo fi korbeessa hoolaa tokko aarsaa dhiʼeesse.
english: He took him into the field of Zophim, to the top of Pisgah, and built seven altars, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

kikuyu: Balaʼaamis Baalaaqiin, “Ati hamma ani achi siqee Waaqa wajjin wal argutti asuma aarsaa kee bira turi” jedhe.
english: He said to Balak, “Stand here by your burnt offering, while I meet God over there.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Balaʼaam wajjin wal argee ergaa tokko afaan isaa keessa kaaʼee, “Baalaaqitti deebiʼiitii ergaa kana itti himi” jedheen.
english: The LORD met Balaam, and put a word in his mouth, and said, “Return to Balak, and say this.”

kikuyu: Balaʼaam Baalaaq bira dhaqee isaa qondaaltota Moʼaab wajjin aarsaa isaa bira dhaabatu arge. Baalaaqis, “Waaqayyo maal jedhe?” jedhee Balaʼaamiin gaafate.
english: He came to him, and behold, he was standing by his burnt offering, and the princes of Moab with him. Balak said to him, “What has the LORD spoken?”

kikuyu: Balaʼaam akkana jedhee ergaa isaa dubbate: “Yaa Baalaaq, kaʼiitii dhaggeeffadhu; yaa ilma Ziphoori na dhagaʼi.
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Rise up, Balak, and hear! Listen to me, you son of Zippor.

kikuyu: Waaqni nama miti; inni hin sobu; yookaan gaabbuudhaaf inni ilma namaa miti. Inni waa dubbatee ergasii hin hojjetuu? Inni waa abdachiisee ergasii hin raawwatuu?
english: God is not a man, that he should lie, nor a son of man, that he should repent. Has he said, and he won’t do it? Or has he spoken, and he won’t make it good?

kikuyu: Kunoo ani eebbisuudhaaf ajaja argadheera; inni eebbiseera; anis geeddaruu hin dandaʼu.
english: Behold, I have received a command to bless. He has blessed, and I can’t reverse it.

kikuyu: “Inni Yaaqoob keessatti daba hin argine; rakkina tokko illee Israaʼel keessatti hin argine. Waaqayyo Waaqni isaanii isaan wajjin jira; ililleen Mootii isaan wajjin jira.
english: He has not seen iniquity in Jacob. Neither has he seen perverseness in Israel. The LORD his God is with him. The shout of a king is among them.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo biyya Gibxiitii isaan baase; inni jabina akka jabina gafarsaa qaba.
english: God brings them out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox.

kikuyu: Yaaqoob irratti falfalli tokko iyyuu hin hojjetu; Israaʼel irrattis tolchi tokko iyyuu hin hojjetu. Amma Yaaqoobii fi Israaʼeliin, ‘Waan Waaqni hojjete ilaalaa!’ jedhama.
english: Surely there is no enchantment with Jacob; neither is there any divination with Israel. Now it shall be said of Jacob and of Israel, ‘What has God done!’

kikuyu: Kunoo sabni sun akka leenca dhalaatti kaʼa; akkuma leencaattis ol jedha; inni hamma waan adamsate nyaatee fixutti, hamma dhiiga waan ajjeefate sanaa dhuguttis hin ciisu.”
english: Behold, a people rises up as a lioness. As a lion he lifts himself up. He shall not lie down until he eats of the prey, and drinks the blood of the slain.”

kikuyu: Baalaaq Balaʼaamiin, “Ati gonkumaa isaan hin abaarin yookaan isaan hin eebbisin” jedhe.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all.”

kikuyu: Balaʼaamis, “Ani akka waan Waaqayyo jedhu kam iyyuu hojjedhu sitti hin himnee?” jedhee Baalaaqiif deebise.
english: But Balaam answered Balak, “Didn’t I tell you, saying, ‘All that the LORD speaks, that I must do’?”

kikuyu: Ergasii Baalaaq Balaʼaamiin, “Mee kottu amma illee ani iddoo biraa sin geessaa. Tarii achii jara naaf abaaruun kee Waaqa gammachiisa taʼaatii” jedhe.
english: Balak said to Balaam, “Come now, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will please God that you may curse them for me from there.”

kikuyu: Baalaaqis Balaʼaamin fiixee tulluu Pheʼoor kan irra dhaabatanii gammoojjii sana gad ilaalanitti ol baase.
english: Balak took Balaam to the top of Peor, that looks down on the desert.

kikuyu: Balaʼaamis Baalaaqiin, “Iddoo aarsaa torba asitti naaf ijaari; ammas korommii loonii torbaa fi korbeeyyii hoolaa torba naaf qopheessi” jedhe.
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here.”

kikuyu: Baalaaqis akkuma Balaʼaam jedheen sana godhe; tokkoo tokkoo iddoo aarsaa irrattis korma loonii tokkoo fi korbeessa hoolaa tokko aarsaa dhiʼeesse.
english: Balak did as Balaam had said, and offered up a bull and a ram on every altar.

kikuyu: Balaʼaam yeroo akka Israaʼelin eebbisuun Waaqayyoon gammachiise argetti akka yeroo kaanii falfala barbaacha hin dhaqne; garuu fuula isaa gara gammoojjiitti deebifate.
english: When Balaam saw that it pleased the LORD to bless Israel, he didn’t go, as at the other times, to use divination, but he set his face toward the wilderness.

kikuyu: Yommuu Balaʼaam ol milʼatee akka Israaʼel gosa gosaan qubate argetti Hafuurri Waaqaa isa irra buʼe;
english: Balaam lifted up his eyes, and he saw Israel dwelling according to their tribes; and the Spirit of God came on him.

kikuyu: innis akkana jedhee ergaa isaa dubbate: “Ergaa Balaʼaam ilma Beʼoor, ergaa nama iji isaa sirriitti arguu,
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

kikuyu: ergaa nama dubbii Waaqaa dhagaʼuu isa Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu irraa mulʼata argu kan kufee iji isaa banamu sanaa:
english: he says, who hears the words of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

kikuyu: “Yaa Yaaqoob, dunkaanonni kee, Yaa Israaʼel, iddoon ati jiraattu akkam miidhaga!
english: How goodly are your tents, Jacob, and your dwellings, Israel!

kikuyu: “Isaan akkuma sulula diriiraa, akkuma iddoo biqiltuu kan afaan lagaa, akkuma argeessa Waaqayyo dhaabee, akkuma birbirsaa qarqara bishaanii ti.
english: As valleys they are spread out, as gardens by the riverside, as aloes which the LORD has planted, as cedar trees beside the waters.

kikuyu: Okolee isaa keessaa bishaantu lolaʼa; sanyiin isaa bishaan baayʼee argata. “Mootiin isaa Agaag caala; mootummaan isaa ni kabajama.
english: Water shall flow from his buckets. His seed shall be in many waters. His king shall be higher than Agag. His kingdom shall be exalted.

kikuyu: “Waaqayyo Gibxii isa baase; inni jabina akka jabina gafarsaa qaba. Inni saba diinota isaa taʼe nyaata; lafee isaanii ni caccabsa; xiyya ofii isaatiin isaan waraana.
english: God brings him out of Egypt. He has as it were the strength of the wild ox. He shall consume the nations his adversaries, shall break their bones in pieces, and pierce them with his arrows.

kikuyu: Inni akkuma leencaa ciiseera; akkuma leenca dhalaas ciiseera; eenyutu isa dammaqsa? “Warri si eebbisan haa eebbifaman; warri si abaaranis haa abaaraman!”
english: He couched, he lay down as a lion, as a lioness; who shall rouse him up? Everyone who blesses you is blessed. Everyone who curses you is cursed.”

kikuyu: Baalaaq Balaʼaamitti aare. Innis harka ofii isaa walitti rurrukutee Balaʼaamiin akkana jedhe; “Ani akka ati diina koo abaartuufan si waammadhe; ati kunoo yeroo sadan kana isaan eebbifte.
english: Balak’s anger burned against Balaam, and he struck his hands together. Balak said to Balaam, “I called you to curse my enemies, and, behold, you have altogether blessed them these three times.

kikuyu: Amma dafii asii deemii mana keetti gali! Ani ulfina guddaa siif nan kenna jedheen ture; amma garuu Waaqayyo akka ati ulfina hin arganne si godheera.”
english: Therefore, flee to your place, now! I thought to promote you to great honor; but, behold, the LORD has kept you back from honor.”

kikuyu: Balaʼaamis Baalaaqiin akkana jedhe; “Ani ergamoota ati natti ergite sanatti akkana jedheen hime mitii?
english: Balaam said to Balak, “Didn’t I also tell your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,

kikuyu: ‘Utuu Baalaaq masaraa meetii fi warqeen guutame sana naaf kennee iyyuu, ani waanuma Waaqayyo jedhe qofan dubbadha malee ajaja Waaqayyootiin alatti waan yaada koo gaarii yookaan hamaa tokko iyyuu hojjechuu hin dandaʼu.’
english: ‘If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I can’t go beyond the LORD’s word, to do either good or bad from my own mind. I will say what the LORD says’?

kikuyu: Kunoo ani amma saba kootti nan deebiʼa; garuu mee kottu ani waan sabni kun bara dhufu keessa saba keetiif godhu sin beeksisaa.”
english: Now, behold, I go to my people. Come, I will inform you what this people shall do to your people in the latter days.”

kikuyu: Inni akkana jedhee ergaa isaa dubbate: Ergaa Balaʼaam ilma Beʼoor, ergaa nama iji isaa sirriitti arguu,
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Balaam the son of Beor says, the man whose eyes are open says;

kikuyu: ergaa nama dubbii Waaqaa dhagaʼuu kan beekumsa Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii qabu kan Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu irraa mulʼata argu kan kufee diriiruu, iji isaas kan banamu sanaa:
english: he says, who hears the words of God, knows the knowledge of the Most High, and who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, and having his eyes open:

kikuyu: “Ani isa nan arga; garuu amma miti; ani isa nan ilaala; garuu dhiʼootti miti. Yaaqoob keessaa urjiin tokko ni baʼa; Israaʼel keessaa bokkuun tokko ol kaʼa. Inni adda warra Moʼaab, buqqee mataa ilmaan Seet hundaas ni caccabsa.
english: I see him, but not now. I see him, but not near. A star will come out of Jacob. A scepter will rise out of Israel, and shall strike through the corners of Moab, and crush all the sons of Sheth.

kikuyu: Edoom ni moʼatama; Seeʼiir, diinni isaa ni moʼatama; Israaʼel garuu jabaachaa deema.
english: Edom shall be a possession. Seir, his enemy, also shall be a possession, while Israel does valiantly.

kikuyu: Yaaqoob keessaa bulchaan tokko ni kaʼa; warra magaalaa sana keessatti lubbuudhaan hafanis ni barbadeessa.”
english: Out of Jacob shall one have dominion, and shall destroy the remnant from the city.”

kikuyu: Ergasiis Balaʼaam Amaaleqin argee akkana jedhee ergaa ofii isa dubbate: “Amaaleq saboota keessaa kan jalqabaa ture; dhumni isaa garuu barbadaaʼuu dha.”
english: He looked at Amalek, and took up his parable, and said, “Amalek was the first of the nations, but his latter end shall come to destruction.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Qeenota argee akkana jedhee ergaa ofii isaa itti dubbate: “Iddoon ati jiraattu jabaa dha; manni kees kattaa keessatti ijaarame;
english: He looked at the Kenite, and took up his parable, and said, “Your dwelling place is strong. Your nest is set in the rock.

kikuyu: taʼus isin warri Qeenotaa, gaafa Asoor isin boojiʼu ni baddu.”
english: Nevertheless Kain shall be wasted, until Asshur carries you away captive.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee ergaa isaa itti dubbate: “Wayyoo! Yeroo Waaqayyo waan kana hojjetu eenyutu jiraachuu dandaʼa?
english: He took up his parable, and said, “Alas, who shall live when God does this?

kikuyu: Dooniiwwan qarqara Kitiim irraa ni dhufu; isaanis Asoorii fi Eeberin ni qabatu; garuu isaanis ni barbadeeffamu.”
english: But ships shall come from the coast of Kittim. They shall afflict Asshur, and shall afflict Eber. He also shall come to destruction.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Balaʼaam kaʼee mana ofii isaatti deebiʼe; Baalaaq immoo karaa ofii isaa qajeele.
english: Balaam rose up, and went and returned to his place; and Balak also went his way.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni yeroo Shixiim keessa turanitti dhiironni isaanii dubartoota Moʼaab wajjin sagaagaluu jalqaban.
english: Israel stayed in Shittim; and the people began to play the prostitute with the daughters of Moab;

kikuyu: Dubartoonni kunneenis gara qalma waaqota isaaniitti saba sana afeerraan, sabni sun qalma sana nyaatee waaqota sanaaf sagade.
english: for they called the people to the sacrifices of their gods. The people ate and bowed down to their gods.

kikuyu: Israaʼel Baʼaal Pheʼoor duukaa buʼe. Dheekkamsi Waaqayyoos isaanitti bobaʼe.
english: Israel joined himself to Baal Peor, and the LORD’s anger burned against Israel.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Akka dheekkamsi Waaqayyoo jabaan sun saba Israaʼel irraa deebiʼuuf, hangafoota saba sanaa hunda fuudhiitii guyyaa adiidhaan fuula Waaqayyoo duratti isaan fannisi.”
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take all the chiefs of the people, and hang them up to the LORD before the sun, that the fierce anger of the LORD may turn away from Israel.”

kikuyu: Museen abbootii murtii Israaʼeliin, “Tokkoon tokkoon keessan namoota keessan kanneen Baʼaal Pheʼoor duukaa buʼan fixaa” jedhe.
english: Moses said to the judges of Israel, “Everyone kill his men who have joined themselves to Baal Peor.”

kikuyu: Kunoo namichi Israaʼel tokko utuma isaan balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti booʼaa jiranuu fuula Museetii fi fuula waldaa Israaʼel guutuu duratti dubartii Midiyaan tokko gara maatii ofii isaatti fidate.
english: Behold, one of the children of Israel came and brought to his brothers a Midianite woman in the sight of Moses, and in the sight of all the congregation of the children of Israel, while they were weeping at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Fiinehaas ilmi Eleʼaazaar ilma Aroon lubichaa waan kana arginaan waldaa sana keessaa baʼee eeboo harkatti qabatee
english: When Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, saw it, he rose up from the middle of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.

kikuyu: namicha Israaʼel sana duukaa buʼee dunkaana seene; namicha Israaʼelii fi dubartittiis walitti waraanee dhagna isheetti fullaase. Akkasiin dhaʼichi Israaʼelitti dhufe sun ni dhowwame.
english: He went after the man of Israel into the pavilion, and thrust both of them through, the man of Israel, and the woman through her body. So the plague was stopped among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Garuu baayʼinni namoota dhaʼicha sanaan dhumanii 24,000 gaʼee ture.
english: Those who died by the plague were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Fiinehaas ilmi Eleʼaazaar ilma Aroon lubicha sanaa dheekkamsa koo Israaʼeloota irraa deebiseera; inni akka ani hinaaffaa kootiin isaan hin balleessineef, akkuma ani ulfina kootiif isaan gidduutti hinaafu sana innis hinaafeeraatii.
english: “Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, has turned my wrath away from the children of Israel, in that he was jealous with my jealousy among them, so that I didn’t consume the children of Israel in my jealousy.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu kunoo akka ani kakuu koo kan nagaa isa wajjin godhadhu itti naaf himi.
english: Therefore say, ‘Behold, I give to him my covenant of peace.

kikuyu: Sababii inni ulfina Waaqa isaatiif hinaafee Israaʼelootaaf araara buuseef, innii fi sanyiin isaa kakuu lubummaa kan bara baraa qabaatu.”
english: It shall be to him, and to his offspring after him, the covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was jealous for his God, and made atonement for the children of Israel.’”

kikuyu: Maqaan namicha Israaʼel kan dubartii Midiyaan wajjin ajjeefame sanaa Zimrii ilma Saaluu ti; innis hoogganaa maatii Simiʼoon.
english: Now the name of the man of Israel that was slain, who was slain with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, the son of Salu, a prince of a fathers’ house among the Simeonites.

kikuyu: Maqaan dubartii Midiyaan kan ajjeefamte sanaa Kozbii intala Zuuri hangafa maatii Midiyaan tokkoo ti.
english: The name of the Midianite woman who was slain was Cozbi, the daughter of Zur. He was head of the people of a fathers’ house in Midian.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Midiyaanota akka diinaatti ilaaliitii ajjeesi;
english: “Harass the Midianites, and strike them;

kikuyu: kunis waan isaan sababii Pheʼooriitii fi obboleettii isaanii Kozbii intala hoogganaa warra Midiyaan, dubartii guyyaa sababii Pheʼooriitiin dhaʼichi dhufe sana ajjeefamte sanaa irratti isin gowwoomsan sana akka diinaatti isin ilaalaniif.”
english: for they harassed you with their wiles, wherein they have deceived you in the matter of Peor, and in the incident regarding Cozbi, the daughter of the prince of Midian, their sister, who was slain on the day of the plague in the matter of Peor.”

kikuyu: Dhaʼicha sana booddee Waaqayyo Musee fi Eleʼaazaar ilma Aroon lubichaatiin akkana jedhe;
english: After the plague, the LORD spoke to Moses and to Eleazar the son of Aaron the priest, saying,

kikuyu: “Waldaa saba Israaʼel warra umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaa fi hammasii ol taʼe kanneen loltoota Israaʼel keessa tajaajiluu dandaʼan hunda maatii maatiidhaan lakkaaʼaa.”
english: “Take a census of all the congregation of the children of Israel, from twenty years old and upward, by their fathers’ houses, all who are able to go out to war in Israel.”

kikuyu: Musee fi Eleʼaazaar lubichi dirreewwan Moʼaab irratti, Yordaanos biratti, Yerikoo gamatti akkana jedhanii isaan wajjin dubbatan;
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: “Akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajajetti namoota umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii lakkaaʼaa.”
english: “Take a census, from twenty years old and upward, as the LORD commanded Moses and the children of Israel.” These are those who came out of the land of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Ruubeen ilma Israaʼel hangaftichaa: karaa Henookiitiin, balbala Hanookotaa; karaa Faluutiin, balbala Faluuwotaa;
english: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel; the sons of Reuben: of Hanoch, the family of the Hanochites; of Pallu, the family of the Palluites;

kikuyu: karaa Hezrooniitiin, balbala Asroonotaa; karaa Karmiitiin, balbala Karmootaa.
english: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Carmi, the family of the Carmites.

kikuyu: Jarri kunneen balbalawwan Ruubeen; baayʼinni isaaniis 43,730 ture.
english: These are the families of the Reubenites; and those who were counted of them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.

kikuyu: Ilmi Faluus Eliiyaab;
english: The son of Pallu: Eliab.

kikuyu: ilmaan Eliiyaabis Nemuuʼeel, Daataanii fi Aberoon. Daataanii fi Abiiraam kunneen qondaaltota waldaa kanneen Musee fi Aroonitti fincilanii dha; isaan yeroo Qooraahii fi duukaa buutonni isaa Waaqayyotti fincilan sanas achi keessa turan.
english: The sons of Eliab: Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are that Dathan and Abiram who were called by the congregation, who rebelled against Moses and against Aaron in the company of Korah when they rebelled against the LORD;

kikuyu: Laftis afaan banattee Qooraahii fi isaan illee liqimsite; warri garee Qooraahi immoo yeroo ibiddii namoota 250 fixe sana dhuman. Isaanis mallattoo namoonni ittiin of eeggatan taʼan.
english: and the earth opened its mouth, and swallowed them up together with Korah when that company died; at the time the fire devoured two hundred fifty men, and they became a sign.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Qooraahi garuu hin duune.
english: Notwithstanding, the sons of Korah didn’t die.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Simiʼoon akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti kanneenii dha: karaa Nemuuʼeel, balbala Nemuuʼeelotaa; karaa Yaamiin, balbala Yaamiinotaa; karaa Yaakiin, balbala Yaakiinotaa;
english: The sons of Simeon after their families: of Nemuel, the family of the Nemuelites; of Jamin, the family of the Jaminites; of Jachin, the family of the Jachinites;

kikuyu: karaa Zeraan, balbala Zerootaa; karaa Shaawul, balbala Shaawulootaa ti.
english: of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites; of Shaul, the family of the Shaulites.

kikuyu: Jarri kunneen balbalawwan Simiʼoonii ti; isaanis namoota 22,200 turan.
english: These are the families of the Simeonites, twenty-two thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Gaad akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti kanneenii dha: karaa Zefoon, balbala Zefoonotaa; karaa Hagii, balbala Hagootaa; karaa Shuunii, balbala Shuunotaa;
english: The sons of Gad after their families: of Zephon, the family of the Zephonites; of Haggi, the family of the Haggites; of Shuni, the family of the Shunites;

kikuyu: karaa Oznii, balbala Oznootaa; karaa Eerii, balbala Eerotaa;
english: of Ozni, the family of the Oznites; of Eri, the family of the Erites;

kikuyu: karaa Arood, balbala Aroodotaa; karaa Ariʼeel, balbala Ariʼeelotaa ti.
english: of Arod, the family of the Arodites; of Areli, the family of the Arelites.

kikuyu: Jarri kunneen balbalawwan Gaadii ti; baayʼinni isaaniis 40,500 ture.
english: These are the families of the sons of Gad according to those who were counted of them, forty thousand and five hundred.

kikuyu: Eerii fi Oonaan ilmaan Yihuudaa ti; isaan garuu Kanaʼaan keessatti duʼan.
english: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan. Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yihuudaa akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti kanneenii dha: karaa Sheelaa, balbala Sheelaanotaa; karaa Faares, balbala Faaresotaa; karaa Zaaraa, balbala Zaarotaa ti.
english: The sons of Judah after their families were: of Shelah, the family of the Shelanites; of Perez, the family of the Perezites; of Zerah, the family of the Zerahites.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Faaresis kanneenii dha: karaa Hezroon, balbala Hezroonotaa; karaa Hamuul, balbala Hamuulotaa ti.
english: The sons of Perez were: of Hezron, the family of the Hezronites; of Hamul, the family of the Hamulites.

kikuyu: Jarri kunneen balbalawwan Yihuudaa ti; baayʼinni isaaniis 76,500 ture.
english: These are the families of Judah according to those who were counted of them, seventy-six thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yisaakor akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti kanneenii dha: karaa Toolaa, balbala Toolotaa; karaa Fuwaa, balbala Fuuwotaa;
english: The sons of Issachar after their families: of Tola, the family of the Tolaites; of Puvah, the family of the Punites;

kikuyu: karaa Yaashuub, balbala Yaashuubotaa; karaa Shimroon, balbala Shimroonotaa ti.
english: of Jashub, the family of the Jashubites; of Shimron, the family of the Shimronites.

kikuyu: Jarri kunneen balbalawwan Yisaakor; baayʼinni isaaniis 64,300 ture.
english: These are the families of Issachar according to those who were counted of them, sixty-four thousand three hundred.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Zebuuloon akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti kanneenii dha: karaa Sered, balbala Seredootaa; karaa Eeloon, balbala Eeloonotaa; karaa Yahiliʼeel, balbala Yahiliʼeelotaa ti.
english: The sons of Zebulun after their families: of Sered, the family of the Seredites; of Elon, the family of the Elonites; of Jahleel, the family of the Jahleelites.

kikuyu: Jarri kunneen balbalawwan Zebuuloon; baayʼinni isaaniis 60,500 ture.
english: These are the families of the Zebulunites according to those who were counted of them, sixty thousand five hundred.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yoosef akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti: Minaasee fi Efreem.
