english: The sons of Joseph after their families: Manasseh and Ephraim.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Minaasee: karaa Maakiir, balbala Maakiirotaa; Maakiir kun abbaa Giliʼaad; karaa Giliʼaad, balbala Giliʼaadotaa ti.
english: The sons of Manasseh: of Machir, the family of the Machirites; and Machir became the father of Gilead; of Gilead, the family of the Gileadites.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Giliʼaad isaan kanneenii dha: karaa Iiʼezer, balbala Iiʼezerootaa; karaa Heleq, balbala Heleqootaa;
english: These are the sons of Gilead: of Iezer, the family of the Iezerites; of Helek, the family of the Helekites;

kikuyu: karaa Asriʼeel, balbala Asriiʼeelotaa, karaa Sheekem, balbala Sheekemotaa;
english: and Asriel, the family of the Asrielites; and Shechem, the family of the Shechemites;

kikuyu: karaa Shemiidaa, balbala Shemiidaa; karaa Heefer, balbala Heeferotaa ti.
english: and Shemida, the family of the Shemidaites; and Hepher, the family of the Hepherites.

kikuyu: Zelofehaad ilmi Heefer ilmaan hin qabu ture; inni intallan qofa qaba ture; maqaan isaaniis Mahilaa, Nohii, Hoglaa, Miilkaa fi Tiirzaa dha.
english: Zelophehad the son of Hepher had no sons, but daughters: and the names of the daughters of Zelophehad were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

kikuyu: Jarri kunneen balbalawwan Minaasee ti; baayʼinni isaaniis 52,700 ture.
english: These are the families of Manasseh. Those who were counted of them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Efreem akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti kanneenii dha: karaa Shuutelaa, balbala Shuutelootaa; karaa Beker, balbala Bekerotaa; karaa Taahan, balbala Taahanotaa ti.
english: These are the sons of Ephraim after their families: of Shuthelah, the family of the Shuthelahites; of Becher, the family of the Becherites; of Tahan, the family of the Tahanites.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Shuutelaa isaan kanneenii dha: karaa Eeraan, balbala Eeraanotaa ti.
english: These are the sons of Shuthelah: of Eran, the family of the Eranites.

kikuyu: Jarri kunneen balbalawwan Efreem; baayʼinni isaaniis 32,500 ture.
english: These are the families of the sons of Ephraim according to those who were counted of them, thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph after their families.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Beniyaam akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti kanneenii dha: karaa Belaa, balbala Belaaʼotaa; karaa Ashbeel, balbala Asbeelotaa; karaa Ahiiraam, balbala Ahiiraamotaa;
english: The sons of Benjamin after their families: of Bela, the family of the Belaites; of Ashbel, the family of the Ashbelites; of Ahiram, the family of the Ahiramites;

kikuyu: karaa Shefuufaami, balbala Shefuufaamotaa; karaa Huufaam, balbala Huufaamotaa ti.
english: of Shephupham, the family of the Shuphamites; of Hupham, the family of the Huphamites.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Belaa, karaa Ardii fi Naʼamaan: karaa Ardii, balbala Ardootaa; karaa Naʼamaan, balbala Naʼamaanotaa ti.
english: The sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the family of the Ardites; and of Naaman, the family of the Naamites.

kikuyu: Jarri kunneen balbalawwan Beniyaam; baayʼinni isaaniis 45,600 ture.
english: These are the sons of Benjamin after their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Daan akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti kanneenii dha: karaa Shuuhaam, balbala Shuuhaamotaa ti.
english: These are the sons of Dan after their families: of Shuham, the family of the Shuhamites. These are the families of Dan after their families.

kikuyu: Isaan hundinuu balbalawwan Shuuhaamotaa ti; baayʼinni isaaniis 64,400 ture.
english: All the families of the Shuhamites, according to those who were counted of them, were sixty-four thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Aasheer akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti kanneenii dha: karaa Yimnaa, balbala Yuumnootaa; karaa Yishwii, balbala Yishwiiyotaa; karaa Beriiyaa, balbala Beriiyootaa;
english: The sons of Asher after their families: of Imnah, the family of the Imnites; of Ishvi, the family of the Ishvites; of Beriah, the family of the Berites.

kikuyu: karaa ilmaan Beriiyaa immoo: karaa Hebeer, balbala Hebeerotaa; karaa Malkiiʼeel, balbala Malkiiʼeelotaa ti.
english: Of the sons of Beriah: of Heber, the family of the Heberites; of Malchiel, the family of the Malchielites.

kikuyu: Aasheer intala Seraa jedhamtu tokko qaba ture.
english: The name of the daughter of Asher was Serah.

kikuyu: Jarri kunneen balbalawwan Aasheer; baayʼinni isaaniis 53,400 ture.
english: These are the families of the sons of Asher according to those who were counted of them, fifty-three thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Niftaalem akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti kanneenii dha: karaa Yahizeel, balbala Yahizeelotaa, karaa Guunii, balbala Guunotaa;
english: The sons of Naphtali after their families: of Jahzeel, the family of the Jahzeelites; of Guni, the family of the Gunites;

kikuyu: karaa Yeexer, balbala Yeexirotaa; karaa Shiileem, balbala Shiileemotaa ti.
english: of Jezer, the family of the Jezerites; of Shillem, the family of the Shillemites.

kikuyu: Jarri kunneen balbalawwan Niftaalem; baayʼinni isaaniis 45,400 ture.
english: These are the families of Naphtali according to their families; and those who were counted of them were forty-five thousand four hundred.

kikuyu: Walumaa galatti baayʼinni dhiira Israaʼel 601,730 ture.
english: These are those who were counted of the children of Israel, six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Biyyi sun akkuma baayʼina maqaa namaatti dhaala taʼee isaan kanneeniif haa qoodamu.
english: “To these the land shall be divided for an inheritance according to the number of names.

kikuyu: Balbala guddaadhaaf dhaala guddaa, balbala xinnaadhaaf immoo dhaala xinnaa kenni; tokkoon tokkoon balbalaa akkuma baayʼina namoota galmeeffamaniitti dhaala isaa haa argatu.
english: To the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance. To everyone according to those who were counted of him shall his inheritance be given.

kikuyu: Garuu biyyi sun ixaadhaan haa qoqoodamtu. Isaanis akkuma maqaawwan gosoota abbootii isaaniitti ni dhaalu.
english: Notwithstanding, the land shall be divided by lot. According to the names of the tribes of their fathers they shall inherit.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon dhaala sanaa garee guddaa fi garee xinnaa gidduutti ixaadhaan haa qoodamu.”
english: According to the lot shall their inheritance be divided between the more and the fewer.”

kikuyu: Lewwonni balbala balbalaan lakkaaʼaman kanneenii dha: karaa Geershoon, balbala Geershoonotaa; karaa Qohaati, balbala Qohaatotaa; karaa Meraarii, balbala Meraarotaa ti.
english: These are those who were counted of the Levites after their families: of Gershon, the family of the Gershonites; of Kohath, the family of the Kohathites; of Merari, the family of the Merarites.

kikuyu: Jarri kunneenis balbalawwan Lewwotaa ti: balbala Liibnotaa, balbala Kebroonotaa, balbala Mahelootaa, balbala Muusotaa, balbala Qooraahotaa. Qohaati abbaa Amraam;
english: These are the families of Levi: the family of the Libnites, the family of the Hebronites, the family of the Mahlites, the family of the Mushites, and the family of the Korahites. Kohath became the father of Amram.

kikuyu: maqaan niitii Amraam Yookebeed. Isheen intala Lewwii kan biyya Gibxitti Lewwiif dhalattee dha. Amraamiifis Aroon, Musee fi obboleettii isaanii Miiriyaam deesse.
english: The name of Amram’s wife was Jochebed, the daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt. She bore to Amram Aaron and Moses, and Miriam their sister.

kikuyu: Aroon abbaa Naadaab, Abiihuu, Eleʼaazaarii fi Iitaamaar.
english: To Aaron were born Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Naadaabii fi Abiihuu garuu yeroo ibidda hin eeyyamamin fuula Waaqayyoo duratti dhiʼeessan sana duʼan.
english: Nadab and Abihu died when they offered strange fire before the LORD.

kikuyu: Dhiironni umuriin isaanii jiʼa tokkoo fi hammasii ol taʼe kanneen lakkaaʼaman hundi 23,000 turan. Isaanis sababii gidduu isaaniitti dhaala hin argatiniif Israaʼeloota kaan wajjin hin lakkaaʼamne.
english: Those who were counted of them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and upward; for they were not counted among the children of Israel, because there was no inheritance given them among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen warra yeroo Musee fi Eleʼaazaar lubichi dirreewwan Moʼaab irratti, Yordaanos biratti, Yerikoo gamatti Israaʼeloota lakkaaʼan sana lakkaaʼamanii dha.
english: These are those who were counted by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Namoota karaa Museetii fi Aroon lubichaan Gammoojjii Siinaa keessatti lakkaaʼaman keessaa namni tokko iyyuu isaan gidduu hin turre.
english: But among these there was not a man of them who were counted by Moses and Aaron the priest, who counted the children of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Sababii Waaqayyo waaʼee isaanii, “Isaan Gammoojjii keessatti ni dhumu” jedhee dubbatee tureef, Kaaleb ilma Yefunee fi Iyyaasuu ilma Nuuni malee isaan keessaa namni tokko iyyuu hin hafne.
english: For the LORD had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Balbala Minaasee ilma Yoosef keessaas intallan Zelofehaad ilma Heefer, ilma Giliʼaad, ilma Maakiirii fi ilma Minaaseetu dhiʼaate. Maqaan intallan sanaas Mahilaa, Nohii, Hoglaa, Miilkaa fi Tiirzaa dha.
english: Then the daughters of Zelophehad, the son of Hepher, the son of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of Manasseh the son of Joseph came near. These are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.

kikuyu: Isaanis balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii dura, fuula Musee fi Eleʼaazaar lubichaa dura, fuula hooggantootaatii fi waldaa hundaa dura dhaabatanii akkana jedhan;
english: They stood before Moses, before Eleazar the priest, and before the princes and all the congregation, at the door of the Tent of Meeting, saying,

kikuyu: “Abbaan keenya Gammoojjii keessatti duʼe. Inni hooggantoota Qooraahi kanneen Waaqayyotti fincilan sana keessa hin turre. Garuu inni cubbudhuma ofii isaatiin duʼe. Ilmaanis hin qabu ture.
english: “Our father died in the wilderness. He was not among the company of those who gathered themselves together against the LORD in the company of Korah, but he died in his own sin. He had no sons.

kikuyu: Maaliif maqaan abbaa keenyaa sababii inni ilma hin qabneef balbala isaa keessaa bada? Firoota abbaa keenyaa gidduutti dhaala nuu kenni.”
english: Why should the name of our father be taken away from among his family, because he had no son? Give to us a possession among the brothers of our father.”

kikuyu: Museen dubbii isaanii sana fuula Waaqayyoo duratti dhiʼeesse;
english: Moses brought their cause before the LORD.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos akkana jedheen;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Wanni intallan Zelofehaad jedhan kun sirrii dha. Atis firoota abbaa isaanii gidduutti dhaala kenniif; dhaala abbaa isaaniis isaaniif dabarsi.
english: “The daughters of Zelophehad speak right. You shall surely give them a possession of an inheritance among their father’s brothers. You shall cause the inheritance of their father to pass to them.

kikuyu: “Israaʼelootaan akkana jedhi; ‘Yoo namni utuu ilma hin dhalchin duʼe, dhaala isaa intala isaatiif dabarsaa.
english: You shall speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If a man dies, and has no son, then you shall cause his inheritance to pass to his daughter.

kikuyu: Yoo inni intalas qabaachuu baate dhaala isaa obboloota isaatiif kennaa.
english: If he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.

kikuyu: Yoo inni obboloota qabaachuu baate dhaala isaa obboloota abbaa isaatiif kennaa.
english: If he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father’s brothers.

kikuyu: Yoo abbaan isaa obboloota qabaachuu baate immoo dhaala isaa balbala isaa keessaa fira aanteef kennaa; firri sun haa dhaalu. Kunis akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajaje sanatti saba Israaʼeliif sirna seera qabeessa haa taʼu.’ ”
english: If his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his kinsman who is next to him of his family, and he shall possess it. This shall be a statute and ordinance for the children of Israel, as the LORD commanded Moses.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Tulluu Abaariim kanatti ol baʼiitii biyya ani saba Israaʼeliif kenne ilaali.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Erga biyya sana argitee booddee atis akkuma obboleessa kee Aroon gara saba keetiitti walitti qabamta;
english: When you have seen it, you also shall be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother was gathered;

kikuyu: yeroo waldaan Gammoojjii Siin keessatti natti finciletti isin lachanuus ajaja kootti finciltanii turtaniitii. Isin bishaanota sana biratti fuula isaanii duratti qulqullina koo hin mulʼifne.” Bishaanonni kunneenis bishaanota Mariibaa Qaadesh kan Gammoojjii Siin keessa jiranii dha.
english: because in the strife of the congregation, you rebelled against my word in the wilderness of Zin, to honor me as holy at the waters before their eyes.” (These are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.)

kikuyu: Museenis Waaqayyoon akkana jedhe;
english: Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,

kikuyu: “Waaqayyo Waaqni hafuurota nama hundaa waldaa kana irratti nama tokko haa muudu;
english: “Let the LORD, the God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,

kikuyu: namichi kunis akka sabni Waaqayyoo akkuma hoolota tiksee hin qabnee hin taaneef kan isaan dura gad baʼuu fi ol galu, kan gad isaan baasuu fi ol isaan galchuu dha.”
english: who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that the congregation of the LORD may not be as sheep which have no shepherd.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Iyyaasuu ilma Nuuni, namicha hafuurri keessa jiru sana fuudhii harka kee isa irra kaaʼi.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.

kikuyu: Akka inni fuula Eleʼaazaar lubichaatii fi fuula waldaa Israaʼel hundaa dura dhaabatu godhi; fuuluma isaanii durattis isa muudi.
english: Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.

kikuyu: Akka sabni Israaʼel hundi isaaf ajajamuuf aangoo kee irraa kenniif.
english: You shall give authority to him, that all the congregation of the children of Israel may obey.

kikuyu: Innis fuula Eleʼaazaar lubichaa kan fuula Waaqayyoo duratti Uriimiidhaan gaafatee murtii isaaf kennuu dura dhaabachuu qaba. Innii fi waldaan Israaʼelootaa hundi ajaja isaatiin baʼu; ajajuma isaatiinis galu.”
english: He shall stand before Eleazar the priest, who shall inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in, both he and all the children of Israel with him, even all the congregation.”

kikuyu: Museen akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajaje sana godhe. Innis Iyyaasuu geessee akka inni fuula Eleʼaazaar lubichaatii fi fuula waldaa Israaʼel hundaa dura dhaabatu godhe.
english: Moses did as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua, and set him before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.

kikuyu: Ergasiis akkuma Waaqayyo karaa Museetiin ajaje sana harka ofii isaa isa irra kaaʼee isa muude.
english: He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as the LORD spoke by Moses.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Ajaja kana Israaʼelootaaf kenni; akkanas jedhiin: ‘Aarsaa nyaataa kan ibiddaan anaaf dhiʼeeffamu kan fooliin isaa natti tolu sana yeroo murtaaʼetti naa dhiʼeessuu keessan mirkaneeffadhaa.’
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘See that you present my offering, my food for my offerings made by fire, as a pleasant aroma to me, in their due season.’

kikuyu: Akkana isaaniin jedhi; ‘Aarsaan isin ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessitan isa kana: xobbaallaawwan hoolaa lama kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokkootii fi kanneen hirʼina hin qabne aarsaa gubamu kan yeroo hunda guyyuma guyyaan dhiʼeeffamu godhaa dhiʼeessaa.
english: You shall tell them, ‘This is the offering made by fire which you shall offer to the LORD: male lambs a year old without defect, two day by day, for a continual burnt offering.

kikuyu: Xobbaallaa hoolaa tokko ganama, kaan immoo galgala dhiʼeessi.
english: You shall offer the one lamb in the morning, and you shall offer the other lamb at evening,

kikuyu: Kana wajjinis kennaa midhaanii kan daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessaa harki tokko zayitii ejersaa kan cuunfamee iinii tokko harka afur keessaa harka tokkoon sukkuumame dhiʼeessi.
english: with one tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering, mixed with the fourth part of a hin of beaten oil.

kikuyu: Kunis aarsaa yeroo hunda gubamu kan fooliin isaa toluu fi kan ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu kan Tulluu Siinaa irratti ajajamee dha.
english: It is a continual burnt offering which was ordained in Mount Sinai for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Dhibaayyuun tokkoo tokkoo xobbaallaa hoolaa wajjin dhiʼeeffamus dhugaatii cimaa iinii tokko irraa harka afur keessaa harka tokko haa taʼu; dhibaayyuu sanas iddoo qulqulluu keessatti Waaqayyoof dhangalaasi.
english: Its drink offering shall be the fourth part of a hin for each lamb. You shall pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD in the holy place.

kikuyu: Xobbaallaa hoolaa kaan immoo akkuma kennaa midhaaniitii fi kan dhibaayyuu wajjin ganama dhiʼeessite sanaa galgalas dhiʼeessi. Kunis aarsaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamu kan fooliin isaa Waaqayyotti toluu dha.
english: The other lamb you shall offer at evening. As the meal offering of the morning, and as its drink offering, you shall offer it, an offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Guyyaa Sanbataa xobbaallaawwan hoolaa lama kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko taʼee fi hirʼina hin qabne aarsaa dhibaayyuutii fi kennaa midhaanii akkasumas kennaa midhaanii kan daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessaa harki lama zayitiidhaan sukkuumame wajjin dhiʼeessi.
english: “‘On the Sabbath day, you shall offer two male lambs a year old without defect, and two tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, and its drink offering:

kikuyu: Kunis aarsaa gubamu kan aarsaa yeroo hunda gubamuu fi dhibaayyuu isaatti dabalamee Sanbata Sanbataan dhiʼeeffamuu dha.
english: this is the burnt offering of every Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Jalqaba jiʼoota keessanii hundatti jiboota loonii lama, korbeessa hoolaa tokko, xobbaallaawwan hoolaa torba kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko taʼee fi kanneen hirʼina hin qabne aarsaa gubamu godhaatii Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessaa.
english: “‘In the beginnings of your months, you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect,

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo jiboota loonii wajjin kennaa midhaanii kan daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii tokkoo irraa harka kudhan keessaa harki sadii zayitiidhaan sukkuumame, korbeessa hoolaa sana wajjinis kennaa midhaanii kan daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii tokkoo irraa harka kudhan keessaa harki lama zayitiidhaan sukkuumame dhiʼeeffamuu qaba;
english: and three tenths of an ephah of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth parts of fine flour for a meal offering mixed with oil, for the one ram;

kikuyu: tokkoo tokkoo xobbaallaa hoolaa wajjinis kennaan midhaanii kan daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii tokkoo irraa harka kudhan keessaa harki tokko zayitiidhaan sukkuumame dhiʼeeffamuu qaba. Kunis aarsaa gubamu kan ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamuu fi fooliin isaa toluu dha.
english: and one tenth part of fine flour mixed with oil for a meal offering to every lamb, as a burnt offering of a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo dibicha loonii wajjin dhibaayyuu daadhii wayinii iinii tokkoo irraa walakkaa isaa, tokkoo tokkoo xobbaallaa hoolaa wajjin iinii tokko irraa harka sadii keessaa harka tokko, korbeessa hoolaa sana wajjinis iinii tokko irraa harka afur keessaa harki tokko haa dhiʼeeffamu. Kunis aarsaa gubamu kan waggaa keessatti baatii haaraatti dhiʼeeffamuu dha.
english: Their drink offerings shall be half a hin of wine for a bull, the third part of a hin for the ram, and the fourth part of a hin for a lamb. This is the burnt offering of every month throughout the months of the year.

kikuyu: Akkasumas aarsaa cubbuutiif korbeessa reʼee tokko Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessaa; innis aarsaa yeroo hunda gubamuu fi dhibaayyuu isaatti dabalamee dhiʼeeffama.
english: Also, one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bultii kudha afuraffaa jiʼa jalqabaatti Faasiikaan Waaqayyoo ayyaaneffamuu qaba.
english: “‘In the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the LORD’s Passover.

kikuyu: Bultii kudha shanaffaa jiʼa kanaatti ayyaanatu jira; isinis guyyaa torba Maxinoo nyaattu.
english: On the fifteenth day of this month shall be a feast. Unleavened bread shall be eaten for seven days.

kikuyu: Guyyaa jalqabaatti wal gaʼii qulqulluu qabaadhaa; hojii idilees hin hojjetinaa.
english: In the first day shall be a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work,

kikuyu: Jiboota loonii lama, korbeessa hoolaa tokko, xobbaallaawwan hoolaa torba kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼee fi kanneen hundi isaanii hirʼina hin qabne aarsaa gubamu godhaatii ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessaa.
english: but you shall offer an offering made by fire, a burnt offering to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old. They shall be without defect,

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo dibicha loonii wajjinis kennaa midhaanii kan daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii tokkoo irraa harka kudhan keessaa harki sadii zayitiidhaan sukkuumame, korbeessa hoolaa wajjin iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessaa harka lama,
english: with their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil. You shall offer three tenths for a bull, and two tenths for the ram.

kikuyu: xobbaallaawwan hoolaa torban wajjin tokkoo tokkoo xobbaallaa hoolaatiif iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessaa harka tokko dhiʼeessi.
english: You shall offer one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Akkasumas akka araarri isinii buʼuuf korbeessa reʼee tokko aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeessi.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.

kikuyu: Kanas aarsaa gubamu kan yeroo hunda ganama ganama dhiʼeeffamutti dabalaatii dhiʼeessaa.
english: You shall offer these in addition to the burnt offering of the morning, which is for a continual burnt offering.

kikuyu: Haaluma kanaan nyaata aarsaa ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamuu kan fooliin isaa Waaqayyotti tolu sana bultii torbaaf guyyuma guyyaan dhiʼeessaa; innis aarsaa gubamuu fi dhibaayyuu isaa kan yeroo hunda dhiʼeeffamutti dabalamee haa dhiʼeeffamu.
english: In this way you shall offer daily, for seven days, the food of the offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD. It shall be offered in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.

kikuyu: Bultii torbaffaatti wal gaʼii qulqulluu qabaadhaa; hojii idilees hin hojjetinaa.
english: On the seventh day you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ayyaana Torbanootaa keessa guyyaa ayyaana mataa midhaaniitti yeroo kennaa midhaan haaraa Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessitan sana wal gaʼii qulqulluu godhadhaa; hojii idilees hin hojjetinaa.
english: “‘Also in the day of the first fruits, when you offer a new meal offering to the LORD in your feast of weeks, you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work;

kikuyu: Jiboota loonii lama, korbeessa hoolaa tokkoo fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa torba kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼe aarsaa gubamu kan fooliin isaa Waaqayyotti tolu dhiʼeessaa.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: two young bulls, one ram, seven male lambs a year old;

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo dibicha loonii wajjinis kennaan midhaanii kan daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii tokkoo irraa harka kudhan keessaa harki sadii zayitiidhaan sukkuumame haa dhiʼeeffamu. Korbeessa hoolaa wajjin iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessaa harki lama,
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil, three tenths for each bull, two tenths for the one ram,

kikuyu: Xobbaallaawwan hoolaa torban sana wajjinis iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessaa harki tokko haa dhiʼeeffamu.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Akkasumas akka araarri isinii buʼuuf korbeessa reʼee tokko itti dabalaa dhiʼeessaa.
english: and one male goat, to make atonement for you.

kikuyu: Aarsaawwan kanneen dhibaayyuu isaanii wajjin, aarsaa gubamu kan yeroo hunda dhiʼeeffamuu fi kennaa midhaan isaatti dabalaatii dhiʼeessaa; horiin sunis kan hirʼina hin qabne taʼuu isaanii mirkaneeffadhaa.
english: Besides the continual burnt offering and its meal offering, you shall offer them and their drink offerings. See that they are without defect.

kikuyu: “ ‘Guyyaa jalqaba jiʼa torbaffaatti wal gaʼii qulqulluu godhadhaa; gaafas hojii idilee hin hojjetinaa. Guyyaan kun guyyaa isin itti malakata afuuftanii dha.
english: “‘In the seventh month, on the first day of the month, you shall have a holy convocation; you shall do no regular work. It is a day of blowing of trumpets to you.

kikuyu: Dibicha loonii tokko, korbeessa hoolaa tokkoo fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa torba kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼee fi kanneen hundi isaanii hirʼina hin qabne aarsaa gubamu kan fooliin isaa Waaqayyotti tolu dhiʼeessaa.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering for a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Dibicha sana wajjinis kennaa midhaanii kan daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii tokkoo irraa harka kudhan keessaa harka sadii zayitiidhaan sukkuumame dhiʼeessaa. Korbeessa hoolaa wajjinis iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessaa harka lama,
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the ram,

kikuyu: xobbaallaawwan hoolaa torban sana wajjinis iifii tokko harka kudhan keessaa harka tokko dhiʼeessaa.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Akkasumas akka araarri isinii buufamuuf korbeessa reʼee tokko itti dabalaatii aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeessaa.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you;

kikuyu: Aarsaawwan kunneen akkuma amala isaaniitti aarsaawwan gubaman kanneen jiʼa jiʼattii fi guyyaa guyyaatti dhiʼeeffamanii fi kennaawwan midhaaniittii fi dhibaayyuu isaaniitti dabalamanii dhiʼeeffamanii dha. Isaanis aarsaawwan ibiddaan Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffaman kanneen fooliin isaanii toluu dha.
english: in addition to the burnt offering of the new moon with its meal offering, and the continual burnt offering with its meal offering, and their drink offerings, according to their ordinance, for a pleasant aroma, an offering made by fire to the LORD.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bultii kurnaffaa jiʼa torbaffaa kanaatti wal gaʼii qulqulluu godhadhaa; isinis gad of deebisaa; hojii tokko illees hin hojjetinaa.
english: “‘On the tenth day of this seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall afflict your souls. You shall do no kind of work;

kikuyu: Dibicha loonii tokko, korbeessa hoolaa tokkoo fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa torba kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼe kanneen hundi isaanii hirʼina hin qabne aarsaa gubamu kan fooliin isaa Waaqayyotti tolu godhaa dhiʼeessaa.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering to the LORD for a pleasant aroma: one young bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old, all without defect;

kikuyu: Dibicha sana wajjinis kennaa midhaanii kan daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessaa harki sadii zayitiidhaan sukkuumamee dhiʼeessaa; korbeessa hoolaa wajjinis iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessaa harka lama,
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for the bull, two tenths for the one ram,

kikuyu: xobbaallaawwan hoolaa torban sana wajjinis iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessa harka tokko dhiʼeessaa.
english: one tenth for every lamb of the seven lambs;

kikuyu: Akkasumas aarsaa cubbuu kan araaraa buusuuf dhiʼeeffamuu fi aarsaa gubamu kan yeroo hunda dhiʼeeffamu, kennaa midhaan isaatii fi dhibaayyuu isaatti dabalaatii korbeessa reʼee tokko aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeessaa.
english: one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and their drink offerings.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bultii kudha shanaffaa jiʼa torbaffaatti wal gaʼii qulqulluu godhadhaa; hojii idilee hin hojjetinaa. Waaqayyoofis bultii torba ayyaana ayyaaneffadhaa.
english: “‘On the fifteenth day of the seventh month you shall have a holy convocation. You shall do no regular work. You shall keep a feast to the LORD seven days.

kikuyu: Jiboota loonii kudha sadii, korbeeyyii hoolaa lamaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa kudha afur kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼee fi kanneen hundi isaanii hirʼina hin qabne aarsaa gubamu kan fooliin isaa Waaqayyotti toluu fi kan ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamu dhiʼeessaa.
english: You shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, of a pleasant aroma to the LORD: thirteen young bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old, all without defect;

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo jiboota kudha sadanii wajjinis kennaa midhaanii kan daakuu bullaaʼaa iifii tokkoo irraa harka kudhan keessaa harki sadii zayitiidhaan sukkuumame dhiʼeessaa; tokkoo tokkoo korbeeyyii hoolaa lamaan sanaa wajjinis iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessaa harka lama,
english: and their meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil: three tenths for every bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenths for each ram of the two rams,

kikuyu: tokkoo tokkoo xobbaallaawwan hoolaa kudha afran sanaa wajjinis iifii tokko irraa harka kudhan keessaa harka tokko dhiʼeessaa.
english: and one tenth for every lamb of the fourteen lambs;

kikuyu: Akkasumas aarsaa gubamu kan yeroo hunda dhiʼeeffamu kennaa midhaan isaattii fi dhibaayyuu isaatti dabalaatii korbeessa reʼee tokko aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeessaa.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bultii lammaffaatti jiboota loonii kudha lama, korbeeyyii hoolaa lamaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa kudha afur kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼee fi kanneen hundi isaanii hirʼina hin qabne dhiʼeessaa.
english: “‘On the second day you shall offer twelve young bulls, two rams, and fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Akka lakkoobsa murtaaʼeettii fi akkuma amala isaaniitti jiboota loonii, korbeeyyii hoolaatii fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa sana wajjin kennaa midhaan isaaniitii fi dhibaayyuu isaanii dhiʼeessaa.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

kikuyu: Akkasumas aarsaa gubamu kan yeroo hunda dhiʼeeffamu, kennaa midhaan isaattii fi dhibaayyuu isaaniitti dabalaatii korbeessa reʼee tokko aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeessaa.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering and their drink offerings.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bultii sadaffaatti jiboota loonii kudha tokko, korbeeyyii hoolaa lamaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa kudha afur kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼee fi kanneen hundi isaanii hirʼina hin qabne dhiʼeessaa.
english: “‘On the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Akka lakkoobsa murtaaʼeettii fi akkuma amala isaaniitti jiboota loonii, korbeeyyii hoolaa sanaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa sana wajjinis kennaa midhaan isaaniitii fi dhibaayyuu isaanii dhiʼeessaa.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

kikuyu: Akkasumas aarsaa gubamu kan yeroo hunda dhiʼeeffamu, kennaa midhaan isaatii fi dhibaayyuu isaatti dabalaatii korbeessa reʼee tokko aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeessaa.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bultii afuraffaatti jiboota loonii kudhan, korbeeyyii hoolaa lamaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa kudha afur kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼee fi kanneen hundi isaanii hirʼina hin qabne dhiʼeessaa.
english: “‘On the fourth day ten bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Akka lakkoobsa murtaaʼeettii fi akkuma amala isaaniitti jiboota loonii, korbeeyyii hoolaa sanaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa sana wajjin kennaa midhaan isaaniitii fi dhibaayyuu isaanii dhiʼeessaa.
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance;

kikuyu: Akkasumas aarsaa gubamu kan yeroo hunda dhiʼeeffamu, kennaa midhaan isaattii fi dhibaayyuu isaatti dabalaatii korbeessa reʼee tokko aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeessaa.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bultii shanaffaatti jiboota loonii sagal, korbeeyyii hoolaa lamaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa kudha afur kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼee fi kanneen hundi isaanii hirʼina hin qabne dhiʼeessaa.
english: “‘On the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Akka lakkoobsa murtaaʼeettii fi akkuma amala isaaniitti jiboota loonii, korbeeyyii hoolaa sanaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa sana wajjin kennaa midhaan isaaniitii fi dhibaayyuu isaanii dhiʼeessaa.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Akkasumas aarsaa gubamu kan yeroo hunda dhiʼeeffamu, kennaa midhaan isaatii fi dhibaayyuu isaatti dabalaatii korbeessa reʼee tokko aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeessaa.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, and its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bultii jaʼaffaatti jiboota loonii saddeeti, korbeeyyii hoolaa lamaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa kudha afur kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼee fi kanneen hundi isaanii hirʼina hin qabne dhiʼeessaa.
english: “‘On the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Akka lakkoobsa murtaaʼeettii fi akkuma amala isaaniitti jiboota loonii, korbeeyyii hoolaa sanaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa sana wajjin kennaa midhaan isaaniitii fi dhibaayyuu isaanii dhiʼeessaa.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Akkasumas aarsaa gubamu kan yeroo hunda dhiʼeeffamu, kennaa midhaan isaatii fi dhibaayyuu isaatti dabalaatii korbeessa reʼee tokko aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeessaa.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and the drink offerings of it.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bultii torbaffaatti jiboota loonii torba, korbeeyyii hoolaa lamaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa kudha afur kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼee fi kanneen hundi isaanii hirʼina hin qabne dhiʼeessaa.
english: “‘On the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Akka lakkoobsa murtaaʼeettii fi akkuma amala isaaniitti jiboota loonii, korbeeyyii hoolaa sanaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa sana wajjin kennaa midhaaniitii fi dhibaayyuu isaanii dhiʼeessaa.
english: and their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Akkasumas aarsaa gubamu kan yeroo hunda dhiʼeeffamu, kennaa midhaan isaatii fi dhibaayyuu isaatti dabalaatii korbeessa reʼee tokko aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeessaa.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering; in addition to the continual burnt offering, its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Bultii saddeettaffaatti wal gaʼii qulqulluu godhadhaa; hojii idilee hin hojjetinaa.
english: “‘On the eighth day you shall have a solemn assembly. You shall do no regular work;

kikuyu: Dibicha loonii tokko, korbeessa hoolaa tokkoo fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa torba kanneen umuriin isaanii waggaa tokko tokko taʼee fi kanneen hundi isaanii hirʼina hin qabne aarsaa gubamu kan ibiddaan dhiʼeeffamuu fi kan fooliin isaa Waaqayyotti tolu dhiʼeessaa.
english: but you shall offer a burnt offering, an offering made by fire, a pleasant aroma to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven male lambs a year old without defect;

kikuyu: Akka lakkoobsa murtaaʼeettii fi akkuma amala isaaniitti dibicha loonii, korbeessa hoolaa sanaa fi xobbaallaawwan hoolaa sana wajjin kennaa midhaan isaaniitii fi dhibaayyuu isaanii dhiʼeessaa.
english: their meal offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, shall be according to their number, after the ordinance,

kikuyu: Akkasumas aarsaa gubamu kan yeroo hunda dhiʼeeffamu, kennaa midhaan isaatii fi dhibaayyuu isaatti dabalaatii korbeessa reʼee tokko aarsaa cubbuutiif dhiʼeessaa.
english: and one male goat for a sin offering, in addition to the continual burnt offering, with its meal offering, and its drink offering.

kikuyu: “ ‘Aarsaa keessan kan gubamu, kennaa midhaan keessanii, dhibaayyuu keessanii fi aarsaa keessan kan nagaa, kan wareega keessaniitii fi aarsaa fedhii keessaniin dhiʼeessitanitti dabalaatii ayyaana keessan beekamaa sana irratti Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessaa.’ ”
english: “‘You shall offer these to the LORD in your set feasts—in addition to your vows and your free will offerings—for your burnt offerings, your meal offerings, your drink offerings, and your peace offerings.’”

kikuyu: Museenis waan Waaqayyo isa ajaje hunda Israaʼelootatti hime.
english: Moses told the children of Israel according to all that the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Museen abbootii gosoota Israaʼeliin akkana jedhe: “Wanni Waaqayyo ajaje kanaa dha:
english: Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the children of Israel, saying, “This is the thing which the LORD has commanded.

kikuyu: Namni tokko yoo Waaqayyoof waa wareege yookaan akka waan tokko hojjetu ofumaa isaatiin yoo kakate, inni kakuu ofii sana hin cabsin; qooda kanaa waan dubbate hunda guutuu qaba.
english: When a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind his soul with a bond, he shall not break his word. He shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.

kikuyu: “Yoo intalli tokko utuma mana abbaa ishee jirtuu Waaqayyoof wareega wareegde yookaan waan tokko gochuudhaaf dirqama keessa seente,
english: “Also, when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds herself by a pledge, being in her father’s house, in her youth,

kikuyu: yoo abbaan ishees waaʼee wareega ishee yookaan dirqama keessa seenuu ishee dhagaʼee homaa isheen jechuu baate wareegni isheettii fi dirqamni isheen seente sun hundi hin geeddaramu.
english: and her father hears her vow and her pledge with which she has bound her soul, and her father says nothing to her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

kikuyu: Yoo abbaan ishee waan kana dhagaʼee ishee dhowwe garuu wareega ishee yookaan kakuu isheen ittiin dirqama seente keessaa tokko iyyuu hin guutamu; sababii abbaan ishee ishee dhowweef Waaqayyo ishee ni bilisoomsa.
english: But if her father forbids her in the day that he hears, none of her vows or of her pledges with which she has bound her soul, shall stand. The LORD will forgive her, because her father has forbidden her.

kikuyu: “Yoo isheen erga wareega seentee booddee yookaan erga dubbii utuu itti hin yaadin dubbatteen dirqama seentee booddee heerumte,
english: “If she has a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips with which she has bound her soul,

kikuyu: dhirsi ishees yoo waan kana dhagaʼee homaa isheen jechuu baate wareegni ishee yookaan dirqamni isheen seente sun hin geeddaramu.
english: and her husband hears it, and says nothing to her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her pledges with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

kikuyu: Garuu dhirsi ishee yoo yeroo waan kana dhagaʼutti ishee dhowwe, wareega ishee kan dirqama keessa ishee galchu yookaan waadaa isheen utuu itti hin yaadin dirqama keessa of galchite sana ishee jalaa diiga; Waaqayyos ishee bilisoomsa.
english: But if her husband forbids her in the day that he hears it, then he makes void her vow which is on her and the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul. The LORD will forgive her.

kikuyu: “Wareegni haadha hiyyeessaa yookaan dubartii dhirsa jalaa baatee, dirqamni isheen seente kam iyyuu ishee qabata.
english: “But the vow of a widow, or of her who is divorced, everything with which she has bound her soul shall stand against her.

kikuyu: “Yoo dubartiin dhirsa ishee wajjin jiraattu tokko wareega tokko wareegdee yookaan waan tokko gochuudhaaf kakuudhaan dirqama keessa of galchite,
english: “If she vowed in her husband’s house or bound her soul by a bond with an oath,

kikuyu: dhirsi ishees yoo waan kana dhagaʼee homaa isheedhaan jechuu baate yookaan yoo ishee dhowwuu baate wareegni ishee yookaan waadaan isheen ittiin dirqama keessa of galchite sun hundi hin geeddaramu.
english: and her husband heard it, and held his peace at her and didn’t disallow her, then all her vows shall stand, and every pledge with which she bound her soul shall stand.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo dhirsi ishee yeroo waan kana dhagaʼutti ishee jalaa diige, wareega ishee yookaan waadaa afaan isheetii baʼe keessaa tokko iyyuu hojii irra hin oolu; sababii dhirsi ishee ishee jalaa diigeef, Waaqayyo ishee bilisoomsa.
english: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand. Her husband has made them void. The LORD will forgive her.

kikuyu: Dhirsi ishee wareega isheen wareegdu yookaan waadaa isheen gad of qabuuf kakuudhaan seentu kam iyyuu fudhachuu yookaan diiguu ni dandaʼa.
english: Every vow, and every binding oath to afflict the soul, her husband may establish it, or her husband may make it void.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo dhirsi ishee guyyuma guyyaan homaa isheen jechuu baate, inni wareega ishee yookaan dirqama ishee irra jiru hunda fudhateera jechuu dha. Inni sababii gaafa waaʼee waan kanaa dhagaʼe sana homaa isheedhaan hin jedhiniif waan sana fudhateera.
english: But if her husband says nothing to her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows or all her pledges which are on her. He has established them, because he said nothing to her in the day that he heard them.

kikuyu: Taʼus inni yoo erga waaʼee waan kanaa dhagaʼee booddee waadaa sana diige yakka isheetti ni gaafatama.”
english: But if he makes them null and void after he has heard them, then he shall bear her iniquity.”

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen seerawwan dhirsaa fi niitii gidduu akkasumas abbaa fi intala isaa kan yeroo ijoollummaa isheetti mana isaa jirtu gidduu jiraachuu qabu kan Waaqayyo Musee ajajee dha.
english: These are the statutes which the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter, being in her youth, in her father’s house.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Saba Israaʼeliif jedhiitii warra Midiyaan irratti haaloo baʼi. Ergasii ati gara saba keetiitti walitti qabamta.”
english: “Avenge the children of Israel on the Midianites. Afterward you shall be gathered to your people.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Museen saba sanaan akkana jedhe; “Akka isaan warra Midiyaanitti duulanii haaloo Waaqayyoo isaan irratti baʼaniif namoota keessan keessaa muraasa hidhachiisaa.
english: Moses spoke to the people, saying, “Arm men from among you for war, that they may go against Midian, to execute the LORD’s vengeance on Midian.

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo gosa Israaʼel keessaa nama kuma tokko tokkoo duulatti ergaa.”
english: You shall send one thousand out of every tribe, throughout all the tribes of Israel, to the war.”

kikuyu: Akkasitti tokkoo tokkoo gosa Israaʼel keessaa namoonni kumni tokko tokko walitti buufamanii namni kumni kudha lama lolaaf hidhate.
english: So there were delivered, out of the thousands of Israel, a thousand from every tribe, twelve thousand armed for war.

kikuyu: Museenis tokkoo tokkoo gosaa keessaa nama kuma tokko tokko Fiinehaas ilma Eleʼaazaar lubichaa isa miʼa iddoo qulqulluutii fi malakata afuufamu harkatti qabate sana wajjin gara waraanaatti erge.
english: Moses sent them, one thousand of every tribe, to the war with Phinehas the son of Eleazar the priest, to the war, with the vessels of the sanctuary and the trumpets for the alarm in his hand.

kikuyu: Isaanis akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajaje sanatti warra Midiyaan lolanii dhiira hunda ajjeesan.
english: They fought against Midian, as the LORD commanded Moses. They killed every male.

kikuyu: Mootonni Midiyaan shanan jechuunis Eewii, Reqem, Zuuri, Huurii fi Rebaanis warra ajjeefaman keessa turan. Akkasumas Balaʼaam ilma Beʼoor goraadeedhaan ajjeesan.
english: They killed the kings of Midian with the rest of their slain: Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian. They also killed Balaam the son of Beor with the sword.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni dubartootaa fi ijoollee warra Midiyaan boojiʼan; loon, bushaayee fi qabeenya isaanii hundas ni saaman.
english: The children of Israel took the women of Midian captive with their little ones; and all their livestock, all their flocks, and all their goods, they took as plunder.

kikuyu: Magaalaawwan Midiyaanonni keessa jiraatan hundaa fi qubatawwan isaanii hunda ibiddaan guban.
english: All their cities in the places in which they lived, and all their encampments, they burned with fire.

kikuyu: Isaanis waan boojiʼanii fi waan saaman hunda namaa fi horii illee fuudhanii
english: They took all the captives, and all the plunder, both of man and of animal.

kikuyu: warra boojiʼan, waan qabatanii fi waan saaman gara iddoo qubata isaanii kan fuula Yerikoo dura, Yordaanos cina, dirreewwan Moʼaab keessa jiruutti gara Museetti, gara Eleʼaazaar lubichaatii fi gara waldaa Israaʼelitti fidan.
english: They brought the captives with the prey and the plunder, to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the congregation of the children of Israel, to the camp at the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Museen, Eleʼaazaar lubichii fi hooggantoonni waldaa hundi qubataan alatti isaan simachuuf gad baʼan.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest, with all the princes of the congregation, went out to meet them outside of the camp.

kikuyu: Museenis ajajjuuwwan loltootaa jechuunis ajajjuuwwan kumaatii fi ajajjuuwwan dhibbaa kanneen lolaa galanitti aare.
english: Moses was angry with the officers of the army, the captains of thousands and the captains of hundreds, who came from the service of the war.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee isaan gaafate; “Isin maaliif dubartoota hunda hambiftan?
english: Moses said to them, “Have you saved all the women alive?

kikuyu: Kunoo warri waan Pheʼooritti taʼe sana keessatti gorsa Balaʼaam fudhachuudhaan akka dhaʼichi saba Waaqayyoo irra buʼuuf Israaʼeloota Waaqayyo irraa deebisan isaan turan.
english: Behold, these caused the children of Israel, through the counsel of Balaam, to commit trespass against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and so the plague was among the congregation of the LORD.

kikuyu: Ammas ilmaan dhiiraa hunda fixaa; akkasumas dubartii dhiira wajjin ciifte hunda ajjeesaa.
english: Now therefore kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known man by lying with him.

kikuyu: Garuu dubara takkumaa dhiira wajjin hin ciisin ofii keessaniif hambifadhaa.
english: But all the girls, who have not known man by lying with him, keep alive for yourselves.

kikuyu: “Isin keessaa namni nama ajjeese kam iyyuu yookaan namni nama ajjeefame tuqe kam iyyuu bultii torba qubataan ala haa turu. Bultii sadaffaa fi bultii torbaffaattis ofii keessanii fi boojuu keessan qulqulleessaa.
english: “Encamp outside of the camp for seven days. Whoever has killed any person, and whoever has touched any slain, purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.

kikuyu: Uffata hunda akkasumas waan gogaa irraa, rifeensa reʼee irraa yookaan muka irraa hojjetame hunda qulqulleessaa.”
english: You shall purify every garment, and all that is made of skin, and all work of goats’ hair, and all things made of wood.”

kikuyu: Ergasiis Eleʼaazaar lubichi loltoota duula dhaqanii turan sanaan akkana jedhe; “Qajeelfamni seeraa kan Waaqayyo Museef kenne kanaa dha:
english: Eleazar the priest said to the men of war who went to the battle, “This is the statute of the law which the LORD has commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Warqee, meetii, naasii, sibiila, qorqorroo, dilaalii fi
english: However the gold, and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead,

kikuyu: wanni ibidda irraa hafuu dandaʼu kam iyyuu ibidda keessa dabarfamee qulqullaaʼuu qaba. Garuu wanni sun bishaan qulqullaaʼummaatiinis qulqulleeffamuu qaba. Wanni ibidda irra hafuu hin dandeenye kam iyyuu bishaan sanaan qulqulleeffama.
english: everything that may withstand the fire, you shall make to go through the fire, and it shall be clean; nevertheless it shall be purified with the water for impurity. All that doesn’t withstand the fire you shall make to go through the water.

kikuyu: Guyyaa torbaffaatti uffata keessan miiccadhaa; isinis ni qulqulleeffamtu. Ergasii qubatatti galuu dandeessu.”
english: You shall wash your clothes on the seventh day, and you shall be clean. Afterward you shall come into the camp.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Ati, Eleʼaazaar lubichii fi abbootiin maatii waldaa sanaa namootaa fi horii boojiʼaman lakkaaʼaa.
english: “Count the plunder that was taken, both of man and of animal, you, and Eleazar the priest, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the congregation;

kikuyu: Boojuu sanas loltoota duula dhaqanii turanii fi waldaa hunda gidduutti iddoo lamatti qoodi.
english: and divide the plunder into two parts: between the men skilled in war, who went out to battle, and all the congregation.

kikuyu: Loltoota duulan irraa namas taʼu loon, harroota, hoolota yookaan reʼoota dhibba shan keessaa tokko Waaqayyoof gibira fuudhi.
english: Levy a tribute to the LORD of the men of war who went out to battle: one soul of five hundred; of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks.

kikuyu: Gibira sanas walakkaa qooda isaanii irraa fuudhii qooda Waaqayyoo godhiitii Eleʼaazaar lubichatti kenni.
english: Take it from their half, and give it to Eleazar the priest, for the LORD’s wave offering.

kikuyu: Walakkaa qooda saba Israaʼel irraa immoo namas taʼu loon, harroota, hoolota, reʼoota yookaan horii biraa shantama keessaa tokko fuudhiitii Lewwota warra itti gaafatamtoota dunkaana Waaqayyoo taʼanitti kenni.”
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, you shall take one drawn out of every fifty, of the persons, of the cattle, of the donkeys, and of the flocks, of all the livestock, and give them to the Levites, who perform the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle.”

kikuyu: Musee fi Eleʼaazaar lubichi akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajaje sana godhan.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest did as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Wanti boojuu loltoonni fudhatan irraa hafe hoolota 675,000,
english: Now the plunder, over and above the booty which the men of war took, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
seventy-two thousand head of cattle,

kikuyu: harroota 61,000,
english: sixty-one thousand donkeys,

kikuyu: dubartoonni takkumaa dhiira wajjin hin ciisin 32,000 turan.
english: and thirty-two thousand persons in all, of the women who had not known man by lying with him.

kikuyu: Qoodni walakkaa kan warra duulaniif qoodame: Hoolota 337,500
english: The half, which was the portion of those who went out to war, was in number three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep;

kikuyu: keessaa gibirri Waaqayyoo 675 ture;
english: and the LORD’s tribute of the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.

kikuyu: loon 36,000 keessaa gibirri Waaqayyoo 72 ture;
english: The cattle were thirty-six thousand, of which the LORD’s tribute was seventy-two.

kikuyu: harroota 30,500 keessaa gibirri Waaqayyoo 61 ture;
english: The donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, of which the LORD’s tribute was sixty-one.

kikuyu: nama 16,000 keessaa gibirri Waaqayyoo 32 ture.
english: The persons were sixteen thousand, of whom the LORD’s tribute was thirty-two persons.

kikuyu: Museen akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajaje sanatti gibira sana qooda Waaqayyoo godhee Eleʼaazaar lubichatti kenne.
english: Moses gave the tribute, which was the LORD’s wave offering, to Eleazar the priest, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Qooda walakkaa kan Museen warra duulan irraa Israaʼelootaaf qoode:
english: Of the children of Israel’s half, which Moses divided off from the men who fought

kikuyu: Walakkaan boojuu kan waldaa sanaa hoolota 337,500,
english: (now the congregation’s half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep,
thirty-six thousand head of cattle,

kikuyu: harroota 30,500,
english: thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,

kikuyu: nama 16,000 ture.
english: and sixteen thousand persons),

kikuyu: Museen akkuma Waaqayyo isa ajaje sanatti walakkaa saba Israaʼel irraa namaa fi horii shantama keessaa tokko fuudhee Lewwota warra itti gaafatamtoota dunkaana Waaqayyoo taʼanitti kenne.
english: even of the children of Israel’s half, Moses took one drawn out of every fifty, both of man and of animal, and gave them to the Levites, who performed the duty of the LORD’s tabernacle, as the LORD commanded Moses.

kikuyu: Ergasiis ajajjuuwwan loltoota kumaatama irratti aangoo qaban jechuunis ajajjuuwwan kumaatii fi ajajjuuwwan dhibbaa gara Musee dhaqanii
english: The officers who were over the thousands of the army, the captains of thousands, and the captains of hundreds, came near to Moses.

kikuyu: akkana jedhaniin; “Nu garboonni kee loltoota ajaja keenya jala jiran lakkoofneerra; namni tokko iyyuu hin hirʼanne.
english: They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not one man of us.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu waan tokkoon tokkoon keenya arganne jechuunis miʼa warqee, arboora, bitawoo, qubeelaa chaappaa, lootii fi amartii mormaa akka fuula Waaqayyoo duratti aarsaa araara nuu buusuuf kennaa Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamu goonee fidneerra.”
english: We have brought the LORD’s offering, what every man found: gold ornaments, armlets, bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and necklaces, to make atonement for our souls before the LORD.”

kikuyu: Musee fi Eleʼaazaar lubichis warqee fi faayawwan harkaan tolfaman hunda isaan harkaa fuudhan.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took their gold, even all worked jewels.

kikuyu: Warqeen ajajjuuwwan kumaatii fi ajajjuuwwan dhibbaa kennan kanneen Musee fi Eleʼaazaar akka kennaatti Waaqayyoof dhiʼeessan hundi saqilii 16,750 ulfaatu ture.
english: All the gold of the wave offering that they offered up to the LORD, of the captains of thousands, and of the captains of hundreds, was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon loltootaa ofii isaaniitiif boojuu fudhatanii turan.
english: The men of war had taken booty, every man for himself.

kikuyu: Musee fi Eleʼaazaar lubichis warqee sana ajajjuuwwan kumaatii fi ajajjuuwwan dhibbaa harkaa fuudhanii akka Israaʼeloonni fuula Waaqayyoo duratti ittiin yaadatamaniif dunkaana wal gaʼiitti ol galchan.
english: Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold of the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and brought it into the Tent of Meeting for a memorial for the children of Israel before the LORD.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Ruubeenii fi ilmaan Gaad warri loonii fi bushaayee hedduu qaban akka biyyi Yaʼizeerii fi biyyi Giliʼaad horii isaaniitiif tolu argan.
english: Now the children of Reuben and the children of Gad had a very great multitude of livestock. They saw the land of Jazer, and the land of Gilead. Behold, the place was a place for livestock.

kikuyu: Isaan gara Musee, gara Eleʼaazaar lubichaatii fi gara hooggantoota waldaa dhufanii akkana jedhan;
english: Then the children of Gad and the children of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, and to Eleazar the priest, and to the princes of the congregation, saying,

kikuyu: “Axaaroti, Diiboon, Yaʼizeer, Niimraa, Heshboon, Eleʼaalee, Sebaamaa, Neboo fi Beʼoon,
english: “Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,

kikuyu: biyyi Waaqayyo fuula waldaa Israaʼel duratti rukute sun horiif tolaa dha; nu tajaajiltoonni kees horii qabna.
english: the land which the LORD struck before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock; and your servants have livestock.”

kikuyu: Yoo nu fuula kee duratti fudhatama argannee jiraanne biyyi kun nu tajaajiltoota keetiif handhuuraa taʼee haa kennamu. Akka nu Yordaanos gama ceenus hin godhin.”
english: They said, “If we have found favor in your sight, let this land be given to your servants for a possession. Don’t bring us over the Jordan.”

kikuyu: Museenis ilmaan Gaadii fi ilmaan Ruubeeniin akkana jedhe; “Obboloonni keessan duula dhaqanii isin immoo as teessuu?
english: Moses said to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, “Shall your brothers go to war while you sit here?

kikuyu: Isin maaliif akka Israaʼeloonni biyya Waaqayyo isaanii kenne sanatti ceʼanii hin galleef abdii isaan kutachiiftuu?
english: Why do you discourage the heart of the children of Israel from going over into the land which the LORD has given them?

kikuyu: Kun waanuma abbootiin keessan gaafa ani akka isaan biyyattii ilaalaniif jedhee Qaadesh Barnee irraa isaan erge sana hojjetanii dha.
english: Your fathers did so when I sent them from Kadesh Barnea to see the land.

kikuyu: Isaanis erga gara Sulula Eshkool dhaqanii biyya sana arganii booddee akka Israaʼeloonni biyya Waaqayyo isaaniif kennetti hin galleef abdii isaan kutachiisan.
english: For when they went up to the valley of Eshcol, and saw the land, they discouraged the heart of the children of Israel, that they should not go into the land which the LORD had given them.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsi Waaqayyoos guyyuma sana bobaʼe; innis akkana jedhee kakate;
english: The LORD’s anger burned in that day, and he swore, saying,

kikuyu: ‘Waan isaan garaa guutuudhaan na faana deemuu didaniif, namoota waggaa digdamaatii fi hammasii olii kanneen biyya Gibxiitii baʼanii dhufan keessaa namni tokko iyyuu biyya ani Abrahaamiif, Yisihaaqii fi Yaaqoobiif waadaa gale sana hin argu.
english: ‘Surely none of the men who came up out of Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall see the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob; because they have not wholly followed me,

kikuyu: Kaaleb ilma Yefunee kan gosa Qeneezii fi Iyyaasuu ilma Nuuni malee namni tokko iyyuu hin argu; isaan lamaan garaa guutuudhaan Waaqayyo duukaa buʼaniiruutii.’
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite, and Joshua the son of Nun, because they have followed the LORD completely.’

kikuyu: Dheekkamsi Waaqayyoo Israaʼel irratti bobaʼe; innis hamma dhaloonni fuula isaa duratti waan hamaa hojjete sun hundi dhumutti akka isaan waggaa afurtama gammoojjii keessa jooran godhe.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation who had done evil in the LORD’s sight was consumed.

kikuyu: “Yaa sanyii cubbamootaa nana, isin kunoo dheekkamsa Waaqayyoo kan Israaʼel irratti bobaʼe sana ittuma caalchisuuf iddoo abbootii keessanii buutaniirtu.
english: “Behold, you have risen up in your fathers’ place, an increase of sinful men, to increase the fierce anger of the LORD toward Israel.

kikuyu: Yoo isin isa duukaa buʼuu irraa garagaltan inni ammas gammoojjii kana keessatti saba kana hunda ni dhiisa; isinis uummata kana ni balleessitu.”
english: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all these people.”

kikuyu: Isaan gara isaa dhufanii akkana jedhaniin; “Nu asitti horii keenyaaf dallaa, dubartootaa fi ijoollee keenyaaf immoo magaalaawwan ijaarra.
english: They came near to him, and said, “We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones;

kikuyu: Nu garuu hamma lafa isaaniitiin isaan geenyutti hidhannee Israaʼel dura deemuuf qophaaʼoo dha. Yeroo kanatti akka jiraattoonni biyyattii isaan hin tuqneef dubartoonnii fi ijoolleen keenya magaalaawwan dallaa jabaa qaban keessa haa jiraatan.
english: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place. Our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.

kikuyu: Hamma tokkoon tokkoon Israaʼelootaa dhaala ofii isaanii argatanitti nu mana keenyatti hin deebinu.
english: We will not return to our houses until the children of Israel have all received their inheritance.

kikuyu: Sababii dhaalli keenya laga Yordaanos irraa gara baʼaatti nuuf kennameef nu Yordaanos irraa gama kaaniin isaan wajjin waan dhaallu hin qabnu.”
english: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Jordan and beyond, because our inheritance has come to us on this side of the Jordan eastward.”

kikuyu: Museenis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Yoo isin waan kana gootan, yoo isin fuula Waaqayyoo duratti hidhattanii duulaaf kaatan,
english: Moses said to them: “If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before the LORD to the war,

kikuyu: yoo isin hundinuu hamma inni diinota ofii isaa fuula ofii isaa duraa ariʼee baasutti hidhattanii fuula Waaqayyoo dura Yordaanosin ceetan,
english: and every one of your armed men will pass over the Jordan before the LORD until he has driven out his enemies from before him,

kikuyu: yeroo biyyattiin fuula Waaqayyoo duratti moʼatamtutti isin itti gaafatama Waaqayyoo fi saba Israaʼeliif qabdan irraa ni bilisoomtu. Biyyi sunis fuula Waaqayyoo duratti dhaala keessan taʼa.
english: and the land is subdued before the LORD; then afterward you shall return, and be clear of obligation to the LORD and to Israel. Then this land shall be your possession before the LORD.

kikuyu: “Garuu isin yoo waan kana gochuu baattan, kunoo Waaqayyotti cubbuu hojjechuu keessan; akka cubbuun keessan isin argatu illee beekkadhaa.
english: “But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against the LORD; and be sure your sin will find you out.

kikuyu: Dubartootaa fi ijoollee keessaniif magaalaawwan, bushaayee keessaniif immoo dallaa ijaaraa; isin garuu waan waadaa galtan sana guutaa.”
english: Build cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.”

kikuyu: Ilmaan Gaadii fi ilmaan Ruubeen Museedhaan akkana jedhan; “Nu garboonni kee akkuma gooftaan keenya nu ajaju goona.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, “Your servants will do as my lord commands.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen keenyaa fi niitonni keenya, bushaayeen keenyaa fi loon keenya, asuma magaalaawwan Giliʼaaditti haa hafan.
english: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of Gilead;

kikuyu: Nu garboonni kee garuu tokkoon tokkoon keenya akkuma gooftaan keenya jedhe sana duulaaf qophoofnee fuula Waaqayyoo duratti duuluuf ni ceena.”
english: but your servants will pass over, every man who is armed for war, before the LORD to battle, as my lord says.”

kikuyu: Ergasiis Museen waaʼee isaanii Eleʼaazaar lubichaaf, Iyyaasuu ilma Nuunitii fi abbootii maatii gosoota Israaʼeliif ajaja kenne.
english: So Moses commanded concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Joshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers’ households of the tribes of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Yoo ilmaan Gaadii fi ilmaan Ruubeen, namni waraanaaf hidhate hundi fuula Waaqayyoo duratti isin wajjin Yordaanos ceʼe, yommuu biyyattiin isin harka galtutti biyya Giliʼaad sana kennaafii.
english: Moses said to them, “If the children of Gad and the children of Reuben will pass with you over the Jordan, every man who is armed to battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession;

kikuyu: Garuu isaan yoo duulaaf hidhatanii isin wajjin ceʼuu baatan, Kanaʼaan keessatti isin wajjin lafa haa argatan.”
english: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Canaan.”

kikuyu: Ilmaan Gaadii fi ilmaan Ruubeenis akkana jedhanii deebii kennan; “Nu garboonni kee waan Waaqayyo jedhe ni goona.
english: The children of Gad and the children of Reuben answered, saying, “As the LORD has said to your servants, so will we do.

kikuyu: Nu miʼa lolaa hidhannee fuula Waaqayyoo dura ceenee Kanaʼaan seenna; garuu qabeenyi nu dhaallu Yordaanosiin gamatti nuuf haa hafu.”
english: We will pass over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the Jordan.”

kikuyu: Museenis mootummaa Sihoon mootii Amoorotaa fi mootummaa Oogi mootii Baashaan jechuunis biyya sana guutuu magaalaawwan isaaniitii fi bulchiinsa naannoo isaanii jiru sana ilmaan Gaadiitiif, ilmaan Ruubeeniitii fi walakkaa gosa Minaasee ilma Yoosefiif kenne.
english: Moses gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuben, and to the half-tribe of Manasseh the son of Joseph, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan; the land, according to its cities and borders, even the cities of the surrounding land.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Gaadis magaalaawwan Diiboon, Axaaroti, Aroʼeer,
english: The children of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,

kikuyu: Atroot Shoofaan, Yaʼizeer, Yogbihaa,
english: Atroth-shophan, Jazer, Jogbehah,

kikuyu: Beet Niimraa fi Beet haaraan magaalaawwan jajjaboo godhanii ijaaran. Bushaayee isaaniitiifis dallaa ijaarratan.
english: Beth Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities and folds for sheep.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Ruubeenis magaalaawwan Heshboon, Eleʼaaleenii fi Kiriyaataayim,
english: The children of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,

kikuyu: akkasumas Neboo fi Baʼaal Meʼoon jechuunis magaalaawwan maqaan isaanii geeddaramee fi Sibimaa deebisanii ijaaran. Isaanis magaalaawwan deebisanii ijaaran sanaaf maqaa baasan.
english: Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah. They gave other names to the cities which they built.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen Maakiir ilma Minaasees gara Giliʼaad dhaqanii biyyattii qabatanii Amoorota achi turan ariʼanii baasan.
english: The children of Machir the son of Manasseh went to Gilead, took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.

kikuyu: Museenis Giliʼaadin ijoollee Maakiir sanyii Minaaseetiif kenne; isaanis achi qubatan.
english: Moses gave Gilead to Machir the son of Manasseh; and he lived therein.

kikuyu: Yaaʼiir ilmi Minaasees dhaqee gandoota isaanii fudhatee gandoota Yaaʼiirootaa jedhee moggaase.
english: Jair the son of Manasseh went and took its villages, and called them Havvoth Jair.

kikuyu: Noobaan immoo Qeenaatii fi gandoota naannoo isaa jiran qabatee Noobaa jedhee maqaa ofii isaatiin waame.
english: Nobah went and took Kenath and its villages, and called it Nobah, after his own name.

kikuyu: Sadarkaaleen adeemsa saba Israaʼel kan yeroo isaan kutaa kutaadhaan qajeelfama Museetii fi Aroon jalatti biyya Gibxii baʼanii kana.
english: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went out of the land of Egypt by their armies under the hand of Moses and Aaron.

kikuyu: Museen ajaja Waaqayyootiin sadarkaalee adeemsa isaanii galmeesse. Adeemsi isaaniis sadarkaa sadarkaadhaan kunoo ti:
english: Moses wrote the starting points of their journeys by the commandment of the LORD. These are their journeys according to their starting points.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni jiʼa jalqabaa keessa guyyaa kudha shanaffaatti guyyaa Faasiikaatti aanu Raamseedhaa kaʼanii qajeelan. Isaanis utuma warri Gibxii hundi isaan arganuu irree jabaadhaan deeman;
english: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover, the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,

kikuyu: yeroo kana warri Gibxi ilmaan hangafa isaanii kanneen Waaqayyo isaan gidduudhaa fixe hunda awwaallachaa turan; waaqota warra Gibxitti Waaqayyo muree tureetii.
english: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom the LORD had struck among them. The LORD also executed judgments on their gods.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonnis Raamseedhaa kaʼanii Sukooti qubatan.
english: The children of Israel traveled from Rameses, and encamped in Succoth.

kikuyu: Sukootii kaʼanii Eetaam ishee qarqara gammoojjiitti argamtu keessa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Succoth, and encamped in Etham, which is in the edge of the wilderness.

kikuyu: Eetaamii kaʼanii gara Phii Hahiiroti kan gama baʼa Baʼaal Zefooniitti argamtuutti garagalanii Migdool bira qubatan.
english: They traveled from Etham, and turned back to Pihahiroth, which is before Baal Zephon, and they encamped before Migdol.

kikuyu: Fiihahiirootii kaʼanii galaana keessa darbanii gammoojjii seenan; isaanis Gammoojjii Eetaamii keessa bultii sadii deemanii Maaraa qubatan.
english: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and crossed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness. They went three days’ journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.

kikuyu: Maaraadhaa kaʼanii Eelim lafa burqaa kudha lamaa fi muka meexxii torbaatama qabu sana dhaqanii achi qubatan.
english: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim. In Elim, there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they encamped there.

kikuyu: Eelimii kaʼanii Galaana Diimaa cina qubatan.
english: They traveled from Elim, and encamped by the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Galaana Diimaadhaa kaʼanii Gammoojjii Siin keessa qubatan.
english: They traveled from the Red Sea, and encamped in the wilderness of Sin.

kikuyu: Gammoojjii Siiniitii kaʼanii Dofqaa qubatan.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sin, and encamped in Dophkah.

kikuyu: Dofqaadhaa kaʼanii Aaluush qubatan.
english: They traveled from Dophkah, and encamped in Alush.

kikuyu: Aaluushii kaʼanii Refiidiim lafa bishaan namni dhugu hin jirre qubatan.
english: They traveled from Alush, and encamped in Rephidim, where there was no water for the people to drink.

kikuyu: Refiidiimii kaʼanii Gammoojjii Siinaa keessa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Rephidim, and encamped in the wilderness of Sinai.

kikuyu: Gammoojjii Siinaatii kaʼanii Qiibrooti Hataabaa qubatan.
english: They traveled from the wilderness of Sinai, and encamped in Kibroth Hattaavah.

kikuyu: Qiibrooti Hataabaadhaa kaʼanii Haxerooti qubatan.
english: They traveled from Kibroth Hattaavah, and encamped in Hazeroth.

kikuyu: Haxerootii kaʼanii Riitmaa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Hazeroth, and encamped in Rithmah.

kikuyu: Riitmaadhaa kaʼanii Rimoon Phereez qubatan.
english: They traveled from Rithmah, and encamped in Rimmon Perez.

kikuyu: Rimoon Phereezii kaʼanii Libnaa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Rimmon Perez, and encamped in Libnah.

kikuyu: Libnaadhaa kaʼanii Riisaa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Libnah, and encamped in Rissah.

kikuyu: Riisaadhaa kaʼanii Qehelaataa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Rissah, and encamped in Kehelathah.

kikuyu: Qehelaataadhaa kaʼanii Gaara Shaafer bira qubatan.
english: They traveled from Kehelathah, and encamped in Mount Shepher.

kikuyu: Gaara Shaafer biraa kaʼanii Haraadaa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Mount Shepher, and encamped in Haradah.

kikuyu: Haraadaa kaʼanii Maqiheelooti qubatan.
english: They traveled from Haradah, and encamped in Makheloth.

kikuyu: Maqiheelootii kaʼanii Tahaati qubatan.
english: They traveled from Makheloth, and encamped in Tahath.

kikuyu: Tahaatii kaʼanii Taaraa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Tahath, and encamped in Terah.

kikuyu: Taaraadhaa kaʼanii Miitiqaa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Terah, and encamped in Mithkah.

kikuyu: Miitiqaadhaa kaʼanii Hashmoonaa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Mithkah, and encamped in Hashmonah.

kikuyu: Hashmoonaadhaa kaʼanii Mooserooti qubatan.
english: They traveled from Hashmonah, and encamped in Moseroth.

kikuyu: Mooserootii kaʼanii Benee Yaaʼakaan qubatan.
english: They traveled from Moseroth, and encamped in Bene Jaakan.

kikuyu: Benee Yaaʼakaanii kaʼanii Hoori Hagidgaad qubatan.
english: They traveled from Bene Jaakan, and encamped in Hor Haggidgad.

kikuyu: Hoori Hagidgaadii kaʼanii Yoxbaataa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.

kikuyu: Yoxbaataadhaa kaʼanii Abroonaa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Jotbathah, and encamped in Abronah.

kikuyu: Abroonaadhaa kaʼanii Eziyoon Geber qubatan.
english: They traveled from Abronah, and encamped in Ezion Geber.

kikuyu: Eziyoon Geberii kaʼanii Gammoojjii Siin keessa Qaadesh qubatan.
english: They traveled from Ezion Geber, and encamped at Kadesh in the wilderness of Zin.

kikuyu: Qaadeshii kaʼanii daarii biyya Edoom irra Tulluu Hoori bira qubatan.
english: They traveled from Kadesh, and encamped in Mount Hor, in the edge of the land of Edom.

kikuyu: Aroon lubichis ajaja Waaqayyootiin Tulluu Hooriitti ol baʼe; innis erga Israaʼeloonni biyya Gibxiitii baʼanii booddee waggaa afurtamaffaatti guyyaa jalqaba jiʼa shanaffaatti achitti duʼe.
english: Aaron the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel had come out of the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.

kikuyu: Aroon yommuu Tulluu Hoori irratti duʼe sana umuriin isaa waggaa dhibba tokkoo fi digdamii sadii ture.
english: Aaron was one hundred twenty-three years old when he died in Mount Hor.

kikuyu: Mootiin Aaraad namichi Kanaʼaan kan Negeeb keessa jiraachaa ture sun akka sabni Israaʼel dhufaa jiru dhagaʼe.
english: The Canaanite king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Canaan, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Isaanis Tulluu Hooriitii kaʼanii Zalmoonaa qubatan.
english: They traveled from Mount Hor, and encamped in Zalmonah.

kikuyu: Zalmoonaadhaa kaʼanii Phuunon qubatan.
english: They traveled from Zalmonah, and encamped in Punon.

kikuyu: Phuunoniidhaa kaʼanii Oobooti qubatan.
english: They traveled from Punon, and encamped in Oboth.

kikuyu: Oobootii kaʼanii daarii Moʼaab irra Iyyee Abaariim qubatan.
english: They traveled from Oboth, and encamped in Iye Abarim, in the border of Moab.

kikuyu: Iyyiimii kaʼanii Diiboongaad qubatan.
english: They traveled from Iyim, and encamped in Dibon Gad.

kikuyu: Diiboongaadii kaʼanii Almoon Diiblaatayim qubatan.
english: They traveled from Dibon Gad, and encamped in Almon Diblathaim.

kikuyu: Almoon Diiblaatayimii kaʼanii Neboo tulluuwwan Abaariim bira qubatan.
english: They traveled from Almon Diblathaim, and encamped in the mountains of Abarim, before Nebo.

kikuyu: Tulluuwwan Abaariimiitii kaʼanii dirreewwan Moʼaab irra, Yordaanos bira, Yerikoo gama qubatan.
english: They traveled from the mountains of Abarim, and encamped in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Isaanis dirreewwan Moʼaab kan Yordaanos cina Beet Yashiimootii jalqabee hamma Abeel Shixiimiitti jiru sana irra qubatan.
english: They encamped by the Jordan, from Beth Jeshimoth even to Abel Shittim in the plains of Moab.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos dirreewwan Moʼaab irratti, Yordaanos biratti, Yerikoo gamatti Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: “Akkana jedhii saba Israaʼelitti dubbadhu; ‘Isin yommuu Yordaanos ceetanii Kanaʼaanitti galtanitti,
english: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, “When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

kikuyu: jiraattota biyya sanaa of duraa ariʼaa baasaa. Fakkiiwwan isaanii kanneen soofamanii hojjetamanii fi waaqota isaanii kanneen baqfamanii tolfaman hunda barbadeessaa; gaarran sagadaa isaanii hundas diigaa.
english: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, destroy all their stone idols, destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places.

kikuyu: Sababii ani biyyattii handhuuraa godhee isinii kenneef, biyyattii dhuunfadhaa keessa jiraadhaa.
english: You shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for I have given the land to you to possess it.

kikuyu: Biyya sanas maatiiwwan keessaniif dhaala godhaatii ixaadhaan gargari qoodaa; maatii baayʼeedhaaf dhaala guddaa, maatii muraasaaf immoo dhaala xinnaa kennaa. Iddoon ixaadhaan isaanii baʼe kan isaanii taʼa. Isinis akkuma gosoota abbootii keessaniitti dhaalaa.
english: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the larger groups you shall give a larger inheritance, and to the smaller you shall give a smaller inheritance. Wherever the lot falls to any man, that shall be his. You shall inherit according to the tribes of your fathers.

kikuyu: “ ‘Garuu yoo isin warra biyya sana jiraatan achii baasuu baattan, warri isin akka isaan achi jiraataniif dhiiftan sun akka huuba ija keessaatii fi akka qoraattii cinaacha keessaa isinitti taʼu. Biyya isin keessa jiraattan keessattis isin rakkisu.
english: “But if you do not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then those you let remain of them will be like pricks in your eyes and thorns in your sides. They will harass you in the land in which you dwell.

kikuyu: Anis waanan isaan gochuu yaade sana isinitti nan fida.’ ”
english: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so I will do to you.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Akkana jedhii Israaʼeloota ajaji: ‘Yeroo isin Kanaʼaan seentanitti biyyi akka dhaalaatti isinii kennamtu sun daangaawwan kanneen qabaatti:
english: “Command the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you come into the land of Canaan (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Canaan according to its borders),

kikuyu: “ ‘Daangaan keessan kan gama kibbaa Gammoojjii Siin kan qarqara Edoom irra jirtu irraa jalqaba; karaa baʼaatiin daangaan keessan kan kibbaa dhuma Galaana Soogiddaa irraa jalqaba;
english: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward.
