kikuyu: daangaan keessan kibba irraa gara tabba Aqrabiimitti deebiʼee, gara Siinitti ceʼee hamma kibba Qaadesh Barneetti deema. Ergasiis gara Hazar Adaaritti ittuma fufee gara Azimoonitti darba.
english: Your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and it shall pass southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go from there to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon.

kikuyu: Daangaan sunis Azimoon irraa gara laga Gibxitti deebiʼee galaana gaʼee dhuma.
english: The border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Egypt, and it shall end at the sea.

kikuyu: Daangaan keessan kan gama dhiʼaa immoo qarqara Galaana guddichaa ti. Kunis gama dhiʼaatiin daangaa keessan taʼa.
english: “‘For the western border, you shall have the great sea and its border. This shall be your west border.

kikuyu: Daarii keessan kan kaabaatiif galaana guddaadhaa hamma Tulluu Huuritti,
english: “‘This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for yourselves Mount Hor.

kikuyu: Tulluu Huuriitii hamma Leeboo Hamaatiitti mallattoo tolchaa. Daariin sunis hamma Zedaaditti deemee
english: From Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the border shall pass by Zedad.

kikuyu: hamma Ziifronitti itti fufee Hazar Eenaan irratti dhuma. Kunis daarii keessan kan kaabaa taʼa.
english: Then the border shall go to Ziphron, and it shall end at Hazar Enan. This shall be your north border.

kikuyu: Daarii keessan kan baʼaatiifis Hazar Eenaanii jalqabaatii hamma Shefaamaatti mallattoo tolchaa.
english: “‘You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham.

kikuyu: Daariin sunis Shefaamaa jalqabee karaa baʼa Aayiniitiin hamma Riibilaatti gad buʼa; itti fufees hamma ededa gama baʼaa Galaana Kinereetitti argamuutti deema.
english: The border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain. The border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward.

kikuyu: Daariin kunis Yordaanositti gad buʼee Galaana Soogiddaa gaʼee dhaabata.
english: The border shall go down to the Jordan, and end at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to its borders around it.’”

kikuyu: Museen akkana jedhee Israaʼeloota ajaje: “Biyya kana dhaala godhadhaatii ixaadhaan qoodadhaa; Waaqayyo akka biyyi kun gosa sagalii fi walakkaadhaaf kennamu ajajeera;
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel, saying, “This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which the LORD has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;

kikuyu: maatiiwwan gosa Ruubeen, kan gosa Gaadii fi walakkaan gosa Minaasee dhaala ofii fudhataniiruutii.
english: for the tribe of the children of Reuben according to their fathers’ houses, the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers’ houses, and the half-tribe of Manasseh have received their inheritance.

kikuyu: Gosoonni lamaanii fi walakkaan gosa tokkoo Yordaanos gamaa, fuullee Yerikootii gara baʼa biiftuutti karaa baʼaatiin dhaala isaanii argataniiru.”
english: The two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Jordan at Jericho eastward, toward the sunrise.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Maqaan namoota akka dhaalaatti lafa kana isinii qoodaniis Eleʼaazaar lubichaa fi Iyyaasuu ilma Nuunii ti.
english: “These are the names of the men who shall divide the land to you for inheritance: Eleazar the priest, and Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Isinis akka isaan lafa dhaalaa qoodaniif tokkoo tokkoo gosaa keessaa hoogganaa tokko filadhaa.
english: You shall take one prince of every tribe, to divide the land for inheritance.

kikuyu: “Maqaan isaaniis kanneenii dha: “Gosa Yihuudaa keessaa, Kaaleb ilma Yefunee;
english: These are the names of the men: Of the tribe of Judah, Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

kikuyu: gosa Simiʼoon keessaa, Shemuuʼeel ilma Amiihuud;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Simeon, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

kikuyu: gosa Beniyaam keessaa, Eliidaad ilma Kisloon;
english: Of the tribe of Benjamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

kikuyu: gosa Daan keessaa hoogganaan, Bukii ilma Yoogilii;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Dan a prince, Bukki the son of Jogli.

kikuyu: gosa Minaasee ilma Yoosef keessaa hoogganaan, Haniiʼeel ilma Eefoodi;
english: Of the children of Joseph: of the tribe of the children of Manasseh a prince, Hanniel the son of Ephod.

kikuyu: gosa Efreem ilma Yoosef keessaa hoogganaan, Qamuʼeel ilma Shiifxaan;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Ephraim a prince, Kemuel the son of Shiphtan.

kikuyu: gosa Zebuuloon keessaa hoogganaan, Eliisaafaan ilma Phaarnaak;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Zebulun a prince, Elizaphan the son of Parnach.

kikuyu: gosa Yisaakor keessaa hoogganaan, Phaaltiiʼeel ilma Azaan;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Issachar a prince, Paltiel the son of Azzan.

kikuyu: gosa Aasheer keessaa hoogganaan, Ahiihuud ilma Sheloomii;
english: Of the tribe of the children of Asher a prince, Ahihud the son of Shelomi.

kikuyu: gosa Niftaalem keessaa hoogganaan, Phedaaʼeel ilma Amiihuud.”
english: Of the tribe of the children of Naphtali a prince, Pedahel the son of Ammihud.”

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen warra Waaqayyo akka isaan biyya Kanaʼaan keessatti Israaʼelootaaf dhaala hiraniif isaan ajajee dha.
english: These are they whom the LORD commanded to divide the inheritance to the children of Israel in the land of Canaan.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos dirreewwan Moʼaab irratti, Yordaanos biratti, Yerikoo gamatti Museedhaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho, saying,

kikuyu: “Israaʼeloonni dhaala ofii isaaniitii argachuuf jiran keessaa magaalaawwan Lewwonni keessa jiraatan akka isaanii kennan Israaʼeloota ajaji. Lafa horii itti bobbaafatanis naannoo magaalaawwaniitti haa kennaniif.
english: “Command the children of Israel to give to the Levites cities to dwell in out of their inheritance. You shall give pasture lands for the cities around them to the Levites.

kikuyu: Isaanis magaalaawwan keessa jiraatanii fi lafa itti loon isaaniitii fi horii isaanii kaan hunda bobbaafatan ni qabaatu.
english: They shall have the cities to dwell in. Their pasture lands shall be for their livestock, and for their possessions, and for all their animals.

kikuyu: “Lafti horiin itti bobbaʼu kan isin naannoo magaalaawwaniitti Lewwotaaf kennitan sun dallaa magaalaa irraa jalqabee gama hundaan dhundhuma kuma tokko achi balʼata.
english: “The pasture lands of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits around it.

kikuyu: Magaalaa sana gidduutti hambisuudhaan karaa alaatiin gama baʼaatiin dhundhuma kuma lama, gama kibbaatiin dhundhuma kuma lama, gama dhiʼaatiin dhundhuma kuma lama, gama kaabaatiin immoo dhundhuma kuma lama safaraa. Iddoowwan kunneen magaalaawwan sanaaf iddoowwan itti horii bobbaafatan taʼu.
english: You shall measure outside of the city for the east side two thousand cubits, and for the south side two thousand cubits, and for the west side two thousand cubits, and for the north side two thousand cubits, the city being in the middle. This shall be the pasture lands of their cities.

kikuyu: “Magaalaawwan jaʼan isin Lewwotaaf kennitan magaalaawwan itti baqatan kanneen namni nama ajjeese itti baqatu taʼu. Magaalaawwan afurtamii lamas kanatti dabalaatii isaanii kennaa.
english: “The cities which you shall give to the Levites, they shall be the six cities of refuge, which you shall give for the man slayer to flee to. Besides them you shall give forty-two cities.

kikuyu: Walumaa galatti magaalaawwan afurtamii saddeet kanneen lafa tika ofii isaanii qaban Lewwotaaf kennaa.
english: All the cities which you shall give to the Levites shall be forty-eight cities together with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Magaalaawwan isin lafa Israaʼeloonni dhaalan irraa Lewwotaaf kennitan, akkuma qooda dhaala tokkoo tokkoo gosaatti haa taʼu; gosa dhaala baayʼee qabu irraa magaalaawwan baayʼee, gosa dhaala muraasa qabu irraa immoo magaalaawwan xinnoo fuudhaa.”
english: Concerning the cities which you shall give of the possession of the children of Israel, from the many you shall take many, and from the few you shall take few. Everyone according to his inheritance which he inherits shall give some of his cities to the Levites.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Museedhaan akkana jedhe:
english: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,

kikuyu: “Israaʼelootatti dubbadhu; akkanas jedhiin: ‘Isin yommuu Yordaanosin ceetanii Kanaʼaanitti galtanitti,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, ‘When you pass over the Jordan into the land of Canaan,

kikuyu: akka isin magaalaawwan itti baqatan kanneen namni tasa nama ajjeese itti baqatu isinii taʼaniif magaalaawwan filadhaa.
english: then you shall appoint for yourselves cities to be cities of refuge for you, that the man slayer who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

kikuyu: Magaalaawwan kunneenis akka namni nama ajjeesuudhaan himatame utuu murtii argachuuf waldaa duratti hin dhiʼaatin hin duuneef iddoo inni itti nama haaloo isa baʼu jalaa baqatu taʼu.
english: The cities shall be for your refuge from the avenger, that the man slayer not die until he stands before the congregation for judgment.

kikuyu: Magaalaawwan isin kennitan jaʼan kunneenis magaalaawwan itti baqattan isinii taʼu.
english: The cities which you shall give shall be for you six cities of refuge.

kikuyu: Yordaanos gamanaan magaalaawwan sadii, Kanaʼaan keessaa immoo magaalaawwan sadii, magaalaawwan itti baqatan godhaa kennaa.
english: You shall give three cities beyond the Jordan, and you shall give three cities in the land of Canaan. They shall be cities of refuge.

kikuyu: Magaalaawwan jaʼan kunneen akka namni tasa nama ajjeese kam iyyuu itti baqatuuf Israaʼelootaaf, alagootaa fi saba isaan gidduu jiraatuuf iddoo itti baqatan taʼu.
english: These six cities shall be refuge for the children of Israel, for the stranger, and for the foreigner living among them, that everyone who kills any person unwittingly may flee there.

kikuyu: “ ‘Namni tokko yoo meeshaa sibiilaatiin nama dhaʼee namichi sun duʼe, inni ajjeese sun nama gumaa ti; namichi ajjeese sun ajjeefamuu qaba.
english: “‘But if he struck him with an instrument of iron, so that he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Yookaan namni tokko yoo dhagaa nama ajjeesuu dandaʼu harkatti qabatee nama dhaʼee ajjeese, inni nama gumaa ti; namichi nama ajjeese sun ajjeefamuu qaba.
english: If he struck him with a stone in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Yookaan namni tokko yoo meeshaa mukaa kan nama ajjeesuu dandaʼu harkatti qabatee nama dhaʼee namichi sun duʼe, inni ajjeese sun nama gumaa ti; namichi nama ajjeese sun ajjeefamuu qaba.
english: Or if he struck him with a weapon of wood in the hand, by which a man may die, and he died, he is a murderer. The murderer shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: Namichi haaloo dhiigaa baʼu sun namicha nama ajjeese sana haa ajjeesu; inni yommuu argatutti isa haa ajjeesu.
english: The avenger of blood shall himself put the murderer to death. When he meets him, he shall put him to death.

kikuyu: Namni tokko yoo jibbaan nama darbatee lafaan dhaʼee yookaan beekaa waa itti darbachuudhaan isa ajjeese,
english: If he shoved him out of hatred, or hurled something at him while lying in wait, so that he died,

kikuyu: yookaan yoo diinummaadhaan kaʼee harkaan isa dhaʼee namichi sun duʼe, inni nama ajjeese sun ajjeefamuu qaba; inni nama gumaa ti. Namichi haaloo dhiigaa baʼu sun namicha nama ajjeese sana yeroo argatutti isa haa ajjeesu.
english: or in hostility struck him with his hand, so that he died, he who struck him shall surely be put to death. He is a murderer. The avenger of blood shall put the murderer to death when he meets him.

kikuyu: “ ‘Garuu inni yoo utuu diinummaa hin qabaatin tasa nama darbatee lafaan dhaʼe yookaan utuu hin beekin waan tokko isatti darbatee
english: “‘But if he shoved him suddenly without hostility, or hurled on him anything without lying in wait,

kikuyu: yookaan utuu isa hin argin dhagaa isa ajjeesuu dandaʼu itti gad dhiisee namichi sun duʼe, inni waan diina isaa hin taʼinii fi isa miidhuuf hin yaadiniif
english: or with any stone, by which a man may die, not seeing him, and cast it on him so that he died, and he was not his enemy and not seeking his harm,

kikuyu: waldaan sun akkuma seera kanneeniitti namicha nama ajjeese sanaa fi isa haaloo dhiigaa baʼu sana gidduutti murtii haa kennu.
english: then the congregation shall judge between the striker and the avenger of blood according to these ordinances.

kikuyu: Waldaan sun namicha nama ajjeesuudhaan himatame sana harka namicha haaloo dhiigaa baʼu sanaa jalaa baasee magaalaa inni itti baqatee ture sanatti deebisee isa haa ergu. Innis hamma lubni ol aanaan zayitii qulqulluudhaan dibame sun duʼutti achuma haa turu.
english: The congregation shall deliver the man slayer out of the hand of the avenger of blood, and the congregation shall restore him to his city of refuge, where he had fled. He shall dwell therein until the death of the high priest, who was anointed with the holy oil.

kikuyu: “ ‘Taʼus yoo namichi nama ajjeese sun daarii magaalaa itti baqate sanaa keessaa baʼee
english: “‘But if the man slayer shall at any time go beyond the border of his city of refuge where he flees,

kikuyu: namichi haaloo dhiigaa baʼu sun magaalaa sanaan alatti isa argate, namichi haaloo dhiigaa baʼu sun namicha himatame sana ajjeesuu dandaʼa; yakka ajjeechaa sanaattis hin gaafatamu.
english: and the avenger of blood finds him outside of the border of his city of refuge, and the avenger of blood kills the man slayer, he shall not be guilty of blood,

kikuyu: Namichi nama ajjeese sun hamma lubni ol aanaan sun duʼutti magaalaa itti baqate keessa turuu qaba; inni erga lubichi ol aanaan duʼee booddee gara qabeenya isaatti deebiʼuu dandaʼa.
english: because he should have remained in his city of refuge until the death of the high priest. But after the death of the high priest, the man slayer shall return into the land of his possession.

kikuyu: “ ‘Isaan kunneenis dhaloota dhufu keessatti lafa isin jiraattan kamitti iyyuu seeraa fi qajeelfama isiniif haa taʼan.
english: “‘These things shall be for a statute and ordinance to you throughout your generations in all your dwellings.

kikuyu: “ ‘Namni kam iyyuu yoo nama ajjeese namichi sun ragaa dhugaa baatonni kennaniin ajjeefama. Taʼus namni kam iyyuu dhuga baʼumsa nama tokkoo qofaan hin ajjeefamin.
english: “‘Whoever kills any person, the murderer shall be slain based on the testimony of witnesses; but one witness shall not testify alone against any person so that he dies.

kikuyu: “ ‘Namicha nama ajjeesee duuti isaaf malu tokko irraa gumaa lubbuu hin fudhatinaa. Inni ajjeefamuu qaba.
english: “‘Moreover you shall take no ransom for the life of a murderer who is guilty of death. He shall surely be put to death.

kikuyu: “ ‘Akka inni utuu lubichi ol aanaan hin duʼin dura biyya ofii isaatti deebiʼee achi jiraatu eeyyamuuf jettanii nama gara magaalaa itti baqataniitti baqate kamiif iyyuu gumaa hin fudhatinaa.
english: “‘You shall take no ransom for him who has fled to his city of refuge, that he may come again to dwell in the land before the death of the priest.

kikuyu: “ ‘Sababii dhangalaafamuun dhiigaa biyya xureessuuf, isin biyya keessa jiraattan sana hin xureessinaa; dhiiguma namicha dhiiga dhangalaase sanaatiin malees biyya dhiigni itti dhangalaafame sanaaf araarri hin buufamu.
english: “‘So you shall not pollute the land where you live; for blood pollutes the land. No atonement can be made for the land for the blood that is shed in it, but by the blood of him who shed it.

kikuyu: Biyya isin keessa jirtan iddoo ani jiraadhu sana hin xureessinaa. Ani Waaqayyo Israaʼeloota gidduu nan jiraadhaatii.’ ”
english: You shall not defile the land which you inhabit, where I dwell; for I, the LORD, dwell among the children of Israel.’”

kikuyu: Abbootiin maatii ilmaan Giliʼaad ilma Maakiir, ilma Minaasee kanneen maatiiwwan ilmaan Yoosef keessaa dhufan sun fuula Museetii fi fuula hooggantoota abbootii maatiiwwan saba Israaʼel duratti dhiʼaatanii dubbatan;
english: The heads of the fathers’ households of the family of the children of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh, of the families of the sons of Joseph, came near and spoke before Moses and before the princes, the heads of the fathers’ households of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: akkanas jedhan; “Akka ati biyyattii dhaala gootee ixaadhaan saba Israaʼeliif kennituuf Waaqayyo Gooftaa koo ajajeera; akkasumas akka ati dhaala obboleessi keenya Zelofehaad intallan isaatiif kennitu inni si ajajeera.
english: They said, “The LORD commanded my lord to give the land for inheritance by lot to the children of Israel. My lord was commanded by the LORD to give the inheritance of Zelophehad our brother to his daughters.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo isaan ilmaan gosoota saba Israaʼel kaanitti heeruman dhaalli isaanii dhaala abbootii keenyaa keessaa fuudhamee dhaala gosa isaan itti heerumaniitti dabalama. Yoos dhaala ixaadhaan nuu qoodame irraa gariin isaa ni fuudhama.
english: If they are married to any of the sons of the other tribes of the children of Israel, then their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of our fathers, and will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So it will be taken away from the lot of our inheritance.

kikuyu: Yommuu Waggaan Iyyoobeeliyyuu kan saba Israaʼel dhufutti dhaalli isaanii sun dhaala gosa isaan itti heerumaniitti dabalama; dhaalli isaaniis dhaala gosa abbootii keenyaa irraa fudhatama.”
english: When the jubilee of the children of Israel comes, then their inheritance will be added to the inheritance of the tribe to which they shall belong. So their inheritance will be taken away from the inheritance of the tribe of our fathers.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Museen akkuma Waaqayyo dubbate sana akkana jedhee saba Israaʼel ajaje: “Wanni gosti ilmaan Yoosef jedhu sirrii dha.
english: Moses commanded the children of Israel according to the LORD’s word, saying, “The tribe of the sons of Joseph speak what is right.

kikuyu: Wanni Waaqayyo waaʼee intallan Zelofehaad ajaje kanaa dha: Isaan gosa abbaa isaanii qofa keessaa haa taʼu malee nama jaallatanitti haa heeruman.
english: This is the thing which the LORD commands concerning the daughters of Zelophehad, saying, ‘Let them be married to whom they think best, only they shall marry into the family of the tribe of their father.

kikuyu: Sababii tokkoon tokkoon ilmaan Israaʼel dhaala gosa abbaa isaa irraa argatu jabeessee qabatuuf, dhaalli ilmaan Israaʼel gosa tokko irraa gosa kaanitti hin darbin.
english: So shall no inheritance of the children of Israel move from tribe to tribe; for the children of Israel shall all keep the inheritance of the tribe of his fathers.

kikuyu: Akka tokkoon tokkoon ilmaan Israaʼel dhaala abbootii isaa argatuuf, gosa ilmaan Israaʼel keessaa intalli dhaala argattu kam iyyuu gosa abbaa ishee keessaa nama tokkotti heerumuu qabdi.
english: Every daughter who possesses an inheritance in any tribe of the children of Israel shall be wife to one of the family of the tribe of her father, that the children of Israel may each possess the inheritance of his fathers.

kikuyu: Sababii tokkoon tokkoon gosa ilmaan Israaʼel dhaala ofii isaa jabeessee qabatuuf, dhaalli tokko iyyuu gosa tokko irraa gosa kaanitti hin darbin.”
english: So shall no inheritance move from one tribe to another tribe; for the tribes of the children of Israel shall each keep his own inheritance.’”

kikuyu: Intallan Zelofehaad akkuma Waaqayyo Musee ajaje sana godhan.
english: The daughters of Zelophehad did as the LORD commanded Moses:

kikuyu: Intallan Zelofehaad Mahilaan, Tiirzaan, Hoglaan, Miilkaa fi Nohi ilmaan obboloota abbaa isaaniitti heeruman.
english: for Mahlah, Tirzah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Noah, the daughters of Zelophehad, were married to their father’s brothers’ sons.

kikuyu: Isaanis maatiiwwan ilmaan Minaasee ilma Yoosef keessatti waan heerumaniif dhaalli isaanii gosa maatii abbaa isaanii harkatti hafe.
english: They were married into the families of the sons of Manasseh the son of Joseph. Their inheritance remained in the tribe of the family of their father.

kikuyu: Ajajawwanii fi murtiiwwan Waaqayyo dirreewwan Moʼaab irratti, Yordaanos biratti, Yerikoo gamatti karaa Museetiin ilmaan Israaʼeliif kenne kanneenii dha.
english: These are the commandments and the ordinances which the LORD commanded by Moses to the children of Israel in the plains of Moab by the Jordan at Jericho.

kikuyu: Dubbiin kun dubbii Museen yeroo isaan gammoojjii gama baʼa Yordaanositti, Arabbaa fuullee Suufitti argamu sana keessa, Phaaraanii fi Toofel, Laabaan, Haxerootii fi Diizaahaab gidduu turanitti Israaʼeloota hundatti dubbatee dha.
english: These are the words which Moses spoke to all Israel beyond the Jordan in the wilderness, in the Arabah opposite Suf, between Paran, Tophel, Laban, Hazeroth, and Dizahab.

kikuyu: Kooreebii karaa Tulluu Seeʼiiriin Qaadesh Barnee gaʼuuf guyyoota kudha tokko fudhata.
english: It is eleven days’ journey from Horeb by the way of Mount Seir to Kadesh Barnea.

kikuyu: Museenis waggaa afurtamaffaa keessa guyyaa tokkoffaa jiʼa kudha tokkoffaatti waan Waaqayyo waaʼee isaanii isa ajaje hunda Israaʼelootatti hime.
english: In the fortieth year, in the eleventh month, on the first day of the month, Moses spoke to the children of Israel according to all that the LORD had given him in commandment to them,

kikuyu: Kunis erga inni Sihoon mootii Amoorotaa kan Heshboon bulchaa ture moʼatee Oogi mootii Baashaan kan Ashtaaroti bulchaa ture illee Edreyiitti moʼatee booddee dha.
english: after he had struck Sihon the king of the Amorites who lived in Heshbon, and Og the king of Bashan who lived in Ashtaroth, at Edrei.

kikuyu: Baʼa Yordaanositti biyya Moʼaab keessatti Museen akkana jedhee seera kana ibsuu jalqabe:
english: Beyond the Jordan, in the land of Moab, Moses began to declare this law, saying,

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya Kooreebitti akkana nuun jedhe; “Isin tulluu kana bira yeroo dheeraa turtaniirtu.
english: “The LORD our God spoke to us in Horeb, saying, ‘You have lived long enough at this mountain.

kikuyu: Qubata buqqisaa kaʼaatii gara biyya gaaraa Amoorotaatti deemsa keessan itti fufaa; ergasiis saboota naannoo Arabbaatti argaman hunda keessa, biyya tulluuwwanii keessa, biyyoota gama dhiʼaatiin cina tulluuwwaniitti argaman keessa, Negeebii fi qarqara galaanaa, biyya Kanaʼaanotaatii fi Libaanoon keessa hamma laga Efraaxiis guddichaatti argaman keessa deemaa.
english: Turn, and take your journey, and go to the hill country of the Amorites and to all the places near there: in the Arabah, in the hill country, in the lowland, in the South, by the seashore, in the land of the Canaanites, and in Lebanon as far as the great river, the river Euphrates.

kikuyu: Kunoo, ani biyya kana isiniif kenneera. Biyya Waaqayyo abbootii keessaniif jechuunis Abrahaamiif, Yisihaaqiif, Yaaqoobii fi sanyii isaanii warra isaaniin duubaatiif kennuuf kakate sanatti galaatii dhaalaa.”
english: Behold, I have set the land before you. Go in and possess the land which the LORD swore to your fathers—to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob—to give to them and to their offspring after them.’”

kikuyu: Ani yeroo sanatti akkanan isiniin jedhe; “Ani kophaa koo isin baachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: I spoke to you at that time, saying, “I am not able to bear you myself alone.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan isin baayʼiseera; kunoo, isin harʼa akkuma urjiiwwan samii baayʼattaniirtu.
english: The LORD your God has multiplied you, and behold, you are today as the stars of the sky for multitude.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni abbootii keessanii yeroo kuma isin haa baayʼisu; akkuma abdii kenne sanattis isin haa eebbisu!
english: May the LORD, the God of your fathers, make you a thousand times as many as you are and bless you, as he has promised you!

kikuyu: Ani garuu akkamitti kophaa koo rakkina keessan, baʼaa keessanii fi wal mormii keessan baachuu dandaʼaa?
english: How can I myself alone bear your problems, your burdens, and your strife?

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo gosoota keessanii keessaa namoota ogeeyyii, hubattootaa fi kabajamoo filadhaa; anis isin irratti bulchitoota isaan nan taasisa.”
english: Take wise men of understanding who are respected among your tribes, and I will make them heads over you.”

kikuyu: Isinis, “Wanni ati dhiʼeessite gaarii dha” jettanii naaf deebiftan.
english: You answered me, and said, “The thing which you have spoken is good to do.”

kikuyu: Ani hangafoota gosoota keessanii jechuunis namoota ogeeyyii fi kabajamoo fudhadhee akka isaan ajajjuuwwan kumaa, ajajjuuwwan dhibbaa, ajajjuuwwan shantamaatii fi ajajjuuwwan kudhanii taʼanii isin irratti aangoo qabaatan nan muude.
english: So I took the heads of your tribes, wise and respected men, and made them heads over you, captains of thousands, captains of hundreds, captains of fifties, captains of tens, and officers, according to your tribes.

kikuyu: Anis yeroo sanatti akkana jedhee abbootii murtii keessan nan ajaje; “Mormii obboloota keessan gidduutti kaʼu dhagaʼaa; yoo wal mormiin kaʼu sun Israaʼeloota obboloota gidduutti yookaan nama Israaʼel tokkoo fi alagaa tokko gidduutti taʼe murtii qajeelaa kennaa.
english: I commanded your judges at that time, saying, “Hear cases between your brothers and judge righteously between a man and his brother, and the foreigner who is living with him.

kikuyu: Murtii kennuu keessatti nama wal hin caalchisinaa; guddaas xinnaas wal qixxee dhagaʼaa. Sababii murtiin kan Waaqaa taʼeef eenyuun iyyuu hin sodaatinaa. Waan humna keessanii ol taʼe natti fidaa; anis nan ilaalaa.”
english: You shall not show partiality in judgment; you shall hear the small and the great alike. You shall not be afraid of the face of man, for the judgment is God’s. The case that is too hard for you, you shall bring to me, and I will hear it.”

kikuyu: Ani yeroo sanatti waan isin gochuu qabdan hunda isin ajajeera.
english: I commanded you at that time all the things which you should do.

kikuyu: Nus ergasii akkuma Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya nu ajajetti Kooreebii kaanee gammoojjii guddaa fi sodaachisaa isin argitan sana keessa dabarree gara biyya gaaraa Amoorotaa dhaqne; akkasiinis Qaadesh Barnee geenye.
english: We traveled from Horeb and went through all that great and terrible wilderness which you saw, by the way to the hill country of the Amorites, as the LORD our God commanded us; and we came to Kadesh Barnea.

kikuyu: Anis akkana isiniin jedhe; “Isin biyya gaaraa Amoorotaa kan Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya nuu kennu geessaniirtu.
english: I said to you, “You have come to the hill country of the Amorites, which the LORD our God gives to us.

kikuyu: Kunoo, Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan biyyattii isiniif kenneera. Dhaqaatii akkuma Waaqayyo Waaqni abbootii keessanii isinitti hime sanatti ishee dhaalaa; hin sodaatinaa; abdiis hin kutatinaa.”
english: Behold, the LORD your God has set the land before you. Go up, take possession, as the LORD the God of your fathers has spoken to you. Don’t be afraid, neither be dismayed.”

kikuyu: Ergasiis hundi keessan na bira dhuftanii, “Akka isaan biyyattii nuu basaasaniif duraan dursinee namoota erganna; isaanis waaʼee karaa achi nu geessuutii fi magaalaawwan nu itti dhufnuu oduu nuu fidu” jettan.
english: You came near to me, everyone of you, and said, “Let’s send men before us, that they may search the land for us, and bring back to us word of the way by which we must go up, and the cities to which we shall come.”

kikuyu: Yaadni sunis gaarii natti fakkaate; ani kudha lamaan keessan jechuunis tokkoo tokkoo gosaa keessaa nama tokko nan filadhe.
english: The thing pleased me well. I took twelve of your men, one man for every tribe.

kikuyu: Isaanis kaʼanii biyya gaaraatti ol baʼanii Sulula Eshkool gaʼanii biyyattii basaasan.
english: They turned and went up into the hill country, and came to the valley of Eshcol, and spied it out.

kikuyu: Ija biyyattii keessaas waa fidanii dhufanii, “Biyyi Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya nuuf kennu kun gaarii dha” jedhanii nutti himan.
english: They took some of the fruit of the land in their hands and brought it down to us, and brought us word again, and said, “It is a good land which the LORD our God gives to us.”

kikuyu: Isin garuu dhaquu diddanii ajaja Waaqayyo Waaqa keessaniitti finciltan.
english: Yet you wouldn’t go up, but rebelled against the commandment of the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Dunkaana keessan keessattis akkana jettanii guungumtan; “Waaqayyo nu jibba; kanaafuu biyya Gibxiitii nu baasuun isaatuu akka isaan nu balleessaniif harka Amoorotaatti dabarsee nu kennuuf.
english: You murmured in your tents, and said, “Because the LORD hated us, he has brought us out of the land of Egypt, to deliver us into the hand of the Amorites to destroy us.

kikuyu: Egaa nu eessa dhaquu dandeenya? Obboloonni keenya, ‘Jarri nu caalaa jajjaboo fi hojjaan isaanii dhedheeraa dha; magaalaawwan isaaniis gurguddaa fi dallaawwan samii gaʼaniin marfamaniiru; kana biratti immoo ilmaan Anaaq argineerra’ jedhanii nu sodaachisan.”
english: Where are we going up? Our brothers have made our heart melt, saying, ‘The people are greater and taller than we. The cities are great and fortified up to the sky. Moreover we have seen the sons of the Anakim there!’”

kikuyu: Anis akkanan isiniin jedhe; “Hin rifatinaa; isaan hin sodaatinaa.
english: Then I said to you, “Don’t be terrified. Don’t be afraid of them.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan kan fuula keessan dura deemu kun akkuma ija keessan duratti biyya Gibxi keessatti isinii godhe sana isiniif ni lola;
english: The LORD your God, who goes before you, he will fight for you, according to all that he did for you in Egypt before your eyes,

kikuyu: gammoojjii keessattis akkasuma. Hamma as geessanittis karaa deemtan hundatti akkamitti akka Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan akkuma abbaan ilma isaa baatutti isin baate argitaniirtu.”
english: and in the wilderness where you have seen how that the LORD your God carried you, as a man carries his son, in all the way that you went, until you came to this place.”

kikuyu: Taʼus isin Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan
english: Yet in this thing you didn’t believe the LORD your God,

kikuyu: isa iddoo isin qubattan barbaaduu fi daandii isin deemuu qabdan isin argisiisuudhaaf jedhee halkan ibiddaan, guyyaa immoo duumessaan isin dura deemee isin qajeelchaa ture hin amananne.
english: who went before you on the way, to seek out a place for you to pitch your tents in: in fire by night, to show you by what way you should go, and in the cloud by day.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos yommuu waan isin jettan dhagaʼetti dheekkamee akkana jedhee kakate:
english: The LORD heard the voice of your words and was angry, and swore, saying,

kikuyu: “Dhaloota hamaa kana keessaa namni tokko iyyuu biyya gaarii ani akka abbootii keessaniif kennu kakuu gale sana hin argu;
english: “Surely not one of these men of this evil generation shall see the good land which I swore to give to your fathers,

kikuyu: Kaaleb ilma Yefunee sana malee kan argu hin jiru. Inni biyya sana ni arga; sababii inni garaa guutuudhaan Waaqayyo duukaa buʼeef ani lafa inni miilla isaa irra dhaabbate sana isaa fi sanyii isaatiif nan kenna.”
english: except Caleb the son of Jephunneh. He shall see it. I will give the land that he has trodden on to him and to his children, because he has wholly followed the LORD.”

kikuyu: Sababii keessaniif Waaqayyo natti illee dheekkamee akkana jedhe; “Ati iyyuu itti hin galtu.
english: Also the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, saying, “You also shall not go in there.

kikuyu: Gargaaraan kee Iyyaasuun ilmi Nuuni garuu itti gala. Inni waan Israaʼeloota biyyattii dhaalchisuuf isa jajjabeessi.
english: Joshua the son of Nun, who stands before you, shall go in there. Encourage him, for he shall cause Israel to inherit it.

kikuyu: Daaʼimman isin ni boojiʼaman jettan, ilmaan keessan kanneen waan tolaa fi hamaa gargar baasanii hin beekne biyya sanatti ni galu. Ani isaaniifan kenna; isaanis ni dhaalu.
english: Moreover your little ones, whom you said would be captured or killed, your children, who today have no knowledge of good or evil, shall go in there. I will give it to them, and they shall possess it.

kikuyu: Isin garuu duubatti deebiʼaatii daandii gara Galaana Diimaatti geessu qabadhaatii gammoojjiitti qajeelaa.”
english: But as for you, turn, and take your journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea.”

kikuyu: Isinis, “Nu Waaqayyotti cubbuu hojjenneerra. Dhaqnee akkuma Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya nu ajajetti lolla” jettanii deebiftan. Biyya gaaraa dhaquun waan salphaa isinitti fakkaatee akkasiin tokkoon tokkoon keessan miʼa lolaa qabattanii kaatan.
english: Then you answered and said to me, “We have sinned against the LORD. We will go up and fight, according to all that the LORD our God commanded us.” Every man of you put on his weapons of war, and presumed to go up into the hill country.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu, “ ‘Waan ani isin wajjin hin jirreef lolaaf hin baʼinaa. Isin diinota keessaniin ni moʼatamtu’ jedhii isaanitti himi” naan jedhe.
english: The LORD said to me, “Tell them, ‘Don’t go up and don’t fight; for I am not among you, lest you be struck before your enemies.’”

kikuyu: Anis akkasuman isinitti hime; isin garuu na hin dhageenye. Ajaja Waaqayyootti finciltanii of tuulummaa keessaniin biyya gaaraatti duultan.
english: So I spoke to you, and you didn’t listen; but you rebelled against the commandment of the LORD, and were presumptuous, and went up into the hill country.

kikuyu: Amooronni gaarran irra jiraatan isinitti dhufan; isaanis akkuma tuuta kanniisaatti baʼanii isin gugsan; Seeʼiirii hamma Hormaatti isin dhaʼan.
english: The Amorites, who lived in that hill country, came out against you and chased you as bees do, and beat you down in Seir, even to Hormah.

kikuyu: Isin deebitanii dhuftanii fuula Waaqayyoo duratti boossan; inni garuu booʼicha keessan hin dhageenye; gurra isaas isiniif hin kennine.
english: You returned and wept before the LORD, but the LORD didn’t listen to your voice, nor turn his ear to you.

kikuyu: Akka yeroo isin achi jiraattaniitti, guyyoonni isin Qaadesh keessa jiraattan baayʼee dha.
english: So you stayed in Kadesh many days, according to the days that you remained.

kikuyu: Ergasii akkuma Waaqayyo natti himetti, duubatti deebinee karaa Galaana Diimaatiin gara gammoojjiitti qajeelle; yeroo dheeraadhaafis naannoo biyya gaaraa Seeʼiir keessa joorre.
english: Then we turned, and took our journey into the wilderness by the way to the Red Sea, as the LORD spoke to me; and we encircled Mount Seir many days.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos akkana naan jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to me, saying,

kikuyu: “Biyya gaaraa kana naannaʼuun isin gaʼa; gara kaabaatti garagalaa.
english: “You have encircled this mountain long enough. Turn northward.

kikuyu: Saba kana akkana jedhii ajaji: ‘Isin biyya obboloota keessan sanyiiwwan Esaawu kanneen Seeʼiir keessa jiraatanii keessa darbitu. Isaan isin sodaatu; isin garuu jabeessaa of eeggadhaa.
english: Command the people, saying, ‘You are to pass through the border of your brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir; and they will be afraid of you. Therefore be careful.

kikuyu: Lolaaf isaan hin kakaasinaa; ani lafa isaanii irraa iddoo isin miilla keessan irra dhaabbattan illee isiniif hin kennuutii. Ani biyya gaaraa Seeʼiir dhaala godhee Esaawuuf kenneera.
english: Don’t contend with them; for I will not give you any of their land, no, not so much as for the sole of the foot to tread on, because I have given Mount Seir to Esau for a possession.

kikuyu: Nyaata achii nyaattanii fi bishaan dhugdaniif maallaqa baaftuuf.’ ”
english: You shall purchase food from them for money, that you may eat. You shall also buy water from them for money, that you may drink.’”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan waan isin hojjettan hundaan isin eebbiseera. Inni deemsa dheeraa isin gammoojjii balʼaa kana keessa deemtan irratti isin eegeera. Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan waggoota afurtamman kanneen isin wajjin ture; isinis waan tokko illee hin dhabne.
english: For the LORD your God has blessed you in all the work of your hands. He has known your walking through this great wilderness. These forty years, the LORD your God has been with you. You have lacked nothing.

kikuyu: Obboloota keenya ilmaan Esaawu warra Seeʼiir keessa jiraatan bira dabarree deemne. Nus daandii Arabbaa kan Eelaatii fi Eziyoon Geberii dhufu irraa garagallee karaa daandii gammoojjii Moʼaab deemne.
english: So we passed by from our brothers, the children of Esau, who dwell in Seir, from the way of the Arabah from Elath and from Ezion Geber. We turned and passed by the way of the wilderness of Moab.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Waaqayyo akkana naan jedhe; “Waan ani lafa Moʼaab irraa isiniif hin kennineef akkasumaan isaan hin rakkisinaa; waraanaafis isaan hin kakaasinaa. Ani Aarin dhaala godhee sanyii Looxiif kenneeraatii.”
english: The LORD said to me, “Don’t bother Moab, neither contend with them in battle; for I will not give you any of his land for a possession, because I have given Ar to the children of Lot for a possession.”

kikuyu: Eemiimoonni achi jiraachaa turan; isaanis namoota jajjaboo fi baayʼee dha; akkuma Anaaqotaas dhedheeroo turan.
english: (The Emim lived there before, a great and numerous people, and tall as the Anakim.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneenis akkuma Anaaqotaa, Refaayimoota jedhamanii hedamu turan; Moʼaabonni garuu Eemiimoota jedhuun.
english: These also are considered to be Rephaim, as the Anakim; but the Moabites call them Emim.

kikuyu: Huuronni kunneen Seeʼiir keessa jiraachaa turan; ilmaan Esaawu garuu ariʼanii achii isaan baasan. Isaanis akkuma Israaʼeloonni biyya Waaqayyo dhaala isaaniif kenne sana keessatti godhan sana Hoorota achii balleessanii ofii isaaniitii biyya jaraa keessa qubatan.
english: The Horites also lived in Seir in the past, but the children of Esau succeeded them. They destroyed them from before them, and lived in their place, as Israel did to the land of his possession, which the LORD gave to them.)

kikuyu: Waaqayyo, “Ammuma kaʼaatii Laga Zered ceʼaa” nuun jedhe. Nu laga sana ceene.
english: “Now rise up and cross over the brook Zered.” We went over the brook Zered.

kikuyu: Yeroo nu Qaadesh Barnee kaanee jalqabee hamma laga Zered ceenutti waggaa soddomii saddeet fudhate. Akkuma Waaqayyo isaanitti kakatetti dhaloonni dhiira waraanaa hundi yeroo sanatti qubata keessaa dhume.
english: The days in which we came from Kadesh Barnea until we had come over the brook Zered were thirty-eight years, until all the generation of the men of war were consumed from the middle of the camp, as the LORD swore to them.

kikuyu: Harki Waaqayyoos qubata keessaa isaan balleessuudhaaf isaan irra ture.
english: Moreover the LORD’s hand was against them, to destroy them from the middle of the camp, until they were consumed.

kikuyu: Yeroo loltoonni hundi saba keessaa dhumanitti,
english: So, when all the men of war were consumed and dead from among the people,

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akkana naan jedhe;
english: the LORD spoke to me, saying,

kikuyu: “Ati harʼa daarii Moʼaab, Aari keessa dabarta.
english: “You are to pass over Ar, the border of Moab, today.

kikuyu: Yommuu Amoonotatti dhuftanitti akkasumaan isaan hin rakkisinaa yookaan waraanaaf isaan hin kakaasinaa; ani biyya isaanii keessaa tokko illee dhaala godhee isiniif hin kennuutii. Ani biyya isaanii sanyii Looxiif handhuuraa godhee kenneera.”
english: When you come near the border of the children of Ammon, don’t bother them, nor contend with them; for I will not give you any of the land of the children of Ammon for a possession, because I have given it to the children of Lot for a possession.”

kikuyu: Kunis biyya Refaayimoota achi jiraachaa turaniiti jedhamee hedama; Amoononni garuu Zamzumoota jedhanii isaan waamu ture.
english: (That also is considered a land of Rephaim. Rephaim lived there in the past, but the Ammonites call them Zamzummim,

kikuyu: Isaanis namoota jajjaboo fi baayʼee dha; akkuma Anaaqotaa dhedheeroo turan. Waaqayyos fuula Amoonota achii isaan baasanii iddoo isaanii qubatan sanaa duraa isaan barbadeesse.
english: a great people, many, and tall, as the Anakim; but the LORD destroyed them from before Israel, and they succeeded them, and lived in their place,

kikuyu: Waaqayyos yommuu Hoorota fuula isaanii duraa balleessetti ilmaan Esaawu kanneen Seeʼiir keessa jiraachaa turanis akkasuma godhe. Isaanis jara achii baasanii hamma harʼaatti biyya isaanii keessa jiraatan.
english: as he did for the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, when he destroyed the Horites from before them; and they succeeded them, and lived in their place even to this day.

kikuyu: Awoota gandoota hamma Gaazaatti jiran keessa jiraatan immoo Kaftooronni Kaftoorii baʼanii dhufan sun balleessanii iddoo isaanii qubatan.
english: Then the Avvim, who lived in villages as far as Gaza: the Caphtorim, who came out of Caphtor, destroyed them and lived in their place.)

kikuyu: “Kaʼaatii Laga Arnoon ceʼaa; ani kunoo, Sihoon Amooricha mootii Heshbooniitii fi biyya isaa illee dabarsee harka keessanitti isinii kenneeraatii. Waraana itti banaatii biyya sana qabachuu jalqabaa.
english: “Rise up, take your journey, and pass over the valley of the Arnon. Behold, I have given into your hand Sihon the Amorite, king of Heshbon, and his land; begin to possess it, and contend with him in battle.

kikuyu: Anis naasisuu fi sodaachisuu keessan saboota samii gad jiran hundatti buusuu hardhuma nan jalqaba. Isaanis oduu waaʼee keessanii dhagaʼanii sababii keessaniif hollatu; naasuunis isaan qabata.”
english: Today I will begin to put the dread of you and the fear of you on the peoples who are under the whole sky, who shall hear the report of you, and shall tremble and be in anguish because of you.”

kikuyu: Anis akkana jedhee gammoojjii Qidemooti keessaa Sihoon mooticha Heshbooniitti ergamoota nagaa nan erge;
english: I sent messengers out of the wilderness of Kedemoth to Sihon king of Heshbon with words of peace, saying,

kikuyu: “Akka nu biyya kee keessaan darbinu nuu eeyyami. Nu karaa guddicha irraa hin gorru; mirgattis gara bitaattis hin gorru.
english: “Let me pass through your land. I will go along by the highway. I will turn neither to the right hand nor to the left.

kikuyu: Waan nyaannuu fi bishaan dhugnu maallaqaan nutti gurguri. Akka miilla qofaan achi keessa dabarru nuuf eeyyami;
english: You shall sell me food for money, that I may eat; and give me water for money, that I may drink. Just let me pass through on my feet,

kikuyu: akkuma ilmaan Esaawu kanneen Seeʼiir keessa jiraatanii fi Moʼaabonni Aari keessa jiraatan nuuf godhan sana atis hamma nu gara biyya Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya nuu kennuutti galuuf laga Yordaanos ceenutti akkasuma nuuf godhi.”
english: as the children of Esau who dwell in Seir, and the Moabites who dwell in Ar, did to me, until I pass over the Jordan into the land which the LORD our God gives us.”

kikuyu: Sihoon mootiin Heshboon garuu akka nu dabarru nuuf eeyyamuu dide. Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan akkuma amma godhe kana dabarsee harka keessanitti isa kennuuf mataa fi garaa isaa jabeessee tureetii.
english: But Sihon king of Heshbon would not let us pass by him, for the LORD your God hardened his spirit and made his heart obstinate, that he might deliver him into your hand, as it is today.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos, “Kunoo, ani Sihoonii fi biyya isaa dabarsee siif kennuu jalqabeera. Ati biyya isaa dhaaluuf qabachuu jalqabi” naan jedhe.
english: The LORD said to me, “Behold, I have begun to deliver up Sihon and his land before you. Begin to possess, that you may inherit his land.”

kikuyu: Yommuu Sihoonii fi guutummaan loltoota isaa nu waraanuuf Yaahazitti baʼanitti,
english: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Jahaz.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya dabarsee harka keenyatti isa nuuf kenne; nus isa, ilmaan isaatii fi loltoota isaa hunda dhoofne.
english: The LORD our God delivered him up before us; and we struck him, his sons, and all his people.

kikuyu: Yeroo sanattis magaalaawwan isaa hunda qabannee dhiirota, dubartootaa fi ijoollee, tokkoo tokkoo magaalaawwanii guutumaan guutuutti barbadeessine. Nama tokko illee hin hambifne.
english: We took all his cities at that time, and utterly destroyed every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones. We left no one remaining.

kikuyu: Garuu horii fi boojuu magaalaawwan qabanne sana keessaa boojine ofii keenyaaf fudhanne.
english: Only the livestock we took for plunder for ourselves, with the plunder of the cities which we had taken.

kikuyu: Magaalaa Aroʼeer kan qarqara Sulula Arnoonitti argamuu fi magaalaa sululicha keessatti argamuu jalqabee magaalaa hamma Giliʼaaditti argamu keessaa tokko iyyuu nu ittisuu hin dandeenye. Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya hunda isaanii dabarsee nuuf kenne.
english: From Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the city that is in the valley, even to Gilead, there was not a city too high for us. The LORD our God delivered up all before us.

kikuyu: Garuu akkuma ajaja Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya nuuf kenne sanaatti isin gara biyyoota Amoonotaa tokkootti illee yookaan gara biyya qarqara laga Yaaboq irratti argamuu yookaan biyyoota naannoo magaalaawwan gaarran irratti argamaniitti hin dabarre.
english: Only to the land of the children of Ammon you didn’t come near: all the banks of the river Jabbok, and the cities of the hill country, and wherever the LORD our God forbade us.

kikuyu: Ergasiis deebinee karaa Baashaan qabannee ol baane; Oogi mootichi Baashaan immoo loltoota isaa guutuu wajjin Edreyiitti nuun wal loluuf gad baʼe.
english: Then we turned, and went up the way to Bashan. Og the king of Bashan came out against us, he and all his people, to battle at Edrei.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos, “Waan ani isa, guutummaa loltoota isaatii fi biyya isaa illee dabarsee harka keetti kenneef isa hin sodaatin. Akkuma Sihoon mootii Amoorotaa kan Heshboon bulchaa ture sana goote isa illee godhi” naan jedhe.
english: The LORD said to me, “Don’t fear him; for I have delivered him, with all his people and his land, into your hand. You shall do to him as you did to Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya Oogi mootii Baashaanii fi guutummaa loltoota isaa dabarsee harka keenyatti kenne. Nus utuu homaa hin hambisin isaan balleessine.
english: So the LORD our God also delivered into our hand Og, the king of Bashan, and all his people. We struck him until no one was left to him remaining.

kikuyu: Yeroo sanattis magaalaawwan isaa hunda qabanne. Magaalaawwan jaatama mootummaa Oogi mooticha Baashaan kanneen kutaa biyya Argobbi jala turan keessaa kan nu hin qabatin tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: We took all his cities at that time. There was not a city which we didn’t take from them: sixty cities, all the region of Argob, the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

kikuyu: Magaalaawwan kunneen hundi dallaa dhagaa dhedheeroo, karraa fi danqaraa qabu turan; akkasumas magaalaawwan dallaa hin qabne baayʼeetu ture.
english: All these were cities fortified with high walls, gates, and bars, in addition to a great many villages without walls.

kikuyu: Nus akkuma Sihoon mootii Heshboon goone sana dhiirota, dubartootaa fi ijoollee tokkoo tokkoo magaalaawwanii guutumaan guutuutti barbadeessine.
english: We utterly destroyed them, as we did to Sihon king of Heshbon, utterly destroying every inhabited city, with the women and the little ones.

kikuyu: Horii fi boojuu magaalaawwan isaanii keessaa saamne hunda garuu ofii keenyaaf fudhannee galle.
english: But all the livestock, and the plunder of the cities, we took for plunder for ourselves.

kikuyu: Yeroo sanatti mootota Amoorotaa lamaan kana irraa karaa baʼa Yordaanos biyya Sulula Arnooniitii jalqabee hamma Tulluu Hermoonitti jiruu fudhanne.
english: We took the land at that time out of the hand of the two kings of the Amorites who were beyond the Jordan, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon.

kikuyu: Siidoononnis Hermoon kana Siiriyoon jedhanii waamu; Amooronni immoo Seniiri jedhanii waamu.
english: (The Sidonians call Hermon Sirion, and the Amorites call it Senir.)

kikuyu: Nus magaalaawwan dirree irratti argaman hunda, Giliʼaad hunda, Baashaanii hamma Salkaa fi Edreyiitti jiru hunda, magaalaawwan mootummaa Oogi kanneen Baashaan keessatti argaman hunda qabanne.
english: We took all the cities of the plain, and all Gilead, and all Bashan, to Salecah and Edrei, cities of the kingdom of Og in Bashan.

kikuyu: Gosa Refaayimootaa keessaa Oogi mootii Baashaan qofatu hafe. Kunoo sireen isaa sibiila irraa hojjetamee dalga dheerinni isaa dhundhuma sagal balʼinni isaa immoo dhundhuma afur ture. Sireen kunis amma iyyuu Rabbaa Amoonotaa keessatti argama.
english: (For only Og king of Bashan remained of the remnant of the Rephaim. Behold, his bedstead was a bedstead of iron. Isn’t it in Rabbah of the children of Ammon? Nine cubits was its length, and four cubits its width, after the cubit of a man.)

kikuyu: Ani biyya yeroo sanatti qabanne keessaa biyya karaa Kaaba Aroʼeeriitiin qarqara Sulula Arnoon jirutti dabalee walakkaa biyya gaaraa Giliʼaad magaalaawwan isaa wajjin gosa Ruubeenii fi Gaadiif kenne.
english: This land we took in possession at that time: from Aroer, which is by the valley of the Arnon, and half the hill country of Gilead with its cities, I gave to the Reubenites and to the Gadites;

kikuyu: Biyya Giliʼaad kan hafee fi guutummaa Baashaan jechuunis mootummaa Oogi walakkaa gosa Minaaseetiifan kenne. Guutummaan kutaa Argobbi kan Baashaan keessaa sun biyya Refaayimootaa jedhamee beekama ture.
english: and the rest of Gilead, and all Bashan, the kingdom of Og, I gave to the half-tribe of Manasseh—all the region of Argob, even all Bashan. (The same is called the land of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Yaaʼiir ilmi Minaasee immoo guutummaa kutaa Argobbi kan hamma daarii Geshuurotaatii fi Maʼakaatotaatti jiru fudhate; biyyi sunis maqaa isaatiin moggaafame; kanaafuu Baashaan hamma harʼaatti Haaboot Yaaʼiir jedhama.
english: Jair the son of Manasseh took all the region of Argob, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and called them, even Bashan, after his own name, Havvoth Jair, to this day.)

kikuyu: Giliʼaad immoo Maakiiriifan kenne.
english: I gave Gilead to Machir.

kikuyu: Walakkaa sulula isaa garuu daangaa gochuudhaan Giliʼaadii jalqabee hamma Sulula Arnoonitti, achii immoo bulchiinsa daangaa Amoonotaa kan hamma laga Yaaboqitti jiru gosa Ruubeenii fi Gaadiifan kenne.
english: To the Reubenites and to the Gadites I gave from Gilead even to the valley of the Arnon, the middle of the valley, and its border, even to the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;

kikuyu: Daangaan isaa karaa lixaatiin Yordaanos isa Arabbaa keessatti argamu sanaa dha; kunis Kinereetii jalqabee hamma Galaana Arabbaa kan Galaana soogiddaa jedhamuutti diriiree tabba Phisgaatii gaditti argama.
english: the Arabah also, and the Jordan and its border, from Chinnereth even to the sea of the Arabah, the Salt Sea, under the slopes of Pisgah eastward.

kikuyu: Anis yeroo sanatti akkana jedheen isin ajaje: “Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan akka dhaaltaniif lafa kana isiniif kenneera. Taʼus namoonni jajjaboon keessan hundi waraanaaf hidhatanii obboloota keessan Israaʼeloota dura gamatti ceʼuu qabdu.
english: I commanded you at that time, saying, “The LORD your God has given you this land to possess it. All of you men of valor shall pass over armed before your brothers, the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Garuu niitonni keessan, ijoolleen keessanii fi horiin keessan magaalaawwan ani isiniif kenne keessa haa turan; ani akka isin horii baayʼee qabdan beekaatii.
english: But your wives, and your little ones, and your livestock, (I know that you have much livestock), shall live in your cities which I have given you,

kikuyu: Kunis hamma Waaqayyo akkuma isin boqochiise sana obboloota keessan boqochiisee isaaniinis lafa Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan Yordaanosiin gamatti isaaniif kennu sana dhaalanitti. Sana booddee tokkoon tokkoon keessan gara biyya ani dhaala isiniif kenneetti ni deebitu.”
english: until the LORD gives rest to your brothers, as to you, and they also possess the land which the LORD your God gives them beyond the Jordan. Then you shall each return to his own possession, which I have given you.”

kikuyu: Anis yeroo sanatti akkana jedhee Iyyaasuu ajaje: “Ati waan Waaqayyo Waaqni kee mootota kanneen lamaan godhe hunda ija keetiin argiteerta. Waaqayyo, mootummoota isin itti yaatan hundas akkasuma ni godha.
english: I commanded Joshua at that time, saying, “Your eyes have seen all that the LORD your God has done to these two kings. So shall the LORD do to all the kingdoms where you go over.

kikuyu: Isin isaan hin sodaatinaa; Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan mataan isaa isiniif lolaatii.”
english: You shall not fear them; for the LORD your God himself fights for you.”

kikuyu: Yeroo sanatti ani akkana jedhee Waaqayyoon nan kadhadhe;
english: I begged GOD at that time, saying,

kikuyu: “Yaa Waaqayyoo Gooftaa, ati guddina keetii fi harka kee jabaa sana garbicha keetti argisiisuu jalqabdeerta. Silaa kan hojii jabaa akkasii kan ati hojjettu hojjechuu dandaʼu Waaqa kamtu samii irra yookaan lafa irra jira?
english: “Lord GOD, you have begun to show your servant your greatness, and your strong hand. For what god is there in heaven or in earth that can do works like yours, and mighty acts like yours?

kikuyu: Akka ani ceʼee biyyattii gaarii Yordaanos gama jirtu jechuunis biyya gaaraa gaarii sanaa fi Libaanoon argu naa eeyyami.”
english: Please let me go over and see the good land that is beyond the Jordan, that fine mountain, and Lebanon.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu waan sababii keessaniif natti dheekkameef, na dhagaʼuu dide. Waaqayyo akkana naan jedhe; “Kun ni gaʼa; lammata waaʼee waan kanaa natti hin dubbatin.
english: But the LORD was angry with me because of you, and didn’t listen to me. The LORD said to me, “That is enough! Speak no more to me of this matter.

kikuyu: Fiixee Phisgaatti ol baʼiitii gara lixaa fi kaabaa, gara kibbaa fi baʼaa ilaali. Ati waan Yordaanos hin ceeneef biyyattii ijuma keetiin ilaali.
english: Go up to the top of Pisgah, and lift up your eyes westward, and northward, and southward, and eastward, and see with your eyes; for you shall not go over this Jordan.

kikuyu: Garuu akka inni saba kana qajeelchee ceesisee akka isaan biyya ati ilaaltu kana dhaalan godhuuf Iyyaasuu ajaji; isa jajjabeessi; cimsis.”
english: But commission Joshua, and encourage him, and strengthen him; for he shall go over before this people, and he shall cause them to inherit the land which you shall see.”

kikuyu: Nu sulula Beet Pheʼoor bira jiru keessa turre.
english: So we stayed in the valley near Beth Peor.

kikuyu: Yaa Israaʼel, ajajawwanii fi seerawwan ani isin barsiisu dhagaʼaa. Akka jiraattanii fi dhaqxanii biyya Waaqayyo Waaqni abbootii keessanii isiniif kennu dhaaltaniifis isaan duukaa buʼaa.
english: Now, Israel, listen to the statutes and to the ordinances which I teach you, to do them, that you may live and go in and possess the land which the LORD, the God of your fathers, gives you.

kikuyu: Ajaja Waaqayyo Waaqa keessanii kan ani isiniif kennu eegaa malee waan tokko illee itti hin dabalinaa yookaan irraa hin hirʼisinaa.
english: You shall not add to the word which I command you, neither shall you take away from it, that you may keep the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you.

kikuyu: Isin waan Waaqayyo Baʼaal Pheʼooritti hojjete ijuma keessaniin argitaniirtu. Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan warra isin gidduudhaa Baʼaal Pheʼoor duukaa buʼan hunda balleesseera;
english: Your eyes have seen what the LORD did because of Baal Peor; for the LORD your God has destroyed all the men who followed Baal Peor from among you.

kikuyu: isin warri Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan qabattan hundi garuu hamma harʼaatti lubbuudhaan jiraattan.
english: But you who were faithful to the LORD your God are all alive today.

kikuyu: Kunoo, akka isin biyya dhaaluuf itti galuuf jirtanitti isaan duukaa buutaniif ani akkuma Waaqayyo Waaqni koo na ajajetti ajajawwanii fi seerawwan isin barsiiseera.
english: Behold, I have taught you statutes and ordinances, even as the LORD my God commanded me, that you should do so in the middle of the land where you go in to possess it.

kikuyu: Kunis akka saboonni waaʼee ajajawwan kanaa hunda dhagaʼanii, “Dhugumaan sabni guddaan kun saba ogeessaa fi hubataa dha” jedhaniif ogummaa fi hubannaa keessan sabootatti argisiisaatii akka gaariitti isaan eegaa.
english: Keep therefore and do them; for this is your wisdom and your understanding in the sight of the peoples who shall hear all these statutes and say, “Surely this great nation is a wise and understanding people.”

kikuyu: Sabni guddaan akka yeroo nu Waaqayyo Waaqa keenya waammannutti nutti dhiʼaatu sana waaqonni isaanii itti dhiʼaatan kan biraa kami?
english: For what great nation is there that has a god so near to them as the LORD our God is whenever we call on him?

kikuyu: Sabni guddaan ajajawwanii fi seera qajeelaa akka seera ani harʼa fuula keessan dura kaaʼu kanaa qabu biraa kami?
english: What great nation is there that has statutes and ordinances so righteous as all this law which I set before you today?

kikuyu: Akka waan iji kee arge hin daganneef yookaan akka hamma ati lubbuudhaan jirtutti garaa keetii hin badneef ofuma eeggadhu; jabaadhuu of eeggadhu. Waan kanas ijoollee keetii fi ijoollee ijoollee ijoollee keetii barsiisi.
english: Only be careful, and keep your soul diligently, lest you forget the things which your eyes saw, and lest they depart from your heart all the days of your life; but make them known to your children and your children’s children—

kikuyu: Gaafa isin Kooreebitti fuula Waaqayyo Waaqa keessanii dura dhaabattan, yeroo inni, “Akka isaan hamma lubbuudhaan lafa irra jiraatan hundatti na sodaachuu baratanii ijoollee ijoollee isaanii illee na sodaachuu barsiisaniif dubbii koo haa dhagaʼaniitii namoota walitti qabi” naan jedhe sana yaadadhaa.
english: the day that you stood before the LORD your God in Horeb, when the LORD said to me, “Assemble the people to me, and I will make them hear my words, that they may learn to fear me all the days that they live on the earth, and that they may teach their children.”

kikuyu: Isin utumaa tulluun sun bobaʼaa ibidda hamma wiirtuu samiitti ol baʼee duumessa gurraachaa fi dukkana limixiidhaan haguugamee jiruu itti dhiʼaattanii miilla tulluu sanaa jala dhadhaabattan.
english: You came near and stood under the mountain. The mountain burned with fire to the heart of the sky, with darkness, cloud, and thick darkness.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Waaqayyo ibidda keessaa isinitti dubbate. Isinis sagalee dubbii sanaa malee bifa tokko illee hin argine; sagalee tokko qofatu ture.
english: The LORD spoke to you out of the middle of the fire: you heard the voice of words, but you saw no form; you only heard a voice.

kikuyu: Innis kakuu isaa jechuunis Ajajawwan Kurnan akka isin isaan duukaa buutaniif isin ajaje sana isiniif labse. Ergasii immoo gabatee dhagaa lama irratti isaan barreesse.
english: He declared to you his covenant, which he commanded you to perform, even the ten commandments. He wrote them on two stone tablets.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos yeroo sanatti akka ani ajajawwanii fi seerawwan biyya isin Yordaanos ceetanii dhaaltan sana keessatti duukaa buʼuu qabdan isin barsiisu na ajaje.
english: The LORD commanded me at that time to teach you statutes and ordinances, that you might do them in the land where you go over to possess it.

kikuyu: Gaafa Waaqayyo Kooreeb irratti ibidda keessaa isinitti dubbatetti isin bifa tokko illee hin argine. Kanaafuu jabeessaa of eeggadhaa;
english: Be very careful, for you saw no kind of form on the day that the LORD spoke to you in Horeb out of the middle of the fire,

kikuyu: kunis akka isin hin xuroofne, akka Waaqa tolfamaa bifa dhiiraatiin yookaan dubartiitiin soofame kam iyyuu ofii keessaniif hin tolfanne
english: lest you corrupt yourselves, and make yourself a carved image in the form of any figure, the likeness of male or female,

kikuyu: yookaan horii lafa irra jiraatu yookaan simbira samii keessa barrisu kam iyyuu
english: the likeness of any animal that is on the earth, the likeness of any winged bird that flies in the sky,

kikuyu: yookaan uumama lafa irra munyuuqu kam iyyuu yookaan qurxummii lafa jala bishaan keessa jiraatu kam iyyuu hin tolfanneef.
english: the likeness of anything that creeps on the ground, the likeness of any fish that is in the water under the earth;

kikuyu: Ati yommuu samii ol ilaaltee aduu, jiʼa, urjiiwwanii fi raayyaa samii hunda argitutti gowwoomfamtee fuula waan Waaqayyo Waaqni kee saboota samiidhaa gadii hundaaf qoodee kennee duratti gad jettee hin sagadin.
english: and lest you lift up your eyes to the sky, and when you see the sun and the moon and the stars, even all the army of the sky, you are drawn away and worship them, and serve them, which the LORD your God has allotted to all the peoples under the whole sky.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu akka isin akkuma amma jirtan kana dhaala isaa taataniif badaa sibiila itti baqsan jechuunis biyya Gibxiitii baasee isin fide.
english: But the LORD has taken you, and brought you out of the iron furnace, out of Egypt, to be to him a people of inheritance, as it is today.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos sababii keessaniif natti dheekkamee akka ani laga Yordaanos ceʼee biyya gaarii kan Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan dhaala godhee isiniif kennu sana hin seenne kakate.
english: Furthermore the LORD was angry with me for your sakes, and swore that I should not go over the Jordan, and that I should not go in to that good land which the LORD your God gives you for an inheritance;

kikuyu: Ani biyyuma kanatti nan duʼa; ani Yordaanosin hin ceʼu; isin garuu ceetanii biyya gaarii sana dhaaluuf jirtu.
english: but I must die in this land. I must not go over the Jordan, but you shall go over and possess that good land.

kikuyu: Akka kakuu Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan isin wajjin gale sana hin daganne of eeggadhaa; waaqota tolfamoo Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan isin dhowwe bifa kamiin iyyuu ofii keessaniif hin tolfatinaa.
english: Be careful, lest you forget the covenant of the LORD your God, which he made with you, and make yourselves a carved image in the form of anything which the LORD your God has forbidden you.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan ibidda gubee balleessuudhaatii; Waaqa hinaafudhas.
english: For the LORD your God is a devouring fire, a jealous God.

kikuyu: Isin erga ijoollee fi ijoollee ijoollee keessanii hortanii biyya sana keessa bara dheeraa jiraattanii booddee, yoo xurooftanii fakkii waaqota tolfamoo bifa kamii iyyuu tolchitanii fuula Waaqayyo Waaqa keessanii duratti waan hamaa hojjettanii dheekkamsaaf isa kakaaftan,
english: When you father children and children’s children, and you have been long in the land, and then corrupt yourselves, and make a carved image in the form of anything, and do that which is evil in the LORD your God’s sight to provoke him to anger,

kikuyu: akka isin biyya Yordaanos ceetanii dhaaltan irraa ariitiidhaan dhabamtan ani guyyaa harʼaa samii fi lafa dhugaa baatota godhee isinitti nan waama. Iddoo sana yeroo dheeraa hin jiraattan; isin guutumaan guutuutti barbadooftu.
english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today, that you will soon utterly perish from off the land which you go over the Jordan to possess it. You will not prolong your days on it, but will utterly be destroyed.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos saboota keessa isin faffacaasa; saboota warra Waaqayyo isaan gidduutti isin faffacaase keessattis muraasa taatanii haftu.
english: The LORD will scatter you among the peoples, and you will be left few in number among the nations where the LORD will lead you away.

kikuyu: Isinis achitti waaqota harka namaatiin mukaa fi dhagaa irraa hojjetaman kanneen arguu yookaan dhagaʼuu yookaan nyaachuu yookaan fuunfachuu hin dandeenye waaqeffattu.
english: There you will serve gods, the work of men’s hands, wood and stone, which neither see, nor hear, nor eat, nor smell.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo achittis Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan barbaaddan ni argattu; isin yoo garaa fi yaada keessan guutuudhaan isa barbaaddan ni argattu.
english: But from there you shall seek the LORD your God, and you will find him when you search after him with all your heart and with all your soul.

kikuyu: Yommuu dhiphattee wanni kun hundi sitti dhufutti, baroota dhufuuf jiran keessa gara Waaqayyo Waaqa keetiitti ni deebita; isaafis ni ajajamta.
english: When you are in oppression, and all these things have come on you, in the latter days you shall return to the LORD your God and listen to his voice.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni kee Waaqa araaraa ti; inni si hin gatu yookaan si hin balleessu yookaan kakuu abbootii keetiif kakate sana hin dagatu.
english: For the LORD your God is a merciful God. He will not fail you nor destroy you, nor forget the covenant of your fathers which he swore to them.

kikuyu: Waaʼee baroota durii kan utuu ati hin dhalatin dura gaafa Waaqayyo lafa irratti nama uumee jalqabee ture sana iyyaafadhaa; daarii samii tokko irraa hamma daarii kaaniitti iyyaafadhaa. Wanni guddaan akkanaa takkumaa uumamee yookaan wanni akkanaa takkumaa dhagaʼamee beekaa?
english: For ask now of the days that are past, which were before you, since the day that God created man on the earth, and from the one end of the sky to the other, whether there has been anything as great as this thing is, or has been heard like it?

kikuyu: Sabni akka keessan sagalee Waaqaa kan ibidda keessaa dubbatu dhagaʼee lubbuudhaan jiraate kan biraa takkumaa argameeraa?
english: Did a people ever hear the voice of God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as you have heard, and live?

kikuyu: Waaqni kam iyyuu takkumaa akka Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan utuma iji keessan arguu biyya Gibxitti isinii godhe sana saba tokko saba biraa keessaa qorumsaan, mallattoo fi dinqiidhaan, waraanaan, harka jabaa fi irree diriirfameen, yookaan hojii guddaa fi sodaachisaadhaan baasee kan ofii isaa godhachuu yaale jira?
english: Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that the LORD your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?

kikuyu: Isinis Waaqayyo Waaqa taʼuu isaa akka beektaniif wantoonni kunneen isinitti argisiifaman; isa malees kan biraa hin jiru.
english: It was shown to you so that you might know that the LORD is God. There is no one else besides him.

kikuyu: Inni si adabachuuf jedhee samiidhaa sagalee isaa si dhageessise. Lafa irratti ibidda isaa guddicha sitti argisiisee atis ibidda keessaa dubbii isaa dhageesse.
english: Out of heaven he made you to hear his voice, that he might instruct you. On earth he made you to see his great fire; and you heard his words out of the middle of the fire.

kikuyu: Inni waan abbootii kee jaallatee isaan booddees sanyiiwwan isaanii filateef ofii isaatiin humna isaa guddaadhaan biyya Gibxiitii baasee isin fide;
english: Because he loved your fathers, therefore he chose their offspring after them, and brought you out with his presence, with his great power, out of Egypt;

kikuyu: kanas akka harʼa taʼee jiru kana saboota si caalaa gurguddaa fi jajjaboo si duraa ariʼee biyya isaanii dhaala godhee siif kennuuf itti si fide.
english: to drive out nations from before you greater and mightier than you, to bring you in, to give you their land for an inheritance, as it is today.

kikuyu: Harʼa akka Waaqayyo ol samii gubbaatti, gad lafa irrattis Waaqa taʼe beeki; garaa keettis qabadhu. Kan biraas hin jiru.
english: Know therefore today, and take it to heart, that the LORD himself is God in heaven above and on the earth beneath. There is no one else.

kikuyu: Akka sii fi ijoollee kee warra siʼiin duubaatiif toluu fi akka biyya Waaqayyo Waaqni kee bara baraan siif kennutti umuriin kee dheeratuuf qajeelchawwanii fi ajajawwan isaa kanneen ani harʼa siif kennu eegi.
english: You shall keep his statutes and his commandments which I command you today, that it may go well with you and with your children after you, and that you may prolong your days in the land which the LORD your God gives you for all time.

kikuyu: Yeroo sanatti Museen magaalaawwan baʼa Yordaanos sadii addaan baafate;
english: Then Moses set apart three cities beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise,

kikuyu: kunis lafa namni nama ajjeese yoo utuu itti hin yaadin nama ajjeese itti baqatuu dha. Innis magaalaawwan kanneen keessaa tokkotti baqatee lubbuu isaa oolfachuu dandaʼa.
english: that the man slayer might flee there, who kills his neighbor unintentionally and didn’t hate him in time past, and that fleeing to one of these cities he might live:

kikuyu: Magaalaawwan sunis kanneen turan: Bezer kan gammoojjii keessa tabba irra jirtu gosa Ruubeeniif, Raamooti kan Giliʼaaditti argamtu gosa Gaadiif, Goolaan kan Baashaanitti argamtu immoo gosa Minaaseef.
english: Bezer in the wilderness, in the plain country, for the Reubenites; and Ramoth in Gilead for the Gadites; and Golan in Bashan for the Manassites.

kikuyu: Kun Seera Museen Israaʼeloota dura kaaʼee dha.
english: This is the law which Moses set before the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Qajeelchi, ajajnii fi seerri Museen yommuu isaan biyya Gibxii baʼanitti Israaʼelootaaf kenne kanaa dha;
english: These are the testimonies, and the statutes, and the ordinances which Moses spoke to the children of Israel when they came out of Egypt,

kikuyu: kunis yeroo isaan Sulula Beet Pheʼoor biyya baʼa Yordaanositti argamtu keessa turanitti taʼe; biyyi kunis biyya Sihoon mootii Amoorotaa kan Heshboon keessa jiraachaa turee Musee fi Israaʼeloonni yeroo biyya Gibxii baʼanitti isa moʼatanii ti.
english: beyond the Jordan, in the valley opposite Beth Peor, in the land of Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived at Heshbon, whom Moses and the children of Israel struck when they came out of Egypt.

kikuyu: Isaanis biyya isaatii fi biyya Oogi mooticha Baashaan jechuunis biyyoota mootota Amoorii lamaan baʼa Yordaanositti argaman dhaala godhanii fudhatan.
english: They took possession of his land and the land of Og king of Bashan, the two kings of the Amorites, who were beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise;

kikuyu: Biyyi kunis Aroʼeer kan daarii Sulula Arnoonii jalqabee hamma Gaara Sihoonitti jechuunis hamma Hermooniitti balʼata;
english: from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, even to Mount Siyon (also called Hermon),

kikuyu: innis Arabbaa baʼa Yordaanosii hamma galaana Arabbaatti jiru kan tabba Phisgaatii gaditti argamu hunda dabalata.
english: and all the Arabah beyond the Jordan eastward, even to the sea of the Arabah, under the slopes of Pisgah.

kikuyu: Museen Israaʼeloota hunda walitti qabee akkana isaaniin jedhe: Yaa Israaʼel ajajawwanii fi seerawwan ani harʼa utuma isin dhageessanuu labsu kana dhagaʼaa. Baradhaatii jabeessaa isaan duukaa buʼaa.
english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them, “Hear, Israel, the statutes and the ordinances which I speak in your ears today, that you may learn them, and observe to do them.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya Kooreebitti nu wajjin kakuu gale.
english: The LORD our God made a covenant with us in Horeb.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo kakuu kana nu wajjin, nu warra harʼa lubbuudhaan as jiraannu hunda wajjin gale malee abbootii keenya wajjin hin galle.
english: The LORD didn’t make this covenant with our fathers, but with us, even us, who are all of us here alive today.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo tulluu irratti ibidda keessaa ifaan ifatti isinitti dubbate.
english: The LORD spoke with you face to face on the mountain out of the middle of the fire,

kikuyu: Yeroo sanatti waan isin ibidda sodaattanii tulluutti ol hin baʼiniif ani dubbii Waaqayyoo isinitti himuuf isinii fi Waaqayyo gidduun dhaabadhe. Innis akkana jedhe:
english: (I stood between the LORD and you at that time, to show you the LORD’s word; for you were afraid because of the fire, and didn’t go up onto the mountain) saying,

kikuyu: “Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa kee kan Gibxii, biyya garbummaatii si baasee dha.
english: “I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

kikuyu: “Ati ana malee waaqota biraa tokko illee hin qabaatin.
english: “You shall have no other gods before me.

kikuyu: Ati bifa waan ol samii gubbaa yookaan gad lafa irra yookaan bishaan lafa jalaa keessa jiru waaqa tolfamaa kamiitiin iyyuu ofii keetiif hin tolfatin.
english: “You shall not make a carved image for yourself—any likeness of what is in heaven above, or what is on the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth.

kikuyu: Isaaniif hin sagadin yookaan isaan hin waaqeffatin; ani Waaqayyo Waaqni kee, Waaqa hinaafu kan ijoollee warra na jibbanii sababii cubbuu abbootiitiif jedhee hamma dhaloota sadii fi afuriitti adabee
english: You shall not bow yourself down to them, nor serve them, for I, the LORD your God, am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers on the children and on the third and on the fourth generation of those who hate me

kikuyu: warra na jaallatanii ajajawwan koo eegan immoo hamma dhaloota kumaatti jaallatuu dha.
english: and showing loving kindness to thousands of those who love me and keep my commandments.

kikuyu: Maqaa Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii akkasumaan hin dhaʼin; Waaqayyo warra akkuma argan maqaa isaa dhaʼan utuu hin adabin hin dhiisuutii.
english: “You shall not misuse the name of the LORD your God; for the LORD will not hold him guiltless who misuses his name.

kikuyu: Akkuma Waaqayyo Waaqni kee si ajajetti guyyaa Sanbataa qulqulleessuudhaan eegi.
english: “Observe the Sabbath day, to keep it holy, as the LORD your God commanded you.

kikuyu: Guyyoota jaʼa hojjedhu; hojii kee hundas hojjetadhu;
english: You shall labor six days, and do all your work;

kikuyu: guyyaan torbaffaan garuu sanbata Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii ti. Gaafas hojii tokko illee hin hojjetin; ati yookaan ilmi kee yookaan intalli kee yookaan hojjetaan kee yookaan xomboreen kee yookaan qotiyyoon kee yookaan harreen kee yookaan horiin kee kam iyyuu yookaan alagaan magaalaa kee keessa jiraatu tokko iyyuu homaa hin hojjetin. Hojjetaan keetii fi hojjettuun kee akkuma kee haa boqotan.
english: but the seventh day is a Sabbath to the LORD your God, in which you shall not do any work—neither you, nor your son, nor your daughter, nor your male servant, nor your female servant, nor your ox, nor your donkey, nor any of your livestock, nor your stranger who is within your gates; that your male servant and your female servant may rest as well as you.

kikuyu: Akka atis biyya Gibxitti garba turtee fi ergasii immoo Waaqayyo Waaqni kee harka jabaa fi irree diriirfameen achii si baase yaadadhu. Kanaafuu Waaqayyo Waaqni kee akka ati Sanbata eegdu si ajaje.
english: You shall remember that you were a servant in the land of Egypt, and the LORD your God brought you out of there by a mighty hand and by an outstretched arm. Therefore the LORD your God commanded you to keep the Sabbath day.

kikuyu: Akka biyya Waaqayyo Waaqni kee siif kennu keessa bara dheeraa jiraattuu fi akka sitti toluuf akkuma Waaqayyo Waaqni kee si ajajetti abbaa keetii fi haadha keetiif ulfina kenni.
english: “Honor your father and your mother, as the LORD your God commanded you, that your days may be long and that it may go well with you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

kikuyu: Hin ajjeesin.
english: “You shall not murder.

kikuyu: Hin ejjin.
english: “You shall not commit adultery.

kikuyu: Hin hatin.
english: “You shall not steal.

kikuyu: Ollaa keetti sobaan dhugaa hin baʼin.
english: “You shall not give false testimony against your neighbor.

kikuyu: Niitii namaa hin hawwin. Mana namaa yookaan lafa qotiisaa yookaan hojjetaa yookaan xomboree isaa, qotiyyoo isaa yookaan harree isaa, yookaan waan namaa kam iyyuu hin hawwin.”
english: “You shall not covet your neighbor’s wife. Neither shall you desire your neighbor’s house, his field, or his male servant, or his female servant, his ox, or his donkey, or anything that is your neighbor’s.”

kikuyu: Ajajawwan Waaqayyo tulluu gubbaatti, ibidda, duumessaa fi dukkana limixii keessa waldaa keessan guutuutti sagalee guddaadhaan labse kanneenii dha; wanni inni itti dabales hin jiru. Ergasiis inni ajajawwan sana gabateewwan dhagaa lama irratti barreessee natti kenne.
english: The LORD spoke these words to all your assembly on the mountain out of the middle of the fire, of the cloud, and of the thick darkness, with a great voice. He added no more. He wrote them on two stone tablets, and gave them to me.

kikuyu: Yeroo isin utuu tulluun sun ibiddaan bobaʼuu dukkana keessaa sagalee sana dhageessanitti, hooggantoonni gosoota keessaniitii fi maanguddoonni keessan hundi gara koo dhufan.
english: When you heard the voice out of the middle of the darkness, while the mountain was burning with fire, you came near to me, even all the heads of your tribes, and your elders;

kikuyu: Isinis akkana jettan; “Kunoo Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya ulfinaa fi guddina isaa nu argisiiseera; ibidda keessaas sagalee isaa nu dhageessiseera. Nu harʼa akka namni yoo Waaqni isatti dubbate illee jiraachuu dandaʼu argineerra.
english: and you said, “Behold, the LORD our God has shown us his glory and his greatness, and we have heard his voice out of the middle of the fire. We have seen today that God does speak with man, and he lives.

kikuyu: Amma garuu nu maaliif duuna? Nu yoo sagalee Waaqayyo Waaqa keenyaa deebinee dhageenye ni duuna; ibiddii guddaan kunis nu barbadeessa.
english: Now therefore, why should we die? For this great fire will consume us. If we hear the LORD our God’s voice any more, then we shall die.

kikuyu: Nama duʼaa hin oolle hunda keessaa eenyutu takkumaa sagalee Waaqa jiraataa ibidda keessaa dubbatuu dhagaʼee akka nu dhageenyee jiraanne kana utuu hin duʼin hafe?
english: For who is there of all flesh who has heard the voice of the living God speaking out of the middle of the fire, as we have, and lived?

kikuyu: Itti dhiʼaadhuutii waan Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya jedhu hunda dhagaʼi. Ergasii immoo waan Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya sitti himu hunda nutti himi. Nu ni dhaggeeffannaa; ni ajajamnas.”
english: Go near, and hear all that the LORD our God shall say, and tell us all that the LORD our God tells you; and we will hear it, and do it.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo yommuu isin natti dubbattanitti isin dhagaʼeera; Waaqayyos akkana naan jedhe; “Ani waan namoonni kunneen siin jedhan dhagaʼeera. Wanni isaan jedhan hundinuu gaarii dha.
english: The LORD heard the voice of your words when you spoke to me; and the LORD said to me, “I have heard the voice of the words of this people which they have spoken to you. They have well said all that they have spoken.

kikuyu: Akka hamma bara baraatti isaanii fi ijoollee isaaniitti toluuf isaan utuu yeroo hunda garaa na sodaatee ajaja koo hunda eegu qabaatanii akkam gaarii ture!
english: Oh that there were such a heart in them that they would fear me and keep all my commandments always, that it might be well with them and with their children forever!

kikuyu: “Dhaqiitii, ‘Dunkaana keessanitti deebiʼaa’ jedhiin.
english: “Go tell them, ‘Return to your tents.’
