kikuyu: Musee fi maanguddoonni Israaʼel akkana jedhanii saba ajajan; “Ajajawwan ani harʼa isiniif kennu kanneen hunda eegaa.
english: Moses and the elders of Israel commanded the people, saying, “Keep all the commandment which I command you today.

kikuyu: Erga biyya Waaqayyo Waaqni kee siif kennutti galuuf Yordaanos ceetanii booddee dhagoota gurguddaa dhaabiitii nooraa dibi.
english: It shall be on the day when you shall pass over the Jordan to the land which the LORD your God gives you, that you shall set yourself up great stones, and coat them with plaster.

kikuyu: Yommuu akkuma Waaqayyo Waaqni abbootii keetii si abdachiisetti biyya aannanii fi dammi keessaa burqu kan Waaqayyo Waaqni kee siif kennutti galuuf ceetutti dubbiiwwan seera kanaa hunda dhagoota irratti barreessi.
english: You shall write on them all the words of this law, when you have passed over, that you may go in to the land which the LORD your God gives you, a land flowing with milk and honey, as the LORD, the God of your fathers, has promised you.

kikuyu: Ati erga Yordaanos ceetee booddee akkuma ani harʼa si ajajutti dhagoota kanneen Tulluu Eebaal irra dhaabii nooraa dibi.
english: It shall be, when you have crossed over the Jordan, that you shall set up these stones, which I command you today, on Mount Ebal, and you shall coat them with plaster.

kikuyu: Achittis Waaqayyo Waaqa keetiif iddoo aarsaa kan dhagaa irraa hojjetame dhaabi; miʼa sibiilaa tokko iyyuu hin fayyadamin.
english: There you shall build an altar to the LORD your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.

kikuyu: Iddoo aarsaa Waaqayyoo Waaqa keetii dhagaa hin soofaminiin hojjedhu; achi irrattis Waaqayyo Waaqa keetiif aarsaa gubamu dhiʼeessi.
english: You shall build the LORD your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Achittis aarsaa nagaa qalii nyaadhuutii fuula Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii duratti gammadi.
english: You shall sacrifice peace offerings, and shall eat there. You shall rejoice before the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Dhagoota irratti dubbiiwwan seera kanaa hunda ibsii barreessi.”
english: You shall write on the stones all the words of this law very plainly.”

kikuyu: Musee fi Lewwonni luboota taʼan Israaʼeloota hundaan akkana jedhan; “Yaa Israaʼel, calʼisii dhagaʼi! Ati harʼa saba Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii taateerta.
english: Moses and the Levitical priests spoke to all Israel, saying, “Be silent and listen, Israel! Today you have become the people of the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqa keetiif ajajamiitii ajajawwan isaatii fi qajeelchawwan ani harʼa siif kennu dhagaʼi.”
english: You shall therefore obey the LORD your God’s voice, and do his commandments and his statutes, which I command you today.”

kikuyu: Museenis gaafasuma akkana jedhee saba ajaje:
english: Moses commanded the people the same day, saying,

kikuyu: Yommuu isin Yordaanosin ceetanitti gosoonni Simiʼoon, Lewwii, Yihuudaa, Yisaakor, Yoosefii fi kan Beniyaam saba eebbisuuf gaara Gerziim irra haa dhaabatan.
english: “These shall stand on Mount Gerizim to bless the people, when you have crossed over the Jordan: Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Joseph, and Benjamin.

kikuyu: Gosoonni Ruubeen, Gaad, Aasheer, Zebuuloon, Daanii fi Niftaalem immoo abaaruuf Tulluu Eebaal irra haa dhaabatan.
english: These shall stand on Mount Ebal for the curse: Reuben, Gad, Asher, Zebulun, Dan, and Naphtali.

kikuyu: Lewwonni sagalee isaanii ol fudhatanii akkana jedhanii saba Israaʼel hundatti haa labsan:
english: With a loud voice, the Levites shall say to all the men of Israel,

kikuyu: “Namni fakkii soofu yookaan baqsee Waaqa tolfamaa jechuunis waan fuula Waaqayyoo duratti balfamaa taʼe hojjetu kan waan ogummaa harkaatiin hojjetame dhoksee ol dhaabu haa abaaramu.” Ergasiis sabni hundi, “Ameen!” haa jedhu.
english: ‘Cursed is the man who makes an engraved or molten image, an abomination to the LORD, the work of the hands of the craftsman, and sets it up in secret.’ All the people shall answer and say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: “Namni abbaa isaa yookaan haadha isaa qaanessu haa abaaramu.” Ergasiis sabni hundi, “Ameen!” haa jedhu.
english: ‘Cursed is he who dishonors his father or his mother.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: “Namni dhagaa daarii ollaa isaa dhiibu haa abaaramu.” Ergasiis sabni hundi, “Ameen!” haa jedhu.
english: ‘Cursed is he who removes his neighbor’s landmark.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: “Namni nama jaamaa karaa irraa jalʼisu haa abaaramu.” Ergasiis sabni hundi, “Ameen!” haa jedhu.
english: ‘Cursed is he who leads the blind astray on the road.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: “Namni murtii alagaa, ijoollee abbaa hin qabneetii fi niitota dhirsoonni isaanii irraa duʼanii jalʼisu haa abaaramu.” Ergasiis sabni hundi, “Ameen!” haa jedhu.
english: ‘Cursed is he who withholds justice from the foreigner, fatherless, and widow.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: “Namni niitii abbaa isaa wajjin ciisu haa abaaramu; inni siree abbaa isaa xureesseeraatii.” Ergasiis sabni hundi, “Ameen!” haa jedhu.
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his father’s wife, because he dishonors his father’s bed.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: “Namni horii kam iyyuu wajjin wal bira gaʼu haa abaaramu.” Ergasiis sabni hundi, “Ameen!” haa jedhu.
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with any kind of animal.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: “Namni obboleettii isaa intala abbaa isaa yookaan intala haadha isaa wajjin ciisu haa abaaramu.” Ergasiis sabni hundi, “Ameen!” haa jedhu.
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his sister, his father’s daughter or his mother’s daughter.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: “Namni haadha niitii isaa wajjin ciisu haa abaaramu.” Ergasiis sabni hundi, “Ameen!” haa jedhu.
english: ‘Cursed is he who lies with his mother-in-law.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: “Namni dhoksaadhaan ollaa isaa ajjeesu haa abaaramu.” Ergasiis sabni hundi, “Ameen!” haa jedhu.
english: ‘Cursed is he who secretly kills his neighbor.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: “Namni nama qulqulluu ajjeesuuf jedhee mattaʼaa fudhatu haa abaaramu.” Ergasiis sabni hundi, “Ameen!” haa jedhu.
english: ‘Cursed is he who takes a bribe to kill an innocent person.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’

kikuyu: “Namni dubbiiwwan seera kanaa eeguudhaan jabaatee hin dhaabanne haa abaaramu.” Ergasiis sabni hundi, “Ameen!” haa jedhu.
english: ‘Cursed is he who doesn’t uphold the words of this law by doing them.’ All the people shall say, ‘Amen.’”

kikuyu: Yoo ati guutumaan guutuutti Waaqayyo Waaqa keetiif ajajamtee ajajawwan isaa kanneen ani harʼa siif kennu of eeggannaadhaan duukaa buute, Waaqayyo Waaqni kee saboota lafa irra jiraatan hundaa olitti ol si qaba.
english: It shall happen, if you shall listen diligently to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments which I command you today, that the LORD your God will set you high above all the nations of the earth.

kikuyu: Yoo ati Waaqayyo Waaqa keetiif ajajamte eebbi kun hundi siif taʼa; si faana deemas:
english: All these blessings will come upon you, and overtake you, if you listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

kikuyu: Ati magaalaatti ni eebbifamta; baadiyyaattis ni eebbifamta.
english: You shall be blessed in the city, and you shall be blessed in the field.

kikuyu: Iji gadameessa keetii, iji lafa keetii, iji horii keetii, jabbiin loon keetiitii fi korbeeyyiin bushaayee keetii ni eebbifamu.
english: You shall be blessed in the fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the fruit of your animals, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock.

kikuyu: Guuboon keetii fi miʼi bukoo keetii ni eebbifamu.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough shall be blessed.

kikuyu: Ati yommuu galtu ni eebbifamta; yommuu baatus ni eebbifamta.
english: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akka diinonni kee kanneen sitti kaʼan fuula kee duratti moʼataman ni godha. Isaan karaa tokkoon sitti dhufu, garuu karaa torbaan si baqatu.
english: The LORD will cause your enemies who rise up against you to be struck before you. They will come out against you one way, and will flee before you seven ways.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo gombisaa keetii fi waan harki kee qabate hundatti eebba isaa ni erga. Waaqayyo Waaqni kee biyya siif kennu keessatti si eebbisa.
english: The LORD will command the blessing on you in your barns, and in all that you put your hand to. He will bless you in the land which the LORD your God gives you.

kikuyu: Yoo ati ajaja Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii eegdee karaa isaa irra deddeebite, Waaqayyo akkuma kakuudhaan si abdachiisetti saba isaa qulqulluu godhee si dhaaba.
english: The LORD will establish you for a holy people to himself, as he has sworn to you, if you shall keep the commandments of the LORD your God, and walk in his ways.

kikuyu: Ergasii saboonni lafa irra jiraatan hundi akka ati maqaa Waaqayyootiin waamamtu arganii si sodaatu.
english: All the peoples of the earth shall see that you are called by the LORD’s name, and they will be afraid of you.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo biyya siif kennuuf abbootii keetiif kakate keessatti ijoolleedhaan, jabbootaa fi midhaan lafaatiin sooruma irra dhangalaʼaa siif kenna.
english: The LORD will grant you abundant prosperity in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers to give you.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo yeroodhaan lafa keetti bokkaa ergee hojii harka keetii hunda eebbisuuf gombisaa badhaadhummaa isaa jechuunis samiiwwan ni bana. Ati saboota hedduudhaaf ni liqeessita malee tokkoo isaanii irraa iyyuu hin liqeeffattu.
english: The LORD will open to you his good treasure in the sky, to give the rain of your land in its season, and to bless all the work of your hand. You will lend to many nations, and you will not borrow.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo mataa si godha malee eegee si hin godhu. Ati yoo ajajawwan Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii kanneen ani harʼa siif kennu of eeggannaadhaan eegdee duukaa buute, yeroo hunda irra aanta malee jala hin aantu.
english: The LORD will make you the head, and not the tail. You will be above only, and you will not be beneath, if you listen to the commandments of the LORD your God which I command you today, to observe and to do,

kikuyu: Ati waaqota biraa duukaa buʼuu fi tajaajiluudhaan ajajawwan ani harʼa siif kennu kanneen irraa mirgattis bitaattis hin gorin.
english: and shall not turn away from any of the words which I command you today, to the right hand or to the left, to go after other gods to serve them.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo ati Waaqayyo Waaqa keetiif ajajamuu baattee ajajawwan isaatii fi qajeelchawwan isaa kanneen ani harʼa siif kennu hunda of eeggannaadhaan eeguu didde, abaarsawwan kunneen hundi si qaqqabu; si liqimsus:
english: But it shall come to pass, if you will not listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to observe to do all his commandments and his statutes which I command you today, that all these curses will come on you and overtake you.

kikuyu: Ati magaalaatti ni abaaramta; baadiyyaattis ni abaaramta.
english: You will be cursed in the city, and you will be cursed in the field.

kikuyu: Guuboon kee ni abaarama; miʼi bukoo keetiis ni abaarama.
english: Your basket and your kneading trough will be cursed.

kikuyu: Iji gadameessa keetii, iji lafa keetii, jabbiin loon keetiitii fi korbeeyyiin bushaayee keetii ni abaaramu.
english: The fruit of your body, the fruit of your ground, the increase of your livestock, and the young of your flock will be cursed.

kikuyu: Ati yommuu galtu ni abaaramta; yommuu baatu illee ni abaaramta.
english: You will be cursed when you come in, and you will be cursed when you go out.

kikuyu: Ati sababii isa dhiiftee waan hamaa hojjetteef Waaqayyo hamma ati barbadooftee daftees lafa irraa dhabamtutti waan harki kee hojjetu hundaan abaarsa, joonjaʼuu fi dheekkamsa sitti erga.
english: The LORD will send on you cursing, confusion, and rebuke in all that you put your hand to do, until you are destroyed and until you perish quickly, because of the evil of your doings, by which you have forsaken me.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo hamma biyya ati dhaaluuf itti galtu irraa si balleessutti dhukkubaan si dhaʼa.
english: The LORD will make the pestilence cling to you, until he has consumed you from off the land where you go in to possess it.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo hamma ati lafa irraa dhabamtutti, dhukkuba nama huqqisuun, dhagna gubaa fi dhullaadhaan, hoʼa aduutii fi bona hamaadhaan, coollaguu fi waagiidhaan si dhaʼa.
english: The LORD will strike you with consumption, with fever, with inflammation, with fiery heat, with the sword, with blight, and with mildew. They will pursue you until you perish.

kikuyu: Samiin mataa keetii olii naasii, lafti miilla kee jalaa sibiila taʼa.
english: Your sky that is over your head will be bronze, and the earth that is under you will be iron.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo bokkaa lafa keetii awwaaraa fi daaraatti geeddara; kunis hamma ati baddutti samiidhaa sitti gad harcaʼa.
english: The LORD will make the rain of your land powder and dust. It will come down on you from the sky, until you are destroyed.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akka ati diina kee duratti moʼatamtu godha. Ati karaa tokkoon isaanitti dhufta; garuu karaa torbaan isaan duraa baqatta; mootummoota lafa irra jiran hundaaf waan kolfaa taata.
english: The LORD will cause you to be struck before your enemies. You will go out one way against them, and will flee seven ways before them. You will be tossed back and forth among all the kingdoms of the earth.

kikuyu: Reeffi kee simbirroota samii hundaa fi bineensota lafaatiif nyaata taʼa; namni sodaachisee isaan ariʼus hin jiraatu.
english: Your dead bodies will be food to all birds of the sky, and to the animals of the earth; and there will be no one to frighten them away.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos dhukkuba ati hin fayyine jechuunis dhullaa biyya Gibxiitiin, iitaan, madaa malaʼuu fi cittoodhaan si dhiphisa.
english: The LORD will strike you with the boils of Egypt, with the tumors, with the scurvy, and with the itch, of which you can not be healed.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo maraatummaadhaan, jaamummaa fi burjaajaʼuu sammuutiin si dhiphisa.
english: The LORD will strike you with madness, with blindness, and with astonishment of heart.

kikuyu: Ati guyyaa saafaa akka jaamaa dukkana keessa waa qaqqabatuutti deemta; wanni ati hojjettu hundinuu siif hin milkaaʼu; guyyuma guyyaan cunqurfamtee saamamta; kan si oolchus hin jiru.
english: You will grope at noonday, as the blind gropes in darkness, and you shall not prosper in your ways. You will only be oppressed and robbed always, and there will be no one to save you.

kikuyu: Ati niitii kaadhimatta; garuu nama biraatu ishee wajjin ciisa. Mana ijaarratta; garuu keessa hin jiraattu. Wayinii dhaabbatta, garuu ija isaa hin nyaattu.
english: You will betroth a wife, and another man shall lie with her. You will build a house, and you won’t dwell in it. You will plant a vineyard, and not use its fruit.

kikuyu: Sangaan kee fuula kee duratti qalama; garuu ati foon isaa irraa homaa hin nyaattu. Harreen kee humnaan sirraa fudhatama; siif hin deebifamus. Hoolonni kee diinota keetiif kennamu; namni isaan harkaa buusus hin jiru.
english: Your ox will be slain before your eyes, and you will not eat any of it. Your donkey will be violently taken away from before your face, and will not be restored to you. Your sheep will be given to your enemies, and you will have no one to save you.

kikuyu: Ilmaanii fi intallan kee namoota ormaatiif kennamu; iji kees guyyuma guyyaan isaan eeguudhaan fajaja; ati harka ol fudhachuuf humna hin qabaattu.
english: Your sons and your daughters will be given to another people. Your eyes will look and fail with longing for them all day long. There will be no power in your hand.

kikuyu: Oomisha lafa keetiitii fi humna keetii hunda namoonni ati hin beekne ni nyaatu; ati bara jireenya keetii guutuu cunqurfamtee jiraachuu malee homaa hin qabaattu.
english: A nation which you don’t know will eat the fruit of your ground and all of your work. You will only be oppressed and crushed always,

kikuyu: Wanni ati argitu hundi si maraacha.
english: so that the sights that you see with your eyes will drive you mad.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo faana miilla keetiitii jalqabee hamma gubbaa mataa keetii gaʼutti madaa hin fayyine kan nama dhiphisuun jilbaa fi miilla kee ni dhaʼa.
english: The LORD will strike you in the knees and in the legs with a sore boil, of which you cannot be healed, from the sole of your foot to the crown of your head.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo siʼii fi mootii ati of irratti moosifte saboota ati yookaan abbootiin kee hin beekinitti ni kenna. Atis achitti waaqota biraa, waaqota mukaatii fi kan dhagaa ni waaqeffatta.
english: The LORD will bring you, and your king whom you will set over yourselves, to a nation that you have not known, you nor your fathers. There you will serve other gods of wood and stone.

kikuyu: Saboota Waaqayyo itti si geessu hunda keessatti waan qaanii, kan kolfaatii fi kan quba itti qaban ni taata.
english: You will become an astonishment, a proverb, and a byword among all the peoples where the LORD will lead you away.

kikuyu: Lafa qotiisaa kee keessa sanyii baayʼee facaafatta; garuu sababii hawwaannisni nyaatee fixuuf xinnoo walitti qabatta.
english: You will carry much seed out into the field, and will gather little in, for the locust will consume it.

kikuyu: Atis wayinii dhaabdee kunuunsita; garuu waan raammoon nyaatuuf daadhii isaa hin dhugdu yookaan ija isaa hin cirattu.
english: You will plant vineyards and dress them, but you will neither drink of the wine, nor harvest, because worms will eat them.

kikuyu: Biyya kee guutuu keessaa muka ejersaa qabaatta; garuu waan iji isaa lafatti harcaʼuuf ati zayitii isaatti hin fayyadamtu.
english: You will have olive trees throughout all your borders, but you won’t anoint yourself with the oil, for your olives will drop off.

kikuyu: Ati ilmaanii fi intallan qabaatta; garuu isaan waan boojiʼamaniif kan kee hin taʼan.
english: You will father sons and daughters, but they will not be yours, for they will go into captivity.

kikuyu: Mukaa fi oomisha lafa qotiisaa keetii hunda tuuta hawwaannisaatu fixa.
english: Locusts will consume all of your trees and the fruit of your ground.

kikuyu: Alagaan gidduu kee jiraatu si caalaa guddata; ati garuu gad deemta.
english: The foreigner who is among you will mount up above you higher and higher, and you will come down lower and lower.

kikuyu: Isatu siif liqeessa malee ati isaaf hin liqeessitu. Inni mataa taʼa; ati garuu eegee taata.
english: He will lend to you, and you won’t lend to him. He will be the head, and you will be the tail.

kikuyu: Abaarsi kun hundinuu si qaqqaba. Ati waan Waaqayyo Waaqa keetiif hin ajajamnee fi waan ajajawwanii fi qajeelchawwan inni siif kenne hin eeginiif hamma ati baddutti abaarsi kun si biraa hin hafu; si fudhatas.
english: All these curses will come on you, and will pursue you and overtake you, until you are destroyed, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which he commanded you.

kikuyu: Isaan bara baraan siʼii fi sanyii keetti mallattoo fi dinqii taʼu.
english: They will be for a sign and for a wonder to you and to your offspring forever.

kikuyu: Ati waan yeroo sooromaatti galataa fi gammachuudhaan Waaqayyo Waaqa kee hin tajaajiliniif,
english: Because you didn’t serve the LORD your God with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, by reason of the abundance of all things;

kikuyu: beelaa fi dheebuudhaan, daaraa fi hiyyummaa hamaadhaan diinota Waaqayyo sitti kaasu ni tajaajilta. Inni hamma si balleessutti waanjoo sibiilaa morma keetti kaaʼa.
english: therefore you will serve your enemies whom the LORD sends against you, in hunger, in thirst, in nakedness, and in lack of all things. He will put an iron yoke on your neck until he has destroyed you.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo biyya akka malee fagoo irraa, daarii lafaatiis saba akka risaa dafee gad buʼu kan ati afaan isaa hin beekne sitti kaasa;
english: The LORD will bring a nation against you from far away, from the end of the earth, as the eagle flies: a nation whose language you will not understand,

kikuyu: innis saba jaarsaaf ulfina hin kennine, kan daaʼimmaniif garaa hin laafnee fi kan akka malee sodaachisuu dha.
english: a nation of fierce facial expressions, that doesn’t respect the elderly, nor show favor to the young.

kikuyu: Isaanis hamma ati baddutti ija loon keetiitii fi ija lafa keetii ni nyaatu. Hamma ati barbadooftutti midhaan tokko iyyuu, daadhii wayinii haaraa yookaan zayitii, jabboota loon keetiitii fi korbeeyyii bushaayee keetii tokko illee siif hin dhiisan.
english: They will eat the fruit of your livestock and the fruit of your ground, until you are destroyed. They also won’t leave you grain, new wine, oil, the increase of your livestock, or the young of your flock, until they have caused you to perish.

kikuyu: Isaan magaalaa biyya keetii hunda hamma dallaawwan ittisaa kanneen ati amanattu jijjiganitti ni marsu; magaalaa biyya Waaqayyo Waaqni kee siif kennu keessa jiran hunda iyyuu ni marsu.
english: They will besiege you in all your gates until your high and fortified walls in which you trusted come down throughout all your land. They will besiege you in all your gates throughout all your land which the LORD your God has given you.

kikuyu: Ati sababii dhiphina diinonni kee yeroo si marsanitti sitti fidaniitiif ija gudeeda keetii, foon ilmaanii fi intallan keetii kanneen Waaqayyo Waaqni kee siif kennee ni nyaatta.
english: You will eat the fruit of your own body, the flesh of your sons and of your daughters, whom the LORD your God has given you, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemies will distress you.

kikuyu: Namni gidduu keetii akka malee gara laafessaa fi garraamii taʼe iyyuu obboleessa isaatiif yookaan niitii isaa kan jaallatuuf yookaan ijoollee isaa warra hafaniif garaa hin laafu;
english: The man who is tender among you, and very delicate, his eye will be evil toward his brother, toward the wife whom he loves, and toward the remnant of his children whom he has remaining,

kikuyu: inni foon ijoollee isaa kan nyaachaa jiru irraa xinnoo ishee illee tokkoo isaaniitiif iyyuu hin kennu. Sababii dhiphina diinonni kee yeroo magaalaawwan kee hunda marsanitti sirraan gaʼaniitiif wanni isaaf hafe kanuma qofaatii.
english: so that he will not give to any of them of the flesh of his children whom he will eat, because he has nothing left to him, in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in all your gates.

kikuyu: Niitiin arjaa fi boontuun gidduu kee jiraattu kan sababii akka malee arjaa fi boontuu taateef miilla isheetiin lafa hin tuqne iyyuu dhirsa ishee kan jaallattutti, ilma isheetii fi intala isheetti illee ni hammaatti;
english: The tender and delicate woman among you, who would not venture to set the sole of her foot on the ground for delicateness and tenderness, her eye will be evil toward the husband that she loves, toward her son, toward her daughter,

kikuyu: isheen hobbaatii garaa isheetii baʼuu fi ijoollee deessu illee ni jibbiti. Sababiin isheen waan kana gootuufis yeroo marfamaa fi rakkinaatti, yommuu diinonni kee magaalaa kee keessatti si dhiphisanitti dhoksitee nyaachuuf jettee ti.
english: toward her young one who comes out from between her feet, and toward her children whom she bears; for she will eat them secretly for lack of all things in the siege and in the distress with which your enemy will distress you in your gates.

kikuyu: Yoo ati of eeggannaadhaan dubbiiwwan seera kanaa kanneen kitaaba kana keessatti barreeffaman hunda duukaa buʼuu dhiiftee maqaa Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii kabajamaa fi sodaachisaa sana sodaachuu baatte,
english: If you will not observe to do all the words of this law that are written in this book, that you may fear this glorious and fearful name, THE LORD your God,

kikuyu: Waaqayyo siʼii fi sanyii keetti dhaʼicha sodaachisaa, balaa dhiphisaa fi kan yeroo dheeraa turu, dhukkuba akka malee hamaa fi dafee hin fayyine ni erga.
english: then the LORD will make your plagues and the plagues of your offspring fearful, even great plagues, and of long duration, and severe sicknesses, and of long duration.

kikuyu: Dhukkuboota Gibxi kanneen ati sodaattus sitti fida; isaanis ciniinanii sitti qabatu.
english: He will bring on you again all the diseases of Egypt, which you were afraid of; and they will cling to you.

kikuyu: Akkasumas hamma ati dhabamtutti Waaqayyo dhukkubootaa fi rakkinnoota biraa kanneen Kitaaba Seeraa kana keessatti hin barreeffamin sitti fida.
english: Also every sickness and every plague which is not written in the book of this law, the LORD will bring them on you until you are destroyed.

kikuyu: Isin sababii Waaqayyo Waaqa keessaniif ajajamuu diddaniif isin warra akka urjiiwwan samii baayʼattanii turtan keessaa xinnootu hafa.
english: You will be left few in number, even though you were as the stars of the sky for multitude, because you didn’t listen to the LORD your God’s voice.

kikuyu: Akkuma isin sooromsuu fi isin baayʼisuun Waaqayyo gammachiisu sana isin balleessuu fi isin barbadeessuunis isa gammachiisa. Isin biyya dhaaluuf itti galtan keessaa ni buqqaatu.
english: It will happen that as the LORD rejoiced over you to do you good, and to multiply you, so the LORD will rejoice over you to cause you to perish and to destroy you. You will be plucked from the land that you are going in to possess.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Waaqayyo daarii lafaa tokko irraa hamma daarii lafaa kaaniitti saboota hunda gidduutti si bittinneessa. Ati achitti waaqota biraa, waaqota mukaatii fi kan dhagaa kanneen atii fi abbootiin kee hin beekin ni waaqeffatta.
english: The LORD will scatter you among all peoples, from one end of the earth to the other end of the earth. There you will serve other gods which you have not known, you nor your fathers, even wood and stone.

kikuyu: Ati saboota sana gidduutti boqonnaa hin argattu; lafa kophee miilla keetii irra keeyyattu illee hin argattu. Achittis Waaqayyo sammuu dhiphatu, ija hawwiidhaan fajajuu fi garaa abdii kutatu siif kenna.
english: Among these nations you will find no ease, and there will be no rest for the sole of your foot; but the LORD will give you there a trembling heart, failing of eyes, and pining of soul.

kikuyu: Ati halkanii guyyaa sodaadhaan qabamtee utuu lubbuun kee wabii hin argatin, yeroo hunda yaaddoodhaan jiraatta.
english: Your life will hang in doubt before you. You will be afraid night and day, and will have no assurance of your life.

kikuyu: Sababii sodaa garaa kee guutuu sanaatii fi waan ija keetiin argitu sanaatiif ganama, “Utuu bariʼuu baatee!” galgala immoo, “Utuu dhiʼuu baatee!” jetta.
english: In the morning you will say, “I wish it were evening!” and at evening you will say, “I wish it were morning!” for the fear of your heart which you will fear, and for the sights which your eyes will see.

kikuyu: Karaa ani ati lammata as hin deebitu siin jedheenis Waaqayyo dooniidhaan Gibxitti si deebisa. Achittis akka garboota dhiiraa dubartiitti diinota keessanitti gurguramuuf of dhiʼeessitu; garuu namni tokko iyyuu isin hin bitatu.
english: The LORD will bring you into Egypt again with ships, by the way of which I told you that you would never see it again. There you will offer yourselves to your enemies for male and female slaves, and nobody will buy you.

kikuyu: Dubbiin kakuu kan Waaqayyo kakuu Kooreebitti isaan wajjin gale sana irratti dabalee akka inni Moʼaab keessatti Israaʼeloota wajjin galuuf Musee ajaje kanaa dha.
english: These are the words of the covenant which the LORD commanded Moses to make with the children of Israel in the land of Moab, in addition to the covenant which he made with them in Horeb.

kikuyu: Museen Israaʼeloota hunda walitti waamee akkana jedheen: Waan Waaqayyo Gibxi keessatti Faraʼoon irratti, qondaaltota isaa hundaa fi guutummaa biyya isaa irratti hojjete hunda iji keessan argeera.
english: Moses called to all Israel, and said to them: Your eyes have seen all that the LORD did in the land of Egypt to Pharaoh, and to all his servants, and to all his land;

kikuyu: Isin qorumsawwan gurguddaa sana, mallattoowwanii fi dinqiiwwan gurguddaa sana ijuma keessaniin argitaniirtu.
english: the great trials which your eyes saw, the signs, and those great wonders.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu hamma harʼaatti qalbii hubatu yookaan ija argitu yookaan gurra dhagaʼu isinii hin kennine.
english: But the LORD has not given you a heart to know, eyes to see, and ears to hear, to this day.

kikuyu: Yeroo waggoota afurtamman ani gammoojjii keessa isin geggeesse sanatti uffanni keessan isin irratti hin dhumne yookaan kopheen miilla keessan irratti hin ciccinne.
english: I have led you forty years in the wilderness. Your clothes have not grown old on you, and your sandals have not grown old on your feet.

kikuyu: Isin buddeena hin nyaanne; daadhii wayinii yookaan dhugaatii nama macheessu hin dhugne. Ani akka isin akka ani Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan taʼe beektaniifan waan kana godhe.
english: You have not eaten bread, neither have you drunk wine or strong drink, that you may know that I am the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Yommuu isin as geessanitti Sihoon mootiin Heshboonii fi Oogi mootiin Baashaan nu loluuf nutti baʼan; nu garuu isaan moʼanne.
english: When you came to this place, Sihon the king of Heshbon and Og the king of Bashan came out against us to battle, and we struck them.

kikuyu: Biyya isaaniis fudhannee gosa Ruubeeniif, gosa Gaadii fi walakkaa gosa Minaaseetiif dhaala goonee kennine.
english: We took their land, and gave it for an inheritance to the Reubenites, and to the Gadites, and to the half-tribe of the Manassites.

kikuyu: Isin akka waan hojjettan hundaan milkooftaniif dubbiiwwan kakuu kanaa of eeggannaadhaan duukaa buʼaa.
english: Therefore keep the words of this covenant and do them, that you may prosper in all that you do.

kikuyu: Hundi keessan jechuunis qajeelchitoonnii fi hooggantoonni keessan, maanguddoonnii fi qondaaltonni keessan akkasumas namoonni Israaʼel kanneen biraa hundinuu harʼa fuula Waaqayyo Waaqa keessanii dura dhaabattaniirtu;
english: All of you stand today in the presence of the LORD your God: your heads, your tribes, your elders, and your officers, even all the men of Israel,

kikuyu: ijoolleen keessanii fi niitonni keessan akkasumas alagoonni muka kee ciraa, bishaan kees waraabaa qubata kee keessa jiraatan si wajjin dhaabataniiru.
english: your little ones, your wives, and the foreigners who are in the middle of your camps, from the one who cuts your wood to the one who draws your water,

kikuyu: Atis kakuu Waaqayyo harʼa si wajjin galee kakaadhaan siif mirkaneessu kana Waaqayyo Waaqa kee wajjin galuuf as dhaabatteerta;
english: that you may enter into the covenant of the LORD your God, and into his oath, which the LORD your God makes with you today,

kikuyu: innis akkuma si abdachiisee abbootii kee Abrahaamiif, Yisihaaqii fi Yaaqoobiif waadaa gale sanatti akka ati saba isaa taatee innis Waaqa kee taʼuuf jabeessee si dhaabuuf waan kana godhe.
english: that he may establish you today as his people, and that he may be your God, as he spoke to you and as he swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob.

kikuyu: Anis kakuu kakaadhaan mirkanaaʼe kana isin qofa wajjin utuu hin taʼin,
english: Neither do I make this covenant and this oath with you only,

kikuyu: warra nu wajjin as fuula Waaqayyo Waaqa keenyaa dura dhaabatan warra harʼa as hin jirre wajjinis nan gala.
english: but with those who stand here with us today before the LORD our God, and also with those who are not here with us today

kikuyu: Akka nu itti Gibxi keessa jiraannee fi yommuu as dhufnus akka nu itti biyyoota keessa dabarre isin mataan keessanuu ni beektu.
english: (for you know how we lived in the land of Egypt, and how we came through the middle of the nations through which you passed;

kikuyu: Isinis gidduu isaaniitti fakkiiwwan isaanii jibbisiisoo, waaqota isaanii tolfamoo kanneen muka, dhagaa, meetii fi warqee irraa hojjetaman argitaniirtu.
english: and you have seen their abominations and their idols of wood, stone, silver, and gold, which were among them);

kikuyu: Akka dhiirri yookaan dubartiin balballi yookaan gosti garaan isaa Waaqayyo Waaqa keenya irraa garagalee waaqota saboota sanaa faana buʼe isin gidduu hin jiraanne mirkaneeffadhaa; akka hiddi summii hadhaaʼaa akkasii baasu tokko iyyuu isin gidduu hin jiraanne qulqulleeffadhaa.
english: lest there should be among you man, woman, family, or tribe whose heart turns away today from the LORD our God, to go to serve the gods of those nations; lest there should be among you a root that produces bitter poison;

kikuyu: Namni akkasii yommuu dubbii kakuu kanaa dhagaʼutti, garaa isaatti of eebbisee, “Ani yoon akka fedhii kootti deeme illee nagaa qaba” jedhee yaada. Kun immoo lafa jiidhaa irrattis taʼu lafa goggogaa irratti badiisa fida.
english: and it happen, when he hears the words of this curse, that he bless himself in his heart, saying, “I shall have peace, though I walk in the stubbornness of my heart,” to destroy the moist with the dry.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo nama sanaaf gonkumaa dhiifama hin godhu; dheekkamsi isaatii fi hinaaffaan isaa namicha sana irratti bobaʼa. Abaarsi kitaaba kana keessatti barreeffame hundi isa qaqqaba; Waaqayyos samii jalaa maqaa isaa ni dhabamsiisa.
english: The LORD will not pardon him, but then the LORD’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse that is written in this book will fall on him, and the LORD will blot out his name from under the sky.

kikuyu: Akkuma kakuu abaarsa Kitaaba Seeraa kana keessatti barreeffame hundaatti, Waaqayyo gosoota Israaʼel hunda keessaa badiisaaf kophaatti isa baasa.
english: The LORD will set him apart for evil out of all the tribes of Israel, according to all the curses of the covenant written in this book of the law.

kikuyu: Dhaloonni itti aanu jechuunis ijoolleen keessan warri isiniin duuba dhufan akkasumas keessummoonni biyyoota fagootii dhufan dhaʼicha guddaa biyyattii irra gaʼee fi dhukkuba Waaqayyo ittiin ishee dhaʼe ni argu.
english: The generation to come—your children who will rise up after you, and the foreigner who will come from a far land—will say, when they see the plagues of that land, and the sicknesses with which the LORD has made it sick,

kikuyu: Guutummaan biyyattii gammoojjii gubduu kan soogiddaa fi dinyiin guutamte kan wanni tokko iyyuu irra hin dhaabamne, kan wanni tokko iyyuu irratti hin biqille, kan biqiltuun tokko iyyuu irratti hin guddanne taati. Badiisni ishee irra gaʼus akka badiisa Sodoomiitii fi Gomoraa, Adimaatii fi Zebooʼiim kanneen Waaqayyo dheekkamsa guddaadhaan isaan barbadeesse sanaa ni taʼa.
english: that all of its land is sulfur, salt, and burning, that it is not sown, doesn’t produce, nor does any grass grow in it, like the overthrow of Sodom, Gomorrah, Admah, and Zeboiim, which the LORD overthrew in his anger, and in his wrath.

kikuyu: Sabni hundinuu, “Waaqayyo maaliif waan akkasii biyya kanatti fide? Dheekkamsi sodaachisaan bobaʼu kunis maaliif dhufe?” jedhanii gaafatu.
english: Even all the nations will say, “Why has the LORD done this to this land? What does the heat of this great anger mean?”

kikuyu: Deebiin isaas kana taʼa; “Kun sababii sabni kun kakuu Waaqayyo Waaqni abbootii isaanii yeroo Gibxii isaan baasetti isaan wajjin gale sana dhiisaniif.
english: Then men will say, “Because they abandoned the covenant of the LORD, the God of their fathers, which he made with them when he brought them out of the land of Egypt,

kikuyu: Isaanis dhaqanii waaqota biraa, kanneen hin beekiniif waaqota inni isaaniif hin kennin waaqeffatan; gad jedhaniis sagadaniif.
english: and went and served other gods and worshiped them, gods that they didn’t know and that he had not given to them.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu dheekkamsi Waaqayyoo biyya kanatti bobaʼee akka inni abaarsa kitaaba kana keessatti barreeffame hunda itti fidu godhe.
english: Therefore the LORD’s anger burned against this land, to bring on it all the curses that are written in this book.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos aarii sodaachisaa fi dheekkamsa guddaadhaan biyya isaaniitii isaan buqqise; akkuma amma jiru kanattis biyya biraatti isaan darbate.”
english: The LORD rooted them out of their land in anger, in wrath, and in great indignation, and thrust them into another land, as it is today.”

kikuyu: Wanti dhoksaan kan Waaqayyo Waaqa keenyaa ti; kan mulʼifame garuu akka nu dubbii seera kanaa hunda eegnuuf bara baraan kan keenyaa fi kan ijoollee keenyaa ti.
english: The secret things belong to the LORD our God; but the things that are revealed belong to us and to our children forever, that we may do all the words of this law.

kikuyu: Yommuu eebbii fi abaarsi ani fuula kee dura kaaʼe kun hundi si argatee ati saboota Waaqayyo Waaqni kee keessatti si bittinneessu hunda gidduu jiraatutti yoo ati waan sana yaadattu,
english: It shall happen, when all these things have come on you, the blessing and the curse, which I have set before you, and you shall call them to mind among all the nations where the LORD your God has driven you,

kikuyu: yommuu atii fi ijoolleen kee gara Waaqayyo Waaqa keetiitti deebitanii akkuma waan ani harʼa isin ajaju hundaatti garaa keessanii fi lubbuu keessan guutuudhaan isaaf ajajamtan,
english: and return to the LORD your God and obey his voice according to all that I command you today, you and your children, with all your heart and with all your soul,

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni kee boojuu kee siif deebisee garaa siif laafuudhaan saboota gidduu isaaniitti si bittinneesse hunda keessaa deebisee walitti si qaba.
english: that then the LORD your God will release you from captivity, have compassion on you, and will return and gather you from all the peoples where the LORD your God has scattered you.

kikuyu: Yoo ati samii jalatti lafa akka malee fagootti geeffamtee jiraatte illee Waaqayyo Waaqni kee walitti si qaba; deebisees si fida.
english: If your outcasts are in the uttermost parts of the heavens, from there the LORD your God will gather you, and from there he will bring you back.

kikuyu: Inni biyya abbootii keetiitti si galcha; atis ni dhaalta. Inni abbootii kee caalaa si sooromsa; akka malee si baayʼisas.
english: The LORD your God will bring you into the land which your fathers possessed, and you will possess it. He will do you good, and increase your numbers more than your fathers.

kikuyu: Akka ati garaa kee guutuudhaan, lubbuu kee guutuudhaan isa jaallattee jiraattuuf Waaqayyo Waaqni kee garaa keetii fi garaa sanyiiwwan keetii dhagna ni qaba.
english: The LORD your God will circumcise your heart, and the heart of your offspring, to love the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul, that you may live.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni kee abaarsa kana hunda warra si jibbanii si rakkisan irra ni kaaʼa.
english: The LORD your God will put all these curses on your enemies and on those who hate you, who persecuted you.

kikuyu: Atis deebitee Waaqayyoof ni ajajamta; ajaja isaa kanneen ani harʼa si ajaju hundas ni eegda.
english: You shall return and obey the LORD’s voice, and do all his commandments which I command you today.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Waaqayyo Waaqni kee hojii harka keetii hundaa fi ijoollee gudeeda keetii baʼaniin, jabboota keetii fi midhaan lafa qotiisaa keetiitiin si sooromsa. Waaqayyo akkuma abbootii keetti gammade sana sittis gammadee si sooromsa;
english: The LORD your God will make you prosperous in all the work of your hand, in the fruit of your body, in the fruit of your livestock, and in the fruit of your ground, for good; for the LORD will again rejoice over you for good, as he rejoiced over your fathers,

kikuyu: kunis yoo ati Waaqayyo Waaqa keetiif ajajamtee ajajawwanii fi qajeelchawwan isaa kanneen Kitaaba Seeraa kana keessatti barreeffaman eeguudhaan garaa kee guutuu fi lubbuu kee guutuudhaan gara Waaqayyo Waaqa keetiitti deebite taʼa.
english: if you will obey the LORD your God’s voice, to keep his commandments and his statutes which are written in this book of the law, if you turn to the LORD your God with all your heart and with all your soul.

kikuyu: Wanni ani harʼa si ajaju kun rakkisaa yookaan kan sirraa fagaate miti.
english: For this commandment which I command you today is not too hard for you or too distant.

kikuyu: Akka ati, “Akka nu dhageenyee isa eegnuuf eenyutu gara samiitti ol baʼee fidee nutti hima?” jettee hin gaafanneef inni ol samii gubbaa hin jiru.
english: It is not in heaven, that you should say, “Who will go up for us to heaven, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

kikuyu: Yookaan akka ati, “Akka nu dhageenyee isa eegnuuf eenyutu galaana ceʼee fidee nutti hima?” jettee hin gaafanneef inni galaana gama hin jiru.
english: Neither is it beyond the sea, that you should say, “Who will go over the sea for us, bring it to us, and proclaim it to us, that we may do it?”

kikuyu: Dubbiin sun garuu baayʼee sitti dhiʼoo jira; akka ati isa eegduufis inni afaan keetii fi garaa kee keessa jira.
english: But the word is very near to you, in your mouth and in your heart, that you may do it.

kikuyu: Kunoo ani harʼa jireenyaa fi eebba, duʼaa fi badiisa fuula kee dura kaaʼeera.
english: Behold, I have set before you today life and prosperity, and death and evil.

kikuyu: Ani akka ati Waaqayyo Waaqa kee jaallattu, akka karaa isaa irras deemtuu fi akka ati ajajawwan isaa, qajeelchawwan isaatii fi seerawwan isaa eegdu si ajaja; ergasiis ati lubbuun jiraattee ni baayʼatta; Waaqayyo Waaqni kees biyya ati dhaaluuf itti galtutti si eebbisa.
english: For I command you today to love the LORD your God, to walk in his ways and to keep his commandments, his statutes, and his ordinances, that you may live and multiply, and that the LORD your God may bless you in the land where you go in to possess it.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo yaadni kee karaa irraa jalʼatee ati ajajamuu baatte, yoo ati waaqota kaan waaqeffachuu fi isaan tajaajiluuf jettee fudhatamte,
english: But if your heart turns away, and you will not hear, but are drawn away and worship other gods, and serve them,

kikuyu: ani akka isin dhugumaan baddan harʼa isinittin hima. Isin Yordaanosin ceetanii biyya itti galtanii dhaaltan keessas bara dheeraa hin jiraattan.
english: I declare to you today that you will surely perish. You will not prolong your days in the land where you pass over the Jordan to go in to possess it.

kikuyu: Ani akkan jireenyaa fi duʼa, eebbaa fi abaarsa fuula kee dura kaaʼee jiru harʼa samii fi lafa ragaan godhee sitti waama. Egaa atii fi ijoolleen kee akka jiraattaniif jireenya filadhu;
english: I call heaven and earth to witness against you today that I have set before you life and death, the blessing and the curse. Therefore choose life, that you may live, you and your descendants,

kikuyu: kunis akka ati Waaqayyo Waaqa kee jaallatuuf, akka dubbii isaa dhageessee isatti maxxantee jiraattuuf. Waaqayyo sababii jireenya kee taʼeef, biyya abbootii kee Abrahaamiif, Yisihaaqii fi Yaaqoobiif kennuuf kakateef sana keessatti bara dheeraa siif kenna.
english: to love the LORD your God, to obey his voice, and to cling to him; for he is your life, and the length of your days, that you may dwell in the land which the LORD swore to your fathers, to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, to give them.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Museen dhaqee dubbii kana Israaʼel hundatti dubbate:
english: Moses went and spoke these words to all Israel.

kikuyu: “Ani amma nama waggaa dhibbaa fi digdamaa ti; siʼachis isin hoogganuu hin dandaʼu. Waaqayyo, ‘Ati Yordaanos hin ceetu’ naan jedheera.
english: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. The LORD has said to me, ‘You shall not go over this Jordan.’

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni kee mataan isaa si dura ni ceʼa. Inni saboota kanneen fuula kee duraa ni barbadeessa; atis biyya isaanii ni dhaalta. Akkuma Waaqayyo jedhetti, Iyyaasuunis si dura ni ceʼa.
english: The LORD your God himself will go over before you. He will destroy these nations from before you, and you shall dispossess them. Joshua will go over before you, as the LORD has spoken.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akkuma Sihoonii fi Oogi mootota Amoorotaa sana biyya isaanii wajjin balleesse sana isaan kanneenis ni balleessa.
english: The LORD will do to them as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, and to their land, when he destroyed them.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo dabarsee harka keessanitti isaan kenna; isinis waan ani isin ajaje hunda isaan gochuu qabdu.
english: The LORD will deliver them up before you, and you shall do to them according to all the commandment which I have commanded you.

kikuyu: Cimaa; jabaadhaa. Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan isin wajjin deemaatii isin sababii isaaniitiif jettanii hin sodaatinaa yookaan hin rifatinaa; inni gonkumaa isin hin dhiisu yookaan isin hin gatu.”
english: Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them, for the LORD your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Museen Iyyaasuu ofitti waamee fuula Israaʼel hundaa duratti akkana jedheen; “Ati sababii biyya Waaqayyo isaaniif kennuuf abbootii isaaniitiif kakatetti galuuf saba kana wajjin deemtuuf cimi; jabaadhus; biyyattiis akka dhaalan godhi.
english: Moses called to Joshua, and said to him in the sight of all Israel, “Be strong and courageous, for you shall go with this people into the land which the LORD has sworn to their fathers to give them; and you shall cause them to inherit it.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo mataan isaa si dura ni deema; si wajjinis ni jiraata; inni si hin dhiisu yookaan si hin gatu. Hin sodaatin; abdiis hin kutatin.”
english: The LORD himself is who goes before you. He will be with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you. Don’t be afraid. Don’t be discouraged.”

kikuyu: Museenis seera kana barreessee ilmaan Lewwii kanneen luboota taʼanii taabota kakuu Waaqayyoo baatanii fi maanguddoota Israaʼel hundatti kenne.
english: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, and to all the elders of Israel.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Museen akkana jedhee isaan ajaje; “Dhuma waggaa torbaffaatti, yeroo itti gatiin dhiifamutti, yeroo itti Ayyaanni Daasii ayyaaneffamutti,
english: Moses commanded them, saying, “At the end of every seven years, in the set time of the year of release, in the feast of booths,

kikuyu: yommuu Israaʼel hundi fuula Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii duratti mulʼachuuf lafa inni filatu dhufanitti akka isaan dhagaʼaniif fuula isaanii duratti seera kana isaanii dubbifta.
english: when all Israel has come to appear before the LORD your God in the place which he will choose, you shall read this law before all Israel in their hearing.

kikuyu: Akka isaan dubbii seera kanaa hunda dhagaʼanii Waaqayyo Waaqa kee sodaachuu baratanii fi of eeggannaadhaan faana buʼaniif namoota jechuunis dhiirota, dubartoota, ijoollee fi alagoota magaalaawwan kee keessa jiraatan walitti qabi.
english: Assemble the people, the men and the women and the little ones, and the foreigners who are within your gates, that they may hear, learn, fear the LORD your God, and observe to do all the words of this law,

kikuyu: Bara isin biyya Yordaanos ceetanii dhaaltan keessa jiraattan guutuu ijoolleen isaanii kanneen seera kana hin beeknes dhagaʼuu fi Waaqayyo Waaqa isaanii sodaachuu barachuu qabu.”
english: and that their children, who have not known, may hear and learn to fear the LORD your God, as long as you live in the land where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Museedhaan, “Yeroon ati duutu dhiʼaateera. Akka ani waan inni hojjechuu malu itti himuuf Iyyaasuu waamiitii dunkaana wal gaʼii biratti dhiʼaadhaa” jedhe. Musee fi Iyyaasuunis dhufanii dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti dhiʼaatan.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of Meeting, that I may commission him.” Moses and Joshua went, and presented themselves in the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo utubaa duumessaatiin dhufee dunkaanicha keessatti mulʼate; duumessi sunis balbala dunkaanichaa dura dhaabate.
english: The LORD appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, and the pillar of cloud stood over the Tent’s door.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Museedhaan akkana jedhe; “Ati abbootii kee wajjin ni boqotta; sabni kun immoo yommuu suma biyya dhaaluuf itti galutti waaqota Namoota Ormaa duukaa buʼee sagaagaluu jalqaba. Isaan na dhiisanii kakuu ani isaan wajjin gale ni cabsu.
english: The LORD said to Moses, “Behold, you shall sleep with your fathers. This people will rise up and play the prostitute after the strange gods of the land where they go to be among them, and will forsake me and break my covenant which I have made with them.

kikuyu: Gaafas ani isaanitti aaree isaan nan dhiisa; fuula koos isaan duraa nan dhoksa; isaanis ni barbadeeffamu. Badiisaa fi rakkoo baayʼeetu isaanitti dhufa; isaanis gaafasi, ‘Badiisni kun waan Waaqni keenya nu wajjin hin jirreef nutti dhufe mitii?’ jedhanii gaafatu.
english: Then my anger shall be kindled against them in that day, and I will forsake them, and I will hide my face from them, and they shall be devoured, and many evils and troubles shall come on them; so that they will say in that day, ‘Haven’t these evils come on us because our God is not among us?’

kikuyu: Waan isaan gara waaqota biraatti garagalaniif ani sababii hammina isaanii hundaatiif guutumaan guutuutti fuula koo isaan duraa nan dhokfadha.
english: I will surely hide my face in that day for all the evil which they have done, in that they have turned to other gods.

kikuyu: “Akka isaanitti ragaa naa taʼuuf, faarfannaa kana barreeffadhuutii akka isaan faarfataniif Israaʼeloota barsiisi.
english: “Now therefore write this song for yourselves, and teach it to the children of Israel. Put it in their mouths, that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Yommuu ani biyya aannanii fi dammi keessaa burqu kan ani abbootii isaaniitiif kakuudhaan waadaa galetti isaan fidutti isaan nyaatanii quufanii narraa garagaluudhaan waaqota biraa waaqeffatu; na dhiisaniis kakuu koo ni cabsu.
english: For when I have brought them into the land which I swore to their fathers, flowing with milk and honey, and they have eaten and filled themselves, and grown fat, then they will turn to other gods, and serve them, and despise me, and break my covenant.

kikuyu: Faarfannaan kunis yommuu badiisnii fi rakkinni isaanitti dhufuti ragaa isaanitti taʼa; kun sanyii isaanii keessatti hin irraanfatamuutii. Ani utuu biyya kakuudhaan waadaa isaanii galetti isaan hin fidin iyyuu waan isaan gochuuf yaadan nan beekaatii.”
english: It will happen, when many evils and troubles have come on them, that this song will testify before them as a witness; for it will not be forgotten out of the mouths of their descendants; for I know their ways and what they are doing today, before I have brought them into the land which I promised them.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Museen gaafas faarfannaa kana barreessee Israaʼeloota barsiise.
english: So Moses wrote this song the same day, and taught it to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Iyyaasuu ilma Nuunitiif ajaja, “Ati sababii biyya ani kakuudhaan waadaa isaanii galetti Israaʼeloota galchituuf cimi, jabaadhu; ani mataan koo si wajjin jiraa” jedhu kenne.
english: He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel into the land which I swore to them. I will be with you.”

kikuyu: Museen erga dubbii seera kanaa jalqabaa hamma dhumaatti kitaaba irratti barreessee fixee booddee,
english: When Moses had finished writing the words of this law in a book, until they were finished,

kikuyu: Lewwota taabota kakuu Waaqayyoo baataniif ajaja kana kenne:
english: Moses commanded the Levites, who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, saying,

kikuyu: “Kitaaba Seeraa kana fudhuutii taabota kakuu Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii bira kaaʼi. Kunis akka inni achuma taaʼee ragaa isinitti taʼuuf.
english: “Take this book of the law, and put it by the side of the ark of the LORD your God’s covenant, that it may be there for a witness against you.

kikuyu: Ani akka isin finciltootaa fi mata jabeeyyii taatan nan beekaatii. Isin yoo utuma ani jiruu Waaqayyotti finciltan, erga ani duʼee booddee immoo hammam caalaa haa finciltan ree!
english: For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck. Behold, while I am yet alive with you today, you have been rebellious against the LORD. How much more after my death?

kikuyu: Akka ani akka isaan dhagaʼaniif dubbii kana isaanitti hime akka isaanitti ragaa taʼuuf samii fi lafa waammachuu dandaʼuuf maanguddoota gosoota keessanii hundaa fi qondaaltota keessan hunda fuula koo duratti walitti qabaa.
english: Assemble to me all the elders of your tribes and your officers, that I may speak these words in their ears, and call heaven and earth to witness against them.

kikuyu: Ani akka isin erga ani duʼee booddee guutumaan guutuutti xurooftanii ajaja ani isinii kenne irraa garagaltan nan beekaatii. Baroota dhufuuf jiran keessa rakkinni isinitti dhufa; isin fuula Waaqayyoo duratti waan hamaa hojjettanii hojiidhuma harka keessaniitiin dheekkamsaaf isa kakaaftuutii.”
english: For I know that after my death you will utterly corrupt yourselves, and turn away from the way which I have commanded you; and evil will happen to you in the latter days, because you will do that which is evil in the LORD’s sight, to provoke him to anger through the work of your hands.”

kikuyu: Museenis jalqabaa hamma dhumaatti dubbii faarfannaa kanaa guutummaa waldaa Israaʼelitti akkana jedhee dhageessise:
english: Moses spoke in the ears of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, until they were finished.

kikuyu: Yaa samiiwwan, dhagaʼaa; ani nan dubbadha; yaa lafa, atis dubbii afaan kootii dhagaʼi.
english: Give ear, you heavens, and I will speak. Let the earth hear the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Barsiisni koo akka bokkaa haa roobu; dubbiin koos akka fixeensaa gad haa coccophu; marga irratti akka tiifuu, biqiltuu corqaa irrattis akka bokkaa guddaa haa roobu.
english: My doctrine will drop as the rain. My speech will condense as the dew, as the misty rain on the tender grass, as the showers on the herb.

kikuyu: Ani maqaa Waaqayyoo nan labsa. Guddina Waaqa keenyaa jajadhaa!
english: For I will proclaim the LORD’s name. Ascribe greatness to our God!

kikuyu: Inni Kattaa dha; hojiin isaa mudaa hin qabu; daandiiwwan isaa hundinuus qajeelaa dha. Inni Waaqa amanamaa hin dogoggorre, tolaa fi qajeelaa dha.
english: The Rock: his work is perfect, for all his ways are just. A God of faithfulness who does no wrong, just and right is he.

kikuyu: Isaan hammina isatti hojjetaniiru; siʼachi isaan sababii qaanii isaaniitiif ijoollee isaa miti; isaan dhaloota jalʼaa fi micciiramaa dha.
english: They have dealt corruptly with him. They are not his children, because of their defect. They are a perverse and crooked generation.

kikuyu: Yaa saba gowwaa, kan ogummaa hin qabne, ati akkasitti Waaqayyoof deebii kennitaa? Inni Abbaa kee, Uumaa kee, kan si hojjetee fi si tolche mitii?
english: Is this the way you repay the LORD, foolish and unwise people? Isn’t he your father who has bought you? He has made you and established you.

kikuyu: Baroota durii yaadadhu; dhaloota darbe illee qalbeeffadhu. Inni siif ibsaatii abbaa kee gaafadhu; maanguddoota kees gaafadhu; isaan sitti himuutii.
english: Remember the days of old. Consider the years of many generations. Ask your father, and he will show you; your elders, and they will tell you.

kikuyu: Waaqni Waan Hundaa Olii yommuu sabootaaf dhaala isaaniif kennetti, yommuu sanyii namaas gargar qoqoodetti, akkuma baayʼina ilmaan Israaʼelitti namootaaf daarii dhaabe.
english: When the Most High gave to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the children of men, he set the bounds of the peoples according to the number of the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Qoodni Waaqayyoo saba isaa ti; Yaaqoob immoo dhaala dhuunfaa isaa ti.
english: For the LORD’s portion is his people. Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

kikuyu: Inni lafa gammoojjii, lafa onaatii fi gammoojjii nama gubu keessatti isa argate. Inni gaachana taʼeefii isa eege; akka qaroo ija isaattis isa eege;
english: He found him in a desert land, in the waste howling wilderness. He surrounded him. He cared for him. He kept him as the apple of his eye.

kikuyu: akkuma risaan mana ishee diigdee ilmaan ishee irra qoochoo qabdu, akkuma qoochoo ishee balʼiftee ol isaan fudhattu, akkuma qoochoo isheetiinis isaan baattu sana,
english: As an eagle that stirs up her nest, that flutters over her young, he spread abroad his wings, he took them, he bore them on his feathers.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo qofatu isa geggeesse; waaqni ormaa tokko iyyuu isa wajjin hin turre.
english: The LORD alone led him. There was no foreign god with him.

kikuyu: Inni lafa ol kaʼaa irra isa burraaqsise; midhaan lafa qotiisaa isa soore. Kattaa keessaa damma isa nyaachise; dhagaa gurraacha keessaa immoo zayitii kenneef;
english: He made him ride on the high places of the earth. He ate the increase of the field. He caused him to suck honey out of the rock, oil out of the flinty rock;

kikuyu: dhadhaa fi aannan saawaanii fi bushaayee, xobbaallaawwanii fi reʼoota cooman, korbeeyyii hoolaa filatamoo Baashaan, ija qamadii gaariis isa soore. Ati cuunfaa dhiiga wayinii qulqulluus ni dhugde.
english: butter from the herd, and milk from the flock, with fat of lambs, rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the finest of the wheat. From the blood of the grape, you drank wine.

kikuyu: Yishuruun ni gabbate; ni dhiite; nyaatee quufe; ni ulfaate; ni cululuqe. Waaqa isa uume ni dhiise; Kattaa Fayyisaa isaa taʼes ni tuffate.
english: But Jeshurun grew fat, and kicked. You have grown fat. You have grown thick. You have become sleek. Then he abandoned God who made him, and rejected the Rock of his salvation.

kikuyu: Isaan waaqota ormaatiin isa hinaafsisan; waaqota jibbisiisoo isaaniitiinis isa dheekkamsiisan.
english: They moved him to jealousy with strange gods. They provoked him to anger with abominations.

kikuyu: Isaan hafuurota hamoo Waaqa hin taʼiniif, waaqota hin beekiniif, waaqota reefuu dhufaniif, waaqota abbootiin keessan hin sodaatiiniif aarsaa dhiʼeessan.
english: They sacrificed to demons, not God, to gods that they didn’t know, to new gods that came up recently, which your fathers didn’t dread.

kikuyu: Ati Kattaa si dhalche gante; Waaqa si uume irraanfatte.
english: Of the Rock who became your father, you are unmindful, and have forgotten God who gave you birth.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo waan kana argee isaan tuffate; inni ilmaanii fi intallan ofii isaatti aareeraatii.
english: The LORD saw and abhorred, because of the provocation of his sons and his daughters.

kikuyu: Innis, “Ani fuula koo isaan duraa nan dhokfadha; dhuma isaaniis nan arga” jedhe; isaan dhaloota jalʼaa, ijoollee hin amanamneedhaatii.
english: He said, “I will hide my face from them. I will see what their end will be; for they are a very perverse generation, children in whom is no faithfulness.

kikuyu: Isaan waan Waaqa hin taʼiniin na hinaafsisan; waaqota tolfamoo isaanii kanneen faayidaa hin qabneenis na aarsan. Anis warra saba hin taʼiniin akka isaan hinaafan nan godha; saba hubannaa hin qabneenis isaan nan aarsa.
english: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God. They have provoked me to anger with their vanities. I will move them to jealousy with those who are not a people. I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsa kootiin ibiddi qabsiifameeraatii; innis hamma siiʼoolitti gad dhidhimee ni bobaʼa. Lafaa fi waan isheen baaftu ni nyaata; hundee tulluuwwaniitti illee ibidda qabsiisa.
english: For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the foundations of the mountains on fire.

kikuyu: “Ani waan hamaa isaan irra nan tuula; xiyya koos isaanitti nan fixadha.
english: “I will heap evils on them. I will spend my arrows on them.

kikuyu: Beela hamaa, golfaa nyaatee nama fixuu fi dhaʼicha isaanitti nan erga; ilkaan bineensaa qaramaa isaa, hadhaa buutii lafa irra lootuus isaanitti nan erga.
english: They shall be wasted with hunger, and devoured with burning heat and bitter destruction. I will send the teeth of animals on them, with the venom of vipers that glide in the dust.

kikuyu: Karaa guddaa irratti goraadeen warra ijoollee hin qabne isaan godha; mana isaaniitti sodaatu moʼa. Dargaggoonnii fi dargaggeettiiwwan, daaʼimmanii fi maanguddoonni ni dhumu.
english: Outside the sword will bereave, and in the rooms, terror on both young man and virgin, the nursing infant with the gray-haired man.

kikuyu: Anis isaan nan bittinneessa; yaadannoo isaaniis sanyii namaa keessaa nan balleessa.
english: I said that I would scatter them afar. I would make their memory to cease from among men;

kikuyu: Garuu akka diinonni isaanii of tuulanii, ‘Harka keenyatu moʼate malee, Waaqayyo waan kana hunda hin goone’ hin jenne, ani dhaadannoo diinaa sodaadheera.”
english: were it not that I feared the provocation of the enemy, lest their adversaries should judge wrongly, lest they should say, ‘Our hand is exalted; the LORD has not done all this.’”

kikuyu: Isaan saba qalbii hin qabne, kan hubannaa tokko illee hin qabnee dha.
english: For they are a nation void of counsel. There is no understanding in them.

kikuyu: Isaan utuu ogeeyyii taʼanii waan kana hubatanii silaa dhuma isaanii ni beeku turan!
english: Oh that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

kikuyu: Yoo Kattaan isaanii isaan gurgure malee, yoo Waaqayyo dabarsee isaan kenne malee, akkamitti namni tokko nama kuma tokko yookaan namni lama nama kuma kudhan gugsa?
english: How could one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, unless their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had delivered them up?

kikuyu: Kattaan isaanii akka kattaa keenyaa miti; kana immoo diinonni keenya iyyuu hin ganan.
english: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.

kikuyu: Wayiniin isaanii wayinii Sodoomiitii fi lafa qotiisaa Gomoraa irraa dhufa. Iji wayinii isaanii summiidhaan, hurbuun isaaniis waan hadhaaʼuun guutameera.
english: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, of the fields of Gomorrah. Their grapes are poison grapes. Their clusters are bitter.

kikuyu: Wayiniin isaanii hadhaa bofaa, summii bofa hadhaan isaa nama ajjeesuu ti.
english: Their wine is the poison of serpents, the cruel venom of asps.

kikuyu: “Kun waan na biratti eegame, kan galmee koo keessattis chaappaadhaan cufame mitii?
english: “Isn’t this laid up in store with me, sealed up among my treasures?

kikuyu: Haaloo baasuun kan koo ti; ani gatii nan deebisa. Yeroo isaatti miilli isaanii ni mucucaata; guyyaan badiisa isaanii dhiʼaateera; badiisni isaaniis isaanitti ariifateera.”
english: Vengeance is mine, and recompense, at the time when their foot slides, for the day of their calamity is at hand. Their doom rushes at them.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo yommuu akka isaan humna dhaban, akka garbichis taʼu namni birmaduun tokko iyyuu hin hafne argutti, saba isaatiif ni murteessa; tajaajiltoota isaatiifis garaa laafa.
english: For the LORD will judge his people, and have compassion on his servants, when he sees that their power is gone, that there is no one remaining, shut up or left at large.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedha: “Kattaan isaan itti daʼatan, waaqonni tolfamoon isaanii amma eessa jiru?
english: He will say, “Where are their gods, the rock in which they took refuge,

kikuyu: Waaqonni cooma qalma isaanii nyaatan, kanneen dhibaayyuu daadhii wayinii isaanii dhuganis eessa jiru? Mee kaʼanii isaan haa gargaaran! Mee daʼannoo haa kennaniif!
english: which ate the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offering? Let them rise up and help you! Let them be your protection.

kikuyu: “Akka ani mataan koo Isa taʼe beekaa! Ana malee Waaqni biraa hin jiru. Ani nan ajjeesa; nan jiraachisas; nan madeessa; nan fayyisas; namni harka kootii baasuu dandaʼu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: “See now that I myself am he. There is no god with me. I kill and I make alive. I wound and I heal. There is no one who can deliver out of my hand.

kikuyu: Ani dhugumaan bara baraan jiraataadhaatii harka koo samiitti ol qabee nan kakadha;
english: For I lift up my hand to heaven and declare, as I live forever,

kikuyu: ani yommuun goraadee koo calaqqisaa qaradhee harki koo murtiidhaaf isa qabatutti, ani diinota koo haaloo nan baʼa; warra na jibbaniif illee waan isaaniif malu nan kenna.
english: if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will repay those who hate me.

kikuyu: Yommuu goraadeen koo foon nyaatutti, ani akka xiyyi koo dhiigaan machaaʼu nan godha; dhiigni sunis dhiiga warra qalamaniitii fi boojiʼamanii kan mataa hooggantoota diinaa ti.”
english: I will make my arrows drunk with blood. My sword shall devour flesh with the blood of the slain and the captives, from the head of the leaders of the enemy.”

kikuyu: Sababii inni haaloo dhiiga tajaajiltoota isaa baʼuuf, yaa sabootaa, namoota isaa wajjin gammadaa. Inni diinota isaa haaloo baʼa; biyyaa fi saba isaatiif araara ni buusa.
english: Rejoice, you nations, with his people, for he will avenge the blood of his servants. He will take vengeance on his adversaries, and will make atonement for his land and for his people.

kikuyu: Museenis Iyyaasuu ilma Nuuni wajjin dhufee dubbiiwwan faarfannaa kana hunda namoota dhageessise.
english: Moses came and spoke all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he and Joshua the son of Nun.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu dubbiiwwan kanneen hunda Israaʼeloota hundatti dubbatee fixetti,
english: Moses finished reciting all these words to all Israel.

kikuyu: akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Akka isaan dubbiiwwan seera kanaa hunda of eeggannaadhaan eeganiif akka isin ijoollee keessan ajajjan, dubbiiwwan ani harʼa ifa baasee isinitti himu hunda qalbiitti qabadhaa.
english: He said to them, “Set your heart to all the words which I testify to you today, which you shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

kikuyu: Isaan isiniif jireenya malee dubbii faayidaa hin qabne miti. Dubbiiwwan kanaan biyya laga Yordaanos ceetanii dhaaltan keessa bara dheeraa ni jiraattu.”
english: For it is no vain thing for you, because it is your life, and through this thing you shall prolong your days in the land, where you go over the Jordan to possess it.”

kikuyu: Gaafasuma Waaqayyo akkana jedhee Museetti hime;
english: The LORD spoke to Moses that same day, saying,

kikuyu: “Biyya Moʼaab kan fuullee Yerikoo jiru, tulluuwwan Abaariim keessa tulluu Nebootti ol baʼiitii biyya Kanaʼaan, biyya ani Israaʼelootaaf dhaala godhee kennu fuulleetti ilaali.
english: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see the land of Canaan, which I give to the children of Israel for a possession.

kikuyu: Akkuma obboleessi kee Aroon tulluu Hoori irratti duʼee gara abbootii isaatti walitti qabame sana, atis tulluu yaabbattu sana irratti ni duuta; gara abbootii keetiittis walitti qabamta.
english: Die on the mountain where you go up, and be gathered to your people, as Aaron your brother died on Mount Hor, and was gathered to his people;

kikuyu: Kunis waan isin lamaanuu Gammoojjii Siin, Qaadesh keessatti bishaan Mariibaa biratti fuula Israaʼelootaa duratti na amanuu diddanii fi sababii Israaʼeloota gidduutti qulqullummaa koo hin eeginiif.
english: because you trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because you didn’t uphold my holiness among the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ati fagootti argita malee biyya ani Israaʼelootaaf kennu sanatti hin galtu.”
english: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”

kikuyu: Eebbi Museen namni Waaqaa sun utuu hin duʼin dura ittiin Israaʼeloota eebbise kana;
english: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.

kikuyu: innis akkana jedhe: “Waaqayyo tulluu Siinaa irraa dhufe; isaan irrattis Seeʼiir irraa akka aduu ganamaatti baʼe; Tulluu Phaaraan irraa isaan eebbise. Inni qulqulloota isaa kumaatama wajjin dhufe; karaa harka isaa mirgaatiin ibidda bobaʼutu baʼe.
english: He said, “The LORD came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan situ saba jaallata; qulqulloonni hundinuu harka kee keessa jiru. Hundi isaanii miilla kee jalatti kufu; qajeelfamas sirraa argatu;
english: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.

kikuyu: Museen seera nuu kenneera; kunis dhaala waldaa Yaaqoob.
english: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.

kikuyu: Yeroo hooggantoonni sabaa gosoota Israaʼel wajjin walitti qabamanitti inni Yishuruun irratti mootii ture.
english: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.

kikuyu: “Ruubeen haa jiraatu malee hin duʼin; yookaan baayʼinni namoota isaa hin xinnaatin.”
english: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”

kikuyu: Waaʼee Yihuudaas akkana jedhe: “Yaa Waaqayyo, iyya Yihuudaa dhagaʼi; gara saba isaattis isa fidi. Inni harka ofii isaatiin of haa eegu. Yommuu inni diinota isaatiin wal lolutti gargaaraa isaa taʼi!”
english: This is for Judah. He said, “Hear, LORD, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”

kikuyu: Inni waaʼee Lewwiis akkana jedhe: “Tumiimii fi Uriimiin kee tajaajilaa kee amanamaadhaaf haa taʼu. Ati lafa Maasaah jedhamutti isa qorte; bishaan Mariibaa irratti isa lolte.
english: About Levi he said, “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.

kikuyu: Waaʼee abbaa fi haadha isaas, ‘Ani isa hin argine’ jedhe. Inni obboloota isaa addaan hin baafanne; ijoollee isaas hin beekne; isaan dubbii keetiif ajajamanii kakuu kee eeganiiruutii.
english: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.

kikuyu: Inni ajaja kee Yaaqoobin, seera kee immoo Israaʼelin ni barsiisa. Fuula kee duratti ixaana, iddoo aarsaa keetii irratti illee aarsaa gubamu guutuu ni dhiʼeessa.
english: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ogummaa isaa hunda eebbisiif; waan harki isaa hojjetuttis gammadi. Moʼoo warra isatti kaʼanii cabsi; akka isaan lammata hin kaane godhiitii diinota isaa dhaʼi.”
english: LORD, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”

kikuyu: Waaʼee Beniyaam akkana jedhe: “Namni Waaqayyo isa jaallatu eegumsa isaatiin nagaan haa jiraatu; inni guyyaa guutuu isa eegaatii; namni Waaqayyo isa jaallatu gatiittii isaa gidduu boqota.”
english: About Benjamin he said, “The beloved of the LORD will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”

kikuyu: Waaʼee Yoosef akkana jedhe: “Waaqayyo biyya isaa haa eebbisu; fixeensa filatamaa samiidhaa buusuudhaan bishaan boolla gad fagoo keessaatiin,
english: About Joseph he said, “His land is blessed by the LORD, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,

kikuyu: midhaan filatamaa aduun biqilchituun, waan akka malee gaarii kan jiʼi kennuun,
english: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,

kikuyu: kennaawwan filatamoo tulluuwwan duriitiin, badhaadhummaa gaarran bara baraatiin,
english: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,

kikuyu: kennaa filatamaa lafaatii fi guutummaa isaatiin, surraa isa daggala bobaʼu keessa ture sanaatiin haa eebbisu. Isaan kunneen hundi mataa Yoosef kan obboloota isaa gidduutti bulchaa taʼe sanaa irra haa buʼan.
english: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.

kikuyu: Inni ulfinaan korma hangafa fakkaata; gaanfawwan isaa akka gaanfawwan gafarsaa ti. Isaaniinis hamma daarii lafaatti saboota ni waraana. Isaanis kuma kurnan Efreem, akkasumas kumaatama Minaasee ti.”
english: Majesty belongs to the firstborn of his herd. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all the peoples to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”

kikuyu: Waaʼee Zebuuloonis akkana jedhe: “Zebuuloon ati gad baʼuu keetiin, Yisaakor atis dunkaanota kee keessatti gammadi.
english: About Zebulun he said, “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.

kikuyu: Isaan saboota gara tulluutti ni waamu; achittis aarsaa qajeelummaa ni dhiʼeessu; isaan sooroma irra dhangalaʼaa galaana keessaatiin, qabeenya cirracha keessa dhokfameenis ni gammadu.”
english: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”

kikuyu: Waaʼee Gaad immoo akkana jedhe: “Namni bulchiinsa Gaad balʼisu eebbifamaa dha! Gaad irree fi mataa caccabsaa akka leencaatti achi jiraata.
english: About Gad he said, “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm and the crown of the head.

kikuyu: Inni ofii isaatiif lafa gabbataa filate; qoodni hooggantootaa isaaf turfame. Yommuu hooggantoonni sabaa walitti qabamanitti, inni fedhii qajeelumma Waaqayyootii fi murtii Israaʼelitti mure sana fiixaan baase.”
english: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of the LORD, His ordinances with Israel.”

kikuyu: Waaʼee Daanis inni akkana jedhe: “Daan akka ilmoolee leencaa kan Baashaan keessaa utaalee baʼuu ti.”
english: About Dan he said, “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”

kikuyu: Waaʼee Niftaalemis akkana jedhe: “Niftaalem surraa gonfateera; eebba Waaqayyootiinis guutameera; inni biyya karaa lixaatii fi kibbaatiin jiru ni dhaala.”
english: About Naphtali he said, “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of the LORD’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”

kikuyu: Waaʼee Aasheer immoo akkana jedhe: “Aasheer ilmaan hunda caalaa eebbifamaa dha; inni obboloota isaa duratti fudhatama haa argatu; miilla isaas zayitii keessa haa cuuphatu.
english: About Asher he said, “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.

kikuyu: Danqaraan balbala keetii sibiilaa fi naasii taʼa; jabinni kees akkuma baroota jireenya keetii ni taʼa.
english: Your bars will be iron and bronze. As your days, so your strength will be.

kikuyu: “Waaqni akka Waaqa Yishuruun, kan si gargaaruuf jedhee samiiwwan irra, surraa isaatiinis duumessoota irra gulufu tokko illee hin jiru.
english: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.

kikuyu: Waaqni bara baraa iddoo jireenyaa keetii ti; irreen bara baraas si jalaan jira. Inni, ‘Isaan balleessi!’ jedhee diinota kee fuula kee duraa ni ariʼa.
english: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Israaʼel kophaa isaa nagaadhaan jiraata; lafa fixeensi samii itti coccophutti, biyya midhaanii fi wayinii haaraatti namni burqaa Yaaqoob tuqu hin jiru.
english: Israel dwells in safety, the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.

kikuyu: Yaa Israaʼel, ati eebbifamaa dha! Sabni Waaqayyo isa fayyise, kan akka keetii eenyu? Inni gaachana keetii fi gargaaraa kee ti; goraadee ulfina keetiitis. Diinonni kee sodaadhaan fuula kee duraa duubatti deebiʼu; ati immoo iddoowwan waaqeffannaa isaanii irra ejjetta.”
english: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by the LORD, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”

kikuyu: Museenis dirree Moʼaabii kaʼee fuullee fiixee Phisgaa kan Yerikootti argamutti, gaara Nebootti ol baʼe. Achittis Waaqayyo guutummaa biyyattii isatti argisiise; kunis Giliʼaadii hamma Daanitti,
english: Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. The LORD showed him all the land of Gilead to Dan,

kikuyu: guutummaa Niftaalem, biyya Efreemiitii fi Minaasee, guutummaa biyya Yihuudaa kan hamma galaana lixaatti balʼatee jiru,
english: and all Naphtali, and the land of Ephraim and Manasseh, and all the land of Judah, to the Western Sea,

kikuyu: Negeebii fi Magaalaa Meexxii kan sulula Yerikootii jalqabee hamma Zoʼaariitti argamuu dha.
english: and the south, and the Plain of the valley of Jericho the city of palm trees, to Zoar.

kikuyu: Ergasii Waaqayyo, “Kun biyya ani yeroo, ‘Sanyii keetiif nan kenna’ jedhetti kakuudhaan Abrahaamiif, Yisihaaqii fi Yaaqoobiif waadaa galee dha. Ani akka ati ija keetiin argitu godheera; ati garuu achi hin ceetu” jedheen.
english: The LORD said to him, “This is the land which I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, saying, ‘I will give it to your offspring.’ I have caused you to see it with your eyes, but you shall not go over there.”

kikuyu: Museen garbichi Waaqayyoos akkuma Waaqayyo isaan jedhetti achuma Moʼaab keessatti duʼe.
english: So Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, according to the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Innis biyya Moʼaabitti sulula fuullee Beet Pheʼooritti argamu keessatti isa awwaale; garuu hamma harʼaatti awwaalli isaa eessa akka jiru namni tokko iyyuu hin beeku.
english: He buried him in the valley in the land of Moab opposite Beth Peor, but no man knows where his tomb is to this day.

kikuyu: Museen yeroo duʼetti nama waggaa dhibba tokkoo fi digdama ture; taʼus iji isaa hin dadhabne; humni isaas hin laafne.
english: Moses was one hundred twenty years old when he died. His eye was not dim, nor his strength gone.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni hamma yeroon gaddaa raawwatutti dirree Moʼaab irratti bultii soddoma Museedhaaf booʼan.
english: The children of Israel wept for Moses in the plains of Moab thirty days, until the days of weeping in the mourning for Moses were ended.

kikuyu: Waan Museen harka isaa isa irra kaaʼee tureef Iyyaasuun ilmi Nuuni hafuura ogummaatiin guutame. Kanaafuu Israaʼeloonni isa dhagaʼanii waan Waaqayyo Musee ajaje godhan.
english: Joshua the son of Nun was full of the spirit of wisdom, for Moses had laid his hands on him. The children of Israel listened to him, and did as the LORD commanded Moses.
