kikuyu: Kana malees Yosiyaas ilaaltotaa fi eker dubbistoota, taraafimii, waaqota tolfamoo fi wantoota jibbisiisoo kanneen Yihuudaa fi Yerusaalem keessatti argaman biraa hunda balleesse. Innis seera kitaaba Hilqiyaa lubichi mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyoo keessatti arge sana irratti barreeffame hojii irra oolchuudhaaf waan kana godhe.
english: Moreover, Josiah removed those who had familiar spirits, the wizards, and the teraphim, and the idols, and all the abominations that were seen in the land of Judah and in Jerusalem, that he might confirm the words of the law which were written in the book that Hilkiah the priest found in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Mootiin akka Yosiyaas kan akka Seera Musee hundaatti garaa isaa guutuudhaan, lubbuu isaa guutuu fi humna isaa guutuudhaan gara Waaqayyootti deebiʼe tokko iyyuu isaan duras isaan duubas hin argamne.
english: There was no king like him before him, who turned to the LORD with all his heart, and with all his soul, and with all his might, according to all the law of Moses; and there was none like him who arose after him.

kikuyu: Taʼus sababii Minaaseen waan hojjete hundaan dheekkamsaaf isa kakaaseef Waaqayyo dheekkamsa isaa guddaa fi sodaachisaa Yihuudaa irratti bobaʼe sana irraa hin deebine.
english: Notwithstanding, the LORD didn’t turn from the fierceness of his great wrath, with which his anger burned against Judah, because of all the provocation with which Manasseh had provoked him.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqayyo, “Ani akkuma Israaʼelin balleesse sana Yihuudaas fuula koo duraa nan balleessa; Yerusaalem magaalaa ani filadheef mana qulqullummaa kan ani, ‘Maqaan koo achi jiraata’ jedhee waaʼee isaa dubbadhe kana nan dhiisa” jedhe.
english: The LORD said, “I will also remove Judah out of my sight, as I have removed Israel; and I will cast off this city which I have chosen, even Jerusalem, and the house of which I said, ‘My name shall be there.’”

kikuyu: Wanni bara mootummaa Yosiyaas keessa hojjetame kan biraatii fi wanni inni hojjete hundi kitaaba seenaa mootota Yihuudaa keessatti barreeffameera mitii?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Josiah, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Bara Yosiyaas mootii turetti, Faraʼoon Nekkoon mootichi Gibxi mootii Asoor gargaaruuf jedhee gara Laga Efraaxiisitti ol baʼe. Yosiyaas mootichis of irraa isa ittisuudhaaf itti gad baʼe. Nekkoon garuu isatti dhufee Megidootti isa ajjeese.
english: In his days Pharaoh Necoh king of Egypt went up against the king of Assyria to the river Euphrates; and King Josiah went against him, but Pharaoh Necoh killed him at Megiddo when he saw him.

kikuyu: Garboonni Yosiyaasis gaariidhaan Megidoodhaa gara Yerusaalemitti reeffa isaa fidanii awwaala isaa keessatti isa awwaalan. Ergasiis sabni biyya sanaa Yehooʼaahaaz ilma Yosiyaas fuudhanii dibanii iddoo abbaa isaa buusanii mootii isa godhan.
english: His servants carried him dead in a chariot from Megiddo, brought him to Jerusalem, and buried him in his own tomb. The people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Josiah, and anointed him, and made him king in his father’s place.

kikuyu: Yehooʼaahaazis yeroo mootii taʼetti umuriin isaa waggaa digdamii sadii ture; innis Yerusaalem keessa taaʼee jiʼa sadii bulche. Maqaan haadha isaa Hamuutaal ture; isheenis intala Ermiyaas kan Libnaadhaa dhuftee turte.
english: Jehoahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

kikuyu: Innis akkuma abbootiin isaa hojjetan sana fuula Waaqayyoo duratti waan hamaa hojjete.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

kikuyu: Akka inni Yerusaalem keessa taaʼee hin bulchineef Faraʼoon Nekkoon Hamaati keessatti Riiblaati foncaan isa hidhee Yihuudaa irrattis gibira meetii taalaantii dhibba tokkoo fi warqee taalaantii tokko mure.
english: Pharaoh Necoh put him in bonds at Riblah in the land of Hamath, that he might not reign in Jerusalem; and put the land to a tribute of one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.

kikuyu: Faraʼoon Nekkoon Eliiyaaqiim ilma Yosiyaas mootichaa iddoo Yosiyaas iddoo abbaa isaa buusee mootii godhe; maqaa Eliiyaaqiimis geeddaree Yehooyaaqiim jedheen. Yehooʼaahaazin garuu fuudhee Gibxitti geesse; innis achitti duʼe.
english: Pharaoh Necoh made Eliakim the son of Josiah king in the place of Josiah his father, and changed his name to Jehoiakim; but he took Jehoahaz away, and he came to Egypt and died there.

kikuyu: Yehooyaaqiimis meetii fi warqee Faraʼoon Nekkoon gaafate sana ni baase. Waan kana baasuufis gibira biyyatti muree namoota biyyattii irraa akkuma galii isaaniitti meetii fi warqee walitti qabe.
english: Jehoiakim gave the silver and the gold to Pharaoh; but he taxed the land to give the money according to the commandment of Pharaoh. He exacted the silver and the gold of the people of the land, from everyone according to his assessment, to give it to Pharaoh Necoh.

kikuyu: Yehooyaaqiim yeroo mootii taʼetti umuriin isaa waggaa digdamii shan ture; innis Yerusaalem keessa taaʼee waggaa kudha tokko bulche. Maqaan haadha isaa Zebuudaa ture; isheenis intala Phedaayaa kan magaalaa Ruumaatii dhufte turte.
english: Jehoiakim was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Zebidah the daughter of Pedaiah of Rumah.

kikuyu: Innis akkuma abbootiin isaa hojjetan sana fuula Waaqayyoo duratti waan hamaa hojjete.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his fathers had done.

kikuyu: Bara mootummaa Yehooyaaqiim keessa Nebukadnezar mootichi Baabilon biyya sana ni weerare; Yehooyaaqiimis waggaa sadii isaaf garboome. Ergasii garuu yaada geeddaratee Nebukadnezaritti fincile.
english: In his days Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up, and Jehoiakim became his servant for three years. Then he turned and rebelled against him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos saamtota Baabilon, saamtota Sooriyaa, saamtota Moʼaabii fi saamtota Amoon isatti erge. Innis akkuma dubbii Waaqayyoo kan garboonni isaa raajonni dubbatan sanaatti Yihuudaa balleessuudhaaf isaan erge.
english: The LORD sent against him bands of the Chaldeans, bands of the Syrians, bands of the Moabites, and bands of the children of Ammon, and sent them against Judah to destroy it, according to the LORD’s word which he spoke by his servants the prophets.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan wanni kun sababii cubbuu Minaaseetii fi waan inni hojjete hundaatiif fuula isaa duraa isaan balleessuudhaaf akkuma ajaja Waaqayyootti Yihuudaatti dhufe;
english: Surely at the commandment of the LORD this came on Judah, to remove them out of his sight for the sins of Manasseh, according to all that he did,

kikuyu: akkasumas sababii inni dhiiga namoota yakka hin qabnee dhangalaasee fi sababii inni dhiiga namoota yakka hin qabneetiin Yerusaalemin guuteef Waaqayyo dhiisuufii hin barbaanne.
english: and also for the innocent blood that he shed; for he filled Jerusalem with innocent blood, and the LORD would not pardon.

kikuyu: Wantoonni bara mootummaa Yehooyaaqiim keessa hojjetaman kanneen biraatii fi wanni inni hojjete hundi kitaaba seenaa mootota Yihuudaa keessatti barreeffamaniiru mitii?
english: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and all that he did, aren’t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Judah?

kikuyu: Yehooyaaqiim abbootii isaa wajjin ni boqote. Ilmi isaa Yehooyaakiin iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe.
english: So Jehoiakim slept with his fathers, and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Sababii mootichi Baabilon biyya isaa hunda, Malkaa Gibxii jalqabee hamma Laga Efraaxiisitti qabateef mootiin Gibxi lammata duulaaf biyya isaatii hin baane.
english: The king of Egypt didn’t come out of his land any more; for the king of Babylon had taken, from the brook of Egypt to the river Euphrates, all that belonged to the king of Egypt.

kikuyu: Yehooyaakiin yeroo mootii taʼetti umuriin isaa waggaa kudha saddeet ture; innis Yerusaalem keessa taaʼee jiʼa sadii bulche. Maqaan haadha isaa Nehushtaa ture; isheenis intala Elnaataan namicha Yerusaalem sanaa ti.
english: Jehoiachin was eighteen years old when he began to reign, and he reigned in Jerusalem three months. His mother’s name was Nehushta the daughter of Elnathan of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Innis akkuma abbaan isaa hojjete sana fuula Waaqayyoo duratti waan hamaa hojjete.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that his father had done.

kikuyu: Yeruma sanatti loltoonni Nebukadnezar mooticha Baabilon Yerusaalemitti duulanii ishee ni marsan;
english: At that time the servants of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up to Jerusalem, and the city was besieged.

kikuyu: utuma ajajjoonni loltoota isaa ishee marsaa jiranuu Nebukadnezar mataan isaa gara magaalattii ni dhufe.
english: Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came to the city while his servants were besieging it,

kikuyu: Yehooyaakiin mootichi Yihuudaa, haati isaa, garboonni isaa, namoonni isaa bebeekamoonii fi qondaaltonni isaa hundinuu mootii Baabilonitti harka kennatan. Mootiin Baabilonis mooʼee waggaa saddeettaffaatti Yehooyaakiinin boojiʼee ni fudhate.
english: and Jehoiachin the king of Judah went out to the king of Babylon—he, his mother, his servants, his princes, and his officers; and the king of Babylon captured him in the eighth year of his reign.

kikuyu: Nebukadnezaris akkuma Waaqayyo dubbatee ture sanatti qabeenya mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyootii fi kan masaraa mootummaa keessa ture hunda ni fudhate; miʼa warqee kan Solomoon mootichi Israaʼel mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyootiif tolche hunda isaa immoo caccabse.
english: He carried out from there all the treasures of the LORD’s house and the treasures of the king’s house, and cut in pieces all the vessels of gold which Solomon king of Israel had made in the LORD’s temple, as the LORD had said.

kikuyu: Inni warra Yerusaalem keessa jiraatan hunda ajajjoota waraanaatii fi loltoota hunda, warra ogummaa hojii harkaa qabanii fi warra sibiila tuman hunda walumatti nama kuma kudhan boojiʼee ni fudhate. Namoota akka malee hiyyeeyyii qofatu biyya sanatti hafe.
english: He carried away all Jerusalem, and all the princes, and all the mighty men of valor, even ten thousand captives, and all the craftsmen and the smiths. No one remained except the poorest people of the land.

kikuyu: Nebukadnezar Yehooyaakiinin boojiʼee Baabilonitti ni geesse. Akkasumas haadha mootichaa, niitota isaa, qondaaltota isaatii fi namoota biyya sanaa bebbeekamoo boojiʼee Yerusaalemii gara Baabilonitti ni geesse.
english: He carried away Jehoiachin to Babylon, with the king’s mother, the king’s wives, his officers, and the chief men of the land. He carried them into captivity from Jerusalem to Babylon.

kikuyu: Kana malees mootichi Baabilon humna waraanaa guutuu kan nama kuma torba of keessaa qabu, warra ogummaa hojii harkaa qabanii fi warra sibiila tuman kuma tokko boojiʼee Baabilonitti ni geesse; isaan kunneen hundi jajjaboo fi warra lola dandaʼan turan.
english: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and fit for war, even them the king of Babylon brought captive to Babylon.

kikuyu: Innis Mataaniyaa eessuma Yehooyaakiin sana iddoo isaa mootii godhe; maqaa isaas Zedeqiyaatti ni geeddare.
english: The king of Babylon made Mattaniah, Jehoiachin’s father’s brother, king in his place, and changed his name to Zedekiah.

kikuyu: Zedeqiyaa yeroo mootii taʼetti umuriin isaa waggaa digdamii tokkoo ture; innis Yerusaalem keessa taaʼee waggaa kudha tokko bulche. Maqaan haadha isaa Hamuutaal ture; isheenis intala Ermiyaas kan magaalaa Libnaatii dhufte turte.
english: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.

kikuyu: Innis akkuma Yehooyaaqiim hojjete sana fuula Waaqayyoo duratti waan hamaa ni hojjete.
english: He did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.

kikuyu: Wanni kun hundi sababii dheekkamsa Waaqayyootiif Yerusaalemii fi Yihuudaa irra gaʼe; dhuma irrattis inni fuula isaa duraa isaan balleesse. Zedeqiyaa mooticha Baabilonitti fincile.
english: For through the anger of the LORD, this happened in Jerusalem and Judah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Then Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu bara mootummaa Zedeqiyaa keessa waggaa saglaffaatti, bultii kurnaffaa jiʼa kurnaffaatti, Nebukadnezar mootiin Baabilon guutummaa loltoota isaa wajjin Yerusaalemitti duule. Innis magaalattiin ala qubatee naannoo ishee hundatti tuullaa biyyoo marse.
english: In the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, he and all his army, against Jerusalem, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it around it.

kikuyu: Magaalaan sunis hamma waggaa kudha tokkoffaa bara Zedeqiyaa Mootichaatti akkuma marfamtetti turte.
english: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.

kikuyu: Bultii saglaffaa jiʼa afuraffaatti, magaalattii keessatti beelli akka malee hammaatee namni waan nyaatu tokko illee dhabe.
english: On the ninth day of the fourth month, the famine was severe in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.

kikuyu: Ergasii dallaan magaalattii cabsamee loltoonni hundinuus utuma Baabilononni magaalaa sana marsanii jiranuu karaa karra dallaa iddoo biqiltuu mootichaa bira jiru lamaan gidduu baasu sanaatiin halkaniin baʼanii baqatan. Isaanis Arabbaatti baqatan;
english: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king’s garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city around it); and the king went by the way of the Arabah.

kikuyu: loltoonni Baabilon garuu mooticha ariʼanii dirree Yerikoo irratti isa qaqqaban. Loltoonni isaa hundis isa irraa gargar baʼanii bibittinnaaʼanii turan;
english: But the Chaldean army pursued the king, and overtook him in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered from him.

kikuyu: innis ni qabame. Gara mootii Baabilonitti Riiblaatti geeffamee achittis itti murame.
english: Then they captured the king and carried him up to the king of Babylon to Riblah; and they passed judgment on him.

kikuyu: Isaanis ijuma isaa duratti ilmaan Zedeqiyaa fixan; isaanis ija isaa keessaa baasanii foncaa naasiitiin hidhanii Baabilonitti isa geessan.
english: They killed Zedekiah’s sons before his eyes, then put out Zedekiah’s eyes, bound him in fetters, and carried him to Babylon.

kikuyu: Bara mootummaa Nebukadnezar mooticha Baabilon keessa waggaa kudha saglaffaatti, bultii torbaffaa jiʼa shanaffaatti, Nebuzaradaan ajajaan eegumsa mootummaa, qondaalli mootii Baabilon sun gara Yerusaalem dhufe.
english: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Babylon, came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Innis mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyootti, masaraa mootummaattii fi manneen Yerusaalem hundatti ibidda qabsiise. Manneen gurguddaa hundas ni gube.
english: He burned the LORD’s house, the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem. He burned every great house with fire.

kikuyu: Loltoonni Baabilon kanneen ajajaa eegumsa mootummaa jala turan hundi dallaawwan naannoo Yerusaalem turan diigan.
english: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down the walls around Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Nebuzaradaan ajajaan eegumsaa sun namoota magaalaa keessatti hafanii fi warra baqatanii mootii Baabilonitti kooluu galan boojiʼee fudhate.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried away captive the rest of the people who were left in the city and those who had deserted to the king of Babylon—all the rest of the multitude.

kikuyu: Ajajaan sun garuu hiyyeeyyii biyyattii keessaa gariin akka wayinii kunuunsanii fi lafa qotaniif achitti dhiise.
english: But the captain of the guard left some of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.

kikuyu: Baabilononni sun utubaawwan naasii, baattuuwwan iddoodhaa sochoʼanii fi Gaanii naasii irraa hojjetamee mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyoo keessa ture caccabsanii naasii sana immoo Baabilonitti geessan.
english: The Chaldeans broke up the pillars of bronze that were in the LORD’s house and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the LORD’s house, and carried the bronze pieces to Babylon.

kikuyu: Akkasumas okkoteewwan, waan ittiin daaraa hammaaran, waan ittiin ibsaa irraa daaraa dhadhaʼan, caabiiwwanii fi miʼoota naasii irraa hojjetaman kanneen tajaajila mana qulqullummaatiif oolan hunda fudhatan.
english: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the spoons, and all the vessels of bronze with which they ministered.

kikuyu: Ajajaan eegumsaa sunis girgiraawwanii fi waciitiiwwan ittiin dhiiga facaasan kanneen hundi isaanii warqee qulqulluu irraa yookaan meetii irraa hojjetaman fudhatee deeme.
english: The captain of the guard took away the fire pans, the basins, that which was of gold, for gold, and that which was of silver, for silver.

kikuyu: Ulfinni naasii kan Solomoon ittiin utubaawwan lamaan, Gaanii fi baattuuwwan iddoodhaa sochoʼaniin mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyootiif hojjetee ture waan madaalliin madaaluu dandaʼuu oli turan.
english: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Solomon had made for the LORD’s house, the bronze of all these vessels was not weighed.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon utubaa sanaa dhundhuma kudha saddeet ol dheerata ture. Guutuun naasii kan utubaa tokko irraas dhundhuma sadii ol dheeratee naannoon isaa guutuun sibiila wal keessa loofamee tolfamee fi roomaanii naasiitiin miidhagfamee ture. Utubaan kaanis sibiila isaa kan wal keessa loofamee tolfame wajjin kanuma fakkaata ture.
english: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of bronze was on it. The height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital around it, all of bronze; and the second pillar with its network was like these.

kikuyu: Ajajaan eegumsaa sun, Seraayaa lubicha hangafa, Sefaaniyaa lubicha Sadarkaan isatti aanuu fi eegdota balbalaa sadan hidhee fuudhee deeme.
english: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold;

kikuyu: Warra amma illee magaalaa keessatti hafan keessaa ajajaa loltootaatii fi gorsitoota mootii shan fudhate. Akkasumas barreessaa qondaala ol aanaa ture kan saba keessaa loltummaaf namoota filatu sanaa fi namoota isaa kanneen magaalaa keessatti argaman jaatama fudhate.
english: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king’s face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land, and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city.

kikuyu: Nebuzaradaan ajajaan sun hunda isaanii guuree Riiblaatti gara mooticha Baabilonitti geesse.
english: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon to Riblah.

kikuyu: Mootichis achuma Riiblaat biyya Hamaati keessatti isaan ni fixe. Yihuudaanis akkasiin boojiʼamtee biyya isheetii baate.
english: The king of Babylon attacked them and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah was carried away captive out of his land.

kikuyu: Nebukadnezar mootichi Baabilon akka inni namoota Yihuudaatti hambise sana bulchuuf Gedaaliyaas ilma Ahiiqaam ilma Shaafaan sana muude.
english: As for the people who were left in the land of Judah whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.

kikuyu: Ajajjoonni loltootaa hundii fi namoonni isaanii yeroo akka mootichi Baabilon Gedaaliyaasin bulchaa kutaa biyyaa godhee muude dhagaʼanitti Gedaaliyaas bira Miisphaa dhufan; isaanis Ishmaaʼeel ilma Naataaniyaa, Yoohaanaan ilma Qaareyaa, Seraayaa ilma Tanhumeeti namicha Netoof sanaa, Yaazaniyaa ilma namicha Maʼakaatii fi namoota isaanii turan.
english: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Babylon had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, Johanan the son of Kareah, Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.

kikuyu: Gedaaliyaasis, “Qondaaltota Baabilon hin sodaatinaa; biyyattii keessa qubadhaatii mooticha Baabilon tajaajilaa; waan gaariitu isinii taʼaatii” jedhee isaanii fi namoota isaaniitiif kakate.
english: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, “Don’t be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans. Dwell in the land and serve the king of Babylon, and it will be well with you.”

kikuyu: Garuu jiʼa torbaffaa keessa Ishmaaʼeel ilmi Naataaniyaa ilma Eliishaamaa kan sanyii moototaa irraa dhalate sun namoota kudhan wajjin dhufee Gedaaliyaas, namoota Yihuudaatii fi namoota Baabilon kanneen isa wajjin Miisphaa turan fixe.
english: But in the seventh month, Ishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal offspring came, and ten men with him, and struck Gedaliah so that he died, with the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.

kikuyu: Kana irratti namni hundi xinnaa fi guddaan, Baabilonota sodaatee ajajjoota waraanaa wajjin gara Gibxitti baqate.
english: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces arose and came to Egypt; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.

kikuyu: Yehooyaakiin mootiin Yihuudaa boojiʼamee waggaa soddomii torbaffaa isaatti, Eewiil Marodaak mootii Baabilon taʼe; innis wagguma sana keessa bultii digdamii torbaffaa jiʼa kudha lammaffaatti Yehooyaakiin mootii Yihuudaa sana mana hidhaatii gad dhiise.
english: In the thirty-seventh year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-seventh day of the month, Evilmerodach king of Babylon, in the year that he began to reign, released Jehoiachin king of Judah out of prison,

kikuyu: Afaan tolaadhaanis isatti dubbatee barcuma ulfinaa kan barcuma mootota isa wajjin Baabilon keessa turan kaanii caalu kenneef.
english: and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Babylon,

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yehooyaakiin uffata isaa kan mana hidhaatti uffachaa ture sana of irraa baasee bara jireenya isaa guutuu yeroo hunda maaddii mootichaa irraa nyaate.
english: and changed his prison garments. Jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life;

kikuyu: Mootichis hamma inni lubbuudhaan jiraatetti guyyuma guyyaadhaan waan isaaf barbaachisu Yehooyaakiiniif kennaa ture.
english: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him from the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.

kikuyu: Addaam, Seeti, Enoosh,
english: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

kikuyu: Qeenaan, Mahalaleel, Yaared,
english: Kenan, Mahalalel, Jared,

kikuyu: Henook, Matuuselaa, Laameh, Noh.
english: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

kikuyu: Ilmaan Noh: Seem, Haam, Yaafet:
english: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yaafet: Goomer, Maagoog, Meedee, Yaawaan, Tuubaal, Meshekii fi Tiiraas turan.
english: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Goomer: Ashkenas, Riifaatii fi Toogarmaa turan.
english: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Diphath, and Togarmah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yaawaan: Eliishaa, Tarshiish, Kitiimii fi Roodaanota turan.
english: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Rodanim.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Haam: Kuushi, Misrayim, Fuuxii fi Kanaʼaan turan.
english: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Kuushi: Saabaa, Hawiilaa, Sabtaa, Raʼimaa fi Sabtekaa turan. Ilmaan Raʼimaa: Shebaa fi Dedaan turan.
english: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raama, Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

kikuyu: Kuushi abbaa Naamruud; Naamruudis lafa irratti loltuu jabaa taʼe.
english: Cush became the father of Nimrod. He began to be a mighty one on the earth.

kikuyu: Misrayim immoo abbaa Luudiimootaa, Anaamiimotaa, Lehaabiimotaa, Naftahiimootaa,
english: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, Naphtuhim,

kikuyu: Fatrusiimotaa, Kaseluhiimotaa jechuunis warra Filisxeemonni irraa dhalatanii fi Kaftooriimotaa ti.
english: Pathrusim, Casluhim (where the Philistines came from), and Caphtorim.

kikuyu: Kanaʼaan abbaa Siidoon ilma isaa hangaftichaa akkasumas kan Heetotaa,
english: Canaan became the father of Sidon his firstborn, Heth,

kikuyu: Yebuusotaa, Amoorotaa, Girgaashotaa,
english: the Jebusite, the Amorite, the Girgashite,

kikuyu: Hiiwotaa, Arkaawotaa, Siinotaa,
english: the Hivite, the Arkite, the Sinite,

kikuyu: Arwaadewotaa, Zemaarotaatii fi Hamaatotaa ture.
english: the Arvadite, the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Seem: Eelaam, Ashuur, Arfaakshad, Luudii fi Arraam turan. Ilmaan Arraam: Uuzi, Huuli, Geterii fi Meshek turan.
english: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arpachshad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

kikuyu: Arfaakshad Sheelaa dhalche; Sheelaan immoo Eeberin dhalche.
english: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

kikuyu: Eeberiifis ilmaan lamatu dhalate: Sababii bara isaa keessa lafti gargar qoodamteef, maqaan isa tokkoo Felegi jedhamee moggaafame; maqaan obboleessa isaa immoo Yooqxaan jedhamee moggaafame.
english: To Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg, for in his days the earth was divided; and his brother’s name was Joktan.

kikuyu: Yooqxaan immoo Almoodaad, Sheleef, Hazarmaawet, Yaaraa,
english: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

kikuyu: Hadooraam, Uuzaal, Diqlaa,
english: Hadoram, Uzal, Diklah,

kikuyu: Eebaal, Abiimaaʼeel, Shebaa,
english: Ebal, Abimael, Sheba,

kikuyu: Oofiir, Hawiilaa fi Yoobaabin dhalche. Warri kunneen hundinuu ilmaan Yooqxaanii ti.
english: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

kikuyu: Seem, Arfaakshadi, Sheelaa,
english: Shem, Arpachshad, Shelah,

kikuyu: Eeberi, Felegi, Reʼuu,
english: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

kikuyu: Seruugi, Naahoor, Taaraa,
english: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

kikuyu: akkasumas Abraam kan Abrahaam jedhame sanaa dha.
english: Abram (also called Abraham).

kikuyu: Ilmaan Abrahaam: Yisihaaqii fi Ishmaaʼeel.
english: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

kikuyu: Sanyiiwwan isaanii warra kanneenii dha: Nabaayooti ilma Ishmaaʼeel hangafticha, Qeedaar, Adbiʼeel, Mibsaami,
english: These are their generations: the firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

kikuyu: Mishmaa, Duumaa, Maasaa, Hadaad, Teemaa,
english: Mishma, Dumah, Massa, Hadad, Tema,

kikuyu: Yexuur, Naafiishii fi Qeedmaa.
english: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Qexuuraan saajjatoon Abrahaam sun deesse: Zimraan, Yoqshaan, Medaan, Midiyaan, Yishbaaqii fi Shuwaa. Ilmaan Yokshaan: Shebaa fi Dedaan.
english: The sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bore Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Midiyaan: Eefaa, Eefer, Henook, Abiidaa fi Eldaaʼaa.
english: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

kikuyu: Abrahaam abbaa Yisihaaq. Ilmaan Yisihaaq: Esaawuu fi Israaʼel.
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Esaawu: Eliifaaz, Reʼuuʼeel, Yeʼuushi, Yaʼilaamii fi Qooraahi.
english: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Eliifaaz: Teemaan, Oomaar, Zefoo, Gaataamii fi Qenaz; karaa Tiimnaatiin: Amaaleq.
english: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Reʼuuʼeel: Nahaati, Zeraa, Shamaa fi Miizaah.
english: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Seeʼiir: Looxaan, Sobaal, Zibeʼoon, Aannaa, Diishoon, Eezerii fi Diishaan.
english: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Looxaan: Hoorii fi Hoomaam, Tiimnaa obboleettii Looxaan.
english: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam; and Timna was Lotan’s sister.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Sobaal: Aliwaan, Maanahaat, Eebaal, Shefoo fi Oonaami. Ilmaan Zibeʼoon: Ayyaa fi Aannaa.
english: The sons of Shobal: Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

kikuyu: Ilmi Aannaa: Diishoon. Ilmaan Diishoon: Hemdaan, Eshbaan, Yitraanii fi Keraan.
english: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Eezeri: Bilhaan, Zaawaanii fi Aqaan. Ilmaan Diishaan: Uuzii fi Araan.
english: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

kikuyu: Mootonni utuu mootiin Israaʼel tokko iyyuu hin moʼin dura Edoom keessatti moʼan kanneen turan: Belaa ilma Beʼoor kan magaalaan isaa Diinhaabaa jedhamee moggaafame sana.
english: Now these are the kings who reigned in the land of Edom, before any king reigned over the children of Israel: Bela the son of Beor; and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

kikuyu: Belaa duunaan Yoobaab ilmi Zeraa namichi Bozraa iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe.
english: Bela died, and Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Yoobaab duunaan Hushaam namichi biyya Teemaan iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe.
english: Jobab died, and Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Hushaam duunaan Hadaad ilmi Bedad inni biyya Moʼaabitti Midiyaanin moʼate sun iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe. Maqaan magaalaa isaa Aawiit jedhame.
english: Husham died, and Hadad the son of Bedad, who struck Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Avith.

kikuyu: Hadaad duunaan Samlaan namichi Masreeqaa iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe.
english: Hadad died, and Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Samlaan duunaan Shaawul namichi biyya Rehoobooti ishee laga bira jirtu sanaa iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe.
english: Samlah died, and Shaul of Rehoboth by the River reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Shaawul duunaan Baʼaal-Haanaan ilmi Akboor iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe.
english: Shaul died, and Baal Hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Baʼaal-Haanaan duunaan immoo Hadaad iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe. Magaalaan isaas Faaʼuu jedhame. Maqaan niitii isaa immoo Maheexabiʼeel jedhama ture; isheenis intala Maxreed, intala Mee-Zaahaab turte.
english: Baal Hanan died, and Hadad reigned in his place; and the name of his city was Pai. His wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.

kikuyu: Hadaadis ni duʼe. Hangafoota saba Edoom: Tiimnaa, Aalwaa, Yeteeti,
english: Then Hadad died. The chiefs of Edom were: chief Timna, chief Aliah, chief Jetheth,

kikuyu: Oholiibaamaa, Eelaa, Phiinoon,
english: chief Oholibamah, chief Elah, chief Pinon,

kikuyu: Qenaz, Teemaan, Mibzaar,
english: chief Kenaz, chief Teman, chief Mibzar,

kikuyu: Magidiiʼeelii fi Iiraam.
english: chief Magdiel, and chief Iram. These are the chiefs of Edom.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Israaʼel warra kanneenii dha: Ruubeen, Simiʼoon, Lewwii, Yihuudaa, Yisaakor, Zebuuloon,
english: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

kikuyu: Daan, Yoosef, Beniyaam, Niftaalem, Gaadii fi Aasheer.
english: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yihuudaa: Eeri, Oonaanii fi Sheelaa. Isaan kanneen sadanuu intala Shuuwaa, dubartii Kanaʼaan sanatu isaaf daʼe. Eer ilmi Yihuudaa hangaftichi fuula Waaqayyoo duratti hamaa ture. Kanaafuu Waaqayyo isa ajjeese.
english: The sons of Judah: Er, Onan, and Shelah, which three were born to him of Shua’s daughter the Canaanitess. Er, Judah’s firstborn, was wicked in the LORD’s sight; and he killed him.

kikuyu: Taamaar niitiin ilma Yihuudaa Faaresii fi Zaaraa Yihuudaaf deesse.
english: Tamar his daughter-in-law bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Faares: Hezroonii fi Hamuul.
english: The sons of Perez: Hezron and Hamul.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Zaaraa: Zimrii, Eetaan, Heemaan, Kalkoolii fi Daardaa. Isaan walumaa galatti dhiirota shan turan.
english: The sons of Zerah: Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara—five of them in all.

kikuyu: Ilma Karmii: Aakaar isa waan balleeffamuu qabu fudhachuudhaan Israaʼelitti rakkina fide.
english: The son of Carmi: Achar, the troubler of Israel, who committed a trespass in the devoted thing.

kikuyu: Ilma Eetaan: Azaariyaa.
english: The son of Ethan: Azariah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Hezroon: Yeramiʼeel, Raamii fi Keluubaa.
english: The sons also of Hezron, who were born to him: Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

kikuyu: Raam abbaa Abiinaadaab ture; Amiinaadaab immoo abbaa Nahishoon hoogganaa saba Yihuudaa ture.
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab, and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;

kikuyu: Nahishoon abbaa Salmaan; Salmaan immoo abbaa Boʼeez;
english: and Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

kikuyu: Boʼeez abbaa Oobeedi; Yoobeed immoo abbaa Isseey.
english: and Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse;

kikuyu: Ilmaan Isseey: Ilmi isaa hangafni Eliiyaab, lammaffaan Abiinaadaab, sadaffaan Shimeʼaa,
english: and Jesse became the father of his firstborn Eliab, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

kikuyu: Afuraffaan Naatnaaʼel, shanaffaan Raadaayi,
english: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

kikuyu: jaʼaffaan Oozem, torbaffaan Daawit.
english: Ozem the sixth, and David the seventh;

kikuyu: Obboleettonni isaanii immoo Zeruuyaa fi Abiigayiil turan. Ilmaan Zeruuyaa sadan Abiishaayi, Yooʼaabii fi Asaaheel turan.
english: and their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah: Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three.

kikuyu: Abiigayiil haadha Amaasaa kan abbaan isaa Yeteer nama gosa Ishmaaʼeel sanaa ti.
english: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmaelite.

kikuyu: Kaaleb ilmi Hezroon niitii isaa Azuubaa fi Yeriʼooti irraa ijoollee dhalche. Ilmaan Aazubaa kanneen turan: Yeeser, Sobaabii fi Ardoon.
english: Caleb the son of Hezron became the father of children by Azubah his wife, and by Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

kikuyu: Kaalebis Azuubaan duunaan Efraataa fuudhe. Isheenis Huurin isaaf deesse.
english: Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.

kikuyu: Huuri abbaa Uuri; Uuri immoo abbaa Bezaliʼeel.
english: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

kikuyu: Ergasii Hezroon yommuu umuriin isaa waggaa jaatama guutetti intala abbaa Giliʼaad intala Maakiir fuudhe; isheenis Seguubin isaaf deesse.
english: Afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

kikuyu: Seguub immoo abbaa Yaaʼiir ture; innis biyya Giliʼaad keessaa magaalaawwan digdamii sadii qaba ture.
english: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

kikuyu: Geshuurii fi Arraam, magaalaa Yaaʼiir akkasumas Qeenaatii fi gandoota naannoo ishee jiraniin walitti magaalaawwan jaatama irraa fudhatan.
english: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and its villages, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

kikuyu: Hezroon erga Kaaleb Efraataatti duʼee booddee, niitiin isaa Abiyaan Ashihuur abbaa Teqooʼaa deesseef.
english: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Abijah, Hezron’s wife, bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yeramiʼeel ilma Hezroon hangafticha sanaa: Raam ilma isaa hangafticha, Buunaah, Ooren, Oozemii fi Ahiiyaa.
english: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

kikuyu: Yeramiʼeel niitii biraa kan Aaxaaraa jedhamtu qaba ture; isheenis haadha Oonaam turte.
english: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah. She was the mother of Onam.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Raam ilma Yeramiʼeel hangafticha sanaa: Maʼaaz, Yaamiinii fi Eeqeer.
english: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Oonaam: Shamaayii fi Yaadaa. Ilmaan Shamaayi: Naadaabii fi Abiishur.
english: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab and Abishur.

kikuyu: Niitiin Abiishur Abiihaayil jedhamti; isheenis Ahibaanii fi Mooliid isaaf deesse.
english: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Naadaab: Seleedii fi Afayiim. Seleed utuu ijoollee hin dhalchin duʼe.
english: The sons of Nadab: Seled and Appaim; but Seled died without children.

kikuyu: Ilma Afayiim: Yisheʼii; Yisheʼiin abbaa Sheeshaan. Sheeshaan immoo abbaa Ahilayi.
english: The son of Appaim: Ishi. The son of Ishi: Sheshan. The son of Sheshan: Ahlai.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yaadaa kan obboleessa Shamaayi: Yeteerii fi Yoonaataan. Yeteer utuu ijoollee hin dhalchin duʼe.
english: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without children.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yoonaataan: Pheletii fi Zaazaa.
english: The sons of Jonathan: Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

kikuyu: Sheeshaan intallan malee ilmaan hin qabu ture. Innis tajaajilaa lammii Gibxi kan Yarihaa jedhamu tokko qaba ture.
english: Now Sheshan had no sons, but only daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.

kikuyu: Sheeshaan tajaajilaa isaa Yarihaatti intala isaa ni heerumsiise; isheenis Ataayin deesseef.
english: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.

kikuyu: Ataayi abbaa Naataan; Naataan immoo abbaa Zaabaadin;
english: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

kikuyu: Zaabaad abbaa Eflaal; Efelaal immoo abbaa Oobeedi;
english: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

kikuyu: Oobeedi abbaa Yehuu; Yehuun abbaa Azaariyaa;
english: and Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,

kikuyu: Azaariyaa abbaa Heleez; Helees immoo abbaa Eleʼaasaa ti;
english: and Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,

kikuyu: Eleʼaasaan abbaa Sismaayi; Sismaayi abbaa Shaluum;
english: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,

kikuyu: Shaluum abbaa Yeqameyaa ti; Yeqameyaan immoo abbaa Eliishaamaa ti.
english: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Kaaleb obboleessa Yeramiʼeel: Meeshaan ilmi isaa hangaftichi abbaa Ziif; Ziif abbaa Maareeshaa ti; Maareeshaan immoo abbaa Kebroon.
english: The sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Kebroon: Qooraahi, Tafuuʼaa, Reqemii fi Shemaa.
english: The sons of Hebron: Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

kikuyu: Shemaan abbaa Raham; Raham immoo abbaa Yorqeʼaam. Reqem abbaa Shamaayi.
english: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

kikuyu: Shamaayi abbaa Maaʼoon; Maaʼoon immoo abbaa Beet Zuuri.
english: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.

kikuyu: Eefaan saajjatoon Kaaleb sun haadha Haaraan, Moozaa fi Gaazeez. Haaraan immoo abbaa Gaazer.
english: Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yaahidaay: Reegeem, Yootaam, Geeshaan, Phelet, Eefaa fi Shaʼaaf.
english: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

kikuyu: Maʼakaan saajjatoon Kaaleb sun haadha Shebeerii fi Tirhaanaa ti.
english: Maacah, Caleb’s concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

kikuyu: Isheen akkasumas Shaʼaaf abbaa Madmaanaa, Shewwaa abbaa Makbeenaa fi abbaa Gibeʼaa deesse. Kaaleb intala Aaksaa jedhamtu qaba ture.
english: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen sanyiiwwan Kaaleb turan. Ilmaan Huuri ilma Efraataa hangaftichaa: Sobaal abbaa Kiriyaati Yeʼaariim,
english: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,

kikuyu: Salmaan abbaa Beetlihem, Haareef abbaa Beet Gaadeer.
english: Salma the father of Bethlehem, and Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

kikuyu: Sanyiiwwan Sobaal kan abbaa Kiriyaati Yeʼaariim: Walakkaan Menuhootaa, Haarooʼee,
english: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.

kikuyu: akkasumas gosti Kiriyaati Yeʼaariim, Yitraawonni, Fuutonni, Shumaatonni, Mishiraawonni, Zoraatotaa fi Eshitaaʼoloonni gosoota isaan kanneen keessaa dhalatanii dha.
english: The families of Kiriath Jearim: the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

kikuyu: Sanyiiwwan Salmaan: Beetlihem, Netoofota, Atroot Beet Yooʼaab, walakkaa Maanaheetotaa, Zoraatota faʼi;
english: The sons of Salma: Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.

kikuyu: balbala barreessitootaa kanneen Yaabeex keessa jiraatan: Tiraatota, Shimeʼaatotaa fi Sukaatota. Isaan kunneen Qeenota mana abbaa Rekaab Hamaati keessaa dhalatanii dha.
english: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen ilmaan Daawit Kebroonitti dhalchee dha: Ilmi isaa hangafni Amnoon kan Ahiinooʼam dubartiin Yizriʼeel deessee dha; inni lammaffaan immoo Daaniʼel kan Abiigayiil dubartiin Qarmeloos deessee dha;
english: Now these were the sons of David, who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess;

kikuyu: sadaffaan Abesaaloom isa Maʼakaan intalli Talmaay mooticha Geshuur deessee dha; afuraffaan Adooniyaa ilma Hagiit;
english: the third, Absalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith;

kikuyu: shanaffaan Shefaaxiyaa ilma Abiixaal; jaʼaffaan Yitreʼaam kan inni niitii isaa Eglaa irraa dhalchee dha.
english: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:

kikuyu: Isaan jaʼaan kunneen warra yeroo Daawit Kebroonitti waggaa torbaa fi walakkaa mootii turetti isaaf dhalatanii dha.
english: six were born to him in Hebron; and he reigned there seven years and six months. He reigned thirty-three years in Jerusalem;

kikuyu: ijoolleen achitti isaaf dhalatanis kanneenii dha: Shimeʼaa, Shobaab, Naataanii fi Solomoon. Ilmaan afran kunneen Batisheebaa intala Amiiʼeel irraa dhalatan.
english: and these were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four, by Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;

kikuyu: Akkasumas ilmaan biraa qaba ture; isaanis: Yibehaar, Eliishuuwaa, Eliiphelexi,
english: and Ibhar, Elishama, Eliphelet,

kikuyu: Noogaa, Nefeg, Yaafiiyaa,
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

kikuyu: Eliishaamaa, Eliyaadaa fi Eliiphelexi; isaanis walumatti ilmaan sagal turan.
english: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.

kikuyu: Ilmaan saajjatoowwan isaa irraa dhalataniin alatti isaan kunneen ilmaan Daawit turan. Taamaar immoo obboleettii isaanii turte.
english: All these were the sons of David, in addition to the sons of the concubines; and Tamar was their sister.

kikuyu: Ilmi Solomoon Rehooboʼaam; ilmi Rehooboʼaam Abiyaa dha; ilmi Abiyaa Aasaa dha; ilmi Aasaa Yehooshaafaax;
english: Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abijah his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,

kikuyu: ilmi Yehooshaafaax Yehooraam; ilmi Yooraam Ahaaziyaa; ilmi Ahaaziyaa Yooʼaash;
english: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,

kikuyu: ilmi Yooʼaash Amasiyaa; ilmi Amasiyaa Azaariyaa; ilmi Azaariyaa Yootaam;
english: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,

kikuyu: ilmi Yootaam Aahaaz; ilmi Aahaaz Hisqiyaas; ilmi Hisqiyaas Minaasee dha;
english: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,

kikuyu: ilmi Minaasee Aamoon; ilmi isaa immoo Yosiyaas.
english: Amon his son, and Josiah his son.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yosiyaas: Inni hangafni Yoohaanaan, lammaffaan Yehooyaaqiim, sadaffaan Zedeqiyaa, afuraffaan immoo Shaluum.
english: The sons of Josiah: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yehooyaaqiim: Ilma isaa Yehooyaakiinii fi ilma isaa Zedeqiyaa.
english: The sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, and Zedekiah his son.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yehooyaakiin isa boojiʼame sanaa: Ilma isaa Sheʼaltiiʼeel,
english: The sons of Jeconiah, the captive: Shealtiel his son,

kikuyu: Malkiiraam, Phedaayaa, Shenaaxaar, Yeqameyaa, Hooshaamaa fi Nedaabiyaa.
english: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazzar, Jekamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Phedaayaa: Zarubaabelii fi Shimeʼii. Ilmaan Zarubaabel: Meshulaamii fi Hanaaniyaa. Obboleettiin isaanii immoo Sheloomiit jedhamti.
english: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubbabel and Shimei. The sons of Zerubbabel: Meshullam and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;

kikuyu: Akkasumas ijoollee gara biraa shanitu ture; isaanis: Hashubaa, Oohel, Berekiyaa, Hasadiyaa fi Yooshab-Heseed.
english: and Hashubah, Ohel, Berechiah, Hasadiah, and Jushab Hesed, five.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Hanaaniyaa: Phelaatiyaa fi Yeshaayaa; akkasumas ilmaan Refaayaa, ilmaan Arnaan, ilmaan Obaadiyaatii fi ilmaan Shekaaniyaa.
english: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Shekaaniyaa: Shemaaʼiyaa fi ilmaan isaa: Haxuush, Yigiʼaal, Baariiyaah, Naʼaariyaa fi Shaafaax; isaan walumatti jaʼa turan.
english: The son of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, Igal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Naʼaariyaa: Eliiyooʼeenayi, Hisqiyaasii fi Azriiqaam; isaan walumatti sadii turan.
english: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Eliiyooʼeenayi: Hoodayiwaa, Eliyaashiib, Phelaayaa, Aquub, Yoohaanaan, Delaayaa fi Anaanii; isaan walumatti torba turan.
english: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Delaiah, and Anani, seven.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yihuudaa: Faares, Hezroon, Karmii, Huurii fi Sobaal.
english: The sons of Judah: Perez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

kikuyu: Reʼaayaan ilmi Sobaal abbaa Yahaatiiti; Yahaati immoo abbaa Ahuumaayii fi Laahadii ti. Isaan kunneen balbalawwan Zoraatotaa ti.
english: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Eexaam kanneenii dha: Yizriʼeel, Yishmaa fi Yidbaashi. Obboleettiin isaanii immoo Hazelelphoonii jedhamti.
english: These were the sons of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash. The name of their sister was Hazzelelponi.

kikuyu: Phenuuʼeel abbaa Gedoor; Eezer immoo abbaa Huushaam. Isaan kunneen sanyii Huuri ilma Efraataa hangaftichaatii fi abbaa Beetlihem sanaa ti.
english: Penuel was the father of Gedor and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Bethlehem.

kikuyu: Ashihuur abbaan Teqooʼaa niitota lama kanneen Heelaa fi Naʼaraa jedhaman qaba ture.
english: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.

kikuyu: Naʼaraan ilmaan Ahuzaam, Heefer, Teemenii fi Haaʼahashitaar jedhaman deesseef. Ilmaan Naʼaraa isaan kanneen turan.
english: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Heelaa: Zeret, Zooharii fi Etnaan;
english: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.

kikuyu: Qoosi abbaa Anuub, abbaa Hazobeebaa fi abbaa balbalawwan Ahariheel ilma Haaruumiti.
english: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.

kikuyu: Yaabeex nama obboloota isaa caalaa ulfina qabu ture; haatii isaa, “Ani dhiphinaanan isa daʼe” jettee Yaabeex jettee isa moggaafte.
english: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers. His mother named him Jabez, saying, “Because I bore him with sorrow.”

kikuyu: Yaabeex immoo akkana jedhee Waaqa Israaʼelitti iyyate; “Ati na eebbisi; biyya koos naaf balʼisi! Akka ani hin miidhamnee fi akka ani dhiphina jalaa baʼuuf harki kee na wajjin haa jiraatu.” Waaqnis waan inni kadhate sana ni kenneef.
english: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, “Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border! May your hand be with me, and may you keep me from evil, that I may not cause pain!” God granted him that which he requested.

kikuyu: Kiluub obboleessi Shuhaa abbaa Mihiirii ti; Mehiir immoo abbaa Eshitooniti.
english: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

kikuyu: Eshitoonis abbaa Beet Raafaan, abbaa Faasehaa fi Tehiinaa ti; Tahiinaan immoo abbaa Iir Naahaashii ti. Isaan kunneen namoota Reekaa ti.
english: Eshton became the father of Beth Rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Qenaz: Otniiʼeelii fi Seraayaa. Ilmaan Otniiʼeel: Hataatii fi Maʼoonotaayi.
english: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.

kikuyu: Meʼoonotaayi abbaa Ofraa ti. Seraayaan abbaa Yooʼaabii ti; Yooʼaab immoo abbaa Gee Haraashiimii ti. Maqaan kun sababii isaan ogummaa hojii harkaa qabaniif kennameef.
english: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Joab the father of Ge Harashim, for they were craftsmen.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Kaaleb ilma Yefunee: Iiruu, Eelaa fi Naʼaam. Ilmi Eelaa: Qenaz.
english: The sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam. The son of Elah: Kenaz.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yehaleliʼeel: Ziifii, Ziifaa, Tiiriyaa fi Asareel.
english: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Izraa: Yeteer, Mered, Eeferii fi Yaaloon. Niitota Mered keessaa isheen tokko Miiriyaam, Shamaayii fi Yishibaa abbaa Eshtimoʼaa sana deesse.
english: The sons of Ezrah: Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and Mered’s wife bore Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.

kikuyu: Niitiin isaa dubartiin Yihuudaa sunis Yaared abbaa Gedoor, Hebeer abbaa Sookooniitii fi Yequutiiʼeel abbaa Zaanoʼaa deesse. Isaan kunneen ijoollee Bitiyaa intala Faraʼoon kan Mered fuudhe sanaa ti.
english: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.

kikuyu: Ilmaan niitiin Hoodiyaa obboleettiin Naham sun deesse: Abbaa Qeyiilaa namicha Garmii sanaatii fi Eshtimoʼaa namicha Maʼakaa ti.
english: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the fathers of Keilah the Garmite and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Simiʼoon: Amnoon, Riinaa, Ben-Haanaanii fi Tiiloon. Ilmaan Yishiʼii: Zoheetii fi Ben-Zoheetii ti.
english: The sons of Shimon: Amnon, Rinnah, Ben Hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi: Zoheth, and Ben Zoheth.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Sheelaa ilma Yihuudaa: Eer abbaa Leekaa, Laʼadaa abbaa Maareeshaatii fi balbalawwan Beet Ashibeeʼaatti warra wayyaa quncee talbaa haphii hojjetanii.
english: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah: Er the father of Lecah, Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen, of the house of Ashbea;

kikuyu: Yooqiim, namoota Koozeebaa, Yooʼaashii fi Saaraaf isa Moʼaabii fi Yaashubiileheem bulchu. Barreeffamni kunneenis kan bara durii ti.
english: and Jokim, and the men of Cozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had dominion in Moab, and Jashubilehem. These records are ancient.

kikuyu: Isaanis suphee dhooftuu Nexaayiimii fi Gedeeraa keessa jiraatan turan; jarri kun mootichaaf hojjechaa achi jiraatu ture.
english: These were the potters, and the inhabitants of Netaim and Gederah; they lived there with the king for his work.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Simiʼoon: Nemuuʼeel, Yaamiin, Yaariib, Zeraa fi Shaawul;
english: The sons of Simeon: Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, Shaul;

kikuyu: Shaluum ilma Saaʼuul ture; Mibsaam ilma Shaluumiti; Mishmaa immoo ilma Mabsaamiti.
english: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, and Mishma his son.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Mishmaa: Ilma isaa Hamuuʼeel, ilma isaa Zakuurii fi ilma isaa Shimeʼii.
english: The sons of Mishma: Hammuel his son, Zaccur his son, Shimei his son.

kikuyu: Shimeʼiin ilmaan kudha jaʼaa fi intallan jaʼa qaba ture; obboloonni isaa garuu ijoollee hedduu hin qaban ture; sababii kanaaf balbalawwan isaanii hundinuu akka gosa Yihuudaa baayʼee hin turre.
english: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers didn’t have many children, and all their family didn’t multiply like the children of Judah.

kikuyu: Isaanis Bersheebaa, Molaadaa, Hazar Shuuʼaal,
english: They lived at Beersheba, Moladah, Hazarshual,

kikuyu: Bilihaa, Ezem, Toolaad,
english: at Bilhah, at Ezem, at Tolad,

kikuyu: Betuuʼeel, Hormaa, Siiqlaag,
english: at Bethuel, at Hormah, at Ziklag,

kikuyu: Beet Markaabot, Hazar Susiim, Beet Biirii fi Shaʼarayiim keessa jiraatan. Magaalaawwan kunneen hamma bara mootummaa Daawitiitti magaalaawwan isaanii turan.
english: at Beth Marcaboth, Hazar Susim, at Beth Biri, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities until David’s reign.

kikuyu: Akkasumas gandoota Eexaam, Ayin, Reemoon, Tookkenii fi Ashaan jechuunis magaalaa shananii fi
english: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan, five cities;

kikuyu: gandoota naannoo isaaniitti argaman hunda keessa hamma Baʼaaliitti jiraatu ture.
english: and all their villages that were around the same cities, as far as Baal. These were their settlements, and they kept their genealogy.

kikuyu: Meshoobaab, Yamleek, Yooshaa ilma Amasiyaa,
english: Meshobab, Jamlech, Joshah the son of Amaziah,

kikuyu: Yooʼeel, Yehuu ilma Yooshibiyaa, ilma Seraayaa, ilma Asiiʼeel,
english: Joel, Jehu the son of Joshibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

kikuyu: akkasumas Eliiyooʼeenayi, Yaaʼiqoobaa, Yashoohayaa, Asaayaa, Aadiiʼeel, Yesiimiʼeel, Benaayaa,
english: Elioenai, Jaakobah, Jeshohaiah, Asaiah, Adiel, Jesimiel, Benaiah,

kikuyu: Ziizaa ilma Shiifii, ilma Aloon, ilma Yedaayaa, ilma Shimrii, ilma Shemaaʼiyaa.
english: and Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah—

kikuyu: Namoonni maqaan isaanii kanaa olitti himame kunneen hooggantoota balbala isaanii turan. Baayʼinni maatii isaaniis akka malee dabalaa dhufe;
english: these mentioned by name were princes in their families. Their fathers’ houses increased greatly.

kikuyu: isaanis bushaayee isaaniitiif lafa dheedaa barbaacha hamma moggaa Gedoor kan gama baʼa sululaa jiru sanaatti deeman.
english: They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

kikuyu: Isaanis naannoo sanatti lafa dheedaa gabbataa fi gaarii argatan; lafni sunis balʼaa, kan nagaa fi tasgabbii qabu ture. Bara durii gosoonni Haamii naannoo sana jiraachaa turan.
english: They found rich, good pasture, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceful, for those who lived there before were descended from Ham.

kikuyu: Namoonni maqaan isaanii dhaʼame kunneen bara Hisqiyaas mootii Yihuudaa ture keessa dhufan. Isaan akkuma hamma harʼaatti illee mulʼatu qubata Kaamotaatii fi Meʼuunoota achi jiraachaa turanii dhaʼanii guutumaan guutuutti isaan barbadeessan. Ergasiis sababii lafa dheedaa balʼaa bushaayee isaaniitiif argataniif lafa jaraa irra ni qubatan.
english: These written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and struck their tents and the Meunim who were found there; and they destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place, because there was pasture there for their flocks.

kikuyu: Simiʼoonota kanneen keessaa namoonni dhibba shan ilmaan Yishiʼii Phelaatiyaa, Naʼaariyaa, Refaayaa fi Uziiʼeel hoogganamanii biyya gaaraa Seeʼiir weeraran.
english: Some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to Mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.

kikuyu: Isaanis Amaaleqoota miliqanii hafan balleessanii hamma harʼaatti achuma jiraatan.
english: They struck the remnant of the Amalekites who escaped, and have lived there to this day.

kikuyu: Ruubeen Israaʼeliif ilma hangafa ture; taʼus sababii inni siree abbaa isaa xureesseef mirgi hangafummaa isaa ilmaan Yoosef ilma Israaʼel sanaatiif kenname. Kanaafuu inni akka mirga isaa kan dhalootaan argamuutti hidda dhalootaa keessatti hin galmeeffamne;
english: The sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel (for he was the firstborn, but because he defiled his father’s couch, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph the son of Israel; and the genealogy is not to be listed according to the birthright.

kikuyu: Yihuudaan obboloota isaa keessa nama jabaa fi kan mootummaan isa keessaa baʼe taʼu illee mirgi hangafummaa kan Yoosefii ti.
english: For Judah prevailed above his brothers, and from him came the prince; but the birthright was Joseph’s)—

kikuyu: Ilmaan Ruubeen ilma Israaʼel hangaftichaa: Henooki, Faluusoo, Hezroonii fi Karmii.
english: the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel: Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yooʼeel: Shemaaʼiyaa ilma isaa, Googi ilma isaa, Shimeʼii ilma isaa,
english: The sons of Joel: Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,

kikuyu: Miikaa ilma isaa, Reʼaayaa ilma isaa, Baʼaal ilma isaatii fi
english: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,

kikuyu: Biʼeeraa ilma isaa kan mootiin Asoor Tiiglaat-Philneeser boojiʼee fudhatee dha. Beʼeeraan hoogganaa gosa Ruubeen ture.
english: and Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive. He was prince of the Reubenites.

kikuyu: Firoonni isaanii warri akkuma hidda dhaloota isaaniitti balbala balbalaan galmeeffaman kanneenii dha: Yeʼiiʼeel hangafticha, Zakkaariyaas,
english: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was listed: the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,

kikuyu: Beelaa ilma Aazaazi, ilma Shemaa, ilma Yooʼeel. Isaanis naannoo Aroʼeeri jalqabee hamma Neboo fi Baʼaal Meʼooniitti jiru keessa qubatan.
english: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon;

kikuyu: Isaanis sababii horiin isaanii Giliʼaadi keessatti baayʼateef karaa baʼa biiftuutiin hamma daarii gammoojjii kan gara laga Efraaxiisitti balʼatu sanaatti biyyattii qabatan.
english: and he lived eastward even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Euphrates, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.

kikuyu: Isaan jabana Saaʼol keessa Aggaariitti waraana kaasan; jarris harka isaaniitti moʼataman; isaanis iddoo jireenyaa warra Aggaar kan Giliʼaadiin gama baʼa biiftuu jiru guutumaan guutuutti qabatan.
english: In the days of Saul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of Gilead.

kikuyu: Gosoonni Gaad isaanitti aananii Baashaan keessa lafa hamma Salkaatti argamu irra jiraatan; isaanis:
english: The sons of Gad lived beside them in the land of Bashan to Salecah:

kikuyu: Yooʼeel hangaftichi, Shaafaam itti aanaan isaa, Yaʼinayii fi Shaafaax Baashaan keessa jiraatan.
english: Joel the chief, Shapham the second, Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

kikuyu: Firoonni isaanii maatii maatiidhaan kanneenii dha: Miikaaʼel, Meshulaam, Shebaa, Yooraay, Yaakaan, Ziiʼaa fi Eeber; walumaa galatti torba turan.
english: Their brothers of their fathers’ houses: Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jacan, Zia, and Eber, seven.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen immoo ilmaan Abiihaayil ilma Huuri, ilma Yaarokaa, ilma Giliʼaad, ilma Miikaaʼel, ilma Yeshiishaayi, ilma Yakedoo, ilma Buuzii ti.
english: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

kikuyu: Ahiin ilmi Abdiʼeel, hangafa maatii isaanii ture; Abdiʼeel immoo ilma Guunii ti.
english: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Warri Gaad Giliʼaad keessa, Baashaanii fi gandoota daarii isheetti argaman, akkasumas lafa tikaa kan Shaaroon keessatti argaman hundaa fi qarqara isaa jiraatan.
english: They lived in Gilead in Bashan and in its towns, and in all the pasture lands of Sharon as far as their borders.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen hundi jabana Yootaam mootii Yihuudaa turee fi jabana Yerobiʼaam mootii Israaʼel ture keessa galmee hidda dhalootaa keessatti galmeeffaman.
english: All these were listed by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.

kikuyu: Ruubeenonni, Gaadonnii fi walakkaan gosa Minaasee namoota dandeettii lolaa qaban 44,760 qaban ture; isaanis namoota jajjaboo warra gaachanaa fi goraadee qabachuu dandaʼan, warra xiyya darbachuu dandaʼanii fi warra waraanaaf leenjifaman turan.
english: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, able to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred sixty that were able to go out to war.

kikuyu: Jarri kunis warra Aggaariitti, warra Yexuuritti, Naafiishiittii fi Noodaabiitti waraana ni banan.
english: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.

kikuyu: Sababii isaan waraana sana irratti gara Waaqaatti iyyatanii turaniif Waaqni isaan gargaaree warra Aggaariitii fi garee isaanii hunda dabarsee harka isaaniitti kenne. Innis sababii isaan isa amanataniif kadhannaa isaaniitiif deebii kenne.
english: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to God in the battle, and he answered them because they put their trust in him.

kikuyu: Isaanis horii warra Aggaar gaala kuma shan, hoolaa kuma dhibba lamaa fi shantamaa fi harree kuma lama saaman. Akkasumas nama kuma dhibba tokkoo boojiʼan;
english: They took away their livestock: of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of men one hundred thousand.

kikuyu: sababii lolli sun kan Waaqaa tureef namoonni biraa baayʼeen ni ajjeefaman. Isaanis hamma bara boojuutti biyya sana keessa ni jiraatan.
english: For many fell slain, because the war was of God. They lived in their place until the captivity.

kikuyu: Walakkaan gosa Minaasee baayʼee turan; isaanis Baashaanii jalqabanii hamma Baʼaal Hermooniitti, hamma Seniir Tulluu Hermoonitti biyya sana keessa qubatan.
english: The children of the half-tribe of Manasseh lived in the land. They increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon, Senir, and Mount Hermon.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen hangafoota maatii isaanii ti: Eefer, Yishiʼii, Eliiʼeel, Azriiʼeel, Ermiyaas, Hoodayiwaa fi Yadiiʼeel. Isaan kunneen loltoota gootota, namoota bebbeekamoo fi hangafoota maatii isaanii ti.
english: These were the heads of their fathers’ houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel—mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu Waaqa abbootii isaaniitiif amanamuu didanii waaqota saboota biyyattii wajjin sagaagalan; saboonni kunneenis warra Waaqni fuula isaanii duraa balleessee dha.
english: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom God destroyed before them.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqni Israaʼel hafuura Fohaa mooticha Asoor jechuunis hafuura Phuuli kakaasee akka inni gosoota Ruubeen, kan Gaadiitii fi walakkaa gosa Minaasee boojiʼu godhe. Innis warra kanneen gara Halaa, Haaboor, Haaraatii fi gara qarqara laga Goozaaniitti geesse; isaanis hamma harʼaatti achuma jiraatan.
english: So the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Lewwii: Geershoon, Qohaatii fi Meraar.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Qohaati: Amraam, Yizihaar, Kebroonii fi Uziiʼeel.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen Amraam: Aroon, Musee fi Miiriyaam. Ilmaan Aroon: Naadaab, Abiihuu, Eleʼaazaarii fi Iitaamaar.
english: The children of Amram: Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Eleʼaazaar abbaa Fiinehaas; Fiinehaas immoo abbaa Abiishuuwaa ti;
english: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, Phinehas became the father of Abishua,

kikuyu: Abiishuuwaan abbaa Buukii ti; Bukiin immoo abbaa Uzii ti;
english: Abishua became the father of Bukki. Bukki became the father of Uzzi.

kikuyu: Uzii abbaa Zeraayaa ti; Zaraaʼiyaan abbaa Meraayootii ti;
english: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah. Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth.

kikuyu: Meraayoot abbaa Amariyaa ti; Amariyaan abbaa Ahiixuubii ti;
english: Meraioth became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

kikuyu: Ahiixuub abbaa Zaadoqii ti; Zaadoq abbaa Ahiimaʼazii ti;
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Ahimaaz.

kikuyu: Ahiimaʼaz abbaa Azaariyaa ti; Azaariyaa abbaa Yoohaanaanii ti;
english: Ahimaaz became the father of Azariah. Azariah became the father of Johanan.

kikuyu: Yoohaanaan abbaa Azaariyaa ti; inni luba taʼee mana qulqullummaa kan Solomoon Yerusaalemitti ijaare keessa tajaajilaa ture.
english: Johanan became the father of Azariah, who executed the priest’s office in the house that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Azaariyaa abbaa Amariyaa ti; Amariyaan abbaa Ahiixuubii ti;
english: Azariah became the father of Amariah. Amariah became the father of Ahitub.

kikuyu: Ahiixuub abbaa Zaadoqii ti; Zaadoq abbaa Shaluumii ti;
english: Ahitub became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Shallum.

kikuyu: Shaluum abbaa Hilqiyaa ti; Hilqiyaa abbaa Azaariyaa ti;
english: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah. Hilkiah became the father of Azariah.

kikuyu: Azaariyaa abbaa Seraayaa ti; Seraayaan abbaa Yehoozaadaaqii ti.
english: Azariah became the father of Seraiah. Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak.

kikuyu: Yeroo Waaqayyo akka sabni Yihuudaatii fi Yerusaalem Nebukadnezariin boojiʼamu godhetti Yehoozaadaaqis boojiʼamee fudhatame.
english: Jehozadak went into captivity when the LORD carried Judah and Jerusalem away by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Lewwii: Geershoom, Qohaatii fi Meraarii.
english: The sons of Levi: Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Maqaan Ilmaan Geershoom kanaa dha: Loobeenii fi Shimeʼii.
english: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Qohaati: Amraam, Yizihaar, Kebroonii fi Uziiʼeel.
english: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Meraarii: Mahilii fi Muusii.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their fathers’ households.

kikuyu: Balbala Geershoom keessaa: Ilma isaa Loobeen, ilma isaa Yahaati, ilma isaa Zimaati,
english: Of Gershom: Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,

kikuyu: ilma isaa Yooʼaa, ilma isaa Iddoo, ilma isaa Zeraa fi ilma isaa Yeʼaateraayi.
english: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, and Jeatherai his son.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Qohaati: Ilma isaa Amiinaadaab, ilma isaa Qooraahi, ilma isaa Asiir,
english: The sons of Kohath: Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,

kikuyu: ilma isaa Elqaanaa, ilma isaa Ebiyaasaaf, ilma isaa Asiir,
english: Elkanah his son, Ebiasaph his son, Assir his son,

kikuyu: ilma isaa Tahaat, ilma isaa Uuriiʼeel, ilma isaa Uziyaa fi ilma isaa Shaawul.
english: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Elqaanaa: Amaasaayi, Ahiimooti,
english: The sons of Elkanah: Amasai and Ahimoth.

kikuyu: ilma isaa Elqaanaa, ilma isaa Zoofayi, ilma isaa Naahat,
english: As for Elkanah, the sons of Elkanah: Zophai his son, Nahath his son,

kikuyu: ilma isaa Eliiyaab, ilma isaa Yeroohaam, ilma isaa Elqaanaa fi ilma isaa Saamuʼeel.
english: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, and Elkanah his son.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Saamuʼeel: Ilma isaa Yooʼeel hangaftichaa fi ilma isaa lammaffaa Abiyaa.
english: The sons of Samuel: the firstborn, Joel, and the second, Abijah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Meraarii: Mahilii, ilma isaa Loobeen, ilma isaa Shimeʼii, ilma isaa Uzaa,
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzzah his son,

kikuyu: ilma isaa Shimeʼaa, ilma isaa Hagiyaa fi ilma isaa Asaayaa.
english: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.

kikuyu: Namoonni erga taabonni dhufee achi boqotee booddee Daawit akka isaan faarfannaadhaan mana Waaqayyoo keessa tajaajilaniif muude kanneenii dha.
english: These are they whom David set over the service of song in the LORD’s house after the ark came to rest there.

kikuyu: Isaanis hamma Solomoon Yerusaalem keessatti mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyoo ijaaretti dunkaana qulqulluu, dunkaana wal gaʼii duratti faarfannaadhaan tajaajilaa turan. Isaanis akkuma seera isaaniif kenname sanaatti hojii isaanii hojjechaa turan.
english: They ministered with song before the tabernacle of the Tent of Meeting until Solomon had built the LORD’s house in Jerusalem. They performed the duties of their office according to their order.

kikuyu: Maqaan namoota ilmaan isaanii wajjin tajaajilanii kanneenii dha: Ilmaan Qohaatotaa keessaa: Heemaan Faarfataa, ilma Yooʼeel, ilma Saamuʼeel,
english: These are those who served, and their sons. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman the singer, the son of Joel, the son of Samuel,

kikuyu: ilma Elqaanaa, ilma Yeroohaam, ilma Eliiʼeel, ilma Tooʼaa,
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

kikuyu: ilma Zuufi, ilma Elqaanaa, ilma Mahat, ilma Amaasaayi,
english: the son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

kikuyu: ilma Elqaanaa, ilma Yooʼeel, ilma Azaariyaa, ilma Sefaaniyaa,
english: the son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

kikuyu: ilma Tahaat, ilma Asiir, ilma Ebiyaasaaf, ilma Qooraahi,
english: the son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

kikuyu: ilma Yizihaar, ilma Qohaati, ilma Lewwii, ilma Israaʼel;
english: the son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

kikuyu: akkasumas Asaaf obboleessi Heemaan karaa mirgaatiin dhaabata ture: Asaaf ilma Berekiyaa, ilma Shimeʼaa,
english: His brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berechiah, the son of Shimea,

kikuyu: ilma Miikaaʼel, ilma Baʼaseeyaa, ilma Malkiyaa,
english: the son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchijah,

kikuyu: ilma Etnii, ilma Zeraa, ilma Adaayaa,
english: the son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

kikuyu: ilma Eetaan, ilma Zimaa, ilma Shimeʼii,
english: the son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

kikuyu: ilma Yahaati, ilma Geershoom, ilma Lewwii;
english: the son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

kikuyu: karaa bitaa isaatiin immoo warri isaan wajjin turan gosa Meraarii keessaa: Eetaan ilma Qiisaa, ilma Abdii, ilma Maluuk,
english: On the left hand their brothers the sons of Merari: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

kikuyu: ilma Hashabiyaa, ilma Amasiyaa, ilma Hilqiyaa,
english: the son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

kikuyu: ilma Amzii, ilma Baanii, ilma Shemeer,
english: the son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shemer,

kikuyu: ilma Mahilii, ilma Muusii, ilma Meraarii, ilma Lewwii.
english: the son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

kikuyu: Obboloonni isaanii Lewwonni akka hojii dunkaana qulqulluu mana Waaqaa hunda hojjetaniif ramadamanii turan.
english: Their brothers the Levites were appointed for all the service of the tabernacle of God’s house.

kikuyu: Aroonii fi ilmaan isaa garuu akkuma waan Museen garbichi Waaqaa sun ajajee ture hundaatti hojii Iddoo Iddoo Hunda Caalaa Qulqulluu taʼe sanaatiif, sababii Israaʼeliitiifis araara buusuudhaaf iddoo aarsaa kan aarsaa gubamuutii fi iddoo aarsaa ixaanaa irratti aarsaawwan dhiʼeessaa turan.
english: But Aaron and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Aroon kanneenii dha: Ilma isaa Eleʼaazaar, ilma isaa Fiinehaas, ilma isaa Abiishuuwaa,
english: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

kikuyu: ilma isaa Bukii, ilma isaa Uzii, ilma isaa Zeraayaa,
english: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,

kikuyu: ilma isaa Meraayoot, ilma isaa Amariyaa, ilma isaa Ahiixuub,
english: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,

kikuyu: ilma isaa Zaadoqii fi ilma isaa Ahiimaʼaz.
english: Zadok his son, and Ahimaaz his son.

kikuyu: Sababii ixaan jalqabaa isaaniif baʼeef iddoowwan kunneen Aroonii fi ilmaan isaa kanneen balbala Qohaati keessaa dhufaniif ni kennaman; iddoowwan qubata isaanii kanneen akka biyya isaanii taʼaniif isaaniif ramadamanii dha:
english: Now these are their dwelling places according to their encampments in their borders: to the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites (for theirs was the first lot),

kikuyu: Kebroon isheen biyya Yihuudaa keessaatii fi lafti dheedaa kan naannoo isheetti argamtu isaaniif ni kennaman.
english: to them they gave Hebron in the land of Judah, and its pasture lands around it;

kikuyu: Lafti qotiisaatii fi gandoonni naannoo Kebrooniitti argaman garuu Kaaleb ilma Yefuneetiif ni kennaman.
english: but the fields of the city and its villages, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Arooniif immoo magaalaawwan itti baqatan Kebroon, Libnaa, Yatiir, Eshtimoʼaa,
english: To the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of refuge, Hebron, Libnah also with its pasture lands, Jattir, Eshtemoa with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Hiileen, Debiir,
english: Hilen with its pasture lands, Debir with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Ashaan, Yootaa fi Beet Shemeshitu lafa dheeda isaanii wajjin kenname.
english: Ashan with its pasture lands, and Beth Shemesh with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Qooda gosa Beniyaam keessaa immoo Gibeʼoon, Gebaa, Alemetii fi Anaatootittu lafa dheeda isaanii wajjin ni kennameef.
english: and out of the tribe of Benjamin, Geba with its pasture lands, Allemeth with its pasture lands, and Anathoth with its pasture lands. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Qohaati kanneen hafaniif immoo balbala walakkaa gosa Minaasee irraa magaalaawwan kudhanitu ixaadhaan kennameef.
english: To the rest of the sons of Kohath were given by lot, out of the family of the tribe, out of the half-tribe, the half of Manasseh, ten cities.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Geershoomiitiif immoo qooda Yisaakor irraa, qooda Aasheer irraa, qooda Niftaalemiitii fi qooda Minaasee kan Baashaanitti argamu irraa magaalaawwan kudha sadii akkuma gosa gosa isaaniitti kennaman.
english: To the sons of Gershom, according to their families, out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Meraariitiif qooda gosa Ruubeen irraa, qooda gosa Gaadiitii fi qooda gosa Zebuuloon irraa magaalaawwan kudha lama akkuma balbala balbala isaaniitti ni kennaman.
english: To the sons of Merari were given by lot, according to their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.

kikuyu: Akkasiin Israaʼeloonni magaalaawwan kanneen lafa dheeda isaanii wajjin Lewwotaaf ni kennan.
english: The children of Israel gave to the Levites the cities with their pasture lands.

kikuyu: Gosa Yihuudaa irraa, gosa Simiʼooniitii fi gosa Beniyaam irraa magaalaawwan maqaan isaanii armaan olitti dhaʼame sana ixaadhaan ni kennaniif.
english: They gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities which are mentioned by name.

kikuyu: Maatiiwwan Qohaati tokko tokkos qooda gosa Efreem keessaa magaalaawwan jireenyaa argatanii turan.
english: Some of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their borders out of the tribe of Ephraim.

kikuyu: Biyya gaaraa Efreem keessatti magaalaawwan itti baqatan Sheekem, Geezir,
english: They gave to them the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its pasture lands and Gezer with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Yoqemiʼaam, Beet Horoon,
english: Jokmeam with its pasture lands, Beth Horon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Ayaaloonii fi Gat Rimoon lafa dheeda isaanii wajjin kennaniif.
english: Aijalon with its pasture lands, Gath Rimmon with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Akkasumas Israaʼeloonni walakkaa qooda gosa Minaasee irraa Aanerii fi Bileʼaam lafa dheeda isaanii wajjin balbalawwan Qohaati kanneen hafaniif ni kennan.
english: and out of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Aner with its pasture lands, and Bileam with its pasture lands, for the rest of the family of the sons of Kohath.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Geershoom immoo: Balbala walakkaa gosa Minaasee irraa Goolaan ishee Baashaan keessaa sanaa fi Ashtaaroti lafa dheeda isaanii wajjin ni argatan;
english: To the sons of Gershom were given, out of the family of the half-tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its pasture lands, and Ashtaroth with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: gosa Yisaakor irraa Qaadesh, Daaberaati,
english: and out of the tribe of Issachar, Kedesh with its pasture lands, Daberath with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Raamootii fi Aanem lafa dheeda isaanii wajjin ni argatan;
english: Ramoth with its pasture lands, and Anem with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: gosa Aasheer irraa Maashaal, Abdoon,
english: and out of the tribe of Asher, Mashal with its pasture lands, Abdon with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Huuqooqii fi Rehoob lafa dheeda isaanii wajjin ni argatan;
english: Hukok with its pasture lands, and Rehob with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: gosa Niftaalem irraa immoo Qaadesh ishee Galiilaatti argamtu, Hamoonii fi Kiriyaataayimin lafa dheeda isaanii wajjin ni argatan.
english: and out of the tribe of Naphtali, Kedesh in Galilee with its pasture lands, Hammon with its pasture lands, and Kiriathaim with its pasture lands.

kikuyu: Namoonni gosa Meraarii jechuunis warri Lewwotaa kanneen hafan qooda kanaa gadii argatan: Gosa Zebuuloon irraa Yooqniʼaam, Qartaa, Rimoonii fi Taaboorin lafa dheeda isaanii wajjin argatan;
english: To the rest of the Levites, the sons of Merari, were given, out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmono with its pasture lands, and Tabor with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: gosa Ruubeen kan baʼa Yerikootti Yordaanosiin gama jiru irraa Bezer ishee gammoojjii keessatti argamtu, Yaahizaa,
english: and beyond the Jordan at Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its pasture lands, Jahzah with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Qidemootii fi Meefiʼaati lafa dheeda isaanii wajjin ni argatan.
