english: Kedemoth with its pasture lands, and Mephaath with its pasture lands;

kikuyu: Gosa Gaad irraa Raamooti ishee Giliʼaad keessaa, Mahanayiim,
english: and out of the tribe of Gad, Ramoth in Gilead with its pasture lands, Mahanaim with its pasture lands,

kikuyu: Heshboonii fi Yaʼizeer lafa dheeda isaanii wajjin ni argatan.
english: Heshbon with its pasture lands, and Jazer with its pasture lands.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yisaakor: Toolaa, Phuwaa, Yaashuubii fi Shimroon; walumatti nama afur turan.
english: Of the sons of Issachar: Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Toolaa: Uzii, Refaayaa, Yiriiʼeel, Yaahimaayi, Yibsaamii fi Shemuuʼeel; isaan kunneen hangafoota maatii isaanii ti. Bara mootummaa Daawit keessa ilmaan Toolaa warri hidda dhaloota isaaniitiin akka loltoota jajjabootti galmeeffaman nama 22,600 turan.
english: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers’ houses, of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations. Their number in the days of David was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Ilma Uzii: Yizrahiyaa. Ilmaan Yizrahiyaa: Miikaaʼel, Obaadiyaa, Yooʼeelii fi Yishiyaa. Shanan isaanii iyyuu hangafoota turan.
english: The son of Uzzi: Izrahiah. The sons of Izrahiah: Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Isshiah, five; all of them chief men.

kikuyu: Isaanis waan niitotaa fi ijoollee hedduu qabaataniif akka hidda dhaloota maatii isaaniitti namoota lolaaf qophaaʼan 36,000 qabu ture.
english: With them, by their generations, after their fathers’ houses, were bands of the army for war, thirty-six thousand; for they had many wives and sons.

kikuyu: Firoonni loltoota jajjaboo turan kanneen balbalawwan Yisaakorii keessaa dhalatan warri akkuma hidda dhaloota isaaniitti galmeeffaman walumatti nama 87,000:
english: Their brothers among all the families of Issachar, mighty men of valor, listed in all by genealogy, were eighty-seven thousand.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Beniyaam sadan: Belaa, Bekerii fi Yediiʼeel.
english: The sons of Benjamin: Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Belaa: Esboon, Uzii, Uziiʼeel, Yeriimootii fi Iirii walumatti shan turan; hangafoonni mana abbootii isaaniis gootota jajjaboo turan; galmeen hidda dhaloota isaanii namoota 22,034 argisiisa.
english: The sons of Bela: Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor; and they were listed by genealogy twenty-two thousand thirty-four.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Beker: Zemiiraa, Yooʼaash, Eliiʼezer, Eliiyooʼeenayi, Omrii, Yereemooti, Abiyaa, Anaatootii fi Alaameti. Isaan kunneen hundi ilmaan Beker turan.
english: The sons of Becher: Zemirah, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jeremoth, Abijah, Anathoth, and Alemeth. All these were the sons of Becher.

kikuyu: Hangafoota mana abbootii isaanii kanneen akka dhaloota isaaniitti hidda dhaloota isaaniitiin lakkaaʼaman gootota jajjaboo 20,200 turan.
english: They were listed by genealogy, after their generations, heads of their fathers’ houses, mighty men of valor, twenty thousand two hundred.

kikuyu: Ilmi Yediiʼeel: Bilihaan. Ilmaan Bilhaanii: Yeʼuushi, Beniyaam, Eehuud, Keniʼaanaa, Zeetaan, Tarshiishii fi Ahiishahar.
english: The son of Jediael: Bilhan. The sons of Bilhan: Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tarshish, and Ahishahar.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yediiʼeel kunneen hundi hangafoota maatiiwwanii turan. Isaanis namoota waraana dhaquuf qophaaʼan 17,200 qaban ture.
english: All these were sons of Jediael, according to the heads of their fathers’ households, mighty men of valor, seventeen thousand two hundred, who were able to go out in the army for war.

kikuyu: Gosti Shufiimiitii fi Hufiim ilmaan Iiri turan; Hushiim immoo ilma Aheerii ti.
english: So were Shuppim, Huppim, the sons of Ir, Hushim, and the sons of Aher.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Niftaalemii: Yahiziiʼeel, Guunii, Yeexerii fi Shaluum; isaan kunneen sanyii Bilihaa ti.
english: The sons of Naphtali: Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, Shallum, and the sons of Bilhah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Minaasee: Asriiʼeel kan saajjatoon isaa isheen Arraamii dhufte sun deesseef. Isheenis Maakiir abbaa Giliʼaad deesse.
english: The sons of Manasseh: Asriel, whom his concubine the Aramitess bore. She bore Machir the father of Gilead.

kikuyu: Maakiir immoo gosoota Hufiimiitii fi Shufiim keessaa niitii fuudhe. Maqaan obboleettii isaas Maʼakaa ture. Sanyiin isaa kan biraa immoo Salphaʼaad jedhama; Zelofehaad intallan qofa qaba ture.
english: Machir took a wife of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maacah. The name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.

kikuyu: Maʼakaan niitiin Maakiirii ilma deessee maqaa isaa Phereesh jettee moggaafte. Obboleessi isaa Sheresh jedhama; ilmaan isaa immoo Uulaamii fi Reqem jedhaman.
english: Maacah the wife of Machir bore a son, and she named him Peresh. The name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.

kikuyu: Ilmi Uulaam: Bedaan. Isaan kunneen ilmaan Giliʼaadii ilma Maakiirii, ilma Minaasee sanaa ti.
english: The sons of Ulam: Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Hamolekeeti obboleettiin isaa Iisihood, Abiiʼezerii fi Mahilaa deesse.
english: His sister Hammolecheth bore Ishhod, Abiezer, and Mahlah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Shemiidaa immoo: Ahiiyaan, Sheekem, Likihii fi Aniyaam turan.
english: The sons of Shemida were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Efreem: Shuutelaa, ilma isaa Bereed, ilma isaa Tahaat, ilma isaa Eleʼaadaa, ilma isaa Tahaat,
english: The sons of Ephraim: Shuthelah, Bered his son, Tahath his son, Eleadah his son, Tahath his son,

kikuyu: ilma isaa Zaabaadii, ilma isaa Shuutelaa. Eezerii fi Eliʼaad yeroo loon warra Gaati kanneen achi jiraatan sanaa boojiʼuuf gad buʼanitti harka jaraatiin ni ajjeefaman.
english: Zabad his son, Shuthelah his son, Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in the land killed, because they came down to take away their livestock.

kikuyu: Efreem abbaan isaanii guyyaa hedduu booʼeef; firoonni isaas isa jajjabeessuu dhufan.
english: Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

kikuyu: Sana booddees dhaqee niitii isaa wajjin ciise; isheenis ulfooftee ilma deesse. Innis sababii maatii isaa keessa rakkinni tureef Beriiyaa jedhee maqaa baaseef.
english: He went in to his wife, and she conceived and bore a son, and he named him Beriah, because there was trouble with his house.

kikuyu: Intalli isaa immoo Sheeraa jedhamti; namni magaalaawwan Beet Horoonii kan gad aanuu fi kan ol aanu, akkasumas magaalaa Uzeen Sheeraa hundeesse ishee dha.
english: His daughter was Sheerah, who built Beth Horon the lower and the upper, and Uzzen Sheerah.

kikuyu: Refaa ilma isaa, Resheef ilma isaa, Teelaa ilma isaa, Taahan ilma isaa,
english: Rephah was his son, Resheph his son, Telah his son, Tahan his son,

kikuyu: Laʼadaan ilma isaa, Amiihuud ilma isaa, Eliishaamaa ilma isaa,
english: Ladan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,

kikuyu: Nuuni ilma isaatii fi Iyyaasuu ilma isaa.
english: Nun his son, and Joshua his son.

kikuyu: Biyyoonnii fi ardaan qubata isaaniis Beetʼeelii fi gandoota naannoo ishee, karaa baʼa biiftuutiin Naʼaraan, karaa lixa biiftuutiin immoo Geezirii fi gandoota ishee akkasumas Sheekemii fi gandoota ishee kanneen hamma Ayyaa fi gandoota isheetti jiran qabata ture.
english: Their possessions and settlements were Bethel and its towns, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer with its towns; Shechem also and its towns, to Azzah and its towns;

kikuyu: Daariiwwan Minaasee irra Beet Sheʼaan, Taʼanaak, Megidoo fi Dooritu gandoota isaanii wajjin ture. Sanyiiwwan Yoosef ilma Israaʼel sanaas magaalaawwan kanneen keessa jiraatan.
english: and by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth Shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, and Dor and its towns. The children of Joseph the son of Israel lived in these.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Aasheer: Yimnaa, Yishwaa, Yishwii fi Beriiyaa. Obboleettiin isaanii immoo Seraa jedhamti.
english: The sons of Asher: Imnah, Ishvah, Ishvi, and Beriah. Serah was their sister.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Beriiyaa: Hebeerii fi Malkiiʼeel abbaa Birzaawitii.
english: The sons of Beriah: Heber and Malchiel, who was the father of Birzaith.

kikuyu: Hebeer immoo abbaa Yaafleexii, Shomeerii, Hootaamiitii fi obboleettii isaanii Shuuʼaa ti.
english: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and Shua their sister.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yaafleex: Phaasaak, Biimihaalii fi Ashwaati.
english: The sons of Japhlet: Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Shemeer: Ahii, Rohigaa, Yehubaa fi Arraam.
english: The sons of Shemer: Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

kikuyu: Ilmaan obboleessa isaa Heelem: Zoofaa, Yimnaa, Sheleeshii fi Aamaal.
english: The sons of Helem his brother: Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Zoofaa: Suuwaa, Harnefer, Shuuʼaali, Beerii, Yimraa,
english: The sons of Zophah: Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, Imrah,

kikuyu: Bezer, Hoodi, Shamaa, Shilshaa, Yitraanii fi Biʼeeraa.
english: Bezer, Hod, Shamma, Shilshah, Ithran, and Beera.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yeteer: Yefunee, Fiisiphaa fi Eraa.
english: The sons of Jether: Jephunneh, Pispa, and Ara.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Ulaa: Aaraa, Haniiʼeelii fi Riiziyaa.
english: The sons of Ulla: Arah, Hanniel, and Rizia.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen hundi gosoota Aasheerii turan; isaanis hangafoota maatiiwwanii, namoota filatamoo, loltoota jajjaboo fi bulchitoota bebbeekamoo turan. Akka galmee hidda dhaloota isaanii keessatti galmeeffametti namoonni isaanii kanneen dandeettii waraanaa qaban 26,000 turan.
english: All these were the children of Asher, heads of the fathers’ houses, choice and mighty men of valor, chief of the princes. The number of them listed by genealogy for service in war was twenty-six thousand men.

kikuyu: Beniyaam ilma isaa hangafa Belaa, ilma isaa lammaffaa Ashbeel, ilma isaa sadaffaa Aharaa,
english: Benjamin became the father of Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, Aharah the third,

kikuyu: ilma isaa afuraffaa Nohaa fi ilma isaa shanaffaa Raafaa dhalche.
english: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Belaa: Adaar, Geeraa, Abiihuud,
english: Bela had sons: Addar, Gera, Abihud,

kikuyu: Abiishuuwaa, Naʼamaan, Ahooʼaa,
english: Abishua, Naaman, Ahoah,

kikuyu: Geeraa, Shefuufaanii fi Huuraam.
english: Gera, Shephuphan, and Huram.

kikuyu: Isaan kun ilmaan Eehuudii kanneen hangafoota maatiiwwan warra Gebaa keessa jiraatanii boojuudhaan Maanahatitti geeffamaniiti:
english: These are the sons of Ehud. These are the heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Geba, who were carried captive to Manahath:

kikuyu: Naʼamaan, Ahiiyaa fi Geeraa; Geeraan kun abbaa Uzaa fi Ahiihudii ti; namni boojuudhaan fuudhee isaan geesses isa ture.
english: Naaman, Ahijah, and Gera, who carried them captive; and he became the father of Uzza and Ahihud.

kikuyu: Shaharaayim erga niitota isaa Hushiimii fi Baʼaraa of jalaa ariʼee booddee Moʼaab keessatti ilmaan dhalche.
english: Shaharaim became the father of children in the field of Moab, after he had sent them away. Hushim and Baara were his wives.

kikuyu: Niitii isaa Hoodesh irraa Yoobaab, Zibiyaa, Meeshaa, Maalkaam,
english: By Hodesh his wife, he became the father of Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, Malcam,

kikuyu: Yeʼuuxi, Saakiyaa fi Miirmaa dhalche; isaan kunneen ilmaan isaa warra hangafoota maatii turanii dha.
english: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirmah. These were his sons, heads of fathers’ households.

kikuyu: Niitii isaa Hushiim irraa immoo Abiituubii fi Elphaʼal dhalche.
english: By Hushim, he became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Elphaʼalii: Eeber, Mishaam, shemedi isa magaalaawwan Oonooniitii fi Lood gandoota naannoo ishee jiran wajjin ijaare;
english: The sons of Elpaal: Eber, Misham, and Shemed, who built Ono and Lod, with its towns;

kikuyu: Beriiyaa fi Shemaa kanneen hangafoota maatiiwwan warra Ayaaloon keessa jiraatan sanaa taʼanii jiraattota Gaatii ariʼanii biyyaa baasanii dha.
english: and Beriah and Shema, who were heads of fathers’ households of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who put to flight the inhabitants of Gath;

kikuyu: Ahiiyoon, Shaashaaq, Yereemooti,
english: and Ahio, Shashak, Jeremoth,

kikuyu: Zebaadiyaan, Aaraad, Ederi,
english: Zebadiah, Arad, Eder,

kikuyu: Miikaaʼel, Yishiphaa fi Yoohaan ilmaan Beriiyaa turan.
english: Michael, Ishpah, Joha, the sons of Beriah,

kikuyu: Zebaadiyaan, Meshulaam, Hizqii, Hebeer,
english: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hizki, Heber,

kikuyu: Yishimraay, Yizliyaa fi Yoobaab ilmaan Elphaʼalii turan.
english: Ishmerai, Izliah, Jobab, the sons of Elpaal,

kikuyu: Yaaqiim, Zikriin, Zabdiin,
english: Jakim, Zichri, Zabdi,

kikuyu: Eliiʼeenaayi, Ziletaayi, Eliiʼeel,
english: Elienai, Zillethai, Eliel,

kikuyu: Adaayaa, Beraayaa fi Shiimraat ilmaan Shimeʼii turan.
english: Adaiah, Beraiah, Shimrath, the sons of Shimei,

kikuyu: Yishiphaan, Eeber, Eliiʼeel,
english: Ishpan, Eber, Eliel,

kikuyu: Abdoon, Zikriin Haanaan,
english: Abdon, Zichri, Hanan,

kikuyu: Hanaaniyaa, Eelaam, Antootiiyaa,
english: Hananiah, Elam, Anthothijah,

kikuyu: Yifdeyaa fi Phenuuʼeel ilmaan Shaashaaq turan.
english: Iphdeiah, Penuel, the sons of Shashak,

kikuyu: Shamisheraayi, Shehaariyaa, Ataaliyaa,
english: Shamsherai, Shehariah, Athaliah,

kikuyu: Yaʼireshiyaa, Eeliyaasii fi Zikriin ilmaan Yiroohamii turan.
english: Jaareshiah, Elijah, Zichri, and the sons of Jeroham.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen hundi akkuma hidda dhaloota isaanii keessatti galmeeffametti abbootii maatiitii fi hangafoota turan; isaanis Yerusaalem keessa jiraatu ture.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households throughout their generations, chief men. These lived in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yeʼiiʼeel abbaan Gibeʼoonis Gibeʼoon keessa jiraata ture; maqaan niitii isaa Maʼakaa dha.
english: The father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon

kikuyu: Ilmi isaa hangafni Abdoon jedhama; kanneen isa booddee dhalatan immoo Zuuri, Qiish, Baʼaal, Neer, Naadaab,
english: with his firstborn son Abdon, Zur, Kish, Baal, Nadab,

kikuyu: Gedoor, Ahiiyoo, Zekeerii fi
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zecher,

kikuyu: Miiqlooti abbaa Shimeʼaa turan; isaanis firoota isaanii wajjin Yerusaalem keessa jiraatan.
english: and Mikloth, who became the father of Shimeah. They also lived with their families in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

kikuyu: Neer abbaa Qiishii ti; Qiish abbaa Saaʼolii ti; Saaʼol immoo abbaa Yoonaataan, Malkii-Shuwaa, Abiinaadaabiitii fi Eshbaʼalii ti.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

kikuyu: Ilmi Yoonaataan: Meriibaʼaal abbaa Miikaa ti.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Miikaa: Phiitoon, Meleek, Taareʼaa fi Aahaaz.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

kikuyu: Aahaaz abbaa Yihoʼaadaa ti; Yihooʼadaan abbaa Aalemeti, Azmaawetiitii fi Zimrii ti; Zimriin immoo abbaa Moozaa ti.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jehoaddah. Jehoaddah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

kikuyu: Moozaan abbaa Biineʼaa ti; Raafaan ilma isaa ti; Eleʼaasaan ilma isaa ti; Aazeelis ilma isaa ti.
english: Moza became the father of Binea. Raphah was his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

kikuyu: Aazeel ilmaan jaʼa qaba ture; maqaan isaaniis: Azriiqaam, Bookeruu, Ishmaaʼeel, Sheʼariyaa, Obaadiyaa fi Haanaan. Isaan kunneen hundi ilmaan Aazeelii ti.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are these: Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.

kikuyu: Ilmaan obboleessa isaa Eseeqii: Ilmi isaa hangafni Uulaam, ilmi isaa lammaffaan Yeʼuushi, ilmi isaa sadaffaan Eliiphelexi.
english: The sons of Eshek his brother: Ulam his firstborn, Jeush the second, and Eliphelet the third.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Uulaam loltoota jajjaboo xiyyaan loluu dandaʼan turan. Isaanis ilmaanii fi ilmaan ilmaanii hedduu walumatti nama 150 qabu turan. Isaan kunneen hundi ilmaan Beniyaam turan.
english: The sons of Ulam were mighty men of valor, archers, and had many sons, and grandsons, one hundred fifty. All these were of the sons of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni hundinuu akkuma hidda dhaloota isaaniitti kitaaba mootota Israaʼel keessatti galmeeffaman. Sabni Yihuudaa sababii cubbuu isaatiif boojiʼamee Baabilonitti geeffame.
english: So all Israel were listed by genealogies; and behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel. Judah was carried away captive to Babylon for their disobedience.

kikuyu: Warri jalqabatti deebiʼanii lafaa fi magaalaawwan ofii isaanii keessa qubatan Israaʼeloota tokko tokko, luboota, Lewwotaa fi tajaajiltoota mana qulqullummaa ti.
english: Now the first inhabitants who lived in their possessions in their cities were Israel, the priests, the Levites, and the temple servants.

kikuyu: Saboonni Yihuudaa, kan Beniyaamii, kan Efreemii fi kan Minaasee warri Yerusaalem keessa jiraachaa turan:
english: In Jerusalem, there lived of the children of Judah, of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim and Manasseh:

kikuyu: Uutaayi ilma Amiihuud, ilma Omrii, ilma Imrii, ilma Baanii ilmaan Faares ilma Yihuudaa.
english: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Perez the son of Judah.

kikuyu: Shelaanota keessaa: Asaayaa ilma isaa hangaftichaa fi ilmaan isaa.
english: Of the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn and his sons.

kikuyu: Zaaraahota keessaa: Yeʼuuʼeel.
english: Of the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred ninety.

kikuyu: Beniyaamota keessaa: Saʼaaluu ilma Meshulaam, ilma Hoodayiwaa, ilma Hasenuuʼaa;
english: Of the sons of Benjamin: Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hassenuah;

kikuyu: Bineeyaa ilma Yirooham; Eelaa ilma Uzii, ilma Mikrii; Meshulaam ilma Shefaaxiyaa, ilmaa Reʼuuʼeel, ilma Yibniyaa.
english: and Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri; and Meshullam the son of Shephatiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;

kikuyu: Sabni Beniyaam akka galmee hidda dhaloota isaanii irratti galmeeffametti nama 956 ture. Namoonni kunneen hundi hangafoota maatii isaanii turan.
english: and their brothers, according to their generations, nine hundred fifty-six. All these men were heads of fathers’ households by their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Luboota keessaa: Yedaaʼiyaa; Yehooyaariib; Yaakiin;
english: Of the priests: Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, Jachin,

kikuyu: Azaariyaa ilma Hilqiyaa, ilma Meshulaam, ilma Zaadoq, ilma Meraayoot, ilma Ahiixuub qondaalticha itti gaafatamaa mana Waaqaa taʼe sanaa.
english: and Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of God’s house;

kikuyu: Adaayaa ilma Yerooham, ilma Phaashihuur, ilma Malkiyaa; Maʼasaayi ilma Aadiiʼeel, ilma Yahizeeraa, ilma Meshulaam, ilma Meshileemiit, ilma Imeer.
english: and Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashhur, the son of Malchijah; and Maasai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;

kikuyu: Baayʼinni luboota abbootii maatii turaniis 1,760 ture. Isaan kunneen namoota dandeettii qaban kanneen tajaajila mana Waaqaa keessatti itti gaafatamtoota taʼanii dha.
english: and their brothers, heads of their fathers’ houses, one thousand seven hundred sixty; they were very able men for the work of the service of God’s house.

kikuyu: Lewwota keessaa: Shemaaʼiyaa ilma Hashuubii, ilma Azriiqaamii, ilma Hashabiyaa namicha gosa Meraarii sanaa;
english: Of the Levites: Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;

kikuyu: Baqbaqar, Hereesh, Gaalaalii fi Mataaniyaa ilma Miikaa, ilma Zikrii, ilma Asaafi;
english: and Bakbakkar, Heresh, Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Mica, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph,

kikuyu: Obaadiyaa ilma Shemaaʼiyaa, ilma Gaalaal, ilma Yeduutuun; Berekiyaa ilma Aasaa, ilma Elqaanaa kan gandoota Netoofotaa keessa jiraachaa ture sana.
english: and Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun; and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, who lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

kikuyu: Eegdota balbalaa: Shaluum, Aquub, Talmoon, Ahiimanii fi obboloota isaanii; Shaluum hangafa gosa isaanii ture;
english: The gatekeepers: Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their brothers (Shallum was the chief),

kikuyu: innis hamma ammaatti Karra Mootii kan gama baʼaa biiftuutti ramadameera. Isaan kunneen eegdota balbala qubata Lewwotaa turan.
english: who previously served in the king’s gate eastward. They were the gatekeepers for the camp of the children of Levi.

kikuyu: Shaluum ilmi Qooraahi ilma Ebiyaasaaf, ilma Qoraahiitii fi maatiin isaa jechuunis gosti Qoraahii kanneen isa wajjin karra eegan sun akkuma abbootiin isaanii dur itti gaafatamtoota balbala mana bultii Waaqayyoo turan sana isaanis itti gaafatamtoota balbala dunkaanaa taʼan.
english: Shallum was the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over the LORD’s camp, keepers of the entry.

kikuyu: Bara durii keessa Fiinehaas ilmi Eleʼaazaar sun dura buʼaa eegdota balbalaa ture; Waaqayyos isa wajjin ture.
english: Phinehas the son of Eleazar was ruler over them in time past, and the LORD was with him.

kikuyu: Zakkaariyaas ilmi Mesheleemiyaa immoo eegduu balbala dunkaana wal gaʼii ture.
english: Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was gatekeeper of the door of the Tent of Meeting.

kikuyu: Namoonni akka balbala eeganiif filataman walumatti 212 turan. Isaanis akkuma hidda dhaloota isaaniitti gandoota isaanii keessatti galmeeffaman. Eegdota balbalaa kanneenis Daawitii fi Saamuʼeel raajichatu hojii isaaniitti isaan ramade.
english: All these who were chosen to be gatekeepers in the thresholds were two hundred twelve. These were listed by genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer ordained in their office of trust.

kikuyu: Isaanii fi sanyiiwwan isaanii itti gaafatamtoota eegumsa karra mana Waaqayyoo jechuunis manicha Dunkaana jedhamu sanaa turan.
english: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the LORD’s house, even the house of the tent, as guards.

kikuyu: Eegdonni balbalaa kunneen qixa afraniin jechuunis karaa baʼa biiftuu, karaa lixa biiftuu, karaa kaabaatii fi kibbaatiin turan.
english: On the four sides were the gatekeepers, toward the east, west, north, and south.

kikuyu: Obboloonni isaaniis yeroo yerootti gandoota isaanii keessaa dhufanii bultii torba torba hojii isaan gargaaraa turan.
english: Their brothers, in their villages, were to come in every seven days from time to time to be with them,

kikuyu: Dura buutota eegdota balbalaa kanneen Lewwota turan afran garuu itti gaafatamummaa kutaalee fi qabeenya mana Waaqaa keessaatu itti kenname.
english: for the four chief gatekeepers, who were Levites, were in an office of trust, and were over the rooms and over the treasuries in God’s house.

kikuyu: Isaanis sababii manicha eeguu qabaniif halkan halkan naannoo mana Waaqaa dhaabatanii bulu turan; ganama ganamas manicha banuuf itti gaafatamummaa qabu turan.
english: They stayed around God’s house, because that was their duty; and it was their duty to open it morning by morning.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa namoonni tokko tokko toʼattoota miʼa mana qulqullummaa keessatti fayyaduu turan; isaanis miʼa kana yeroo inni gad baafamuu fi yeroo inni ol galfamu ni lakkaaʼu ture.
english: Certain of them were in charge of the vessels of service, for these were brought in by count, and these were taken out by count.

kikuyu: Warri kaan immoo akka miʼoota mana qulqullummaa, daakuu isaa, daadhii wayinii isaa, zayitii isaa, ixaana isaatii fi urgooftuuwwan eeganiif ramadaman.
english: Some of them also were appointed over the furniture, and over all the vessels of the sanctuary, over the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

kikuyu: Luboota keessaa tokko tokko immoo urgooftuuwwan walitti makanii qopheessu ture.
english: Some of the sons of the priests prepared the mixing of the spices.

kikuyu: Lewwicha Matiitiyaa jedhamu, ilma Shaluum namicha gosa Qooraahi hangaftichatti immoo itti gaafatamummaa buddeena aarsaa tolchuutu kenname.
english: Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the office of trust over the things that were baked in pans.

kikuyu: Obboloota isaanii Qohaatota tokko tokkotti immoo itti gaafatamummaa buddeena guyyaa Sanbataa hunda minjaala irra kaaʼamu qopheessuutu kenname.
english: Some of their brothers, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the show bread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

kikuyu: Faarfattoonni abbootii maatiiwwani Lewwotaa turan immoo waan halkanii fi guyyaa itti gaafatamummaa hojii qabaniif kutaa mana qulqullummaa keessaa hin baʼan; hojii biraattis hin waamaman ture.
english: These are the singers, heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, who lived in the rooms and were free from other service, for they were employed in their work day and night.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen hundinuu abbootii maatiiwwan Lewwotaa hangafoota gosaa kanneen akkuma hidda dhaloota isaaniitti galmeeffamanii dha; isaanis Yerusaalem keessa jiraatan.
english: These were heads of fathers’ households of the Levites, throughout their generations, chief men. They lived at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yeʼiiʼeel abbaan Gibeʼoonis Gibeʼoon keessa jiraata ture. Maqaan niitii isaa Maʼakaa dha;
english: Jeiel the father of Gibeon, whose wife’s name was Maacah, lived in Gibeon.

kikuyu: ilmi isaa hangafni Abdoon jedhama; kanneen isa booddee dhalatan immoo Zuuri, Qiish, Baʼaal, Neer, Naadaab,
english: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, Nadab,

kikuyu: Gedoor, Ahiiyoo, Zakkaariyaas fi Miiqlooti.
english: Gedor, Ahio, Zechariah, and Mikloth.

kikuyu: Miiqlooti abbaa Shimeʼaam. Isaanis firoota isaanii wajjin Yerusaalem keessa jiraatan.
english: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, near their relatives.

kikuyu: Neer abbaa Qiishii ti; Qiish abbaa Saaʼolii ti; Saaʼol immoo abbaa Yoonaataan, Malkii-Shuwaa, Abiinaadaabiitii fi Eshbaʼalii ti.
english: Ner became the father of Kish. Kish became the father of Saul. Saul became the father of Jonathan, Malchishua, Abinadab, and Eshbaal.

kikuyu: Ilmi Yoonaataan: Meriibaʼaal abbaa Miikaa ti.
english: The son of Jonathan was Merib-baal. Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Miikaa: Phiitoon, Meleek, Tahireeʼaa fi Aahaaz.
english: The sons of Micah: Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

kikuyu: Aahaaz abbaa Yaʼiraa ti; Yaʼiraan immoo abbaa Aalemeti, Azmaawetiitii fi Zimrii ti; Zimriin immoo abbaa Moozaa ti.
english: Ahaz became the father of Jarah. Jarah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri. Zimri became the father of Moza.

kikuyu: Moozaan abbaa Biineʼaa ti; Refaayaan ilma isaa ti; Eleʼaasaan ilma isaa ti; Aazeelis ilma isaa ti.
english: Moza became the father of Binea, Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, and Azel his son.

kikuyu: Aazeel ilmaan jaʼa qaba ture; maqaan isaaniis: Azriiqaam, Bookeruu, Ishmaaʼeel, Sheʼariyaa, Obaadiyaa fi Haanaan. Isaan kunneen ilmaan Aazeelii ti.
english: Azel had six sons, whose names are Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. These were the sons of Azel.

kikuyu: Filisxeemonni yeroo kanatti Israaʼelitti waraana kaasan; Israaʼeloonnis isaan duraa baqatan; hedduun isaaniis Tulluu Gilboʼaa irratti dhuman.
english: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.

kikuyu: Filisxeemonni ittuma jabeessanii Saaʼolii fi ilmaan isaa ariʼan; isaanis ilmaan isaa jechuunis Yoonaataan, Abiinaadaabii fi Malkii-Shuwaa ajjeesan.
english: The Philistines followed hard after Saul and after his sons; and the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Saul.

kikuyu: Lollis naannoo Saaʼolitti baayʼee cime; warri xiyyaan lolanis isa qaqqabanii isa madeessan.
english: The battle went hard against Saul, and the archers overtook him; and he was distressed by reason of the archers.

kikuyu: Saaʼolis namicha miʼa lolaa isaa baatuun, “Goraadee kee luqqifadhuutii na waraani; yoo kanaa achii namoonni dhagna hin qabamin kunneen dhufanii natti taphatuu” jedhe. Namichi miʼa lolaa baatuuf sun garuu waan akka malee sodaateef isa hin waraanne; kanaafuu Saaʼol goraadee ofii isaa luqqifatee irratti kufe.
english: Then Saul said to his armor bearer, “Draw your sword, and thrust me through with it, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me.” But his armor bearer would not, for he was terrified. Therefore Saul took his sword and fell on it.

kikuyu: Namichi miʼa lolaa baatu sun yommuu akka Saaʼol duʼe argetti innis goraadee ofii isaa irratti kufee duʼe.
english: When his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword and died.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Saaʼolii fi ilmaan isaa sadan ni duʼan; warri mana isaa hundinuus walumaan dhuman.
english: So Saul died with his three sons; and all his house died together.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni sulula keessa turan hundi yommuu akka loltoonni baqatan, akka Saaʼolii fi ilmaan isaas dhuman arganitti magaalaawwan isaanii dhiisanii baqatan. Filisxeemonni immoo dhufanii keessa qubatan.
english: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.

kikuyu: Filisxeemonnis guyyaa itti aanutti yommuu warra dhuman irraa hidhannaa hiikkachuu dhufanitti akka Saaʼolii fi ilmaan isaa Tulluu Gilboʼaa irratti kukkufanii jiran argan.
english: On the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, they found Saul and his sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.

kikuyu: Isaanis erga hidhata Saaʼolii hiikkatanii mataa isaan irraa kutanii booddee akka isaan waaqota tolfamoo fi namoota isaaniitti oduu gaarii labsaniif guutummaa Filisxeemiitti ergamoota ni ergan.
english: They stripped him and took his head and his armor, then sent into the land of the Philistines all around to carry the news to their idols and to the people.

kikuyu: Ergasii immoo miʼa lolaa isaa mana waaqota tolfamoo isaanii keessa, mataa isaa immoo mana Daagon waaqicha tolfamaa sanaa keessatti ni fannisan.
english: They put his armor in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the house of Dagon.

kikuyu: Jiraattonni Yaabeesh Giliʼaad hundi yommuu waan Filisxeemonni Saaʼolin godhan dhagaʼanitti,
english: When all Jabesh Gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,

kikuyu: namoonni jajjaboon isaanii hundi dhaqanii reeffa Saaʼolii fi reeffa ilmaan isaa guuranii gara Yaabeeshitti ni fidan. Ergasii immoo reeffa isaanii muka guddaa Yaabeesh keessaa tokko jalatti awwaalan; guyyaa torbas ni sooman.
english: all the valiant men arose and took away the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.

kikuyu: Saaʼol sababii Waaqayyoof amanamaa hin taʼiniif duʼe; inni dubbii Waaqayyootiif hin ajajamne; qooda kanaa ilaaltuu gorsa gaafate;
english: So Saul died for his trespass which he committed against the LORD, because of the LORD’s word, which he didn’t keep, and also because he asked counsel of one who had a familiar spirit, to inquire,

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon gorsa hin gaafanne. Kanaaf Waaqayyo isa ajjeese; mootummaa isaas dabarsee Daawit ilma Isseeyiitiif kenne.
english: and didn’t inquire of the LORD. Therefore he killed him, and turned the kingdom over to David the son of Jesse.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni hundinuu Kebroonitti Daawit biratti walitti dhufanii akkana jedhan; “Nu foonii fi dhiiga kee ti.
english: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David to Hebron, saying, “Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.

kikuyu: Duraan, yeroo Saaʼol mootii turetti iyyuu namni duula loltoota Israaʼel hoogganu siʼi ture. Waaqayyoo Waaqni kees, ‘Situ saba koo Israaʼelin tiksa; bulchaa isaaniis ni taata’ siin jedhee ture.”
english: In times past, even when Saul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel. The LORD your God said to you, ‘You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.’”

kikuyu: Yommuu maanguddoonni Israaʼel hundi Kebroonitti Daawit Mooticha bira dhufanitti, inni Kebroonitti fuula Waaqayyoo duratti isaan wajjin kakuu gale. Isaanis akkuma Waaqayyo karaa Saamuʼeeliin abdachiise sanatti dibanii Israaʼel irratti mootii isa godhan.
english: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the LORD. They anointed David king over Israel, according to the LORD’s word by Samuel.

kikuyu: Daawitii fi Israaʼeloonni hundinuu gara Yerusaalemitti jechuunis Yebuusiitti ni qajeelan. Yebuusonni achi jiraatan garuu
english: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem (also called Jebus); and the Jebusites, the inhabitants of the land, were there.

kikuyu: Daawitiin, “Ati as hin seentu” jedhan. Taʼus Daawit daʼannoo Xiyoon jechuunis Magaalaa Daawit ni qabate.
english: The inhabitants of Jebus said to David, “You will not come in here!” Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. The same is David’s city.

kikuyu: Daawitis, “Namni duraan dursee dhaqee Yebuusota lolu ajajaa loltootaa taʼa” jedhee ture. Yooʼaab ilmi Zeruuyaa jalqabatti baʼe; kanaafuu inni ajajaa waraanaa taʼe.
english: David had said, “Whoever strikes the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain.” Joab the son of Zeruiah went up first, and was made chief.

kikuyu: Daawitis iddoo jireenya isaa daʼannoo sana keessa godhate; kanaafuu daʼannoon sun Magaalaa Daawit jedhamee waamame.
english: David lived in the stronghold; therefore they called it David’s city.

kikuyu: Innis Miiloodhaa jalqabee naannoo isheetti dallaa dhagaa ni ijaare; Yooʼaab immoo kutaa Magaalaa sanaa kan hafe deebisee ijaare.
english: He built the city all around, from Millo even around; and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

kikuyu: Daawitis sababii Waaqayyoon Waan Hunda Dandaʼu isa wajjin tureef yeruma yeroon jabaachaa dhufe.
english: David grew greater and greater, for the LORD of Armies was with him.

kikuyu: Namoota Daawit warra jajjaboo keessaa hangafoonni kanneenii dha; isaanis akkuma Waaqayyo waaʼee Israaʼel dubbate sanatti mootii isa gochuuf jedhanii saba Israaʼel hunda wajjin mootummaa isaa keessatti gargaarsa guddaa godhaniif.
english: Now these are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who showed themselves strong with him in his kingdom, together with all Israel, to make him king, according to the LORD’s word concerning Israel.

kikuyu: Maqaan namoota Daawit warra jajjaboo kanaa dha: Yaashobiʼaam namichi gosa Hakmooni hangafa ajajjoota sanaa ture; innis lola tokko irratti eeboo mirmirsee namoota dhibba sadii fixe.
english: This is the number of the mighty men whom David had: Jashobeam, the son of a Hachmonite, the chief of the thirty; he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them at one time.

kikuyu: Kan isatti aanu immoo Eleʼaazaar namicha gosa Ahooʼaa, ilma Doodoo ture; innis namoota jajjaboo sadan sana keessaa tokko ture.
english: After him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighty men.

kikuyu: Eleʼaazaar yeroo Filisxeemonni waraanaaf walitti qabamanii turanitti Daawit wajjin Phaas Damiim ture. Loltoonnis lafa qotiisaa kan garbuudhaan guutame tokko biratti Filisxeemota duraa baqatan.
english: He was with David at Pasdammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where there was a plot of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.

kikuyu: Innii fi Daawit garuu lafa qotiisaa walakkaatti iddoo qabatan. Isaanis irraa ittisuudhaan Filisxeemota fixan; Waaqayyos moʼannaa guddaa isaaniif kenne.
english: They stood in the middle of the plot, defended it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them by a great victory.

kikuyu: Utuma gareen Filisxeemotaa Sulula Refaayim keessa qubatee jiruu hangafoota soddomman sana keessaa namoonni sadii gara kattaa holqa Adulaamitti gara Daawit gad buʼan.
english: Three of the thirty chief men went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines were encamped in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: Yeroo sanatti Daawit daʼannoo cimaa keessa ture; loltoonni Filisxeem immoo Beetlihem turan.
english: David was then in the stronghold, and the garrison of the Philistines was in Bethlehem at that time.

kikuyu: Daawitis dheebotee, “Utuu namni tokko boolla bishaanii kan karra Beetlihem bira jiru keessaa bishaan dhugaatii naa fidee hoo!” jedhe.
english: David longed, and said, “Oh, that someone would give me water to drink from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the gate!”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namoonni Sadan sun qubata Filisxeemotaa keessaan darbanii boolla bishaanii kan karra Beetlihem bira jiru keessaa bishaan waraabanii Daawitiif fidan. Inni garuu dhuguu ni dide; qooda kanaa bishaan sana fuula Waaqayyoo duratti dhangalaase.
english: The three broke through the army of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Bethlehem that was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink any of it, but poured it out to the LORD,

kikuyu: Innis, “Akka ani waan kana hin goone Waaqni narraa haa fageessu! Ani dhiiga namoota lubbuu ofii isaaniitti muranii dhaqan kanaa nan dhugaa?” jedhe. Sababii isaan lubbuu ofii isaaniitti muranii dhaqanii fidaniif Daawit bishaan sana hin dhugne. Egaa wanni namoonni jajjaboon sadan sun hojjetan kana ture.
english: and said, “My God forbid me, that I should do this! Shall I drink the blood of these men who have put their lives in jeopardy?” For they risked their lives to bring it. Therefore he would not drink it. The three mighty men did these things.

kikuyu: Abiishaayi obboleessi Yooʼaab hoogganaa Sadan isaanii ture. Innis namoota dhibba sadiitti eeboo isaa ol kaafatee isaan fixe; akkasiin innis akkuma namoota Sadan sanaa beekamaa taʼe.
english: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was chief of the three; for he lifted up his spear against three hundred and killed them, and had a name among the three.

kikuyu: Inni yoo isaan keessaa tokko taʼuu baate iyyuu warra Sadan caalaa ulfina argatee ajajaa isaanii taʼe.
english: Of the three, he was more honorable than the two, and was made their captain; however he wasn’t included in the three.

kikuyu: Benaayaa ilmi Yehooyaadaa loltuun cimaan biyya Qabziʼeel sunis loltuu moʼannaa gurguddaa argamsiise ture. Innis loltoota Moʼaab kanneen akka malee jajjaboo taʼan lama ajjeese. Gaafa cabbiin roobe tokkos boolla keessa seenee leenca ajjeese.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit on a snowy day.

kikuyu: Namicha biyya Gibxi kan dhundhuma shan dheeratu tokko illee ni ajjeese. Namichi Gibxi sun eeboo akka danqaraa wayya dhooftuu harkaa qabaatu iyyuu Benaayaa bokkuudhaan isatti baʼe. Innis harka namicha Gibxi sanaatii eeboo butatee eeboodhuma isaatiin isa ajjeese.
english: He killed an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high. In the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

kikuyu: Hojiiwwan gootummaa kanneen Benaayaa ilmi Yehooyaadaa hojjete kana faʼi; innis akkuma namoota jajjaboo sadan sanaa nama beekamaa ture.
english: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada did these things and had a name among the three mighty men.

kikuyu: Inni namoota Soddomman sana keessaa nama kam iyyuu caalaa ulfina guddaa argate; garuu namoota Sadan sanatti hin dabalamne. Daawitis ajajaa eegdota ofii isaa isa godhate.
english: Behold, he was more honorable than the thirty, but he didn’t attain to the three; and David set him over his guard.

kikuyu: Namoonni jajjaboon sunis kanneenii dha: Asaaheel obboleessa Yooʼaab, Elhaanaan namicha Beetlihem ilma Doodoo,
english: The mighty men of the armies also include Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Bethlehem,

kikuyu: Shamoot namicha gosa Haroor, Heleez namicha gosa Pheloonaa,
english: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,

kikuyu: Iiraa ilma Iqeesh nama Teqooʼaa, Abiiʼezer nama Anaatoot,
english: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abiezer the Anathothite,

kikuyu: Siibekaay nama biyya Hushaa, Iilaayi nama Ahooʼaa,
english: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,

kikuyu: Maharaayi nama Netoofaa, Heeled ilma Baʼanaa nama Netoofaa,
english: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,

kikuyu: gosa Beniyaam keessaa Iitaayi ilma Riibaay, namicha Gibeʼaa, Benaayaa nama Phiraatoon,
english: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah of the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,

kikuyu: Huuraayi namicha sululoota Gaʼaash, Abiiʼeel namicha biyya Arbaa,
english: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,

kikuyu: Azmaawet namicha Baharuum, Eliiyaabaa namicha Shaʼalboon,
english: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,

kikuyu: ilmaan Haasheem namicha Gizoon, Yoonaataan ilma Shaagee namicha Haraaraa,
english: the sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shagee the Hararite,

kikuyu: Ahiiʼaam ilma Saakaar namicha Haraaraa, Eliifaal ilma Uuri,
english: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,

kikuyu: Heefer namicha Mekeeraataa, Ahiiyaa namicha Pheloonaa,
english: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,

kikuyu: Hezroo nama Qarmeloos, Naʼaraayi ilma Ezbayi,
english: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,

kikuyu: Yooʼeel obboleessa Naataanii, Mibehaar ilma Hagrii,
english: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Hagri,

kikuyu: Zeleq namicha gosa Amoon, Nahaaraay namicha Biʼeeroot kan Yooʼaab ilma Zeruuyaatiif miʼa lolaa baatu sana,
english: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite (the armor bearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah),

kikuyu: Iiraas namicha gosa Yitraa, Gaareeb namicha gosa Yitraa,
english: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,

kikuyu: Uuriyaa namicha Heet, Zaabaad ilma Ahilayi,
english: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

kikuyu: Aadiinaa ilma Shiizaa namicha gosa Ruubeen, inni hoogganaa Ruubeenotaatii fi kan namoota Soddomman isa wajjin turanii ti;
english: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite (a chief of the Reubenites), and thirty with him,

kikuyu: Haanaan ilma Maʼakaa, Yooshaafaaxi namicha Miitinaa,
english: Hanan the son of Maacah, Joshaphat the Mithnite,

kikuyu: Uziyaa namicha Ashteraati, Shaamaaʼii fi Yeʼiiʼeel ilmaan Hootaam namicha Aroʼeer,
english: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jeiel the sons of Hotham the Aroerite,

kikuyu: Yediʼyaaʼeel ilma Shimrii, obboleessa isaa Yoohaa namicha Tiizii,
english: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,

kikuyu: Eliiʼeel namicha Mahawaa, Yeriibaayii fi Yooshabiyaa ilmaan Elnaʼam, Yitmaa namicha Moʼaab,
english: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,

kikuyu: Eliiʼeel, Oobeedii fi Yaʼisiiʼel namicha Mezoobaa.
english: Eliel, Obed, and Jaasiel the Mezobaite.

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen warra yeroo inni sababii Saaʼol ilma Qiish sanaatiif asii fi achi sochoʼuu dadhabetti Siiqlaagitti gara Daawit dhufanii dha. Isaanis loltoota jajjaboo kanneen lola irratti isa gargaaran keessaa tokkoo dha;
english: Now these are those who came to David to Ziklag while he was a fugitive from Saul the son of Kish. They were among the mighty men, his helpers in war.

kikuyu: isaan warra iddaa qabatanii harka mirgaatiin yookaan harka bitaatiin xiyya darbachuu yookaan dhagaa furrisuu dandaʼanii dha; isaanis gosa Beniyaam keessaa warra Saaʼoliif firootaa dhiigaa taʼanii dha.
english: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in slinging stones and in shooting arrows from the bow. They were of Saul’s relatives of the tribe of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Ahiiʼezer hangafa isaanii ture; sana booddee immoo Yooʼaashitu ture; lamaan isaanii iyyuu ilmaan Shemaaʼaa namicha Gibeʼaa sanaa turan. Ilmaan Azmaawet Yiziiʼeelii fi Phelet, Beraakiyaa, Yehuu namicha Anaatoot,
english: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; Beracah; Jehu the Anathothite;

kikuyu: Yishmaʼiyaa namichi Gibeʼoonii sun jara Soddomman keessaa nama jabaa fi hoogganaa Soddomman isaanii ture; Ermiyaas, Yahiziiʼeel, Yoohaanaan, Yoozaabaad namicha Gedeeraa,
english: Ishmaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty and a leader of the thirty; Jeremiah; Jahaziel; Johanan; Jozabad the Gederathite;

kikuyu: Elʼuuzay, Yeriimooti, Beʼaaliyaa, Shemaariyaa, Shefaaxiyaa namicha Haruufaa,
english: Eluzai; Jerimoth; Bealiah; Shemariah; Shephatiah the Haruphite;

kikuyu: Elqaanaa, Yishiyaa, Azariʼeel, Yoozerii fi Yaashobiʼaam jarreen gosa Qooraahi,
english: Elkanah, Isshiah, Azarel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korahites;

kikuyu: Yooʼelaa fi Zebaadiyaa ilmaan Yeroohaam namicha Gedoor.
english: and Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.

kikuyu: Yeroo Daawit gammoojjiitti daʼoo keessa turetti namoonni gosa Gaad tokko tokko dhufanii isaatti ni dabalaman. Isaanis loltoota ciccimoo gaachanaa fi eeboo qabachuu dandaʼan kanneen waraanaaf qophaaʼan turan. Fuulli isaanii fuula leencaa fakkaata ture; isaan akkuma kuruphee tulluu gubbaa saffistoota turan.
english: Some Gadites joined David in the stronghold in the wilderness, mighty men of valor, men trained for war, who could handle shield and spear; whose faces were like the faces of lions, and they were as swift as the gazelles on the mountains:

kikuyu: Eezer hoogganaa isaanii ture; Obaadiyaan lamaffaa, Eliiyaab sadaffaa,
english: Ezer the chief, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,

kikuyu: Mishmanaan afuraffaa, Ermiyaas shanaffaa,
english: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,

kikuyu: Ataayi jaʼaffaa, Eliiʼeel torbaffaa,
english: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,

kikuyu: Yoohaanaan saddeettaffaa, Elzaabaad saglaffaa,
english: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,

kikuyu: Ermiyaas kurnaffaa, Makibanaayi kudha tokkoffaa ture.
english: Jeremiah the tenth, and Machbannai the eleventh.

kikuyu: Jarreen gosa Gaad kunneen ajajjoota loltootaa turan; isaan keessaa inni xinnaan akka ajajaa nama dhibbaatti, inni guddaan immoo akka ajajaa nama kumaatti hedama ture.
english: These of the sons of Gad were captains of the army. He who was least was equal to one hundred, and the greatest to one thousand.

kikuyu: Warri jiʼa jalqabaatti yeroo lagni Yordaanos guutee ededa isaa hunda irra dhangalaʼutti ceʼanii akka namoonni sululicha keessa jiraachaa turan gara baʼa biiftuutii fi gara lixa biiftuutti baqatan godhan namootuma kanneen turan.
english: These are those who went over the Jordan in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they put to flight all who lived in the valleys, both toward the east and toward the west.

kikuyu: Namoonni Beniyaamiitii fi Yihuudaa tokko tokkos Daawit bira gara daʼannoo isaa ni dhufan.
english: Some of the children of Benjamin and Judah came to the stronghold to David.

kikuyu: Daawitis isaan simachuudhaaf gad baʼee akkana jedheen; “Isin yoo na gargaaruudhaaf jettanii nagaadhaan dhuftanii jiraattan, ani ofitti isin dabalachuudhaaf qophaaʼaa dha. Garuu yoo isin utuu harki koo yakka hin hojjetin diinota kootti dabarsitanii na kennuudhaaf dhuftanii jiraattan, Waaqni abbootii keenyaa ilaalee murtii haa kennu.”
english: David went out to meet them, and answered them, “If you have come peaceably to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my adversaries, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our fathers see this and rebuke it.”

kikuyu: Ergasiis Hafuurri Qulqulluun Amaasaayi hoogganaa namoota Soddomman sanaa irra buʼe; innis akkana jedhe: “Yaa Daawit, nu kan kee ti! Yaa ilma Isseey, nu suma wajjin jirra! Milkaaʼi, milkaaʼi; warri si gargaaranis haa milkaaʼan; Waaqni kee si gargaaraatii.” Kanaafuu Daawit isaan simatee dura deemtota loltoota isaa isaan godhate.
english: Then the Spirit came on Amasai, who was chief of the thirty, and he said, “We are yours, David, and on your side, you son of Jesse. Peace, peace be to you, and peace be to your helpers; for your God helps you.” Then David received them and made them captains of the band.

kikuyu: Yeroo Daawit Saaʼolin loluuf jedhee Filisxeemota wajjin duuletti namoonni Minaasee tokko tokko fottoqanii gara Daawititti ni goran. Inni garuu sababii bulchitoonni Filisxeem mariʼatanii of irraa isa ariʼaniif innii fi namoonni isaa Filisxeemota hin gargaarre. Isaanis, “Yoo inni nu dhiisee gara gooftaa isaa gara Saaʼol deebiʼe wanni kun nu ficcisiisa” jedhanii turaniitii.
english: Some of Manasseh also joined David when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle, but they didn’t help them, for the lords of the Philistines sent him away after consultation, saying, “He will desert to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.”

kikuyu: Yeroo Daawit gara Siiqlaag deemetti namoonni Minaasee warri fottoqanii gara isaa goran kanneenii dha: Adinaahi, Yoozaabaad, Yediiʼeel, Miikaaʼel, Yoozaabaad, Eliihuu fi Ziletaayi; isaan kunneen gosa Minaasee keessatti ajajjuuwwan kumaa turan.
english: As he went to Ziklag, some from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zillethai, captains of thousands who were of Manasseh.

kikuyu: Isaanis balaa buuftota dhaʼuu irratti Daawitin ni gargaaran; hundi isaanii loltoota jajjaboo fi ajajjoota loltoota isaa turaniitii.
english: They helped David against the band of raiders, for they were all mighty men of valor and were captains in the army.

kikuyu: Hamma inni loltoota guddaa akka loltoota Waaqaa qabaatutti, namoonni Daawitin gargaaruudhaaf guyyaa guyyaadhaan gara isaa dhufaa ture.
english: For from day to day men came to David to help him, until there was a great army, like God’s army.

kikuyu: Baayʼinni namoota lolaaf hidhatanii akkuma Waaqayyo dubbatee turetti mootummaa Saaʼol gara Daawitiitti dabarsuudhaaf jedhanii Daawit bira gara Kebroonii dhufanii kanneenii dha:
english: These are the numbers of the heads of those who were armed for war, who came to David to Hebron to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Namoonni Yihuudaa kanneen gaachanaa fi eeboo qabatanii lolaaf qophaaʼan 6,800;
english: The children of Judah who bore shield and spear were six thousand eight hundred, armed for war.

kikuyu: namoonni Simiʼoonii loltoonni waraanaaf qophaaʼan 7,100;
english: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valor for the war: seven thousand one hundred.

kikuyu: namoonni Lewwii 4,600;
english: Of the children of Levi: four thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: Yehooyaadaan hoogganaa maatii Aroon ture; namoonni 3,700 isa wajjin turan;
english: Jehoiada was the leader of the household of Aaron; and with him were three thousand seven hundred,

kikuyu: Zaadoq dargaggeessa loltuu jagnaa sanaa fi maatii isaa keessaa ajajjoota waraanaa 22;
english: and Zadok, a young man mighty of valor, and of his father’s house twenty-two captains.

kikuyu: namoonni Beniyaam kanneen firoota Saaʼolii taʼan 3,000; isaan keessaas hedduun isaanii hamma yeroo sanaatti mana Saaʼoliitiif amanamoo turan;
english: Of the children of Benjamin, Saul’s relatives: three thousand, for until then, the greatest part of them had kept their allegiance to Saul’s house.

kikuyu: namoonni Efreem warri lolatti ciccimoo fi balbala isaanii keessatti bebeekamoo taʼan 20,800;
english: Of the children of Ephraim: twenty thousand eight hundred, mighty men of valor, famous men in their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: walakkaa gosa Minaasee keessaa namoonni Daawitin mootii gochuudhaaf maqaan isaanii galmaaʼee dhufan 18,000;
english: Of the half-tribe of Manasseh: eighteen thousand, who were mentioned by name, to come and make David king.

kikuyu: namoota Yisaakor keessaa warra haala yeroo hubatanii waan Israaʼeloonni gochuu qaban beekan hangafoota 200, firoota isaanii kanneen isaan jalatti bulan hunda wajjin;
english: Of the children of Issachar, men who had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do, their heads were two hundred; and all their brothers were at their command.

kikuyu: namoota Zebuuloon keessaa loltoonni muuxannoo qaban warri meeshaa lolaa kamiin iyyuu loluuf qophaaʼan kanneen Daawitin gargaaruuf garaan isaanii tokko taʼe 50,000;
english: Of Zebulun, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array with all kinds of instruments of war: fifty thousand who could command and were not of double heart.

kikuyu: namoota Niftaalem keessaa ajajjoota 1,000; namoota gaachanaa fi eeboo qabatan 37,000 wajjin;
english: Of Naphtali: one thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty-seven thousand.

kikuyu: namoota Daan kanneen lolaaf qophaaʼan 28,600;
english: Of the Danites who could set the battle in array: twenty-eight thousand six hundred.

kikuyu: namoota Aasheer keessaa loltoonni muuxannoo qaban kanneen lolaaf qophaaʼan 40,000;
english: Of Asher, such as were able to go out in the army, who could set the battle in array: forty thousand.

kikuyu: gama baʼa Yordaanosiitii namoota Ruubeen, namoota Gaadiitii fi walakkaa gosa Minaasee keessaa namoota miʼa lolaa kan gosa hundaa hidhatan 120,000.
english: On the other side of the Jordan, of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and of the half-tribe of Manasseh, with all kinds of instruments of war for the battle: one hundred twenty thousand.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen hundinuu loltoota waraana keessa tajaajiluudhaaf of kennanii dha. Isaanis Israaʼel hunda irratti Daawitin mootii gochuuf kutatanii gara Kebroon ni dhufan. Israaʼeloonni hafan hundinuus Daawitin mootii gochuuf yaaduma tokko qabu turan.
english: All these were men of war who could order the battle array, and came with a perfect heart to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.

kikuyu: Namoonnis sababii maatiin isaanii waan hunda isaaniif qopheessaniif nyaachaa dhugaa guyyaa sadii Daawit wajjin achi turan.
english: They were there with David three days, eating and drinking; for their brothers had supplied provisions for them.

kikuyu: Akkasumas olloonni isaanii kanneen hamma Yisaakoriitti, Zebuuloonittii fi Niftaalemiitti jiran harrootatti, gaalawwanitti, gaangolii fi sangootatti nyaata feʼanii fidanii ni dhufan. Sababii Israaʼel keessa gammachuun guddaan tureefis daakuun, bixxilleen ija harbuutii fi bixxilleen ija wayinii, daadhiin wayinii, zayitiin, loonii fi hoolonni akka malee baayʼeen dhiʼeeffamanii turan.
english: Moreover those who were near to them, as far as Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, on camels, on mules, and on oxen: supplies of flour, cakes of figs, clusters of raisins, wine, oil, cattle, and sheep in abundance; for there was joy in Israel.

kikuyu: Daawit ajajjoota isaa hunda ajajjoota kumaatii fi ajajjoota dhibbaa wajjin ni mariʼate.
english: David consulted with the captains of thousands and of hundreds, even with every leader.

kikuyu: Ergasii inni yaaʼii Israaʼel guutuudhaan akkana jedhe; “Yoo wanni kun waan gaarii isinitti fakkaatee fi yoo fedhii Waaqayyo Waaqa keenyaa taʼe, kottaa mee akka isaan dhufanii nutti dabalamaniif obboloota keenya kanneen guutummaa biyya Israaʼel keessatti hafanitti akkasumas lubootaa fi Lewwota isaan wajjin magaalaawwanii fi lafa dheeda isaanii keessa jiraatanitti ergaa haa erginu.
english: David said to all the assembly of Israel, “If it seems good to you, and if it is of the LORD our God, let’s send word everywhere to our brothers who are left in all the land of Israel, with whom the priests and Levites are in their cities that have pasture lands, that they may gather themselves to us.

kikuyu: Taabota Waaqa keenyaa deebifnee haa fidannu; nu bara mootummaa Saaʼol keessa isa hin barbaaneetii.”
english: Also, let’s bring the ark of our God back to us again, for we didn’t seek it in the days of Saul.”

kikuyu: Sababii wanni kun saba hundatti waan qajeelaa fakkaateef guutummaan yaaʼii sanaa waan kana gochuudhaaf walii gale.
english: All the assembly said that they would do so, for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Daawit taabota Waaqaa Kiriyaati Yeʼaariimii fiduudhaaf Israaʼeloota Laga Shihoorii kan biyya Gibxiitti argamuu jalqabee hamma karra Hamaatiitti jiran hunda walitti qabe.
english: So David assembled all Israel together, from the Shihor River of Egypt even to the entrance of Hamath, to bring God’s ark from Kiriath Jearim.

kikuyu: Daawitii fi Israaʼeloonni isa wajjin turan hundi taabota Waaqa kiirubeelii gidduu teessoo irra jiru sanaa jechuunis taabota Maqaa Waaqayyootiin waamamu sana achii fiduuf jedhanii gara Baʼaalaa jechuunis gara Kiriyaati Yeʼaariim ishee Yihuudaa keessaa sanaa ni dhaqan.
english: David went up with all Israel to Baalah, that is, to Kiriath Jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up from there God the LORD’s ark that sits above the cherubim, that is called by the Name.

kikuyu: Isaanis taabota Waaqaa sana gaarii haaraatti feʼanii mana Abiinaadaabiitii ni baasan; Uzaa fi Ahiiyoon gaarii sana oofaa turan.
english: They carried God’s ark on a new cart, and brought it out of Abinadab’s house; and Uzza and Ahio drove the cart.

kikuyu: Daawitii fi Israaʼeloonni hundinuu humna isaanii guutuudhaan faarfannaa fi baganaadhaan, kiraaraa fi dibbeedhaan, kilillee fi malakataan fuula Waaqaa duratti gammadanii shuubbisaa.
english: David and all Israel played before God with all their might, even with songs, with harps, with stringed instruments, with tambourines, with cymbals, and with trumpets.

kikuyu: Yommuu isaan oobdii Kiidoon bira gaʼanitti waan sangoonni gufataniif Uzaan taabota sana qabuuf harka isaa hiixate.
english: When they came to Chidon’s threshing floor, Uzza put out his hand to hold the ark, for the oxen stumbled.

kikuyu: Sababii Uzaan taabota irra harka isaa kaaʼeef dheekkamsi Waaqayyoo Uzaatti bobaʼe; innis isa rukute; kanaafuu inni achumatti fuula Waaqaa duratti ni duʼe.
english: The LORD’s anger burned against Uzza, and he struck him because he put his hand on the ark; and he died there before God.

kikuyu: Daawitis sababii Waaqayyo akka malee Uzaatti dheekkameef ni aare; iddoon sun hamma harʼaatti Phereez Uzaa jedhamee waamama.
english: David was displeased, because the LORD had broken out against Uzza. He called that place Perez Uzza, to this day.

kikuyu: Daawitis gaafa sana Waaqa sodaatee, “Ani akkamittan taabota Waaqaa gara mana kootti fiduu dandaʼa?” jedhee gaafate.
english: David was afraid of God that day, saying, “How can I bring God’s ark home to me?”

kikuyu: Innis akka taabonni isa wajjin Magaalaa Daawit keessa jiraatuuf ofitti hin fudhanne. Qooda kanaa gara mana Oobeed Edoom namicha Gitii sanaatti geesse.
english: So David didn’t move the ark with him into David’s city, but carried it aside into Obed-Edom the Gittite’s house.

kikuyu: Taabonni Waaqaas jiʼa sadii maatii Oobeed Edoom wajjin mana isaa keessa ture; Waaqayyos warra mana isaa jiraatanii fi waan inni qabu hunda ni eebbise.
english: God’s ark remained with the family of Obed-Edom in his house three months; and the LORD blessed Obed-Edom’s house and all that he had.

kikuyu: Yeroo kanatti Huuraam mootiin Xiiroos akka isaan Daawitiif masaraa mootummaa ijaaraniif ergamoota wajjin muka birbirsaa, warra dhagaa soofanii fi warra ogummaa hojii mukaa qaban gara Daawititti erge.
english: Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David with cedar trees, masons, and carpenters, to build him a house.

kikuyu: Daawitis akka Waaqayyo saba Israaʼel irratti mootii godhee jabeessee isa dhaabee fi akka mootummaan isaas sababii saba Israaʼeliif akka malee guddate ni beeke.
english: David perceived that the LORD had established him king over Israel, for his kingdom was highly exalted, for his people Israel’s sake.

kikuyu: Daawitis Yerusaalem keessatti niitota dabalee fuudhee ilmaanii fi intallan dabalataa dhalche.
english: David took more wives in Jerusalem, and David became the father of more sons and daughters.

kikuyu: Maqaan ijoollee isaa kanneen achitti isaaf dhalataniis: Shamuuʼaa, Shobaab, Naataan, Solomoon,
english: These are the names of the children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, Solomon,

kikuyu: Yibehaar, Eliishuuwaa, Eliiphelexi,
english: Ibhar, Elishua, Elpelet,

kikuyu: Noogaa, Nefeg, Yaafiiyaa,
english: Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia,

kikuyu: Eliishaamaa, Beeliyaadaa fi Eliiphelexi jedhamu.
english: Elishama, Beeliada, and Eliphelet.

kikuyu: Filisxeemonni yommuu akka Daawit dibamee guutummaa Israaʼel irratti mootii taʼe dhagaʼanitti humna guutuudhaan isa barbaacha ol baʼan; Daawit garuu waan kana dhagaʼee isaanitti baʼe.
english: When the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David; and David heard of it, and went out against them.

kikuyu: Yeroo kanatti Filisxeemonni dhufanii Sulula Refaayim weeraran;
english: Now the Philistines had come and made a raid in the valley of Rephaim.

kikuyu: kanaafuu Daawit, “Ani baʼee Filisxeemota dhaʼuu? Ati dabarsitee harka kootti isaan kennitaa?” jedhee Waaqa ni gaafate. Waaqayyos, “Baʼi; ani dhugumaan Filisxeemota dabarsee harka keetti nan kennaatii” jedhee deebiseef.
english: David inquired of God, saying, “Shall I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand?” The LORD said to him, “Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Daawitii fi namoonni isaa gara Baʼaal Pheraaziim ol baʼan; achittis isaan moʼate. Innis, “Akkuma bishaan mana isaa cabsee yaaʼu sana Waaqni harka kootiin diinota koo cabsee baʼeera” jedhe. Kanaafuu iddoon sun Baʼaal Pheraaziim jedhamee waamame.
english: So they came up to Baal Perazim, and David defeated them there. David said, God has broken my enemies by my hand, like waters breaking out. Therefore they called the name of that place Baal Perazim.

kikuyu: Filisxeemonni waaqota isaanii tolfamoo achitti ni dhiisan; Daawit immoo akka waaqonni sun ibiddaan gubaman ni ajaje.
english: They left their gods there; and David gave a command, and they were burned with fire.

kikuyu: Filisxeemonni amma illee deebiʼanii sulula sana weeraran;
english: The Philistines made another raid in the valley.

kikuyu: kanaafuu Daawit ammas Waaqa gaafate; Waaqnis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Qajeelumatti itti ol hin baʼin; garuu isaan marsiitii muka qilxuu duratti isaan waraani.
english: David inquired again of God; and God said to him, “You shall not go up after them. Turn away from them, and come on them opposite the mulberry trees.

kikuyu: Akkuma fiixee muka qilxuu irraan sagalee duulaa dhageesseen loluuf baʼi; Waaqni loltoota Filisxeem dhaʼuudhaaf si dura baʼeera jechuudhaatii.”
english: When you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, then go out to battle; for God has gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Daawit akkuma Waaqni isa ajaje sana ni godhe; isaanis Gibeʼoonii jalqabanii hamma Geeziritti loltoota Filisxeem ni dhaʼan.
english: David did as God commanded him; and they attacked the army of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gezer.

kikuyu: Akkasiin maqaan Daawit biyya hunda keessatti beekame; Waaqayyos akka saboonni hundinuu isa sodaatan godhe.
english: The fame of David went out into all lands; and the LORD brought the fear of him on all nations.

kikuyu: Daawit erga ofii isaatiif Magaalaa Daawit keessatti mana ijaarratee booddee taabota Waaqaatiif lafa qopheessee dunkaana dhaabe.
english: David made himself houses in David’s city; and he prepared a place for God’s ark, and pitched a tent for it.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Daawit, “Waan Waaqayyo akka isaan taabota Waaqaa baatanii bara baraan fuula isaa dura tajaajilaniif isaan filateef, Lewwota malee namni biraa taabota Waaqayyoo hin baatin” jedhee ajaje.
english: Then David said, “No one ought to carry God’s ark but the Levites. For the LORD has chosen them to carry God’s ark, and to minister to him forever.”

kikuyu: Daawitis taabota Waaqayyoo iddoo qopheesseef sanatti fiduuf Israaʼeloota hunda Yerusaalemitti walitti qabe.
english: David assembled all Israel at Jerusalem, to bring up the LORD’s ark to its place, which he had prepared for it.

kikuyu: Innis sanyiiwwan Aroonii fi Lewwota walitti waame; isaanis:
english: David gathered together the sons of Aaron and the Levites:

kikuyu: Ilmaan Qohaati keessaa, Uuriiʼeel hoogganaa sanaa fi firoota isaa nama 120;
english: of the sons of Kohath, Uriel the chief, and his brothers one hundred twenty;

kikuyu: ilmaan Meraarii keessaa, Asaayaa hoogganaa sanaa fi firoota isaa 220;
english: of the sons of Merari, Asaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred twenty;

kikuyu: ilmaan Geershoom keessaa, Yooʼeel hoogganaa sanaa fi firoota isaa 130;
english: of the sons of Gershom, Joel the chief, and his brothers one hundred thirty;

kikuyu: ilmaan Eliisaafaan keessaa, Shemaaʼiyaa hoogganaa sanaa fi firoota isaa 200;
english: of the sons of Elizaphan, Shemaiah the chief, and his brothers two hundred;

kikuyu: ilmaan Kebroon keessaa, Eliiʼeel hoogganaa sanaa fi firoota isaa 80;
english: of the sons of Hebron, Eliel the chief, and his brothers eighty;

kikuyu: ilmaan Uziiʼeel keessaa, Amiinaadaab hoogganaa sanaa fi firoota isaa nama 112.
english: of the sons of Uzziel, Amminadab the chief, and his brothers one hundred twelve.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Daawit luboota jechuunis Saadoqii fi Abiyaataar akkasumas Lewwota jechuunis Uuriiʼeel, Asaayaa, Yooʼeel, Shemaaʼiyaa, Eliiʼeelii fi Amiinaadaabin ni waame;
english: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites: for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,

kikuyu: akkanas isaaniin jedhe; “Isin hangafoota maatiiwwan Lewwotaa ti; isinii fi Lewwonni akka keessanii of qulqulleessaa; ergasiis taabota Waaqayyo Waaqa Israaʼel gara iddoo ani qopheesseefitti fidaa.
english: and said to them, “You are the heads of the fathers’ households of the Levites. Sanctify yourselves, both you and your brothers, that you may bring the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel, up to the place that I have prepared for it.

kikuyu: Sababii isin Lewwonni yeroo jalqabaatti taabota sana hin fidiniif Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya nutti dheekkame. Nu akka seerri ajajutti isa hin barbaaddanneetii.”
english: For because you didn’t carry it at first, the LORD our God broke out in anger against us, because we didn’t seek him according to the ordinance.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu luboonnii fi Lewwonni taabota Waaqayyo Waaqa Israaʼel sana fiduuf of qulqulleessan.
english: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Lewwonni akkuma kan Museen dubbii Waaqayyootiin ajajetti taabota Waaqaa sana danqaraadhaan gatiittii isaaniitti ni baatan.
english: The children of the Levites bore God’s ark on their shoulders with its poles, as Moses commanded according to the LORD’s word.

kikuyu: Daawitis akka isaan meeshaa muuziiqaatiin jechuunis kiraaraan, baganaa fi kililleedhaan faarfannaa gammachuu faarfataniif akka isaan obboloota isaanii muudaniif Lewwota dura deemtotatti ni hime.
english: David spoke to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brothers as singers with instruments of music, stringed instruments, harps, and cymbals, sounding aloud and lifting up their voices with joy.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Lewwonni Heemaan ilma Yooʼeel muudatan; obboloota isaa keessaa immoo Asaaf ilma Berekiyaa, obboloota isaanii gosa Meraarii keessaa Eetaan ilma Qushaayaa ni muuddatan;
english: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brothers, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brothers, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;

kikuyu: isaan wajjinis obboloota isaanii kanneen isaanitti aannan: Zakkaariyaas, Yaʼaziiʼeel, Shemiiraamoot, Yehiiʼeel, Unnii, Eliiyaab, Benaayaa, Maʼaseyaa, Matiitiyaa, Eliipheleehuu, Miiqneyaa, Oobeed Edoomii fi Yeʼiiʼeel eegdota balbalaa turan.
english: and with them their brothers of the second rank: Zechariah, Ben, Jaaziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Benaiah, Maaseiah, Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, the doorkeepers.

kikuyu: Faarfattoonni Heemaan, Asaafii fi Eetaan jedhaman akka kilillee naasiitiin sagalee isaanii ol fudhatanii faarfannaa dhageessisaniif ni muudaman;
english: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were given cymbals of bronze to sound aloud;

kikuyu: Zakkaariyaas, Aziiʼeel Shemiiraamoot, Yehiiʼeel, Unnii, Eliiyaabi, Maʼaseyaanii fi Benaayaa immoo akka seera alamootiitti kiraaraan faarfatu ture;
english: and Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with stringed instruments set to Alamoth;

kikuyu: akkasumas Matiitiyaan, Eliipheleehuu, Miiqneyaan, Oobeed Edoom, Yeʼiiʼeel, Azaaziyaan akka seera shiimiiniitiitti baganaa taphatu ture.
english: and Mattithiah, Eliphelehu, Mikneiah, Obed-Edom, Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps tuned to the eight-stringed lyre, to lead.

kikuyu: Kenaaniyaan hangaftichi Lewwotaa itti gaafatamaa faarfannaa ture; innis itti gaafatamummaa kana sababii ogummaa isaa qabuuf fudhate.
english: Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was over the singing. He taught the singers, because he was skillful.

kikuyu: Berekiyaa fi Elqaanaan eegdota balbala taabotaa turan.
english: Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.

kikuyu: Luboonni jechuunis, Shebaniyaan, Yooshaafaaxi, Naatnaaʼel, Amaasaayi, Zakkaariyaas, Benaayaanii fi Eliiʼezer fuula taabota Waaqaa duratti malakata afuufu ture. Oobeed Edoomii fi Yehiyaan immoo eegdota balbala taabotaa turan.
english: Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s ark; and Obed-Edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Daawitii fi maanguddoonni Israaʼel akkasumas ajajjuuwwan kumaa gammachuudhaan taabota kakuu Waaqayyoo sana mana Oobeed Edoomiitii fiduu dhaqan.
english: So David, the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands went to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant up out of the house of Obed-Edom with joy.

kikuyu: Isaanis sababii Waaqni Lewwota taabota kakuu Waaqayyoo baatan gargaareef korommii loonii torbaa fi korbeeyyii hoolaa torba aarsaa godhan.
english: When God helped the Levites who bore the ark of the LORD’s covenant, they sacrificed seven bulls and seven rams.

kikuyu: Daawitis wandaboo haphii quncee talbaa irraa hojjetame kan akka uffata Lewwonni taabota sana baatan, kan akka faarfattoonnii fi Kenaaniyaan qajeelchaan faarfannaa faarfattootaa uffatan sanaa uffatee ture. Daawitis dirata quncee talbaa irraa hojjetames uffatee ture.
english: David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, as were all the Levites who bore the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah the choir master with the singers; and David had an ephod of linen on him.

kikuyu: Akkasiinis Israaʼel hundi gaanfa korbeessa hoolaatii fi malakata afuufaa, kilillee dhageessisaa, kiraaraa fi baganaadhaan sirbaa taabota kakuu Waaqayyoo sana ni fidan.
english: Thus all Israel brought the ark of the LORD’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and with cymbals, sounding aloud with stringed instruments and harps.

kikuyu: Yeroo taabonni kakuu Waaqayyoo Magaalaa Daawit seenutti Miikaal intalli Saaʼol foddaa keessaan ilaalaa turte. Isheenis akka Daawit Mootichi shuubbisee gammadu yommuu argitetti garaa ishee keessatti isa tuffatte.
english: As the ark of the LORD’s covenant came to David’s city, Michal the daughter of Saul looked out at the window, and saw king David dancing and playing; and she despised him in her heart.

kikuyu: Isaanis taabota Waaqaa fidanii dunkaana Daawit dhaabeef keessa ni kaaʼan; aarsaa gubamuu fi aarsaa nagaa fuula Waaqaa duratti ni dhiʼeessan.
english: They brought in God’s ark, and set it in the middle of the tent that David had pitched for it; and they offered burnt offerings and peace offerings before God.

kikuyu: Daawitis erga aarsaa gubamuu fi aarsaa nagaa dhiʼeessee booddee maqaa Waaqayyootiin namoota ni eebbise.
english: When David had finished offering the burnt offering and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Ergasiis inni tokkoo tokkoo nama Israaʼeliitiif, dhiiraa fi dubartiif buddeena tokko tokko, gumaa foonii tokko tokkoo fi bixxillee ija wayinii tokko tokko ni kenne.
english: He gave to everyone of Israel, both man and woman, to everyone a loaf of bread, a portion of meat, and a cake of raisins.

kikuyu: Innis akka isaan fuula taabota Waaqayyoo duratti tajaajilaniif, akka isaan Waaqayyo Waaqa Israaʼel waammataniif, akka isa galateeffatanii fi akka isa jajataniif Lewwota tokko tokko ni muuddate;
english: He appointed some of the Levites to minister before the LORD’s ark, and to commemorate, to thank, and to praise the LORD, the God of Israel:

kikuyu: isaanis Asaaf hangafticha, Zakkaariyaas itti aanaa isaa, itti fufees Yeʼiiʼeel, Shemiiraamoot, Yehiiʼeel, Matiitiyaa, Eliiyaab, Benaayaa, Oobeed Edoomii fi Yeʼiiʼeel faʼi turan. Jarri kunneen kiraaraa fi baganaa taphatu ture; Asaaf immoo kilillee dhageessisa ture;
english: Asaph the chief, and second to him Zechariah, then Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, Obed-Edom, and Jeiel, with stringed instruments and with harps; and Asaph with cymbals, sounding aloud;

kikuyu: Benaayaa fi Yahiziiʼeel luboonni yeroo hunda fuula taabota kakuu Waaqaa duratti malakata afuufu turan.
english: with Benaiah and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually, before the ark of the covenant of God.

kikuyu: Daawitis gaafa sana akka Asaafii fi michoota isaa faarfannaa galataa kana Waaqayyoof faarfataniif jalqabatti ajaja kenne:
english: Then on that day David first ordained giving of thanks to the LORD by the hand of Asaph and his brothers.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoof galata galchaa; maqaa isaas waammadhaa; waan inni hojjetes saboota gidduutti beeksisaa.
english: Oh give thanks to the LORD. Call on his name. Make what he has done known among the peoples.

kikuyu: Isaaf faarfadhaa; faarfannaadhaan isa galateeffadhaa; waaʼee hojii isaa isa dinqisiisaa hundaas odeessaa.
english: Sing to him. Sing praises to him. Tell of all his marvelous works.

kikuyu: Maqaa isaa qulqulluu sanaan boonaa; garaan warra Waaqayyoon barbaadanii haa gammadu.
english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoo fi humna isaa barbaaddadhaa; yeroo hunda fuula isaa barbaadaa.
english: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

kikuyu: Dinqii inni hojjete, hojii isaa dinqii sanaa fi murtii inni labse yaadadhaa;
english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

kikuyu: isin tajaajiltoonni isaa, warri sanyii Israaʼel taatan, isin filatamtoonni isaa, ilmaan Yaaqoobis kana yaadadhaa.
english: you offspring of Israel his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

kikuyu: Inni Waaqayyo Waaqa keenya; murtiin isaas lafa hunda irra jira.
english: He is the LORD our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

kikuyu: Inni kakuu isaa bara baraan, waadaa gale sanas dhaloota kumaaf ni yaadata;
english: Remember his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

kikuyu: inni kakuu Abrahaam wajjin gale, kakuu Yisihaaqiif kakates ni yaadata.
english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac.

kikuyu: Kanas Yaaqoobiif seera, Israaʼeliif immoo kakuu bara baraa godhee akkana jedhee mirkaneesseera; innis:
english: He confirmed it to Jacob for a statute, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

kikuyu: “Ani biyya Kanaʼaan qooda ati dhaaltu godhee, siif nan kenna” jedhe.
english: saying, “I will give you the land of Canaan, The lot of your inheritance,”

kikuyu: Isaan yeroo lakkoobsaan xinnoo turanitti, dhugumaanuu xinnoo fi biyyattii keessattis keessummoota turanitti,
english: when you were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

kikuyu: sabaa gara sabaatti, mootummaa tokkoo gara mootummaa biraatti jooran.
english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

kikuyu: Inni akka namni tokko iyyuu isaan cunqursu hin eeyyamne; sababii isaaniitiifis akkana jedhee mootota ifate:
english: He allowed no man to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

kikuyu: “Dibamtoota koo hin tuqinaa; raajota koos hin miidhinaa.”
english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

kikuyu: Lafti hundinuu Waaqayyoon faarfadhaa; fayyisuu isaas guyyuma guyyaan labsaa.
english: Sing to the LORD, all the earth! Display his salvation from day to day.

kikuyu: Ulfina isaa saboota gidduutti, hojii isaa dinqisiisaa sana immoo namoota hunda keessatti labsaa.
english: Declare his glory among the nations, and his marvelous works among all the peoples.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo guddaadhaatii galanni baayʼeen isaaf ni mala; inni waaqota hundaa olittis sodaatamuu qaba.
english: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised. He also is to be feared above all gods.

kikuyu: Waaqonni saboota ormaa hundinuu waaqota tolfamoodhaatii; Waaqayyo garuu samiiwwan uume.
english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

kikuyu: Miidhaginnii fi surraan fuula isaa dura jiru; jabinnii fi gammachuunis iddoo jireenya isaa jiru.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and gladness are in his place.

kikuyu: Yaa maatiiwwan sabootaa, Waaqayyoof kennaa; ulfinaa fi jabina Waaqayyoof kennaa.
english: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of the peoples, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength!

kikuyu: Ulfina maqaa isaatiif malu Waaqayyoof kennaa. Aarsaa fidaatii fuula isaa duratti dhiʼaadhaa. bareedina qulqullummaa isaatiin Waaqayyoon waaqeffadhaa.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come before him. Worship the LORD in holy array.

kikuyu: Isin lafti hundinuu fuula isaa duratti holladhaa! Addunyaan jabaattee dhaabatteerti; sochoofamuus hin dandeessu.
english: Tremble before him, all the earth. The world also is established that it can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Samiiwwan haa ililchan; laftis haa gammaddu; isaan saboota gidduutti, “Waaqayyo moʼeera!” haa jedhan.
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice! Let them say among the nations, “The LORD reigns!”

kikuyu: Galaannii fi wanni isa keessa jiru hundinuu haa huursu; dirreewwanii fi wanni isaan irra jiran hundinuu haa gammadani!
english: Let the sea roar, and its fullness! Let the field exult, and all that is in it!

kikuyu: Mukkeen bosonaa haa faarfatan; isaan gammachuudhaan fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa faarfatan; inni lafatti muruudhaaf ni dhufaatii.
english: Then the trees of the forest will sing for joy before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoof galata galchaa; inni gaariidhaatii; jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Akkana jedhaatii iyyaa; “Yaa Waaqayyo, Fayyisaa keenya, ati nu baasi; akka nu maqaa kee qulqulluu sana galateeffannuuf, akka galata keetiin of jajnuufis, walitti nu qabiitii saboota ormaa jalaa nu oolchi.”
english: Say, “Save us, God of our salvation! Gather us together and deliver us from the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise.”
