kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqa Israaʼeliitiif bara baraa hamma bara baraatti galanni haa gaʼu. Kana irratti namni hundinuu, “Ameen; Waaqayyo haa galatoomu” jedhe.
english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting. All the people said, “Amen,” and praised the LORD.

kikuyu: Daawitis akka isaan fuula taabotaa dura yeroo hunda tajaajilaniif, Asaafii fi obboloota isaa achuma fuula taabota kakuu Waaqayyoo duratti isaan dhiise.
english: So he left Asaph and his brothers there before the ark of the LORD’s covenant, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required;

kikuyu: Akkasumas Oobeed Edoomii fi warra isaan wajjin hojjetan jaatamii saddeettan akka isaan wajjin tajaajilaniif achitti dhiise. Oobeed Edoom ilmi Yeduutuuniitii fi Hoosaan eegdota balbalaa turan.
english: and Obed-Edom with their sixty-eight relatives; Obed-Edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be doorkeepers;

kikuyu: Daawit Zaadoq lubichaa fi luboota isa wajjin hojjetan kaan dunkaana Waaqayyoo qulqulluu kan Gibeʼoon keessatti gaara sagadaa irratti argamu biratti dhiise;
english: and Zadok the priest and his brothers the priests, before the LORD’s tabernacle in the high place that was at Gibeon,

kikuyu: kunis isaan akkuma waan Seera Waaqayyoo kan inni Israaʼeliif kenne hunda keessatti barreeffame sanaatti yeroo hunda galgalaa fi ganama iddoo aarsaa gubamuu irratti aarsaa gubamu Waaqayyoof akka dhiʼeessaniif.
english: to offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually morning and evening, even according to all that is written in the LORD’s law, which he commanded to Israel;

kikuyu: Isaan wajjinis Heemaanii fi Yeduutuun akkasumas warra akka, “Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata” jedhanii Waaqayyoof galata galchaniif filatamanii maqaan isaanii beekame biraatu ture.
english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun and the rest who were chosen, who were mentioned by name, to give thanks to the LORD, because his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Heemaanii fi Yeduutuun sagalee malakataatiif kilillee dhageessisuu fi akkasumas meeshaa muuziiqaa kan Waaqaa irratti itti gaafatamtoota turan. Ilmaan Yeduutuun immoo karra eegan.
english: and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for the songs of God, and the sons of Jeduthun to be at the gate.

kikuyu: Ergasii namoonni hundinuu achii kaʼanii tokkoon tokkoon isaanii gara mana ofii isaatti galan; Daawit immoo maatii ofii eebbisuuf gara manaatti ni deebiʼe.
english: All the people departed, each man to his house; and David returned to bless his house.

kikuyu: Daawit erga masaraa isaa keessa jiraachuu jalqabee booddee Naataan raajichaan, “Ani kunoo mana birbirsaan ijaarame keessan jiraadha; taabonni kakuu Waaqayyoo garuu dunkaana keessa jiraata” jedhe.
english: When David was living in his house, David said to Nathan the prophet, “Behold, I live in a cedar house, but the ark of the LORD’s covenant is in a tent.”

kikuyu: Naataan immoo deebisee Daawitiin, “Waaqni si wajjin jiraatii waan garaa keetti yaadde kam iyyuu godhi” jedhe.
english: Nathan said to David, “Do all that is in your heart; for God is with you.”

kikuyu: Halkan sana garuu dubbiin Waaqayyoo akkana jedhee gara Naataan dhufe:
english: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

kikuyu: “Dhaqiitii akkana jedhii garbicha koo Daawititti himi; ‘Waaqayyo akkana jedha: Kan mana ani keessa jiraadhu naaf ijaaru siʼi miti.
english: “Go and tell David my servant, ‘The LORD says, “You shall not build me a house to dwell in;

kikuyu: Ani gaafan Israaʼelin Gibxii baasee jalqabee hamma harʼaatti mana keessa hin jiraanne. Ani dunkaana tokkoo irraa gara isa kaaniitti, iddoo bultii tokkoo irraa gara iddoo bultii isa kaaniitti darbaan ture.
english: for I have not lived in a house since the day that I brought up Israel to this day, but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tent to another.

kikuyu: Ani iddoon Israaʼeloota hunda wajjin naannaʼaa ture kamitti iyyuu hooggantoota akka isaan saba koo eeganiif ajaje keessaa nama tokkoon iyyuu, “Isin maaliif mana birbirsaa naaf hin ijaarre?” jedhee beekaa?’
english: In all places in which I have walked with all Israel, did I speak a word with any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to be shepherd of my people, saying, ‘Why have you not built me a house of cedar?’”’

kikuyu: “Egaa amma akkana jedhii garbicha koo Daawititti himi; ‘Waaqayyoon Waan Hunda Dandaʼu akkana jedha: Ani akka ati bulchaa saba koo Israaʼel taatuuf, lafa tikaatii fi bushaayee faana deemuu keessaan si fudhadhe.
english: “Now therefore, you shall tell my servant David, ‘The LORD of Armies says, “I took you from the sheep pen, from following the sheep, to be prince over my people Israel.

kikuyu: Ani lafa ati dhaqxe hundatti si wajjinin ture; diinota kee hundas fuula kee duraa balleesseera. Ammas ani maqaa kee akkuma maqaa namoota addunyaa irratti akka malee gurguddaa taʼanii nan godha.
english: I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have cut off all your enemies from before you. I will make you a name like the name of the great ones who are on the earth.

kikuyu: Ani akka isaan mana ofii isaanii qabaatanii fi akka isaan siʼachi hin raafamneef saba koo Israaʼeliif lafa kennee isaan nan dhaaba. Namoonni hamoon akka jalqabatti godhan sana deebiʼanii isaan hin cunqursan;
english: I will appoint a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, that they may dwell in their own place, and be moved no more. The children of wickedness will not waste them any more, as at the first,

kikuyu: akka yeroo ani saba koo Israaʼel irratti abbootii murtii muudee as godhan sana illee hin godhan; ani diinota kee hundas siifin garboomsa. “ ‘Ani akka Waaqayyo mana siif ijaaru sittin hima:
english: and from the day that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. I will subdue all your enemies. Moreover I tell you that the LORD will build you a house.

kikuyu: Yommuu barri jireenya keetii dhumee ati abbootii keetti dabalamuuf dhaqxutti ani akka inni iddoo kee buʼuuf sanyii kee keessaa, ilmaan kee keessaa tokko nan kaasa; mootummaa isaa illee jabeessee nan dhaaba.
english: It will happen, when your days are fulfilled that you must go to be with your fathers, that I will set up your offspring after you, who will be of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

kikuyu: Kan mana naaf ijaaru isa; anis teessoo isaa bara baraan jabeessee nan dhaaba.
english: He will build me a house, and I will establish his throne forever.

kikuyu: Ani isaaf abbaa nan taʼa; innis ilma naa taʼa. Ani akka namicha si dura ture sana irraa fudhadhe, jaalala koo gonkumaa isa irraa hin fudhadhu.
english: I will be his father, and he will be my son. I will not take my loving kindness away from him, as I took it from him who was before you;

kikuyu: Ani mana koo fi mootummaa koo irratti bara baraan isa nan muuda; teessoon isaas bara baraan jabaatee ni dhaabata.’ ”
english: but I will settle him in my house and in my kingdom forever. His throne will be established forever.”’”

kikuyu: Naataanis dubbii mulʼata kanaa hunda Daawititti hime.
english: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so Nathan spoke to David.

kikuyu: Ergasii Daawit mootichi ol seenee fuula Waaqayyoo dura taaʼee akkana jedhe: “Yaa Waaqayyo, yaa Waaqi, kan ati asiin na geesse, ani eenyu? Maatiin koos maali?
english: Then David the king went in and sat before the LORD; and he said, “Who am I, LORD God, and what is my house, that you have brought me this far?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, ati akka waan wanni kun fuula kee duratti quubsaa hin taʼiniitti ilaaltee waaʼee mana garbicha keetii kan fuul duraa illee dubbatte. Yaa Waaqayyo, yaa Waaqi, ati akka waan ani nama hunda caalaa kabajamaa taʼeetti na ilaalte.
english: This was a small thing in your eyes, O God, but you have spoken of your servant’s house for a great while to come, and have respected me according to the standard of a man of high degree, LORD God.

kikuyu: “Waan ati garbicha kee ulfeessiteef Daawit kana caalaa maal jechuu dandaʼa? Ati garbicha kee ni beektaatii.
english: What can David say yet more to you concerning the honor which is done to your servant? For you know your servant.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati sababii garbicha keetiitii fi akkuma fedhii keetiitti waan guddaa kana goote; akka waadaawwan gurguddaan kunneenis beekaman gooteerta.
english: LORD, for your servant’s sake, and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness, to make known all these great things.

kikuyu: “Yaa Waaqayyo, kan akka keetii tokko iyyuu hin jiru; akka nu gurruma keenyaan dhageenyetti si malee Waaqni biraa hin jiru.
english: LORD, there is no one like you, neither is there any God besides you, according to all that we have heard with our ears.

kikuyu: Sabni akka saba kee Israaʼel kan Waaqni saba lafa irra jiraatu keessaa saba tokkicha ofii isaatiif furachuu fi ofii keetiitiifis maqaa tolfachuuf jettee fuula saba keetii duraa saboota ariʼuudhaan dinqiiwwan gurguddaa fi sodaachisaa hojjechuudhaaf baʼe, kan ati Gibxii baafte sanaa tokko iyyuu jiraa?
english: What one nation on the earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to himself for a people, to make you a name by great and awesome things, in driving out nations from before your people whom you redeemed out of Egypt?

kikuyu: Ati saba kee Israaʼelin bara baraan kan ofii keetii goote; Yaa Waaqayyo, ati Waaqa isaanii taateerta.
english: For you made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.

kikuyu: “Ammas yaa Waaqayyo, waadaan ati garbicha keetii fi mana isaatiif galte sun bara baraan jabaatee haa dhaabatu. Ati akkuma waadaa galte sana raawwadhu;
english: Now, LORD, let the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, be established forever, and do as you have spoken.

kikuyu: kunis akka maqaan kee jabaatee dhaabatee, bara baraanis guddaa taʼuuf. Kana irratti namoonni, ‘Waaqayyoon Waan Hunda Dandaʼu, Israaʼel irratti Waaqa; inni Waaqa Israaʼel!’ ni jedhu. Manni garbicha kee Daawitis fuula kee duratti jabaatee ni dhaabata.
english: Let your name be established and magnified forever, saying, ‘The LORD of Armies is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel. The house of David your servant is established before you.’

kikuyu: “Yaa Waaqa ko, ati akka mana isaaf ijaartu garbicha keetti mulʼifteerta. Kanaafuu garbichi kee si kadhachuudhaaf ija jabina argateera.
english: For you, my God, have revealed to your servant that you will build him a house. Therefore your servant has found courage to pray before you.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati Waaqa! Ati waan gaarii kana garbicha keetiif waadaa galteerta.
english: Now, LORD, you are God, and have promised this good thing to your servant.

kikuyu: Akka manni isaa bara baraan jabaattee fuula kee dura dhaabatuuf ammas mana garbicha keetii eebbisuun fedhii kee taʼeera; yaa Waaqayyo sababii ati isa eebbifteef, inni bara baraan ni eebbifama.”
english: Now it has pleased you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, LORD, have blessed, and it is blessed forever.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Daawit Filisxeemota moʼatee of jala isaan galfate; Gaatii fi gandoota naannoo ishee jiranis harka Filisxeemotaatii baase.
english: After this, David defeated the Philistines and subdued them, and took Gath and its towns out of the hand of the Philistines.

kikuyu: Daawit Moʼaabotas ni moʼate; isaanis isa jalatti bulanii gibira fidaniif.
english: He defeated Moab; and the Moabites became servants to David and brought tribute.

kikuyu: Kana irrattis Daawit yeroo Laga Efraaxiis bira yaadannoo ofii dhaabbachuu dhaqetti, hamma Hamaatiitti deemee Hadaadezer mooticha Zoobaa moʼate.
english: David defeated Hadadezer king of Zobah, toward Hamath, as he went to establish his dominion by the river Euphrates.

kikuyu: Daawitis gaariiwwan waraanaa isaa kuma tokko, abbootii fardaa kuma torbaa fi loltoota lafoo kuma digdama isa irraa fudhate. Innis fardeen gaariiwwanii dhibba tokko qofa hambisee kanneen hafan hunda mogolee kukkute.
english: David took from him one thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen; and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them enough for one hundred chariots.

kikuyu: Yeroo warri Sooriyaa kanneen Damaasqoo jiraatan Hadaadezer mooticha Zoobaa gargaaruuf dhufanittis, Daawit isaan keessaa nama kuma digdamii lama fixe.
english: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck twenty-two thousand men of the Syrians.

kikuyu: Ergasiis kutaa bulchiinsa Damaasqoo kan biyya Sooriyaa keessa qubata loltootaa dhaabbate; warri Sooriyaas isa jalatti bulanii gibira fidaniif. Waaqayyos Daawitiif lafa inni dhaqe hundatti mooʼicha kenne.
english: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David and brought tribute. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

kikuyu: Daawitis gaachana warqee kan ajajjoonni loltoota Hadaadezer harkatti qabatan fudhatee gara Yerusaalem fide.
english: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Daawit magaalaawwan Hadaadezer jechuunis Xibihaatii fi Kuuni naasii akka malee baayʼee fudhate; Solomoon immoo Gaanii naasii, utubaawwanii fi miʼoota naasii garaa garaa naasii sana irraa hojjete.
english: From Tibhath and from Cun, cities of Hadadezer, David took very much bronze, with which Solomon made the bronze sea, the pillars, and the vessels of bronze.

kikuyu: Tooʼuun mootiin Hamaati yommuu akka Daawit guutummaa loltoota Hadaadezer mooticha Zoobaa moʼate dhagaʼetti,
english: When Tou king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer king of Zobah,

kikuyu: akka inni sababii ol aantummaa Daawit Mootichi waraana keessatti Hadaadezer irratti argateetiif harka isa fuudhee dhaamsa gammachuu isaaf dabarsuuf ilma ofii Hadooraamin gara isaatti erge; Hadaadezer Tooʼuu wajjin wal waraanaa tureetii. Adooraamis kennaa gosa hundaa warqee irraa, meetii fi naasii irraa hojjetaman fideef.
english: he sent Hadoram his son to King David to greet him and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him (for Hadadezer had wars with Tou); and he had with him all kinds of vessels of gold and silver and bronze.

kikuyu: Daawit Mootichis akkuma meetii fi warqee saboota Edoom, Moʼaab, Amoonota, Filisxeemotaa fi Amaaleq hunda irraa boojiʼee ture godhe sana miʼoota kanneen illee Waaqayyoof addaan baase.
english: King David also dedicated these to the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he carried away from all the nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the children of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

kikuyu: Abiishaayi ilmi Zeruuyaa Sulula Soogiddaa keessatti Edoomota kuma kudha saddeet fixe.
english: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah struck eighteen thousand of the Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

kikuyu: Innis Edoom keessa qubata loltootaa dhaabbate; Edoomonni hundinuus Daawitiif ni garbooman. Waaqayyos lafa inni dhaqe hundatti Daawitiif moʼannaa ni kenne.
english: He put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became servants to David. The LORD gave victory to David wherever he went.

kikuyu: Daawit guutummaa Israaʼel irratti mootii taʼee saba isaa hundaaf murtii qajeelaa fi qajeelummaadhaan hojjete.
english: David reigned over all Israel; and he executed justice and righteousness for all his people.

kikuyu: Yooʼaab ilmi Zeruuyaa hoogganaa loltootaa ture; Yehooshaafaax ilmi Ahiiluud immoo galmeessaa ture;
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

kikuyu: Zaadoq ilmi Ahiixuubii fi Abiimelek ilmi Abiyaataar luboota turan; Shaafisaan immoo barreessaa ture;
english: Zadok the son of Ahitub and Abimelech the son of Abiathar were priests; Shavsha was scribe;

kikuyu: Benaayaa ilmi Yehooyaadaa hoogganaa Kereetotaa fi Pheletotaa ture; ilmaan Daawit immoo mootichatti aananii qondaaltota hangafoota turan.
english: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief officials serving the king.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Naahaash mootiin Amoonotaa ni duʼe; ilmi isaa iddoo isaa buʼee mootii taʼe.
english: After this, Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his place.

kikuyu: Daawitis, “Sababii abbaan isaa naa arjoomeef anis Haanuun ilma Naahaashiif nan arjooma” jedhee yaade. Kanaafuu Daawit gadda waaʼee abbaa isaatiif itti dhagaʼame isaa ibsuuf Haanuunitti ergamoota ni erge. Yommuu namoonni Daawit dhaamsa gaddaa itti himuuf Haanuun bira biyya Amoonotaa dhaqanitti,
english: David said, “I will show kindness to Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me.” So David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. David’s servants came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.

kikuyu: qondaaltonni Amoonotaa Haanuuniin, “Ati sababii Daawit akka isaan dhaamsa gaddaa sitti himaniif namoota sitti ergeef inni waan abbaa keetiif ulfina kenne seetaa? Ergamoonni isaa biyyattii qorachuu, basaasanii qabachuuf gara kee dhufan mitii?” jedhan.
english: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, “Do you think that David honors your father, in that he has sent comforters to you? Haven’t his servants come to you to search, to overthrow, and to spy out the land?”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Haanuun namoota Daawit sana qaqqabee rifeensa irraa haadee wayyaa isaanii illee teessuma irratti cicciree of irraa isaan erge.
english: So Hanun took David’s servants, shaved them, and cut off their garments in the middle at their buttocks, and sent them away.

kikuyu: Daawit yommuu namni tokko dhufee waaʼee namoota sanaa isatti himetti, sababii isaan akka malee qaanaʼaniif ergamoota gara isaaniitti erge. Mootichis “Isin hamma areedni keessan isinii guddatutti Yerikoo turaatii ergasii deebiʼaa kottaa” jedheen.
english: Then some people went and told David how the men were treated. He sent to meet them; for the men were greatly humiliated. The king said, “Stay at Jericho until your beards have grown, and then return.”

kikuyu: Amoononni yommuu akka Daawit isaan xireeffate hubatanitti Haanuunii fi Amoononni Phaadaan Arraamii, Araamaʼaakaa fi Zoobaadhaa gaariiwwan kireeffachuuf meetii taalaantii kuma tokko ni ergan.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent one thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, out of Aram-maacah, and out of Zobah.

kikuyu: Isaanis gaariiwwan kuma soddomii lamaa fi ooftota gaariiwwanii, akkasumas mootii Maʼakaatii fi loltoota isaa kanneen dhufanii Meedebaa bira qubatan sana kireeffatan; Amoononni immoo magaalaawwan isaaniitii walitti qabamanii waraanatti ni qajeelan.
english: So they hired for themselves thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maacah with his people, who came and encamped near Medeba. The children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.

kikuyu: Daawit yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti Yooʼaabii fi guutummaa loltootaa ni erge.
english: When David heard of it, he sent Joab with all the army of the mighty men.

kikuyu: Amoononni immoo baʼanii karra magaalaa isaanii irratti waraanaaf hiriiran; mootonni dhufan sun immoo kophaa isaanii dirree irra turan.
english: The children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array at the gate of the city; and the kings who had come were by themselves in the field.

kikuyu: Yooʼaabis akka fuula isaa duraa fi dugda isaa duubaan waraanni jiru ni arge; kanaafuu loltoota Israaʼel keessaa namoota bebeekamoo filatee adda loltoonni Sooriyaa jiranitti bobbaase.
english: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose some of all the choice men of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.

kikuyu: Namoota hafan immoo ajaja obboleessa isaa Abiishaayi jalatti ni hiriirse; isaanis Amoonotatti duulan.
english: The rest of the people he committed into the hand of Abishai his brother; and they put themselves in array against the children of Ammon.

kikuyu: Yooʼaabis akkana jedhe; “Yoo warri Sooriyaa natti jabaatan ati na gargaarta; yoo Amoononni sitti jabaatan immoo ani sin gargaara.
english: He said, “If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you are to help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

kikuyu: Jabaadhaa saba keenyaa fi magaalaawwan Waaqa keenyaatiif garaa kutannaadhaan haa lollu. Waaqayyos waan fuula isaa duratti gaarii taʼe ni godha.”
english: Be courageous, and let’s be strong for our people and for the cities of our God. May the LORD do that which seems good to him.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Yooʼaabii fi loltoonni isa wajjin turan warra Sooriyaa waraanuuf fuul duratti ni qajeelan; jarris fuula isaa duraa baqatan.
english: So Joab and the people who were with him came near to the front of the Syrians to the battle; and they fled before him.

kikuyu: Amoononni yommuu akka namoonni Sooriyaa baqatan arganitti isaanis fuula obboleessa isaa Abiishaayi duraa baqatanii magaalaa seenan. Akkasiin Yooʼaab Yerusaalemitti deebiʼe.
english: When the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians had fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Namoonni Sooriyaa yommuu akka Israaʼeloonni isaan moʼatan arganitti ergamoota erganii namoota Sooriyaa kanneen Laga Efraaxiisiitiin gamaa fichisiisan; Shoofaki ajajaan loltoota Hadaadezer sun isaan hoogganaa ture.
english: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and called out the Syrians who were beyond the River, with Shophach the captain of the army of Hadadezer leading them.

kikuyu: Daawitis yommuu wanni kun isatti himametti, Israaʼeloota hunda walitti qabee Yordaanos ceʼe; innis dursee dhaqee fuula isaanii duraan toora lolaa ni qabate. Daawitis warra Sooriyaa waraanuuf loltoota isaa hiriirse; namoonni Sooriyaas ni lolaniin.
english: David was told that, so he gathered all Israel together, passed over the Jordan, came to them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu Israaʼeloota duraa baqatan; Daawitis namoota gaarii waraanaa oofan kuma torbaa fi loltoota lafoo kuma afurtama fixe. Ajajaa loltoota isaanii Shoofaki illee ni ajjeese.
english: The Syrians fled before Israel; and David killed of the Syrian men seven thousand charioteers and forty thousand footmen, and also killed Shophach the captain of the army.

kikuyu: Tajaajiltoonni Hadaadezeriis yommuu akka Israaʼelootaan moʼataman arganitti Daawit wajjin nagaa uumanii isa jalatti bulan. Kanaafuu namoonni Sooriyaa ergasii Amoonota gargaaruu hin feene.
english: When the servants of Hadadezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and served him. The Syrians would not help the children of Ammon any more.

kikuyu: Birraa keessa yeroo mootonni waraanaaf baʼanitti Yooʼaab humnoota waraanaa qajeelchee biyya Amoonotaa barbadeesse; ergasiis dhaqee Rabbaa marse; Daawit garuu Yerusaalemitti hafe. Yooʼaabis Raabbaa waraanee daaraa ishee godhe.
english: At the time of the return of the year, at the time when kings go out, Joab led out the army and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David stayed at Jerusalem. Joab struck Rabbah, and overthrew it.

kikuyu: Daawitis mataa mootii isaanii irraa gonfoo fudhate; gonfoon sun hamma warqee taalaantii tokkoo ulfaatee dhagaawwan gati jabeeyyiis of irraa qaba ture; gonfichis mataa Daawit irra kaaʼame. Innis magaalaa sana keessaa boojuu akka malee baayʼee fudhatee
english: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.

kikuyu: namoota achi keessa turanis gad yaasee akka isaan magaaziidhaan, gasoo sibiilaatii fi qottoodhaan hojii hojjetan godhe. Daawit magaalaawwan Amoonotaa hunda keessattis akkasuma godhe. Ergasii Daawitii fi loltoonni isaa hundinuu Yerusaalemitti ni deebiʼan.
english: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ergasii immoo lafa Geezir jedhamutti Filisxeemota wajjin waraanni baname. Yeroo sanattis Siibekaay namichi biyya Hushaa sun Siifaay namicha gosa tokko Refaayin ajjeese; Filisxeemonnis ni bulaniif.
english: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

kikuyu: Waraana biraa kan Filisxeemota wajjin godhame keessatti immoo Elhaanaan ilmi Yaaʼiir sun Lahemii obboleessa Gooliyaad namicha Gitii kan somaan eeboo isaa loosaa wayya dhooftuu gaʼu qabu sanaa ni ajjeese.
english: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

kikuyu: Ammas waraana Gaatitti godhame kan biraa keessatti namicha hamma wayii gaʼu kan tokkoo tokkoo harka isaa irraa quboota jaʼa jaʼa akkasumas tokkoo tokkoo miilla isaa irraa quboota jaʼa jaʼa walumatti quboota digdamii afur qabu tokkotu ture. Innis sanyii Raafaa keessaa dhalate.
english: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.

kikuyu: Yommuu inni Israaʼelin tuttuqettis Yoonaataan ilmi Shimeʼaa obboleessi Daawit isa ajjeese.
english: When he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen sanyiiwwan Raafaa warra Gaati keessa turanii dha; isaanis harka Daawitii fi harka namoota isaatiin dhuman.
english: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David and by the hand of his servants.

kikuyu: Seexanni Israaʼelitti kaʼee akka Daawit saba Israaʼel lakkaaʼuuf isa kakaase.
english: Satan stood up against Israel, and moved David to take a census of Israel.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Daawit Yooʼaabii fi ajajjoota loltootaatiin, “Dhaqaatii Bersheebaadhaa hamma Daaniitti Israaʼeloota lakkaaʼaa. Ergasii immoo akka ani akka isaan hammam akka baayʼatan beekuu dandaʼuuf deebiʼaatii natti himaa” jedhe.
english: David said to Joab and to the princes of the people, “Go, count Israel from Beersheba even to Dan; and bring me word, that I may know how many there are.”

kikuyu: Yooʼaab garuu deebisee, “Waaqayyo loltoota isaa dachaa dhibba caalaa haa baayʼisu. Yaa gooftaa koo mooticha, isaan hundi garboota gooftaa kootiif bulan mitii? Gooftaan koo maaliif waan kana gochuu barbaade? Inni maaliif Israaʼelitti yakka fida?” jedhe.
english: Joab said, “May the LORD make his people a hundred times as many as they are. But, my lord the king, aren’t they all my lord’s servants? Why does my lord require this thing? Why will he be a cause of guilt to Israel?”

kikuyu: Taʼus dubbiin mootichaa Yooʼaabin yaada geeddarachiise; kanaafuu Yooʼaab achii baʼee guutummaa Israaʼel keessa naannaʼee Yerusaalemitti deebiʼe.
english: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Therefore Joab departed and went throughout all Israel, then came to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yooʼaabis lakkoobsa namoota loluu dandaʼanii Daawititti hime; namoota Yihuudaa keessa jiraatan kuma dhibba afurii fi torbaatama dabalatee namoota goraadee qabachuu dandaʼan miliyoona tokkoo fi kuma dhibba tokkootu guutummaa Israaʼel keessa ture.
english: Joab gave the sum of the census of the people to David. All those of Israel were one million one hundred thousand men who drew a sword; and in Judah were four hundred seventy thousand men who drew a sword.

kikuyu: Sababii ajajni mootichaa Yooʼaabin jibbisiiseef inni gosoota Lewwiitii fi Beniyaam itti dabalee hin lakkoofne.
english: But he didn’t count Levi and Benjamin among them, for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.

kikuyu: Ajajni kun fuula Waaqaa durattis waan hamaa ture; kanaafuu inni Israaʼelin rukute.
english: God was displeased with this thing; therefore he struck Israel.

kikuyu: Kana irratti Daawit Waaqaan, “Ani waan kana gochuudhaan akka malee cubbuu hojjedheera. Amma garuu akka ati balleessaa garbicha keetii dhiiftuuf sin kadhadha. Ani hojii gowwummaa guddaa hojjedheeraa” jedhe.
english: David said to God, “I have sinned greatly, in that I have done this thing. But now put away, I beg you, the iniquity of your servant, for I have done very foolishly.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Gaad raajii Daawit sanaan akkana jedhe;
english: The LORD spoke to Gad, David’s seer, saying,

kikuyu: “Dhaqiitii Daawitiin, ‘Waaqayyo akkana siin jedha: Ani filannoo sadii siifin kenna. Akka ani isa sitti fiduuf, isaan keessaa tokko filadhu’ jedhi.”
english: “Go and speak to David, saying, ‘The LORD says, “I offer you three things. Choose one of them, that I may do it to you.”’”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Gaad gara Daawit dhaqee akkana jedheen; “Waaqayyo akkana jedha: ‘Filannoo kee addaan baafadhu:
english: So Gad came to David and said to him, “The LORD says, ‘Take your choice:

kikuyu: Beela waggaa sadii yookaan jiʼa sadii fuula diinota keetii dura ariʼamuu fi goraadee isaaniitiin balleeffamuu yookaan guyyaa goraadee Waaqayyoo sadii jechuunis guyyoota dhaʼichi biyyattiitti buʼee ergamaan Waaqayyoo kutaa Israaʼel hunda balleessu.’ Egaa amma waan ani isa na erge sanaaf deebisu murteeffadhu.”
english: either three years of famine; or three months to be consumed before your foes, while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the sword of the LORD, even pestilence in the land, and the LORD’s angel destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now therefore consider what answer I shall return to him who sent me.’”

kikuyu: Daawit immoo Gaadiin, “Ani akka malee dhiphadheera. Waan araarri isaa akka malee guddaa taʼeef ani harka Waaqayyoo seenuu naaf wayya; garuu akka ani harka namaa seenu na hin godhin” jedhe.
english: David said to Gad, “I am in distress. Let me fall, I pray, into the LORD’s hand, for his mercies are very great. Don’t let me fall into man’s hand.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqayyo Israaʼelitti dhaʼicha ergee namoonni Israaʼel kuma torbaatama ni dhuman.
english: So the LORD sent a pestilence on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel fell.

kikuyu: Waaqni akka inni Yerusaalem balleessuuf ergamaa isaa tokko erge. Garuu utuma ergamaan Waaqayyoo sun Yerusaalemin balleessuuf qophaaʼaa jiruu Waaqayyo balaa sana argee gaabbee ergamaa isaa kan saba balleessuuf ture sanaan, “Ni gaʼa! Harka kee deebifadhu” jedhe. Yeroo sana ergamaan Waaqayyoo sun oobdii Ornaa namicha gosa Yebuus sanaa bira dhaabachaa ture.
english: God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it. As he was about to destroy, the LORD saw, and he relented of the disaster, and said to the destroying angel, “It is enough. Now withdraw your hand.” the LORD’s angel was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

kikuyu: Daawitis ol ilaalee ergamaa Waaqayyoo kan goraadee luqqifamee Yerusaalemitti diriirfame harka isaatti qabatee samii fi lafa gidduu dhaabachaa jiru tokko ni arge. Daawitii fi maanguddoonni wayyaa gaddaa uffatanii fuula isaa duratti addaan lafatti ni gombifaman.
english: David lifted up his eyes, and saw the LORD’s angel standing between earth and the sky, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders, clothed in sackcloth, fell on their faces.

kikuyu: Daawit immoo Waaqaan, “Namni akka loltoonni lakkaaʼaman godhe ana mitii? Namni cubbuu fi balleessaa hojjete anuma. Isaan kunneen garuu hoolotaa dha. Isaan maal godhan? Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa koo harki kee anaa fi maatii koo irra haa buʼu; garuu akka dhaʼichi kun saba kee irra turu hin godhin” jedhe.
english: David said to God, “Isn’t it I who commanded the people to be counted? It is even I who have sinned and done very wickedly; but these sheep, what have they done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be against me and against my father’s house; but not against your people, that they should be plagued.”

kikuyu: Ergasii ergamaan Waaqayyoo akka Daawit ol baʼee oobdii Ornaa namicha gosa Yebuus sanaa keessatti iddoo aarsaa Waaqayyoof ijaaru akka inni Daawititti himu Gaadin ajaje.
english: Then the LORD’s angel commanded Gad to tell David that David should go up and raise an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Daawit dubbii Gaad maqaa Waaqayyootiin isatti hime sanaaf ajajamee ol baʼe.
english: David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spoke in the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Ornaan utuu qamadii dhaʼuutti jiruu ol jedhee ergamaa Waaqayyoo sana arge; ilmaan isaa warri isa wajjin turan afranis ni dhokatan.
english: Ornan turned back and saw the angel; and his four sons who were with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.

kikuyu: Ergasii Daawit achi gaʼe; Ornaanis yommuu milʼatee isa argetti oobdii sana keessaa baʼee fuula Daawit duratti addaan lafatti gombifamee sagade.
english: As David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshing floor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.

kikuyu: Daawitis, “Ani akka isa irratti iddoo aarsaa Waaqayyoof tolchee akkasiin dhaʼichi saba irra buʼe kun dhaabatuuf oobdii kee naaf kenni. Gatii isaa guutuutti natti gurguri” jedheen.
english: Then David said to Ornan, “Sell me the place of this threshing floor, that I may build an altar to the LORD on it. You shall sell it to me for the full price, that the plague may be stopped from afflicting the people.”

kikuyu: Ornaanis Daawitiin, “Fudhadhu! Gooftaan koo mootichi waan isatti tolu kam iyyuu haa godhu. Kunoo ani aarsaa gubamuuf sangoota, qoraaniif ulee ittiin midhaan dhaʼan, kennaa midhaan dhiʼeeffamuufis qamadii nan kenna; ani waan kana hunda nan kenna” jedhe.
english: Ornan said to David, “Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes. Behold, I give the oxen for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meal offering. I give it all.”

kikuyu: Daawit Mootichi garuu Ornaadhaan, “Kun hin taʼu; ani gatii isaa guutuu siifin kenna. Ani waan kan kee taʼe Waaqayyoof hin fudhadhu yookaan waan gatii na hin baasisin aarsaa gubamuuf hin dhiʼeessu” jedhe.
english: King David said to Ornan, “No, but I will most certainly buy it for the full price. For I will not take that which is yours for the LORD, nor offer a burnt offering that costs me nothing.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Daawit gatii lafa sanaa Ornaadhaaf warqee saqilii dhibbaa jaʼa kafale.
english: So David gave to Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

kikuyu: Daawitis achitti iddoo aarsaa Waaqayyoof tolchee aarsaa gubamuu fi aarsaa nagaa dhiʼeesse. Innis Waaqayyoon ni waammate; Waaqayyos samiidhaa ibiddaan iddoo aarsaa gubamuu irratti isaaf deebii kenne.
english: David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called on the LORD; and he answered him from the sky by fire on the altar of burnt offering.

kikuyu: Sana booddee Waaqayyo ergamaa isaa sanatti dubbate; innis goraadee isaa manʼee isaatti ni deebise.
english: Then the LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

kikuyu: Daawit yeroo sanatti akka Waaqayyo oobdii Ornaa namicha gosa Yebuus sanaa irratti deebii isaa kenne ni hubate; achittis aarsaa ni dhiʼeesse.
english: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.

kikuyu: Dunkaanni Waaqayyoo kan Museen gammoojjiitti hojjetee fi iddoon aarsaa gubamuu Gibeʼoon keessa gaara sagadaa irra ture.
english: For the LORD’s tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of burnt offering, were at that time in the high place at Gibeon.

kikuyu: Daawit garuu sababii goraadee ergamaa Waaqayyoo sodaateef achi dhaqee fuula iddoo aarsaa sanaa duratti Waaqa kadhachuu hin dandeenye.
english: But David couldn’t go before it to inquire of God, for he was afraid because of the sword of the LORD’s angel.

kikuyu: Ergasii Daawit, “Kun mana Waaqayyo Waaqaa ti; kun immoo iddoo aarsaa, aarsaan gubamu Israaʼeliif itti dhiʼeeffamuu dha” jedhe.
english: Then David said, “This is the house of the LORD God, and this is the altar of burnt offering for Israel.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Daawit akka alagoonni Israaʼel keessa jiraatan walitti qabaman ajaje; isaan keessaas akka isaan ijaarsa mana qulqullummaa Waaqaatiif dhagaa soofame qopheessaniif warra dhagaa cabsan ni filate.
english: David gave orders to gather together the foreigners who were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to cut dressed stones to build God’s house.

kikuyu: Inni mismaara ittiin hundaa balbalaa hojjetanii fi miʼa ittiin walitti qabsiisan hojjechuudhaaf sibiila akka malee baayʼee fi naasii madaalliin isaa hamma hin qabne ni kenne.
english: David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the couplings, and bronze in abundance without weight,

kikuyu: Daawitis sababii warri Siidoonaatii fi warri Xiiroos birbirsa akka malee baayʼee isaaf fidaniif birbirsa baayʼinni isaa lakkaaʼamuu hin dandeenye ni kenne.
english: and cedar trees without number, for the Sidonians and the people of Tyre brought cedar trees in abundance to David.

kikuyu: Daawit akkana jedhe; “Ilmi koo Solomoon ijoollee dha; muuxannoo illee hin qabu. Manni Waaqayyoof ijaaramu kun immoo ulfina qabeessa, kan gurra qabuu fi kan fuula saboota hundaa duratti akka malee miidhagu taʼuu qaba. Kanaafuu ani isaaf qophii nan godha.” Akkasiin Daawit utuu hin duʼin qophii guddaa godhe.
english: David said, “Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be exceedingly magnificent, of fame and of glory throughout all countries. I will therefore make preparation for it.” So David prepared abundantly before his death.

kikuyu: Ergasii Daawit ilma isaa Solomoonin waamee akka inni Waaqayyo Waaqa Israaʼeliif mana ijaaru isa ajaje.
english: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Daawitis Solomooniin akkana jedhe: “Yaa ilma ko, ani Maqaa Waaqayyo Waaqa kootiif mana ijaaruu yaadee ture.
english: David said to Solomon his son, “As for me, it was in my heart to build a house to the name of the LORD my God.

kikuyu: Garuu dubbiin Waaqayyoo akkana jedhee gara koo dhufe: ‘Ati dhiiga baayʼee dhangalaafteerta; lola hedduus lolteerta. Ati sababii fuula koo duratti dhiiga baayʼee lafa irratti dhangalaafteef Maqaa kootiif mana hin ijaartu.
english: But the LORD’s word came to me, saying, ‘You have shed blood abundantly and have made great wars. You shall not build a house to my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

kikuyu: Kunoo ilmi tokko siif ni dhalata; innis nama boqonnaa ni taʼa; anis diinota isaa kanneen naannoo isaa jiran hunda irraa boqonnaa nan kennaaf. Maqaan isaas Solomoon jedhama; ani bara mootummaa isaa keessa Israaʼeliif nagaa fi tasgabbii nan kenna.
english: Behold, a son shall be born to you, who shall be a man of peace. I will give him rest from all his enemies all around; for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness to Israel in his days.

kikuyu: Namni Maqaa kootiif mana ijaaru isa. Inni ilma naaf taʼa; anis abbaa nan taʼaaf. Teessoo mootummaa isaas Israaʼel irratti bara baraan jabeessee nan dhaaba.’
english: He shall build a house for my name; and he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.’

kikuyu: “Egaa yaa ilma ko, akkuma inni waaʼee kee dubbate sanatti akka mana Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii ijaaruun siif milkaaʼuuf Waaqayyo si wajjin haa taʼu.
english: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you and prosper you, and build the house of the LORD your God, as he has spoken concerning you.

kikuyu: Akka ati yommuu inni Israaʼel irratti aangoo siif kennutti seera Waaqayyo Waaqa keetii eegduuf Waaqayyo ogummaa fi hubannaa siif haa kennu.
english: May the LORD give you discretion and understanding, and put you in charge of Israel, so that you may keep the law of the LORD your God.

kikuyu: Akkasiin ati yoo ajajaa fi seera Waaqayyo karaa Museetiin Israaʼeliif kenne sana akka gaariitti eegde ni milkoofta. Jabaadhu; onnoomis. Hin sodaatin yookaan abdii hin kutatin.
english: Then you will prosper, if you observe to do the statutes and the ordinances which the LORD gave Moses concerning Israel. Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid and don’t be dismayed.

kikuyu: “Kunoo, ani ijaarsa mana Waaqayyootiif warqee taalaantii kuma dhibba tokko, meetii taalaantii miliyoona tokko, naasii fi sibiila akka malee baayʼee kan madaalamuu hin dandeenye, mukaa fi dhagaa illee qopheessuu irratti akka malee dadhabeera. Atis itti dabaluu ni dandeessa.
english: Now, behold, in my affliction I have prepared for the LORD’s house one hundred thousand talents of gold, one million talents of silver, and bronze and iron without weight; for it is in abundance. I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to them.

kikuyu: Ati hojjettoota hedduu qabda; isaanis: warra dhagaa cabsan, warra mana dhagaa ijaaranii fi warra ogummaa hojii mukaa qaban, akkasumas namoota ogummaa hojii gosa gosaa,
english: There are also workmen with you in abundance—cutters and workers of stone and timber, and all kinds of men who are skillful in every kind of work;

kikuyu: kan hojii warqeetii fi meetii, kan naasiitii fi sibiilaa, ogeeyyii hojii harkaa warra lakkoobsi isaanii hin beekamne qabda. Egaa amma hojii jalqabi; Waaqayyos si wajjin haa taʼu.”
english: of the gold, the silver, the bronze, and the iron, there is no number. Arise and be doing, and may the LORD be with you.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Daawit akka isaan ilma isaa Solomoon gargaaraniif dura buutota Israaʼel hunda ni ajaje.
english: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,

kikuyu: Akkanas isaaniin jedhe; “Waaqayyo Waaqni keessan isin wajjin jira mitii? Inni gama hundaan boqonnaa isiniif kenneera mitii? Inni jiraattota biyya kanaa dabarsee natti kenneeraatii; biyyattiinis Waaqayyoo fi saba isaatiif garboomteerti.
english: “Isn’t the LORD your God with you? Hasn’t he given you rest on every side? For he has delivered the inhabitants of the land into my hand; and the land is subdued before the LORD and before his people.

kikuyu: Amma Waaqayyo Waaqa keessan barbaaduuf garaa fi lubbuu keessan guutuudhaan kutadhaa kaʼaa. Akka taabota kakuu Waaqayyootii fi miʼoota qulqulluu kan Waaqaa fiddanii mana qulqullummaa kan Maqaa Waaqayyootiif ijaaramuuf jiru sanatti galchitaniif mana Waaqayyo Gooftaa ijaaruu jalqabaa.”
english: Now set your heart and your soul to follow the LORD your God. Arise therefore, and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the LORD’s covenant and the holy vessels of God into the house that is to be built for the LORD’s name.”

kikuyu: Daawit erga waggaa hedduu jiraatee dulloomee booddee ilma isaa Solomoonin Israaʼel irratti mootii godhe.
english: Now David was old and full of days; and he made Solomon his son king over Israel.

kikuyu: Akkasumas Daawit dura buutota Israaʼel hunda, lubootaa fi Lewwota illee walitti qabe.
english: He gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.

kikuyu: Lewwonni umuriin isaanii waggaa soddomaa fi hammasii olii ni lakkaaʼaman; baayʼinni dhiirotaa kuma soddomii saddeet taʼe.
english: The Levites were counted from thirty years old and upward; and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty-eight thousand.

kikuyu: Daawitis akkana jedhe; “Isaan kanneen keessaa kuma digdamii afur hojii mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyoo haa toʼatan; namoonni kuma jaʼa qondaaltotaa fi abbootii murtii haa taʼan.
english: David said, “Of these, twenty-four thousand were to oversee the work of the LORD’s house, six thousand were officers and judges,

kikuyu: Kumni afur eegdota balbalaa haa taʼan; kumni afur immoo miʼoota faarfannaa kanneen ani kaayyoo kanaaf kenneen Waaqayyoon haa galateeffatan.”
english: four thousand were doorkeepers, and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments which I made for giving praise.”

kikuyu: Daawitis Lewwota akkuma gosoota Lewwiitti garee gareen gargar ni qoode; isaanis: Geershoon, Qohaatii fi Meraarii.
english: David divided them into divisions according to the sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

kikuyu: Gosa Geershoon keessaa: Laʼadaanii fi Shimeʼii.
english: Of the Gershonites: Ladan and Shimei.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Laʼadaanii: Yehiiʼeel hangafticha, Zeetaamii fi Yooʼeel; walumatti nama sadii turan.
english: The sons of Ladan: Jehiel the chief, Zetham, and Joel, three.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Shimeʼii: Sheloomot, Haziiʼeelii fi Haaraan; walumatti nama sadii turan. Isaan kunneen hangafoota Maatii Laʼadaan turan.
english: The sons of Shimei: Shelomoth, Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the heads of the fathers’ households of Ladan.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Shimeʼii: Yahaati, Ziinaa, Yeʼuushii fi Beriiyaa. Isaan kunneen ilmaan Shimeʼii ti; walumatti nama afur turan.
english: The sons of Shimei: Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

kikuyu: Yahaati hangafa; Ziinaan lammaffaa; Yeʼuushii fi Beriiyaan garuu ilmaan baayʼee hin qaban; kanaafuu isaan akkuma maatii tokkootti lakkaaʼaman.
english: Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second; but Jeush and Beriah didn’t have many sons; therefore they became a fathers’ house in one reckoning.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Qohaatii: Amraam, Yizihaar, Kebroonii fi Uziiʼeel; walumatti nama afur turan.
english: The sons of Kohath: Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Amraam: Aroonii fi Musee. Aroon akka innii fi sanyiin isaa wantoota waan hunda caalaa qulqulluu taʼan Waaqaaf qulqulleessaniif, akka fuula Waaqayyoo duratti aarsaa dhiʼeessaniif, akka fuula isaa dura tajaajilanii fi akka maqaa isaatiin eebba labsaniif bara baraan addaan baafaman.
english: The sons of Amram: Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was separated that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons forever, to burn incense before the LORD, to minister to him, and to bless in his name forever.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Musee nama Waaqaa immoo gosa Lewwiitti dabalamanii lakkaaʼaman.
english: But as for Moses the man of God, his sons were named among the tribe of Levi.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Musee: Geershoomii fi Eliiʼezer.
english: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Geershoomii: Shebuuʼeel hangafa.
english: The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Eliiʼezerii keessaa: Rehaabiyaa hangafa. Eleʼaazaar ilmaan biraa hin qabu ture; ilmaan Rehaabiyaa garuu akka malee hedduu turan.
english: The son of Eliezer was Rehabiah the chief; and Eliezer had no other sons, but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yizihaar keessaa: Sheloomiit hangafta.
english: The son of Izhar: Shelomith the chief.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Kebroon; hangaftichi Yeriyaa, lammaffaan Amariyaa, sadaffaan Yahiziiʼeel, afuraffaan Yeqameʼaam.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah the chief, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Uziiʼeel: hangaftichi Miikaa, lammaffaan Yishiyaa.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah the chief, and Isshiah the second.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Meraarii: Mahilii fi Muusii. Ilmaan Mahilii: Eleʼaazaarii fi Qiish.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli: Eleazar and Kish.

kikuyu: Eleʼaazaar utuu ilmaan hin dhalchin duʼe; inni intallan qofa qaba ture. Durbiiwwan isaanii ilmaan Qiishitu isaan fuudhe.
english: Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters only; and their relatives, the sons of Kish, took them as wives.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Muusii: Mahelii, Eederii fi Yereemooti; walumatti nama sadii turan.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth, three.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen ilmaan Lewwii kanneen akkuma mana abbootii isaaniitti hangafoonni abbootii warri maqaa maqaadhaan galmeeffamanii tokko tokkoon lakkaaʼaman, hojjettoota umuriin isaanii waggaa digdamaa fi sanaa ol taʼe warra mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyoo keessa tajaajilanii dha.
english: These were the sons of Levi after their fathers’ houses, even the heads of the fathers’ houses of those who were counted individually, in the number of names by their polls, who did the work for the service of the LORD’s house, from twenty years old and upward.

kikuyu: Daawit akkana jedhee tureetii; “Waaqayyoo Waaqni Israaʼel saba isaatiif boqonnaa kenneera; bara baraanis Yerusaalem keessa ni jiraata;
english: For David said, “The LORD, the God of Israel, has given rest to his people; and he dwells in Jerusalem forever.

kikuyu: siʼachi Lewwonni dunkaana yookaan miʼoota achi keessatti itti fayyadaman hin baatan.”
english: Also the Levites will no longer need to carry the tabernacle and all its vessels for its service.”

kikuyu: Akkuma qajeelcha Daawit dhuma irratti kenneetti, Lewwonni waggaa digdamaa fi sanaa olii hedamaniiruutii.
english: For by the last words of David the sons of Levi were counted, from twenty years old and upward.

kikuyu: Hojiin Lewwotaas tajaajila mana qulqullummaa Waaqaa keessatti sanyiiwwan Aroonii gargaaruu dha; kunis oobdiiwwanii fi kutaawwan mana qulqullummaa eeguu, miʼoota qulqulluu qulqulleessuu fi hojiiwwan biraas mana Waaqayyoo keessatti hojjechuu dha.
english: For their duty was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the LORD’s house—in the courts, in the rooms, and in the purifying of all holy things, even the work of the service of God’s house;

kikuyu: Akkasumas buddeena minjaala irra kaaʼuu, daakuu kennaa midhaanii, buddeena utuu hin bukaaʼin tolfame, tolchuu fi waliin makuu, safartuu fi madaalii hunda irratti itti gaafatamtoota turan.
english: for the show bread also, and for the fine flour for a meal offering, whether of unleavened wafers, or of that which is baked in the pan, or of that which is soaked, and for all measurements of quantity and size;

kikuyu: Isaan guyyaa guyyaadhaan Waaqayyoon galateeffachuu fi jajachuuf ganama ganama fuula isaa dura ni dhaabatu; galgala galgalas akkasuma ni godhu;
english: and to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and likewise in the evening;

kikuyu: yeroo aarsaan gubamu guyyaa Sanbataa Waaqayyoof dhiʼeeffamutti yeroo Ayyaana Baatii Haaraa fi gaafa ayyaana yeroon isaa murtaaʼe kamii iyyuu akkanuma ni godhu. Isaan yeroo hunda akkuma lakkoobsaa fi qajeelfama isaanii kennameetti fuula Waaqayyoo dura tajaajilu ture.
english: and to offer all burnt offerings to the LORD on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the set feasts, in number according to the ordinance concerning them, continually before the LORD;

kikuyu: Lewwonni akkasiin itti gaafatama dunkaana wal gaʼii fi Iddoo Qulqulluu eeguuf qaban raawwatan; akkasumas ajaja obboloota isaanii sanyiiwwan Aroon jalatti itti gaafatamummaa mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyoo keessatti qaban raawwachaa turan.
english: and that they should keep the duty of the Tent of Meeting, the duty of the holy place, and the duty of the sons of Aaron their brothers for the service of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Aroon akka armaan gadiitti ramadaman: Ilmaan Aroon Naadaab, Abiihuu, Eleʼaazaarii fi Iitaamaar turan.
english: These were the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

kikuyu: Naadaabii fi Abiihuu garuu utuu ijoollee hin dhalchin abbaa isaanii dursanii duʼan; kanaafuu Eleʼaazaarii fi Iitaamaar luboota taʼanii tajaajilan.
english: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children; therefore Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.

kikuyu: Daawitis gargaarsa Zaadoq sanyii Eleʼaazaar sanaatii fi Ahiimelek sanyii Iitaamaariin akkuma tajaajila isaaniitti garee gareen isaan ramade.
english: David, with Zadok of the sons of Eleazar and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, divided them according to their ordering in their service.

kikuyu: Sanyiiwwan Iitaamaarii caalaa sanyiiwwan Eleʼaazaar keessaa hooggantoonni hedduun ni argaman; isaanis akkanatti ramadaman: sanyiiwwan Eleʼaazaar keessaa abbootii maatii kudha jaʼa, sanyiiwwan Iitaamaar keessaa immoo abbootii maatii saddeet.
english: There were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and they were divided like this: of the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen, heads of fathers’ houses; and of the sons of Ithamar, according to their fathers’ houses, eight.

kikuyu: Isaan sababii sanyiiwwan Eleʼaazaarii fi sanyiiwwan Iitaamaar keessa qondaaltonni mana qulqullummaatii fi qondaaltonni Waaqaa turaniif loogii malee ixaadhaan isaan ramadan.
english: Thus they were divided impartially by drawing lots; for there were princes of the sanctuary and princes of God, both of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.

kikuyu: Shemaaʼiyaan ilmi Naatnaaʼel namicha gosa Lewwii barreessaan sun fuula mootichaatii fi qondaaltotaa duratti maqaa isaanii Zaadoq lubicha, Ahiimelek ilma Abiyaataar, abbootii maatiiwwan lubootaatii fi Lewwotaa, innis gosa Eleʼaazaar keessaa maatii tokko, gosa Iitaamaar keessaa immoo maatii tokko fuudhee barreesse.
english: Shemaiah the son of Nethanel the scribe, who was of the Levites, wrote them in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites; one fathers’ house being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.

kikuyu: Ixaan jalqabaa Yehooyaariibiif, lammaffaan Yedaaʼiyaaf,
english: Now the first lot came out to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

kikuyu: sadaffaan Haariimiif, afuraffaan Seʼooriimiif,
english: the third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,

kikuyu: shanaffaan Malkiyaaf, jaʼaffaan Miyaamiiniif,
english: the fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

kikuyu: torbaffaan Haqoosiif, saddeettaffaan Abiyaaf,
english: the seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

kikuyu: saglaffaan Yeeshuuʼaaf, kurnaffaan Shekaaniyaaf,
english: the ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

kikuyu: kudhan tokkoffaan Eliyaashiibiif, kudha lammaffaan Yaaqiimiif,
english: the eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

kikuyu: kudha sadaffaan Huphaaf, kudha afuraffaan Yeshebeʼaabiif,
english: the thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

kikuyu: kudhan shanaffaan Bilgaaf, kudha jaʼaffaan Imeeriif,
english: the fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

kikuyu: kudha torbaffaan Heeziiriif, kudha saddeettaffaan Haphizeeziif,
english: the seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Happizzez,

kikuyu: kudha saglaffaan Phetaayaaf, digdammaffaan Hisqiʼeeliif,
english: the nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezkel,

kikuyu: digdamii tokkoffaan Yaakiiniif, digdamii lammaffaan Gaamuuliif,
english: the twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

kikuyu: digdamii sadaffaan Delaayaaf, digdamii afuraffaan Maʼaaziyaaf baʼe.
english: the twenty-third to Delaiah, and the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

kikuyu: Kun seera isaan yeroo mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyoo seenanitti ittiin tajaajilanii dha; seera kanas abbaa isaanii Aroonitu akkuma Waaqayyo Waaqni Israaʼel isa ajajetti isaaniif kenne.
english: This was their ordering in their service, to come into the LORD’s house according to the ordinance given to them by Aaron their father, as the LORD, the God of Israel, had commanded him.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Lewwii warra hafan: Ilmaan Amraamii keessaa: Shuubaaʼeel; ilmaan Shuubaaʼeel keessaa: Yehideyaa.
english: Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Rehaabiyaa keessaa: Yishiyaa hangafticha.
english: Of Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, Isshiah the chief.

kikuyu: Yizihaarota keessaa: Sheloomiit; ilmaan Sheloomiit keessaa immoo: Yahaati.
english: Of the Izharites, Shelomoth; of the sons of Shelomoth, Jahath.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Kebroon: Inni jalqabaa Yeriyaa, lammaffaan Amariyaa, sadaffaan Yahiziiʼeel, afuraffaan Yeqameʼaam.
english: The sons of Hebron: Jeriah, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

kikuyu: Ilma Uziiʼeel: Miikaa. Ilmaan Miikaa keessaa: Shaamiir.
english: The sons of Uzziel: Micah; of the sons of Micah, Shamir.

kikuyu: Obboleessa Miikaa: Yishiyaa; Ilmaan Yishiyaa keessaa: Zakkaariyaas.
english: The brother of Micah: Isshiah; of the sons of Isshiah, Zechariah.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Meraarii: Mahilii fi Muusii. Ilma Yaʼaziyaa: Banoo.
english: The sons of Merari: Mahli and Mushi. The son of Jaaziah: Beno.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Meraarii: Yaʼaziyaa irraa: Banoo, Shohaam, Zakuurii fi Ibrii.
english: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah: Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

kikuyu: Mahilii irra: Eleʼaazaar; namichi kun ilmaan hin qabu ture.
english: Of Mahli: Eleazar, who had no sons.

kikuyu: Qiish irraa: Yeramiʼeel ilma Qiish.
english: Of Kish, the son of Kish: Jerahmeel.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Muusii: Mahelii, Eederii fi Yeriimooti.
english: The sons of Mushi: Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after their fathers’ houses.

kikuyu: Isaanis akkuma obboloota isaanii ilmaan Aroon sana fuula Daawit Mootichaa duratti, fuula Zaadoq, Ahiimelek, fuula hangafoota maatii lubootaatii fi Lewwotaa duratti ixaa buufatan. Maatii obboleessa hangaftichaatiifis akkuma maatii obboleessa quxisuutti ixaan buʼe.
english: These likewise cast lots even as their brothers the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the heads of the fathers’ households of the priests and of the Levites, the fathers’ households of the chief even as those of his younger brother.

kikuyu: Daawit ajajjoota loltootaa wajjin akka isaan kiraaraan, baganaa fi kililleetti fayyadamanii raajii dubbataniif maatii Asaaf, Heemaanii fi Yeduutuun keessaa namoota addaan baafate. Maqaan namoota tajaajila kana kennaa turaniis:
english: Moreover, David and the captains of the army set apart for the service certain of the sons of Asaph, of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who were to prophesy with harps, with stringed instruments, and with cymbals. The number of those who did the work according to their service was:

kikuyu: Ilmaan Asaaf keessaa: Zakuur, Yoosef, Naataaniyaa fi Asareelaa. Ilmaan Asaaf qajeelcha Asaaf jala turan. Asaaf immoo qajeelcha mootichaa jalatti raajii dubbachaa ture.
english: of the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asharelah. The sons of Asaph were under the hand of Asaph, who prophesied at the order of the king.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Yeduutuun keessaa: Gedaaliyaas, Zerii, Isaayyaas, Sameeʼi, Hashabiyaa fi Matiitiyaa. Isaan kunneen jaʼan qajeelcha abbaa isaanii Yeduutuun isa kiraaraan Waaqayyo galateeffachaa fi jajachaa raajii dubbachaa ture sanaa jala turan.
english: Of Jeduthun, the sons of Jeduthun: Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Shimei, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied in giving thanks and praising the LORD with the harp.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Heemaan keessaa: Bukiyaa, Mataaniyaa, Uziiʼeel, Shebuuʼeelii fi Yeriimooti; Hanaaniyaa, Hanaanii, Eliiʼaataa, Gidaltii fi Roomaamti-Ezer; Yoshibqaashaa, Malootii, Hootiirii fi Mahaaziyoo ti.
english: Of Heman, the sons of Heman: Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-Ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen hundi ilmaan Heemaan namicha mootichaaf mulʼata argu sanaa turan. Isaan akka isa kabajaniif akkuma Waaqni abdachiise sanatti isaa ni kennaman. Waaqnis ilmaan kudha afurii fi intallan sadii Heemaaniif ni kenne.
english: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen hundi tajaajila mana Waaqaa keessatti faarfannaa kililleedhaan, kiraaraa fi baganaadhaan mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyoo keessatti faarfatamu sanaaf qajeelcha abbootii isaanii jala turan. Asaaf, Yeduutuunii fi Heemaan immoo qajeelcha mootichaa jala turan.
english: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the LORD’s house, with cymbals, stringed instruments, and harps, for the service of God’s house: Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman being under the order of the king.

kikuyu: Isaanii fi firoonni isaanii kanneen hundi isaanii faarfannaa Waaqayyoof faarfatamuun leenjifamanii ogummaa qaban walumaa galatti 288 turan.
english: The number of them, with their brothers who were instructed in singing to the LORD, even all who were skillful, was two hundred eighty-eight.

kikuyu: Jarris ramaddii isaanii beekuudhaaf xinnaa fi guddaan, barsiisaa fi barataan haaluma wal fakkaatuun ixaa buufatan.
english: They cast lots for their offices, all alike, the small as well as the great, the teacher as well as the student.

kikuyu: Ixaan jalqabatti Asaafiif buʼe sun Yoosefiif, ilmaan Yoosefiitii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaaniis kudha lama turan lammaffaan Gedaaliyaasiif, isaaf, firoota isaatii fi ilmaan isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: Now the first lot came out for Asaph to Joseph; the second to Gedaliah, he and his brothers and sons were twelve;

kikuyu: sadaffaan Zakuuriif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: the third to Zaccur, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: afuraffaan Izriif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: the fourth to Izri, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: shanaffaan Naataaniyaaf, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: the fifth to Nethaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: jaʼaffaan Bukiyaaf, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: the sixth to Bukkiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: torbaffaan Yishiriʼeeliif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: the seventh to Jesharelah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: saddeettaffaan Yashaayaaf, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: the eighth to Jeshaiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: saglaffaan Mataaniyaaf, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: the ninth to Mattaniah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: kurnaffaan Shimeʼiif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: the tenth to Shimei, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: kudha tokkoffaan Azariʼeeliif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: the eleventh to Azarel, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: kudha lammaffaan Hashabiyaaf, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: the twelfth to Hashabiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: kudha sadaffaan Shuubaaʼeeliif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: for the thirteenth, Shubael, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: kudha afuraffaan Matiitiyaaf, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: for the fourteenth, Mattithiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: kudha shanaffaan Yereemootiif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii nama kudha lama turan
english: for the fifteenth to Jeremoth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: kudha jaʼaffaan Hanaaniyaaf, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: for the sixteenth to Hananiah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: kudha torbaffaan Yoshibqaashaaf, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: for the seventeenth to Joshbekashah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: kudha saddeettaffaan Hanaaniif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii nama kudha lama turan
english: for the eighteenth to Hanani, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: kudha saglaffaan Malootiif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: for the nineteenth to Mallothi, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: digdammaffaan Eliyaataaf, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: for the twentieth to Eliathah, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: digdamii tokkoffaan Hootiiriif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: for the twenty-first to Hothir, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: digdamii lammaffaan Gidaltiif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: for the twenty-second to Giddalti, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: digdamii sadaffaan Mahaaziyootiif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan
english: for the twenty-third to Mahazioth, his sons and his brothers, twelve;

kikuyu: digdamii afuraffaan Roomaamti-Ezeriif, ilmaan isaatii fi firoota isaatiif baʼe; baayʼinni isaanii kudha lama turan.
english: for the twenty-fourth to Romamti-Ezer, his sons and his brothers, twelve.

kikuyu: Akka itti eegdonni karraa qoodaman: Gosa qoree keessaa: Ilmaan Asaaf keessaa Mesheleemiyaa ilma Qooraahi.
english: For the divisions of the doorkeepers: of the Korahites, Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.

kikuyu: Mesheleemiyaa ilmaan qaba ture; isaanis: Inni hangafti Zakkaariyaas, lammaffaan Yediiʼeel, sadaffaan Zabaadiyaa, Afuraffaan Yatniiʼeel,
english: Meshelemiah had sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,

kikuyu: inni shanaffaan Eelaam, jaʼaffaan Yehohaanaan, torbaffaan Eliihooʼeenayi.
english: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, and Eliehoenai the seventh.

kikuyu: Oobeed Edoomis akkasuma ilmaan qaba ture; isaanis: Inni hangafti Shemaaʼiyaa, lammaffaan Yehoozaabaad, sadaffaan Yooʼaa, afuraffaan Saakaar, shanaffaan Naatnaaʼel,
english: Obed-Edom had sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethanel the fifth,

kikuyu: jaʼaffaan Amiiʼeel, torbaffaan Yisaakor, saddeettaffaan Pheʼuletii; Waaqni Oobeed Edoomin eebbiseeraatii.
english: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, and Peullethai the eighth; for God blessed him.

kikuyu: Shemaaʼiyaan ilmi isaas ilmaan qaba ture; isaanis waan dandeettii guddaa qabaniif qajeelchitoota maatii abbaa isaanii turan.
english: Sons were also born to Shemaiah his son, who ruled over the house of their father; for they were mighty men of valor.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Shemaaʼiyaa: Otnii, Raafaaʼeel, Oobeedii fi Elzaabaad; firoonni isaa Eliihuu fi Samaakiyaanis dandeettii guddaa qabu ture.
english: The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose relatives were valiant men, Elihu, and Semachiah.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen hundi ilmaan Oobeed Edoom; isaan, ilmaan isaaniitii fi firoonni isaanii namoota jajjaboo dandeettii hojii qaban turan; ilmaan Oobeed Edoom; walumatti nama 62 turan.
english: All these were of the sons of Obed-Edom with their sons and their brothers, able men in strength for the service: sixty-two of Obed-Edom.

kikuyu: Mesheleemiyaa fi firoota dandeettii guddaa qaban qaba ture; isaanis walumatti nama 18 turan.
english: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen valiant men.

kikuyu: Hoosaan inni gosa Meraarii sun ilmaan qaba ture; isaanis: Shimriin dura buʼaa ture; inni hangafa taʼuu baatu iyyuu abbaan isaa dura buʼaa isa godhee ture;
english: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons: Shimri the chief (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him chief),

kikuyu: inni lammaffaan Hilqiyaa, inni sadaffaan Xibaliyaa, inni afuraffaan Zakkaariyaas.
english: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, and Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

kikuyu: Garee eegdota karraa kana keessaa hangafoota isaaniitiif hojiin akkuma firoonni isaanii hojjetan sanaa mana Waaqayyoo keessa tajaajiluu ni kennameef.
english: Of these were the divisions of the doorkeepers, even of the chief men, having offices like their brothers, to minister in the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo balbalaatiifis akkuma maatii maatii isaaniitti xinnaa guddaaf ixaan buʼe.
english: They cast lots, the small as well as the great, according to their fathers’ houses, for every gate.

kikuyu: Ixaan Karra Baʼa Biiftuu Shelemiyaaf baʼe. Ergasii immoo Zakkaariyaas ilma isaa gorsituu ogeessa sanaaf ixaan buʼe; ixaan balbala kaabaa isaaf baʼe.
english: The lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counselor, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.

kikuyu: Ixaan Karra gama kibbaa Oobeed Edoomiif, kan mankuusaa immoo ilmaan isaatiif baʼe.
english: To Obed-Edom southward; and to his sons the storehouse.

kikuyu: Ixaan Karra Lixa biiftuutii fi Karra Shaleekeet kan daandii olii irratti argamu Shufiimii fi Hoosaaf baʼe.
english: To Shuppim and Hosah westward, by the gate of Shallecheth, at the causeway that goes up, watchman opposite watchman.

kikuyu: Karaa baʼa biiftuutiin guyyaa guyyaatti Lewwota jaʼa, karaa kaabaatiin guyyaa guyyaatti afur, karaa kibbaatiin guyyaa guyyaatti afur karaa mankuusaa immoo yeroo tokkotti lamatu ture.
english: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and for the storehouse two and two.

kikuyu: Oobdii gama lixa biiftuutiin jiruuf daandii irra afur, waltajjicha gubbaa immoo lamatu ture.
english: For Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen garee eegdota karraa kanneen ilmaan Qooraahiitii fi Meraarii keessaa dhufanii dha.
english: These were the divisions of the doorkeepers; of the sons of the Korahites, and of the sons of Merari.

kikuyu: Lewwota keessaa Ahiiyaan itti gaafatamaa qabeenya mana Waaqaatii fi itti gaafatamaa miʼoota qulqulleeffamanii ture.
english: Of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of God’s house and over the treasures of the dedicated things.

kikuyu: Sanyiiwwan Laʼadaan kanneen karaa Laʼadaaniitiin Geershoonota taʼan warri hangafoota maatii Laʼadaan namicha gosa Geershoon sanaa turan: Yehiiʼeelii,
english: The sons of Ladan, the sons of the Gershonites belonging to Ladan, the heads of the fathers’ households belonging to Ladan the Gershonite: Jehieli.

kikuyu: ilmaan Yehiiʼeelii, Zeetaamii fi obboleessa isaa Yooʼeel. Isaan kunis itti gaafatamtoota qabeenya mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyoo turan.
english: The sons of Jehieli: Zetham, and Joel his brother, over the treasures of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Amraamota keessaa, Yizihaarota keessaa, Kebroonota keessaa, Uziiʼeel keessaa:
english: Of the Amramites, of the Izharites, of the Hebronites, of the Uzzielites:

kikuyu: Shebuuʼeel ilmi Geershoom ilma Musee sanaa itti gaafatamaa qabeenyaa hangafa ture.
english: Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasuries.

kikuyu: Namoonni karaa Eliiʼezeriitiin firoota isaa taʼan immoo: ilma isaa Rehaabiyaa, ilma isaa Isaayyaas, ilma isaa Yooraam, ilma isaa Zikrii fi ilma isaa Sheloomiit.
english: His brothers: of Eliezer, Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomoth his son.

kikuyu: Sheloomiitii fi firoonni isaa mankuusaa miʼoota Daawit mootichi, hangafoonni maatiiwwanii kanneen ajajjuuwwan kumaatii fi ajajjuuwwan dhibbaa turan, akkasumas ajajjoonni loltootaa biraa Waaqaaf addaan baasan irratti itti gaafatamtoota turan.
english: This Shelomoth and his brothers were over all the treasuries of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the heads of the fathers’ households, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the army, had dedicated.

kikuyu: Isaan boojuu waraanaan argame keessaa gara tokko haaromsuu mana qulqullummaa Waaqayyootiif addaan baasanii kennan.
english: They dedicated some of the plunder won in battles to repair the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Waan Saamuʼeel namichi mulʼata argu sun, Saaʼol ilmi Qiish, Abneer ilmi Neerii fi Yooʼaab ilmi Zeruuyaa dhiʼeessanii fi waan Waaqaaf addaan baafame hunda Sheloomiitii fi firoota isaatu eega ture.
english: All that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated, whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the hand of Shelomoth and of his brothers.

kikuyu: Yizihaarota keessaa: Kenaaniyaa fi ilmaan isaa hojii mana qulqullummaatiin ala taʼetti Israaʼeloota irratti qondaaltotaa fi abbootii murtii taʼanii ramadaman.
english: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were appointed to the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.

kikuyu: Kebroonota keessaa: Hashabiyaa fi firoonni isaa kanneen dandeettii qaban kuma tokkoo fi dhibba torba biyya Israaʼel kan Yordaanosiin gama lixa biiftuu jirutti hojii Waaqayyoo hundaa fi tajaajila mootichaa irratti itti gaafatamtoota turan.
english: Of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, one thousand seven hundred men of valor, had the oversight of Israel beyond the Jordan westward, for all the business of the LORD and for the service of the king.

kikuyu: Kebroonota keessaa akkuma galmee hiddaa dhaloota maatii isaaniitti Yeriyaan hangafa isaanii ture. Bara mootummaa Daawit keessa waggaa afurtamaffaatti galmeewwan ilaalamanii gosa Kebroon keessaa namoonni dandeettii qaban Yaʼizeer biyya Giliʼaadi keessaa sanatti argaman.
english: Of the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief of the Hebronites, according to their generations by fathers’ households. They were sought for in the fortieth year of the reign of David, and mighty men of valor were found among them at Jazer of Gilead.

kikuyu: Yiriiyaan firoota dandeettii qaban kanneen hangafoota maatii turan kuma lamaa fi dhibba torba qaba ture; Daawit mootichis waan kan Waaqaa taʼeef dhimma mootichaa hunda irratti gosa Ruubeen gosa Gaadii fi walakkaa gosa Minaasee toʼattoota godhe.
english: His relatives, men of valor, were two thousand seven hundred, heads of fathers’ households, whom King David made overseers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of the Manassites, for every matter pertaining to God and for the affairs of the king.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi ijoollee Israaʼel hangafoonni maatii isaanii, ajajjuuwwan kumaa, ajajjuuwwan dhibbaatii fi qondaaltonni isaanii warri waan kutaawwan loltootaa kanneen waggaa guutuu jiʼa jiʼaan hojiitti ramadaman sanaa ilaalu hunda irratti mooticha tajaajilan kanaa dha. Tokkoon tokkoon kutaawwan loltootaa kunis nama 24,000 of keessaa qaba ture.
english: Now the children of Israel after their number, the heads of fathers’ households and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year—of every division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Jiʼa jalqabaatiif ajajaan kutaa loltootaa kan duraa Yaashobiʼaam ilma Zabdiiʼeel ture. Kutaa loltoota isaa keessas loltoota 24,000 ture.
english: Over the first division for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Innis sanyii Faaresii fi hangafa ajajjoota kutaa loltoota hundaa kan jiʼa jalqabaa ture.
english: He was of the children of Perez, the chief of all the captains of the army for the first month.

kikuyu: Doodaayi namichi Ahooʼaa ajaja kutaa waraanaa kan jiʼa lammaffaaf ture; Miiqlooti hoogganaa kutaa waraana isaa ture. Kutaan waraana isaas namoota 24,000 of keessaa qaba ture.
english: Over the division of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite and his division, and Mikloth the ruler; and in his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Ajajaan kutaa waraanaa sadaffaan kan jiʼa sadaffaa immoo Benaayaa ilma Yehooyaadaa lubichaa ture. Innis hangafa; kutaan waraana isaa namoota 24,000 of keessaa qaba ture.
english: The third captain of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada the chief priest. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Benaayaa kun isuma warra soddoma keessaa nama jabaa fi ajajaa warra soddoma sanaa ture sanaa dha. Amiizaabaad ilmi isaa immoo ajajaa kutaa waraana isaa ture.
english: This is that Benaiah who was the mighty man of the thirty and over the thirty. Of his division was Ammizabad his son.

kikuyu: Jiʼa afuraffaaf ajajaan kuta afuraffaa Asaaheel obboleessa Yooʼaab ture; kan iddoo isaa buʼe immoo ilma isaa Zebaadiyaa dha. Kutaa isaa keessa namoota 24,000 turan.
english: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Jiʼa shanaffaaf ajajaan kutaa shanaffaa Shamhuuti namicha Yizraa ture. Kutaa isaa keessa namoota 24,000 turan.
english: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Jiʼa jaʼaffaaf Iiraa ilmi Iqeesh namicha Teqooʼaa sanaa ajajaa jaʼaffaa ture. Kutaa isaa keessa namoota 24,000 turan.
english: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Jiʼa torbaffaaf Heleez namichi Pheloonaa kan gosa Efreem sun ajajaa torbaffaa ture. Kutaa isaa keessa namoota 24,000 turan.
english: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Jiʼa saddeettaffaaf Siibekaay namichi biyya Hushaa kan gosa Zaarotaa ajajaa saddeettaffaa ture; kutaa isaa keessa namoota 24,000 turan.
english: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Jiʼa saglaffaaf Abiiʼezer namicha Anaatootii kan gosa Beniyaam sanattu ajajaa saglaffaa ture; kutaa isaa keessaa namoota 24,000 turan.
english: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anathothite, of the Benjamites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Jiʼa kurnaffaaf Maharaayi namicha Netoof kan gosa Zaaraa sanatu ajajaa kurnaffaa ture. Kutaa isaa keessa namoota 24,000 turan.
english: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zerahites. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Jiʼa kudha tokkoffaaf ajajaan kudha tokkoffaan Benaayaa namicha Phiraatoon kan gosa Efreem sana ture. Kutaa isaa keessa namoota 24,000 turan.
english: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Jiʼa kudha lammaffaaf ajajaan kudha lammaffaan Heldaayi namicha Netoof kan gosa Otniiʼeel sana ture. Kutaa isaa keessa namoota 24,000 turan.
english: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel. In his division were twenty-four thousand.

kikuyu: Hangafoonni gosoota Israaʼel: Gosa Ruubeen irratti: Eliiʼezer ilma Zikrii; gosa Simiʼoon irratti: Shefaaxiyaa ilma Maʼakaa;
english: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: of the Reubenites, Eliezer the son of Zichri was the ruler; of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maacah;

kikuyu: gosa Lewwii irratti: Hashabiyaa ilma Qemuuʼeel; gosa Aroon irratti: Zaadoq;
english: of Levi, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel; of Aaron, Zadok;

kikuyu: gosa Yihuudaa irratti: Eliihuu obboleessa Daawit; gosa Yisaakor irratti: Omrii ilma Miikaaʼel;
english: of Judah, Elihu, one of the brothers of David; of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael;
