english: Then Haman went out that day joyful and glad of heart, but when Haman saw Mordecai in the king’s gate, that he didn’t stand up nor move for him, he was filled with wrath against Mordecai.

kikuyu: Taʼu illee Haamaan of qabee mana isaatti gale. Ergasiis michoota isaatii fi niitii isaa Zeresh walitti qabe;
english: Nevertheless Haman restrained himself, and went home. There, he sent and called for his friends and Zeresh his wife.

kikuyu: Haamaanis qabeenya isaa guddaa sanaan, ilmaan isaa hedduu sanaan akkasumas ulfina mootichi isaaf kenne hundaa fi akkaataa itti mootichi qondaaltota isaatii fi tajaajiltoota isaa kaanii olitti isa guddiseen isaanitti of jaje.
english: Haman recounted to them the glory of his riches, the multitude of his children, all the things in which the king had promoted him, and how he had advanced him above the princes and servants of the king.

kikuyu: Haamaan itti fufee akkana jedhe; “Kana qofa miti; namni Asteer Mootittiin akka mooticha wajjin gara cidha qopheessite sanaa dhufu waamte anuma qofa. Boris akkasuma mooticha wajjin na affeerteerti.
english: Haman also said, “Yes, Esther the queen let no man come in with the king to the banquet that she had prepared but myself; and tomorrow I am also invited by her together with the king.

kikuyu: Taʼus wanni kun hundinuu utuu ani Mordekaayi Yihuudicha isaa karra mootichaa dura taaʼu arguu na hin gammachiisu.”
english: Yet all this avails me nothing, so long as I see Mordecai the Jew sitting at the king’s gate.”

kikuyu: Niitiin isaa Zeresh fi michoonni isaa hundinuu, “Muka itti nama fannisan kan dhundhuma shantama ol dheeratu dhaabiitii akka Mordekaayi bor ganama irratti fannifamu mooticha gaafadhu. Ergasiis mooticha wajjin gara cidha sanaa dhaqii gammadi” jedhaniin. Yaadni kun Haamaanin gammachiise; innis muka sana dhaabe.
english: Then Zeresh his wife and all his friends said to him, “Let a gallows be made fifty cubits high, and in the morning speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on it. Then go in merrily with the king to the banquet.” This pleased Haman, so he had the gallows made.

kikuyu: Halkan sana mootichi rafuu hin dandeenye; kanaafuu inni akka isaan kitaaba seenaa kan waaʼee mootummaa isaa barreeffame isaaf dubbisan ni ajaje.
english: On that night, the king couldn’t sleep. He commanded the book of records of the chronicles to be brought, and they were read to the king.

kikuyu: Kitaaba sana keessattis Mordekaayi akka Bigtaanaa fi Tereshi xuʼaashiiwwan balbala eegan kanneen Ahashweroos Mooticha ajjeesuuf mariʼatan sana lamaan saaxilee ture barreeffamee argame.
english: It was found written that Mordecai had told of Bigthana and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs, who were doorkeepers, who had tried to lay hands on the King Ahasuerus.

kikuyu: Mootichis, “Yoos Mordekaayi sababii waan kanaatiif ulfina yookaan kabaja maalii argate ree?” jedhee gaafate. Tajaajiltoonni isaa immoo, “Wanni tokko iyyuu hin godhamneef” jedhanii deebisan.
english: The king said, “What honor and dignity has been given to Mordecai for this?” Then the king’s servants who attended him said, “Nothing has been done for him.”

kikuyu: Mootichis, “Eenyutu oobdii kana keessa jira?” jedhee gaafate. Yeroo sana Haamaan waaʼee Mordekaayiin muka dhaabe sana irratti fannisuu mootichatti himuuf jedhee oobdii masaraa mootummaa isa gara alaa seenee ture.
english: The king said, “Who is in the court?” Now Haman had come into the outer court of the king’s house, to speak to the king about hanging Mordecai on the gallows that he had prepared for him.

kikuyu: Tajaajiltoonni mootichaa, “Haamaanitu oobdii keessa dhaabatee jira” jedhanii deebisan. Mootichis, “Isa ol galchaa” jedhee ajaje.
english: The king’s servants said to him, “Behold, Haman stands in the court.” The king said, “Let him come in.”

kikuyu: Mootichis yeroo Haamaan ol galetti, “Nama mootichi kabajuu barbaaduuf maaltu godhamuufii qaba?” jedhee isa gaafate. Haamaanis, “Namni mootichi na caalchisee kabaju eenyu?” jedhee ofi keessatti yaade.
english: So Haman came in. The king said to him, “What shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor?” Now Haman said in his heart, “Who would the king delight to honor more than myself?”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Haamaan akkana jedhee mootichaaf deebise; “Nama mootichi kabajuu jaallatuuf,
english: Haman said to the king, “For the man whom the king delights to honor,

kikuyu: uffata mootummaa kan mootichi uffatuu fi farda mootummaa kan mootichi yaabbatu haa fidan; fardi gonfoon mootii mataatti kaaʼameef haa dhufuuf.
english: let royal clothing be brought which the king uses to wear, and the horse that the king rides on, and on the head of which a royal crown is set.

kikuyu: Ergasii uffannii fi fardi sun qondaaltota mootichaa kanneen qondaaltota hunda caalaa beekamoo taʼan keessaa isa tokkotti imaanaan haa kennamuuf; isaan immoo nama mootichi ulfina kennuufii barbaadu sanatti uffata sana haa uffisan; farda yaabbachiisaniis, ‘Wanni nama mootichi ulfina kennuufii barbaaduuf godhamu kana!’ jedhanii labsaa daandiiwwan magaalattii irra fuula isaa dura haa deeman.”
english: Let the clothing and the horse be delivered to the hand of one of the king’s most noble princes, that they may array the man whom the king delights to honor with them, and have him ride on horseback through the city square, and proclaim before him, ‘Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!’”

kikuyu: Mootichis akkana jedhee Haamaanin ajaje; “Dafii dhaqii uffataa fi farda sana fuudhiitii akkuma jette sana Mordekaayi Yihuudicha karra mootii dura taaʼu sanaaf godhi. Waan jette sana keessaa tokko illee hin hambisin.”
english: Then the king said to Haman, “Hurry and take the clothing and the horse, as you have said, and do this for Mordecai the Jew, who sits at the king’s gate. Let nothing fail of all that you have spoken.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Haamaan dhaqee uffataa fi farda sana fuudhe. Innis uffata sana Mordekaayiitti uffisee fardas yaabbachiisee, “Wanni nama mootichi ulfina kennuufii barbaaduuf godhamu kanaa dha!” jedhee labsaa daandii magaalaa irra fuula isaa dura deeme.
english: Then Haman took the clothing and the horse, and arrayed Mordecai, and had him ride through the city square, and proclaimed before him, “Thus it shall be done to the man whom the king delights to honor!”

kikuyu: Ergasii Mordekaayi gara karra mootichaatti deebiʼe. Haamaan garuu gaddaan mataa haguuggatee ariitiidhaan manatti gale;
english: Mordecai came back to the king’s gate, but Haman hurried to his house, mourning and having his head covered.

kikuyu: waan isa irra gaʼe hundas niitii isaa Zeresh fi michoota isaa hundatti hime. Gorsitoonni isaatii fi niitiin isaa Zosaaraan, “Sababii Mordekaayi inni kufaatiin kee fuula isaa duratti jalqabe sun sanyii Yihuudaa taʼeef ati isaan mormuu hin dandeessu; ati dhugumaan ni badda!” jedhaniin.
english: Haman recounted to Zeresh his wife and all his friends everything that had happened to him. Then his wise men and Zeresh his wife said to him, “If Mordecai, before whom you have begun to fall, is of Jewish descent, you will not prevail against him, but you will surely fall before him.”

kikuyu: Utuma isaan isa wajjin dubbachaa jiranuu xuʼaashiiwwan mootichaa dhufanii gara cidha Asteer qopheessitee turte sanaatti Haamaan ariifachiisan.
english: While they were yet talking with him, the king’s eunuchs came, and hurried to bring Haman to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

kikuyu: Mootichii fi Haamaan gara cidha Asteer Mootittiin qopheessite sanaa dhaqan;
english: So the king and Haman came to banquet with Esther the queen.

kikuyu: utuma guyyaa lammaffaa sanatti daadhii wayinii dhugaa jiranuu, mootichi akkana jedhee gaafate; “Yaa Asteer Mootittii wanni ati kadhattu maal? Wanni sun siif kennama. Gaaffiin kee maal? Walakkaa mootummaa koo illee taanaan wanni ati gaafattu siif kennama.”
english: The king said again to Esther on the second day at the banquet of wine, “What is your petition, queen Esther? It shall be granted you. What is your request? Even to the half of the kingdom it shall be performed.”

kikuyu: Asteer Mootittiin akkana jettee deebifte; “Yaa mooticha, yoo ani fuula kee duratti fudhatama argadhee jiraadhe, yoo wanni kunis mooticha gammachiise, lubbuu koo naaf oolchi; kadhaan koo kanuma. Saba koo illee naaf baraar; gaaffiin koos kanuma.
english: Then Esther the queen answered, “If I have found favor in your sight, O king, and if it pleases the king, let my life be given me at my petition, and my people at my request.

kikuyu: Anii fi sabni koo ajjeefamuutti, barbadeeffamuu fi lafa irraa balleeffamuutti gurguramneerraatii. Nu utuu dhiiraa fi dubartiin garbummaa qofatti gurguramne taʼee, ani silaa nan calʼisan ture; rakkinni akkasii mooticha jeequuf sababii gaʼaa mitiitii.”
english: For we are sold, I and my people, to be destroyed, to be slain, and to perish. But if we had been sold for male and female slaves, I would have held my peace, although the adversary could not have compensated for the king’s loss.”

kikuyu: Ahashweroos Mootichis, “Inni eenyuu? Namni waan akkasii gochuuf ija jabaate sun eessa jira?” jedhee Asteer Mootittii gaafate.
english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen, “Who is he, and where is he who dared presume in his heart to do so?”

kikuyu: Asteer immoo, “Amajaajii fi diinni sun Haamaan namichuma jalʼaa kanaa dha” jette. Kana irratti Hamaan fuula mootichaatii fi mootittii duratti akka malee rifate.
english: Esther said, “An adversary and an enemy, even this wicked Haman!” Then Haman was afraid before the king and the queen.

kikuyu: Mootichis aaree kaʼee daadhii wayinii isaa dhiisee gad baʼee iddoo biqiltuu masaraa mootummaa seene. Haamaan garuu akka mootichi isa balleessuudhaaf kutate beekkatee lubbuu ofii oolfachuudhaaf Asteer Mootittii kadhachuudhaaf duubatti hafe.
english: The king arose in his wrath from the banquet of wine and went into the palace garden. Haman stood up to make request for his life to Esther the queen, for he saw that there was evil determined against him by the king.

kikuyu: Yeroo mootichi iddoo biqiltuu masaraa mootummaatii gara galma cidhaatti deebiʼetti Haamaan siree Asteer itti irkattee turte irratti gombifamee ture. Mootichis, “Inni inumaa iyyuu manuma koo keessatti utuma isheen na wajjin jirtuu ishee qabataa?” jedhee dubbate. Akkuma dubbiin kun afaan mootichaatii baʼeen isaan fuula Haamaan haguugan.
english: Then the king returned out of the palace garden into the place of the banquet of wine; and Haman had fallen on the couch where Esther was. Then the king said, “Will he even assault the queen in front of me in the house?” As the word went out of the king’s mouth, they covered Haman’s face.

kikuyu: Ergasiis xuʼaashiiwwan mooticha tajaajilan keessaa Harboonaan akkana jedhe; “Mukni dhundhuma shantama ol dheeratu tokko mana Haamaa bira dhaabameera. Muka kanas Haamaanitu Mordekaayi isa mooticha gargaaruudhaaf dubbate sana itti fannisuudhaaf dhaabe.” Mootichis, “Achi irratti isa fannisaa!” jedhe.
english: Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs who were with the king, said, “Behold, the gallows fifty cubits high, which Haman has made for Mordecai, who spoke good for the king, is standing at Haman’s house.” The king said, “Hang him on it!”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isaan muka inni Mordekaayiif qopheesse sana irratti Haamaanin fannisan. Ergasiis aariin mootichaa ni qabbanaaʼe.
english: So they hanged Haman on the gallows that he had prepared for Mordecai. Then the king’s wrath was pacified.

kikuyu: Gaafuma sana Ahashweroos Mootichi qabeenya Haamaan isa diina Yihuudootaa ture sanaa Asteer Mootittiif kenne. Asteer akka inni fira ishee taʼe waan mootichatti himtee turteef Mordekaayi fuula mootichaa duratti dhiʼaate.
english: On that day, King Ahasuerus gave the house of Haman, the Jews’ enemy, to Esther the queen. Mordecai came before the king; for Esther had told what he was to her.

kikuyu: Mootichis qubeelaa chaappaa isaa kan Haamaan irraa deebisee fudhate sana ofi irraa baasee Mordekaayiif kenne. Asteeris qabeenya Haamaan irratti Mordekaayiin muudde.
english: The king took off his ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai. Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman.

kikuyu: Asteer miilla isaa irratti kuftee booʼaa ammas mooticha kadhatte. Isheenis akka inni karoora jalʼaa kan Haamaan namichi biyya Agaag sun Yihuudootatti baase sana fashaleessuuf isa kadhatte.
english: Esther spoke yet again before the king, and fell down at his feet and begged him with tears to put away the mischief of Haman the Agagite, and his plan that he had planned against the Jews.

kikuyu: Mootichis bokkuu warqee Asteeriif diriirsinaan isheen kaatee fuula isaa dura dhaabatte.
english: Then the king held out to Esther the golden scepter. So Esther arose, and stood before the king.

kikuyu: Isheen akkana jette; “Yoo wanni kun mooticha gammachiise, yoo ani fuula mootichaa duratti surraa argadhee jiraadhe, yoo wanni kun qajeelaa isatti fakkaatee fi yoo inni natti gammade, xalayaa Haamaan ilmi Hamedaataa namichi biyya Agaag sun Yihuudoota kutaalee biyyaa mootichaa hunda keessa jiraatan balleessuudhaaf barreesse sana fashaleessuuf ajajni haa barreeffamu.
english: She said, “If it pleases the king, and if I have found favor in his sight, and the thing seems right to the king, and I am pleasing in his eyes, let it be written to reverse the letters devised by Haman, the son of Hammedatha the Agagite, which he wrote to destroy the Jews who are in all the king’s provinces.

kikuyu: Ani utuun balaa saba koo irra gaʼu arguu akkamittin obsuu dandaʼa? Akkamittis badiisa maatii koo argee obsuu dandaʼa?”
english: For how can I endure to see the evil that would come to my people? How can I endure to see the destruction of my relatives?”

kikuyu: Ahashweroos Mootichis akkana jedhee Asteer Mootittii fi Mordekaayi Yihuudichaaf deebii kenne; “Sababii Haamaan Yihuudoota miidheef ani qabeenya isaa Asteeriif kenneera; isaanis muka irratti isa fannisaniiru.
english: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen and to Mordecai the Jew, “See, I have given Esther the house of Haman, and they have hanged him on the gallows because he laid his hand on the Jews.

kikuyu: Sababii labsiin maqaa mootichaatiin barreeffamee chaappaan qubeelaa mootichaa itti godhame diigamuu hin dandeenyeef isin akkuma jaallattanitti waan Yihuudoota ilaalu maqaa mootichaatiin barreessaatii chaappaa qubeelaa mootichaa itti chaappessaa.”
english: Write also to the Jews as it pleases you, in the king’s name, and seal it with the king’s ring; for the writing which is written in the king’s name, and sealed with the king’s ring, may not be reversed by any man.”

kikuyu: Barreessitoonni mootichaas yommusuma bultii digdamii sadaffaa jiʼa sadaffaatti jiʼa Siiwaan jedhamu keessa walitti waamaman. Isaanis ajaja Mordekaayi hunda gara Yihuudoota, ergamoota, bulchitootaa fi namoota bebeekamoo kutaalee biyyaa 127 kanneen biyya Hindiitii hamma Itoophiyaatti jiraatanitti barreessanii ergan. Ajajni kunis arfii tokkoo tokkoo kutaalee biyyaatiin, afaan tokkoo tokkoo sabaatiin akkasumas Yihuudootatti arfii fi afaanuma ofii isaaniitiin barreeffame.
english: Then the king’s scribes were called at that time, in the third month, which is the month Sivan, on the twenty-third day of the month; and it was written according to all that Mordecai commanded to the Jews, and to the local governors, and the governors and princes of the provinces which are from India to Ethiopia, one hundred twenty-seven provinces, to every province according to its writing, and to every people in their language, and to the Jews in their writing, and in their language.

kikuyu: Mordekaayis maqaa Ahashweroos Mootichaatiin xalayoota barreessee chaappaa qubeelaa mootichaa itti chaappesse; xalayoota sanas abbootii fardaa kanneen fardeen mootichaaf leenjifaman keessaa collee taʼan yaabbatanitti erge.
english: He wrote in the name of King Ahasuerus, and sealed it with the king’s ring, and sent letters by courier on horseback, riding on royal horses that were bred from swift steeds.

kikuyu: Labsiin mootichaa akka Yihuudoonni magaalaawwan hunda keessa jiraatan walitti qabaman, akka of eeganii fi akka isaan humna waraana saba kamii iyyuu yookaan biyya kamii iyyuu kan isaan, dubartoota isaaniitii fi ijoollee isaanii miidhu akka ajjeesan, akka barbadeessanii fi lafa irraa balleessan akkasumas akka qabeenya diinota isaanii saaman mirga kenneef.
english: In those letters, the king granted the Jews who were in every city to gather themselves together and to defend their lives—to destroy, to kill, and to cause to perish all the power of the people and province that would assault them, their little ones and women, and to plunder their possessions,

kikuyu: Guyyaan akka Yihuudoonni kutaalee biyya Ahashweroos Mootichaa hunda keessatti waan kana godhan murtaaʼeefis bultii kudha sadaffaa jiʼa kudha lammaffaa, jiʼa Adaar jedhamu keessa ture.
english: on one day in all the provinces of King Ahasuerus, on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month Adar.

kikuyu: Garagalchi labsii sanaas kutaalee biyyaa hunda keessatti akka seeraatti raabsamee sabni hundi beekuu qaba ture; kunis akka Yihuudoonnis diinota isaanii haaloo baʼuuf gaafasitti qophaaʼaniif.
english: A copy of the letter, that the decree should be given out in every province, was published to all the peoples, that the Jews should be ready for that day to avenge themselves on their enemies.

kikuyu: Ergamoonni fardeen mootichaa yaabbatan sunis ajaja mootichaatiin ariifatanii gulufaa deeman. Labsiin sunis gamoo Suusaa keessatti labsame.
english: So the couriers who rode on royal horses went out, hastened and pressed on by the king’s commandment. The decree was given out in the citadel of Susa.

kikuyu: Mordekaayis uffata mootii kan bifa cuquliisaatii fi adii uffatee, gonfoo warqee guddaa isaa kaaʼatee wayyaa quncee talbaa irraa hojjetame dhiilgee irraan uffatee fuula mootichaa duraa baʼe. Magaalaan Suusaas gammaddee ililchite.
english: Mordecai went out of the presence of the king in royal clothing of blue and white, and with a great crown of gold, and with a robe of fine linen and purple; and the city of Susa shouted and was glad.

kikuyu: Yeroon sun Yihuudootaaf ifa, gammachuu, ilillee fi yeroo ulfinaa ture.
english: The Jews had light, gladness, joy, and honor.

kikuyu: Kutaalee biyyaatii fi magaalaawwan hunda keessatti, lafa labsiin mootichaa gaʼe hundatti Yihuudoonni ilillee fi gammachuudhaan, nyaataa fi dhugaatiidhaan ni ayyaaneffatan. Namoonni gosa kaanii hedduun sababii Yihuudoota sodaataniif Yihuudoota taʼan.
english: In every province and in every city, wherever the king’s commandment and his decree came, the Jews had gladness, joy, a feast and a holiday. Many from among the peoples of the land became Jews, for the fear of the Jews had fallen on them.

kikuyu: Bultii kudha sadaffaa jiʼa kudha lammaffaatti, jiʼa Adaar keessa labsiin mootichi ajaje sun hojii irra ooluu qaba ture. Guyyaa kanatti diinonni Yihuudootaa isaan moʼachuu abdatanii turan; amma garuu dubbiin garagalee Yihuudoonni warra isaan jibban sana irratti ol aantummaa argatan.
english: Now in the twelfth month, which is the month Adar, on the thirteenth day of the month, when the king’s commandment and his decree came near to be put in execution, on the day that the enemies of the Jews hoped to conquer them, (but it turned out that the opposite happened, that the Jews conquered those who hated them),

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis warra badiisa isaanii hawwaa turan sana balleessuudhaaf magaalaawwan ofii isaanii kanneen kutaa biyyaa Ahashweroos Mootichaa hunda keessatti argamanitti walitti qabaman. Sababii namoonni saba kaanii hundinuu Yihuudoota sodaataniif namni tokko iyyuu fuula isaanii dura dhaabachuu hin dandeenye.
english: the Jews gathered themselves together in their cities throughout all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, to lay hands on those who wanted to harm them. No one could withstand them, because the fear of them had fallen on all the people.

kikuyu: Namoonni bebeekamoon kutaalee biyyaa hundi, ergamoonni, bulchitoonnii fi qondaaltonni mootichaa sababii Mordekaayiin sodaataniif Yihuudoota gargaaran.
english: All the princes of the provinces, the local governors, the governors, and those who did the king’s business helped the Jews, because the fear of Mordecai had fallen on them.

kikuyu: Mordekaayi masaraa mootummaa keessatti beekamaa ture; waaʼeen isaa kutaalee biyyaa guutuu gaʼe; innis akka malee jabaachaa deeme.
english: For Mordecai was great in the king’s house, and his fame went out throughout all the provinces, for the man Mordecai grew greater and greater.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonni diinota isaanii hunda goraadeedhaan cicciranii ajjeesuudhaan barbadeessanii warra isaan jibbanis akkuma barbaadan godhan.
english: The Jews struck all their enemies with the stroke of the sword, and with slaughter and destruction, and did what they wanted to those who hated them.

kikuyu: Gamoo Suusaa keessattis Yihuudoonni nama dhibba shan qalanii fixan.
english: In the citadel of Susa, the Jews killed and destroyed five hundred men.

kikuyu: Amma illee Paarshandaataa, Dalfoon, Asfaataa,
english: They killed Parshandatha, Dalphon, Aspatha,

kikuyu: Phooraataa, Adaliyaa, Ariidaataa,
english: Poratha, Adalia, Aridatha,

kikuyu: Paarmaashitaa, Ariisayi, Ariidayii fi Wayizaataa ajjeesan;
english: Parmashta, Arisai, Aridai, and Vaizatha,

kikuyu: isaan kunneen ilmaan Haamaan ilma Hamedaataa namicha diina Yihuudootaa ture sanaa kurnanii dha. Yihuudoonni garuu boojuu tokko illee hin tuqne.
english: the ten sons of Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Jews’ enemy, but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

kikuyu: Baayʼinni namoota gamoo Suusaa keessatti ajjeefamaniis guyyuma sana mootichatti himame.
english: On that day, the number of those who were slain in the citadel of Susa was brought before the king.

kikuyu: Mootichis Asteer Mootittiidhaan akkana jedhe; “Yihuudoonni namoota dhibba shanii fi ilmaan Haamaan kurnan gamoo Suusaa keessatti ajjeesanii balleessaniiru. Kutaalee biyyaa mootichaa kanneen hafan keessatti maal godhan laata? Amma wanni ati kadhattu maali? Wanni sun siif kennama. Gaaffiin kee maali? Wanni sunis siif guutama.”
english: The king said to Esther the queen, “The Jews have slain and destroyed five hundred men in the citadel of Susa, including the ten sons of Haman; what then have they done in the rest of the king’s provinces! Now what is your petition? It shall be granted you. What is your further request? It shall be done.”

kikuyu: Asteeris akkana jettee deebifte; “Yoo wanni kun mooticha gammachiise akka Yihuudoonni Suusaa keessa jiran labsii harʼaa kana bori illee hojii irra oolchaniif eeyyama kennaniif; ilmaan Haamaan kurnanis muka irratti haa fannifaman.”
english: Then Esther said, “If it pleases the king, let it be granted to the Jews who are in Susa to do tomorrow also according to today’s decree, and let Haman’s ten sons be hanged on the gallows.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu mootichi akka wanni kun raawwatamu ajaje. Labsiin tokko Suusaa keessatti labsame; isaanis ilmaan Haamaan kurnan fannisan.
english: The king commanded this to be done. A decree was given out in Susa; and they hanged Haman’s ten sons.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonni Suusaa keessa jiraatan bultii kudha afuraffaa jiʼa Adaaritti walitti qabamanii nama dhibba sadii Suusaa keessatti fixan; garuu boojuu tokko illee hin tuqne.
english: The Jews who were in Susa gathered themselves together on the fourteenth day also of the month Adar, and killed three hundred men in Susa; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

kikuyu: Yeroo kanatti Yihuudoonni kutaalee biyya mootichaa keessatti hafan kaanis mataa isaanii eeguu fi diinota isaanii irraa boqochuuf jedhanii walitti qabaman. Isaanis jara keessaa nama kuma torbaatamii shan fixan; garuu boojuu tokko illee hin tuqne.
english: The other Jews who were in the king’s provinces gathered themselves together, defended their lives, had rest from their enemies, and killed seventy-five thousand of those who hated them; but they didn’t lay their hand on the plunder.

kikuyu: Wanni kunis bultii kudha sadaffaa jiʼa Adaar keessa taʼe; guyyaa kudha afuraffaatti immoo boqotanii guyyaa sana guyyaa cidhaa fi gammachuu godhatan.
english: This was done on the thirteenth day of the month Adar; and on the fourteenth day of that month they rested and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

kikuyu: Taʼus Yihuudoonni Suusaa keessa jiraatan guyyaa kudha sadaffaa fi kudha afuraffaatti walitti qabaman; ergasii immoo guyyaa kudha shanaffaatti boqotanii guyyaa sana guyyaa cidhaa fi gammachuu godhatan.
english: But the Jews who were in Susa assembled together on the thirteenth and on the fourteenth days of the month; and on the fifteenth day of that month, they rested, and made it a day of feasting and gladness.

kikuyu: Sababiin Yihuudoonni baadiyyaa kanneen gandoota keessa jiraatan guyyaa kudha afuraffaa jiʼa Adaar akka guyyaa cidhaa fi gammachuutti, akka guyyaa itti kennaa waliif kennaniittis ayyaaneffataniif kanuma.
english: Therefore the Jews of the villages, who live in the unwalled towns, make the fourteenth day of the month Adar a day of gladness and feasting, a holiday, and a day of sending presents of food to one another.

kikuyu: Mordekaayis wantoota kanneen galmeessee Yihuudoota kutaalee biyya Ahashweroos Mootichaa keessa dhiʼoo fi fagoo jiraatan hundatti xalayoota erge;
english: Mordecai wrote these things, and sent letters to all the Jews who were in all the provinces of the King Ahasuerus, both near and far,

kikuyu: kunis akka isaan waggaa waggaadhaan guyyaa kudha afuraffaa fi kudha shanaffaa jiʼa Adaar
english: to enjoin them that they should keep the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month Adar yearly,

kikuyu: akkuma yeroo itti Yihuudoonni diinota isaanii irraa boqonnaa argataniittii fi akka jiʼa itti gaddi isaanii gara gammachuutti, booʼichi isaanii immoo gara kolfaatti geeddarameetti ayyaaneffataniif. Innis akka isaan guyyoota sana akka guyyoota cidhaa fi gammachuutti, akka guyyoota itti nyaata waliif kennanii hiyyeeyyiifis kennaa kennaniitti ayyaaneffatanitti isaaniif barreesse.
english: as the days in which the Jews had rest from their enemies, and the month which was turned to them from sorrow to gladness, and from mourning into a holiday; that they should make them days of feasting and gladness, and of sending presents of food to one another, and gifts to the needy.

kikuyu: Akkasiin Yihuudoonni akkuma Mordekaayi isaaniif barreessetti ayyaana ayyaaneffachuu jalqaban sana itti fufuuf walii galan.
english: The Jews accepted the custom that they had begun, as Mordecai had written to them,

kikuyu: Haamaan ilmi Hamedaataa namichi biyya Agaag diinni Yihuudoota hundaa sun Yihuudoota balleessuudhaaf isaanitti yaadee akka isaan badanii fi barbadeeffamaniif ixaa Fuur jedhamu buusee tureetii.
english: because Haman the son of Hammedatha, the Agagite, the enemy of all the Jews, had plotted against the Jews to destroy them, and had cast “Pur”, that is the lot, to consume them and to destroy them;

kikuyu: Yeroo yaadni sun gurra mootichaa buʼetti mootichi akka yaadni jalʼaan kan Hamaan Yihuudootatti yaade sun matuma isaatti deebiʼee innii fi ilmaan isaa muka irratti fannifamaniif barreeffamaan ajaja dabarse.
english: but when this became known to the king, he commanded by letters that his wicked plan, which he had planned against the Jews, should return on his own head, and that he and his sons should be hanged on the gallows.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu guyyoonni sun jecha Fuur jedhamu irraa Furiim jedhamanii moggaafaman. Sababii waan xalayaa kana keessatti barreeffame hundaatii fi sababii waan arganiitii fi waan isaan irra gaʼee tureetiif,
english: Therefore they called these days “Purim”, from the word “Pur.” Therefore because of all the words of this letter, and of that which they had seen concerning this matter, and that which had come to them,

kikuyu: Yihuudoonni akka guyyoonni lamaan kunneen akkuma barreeffamettii fi yeroo murteeffametti utuu addaan hin citin waggaa waggaadhaan ayyaaneffamaniif bartee ofii isaanii, kan sanyiiwwan isaaniitii fi warra isaanitti dabalaman hundaa godhanii dhaabbatan.
english: the Jews established and imposed on themselves, on their descendants, and on all those who joined themselves to them, so that it should not fail that they would keep these two days according to what was written and according to its appointed time every year;

kikuyu: Guyyoonni kunneen dhaloota hunda keessatti, maatii hundaan, kutaalee biyyaa hundaa fi magaalaa hunda keessatti yaadatamuu fi kabajamuu qabu; guyyoonni Furiim kunneen Yihuudootaan kabajamuunis hafuu hin qabu; yaadannoon guyyoota kanneeniis sanyii isaanii keessaa baduu hin qabu.
english: and that these days should be remembered and kept throughout every generation, every family, every province, and every city; and that these days of Purim should not fail from among the Jews, nor their memory perish from their offspring.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Asteer Mootittiin intalli Abiihaayil sun Mordekaayi Yihuudicha wajjin taʼanii xalayaa lammaffaa waaʼee Furiim dubbatu kana mirkaneessuudhaaf aangoo guutuudhaan barreessan.
english: Then Esther the queen, the daughter of Abihail, and Mordecai the Jew wrote with all authority to confirm this second letter of Purim.

kikuyu: Mordekaayis Yihuudoota kutaalee biyyaa 127 kanneen mootummaa Ahashweroos keessa jiraatan hundatti dubbii hawwii nagaatii fi qabbanaa barreessee erge.
english: He sent letters to all the Jews in the hundred twenty-seven provinces of the kingdom of Ahasuerus with words of peace and truth,

kikuyu: Kunis akka guyyoonni Furiim kunneen akkuma Mordekaayi Yihuudichii fi Asteer Mootittiin isaaniif labsanitti, akkuma isaanis ofii isaaniitii fi sanyiiwwan isaaniitiif waaʼee soomaatii fi yeroo booʼicha isaanii ilaalchisee dhaabbatanitti yeroo murtaaʼetti ayyaaneffamuuf.
english: to confirm these days of Purim in their appointed times, as Mordecai the Jew and Esther the queen had decreed, and as they had imposed upon themselves and their descendants in the matter of the fastings and their mourning.

kikuyu: Labsiin Asteeris seera waaʼee Furiim kana mirkaneesse; wanni kunis galmee keessatti barreeffame.
english: The commandment of Esther confirmed these matters of Purim; and it was written in the book.

kikuyu: Ahashweroos Mootichi hamma qarqara galaanaatti bulchiinsa isaa guutuu irratti gibira buuse.
english: King Ahasuerus laid a tribute on the land and on the islands of the sea.

kikuyu: Hojiin humnaa fi jabina isaa hundinuu, seenaa guddina Mordekaayi kan mootichi itti ol isa guddise guutuu wajjin kitaaba seenaa mootota Meedee fi Faares keessatti barreeffameera mitii?
english: Aren’t all the acts of his power and of his might, and the full account of the greatness of Mordecai, to which the king advanced him, written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Media and Persia?

kikuyu: Mordekaayi Yihuudichi sadarkaadhaan nama Ahashweroos Mootichatti aanu ture; inni sababii uummata isaatiif waan gaarii hojjetee fi sababii nageenya Yihuudoota hundaatiif falmeef obboloota isaa Yihuudoota hedduu biratti ulfina guddaa qaba ture.
english: For Mordecai the Jew was next to King Ahasuerus, and great among the Jews and accepted by the multitude of his brothers, seeking the good of his people and speaking peace to all his descendants.

kikuyu: Biyya Uuzi jedhamu keessa nama Iyyoob jedhamu tokkotu ture. Namichi kunis nama hirʼina hin qabnee fi qajeelaa, nama Waaqa sodaatuu fi hammina irraa fagaate ture.
english: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and turned away from evil.

kikuyu: Innis ilmaan torbaa fi intallan sadii qaba ture;
english: There were born to him seven sons and three daughters.

kikuyu: akkasumas hoolota kuma torba, gaala kuma sadii, qotiyyoo cimdii dhibba shanii fi harroota dhibba shan, tajaajiltoota hedduus qaba ture; innis namoota biyya Baʼa Biiftuu jiraatan hunda keessaa nama guddaa ture.
english: His possessions also were seven thousand sheep, three thousand camels, five hundred yoke of oxen, five hundred female donkeys, and a very great household; so that this man was the greatest of all the children of the east.

kikuyu: Ilmaan isaas mana isaaniitti dabaree dabareedhaan cidha qopheessanii akka isaan wajjin nyaatanii dhuganiif obboleettota isaanii sadan affeeru ture.
english: His sons went and held a feast in the house of each one on his birthday; and they sent and called for their three sisters to eat and to drink with them.

kikuyu: Erga yeroon cidha sanaa raawwatamee booddee Iyyoob itti ergee ijoollee isaa waamsisuudhaan, “Tarii ijoolleen koo cubbuu hojjetanii garaa isaaniittis Waaqa abaaraniiru taʼa” jedhee ganama barii waaʼee tokkoo tokkoo isaaniitiif aarsaa gubamu dhiʼeessuudhaan isaan qulqulleessa ture. Iyyoob yeroo hunda waan kana godha ture.
english: It was so, when the days of their feasting had run their course, that Job sent and sanctified them, and rose up early in the morning, and offered burnt offerings according to the number of them all. For Job said, “It may be that my sons have sinned, and renounced God in their hearts.” Job did so continually.

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko yeroo ergamoonni Waaqayyoo fuula Waaqayyoo duratti dhiʼaachuuf dhufanitti Seexannis isaan wajjin dhufe.
english: Now on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan also came among them.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos seexanaan, “Ati Eessaa dhufte?” jedhe. Seexannis, “Ani lafa hunda irra jooraa, asii fi achis deddeebiʼaa tureen dhufe” jedhee Waaqayyoof deebise.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Seexanaan, “Ati tajaajilaa koo Iyyoobin qalbeeffatteertaa? Namni isa fakkaatu tokko illee lafa irra hin jiru; inni nama hirʼina hin qabnee fi qajeelaa, nama Waaqa sodaatuu fi hammina irraa fagaatee dha” jedhe.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant, Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil.”

kikuyu: Seexanni immoo deebisee akkana jedhe, “Iyyoob akkasumaan Waaqa sodaataa?
english: Then Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Does Job fear God for nothing?

kikuyu: Ati naannoo isaatti, warra mana isaa jiraatanii fi waan kan isaa taʼe hundatti dallaa ijaarteerta mitii? Ati akka bushaayee fi loon isaa biyyicha guutaniif hojii harka isaa eebbifteertaaf.
english: Haven’t you made a hedge around him, and around his house, and around all that he has, on every side? You have blessed the work of his hands, and his substance is increased in the land.

kikuyu: Garuu ati mee harka kee diriirsiitii waan inni qabu hunda dhaʼi; inni dhugumaan ifaan ifatti si abaara.”
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch all that he has, and he will renounce you to your face.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Seexanaan, “Kunoo, wanti inni qabu hundi si harka jira; isa garuu qubaanuu hin tuqin” jedhe. Sana booddee Seexanni fuula Waaqayyoo duraa baʼee deeme.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, all that he has is in your power. Only on himself don’t stretch out your hand.” So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD.

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko utuu ilmaanii fi intallan Iyyoob mana obboleessa isaanii isa hangafaatti nyaachaa, daadhii wayinii dhugaa jiranuu,
english: It fell on a day when his sons and his daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

kikuyu: ergamaan tokko gara Iyyoob dhufee akkana jedhe; “Utuu qotiyyoon qotaa, harroonni immoo naannuma sana dheedaa jiranuu,
english: that a messenger came to Job, and said, “The oxen were plowing, and the donkeys feeding beside them,

kikuyu: namoonni Shebaa balaa buusanii isaan fudhatanii deeman. Tajaajiltootas goraadeedhaan fixan; ana qofatu miliqee sitti himuuf dhufe!”
english: and the Sabeans attacked, and took them away. Yes, they have killed the servants with the edge of the sword, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Utuma inni dubbachaa jiruu ergamaan biraa dhufee, “Ibiddi Waaqaa samiidhaa buʼee hoolotaa fi tajaajiltoota gubee fixe; ana qofatu miliqee sitti himuuf dhufe!” jedhe.
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The fire of God has fallen from the sky, and has burned up the sheep and the servants, and consumed them, and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Utuu inni dubbachaa jiruu ammas ergamaan biraa dhufee, “Kaldoonni garee sadiitti qoodamanii gaalawwan kee irra yaaʼanii isaan oofatanii deeman; tajaajiltootas goraadeedhaan fixan; ana qofatu miliqee sitti himuuf dhufe!” jedhe.
english: While he was still speaking, another also came and said, “The Chaldeans made three bands, and swept down on the camels, and have taken them away, yes, and killed the servants with the edge of the sword; and I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Utuma inni dubbachaa jiruu ergamaan biraa dhufee akkana jedheen; “Ilmaanii fi intallan kee mana obboleessa isaanii isa hangafaatti nyaachaa, daadhii wayinii dhugaa turan;
english: While he was still speaking, there came also another, and said, “Your sons and your daughters were eating and drinking wine in their oldest brother’s house,

kikuyu: yeroo kanattis bubbee hamaan akka tasaa gammoojjiidhaa kaʼee golee mana sanaa afran dhaʼe; manni sunis isaan irratti jigee dhuman; ana qofatu miliqee sitti himuuf dhufe!”
english: and behold, there came a great wind from the wilderness, and struck the four corners of the house, and it fell on the young men, and they are dead. I alone have escaped to tell you.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Iyyoob uffata isaa tarsaasee mataa isaa haaddate. Lafatti gombifamee sagadee
english: Then Job arose, and tore his robe, and shaved his head, and fell down on the ground, and worshiped.

kikuyu: akkana jedhe: “Ani qullaa koon gadameessa haadha kootiitii baʼe; qullaa koos nan deema. Waaqayyotu kenne; Waaqayyotu fudhate; maqaan Waaqayyoo haa eebbifamu.”
english: He said, “Naked I came out of my mother’s womb, and naked will I return there. The LORD gave, and the LORD has taken away. Blessed be the LORD’s name.”

kikuyu: Wantoota kanneen hunda keessatti Iyyoob hojii dogoggoraatiin Waaqa himachuudhaan cubbuu hin hojjenne.
english: In all this, Job didn’t sin, nor charge God with wrongdoing.

kikuyu: Guyyaa biraas ergamoonni Waaqayyoo fuula Waaqayyoo duratti dhiʼaachuuf dhufan; Seexannis isaan wajjin fuula Waaqayyoo duratti dhiʼaachuuf dhufe.
english: Again, on the day when God’s sons came to present themselves before the LORD, Satan came also among them to present himself before the LORD.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Seexanaan, “Ati eessaa dhufte?” jedhe. Seexannis, “Ani lafa hunda irra jooree asii fi achis deddeebiʼaa tureen dhufe” jedhee Waaqayyoof deebise.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Where have you come from?” Satan answered the LORD, and said, “From going back and forth on the earth, and from walking up and down in it.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Seexanaan akkana jedhe; “Tajaajilaa koo Iyyoobin qalbeeffatteertaa? Namni isa fakkaatu tokko illee lafa irra hin jiru; inni nama hirʼina hin qabnee fi qajeelaa, nama Waaqa sodaatuu fi hammina irraa fagaate dha. Ati akka ani sababii tokko malee isa balleessuuf na kakaaftu iyyuu inni hamma ammaatti qajeelummaa isaa cichee qabateera.”
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Have you considered my servant Job? For there is no one like him on the earth, a blameless and an upright man, one who fears God, and turns away from evil. He still maintains his integrity, although you incited me against him, to ruin him without cause.”

kikuyu: Seexannis deebisee akkana jedhe; “Gogaan gogaadhaaf! Namni lubbuu isaa oolfachuuf jedhee waan qabu hunda ni kenna.
english: Satan answered the LORD, and said, “Skin for skin. Yes, all that a man has he will give for his life.

kikuyu: Garuu ati mee harka kee diriirfadhuutii foonii fi lafee isaa rukuti; inni dhugumaan ifumaan ifatti si abaara.”
english: But stretch out your hand now, and touch his bone and his flesh, and he will renounce you to your face.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Seexanaan, “Kunoo inni si harka jira; lubbuu isaa garuu hin tuqin” jedhe.
english: The LORD said to Satan, “Behold, he is in your hand. Only spare his life.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Seexanni fuula Waaqayyoo duraa baʼee Iyyoobin faana miilla isaatii jalqabee hamma gubbee mataa isaatti madaa hamaadhaan rukute.
english: So Satan went out from the presence of the LORD, and struck Job with painful sores from the sole of his foot to his head.

kikuyu: Iyyoobis ittiin of hooquuf jedhee qiraacii fudhatee daaraa keessa taaʼe.
english: He took for himself a potsherd to scrape himself with, and he sat among the ashes.

kikuyu: Niitiin isaa, “Ati amma illee qajeelummaa kee cichitee qabatteertaa? Waaqa abaariitii duʼi!” isaan jette.
english: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”

kikuyu: Inni immoo deebisee, “Ati akka dubartii gowwaa tokkootti dubbatte. Nu harka Waaqaatii waan gaarii fudhanneerra; waan hamaa immoo fudhachuu hin qabnuu?” jedhe. Wantoota kanneen hunda keessatti Iyyoob waan dubbateen cubbuu hin hojjenne.
english: But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God, and shall we not receive evil?” In all this Job didn’t sin with his lips.

kikuyu: Michoonni Iyyoob sadan jechuunis Eliifaaz namni Teemaan, Bildaad namni Shuhaatii fi Zoofaari namni Naaʼimaataa yommuu waan Iyyoob irra gaʼe hunda dhagaʼanitti rakkina isaa qoodachuu fi isa jajjabeessuudhaaf tokkummaan walii galanii mana isaaniitii baʼan.
english: Now when Job’s three friends heard of all this evil that had come on him, they each came from his own place: Eliphaz the Temanite, Bildad the Shuhite, and Zophar the Naamathite; and they made an appointment together to come to sympathize with him and to comfort him.

kikuyu: Yommuu fagootti isa arganitti isa beekuu hin dandeenye; isaanis sagalee ol fudhatanii booʼan; uffata isaaniis tarsaasanii mataa isaaniitti daaraa firfirfatan.
english: When they lifted up their eyes from a distance, and didn’t recognize him, they raised their voices, and wept; and they each tore his robe, and sprinkled dust on their heads toward the sky.

kikuyu: Ergasiis guyyaa torbaa fi halkan torba isa wajjin lafa tataaʼan. Isaan sababii dhiphinni isaa akka malee cimaa taʼuu isaa arganiif, namni tokko iyyuu homaa isatti hin dubbanne.
english: So they sat down with him on the ground seven days and seven nights, and no one spoke a word to him, for they saw that his grief was very great.

kikuyu: Kana irratti Iyyoob afaan isaa banatee guyyaa itti dhalate abaare.
english: After this Job opened his mouth, and cursed the day of his birth.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhe:
english: Job answered:

kikuyu: “Guyyaan ani itti dhaladhe haa badu; halkan, ‘Ilmi dhalate!’ jedhame sunis haa badu.
english: “Let the day perish in which I was born, the night which said, ‘There is a boy conceived.’

kikuyu: Guyyaan sun haa dukkanaaʼu; Waaqni ol gubbaadhaa isa hin ilaalin; ifnis itti hin ifin.
english: Let that day be darkness. Don’t let God from above seek for it, neither let the light shine on it.

kikuyu: Dukkannii fi gaaddidduun guddaan isa haa dhaalan; duumessi isa irra haa buʼu; ifa isaa dukkanni haa liqimsu.
english: Let darkness and the shadow of death claim it for their own. Let a cloud dwell on it. Let all that makes the day black terrify it.

kikuyu: Halkan sana dukkanni limixiin haa qabatu; guyyoota waggaa keessa jiranittis hin dabalamin yookaan jiʼoota kam iyyuu keessatti hin lakkaaʼamin.
english: As for that night, let thick darkness seize on it. Let it not rejoice among the days of the year. Let it not come into the number of the months.

kikuyu: Halkan sun haa maseenu; ililleenis keessatti hin dhagaʼamin.
english: Behold, let that night be barren. Let no joyful voice come therein.

kikuyu: Warri Lewaataanin kakaasuuf qophaaʼan, kanneen guyyoota abaaran guyyaa sana haa abaaran.
english: Let them curse it who curse the day, who are ready to rouse up leviathan.

kikuyu: Bakkalchi barii kan guyyaa sanaa haa dukkanaaʼu; ifa eeggatee haa dhabu; boruu baqaqus hin argin.
english: Let the stars of its twilight be dark. Let it look for light, but have none, neither let it see the eyelids of the morning,

kikuyu: Inni ija koo duraa rakkina dhoksuuf, balbala gadameessa haadha kootii natti hin cufneetii.
english: because it didn’t shut up the doors of my mother’s womb, nor did it hide trouble from my eyes.

kikuyu: “Ani maaliif gadameessa haadha kootii keessatti hin badin? Maaliifis yeruman garaa keessaa baʼetti hin duʼin?
english: “Why didn’t I die from the womb? Why didn’t I give up the spirit when my mother bore me?

kikuyu: Jilbawwan na simatan, harmawwan ani hodhus maaliif achitti argaman?
english: Why did the knees receive me? Or why the breast, that I should nurse?

kikuyu: Ani silaa yoona nagaan nan ciisa; rafees nan boqodhan tureetii;
english: For now I should have lain down and been quiet. I should have slept, then I would have been at rest,

kikuyu: moototaa fi gorsitoota addunyaa warra iddoowwan amma diigamanii jiran ofii isaaniitiif qopheeffatan wajjin,
english: with kings and counselors of the earth, who built up waste places for themselves;

kikuyu: bulchitoota warqee qaban, kanneen manneen isaanii meetiidhaan guutatan wajjin nan boqodhan ture.
english: or with princes who had gold, who filled their houses with silver;

kikuyu: Yookaan ani maaliifin akkuma mucaa duʼee garaa baʼee, akkuma daaʼima ifa guyyaa hin arginiitti hin awwaalamin?
english: or as a hidden untimely birth I had not been, as infants who never saw light.

kikuyu: Achittis namoonni hamoonni jeequu ni dhiisu; dadhaboonnis achitti ni boqotu.
english: There the wicked cease from troubling. There the weary are at rest.

kikuyu: Boojiʼamtoonni nagaadhaan walii wajjin jiraatu; waca cunqursitoota isaaniis hin dhagaʼan.
english: There the prisoners are at ease together. They don’t hear the voice of the taskmaster.

kikuyu: Xinnaa fi guddaan achi jira; garbichis gooftaa isaa jalaa bilisoomeera.
english: The small and the great are there. The servant is free from his master.

kikuyu: “Maaliif warra gadadoo keessa jiraniif ifni warra lubbuun isaanii gadditeef immoo jireenyi kennama?
english: “Why is light given to him who is in misery, life to the bitter in soul,

kikuyu: Warra duʼa hawwanii dhabaniif warra qabeenya dhokfame caalaa duʼa barbaadaniif
english: who long for death, but it doesn’t come; and dig for it more than for hidden treasures,

kikuyu: warra yommuu awwaalamuu gaʼanitti gammachuun guutamanii ililchaniif jireenyi maaliif kennama?
english: who rejoice exceedingly, and are glad, when they can find the grave?

kikuyu: Nama karaan isaa duraa dhokateef nama Waaqni dallaa itti marse jireenyi maaliif kennama?
english: Why is light given to a man whose way is hidden, whom God has hedged in?

kikuyu: Gaddi buddeena naa taʼeera; aaduun koos akka bishaanii dhangalaʼa.
english: For my sighing comes before I eat. My groanings are poured out like water.

kikuyu: Wanni ani sodaadhe natti dhufeera; wanni na naasisus narra gaʼeera.
english: For the thing which I fear comes on me, that which I am afraid of comes to me.

kikuyu: Ani nagaa hin qabu; tasgabbiis hin qabu; jeequmsa malee boqonnaa hin qabu.”
english: I am not at ease, neither am I quiet, neither do I have rest; but trouble comes.”

kikuyu: Eliifaaz namichi Teemaan sun akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

kikuyu: “Yoo namni tokko sitti dubbachuu yaale, ati ni komattaa? Garuu eenyutu dubbachuu dhiisa?
english: “If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?

kikuyu: Ati akka nama baayʼee barsiifte, akka harka dadhabaa illee jajjabeessite yaadadhu.
english: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.

kikuyu: Dubbiin kee warra gatantaran gargaaree dhaabeera; atis jilba laafe jabeessiteerta.
english: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.

kikuyu: Amma garuu rakkinni sirra gaʼe; atis abdii kutatteerta; rakkinni si miidheera; atis rifatteerta;
english: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.

kikuyu: Waaqa sodaachuun kee irkoo kee, qajeelinni karaa keetiis abdii kee mitii?
english: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?

kikuyu: “Ammas yaadadhu; namni qulqulluun takkumaa badee beekaa? Qajeelonni eessatti badanii beeku?
english: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?

kikuyu: Akka ani hubadhetti warri waan hamaa qotatan, kanneen waan hamaa facaasanis isuma haammatu.
english: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.

kikuyu: Isaanis hafuura Waaqni isaanitti baafatuun badu; hafuuraa dheekkamsa isaaniitiinis ni barbadeeffamu.
english: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.

kikuyu: Leenci ni aada; ni gururiʼas; ilkaan leenca saafelaa garuu ni caccaba.
english: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.

kikuyu: Leenci jabaan waan adamsu dhabee ni duʼa; ilmaan leenca dhaltuus ni bittinnaaʼu.
english: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.

kikuyu: “Dubbiin tokko icciitiidhaan naa fidame; gurri koos asaasa isaa dhagaʼe.
english: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.

kikuyu: Abjuu halkanii sodaachisaa keessa, yommuu hirribni cimaan nama qabatutti,
english: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,

kikuyu: sodaa fi hollachuun na qabatee lafee koo hunda raase.
english: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.

kikuyu: Hafuurri luffi jedhee fuula koo dura darbe; rifeensi dhagna koos kaʼee dhaabate.
english: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.

kikuyu: Innis ni dhaabate; ani garuu inni maal akka taʼe hubachuu hin dandeenye. Fakkiin tokko ija koo dura dhaabate; anis sagalee tasgabbii kan akkana jedhu tokkon dhagaʼe:
english: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes. Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,

kikuyu: ‘Namni duʼa hin oolle, Waaqa caalaa qajeelaa taʼuu dandaʼaa? Namni Uumaa isaa caalaa qulqulluu taʼuu dandaʼaa?
english: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?

kikuyu: Waaqni tajaajiltoota isaa hin amanatu; ergamoota isaas balleessaa isaaniitiin ni gaafata;
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.

kikuyu: yoos warri manneen suphee keessa jiraatan, warri hundeen isaanii biyyoo taʼe, warri bilii caalaa burkutaaʼan immoo akkam haa taʼan ree?
english: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust, who are crushed before the moth!

kikuyu: Isaan ganamaa fi galgala gidduutti burkutaaʼu; tasumas bara baraan ni badu.
english: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.

kikuyu: Akka isaan ogummaa malee duʼaniif funyoon dunkaana isaanii hin luqqifamnee?’
english: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’

kikuyu: “Mee waami, namni deebii siif kennu jiraa? Qulqulloota keessaas ati gara isa kamiitti gorta?
english: “Call now; is there any who will answer you? To which of the holy ones will you turn?

kikuyu: Nama gowwaa aariitu ajjeesa; raatuus hinaaffaatu galaafata.
english: For resentment kills the foolish man, and jealousy kills the simple.

kikuyu: Namni gowwaan hidda isaa gad fageeffatee nan arge; manni isaa garuu yoosuma abaarame.
english: I have seen the foolish taking root, but suddenly I cursed his habitation.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen isaa nagaa hin qaban; isaan karra duratti burkutaaʼan; namni isaan oolchus hin jiru.
english: His children are far from safety. They are crushed in the gate. Neither is there any to deliver them,

kikuyu: Namni beelaʼe midhaan isaa qoraattii keessaa iyyuu fuudhee nyaata; inni dheebotes qabeenya isaa hawwa.
english: whose harvest the hungry eat up, and take it even out of the thorns. The snare gapes for their substance.

kikuyu: Rakkinni biyyoo keessaa hin burquutii; dhiphinnis lafa keessaa hin biqilu.
english: For affliction doesn’t come out of the dust, neither does trouble spring out of the ground;

kikuyu: Akkuma qaanqeen ibiddaa ol facaʼu namni rakkinaaf dhalata.
english: but man is born to trouble, as the sparks fly upward.

kikuyu: “Garuu utuu ana taʼee Waaqa nan barbaaddadha; dhimma koos fuula isaa duratti nan dhiʼeeffadhan ture.
english: “But as for me, I would seek God. I would commit my cause to God,

kikuyu: Inni dinqiiwwan qoranii bira gaʼuu hin dandeenye, hojiiwwan dinqisiisoo lakkaaʼamuu hin dandeenye hojjeta.
english: who does great things that can’t be fathomed, marvelous things without number;

kikuyu: Inni bokkaadhaan lafa ni quubsa; lafa qotiisaas bishaan ni obaasa.
english: who gives rain on the earth, and sends waters on the fields;

kikuyu: Warra gad qabaman ol baasa; warra gaddanis iddoo nagaatti ol kaasa.
english: so that he sets up on high those who are low, those who mourn are exalted to safety.

kikuyu: Akka hojiin harka isaanii hin milkoofneef, inni karoora jalʼootaa ni fashaleessa.
english: He frustrates the plans of the crafty, so that their hands can’t perform their enterprise.

kikuyu: Inni ogeeyyii haxxummaa isaaniitiin qaba; malli jalʼootaa immoo dafee ni bada.
english: He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.

kikuyu: Guyyaan dukkana isaanitti taʼa; guyyaa saafaas akka nama dukkana keessa jiruu qaqqabannaadhaan deemu.
english: They meet with darkness in the day time, and grope at noonday as in the night.

kikuyu: Inni nama rakkataa goraadee afaan isaanii jalaa, harka nama jabaa jalaas ni baasa.
english: But he saves from the sword of their mouth, even the needy from the hand of the mighty.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu hiyyeessi abdii qaba; jalʼinnis afaan isaa ni cufata.
english: So the poor has hope, and injustice shuts her mouth.

kikuyu: “Namni Waaqni adabu eebbifamaa dha; kanaafuu ati adabbii Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼuu hin tuffatin.
english: “Behold, happy is the man whom God corrects. Therefore do not despise the chastening of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Inni ni madeessa; ni fayyisas; inni ni cabsa; harka isaatiinis deebisee ni fayyisa.
english: For he wounds and binds up. He injures and his hands make whole.

kikuyu: Balaa jaʼa jalaa si baasa; torba keessattis hin miidhamtu.
english: He will deliver you in six troubles; yes, in seven no evil will touch you.

kikuyu: Bara beelaa duʼa jalaa, lola keessattis rukuttaa goraadee jalaa si baasa.
english: In famine he will redeem you from death; in war, from the power of the sword.

kikuyu: Ati garaffii arrabaa jalaa ni dhokfamta; yommuu badiisni dhufuttis hin sodaattu.
english: You will be hidden from the scourge of the tongue, neither will you be afraid of destruction when it comes.

kikuyu: Badiisaa fi beelatti ni kolfita; bineensota lafaas hin sodaattu.
english: You will laugh at destruction and famine, neither will you be afraid of the animals of the earth.

kikuyu: Dhagoota bakkee wajjin kakuu galta; bineensonni bosonaas nagaadhaan si wajjin jiraatu.
english: For you will be allied with the stones of the field. The animals of the field will be at peace with you.

kikuyu: Dunkaanni kee nagaan akka jiru ni beekta; qabeenya kee ni toʼatta; wanni tokko illee si jalaa hin badu.
english: You will know that your tent is in peace. You will visit your fold, and will miss nothing.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen kee akka baayʼatan, sanyiiwwan kees akkuma marga lafaa akka taʼan ni beekta.
english: You will know also that your offspring will be great, your offspring as the grass of the earth.

kikuyu: Akkuma bissiin midhaanii yeroo isaatti walitti qabamu sana, atis bara dheeraa jiraattee awwaala seenta.
english: You will come to your grave in a full age, like a shock of grain comes in its season.

kikuyu: “Nu waan kana qoranneerra; innis dhugaa dha. Kanaafuu qalbeeffadhu; ofii keetiifis beeki.”
english: Behold, we have researched it. It is so. Hear it, and know it for your good.”

kikuyu: Iyyoobis akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Utuu gaddi koo safaramee dhiphinni koo hundis madaalii irra kaaʼamee jiraatee!
english: “Oh that my anguish were weighed, and all my calamity laid in the balances!

kikuyu: Waan inni cirracha galaanaa caalaa ulfaatuuf, ariitiin dubbachuun koo nama hin dinqisiisu ture.
english: For now it would be heavier than the sand of the seas, therefore my words have been rash.

kikuyu: Xiyyawwan Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼuu na keessa jiru; hafuurri koo summii isaanii dhuga; sodaachisuun Waaqaa natti hiriireera.
english: For the arrows of the Almighty are within me. My spirit drinks up their poison. The terrors of God set themselves in array against me.

kikuyu: Harreen diidaa utuu marga qabuu halaakaa? Yookaan qotiyyoon utuu okaa qabuu baroodaa?
english: Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?

kikuyu: Nyaanni hin miʼoofne soogidda malee nyaatamaa? Yookaan bishaan hanqaaquu ni miʼaawaa?
english: Can that which has no flavor be eaten without salt? Or is there any taste in the white of an egg?

kikuyu: Ani isa tuquu hin fedhu; nyaanni akkasii na dhukkubsa.
english: My soul refuses to touch them. They are as loathsome food to me.

kikuyu: “Utuu kadhannaan koo deebii argatee, Waaqnis waan ani hawwu naa kennee jiraatee,
english: “Oh that I might have my request, that God would grant the thing that I long for,

kikuyu: utuu na caccabsuun fedhii Waaqaa taʼee, utuu harki isaa hiikamee na galaafatee!
english: even that it would please God to crush me; that he would let loose his hand, and cut me off!

kikuyu: Silaa kun jajjabina naa taʼa ture; dhukkuba hamaa keessatti iyyuu nan gammada ture; ani dubbii Qulqullicha sanaa hin ganneetii.
english: Let it still be my consolation, yes, let me exult in pain that doesn’t spare, that I have not denied the words of the Holy One.

kikuyu: “Ammas akkan abdadhuuf jabinni koo maali? Akkan obsuufis humni koo maali?
english: What is my strength, that I should wait? What is my end, that I should be patient?

kikuyu: Ani jabina dhagaa qabaa? Foon koos naasiidhaa?
english: Is my strength the strength of stones? Or is my flesh of bronze?

kikuyu: Ani of gargaaruuf humna tokko illee qabaa? Ogummaan na keessaa badeera mitii?
english: Isn’t it that I have no help in me, that wisdom is driven away from me?

kikuyu: “Namni michuu isaatiif garaa hin laafne Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu iyyuu sodaachuu dhiiseera.
english: “To him who is ready to faint, kindness should be shown from his friend; even to him who forsakes the fear of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Obboloonni koo garuu akka doloolloo, akkuma laga yeroof guutee darbuu gowwoomsitoota;
english: My brothers have dealt deceitfully as a brook, as the channel of brooks that pass away;

kikuyu: isaan laga cabbiidhaan booraʼee yommuu cabbiin sun baqutti immoo guutee irra yaaʼuu ti.
english: which are black by reason of the ice, in which the snow hides itself.

kikuyu: Lageen yeroo bonni cimutti ni goggogu; yeroo hoʼaatti immoo iddoo isaaniitii badu.
english: In the dry season, they vanish. When it is hot, they are consumed out of their place.

kikuyu: Warri gaalaan daldalan karaa isaanii irraa jalʼatu; gammoojjiitti namʼanii dhumu.
english: The caravans that travel beside them turn away. They go up into the waste, and perish.

kikuyu: Daldaltoonni Teemaa kanneen gaalaan daldalan bishaan barbaadu; karaa adeemtonni Shebaa immoo isaan abdatu.
english: The caravans of Tema looked. The companies of Sheba waited for them.

kikuyu: Isaan waan abdatanii turaniif ni qaanaʼan; achi gaʼaniis waan jedhan wallaalan.
english: They were distressed because they were confident. They came there, and were confounded.

kikuyu: Ammas isin akka waan faayidaa hin qabnee taatan; gidiraa koo argitanii sodaattan.
english: For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.

kikuyu: Ani takkumaa, ‘Waa naaf kennaa’ yookaan ‘Qabeenya keessan furii naaf godhaa’ jedheeraa?
english: Did I ever say, ‘Give to me’? or, ‘Offer a present for me from your substance’?

kikuyu: Yookaan, ‘Harka diinaa jalaa na baasaa’ yookaan, ‘Harka cunqursitootaa jalaa na furaa’ jedheeraa?
english: or, ‘Deliver me from the adversary’s hand’? or, ‘Redeem me from the hand of the oppressors’?

kikuyu: “Na barsiisaa; ani nan calʼisa; iddoo ani itti dogoggores na argisiisaa.
english: “Teach me, and I will hold my peace. Cause me to understand my error.

kikuyu: Dubbiin qajeelaan akkam ulfaataa dha! Falmiin keessan garuu maal mirkaneessa?
english: How forcible are words of uprightness! But your reproof, what does it reprove?

kikuyu: Isin waan ani jedhu qajeelchuu, dubbii nama abdii kutatees akka bubbeetti heduu barbaadduu?
english: Do you intend to reprove words, since the speeches of one who is desperate are as wind?

kikuyu: Isin ijoollee abbaa hin qabnetti ixaa buufattu; michoota keessaniifis boolla qottu.
english: Yes, you would even cast lots for the fatherless, and make merchandise of your friend.

kikuyu: “Amma garuu yoo fedhii keessan taʼe na ilaalaa. Ani fuula keessan duratti nan sobaa?
english: Now therefore be pleased to look at me, for surely I will not lie to your face.

kikuyu: Deebiʼaa; murtiis hin jalʼisinaa; hubadhaa; ani nama qajeelaadhaatii.
english: Please return. Let there be no injustice. Yes, return again. My cause is righteous.

kikuyu: Jalʼinni arraba koo irra jiraa? Afaan koo daba addaan baasuu hin dandaʼuu?
english: Is there injustice on my tongue? Can’t my taste discern mischievous things?

kikuyu: “Jireenyi namaa lafa irratti qabsoo cimaa mitii? Barri isaas akkuma bara nama qacaramaa tokkootii mitii?
english: “Isn’t a man forced to labor on earth? Aren’t his days like the days of a hired hand?

kikuyu: Akkuma garbicha gaaddisa galgalaa hawwuu, yookaan akkuma hojjetaa mindaa isaa eegatu tokkoo,
english: As a servant who earnestly desires the shadow, as a hireling who looks for his wages,

kikuyu: jiʼoonni faayidaa hin qabne naa qoodaman; halkanoonni dhiphinaas naa ramadaman.
english: so I am made to possess months of misery, wearisome nights are appointed to me.

kikuyu: Yommuun ciisutti, ‘Ani yoomin kaʼa?’ jedheen yaada. Halkan natti dheerata; anis hamma bariʼutti nan gaggaragala.
english: When I lie down, I say, ‘When will I arise, and the night be gone?’ I toss and turn until the dawning of the day.

kikuyu: Nafni koo raammoo fi qonyanyaa uffateera; gogaan koo babbaqaqee malaʼaa jira.
english: My flesh is clothed with worms and clods of dust. My skin closes up, and breaks out afresh.

kikuyu: “Barri koo kolloo wayya dhooftuu caalaa ariifata; innis abdii malee dhuma.
english: My days are swifter than a weaver’s shuttle, and are spent without hope.

kikuyu: Egaa yaa Waaqayyo, akka jireenyi koo akkuma qilleensaa taʼe yaadadhu; iji koo lammata waan gaarii hin argu.
english: Oh remember that my life is a breath. My eye will no more see good.

kikuyu: Iji amma na argu siʼachi na hin argu; ati na barbaadda; garuu ani hin jiru.
english: The eye of him who sees me will see me no more. Your eyes will be on me, but I will not be.

kikuyu: Akkuma duumessi bittinnaaʼee badus namni awwaalame hin deebiʼu.
english: As the cloud is consumed and vanishes away, so he who goes down to Sheol will come up no more.

kikuyu: Inni lammata mana isaatti hin deebiʼu; iddoon isaas siʼachi isa hin beeku.
english: He will return no more to his house, neither will his place know him any more.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu ani cal hin jedhu; ani hafuura koo dhiphate sanaan nan dubbadha; hadhaaʼummaa lubbuu kootiinis nan guunguma.
english: “Therefore I will not keep silent. I will speak in the anguish of my spirit. I will complain in the bitterness of my soul.

kikuyu: Ati eegduu natti ramaduun kee, ani galaana moo yookaan bineensa galaanaa ti?
english: Am I a sea, or a sea monster, that you put a guard over me?

kikuyu: Yommuu ani, ‘Sireen koo na jajjabeessa; wanni ani irra ciisu guungummii koo naa xinneessa’ jedhutti,
english: When I say, ‘My bed will comfort me. My couch will ease my complaint,’

kikuyu: ati abjuu keessa na sodaachifta; mulʼataanis na rifachiifta.
english: then you scare me with dreams and terrify me through visions,

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani akkasitti jiraachuu irra of hudhee duʼuu nan filadha.
english: so that my soul chooses strangling, death rather than my bones.

kikuyu: Jireenya koo nan jibba; ani bara baraan hin jiraadhu. Na dhiisi; jiraachuun koo faayidaa hin qabuutii.
english: I loathe my life. I don’t want to live forever. Leave me alone, for my days are but a breath.

kikuyu: “Akka ati isa leelliftuuf, akka qalbii kee isa irra keessuufis namni maali?
english: What is man, that you should magnify him, that you should set your mind on him,

kikuyu: Ati ganama ganama isa xiinxaltee yeroo yerootti isa qorta.
english: that you should visit him every morning, and test him every moment?

kikuyu: Ati ija kee narraa hin buqqiftuu? Hamma ani hancufa liqimsutti kophaa koo na hin dhiiftuu?
english: How long will you not look away from me, nor leave me alone until I swallow down my spittle?

kikuyu: Yaa isa nama eegdu, yoon cubbuu hojjedhe iyyuu ani maalan si godha? Ati maaliif waan itti akeekkattu na godhatte? Ani baʼaa sitti taʼeeraa?
english: If I have sinned, what do I do to you, you watcher of men? Why have you set me as a mark for you, so that I am a burden to myself?

kikuyu: Ati maaliif balleessaa koo irra dabartee cubbuu koo illee naaf hin dhiifne? Yeroon ani itti biyyoo keessa ciisu gaʼeeraatii; ati na barbaadda; garuu ani hin argamu.”
english: Why do you not pardon my disobedience, and take away my iniquity? For now will I lie down in the dust. You will seek me diligently, but I will not be.”

kikuyu: Bildaad Shuhaahichi akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

kikuyu: “Ati hamma yoomiitti waan akkasii dubbatta? Dubbiin kee bubbee jabaa dha.
english: “How long will you speak these things? Shall the words of your mouth be a mighty wind?

kikuyu: Waaqni murtii qajeelaa jalʼisaa ree? Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu waan qajeelaa jalʼisaa?
english: Does God pervert justice? Or does the Almighty pervert righteousness?

kikuyu: Yommuu ijoolleen kee cubbuu isatti hojjetanitti, inni adabbii cubbuu isaaniitti dabarsee isaan kenne.
english: If your children have sinned against him, he has delivered them into the hand of their disobedience.

kikuyu: Ati garuu yoo Waaqa barbaadatte, Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu yoo waammatte,
english: If you want to seek God diligently, make your supplication to the Almighty.

kikuyu: yoo ati qulqulluu fi qajeelaa taate, inni waaʼee keetiif ammuma kaʼa; jireenya qajeelummaa kees siif deebisa.
english: If you were pure and upright, surely now he would awaken for you, and make the habitation of your righteousness prosperous.

kikuyu: Jalqabni kee xinnaa taʼu illee, dhumni kee baayʼee guddaa taʼa.
english: Though your beginning was small, yet your latter end would greatly increase.

kikuyu: “Dhaloota darbe gaafadhu; waan abbootiin isaanii qoratanii bira gaʼanis hubadhu;
english: “Please inquire of past generations. Find out about the learning of their fathers.

kikuyu: nu waan kaleessa dhalanneef waa tokko illee hin beeknuutii; baroonni keenyas lafa irratti akkuma gaaddidduu ti.
english: (For we are but of yesterday, and know nothing, because our days on earth are a shadow.)

kikuyu: Isaan si hin barsiisanii? Sittis hin himanii? Dubbii garaa isaanii keessa jirus hin dubbatanii?
english: Shall they not teach you, tell you, and utter words out of their heart?

kikuyu: Dhallaadduun lafa caffee hin taʼinitti guddataa? Shambaqqoonis bishaan malee lalisaa?
english: “Can the papyrus grow up without mire? Can the rushes grow without water?

kikuyu: Isaan utuma guddachaa jiranuu, utuu hin muramin, biqiltuuwwan kaan dura dafanii gogu.
english: While it is yet in its greenness, not cut down, it withers before any other reed.

kikuyu: Dhumni warra Waaqa irraanfataniis akkasuma taʼa; abdiin warra Waaqa hin beeknees ni bada.
english: So are the paths of all who forget God. The hope of the godless man will perish,

kikuyu: Abdiin isaa akkuma salphaatti cita; ofitti amanachuun isaas manʼee sariitii ti.
english: whose confidence will break apart, whose trust is a spider’s web.

kikuyu: Inni manʼee isaatti irkata; manʼeen sun garuu hin dhaabatu; itti maxxanas; manʼeen sun garuu dandaʼee isa hin baatu.
english: He will lean on his house, but it will not stand. He will cling to it, but it will not endure.

kikuyu: Inni akka biqiltuu aduu keessatti bishaan obaafamee lalisuutti, dameewwan isaa lafa biqiltuu irra diriirfatuu ti.
english: He is green before the sun. His shoots go out along his garden.

kikuyu: Hidda isaa tuullaa dhagaatti marata; kattaa gidduus iddoo jiraatu ni barbaaddata.
english: His roots are wrapped around the rock pile. He sees the place of stones.

kikuyu: Yommuu inni iddoo isaatii badutti garuu, iddoon sun, ‘Ani si argee hin beeku’ jedhee isa gana.
english: If he is destroyed from his place, then it will deny him, saying, ‘I have not seen you.’

kikuyu: Kunis dhuma jireenya isaa ti; biqiltuuwwan biraas lafaa ni biqilu.
english: Behold, this is the joy of his way. Out of the earth, others will spring.

kikuyu: “Waaqni nama hirʼina hin qabne hin gatu; yookaan harka jalʼootaa hin jabeessu.
english: “Behold, God will not cast away a blameless man, neither will he uphold the evildoers.

kikuyu: Inni afaan kee kolfaan, arraba kee immoo ililleedhaan ni guuta.
english: He will still fill your mouth with laughter, your lips with shouting.

kikuyu: Warri si jibban salphina uffatu. Dunkaanni jalʼootaas siʼachi hin jiraatu.”
english: Those who hate you will be clothed with shame. The tent of the wicked will be no more.”

kikuyu: Iyyoob akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Ani akka wanni kun dhugaa taʼe beeka. Namni garuu akkamitti fuula Waaqaa duratti qajeelaa taʼuu dandaʼa?
english: “Truly I know that it is so, but how can man be just with God?

kikuyu: Namni tokko yoo isa wajjin falmuu barbaade kuma keessaa siʼa tokko illee isaaf deebisuu hin dandaʼu.
english: If he is pleased to contend with him, he can’t answer him one time in a thousand.

kikuyu: Ogummaan isaa gad fagoo dha; humni isaas guddaa dha. Namni isaan mormee utuu hin miidhamin hafu jiraa?
english: God is wise in heart, and mighty in strength. Who has hardened himself against him and prospered?

kikuyu: Inni utuu isaan hin beekin tulluuwwan iddoo isaaniitii buqqisa; dheekkamsa isaatiinis isaan gaggaragalcha.
english: He removes the mountains, and they don’t know it, when he overturns them in his anger.

kikuyu: Lafa iddoo isheetii ni sochoosa; utubaawwan ishees ni raasa.
english: He shakes the earth out of its place. Its pillars tremble.

kikuyu: Inni biiftuu ni ajaja; isheenis hin baatu; urjiiwwanis chaappaadhaan ni cufa.
english: He commands the sun and it doesn’t rise, and seals up the stars.

kikuyu: Isa qofatu samiiwwan diriirsa; dambalii galaanaa irras ni deema.
english: He alone stretches out the heavens, and treads on the waves of the sea.

kikuyu: Urjiiwwan Amaaketaa fi urjii sadee, Urjii torbii fi tuuta ‘Urjiiwwan Kibbaa’ jedhaman isatu uume.
english: He makes the Bear, Orion, and the Pleiades, and the rooms of the south.

kikuyu: Inni wantoota gurguddaa qoratanii bira gaʼuun hin dandaʼamne, dinqiiwwan hin lakkaaʼamne hojjeta.
english: He does great things past finding out; yes, marvelous things without number.

kikuyu: Yommuu inni na bira darbu ani isa arguu hin dandaʼu; yommuu inni na cina deemus ani isa hubachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: Behold, he goes by me, and I don’t see him. He passes on also, but I don’t perceive him.

kikuyu: Yoo inni butee deeme eenyutu isa dhowwuu dandaʼa? Eenyutus, ‘Ati maal hojjettaa?’ isaan jechuu dandaʼa?
english: Behold, he snatches away. Who can hinder him? Who will ask him, ‘What are you doing?’

kikuyu: Waaqni dheekkamsa isaa hin deebisu; warri Raʼaabin gargaaran iyyuu gad deebiʼu.
english: “God will not withdraw his anger. The helpers of Rahab stoop under him.

kikuyu: “Yoos ani akkamittan isatti falmuu dandaʼa? Isatti falmuufis akkamittan dubbii filachuu dandaʼa?
english: How much less will I answer him, and choose my words to argue with him?

kikuyu: Ani nama balleessaa hin qabne utuun taʼe iyyuu, isaaf deebisuu hin dandaʼu; abbaa Murtii koo araara kadhachuu qofa nan dandaʼa.
english: Though I were righteous, yet I wouldn’t answer him. I would make supplication to my judge.

kikuyu: Yoo ani isa waammadhee inni naa deebise illee, akka inni na dhagaʼu ani hin amanu.
english: If I had called, and he had answered me, yet I wouldn’t believe that he listened to my voice.

kikuyu: Inni bubbee hamaadhaan na caccabsa; madaa koos sababii malee natti baayʼisa.
english: For he breaks me with a storm, and multiplies my wounds without cause.

kikuyu: Inni waan hadhaaʼaadhaan na guute malee akka ani hafuura fudhadhuuf illee yeroo naaf hin kennine.
english: He will not allow me to catch my breath, but fills me with bitterness.

kikuyu: Waaʼee jabinaa taanaan inni jabaa dha! Waaʼee murtii qajeelaas taanaan eenyutu isa waamuu dandaʼa?
english: If it is a matter of strength, behold, he is mighty! If of justice, ‘Who,’ says he, ‘will summon me?’

kikuyu: Utuu ani nama balleessaa hin qabne taʼe iyyuu afaan koo natti mura; utuma ani hirʼina hin qabaannes yakkamaa taʼuu koo hima.
english: Though I am righteous, my own mouth will condemn me. Though I am blameless, it will prove me perverse.

kikuyu: “Ani hirʼina qabaachuu baadhu iyyuu, waaʼee ofii kootii hin yaaddaʼu; jireenya koos nan tuffadha.
english: I am blameless. I don’t respect myself. I despise my life.

kikuyu: Wanni hundinuu tokkuma; kanaafuu ani, ‘Inni isa hirʼina hin qabnes, isa hamaas ni balleessa’ nan jedha.
english: “It is all the same. Therefore I say he destroys the blameless and the wicked.

kikuyu: Yommuu dhaʼichi buʼee duʼa tasaa fidutti, inni badiisa warra yakka hin qabneetti ni qoosa.
english: If the scourge kills suddenly, he will mock at the trial of the innocent.

kikuyu: Yommuu lafti harka hamootaa jala galtutti, inni ija abbootii murtii ishee ni jaamsa; kun yoo isa taʼuu baate, egaa eenyu ree?
english: The earth is given into the hand of the wicked. He covers the faces of its judges. If not he, then who is it?

kikuyu: “Barri jireenya koo nama fiigu caalaa ariifata; utuu gammachuu tokko illee hin argin darba.
english: “Now my days are swifter than a runner. They flee away. They see no good.

kikuyu: Inni akkuma bidiruu dhallaadduu irraa hojjetamee, akkuma risaa waa butachuuf gad barrisuu ariifata.
english: They have passed away as the swift ships, as the eagle that swoops on the prey.

kikuyu: Yoo ani, ‘Guungummii koo nan dhiisa; nyaara guuruus dhiisee nan seeqa’ jedhe,
english: If I say, ‘I will forget my complaint, I will put off my sad face, and cheer up,’

kikuyu: ani amma iyyuu dhiphina koo hunda nan sodaadha; akka ati akka nama balleessaa hin qabneetti na hin hedne nan beekaatii.
english: I am afraid of all my sorrows. I know that you will not hold me innocent.

kikuyu: Erga yakkamaa taʼuun koo beekamee, ani maaliifin akkasumaan dadhaba ree?
english: I will be condemned. Why then do I labor in vain?

kikuyu: Utuma ani saamunaadhaan dhiqadhee handoodeedhaanis harka koo qulqulleeffadhe iyyuu,
english: If I wash myself with snow, and cleanse my hands with lye,

kikuyu: ati hamma uffanni koos na balfutti, boolla keessa na dhidhimsita.
english: yet you will plunge me in the ditch. My own clothes will abhor me.

kikuyu: “Akka ani isaa deebisuu fi mana murtiittis wal falminuuf, inni akka koo nama foonii miti.
english: For he is not a man, as I am, that I should answer him, that we should come together in judgment.

kikuyu: Utuu namni nu lamaan irra harka kaaʼu, kan gidduu keenyattis araara buusu tokko jiraatee,
english: There is no umpire between us, that might lay his hand on us both.

kikuyu: utuu Waaqni ulee isaa narraa kaasee silaa naasisuun isaa na hin sodaachisu ture.
english: Let him take his rod away from me. Let his terror not make me afraid;

kikuyu: Silaa ani utuun isa hin sodaatin nan dubbadhan ture; haalan amma keessa jiruun garuu hin dandaʼu.
english: then I would speak, and not fear him, for I am not so in myself.

kikuyu: “Ani jireenya koo akka malee jibbeera; kanaafuu caalchisee nan guunguma; hadhaaʼummaa lubbuu kootiinis nan dubbadha.
english: “My soul is weary of my life. I will give free course to my complaint. I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

kikuyu: Waaqaanis akkana nan jedha: Ati maaliin akka na himattu natti himi malee natti hin murin.
english: I will tell God, ‘Do not condemn me. Show me why you contend with me.

kikuyu: Hojii jalʼootaa gammachuudhaan fudhattee ana immoo yommuu cunqursitu, hojii harka keetiis yommuu tuffattu sitti tolaa?
english: Is it good to you that you should oppress, that you should despise the work of your hands, and smile on the counsel of the wicked?

kikuyu: Ati ija foonii qabdaa? Akka namni ilaaluttis ni ilaaltaa?
english: Do you have eyes of flesh? Or do you see as man sees?

kikuyu: Barri kee akka bara namaatii? Yookaan waggoonni kee akka waggoota namaatii?
english: Are your days as the days of mortals, or your years as man’s years,

kikuyu: Yoos ati maaliif balleessaa koo barbaaddee cubbuu koo qoratta?
english: that you inquire after my iniquity, and search after my sin?

kikuyu: Taʼus ati akka ani yakka hin qabnee fi akka namni harka keetii na baasu tokko iyyuu hin jirre ni beekta.
english: Although you know that I am not wicked, there is no one who can deliver out of your hand.

kikuyu: “Harki kee tolchee na uume. Ati amma deebitee na balleessitaa?
english: “‘Your hands have framed me and fashioned me altogether, yet you destroy me.

kikuyu: Akka supheetti na tolchuu kee yaadadhu. Ati amma gara biyyootti na deebiftaa?
english: Remember, I beg you, that you have fashioned me as clay. Will you bring me into dust again?

kikuyu: Ati akka aannanii na hin dhangalaafnee? Akka baaduus na hin itichinee?
english: Haven’t you poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

kikuyu: Ati gogaa fi foon natti uffifte; lafee fi ribuudhaanis walitti hodhitee na tolchite.
english: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and knit me together with bones and sinews.

kikuyu: Ati jireenya naa kennitee gaarummaa natti argisiifte; kunuunsi kees hafuura koo naa eege.
english: You have granted me life and loving kindness. Your visitation has preserved my spirit.

kikuyu: “Ati garuu waan kana hunda garaatti qabatte; anis akka wanni kun yaada kee keessa jiru nan beeka.
english: Yet you hid these things in your heart. I know that this is with you:

kikuyu: Ati yoo ani cubbuu hojjedhe na argita; balleessaa koos utuu hin adabin bira hin dabartu.
english: if I sin, then you mark me. You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

kikuyu: Yoo ani yakka hojjedhe, anaaf wayyoo! Ani yoo nama balleessaa hin qabne taʼe illee, mataa koo ol qabachuu hin dandaʼu; ani salphina uffadhee dhiphina keessa seeneeraatii.
english: If I am wicked, woe to me. If I am righteous, I still will not lift up my head, being filled with disgrace, and conscious of my affliction.

kikuyu: Yoo ani mataa ol qabadhe ati akka leenca waa adamsuu na adamsita; humna kee sodaachisaa sanas ammumaa amma natti argisiifta.
