english: If my head is held high, you hunt me like a lion. Again you show yourself powerful to me.

kikuyu: Ati dhuga baatota haaraa natti fiddee dheekkamsa kee natti dabalta; loltuus natti fidda.
english: You renew your witnesses against me, and increase your indignation on me. Changes and warfare are with me.

kikuyu: “Egaa ati maaliif gadameessa keessaa na baafte? Utuu iji tokko iyyuu na hin argin utuun duʼee.
english: “‘Why, then, have you brought me out of the womb? I wish I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me.

kikuyu: Ani utuun dhalachuu baadhee yookaan utuun akkuman dhaladheen awwaalamee jiraadhee!
english: I should have been as though I had not been. I should have been carried from the womb to the grave.

kikuyu: Barri koo gabaabaan dhumaa jira mitii? Akka ani yeroo xinnoof gammaduuf narraa deebiʼi;
english: Aren’t my days few? Stop! Leave me alone, that I may find a little comfort,

kikuyu: utuu ani lafa dhaqanii hin deebine, biyya dimimmisaa fi dukkana limixii hin dhaqin dura,
english: before I go where I will not return from, to the land of darkness and of the shadow of death;

kikuyu: gara biyya dimimmisaaʼaa akka dukkanaa, biyya gaaddidduu duʼaatiin guutame, kan ifni iyyuu akkuma dukkanaa taʼee hin dhaqin, narraa deebiʼi.”
english: the land dark as midnight, of the shadow of death, without any order, where the light is as midnight.’”

kikuyu: Zoofaari Naaʼimaatichi akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Zophar, the Naamathite, answered,

kikuyu: “Dubbiiwwan kunneen hundi deebii argachuu hin qabanii? Dubbii baayʼisuun qajeelaa nama godhaa?
english: “Shouldn’t the multitude of words be answered? Should a man full of talk be justified?

kikuyu: Of jajuun kee afaan nama qabachiisaa? Yommuu ati qoostu namni si ifatu hin jiruu?
english: Should your boastings make men hold their peace? When you mock, will no man make you ashamed?

kikuyu: Ati Waaqaan, ‘Barsiisni koo qulqulluu dha; ani fuula kee duratti hirʼina hin qabu’ jetta.
english: For you say, ‘My doctrine is pure. I am clean in your eyes.’

kikuyu: Maaloo utuu Waaqni sitti dubbatee, utuu afaan isaas sitti saaqqatee
english: But oh that God would speak, and open his lips against you,

kikuyu: icciitii ogummaa siif ibsee ani akkamin hawwa! Ogummaan dhugaan bifa lama qabaatii. Kanaafuu Waaqni cubbuu kee muraasa akka siif irraanfate beeki.
english: that he would show you the secrets of wisdom! For true wisdom has two sides. Know therefore that God exacts of you less than your iniquity deserves.

kikuyu: “Icciitii Waaqaa qorattee bira gaʼuu yookaan yaada Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼuu qorattee bira gaʼuu dandeessaa?
english: “Can you fathom the mystery of God? Or can you probe the limits of the Almighty?

kikuyu: Isaan samiiwwan caalaa ol fagaatu; ati maal gochuu dandeessa? Qilee awwaalaa caalaas gad fagaatu; ati maal beekuu dandeessa?
english: They are high as heaven. What can you do? They are deeper than Sheol. What can you know?

kikuyu: Safarri isaa lafa caalaa dheerata; galaana caalaa balʼata.
english: Its measure is longer than the earth, and broader than the sea.

kikuyu: “Yoo inni dhufee mana hidhaatti si galche, yoo waldaa murtiis walitti qabe eenyutu isa dhowwuu dandaʼa?
english: If he passes by, or confines, or convenes a court, then who can oppose him?

kikuyu: Dhugumaan inni sobdoota ni beeka; inni yommuu jalʼina argutti hin qalbeeffatuu?
english: For he knows false men. He sees iniquity also, even though he doesn’t consider it.

kikuyu: Yoo harreen diidaa nama taʼee dhalate malee gowwaan ogeessa taʼuu hin dandaʼu.
english: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.

kikuyu: “Taʼus yoo ati yaada kee gara isaatti deebiftee harka kees gara isaatti diriirsite,
english: “If you set your heart aright, stretch out your hands toward him.

kikuyu: cubbuu harka kee keessa jiru yoo of irraa fageessite, akka wanni hamaanis dunkaana kee keessa hin jiraanne yoo goote,
english: If iniquity is in your hand, put it far away. Don’t let unrighteousness dwell in your tents.

kikuyu: ati qaanii tokko malee fuula kee ol qabachuu dandeessa; sodaa tokko malees jabaattee dhaabatta.
english: Surely then you will lift up your face without spot. Yes, you will be steadfast, and will not fear,

kikuyu: Ati dhugumaan rakkina kee ni irraanfatta; akkuma lolaa darbeettis ni lakkoofta.
english: for you will forget your misery. You will remember it like waters that have passed away.

kikuyu: Jireenyi kee aduu saafaa caalaa ifa; dukkanni isaas akkuma barii ganamaa taʼa.
english: Life will be clearer than the noonday. Though there is darkness, it will be as the morning.

kikuyu: Waan abdiin jiruuf ati hin sodaattu; naannoo kee ni ilaalta; nagaadhaanis ni boqotta.
english: You will be secure, because there is hope. Yes, you will search, and will take your rest in safety.

kikuyu: Ati ni rafta; namni tokko iyyuu si hin sodaachisu; namoonni baayʼeenis fuula kee barbaadu.
english: Also you will lie down, and no one will make you afraid. Yes, many will court your favor.

kikuyu: Iji hamootaa ni dadhaba; karaan ittiin baqatanis isaan jalaa bada; abdiin isaaniis duʼa qofa.”
english: But the eyes of the wicked will fail. They will have no way to flee. Their hope will be the giving up of the spirit.”

kikuyu: Iyyoob akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Nama jechuun dhugumaan isin; ogummaanis isin wajjin duuti!
english: “No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.

kikuyu: Garuu anis akkuma keessan sammuun qaba; ani isinii gad miti. Namni waan akkanaa hin beekne eenyu?
english: But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?

kikuyu: “Ani nama Waaqa waammatee deebii argate taʼu illee, michoota koo biratti nama kolfaa taʼeera. Ani utuun nama qajeelaa hirʼina hin qabne taʼee jiruu nama kolfaa taʼeera.
english: I am like one who is a joke to his neighbor, I, who called on God, and he answered. The just, the blameless man is a joke.

kikuyu: Warri itti tole rakkinatti qoosu; nama kufuuf miilli isaa mucucaateenis kun hiree isaati jedhu.
english: In the thought of him who is at ease there is contempt for misfortune. It is ready for them whose foot slips.

kikuyu: Dunkaanni saamtotaa hin jeeqamu; warri Waaqa isaanii harkatti baatanii jooran, warri Waaqa dheekkamsiisan nagaan jiraatu.
english: The tents of robbers prosper. Those who provoke God are secure, who carry their god in their hands.

kikuyu: “Mee horii gaafadhu; isaan si barsiisu; yookaan simbirroota samii gaafadhu; isaan sitti himu;
english: “But ask the animals now, and they will teach you; the birds of the sky, and they will tell you.

kikuyu: yookaan lafatti dubbadhu; inni si barsiisa; yookaan qurxummiiwwan galaanaa sitti haa himan.
english: Or speak to the earth, and it will teach you. The fish of the sea will declare to you.

kikuyu: Akka harki Waaqayyoo waan kana hojjete, isaan kanneen hunda keessaa eenyutu hin beekne?
english: Who doesn’t know that in all these, the LORD’s hand has done this,

kikuyu: Lubbuun uumama hundaa, hafuurri nama hundaas harka isaa keessa jira.
english: in whose hand is the life of every living thing, and the breath of all mankind?

kikuyu: Akkuma arrabni nyaata afaaniin qabu, gurris dubbii dhagaʼee addaan hin baasuu?
english: Doesn’t the ear try words, even as the palate tastes its food?

kikuyu: Ogummaan jaarsolii biratti, hubannaanis warra umuriin dheerate biratti argama mitii?
english: With aged men is wisdom, in length of days understanding.

kikuyu: “Ogummaa fi humni kan Waaqaa ti; gorsii fi hubannaanis kan isaa ti.
english: “With God is wisdom and might. He has counsel and understanding.

kikuyu: Waan inni diigu eenyu iyyuu deebisee ijaaruu hin dandaʼu; nama inni hidhe eenyu iyyuu hiikuu hin dandaʼu.
english: Behold, he breaks down, and it can’t be built again. He imprisons a man, and there can be no release.

kikuyu: Yoo inni bishaan dhowwate, hongeetu buʼa; yoo inni gad dhiise immoo biyya balleessa.
english: Behold, he withholds the waters, and they dry up. Again, he sends them out, and they overturn the earth.

kikuyu: Jabinnii fi ogummaan kan isaa ti; namni gowwoomfamuu fi inni gowwoomsus kanuma isaa ti.
english: With him is strength and wisdom. The deceived and the deceiver are his.

kikuyu: Inni gorsitoota qullaa deemsisa; abbootii murtiis gowwoota godha.
english: He leads counselors away stripped. He makes judges fools.

kikuyu: Inni mootota irraa hidhaa hiikee, mudhii isaaniitti sabbata hidha.
english: He loosens the bond of kings. He binds their waist with a belt.

kikuyu: Luboota qullaa deemsisa; jajjabeeyyiis ni gaggaragalcha.
english: He leads priests away stripped, and overthrows the mighty.

kikuyu: Gorsitoota amanamoo afaan qabachiisa; hubannaa jaarsoliis irraa fuudha.
english: He removes the speech of those who are trusted, and takes away the understanding of the elders.

kikuyu: Warra kabajamootti salphina fida; warra jajjaboo immoo hidhata hiikachiisa.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and loosens the belt of the strong.

kikuyu: Inni icciitii dukkanaa keessaa ifatti baasa; dukkana limixiis ifatti geeddara.
english: He uncovers deep things out of darkness, and brings out to light the shadow of death.

kikuyu: Inni saboota ni guddisa; ni balleessas; saboota ni baayʼisa; ni bittinneessas.
english: He increases the nations, and he destroys them. He enlarges the nations, and he leads them captive.

kikuyu: Bulchitoota addunyaa hubannaa malee hambisa; gammoojjii daandii hin qabne keessas isaan joorsa.
english: He takes away understanding from the chiefs of the people of the earth, and causes them to wander in a wilderness where there is no way.

kikuyu: Isaan dukkana ifa hin qabne keessa qaqqabannaadhaan deemu; inni akka isaan akkuma nama machaaʼeetti gatantaranis ni godha.
english: They grope in the dark without light. He makes them stagger like a drunken man.

kikuyu: “Waan kana hunda iji koo argeera; gurri koos dhagaʼee hubateera.
english: “Behold, my eye has seen all this. My ear has heard and understood it.

kikuyu: Waan isin beektan anis beeka; ani isinii gad miti.
english: What you know, I know also. I am not inferior to you.

kikuyu: Ani garuu Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼutti nan dubbadha; waaʼee dhimma koos Waaqatti falmuu nan barbaada.
english: “Surely I would speak to the Almighty. I desire to reason with God.

kikuyu: Isin garuu sobaan nama faaltu; hundi keessan abbootii qorichaa kanneen faayidaa hin qabnee dha!
english: But you are forgers of lies. You are all physicians of no value.

kikuyu: Isin yoo cal jettan maal qaba! Wanni sun ogummaa isiniif taʼa.
english: Oh that you would be completely silent! Then you would be wise.

kikuyu: Amma falmii koo dhagaʼaa; kadhannaa afaan kootiis dhaggeeffadhaa.
english: Hear now my reasoning. Listen to the pleadings of my lips.

kikuyu: Isin jalʼinaan Waaqaaf dubbattuu? Gowwoomsaadhaanis isaaf odeessituu?
english: Will you speak unrighteously for God, and talk deceitfully for him?

kikuyu: Isaaf ni loogduu? Waaqaafis ni falmituu?
english: Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?

kikuyu: Yoo inni isin qore wanni gaariin isin irraa argamaa? Isin akka nama gowwoomsitan, isa gowwoomsuu dandeessuu?
english: Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?

kikuyu: Yoo isin dhoksaadhaan loogii hojjettan, inni dhugumaan isinitti dheekkama.
english: He will surely reprove you if you secretly show partiality.

kikuyu: Surraan isaa isin hin sodaachisuu? Sodaachisuun isaa isinitti hin dhagaʼamuu?
english: Won’t his majesty make you afraid and his dread fall on you?

kikuyu: Fakkeenyi keessan fakkeenya daaraa ti; daʼoon keessanis daʼoo suphee ti.
english: Your memorable sayings are proverbs of ashes. Your defenses are defenses of clay.

kikuyu: “Akka ani dubbadhuuf isin cal jedhaa; ergasii wanni barbaade natti haa dhufu.
english: “Be silent! Leave me alone, that I may speak. Let come on me what will.

kikuyu: Ani maaliifin foon koo ilkaan kootiin, lubbuu koos harka kootiin qabadha?
english: Why should I take my flesh in my teeth, and put my life in my hand?

kikuyu: Yoo inni na ajjeese iyyuu ani isa nan abdadha; waaʼee dhimma kootii illee fuula isaa duratti nan falmadha.
english: Behold, he will kill me. I have no hope. Nevertheless, I will maintain my ways before him.

kikuyu: Kun fayyina koo ni taʼa; warri Waaqatti hin bulle fuula isaa duratti dhiʼaachuu hin dandaʼaniitii!
english: This also will be my salvation, that a godless man will not come before him.

kikuyu: Dubbii koo qalbeeffadhaa dhaggeeffadhaa; waan ani jedhus gurri keessan haa dhagaʼu.
english: Listen carefully to my speech. Let my declaration be in your ears.

kikuyu: Kunoo ani himata koo qopheeffadheera; akka inni murtii qajeelaa naa kennus nan beeka.
english: See now, I have set my cause in order. I know that I am righteous.

kikuyu: Namni na himatu jiraa? Yoo jiraate, ani nan calʼisa; nan duʼas.
english: Who is he who will contend with me? For then I would hold my peace and give up the spirit.

kikuyu: “Yaa Waaqayyo, ati wantoota kanneen lamaan naa kenni malee ani fuula kee duraa hin dhokadhu.
english: “Only don’t do two things to me, then I will not hide myself from your face:

kikuyu: Harka kee narraa fageessi; sodaachisni kees na hin rifachiisin.
english: withdraw your hand far from me, and don’t let your terror make me afraid.

kikuyu: Ergasii na waami; anis nan owwaadha; yookaan nan dubbadha; ati immoo deebii naa kennita.
english: Then call, and I will answer, or let me speak, and you answer me.

kikuyu: Ani balleessaa fi cubbuu hammamin hojjedhe? Yakka kootii fi cubbuu koo na beeksisi.
english: How many are my iniquities and sins? Make me know my disobedience and my sin.

kikuyu: Ati maaliif fuula kee dhokfattee akka diinaatti na ilaalta?
english: Why do you hide your face, and consider me your enemy?

kikuyu: Baala qilleensi harcaase ni ciccirtaa? Habaqii gogaa ni ariitaa?
english: Will you harass a driven leaf? Will you pursue the dry stubble?

kikuyu: Ati waan ittiin na hadheessitu natti barreessitaatii; cubbuu dargaggummaa kootiis na dhaalchifta.
english: For you write bitter things against me, and make me inherit the iniquities of my youth.

kikuyu: Miilla koo jirma gidduu galchita; faana miilla kootiitti mallattoo gootee karaa koo hunda xiyyeeffattee duukaa buuta.
english: You also put my feet in the stocks, and mark all my paths. You set a bound to the soles of my feet,

kikuyu: “Namnis akkuma waan bososeetti, akkuma wayyaa biliin nyaateetti ni dhuma.
english: though I am decaying like a rotten thing, like a garment that is moth-eaten.

kikuyu: “Nama dubartoota irraa dhalate, barri isaa gabaabaa fi kan rakkinaan guutamee dha.
english: “Man, who is born of a woman, is of few days, and full of trouble.

kikuyu: Inni akkuma daraaraa ni biqila; ni coollagas; akkuma gaaddidduu ariifatee darba malee hin turu.
english: He grows up like a flower, and is cut down. He also flees like a shadow, and doesn’t continue.

kikuyu: Iji kee nama akkasii xiyyeeffatee ilaalaa? Ati murtiif fuula kee duratti isa fiddaa?
english: Do you open your eyes on such a one, and bring me into judgment with you?

kikuyu: Eenyutu waan xuraaʼaa keessaa waan qulqullaaʼaa baasuu dandaʼa? Namni tokko iyyuu hin dandaʼu!
english: Who can bring a clean thing out of an unclean? Not one.

kikuyu: Barri jireenya namaa murtaaʼaa dha; baayʼinni jiʼoota isaas si bira jira; daangaa inni darbuu hin dandeenye daangessiteefii jirta.
english: Seeing his days are determined, the number of his months is with you, and you have appointed his bounds that he can’t pass.

kikuyu: Hamma inni akka hojjetaa tokkootti bara isaa raawwatutti, fuula kee isa irraa deebifadhu; isas dhiisi.
english: Look away from him, that he may rest, until he accomplishes, as a hireling, his day.

kikuyu: “Mukni illee abdii qaba: Yoo murame deebiʼee ni lata; dameen isaa haaraanis hin gogu.
english: “For there is hope for a tree if it is cut down, that it will sprout again, that the tender branch of it will not cease.

kikuyu: Yoo gufuun isaa lafa keessatti dulloomee gufuun isaa biyyoo keessatti tortore iyyuu,
english: Though its root grows old in the earth, and its stock dies in the ground,

kikuyu: foolii bishaaniitiin lata; akka biqiltuuttis damee ni baafata.
english: yet through the scent of water it will bud, and sprout boughs like a plant.

kikuyu: Namni garuu duʼee awwaalama; lubbuun isaa keessaa baati; innis hin jiraatu.
english: But man dies, and is laid low. Yes, man gives up the spirit, and where is he?

kikuyu: Akkuma bishaan galaanaa gogu yookaan lagnis dhumee gogu sana,
english: As the waters fail from the sea, and the river wastes and dries up,

kikuyu: namnis akkasuma ni ciisa; hin kaʼus; hamma samiiwwan darbanittis hin dammaqu yookaan hirribaa hin kaʼu.
english: so man lies down and doesn’t rise. Until the heavens are no more, they will not awake, nor be roused out of their sleep.

kikuyu: “Maaloo utuu awwaala keessa na dhoksitee hamma dheekkamsi kee darbutti na haguugdee! Maaloo utuu beellama naa kennitee ergasii immoo na yaadattee!
english: “Oh that you would hide me in Sheol, that you would keep me secret until your wrath is past, that you would appoint me a set time and remember me!

kikuyu: Namni tokko yoo duʼe deebiʼee ni jiraataa? Ani hamma haaromfamni koo dhufutti, bara rakkoo koo hunda obsaan nan eeggadha.
english: If a man dies, will he live again? I would wait all the days of my warfare, until my release should come.

kikuyu: Ati na waamta; anis si jalaa nan owwaadha; hojii harka keetiis ni hawwita.
english: You would call, and I would answer you. You would have a desire for the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana ati tarkaanfii koo ni lakkoofta; cubbuu koo garuu hin toʼattu.
english: But now you count my steps. Don’t you watch over my sin?

kikuyu: Yakki koo korojootti naqamee chaappeffama; ati cubbuu koo ni haguugda.
english: My disobedience is sealed up in a bag. You fasten up my iniquity.

kikuyu: “Garuu akkuma tulluun lolaadhaan dhiqamee jigu, kattaanis iddoo isaatii buqqaʼu sana,
english: “But the mountain falling comes to nothing. The rock is removed out of its place.

kikuyu: akkuma bishaan dhagaa nyaatee haphisu, akkuma lolaan biyyoo dhiqu sana, atis akkasuma abdii namaa ni balleessita.
english: The waters wear the stones. The torrents of it wash away the dust of the earth. So you destroy the hope of man.

kikuyu: Ati bara baraan isa ni moota; innis ni bada; bifa isaa ni geeddarta; of irraas isa fageessita.
english: You forever prevail against him, and he departs. You change his face, and send him away.

kikuyu: Yoo ilmaan isaa ulfina argatan inni hin beeku; yoo isaan salphatanis hin argu.
english: His sons come to honor, and he doesn’t know it. They are brought low, but he doesn’t perceive it of them.

kikuyu: Dhukkuba dhagna isaa qofatu isatti dhagaʼama; inni mataa isaa qofaaf booʼa.”
english: But his flesh on him has pain, and his soul within him mourns.”

kikuyu: Eliifaaz Teemaanichi akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

kikuyu: “Namni ogeessi tokko dubbii faayidaa hin qabneen deebii kennaa? Yookaan bubbee baʼa biiftuutiin garaa isaa guutataa?
english: “Should a wise man answer with vain knowledge, and fill himself with the east wind?

kikuyu: Inni dubbii faayidaa hin qabneen, haasaa buʼaa hin qabneenis ni falmaa?
english: Should he reason with unprofitable talk, or with speeches with which he can do no good?

kikuyu: Ati garuu Waaqa sodaachuu ni tuffatta; Waaqa kadhachuu illee nama dhowwita.
english: Yes, you do away with fear, and hinder devotion before God.

kikuyu: Cubbuun kee afaan kee ni barsiifti; atis afaan jalʼootaa filatta.
english: For your iniquity teaches your mouth, and you choose the language of the crafty.

kikuyu: Afaanuma keetu sitti mura malee afaan koo miti; arrabuma keetu ragaa sitti taʼa.
english: Your own mouth condemns you, and not I. Yes, your own lips testify against you.

kikuyu: “Situ nama hunda dura dhalatee? Yookaan situ tulluuwwan dura argamee?
english: “Are you the first man who was born? Or were you brought out before the hills?

kikuyu: Ati dhoksaa Waaqaa dhageesseertaa? Ogummaas ofuma keetiif dhuunfattaa?
english: Have you heard the secret counsel of God? Do you limit wisdom to yourself?

kikuyu: Wanni ati beektu kan nu hin beekne maali? Hubannaan ati qabdu kan nu hin qabne maali?
english: What do you know that we don’t know? What do you understand which is not in us?

kikuyu: Namoonni arrii baasanii fi kanneen jaaran, warri abbaa kee iyyuu caalaa dullooman nu gidduu jiru.
english: With us are both the gray-headed and the very aged men, much older than your father.

kikuyu: Gorsi Waaqaa kan nama jajjabeessu, dubbiin suutaan sitti himame sun si hanqatee?
english: Are the consolations of God too small for you, even the word that is gentle toward you?

kikuyu: Yaadni kee maaliif si fudhatee bada? Ijas maaliif babaafta?
english: Why does your heart carry you away? Why do your eyes flash,

kikuyu: Wanni akka ati Waaqatti aartu, akka dubbiin akkasiis afaan keetii baʼu godhe maali?
english: that you turn your spirit against God, and let such words go out of your mouth?

kikuyu: “Akka qulqulluu taʼuuf namni maali? Yookaan akka qajeeltota taʼaniif warri dubartoota irraa dhalatan maali?
english: What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?

kikuyu: Yoo Waaqni qulqulloota isaa illee amanuu baatee samiiwwan iyyuu fuula isaa duratti qulqulluu taʼuu baatan,
english: Behold, he puts no trust in his holy ones. Yes, the heavens are not clean in his sight;

kikuyu: yoos sanyiin namaa inni hamaa fi xuraaʼaan, kan akkuma bishaaniitti cubbuu dhugu sun hammam hammasii gad haa taʼu ree!
english: how much less one who is abominable and corrupt, a man who drinks iniquity like water!

kikuyu: “Na dhaggeeffadhu; ani siifan ibsaa; waanan arges sitti nan hima;
english: “I will show you, listen to me; that which I have seen I will declare

kikuyu: waan namoonni ogeeyyiin waan abbootii isaanii irraa dhagaʼan keessaa tokko illee utuu hin dhoksin odeessan sana nan dubbadha;
english: (which wise men have told by their fathers, and have not hidden it;

kikuyu: biyyattiin abbootii isaanii qofaaf kennamte; alagaan tokko iyyuu isaan gidduu hin jiraanne.
english: to whom alone the land was given, and no stranger passed among them):

kikuyu: Namni dabaan bara jireenya isaa guutuu, gara jabeessis bara isaaf qoodame guutuu ni rakkata.
english: the wicked man writhes in pain all his days, even the number of years that are laid up for the oppressor.

kikuyu: Sagaleen sodaachisaan gurra isaatti ni iyya; utuma inni nagaan jiraatuus saamtonni tasuma itti dhufu.
english: A sound of terrors is in his ears. In prosperity the destroyer will come on him.

kikuyu: Inni akka deebiʼee dukkana keessaa baʼu hin amanu; goraadeetu isa eeggata.
english: He doesn’t believe that he will return out of darkness. He is waited for by the sword.

kikuyu: Inni waan nyaatamu barbaacha asii fi achi joora; akka guyyaan dukkanaa dhiʼaates ni beeka.
english: He wanders abroad for bread, saying, ‘Where is it?’ He knows that the day of darkness is ready at his hand.

kikuyu: Dhiphinaa fi gaddi isa sodaachisu; akkuma mootii lolaaf qophaaʼeettis isatti cimu;
english: Distress and anguish make him afraid. They prevail against him, as a king ready to the battle.

kikuyu: inni harka isaa Waaqatti ol fudhatee Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼus tuffateera;
english: Because he has stretched out his hand against God, and behaves himself proudly against the Almighty,

kikuyu: gaachana yabbuu fi jabaa qabatee isaan mormuuf mata jabinaan baʼeera.
english: he runs at him with a stiff neck, with the thick shields of his bucklers,

kikuyu: “Yoo fuulli isaa coomaan haguugamee mudhiin isaa foon baasee iitaʼe iyyuu,
english: because he has covered his face with his fatness, and gathered fat on his thighs.

kikuyu: inni magaalaawwan barbadaaʼan keessa, manneen namni tokko iyyuu keessa hin jiraanne, kanneen diigamanii tuulamuu gaʼan keessa jiraata.
english: He has lived in desolate cities, in houses which no one inhabited, which were ready to become heaps.

kikuyu: Inni siʼachi hin sooromu; qabeenyi isaas hin jiraatu; yookaan qabeenyi isaa lafa irra hin turu.
english: He will not be rich, neither will his substance continue, neither will their possessions be extended on the earth.

kikuyu: Inni dukkana jalaa hin baʼu; arrabni ibiddaa damee isaa ni gogsa; hafuurri afaan Waaqaatii baʼus isa fudhata.
english: He will not depart out of darkness. The flame will dry up his branches. He will go away by the breath of God’s mouth.

kikuyu: Inni sababii beenyaa tokko illee hin arganneef, waan faayidaa hin qabne amanachuudhaan of hin gowwoomsin.
english: Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself, for emptiness will be his reward.

kikuyu: Inni utuu yeroon isaa hin gaʼin ni coollaga; dameen isaas hin lalisu.
english: It will be accomplished before his time. His branch will not be green.

kikuyu: Inni akka muka wayinii iji isaa utuu hin bilchaatin irraa funaanamee, akka ejersa daraaraa isaa of irraa harcaasee ni taʼa.
english: He will shake off his unripe grape as the vine, and will cast off his flower as the olive tree.

kikuyu: Gareen warra Waaqaaf hin bullee ni maseena; ibiddis dunkaana warra mattaʼaa jaallatanii ni guba.
english: For the company of the godless will be barren, and fire will consume the tents of bribery.

kikuyu: Isaan rakkina ulfaaʼanii hammina dhalan; garaan isaaniis jalʼina yaada.”
english: They conceive mischief and produce iniquity. Their heart prepares deceit.”

kikuyu: Iyyoobis akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Ani waan akkanaa baayʼee dhagaʼeera; hundi keessan jajjabeessitoota nama dhiphistanii dha!
english: “I have heard many such things. You are all miserable comforters!

kikuyu: Haasaan faayidaa hin qabne kun hin dhumuu? Wanni akka ati oduu dheeressituuf si tuttuqu maali?
english: Shall vain words have an end? Or what provokes you that you answer?

kikuyu: Utuu isin iddoo koo jiraattanii silaa ani akkuma keessan kana nan dubbadha ture; dubbii miʼooftuu dubbachuudhaanis mataa koo isinitti nan raasan ture.
english: I also could speak as you do. If your soul were in my soul’s place, I could join words together against you, and shake my head at you,

kikuyu: Ani afaan kootiin isin jajjabeessee gorsi arraba kootiis qabbana isinii kenna ture.
english: but I would strengthen you with my mouth. The solace of my lips would relieve you.

kikuyu: “Yoo ani dubbadhe dhukkubni koo natti hin wayyaaʼu; cal jedhus na hin dhiisu.
english: “Though I speak, my grief is not subsided. Though I forbear, what am I eased?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, ati dhugumaan na dadhabsiifteerta; warra mana koo jiru hundas balleessiteerta.
english: But now, God, you have surely worn me out. You have made all my company desolate.

kikuyu: Ati na kokotteessite; kunis ragaa natti taʼe; akka malee huqqachuun koos ifatti baʼee na saaxile.
english: You have shriveled me up. This is a witness against me. My leanness rises up against me. It testifies to my face.

kikuyu: Waaqni dheekkamsa isaatiin rukutee na ciccire; ilkaan isaa natti qarate; diinni koo ija isaa natti babaase.
english: He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me. He has gnashed on me with his teeth. My adversary sharpens his eyes on me.

kikuyu: Namoonni natti qoosuuf afaan banatan; tuffiidhaan maddii koo kabalan; tokko taʼanii natti kaʼan.
english: They have gaped on me with their mouth. They have struck me on the cheek reproachfully. They gather themselves together against me.

kikuyu: Waaqnis dabarsee hamootatti na kenne; harka jalʼootaa keessas na buuse.
english: God delivers me to the ungodly, and casts me into the hands of the wicked.

kikuyu: Ani nagaan jiraachaan ture; inni garuu na burkuteesse; morma na qabee na caccabse. Xiyyeeffannaa isaas na godhate;
english: I was at ease, and he broke me apart. Yes, he has taken me by the neck, and dashed me to pieces. He has also set me up for his target.

kikuyu: loltoonni isaa warri xiyyaan lolan na marsu. Inni gara laafina malee kalee koo waraanee hadhooftuu koo illee lafatti gad jigse.
english: His archers surround me. He splits my kidneys apart, and does not spare. He pours out my bile on the ground.

kikuyu: Inni ammumaa amma na caccabsa; akkuma loltuu tokkootti natti fiiga.
english: He breaks me with breach on breach. He runs at me like a giant.

kikuyu: “Ani gogaa kootti uffata gaddaa hodhadheera; gaanfa koos biyyoo keessatti awwaaleera.
english: I have sewed sackcloth on my skin, and have thrust my horn in the dust.

kikuyu: Fuulli koo booʼichaan diimateera; dukkanni limixiinis ija koo irra buʼeera.
english: My face is red with weeping. Deep darkness is on my eyelids,

kikuyu: Taʼus harki koo yakka tokko illee hin hojjenne; kadhannaan koos qulqulluu dha.
english: although there is no violence in my hands, and my prayer is pure.

kikuyu: “Yaa lafa, ati dhiiga koo hin dhoksin; akka iyyi koo iddoo boqonnaa argatus hin godhin!
english: “Earth, don’t cover my blood. Let my cry have no place to rest.

kikuyu: Amma iyyuu dhuga baʼaan koo samii irra jira; abukaattoon koos ol gubbaa jira.
english: Even now, behold, my witness is in heaven. He who vouches for me is on high.

kikuyu: Michoonni koo na tuffatu; iji koos imimmaan gara Waaqaatti facaasa;
english: My friends scoff at me. My eyes pour out tears to God,

kikuyu: akkuma namni michuu isaatiif kadhatu sana utuu namni Waaqa kadhatu namaaf jiraatee!
english: that he would maintain the right of a man with God, of a son of man with his neighbor!

kikuyu: “Waggoota xinnoo booddee, ani gara deemanii deebiʼuun hin jirre nan deema.
english: For when a few years have come, I will go the way of no return.

kikuyu: Hafuurri koo dadhabeera; barri koo gabaabbateera; awwaallis naa qopheeffameera.
english: “My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct and the grave is ready for me.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan qoostonni na marsaniiru; iji koos hojii isaanii isa hamaa sana hubatee ilaala.
english: Surely there are mockers with me. My eye dwells on their provocation.

kikuyu: “Yaa Waaqi, qabsiisa naa taʼi; si malee eenyutu wabii naa taʼa?
english: “Now give a pledge. Be collateral for me with yourself. Who is there who will strike hands with me?

kikuyu: Akka isaan waa hin hubanneef ati sammuu isaanii cufteerta; kanaafuu ati akka isaan moʼatan hin gootu.
english: For you have hidden their heart from understanding, therefore you will not exalt them.

kikuyu: Yoo namni tokko faayidaa argachuuf michuu isaa maqaa balleesse, iji ijoollee isaa ni jaama.
english: He who denounces his friends for plunder, even the eyes of his children will fail.

kikuyu: “Waaqni nama hunda biratti nama kolfaa, nama namni fuula isaatti tufu na godheera.
english: “But he has made me a byword of the people. They spit in my face.

kikuyu: Iji koo sababii gaddaatiif arguu dhabe; dhagni koo guutuunis akkuma gaaddidduu ti.
english: My eye also is dim by reason of sorrow. All my members are as a shadow.

kikuyu: Qajeeltonni waan kanaan ni rifatu; namni balleessaa hin qabnes warra Waaqatti hin bulle irratti kaʼa.
english: Upright men will be astonished at this. The innocent will stir himself up against the godless.

kikuyu: Qajeelaan garuu karaa isaatti cima; warri harki isaanii qulqulluu taʼes jabaachaa deemu.
english: Yet the righteous will hold to his way. He who has clean hands will grow stronger and stronger.

kikuyu: “Hundi keessan garuu mee deebiʼaa yaalaa! Ani isin keessaa nama ogeessa tokko illee hin argadhu.
english: But as for you all, come back. I will not find a wise man among you.

kikuyu: Barri koo darbeera; karoorri koo fashalaaʼeera; hawwiin garaa koos akkasuma taʼeera.
english: My days are past. My plans are broken off, as are the thoughts of my heart.

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen halkan guyyaatti geeddaraniiru; utuma dukkana arganuus, ‘Ifni dhiʼaateera’ jedhu.
english: They change the night into day, saying ‘The light is near’ in the presence of darkness.

kikuyu: Yoo manni ani abdadhu awwaala qofa taʼe, yoo ani dukkana keessatti siree koo afadhe,
english: If I look for Sheol as my house, if I have spread my couch in the darkness,

kikuyu: yoo ani boolla qileetiin, ‘Ati abbaa koo ti;’ raammoodhaan immoo, ‘Ati haadha koo ti;’ yookaan ‘Obboleettii koo ti’ jedhe,
english: if I have said to corruption, ‘You are my father,’ and to the worm, ‘My mother,’ and ‘My sister,’

kikuyu: egaa abdiin koo eessa jira? Eenyutus abdii tokko illee naa arga?
english: where then is my hope? As for my hope, who will see it?

kikuyu: Inni na wajjin awwaala buʼaa? Nus walumaan biyyoo seennaa?”
english: Shall it go down with me to the gates of Sheol, or descend together into the dust?”

kikuyu: Bildaad Shuhaahichi akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

kikuyu: “Isin haasaa kana yoom fixxu? Mee qalbeeffadhaa; ergasii dubbachuu dandeenya.
english: “How long will you hunt for words? Consider, and afterwards we will speak.

kikuyu: Nu maaliif akka looniitti hedamna? Maaliifis fuula kee duratti akka gowwaatti ilaalamna?
english: Why are we counted as animals, which have become unclean in your sight?

kikuyu: Ati kan aariidhaan of ciccirtu, lafti sababii keetiif duwwaatti haftii? Yookaan kattaan iddoo isaatii ni buqqifamaa?
english: You who tear yourself in your anger, will the earth be forsaken for you? Or will the rock be removed out of its place?

kikuyu: “Ibsaan nama hamaa ni dhaama; arrabni ibidda isaa ifa hin kennu.
english: “Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.

kikuyu: Ifni dunkaana isaa keessaa ni dukkanaaʼa; ibsaan isa bira jirus ni dhaama.
english: The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.

kikuyu: Jabinni tarkaanfii isaa ni dadhaba; malli isaas isuma kuffisa.
english: The steps of his strength will be shortened. His own counsel will cast him down.

kikuyu: Miilli isaa kiyyoo keessa isa buusa; inni boolla kiyyeeffame irra ni joora.
english: For he is cast into a net by his own feet, and he wanders into its mesh.

kikuyu: Kiyyoon kottee isaa qaba; futtaasaanis jabeessee isa qaba.
english: A snare will take him by the heel. A trap will catch him.

kikuyu: Lafa irra funyoon isaaf dhokfameera; karaa isaa irras kiyyoon kaaʼameera.
english: A noose is hidden for him in the ground, a trap for him on the path.

kikuyu: Naasuun karaa hundaan isa sodaachisa; faana isaa buʼees isa ariʼa.
english: Terrors will make him afraid on every side, and will chase him at his heels.

kikuyu: Badiisni afaan itti banateera; balaanis qophaaʼee jiguu isaa eeggata.
english: His strength will be famished. Calamity will be ready at his side.

kikuyu: Gogaan isaa dhukkubaan nyaatamee dhuma; ilmi duʼaa hangaftichi harkaa fi miilla isaa nyaata.
english: The members of his body will be devoured. The firstborn of death will devour his members.

kikuyu: Inni dunkaana abdate keessaa buqqifamee gara mootii sodaatti geeffama.
english: He will be rooted out of the security of his tent. He will be brought to the king of terrors.

kikuyu: Waan kan isaa hin taʼinis dunkaana isaa keessa jiraata; dinyiin bobaʼus iddoo inni jiraatu irra faffacaʼa.
english: There will dwell in his tent that which is none of his. Sulfur will be scattered on his habitation.

kikuyu: Jalaan hiddi isaa ni goga; irraan immoo dameen isaa ni coollaga.
english: His roots will be dried up beneath. His branch will be cut off above.

kikuyu: Yaadannoon isaa lafa irraa ni bada; maqaan isaas lafa irraa ni dhabama.
english: His memory will perish from the earth. He will have no name in the street.

kikuyu: Inni ifa keessaa gara dukkanaatti darbatama; addunyaa irraas ni dhabama.
english: He will be driven from light into darkness, and chased out of the world.

kikuyu: Inni saba isaa gidduutti ijoollee yookaan sanyii, biyya duraan jiraate keessatti hambaa hin qabaatu.
english: He will have neither son nor grandson among his people, nor any remaining where he lived.

kikuyu: Namoonni dhiʼaa waaʼee isaa dhagaʼanii rifatu; warri baʼaas sodaadhaan guutamu.
english: Those who come after will be astonished at his day, as those who went before were frightened.

kikuyu: Iddoon jireenya nama hamaa, dhugumaan akkana taʼa; iddoon nama Waaqa hin beeknees kanuma taʼa.”
english: Surely such are the dwellings of the unrighteous. This is the place of him who doesn’t know God.”

kikuyu: Iyyoobis akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Isin hamma yoomiitti na dhiphistanii dubbiin na cabsitu?
english: “How long will you torment me, and crush me with words?

kikuyu: Amma siʼa kudhan na arrabsitaniirtu; qaanii malees na miitaniirtu.
english: You have reproached me ten times. You aren’t ashamed that you attack me.

kikuyu: Yoo ani dhugumaan karaa irraa goree jiraadhe, dogoggorri koo anuma wajjin jiraata.
english: If it is true that I have erred, my error remains with myself.

kikuyu: Yoo isin dhugumaan anaa olitti of guddiftanii na miidhuuf salphina kootti fayyadamtan,
english: If indeed you will magnify yourselves against me, and plead against me my reproach,

kikuyu: akka Waaqni na miidhee kiyyoo isaa illee natti xaxe beekaa.
english: know now that God has subverted me, and has surrounded me with his net.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ani miidhameera!’ jedhee iyyadhu illee deebii hin argadhu; sagalee ol fudhadhee gargaarsaaf iyyus murtiin qajeelaan hin jiru.
english: “Behold, I cry out of wrong, but I am not heard. I cry for help, but there is no justice.

kikuyu: Akka ani hin dabarreef inni karaa koo cufeera; daandii koottis dukkana haguugeera.
english: He has walled up my way so that I can’t pass, and has set darkness in my paths.

kikuyu: Ulfina koo narraa mulqeera; mataa koo irraas gonfoo fuudheera.
english: He has stripped me of my glory, and taken the crown from my head.

kikuyu: Inni hamma ani badutti gama hundaan na diiga; abdii koo illee akkuma mukaa buqqisa.
english: He has broken me down on every side, and I am gone. He has plucked my hope up like a tree.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsi isaa natti bobaʼa; akkuma diina isaattis na heda.
english: He has also kindled his wrath against me. He counts me among his adversaries.

kikuyu: Loltoonni isaa humnaan dhufanii naannoo kootti daʼannaa ijaarratan; dunkaana koos ni marsan.
english: His troops come on together, build a siege ramp against me, and encamp around my tent.

kikuyu: “Inni obboloota koo narraa fageesseera; michoonni koos keessummaa natti taʼan.
english: “He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.

kikuyu: Firoonni koo na dhiisaniiru; michuuwwan koos na dagataniiru.
english: My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.

kikuyu: Keessumoonni mana koo jiranii fi xomboreewwan koo akka alagaatti na ilaalan; akka nama ormaattis na hedan.
english: Those who dwell in my house and my maids consider me a stranger. I am an alien in their sight.

kikuyu: Hojjetaa koo nan waama; afaan kootiinis isa nan kadhadha; inni garuu na jalaa hin owwaatu.
english: I call to my servant, and he gives me no answer. I beg him with my mouth.

kikuyu: Hafuurri koo niitii kootti illee jibbisiisaa dha; ani obboloota koottis xiraaʼaa dha.
english: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen xixinnoon iyyuu na tuffatu; yommuu ani kaʼus natti qoosu.
english: Even young children despise me. If I arise, they speak against me.

kikuyu: Michoonni koo kanneen walitti dhiʼaannu hundi na balfan; warri ani jaalladhus natti garagalan.
english: All my familiar friends abhor me. They whom I loved have turned against me.

kikuyu: Ani gogaa fi lafeedha malee homaa miti; gogaan ilkaanii qofti naaf hafeen jalaa baʼe.
english: My bones stick to my skin and to my flesh. I have escaped by the skin of my teeth.

kikuyu: “Garaa naa laafaa, yaa michoota koo garaa naa laafaa; harki Waaqaa na dhaʼeeraatii.
english: “Have pity on me. Have pity on me, you my friends, for the hand of God has touched me.

kikuyu: Isin maaliif akkuma Waaqni na ariʼu sana na ariitu? Amma illee foon koo isin hin geenyee?
english: Why do you persecute me as God, and are not satisfied with my flesh?

kikuyu: “Maaloo utuu dubbiin koo barreeffamee jiraatee! Utuu kitaaba keessatti barreeffamee!
english: “Oh that my words were now written! Oh that they were inscribed in a book!

kikuyu: Utuu sibiilaan kattaa irratti barreeffamee yookaan bara baraan dhagaa irratti qirixamee jiraatee!
english: That with an iron pen and lead they were engraved in the rock forever!

kikuyu: Ani akka furiin koo jiraataa taʼe, akka inni dhuma irratti lafa irra dhaabatus nan beeka.
english: But as for me, I know that my Redeemer lives. In the end, he will stand upon the earth.

kikuyu: Erga gogaan koo badee booddee, ani amma iyyuu foon kootiin Waaqa nan arga;
english: After my skin is destroyed, then I will see God in my flesh,

kikuyu: ani mataan koo isa nan arga; utuu nama biraa hin taʼin anuu ija kootiin isa nan arga. Onneen koo akkam na keessatti gaggabdi!
english: whom I, even I, will see on my side. My eyes will see, and not as a stranger. “My heart is consumed within me.

kikuyu: “Yoo isin, ‘Sababii hiddi rakkina sanaa isa keessa jiruuf nu akkamitti isa ariina?’ jettan,
english: If you say, ‘How we will persecute him!’ because the root of the matter is found in me,

kikuyu: sababii dheekkamsi goraadeedhaan adabamuu fiduuf isin mataan keessan goraadee sodaachuu qabdu; kunis akka isin akka murtiin jiru beektaniif.”
english: be afraid of the sword, for wrath brings the punishments of the sword, that you may know there is a judgment.”

kikuyu: Zoofaari Naaʼimaatichi akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Zophar the Naamathite answered,

kikuyu: “Waan ani akka malee jeeqameef, yaadni koo akka ani deebii kennu na kakaasa.
english: “Therefore my thoughts answer me, even by reason of my haste that is in me.

kikuyu: Ani dheekkamsa na qaanessu dhagaʼaan jira; qalbiin koos akka ani deebii kennu na kakaasa.
english: I have heard the reproof which puts me to shame. The spirit of my understanding answers me.

kikuyu: “Ati erga namni lafa irra kaaʼamee bara duriitii jalqabee wanni kun akkam akka ture ni beekta mitii?
english: Don’t you know this from old time, since man was placed on earth,

kikuyu: Burraaquun jalʼootaa yeroo gabaabaaf tura; gammachuun warra Waaqaaf hin bullees akkuma liphsuu ijaa ti.
english: that the triumphing of the wicked is short, the joy of the godless but for a moment?

kikuyu: Of tuulummaan isaa samiiwwan gaʼee mataan isaa duumessawwan tuqus,
english: Though his height mount up to the heavens, and his head reach to the clouds,

kikuyu: inni akkuma awwaaraa bara baraan bada; warri duraan isa arganis, ‘Inni eessa jira?’ jedhu.
english: yet he will perish forever like his own dung. Those who have seen him will say, ‘Where is he?’

kikuyu: Inni akkuma abjuu fiigee bada; deebiʼees hin argamu; akkuma mulʼata halkaniis dafee dhabama.
english: He will fly away as a dream, and will not be found. Yes, he will be chased away like a vision of the night.

kikuyu: Iji isaa argee ture deebiʼee isa hin argu; iddoon isaas siʼachi isa hin ilaalu.
english: The eye which saw him will see him no more, neither will his place see him any more.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen isaa hiyyeeyyiif beenyaa baasu; harki isaas qabeenya inni saame deebisee kennuu qaba.
english: His children will seek the favor of the poor. His hands will give back his wealth.

kikuyu: Jabinni dargaggummaa kan lafee isaa keessa guute sun, isa wajjin biyyoo keessa ciisa.
english: His bones are full of his youth, but youth will lie down with him in the dust.

kikuyu: “Hamminni afaan isaa keessatti miʼaawee inni arraba isaa jala dhokfatu iyyuu,
english: “Though wickedness is sweet in his mouth, though he hide it under his tongue,

kikuyu: inni afaanii baafatee gatuu jibbee afaanuma ofii isaa keessa turfatu iyyuu,
english: though he spare it, and will not let it go, but keep it still within his mouth,

kikuyu: nyaanni isaa garaa isaa keessatti dhangaggaaʼa; isa keessattis hadhaa bofaa taʼa.
english: yet his food in his bowels is turned. It is cobra venom within him.

kikuyu: Inni qabeenya liqimse sana ni tufa; Waaqnis akka garaan isaa waan sana diddigu ni godha.
english: He has swallowed down riches, and he will vomit them up again. God will cast them out of his belly.

kikuyu: Inni summii bofaa xuuxa; arrabni buutiis isa ajjeesa.
english: He will suck cobra venom. The viper’s tongue will kill him.

kikuyu: Inni laga yaaʼu, burqaa dammaatii fi dhadhaa hin argu.
english: He will not look at the rivers, the flowing streams of honey and butter.

kikuyu: Inni waan itti dadhabe utuu hin nyaatin deebisa; buʼaa daldala isaa irraa argatettis hin gammadu.
english: He will restore that for which he labored, and will not swallow it down. He will not rejoice according to the substance that he has gotten.

kikuyu: Inni hiyyeeyyii hacuucee harka duwwaa hambiseeraatii; mana ofii hin ijaarinis humnaan fudhateera.
english: For he has oppressed and forsaken the poor. He has violently taken away a house, and he will not build it up.

kikuyu: “Hawwii isaa hamaa sana irraa boqonnaa hin argatu; inni qabeenya isaatiin of oolchuu hin dandaʼu.
english: “Because he knew no quietness within him, he will not save anything of that in which he delights.

kikuyu: Wanni inni nyaatu tokko iyyuu hin hafuuf; badhaadhummaan isaas itti fufee hin jiraatu.
english: There was nothing left that he didn’t devour, therefore his prosperity will not endure.

kikuyu: Utuma inni waan hunda qabuu rakkinni isatti dhufa; dhiphinni cimaanis isa qabata.
english: In the fullness of his sufficiency, distress will overtake him. The hand of everyone who is in misery will come on him.

kikuyu: Yeroo inni garaa isaa guutatutti, Waaqni dheekkamsa isaa sodaachisaa sana itti erga; dhaʼicha isaa illee itti roobsa.
english: When he is about to fill his belly, God will cast the fierceness of his wrath on him. It will rain on him while he is eating.

kikuyu: Inni miʼa lolaa sibiilaa baqatu illee, xiyya naasiitu isa waraana.
english: He will flee from the iron weapon. The bronze arrow will strike him through.

kikuyu: Dudga isaa keessaa xiyya, tiruu isaa keessaa immoo fiixee calaqqisu buqqisa. Sodaan guddaan isa qabata;
english: He draws it out, and it comes out of his body. Yes, the glittering point comes out of his liver. Terrors are on him.

kikuyu: dukkanni limixiinis riphee qabeenya isaa eeggata. Ibiddi namni tokko iyyuu hin afarsin gubee isa fixa; waan dunkaana isaa keessatti hafes ni barbadeessa.
english: All darkness is laid up for his treasures. An unfanned fire will devour him. It will consume that which is left in his tent.

kikuyu: Samiiwwan balleessaa isaa saaxilu; laftis isatti kaati.
english: The heavens will reveal his iniquity. The earth will rise up against him.

kikuyu: Guyyaa dheekkamsa Waaqaatti lolaan mana isaa, bishaan yaaʼus miʼa isaa fudhatee deema.
english: The increase of his house will depart. They will rush away in the day of his wrath.

kikuyu: Carraan Waaqni cubbamootaaf kennu, dhaalli Waaqni isaaniif qoodes kanuma.”
english: This is the portion of a wicked man from God, the heritage appointed to him by God.”

kikuyu: Iyyoob akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Dubbii koo qalbeeffadhaa dhaggeeffadhaa; kun waan isin ittiin na jajjabeessitan haa taʼu.
english: “Listen diligently to my speech. Let this be your consolation.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani dubbadhu naa obsaa; erga ani dubbadhee booddee isin natti qoosuu dandeessu.
english: Allow me, and I also will speak. After I have spoken, mock on.

kikuyu: “Dhugumaan kan ani komadhu namaa? Ani maaliif obsa hin dhabne ree?
english: As for me, is my complaint to man? Why shouldn’t I be impatient?

kikuyu: Na ilaalaatii dinqisiifadhaa; harka keessanis afaan keessan irra kaaʼadhaa.
english: Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.

kikuyu: Ani yommuu waan kana yaadu nan sodaadha; hollannaanis na qabata.
english: When I remember, I am troubled. Horror takes hold of my flesh.

kikuyu: Hamoonni maaliif itti fufanii lubbuun jiraatu? Maaliif dulloomanii humnas argachaa deemu?
english: “Why do the wicked live, become old, yes, and grow mighty in power?

kikuyu: Ijoolleen isaanii naannoo isaaniitti, sanyiin isaaniis fuula isaanii duratti jabaatanii dhaabatu.
english: Their child is established with them in their sight, their offspring before their eyes.

kikuyu: Manni isaanii nagaa dha; waan sodaatu illee hin qabu; uleen Waaqaas isaan hin tuqxu.
english: Their houses are safe from fear, neither is the rod of God upon them.

kikuyu: Kormi isaanii dhalchuu hin dadhabu; saawwan isaanii ni dhalu; hin gatatanis.
english: Their bulls breed without fail. Their cows calve, and don’t miscarry.

kikuyu: Isaan ijoollee isaanii akkuma bushaayeetti bobbaasu; daaʼimman isaanii immoo ni burraaqu.
english: They send out their little ones like a flock. Their children dance.

kikuyu: Dibbee fi kiraaraan sirbu; sagalee ululleetiinis ni gammadu.
english: They sing to the tambourine and harp, and rejoice at the sound of the pipe.

kikuyu: Isaan bara isaanii badhaadhummaadhaan fixatu; nagaadhaanis ni awwaalamu.
english: They spend their days in prosperity. In an instant they go down to Sheol.

kikuyu: Taʼu illee isaan Waaqaan akkana jedhu; ‘Nu dhiisi! Nu karaa kee beekuuf fedhii hin qabnu.
english: They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.

kikuyu: Akka nu isa tajaajilluuf Waaqni waan Hunda Dandaʼu eenyu? Nu isa kadhannee maal arganna?’
english: What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

kikuyu: Badhaadhummaan isaanii garuu isaan harka hin jiru; kanaafuu ani gorsa hamootaa irraa nan fagaadha.
english: Behold, their prosperity is not in their hand. The counsel of the wicked is far from me.

kikuyu: “Garuu ibsaan hamootaa yoom iyyuu ni dhaamaa? Balaan yoom iyyuu isaanitti dhufaa? Waaqnis dheekkamsa isaatiin badiisa isaanitti fidaa?
english: “How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes sorrows in his anger?

kikuyu: Isaan akkuma cidii fuula qilleensaa duraa ti; akkuma habaqii bubbeen hamaan fudhatee deemuu ti.
english: How often is it that they are as stubble before the wind, as chaff that the storm carries away?

kikuyu: Isin, ‘Waaqni balleessaa nama tokkoo ilmaan isaatiif kuusa’ jettu. Akka inni waan kana beekuuf Waaqni namichuma mataa isaatiif gatii isaa haa kennu!
english: You say, ‘God lays up his iniquity for his children.’ Let him recompense it to himself, that he may know it.

kikuyu: Iji isaa badiisa isaa haa argu; inni xoofoo dheekkamsa Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼuu haa dhugu.
english: Let his own eyes see his destruction. Let him drink of the wrath of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Inni yeroo jiʼi isaaf qoodame dhumutti, waaʼee maatii isaa kan dhiisee biraa deemu sanaa dhimma maalii qabaata?
english: For what does he care for his house after him, when the number of his months is cut off?

kikuyu: “Namni tokko iyyuu Waaqa beekumsa barsiisuu dandaʼaa? Waaqni ol aantotatti iyyuu ni muraatii.
english: “Shall any teach God knowledge, since he judges those who are high?

kikuyu: Namni tokko utuma itti tolee nagaan jiraatuu, utuma humna guutuu qabuu,
english: One dies in his full strength, being wholly at ease and quiet.

kikuyu: utuma dhagni isaa gabbatee jiruu, utuma lafeen isaa dhukaan guutamee jiruu ni duʼa.
english: His pails are full of milk. The marrow of his bones is moistened.

kikuyu: Namni biraa immoo utuu gammachuu tokko illee hin argin, jireenya hadhaaʼaa jiraachaa duʼa.
english: Another dies in bitterness of soul, and never tastes of good.

kikuyu: Isaan biyyoo keessa wal bira ciciisu; lachan isaaniittuu raammoon ni tuutaʼa.
english: They lie down alike in the dust. The worm covers them.

kikuyu: “Ani yaada keessanii fi mala isin ittiin na miidhuu barbaaddan nan beeka.
english: “Behold, I know your thoughts, the plans with which you would wrong me.

kikuyu: Isin, ‘Manni namicha guddaa, dunkaanni namoonni hamoon keessa jiraatan amma eessa jira?’ jettu.
english: For you say, ‘Where is the house of the prince? Where is the tent in which the wicked lived?’

kikuyu: Isin namoota karaa deeman hin gaafannee? Waan isaan jedhanis hin qalbeeffannee?
english: Haven’t you asked wayfaring men? Don’t you know their evidences,

kikuyu: Akka namni hamaan guyyaa balaa oolfamu, akka inni guyyaa dheekkamsaa illee baraaramu hin qalbeeffannee?
english: that the evil man is reserved to the day of calamity, that they are led out to the day of wrath?

kikuyu: Namni fuuluma isaa dura dhaabatee hojii isaa itti himu eenyu? Namni gatii waan inni hojjetee baasuuf eenyu?
english: Who will declare his way to his face? Who will repay him what he has done?

kikuyu: Inni gara awwaalaatti geeffama; awwaalli isaas ni eegama.
english: Yet he will be borne to the grave. Men will keep watch over the tomb.

kikuyu: Biyyoon sulula keessaa isatti miʼaawa; namoonni hundi isa duukaa buʼu; namoonni akka malee baayʼeenis fuula isaa dura deemu.
english: The clods of the valley will be sweet to him. All men will draw after him, as there were innumerable before him.

kikuyu: “Yoos isin akkamiin waan faayidaa hin qabneen na jajjabeessuu dandeessu ree? Deebiin keessanis soba qofa!”
english: So how can you comfort me with nonsense, because in your answers there remains only falsehood?”

kikuyu: Eliifaaz Teemaanichi akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

kikuyu: “Namni Waaqa fayyaduu dandaʼaa? Namni ogeessi iyyuu maal isa fayyada?
english: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

kikuyu: Yoo ati nama qajeelaa taate wanni kun Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼuuf gammachuu maalii kenna? Yoo karaan kee hirʼina qabaachuu baates inni buʼaa maalii argata?
english: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

kikuyu: “Wanni Waaqni sitti dheekkamee murtiitti si dhiʼeessuuf waan ati isa sodaattuufii?
english: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

kikuyu: Hamminni kee guddaa dha mitii? Cubbuun kees dhuma hin qabu mitii?
english: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

kikuyu: Ati sababii malee obboloota kee irraa qabdii fudhatteerta; namoota irraa uffata baaftee qullaa isaan hambifteerta.
english: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

kikuyu: Warra dadhaban bishaan hin obaafne; kanneen beelaʼanis nyaata dhowwatteerta;
english: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

kikuyu: namni humna qabu biyya qabaata; kan ulfina qabus keessa jiraata.
english: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

kikuyu: Ati dubartoota dhirsoonni irraa duʼan harka duwwaa gad dhiifte; irree ijoollee abbaa hin qabnees ni cabsite.
english: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu kiyyoon si marseera; sodaan tasaas si qabateera.
english: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

kikuyu: Akka ati hin argineef ifni kee dukkanaaʼeera; lolaan bishaaniis sirra garagala.
english: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

kikuyu: “Waaqni samii keessa ol fagoo jiraata mitii? Inni urjiiwwan ol fagoo jiran illee hammam akka ol fagaatan of jalatti gad ilaala!
english: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

kikuyu: Ati garuu akkana jetta; ‘Waaqni maal beeka? Inni dukkana akkasii keessatti murtii kennaa?
english: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

kikuyu: Yommuu inni bantii samii irra deemu, akka inni nu hin argineef duumessi gobbuun isa haguuga.’
english: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

kikuyu: Ati daandii durii kan namoonni hamoon irra deeman duukaa buutaa?
english: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

kikuyu: Isaan utuu yeroon isaanii hin gaʼin fudhataman; hundeen isaanis lolaadhaan haxaaʼame.
english: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

kikuyu: Isaanis Waaqaan, ‘Nu dhiisi! Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu maal nu gochuu dandaʼa?’ jedhan.
english: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

kikuyu: Garuu kan mana isaanii waan gaariin guute isuma; kanaafuu ani gorsa hamootaa irraa nan fagaadha.
english: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

kikuyu: Qajeelonnis badiisa isaanii arganii ni gammadu; warri balleessaa hin qabnes akkana jedhanii isaanitti qoosu;
english: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

kikuyu: ‘Dhugumaan amajaajonni keenya balleeffamaniiru; qabeenya isaaniis ibiddi barbadeesseera.’
english: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

kikuyu: “Waaqaan walii gali; isa wajjinis nagaan jiraadhu; haala kanaanis wanni gaariin siif dhufa.
english: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

kikuyu: Afaan isaatii qajeelfama fudhadhu; dubbii isaa illee garaatti qabadhu.
english: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

kikuyu: Yoo gara Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼuutti deebite, ati ni haaromfamta; yoo dunkaana kee keessaa hammina balleessitee
english: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

kikuyu: warqee kee biyyoo keessa buufte, yoo warqee Oofiirii immoo dhagaa keessatti gatte,
english: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

kikuyu: yoos Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu warqee, meetii filatamaas siif taʼa.
english: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

kikuyu: Ati yeroo sanatti Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼutti ni gammadda; fuula kees gara Waaqaatti ol qabatta.
english: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

kikuyu: Ati isa kadhatta; inni si dhagaʼa; ati immoo wareega kee ni baafatta.
english: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

kikuyu: Wanni ati murteessite ni taʼa; ifnis karaa kee irratti ni ifa.
english: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

kikuyu: Yeroo namoonni gad qabamanitti ati immoo, ‘Ol isaan qabi!’ jetta; innis warra gad qabaman ni baraara.
english: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

kikuyu: Inni nama balleessaa qabu illee ni oolcha; ati qulqullummaa harka keetiitiin furamta.”
english: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

kikuyu: Iyyoob akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Harʼa iyyuu guungummiin koo hadhaaʼaa dha; yoo ani akkam aade iyyuu harki isaa natti ulfaateera.
english: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

kikuyu: Ani utuun iddoo itti isa argadhu beekee, utuu iddoo inni jiraatu illee dhaquu dandaʼee!
english: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

kikuyu: Silaa dhimma koo fuula isaa duratti dhiʼeeffadhee afaan koo falmiin guuttadha ture.
english: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

kikuyu: Waan inni naa deebisu nan beekan ture; waan inni naan jedhus nan hubadhan ture.
english: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

kikuyu: Inni humna isaa guddaa sanaan anaan mormaa? Lakki, na dhaggeeffata malee.
english: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan achuma fuula isaa duratti dhimma isaa ni dhiʼeeffata; anis isa natti muru jalaa bara baraan nan baʼa.
english: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

kikuyu: “Garuu yoo ani gara baʼa biiftuu deeme, inni achi hin jiru; ani yoo gara dhiʼaa dhaqes achitti isa hin argadhu.
english: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

kikuyu: Yommuu inni kaabatti hojii irra jirutti ani isa hin argu; yommuu inni gara kibbaatti deebiʼuttis ani hamma libsuu ijaa isa arguu hin dandaʼu.
english: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

kikuyu: Inni garuu karaa ani baʼu ni beeka; yommuu inni na qoruttis ani akka warqee taʼee nan mulʼadha.
english: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

kikuyu: Miilli koo tarkaanfii isaatti dhiʼaatee duukaa buʼeera; ani utuun irraa hin gorin karaa isaa eegeera.
english: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

kikuyu: Ani ajaja afaan isaa irraa hin fagaanne; nyaata guyyaa guyyaa caalaas dubbii afaan isaa nan jaalladha.
english: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

kikuyu: “Inni garuu of dandaʼee kophaa isaa dhaabata; kan isaan mormuu dandaʼu eenyu? Inni waanuma jaallatu hojjeta.
english: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

kikuyu: Inni waan natti mure ni raawwata; amma illee karoora akkanaa hedduu yaada isaa keessaa qaba.
english: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

kikuyu: Wanni ani fuula isaa duratti naʼuufis kanuma; ani yommuun waan kana hunda yaadutti isa nan sodaadha.
english: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

kikuyu: Waaqni garaa koo ni raase; Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu na sodaachise.
english: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

kikuyu: Haa taʼu malee dukkanni, dukkanni limixiin fuula koo haguugu iyyuu na hin barbadeessine.
english: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

kikuyu: “Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu sun maaliif yeroo murtii hin murteessine? Warri isa beekan maaliif akkasumaan guyyoota isaa hin argine?
english: “Why aren’t times laid up by the Almighty? Why don’t those who know him see his days?

kikuyu: Namoonni dhagaa daarii ni dhiibu; bushaayee hataniis ni bobbaasu.
english: There are people who remove the landmarks. They violently take away flocks, and feed them.

kikuyu: Isaan harree ijoollee abbaa hin qabnee ooffatanii deemu; sangaa haadha hiyyeessaa qabdii fudhatu.
english: They drive away the donkey of the fatherless, and they take the widow’s ox for a pledge.

kikuyu: Rakkataa karaa irraa balleessu; hiyyeeyyiin biyyaa hundis isaan jalaa dhokatu.
english: They turn the needy out of the way. The poor of the earth all hide themselves.

kikuyu: Hiyyeeyyiin akkuma harree diidaa kan gammoojjii keessaa nyaata barbaacha asii fi achi jooru; gammoojjii sana keessaas ijoollee isaaniitiif nyaata kenna.
english: Behold, as wild donkeys in the desert, they go out to their work, seeking diligently for food. The wilderness yields them bread for their children.

kikuyu: Isaan dirree irratti okaa walitti qabatu; iddoo dhaabaa wayinii nama hamaa irraas qarmii funaannatu.
english: They cut their food in the field. They glean the vineyard of the wicked.

kikuyu: Uffata dhabanii halkan qullaa bulu; waan dhaamocha keessatti uffatan tokko illee hin qaban.
english: They lie all night naked without clothing, and have no covering in the cold.

kikuyu: Isaan bokkaa tulluutiin tortoraniiru; waan itti daʼatan illee dhabanii kattaa hammatu.
english: They are wet with the showers of the mountains, and embrace the rock for lack of a shelter.

kikuyu: Mucaan abbaa hin qabne harma irraa butameera; daaʼimni hiyyeessaa qabdii kennameera.
english: There are those who pluck the fatherless from the breast, and take a pledge of the poor,

kikuyu: Isaan uffata dhabanii qullaa deemu; bissii baatu; garuu ni beelaʼu.
english: so that they go around naked without clothing. Being hungry, they carry the sheaves.

kikuyu: Isaan dhagaa gidduutti zayitii ejersaa baasu; wayinii cuunfu; garuu ni dheebotu.
english: They make oil within the walls of these men. They tread wine presses, and suffer thirst.

kikuyu: Aaduun warra duʼuutti jiranii magaalaa keessaa ni dhagaʼama; lubbuun warra madaaʼaniis gargaarsa barbaacha iyyiti. Waaqni garuu balleessaa tokko iyyuu isaanitti hin lakkaaʼu.
english: From out of the populous city, men groan. The soul of the wounded cries out, yet God doesn’t regard the folly.

kikuyu: “Warri ifatti fincilan kanneen daandii isaa hin beekne yookaan daandii ifaa irra hin jiraanne jiru.
english: “These are of those who rebel against the light. They don’t know its ways, nor stay in its paths.

kikuyu: Yommuu aduun dhiitu, namni nama ajjeesu ni kaʼa; innis hiyyeeyyii fi rakkattoota ni ajjeesa; halkan immoo akkuma hattuu taʼa.
english: The murderer rises with the light. He kills the poor and needy. In the night he is like a thief.

kikuyu: Iji ejjaan dimimmisa eeggata; innis, ‘Iji na argu hin jirtu’ jedha; fuula isaas ni dhokfata.
english: The eye also of the adulterer waits for the twilight, saying, ‘No eye will see me.’ He disguises his face.

kikuyu: Namoonni dukkana keessa mana cabsanii seenu; guyyaa garuu ofitti cufanii oolu; isaan ifa hin beekan.
english: In the dark they dig through houses. They shut themselves up in the daytime. They don’t know the light.

kikuyu: Hunda isaaniitiif, dukkanni guddaan barii isaanii ti; isaan sodaa dukkana guddaatti michoomu.
english: For the morning is to all of them like thick darkness, for they know the terrors of the thick darkness.

kikuyu: “Taʼus isaan hoomacha bishaan gubbaa ti; akka namni tokko iyyuu gara iddoo dhaabaa wayinii hin dhaqneef, qoodni lafa isaanii abaarameera.
english: “They are foam on the surface of the waters. Their portion is cursed on the earth. They don’t turn into the way of the vineyards.

kikuyu: Akkuma hoʼii fi hoongeen cabbii baqee xuuxee fixu, awwaalli namoota cubbuu hojjetan ni butata.
english: Drought and heat consume the snow waters, so does Sheol those who have sinned.

kikuyu: Gadameessi isaan irraanfata; raammoonnis itti duuddee isaan nyaatti; namoonni hamoon akkuma mukaa ni caccabu; siʼachis hin yaadataman.
english: The womb will forget him. The worm will feed sweetly on him. He will be no more remembered. Unrighteousness will be broken as a tree.

kikuyu: Isaan dubartii dhabduu ni saamu; haadha hiyyeessaatiif illee garaa hin laafan.
english: He devours the barren who don’t bear. He shows no kindness to the widow.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu humna isaatiin jajjaboota alatti harkisa; isaan ol kaʼu; garuu wabii jireenyaa hin qaban.
english: Yet God preserves the mighty by his power. He rises up who has no assurance of life.

kikuyu: Inni akka isaan waan nagaan jiraatan seʼaniif ittuma dhiisuu dandaʼa; iji isaa garuu karaa isaanii ni toʼata.
english: God gives them security, and they rest in it. His eyes are on their ways.

kikuyu: Isaan yeroo xinnoof mataa ol qabatu; ergasii immoo ni badu; gad deebifamaniis akkuma warra kaanii walitti qabamu; akkuma mataa midhaaniis ni muramu.
english: They are exalted; yet a little while, and they are gone. Yes, they are brought low, they are taken out of the way as all others, and are cut off as the tops of the ears of grain.

kikuyu: “Yoo kun akkas taʼuu baate eenyutu sobduu na godhee dubbii koo busheessa?”
english: If it isn’t so now, who will prove me a liar, and make my speech worth nothing?”

kikuyu: Bildaad Shuhaahichi akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Bildad the Shuhite answered,

kikuyu: “Mootummaa fi sodaatamuun kan Waaqaa ti; inni samiiwwan ol fagoo keessatti nagaa buusa.
english: “Dominion and fear are with him. He makes peace in his high places.

kikuyu: Loltoonni isaa lakkaaʼamuu dandaʼuu? Ifni isaa eenyu irratti utuu hin baʼin hafa?
english: Can his armies be counted? On whom does his light not arise?

kikuyu: Yoos namni akkamitti fuula Waaqaa duratti qajeelaa taʼuu dandaʼa ree? Namni dubartii irraa dhalate akkamitti qulqulluu taʼuu dandaʼa?
english: How then can man be just with God? Or how can he who is born of a woman be clean?

kikuyu: Yoo jiʼi illee fuula isaa duratti hin ifne, yoo urjiiwwanis ija isaa duratti qulqulluu taʼuu baatan,
english: Behold, even the moon has no brightness, and the stars are not pure in his sight;

kikuyu: namni raammoo foonii taʼe, ilmi namaa kan raammoo taʼe sun hammam kanaa gad haa taʼu ree!”
english: How much less man, who is a worm, and the son of man, who is a worm!”

kikuyu: Iyyoob akkana jedhee deebise:
english: Then Job answered,

kikuyu: “Ati nama humna hin qabne hammam gargaarte! Irree laafes hammam jajjabeessite!
english: “How have you helped him who is without power! How have you saved the arm that has no strength!

kikuyu: Nama ogummaa hin qabneef gorsa akkamii kennite! Beekumsa guddaa akkamiis argisiifte!
english: How have you counseled him who has no wisdom, and plentifully declared sound knowledge!

kikuyu: Akka ati dubbii kana dubbattuuf eenyutu si gargaare? Hafuura eenyuutu afaan kee keessaa dubbate?
english: To whom have you uttered words? Whose spirit came out of you?

kikuyu: “Warri duʼan, warri bishaanii gadiitii fi kanneen bishaan keessa jiraatan hundii ni hollatu.
english: “The departed spirits tremble, those beneath the waters and all that live in them.

kikuyu: Duuti fuula Waaqaa duratti qullaa jira; badiisnis waan isa dhoksu hin qabu.
english: Sheol is naked before God, and Abaddon has no covering.

kikuyu: Waaqni iddoo duwwaa irra samii kaabaa diriirsa; lafas iddoo duwwaa irratti rarraasa.
english: He stretches out the north over empty space, and hangs the earth on nothing.

kikuyu: Inni duumessa isaatiin bishaanota hidhee qaba; duumessi sunis bishaanota jalatti hin dhoʼu.
english: He binds up the waters in his thick clouds, and the cloud is not burst under them.

kikuyu: Inni duumessoota isaa itti uffisuudhaan fuula jiʼaa ni haguuga.
english: He encloses the face of his throne, and spreads his cloud on it.

kikuyu: Inni fuula bishaanotaa irratti, ifaa fi dukkana gidduu daarii dhaabe.
english: He has described a boundary on the surface of the waters, and to the confines of light and darkness.

kikuyu: Utubaawwan samii ni hollatu; dheekkamsa isaatiinis ni rifatu.
english: The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his rebuke.

kikuyu: Inni humna isaatiin galaana ni raasa; ogummaa isaatiinis Raʼaabin ni ciccira.
english: He stirs up the sea with his power, and by his understanding he strikes through Rahab.

kikuyu: Hafuura baafatuun samiiwwan qulqulleesse; harki isaas bofa shawwisaa waraane.
english: By his Spirit the heavens are garnished. His hand has pierced the swift serpent.

kikuyu: Wantoonni kunneen hojii isaa keessaa qarqaruma qofa; hasaasni nu waaʼee isaa dhageenyu hammam xinnaa dha! Yoos kakawwee humna isaa eenyutu hubachuu dandaʼa ree?”
english: Behold, these are but the outskirts of his ways. How small a whisper do we hear of him! But the thunder of his power who can understand?”

kikuyu: Iyyoob haasaa isaa itti fufee akkana jedhe:
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

kikuyu: “Dhugaa Waaqa jiraataa murtii qajeelaa na dhowwate, Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu kan lubbuu koo hadheesse sanaa,
english: “As God lives, who has taken away my right, the Almighty, who has made my soul bitter

kikuyu: hamma lubbuun na keessa jirtutti, hamma hafuurri Waaqaa funyaan koo keessa jirutti,
english: (for the length of my life is still in me, and the spirit of God is in my nostrils);

kikuyu: afaan koo hammina hin dubbatu; arrabni koos nama hin gowwoomsu.
english: surely my lips will not speak unrighteousness, neither will my tongue utter deceit.

kikuyu: Isin qajeeltota jechuu, Waaqni ana irraa haa fagaatu; ani hamman duʼutti amanamummaa koo hin dhiisu.
english: Far be it from me that I should justify you. Until I die I will not put away my integrity from me.

kikuyu: Qajeelummaa koo jabeessee nan qabadha; gadis hin dhiisu; bara jireenya kootii guutuu qalbiin koo na hin komattu.
english: I hold fast to my righteousness, and will not let it go. My heart will not reproach me so long as I live.

kikuyu: “Diinni koo akka nama hamaa, mormituun koo akka nama jalʼaa haa taʼu!
english: “Let my enemy be as the wicked. Let him who rises up against me be as the unrighteous.

kikuyu: Yommuu Waaqni lubbuu isaa isa irraa fudhatee isa balleessutti, namni Waaqaaf hin bulle abdii maalii qaba?
english: For what is the hope of the godless, when he is cut off, when God takes away his life?

kikuyu: Yeroo rakkinni isatti dhufutti, Waaqni iyya isaa ni dhagaʼaa?
english: Will God hear his cry when trouble comes on him?

kikuyu: Inni Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼutti ni gammadaa? Yeroo hundas Waaqa waammataa?
english: Will he delight himself in the Almighty, and call on God at all times?

kikuyu: “Ani waaʼee harka Waaqaa isin nan barsiisa; waan Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu bira jirus isin hin dhoksu.
english: I will teach you about the hand of God. I will not conceal that which is with the Almighty.

kikuyu: Hundi keessan waan kana argitaniirtu; yoos haasaan faayidaa hin qabne kun maali?
english: Behold, all of you have seen it yourselves; why then have you become altogether vain?

kikuyu: “Carraan Waaqni nama hamaaf qoode, dhaalli namni jalʼaan Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu irraa argatu kana:
english: “This is the portion of a wicked man with God, the heritage of oppressors, which they receive from the Almighty.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen isaa akka malee baayʼatan iyyuu goraadeetu isaan eeggata; sanyiin isaas waan nyaatee quufu hin qabaatu.
english: If his children are multiplied, it is for the sword. His offspring will not be satisfied with bread.

kikuyu: Hambaa isaa dhaʼichatu awwaala; niitonni isaaniis hin booʼaniif.
english: Those who remain of him will be buried in death. His widows will make no lamentation.

kikuyu: Inni meetii akkuma biyyootti tuullatee uffata immoo akkuma supheetti kuufatu illee,
english: Though he heap up silver as the dust, and prepare clothing as the clay;

kikuyu: waan inni kuufate nama qajeelaatu uffata; meetii isaa illee nama balleessaa hin qabnetu qooddata.
english: he may prepare it, but the just will put it on, and the innocent will divide the silver.

kikuyu: Manni inni ijaaru akkuma mana dholdholee ti; akkuma daasii eegduun ijaaruu ti.
english: He builds his house as the moth, as a booth which the watchman makes.

kikuyu: Inni utuma qabeenya qabuu dhaqee ciisa; garuu itti hin deebiʼu; yeroo inni ija banatutti, qabeenyi isaa hundi hin jiru.
english: He lies down rich, but he will not do so again. He opens his eyes, and he is not.

kikuyu: Sodaan akkuma lolaa isa irra garagala; bubbeen hamaan immoo halkaniin isa fudhatee sokka.
english: Terrors overtake him like waters. A storm steals him away in the night.

kikuyu: Bubbeen baʼa biiftuu isa fudhata; innis hin argamu; bubbeen sunis lafa inni jiru irraa isa haxaaʼa.
english: The east wind carries him away, and he departs. It sweeps him out of his place.

kikuyu: Inni humna bubbee jalaa baʼuuf jedhee baqata; bubbeen sunis gara laafina tokko malee itti of darbata.
english: For it hurls at him, and does not spare, as he flees away from his hand.

kikuyu: Harka isaa dhadhaʼee itti qoosa; afuufees iddoo isaatii isa balleessa.”
english: Men will clap their hands at him, and will hiss him out of his place.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan iddoon meetiin keessaa qotamu, lafti warqeen itti baafamee qulqulleeffamu jira.
english: “Surely there is a mine for silver, and a place for gold which they refine.

kikuyu: Sibiilli lafa keessaa baafama; sibiilli diimaan immoo dhagaa albuudaa irraa baqfama.
english: Iron is taken out of the earth, and copper is smelted out of the ore.

kikuyu: Namni hamma dhuma dukkanaatti deema; moggaa akka malee fagoo dhaqees, dukkana hamaa keessa dhagaa albuudaa barbaada.
english: Man sets an end to darkness, and searches out, to the furthest bound, the stones of obscurity and of thick darkness.

kikuyu: Inni lafa namoonni jiraatan irraa fagaatee iddoo miilli namaa ejjetee hin beeknetti boolla qota; namoota irraa fagaatee ni rarraʼa; asii fi achis ni raafama.
english: He breaks open a shaft away from where people live. They are forgotten by the foot. They hang far from men, they swing back and forth.

kikuyu: Lafa irraa garuu nyaatatu argama; jala isheetiin immoo akka waan ibidda taateetti geeddaramti;
english: As for the earth, out of it comes bread. Underneath it is turned up as it were by fire.

kikuyu: dhagaan isaa burqaa sanpeerii ti; biyyoon isaas warqee qaba.
english: Sapphires come from its rocks. It has dust of gold.

kikuyu: Allaattiin tokko iyyuu karaa dhokfame sana hin beeku; iji culullees karaa sana hin argine.
english: That path no bird of prey knows, neither has the falcon’s eye seen it.

kikuyu: Bineensonni sodaachisoon irra hin ejjenne; leencis karaa sana hin darbine.
english: The proud animals have not trodden it, nor has the fierce lion passed by there.

kikuyu: Harki namaa dhagaa jabaa cabsa; hundee tulluuwwanii immoo ni gaggaragalcha.
english: He puts his hand on the flinty rock, and he overturns the mountains by the roots.

kikuyu: Inni kattaa keessaan karaa baasa; iji isaas waan gatii guddaa hunda arga.
english: He cuts out channels among the rocks. His eye sees every precious thing.

kikuyu: Madda lageenii ni sakattaʼa; waan dhokfames ifatti ni baasa.
english: He binds the streams that they don’t trickle. The thing that is hidden he brings out to light.

kikuyu: Ogummaan garuu eessaa argamti? Hubannaanis eessa jiraata?
english: “But where will wisdom be found? Where is the place of understanding?

kikuyu: Namni gatii isaa hin beeku; inni biyya jiraattotaa keessatti hin argamu.
english: Man doesn’t know its price, and it isn’t found in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Tujubni, “Inni na keessa hin jiru” jedha; galaannis, “Inni na bira hin jiru” jedha.
english: The deep says, ‘It isn’t in me.’ The sea says, ‘It isn’t with me.’

kikuyu: Warqeen qulqulluun isa bituu hin dandaʼu; gatiin isaas meetiidhaan hin madaalamu.
english: It can’t be gotten for gold, neither will silver be weighed for its price.

kikuyu: Warqee Oofiiriitti, dhagaa gatii guddaa sardooniksiitti yookaan sanpeeriitti hin tilmaamamu.
english: It can’t be valued with the gold of Ophir, with the precious onyx, or the sapphire.

kikuyu: Warqee fi dhagaan akka bilillee calaqqisu ittiin hin qixxaatu; inni faaya warqee qulqulluutiin hin geeddaramu.
english: Gold and glass can’t equal it, neither will it be exchanged for jewels of fine gold.

kikuyu: Elellaanii fi dooqni akka waan gatii qabaniitti hin hedaman; gatiin ogummaa lula diimaa caala.
english: No mention will be made of coral or of crystal. Yes, the price of wisdom is above rubies.

kikuyu: Tophaaziyooniin Itoophiyaa itti qixxaatu; warqee qulqulluudhaanis bitamuu hin dandaʼu.
english: The topaz of Ethiopia will not equal it. It won’t be valued with pure gold.

kikuyu: Yoos ogummaan eessaa dhufti ree? Hubannaanis eessa jiraatti?
english: Where then does wisdom come from? Where is the place of understanding?

kikuyu: Isheen ija uumama hundaa jalaa dhokatteerti; simbirroota samii jalaas baddeerti.
english: Seeing it is hidden from the eyes of all living, and kept close from the birds of the sky.

kikuyu: Badiisnii fi Duuti, “Nu oduu ishee qofa gurra keenyaan dhageenye” jedhu.
english: Destruction and Death say, ‘We have heard a rumor of it with our ears.’
