kikuyu: Waaqa qofatu daandii gara ishee geessu hubatee, lafa inni jiraatus beeka;
english: “God understands its way, and he knows its place.

kikuyu: inni handaara lafaa ni ilaala; waan samii jala jiru hunda ni argaatii.
english: For he looks to the ends of the earth, and sees under the whole sky.

kikuyu: Inni yommuu bubbeedhaaf humna kennee bishaanota safaretti,
english: He establishes the force of the wind. Yes, he measures out the waters by measure.

kikuyu: yommuu bokkaadhaaf seera dhaabee bakakkaaf immoo daandii baasetti,
english: When he made a decree for the rain, and a way for the lightning of the thunder,

kikuyu: inni ogummaa ilaalee madaale; jabeessee dhaabee ishee qorate.
english: then he saw it, and declared it. He established it, yes, and searched it out.

kikuyu: Ergasii ilmaan namaatiin, “Gooftaa sodaachuun ogummaa; waan hamaa irraa fagaachuunis hubannaa dha” jedhe.
english: To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’”

kikuyu: Iyyoob haasaa isaa itti fufee akkana jedhe:
english: Job again took up his parable, and said,

kikuyu: “Ani jiʼoota darban, bara Waaqni na eege sana akkamin hawwa ture,
english: “Oh that I were as in the months of old, as in the days when God watched over me;

kikuyu: yeroo ibsaan isaa mataa koo irratti ife, anis ifa isaatiin dukkana keessa darbee yeroon deeme,
english: when his lamp shone on my head, and by his light I walked through darkness,

kikuyu: yeroo ani nama jabaa ture, yeroo michummaan Waaqaa mana koo eebbise,
english: as I was in my prime, when the friendship of God was in my tent,

kikuyu: yeroo Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu na wajjin ture, yeroo ijoolleen koo naannoo koo turan,
english: when the Almighty was yet with me, and my children were around me,

kikuyu: yeroo daandiin koo dhadhaadhaan jiifame, yeroo kattaanis laga zayitii ejersaa naaf yaase.
english: when my steps were washed with butter, and the rock poured out streams of oil for me,

kikuyu: “Yeroo ani gara karra magaalaatti gad baʼee oobdii sabaa keessa barcuma koo irra taaʼe,
english: when I went out to the city gate, when I prepared my seat in the street.

kikuyu: dargaggeeyyiin na arganii karaa irraa goru; maanguddoonnis kaʼanii dhaabatu ture;
english: The young men saw me and hid themselves. The aged rose up and stood.

kikuyu: hangafoonni sabaa dubbii afaanitti qabatanii harka isaanii afaan irra kaaʼatu ture;
english: The princes refrained from talking, and laid their hand on their mouth.

kikuyu: sagaleen namoota bebeekamoo hin dhagaʼamu ture; arrabni isaaniis laagaa isaaniitti ni maxxana ture.
english: The voice of the nobles was hushed, and their tongue stuck to the roof of their mouth.

kikuyu: Namni na dhagaʼu kam iyyuu na jaja; kanneen na arganis na galateeffatu ture;
english: For when the ear heard me, then it blessed me, and when the eye saw me, it commended me,

kikuyu: ani hiyyeessa gargaarsa barbaachaaf booʼu, nama abbaa hin qabne kan namni isa gargaaru tokko iyyuu hin jirre fureeraatii.
english: because I delivered the poor who cried, and the fatherless also, who had no one to help him,

kikuyu: Namni duʼuu gaʼe na eebbiseera; ani akka garaan haadha hiyyeessaa gammachuun ililchus godheera.
english: the blessing of him who was ready to perish came on me, and I caused the widow’s heart to sing for joy.

kikuyu: Qajeelummaa akka uffata kootti uffadheera; murtiin qajeelaan immoo uffata koo fi marata mataa koo ture.
english: I put on righteousness, and it clothed me. My justice was as a robe and a diadem.

kikuyu: Ani nama jaameef ija, okkolaaf immoo miilla taʼeen ture.
english: I was eyes to the blind, and feet to the lame.

kikuyu: Ani rakkataadhaaf abbaan ture; nama ormaatiif illee nan falman ture.
english: I was a father to the needy. I researched the cause of him whom I didn’t know.

kikuyu: Qarriffaa nama hamaa nan cabse; waan inni qabates afaan isaatii buuseera.
english: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.

kikuyu: “Ani akkana jedheen yaadee ture; ‘Manuma koo keessattin duʼa; barri jireenya kootiis akkuma cirrachaa baayʼata.
english: Then I said, ‘I will die in my own house, I will count my days as the sand.

kikuyu: Hiddi koo gad fagaatee bishaan qaqqaba; fixeensis halkan guutuu dameewwan koo irra bula.
english: My root is spread out to the waters. The dew lies all night on my branch.

kikuyu: Ulfinni koo na keessatti haaraa taʼee jiraata; iddaanis harka koo keessatti haaromfama.’
english: My glory is fresh in me. My bow is renewed in my hand.’

kikuyu: “Namoonni calʼisanii gorsa koo eeggachaa abdiidhaan na dhaggeeffatu.
english: “Men listened to me, waited, and kept silence for my counsel.

kikuyu: Erga ani dubbadhee booddee isaan deebiʼanii hin dubbanne; dubbiin koos akka gaariitti gurra isaanii seena ture.
english: After my words they didn’t speak again. My speech fell on them.

kikuyu: Isaan akkuma nama bokkaa eeggatuutti na eeggatan; dubbii koos akkuma bokkaa arfaasaa dhugan.
english: They waited for me as for the rain. Their mouths drank as with the spring rain.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani isaaniif seequtti isaan hin amanne; ifni fuula koos isaaniif waan guddaa ture.
english: I smiled on them when they had no confidence. They didn’t reject the light of my face.

kikuyu: Ani karaa isaaniif filee akka hangafa isaaniitti nan taaʼe; akka mootii loltoota isaa gidduu jiraatuutti nan jiraadhe; ani akka nama warra booʼan jajjabeessuus taʼe.
english: I chose out their way, and sat as chief. I lived as a king in the army, as one who comforts the mourners.

kikuyu: “Amma garuu warri umuriidhaan naa gadii, kanneen ani abbootii isaanii saroota hoolota koo tiksitu wajjin iyyuu madaaluu tuffadhe, kunoo natti qoosu.
english: “But now those who are younger than I have me in derision, whose fathers I considered unworthy to put with my sheep dogs.

kikuyu: Warra humna dhaban, jabinni irree isaanii maal na fayyada?
english: Of what use is the strength of their hands to me, men in whom ripe age has perished?

kikuyu: Isaan rakkinaa fi beelaan laafan; lafa gogaa keessa, gammoojjii namni keessa hin jiraanne keessa halkaniin jooran.
english: They are gaunt from lack and famine. They gnaw the dry ground, in the gloom of waste and desolation.

kikuyu: Daggala keessaa biqiltuu soogiddaa funaannatan; nyaanni isaaniis hidda mukaa kan hin miʼoofne ture.
english: They pluck salt herbs by the bushes. The roots of the broom tree are their food.

kikuyu: Isaan namoota gidduudhaa ariʼaman; namoonnis akkuma waan hattuutti iyyaniitti itti iyyan.
english: They are driven out from among men. They cry after them as after a thief,

kikuyu: Isaan akka laga gogaa keessa, kattaa gidduu fi boolla lafaa keessa jiraataniif dirqamaman.
english: so that they live in frightful valleys, and in holes of the earth and of the rocks.

kikuyu: Bosona keessatti ni halaaku; daggala keessattis walitti tuutaʼu.
english: They bray among the bushes. They are gathered together under the nettles.

kikuyu: Isaan gowwoota maqaa hin qabne, kanneen biyyaa ariʼaman turan.
english: They are children of fools, yes, children of wicked men. They were flogged out of the land.

kikuyu: “Amma ilmaan isaanii sirba natti baafatan; ani isaan gidduutti waan kolfaa taʼeera.
english: “Now I have become their song. Yes, I am a byword to them.

kikuyu: Isaan xireeffatanii narraa fagaatan; fuula kootti tufuu irraas duubatti hin deebiʼan.
english: They abhor me, they stand aloof from me, and don’t hesitate to spit in my face.

kikuyu: Sababii Waaqni iddaa koo laafisee gad na deebiseef, isaan fuula koo duratti luugama baafatan.
english: For he has untied his cord, and afflicted me; and they have thrown off restraint before me.

kikuyu: Karaa mirga kootiin addaggeewwan kaʼaniiru; miilla kootiif kiyyoo kaaʼaniiru; biyyoos akka dallaa natti naannessan.
english: On my right hand rise the rabble. They thrust aside my feet. They cast their ways of destruction up against me.

kikuyu: Isaan karaa koo natti cufu; na galaafachuufis ni milkaaʼu; namni isaan dhowwu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: They mar my path. They promote my destruction without anyone’s help.

kikuyu: Akkuma nama qaawwa balʼaan dhufuutti, ona diigamaa keessa gangalachaa natti dhufu.
english: As through a wide breach they come. They roll themselves in amid the ruin.

kikuyu: Sodaan na liqimseera; ulfinni koo akkuma waan bubbeedhaan fudhatamuutti narraa fudhatameera; badhaadhummaan koos akkuma duumessaa bada.
english: Terrors have turned on me. They chase my honor as the wind. My welfare has passed away as a cloud.

kikuyu: “Amma lubbuun koo na keessatti dhumteerti; barri rakkinaas na qabateera.
english: “Now my soul is poured out within me. Days of affliction have taken hold of me.

kikuyu: Halkan keessa lafeen koo ni waraanama; dhukkubbiin na nyaatus natti hin furu.
english: In the night season my bones are pierced in me, and the pains that gnaw me take no rest.

kikuyu: Waaqni humna jabaadhaan uffata koo qabeera; akkuma morma wayyaa kootti hudhee na qabeera.
english: My garment is disfigured by great force. It binds me about as the collar of my tunic.

kikuyu: Inni darbatee dhoqqee keessa na buusa; anis akkuma biyyoo fi daaraa taʼeera.
english: He has cast me into the mire. I have become like dust and ashes.

kikuyu: “Yaa Waaqi, ani sitti nan iyyadha; ati garuu deebii naa hin kennitu; ani nan dhaabadha; ati garuu calʼistee na ilaalta.
english: I cry to you, and you do not answer me. I stand up, and you gaze at me.

kikuyu: Ati gara jabinaan natti garagalta; irree kee jabaadhaanis na dhoofta.
english: You have turned to be cruel to me. With the might of your hand you persecute me.

kikuyu: Ol na buttee fuula bubbee dura na oofta; bubbee hamaa keessas asii fi achi na aata.
english: You lift me up to the wind, and drive me with it. You dissolve me in the storm.

kikuyu: Ani akka ati gara duʼaatti, gara mana warra lubbuun jiraatan hundaaf ramadameetti na geessitu nan beeka.
english: For I know that you will bring me to death, to the house appointed for all living.

kikuyu: “Dhuguma iyyuu yeroo inni rakkatee gargaarsa barbaachaaf iyyutti, namni harka isaa isa irra kaaʼu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: “However doesn’t one stretch out a hand in his fall? Or in his calamity therefore cry for help?

kikuyu: Ani warra rakkina keessa jiraniif hin boonyee? Lubbuun koos hiyyeeyyiif hin gaddinee?
english: Didn’t I weep for him who was in trouble? Wasn’t my soul grieved for the needy?

kikuyu: Garuu utuu ani waan gaarii abdadhuu, wanni hamaan natti dhufe; utuu ani ifa eeggadhuus, dukkanni natti dhufe.
english: When I looked for good, then evil came. When I waited for light, darkness came.

kikuyu: Keessi koo jeeqamaa jira; gonkumaa hin qabbanoofne; barri gidiraas natti dhufeera.
english: My heart is troubled, and doesn’t rest. Days of affliction have come on me.

kikuyu: Ani jajjabina dhabee asii fi achi deemee nan booʼa; waldaa keessa dhaabadhees gargaarsaaf nan iyya.
english: I go mourning without the sun. I stand up in the assembly, and cry for help.

kikuyu: Ani obboleessa waangoo, michuu urunguus taʼeera.
english: I am a brother to jackals, and a companion to ostriches.

kikuyu: Gogaan koo gurraachaʼee qolli irraa kaʼeera; dhagni koos hoʼaan bobaʼeera.
english: My skin grows black and peels from me. My bones are burned with heat.

kikuyu: Baganaan koo booʼichaaf, ululleen koo immoo sagalee iyyaatiif qopheeffameera.
english: Therefore my harp has turned to mourning, and my pipe into the voice of those who weep.

kikuyu: “Ani ija koo wajjin kakuu galeera; yoos ani akkamiin hawwiidhaan gara durbaa ilaala ree?
english: “I made a covenant with my eyes; how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?

kikuyu: Carraan namni Waaqa samii biraa qabu, dhaalli inni Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu irraa argatu maali?
english: For what is the portion from God above, and the heritage from the Almighty on high?

kikuyu: Hamootaaf badiisa, warra jalʼina hojjetaniif immoo dhaʼicha mitii?
english: Is it not calamity to the unrighteous, and disaster to the workers of iniquity?

kikuyu: Inni karaa koo hin arguu? Tarkaanfii koo hundas hin lakkaaʼuu?
english: Doesn’t he see my ways, and count all my steps?

kikuyu: “Yoo ani karaa sobaa irra deemee yookaan miilli koo gara gowwoomsaatti ariifatee jiraate,
english: “If I have walked with falsehood, and my foot has hurried to deceit

kikuyu: Waaqni madaalii dhugaatiin na haa madaalu; akka ani hirʼina hin qabne illee haa beeku;
english: (let me be weighed in an even balance, that God may know my integrity);

kikuyu: yoo tarkaanfiin koo karaa irraa goree, garaan koo waan iji koo argu duukaa buʼee jiraate yookaan yoo harki koo xuraaʼee jiraate,
english: if my step has turned out of the way, if my heart walked after my eyes, if any defilement has stuck to my hands,

kikuyu: waan ani facaafadhe namni biraa haa nyaatu; midhaan koos haa buqqifamu.
english: then let me sow, and let another eat. Yes, let the produce of my field be rooted out.

kikuyu: “Yoo garaan koo dubartiidhaan gowwoomfamee jiraate, yookaan yoo ani balbala ollaa koo jalatti riphee eeggadhe,
english: “If my heart has been enticed to a woman, and I have laid wait at my neighbor’s door,

kikuyu: niitiin koo midhaan nama biraa haa daaktu; namoonni biraas ishee wajjin haa ciisan.
english: then let my wife grind for another, and let others sleep with her.

kikuyu: Kun hammina; kan abbaa murtiitiinis adabamuu qabuu dha.
english: For that would be a heinous crime. Yes, it would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges,

kikuyu: Kun ibidda hamma Barbadeessutti waa gubuu dha; midhaan ani qabu hundas gubee balleessa ture.
english: for it is a fire that consumes to destruction, and would root out all my increase.

kikuyu: “Yoo ani yeroo isaan na himatanitti, tajaajiltoota koo dhiiraa fi dubartii murtii qajeelaa dhowwadhee jiraadhe,
english: “If I have despised the cause of my male servant or of my female servant, when they contended with me,

kikuyu: yeroo Waaqni kaʼutti ani maalan godha? Yoo inni na gaafates ani maalan deebisa?
english: what then will I do when God rises up? When he visits, what will I answer him?

kikuyu: Isuma gadameessa keessatti na uume sanatu isaan uume mitii? Kan hunda keenya gadameessa keessatti tolches isuma mitii?
english: Didn’t he who made me in the womb make him? Didn’t one fashion us in the womb?

kikuyu: “Yoo ani waan hiyyeessaaf barbaachisu dhowwadhee jiraadhe, yookaan yoo ani akka iji haadha hiyyeessaa dadhabu godhee jiraadhe,
english: “If I have withheld the poor from their desire, or have caused the eyes of the widow to fail,

kikuyu: yoo ani buddeena koo utuu ilma abbaa hin qabneef hin qoodin kophaa koo nyaadhee jiraadhe,
english: or have eaten my morsel alone, and the fatherless has not eaten of it

kikuyu: ani garuu dargaggummaa kootii jalqabee akkuma abbaattin isa guddise; dhaloota kootii jalqabees haadha hiyyeessaa karaa argisiise.
english: (no, from my youth he grew up with me as with a father, I have guided her from my mother’s womb);

kikuyu: Ani yoon utuu namni tokko wayyaa dhabee akka malee miidhamuu, yookaan rakkataa uffata of irraa hin qabne tokko argee
english: if I have seen any perish for want of clothing, or that the needy had no covering;

kikuyu: sababii ani rifeensa hoolota kootiin isa hoʼiseef, yoo garaan isaa na hin eebbisin,
english: if his heart hasn’t blessed me, if he hasn’t been warmed with my sheep’s fleece;

kikuyu: yoo ani mana murtiitti fudhatama qaba jedhee ijoollee abbaa hin qabnetti harka koo ol kaasee jiraadhe,
english: if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate;

kikuyu: irreen koo gatiittii koo irraa haa buqqaʼu; irreen koo buusaa isaatti haa cabu.
english: then let my shoulder fall from the shoulder blade, and my arm be broken from the bone.

kikuyu: Ani sababiin dhaʼicha Waaqaa sodaadhee fi sababiin surraa isaa kabajeef waan akkanaa hojjechuu hin dandeenye.
english: For calamity from God is a terror to me. Because of his majesty, I can do nothing.

kikuyu: “Yoo ani warqee abdadhee yookaan warqee qulqulluudhaan, ‘Ati irkoo koo ti’ jedhee jiraadhe,
english: “If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’

kikuyu: yoo ani qabeenya koo guddaatti, milkaaʼina harki koo argatetti gammadee jiraadhe,
english: If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;

kikuyu: yoo ani aduu iftu argee yookaan jiʼa miidhaginaan deemu ilaalee kabajee,
english: if I have seen the sun when it shined, or the moon moving in splendor,

kikuyu: akkasiinis garaan koo dhoksaan gowwoomfamee afaan koo harka koo dhungatee jiraate,
english: and my heart has been secretly enticed, and my hand threw a kiss from my mouth;

kikuyu: wanni kun cubbuu adabamuu qabuu dha; ani Waaqa samiitiif hin amanamne tureetii.
english: this also would be an iniquity to be punished by the judges, for I would have denied the God who is above.

kikuyu: “Yoo ani badiisa diina kootiitti gammadee yookaan rakkina isa irra gaʼeef ililchee jiraadhe,
english: “If I have rejoiced at the destruction of him who hated me, or lifted up myself when evil found him

kikuyu: ani jireenya isaa abaaruudhaan akka afaan koo cubbuu hojjetu hin eeyyamne.
english: (I have certainly not allowed my mouth to sin by asking his life with a curse);

kikuyu: Yoo namoonni mana koo jiraatan, takkumaa, ‘Eenyutu buddeena mana Iyyoob nyaatee hin quufin?’ hin jedhin,
english: if the men of my tent have not said, ‘Who can find one who has not been filled with his meat?’

kikuyu: sababii manni koo karaa deemtuuf banaa tureef, keessummaan kam iyyuu ala hin bulu ture.
english: (the foreigner has not camped in the street, but I have opened my doors to the traveler);

kikuyu: Yoo ani akkuma namoonni godhan sana balleessaa koo garaatti qabadhee cubbuu koos dhokfadhee jiraadhe,
english: if like Adam I have covered my transgressions, by hiding my iniquity in my heart,

kikuyu: ani waldaa guddaa sodaadhee yookaan tuffiin gosaa na naasisee, calʼisee gad baʼuu dhiiseeraa?
english: because I feared the great multitude, and the contempt of families terrified me, so that I kept silence, and didn’t go out of the door—

kikuyu: “Maaloo ani utuu nama na dhagaʼu argadhee! Ani mallattoo falmii koo nan mallatteessa; Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu deebii naaf haa kennu; himataan koo dubbii isaa barreeffamaan haa dhiʼeeffatu.
english: oh that I had one to hear me! Behold, here is my signature! Let the Almighty answer me! Let the accuser write my indictment!

kikuyu: Dhugumaan ani gatiittii koo irratti waan kana nan baadha; akka gonfoottis mataa irra nan kaaʼadhan ture.
english: Surely I would carry it on my shoulder, and I would bind it to me as a crown.

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo tarkaanfii koo isatti nan hima; akkuma ilma mootiittis isatti nan dhiʼaadhan ture.
english: I would declare to him the number of my steps. I would go near to him like a prince.

kikuyu: “Yoo lafti koo natti iyyitee boʼoon ishee hundinuu imimmaaniin jiidhe,
english: If my land cries out against me, and its furrows weep together;

kikuyu: yoo ani kaffaltii malee midhaan ishee nyaadhe, yookaan akka hojjettoonni isaa lubbuu isaanii dhaban godhee jiraadhe,
english: if I have eaten its fruits without money, or have caused its owners to lose their life,

kikuyu: qooda qamadii qoraattiin, qooda garbuus aramaan itti haa biqilu.” Dubbiin Iyyoob xumurame.
english: let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.

kikuyu: Sababii Iyyoob nama qajeelaa of seʼeef namoonni sadan kunneen deebii kennuufii dhiisan.
english: So these three men ceased to answer Job, because he was righteous in his own eyes.

kikuyu: Eliihuun ilmi Barakeel Buuzichi maatiin Raamii sun garuu sababii Iyyoob qooda Waaqaa qajeelaa of godheef akka malee itti aare.
english: Then the wrath of Elihu the son of Barachel, the Buzite, of the family of Ram, was kindled against Job. His wrath was kindled because he justified himself rather than God.

kikuyu: Akkasumas sababii isaan Iyyoobitti muruu malee deebii hin qabaatiniif Eeliihuun michoota Iyyoob sadanitti akka malee aare.
english: Also his wrath was kindled against his three friends, because they had found no answer, and yet had condemned Job.

kikuyu: Eliihuun waan namoonni sun umuriidhaan isa caalaniif utuu dursee Iyyoobitti hin dubbatin ture.
english: Now Elihu had waited to speak to Job, because they were older than he.

kikuyu: Garuu yeroo akka namoonni sun sadan waan dubbatan dhaban argetti aariin isaa ittuma caale.
english: When Elihu saw that there was no answer in the mouth of these three men, his wrath was kindled.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Eliihuun ilmi Barakeel Buuzichaa sun akkana jedhe: “Ani umuriidhaan xinnaa dha; isin garuu jaarsolii dha; kanaafuu ani yaada koo isinitti himuu nan saalfadhe; nan sodaadhes.
english: Elihu the son of Barachel the Buzite answered, “I am young, and you are very old. Therefore I held back, and didn’t dare show you my opinion.

kikuyu: Ani, ‘Umuriin ni dubbata; barri dheeraanis ogummaa barsiisa’ jedhee yaadeen ture.
english: I said, ‘Days should speak, and multitude of years should teach wisdom.’

kikuyu: Garuu hafuura nama keessa jiru, hafuura Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu itti baafatutu hubannaa kennaaf.
english: But there is a spirit in man, and the Spirit of the Almighty gives them understanding.

kikuyu: Ogeessi jaarsa qofa miti; kan waan qajeelaa hubatus, nama umurii dheeraa qofa miti.
english: It is not the great who are wise, nor the aged who understand justice.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu ani akkana nan jedhaa na dhaggeeffadhaa; anis waanan beeku isinitti nan hima.
english: Therefore I said, ‘Listen to me; I also will show my opinion.’

kikuyu: Ani yeroo isin dubbattan nan obse; yeroo isin jechoota filattanitti illee ani dubbii ogummaa kan isin dubbattan nan dhaggeeffadhe;
english: “Behold, I waited for your words, and I listened for your reasoning, while you searched out what to say.

kikuyu: ani qalbeeffadheen isin dhagaʼe. Garuu isin keessaa namni tokko iyyuu akka inni dogoggore Iyyoobin hin amansiifne; namni tokko iyyuu falmii isaatiif deebii hin kennine.
english: Yes, I gave you my full attention, but there was no one who convinced Job, or who answered his words, among you.

kikuyu: Isin, ‘Nu ogummaa arganneerra; nama utuu hin taʼin, Waaqni isa irra haa aanu’ hin jedhinaa.
english: Beware lest you say, ‘We have found wisdom. God may refute him, not man;’

kikuyu: Iyyoob garuu dubbii isaatiin na hin tuqne; anis falmii keessaniin deebii isaaf hin kennu.
english: for he has not directed his words against me; neither will I answer him with your speeches.

kikuyu: “Isaan abdii kutatanii waan jedhan dhaban; dubbiinis isaan harkaa badde.
english: “They are amazed. They answer no more. They don’t have a word to say.

kikuyu: Erga isaan calʼisanii, erga isaan deebii kennan tokko illee dhabanii achi dhadhaabatanii, ani eeguun qabaa?
english: Shall I wait, because they don’t speak, because they stand still, and answer no more?

kikuyu: Ani deebii koo nan kenna; waanan beeku nan hima.
english: I also will answer my part, and I also will show my opinion.

kikuyu: Dubbiin na keessa guuteeraatii; hafuurri na keessa jirus na kakaasa;
english: For I am full of words. The spirit within me constrains me.

kikuyu: garaan koo akkuma daadhii wayinii kan qadaadamee, akkuma qalqalloo daadhii wayinii haaraa dhoʼuun gaʼeetii.
english: Behold, my breast is as wine which has no vent; like new wineskins it is ready to burst.

kikuyu: Ani dubbadhee qabbaneeffachuun qaba; afaan koo banadhees deebii kennuun qaba.
english: I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.

kikuyu: Ani nama wal hin caalchisu; yookaan nama tokko iyyuu hin saadu.
english: Please don’t let me respect any man’s person, neither will I give flattering titles to any man.

kikuyu: Utuu ani nama saaduu beekee, Uumaan koo silaa dafee lafa irraa na balleessa ture.
english: For I don’t know how to give flattering titles, or else my Maker would soon take me away.

kikuyu: “Yaa Iyyoob amma garuu ati dubbii koo dhaggeeffadhu; waan ani jedhu hundas dhagaʼi.
english: “However, Job, please hear my speech, and listen to all my words.

kikuyu: Kunoo ani afaan koo nan banadha; dubbiin koos fiixee arraba kootii irra jira.
english: See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.

kikuyu: Dubbiin koo garaa qajeelaa keessaa baʼa; hidhiin koos waan ani beeku ifatti baasee dubbata.
english: My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.

kikuyu: Hafuura Waaqaatu na uume; hafuurri Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu baafatus jireenya naa kenna.
english: The Spirit of God has made me, and the breath of the Almighty gives me life.

kikuyu: Egaa yoo dandeesse deebii naa kenni; qophaaʼiitii fuula koo dura dhaabadhu.
english: If you can, answer me. Set your words in order before me, and stand up.

kikuyu: Ani fuula Waaqaa duratti namuma akka keetii ti; anis biyyoo irraan hojjetame.
english: Behold, I am toward God even as you are. I am also formed out of the clay.

kikuyu: Ati na sodaattee hin raafamin; harki koos sitti hin ulfaatin.
english: Behold, my terror will not make you afraid, neither will my pressure be heavy on you.

kikuyu: “Dhugumaan ati utuma ani dhagaʼuu dubbatteerta; anis dubbii kee dhagaʼeera.
english: “Surely you have spoken in my hearing, I have heard the voice of your words, saying,

kikuyu: Ati akkana jetta: ‘Ani qulqulluu dha; cubbuu illee hin qabu; ani balleessaa hin qabu; yakka illee hin hojjenne.
english: ‘I am clean, without disobedience. I am innocent, neither is there iniquity in me.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu balleessaa narratti argeera; akka diina isaattis na ilaaleera.
english: Behold, he finds occasions against me. He counts me for his enemy.

kikuyu: Miilla koo gudeelcha gidduu galchee hidha; karaa koo hundas ni eega.’
english: He puts my feet in the stocks. He marks all my paths.’

kikuyu: “Garuu ani sitti nan hima; kana irratti ati qajeelaa miti; Waaqni nama caalaa guddaadhaatii.
english: “Behold, I will answer you. In this you are not just, for God is greater than man.

kikuyu: Ati maaliif akka waan inni dubbii namaatiif deebii hin kennineetti isatti guungumta?
english: Why do you strive against him, because he doesn’t give account of any of his matters?

kikuyu: Namni hubachuu baattu iyyuu, Waaqni karaa tokkoonis, karaa biraatiinis ni dubbata.
english: For God speaks once, yes twice, though man pays no attention.

kikuyu: Inni utuma isaan siree isaanii irra ciisanuu, yeroo hirribni cimaan isaan qabutti, abjuudhaan, mulʼata halkaniitiinis,
english: In a dream, in a vision of the night, when deep sleep falls on men, in slumbering on the bed,

kikuyu: gurra isaaniitti ni dubbata; of eeggachiisaanis isaan rifachiisa;
english: then he opens the ears of men, and seals their instruction,

kikuyu: jalʼina irraa nama deebisuuf, of jajuu irraas isa dhowwuuf,
english: that he may withdraw man from his purpose, and hide pride from man.

kikuyu: lubbuu isaa boolla irraa, jireenya isaas goraadeedhaan baduu irraa oolchuudhaaf.
english: He keeps back his soul from the pit, and his life from perishing by the sword.

kikuyu: “Namni tokko dhiphina lafee isaa keessaa kan gargar hin cinneen, siree dhiphinaa irratti ni adabama taʼa;
english: “He is chastened also with pain on his bed, with continual strife in his bones,

kikuyu: kanaafuu jireenyi isaa nyaata jibba; lubbuun isaas nyaata filatamaa balfiti.
english: so that his life abhors bread, and his soul dainty food.

kikuyu: Foon isaa nyaatamee dhuma; lafeen isaa kan duraan dhokatee ture sun alatti yaaʼa.
english: His flesh is so consumed away that it can’t be seen. His bones that were not seen stick out.

kikuyu: Lubbuun isaa gara boollaatti, jireenyi isaas ergamoota duʼaatti dhiʼaata.
english: Yes, his soul draws near to the pit, and his life to the destroyers.

kikuyu: Taʼus yoo kuma keessaa ergamaan Waaqayyoo tokko akka itti qajeelaa taʼan isaanitti himuuf, ergamaan Waaqaa isaanii dhaabatee jiraate,
english: “If there is beside him an angel, an interpreter, one among a thousand, to show to man what is right for him,

kikuyu: yoo namichaaf garaa laafee ‘Boolla buʼuu irraa isa oolche; ani furii isaaf argeen jira’ jedhe,
english: then God is gracious to him, and says, ‘Deliver him from going down to the pit, I have found a ransom.’

kikuyu: dhagni isaa akkuma dhagna daaʼimaatti haaromfama; akka bara dargaggummaa isaattis ni deebiʼa.
english: His flesh will be fresher than a child’s. He returns to the days of his youth.

kikuyu: Inni Waaqa ni kadhata; isa birattis fudhatama argata; fuula Waaqaa ni arga; ni ililchas; Waaqnis gara qajeelummaa isaa kan duriitti isa ni deebisa.
english: He prays to God, and he is favorable to him, so that he sees his face with joy. He restores to man his righteousness.

kikuyu: Ergasiis gara namootaa dhufee akkana jedha; ‘Ani cubbuu hojjedheera; waan qajeelaas jalʼiseera; garuu waan naa malu hin arganne.
english: He sings before men, and says, ‘I have sinned, and perverted that which was right, and it didn’t profit me.

kikuyu: Inni akka isheen boolla hin buuneef lubbuu koo fureera; anis jiraadhee ifa nan arga.’
english: He has redeemed my soul from going into the pit. My life will see the light.’

kikuyu: “Waaqni waan kana hunda yeroo lama, yeroo sadii iyyuu namaaf ni godha.
english: “Behold, God does all these things, twice, yes three times, with a man,

kikuyu: Kanas akka ifni jireenyaa isaaf ifuuf, lubbuu isaas boolla irraa deebisuuf godha.
english: to bring back his soul from the pit, that he may be enlightened with the light of the living.

kikuyu: “Yaa Iyyoob qalbeeffadhuutii na dhaggeeffadhu; ati calʼisi; ani nan dubbadhaa.
english: Mark well, Job, and listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will speak.

kikuyu: Yoo waan jettu tokko illee qabaatte deebii naa kenni; dubbadhu, ani akka ati qajeelaa taate mirkaneessuu nan barbaadaatii.
english: If you have anything to say, answer me. Speak, for I desire to justify you.

kikuyu: Yoo akkas taʼuu baate garuu na dhaggeeffadhu; calʼisi, anis ogummaa sin barsiisaa.”
english: If not, listen to me. Hold your peace, and I will teach you wisdom.”

kikuyu: Eliihuun akkana jedhe:
english: Moreover Elihu answered,

kikuyu: “Yaa ogeeyyii, dubbii koo dhagaʼaa; beektonnis na dhaggeeffadhaa.
english: “Hear my words, you wise men. Give ear to me, you who have knowledge.

kikuyu: Akkuma arrabni nyaata afaaniin qabu, gurris dubbii calalaatii.
english: For the ear tries words, as the palate tastes food.

kikuyu: Waan qajeelaa taʼe ofii keenyaaf haa filannu; waan gaariis tokkummaadhaan haa barannu.
english: Let us choose for us that which is right. Let us know among ourselves what is good.

kikuyu: “Iyyoob akkana jedha; ‘Ani qajeelaa dha; Waaqni garuu murtii qajeelaa narraa fudhate.
english: For Job has said, ‘I am righteous, God has taken away my right.

kikuyu: Ani utuman nama dhugaa taʼee jiruu, akka sobduuttin herregame; ani yakka qabaachuu baadhu illee xiyyi isaa madaa hin fayyineen na madeesseera.’
english: Notwithstanding my right I am considered a liar. My wound is incurable, though I am without disobedience.’

kikuyu: Namni akka bishaaniitti tuffii dhugu, kan akka Iyyoob eenyu?
english: What man is like Job, who drinks scorn like water,

kikuyu: Inni warra hammina hojjetu wajjin walii gala; jalʼoota wajjinis tokkummaa qabaata.
english: who goes in company with the workers of iniquity, and walks with wicked men?

kikuyu: Inni, ‘Waaqa gammachiisuu yaaluun, namaaf faayidaa tokko iyyuu hin qabu’ jedhaatii.
english: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight himself with God.’

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu isin yaa hubattoota, na dhagaʼaa. Waan hamaa hojjechuun Waaqa irraa, dogoggoruunis Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu irraa haa fagaatu.
english: “Therefore listen to me, you men of understanding: far be it from God, that he should do wickedness, from the Almighty, that he should commit iniquity.

kikuyu: Inni namaaf akkuma hojii isaatti gatii ni kenna; waan karaa isaatiif malus itti fida.
english: For the work of a man he will give to him, and cause every man to find according to his ways.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan Waaqni hammina hin hojjetu; Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu murtii qajeelaa hin jalʼisu.
english: Yes surely, God will not do wickedly, neither will the Almighty pervert justice.

kikuyu: Eenyutu lafa irratti isa muude? Eenyutus addunyaa guutuu isatti kenne?
english: Who put him in charge of the earth? Or who has appointed him over the whole world?

kikuyu: Utuu inni hafuura isaa deebisee fudhatee, hafuura baafatu illee gara ofii isaatti deebifatee,
english: If he set his heart on himself, if he gathered to himself his spirit and his breath,

kikuyu: silaa sanyiin namaa hundi walumaan bada; namnis biyyootti deebiʼa ture.
english: all flesh would perish together, and man would turn again to dust.

kikuyu: “Ati yoo hubannaa qabaatte waan kana dhagaʼi; waan ani jedhus dhaggeeffadhu.
english: “If now you have understanding, hear this. Listen to the voice of my words.

kikuyu: Namni murtii qajeelaa jibbu bulchuu dandaʼaa? Atis isa qajeelaa fi humna qabeessa sanatti murtaa?
english: Should even one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn him who is righteous and mighty,

kikuyu: Kan moototaan, ‘Isin faayidaa hin qabdan;’ jedhee qondaaltotaanis, ‘Isin hamoo dha’ jedhu isa mitii?
english: who says to a king, ‘Vile!’ or to nobles, ‘Wicked!’?

kikuyu: Inni ilmaan moototaatiif illee hin looguu; sooreyyii fi hiyyeeyyii wal hin caalchisu; hundi isaanii hojii harka isaatii.
english: He doesn’t respect the persons of princes, nor respect the rich more than the poor, for they all are the work of his hands.

kikuyu: Isaan halkan walakkaa tasa duʼu; namoonni hollatanii dhumu; jajjaboonnis utuma harki namaa isaan hin tuqin ni badu.
english: In a moment they die, even at midnight. The people are shaken and pass away. The mighty are taken away without a hand.

kikuyu: “Iji isaa karaa namootaa irra jira; inni tarkaanfii isaanii hunda ni arga.
english: “For his eyes are on the ways of a man. He sees all his goings.

kikuyu: Iddoon warri waan hamaa hojjetan itti dhokatan, dukkanni yookaan gaaddisni guddaan hin jiru.
english: There is no darkness, nor thick gloom, where the workers of iniquity may hide themselves.

kikuyu: Akka inni murtiidhaaf fuula isaa duratti dhiʼaatuuf, Waaqni nama kam iyyuu hin beellamu.
english: For he doesn’t need to consider a man further, that he should go before God in judgment.

kikuyu: Inni gaaffii tokko malee namoota jajjaboo ni burkuteessa; warra biraa immoo iddoo isaanii ni kaaʼa.
english: He breaks mighty men in pieces in ways past finding out, and sets others in their place.

kikuyu: Inni sababii hojii isaanii beekuuf, halkan keessa isaan garagalcha; isaanis ni barbadaaʼu.
english: Therefore he takes knowledge of their works. He overturns them in the night, so that they are destroyed.

kikuyu: Sababii jalʼina isaaniitiifis inni iddoo namni hundi argutti isaan adaba;
english: He strikes them as wicked men in the open sight of others;

kikuyu: kunis waan isaan isa duukaa buʼuu irraa garagalanii karaa isaa hunda dhiisaniif.
english: because they turned away from following him, and wouldn’t pay attention to any of his ways,

kikuyu: Isaan akka inni iyya rakkattootaa dhagaʼuuf, akka iyyi hiyyeeyyii fuula isaa duratti dhagaʼamu godhaniiru.
english: so that they caused the cry of the poor to come to him. He heard the cry of the afflicted.

kikuyu: Yoo inni calʼise garuu, eenyutu isatti muruu dandaʼa? Yoo inni fuula isaa dhokfates eenyutu isa arguu dandaʼa? Taʼus inni namaa fi saba illee ni toʼata;
english: When he gives quietness, who then can condemn? When he hides his face, who then can see him? He is over a nation or a man alike,

kikuyu: kunis akka namni Waaqaaf hin bulle mootii hin taanee fi akka isaan sabaaf kiyyoo hin keenyeefii dha.
english: that the godless man may not reign, that there be no one to ensnare the people.

kikuyu: “Namni tokko Waaqaan akkana jedha haa jennu; ‘Ani yakka hojjedheera; garuu itti hin deebiʼu.
english: “For has any said to God, ‘I am guilty, but I will not offend any more.

kikuyu: Waan ani arguu hin dandeenye na barsiisi; ani yoon dogoggora hojjedhee jiraadhe, lammata itti hin deebiʼu.’
english: Teach me that which I don’t see. If I have done iniquity, I will do it no more’?

kikuyu: Waaqni sababii ati qalbii jijjiirrachuu didduuf akkuma yaada keetiitti gatii siif baasaa? Situ murteessuu qaba malee ana miti; kanaafuu ati waan beektu natti himi.
english: Shall his recompense be as you desire, that you refuse it? For you must choose, and not I. Therefore speak what you know.

kikuyu: “Namoonni hubannaa qaban ni dubbatu; namoonni ogeeyyiin na dhagaʼanis akkana jedhu;
english: Men of understanding will tell me, yes, every wise man who hears me:

kikuyu: ‘Iyyoob beekumsa malee dubbata; dubbiin isaas hubannaa cimaa hin qabu.’
english: ‘Job speaks without knowledge. His words are without wisdom.’

kikuyu: Iyyoob sababii akka nama hamaatti deebii kenneef maaloo utuu hamma dhumaatti qoramee jiraatee!
english: I wish that Job were tried to the end, because of his answering like wicked men.

kikuyu: Inni cubbuu isaa irratti fincila dabala; tuffiidhaan gidduu keenyatti harka dhaʼa; Waaqa irrattis waan baayʼee dubbata.”
english: For he adds rebellion to his sin. He claps his hands among us, and multiplies his words against God.”

kikuyu: Eliihuunis itti fufee akkana jedhe:
english: Moreover Elihu answered,

kikuyu: “Ati waan kana qajeelaa seetaa? Ati, ‘Ani fuula Waaqaa duratti qajeelaa dha’ jetta.
english: “Do you think this to be your right, or do you say, ‘My righteousness is more than God’s,’

kikuyu: Ati, ‘Wanni kun faayidaa maalii naa qaba? Ani cubbuu hojjechuu dhiisuudhaan maalin argadha?’ jettee gaafatta.
english: that you ask, ‘What advantage will it be to you? What profit will I have, more than if I had sinned?’

kikuyu: “Ani siʼii fi michoota kee kanneen si wajjin jiraniif deebii kennuu nan barbaada.
english: I will answer you, and your companions with you.

kikuyu: Ol jedhiitii samiiwwan ilaali; duumessoota siin ol jiranis argi.
english: Look to the skies, and see. See the skies, which are higher than you.

kikuyu: Ati yoo cubbuu hojjette maal isa miita? Cubbuun kees yoo baayʼate maal isa godha?
english: If you have sinned, what effect do you have against him? If your transgressions are multiplied, what do you do to him?

kikuyu: Ati yoo qajeelaa taate, maal isaaf kennita? Yookaan inni harka kee irraa maal argata?
english: If you are righteous, what do you give him? Or what does he receive from your hand?

kikuyu: Hamminni kee nama akka keetii qofa miidha; qajeelummaan kees ilmaan namaa qofa fayyada.
english: Your wickedness may hurt a man as you are, and your righteousness may profit a son of man.

kikuyu: “Waan cunqursaan itti hammaatteef namoonni ni iyyu; irree humna qabeessaa jalaa baʼuufis gargaarsaaf wawwaatu.
english: “By reason of the multitude of oppressions they cry out. They cry for help by reason of the arm of the mighty.

kikuyu: Garuu namni tokko iyyuu akkana hin jedhu; ‘Waaqni Uumaan koo, inni halkaniin faarfannaa namaa kennu,
english: But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker, who gives songs in the night,

kikuyu: kan bineensota lafa irraa caalaa beektota, simbirroo samii caalaas ogeeyyii nu godhu eessa jira?’
english: who teaches us more than the animals of the earth, and makes us wiser than the birds of the sky?’

kikuyu: Inni sababii of tuulummaa jalʼootaatiif yommuu namoonni iyyanitti deebii hin kennu.
english: There they cry, but no one answers, because of the pride of evil men.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan Waaqni iyya isaanii kan gatii hin qabne sana hin dhaggeeffatu; Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu iyya sanaaf gurra hin kennu.
english: Surely God will not hear an empty cry, neither will the Almighty regard it.

kikuyu: Yoo ati, ‘Dubbiin koo fuula isaa dura jira; ani isa eeggachaan jira; garuu isa arguu hin dandaʼu’ jette, inni hammam kanaa gad iyyuu xinneessee haa dhagaʼu ree!
english: How much less when you say you don’t see him. The cause is before him, and you wait for him!

kikuyu: Amma illee sababii dheekkamsi isaa nama hin adabneef, sababii inni balleessaa namaa akka waan guddaa tokkootti hin fudhanneef,
english: But now, because he has not visited in his anger, neither does he greatly regard arrogance,

kikuyu: Iyyoob oduu faayidaa hin qabneen afaan bana; beekumsa malees dubbii baayʼisa.”
english: therefore Job opens his mouth with empty talk, and he multiplies words without knowledge.”

kikuyu: Eliihuun ittuma fufee akkana jedhe:
english: Elihu also continued, and said,

kikuyu: “Ani akka qooda Waaqaa wanni jedhamu hedduun jiru sitti nan argisiisaatii mee xinnoo naa obsi.
english: “Bear with me a little, and I will show you; for I still have something to say on God’s behalf.

kikuyu: Ani beekumsa koo fagoodhaa nan fida; qajeelummaa Uumaa kootiis nan labsa.
english: I will get my knowledge from afar, and will ascribe righteousness to my Maker.

kikuyu: Akka dubbiin koo soba hin taʼin mirkaneeffadhu; kan beekumsaan hirʼina hin qabne tokko si wajjin jira.
english: For truly my words are not false. One who is perfect in knowledge is with you.

kikuyu: “Waaqni jabaa dha; garuu eenyun iyyuu hin tuffatu; inni jabaa dha; kaayyoo isaattis cimee dhaabata.
english: “Behold, God is mighty, and doesn’t despise anyone. He is mighty in strength of understanding.

kikuyu: Inni hamoota hin jiraachisu; warra rakkataniif garuu murtii qajeelaa ni kenna.
english: He doesn’t preserve the life of the wicked, but gives justice to the afflicted.

kikuyu: Ija isaa qajeeltota irraa hin buqqifatu; mootota wajjin teessoo irra isaan teessisa; bara baraanis ol isaan guddisa.
english: He doesn’t withdraw his eyes from the righteous, but with kings on the throne, he sets them forever, and they are exalted.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo namoonni foncaadhaan hidhaman, yoo funyoo rakkinaatiinis hidhaman,
english: If they are bound in fetters, and are taken in the cords of afflictions,

kikuyu: inni hojii isaanii, daba isaan of tuulummaan hojjetanis isaanitti ni hima.
english: then he shows them their work, and their transgressions, that they have behaved themselves proudly.

kikuyu: Inni gurra isaanii sirreeffama dhaggeeffachuuf ni bana; akka isaan waan hamaa irraa qalbii jijjiirratanis ni ajaja.
english: He also opens their ears to instruction, and commands that they return from iniquity.

kikuyu: Isaan yoo ajajamanii isa tajaajilan, bara jireenya isaanii badhaadhummaan, umurii isaaniis gammachuudhaan fixatu.
english: If they listen and serve him, they will spend their days in prosperity, and their years in pleasures.

kikuyu: Yoo ajajamuu baatan garuu, goraadeedhaan badu; beekumsa malees ni duʼu.
english: But if they don’t listen, they will perish by the sword; they will die without knowledge.

kikuyu: “Warri garaan isaanii Waaqa irraa fagaate, aarii of keessatti kuufatu; yommuu inni foncaan isaan hidhutti illee gargaarsa barbaachaaf hin iyyan.
english: “But those who are godless in heart lay up anger. They don’t cry for help when he binds them.

kikuyu: Isaan dargaggummaa isaanii keessa duʼu; jireenyi isaaniis xuraaʼota gidduutti bada.
english: They die in youth. Their life perishes among the unclean.

kikuyu: Inni garuu warra dhiphatan dhiphina isaanii keessaa baasa; rakkoo isaanii keessattis isaanitti dubbata.
english: He delivers the afflicted by their affliction, and opens their ear in oppression.

kikuyu: “Inni dhiphina keessaa si baasee gara lafa balʼaa dhiphina hin qabneetti, maaddii coomaan guutametti si geessa.
english: Yes, he would have allured you out of distress, into a wide place, where there is no restriction. That which is set on your table would be full of fatness.

kikuyu: Amma garuu murtiin hamootaaf malu sirra tuulameera; murtii fi haqni si qabataniiru.
english: “But you are full of the judgment of the wicked. Judgment and justice take hold of you.

kikuyu: Akka badhaadhummaan si hin gowwoomsine of eeggadhu; akka baayʼinni mattaʼaas karaa irraa si jalʼisu hin godhin.
english: Don’t let riches entice you to wrath, neither let the great size of a bribe turn you aside.

kikuyu: Badhaadhummaan kee yookaan tattaaffiin kee guddaan sun hundi rakkoo irraa si eeguu dandaʼaa?
english: Would your wealth sustain you in distress, or all the might of your strength?

kikuyu: Halkan itti namoonni mana isaaniitii buqqifaman hin hawwin.
english: Don’t desire the night, when people are cut off in their place.

kikuyu: Ati akka hamminatti hin deebine of eeggadhu; qooda rakkinaa waan kana filatteertaatii.
english: Take heed, don’t regard iniquity; for you have chosen this rather than affliction.

kikuyu: “Kunoo Waaqni humna isaatiin ol ol jedheera; barsiisaan akka isaa eenyu?
english: Behold, God is exalted in his power. Who is a teacher like him?

kikuyu: Namni karaa isatti himu, yookaan kan, ‘Ati dogoggorteerta’ isaan jedhu eenyu?
english: Who has prescribed his way for him? Or who can say, ‘You have committed unrighteousness’?

kikuyu: Hojii isaa kan namoonni faarfannaadhaan jajan sana, leellisuu hin dagatin.
english: “Remember that you magnify his work, about which men have sung.

kikuyu: Namni hundinuu argeera; tokkoon tokkoon namaas fagootti xiyyeeffatee ilaala.
english: All men have looked on it. Man sees it afar off.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan Waaqni guddaa dha; nus isa hin beeknu; baayʼina bara isaas namni beekuu hin dandaʼu.
english: Behold, God is great, and we don’t know him. The number of his years is unsearchable.

kikuyu: “Inni copha bishaanii ol baasa; hurrii isaas walitti qabee bokkaatti geeddara.
english: For he draws up the drops of water, which distill in rain from his vapor,

kikuyu: Duumessis jiidha isaa gad coccobsa; bokkaan guddaanis namatti rooba.
english: which the skies pour down and which drop on man abundantly.

kikuyu: Eenyutu akka inni itti duumessoota diriirsu, akka inni itti dunkaana isaa keessaa qaqawweessaʼus hubachuu dandaʼa?
english: Indeed, can anyone understand the spreading of the clouds and the thunderings of his pavilion?

kikuyu: Akka inni itti bakakkaa naannoo isaatti bittinneessu, akka inni itti tuujuba galaanaa illee haguugu ilaali.
english: Behold, he spreads his light around him. He covers the bottom of the sea.

kikuyu: Kun haala inni ittiin saboota bulchuu fi nyaata baayʼinaan isaaniif kennuu dha.
english: For by these he judges the people. He gives food in abundance.

kikuyu: Inni harka isaa bakakkaadhaan ni guuta; akka bakakkaan sun iddoo akeeka isaa dhaʼus ni ajaja.
english: He covers his hands with the lightning, and commands it to strike the mark.

kikuyu: Kakawween isaa akka bakakkaan dhufu labsa; looni iyyuu akka inni dhiʼaate beeksisu.
english: Its noise tells about him, and the livestock also, concerning the storm that comes up.

kikuyu: “Kana irratti onneen koo ni dhikkifata; iddoo isaatiis ni uʼutaala.
english: “Yes, at this my heart trembles, and is moved out of its place.

kikuyu: Dhaggeeffadhaa! Iyya sagalee isaa, guungummii afaan isaatii baʼu illee dhagaʼaa.
english: Hear, oh, hear the noise of his voice, the sound that goes out of his mouth.

kikuyu: Inni bakakkaa isaa samii hunda jalatti gad dhiisa; gara handaara lafaattis ni erga.
english: He sends it out under the whole sky, and his lightning to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Ergasii sagaleen guungummii isaa ni dhufa; inni sagalee isaa ulfina qabeessa sanaan ni qaqawweessaʼa. Yommuu sagaleen isaa dhagaʼamutti, inni waan tokko illee hin qusatu.
english: After it a voice roars. He thunders with the voice of his majesty. He doesn’t hold back anything when his voice is heard.

kikuyu: Sagaleen Waaqaa haala dinqisiisaadhaan ni qaqawweessaʼa; inni waan guddaa hubannaa keenyaa ol taʼe godha.
english: God thunders marvelously with his voice. He does great things, which we can’t comprehend.

kikuyu: Inni cabbiidhaan, ‘Lafa irra buʼi;’ tiifuudhaanis, ‘Bokkaa jabaa taʼi’ jedha.
english: For he says to the snow, ‘Fall on the earth,’ likewise to the shower of rain, and to the showers of his mighty rain.

kikuyu: Akka namni inni uume hundi hojii isaa beekuuf, inni harka tokkoo tokkoo namaa chaappessa.
english: He seals up the hand of every man, that all men whom he has made may know it.

kikuyu: Bineensonni holqa isaaniitti galu; daʼannoo isaanii keessas ni turu.
english: Then the animals take cover, and remain in their dens.

kikuyu: Bubbeen hamaan iddoo isaatii ni baʼa; dhaamochis bubbee bittinneessu keessaa ni baʼa.
english: Out of its room comes the storm, and cold out of the north.

kikuyu: Hafuurri Waaqni baafatu cabbii uuma; bishaanonni babalʼaanis ni ititu.
english: By the breath of God, ice is given, and the width of the waters is frozen.

kikuyu: Inni duumessoota bishaan baachisa; bakakkaa isaas isaan keessa facaasa.
english: Yes, he loads the thick cloud with moisture. He spreads abroad the cloud of his lightning.

kikuyu: Isaan waan inni ajaju hunda hojjechuuf, qajeelfama inni kennuun addunyaa hunda irra naannaʼu.
english: It is turned around by his guidance, that they may do whatever he commands them on the surface of the habitable world,

kikuyu: Inni namoota adabuuf, yookaan lafa isaa obaasee jaalala isaa argisiisuuf jedhee duumessa fida.
english: whether it is for correction, or for his land, or for loving kindness, that he causes it to come.

kikuyu: “Yaa Iyyoob waan kana dhaggeeffadhu; mee of qabiitii hojii Waaqaa isa dinqisiisaa sana hubadhu.
english: “Listen to this, Job. Stand still, and consider the wondrous works of God.

kikuyu: Waaqni akkamitti duumessoota akka ajajuu fi akkamitti akka balaqqeessisu ati ni beektaa?
english: Do you know how God controls them, and causes the lightning of his cloud to shine?

kikuyu: Akka itti duumessoonni wal qixxaatanii rarraʼan, hojii dinqisiisaa Waaqaa isa beekumsaan mudaa hin qabne sanaa beektaa?
english: Do you know the workings of the clouds, the wondrous works of him who is perfect in knowledge?

kikuyu: Ati kan yeroo lafti bubbee kibbaatiin calʼistutti hoʼa wayyaa keetiitiin waxalamtu,
english: You whose clothing is warm when the earth is still by reason of the south wind?

kikuyu: samii akkuma of-ilaalee naasii baqfamee jabaatu sana diriirsuu keessatti isa gargaaruu ni dandeessaa?
english: Can you, with him, spread out the sky, which is strong as a cast metal mirror?

kikuyu: “Waan nu isaan jennu nutti himi; nu sababii dukkana keenyaatiifuu dubbii keenya qajeelfachuu hin dandeenyu.
english: Teach us what we will tell him, for we can’t make our case by reason of darkness.

kikuyu: Akka ani dubbachuu fedhu isatti himamuu qabaa? Namni kam iyyuu liqimfamuuf ni gaafataa?
english: Will it be told him that I would speak? Or should a man wish that he were swallowed up?

kikuyu: Erga qilleensi samiiwwan qulqulleessee booddee, namni aduu humna guutuun iftu ilaaluu dandaʼu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: Now men don’t see the light which is bright in the skies, but the wind passes, and clears them.

kikuyu: Waaqni bareedina warqeetiin kaabaa ni dhufa; inni ulfina isaa isa sodaachisaa sanaan ni dhufa.
english: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.

kikuyu: Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu hubannaa keenyaa oli; inni humnaa fi murtii qajeelaadhaan guddaa dha; qajeelummaan isaa baayʼee dha; inni nama hin cunqursu.
english: We can’t reach the Almighty. He is exalted in power. In justice and great righteousness, he will not oppress.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu, namoonni isa sodaatu; inni warra ogeeyyii of seʼan hunda waʼittuu hin hedu.”
english: Therefore men revere him. He doesn’t regard any who are wise of heart.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Waaqayyo bubbee jabaa keessaa Iyyoobitti dubbate. Akkana jedhes:
english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind,

kikuyu: “Namni dubbii beekumsa malee dubbatamuun karoora koo dukkanneessu kun eenyu?
english: “Who is this who darkens counsel by words without knowledge?

kikuyu: Mee akka gootaa mudhii kee hidhadhu; ani sin gaafadha; ati immoo deebii naa kenni.
english: Brace yourself like a man, for I will question you, then you answer me!

kikuyu: “Yeroo ani hundee lafaa kaaʼetti ati eessa turte? Yoo hubatte mee natti himi.
english: “Where were you when I laid the foundations of the earth? Declare, if you have understanding.

kikuyu: Eenyutu balʼina ishee murteesse? Dhugumaan ni beektaa? Eenyutu ulee safaraa ishee irra harkise?
english: Who determined its measures, if you know? Or who stretched the line on it?

kikuyu: Hundeen ishee maal irra dhaabame? Yookaan eenyutu dhagaa golee ishee dhaabe?
english: What were its foundations fastened on? Or who laid its cornerstone,

kikuyu: Kunis yeroo bakkalchoonni barii walii wajjin faarfatanitti, yeroo ilmaan Waaqayyoos ililchanitti ture.
english: when the morning stars sang together, and all the sons of God shouted for joy?

kikuyu: “Yeroo galaanni cabsee garaa lafaa keessaa baʼetti eenyutu balbala itti cufee ittise?
english: “Or who shut up the sea with doors, when it broke out of the womb,

kikuyu: Yeroo ani duumessoota uffata isaa godhee dukkana guddaan maretti,
english: when I made clouds its garment, and wrapped it in thick darkness,

kikuyu: yeroo ani daangaa isaa dhaabee balbalaa fi danqaraa hojjedheefitti,
english: marked out for it my bound, set bars and doors,

kikuyu: anis, ‘Ati hamma asiitti dhufta; garuu darbuu hin dandeessu; dambaliin of jajuu keetii illee asumatti dhaabata!’ jedheen.
english: and said, ‘You may come here, but no further. Your proud waves shall be stopped here’?

kikuyu: “Ati bara jireenya keetii barraaqa ajajjee yookaan barii obborootti iddoo isaa argisiiftee beektaa?
english: “Have you commanded the morning in your days, and caused the dawn to know its place,

kikuyu: Akka inni handaara lafaa qabatee namoota hamoo achi keessaa hurgufu gooteertaa?
english: that it might take hold of the ends of the earth, and shake the wicked out of it?

kikuyu: Lafti akka suphee chaappaa jala jiruutti bifa geeddaratti; bifti ishees akka bifa uffataatti mulʼata.
english: It is changed as clay under the seal, and presented as a garment.

kikuyu: Hamoonni ifa isaanii dhowwatamaniiru; irreen isaanii inni ol kaʼes cabeera.
english: From the wicked, their light is withheld. The high arm is broken.

kikuyu: “Ati gara burqaa galaanaa gad buutee yookaan tuujuba bishaanii seentee hundee isaa irra deemtee beektaa?
english: “Have you entered into the springs of the sea? Or have you walked in the recesses of the deep?

kikuyu: Karri duʼaa sitti mulʼifameeraa? Karra gaaddidduu duʼaas argiteertaa?
english: Have the gates of death been revealed to you? Or have you seen the gates of the shadow of death?

kikuyu: Balʼina lafaa guddaa sana hubatteertaa? Yoo kana hunda beekte dubbadhu.
english: Have you comprehended the earth in its width? Declare, if you know it all.

kikuyu: “Karaan iddoo ifni jirutti nama geessu kami? Dukkannis eessa jiraata?
english: “What is the way to the dwelling of light? As for darkness, where is its place,

kikuyu: Iddoo isaaniitti isaan geessuu dandeessaa? Daandii lafa jireenya isaaniitti geessu beektaa?
english: that you should take it to its bound, that you should discern the paths to its house?

kikuyu: Ati dhugumaan ni beekta; yeroo sana dhalatteertaatii! Ati bara hedduu jiraatteerta!
english: Surely you know, for you were born then, and the number of your days is great!

kikuyu: “Mankuusa cabbii seentee yookaan mankuusa dhagaa cabbii argiteertaa?
english: Have you entered the storehouses of the snow, or have you seen the storehouses of the hail,

kikuyu: Kan ani yeroo rakkinaatiif, guyyaa waraanaa fi lolaatiif ol kaaʼadhe argiteertaa?
english: which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?

kikuyu: Karaan iddoo ifni itti bittinnaaʼutti yookaan gara iddoo bubbeen baʼaa itti lafa irra faffacaʼuutti nama geessu kami?
english: By what way is the lightning distributed, or the east wind scattered on the earth?

kikuyu: Eenyutu lolaadhaaf boʼoo, bakakkaadhaaf immoo daandii baasee,
english: Who has cut a channel for the flood water, or the path for the thunderstorm,

kikuyu: lafa namni tokko iyyuu keessa hin jiraanne, gammoojjii namni tokko iyyuu keessa hin jirre bishaan obaasuuf,
english: to cause it to rain on a land where there is no man, on the wilderness, in which there is no man,

kikuyu: lafa namni keessa hin jiraannee fi lafa onaa quubsee margas itti biqilchu eenyu?
english: to satisfy the waste and desolate ground, to cause the tender grass to grow?

kikuyu: Roobni abbaa qabaa? Copha fixeensaa eenyutu dhalche?
english: Does the rain have a father? Or who fathers the drops of dew?

kikuyu: Cabbiin garaa eenyuutii baʼa? Qorra samii eenyutu dhala?
english: Whose womb did the ice come out of? Who has given birth to the gray frost of the sky?

kikuyu: Bishaanonni akka dhagaa jabaatu, fuulli tuujubaas akka cabbii taʼa.
english: The waters become hard like stone, when the surface of the deep is frozen.

kikuyu: “Urjiiwwan babbareedoo Torbii jedhaman hidhuu ni dandeessaa? Yookaan hidhaa Urjii Sadee jedhamuu hiikuu ni dandeessaa?
english: “Can you bind the cluster of the Pleiades, or loosen the cords of Orion?

kikuyu: Tuuta urjiiwwanii waqtiilee isaaniitti fiduu yookaan urjii Amaaketa jedhamu ilmaan isaa wajjin bobbaasuu ni dandeessaa?
english: Can you lead the constellations out in their season? Or can you guide the Bear with her cubs?

kikuyu: Seera samiiwwanii beektaa? Bulchiinsa isaanii lafa irratti hundeessuu ni dandeessaa?
english: Do you know the laws of the heavens? Can you establish its dominion over the earth?

kikuyu: “Ati sagalee kee gara duumessaatti ol fudhattee, lolaa bishaaniitiin of haguuguu ni dandeessaa?
english: “Can you lift up your voice to the clouds, that abundance of waters may cover you?

kikuyu: Ati bakakkaa daandii isaa irra erguu ni dandeessaa? Innis, ‘Kunoo ani asan jira’ siin jedhaa?
english: Can you send out lightnings, that they may go? Do they report to you, ‘Here we are’?

kikuyu: Eenyutu yaada garaatiif ogummaa yookaan sammuudhaaf hubannaa kenne?
english: Who has put wisdom in the inward parts? Or who has given understanding to the mind?

kikuyu: Eenyutu duumessoota lakkaaʼuuf ogummaa qaba? Eenyutu okkotee bishaan samii
english: Who can count the clouds by wisdom? Or who can pour out the containers of the sky,

kikuyu: yeroo biyyoon jabaattutti, yeroo supheen wal qabattutti jalʼisuu dandaʼa?
english: when the dust runs into a mass, and the clods of earth stick together?

kikuyu: “Ati leenca dhalaadhaaf nyaata adamsitee saafela leencaas beela baaftee
english: “Can you hunt the prey for the lioness, or satisfy the appetite of the young lions,

kikuyu: yeroo isaan manʼee isaanii keessatti riphanitti yookaan yeroo isaan daggala keessatti riphanii waa eeggatanitti beela ni baaftaa?
english: when they crouch in their dens, and lie in wait in the thicket?

kikuyu: Eenyutu yeroo ilmaan ishee gara Waaqaatti iyyan, yeroo isaan nyaata dhabanii jooranitti, arraagessaaf nyaata kenna?
english: Who provides for the raven his prey, when his young ones cry to God, and wander for lack of food?

kikuyu: “Yeroo itti qellejjeen dhaltu beektaa? Yeroo itti borofni ilmoo ishee dhaltu argiteertaa?
english: “Do you know the time when the mountain goats give birth? Do you watch when the doe bears fawns?

kikuyu: Jiʼa isaan garaatti ilmaan baatan ni lakkooftaa? Yeroo isaan itti dhalan ni beektaa?
english: Can you count the months that they fulfill? Or do you know the time when they give birth?

kikuyu: Isaan jilbeenfatanii ilmaan isaanii dhalu; foolachuu isaaniis ni hobbaafatu.
english: They bow themselves. They bear their young. They end their labor pains.

kikuyu: Ilmaan isaanii ni jabaatu; alattis ni guddatu; baʼanii ni deemu; hin deebiʼanis.
english: Their young ones become strong. They grow up in the open field. They go out, and don’t return again.

kikuyu: “Eenyutu harree diidaa gad dhiise? Funyoo isaas eenyutu hiike?
english: “Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,

kikuyu: Ani gammoojjii mana isaa, lafa soogiddaas iddoo jireenya isaa godheen kenneef.
english: whose home I have made the wilderness, and the salt land his dwelling place?

kikuyu: Inni waca magaalaa keessaatti ni kolfa; iyya konkolaachisaas hin dhagaʼu.
english: He scorns the tumult of the city, neither does he hear the shouting of the driver.

kikuyu: Waan dheedu argachuuf tulluuwwan irra laba; waan lalisaa hundas ni barbaada.
english: The range of the mountains is his pasture. He searches after every green thing.

kikuyu: “Gafarsi si tajaajiluuf siif ajajamaa? Dallaa kee keessas ni bulaa?
english: “Will the wild ox be content to serve you? Or will he stay by your feeding trough?

kikuyu: Akka inni lafa siif qotuuf funyoodhaan isa hidhuu ni dandeessaa? Yookaan inni si duubaan boʼoo ni baasaa?
english: Can you hold the wild ox in the furrow with his harness? Or will he till the valleys after you?

kikuyu: Ati waan inni humna guddaa qabuuf isa ni amanattaa? Hojii kee jabaa illee isatti ni dhiiftaa?
english: Will you trust him, because his strength is great? Or will you leave to him your labor?

kikuyu: Akka inni midhaan kee walitti qabee oobdii kee irratti siif tuuluuf isa ni abdattaa?
english: Will you confide in him, that he will bring home your seed, and gather the grain of your threshing floor?

kikuyu: “Guchiin gammachuudhaan qoochoo ishee afarsiti; garuu qoochoo fi baallee huummootiin wal bira hin qabamu.
english: “The wings of the ostrich wave proudly, but are they the feathers and plumage of love?

kikuyu: Hanqaaquu ishee lafa irratti buufti; akka itti hoʼuufis cirracha keessatti dhiifti;
english: For she leaves her eggs on the earth, warms them in the dust,

kikuyu: garuu akka miilli wayii caccabsu, akka bineensi irra ejjetu hin yaadattu.
english: and forgets that the foot may crush them, or that the wild animal may trample them.

kikuyu: Cuucii isheettis akka waan isaan kan ishee hin taʼiniitti garaa jabaatti; yoo dadhabbiin ishee akkasumaan bade illee isheef homaa miti;
english: She deals harshly with her young ones, as if they were not hers. Though her labor is in vain, she is without fear,

kikuyu: Waaqni ogummaadhaan ishee hin badhaafneetii; yookaan hubannaa isheef hin qoodne.
english: because God has deprived her of wisdom, neither has he imparted to her understanding.

kikuyu: Yeroo fiiguuf qoochoo ishee balʼifattutti, isheen fardaa fi namicha gulufutti kofalti.
english: When she lifts up herself on high, she scorns the horse and his rider.

kikuyu: “Ati fardaaf jabina ni kennitaa? Yookaan morma isaatti gama uffisuu dandeessaa?
english: “Have you given the horse might? Have you clothed his neck with a quivering mane?

kikuyu: Akka inni akkuma hawwaannisaatti utaalu ni gootaa? Ulfinni korrisa isaas sodaachisaa dha.
english: Have you made him to leap as a locust? The glory of his snorting is awesome.

kikuyu: Inni humna isaatti gammadee akka malee guulee lafa dhidhiita; baʼees miʼa lolaatti qajeela.
english: He paws in the valley, and rejoices in his strength. He goes out to meet the armed men.

kikuyu: Inni sodaatti ni kolfa; waan tokko illee hin sodaatu; goraadee irraas duubatti hin deebiʼu.
english: He mocks at fear, and is not dismayed, neither does he turn back from the sword.

kikuyu: Manʼeen xiyyaa, eeboo fi ankaaseen calaqqisus cinaacha isaatti bubbuʼee kililcha.
english: The quiver rattles against him, the flashing spear and the javelin.

kikuyu: Siʼaaʼee rommuudhaan lafa haadha; yeroo malakanni afuufamutti illee obsee dhaabachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: He eats up the ground with fierceness and rage, neither does he stand still at the sound of the trumpet.

kikuyu: Inni yommuu malakanni afuufamutti ‘Uffee’ jedhee imimsa; waca ajajjootaatii fi iyya waraanaa, foolii waraanaa illee fagoottu suufa.
english: As often as the trumpet sounds he snorts, ‘Aha!’ He smells the battle afar off, the thunder of the captains, and the shouting.

kikuyu: “Cululleen ogummaa keetiin barriftee qoochoo ishees gara kibbaatti balʼiftii?
english: “Is it by your wisdom that the hawk soars, and stretches her wings toward the south?

kikuyu: Risaan ajaja keetiin ol baʼee ol fagootti mana isaa ijaarrataa?
english: Is it at your command that the eagle mounts up, and makes his nest on high?

kikuyu: Inni qarqara hallayyaa irra jiraata; halkanis achuma bula; kattaan fofottoqaanis daʼoo isaa ti.
english: On the cliff he dwells and makes his home, on the point of the cliff and the stronghold.

kikuyu: Achi taaʼees waan nyaatu adamsa; iji isaas fagootti waan sana arga.
english: From there he spies out the prey. His eyes see it afar off.

kikuyu: Cuucoliin isaa dhiiga dhugu; innis lafa raqni jiruu hin dhabamu.”
english: His young ones also suck up blood. Where the slain are, there he is.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyos Iyyoobiin akkana jedhe:
english: Moreover the LORD answered Job,

kikuyu: “Namni Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼuun falmu tokko isa ni qajeelchaa? Namni Waaqa himatu deebii haa kennuuf!”
english: “Shall he who argues contend with the Almighty? He who argues with God, let him answer it.”

kikuyu: Iyyoobis akkana jedhee Waaqayyoof deebise:
english: Then Job answered the LORD,

kikuyu: “Ani nama faayidaa hin qabnee dha; akkamittin deebii siif kenna? Harka koo afaan koo irra nan kaaʼadha.
english: “Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.

kikuyu: Ani yeroo tokko dubbadheera; garuu ani waanan deebisu hin qabu; siʼa lama dubbadheera; kana caalaa garuu homaa hin jedhu.”
english: I have spoken once, and I will not answer; Yes, twice, but I will proceed no further.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Waaqayyo bubbee jabaa keessaa Iyyoobitti dubbate:
english: Then the LORD answered Job out of the whirlwind:

kikuyu: “Akka dhiiraatti mudhii kee hidhadhu; ani sin gaafadha; ati immoo deebii naa kennita.
english: “Now brace yourself like a man. I will question you, and you will answer me.

kikuyu: “Ati murtii koo qajeelaa sana gatii dhabsiistaa? Ofii keetii qajeelaa taʼuuf na himattaa?
english: Will you even annul my judgment? Will you condemn me, that you may be justified?

kikuyu: Irree akka irree Waaqaa qabdaa? Sagaleen kees akka sagalee isaa qaqawweessaʼuu dandaʼaa?
english: Or do you have an arm like God? Can you thunder with a voice like him?

kikuyu: Ulfinaa fi guddinaan of miidhagsi; kabajaa fi barreedina uffadhu.
english: “Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsa kee kan guutee irra yaaʼu sana dhangalaasi; nama of tuulu kam iyyuu ilaalii qaanessi.
english: Pour out the fury of your anger. Look at everyone who is proud, and bring him low.

kikuyu: Nama of tuulu hunda ilaalii gad deebisi; hamoota illee iddoodhuma isaan dhaabatanitti caccabsi.
english: Look at everyone who is proud, and humble him. Crush the wicked in their place.

kikuyu: Isaan hunda walitti qabii biyyoo keessatti awwaali; fuula isaaniis awwaala keessa dhoksi.
english: Hide them in the dust together. Bind their faces in the hidden place.

kikuyu: Yoos ani mataan koo, akka harki kee mirgaa si oolchuu dandaʼu siifin mirkaneessa.
english: Then I will also admit to you that your own right hand can save you.

kikuyu: “Bihemootin ani akkuman si uumettin uume, kan akkuma qotiyyoo marga dheedu sana mee ilaali.
english: “See now behemoth, which I made as well as you. He eats grass as an ox.

kikuyu: Jabinni isaa dugda isaa keessa, humni isaa immoo ribuu garaa isaa keessa jira!
english: Look now, his strength is in his thighs. His force is in the muscles of his belly.

kikuyu: Eegeen isaa akkuma muka birbirsaa raafama; ribuun tafa isaa wal keessa xaxamaa dha.
english: He moves his tail like a cedar. The sinews of his thighs are knit together.

kikuyu: Lafeen isaa akka ujummoo naasii ti; harkii fi miilli isaa immoo akka ulee sibiilaa ti.
english: His bones are like tubes of bronze. His limbs are like bars of iron.

kikuyu: Inni uumamawwan Waaqaa keessaa hangafa; garuu inni isa uume goraadee isaatiin isatti dhiʼaachuu dandaʼa.
english: He is the chief of the ways of God. He who made him gives him his sword.

kikuyu: Gaarran marga ni kennuuf; bineensonni hundi naannoo isaa ni burraaqu.
english: Surely the mountains produce food for him, where all the animals of the field play.

kikuyu: Inni huuxxii qoraattii qabu jala ciisa; shambaqqoo lafa dhaqdhaqii keessa dhokata.
english: He lies under the lotus trees, in the covert of the reed, and the marsh.

kikuyu: Gaaddisni huuxxii qoraattii qabuu isa haguuga; alaltuun lagaas isa marsa.
english: The lotuses cover him with their shade. The willows of the brook surround him.

kikuyu: Yommuu lagni cabsee yaaʼutti iyyuu kunoo, inni hin rifatu. Lagni Yordaanos afaan isaa irra garagalu iyyuu inni hin shishu.
english: Behold, if a river overflows, he doesn’t tremble. He is confident, though the Jordan swells even to his mouth.

kikuyu: Namni utuma inni arguu isa qabuu yookaan kiyyoodhaan isa qabee funyaan isaa uruu dandaʼu tokko iyyuu jiraa?
english: Shall any take him when he is on the watch, or pierce through his nose with a snare?

kikuyu: “Ati hokkoo qurxummiitiin Lewaataan harkiftee baasuu yookaan arraba isaa funyoodhaan hidhuu ni dandeessaa?
english: “Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?

kikuyu: Funyaan isaa keessa funyoo baasuu yookaan lafee mangaagaa isaa hokkoodhaan uruu ni dandeessaa?
english: Can you put a rope into his nose, or pierce his jaw through with a hook?

kikuyu: Inni akka ati isaaf araaramtuuf guddisee si kadhataa? Afaan nagaatiinis sitti ni dubbataa?
english: Will he make many petitions to you, or will he speak soft words to you?

kikuyu: Akka ati bara baraan garbicha godhattuuf inni si wajjin kakuu ni galaa?
english: Will he make a covenant with you, that you should take him for a servant forever?

kikuyu: Ati akka simbirroota wajjin taphattu isa wajjin ni taphattaa? Yookaan shamarran keetiif isa ni hiitaa?
english: Will you play with him as with a bird? Or will you bind him for your girls?

kikuyu: Daldaltoonni isa irratti gatii wal dubbatuu? Warra bitee gurguruufis isa ni qooduu?
english: Will traders barter for him? Will they part him among the merchants?

kikuyu: Ati gogaa isaa xiyyaan, yookaan mataa isaa hokkoo ittiin qurxummii qabaniin wawwaraanuu ni dandeessaa?
english: Can you fill his skin with barbed irons, or his head with fish spears?

kikuyu: Yoo harka keetiin isa tuqxe, walʼaansoo sana ni yaadatta; deebitees waan sana hin gootu!
english: Lay your hand on him. Remember the battle, and do so no more.

kikuyu: Isa moʼanna jedhanii abdachuun soba; ijumaan isa ilaaluunuu nama hollachiisa.
english: Behold, the hope of him is in vain. Won’t one be cast down even at the sight of him?

kikuyu: Namni isa dammaqsuuf garaa qabaatu tokko iyyuu hin jiru. Egaa namni na dura dhaabachuu dandaʼu eenyu?
english: None is so fierce that he dare stir him up. Who then is he who can stand before me?

kikuyu: Namni waa natti kennatee ani deebisuufii qabu eenyu? Wanni samii jala jiru hundinuu kanuma koo ti.
english: Who has first given to me, that I should repay him? Everything under the heavens is mine.

kikuyu: “Ani waaʼee harkaa fi miilla isaa, waaʼee jabinaa fi dhaaba toluu isaa dubbachuu hin dhiisu.
english: “I will not keep silence concerning his limbs, nor his mighty strength, nor his goodly frame.

kikuyu: Eenyutu uffata inni irraan uffatu irraa baasa? Eenyutu luugama qabatee isatti dhiʼaata?
english: Who can strip off his outer garment? Who will come within his jaws?

kikuyu: Eenyutu balbala afaan isaa isa ilkaan isaa sodaachisaa sanaan marfame banuu dandaʼa?
english: Who can open the doors of his face? Around his teeth is terror.

kikuyu: Dugdi isaa gaachanawwan tarree galan, kanneen akka malee walitti maxxanfaman qaba;
english: Strong scales are his pride, shut up together with a close seal.

kikuyu: tokkoon tokkoon gaachanawwan sanaa akka qilleensi gidduu isaanii hin baaneef baayʼee walitti maxxanu.
english: One is so near to another, that no air can come between them.

kikuyu: Isaan jabeeffamanii walitti qabsiifaman; waan walitti fayyaniif gargar hin baafaman.
english: They are joined to one another. They stick together, so that they can’t be pulled apart.

kikuyu: Haxxissoon isaa balaqqeessa ifaa baasa; iji isaa immoo akkuma ifa biiftuu reefuu baatuu ti.
english: His sneezing flashes out light. His eyes are like the eyelids of the morning.

kikuyu: Afaan isaa keessaa arraba ibiddaatu baʼa; qaanqeenis afaan isaa keessaa ni faffacaʼa.
english: Out of his mouth go burning torches. Sparks of fire leap out.

kikuyu: Akkuma aara xuwwee ibidda shambaqqoo irratti dafqu keessaa baʼuu funyaan isaatii aarri ni baʼa.
english: Out of his nostrils a smoke goes, as of a boiling pot over a fire of reeds.

kikuyu: Hafuurri afaan isaatii baʼu cilee ibiddaa qabsiisa; afaan isaa keessaas arrabni ibiddaa ni baʼa.
english: His breath kindles coals. A flame goes out of his mouth.

kikuyu: Morma isaa keessa jabinatu jira; sodaachisuunis fuula isaa dura ni utaala.
english: There is strength in his neck. Terror dances before him.

kikuyu: Dachaan foon isaa wal qabateera; dachaan sunis walitti fayyeera; hin sochoʼus.
english: The flakes of his flesh are joined together. They are firm on him. They can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Lapheen isaa akka kattaa jabaata; akka dhagaa daakuus jabaa dha.
english: His heart is as firm as a stone, yes, firm as the lower millstone.

kikuyu: Yeroo inni ol kaʼutti, jajjaboonni ni sodaatu; yommuu inni lafa sochoosaa dhufutti isaan of irra garagalanii baqatu.
english: When he raises himself up, the mighty are afraid. They retreat before his thrashing.

kikuyu: Goraadeen itti buʼu illee homaa isa hin godhu; eeboon yookaan xiyyi yookaan ankaaseenis homaa isa hin godhu.
english: If one attacks him with the sword, it can’t prevail; nor the spear, the dart, nor the pointed shaft.

kikuyu: Inni sibiila akka cidiitti, naasii immoo akka muka tortoreetti heda.
english: He counts iron as straw, and bronze as rotten wood.

kikuyu: Xiyyi isa hin baqachiisu; dhagaan furrisaa isaaf akkuma habaqii ti.
english: The arrow can’t make him flee. Sling stones are like chaff to him.

kikuyu: Bokkuun isaaf akkuma cidii ti; inni mirmirfamuu eebootti ni kolfa.
english: Clubs are counted as stubble. He laughs at the rushing of the javelin.

kikuyu: Garaan isaa jalli akka cabaa okkotee kan qara qabuu ti; akka muka ittiin midhaan dhaʼaniittis dhoqqee baqaqsa.
english: His undersides are like sharp potsherds, leaving a trail in the mud like a threshing sledge.

kikuyu: Inni tuujuba akka okkotee dafquutti koqsiisa; galaanas akkuma bilqaaxxii dibataa raasa.
english: He makes the deep to boil like a pot. He makes the sea like a pot of ointment.

kikuyu: Inni duuba isaatiin akka karaan ifu ni godha; namni waan tuujubni sun rifeensa adii qabu seʼa.
english: He makes a path shine after him. One would think the deep had white hair.

kikuyu: Uumamni homaa hin sodaanne, kan isaan qixxaatu tokko iyyuu lafa irra hin jiru.
english: On earth there is not his equal, that is made without fear.

kikuyu: Inni warra of tuulu ni tuffata; warra of jaju hunda irratti mootii dha.”
english: He sees everything that is high. He is king over all the sons of pride.”

kikuyu: Iyyoobis akkana jedhee Waaqayyoof deebii kenne:
english: Then Job answered the LORD:

kikuyu: “Ani akka ati waan hunda hojjechuu dandeessu nan beeka; karoorri kee tokko iyyuu karaatti hin hafu.
english: “I know that you can do all things, and that no purpose of yours can be restrained.

kikuyu: Ati, ‘Namni beekumsa malee gorsa koo dhoksu kun eenyu?’ jettee gaafatte. Ani dhugumaan waan naaf hin galin, waan dinqii natti taʼe kan ani hin beekin dubbadheera.
english: You asked, ‘Who is this who hides counsel without knowledge?’ therefore I have uttered that which I didn’t understand, things too wonderful for me, which I didn’t know.

kikuyu: “Ati akkana jetteerta; ‘Ani nan dubbadhaa mee dhaggeeffadhu; ani sin gaafadhaa, ati immoo naaf deebisi.’
english: You said, ‘Listen, now, and I will speak; I will question you, and you will answer me.’

kikuyu: Gurri koo waaʼee kee dhagaʼee ture; amma garuu iji koo si argeera.
english: I had heard of you by the hearing of the ear, but now my eye sees you.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani of tuffadhee biyyoo fi daaraa keessa taaʼee qalbii nan jijjiirradha.”
english: Therefore I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo erga waan kana Iyyoobitti dubbatee booddee Eliifaaz Teemaanichaan akkana jedhe; “Sababii isin akka Iyyoob garbichi koo dubbate sana waaʼee koo waan qajeelaa hin dubbatiniif dheekkamsi koo siʼii fi michoota kee lamaanitti bobaʼeera.
english: It was so, that after the LORD had spoken these words to Job, the LORD said to Eliphaz the Temanite, “My wrath is kindled against you, and against your two friends; for you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isin amma jiboota torbaa fi korbeeyyii hoolaa torba fuudhaatii gara garbicha koo Iyyoob dhaqaatii waaʼee ofii keessaniitiif aarsaa gubamu dhiʼeessaa. Iyyoob garbichi koo isinii kadhata; ani kadhannaa isaa nan dhagaʼa; akka balleessaa keessaniittis isinitti hin muru. Isin akka Iyyoob garbichi koo dubbate sana waaʼee koo waan qajeelaa hin dubbanneetii.”
english: Now therefore, take to yourselves seven bulls and seven rams, and go to my servant Job, and offer up for yourselves a burnt offering; and my servant Job shall pray for you, for I will accept him, that I not deal with you according to your folly. For you have not spoken of me the thing that is right, as my servant Job has.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Eliifaaz Teemaanichi, Bildaad Shuhaahichii fi Zoofaari Naaʼimaatichi waan Waaqayyo isaanitti hime sana godhan; Waaqayyos kadhannaa Iyyoob dhagaʼe.
english: So Eliphaz the Temanite and Bildad the Shuhite and Zophar the Naamathite went and did what the LORD commanded them, and the LORD accepted Job.

kikuyu: Erga Iyyoob michoota isaatiif kadhatee booddee Waaqayyo deebisee isa sooromsee qabeenya inni duraan qabu sana harka lama kenneef.
english: The LORD restored Job’s prosperity when he prayed for his friends. The LORD gave Job twice as much as he had before.

kikuyu: Obboloonni isaa, obboleettonni isaa hundinuu fi warri dur isa beekan hundi dhufanii mana isaatti isa wajjin nyaatan. Isaanis sababii rakkina Waaqayyo isatti fide hundaatiif isaaf gaddanii isa jajjabeessan; tokkoon tokkoon isaaniis meetii fi qubeelaa warqee kennaniif.
english: Then all his brothers, all his sisters, and all those who had been of his acquaintance before, came to him and ate bread with him in his house. They comforted him, and consoled him concerning all the evil that the LORD had brought on him. Everyone also gave him a piece of money, and everyone a ring of gold.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos kan duraa caalaa jireenya Iyyoob kan fuul duraa eebbise. Iyyoobis hoolaa kuma kudha afur, gaala kuma jaʼa, qotiyyoo kuma lamaa fi harree dhaltuu kuma tokko qaba ture.
english: So the LORD blessed the latter end of Job more than his beginning. He had fourteen thousand sheep, six thousand camels, one thousand yoke of oxen, and a thousand female donkeys.

kikuyu: Akkasumas ilmaan torbaa fi intallan sadii qaba ture.
english: He had also seven sons and three daughters.

kikuyu: Intala isaa jalqabaa Yemiimaa, ishee lammaffaa Keziiyaa, ishee sadaffaa immoo Qeren-Haphuuk jedhee moggaase.
english: He called the name of the first, Jemimah; and the name of the second, Keziah; and the name of the third, Keren Happuch.

kikuyu: Biyya sana hunda keessatti dubartoonni akka intallan Iyyoob babbareedan eessattuu hin argamne. Abbaan isaaniis obboloota isaanii gidduutti dhaala kenneef.
english: In all the land were no women found so beautiful as the daughters of Job. Their father gave them an inheritance among their brothers.
