kikuyu: Iyyoobis ergasii waggaa dhibba tokkoo fi afurtama jiraate; innis hamma dhaloota afuriitti ijoollee fi ijoollee ijoollee isaa arge.
english: After this Job lived one hundred forty years, and saw his sons, and his sons’ sons, to four generations.

kikuyu: Innis akkasiin bara dheeraa jiraatee dulloomee duʼe.
english: So Job died, being old and full of days.

kikuyu: Namni gorsa hamootaatiin hin deddeebine, yookaan karaa cubbamootaa irra hin dhaabanne, yookaan barcuma qoostotaa irra hin teenye, eebbifamaa dha.
english: Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat of scoffers;

kikuyu: Garuu inni seera Waaqayyootti gammada; seera isaas halkanii guyyaa irra deddeebiʼee itti yaada.
english: but his delight is in the LORD’s law. On his law he meditates day and night.

kikuyu: Inni akkuma muka qarqara bishaan yaaʼuu dhaabamee yeroo isaatti ija isaa kennu, kan baalli isaas hin coollagnee ti; wanni inni hojjetu hundinuus ni tolaaf.
english: He will be like a tree planted by the streams of water, that produces its fruit in its season, whose leaf also does not wither. Whatever he does shall prosper.

kikuyu: Hamoonni garuu akkana miti; isaan akka habaqii qilleensi fudhatee balleessuu ti.
english: The wicked are not so, but are like the chaff which the wind drives away.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu hamoonni murtii dura, yookaan cubbamoonni waldaa qajeeltotaa keessa hin dhaabatan.
english: Therefore the wicked shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo karaa qajeeltotaa ni beekaatii; karaan hamootaa garuu gara badiitti geessa.
english: For the LORD knows the way of the righteous, but the way of the wicked shall perish.

kikuyu: Namoonni maaliif akkanumaan malatu? Saboonnis maaliif waan akkanumaan mariʼatu?
english: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

kikuyu: Mootonni lafaa kaʼanii, bulchitoonnis Waaqayyoo fi Masiihii isaatiin mormuuf walitti qabaman;
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers take counsel together, against the LORD, and against his Anointed, saying,

kikuyu: isaanis, “Kottaa foncaa isaanii of irraa kukkunnaa; hidhaa isaaniis of irraa hiiknee gannaa” jedhu.
english: “Let’s break their bonds apart, and cast their cords from us.”

kikuyu: Inni samii keessa, teessoo irra taaʼee jiru ni kolfa; Gooftaanis isaanitti qoosa.
english: He who sits in the heavens will laugh. The Lord will have them in derision.

kikuyu: Innis aarii isaatiin isaan ifata; dheekkamsa isaatiinis isaan naasisa;
english: Then he will speak to them in his anger, and terrify them in his wrath:

kikuyu: innis, “Ani tulluu koo qulqulluu irra, Xiyoon irra, mootii koo teessifadheera” jedha.
english: “Yet I have set my King on my holy hill of Zion.”

kikuyu: Ani seera Waaqayyoo nan labsa: innis akkana anaan jedhe; “Ati ilma koo ti; ani harʼa si dhalcheera.
english: I will tell of the decree: The LORD said to me, “You are my son. Today I have become your father.

kikuyu: Na kadhadhu; ani saboota dhaala kee, handaara lafaas qabeenya kee godhee siifan kenna.
english: Ask of me, and I will give the nations for your inheritance, the uttermost parts of the earth for your possession.

kikuyu: Ati ulee sibiilaatiin isaan cabsita; akka qodaa supheettis isaan hurreessita.”
english: You shall break them with a rod of iron. You shall dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa mootota, qalbeeffadhaa; bulchitoonni lafaas of eeggadhaa.
english: Now therefore be wise, you kings. Be instructed, you judges of the earth.

kikuyu: Sodaadhaan Waaqayyoon tajaajilaa; hollachaas gammadaa.
english: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

kikuyu: Akka inni hin aarreef, isinis akka karaa irratti hin badneef ilma isaa dhungadhaa; dheekkamsi isaa dafee bobaʼaatii. Warri isatti kooluu galan hundi eebbifamoo dha.
english: Give sincere homage to the Son, lest he be angry, and you perish on the way, for his wrath will soon be kindled. Blessed are all those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit yeroo ilma isaa Abesaaloom jalaa baqatetti faarfate. Yaa Waaqayyo, diinonni koo akkam baayʼatu! Namoonni baayʼeen natti kaʼaniiru!
english: A Psalm by David, when he fled from Absalom his son. LORD, how my adversaries have increased! Many are those who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeen, “Waaqni isa hin baraaru” jedhanii waaʼee koo dubbatu.
english: Many there are who say of my soul, “There is no help for him in God.” Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati garuu naannoo kootti gaachana koo ti; ulfina kootis; mataa koos kan ol qabdu suma.
english: But you, LORD, are a shield around me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head.

kikuyu: Ani guddisee Waaqayyotti nan iyyadha; innis tulluu isaa qulqulluu irraa deebii naa kenna.
english: I cry to the LORD with my voice, and he answers me out of his holy hill. Selah.

kikuyu: Ani nan ciisa; nan rafas; waan Waaqayyo ol na qabuuf nan dammaqa.
english: I laid myself down and slept. I awakened, for the LORD sustains me.

kikuyu: Saba kumaatama qixa hundaan kaʼee na marse ani hin sodaadhu.
english: I will not be afraid of tens of thousands of people who have set themselves against me on every side.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo kaʼi! Yaa Waaqa koo na baraari! Mangaagaa diinota kootii hundumaa rukuti; ilkaan hamootaa illee caccabsi.
english: Arise, LORD! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Fayyinni kan Waaqayyoo ti. Eebbi kee saba kee irra haa jiraatu.
english: Salvation belongs to the LORD. May your blessing be on your people. Selah.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit kan Baganaadhaan Faarfatamu. Yaa Waaqa qajeelumma kootii, yommuu ani si waammadhutti deebii naa kenni. Ati yeroo rakkina kootti na boqochiisi; araara kee naa buusi; kadhaa koos dhagaʼi.
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments. A Psalm by David. Answer me when I call, God of my righteousness. Give me relief from my distress. Have mercy on me, and hear my prayer.

kikuyu: Yaa ilmaan namootaa, isin hamma yoomiitti ulfina koo gara salphinaatti deebiftu? Isin hamma yoomiitti waan faayidaa hin qabne jaallattanii soba barbaaddu?
english: You sons of men, how long shall my glory be turned into dishonor? Will you love vanity and seek after falsehood? Selah.

kikuyu: Isin akka Waaqayyo warra isaaf bulan ofii isaatiif addaan baafate beekaa; Waaqayyo yommuu ani isa waammadhutti na dhagaʼa.
english: But know that the LORD has set apart for himself him who is godly; The LORD will hear when I call to him.

kikuyu: Yeroo aartanitti cubbuu hin hojjetinaa; yommuu siree keessan irra jirtanitti, garaa keessan keessatti yaadaa; calʼisaas.
english: Stand in awe, and don’t sin. Search your own heart on your bed, and be still. Selah.

kikuyu: Aarsaa qajeelummaa dhiʼeessaa; Waaqayyonis amanadhaa.
english: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness. Put your trust in the LORD.

kikuyu: Namoonni, “Eenyutu waan gaarii nu argi argisiisa?” jedhan baayʼee dha; yaa Waaqayyo, ifni fuula keetii nurratti haa ifu.
english: Many say, “Who will show us any good?” LORD, let the light of your face shine on us.

kikuyu: Gammachuu isaan yeroo midhaanii fi daadhiin wayinii isaanii baayʼatutti argatan caalaa, ati garaa koo gammachuu guddaadhaan guutteerta.
english: You have put gladness in my heart, more than when their grain and their new wine are increased.

kikuyu: Ani nagaadhaan nan ciisa; nan rafas; yaa Waaqayyo si qofatu, sodaa malee na jiraachisaatii.
english: In peace I will both lay myself down and sleep, for you alone, LORD, make me live in safety.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawitii kan ululleedhaan faarfatamu. Yaa Waaqayyo, gurra kee dubbii kootti qabi; aaduu koo illee naa hubadhu.
english: For the Chief Musician, with the flutes. A Psalm by David. Give ear to my words, LORD. Consider my meditation.

kikuyu: Yaa mootii koo fi Waaqa ko, iyya ani gargaarsaaf iyyadhu dhaggeeffadhu; ani sin kadhadhaatii.
english: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God, for I pray to you.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ganamaan sagalee koo ni dhageessa; anis ganamaan kadhata koo fuula kee duratti nan dhiʼeessa; abdiidhaanis nan eeggadha.
english: LORD, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch expectantly.

kikuyu: Ati Waaqa hamminatti gammadu miti; hamaanis si wajjin hin jiraatu.
english: For you are not a God who has pleasure in wickedness. Evil can’t live with you.

kikuyu: Of tuultonni fuula kee dura dhaabachuu hin dandaʼan. Atis warra jalʼina hojjetan hunda ni jibbita;
english: The arrogant will not stand in your sight. You hate all workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Ati warra soba dubbatan ni balleessita. Waaqayyo warra dhiiga dheebotanii fi warra nama gowwoomsan ni xireeffata.
english: You will destroy those who speak lies. The LORD abhors the bloodthirsty and deceitful man.

kikuyu: Ani garuu araara kee baayʼee sanaan mana keetti ol nan gala; si sodaachuudhaanis gad jedhee gara mana qulqullummaa kee qulqulluu sanaatti garagalee nan sagada.
english: But as for me, in the abundance of your loving kindness I will come into your house. I will bow toward your holy temple in reverence of you.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, sababii diinota kootiif jedhiitii qajeelummaa keetiin na dura buʼi; karaa kees fuula koo duratti naa qajeelchi.
english: Lead me, LORD, in your righteousness because of my enemies. Make your way straight before my face.

kikuyu: Dubbiin afaan isaaniitii baʼu tokko iyyuu hin amanamu; garaan isaanii badiisaan guutameera. Laagaan isaanii awwaala banamaa dha; arraba isaaniitiin ni sobu.
english: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth. Their heart is destruction. Their throat is an open tomb. They flatter with their tongue.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, yakkitoota taʼuu isaanii isaanitti beeksisi! Daba isaaniitiinis haa kufan. Baayʼina cubbuu isaaniitiin isaan balleessi; isaan sitti fincilaniiruutii.
english: Hold them guilty, God. Let them fall by their own counsels. Thrust them out in the multitude of their transgressions, for they have rebelled against you.

kikuyu: Warri kooluu sitti galan hundinuu garuu haa gammadan; bara baraanis gammachuudhaan haa faarfatan. Akka warri maqaa kee jaallatan sitti gammadaniif ati eegumsa kee isaan irra diriirsi.
english: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also who love your name be joyful in you.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati qajeeltota ni eebbiftaatii; akka gaachanaattis surraa keetiin isaan marsita.
english: For you will bless the righteous. LORD, you will surround him with favor as with a shield.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Baganaadhaan faarfatamu. Faarfannaa Daawit kan akka sirna Shamiiniitiitti faarfatamu. Yaa Waaqayyo aarii keetiin na hin hifatin; yookaan dheekkamsa keetiin na hin adabin.
english: For the Chief Musician; on stringed instruments, upon the eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm by David. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your anger, neither discipline me in your wrath.

kikuyu: Naa gameeraatii yaa Waaqayyo naaf araarami; lafeen koos jeeqameeraatii yaa Waaqayyo na fayyisi.
english: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am faint. LORD, heal me, for my bones are troubled.

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo akka malee jeeqameera; kun hamma yoomiitti? Yaa Waaqayyo, hamma yoomiitti?
english: My soul is also in great anguish. But you, LORD—how long?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, deebiʼiitii lubbuu koo oolchi; araara keetiif jedhiitii na fayyisi.
english: Return, LORD. Deliver my soul, and save me for your loving kindness’ sake.

kikuyu: Namni duʼe si hin yaadatu. Siiʼool keessatti eenyutu si galateeffata?
english: For in death there is no memory of you. In Sheol, who shall give you thanks?

kikuyu: Ani aaduu kootiin bututeera. Halkan hunda booʼichaan siree koo nan dhiqa; imimmaaniinis iddoo ciisichaa koo nan tortorsa.
english: I am weary with my groaning. Every night I flood my bed. I drench my couch with my tears.

kikuyu: Iji koo gaddaan fajajeera; sababii diinota koo hundaatiifis dadhabeera.
english: My eye wastes away because of grief. It grows old because of all my adversaries.

kikuyu: Warri hamaa hojjettan hundinuu narraa fagaadhaa; Waaqayyo sagalee booʼicha koo dhagaʼeeraatii.
english: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard the voice of my weeping.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo waammata koo dhagaʼeera; Waaqayyo kadhannaa koo ni fudhata.
english: The LORD has heard my supplication. The LORD accepts my prayer.

kikuyu: Diinonni koo hundinuu haa qaanaʼan; akka malees haa rifatan; qaanii tasaatiinis of irra haa garagalan.
english: May all my enemies be ashamed and dismayed. They shall turn back, they shall be disgraced suddenly.

kikuyu: Shiigaayoonni Daawit kan inni waaʼee Kuushi namicha gosa Beniyaamiif jedhee Waaqayyoof faarfate. Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa ko, ani kooluu sitti nan gala; warra na ariʼatan hunda jalaa na baasi; na oolchis;
english: A meditation by David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite. LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

kikuyu: yoo kanaa achii isaan yeroo namni na oolchu hin jirretti, akka leencaa na cicciratu; na kukkutatus.
english: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa ko, yoo ani waan kana godhee jiraadhe yoo harka koo keessa yakki jiraate,
english: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

kikuyu: yoo ani nama nagaadhaan na wajjin jiraatutti hamaa hojjedhee jiraadhe, yookaan yoo ani sababii malee diina koo saamee jiraadhe,
english: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

kikuyu: diinni koo ariʼee na haa qabatu; jireenya koo lafatti haa dhidhiitu; ulfina koos awwaara keessa haa buusu.
english: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo aarii keetiin kaʼi; dheekkamsa diinota kootti kaʼi. Yaa Waaqa koo anaaf dammaqi; murtii qajeelaa labsi.
english: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

kikuyu: Yaaʼiin namootaa naannoo keetti walitti haa qabamu; atis ol gubbaadhaa isaan bulchi.
english: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo sabootaaf murtii haa kennu. Yaa Waaqayyo, akka qajeelummaa kootiitti, akka amanamummaa kootiittis naa murteessi.
english: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa qajeelaa, kan yaadaa fi garaa namaa qortu, fincila hamootaa balleessi; qajeeltota immoo jabeessii dhaabi.
english: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

kikuyu: Gaachanni koo Waaqa; inni gara toleeyyii ni oolcha.
english: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Waaqni abbaa murtii qajeelaa dha; inni Waaqa guyyaa hunda dheekkamsa isaa mulʼisuu dha.
english: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

kikuyu: Yoo namni qalbii jijjiirrachuu baate, inni goraadee isaa ni qarata; iddaa isaas dabsee qopheeffata.
english: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

kikuyu: Inni meeshaa nama ajjeesu qopheeffateera; xiyya bobaʼus ni qopheeffata.
english: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

kikuyu: Kunoo, namni hamaan hammina ulfaaʼa; jalʼina garaatti baata; soba dhala.
english: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

kikuyu: Inni gad fageessee boolla qota; boolla qopheesse sana keessas ni buʼa.
english: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

kikuyu: Dabni isaa matuma isaatti deebiʼa; jalʼinni isaas gubbee mataa isaa irra buʼa.
english: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

kikuyu: Qajeelummaa isaatiif Waaqayyoon nan galateeffadha; maqaa Waaqayyoo Waaqa Waan Hundaa Oliis faarfannaadhaan nan jajadha.
english: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit kan Gitiitiidhaan faarfatamu. Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa keenya, maqaan kee lafa hundatti akkam ulfina qabeessa! Ati ulfina kee samiiwwan irratti diriirsiteerta.
english: For the Chief Musician; on an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by David. LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth! You have set your glory above the heavens!

kikuyu: Sababii diinota keetiitiif, amajaajii fi nama haaloo baafatu afaan qabachiisuuf jettee, afaan daaʼimmaniitii fi mucoolii harma hodhanii irraa galata qopheessiteerta.
english: From the lips of babes and infants you have established strength, because of your adversaries, that you might silence the enemy and the avenger.

kikuyu: Yommuu ani hojii quba keetii, samiiwwan kee, jiʼaa fi urjiiwwan ati hundeessitee ilaalutti,
english: When I consider your heavens, the work of your fingers, the moon and the stars, which you have ordained,

kikuyu: akka ati isaaf yaadduuf namni maali? Akka isaaf dhimmituuf ilmi namaa maali?
english: what is man, that you think of him? What is the son of man, that you care for him?

kikuyu: Ati xinnoo ishee ofii keetii gad isa goote; ulfinaa fi kabajaan isa gonfite.
english: For you have made him a little lower than the angels, and crowned him with glory and honor.

kikuyu: Hojii harka keetii irratti bulchaa isa goote; waan hundas miilla isaa jala galchite;
english: You make him ruler over the works of your hands. You have put all things under his feet:

kikuyu: bushaayee fi loon hunda, bineensota bosonaas,
english: All sheep and cattle, yes, and the animals of the field,

kikuyu: simbirroota samii irraa, qurxummii galaanaa, waan daandii galaanaatiin darbu hundas miilla isaa jala galchite.
english: the birds of the sky, the fish of the sea, and whatever passes through the paths of the seas.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa keenya, maqaan kee lafa hundumaa irratti akkam ulfina qabeessa!
english: LORD, our Lord, how majestic is your name in all the earth!

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif; Yeedaloo, “Duʼa ilmaa” jedhamu. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, ani garaa koo guutuudhaan sin galateeffadha; waaʼee dinqii kee hundumaas nan odeessa.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm by David. I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart. I will tell of all your marvelous works.

kikuyu: Ani sittin gammada; nan ililchas; yaa Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii, faarfannaadhaan maqaa kee nan jajadha.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.

kikuyu: Diinonni koo dugda duubatti ni deebiʼu; ni gufatu; fuula kee duraas ni badu.
english: When my enemies turn back, they stumble and perish in your presence.

kikuyu: Mirga koo fi dhimma koo qabatteerta; atis murtii qajeelaa kennaa teessoo kee irra teesseerta.
english: For you have maintained my just cause. You sit on the throne judging righteously.

kikuyu: Saboota ifattee hamootas balleessiteerta; maqaa isaaniis baraa hamma bara baraatti haqxeerta.
english: You have rebuked the nations. You have destroyed the wicked. You have blotted out their name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Diinonni badiisa bara baraatiin balleeffamu; ati magaalaawwan isaanii bubuqqifteerta; seenaan isaaniis barbadeeffameera.
english: The enemy is overtaken by endless ruin. The very memory of the cities which you have overthrown has perished.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu bara baraan ni moʼa; teessoo isaas murtiidhaaf dhaabbateera.
english: But the LORD reigns forever. He has prepared his throne for judgment.

kikuyu: Inni qajeelummaadhaan addunyaadhaaf murtii ni kenna; sabootas murtii qajeelaadhaan bulcha.
english: He will judge the world in righteousness. He will administer judgment to the peoples in uprightness.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo warra cunqurfamaniif irkoo dha; yeroo rakkinaattis daʼoo dha.
english: The LORD will also be a high tower for the oppressed; a high tower in times of trouble.

kikuyu: Warri maqaa kee beekan si amanatu; yaa Waaqayyo, ati warra si barbaadan gattee hin beektuutii.
english: Those who know your name will put their trust in you, for you, LORD, have not forsaken those who seek you.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo isa Xiyoon irra jiraatu faarfannaadhaan jajadhaa; hojii isaa illee saboota keessatti labsaa.
english: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion, and declare among the people what he has done.

kikuyu: Inni haaloo dhiigaa baasu sunis isaan yaadataatii; iyya warra dhiphataniis hin irraanfatu.
english: For he who avenges blood remembers them. He doesn’t forget the cry of the afflicted.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, hammam akka diinonni koo na ariʼatan ilaali! Naaf araaramiitii afaan boolla duʼaa keessaa na baasi;
english: Have mercy on me, LORD. See my affliction by those who hate me, and lift me up from the gates of death,

kikuyu: kunis ani karra Intala Xiyoon irratti akka galata kee labsuu fi fayyisuu keettis baayʼisee gammaduuf.
english: that I may show all of your praise. I will rejoice in your salvation in the gates of the daughter of Zion.

kikuyu: Saboonni boolla qotan keessa buʼan; miilli isaaniis kiyyoodhuma isaan dhoksaniin qabame.
english: The nations have sunk down in the pit that they made. In the net which they hid, their own foot is taken.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo murtii qajeelaa kennuudhaan beekama; hamoonni garuu hojii harka isaaniitiin kiyyoo seenu.
english: The LORD has made himself known. He has executed judgment. The wicked is snared by the work of his own hands. Meditation. Selah.

kikuyu: Namoonni hamoon, warri Waaqa irraanfatan hundinuus siiʼoolitti gad buʼu.
english: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.

kikuyu: Rakkattoonni garuu yoom iyyuu hin irraanfataman; abdiin hiyyeeyyiis bara baraan hin badu.
english: For the needy shall not always be forgotten, nor the hope of the poor perish forever.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo kaʼi; jabinni namaa hin mulʼatin; fuula kee duratti sabootatti haa muramu.
english: Arise, LORD! Don’t let man prevail. Let the nations be judged in your sight.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, sodaa isaanitti buusi; saboonnis akka namuma taʼan haa beekan.
english: Put them in fear, LORD. Let the nations know that they are only men. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati maaliif achi fagaattee dhaabatta? Yeroo rakkinaattis maaliif of dhoksita?
english: Why do you stand far off, LORD? Why do you hide yourself in times of trouble?

kikuyu: Namni hamaan of tuulummaa isaatiin hiyyeessa adamsa; inni maluma malatuun haa qabamu.
english: In arrogance, the wicked hunt down the weak. They are caught in the schemes that they devise.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan hawwii isaatiin of jaja; ofittoo ni eebbisa; Waaqayyoon immoo ni arrabsa.
english: For the wicked boasts of his heart’s cravings. He blesses the greedy and condemns the LORD.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan sababii of tuuluuf Waaqa hin barbaadu; yaada isaa hundumaa keessas Waaqni hin jiru.
english: The wicked, in the pride of his face, has no room in his thoughts for God.

kikuyu: Karaan isaa yeroo hunda ni milkaaʼaaf; inni of tuula; seerri kees isa irraa fagoo dha; diinota isaa hundattis tuffiidhaan qummaada.
english: His ways are prosperous at all times. He is arrogant, and your laws are far from his sight. As for all his adversaries, he sneers at them.

kikuyu: Innis, “Wanni na sochoosu hin jiru; rakkinnis gonkumaa na hin argatu” ofiin jedha.
english: He says in his heart, “I shall not be shaken. For generations I shall have no trouble.”

kikuyu: Afaan isaa abaarsaan, sobaa fi doorsisaan guutameera; dabaa fi hamminni arraba isaa jala jiru.
english: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and oppression. Under his tongue is mischief and iniquity.

kikuyu: Inni gandoota keessatti riphee eeggata; iddoo dhokataattis warra yakka hin qabne ajjeesa. Ija isaatiinis hiyyeeyyii gaada.
english: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.

kikuyu: Akka leenca daggala isaa keessaatti riphee eeggata. Hiyyeessa qabachuudhaaf dhokatee eeggata; hiyyeessas qabatee kiyyoo isaatiin harkifata.
english: He lurks in secret as a lion in his ambush. He lies in wait to catch the helpless. He catches the helpless when he draws him in his net.

kikuyu: Hiyyeessi sunis ni caccaba; gad of qabas; humna nama hamaa jalattis ni kufa.
english: The helpless are crushed. They collapse. They fall under his strength.

kikuyu: Innis, “Waaqa irraanfateera; fuula isaas dhokfateera; gonkumaa hin argu” ofiin jedha.
english: He says in his heart, “God has forgotten. He hides his face. He will never see it.”

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo kaʼi! Yaa Waaqi harka kee ol kaafadhu. Rakkataas hin dagatin.
english: Arise, LORD! God, lift up your hand! Don’t forget the helpless.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan maaliif Waaqa arrabsa? Maaliifis garaa isaatti, “Inni waan kanatti na hin gaafatu” jedha?
english: Why does the wicked person condemn God, and say in his heart, “God won’t call me into account”?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, ati garuu rakkinaa fi gadda warra miidhamanii ni argita; harka keetiinis gatii baasifta. Deegaan dabarsee sitti of kenna; ati ijoollee abbaa hin qabneef gargaaraa dha.
english: But you do see trouble and grief. You consider it to take it into your hand. You help the victim and the fatherless.

kikuyu: Irree nama hamaatii fi jalʼaa cabsi; hamma hamminni isaa dhumee dhabamutti, hammina isaatti isa gaafadhu.
english: Break the arm of the wicked. As for the evil man, seek out his wickedness until you find none.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo bara baraa hamma bara baraatti Mootii dha; ormoonni lafa isaa irraa ni barbadaaʼu.
english: The LORD is King forever and ever! The nations will perish out of his land.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati hawwii rakkattootaa ni dhageessa; isaan jajjabeessita; iyya isaanii illee ni dhaggeeffatta;
english: LORD, you have heard the desire of the humble. You will prepare their heart. You will cause your ear to hear,

kikuyu: kunis akka namni biyyoo irraa uumame siʼachi isaan hin cunqursineef ati ijoollee abbaa hin qabnee fi cunqurfamtootaaf akka dhaabattuuf.
english: to judge the fatherless and the oppressed, that man who is of the earth may terrify no more.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Ani Waaqayyotti kooluu galeera. Yoos isin akkamitti lubbuu kootiin akkana jechuu dandeessu: “Ati akkuma simbirroo tulluu keetti barrisi.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. In the LORD, I take refuge. How can you say to my soul, “Flee as a bird to your mountain”?

kikuyu: Kunoo namoonni hamoon iddaa isaanii dabsataniiru; isaan warra toloota taʼan, dukkana keessa waraanuuf jedhanii, xiyya isaanii ribuutti dhaabbataniiru.
english: For, behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrows on the strings, that they may shoot in darkness at the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Yoo hundeewwan diigaman, namni qajeelaan maal gochuu dandaʼa?”
english: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?

kikuyu: Waaqayyo mana qulqullummaa isaa qulqulluu sana keessa jira; teessoon Waaqayyoo samii irra jira. Inni ilmaan namootaa ni ilaala; iji isaas namoota ni qora.
english: The LORD is in his holy temple. The LORD is on his throne in heaven. His eyes observe. His eyes examine the children of men.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo qajeeltotaa fi jalʼoota ni qora; lubbuun isaa garuu nama goolii jaallatu ni jibbiti.
english: The LORD examines the righteous, but his soul hates the wicked and him who loves violence.

kikuyu: Inni hamoota irratti, barbadaa ibiddaatii fi dinyii bobaʼu ni roobsa; qoodni isaaniis bubbee finiinaa dha.
english: On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo waan qajeelaa taʼeef, murtii qajeelaa jaallata; toloonnis fuula isaa ni argu.
english: For the LORD is righteous. He loves righteousness. The upright shall see his face.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit kan akka sirna Shamiiniitiitti faarfatamu. Yaa Waaqayyo, namni Waaqa sodaatu hin jiruutii ati na gargaar; ilmaan namaa keessaas namni amanamu dhabameeraatii.
english: For the Chief Musician; upon an eight-stringed lyre. A Psalm of David. Help, LORD; for the godly man ceases. For the faithful fail from among the children of men.

kikuyu: Namni hundinuu ollaa isaatti soba dubbata; isaan nama saadanii garaa lamaan dubbatu.
english: Everyone lies to his neighbor. They speak with flattering lips, and with a double heart.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo afaan nama saadu hunda, arraba of tuulu hundas haa kukkutu;
english: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that boasts,

kikuyu: isaanis, “Nu arraba keenyaan ni moona; hidhiin keenyas keenyuma; eenyutu nurratti gooftummaa qaba?” jedhu.
english: who have said, “With our tongue we will prevail. Our lips are our own. Who is lord over us?”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo, “Ani sababii hacuucamuu hiyyeeyyiitiif, sababii aaduu rakkattootaatiifis amma nan kaʼa. Nagaa isaan hawwan keessas isaan nan jiraachisa” jedha.
english: “Because of the oppression of the weak and because of the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD; “I will set him in safety from those who malign him.”

kikuyu: Dubbiin Waaqayyoo hirʼina hin qabu; innis akka meetii boolla ibiddaa keessatti baqfamee yeroo torba qulqulleeffamee ti.
english: The LORD’s words are flawless words, as silver refined in a clay furnace, purified seven times.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo ati nu eegda; dhaloota akkanaa irraas bara baraan nu oolchita.
english: You will keep them, LORD. You will preserve them from this generation forever.

kikuyu: Yeroo wanni faayidaa hin qabne ilmaan namaa gidduutti kabajamutti hamoonni of dhiibuudhaan kallattii hundaan asii fi achi naannaʼu.
english: The wicked walk on every side, when what is vile is exalted among the sons of men.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, hamma yoomiitti? Ati hamma bara baraatti na irraanfattaa? Hamma yoomiittis fuula kee na duraa dhoksita?
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. How long, LORD? Will you forget me forever? How long will you hide your face from me?

kikuyu: Ani hamma yoomiittin rakkina obsee guyyaa guutuu garaa koo keessatti gadda? Hamma yoomiitti diinni koo narra aana?
english: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart every day? How long shall my enemy triumph over me?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa ko, na ilaali; deebii illee naa kenni. Akka ani hirriba duʼaa hin rafneefis ija kootiif ifa kenni;
english: Behold, and answer me, LORD, my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death;

kikuyu: diinni koo, “Ani isa moʼadheera” jedha; amajaajiiwwan koos kufaatii kootti gammadu.
english: lest my enemy say, “I have prevailed against him;” lest my adversaries rejoice when I fall.

kikuyu: Ani garuu araara kee nan amanadha; garaan koos fayyisuu keetti ni gammada.
english: But I trust in your loving kindness. My heart rejoices in your salvation.

kikuyu: Ani Waaqayyoof nan faarfadha; arjummaan isaa naa baayʼateeraatii.
english: I will sing to the LORD, because he has been good to me.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Gowwaan garaa isaatti, “Waaqni hin jiru” jedha. Isaan xuraaʼaniiru; hojiin isaaniis jibbisiisaa dha; namni waan gaarii hojjetu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt. They have done abominable deeds. There is no one who does good.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo yoo namni waa hubatu, kan Waaqas barbaadu, tokko iyyuu jiraate arguuf jedhee, samii irraa ilmaan namootaa gad ilaala.
english: The LORD looked down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there were any who understood, who sought after God.

kikuyu: Hundinuu dogoggoraniiru; hundi isaaniis xuraaʼaniiru; namni waan gaarii hojjetu tokko hin jiru; tokkumti iyyuu hin jiru.
english: They have all gone aside. They have together become corrupt. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

kikuyu: Warri hammina hojjetan kanneen akkuma waan buddeena nyaataniitti saba koo nyaatan, warri Waaqayyoon hin waammanne hundinuu homaa hin beekanii?
english: Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on the LORD?

kikuyu: Isaan sodaadhaan liqimfamaniiru; Waaqni dhaloota qajeeltotaa wajjin jiraatii.
english: There they were in great fear, for God is in the generation of the righteous.

kikuyu: Isin jalʼoonni karoora hiyyeeyyii jalaa fashaleessitu; Waaqayyo garuu daʼoo isaanii ti.
english: You frustrate the plan of the poor, because the LORD is his refuge.

kikuyu: Maaloo utuu Xiyoon keessaa fayyinni Israaʼeliif dhufee! Yommuu Waaqayyo saba isaa warra boojiʼaman deebisutti, Yaaqoob haa ililchu; Israaʼelis haa gammadu!
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When the LORD restores the fortunes of his people, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, eenyutu dunkaana kee keessa jiraata? Eenyutu tulluu kee qulqulluu sana irra jiraachuu dandaʼa?
english: A Psalm by David. LORD, who shall dwell in your sanctuary? Who shall live on your holy hill?

kikuyu: Nama adeemsi isaa mudaa hin qabnee fi nama waan qajeelaa hojjetu, nama garaa isaatii dhugaa dubbatuu fi
english: He who walks blamelessly and does what is right, and speaks truth in his heart;

kikuyu: kan arraba isaatiin nama hin hamanne, nama ollaa isaatti waan hamaa hin hojjennee fi nama ollaa isaa maqaa hin balleessine,
english: he who doesn’t slander with his tongue, nor does evil to his friend, nor casts slurs against his fellow man;

kikuyu: kan nama hamaa tuffatee warra Waaqayyoon sodaatan garuu kabaju, yoo waan isa miidhu taʼe illee nama kakuu isaa eegu,
english: in whose eyes a vile man is despised, but who honors those who fear the LORD; he who keeps an oath even when it hurts, and doesn’t change;

kikuyu: nama maallaqa isaa hiiqiidhaan hin liqeessinee fi kan nama yakka hin qabne miidhuuf jedhee mattaʼaa hin fudhannee dha. Namni wantoota kanneen hojjetu, gonkumaa hin raafamu.
english: he who doesn’t lend out his money for usury, nor take a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things shall never be shaken.

kikuyu: Miiktaamii Daawit. Yaa Waaqi, ani kooluu sitti galeeraatii, ati na eegi.
english: A Poem by David. Preserve me, God, for I take refuge in you.

kikuyu: Anis Waaqayyoon, “Ati Gooftaa koo ti; ani si malee gaarummaa hin qabu” nan jedha.
english: My soul, you have said to the LORD, “You are my Lord. Apart from you I have no good thing.”

kikuyu: Qulqulloonni lafa irraa garuu ulfina qabeeyyii dha; anis isaanitti baayʼee nan gammada.
english: As for the saints who are on the earth, they are the excellent ones in whom is all my delight.

kikuyu: Warra waaqota tolfamoo duukaa buʼan, gaddi isaanii ni guddata. Dhibaayyuu dhiigaa ani isaaniif hin dhibaafadhu; yookaan afaan kootiin maqaa isaanii hin dhaʼu.
english: Their sorrows shall be multiplied who give gifts to another god. Their drink offerings of blood I will not offer, nor take their names on my lips.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo qooda dhaala kootii fi qooda xoofoo koo ti; ixaa koos situ naa jiraachisa.
english: The LORD assigned my portion and my cup. You made my lot secure.

kikuyu: Funyoon daangaa iddoo gaarii naa buʼeera; dhugumaan ani dhaala nama gammachiisu qaba.
english: The lines have fallen to me in pleasant places. Yes, I have a good inheritance.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo isa na gorsu sana ani nan jajadha; halkanis yaadni koo na qajeelcha.
english: I will bless the LORD, who has given me counsel. Yes, my heart instructs me in the night seasons.

kikuyu: Ani yeroo hunda fuula koo duraa Waaqayyoon qaba. Waan inni mirga koo jiruuf ani hin raafamu.
english: I have set the LORD always before me. Because he is at my right hand, I shall not be moved.

kikuyu: Kanaaf garaan koo ni gammada; arrabni koos ni ililcha; foon koos nagaadhaan jiraata;
english: Therefore my heart is glad, and my tongue rejoices. My body shall also dwell in safety.

kikuyu: ati siiʼool keessatti na hin dhiiftuutii, yookaan amanamaan kee akka tortoru hin gootu.
english: For you will not leave my soul in Sheol, neither will you allow your holy one to see corruption.

kikuyu: Ati karaa jireenyaa na barsiifta; fuula kee durattis gammachuudhaan na guutta; gara mirga keetii gammachuu bara baraatu jira.
english: You will show me the path of life. In your presence is fullness of joy. In your right hand there are pleasures forever more.

kikuyu: Kadhannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, iyyata ani murtii qajeelaaf iyyadhu dhagaʼi; booʼicha koos dhaggeeffadhu. Kadhannaa koo kan afaan nama hin gowwoomsine keessaa baʼuufis gurra kenni.
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, my righteous plea. Give ear to my prayer that doesn’t go out of deceitful lips.

kikuyu: Murtiin koo si biraa haa dhufu; iji kees waan qajeelaa haa argu.
english: Let my sentence come out of your presence. Let your eyes look on equity.

kikuyu: Ati yoo garaa koo qorte, halkaniinis yoo na ilaalte, yoo na sakattaates, homaa narratti hin argattu; ani akka afaan koo cubbuu hin hojjenneef kutadheeraatii.
english: You have proved my heart. You have visited me in the night. You have tried me, and found nothing. I have resolved that my mouth shall not disobey.

kikuyu: Waaʼee hojii namootaa immoo ani dubbii afaan keetiitiin karaa gooltotaa irraa of eeggadheera.
english: As for the deeds of men, by the word of your lips, I have kept myself from the ways of the violent.

kikuyu: Tarkaanfiin koo karaa kee irratti cimeera; miilli koos hin mucucaanne.
english: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, waan ati deebii naa kennituuf ani sin waammadha; gurra kee gara kootti qabiitii kadhannaa koo dhagaʼi.
english: I have called on you, for you will answer me, God. Turn your ear to me. Hear my speech.

kikuyu: Yaa isa warra diinota isaanii jalaa sitti baqatan harka kee mirgaatiin oolchitu, ati jaalala kee isa hin geeddaramne sana haala dinqisiisaadhaan argisiisi.
english: Show your marvelous loving kindness, you who save those who take refuge by your right hand from their enemies.

kikuyu: Akka agartuu ija keetiitti na eegi; gaaddidduu qoochoo keetiitiinis na dhoksi;
english: Keep me as the apple of your eye. Hide me under the shadow of your wings,

kikuyu: hamoota na dhiphisan jalaa, diinota na ajjeesuuf na marsan jalaa na baasi.
english: from the wicked who oppress me, my deadly enemies, who surround me.

kikuyu: Isaan garaa isaanii kan namaa hin naane sana ni guduunfu; afaan isaaniis of tuulummaadhaan dubbata.
english: They close up their callous hearts. With their mouth they speak proudly.

kikuyu: Isaan faana na dhaʼu; ammas na marsaniiru; lafaan na dhaʼuudhaafis ija babaasu.
english: They have now surrounded us in our steps. They set their eyes to cast us down to the earth.

kikuyu: Isaan akka leenca waa kukkutachuu kajeeluu ti; akka leenca guddaa riphee waa gaaduu ti.
english: He is like a lion that is greedy of his prey, as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo kaʼi; itti baʼiitii isaan kuffisi; goraadee keetiinis hamoota jalaa na baasi.
english: Arise, LORD, confront him. Cast him down. Deliver my soul from the wicked by your sword,

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, namoota akkanaa jalaa, namoota addunyaa kanaa warra qoodni isaanii jireenyuma ammaa taʼe jalaa harka keetiin na baraari. Garaan isaanii waan ati isaaniif kuufte haa quufu; ijoolleen isaaniis akka malee haa quufan; isaanis waan isaan irraa hafe daaʼimman isaaniitiif haa kaaʼan.
english: from men by your hand, LORD, from men of the world, whose portion is in this life. You fill the belly of your cherished ones. Your sons have plenty, and they store up wealth for their children.

kikuyu: Ani garuu qajeelummaadhaan fuula kee nan arga; yommuun dammaquttis ani ulfina kee arguudhaan nan quufa.
english: As for me, I shall see your face in righteousness. I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with seeing your form.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit garbicha Waaqayyoo; innis yommuu Waaqayyo harka diinota isaa hundaa fi harka Saaʼol jalaa isa baasetti dubbii faarfannaa kana Waaqayyoof faarfate. Innis akkana jedhe: Yaa Waaqayyo jabina ko, ani sin jaalladha.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of the LORD, who spoke to the LORD the words of this song in the day that the LORD delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, LORD, my strength.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo kattaa koo, daʼannoo kootii fi oolchaa koo ti; Waaqni koo kattaa koo kan ani kooluu itti galuu dha; inni gaachana kootii fi gaanfa fayyina koo ti; daʼannoo koo cimaa dha.
english: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

kikuyu: Ani Waaqayyo galanni isaaf malu sana nan waammadha; diinota koo jalaas nan baraarama.
english: I call on the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

kikuyu: Funyoon duʼaa na xaxe; lolaan badiisaas na liqimseera.
english: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

kikuyu: Funyoon siiʼool natti marame; kiyyoon duʼaas natti dhufe.
english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

kikuyu: Ani dhiphina koo keessatti Waaqayyoon nan waammadhe; gargaarsaafis Waaqa kootti nan iyyadhe. Innis mana qulqullummaa isaatii sagalee koo dhagaʼe; iyyi koos gurra isaa seene.
english: In my distress I called on the LORD, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

kikuyu: Lafti ni hollatte; ni sochootes; hundeewwan tulluuwwaniis ni raafaman; sababii inni dheekkameefis isaan ni hollatan.
english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

kikuyu: Aarri funyaan isaatii ol baʼe; ibiddi waa barbadeessu afaan isaatii baʼe; cileen bobaʼus afaan isaatii baʼe.
english: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

kikuyu: Inni samiiwwan tarsaasee gad buʼe; duumessoonni gurraachis miilla isaa jala turan.
english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

kikuyu: Inni kiirubeelin yaabbatee barrise; qoochoo qilleensaatiinis ol baʼe.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

kikuyu: Inni dukkana haguuggii isaa, duumessa samii kan bokkaadhaan dukkanaaʼe immoo godoo isaa godhate.
english: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

kikuyu: Ifa fuula isaa keessaas duumessi dhagaa cabbiitii fi bakakkaadhaan tarsaasee baʼe.
english: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo samiidhaa ni qaqawweessaʼe; sagaleen Waaqa Waan Hundaa Oliis ni dhagaʼame.
english: The LORD also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

kikuyu: Inni xiyya isaa darbatee diinota bittinneesse; bakakkaas gad dhiisee isaan fixe.
english: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, dheekkamsa keetiin, humna hafuura funyaan keetii baʼuutiinis, sululawwan galaanaa ifatti baafaman; hundeewwan lafaas qullaa hafan.
english: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, LORD, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

kikuyu: Inni ol gubbaadhaa gad hiixatee na qabe; bishaanota gad fagoo keessaas na baase.
english: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

kikuyu: Inni diina koo isa jabaa jalaa, amajaajota koo warra akka malee natti ciman jalaas na baase.
english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

kikuyu: Isaan guyyaa rakkina kootti natti dhufan; Waaqayyo garuu gargaarsa koo ture.
english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but the LORD was my support.

kikuyu: Inni iddoo balʼaatti na baase; waan natti gammadeefis na oolche.
english: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akkuma qajeelummaa kootiitti naa kenneera; akkuma qulqullina harka koottis na badhaase.
english: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

kikuyu: Ani karaa Waaqayyoo eegeeraatii; Waaqa koo irraa garagalee hammina hin hojjenne.
english: For I have kept the ways of the LORD, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

kikuyu: Seerri isaa hundinuu fuula koo dura jira; anis labsii isaa irraa hin gorre.
english: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

kikuyu: Ani fuula isaa duratti mudaa hin qabu ture; cubbuu irraas of eeggadheera.
english: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akkuma qajeelumma kootti, akkuma harki koo fuula isaa duratti qulqulluu taʼettis na badhaaseera.
english: Therefore the LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

kikuyu: Ati nama amanamaatti amanamummaa kee argisiifta; nama mudaa hin qabnettis kan mudaa hin qabne taata.
english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

kikuyu: Nama qulqulluutti qulqulluu taata; nama jalʼaatti immoo jalʼaa taata.
english: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

kikuyu: Ati warra gad of qaban ni oolchita; ija of tuulu garuu gad deebifta.
english: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo ati ibsaa koo jabeessitee ni ibsita; Waaqni koo dukkana koo ifatti ni geeddara.
english: For you will light my lamp, LORD. My God will light up my darkness.

kikuyu: Ani gargaarsa keetiin loltoota dhiibbadhee nan deema; Waaqa kootiinis dallaa utaaluu nan dandaʼa.
english: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

kikuyu: Waaqa kana karaan isaa mudaa hin qabu; dubbiin Waaqayyoo hirʼina hin qabu; warra isatti kooluu galan hundaaf Waaqayyo gaachana taʼa.
english: As for God, his way is perfect. The LORD’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo malee Waaqni eenyu? Waaqa keenya malees kattaan eenyu?
english: For who is God, except the LORD? Who is a rock, besides our God,

kikuyu: Kan humna na hidhachiisu, kan akka karaan koos nagaa taʼu godhu Waaqa.
english: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

kikuyu: Inni miilla koo akka miilla borofaa godha; iddoo ol dheeraa irras na dhaabachiisa.
english: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

kikuyu: Inni harka koo waraanaaf leenjisa; irreen koos iddaa naasii dabsuu ni dandaʼa.
english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

kikuyu: Ati gargaarsa kee kan nama fayyisu gaachana naaf goota; harki kee mirgaa ol na qabeera; gargaarsi kees nama guddaa na godhe.
english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

kikuyu: Akka koomeen koo hin mucucaanneef, miilla kootiif daandii balʼifteerta.
english: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

kikuyu: Ani diinota koo ariʼee nan qaqqabadhe; hamma isaan barbadaaʼanittis ani duubatti hin deebine.
english: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

kikuyu: Ani akka isaan deebiʼanii kaʼuu hin dandeenyeef isaan nan barbadeesse; isaanis miilla koo jalatti ni kufan.
english: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

kikuyu: Ati lolaaf humna na hidhachiifte; amajaajota koos fuula koo duratti gad deebifte.
english: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

kikuyu: Akka diinonni koo dugda duubatti deebiʼanii baqatan gooteerta; anis amajaajota koo barbadeesseera.
english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

kikuyu: Isaan gargaarsaaf iyyan; garuu kan isaan oolchu tokko iyyuu hin turre; gara Waaqayyoottis ni iyyatan; inni garuu deebii hin kennineef.
english: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to the LORD, but he didn’t answer them.

kikuyu: Anis akkuma awwaara bubbeen fudhatuutti isaan nan daake; akkuma dhoqqee daandii irraatti isaan nan dhidhiite.
english: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

kikuyu: Ati lola namootaa jalaa na baafteerta; mataa sabootaa na gooteerta; sabni ani hin beekne na tajaajila.
english: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

kikuyu: Namoonni ormaa na sossobatan; isaan akkuma waaʼee koo dhagaʼaniin naaf ajajaman.
english: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

kikuyu: Isaan hundi abdii kutatan; hollachaas daʼannoo isaanii jabaa keessaa baʼan.
english: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo jiraataa dha! Kattaan koo haa eebbifamu! Waaqni Fayyisaan koo ol ol haa jedhu!
english: The LORD lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

kikuyu: Inni Waaqa haaloo naa baasu, kan sabootas na jalatti bulchuu dha;
english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

kikuyu: diinota koo jalaas na baasa. Ati amajaajota kootii ol na goota; gooltota jalaas na baafte.
english: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa Waaqayyo, ani saboota gidduutti sin leellisa; faarfannaa galataa illee maqaa keetiif nan faarfadha.
english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

kikuyu: Inni moʼannaawwan gurguddaa mootii isaatiif ni kenna; dibamaa isaa Daawitii fi sanyii isaatiif, jaalala bara baraa ni argisiisa.
english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Samiiwwan ulfina Waaqaa odeessu; bantiin samiis hojii harka isaa labsa.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The heavens declare the glory of God. The expanse shows his handiwork.

kikuyu: Guyyaan tokko guyyaa kaanitti odeessa, halkan tokkos halkan kaanitti beekumsa mulʼisa.
english: Day after day they pour out speech, and night after night they display knowledge.

kikuyu: Haasaan yookaan dubbiin hin jiru; sagaleen isaaniis hin dhagaʼamu.
english: There is no speech nor language where their voice is not heard.

kikuyu: Taʼus sagaleen isaanii lafa hundumaa, dubbiin isaaniis handaara addunyaa gaʼe. Inni samiiwwan keessatti biiftuudhaaf dunkaana dhaabe;
english: Their voice has gone out through all the earth, their words to the end of the world. In them he has set a tent for the sun,

kikuyu: biiftuunis akkuma misirricha dinqa isaatii baʼuutii fi akkuma moʼataa fiigicha dorgomutti gammadu tokkoo ti.
english: which is as a bridegroom coming out of his room, like a strong man rejoicing to run his course.

kikuyu: Isheenis handaara samiiwwanii tokkoo baatee gara handaara kaaniitti naannofti; wanni hoʼa ishee jalaa dhokatu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: His going out is from the end of the heavens, his circuit to its ends. There is nothing hidden from its heat.

kikuyu: Seerri Waaqayyoo mudaa hin qabu; lubbuu namatti deebisa. Ajajni Waaqayyoo amanamaa dha; nama wallaalaa beekaa godha.
english: The LORD’s law is perfect, restoring the soul. The LORD’s covenant is sure, making wise the simple.

kikuyu: Seerri Waaqayyoo qajeelaa dha; garaadhaaf gammachuu kenna. Ajajni Waaqayyoo qulqulluu dha; ijaafis ifa kenna.
english: The LORD’s precepts are right, rejoicing the heart. The LORD’s commandment is pure, enlightening the eyes.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon sodaachuun qulqulluu dha; bara baraan jiraata. Murtiin Waaqayyoo dhugaa dha; walumaa galattis qajeelaa dha.
english: The fear of the LORD is clean, enduring forever. The LORD’s ordinances are true, and righteous altogether.

kikuyu: Inni warqee caalaa, warqee akka malee qulqulleeffame caalaa iyyuu gatii qabeessa; inni damma caalaa, nadhii dammaa caalaa miʼaawaa dha.
english: They are more to be desired than gold, yes, than much fine gold, sweeter also than honey and the extract of the honeycomb.

kikuyu: Murtii kanaanis tajaajilaan kee ni gorfama; isa eeguunis gatii guddaa qaba.
english: Moreover your servant is warned by them. In keeping them there is great reward.

kikuyu: Eenyutu dogoggora isaa hubachuu dandaʼa? Yakka koo isa dhokfamaa irraa na qulqulleessi.
english: Who can discern his errors? Forgive me from hidden errors.

kikuyu: Tajaajilaa kee cubbuu ija jabinaan hojjetamu irraa eegi; cubbuun kunis na hin moʼatin. Yoos ani hirʼina malee nan jiraadha; dogoggora guddaa irraas qulqulluu nan taʼa.
english: Keep back your servant also from presumptuous sins. Let them not have dominion over me. Then I will be upright. I will be blameless and innocent of great transgression.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, Kattaa koo fi Furii ko, dubbiin afaan kootii fi yaadni garaa koo fuula kee duratti fudhatamaa haa taʼu.
english: Let the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be acceptable in your sight, LORD, my rock, and my redeemer.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Guyyaa rakkinaatti Waaqayyo deebii siif haa kennu; maqaan Waaqa Yaaqoobis si haa eegu.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble. May the name of the God of Jacob set you up on high,

kikuyu: Inni iddoo qulqulluudhaa gargaarsa siif haa ergu; Xiyoon irraas jabina siif haa kennu.
english: send you help from the sanctuary, grant you support from Zion,

kikuyu: Aarsaa kee hunda siif haa yaadatu; qalma kee kan gubamus siif haa fudhatu.
english: remember all your offerings, and accept your burned sacrifice. Selah.

kikuyu: Hawwii garaa keetii siif haa kennu; karoora kee hundas fiixaan siif haa baasu.
english: May he grant you your heart’s desire, and fulfill all your counsel.

kikuyu: Yommuu ati moʼattutti ililchinee maqaa Waaqa keenyaatiin faajjii keenya ol fudhanna. Waaqayyo waan ati kadhattu hundumaa siif haa kennu.
english: We will triumph in your salvation. In the name of our God, we will set up our banners. May the LORD grant all your requests.

kikuyu: Ani akka Waaqayyo dibamaa isaa fayyisu amma beeka; Waaqayyo humna nama fayyisu kan harka isaa mirgaa keessa jiru sanaan samii isaa qulqulluu keessaa deebii ni kennaaf.
english: Now I know that the LORD saves his anointed. He will answer him from his holy heaven, with the saving strength of his right hand.

kikuyu: Namoonni tokko tokko gaariiwwan amanatu; kaan immoo fardeen amanatu; nu garuu maqaa Waaqayyo Waaqa keenyaa amananna.
english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.

kikuyu: Isaan gufatanii kufu; nu garuu ol kaana; jabaannees ni dhaabanna.
english: They are bowed down and fallen, but we rise up, and stand upright.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati mootiidhaaf moʼannaa kenni! Yommuu nu si waammannuttis deebii nuu kenni!
english: Save, LORD! Let the King answer us when we call!

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, mootiin jabina keetti baayʼee gammada. Gargaarsa keettis gammachuun isaa hammam guddaa dha!
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. The king rejoices in your strength, LORD! How greatly he rejoices in your salvation!

kikuyu: Ati hawwii garaa isaa kenniteefii jirta; kadhannaa afaan isaas isa hin dhowwanne.
english: You have given him his heart’s desire, and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah.

kikuyu: Ati eebba guddaadhaan isa simatte; gonfoo warqee qulqulluus mataa isaa irra keesse.
english: For you meet him with the blessings of goodness. You set a crown of fine gold on his head.

kikuyu: Inni jireenya si kadhate; atis ni kenniteef; bara dheeraas bara baraa hamma bara baraatti kenniteef.
english: He asked life of you and you gave it to him, even length of days forever and ever.

kikuyu: Ulfinni isaa moʼannaa ati isaaf kenniteen guddaa taʼe; atis ulfinaa fi surraa isatti uwwifte.
english: His glory is great in your salvation. You lay honor and majesty on him.

kikuyu: Ati eebba bara baraa kenniteef; akka inni gammachuu argama keetiitiin gammadus goote.
english: For you make him most blessed forever. You make him glad with joy in your presence.

kikuyu: Mootichi Waaqayyoon amanataatii; sababii jaalala Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii kan hin geeddaramne sanaatiifis inni hin raafamu.
english: For the king trusts in the LORD. Through the loving kindness of the Most High, he shall not be moved.

kikuyu: Harki kee diinota kee hunda ni qabata; harki kee mirgaas warra si jibban ni qaba.
english: Your hand will find out all of your enemies. Your right hand will find out those who hate you.

kikuyu: Yeroo mulʼachuu keetiitti, akka boolla ibiddi keessaa bobaʼuu isaan goota. Waaqayyo dheekkamsa isaatiin isaan liqimsa; ibiddis isaan fixa.
english: You will make them as a fiery furnace in the time of your anger. The LORD will swallow them up in his wrath. The fire shall devour them.

kikuyu: Ati sanyii isaanii lafa irraa, ijoollee isaaniis ilmaan namaa gidduudhaa ni balleessita.
english: You will destroy their descendants from the earth, their posterity from among the children of men.

kikuyu: Isaan yoo waan hamaa sitti yaadan, yoo daba sitti mariʼatanis hin milkaaʼan.
english: For they intended evil against you. They plotted evil against you which cannot succeed.

kikuyu: Ati yommuu iddaa kee isaanitti qabdutti, akka isaan baqatan gootaatii.
english: For you will make them turn their back, when you aim drawn bows at their face.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, jabina keetiin ol ol jedhi; nu humna kee ni jajanna; ni faarfannas.
english: Be exalted, LORD, in your strength, so we will sing and praise your power.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo “Borofa Ganamaa” jedhu. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqa ko, yaa Waaqa ko, ati maaliif na dhiifte? Ati na gargaaruu irraa, iyya koo irraas maaliif akkas fagaatta?
english: For the Chief Musician; set to “The Doe of the Morning.” A Psalm by David. My God, my God, why have you forsaken me? Why are you so far from helping me, and from the words of my groaning?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa ko, ani guyyaa guyyaa sittin iyyadha; ati garuu deebii naaf hin deebiftu; halkan halkanis afaan hin qabadhu.
english: My God, I cry in the daytime, but you don’t answer; in the night season, and am not silent.

kikuyu: Ati garuu Qulqullicha teessoo irra taaʼuu dha; ati galata Israaʼel.
english: But you are holy, you who inhabit the praises of Israel.

kikuyu: Abbootiin keenya si amanatan; isaan si amanatan; atis isaan oolchite.
english: Our fathers trusted in you. They trusted, and you delivered them.

kikuyu: Isaan sitti iyyatan; ni fayyifamanis; si amanatan; hin qaanofnes.
english: They cried to you, and were delivered. They trusted in you, and were not disappointed.

kikuyu: Ani garuu raammoodha malee nama miti; ani nama namni itti qoosuu fi sabnis tuffatuu dha.
english: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.

kikuyu: Warri na argan hundinuu natti kolfu; mataa isaanii raasanii na arrabsu.
english: All those who see me mock me. They insult me with their lips. They shake their heads, saying,

kikuyu: Akkanas jedhu; “Inni Waaqayyoon amanata; mee Waaqayyo isa haa oolchu kaa. Inni waan isatti gammaduuf, isa haa oolchu.”
english: “He trusts in the LORD. Let him deliver him. Let him rescue him, since he delights in him.”

kikuyu: Ati garuu gadameessa keessaa na baafte; harma haadha koo irrattis, situ nagaan na eege.
english: But you brought me out of the womb. You made me trust while at my mother’s breasts.

kikuyu: Ani gaafan dhaladhee jalqabee sirratti nan gatame; erga haati koo na deessee jalqabdee ati Waaqa koo ti.
english: I was thrown on you from my mother’s womb. You are my God since my mother bore me.

kikuyu: Ati narraa hin fagaatin; rakkinni dhiʼaateeraatii; namni na gargaarus hin jiru.
english: Don’t be far from me, for trouble is near. For there is no one to help.

kikuyu: Korommiin baayʼeen na marsu; korommiin Baashaan jajjaboonis karaa hundumaan na marsu.
english: Many bulls have surrounded me. Strong bulls of Bashan have encircled me.

kikuyu: Isaanis akka leenca beelaʼee aaduu afaan isaanii balʼisanii natti banatu.
english: They open their mouths wide against me, lions tearing prey and roaring.

kikuyu: Ani akkuma bishaaniitti nan dhangalaafame; lafeen koo hundinuus wal gad dhiise. Onneen koo gara gagaatti geeddarame; na keessattis baqe.
english: I am poured out like water. All my bones are out of joint. My heart is like wax. It is melted within me.

kikuyu: Jabinni koo akka qiraacii goge; arrabni koo laagaatti na maxxane; awwaara duʼaa keessas na ciibsite.
english: My strength is dried up like a potsherd. My tongue sticks to the roof of my mouth. You have brought me into the dust of death.

kikuyu: Saroonni na marsaniiru; gareen namoota hamoo na marseera; isaanis harkaa fi miilla koo waraananii fullaasaniiru.
english: For dogs have surrounded me. A company of evildoers have enclosed me. They have pierced my hands and feet.

kikuyu: Ani lafee koo hunda lakkaaʼuu nan dandaʼa; isaanis ija babaasanii na ilaalu; akkas taʼuu koottis ni gammadu.
english: I can count all of my bones. They look and stare at me.

kikuyu: Isaan wayyaa koo hiratan; uffata koottis ixaa buufatan.
english: They divide my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati garuu narraa hin fagaatin; yaa Jabina koo na gargaaruuf ariifadhu.
english: But don’t be far off, LORD. You are my help. Hurry to help me!

kikuyu: Lubbuu koo goraadee jalaa, jireenya koo immoo humna sarootaa jalaa baasi.
english: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of the dog.

kikuyu: Afaan leencaa jalaa na miliqsi; gaanfa gafarsaa jalaas na baasi.
english: Save me from the lion’s mouth! Yes, you have rescued me from the horns of the wild oxen.

kikuyu: Maqaa kee obboloota kootti nan labsa; waldaa keessattis sin jajadha.
english: I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

kikuyu: Isin warri Waaqayyoon sodaattan isa jajadhaa! Isin sanyiin Yaaqoob hundinuu isa ulfeessaa! Sanyiin Israaʼel hundinuus isa sodaadhaa!
english: You who fear the LORD, praise him! All you descendants of Jacob, glorify him! Stand in awe of him, all you descendants of Israel!

kikuyu: Inni dhiphina nama dhiphatee hin tuffanne yookaan hin balfineetii; yommuu inni gargaarsaaf isatti iyyatettis, ni dhagaʼeef malee fuula isaa hin dhokfanne.
english: For he has not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted, neither has he hidden his face from him; but when he cried to him, he heard.

kikuyu: Galanni ani yaaʼii guddaa irratti siif galchu si biraa dhufa; warra si sodaatan durattis wareega koo of irraa nan baasa.
english: My praise of you comes in the great assembly. I will pay my vows before those who fear him.

kikuyu: Hiyyeeyyiin nyaatanii quufu; warri Waaqayyoon barbaaddatanis isa ni jajatu; garaan keessan bara baraan haa jiraatu!
english: The humble shall eat and be satisfied. They shall praise the LORD who seek after him. Let your hearts live forever.

kikuyu: Handaarri lafaa hundinuu ni yaadata; gara Waaqayyoottis ni deebiʼa; maatiiwwan sabootaa hundinuus fuula isaa duratti ni sagadu;
english: All the ends of the earth shall remember and turn to the LORD. All the relatives of the nations shall worship before you.

kikuyu: mootummaan kan Waaqayyootii; innis saboota hunda ni bulcha.
english: For the kingdom is the LORD’s. He is the ruler over the nations.

kikuyu: Sooreyyiin lafaa hundinuu ni nyaatu; ni waaqeffatus; warri of jiraachisuu hin dandeenye kanneen biyyoo seenan hundi fuula isaa duratti ni jilbeenfatu.
english: All the rich ones of the earth shall eat and worship. All those who go down to the dust shall bow before him, even he who can’t keep his soul alive.

kikuyu: Dhaloonni dhufu isa tajaajila; dhaloota boriittis waaʼeen Gooftaa ni himama.
english: Posterity shall serve him. Future generations shall be told about the Lord.

kikuyu: Sababii inni waan kana hojjeteef, isaan saba dhalachuuf jirutti qajeelummaa isaa ni labsu.
english: They shall come and shall declare his righteousness to a people that shall be born, for he has done it.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Waaqayyo tiksee koo ti; ani homaa hin dhabu.
english: A Psalm by David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall lack nothing.

kikuyu: Inni marga lalisaa keessa na boqochiisa; gara bishaan tasgabbaaʼaattis na geessa;
english: He makes me lie down in green pastures. He leads me beside still waters.

kikuyu: inni lubbuu natti deebisa. Maqaa isaatiif jedhees karaa qajeelaa irra na deemsisa.
english: He restores my soul. He guides me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

kikuyu: Ani yoon sulula gaaddisa duʼaa keessa deeme illee ati waan na wajjin jirtuuf, homaa hin sodaadhu; uleen keetii fi bokkuun kee na jajjabeessu.
english: Even though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil, for you are with me. Your rod and your staff, they comfort me.

kikuyu: Ati utuma diinonni koo ilaalanuu fuula koo duratti maaddii naa qopheessita. Mataa koo zayitii dibda; xoofoon koos guutuu irraan dhangalaʼaa dha.
english: You prepare a table before me in the presence of my enemies. You anoint my head with oil. My cup runs over.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan gaarummaan keetii fi araarri kee, bara jireenya kootii hunda na duukaa buʼu; anis bara baraan, mana Waaqayyoo keessa nan jiraadha.
english: Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the LORD’s house forever.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Laftii fi wanni lafa irra jiru hundinuu, addunyaa fi wanni ishee keessa jiraatu hundinuus kan Waaqayyoo ti;
english: A Psalm by David. The earth is the LORD’s, with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell in it.

kikuyu: inni galaanota irratti ishee hundeesseeraatii; bishaan irras ishee dhaabeera.
english: For he has founded it on the seas, and established it on the floods.

kikuyu: Eenyutu tulluu Waaqayyootti ol baʼa? Iddoo isaa qulqulluu sanas eenyutu dhaabata?
english: Who may ascend to the LORD’s hill? Who may stand in his holy place?

kikuyu: Nama harka qulqulluu fi garaa qulqulluu qabu, nama lubbuu isaa gara waaqa tolfamaatti ol hin kaafne yookaan nama sobaan hin kakannee dha.
english: He who has clean hands and a pure heart; who has not lifted up his soul to falsehood, and has not sworn deceitfully.

kikuyu: Inni Waaqayyo biraa eebba, Waaqa Fayyisaa isaa biraa immoo qajeelummaa ni argata.
english: He shall receive a blessing from the LORD, righteousness from the God of his salvation.

kikuyu: Dhaloonni kun dhaloota warra isa barbaadanii ti; kan dhaloota warra fuula Waaqa Yaaqoob barbaadanii ti.
english: This is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek your face—even Jacob. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa karroota nana, mataa keessan ol qabadhaa; isinis balbalawwan durii, akka mootiin ulfinaa ol galuuf ol qabamaa.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates! Be lifted up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

kikuyu: Mootiin ulfinaa kun eenyu? Waaqayyo jabaa fi humna qabeessa, Waaqayyo isa waraana keessattis humna qabu sanaa dha.
english: Who is the King of glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.

kikuyu: Yaa karroota nana, mataa keessan ol qabadhaa; isinis balbalawwan durii akka mootiin ulfinaa ol galuuf mataa keessan ol qabadhaa.
english: Lift up your heads, you gates; yes, lift them up, you everlasting doors, and the King of glory will come in.

kikuyu: Mootiin ulfinaa kun eenyu? Waaqayyoon Waan Hunda Dandaʼu sun, inni Mootii ulfinaa ti.
english: Who is this King of glory? The LORD of Armies is the King of glory! Selah.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, ani lubbuu koo gara keetti ol nan qaba.
english: By David. To you, LORD, I lift up my soul.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa koo ani sin amanadha. Ati na hin qaanessin; akka diinonni koo na moʼatanis hin godhin.
english: My God, I have trusted in you. Don’t let me be shamed. Don’t let my enemies triumph over me.

kikuyu: Namni si eeggatu tokko iyyuu yoom iyyuu hin qaaneffamu; warri sababii malee yakka hojjetan garuu ni qaaneffamu.
english: Yes, no one who waits for you will be shamed. They will be shamed who deal treacherously without cause.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, karaa kee na argisiisi; daandii kees na barsiisi;
english: Show me your ways, LORD. Teach me your paths.

kikuyu: ati Waaqa Fayyisaa koo waan taateef, dhugaa keetiin na dura buʼi; na barsiisi; anis guyyaa guutuu sin eeggadha.
english: Guide me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvation. I wait for you all day long.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, araara keetii fi jaalala kee yaadadhu; isaan durumaa jalqabanii jiruutii.
english: LORD, remember your tender mercies and your loving kindness, for they are from old times.

kikuyu: Cubbuu afaan kootii yookaan dogoggora koo hin yaadatin; yaa Waaqayyo, gaarummaa keetiif jedhiitii akkuma araara keetiitti na yaadadhu.
english: Don’t remember the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions. Remember me according to your loving kindness, for your goodness’ sake, LORD.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo gaarii dha; tolaadhas; kanaafuu inni daandii isaa cubbamootatti argisiisa.
english: Good and upright is the LORD, therefore he will instruct sinners in the way.

kikuyu: Warra gad of qaban waan qajeelaa taʼeen geggeessa; karaa isaas isaan barsiisa.
english: He will guide the humble in justice. He will teach the humble his way.

kikuyu: Karaan Waaqayyoo hundinuu warra kakuu isaatii fi seera isaa eeganiif araaraa fi dhugaa dha.
english: All the paths of the LORD are loving kindness and truth to such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, cubbuun koo guddaa taʼu iyyuu maqaa keetiif jedhiitii dhiifama naa godhi.
english: For your name’s sake, LORD, pardon my iniquity, for it is great.

kikuyu: Namni Waaqayyoon sodaatu eenyu? Waaqayyo karaa inni filachuu qabu isa argisiisa.
english: What man is he who fears the LORD? He shall instruct him in the way that he shall choose.

kikuyu: Lubbuun isaa badhaadhummaadhaan jiraatti; sanyiin isaas lafa dhaala.
english: His soul will dwell at ease. His offspring will inherit the land.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo icciitii isaa warra isa sodaatan duraa hin dhoksu; kakuu isaa illee isaan beeksisa.
english: The friendship of the LORD is with those who fear him. He will show them his covenant.

kikuyu: Iji koo yeroo hunda gara Waaqayyoo ilaala; inni miilla koo kiyyoo keessaa ni baasaatii.
english: My eyes are ever on the LORD, for he will pluck my feet out of the net.

kikuyu: Gara kootti garagali; garaas naa laafi; ani kophaa koon jiraatii; rakkataadhas.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, for I am desolate and afflicted.

kikuyu: Yaaddoon garaa kootii baayʼateera; dhiphina koo keessaas na baasi.
english: The troubles of my heart are enlarged. Oh bring me out of my distresses.

kikuyu: Dhiphina kootii fi rakkina koo ilaali; cubbuu koo hunda naa dhiisi.
english: Consider my affliction and my travail. Forgive all my sins.

kikuyu: Akka diinonni koo baayʼatan, hammam akka cimsanii na jibban argi!
english: Consider my enemies, for they are many. They hate me with cruel hatred.

kikuyu: Lubbuu koo eegi; na oolchis; sababii ani kooluu sitti galeef, akka ani qaanaʼu na hin godhin.
english: Oh keep my soul, and deliver me. Let me not be disappointed, for I take refuge in you.

kikuyu: Waan ani si eeggadhuuf, amanamummaa fi qajeelummaan ana haa eegan.
english: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me, for I wait for you.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, rakkina isaa hundumaa keessaa Israaʼelin furi!
english: God, redeem Israel out of all his troubles.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, sababii ani jireenya hirʼina hin qabne jiraadheef, ati naa murteessi; anis utuu asii fi achi hin raafamin, Waaqayyoon amanadheera.
english: By David. Judge me, LORD, for I have walked in my integrity. I have trusted also in the LORD without wavering.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, qoriitii na ilaali; garaa koo fi qalbii koo qori;
english: Examine me, LORD, and prove me. Try my heart and my mind.

kikuyu: jaalalli kee kan hin geeddaramne sun ija koo dura jiraatii; anis dhugaa keetiin nan deddeebiʼa.
english: For your loving kindness is before my eyes. I have walked in your truth.

kikuyu: Ani warra nama gowwoomsan wajjin hin taaʼu, yookaan fakkeessitoota wajjin tokkummaa hin qabaadhu;
english: I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.

kikuyu: ani waldaa warra hammina hojjetanii nan jibba; hamoota wajjinis hin taaʼu.
english: I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani harka koo qulqullummaadhaan nan dhiqadha; iddoo aarsaa keetii irras nan naannaʼa.
english: I will wash my hands in innocence, so I will go about your altar, LORD,

kikuyu: Faarfannaa galataa guddisee nan faarfadha; dinqii hojii keetii hunda nan odeessa.
english: that I may make the voice of thanksgiving to be heard and tell of all your wondrous deeds.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, mana ati keessa jiraattu, iddoo ulfinni kee jirus nan jaalladha.
english: LORD, I love the habitation of your house, the place where your glory dwells.

kikuyu: Lubbuu koo cubbamoota wajjin, jireenya koos warra dhiiga dhangalaasan wajjin hin balleessin;
english: Don’t gather my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloodthirsty men

kikuyu: warra harka isaanii keessa karoorri jalʼinaa jiru kanneen harki isaanii mirgaa mattaʼaadhaan guutame wajjin na hin balleessin.
english: in whose hands is wickedness; their right hand is full of bribes.

kikuyu: Ani garuu jireenya hirʼina hin qabne nan jiraadha; ati na furi; araaras naa buusi.
english: But as for me, I will walk in my integrity. Redeem me, and be merciful to me.

kikuyu: Miilli koo lafa wal qixxee irra dhaabata; waldaa guddaa keessattis Waaqayyoon nan jajadha.
english: My foot stands in an even place. In the congregations I will bless the LORD.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Waaqayyo ibsaa kootii fi fayyina koo ti; ani eenyunan sodaadha? Waaqayyo daʼoo jireenya kootii ti; eenyutu na sodaachisa?
english: By David. The LORD is my light and my salvation. Whom shall I fear? The LORD is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?

kikuyu: Namoonni hamoon yommuu foon koo nyaachuudhaaf natti dhufan, diinonni koo fi amajaajonni koo yommuu na miidhuuf natti kaʼan, gufatanii kufu.
english: When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.

kikuyu: Yoo duulli na marse illee, garaan koo hin sodaatu; yoo waraanni natti baname illee ani hin raafamu.
english: Though an army should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear. Though war should rise against me, even then I will be confident.

kikuyu: Ani waan tokko Waaqayyoon nan kadhadha; waan kanas nan barbaada: Kunis bara jireenya kootii guutuu mana Waaqayyoo keessa jiraachuu, miidhagina Waaqayyoo ilaaluu fi mana qulqullummaa isaa keessatti isa kadhachuu dha.
english: One thing I have asked of the LORD, that I will seek after: that I may dwell in the LORD’s house all the days of my life, to see the LORD’s beauty, and to inquire in his temple.

kikuyu: Inni guyyaa rakkinaa iddoo ofii jiraatu na kaaʼataatii; daʼoo dunkaana isaa jala na dhoksa; kattaa gubbaattis ol na baasa.
english: For in the day of trouble, he will keep me secretly in his pavilion. In the secret place of his tabernacle, he will hide me. He will lift me up on a rock.

kikuyu: Yommus diinota na marsanii olitti mataan koo ol jedha; dunkaana isaa keessatti illee ililleedhaan aarsaa nan dhiʼeessa; Waaqayyoof nan faarfadha; nan weeddisas.
english: Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises to the LORD.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, yommuu ani si waammadhu, sagalee koo dhagaʼi; naaf araarami; deebiis naaf kenni.
english: Hear, LORD, when I cry with my voice. Have mercy also on me, and answer me.

kikuyu: Yommuu ati, “Fuula koo barbaadaa!” jettetti, garaan koo, “Yaa Waaqayyo, ani fuula kee nan barbaada” siin jedha.
english: When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart said to you, “I will seek your face, LORD.”

kikuyu: Fuula kee na duraa hin dhoksin; aartee tajaajilaa kee of irraa hin deebisin; ati gargaaraa koo taateerta. Yaa Waaqayyo, Fayyisaa ko, na hin gatin; na hin dhiisinis.
english: Don’t hide your face from me. Don’t put your servant away in anger. You have been my help. Don’t abandon me, neither forsake me, God of my salvation.

kikuyu: Yoo abbaan kootii fi haati koo na dhiisan illee, Waaqayyo na simata.
english: When my father and my mother forsake me, then the LORD will take me up.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, karaa kee na barsiisi; sababii ani diinota baayʼee qabuuf daandii qajeelaa irra na buusi.
english: Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me in a straight path, because of my enemies.

kikuyu: Fedhii diinota kootiitti dabarsitee na hin kennin; dhuga baatonni sobduun narratti kaʼaniiruutii; isaanis hafuura jalʼinaa baafatu.
english: Don’t deliver me over to the desire of my adversaries, for false witnesses have risen up against me, such as breathe out cruelty.

kikuyu: Anis biyya jiraattotaa keessatti gaarummaa Waaqayyoo akkan argu amma iyyuu nan amana.
english: I am still confident of this: I will see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon eeggadhu; cimi; jabaadhus; Waaqayyoon eeggadhu.
english: Wait for the LORD. Be strong, and let your heart take courage. Yes, wait for the LORD.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, Kattaa ko, ani sin waammadha; ati na jalaa hin didin. Yoo ati na jalaa didde, ani akka warra boolla buʼanii nan taʼa.
english: By David. To you, LORD, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: Yommuu ani gargaarsaaf si waammadhee harka koo illee gara Iddoo Qulqullummaa kee kan Waan Hundumaa Caalaa Qulqulluu taʼe sanaatti ol kaafadhu, sagalee kadhannaa koo naa dhagaʼi.
english: Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.

kikuyu: Namoota hamoo warra jalʼina hojjetan wajjin, warra garaa isaaniitti hammina qabatanii olloota isaanii wajjin garuu nagaa dubbatan wajjin na hin balleessin.
english: Don’t draw me away with the wicked, with the workers of iniquity who speak peace with their neighbors, but mischief is in their hearts.
