kikuyu: Akka hojii isaaniitti, akkuma hojii isaanii hamaa sanaattis deebisiif; akkuma hojii harka isaaniitti kenniif; gatii isaaniif malu isaanumatti deebisi.
english: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings. Give them according to the operation of their hands. Bring back on them what they deserve.

kikuyu: Sababii isaan hojii Waaqayyoo, yookaan waan harki isaa hojjete hin kabajneef inni isaan diiga; deebisees isaan hin ijaaru.
english: Because they don’t respect the works of the LORD, nor the operation of his hands, he will break them down and not build them up.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo haa eebbifamu! Inni iyya kadhannaa kootii naa dhagaʼeeraatii.
english: Blessed be the LORD, because he has heard the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo jabina koo fi gaachana koo ti; garaan koo isa amanata; anis gargaarsa argadheera. Garaan koo baayʼee gammada; anis faarfannaadhaan isa nan galateeffadha.
english: The LORD is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo jabina saba isaa ti; dibamaa isaatiifis daʼoo fayyinaa ti.
english: The LORD is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

kikuyu: Saba kee fayyisi; dhaala kees eebbisi; tiksee isaanii taʼii bara baraan isaan baadhu.
english: Save your people, and bless your inheritance. Be their shepherd also, and bear them up forever.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Isin jajjabeeyyiin, Waaqayyoof fidaa; ulfinaa fi jabina Waaqayyoof fidaa.
english: A Psalm by David. Ascribe to the LORD, you sons of the mighty, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

kikuyu: Ulfina maqaa isaatiif malu Waaqayyoof kennaa; iddoo qulqullummaa isaatti Waaqayyoon waaqeffadhaa.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Worship the LORD in holy array.

kikuyu: Sagaleen Waaqayyoo bishaanota irra jira; Waaqni ulfinaa ni qaqawweessaʼa; Waaqayyo bishaanota baayʼee irratti ni qaqawweessaʼa.
english: The LORD’s voice is on the waters. The God of glory thunders, even the LORD on many waters.

kikuyu: Sagaleen Waaqayyoo humna qaba; sagaleen Waaqayyoo surra qabeessa.
english: The LORD’s voice is powerful. The LORD’s voice is full of majesty.

kikuyu: Sagaleen Waaqayyoo birbirsa ni cabsa; Waaqayyo birbirsa Libaanoon ni caccabsa.
english: The LORD’s voice breaks the cedars. Yes, the LORD breaks in pieces the cedars of Lebanon.

kikuyu: Inni Libaanoonin akka jabbiitti, Siiriyoonin immoo akka dibicha gafarsaatti ni utaalchisa.
english: He makes them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young, wild ox.

kikuyu: Sagaleen Waaqayyoo balaqqeessa bakakkaatiin rukuta.
english: The LORD’s voice strikes with flashes of lightning.

kikuyu: Sagaleen Waaqayyoo gammoojjii sochoosa; Waaqayyo Gammoojjii Qaadesh sochoosa.
english: The LORD’s voice shakes the wilderness. The LORD shakes the wilderness of Kadesh.

kikuyu: Sagaleen Waaqayyoo qilxuu micciira; bosonas qullaatti hambisa. Hundinuus mana qulqullummaa isaa keessatti, “Ulfina!” jedhee iyya.
english: The LORD’s voice makes the deer calve, and strips the forests bare. In his temple everything says, “Glory!”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo lolaa badiisaatiin olitti teessoo isaa irra taaʼa; Waaqayyo Mootii taʼee bara baraan teessoo isaa irra taaʼa.
english: The LORD sat enthroned at the Flood. Yes, the LORD sits as King forever.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo saba isaatiif jabina kenna; Waaqayyo saba isaa nagaadhaan eebbisa.
english: The LORD will give strength to his people. The LORD will bless his people with peace.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa eebba mana qulqullummaatiif Faarfatame. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, sababii ati ol na fuutee akka diinonni koo natti hin gammanne gooteef, ani sin jajadha.
english: A Psalm. A Song for the Dedication of the Temple. By David. I will extol you, LORD, for you have raised me up, and have not made my foes to rejoice over me.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa ko, ani gargaarsaaf sin waammadhe; atis na fayyifte.
english: LORD my God, I cried to you, and you have healed me.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati lubbuu koo siiʼoolii baafte; akka ani boolla hin buune gootees na jiraachifte.
english: LORD, you have brought up my soul from Sheol. You have kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

kikuyu: Isin qulqulloonni isaa, faarfannaadhaan Waaqayyoon jajadhaa; maqaa isaa qulqulluu sanaafis galata galchaa.
english: Sing praise to the LORD, you saints of his. Give thanks to his holy name.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsi isaa hamma liphsuu ijaa ti; gaarummaan isaa immoo bara jireenyaa guutuudhaaf tura; booʼichi galgala tokko qofaaf tura; ganama garuu ililleetu taʼa.
english: For his anger is but for a moment. His favor is for a lifetime. Weeping may stay for the night, but joy comes in the morning.

kikuyu: Anis yommuun nagaa argadhetti, “Ani gonkumaa hin raafamu” nan jedhe.
english: As for me, I said in my prosperity, “I shall never be moved.”

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati jaalala keetiin akka tulluu jabaatti na dhaabde; yeroo ati fuula kee na duraa dhoksitetti garuu naasuutu na qabate.
english: You, LORD, when you favored me, made my mountain stand strong; but when you hid your face, I was troubled.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani sin waammadha; ani gara Gooftaatti akkana jedhee araaraaf nan iyyadha:
english: I cried to you, LORD. I made supplication to the Lord:

kikuyu: “Duʼuu koo keessaa, boolla buʼuu koo keessaas faayidaa maaliitu argama? Biyyoon si galateeffataa? Amanamummaa kees ni odeessaa?
english: “What profit is there in my destruction, if I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise you? Shall it declare your truth?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo na dhagaʼi; na maaris; Yaa Waaqayyo, gargaarsa naa taʼi.”
english: Hear, LORD, and have mercy on me. LORD, be my helper.”

kikuyu: Ati booʼicha koo shuubbisuutti geeddarte; wayyaa gaddaa narraa baaftee gammachuu natti uwwifte;
english: You have turned my mourning into dancing for me. You have removed my sackcloth, and clothed me with gladness,

kikuyu: kunis akka lubbuun koo faarfannaadhaan si jajattuu fi akka isheen hin calʼisneefii dha. Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa ko, ani bara baraan sin galateeffadha.
english: to the end that my heart may sing praise to you, and not be silent. LORD my God, I will give thanks to you forever!

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, ani kooluu sitti galeera; ati gonkumaa na hin qaanessin; qajeelummaa keetiin na oolchi.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. In you, LORD, I take refuge. Let me never be disappointed. Deliver me in your righteousness.

kikuyu: Gurra kee gara kootti qabi; dafiitii na oolchi; kattaa ani itti kooluu galu naa taʼi; na oolchuudhaafis daʼoo jabaa naa taʼi.
english: Bow down your ear to me. Deliver me speedily. Be to me a strong rock, a house of defense to save me.

kikuyu: Ati waan kattaa koo fi daʼoo koo taateef, maqaa keetiif jedhiitii na qajeelchi; karaa irras na buusi.
english: For you are my rock and my fortress, therefore for your name’s sake lead me and guide me.

kikuyu: Ati iddoo ani itti baqadhu waan taateef, kiyyoo diinonni koo naa kaaʼan keessaa na baasi.
english: Pluck me out of the net that they have laid secretly for me, for you are my stronghold.

kikuyu: Ani hafuura koo dabarsee harka keettin kennadha; yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa dhugaa, ati na furi.
english: Into your hand I commend my spirit. You redeem me, LORD, God of truth.

kikuyu: Ani warra waaqota faayidaa hin qabne abdatan nan jibba; Waaqayyoon garuu nan amanadha.
english: I hate those who regard lying vanities, but I trust in the LORD.

kikuyu: Ani jaalala kee kan hin geeddaramne sanatti nan gammada; nan ililchas; ati dhiphina koo argiteertaatii; rakkina lubbuu kootii illee beekteerta.
english: I will be glad and rejoice in your loving kindness, for you have seen my affliction. You have known my soul in adversities.

kikuyu: Ati dabarsitee diinatti na hin kennine; miilla koos iddoo balʼaa irra dhaabdeerta.
english: You have not shut me up into the hand of the enemy. You have set my feet in a large place.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani dhiphina keessan jiraatii na baasi; iji koo gaddaan, lubbuun koo fi dhagni koo gaddaan dadhabaniiru.
english: Have mercy on me, LORD, for I am in distress. My eye, my soul, and my body waste away with grief.

kikuyu: Jireenyi koo gaddaan, umuriin koo aaduudhaan dhumeera; jabinni koo sababii dhiphina kootiitiif laafeera; lafeen koos xuuxameera.
english: For my life is spent with sorrow, my years with sighing. My strength fails because of my iniquity. My bones are wasted away.

kikuyu: Sababii diinota koo hundaatiif, ani olloota koo biratti waan sodaachisaa, michoota koo biratti immoo waan jibbisiisaa taʼeera; warri karaa irratti na arganis na baqatu.
english: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.

kikuyu: Ani akkuma nama duʼeetti irraanfatameera; akkuma qodaa cabaas nan taʼe.
english: I am forgotten from their hearts like a dead man. I am like broken pottery.

kikuyu: Asaasa namoota baayʼee nan dhagaʼaatii; kallattii hundaan sodaatu jira! Isaan natti malatanii lubbuu koo balleessuuf mariʼatan.
english: For I have heard the slander of many, terror on every side, while they conspire together against me, they plot to take away my life.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani garuu sin amanadha; “Ati Waaqa koo ti” nan jedha.
english: But I trust in you, LORD. I said, “You are my God.”

kikuyu: Barri koo si harka jira; diinota koo jalaa, warra na ariʼatan harkaas na baasi.
english: My times are in your hand. Deliver me from the hand of my enemies, and from those who persecute me.

kikuyu: Fuulli kee tajaajilaa kee irratti haa ifu; jaalala kee kan hin geeddaramne sanaanis na baraari.
english: Make your face to shine on your servant. Save me in your loving kindness.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani hin qaaneffamin; ani si waammadheeraatii; warri hamoon garuu haa qaaneffaman; calʼisaniis siiʼool keessa haa buʼan.
english: Let me not be disappointed, LORD, for I have called on you. Let the wicked be disappointed. Let them be silent in Sheol.

kikuyu: Afaan soba dubbatu, kan of tuulummaa fi tuffiidhaan, nama qajeelaatti kooree dubbatu haa duudu.
english: Let the lying lips be mute, which speak against the righteous insolently, with pride and contempt.

kikuyu: Gaarummaan kee kan ati warra si sodaataniif ol keesse, kan ati fuula namootaa duratti warra kooluu sitti galaniif kennite akkam guddaa dha!
english: Oh how great is your goodness, which you have laid up for those who fear you, which you have worked for those who take refuge in you, before the sons of men!

kikuyu: Daʼoo fuula keetiitiin, waan namoonni isaanitti malatan jalaa isaan dhoksita; dunkaana kee keessattis dubbiin tuttuquu jalaa isaan daʼeessita.
english: In the shelter of your presence you will hide them from the plotting of man. You will keep them secretly in a dwelling away from the strife of tongues.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo haa eebbifamu; inni yeroo ani magaalaa marfamte keessa turetti, jaalala isaa dinqisiisaa sana na argisiiseeraatii.
english: Praise be to the LORD, for he has shown me his marvelous loving kindness in a strong city.

kikuyu: Ani yeroon akka malee dhiphadhetti, “Ani fuula kee duraa badeera!” jedheen ture. Ati garuu yeroo ani gargaarsaaf sitti iyyadhetti, kadhannaa koo naa dhageesse.
english: As for me, I said in my haste, “I am cut off from before your eyes.” Nevertheless you heard the voice of my petitions when I cried to you.

kikuyu: Qulqulloonni isaa hundinuu, Waaqayyoon jaalladhaa! Waaqayyo amanamoota ni eega; of tuultotaaf garuu akkuma hojii isaaniitti irra dabarsee deebisaaf.
english: Oh love the LORD, all you his saints! The LORD preserves the faithful, and fully recompenses him who behaves arrogantly.

kikuyu: Warri Waaqayyoon abdattan hundinuu jabaadhaa; garaan keessan hin sodaatin.
english: Be strong, and let your heart take courage, all you who hope in the LORD.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Maskiil. Namni yakki isaa dhiifameef, kan cubbuun isaas haguugameef, eebbifamaa dha.
english: By David. A contemplative psalm. Blessed is he whose disobedience is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

kikuyu: Namni Waaqayyo cubbuu itti hin lakkoofne, kan hafuura isaa keessas gowwoomsaan hin jirre, eebbifamaa dha.
english: Blessed is the man to whom the LORD doesn’t impute iniquity, in whose spirit there is no deceit.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani cubbuu koo himachuu dhiisetti, guyyaa guutuu aaduu kootiin, lafeen koo ni bosose.
english: When I kept silence, my bones wasted away through my groaning all day long.

kikuyu: Harki kee halkanii fi guyyaa natti ulfaateeraatii; jabinni koos akkuma waan hoʼa bonaatiin taʼuutti xuuxame.
english: For day and night your hand was heavy on me. My strength was sapped in the heat of summer. Selah.

kikuyu: Ergasiis cubbuu koo sitti nan himadhe; balleessaa koos si hin dhokfanne. Anis, “Irra daddarba koo, Waaqayyootti nan himadha” nan jedhe; atis yakka cubbuu kootii, naa dhiifteerta.
english: I acknowledged my sin to you. I didn’t hide my iniquity. I said, I will confess my transgressions to the LORD, and you forgave the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namni amanamaan kam iyyuu, yeroo ati itti argamtutti si haa kadhatu; lolaan bishaan guddaas isa bira hin gaʼu.
english: For this, let everyone who is godly pray to you in a time when you may be found. Surely when the great waters overflow, they shall not reach to him.

kikuyu: Ati iddoo ani itti dhokadhuu dha; rakkina irraa na eegda; faarfannaa moʼannaatiinis na marsita.
english: You are my hiding place. You will preserve me from trouble. You will surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah.

kikuyu: Ani karaa ati irra deemtu irratti sin qajeelcha; sin barsiisas; ani ija koo jaalalaatiin sin ilaala; sin gorsa.
english: I will instruct you and teach you in the way which you shall go. I will counsel you with my eye on you.

kikuyu: Isin akka farda yookaan gaangoo hubannaa hin qabnee hin taʼinaa; isaan yoo luugamaa fi fuuloodhaan qabaman malee gara kee hin dhufan.
english: Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else they will not come near to you.

kikuyu: Dhiphinni namoota hamoo baayʼee dha; araarri Waaqayyoo garuu nama isa amanatu ni marsa.
english: Many sorrows come to the wicked, but loving kindness shall surround him who trusts in the LORD.

kikuyu: Yaa qajeeltota, isin Waaqayyotti gammadaa; ililchaas; warri garaa qulqulluu qabdan hundinuu ililchaa.
english: Be glad in the LORD, and rejoice, you righteous! Shout for joy, all you who are upright in heart!

kikuyu: Yaa qajeeltota, isin Waaqayyotti gammadaa; isa jajuun tolootaaf ni mala.
english: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous! Praise is fitting for the upright.

kikuyu: Kiraaraan Waaqayyoon galateeffadhaa; baganaa ribuu kudhan qabuun isaaf faarfadhaa.
english: Give thanks to the LORD with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa haaraa isaaf faarfadhaa; ribuu haalaan rukutaa; sirriitti rukutaa; gammachuudhaanis ililchaa.
english: Sing to him a new song. Play skillfully with a shout of joy!

kikuyu: Dubbiin Waaqayyoo qajeelaadhaatii; inni waan hojjetu hundumaatti amanamaa dha.
english: For the LORD’s word is right. All his work is done in faithfulness.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo qajeelummaa fi murtii qajeelaa jaallata; laftis jaalala isaa kan hin geeddaramneen guutamteerti.
english: He loves righteousness and justice. The earth is full of the loving kindness of the LORD.

kikuyu: Samiiwwan dubbii Waaqayyootiin hojjetaman; tuunni urjiiwwanii hundinuus hafuura afaan isaatii baʼuun uumaman.
english: By the LORD’s word, the heavens were made: all their army by the breath of his mouth.

kikuyu: Inni bishaan galaanaa akka tuullaatti walitti qaba; bishaan tuujubaas kuusaa keessa kaaʼa.
english: He gathers the waters of the sea together as a heap. He lays up the deeps in storehouses.

kikuyu: Lafti hundi Waaqayyoon haa sodaatu; sabni addunyaa irra jiraatu hundinuus, guddisee isa haa sodaatu.
english: Let all the earth fear the LORD. Let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

kikuyu: Inni dubbateeraatii, wanni inni dubbate ni taʼe; inni ni ajaje; wanni inni ajajes ni raawwate.
english: For he spoke, and it was done. He commanded, and it stood firm.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo marii sabootaa ni fashaleessa; akka karoorri namootaa hojii irra hin oolles ni godha.
english: The LORD brings the counsel of the nations to nothing. He makes the thoughts of the peoples to be of no effect.

kikuyu: Karoorri Waaqayyoo garuu bara baraan, yaadni garaa isaas dhaloota hundumaa keessatti cimee ni dhaabata.
english: The counsel of the LORD stands fast forever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

kikuyu: Sabni Waaqayyo Waaqa isaaf taʼe, namoonni inni akka dhaala ofii isaatti filate eebbifamoo dha.
english: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people whom he has chosen for his own inheritance.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo samii irraa gad ni ilaala; ilmaan namootaa hundas ni arga;
english: The LORD looks from heaven. He sees all the sons of men.

kikuyu: inni teessoo isaa irra taaʼee, warra lafa irra jiraatan hunda gad ilaala;
english: From the place of his habitation he looks out on all the inhabitants of the earth,

kikuyu: inni garaa nama hundumaa uumu sun, hojii isaanii hunda ni hubata.
english: he who fashions all of their hearts; and he considers all of their works.

kikuyu: Mootiin baayʼina loltoota isaatiin duʼa hin oolu; jagnis guddina humna isaatiin duʼa jalaa hin baʼu.
english: There is no king saved by the multitude of an army. A mighty man is not delivered by great strength.

kikuyu: Fardi moʼannaadhaaf abdii gatii hin qabnee dha; guddinni humna isaas nama hin oolchu.
english: A horse is a vain thing for safety, neither does he deliver any by his great power.

kikuyu: Garuu iji Waaqayyoo warra isa sodaatan irra, warra araara isaa abdatan irras jira;
english: Behold, the LORD’s eye is on those who fear him, on those who hope in his loving kindness,

kikuyu: inni lubbuu isaanii duʼa jalaa ni baasa; bara beelaas isaan ni jiraachisa.
english: to deliver their soul from death, to keep them alive in famine.

kikuyu: Lubbuun keenya abdiidhaan Waaqayyoon eeggatti; innis gargaarsa keenyaa fi gaachana keenya.
english: Our soul has waited for the LORD. He is our help and our shield.

kikuyu: Garaan keenya isatti ni gammadaatii; nu maqaa isaa qulqulluu ni amanannaatii.
english: For our heart rejoices in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, akkuma nu abdii keenya sirra kaaʼannutti, araarri kee nurra haa buʼu.
english: Let your loving kindness be on us, LORD, since we have hoped in you.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Innis fuula Abiimelek duratti maraatuu of fakkeesseef Abiimelek isa ariinaan yeroo achii deemetti faarfate. Ani yeroo hunda Waaqayyoon nan eebbisa; galanni isaas yeroo hunda afaanii na hin buʼu.
english: By David; when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the LORD at all times. His praise will always be in my mouth.

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo Waaqayyoon boonti; cunqurfamtoonni dhagaʼanii haa gammadan.
english: My soul shall boast in the LORD. The humble shall hear of it and be glad.

kikuyu: Na wajjin Waaqayyoof ulfina kennaa; kottaa walii wajjin maqaa isaa ol kaafnaa.
english: Oh magnify the LORD with me. Let’s exalt his name together.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon nan barbaaddadhe; innis deebii naa kenne; sodaa koo hunda keessaas na baase.
english: I sought the LORD, and he answered me, and delivered me from all my fears.

kikuyu: Warri gara isaa ilaalan ni ifu; fuulli isaaniis yoom iyyuu hin qaanaʼu.
english: They looked to him, and were radiant. Their faces shall never be covered with shame.

kikuyu: Hiyyeessi kun ni iyye; Waaqayyos isa dhagaʼe; rakkina isaa hundumaa keessaas isa baase.
english: This poor man cried, and the LORD heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqayyoo naannoo warra Waaqa sodaatanii ni qubata; isaan ni oolchas.
english: The LORD’s angel encamps around those who fear him, and delivers them.

kikuyu: Akka Waaqayyo gaarii taʼe mee miʼeeffadhaa ilaalaa; namni isatti kooluu galu eebbifamaa dha.
english: Oh taste and see that the LORD is good. Blessed is the man who takes refuge in him.

kikuyu: Isin qulqulloonni isaa Waaqayyoon sodaadhaa; warri isa sodaatan homaa hin dhabaniitii.
english: Oh fear the LORD, you his saints, for there is no lack with those who fear him.

kikuyu: Leenci saafelli iyyuu waa ni dhaba; ni beelaʼas; namni Waaqayyoon barbaaddatu garuu waan gaarii tokko illee hin dhabu.
english: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger, but those who seek the LORD shall not lack any good thing.

kikuyu: Yaa ijoollee ko, kottaa na dhagaʼaa; anis Waaqayyoon sodaachuu isinan barsiisa.
english: Come, you children, listen to me. I will teach you the fear of the LORD.

kikuyu: Namni jireenya jaallatu, kan bara gaarii arguudhaafis bara baayʼee hawwu eenyu?
english: Who is someone who desires life, and loves many days, that he may see good?

kikuyu: Arraba kee waan hamaa irraa, afaan kees soba dubbachuu irraa eeggadhu.
english: Keep your tongue from evil, and your lips from speaking lies.

kikuyu: Hammina irraa deebiʼi; gaarii hojjedhu; nagaa barbaadi; duukaa buʼis.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Seek peace, and pursue it.

kikuyu: Iji Waaqayyoo qajeeltota irra jira; gurri isaas iyya isaaniitiif banamaa dha;
english: The LORD’s eyes are toward the righteous. His ears listen to their cry.

kikuyu: yaadannoo isaanii lafa irraa balleessuudhaaf, fuulli Waaqayyoo warra hamaa hojjetanitti ni hammaata.
english: The LORD’s face is against those who do evil, to cut off their memory from the earth.

kikuyu: Qajeeltonni gargaarsaaf iyyatu; Waaqayyos isaan dhagaʼa. Rakkina isaanii hunda keessaas isaan baasa.
english: The righteous cry, and the LORD hears, and delivers them out of all their troubles.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo warra garaan isaanii cabetti dhiʼoo dha; warra abdii kutatanis ni fayyisa.
english: The LORD is near to those who have a broken heart, and saves those who have a crushed spirit.

kikuyu: Rakkinni nama qajeelaa baayʼee dha; Waaqayyo garuu hunda isaa jalaa isa baasa;
english: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him out of them all.

kikuyu: lafee isaa hunda ni eega; isaan keessaas tokko illee hin cabu.
english: He protects all of his bones. Not one of them is broken.

kikuyu: Hamoota hamminatu ajjeesa; warra nama qajeelaa jibbanitti ni murteeffama.
english: Evil shall kill the wicked. Those who hate the righteous shall be condemned.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo lubbuu tajaajiltoota isaa ni fura; warra isatti kooluu galan keessaa tokkotti illee hin murteeffamu.
english: The LORD redeems the soul of his servants. None of those who take refuge in him shall be condemned.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, warra anaan mormaniin mormi; warra na lolanis loli.
english: By David. Contend, LORD, with those who contend with me. Fight against those who fight against me.

kikuyu: Gaachanaa fi miʼa lolaa qabadhu; na gargaaruudhaafis kaʼi.
english: Take hold of shield and buckler, and stand up for my help.

kikuyu: Warra na ariʼanitti eeboo fi bodee luqqifadhu. Lubbuu kootiinis, “Fayyinni kee ana” jedhi.
english: Brandish the spear and block those who pursue me. Tell my soul, “I am your salvation.”

kikuyu: Warri lubbuu koo barbaadan, haa qaanaʼan; haa salphatanis; warri na balleessuuf mariʼatanis, abdii kutatanii duubatti haa deebiʼan.
english: Let those who seek after my soul be disappointed and brought to dishonor. Let those who plot my ruin be turned back and confounded.

kikuyu: Akka habaqii qilleensaan fudhatamee haa taʼan; ergamaan Waaqayyoos isaan haa ariʼu.
english: Let them be as chaff before the wind, the LORD’s angel driving them on.

kikuyu: Karaan isaanii dukkanaaʼaa fi mucucaataa haa taʼu; ergamaan Waaqayyoos isaan haa ariʼu.
english: Let their way be dark and slippery, the LORD’s angel pursuing them.

kikuyu: Isaan sababii malee kiyyoo isaanii dhoksanii na dura kaaʼaniiruutii; sababii malees boolla naa qotaniiru;
english: For without cause they have hidden their net in a pit for me. Without cause they have dug a pit for my soul.

kikuyu: utuu inni hin beekin badiisni isatti haa dhufu; kiyyoon inni dhokse sunis isuma haa qabu; boolluma qote sanattis haa kufu.
english: Let destruction come on him unawares. Let his net that he has hidden catch himself. Let him fall into that destruction.

kikuyu: Yoos lubbuun ko, Waaqayyotti gammaddi; fayyisuu isaattis ni ililchiti.
english: My soul shall be joyful in the LORD. It shall rejoice in his salvation.

kikuyu: Lafeen koo hundi akkana siin jedha: “Yaa Waaqayyo, kan akka keetii eenyu? Ati dadhabdoota warra isaan caalaa jabaatan jalaa baafta; hiyyeeyyii fi rakkattoota illee saamtota jalaa baafta.”
english: All my bones shall say, “LORD, who is like you, who delivers the poor from him who is too strong for him; yes, the poor and the needy from him who robs him?”

kikuyu: Dhuga baatonni sobaa natti kaʼan; waan ani waaʼee isaa hin beeknes na gaafatu.
english: Unrighteous witnesses rise up. They ask me about things that I don’t know about.

kikuyu: Isaan qooda waan gaarii waan hamaa naa deebisu; lubbuu koos kophaatti hambisu.
english: They reward me evil for good, to the bereaving of my soul.

kikuyu: Ani garuu yeroo isaan dhibamanitti, wayyaa gaddaa nan uffadhe; lubbuu koos soomaan nan miidhe. Yeroo kadhannaan koo deebii malee hafettis
english: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth. I afflicted my soul with fasting. My prayer returned into my own bosom.

kikuyu: ani akkuma waan michuu kootiif yookaan obboleessa kootiif gadduutti, gaddaan asii fi achi deddeebiʼe. Akkuma waan haadha kootiif booʼuuttis, gaddaan mataa koo nan buuse.
english: I behaved myself as though it had been my friend or my brother. I bowed down mourning, as one who mourns his mother.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu yeroo ani gufadhetti gammadanii walitti qabaman; utuu ani hin beekin na marsan; utuu wal irraa hin kutinis na cicciratan.
english: But in my adversity, they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together. The attackers gathered themselves together against me, and I didn’t know it. They tore at me, and didn’t cease.

kikuyu: Isaan akkuma warra Waaqatti hin bulleetti hamminaan natti qoosan; ilkaan isaanii illee natti qaratan.
english: Like the profane mockers in feasts, they gnashed their teeth at me.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, ati hamma yoomiitti calʼistee ilaalta? Lubbuu koo badiisa isaan fidan jalaa, jireenya koos leenca jalaa baasi.
english: Lord, how long will you look on? Rescue my soul from their destruction, my precious life from the lions.

kikuyu: Ani wal gaʼii guddaa keessatti sin galateeffadha; tuuta guddaa keessatti sin jajadha.
english: I will give you thanks in the great assembly. I will praise you among many people.

kikuyu: Warri akkasumaan diina natti taʼan natti hin gammadin; warri sababii malee na jibban sunis ija natti hin qisin.
english: Don’t let those who are my enemies wrongfully rejoice over me; neither let those who hate me without a cause wink their eyes.

kikuyu: Isaan nagaa hin dubbatan; warra qabbanaan biyya keessa jiraatanittis, mala sobaa malatu.
english: For they don’t speak peace, but they devise deceitful words against those who are quiet in the land.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Baga! Baga! Ijuma keenyaan isa argine” jedhanii afaan natti banatu.
english: Yes, they opened their mouth wide against me. They said, “Aha! Aha! Our eye has seen it!”

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati waan kana argiteerta; hin calʼisin. Yaa gooftaa, narraa hin fagaatin.
english: You have seen it, LORD. Don’t keep silent. Lord, don’t be far from me.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa koo fi Gooftaa ko, ati mirga kootiif, dhimma kootiifis dammaqi; kaʼi!
english: Wake up! Rise up to defend me, my God! My Lord, contend for me!

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa ko, akkuma qajeelummaa keetiitti naa murteessi; akka isaan natti gammadanis hin godhin.
english: Vindicate me, LORD my God, according to your righteousness. Don’t let them gloat over me.

kikuyu: Akka isaan, “Baga! Akkuma nu barbaanne taʼeera!” jedhan, yookaan akka isaan, “Nu isa liqimsineerra” jedhan hin godhin.
english: Don’t let them say in their heart, “Aha! That’s the way we want it!” Don’t let them say, “We have swallowed him up!”

kikuyu: Warri dhiphina kootti gammadan hundinuu haa qaanaʼan; haa burjaajaʼanis; warri natti kooran hundinuus, qaanii fi salphina haa uffatan.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who rejoice at my calamity. Let them be clothed with shame and dishonor who magnify themselves against me.

kikuyu: Warri qajeelumma koo jaallatan, sagalee guddaadhaan haa ililchan; haa gammadanis. Isaan yeroo hunda, “Waaqayyo inni nagaa garbicha isaatti gammadu guddaa dha” haa jedhan.
english: Let those who favor my righteous cause shout for joy and be glad. Yes, let them say continually, “May the LORD be magnified, who has pleasure in the prosperity of his servant!”

kikuyu: Arrabni koo qajeelummaa kee, guyyaa guutuus galata kee odeessa.
english: My tongue shall talk about your righteousness and about your praise all day long.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit Garbicha Waaqayyoo. Ani waaʼee cubbamootaa, ergaa Waaqa bira dhufe garaa koo keessaa qaba: Waaqa sodaachuun ija isaanii dura hin jiru.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David, the servant of the LORD. A revelation is within my heart about the disobedience of the wicked: There is no fear of God before his eyes.

kikuyu: Akka cubbuun isaanii ifatti baʼee hin jibbamneefis, isaan ijuma ofii isaanii duratti akka malee of saadu.
english: For he flatters himself in his own eyes, too much to detect and hate his sin.

kikuyu: Dubbiin afaan isaanii jalʼinaa fi gowwoomsaa dha; isaan ogummaadhaan hojjechuu fi waan gaarii gochuu dhiisaniiru.
english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit. He has ceased to be wise and to do good.

kikuyu: Siree isaanii irratti iyyuu isaan hammina xaxu; karaa cubbuutti of kennu; waan hamaas hin lagatan.
english: He plots iniquity on his bed. He sets himself in a way that is not good. He doesn’t abhor evil.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, araarri kee samiiwwan bira, amanamummaan kees duumessa bira gaʼa.
english: Your loving kindness, LORD, is in the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

kikuyu: Qajeelummaan kee akka tulluuwwan gurguddaa ti; murtiin kees akkuma tuujuba guddaa ti. Yaa Waaqayyo, ati namaa fi bineensa ni jiraachifta.
english: Your righteousness is like the mountains of God. Your judgments are like a great deep. LORD, you preserve man and animal.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, jaalalli kee inni hin geeddaramne sun akkam ulfina qabeessa! Ilmaan namootaa, gaaddisa qoochoo keetii jalatti kooluu galu.
english: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.

kikuyu: Isaan badhaadhummaa mana keetii nyaatanii quufu; atis laga gammachuu keetii irraa isaan obaafta.
english: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your pleasures.

kikuyu: Burqaan jireenyaa si bira jiraatii; nu ifa keetiin ifa argina.
english: For with you is the spring of life. In your light we will see light.

kikuyu: Jaalala kee warra si beekaniif, qajeelummaa kees gara toleeyyiidhaaf ittuma fufi.
english: Oh continue your loving kindness to those who know you, your righteousness to the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Miilli of tuultotaa natti hin dhufin; harki hamootaas dhiibee na hin fageessin.
english: Don’t let the foot of pride come against me. Don’t let the hand of the wicked drive me away.

kikuyu: Warri waan hamaa hojjetan kunoo kufanii diriiraniiru; gad darbatamaniiru; kaʼuus hin dandaʼan!
english: There the workers of iniquity are fallen. They are thrust down, and shall not be able to rise.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Ati sababii namoota hamootiif jettee hin aarin yookaan warra jalʼina hojjetanitti hin hinaafin.
english: By David. Don’t fret because of evildoers, neither be envious against those who work unrighteousness.

kikuyu: Isaan akkuma margaa dafanii coollagu; akkuma biqiltuu misee dafanii gogu.
english: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither like the green herb.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon amanadhu; waan gaariis hojjedhu; biyyattii keessa jiraadhu; nagaas qabaadhu.
english: Trust in the LORD, and do good. Dwell in the land, and enjoy safe pasture.

kikuyu: Waaqayyotti gammadi; innis hawwii garaa keetii siif guuta.
english: Also delight yourself in the LORD, and he will give you the desires of your heart.

kikuyu: Karaa kee Waaqayyotti kennadhu; isa amanadhu; inni siif milkeessa.
english: Commit your way to the LORD. Trust also in him, and he will do this:

kikuyu: Inni qajeelummaa kee akka aduu ganamaatti, murtii kee immoo akka aduu saafaatti ibsa.
english: he will make your righteousness shine out like light, and your justice as the noon day sun.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo duratti calʼisi; obsaanis isa eeggadhu; nama karaan isaa qajeeleefitti, kan hammina hojjetuttis hin hinaafin.
english: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him. Don’t fret because of him who prospers in his way, because of the man who makes wicked plots happen.

kikuyu: Aarii irraa of eegi; dheekkamsa irraas deebiʼi; hin aarin; aariin hammina qofatti nama geessaatii.
english: Cease from anger, and forsake wrath. Don’t fret; it leads only to evildoing.

kikuyu: Namoonni hamoon ni balleeffamuutii; warri Waaqayyoon abdatan garuu lafa dhaalu.
english: For evildoers shall be cut off, but those who wait for the LORD shall inherit the land.

kikuyu: Namoonni hamoon yeroo xinnoodhaaf malee siʼachi hin jiraatan; yoo ati isaan barbaadde illee hin argaman.
english: For yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more. Yes, though you look for his place, he isn’t there.

kikuyu: Garraamonni garuu lafa ni dhaalu; nagaa guddaadhaanis ni gammadu.
english: But the humble shall inherit the land, and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

kikuyu: Namoonni hamoon nama qajeelaatti mariʼatu; ilkaan isaaniis isatti qaratu;
english: The wicked plots against the just, and gnashes at him with his teeth.

kikuyu: Gooftaan hamootatti ni kolfa; inni akka guyyaan isaanii dhiʼaate ni beekaatii.
english: The Lord will laugh at him, for he sees that his day is coming.

kikuyu: Namoonni hamoon hiyyeeyyii fi rakkattoota lafaan dhaʼuudhaaf, warra karaan isaanii qajeelaa taʼe immoo gorraʼuudhaaf, goraadee isaanii luqqifatu; iddaa isaaniis ni dabsatu.
english: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, to kill those who are upright on the path.

kikuyu: Goraadeen isaanii garuu garaadhuma isaanii waraana; iddaan isaaniis ni caccaba.
english: Their sword shall enter into their own heart. Their bows shall be broken.

kikuyu: Badhaadhummaa hamoonni baayʼeen qaban irra, waan xinnoo namni qajeelaan qabu wayya;
english: Better is a little that the righteous has, than the abundance of many wicked.

kikuyu: humni hamootaa ni cabaatii; Waaqayyo garuu qajeeltota jabeessee ni dhaaba.
english: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo bara tolootaa ni beeka; dhaalli isaaniis bara baraan jiraata.
english: The LORD knows the days of the perfect. Their inheritance shall be forever.

kikuyu: Isaan bara hamaa keessa hin qaanaʼan; bara beelaa keessas ni quufu.
english: They shall not be disappointed in the time of evil. In the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

kikuyu: Namoonni hamoon garuu ni barbadaaʼu; diinonni Waaqayyoos akkuma miidhagina daraaraa dirree ti; isaan ni badu; akkuma aaraa ni badu.
english: But the wicked shall perish. The enemies of the LORD shall be like the beauty of the fields. They will vanish— vanish like smoke.

kikuyu: Namoonni hamoon ni liqeeffatu; garuu deebisanii of irraa hin baasan; qajeeltonni garuu arjummaadhaan kennu;
english: The wicked borrow, and don’t pay back, but the righteous give generously.

kikuyu: warri Waaqayyo eebbisu lafa ni dhaalu; warri inni abaaru garuu ni balleeffamu.
english: For such as are blessed by him shall inherit the land. Those who are cursed by him shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Adeemsi nama Waaqayyo biraa ajajama; inni karaa namicha sanaatti ni gammada.
english: A man’s steps are established by the LORD. He delights in his way.

kikuyu: Inni yoo gufate illee lafa hin gaʼu; Waaqayyo harka isaatiin qabee isa dhaabaatii.
english: Though he stumble, he shall not fall, for the LORD holds him up with his hand.

kikuyu: Ani dargaggeessan ture; amma immoo dulloomeera; garuu qajeeltonni gatamuu isaanii yookaan ijoolleen isaaniis buddeena kadhachuu isaanii hin argine.
english: I have been young, and now am old, yet I have not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his children begging for bread.

kikuyu: Qajeeltonni yeroo hundumaa ni arjoomu; ni liqeessus; ijoolleen isaaniis ni eebbifamu.
english: All day long he deals graciously, and lends. His offspring is blessed.

kikuyu: Waan hamaa irraa deebiʼiitii waan gaarii hojjedhu; yoos ati bara baraan ni jiraatta.
english: Depart from evil, and do good. Live securely forever.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo murtii qajeelaa jaallataatii; warra isaaf amanamanis hin gatu. Isaanis bara baraan ni eegamu; sanyiin hamootaa garuu ni balleeffama.
english: For the LORD loves justice, and doesn’t forsake his saints. They are preserved forever, but the children of the wicked shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Qajeeltonni lafa ni dhaalu; bara baraanis ishee irra ni jiraatu.
english: The righteous shall inherit the land, and live in it forever.

kikuyu: Afaan nama qajeelaa ogummaa dubbata; arrabni isaas murtii qajeelaa labsa.
english: The mouth of the righteous talks of wisdom. His tongue speaks justice.

kikuyu: Seerri Waaqa isaa garaa isaa keessa jira; miilli isaas hin mucucaatu.
english: The law of his God is in his heart. None of his steps shall slide.

kikuyu: Namoonni hamoon qajeeltota gaadu; isaan ajjeesuus ni barbaadu;
english: The wicked watch the righteous, and seek to kill him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu harka isaaniitti jara hin dhiisu yookaan yommuu isaan murtiitti dhiʼeeffamanitti, akka isaanitti murteeffamu hin eeyyamu.
english: The LORD will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon eeggadhu; karaa isaas eegi. Inni akka ati lafa dhaaltuuf ulfina siif kenna; atis badiisa hamootaa ni argita.
english: Wait for the LORD, and keep his way, and he will exalt you to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you shall see it.

kikuyu: Nama hamaa fi gara jabeessa, isaa akkuma muka iddoon isaa itti tolee jiru nan arge.
english: I have seen the wicked in great power, spreading himself like a green tree in its native soil.

kikuyu: Ergasiis achiin nan darbe; inni garuu achi hin turre; ani cimsee isa nan barbaade; inni garuu hin argamne.
english: But he passed away, and behold, he was not. Yes, I sought him, but he could not be found.

kikuyu: Nama mudaa hin qabne yaadatti qabadhu; tolootas ilaali; sanyiin nama nagaa hin baduutii.
english: Mark the perfect man, and see the upright, for there is a future for the man of peace.

kikuyu: Cubbamoonni hundinuu garuu ni barbadeeffamu; galgalli nama hamaas hin tolu.
english: As for transgressors, they shall be destroyed together. The future of the wicked shall be cut off.

kikuyu: Fayyinni qajeeltotaa Waaqayyo biraa dhufa; inni yeroo rakkinaatti daʼoo isaanii ti.
english: But the salvation of the righteous is from the LORD. He is their stronghold in the time of trouble.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo isaan gargaara; isaan oolchas; harka namoota hamoo jalaa isaan baasa; isaan baraaras; isaan isatti kooluu galaniiruutii.
english: The LORD helps them and rescues them. He rescues them from the wicked and saves them, because they have taken refuge in him.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaadannoodhaaf. Yaa Waaqayyo, aarii keetiin na hin ifatin yookaan dheekkamsa keetiin na hin adabin.
english: A Psalm by David, for a memorial. LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

kikuyu: Xiyyooliin kee na waraananiiru; harki kees akka malee natti ulfaateera.
english: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

kikuyu: Sababii dheekkamsa keetiitiif dhagni koo fayyaa dhabeera; sababii cubbuu kootiifis lafeen koo nagaa dhabeera.
english: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

kikuyu: Cubbuun koo na liqimseeraatii; akkuma baʼaa baatamuu hin dandaʼamne tokkoottis natti ulfaateera.
english: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

kikuyu: Sababii gowwummaa kootiitiif, madaan koo malaa naqate; ni ajaaʼes.
english: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

kikuyu: Ani gad nan qabame; gadis nan cabe; guyyaa guutuus gaddaan oola.
english: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

kikuyu: Dugdi koo na bobaʼa; dhagni koos fayyaa hin qabu.
english: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

kikuyu: Ani laafeera; akka malees bututeera; garaan koo dhiphatee ani aadaan jira.
english: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, hawwiin koo hundinuu fuula kee duratti beekamaa dha; argansuun koo si duraa hin dhokatu.
english: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

kikuyu: Lapheen koo ni dhaʼatti; jilbis na laafeera; ifni ija kootiis badeera.
english: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

kikuyu: Michoonni koo fi miiltoon koo sababii madaa kootiitiif narraa hiiqan; firoonni koos narraa fagaatanii dhadhaabatu.
english: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

kikuyu: Warri lubbuu koo galaafachuu barbaadan kiyyoo naa kaaʼaniiru; warri na miidhuu barbaadanis waaʼee badiisa kootii dubbatu; guyyaa guutuus hammina natti yaadu.
english: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

kikuyu: Ani garuu akkuma duudaa dhagaʼuu hin dandeenyee, akkuma arrab-didaa dubbachuu hin dandeenyeetii.
english: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

kikuyu: Ani akka nama dhagaʼuu hin dandeenyee, akkuma nama afaan isaa deebii kennuu hin dandeenyees taʼeera.
english: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani sin eeggadha; yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa ko, ati deebii naa kennita.
english: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.

kikuyu: Ani, “Akka diinonni koo natti gammadan yookaan akka isaan yeroo miilli koo mucucaatutti natti of jajan hin eeyyamin” jedheeraatii.
english: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

kikuyu: Ani kufuu gaʼeeraatii; dhukkubbiin koos takkumaa na hin dhiifne.
english: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

kikuyu: Ani balleessaa koo nan himadha; sababii cubbuu kootiitiifis nan gadda.
english: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

kikuyu: Warri akkasumaan diinota koo taʼan jajjaboo dha; warri sababii malee na jibbanis hedduu dha.
english: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

kikuyu: Warri qooda waan gaarii waan hamaa naa deebisan diinota koo ti; ani waan gaarii duukaa nan buʼaatii.
english: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati na hin gatin; yaa Waaqa ko, narraa hin fagaatin.
english: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, yaa fayyisaa ko, na gargaaruudhaaf ariifadhu!
english: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeduutuuniif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Ani akkana nan jedhe; “Ani karaa koo nan eeggadha; arraba koos cubbuu irraa nan ittisa; hamma namni hamaan na bira jiruttis, afaan kootti luugama nan kaaʼadha.”
english: For the Chief Musician. For Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. I said, “I will watch my ways, so that I don’t sin with my tongue. I will keep my mouth with a bridle while the wicked is before me.”

kikuyu: Ani calʼisee akkuma duudaa nan taʼe; waan gaarii dubbachuu irraas of nan qusadhe; dhiphinni koo garuu ittuma caale;
english: I was mute with silence. I held my peace, even from good. My sorrow was stirred.

kikuyu: onneen koo na keessatti bulluqaa deeme; yeroo ani irra deddeebiʼee yaadettis ibiddi sun ni bobaʼe; anis arraba kootiin akkana jedheen dubbadhe:
english: My heart was hot within me. While I meditated, the fire burned. I spoke with my tongue:

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati dhuma jireenya kootii na argisiisi; dheerina umurii kootiis na barsiisi; jireenyi koo akkam dafee akka darbus na beeksisi.
english: “LORD, show me my end, what is the measure of my days. Let me know how frail I am.

kikuyu: Kunoo, ati bara koo taakkuu tokkittii gooteerta; umuriin koos fuula kee duratti homaattuu hin hedamu; jireenyi nama hundumaas akkuma qilleensa shuf jedhee darbuu ti.
english: Behold, you have made my days hand widths. My lifetime is as nothing before you. Surely every man stands as a breath.” Selah.

kikuyu: Dhuguma iyyuu namni akkuma gaaddidduu deddeebiʼa; dhugumaan inni akkasumaan goolama; namni qabeenya ni kuusa; garuu eenyuuf akka walitti qabu hin beeku.
english: “Surely every man walks like a shadow. Surely they busy themselves in vain. He heaps up, and doesn’t know who shall gather.

kikuyu: “Egaa amma yaa Gooftaa, ani maalin eeggadha? Abdiin koo suma irra jira.
english: Now, Lord, what do I wait for? My hope is in you.

kikuyu: Dogoggora koo hunda irraa na oolchi; nama gowwoonni itti kolfan na hin godhin.
english: Deliver me from all my transgressions. Don’t make me the reproach of the foolish.

kikuyu: Ani duudaa dha; afaan koos hin saaqqadhu; kan waan kana godhe sumaatii.
english: I was mute. I didn’t open my mouth, because you did it.

kikuyu: Ani rukuttaa harka keetiitiin dhumeeraatii; dhaʼicha kee narraa fuudhi.
english: Remove your scourge away from me. I am overcome by the blow of your hand.

kikuyu: Ati sababii cubbuu isaaniitiif namoota ifatta; ni adabdas; akkuma biliis qabeenya isaanii ni balleessita; dhugumaan namni hundinuu qilleensuma shuf jedhee darbuu dha.
english: When you rebuke and correct man for iniquity, you consume his wealth like a moth. Surely every man is but a breath.” Selah.

kikuyu: “Yaa Waaqayyo, kadhannaa koo naa dhagaʼi; iyya ani gargaarsa barbaachaaf iyyus dhaggeeffadhu; booʼicha koos calʼistee hin ilaalin. Ani akka alagaatti si bira nan jiraadhaatii; akkuma abbootii koo hundumaattis ani nama biyya ormaa ti.
english: “Hear my prayer, LORD, and give ear to my cry. Don’t be silent at my tears. For I am a stranger with you, a foreigner, as all my fathers were.

kikuyu: Utuun godaanee lafa irraa hin dhabamin dura akkan deebiʼee gammaduuf, ija kee narraa deebifadhu.”
english: Oh spare me, that I may recover strength, before I go away and exist no more.”

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Ani obsaan Waaqayyoon nan eeggadhe; innis gara kootti garagalee iyya koo naa dhagaʼe.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. I waited patiently for the LORD. He turned to me, and heard my cry.

kikuyu: Inni boolla sodaachisaa keessaa, dhoqqee nama liqimsu keessaas na baase; miilla koo kattaa irra dhaabe; ejjeta koos naa jabeesse.
english: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place to stand.

kikuyu: Innis faarfannaa haaraa, faarfannaa galataas afaan koo keessa Waaqa keenyaaf kaaʼe. Namoonni baayʼeen arganii Waaqayyo sodaatu; isas ni amanatu.
english: He has put a new song in my mouth, even praise to our God. Many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the LORD.

kikuyu: Namni Waaqayyoon abdatu, kan gara of tuultotaa hin ilaalle, namni warra karaa irraa jalʼatanii waaqota sobaa duukaa buʼinitti hin gara galle eebbifamaa dha.
english: Blessed is the man who makes the LORD his trust, and doesn’t respect the proud, nor such as turn away to lies.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa ko, dinqiin ati hojjette baayʼee dha; waan ati nuuf yaadde, namni tokko tokkoon sitti himuu dandaʼu tokko iyyuu hin jiru; yoo ani waaʼee isaanii labsee dubbadhe illee, baayʼinni isaanii hamma hin qabu.
english: Many, LORD, my God, are the wonderful works which you have done, and your thoughts which are toward us. They can’t be declared back to you. If I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be counted.

kikuyu: Ati aarsaa fi kennaa hin feene; gurra koo garuu naa banteerta; aarsaa gubamuu fi aarsaa cubbuu ati hin barbaanne.
english: Sacrifice and offering you didn’t desire. You have opened my ears. You have not required burnt offering and sin offering.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana ani akkana nan jedhe; “Ani kunoo ti; ani dhufeera; waaʼeen koo kitaaba maramaa keessatti barreeffameera.
english: Then I said, “Behold, I have come. It is written about me in the book in the scroll.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa ko, ani fedhii kee raawwachuutti nan gammada; seerri kee garaa koo keessa jira.”
english: I delight to do your will, my God. Yes, your law is within my heart.”

kikuyu: Ani yaaʼii guddaa keessatti qajeelummaa nan labsa; Yaa Waaqayyo, akkuma ati beektu, ani afaan koo hin qabadhu.
english: I have proclaimed glad news of righteousness in the great assembly. Behold, I will not seal my lips, LORD, you know.

kikuyu: Ani qajeelummaa kee garaa koo keessa hin dhoksu; waaʼee amanamummaa keetiitii fi waaʼee fayyisuu keetii nan odeessa; jaalala keetii fi dhugaa kees yaaʼii guddaa duraa hin dhoksu.
english: I have not hidden your righteousness within my heart. I have declared your faithfulness and your salvation. I have not concealed your loving kindness and your truth from the great assembly.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo araara kee na hin dhowwatin; jaalalli keetii fi dhugaan kee yeroo hunda ana haa eegan.
english: Don’t withhold your tender mercies from me, LORD. Let your loving kindness and your truth continually preserve me.

kikuyu: Rakkinni hamma hin qabne na marseeraatii; cubbuun koos na liqimseera; arguus dadhabeera; cubbuun koo rifeensa mataa koo caalaa baayʼata; onneen koos na keessatti laafteerti.
english: For innumerable evils have surrounded me. My iniquities have overtaken me, so that I am not able to look up. They are more than the hairs of my head. My heart has failed me.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, na fayyisuutti gammadi; yaa Waaqayyo, na gargaaruudhaaf dafii kottu.
english: Be pleased, LORD, to deliver me. Hurry to help me, LORD.

kikuyu: Warri lubbuu koo galaafachuu barbaadan hundinuu, haa qaanaʼan; haa burjaajaʼanis. Warri badii koo hawwan hundi, qaanaʼanii duubatti haa deebiʼan.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and brought to dishonor who delight in my hurt.

kikuyu: Warri, “Baga! Baga!” anaan jedhan, qaanii isaaniitiin haa rifatan.
english: Let them be desolate by reason of their shame that tell me, “Aha! Aha!”

kikuyu: Warri si barbaadan hundinuu garuu sitti gammadanii haa ililchan. Warri fayyisuu kee jaallatan yeroo hunda, “Waaqayyo guddaa dha!” haa jedhan.
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let such as love your salvation say continually, “Let the LORD be exalted!”

kikuyu: Ani garuu hiyyeessaa fi rakkataa dha; taʼus Gooftaan naaf yaada. Ati gargaarsa koo fi fayyisaa koo ti; yaa Waaqa ko, hin turin.
english: But I am poor and needy. May the Lord think about me. You are my help and my deliverer. Don’t delay, my God.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Namni hiyyeessaaf yaadu eebbifamaa dha; guyyaa rakkinaatti Waaqayyo isa ni oolcha.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Blessed is he who considers the poor. The LORD will deliver him in the day of evil.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo isa ni eega; bara jireenya isaas ni dheeressa; lafa irratti isa eebbisa; hawwii diinota isaattis dabarsee isa hin kennu.
english: The LORD will preserve him, and keep him alive. He shall be blessed on the earth, and he will not surrender him to the will of his enemies.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo siree inni dhukkubsatee irra ciisu irratti isa kunuunsa; fayyisees siree dhukkubaa irraa isa ni kaasa.
english: The LORD will sustain him on his sickbed, and restore him from his bed of illness.

kikuyu: Anis, “Yaa Waaqayyo na maari; ani cubbuu sitti hojjedheeraatii na fayyisi” nan jedhe.
english: I said, “LORD, have mercy on me! Heal me, for I have sinned against you.”

kikuyu: Diinonni koo hamminaan, “Inni yoom duʼee maqaan isaa lafa irraa bada?” jedhanii waaʼee koo dubbatu.
english: My enemies speak evil against me: “When will he die, and his name perish?”

kikuyu: Namni tokko yeroo na gaafachuu dhufutti, utuma garaa isaatti hammina kuufatee qabuu, sobee dubbata; gad baʼees iddoo hundumatti odeessa.
english: If he comes to see me, he speaks falsehood. His heart gathers iniquity to itself. When he goes abroad, he tells it.

kikuyu: Warri na jibban hundinuu waaʼee koo walitti hasaasu; waan akka malee hamaa taʼes natti mariʼatu.
english: All who hate me whisper together against me. They imagine the worst for me.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Dhukkubni hamaan isa qabateera; inni siʼachi iddoo ciisu sanaa hin kaʼu” jedhu.
english: “An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”

kikuyu: Michuun koo inni natti dhiʼaatu, inni ani amanadhe, inni buddeena koo nyaate koomee isaa natti ol fudhate.
english: Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.

kikuyu: Ati garuu yaa Waaqayyo na baasi; akka ani haaloo baafadhuufis ol na kaasi.
english: But you, LORD, have mercy on me, and raise me up, that I may repay them.

kikuyu: Akka ati natti gammaddu ani beeka; diinni koo narra hin aanuutii.
english: By this I know that you delight in me, because my enemy doesn’t triumph over me.

kikuyu: Ati sababii amanamummaa kootiitiif utubdee na qabda; baruma baraanis fuula kee dura na dhaabda.
english: As for me, you uphold me in my integrity, and set me in your presence forever.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni Israaʼel, bara baraa hamma bara baraatti haa eebbifamu.
english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting and to everlasting! Amen and amen.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Maskiilii Ilmaan Qooraahi. Akkuma gadamsi bishaan yaaʼutti gaggabu sana, yaa Waaqa ko, lubbuun koo sitti gaggabdi.
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for the water brooks, so my soul pants after you, God.

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo Waaqayyoon Waaqa jiraataa dheebotti. Ani yoomin dhaqee fuula Waaqaa arga?
english: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?

kikuyu: Imimmaan koo halkanii guyyaa soora naa taʼeera; namoonni guyyaa guutuu “Waaqni kee eessa jira?” anaan jedhuutii.
english: My tears have been my food day and night, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

kikuyu: Ani yommuun waan kana yaadadhutti, lubbuu koo of keessatti nan dhangalaasa: ilillee fi faarfannaa galataatiin tuuta ayyaana ayyaaneffatu tokko, hiriiraan gara mana Waaqaatti geggeessaa tuuticha wajjin akkamitti akka ani deemaa ture yaadadha.
english: These things I remember, and pour out my soul within me, how I used to go with the crowd, and led them to God’s house, with the voice of joy and praise, a multitude keeping a holy day.

kikuyu: Yaa lubbuu ko, ati maaliif gaddita? Na keessattis maaliif raafamta? Abdii kee Waaqa irra keeyyadhu; ani amma iyyuu isa nan jajadha. Fayyisaa koo fi Waaqa koo nan jajadha.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him for the saving help of his presence.

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo na keessatti gadditeerti; kanaafuu ani biyya Yordaanos irraa, fiixee Hermoonii fi Gaara Miizaarii irraa si yaadadha.
english: My God, my soul is in despair within me. Therefore I remember you from the land of the Jordan, the heights of Hermon, from the hill Mizar.

kikuyu: Huursaa fincaaʼaa keetiitiin, tuujubni tuujuba waama; dambalii fi dhaʼaan kee hundinuu, narra yaaʼan.
english: Deep calls to deep at the noise of your waterfalls. All your waves and your billows have swept over me.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo guyyaadhaan jaalala isaa kan hin geeddaramne ni ajaja; halkan immoo faarfannaan isaa na wajjin jira; kunis kadhannaa ani Waaqa jireenya kootii kadhadhuu dha.
english: The LORD will command his loving kindness in the daytime. In the night his song shall be with me: a prayer to the God of my life.

kikuyu: Anis Waaqa Kattaa kootiin akkana nan jedha; “Ati maaliif na dagatte? Maaliif ani diinaan cunqurfamee gaddaan jiraadha?”
english: I will ask God, my rock, “Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?”

kikuyu: Amajaajonni koo guyyaa guutuu, “Waaqni kee eessa jira?” jedhanii natti qoosudhaan, akkuma goraadee lafee koo keessaatti na dhiphisu.
english: As with a sword in my bones, my adversaries reproach me, while they continually ask me, “Where is your God?”

kikuyu: Yaa lubbuu ko, ati maaliif gaddita? Na keessattis maaliif raafamta? Abdii kee Waaqa irra kaaʼadhu; ani amma iyyuu isa nan galateeffadha; Fayyisaa koo fi Waaqa koo nan jajadha.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him, the saving help of my countenance, and my God.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, naa murteessi; saba hin amanametti dubbii koo naa falmi; gowwoomsitootaa fi jalʼoota jalaas na baasi.
english: Vindicate me, God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation. Oh, deliver me from deceitful and wicked men.

kikuyu: Ati Waaqa jabina kootii ti. Maaliif na gatte? Ani maaliifin diinaan cunqurfamee gaddaan jiraadha?
english: For you are the God of my strength. Why have you rejected me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

kikuyu: Ifa keetii fi dhugaa kee ergi; isaan na haa qajeelchan; gara tulluu kee qulqulluutti, gara iddoo ati jiraattu sanaatti ana haa fiddan.
english: Oh, send out your light and your truth. Let them lead me. Let them bring me to your holy hill, to your tents.

kikuyu: Yoos ani gara iddoo aarsaa Waaqaa, gara Waaqa gammachuu fi ilillee koo nan dhaqa. Yaa Waaqayyo, Waaqa ko, ani baganaadhaan sin galateeffadha.
english: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.

kikuyu: Yaa lubbuu ko, ati maaliif gaddita? Na keessattis maaliif raafamta? Abdii kee Waaqa irra kaaʼadhu; ani amma iyyuu isa nan galateeffadha; Fayyisaa koo fi Waaqa koo nan jajadha.
english: Why are you in despair, my soul? Why are you disturbed within me? Hope in God! For I shall still praise him: my Savior, my helper, and my God.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Maskiilii Ilmaan Qooraahi. Yaa Waaqi, waan ati bara durii, jabana isaanii keessa hojjette sana, abbootiin keenya nutti himaniiru; nuus gurra keenyaan dhageenyeerra.
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. A contemplative psalm. We have heard with our ears, God; our fathers have told us what work you did in their days, in the days of old.

kikuyu: Ati harka keetiin saboota ariitee baafte; abbootii keenya immoo ni dhaabde; namoota ni balleessite; abbootii keenya garuu bilisa baafte.
english: You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.

kikuyu: Harka kee mirgaatiin, irree keetii fi ifa fuula keetiitiin dhaalan malee isaan goraadee isaaniitiin lafa sana hin dhaalle; yookaan irreen isaanii moʼannoo isaaniif hin fidne; ati isaan jaallatteertaatii.
english: For they didn’t get the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them; but your right hand, your arm, and the light of your face, because you were favorable to them.

kikuyu: Ati Mootii koo fi Waaqa koo kan Yaaqoobiif moʼicha ajajjuu dha.
english: God, you are my King. Command victories for Jacob!

kikuyu: Nu siin diinota keenya duubatti deebifna; maqaa keetiinis amajaajota keenya gad dhidhiinna.
english: Through you, we will push down our adversaries. Through your name, we will tread down those who rise up against us.

kikuyu: Ani iddaa koo hin amanadhu; goraadeen koos moʼannaa naa hin fidu;
english: For I will not trust in my bow, neither will my sword save me.

kikuyu: ati garuu diinota keenya jalaa nu oolchita; warra nu jibban immoo ni qaanessita.
english: But you have saved us from our adversaries, and have shamed those who hate us.

kikuyu: Nu yeroo hundumaa Waaqaan dhaadanna; maqaa kees bara baraan ni galateeffanna.
english: In God we have made our boast all day long. We will give thanks to your name forever. Selah.

kikuyu: Amma garuu ati nu gatteerta; gadis nu deebifteerta; ati loltoota keenya wajjin hin baane.
english: But now you rejected us, and brought us to dishonor, and don’t go out with our armies.

kikuyu: Akka nu diinota keenya baqannu nu gooteerta; warri nu jibbanis nu saamaniiru.
english: You make us turn back from the adversary. Those who hate us take plunder for themselves.

kikuyu: Ati akka hoolota qalamuuf qopheeffamanii nu gooteerta; ormoota keessas nu bittinneessiteerta.
english: You have made us like sheep for food, and have scattered us among the nations.

kikuyu: Saba kee gatii xinnaatti gurgurteerta; gurgurtaa isaanii irraas buʼaa hin arganne.
english: You sell your people for nothing, and have gained nothing from their sale.

kikuyu: Ollaa keenya duratti nama kolfaa, warra naannoo keenyaa birattis waan qoosaatii fi nama tuffii nu gooteerta.
english: You make us a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and a derision to those who are around us.

kikuyu: Ormoota keessatti waan mammaaksaa nu goote; namoonnis mataa nutti raasan.
english: You make us a byword among the nations, a shaking of the head among the peoples.

kikuyu: Salphinni koo guyyaa guutuu fuula koo dura jira; fuulli koos qaaniidhaan haguugameera.
english: All day long my dishonor is before me, and shame covers my face,

kikuyu: Kunis sababii dubbii warra na tuffataniitii fi warra na arrabsaniitiif, sababii diinaatii fi sababii nama haaloo baafatuutiif taʼe.
english: at the taunt of one who reproaches and verbally abuses, because of the enemy and the avenger.

kikuyu: Kun hundi nutti dhufeera; taʼus nu si hin daganne; yookaan kakuu kee keessatti amanamummaa hin dhabne.
english: All this has come on us, yet we haven’t forgotten you. We haven’t been false to your covenant.

kikuyu: Garaan keenya dugda duubatti hin deebine; tarkaanfiin keenyas karaa kee irraa hin jalʼanne.
english: Our heart has not turned back, neither have our steps strayed from your path,

kikuyu: Ati garuu iddoo waangoonni jiraatanitti nu caccabsite; dukkana hamaadhaan nu haguugde.
english: though you have crushed us in the haunt of jackals, and covered us with the shadow of death.

kikuyu: Utuu nu maqaa Waaqa keenyaa irraanfannee, yookaan utuu harka keenya gara waaqa ormaatti balʼifannee jiraannee,
english: If we have forgotten the name of our God, or spread out our hands to a strange god,

kikuyu: silaa Waaqni waan kana bira hin gaʼu turee? Inni icciitii garaa namaa beekaatii.
english: won’t God search this out? For he knows the secrets of the heart.

kikuyu: Nu siif jennee guyyaa guutuu ni ajjeefamna; akka hoolota qalamuuf jiraniittis lakkaaʼamneerra.
english: Yes, for your sake we are killed all day long. We are regarded as sheep for the slaughter.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa dammaqi! Ati maaliif rafta? Kaʼi! Bara baraanis nu hin gatin.
english: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.

kikuyu: Ati maaliif fuula kee dhokfatta? Maaliifis dhiphinaa fi hacuucamuu keenya irraanfatta?
english: Why do you hide your face, and forget our affliction and our oppression?

kikuyu: Lubbuun keenya biyyootti dabalamteertii; garaan keenyas lafatti maxxaneera.
english: For our soul is bowed down to the dust. Our body clings to the earth.

kikuyu: Kaʼiitii nu gargaar; sababii jaalala kee kan hin geeddaramneetiifis nu furi.
english: Rise up to help us. Redeem us for your loving kindness’ sake.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo ilmaan Qooraahi kan “Daraaraa” jedhamu. Maskiil. Faarfannaa cidhaa. Yommuu ani mootiidhaaf faarfadhutti, yaadni gaariin garaa koo guutee irra dhangalaʼa; arrabni koos akkuma biirii barreessaa ogeessa tokkoo ti.
english: For the Chief Musician. Set to “The Lilies.” A contemplation by the sons of Korah. A wedding song. My heart overflows with a noble theme. I recite my verses for the king. My tongue is like the pen of a skillful writer.

kikuyu: Ati nama hundumaa caalaa miidhagaa dha; hidhii kee irra surraatu dhangalaʼa; kanaafuu Waaqni bara baraan si eebbiseera.
english: You are the most excellent of the sons of men. Grace has anointed your lips, therefore God has blessed you forever.

kikuyu: Yaa gooticha, goraadee kee luqqeettuutti hidhadhu; ulfinaa fi surraa uffadhu.
english: Strap your sword on your thigh, O mighty one, in your splendor and your majesty.

kikuyu: Sababii dubbii dhugaatiif, gad of qabiisaa fi qajeelummaatiif, miidhagina keetiin moʼannaadhaan fuula duratti gulufi; harki kee mirgaas hojii sodaachisaa haa hojjetu.
english: In your majesty ride on victoriously on behalf of truth, humility, and righteousness. Let your right hand display awesome deeds.

kikuyu: Xiyyawwan kee qara qabeeyyiin sun onnee diinota mootii haa waraanan; saboonnis miilla kee jalatti haa jijjiganii.
english: Your arrows are sharp. The nations fall under you, with arrows in the heart of the king’s enemies.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, teessoon kee bara baraa hamma bara baraatti ni jiraata; bokkuun qajeelummaas bokkuu mootummaa keetii ni taʼa.
english: Your throne, God, is forever and ever. A scepter of equity is the scepter of your kingdom.

kikuyu: Ati qajeelummaa jaallatta; jalʼina immoo ni jibbita; kanaafuu Waaqayyo, Waaqni kee hiriyoota kee caalaatti, zayitiidhaan gammachuu si dibeera.
english: You have loved righteousness, and hated wickedness. Therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.

kikuyu: Uffanni kee hundinuu qumbiidhaan, argeessaa fi qundhiidhaan ni urgaaʼa; masaraawwan ilka arbaatiin miidhagfaman keessattis muuziiqaan miʼa ribuu si gammachiisa.
english: All your garments smell like myrrh, aloes, and cassia. Out of ivory palaces stringed instruments have made you glad.

kikuyu: Intallan moototaa dubartoota kee warra kabajamoo keessa jiru; mootittiinis warqee Oofiiriitiin miidhagfamtee karaa harka mirga keetii dhaabatti.
english: Kings’ daughters are among your honorable women. At your right hand the queen stands in gold of Ophir.

kikuyu: Yaa intalaa dhagaʼi; hubadhu; gurra kees as qabi; saba keetii fi mana abbaa keetii irraanfadhu.
english: Listen, daughter, consider, and turn your ear. Forget your own people, and also your father’s house.

kikuyu: Mootiin miidhagina kee hawwa; waan inni gooftaa kee taʼeef isa kabaji.
english: So the king will desire your beauty, honor him, for he is your lord.

kikuyu: Intalli Xiiroos kennaa fiddee dhufti; sooreyyiinis garaa si laafifachuu barbaadu.
english: The daughter of Tyre comes with a gift. The rich among the people entreat your favor.

kikuyu: Intalli mootii ulfina guddaadhaan diinqa ishee jirti; uffanni ishees warqeedhaan dhaʼame.
english: The princess inside is all glorious. Her clothing is interwoven with gold.

kikuyu: Isheenis uffata halluu garaa garaa qabu uffattee gara mootiitti geeffamti; durboonni waaʼelli ishees ishee duukaa buʼanii gara keetti fidamu.
english: She shall be led to the king in embroidered work. The virgins, her companions who follow her, shall be brought to you.

kikuyu: Isaanis gammachuu fi ililleedhaan ol galfamu; masaraa mootichaas ni seenu.
english: With gladness and rejoicing they shall be led. They shall enter into the king’s palace.

kikuyu: Ilmaan kee iddoo abbootii keetii buʼan; atis lafa hunda irratti isaan ni moosifta.
english: Your sons will take the place of your fathers. You shall make them princes in all the earth.

kikuyu: Ani akka maqaan kee dhaloota hunda keessatti yaadatamu nan godha; kanaafuu saboonni bara baraa hamma bara baraatti si jajatu.
english: I will make your name to be remembered in all generations. Therefore the peoples shall give you thanks forever and ever.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Ilmaan Qooraahi. Haala Alaamootiitiin. Waaqni daʼoo fi jabina keenya; inni gargaarsa yeroo hunda rakkina keessatti nu wajjin jiruu dha.
english: For the Chief Musician. By the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yoo lafti raafamtee tulluuwwanis garaa galaanaa keessa gadi buʼan iyyuu nu hin sodaannu.
english: Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;

kikuyu: Utuu bishaan isaas huursee hoomachaaʼee tulluuwwanis raafama isaatiin sochoʼan iyyuu nu hin sodaannu.
english: though its waters roar and are troubled, though the mountains tremble with their swelling. Selah.

kikuyu: Lagni yaaʼaan isaa magaalaa Waaqaa gammachiisu kan iddoo qulqulluu Waaqni Waan Hundaa Olii jiraatuuf gammachuu kennu tokko jira.
english: There is a river, the streams of which make the city of God glad, the holy place of the tents of the Most High.

kikuyu: Waaqni magaalattii keessa jira; isheenis hin raafamtu; ganama barii Waaqni ishee gargaara.
english: God is within her. She shall not be moved. God will help her at dawn.

kikuyu: Saboonni ni raafaman; mootummoonnis ni kufan; inni sagalee isaa dhageessise; laftis ni baqxe.
english: The nations raged. The kingdoms were moved. He lifted his voice and the earth melted.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon Waan Hunda Dandaʼu nu wajjin jira; Waaqni Yaaqoob daʼoo keenya.
english: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

kikuyu: Kottaa, hojii Waaqayyoo ilaalaa; badiisa inni lafa irratti fides argaa.
english: Come, see the LORD’s works, what desolations he has made on the earth.

kikuyu: Inni hamma handaara lafaatti waraana ni balleessa; iddaa ni cabsa; eeboo ni burkuteessa; gaachanas ibiddaan guba.
english: He makes wars cease to the end of the earth. He breaks the bow, and shatters the spear. He burns the chariots in the fire.

kikuyu: “Calʼisaa; akka ani Waaqa taʼes beekaa; ani saboota gidduutti ol ol nan jedha; lafa irrattis ol ol nan jedha.”
english: “Be still, and know that I am God. I will be exalted among the nations. I will be exalted on the earth.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon Waan Hunda Dandaʼu nu wajjin jira; Waaqni Yaaqoob daʼoo keenya.
english: The LORD of Armies is with us. The God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Ilmaan Qooraahi. Isin saboonni hundinuu harka keessan rukutaa; sagalee ol fudhadhaatii gammachuudhaan Waaqaaf ililchaa.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii, Mootichi guddaan lafa hundumaa, sodaachisaadhaatii!
english: For the LORD Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.

kikuyu: Inni saboota nu jala, namootas miilla keenya jala galcheera.
english: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.

kikuyu: Innis nu warra Yaaqoob isa inni jaallate sanaaf ulfina taaneef, dhaala keenya nuu fileera.
english: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

kikuyu: Waaqni ililleedhaan, Waaqayyo sagalee malakataatiin ol baʼe.
english: God has gone up with a shout, the LORD with the sound of a trumpet.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa galataa Waaqaaf faarfadhaa; faarfannaa galataa faarfadhaa; faarfannaa galataa Mootii keenyaaf faarfadhaa; faarfannaa galataa faarfadhaa.
english: Sing praises to God! Sing praises! Sing praises to our King! Sing praises!

kikuyu: Waaqni Mootii lafa hundaa ti; faarfannaa galataa hubannaadhaan faarfadhaa.
english: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.

kikuyu: Waaqni saboota irratti Mootii dha; Waaqni teessoo isaa qulqulluu irra taaʼeera.
english: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.

kikuyu: Qondaaltonni sabootaa, akkuma saba Waaqa Abrahaamitti walitti qabamu; mootonni lafa irraa kan Waaqaatii; innis guddisee ol ol jedheera.
english: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!

kikuyu: Weedduu. Faarfannaa Ilmaan Qooraahi. Magaalaa Waaqa keenyaa keessatti, tulluu isaa qulqulluu irrattis, Waaqayyo guddaa dha; waan hundaa olittis galanni isaaf mala.
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised, in the city of our God, in his holy mountain.

kikuyu: Tulluun Xiyoon gara kaabaatti argama; dheerina isaatiinis ni bareeda. Innis gammachuu addunyaa hundaa ti; magaalaa Mooticha Guddaatis.
english: Beautiful in elevation, the joy of the whole earth, is Mount Zion, on the north sides, the city of the great King.

kikuyu: Waaqni daʼannoo ishee keessa jira; inni daʼannoo ishee taʼuu isaa argisiiseera.
english: God has shown himself in her citadels as a refuge.

kikuyu: Mootonni humna walitti daratanii tokkummaadhaan itti qajeelan.
english: For, behold, the kings assembled themselves, they passed by together.

kikuyu: Isaanis ishee arganii dinqifatan; sodaataniis baqatan.
english: They saw it, then they were amazed. They were dismayed. They hurried away.

kikuyu: Achittis akkuma muddama dubartii ciniinsifattuutti, hollannaan isaan qabate.
english: Trembling took hold of them there, pain, as of a woman in travail.

kikuyu: Atis bubbee baʼa biiftuutiin dooniiwwan Tarshiish caccabsite.
english: With the east wind, you break the ships of Tarshish.

kikuyu: Akkuma dhageenye sana, magaalaa Waaqayyoo Waan Hunda Dandaʼuu keessatti, magaalaa Waaqa keenyaa keessatti, akkasuma argineerra; Waaqni bara baraan jabeessee ishee dhaaba.
english: As we have heard, so we have seen, in the city of the LORD of Armies, in the city of our God. God will establish it forever. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, nu mana qulqullummaa kee keessatti, jaalala kee kan hin geeddaramne sana irra deddeebinee yaadna.
english: We have thought about your loving kindness, God, in the middle of your temple.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, galanni kee akkuma maqaa keetii handaara lafaa gaʼa; harki kee mirgaas qajeelummaan guutameera.
english: As is your name, God, so is your praise to the ends of the earth. Your right hand is full of righteousness.

kikuyu: Sababii murtii keetiitiif, Tulluun Xiyoon haa gammaddu; intallan Yihuudaas haa ililchan.
english: Let Mount Zion be glad! Let the daughters of Judah rejoice because of your judgments.

kikuyu: Xiyoon irra naannaʼaa; naannoo ishee irras adeemaa; gamoowwan ishees lakkaaʼaa.
english: Walk about Zion, and go around her. Number its towers.

kikuyu: Dhaloota itti aanutti akka himtaniif, dallaa eegumsa ishee sirriitti hubadhaa; galma ishees ilaalaa.
english: Notice her bulwarks. Consider her palaces, that you may tell it to the next generation.

kikuyu: Waaqni kun bara baraa hamma bara baraatti Waaqa keenyaatii; inni hamma dhumaatti illee nu qajeelcha.
english: For this God is our God forever and ever. He will be our guide even to death.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Ilmaan Qooraahi. Yaa namoota, isin hundi waan kana dhagaʼaa; warri addunyaa kana irra jiraattan hundinuu dhaggeeffadhaa;
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,

kikuyu: xinnaa fi guddaan, sooressii fi hiyyeessi walumaan dhaggeeffadhaa; kunis:
english: both low and high, rich and poor together.

kikuyu: Afaan koo dubbii ogummaa dubbata; wanti ani garaatti yaadus hubannaa kenna.
english: My mouth will speak words of wisdom. My heart will utter understanding.

kikuyu: Gurra koo gara mammaaksaatti nan qabadha; hibboo koos baganaadhaan nan ibsadha.
english: I will incline my ear to a proverb. I will solve my riddle on the harp.

kikuyu: Bara rakkinaa, yeroo gowwoomsitoonni hamoon na marsanitti, ani maaliifan sodaadha?
english: Why should I fear in the days of evil, when iniquity at my heels surrounds me?

kikuyu: Isaan qabeenya isaanii amanatu; guddina sooruma isaaniitiinis boonu.
english: Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—

kikuyu: Namni lubbuu nama gara biraa furu, yookaan gatii furii nama sanaa Waaqaaf baasu tokko iyyuu hin jiru;
english: none of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give God a ransom for him.

kikuyu: furiin lubbuu namaa gatii guddaa qabaatii; gatiin quufsaanis yoom iyyuu hin argamu;
english: For the redemption of their life is costly, no payment is ever enough,

kikuyu: silaa inni bara baraan ni jiraata; hin tortorus ture.
english: that he should live on forever, that he should not see corruption.

kikuyu: Akka ogeeyyiin duʼan namni hundinuu ni arga; gowwoonnii fi raatuwwanis akkasuma ni badu; qabeenya isaaniis warra kaaniif dhiisu.
english: For he sees that wise men die; likewise the fool and the senseless perish, and leave their wealth to others.

kikuyu: Isaan yoo lafa maqaa isaaniitiin waamamtu qabaatan illee, awwaalli isaanii bara baraan mana isaanii, dhalootaa hamma dhalootaattis iddoo boqonnaa isaanii taʼee hafa.
english: Their inward thought is that their houses will endure forever, and their dwelling places to all generations. They name their lands after themselves.

kikuyu: Namni garuu qabeenya qabaatu illee bara dheeraa hin jiraatu; inni akkuma bineensa duʼee baduu ti.
english: But man, despite his riches, doesn’t endure. He is like the animals that perish.

kikuyu: Wanni namoota ofitti amanatanii fi warra isaan duukaa buʼanii dubbii isaanii hoʼisan eeggatu kanuma.
english: This is the destiny of those who are foolish, and of those who approve their sayings. Selah.

kikuyu: Isaan akkuma hoolaa duʼaaf ramadamaniiru; duuti tiksee isaanii ti; toloonni ganamaan isaan irratti aangoo qabaatu; dhagni isaanii mana isaanii irraa fagaatee awwaala keessatti ni tortora; awwaallis mana jireenya isaanii ti.
english: They are appointed as a flock for Sheol. Death shall be their shepherd. The upright shall have dominion over them in the morning. Their beauty shall decay in Sheol, far from their mansion.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu lubbuu koo humna siiʼool jalaa baasa; inni dhugumaan ofitti na fudhata.
english: But God will redeem my soul from the power of Sheol, for he will receive me. Selah.

kikuyu: Yommuu namni tokko sooromu, yommuu ulfinni mana isaas guddatu hin sodaatin.
english: Don’t be afraid when a man is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

kikuyu: Inni yommuu duʼutti waanuma tokko illee fudhatee hin deemuutii; ulfinni isaas isa wajjin hin dhaqu.
english: for when he dies he will carry nothing away. His glory won’t descend after him.

kikuyu: Inni bara jireenya isaa lubbuu isaa eebbisu iyyuu, yoo namoonni yeroo ati waan gaarii ofii keetii godhattutti si jajan illee,
english: Though while he lived he blessed his soul— and men praise you when you do well for yourself—

kikuyu: inni gara dhaloota abbootii isaa, gara warra gonkumaa deebiʼanii ifa jireenyaa hin arginee ni dhaqa.
