english: he shall go to the generation of his fathers. They shall never see the light.

kikuyu: Namni badhaadhaan hubannaa hin qabne, akkuma bineensaa duʼee bada.
english: A man who has riches without understanding, is like the animals that perish.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Asaaf. Waaqayyo, Humna Qabeessi dubbatee baʼa biiftuutii jalqabee hamma lixa biiftuutti lafa waameera.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, speaks, and calls the earth from sunrise to sunset.

kikuyu: Xiyoon ishee miidhaginni ishee hirʼina hin qabne irraa Waaqni ni ibsa.
english: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God shines out.

kikuyu: Waaqni keenya ni dhufa; hin calʼisus; ibiddi hamaan fuula isaa dura, bubbeen jabaanis naannoo isaa jira.
english: Our God comes, and does not keep silent. A fire devours before him. It is very stormy around him.

kikuyu: Inni saba isaatti muruuf jedhee, samiiwwan oliitii fi lafa akkana jedhee ni waama:
english: He calls to the heavens above, to the earth, that he may judge his people:

kikuyu: “Qulqulloota koo warra aarsaadhaan na wajjin kakuu galan, gara kootti walitti naa qabaa.”
english: “Gather my saints together to me, those who have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.”

kikuyu: Samiiwwan qajeelummaa isaa ni labsu; Waaqni mataan isaa abbaa murtiitii.
english: The heavens shall declare his righteousness, for God himself is judge. Selah.

kikuyu: “Yaa saba ko, nan dubbadhaatii dhagaʼi; yaa Israaʼel, ani dhugaa sitti nan baʼa: Ani Waaqni Waaqa kee ti.
english: “Hear, my people, and I will speak. Israel, I will testify against you. I am God, your God.

kikuyu: Ani aarsaa keetiif sitti hin dheekkamu; aarsaan kee inni gubamu yeroo hunda fuula koo dura jira.
english: I don’t rebuke you for your sacrifices. Your burnt offerings are continually before me.

kikuyu: Ani dallaa kee keessaa korma, yookaan karra kee keessaa korbeessa reʼee hin barbaadu.
english: I have no need for a bull from your stall, nor male goats from your pens.

kikuyu: Bineensi bosonaa hundinuu, horiin tulluu kuma irratti bobbaʼus kan kootii.
english: For every animal of the forest is mine, and the livestock on a thousand hills.

kikuyu: Ani simbirroota tulluuwwan irraa hunda beeka; wanni lafa irra sosochoʼu hundinuus kan koo ti.
english: I know all the birds of the mountains. The wild animals of the field are mine.

kikuyu: Ani utuun beelaʼee iyyuu sitti hin himadhu ture; addunyaa fi wanni ishee keessa jiru hundi kanuma kootii.
english: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is mine, and all that is in it.

kikuyu: Ani foon korommii nan nyaadhaa? Yookaan dhiiga reʼootaa nan dhugaa?
english: Will I eat the meat of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

kikuyu: “Aarsaa galataa Waaqaaf dhiʼeessi; wareega kee illee Waaqa Waan Hundaa Oliitiif galchi;
english: Offer to God the sacrifice of thanksgiving. Pay your vows to the Most High.

kikuyu: guyyaa rakkinaa na waammadhu; ani sin oolchaa; atis ulfina naa kennita.”
english: Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu nama hamaadhaan akkana jedha: “Ati seera koo labsuudhaaf, kakuu koos afaan keetiin dubbachuudhaaf mirga maalii qabda?
english: But to the wicked God says, “What right do you have to declare my statutes, that you have taken my covenant on your lips,

kikuyu: Ati adaba koo ni jibbita; dubbii koos of duubatti gatta.
english: since you hate instruction, and throw my words behind you?

kikuyu: Ati yoo hattuu argite isa michuu godhatta; ejjitoota wajjinis qooda qabaatta.
english: When you saw a thief, you consented with him, and have participated with adulterers.

kikuyu: Ati afaan kee waan hamaa dubbachuuf itti fayyadamta; arraba kees gowwoomsaadhaaf dheereffatta.
english: “You give your mouth to evil. Your tongue frames deceit.

kikuyu: Ati teessee obboleessa kee hamatta; ilma haadha kee maqaa balleessita.
english: You sit and speak against your brother. You slander your own mother’s son.

kikuyu: Ati waan kana hunda hojjetteerta; ani immoo inuma calʼise; ati akkuma ofii keetii na seete. Amma garuu ani sin ifadha; ifatti baasees sin himadha.
english: You have done these things, and I kept silent. You thought that I was just like you. I will rebuke you, and accuse you in front of your eyes.

kikuyu: “Isin warri Waaqa irraanfattan waan kana hubadhaa; yoo kanaa achii ani isin nan ciccira; namni isin oolchu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: “Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you into pieces, and there be no one to deliver.

kikuyu: Namni aarsaa galataa dhiʼeessu ulfina naa kenna; anis warra hirʼina hin qabnetti fayyisuu Waaqaa nan argisiisa.”
english: Whoever offers the sacrifice of thanksgiving glorifies me, and prepares his way so that I will show God’s salvation to him.”

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Faarfannaa kanas inni erga Batisheebaa bira gaʼee booddee yeroo Naataan raajichi gara isaa dhufetti faarfate. Yaa Waaqayyo, akkuma jaalala kee kan hin geeddaramne sanaatti na maari; akkuma baayʼina araara keetiitti, yakka koo narraa haqi.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David, when Nathan the prophet came to him, after he had gone in to Bathsheba. Have mercy on me, God, according to your loving kindness. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, blot out my transgressions.

kikuyu: Yakka koo hundumaa narraa dhiqi; cubbuu koo irraas na qulqulleessi.
english: Wash me thoroughly from my iniquity. Cleanse me from my sin.

kikuyu: Ani yakka koo beekaatii; cubbuun koos yeroo hunda fuula koo dura jira.
english: For I know my transgressions. My sin is constantly before me.

kikuyu: Ani sitti, suma qofatti cubbuu hojjedheera; waan fuula kee duratti hamaa taʼes hojjedheera; kanaafuu ati murtii keetiin qajeelaa dha; yommuu murtii kennituttis hin dogoggortu.
english: Against you, and you only, I have sinned, and done that which is evil in your sight, so you may be proved right when you speak, and justified when you judge.

kikuyu: Dhuguma iyyuu ani cubbuudhaanan dhaladhe; yeroo haati koo na ulfooftee jalqabees cubbamaan ture.
english: Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.

kikuyu: Ati keessa namaatti dhugaa hawwita; kanaafuu keessa kootti ogummaa na barsiisi.
english: Behold, you desire truth in the inward parts. You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.

kikuyu: Hiisophiidhaan cubbuu irraa na qulqulleessi; anis nan qulqullaaʼa; na dhiqi; anis cabbii caalaatti nan addaadha.
english: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean. Wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.

kikuyu: Gammachuu fi ilillee na dhageessisi; lafeen ati caccabsites haa ililchu.
english: Let me hear joy and gladness, that the bones which you have broken may rejoice.

kikuyu: Fuula kee cubbuu koo irraa deebifadhu; yakka koo hundas narraa haqi.
english: Hide your face from my sins, and blot out all of my iniquities.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, garaa qulqulluu na keessatti uumi; Hafuura qajeelaas na keessatti haaromsi.
english: Create in me a clean heart, O God. Renew a right spirit within me.

kikuyu: Fuula kee duraa na hin balleessin; Hafuura kee Qulqulluus narraa hin fudhatin.
english: Don’t throw me from your presence, and don’t take your Holy Spirit from me.

kikuyu: Gammachuu fayyina keetii naa deebisi; na jiraachisuudhaafis hafuura sarmu naa kenni.
english: Restore to me the joy of your salvation. Uphold me with a willing spirit.

kikuyu: Anis warra karaa kee irraa jalʼatan nan barsiisa; cubbamoonnis gara kee ni deebiʼu.
english: Then I will teach transgressors your ways. Sinners will be converted to you.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, Waaqa na Fayyiftu, ati dhiiga dhangalaasuu irraa na oolchi; arrabni koos qajeelummaa kee ni faarfata.
english: Deliver me from the guilt of bloodshed, O God, the God of my salvation. My tongue will sing aloud of your righteousness.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, hidhii koo naa bani; afaan koos galata kee labsa.
english: Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.

kikuyu: Ati aarsaatti hin gammaddu malee silaa nan dhiʼeessa ture; aarsaa gubamuttis hin gammaddu.
english: For you don’t delight in sacrifice, or else I would give it. You have no pleasure in burnt offering.

kikuyu: Aarsaan Waaqni fudhatu hafuura cabaa dha; Yaa Waaqi, ati garaa cabaa fi kan gaabbu hin tuffatu.
english: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit. O God, you will not despise a broken and contrite heart.

kikuyu: Jaalala keetiin Xiyooniif waan gaarii godhi; dallaa Yerusaalem ijaari.
english: Do well in your good pleasure to Zion. Build the walls of Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yoos ati aarsaa qajeelaatti, qalma gubamuu fi qalma akkuma jirutti gubamutti ni gammadda; korommiinis iddoo aarsaa kee irratti ni dhiʼeeffaman.
english: Then you will delight in the sacrifices of righteousness, in burnt offerings and in whole burnt offerings. Then they will offer bulls on your altar.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Maskiilii Daawit. Dooʼeeg namni biyya Edoomii yeroo gara Saaʼolii dhaqee, “Daawit gara mana Ahiimelekii dhufeera” jedhee itti himetti faarfatame. Yaa nama jabaa nana, ati maaliif hamminaan koorta? Ati namni fuula Waaqaa duratti tuffatamtu, maaliif guyyaa guutuu koorta?
english: For the Chief Musician. A contemplation by David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, “David has come to Ahimelech’s house.” Why do you boast of mischief, mighty man? God’s loving kindness endures continually.

kikuyu: Ati namni nama gowwoomsitu, arrabni kee badiisa qopheessa; arrabni kee akkuma qarabaa qaramee ti.
english: Your tongue plots destruction, like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

kikuyu: Ati waan gaarii irra waan hamaa jaallatta; dhugaa dubbachuu irra immoo soba dubbachuu jaallatta.
english: You love evil more than good, lying rather than speaking the truth. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa arraba gowwoomsituu nana, ati dubbii nama miidhu hunda jaallatta.
english: You love all devouring words, you deceitful tongue.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqni bara baraan si balleessa: Inni dunkaana kee keessaa butee si ciccira; biyya jiraattotaa keessaas si buqqisa.
english: God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the land of the living. Selah.

kikuyu: Qajeeltonni waan kana arganii sodaatan; isaanis akkana jedhanii isatti kolfan;
english: The righteous also will see it, and fear, and laugh at him, saying,

kikuyu: “Kunoo, namicha Waaqa daʼoo isaa hin godhatin, qooda kanaa immoo baayʼina qabeenya isaa amanatee jalʼina ofiitti ciche!”
english: “Behold, this is the man who didn’t make God his strength, but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.”

kikuyu: Ani garuu akkuma ejersa mana Waaqaa keessatti lalisuu ti; baraa hamma bara baraattis, jaalala Waaqaa kan hin geeddaramne sana nan amanadha.
english: But as for me, I am like a green olive tree in God’s house. I trust in God’s loving kindness forever and ever.

kikuyu: Sababii ati waan kana gooteef ani bara baraan sin galateeffadha; sababii maqaan kee gaarii taʼeef ani maqaa kee nan abdadha. Fuula qulqulloota kee durattis sin leellisa.
english: I will give you thanks forever, because you have done it. I will hope in your name, for it is good, in the presence of your saints.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Gosa Muuziiqaa maahilaati jedhamuun faarfatame. Maskiilii Daawiti. Gowwaan garaa isaatti, “Waaqni hin jiru” jedha. Isaan xuraaʼaniiru; karaan isaaniis jibbisiisaa dha; namni waan gaarii hojjetu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Mahalath.” A contemplation by David. The fool has said in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt, and have done abominable iniquity. There is no one who does good.

kikuyu: Waaqni yoo namni waa hubatu, kan Waaqas barbaadu tokko iyyuu jiraate arguuf jedhee, samii irraa ilmaan namootaa gad ilaala.
english: God looks down from heaven on the children of men, to see if there are any who understood, who seek after God.

kikuyu: Hundinuu dogoggoraniiru; hundi isaaniis xuraaʼaniiru; namni waan gaarii hojjetu tokko iyyuu hin jiru; tokkumti iyyuu hin jiru.
english: Every one of them has gone back. They have become filthy together. There is no one who does good, no, not one.

kikuyu: Warri hammina hojjetan, kanneen akkuma waan buddeena nyaataniitti saba koo nyaatan, warri Waaqa hin waammanne hundinuu homaa hin beekanii?
english: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge, who eat up my people as they eat bread, and don’t call on God?

kikuyu: Isaan iddoo wanni sodaatamu hin jirretti, sodaadhaan liqimfamaniiru. Waaqni lafee warra si marsanii ni bittinneessa; sababii Waaqni isaan tuffateef, ati isaan qaanessite.
english: There they were in great fear, where no fear was, for God has scattered the bones of him who encamps against you. You have put them to shame, because God has rejected them.

kikuyu: Maaloo utuu Xiyoon keessaa fayyinni Israaʼeliif dhufee! Yommuu Waaqni saba isaa warra boojiʼaman deebisutti, Yaaqoob haa ililchu; Israaʼelis haa gammadu!
english: Oh that the salvation of Israel would come out of Zion! When God brings back his people from captivity, then Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Miʼa ribuutiin. Maskiilii Daawit. Yeroo warri Ziif Saaʼol bira dhaqanii, “Daawit nu gidduu dhokatee jira” jedhanitti faarfatame. Yaa Waaqi, maqaa keetiin na fayyisi; humna keetiinis naa murteessi.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David, when the Ziphites came and said to Saul, “Isn’t David hiding himself among us?” Save me, God, by your name. Vindicate me in your might.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, kadhannaa koo naa dhagaʼi, dubbii afaan kootiis dhaggeeffadhu.
english: Hear my prayer, God. Listen to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Keessumoonni natti kaʼaniiruutii; warri garaa namaa hin laafne lubbuu koo galaafachuu barbaadu; Isaanis warra Waaqaaf ulfina hin kenninee dha.
english: For strangers have risen up against me. Violent men have sought after my soul. They haven’t set God before them. Selah.

kikuyu: Kunoo, Waaqni gargaaraa koo ti; Gooftaan jiraachisaa lubbuu koo ti.
english: Behold, God is my helper. The Lord is the one who sustains my soul.

kikuyu: Hamminni warra maqaa na balleessanii isaanumatti haa deebiʼu; atis amanamummaa keetiin isaan balleessi.
english: He will repay the evil to my enemies. Destroy them in your truth.

kikuyu: Ani fedhii kootiin aarsaa siif dhiʼeessa; yaa Waaqayyo, ani maqaa kee nan galateeffadha; inni gaariidhaatii.
english: With a free will offering, I will sacrifice to you. I will give thanks to your name, LORD, for it is good.

kikuyu: Inni dhiphina koo hundumaa keessaa na baaseeraatii; iji koos ol aantummaadhaan diinota koo of jalatti ilaaleera.
english: For he has delivered me out of all trouble. My eye has seen triumph over my enemies.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Miʼa ribuutiin. Maskiilii Daawit. Yaa Waaqi, kadhannaa koo dhagaʼi; waammata koo jalaas hin didin.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A contemplation by David. Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.

kikuyu: Na dhagaʼiitii deebii naa kenni; komiin koo na dhiphisa; anis nagaa dhabeera.
english: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan

kikuyu: Sagalee diinaatiin, cunqursa namoota hamoos dhufe; isaan dhiphina natti fiduutii; aariidhaanis na jibbu.
english: because of the voice of the enemy, because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.

kikuyu: Lapheen koo na keessatti dhiphatte; sodaan duʼaas na qabate.
english: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.

kikuyu: Sodaa fi hollannaan natti dhufeera; naasuunis na fudhateera.
english: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.

kikuyu: Anis akkana nan jedhe; “Utuu ani akkuma gugee qoochoo qabaadhee! Silaa asii barrisee nan boqodhan ture.
english: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.

kikuyu: Silaa fagootti baqadhee gammoojjii keessa nan bubbula ture;
english: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.

kikuyu: silaa bubbee hamaa fi qilleensa jabaa irraa fagaadhee gara iddoo boqonnaa kootti nan ariifadhan ture.”
english: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, namoota hamoo burjaajessi; dubbii isaaniis waliin dhaʼi; ani magaalaa keessatti goolii fi lola argeeraatii.
english: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

kikuyu: Isaan halkanii guyyaa ol baʼanii dallaa ishee irra naannaʼu; jalʼinnii fi rakkinni ishee keessa jira.
english: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.

kikuyu: Ishee keessa badiisatu jira; nama cunqursuu fi gowwoomsuun daandii ishee irraa hin dhabamu.
english: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.

kikuyu: Utuu diinni na arrabsee, silaa obsuu nan dandaʼa ture; utuu amajaajiin natti kaʼee, silaa jalaa dhokachuu nan dandaʼa ture.
english: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.

kikuyu: Garuu siʼi namuma akka kootii, hiriyaa koo, michuu koo kan natti dhiʼaatutu waan kana godhe.
english: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.

kikuyu: Tokkummaadhaan mana Waaqaa walii wajjin deemne; haasaa miʼaawaas walii wajjin haasofne.
english: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.

kikuyu: Duuti tasa isaanitti haa dhufu; utuma lubbuudhaan jiranuu siiʼool keessa haa buʼan; hamminni mana isaaniitii fi garaa isaanii keessa jiraattii.
english: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is among them, in their dwelling.

kikuyu: Ani garuu Waaqa nan waammadha; Waaqayyos jalaa na baasa.
english: As for me, I will call on God. The LORD will save me.

kikuyu: Ani galgala, ganamaa fi waareetti dhiphinaan nan iyya; innis sagalee koo ni dhagaʼa.
english: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.

kikuyu: Yoo namni baayʼeen anaan morme illee, inni waraana natti kaʼe jalaa miidhaa malee na baasa.
english: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.

kikuyu: Waaqni inni durumaa jalqabee teessoo irra jiru sun, Namoota karaa isaanii hin geeddaranne, kanneen Waaqa hin sodaanne ni dhagaʼa; isaan qaanessas.
english: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear and answer them. Selah. They never change and don’t fear God.

kikuyu: Hiriyaan koo michoota isaatti harka isaa ol fudhate; kakuu isaa illee ni cabse.
english: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.

kikuyu: Dubbiin isaa akkuma dhadhaa ti; nama hin quuqu; garaa isaa keessa garuu lolatu jira; dubbiin isaa zayitii caalaa lallaafa; garuu goraadee luqqifamee dha.
english: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.

kikuyu: Yaaddoo kee Waaqayyotti kennadhu; inni si jiraachisa; namni qajeelaan akka jeqamus hin godhu.
english: Cast your burden on the LORD and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati garuu namoota hamoo boolla badiisaa keessa ni buufta; warri dhiiga dhangalaasanii fi gowwoomsitoonni, walakkaa bara jireenya isaanii iyyuu hin jiraatan. Ani garuu sin amanadha.
english: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo “Gugee Qilxuu Fagoo irraa” jedhuun faarfatame. Miiktaamii Faarfannaa Daawit. Innis yeroo Filisxeemonni Gaati keessatti isa qaban faarfate. Yaa Waaqi na maari; diinonni koo akka malee na ariʼu; guyyaa guutuus na cunqursu.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Silent Dove in Distant Lands.” A poem by David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, God, for man wants to swallow me up. All day long, he attacks and oppresses me.

kikuyu: Diinonni koo guyyaa guutuu na gaadu; namoonni baayʼeen of tuulummaadhaan na lolu.
english: My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.

kikuyu: Ani yommuun sodaadhutti sin amanadha.
english: When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.

kikuyu: Waaqa ani dubbii isaa jajadhu, Waaqa nan amanadha; homaa hin sodaadhu. Namni duʼa hin oolle maal na gochuu dandaʼa?
english: In God, I praise his word. In God, I put my trust. I will not be afraid. What can flesh do to me?

kikuyu: Isaan guyyaa guutuu dubbii koo micciiru; na miidhuudhaafis yeroo hunda natti malatu.
english: All day long they twist my words. All their thoughts are against me for evil.

kikuyu: Isaan ni mariʼatu; ni riphus; lubbuu koo galaafachuuf jedhanii tarkaanfii koo eeggatu.
english: They conspire and lurk, watching my steps. They are eager to take my life.

kikuyu: Sababii hammina isaaniitiif akka isaan miliqan hin godhin; yaa Waaqi, dheekkamsa keetiin saboota gad deebisi.
english: Shall they escape by iniquity? In anger cast down the peoples, God.

kikuyu: Gadadamu koo galmeessi; imimmaan koos kitaaba kee keessatti barreessi; isaan galmee kee keessa jiru mitii?
english: You count my wanderings. You put my tears into your container. Aren’t they in your book?

kikuyu: Yommuu ani gargaarsaaf si waammadhutti, diinonni koo dugda duuba deebiʼu. Anis kanaan akka Waaqni na wajjin jiru beeka.
english: Then my enemies shall turn back in the day that I call. I know this: that God is for me.

kikuyu: Waaqa ani dubbii isaa jajadhu, Waaqayyo ani dubbii isaa jajadhu,
english: In God, I will praise his word. In the LORD, I will praise his word.

kikuyu: Waaqa nan amanadha; ani homaa hin sodaadhu. Namni maal na gochuu dandaʼa?
english: I have put my trust in God. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi wareegni kee narra jira; aarsaa galataas siif nan dhiʼeessa.
english: Your vows are on me, God. I will give thank offerings to you.

kikuyu: Akka ani fuula Waaqaa dura, ifa jireenyaa keessa deddeebiʼuuf, ati lubbuu koo duʼa jalaa, miilla koos gufachuu oolchiteertaatii.
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, and prevented my feet from falling, that I may walk before God in the light of the living.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo “Hin balleessin” jedhuun faarfatame. Faarfannaa Daawit. Miiktaamii. Innis yeroo Saaʼol jalaa baqatee holqatti galee faarfate. Na maari; yaa Waaqa na maari; lubbuun koo sitti kooluu galtiitii. Anis hamma balaan darbutti, gaaddisa qoochoo keetii jalatti kooluu nan gala.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when he fled from Saul, in the cave. Be merciful to me, God, be merciful to me, for my soul takes refuge in you. Yes, in the shadow of your wings, I will take refuge, until disaster has passed.

kikuyu: Ani gara Waaqa Waan Hundaa Oliitti, gara Waaqa haaloo naa baasuutti nan iyya.
english: I cry out to God Most High, to God who accomplishes my requests for me.

kikuyu: Inni samii irraa ergee na oolcha; warra akka malee na ariʼan ni ifata; Waaqni jaalala isaatii fi amanamummaa isaa ni erga.
english: He will send from heaven, and save me, he rebukes the one who is pursuing me. Selah. God will send out his loving kindness and his truth.

kikuyu: Ani leencota gidduun jira; ani bineensota nama nyaatan, namoota ilkaan isaanii eeboo fi xiyyaa kanneen arrabni isaanii akka goraadee qaramaa gidduu ciiseera.
english: My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, ati samiiwwaniin olitti ol ol jedhi; ulfinni kees lafa hunda irra haa jiraatu.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be above all the earth!

kikuyu: Isaanis kiyyoo miilla kootiif kaaʼan; lubbuun koos dhiphinaan gad gogdeerti. Isaan karaa koo irratti boolla qotan; garuu isaanumattu keessatti kufe.
english: They have prepared a net for my steps. My soul is bowed down. They dig a pit before me. They fall into the middle of it themselves. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, garaan koo hin raafamu; garaan koo hin raafamu; ani nan faarfadha; nan weeddisas.
english: My heart is steadfast, God. My heart is steadfast. I will sing, yes, I will sing praises.

kikuyu: Yaa lubbuu ko, dammaqi! Yaa kiraaraa fi baganaa dammaqaa! Anis ganamaan nan dammaqa.
english: Wake up, my glory! Wake up, lute and harp! I will wake up the dawn.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, ani saboota gidduutti galata siif nan galcha; namoota gidduuttis waaʼee kee nan faarfadha.
english: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.

kikuyu: Jaalalli kee guddaa dha; samiiwwanis gaʼaatii; amanamummaan kees samiiwwan qaqqaba.
english: For your great loving kindness reaches to the heavens, and your truth to the skies.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, ati samiiwwaniin olitti ol ol jedhi; ulfinni kees lafa hunda irra haa jiraatu.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens. Let your glory be over all the earth.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo “Hin balleessin” jedhuun faarfatame. Faarfannaa Daawiti. Miiktaamii. Yaa bulchitoota, isin dhugumaan waan qajeelaa dubbattanii? Nama gidduuttis murtii qajeelaa kennitanii?
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David. Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

kikuyu: Akkas miti; isin garaa keessan keessatti hammina yaaddu; harki keessanis lafa irratti goolii kaasa.
english: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.

kikuyu: Namoonni hamoon dhalootumaa kaasanii karaa irraa jalʼatu; gadameessa haadha isaaniitii jalqabniis karaa irraa goranii soba dubbatu.
english: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

kikuyu: Hadhaan isaanii akkuma hadhaa bofaa ti; isaan akkuma buutii duudaa gurra isaa cuqqaalatee
english: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

kikuyu: sagalee nama isa raatessuu yookaan nama waan ittiin isa raatessu hojjetu tokkoo dhagaʼuu diduu ti.
english: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi ati ilkaan isaanii afaan isaanii keessatti caccabsi; qarriffaa leencotaas daaki, yaa Waaqayyo!
english: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, LORD.

kikuyu: Isaan akkuma bishaan dhangalaʼee baduutti haa badan; yeroo iddaa futtaasanitti xiyyi isaanii haa doomu.
english: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

kikuyu: Akkuma ciilalluu yommuu deemu baquutti, akkuma daaʼima utuu yeroon hin gaʼin dhalatuuttis aduu hin argin.
english: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

kikuyu: Utuu okkoteen keessan ibidda qoraattiitiin hin hoʼin, jiidhaas taʼu gogaan isaanii haxaaʼamanii balleeffamu.
english: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan yommuu haaloo baʼuu kana argutti ni gammada; miilla isaas dhiiga namoota hamootiin ni dhiqata.
english: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

kikuyu: Yommus namoonni akkana ni jedhu; “Dhugumaan nama qajeelaadhaaf badhaasni jira; dhugumaan Waaqni lafa irratti murtii kennu jira.”
english: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo Daawit kan “Hin balleessin” jedhuun faarfatame. Miiktaamii. Daawitis yeroo Saaʼol isa ajjeesuudhaaf jedhee namoota ergee mana isaa eegsisetti faarfate. Yaa Waaqi, diinota koo jalaa na baasi; warra natti kaʼan jalaas na furi.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David, when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, my God. Set me on high from those who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Warra hammina hojjetan jalaa na baasi; namoota dhiiga dhangalaasan jalaas na baraari.
english: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity. Save me from the bloodthirsty men.

kikuyu: Ilaa, isaan riphanii na eeggachaa jiruu! Yaa Waaqayyo, namoonni hamoon, utuu ani balleessaa fi cubbuu hin qabaatin lola natti kaasu.
english: For, behold, they lie in wait for my soul. The mighty gather themselves together against me, not for my disobedience, nor for my sin, LORD.

kikuyu: Ani balleessaa tokko illee hin hojjennee; isaan garuu na loluuf qophaaʼaniiru. Na gargaaruudhaaf kaʼi; rakkina koos ilaali!
english: I have done no wrong, yet they are ready to attack me. Rise up, behold, and help me!

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu, yaa Waaqa Israaʼel, saboota hunda adabuudhaaf kaʼi; warra hammina isaaniitiin yakka hojjetan tokko illee hin maarin.
english: You, LORD God of Armies, the God of Israel, rouse yourself to punish the nations. Show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah.

kikuyu: Isaanis galgala galgala deebiʼanii, akka saree gururiʼaa magaalattii irra naannaʼu.
english: They return at evening, howling like dogs, and prowl around the city.

kikuyu: Waan isaan afaan isaaniitii baasan ilaali; hidhii isaanii irra goraadeetu jira; isaanis, “Eenyutu nu dhagaʼuu dandaʼa?” jedhu.
english: Behold, they spew with their mouth. Swords are in their lips, “For”, they say, “who hears us?”

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati garuu isaanitti kolfita; saboota sana hundumattis ni qoosta.
english: But you, LORD, laugh at them. You scoff at all the nations.

kikuyu: Yaa Jabina ko, ani sin eeggadha; yaa Waaqi ati daʼoo koo,
english: Oh, my Strength, I watch for you, for God is my high tower.

kikuyu: Waaqa na jaallatuu dha. Waaqni fuula koo dura deema; akka ani diinota koo moʼannoodhaan of jalatti ilaalu godha.
english: My God will go before me with his loving kindness. God will let me look at my enemies in triumph.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, yaa gaachana keenya, ati garuu isaan hin ajjeesin; yoo kanaa achii sabni koo ni irraanfata. Humna keetiin akka isaan jooran godhi; gad isaan deebisis.
english: Don’t kill them, or my people may forget. Scatter them by your power, and bring them down, Lord our shield.

kikuyu: Sababii cubbuu afaan isaaniitiif, sababii dubbii hidhii isaaniitiif, isaan of tuulummaa isaaniitiin haa qabaman. Sababii abaarsaa fi soba isaan dubbataniitiif,
english: For the sin of their mouth, and the words of their lips, let them be caught in their pride, for the curses and lies which they utter.

kikuyu: dheekkamsaan isaan balleessi; akka isaan deebiʼanii hin argamneef isaan balleessi. Kanaanis akka Waaqni Yaaqoob irratti mootii taʼe, hamma handaara lafaatti ni beekama.
english: Consume them in wrath. Consume them, and they will be no more. Let them know that God rules in Jacob, to the ends of the earth. Selah.

kikuyu: Isaanis galgala galgala deebiʼanii, akka saree gururiʼaa, magaalattii irra naannaʼu.
english: At evening let them return. Let them howl like a dog, and go around the city.

kikuyu: Isaan waan nyaatan barbaacha asii fi achi jooru; yoo quufuu baatan immoo ni iyyu.
english: They shall wander up and down for food, and wait all night if they aren’t satisfied.

kikuyu: Ani garuu waaʼee jabina keetii nan faarfadha; ganamaanis waaʼee jaalala keetii nan faarfadha; ati daʼoo kootii; yeroo rakkina koottis ati iddoo ani itti kooluu galuu dha.
english: But I will sing of your strength. Yes, I will sing aloud of your loving kindness in the morning. For you have been my high tower, a refuge in the day of my distress.

kikuyu: Yaa Jabina ko, ani faarfannaa galataa siifin faarfadha; yaa Waaqi, ati daʼoo koo ti; ati Waaqa ani abdadhuu dha.
english: To you, my strength, I will sing praises. For God is my high tower, the God of my mercy.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo “Daraaraa kakuu” jedhamuun faarfatame. Miiktaamii Daawit. Barsiisuuf. Yeroo inni Arraam Nahaaraayimii fi Arraam Zoobaa lolee fi yeroo Yooʼaabin deebisee warra Edoomii keessaa namoota kuma kudha lama Sulula soogiddaa keessatti fixetti faarfatame. Yaa Waaqi, ati nu gatteerta; nu caccabsiteertas; nutti aarteerta; amma garuu iddootti nu deebisi!
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A teaching poem by David, when he fought with Aram Naharaim and with Aram Zobah, and Joab returned, and killed twelve thousand of Edom in the Valley of Salt. God, you have rejected us. You have broken us down. You have been angry. Restore us, again.

kikuyu: Ati lafa sochoofteerta; tarsaaftees afaan bansiifteerta; caccabaa ishees walitti suphi; isheen raafamteertii.
english: You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.

kikuyu: Ati akka sabni kee waan hamaadhaan dhiphatu gooteerta; daadhii wayinii nu gatantarsus nuu kenniteerta.
english: You have shown your people hard things. You have made us drink the wine that makes us stagger.

kikuyu: Akka isaan iddaa jalaa gara isaatti baqataniif, ati warra si sodaataniif mallattoo kenniteerta.
english: You have given a banner to those who fear you, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

kikuyu: Akka warri ati jaallattu furamaniif, harka kee mirgaatiin nu oolchi; nu gargaaris.
english: So that your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

kikuyu: Waaqni iddoo qulqullummaa isaatii akkana jedhee dubbateera; “Ani gammachuudhaan Sheekemin gargar nan qooda; Sulula Sukootis nan safara.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “I will triumph. I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

kikuyu: Giliʼaad kan koo ti; Minaaseenis kan koo ti. Efreem gonfoo sibiilaa koo ti; Yihuudaanis bokkuu mootummaa koo ti.
english: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is the defense of my head. Judah is my scepter.

kikuyu: Moʼaab caabii dhiqannaa koo ti; Edoom irra kophee koo darbadhee nan buusa; Filisxeem irrattis moʼannaadhaan nan geerara.”
english: Moab is my wash basin. I will throw my sandal on Edom. I shout in triumph over Philistia.”

kikuyu: Eenyutu magaalaa jabeeffamtee ijaaramtetti na fida? Eenyutu Edoomitti na geessa?
english: Who will bring me into the strong city? Who has led me to Edom?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, kan nu gatte suma mitii? Yaa Waaqi, kan loltoota keenya wajjin baʼuu diddes suma mitii?
english: Haven’t you, God, rejected us? You don’t go out with our armies, God.

kikuyu: Diina keenya of irraa dhowwuu nu gargaar; gargaarsi namaa faayidaa hin qabuutii.
english: Give us help against the adversary, for the help of man is vain.

kikuyu: Nu Waaqa wajjin ni moʼanna; innis diinota keenya gad dhidhiita.
english: Through God we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our adversaries.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit kan miʼa ribuutiin faarfatame. Yaa Waaqi, iyyata koo dhagaʼi; kadhannaa koos dhaggeeffadhu.
english: For the Chief Musician. For a stringed instrument. By David. Hear my cry, God. Listen to my prayer.

kikuyu: Yeroo garaan koo citetti, ani handaara lafaatii sin waammadha; ati gara kattaa na caalaa ol dheeratuutti na geessi.
english: From the end of the earth, I will call to you when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

kikuyu: Ati iddoo ani itti kooluu galuudhaatii; fuula diina koo durattis gamoo jabaa dha.
english: For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.

kikuyu: Ani bara baraan dunkaana kee keessa jiraachuu, gaaddisa qoochoo keetii jalattis kooluu galuu nan hawwa.
english: I will dwell in your tent forever. I will take refuge in the shelter of your wings. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, ati wareega koo dhageesseertaatii; dhaala warri maqaa kee sodaatan argatanis naa kenniteerta.
english: For you, God, have heard my vows. You have given me the heritage of those who fear your name.

kikuyu: Bara jireenya mootii, umurii isaa illee dhalootaa gara dhalootaatti dheeressi.
english: You will prolong the king’s life. His years will be for generations.

kikuyu: Innis fuula Waaqaa duratti bara baraan haa moʼu; akka jaalalli keetii fi amanamummaan kee isa eeganis godhi.
english: He shall be enthroned in God’s presence forever. Appoint your loving kindness and truth, that they may preserve him.

kikuyu: Anis faarfannaa galataa maqaa keetiif nan faarfadha; guyyuma guyyaanis wareega koo nan guuttadha.
english: So I will sing praise to your name forever, that I may fulfill my vows daily.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeduutuuniif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Lubbuun koo Waaqa qofa eeggatti; fayyinni koos isa biraa naa dhufa.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by David. My soul rests in God alone. My salvation is from him.

kikuyu: Kattaan kootii fi fayyinni koo isa qofa; inni daʼoo koo ti; ani gonkumaa hin raafamu.
english: He alone is my rock, my salvation, and my fortress. I will never be greatly shaken.

kikuyu: Isin hamma yoomiitti nama miitu? Hamma yoomiitti akka keenyan manaa kan duufeetti, akka dallaa raafameettis lafaan isa dhaʼuu barbaaddu?
english: How long will you assault a man? Would all of you throw him down, like a leaning wall, like a tottering fence?

kikuyu: Isaan aangoo isaa guddaa sana irraa, guutummaatti gad isa deebisuu barbaadu; isaan sobatti ni gammadu. Afaan isaaniitiin ni eebbisu; garaa isaaniitiin garuu ni abaaru.
english: They fully intend to throw him down from his lofty place. They delight in lies. They bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo Waaqa qofa obsaan eeggatti; abdiin koo isa biraa dhufaatii.
english: My soul, wait in silence for God alone, for my expectation is from him.

kikuyu: Kattaan kootii fi fayyinni koo isa qofa; inni daʼoo koo ti; ani hin raafamu.
english: He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.

kikuyu: Fayyinni kootii fi ulfinni koo harka Waaqaa keessa jira; kattaan koo jabaan, iddoon ani itti kooluu galu Waaqa.
english: My salvation and my honor is with God. The rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

kikuyu: Yaa namoota, yeroo hunda isa amanadhaa; garaa keessanis fuula isaa duratti dhangalaasaa; Waaqni iddoo nu itti kooluu galluudhaatii.
english: Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us. Selah.

kikuyu: Gosa tuffatamaa irraa dhalachuun homaa miti; gosa kabajamaa irraa dhalachuunis sobuma; yoo madaaliidhaan madaalaman lachanuu qilleensa caalaa salphatu.
english: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are together lighter than a breath.

kikuyu: Waan saamichaan argattan hin amanatinaa; waan hatameenis hin koorinaa. Yoo qabeenyi keessan guddate illee, qalbii keessan isa irra hin kaaʼatinaa.
english: Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.

kikuyu: Waaqni yeroo tokko dubbate; ani immoo yeroo lama nan dhagaʼe; kunis akka humni kan Waaqaa taʼee dha.
english: God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa araarri kan kee ti. Ati dhugumaan tokkoo tokkoo namaa akkuma hojii isaatti gatii isaa ni kennitaaf.
english: Also to you, Lord, belongs loving kindness, for you reward every man according to his work.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yeroo inni Gammoojjii Yihuudaa keessa turetti. Yaa Waaqi, ati Waaqa koo ti; ani dhugumaan sin barbaadadha; lafa gogaa fi gammoojjii, lafa bishaan hin jirretti, lubbuun koo si dheebotti; foon koos sitti gaggaba.
english: A Psalm by David, when he was in the desert of Judah. God, you are my God. I will earnestly seek you. My soul thirsts for you. My flesh longs for you, in a dry and weary land, where there is no water.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani iddoo qulqulluu keessattin si arge; humna keetii fi ulfina kees nan ilaale.
english: So I have seen you in the sanctuary, watching your power and your glory.

kikuyu: Waan jaalalli kee jireenya caaluuf, hidhiin koo si jajatti.
english: Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.

kikuyu: Ani hamman jirutti sin eebbisa; maqaa keetiinis harka koo ol nan qabadha.
english: So I will bless you while I live. I will lift up my hands in your name.

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo akka nama dhukaa fi cooma quufeetti quufti; afaan koos hidhii ililleetiin si jajata.
english: My soul shall be satisfied as with the richest food. My mouth shall praise you with joyful lips,

kikuyu: Ani siree koo irratti sin yaadadha; halkan guutuus waaʼee kee nan yaada.
english: when I remember you on my bed, and think about you in the night watches.

kikuyu: Waan ati gargaarsa koo taateef, ani gaaddisa qoochoo keetii jalatti gammachuudhaan nan faarfadha.
english: For you have been my help. I will rejoice in the shadow of your wings.

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo sitti maxxanti; harki kee mirgaa ol na qaba.
english: My soul stays close to you. Your right hand holds me up.

kikuyu: Warri lubbuu koo galaafachuu barbaadan garuu boolla lafaa isa gad fagoo keessa buʼu.
english: But those who seek my soul to destroy it shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

kikuyu: Isaan dabarfamanii goraadeetti kennamu; nyaata waangoos ni taʼu.
english: They shall be given over to the power of the sword. They shall be jackal food.

kikuyu: Mootiin garuu Waaqaatti ni gammada; namni Waaqaan kakatu hundinuu ulfina argata; afaan warra soba dubbatuu immoo ni cufama.
english: But the king shall rejoice in God. Everyone who swears by him will praise him, for the mouth of those who speak lies shall be silenced.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqi, yommuu ani iyyadhu sagalee koo dhagaʼi; lubbuu koos doorsisuu diinaa duraa baasi.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Hear my voice, God, in my complaint. Preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

kikuyu: Marii jalʼootaa duraa, mala namoota hamoo duraas na dhoksi.
english: Hide me from the conspiracy of the wicked, from the noisy crowd of the ones doing evil;

kikuyu: Isaan arraba isaanii akka goraadee qaratan; dubbii hadhaaʼaas akkuma xiyyaatti qopheeffatu.
english: who sharpen their tongue like a sword, and aim their arrows, deadly words,

kikuyu: Isaan riphanii nama yakka hin qabnetti futtaasu; akkuma tasaas sodaa malee itti gad dhiisu.
english: to shoot innocent men from ambushes. They shoot at him suddenly and fearlessly.

kikuyu: Kaayyoo jalʼinaa irratti wal jajjabeessu; waaʼee dhoksanii kiyyoo kaaʼuus ni mariʼatu; “Eenyutu isa arguu dandaʼa?” jedhaniis ni yaadu.
english: They encourage themselves in evil plans. They talk about laying snares secretly. They say, “Who will see them?”

kikuyu: Isaanis jalʼina yaaduudhaan, “Nu mala hirʼina hin qabne malanneerra!” jedhu; yaadnii fi keessi garaa namaa gad fagoodhaatii.
english: They plot injustice, saying, “We have made a perfect plan!” Surely man’s mind and heart are cunning.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu xiyya isaa isaanitti futtaasa; isaanis akkuma tasaa madaaʼu.
english: But God will shoot at them. They will be suddenly struck down with an arrow.

kikuyu: Innis arrabuma isaaniin isaan balleessa; warri isaan argan hundinuu tuffiidhaan mataa raasu.
english: Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.

kikuyu: Namoonni hundinuu ni sodaatu; isaan hojii Waaqaa ni labsu; waan inni hojjete illee ni qalbeeffatu.
english: All mankind shall be afraid. They shall declare the work of God, and shall wisely ponder what he has done.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan Waaqayyotti gammada; isattis kooluu gala; gara toleeyyiin hundinuu isaan ulfina argatu.
english: The righteous shall be glad in the LORD, and shall take refuge in him. All the upright in heart shall praise him!

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqi, Xiyoon keessatti galatatu si eeggata; wareegni keenyas siif galfama.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.

kikuyu: Yaa isa kadhannaa namaa dhageessu, namni hundinuu gara kee ni dhufa.
english: You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.

kikuyu: Yeroo cubbuun na moʼattetti, ati yakka keenya nuu dhiifteerta.
english: Sins overwhelmed me, but you atoned for our transgressions.

kikuyu: Warri ati filattee akka isaan qeʼee kee jiraataniif ofitti dhiʼeessite eebbifamoo dha! Nus waan gaarii mana keetiitiin, kan mana qulqullummaa keetiitiinis ni quufna.
english: Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the goodness of your house, your holy temple.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi Fayyisaa keenya, ati hojii qajeelummaa sodaachisaadhaan deebii nuu kennita; daarii lafaa hundumaaf, galaana fagootti argamuufis ati abdii dha;
english: By awesome deeds of righteousness, you answer us, God of our salvation. You who are the hope of all the ends of the earth, of those who are far away on the sea.

kikuyu: ati humna uffatteerta; jabina keetiinis tulluuwwan hundeessite;
english: By your power, you form the mountains, having armed yourself with strength.

kikuyu: ati huursaa galaanaa, huursaa dhaʼaa bishaanii, raafama uummataas ni calʼisiifte.
english: You still the roaring of the seas, the roaring of their waves, and the turmoil of the nations.

kikuyu: Warri fagoo jiraatan dinqiiwwan kee ni sodaatu; ati yeroo bariʼuu fi yeroo dhiʼutti, akka faarfannaan gammachuu faarfatamu ni goota.
english: They also who dwell in faraway places are afraid at your wonders. You call the morning’s dawn and the evening with songs of joy.

kikuyu: Ati lafa ni eegda; bishaanis ni obaafta; akka malees ni gabbifta; akka namootaaf midhaan kennaniifis lageen Waaqaa bishaaniin guutamaniiru; ati kanumaaf qopheessiteertaatii.
english: You visit the earth, and water it. You greatly enrich it. The river of God is full of water. You provide them grain, for so you have ordained it.

kikuyu: Boʼoo isaa bishaan quubsita; biyyoo isaas wal qixxeessita; tiifuu bokkaatiinis ni jiifta; biqila isaas ni eebbifta.
english: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.

kikuyu: Gaarummaa keetiin bara ni gonfita; daandiiwwan kees cooma coccobsu.
english: You crown the year with your bounty. Your carts overflow with abundance.

kikuyu: Lafti margaa kan gammoojjii akka malee misa; gaarranis gammachuudhaan guutamu.
english: The wilderness grasslands overflow. The hills are clothed with gladness.

kikuyu: Dirreewwan bushaayeedhaan guutamu; sululoonni midhaaniin haguugamu; isaanis ililleedhaan iyyanii faarfatu.
english: The pastures are covered with flocks. The valleys also are clothed with grain. They shout for joy! They also sing.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa. Isin lafti hundinuu ililleedhaan gara Waaqaatti iyyaa!
english: For the Chief Musician. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful shout to God, all the earth!

kikuyu: Ulfina maqaa isaa faarfadhaa; galata isaatiifis ulfina kennaa!
english: Sing to the glory of his name! Offer glory and praise!

kikuyu: Waaqaan akkana jedhaa; “Hojiin kee akkam sodaachisaa dha! Sababii humni kee guddaa taʼeef, diinonni kee fuula kee duratti hollatu.
english: Tell God, “How awesome are your deeds! Through the greatness of your power, your enemies submit themselves to you.

kikuyu: Lafti hundinuu siif sagadu; faarfannaa galataa siif faarfatu; maqaa keetiifis faarfatu.”
english: All the earth will worship you, and will sing to you; they will sing to your name.” Selah.

kikuyu: Kottaatii waan Waaqni hojjete, hojii sodaachiisaa inni namaaf hojjete ilaalaa!
english: Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.

kikuyu: Inni galaana lafa gogaatti geeddare; isaanis miilla isaaniitiin laga ceʼan; kottaa isatti haa gammannu!
english: He turned the sea into dry land. They went through the river on foot. There, we rejoiced in him.

kikuyu: Inni bara baraan humna isaatiin bulcha; iji isaas saboota ilaala; finciltoonni ol ol of hin qabin.
english: He rules by his might forever. His eyes watch the nations. Don’t let the rebellious rise up against him. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa saboota, Waaqa keenya eebbisaa; sagaleen isa galateeffatus haa dhagaʼamu;
english: Praise our God, you peoples! Make the sound of his praise heard,

kikuyu: inni lubbuu keenya jiraachiseera; miilla keenyas mucucaachuu oolcheera.
english: who preserves our life among the living, and doesn’t allow our feet to be moved.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati nu qorteertaatii; akkuma meetiis nu qulqulleessiteerta.
english: For you, God, have tested us. You have refined us, as silver is refined.

kikuyu: Ati kiyyootti nu galchiteerta; dugda keenya irras baʼaa keesseerta.
english: You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.

kikuyu: Akka namoonni mataa keenya yaabbatan gooteerta; nu ibiddaa fi bishaan keessa dabarre; ati garuu iddoo badhaadhummaatti nu fidde.
english: You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of abundance.

kikuyu: Anis qalma gubamu qabadhee mana qulqullummaa kee nan seena; wareega koos siif nan galcha;
english: I will come into your temple with burnt offerings. I will pay my vows to you,

kikuyu: kunis wareega yeroo ani rakkina keessa turetti arrabni koo waadaa galee afaan koos dubbatee dha.
english: which my lips promised, and my mouth spoke, when I was in distress.

kikuyu: Anis horii coccoomoo, qalma gubamu, korbeeyyii hoolaa immoo aarsaa godhee siif nan dhiʼeessa; jibootaa fi reʼoota illee aarsaa siifin dhiʼeessa.
english: I will offer to you burnt offerings of fat animals, with the offering of rams, I will offer bulls with goats. Selah.

kikuyu: Isin warri Waaqa sodaattan hundi kottaa dhaggeeffadhaa; anis waan inni naaf godhe isinitti nan hima.
english: Come and hear, all you who fear God. I will declare what he has done for my soul.

kikuyu: Ani afaan kootiin isatti nan iyye; galanni isaas arraba koo irra ture.
english: I cried to him with my mouth. He was extolled with my tongue.

kikuyu: Utuu ani garaa koo keessa cubbuu kaaʼadhee jiraadhee, silaa Gooftaan naaf hin dhagaʼu ture;
english: If I cherished sin in my heart, the Lord wouldn’t have listened.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu dhugumaan na dhaggeeffateera; sagalee kadhannaa kootiis dhagaʼeera.
english: But most certainly, God has listened. He has heard the voice of my prayer.

kikuyu: Waaqni kadhannaa koo hin didin yookaan jaalala isaa na hin dhowwatin haa eebbifamu!
english: Blessed be God, who has not turned away my prayer, nor his loving kindness from me.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Miʼa ribuutiin. Faarfannaa. Waaqni garaa nuuf laafu; nu haa eebbisus; fuula isaas nurratti haa ibsu;
english: For the Chief Musician. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be merciful to us, bless us, and cause his face to shine on us. Selah.

kikuyu: kunis akka karaan kee lafa irratti, fayyisuun kee immoo saboota hundumaa biratti beekamuuf.
english: That your way may be known on earth, and your salvation among all nations,

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, saboonni si haa jajatan; saboonni hundii si haa jajatan.
english: let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

kikuyu: Ati waan qajeelummaadhaan namoota bulchituuf, saboota lafa irraas waan geggeessituuf, saboonni haa gammadanis; ililchaniis haa faarfatan.
english: Oh let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for you will judge the peoples with equity, and govern the nations on earth. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, saboonni si haa jajatan; saboonni hundii si haa jajatan.
english: Let the peoples praise you, God. Let all the peoples praise you.

kikuyu: Lafti midhaan kenniteerti; Waaqayyo Waaqni keenyas nu eebbiseera.
english: The earth has yielded its increase. God, even our own God, will bless us.

kikuyu: Waaqni nu eebbiseera; handaarri lafaa hundi isa haa sodaatu.
english: God will bless us. All the ends of the earth shall fear him.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Waaqni haa kaʼu; diinonni isaas haa bittinnaaʼan; warri isa jibbanis fuula isaa duraa haa baqatan.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. A song. Let God arise! Let his enemies be scattered! Let them who hate him also flee before him.

kikuyu: Akkuma aarri bittinnaaʼu, ati isaan bittinneessi; akkuma gagaan ibidda duratti baqu, hamoonni fuula Waaqaa duraa haa badan.
english: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away. As wax melts before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

kikuyu: Qajeelonni garuu haa gammadan; fuula Waaqaa durattis baayʼee haa gammadan; isaan gammachuudhaan haa ililchan.
english: But let the righteous be glad. Let them rejoice before God. Yes, let them rejoice with gladness.

kikuyu: Waaqaaf faarfadhaa; faarfannaa galataa maqaa isaatiif faarfadhaa; isa duumessaan gulufu sana jajadhaa; maqaan isaa Waaqayyoo dha; fuula isaa durattis baayʼee gammadaa.
english: Sing to God! Sing praises to his name! Extol him who rides on the clouds: to the LORD, his name! Rejoice before him!

kikuyu: Waaqni warra abbaa hin qabneef abbaa, niitota dhirsoonni irraa duʼaniifis falmaa taʼe sun iddoo jireenya isaa qulqulluu keessa jira.
english: A father of the fatherless, and a defender of the widows, is God in his holy habitation.

kikuyu: Waaqni warra kophaa taʼan maatii keessa jiraachisa; warra hidhamanis mana hidhaatii baasa; finciltoonni garuu lafa gogaa irra jiraatu.
english: God sets the lonely in families. He brings out the prisoners with singing, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, gaafa ati saba kee dura baate, gaafa ati gammoojjii keessa dabarte,
english: God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness... Selah.

kikuyu: fuula Waaqaa, Waaqa Siinaa duratti, fuula Waaqaa, Waaqa Israaʼel duratti, lafti ni raafamte; samiiwwanis bokkaa roobsan.
english: The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati bokkaa baayʼee roobsite; dhaala kee kan dadhabe illee ni quubsite.
english: You, God, sent a plentiful rain. You confirmed your inheritance when it was weary.

kikuyu: Sabni kee achi qubate; yaa Waaqayyo, ati badhaadhummaa kee keessaa hiyyeeyyii soorte.
english: Your congregation lived therein. You, God, prepared your goodness for the poor.

kikuyu: Gooftaan dubbii isaa kenne; dubartoonni dubbii sana labsanis baayʼee dha:
english: The Lord announced the word. The ones who proclaim it are a great company.

kikuyu: “Mootonnii fi loltoonni ariitiin baqatan; dubartoonni qeʼee oolan boojuu qooddatan.
english: “Kings of armies flee! They flee!” She who waits at home divides the plunder,

kikuyu: Yoo gola hoolotaa gidduutti argamtan illee, isin akka gugee qoochoon ishee meetiidhaan uffifamee baalleen ishee immoo warqee calaqqisuun uffifamee ti.”
english: while you sleep among the camp fires, the wings of a dove sheathed with silver, her feathers with shining gold.

kikuyu: Yommuu Waaqni Waan Hunda Dandaʼu mootota achitti bittinneessetti, Zalmoon irratti cabbiin buʼe.
english: When the Almighty scattered kings in her, it snowed on Zalmon.

kikuyu: Yaa tulluu Baashaan, yaa tulluu surra qabeessa, yaa Tulluu Baashaan, yaa tulluu fiixee baayʼee qabu,
english: The mountains of Bashan are majestic mountains. The mountains of Bashan are rugged.

kikuyu: yaa tulluu fiixee baayʼee qabdu, ati maaliif tulluu Waaqni bulchuuf filate, iddoo Waaqayyo bara baraan jiraatu sana hinaaffaadhaan ilaalta?
english: Why do you look in envy, you rugged mountains, at the mountain where God chooses to reign? Yes, the LORD will dwell there forever.

kikuyu: Gaariiwwan Waaqaa kuma hedduu dha; isaan kumaatama yeroo kumaatamaa ti; Gooftaanis Siinaadhaa gara iddoo qulqulluu dhufeera.
english: The chariots of God are tens of thousands and thousands of thousands. The Lord is among them, from Sinai, into the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Ati yommuu ol gubbaa baatetti boojuu baayʼee fudhate; yaa Waaqayyo, yaa Waaqi, ati achi jiraachuuf jettee, namoota irraa, finciltoota irraas kennaa fudhatte.
english: You have ascended on high. You have led away captives. You have received gifts among people, yes, among the rebellious also, that the LORD God might dwell there.

kikuyu: Gooftaan guyyuma guyyaan baʼaa keenya baatu, Waaqni Fayyissaa keenya taʼe sun haa eebbifamu.
english: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burdens, even the God who is our salvation. Selah.

kikuyu: Waaqni keenya Waaqa fayyinaa ti; duʼa jalaa baʼuunis Waaqayyo Goofticha biraa dhufa.
english: God is to us a God of deliverance. To GOD, the Lord, belongs escape from death.

kikuyu: Waaqni dhugumaan mataa diina isaa, gubbee mataa warra cubbuu isaaniitti fufanii kan rifeensa qabu ni caccabsa.
english: But God will strike through the head of his enemies, the hairy scalp of such a one as still continues in his guiltiness.

kikuyu: Gooftaan akkana jedha; “Ani deebisee Baashaanii isaan nan fida; tuujuba galaanaa keessaas deebisee isaan nan fida;
english: The Lord said, “I will bring you again from Bashan, I will bring you again from the depths of the sea,

kikuyu: kunis akka ati dhiiga diinota keetii miilla keetiin borcituuf; arrabni saroota keetiis akka qooda isaanii qabaatuuf.”
english: that you may crush them, dipping your foot in blood, that the tongues of your dogs may have their portion from your enemies.”

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, hiriirri kee mulʼateera; hiriirri Waaqa kootiitii fi mootii kootii iddoo qulqulluutti ol galeera.
english: They have seen your processions, God, even the processions of my God, my King, into the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Fuula duraan faarfattoota, dugda duubaan immoo warra muuziiqaa taphatantu ture; dubartoonni dibbee rukutanis gidduu isaanii turan.
english: The singers went before, the minstrels followed after, among the ladies playing with tambourines,

kikuyu: Waldaa guddaa keessatti Waaqa jajadhaa; yaaʼii Israaʼel keessattis Waaqayyoon jajadhaa.
english: “Bless God in the congregations, even the Lord in the assembly of Israel!”

kikuyu: Beniyaam gosti xinnichi isaan dura deema; tuunni ilmaan mootota Yihuudaas achi turan; ilmaan mootota Zebuuloonii fi Niftaalemis achi turan.
english: There is little Benjamin, their ruler, the princes of Judah, their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, humna kee ajaji; yaa Waaqa keenya, akkuma duraan goote sana jabina kee nu argisiisi.
english: Your God has commanded your strength. Strengthen, God, that which you have done for us.

kikuyu: Sababii mana qulqullummaa keetii kan Yerusaalem keessaatiif mootonni kennaa siif fidu.
english: Because of your temple at Jerusalem, kings will bring presents to you.

kikuyu: Bineensota shambaqqoo keessaa, karra korommii jabboota sabootaa keessaas ifadhu. Warra meetii fidan gad deebisi. Warra waraanatti gammadanis bittinneessi.
english: Rebuke the wild animal of the reeds, the multitude of the bulls with the calves of the peoples. Trample under foot the bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.

kikuyu: Ergamoonni Gibxi ni dhufu; Itoophiyaanis daftee harka ishee Waaqatti balʼifatti.
english: Princes shall come out of Egypt. Ethiopia shall hurry to stretch out her hands to God.

kikuyu: Yaa mootummoota lafaa, Waaqa faarfadhaa; faarfannaa galataas Gooftaadhaaf faarfadhaa;
english: Sing to God, you kingdoms of the earth! Sing praises to the Lord— Selah—

kikuyu: isa samiiwwan durii keessa gulufu, isa sagalee jabaadhaan qaqawweessaʼu sana faarfadhaa.
english: to him who rides on the heaven of heavens, which are of old; behold, he utters his voice, a mighty voice.

kikuyu: Waaqa ulfinni isaa Israaʼel irra jiru, isa miidhaginni isaa samiiwwan keessa jiru sana humna isaa labsaa.
english: Ascribe strength to God! His excellency is over Israel, his strength is in the skies.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati iddoo qulqullummaa keetiitti sodaachisaa dha; Waaqni Israaʼel saba isaatiif humnaa fi jabina ni kenna. Waaqni haa eebbifamu!
english: You are awesome, God, in your sanctuaries. The God of Israel gives strength and power to his people. Praise be to God!

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo “Daraaraatiin.” Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqi, ati na baasi; bishaan ol dhufee morma na gaʼeeraatii.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Lilies.” By David. Save me, God, for the waters have come up to my neck!

kikuyu: Ani raaree keessa, lafa iddoon miilla dhaabatan hin jirre keessa seeneera. Ani tuujuba bishaanii keessa seeneera; lolaanis narra garagaleera.
english: I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold. I have come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

kikuyu: Ani iyyuudhaan dadhabeera; laagaan koo babbaqaqeera; iji koo, Waaqa koo eeggachuudhaan dadhabeera.
english: I am weary with my crying. My throat is dry. My eyes fail looking for my God.

kikuyu: Warri lafumaa kaʼanii na jibban rifeensa mataa kootii caalaa baayʼatu; warri na ajjeesuu barbaadan, warri akkasumaan diina koo taʼan baayʼee dha. Ani akkan waan hin hatin deebisu dirqameera.
english: Those who hate me without a cause are more than the hairs of my head. Those who want to cut me off, being my enemies wrongfully, are mighty. I have to restore what I didn’t take away.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, ati gowwummaa koo ni beekta; yakki koos si duraa hin dhokatu.
english: God, you know my foolishness. My sins aren’t hidden from you.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandeessu, warri abdii sirra kaaʼatan, sababii kootiif hin qaanaʼin; yaa Waaqa Israaʼel, warri si barbaadan, sababii kootiif hin qaaneffamin.
english: Don’t let those who wait for you be shamed through me, Lord GOD of Armies. Don’t let those who seek you be brought to dishonor through me, God of Israel.

kikuyu: Ani siif jedhee tuffii obseeraatii; qaaniinis fuula koo haguugeera.
english: Because for your sake, I have borne reproach. Shame has covered my face.

kikuyu: Ani obboloota kootti keessummaa, ilmaan haadha kootiittis alagaa dha;
english: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother’s children.

kikuyu: Hinaaffaan mana keetii na guggubeeraatii; arrabsoon warra si arrabsaniis narra buʼeera.
english: For the zeal of your house consumes me. The reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.

kikuyu: Booʼuu fi soomuun koo, arrabsoo natti taʼe.
english: When I wept and I fasted, that was to my reproach.

kikuyu: Yommuu ani wayyaa gaddaa uffadhetti, namoonni natti qoosu.
english: When I made sackcloth my clothing, I became a byword to them.

kikuyu: Warri karra dura tataaʼan natti qoosu; machooftonnis waaʼee kootiin sirbu.
english: Those who sit in the gate talk about me. I am the song of the drunkards.

kikuyu: Ani garuu yaa Waaqayyo, yeroo ati filattutti sin kadhadha; yaa Waaqi, jaalala kee guddichaan fayyina kee kan dhugaatiinis deebii naaf kenni.
english: But as for me, my prayer is to you, LORD, in an acceptable time. God, in the abundance of your loving kindness, answer me in the truth of your salvation.

kikuyu: Akka ani hin liqimfamneef, raaree keessaa na baasi; warra na jibban jalaa, bishaanota gad fagoo keessaas na baasi.
english: Deliver me out of the mire, and don’t let me sink. Let me be delivered from those who hate me, and out of the deep waters.

kikuyu: Ati akka lolaan na hin fudhanne, akka tuujubni na hin liqimsine, akka boollis afaan isaa natti hin cufanne godhi.
english: Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, gaarummaa jaalala keetiitiin deebii naaf kenni; araara kee guddichaanis natti garagali.
english: Answer me, LORD, for your loving kindness is good. According to the multitude of your tender mercies, turn to me.

kikuyu: Fuula kee tajaajilaa kee duraa hin dhokfatin; waan ani rakkina keessa jiruuf dafiitii deebii naaf kenni.
english: Don’t hide your face from your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me speedily!

kikuyu: Natti dhiʼaadhuutii na furi; xiiqii diinota kootiif jedhii na baasi.
english: Draw near to my soul and redeem it. Ransom me because of my enemies.

kikuyu: Ati akka ani hammam tuffatamee, salphifamee fi akka ani qaaneffame ni beekta; diinonni koo hundinuus fuula koo dura jiru.
english: You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.

kikuyu: Arrabsoon garaa koo cabse; anis abdii kutadheera. Ani nama garaa naaf laafu nan barbaade; garuu nan dhabe; nama na jajjabeessus nan barbaade; garuu tokko illee hin arganne.
english: Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for comforters, but I found none.

kikuyu: Nyaata kootti hadhooftuu makan; akka ani dhuguuf immoo waan dhangaggaaʼaa naa kennan.
english: They also gave me poison for my food. In my thirst, they gave me vinegar to drink.

kikuyu: Maaddiin isaanii iddaa isaanitti haa taʼu; adabaa fi kiyyoo isaanitti haa taʼu.
english: Let their table before them become a snare. May it become a retribution and a trap.

kikuyu: Akka arguu hin dandeenyeef iji isaanii haa haguuggamu; dugdi isaaniis bara baraan haa goophatu.
english: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they can’t see. Let their backs be continually bent.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsa kee isaan irratti dhangalaasi; aariin kee bobaʼaan sunis isaan irra haa buʼu.
english: Pour out your indignation on them. Let the fierceness of your anger overtake them.

kikuyu: Qeʼeen isaanii haa onu; namni dunkaana isaanii keessa jiraatu tokko iyyuu hin hafin.
english: Let their habitation be desolate. Let no one dwell in their tents.

kikuyu: Isaan warra ati madeessite sana ni ariʼatuutii; waaʼee dhukkubbii warra ati miite sanaas ni odeessu.
english: For they persecute him whom you have wounded. They tell of the sorrow of those whom you have hurt.

kikuyu: Yakka irratti yakka isaanitti dabali; isaan gara qajeelumma keetii hin dhufin.
english: Charge them with crime upon crime. Don’t let them come into your righteousness.

kikuyu: Maqaan isaanii kitaaba jireenyaa keessaa haa haqamu; qajeeltota wajjinis hin galmeeffamin.
english: Let them be blotted out of the book of life, and not be written with the righteous.

kikuyu: Ani garuu dhiphinaa fi rakkina keessan jira; yaa Waaqi, fayyinni kee ol na haa qabu.
english: But I am in pain and distress. Let your salvation, God, protect me.

kikuyu: Ani faarfannaadhaan maqaa Waaqaa nan galateeffadha; galataanis ulfina nan kennaaf.
english: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

kikuyu: Kunis sangaa caalaa, korma gaanfaa fi kottee qabu dhiʼeessuu caalaa Waaqayyoon gammachiisa.
english: It will please the LORD better than an ox, or a bull that has horns and hoofs.

kikuyu: Hiyyeeyyiin waan kana arganii ni gammadu; isin warri Waaqa barbaaddan garaan keessan jiraata haa taʼu!
english: The humble have seen it, and are glad. You who seek after God, let your heart live.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo rakkattoota ni dhagaʼa; namoota isaa warra hidhamanis hin tuffatu.
english: For the LORD hears the needy, and doesn’t despise his captive people.

kikuyu: Samii fi lafti, galaanonnii fi wanni isaan keessa jiraatan hundinuu isa haa leellissan.
english: Let heaven and earth praise him; the seas, and everything that moves therein!

kikuyu: Waaqni Xiyoonin ni fayyisaatii; magaalaawwan Yihuudaas deebisee ni ijaara. Sabni isaas achi qubata; ni dhaalas.
english: For God will save Zion, and build the cities of Judah. They shall settle there, and own it.

kikuyu: Sanyiin tajaajiltoota isaa magaalattii ni dhaalu; warri maqaa isaa jaallatanis achi jiraatu.
english: The children also of his servants shall inherit it. Those who love his name shall dwell therein.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawiti. Yaa Waaqi, na fayyisuuf ariifadhu; yaa Waaqayyo, na gargaaruuf dafii kottu.
english: For the Chief Musician. By David. A reminder. Hurry, God, to deliver me. Come quickly to help me, LORD.

kikuyu: Warri lubbuu koo galaafachuu barbaadan hundinuu, haa qaanaʼan; haa burjaajaʼanis; warri badii koo hawwan hundi qaanaʼanii duubatti haa deebiʼan.
english: Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.

kikuyu: Warri, “Baga! Baga!” anaan jedhan qaanaʼanii duubatti haa deebiʼan.
english: Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”

kikuyu: Warri si barbaadan hundinuu garuu sitti gammadanii haa ililchan; warri fayyisuu kee jaallatan, yeroo hunda, “Waaqni guddaa dha!” haa jedhan.
english: Let all those who seek you rejoice and be glad in you. Let those who love your salvation continually say, “Let God be exalted!”

kikuyu: Ani garuu hiyyeessaa fi rakkataa dha; yaa Waaqi, dafii na qaqqabi. Ati gargaaraa koo fi fayyisaa koo ti; yaa Waaqayyo hin turin.
english: But I am poor and needy. Come to me quickly, God. You are my help and my deliverer. LORD, don’t delay.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani kooluu sitti galeera; ati gonkumaa na hin qaanessin.
english: In you, LORD, I take refuge. Never let me be disappointed.

kikuyu: Qajeelummaa keetiin na baasi; na oolchis; gurra kee gara kootti qabi; na fayyisis.
english: Deliver me in your righteousness, and rescue me. Turn your ear to me, and save me.

kikuyu: Ati kattaa ani kooluu itti galu, iddoo ani yeroo hunda itti baqadhu naa taʼi; ati waan kattaa koo fi daʼoo koo taateef, na baraaruuf ajaja kenni.
english: Be to me a rock of refuge to which I may always go. Give the command to save me, for you are my rock and my fortress.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa ko, harka nama hamaa, qabaa nama jalʼaatii fi gara jabeessaa keessaa na baasi.
english: Rescue me, my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa, ati abdii kootii; ijoollummaa kootii kaaftees ati Waaqa ani amanadhuu dha.
english: For you are my hope, Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.

kikuyu: Ani gaafan dhaladhee jalqabee sitti irkadheera; gadameessa haadha koo keessaas situ na baase. Ani yeroo hunda sin galateeffadha.
english: I have relied on you from the womb. You are he who took me out of my mother’s womb. I will always praise you.

kikuyu: Ani namoota baayʼeedhaaf mallattoo taʼeera; ati garuu daʼoo koo isa jabaa dha.
english: I am a marvel to many, but you are my strong refuge.

kikuyu: Afaan koo guyyaa guutuu, galataa fi ulfina keetiin guutama.
english: My mouth shall be filled with your praise, with your honor all day long.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani dulloomutti ati na hin gatin; yeroo humni koo dhumuttis na hin dhiisin.
english: Don’t reject me in my old age. Don’t forsake me when my strength fails.

kikuyu: Diinonni koo natti mariʼatuutii; warri na ajjeesuuf riphanii eeggatanis walii wajjin natti mariʼatu.
english: For my enemies talk about me. Those who watch for my soul conspire together,

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Waaqni isa dhiiseera; namni isa oolchu tokko iyyuu hin jiruutii faana buʼaatii qabaa” jedhu.
english: saying, “God has forsaken him. Pursue and take him, for no one will rescue him.”

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, narraa hin fagaatin; yaa Waaqa ko, na gargaaruuf dafii kottu.
english: God, don’t be far from me. My God, hurry to help me.

kikuyu: Warri na himatan qaanaʼanii haa badan; warri na miidhuu barbaadanis tuffii fi salphina haa uffatan.
english: Let my accusers be disappointed and consumed. Let them be covered with disgrace and scorn who want to harm me.

kikuyu: Ani garuu yeroo hundumaa abdii qaba; ittuma caalchisees sin galateeffadha.
english: But I will always hope, and will add to all of your praise.

kikuyu: Ani yoo hammam akka inni gaʼu beekuu baadhe illee, afaan koo waaʼee qajeelummaa keetiitii fi waaʼee fayyisuu keetii guyyaa guutuu ni odeessa.
english: My mouth will tell about your righteousness, and of your salvation all day, though I don’t know its full measure.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa, ani dhufee hojii kee humna qabeessa sana nan odeessa; ani qajeelummaa kee qofa labsa.
english: I will come with the mighty acts of the Lord GOD. I will make mention of your righteousness, even of yours alone.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, ati ijoollummaa kootii jalqabdee na barsiifteerta; anis hamma harʼaatti hojii kee dinqisiisaa sana nan labsa.
english: God, you have taught me from my youth. Until now, I have declared your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, yeroo ani dulloomee mataan koo arrii taʼutti illee, hamma ani humna kee dhaloota kanatti, jabina kees dhaloota dhufuuf jiru hundatti labsuutti, ati na hin dhiisin.
english: Yes, even when I am old and gray-haired, God, don’t forsake me, until I have declared your strength to the next generation, your might to everyone who is to come.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, qajeelummaan kee samiiwwan bira gaʼa; ati waan gurguddaa hojjetteerta; yaa Waaqi, kan akka keetii eenyu?
english: God, your righteousness also reaches to the heavens. You have done great things. God, who is like you?

kikuyu: Ati rakkinaa fi dhiphina baayʼee na argisiifteerta; taʼus jireenya koo deebiftee ni haaromsita, qilee lafaa keessaas deebiftee ol na baafta.
english: You, who have shown us many and bitter troubles, you will let me live. You will bring us up again from the depths of the earth.

kikuyu: Ulfina koo ni guddifta; amma illee na jajjabeessita.
english: Increase my honor and comfort me again.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa ko, ani amanamummaa keetiif, kiraaraan sin faarfadha; Yaa Qulqullicha Israaʼel ani kiraaraan faarfannaa galataa siif faarfadha.
english: I will also praise you with the harp for your faithfulness, my God. I sing praises to you with the lyre, Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Yommuu ani faarfannaa galataa siif faarfadhutti, hidhiin koo, lubbuun koo kan ati furtes guddisanii ni ililchu.
english: My lips shall shout for joy! My soul, which you have redeemed, sings praises to you!

kikuyu: Warri na miidhuu barbaadan, waan qaanaʼanii burjaajaʼaniif arrabni koo guyyaa guutuu qajeelummaa kee odeessa.
english: My tongue will also talk about your righteousness all day long, for they are disappointed, and they are confounded, who want to harm me.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Solomoon. Yaa Waaqi, murtii kee mootiidhaaf, qajeelumma kee immoo ilma mootiitiif kenni.
english: By Solomon. God, give the king your justice; your righteousness to the royal son.

kikuyu: Innis saba keetiif qajeelummaadhaan murteessa; hiyyeeyyiifis murtii qajeelaa kenna.
english: He will judge your people with righteousness, and your poor with justice.

kikuyu: Tulluuwwan badhaadhummaa, gaarran immoo ija qajeelummaa sabaaf haa fidan.
english: The mountains shall bring prosperity to the people. The hills bring the fruit of righteousness.

kikuyu: Inni hiyyeeyyii saba keessa jiraataniif ni falma; ijoollee rakkattootaa ni oolcha; cunqursituu immoo ni barbadeessa.
english: He will judge the poor of the people. He will save the children of the needy, and will break the oppressor in pieces.

kikuyu: Namoonni hamma aduun jiraattuu fi hamma jiʼi jiraatutti, dhalootaa hamma dhalootaatti si sodaatu.
english: They shall fear you while the sun endures; and as long as the moon, throughout all generations.

kikuyu: Inni akkuma bokkaa marga haamame irratti roobuu, akkuma tiifuu lafa jiisuuttis ni dhufa.
english: He will come down like rain on the mown grass, as showers that water the earth.

kikuyu: Bara isaa keessa qajeelummaan ni daraara; nageenyis hamma jiʼi dhabamutti ni baayʼata.
english: In his days, the righteous shall flourish, and abundance of peace, until the moon is no more.

kikuyu: Innis galaanaa hamma galaanaatti, Laga Efraaxiisii hamma moggaa lafaatti ni bulcha.
english: He shall have dominion also from sea to sea, from the River to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Warri gammoojjii keessa jiraatan fuula isaa duratti ni sagadu; diinonni isaas biyyoo arraabu.
english: Those who dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him. His enemies shall lick the dust.

kikuyu: Mootonni Tarshiishii fi mootonni biyyoota qarqarawwan galaana fagoo gibira isaaf ni fidu; mootonni Shebaatii fi mootonni Saabaa kennaa ni fiduuf.
english: The kings of Tarshish and of the islands will bring tribute. The kings of Sheba and Seba shall offer gifts.

kikuyu: Mootonni hundinuus isaaf ni sagadu; saboonni hundinuus isa ni tajaajilu.
english: Yes, all kings shall fall down before him. All nations shall serve him.

kikuyu: Inni nama rakkatee gara isaatti iyyu, hiyyeessaa fi nama gargaarsa hin qabne ni baraaraatii.
english: For he will deliver the needy when he cries; the poor, who has no helper.

kikuyu: Nama dadhabaa fi rakkataaf garaa lafa; nama rakkataas duʼa jalaa baasa.
english: He will have pity on the poor and needy. He will save the souls of the needy.

kikuyu: Lubbuu isaaniis hacuuccaa fi cunqursaa jalaa ni fura; dhiigni isaanii fuula isaa duratti gatii guddaa qabaatii.
english: He will redeem their soul from oppression and violence. Their blood will be precious in his sight.

kikuyu: Umuriin isaa haa dheeratu; warqeen Shebaa isaaf haa kennamu. Yeroo hunda Waaqa isaaf haa kadhatan; guyyaa guutuus isa haa eebbisan.
english: He will live; and Sheba’s gold will be given to him. Men will pray for him continually. They will bless him all day long.

kikuyu: Lafa irratti midhaan akka malee haa baayʼatu; fiixee tulluuwwanii irras asii fi achi haa raafamu. Iji isaa akka Libaanoon haa tolu; akka marga lafaas haa misu.
english: Abundance of grain shall be throughout the land. Its fruit sways like Lebanon. Let it flourish, thriving like the grass of the field.

kikuyu: Maqaan isaa bara baraan haa jiraatu; Akkuma aduus itti fufee haa jiraatu. Saboonni hundinuu isaan ni eebbifamu; jarris eebbifamaa jedhaanii isa waamu.
english: His name endures forever. His name continues as long as the sun. Men shall be blessed by him. All nations will call him blessed.

kikuyu: Inni kophaa isaa waan dinqii hojjetu, Waaqayyo Waaqni, Waaqni Israaʼel haa eebbifamu.
english: Praise be to the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.

kikuyu: Maqaa isaa ulfaataa sanaaf bara baraan galanni haa taʼu; lafti hundinuu ulfina isaatiin haa guutamu.
english: Blessed be his glorious name forever! Let the whole earth be filled with his glory! Amen and amen.

kikuyu: Kadhannaan Daawit ilma Isseey as irratti xumurame.
english: This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Asaaf. Dhugumaan Waaqni Israaʼeliif, warra garaan isaanii qulqulluu taʼeef gaarii dha.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.

kikuyu: Ani garuu miilli koo gufachuu gaʼee, faanni koos mucucaachuu gaʼee ture.
english: But as for me, my feet were almost gone. My steps had nearly slipped.

kikuyu: Ani yommuun badhaadhummaa hamootaa argetti, of tuultotatti hinaafeen tureetii.
english: For I was envious of the arrogant, when I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

kikuyu: Isaan hin dhiphatan; dhagni isaaniis fayyaa dha; cimaa dhas.
english: For there are no struggles in their death, but their strength is firm.

kikuyu: Rakkinni nama biraatti dhufu isaanitti hin dhufu; isaan akka namoota kaanii dhukkubaan hin dhaʼaman.
english: They are free from burdens of men, neither are they plagued like other men.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu of tuulummaan faaya morma isaanii ti; fincilas akka wayyaatti uffatu.
