english: Therefore pride is like a chain around their neck. Violence covers them like a garment.

kikuyu: Iji isaanii coomee alatti dhiibama; hamminni isaan garaatti yaadan dhuma hin qabu.
english: Their eyes bulge with fat. Their minds pass the limits of conceit.

kikuyu: Isaan ni qoosu; hamminas ni dubbatu; of tuulaa cunqursaadhaan nama doorsisu.
english: They scoff and speak with malice. In arrogance, they threaten oppression.

kikuyu: Afaan isaanii samii falmata; arrabni isaaniis lafa dhaala.
english: They have set their mouth in the heavens. Their tongue walks through the earth.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu sabni gara isaaniitti dachaʼee bishaan baayʼee dhuga.
english: Therefore their people return to them, and they drink up waters of abundance.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Waaqni akkamitti beekuu dandaʼaa? Waaqni Waan Hundaa Olii beekumsa qabaa?” jedhu.
english: They say, “How does God know? Is there knowledge in the Most High?”

kikuyu: Egaa namoonni hamoon akkana; isaan yeroo hunda yaaddoo malee jiraatu; badhaadhummaanis guddachaa deemu.
english: Behold, these are the wicked. Being always at ease, they increase in riches.

kikuyu: Yoos ani akkasumaan garaa koo qulqullinaan eeggadhee harka koos akkasumaan dhiqadhe kaa!
english: Surely I have cleansed my heart in vain, and washed my hands in innocence,

kikuyu: Ani guyyaa guutuu dhaʼameera; ganama ganamas adabameera.
english: For all day long I have been plagued, and punished every morning.

kikuyu: Ani utuu, “Akkana nan dubbadha” jedhee jiraadhee silaa ijoollee kee nan yakkan ture.
english: If I had said, “I will speak thus”, behold, I would have betrayed the generation of your children.

kikuyu: Garuu yommuu ani waan kana hunda hubachuu yaaletti, wanni kun hojii dadhabsiisaa natti taʼe.
english: When I tried to understand this, it was too painful for me—

kikuyu: Kunis hamma ani iddoo qulqullummaa Waaqaa seenutti ture; ergasiis ani galgala isaanii nan hubadhe.
english: until I entered God’s sanctuary, and considered their latter end.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan ati iddoo mucucaataa irra isaan dhaabde; akka isaan kufanii caccabaniifis gad isaan darbatte.
english: Surely you set them in slippery places. You throw them down to destruction.

kikuyu: Isaan akkamiin guutumaan guutuutti sodaadhaan fudhatamanii akkuma tasaa barbadaaʼan!
english: How they are suddenly destroyed! They are completely swept away with terrors.

kikuyu: Akkuma abjuun yeroo namni hirribaa dammaqutti taʼu sana, atis yaa Gooftaa, akkasuma yommuu ol kaatu, hawwii garaa isaanii ni busheessita.
english: As a dream when one wakes up, so, Lord, when you awake, you will despise their fantasies.

kikuyu: Yommuu lubbuun koo gadditee onneen koos waraanamtetti,
english: For my soul was grieved. I was embittered in my heart.

kikuyu: ani gowwaa fi wallaalaan ture; fuula kee durattis akka horii nan taʼe.
english: I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.

kikuyu: Taʼus ani yeroo hunda si wajjinan jira; atis harka koo mirgaa ni qabda.
english: Nevertheless, I am continually with you. You have held my right hand.

kikuyu: Ati gorsa keetiin na qajeelchita; ergasii immoo ulfinatti na galchita.
english: You will guide me with your counsel, and afterward receive me to glory.

kikuyu: Ani samii keessaa eenyunan qaba? Lafa irraas si malee homaa hin fedhu.
english: Whom do I have in heaven? There is no one on earth whom I desire besides you.

kikuyu: Foon koo fi onneen koo dadhabuu dandaʼu; Waaqni garuu jabina garaa koo ti; bara baraanis inni qooda koo.
english: My flesh and my heart fails, but God is the strength of my heart and my portion forever.

kikuyu: Warri sirraa fagoo jiran ni badu; atis warra siif hin amanamne hunda ni balleessita.
english: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.

kikuyu: Akka ani yaadutti garuu Waaqatti dhiʼaachuun gaarii dha; Waaqayyo Gooftaa daʼoo koo godhadheera; ani hojii kee hunda nan labsa.
english: But it is good for me to come close to God. I have made the Lord GOD my refuge, that I may tell of all your works.

kikuyu: Maskiilii Asaaf. Yaa Waaqi, ati maaliif bara baraan nu gatte? Aariin kee maaliif hoolota ati bobbaafte irratti akka malee bobaʼa?
english: A contemplation by Asaph. God, why have you rejected us forever? Why does your anger smolder against the sheep of your pasture?

kikuyu: Saba ati dur filatte, gosa dhaala keetii, warra ati furte, Tulluu Xiyoon iddoo ati jiraattes yaadadhu.
english: Remember your congregation, which you purchased of old, which you have redeemed to be the tribe of your inheritance: Mount Zion, in which you have lived.

kikuyu: Tarkaanfii kee gara waan bara baraan diigameetti qajeelfadhu; diinni waan mana qulqullummaa keessa jiru hunda barbadeesseera.
english: Lift up your feet to the perpetual ruins, all the evil that the enemy has done in the sanctuary.

kikuyu: Diinonni kee iddoo qulqulluu kee keessatti bookkisan; mallattoo isaaniis mallattoo godhanii dhaabbatan.
english: Your adversaries have roared in the middle of your assembly. They have set up their standards as signs.

kikuyu: Isaan nama bosona keessatti muka muruuf qottoo ol fudhatu fakkaatu.
english: They behaved like men wielding axes, cutting through a thicket of trees.

kikuyu: Isaanis waan soofame hunda, qottoo fi burrusaan caccabsan.
english: Now they break all its carved work down with hatchet and hammers.

kikuyu: Isaan mana qulqullummaa kee guban; lafa jireenya Maqaa keetiis ni xureessan.
english: They have burned your sanctuary to the ground. They have profaned the dwelling place of your Name.

kikuyu: Garaa isaanii keessatti, “Nu guutumaan guutuutti isaan barbadeessina!” jedhan. Iddoo Waaqni biyyattii keessatti itti waaqeffamaa ture hundumas ni guban.
english: They said in their heart, “We will crush them completely.” They have burned up all the places in the land where God was worshiped.

kikuyu: Mallattoon dinqii nuu hin kennamne; siʼachi raajiin tokko illee hin jiru; wanni kun hamma yoomiitti akka turu nu keessaa namni beeku hin jiru.
english: We see no miraculous signs. There is no longer any prophet, neither is there among us anyone who knows how long.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, hamma yoomiitti diinni sitti qoosa? Amajaajiinis bara baraan maqaa kee xureessaa?
english: How long, God, shall the adversary reproach? Shall the enemy blaspheme your name forever?

kikuyu: Ati maaliif harka kee, harka kee mirgaa dachaafatta? Harka kee bobaa jalaa baafadhuutii isaan barbadeessi!
english: Why do you draw back your hand, even your right hand? Take it from your chest and consume them!

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, ati durumaa jalqabdee mootii koo ti; lafa irrattis hojii fayyinaa hojjetta.
english: Yet God is my King of old, working salvation throughout the earth.

kikuyu: Situ humna keetiin galaana gargar qoode; ati bishaan keessattis mataa bineensa jawwee fakkaatuu caccabsite.
english: You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.

kikuyu: Situ mataa Lewaataan caccabsee nyaata godhee uumamawwan gammoojjii jiraataniif kenne.
english: You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.

kikuyu: Situ burqaawwanii fi bishaan yaaʼuuf karaa bane; ati laga yeroo hunda yaaʼu illee gogsiteerta.
english: You opened up spring and stream. You dried up mighty rivers.

kikuyu: Guyyaan kan kee ti; halkanis keetuma; ati aduu fi jiʼa uumteerta.
english: The day is yours, the night is also yours. You have prepared the light and the sun.

kikuyu: Situ daarii lafaa hunda dhaabe; ati bonaa fi ganna uumteerta.
english: You have set all the boundaries of the earth. You have made summer and winter.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, akkamitti akka diinni sitti qoosu, akkamitti akka namoonni gowwoonnis maqaa kee xureessan yaadadhu.
english: Remember this, that the enemy has mocked you, LORD. Foolish people have blasphemed your name.

kikuyu: Lubbuu gugee keetii dabarsitee bineensa bosonaatti hin kennin; jireenya saba kee hiyyoomee bara baraan hin irraanfatin.
english: Don’t deliver the soul of your dove to wild beasts. Don’t forget the life of your poor forever.

kikuyu: Kakuu kee eegi; iddoon lafaa dukkanaaʼaan hundinuu gooliidhaan guutameeraatii.
english: Honor your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the earth.

kikuyu: Warri cunqurfaman qaanaʼanii duubatti hin deebiʼin; hiyyeeyyii fi rakkattoonni maqaa kee haa galateeffatan.
english: Don’t let the oppressed return ashamed. Let the poor and needy praise your name.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi kaʼi; dubbii kees falmadhu; akka gowwoonni guyyaa guutuu sitti qoosan yaadadhu.
english: Arise, God! Plead your own cause. Remember how the foolish man mocks you all day.

kikuyu: Dhaadachuu diinota keetii, bookkisuu diina keetii kan gargar hin cinne sana hin dagatin.
english: Don’t forget the voice of your adversaries. The tumult of those who rise up against you ascends continually.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Yeedaloo, “Hin balleessin” jedhuun faarfatame. Faarfannaa Asaaf. Yaa Waaqi, nu si galateeffanna; sababii Maqaan kee dhiʼoo taʼeef galata siif galchina; namoonni waaʼee dinqii hojii keetii odeessu.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm by Asaph. A song. We give thanks to you, God. We give thanks, for your Name is near. Men tell about your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Ati akkana jetta; “Ani yeroo murteeffame nan filadha; kan qajeelummaadhaan muru ana.
english: When I choose the appointed time, I will judge blamelessly.

kikuyu: Yommuu laftii fi sabni ishee hundi raafamanitti, kan utubaa ishee jabeessee qabu ana.
english: The earth and all its inhabitants quake. I firmly hold its pillars. Selah.

kikuyu: Ani of tuultotaan akkana nan jedha; ‘Of hin jajinaa.’ Hamootaanis, ‘Gaanfa keessan ol hin qabatinaa.
english: I said to the arrogant, “Don’t boast!” I said to the wicked, “Don’t lift up the horn.

kikuyu: Gaanfa keessan samiitti hin kaasinaa; morma keessan dheereffattanii hin dubbatinaa.’ ”
english: Don’t lift up your horn on high. Don’t speak with a stiff neck.”

kikuyu: Ulfinni baʼa biiftuutii yookaan lixa biiftuutii yookaan lafa onaatii hin dhufuutii.
english: For neither from the east, nor from the west, nor yet from the south, comes exaltation.

kikuyu: Garuu kan murtii kennu Waaqa; inni nama tokko gad buusa; kaan immoo ol baasa.
english: But God is the judge. He puts down one, and lifts up another.

kikuyu: Harka Waaqayyoo keessa, xoofoo wayinii urgooftuudhaan walitti makame kan hoomachaan guutame tokkotu jira; inni wayinii sana gad naqa; hamoonni lafaa hundinuu utuu siicoo isaa illee hin hambisin xuruurfatanii dhugu.
english: For in the LORD’s hand there is a cup, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours it out. Indeed the wicked of the earth drink and drink it to its very dregs.

kikuyu: Ani garuu bara baraan waan kana nan labsa; Waaqa Yaaqoobis nan faarfadha.
english: But I will declare this forever: I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

kikuyu: Gaanfa hamoota hundaa nan caccabsa; gaanfi qajeeltotaa garuu ol ol jedha.
english: I will cut off all the horns of the wicked, but the horns of the righteous shall be lifted up.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Miʼa Ribuutiin. Faarfannaa Asaaf. Yihuudaa keessatti Waaqni beekamaa dha; maqaan isaas Israaʼel keessatti guddaa dha.
english: For the Chief Musician. On stringed instruments. A Psalm by Asaph. A song. In Judah, God is known. His name is great in Israel.

kikuyu: Dunkaanni isaa Saalem keessa, iddoon jireenya isaa Xiyoon keessa jira.
english: His tabernacle is also in Salem. His dwelling place in Zion.

kikuyu: Innis achitti xiyya bobaʼuu fi gaachana, goraadee fi meeshaawwan waraanaa caccabse.
english: There he broke the flaming arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the weapons of war. Selah.

kikuyu: Ati ifa uffattee miidhagdeerta; ati tulluuwwan bara baraa caalaa Surra qabeessa.
english: Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.

kikuyu: Gootonni boojiʼamaniiru; hirribaanis fudhatamaniiru; duultota keessaas namni tokko iyyuu harka sochoofachuu hin dandeenye.
english: Valiant men lie plundered, they have slept their last sleep. None of the men of war can lift their hands.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa Yaaqoob, ifannaa keetiin fardeenii fi warri fardeen yaabbatan of wallaalaniiru.
english: At your rebuke, God of Jacob, both chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

kikuyu: Siʼi qofatu sodaatamuu qaba. Yommuu ati aartu eenyutu fuula kee dura dhaabachuu dandaʼaa?
english: You, even you, are to be feared. Who can stand in your sight when you are angry?

kikuyu: Ati samii irraa murtii kennite; laftis ni sodaatte; ni calʼiftes;
english: You pronounced judgment from heaven. The earth feared, and was silent,

kikuyu: yaa Waaqi, wanni kunis yommuu ati murtii kennuudhaaf, rakkattoota biyyattii fayyisuuf kaatetti taʼe.
english: when God arose to judgment, to save all the afflicted ones of the earth. Selah.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsi ati namatti dheekkamtu dhugumaan ulfina siif fida; warra dheekkamsa kee irraa hafanis ni hidhatta.
english: Surely the wrath of man praises you. The survivors of your wrath are restrained.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqa keessaniif wareegaa; wareegichas guuttadhaa; warri naannoo isaa jiraatan hundinuus Waaqa sodaatamuu qabu sanaaf kennaawwan haa fidan.
english: Make vows to the LORD your God, and fulfill them! Let all of his neighbors bring presents to him who is to be feared.

kikuyu: Inni hafuura bulchitootaa ni cabsa; mootonni lafaas isa sodaatu.
english: He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Yeduutuuniif. Faarfannaa Asaaf. Ani gargaarsaaf gara Waaqaatti nan iyyadhe; ani akka Waaqni na dhagaʼuuf nan iyyadhe.
english: For the Chief Musician. To Jeduthun. A Psalm by Asaph. My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.

kikuyu: Yeroo rakkina kootiitti Gooftaa nan barbaaddadhe; halkanis utuu hin dadhabin harka koo nan diriirfadhe; lubbuun koos jajjabaachuu didde.
english: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul refused to be comforted.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, ani yommuun si yaadadhu nan aada; ani irra deddeebiʼee nan yaade; hafuurri koos ni laafe.
english: I remember God, and I groan. I complain, and my spirit is overwhelmed. Selah.

kikuyu: Ati akka iji koo hin dunuunfanne goote; ani akka malee lubbamee dubbachuu iyyuu dadhabe.
english: You hold my eyelids open. I am so troubled that I can’t speak.

kikuyu: Ani waaʼee bara durii, waaʼee waggoota durii duriis nan yaade;
english: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

kikuyu: ani halkaniin faarfannaa koo nan yaadadhe. Ani irra deddeebiʼee na yaade; hafuurri koos akkana jedhee qorate:
english: I remember my song in the night. I consider in my own heart; my spirit diligently inquires:

kikuyu: “Gooftaan bara baraan nama gataa? Inni deebiʼee garaa hin laafuu?
english: “Will the Lord reject us forever? Will he be favorable no more?

kikuyu: Araarri isaa bara baraan badee? Waadaan isaa bara baraan guutamuu dhabee?
english: Has his loving kindness vanished forever? Does his promise fail for generations?

kikuyu: Waaqni arjoomuu irraanfateeraa? Inni aariidhaan gara laafina isaa dhiiseeraa?”
english: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has he, in anger, withheld his compassion?” Selah.

kikuyu: Anis, “Harki mirgaa kan Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii jijjiirameera jedhee yaaduun koo, dadhabbii koo ti” nan jedhe.
english: Then I thought, “I will appeal to this: the years of the right hand of the Most High.”

kikuyu: Ani hojii Waaqayyoo nan yaadadha; dhugumaan dinqii kee kan durii nan yaadadhaa.
english: I will remember the LORD’s deeds; for I will remember your wonders of old.

kikuyu: Ani waan ati hojjette hunda irra deddeebiʼee nan yaada; waaʼee hojii keetii illee nan dubbadha.
english: I will also meditate on all your work, and consider your doings.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, karaan kee qulqulluu dha. Waaqni guddaan akka Waaqa keenyaa eessa jira?
english: Your way, God, is in the sanctuary. What god is great like God?

kikuyu: Ati Waaqa hojii dinqii hojjettuu dha; saboota gidduuttis humna kee ni argisiifta.
english: You are the God who does wonders. You have made your strength known among the peoples.

kikuyu: Irree kee cimaadhaan saba kee, sanyii Yaaqoobii fi sanyii Yoosef furteerta.
english: You have redeemed your people with your arm, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, bishaanonni si argan; bishaanonni si arganii sodaatan; tuujubawwan ni hollatan.
english: The waters saw you, God. The waters saw you, and they writhed. The depths also convulsed.

kikuyu: Duumessi bishaan gad dhangalaase; samiiwwan ni qaqawweessaʼan; xiyyi kees qixa hundaan balaqqise.
english: The clouds poured out water. The skies resounded with thunder. Your arrows also flashed around.

kikuyu: Bakakkaan kee bubbee hamaa keessaa dhagaʼame; balaqqeesi kee addunyaa ibse; laftis hollattee sochoote.
english: The voice of your thunder was in the whirlwind. The lightnings lit up the world. The earth trembled and shook.

kikuyu: Daandiin kee galaana keessa, karaan kee immoo bishaanota gurguddaa keessa baʼa; garuu faanni kee hin argamne.
english: Your way was through the sea, your paths through the great waters. Your footsteps were not known.

kikuyu: Ati harka Museetii fi harka Arooniin, saba kee akka bushaayeetti geggeessite.
english: You led your people like a flock, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

kikuyu: Maskiilii Asaaf. Yaa saba ko, barsiisa koo dhagaʼaa; dubbii afaan koo dhaggeeffadhaa.
english: A contemplation by Asaph. Hear my teaching, my people. Turn your ears to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Ani fakkeenyaan afaan koo nan banadha; waan durumaa jalqabee dhokfames nan dubbadha.
english: I will open my mouth in a parable. I will utter dark sayings of old,

kikuyu: Kunis waanuma nu dhageenyee fi waanuma nu beeknu, waan abbootiin keenya nutti himanii dha.
english: which we have heard and known, and our fathers have told us.

kikuyu: Nus waan kana ijoollee isaanii duraa hin dhoksinu; hojii Waaqayyoo ulfina qabeessa sana, humna isaatii fi dinqii inni hojjete, dhaloota itti aanutti ni himna.
english: We will not hide them from their children, telling to the generation to come the praises of the LORD, his strength, and his wondrous deeds that he has done.

kikuyu: Inni Yaaqoobiif sirna dhaabe; Israaʼeliif immoo seera kenne; waan kana illee akka isaan ijoollee isaanii barsiisaniif, abbootii keenya ajaje;
english: For he established a covenant in Jacob, and appointed a teaching in Israel, which he commanded our fathers, that they should make them known to their children;

kikuyu: kunis akka dhaloonni itti aanu beeku, akka ijoolleen amma iyyuu hin dhalatin beekan, isaanis akka ijoollee isaaniitti dabarsanii himaniif.
english: that the generation to come might know, even the children who should be born; who should arise and tell their children,

kikuyu: Yoos isaan Waaqa amanatu; ajaja isaas ni eegu malee hojii isaa hin irraanfatan.
english: that they might set their hope in God, and not forget God’s deeds, but keep his commandments,

kikuyu: Isaan akka abbootii isaanii, akka dhaloota mata jabeessaa fi fincilaa, warra garaan isaanii Waaqaaf hin ajajamnee, akka warra hafuurri isaanii isaaf hin amanamin sanaa hin taʼan.
english: and might not be as their fathers— a stubborn and rebellious generation, a generation that didn’t make their hearts loyal, whose spirit was not steadfast with God.

kikuyu: Namoonni Efreem xiyya qabatanii turan; taʼus gaafa lolaa duubatti deebiʼan.
english: The children of Ephraim, being armed and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

kikuyu: Isaan kakuu Waaqaa hin eegne; seera isaattis buluu didan.
english: They didn’t keep God’s covenant, and refused to walk in his law.

kikuyu: Isaan hojii inni hojjete, dinqii inni isaanitti argisiises ni irraanfatan.
english: They forgot his doings, his wondrous deeds that he had shown them.

kikuyu: Inni fuula abbootii isaanii duratti, biyya Gibxi kutaa Zooʼaanitti waan nama dinqisiisu hojjete.
english: He did marvelous things in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

kikuyu: Inni galaana gargar qoodee gidduun isaan dabarse; bishaan sanas akkuma keenyan manaa dhaabachiise.
english: He split the sea, and caused them to pass through. He made the waters stand as a heap.

kikuyu: Guyyaa duumessaan, halkan guutuu immoo ifa ibiddaatiin isaan geggeesse.
english: In the daytime he also led them with a cloud, and all night with a light of fire.

kikuyu: Inni gammoojjii keessatti kattaa dayyaasee bishaan akka galaanaa baayʼatu isaanii kenne.
english: He split rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink abundantly as out of the depths.

kikuyu: Kattaa keessaa burqaa burqisiisee akka bishaan akkuma lagaatti yaaʼu godhe.
english: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu gammoojjii keessatti Waaqa Waan Hundaa Oliitti fincilan; ittuma fufaniis isatti cubbuu hojjetan.
english: Yet they still went on to sin against him, to rebel against the Most High in the desert.

kikuyu: Isaan nyaata dharraʼanii, “Fidi” jechuudhaan beekumsa Waaqaa qoran.
english: They tempted God in their heart by asking food according to their desire.

kikuyu: Akkana jedhanii Waaqa hamatan; “Waaqni gammoojjii keessatti maaddii qopheessuu dandaʼaa?
english: Yes, they spoke against God. They said, “Can God prepare a table in the wilderness?

kikuyu: Inni kattaa rukunnaan bishaan humnaan keessaa burqe; burqaan guutee irraan dhangalaʼe. Garuu inni nyaata nuu kennuu dandaʼaa? Saba isaatiifis foon kennuu dandaʼaa?”
english: Behold, he struck the rock, so that waters gushed out, and streams overflowed. Can he give bread also? Will he provide meat for his people?”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti baayʼee aare; Yaaqoob irratti ibiddi isaa ni qabsiifame; dheekkamsi isaas Israaʼelitti dhufe;
english: Therefore the LORD heard, and was angry. A fire was kindled against Jacob, anger also went up against Israel,

kikuyu: isaan Waaqa hin amananneetii; fayyisuu isaattis hin amanne.
english: because they didn’t believe in God, and didn’t trust in his salvation.

kikuyu: Inni garuu samii gubbaatiif ajaja kenne; balbala samiis ni bane;
english: Yet he commanded the skies above, and opened the doors of heaven.

kikuyu: akka isaan nyaataniif mannaa gad roobseef; midhaan samiis isaaniif kenne.
english: He rained down manna on them to eat, and gave them food from the sky.

kikuyu: Namoonni buddeena ergamoota Waaqayyoo nyaatan; inni waan isaan nyaatanii quufan ergeef.
english: Man ate the bread of angels. He sent them food to the full.

kikuyu: Inni akka bubbeen baʼa biiftuu samii keessaa bubbisu godhe; bubbee kibbaas humna ofii isaatiin oofe.
english: He caused the east wind to blow in the sky. By his power he guided the south wind.

kikuyu: Foon akkuma awwaaraatti, simbirroota barrisanis akkuma cirracha galaanaatti gad isaaniif roobse.
english: He also rained meat on them as the dust, winged birds as the sand of the seas.

kikuyu: Innis akka isaan qubata isaanii keessatti naannoo dunkaanota isaaniitti gad harcaʼan godhe.
english: He let them fall in the middle of their camp, around their habitations.

kikuyu: Isaanis nyaatanii quufan; inni waan isaan dharraʼan isaaniif kenneeraatii.
english: So they ate, and were well filled. He gave them their own desire.

kikuyu: Garuu utuu isaan nyaata dharraʼan sana hin quufin, utuma nyaanni sun afaan isaanii keessa jiruu,
english: They didn’t turn from their cravings. Their food was yet in their mouths,

kikuyu: dheekkamsi Waaqaa isaanitti dhufe; innis isaan keessaa warra jajjabeeyyii galaafate; dargaggeeyyii Israaʼelis ni fixe.
english: when the anger of God went up against them, killed some of their strongest, and struck down the young men of Israel.

kikuyu: Isaan waan kana hunda irra darbanii cubbuu hojjechuutti fufan; dinqii isaattis hin amanne.
english: For all this they still sinned, and didn’t believe in his wondrous works.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu inni akka barri isaanii faayidaa malee darbu, akka waggoonni isaaniis sodaadhaan dhuman godhe.
english: Therefore he consumed their days in vanity, and their years in terror.

kikuyu: Yeroo Waaqni isaan ajjeese kamitti iyyuu, isaan isa barbaaddatan; isaan ammas fedhiidhaan gara isaatti deebiʼan.
english: When he killed them, then they inquired after him. They returned and sought God earnestly.

kikuyu: Akka Waaqni Kattaa isaanii taʼe, akka Waaqni Waan Hundaa Olii Furii isaanii taʼe yaadatan.
english: They remembered that God was their rock, the Most High God, their redeemer.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu afaan isaaniitiin isa saadan; arraba isaaniitiinis isa soban;
english: But they flattered him with their mouth, and lied to him with their tongue.

kikuyu: garaan isaanii isaaf amanamaa hin turre; isaan kakuu isaatiif hin amanamne.
english: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they faithful in his covenant.

kikuyu: Inni garuu araara qabeessa waan taʼeef, cubbuu isaanii ni dhiiseef malee isaan hin fixne. Inni yeroo yerootti aarii isaa ittifate; dheekkamsa isaa hundaas hin kakaafne.
english: But he, being merciful, forgave iniquity, and didn’t destroy them. Yes, many times he turned his anger away, and didn’t stir up all his wrath.

kikuyu: Innis akka isaan nama duʼa hin oolle, qilleensuma darbu kan deebiʼee hin dhufne taʼan yaadate.
english: He remembered that they were but flesh, a wind that passes away, and doesn’t come again.

kikuyu: Isaan hammam gammoojjii keessatti isatti fincilanii gammoojjii keessattis isa gaddisiisan
english: How often they rebelled against him in the wilderness, and grieved him in the desert!

kikuyu: Isaan ammumaa amma Waaqa qoran; Qulqullicha Israaʼel sanas ni aarsan.
english: They turned again and tempted God, and provoked the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Isaan humna isaa yookaan guyyaa inni itti diinota isaanii jalaa isaan baase hin yaadanne.
english: They didn’t remember his hand, nor the day when he redeemed them from the adversary;

kikuyu: Guyyaa inni itti biyya Gibxi keessatti mallattoo isaa, kutaa Zooʼaan keessatti immoo dinqii isaa argisiise isaan hin yaadanne.
english: how he set his signs in Egypt, his wonders in the field of Zoan,

kikuyu: Inni lageen isaanii dhiigatti geeddare; isaanis burqaawwan isaanii dhuguu hin dandeenye.
english: he turned their rivers into blood, and their streams, so that they could not drink.

kikuyu: Innis tuuta tisiisaa kan isaan balleessu, fattee isaan barbadeessu itti erge.
english: He sent among them swarms of flies, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

kikuyu: Midhaan isaanii ilmaan hawwaannisaatiif, buʼaa dadhabbii isaanii immoo hawwaannisaaf kenne.
english: He also gave their increase to the caterpillar, and their labor to the locust.

kikuyu: Muka wayinii isaanii cabbiidhaan, harbuu isaanii immoo dhaamocha hamaan dhaʼe.
english: He destroyed their vines with hail, their sycamore fig trees with frost.

kikuyu: Loon isaanii cabbiif, horii isaanii immoo bakakkaaf dabarsee kenne.
english: He also gave over their livestock to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

kikuyu: Inni ergamoota badiisa fidan isaanitti erguudhaan aarii isaa sodaachisaa, dheekkamsa isaa, dallansuu isaatii fi rakkoo isaanitti gad lakkise.
english: He threw on them the fierceness of his anger, wrath, indignation, and trouble, and a band of angels of evil.

kikuyu: Inni aarii isaatiif daandii qopheesse; lubbuu isaanii dabarsee dhaʼichatti kenne malee duʼa isaan hin oolchine.
english: He made a path for his anger. He didn’t spare their soul from death, but gave their life over to the pestilence,

kikuyu: Hangafoota Gibxi hunda, ilmaan jalqabatti dhalatanis dunkaana Haam keessatti dhaʼe.
english: and struck all the firstborn in Egypt, the chief of their strength in the tents of Ham.

kikuyu: Saba isaa garuu akkuma nama bushaayee bobbaasuutti achii baase; akkuma hoolaas gammoojjii keessa isaan geggeesse.
english: But he led out his own people like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

kikuyu: Inni nagaadhaan isaan geggeesse; kanaafuu isaan homaa hin sodaanne; diinota isaanii garuu galaanatu liqimse.
english: He led them safely, so that they weren’t afraid, but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

kikuyu: Innis gara daarii biyya isaa qulqulluutti, gara biyya gaaraa kan harki isaa mirgaa fudhateetti isaan galche.
english: He brought them to the border of his sanctuary, to this mountain, which his right hand had taken.

kikuyu: Inni ormoota isaan duraa ariʼe; lafa jaraas dhaala godhee isaanii qoode; gosa Israaʼelis dunkaana isaanii keessa qubachiise.
english: He also drove out the nations before them, allotted them for an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu Waaqa qoran; Waaqa Waan Hundaa Oliitti fincilan; ajaja isaas hin eegne.
english: Yet they tempted and rebelled against the Most High God, and didn’t keep his testimonies,

kikuyu: Akkuma abbootii isaanii duubatti deebiʼan; amanamuus ni didan; akka iddaa micciiramaattis jajalʼatan.
english: but turned back, and dealt treacherously like their fathers. They were twisted like a deceitful bow.

kikuyu: Isaan iddoowwan sagadaa isaanii kanneen gaarran irraatiin isa aarsan; waaqota isaanii tolfamoodhaanis hinaaffaadhaaf isa kakaasan.
english: For they provoked him to anger with their high places, and moved him to jealousy with their engraved images.

kikuyu: Waaqnis yeroo isaan dhagaʼetti akka malee dheekkame; guutumaan guutuuttis Israaʼelin gate.
english: When God heard this, he was angry, and greatly abhorred Israel,

kikuyu: Innis iddoo jireenya isaa kan Shiiloo keessaa, dunkaana inni namoota gidduu dhaabbate sanas ni dhiise.
english: so that he abandoned the tent of Shiloh, the tent which he placed among men,

kikuyu: Humna isaa boojuutti, ulfina isaa immoo harka diinaatti dabarsee kenne.
english: and delivered his strength into captivity, his glory into the adversary’s hand.

kikuyu: Saba isaa dabarsee goraadeef kenne; handhuuraa isaattis akka malee dheekkame.
english: He also gave his people over to the sword, and was angry with his inheritance.

kikuyu: Dargaggoota isaanii ibiddatu fixe; durboota isaaniitiifis sirbi heerumaa hin sirbamne;
english: Fire devoured their young men. Their virgins had no wedding song.

kikuyu: luboonni isaanii goraadeedhaan dhuman; niitonni dhirsoonni irraa duʼan immoo booʼuu hin dandeenye.
english: Their priests fell by the sword, and their widows couldn’t weep.

kikuyu: Gooftaanis akkuma waan hirribaa dammaquutti, akkuma goota sababii wayiniitiin iyyuuttis dammaqe.
english: Then the Lord awakened as one out of sleep, like a mighty man who shouts by reason of wine.

kikuyu: Inni diinota isaa rukutee duubatti deebise; qaanii bara baraa keessas isaan buuse.
english: He struck his adversaries backward. He put them to a perpetual reproach.

kikuyu: Dunkaanota Yoosef ni tuffate; gosa Efreemis hin filanne;
english: Moreover he rejected the tent of Joseph, and didn’t choose the tribe of Ephraim,

kikuyu: inni garuu gosa Yihuudaa, Tulluu Xiyoon kan jaallatu sana ni filate.
english: But chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion which he loved.

kikuyu: Mana qulqullummaa isaa akka samii ol dheeraatti, akka lafa bara baraan hundeesseettis ijaare.
english: He built his sanctuary like the heights, like the earth which he has established forever.

kikuyu: Inni Daawit garbicha isaa ni filate; dallaa hoolotaa keessaas isa waammate;
english: He also chose David his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds;

kikuyu: akka inni saba isaa Yaaqoobin, handhuuraa isaa Israaʼelin tiksuuf jedhee hoolota tiksuu irraa isa fide.
english: from following the ewes that have their young, he brought him to be the shepherd of Jacob, his people, and Israel, his inheritance.

kikuyu: Daawitis garaa qajeelaadhaan isaan tikse; ogummaa harka isaatiinis isaan dura buʼe.
english: So he was their shepherd according to the integrity of his heart, and guided them by the skillfulness of his hands.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Asaaf. Yaa Waaqi, namoonni ormaa handhuuraa kee qabataniiru; mana qulqullummaa kee qulqullicha xureessaniiru; Yerusaaleminis barbadeessaniiru.
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God, the nations have come into your inheritance. They have defiled your holy temple. They have laid Jerusalem in heaps.

kikuyu: Akka isaan nyaata isaaniif taʼaniif, reeffa garboota keetii allaattii samiitiif, foon qulqulloota keetii immoo bineensota lafaatiif kennaniiru.
english: They have given the dead bodies of your servants to be food for the birds of the sky, the flesh of your saints to the animals of the earth.

kikuyu: Dhiiga isaaniis naannoo Yerusaalemitti akkuma bishaanii dhangalaasan; namni isaan awwaalu tokko illee hin argamne.
english: They have shed their blood like water around Jerusalem. There was no one to bury them.

kikuyu: Ollaa keenya biratti maqaan nu badeera; warra naannoo keenya jiran birattis nama tuffii fi kolfaa taane.
english: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scoffing and derision to those who are around us.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, kun hamma yoomiitti? Ati hamma bara baraatti aartaa? Hinaaffaan kees hamma yoomiitti akka ibiddaa bobaʼa?
english: How long, LORD? Will you be angry forever? Will your jealousy burn like fire?

kikuyu: Dheekkamsa kee sana saboota si hin beekne irratti, mootummoota maqaa kee hin waammanne irratti gad dhangalaasi;
english: Pour out your wrath on the nations that don’t know you, on the kingdoms that don’t call on your name,

kikuyu: isaan Yaaqoobin liqimsaniiruutii; iddoo jireenya isaas balleessaniiru.
english: for they have devoured Jacob, and destroyed his homeland.

kikuyu: Cubbuu abbootii keenyaa nutti hin herregin; waan nu baayʼee gad deebifamneef, araarri kee dafee nu bira haa gaʼu.
english: Don’t hold the iniquities of our forefathers against us. Let your tender mercies speedily meet us, for we are in desperate need.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi Fayyisaa keenya, ulfina maqaa keetiitiif jedhii nu gargaari; maqaa keetiif jedhiitii nu oolchi; cubbuu keenya illee nuu dhiisi.
english: Help us, God of our salvation, for the glory of your name. Deliver us, and forgive our sins, for your name’s sake.

kikuyu: Ormoonni maaliif, “Waaqni isaanii eessa jira?” jedhu ree? Dhiiga tajaajiltoota keetii kan dhangalaafame sanaaf, akka haaloo baaftu ija keenya duratti saboota gidduutti beeksisi.
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?” Let it be known among the nations, before our eyes, that vengeance for your servants’ blood is being poured out.

kikuyu: Aaduun hidhamtootaa fuula kee dura haa gaʼu; jabina irree keetiitiin warra duuti itti murame oolchi.
english: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before you. According to the greatness of your power, preserve those who are sentenced to death.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, arraba isaan ittiin si arrabsan, dachaa torba godhiitii ollaa keenyatti deebisi.
english: Pay back to our neighbors seven times into their bosom their reproach with which they have reproached you, Lord.

kikuyu: Yoos nu sabni kee, hoolonni tika keetii, bara baraan si jajanna; dhalootaa hamma dhalootaattis, galata kee ni odeessina.
english: So we, your people and sheep of your pasture, will give you thanks forever. We will praise you forever, to all generations.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Yeedaloo, “Daraaraa Kakuutiin” Faarfatame. Faarfannaa Asaaf. Yaa tiksee saba Israaʼel, kan akkuma bushaayeetti Yoosefin geggeessitu nu dhagaʼi; ati kan kiirubeel gidduu teessoo irra teessu, ifiitii mulʼadhu.
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm by Asaph. Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.

kikuyu: Fuula Efreem, Beniyaamii fi Minaasee duratti humna kee sochoosi; kottuutii nu fayyisi.
english: Before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, iddoo keenyatti nu deebisi; akka fayyinuufis fuula kee nurratti ibsi.
english: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandeessu, ati hamma yoomiitti kadhannaa saba keetiitti aarta?
english: LORD God of Armies, how long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?

kikuyu: Ati buddeena imimmaanii isaan nyaachifte; imimmaan waciitii guutuus isaan obaafte.
english: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.

kikuyu: Ati akka olloonni keenya nu tuffatan goote; diinonni keenyas nutti qoosu.
english: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandeessu, iddoo keenyatti nu deebisi; akka nu fayyinuufis fuula kee nurratti ibsi.
english: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Ati muka wayinii biyya Gibxii buqqiftee fidde; ormootas ariitee muka sana dhaabde.
english: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.

kikuyu: Mukichaafis lafa qopheessite; mukni sunis hidda gad fageeffatee biyyattii guute.
english: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.

kikuyu: Tulluuwwan gaaddisa isaatiin, birbirsawwan gurguddaanis dameewwan isaatiin haguugaman.
english: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.

kikuyu: Innis dameewwan isaa gara Galaanaatti, lata isaas hamma Lagaatti diriirfate.
english: It sent out its branches to the sea, its shoots to the River.

kikuyu: Yoos ati maaliif akka namni achiin darbu hundinuu ija isaa ciratu gochuuf jettee dallaa isaa diigde ree?
english: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?

kikuyu: Kormi booyyee bosona keessaa baʼee isa ni balleessa; bineensi dirrees isa ni nyaata.
english: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandeessu, si kadhannaa gara keenyatti deebiʼi! Samii irraa gad ilaalii argi! Muka wayinii kana eegi;
english: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,

kikuyu: mukni kun muka wayinii kan harki kee mirgaa dhaabee dha; biqiltuu ati ofii keetiif guddifattee dha.
english: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.

kikuyu: Wayiniin kee ciramee ibiddaan gubameera; sabni kees dheekkamsa keetiin bada.
english: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.

kikuyu: Harki kee namicha karaa harka kee mirgaa jiru irra, ilma namaa kan ati ofii keetiif guddifatte irra haa boqotu.
english: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.

kikuyu: Yoos nu sirraa hin garagallu; jireenya nuu kenni; nus maqaa kee ni waammannaa.
english: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandeessu iddoo keenyatti nu deebisi; akka nu fayyinuufis fuula kee nurratti ibsi.
english: Turn us again, LORD God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Asaaf Kan Gitiitiidhaan Faarfatamu. Waaqa jabina nuu taʼeef gammachuudhaan faarfadhaa; Waaqa Yaaqoobiitiif gammachuudhaan ililchaa!
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. By Asaph. Sing aloud to God, our strength! Make a joyful shout to the God of Jacob!

kikuyu: Faarfachuu jalqabaa; dibbees rukutaa; baganaa fi kiraara sagalee gaarii qabu rukutaa.
english: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.

kikuyu: Yeroo Baatiin dhalattu, yommuu jiʼi goobanutti, guyyaa ayyaana keenyaa malakata afuufaa;
english: Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.

kikuyu: kun seera Israaʼeliif kenname, ajaja Waaqa Yaaqoob.
english: For it is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.

kikuyu: Inni yeroo biyya Gibxi dhaʼuuf baʼetti, waan kana Yoosefiif seera godhee dhaabe. Anis afaan duraan hin beekin tokko dhagaʼe.
english: He appointed it in Joseph for a covenant, when he went out over the land of Egypt, I heard a language that I didn’t know.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhe; “Ani gatiittii isaanii irraa baʼaa buuseera; harki isaanis guuboo baachuu jalaa baʼe.
english: “I removed his shoulder from the burden. His hands were freed from the basket.

kikuyu: Ati dhiphina kee keessatti na waammatte; anis sin oolche; anis lafa bakakkaan itti dhokatu keessaa deebii siifin kenne; bishaan Mariibaa birattis sin qore.
english: You called in trouble, and I delivered you. I answered you in the secret place of thunder. I tested you at the waters of Meribah.” Selah.

kikuyu: “Yaa saba koo dhagaʼi; ani siin akeekkachiisa; yaa Israaʼel ati utuu na dhaggeeffate!
english: “Hear, my people, and I will testify to you, Israel, if you would listen to me!

kikuyu: Waaqni ormaa tokko iyyuu isin gidduu hin jiraatin; ana malee waaqa biraa hin waaqeffatin.
english: There shall be no strange god in you, neither shall you worship any foreign god.

kikuyu: Ani Waaqayyo Waaqa kee, kan Gibxii baasee isin fidee dha. Afaan kee balʼisii banadhu; ani nan guutaa.
english: I am the LORD, your God, who brought you up out of the land of Egypt. Open your mouth wide, and I will fill it.

kikuyu: “Sabni koo garuu na hin dhaggeeffanne; Israaʼel anaaf hin bulle.
english: But my people didn’t listen to my voice. Israel desired none of me.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani akka isaan karaa fedhii isaanii deemaniif dabarsee mata jabina isaaniitti isaan kenne.
english: So I let them go after the stubbornness of their hearts, that they might walk in their own counsels.

kikuyu: “Utuu sabni koo na dhaggeeffatee, utuu Israaʼel karaa koo irra deemee jiraatee,
english: Oh that my people would listen to me, that Israel would walk in my ways!

kikuyu: ani silaa akkam dafee diinota isaanii jilbeenfachiisee harka koos amajaajota isaaniitti nan kaasa ture!
english: I would soon subdue their enemies, and turn my hand against their adversaries.

kikuyu: Warri Waaqayyoon jibban fuula isaa duratti ni gugguufu; adabbiin isaaniis bara baraan itti fufa.
english: The haters of the LORD would cringe before him, and their punishment would last forever.

kikuyu: Ani garuu qamadii qulqulluu isin soora; damma kattaa keessaa baafames isinan quubsa.”
english: But he would have also fed them with the finest of the wheat. I will satisfy you with honey out of the rock.”

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Asaaf. Waaqni, waldaa waaqotaa gidduu dhaabata; “waaqota” gidduuttis murtii kenna; akkanas jedha:
english: A Psalm by Asaph. God presides in the great assembly. He judges among the gods.

kikuyu: “Isin hamma yoomiitti seera jalʼiftu? Hamma yoomiittis jalʼootaaf dhaabattu?
english: “How long will you judge unjustly, and show partiality to the wicked?” Selah.

kikuyu: Dadhabdootaa fi ijoollee abbaa hin qabneef murtii qajeelaa kennaa; mirga hiyyeeyyiitii fi cunqurfamtootaas eegsisaa.
english: “Defend the weak, the poor, and the fatherless. Maintain the rights of the poor and oppressed.

kikuyu: Warra dadhabaa fi rakkattoota baraaraa; harka jalʼootaatiis isaan baasaa.
english: Rescue the weak and needy. Deliver them out of the hand of the wicked.”

kikuyu: “Isaan homaa hin beekan; homaa illee hin hubatan. Isaan dukkana keessa jiraatu; hundeen lafaa hundinuu ni raafame.
english: They don’t know, neither do they understand. They walk back and forth in darkness. All the foundations of the earth are shaken.

kikuyu: “Anis, ‘Isin, “waaqota;” hundi keessan ilmaan Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii ti’ jedheera.
english: I said, “You are gods, all of you are sons of the Most High.

kikuyu: Taʼus isin akkuma namatti ni duutu; akkuma bulchitoota kamii iyyuu ni kuftu.”
english: Nevertheless you shall die like men, and fall like one of the rulers.”

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi kaʼi; lafatti muri; sabni hundinuu kan keetiitii.
english: Arise, God, judge the earth, for you inherit all of the nations.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Asaaf. Yaa Waaqi gab hin jedhin; yaa Waaqi, hin calʼisin; akkasumattis hin dhiisin.
english: A song. A Psalm by Asaph. God, don’t keep silent. Don’t keep silent, and don’t be still, God.

kikuyu: Diinonni kee akkam akka kakaʼan, warri si jibbanis akkam akka mataa ol qabatan ilaali.
english: For, behold, your enemies are stirred up. Those who hate you have lifted up their heads.

kikuyu: Isaan saba keetti daba karoorfatu; warra ati eegdutti mariʼatu.
english: They conspire with cunning against your people. They plot against your cherished ones.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Kottaa akka maqaan Israaʼel lammata hin yaadatamneef, akka isaan saba hin taaneef isaan barbadeessinaa” jedhu.
english: “Come,” they say, “let’s destroy them as a nation, that the name of Israel may be remembered no more.”

kikuyu: Isaan yaada tokkoon walii galu; sittis ni gurmaaʼu;
english: For they have conspired together with one mind. They form an alliance against you.

kikuyu: isaanis dunkaanota Edoom, Ishmaaʼeeloota, Moʼaabii fi gosa Aggaar,
english: The tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites; Moab, and the Hagrites;

kikuyu: Gebaal, Amoonii fi Amaaleq, Filisxeemii fi namoota biyya Xiiroos wajjin turan.
english: Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek; Philistia with the inhabitants of Tyre;

kikuyu: Warri Asooriis, ilmaan Looxiitiif irree jabaa taʼuudhaaf isaanitti makaman.
english: Assyria also is joined with them. They have helped the children of Lot. Selah.

kikuyu: Ati akkuma Midiyaanin goote, akkuma laga Qiishooniitti Siisaaraa fi Yaabiinin goote sana isaan godhi;
english: Do to them as you did to Midian, as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the river Kishon;

kikuyu: isaan Eendooritti dhumanii akkuma kosii lafaa taʼan.
english: who perished at Endor, who became as dung for the earth.

kikuyu: Gurguddoota isaanii akka Hereebiitii fi Zeʼeeb, ilmaan mootota isaanii immoo akka Zebaa fi Zalmunaa godhi;
english: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, yes, all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,

kikuyu: isaan warra, “Kottaa, lafa tika Waaqaa fudhannee kan dhuunfaa keenyaa godhannaa” jedhanii dha.
english: who said, “Let’s take possession of God’s pasture lands.”

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa ko, akka awwaara bubbeen fudhatuu, akka habaqii qilleensi bittinneessuu isaan godhi.
english: My God, make them like tumbleweed, like chaff before the wind.

kikuyu: Akkuma ibiddi bosona balleessu, yookaan akkuma arrabni ibiddaa tulluuwwan gubu,
english: As the fire that burns the forest, as the flame that sets the mountains on fire,

kikuyu: atis akkasuma aarii keetiin isaan gugsi; bubbee keetiin isaan sodaachisi.
english: so pursue them with your tempest, and terrify them with your storm.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, akka isaan maqaa kee barbaaddataniif, fuula isaanii qaaniin haguugi.
english: Fill their faces with confusion, that they may seek your name, LORD.

kikuyu: Isaan yeroo hunda qaanaʼanii haa dhiphatan; salphinaanis haa badan.
english: Let them be disappointed and dismayed forever. Yes, let them be confounded and perish;

kikuyu: Isaan akka ati kan maqaan kee Waaqayyo taʼe sun qofti, lafa hundumaa irratti Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii taate haa beekan.
english: that they may know that you alone, whose name is the LORD, are the Most High over all the earth.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Kan Gitiitiidhaan Faarfatamu. Faarfannaa Ilmaan Qooraahi. Yaa Waaqayyoo Waan Hunda Dandeessu, iddoon ati jiraattu akkam namatti tola!
english: For the Chief Musician. On an instrument of Gath. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. How lovely are your dwellings, LORD of Armies!

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo oobdiiwwan Waaqayyoo hawwiti; akka malees itti gaggabdi; onneen koo fi foon koo Waaqa jiraataadhaaf ililleedhaan ni faarfatu.
english: My soul longs, and even faints for the courts of the LORD. My heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyoo Waan Hunda Dandeessu, Mootii koo fi Waaqa ko, iddoo aarsaa keetii biratti, dimbiitiin iddoo jireenyaa, girrisnis ofii isheetiif manʼee cuucii ishee keessa kaaʼattu argatti.
english: Yes, the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may have her young, near your altars, LORD of Armies, my King, and my God.

kikuyu: Warri mana kee keessa jiraatan eebbifamoo dha; isaan yeroo hundumaa si jajatuutii.
english: Blessed are those who dwell in your house. They are always praising you. Selah.

kikuyu: Warri sirraa jabina argatan, kanneen garaa isaaniitiin karaa kee yaadan eebbifamoo dha.
english: Blessed are those whose strength is in you, who have set their hearts on a pilgrimage.

kikuyu: Isaan yommuu Sulula Baakaa keessa darbanitti, iddoo sana lafa bishaan keessaa burqu godhatu; bokkaan jalqabaas eebba itti dhangalaasa.
english: Passing through the valley of Weeping, they make it a place of springs. Yes, the autumn rain covers it with blessings.

kikuyu: Isaan hamma Xiyoon keessatti fuula Waaqaa duratti mulʼatanitti, jabina irraa gara jabinaatti ni darbu.
english: They go from strength to strength. Every one of them appears before God in Zion.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandeessu, kadhannaa koo dhagaʼi; yaa Waaqa Yaaqoob na dhaggeeffadhu.
english: LORD, God of Armies, hear my prayer. Listen, God of Jacob. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, gara gaachana keenyaa ilaali; fuula dibamaa kee sanaas ilaali.
english: Behold, God our shield, look at the face of your anointed.

kikuyu: Guyyaa kuma tokko iddoo biraa jiraachuu irra, guyyaa tokko oobdii keetii irra ooluu wayya; dunkaana hamootaa keessa jiraachuu irra, eegduu balbala mana Waaqa koo taʼuu naa wayya.
english: For a day in your courts is better than a thousand. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqni aduu fi gaachanaatii; Waaqayyo surraa fi ulfina ni kenna; inni toloota waan gaarii hin dhowwatu.
english: For the LORD God is a sun and a shield. The LORD will give grace and glory. He withholds no good thing from those who walk blamelessly.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyoo Waan Hunda Dandeessu, namni si amanatu eebbifamaa dha.
english: LORD of Armies, blessed is the man who trusts in you.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Ilmaan Qooraahi. Yaa Waaqayyo, ati lafa keetiif arjoomteerta; boojuu Yaaqoobis deebifteerta.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. LORD, you have been favorable to your land. You have restored the fortunes of Jacob.

kikuyu: Ati balleessaa uummata keetii dhiifteertaaf; cubbuu isaanii hundumaas dhoksiteerta.
english: You have forgiven the iniquity of your people. You have covered all their sin. Selah.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsa kee hunda fageessiteerta; aarii kee sodaachisaa sana irraas deebiteerta.
english: You have taken away all your wrath. You have turned from the fierceness of your anger.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa Fayyisaa keenya, iddoo keenyatti nu deebisi; dheekkamsa kees nurraa qabi.
english: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.

kikuyu: Ati bara baraan nutti aartaa? Dheekkamsa kee dhaloota tokko irraa dhaloota kaanitti dabarsitaa?
english: Will you be angry with us forever? Will you draw out your anger to all generations?

kikuyu: Akka sabni kee sitti gammaduuf, ati lubbuu nutti hin deebiftuu?
english: Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, araara kee nutti mulʼisi; fayyina kees nuu kenni.
english: Show us your loving kindness, LORD. Grant us your salvation.

kikuyu: Ani waan Waaqayyo Waaqni jedhu nan dhaggeeffadha; inni saba isaa qulqullootaaf nagaa abdachiisa; isaan garuu gara gowwummaatti hin deebiʼin.
english: I will hear what God, the LORD, will speak, for he will speak peace to his people, his saints; but let them not turn again to folly.

kikuyu: Akka ulfinni isaa lafa keenya irra jiraatuuf, fayyisuun isaa dhugumaan warra isa sodaatanitti dhiʼoo jira.
english: Surely his salvation is near those who fear him, that glory may dwell in our land.

kikuyu: Jaalallii fi amanamummaan wal gaʼan; qajeelummaa fi nagaan wal dhungatan.
english: Mercy and truth meet together. Righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

kikuyu: Amanamummaan lafa keessaa burqa; qajeelummaan immoo samii irraa gad ilaala.
english: Truth springs out of the earth. Righteousness has looked down from heaven.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo dhugumaan waan gaarii ni kenna; lafti keenyas midhaan ishee ni kenniti.
english: Yes, the LORD will give that which is good. Our land will yield its increase.

kikuyu: Qajeelummaan fuula isaa dura deema; miilla isaatiifis karaa qopheessa.
english: Righteousness goes before him, and prepares the way for his steps.

kikuyu: Kadhannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, waan ani hiyyeessaa fi rakkataa taʼeef, na dhagaʼiitii deebii naa kenni.
english: A Prayer by David. Hear, LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.

kikuyu: Ani sitti of kenneeraatii lubbuu koo eegi. Ati Waaqa koo ti; garbicha kee kan si amanatu oolchi.
english: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You, my God, save your servant who trusts in you.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa na maari; ani guyyaa guutuu sin waammadhaatii.
english: Be merciful to me, Lord, for I call to you all day long.

kikuyu: Lubbuu garbicha keetii gammachiisi; yaa Gooftaa, ani lubbuu koo gara keetti oli nan fuudhaatii.
english: Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa ati gaarii dha; dhiifamas namaa goota; warra si waammatan hundaafis jaalalli kee guddaa dha.
english: For you, Lord, are good, and ready to forgive, abundant in loving kindness to all those who call on you.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, kadhannaa koo dhagaʼi; iyya waammata koos dhaggeeffadhu.
english: Hear, LORD, my prayer. Listen to the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Ani guyyaa rakkina kootiitti sin waammadha; ati deebii naa kennitaatii.
english: In the day of my trouble I will call on you, for you will answer me.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, waaqota keessaa kan akka keetii hin jiru; hojiin hojii keetiin wal qixxaatu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: There is no one like you among the gods, Lord, nor any deeds like your deeds.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, saboonni ati uumte hundinuu dhufanii, fuula kee duratti ni sagadu; maqaa keetiifis ulfina fidu.
english: All nations you have made will come and worship before you, Lord. They shall glorify your name.

kikuyu: Ati guddaa fi kan hojii dinqisiisaa hojjettuu dha; Waaqni suma qofa.
english: For you are great, and do wondrous things. You are God alone.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, karaa kee na barsiisi; anis dhugaa keetiin nan bula; akka ani maqaa kee sodaadhuuf, garaa gargar hin qoodamne naa kenni.
english: Teach me your way, LORD. I will walk in your truth. Make my heart undivided to fear your name.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqa koo Gooftaa, ani garaa koo guutuudhaan sin galateeffadha; maqaa kee illee bara baraan nan ulfeessa.
english: I will praise you, Lord my God, with my whole heart. I will glorify your name forever more.

kikuyu: Jaalalli ati naa qabdu guddaadhaatii; lubbuu koo dhidhima siiʼool keessaa baafteerta.
english: For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, of tuultonni natti kaʼaniiru; tuunni finciltootaa, namoonni si hin sodaanne lubbuu koo galaafachuu barbaadu.
english: God, the proud have risen up against me. A company of violent men have sought after my soul, and they don’t hold regard for you before them.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, ati garuu Waaqa garaa laafessaa fi arjaa dha; daftee hin aartu; jaalallii fi amanamummaan kee dhuma hin qabu.
english: But you, Lord, are a merciful and gracious God, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness and truth.

kikuyu: Gara kootti deebiʼiitii na maari; jabina kee tajaajilaa keetii kenni; ilma garbittii keetiis oolchi.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me! Give your strength to your servant. Save the son of your servant.

kikuyu: Akka diinonni koo arganii qaanaʼaniif, mallattoo gaarummaa keetii naa kenni; yaa Waaqayyo, ati na gargaartee na jajjabeessiteertaatii.
english: Show me a sign of your goodness, that those who hate me may see it, and be shamed, because you, LORD, have helped me, and comforted me.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Ilmaan Qooraahi. Hundeen magaalaa isaa tulluu qulqulluu irra jira.
english: A Psalm by the sons of Korah; a Song. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo iddoo jireenya Yaaqoob hunda caalaa, karrawwan Xiyoon jaallata.
english: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

kikuyu: Yaa magaalaa Waaqaa, waaʼee keetiif wanni kabajamaan akkana jedhamee ni dubbatama:
english: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God. Selah.

kikuyu: “Ani Raʼaabii fi Baabilonin warra na beekan gidduutti maqaa nan dhaʼa; kunoo, Filisxeemii fi Xiiroos Itoophiyaa wajjin, ‘Namichi kun achitti dhalate’ jedhu.”
english: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”

kikuyu: Dhugumaan waaʼee Xiyoon, “Inni kunii fi inni sun ishee keessatti dhalatan; Waaqni Waan Hunda Olii mataan isaa iyyuu ishee dhaaba” jedhama.
english: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo yeroo saboota galmeessutti, “Namichi kun achitti dhalate” jedhee barreessa.
english: The LORD will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.” Selah.

kikuyu: Warri faarfatanii fi warri meeshaa muuziiqaa taphatan, “Burqaan koo hundi si keessatti argama” jedhu.
english: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Ilmaan Qooraahi kan maahilaati liinootiin Faarfatame. Maskiilii Heemaan Izraahichaa. Yaa Waaqayyo, Waaqa na fayyiftu, ani halkanii fi guyyaa fuula kee duratti nan iyyadha.
english: A Song. A Psalm by the sons of Korah. For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “The Suffering of Affliction.” A contemplation by Heman, the Ezrahite. LORD, the God of my salvation, I have cried day and night before you.

kikuyu: Kadhannaan koo fuula kee duratti haa dhiʼaatu; atis gurra kee gara iyyannaa kootiitti qabi.
english: Let my prayer enter into your presence. Turn your ear to my cry.

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo rakkinaan guutamteertii; jireenyi koos awwaalatti dhiʼaateera.
english: For my soul is full of troubles. My life draws near to Sheol.

kikuyu: Ani warra boolla keessa buʼanitti nan lakkaaʼame; akka nama humna hin qabnees nan taʼe.
english: I am counted among those who go down into the pit. I am like a man who has no help,

kikuyu: Ani akka nama gorraʼamee awwaala keessa ciisuutti, akka nama ati deebitee hin yaadanneetti, akka warra eegumsa kee jalaa baʼaniitti, warra duʼan wajjin gatameera.
english: set apart among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom you remember no more. They are cut off from your hand.

kikuyu: Ati boolla gad fagoo keessa, dukkana hamaa keessas na buufteerta.
english: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsi kee ulfaatee narra ciiseera; dambalii kee hundas narra garagalchiteerta.
english: Your wrath lies heavily on me. You have afflicted me with all your waves. Selah.

kikuyu: Michoota koo narraa fageessiteerta; isaan biratti jibbamaa na gooteerta; akka ani jalaa hin baanettis balballi natti cufameera.
english: You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.

kikuyu: Iji koo gaddaan dadhabeera. Yaa Waaqayyo, ani guyyuma guyyaan sin waammadha; harka koo illee gara keetti nan balʼifadha.
english: My eyes are dim from grief. I have called on you daily, LORD. I have spread out my hands to you.

kikuyu: Ati dinqii kee warra duʼanitti ni argisiiftaa? Warri duʼanis kaʼanii si galateeffatuu?
english: Do you show wonders to the dead? Do the departed spirits rise up and praise you? Selah.

kikuyu: Jaalalli kee awwaala keessatti, amanamummaan kee immoo Qilee keessatti ni labsamaa?
english: Is your loving kindness declared in the grave? Or your faithfulness in Destruction?

kikuyu: Dinqiiwwan kee dukkana keessatti, yookaan qajeelummaan kee biyya irraanfannaa keessatti ni beekamaa?
english: Are your wonders made known in the dark? Or your righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani garuu akka ati na gargaartuuf gara keetti nan iyyadha; ganamaanis kadhannaan koo fuula kee duratti ni dhiʼaata.
english: But to you, LORD, I have cried. In the morning, my prayer comes before you.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati maaliif na gatta? Fuula kees maaliif na duraa dhokfatta?
english: LORD, why do you reject my soul? Why do you hide your face from me?

kikuyu: Ani ijoollummaa kootii jalqabee rakkadhee duʼuu gaʼeen ture; naasisuun kee na dhiphiseera; abdiis kutadheera.
english: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up. While I suffer your terrors, I am distracted.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsi kee narra yaaʼe; naasisuun kees na balleesseera.
english: Your fierce wrath has gone over me. Your terrors have cut me off.

kikuyu: Isaan guyyaa guutuu akkuma lolaa bishaanii na marsu; guutumaan guutuuttis na liqimsaniiru.
english: They came around me like water all day long. They completely engulfed me.

kikuyu: Michoota koo fi warra na jaallatan narraa fudhatteerta; dukkana qofatu michuu naa taʼe.
english: You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.

kikuyu: Maskiilii Eetaan Izraahichaa. Ani waaʼee araara Waaqayyoo bara baraan nan faarfadha; afaan kootiinis amanamummaa kee dhaloota hundumatti nan labsa.
english: A contemplation by Ethan, the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving kindness of the LORD forever. With my mouth, I will make known your faithfulness to all generations.

kikuyu: Akka araarri kee bara baraan jiraatu, akka ati amanamummaa kee samii keessatti jabeessitee dhaabde nan labsa.
english: I indeed declare, “Love stands firm forever. You established the heavens. Your faithfulness is in them.”

kikuyu: Ati akkana jetteerta; “Ani filatamaa koo wajjin kakuu galeera; Daawit tajaajilaa kootiif illee akkana jedhee kakadheera;
english: “I have made a covenant with my chosen one, I have sworn to David, my servant,

kikuyu: ‘Ani bara baraan sanyii kee nan dhaaba; teessoo kees dhaloota hundaaf nan cimsa.’ ”
english: ‘I will establish your offspring forever, and build up your throne to all generations.’” Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, samiiwwan dinqii kee jaju; yaaʼii qulqullootaa keessattis amanamummaa kee jaju.
english: The heavens will praise your wonders, LORD, your faithfulness also in the assembly of the holy ones.

kikuyu: Samii keessatti eenyutu Waaqayyoon qixxaachuu dandaʼa? Uumamawwan samii keessaa kan Waaqayyoon fakkaatu eenyu?
english: For who in the skies can be compared to the LORD? Who among the sons of the heavenly beings is like the LORD,

kikuyu: Waaqni waldaa qulqullootaa keessatti baayʼee sodaatama; warra naannoo isaa jiran hunda keessaas isatu sodaachisaa dha.
english: a very awesome God in the council of the holy ones, to be feared above all those who are around him?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandeessu, kan akka keetii eenyu? Yaa Waaqayyo, ati jabaa dha; amanamummaan kees si marsa.
english: LORD, God of Armies, who is a mighty one, like you? LORD, your faithfulness is around you.

kikuyu: Ati raafama galaanaa ni moota; yommuu dhaʼaan isaa jabaatus ni tasgabbeessita.
english: You rule the pride of the sea. When its waves rise up, you calm them.

kikuyu: Akka warra qalamaniitti Raʼaabin bulleessite; irree kee jabaa sanaanis diinota kee ni bittinneessite.
english: You have broken Rahab in pieces, like one of the slain. You have scattered your enemies with your mighty arm.

kikuyu: Samiiwwan kan kee ti; laftis akkasuma kan kee ti; ati addunyaa fi waan ishee keessa jiru hunda hundeessiteerta.
english: The heavens are yours. The earth also is yours, the world and its fullness. You have founded them.

kikuyu: Kaabaa fi kibba situ uume; Taaboorii fi Hermoon gammachuudhaan maqaa kee galateeffatu.
english: You have created the north and the south. Tabor and Hermon rejoice in your name.

kikuyu: Ati irree jabaa qabda; harki kee jabaa dha; harki kee mirgaas ol kaʼeera.
english: You have a mighty arm. Your hand is strong, and your right hand is exalted.

kikuyu: Qajeelummaa fi murtiin qajeelaan hundee teessoo keetii ti; araarrii fi amanamummaan fuula kee dura deemu.
english: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of your throne. Loving kindness and truth go before your face.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, warri siif ililchuu beekan, warri ifa iddoo ati jirtuu keessa jiraatan eebbifamoo dha.
english: Blessed are the people who learn to acclaim you. They walk in the light of your presence, LORD.

kikuyu: Isaan guyyaa guutuu maqaa keetiin gammadu; qajeelummaa keetiinis si jajatu.
english: In your name they rejoice all day. In your righteousness, they are exalted.

kikuyu: Ati ulfina jabina isaanii ti; jaalala keetiinis gaanfa keenya ol qabdeerta.
english: For you are the glory of their strength. In your favor, our horn will be exalted.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan gaachanni keenya kan Waaqayyoo ti; kan mootii keenya Qulqullicha Israaʼelii ti.
english: For our shield belongs to the LORD, our king to the Holy One of Israel.

kikuyu: Ati dur akkana jettee saba kee amanamaatti mulʼataan dubbatteerta: “Ani loltuu tokkoof humna kenneera; dargaggeessa saba keessaa filatame tokkos ani ol guddiseera.
english: Then you spoke in vision to your saints, and said, “I have given strength to the warrior. I have exalted a young man from the people.

kikuyu: Ani garbicha koo Daawitin argadheera; zayitii koo qulqulluunis isa dibeera.
english: I have found David, my servant. I have anointed him with my holy oil,

kikuyu: Harki koo isa wajjin jira; irreen koos isa jajjabeessa.
english: with whom my hand shall be established. My arm will also strengthen him.

kikuyu: Diinni tokko iyyuu isa hin moʼatu; namni hamaanis isa hin hacuucu.
english: No enemy will tax him. No wicked man will oppress him.

kikuyu: Amajaajota isaa fuula isaa duratti nan barbadeessa; warra isa jibbanis nan dhaʼa.
english: I will beat down his adversaries before him, and strike those who hate him.

kikuyu: Amanamummaa fi araarri koo isa wajjin jiraata; gaanfi isaas maqaa kootiin ol jedha.
english: But my faithfulness and my loving kindness will be with him. In my name, his horn will be exalted.

kikuyu: Ani harka isaa galaana irra, harka isaa mirgaas lageen irra nan kaaʼa.
english: I will set his hand also on the sea, and his right hand on the rivers.

kikuyu: Innis, ‘Ati Abbaa koo ti; Waaqa koo ti, Kattaa Fayyina koo ti’ jedhee na waammata.
english: He will call to me, ‘You are my Father, my God, and the rock of my salvation!’

kikuyu: Anis ilma koo hangafa, kan mootota lafaa hundaa olii isa nan godha.
english: I will also appoint him my firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.

kikuyu: Jaalala koos bara baraan isaaf nan tursa; kakuun ani isa wajjin qabus hin cabu.
english: I will keep my loving kindness for him forever more. My covenant will stand firm with him.

kikuyu: Hidda sanyii isaa bara baraan, teessoo isaa illee hamma samiiwwan jiraatanitti nan dhaaba.
english: I will also make his offspring endure forever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

kikuyu: “Yoo ilmaan isaa seera koo eeguu didan, yoo isaan ajaja koo faana buʼuu baatan,
english: If his children forsake my law, and don’t walk in my ordinances;

kikuyu: yoo isaan sirna koo cabsanii ajaja koo illee eeguu baatan,
english: if they break my statutes, and don’t keep my commandments;

kikuyu: ani cubbuu isaanii uleedhaan, yakka isaanii immoo qacceedhaan nan adaba;
english: then I will punish their sin with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

kikuyu: ani garuu jaalala koo isa irraa hin fudhadhu; yookaan amanamummaa koo sobatti hin geeddaru.
english: But I will not completely take my loving kindness from him, nor allow my faithfulness to fail.

kikuyu: Ani kakuu koo hin cabsu; yookaan waan afaan koo dubbates hin geeddaru.
english: I will not break my covenant, nor alter what my lips have uttered.

kikuyu: Siʼa tokko yeroo hundaaf, qulqullina kootiin kakadheera; ani Daawitin hin sobu.
english: Once I have sworn by my holiness, I will not lie to David.

kikuyu: Sanyiin isaa bara baraan itti fufa; teessoon isaas akkuma aduu fuula koo dura jiraata;
english: His offspring will endure forever, his throne like the sun before me.

kikuyu: akkuma jiʼaas bara baraan ni jiraata; hamma samiiwwan jiranittis cimee dhaabata.”
english: It will be established forever like the moon, the faithful witness in the sky.” Selah.

kikuyu: Ati amma garuu isa dhiifteerta; tuffatteertas; isa dibde sanatti baayʼee aarteerta.
english: But you have rejected and spurned. You have been angry with your anointed.

kikuyu: Kakuu tajaajilaa kee wajjin galte cabsiteerta; gonfoo isaas awwaara keessa buuftee xureessiteerta.
english: You have renounced the covenant of your servant. You have defiled his crown in the dust.

kikuyu: Dallaa isaa hunda caccabsiteerta; daʼoo isaa jajjabaas barbadeessiteerta.
english: You have broken down all his hedges. You have brought his strongholds to ruin.

kikuyu: Warri achiin darban hundi isa saamu; olloonni isaas itti qoosu.
english: All who pass by the way rob him. He has become a reproach to his neighbors.

kikuyu: Ati harka amajaajii isaa mirgaa ol qabdeerta; akka diinonni isaa hundi gammadan gooteerta.
english: You have exalted the right hand of his adversaries. You have made all of his enemies rejoice.

kikuyu: Arfii goraadee isaa duubatti deebifteerta; waraana keessattis isa hin gargaarre.
english: Yes, you turn back the edge of his sword, and haven’t supported him in battle.

kikuyu: Surraa isaa isa irraa balleessiteerta; teessoo isaas lafatti gatteerta.
english: You have ended his splendor, and thrown his throne down to the ground.

kikuyu: Umurii dargaggummaa isaa gabaabsiteerta; qaaniidhaanis isa haguugdeerta.
english: You have shortened the days of his youth. You have covered him with shame. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, kun hamma yoomiitti? Ati bara baraan of dhoksitaa? Dheekkamsi kee hamma yoomiitti akka ibiddaa bobaʼa?
english: How long, LORD? Will you hide yourself forever? Will your wrath burn like fire?

kikuyu: Umuriin koo hammam akka gabaabaa taʼe yaadadhu. Ati badiisa akkamiitiif ilmaan namaa hunda uumte!
english: Remember how short my time is, for what vanity you have created all the children of men!

kikuyu: Utuu duʼa hin argin jiraachuu kan dandaʼu yookaan humna siiʼool jalaa of baasuu kan dandaʼu nama akkamii ti?
english: What man is he who shall live and not see death, who shall deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, jaalalli kee guddaan durii kan ati amanamummaa keetiin Daawitiif kakatte sun eessa jira?
english: Lord, where are your former loving kindnesses, which you swore to David in your faithfulness?

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, akkamitti akka tajaajilaan kee tuffatame, akkamitti akka ani arrabsoo saboota hundaa bobaatti baadhe yaadadhu;
english: Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,

kikuyu: yaa Waaqayyo, qoosaa diinonni kee natti qoosan, kan isaan ittiin tarkaanfii dibamaa keetii hundatti qoosan yaadadhu.
english: With which your enemies have mocked, LORD, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.

kikuyu: Galanni bara baraan Waaqayyoof haa taʼu! Ameen; Ameen.
english: Blessed be the LORD forever more. Amen, and Amen.

kikuyu: Kadhannaa Musee Nama Waaqaa Sanaa. Yaa Gooftaa, ati dhaloota hunda keessatti iddoo jireenyaa nuu taateerta.
english: A Prayer by Moses, the man of God. Lord, you have been our dwelling place for all generations.

kikuyu: Utuu tulluuwwan hin dhalatin yookaan utuu ati lafaa fi addunyaa hin uumin, baraa baraa hamma bara baraatti ati Waaqa.
english: Before the mountains were born, before you had formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, you are God.

kikuyu: Atis, “Yaa ilmaan namootaa, biyyootti deebiʼaa” jettee namoota biyyootti deebista.
english: You turn man to destruction, saying, “Return, you children of men.”

kikuyu: Fuula kee duratti waggaan kumni tokko, akkuma guyyaa kaleessa darbee ti; yookaan akkuma dabaree eegumsa halkanii tokkoo ti.
english: For a thousand years in your sight are just like yesterday when it is past, like a watch in the night.

kikuyu: Ati hirriba duʼaatiin namoota haxooftee balleessita; isaan akkuma marga ganama bayyanatuu ti;
english: You sweep them away as they sleep. In the morning they sprout like new grass.

kikuyu: margi sun ganama ganama bayyanatu illee galgala galgala garuu coollagee goga.
english: In the morning it sprouts and springs up. By evening, it is withered and dry.

kikuyu: Aariin kee nu fixeera; dheekkamsi kees nu naasiseera.
english: For we are consumed in your anger. We are troubled in your wrath.

kikuyu: Yakka keenya fuula kee dura, cubbuu keenya dhokataa sanas ifa fuula keetii dura keesseerta.
english: You have set our iniquities before you, our secret sins in the light of your presence.

kikuyu: Barri keenya hundinuu dheekkamsa keetiin dhumeeraatii; umurii keenyas aaduudhaan fixanna.
english: For all our days have passed away in your wrath. We bring our years to an end as a sigh.

kikuyu: Dheerinni bara keenyaa waggaa torbaatama, yoo jabaanne immoo waggaa saddeettama taʼa; kuni iyyuu garri caalaan isaa dadhabbii fi rakkinaan guutameera; inni dafee darbaatii; nus barrifnee ni sokkina.
english: The days of our years are seventy, or even by reason of strength eighty years; yet their pride is but labor and sorrow, for it passes quickly, and we fly away.

kikuyu: Humna aarii keetii eenyutu beeka? Dheekkamsi kee akkuma sodaa nu siif qabaachuu qabnu sanaa guddaadhaatii.
english: Who knows the power of your anger, your wrath according to the fear that is due to you?

kikuyu: Akka nu garaa ogummaadhaan guutame qabaannuuf, bara keenya lakkaaʼuu nu barsiisi.
english: So teach us to count our days, that we may gain a heart of wisdom.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, deebiʼi! Kun hamma yoomiitti taʼa? Tajaajiltoota keetiifis garaa laafi.
english: Relent, LORD! How long? Have compassion on your servants!

kikuyu: Akka nu bara keenya guutuu gammannee ililchinuuf, ganama ganama araara keetiin nu quufsi.
english: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.

kikuyu: Hamma baayʼina guyyoota ati nu miite sanaa, hamma baayʼina waggoota nu rakkanne sanaas nu gammachiisi.
english: Make us glad for as many days as you have afflicted us, for as many years as we have seen evil.

kikuyu: Hojiin kee tajaajiltoota keetti, ulfinni kees ijoollee isaaniitti haa mulʼifamu.
english: Let your work appear to your servants, your glory to their children.

kikuyu: Eebbi Waaqa keenya Gooftichaa nurra haa buʼu; hojii harka keenyaas jabeessii nuu dhaabi; eeyyee, hojii harka keenyaa jabeessii nuu dhaabi.
english: Let the favor of the Lord our God be on us. Establish the work of our hands for us. Yes, establish the work of our hands.

kikuyu: Namni daʼoo Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii keessa jiraatu, gaaddisa Waaqa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu sanaa jala boqota.
english: He who dwells in the secret place of the Most High will rest in the shadow of the Almighty.

kikuyu: Anis Waaqayyoon, “Inni iddoo ani itti kooluu galuu fi daʼannoo koo ti; Waaqa koo kan ani amanadhuu dha” nan jedha.
english: I will say of the LORD, “He is my refuge and my fortress; my God, in whom I trust.”

kikuyu: Inni dhugumaan kiyyoo adamsaa jalaa, dhukkuba nama fixu jalaas si baasa.
english: For he will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly pestilence.

kikuyu: Inni baallee isaatiin si dhoksa; atis qoochoo isaa jalatti kooluu ni galta; amanamummaan isaa gaachanaa fi dallaa eegumsaa siif taʼa.
english: He will cover you with his feathers. Under his wings you will take refuge. His faithfulness is your shield and rampart.

kikuyu: Atis naasuu halkanii, yookaan xiyya guyyaan futtaafamu hin sodaattu;
english: You shall not be afraid of the terror by night, nor of the arrow that flies by day,

kikuyu: golfaa dukkana keessa deemu, yookaan dhaʼicha guyyaa saafaan nama balleessu hin sodaannu.
english: nor of the pestilence that walks in darkness, nor of the destruction that wastes at noonday.

kikuyu: Kumni tokko si cinatti, kumni kudhan immoo mirga keetti ni kufa; garuu sitti hin dhiʼaatu.
english: A thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand; but it will not come near you.

kikuyu: Ati ijuma kee qofaan ilaalta; adaba hamootatti dhufus ni argita.
english: You will only look with your eyes, and see the recompense of the wicked.

kikuyu: Ati waan Waaqayyoon iddoo kooluu itti galtu, Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii iddoo jireenya keetii godhatteef,
english: Because you have made the LORD your refuge, and the Most High your dwelling place,

kikuyu: wanni hamaan si hin tuqu; dhaʼichis dunkaana keetti hin dhiʼaatu.
english: no evil shall happen to you, neither shall any plague come near your dwelling.

kikuyu: Inni akka isaan karaa kee hunda irratti si eeganiif, ergamoota isaa siif ni ajaja;
english: For he will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you in all your ways.

kikuyu: isaanis akka miilla keetiin dhagaatti hin buuneef harka isaaniitiin ol si fuudhu.
english: They will bear you up in their hands, so that you won’t dash your foot against a stone.

kikuyu: Ati leencaa fi buutii irra ejjetta; leenca saafelaa fi jawwee ni dhidhiitta.
english: You will tread on the lion and cobra. You will trample the young lion and the serpent underfoot.

kikuyu: Waaqayyos akkana jedha; “Sababii inni na jaallatuuf, ani isa nan oolcha; waan inni maqaa koo beekuuf isa nan eega.
english: “Because he has set his love on me, therefore I will deliver him. I will set him on high, because he has known my name.

kikuyu: Inni na waammata; anis nan deebisaaf; rakkina keessatti ani isa wajjin nan taʼa; isa nan oolcha; ulfinas nan kennaaf.
english: He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.

kikuyu: Ani umurii dheeraa isa nan quufsa; fayyisuu koos isatti argisiisa.”
english: I will satisfy him with long life, and show him my salvation.”

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Guyyaa Sanbataa Faarfatamu. Waaqayyoon, galateeffachuun, yaa Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii, maqaa keetiif faarfachuun gaarii dha.
english: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks to the LORD, to sing praises to your name, Most High,

kikuyu: Jaalala kee ganamaan, amanamummaa kees halkaniin labsuun,
english: to proclaim your loving kindness in the morning, and your faithfulness every night,

kikuyu: kiraara ribuu kudhaniitiin, sagalee baganaatiinis labsuun gaarii dha.
english: with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati hojii keetiin na gammachiiftaatii; ani sababii hojii harka keetiitiif gammachuudhaan nan faarfadha.
english: For you, LORD, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, hojiin kee akkam guddaa dha; yaadni kees akkam gad fagoo dha!
english: How great are your works, LORD! Your thoughts are very deep.

kikuyu: Namni qalbii hin qabne waan kana beekuu hin dandaʼu; gowwaanis hin hubatu;
english: A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:

kikuyu: hamoonni yoo akkuma margaa biqilan iyyuu, jalʼoonni hundinuus yoo daraaran iyyuu, isaan bara baraan ni barbadaaʼu.
