english: though the wicked spring up as the grass, and all the evildoers flourish, they will be destroyed forever.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati garuu bara baraan ol ol jetta.
english: But you, LORD, are on high forever more.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, kunoo diinota kee, kunoo diinonni kee ni badu; warri jalʼina hojjetan hundinuus ni bittinneeffamu.
english: For behold, your enemies, LORD, for behold, your enemies shall perish. All the evildoers will be scattered.

kikuyu: Ati gaanfa koo akka gaanfa gafarsaa ol ol qabde; zayitii haaraa natti dhangalaafte.
english: But you have exalted my horn like that of the wild ox. I am anointed with fresh oil.

kikuyu: Iji koo moʼatamuu diinota koo argeera; gurri koos badiisa jalʼoota natti kaʼanii dhagaʼeera.
english: My eye has also seen my enemies. My ears have heard of the wicked enemies who rise up against me.

kikuyu: Qajeeltonni akkuma muka meexxii ni dagaagu; akkuma birbirsa Libaanoonitti ni guddatu;
english: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree. He will grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

kikuyu: isaan mana Waaqayyoo keessa dhaabamanii jiru; oobdii Waaqa keenyaa keessattis itti tolee misanii jiran.
english: They are planted in the LORD’s house. They will flourish in our God’s courts.

kikuyu: Isaan amma iyyuu bara dullumaa keessa ija naqatu; gabbataniis dagaaganii jiraatu.
english: They will still produce fruit in old age. They will be full of sap and green,

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Waaqayyo tolaa dha; inni Kattaa koo ti; hamminni isa keessa hin jiru” jedhanii labsu.
english: to show that the LORD is upright. He is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo ni moʼa; surraas ni uffata; Waaqayyo surra ni uffata; jabinas hidhata. Addunyaan cimtee dhaabamteerti; hin sochoofamtus.
english: The LORD reigns! He is clothed with majesty! The LORD is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be moved.

kikuyu: Teessoon kee durumaa jalqabee cimee dhaabateera; ati durii duriitii jalqabdee jirta.
english: Your throne is established from long ago. You are from everlasting.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, galaanonni ol kaasaniiru; galaanonni sagalee isaanii ol kaafataniiru; galaanonni huursuu isaanii ol kaafataniiru.
english: The floods have lifted up, LORD, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.

kikuyu: Sagalee bishaan baayʼee caalaa, jabina dhaʼaa galaanaa caalaas, Waaqayyo ol gubbaa jiru sun humna qabeessa.
english: Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, the LORD on high is mighty.

kikuyu: Seerri kee jabaatee ni dhaabata; Yaa Waaqayyo, qulqullummaan bara baraan faaya mana keetii ti.
english: Your statutes stand firm. Holiness adorns your house, LORD, forever more.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, Waaqa haaloo baaftu, Yaa Waaqa haaloo baaftu, ifii mulʼadhu.
english: LORD, you God to whom vengeance belongs, you God to whom vengeance belongs, shine out.

kikuyu: Yaa Abbaa Murtii lafa kanaa kaʼi; of tuultotaaf illee waan isaanii malu kenni.
english: Rise up, you judge of the earth. Pay back the proud what they deserve.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, hamma yoomiitti warri hamoon, warri hamoon hamma yoomiitti burraaqu?
english: LORD, how long will the wicked, how long will the wicked triumph?

kikuyu: Isaan dubbii of tuulummaa gad roobsu; jalʼoonni hundinuu of dhiibuudhaan guutaman.
english: They pour out arrogant words. All the evildoers boast.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, isaan saba kee miidhu; handhuuraa kees ni hacuucu.
english: They break your people in pieces, LORD, and afflict your heritage.

kikuyu: Haadha hiyyeessaatii fi keessummaa ni gorraʼu; ijoollee abbaa hin qabnes ni ajjeesu.
english: They kill the widow and the alien, and murder the fatherless.

kikuyu: Isaan, “Waaqayyo hin argu; Waaqni Yaaqoob hin qalbeeffatu” jedhu.
english: They say, “The LORD will not see, neither will Jacob’s God consider.”

kikuyu: Warri saba keessaa raatoftan mee hubadhaa; isin warri gowwoonni yoom ogeeyyii taatu?
english: Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?

kikuyu: Inni gurra uume sun hin dhagaʼuu? Inni ija uume hin argu?
english: He who implanted the ear, won’t he hear? He who formed the eye, won’t he see?

kikuyu: Inni saboota sirreessu sun hin adabuu? Inni nama barsiisu sun beekumsa hin qabuu?
english: He who disciplines the nations, won’t he punish? He who teaches man knows.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo yaada namaa beeka; akka yaadni namaa faayidaa hin qabnes ni beeka.
english: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, namni ati adabdu, namni ati seera kee irraa barsiiftu eebbifamaa dha;
english: Blessed is the man whom you discipline, LORD, and teach out of your law,

kikuyu: hamma hamootaaf boolli qotamutti, guyyaa rakkinaatti ati boqonnaa kennitaaf.
english: that you may give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit is dug for the wicked.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo saba isaa hin gatuutii; inni akkana illee jedhee handhuuraa ofii isaa hin dhiisu.
english: For the LORD won’t reject his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

kikuyu: Murtiin qajeelummaa irratti hundeeffama; toloonni hundinuus isa faana buʼu.
english: For judgment will return to righteousness. All the upright in heart shall follow it.

kikuyu: Eenyutu hamootatti naa kaʼa? Eenyutu na cina dhaabatee warra jalʼina hojjetaniin morma?
english: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand up for me against the evildoers?

kikuyu: Utuu Waaqayyo na gargaaruu baatee, silaa yoona lubbuun koo boolla duʼaa keessa jirti.
english: Unless the LORD had been my help, my soul would have soon lived in silence.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo yeroo ani, “Miilli koo mucucaateera” jedhetti, araarri kee ol qabee na dhaabe.
english: When I said, “My foot is slipping!” Your loving kindness, LORD, held me up.

kikuyu: Yommuu yaaddoon natti baayʼatetti, jajjabeessuun kee lubbuu koo gammachiise.
english: In the multitude of my thoughts within me, your comforts delight my soul.

kikuyu: Bulchitoonni hamoon, warri seeratti fayyadamanii jalʼina hojjetan si wajjin tokkummaa qabaachuu dandaʼuu?
english: Shall the throne of wickedness have fellowship with you, which brings about mischief by statute?

kikuyu: Isaan tokkummaadhaan nama qajeelaatti kaʼanii nama yakka hin qabnetti duʼa muru.
english: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu daʼoo, Waaqni koos, kattaa ani itti baqadhu naa taʼeera.
english: But the LORD has been my high tower, my God, the rock of my refuge.

kikuyu: Inni gatii cubbuu isaanii isaanumatti deebisa; sababii hammina isaaniitiif illee isaan balleessa; Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya isaan barbadeessa.
english: He has brought on them their own iniquity, and will cut them off in their own wickedness. The LORD, our God, will cut them off.

kikuyu: Kottaa Waaqayyoof faarfannaa; Kattaa fayyina keenyaatiifis ni ililchinaa.
english: Oh come, let’s sing to the LORD. Let’s shout aloud to the rock of our salvation!

kikuyu: Galataan fuula isaa duratti haa dhiʼaannu; faarfannaadhaanis isa haa leellifnu.
english: Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving. Let’s extol him with songs!

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqa guddaadhaatii; inni waaqota hundaa olitti Mootii guddaa dha.
english: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.

kikuyu: Qileewwan lafaa harka isaa keessa jiru; fiixeewwan tulluus kan isaa ti.
english: In his hand are the deep places of the earth. The heights of the mountains are also his.

kikuyu: Galaanni kan isaa ti; isatu hojjeteetii; lafa gogaa illee harka isaatu uume.
english: The sea is his, and he made it. His hands formed the dry land.

kikuyu: Kottaa gad jennee sagadnaa; Uumaa keenya Waaqayyo duratti ni jilbeenfannaa;
english: Oh come, let’s worship and bow down. Let’s kneel before the LORD, our Maker,

kikuyu: inni Waaqa keenyaatii; nu immoo saba eegumsa isaa jala jirruu dha; bushaayee harka isaa keessa jiruudhas. Isin harʼa yoo sagalee isaa dhageessan,
english: for he is our God. We are the people of his pasture, and the sheep in his care. Today, oh that you would hear his voice!

kikuyu: akka Mariibaatti gootan sana, akka gaafa gammoojjii keessatti Maasaatti gootan sanaa mataa hin jabaatinaa;
english: Don’t harden your heart, as at Meribah, as in the day of Massah in the wilderness,

kikuyu: abbootiin keessan utuma hojii koo arganuu, achitti qoranii na ilaalan.
english: when your fathers tempted me, tested me, and saw my work.

kikuyu: Dhaloota sanatti ani waggaa afurtama nan dheekkame; anis, “Isaan saba garaan isaanii karaa irraa jalʼatee dha; isaan karaa koo hin beekne” nan jedheen.
english: Forty long years I was grieved with that generation, and said, “They are a people who err in their heart. They have not known my ways.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani dheekkamsa kootiin, “Isaan boqonnaa kootti hin galan” jedhee kakadhe.
english: Therefore I swore in my wrath, “They won’t enter into my rest.”

kikuyu: Faarfannaa haaraa Waaqayyoof faarfadhaa; lafti hundinuu Waaqayyoon faarfadhaa.
english: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon faarfadhaa; maqaa isaa eebbisaa; fayyisuu isaas guyyuma guyyaan labsaa.
english: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

kikuyu: Ulfina isaa saboota gidduutti, hojii isaa dinqisiisaa sana immoo namoota hunda keessatti labsaa.
english: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo guddaadhaatii galanni baayʼeen isaaf ni mala; inni waaqota hundaa olittis sodaatamuu qaba.
english: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

kikuyu: Waaqonni saboota ormaa hundinuu waaqota tolfamoodhaatii; Waaqayyo garuu samiiwwan uume.
english: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

kikuyu: Miidhaginnii fi surraan fuula isaa dura jiru; jabinnii fi ulfinni iddoo qulqullummaa isaa keessa jiru.
english: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

kikuyu: Yaa maatiiwwan sabootaa Waaqayyoof kennaa; ulfinaa fi jabina Waaqayyoof kennaa.
english: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

kikuyu: Ulfina maqaa isaatiif malu Waaqayyoof kennaa; aarsaa fidaatii oobdii isaa seenaa.
english: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

kikuyu: Bareedina qulqullummaa isaatiin Waaqayyoon waaqeffadhaa; isin lafti hundinuu fuula isaa duratti holladhaa.
english: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

kikuyu: Saboota gidduutti, “Waaqayyo mootii dha” jedhaa; addunyaan jabaattee dhaabatteerti; sochoofamuus hin dandeessu. Inni qajeelummaadhaan sabootaaf murtii kenna.
english: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

kikuyu: Samiiwwan haa ililchan; laftis haa gammaddu; galaannii fi wanni isa keessa jiru hundinuu haa huursu.
english: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

kikuyu: Dirreewwanii fi wanni isaan irra jiran hundinuu haa gammadan. Mukkeen bosonaa hundinuus gammachuudhaan haa faarfatan.
english: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

kikuyu: Uumamni hundi fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa faarfatu; inni ni dhufaatii; inni lafatti murteessuuf ni dhufa. Addunyaatti qajeelummaadhaan, sabootatti immoo dhugaa isaatiin ni mura.
english: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo moʼeera; lafti haa gammaddu; biyyoonni qarqara galaanaa hedduunis haa ililchan.
english: The LORD reigns! Let the earth rejoice! Let the multitude of islands be glad!

kikuyu: Duumessaa fi dukkanni limixiin isa marsaniiru; qajeelummaa fi murtii qajeelaan hundee teessoo isaa ti.
english: Clouds and darkness are around him. Righteousness and justice are the foundation of his throne.

kikuyu: Ibiddi fuula isaa dura deemee diinota isaa naannoo isaatii fixa.
english: A fire goes before him, and burns up his adversaries on every side.

kikuyu: Balaqqeen isaa addunyaa ibsa; laftis argitee hollatti.
english: His lightning lights up the world. The earth sees, and trembles.

kikuyu: Tulluuwwan fuula Waaqayyoo duratti, fuula Gooftaa lafa hundumaa durattis akkuma gagaa baqu.
english: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

kikuyu: Samiiwwan qajeelummaa isaa labsu; saboonni hundinuus ulfina isaa argu.
english: The heavens declare his righteousness. All the peoples have seen his glory.

kikuyu: Warri fakkii waaqeffatan, kanneen waaqota tolfamoon of jajan hundi haa qaaneffaman; isin waaqonni hundinuus isa waaqeffadhaa!
english: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, sababii murtii keetiitiif, Xiyoon dhageessee ililchiti; gandoonni Yihuudaas ni gammadu.
english: Zion heard and was glad. The daughters of Judah rejoiced because of your judgments, LORD.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati lafa hundumaa irratti Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii ti; ati waaqota hundumaa irra akka malee ol ol jetteerta.
english: For you, LORD, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.

kikuyu: Sababii inni lubbuu amanamoota isaa eegee, harka hamootaa jalaa isaan baasuuf, warri Waaqayyoon jaallatan hammina haa jibban.
english: You who love the LORD, hate evil! He preserves the souls of his saints. He delivers them out of the hand of the wicked.

kikuyu: Qajeeltota irratti ifni ni ifa; gara tolootaafis gammachuun ni dhufa.
english: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

kikuyu: Isin qajeeltonni Waaqayyotti gammadaa; maqaa isaa qulqulluus galateeffadhaa.
english: Be glad in the LORD, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa. Waaqayyoof faarfannaa haaraa faarfadhaa; inni dinqii hojjeteeratii; harki isaa inni mirgaatii fi irreen isaa qulqulluun, akka inni moʼannaa argatu godhaniiru.
english: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for he has done marvelous things! His right hand and his holy arm have worked salvation for him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akka fayyisuun isaa beekamu godheera; qajeelummaa isaas sabootatti mulʼiseera.
english: The LORD has made known his salvation. He has openly shown his righteousness in the sight of the nations.

kikuyu: Inni jaalala isaatii fi amanamummaa isaa mana Israaʼeliif yaadateera; daariin lafaa hundinuu, fayyisuu Waaqa keenyaa arganiiru.
english: He has remembered his loving kindness and his faithfulness toward the house of Israel. All the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

kikuyu: Lafti hundinuu Waaqayyoof ililchaa; faarfannaa gammachuutiin iyyaa; weedduu galataas weeddisaa;
english: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth! Burst out and sing for joy, yes, sing praises!

kikuyu: baganaadhaan faarfannaa galataa, baganaa fi sagalee weedduutiin Waaqayyoof faarfadhaa;
english: Sing praises to the LORD with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.

kikuyu: malakataa fi sagalee gaanfaatiin, fuula Waaqayyo mootichaa duratti ililchaa.
english: With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, the LORD.

kikuyu: Galaannii fi wanni isa keessa jiru hundinuu, addunyaa fi wanti ishee keessa jiraatu hundinuu haa huursan.
english: Let the sea roar with its fullness; the world, and those who dwell therein.

kikuyu: Lageen harka isaanii haa rurrukutan; tulluuwwanis tokkummaadhaan haa ililchan;
english: Let the rivers clap their hands. Let the mountains sing for joy together.

kikuyu: isaan fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa faarfatan; inni lafatti murteessuu ni dhufaatii. Inni addunyaaf qajeelummaadhaan, namootaaf immoo utuu wal hin caalchisin murtii kenna.
english: Let them sing before the LORD, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, and the peoples with equity.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo moʼeera; saboonni haa hollatan; inni kiirubeel gidduu, teessoo isaa irra taaʼa; lafti haa raafamtu.
english: The LORD reigns! Let the peoples tremble. He sits enthroned among the cherubim. Let the earth be moved.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Xiyoon keessatti guddaa dha; inni saboota hunda irra ol ol jedheera.
english: The LORD is great in Zion. He is high above all the peoples.

kikuyu: Isaan maqaa kee guddichaa fi sodaachisaa sana haa jajan; inni qulqulluu dha.
english: Let them praise your great and awesome name. He is Holy!

kikuyu: Mootichi humna qabeessa; inni murtii qajeelaa jaallata; ati tola hundeessiteerta; Yaaqoob keessattis haqaa fi qajeelummaa hojjetteerta.
english: The King’s strength also loves justice. You establish equity. You execute justice and righteousness in Jacob.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqa keenya leellisaa; ejjeta miilla isaa jalatti sagadaa; inni qulqulluu dha.
english: Exalt the LORD our God. Worship at his footstool. He is Holy!

kikuyu: Musee fi Aroon luboota isaa keessa turan; Saamuʼeelis warra maqaa isaa waammatan keessa ture; isaan Waaqayyoon waammatan; innis deebii kenneef.
english: Moses and Aaron were among his priests, Samuel was among those who call on his name. They called on the LORD, and he answered them.

kikuyu: Inni utubaa duumessaa keessaa isaanitti dubbate; isaanis sirna isaatii fi seera inni isaaniif kenne eegan.
english: He spoke to them in the pillar of cloud. They kept his testimonies, the statute that he gave them.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa keenya, ati deebii isaanii kennite; ati balleessaa isaanii adabdu illee, Israaʼeliif Waaqa dhiifama gootu turte.
english: You answered them, LORD our God. You are a God who forgave them, although you took vengeance for their doings.

kikuyu: Waaqa keenya Waaqayyoon leellisaa; tulluu isaa qulqulluu irrattis waaqeffadhaa; Waaqayyo Waaqni keenya Waaqa qulqulluudhaatii.
english: Exalt the LORD, our God. Worship at his holy hill, for the LORD, our God, is holy!

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Galataa. Lafti hundinuu Waaqayyoof ililchaa.
english: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Shout for joy to the LORD, all you lands!

kikuyu: Gammachuudhaan Waaqayyoon waaqeffadhaa; faarfannaa gammachuutiinis fuula isaa duratti dhiʼaadhaa.
english: Serve the LORD with gladness. Come before his presence with singing.

kikuyu: Akka Waaqayyo Waaqa taʼe beekaa; isattu nu uume; nu kan isaa ti; nu saba isaa ti; hoolota tika isaa jala jirruu dha.
english: Know that the LORD, he is God. It is he who has made us, and we are his. We are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

kikuyu: Galateeffachuudhaan karrawwan isaa, jajachuudhaanis oobdii isaa seenaa; isa galateeffadhaa; maqaa isaa illee eebbisaa.
english: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise. Give thanks to him, and bless his name.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo gaariidhaatii; araarri isaa kan bara baraa ti; amanamummaan isaas dhalootaa gara dhalootaatti itti fufa.
english: For the LORD is good. His loving kindness endures forever, his faithfulness to all generations.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Ani jaalala keetii fi murtii kee qajeelaa sanaaf nan faarfadha; Yaa Waaqayyo ani siif nan faarfadha.
english: A Psalm by David. I will sing of loving kindness and justice. To you, LORD, I will sing praises.

kikuyu: Ani jireenya hirʼina hin qabne jiraachuuf of nan eeggadha; ati yoom gara koo dhufta? Ani garaa qulqulluudhaan, mana koo nan jiraadha.
english: I will be careful to live a blameless life. When will you come to me? I will walk within my house with a blameless heart.

kikuyu: Ani ija koo dura, waan hamaa hin kaaʼu. Hojii jalʼootaa nan jibba; nattis hin qabatu.
english: I will set no vile thing before my eyes. I hate the deeds of faithless men. They will not cling to me.

kikuyu: Namoonni yaada micciiramaa qaban narraa haa fagaatan; ani jalʼina wajjin tokkummaa hin qabaadhu.
english: A perverse heart will be far from me. I will have nothing to do with evil.

kikuyu: Nama dhoksaan ollaa isaa hamatu kam iyyuu, ani afaan nan qabachiisa; nama tuffiin nama ilaaluu fi kan garaa of tuulu qabuuf, ani obsa hin qabaadhu.
english: I will silence whoever secretly slanders his neighbor. I won’t tolerate one who is arrogant and conceited.

kikuyu: Akka isaan na wajjin jiraataniif, iji koo amanamoota biyyattii irra jiraatti; namni karaa qajeelaa irra deemu, inni na tajaajila.
english: My eyes will be on the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me. He who walks in a perfect way, he will serve me.

kikuyu: Namni nama gowwoomsu tokko iyyuu mana koo keessa hin jiraatu; namni soba dubbatu tokko iyyuu fuula koo dura hin dhaabatu.
english: He who practices deceit won’t dwell within my house. He who speaks falsehood won’t be established before my eyes.

kikuyu: Ani jalʼoota biyyattii hunda, ganama ganama nan barbadeessa; warra waan hamaa hojjetan magaalaa Waaqayyoo keessaa nan balleessa.
english: Morning by morning, I will destroy all the wicked of the land, to cut off all the workers of iniquity from the LORD’s city.

kikuyu: Kadhannaa Namni Dhiphate Tokko Faaruu Booʼichaa Faarsee Fuula Waaqayyoo Duratti Dhiʼeeffatu. Yaa Waaqayyo, kadhannaa koo naa dhagaʼi; iyyi ani gargaarsaaf iyyadhus si bira haa gaʼu.
english: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed and pours out his complaint before the LORD. Hear my prayer, LORD! Let my cry come to you.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani dhiphadhetti, fuula kee na duraa hin dhoksin. Gurra kee gara kootti deebisi; yommuu ani si waammadhu dafiitii deebii naa kenni.
english: Don’t hide your face from me in the day of my distress. Turn your ear to me. Answer me quickly in the day when I call.

kikuyu: Barri koo akkuma aaraatti ni badaatii; lafeen koos akkuma barbadaa ibiddaa bobaʼaa jira.
english: For my days consume away like smoke. My bones are burned as a torch.

kikuyu: Garaan koo dhukkubsatee akkuma margaa coollageera; ani nyaata koo nyaachuu irraanfadheera.
english: My heart is blighted like grass, and withered, for I forget to eat my bread.

kikuyu: Sababii ani guddisee aaduuf, lafeen koo gogaa kootti maxxaneera.
english: By reason of the voice of my groaning, my bones stick to my skin.

kikuyu: Ani akka urunguu gammoojjii, akka urunguu lafa barbadaaʼe keessaa nan taʼe.
english: I am like a pelican of the wilderness. I have become as an owl of the waste places.

kikuyu: Ani hirriba malee nan bula; akka simbirroo kophaa ishee guutuu manaa irra jirtuus taʼeera.
english: I watch, and have become like a sparrow that is alone on the housetop.

kikuyu: Diinonni koo guyyaa guutuu na arrabsu; warri natti qoosanis abaarsaaf maqaa kootti fayyadamu.
english: My enemies reproach me all day. Those who are mad at me use my name as a curse.

kikuyu: Ani akkuma buddeenaatti daaraa nyaadheeraattii; dhugaatii koottis imimmaan makadheera;
english: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mixed my drink with tears,

kikuyu: kunis sababii aarii fi dheekkamsa keetiitiif natti dhufe; ati ol na fuutee gad na darbatteertaatii.
english: because of your indignation and your wrath; for you have taken me up and thrown me away.

kikuyu: Barri koo akkuma gaaddidduu galgalaa ti; anis akkuma margaa gogeera.
english: My days are like a long shadow. I have withered like grass.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati bara baraan teessoo irra jirta; yaadannoon kees dhaloota hundatti darba.
english: But you, LORD, will remain forever; your renown endures to all generations.

kikuyu: Ati kaatee Xiyooniif garaa ni laafta; yeroon itti isheen fudhatama argachuu qabdu ammumaatii; yeroon murteeffame sun gaʼeeraa.
english: You will arise and have mercy on Zion, for it is time to have pity on her. Yes, the set time has come.

kikuyu: Garboonni kee dhagaa isheetti gammaduutii; biyyoo ishees ni mararfatu.
english: For your servants take pleasure in her stones, and have pity on her dust.

kikuyu: Saboonni maqaa Waaqayyoo ni sodaatu; mootonni lafaa hundinuus ulfina kee ni kabaju.
english: So the nations will fear the LORD’s name, all the kings of the earth your glory.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo deebisee Xiyoonin ijaaraatii; ulfina isaatiinis ni mulʼata.
english: For the LORD has built up Zion. He has appeared in his glory.

kikuyu: Inni kadhannaa gadadamtootaa ni dhagaʼa; waammata isaaniis hin tuffatu.
english: He has responded to the prayer of the destitute, and has not despised their prayer.

kikuyu: Akka sabni hamma ammaatti hin dhalatin Waaqayyoon galateeffatuuf, wanni kun akkana jedhamee dhaloota dhufuuf haa barreeffamu:
english: This will be written for the generation to come. A people which will be created will praise the LORD,

kikuyu: “Waaqayyo iddoo qulqullummaa isaa gubbaa irraa gad ilaale; samii irraas gara lafaa gad milʼate;
english: for he has looked down from the height of his sanctuary. From heaven, the LORD saw the earth,

kikuyu: kanas aaduu warra hidhamanii dhagaʼuu fi warra duuti itti murame baasuudhaaf hojjete.”
english: to hear the groans of the prisoner, to free those who are condemned to death,

kikuyu: Akkasiin maqaan Waaqayyoo Xiyoon keessatti, galanni isaas Yerusaalem keessatti ni labsama;
english: that men may declare the LORD’s name in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem,

kikuyu: kunis yommuu saboonnii fi mootummoonni, Waaqayyoon waaqeffachuuf walitti qabamanitti taʼa.
english: when the peoples are gathered together, the kingdoms, to serve the LORD.

kikuyu: Inni jabina koo karaatti hambise; umurii koos ni gabaabse.
english: He weakened my strength along the course. He shortened my days.

kikuyu: Anis akkanan jedhe: “Yaa Waaqa ko, walakkaa umurii kootti na hin fudhatin; waggoonni kee dhalootaa hamma dhaloota hundaatti itti fufu.
english: I said, “My God, don’t take me away in the middle of my days. Your years are throughout all generations.

kikuyu: Ati jalqabatti lafa hundeessite; samiiwwanis hojii harka keetii ti.
english: Of old, you laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Isaan ni badu; ati garuu ni jiraatta; hundumti isaanii akkuma wayyaa ni dhumu. Ati akkuma uffataa isaan geeddarta; isaanis ni badu.
english: They will perish, but you will endure. Yes, all of them will wear out like a garment. You will change them like a cloak, and they will be changed.

kikuyu: Ati garuu sanuma; umuriin kees gonkumaa dhuma hin qabu.
english: But you are the same. Your years will have no end.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen garboota keetii sodaa malee jiraatu; sanyiin isaaniis fuula kee dura jiraata.”
english: The children of your servants will continue. Their offspring will be established before you.”

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa lubbuu ko, Waaqayyoon eebbisi; keessi namummaa koo hundi maqaa isaa qulqulluu sana eebbisaa.
english: By David. Praise the LORD, my soul! All that is within me, praise his holy name!

kikuyu: Yaa lubbuu koo Waaqayyoon eebbisi; tola isaa hundas hin irraanfatin.
english: Praise the LORD, my soul, and don’t forget all his benefits,

kikuyu: Inni cubbuu kee hundumaa siif dhiisa; dhukkuba kee hundumaa ni fayyisa;
english: who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,

kikuyu: jireenya kee boolla irraa ni baraara; jaalalaa fi gara laafinaan si gonfa;
english: who redeems your life from destruction, who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies,

kikuyu: akka dargaggummaan kee akkuma risaa haaromfamuufis, inni fedhii kee waan gaariidhaan ni guuta.
english: who satisfies your desire with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo warra cunqurfaman hundaaf qajeelummaa fi murtii qajeelaa kenna.
english: The LORD executes righteous acts, and justice for all who are oppressed.

kikuyu: Inni karaa isaa Museetti, hojii isaa immoo saba Israaʼelitti beeksise.
english: He made known his ways to Moses, his deeds to the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo gara laafessaa fi arjaa dha; inni aaruuf hin ariifatu; jaalalli isaas baayʼee dha.
english: The LORD is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and abundant in loving kindness.

kikuyu: Inni yeroo hunda hin dheekkamu; aarii isaa illee bara baraan hin kuufatu;
english: He will not always accuse; neither will he stay angry forever.

kikuyu: inni akka cubbuu keenyaatti nu hin adabne; yookaan akka balleessaa keenyaatti nuuf hin deebifne.
english: He has not dealt with us according to our sins, nor repaid us for our iniquities.

kikuyu: Akkuma samiiwwan lafa irraa ol fagaatan sana, jaalalli inni warra isa sodaataniif qabu akkasuma guddaa dha;
english: For as the heavens are high above the earth, so great is his loving kindness toward those who fear him.

kikuyu: akkuma baʼi biiftuu lixa biiftuu irraa fagaatu, akkasuma inni balleessaa keenya nurraa haqeera.
english: As far as the east is from the west, so far has he removed our transgressions from us.

kikuyu: Akkuma abbaan ijoollee isaatiif garaa laafu, Waaqayyo warra isa sodaataniif garaa ni laafa;
english: Like a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear him.

kikuyu: inni akka nu itti uumamne ni beekaatii; akka nu biyyoo taanes ni yaadata.
english: For he knows how we are made. He remembers that we are dust.

kikuyu: Barri namaa akkuma margaa ti; akka abaaboo dirrees ni misa;
english: As for man, his days are like grass. As a flower of the field, so he flourishes.

kikuyu: inni yeroo bubbeen itti bubbisutti ni bada; iddoon isaas deebiʼee isa hin yaadatu.
english: For the wind passes over it, and it is gone. Its place remembers it no more.

kikuyu: Jaalalli Waaqayyoo garuu bara baraa hamma bara baraatti warra isa sodaatan wajjin ni jiraata; qajeelummaan isaa immoo ijoollee ijoollee isaaniitti darba;
english: But the LORD’s loving kindness is from everlasting to everlasting with those who fear him, his righteousness to children’s children,

kikuyu: warra kakuu isaa eeganitti, warra ajaja isaatti buluu yaadatanittis ni darba.
english: to those who keep his covenant, to those who remember to obey his precepts.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo teessoo isaa samii keessa dhaabbateera; mootummaan isaas waan hunda bulcha.
english: The LORD has established his throne in the heavens. His kingdom rules over all.

kikuyu: Isin ergamoonni isaa, warri ajaja isaa eegdan jajjaboon, warri dubbii isaatiif ajajamtanis Waaqayyoon eebbisaa.
english: Praise the LORD, you angels of his, who are mighty in strength, who fulfill his word, obeying the voice of his word.

kikuyu: Raayyaan isaa hundinuu, isin tajaajiltoonni isaa warri fedhii isaa guuttan Waaqayyoon eebbisaa.
english: Praise the LORD, all you armies of his, you servants of his, who do his pleasure.

kikuyu: Uumamawwan bulchiinsa isaa jala lafa hunda jirtan hundi Waaqayyoon eebbisaa. Yaa lubbuu ko, Waaqayyoon eebbisi.
english: Praise the LORD, all you works of his, in all places of his dominion. Praise the LORD, my soul!

kikuyu: Yaa lubbuu ko, Waaqayyoon eebbisi. Yaa Waaqayyo, Waaqa ko, ati akka malee guddaa dha; miidhaginaa fi surraa uffatteerta.
english: Bless the LORD, my soul. The LORD, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.

kikuyu: Ati akkuma wayyaa ifa uffatta; samiiwwanis akkuma dunkaanaa diriirsita.
english: He covers himself with light as with a garment. He stretches out the heavens like a curtain.

kikuyu: Dareeraa diinqa isaa bishaanota irra buufta. Duumessoota gaarii isaa godhata; qoochoo bubbee yaabbattee deema.
english: He lays the beams of his rooms in the waters. He makes the clouds his chariot. He walks on the wings of the wind.

kikuyu: Inni ergamoota isaa hafuurota, tajaajiltoota isaa immoo arraba ibiddaa godha.
english: He makes his messengers winds, and his servants flames of fire.

kikuyu: Inni lafa hundee ishee irra dhaabeera; isheenis gonkumaa hin sochootu.
english: He laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be moved forever.

kikuyu: Ati akkuma wayyaatti tuujubaan ishee haguugde; bishaanonnis tulluuwwanii ol dhaabatan.
english: You covered it with the deep as with a cloak. The waters stood above the mountains.

kikuyu: Ati ifannaan bishaanonni baqatan; sagalee qaqawwee keetii dhageenyaan gugatan.
english: At your rebuke they fled. At the voice of your thunder they hurried away.

kikuyu: Isaan tulluuwwan irraan dhangalaʼan; gara iddoo ati isaanii qopheessitee, gara sululootaatti gad yaaʼan.
english: The mountains rose, the valleys sank down, to the place which you had assigned to them.

kikuyu: Akka isaan deebiʼanii lafa hin haguugneef ati daarii isaan darbuu hin dandeenye isaan dura dhaabde.
english: You have set a boundary that they may not pass over, that they don’t turn again to cover the earth.

kikuyu: Akka burqaawwan sululoota keessa yaaʼan goota; isaanis tulluuwwan gidduu yaaʼu.
english: He sends springs into the valleys. They run among the mountains.

kikuyu: Isaan bineensota bakkee hundaaf bishaan kennu; harroonni diidaas dheebuu baʼu.
english: They give drink to every animal of the field. The wild donkeys quench their thirst.

kikuyu: Simbirroonni samii bishaanota biratti mandhee ijaarratan; dameewwan gidduutti ni faarfatan.
english: The birds of the sky nest by them. They sing among the branches.

kikuyu: Inni mana isaa kan olii irraa tulluuwwan bishaan obaafta; laftis ija hojii keetiitiin quufti.
english: He waters the mountains from his rooms. The earth is filled with the fruit of your works.

kikuyu: Inni lafa irraa nyaata kennuuf jedhee looniif marga, faayidaa namaatiif immoo biqiltuuwwan biqilcha;
english: He causes the grass to grow for the livestock, and plants for man to cultivate, that he may produce food out of the earth:

kikuyu: akka daadhiin wayinii garaa nama gammachiisu, akka zayitiin fuula nama cululuqsuu fi akka midhaan nama jajjabeessu ni goota.
english: wine that makes the heart of man glad, oil to make his face to shine, and bread that strengthens man’s heart.

kikuyu: Mukkeen Waaqayyoo, birbirsi Libaanoon kan inni dhaabe sun bishaan quufaniiru.
english: The LORD’s trees are well watered, the cedars of Lebanon, which he has planted,

kikuyu: Simbirroonni achitti mandhee isaanii ijaarratu; huummoonis birbirsa irraa mana qabdi.
english: where the birds make their nests. The stork makes its home in the cypress trees.

kikuyu: Tulluuwwan dhedheeroon daʼoo reʼee diidaa ti; holqi kattaawwanii immoo daʼoo osolee ti.
english: The high mountains are for the wild goats. The rocks are a refuge for the rock badgers.

kikuyu: Inni akka jiʼi waqtiilee gargar qoodu godha; biiftuunis yeroo itti lixxu ni beekti.
english: He appointed the moon for seasons. The sun knows when to set.

kikuyu: Ati dukkana uumta; halkanis ni taʼa; bineensonni bosonaa hundis gad yaaʼu.
english: You make darkness, and it is night, in which all the animals of the forest prowl.

kikuyu: Leenci saafelli waan nyaatu barbaadee aada; nyaata isaas Waaqa bira barbaada.
english: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their food from God.

kikuyu: Isaan yommuu biiftuun baatutti walitti qabamu; dachaʼaniis goda isaanii keessa ciciisu.
english: The sun rises, and they steal away, and lie down in their dens.

kikuyu: Namni gara hojii isaatti, hamma galgalaattis gara jiruu isaatti ni baʼa.
english: Man goes out to his work, to his labor until the evening.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, hojiin kee akkam baayʼee dha! Ati hunda isaanii ogummaadhaan hojjette; laftis uumamawwan keetiin guutamte.
english: LORD, how many are your works! In wisdom, you have made them all. The earth is full of your riches.

kikuyu: Galaanni guddaa fi balʼaan kun, uumamawwan hamma hin qabneen guutame; kan lubbuu qabeeyyiin gurguddaa fi xixinnoon keessa jiraatan kuunnoo jira.
english: There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.

kikuyu: Dooniiwwan as irra deddeebiʼu; lewaataan kan akka inni achi keessa taphatuuf ati uumtes achi jira.
english: There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.

kikuyu: Akka ati nyaata isaanii yeroo barbaachisuutti isaaniif kennituuf, isaan hundi si eeggatu.
english: These all wait for you, that you may give them their food in due season.

kikuyu: Yeroo ati isaaniif kennitutti, isaan walitti qabatu; yeroo ati harka kee balʼiftutti, isaan waan gaarii quufu.
english: You give to them; they gather. You open your hand; they are satisfied with good.

kikuyu: Yeroo ati fuula kee dhokfattutti, isaan ni naʼu; yeroo ati hafuura isaanii fudhattutti, isaan duʼanii biyyootti deebiʼu.
english: You hide your face; they are troubled. You take away their breath; they die and return to the dust.

kikuyu: Yeroo ati Hafuura kee ergitutti isaan ni uumamu; atis fuula lafaa ni haaromsita.
english: You send out your Spirit and they are created. You renew the face of the ground.

kikuyu: Ulfinni Waaqayyoo bara baraan haa jiraatu; Waaqayyo hojii isaatti haa gammadu;
english: Let the LORD’s glory endure forever. Let the LORD rejoice in his works.

kikuyu: inni ilaallaan lafti hollatte; inni tuqnaan tulluuwwan keessaa aarrii baʼe.
english: He looks at the earth, and it trembles. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.

kikuyu: Bara jireenya koo guutuu ani Waaqayyoof nan faarfadha; hamma lubbuun koo jirtuttis faarfannaadhaan Waaqa koo nan galateeffadha.
english: I will sing to the LORD as long as I live. I will sing praise to my God while I have any being.

kikuyu: Irra deddeebiʼee yaaduun koo isa haa gammachiisu; ani Waaqayyotti nan gammadaatii.
english: Let my meditation be sweet to him. I will rejoice in the LORD.

kikuyu: Cubbamoonni lafa irraa haa badan; hamoonnis siʼachi hin jiraatin. Yaa lubbuu koo Waaqayyoon eebbisi. Haalleluuyaa.
english: Let sinners be consumed out of the earth. Let the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Waaqayyoof galata galchaa; maqaa isaas waammadhaa; waan inni hojjetes saboota gidduutti beeksisaa.
english: Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples.

kikuyu: Isaaf faarfadhaa; faarfannaadhaan isa galateeffadhaa; waaʼee hojii isaa isa dinqisiisaa hundaas odeessaa.
english: Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works.

kikuyu: Maqaa isaa qulqulluu sanaan boonaa; garaan warra Waaqayyoon barbaadanii haa gammadu.
english: Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoo fi humna isaa barbaaddadhaa; yeroo hunda fuula isaa barbaadaa.
english: Seek the LORD and his strength. Seek his face forever more.

kikuyu: Dinqii inni hojjete, hojii isaa dinqii sanaa fi murtii inni labse yaadadhaa;
english: Remember his marvelous works that he has done: his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth,

kikuyu: isin tajaajiltoonni isaa, warri sanyii Abrahaam taatan, isin filatamtoonni isaa, ilmaan Yaaqoobis kana yaadadhaa.
english: you offspring of Abraham, his servant, you children of Jacob, his chosen ones.

kikuyu: Inni Waaqayyo Waaqa keenya; murtiin isaas lafa hunda irra jira.
english: He is the LORD, our God. His judgments are in all the earth.

kikuyu: Inni kakuu isaa bara baraan, waadaa gale sanas dhaloota kumaaf ni yaadata;
english: He has remembered his covenant forever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations,

kikuyu: inni kakuu Abrahaam wajjin gale, kakuu Yisihaaqiif kakates ni yaadata.
english: the covenant which he made with Abraham, his oath to Isaac,

kikuyu: Kanas Yaaqoobiif seera, Israaʼeliif immoo kakuu bara baraa godhee akkana jedhee mirkaneesseera:
english: and confirmed it to Jacob for a statute; to Israel for an everlasting covenant,

kikuyu: “Ani biyya Kanaʼaan qooda ati dhaaltu godhee siif nan kenna.”
english: saying, “To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance,”

kikuyu: Isaan yeroo lakkoobsaan xinnoo turanitti, dhugumaanuu xinnoo fi biyyattii keessattis keessummoota turanitti,
english: when they were but a few men in number, yes, very few, and foreigners in it.

kikuyu: sabaa gara sabaatti, mootummaa tokkoo gara mootummaa biraatti jooran.
english: They went about from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another people.

kikuyu: Inni akka namni tokko iyyuu isaan cunqursu hin eeyyamne; sababii isaaniitiifis akkana jedhee mootota ifate:
english: He allowed no one to do them wrong. Yes, he reproved kings for their sakes,

kikuyu: “Dibamtoota koo hin tuqinaa; raajota koos hin miidhinaa.”
english: “Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

kikuyu: Inni beela biyyattiitti waame; midhaan nyaataa hundas ni balleesse;
english: He called for a famine on the land. He destroyed the food supplies.

kikuyu: innis Yoosef namicha akka garbaatti gurgurame tokko isaan dura erge.
english: He sent a man before them. Joseph was sold for a slave.

kikuyu: Isaan foncaadhaan miilla isaa luqqisan; mormi isaas sibiila keessa galfame;
english: They bruised his feet with shackles. His neck was locked in irons,

kikuyu: hamma wanni inni duraan dursee dubbate guutamutti dubbiin Waaqayyoo isa qore.
english: until the time that his word happened, and the LORD’s word proved him true.

kikuyu: Mootiin nama ergee gad isa dhiisise; bulchaan sabaa isa hiiksise.
english: The king sent and freed him, even the ruler of peoples, and let him go free.

kikuyu: Mootichis mana isaa irratti ajajaa, qabeenya isaa hunda irratti immoo bulchaa isa godhate;
english: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all of his possessions,

kikuyu: kanas akka inni akkuma fedhetti qondaaltota isaa gorsuuf, akka inni maanguddoota isaa ogummaa barsiisuuf godhe.
english: to discipline his princes at his pleasure, and to teach his elders wisdom.

kikuyu: Israaʼel biyya Gibxi dhaqe; Yaaqoobis akka alagaatti biyya Haam keessa jiraate.
english: Israel also came into Egypt. Jacob lived in the land of Ham.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo saba isaa akka malee baayʼise; akka isaan amajaajota isaanii caalaa jabaatanis godhe;
english: He increased his people greatly, and made them stronger than their adversaries.

kikuyu: innis akka isaan saba isaa jibbanii fi akka isaan tajaajiltoota isaatti mariʼataniif yaada isaanii geeddare.
english: He turned their heart to hate his people, to conspire against his servants.

kikuyu: Waaqnis Musee tajaajilaa isaatii fi Aroon filatamaa isaa erge.
english: He sent Moses, his servant, and Aaron, whom he had chosen.

kikuyu: Isaanis jara gidduutti mallattoo isaa, biyya Haam keessatti immoo dinqii isaa argisiisan.
english: They performed miracles among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

kikuyu: Inni dukkana ergee biyyattii dukkaneesse; isaan dubbii isaatti fincilaniiruutii.
english: He sent darkness, and made it dark. They didn’t rebel against his words.

kikuyu: Inni bishaanota isaanii dhiigatti geeddaree akka qurxummiiwwan isaanii dhuman godhe.
english: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

kikuyu: Fatteen biyya isaanii guutee diinqa mootota isaanii keessa yaaʼe.
english: Their land swarmed with frogs, even in the rooms of their kings.

kikuyu: Inni dubbannaan tuunni tisiisaatii fi bookeen biyya isaanii hunda keessa guutte.
english: He spoke, and swarms of flies came, and lice in all their borders.

kikuyu: Inni qooda bokkaa cabbii isaaniif roobse; bakakkaas biyya isaaniitti erge;
english: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning in their land.

kikuyu: wayinii isaaniitii fi muka harbuu isaanii balleesse; mukkeen biyya isaaniis ni caccabse.
english: He struck their vines and also their fig trees, and shattered the trees of their country.

kikuyu: Inni dubbannaan hawwaannisnii fi korophisni hedduun dhufan;
english: He spoke, and the locusts came with the grasshoppers, without number.

kikuyu: isaanis biqiltuu biyya jaraa hunda nyaatan; waan lafti isaanii baases ni fixan.
english: They ate up every plant in their land, and ate up the fruit of their ground.

kikuyu: Ergasii inni hangafa biyya isaanii hunda, jabina isaanii jalqabaas ni dhaʼe.
english: He struck also all the firstborn in their land, the first fruits of all their manhood.

kikuyu: Akka sabni Israaʼel meetii fi warqee baadhatee baʼu godhe; gosa isaanii keessaa namni tokko iyyuu hin gufanne.
english: He brought them out with silver and gold. There was not one feeble person among his tribes.

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni baanaan warri Gibxi gammadan; isaan Israaʼelin sodaatanii turaniitii.
english: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the fear of them had fallen on them.

kikuyu: Inni akka gaaddisaatti duumessa isaan irra qabe; akka halkaniin isaaniif ibsuuf immoo ibidda qabsiiseef.
english: He spread a cloud for a covering, fire to give light in the night.

kikuyu: Isaan kadhannaan inni dimbiriqqee kenneef; buddeena samiitiinis isaan quufse.
english: They asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of the sky.

kikuyu: Innis kattaa bane; bishaanis keessaa gad dhangalaʼe; akkuma bishaan lagaattis gammoojjii keessaa yaaʼe.
english: He opened the rock, and waters gushed out. They ran as a river in the dry places.

kikuyu: Inni waadaa isaa qulqulluu, kan garbicha isaa Abrahaamiif gale sana yaadateeraatii.
english: For he remembered his holy word, and Abraham, his servant.

kikuyu: Inni saba isaa gammachuun, warra isaaf filataman immoo ililleedhaan baaseera;
english: He brought his people out with joy, his chosen with singing.

kikuyu: inni biyya ormootaa isaaniif kenne; isaanis waan saboonni sun itti dadhaban dhaalan;
english: He gave them the lands of the nations. They took the labor of the peoples in possession,

kikuyu: kanas akka isaan sirna isaa eeganii seera isaatiif bulaniif godhe. Haalleluuyaa.
english: that they might keep his statutes, and observe his laws. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Haalleluuyaa. Waaqayyoof galata galchaa; inni gaariidhaatii; jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: Praise the LORD! Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Eenyutu hojii Waaqayyoo jabaa sana labsuu, yookaan galata isaa guutummaatti odeessuu dandaʼaa?
english: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD, or fully declare all his praise?

kikuyu: Warri jabeessanii murtii qajeelaa eegan, warri yeroo hunda waan qajeelaa hojjetan eebbifamoo dha.
english: Blessed are those who keep justice. Blessed is one who does what is right at all times.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, yommuu saba keetti faara toltutti na yaadadhu; yommuu isaan oolchituttis na gargaari;
english: Remember me, LORD, with the favor that you show to your people. Visit me with your salvation,

kikuyu: akka ani badhaadhummaa filatamtoota keetii arguuf, akka ani gammachuu saba keetii keessatti hirmaadhee dhaala kee wajjin boonuuf na yaadadhu.
english: that I may see the prosperity of your chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of your nation, that I may glory with your inheritance.

kikuyu: Nu akkuma abbootii keenyaa cubbuu hojjenneerra; yakka hojjenneerra; hamminas hojjenneerra.
english: We have sinned with our fathers. We have committed iniquity. We have done wickedly.

kikuyu: Abbootiin keenya yeroo biyya Gibxi keessa turanitti, dinqii kee hin hubanne; baayʼina araara keetiis hin yaadanne; isaan galaana biratti, Galaana Diimaa biratti sitti fincilan.
english: Our fathers didn’t understand your wonders in Egypt. They didn’t remember the multitude of your loving kindnesses, but were rebellious at the sea, even at the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Taʼus inni akka humni isaa guddaan sun beekamuuf, maqaa isaatiif jedhee isaan oolche.
english: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power known.

kikuyu: Inni Galaana Diimaa ifate; galaanichis ni goge; akkuma waan gammoojjii keessa dabarsuutti lafa gogaa irra isaan dabarse.
english: He rebuked the Red Sea also, and it was dried up; so he led them through the depths, as through a desert.

kikuyu: Harka amajaajii isaanii keessaa isaan baase; humna diinaa jalaas isaan fure.
english: He saved them from the hand of him who hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

kikuyu: Bishaanonni diinota isaanii liqimsan; tokkoon isaanii iyyuu hin hafne.
english: The waters covered their adversaries. There was not one of them left.

kikuyu: Ergasii isaan dubbii isaa amananii faarfannaadhaan isa galateeffatan.
english: Then they believed his words. They sang his praise.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu yommusuma waan inni hojjetee ture dagatan; gorsa isaas obsaan hin eegganne.
english: They soon forgot his works. They didn’t wait for his counsel,

kikuyu: Gammoojjii keessatti dharraa hamaadhaan guutaman; lafa onaa keessattis Waaqa qoran.
english: but gave in to craving in the desert, and tested God in the wasteland.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu inni waan isaan kadhatan kenneef; garuu dhukkuba nama huqqisu isaanitti erge.
english: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.

kikuyu: Isaan qubata keessatti Musee fi Aroon qulqullicha Waaqayyootti hinaafan.
english: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron, the LORD’s saint.

kikuyu: Lafti afaan banattee Daataanin liqimsite; garee Abiiraamis gad fudhatte.
english: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

kikuyu: Duuka buutoota isaanii gidduutti ibiddi bobaʼe; arrabni ibiddaas hamoota fixe.
english: A fire was kindled in their company. The flame burned up the wicked.

kikuyu: Isaan Kooreebitti jabbii tolfatan; fakkii baqfamee tolfames waaqeffatan.
english: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshiped a molten image.

kikuyu: Isa Ulfina isaanii taʼe sana, fakkii sangaa marga dheeduutti geeddaran.
english: Thus they exchanged their glory for an image of a bull that eats grass.

kikuyu: Waaqa isaan fayyise, isa biyya Gibxitti waan gurguddaa hojjete sana irraanfatan.
english: They forgot God, their Savior, who had done great things in Egypt,

kikuyu: Dinqii inni biyya Haam keessatti hojjete, hojii sodaachisaa inni Galaana Diimaa irratti hojjetes ni irraanfatan.
english: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome things by the Red Sea.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu utuu filatamaan isaa Museen akka dheekkamsi Waaqaa isaan hin balleessineef gidduu galee fuula isaa dura dhaabachuu baatee silaa Waaqni akka isaan balleessu dubbatee ture.
english: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had Moses, his chosen, not stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, so that he wouldn’t destroy them.

kikuyu: Isaanis biyya namatti tolu sana tuffatan; waadaa Waaqni gales hin amanne.
english: Yes, they despised the pleasant land. They didn’t believe his word,

kikuyu: Dunkaanota isaanii keessatti ni guunguman; Waaqayyoofis hin ajajamne.
english: but murmured in their tents, and didn’t listen to the LORD’s voice.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu inni akka gammoojjii keessatti isaan gatu harka isaa ol qabatee kakate;
english: Therefore he swore to them that he would overthrow them in the wilderness,

kikuyu: sanyii isaanii akka saboota gidduutti gatu, biyyoota hunda keessas akka isaan bittinneessu kakate.
english: that he would overthrow their offspring among the nations, and scatter them in the lands.

kikuyu: Isaan Baʼaal Pheʼooritti of kennanii aarsaa waaqota lubbuu hin qabneef dhiʼeeffame nyaatan.
english: They joined themselves also to Baal Peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

kikuyu: Hojii isaanii hamaa sanaan Waaqayyoon dheekkamsaaf kakaasan; dhaʼichis isaan irra buʼe.
english: Thus they provoked him to anger with their deeds. The plague broke in on them.

kikuyu: Garuu Fiinehaas kaʼee gidduu seennaan dhaʼichi sun dhaabate.
english: Then Phinehas stood up and executed judgment, so the plague was stopped.

kikuyu: Kunis dhalootaa hamma dhalootaatti, akka qajeelummaatti isaaf herregame.
english: That was credited to him for righteousness, for all generations to come.

kikuyu: Isaan bishaan Mariibaa biratti akka Waaqayyo aaru godhan. Museenis sababii isaaniitiif rakkate;
english: They angered him also at the waters of Meribah, so that Moses was troubled for their sakes;

kikuyu: sababii isaan Hafuura Waaqaatti fincilaniif Museen utuu itti hin yaadin dubbate.
english: because they were rebellious against his spirit, he spoke rashly with his lips.

kikuyu: Isaan akka Waaqayyo isaan ajajetti, saboota hin balleessine;
english: They didn’t destroy the peoples, as the LORD commanded them,

kikuyu: isaan garuu ormootatti makamanii duudhaa isaanii baratan.
english: but mixed themselves with the nations, and learned their works.

kikuyu: Waaqota isaanii tolfamoo, kanneen kiyyoo isaanitti taʼan waaqeffatan.
english: They served their idols, which became a snare to them.

kikuyu: Ilmaan isaaniitii fi intallan isaanii aarsaa godhanii hafuurota hamoof dhiʼeessan.
english: Yes, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

kikuyu: Isaanis dhiiga warra balleessaa hin qabnee, dhiiga ilmaan isaaniitii fi intallan isaanii, kan waaqota tolfamoo Kanaʼaaniif aarsaa godhanii dhiʼeessan sana dhangalaasan; biyyattiinis dhiiga isaaniitiin faalamte.
english: They shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan. The land was polluted with blood.

kikuyu: Isaan waanuma hojjetaniin of xureessan; hojii isaaniitiin sagaagaltoota of taasisan.
english: Thus they were defiled with their works, and prostituted themselves in their deeds.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqayyo saba isaatti aare; handhuuraa isaas ni balfe.
english: Therefore the LORD burned with anger against his people. He abhorred his inheritance.

kikuyu: Inni dabarsee ormootatti isaan kenne; amajaajonni isaaniis of jalatti isaan bulchan.
english: He gave them into the hand of the nations. Those who hated them ruled over them.

kikuyu: Diinonni isaanii isaan cunqursan; humna isaanii jalas isaan galfatan.
english: Their enemies also oppressed them. They were brought into subjection under their hand.

kikuyu: Inni yeroo baayʼee isaan baraare; isaan garuu ittuma fufanii fincilan; ittuma caalchisaniis cubbuu hojjetan.
english: He rescued them many times, but they were rebellious in their counsel, and were brought low in their iniquity.

kikuyu: Inni garuu yommuu iyya isaanii dhagaʼetti, rakkina isaanii hubate;
english: Nevertheless he regarded their distress, when he heard their cry.

kikuyu: isaaniif jedhee kakuu isaa yaadate; sababii jaalala isaa guddaa sanaatiif garaa laafeef.
english: He remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses.

kikuyu: Inni akka warri isaan boojiʼan hundinuu garaa isaaniif laafaniif godhe.
english: He made them also to be pitied by all those who carried them captive.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, Waaqa keenya nu oolchi; akka nu maqaa kee qulqulluu sana galateeffannuuf, akka galata keetiin of jajnuufis, ormoota keessaa walitti nu qabi.
english: Save us, LORD, our God, gather us from among the nations, to give thanks to your holy name, to triumph in your praise!

kikuyu: Waaqayyo, Waaqa Israaʼeliitiif, bara baraa hamma bara baraatti galanni haa gaʼu. Namni hundinuu “Ameen!” haa jedhu. Haalleluuyaa!
english: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting even to everlasting! Let all the people say, “Amen.” Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Waaqayyoof galata galchaa; inni gaariidhaatii; jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Warri Waaqayyo isaan fure, warri inni harka diinaatii baase,
english: Let the redeemed by the LORD say so, whom he has redeemed from the hand of the adversary,

kikuyu: warri inni biyya gara garaatii, baʼaa fi lixa biiftuutii, kaabaa fi kibbaa walitti qabe waan kana haa dubbatan.
english: and gathered out of the lands, from the east and from the west, from the north and from the south.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa tokko tokko gammoojjii goggogaa keessa jooran; magaalaa keessa jiraachuu dandaʼanis hin arganne.
english: They wandered in the wilderness in a desert way. They found no city to live in.

kikuyu: Isaan ni beelaʼan; ni dheebotanis; lubbuun isaaniis isaan keessatti gaggabde.
english: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

kikuyu: Isaan rakkina isaanii keessatti Waaqayyotti iyyatan; innis dhiphina isaanii keessaa isaan baase.
english: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: Inni hamma isaan magaalaa keessa jiraachuu dandaʼan gaʼanitti karaa qajeelaa irra isaan qajeelche.
english: He led them also by a straight way, that they might go to a city to live in.

kikuyu: Isaan sababii jaalala isaa kan hin geeddaramne sanaatii fi hojii dinqii kan inni ilmaan namaatiif hojjete sanaatiif Waaqayyoon haa galateeffatan;
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

kikuyu: inni warra dheebotan dheebuu baasee warra beelaʼan illee waan gaariidhaan quufsaatii.
english: For he satisfies the longing soul. He fills the hungry soul with good.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaas tokko tokko sibiilaan hidhamanii rakkachaa, dukkanaa fi dimimmisa keessa jiraatan;
english: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron,

kikuyu: isaan dubbii Waaqaatti fincilanii gorsa Waaqa Waan Hundaa Oliis tuffataniiruutii.
english: because they rebelled against the words of God, and condemned the counsel of the Most High.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu inni dabarsee hojii dadhabsiisaatti isaan kenne; isaanis ni gufatan; namni isaan gargaaru tokko iyyuu hin argamne.
english: Therefore he brought down their heart with labor. They fell down, and there was no one to help.

kikuyu: Isaan rakkina isaanii keessatti Waaqayyotti iyyatan; innis dhiphina isaanii keessaa isaan baase.
english: Then they cried to the LORD in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: Inni dukkanaa fi dimimmisa keessaa isaan baase; foncaa isaanis gargar kukkute.
english: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and broke away their chains.

kikuyu: Isaan sababii jaalala isaa kan hin geeddaramne sanaatii fi hojii dinqii kan inni ilmaan namaatiif hojjete sanaatiif Waaqayyoon haa galateeffatan;
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

kikuyu: inni balbalawwan naasii caccabsee danqaraawwan sibiilaa illee kukkutaatii.
english: For he has broken the gates of bronze, and cut through bars of iron.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa tokko tokko cubbuu mataa isaaniitiin gowwooman; sababii balleessaa isaaniitiifis gadadoo keessa seenan.
english: Fools are afflicted because of their disobedience, and because of their iniquities.

kikuyu: Isaan nyaata gosa kamii iyyuu balfanii afaan boolla duʼaa gaʼan.
english: Their soul abhors all kinds of food. They draw near to the gates of death.

kikuyu: Rakkina isaanii keessatti Waaqayyotti iyyatan; innis dhiphina isaanii keessaa isaan baase.
english: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he saves them out of their distresses.

kikuyu: Inni dubbii isaa ergee isaan fayyise; awwaala keessaas isaan baase.
english: He sends his word, and heals them, and delivers them from their graves.

kikuyu: Isaan sababii jaalala isaa kan hin geeddaramne sanaatii fi hojii dinqii kan inni ilmaan namaatiif hojjete sanaatiif, Waaqayyoon haa galateeffatan!
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds to the children of men!

kikuyu: Aarsaa galataa haa dhiʼeessan; faarfannaa gammachuutiinis hojii isaa haa himan.
english: Let them offer the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his deeds with singing.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa tokko tokko dooniidhaan galaana irra deemanii bishaanota gurguddaa irratti daldalan.
english: Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters,

kikuyu: Isaanis hojii Waaqayyootii fi hojii isaa dinqisiisaa sana tuujuba keessatti argan.
english: these see the LORD’s deeds, and his wonders in the deep.

kikuyu: Inni dubbatee bubbee jabaa dambalii galaanaa ol fuudhu tokko kaaseeraatii.
english: For he commands, and raises the stormy wind, which lifts up its waves.

kikuyu: Isaan samiitti ol baʼanii tuujubatti gad buʼan; rakkina isaanii keessattis abdii kutatan.
english: They mount up to the sky; they go down again to the depths. Their soul melts away because of trouble.

kikuyu: Akka nama machaaʼee daddarbatamanii gatantaran ogummaan isaanis faayidaa dhabe.
english: They reel back and forth, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

kikuyu: Isaan rakkina isaanii keessatti Waaqayyotti iyyatan; innis dhiphina isaanii keessaa isaan baase.
english: Then they cry to the LORD in their trouble, and he brings them out of their distress.

kikuyu: Inni akka dambaliin sun qabbanaaʼuuf dhaʼaa galaanaa calʼisiise.
english: He makes the storm a calm, so that its waves are still.

kikuyu: Isaan waan dambalii fi dhaʼaan galaanaa sun calʼisaniif ni gammadan; haala kanaanis gara qubata doonii barbaadaniitti isaan geesse.
english: Then they are glad because it is calm, so he brings them to their desired haven.

kikuyu: Isaan sababii jaalala isaa kan hin geeddaramne sanaatii fi hojii dinqii kan inni ilmaan namaatiif hojjete sanaatiif Waaqayyoon haa galateeffatan.
english: Let them praise the LORD for his loving kindness, for his wonderful deeds for the children of men!

kikuyu: Waldaa namootaa keessatti isa haa leellisan; wal gaʼii maanguddootaa keessattis isa haa jajan.
english: Let them exalt him also in the assembly of the people, and praise him in the seat of the elders.

kikuyu: Innis lagoota gammoojjii taasisee burqaawwan bishaanis gara lafa goggogaatti geeddare;
english: He turns rivers into a desert, water springs into a thirsty ground,

kikuyu: sababii hammina warra achi jiraataniitiif, biyya midhaan baasu lafa soogiddaa taasise.
english: and a fruitful land into a salt waste, for the wickedness of those who dwell in it.

kikuyu: Gammoojjii kuusaa bishaaniitti, lafa goggogaa immoo burqaa bishaaniitti geeddare;
english: He turns a desert into a pool of water, and a dry land into water springs.

kikuyu: inni akka warri beelaʼan achi jiraatan godhe; isaanis magaalaa keessa jiraatan ijaarratan.
english: There he makes the hungry live, that they may prepare a city to live in,

kikuyu: Lafa qotiisaa isaanii facaafatanii wayiniis ni dhaabbatan; midhaan gaariis argatan.
english: sow fields, plant vineyards, and reap the fruits of increase.

kikuyu: Inni isaan eebbise; baayʼina isaaniis akka malee dabale; akka loon isaanii lakkoobsaan yarachaa deeman hin goone.
english: He blesses them also, so that they are multiplied greatly. He doesn’t allow their livestock to decrease.

kikuyu: Yeroo isaan cunqursaadhaan, rakkinaa fi gaddaan xinnaatanii gad deebiʼanitti,
english: Again, they are diminished and bowed down through oppression, trouble, and sorrow.

kikuyu: inni namoota bebeekamoo irratti tuffii roobsee akka isaan gammoojjii karaa hin qabne keessa jooran godhe.
english: He pours contempt on princes, and causes them to wander in a trackless waste.

kikuyu: Inni garuu rakkattoota dhiphina isaanii keessaa baase; maatii isaanis akkuma bushaayee baayʼise.
english: Yet he lifts the needy out of their affliction, and increases their families like a flock.

kikuyu: Qajeeltonni waan kana arganii ililchu; hamoonni hundinuu garuu afaan qabatu.
english: The upright will see it, and be glad. All the wicked will shut their mouths.

kikuyu: Ogeessi kam iyyuu waan kana yaadatti haa qabatu; jaalala Waaqayyoo kan dhuma hin qabne sana illee haa hubatu.
english: Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of the LORD.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqi, garaan koo hin raafamu; ani nan faarfadha; lubbuu koo guutuudhaanis sin galateeffadha.
english: A Song. A Psalm by David. My heart is steadfast, God. I will sing and I will make music with my soul.

kikuyu: Yaa kiraaraa fi baganaa dammaqaa! Anis ganamaan nan dammaqa.
english: Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani saboota gidduutti galata siif nan galcha; namoota gidduuttis waaʼee kee nan faarfadha.
english: I will give thanks to you, LORD, among the nations. I will sing praises to you among the peoples.

kikuyu: Jaalalli kee guddaa dha; samiiwwanis caalaa ol dheeraadhaatii; amanamummaan kees samiiwwan qaqqaba.
english: For your loving kindness is great above the heavens. Your faithfulness reaches to the skies.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, ati samiiwwaniin olitti ol ol jedhi; ulfinni kees lafa hunda irra haa jiraatu.
english: Be exalted, God, above the heavens! Let your glory be over all the earth.

kikuyu: Akka warri ati jaallattu furamaniif, harka kee mirgaatiin nu oolchi; nu gargaaris;
english: That your beloved may be delivered, save with your right hand, and answer us.

kikuyu: Waaqni iddoo qulqullummaa isaatii akkana jedhee dubbateera: “Ani gammachuudhaan Sheekemin gargar nan qooda; Sulula Sukootis nan safara.
english: God has spoken from his sanctuary: “In triumph, I will divide Shechem, and measure out the valley of Succoth.

kikuyu: Giliʼaad kan koo ti; Minaaseenis kan koo ti; Efreem gonfoo sibiilaa koo ti; Yihuudaanis bokkuu mootummaa koo ti.
english: Gilead is mine. Manasseh is mine. Ephraim also is my helmet. Judah is my scepter.

kikuyu: Moʼaab caabii dhiqannaa koo ti; Edoom irra kophee koo darbadhee nan buusa; Filisxeem irrattis moʼannaadhaan nan geerara.”
english: Moab is my wash pot. I will toss my sandal on Edom. I will shout over Philistia.”

kikuyu: Eenyutu magaalaa jabeeffamtee ijaaramtetti na fida? Eenyutu Edoomitti na geessa?
english: Who will bring me into the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi kan nu gatte, kan loltoota keenya wajjin baʼuu diddes suma mitii?
english: Haven’t you rejected us, God? You don’t go out, God, with our armies.

kikuyu: Diina keenya of irraa dhowwuu nu gargaar, gargaarsi namaa faayidaa hin qabuutii.
english: Give us help against the enemy, for the help of man is vain.

kikuyu: Nu Waaqa wajjin ni moʼanna; innis diinota keenya gad dhidhiita.
english: Through God, we will do valiantly, for it is he who will tread down our enemies.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa Faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqa ani galateeffadhu ati hin calʼisin;
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. God of my praise, don’t remain silent,

kikuyu: namoonni hamoonnii fi gowwoomsitoonni, afaan isaanii natti banatanii jiruutii; isaan arraba sobaatiin maqaa na balleessaniiru.
english: for they have opened the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of deceit against me. They have spoken to me with a lying tongue.

kikuyu: Isaan dubbii jibbaatiin na marsan; sababii tokko malees na lolan.
english: They have also surrounded me with words of hatred, and fought against me without a cause.

kikuyu: Utuma ani isaan jaalladhuu na himatan; ani garuu nan kadhadha.
english: In return for my love, they are my adversaries; but I am in prayer.

kikuyu: Qooda waan gaarii hammina, qooda jaalala koo immoo jibba naa deebisan.
english: They have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

kikuyu: Akka inni isa mormuuf nama itti ramadi; seexannis karaa mirga isaa haa dhaabatu.
english: Set a wicked man over him. Let an adversary stand at his right hand.

kikuyu: Yommuu qoratamutti isatti haa muramu; kadhannaan isaas cubbuu isatti haa taʼu.
english: When he is judged, let him come out guilty. Let his prayer be turned into sin.

kikuyu: Umuriin isaa haa gabaabbatu, aangoo isaa namni biraa haa fudhatu.
english: Let his days be few. Let another take his office.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen isaa abbaa malee haa hafan; niitiin isaas haadha hiyyeessaa haa taatu.
english: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen isaa kadhattoota asii fi achi jooran haa taʼan; mana isaanii diigamaa keessaa illee haa ariʼaman.
english: Let his children be wandering beggars. Let them be sought from their ruins.

kikuyu: Waan inni qabu hunda namni isa irraa liqii qabu haa fudhatu; buʼaa dadhabbii isaa illee karaa adeemtonni haa saaman.
english: Let the creditor seize all that he has. Let strangers plunder the fruit of his labor.

kikuyu: Namni tokko iyyuu isaaf hin naʼin, yookaan ijoollee isaa kanneen abbaa hin qabneef garaa hin laafin.
english: Let there be no one to extend kindness to him, neither let there be anyone to have pity on his fatherless children.

kikuyu: Sanyiin isaa haa dhumu; maqaan isaanii dhaloota itti aanu keessaa haa balleeffamu.
english: Let his posterity be cut off. In the generation following let their name be blotted out.

kikuyu: Balleessaan abbootii isaa fuula Waaqayyoo duratti haa yaadatamu; cubbuun haadha isaas hin haqamin.
english: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered by the LORD. Don’t let the sin of his mother be blotted out.

kikuyu: Akka inni seenaa isaanii lafa irraa balleessuuf, cubbuun isaanii yeroo hunda fuula Waaqayyoo dura haa jiraatu.
english: Let them be before the LORD continually, that he may cut off their memory from the earth;

kikuyu: Inni hiyyeeyyii fi rakkattoota, warra garaan isaanii madaaʼes hamma duʼaatti gugse malee garaa isaaniif laafuu hin yaadneetii.
english: because he didn’t remember to show kindness, but persecuted the poor and needy man, the broken in heart, to kill them.

kikuyu: Inni abaaruu jaallate; abaarsi sun isumatti haa deebiʼu; inni eebbisuu hin jaallanne; eebbis isa irraa haa fagaatu.
english: Yes, he loved cursing, and it came to him. He didn’t delight in blessing, and it was far from him.

kikuyu: Inni akkuma uffata isaatti abaarsa uffata; abaarsis akkuma bishaanii dhagna isaa seena; akkuma zayitiis lafee isaa lixa.
english: He clothed himself also with cursing as with his garment. It came into his inward parts like water, like oil into his bones.

kikuyu: Abaarsi sun akkuma uffata inni ittiin of haguuguu, sabbata inni yeroo hunda hidhatuus isatti haa taʼu.
english: Let it be to him as the clothing with which he covers himself, for the belt that is always around him.

kikuyu: Kaffaltiin Waaqayyo warra na himatanii fi warra jireenya koo irratti waan hamaa dubbataniif kaffalu kanuma haa taʼu.
english: This is the reward of my adversaries from the LORD, of those who speak evil against my soul.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa, ati garuu maqaa keetiif jedhii na gargaar; gaarummaa jaalala keetiitiif jedhiitii na oolchi.
english: But deal with me, GOD the Lord, for your name’s sake, because your loving kindness is good, deliver me;

kikuyu: Ani hiyyeessaa fi rakkataadhaatii; garaan koos na keessatti madaaʼeera.
english: for I am poor and needy. My heart is wounded within me.

kikuyu: Ani akkuma gaaddidduu galgalaa badeera; akkuma hawwaannisaas olii gad oofameera.
english: I fade away like an evening shadow. I am shaken off like a locust.

kikuyu: Jilbi koo soomuudhaan dadhabeera; dhagni koos huqqatee lafeetti baʼeera.
english: My knees are weak through fasting. My body is thin and lacks fat.

kikuyu: Ani warra na himatan biratti waan tuffii taʼeera; isaan yommuu na argan mataa isaanii raasu.
english: I have also become a reproach to them. When they see me, they shake their head.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Waaqa ko, na gargaari; akkuma jaalala keetiittis na oolchi.
english: Help me, LORD, my God. Save me according to your loving kindness;

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, akka wanni kun harka kee taʼe, akka ati waan kana hojjette isaan haa beekan.
english: that they may know that this is your hand; that you, LORD, have done it.

kikuyu: Isaan ni abaaru; ati garuu ni eebbifta; yommuu natti kaʼan isaan ni qaanaʼu; tajaajilaan kee garuu ni gammada.
english: They may curse, but you bless. When they arise, they will be shamed, but your servant shall rejoice.

kikuyu: Himattoonni koo salphina haa uffatan; akkuma nama waaroo uffatuutti qaaniidhaan haa haguugaman.
english: Let my adversaries be clothed with dishonor. Let them cover themselves with their own shame as with a robe.

kikuyu: Ani afaan kootiin guddisee Waaqayyoon nan galateeffadha; waldaa guddaa gidduuttis isa nan jajadha.
english: I will give great thanks to the LORD with my mouth. Yes, I will praise him among the multitude.

kikuyu: Innis warra lubbuu isaatti muran jalaa isa baasuuf jedhee, karaa harka mirga rakkataatiin dhaabataatii.
english: For he will stand at the right hand of the needy, to save him from those who judge his soul.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Waaqayyo, gooftaa kootiin: “Hamma ani diinota kee ejjeta miilla keetii godhutti, karaa mirga koo taaʼi” jedhe.
english: A Psalm by David. The LORD says to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies your footstool for your feet.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo, “Diinota kee gidduutti moʼi” jedhee bokkuu aangoo keetii Xiyoonii siif erga.
english: The LORD will send out the rod of your strength out of Zion. Rule among your enemies.

kikuyu: Gaafa ati waraanaaf baatu, loltoonni kee fedhee isaaniitiin si faana qajeelu. Ati gadameessa ganamaa keessaa, surraa qulqulluu gonfattee fixeensa dargaggummaa keetii qabaatta.
english: Your people offer themselves willingly in the day of your power, in holy array. Out of the womb of the morning, you have the dew of your youth.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo, “Akka sirna Malkiiseedeqitti, ati luba bara baraa ti” jedhee kakateera. Inni yaada isaa hin geeddaru.
english: The LORD has sworn, and will not change his mind: “You are a priest forever in the order of Melchizedek.”

kikuyu: Gooftaan karaa harka kee mirgaa jira; inni guyyaa dheekkamsa isaatti mootota ni burkuteessa.
english: The Lord is at your right hand. He will crush kings in the day of his wrath.

kikuyu: Inni reeffa tuuluudhaan, bulchitoota guutummaa lafaa barbadeessuudhaan sabootatti mura.
english: He will judge among the nations. He will heap up dead bodies. He will crush the ruler of the whole earth.

kikuyu: Innis laga karaa cina jiru keessaa ni dhuga; kanaafuu mataa ol qabata.
english: He will drink of the brook on the way; therefore he will lift up his head.

kikuyu: Haalleluuyaa. Ani waldaa tolootaatii fi wal gaʼii keessatti, garaa koo guutuudhaan Waaqayyoon nan galateeffadha.
english: Praise the LORD! I will give thanks to the LORD with my whole heart, in the council of the upright, and in the congregation.

kikuyu: Hojiin Waaqayyoo guddaa dha; warri itti gammadan hundinuus irra deddeebiʼanii yaadan.
english: The LORD’s works are great, pondered by all those who delight in them.

kikuyu: Hojiin isaa surra qabeessaa fi kabajamaa dha; qajeelummaan isaas bara baraan jiraata.
english: His work is honor and majesty. His righteousness endures forever.

kikuyu: Inni akka dinqiin isaa yaadatamu godheera; Waaqayyo arjaa fi gara laafessa.
english: He has caused his wonderful works to be remembered. The LORD is gracious and merciful.

kikuyu: Inni warra isa sodaataniif nyaata kenna; kakuu isaas bara baraan ni yaadata.
english: He has given food to those who fear him. He always remembers his covenant.

kikuyu: Lafa saboota kaanii isaaniif kennuudhaan humna hojii isaa saba isaatti mulʼiseera.
english: He has shown his people the power of his works, in giving them the heritage of the nations.

kikuyu: Hojiin harka isaa amanamaa fi qajeelaa dha; ajajni isaa hundinuus amanamaa dha.
english: The works of his hands are truth and justice. All his precepts are sure.

kikuyu: Isaanis bara baraa hamma bara baraatti jabaatanii dhaabatu; amanamummaa fi qajeelummaadhaanis hojjetamu.
english: They are established forever and ever. They are done in truth and uprightness.

kikuyu: Inni saba isaatiif furii ergeera; kakuu isaas bara baraan ajajeera; maqaan isaa qulqulluu fi sodaachisaa dha.
english: He has sent redemption to his people. He has ordained his covenant forever. His name is holy and awesome!

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon sodaachuun jalqaba ogummaa ti; warri sirna isaa faana buʼan hundinuu hubannaa gaarii qabu. Galanni isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. All those who do his work have a good understanding. His praise endures forever!

kikuyu: Haalleluuyaa. Namni Waaqayyoon sodaatu, kan ajaja isaatti baayʼee gammadu eebbifamaa dha.
english: Praise the LORD! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who delights greatly in his commandments.

kikuyu: Sanyiin isaa lafa irratti jabaa taʼa; dhaloonni tolootaa ni eebbifama.
english: His offspring will be mighty in the land. The generation of the upright will be blessed.

kikuyu: Qabeenyii fi badhaadhummaan mana isaa keessa jira; qajeelummaan isaas bara baraan jiraata.
english: Wealth and riches are in his house. His righteousness endures forever.

kikuyu: Nama tolaa fi arjaadhaaf, gara laafessaa fi qajeelaaf, dukkana keessatti iyyuu ifni ni baʼa.
english: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright, gracious, merciful, and righteous.

kikuyu: Nama arjaa fi nama waa namaa liqeessuuf, nama hojii isaa qajeelummaadhaan adeemsifatuuf waan gaariitu taʼa.
english: It is well with the man who deals graciously and lends. He will maintain his cause in judgment.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan inni gonkumaa hin raafamu; namni qajeelaan bara baraan yaadatama.
english: For he will never be shaken. The righteous will be remembered forever.

kikuyu: Inni oduu hamaa hin sodaatu; garaan isaas Waaqayyoon amanachuudhaan jabaatee dhaabata.
english: He will not be afraid of evil news. His heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.

kikuyu: Garaan isaa hin raafamu; hin sodaatus; dhuma irrattis diinota isaa moʼata.
english: His heart is established. He will not be afraid in the end when he sees his adversaries.

kikuyu: Inni ni bittinneesse; hiyyeeyyiifis ni kenne; qajeelummaan isaa bara baraan ni jiraata; gaanfi isaas ulfinaan ol qabama.
english: He has dispersed, he has given to the poor. His righteousness endures forever. His horn will be exalted with honor.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan waan kana argee aara; ilkaan isaa qara; baqees ni bada; hawwiin hamootaa faayidaa malee hafa.
english: The wicked will see it, and be grieved. He shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away. The desire of the wicked will perish.

kikuyu: Haalleluuyaa. Yaa tajaajiltoota Waaqayyoo, galata galchaa; maqaa Waaqayyoo jajadhaa.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise, you servants of the LORD, praise the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Ammaa hamma bara baraatti maqaan Waaqayyoo haa eebbifamu.
english: Blessed be the LORD’s name, from this time forward and forever more.

kikuyu: Baʼa biiftuutii hamma lixa biiftuutti, maqaan Waaqayyoo haa jajamu.
english: From the rising of the sun to its going down, the LORD’s name is to be praised.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo saba hundaa ol jira; ulfinni isaas samiiwwanii ol.
english: The LORD is high above all nations, his glory above the heavens.

kikuyu: Kan akka Waaqayyo Waaqa keenya isa gubbaa teessoo isaa irra taaʼu sanaa eenyu?
english: Who is like the LORD, our God, who has his seat on high,

kikuyu: Kan gad jedhee samii fi lafa ilaalu eenyu?
english: who stoops down to see in heaven and on the earth?

kikuyu: Inni hiyyeessa awwaara keessaa ni kaasa; rakkataas tuulaa daaraa keessaa ol fuudha;
english: He raises up the poor out of the dust, and lifts up the needy from the ash heap,

kikuyu: inni bulchitoota gidduu, bulchitoota saba isaa gidduus isaan teessisa.
english: that he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

kikuyu: Inni akkuma haadha ijoollee kan gammachuudhaan jiraattuutti, dubartii maseena mana ishee keessa ni jiraachisa. Haalleluuyaa.
english: He settles the barren woman in her home as a joyful mother of children. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Yeroo sabni Israaʼel biyya Gibxii, manni Yaaqoobis saba afaan ormaa dubbatu keessaa baʼetti,
english: When Israel went out of Egypt, the house of Jacob from a people of foreign language,

kikuyu: Yihuudaan mana qulqullummaa Waaqaa, Israaʼel immoo bulchiinsa isaa taʼe.
english: Judah became his sanctuary, Israel his dominion.

kikuyu: Galaanni argee baqate; Yordaanosis duubatti deebiʼe;
english: The sea saw it, and fled. The Jordan was driven back.

kikuyu: tulluuwwan akka korbeeyyii hoolaa, gaarranis akkuma xobbaallaawwan hoolaa burraaqan.
english: The mountains skipped like rams, the little hills like lambs.
