kikuyu: Yaa galaana, ati maaliif baqatte? Yaa Yordaanos, atis maaliif duubatti deebite?
english: What was it, you sea, that you fled? You Jordan, that you turned back?

kikuyu: Yaa tulluuwwan, isin maaliif akka korbeeyyii hoolaa, yaa gaarran isinis maaliif akka xobbaallaawwan hoolaa burraaqxu?
english: You mountains, that you skipped like rams? You little hills, like lambs?

kikuyu: Yaa lafa, fuula Gooftaa duratti, fuula Waaqa Yaaqoob duratti holladhu;
english: Tremble, you earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,

kikuyu: inni kattaa gara harootti, kattaa jabaa immoo gara burqaa bishaaniitti geeddare.
english: who turned the rock into a pool of water, the flint into a spring of waters.

kikuyu: Nuuf miti; yaa Waaqayyo, nuuf miti; garuu jaalalaa fi amanamummaa keetiif jedhiitii maqaa keetiif ulfina kenni.
english: Not to us, LORD, not to us, but to your name give glory, for your loving kindness, and for your truth’s sake.

kikuyu: Saboonni maaliif, “Waaqni isaanii eessa jira?” jedhu?
english: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God, now?”

kikuyu: Waaqni keenya samii keessa jira; inni waan isa gammachiisu kam iyyuu ni hojjeta.
english: But our God is in the heavens. He does whatever he pleases.

kikuyu: Waaqonni isaanii tolfamoon garuu meetii fi warqee harka namaatiin hojjetamanii dha.
english: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

kikuyu: Isaan afaan qabu; garuu dubbachuu hin dandaʼan; ijas qabu; garuu arguu hin dandaʼan;
english: They have mouths, but they don’t speak. They have eyes, but they don’t see.

kikuyu: gurra qabu; garuu dhagaʼuu hin dandaʼan; funyaan qabu; garuu fuunfachuu hin dandaʼan;
english: They have ears, but they don’t hear. They have noses, but they don’t smell.

kikuyu: harka qabu; garuu qaqqabachuu hin dandaʼan; miilla qabu; garuu deemuu hin dandaʼan; laagaa isaanii keessattis sagalee tokko illee hin uuman.
english: They have hands, but they don’t feel. They have feet, but they don’t walk, neither do they speak through their throat.

kikuyu: Warri isaan tolchan kanneen isaan amanatan hundi akkuma isaanii taʼu.
english: Those who make them will be like them; yes, everyone who trusts in them.

kikuyu: Yaa mana Israaʼel, Waaqayyoon amanadhu; inni gargaarsaa fi gaachana isaanii ti.
english: Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: Yaa mana Aroon, Waaqayyoon amanadhu; inni gargaarsaa fi gaachana isaanii ti.
english: House of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: Isin warri isa sodaattan, Waaqayyoon amanadhaa; inni gargaarsaa fi gaachana isaanii ti.
english: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and their shield.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo nu yaadata; nu eebbisas; inni mana Israaʼel ni eebbisa; mana Aroonis ni eebbisa;
english: The LORD remembers us. He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel. He will bless the house of Aaron.

kikuyu: inni warra Waaqayyoon sodaatan, xinnaas guddaas ni eebbisa.
english: He will bless those who fear the LORD, both small and great.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo, isinii fi ijoollee keessan haa baayʼisu.
english: May the LORD increase you more and more, you and your children.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo samii fi lafa Uume sun isin haa eebbisu.
english: Blessed are you by the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Samiin samiiwwanii oliis kan Waaqayyoo ti; lafa garuu inni namaaf kenneera.
english: The heavens are the LORD’s heavens, but he has given the earth to the children of men.

kikuyu: Warri duʼan yookaan warri gara iddoo calʼisanitti gad buʼan Waaqayyoon galateeffachuu hin dandaʼan;
english: The dead don’t praise the LORD, nor any who go down into silence,

kikuyu: nu garuu ammaa jalqabnee bara baraan Waaqayyoon ni eebbifna. Haalleluuyaa.
english: but we will bless the LORD, from this time forward and forever more. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Ani Waaqayyoon nan jaalladha; inni sagalee waammata kootii naa dhagaʼeeraatii.
english: I love the LORD, because he listens to my voice, and my cries for mercy.

kikuyu: Sababii inni gurra isaa gara kootti deebiseef, ani hamman lubbuun jiraadhutti isa nan waammadha.
english: Because he has turned his ear to me, therefore I will call on him as long as I live.

kikuyu: Kiyyoon duʼaa na marse; dhiphinni Siiʼoolis na qabate; ani rakkinaa fi gaddaan nan moʼame.
english: The cords of death surrounded me, the pains of Sheol got a hold of me. I found trouble and sorrow.

kikuyu: Anis, “Yaa Waaqayyo na oolchi!” jedhee maqaa Waaqayyoo nan waammadhe.
english: Then I called on the LORD’s name: “LORD, I beg you, deliver my soul.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo arjaa fi qajeelaa dha; Waaqni keenya gara laaffessa.
english: The LORD is gracious and righteous. Yes, our God is merciful.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garraamota ni eega; yeroo ani baayʼee rakkadhetti isatu na gargaare.
english: The LORD preserves the simple. I was brought low, and he saved me.

kikuyu: Yaa lubbuu ko, boqonnaa keetti deebiʼi; Waaqayyo waan gaarii siif godheeraatii.
english: Return to your rest, my soul, for the LORD has dealt bountifully with you.

kikuyu: Ati yaa Waaqayyo lubbuu koo duʼa irraa, ija koo imimmaan irraa, miilla koo gufachuu irraa waan oolchiteef,
english: For you have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

kikuyu: ani biyya warra jiraatoo keessa, fuula Waaqayyoo dura nan jiraadha.
english: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.

kikuyu: Ani yeroo, “Ani baayʼee dhiphadheera” jedhetti, amantii koo eeggadheera.
english: I believed, therefore I said, “I was greatly afflicted.”

kikuyu: Ani yommuun burjaajaʼetti, “Namni hundinuu sobduu dha” nan jedhe.
english: I said in my haste, “All people are liars.”

kikuyu: Waan gaarii inni naa godhe hundaaf, ani Waaqayyoof maalan deebisa?
english: What will I give to the LORD for all his benefits toward me?

kikuyu: Ani xoofoo fayyinaa ol kaasee maqaa Waaqayyoo nan waammadha.
english: I will take the cup of salvation, and call on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Fuula saba isaa hundumaa duratti, ani wareega koo Waaqayyoof nan galcha.
english: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people.

kikuyu: Duuti qulqulloota isaa, fuula Waaqayyoo duratti ulfina qaba.
english: Precious in the LORD’s sight is the death of his saints.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani dhugumaan tajaajilaa kee ti; ani tajaajilaa kee ilma tajaajiltuu keetii ti; ati foncaa koo narraa hiikteerta.
english: LORD, truly I am your servant. I am your servant, the son of your servant girl. You have freed me from my chains.

kikuyu: Ani aarsaa galataa siif nan dhiʼeessa; maqaa Waaqayyoos nan waammadha.
english: I will offer to you the sacrifice of thanksgiving, and will call on the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Iddoo sabni isaa hundi jirutti, ani wareega koo Waaqayyoof nan galcha;
english: I will pay my vows to the LORD, yes, in the presence of all his people,

kikuyu: yaa Yerusaalem si keessatti, oobdii mana Waaqayyoo irrattis nan galcha. Haalleluuyaa.
english: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in the middle of you, Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Saboonni hundi Waaqayyoon jajadhaa; isin namoonni hundinuu isa leellisaa.
english: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol him, all you peoples!

kikuyu: Jaalalli inni nuuf qabu guddaadhaatii; amanamummaan Waaqayyoo bara baraan jiraata. Haalleluuyaa.
english: For his loving kindness is great toward us. The LORD’s faithfulness endures forever. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Waaqayyoof galata galchaa; inni gaariidhaatii; jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Sabni Israaʼel, “Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata” haa jedhu.
english: Let Israel now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Manni Aroonis, “Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata” haa jedhu.
english: Let the house of Aaron now say that his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Warri Waaqayyoon sodaatan, “Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata” haa jedhan.
english: Now let those who fear the LORD say that his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Dhiphina koo keessatti ani Waaqayyotti nan iyyadhe; innis deebii naa kenne; iddoo balʼaas na qubachiise.
english: Out of my distress, I called on the LORD. The LORD answered me with freedom.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo na wajjin jira; ani hin sodaadhu; namni maal na gochuu dandaʼa?
english: The LORD is on my side. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?

kikuyu: Waaqayyo na wajjin jira; inni gargaaraa koo ti. Anis diinota koo nan moʼadha.
english: The LORD is on my side among those who help me. Therefore I will look in triumph at those who hate me.

kikuyu: Nama amanachuu irra, Waaqayyotti kooluu galuu wayya.
english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in man.

kikuyu: Qondaaltota amanachuu irra, Waaqayyotti kooluu galuu wayya.
english: It is better to take refuge in the LORD, than to put confidence in princes.

kikuyu: Saboonni hundinuu na marsan; ani garuu maqaa Waaqayyootiin isaan nan barbadeesse.
english: All the nations surrounded me, but in the LORD’s name I cut them off.

kikuyu: Isaan karaa hundaan na marsan; ani garuu maqaa Waaqayyootiin isaan nan barbadeesse.
english: They surrounded me, yes, they surrounded me. In the LORD’s name I indeed cut them off.

kikuyu: Akkuma tuuta kanniisaa na marsan; garuu akka qoraattii gubatuutti barbadaaʼan; anis maqaa Waaqayyootiin isaan nan barbadeesse.
english: They surrounded me like bees. They are quenched like the burning thorns. In the LORD’s name I cut them off.

kikuyu: Ani dhiibamee kufuu gaʼeen ture; Waaqayyo garuu na gargaare.
english: You pushed me back hard, to make me fall, but the LORD helped me.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo jabina kootii fi faarfannaa koo ti; inni fayyina koo taʼeera.
english: The LORD is my strength and song. He has become my salvation.

kikuyu: Sagaleen gammachuutii fi moʼannaa dunkaanota qajeeltotaa keessaa ni dhagaʼama; “Harki Waaqayyoo kan mirgaa waan jabaa hojjeteera!
english: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tents of the righteous. “The right hand of the LORD does valiantly.

kikuyu: Harki Waaqayyo mirgaa ol qabameera; harki Waaqayyoo mirgaa waan jabaa hojjeteera!”
english: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD does valiantly!”

kikuyu: Ani nan jiraadha malee hin duʼu; waan Waaqayyo hojjetes nan labsa.
english: I will not die, but live, and declare the LORD’s works.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo jabeessee na adabeera; garuu dabarsee duʼatti na hin kennine.
english: The LORD has punished me severely, but he has not given me over to death.

kikuyu: Karra qajeelummaa naa banaa; anis ol galee Waaqayyoof galata nan galcha.
english: Open to me the gates of righteousness. I will enter into them. I will give thanks to the LORD.

kikuyu: Kun karra Waaqayyoo, kan qajeeltonni ittiin ol galanii dha.
english: This is the gate of the LORD; the righteous will enter into it.

kikuyu: Ati deebii naa kenniteertaatii, ani sin galateeffadha; ati fayyina naa taateerta.
english: I will give thanks to you, for you have answered me, and have become my salvation.

kikuyu: Dhagaan ijaartonni tuffatan, dhagaa golee taʼeera;
english: The stone which the builders rejected has become the cornerstone.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo waan kana hojjeteera; kunis ija keenyatti dinqii dha.
english: This is the LORD’s doing. It is marvelous in our eyes.

kikuyu: Guyyaan kun guyyaa Waaqayyo uumee dha; kottaa ni ililchina; itti gammannas.
english: This is the day that the LORD has made. We will rejoice and be glad in it!

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, si kadhannaa nu oolchi; Yaa Waaqayyo, si kadhannaa nu milkoomsi.
english: Save us now, we beg you, LORD! LORD, we beg you, send prosperity now.

kikuyu: Kan maqaa Waaqayyootiin dhufu eebbifamaa dha. Nu mana Waaqayyoo keessaa isin eebbifna.
english: Blessed is he who comes in the LORD’s name! We have blessed you out of the LORD’s house.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waaqa; ifa isaas nuu irratti ibseera. Dameewwan harkatti qabadhaatii warra ayyaaneffachuu dhaqanitti makamaa; gara gaanfawwan iddoo aarsaas dhaqaa.
english: The LORD is God, and he has given us light. Bind the sacrifice with cords, even to the horns of the altar.

kikuyu: Ati Waaqa koo ti; ani sin galateeffadha; ati Waaqa koo ti; anis sin leellisa.
english: You are my God, and I will give thanks to you. You are my God, I will exalt you.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoof galata galchaa; inni gaariidhaatii; jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: Oh give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Warri jireenyi isaanii mudaa hin qabne, kanneen akka seera Waaqayyootti jiraattan eebbifamoo dha.
english: ALEPH Blessed are those whose ways are blameless, who walk according to the LORD’s law.

kikuyu: Warri ajajawwan isaa eegan, kanneen garaa guutuun isa barbaadan eebbifamoo dha.
english: Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.

kikuyu: Isaan balleessaa hin hojjetan; karaa isaa irras ni deemu.
english: Yes, they do nothing wrong. They walk in his ways.

kikuyu: Akka Seerri kee amanamummaadhaan eegamuuf ati ajajjeerta.
english: You have commanded your precepts, that we should fully obey them.

kikuyu: Akka ani ajaja kee eeguuf utuu karaan koo naa qajeelee jiraatee!
english: Oh that my ways were steadfast to obey your statutes!

kikuyu: Ani utuun ajajawwan kee hunda xiyyeeffadhee ilaalee silaa hin qaanaʼun ture.
english: Then I wouldn’t be disappointed, when I consider all of your commandments.

kikuyu: Ani yommuun seera kee qajeelaa sana baradhutti, garaa tolaadhaan sin galateeffadha.
english: I will give thanks to you with uprightness of heart, when I learn your righteous judgments.

kikuyu: Ani sirna keetiif nan bula; ati gonkumaa na hin dhiisin.
english: I will observe your statutes. Don’t utterly forsake me. BETH

kikuyu: Dargaggeessi akkamitti jireenya qulqulluu jiraachuu dandaʼa? Akka dubbii keetiitti jiraachuudhaan.
english: How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.

kikuyu: Ani garaa koo guutuudhaan sin barbaada; akka ani ajajawwan kee irraa jalʼadhu na hin godhin.
english: With my whole heart I have sought you. Don’t let me wander from your commandments.

kikuyu: Ani akkan cubbuu sitti hin hojjenneef, dubbii kee garaa koo keessa dhokfadheera.
english: I have hidden your word in my heart, that I might not sin against you.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, galanni siif haa taʼu; sirna kee na barsiisi.
english: Blessed are you, LORD. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Ani seera afaan keetii baʼu hundumaa, afaan kootiin nan dubbadha.
english: With my lips, I have declared all the ordinances of your mouth.

kikuyu: Akkuma namni tokko badhaadhummaa guddaatti gammadu, ani ajaja kee faana buʼuutti nan gammada.
english: I have rejoiced in the way of your testimonies, as much as in all riches.

kikuyu: Ajajawwan kee irra deddeebiʼee nan yaada; karaa kee irraas ija koo hin buqqifadhu.
english: I will meditate on your precepts, and consider your ways.

kikuyu: Ani sirna keetti nan gammada; dubbii kees hin dagadhu.
english: I will delight myself in your statutes. I will not forget your word. GIMEL

kikuyu: Akka ani jiraadhuu fi dubbii kee eeguuf, garbicha keetiif waan gaarii godhi.
english: Do good to your servant. I will live and I will obey your word.

kikuyu: Akka ani seera kee keessatti waan dinqisiisaa arguuf, ija koo naa bani.
english: Open my eyes, that I may see wondrous things out of your law.

kikuyu: Ani lafa irratti keessummaa dha; ajajawwan kee na duraa hin dhoksin.
english: I am a stranger on the earth. Don’t hide your commandments from me.

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo yeroo hunda seera kee hawwuudhaan, laafaa jirti.
english: My soul is consumed with longing for your ordinances at all times.

kikuyu: Ati of tuultota warra abaaramoo, kanneen ajajawwan kee irraa jalʼatan ni ifatta.
english: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.

kikuyu: Waan ani seera kee eeguuf, arrabsoo fi tuffii isaanii narraa fageessi.
english: Take reproach and contempt away from me, for I have kept your statutes.

kikuyu: Bulchitoonni walii wajjin taaʼanii yoo maqaa na balleessan iyyuu, tajaajilaan kee irra deddeebiʼee labsii kee ni yaada.
english: Though princes sit and slander me, your servant will meditate on your statutes.

kikuyu: Ajajni kee gammachuu koo ti; gorsituu kootis.
english: Indeed your statutes are my delight, and my counselors. DALETH

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo biyyootti maxxante; ati akkuma dubbii keetiitti na oolchi.
english: My soul is laid low in the dust. Revive me according to your word!

kikuyu: Yeroo ani waaʼee karaa koo sitti himetti, ati deebii naa kennite; sirna kees na barsiisi.
english: I declared my ways, and you answered me. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Barsiisa seera keetii na hubachiisi; anis irra deddeebiʼee dinqii kee nan yaada.
english: Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo gaddaan laafteerti; ati akkuma dubbii keetiitti na jabeessi.
english: My soul is weary with sorrow; strengthen me according to your word.

kikuyu: Karaa sobaa irraa na fageessi; arjumaadhaanis seera kee na barsiisi.
english: Keep me from the way of deceit. Grant me your law graciously!

kikuyu: Ani karaa dhugaa filadheera; seera kees of dura kaaʼadheera.
english: I have chosen the way of truth. I have set your ordinances before me.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani ajaja kee jabeessee qabadheera; ati na hin qaanessin.
english: I cling to your statutes, LORD. Don’t let me be disappointed.

kikuyu: Sababii ati hubannaa koo naa balʼifteef ani daandii ajajawwan keetii irra nan fiiga.
english: I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free. HE

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, akka ani sirna kee duukaa buʼu na barsiisi; anis hamma dhumaatti isa nan eega.
english: Teach me, LORD, the way of your statutes. I will keep them to the end.

kikuyu: Akka ani seera kee eegee garaa koo guutuun isaaf ajajamuuf hubannaa naa kenni.
english: Give me understanding, and I will keep your law. Yes, I will obey it with my whole heart.

kikuyu: Daandii ajajawwan keetii irra na deemsisi; anis achitti gammachuu nan argadhaatii.
english: Direct me in the path of your commandments, for I delight in them.

kikuyu: Garaa koo gara ofittummaadhaan faayidaa argachuutti utuu hin taʼin, gara sirna keetiitti naa deebisi.
english: Turn my heart toward your statutes, not toward selfish gain.

kikuyu: Ija koo waan faayidaa hin qabne irraa deebisi; akkuma dubbii keetiittis na jiraachisi.
english: Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.

kikuyu: Ati akka sodaatamtuuf, waadaa kee garbicha keetiif guuti.
english: Fulfill your promise to your servant, that you may be feared.

kikuyu: Salphina ani sodaadhu narraa fageessi; seerri kee gaariidhaatii.
english: Take away my disgrace that I dread, for your ordinances are good.

kikuyu: Kunoo, ani sirna kee nan hawwa; qajeelummaa keetiin na jiraachisi.
english: Behold, I long for your precepts! Revive me in your righteousness. VAV

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, jaalalli kee kan hin geeddaramne sun, fayyisuun kees akkuma dubbii keetiitti gara koo haa dhufu;
english: Let your loving kindness also come to me, LORD, your salvation, according to your word.

kikuyu: yoos ani sababii dubbii kee amanadhuuf, warra na arrabsaniif deebii kenna.
english: So I will have an answer for him who reproaches me, for I trust in your word.

kikuyu: Waan ani seera kee abdadheef, ati dubbii dhugaa afaan koo keessaa hin balleessin.
english: Don’t snatch the word of truth out of my mouth, for I put my hope in your ordinances.

kikuyu: Bara baraa hamma bara baraatti, ani yeroo hunda seera kee nan eega.
english: So I will obey your law continually, forever and ever.

kikuyu: Ani ajaja kee waanan barbaaduuf, bilisummaadhaan nan deddeebiʼa.
english: I will walk in liberty, for I have sought your precepts.

kikuyu: Ani waaʼee ajaja keetii mootota duratti nan dubbadha; hin qaaneffamus;
english: I will also speak of your statutes before kings, and will not be disappointed.

kikuyu: waan ani ajajawwan kee jaalladhuuf, isaanitti nan gammada.
english: I will delight myself in your commandments, because I love them.

kikuyu: Ani gara ajajawwan kee kanneen ani jaalladhu sanaatti harka koo ol nan fudhadha; labsii kees irra deddeebiʼee nan yaada.
english: I reach out my hands for your commandments, which I love. I will meditate on your statutes. ZAYIN

kikuyu: Waadaa tajaajilaa keetiif seente sana yaadadhu; ati isumaan abdii naa kenniteertaatii.
english: Remember your word to your servant, because you gave me hope.

kikuyu: Rakkina koo keessatti jajjabinni koo kana: Waadaan kee na jiraachisa.
english: This is my comfort in my affliction, for your word has revived me.

kikuyu: Of tuultonni akkuma barbaadanitti natti qoosu; ani garuu seera kee irraa hin jalʼadhu.
english: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani seera kee durii sana nan yaadadha; isa keessattis jajjabina nan argadha.
english: I remember your ordinances of old, LORD, and have comforted myself.

kikuyu: Sababii hamoota warra seera kee dhiisaniitiif, aariin na gugguba.
english: Indignation has taken hold on me, because of the wicked who forsake your law.

kikuyu: Iddoo keessummummaa koo hundatti seerri kee faarfannaa koo ti.
english: Your statutes have been my songs in the house where I live.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani halkan keessa maqaa kee nan yaadadha; seera kees nan eega.
english: I have remembered your name, LORD, in the night, and I obey your law.

kikuyu: Waan ani ajaja kee eegeef, kun naaf taʼeera.
english: This is my way, that I keep your precepts. HETH

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati qooda koo ti; anis dubbii keetiif ajajamuuf waadaa galeera.
english: The LORD is my portion. I promised to obey your words.

kikuyu: Ani garaa koo guutuun fuula kee barbaaddadheera; ati akkuma waadaa keetiitti naa araarami.
english: I sought your favor with my whole heart. Be merciful to me according to your word.

kikuyu: Ani karaa koo itti deddeebiʼee yaadeera; tarkaanfii koo gara sirna keetiitti deebiseera.
english: I considered my ways, and turned my steps to your statutes.

kikuyu: Ani ajajawwan kee eeguuf, nan ariifadha; hin barfadhus.
english: I will hurry, and not delay, to obey your commandments.

kikuyu: Hamoonni yoo funyoodhaan na hidhan iyyuu, ani seera kee hin irraanfadhu.
english: The ropes of the wicked bind me, but I won’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Sababii seera kee qajeelaa sanaatiif, ani si galateeffachuuf jedhee halkan walakkaa nan kaʼa.
english: At midnight I will rise to give thanks to you, because of your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: Ani warra si sodaatan hundaaf, warra ajaja kee eegan hundaafis michuu dha.
english: I am a friend of all those who fear you, of those who observe your precepts.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, lafti jaalala keetiin guutamteerti; sirna kee na barsiisi.
english: The earth is full of your loving kindness, LORD. Teach me your statutes. TETH

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati akkuma dubbii keetiitti, tajaajilaa keetiif waan gaarii gooteerta.
english: You have treated your servant well, according to your word, LORD.

kikuyu: Murtii gaarii fi beekumsa na barsiisi; ani ajajawwan keetti nan amanaatii.
english: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in your commandments.

kikuyu: Ani utuun hin rakkatin karaa irraa badee ture; amma garuu dubbii kee nan eega.
english: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I observe your word.

kikuyu: Ati gaarii dha; wanni ati hojjettus gaarii dha; sirna kee na barsiisi.
english: You are good, and do good. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Of tuultonni yoo sobaan maqaa na balleessan iyyuu, ani garaa koo guutuudhaan seera kee nan eega.
english: The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.

kikuyu: Onneen isaanii mooraan haguugamteerti; ani garuu seera keetti nan gammada.
english: Their heart is as callous as the fat, but I delight in your law.

kikuyu: Akka ani sirna kee baradhuuf, rakkachuun koo anaaf gaarii ture.
english: It is good for me that I have been afflicted, that I may learn your statutes.

kikuyu: Meetii fi warqee kumaatama irra, seeri afaan keetii baʼu anaaf gaariidha.
english: The law of your mouth is better to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver. YODH

kikuyu: Harki kee na uume; na tolches; akka ani ajaja kee baradhuuf ati hubannaa naa kenni.
english: Your hands have made me and formed me. Give me understanding, that I may learn your commandments.

kikuyu: Sababii ani dubbii kee abdadheef, warri si sodaatan yommuu na arganitti haa gammadan.
english: Those who fear you will see me and be glad, because I have put my hope in your word.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani akka murtiin kee qajeelaa taʼe, akka atis amanamummaadhaan na dhiphiste beeka.
english: LORD, I know that your judgments are righteous, that in faithfulness you have afflicted me.

kikuyu: Akkuma ati tajaajilaa keetiif waadaa galte sanatti, jaalalli kee kan hin geeddaramne sun na haa jajjabeessu.
english: Please let your loving kindness be for my comfort, according to your word to your servant.

kikuyu: Akka ani lubbuun jiraadhuuf gara laafinni kee gara koo haa dhufu; seerri kee gammachuu kootii.
english: Let your tender mercies come to me, that I may live; for your law is my delight.

kikuyu: Of tuultonni waan sababii malee na yakkaniif haa qaanaʼan; ani garuu irra deddeebiʼee seera kee nan yaada.
english: Let the proud be disappointed, for they have overthrown me wrongfully. I will meditate on your precepts.

kikuyu: Warri si sodaatan, kanneen seera kee hubatan gara kootti haa deebiʼan.
english: Let those who fear you turn to me. They will know your statutes.

kikuyu: Akka ani hin qaanofneef garaan koo seera kee duratti hanqina hin qabaatin.
english: Let my heart be blameless toward your decrees, that I may not be disappointed. KAPF

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo fayyisuu kee hawwuudhaan gaggabdi; ani garuu dubbii kee nan abdadha.
english: My soul faints for your salvation. I hope in your word.

kikuyu: Iji koo waadaa kee eeggachuudhaan dadhabe; anis, “Ati yoom na jajjabeessita?” nan jedha.
english: My eyes fail for your word. I say, “When will you comfort me?”

kikuyu: Qalqalloo wayinii kan aara keessa ture fakkaadhus ani ajaja kee hin irraanfadhu.
english: For I have become like a wineskin in the smoke. I don’t forget your statutes.

kikuyu: Tajaajilaan kee hamma yoomiitti obsuu qaba? Ati warra na ariʼatanitti yoom murta?
english: How many are the days of your servant? When will you execute judgment on those who persecute me?

kikuyu: Of tuultonni warri akka seera keetiitti hin bulle, boolla naa qotaniiru.
english: The proud have dug pits for me, contrary to your law.

kikuyu: Ajajawwan kee hundinuu amanamoo dha; namoonni sababii malee waan na ariʼataniif ati na gargaari.
english: All of your commandments are faithful. They persecute me wrongfully. Help me!

kikuyu: Isaan lafa irraa na balleessuu gaʼanii turan; ani garuu sirna kee hin dhiifne.
english: They had almost wiped me from the earth, but I didn’t forsake your precepts.

kikuyu: Ati akkuma jaalala keetiitti lubbuu koo baraari; anis seera afaan keetii baʼu nan eega.
english: Preserve my life according to your loving kindness, so I will obey the statutes of your mouth. LAMEDH

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, dubbiin kee bara baraan jiraata; samii keessas jabaatee ni dhaabata.
english: LORD, your word is settled in heaven forever.

kikuyu: Amanamummaan kee dhaloota hundaaf itti fufa; ati lafa hundeessite; isheenis ni jiraatti.
english: Your faithfulness is to all generations. You have established the earth, and it remains.

kikuyu: Sababii wanni hundinuu si tajaajiluuf, seerri kee hamma harʼaatti jiraateera.
english: Your laws remain to this day, for all things serve you.

kikuyu: Utuu seerri kee gammachuu naa taʼuu baatee, ani silaa rakkina kootiin badeen ture.
english: Unless your law had been my delight, I would have perished in my affliction.

kikuyu: Sababii ati isaan na jiraachifteef, ani gonkumaa ajaja kee hin irraanfadhu.
english: I will never forget your precepts, for with them, you have revived me.

kikuyu: Sababii ani kan kee taʼeef na fayyisi; anis sirna kee barbaadeera.
english: I am yours. Save me, for I have sought your precepts.

kikuyu: Hamoonni na balleessuuf na eeggachaa jiru; ani garuu irra deddeebiʼee seera kee nan yaada.
english: The wicked have waited for me, to destroy me. I will consider your statutes.

kikuyu: Ani akka wanni mudaa hin qabnee hundinuu daangaa qabu argeera; ajajni kee garuu baayʼee balʼaa dha.
english: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but your commands are boundless. MEM

kikuyu: Ani seera kee akkaman jaalladha! Guyyaa guutuu irra deddeebiʼee waaʼee isaa nan yaada.
english: How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.

kikuyu: Ajajawwan kee waan yeroo hunda na wajjin jiraniif, diinota koo caalaa ogeessa na godhan.
english: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for your commandments are always with me.

kikuyu: Ani sababiin irra deddeebiʼee seera kee yaaduuf, barsiisota koo hundumaa caalaa hubannaa qaba.
english: I have more understanding than all my teachers, for your testimonies are my meditation.

kikuyu: Ani sababiin ajaja kee eeguuf, maanguddoota caalaa hubannaa guddaan qaba.
english: I understand more than the aged, because I have kept your precepts.

kikuyu: Ani akkan dubbii kee eeguuf, karaa hamaa hunda irraa miilla koo adabadheera.
english: I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.

kikuyu: Waan ati mataan kee na barsiifteef, ani seera kee irraa hin fagaanne.
english: I have not turned away from your ordinances, for you have taught me.

kikuyu: Dubbiin kee akkam arraba kootti miʼaawa; nadhii dammaa caalaa afaan kootti miʼaawa!
english: How sweet are your promises to my taste, more than honey to my mouth!

kikuyu: Ani qajeelfama kee irraa hubannaa argadheera; kanaafuu daandii sobaa hunda nan jibba.
english: Through your precepts, I get understanding; therefore I hate every false way. NUN

kikuyu: Dubbiin kee miilla kootiif ibsaa dha; daandii kootiif immoo ifa.
english: Your word is a lamp to my feet, and a light for my path.

kikuyu: Ani akkan seera kee qajeelaa sana eeguuf, kakadheera; kanas mirkaneesseera.
english: I have sworn, and have confirmed it, that I will obey your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: Ani akka malee dhiphadheen jira; yaa Waaqayyo, ati akkuma dubbii keetiitti lubbuu koo baraari.
english: I am afflicted very much. Revive me, LORD, according to your word.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, galata fedhiidhaan afaan kootii baʼu fudhadhu; seera kees na barsiisi.
english: Accept, I beg you, the willing offerings of my mouth. LORD, teach me your ordinances.

kikuyu: Jireenyi koo yeroo hunda harka koo keessa jiraatu iyyuu, ani seera kee hin irraanfadhu.
english: My soul is continually in my hand, yet I won’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Hamoonni kiyyoo naa kaaʼaniiru; ani garuu ajaja kee irraa hin jalʼanne.
english: The wicked have laid a snare for me, yet I haven’t gone astray from your precepts.

kikuyu: Seerri kee dhaala koo kan bara baraa ti; gammachuu garaa kootiitis.
english: I have taken your testimonies as a heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.

kikuyu: Garaan koo hamma dhumaatti ajaja kee eeguuf kutateera.
english: I have set my heart to perform your statutes forever, even to the end. SAMEKH

kikuyu: Ani nama yaada lamaa nan jibba; seera kee garuu nan jaalladha.
english: I hate double-minded men, but I love your law.

kikuyu: Ati iddoo ani itti baqadhuu fi gaachana koo ti; ani dubbii kee abdadheera.
english: You are my hiding place and my shield. I hope in your word.

kikuyu: Akka ani ajajawwan Waaqa koo eeguuf, isin warri waan hamaa hojjettan narraa fagaadhaa!
english: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may keep the commandments of my God.

kikuyu: Ati akkuma waadaa keetiitti na deeggari; anis nan jiraadha; akka ani abdii kootti qaanaʼu na hin godhin.
english: Uphold me according to your word, that I may live. Let me not be ashamed of my hope.

kikuyu: Akka ani nagaadhaan jiraadhuuf na deeggari; yeroo hunda seera kee nan kabaja.
english: Hold me up, and I will be safe, and will have respect for your statutes continually.

kikuyu: Sababii gowwoomsaan isaanii faayidaa hin qabneef; ati warra seera kee irraa jalʼatan hunda tuffattee gatta.
english: You reject all those who stray from your statutes, for their deceit is in vain.

kikuyu: Ati hamoota lafa irraa hunda akka kosiitti gatta; kanaafuu ani seera kee nan jaalladha.
english: You put away all the wicked of the earth like dross. Therefore I love your testimonies.

kikuyu: Foon koo si sodaachuudhaan hollata; anis murtii kee nan sodaadha.
english: My flesh trembles for fear of you. I am afraid of your judgments. AYIN

kikuyu: Ani waan qajeelaa fi tolaa hojjedheera; ati warra na hacuucanitti dabarsitee na hin kennin.
english: I have done what is just and righteous. Don’t leave me to my oppressors.

kikuyu: Nagaan jiraachuu tajaajilaa keetii mirkaneessi; akka of tuultonni na cunqursanis hin eeyyamin.
english: Ensure your servant’s well-being. Don’t let the proud oppress me.

kikuyu: Iji koo fayyisuu kee eeguudhaan, waadaa kee qajeelaas eeguudhaanis dadhabeera.
english: My eyes fail looking for your salvation, for your righteous word.

kikuyu: Akkuma jaalala keetiitti tajaajilaa kee yaadadhu; seera kees na barsiisi.
english: Deal with your servant according to your loving kindness. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Ani tajaajilaa kee ti; akka ani ajaja kee beekuuf hubannaa naa kenni.
english: I am your servant. Give me understanding, that I may know your testimonies.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, kun yeroo ati itti hojjettuu dha; seerri kee cabsamaa jiraatii.
english: It is time to act, LORD, for they break your law.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani warqee caalaa, warqee qulqulluu caalaa, ajajawwan kee nan jaalladha;
english: Therefore I love your commandments more than gold, yes, more than pure gold.

kikuyu: ani akka seerri kee hundi qajeelaa taʼe nan amana; daandii sobaa hundas nan jibba.
english: Therefore I consider all of your precepts to be right. I hate every false way. PE

kikuyu: Sirni kee dinqisiisaa dha; kanaafuu ani isa nan eega.
english: Your testimonies are wonderful, therefore my soul keeps them.

kikuyu: Ibsamuun dubbii keetii ifa kenna; wallaalotaafis hubannaa kenna.
english: The entrance of your words gives light. It gives understanding to the simple.

kikuyu: Ani ajajawwan kee hawwuudhaan afaan koo banee nan hargana.
english: I opened my mouth wide and panted, for I longed for your commandments.

kikuyu: Ati akkuma yeroo hunda warra maqaa kee jaalataniif gootu sana, gara kootti garagalii na maari.
english: Turn to me, and have mercy on me, as you always do to those who love your name.

kikuyu: Akkuma dubbii keetiitti tarkaanfii miilla kootii naa qajeelchi; cubbuun tokko iyyuu narratti hin moʼin.
english: Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.

kikuyu: Akka ani ajaja kee eeguuf hacuuccaa namootaa jalaa na furi.
english: Redeem me from the oppression of man, so I will observe your precepts.

kikuyu: Akka fuulli kee tajaajilaa kee irratti ifu godhi; sirna kees na barsiisi.
english: Make your face shine on your servant. Teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Sababii namoonni seerra kee hin eegneef, iji koo imimmaan lolaasa.
english: Streams of tears run down my eyes, because they don’t observe your law. TZADHE

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati qajeelaa dha; murtiin kees qajeelaa dha.
english: You are righteous, LORD. Your judgments are upright.

kikuyu: Seerri ati kennite qajeelaa dha; guutummaattis amanamaa dha.
english: You have commanded your statutes in righteousness. They are fully trustworthy.

kikuyu: Sababii diinonni koo dubbii kee dagataniif, hinaaffaan ani qabu na guggubeera.
english: My zeal wears me out, because my enemies ignore your words.

kikuyu: Waadaan kee sirriitti qoramee ilaalameera; tajaajilaan kees isa jaallata.
english: Your promises have been thoroughly tested, and your servant loves them.

kikuyu: Xinnaadhee tuffatamu iyyuu, ani ajaja kee hin irraanfadhu.
english: I am small and despised. I don’t forget your precepts.

kikuyu: Qajeelummaan kee bara baraan jiraata; seerri kees dhugaa dha.
english: Your righteousness is an everlasting righteousness. Your law is truth.

kikuyu: Rakkinnii fi dhiphinni natti dhufeera; ajajawwan kee garuu gammachuu koo ti.
english: Trouble and anguish have taken hold of me. Your commandments are my delight.

kikuyu: Seerri kee bara baraan qajeelaa dha; akka ani jiraadhuuf hubannaa naa kenni.
english: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live. QOPH

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani garaa koo guutuudhaan sin waammadha; deebii naa kenni; anis sirna keetiif nan ajajama.
english: I have called with my whole heart. Answer me, LORD! I will keep your statutes.

kikuyu: Ani sittin iyyadha; ati na fayyisi; seera kees nan eega.
english: I have called to you. Save me! I will obey your statutes.

kikuyu: Ani utuu lafti hin bariʼin kaʼee gargaarsaaf nan iyyadha; ani dubbii kee abdadheera.
english: I rise before dawn and cry for help. I put my hope in your words.

kikuyu: Akka ani irra deddeebiʼee waadaa kee yaaduuf, iji koo halkan guutuu banamee bula.
english: My eyes stay open through the night watches, that I might meditate on your word.

kikuyu: Akkuma jaalala keetiitti sagalee koo dhagaʼi; Yaa Waaqayyo, akkuma seera keetiitti lubbuu koo baraari.
english: Hear my voice according to your loving kindness. Revive me, LORD, according to your ordinances.

kikuyu: Warri daba mariʼatan as dhiʼoo jiru; seera kee irraa garuu fagoo jiru.
english: They draw near who follow after wickedness. They are far from your law.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ati garuu dhiʼoo jirta; ajajawwan kee hundis dhugaa dha.
english: You are near, LORD. All your commandments are truth.

kikuyu: Akka ati ajajawwan kee bara baraan hundeessite, ani seera kee irraa dur baradheera.
english: Of old I have known from your testimonies, that you have founded them forever. RESH

kikuyu: Dhiphina koo argiitii na oolchi; ani seera kee hin daganneetii.
english: Consider my affliction, and deliver me, for I don’t forget your law.

kikuyu: Dubbii koo naa falmi; na furis; akkuma waadaa keetiitti lubbuu koo baraari.
english: Plead my cause, and redeem me! Revive me according to your promise.

kikuyu: Sababii isaan sirna kee hin barbaanneef, fayyinni hamoota irraa fagaateera.
english: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, gara laafinni kee guddaa dha; akkuma seera keetiitti lubbuu koo baraari.
english: Great are your tender mercies, LORD. Revive me according to your ordinances.

kikuyu: Diinonni koo warri na ariʼatan baayʼee dha; ani garuu seera kee irraa hin jalʼanne.
english: Many are my persecutors and my adversaries. I haven’t swerved from your testimonies.

kikuyu: Sababii isaan dubbii keetiif hin ajajamneef, ani warra amantii hin qabne ija jibbaatiin nan ilaala.
english: I look at the faithless with loathing, because they don’t observe your word.

kikuyu: Akkam akka ani qajeelfama kee jaalladhu mee ilaali; Yaa Waaqayyo, akkuma jaalala keetiitti lubbuu koo baraari.
english: Consider how I love your precepts. Revive me, LORD, according to your loving kindness.

kikuyu: Dubbiin kee hundinuu dhugaa dha; seerri kee qajeelaan hundinuus bara baraan jiraata.
english: All of your words are truth. Every one of your righteous ordinances endures forever. SIN AND SHIN

kikuyu: Bulchitoonni sababii malee na ariʼatan; garaan koo garuu dubbii kee sodaachuudhaan hollata.
english: Princes have persecuted me without a cause, but my heart stands in awe of your words.

kikuyu: Ani akka nama boojuu guddaa argate tokkootti, dubbii keetti nan gammada.
english: I rejoice at your word, as one who finds great plunder.

kikuyu: Ani soba nan jibba; nan xireeffadhas; seera kee garuu nan jaalladha.
english: I hate and abhor falsehood. I love your law.

kikuyu: Sababii seera kee qajeelaa sanaatiif, ani guyyaatti yeroo torba sin galateeffadha.
english: Seven times a day, I praise you, because of your righteous ordinances.

kikuyu: Warri seera kee jaallatan nagaa guddaa qabu; wanni isaan gufachiisu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: Those who love your law have great peace. Nothing causes them to stumble.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani fayyisuu kee nan abdadha; ajaja kee duukaas nan buʼa.
english: I have hoped for your salvation, LORD. I have done your commandments.

kikuyu: Ani waanan guddaa isa jaalladhuuf, ajaja kee nan eega.
english: My soul has observed your testimonies. I love them exceedingly.

kikuyu: Ati karaa koo hunda waan beektuuf, ani sirna keetii fi seera kee nan eega.
english: I have obeyed your precepts and your testimonies, for all my ways are before you. TAV

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, iyyi koo fuula kee dura haa gaʼu; ati akkuma dubbii keetiitti hubannaa naa kenni.
english: Let my cry come before you, LORD. Give me understanding according to your word.

kikuyu: Waammanni koo fuula kee dura haa gaʼu; akkuma waadaa keetiitti na baasi.
english: Let my supplication come before you. Deliver me according to your word.

kikuyu: Sababii ati qajeelfama kee na barsiiftuuf, hidhiin koo galata haa dhangalaasu.
english: Let my lips utter praise, for you teach me your statutes.

kikuyu: Arrabni koo dubbii kee haa faarfatu; ajajni kee hundi qajeelaadhaatii.
english: Let my tongue sing of your word, for all your commandments are righteousness.

kikuyu: Waan ani sirna kee filadheef, harki kee na gargaaruuf haa qophaaʼu.
english: Let your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen your precepts.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani fayyisuu kee nan hawwa; seerri kees gammachuu koo ti.
english: I have longed for your salvation, LORD. Your law is my delight.

kikuyu: Lubbuun koo si galateeffachuuf haa jiraattu; seerri kees na haa gargaaru.
english: Let my soul live, that I may praise you. Let your ordinances help me.

kikuyu: Ani akkuma hoolaa badee karaa irraa jalʼadheera. Ani ajajawwan kee hin irraanfanneetii, tajaajilaa kee barbaadi.
english: I have gone astray like a lost sheep. Seek your servant, for I don’t forget your commandments.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Ol baʼuu. Ani rakkina koo keessatti Waaqayyotti nan iyyadha; innis deebii naa kenna.
english: A Song of Ascents. In my distress, I cried to the LORD. He answered me.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, afaan sobuu fi arraba nama gowwoomsu jalaa na baasi.
english: Deliver my soul, LORD, from lying lips, from a deceitful tongue.

kikuyu: Yaa arraba gowwoomsituu nana, maaltu siif kennama? Kana caalaas maal godhamta?
english: What will be given to you, and what will be done more to you, you deceitful tongue?

kikuyu: Inni xiyya loltootaa kan qarameen, barbadaa ibiddaa qacamaatiin si adaba.
english: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

kikuyu: Ani waanan Meshek keessa taaʼee dunkaanota Qeedaar gidduu jiraadhuuf, anaaf wayyoo!
english: Woe is me, that I live in Meshech, that I dwell among the tents of Kedar!

kikuyu: Warra nagaa jibban gidduu, ani yeroo dheeraa jiraadheera.
english: My soul has had her dwelling too long with him who hates peace.

kikuyu: Ani nama nagaa barbaadu dha; isaan garuu yeroo ani dubbadhu lolaaf kakaʼan.
english: I am for peace, but when I speak, they are for war.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Ol baʼuu. Ani ija koo gara tulluuwwaniitti ol nan qabadha; gargaarsi koo eessaa dhufa?
english: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up my eyes to the hills. Where does my help come from?

kikuyu: Gargaarsi koo Waaqayyo samii fi lafa uume biraa dhufa.
english: My help comes from the LORD, who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Inni akka miilli kee mucucaatu hin godhu; kan si eegu hin mugu;
english: He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.

kikuyu: dhugumaan inni Israaʼelin eegu hin mugu; hin rafus.
english: Behold, he who keeps Israel will neither slumber nor sleep.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo si eega; Waaqayyo karaa mirga keetiitiin gaaddisa siif taʼa;
english: The LORD is your keeper. The LORD is your shade on your right hand.

kikuyu: guyyaa aduun si hin gubu; halkanis jiʼi si hin miidhu.
english: The sun will not harm you by day, nor the moon by night.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo miidhaa hunda irraa si eega; inni lubbuu kee ni eega;
english: The LORD will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo ammaa jalqabee hamma bara baraatti, baʼuu fi galuu kee ni eega.
english: The LORD will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Ol baʼuu. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yommuu isaan, “Kottu gara mana Waaqayyoo dhaqnaa” naan jedhanitti, ani nan gammade.
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. I was glad when they said to me, “Let’s go to the LORD’s house!”

kikuyu: Yaa Yerusaalem, miilli keenya karrawwan kee irra dhaabata.
english: Our feet are standing within your gates, Jerusalem!

kikuyu: Yerusaalem akka magaalaa walitti maxxantee gobbatte tokkootti ijaaramte.
english: Jerusalem is built as a city that is compact together,

kikuyu: Kunis iddoo gosoonni, gosoonni Waaqayyo, akka sirna Israaʼeliif kenname sanaatti, maqaa Waaqayyoo galateeffachuuf itti ol baʼanii dha.
english: where the tribes go up, even the LORD’s tribes, according to an ordinance for Israel, to give thanks to the LORD’s name.

kikuyu: Teessoowwan murtii, teessoowwan mana Daawit achi dhaabatu.
english: For there are set thrones for judgment, the thrones of David’s house.

kikuyu: Akkana jedhaa nagaa Yerusaalemiif kadhadhaa: “Warri si jaallatan nagaan haa jiraatan.
english: Pray for the peace of Jerusalem. Those who love you will prosper.

kikuyu: Dallaa kee keessa nagaan, masaraa mootummaa keetii keessa immoo tasgabbiin haa jiraatu.”
english: Peace be within your walls, and prosperity within your palaces.

kikuyu: Ani obboloota kootii fi michoota kootiif jedhee, “Nagaan si keessa haa jiraatu” nan jedha.
english: For my brothers’ and companions’ sakes, I will now say, “Peace be within you.”

kikuyu: Mana Waaqayyo Waaqa keenyaatiif jedhee, ani akka wanni gaariin siif taʼu nan hawwa.
english: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your good.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa ol baʼuu. Yaa isa teessoon kee samii irra jiru, ani ija koo gara keetti ol nan qabadha.
english: A Song of Ascents. I lift up my eyes to you, you who sit in the heavens.

kikuyu: Akkuma iji garbootaa harka gooftaa isaanii, iji garbittii immoo harka giiftii ishee ilaalu sana, hamma inni araara nuu buusutti, iji keenyas gara Waaqayyo Waaqa keenyaa ni ilaala.
english: Behold, as the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maid to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes look to the LORD, our God, until he has mercy on us.

kikuyu: Nuu araarami; yaa Waaqayyo, nuu araarami; tuffatamuun nutti baayʼateeraatii.
english: Have mercy on us, LORD, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.

kikuyu: Arrabni warra of jajaniitii fi tuffiin warra of tuulanii nutti baayʼateera.
english: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa ol baʼuu. Faarfannaa Daawit. Israaʼel akkana haa jedhu: Utuu Waaqayyo garee keenya taʼuu baatee,
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. If it had not been the LORD who was on our side, let Israel now say,

kikuyu: utuu Waaqayyo garee keenya taʼuu baatee, yommuu namoonni nutti kaʼanitti,
english: if it had not been the LORD who was on our side, when men rose up against us,

kikuyu: yommuu aariin isaanii nutti bobaʼetti, silaa isaan utuu nu lubbuun jirruu nu liqimsu turan;
english: then they would have swallowed us up alive, when their wrath was kindled against us,

kikuyu: lolaan nu liqimsee dhaʼaan bishaanii nurra yaaʼa ture;
english: then the waters would have overwhelmed us, the stream would have gone over our soul.

kikuyu: bishaan hamaan nu fudhatee bada ture.
english: Then the proud waters would have gone over our soul.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akka nu ilkaan isaaniitiin cicciramnuuf dabarsee itti nu hin kennin sun haa eebbifamu.
english: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as a prey to their teeth.

kikuyu: Akkuma simbirri kiyyoo adamsituu jalaa baatu, nu isaan jalaa baaneerra; kiyyoon ni ciccite; nus jalaa baane.
english: Our soul has escaped like a bird out of the fowler’s snare. The snare is broken, and we have escaped.

kikuyu: Gargaarsi keenya maqaa Waaqayyoo, Uumaa samii fi lafa sanaa ti.
english: Our help is in the LORD’s name, who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa ol baʼuu. Warri Waaqayyoon amanatan akka Tulluu Xiyoon kan hin raafamne, kan bara baraan jiraatu sanaa ti.
english: A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are as Mount Zion, which can’t be moved, but remains forever.

kikuyu: Akkuma tulluuwwan Yerusaalemin marsan sana, Waaqayyo ammaa jalqabee hamma bara baraatti, saba isaa ni marsa.
english: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people from this time forward and forever more.

kikuyu: Akka qajeeltonni jalʼina hojjechuuf harka isaanii ol hin diriirfanneef, bokkuun hamootaa lafa qajeeltotaaf ixaadhaan qoodame irra hin jiraatu.
english: For the scepter of wickedness won’t remain over the allotment of the righteous, so that the righteous won’t use their hands to do evil.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, warra gaariif, warra garaa isaaniitiin toloota taʼaniifis waan gaarii godhi.
english: Do good, LORD, to those who are good, to those who are upright in their hearts.

kikuyu: Warra karaa micciiramaatti garagalan garuu, Waaqayyo akkuma warra hammina hojjetan balleessu jaras ni balleessa. Nagaan Israaʼeliif haa taʼu.
english: But as for those who turn away to their crooked ways, the LORD will lead them away with the workers of iniquity. Peace be on Israel.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa ol baʼuu. Yeroo Waaqayyo warra boojiʼamanii turan gara Xiyoonitti deebisetti, nu akka warra abjuu abjootanii taane.
english: A Song of Ascents. When the LORD brought back those who returned to Zion, we were like those who dream.

kikuyu: Afaan keenya kolfaan, arrabni keenya immoo faarfannaa gammachuutiin guutame. Kana irratti saboota gidduutti, “Waaqayyo waan guddaa isaaniif godheera” jedhame.
english: Then our mouth was filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing. Then they said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo waan guddaa nuuf godhe; nus ni gammanne.
english: The LORD has done great things for us, and we are glad.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, akkuma lagoota Negeeb, boojuu keenya nuu deebisi.
english: Restore our fortunes again, LORD, like the streams in the Negev.

kikuyu: Warri imimmaaniin facaasan, faarfannaa gammachuutiin ni haammatu.
english: Those who sow in tears will reap in joy.

kikuyu: Namni sanyii facaafamu baadhatee booʼaa gad baʼu, bissii isaa baadhatee faarfannaa gammachuu faarfachaa deebiʼa.
english: He who goes out weeping, carrying seed for sowing, will certainly come again with joy, carrying his sheaves.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Ol baʼuu. Faarfannaa Solomoon. Waaqayyo mana ijaaruu baannaan, warri ijaaran akkasumaan dadhabu. Waaqayyo magaalaa eeguu baannaan, warri eegan akkasumaan dhaabachaa bulu.
english: A Song of Ascents. By Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, they who build it labor in vain. Unless the LORD watches over the city, the watchman guards it in vain.

kikuyu: Isin buddeena dadhabbii guddaan argame nyaachuuf jettanii, barii barraaqaan kaʼuun keessan, turtanii rafuun keessan faayidaa hin qabu; inni warra jaallatuuf utuma isaan rafanii iyyuu waan isaan barbaachisu ni kennaaf.
english: It is vain for you to rise up early, to stay up late, eating the bread of toil, for he gives sleep to his loved ones.

kikuyu: Kunoo, ijoolleen kennaa Waaqayyoo ti; iji gadameessaas badhaasa isaa ti.
english: Behold, children are a heritage of the LORD. The fruit of the womb is his reward.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen dargaggummaa keessa dhalchan, akkuma xiyya harka goota tokkoo keessa jiruu ti.
english: As arrows in the hand of a mighty man, so are the children of youth.

kikuyu: Namni korojoon isaa xiyyaan guutame eebbifamaa dha. Inni yommuu karra duratti diinota isaatiin falmutti hin qaanaʼu.
english: Happy is the man who has his quiver full of them. They won’t be disappointed when they speak with their enemies in the gate.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Ol Baʼuu. Warri Waaqayyoon sodaatan, kanneen karaa isaa irra deeman eebbifamoo dha.
english: A Song of Ascents. Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.

kikuyu: Ati buʼaa dadhabbii keetii ni nyaatta; ni eebbifamta; jireenyis sitti tola.
english: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

kikuyu: Niitiin kee mana kee keessatti, akka muka wayinii kan ija naqatee ni taati; ijoolleen kees naannoo maaddii keetiitti, akka lataa muka ejersaa ni taʼu.
english: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

kikuyu: Namni Waaqayyoon sodaatu akkasitti eebbifama.
english: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.

kikuyu: Bara jireenya keetii guutuu, Waaqayyo Xiyoon irraa si haa eebbisu; atis badhaadhummaa Yerusaalem argi.
english: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

kikuyu: ijoollee ijoollee keetii ni argi; nagaan Israaʼeliif haa taʼu.
english: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa ol baʼuu. Israaʼel akkana haa jedhu; “Isaan dargaggummaa kootii jalqabanii akka malee na cunqursaniiru;
english: A Song of Ascents. Many times they have afflicted me from my youth up. Let Israel now say:

kikuyu: isaan dargaggummaa kootii jalqabanii akka malee na cunqursaniiru; garuu na hin moʼanne.
english: many times they have afflicted me from my youth up, yet they have not prevailed against me.

kikuyu: Warri qootiisa qotan dugda koo qotan; boʼoo isaaniis ni dheeressan.
english: The plowers plowed on my back. They made their furrows long.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo garuu qajeelaa dha; funyoo jalʼootaa gargar kukkuteera.”
english: The LORD is righteous. He has cut apart the cords of the wicked.

kikuyu: Warri Xiyoonin jibban hundinuu, qaaniidhaan duubatti haa deebiʼan.
english: Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.

kikuyu: Isaan akka marga bantii manaa irraa kan utuu hin guddatin goguu haa taʼan;
english: Let them be as the grass on the housetops, which withers before it grows up,

kikuyu: namichi haamu qabaa isaa guuttachuu, yookaan namichi walitti qabu bissii isaa guuttachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: with which the reaper doesn’t fill his hand, nor he who binds sheaves, his bosom.

kikuyu: Warri achiin darban, “Eebbi Waaqayyoo isiniif haa taʼu; maqaa Waaqayyootiin isin eebbifna” isaaniin hin jedhin.
english: Neither do those who go by say, “The blessing of the LORD be on you. We bless you in the LORD’s name.”

kikuyu: Faarfannaa ol baʼuu. Yaa Waaqayyo, ani boolla gad fagoo keessaa sitti nan iyyadha;
english: A Song of Ascents. Out of the depths I have cried to you, LORD.

kikuyu: yaa Gooftaa, sagalee koo dhagaʼi. Gurri kees sagalee waammata koo xiyyeeffatee haa dhagaʼu.
english: Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, utuu ati cubbuu lakkooftee, yaa gooftaa silaa eenyutu dhaabachuu dandaʼa?
english: If you, LORD, kept a record of sins, Lord, who could stand?

kikuyu: Garuu dhiifamni si bira jira; kanaaf ati ni sodaatamta.
english: But there is forgiveness with you, therefore you are feared.

kikuyu: Ani Waaqayyoon nan eeggadha; lubbuun koos isa eeggatti; dubbii isaas nan abdadha.
english: I wait for the LORD. My soul waits. I hope in his word.

kikuyu: Eegdota barii lafaa eeggatan caalaa, dhugumaan eegdota barii lafaa eeggatan caalaa lubbuun koo Gooftaa eeggatti.
english: My soul longs for the Lord more than watchmen long for the morning, more than watchmen for the morning.

kikuyu: Yaa Israaʼel, ati Waaqayyoon abdadhu; Waaqayyo bira jaalalli dhuma hin qabne, furiin guutuunis ni jiraatii.
english: Israel, hope in the LORD, for there is loving kindness with the LORD. Abundant redemption is with him.

kikuyu: Inni mataan isaa cubbuu isaanii hundumaa irraa Israaʼelin ni fura.
english: He will redeem Israel from all their sins.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa ol baʼuu. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, garaan koo of hin jaju; iji koos of hin tuulu; ani waan guddaa fi waan humna kootii ol taʼe keessa hin seenu.
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. LORD, my heart isn’t arrogant, nor my eyes lofty; nor do I concern myself with great matters, or things too wonderful for me.

kikuyu: Ani garuu lubbuu koo afaan qabachiiseera; calʼisiiseeras; akkuma daaʼimni harma haadha isaa guusan tokko haadhatti irkatee boqotu sana, akkuma daaʼima harma haadha isaa guusanii lubbuun koo na keessatti calʼiste.
english: Surely I have stilled and quieted my soul, like a weaned child with his mother, like a weaned child is my soul within me.

kikuyu: Yaa Israaʼel, ammaa fi bara baraaf, Waaqayyoon abdadhu.
english: Israel, hope in the LORD, from this time forward and forever more.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa ol baʼuu. Yaa Waaqayyo, Daawitii fi rakkina inni obse hundumaa yaadadhu.
english: A Song of Ascents. LORD, remember David and all his affliction,

kikuyu: Inni kakuu tokko Waaqayyoof kakatee Waaqa Yaaqoob Jabaa sanaaf akkana jedhee wareege:
english: how he swore to the LORD, and vowed to the Mighty One of Jacob:

kikuyu: “Ani mana koo ol hin seenu; yookaan siree kootti ol hin baʼu.
english: “Surely I will not come into the structure of my house, nor go up into my bed;

kikuyu: Ani ija kootiif hirriba, baallee ija kootiitiif immoo mugaatii hin eeyyamu;
english: I will not give sleep to my eyes, or slumber to my eyelids,

kikuyu: kunis hamma ani Waaqayyoof iddoo argutti, Waaqa Yaaqoob Jabaa sanaaf iddoo jireenyaa argutti.”
english: until I find out a place for the LORD, a dwelling for the Mighty One of Jacob.”

kikuyu: Kunoo, Efraataatti waaʼee isaa dhageenye; Yaaʼaarittis isa arganne:
english: Behold, we heard of it in Ephrathah. We found it in the field of Jaar.

kikuyu: “Kottaa iddoo jireenya isaa dhaqnaa; ejjeta miilla isaa jalattis kufnee waaqeffannaa.
english: “We will go into his dwelling place. We will worship at his footstool.”

kikuyu: ‘Yaa Waaqayyo kaʼiitii, gara iddoo boqonnaa keetii kottu; atii fi taabonni jabina keetiis kottaa.
english: Arise, LORD, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength.

kikuyu: Luboonni kee qajeelummaa haa uffatan; qulqulloonni kees gammachuudhaan haa faarfatan.’ ”
english: Let your priests be clothed with righteousness. Let your saints shout for joy!

kikuyu: Sababii garbicha kee Daawitiif jedhiitii, dibamaa kee hin gatin.
english: For your servant David’s sake, don’t turn away the face of your anointed one.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akkana jedhee kakuu dhugaa tokko Daawitiif kakateera; inni kakuu kana irraa duubatti hin deebiʼu: “Ani ilmaan kee keessaa isa tokko teessoo kee irra nan teessisa;
english: The LORD has sworn to David in truth. He will not turn from it: “I will set the fruit of your body on your throne.

kikuyu: yoo ilmaan kee kakuu koo fi seera ani isaan barsiisu eegan, ilmaan isaaniis akkasuma bara baraa hamma bara baraatti teessoo kee irra ni taaʼu.”
english: If your children will keep my covenant, my testimony that I will teach them, their children also will sit on your throne forever more.”

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Xiyoonin filateeraatii; akka isheen iddoo jireenya isaa taatus fedhee akkana jedheera:
english: For the LORD has chosen Zion. He has desired it for his habitation.

kikuyu: “Kun bara baraa hamma bara baraatti iddoo jireenyaa koo ti; kanas ani waanan fedheef, as nan jiraadha.
english: “This is my resting place forever. I will live here, for I have desired it.

kikuyu: Ani waan hundaan ishee nan eebbisa; hiyyeeyyii ishee illee buddeena nan quubsa.
english: I will abundantly bless her provision. I will satisfy her poor with bread.

kikuyu: Luboota isheetti fayyina nan uffisa; qulqulloonni ishees gammachuudhaan ni faarfatu.
english: I will also clothe her priests with salvation. Her saints will shout aloud for joy.

kikuyu: “Ani achitti akka gaanfi tokko Daawitiif biqilu nan godha; dibamaa koofis ibsaa qopheesseera.
english: I will make the horn of David to bud there. I have ordained a lamp for my anointed.

kikuyu: Diinota isaatti qaanii nan uffisa; gonfoon mataa isaa irraa garuu ni ifa.”
english: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but on himself, his crown will shine.”

kikuyu: Faarfannaa ol baʼuu. Faarfannaa Daawit. Obboloonni tokkummaadhaan walii wajjin jiraachuun, akkam gaarii dha! Akkam namatti tolas!
english: A Song of Ascents. By David. See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!

kikuyu: Kun akka zayitii gatii guddaa kan mataa irratti dhangalaafamee, akka isa areeda irra gad yaaʼuu, areeda Aroon irra, morma uffata isaa irras gad yaaʼa ti.
english: It is like the precious oil on the head, that ran down on the beard, even Aaron’s beard, that came down on the edge of his robes,

kikuyu: Innis akkuma fixeensa Hermoon, kan Tulluu Xiyoon irra gad yaaʼuu ti. Achi irratti Waaqayyo hamma bara baraatti eebba isaa, jireenyas ajajeeraatii.
english: like the dew of Hermon, that comes down on the hills of Zion; for there the LORD gives the blessing, even life forever more.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa ol baʼuu. Isin tajaajiltoonni Waaqayyoo, warri halkan mana Waaqayyoo keessa tajaajiltan hundinuu, Waaqayyoon galateeffadhaa.
english: A Song of Ascents. Look! Praise the LORD, all you servants of the LORD, who stand by night in the LORD’s house!

kikuyu: Mana qulqullummaa keessatti harka keessan ol qabaatii Waaqayyoon galateeffadhaa.
english: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Waaqayyo samii fi lafa uume sun Xiyoon irraa isin haa eebbisu.
english: May the LORD bless you from Zion, even he who made heaven and earth.

kikuyu: Haalleluuyaa. Maqaa Waaqayyoo jajadhaa; isin garboonni Waaqayyoo isa galateeffadhaa.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD’s name! Praise him, you servants of the LORD,

kikuyu: Isin warri mana Waaqayyoo keessa, oobdii mana Waaqa keenyaa keessa tajaajiltan, isa galateeffadhaa.
english: you who stand in the LORD’s house, in the courts of our God’s house.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo gaariidhaatii, Waaqayyoon galateeffadhaa; inni arjaadhaatii maqaa isaatiif faarfadhaa.
english: Praise the LORD, for the LORD is good. Sing praises to his name, for that is pleasant.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Yaaqoobin ofii isaatiif, Israaʼelin immoo dhaala dhuunfaa isaa godhee filateeraatii.
english: For the LORD has chosen Jacob for himself, Israel for his own possession.

kikuyu: Ani akka Waaqayyo guddaa taʼe, akka Gooftaan keenya waaqota hunda caalaa guddaa taʼe beeka.
english: For I know that the LORD is great, that our Lord is above all gods.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo samiiwwan keessattii fi lafa irratti, galaanotaa fi tuujuba isaanii hunda keessatti, waan isa gammachiisu kam iyyuu ni hojjeta.
english: Whatever the LORD pleased, that he has done, in heaven and in earth, in the seas and in all deeps.

kikuyu: Inni akka duumessoonni daarii lafaatii kaʼan ni godha; bokkaa wajjin balaqqee erga; gombisaa isaa keessaas bubbee gad baasa.
english: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He makes lightnings with the rain. He brings the wind out of his treasuries.

kikuyu: Inni hangafoota Gibxi, kan namaatii fi kan horii ni dhaʼe.
english: He struck the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and animal.

kikuyu: Yaa Gibxi, inni gidduu keetti, Faraʼoonii fi tajaajiltoota isaa hundatti mallattoo fi dinqii isaa ergeera.
english: He sent signs and wonders into the middle of you, Egypt, on Pharaoh, and on all his servants.

kikuyu: Inni saboota baayʼee dhaʼee mootota jajjaboo ajjeese;
english: He struck many nations, and killed mighty kings—

kikuyu: Sihoon mootii warra Amoorotaa, Oogi mootii Baashaanii fi mootota Kanaʼaan hunda ni ajjeese;
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan—

kikuyu: lafa isaanii dhaala godhee akka dhaala isaanii taʼuufis saba isaa Israaʼeliif kenne.
english: and gave their land for a heritage, a heritage to Israel, his people.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, maqaan kee bara baraan jiraata; yaa Waaqayyo, ati dhaloota hunda keessatti ni yaadatamta.
english: Your name, LORD, endures forever; your renown, LORD, throughout all generations.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo saba isaatiif ni falma; tajaajiltoota isaatiifis garaa laafa.
english: For the LORD will judge his people and have compassion on his servants.

kikuyu: Waaqonni tolfamoon namoota ormaa meetii fi warqee harka namaatiin hojjetamanii dha.
english: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

kikuyu: Isaan afaan qabu; garuu dubbachuu hin dandaʼan; ijas qabu; garuu arguu hin dandaʼan;
english: They have mouths, but they can’t speak. They have eyes, but they can’t see.

kikuyu: gurra qabu; garuu dhagaʼuu hin dandaʼan; yookaan hafuurri tokko iyyuu afaan isaanii keessa hin jiru.
english: They have ears, but they can’t hear, neither is there any breath in their mouths.

kikuyu: Warri isaan tolchan kanneen isaan amanatan hundi akkuma isaanii taʼu.
english: Those who make them will be like them, yes, everyone who trusts in them.

kikuyu: Yaa mana Israaʼel Waaqayyoon eebbisaa; yaa mana Aroon Waaqayyoon eebbisaa;
english: House of Israel, praise the LORD! House of Aaron, praise the LORD!

kikuyu: yaa mana Lewwii Waaqayyoon eebbisaa; isin warri isa sodaattanis, Waaqayyoon eebbisaa.
english: House of Levi, praise the LORD! You who fear the LORD, praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Waaqayyo inni Yerusaalem keessa jiraatu sun, Xiyoon irraa haa eebbifamu. Haalleluuyaa!
english: Blessed be the LORD from Zion, who dwells in Jerusalem. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Waaqayyoof galata galchaa; inni gaariidhaatii. Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: Give thanks to the LORD, for he is good, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Waaqa waaqotaatiif galata galchaa. Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: Give thanks to the God of gods, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Gooftaa Gooftotaatiif galata galchaa: Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: Give thanks to the Lord of lords, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni kophaa isaa dinqii gurguddaa hojjeta; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: to him who alone does great wonders, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni ogummaa isaatiin samiiwwan uume; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: to him who by understanding made the heavens, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni bishaanota irratti lafa diriirse; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: to him who spread out the earth above the waters, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni ifa gurguddaa hojjete; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: to him who made the great lights, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni akka biiftuun guyyaa mootu godhe; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: the sun to rule by day, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni akka jiʼii fi urjiiwwan halkan moʼan godhe; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: the moon and stars to rule by night, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni hangafa Gibxi dhaʼe; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: to him who struck down the Egyptian firstborn, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni isaan gidduudhaa Israaʼelin baase; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: and brought out Israel from among them, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: harka jabaa fi irree diriiraadhaan Israaʼelin baase; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: with a strong hand, and with an outstretched arm, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni Galaana Diimaa iddoo lamatti gargarii qoode; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: to him who divided the Red Sea apart, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni galaana gidduudhaan Israaʼelin dabarse; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: and made Israel to pass through the middle of it, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Faraʼoonii fi loltoota isaa garuu Galaana Diimaatti naqe; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: but overthrew Pharaoh and his army in the Red Sea, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni saba ofii isaa gammoojjii keessa geggeesse; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: to him who led his people through the wilderness, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni mootota gurguddaa dhaʼe; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: to him who struck great kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni mootota jajjaboo fixe; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: and killed mighty kings, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni Sihoon mootii Amoorotaa ajjeese; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: Sihon king of the Amorites, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni Oogi mootii Baashaan ajjeese; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: Og king of Bashan, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni biyya isaanii dhaala godhee kenne; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: and gave their land as an inheritance, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: dhaala godhee garbicha isaa Israaʼeliif kenne; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: even a heritage to Israel his servant, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: Inni yeroo nu gad deebinetti nu yaadate; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: who remembered us in our low estate, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni harka diinota keenyaatii nu baase, Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: and has delivered us from our adversaries, for his loving kindness endures forever;

kikuyu: inni uumama hundaaf soora kenna; Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: who gives food to every creature, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Waaqa samiitiif galata galchaa. Jaalalli isaa bara baraan jiraata.
english: Oh give thanks to the God of heaven, for his loving kindness endures forever.

kikuyu: Nu yeroo Xiyoonin yaadannetti, lageen Baabilon bira teenyee boonye.
english: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down. Yes, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

kikuyu: Achittis kiraara keenya muka alaltuutti fannifne;
english: On the willows in that land, we hung up our harps.

kikuyu: achitti warri nu boojiʼan faarfannaa, warri nu dhiphisanis, “Faarfannaawwan Xiyoon keessaa tokko nuu faarfadhaa!” jedhanii akka nu faarfannaa gammachuu isaaniif faarfannu nu gaafatan.
english: For there, those who led us captive asked us for songs. Those who tormented us demanded songs of joy: “Sing us one of the songs of Zion!”

kikuyu: Nu utuu biyya ormaa jirruu, akkamitti faarfannaa Waaqayyoo faarfachuu dandeenya?
english: How can we sing the LORD’s song in a foreign land?

kikuyu: Yaa Yerusaalem, yoo ani si irraanfadhe, harki koo mirgaa ogummaa isaa haa irraanfatu.
english: If I forget you, Jerusalem, let my right hand forget its skill.

kikuyu: Yoo ani si yaadachuu baadhe, yoo ani gammachuu koo guddichaa olitti Yerusaalemin ilaaluu baadhe, arrabni koo laagaa kootti haa maxxanu.
english: Let my tongue stick to the roof of my mouth if I don’t remember you, if I don’t prefer Jerusalem above my chief joy.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, waan warri Edoom gaafa Yerusaalem diigamte jedhan sana yaadadhu; isaanis, “Ishee diigaa! Hamma hundee isheetti ishee diigaa!” jedhanii iyyan.
english: Remember, LORD, against the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem, who said, “Raze it! Raze it even to its foundation!”

kikuyu: Yaa intala Baabilon, kan baduudhaaf qophoofte, inni waan ati nu goote sanaaf, gatii kee siif kennu eebbifamaa dha.
english: Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, he will be happy who repays you, as you have done to us.

kikuyu: Inni daaʼimman kee qabee dhagaa irratti caccabsu sun eebbifamaa dha.
english: Happy shall he be, who takes and dashes your little ones against the rock.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, ani garaa koo guutuudhaan sin galateeffadha; fuula “waaqotaa” durattis galata kee nan faarfadha.
english: By David. I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

kikuyu: Sababii ati maqaa keetii fi dubbii kee waan hundaa olitti guddifteef, ani sababii jaalalaa fi amanamummaa keetiitiif gara mana qulqullummaa kee qulqullichaatti gad jedhee, maqaa kee nan leellisa.
english: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani si waammadhetti ati deebii naa kennite; irree keetiinis na jabeessite.
english: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, mootonni lafaa hundinuu, yeroo dubbii afaan keetii dhagaʼanitti si haa leellisan.
english: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

kikuyu: Ulfinni Waaqayyoo, guddaadhaatii, isaan waaʼee karaa Waaqayyoo haa faarfatan.
english: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!

kikuyu: Waaqayyo yoo ol fagoo jiraate iyyuu, nama gad qabame ni ilaala; nama of tuulu immoo fagootti beeka.
english: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

kikuyu: Ani rakkina keessa jiraadhu iyyuu, ati lubbuu koo ni eegda; aarii diina kootti harka kee ni diriirsita; harka kee mirgaatiinis na oolchita.
english: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo kaayyoo isaa fiixaan naa baasa; yaa Waaqayyo, jaalalli kee bara baraan jiraata; hojii harka keetii hin gatin.
english: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.

kikuyu: Dura buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, ati na qorteerta; na beekteertas.
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. LORD, you have searched me, and you know me.

kikuyu: Ati yeroo ani gad taaʼuu fi yeroo ani ol kaʼu ni beekta; yaada koos fagootti hubatta.
english: You know my sitting down and my rising up. You perceive my thoughts from afar.

kikuyu: Deemuu koo fi ciisuu koo addaan baaftee beekta; karaa koo hundas beekta.
english: You search out my path and my lying down, and are acquainted with all my ways.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, akka dubbiin tokko iyyuu arraba koo hin jirre, ati guutumaan guutuutti ni beekta.
english: For there is not a word on my tongue, but behold, LORD, you know it altogether.

kikuyu: Ati duraa fi duubaan na marsiteerta; harka kees narra keesseerta.
english: You hem me in behind and before. You laid your hand on me.

kikuyu: Beekumsi akkanaa anaaf akka malee dinqii dha; hubachuufis akka malee narraa fagoo dha.
english: This knowledge is beyond me. It’s lofty. I can’t attain it.

kikuyu: Hafuura kee biraa ani eessa dhaquun dandaʼa? Fuula kee duraas ani eessatti baqachuun dandaʼa?
english: Where could I go from your Spirit? Or where could I flee from your presence?

kikuyu: Yoo ani samiiwwanitti ol baʼe, ati achi jirta; yoo ani siree koo siiʼool keessa dhaabbadhes, achis ni jirta.
english: If I ascend up into heaven, you are there. If I make my bed in Sheol, behold, you are there!

kikuyu: Yoo ani qoochoo ganamaatiin barrisee qarqara galaanaa fagoo irra qubadhe,
english: If I take the wings of the dawn, and settle in the uttermost parts of the sea,

kikuyu: achittis harki kee karaa na argisiisa; harki kee mirgaas jabeessee na qaba.
english: even there your hand will lead me, and your right hand will hold me.

kikuyu: Yoo ani, “Dhugumaan dukkanni na dhoksa; ifnis naannoo kootti halkan taʼa” jedhe,
english: If I say, “Surely the darkness will overwhelm me. The light around me will be night,”

kikuyu: dukkanni iyyuu siif dukkana hin taʼu; halkanis akkuma guyyaa ifa; dukkanni siif akkuma ifaatii.
english: even the darkness doesn’t hide from you, but the night shines as the day. The darkness is like light to you.

kikuyu: Ati namummaa koo isa keessaa uumteertaatii; gadameessa haadha koo keessattis na tolchite.
english: For you formed my inmost being. You knit me together in my mother’s womb.

kikuyu: Ani sababii haala sodaachisaa fi dinqisiisaadhaan uumameef sin galateeffadha; hojiin kee dinqisiisaa dha; kanas ani akka gaariittan beeka.
english: I will give thanks to you, for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. Your works are wonderful. My soul knows that very well.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani iddoo dhoksaatti uumame, lafeen koo si duraa hin dhokanne. Yeroo ani dhidhima lafaa keessatti tolfame,
english: My frame wasn’t hidden from you, when I was made in secret, woven together in the depths of the earth.

kikuyu: iji kee dhagna koo kan hin tolfamin arge. Guyyoonni duraan dursanii naaf murteeffaman hundi utuu hin jiraatin, kitaaba kee keessatti barreeffamaniiru.
english: Your eyes saw my body. In your book they were all written, the days that were ordained for me, when as yet there were none of them.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, yaada kee hubachuun akkam ulfaata! Baayʼinni isaas akkam guddaa dha!
english: How precious to me are your thoughts, God! How vast is their sum!

kikuyu: Utuu ani isaan lakkaaʼee jiraadhee, silaa lakkoobsi isaanii cirracha irra baayʼata. Ani yeroon dammaqutti, amma iyyuu suma wajjinan jira.
english: If I would count them, they are more in number than the sand. When I wake up, I am still with you.

kikuyu: Maaloo yaa Waaqi, ati utuu hamoota fixxee! Warri dhiiga namaa dhangalaaftan, narraa fagaadhaa!
english: If only you, God, would kill the wicked. Get away from me, you bloodthirsty men!

kikuyu: Isaan yaada hamaadhaan waaʼee kee dubbatu; diinonni kee akkasumaan maqaa kee dhaʼu.
english: For they speak against you wickedly. Your enemies take your name in vain.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani warra si jibban hin jibbuu? Warra sitti kaʼanis hin xireeffadhuu?
english: LORD, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?

kikuyu: Ani hamma dhumaatti isaan jibbeera; akka diina koottis isaan nan heda.
english: I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, na sakattaʼi; garaa koos beeki; qoriitii na ilaali; yaada koos beeki.
english: Search me, God, and know my heart. Try me, and know my thoughts.

kikuyu: Yoo karaan hamminaa na keessa jiraate mee ilaali; karaa bara baraa irras na adeemsisi.
english: See if there is any wicked way in me, and lead me in the everlasting way.

kikuyu: Dura Buʼaa faarfattootaatiif. Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, namoota hamoo jalaa na baasi; namoota finciltoota
english: For the Chief Musician. A Psalm by David. Deliver me, LORD, from evil men. Preserve me from violent men:

kikuyu: warra garaa isaanii keessatti hammina yaadanii guyyaa hunda waraana kaasan narraa eegi.
english: those who devise mischief in their hearts. They continually gather themselves together for war.

kikuyu: Isaan arraba isaanii akkuma bofaa qaratu; hadhaan buutii hidhii isaanii jala jira.
english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent. Viper’s poison is under their lips. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, harka hamootaa narraa eegi; namoota finciltoota warra miilla koo kiyyootti galchuu yaadan jalaa na baasi.
