english: LORD, keep me from the hands of the wicked. Preserve me from the violent men who have determined to trip my feet.

kikuyu: Of tuultonni dhoksanii kiyyoo na dura kaaʼaniiru; ribuu kiyyoo isaanii diriirsaniiru; karaa koo irras kiyyoo isaanii kaaʼaniiru.
english: The proud have hidden a snare for me, they have spread the cords of a net by the path. They have set traps for me. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani, “Ati Waaqa koo ti” siin nan jedha. Yaa Waaqayyo, waammata koo dhagaʼi.
english: I said to the LORD, “You are my God.” Listen to the cry of my petitions, LORD.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa, fayyisaa koo jabaa, ati guyyaa waraanaatti gaachana mataa naa taate.
english: LORD, the Lord, the strength of my salvation, you have covered my head in the day of battle.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, akka fedhiin hamootaa fiixaan baʼu hin godhin; akka isaan of hin tuulleef, akka karoorri isaanii milkaaʼu hin godhin.
english: LORD, don’t grant the desires of the wicked. Don’t let their evil plans succeed, or they will become proud. Selah.

kikuyu: Mataan warra na marsanii, hammina afaan isaaniitii baʼuun haa haguugamu.
english: As for the head of those who surround me, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

kikuyu: Barbadaan ibiddaa isaan irra haa buʼu; isaan ibiddatti illee haa darbataman; akka lammata hin kaaneefis boolla qileetti haa darbataman.
english: Let burning coals fall on them. Let them be thrown into the fire, into miry pits, from where they never rise.

kikuyu: Maqa balleessitoonni lafa irra hin jiraatin; namni jalʼaan waan hamaadhaan haa badu.
english: An evil speaker won’t be established on the earth. Evil will hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo rakkattootaaf falmee hiyyeeyyiif illee murtii qajeelaa akka kennu ani beeka.
english: I know that the LORD will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and justice for the needy.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan namni qajeelaan maqaa kee ni galateeffata; namni tolaanis fuula kee dura ni jiraata.
english: Surely the righteous will give thanks to your name. The upright will dwell in your presence.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, ani sin waammadha; dafii na qaqqabi. Yommuu ani si waammadhus sagalee koo dhagaʼi.
english: A Psalm by David. LORD, I have called on you. Come to me quickly! Listen to my voice when I call to you.

kikuyu: Kadhannaan koo fuula kee duratti akka ixaanaatti anaaf haa fudhatamu; harka koo ol qabachuun koos akka aarsaa galgalaa anaaf haa taʼu.
english: Let my prayer be set before you like incense; the lifting up of my hands like the evening sacrifice.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, afaan kootiif eegduu naa dhaabi; balbala afaan kootiis naa eegi.
english: Set a watch, LORD, before my mouth. Keep the door of my lips.

kikuyu: Garaan koo namoota waan hamaa hojjetan wajjin, hojii hamminaa keessatti hirmaachuuf, gara jalʼina kamiitti iyyuu hin harkifamin; akka ani nyaata isaanii miʼaawaa nyaadhus anaaf hin eeyyamin.
english: Don’t incline my heart to any evil thing, to practice deeds of wickedness with men who work iniquity. Don’t let me eat of their delicacies.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan na haa rukutu; kun gara laafinaatii; inni ana haa ifatu; kunis zayitii mataa koo irraatti. Mataan koo waan kana hin didu. Taʼus kadhannaan koo yoom iyyuu hojii hamootaatiin mormuu dha.
english: Let the righteous strike me, it is kindness; let him reprove me, it is like oil on the head; don’t let my head refuse it; Yet my prayer is always against evil deeds.

kikuyu: Bulchitoonni isaanii ededa boollaa irraa gad ni darbatamu; isaan dubbii koo ni dhagaʼu; dubbiin koo ni miʼaawaatii.
english: Their judges are thrown down by the sides of the rock. They will hear my words, for they are well spoken.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Akkuma namni lafa qotu biyyoo bulleessu sana, lafeen keenya afaan siiʼool irratti bittinneeffamee jira” jedhu.
english: “As when one plows and breaks up the earth, our bones are scattered at the mouth of Sheol.”

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo Gooftaa, ani garuu ija koo sirraa hin buqqifadhu; ani kooluu sitti galeera; dabarsitee duʼatti na hin kennin.
english: For my eyes are on you, LORD, the Lord. I take refuge in you. Don’t leave my soul destitute.

kikuyu: Kiyyoo isaan naaf kaaʼan irraa, kiyyoo warri jalʼina hojjetan naaf qopheessan irraas na eegi.
english: Keep me from the snare which they have laid for me, from the traps of the workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Warri hamoon kiyyoo ofii isaaniitiin haa qabaman; ani garuu nagumaan nan baʼa.
english: Let the wicked fall together into their own nets while I pass by.

kikuyu: Maaskiilii Daawit Ani gara Waaqayyotti nan iyya; sagalee kootiinis fuula Waaqayyoo duratti waammata koo nan dhiʼeeffadha.
english: A contemplation by David, when he was in the cave. A Prayer. I cry with my voice to the LORD. With my voice, I ask the LORD for mercy.

kikuyu: Ani guungummii koo fuula isaa duratti nan dhangalaasa; dhibee koos fuula isaa duratti nan himadha.
english: I pour out my complaint before him. I tell him my troubles.

kikuyu: Yeroof hafuurri koo na keessatti laafu, situ karaa koo beeka. Namoonni daandii ani deemu irra, kiyyoo naa kaaʼaniiru.
english: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, you knew my route. On the path in which I walk, they have hidden a snare for me.

kikuyu: Gara mirga koo ilaali; argis; namni naa yaadu tokko iyyuu hin jiru; ani iddoon itti kooluu galu tokko illee hin qabu; namni jireenya kootiif yaadus hin jiru.
english: Look on my right, and see; for there is no one who is concerned for me. Refuge has fled from me. No one cares for my soul.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, sitti nan iyyadha; “Ati iddoo ani itti kooluu galuu dha; biyya warra jiraatoo keessattis ati qooda koo ti” nan jedha.
english: I cried to you, LORD. I said, “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”

kikuyu: Ani abdii kutadheeraatii, kadhannaa koo naa dhagaʼi; warra na ariʼatan jalaa na baasi; isaan akka malee natti cimaniiruutii.
english: Listen to my cry, for I am in desperate need. Deliver me from my persecutors, for they are too strong for me.

kikuyu: Akka ani maqaa kee galateeffadhuuf, lubbuu koo mana hidhaatii naa baasi. Sababii ati waan gaarii naa gooteef, qajeeltonni naannoo kootti walitti qabamu.
english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may give thanks to your name. The righteous will surround me, for you will be good to me.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqayyo, kadhannaa koo naa dhagaʼi; gurra kees gara waammata kootiitti deebisi; amanamummaa fi qajeelummaa keetiin, na gargaari.
english: A Psalm by David. Hear my prayer, LORD. Listen to my petitions. In your faithfulness and righteousness, relieve me.

kikuyu: Ati garbicha kee murtiitti hin dhiʼeessin; namni lubbuun jiraatu kam iyyuu fuula kee duratti qajeelaa mitiitii.
english: Don’t enter into judgment with your servant, for in your sight no man living is righteous.

kikuyu: Diinni lubbuu koo ariʼachaa jiraatii; jireenya koos butuchee biyyootti make. Akkuma warra dur duʼaniittis dukkana keessa na jiraachiseera.
english: For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those who have been long dead.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu hafuurri koo na keessatti gaggabeera; onneen koos na keessatti rifatteerti.
english: Therefore my spirit is overwhelmed within me. My heart within me is desolate.

kikuyu: Ani guyyoota durii nan yaadadha; waan ati hojjette hundas irra deddeebiʼee nan yaada; waan harki kee hojjete illee nan heda.
english: I remember the days of old. I meditate on all your doings. I contemplate the work of your hands.

kikuyu: Harka koo gara keetti nan diriirfadha; lubbuun koos akkuma lafa gogaa si dheebotti.
english: I spread out my hands to you. My soul thirsts for you, like a parched land. Selah.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, dafii deebii naa kenni; hafuurri koo dadhabeera. Fuula kee na duraa hin dhoksin yookaan ani akka warra boolla buʼanii nan taʼa.
english: Hurry to answer me, LORD. My spirit fails. Don’t hide your face from me, so that I don’t become like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: Ani waanan si amanadheef, akka ani ganama ganama oduu jaalala keetii dhagaʼu godhi. Ani lubbuu koo gara keetti ol nan kaasaatii, karaa ani irra deemuu qabu natti argisiisi.
english: Cause me to hear your loving kindness in the morning, for I trust in you. Cause me to know the way in which I should walk, for I lift up my soul to you.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, ani akka ati na dhoksituuf sitti nan baqadhaatii, diinota koo jalaa na baasi.
english: Deliver me, LORD, from my enemies. I flee to you to hide me.

kikuyu: Ati sababii Waaqa koo taateef, akka ani fedhii kee guutu na barsiisi; hafuurri kee gaariin sun karaa wal qixxee irra na haa qajeelchu.
english: Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Your Spirit is good. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, maqaa keetii jedhiitii lubbuu koo jiraachisi; qajeelummaa keetiinis rakkina keessaa na baasi.
english: Revive me, LORD, for your name’s sake. In your righteousness, bring my soul out of trouble.

kikuyu: Ati sababii na jaallattuuf diinota koo fixi; waan ani garbicha kee taʼeef, warra na cunqursan hunda barbadeessi.
english: In your loving kindness, cut off my enemies, and destroy all those who afflict my soul, for I am your servant.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Waaqayyo kattaa koo, isa harka koo waraanaaf, quba koos lolaaf leenjisu sanaaf galanni haa gaʼu.
english: By David. Blessed be the LORD, my rock, who trains my hands to war, and my fingers to battle—

kikuyu: Inni Waaqa na jaallatuu fi daʼoo koo ti; iddoo ani itti daʼadhuu fi fayyisaa koo ti. Gaachana koo, iddoo ani itti kooluu galu, kan na jalatti saba naaf bulchuu dha.
english: my loving kindness, my fortress, my high tower, my deliverer, my shield, and he in whom I take refuge, who subdues my people under me.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, akka ati waaʼee isaa yaadduuf, namni maali? Akka ati isaaf yaadduuf ilmi namaa maali?
english: LORD, what is man, that you care for him? Or the son of man, that you think of him?

kikuyu: Namni akkuma qilleensa shuf jedhee darbuuti, barri isaas akkuma gaaddisa darbuu ti.
english: Man is like a breath. His days are like a shadow that passes away.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, samiiwwan kee tarsaasii gad buʼi; akka aarri isaan keessaa yaaʼuufis tulluuwwan tuqi.
english: Part your heavens, LORD, and come down. Touch the mountains, and they will smoke.

kikuyu: Bakakkaa ergiitii diina bittinneessi; xiyya kee darbadhuutii isaan balleessi.
english: Throw out lightning, and scatter them. Send out your arrows, and rout them.

kikuyu: Ol gubbaadhaa harka kee gad hiixadhuutii bishaan jabaa jalaa, harka alagaa duraas, na baasi; na oolchis;
english: Stretch out your hand from above, rescue me, and deliver me out of great waters, out of the hands of foreigners,

kikuyu: warra afaan isaanii sobaan guutame, warra harki isaanii mirgaa nama dogoggorsu duraa na baasi.
english: whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqi, ani faarfannaa haaraa siif nan faarfadha; kiraara ribuu kudhaniitiinis siifin weeddisa;
english: I will sing a new song to you, God. On a ten-stringed lyre, I will sing praises to you.

kikuyu: isa moototaaf moʼannoo kennuuf, isa garbicha isaa Daawitin goraadee nama ajjeesu jalaa baasuuf nan faarfadha.
english: You are he who gives salvation to kings, who rescues David, his servant, from the deadly sword.

kikuyu: Harka Ormootaa duraa, warra afaan isaanii sobaan guutame, warra harki isaanii mirgaa nama dogoggorsu jalaa na baasi; na oolchis.
english: Rescue me, and deliver me out of the hands of foreigners, whose mouths speak deceit, whose right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

kikuyu: Ilmaan keenya dargaggummaa isaanii keessatti, akka biqiltuu tolee guddatee haa taʼan; intallan keenyas akka utubaa golee, kan masaraa mootummaa miidhagsuuf soofamee haa taʼan.
english: Then our sons will be like well-nurtured plants, our daughters like pillars carved to adorn a palace.

kikuyu: Gombisaawwan keenya, midhaan gosa garaa garaatiin haa guutaman. Hoolonni keenya kumaatama haa dhalan; dirree keenya irrattis kumaatama kudhaniin haa baayʼatan;
english: Our barns are full, filled with all kinds of provision. Our sheep produce thousands and ten thousands in our fields.

kikuyu: loon keenya haa dorroban hin gatatin yookaan yeroo malee hin dhalin; boojiʼamuunis hin jiraatin; wawwaachuunis karaa keenya irratti hin dhagaʼamin.
english: Our oxen will pull heavy loads. There is no breaking in, and no going away, and no outcry in our streets.

kikuyu: Warri eebbi kun taʼeef haa gammadan; warri Waaqayyo Waaqa isaanii taʼeef eebbifamoo dha.
english: Happy are the people who are in such a situation. Happy are the people whose God is the LORD.

kikuyu: Faarfannaa Daawit. Yaa Waaqa koo Mooticha, ani sin leellisa; bara baraa hamma bara baraattis maqaa kee nan galateeffadha.
english: A praise psalm by David. I will exalt you, my God, the King. I will praise your name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Ani guyyuma guyyaan sin galateeffadha; bara baraa hamma bara baraattis maqaa kee nan leellisa.
english: Every day I will praise you. I will extol your name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo guddaa dha; galateeffamuunis baayʼee malaaf; guddina isaa qoratanii itti baʼuun hin dandaʼamu.
english: Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised! His greatness is unsearchable.

kikuyu: Dhaloonni tokko dhaloota biraatti hojii kee ni hima; hojiiwwan kee jajjaboos ni labsa.
english: One generation will commend your works to another, and will declare your mighty acts.

kikuyu: Isaanis waaʼee miidhagina ulfina qabeessa surraa kee sanaa ni dubbatu; anis waaʼee hojii kee dinqisiisaa sanaa irra deddeebiʼee itti nan yaada.
english: I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.

kikuyu: Isaan waaʼee hojii kee sodaachisaa sanaa ni odeessu; anis guddina kee nan labsa.
english: Men will speak of the might of your awesome acts. I will declare your greatness.

kikuyu: Isaan yaadannoo gaarummaa keetii baayʼisanii odeessu; waaʼee qajeelummaa keetiis ililchanii faarfatu.
english: They will utter the memory of your great goodness, and will sing of your righteousness.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo arjaa fi gara laafessa; inni aaruuf hin ariifatu; jaalalli isaas baayʼee dha.
english: The LORD is gracious, merciful, slow to anger, and of great loving kindness.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo, nama hundaaf gaarii dha; inni waan uume hundaaf garaa ni laafa.
english: The LORD is good to all. His tender mercies are over all his works.

kikuyu: Yaa Waaqayyo, hojiin kee hundinuu si galateeffata; qulqulloonni kees si leellisu.
english: All your works will give thanks to you, LORD. Your saints will extol you.

kikuyu: Isaan waaʼee ulfina mootummaa keetii ni odeessu; waaʼee humna keetiis ni dubbatu;
english: They will speak of the glory of your kingdom, and talk about your power,

kikuyu: kunis akka namoonni hundi hojii kee humna qabeessa, surraa ulfina qabeessa mootummaa kee sanaas beekaniif.
english: to make known to the sons of men his mighty acts, the glory of the majesty of his kingdom.

kikuyu: Mootummaan kee mootummaa bara baraa ti; bulchiinsi kees dhalootaa gara dhalootaatti darba. Waaqayyo dubbii isaa hundaan amanamaa dha; hojii isaa hundaanis arjaa dha.
english: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom. Your dominion endures throughout all generations. The LORD is faithful in all his words, and loving in all his deeds.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo warra kufan hunda ol qaba; warra gad qabaman hundas ni kaasa.
english: The LORD upholds all who fall, and raises up all those who are bowed down.

kikuyu: Iji nama hundaa si eeggata; atis yeroo barbaachisutti nyaata isaaniif ni kennita.
english: The eyes of all wait for you. You give them their food in due season.

kikuyu: Ati harka kee balʼiftee fedhii warra lubbuu qaban hundaa ni guutta.
english: You open your hand, and satisfy the desire of every living thing.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo karaa isaa hundaan qajeelaa dha; hojii isaa hundaanis arjaa dha.
english: The LORD is righteous in all his ways, and gracious in all his works.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo warra isa waammatan hundatti, warra dhugaadhaan isa waammatan hundatti dhiʼoo dha.
english: The LORD is near to all those who call on him, to all who call on him in truth.

kikuyu: Inni fedhii warra isa sodaatanii ni guuta; kadhannaa isaanis dhagaʼee isaan oolcha.
english: He will fulfill the desire of those who fear him. He also will hear their cry, and will save them.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo warra isa jaallatan hunda ni eega; jalʼoota hunda garuu ni balleessa.
english: The LORD preserves all those who love him, but he will destroy all the wicked.

kikuyu: Afaan koo Waaqayyoon galateeffachuudhaan ni dubbata. Uumamni hundinuu maqaa isaa qulqulluu sana bara baraa hamma bara baraatti haa eebbisu.
english: My mouth will speak the praise of the LORD. Let all flesh bless his holy name forever and ever.

kikuyu: Haalleluuyaa. Yaa lubbuu ko, Waaqayyoon galateeffadhu.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD, my soul.

kikuyu: Ani bara jireenya koo guutuu Waaqayyoon nan galateeffadha; ani hamman jirutti Waaqaaf nan faarfadha.
english: While I live, I will praise the LORD. I will sing praises to my God as long as I exist.

kikuyu: Abdii keessan bulchitoota irra, namoota duʼa hin oolle warra isin gargaaruu hin dandeenye irra hin kaaʼatinaa.
english: Don’t put your trust in princes, in a son of man in whom there is no help.

kikuyu: Isaan yeruma lubbuun isaan keessaa baatu gara lafaatti deebiʼu; guyyuma sanas karoorri isaanii bada.
english: His spirit departs, and he returns to the earth. In that very day, his thoughts perish.

kikuyu: Namni gargaarsi isaa Waaqa Yaaqoob taʼe, kan abdiin isaas Waaqayyo Waaqa isaa taʼe eebbifamaa dha.
english: Happy is he who has the God of Jacob for his help, whose hope is in the LORD, his God,

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Uumaa samii fi lafaa, galaanaa fi waan isaan keessa jiru hundaa ti; inni bara baraan amanamaa taʼe jiraata.
english: who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that is in them; who keeps truth forever;

kikuyu: Inni warra cunqurfamaniif ni mura; warra beelaʼaniif nyaata kenna. Waaqayyo warra hidhaman illee ni hiika;
english: who executes justice for the oppressed; who gives food to the hungry. The LORD frees the prisoners.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo jaamotaaf agartuu ni kenna; Waaqayyo warra gad deebiʼan ol qaba; Waaqayyo qajeeltota ni jaallata.
english: The LORD opens the eyes of the blind. The LORD raises up those who are bowed down. The LORD loves the righteous.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo alagaadhaaf eegumsa ni godha; ijoollee haadhaa fi abbaa hin qabnee fi dubartoota dhirsoonni irraa duʼan ni jiraachisa; karaa jalʼootaa garuu ni balleessa.
english: The LORD preserves the foreigners. He upholds the fatherless and widow, but he turns the way of the wicked upside down.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo bara baraan ni moʼa; Yaa Xiyoon, Waaqni kee dhaloota hundaaf mootii taʼa. Haalleluuyaa.
english: The LORD will reign forever; your God, O Zion, to all generations. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Haalleluuyaa. Faarfannaadhaan Waaqa galateeffachuun akkam gaarii dha; isa galateeffachuun akkam gammachiisaa fi kan maluu dha!
english: Praise the LORD, for it is good to sing praises to our God; for it is pleasant and fitting to praise him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Yerusaalemin ni ijaara; Israaʼeloota boojiʼamanis walitti qaba.
english: The LORD builds up Jerusalem. He gathers together the outcasts of Israel.

kikuyu: Warra garaan cabe ni fayyisa; madaa isaaniis walitti hodha.
english: He heals the broken in heart, and binds up their wounds.

kikuyu: Inni baayʼina urjiiwwanii ni beeka; tokkoo tokkoo isaaniis maqaa maqaadhaan waama.
english: He counts the number of the stars. He calls them all by their names.

kikuyu: Gooftaan keenya guddaa dha; humni isaas jabaa dha; hubannaan isaas dhuma hin qabu.
english: Great is our Lord, and mighty in power. His understanding is infinite.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo warra gad qabaman ni jiraachisa; hamoota garuu lafatti darbata.
english: The LORD upholds the humble. He brings the wicked down to the ground.

kikuyu: Galata galchaa Waaqayyoon faarfadhaa; baganaadhaanis Waaqa keenyaaf weeddisaa.
english: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving. Sing praises on the harp to our God,

kikuyu: Inni samiiwwani duumessaan haguuga; lafaafis bokkaa kenna; tulluuwwan irrattis marga biqilcha.
english: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass grow on the mountains.

kikuyu: Horiidhaaf waan isaan dheedan, yommuu ilmaan arraagessaa iyyanitti nyaata isaaniif ni kenna.
english: He provides food for the livestock, and for the young ravens when they call.

kikuyu: Inni jabina fardaatti hin gammadu; yookaan miilli namaa isa hin gammachiisu;
english: He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo warra isa sodaatanitti, warra araara isaa abdatanitti ni gammada.
english: The LORD takes pleasure in those who fear him, in those who hope in his loving kindness.

kikuyu: Yaa Yerusaalem, Waaqayyoon galateeffadhu; Yaa Xiyoon Waaqa kee galateeffadhu.
english: Praise the LORD, Jerusalem! Praise your God, Zion!

kikuyu: Inni danqaraa karra keetii ni jabeessaatii; ijoollee kees si keessatti eebbisa.
english: For he has strengthened the bars of your gates. He has blessed your children within you.

kikuyu: Daarii keetiif nagaa kenna; qamadii qulqulluudhaanis si quubsa.
english: He makes peace in your borders. He fills you with the finest of the wheat.

kikuyu: Inni ajaja isaa gara lafaatti ni erga; dubbiin isaas ni ariifata.
english: He sends out his commandment to the earth. His word runs very swiftly.

kikuyu: Inni cabbii akkuma suufiitti diriirsa; qorras akkuma daaraatti bittinneessa.
english: He gives snow like wool, and scatters frost like ashes.

kikuyu: Dhagaa cabbii akkuma cirrachaa gad darbata. Dhaamocha isaa dura eenyutu dhaabachuu dandaʼa?
english: He hurls down his hail like pebbles. Who can stand before his cold?

kikuyu: Inni dubbii isaa ergee isaan baqsa; bubbee isaa ni kaasa; bishaanonnis ni yaaʼu.
english: He sends out his word, and melts them. He causes his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

kikuyu: Inni dubbii isaa Yaaqoobitti, seeraa fi sirna isaa immoo Israaʼelitti mulʼiseera.
english: He shows his word to Jacob, his statutes and his ordinances to Israel.

kikuyu: Waan kana saba biraa tokkoof iyyuu hin goone; isaan seera isaa hin beekan. Haalleluuyaa.
english: He has not done this for just any nation. They don’t know his ordinances. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Haalleluuyaa. Samiiwwan irraa Waaqayyoon galateeffadhaa; ol gubbaatti isa galateeffadhaa.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise the LORD from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!

kikuyu: Ergamoonni isaa hundinuu isa galateeffadhaa; raayyaan isaa hundinuus isa galateeffadhaa.
english: Praise him, all his angels! Praise him, all his army!

kikuyu: Aduu fi jiʼi isa galateeffadhaa; urjiiwwan ibsitan hundinuus isa galateeffadhaa.
english: Praise him, sun and moon! Praise him, all you shining stars!

kikuyu: Samiiwwan samii isa galateeffadhaa; bishaanonni samiin ol jirtanis isa galateeffadhaa.
english: Praise him, you heavens of heavens, you waters that are above the heavens.

kikuyu: Isaan maqaa Waaqayyoo haa galateeffatan; inni ajajnaan, isaan uumamaniitii.
english: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for he commanded, and they were created.

kikuyu: Inni bara baraa hamma bara baraatti isaan dhaabeera; seera hin geeddaramnes isaaniif kenneera.
english: He has also established them forever and ever. He has made a decree which will not pass away.

kikuyu: Uumamawwan galaanaatii fi tuujubawwan hundi, lafa irraa Waaqayyoon galateeffadhaa;
english: Praise the LORD from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths,

kikuyu: bakakkaa fi dhagaan cabbii, cabbii fi duumessi, bubbeen jabaan ajaja isaa raawwatan,
english: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, stormy wind, fulfilling his word,

kikuyu: tulluuwwanii fi gaarran hundinuu, mukkeen ija naqatanii fi birbirsi hundinuu,
english: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,

kikuyu: bineensonnii fi loon hundinuu, uumamawwan xixinnoo fi simbirroonni barrisan,
english: wild animals and all livestock, small creatures and flying birds,

kikuyu: mootonni lafaatii fi saboonni hundinuu, ilmaan moototaatii fi bulchitoonni lafaa hundinuu,
english: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all judges of the earth,

kikuyu: dargaggoonnii fi shamarran, jaarsolii fi daaʼimman isa galateeffadhaa.
english: both young men and maidens, old men and children.

kikuyu: Maqaan isaa qofti ol ol jedheeraatii, isaan maqaa Waaqayyoo haa galateeffatan; ulfinni isaas lafaa fi samiiwwanii ol jira.
english: Let them praise the LORD’s name, for his name alone is exalted. His glory is above the earth and the heavens.

kikuyu: Inni saba isaatiif gaanfa ol kaaseera; kunis qulqulloota isaa hundaaf, saba Israaʼel warra isatti dhiʼoo jiran hundaaf ulfina. Haalleluuyaa.
english: He has lifted up the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints, even of the children of Israel, a people near to him. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Haalleluuyaa. Faarfannaa haaraa Waaqayyoof faarfadhaa; waldaa qulqullootaa keessatti illee isa jajadhaa.
english: Praise the LORD! Sing to the LORD a new song, his praise in the assembly of the saints.

kikuyu: Israaʼel Uumaa isaatti haa gammadu; sabni Xiyoon Mootii isaatti haa gammadu.
english: Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

kikuyu: Maqaa isaas shuubbisuudhaan haa jajatu; dibbee fi baganaadhaan isaaf haa faarfatu.
english: Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

kikuyu: Waaqayyo saba isaatti ni gammadaatii; warra gad of qabanis fayyina gonfachiisa.
english: For the LORD takes pleasure in his people. He crowns the humble with salvation.

kikuyu: Qulqulloonni ulfina kanatti haa gammadan; siree isaanii irrattis gammachuudhaan haa faarfatan.
english: Let the saints rejoice in honor. Let them sing for joy on their beds.

kikuyu: Galanni Waaqaa afaan isaanii keessa haa jiraatu; goraadeen afaan lamaas harka isaanii keessa haa jiraattu;
english: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a two-edged sword in their hand,

kikuyu: kunis sabootatti haaloo baʼuu fi namoota adabuudhaaf;
english: to execute vengeance on the nations, and punishments on the peoples;

kikuyu: mootota isaanii foncaan, hangafoota isaaniis funyoo sibiilaatiin hidhuudhaaf,
english: to bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

kikuyu: murtii barreeffame sana isaan irratti dhugaa baʼuudhaaf. Kunis amanamtoota isaa hundaaf ulfina. Haalleluuyaa.
english: to execute on them the written judgment. All his saints have this honor. Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Haalleluuyaa. Mana qulqullummaa isaa keessatti Waaqa galateeffadhaa; samiiwwan isaa humna qabeeyyii keessattis isa galateeffadhaa.
english: Praise the LORD! Praise God in his sanctuary! Praise him in his heavens for his acts of power!

kikuyu: Hojiiwwan isaa jajjaboo sanaaf isa leellisaa; guddina isaa hamma hin qabne sanaaf isa leellisaa.
english: Praise him for his mighty acts! Praise him according to his excellent greatness!

kikuyu: Malakata afuufuudhaan isa galateeffadhaa; baganaa fi kiraaraan isa galateeffadhaa;
english: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!

kikuyu: dibbeedhaan shuubbisaatii isa jajadhaa; miʼa ribuutii fi ululleedhaan isa jajadhaa.
english: Praise him with tambourine and dancing! Praise him with stringed instruments and flute!

kikuyu: Kilillee sagalee qabuun isa jajadhaa; kilillee sagalee guddaatiin isa jajadhaa.
english: Praise him with loud cymbals! Praise him with resounding cymbals!

kikuyu: Wanni hafuura baafatu hundinuu Waaqayyoon haa jajatu. Haalleluuyaa.
english: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Praise the LORD!

kikuyu: Fakkeenya Solomoon Ilma Daawit, mootii Israaʼel:
english: The proverbs of Solomon, the son of David, king of Israel:

kikuyu: Ogummaa fi qajeelfama qabaachuudhaaf, dubbii beekumsa guddaa hubachuudhaaf;
english: to know wisdom and instruction; to discern the words of understanding;

kikuyu: ogummaadhaan jiraachuudhaan, qajeelummaadhaan, murtii qajeelaa kennuu fi nama wal qixxeessuudhaan qajeelfama argachuudhaaf;
english: to receive instruction in wise dealing, in righteousness, justice, and equity;

kikuyu: warra waa hin beekneef of eeggannoo kennuudhaaf, dargaggootaaf immoo beekumsaa fi hubannaa kennuudhaaf,
english: to give prudence to the simple, knowledge and discretion to the young man—

kikuyu: ogeeyyiin dhaggeeffatanii barumsa isaanii irratti waa haa dabalatan; warri qalbii qabanis qajeelfama haa argatan;
english: that the wise man may hear, and increase in learning; that the man of understanding may attain to sound counsel;

kikuyu: kunis fakkeenyaa fi hiikkaa, jechaa fi hibboo ogeeyyii hubachuudhaaf.
english: to understand a proverb and parables, the words and riddles of the wise.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon sodaachuun jalqaba ogummaa ti; gowwoonni garuu ogummaa fi adabamuu tuffatu.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of knowledge, but the foolish despise wisdom and instruction.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, gorsa abbaa keetii dhaggeeffadhu; barsiisa haadha keetii illee hin gatin.
english: My son, listen to your father’s instruction, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching;

kikuyu: Wanni kun mataa kee miidhagsuudhaaf gonfoo, morma kee bareechuudhaaf immoo faaya siif taʼa.
english: for they will be a garland to grace your head, and chains around your neck.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, yoo cubbamoonni sossobanii ofitti si harkisan, tole hin jedhiniif.
english: My son, if sinners entice you, don’t consent.

kikuyu: Yoo isaan, “Nu wajjin kottu; riphnee dhiiga namaa dhangalaasnaa; nama balleessaa hin qabne galaafachuudhaafis dhokannee eeggannaa;
english: If they say, “Come with us. Let’s lie in wait for blood. Let’s lurk secretly for the innocent without cause.

kikuyu: kottu akkuma awwaalaa jiraatti isaan liqimsinaa; akkuma warra boolla keessa buufamaniis guutumaan guutuutti isaan liqimsinaa;
english: Let’s swallow them up alive like Sheol, and whole, like those who go down into the pit.

kikuyu: nu waan gatii qabu kan gosa hundaa ni arganna; manneen keenya illee boojuudhaan guuttanna;
english: We’ll find all valuable wealth. We’ll fill our houses with plunder.

kikuyu: ixaa kee nu wajjin buufadhu; nus korojoo tokko si wajjin qooddannaa” siin jedhan,
english: You shall cast your lot among us. We’ll all have one purse”—

kikuyu: yaa ilma ko, ati isaan wajjin hin deemin; miilla keetiin karaa isaanii irra illee hin ejjetin;
english: my son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,

kikuyu: miilli isaanii cubbuutti ariifataatii; isaan dhiiga dhangalaasuuf jarjaru.
english: for their feet run to evil. They hurry to shed blood.

kikuyu: Utuma simbirroonni hundi arganuu, kiyyoo buusuun waan gatii hin qabnee dha!
english: For the net is spread in vain in the sight of any bird;

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen dhiiguma ofii isaanii riphanii eeggatu; lubbuma ofii isaanii gaadu!
english: but these lay in wait for their own blood. They lurk secretly for their own lives.

kikuyu: Kun dhuma warra qabeenya karaa hamaadhaan argamu duukaa buʼan hundaa ti; wanni akkasii jireenya warra isa argatanii balleessa.
english: So are the ways of everyone who is greedy for gain. It takes away the life of its owners.

kikuyu: Ogummaan karaa irratti guddiftee iyyiti; iddoo wal gaʼii uummataattis sagalee ishee ol fudhatti.
english: Wisdom calls aloud in the street. She utters her voice in the public squares.

kikuyu: Isheen fiixee daandii irraa iyyiti; karra magaalaa duraas akkana jettee dubbatti:
english: She calls at the head of noisy places. At the entrance of the city gates, she utters her words:

kikuyu: “Isin warri homaa hin beekne kun hamma yoomiitti karaa keessan kan faayidaa hin qabne sana jaallattu? Warri namatti qoosan hamma yoomiitti qoosaa sanatti gammadanii gowwoonnis beekumsa jibbu?
english: “How long, you simple ones, will you love simplicity? How long will mockers delight themselves in mockery, and fools hate knowledge?

kikuyu: Mormii koo qalbeeffadhaa; ani yaada koo isinii nan dhangalaasa; dubbii koos isiniifin ibsa.
english: Turn at my reproof. Behold, I will pour out my spirit on you. I will make known my words to you.

kikuyu: Garuu sababii isin yeroo ani isin waametti diddanii yeroo ani harka balʼifadhetti namni tokko iyyuu na hin dhaggeeffatiniif,
english: Because I have called, and you have refused; I have stretched out my hand, and no one has paid attention;

kikuyu: waan isin gorsa koo hunda tuffattanii dheekkamsa koo dhagaʼuu diddaniif,
english: but you have ignored all my counsel, and wanted none of my reproof;

kikuyu: anis badiisa keessanitti nan kolfa, yeroo balaan isinitti dhufuttis nan qoosa;
english: I also will laugh at your disaster. I will mock when calamity overtakes you,

kikuyu: yeroo balaan akkuma bubbeetti isin fudhatutti, yeroo badiisni akkuma bubbee hamaatti isin haxaaʼutti, yeroo dhiphinaa fi rakkinni isinitti dhufutti ani isinittan qoosa.
english: when calamity overtakes you like a storm, when your disaster comes on like a whirlwind, when distress and anguish come on you.

kikuyu: “Yeroo sana isaan na waammatu; ani garuu isaan jalaa hin owwaadhu; isaan na barbaadu; garuu na hin argatan.
english: Then they will call on me, but I will not answer. They will seek me diligently, but they will not find me,

kikuyu: Isaan waan beekumsa jibbanii Waaqayyoon sodaachuu illee filachuu didaniif,
english: because they hated knowledge, and didn’t choose the fear of the LORD.

kikuyu: waan gorsa koo fudhachuu didanii dheekkamsa koos tuffataniif,
english: They wanted none of my counsel. They despised all my reproof.

kikuyu: isaan gatii karaa isaanii ni nyaatu; buʼaa jalʼina isaaniis ni quufu.
english: Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.

kikuyu: Gowwoota waa dagachuutu isaan balleessaatii; quufni gowwootaa isaanuma balleessa;
english: For the backsliding of the simple will kill them. The careless ease of fools will destroy them.

kikuyu: namni na dhaggeeffatu kam iyyuu garuu nagaadhaan jiraata; inni qabbanaan jiraata; wanni hamaanis isa hin sodaachisu.”
english: But whoever listens to me will dwell securely, and will be at ease, without fear of harm.”

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, yoo ati dubbii koo fudhattee ajaja koos of keessatti kuufatte,
english: My son, if you will receive my words, and store up my commandments within you,

kikuyu: yoo ati gurra kee ogummaatti garagalfattee yaada kee hubannaatti deebifatte,
english: so as to turn your ear to wisdom, and apply your heart to understanding;

kikuyu: yoo ati jabaattee qalbeeffannaa barbaaddee hubannaa argachuuf jettee iyyitee kadhatte,
english: yes, if you call out for discernment, and lift up your voice for understanding;

kikuyu: yoo ati akkuma meetiitti isa barbaaddattee akkuma qabeenya dhokfameetti isa barbaadde,
english: if you seek her as silver, and search for her as for hidden treasures;

kikuyu: ati Waaqayyoon sodaachuu ni hubatta; Waaqa beekuus ni argatta.
english: then you will understand the fear of the LORD, and find the knowledge of God.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo ogummaa namaa kennaatii; afaan isaa keessaa illee beekumsaa fi hubannaatu baʼa.
english: For the LORD gives wisdom. Out of his mouth comes knowledge and understanding.

kikuyu: Inni qajeeltotaaf ogummaa dhugaa kuusa; warra adeemsi isaanii mudaa hin qabneef gaachana;
english: He lays up sound wisdom for the upright. He is a shield to those who walk in integrity,

kikuyu: inni daandii tolootaa ni eega; karaa qulqulloota isaa illee ni tiksa.
english: that he may guard the paths of justice, and preserve the way of his saints.

kikuyu: Ergasii ati qajeelummaa fi murtii qajeelaa, nama wal qixxeessuu, karaa qajeelaa hundas ni hubatta.
english: Then you will understand righteousness and justice, equity and every good path.

kikuyu: Ogummaan garaa kee seena; beekumsis lubbuu kee gammachiisa.
english: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.

kikuyu: Qalbeeffannaan si eega; hubannaanis si tiksa.
english: Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,

kikuyu: Ogummaan karaa hamootaa irraa, namoota daba dubbatan jalaas si baraara;
english: to deliver you from the way of evil, from the men who speak perverse things,

kikuyu: warra karaa dukkanaa irra deemuudhaaf jedhanii daandii qajeelaa dhiisan,
english: who forsake the paths of uprightness, to walk in the ways of darkness,

kikuyu: warra waan hamaa hojjechuutti gammadan, warra jalʼina hojjechuun itti tolu,
english: who rejoice to do evil, and delight in the perverseness of evil,

kikuyu: warra daandiin isaanii jalʼate, warra karaan isaanii dabe jalaa si baraara.
english: who are crooked in their ways, and wayward in their paths,

kikuyu: Ogummaatu dubartii ganda labee, niitii dubbiidhaan sossobdee ofitti nama harkiftu jalaa si baraara;
english: to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,

kikuyu: niitii dhirsa ishee kan jalqabaa dhiiftee kakuu fuula Waaqaa duratti galte sana dagatte jalaa si baraara.
english: who forsakes the friend of her youth, and forgets the covenant of her God;

kikuyu: Manni ishee gara duʼaatti, karaan ishee immoo gara hafuurota warra duʼaniitti nama geessaatii.
english: for her house leads down to death, her paths to the departed spirits.

kikuyu: Namni gara ishee dhaqu tokko iyyuu hin deebiʼu yookaan karaa jireenyaa hin argatu.
english: None who go to her return again, neither do they attain to the paths of life.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ati karaa namoota gaggaarii irra ni deemta; daandii qajeeltotaa irraas hin jalʼattu.
english: Therefore walk in the way of good men, and keep the paths of the righteous.

kikuyu: Toloonni biyyattii keessa ni jiraatuutii; warri mudaa hin qabnes achi keessa jiraatu;
english: For the upright will dwell in the land. The perfect will remain in it.

kikuyu: hamoonni garuu biyyattii keessaa ni balleeffamu; warri hin amanamnes ishee keessaa buqqifamu.
english: But the wicked will be cut off from the land. The treacherous will be rooted out of it.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, barumsa ani siif kennu hin dagatin; ajaja koos garaatti qabadhu;
english: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

kikuyu: isaan bara baayʼee fi umurii dheeraa, nagaa fi badhaadhummaa siif dabaluutii.
english: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

kikuyu: Jaalallii fi amanamummaan yoom iyyuu sirraa hin fagaatin; morma keetti hidhadhu; gabatee garaa kee irrattis barreeffadhu.
english: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

kikuyu: Ati karaa kanaan fuula Waaqaatii fi fuula namaa duratti surraa fi maqaa gaarii ni argatta.
english: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

kikuyu: Garaa kee guutuun Waaqayyoon amanadhu; hubannaa kees hin abdatin;
english: Trust in the LORD with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

kikuyu: karaa kee hunda keessatti isa dursi; innis daandii kee siif qajeelcha.
english: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

kikuyu: Ani ogeessa ofiin hin jedhin; Waaqayyoon sodaadhu; waan hamaa irraas fagaadhu.
english: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear the LORD, and depart from evil.

kikuyu: Wanni kun dhagna keetiif fayyaa kenna; lafee kee illee ni haaromsa.
english: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

kikuyu: Qabeenya keetiin, mataa midhaan keetii hundaanis Waaqayyoon kabaji;
english: Honor the LORD with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

kikuyu: yoos gombisaan kee hamma irraan dhangalaʼutti guutama; iddoon cuunfaa wayinii keetiis daadhiidhaan guutamee irraan dhangalaʼa.
english: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, adabbii Waaqayyoo hin tuffatin; dheekkamsa isaas hin jibbin.
english: My son, don’t despise the LORD’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akkuma abbaa ilma ofii isaa jaallatu tokkootti warra jaallatu ni adabaatii.
english: for whom the LORD loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

kikuyu: Namni ogummaa argatu kan hubannaas argatu eebbifamaa dha;
english: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

kikuyu: ogummaan meetii caalaa faayidaa qabaatii; warqee caalaas buʼaa namaaf buusa.
english: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

kikuyu: Gatiin ishee gatii lula diimaa caala; wanni ati akka malee hawwitu kam iyyuu isheedhaan wal qixxaachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

kikuyu: Jireenyi dheeraan harka ishee mirgaa keessa jira; badhaadhummaa fi ulfinni harka ishee bitaa keessa jiru.
english: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

kikuyu: Karaan ishee karaa nama gammachiisuu dha; daandiin ishee hundis nagaa dha.
english: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

kikuyu: Isheen warra jabeessanii ishee qabataniif muka jireenyaa ti; warri itti cichanii ishee qabatan immoo ni eebbifamu.
english: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo ogummaadhaan hundee lafaa buuse; hubannaadhaanis samiiwwan iddoo isaanii kaaʼe;
english: By wisdom the LORD founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

kikuyu: beekumsa isaatiin tuujubawwan gargar qoodaman; duumessoonnis fixeensa coccobsan.
english: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko ogummaa fi hubannaa dhugaa eeggadhu; isaanis fuula kee duraa hin dhabamin;
english: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

kikuyu: isaan jireenya siif taʼu; morma kee miidhagsuufis faaya mormaa siif taʼu.
english: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

kikuyu: Yoos ati karaa kee nagumaan deemta; miilli kees hin gufatu;
english: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

kikuyu: ati yoo raftu hin sodaattu; hirribni kees yoo ati raftu sitti miʼaawa.
english: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

kikuyu: Balaa akkuma tasaa sitti dhufu yookaan badiisa hamoota galaafatu hin sodaatin;
english: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

kikuyu: Waaqayyo irkoo siif taʼaatii; akka miilli kee kiyyoodhaan hin qabamnes si eega.
english: for the LORD will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

kikuyu: Ati yeroo waan tokko gochuudhaaf aangoo qabdutti, warra wanni gaariin isaaniif malu irraa waan sana hin hanqisin.
english: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

kikuyu: Utuu amma waa qabduu, ollaa keetiin, “Yeroo biraa deebiʼii kottu; ani bori siifin kennaatii” hin jedhin.
english: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

kikuyu: Ollaa kee kan si amanee si cina jiraatu miidhuuf jettee waan hamaa itti hin yaadin.
english: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

kikuyu: Nama tokko utuu inni homaa si hin godhin akkasumaan hin miidhin.
english: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

kikuyu: Nama dabaatti hin hinaafin; yookaan karaa isaa tokko illee hin filatin.
english: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo nama jalʼaa ni jibbaatii; nama qajeelaa garuu ofitti aanfata.
english: For the perverse is an abomination to the LORD, but his friendship is with the upright.

kikuyu: Abaarsi Waaqayyoo mana nama hamaa irra buʼa; inni garuu mana nama qajeelaa ni eebbisa.
english: The LORD’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

kikuyu: Inni qoostota of tuultotatti ni qoosa; warra gad of qabaniif immoo ayyaana kenna.
english: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

kikuyu: Ogeeyyiin ulfina dhaalu; gowwoota garuu inni ni qaanessa.
english: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.

kikuyu: Yaa ilmaan ko, mee gorsa abbaan namaaf kennu dhagaʼaa; qalbeeffadhaatii hubannaa argadhaa.
english: Listen, sons, to a father’s instruction. Pay attention and know understanding;

kikuyu: Ani barumsa gaarii isinii nan kenna; kanaafuu barsiisa koo hin dhiisinaa.
english: for I give you sound learning. Don’t forsake my law.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani mucaa xinnaa taʼee mana abbaa koo turetti, yeroo ani daaʼima dhiiga taʼee haadha kootiif ilma tokkicha turetti,
english: For I was a son to my father, tender and an only child in the sight of my mother.

kikuyu: inni akkana jedhee na barsiise; “Garaa kee guutuudhaan dubbii koo jabeessii qabadhu; seera koo eegi; ati ni jiraattaatii.
english: He taught me, and said to me: “Let your heart retain my words. Keep my commandments, and live.

kikuyu: Ogummaa argadhu; hubannaas argadhu; dubbii koo hin dagatin yookaan irraa hin jalʼatin.
english: Get wisdom. Get understanding. Don’t forget, and don’t deviate from the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Ogummaa hin dhiisin; isheen si eegdii; ishee jaalladhu; isheenis si tiksitii.
english: Don’t forsake her, and she will preserve you. Love her, and she will keep you.

kikuyu: Ogummaan waan hunda caalti; kanaafuu ogummaa argadhu. Yoo isheen waan ati qabdu hunda si baasifte illee hubannaa argadhu.
english: Wisdom is supreme. Get wisdom. Yes, though it costs all your possessions, get understanding.

kikuyu: Ogummaa kabaji; inni ol si guddisaatii; isa hammadhu; innis si kabajaatii.
english: Esteem her, and she will exalt you. She will bring you to honor when you embrace her.

kikuyu: Isheen kallacha bareedaa mataa kee irra siif keessi; gonfoo miidhagaa illee siif kenniti.”
english: She will give to your head a garland of grace. She will deliver a crown of splendor to you.”

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko dhagaʼi; waan ani jedhu illee fudhadhu; barri jireenya keetiis ni baayʼataa.
english: Listen, my son, and receive my sayings. The years of your life will be many.

kikuyu: Ani karaa ogummaa irra sin qajeelcha; daandii qajeelaa irras sin buusa.
english: I have taught you in the way of wisdom. I have led you in straight paths.

kikuyu: Yeroo ati deemtu, tarkaanfiin kee hin ittifamu; yoo fiigdu illee ati hin gufattu.
english: When you go, your steps will not be hampered. When you run, you will not stumble.

kikuyu: Qajeelfama jabeessii qabadhu; gad hin dhiisin; waan inni jireenya kee taʼeef jabeessii eeggadhu.
english: Take firm hold of instruction. Don’t let her go. Keep her, for she is your life.

kikuyu: Daandii hamootaa irra miilla kee hin dhaabin yookaan karaa jalʼootaa irra hin deemin.
english: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.

kikuyu: Irraa fagaadhu; irras hin deemin; irraa goriitii karaa kee irra qajeeli.
english: Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.

kikuyu: Isaan waan hamaa hojjetan malee rafuu hin dandaʼaniitii; isaan hamma nama gufachiisanitti hirriba hin argatan.
english: For they don’t sleep unless they do evil. Their sleep is taken away, unless they make someone fall.

kikuyu: Isaan buddeena hamminaa nyaatu; daadhii wayinii kan dabaan argame dhugu.
english: For they eat the bread of wickedness and drink the wine of violence.

kikuyu: Karaan qajeeltotaa akkuma ifa barii barraaqaa kan hamma saafaatti ittuma fufee ifaa deemuu ti.
english: But the path of the righteous is like the dawning light that shines more and more until the perfect day.

kikuyu: Karaan hamootaa garuu akkuma dukkana guddaa ti; isaan waan isaan gufachiisu hin beekan.
english: The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, waan ani jedhu qalbeeffadhu; dubbii kootiifis gurra kenni.
english: My son, attend to my words. Turn your ear to my sayings.

kikuyu: Akka inni fuula kee duraa dhabamu hin godhin; garaa kee keessa ol kaaʼadhu;
english: Let them not depart from your eyes. Keep them in the center of your heart.

kikuyu: inni warra isa argatuuf jireenya, dhagna namaa guutuufis fayyinaatii.
english: For they are life to those who find them, and health to their whole body.

kikuyu: Waan hunda caalaa qalbii kee eeggadhu; burqaan jireenyaa achii baʼaatii.
english: Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.

kikuyu: Dubbii jalʼinaa afaan kee keessaa balleessi; haasaa hamaas arraba kee irraa fageessi.
english: Put away from yourself a perverse mouth. Put corrupt lips far from you.

kikuyu: Iji kee kallattiidhaan qajeelchee haa ilaalu; atis xiyyeeffadhuu fuula kee dura ilaali.
english: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.

kikuyu: Miilla keetiif daandii wal qixxeeffadhu; karaan kee hundinuu haa jabaatu.
english: Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.

kikuyu: Gara mirgaatti yookaan gara bitaatti hin gorin; miilla kee hammina irraa eeggadhu.
english: Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, ogummaa koo qalbeeffadhu; hubannaa kootiif illee gurra kenni;
english: My son, pay attention to my wisdom. Turn your ear to my understanding,

kikuyu: kunis akka ati hubannaa turfattee arrabni kees beekumsa kuufattuuf.
english: that you may maintain discretion, that your lips may preserve knowledge.

kikuyu: Hidhiin ejjituu damma coccobsa; haasaan ishee zayitii caalaa lallaafa;
english: For the lips of an adulteress drip honey. Her mouth is smoother than oil,

kikuyu: dhuma irratti garuu isheen akkuma hadhooftuu hadhoofti; akkuma goraadee afaan lamaas qara qabeettii dha.
english: but in the end she is as bitter as wormwood, and as sharp as a two-edged sword.

kikuyu: Miilli ishee gara duʼaatti gad buʼa; tarkaanfiin ishee awwaalatti nama geessa.
english: Her feet go down to death. Her steps lead straight to Sheol.

kikuyu: Isheen waaʼee karaa jireenyaa dhimma hin qabdu; daandiin ishee jalʼaa dha; isheen garuu kana hin beektu.
english: She gives no thought to the way of life. Her ways are crooked, and she doesn’t know it.

kikuyu: Egaa yaa ilmaan ko, mee na dhagaʼaa; waan ani jedhu irraa gara kamitti iyyuu hin gorinaa.
english: Now therefore, my sons, listen to me. Don’t depart from the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Karaa keessan ishee irraa fageeffadhaa; balbala mana isheetti hin dhiʼaatinaa;
english: Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,

kikuyu: kunis akka ati ulfina kee nama biraatiif, umurii kees nama namaaf hin naaneef hin kennineef;
english: lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;

kikuyu: akkasumas qabeenya kee ormatu nyaata; dadhabbiin kees mana alagaa badhaasa.
english: lest strangers feast on your wealth, and your labors enrich another man’s house.

kikuyu: Dhuma jireenya keetiitti, yeroo foonii fi dhagni kee dhumutti ati ni aadda.
english: You will groan at your latter end, when your flesh and your body are consumed,

kikuyu: Atis akkana jetta; “Ani akkamittin adabamuu jibbee! Garaan koos akkam sirreeffamuu tuffate!
english: and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof.

kikuyu: Ani barsiistota kootiif hin ajajamne yookaan qajeelchitoota koo hin dhaggeeffanne.
english: I haven’t obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!

kikuyu: Ani waldaa guutuu gidduutti qarqara badiisaa gaʼeen ture.”
english: I have come to the brink of utter ruin, among the gathered assembly.”

kikuyu: Eela kee keessaa bishaan, boolla bishaanii kee keessaa immoo bishaan qulqulluu dhugi.
english: Drink water out of your own cistern, running water out of your own well.

kikuyu: Burqaan kee guutee daandii irra, bishaan kee kan yaaʼus oobdii keessa dhangalaʼuu qabaa?
english: Should your springs overflow in the streets, streams of water in the public squares?

kikuyu: Isaan kan kee haa taʼan; ormi si wajjin qooddachuu hin qabu.
english: Let them be for yourself alone, not for strangers with you.

kikuyu: Burqaan kee haa eebbifamu; niitii dargaggummaa keetiitti gammadi.
english: Let your spring be blessed. Rejoice in the wife of your youth.

kikuyu: Isheen miidhagduu akka borofaa, bareedduu akka gadamsaa ti; harmi ishee yeroo hunda sitti haa tolu; yeroo hunda jaalalli ishee si haa boojiʼu.
english: A loving doe and a graceful deer— let her breasts satisfy you at all times. Be captivated always with her love.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, ati maaliif ejjituudhaan boojiʼamta? Maaliif bobaa niitii nama biraa hammatta?
english: For why should you, my son, be captivated with an adulteress? Why embrace the bosom of another?

kikuyu: Karaan namaa guutumaan guutuutti fuula Waaqayyoo dura jiraatii; innis daandii namaa hunda ni toʼata.
english: For the ways of man are before the LORD’s eyes. He examines all his paths.

kikuyu: Balleessaan nama hamaa isuma qabaata; funyoon cubbuu isaa jabeessee isa qaba.
english: The evil deeds of the wicked ensnare him. The cords of his sin hold him firmly.

kikuyu: Inni sababii adabamuu dhabeef duʼa; guddinni gowwummaa isaas karaa irraa isa balleessa.
english: He will die for lack of instruction. In the greatness of his folly, he will go astray.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, ati yoo ollaa keetiif wabii taatee harka dhooftee nama ormaatiif kakatte,
english: My son, if you have become collateral for your neighbor, if you have struck your hands in pledge for a stranger,

kikuyu: yoo waanuma dubbatteen qabamtee dubbuma afaan keetiitiin kiyyoo seente,
english: you are trapped by the words of your mouth; you are ensnared with the words of your mouth.

kikuyu: yoos yaa ilma ko, ati sababii harka ollaa keetii seentee jirtuuf ati of baasuudhaaf dafii dhaqiitii gad of qabii jabeessiitii ollaa kee kadhadhu!
english: Do this now, my son, and deliver yourself, since you have come into the hand of your neighbor. Go, humble yourself. Press your plea with your neighbor.

kikuyu: Ija keetiif hirriba, baallee ija keetiitiif immoo mugaatii hin eeyyamin.
english: Give no sleep to your eyes, nor slumber to your eyelids.

kikuyu: Ati akkuma kuruphee harka adamsituutii baatuutti, akkuma simbirroo kiyyoo nama ishee qabuu jalaa baatuutti of oolchi.
english: Free yourself, like a gazelle from the hand of the hunter, like a bird from the snare of the fowler.

kikuyu: Yaa dhibaaʼaa nana mee gara goondaa dhaqi; karaa ishee qalbeeffadhuutii ogeessa taʼi!
english: Go to the ant, you sluggard. Consider her ways, and be wise;

kikuyu: Inni ajajaa hin qabu; toʼataa yookaan bulchaa hin qabu;
english: which having no chief, overseer, or ruler,

kikuyu: taʼu illee inni bona keessa nyaata isaa kuufata; yeroo midhaan galfamutti immoo nyaata isaa walitti qabata.
english: provides her bread in the summer, and gathers her food in the harvest.

kikuyu: Yaa dhibaaʼaa nana, ati hamma yoomiitti ciifta? Ati yoomi hirriba keetii kaata?
english: How long will you sleep, sluggard? When will you arise out of your sleep?

kikuyu: Hirriba xinnaa, mugaatii xinnaa, xinnoo harka walitti marachuu,
english: A little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep—

kikuyu: hiyyummaanis akkuma hattuutti sitti dhufa; deegummaanis akkuma loltuu hidhateetti sitti dhufa.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber, and your scarcity as an armed man.

kikuyu: Namni rakkisaan, namni hamaan, dubbii sobaatiin asii fi achi naannaʼa;
english: A worthless person, a man of iniquity, is he who walks with a perverse mouth,

kikuyu: inni ijaan dhaʼa; miilla isaatiinis mallattoo kenna; quba isaatiin argisiisa;
english: who winks with his eyes, who signals with his feet, who motions with his fingers,

kikuyu: inni garaa isaa isa sobaadhaan hammina yaada; yeroo hundas lola kakaasa.
english: in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu badiisni yommusuma isatti dhufa; inni akkuma tasaa caba; deebiʼees hin fayyu.
english: Therefore his calamity will come suddenly. He will be broken suddenly, and that without remedy.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo waan jaʼa jibba; waan torba immoo ni xireeffata; isaanis:
english: There are six things which the LORD hates; yes, seven which are an abomination to him:

kikuyu: Ija of tuulu, arraba sobu, harka dhiiga nama balleessaa hin qabnee dhangalaasu,
english: arrogant eyes, a lying tongue, hands that shed innocent blood,

kikuyu: garaa mala hamaa malu, miilla gara jalʼinaatti ariifatu,
english: a heart that devises wicked schemes, feet that are swift in running to mischief,

kikuyu: dhuga baatuu sobaa kan soba dhangalaasu, nama obboloota gidduutti lola kakaasuu dha.
english: a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, ajaja abbaa keetii eegi; barsiisa haadha keetii illee hin gatin.
english: My son, keep your father’s commandment, and don’t forsake your mother’s teaching.

kikuyu: Bara baraan garaa keetti qabadhu; morma keettis hidhadhu.
english: Bind them continually on your heart. Tie them around your neck.

kikuyu: Yeroo ati deemtu isaan si qajeelchu; yeroo ati raftu si eegu; yeroo ati hirribaa kaatu illee si haasofsiisu.
english: When you walk, it will lead you. When you sleep, it will watch over you. When you awake, it will talk with you.

kikuyu: Ajajni kun ibsaadhaatii; barsiisni kunis ifa; sirreeffamni amalaa immoo karaa jireenyaa ti;
english: For the commandment is a lamp, and the law is light. Reproofs of instruction are the way of life,

kikuyu: isaan dubartii hamtuu irraa, niitii kashlabbee afaan dammaa irraa si eegu.
english: to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.

kikuyu: Garaa kee keessatti bareedina ishee hin dharraʼin; yookaan akka isheen ija isheetiin si boojitu hin godhin.
english: Don’t lust after her beauty in your heart, neither let her captivate you with her eyelids.

kikuyu: Sagaagaltuun buddeena tokkoon bitamtiitii; ejjituunis jireenyuma kee adamsiti.
english: For a prostitute reduces you to a piece of bread. The adulteress hunts for your precious life.

kikuyu: Namni bobaa jalatti ibidda baadhatee wayyaan isaa hin gubanne jiraa?
english: Can a man scoop fire into his lap, and his clothes not be burned?

kikuyu: Namni ibidda cilee irra ejjetee miilli isaa hin gubanne jiraa?
english: Or can one walk on hot coals, and his feet not be scorched?

kikuyu: Namni niitii nama biraa wajjin ciisus akkasuma taʼa; namni ishee tuqu kam iyyuu utuu hin adabamin hin hafu.
english: So is he who goes in to his neighbor’s wife. Whoever touches her will not be unpunished.

kikuyu: Yoo hattuun tokko beela baʼuuf jedhee hate, namoonni hin tuffatan.
english: Men don’t despise a thief if he steals to satisfy himself when he is hungry,

kikuyu: Garuu inni yoo qabame dachaa torba baasa; miʼa mana isaa hundas ni kenna.
english: but if he is found, he shall restore seven times. He shall give all the wealth of his house.

kikuyu: Namni sagaagalu qalbii hin qabu; namni waan akkasii hojjetu ofuma galaafata.
english: He who commits adultery with a woman is void of understanding. He who does it destroys his own soul.

kikuyu: Qoodni isaa dhaanamuu fi salphachuu dha; qaaniin isaa yoom iyyuu isa irraa hin haqamu.
english: He will get wounds and dishonor. His reproach will not be wiped away.

kikuyu: Hinaaffaan aarii dhirsaa kakaasaatii; inni yeroo haaloo baʼutti dhiifama tokko iyyuu hin godhu.
english: For jealousy arouses the fury of the husband. He won’t spare in the day of vengeance.

kikuyu: Inni beenyaa tokko illee hin fudhatu; hammam baayʼatu iyyuu inni mattaʼaa ni dida.
english: He won’t regard any ransom, neither will he rest content, though you give many gifts.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, dubbii koo eegiitii ajaja koos of keessatti kuufadhu.
english: My son, keep my words. Lay up my commandments within you.

kikuyu: Ajaja koo eegi, ati ni jiraataatii; barsiisa koos akkuma qaroo ija keetiitti eegi.
english: Keep my commandments and live! Guard my teaching as the apple of your eye.

kikuyu: Quba keetti isaan hidhadhu; gabatee garaa keetii irrattis barreeffadhu.
english: Bind them on your fingers. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

kikuyu: Ogummaan, “Ati obboleettii koo ti” jedhi; hubannaa immoo, fira koo jedhii waami;
english: Tell wisdom, “You are my sister.” Call understanding your relative,

kikuyu: isaan sagaagaltuu irraa, niitii kashlabbee dubbii isheetiin nama harkiftu irraa si eegu.
english: that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.

kikuyu: Ani foddaa mana koo biraa keessaan, karaa qaawwaatiin ala ilaale.
english: For at the window of my house, I looked out through my lattice.

kikuyu: Ani warra homaa hin dandeenye keessatti, dargaggoota keessatti hubadhee dargaggeessa qalbii hin qabne tokko arge.
english: I saw among the simple ones. I discerned among the youths a young man void of understanding,

kikuyu: Innis karaa mana ishee dhaqu qabatee daandii golee mana ishee bira jiruutiin gad buʼaa ture.
english: passing through the street near her corner, he went the way to her house,

kikuyu: Kunis yeroo aduun dhiitee lafti dimimmisaaʼaa turetti, yeroo halkan dukkanaaʼuu jalqabetti ture.
english: in the twilight, in the evening of the day, in the middle of the night and in the darkness.

kikuyu: Dubartiin tokko akka sagaagaltuutti uffattee yaada haxxummaatiin isa simachuuf gad baate.
english: Behold, there a woman met him with the attire of a prostitute, and with crafty intent.

kikuyu: Isheen iyyituu fi kashlabbee dha; miilli ishee mana hin dhaabatu;
english: She is loud and defiant. Her feet don’t stay in her house.

kikuyu: takka daandii irratti, takka oobdii irratti, golee hundatti riphxee nama eeggatti.
english: Now she is in the streets, now in the squares, and lurking at every corner.

kikuyu: Isheen qabdee isa dhungatti; fuula qaanii hin qabneen akkana jettiin:
english: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

kikuyu: “Ani aarsaa nagaa dhiʼeessuun qaba; harʼa wareega koo guuttadheera.
english: “Sacrifices of peace offerings are with me. Today I have paid my vows.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani si simachuufin gad baʼe; ani barbaadee si argadheera!
english: Therefore I came out to meet you, to diligently seek your face, and I have found you.

kikuyu: Ani wayyaa bareedduu quncee talbaa irraa hojjetame kan Gibxii dhufeen, siree koo afee miidhagseera.
english: I have spread my couch with carpets of tapestry, with striped cloths of the yarn of Egypt.

kikuyu: Ani qumbiin, argeessaa fi qarafaan siree koo urgeesseera.
english: I have perfumed my bed with myrrh, aloes, and cinnamon.

kikuyu: Kottu mee hamma bariitti gad fageenya jaalalaa walii wajjin dhugnaa; kottu jaalalaan of gammachiifnaa!
english: Come, let’s take our fill of loving until the morning. Let’s solace ourselves with loving.

kikuyu: Dhirsi koo mana hin jiru; inni karaa dheeraa deemeera.
english: For my husband isn’t at home. He has gone on a long journey.

kikuyu: Inni boorsaa isaa maallaqaan guuttatee deeme; hamma jiʼi goobanutti manatti hin deebiʼu.”
english: He has taken a bag of money with him. He will come home at the full moon.”

kikuyu: Isheen dubbii miʼooftuudhaan karaa irraa isa jalʼifte; haasaa nama sossobuunis isa dirqisiifte.
english: With persuasive words, she led him astray. With the flattering of her lips, she seduced him.

kikuyu: Innis akkuma sangaa qalamuuf deemuutti, akkuma gadamsa kiyyoo keessa seenuuttis yommusuma kaʼee ishee duukaa buʼe;
english: He followed her immediately, as an ox goes to the slaughter, as a fool stepping into a noose.

kikuyu: akkuma simbira kiyyootti ariifattuutti, inni hamma xiyyi tiruu isaa waraanutti akka wanni kun lubbuu isaa galaafatu hin beeku.
english: Until an arrow strikes through his liver, as a bird hurries to the snare, and doesn’t know that it will cost his life.

kikuyu: Egaa yaa ilmaan ko, na dhaggeeffadhaa; waan ani jedhus qalbeeffadhaa.
english: Now therefore, sons, listen to me. Pay attention to the words of my mouth.

kikuyu: Akka garaan kee karaa isheetti garagalu hin godhin; karaa kee irraas baddee daandii ishee irra hin buʼin.
english: Don’t let your heart turn to her ways. Don’t go astray in her paths,

kikuyu: Namoonni hedduun warra isheen lafaan dhooftee dha; namoonni jajjaboon baayʼeenis harka isheetti dhumaniiru.
english: for she has thrown down many wounded. Yes, all her slain are a mighty army.

kikuyu: Manni ishee karaa qileetti nama geessu, kan gola duʼaatti gad nama buusuu dha.
english: Her house is the way to Sheol, going down to the rooms of death.

kikuyu: Ogummaan hin iyyuu? Hubannaanis sagalee isaa ol hin fudhatuu?
english: Doesn’t wisdom cry out? Doesn’t understanding raise her voice?

kikuyu: Isheen qarqara karaa, lafa ol kaʼaa irra, iddoo daandiin itti wal gaʼu dhaabatti;
english: On the top of high places by the way, where the paths meet, she stands.

kikuyu: karra magaalaatti nama galchu bira, balbala dura dhaabattee akkana jettee iyyiti:
english: Beside the gates, at the entry of the city, at the entry doors, she cries aloud:

kikuyu: “Yaa namoota, ani iyyeen isin waama; ani ilmaan namaa hundatti sagalee koo ol nan fudhadha.
english: “I call to you men! I send my voice to the sons of mankind.

kikuyu: Isin warri homaa hin beekne, qalbii horadhaa; isin warri gowwaan hubannaa argadhaa.
english: You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!

kikuyu: Ani waan faayidaa qabu nan dubbadhaatii, dhagaʼaa; waan qajeelaa dubbachuufis afaan koo nan banadha.
english: Hear, for I will speak excellent things. The opening of my lips is for right things.

kikuyu: Afaan koo dhugaa dubbata; arrabni koo hammina jibbaatii.
english: For my mouth speaks truth. Wickedness is an abomination to my lips.

kikuyu: Dubbiin afaan koo hundinuu qajeelaa dha; dubbii koo keessaa tokko iyyuu jalʼaa yookaan micciiramaa miti.
english: All the words of my mouth are in righteousness. There is nothing crooked or perverse in them.

kikuyu: Nama waa hubatuuf dubbiin koo hundinuu qajeelaa dha; warra beekumsa qabuufis hirʼina hin qabu.
english: They are all plain to him who understands, right to those who find knowledge.

kikuyu: Qooda meetii gorsa koo, warqee qulqulluu caalaas beekumsa filadhu;
english: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.

kikuyu: ogummaan lula diimaa caalaa gatii guddaa qabdii; wanni ati hawwitu tokko iyyuu isheedhaan wal hin madaalu.
english: For wisdom is better than rubies. All the things that may be desired can’t be compared to it.

kikuyu: “Ani ogummaan, qalbii wajjin nan jiraadha; ani beekumsaa fi hubannaa qaba.
english: “I, wisdom, have made prudence my dwelling. Find out knowledge and discretion.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon sodaachuun jibbuu dha; hammina ani of tuulummaa fi of guddisuu, amala hamaa fi haasaa jalʼaa nan jibba.
english: The fear of the LORD is to hate evil. I hate pride, arrogance, the evil way, and the perverse mouth.

kikuyu: Gorsaa fi murtiin dhugaa kan koo ti; ani hubannaa fi humna qaba.
english: Counsel and sound knowledge are mine. I have understanding and power.

kikuyu: Mootonni anaan moʼu; bulchitoonnis anaan seera qajeelaa baasu.
english: By me kings reign, and princes decree justice.

kikuyu: Ilmaan moototaa anaan bulchu; namoonni bebeekamoon hundis anaan biyya bulchu.
english: By me princes rule, nobles, and all the righteous rulers of the earth.

kikuyu: Ani warra na jaallatan nan jaalladha; warri na barbaadanis na argatu.
english: I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.

kikuyu: Soorumnii fi ulfinni, qabeenyii fi badhaadhummaan dhuma hin qabne harkuma koo jiru.
english: With me are riches, honor, enduring wealth, and prosperity.

kikuyu: Iji koo warqee qulqulluu caala; buʼaan narraa argamus meetii filatamaa caala.
english: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.

kikuyu: Ani karaa qajeelummaa irra, daandii qajeelaa irras nan deema;
english: I walk in the way of righteousness, in the middle of the paths of justice,

kikuyu: warra na jaallatutti qabeenya nan dhangalaasa; mankuusa qabeenya isaanii illee nan guuta.
english: that I may give wealth to those who love me. I fill their treasuries.

kikuyu: “Waaqayyo waan bara durii hojjeteen dura, hojii isaa kan jalqabaatiin dura na aanfate;
english: “The LORD possessed me in the beginning of his work, before his deeds of old.

kikuyu: ani utuu addunyaan hin uumamin dura, jalqabumatti, bara hamma hin qabneen dura nan muudame.
english: I was set up from everlasting, from the beginning, before the earth existed.

kikuyu: Ani utuu tuujubni hin jiraatin, utuu burqaawwan bishaaniin hin guutamin dhaladhe;
english: When there were no depths, I was born, when there were no springs abounding with water.

kikuyu: utuu tulluuwwan iddoo isaanii hin dhaabamin dura, ani gaarraniin dura nan dhaladhe;
english: Before the mountains were settled in place, before the hills, I was born;

kikuyu: utuu inni lafa yookaan dirree ishee yookaan biyyoo addunyaa tokko iyyuu hin uumin dura nan dhaladhe.
english: while as yet he had not made the earth, nor the fields, nor the beginning of the dust of the world.

kikuyu: Yeroo inni samiiwwan hundeessetti, yeroo inni dhidhima irra muummee kaaʼetti ani achin ture;
english: When he established the heavens, I was there. When he set a circle on the surface of the deep,

kikuyu: yeroo inni gubbaatti duumessa jabeessee dhaabee madda tuujubaa illee hundeessetti ani achin ture;
english: when he established the clouds above, when the springs of the deep became strong,

kikuyu: yeroo inni akka bishaanonni ajaja isaa hin cabsineef jedhee, galaanaaf daangaa dhaabetti, yeroo inni lafa hundeessetti ani achin ture.
english: when he gave to the sea its boundary, that the waters should not violate his commandment, when he marked out the foundations of the earth,

kikuyu: Yeroo sanatti ani ogeessa hojii harkaa taʼee isa biran ture. Ani yeroo hunda fuula isaa dura burraaqaa, guyyuma guyyaadhaan gammachuudhaan guutamaan ture;
english: then I was the craftsman by his side. I was a delight day by day, always rejoicing before him,

kikuyu: ani guutummaa addunyaa isaa keessatti ililchaa, ilmaan namaatti illee gammadaan ture.
english: rejoicing in his whole world. My delight was with the sons of men.

kikuyu: “Eegaa yaa ilmaan ko, mee na dhagaʼaa; warri karaa koo eegan eebbifamoo dha.
english: “Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.

kikuyu: Gorsa koo dhaggeeffadhaatii ogeeyyii taʼaa; isa hin tuffatinaa.
english: Hear instruction, and be wise. Don’t refuse it.

kikuyu: Namni na dhagaʼu, kan guyyaa hunda balbala koo eegu, kan karra koo dura turu eebbifamaa dha.
english: Blessed is the man who hears me, watching daily at my gates, waiting at my door posts.

kikuyu: Namni na argatu kam iyyuu jireenya argata; Waaqayyo biratti illee fudhatama argata.
english: For whoever finds me finds life, and will obtain favor from the LORD.

kikuyu: Namni na hin arganne garuu ofuma miidha; namni na jibbu hundinuu duʼa jaallata.”
english: But he who sins against me wrongs his own soul. All those who hate me love death.”

kikuyu: Ogummaan mana ishee ijaarratte; utubaa ishee torbanis dhagaa irraa qopheeffate.
english: Wisdom has built her house. She has carved out her seven pillars.

kikuyu: Isheen horii qalattee daadhii wayinii ishee bulbulatte; maaddii ishee illee qopheeffatte.
english: She has prepared her meat. She has mixed her wine. She has also set her table.

kikuyu: Tajaajiltoota ishee dubarran ergattee fiixee magaalaa irraa lallabde.
english: She has sent out her maidens. She cries from the highest places of the city:

kikuyu: Isheen warra qalbii hin qabneen akkana jetti; “Isin warri homaa hin beekne hundi as kottaa!
english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here!” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

kikuyu: Kottaatii nyaata koo nyaadhaa; daadhii wayinii ani bulbuladhe illee dhugaa.
english: “Come, eat some of my bread, Drink some of the wine which I have mixed!

kikuyu: Karaa gowwummaa keessanii sana dhiisaatii jiraadhaa; karaa hubannaa irra deemaa.
english: Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”

kikuyu: “Namni nama namatti qoosu gorsu kam iyyuu ni arrabsama; namni nama hamaa ifatu kam iyyuu ni salphata.
english: One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.

kikuyu: Ati nama namatti qoosu hin ifatin; inni si jibbaatii; nama ogeessa ifadhu; inni si jaallataatii.
english: Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.

kikuyu: Nama ogeessa gorsi; inni ittuma caalchisee ogeessa taʼaa; nama qajeelaaf barumsa kenni; inni beekumsa isaatti dabalaatii.
english: Instruct a wise person, and he will be still wiser. Teach a righteous person, and he will increase in learning.

kikuyu: “Waaqayyoon sodaachuun jalqaba ogummaa ti; isa Qulqulluu Sana beekuun hubannaa dha.
english: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom. The knowledge of the Holy One is understanding.

kikuyu: Karaa kootiin barii jireenya keetii ni dheerata; jireenya kee irrattis waggoonni ni dabalamuutii.
english: For by me your days will be multiplied. The years of your life will be increased.

kikuyu: Yoo ati nama ogeessa taate, ogummaan kee si badhaasa; yoo ati kan namatti qoostu taate suma qofatu gidirama.”
english: If you are wise, you are wise for yourself. If you mock, you alone will bear it.

kikuyu: Dubartiin gowwaan oduu baayʼifti; isheen raatuu homaa hin beeknee dha.
english: The foolish woman is loud, undisciplined, and knows nothing.

kikuyu: Isheen balbala mana ishee dura, fiixee magaalaa gubbaa barcuma irra teessee
english: She sits at the door of her house, on a seat in the high places of the city,

kikuyu: warra achiin darban, kanneen qajeelanii daandii isaanii irra deeman waamti.
english: to call to those who pass by, who go straight on their ways,

kikuyu: Isheen warra qalbii hin qabneen akkana jetti. “Isin warri homaa hin beekne hundi as kottaa!
english: “Whoever is simple, let him turn in here.” As for him who is void of understanding, she says to him,

kikuyu: Bishaan hatan ni miʼaawa; nyaanni dhoksaan nyaatanis guddoo namatti tola!”
english: “Stolen water is sweet. Food eaten in secret is pleasant.”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu akka warri duʼan achi jiran, akka keessumoonni ishee dhidhima awwaalaa keessa jiran illee xinnuma beeku.
english: But he doesn’t know that the departed spirits are there, that her guests are in the depths of Sheol.

kikuyu: Fakkeenyawwan Solomoon: Ilmi ogeessi abbaa isaa gammachiisa; ilmi gowwaan garuu haadha isaa gaddisiisa.
english: The proverbs of Solomon. A wise son makes a glad father; but a foolish son brings grief to his mother.

kikuyu: Qabeenyi karaa hamaadhaan horatan gatii hin qabu; qajeelummaan garuu duʼa jalaa nama baasa.
english: Treasures of wickedness profit nothing, but righteousness delivers from death.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo akka warri qajeelaan beelaʼan hin eeyyamu; hawwii jalʼootaa garuu ni busheessa.
english: The LORD will not allow the soul of the righteous to go hungry, but he thrusts away the desire of the wicked.

kikuyu: Harki hojii hin hojjenne nama hiyyoomsa; harki jabaatee hojii hojjetu garuu nama sooromsa.
english: He becomes poor who works with a lazy hand, but the hand of the diligent brings wealth.

kikuyu: Namni yeroo bonaa midhaan walitti qabatu ilma ogeessa; kan yeroo midhaan galfamutti rafu immoo ilma nama qaanessuu dha.
english: He who gathers in summer is a wise son, but he who sleeps during the harvest is a son who causes shame.

kikuyu: Eebbi mataa qajeeltotaatti gonfoo kaaʼa; afaan hamootaa irra garuu jeequmsatu lolaʼa.
english: Blessings are on the head of the righteous, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Yaadannoon nama qajeelaa eebba taʼa; maqaan nama hamaa garuu lafa irraa bada.
english: The memory of the righteous is blessed, but the name of the wicked will rot.

kikuyu: Namni garaa isaatti ogeessa taʼe ajaja fudhata; gowwaan oduu baayʼisu garuu ni bada.
english: The wise in heart accept commandments, but a chattering fool will fall.

kikuyu: Namni amanamaan sodaa malee deema; kan karaa isaa jalʼisu garuu ni saaxilama.
english: He who walks blamelessly walks surely, but he who perverts his ways will be found out.

kikuyu: Namni ija hamminaatiin waa namaan jedhu rakkoo uuma; gowwaan oduu baayʼisu garuu ni bada.
english: One who winks with the eye causes sorrow, but a chattering fool will fall.

kikuyu: Afaan nama qajeelaa burqaa jireenyaa ti; afaan hamootaa irra garuu jeequmsatu lolaʼa.
english: The mouth of the righteous is a spring of life, but violence covers the mouth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Jibbi lola kakaasa; jaalalli garuu balleessaa hunda haguuga.
english: Hatred stirs up strife, but love covers all wrongs.

kikuyu: Ogummaan hidhii nama waa hubatuu irratti argamti; uleen immoo dirra nama hubannaa hin qabnee irra buʼa.
english: Wisdom is found on the lips of him who has discernment, but a rod is for the back of him who is void of understanding.

kikuyu: Namoonni ogeeyyiin beekumsa kuufatu; afaan gowwaa garuu badiisa waama.
english: Wise men lay up knowledge, but the mouth of the foolish is near ruin.

kikuyu: Qabeenyi sooreyyii isaaniif magaalaa daʼoo qabduu dha; hiyyummaan garuu badiisa hiyyeeyyii ti.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

kikuyu: Mindaan qajeeltotaa jireenya; galiin hamootaa garuu cubbuu fi duʼa.
english: The labor of the righteous leads to life. The increase of the wicked leads to sin.

kikuyu: Namni gorsa fudhatu karaa jireenyaa irra deema; namni adaba didu kam iyyuu garuu warra kaan karaa irraa jalʼisa.
english: He is in the way of life who heeds correction, but he who forsakes reproof leads others astray.

kikuyu: Namni hidhii sobuun jibba dhokfatu, kan maqaa namaa balleessus gowwaa dha.
english: He who hides hatred has lying lips. He who utters a slander is a fool.

kikuyu: Yoo dubbiin baayʼatu, cubbuun keessaa hin dhabamu; namni arraba isaa eeggatu garuu ogeessa.
english: In the multitude of words there is no lack of disobedience, but he who restrains his lips does wisely.

kikuyu: Arrabni nama qajeelaa meetii filatamaa dha; garaan nama hamaa garuu faayidaa xinnoo qaba.
english: The tongue of the righteous is like choice silver. The heart of the wicked is of little worth.

kikuyu: Arrabni nama qajeelaa nama hedduu soora; gowwoonni garuu hubannaa dhabiisaan duʼu.
english: The lips of the righteous feed many, but the foolish die for lack of understanding.

kikuyu: Eebbi Waaqayyoo nama sooromsa; inni rakkina tokko illee itti hin dabalu.
english: The LORD’s blessing brings wealth, and he adds no trouble to it.

kikuyu: Gowwaan amala hamaadhaan gammachuu argata; namni waa hubatu garuu ogummaatti gammada.
english: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.

kikuyu: Wanni namni hamaan sodaatu isumatti dhufa; hawwiin nama qajeelaa immoo ni guutamaaf.
english: What the wicked fear will overtake them, but the desire of the righteous will be granted.

kikuyu: Yeroo bubbeen hamaan bubbisu namoonni hamoon ni badu; qajeeltonni garuu bara baraan jabaatanii jiraatu.
