english: When the whirlwind passes, the wicked is no more; but the righteous stand firm forever.

kikuyu: Akkuma wanni dhangaggaaʼaan ilkaan miidhee, aarris ija miidhu sana namni dhibaaʼaan warra isa ergatu miidha.
english: As vinegar to the teeth, and as smoke to the eyes, so is the sluggard to those who send him.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon sodaachuun bara jireenya namaa dheeressa; umuriin nama hamaa garuu ni gabaabbata.
english: The fear of the LORD prolongs days, but the years of the wicked shall be shortened.

kikuyu: Abdiin nama qajeelaa gammachuu taʼa; wanni namni hamaan eeggatu garuu ni bada.
english: The prospect of the righteous is joy, but the hope of the wicked will perish.

kikuyu: Karaan Waaqayyoo nama qajeelaaf daʼoo dha; nama jalʼaaf garuu badiisa.
english: The way of the LORD is a stronghold to the upright, but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Qajeeltonni yoom iyyuu hin fonqolfaman; hamoonni garuu lafa irratti hin hafan.
english: The righteous will never be removed, but the wicked will not dwell in the land.

kikuyu: Afaan nama qajeelaa ogummaa dubbata; arrabni jalʼaan garuu ni kutama.
english: The mouth of the righteous produces wisdom, but the perverse tongue will be cut off.

kikuyu: Arrabni nama qajeelaa waan fudhatama qabu dubbata; afaan nama hamaa garuu waan jalʼaa qofa dubbata.
english: The lips of the righteous know what is acceptable, but the mouth of the wicked is perverse.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo madaalii hin amanamne ni balfa; madaalii dhugaatti immoo ni gammada.
english: A false balance is an abomination to the LORD, but accurate weights are his delight.

kikuyu: Gaafa of tuuluun dhufu, salphinatu dhufa; gad of qabiisa wajjin immoo ogummaatu dhufa.
english: When pride comes, then comes shame, but with humility comes wisdom.

kikuyu: Amanamummaan tolootaa isaan dura deema; warri hin amanamne garuu dabuma isaaniitiin badu.
english: The integrity of the upright shall guide them, but the perverseness of the treacherous shall destroy them.

kikuyu: Guyyaa dheekkamsaatti qabeenyi faayidaa hin qabu; qajeelummaan garuu duʼa jalaa nama baasa.
english: Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.

kikuyu: Qajeelummaan warra mudaa hin qabnee karaa qajeelaa baasaaf; hamoonni garuu hamminuma isaaniitiin badu.
english: The righteousness of the blameless will direct his way, but the wicked shall fall by his own wickedness.

kikuyu: Qajeelummaan tolootaa isaan oolcha; warri hin amanamne garuu hawwii hamaadhaan qabamu.
english: The righteousness of the upright shall deliver them, but the unfaithful will be trapped by evil desires.

kikuyu: Yeroo namni hamaan duʼu, abdiin isaas ni bada; wanni namni hamaan eeggatus ni barbadeeffama.
english: When a wicked man dies, hope perishes, and expectation of power comes to nothing.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan rakkoo jalaa ni baafama; rakkoon sunis qooda isaa nama hamaa irra gaʼa.
english: A righteous person is delivered out of trouble, and the wicked takes his place.

kikuyu: Namni Waaqatti hin bulle dubbii afaan isaatiin ollaa isaa balleessa; namni qajeelaan immoo beekumsaan miliqa.
english: With his mouth the godless man destroys his neighbor, but the righteous will be delivered through knowledge.

kikuyu: Yommuu namni qajeelaan badhaadhu magaalaan ni gammada; yommuu namni hamaan barbadaaʼu immoo iyya gammachuutu dhagaʼama.
english: When it goes well with the righteous, the city rejoices. When the wicked perish, there is shouting.

kikuyu: Eebba nama tolaatiin magaalaan ulfina argata; afaan nama hamaatiin garuu ni barbadeeffama.
english: By the blessing of the upright, the city is exalted, but it is overthrown by the mouth of the wicked.

kikuyu: Namni sammuu hin qabne ollaa isaa tuffata; kan hubannaa qabu garuu ni calʼisa.
english: One who despises his neighbor is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding holds his peace.

kikuyu: Namni odeessu dhoksaa gad baasa; kan amanamu garuu icciitii eega.
english: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.

kikuyu: Qajeelfama dhabiisaan sabni ni kufa; baayʼina gorsitootaatiin garuu nagaatu argama.
english: Where there is no wise guidance, the nation falls, but in the multitude of counselors there is victory.

kikuyu: Namni nama hin beekneef wabii taʼu ni rakkata; namni namaaf kakachuuf jedhee harka dhaʼuu didu immoo nagaan jiraata.
english: He who is collateral for a stranger will suffer for it, but he who refuses pledges of collateral is secure.

kikuyu: Dubartiin gara laafettiin ulfina argatti; namoonni garaa dhagaa immoo qabeenya qofa argatu.
english: A gracious woman obtains honor, but violent men obtain riches.

kikuyu: Namni gaariin of fayyada; gara jabeessi garuu rakkina ofitti fida.
english: The merciful man does good to his own soul, but he who is cruel troubles his own flesh.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan mindaa sobaa argata; kan qajeelummaa facaafatu immoo badhaasa dhugaa argata.
english: Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan dhugumaan jireenya argata; kan waan hamaa duukaa buʼu garuu gara duʼaa argata.
english: He who is truly righteous gets life. He who pursues evil gets death.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo warra yaada jalʼaa qaban balfa; warra karaan isaanii mudaa hin qabnetti immoo ni gammada.
english: Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to the LORD, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.

kikuyu: Waan kana hubadhu: Namni hamaan utuu hin adabamin hin hafu; qajeeltonni garuu bilisa baʼu.
english: Most certainly, the evil man will not be unpunished, but the offspring of the righteous will be delivered.

kikuyu: Dubartiin miidhagduun qalbii hin qabne akkuma qubeelaa warqee kan funyaan booyyeetti jirtuu ti.
english: Like a gold ring in a pig’s snout, is a beautiful woman who lacks discretion.

kikuyu: Wanni qajeeltonni hawwan gaarii taʼaaf; abdiin hamootaa garuu dheekkamsa qofa taʼa.
english: The desire of the righteous is only good. The expectation of the wicked is wrath.

kikuyu: Namni tokko toluma waa namaa kenna; taʼus ittuma caalchisee sooroma; kaan immoo waan kennuu malu dhowwata; taʼus inuma hiyyooma.
english: There is one who scatters, and increases yet more. There is one who withholds more than is appropriate, but gains poverty.

kikuyu: Namni arjaan ni badhaadha; namni warra kaan dheebuu baasu ofii isaatii illee dheebuu baʼa.
english: The liberal soul shall be made fat. He who waters shall be watered also himself.

kikuyu: Nama dhoksee midhaan kuufatu sabni ni abaara; kan gurguruuf fedhii qabu immoo eebbatu gonfoo taʼaaf.
english: People curse someone who withholds grain, but blessing will be on the head of him who sells it.

kikuyu: Namni waan gaarii barbaadu carraa gaarii argata; hamminni garuu nama hammina barbaadutti dhufa.
english: He who diligently seeks good seeks favor, but he who searches after evil, it shall come to him.

kikuyu: Namni sooruma ofii isaa abdatu kam iyyuu ni kufa; qajeelaan garuu akkuma baala magariisaatti lalisa.
english: He who trusts in his riches will fall, but the righteous shall flourish as the green leaf.

kikuyu: Namni maatii isaatti rakkoo fidu bubbee qofa dhaala; gowwaan immoo garbicha nama ogeessaa taʼa.
english: He who troubles his own house shall inherit the wind. The foolish shall be servant to the wise of heart.

kikuyu: Iji nama qajeelaa muka jireenyaa ti; namni lubbuu namaa baraaru immoo ogeessa.
english: The fruit of the righteous is a tree of life. He who is wise wins souls.

kikuyu: Erga qajeeltonni lafa irratti gatii isaanii argatanii, namni Waaqatti hin bullee fi cubbamaan hammam caalaa haa argatanii ree!
english: Behold, the righteous shall be repaid on the earth, how much more the wicked and the sinner!

kikuyu: Namni adabamuu jaallatu kam iyyuu beekumsa jaallata; kan sirreeffamuu jibbu garuu gowwaa dha.
english: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.

kikuyu: Namni gaariin Waaqayyo biratti fudhatama argata; Waaqayyo garuu nama hammina malatutti ni mura.
english: A good man shall obtain favor from the LORD, but he will condemn a man of wicked plans.

kikuyu: Namni tokko hamminaan jabaatee hin dhaabatu; qajeelaan garuu hin buqqifamu.
english: A man shall not be established by wickedness, but the root of the righteous shall not be moved.

kikuyu: Niitiin amala gaarii dhirsa isheetiif gonfoo dha; niitiin qaanessitu garuu akkuma tortora lafee isaa keessaa ti.
english: A worthy woman is the crown of her husband, but a disgraceful wife is as rottenness in his bones.

kikuyu: Karoorri qajeeltotaa qajeelaa dha; gorsi jalʼootaa garuu gowwoomsaa dha.
english: The thoughts of the righteous are just, but the advice of the wicked is deceitful.

kikuyu: Dubbiin hamootaa dhiiga dhangalaasuuf riphee nama eeggata; haasaan tolootaa garuu duʼa jalaa nama baasa.
english: The words of the wicked are about lying in wait for blood, but the speech of the upright rescues them.

kikuyu: Namoonni hamoon ni garagalfamu; deebiʼaniis hin argaman; manni qajeeltotaa garuu jabaatee dhaabata.
english: The wicked are overthrown, and are no more, but the house of the righteous shall stand.

kikuyu: Namni tokko akkuma ogummaa isaatti jajama; namni yaada jalʼaa qabu immoo ni tuffatama.
english: A man shall be commended according to his wisdom, but he who has a warped mind shall be despised.

kikuyu: Namni tuffatamaan hojjetaa qabu tokko, nama of kabaju kan waan nyaatu iyyuu hin qabne caala.
english: Better is he who is little known, and has a servant, than he who honors himself and lacks bread.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan lubbuu horii isaatiif yaada; hojiin jalʼootaa garuu tolaan isaa iyyuu hammina.
english: A righteous man respects the life of his animal, but the tender mercies of the wicked are cruel.

kikuyu: Namni lafa isaa qotatu nyaata guddaa argata; kan yaada faayidaa hin qabne duukaa buʼu garuu hubannaa hin qabu.
english: He who tills his land shall have plenty of bread, but he who chases fantasies is void of understanding.

kikuyu: Hamoonni boojuu jalʼootaa hawwu; hiddi qajeeltotaa garuu ni lalisa.
english: The wicked desires the plunder of evil men, but the root of the righteous flourishes.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan cubbuu afaan isaatiin qabama; namni qajeelaan garuu rakkoo jalaa miliqa.
english: An evil man is trapped by sinfulness of lips, but the righteous shall come out of trouble.

kikuyu: Namni waan afaan isaatii baʼuun waan gaariin guutama; hojiin harka namaas isumaaf deebiʼa.
english: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth. The work of a man’s hands shall be rewarded to him.

kikuyu: Nama gowwaa karaan isaa qajeelaa itti fakkaata; namni ogeessi garuu gorsa dhagaʼa.
english: The way of a fool is right in his own eyes, but he who is wise listens to counsel.

kikuyu: Aariin gowwaa yommusuma isa irraa beekama; namni hubataan garuu arrabsoo tuffata.
english: A fool shows his annoyance the same day, but one who overlooks an insult is prudent.

kikuyu: Namnii dhugaa dubbatu ragaa amanamaa kenna; dhuga baatuun sobaa garuu soba dubbatti.
english: He who is truthful testifies honestly, but a false witness lies.

kikuyu: Dubbiin of eeggannaa hin qabne akkuma goraadee nama waraana; arrabni nama ogeessaa garuu nama fayyisa.
english: There is one who speaks rashly like the piercing of a sword, but the tongue of the wise heals.

kikuyu: Afaan dhugaa dubbatu bara baraan jiraata; arrabni soba dubbatu garuu yeroo gabaabaa qofa jiraata.
english: Truth’s lips will be established forever, but a lying tongue is only momentary.

kikuyu: Garaa warra waan hamaa malatanii keessa gowwoomsaatu jira; warri nagaa buusan garuu gammachuu qabu.
english: Deceit is in the heart of those who plot evil, but joy comes to the promoters of peace.

kikuyu: Qajeeltotatti miidhaan tokko iyyuu hin dhufu; hamoonni rakkinaan guutamu.
english: No mischief shall happen to the righteous, but the wicked shall be filled with evil.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo arraba sobu ni jibba; warra dhugaa dubbatutti garuu ni gammada.
english: Lying lips are an abomination to the LORD, but those who do the truth are his delight.

kikuyu: Namni hubataan beekaa taʼuu isaa dhokfata; gowwoonni garuu gowwummaa isaanii labsu.
english: A prudent man keeps his knowledge, but the hearts of fools proclaim foolishness.

kikuyu: Harki nama jabaatee hojjetuu ni moʼa; dhibaaʼummaan garuu garbummaatti nama geessa.
english: The hands of the diligent ones shall rule, but laziness ends in slave labor.

kikuyu: Garaan yaaddaʼu gad nama deebisa; dubbiin tolaan immoo nama gammachiisa.
english: Anxiety in a man’s heart weighs it down, but a kind word makes it glad.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan ollaa isaa karaa argisiisa; karaan hamootaa garuu karaa irraa nama jalʼisa.
english: A righteous person is cautious in friendship, but the way of the wicked leads them astray.

kikuyu: Namni dhibaaʼaan waan adamsee ajjeese hin waaddatu; kan jabaatee hojjetu immoo qabeenya gatii guddaa argata.
english: The slothful man doesn’t roast his game, but the possessions of diligent men are prized.

kikuyu: Karaa qajeelummaa irra jireenyatu jira; daandii sana irra duuti hin jiru.
english: In the way of righteousness is life; in its path there is no death.

kikuyu: Ilmi ogeessi gorsa abbaa isaa dhagaʼa; qoostuun namaa immoo dheekkamsa hin dhaggeeffatu.
english: A wise son listens to his father’s instruction, but a scoffer doesn’t listen to rebuke.

kikuyu: Namni waan afaan isaatii baʼuun waan gaariin gammada; namni hin amanamne garuu jeequmsaaf ariifata.
english: By the fruit of his lips, a man enjoys good things, but the unfaithful crave violence.

kikuyu: Namni arraba isaa eeggatu, jireenya isaa eeggata; kan of eeggachuu malee dubbatu immoo baduuf ariifata.
english: He who guards his mouth guards his soul. One who opens wide his lips comes to ruin.

kikuyu: Fedhiin dhibaaʼaa yoom iyyuu hin guutamu; fedhiin nama jabaatee hojjetuu immoo guutumaan ni milkaaʼa.
english: The soul of the sluggard desires, and has nothing, but the desire of the diligent shall be fully satisfied.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan soba jibba; namni hamaan garuu qaanii fi salphina fida.
english: A righteous man hates lies, but a wicked man brings shame and disgrace.

kikuyu: Qajeelummaatu nama tolaa tiksa; hamminni garuu cubbamaa galaafata.
english: Righteousness guards the way of integrity, but wickedness overthrows the sinner.

kikuyu: Namni tokko sooressa of fakkeessa; garuu homaa hin qabu; tokko immoo hiyyeessa of fakkeessa; garuu qabeenya guddaa qaba.
english: There are some who pretend to be rich, yet have nothing. There are some who pretend to be poor, yet have great wealth.

kikuyu: Soorumni nama tokkoo furii jireenya isaa taʼuu dandaʼa; hiyyeessi garuu ifannaa hin dhagaʼu.
english: The ransom of a man’s life is his riches, but the poor hear no threats.

kikuyu: Ifni nama qajeelaa akka gaarii ifa; ibsaan nama hamaa garuu ni dhaama.
english: The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.

kikuyu: Of tuulummaan lola qofa baayʼisa; ogummaan garuu warra gorsa dhagaʼan biratti argamti.
english: Pride only breeds quarrels, but wisdom is with people who take advice.

kikuyu: Maallaqni karaa sobaatiin dhufu dafee bada; namni xinnoo xinnoon maallaqa walitti qabatu garuu ni kuufata.
english: Wealth gained dishonestly dwindles away, but he who gathers by hand makes it grow.

kikuyu: Abdiin lafa irra harkifatu garaa nama dhukkubsa; hawwiin guutamu garuu muka jireenyaa ti.
english: Hope deferred makes the heart sick, but when longing is fulfilled, it is a tree of life.

kikuyu: Namni gorsa tuffatu badiisa ofitti fida; kan ajaja ulfeessu immoo badhaasa argata.
english: Whoever despises instruction will pay for it, but he who respects a command will be rewarded.

kikuyu: Barsiisni nama ogeessaa burqaa jireenyaa ti; kiyyoo duʼaa irraas nama deebisa.
english: The teaching of the wise is a spring of life, to turn from the snares of death.

kikuyu: Hubannaan gaariin surraa argamsiisa; karaan warra hin amanamnee garuu badiisatti isaan geessa.
english: Good understanding wins favor, but the way of the unfaithful is hard.

kikuyu: Namni qalbii qabu kam iyyuu beekumsaan hojjeta; gowwaan immoo gowwummaa isaa mulʼisa.
english: Every prudent man acts from knowledge, but a fool exposes folly.

kikuyu: Ergamaan hamaan rakkoo keessa seena; ergamaan amanamaan garuu fayyina fida.
english: A wicked messenger falls into trouble, but a trustworthy envoy gains healing.

kikuyu: Namni adabamuu jibbu ni hiyyooma; ni qaanaʼas; kan sirreeffama kabaju immoo ulfina argata.
english: Poverty and shame come to him who refuses discipline, but he who heeds correction shall be honored.

kikuyu: Hawwiin guutame namatti miʼaawa; gowwoonni garuu waan hamaa irraa deebiʼuu balfu.
english: Longing fulfilled is sweet to the soul, but fools detest turning from evil.

kikuyu: Namni nama ogeessa wajjin deemu ogeessa taʼa, michuun gowwootaa garuu ni miidhama.
english: One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.

kikuyu: Wanni hamaan cubbamoota ariʼata; badhaadhummaan immoo badhaasa qajeelotaa ti.
english: Misfortune pursues sinners, but prosperity rewards the righteous.

kikuyu: Namni gaariin ilmaan ilmaan isaatiif dhaala dabarsa; qabeenyi nama cubbamaa garuu qajeeltotaaf kuufama.
english: A good man leaves an inheritance to his children’s children, but the wealth of the sinner is stored for the righteous.

kikuyu: Qonnaan hiyyeessaa midhaan guddaa baasa; murtiin jalʼaan garuu haxaaʼee duraa balleessa.
english: An abundance of food is in poor people’s fields, but injustice sweeps it away.

kikuyu: Namni harcummee qusatu ilma isaa jibba; kan ilma ofii jaallatu immoo ilaallachaa isa adaba.
english: One who spares the rod hates his son, but one who loves him is careful to discipline him.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan hamma quufutti nyaata; garaan nama hamaa garuu ni beelaʼa.
english: The righteous one eats to the satisfying of his soul, but the belly of the wicked goes hungry.

kikuyu: Dubartiin ogeettiin mana ishee ijaarratti; gowwaan immoo harkuma isheetiin mana ofii diigdi.
english: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelummaan jiraatu Waaqayyoon sodaata; kan karaan isaa jalʼaa taʼe garuu isa tuffata.
english: He who walks in his uprightness fears the LORD, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.

kikuyu: Afaan nama gowwaa dugda isaatti ulee of tuulummaa fida; arrabni ogeeyyii garuu isaan eega.
english: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.

kikuyu: Yoo qotiyyoon hin jirre, dallaan duwwaa taʼa; garuu humna qotiyyoo tokkootiin midhaan baayʼeen argama.
english: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.

kikuyu: Dhuga baatuun amanamaan hin sobu; dhuga baatuun sobaa immoo dhara of keessaa gad naqa.
english: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.

kikuyu: Qoostuun namaa ogummaa barbaadee hin argatu; nama waa hubatuuf garuu beekumsi dadhabbii malee dhufa.
english: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.

kikuyu: Ati nama gowwaa irraa fagaadhu; arraba isaa irraa beekumsa hin argattuutii.
english: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.

kikuyu: Ogummaan hubattootaa akka isaan karaa isaanii beekan isaan godha; gowwummaan gowwootaa garuu karaa irraa isaan balleessa.
english: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.

kikuyu: Gowwoonni cubbuutti qoosu; qajeeltota gidduutti garuu hawwii gaariitu argama.
english: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.

kikuyu: Garaan gadda ofii isaa ni beeka; namni biraa tokko iyyuu gammachuu isaa irraa hin qooddatu.
english: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.

kikuyu: Manni nama hamaa ni bada; dunkaanni nama qajeelaa immoo ni daraara.
english: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.

kikuyu: Karaan qajeelaa namatti fakkaatu tokko jira; dhuma irratti garuu duʼatti nama geessa.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

kikuyu: Kolfa keessatti iyyuu garaan nama dhukkubuu dandaʼa; gammachuunis gaddaan dhumuu dandaʼa.
english: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.

kikuyu: Namni hin amanamne gatii karaa isaa, namni gaariin immoo gatii hojii isaa argata.
english: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.

kikuyu: Namni homaa hin beekne waan hunda amana; namni qalbii qabu garuu tarkaanfii isaa ilaallata.
english: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.

kikuyu: Namni ogeessi of eeggata; waan hamaa irraas ni deebiʼa; gowwaan garuu waan hundatti jarjara; of illee hin eeggatu.
english: A wise man fears and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.

kikuyu: Namni dafee aaru gowwummaa hojjeta; namni daba hojjetu garuu ni jibbama.
english: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.

kikuyu: Namni homaa hin beekne gowwummaa dhaala; qalbeeffataan garuu beekumsa gonfata.
english: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

kikuyu: Namoonni hamoon fuula namoota gaarii duratti, jalʼoonnis karra qajeeltotaa duratti sagadu.
english: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.

kikuyu: Hiyyeeyyii olloonni isaanii iyyuu ni jibbu; sooreyyiin immoo michoota hedduu qabu.
english: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.

kikuyu: Namni ollaa isaa tuffatu cubbuu hojjeta; kan rakkataaf garaa laafu garuu eebbifamaa dha.
english: He who despises his neighbor sins, but he who has pity on the poor is blessed.

kikuyu: Namni hammina yaadu karaa irraa hin baduu? Warri waan gaarii karoorsan garuu jaalalaa fi amanamummaa argatu.
english: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.

kikuyu: Jabaatanii hojjechuun hundi buʼaa buusa; oduun faayidaa hin qabne garuu hiyyummaa qofa fida.
english: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.

kikuyu: Gonfoon ogeeyyii qabeenya isaanii ti; gowwummaan gowwootaa garuu gowwummaa dhala.
english: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.

kikuyu: Dhuga baatuun dhugaa lubbuu baraara; dhuga baatuun sobaa immoo soba dubbata.
english: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.

kikuyu: Namni Waaqayyoon sodaatu daʼannoo jabaa qaba; ijoolleen isaas daʼoo argatu.
english: In the fear of the LORD is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon sodaachuun burqaa jireenyaa ti; kiyyoo duʼaa irraas nama deebisa.
english: The fear of the LORD is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.

kikuyu: Ulfinni mootii tokkoo baayʼina uummata isaa ti; yoo uummanni hin jirre garuu ilmi mootiis ni bada.
english: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.

kikuyu: Namni obsa qabu hubannaa guddaa qaba; kan dafee aaru garuu gowwummaa mulʼisa.
english: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.

kikuyu: Garaan nagaa qabu dhagnaaf jireenya kenna; hinaaffaan garuu lafee tortorsa.
english: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.

kikuyu: Namni hiyyeessa cunqursu kan isa Uume tuffata; namni hiyyeessaaf garaa laafu immoo Waaqa kabaja.
english: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.

kikuyu: Hamoonni jalʼinuma isaaniitiin badu; qajeeltonni garuu duʼa keessatti illee amanamummaa isaaniitiin daʼannoo argatu.
english: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.

kikuyu: Ogummaan qalbii nama waa hubatuu keessa jirti; garaa gowwootaa keessatti garuu hin beekamtu.
english: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.

kikuyu: Qajeelummaan saba ol guddisa; cubbuun garuu saba kamiif iyyuu salphina.
english: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.

kikuyu: Mootiin tajaajilaa ogeessatti ni gammada; kan isa qaanessutti garuu ni dheekkama.
english: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.

kikuyu: Deebiin laafaan dheekkamsa qabbaneessa; jechi hamaan garuu aarii kakaasa.
english: A gentle answer turns away wrath, but a harsh word stirs up anger.

kikuyu: Arrabni nama ogeessaa beekumsa jaja; afaan nama gowwaa garuu gowwummaa dhangalaasa.
english: The tongue of the wise commends knowledge, but the mouths of fools gush out folly.

kikuyu: Iji Waaqayyoo idduma hunda jira; nama hamaa fi gaariis ni toʼata.
english: The LORD’s eyes are everywhere, keeping watch on the evil and the good.

kikuyu: Arrabni fayyina fidu muka jireenyaa ti; arrabni sobu garuu hafuura cabsa.
english: A gentle tongue is a tree of life, but deceit in it crushes the spirit.

kikuyu: Gowwaan adabbii abbaa isaa tuffata; namni sirreeffama fudhatu kam iyyuu garuu qalbii qabeessa.
english: A fool despises his father’s correction, but he who heeds reproof shows prudence.

kikuyu: Manni nama qajeelaa badhaadhummaa guddaa qaba; galiin nama hamaa garuu rakkoo isatti fida.
english: In the house of the righteous is much treasure, but the income of the wicked brings trouble.

kikuyu: Arrabni nama ogeessaa beekumsa facaasa; garaan nama gowwaa garuu akkas miti.
english: The lips of the wise spread knowledge; not so with the heart of fools.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo aarsaa hamootaa ni balfa; kadhannaan tolootaa garuu isa gammachiisa.
english: The sacrifice made by the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but the prayer of the upright is his delight.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo karaa hamootaa ni balfa; warra qajeelummaa duukaa buʼan garuu ni jaallata.
english: The way of the wicked is an abomination to the LORD, but he loves him who follows after righteousness.

kikuyu: Nama daandii irraa jalʼatu adabbii hamaatu isa eeggata; kan sirreeffama jibbu ni duʼa.
english: There is stern discipline for one who forsakes the way. Whoever hates reproof shall die.

kikuyu: Duʼaa fi Badiisni fuula Waaqayyoo duratti beekamoo dha; yoos garaan namaa hammam caalaa haa beekamu ree!
english: Sheol and Abaddon are before the LORD— how much more then the hearts of the children of men!

kikuyu: Namni qoosu sirreeffama hin jaallatu; nama ogeessaanis hin mariʼatu.
english: A scoffer doesn’t love to be reproved; he will not go to the wise.

kikuyu: Garaan gammadu akka fuulli ifu godha; gaddi garaa garuu hafuura cabsa.
english: A glad heart makes a cheerful face, but an aching heart breaks the spirit.

kikuyu: Garaan waa qalbeeffatu beekumsa barbaada; afaan gowwaa garuu gowwummaa nyaata.
english: The heart of one who has understanding seeks knowledge, but the mouths of fools feed on folly.

kikuyu: Barri nama hacuucamee guutumaan guutuutti gadadoo dha; garaa gammaduuf garuu guyyaan hundinuu cidha.
english: All the days of the afflicted are wretched, but one who has a cheerful heart enjoys a continual feast.

kikuyu: Qabeenya guddaa rakkina of keessaa qabuu mannaa, Waaqayyoon sodaachaa waan xinnaa qabaachuu wayya.
english: Better is little, with the fear of the LORD, than great treasure with trouble.

kikuyu: Jibbaan cooma sangaa nyaachuu mannaa, jaalalaan raafuu nyaachuu wayya.
english: Better is a dinner of herbs, where love is, than a fattened calf with hatred.

kikuyu: Namni dafee aaru lola kakaasa; namni obsa qabu garuu lola qabbaneessa.
english: A wrathful man stirs up contention, but one who is slow to anger appeases strife.

kikuyu: Karaan nama dhibaaʼaa qoraattiidhaan cufama; daandiin tolootaa garuu karaa diriiraa dha.
english: The way of the sluggard is like a thorn patch, but the path of the upright is a highway.

kikuyu: Ilmi ogeessi abbaa isaa gammachiisa; namni gowwaan garuu haadha isaa tuffata.
english: A wise son makes a father glad, but a foolish man despises his mother.

kikuyu: Nama qalbii hin qabne gowwummaatu isa gammachiisa; namni hubataan garuu daandii qajeelaa irra deema.
english: Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.

kikuyu: Karoorri gorsa hin qabne fiixaan hin baʼu; garuu gorsitoota hedduudhaan ni milkaaʼa.
english: Where there is no counsel, plans fail; but in a multitude of counselors they are established.

kikuyu: Namni tokko deebii malu kennuudhaan gammachuu argata; dubbiin yeroo isaatti dubbatamu akkam gaarii dha!
english: Joy comes to a man with the reply of his mouth. How good is a word at the right time!

kikuyu: Daandiin nama hubataa akka inni siiʼoolitti gad hin buuneef gara jireenyaatti ol isa baasa.
english: The path of life leads upward for the wise, to keep him from going downward to Sheol.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo mana nama of tuuluu ni diiga; daangaa haadha hiyyeessaa garuu ni dhaaba.
english: The LORD will uproot the house of the proud, but he will keep the widow’s borders intact.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo yaada nama hamaa ni balfa; yaadni nama qulqulluu garuu isa gammachiisa.
english: The LORD detests the thoughts of the wicked, but the thoughts of the pure are pleasing.

kikuyu: Namni doqni maatii isaatti rakkina fida; kan mattaʼaa jibbu garuu ni jiraata.
english: He who is greedy for gain troubles his own house, but he who hates bribes will live.

kikuyu: Garaan nama qajeelaa haala ittiin deebii kennu yaada; afaan nama hamaa garuu hammina dhangalaasa.
english: The heart of the righteous weighs answers, but the mouth of the wicked gushes out evil.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo nama hamaa irraa fagoo jira; kadhannaa nama qajeelaa garuu ni dhagaʼa.
english: The LORD is far from the wicked, but he hears the prayer of the righteous.

kikuyu: Fuulli ifaan garaa gammachiisa; oduun gaariinis lafee haaromsa.
english: The light of the eyes rejoices the heart. Good news gives health to the bones.

kikuyu: Namni adabbii jireenya kennu dhaggeeffatu, ogeeyyii gidduu jiraata.
english: The ear that listens to reproof lives, and will be at home among the wise.

kikuyu: Namni adabbii tuffatu ofuma tuffata; kan sirreeffama fudhatu garuu hubannaa argata.
english: He who refuses correction despises his own soul, but he who listens to reproof gets understanding.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon sodaachuun ogummaa nama barsiisa; gad of qabuunis ulfina dura dhufa.
english: The fear of the LORD teaches wisdom. Before honor is humility.

kikuyu: Karoorri garaa kan namaa ti; deebiin arrabaa garuu Waaqayyo biraa dhufa.
english: The plans of the heart belong to man, but the answer of the tongue is from the LORD.

kikuyu: Nama tokko karaan isaa hundi qulqulluu itti fakkaata; yaada namaa garuu Waaqayyotu madaala.
english: All the ways of a man are clean in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the motives.

kikuyu: Waan hojjettu hunda Waaqayyotti kennadhu; karoorri kees siif milkaaʼa.
english: Commit your deeds to the LORD, and your plans shall succeed.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo waan hunda kaayyoo ofii isaatiif hojjeta; hamoota iyyuu guyyaa badiisaatiif qopheessa.
english: The LORD has made everything for its own end— yes, even the wicked for the day of evil.

kikuyu: Namni of tuulu kam iyyuu fuula Waaqayyoo duratti balfamaa dha; dhugumaan inni utuu hin adabamin hin hafu.
english: Everyone who is proud in heart is an abomination to the LORD; they shall certainly not be unpunished.

kikuyu: Namni jaalalaa fi amanamummaadhaan araara cubbuu argata; Waaqayyoon sodaachuudhaanis hammina irraa cita.
english: By mercy and truth iniquity is atoned for. By the fear of the LORD men depart from evil.

kikuyu: Yoo karaan namaa Waaqayyoon gammachiise, inni akka diinonni isaas nagaan isa wajjin jiraatan ni godha.
english: When a man’s ways please the LORD, he makes even his enemies to be at peace with him.

kikuyu: Galii guddaa jalʼinaan argatan mannaa waan xinnoo qajeelummaan argatan wayya.
english: Better is a little with righteousness, than great revenues with injustice.

kikuyu: Namni garaa isaa keessatti karaa isaa karoorfata; Waaqayyo garuu tarkaanfii isaa illee ni murteessa.
english: A man’s heart plans his course, but the LORD directs his steps.

kikuyu: Hidhiin mootii hooda dubbata; afaan isaa illee murtii hin jalʼisu.
english: Inspired judgments are on the lips of the king. He shall not betray his mouth.

kikuyu: Madaallii fi safartuun qajeelaan kan Waaqayyoo ti; ulfinni korojoo keessa jiru hundinuu hojii isaa ti.
english: Honest balances and scales are the LORD’s; all the weights in the bag are his work.

kikuyu: Sababii teessoon qajeelummaadhaan jabaatee dhaabatuuf mootonni waan hamaa hojjechuu ni balfu.
english: It is an abomination for kings to do wrong, for the throne is established by righteousness.

kikuyu: Mootonni afaan dhugaa dubbatutti ni gammadu; isaan nama dhugaa dubbatu ni jaallatu.
english: Righteous lips are the delight of kings. They value one who speaks the truth.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsi mootii ergamaa duʼaa ti; namni ogeessi garuu ni qabbaneessa.
english: The king’s wrath is a messenger of death, but a wise man will pacify it.

kikuyu: Jireenyi ifa fuula mootii keessa jira; surraan isaa akkuma duumessa bokkaa arfaasaa ti.
english: In the light of the king’s face is life. His favor is like a cloud of the spring rain.

kikuyu: Ogummaa argachuun warqee caala; hubannaa argachuunis meetii caala!
english: How much better it is to get wisdom than gold! Yes, to get understanding is to be chosen rather than silver.

kikuyu: Daandiin nama tolaa hammina irraa fagoo dha; namni karaa isaa eegus jireenya isaa eeggata.
english: The highway of the upright is to depart from evil. He who keeps his way preserves his soul.

kikuyu: Of tuuluun badiisaan dura, of bokoksuunis kufaatiin dura deema.
english: Pride goes before destruction, and an arrogant spirit before a fall.

kikuyu: Warra of tuulu wajjin boojuu qooddachuu mannaa, hafuuraan gad of qabanii warra cunqurfame wajjin jiraachuu wayya.
english: It is better to be of a lowly spirit with the poor, than to divide the plunder with the proud.

kikuyu: Namni gorsa fudhatu kam iyyuu ni milkaaʼa; kan Waaqayyoon amanatus eebbifamaa dha.
english: He who heeds the Word finds prosperity. Whoever trusts in the LORD is blessed.

kikuyu: Namni garaadhaan ogeessa taʼe qalbeeffataa jedhama; dubbiin miʼaawu immoo gorsa dabala.
english: The wise in heart shall be called prudent. Pleasantness of the lips promotes instruction.

kikuyu: Hubannaan nama isa qabuuf madda jireenyaa ti; gowwummaan garuu gowwootatti adabbii fida.
english: Understanding is a fountain of life to one who has it, but the punishment of fools is their folly.

kikuyu: Garaan nama ogeessaa arraba isaa qajeelcha; afaan isaas gorsa dabala.
english: The heart of the wise instructs his mouth, and adds learning to his lips.

kikuyu: Dubbiin nama gammachiisu dhaaba dammaa ti; inni lubbuutti ni miʼaawa; lafees ni fayyisa.
english: Pleasant words are a honeycomb, sweet to the soul, and health to the bones.

kikuyu: Karaan qajeelaa namatti fakkaatu tokko jira; dhuma irratti garuu duʼatti nama geessa.
english: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.

kikuyu: Fedhiin hojjetaan tokko nyaataaf qabu hojiif isa kakaasa; beelaʼuun isaas ittuma cima.
english: The appetite of the laboring man labors for him, for his mouth urges him on.

kikuyu: Namni faayidaa hin qabne hammina malata; haasaan isaas akkuma ibidda waa gubuu ti.
english: A worthless man devises mischief. His speech is like a scorching fire.

kikuyu: Namni jalʼaan lola kakaasa; hamattuun immoo michoota walitti dhiʼaatan gargar baafti.
english: A perverse man stirs up strife. A whisperer separates close friends.

kikuyu: Namni jeequmsaan deemu ollaa isaa gowwoomsee karaa jalʼaatti isa geessa.
english: A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.

kikuyu: Namni ija qisu jalʼina karoorfata; kan hidhii ciniinnatu immoo hammina fida.
english: One who winks his eyes to plot perversities, one who compresses his lips, is bent on evil.

kikuyu: Arriin gonfoo ulfinaa ti; innis karaa qajeelaadhaan argama.
english: Gray hair is a crown of glory. It is attained by a life of righteousness.

kikuyu: Goota waraanaa irra nama obsa qabu, nama magaalaa tokko boojiʼee fudhatu irra kan of qabu wayya.
english: One who is slow to anger is better than the mighty; one who rules his spirit, than he who takes a city.

kikuyu: Ixaan gudeeda irratti buufama; murtoon isaa garuu guutumaan guutuutti Waaqayyo biraa dhufa.
english: The lot is cast into the lap, but its every decision is from the LORD.

kikuyu: Mana nyaataa dhugaatiin guutame kan lola qabuu mannaa, iddoo nagaan jirutti hurraaʼaa buddeena goggogaa wayya.
english: Better is a dry morsel with quietness, than a house full of feasting with strife.

kikuyu: Garbichi hubataan ilma salphaa bulcha; obboloota gidduuttis dhaala qooddata.
english: A servant who deals wisely will rule over a son who causes shame, and shall have a part in the inheritance among the brothers.

kikuyu: Okkoteen waa itti baqsan meetiif, boolli ibiddaa immoo warqeef; Waaqayyo garuu garaa namaa qora.
english: The refining pot is for silver, and the furnace for gold, but the LORD tests the hearts.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan dubbii gowwoomsaa dhaggeeffata; sobaanis arraba balaʼamaadhaaf gurra kenna.
english: An evildoer heeds wicked lips. A liar gives ear to a mischievous tongue.

kikuyu: Namni hiyyeeyyiitti qoosu kan isaan Uume sana tuffata; kan badiisa namaatti gammadu utuu hin adabamin hin hafu.
english: Whoever mocks the poor reproaches his Maker. He who is glad at calamity shall not be unpunished.

kikuyu: Nama jaare tokkoof ilmaan ilmaan isaa gonfoo dha; haadhaa fi abbaanis ijoollee isaaniitiif ulfina.
english: Children’s children are the crown of old men; the glory of children is their parents.

kikuyu: Dubbiin baʼeessi nama gowwaatti hin tolu; hidhiin sobu immoo hammam bulchaa tokkotti haa hammaatu ree!
english: Excellent speech isn’t fitting for a fool, much less do lying lips fit a prince.

kikuyu: Mattaʼaan namicha kennuuf miʼa falfalaa ti; inni lafa dhaqu kamitti iyyuu ni milkaaʼa.
english: A bribe is a precious stone in the eyes of him who gives it; wherever he turns, he prospers.

kikuyu: Namni balleessaa namaaf dhiisu jaalala guddisa; namni waan tokko irra deddeebiʼu, garuu michoota walitti dhiʼaatan gargar baasa.
english: He who covers an offense promotes love; but he who repeats a matter separates best friends.

kikuyu: Hamma gowwaan yeroo dhibba garafamee itti dhagaʼamu caalaa ifannaan nama waa hubatutti dhagaʼama.
english: A rebuke enters deeper into one who has understanding than a hundred lashes into a fool.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan fincila qofa barbaada; ergamaan namaa hin naane isatti ni ergama.
english: An evil man seeks only rebellion; therefore a cruel messenger shall be sent against him.

kikuyu: Gowwaa gowwummaa isa keessa jiruun walitti dhufuu mannaa amaaketa dhaltuu ilmaan ishee jalaa fudhatamaniin walitti dhufuu wayya.
english: Let a bear robbed of her cubs meet a man, rather than a fool in his folly.

kikuyu: Nama qooda gaarii hamaa deebisu, hamminni mana isaa keessaa hin baʼu.
english: Whoever rewards evil for good, evil shall not depart from his house.

kikuyu: Lola jalqabuun akkuma bishaan cabsanii yaasuu ti; kanaafuu utuu lolli hin hoʼin dubbii dhiisi.
english: The beginning of strife is like breaching a dam, therefore stop contention before quarreling breaks out.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo waan kana lachuu ni balfa; kunis nama yakka qabu qulqulluu gochuu fi nama balleessaa hin qabnetti muruu dha.
english: He who justifies the wicked, and he who condemns the righteous, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

kikuyu: Sababii inni ogummaa argachuuf fedhii hin qabneef, maallaqni harka gowwaa jiru faayidaa maalii qaba?
english: Why is there money in the hand of a fool to buy wisdom, since he has no understanding?

kikuyu: Michuun yeroo hunda nama jaallata; obboleessi immoo guyyaa rakkootiif dhalata.
english: A friend loves at all times; and a brother is born for adversity.

kikuyu: Namni qalbii hin qabne harka dhaʼee waa namaaf kakata; fuula ollaa ofii isaa durattis wabii taʼa.
english: A man void of understanding strikes hands, and becomes collateral in the presence of his neighbor.

kikuyu: Namni lola jaallatu cubbuu jaallata; namni karra ol dheeraa ijaarus badiisa waama.
english: He who loves disobedience loves strife. One who builds a high gate seeks destruction.

kikuyu: Namni yaada hamaa qabu hin milkaaʼu; kan arrabni isaa nama gowwoomsus rakkoo keessa seena.
english: One who has a perverse heart doesn’t find prosperity, and one who has a deceitful tongue falls into trouble.

kikuyu: Ilmi gowwaan abbaa isaatti gadda fida; abbaan ilma gowwaas hin gammadu.
english: He who becomes the father of a fool grieves. The father of a fool has no joy.

kikuyu: Garaan gammadu qoricha gaarii dha; hafuurri cabe immoo lafee gogsa.
english: A cheerful heart makes good medicine, but a crushed spirit dries up the bones.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan karaa murtii qajeelaa jalʼisuuf jedhee dhoksaadhaan mattaʼaa fudhata.
english: A wicked man receives a bribe in secret, to pervert the ways of justice.

kikuyu: Namni hubataan fuula isaa gara ogummaatti deebifata; iji gowwaa garuu hamma handaara lafaatti joora.
english: Wisdom is before the face of one who has understanding, but the eyes of a fool wander to the ends of the earth.

kikuyu: Ilmi gowwaan abbaa isaatti gadda fida; haadha isa deessettis jireenya hadheessa.
english: A foolish son brings grief to his father, and bitterness to her who bore him.

kikuyu: Nama balleessaa hin qabne tokko adabuun gaarii miti; qondaaltota amanamoo rukutuunis sirrii miti.
english: Also to punish the righteous is not good, nor to flog officials for their integrity.

kikuyu: Namni beekaan of qusachaa dubbata; namni hubataanis hafuura qabanaaʼaa qaba.
english: He who spares his words has knowledge. He who is even tempered is a man of understanding.

kikuyu: Gowwaan iyyuu yommuu calʼisu ogeessa fakkaata; yommuu arraba isaa toʼatus hubataa fakkaata.
english: Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.

kikuyu: Namni addaan of baasu ofittummaa duukaa buʼa; murtii dhugaa hundaanis ni morma.
english: A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.

kikuyu: Namni gowwaan hubannaa argachuutti hin gammadu; garuu yaaduma isaa ibsuutti gammada.
english: A fool has no delight in understanding, but only in revealing his own opinion.

kikuyu: Yeroo hamminni dhufu tuffiin dhufa; salphinnis qaanii wajjin dhufa.
english: When wickedness comes, contempt also comes, and with shame comes disgrace.

kikuyu: Dubbiin afaan namaa bishaan gad fagoo dha; burqaan ogummaa garuu bishaan yaaʼuu dha.
english: The words of a man’s mouth are like deep waters. The fountain of wisdom is like a flowing brook.

kikuyu: Gara nama hamaa goruun yookaan nama balleessaa hin qabne murtii qajeelaa dhowwachuun gaarii miti.
english: To be partial to the faces of the wicked is not good, nor to deprive the innocent of justice.

kikuyu: Hidhiin gowwaa lola fida; afaan isaas rukutamuu itti waama.
english: A fool’s lips come into strife, and his mouth invites beatings.

kikuyu: Afaan gowwaa badiisa isaa ti; hidhiin isaas kiyyoo lubbuu isaa ti.
english: A fool’s mouth is his destruction, and his lips are a snare to his soul.

kikuyu: Dubbiin hamattuu akkuma gurshaa miʼaawuu ti; gara kutaa garaattis gad buʼa.
english: The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.

kikuyu: Namni hojii isaa irratti dhibaaʼu, obboleessa nama waa balleessuu ti.
english: One who is slack in his work is brother to him who is a master of destruction.

kikuyu: Maqaan Waaqayyoo gamoo jabaa dha; namni qajeelaan itti baqatee badiisa oola.
english: The LORD’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.

kikuyu: Qabeenyi sooreyyii isaaniif magaalaa daʼoo qabduu dha; isaanis akka dallaa ol dheeraatti hedu.
english: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.

kikuyu: Kufaatiidhaan dura garaan namaa of tuula; gad of qabuun garuu ulfinaan dura dhufa.
english: Before destruction the heart of man is proud, but before honor is humility.

kikuyu: Utuu hin dhaggeeffatin deebii kennuun, gowwummaa fi qaanii dha.
english: He who answers before he hears, that is folly and shame to him.

kikuyu: Hafuurri namaa dhukkuba ni obsa; hafuura cabe garuu eenyutu obsuu dandaʼa?
english: A man’s spirit will sustain him in sickness, but a crushed spirit, who can bear?

kikuyu: Garaan nama hubataa beekumsa argata; gurri ogeessaas waan kana barbaada.
english: The heart of the discerning gets knowledge. The ear of the wise seeks knowledge.

kikuyu: Kennaan abbicha kennuuf karaa bana; fuula namoota gurguddaa durattis isa dhiʼeessa.
english: A man’s gift makes room for him, and brings him before great men.

kikuyu: Hamma namni biraa dhufee isaan mormutti, namni jalqabatti himata isaa dhiʼeeffatu tokko dhugaa qabeessa fakkaata.
english: He who pleads his cause first seems right— until another comes and questions him.

kikuyu: Ixaa buusuun wal falmii qabbaneessa; namoota wal lolan jajjaboos addaan galcha.
english: The lot settles disputes, and keeps strong ones apart.

kikuyu: Obboleessa yakkame tokko deebisuun magaalaa daʼoo qabdu irra ulfaata; wal falmiinis akkuma danqaraa karra dallaa dhagaa ti.
english: A brother offended is more difficult than a fortified city. Disputes are like the bars of a fortress.

kikuyu: Ija afaan isaatiin garaan namaa quufa; dubbii arraba isaatiinis ni guuta.
english: A man’s stomach is filled with the fruit of his mouth. With the harvest of his lips he is satisfied.

kikuyu: Arrabni humna jireenyaatii fi duʼaa qaba; warri isa jaallatanis ija isaa nyaatu.
english: Death and life are in the power of the tongue; those who love it will eat its fruit.

kikuyu: Namni niitii argatu waan gaarii argata; fuula Waaqayyoo durattis surraa argata.
english: Whoever finds a wife finds a good thing, and obtains favor of the LORD.

kikuyu: Hiyyeessi arraba laafaadhaan dubbata; sooressi garuu sagalee jabaadhaan deebii kenna.
english: The poor plead for mercy, but the rich answer harshly.

kikuyu: Namni michoota baayʼisu ni bada; garuu michuun obboleessa caalaa namatti aanu ni jira.
english: A man of many companions may be ruined, but there is a friend who sticks closer than a brother.

kikuyu: Gowwaa daba dubbatuu mannaa hiyyeessa amanamummaadhaan jiraatu wayya.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

kikuyu: Namni beekumsa hin qabne gaarii miti; miilli jarjarus karaa irraa jalʼata.
english: It isn’t good to have zeal without knowledge, nor to be hasty with one’s feet and miss the way.

kikuyu: Gowwummaan namaa karaa isaa jalʼisa; garaan isaa immoo Waaqayyotti aara.
english: The foolishness of man subverts his way; his heart rages against the LORD.

kikuyu: Badhaadhummaan michoota hedduu nama argachiisa; hiyyeessi garuu michoota isaa irraa gargar baʼa.
english: Wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

kikuyu: Namni sobaan dhugaa baʼu utuu hin adabamin hin hafu; namni soba odeessuus jalaa hin baʼu.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who pours out lies shall not go free.

kikuyu: Namni hedduun bulchaa biratti surraa argachuu barbaada; namni hundis michuu nama waa namaa kennuu ti.
english: Many will entreat the favor of a ruler, and everyone is a friend to a man who gives gifts.

kikuyu: Obboloonni hiyyeessaa hundinuu isa jibbu; yoos michoonni isaa hammam caalaa isa irraa haa fagaatan ree! Inni kadhachaa isaan duukaa buʼu iyyuu isaan eessattuu hin argaman.
english: All the relatives of the poor shun him; how much more do his friends avoid him! He pursues them with pleas, but they are gone.

kikuyu: Namni qalbii qabu ofii isaa jaallata; namni hubannaa jaallatu ni milkaaʼa.
english: He who gets wisdom loves his own soul. He who keeps understanding shall find good.

kikuyu: Namni sobaan dhugaa baʼu utuu hin adabamin hin hafu; namni soba odeessus ni bada.
english: A false witness shall not be unpunished. He who utters lies shall perish.

kikuyu: Jireenya qananii jiraachuun gowwaaf hin malu; yoos ilmaan mootii bulchuun garbichaaf hammam caalaa haa hammaatu ree?
english: Delicate living is not appropriate for a fool, much less for a servant to have rule over princes.

kikuyu: Ogummaan nama tokkoo obsa kennaaf; balleessaa namaa irra darbuunis isaaf ulfina.
english: The discretion of a man makes him slow to anger. It is his glory to overlook an offense.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsi mootii akkuma aaduu leencaa ti, surraan isaa immoo akkuma fixeensa marga irratti.
english: The king’s wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

kikuyu: Ilmi gowwaan abbaa isaatiif badiisa; niitiin nyakkiftunis akka mana yeroo hundumaa dhimmisuu ti.
english: A foolish son is the calamity of his father. A wife’s quarrels are a continual dripping.

kikuyu: Manaa fi qabeenyi warra ofii irraa dhaalamu; niitii qalbii qabdu garuu Waaqayyotu namaaf kenna.
english: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from the LORD.

kikuyu: Dhibaaʼummaan hirriba guddaa namatti buusa; namni hojii malee taaʼus ni beelaʼa.
english: Slothfulness casts into a deep sleep. The idle soul shall suffer hunger.

kikuyu: Namni ajaja eegu lubbuu isaa eeggata; kan karaa isaa tuffatu immoo ni duʼa.
english: He who keeps the commandment keeps his soul, but he who is contemptuous in his ways shall die.

kikuyu: Namni hiyyeessaaf garaa laafu Waaqayyoof liqeessa; Waaqnis waan inni hojjete sanaaf isa badhaasa.
english: He who has pity on the poor lends to the LORD; he will reward him.

kikuyu: Yeroo abdiin jirutti ilma kee adabadhu; akka inni duʼuufis calʼistee hin ilaalin.
english: Discipline your son, for there is hope; don’t be a willing party to his death.

kikuyu: Namni dafee aaru adabamuu qaba; ati yoo isa oolchite, amma illee akkasuma gochuu qabda.
english: A hot-tempered man must pay the penalty, for if you rescue him, you must do it again.

kikuyu: Gorsa namaa dhaggeeffadhu; sirreeffamas fudhadhu; dhuma irratti ati nama ogeessa taata.
english: Listen to counsel and receive instruction, that you may be wise in your latter end.

kikuyu: Garaa namaa keessa karoora baayʼeetu jira; garuu wanni fiixaan baʼu kaayyoo Waaqayyoo ti.
english: There are many plans in a man’s heart, but the LORD’s counsel will prevail.

kikuyu: Wanni namni hawwu jaalala dhuma hin qabnee dha; sobduu taʼuu mannaa hiyyeessa taʼuu wayya.
english: That which makes a man to be desired is his kindness. A poor man is better than a liar.

kikuyu: Waaqayyoon sodaachuun jireenyatti nama geessa; yoos namni boqonnaadhaan jiraata; rakkinnis isa hin argatu.
english: The fear of the LORD leads to life, then contentment; he rests and will not be touched by trouble.

kikuyu: Dhibaaʼaan harka isaa waciitii keessa kaaʼa; gara afaan isaattis hin deebifatu!
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish; he will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

kikuyu: Qoostuu garafi; wallaalaan hubannaa argataa; nama qalbii qabu ifadhu; inni beekumsa argataatii.
english: Flog a scoffer, and the simple will learn prudence; rebuke one who has understanding, and he will gain knowledge.

kikuyu: Namni abbaa isaa saamu, haadha isaas kan manaa ariʼu, ilma qaanii fi salphina fiduu dha.
english: He who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, mee qajeelfama dhaggeeffachuu dhiisi; ati dubbii beekumsaa irraa ni baddaa.
english: If you stop listening to instruction, my son, you will stray from the words of knowledge.

kikuyu: Dhuga baʼaan faayidaa hin qabne murtii qajeelaa tuffata; afaan hamootaa immoo hammina liqimsa.
english: A corrupt witness mocks justice, and the mouth of the wicked gulps down iniquity.

kikuyu: Qoostotaaf adabbii, dugda gowwootaatiif immoo rukuttaatu qopheeffama.
english: Penalties are prepared for scoffers, and beatings for the backs of fools.

kikuyu: Daadhiin wayinii nama qoostuu, dhugaatiin cimaan immoo waccuu nama godha; namni isaaniin fudhatamus ogeessa miti.
english: Wine is a mocker and beer is a brawler. Whoever is led astray by them is not wise.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsi mootii akkuma aaduu leencaa ti; namni isa aarsus lubbuu ofii isaa dhaba.
english: The terror of a king is like the roaring of a lion. He who provokes him to anger forfeits his own life.

kikuyu: Lola irraa fagaachuun ulfina; gowwaan hundi garuu lolatti ariifata.
english: It is an honor for a man to keep aloof from strife, but every fool will be quarreling.

kikuyu: Dhibaaʼaan yeroodhaan hin qotatu; kanaafuu inni yeroo haamaatti ni ilaala malee homaa hin argatu.
english: The sluggard will not plow by reason of the winter; therefore he shall beg in harvest, and have nothing.

kikuyu: Yaadni qalbii namaa akkuma bishaan gad fagoo ti; hubataan namaa garuu ni waraabbata.
english: Counsel in the heart of man is like deep water, but a man of understanding will draw it out.

kikuyu: Namni hedduun akka jaalala hin dhumne qabu dubbata; nama amanamaa garuu eenyutu argachuu dandaʼa?
english: Many men claim to be men of unfailing love, but who can find a faithful man?

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan amanamummaadhaan jiraata; ijoolleen isaa warri booddee dhalatanis ni eebbifamu.
english: A righteous man walks in integrity. Blessed are his children after him.

kikuyu: Mootiin tokko yeroo murtii kennuuf teessoo isaa irra taaʼutti, waan hamaa hunda ijuma isaatiin gingilchee addaan baasa.
english: A king who sits on the throne of judgment scatters away all evil with his eyes.

kikuyu: Eenyutu, “Ani garaa koo qulqulleeffadheera; ani qulqulluu dha; cubbuus hin qabu” jechuu dandaʼa?
english: Who can say, “I have made my heart pure. I am clean and without sin”?

kikuyu: Madaalii jalʼaa fi safartuu jalʼaa lamaanuu Waaqayyo ni balfa.
english: Differing weights and differing measures, both of them alike are an abomination to the LORD.

kikuyu: Mucaan xinnaan iyyuu amalli isaa qulqulluu fi qajeelaa taʼuun isaa hojii isaatiin beekama.
english: Even a child makes himself known by his doings, whether his work is pure, and whether it is right.

kikuyu: Gurra dhagaʼuu fi ija argu, lachanuu Waaqayyotu uume.
english: The hearing ear, and the seeing eye, the LORD has made even both of them.

kikuyu: Akka hin hiyyoomneef, hirriba hin jaallatin; midhaan akka quuftuuf, dammaqii jiraadhu.
english: Don’t love sleep, lest you come to poverty. Open your eyes, and you shall be satisfied with bread.

kikuyu: Namni waa bitatu, “Wanni kun gaarii miti; wanni kun gaarii miti!” jedha; ergasii immoo dhaqee waaʼee waan bitate sanaa boona.
english: “It’s no good, it’s no good,” says the buyer; but when he is gone his way, then he boasts.

kikuyu: Warqeen ni jira; lulli diimaanis baayʼinaan jira; arrabni beekumsa dubbatu garuu faaya gatii guddaa ti.
english: There is gold and abundance of rubies, but the lips of knowledge are a rare jewel.

kikuyu: Nama nama ormaatiif wabii taʼe irraa uffata isaa fudhadhu; yoo inni dubartii ormaatiif wabii taʼes uffata sana qabdii qabadhu.
english: Take the garment of one who puts up collateral for a stranger; and hold him in pledge for a wayward woman.

kikuyu: Nyaanni gowwoomsaadhaan argame namatti miʼaawa; dhuma irratti garuu afaan nama sanaa cirrachatu guuta.
english: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.

kikuyu: Gorsaan karoora baafadhu; qajeelfama ogummaatiin waraana bani.
english: Plans are established by advice; by wise guidance you wage war!

kikuyu: Hamattuun icciitii baafti; kanaafuu odeessituu wajjin tokkummaa hin qabaatin.
english: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.

kikuyu: Namni tokko yoo abbaa isaa yookaan haadha isaa abaare, ibsaan isaa dukkana hamaa keessatti dhaama.
english: Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.

kikuyu: Dhaalli jalqabumatti dafee argame dhumni isaa eebba hin qabaatu.
english: An inheritance quickly gained at the beginning won’t be blessed in the end.

kikuyu: Ati, “Yakka ati hojjette kanaaf ani gatii kee siifin kenna!” hin jedhin; Waaqayyoon eeggadhu; inni si baasa.
english: Don’t say, “I will pay back evil.” Wait for the LORD, and he will save you.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo madaalii jalʼaa ni balfa; safartuu sobaattis hin gammadu.
english: The LORD detests differing weights, and dishonest scales are not pleasing.

kikuyu: Adeemsi namaa Waaqayyoon qajeelfama. Yoos namni kam iyyuu akkamiin karaa ofii isaa hubachuu dandaʼa ree?
english: A man’s steps are from the LORD; how then can man understand his way?

kikuyu: Namni utuu itti hin yaadin, “Wanni kun Waaqaaf qulqulleeffameera” jedhee ergasii immoo waan wareege sana gaabbe kiyyoo isatti taʼa.
english: It is a snare to a man to make a rash dedication, then later to consider his vows.

kikuyu: Mootiin ogeessi hamoota gingilchee addaan baasa; geengoo ittiin midhaan dhaʼan illee isaan irra oofa.
english: A wise king winnows out the wicked, and drives the threshing wheel over them.

kikuyu: Ibsaan Waaqayyoo hafuura namaa sakattaʼa; inni keessa namaa illee isumaan qora.
english: The spirit of man is the LORD’s lamp, searching all his innermost parts.

kikuyu: Jaalallii fi amanamummaan mootii tokko nagaan jiraachisu; teessoon mootummaa isaas jaalalaan eegama.
english: Love and faithfulness keep the king safe. His throne is sustained by love.

kikuyu: Ulfinni dargaggootaa jabina isaanii ti; arriin mataa kabaja nama umuriin dheeratee ti.
english: The glory of young men is their strength. The splendor of old men is their gray hair.

kikuyu: Abootteen nama madeessu hammina nama irraa qulqulleessa; garaffiin immoo keessa namaa geeddara.
english: Wounding blows cleanse away evil, and beatings purge the innermost parts.

kikuyu: Yaadni mootii akkuma yaaʼaa bishaanii harka Waaqayyoo keessa jira; innis garuma fedhetti qajeelcha.
english: The king’s heart is in the LORD’s hand like the watercourses. He turns it wherever he desires.

kikuyu: Karaan namaa hundinuu ija ofii isaa duratti qajeelaa itti fakkaata; Waaqayyo garuu yaada namaa madaala.
english: Every way of a man is right in his own eyes, but the LORD weighs the hearts.

kikuyu: Fuula Waaqayyoo duratti aarsaa caalaa, waan qajeelaa fi sirrii taʼe hojjechuutu fudhatama qaba.
english: To do righteousness and justice is more acceptable to the LORD than sacrifice.

kikuyu: Iji of jajuu fi garaan of tuuluu maasii hamootaa kan hin qotaminii dha; innis cubbuu dhala.
english: A high look and a proud heart, the lamp of the wicked, is sin.

kikuyu: Karoorri nama tattaaffatuu buʼaa argamsiisa; namni ariifatu garuu ni hiyyooma.
english: The plans of the diligent surely lead to profit; and everyone who is hasty surely rushes to poverty.

kikuyu: Qabeenyi arraba sobuun argamu, urrii bittinnaaʼee baduu fi kiyyoo duʼaa ti.
english: Getting treasures by a lying tongue is a fleeting vapor for those who seek death.

kikuyu: Sababii isaan waan qajeelaa hojjechuu didaniif, fincilli hamootaa isaanuma balleessa.
english: The violence of the wicked will drive them away, because they refuse to do what is right.

kikuyu: Karaan nama balleessaa qabuu jalʼaa dha; amalli nama qulqulluu garuu qajeelaa dha.
english: The way of the guilty is devious, but the conduct of the innocent is upright.

kikuyu: Niitii nyakkiftuu wajjin mana tokko keessa jiraachuu mannaa, golee bantii manaa irra jiraachuu wayya.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan jalʼina dharraʼa; ollaan isaa gara laafina tokko iyyuu isa irraa hin argatu.
english: The soul of the wicked desires evil; his neighbor finds no mercy in his eyes.

kikuyu: Yeroo namni qoosu tokko adabamutti, wallaalaan ogummaa argata; namni ogeessi yeroo gorfamutti beekumsa argata.
english: When the mocker is punished, the simple gains wisdom. When the wise is instructed, he receives knowledge.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan mana hamootaa qalbeeffatee ilaala; hamootas ni balleessa.
english: The Righteous One considers the house of the wicked, and brings the wicked to ruin.

kikuyu: Namni tokko yoo iyya hiyyeessaatiif gurra kennuu dide, innis ni iyya; deebiis hin argatu.
english: Whoever stops his ears at the cry of the poor, he will also cry out, but shall not be heard.

kikuyu: Wanni dhoksaadhaan namaaf kennan aarii qabbaneessa; mattaʼaan harka bobaa jalaatiin kennanis dheekkamsa guddaa gab godha.
english: A gift in secret pacifies anger, and a bribe in the cloak, strong wrath.

kikuyu: Murtii qajeelaa kennuun qajeeltotaaf gammachuu kenna; hamootatti immoo raafama fida.
english: It is joy to the righteous to do justice; but it is a destruction to the workers of iniquity.

kikuyu: Namni karaa hubannaa irraa badu kam iyyuu waldaa warra duʼaniitti dabalama.
english: The man who wanders out of the way of understanding shall rest in the assembly of the departed spirits.

kikuyu: Namni qananii jaallatu ni deega; kan daadhii wayiniitii fi zayitii jaallatu immoo hin sooromu.
english: He who loves pleasure will be a poor man. He who loves wine and oil won’t be rich.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan nama qajeelaadhaaf, kan hin amanamne immoo nama tolaadhaaf furii taʼa.
english: The wicked is a ransom for the righteous, the treacherous for the upright.

kikuyu: Niitii nyakkiftuu fi kan daftee aartu wajjin jiraachuu mannaa, gammoojjii keessa jiraachuu wayya.
english: It is better to dwell in a desert land, than with a contentious and fretful woman.

kikuyu: Mana nama ogeessaa keessa qabeenya gatii guddaatii fi zayitiitu jira; gowwaan garuu waan qabu hunda nyaatee fixa.
english: There is precious treasure and oil in the dwelling of the wise, but a foolish man swallows it up.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelummaa fi jaalala duukaa buʼu, jireenya, badhaadhummaa fi ulfina argata.
english: He who follows after righteousness and kindness finds life, righteousness, and honor.

kikuyu: Namni ogeessi magaalaa nama jabaatti baʼee daʼoo jabaa inni amanatu jalaa diiga.
english: A wise man scales the city of the mighty, and brings down the strength of its confidence.

kikuyu: Namni afaan isaatii fi arraba isaa eeggatu, balaa irraa of eega.
english: Whoever guards his mouth and his tongue keeps his soul from troubles.

kikuyu: Nama of jajuu fi of tuulu maqaan isaa, “Qoostuu dha;” inni akka malee koora.
english: The proud and arrogant man—“Scoffer” is his name— he works in the arrogance of pride.

kikuyu: Sababii harki isaa hojii hojjechuu hin jaallanneef, hawwiin nama dhibaaʼaa duʼa isatti fida.
english: The desire of the sluggard kills him, for his hands refuse to labor.

kikuyu: Inni guyyaa guutuu kajeela; namni qajeelaan garuu utuu hin qusatin kenna.
english: There are those who covet greedily all day long; but the righteous give and don’t withhold.

kikuyu: Aarsaan nama hamaa balfamaa dha; yoos yoo inni yaada hamaadhaan dhiʼeesse hammam sana caalaa haa balfamu ree!
english: The sacrifice of the wicked is an abomination— how much more, when he brings it with a wicked mind!

kikuyu: Dhuga baatuun sobaa ni bada; namni isa dhagaʼu kam iyyuus bara baraan bada.
english: A false witness will perish. A man who listens speaks to eternity.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan ija jabaata; namni tolaan garuu karaa isaa qajeelfata.
english: A wicked man hardens his face; but as for the upright, he establishes his ways.

kikuyu: Ogummaan, hubannaanii fi karoorri Waaqayyoon mormee milkaaʼuu hin jiru.
english: There is no wisdom nor understanding nor counsel against the LORD.

kikuyu: Fardi guyyaa waraanaatiif qopheeffama; moʼichi garuu kan Waaqayyoo ti.
english: The horse is prepared for the day of battle; but victory is with the LORD.

kikuyu: Maqaan gaariin badhaadhummaa guddaa caalaa filatamaa dha; kabajamuunis meetii fi warqee caala.
english: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.

kikuyu: Wanni sooressaa fi hiyyeessa wal fakkeessu kanaa dha: Uumaan hunda isaanii Waaqayyoo dha.
english: The rich and the poor have this in common: The LORD is the maker of them all.

kikuyu: Namni hubataan balaa argee jalaa dhokata; wallaalaan immoo ittuma deemee adabama.
english: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

kikuyu: Gad of qabiisnii fi Waaqayyoon sodaachuun, qabeenya, ulfinaa fi jireenya namaa kennu.
english: The result of humility and the fear of the LORD is wealth, honor, and life.

kikuyu: Karaa hamootaa irra qoraattii fi kiyyootu jira; namni lubbuu isaa eeggatu garuu waan kana irraa fagaatee jiraata.
english: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.

kikuyu: Daaʼima tokko karaa inni irra deemuu qabu barsiisi; inni gaafa dulloome iyyuu karaa sana irraa hin jalʼatu.
english: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.

kikuyu: Sooressi hiyyeessa bulcha; liqeeffataan garbicha liqeessituu ti.
english: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.

kikuyu: Namni hammina facaasu rakkina haammata; uleen aarii isaas ni hurraaʼaa.
english: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.

kikuyu: Namni arjaan waan nyaata isaa hiyyeeyyiif qooduuf ofii isaatii ni eebbifama.
english: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.

kikuyu: Qoostuu of biraa ariʼi; lolli ni qabbanaaʼaa; wal diddaa fi arrabsoonis hin jiraatu.
english: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.

kikuyu: Nama qulqullina garaa jaallatuu fi dubbiin isaa namatti tolu mootiin michuu isaaf taʼa.
english: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.

kikuyu: Iji Waaqayyoo xiyyeeffatee beekumsa ilaala; inni garuu dubbii nama hin amanamnee ni busheessa.
english: The LORD’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.

kikuyu: Dhibaaʼaan, “Leenci ala jira! Ani karaa gubbaatti nan ajjeefama!” jedha.
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”

kikuyu: Afaan ejjituu boolla gad fagoo dha; namni dheekkamsa Waaqayyoo jala jiru achi keessa buʼa.
english: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under the LORD’s wrath will fall into it.

kikuyu: Gowwummaan yaada daaʼimaa keessatti hidhameera; uleen ittiin adaban garuu irraa fageessa.
english: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.

kikuyu: Namni qabeenya isaa guddifachuuf jedhee hiyyeessa hacuucuu fi kan sooressaaf kennaa kennu ni deega.
english: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.

kikuyu: Qalbeeffadhuutii waan namni ogeessi jedhu dhaggeeffadhu; yaada kees gara waan ani barsiisuutti deebifadhu;
english: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.

kikuyu: yoo ati qalbiitti qabattee hunduma isaa hidhii kee irratti qopheeffatte wanni kun nama gammachiisaatii.
english: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.

kikuyu: Akka abdiin kee Waaqayyo taʼuuf ani harʼa suma mataa kee iyyuu nan barsiisa.
english: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in the LORD.

kikuyu: Ani jecha soddoma, jecha gorsaatii fi beekumsaa siif hin barreessinee?
english: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,

kikuyu: Kanas ani akka ati warra si erganiif deebii dhugaa kennituuf waan qajeelaa fi dhugaa si argisiisuufin barreesse mitii?
english: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?

kikuyu: Ati sababii inni hiyyeessa taʼeef jettee hiyyeessa hin saamin; rakkataas mana murtiitti hin cunqursin;
english: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;

kikuyu: Waaqayyo dubbii isaanii ni ilaalaaf; jireenya warra isaan saamaniis ni saamaatii.
english: for the LORD will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.

kikuyu: Nama dafee aaru michuu hin godhatin; nama akka salphaatti dheekkamu wajjinis tokkummaa hin qabaatin;
english: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,

kikuyu: yoo kana goote karaa isaa baratta; ofii kees kiyyootti galchita.
english: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.

kikuyu: Nama harka dhaʼee waadaa galu yookaan nama liqii namaatiif wabii taʼu hin taʼin;
english: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.

kikuyu: yoo ati waan baaftu dhabde, sireen kee iyyuu si jalaa fudhatama.
english: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?

kikuyu: Dhagaa daarii durii, kan abbootiin kee dhaaban hin dhiibin.
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.

kikuyu: Nama hojii isaa keessatti ogummaa qabu argitee? Inni fuula moototaa dura dhaabata; fuula namoota kaanii dura garuu hin dhaabatu.
english: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.

kikuyu: Ati yeroo waa nyaachuuf bulchaa tokko wajjin teessutti, waan fuula kee dura jiru hubadhuu ilaali;
english: When you sit to eat with a ruler, consider diligently what is before you;

kikuyu: ati yoo nyaataaf fedhii guddaa qabaatte, qoonqoo kee irra billaa kaaʼi.
english: put a knife to your throat if you are a man given to appetite.

kikuyu: Waan nyaanni sun nama gowwoomsuuf, miʼaa isaatti hin gaggabin.
english: Don’t be desirous of his dainties, since they are deceitful food.

kikuyu: Sooromuuf jettee of hin dadhabsiisin; of qabuufis ogummaa qabaadhu.
english: Don’t weary yourself to be rich. In your wisdom, show restraint.

kikuyu: Sooromni yommuu ati ija irra buufattutti ni bada; inni dhugumaan Baallee baafatee akkuma risaa gara samiitti ol barrisaatii.
english: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.

kikuyu: Buddeena doqnaa hin nyaatin; cidha isaas hin kajeelin;
english: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies,

kikuyu: inni yeroo hunda waaʼee gatii yaadaatii. Inni, “Nyaadhuu dhugi” siin jedha; garaan isaa garuu si wajjin hin jiru.
english: for as he thinks about the cost, so he is. “Eat and drink!” he says to you, but his heart is not with you.

kikuyu: Ati waanuma xinnoo nyaatte sana ni diddigda; dubbii kee gaarii sana illee ni dhabda.
english: You will vomit up the morsel which you have eaten and waste your pleasant words.

kikuyu: Sababii inni ogummaa dubbii keetii tuffatuuf ati nama gowwaatti hin dubbatin.
english: Don’t speak in the ears of a fool, for he will despise the wisdom of your words.

kikuyu: Dhagaa daangaa durii hin dhiibin yookaan lafa qotiisaa ijoollee abbaa hin qabneetti hin darbin.
english: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone. Don’t encroach on the fields of the fatherless,

kikuyu: Furiin isaanii jabaadhaatii; inni gara isaanii goree sitti falma.
english: for their Defender is strong. He will plead their case against you.

kikuyu: Qalbii kee gara gorsaatti, gurra kee immoo gara dubbii beekumsaatti deebifadhu.
english: Apply your heart to instruction, and your ears to the words of knowledge.

kikuyu: Ijoollee kee adabachuu hin dhiisin; yoo ati arcummeedhaan adabde isaan hin duʼan.
english: Don’t withhold correction from a child. If you punish him with the rod, he will not die.

kikuyu: Arcummeedhaan isaan adabiitii lubbuu isaanii duʼa oolchi.
english: Punish him with the rod, and save his soul from Sheol.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, yoo garaan kee ogeessa taʼe, garaan koo ni gammada;
english: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.

kikuyu: yoo arrabni kee waan qajeelaa dubbate, keessi koo baayʼee gammada.
english: Yes, my heart will rejoice when your lips speak what is right.

kikuyu: Garaan kee cubbamootatti hin hinaafin; garuu yeroo hunda Waaqayyoon sodaadhu.
english: Don’t let your heart envy sinners, but rather fear the LORD all day long.

kikuyu: Ati dhugumaan gara fuulduraatti abdii qabda; abdiin kees hin citu.
english: Indeed surely there is a future hope, and your hope will not be cut off.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, dhaggeeffadhu; ogeessa taʼi; qalbii kee daandii qajeelaa irra buufadhu.
english: Listen, my son, and be wise, and keep your heart on the right path!

kikuyu: Warra daadhii wayinii baayʼee dhuganitti yookaan warra foonitti gaggabanitti hin makamin;
english: Don’t be among ones drinking too much wine, or those who gorge themselves on meat;

kikuyu: machooftuu fi albaadheyyiin ni hiyyoomu; hirriba baayʼisuunis moofaa nama uffachiisa.
english: for the drunkard and the glutton shall become poor; and drowsiness clothes them in rags.

kikuyu: Abbaa kee kan si dhalche dhagaʼi; haadha kees yeroo isheen jaartu hin tuffatin.
english: Listen to your father who gave you life, and don’t despise your mother when she is old.

kikuyu: Dhugaa bitadhu malee hin gurgurin; ogummaa, qajeelfamaa fi hubannaas bitadhu.
english: Buy the truth, and don’t sell it. Get wisdom, discipline, and understanding.

kikuyu: Abbaan nama qajeelaa gammachuu guddaa qaba; namni ilma ogeessa qabu isatti gammada.
english: The father of the righteous has great joy. Whoever fathers a wise child delights in him.

kikuyu: Abbaan keetii fi haati kee haa gammadan; isheen si deesse sun haa ililchitu!
english: Let your father and your mother be glad! Let her who bore you rejoice!

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, garaa kee naa kenni; iji kees karaa koo haa ilaalu;
english: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.

kikuyu: sagaagaltuun boolla gad fagoodhaatii, niitiin ganda labeenis boolla bishaanii dhiphaa dha.
english: For a prostitute is a deep pit; and a wayward wife is a narrow well.

kikuyu: Isheen akkuma saamtuutti riphxee nama eeggatti; namoota gidduuttis warra hin amanamne baayʼifti.
english: Yes, she lies in wait like a robber, and increases the unfaithful among men.

kikuyu: Eenyutu, “Anaaf wayyoo!” jedha? Eenyutu gadda qaba? Eenyutu lola qaba? Eenyutu komii qaba? Eenyutu sababii malee madaaʼa? Kan iji isaa diimatu eenyu?
english: Who has woe? Who has sorrow? Who has strife? Who has complaints? Who has needless bruises? Who has bloodshot eyes?

kikuyu: Warra daadhii wayinii dhuguu irra akka malee turan, warra daadhii wayinii walmakaa afaaniin qabuu dhaqanii dha.
english: Those who stay long at the wine; those who go to seek out mixed wine.

kikuyu: Yeroo inni diimatutti, yeroo inni billillee keessa ol xixinniqutti, yeroo inni suuta jedhee gad buʼutti daadhii wayinii ija itti qabdee hin ilaalin.
english: Don’t look at the wine when it is red, when it sparkles in the cup, when it goes down smoothly.

kikuyu: Dhuma irratti akkuma bofaa nama idda; akkuma buutiis nama ciniina.
english: In the end, it bites like a snake, and poisons like a viper.

kikuyu: Iji kee waan haaraa arga; qalbiin kees jalʼina yaada.
english: Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.

kikuyu: Ati akkuma nama walakkaa galaana guddaa ciisuu ti; akkuma nama fiixee utubaa doonii irra ciisuu taata.
english: Yes, you will be as he who lies down in the middle of the sea, or as he who lies on top of the rigging:

kikuyu: Ati akkana jetta; “Isaan na dhaʼan; ani garuu hin miidhamne! Isaan na tuman; garuu natti hin dhagaʼamne! Ani dhugaatii biraa barbaaddachuuf yooman dammaqa?”
english: “They hit me, and I was not hurt! They beat me, and I don’t feel it! When will I wake up? I can do it again. I will look for more.”

kikuyu: Hamootatti hin hinaafin; garee isaanii taʼuus hin hawwin;
english: Don’t be envious of evil men, neither desire to be with them;

kikuyu: garaan isaanii hammina malataatii; hidhiin isaaniis rakkina odeessa.
english: for their hearts plot violence and their lips talk about mischief.

kikuyu: Manni ogummaadhaan ijaarama; hubannaadhaanis jabeeffamee dhaabama;
english: Through wisdom a house is built; by understanding it is established;

kikuyu: kutaawwan isaas, beekumsaan, qabeenya gatii guddaatii fi miidhagaadhaan guutamu.
english: by knowledge the rooms are filled with all rare and beautiful treasure.

kikuyu: Ogeessi humna guddaa qaba; beekaan namaa immoo jabina itti dabalata;
english: A wise man has great power. A knowledgeable man increases strength,

kikuyu: waraana banuuf qajeelfama, moʼannaa argachuudhaaf immoo gorsitoota hedduu si barbaachisa.
english: for by wise guidance you wage your war, and victory is in many advisors.

kikuyu: Gowwaa irraa ogummaan akka malee ol fagoo dha; inni karra duratti afaan isaa hin saaqqatu.
english: Wisdom is too high for a fool. He doesn’t open his mouth in the gate.

kikuyu: Namni hammina malu, “Maltee” jedhama.
english: One who plots to do evil will be called a schemer.

kikuyu: Malli gowwummaa cubbuu dha; namoonnis qoostuu ni balfu.
english: The schemes of folly are sin. The mocker is detested by men.

kikuyu: Ati yoo gaafa rakkinaa laafte, jabinni kee dhugumaanuu xinnaa dha!
english: If you falter in the time of trouble, your strength is small.

kikuyu: Warra gara duʼaatti geeffamaa jiran duʼa jalaa baasi; warra ajjeefamuuf qopheeffamanis oolchi.
english: Rescue those who are being led away to death! Indeed, hold back those who are staggering to the slaughter!

kikuyu: Yoo ati, “Nu waan kana homaa hin beekne” jette, inni yaada namaa madaalu sun hin hubatuu? Kan lubbuu kee eegu sun waan kana hin beekuu? Inni nama hundaaf akkuma hojii isaatti gatii hin kennuu?
english: If you say, “Behold, we didn’t know this,” doesn’t he who weighs the hearts consider it? He who keeps your soul, doesn’t he know it? Shall he not give to every man according to his work?

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, dammi waan gaarii taʼeef nyaadhu; nadhiin dammaa sitti ni miʼaawa.
english: My son, eat honey, for it is good, the droppings of the honeycomb, which are sweet to your taste;

kikuyu: Akka ogummaan lubbuu keetti miʼaawu illee beeki; ati yoo isa argatte fuul duratti abdii qabda; abdiin kees hin citu.
english: so you shall know wisdom to be to your soul. If you have found it, then there will be a reward: Your hope will not be cut off.

kikuyu: Akka nama seeraan hin bulleetti mana nama qajeelaa riphxee hin eeggatin; mana jireenya isaas hin saamin.
english: Don’t lay in wait, wicked man, against the habitation of the righteous. Don’t destroy his resting place;

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan yeroo torba kufu iyyuu, deebiʼee ni kaʼaatii; namni hamaan garuu yeroo balaan itti dhufutti ni gufata.
english: for a righteous man falls seven times and rises up again, but the wicked are overthrown by calamity.

kikuyu: Yeroo diinni kee kufutti hin ililchin; yeroo inni gufatuttis garaan kee hin gammadin;
english: Don’t rejoice when your enemy falls. Don’t let your heart be glad when he is overthrown,

kikuyu: yoo kanaa achii Waaqayyo waan kanatti ni gaddaatii; dheekkamsa isaas isa irraa deebisa.
english: lest the LORD see it, and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.

kikuyu: Ati sababii jalʼootaatiif aariidhaan hin gubatin; hamootattis hin hinaafin.
