english: Don’t fret yourself because of evildoers, neither be envious of the wicked;

kikuyu: Namni jalʼaan fuul duratti abdii hin qabuutii; ibsaan hamootaas ni dhaama.
english: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, Waaqayyoo fi mootii sodaadhu; finciltootattis hin makamin;
english: My son, fear the LORD and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious,

kikuyu: badiisni akkuma tasaa isaanitti dhufaatii; balaa isaan lachuu fidan eenyutu beeka?
english: for their calamity will rise suddenly. Who knows what destruction may come from them both?

kikuyu: Kunneenis jechoota ogeessaa ti: Murtii kennuu irratti nama wal caalchisuun gaarii miti:
english: These also are sayings of the wise: To show partiality in judgment is not good.

kikuyu: Kan nama yakka qabuun, “Ati balleessaa hin qabdu” jedhu kam iyyuu namni isa abaara; sabnis isa balaaleffata.
english: He who says to the wicked, “You are righteous,” peoples will curse him, and nations will abhor him—

kikuyu: Warri nama yakka hojjetu ifatan garuu ni gammadu; eebbi guddaanis ni dhufaaf.
english: but it will go well with those who convict the guilty, and a rich blessing will come on them.

kikuyu: Deebiin qajeelaan, akkuma hidhii dhungachuu ti.
english: An honest answer is like a kiss on the lips.

kikuyu: Hojii kee kan diidaa raawwadhuutii lafa qotiisaa kees qopheeffadhu; ergasii mana kee ijaarradhu.
english: Prepare your work outside, and get your fields ready. Afterwards, build your house.

kikuyu: Sababii tokko malee ollaa keetti dhugaa hin baʼin yookaan hidhii keetiin hin gowwoomsin.
english: Don’t be a witness against your neighbor without cause. Don’t deceive with your lips.

kikuyu: Ati, “Waanuma inni na godhe anis isa nan godha; waan inni hojjeteefis gatii isaa nan deebisa” hin jedhin.
english: Don’t say, “I will do to him as he has done to me; I will repay the man according to his work.”

kikuyu: Ani lafa qotiisaa nama dhibaaʼaa keessa baʼee, iddoo dhaabaa wayinii nama qalbii hin qabnee keessas darbe;
english: I went by the field of the sluggard, by the vineyard of the man void of understanding.

kikuyu: qoraattiin lafa hunda guuteera; laftis aramaadhaan fudhatameera; dallaan dhagaas diigameera.
english: Behold, it was all grown over with thorns. Its surface was covered with nettles, and its stone wall was broken down.

kikuyu: Ani argeen waan sana qalbeeffadhe; waanan arge sana irraas barumsa nan argadhe:
english: Then I saw, and considered well. I saw, and received instruction:

kikuyu: hirriba xinnaa; mugaatii xinnaa; xinnoo harka walitti marachuu;
english: a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep,

kikuyu: hiyyummaanis akkuma hattuutti, deegummaanis akkuma loltuu hidhateetti sitti dhufa.
english: so your poverty will come as a robber and your want as an armed man.

kikuyu: Fakkeenyawwan kunneen fakkeenyawwan Solomoon kanneen namoonni Hisqiyaas, mooticha Yihuudaa garagalchanii dha:
english: These also are proverbs of Solomon, which the men of Hezekiah king of Judah copied out.

kikuyu: Waa dhoksuun Waaqaaf ulfina isaa ti; waa sakattaʼanii bira gaʼuun immoo ulfina moototaa ti.
english: It is the glory of God to conceal a thing, but the glory of kings is to search out a matter.

kikuyu: Akkuma samiiwwan ol dheeratanii laftis gad fagaatu sana, yaadni moototaa qoratamee bira hin gaʼamu.
english: As the heavens for height, and the earth for depth, so the hearts of kings are unsearchable.

kikuyu: Meetii irraa xurii baasi; ergasii tumtuun qodaa tolchuu dandaʼa.
english: Take away the dross from the silver, and material comes out for the refiner.

kikuyu: Nama hamaa fuula mootii duraa balleessi; ergasii teessoon isaa qajeelummaadhaan ni jabaata.
english: Take away the wicked from the king’s presence, and his throne will be established in righteousness.

kikuyu: Fuula mootii duratti ol of hin qabin; iddoo namoota gurguddaas hin dhaabatin;
english: Don’t exalt yourself in the presence of the king, or claim a place among great men;

kikuyu: inni fuula namoota bebeekamoo duratti si salphisuu irra, yoo inni, “As ol kottu” siin jedhe wayyaa. Ati waan ija keetiin argite,
english: for it is better that it be said to you, “Come up here,” than that you should be put lower in the presence of the prince, whom your eyes have seen.

kikuyu: daftee mana murtiitti hin fidin; yoo ollaan kee si qaanesse, dhuma irratti ati maal gochuu dandeessa?
english: Don’t be hasty in bringing charges to court. What will you do in the end when your neighbor shames you?

kikuyu: Dhimma kee ollaa kee wajjin falmadhu; iccitii nama kaanii immoo hin baasin;
english: Debate your case with your neighbor, and don’t betray the confidence of another,

kikuyu: yoo kanaa achii namni waan sana dhagaʼee si qaanessa; maqaan hamaan siif kenname sunis sirraa hin baʼu.
english: lest one who hears it put you to shame, and your bad reputation never depart.

kikuyu: Dubbiin yeroo isaatti dubbatame, akkuma hudhaa warqee kan meetii irratti hojjetamee ti.
english: A word fitly spoken is like apples of gold in settings of silver.

kikuyu: Ifanni nama ogeessaa gurra dhaggeeffatuuf, lootii warqee yookaan faaya warqee qulqulluu ti.
english: As an earring of gold, and an ornament of fine gold, so is a wise reprover to an obedient ear.

kikuyu: Ergamaan amanamaan tokko warra isa ergataniif akkuma qabbana cabbii kan yeroo midhaan haamanii ti; inni hafuura gooftota isaa haaromsaatii.
english: As the cold of snow in the time of harvest, so is a faithful messenger to those who send him; for he refreshes the soul of his masters.

kikuyu: Namni kennaa namaaf hin kennineen boonu tokko akkuma duumessaa fi bubbee bokkaa hin qabnee ti.
english: As clouds and wind without rain, so is he who boasts of gifts deceptively.

kikuyu: Obsaan bulchaa tokko garaa laafifachuun ni dandaʼama; dubbiin malaan dubbatame lafee ni cabsa.
english: By patience a ruler is persuaded. A soft tongue breaks the bone.

kikuyu: Damma yoo argatte hamma si gaʼu nyaadhu; yoo baayʼiftee nyaatte ni diddigda.
english: Have you found honey? Eat as much as is sufficient for you, lest you eat too much, and vomit it.

kikuyu: Mana ollaa keetii dhaquu hin baayʼisin; yoo ati miilla itti baayʼifte inni si jibba.
english: Let your foot be seldom in your neighbor’s house, lest he be weary of you, and hate you.

kikuyu: Namni sobaan ollaa isaatti dhugaa baʼu, akkuma bokkuu yookaan goraadee yookaan xiyya qara qabuu ti.
english: A man who gives false testimony against his neighbor is like a club, a sword, or a sharp arrow.

kikuyu: Nama hin amanamne tokko yeroo rakkootti abdachuun akkuma ilkaan cabee yookaan miilla okkoluu ti.
english: Confidence in someone unfaithful in time of trouble is like a bad tooth or a lame foot.

kikuyu: Nama garaan isaa gaddeef sirba sirbuun akkuma nama guyyaa dhaamochaa wayyaa of irraa baasuu, yookaan madaa irratti dhangaggaaʼaa dhangalaasuu ti.
english: As one who takes away a garment in cold weather, or vinegar on soda, so is one who sings songs to a heavy heart.

kikuyu: Yoo diinni kee beelaʼe waan inni nyaatu kenniif; yoo inni dheebotes bishaan inni dhugu kenniif.
english: If your enemy is hungry, give him food to eat. If he is thirsty, give him water to drink;

kikuyu: Kana gochuu keetiin barbadaa ibiddaa mataa isaa irra tuulta; Waaqayyos si badhaasa.
english: for you will heap coals of fire on his head, and the LORD will reward you.

kikuyu: Akkuma bubbeen kaabaa bokkaa fidu, arrabni hamatus fuula dheekkamu fida.
english: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.

kikuyu: Niitii nyakkiftuu wajjin mana tokko keessa jiraachuu mannaa, golee bantii manaa irra jiraachuu wayya.
english: It is better to dwell in the corner of the housetop than to share a house with a contentious woman.

kikuyu: Oduun gaariin biyya fagootii dhufu, akkuma bishaan qabbanaaʼaa lubbuu dheebotteef taʼuu ti.
english: Like cold water to a thirsty soul, so is good news from a far country.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan fuula hamootaa duratti kufu, akkuma burqaa dhoqqaaʼee yookaan boolla bishaanii faalame tokkoo ti.
english: Like a muddied spring and a polluted well, so is a righteous man who gives way before the wicked.

kikuyu: Damma baayʼee nyaachuun gaarii miti; ulfina mataa ofii barbaaduunis ulfina miti.
english: It is not good to eat much honey, nor is it honorable to seek one’s own honor.

kikuyu: Namni of hin qabne, akkuma magaalaa dallaan isaa diigamee ti.
english: Like a city that is broken down and without walls is a man whose spirit is without restraint.

kikuyu: Akkuma cabbii yeroo bonaa yookaan bokkaa yeroo haamaa, nama gowwaaf ulfinni hin malu.
english: Like snow in summer, and as rain in harvest, so honor is not fitting for a fool.

kikuyu: Akkuma simbirri barriftu yookaan daaloteen barriftu abaarsi sababii malee dhufu nama irra hin buʼu.
english: Like a fluttering sparrow, like a darting swallow, so the undeserved curse doesn’t come to rest.

kikuyu: Alangaan fardaaf, luugamni harreef, uleen immoo dugda gowwaatiif mala!
english: A whip is for the horse, a bridle for the donkey, and a rod for the back of fools!

kikuyu: Gowwaadhaaf akka gowwummaa isaatti hin deebisin; yoo akkas goote ati mataan kee iyyuu akkuma isaa taata.
english: Don’t answer a fool according to his folly, lest you also be like him.

kikuyu: Gowwaadhaaf deebii gowwummaa isaatiif malu kenni; yoo kanaa achii inni ogeessa of seʼaa.
english: Answer a fool according to his folly, lest he be wise in his own eyes.

kikuyu: Harka nama gowwaatti ergaa ergachuun, akkuma miilla ofii irraa muruu yookaan summii dhuguu ti.
english: One who sends a message by the hand of a fool is cutting off feet and drinking violence.

kikuyu: Afaan nama gowwaa keessatti, fakkeenyi akkuma miilla naafaa ti.
english: Like the legs of the lame that hang loose, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

kikuyu: Namni gowwaadhaaf ulfina kennu, akkuma nama furrisaatti dhagaa guduunfuu ti.
english: As one who binds a stone in a sling, so is he who gives honor to a fool.

kikuyu: Fakkeenyi afaan gowwaa keessatti akkuma qoraattii harka nama machaaʼee keessaa ti.
english: Like a thorn bush that goes into the hand of a drunkard, so is a parable in the mouth of fools.

kikuyu: Namni gowwaa yookaan kara deemaa qaxaratu akkuma adamsaa nama hunda xiyyaan madeessuu ti.
english: As an archer who wounds all, so is he who hires a fool or he who hires those who pass by.

kikuyu: Akkuma sareen diddiga isheetti deebitu sana, gowwaan gowwummaa isaa irra deddeebiʼa.
english: As a dog that returns to his vomit, so is a fool who repeats his folly.

kikuyu: Ati nama akka ilaalcha ofii isaatti ogeessa taʼe argitaa? Isa irra gowwaatu abdii caalu qaba.
english: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

kikuyu: Dhibaaʼaan, “Leenci karaa irra jira; leenci sodaachisaan daandii irra jira!” jedha.
english: The sluggard says, “There is a lion in the road! A fierce lion roams the streets!”

kikuyu: Akkuma saanqaan muchoo isaa irra naannaʼu, dhibaaʼaan siree ofii irra gaggaragala
english: As the door turns on its hinges, so does the sluggard on his bed.

kikuyu: Dhibaaʼaan harka isaa waciitii keessa kaaʼa; gara afaan isaatti deebifachuuf ni dhibaaʼa.
english: The sluggard buries his hand in the dish. He is too lazy to bring it back to his mouth.

kikuyu: Dhibaaʼaan namoota hubannaadhaan deebii kennan torba caalaa ogeessa of seʼa.
english: The sluggard is wiser in his own eyes than seven men who answer with discretion.

kikuyu: Namni lola nama biraa keessa seenu, akkuma nama harkaan gurra saree qabuu ti.
english: Like one who grabs a dog’s ears is one who passes by and meddles in a quarrel not his own.

kikuyu: Akkuma maraatuu ibidda yookaan xiyya namatti gad dhiisu tokkoo
english: Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,

kikuyu: namni, “Ani nan qoose!” jedhee ollaa isaa gowwoomsus akkasuma.
english: is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”

kikuyu: Ibiddi yoo qoraan dhabe ni dhaama; hamiin yoo hin jiraanne, lolli ni qabbanaaʼa.
english: For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.

kikuyu: Akkuma cileen barbadaa ibiddaa bobeessee qoraan ibidda qabsiisu sana namni lola jaallatu lola kakaasa.
english: As coals are to hot embers, and wood to fire, so is a contentious man to kindling strife.

kikuyu: Dubbiin hamattuu akkuma gurshaa miʼaawuu ti; gara kutaa garaattis gad buʼa.
english: The words of a whisperer are as dainty morsels, they go down into the innermost parts.

kikuyu: Dubbiin gaariin garaa hamaa keessaa baʼu akkuma okkotee meetiin irra dibamee ti.
english: Like silver dross on an earthen vessel are the lips of a fervent one with an evil heart.

kikuyu: Namni maqaa namaa balleessu tokko arrabuma ofiitiin nama tolaa of fakkeessa; garaa isaa keessatti immoo gowwoomsaa guduunfata.
english: A malicious man disguises himself with his lips, but he harbors evil in his heart.

kikuyu: Yoo dubbiin isaa sitti miʼaawe iyyuu isa hin amanin; wanni jibbisiisaan torba garaa isaa guuteeraatii.
english: When his speech is charming, don’t believe him, for there are seven abominations in his heart.

kikuyu: Jalʼinni isaa sobaan haguugamee dhokfamuu dandaʼa; hamminni isaa garuu fuula waldaa duratti ifatti baʼa.
english: His malice may be concealed by deception, but his wickedness will be exposed in the assembly.

kikuyu: Namni boolla qotu boolla keessa buʼa; nama dhagaa gangalchus, dhagaan sun isumatti deebiʼa.
english: Whoever digs a pit shall fall into it. Whoever rolls a stone, it will come back on him.

kikuyu: Arrabni sobu tokko warruma miidhu sana jibba; afaan saadu tokkos badiisa fida.
english: A lying tongue hates those it hurts; and a flattering mouth works ruin.

kikuyu: Ati waaʼee boriitiin hin boonin; waan guyyaan fidu hin beektuutii.
english: Don’t boast about tomorrow; for you don’t know what a day may bring.

kikuyu: Namni biraa si haa jaju malee ati afaan keetiin of hin jajin; namni kaan si haa jajuu malee hidhiin kee si hin jajin.
english: Let another man praise you, and not your own mouth; a stranger, and not your own lips.

kikuyu: Dhagaan ni ulfaata; cirrachis baʼaa dha; tuttuqaan gowwaa garuu lachuu caalaa ulfaata.
english: A stone is heavy, and sand is a burden; but a fool’s provocation is heavier than both.

kikuyu: Dheekkamsi gara jabeessa; aariinis guutee dhangalaʼa; hinaaffaa dura garuu eenyutu dhaabachuu dandaʼa?
english: Wrath is cruel, and anger is overwhelming; but who is able to stand before jealousy?

kikuyu: Jaalala dhokfamee mannaa ifannaa ifatti baʼe wayya.
english: Better is open rebuke than hidden love.

kikuyu: Madaan michuun nama madeessu amanamaa dha; dhungachuun diinaa garuu gowwoomsaa dha.
english: The wounds of a friend are faithful, although the kisses of an enemy are profuse.

kikuyu: Namni quufe damma illee ni balfa; kan beelaʼe garuu wanni hadhaaʼu iyyuu itti miʼaawa.
english: A full soul loathes a honeycomb; but to a hungry soul, every bitter thing is sweet.

kikuyu: Namni mana isaatii badu tokko, akkuma simbirroo manʼee isheetii badduu ti.
english: As a bird that wanders from her nest, so is a man who wanders from his home.

kikuyu: Shittoo fi ixaanni garaa nama gammachiisu; gorsi michuus garaa nama ciibsa.
english: Perfume and incense bring joy to the heart; so does earnest counsel from a man’s friend.

kikuyu: Michoota keetii fi michoota abbaa keetii hin gatin; yoo balaan sitti dhufe mana obboleessa keetii hin dhaqin; obboleessa fagoo jiru irra ollaa dhiʼoo jiru wayya.
english: Don’t forsake your friend and your father’s friend. Don’t go to your brother’s house in the day of your disaster. A neighbor who is near is better than a distant brother.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma ko, ogeessa taʼiitii garaa koo gammachiisi; ergasii ani nama na tuffatu hundaaf deebii kennuu nan dandaʼa.
english: Be wise, my son, and bring joy to my heart, then I can answer my tormentor.

kikuyu: Namni hubataan balaa argee jalaa dhokata; wallaalaan immoo ittuma deemee adabama.
english: A prudent man sees danger and takes refuge; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.

kikuyu: Nama nama ormaatiif wabii taʼe irraa uffata isaa fudhadhu; yoo inni dubartii ormaatiif wabii taʼes uffata sana qabdii qabadhu.
english: Take his garment when he puts up collateral for a stranger. Hold it for a wayward woman!

kikuyu: Namni tokko ganamaan sagalee ol fudhatee ollaa isaa yoo eebbise wanni sun akka abaarsaatti fudhatama.
english: He who blesses his neighbor with a loud voice early in the morning, it will be taken as a curse by him.

kikuyu: Niitiin nyakkiftuun, akkuma bokkaa guyyaa roobaa dhimmisaa ooluu ti;
english: A continual dropping on a rainy day and a contentious wife are alike:

kikuyu: ishee ittisuun akkuma bubbee ittisuu ti yookaan akkuma zayitii harkaan qabuu ti.
english: restraining her is like restraining the wind, or like grasping oil in his right hand.

kikuyu: Akkuma sibiilli sibiila qaru, namni tokko nama kaan qara.
english: Iron sharpens iron; so a man sharpens his friend’s countenance.

kikuyu: Namni muka harbuu eeggatu tokko ija isaa nyaata; namni gooftaa isaa eeggatus ulfina argata.
english: Whoever tends the fig tree shall eat its fruit. He who looks after his master shall be honored.

kikuyu: Akkuma bishaan fuula namaa argisiisu sana garaan nama tokkoo eenyummaa namichaa argisiisa.
english: Like water reflects a face, so a man’s heart reflects the man.

kikuyu: Duʼaa fi Badiisni gonkumaa hin quufan; iji namaas akkasuma.
english: Sheol and Abaddon are never satisfied; and a man’s eyes are never satisfied.

kikuyu: Okkoteen waa itti baqsan meetiif; boolli ibiddaa immoo warqeef; namni immoo ulfina argatuun qorama.
english: The crucible is for silver, and the furnace for gold; but man is refined by his praise.

kikuyu: Gowwaa mooyyee keessatti yoo tumte iyyuu, akkuma midhaaniitti muka mooyyeetiin isa bulleessite iyyuu, ati gowwummaa isa irraa hin balleessitu.
english: Though you grind a fool in a mortar with a pestle along with grain, yet his foolishness will not be removed from him.

kikuyu: Haala bushaayeen kee keessa jiran sirriitti beeki; loon keetiifis xiyyeeffannaa kenni;
english: Know well the state of your flocks, and pay attention to your herds,

kikuyu: soorumni bara baraan itti hin fufuutii; gonfoonis dhaloota irraa dhalootatti hin darbu.
english: for riches are not forever, nor does the crown endure to all generations.

kikuyu: Yeroo okaan haamamee biqilaa haaraan jalaan biqilee margi tulluu irraa walitti qabamutti,
english: The hay is removed, and the new growth appears, the grasses of the hills are gathered in.

kikuyu: xobbaallaawwaniin daara baata; reʼoonni immoo gatii lafa qotiisaa siif taʼu.
english: The lambs are for your clothing, and the goats are the price of a field.

kikuyu: Ati ofii keetii fi maatii kee, xomboreewwan kees ittiin jiraachisuuf aannan reʼootaa baayʼee ni qabaatta.
english: There will be plenty of goats’ milk for your food, for your family’s food, and for the nourishment of your servant girls.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan utuu namni tokko iyyuu isa hin ariʼin baqata; qajeeltonni garuu akkuma leencaa ija jabaatu.
english: The wicked flee when no one pursues; but the righteous are as bold as a lion.

kikuyu: Biyya fincilu keessa bulchitoota hedduutu jira; bulchaan hubataanii fi beekaan garuu seera eegsisa.
english: In rebellion, a land has many rulers, but order is maintained by a man of understanding and knowledge.

kikuyu: Bulchaan hiyyeessa hacuucu tokko akkuma bokkaa jabaa midhaan lafa irraa balleessuu ti.
english: A needy man who oppresses the poor is like a driving rain which leaves no crops.

kikuyu: Warri seera didan hamoota jaju; warri seera eegan garuu isaaniin mormu.
english: Those who forsake the law praise the wicked; but those who keep the law contend with them.

kikuyu: Jalʼoonni murtii qajeelaa hin hubatan; warri Waaqayyoon barbaadan immoo guutumaan guutuutti hubatu.
english: Evil men don’t understand justice; but those who seek the LORD understand it fully.

kikuyu: Sooressa karaan isaa jalʼaa taʼe mannaa hiyyeessa adeemsi isaa mudaa hin qabne wayya.
english: Better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his ways, and he is rich.

kikuyu: Namni seera eegu ilma ogeessa; michuun albaadhessaa immoo abbaa isaa qaanessa.
english: Whoever keeps the law is a wise son; but he who is a companion of gluttons shames his father.

kikuyu: Namni dhalaa fi hiiqiidhaan qabeenya isaa guddifatu kam iyyuu, nama hiyyeessaaf garaa laafuuf walitti qaba.
english: He who increases his wealth by excessive interest gathers it for one who has pity on the poor.

kikuyu: Nama seeraaf gurra kennuu didu kam iyyuu, kadhannaan isaa balfamaa dha.
english: He who turns away his ear from hearing the law, even his prayer is an abomination.

kikuyu: Namni nama tolaa karaa jalʼaa irra adeemsisu kam iyyuu kiyyoo ofii isaa keessa seena; namni balleessaa hin qabne garuu dhaala gaarii argata.
english: Whoever causes the upright to go astray in an evil way, he will fall into his own trap; but the blameless will inherit good.

kikuyu: Namni sooressi ogeessa of seʼa; hiyyeessi hubannaa qabu garuu isa qoree bira gaʼa.
english: The rich man is wise in his own eyes; but the poor who has understanding sees through him.

kikuyu: Yeroo namni qajeelaan moʼatutti gammachuu guddaatu taʼa; yeroo namni hamaan aangoo qabatutti garuu namoonni ni dhokatu.
english: When the righteous triumph, there is great glory; but when the wicked rise, men hide themselves.

kikuyu: Namni cubbuu ofii dhokfatu hin milkaaʼu; kan cubbuu isaa himatee irraa deebiʼu garuu araara argata.
english: He who conceals his sins doesn’t prosper, but whoever confesses and renounces them finds mercy.

kikuyu: Namni yeroo hunda Waaqayyoon sodaatu eebbifamaa dha; kan mataa jabaatu garuu rakkoo keessatti kufa.
english: Blessed is the man who always fears; but one who hardens his heart falls into trouble.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan hiyyeeyyii bulchu, akkuma leenca aaduu yookaan amaaketa wayitti ariifatuu ti.
english: As a roaring lion or a charging bear, so is a wicked ruler over helpless people.

kikuyu: Bulchaan akka malee nama cunqursu hubannaa hin qabu; kan buʼaa karaa hin malleen argamu jibbu garuu bara dheeraa jiraata.
english: A tyrannical ruler lacks judgment. One who hates ill-gotten gain will have long days.

kikuyu: Namni yakki dhiiga namaa dhangalaasuu isa irra jiru, boollatti baqata; namni tokko iyyuu isa hin gargaarin.
english: A man who is tormented by blood guilt will be a fugitive until death. No one will support him.

kikuyu: Namni adeemsi isaa mudaa hin qabne nagumaan jiraata; kan karaan isaa jalʼaa taʼe garuu boollatti kufa.
english: Whoever walks blamelessly is kept safe; but one with perverse ways will fall suddenly.

kikuyu: Namni lafa isaa qotatu nyaata guddaa argata; kan yaada faayidaa hin qabne duukaa buʼu garuu hiyyumaan guutama.
english: One who works his land will have an abundance of food; but one who chases fantasies will have his fill of poverty.

kikuyu: Namni amanamaan eebba quufa; kan sooromuutti gaggabu garuu adabbii jalaa hin baʼu.
english: A faithful man is rich with blessings; but one who is eager to be rich will not go unpunished.

kikuyu: Nama wal caalchisuun gaarii miti; namni garuu muraa buddeenaa argachuuf jedhee yakka hojjeta.
english: To show partiality is not good, yet a man will do wrong for a piece of bread.

kikuyu: Namni waa kajeelu sooromuuf jarjara; inni akka hiyyummaan isa eeggatu hin beeku.
english: A stingy man hurries after riches, and doesn’t know that poverty waits for him.

kikuyu: Namni nama ifatu dhuma irratti nama arrabaan nama saadu caalaa surraa argata.
english: One who rebukes a man will afterward find more favor than one who flatters with the tongue.

kikuyu: Namni abbaa yookaan haadha isaa saamee, “Kun balleessaa miti” jedhu garee nama waa balleessuu ti.
english: Whoever robs his father or his mother and says, “It’s not wrong,” is a partner with a destroyer.

kikuyu: Namni wayitti gaggabu lola kakaasa; kan Waaqayyoon amanatu garuu ni badhaadha.
english: One who is greedy stirs up strife; but one who trusts in the LORD will prosper.

kikuyu: Namni of amanatu gowwaa dha; kan ogummaadhaan deemu immoo nagaadhaan jiraata.
english: One who trusts in himself is a fool; but one who walks in wisdom is kept safe.

kikuyu: Namni hiyyeessaaf kennu waan tokko illee hin dhabu; kan ija dunuunfatu garuu abaarsa baayʼee argata.
english: One who gives to the poor has no lack; but one who closes his eyes will have many curses.

kikuyu: Yeroo namni hamaan aangoo qabatutti namoonni ni dhokatu; yeroo namni hamaan badutti garuu qajeeltonni ni baayʼatu.
english: When the wicked rise, men hide themselves; but when they perish, the righteous thrive.

kikuyu: Namni ifannaa baayʼee booddee mataa jabaatu kam iyyuu akkuma tasaa caba; hin fayyus.
english: He who is often rebuked and stiffens his neck will be destroyed suddenly, with no remedy.

kikuyu: Yommuu namni qajeelaan aangoo qabatutti, sabni ni ililcha; yommuu namni hamaan bulchu garuu sabni ni guunguma.
english: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; but when the wicked rule, the people groan.

kikuyu: Namni ogummaa jaallatu abbaa isaa gammachiisa; miiltoon sagaagaltuu garuu qabeenya isaa barbadeessa.
english: Whoever loves wisdom brings joy to his father; but a companion of prostitutes squanders his wealth.

kikuyu: Mootiin murtii qajeelaadhaan biyyaaf nagaa buusa; kan mattaʼaaf gaggabu immoo biyya gargar qoqqooda.
english: The king by justice makes the land stable, but he who takes bribes tears it down.

kikuyu: Namni ollaa isaa jaju, miilluma isaatiif kiyyoo kaaʼa.
english: A man who flatters his neighbor spreads a net for his feet.

kikuyu: Namni hamaan cubbuu ofii isaatiin qabama; qajeelaan garuu ni faarfata; ni ililchas.
english: An evil man is snared by his sin, but the righteous can sing and be glad.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan mirga hiyyeessaatiif dhaabata; namni hamaan garuu dhimma akkanaa hin qabu.
english: The righteous care about justice for the poor. The wicked aren’t concerned about knowledge.

kikuyu: Qoostonni magaalaa jeequ; ogeeyyiin garuu aarii qabbaneessu.
english: Mockers stir up a city, but wise men turn away anger.

kikuyu: Yoo ogeessi gowwaa wajjin mana murtii dhaqe, gowwaan sun ni aara yookaan ni kolfa; nagaanis hin jiraatu.
english: If a wise man goes to court with a foolish man, the fool rages or scoffs, and there is no peace.

kikuyu: Namoonni dhiiga dheebotan, nama amanamaa jibbu; nama tolaas ajjeesuu barbaadu.
english: The bloodthirsty hate a man of integrity; and they seek the life of the upright.

kikuyu: Gowwaan guutumaan guutuutti aariitti of kenna; ogeessi garuu of qaba.
english: A fool vents all of his anger, but a wise man brings himself under control.

kikuyu: Yoo bulchaan tokko soba dhaggeeffate, qondaaltonni isaa hundi ni hammaatu.
english: If a ruler listens to lies, all of his officials are wicked.

kikuyu: Hiyyeessaa fi namni nama cunqursu waan kanaan wal fakkaatu: Waaqayyo ija lachan isaaniitiifuu agartuu kenna.
english: The poor man and the oppressor have this in common: The LORD gives sight to the eyes of both.

kikuyu: Yoo mootiin tokko wal qixxummaadhaan hiyyeeyyiif murtii kenne, teessoon isaa bara baraan jabaatee dhaabata.
english: The king who fairly judges the poor, his throne shall be established forever.

kikuyu: Ulee fi ifannaan ogummaa kennu; daaʼimni akkasumatti gad dhiifame garuu haadha isaa salphisa.
english: The rod of correction gives wisdom, but a child left to himself causes shame to his mother.

kikuyu: Yommuu hamoonni aangoo qabatan, cubbuutu baayʼata; qajeeltonni garuu kufaatii jaraa argu.
english: When the wicked increase, sin increases; but the righteous will see their downfall.

kikuyu: Ilma kee adabadhu, inni nagaa siif kenna; lubbuu kees ni gammachiisa.
english: Correct your son, and he will give you peace; yes, he will bring delight to your soul.

kikuyu: Iddoo mulʼanni hin jirretti sabni gad dhiisii taʼa; namni seera eegu garuu eebbifamaa dha.
english: Where there is no revelation, the people cast off restraint; but one who keeps the law is blessed.

kikuyu: Garbichi dubbii afaanii qofaan hin sirreeffamu; inni yoo hubate illee deebii hin kennuutii.
english: A servant can’t be corrected by words. Though he understands, yet he will not respond.

kikuyu: Ati nama jarjarsuun dubbatu argitee? Isa irra gowwaatu abdii caalu qaba.
english: Do you see a man who is hasty in his words? There is more hope for a fool than for him.

kikuyu: Nama garbicha ofii isaa ijoollummaa isaatii jalqabee qanansiisu, galgalli isaa rakkina.
english: He who pampers his servant from youth will have him become a son in the end.

kikuyu: Namni aaru lola kakaasa; kan dafee aarus cubbuu hedduu hojjeta.
english: An angry man stirs up strife, and a wrathful man abounds in sin.

kikuyu: Of tuulummaan namaa isuma gad deebisa; namni hafuuraan gad of qabu garuu ulfina argata.
english: A man’s pride brings him low, but one of lowly spirit gains honor.

kikuyu: Namni hattuu wajjin qooddatu lubbuu ofii isaa jibba; inni ni kakata; garuu waan tokko illee hin himu.
english: Whoever is an accomplice of a thief is an enemy of his own soul. He takes an oath, but dares not testify.

kikuyu: Nama sodaachuun kiyyoo namatti taʼa; kan Waaqayyoon amanatu garuu nagaadhaan jiraata.
english: The fear of man proves to be a snare, but whoever puts his trust in the LORD is kept safe.

kikuyu: Namni hedduun bulchaa biratti surraa argachuu barbaada; murtiin qajeelaan garuu Waaqayyo biraa dhufa.
english: Many seek the ruler’s favor, but a man’s justice comes from the LORD.

kikuyu: Qajeelaan sobduu xireeffata; hamaan immoo nama tolaa jibba.
english: A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.

kikuyu: Jecha Aguur ilma Yaaqee. Dubbiin nama kanaa akkana jedhee Iitiiʼeeliitti dubbatame: “Innis Iitiiʼeeliittii fi Ukaalitti dubbate:
english: The words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation: the man says to Ithiel, to Ithiel and Ucal:

kikuyu: Ani dhugumaan doofaa nama hundaa gadii ti; ani hubannaa namni qabu hin qabu.
english: “Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.

kikuyu: Ani ogummaa hin baranne yookaan beekumsa Isa Qulqulluu sanaa hin qabu.
english: I have not learned wisdom, neither do I have the knowledge of the Holy One.

kikuyu: Eenyutu samiitti ol baʼee deebiʼee dhufe? Kan harki isaa bubbee walitti qabe eenyu? Namni bishaan uffataan mare eenyu? Kan daarii lafaa hunda jabeessee dhaabe eenyu? Maqaan isaatii fi maqaan ilma isaa eenyu? Mee yoo beekte natti himi!
english: Who has ascended up into heaven, and descended? Who has gathered the wind in his fists? Who has bound the waters in his garment? Who has established all the ends of the earth? What is his name, and what is his son’s name, if you know?

kikuyu: “Dubbiin Waaqaa hundinuu hirʼina hin qabu; warra isatti kooluu galaniif, inni gaachana.
english: “Every word of God is flawless. He is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

kikuyu: Dubbii isaatti homaa hin dabalin; yoo kanaa achii inni si ifata; atis sobduu taatee argamta.
english: Don’t you add to his words, lest he reprove you, and you be found a liar.

kikuyu: “Yaa Waaqayyo ani wantoota lama sin kadhadha; isaanis utuu hamman jirutti ana hin dhowwatin.
english: “Two things I have asked of you. Don’t deny me before I die.

kikuyu: Gowwoomsaa fi soba narraa fageessi; hiyyummaa yookaan sooruma naaf hin kennin; garuu buddeena koo guyyaa guyyaan naaf kenni.
english: Remove far from me falsehood and lies. Give me neither poverty nor riches. Feed me with the food that is needful for me,

kikuyu: Yoo kanaa achii ani akka malee quufee si ganee ‘Waaqayyo eenyuu dha?’ nan jedha; yookaan hiyyoomee hatee, akkasiin maqaa Waaqa koo nan salphisa.
english: lest I be full, deny you, and say, ‘Who is the LORD?’ or lest I be poor, and steal, and so dishonor the name of my God.

kikuyu: “Garbicha tokko gooftaa isaa biratti hin hamatin, yoo kanaa achii inni si abaaraa; atis waan kanatti ni gaafatamta.
english: “Don’t slander a servant to his master, lest he curse you, and you be held guilty.

kikuyu: “Dhaloota abbaa isaa abaaru kan haadha isaa illee hin eebbifnetu jira;
english: There is a generation that curses their father, and doesn’t bless their mother.

kikuyu: dhaloota qulqulluu of seʼu, kan xurii isaa irraa hin qulqulleeffamintu jiru;
english: There is a generation that is pure in their own eyes, yet are not washed from their filthiness.

kikuyu: dhaloota iji isaa akka malee of tuulu, kan baalleen ija isaas nama tuffatutu jira;
english: There is a generation, oh how lofty are their eyes! Their eyelids are lifted up.

kikuyu: dhaloota hiyyeeyyii lafa irraa fixuuf rakkattoota illee gidduu namaatii balleessuuf ilkaan isaa goraadee, haʼoon isaa immoo billaa taʼe jira.
english: There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and the needy from among men.

kikuyu: “Dhulaandhulli intallan, ‘Kenni! Kenni!’ jedhanii iyyan lama qabdi. “Wantoota gonkumaa hin quufne sadiitu jira; kanneen gonkumaa, ‘Nu gaʼe!’ hin jenne immoo afurtu jira:
english: “The leech has two daughters: ‘Give, give.’ “There are three things that are never satisfied; four that don’t say, ‘Enough!’:

kikuyu: isaanis Siiʼool, gadameessa maseene, lafa gonkumaa bishaan hin quufnee fi ibidda gonkumaa, ‘Na gaʼe!’ hin jennee dha.
english: Sheol, the barren womb, the earth that is not satisfied with water, and the fire that doesn’t say, ‘Enough!’

kikuyu: “Ija abbaatti qoosu, kan ajaja haadhaa tuffatu arraagessa sululaatiin baafama; joobiraanis ni nyaatama.
english: “The eye that mocks at his father, and scorns obedience to his mother, the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, the young eagles shall eat it.

kikuyu: “Wantoonni akka malee na dinqisiisan sadiitu jira; afur immoo ani hin hubadhu; kunis:
english: “There are three things which are too amazing for me, four which I don’t understand:

kikuyu: Karaan risaa samii irra, karaan bofaa kattaa irra, karaan doonii galaana guddaa irra, karaan dhiiraa immoo dubartii wajjin taʼuu isaa ti.
english: The way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

kikuyu: “Karaan ejjituu kana: Isheen waa nyaattee afaan haqatti; ergasii immoo, ‘Ani homaa hin balleessine’ jetti.
english: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’

kikuyu: “Lafti waan sadii jalatti hollatti; afur immoo baachuu hin dandeessu; kunis:
english: “For three things the earth trembles, and under four, it can’t bear up:

kikuyu: Garbicha mootii taʼu, gowwaa nyaatee quufu,
english: For a servant when he is king, a fool when he is filled with food,

kikuyu: dubartiin jibbamte yeroo dhirsa argattu, garbittii giiftii ishee dhaaltu.
english: for an unloved woman when she is married, and a servant who is heir to her mistress.

kikuyu: “Wantoonni xixinnoon afur lafa irra jiru; taʼu illee isaan akka malee ogeeyyii dha; isaanis:
english: “There are four things which are little on the earth, but they are exceedingly wise:

kikuyu: Goondaawwan tuuta jabina hin qabnee dha; taʼus isaan yeroo bonaa nyaata isaanii walitti qaban;
english: The ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

kikuyu: osoleewwan uumamawwan humna hin qabnee dha; garuu kattaa keessa jiraatu;
english: The hyraxes are but a feeble folk, yet make they their houses in the rocks.

kikuyu: hawwaannisni mootii hin qabu; garuu tarree galee yaaʼa;
english: The locusts have no king, yet they advance in ranks.

kikuyu: loccuun harkaan qabamuu dandeessi; garuu masaraa mootii keessatti argamti.
english: You can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings’ palaces.

kikuyu: “Wantoota deemsa tolan sadiitu jira; kanneen tarkaanfii bareedanis afurtu jira; isaanis:
english: “There are three things which are stately in their march, four which are stately in going:

kikuyu: Leenca bineensa hunda keessaa jabaa, kan waan tokko illee sodaatee duubatti hin deebine;
english: The lion, which is mightiest among animals, and doesn’t turn away for any;

kikuyu: korma indaanqoo kan kooraa deemu, korbeessa reʼeetii fi, mootii loltoota isaa dura deemu.
english: the greyhound; the male goat; and the king against whom there is no rising up.

kikuyu: “Ati yoo of jajuudhaan gowwoomte, yookaan yoo hammina malatte, harka kee afaan kee irra kaaʼadhu!
english: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.

kikuyu: Akkuma aannan raasuun dhadhaa baasu, funyaan micciiruunis dhiiga baasu sana, aarii kakaasuun lola fida.”
english: For as the churning of milk produces butter, and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.”

kikuyu: Jecha Lemuuʼeel mootichaa kan haati isaa isa barsiifte:
english: The words of King Lemuel—the revelation which his mother taught him:

kikuyu: “Maali yaa ilma ko, maali yaa ilma gadameessa ko, maali yaa ilma wareega ko,
english: “Oh, my son! Oh, son of my womb! Oh, son of my vows!

kikuyu: humna kee dubartoota irratti, jabina kee warra mootota balleessan irratti hin fixin.
english: Don’t give your strength to women, nor your ways to that which destroys kings.

kikuyu: “Yaa Lemuuʼeel, wanni kun moototaaf hin malu; daadhii wayinii dhuguun moototaaf hin malu; dhugaatii cimaatti gaggabuunis bulchitootaaf hin malu;
english: It is not for kings, Lemuel, it is not for kings to drink wine, nor for princes to say, ‘Where is strong drink?’

kikuyu: kunis akka isaan dhuganii waan seerri jedhu dagatanii warra hacuucaman hunda mirga isaanii hin dhowwanneef.
english: lest they drink, and forget the law, and pervert the justice due to anyone who is afflicted.

kikuyu: Warra baduuf jiraniif dhugaatii cimaa, warra jireenyi itti hadhaaʼeef daadhii wayinii kenni;
english: Give strong drink to him who is ready to perish, and wine to the bitter in soul.

kikuyu: isaan dhuganii hiyyummaa isaanii haa irraanfatan; rakkina isaaniis deebiʼanii hin yaadatin.
english: Let him drink, and forget his poverty, and remember his misery no more.

kikuyu: “Warra ofii isaaniitiif dubbachuu hin dandeenyeef, mirga warra gatamaniitiifis falmi.
english: Open your mouth for the mute, in the cause of all who are left desolate.

kikuyu: Afaan kee banadhu; murtii qajeelaas kenni; mirga hiyyeeyyiitii fi rakkattootaatiif falmi.”
english: Open your mouth, judge righteously, and serve justice to the poor and needy.”

kikuyu: Niitii amala gaarii qabdu eenyutu argachuu dandaʼa? Isheen lula diimaa caalaa gati qabeettii dha.
english: Who can find a worthy woman? For her value is far above rubies.

kikuyu: Dhirsi ishee guddisee ishee amanata; inni waan faayidaa qabu tokko illee hin dhabu.
english: The heart of her husband trusts in her. He shall have no lack of gain.

kikuyu: Isheen bara jireenya ishee guutuu waan gaarii isaaf fiddi malee isa hin miitu.
english: She does him good, and not harm, all the days of her life.

kikuyu: Isheen suufii fi quncee talbaa barbaaddee harka ishee kan hojii jaallatuun footi.
english: She seeks wool and flax, and works eagerly with her hands.

kikuyu: Isheen akkuma doonii daldalaatti lafa fagoodhaa nyaata ishee fidatti.
english: She is like the merchant ships. She brings her bread from afar.

kikuyu: Isheen utuu lafti hin bariʼin hirribaa kaatee maatii isheetiif nyaata kenniti; xomboreewwan isheefis hojii qooddi.
english: She rises also while it is yet night, gives food to her household, and portions for her servant girls.

kikuyu: Isheen lafa qotiisaa hubattee ilaaltee bitti; waan hojjettee argattu keessaa wayinii dhaabdi.
english: She considers a field, and buys it. With the fruit of her hands, she plants a vineyard.

kikuyu: Isheen jabinaan mudhii ishee hidhattee hojiidhaaf irree ishee jabeeffatti.
english: She arms her waist with strength, and makes her arms strong.

kikuyu: Isheen akka daldalli ishee buʼaa qabu hubatti; ibsaan ishees halkaniin hin dhaamu.
english: She perceives that her merchandise is profitable. Her lamp doesn’t go out by night.

kikuyu: Mukni itti jirbii maran harka ishee keessa jira; quba isheetiin immoo calii qabatti.
english: She lays her hands to the distaff, and her hands hold the spindle.

kikuyu: Isheen hiyyeessaaf harka hiixatti; dhabaadhaaf illee harka balʼifti.
english: She opens her arms to the poor; yes, she extends her hands to the needy.

kikuyu: Yoo cabbiin buʼe illee isheen maatii isheetiif hin yaaddoftu; isaan hundinuu uffata bildiimaa uffataniiruutii.
english: She is not afraid of the snow for her household, for all her household are clothed with scarlet.

kikuyu: Isheen wayyaa siree dhaʼatti; uffata dhiilgee quncee talbaa haphii irraa hojjetames uffatti.
english: She makes for herself carpets of tapestry. Her clothing is fine linen and purple.

kikuyu: Dhirsi ishee yommuu karra magaalaa dura, jaarsolii biyyaa gidduu taaʼu ni kabajama.
english: Her husband is respected in the gates, when he sits among the elders of the land.

kikuyu: Isheen wayyaa quncee talbaa dhooftee gurgurti; daldaltootaafis sabbata dhiʼeessiti.
english: She makes linen garments and sells them, and delivers sashes to the merchant.

kikuyu: Isheen jabinaa fi ulfina uffatti; bara dhufaa jiruttis kolfuu dandeessi.
english: Strength and dignity are her clothing. She laughs at the time to come.

kikuyu: Afaan ishee ogummaadhaan banatti; gorsi gara laafinaas arraba ishee irra jira.
english: She opens her mouth with wisdom. Kind instruction is on her tongue.

kikuyu: Isheen mana ishee toʼatti; isheen buddeena dhibaaʼummaas hin nyaattu.
english: She looks well to the ways of her household, and doesn’t eat the bread of idleness.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen ishee kaʼanii, eebbifamtuu jedhuun; dhirsi ishees akkasuma jedhaan; akkana jedhees ishee jaja:
english: Her children rise up and call her blessed. Her husband also praises her:

kikuyu: “Dubartoonni hedduun waan gaarii hojjetu; ati garuu isaan hunda caalta.”
english: “Many women do noble things, but you excel them all.”

kikuyu: Simboon nama gowwoomsa; miidhaginnis ni darba; dubartiin Waaqayyoon sodaattu garuu galateeffamtuu dha.
english: Charm is deceitful, and beauty is vain; but a woman who fears the LORD, she shall be praised.

kikuyu: Buʼaa harka ishee kennaafii; hojiin ishee karra magaalaa duratti ishee haa jaju.
english: Give her of the fruit of her hands! Let her works praise her in the gates!

kikuyu: Dubbii lallabaa ilma Daawit, isa Yerusaalem keessaatti mootii taʼe sanaa:
english: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem:

kikuyu: Lallabichi, “Faayidaa hin qabu! Faayidaa hin qabu! Guutumaan guutuutti faayidaa hin qabu! Wanni hundinuu faayidaa hin qabu” jedha.
english: “Vanity of vanities,” says the Preacher; “Vanity of vanities, all is vanity.”

kikuyu: Namni hojii isaa kan aduudhaa gaditti itti dadhabu hunda keessaa, buʼaa maalii argata?
english: What does man gain from all his labor in which he labors under the sun?

kikuyu: Dhaloonni ni dhufa; dhaloonni ni darba; lafti garuu bara baraan jiraatti.
english: One generation goes, and another generation comes; but the earth remains forever.

kikuyu: Biiftuun ni baati; biiftuun ni lixxi; gara baate sanatti deebiʼuufis ni ariifatti.
english: The sun also rises, and the sun goes down, and hurries to its place where it rises.

kikuyu: Bubbeen gara kibbaatti bubbisa; gara kaabaattis ni deebiʼa; innis naannaʼuma naannaʼee deema; karaa isaa irras deddeebiʼa.
english: The wind goes toward the south, and turns around to the north. It turns around continually as it goes, and the wind returns again to its courses.

kikuyu: Lagni hundi galaanatti yaaʼa; galaanni garuu hin guutu. Lageen garuma dhufanitti deebiʼanii yaaʼu.
english: All the rivers run into the sea, yet the sea is not full. To the place where the rivers flow, there they flow again.

kikuyu: Wanni hundinuu hamma namni tokko dubbachuu dandaʼu caalaa dadhabsiisaa dha. Iji argee hin quufu; yookaan gurri dhagaʼee hin guutu.
english: All things are full of weariness beyond uttering. The eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

kikuyu: Wanni duraan ture ammas ni taʼa; wanni duraan hojjetame ammas ni hojjetama; aduudhaa gaditti wanni haaraan tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: That which has been is that which shall be, and that which has been done is that which shall be done; and there is no new thing under the sun.

kikuyu: Wanni namni tokko, “Ilaa! Wanni kun haaraa dha” jechuu dandaʼu kam iyyuu jiraa? Wanni kun duraanuu bara dheeraan dura as ture; bara keenyaan dura iyyuu asuma ture.
english: Is there a thing of which it may be said, “Behold, this is new”? It has been long ago, in the ages which were before us.

kikuyu: Namoonni bara durii hin yaadataman; kanneen dhufuuf jiranis warra isaan duubaan dhufaniin hin yaadataman.
english: There is no memory of the former; neither shall there be any memory of the latter that are to come, among those that shall come after.

kikuyu: Ani Lallabaan, Yerusaalem keessatti mootii Israaʼelin ture.
english: I, the Preacher, was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ani waan samii gaditti hojjetame hunda ogummaadhaan quʼadhee qoradhee bira gaʼuuf of kenneen ture. Waaqni baʼaa ulfaataa akkamii nama irra kaaʼe!
english: I applied my heart to seek and to search out by wisdom concerning all that is done under the sky. It is a heavy burden that God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

kikuyu: Ani waan aduudhaa gaditti hojjetame hunda argeera; hundi isaanii iyyuu faayidaa hin qaban; kun akkuma nama bubbee ariʼuu ti.
english: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and behold, all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Wanni jalʼifame tokko deebiʼee hin qajeelfamu; wanni hin jirres lakkaaʼamuu hin dandaʼu.
english: That which is crooked can’t be made straight; and that which is lacking can’t be counted.

kikuyu: Anis akkana jedheen yaade; “Kunoo, ani nama anaan dura Yerusaalemin bulchaa ture kam iyyuu caalaa guddadhee ogummaas dabaladheera; ani muuxannoo ogummaatii fi beekumsaa guddaa argadheera.”
english: I said to myself, “Behold, I have obtained for myself great wisdom above all who were before me in Jerusalem. Yes, my heart has had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani ogummaa, maraatummaa fi gowwummaa hubachuufin of kenne; garuu ani akka wanni kunis bubbee ariʼuu taʼe nan baradhe.
english: I applied my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly. I perceived that this also was a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Ogummaa guddaa keessa gadda baayʼeetu jiraatii; akkuma beekumsi dabalamuun gaddis dabalama.
english: For in much wisdom is much grief; and he who increases knowledge increases sorrow.

kikuyu: Ani garaa koo keessatti, “Ani waan gaarii barbaaduudhaaf gammachuudhaan sin qoraatii mee kottu” jedheen yaade. Garuu wanni kunis waan faayidaa hin qabne taʼuu isaa nan mirkaneeffadhe.
english: I said in my heart, “Come now, I will test you with mirth; therefore enjoy pleasure;” and behold, this also was vanity.

kikuyu: Anis, “Kolfi gowwummaa dha; gammachuunis maal fayyada?” nan jedhe.
english: I said of laughter, “It is foolishness;” and of mirth, “What does it accomplish?”

kikuyu: Anis utuma qalbiin koo ogummaadhaan na qajeelchaa jiruu gowwummaa qabadhee daadhii wayiniitiin of gammachiisu nan yaale. Waan namoonni bara jireenya isaanii muraasa keessatti samii gaditti hojjetan arguu nan fedhe.
english: I searched in my heart how to cheer my flesh with wine, my heart yet guiding me with wisdom, and how to lay hold of folly, until I might see what it was good for the sons of men that they should do under heaven all the days of their lives.

kikuyu: Ani hojii guddaa nan hojjedhe: Manneen ijaarradhee wayiniis dhaabadhe.
english: I made myself great works. I built myself houses. I planted myself vineyards.

kikuyu: Ani iddoo biqiltuutii fi iddoo bashannanaa qopheeffadhee mukkeen ija naqatan kanneen gosa hundaa achi keessa nan dhaabadhe.
english: I made myself gardens and parks, and I planted trees in them of all kinds of fruit.

kikuyu: Bosona mukkeen guddachaa jiranii ittiin obaafachuufis kuusaa bishaanii nan qopheeffadhe.
english: I made myself pools of water, to water the forest where trees were grown.

kikuyu: Ani garboota dhiiraa fi dubartii nan bitadhe; garboota mana kootti dhalatan biraas nan qabaadhe; nama naan dura Yerusaalem keessa jiraate kam iyyuu caalaas loonii fi bushaayee hedduu nan horadhe.
english: I bought male servants and female servants, and had servants born in my house. I also had great possessions of herds and flocks, above all who were before me in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ani meetii fi warqee, qabeenya moototaatii fi kutaawwan biyyaa walitti nan qabadhe. Ani faarfattoota dhiiraa fi dubartii akkasumas saajjatoowwan nama gammachiisan hedduu qaban ture.
english: I also gathered silver and gold for myself, and the treasure of kings and of the provinces. I got myself male and female singers, and the delights of the sons of men: musical instruments of all sorts.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani akka malee guddadhee nama anaan dura Yerusaalem keessa ture kam iyyuu caale. Waan kana hunda keessatti ogummaan koo anuma wajjin ture.
english: So I was great, and increased more than all who were before me in Jerusalem. My wisdom also remained with me.

kikuyu: Ani waan iji koo hawwe hunda isa hin dhowwine; garaa koos gammachuu tokko illee hin lagne. Garaan koo hojii koo hundatti gammade; kunis dadhabbii koo hundaaf badhaasa ture.
english: Whatever my eyes desired, I didn’t keep from them. I didn’t withhold my heart from any joy, for my heart rejoiced because of all my labor, and this was my portion from all my labor.

kikuyu: Taʼus ani yeroon waan harki koo hojjete hundaa fi waanan argachuuf jedhee itti dadhabe hubadhee ilaaletti, wanni hundi akkuma bubbee ariʼuuti malee faayidaa hin qabu ture; aduudhaa gaditti buʼaan tokko iyyuu hin turre.
english: Then I looked at all the works that my hands had worked, and at the labor that I had labored to do; and behold, all was vanity and a chasing after wind, and there was no profit under the sun.

kikuyu: Anis yaada koo gara ogummaa, maraatummaa fi gowwummaa hubachuutti nan deebifadhe. Namni mootii iddoo buʼu tokko waan duraan hojjetame caalaa maal gochuu dandaʼa?
english: I turned myself to consider wisdom, madness, and folly; for what can the king’s successor do? Just that which has been done long ago.

kikuyu: Ani akkuma ifni dukkana irra wayyu sana, akka ogummaan gowwummaa irra wayyu nan arge.
english: Then I saw that wisdom excels folly, as far as light excels darkness.

kikuyu: Ogeessi mataa isaa keessaa ija qaba; gowwaan garuu dukkana keessa deema; ani garuu akka galgalli isaan lamaanii tokkuma taʼe nan hubadhe.
english: The wise man’s eyes are in his head, and the fool walks in darkness—and yet I perceived that one event happens to them all.

kikuyu: Ergasii ani akkana jedheen garaa koo keessatti nan yaade; “Wanni gowwaa quunname, anaanis ni quunnama; yoos ani ogeessa taʼuudhaan maalan argadha ree?” Ani garaa koo keessatti, “Kunis faayidaa hin qabu” nan jedhe.
english: Then I said in my heart, “As it happens to the fool, so will it happen even to me; and why was I then more wise?” Then I said in my heart that this also is vanity.

kikuyu: Ogeessi akkuma gowwaa yeroo dheeraaf hin yaadatamuutii; bara dhufuuf jiru keessa isaan lachuu ni irraanfatamu. Ogeessis akkuma gowwaa duʼuu qaba!
english: For of the wise man, even as of the fool, there is no memory forever, since in the days to come all will have been long forgotten. Indeed, the wise man must die just like the fool!

kikuyu: Sababii wanni aduu gaditti hojjetamu na gaddisiiseef ani jireenya nan jibbe; kun hundinuu bubbee ariʼuu dha; faayidaas hin qabu.
english: So I hated life, because the work that is worked under the sun was grievous to me; for all is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Ani sababii nama ana duubaan dhufuuf waan kana dhiisuu qabuuf, waanan aduudhaa gaditti itti dadhabe hunda nan jibbe.
english: I hated all my labor in which I labored under the sun, because I must leave it to the man who comes after me.

kikuyu: Eenyutu akka inni ogeessa yookaan gowwaa taʼu beeka? Taʼus inni hojii ani aduudhaa gaditti yaalii fi ogummaa koo itti dhangalaase hundatti abbaa taʼa. Kunis faayidaa hin qabu.
english: Who knows whether he will be a wise man or a fool? Yet he will have rule over all of my labor in which I have labored, and in which I have shown myself wise under the sun. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu garaan koo sababii hojii koo dadhabsiisaa ani aduudhaa gaditti itti dadhabe hundaatiif abdii kutachuu jalqabe.
english: Therefore I began to cause my heart to despair concerning all the labor in which I had labored under the sun.

kikuyu: Namni tokko hojii isaa ogummaan, beekumsaa fi harka toliisaan hojjetee ergasii immoo waan qabu hunda nama homaa itti hin dadhabiniif dhiisuu qabaatii. Wanni kunis faayidaa hin qabu; hammina guddaadhas.
english: For there is a man whose labor is with wisdom, with knowledge, and with skillfulness; yet he shall leave it for his portion to a man who has not labored for it. This also is vanity and a great evil.

kikuyu: Namni tokko dadhabbii isaatiif yaalii cimaa aduudhaa gaditti godhe sana hundaaf maal argata?
english: For what does a man have of all his labor and of the striving of his heart, in which he labors under the sun?

kikuyu: Hojiin isaa bara jireenya isaa hunda rakkinaa fi gadda; sammuun isaa halkan iyyuu hin boqotu. Kunis waan faayidaa hin qabnee dha.
english: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: Namni nyaatee dhugee hojii isaatti gammaduu caalaa homaa gochuu hin dandaʼu. Ani akka wanni kun harka Waaqaatii dhufe nan arge;
english: There is nothing better for a man than that he should eat and drink, and make his soul enjoy good in his labor. This also I saw, that it is from the hand of God.

kikuyu: Waaqaan malee eenyutu nyaachuu yookaan gammaduu dandaʼa?
english: For who can eat, or who can have enjoyment, more than I?

kikuyu: Waaqni nama isa gammachiisuuf ogummaa, beekumsaa fi gammachuu kenna; nama cubbamaa garuu akka inni namicha Waaqa gammachiisuuf kennuuf jedhee hojii qabeenya walitti qabuutii fi kuusuu hojjetu godha. Kunis bubbee ariʼuu dha; faayidaas hin qabu.
english: For to the man who pleases him, God gives wisdom, knowledge, and joy; but to the sinner he gives travail, to gather and to heap up, that he may give to him who pleases God. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Wanni hundinuu yeroo qaba; hojiin samiidhaa gaditti hojjetamu hundis waqtii qaba:
english: For everything there is a season, and a time for every purpose under heaven:

kikuyu: Dhalachuuf yeroo qaba; duʼuufis yeroo qaba; dhaabuuf yeroo qaba; buqqisuufis yeroo qaba;
english: a time to be born, and a time to die; a time to plant, and a time to pluck up that which is planted;

kikuyu: ajjeesuuf yeroo qaba; fayyisuufis yeroo qaba; diiguuf yeroo qaba; ijaaruufis yeroo qaba;
english: a time to kill, and a time to heal; a time to break down, and a time to build up;

kikuyu: booʼuuf yeroo qaba; kolfuufis yeroo qaba; gadduuf yeroo qaba; sirbuufis yeroo qaba;
english: a time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;

kikuyu: dhagaa bittinneessuuf yeroo qaba; walitti qabuufis yeroo qaba; hammachuuf yeroo qaba; hammachuu dhiisuufis yeroo qaba;
english: a time to cast away stones, and a time to gather stones together; a time to embrace, and a time to refrain from embracing;

kikuyu: barbaaduuf yeroo qaba; barbaaduu dhiisuufis yeroo qaba; kaaʼuuf yeroo qaba; gatuufis yeroo qaba;
english: a time to seek, and a time to lose; a time to keep, and a time to cast away;

kikuyu: tarsaasuuf yeroo qaba; hodhuufis yeroo qaba; calʼisuuf yeroo qaba; dubbachuufis yeroo qaba;
english: a time to tear, and a time to sew; a time to keep silence, and a time to speak;

kikuyu: jaallachuun yeroo qaba; jibbuufis yeroo qaba; loluuf yeroo qaba; nagaafis yeroo qaba.
english: a time to love, and a time to hate; a time for war, and a time for peace.

kikuyu: Hojjetaan tokko dadhabbii isaa irraa buʼaa maalii argata?
english: What profit has he who works in that in which he labors?

kikuyu: Ani baʼaa Waaqni namoota irra kaaʼe argeera.
english: I have seen the burden which God has given to the sons of men to be afflicted with.

kikuyu: Inni waan hunda yeruma isaatti miidhagsee tolcheera. Akkasumas yaada baraa baraa garaa namootaa keessa kaaʼe. Taʼus isaan waan Waaqni jalqabaa hamma dhumaatti hojjete beekuu hin dandaʼan.
english: He has made everything beautiful in its time. He has also set eternity in their hearts, yet so that man can’t find out the work that God has done from the beginning even to the end.

kikuyu: Ani akka namootaaf bara jireenya isaanii keessa wanni gammaduu fi waan gaarii hojjechuu caalu tokko iyyuu hin jirre nan beeka.
english: I know that there is nothing better for them than to rejoice, and to do good as long as they live.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon namaa nyaatee dhugee buʼaa hojii isaa hundatti gammaduun kennaa Waaqaa ti.
english: Also that every man should eat and drink, and enjoy good in all his labor, is the gift of God.

kikuyu: Ani akka wanni Waaqni hojjetu hundi bara baraan jiraatu beeka; wanni tokko illee itti hin dabalamu; wanni tokko iyyuus irraa hin fudhatamu. Waaqni akka namoonni isa sodaataniif waan kana godha.
english: I know that whatever God does, it shall be forever. Nothing can be added to it, nor anything taken from it; and God has done it, that men should fear before him.

kikuyu: Wanni amma jiru kam iyyuu duraanuu tureera; wanni dhufuuf jirus duraanuu jira ture; Waaqni waan darbes deebisee fida.
english: That which is has been long ago, and that which is to be has been long ago. God seeks again that which is passed away.

kikuyu: Anis aduudhaa gaditti waan biraa nan arge; kunis: Iddoo murtiin qajeelaan jiraachuu malu, hamminatu ture; iddoo qajeelummaan jiraachuu malu immoo jalʼinatu ture.
english: Moreover I saw under the sun, in the place of justice, that wickedness was there; and in the place of righteousness, that wickedness was there.

kikuyu: Ani garaa koo keessatti akkana jedheen yaade; “Waaqni qajeeltotaa fi hamoota, gara murtiitti ni fida; wanni hundinuu, hojiin hundinuus yeroo ni qabaatii.”
english: I said in my heart, “God will judge the righteous and the wicked; for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.”

kikuyu: Ani amma illee akkana jedhee garaa koo keessatti nan yaade; “Waaqni akka isaan akkuma bineensotaa taʼuu isaanii arganiif ilmaan namaa qora.
english: I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.

kikuyu: Wanni nama irra gaʼu, bineensota irras ni gaʼa; lachan isaanii iyyuu waanuma tokkotu eeggata; akkuma inni tokko duʼu, inni kaanis ni duʼa. Hundi isaanii hafuuruma tokko qabu; namni bineensa caalaa faayidaa argatu tokko illee hin qabu. Wanni hundinuu faayidaa hin qabu.
english: For that which happens to the sons of men happens to animals. Even one thing happens to them. As the one dies, so the other dies. Yes, they have all one breath; and man has no advantage over the animals, for all is vanity.

kikuyu: Isaan hundi idduma tokko dhaqu; hundinuu biyyoo irraa dhufan; hundinuus biyyootti deebiʼu.
english: All go to one place. All are from the dust, and all turn to dust again.

kikuyu: Akka hafuurri namaa ol baʼee hafuurri bineensaa immoo lafa keessa seenu eenyutu beeka?”
english: Who knows the spirit of man, whether it goes upward, and the spirit of the animal, whether it goes downward to the earth?”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani sababii wanni sun ixaa isaa taʼeef akka namaaf wanni hojii isaatti gammaduu caalu tokko iyyuu hin jirre nan arge. Akka inni waan isa duubaan taʼu arguuf eenyutu isa fiduu dandaʼa?
english: Therefore I saw that there is nothing better than that a man should rejoice in his works, for that is his portion; for who can bring him to see what will be after him?

kikuyu: Ani ammas ilaalee cunqursaa aduudhaa gaditti adeemsifamaa jiru hunda nan arge: Ani imimmaan cunqurfamtootaa nan arge; nama isaan jajjabeessu tokko illees hin qaban; humni gama cunqursitoota isaanii ture; isaan nama isaan jajjabeessu tokko illee hin qaban.
english: Then I returned and saw all the oppressions that are done under the sun: and behold, the tears of those who were oppressed, and they had no comforter; and on the side of their oppressors there was power; but they had no comforter.

kikuyu: Anis akka warri duʼan, kanneen kanaan dura duʼan, jiraattota amma lubbuudhaan jiraatan caalan nan labse.
english: Therefore I praised the dead who have been long dead more than the living who are yet alive.

kikuyu: Garuu namni hamma ammaatti hin dhalatin kan hammina aduudhaa gaditti hojjetamu hin argin, lachan isaanii irra wayya.
english: Yes, better than them both is him who has not yet been, who has not seen the evil work that is done under the sun.

kikuyu: Anis akka dadhabbiin hojii hundii fi milkaaʼuun hundi hinaaffaa namni ollaa isaa wajjin qabu irraa burqu nan arga. Kunis bubbee ariʼuu dha; faayidaas hin qabu.
english: Then I saw all the labor and achievement that is the envy of a man’s neighbor. This also is vanity and a striving after wind.

kikuyu: Gowwaan harka isaa maratee taaʼa; foonuma ofii isaas nyaata.
english: The fool folds his hands together and ruins himself.

kikuyu: Dadhabbii fi bubbee ariʼuudhaan konyee lama argachuu irra nagaan konyee tokko argachuu wayya.
english: Better is a handful, with quietness, than two handfuls with labor and chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Ani amma illee waan faayidaa hin qabne tokko aduudhaa gaditti nan arge:
english: Then I returned and saw vanity under the sun.

kikuyu: Nama kophaa isaa jiraatu tokkotu jira; innis ilma yookaan obboleessa hin qabu ture. Yeroo hunda hojiitti dadhaba; taʼus iji isaa qabeenya isaa ilaalee quufe hin jedhu. Innis, “Ani eenyuuf jedheen dadhaba? Maaliifan gammachuus of laga?” jedhee gaafate. Kunis faayidaa hin qabu; hojii buʼaa hin qabnee dha!
english: There is one who is alone, and he has neither son nor brother. There is no end to all of his labor, neither are his eyes satisfied with wealth. “For whom then do I labor and deprive my soul of enjoyment?” This also is vanity. Yes, it is a miserable business.

kikuyu: Isaan sababii hojii isaaniitiif gatii gaarii waan argataniif nama tokko irra nama lama wayya:
english: Two are better than one, because they have a good reward for their labor.

kikuyu: Yoo inni tokko kufe, inni kaan ol isa qaba. Garuu namni kufee kan ol isa kaasu hin qabne garaa nama nyaata!
english: For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow; but woe to him who is alone when he falls, and doesn’t have another to lift him up.

kikuyu: Yoo namoonni lama wajjin ciisan itti hoʼa; nama tokko garuu akkamitti kophaa isaa itti hoʼuu dandaʼa?
english: Again, if two lie together, then they have warmth; but how can one keep warm alone?

kikuyu: Namni tokko moʼatamuu dandaʼa; namoonni lama garuu of irraa deebisuu dandaʼu. Funyoon foʼaa sadiin foʼame dafee hin citu.
english: If a man prevails against one who is alone, two shall withstand him; and a threefold cord is not quickly broken.

kikuyu: Mootii dulloomaa fi gowwaa siʼachi gorsa hin fudhanne irra, dargaggeessa hiyyeessa ogeessa wayya.
english: Better is a poor and wise youth than an old and foolish king who doesn’t know how to receive admonition any more.

kikuyu: Inni yoo hiyyumaan mootummaa sana keessatti dhalate iyyuu mana hidhaatii baʼee mootii taʼuu dandaʼaatii.
english: For out of prison he came out to be king; yes, even in his kingdom he was born poor.

kikuyu: Ani akka namni aduudhaa gad jiraate hundi dargaggeessa mootii dhaalu sana duukaa buʼe nan arge.
english: I saw all the living who walk under the sun, that they were with the youth, the other, who succeeded him.

kikuyu: Baayʼinni nama fuula isaanii dura jiruu hamma hin qabu ture. Warri duubaan dhufan garuu dargaggeessa dhaalu sanatti hin gammanne. Kun hundis bubbee ariʼuu dha; faayidaas hin qabu.
english: There was no end of all the people, even of all them over whom he was—yet those who come after shall not rejoice in him. Surely this also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Ati yeroo gara mana Waaqaa dhaqxu tarkaanfii kee eeggadhu. Dhaggeeffachuuf dhiʼaachuun aarsaa gowwootaa dhiʼeessuu caala; isaan akka hammina hojjechaa jiran hin beekaniitii.
english: Guard your steps when you go to God’s house; for to draw near to listen is better than to give the sacrifice of fools, for they don’t know that they do evil.

kikuyu: Fuula Waaqaa duratti waan tokko dubbachuuf afaan keetiin hin jarjarin; garaan kees hin ariifatin. Waaqni samii keessa jira; ati immoo lafa irra jirta; kanaafuu dubbiin kee haa gabaabbatu.
english: Don’t be rash with your mouth, and don’t let your heart be hasty to utter anything before God; for God is in heaven, and you on earth. Therefore let your words be few.

kikuyu: Abjuun baayʼina hojiitiin dhufa; haasaan gowwaas baayʼina dubbiitiin beekama.
english: For as a dream comes with a multitude of cares, so a fool’s speech with a multitude of words.

kikuyu: Ati yeroo wareega tokko Waaqaaf wareegdutti wareega sana of irraa baasuuf lafa irra hin harkifatin. Inni gowwootatti hin gammadu; ati wareega kee of irraa baasi.
english: When you vow a vow to God, don’t defer to pay it; for he has no pleasure in fools. Pay that which you vow.

kikuyu: Wareeganii of irraa baasuu dhiisuu mannaa wareeguu dhiisuu wayya.
english: It is better that you should not vow, than that you should vow and not pay.

kikuyu: Afaan kee cubbuu keessa si hin buusin. Ergamaa mana qulqullummaatiinis, “Wareegni koo dogoggora ture” hin jedhin. Waaqni maaliif waan ati jettetti aaree hojii harka keetii balleessa?
english: Don’t allow your mouth to lead you into sin. Don’t protest before the messenger that this was a mistake. Why should God be angry at your voice, and destroy the work of your hands?

kikuyu: Abjuun baayʼeenii fi dubbiin baayʼeen faayidaa hin qaban. Kanaafuu Waaqa sodaadhu.
english: For in the multitude of dreams there are vanities, as well as in many words; but you must fear God.

kikuyu: Ati yoo hiyyeessa aanaa tokko keessatti hacuucamee murtii qajeelaa fi mirgi dhowwatame argite, waan akkanaa hin dinqisiifatin; qondaalli tokko qondaala isaa oliitiin ilaalaamaatii; isaaniin olittis qondaaltonni biraa jiru.
english: If you see the oppression of the poor, and the violent taking away of justice and righteousness in a district, don’t marvel at the matter, for one official is eyed by a higher one, and there are officials over them.

kikuyu: Faayidaan lafa irraa argamu kan nama hundaa ti; mootichi mataan isaa iyyuu qonna lafaa irraa fayyadama.
english: Moreover the profit of the earth is for all. The king profits from the field.

kikuyu: Nama maallaqa jaalatu kam iyyuu maallaqni isa hin gaʼu; nama qabeenya jaalatu illee galiin isaa isa hin quubsu. Kunis faayidaa hin qabu.
english: He who loves silver shall not be satisfied with silver, nor he who loves abundance, with increase. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: Akkuma qabeenyi baayʼatuun, warri nyaatanis ni baayʼatu. Yoos abbootiin qabeenyaa ijumaan ilaaluu malee faayidaa maalii argatu ree?
english: When goods increase, those who eat them are increased; and what advantage is there to its owner, except to feast on them with his eyes?

kikuyu: Xinnaas nyaatu, guddaas nyaatu, hirribni hojjetaa tokkoo miʼaawaa dha; baayʼinni qabeenyaa garuu sooressa tokko hirriba dhowwa.
english: The sleep of a laboring man is sweet, whether he eats little or much; but the abundance of the rich will not allow him to sleep.

kikuyu: Ani aduudhaa gaditti hammina nama gaddisiisu nan arge; kunis: qabeenya abbuma isaa miidhuuf kuufame,
english: There is a grievous evil which I have seen under the sun: wealth kept by its owner to his harm.

kikuyu: yookaan qabeenya milkii dhabuudhaan badee yeroo namichi sun ilma dhalchetti ilma isaatiif homaa hin hafinii dha.
english: Those riches perish by misfortune, and if he has fathered a son, there is nothing in his hand.

kikuyu: Namni qullaadhuma isaa gadameessa haadha isaatii baʼa; inni akkuma dhufetti deebiʼee deema. Inni waan itti dadhabe keessaa waan tokko illee harkatti qabatee hin deemu.
english: As he came out of his mother’s womb, naked shall he go again as he came, and shall take nothing for his labor, which he may carry away in his hand.

kikuyu: Kunis hammina nama gaddisiisuu dha: Namni akkuma dhufetti deema; inni waan bubbeedhaaf dadhabuuf faayidaa maalii argata?
english: This also is a grievous evil, that in all points as he came, so shall he go. And what profit does he have who labors for the wind?

kikuyu: Inni bara jireenya isaa hunda yaaddoo, dhukkubbii fi aarii guddaadhaan dukkana keessatti nyaata.
english: All his days he also eats in darkness, he is frustrated, and has sickness and wrath.

kikuyu: Anis akka namni bara jireenya isaa kan Waaqni isaaf kenne gabaabaa kana keessa nyaatee dhugee hojii isaa kan aduudhaa gaditti itti dadhabe sanatti illee gammaduun isaaf gaarii fi barbaachisaa taʼe nan hubadhe; qoodni isaa kanumaatii.
english: Behold, that which I have seen to be good and proper is for one to eat and to drink, and to enjoy good in all his labor, in which he labors under the sun, all the days of his life which God has given him; for this is his portion.

kikuyu: Akkasumas Waaqni nama kamiifuu badhaadhummaa fi qabeenya kennee akka inni itti gammadu, akka inni qooda ofii isaa fudhatee hojii ofii isaatti gammadu isa godhuun isaa, kennaa Waaqaa ti.
english: Every man also to whom God has given riches and wealth, and has given him power to eat of it, and to take his portion, and to rejoice in his labor—this is the gift of God.

kikuyu: Sababii Waaqni garaa isaa gammachuudhaan guuteef inni bara jireenya isaa baayʼee hin yaadatu.
english: For he shall not often reflect on the days of his life, because God occupies him with the joy of his heart.

kikuyu: Ani aduudhaa gaditti waan hamaa biraa argeera; kunis akka malee namatti ulfaata:
english: There is an evil which I have seen under the sun, and it is heavy on men:

kikuyu: Waaqni akka namni waan garaa isaatti hawwu tokko iyyuu hin dhabneef qabeenya, badhaadhummaa fi ulfina isaaf kenne; Waaqni garuu akka inni itti gammadu hin goone; qooda namichaa nama ormaatu itti gammada. Kun waan faayidaa hin qabnee dha; hammina nama gaddisiisuudhas.
english: a man to whom God gives riches, wealth, and honor, so that he lacks nothing for his soul of all that he desires, yet God gives him no power to eat of it, but an alien eats it. This is vanity, and it is an evil disease.

kikuyu: Namni tokko ijoollee dhibba qabaatee waggoota baayʼee jiraachuu dandaʼa; inni hamma fedhe jiraatu illee yoo qabeenya isaatti gammaduu baatee awwaala gaariis argachuu baate, ani, “Isaa mannaa gatata wayya” nan jedha.
english: If a man fathers a hundred children, and lives many years, so that the days of his years are many, but his soul is not filled with good, and moreover he has no burial, I say that a stillborn child is better than he;

kikuyu: Inni akkasumaan dhufa; dukkana keessa bada; maqaan isaas dukkanaan haguugama.
english: for it comes in vanity, and departs in darkness, and its name is covered with darkness.

kikuyu: Inni yoo aduu arguu baate iyyuu yookaan yoo homaa beekuu baate iyyuu boqonnaa namichi sun argatu caalaa boqonnaa qabaata.
english: Moreover it has not seen the sun nor known it. This has rest rather than the other.

kikuyu: Inni waggaa kuma yeroo lama jiraatu illee yoo jireenya gaarii hin jiraatin, namni hundi idduma tokko dhaqa mitii?
english: Yes, though he live a thousand years twice told, and yet fails to enjoy good, don’t all go to one place?

kikuyu: Dadhabbiin nama hundaa afaanuma isaatiif; fedhiin isaa garuu yoom iyyuu hin guutu.
english: All the labor of man is for his mouth, and yet the appetite is not filled.

kikuyu: Ogeessi maaliin gowwaa caala? Hiyyeessi akka itti fuula namootaa dura jiraatu beekuudhaan faayidaa maalii argata?
english: For what advantage has the wise more than the fool? What has the poor man, that knows how to walk before the living?

kikuyu: Hawwiidhaan jooruu mannaa waan iji argu wayya. Kunis bubbee ariʼuu malee faayidaa hin qabu.
english: Better is the sight of the eyes than the wandering of the desire. This also is vanity and a chasing after wind.

kikuyu: Waan jiru hundaaf duraanuu maqaan baʼeera; maalummaan namaas beekamaa dha; namni tokko iyyuu nama isa caalaa humna qabuun morkachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: Whatever has been, its name was given long ago; and it is known what man is; neither can he contend with him who is mightier than he.

kikuyu: Dubbiin akkuma baayʼatuun faayidaa dhaba; yoos wanni sun akkamiin nama kam iyyuu fayyada?
english: For there are many words that create vanity. What does that profit man?

kikuyu: Bara jireenya namaa kan inni akkuma gaaddisaatti keessa baʼee darbu gabaabaa faayidaa hin qabne kana keessa eenyutu waan namaaf gaarii taʼe beeka? Waan erga inni deemee booddee aduudhaa gaditti taʼus eenyutu isatti himuu dandaʼa?
english: For who knows what is good for man in life, all the days of his vain life which he spends like a shadow? For who can tell a man what will be after him under the sun?

kikuyu: Shittoo urgaaʼaa irra maqaa gaarii wayya; guyyaa dhalootaa irra guyyaa duʼaa wayya.
english: A good name is better than fine perfume; and the day of death better than the day of one’s birth.

kikuyu: Mana cidhaa dhaquu mannaa mana booʼichaa dhaquu wayya; galgalli nama hundaa duʼumaatii; namni lubbuun jiraatu waan kana garaatti haa qabatu.
english: It is better to go to the house of mourning than to go to the house of feasting; for that is the end of all men, and the living should take this to heart.

kikuyu: Fuulli gaddu waan garaa gammachiisuuf kolfa irra gadda wayya.
english: Sorrow is better than laughter; for by the sadness of the face the heart is made good.

kikuyu: Qalbiin ogeessaa mana booʼichaa jira, qalbiin gowwaa garuu mana gammachuu jira.
english: The heart of the wise is in the house of mourning; but the heart of fools is in the house of mirth.

kikuyu: Sirba gowwootaa dhagaʼuu mannaa ifannaa ogeessaa dhaggeeffachuu wayya.
english: It is better to hear the rebuke of the wise than for a man to hear the song of fools.

kikuyu: Kolfi gowwaa akkuma qoraattii xuwwee jalaa xaaxaʼuu ti. Kunis faayidaa hin qabu.
english: For as the crackling of thorns under a pot, so is the laughter of the fool. This also is vanity.

kikuyu: Cunqursaan ogeessa gowwaa godha; mattaʼaanis sammuu nama xureessa.
english: Surely extortion makes the wise man foolish; and a bribe destroys the understanding.

kikuyu: Jalqaba waan tokkoo irra dhuma isaa wayya; of tuuluu irras obsa wayya.
english: Better is the end of a thing than its beginning. The patient in spirit is better than the proud in spirit.

kikuyu: Hafuura keetiin aaruuf hin ariifatin; aariin bobaa gowwootaa keessa jiraatii.
english: Don’t be hasty in your spirit to be angry, for anger rests in the bosom of fools.

kikuyu: Ati, “Barri durii maaliif bara kana caale?” hin jedhin; waan kana gaafachuun ogummaa miti.
english: Don’t say, “Why were the former days better than these?” For you do not ask wisely about this.

kikuyu: Ogummaan akkuma dhaalaa waan gaarii dha; warra aduu arganiifis buʼaa qaba.
english: Wisdom is as good as an inheritance. Yes, it is more excellent for those who see the sun.

kikuyu: Akkuma maallaqni daʼoo taʼe sana ogummaanis daʼoo dha; faayidaan beekumsaa garuu kana: innis ogummaan warra ishee qabaniif jireenya kennuu ishee ti.
english: For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life of him who has it.

kikuyu: Waan Waaqni hojjete mee ilaali: Waan inni jalʼise eenyutu qajeelchuu dandaʼa?
english: Consider the work of God, for who can make that straight which he has made crooked?

kikuyu: Yommuu yeroon gaarii taʼutti gammadi; yommuu yeroon hammaatu garuu itti yaadi: Waaqni isa tokko hojjete isa kaanis hojjeteera. Kanaafuu namni egeree isaa beekuu hin dandaʼu.
english: In the day of prosperity be joyful, and in the day of adversity consider; yes, God has made the one side by side with the other, to the end that man should not find out anything after him.

kikuyu: Ani jireenya koo kan faayidaa hin qabne kana keessatti waan kana lachuu argeera; kunis: Qajeelaan qajeelummaa isaatiin baduu isaatii fi hamaan immoo hammina isaatiin bara dheeraa jiraachuu isaa ti.
english: All this I have seen in my days of vanity: there is a righteous man who perishes in his righteousness, and there is a wicked man who lives long in his evildoing.

kikuyu: Ati akka malee qajeelaa hin taʼin; yookaan akka malee ogeessa hin taʼin; maaliif of galaafatta?
english: Don’t be overly righteous, neither make yourself overly wise. Why should you destroy yourself?

kikuyu: Ati akka malee hamaa hin taʼin; gowwaas hin taʼin; maaliif utuu yeroon kee hin gaʼin duuta?
english: Don’t be too wicked, neither be foolish. Why should you die before your time?

kikuyu: Utuu isa kaan gad hin dhiisin waan tokko qabaachuun gaarii dha. Namni Waaqa sodaatu waan hundaan ni milkaaʼa.
english: It is good that you should take hold of this. Yes, also don’t withdraw your hand from that; for he who fears God will come out of them all.

kikuyu: Ogummaan, bulchitoota magaalaa tokko keessa jiran kudhan caalaa nama ogeessa tokko humna qabeessa gooti.
english: Wisdom is a strength to the wise man more than ten rulers who are in a city.

kikuyu: Namni qajeelaan waan qajeelaa malee cubbuu tokko illee hin hojjenne lafa irra hin jiru.
english: Surely there is not a righteous man on earth who does good and doesn’t sin.

kikuyu: Waan namni jedhu hunda hin dhaggeeffatin; yoo kana goote utuu hojjetaan kee si abaaruu dhageessaa;
english: Also don’t take heed to all words that are spoken, lest you hear your servant curse you;

kikuyu: ati mataan kee iyyuu yeroo baayʼee namoota kaan akka abaarte garaan kee beekaatii.
english: for often your own heart knows that you yourself have likewise cursed others.

kikuyu: Ani waan kana hunda ogummaadhaanan qoradhee, “Ani ogeessan taʼa” nan jedhe. Wanni kun garuu narraa fagoo ture.
english: All this I have proved in wisdom. I said, “I will be wise;” but it was far from me.

kikuyu: Wanti jiru hundi fagoo dha; gad fagoo dha; eenyutu qoratee bira gaʼuu dandaʼa?
english: That which is, is far off and exceedingly deep. Who can find it out?

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani gara ogummaa fi maalummaa wantootaa hubachuutti, sakattaʼuutti, qorachuutti akkasumas hammina gowwummaatii fi maraatummaa gowwummaa hubachuutti qalbii koo nan deebifadhe.
english: I turned around, and my heart sought to know and to search out, and to seek wisdom and the scheme of things, and to know that wickedness is stupidity, and that foolishness is madness.

kikuyu: Ani waan duʼa caalaa hadhaaʼuu nan arge; kunis: dubartii kiyyoo taate, kan yaadni ishee kiyyoo, harki ishee immoo foncaa taʼee dha. Namni Waaqa gammachiisu ishee jalaa ni baʼa; cubbamaan garuu isheedhaan qabama.
english: I find more bitter than death the woman whose heart is snares and traps, whose hands are chains. Whoever pleases God shall escape from her; but the sinner will be ensnared by her.

kikuyu: Lallabaan akkana jedha; “Kunoo wanni ani qoradhee bira gaʼe kanaa dha: “Mala isaa beekuuf waan tokko fuudhanii waan kaanitti dabaluu dha;
