english: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains, for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel. Yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. The LORD my God will come, and all the holy ones with you.

kikuyu: Guyyaa sana ifni, dhaamochii fi qorri hin jiraatan.
english: It will happen in that day that there will not be light, cold, or frost.

kikuyu: Guyyaan sun guyyaa addaa, guyyaa Waaqayyo qofa biratti beekamu, yeroo itti garaagarummaan guyyaa fi halkanii hin beekamne ni taʼa. Yeroo dhiʼutti ifa ni taʼa.
english: It will be a unique day which is known to the LORD—not day, and not night; but it will come to pass that at evening time there will be light.

kikuyu: Gaafas bishaan jireenyaa Yerusaalem keessaa ni yaaʼa; walakkaan isaa gara galaana baʼaatti, walakkaan immoo gara galaana lixaatti bonaa fi ganna yaaʼa.
english: It will happen in that day that living waters will go out from Jerusalem, half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea. It will be so in summer and in winter.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo guutummaa lafaa irratti mootii taʼa. Gaafas Waaqayyo tokko, maqaan isaas maqaa tokko taʼa.
english: The LORD will be King over all the earth. In that day the LORD will be one, and his name one.

kikuyu: Guutummaan biyyattii Gebaadhaa hamma Rimoon ishee kibba Yerusaalem jirtuutti akka Arabbaa taʼa. Yerusaalem garuu Karra Beniyaamii hamma Karra Jalqabaatti, hamma Karra Goleetti, Gamoo Hanaaniʼeelii hamma iddoo cuunfaa wayinii mootichaatti ol kaafamtee iddoodhuma ishee durii ni turti.
english: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.

kikuyu: Namni ishee keessa jiraata; isheen siʼachi hin diigamtu. Yerusaalem nagaadhaan jiraatti.
english: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.

kikuyu: Kun dhaʼicha Waaqayyo ittiin saboota Yerusaalemin lolan hunda rukutuu dha: Foon isaanii utuma isaan miilla isaaniitiin dhaabatanii jiranuu tortora; iji isaanii boolla ija isaanii keessatti tortora; arrabni isaaniis afaan isaanii keessatti tortora.
english: This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.

kikuyu: Gaafas jeequmsi guddaan Waaqayyo biraa namootatti ni dhufa. Isaanis harkaan wal qabatanii wal haleelu
english: It will happen in that day that a great panic from the LORD will be among them; and they will each seize the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.

kikuyu: Yihuudaanis Yerusaalemin lola. Qabeenyi saboota naannoo ishee jiraatanii hundi warqeen, meetii fi uffanni baayʼeen walitti qabama.
english: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, silver, and clothing, in great abundance.

kikuyu: Dhaʼichi akkasii fardeenii fi gaangolii, gaalaa fi harree, akkasumas horii qubata keessaa hunda ni rukuta.
english: A plague like this will fall on the horse, on the mule, on the camel, on the donkey, and on all the animals that will be in those camps.

kikuyu: Ergasii hambaawwan saboota Yerusaalemin lolan hundaa wagguma waggaadhaan Mooticha, Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu waaqeffachuu fi Ayyaana Daasii ayyaaneffachuuf ol baʼu.
english: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, and to keep the feast of booths.

kikuyu: Uummanni lafa irra jiraatu kam iyyuu yoo Mooticha, Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu waaqeffachuuf Yerusaalemitti ol baʼuu baate bokkaa hin argatu.
english: It will be that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of Armies, on them there will be no rain.

kikuyu: Uummanni Gibxiis yoo ol baʼee hirmaachuu baate bokkaa hin argatu. Waaqayyo dhaʼicha ittiin saboota Ayyaana Daasii ayyaaneffachuuf ol hin baane rukutu isaanitti ni fida.
english: If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with which the LORD will strike the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

kikuyu: Kun adabbii Gibxii fi adabbii saboota Ayyaana Daasii ayyaaneffachuuf ol hin baane hundaa taʼa.
english: This will be the punishment of Egypt and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of booths.

kikuyu: Gaafas katabbiin, “Waaqayyoof qulqullaaʼe” jedhu bilbila fardeenii irratti ni barreeffama. Xuwween mana Waaqayyoo keessaas akkuma waciitii qulqulluu fuula iddoo aarsaa dura jiru sanaa ni taʼa.
english: In that day there will be inscribed on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO THE LORD”; and the pots in the LORD’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.

kikuyu: Xuwween Yerusaalemii fi Yihuudaa keessaa hundi Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼuuf qulqulluu taʼa; namni aarsaa dhiʼeessuuf dhufu hundinuus xuwweewwan sana keessaa muraasa ni fudhata. Foon aarsaa itti bilcheeffata. Gaafas namni Kanaʼaan tokko iyyuu deebiʼee mana Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼuu keessatti hin argamu.
english: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the LORD of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them, and cook in them. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Raajii dubbii Waaqayyoo kan karaa Miilkiyaasiin gara Israaʼel dhufe.
english: A revelation, the LORD’s word to Israel by Malachi.

kikuyu: “Ani isin jaalladheera” jedha Waaqayyo. “Isin immoo, ‘Ati akkamitti nu jaallatte?’ jettanii gaafattu. “Esaawu obboleessa Yaaqoob hin turree?” jedha Waaqayyo. “Taʼus ani Yaaqoobin jaalladhee,
english: “I have loved you,” says the LORD. Yet you say, “How have you loved us?” “Wasn’t Esau Jacob’s brother?” says the LORD, “Yet I loved Jacob;

kikuyu: Esaawun garuu jibbeera; ani tulluuwwan isaa lafa onaa godhee dhaala isaas waangoo gammoojjiitiif kenneera.”
english: but Esau I hated, and made his mountains a desolation, and gave his heritage to the jackals of the wilderness.”

kikuyu: Edoomiyaas, “Nu caccabnu iyyuu, diigama sana deebisnee ni ijaarra” jedha taʼa. Garuu Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu akkana jedha: “Isaan ni ijaaru taʼa; ani garuu nan diiga. Isaan Biyya Hamaa, saba yeroo hunda dheekkamsa Waaqayyoo jala jiraatu jedhamanii ni waamamu.
english: Whereas Edom says, “We are beaten down, but we will return and build the waste places,” the LORD of Armies says, “They shall build, but I will throw down; and men will call them ‘The Wicked Land,’ even the people against whom the LORD shows wrath forever.”

kikuyu: Isin waan kana ija keessaniin argitanii, ‘Daarii biyya Israaʼeliin gamatti iyyuu Waaqayyo Guddaa dha!’ jettu.
english: Your eyes will see, and you will say, “The LORD is great—even beyond the border of Israel!”

kikuyu: “Ilmi abbaa isaa, garbichis gooftaa isaa ulfeessa. Egaa ergan abbaa taʼe, ulfinni naaf malu meerre ree? Ergan gooftaa taʼe, kabajni naaf malu meerree ree?” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu. “Yaa luboota; isintu maqaa koo tuffata. “Isin garuu, ‘Nu akkamiin maqaa kee tuffanne?’ jettanii gaafattu.
english: “A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me?” says the LORD of Armies to you priests who despise my name. “You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’

kikuyu: “Isin nyaata xuraaʼaa iddoo aarsaa koo irratti dhiʼeessitu. “Isin garuu, ‘Nu akkamiin si xureessine’ jettanii gaafattu. “Maaddiin Waaqayyoo tuffatamaa dha jechuudhaan.
english: You offer polluted bread on my altar. You say, ‘How have we polluted you?’ In that you say, ‘The LORD’s table is contemptible.’

kikuyu: Isin yoo horii jaamaa aarsaadhaaf dhiʼeessitan, sun balleessaa mitii? Isin yoo horii naafa yookaan horii dhukkubsataa naaf qaltan, sun balleessaa mitii? Mee horii sana bulchaa keessaniif kennuu yaalaa! Inni isinitti ni gammadaa? Inni isin harkaa ni fudhataa?” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.
english: When you offer the blind for sacrifice, isn’t that evil? And when you offer the lame and sick, isn’t that evil? Present it now to your governor! Will he be pleased with you? Or will he accept your person?” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: “Egaa mee akka inni garaa nuu laafuuf Waaqa nuuf kadhadhaa. Isin yoo aarsaa akkasii qabattanii dhiʼaattan inni isin harkaa ni fudhataa?” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda dandaʼu.
english: “Now, please entreat the favor of God, that he may be gracious to us. With this, will he accept any of you?” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: “Isin keessaa namni tokko akka isin ibidda faayidaa hin qabne iddoo aarsaa koo irratti hin bobeessineef utuu balbala mana qulqullummaa cufee jiraatee! Ani isinitti hin gammadu; aarsaa tokko iyyuu isin harkaa hin fudhu” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.
english: “Oh that there were one among you who would shut the doors, that you might not kindle fire on my altar in vain! I have no pleasure in you,” says the LORD of Armies, “neither will I accept an offering at your hand.

kikuyu: “Maqaan koo baʼa aduutii kaasee hamma lixa aduutti saboota gidduutti guddaa ni taʼa. Iddoo hundatti ixaannii fi aarsaan qulqulluun ni kennama; maqaan koo saboota gidduutti guddaa ni taʼaatii” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.
english: For from the rising of the sun even to its going down, my name is great among the nations, and in every place incense will be offered to my name, and a pure offering; for my name is great among the nations,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: “Isin garuu maaddiin Gooftaa ‘xuraaʼaa dha’ nyaanni isaas ‘tuffatamaa dha’ jechuudhaan maqaa koo xureessitu.
english: “But you profane it when you say, ‘The LORD’s table is polluted, and its fruit, even its food, is contemptible.’

kikuyu: ‘Kun dadhabbii dha!’ jettaniis tuffiidhaan itti cirriiqfattu” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu. “Isin yoo horii hatame, kan naafate yookaan kan dhukkuba qabu fiddanii aarsaa gootanii dhiʼeessitan, ani isin harkaa fudhachuutu narra jiraa?” jedha Waaqayyo.
english: You say also, ‘Behold, what a weariness it is!’ And you have sniffed at it”, says the LORD of Armies; “and you have brought that which was taken by violence, the lame, and the sick; thus you bring the offering. Should I accept this at your hand?” says the LORD.

kikuyu: “Namni bushaayee isaa keessaa korbeessa jaallatamaa qabu kan korbeessa sana aarsaa dhiʼeessuuf wareega kennee garuu sobee horii hirʼina qabu Gooftaadhaaf dhiʼeessu abaaramaa haa taʼu. Ani mootii guddaadhaatii, maqaan koo saboota gidduutti sodaatamuu qaba” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.
english: “But the deceiver is cursed who has in his flock a male, and vows and sacrifices to the Lord a defective thing; for I am a great King,” says the LORD of Armies, “and my name is awesome among the nations.”

kikuyu: “Yaa luboota akeekkachiisni kun isiniif kenname.
english: “Now, you priests, this commandment is for you.

kikuyu: Yoo isin dhaggeeffachuu baattan, yoo isin maqaa koo kabajuuf garaa keessan qopheessuu baattan, ani abaarsa isinitti nan erga; eebba keessanis nan abaara” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu. “Sababii isin maqaa koo kabajuuf garaa keessan hin qopheessiniif dhugumaan ani amma iyyuu eebba keessan abaareera.
english: If you will not listen, and if you will not take it to heart, to give glory to my name,” says the LORD of Armies, “then I will send the curse on you, and I will curse your blessings. Indeed, I have cursed them already, because you do not take it to heart.

kikuyu: “Sababii keessaniif ani sanyii keessan nan ifadha; faandoo aarsaa isin guyyaa ayyaanaa dhiʼeessitanii fuula keessanitti nan facaasa; isa wajjinis ni baddu.
english: Behold, I will rebuke your offspring, and will spread dung on your faces, even the dung of your feasts; and you will be taken away with it.

kikuyu: Kakuun ani Lewwii wajjin qabu akka itti fufuuf, ajaja kana isinitti erguu koo isin ni beektu” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.
english: You will know that I have sent this commandment to you, that my covenant may be with Levi,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: “Kakuun ani isa wajjin gale kakuu jireenyaatii fi kakuu nagaa ture; isas nan kenneef; kunis kabaja fide; innis na kabaje; maqaa koo sodaachuudhaanis ni dhaabate.
english: “My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name.

kikuyu: Gorsi dhugaa afaan isaa keessa ture; sobni tokko iyyuu hidhii isaa irraa hin argamne. Inni nagaa fi qajeelummaadhaan na wajjin jiraate; nama hedduus qalbii jijjiirrachiise.
english: The law of truth was in his mouth, and unrighteousness was not found in his lips. He walked with me in peace and uprightness, and turned many away from iniquity.

kikuyu: “Sababii inni ergamaa Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼuu taʼeef, hidhiin luba tokkoo beekumsa kuufata; namoonnis afaan isaa irraa gorsa barbaadu.
english: For the priest’s lips should keep knowledge, and they should seek the law at his mouth; for he is the messenger of the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Isin garuu karaa irraa jalʼattaniirtu; barsiisa keessaniinis namoota baayʼee gufachiiftaniirtu; kakuu Lewwiis cabsitaniirtu” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.
english: But you have turned away from the path. You have caused many to stumble in the law. You have corrupted the covenant of Levi,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu ani akka isin saboota hunda duratti tuffatamtanii fi salphattan nan godha; isin waaʼee seeraa keessatti loogii hojjettan malee karaa koo duukaa hin buuneetii.”
english: “Therefore I have also made you contemptible and wicked before all the people, according to the way you have not kept my ways, but have had respect for persons in the law.

kikuyu: Nu hundi Abbaa tokko qabna mitii? Waaquma tokkotu nu uume mitii? Yoos nu maaliif waliif amanamuu diduudhaan kakuu abbootii keenyaa xureessina ree?
english: Don’t we all have one father? Hasn’t one God created us? Why do we deal treacherously every man against his brother, profaning the covenant of our fathers?

kikuyu: Yihuudaan hin amanamne. Israaʼelii fi Yerusaalem keessatti wanni jibbisiisaan tokko raawwatameera; Yihuudaan dubartoota waaqa ormaa waaqeffatan fuudhuudhaan iddoo qulqulluu Waaqayyo jaallatu xureesseera.
english: Judah has dealt treacherously, and an abomination is committed in Israel and in Jerusalem; for Judah has profaned the holiness of the LORD which he loves, and has married the daughter of a foreign god.

kikuyu: Nama waan kana hojjetu abbaa fedhe illee yoo taʼe, Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼuuf aarsaa fidu iyyuu dunkaana Yaaqoob keessaa Waaqayyo isa haa balleessu.
english: The LORD will cut off the man who does this, him who wakes and him who answers, out of the tents of Jacob and him who offers an offering to the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Wanni isin hojjettan kan biraas kanaa dha: iddoo aarsaa Waaqayyoo irra imimmaan lolaaftu. Sababii inni siʼachi aarsaa keessaniif xiyyeeffannoo hin kennineef yookaan aarsaa keessan gammachuudhaan isin harkaa hin fudhanneef ni boossu; ni wawwaattus.
english: “This again you do: you cover the LORD’s altar with tears, with weeping, and with sighing, because he doesn’t regard the offering any more, neither receives it with good will at your hand.

kikuyu: Isinis, “Kun maaliif taʼe?” jettanii gaafattu. Kun sababii ati utuma isheen hidhata kee, niitii kee kan kakuu taatee jirtuu amanamummaa isheef dhabdeef Waaqayyo siʼii fi niitii qeerrummaa kee gidduutti ragaa taʼeefii dha.
english: Yet you say, ‘Why?’ Because the LORD has been witness between you and the wife of your youth, against whom you have dealt treacherously, though she is your companion and the wife of your covenant.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo tokko isaan hin goonee? Isaan fooniinis hafuuraanis kanuma isaa ti. Inni maaliif tokko isaan godhe? Sababii inni sanyii Waaqa sodaatu barbaadaa tureef. Kanaafuu of eeggadhaa; eenyu iyyuu amanamummaa niitii qeerrummaa isaatiif qabu hin cabsin.
english: Did he not make you one, although he had the residue of the Spirit? Why one? He sought godly offspring. Therefore take heed to your spirit, and let no one deal treacherously against the wife of his youth.

kikuyu: “Ani wal hiikuu dhirsaa fi niitii nan jibba” jedha Waaqayyo Waaqni Israaʼel; “Ani nama wayyaa isaatiin jalʼina haguugu nan jibba” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu. Kanaafuu of eeggadhaa; amanamummaas hin dhabinaa.
english: One who hates and divorces”, says the LORD, the God of Israel, “covers his garment with violence!” says the LORD of Armies. “Therefore pay attention to your spirit, that you don’t be unfaithful.

kikuyu: Isin dubbii keessaniin Waaqayyoon dadhabsiiftaniirtu. “Nu akkamiin isa dadhabsiifne?” jettaniis gaafattu. “Warri waan hamaa hojjetan hundinuu fuula Waaqayyoo duratti gaarii dha; innis isaanitti gammada” yookaan “Waaqni murtii qajeelaa meerre?” jechuudhaan.
english: You have wearied the LORD with your words. Yet you say, ‘How have we wearied him?’ In that you say, ‘Everyone who does evil is good in the LORD’s sight, and he delights in them;’ or ‘Where is the God of justice?’

kikuyu: “Kunoo ani ergamaa koo isa fuula koo duraan karaa naaf qopheessu nan erga. Ergasii Gooftaan isin eeggattan akkuma tasaa gara mana qulqullummaa isaa ni dhufa; ergamaan kakuu kan isin hawwitan sun ni dhufa” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.
english: “Behold, I send my messenger, and he will prepare the way before me! The Lord, whom you seek, will suddenly come to his temple. Behold, the messenger of the covenant, whom you desire, is coming!” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: Garuu eenyutu guyyaa dhufaatii isaa sana obsuu dandaʼa? Yeroo inni mulʼatuttis eenyutu isa dura dhaabachuu dandaʼa? Inni akka ibidda nama sibiila baqsee qulqulleessuu yookaan akka saamunaa nama wayyaa miicuu ti.
english: “But who can endure the day of his coming? And who will stand when he appears? For he is like a refiner’s fire, and like launderers’ soap;

kikuyu: Inni akkuma nama meetii baqsee qulqulleessuu ni taʼa; Lewwotas calalee akka warqeettii fi meetiitti qulqulleessa. Ergasiis Waaqayyo namoota qajeelummaadhaan aarsaa isaaf fidan ni qabaata;
english: and he will sit as a refiner and purifier of silver, and he will purify the sons of Levi, and refine them as gold and silver; and they shall offer to the LORD offerings in righteousness.

kikuyu: akkuma bara darbee, akkuma waggoota duraa aarsaan Yihuudaatii fi Yerusaalem Waaqayyoon ni gammachiisa.
english: Then the offering of Judah and Jerusalem will be pleasant to the LORD as in the days of old and as in ancient years.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu ani murtiif gara keessan nan dhufa. Ani falfaltootatti, sagaagaltootatti, warra sobaan kakatanitti, warra mindaa hojjettootaa dhowwatanitti, warra haadhota hiyyeessaa fi ijoollee abbaa hin qabne hacuucanitti, warra alagoota murtii qajeelaa dhowwatanii fi na hin sodaannetti dhugaa baʼuuf nan ariifadha” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.
english: I will come near to you to judgment. I will be a swift witness against the sorcerers, against the adulterers, against the perjurers, and against those who oppress the hireling in his wages, the widow, and the fatherless, and who deprive the foreigner of justice, and don’t fear me,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: “Ani Waaqayyo hin geeddaramu. Kanaafuu yaa ilmaan Yaaqoob isin hin barbadoofne.
english: “For I, the LORD, don’t change; therefore you, sons of Jacob, are not consumed.

kikuyu: Isin bara abbootii keessaniitii jalqabdanii sirna koo irraa jalʼattaniirtu; hin eegnes. Gara kootti deebiʼaa; anis gara keessanitti nan deebiʼaa” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu. “Isin garuu, ‘Nu akkamiin deebina?’ jettanii gaafattu.
english: From the days of your fathers you have turned away from my ordinances and have not kept them. Return to me, and I will return to you,” says the LORD of Armies. “But you say, ‘How shall we return?’

kikuyu: “Namni Waaqa ni saamaa?” Taʼus isin na saamtan. “Isin garuu, ‘Nu akkamiin si saamne?’ jettanii gaafattu. “Kudhan keessaa tokkoo fi aarsaadhaan.
english: Will a man rob God? Yet you rob me! But you say, ‘How have we robbed you?’ In tithes and offerings.

kikuyu: Isin guutummaan saba keessanii sababii na saamtaniif abaarsa jala jirtu.
english: You are cursed with the curse; for you rob me, even this whole nation.

kikuyu: Akka mana koo keessa nyaanni jiraatuuf, kudhan keessa tokko guutummaatti gombisaatti galchaa. Kanaan na qoraatii akka ani karra burqaa samii banee hamma isin iddoo itti kuufattan dhabdanitti eebba guddaa isiniif hin roobsine ilaalaa” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.
english: Bring the whole tithe into the storehouse, that there may be food in my house, and test me now in this,” says the LORD of Armies, “if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there will not be enough room for.

kikuyu: “Ani akka daanaʼoon midhaan keessan hin balleessineef nan ifadha; mukni wayinii lafa qotiisa keessaniis ija hin harcaafatu” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.
english: I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast its fruit before its time in the field,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: “Ergasii isin biyya gammaddu waan taataniif, saboonni hundinuu eebbifamtoota isiniin jedhu” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.
english: “All nations shall call you blessed, for you will be a delightful land,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: “Isin of tuulummaadhaan natti dubbattan” jedha Waaqayyo. “Taʼus, ‘Nu maal siin jenne?’ jettanii gaafattu.
english: “Your words have been harsh against me,” says the LORD. “Yet you say, ‘What have we spoken against you?’

kikuyu: “Isin akkana dubbattan; ‘Waaqa tajaajiluun faayidaa hin qabu. Nu fedhii isaa duukaa buunee akkuma nama booʼuu, fuula Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼuu dura jooruudhaan maal arganne?
english: You have said, ‘It is vain to serve God,’ and ‘What profit is it that we have followed his instructions and that we have walked mournfully before the LORD of Armies?

kikuyu: Amma garuu of tuultotaan eebbifamtoota jenna. Dhugumaan warri hamaa hojjetan ni eebbifamu; warri Waaqa qoranis ni miliqu.’ ”
english: Now we call the proud happy; yes, those who work wickedness are built up; yes, they tempt God, and escape.’

kikuyu: Warri Waaqayyoon sodaatan walitti dubbatan; Waaqayyos isaan dhaggeeffate; ni dhagaʼes. Warra Waaqayyoon sodaatanii fi maqaa isaa kabajaniifis kitaabni maramaan yaadannoodhaaf fuula isaa duratti barreeffame.
english: Then those who feared the LORD spoke one with another; and the LORD listened and heard, and a book of memory was written before him for those who feared the LORD and who honored his name.

kikuyu: Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu akkana jedha; “Guyyaa ani hojjedhutti isaan handhuuraa koo addaa ni taʼu. Akkuma namni tokko ilma isaa kan isa tajaajilu baraaru sana ani isa nan baraara.
english: They shall be mine,” says the LORD of Armies, “my own possession in the day that I make. I will spare them, as a man spares his own son who serves him.

kikuyu: Isin ammas garaa garummaa nama qajeelaatii fi nama hamaa, garaa garummaa warra Waaqa tajaajilaniitii fi warra hin tajaajillee ni argitu.
english: Then you shall return and discern between the righteous and the wicked, between him who serves God and him who doesn’t serve him.

kikuyu: “Dhugumaan guyyaan akka badaa ibiddaa bobaʼu ni dhufa. Of tuultonni hundii fi warri hammina hojjetan hundi cidii taʼu; guyyaan sunis isaan guba” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu. “Hiddi yookaan dameen tokko iyyuu isaaniif hin hafu.
english: “For behold, the day comes, burning like a furnace, when all the proud and all who work wickedness will be stubble. The day that comes will burn them up,” says the LORD of Armies, “so that it will leave them neither root nor branch.

kikuyu: Isin warra maqaa koo kabajjaniif garuu Aduun qajeelummaa qoochoo isaa jalatti fayyina qabatee ni baʼa. Isinis baatanii akkuma jabbii golaa gad dhiifamteetti burraaqxu.
english: But to you who fear my name shall the sun of righteousness arise with healing in its wings. You will go out and leap like calves of the stall.

kikuyu: Ergasii isin hamoota ni dhidhiittu; isaanis guyyaa ani wantoota kanneen hojjedhutti faana miilla keessanii jalatti daaraa ni taʼu” jedha Waaqayyo Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.
english: You shall tread down the wicked; for they will be ashes under the soles of your feet in the day that I make,” says the LORD of Armies.

kikuyu: “Seera garbicha koo Musee, sirnaa fi ajaja ani Israaʼeloota hundaaf Kooreebitti isatti kenne sana yaadadhaa.
english: “Remember the law of Moses my servant, which I commanded to him in Horeb for all Israel, even statutes and ordinances.

kikuyu: “Kunoo ani, guyyaan Waaqayyoo inni guddaanii fi sodaachisaan sun utuu hin dhufin dura Eeliyaas raajicha isiniif nan erga.
english: Behold, I will send you Elijah the prophet before the great and terrible day of the LORD comes.

kikuyu: Inni qalbii abbootii gara ijoolleetti, qalbii ijoollee immoo gara abbootiitti ni deebisa; yoo kanaa achii ani dhufee abaarsaan biyyattii nan rukuta.”
english: He will turn the hearts of the fathers to the children and the hearts of the children to their fathers, lest I come and strike the earth with a curse.”

kikuyu: Hiddi dhaloota Yesuus Kiristoos sanyii Daawit, sanyii Abrahaam taʼe sanaa kanaa dha:
english: The book of the genealogy of Jesus Christ, the son of David, the son of Abraham.

kikuyu: Abrahaam Yisihaaqin dhalche; Yisihaaq Yaaqoobin dhalche; Yaaqoob Yihuudaa fi obboloota isaa dhalche;
english: Abraham became the father of Isaac. Isaac became the father of Jacob. Jacob became the father of Judah and his brothers.

kikuyu: Yihuudaan Taamaar irraa Faaresii fi Zeraa dhalche; Faares Hezroonin dhalche; Hezroon Arraamin dhalche;
english: Judah became the father of Perez and Zerah by Tamar. Perez became the father of Hezron. Hezron became the father of Ram.

kikuyu: Arraam Amiinaadaabin dhalche; Abiinaadaab Nahishoonin dhalche; Nahishoon Salmoonin dhalche;
english: Ram became the father of Amminadab. Amminadab became the father of Nahshon. Nahshon became the father of Salmon.

kikuyu: Salmoon Rahaab irraa Boʼeezin dhalche; Boʼeez Ruut irraa Yoobeedin dhalche; Yoobeed Isseeyin dhalche;
english: Salmon became the father of Boaz by Rahab. Boaz became the father of Obed by Ruth. Obed became the father of Jesse.

kikuyu: Isseey Daawit Mooticha dhalche. Daawit niitii Uuriyaa irraa Solomoonin dhalche;
english: Jesse became the father of King David. David the king became the father of Solomon by her who had been Uriah’s wife.

kikuyu: Solomoon Rehooboʼaamin dhalche; Rehooboʼaam Abiyaa dhalche; Abiyaan Asaafin dhalche;
english: Solomon became the father of Rehoboam. Rehoboam became the father of Abijah. Abijah became the father of Asa.

kikuyu: Asaaf Yehooshaafaaxin dhalche; Yehooshaafaax Yehooraamin dhalche; Yehooraam Uziyaan dhalche;
english: Asa became the father of Jehoshaphat. Jehoshaphat became the father of Joram. Joram became the father of Uzziah.

kikuyu: Uziyaan Yootaamin dhalche; Yootaam Akaazin dhalche; Akaaz Hisqiyaasin dhalche;
english: Uzziah became the father of Jotham. Jotham became the father of Ahaz. Ahaz became the father of Hezekiah.

kikuyu: Hisqiyaas Minaasee dhalche; Minaaseen Aamoonin dhalche; Aamoon Yosiyaasin dhalche;
english: Hezekiah became the father of Manasseh. Manasseh became the father of Amon. Amon became the father of Josiah.

kikuyu: Yosiyaas bara boojuu Baabilon keessa, Yekooniyaanii fi obboloota isaa dhalche.
english: Josiah became the father of Jechoniah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.

kikuyu: Boojuu Baabilon booddee, Yekooniyaan Sheʼaltiiʼeelin dhalche; Sheʼaltiiʼeel Zarubaabelin dhalche;
english: After the exile to Babylon, Jechoniah became the father of Shealtiel. Shealtiel became the father of Zerubbabel.

kikuyu: Zarubaabel Abiyuudin dhalche; Abiyuud Eliyaaqeemin dhalche; Eliyaaqeem Azoorin dhalche;
english: Zerubbabel became the father of Abiud. Abiud became the father of Eliakim. Eliakim became the father of Azor.

kikuyu: Azoor Zaadoqin dhalche; Zaadoq Akiimin dhalche; Akiim Eliyuudin dhalche;
english: Azor became the father of Zadok. Zadok became the father of Achim. Achim became the father of Eliud.

kikuyu: Eliyuud Eleʼaazaarin dhalche; Eleʼaazaar Maattaanin dhalche; Maattaan Yaaqoobin dhalche;
english: Eliud became the father of Eleazar. Eleazar became the father of Matthan. Matthan became the father of Jacob.

kikuyu: Yaaqoob Yoosefin dhalche; Yoosef kunis dhirsa Maariyaam ishee Yesuus isa Kiristoos jedhamu deesse sanaa ti.
english: Jacob became the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, from whom was born Jesus, who is called Christ.

kikuyu: Egaa walumaa galatti Abrahaamii hamma Daawititti dhaloota kudha afur, Daawitii hamma boojuu Baabilonitti dhaloota kudha afur, boojuu Baabilonii hamma Kiristoosiitti dhaloota kudha afurtu ture.
english: So all the generations from Abraham to David are fourteen generations; from David to the exile to Babylon fourteen generations; and from the carrying away to Babylon to the Christ, fourteen generations.

kikuyu: Dhalachuun Yesuus Kiristoos akkana ture: Haati isaa Maariyaam kaadhima Yoosef turte; isheenis utuu Yoosef wajjin wal bira hin gaʼin Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan ulfooftee argamte.
english: Now the birth of Jesus Christ was like this: After his mother, Mary, was engaged to Joseph, before they came together, she was found pregnant by the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Yoosef kaadhimni ishee sunis nama qajeelaa waan tureef, dhoksaadhaan ishee dhiisuu murteesse malee uummata duratti ishee qaanessuu hin barbaanne.
english: Joseph, her husband, being a righteous man, and not willing to make her a public example, intended to put her away secretly.

kikuyu: Utuu inni waan kana yaadaa jiruu, ergamaan Gooftaa abjuu keessa itti mulʼatee akkana jedheen; “Yaa Yoosef ilma Daawit, kaadhimni kee Maariyaam Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan waan ulfoofteef ishee fuudhuu hin sodaatin.
english: But when he thought about these things, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream, saying, “Joseph, son of David, don’t be afraid to take to yourself Mary as your wife, for that which is conceived in her is of the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Isheen ilma deessi; atis maqaa isaa Yesuus jettee ni moggaafta; inni saba isaa cubbuu isaanii irraa ni fayyisaatii.”
english: She shall give birth to a son. You shall name him Jesus, for it is he who shall save his people from their sins.”

kikuyu: Kun hundinuu akka wanni Gooftaan karaa raajichaatiin dubbate sun raawwatamuuf taʼe.
english: Now all this has happened that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: Innis, “Kunoo, durbi tokko ni ulfoofti; ilma ni deessi; maqaa isaas Amaanuʼel jedhu” jedha. Amaanuʼel jechuunis, “Waaqni nu wajjin jira” jechuu dha.
english: “Behold, the virgin shall be with child, and shall give birth to a son. They shall call his name Immanuel,” which is, being interpreted, “God with us.”

kikuyu: Yoosefis hirribaa dammaqee akkuma ergamaan Gooftaa isa ajajetti Maariyaamin niitummaadhaan mana isaatti fudhate.
english: Joseph arose from his sleep, and did as the angel of the Lord commanded him, and took his wife to himself;

kikuyu: Garuu inni hamma isheen ilma deessutti ishee bira hin geenye. Maqaa isaas, “Yesuus” jedhee moggaase.
english: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.

kikuyu: Bara Heroodis Mootichaa keessa, erga Yesuus magaalaa Beetlihem Yihuudaatti argamtu keessatti dhalatee booddee, beektonni baʼa biiftuutii gara Yerusaalem dhufan;
english: Now when Jesus was born in Bethlehem of Judea in the days of King Herod, behold, wise men from the east came to Jerusalem, saying,

kikuyu: isaanis, “Mootiin Yihuudootaa inni dhalate sun eessa jira? Nu urjii isaa baʼa biiftuutti arginee isaaf sagaduu dhufneerra” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: “Where is he who is born King of the Jews? For we saw his star in the east, and have come to worship him.”

kikuyu: Heroodis Mootichi yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti ni jeeqame; Yerusaalemis guutummaatti isa wajjin jeeqamte.
english: When King Herod heard it, he was troubled, and all Jerusalem with him.

kikuyu: Innis luboota hangafootaa fi barsiistota seeraa hunda saba keessaa walitti qabee, Kiristoos eessatti akka dhalatu isaan gaafate.
english: Gathering together all the chief priests and scribes of the people, he asked them where the Christ would be born.

kikuyu: Isaanis akkana jedhanii deebisaniif; “Beetlihem Yihuudaatti dhalata; kunis dubbii raajichi, “ ‘Yaa Beetlihem ishee biyya Yihuudaa, ati gonkumaa bulchitoota Yihuudaatii gad miti; bulchaan saba koo Israaʼelin tiksu si keessaa ni baʼaatii’ jedhee barreesse sanaa dha.”
english: They said to him, “In Bethlehem of Judea, for this is written through the prophet,

kikuyu: Ergasii Heroodis beektota sana dhoksaatti waamee yeroo itti urjiin sun mulʼate isaan irraa hubate.
english: Then Herod secretly called the wise men, and learned from them exactly what time the star appeared.

kikuyu: Innis, “Dhaqaatii jabeessaa mucicha barbaadaa. Yeroo argitanitti immoo akka anis dhufee isaaf sagaduuf natti himaa” jedhee Beetlihemitti isaan erge.
english: He sent them to Bethlehem, and said, “Go and search diligently for the young child. When you have found him, bring me word, so that I also may come and worship him.”

kikuyu: Isaanis erga waan mootichi jedhe sana dhagaʼanii booddee karaa isaanii itti fufan; urjiin isaan baʼa biiftuutti argan sunis hamma iddoo mucichi ture gaʼee dhaabatutti isaan dura deeme.
english: They, having heard the king, went their way; and behold, the star, which they saw in the east, went before them until it came and stood over where the young child was.

kikuyu: Isaanis yeroo urjii sana arganitti akka malee gammadan.
english: When they saw the star, they rejoiced with exceedingly great joy.

kikuyu: Akkuma mana ol seenaniinis mucicha, haadha isaa Maariyaam wajjin argan; kufaniis sagadaniif. Qorxii isaaniis bananii kennaa warqee, ixaanaa fi qumbii dhiʼeessaniif.
english: They came into the house and saw the young child with Mary, his mother, and they fell down and worshiped him. Opening their treasures, they offered to him gifts: gold, frankincense, and myrrh.

kikuyu: Beektonnis akka gara Heroodisitti hin deebineef waan abjuudhaan of eeggachiisni isaaniif kennameef karaa biraatiin biyya isaaniitti deebiʼan.
english: Being warned in a dream not to return to Herod, they went back to their own country another way.

kikuyu: Yommuu beektonni sun deemanitti, kunoo ergamaan Gooftaa abjuudhaan Yoosefitti mulʼatee, “Sababii Heroodis mucicha ajjeesuu barbaaduuf kaʼiitii mucichaa fi haadha isaa fudhadhuutii Gibxitti baqadhu. Hamma ani yeroo ati itti deebitu sitti himutti achuma turi” jedheen.
english: Now when they had departed, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream, saying, “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and flee into Egypt, and stay there until I tell you, for Herod will seek the young child to destroy him.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yoosef kaʼee mucichaa fi haadha isaa halkaniin fudhatee Gibxitti qajeele;
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother by night and departed into Egypt,

kikuyu: hamma Heroodis duʼuttis achi jiraate. Kunis akka wanni Gooftaan karaa raajichaatiin, “Ani Gibxii ilma koo waameera” jedhe sun raawwatamuuf taʼe.
english: and was there until the death of Herod, that it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the Lord through the prophet, saying, “Out of Egypt I called my son.”

kikuyu: Heroodis yommuu akka beektonni sun isa gowwoomsan hubatetti akka malee aare; innis akka yeroo beektota sana irraa bareetti, ijoollee dhiiraa warra umuriin isaanii waggaa lamaa fi hammasii gad taʼe kanneen Beetlihemii fi naannoo ishee keessa jiraatan hunda nama itti ergee ficcisiise.
english: Then Herod, when he saw that he was mocked by the wise men, was exceedingly angry, and sent out and killed all the male children who were in Bethlehem and in all the surrounding countryside, from two years old and under, according to the exact time which he had learned from the wise men.

kikuyu: Kanaanis wanni Ermiyaas raajichi dubbate ni raawwatame. Innis akkana jedha:
english: Then that which was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying,

kikuyu: “Sagaleen booʼichaatii fi wawwaannaa guddaan tokko Raamaa keessaa dhagaʼame; sababii isaan hin jirreef, Raahel ijoollee isheetiif booʼaa jirti; jajjabaachuus ni didde.”
english: “A voice was heard in Ramah, lamentation, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children; she wouldn’t be comforted, because they are no more.”

kikuyu: Erga Heroodis duʼee booddee, ergamaan Gooftaa tokko Gibxitti abjuudhaan Yoosefitti mulʼatee,
english: But when Herod was dead, behold, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt, saying,

kikuyu: “Warri lubbuu mucichaa barbaadan waan duʼaniif kaʼiitii mucicha haadha isaa wajjin fudhadhuutii biyya Israaʼel dhaqi” jedheen.
english: “Arise and take the young child and his mother, and go into the land of Israel, for those who sought the young child’s life are dead.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yoosef kaʼee mucichaa fi haadha isaa fudhatee biyya Israaʼel dhaqe.
english: He arose and took the young child and his mother, and came into the land of Israel.

kikuyu: Garuu yommuu akka Arkelaawoos iddoo abbaa isaa, iddoo Heroodis Yihuudaa irratti moʼe dhagaʼetti achi dhaquu sodaate; abjuudhaanis waan of eeggachiisni isaaf kennameef gara aanaa Galiilaa deeme;
english: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning over Judea in the place of his father, Herod, he was afraid to go there. Being warned in a dream, he withdrew into the region of Galilee,

kikuyu: achis dhaqee magaalaa Naazreeti jedhamtu keessa jiraate. Kunis dubbiin, “Inni Naaziricha jedhamee ni waamama” jedhamee karaa raajotaatiin dubbatame sun akka raawwatamuuf taʼe.
english: and came and lived in a city called Nazareth; that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophets that he will be called a Nazarene.

kikuyu: Bara sana Yohannis Cuuphaan gammoojjii Yihuudaa keessatti lallabaa dhufe;
english: In those days, John the Baptizer came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea, saying,

kikuyu: innis, “Mootummaan samii dhiʼaateeraatii qalbii jijjiirradhaa” jedhe.
english: “Repent, for the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!”

kikuyu: Kunis isa waaʼeen isaa karaa Isaayyaas raajichaatiin, “Sagalee nama, ‘Gooftaadhaaf karaa qopheessaa; daandii qajeelaas isaaf hojjedhaa’ jedhee gammoojjii keessaa iyyu tokkoo” jedhamee dubbatame sanaa dha.
english: For this is he who was spoken of by Isaiah the prophet, saying, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, make the way of the Lord ready! Make his paths straight!”

kikuyu: Uffanni Yohannis rifeensa gaalaa irraa hojjetame; innis mudhii isaatti sabbata teephaa hidhata ture. Nyaanni isaa immoo hawwaannisaa fi damma bosonaa ture.
english: Now John himself wore clothing made of camel’s hair with a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.

kikuyu: Namoonnis Yerusaalem irraa, Yihuudaa hundaa fi biyya naannoo Yordaanos guutuu irraa gara isaa dhaqaa turan.
english: Then people from Jerusalem, all of Judea, and all the region around the Jordan went out to him.

kikuyu: Cubbuu isaaniis himachaa, Laga Yordaanos keessatti isaan cuuphamaa turan.
english: They were baptized by him in the Jordan, confessing their sins.

kikuyu: Inni garuu yommuu Fariisotaa fi Saduuqota keessaa baayʼeen isaanii utuu gara iddoo inni itti cuuphaa turee dhufanuu argetti akkana jedheen; “Isin ijoollee buutii nana! Dheekkamsa dhufu jalaa akka baqattaniif eenyutu isinitti hime?
english: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming for his baptism, he said to them, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

kikuyu: Egaa ija qalbii jijjiirrannaa mirkaneessu naqadhaa.
english: Therefore produce fruit worthy of repentance!

kikuyu: Isin, ‘Abbaan keenya Abrahaamii dha’ ofiin jechuu waan dandeessan hin seʼinaa. Waaqni dhagoota kanneen irraa Abrahaamiif ijoollee kaasuu akka dandaʼu ani isinittan himaatii.
english: Don’t think to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father,’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones.

kikuyu: Qottoon amma iyyuu hidda mukkeenii irra kaaʼameera; mukti ija gaarii hin naqanne hundinuus muramee ibiddatti darbatama.
english: Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and cast into the fire.

kikuyu: “Ani qalbii jijjiirrannaadhaafin bishaaniin isin cuupha. Inni na duubaan dhufu garuu na caalaa jabaa dha; ani kophee isaa iyyuu baachuuf hin malu. Inni Hafuura Qulqulluu fi ibiddaan isin cuupha.
english: “I indeed baptize you in water for repentance, but he who comes after me is mightier than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Inni afarsaa ittiin midhaan qulleessu of harkaa qaba; qamadii isaa gombisaatti naqata; oobdii isaa ni qulqulleessa; habaqii garuu ibidda hin dhaamneen guba.”
english: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor. He will gather his wheat into the barn, but the chaff he will burn up with unquenchable fire.”

kikuyu: Yesuus ergasii Yohannisiin cuuphamuuf Galiilaadhaa gara Laga Yordaanos dhufe.
english: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to John, to be baptized by him.

kikuyu: Yohannis garuu, “Ani siin cuuphamuu na barbaachisa; ati immoo gara koo dhuftaa?” jedhee isa dhowwe.
english: But John would have hindered him, saying, “I need to be baptized by you, and you come to me?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Ammaaf akkanuma haa taʼuu dhiisi; nu qajeelummaa hunda raawwachuudhaaf waan kana gochuu qabnaatii” jedheen. Yohannisis isa dhowwuu dhiise.
english: But Jesus, answering, said to him, “Allow it now, for this is the fitting way for us to fulfill all righteousness.” Then he allowed him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkuma cuuphameen bishaan keessaa ol baʼe. Innis yommusuma samiin banamee, utuu Hafuurri Waaqaa akkuma gugeetti gad buʼee isa irras qubatuu arge.
english: Jesus, when he was baptized, went up directly from the water: and behold, the heavens were opened to him. He saw the Spirit of God descending as a dove, and coming on him.

kikuyu: Sagaleen tokkos samii irraa, “Kun Ilma koo isa ani jaalladhuu dha; isatti baayʼee nan gammada” jedhe.
english: Behold, a voice out of the heavens said, “This is my beloved Son, with whom I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Yesuus akka diiyaabiloosiin qoramuuf Hafuuraan gammoojjiitti geeffame.
english: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.

kikuyu: Innis erga guyyaa afurtamaa fi halkan afurtama soomee booddee ni beelaʼe.
english: When he had fasted forty days and forty nights, he was hungry afterward.

kikuyu: Inni nama qoru sun gara isaa dhufee, “Ati yoo Ilma Waaqaa taate, akka dhagoonni kunneen buddeena taʼan ajaji” jedheen.
english: The tempter came and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command that these stones become bread.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo deebisee, “ ‘Namni dubbii afaan Waaqayyootii baʼu hundaan malee buddeena qofaan hin jiraatu’jedhamee barreeffameera” jedheen.
english: But he answered, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds out of God’s mouth.’”

kikuyu: Ergasii diiyaabiloos gara magaalaa qulqulluutti isa geessee fiixee mana qulqullummaa irra dhaabachiise.
english: Then the devil took him into the holy city. He set him on the pinnacle of the temple,

kikuyu: Akkanas jedheen; “Ati yoo Ilma Waaqaa taate, gad of darbadhu. Akkana jedhamee barreeffameeraatii: “ ‘Inni ergamoota isaa siif ni ajaja; isaanis akka ati miilla keetiin dhagaatti hin buuneef, harka isaaniitiin ol si fuudhu.’”
english: and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, throw yourself down, for it is written, ‘He will command his angels concerning you,’ and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, so that you don’t dash your foot against a stone.’”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo deebisee, “ ‘Waaqa kee Goofticha hin qorin’jedhamee barreeffameera” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “Again, it is written, ‘You shall not test the Lord, your God.’”

kikuyu: Ammas diiyaabiloos tulluu akka malee ol dheeraa tokkotti ol isa baasee mootummoota addunyaa hundaa fi ulfina isaanii isatti argisiise.
english: Again, the devil took him to an exceedingly high mountain, and showed him all the kingdoms of the world and their glory.

kikuyu: Akkanas jedheen; “Yoo ati gad jettee naaf sagadde, waan kana hundumaa siifin kenna.”
english: He said to him, “I will give you all of these things, if you will fall down and worship me.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Seexana nana, narraa fagaadhu! ‘Waaqa kee Gooftichaaf sagadi; isuma qofa tajaajili’jedhamee barreeffameeraatii” jedheen.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

kikuyu: Diiyaabiloosis isa dhiisee deeme; ergamoonni immoo dhufanii isa tajaajilan.
english: Then the devil left him, and behold, angels came and served him.

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu akka Yohannis mana hidhaatti galfame dhagaʼetti Galiilaatti deebiʼe.
english: Now when Jesus heard that John was delivered up, he withdrew into Galilee.

kikuyu: Innis Naazreetii baʼee gara Qifirnaahom ishee biyya Zebuuloonii fi Niftaalem keessatti qarqara galaanaatti argamtu sanaa dhaqee achi jiraate;
english: Leaving Nazareth, he came and lived in Capernaum, which is by the sea, in the region of Zebulun and Naphtali,

kikuyu: kunis akka dubbiin karaa Isaayyaas raajichaatiin dubbatame sun raawwatamuuf taʼe; dubbichis akkana jedha:
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: “Biyyi Zebuuloonii fi biyyi Niftaalem kanneen Yordaanos gama, qarqara Daandii Galaanaa irra jiran, Galiilaan Namoota Ormaas,
english: “The land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, toward the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the Gentiles,

kikuyu: sabni dukkana keessa jiraatu, ifa guddaa argeera; warra biyya gaaddidduu duʼaa keessa jiraataniifis, ifni baʼeera.”
english: the people who sat in darkness saw a great light; to those who sat in the region and shadow of death, to them light has dawned.”

kikuyu: Yesuus yeroo sanaa jalqabee, “Mootummaan samii dhiʼaateeraatii qalbii jijjiirradhaa” jedhee lallabuutti kaʼe.
english: From that time, Jesus began to preach, and to say, “Repent! For the Kingdom of Heaven is at hand.”

kikuyu: Yesuus utuu qarqara Galaana Galiilaa irra deemaa jiruu, obboloota lama jechuunis Simoon isa Phexros jedhamuu fi obboleessa isaa Indiriiyaasin arge. Isaanis qurxummii qabdoota waan taʼaniif kiyyoo galaanatti darbachaa turan.
english: Walking by the sea of Galilee, he saw two brothers: Simon, who is called Peter, and Andrew, his brother, casting a net into the sea; for they were fishermen.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Kottaa, na duukaa buʼaa; anis akka isin qabduu namootaa taataniif isin nan erga” jedheen.
english: He said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you fishers for men.”

kikuyu: Isaanis yommusuma kiyyoo isaanii dhiisanii isa duukaa buʼan.
english: They immediately left their nets and followed him.

kikuyu: Innis utuu achii kaʼee deemuu obboloota gara biraa lama jechuunis Yaaqoob ilma Zabdewoosii fi obboleessa isaa Yohannisin arge. Isaanis abbaa isaanii Zabdewoos wajjin kiyyoo isaanii qopheeffachaa bidiruu keessa turan. Yesuusis isaan waame;
english: Going on from there, he saw two other brothers, James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, in the boat with Zebedee their father, mending their nets. He called them.

kikuyu: isaanis yommusuma bidiruu sanaa fi abbaa isaanii dhiisanii isa duukaa buʼan.
english: They immediately left the boat and their father, and followed him.

kikuyu: Yesuus manneen sagadaa isaanii keessatti barsiisaa, wangeela mootummaa lallabaa, dhibee fi dhukkuba saba keessa jiru hunda fayyisaa Galiilaa guutuu keessa deeme.
english: Jesus went about in all Galilee, teaching in their synagogues, preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

kikuyu: Oduun waaʼee isaas Sooriyaa hunda keessatti dhagaʼame; namoonnis warra dhukkuba garaa garaatiin qabaman, warra dhukkuba hamaan dhiphatan, warra hafuura hamaan qabaman, warra dhukkuba gaggabdootiin dhiphatanii fi warra dhagni irratti duʼe isatti fidan; innis isaan fayyise.
english: The report about him went out into all Syria. They brought to him all who were sick, afflicted with various diseases and torments, possessed with demons, epileptics, and paralytics; and he healed them.

kikuyu: Tuunni namoota baayʼees Galiilaadhaa, Magaalaa Kurnanii, Yerusaalemii, Yihuudaa fi biyya Yordaanos gamaatii isa duukaa buʼe.
english: Great multitudes from Galilee, Decapolis, Jerusalem, Judea, and from beyond the Jordan followed him.

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu namoota baayʼee argetti, tulluutti ol baʼee taaʼe. Barattoonni isaas gara isaa dhufan;
english: Seeing the multitudes, he went up onto the mountain. When he had sat down, his disciples came to him.

kikuyu: innis isaan barsiisuu jalqabe. Akkanas jedhe:
english: He opened his mouth and taught them, saying,

kikuyu: “Warri hafuuraan hiyyeeyyii taʼan eebbifamoo dha; mootummaan samii kan isaaniitii.
english: “Blessed are the poor in spirit, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Warri gaddan eebbifamoo dha; jajjabina ni argatuutii.
english: Blessed are those who mourn, for they shall be comforted.

kikuyu: Warri garraamiin eebbifamoo dha; lafa ni dhaaluutii.
english: Blessed are the gentle, for they shall inherit the earth.

kikuyu: Warri qajeelummaa beelaʼanii fi dheebotan eebbifamoo dha; isaan ni quufuutii.
english: Blessed are those who hunger and thirst for righteousness, for they shall be filled.

kikuyu: Araara qabeeyyiin eebbifamoo dha; araara ni argatuutii.
english: Blessed are the merciful, for they shall obtain mercy.

kikuyu: Warri garaan isaanii qulqulluu eebbifamoo dha; Waaqa ni arguutii.
english: Blessed are the pure in heart, for they shall see God.

kikuyu: Warri nagaa buusan eebbifamoo dha; ijoollee Waaqaa ni jedhamuutii.
english: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they shall be called children of God.

kikuyu: Warri qajeelummaadhaaf jedhanii ariʼataman eebbifamoo dha; mootummaan samii kan isaaniitii.
english: Blessed are those who have been persecuted for righteousness’ sake, for theirs is the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: “Yommuu namoonni sababii kootiif jedhanii isin arrabsan, yommuu isin ariʼatanii fi yommuu waan hamaa gosa hundaa sobaan isin irratti dubbatan isin eebbifamoo dha.
english: “Blessed are you when people reproach you, persecute you, and say all kinds of evil against you falsely, for my sake.

kikuyu: Sababii gatiin keessan samii keessatti guddaa taʼeef ililchaa; gammadaas; isaan raajota isin dura turanis haaluma kanaan ariʼataniiruutii.
english: Rejoice, and be exceedingly glad, for great is your reward in heaven. For that is how they persecuted the prophets who were before you.

kikuyu: “Isin soogidda lafaa ti. Garuu soogiddi yoo miʼaa isaa dhabe, miʼaan isaa akkamiin deebifamuu dandaʼa? Gad gatamee miillaan dhidhiitama malee siʼachi waan tokko illee hin fayyadu.
english: “You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt has lost its flavor, with what will it be salted? It is then good for nothing, but to be cast out and trodden under the feet of men.

kikuyu: “Isin ifa addunyaa ti. Magaalaan gaara gubbaa jiru tokko dhokachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: “You are the light of the world. A city located on a hill can’t be hidden.

kikuyu: Yookaan namoonni ibsaa qabsiisanii gombisaa jala hin kaaʼan. Qooda kanaa baattuu isaa irra kaaʼu; ibsaan sunis namoota mana keessa jiran hundaaf ifa kenna.
english: Neither do you light a lamp and put it under a measuring basket, but on a stand; and it shines to all who are in the house.

kikuyu: Akka namoonni hojii keessan isa gaarii arganii abbaa keessan kan samii irraatiif ulfina kennaniif ifni keessanis akkasuma fuula namootaa duratti haa ifu.
english: Even so, let your light shine before men, that they may see your good works and glorify your Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: “Isin waan ani Seera yookaan Raajota diiguu dhufe hin seʼinaa; ani isaan raawwachuuf malee diiguuf hin dhufne.
english: “Don’t think that I came to destroy the law or the prophets. I didn’t come to destroy, but to fulfill.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; hamma samii fi lafti darbanitti, Seerri guutummaatti raawwatama malee seericha keessaa qubeen tokko iyyuu, tuqaan xinnoon ishee iyyuu gonkumaa hin baddu.
english: For most certainly, I tell you, until heaven and earth pass away, not even one smallest letter or one tiny pen stroke shall in any way pass away from the law, until all things are accomplished.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namni ajajawwan kanneen keessaa xinnaa isaa illee diigu, kan akka warri kaanis diiganiif barsiisu kam iyyuu mootummaa samii keessatti xinnaa jedhama; namni ajajawwan kanneen eeguu fi kan warra kaanis barsiisu kam iyyuu garuu mootummaa samii keessatti guddaa jedhama.
english: Therefore, whoever shall break one of these least commandments and teach others to do so, shall be called least in the Kingdom of Heaven; but whoever shall do and teach them shall be called great in the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; qajeelummaan keessan qajeelummaa Fariisotaatii fi qajeelummaa barsiistota seeraa yoo caaluu baate isin dhugumaan mootummaa samiitti hin galtan.
english: For I tell you that unless your righteousness exceeds that of the scribes and Pharisees, there is no way you will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: “Isin akka bara dheeraan dura namootaan, ‘Hin ajjeesin; nama ajjeese kamitti iyyuu ni muramaa’jedhame dhageessaniirtu.
english: “You have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not murder;’ and ‘Whoever murders will be in danger of the judgment.’

kikuyu: Ani garuu isinittin hima; nama obboleessa isaatti dheekkamu hundumaa murtiitu eeggata. Namni obboleessa isaatiin ‘Raatuu’ jedhu hundis murtii waldaatti dhiʼaata. Nama obboleessa isaatiin ‘Doofaa nana!’ jedhu immoo ibidda gahaannamtu isa eeggata.
english: But I tell you that everyone who is angry with his brother without a cause will be in danger of the judgment. Whoever says to his brother, ‘Raca!’ will be in danger of the council. Whoever says, ‘You fool!’ will be in danger of the fire of Gehenna.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu ati yeroo kennaa kee iddoo aarsaatti dhiʼeessitutti yoo akka obboleessi kee komii sirraa qabu yaadatte,
english: “If therefore you are offering your gift at the altar, and there remember that your brother has anything against you,

kikuyu: kennaa kee achuma iddoo aarsaa duratti dhiisii dhaqiitii duraan dursii obboleessa keetti araarami; ergasii kottuutii kennaa kee dhiʼeessi.
english: leave your gift there before the altar, and go your way. First be reconciled to your brother, and then come and offer your gift.

kikuyu: “Amajaajii kee isa mana murtiitti si geessaa jiru wajjin dafii walii gali. Kanas utuma isa wajjin karaa jirtuu godhi; yoo kanaa achii amajaajiin kee dabarsee abbaa seeraatti si kenna; abbaan seeraa immoo poolisiitti si kenna; atis mana hidhaatti darbatamta.
english: Agree with your adversary quickly while you are with him on the way; lest perhaps the prosecutor deliver you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and you be cast into prison.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman sitti hima; ati hamma saantima ishee dhumaa baaftutti achii hin baatu.
english: Most certainly I tell you, you shall by no means get out of there until you have paid the last penny.

kikuyu: “Isin akka, ‘Hin ejjin’jedhame dhageessaniirtu.
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall not commit adultery;’

kikuyu: Ani garuu isinittin hima; namni hawwiidhaan dubartii ilaalu hundinuu yaada isaatti ishee wajjin ejjeera.
english: but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his heart.

kikuyu: Yoo iji kee mirgaa si gufachiise, of keessaa baasii gati. Dhagni kee guutuun gahaannamitti darbatamuu irra, kutaa dhagna keetii keessaa tokko dhabuu siif wayyaatii.
english: If your right eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

kikuyu: Yoo harki kee mirgaa si gufachiise of irraa murii gati. Dhagni kee guutuun gahaannamitti galuu irra, kutaa dhagna keetii keessaa tokko dhabuu siif wayya.
english: If your right hand causes you to stumble, cut it off, and throw it away from you. For it is more profitable for you that one of your members should perish, than for your whole body to be cast into Gehenna.

kikuyu: “Namni niitii isaa hiiku kam iyyuu, ‘Waraqaa ragaa hiikkaa haa kennuuf’jedhameera.
english: “It was also said, ‘Whoever shall put away his wife, let him give her a writing of divorce,’

kikuyu: Ani garuu isinittin hima; namni utuu isheen halalummaa hin hojjetin niitii isaa hiiku kam iyyuu akka isheen ejjitu ishee taasisa; namni dubartii hiikamte fuudhu kam iyyuus ni ejja.
english: but I tell you that whoever puts away his wife, except for the cause of sexual immorality, makes her an adulteress; and whoever marries her when she is put away commits adultery.

kikuyu: “Ammas akka warra duriitiin, ‘Waan kakatte Gooftaadhaaf guuti malee sobaan hin kakatin’jedhame dhageessaniirtu.
english: “Again you have heard that it was said to the ancient ones, ‘You shall not make false vows, but shall perform to the Lord your vows,’

kikuyu: Ani garuu isinittin hima; gonkumaa hin kakatinaa: samiidhaan hin kakatinaa; inni teessoo Waaqaatii;
english: but I tell you, don’t swear at all: neither by heaven, for it is the throne of God;

kikuyu: yookaan lafaan hin kakatinaa; isheen ejjeta miilla isaatii; yookaan Yerusaalemiin hin kakatinaa; isheen magaalaa Mooticha Guddaatii.
english: nor by the earth, for it is the footstool of his feet; nor by Jerusalem, for it is the city of the great King.

kikuyu: Mataa keetiinis hin kakatin; ati rifeensa tokko illee addeessuu yookaan gurraachesuu hin dandeessuutii.
english: Neither shall you swear by your head, for you can’t make one hair white or black.

kikuyu: Wanni isin jechuu qabdan, ‘Eeyyee’ yookaan ‘Waawuu’ haa taʼu; wanni kanaa achii kam iyyuu isa hamaa sana irraa dhufa.
english: But let your ‘Yes’ be ‘Yes’ and your ‘No’ be ‘No.’ Whatever is more than these is of the evil one.

kikuyu: “ ‘Qooda ijaa, ija; qooda ilkaanii immoo ilkaan’akka jedhame dhageessaniirtu.
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘An eye for an eye, and a tooth for a tooth.’

kikuyu: Ani garuu isinittin hima. Nama hamaadhaan hin morkatinaa. Yoo namni tokko maddii kee mirgaa si kabale, kaanis itti qabi.
english: But I tell you, don’t resist him who is evil; but whoever strikes you on your right cheek, turn to him the other also.

kikuyu: Yoo namni tokko si himatee kittaa kee sirraa fudhate, kootii kees kenniif.
english: If anyone sues you to take away your coat, let him have your cloak also.

kikuyu: Yoo namni tokko akka ati gara kiiloo meetira tokkoo fi walakkaa isa wajjin deemtu si dirqisiise, ati immoo gara kiiloo meetira sadii isa wajjin deemi.
english: Whoever compels you to go one mile, go with him two.

kikuyu: Nama si kadhatuuf kenni; nama sirraa liqeeffachuu barbaaduttis dugda hin garagalchin.
english: Give to him who asks you, and don’t turn away him who desires to borrow from you.

kikuyu: “ ‘Ollaa kee jaalladhu;diina kee jibbi’ akka jedhame dhageessaniirtu.
english: “You have heard that it was said, ‘You shall love your neighbor and hate your enemy.’

kikuyu: Ani garuu isinittin hima; diinota keessan jaalladhaa; warra isin ariʼataniifis kadhadhaa;
english: But I tell you, love your enemies, bless those who curse you, do good to those who hate you, and pray for those who mistreat you and persecute you,

kikuyu: kanaanis abbaa keessan kan samii irraatiif ijoollee ni taatu. Inni warra hamoo fi warra gaggaariidhaaf aduu isaa ni baasa; qajeeltotaa fi jalʼootaafis bokkaa ni roobsa.
english: that you may be children of your Father who is in heaven. For he makes his sun to rise on the evil and the good, and sends rain on the just and the unjust.

kikuyu: Isin warra isin jaallatan qofa yoo jaallattan gatii maalii argattu? Kana immoo qaraxxoonni iyyuu ni godhu mitii?
english: For if you love those who love you, what reward do you have? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

kikuyu: Isin yoo obboloota keessan qofa nagaa gaafattan warra kaan caalaa maal hojjechuutti jirtu? Kana immoo ormoonni iyyuu ni godhu mitii?
english: If you only greet your friends, what more do you do than others? Don’t even the tax collectors do the same?

kikuyu: Akkuma abbaan keessan inni samii irraa mudaa hin qabne sana, isinis warra mudaa hin qabne taʼaa.
english: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.

kikuyu: “Akka isaan isin arganiif jettanii ‘Hojii qajeelummaa’ keessan fuula namootaa duratti akka hin hojjenneef of eeggadhaa. Yoo akkas gootan abbaa keessan kan samii irraa biraa gatii hin qabaattaniitii.
english: “Be careful that you don’t do your charitable giving before men, to be seen by them, or else you have no reward from your Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu ati yommuu warra rakkataniif waa kennitutti akka fakkeessitoonni namoota biratti jajamuuf jedhanii manneen sagadaa keessattii fi karaa irratti godhan sana malakataan hin labsatin. Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; isaan gatii isaanii argataniiru.
english: Therefore, when you do merciful deeds, don’t sound a trumpet before yourself, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, that they may get glory from men. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

kikuyu: Yeroo ati rakkattootaaf waa kennitutti garuu waan harki kee mirgaa godhu, harki kee bitaa hin beekin;
english: But when you do merciful deeds, don’t let your left hand know what your right hand does,

kikuyu: kunis akka kennaan kee dhoksaan taʼuuf. Abbaan kee inni waan dhoksaatti hojjetamu argu sun ifaan ifatti gatii siif kenna.
english: so that your merciful deeds may be in secret, then your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

kikuyu: “Isin yommuu kadhattan akka fakkeessitootaa hin taʼinaa; isaan namatti mulʼachuuf jedhanii manneen sagadaa keessaa fi golee karaa irra dhaabatanii kadhachuu jaallatuutii. Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; isaan gatii isaanii argataniiru.
english: “When you pray, you shall not be as the hypocrites, for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and in the corners of the streets, that they may be seen by men. Most certainly, I tell you, they have received their reward.

kikuyu: Ati garuu yeroo kadhattu mana keetti ol gali; balbala cufadhuutii Abbaa kee isa hin mulʼanne sana kadhadhu. Abbaan kee inni waan dhoksaatti hojjetamu argu sun ifaan ifatti gatii siif kenna.
english: But you, when you pray, enter into your inner room, and having shut your door, pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you openly.

kikuyu: Isinis yommuu kadhattan akka ormootaa dubbii faayidaa hin qabne irra hin deddeebiʼinaa; isaan baayʼina dubbii isaaniitiin waan isaaniif dhagaʼamu seʼu.
english: In praying, don’t use vain repetitions as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard for their much speaking.

kikuyu: Isin akka isaanii hin taʼinaa; abbaan keessan utuma isin hin kadhatin iyyuu waan isin barbaachisu ni beekaatii.
english: Therefore don’t be like them, for your Father knows what things you need before you ask him.

kikuyu: “Egaa akkana jedhaa kadhadhaa: “ ‘Yaa Abbaa keenya kan samii irra jirtu, maqaan kee haa qulqullaaʼu;
english: Pray like this: “‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy.

kikuyu: mootummaan kee haa dhufu; fedhiin kee akkuma samii irratti taʼe sana, lafa irrattis haa taʼu.
english: Let your Kingdom come. Let your will be done on earth as it is in heaven.

kikuyu: Buddeena keenya kan guyyuma guyyaa harʼa nuu kenni.
english: Give us today our daily bread.

kikuyu: Akkuma nu warra yakka nutti hojjetaniif dhiifnu sana, atis yakka keenya nuuf dhiisi.
english: Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.

kikuyu: Isa hamaa jalaa nu baasi malee qoramatti nu hin galchin.’ Mootummaan, humni, ulfinnis bara baraan kan kee ti. Ameen.
english: Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one. For yours is the Kingdom, the power, and the glory forever. Amen.’

kikuyu: Yoo isin namootaaf cubbuu isaanii dhiiftan, Abbaan keessan inni samii irraas akkasuma isiniif dhiisaatii.
english: “For if you forgive men their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you.

kikuyu: Yoo isin namootaaf cubbuu isaanii dhiisuu baattan garuu, Abbaan keessanis akkasuma cubbuu keessan isiniif hin dhiisu.
english: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

kikuyu: “Isin yommuu soomtanitti akka fakkeessitootaa fuula hin dukkaneeffatinaa; isaan akka soomuutti jiran argisiifachuuf jedhanii fuula isaanii hammeessu. Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; isaan gatii isaanii argataniiru.
english: “Moreover when you fast, don’t be like the hypocrites, with sad faces. For they disfigure their faces that they may be seen by men to be fasting. Most certainly I tell you, they have received their reward.

kikuyu: Ati garuu yeroo soomtu mataa kee dibadhu; fuula kees dhiqadhu.
english: But you, when you fast, anoint your head and wash your face,

kikuyu: Kunis akka sooma kee sana abbaa kee isa namatti hin mulʼanne malee namni hin beekneefii dha. Abbaan kee inni waan dhoksaatti hojjetamu argu sun gatii kee ifaan ifatti siif kenna.
english: so that you are not seen by men to be fasting, but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father, who sees in secret, will reward you.

kikuyu: “Isin iddoo itti bilii fi daanaʼoon balleessituu fi iddoo itti hattuun cabsitee hattu lafa irratti badhaadhummaa ofii keessaniif hin kuufatinaa.
english: “Don’t lay up treasures for yourselves on the earth, where moth and rust consume, and where thieves break through and steal;

kikuyu: Garuu iddoo itti bilii fi daanaʼoon nyaattee hin balleessinee fi iddoo itti hattuun cabsitee hin hanne samii irratti badhaadhummaa ofii keessaniif kuufadhaa.
english: but lay up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consume, and where thieves don’t break through and steal;

kikuyu: Idduma badhaadhummaan kee jiru sana garaan kees jiraatii.
english: for where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.

kikuyu: “Iji ibsaa dhagnaa ti. Iji kee fayyaa taanaan, dhagni kee guutuun ifaan guutama.
english: “The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

kikuyu: Yoo iji kee fayyaa hin taʼin garuu, dhagni kee guutuun ni dukkanaaʼa. Erga ifni si keessa jiru sun dukkanaaʼee, dukkanni sun hammam haa jabaatu ree!
english: But if your eye is evil, your whole body will be full of darkness. If therefore the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!

kikuyu: “Namni gooftota lama tajaajiluu dandaʼu tokko iyyuu hin jiru. Isa tokko jibbitee isa kaan jaallattaatii; yookaan isa tokkoof of kennitee isa kaan immoo tuffatta. Isinis Waaqaa fi Maallaqa tajaajiluu hin dandeessan.
english: “No one can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other, or else he will be devoted to one and despise the other. You can’t serve both God and Mammon.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu ani isinittin hima; ‘Maal nyaanna yookaan maal dhugna?’ jettanii waaʼee jireenya keessanii hin yaaddaʼinaa; yookaan ‘maal uffanna?’ jettanii waaʼee dhagna keessanii hin yaaddaʼinaa. Jireenyi nyaata hin caaluu? Dhagnis uffata hin caaluu?
english: Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life: what you will eat, or what you will drink; nor yet for your body, what you will wear. Isn’t life more than food, and the body more than clothing?

kikuyu: Mee simbirroota samii ilaalaa; isaan hin facaafatan yookaan hin haammatan yookaan gombisaatti hin galfatan; taʼus Abbaan keessan inni samii irraa isaan soora. Isin immoo isaan caalaa gatii guddaa qabdu mitii?
english: See the birds of the sky, that they don’t sow, neither do they reap, nor gather into barns. Your heavenly Father feeds them. Aren’t you of much more value than they?

kikuyu: Isin keessaa namni yaaddaʼuudhaan hojjaa isaa irratti dhundhuma tokko dabalachuu dandaʼuu eenyu?
english: “Which of you by being anxious, can add one moment to his lifespan?

kikuyu: “Isin maaliif waaʼee uffataa yaaddoftu? Daraaraawwan dirree akkamitti akka guddatan mee ilaalaa. Isaan hin dhamaʼan yookaan hin foʼan.
english: Why are you anxious about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin,

kikuyu: Ani garuu isinittin hima; Solomoon iyyuu ulfina isaa hunda keessatti, akka tokkoo isaaniitti hin uffanne.
english: yet I tell you that even Solomon in all his glory was not dressed like one of these.

kikuyu: Isin yaa warra amantii xinnoo nana. Waaqni erga marga dirree kan harʼa jiruu fi kan bor immoo ibiddatti naqamutti iyyuu akkasitti uffisee, isinitti immoo guddaa caalchisee hin uffisuu ree?
english: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which today exists and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, won’t he much more clothe you, you of little faith?

kikuyu: Kanaafuu, ‘Maal nyaanna?’ yookaan ‘Maal dhugna?’ yookaan ‘Maal uffanna?’ jettanii hin yaaddaʼinaa.
english: “Therefore don’t be anxious, saying, ‘What will we eat?’, ‘What will we drink?’ or, ‘With what will we be clothed?’

kikuyu: Kana hunda ormoonni iyyuu ni barbaaduutii; Abbaan keessan inni samii irraas akka wanni kun hundinuu isin barbaachisu ni beeka.
english: For the Gentiles seek after all these things; for your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.

kikuyu: Garuu duraan dursaatii mootummaa isaatii fi qajeelummaa isaa barbaadaa; wanni kun hundinuu akkasuma isiniif kennama.
english: But seek first God’s Kingdom and his righteousness; and all these things will be given to you as well.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu waaʼee boriitiif hin yaaddaʼinaa; bor ofii isaatiif ni yaaddaʼaatii. Hamminni guyyaa sanaa mataan isaa guyyicha ni gaʼa.
english: Therefore don’t be anxious for tomorrow, for tomorrow will be anxious for itself. Each day’s own evil is sufficient.

kikuyu: “Akka isinitti hin muramneef namoota kaanitti hin murinaa.
english: “Don’t judge, so that you won’t be judged.

kikuyu: Murtiidhuma isin namatti murtaniin isinitti muramaatii; safartuu ittiin safartaniinis isiniif safarama.
english: For with whatever judgment you judge, you will be judged; and with whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you.

kikuyu: “Ati maaliif jirma ija kee keessa jiru arguu dhiiftee huuba ija obboleessa keetii keessa jiru ilaalta?
english: Why do you see the speck that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

kikuyu: Ati utuu jirmi ija kee keessa jiruu akkamitti obboleessa keetiin, ‘Kottu mee ani huuba ija kee keessa jiru siif nan baasa’ jechuu dandeessa?
english: Or how will you tell your brother, ‘Let me remove the speck from your eye,’ and behold, the beam is in your own eye?

kikuyu: Fakkeessituu nana; duraan dursiitii jirma ija kee keessa jiru baafadhu; ergasiis huuba ija obboleessa keetii keessa jiru baasuudhaaf sirriitti argita.
english: You hypocrite! First remove the beam out of your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck out of your brother’s eye.

kikuyu: “Waan qulqulluu sarootaaf hin kenninaa; lula keessanis booyyee dura hin buusinaa. Yoo kana gootan isaan miilla isaaniitiin dhidhiitu; gara galanis isin cicciru.
english: “Don’t give that which is holy to the dogs, neither throw your pearls before the pigs, lest perhaps they trample them under their feet, and turn and tear you to pieces.

kikuyu: “Kadhadhaa, isiniif ni kennamaa; barbaadaa, ni argattuu; rurrukutaa, balballi isiniif ni banamaa.
english: “Ask, and it will be given you. Seek, and you will find. Knock, and it will be opened for you.

kikuyu: Namni kadhatu hundi ni argataatii; namni barbaadu ni argata; nama rurrukutuufis balballi ni banama.
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

kikuyu: “Isin keessaa namni yoo ilmi isaa buddeena isa kadhate, dhagaa kennuuf eenyu?
english: Or who is there among you who, if his son asks him for bread, will give him a stone?

kikuyu: Yookaan yoo inni qurxummii isa kadhate, bofa kennuuf eenyu?
english: Or if he asks for a fish, who will give him a serpent?

kikuyu: Erga isin warri hamoon iyyuu kennaa gaarii ijoollee keessaniif kennuu beektanii, abbaan keessan inni samii irraa immoo hammam caalchisee warra isa kadhataniif kennaa gaarii haa kennuu ree!
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your Father who is in heaven give good things to those who ask him!

kikuyu: Kanaafuu waan akka namoonni isiniif godhan barbaaddan hundumaa isinis akkasuma isaaniif godhaa; Seerris Raajonnis kanumaatii.
english: Therefore, whatever you desire for men to do to you, you shall also do to them; for this is the law and the prophets.

kikuyu: “Karra dhiphaadhaan seenaa. Karaan badiisatti geessu balʼaadhaatii; karri isaas balʼaa dha; namoonni ittiin seenanis baayʼee dha.
english: “Enter in by the narrow gate; for the gate is wide and the way is broad that leads to destruction, and there are many who enter in by it.

kikuyu: Garuu karri isaa dhiphaa dha; karaan jireenyatti nama geessu qalʼaa dha; warri isa argatanis muraasa.
english: How narrow is the gate and the way is restricted that leads to life! There are few who find it.

kikuyu: “Raajota sobaa warra kalʼee hoolaa uffatanii gara keessan dhufan, kanneen keessi isaanii garuu yeeyyii akka malee beelaʼee waa cicciratu taʼe irraa of eeggadhaa.
english: “Beware of false prophets, who come to you in sheep’s clothing, but inwardly are ravening wolves.

kikuyu: Isin ija isaaniitiin isaan beektu. Namoonni qoraattii irraa wayinii yookaan sokorruu irraa harbuu ni ciruu?
english: By their fruits you will know them. Do you gather grapes from thorns or figs from thistles?

kikuyu: Akkasumas mukni gaariin hundumtuu ija gaarii naqata; mukni gadheen immoo ija gadhee naqata.
english: Even so, every good tree produces good fruit, but the corrupt tree produces evil fruit.

kikuyu: Mukni gaariin ija gadhee naqachuu hin dandaʼu; mukni gadheenis ija gaarii naqachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: A good tree can’t produce evil fruit, neither can a corrupt tree produce good fruit.

kikuyu: Mukni ija gaarii hin naqanne hundi muramee ibiddatti naqama.
english: Every tree that doesn’t grow good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.

kikuyu: Kanaaf isin ija isaaniitiin isaan beektu.
english: Therefore by their fruits you will know them.

kikuyu: “Nama fedhii Abbaa koo isa samii irraa raawwatu malee namni, ‘Yaa Gooftaa, yaa Gooftaa’ naan jedhu hundi mootummaa samiitti hin galu.
english: “Not everyone who says to me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven, but he who does the will of my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Guyyaa sana namoonni hedduun, ‘Yaa Gooftaa, yaa Gooftaa, nu maqaa keetiin raajii dubbanneerra mitii? Maqaa keetiin hafuurota hamoo baafneerra mitii? Maqaa keetiin dinqii hedduu hojjenneerra mitii?’ naan jedhu.
english: Many will tell me in that day, ‘Lord, Lord, didn’t we prophesy in your name, in your name cast out demons, and in your name do many mighty works?’

kikuyu: Ani immoo, ‘Narraa fagaadhaa! Isin warra hammina hojjettan, ani gonkumaa isin hin beekne’ jedhee ifaan ifatti isaanitti nan hima.
english: Then I will tell them, ‘I never knew you. Depart from me, you who work iniquity.’

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu namni dubbii koo kana dhagaʼee hojiidhaan argisiisu hundi, nama ogeessa mana isaa kattaa irratti ijaarrate fakkaata.
english: “Everyone therefore who hears these words of mine and does them, I will liken him to a wise man who built his house on the rock.

kikuyu: Bokkaan roobee, lolaan lolaʼee, bubbeenis bubbisee mana sana dhaʼe; manichi garuu waan kattaa irratti hundeeffameef hin jigne.
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it didn’t fall, for it was founded on the rock.

kikuyu: Namni dubbii koo kana dhagaʼee hojiidhaan hin argisiifne hundi garuu nama gowwaa mana isaa cirracha irratti ijaarrate fakkaata.
english: Everyone who hears these words of mine and doesn’t do them will be like a foolish man who built his house on the sand.

kikuyu: Bokkaan roobee, lolaan lolaʼee, bubbeenis bubbisee manicha dhaʼe; manni sunis ni jige; jiguun isaas akka malee hamaa ture.”
english: The rain came down, the floods came, and the winds blew and beat on that house; and it fell—and its fall was great.”

kikuyu: Yommuu Yesuus dubbii kana dubbatee raawwatetti namoonni barsiisa isaa ni dinqisiifatan;
english: When Jesus had finished saying these things, the multitudes were astonished at his teaching,

kikuyu: inni akka barsiistota seeraatti utuu hin taʼin, akka nama taayitaa qabu tokkootti isaan barsiisa tureetii.
english: for he taught them with authority, and not like the scribes.

kikuyu: Yeroo Yesuus gaara irraa buʼetti, tuuta namoota baayʼeetu isa duukaa buʼe.
english: When he came down from the mountain, great multitudes followed him.

kikuyu: Kunoo namichi lamxaaʼaan tokkos dhufee, fuula isaa duratti jilbeenfatee, “Yaa Gooftaa, yoo fedhii kee taʼe, ati na qulqulleessuu ni dandeessa” jedheen.
english: Behold, a leper came to him and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis harka isaa hiixatee namicha qaqqabee, “Fedhii koo ti; qulqullaaʼi!” jedheen. Lamxiin isaas yeruma sana qulqullaaʼe.
english: Jesus stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately his leprosy was cleansed.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Yesuus, “Nama tokkotti illee akka hin himne beekkadhu. Garuu dhaqiitii akka isaaniif ragaa taʼuuf lubatti of argisiisi; kennaa Museen ajaje sana illee dhiʼeessi” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “See that you tell nobody; but go, show yourself to the priest, and offer the gift that Moses commanded, as a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Yeroo Yesuus Qifirnaahom seenetti, ajajaan dhibbaa tokko gara isaa dhufee akkana jedhee isa kadhate;
english: When he came into Capernaum, a centurion came to him, asking him for help,

kikuyu: “Yaa Gooftaa, tajaajilaan koo dhagni irratti duʼee mana ciisa; akka malees dhiphachaa jira.”
english: saying, “Lord, my servant lies in the house paralyzed, grievously tormented.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Ani dhufeen isa fayyisa” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “I will come and heal him.”

kikuyu: Ajajaan dhibbaa sun immoo akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Yaa Gooftaa, ati bantii mana kootii jala seenuun naaf hin malu. Garuu dubbicha qofa dubbadhu; tajaajilaan koo ni fayyaatii.
english: The centurion answered, “Lord, I’m not worthy for you to come under my roof. Just say the word, and my servant will be healed.
