kikuyu: Ani mataan koo iyyuu nama taayitaa jala jiruu dha; loltootas of jalaa qaba. Isa tokkoon, ‘Deemi’ nan jedha; innis ni deema; isa kaaniin immoo, ‘Kottu’ nan jedha; innis ni dhufa. Tajaajilaa kootiinis, ‘Waan kana hojjedhu’ nan jedha; innis ni hojjeta.”
english: For I am also a man under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go,’ and he goes; and tell another, ‘Come,’ and he comes; and tell my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti dinqifatee warra isa duukaa buʼaa turaniin akkana jedhe; “Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; ani Israaʼel keessatti nama amantii guddaa akkanaa qabu tokko illee hin arganne.
english: When Jesus heard it, he marveled and said to those who followed, “Most certainly I tell you, I haven’t found so great a faith, not even in Israel.

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; namoonni hedduun baʼa biiftuutii fi lixa biiftuutii ni dhufu; isaanis Abrahaam, Yisihaaqii fi Yaaqoob wajjin mootummaa samii keessatti maaddiitti ni dhiʼaatu.
english: I tell you that many will come from the east and the west, and will sit down with Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob in the Kingdom of Heaven,

kikuyu: Ijoolleen mootummaa garuu dukkana alaatti gad darbatamu; achitti booʼuu fi ilkaan qaruutu taʼa.”
english: but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee ajajaa dhibbaa sanaan, “Akkuma amantii keetii siif haa taʼu; deemi!” jedhe. Tajaajilaan isaas yeruma sana fayye.
english: Jesus said to the centurion, “Go your way. Let it be done for you as you have believed.” His servant was healed in that hour.

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu mana Phexros seenetti, haati niitii Phexros dhukkuba dhagna gubaadhaan qabamtee ciiftee arge.
english: When Jesus came into Peter’s house, he saw his wife’s mother lying sick with a fever.

kikuyu: Innis harka ishee tuqe; dhagna gubaan sunis ishee dhiise; isheenis kaatee isa tajaajiluu jalqabde.
english: He touched her hand, and the fever left her. So she got up and served him.

kikuyu: Galgala sanas namoota hafuurota hamoon qabaman hedduu gara isaa fidan; innis jecha tokkoon hafuurota sana baase; dhukkubsattoota hundumaa ni fayyise.
english: When evening came, they brought to him many possessed with demons. He cast out the spirits with a word, and healed all who were sick,

kikuyu: Kunis akka dubbiin karaa Isaayyaas raajichaatiin, “Inni dhibee keenya nurraa fuudhe; dhukkuba keenyas ni baate” jedhame sun raawwatamuuf taʼe.
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying, “He took our infirmities and bore our diseases.”

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu tuuta namoota baayʼee naannoo isaatti argetti akka gama ceʼaniif ajaje.
english: Now when Jesus saw great multitudes around him, he gave the order to depart to the other side.

kikuyu: Barsiisaan seeraa tokkos gara isaa dhufee, “Yaa barsiisaa, ani iddoo ati dhaqxu hundatti si duukaa nan buʼa” jedhe.
english: A scribe came and said to him, “Teacher, I will follow you wherever you go.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Waangoonni boolla qabu; simbirroonnis manʼee qabu; Ilmi Namaa garuu iddoo itti mataa isaa irkifatu illee hin qabu” jedhe.
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has nowhere to lay his head.”

kikuyu: Barattoota isaa keessaas inni tokko, “Yaa Gooftaa, dura akka ani dhaqee abbaa koo awwaalladhu naa eeyyami!” jedheen.
english: Another of his disciples said to him, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu, “Warri duʼan duʼaa isaanii haa awwaallatan; ati immoo na duukaa buʼi” jedheen.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Follow me, and leave the dead to bury their own dead.”

kikuyu: Yommuu inni bidiruu yaabbatettis, barattoonni isaa isa duukaa buʼan.
english: When he got into a boat, his disciples followed him.

kikuyu: Akkuma tasaa bubbeen hamaan tokko galaana irratti kaʼe; dambaliinis bidiruu sana irra gara gale. Yesuus garuu rafaa ture.
english: Behold, a violent storm came up on the sea, so much that the boat was covered with the waves; but he was asleep.

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaa gara isaa dhufanii, “Yaa Gooftaa, nu oolchi! Nu dhumuufii!” jedhanii isa dammaqsan.
english: The disciples came to him and woke him up, saying, “Save us, Lord! We are dying!”

kikuyu: Innis deebisee, “Isin warra amantii xinnoo nana; maaliif akkana sodaattu?” jedheen. Kaʼees bubbee sanaa fi galaana sana ifate; tasgabbiin guddaanis ni taʼe.
english: He said to them, “Why are you fearful, O you of little faith?” Then he got up, rebuked the wind and the sea, and there was a great calm.

kikuyu: Namoonnis dinqifatanii, “Namni bubbee fi galaanni ajajamaniif kun nama akkamii ti?” jedhan.
english: The men marveled, saying, “What kind of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

kikuyu: Yommuu Yesuus gama ceʼee biyya Gadareen gaʼetti, namoonni hafuura hamaan qabaman lama iddoo awwaalaatii baʼanii itti dhufan. Isaanis waan akka malee hamoo turaniif namni tokko iyyuu karaa sana irra darbuu hin dandaʼu ture.
english: When he came to the other side, into the country of the Gergesenes, two people possessed by demons met him there, coming out of the tombs, exceedingly fierce, so that nobody could pass that way.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Yaa Ilma Waaqaa, ati maal nurraa barbaadda? Utuu yeroon sun hin gaʼin nu dhiphisuu dhufte moo?” jedhanii iyyan.
english: Behold, they cried out, saying, “What do we have to do with you, Jesus, Son of God? Have you come here to torment us before the time?”

kikuyu: Hoomaan booyyee guddaan isaas xinnoo isaan irraa fagaatee dheedaa ture.
english: Now there was a herd of many pigs feeding far away from them.

kikuyu: Hafuuronni hamoon sunis, “Yoo nu baafte, gara hoomaa booyyee sanaatti nu ergi” jedhanii Yesuusin kadhatan.
english: The demons begged him, saying, “If you cast us out, permit us to go away into the herd of pigs.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Dhaqaa!” jedheen. Isaanis namicha keessaa baʼanii hoomaa booyyee sanatti galan; hoomaan sun guutuunis ededa hallayyaa irraa gad gugatee galaanatti namʼee bishaan keessatti dhume.
english: He said to them, “Go!” They came out and went into the herd of pigs; and behold, the whole herd of pigs rushed down the cliff into the sea and died in the water.

kikuyu: Warri booyyeewwan tiksan sunis baqatanii magaalaa seenan; isaanis waan hunda, waan namoota hafuurota hamoon qabamanii turan irra gaʼes ni odeessan.
english: Those who fed them fled and went away into the city and told everything, including what happened to those who were possessed with demons.

kikuyu: Magaalaan sun guutuunis Yesuusin arguuf baʼe. Yommuu isa argettis akka inni biyya isaanii keessaa baʼuuf isa kadhate.
english: Behold, all the city came out to meet Jesus. When they saw him, they begged that he would depart from their borders.

kikuyu: Yesuus bidiruu yaabbatee galaana ceʼee gara magaalaa isaa dhufe.
english: He entered into a boat and crossed over, and came into his own city.

kikuyu: Kunoo, jarri tokko nama dhagni irratti duʼee siree irra ciisu tokko gara isaa fidan. Yesuusis yommuu amantii isaanii argetti namichaan, “Ilma koo jabaadhu; cubbuun kee siif dhiifameeraatii” jedhe.
english: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, cheer up! Your sins are forgiven you.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti barsiistota seeraa keessaa tokko tokko garaa isaanii keessatti, “Kunoo, namichi kun Waaqa arrabsa!” jedhan.
english: Behold, some of the scribes said to themselves, “This man blasphemes.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis yaada isaanii beekee akkana jedhe; “Isin maaliif garaa keessan keessatti waan hamaa yaaddu?
english: Jesus, knowing their thoughts, said, “Why do you think evil in your hearts?

kikuyu: ‘Cubbuun kee siif dhiifameera’ jechuu moo ‘Kaʼii deemi’ jechuutu salphaa dha?
english: For which is easier, to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Get up, and walk’?

kikuyu: Ani garuu akka Ilmi Namaa cubbuu namaaf dhiisuudhaaf lafa irratti taayitaa qabu akka beektan nan barbaada.” Kanaafuu inni namicha dhagni irratti duʼe sanaan, “Kaʼi; siree kee fudhadhuutii mana keetti gali” jedhe.
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins—” (then he said to the paralytic), “Get up, and take up your mat, and go to your house.”

kikuyu: Namichis kaʼee mana isaatti gale.
english: He arose and departed to his house.

kikuyu: Namoonnis yommuu waan kana arganitti ni dinqifatan; Waaqa taayitaa akkasii namaaf kenneefis ulfina kennan.
english: But when the multitudes saw it, they marveled and glorified God, who had given such authority to men.

kikuyu: Yesuus achii kaʼee utuu deemuu namicha Maatewos jedhamu tokko utuu inni iddoo itti qaraxa walitti qaban taaʼuu argee, “Na duukaa buʼi” jedheen. Maatewosis kaʼee isa duukaa buʼe.
english: As Jesus passed by from there, he saw a man called Matthew sitting at the tax collection office. He said to him, “Follow me.” He got up and followed him.

kikuyu: Yeroo Yesuus mana Maatewositti irbaata nyaachaa turetti, qaraxxoonnii fi cubbamoonni baayʼeen dhufanii isaa fi barattoota isaa wajjin nyaatan.
english: As he sat in the house, behold, many tax collectors and sinners came and sat down with Jesus and his disciples.

kikuyu: Fariisonni yommuu waan kana arganitti, “Barsiisaan keessan maaliif qaraxxootaa fi cubbamoota wajjin nyaata?” jedhanii barattoota isaa gaafatan.
english: When the Pharisees saw it, they said to his disciples, “Why does your teacher eat with tax collectors and sinners?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo waan kana dhageenyaan akkana jedhe; “Ogeessi fayyaa warra dhukkubsataniif malee warra fayyaa qabaniif hin barbaachisu.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

kikuyu: Garuu dhaqaatii dubbiin, ‘Ani araaran fedha malee aarsaa hin fedhu’jedhu sun maal jechuu akka taʼe hubadhaa. Ani cubbamoota waamuufin dhufe malee qajeeltota waamuuf hin dhufneetii.”
english: But you go and learn what this means: ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ for I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni Yohannis dhufanii, “Sababiin utuu nuu fi Fariisonni soomnuu, barattoonni kee hin soomneef maali?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: Then John’s disciples came to him, saying, “Why do we and the Pharisees fast often, but your disciples don’t fast?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Keessummoonni misirrichaa akkamiin utuu inni isaan wajjin jiruu gadduu dandaʼu? Yeroon itti misirrichi isaan biraa fudhatamu ni dhufa; isaanis yeroo sana ni soomu.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast.

kikuyu: “Namni uffata moofaa irratti erbee haaraa erbu tokko illee hin jiru; erbeen sun uffata sana irraa tarsaasaatii; tarsaʼaan sunis isa duraa ni caala.
english: No one puts a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment; for the patch would tear away from the garment, and a worse hole is made.

kikuyu: Akkasuma immoo namoonni daadhii wayinii haaraa qalqalloo moofaatti hin naqan. Yoo isaan itti naqan qalqallichi ni dhoʼa; daadhiinis ni dhangalaʼa; qalqalloonis horoomaa baʼa. Daadhiin wayinii haaraan garuu yoo qalqalloo haaraatti naqame lachanuu yeroo dheeraa turu.”
english: Neither do people put new wine into old wineskins, or else the skins would burst, and the wine be spilled, and the skins ruined. No, they put new wine into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.”

kikuyu: Utuu inni waan kana dubbachaa jiruu, bulchaan mana sagadaa tokko dhufee fuula isaa duratti jilbeenfatee, “Intalli koo ammuma na duraa duute. Garuu kottuutii harka kee ishee irra kaaʼi; isheenis ni jiraattii” jedheen.
english: While he told these things to them, behold, a ruler came and worshiped him, saying, “My daughter has just died, but come and lay your hand on her, and she will live.”

kikuyu: Yesuus kaʼee barattoota isaa wajjin isa duukaa buʼe.
english: Jesus got up and followed him, as did his disciples.

kikuyu: Kunoo, dubartiin dhiigni ishee waggaa kudha lama dhangalaʼaa ture tokko dugda isaa duubaan dhuftee handaara uffata isaa tuqxe.
english: Behold, a woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years came behind him, and touched the fringe of his garment;

kikuyu: Isheenis garaa ishee keessatti, “Ani yoon uffatuma isaa illee tuqe nan fayya” jettee yaaddee turteetii.
english: for she said within herself, “If I just touch his garment, I will be made well.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis garagalee ishee ilaalee, “Yaa intalaa, amantiin kee si fayyiseeraatii jabaadhu!” jedheen. Dubartiin sunis yeruma sana fayyite.
english: But Jesus, turning around and seeing her, said, “Daughter, cheer up! Your faith has made you well.” And the woman was made well from that hour.

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu mana bulchaa mana sagadaa sanaa seenee warra ulullee afuufanii fi uummata wacu argetti,
english: When Jesus came into the ruler’s house and saw the flute players and the crowd in noisy disorder,

kikuyu: “Asii deemaa! Intalattiin rafteerti malee hin duunee” jedhe. Isaan garuu isatti kolfan.
english: he said to them, “Make room, because the girl isn’t dead, but sleeping.” They were ridiculing him.

kikuyu: Erga namoonni gad baafamanii booddees inni ol seenee harka intalattii qabe; isheenis kaatee dhaabatte.
english: But when the crowd was sent out, he entered in, took her by the hand, and the girl arose.

kikuyu: Oduun waaʼee kanaas biyya sana guutuu keessa facaʼe.
english: The report of this went out into all that land.

kikuyu: Yesuus utuu achii kaʼee deemaa jiruu, jaamonni lama isa duukaa buʼanii, “Yaa Ilma Daawit nu maari!” jedhanii iyyan.
english: As Jesus passed by from there, two blind men followed him, calling out and saying, “Have mercy on us, son of David!”

kikuyu: Yommuu inni mana seenettis jaamonni sun gara isaa dhufan; innis, “Akka ani waan kana gochuu dandaʼu ni amantuu ree?” jedhee isaan gaafate. Isaanis, “Eeyyee, yaa Gooftaa!” jedhanii deebisaniif.
english: When he had come into the house, the blind men came to him. Jesus said to them, “Do you believe that I am able to do this?” They told him, “Yes, Lord.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis ija isaanii qaqqabee, “Akkuma amantii keessanii isiniif haa taʼu” jedheen.
english: Then he touched their eyes, saying, “According to your faith be it done to you.”

kikuyu: Iji isaaniis ni baname. Yesuusis, “Akka namni tokko iyyuu waan kana hin beekne of eeggadhaa” jedhee jabeessee isaan akeekkachiise.
english: Then their eyes were opened. Jesus strictly commanded them, saying, “See that no one knows about this.”

kikuyu: Jarri garuu achii baʼanii biyya sana hunda keessatti waaʼee isaa odeessan.
english: But they went out and spread abroad his fame in all that land.

kikuyu: Utuu isaan gad baʼuutti jiranuu jarri tokko nama hafuura hamaadhaan qabamee dubbachuu hin dandeenye tokko Yesuusitti fidan.
english: As they went out, behold, a mute man who was demon possessed was brought to him.

kikuyu: Namichi sunis erga hafuurri hamaan isa keessaa baafamee booddee ni dubbate. Namoonnis, “Wanni akkanaa gonkumaa Israaʼel keessatti hin argamne” jedhanii dinqifatan.
english: When the demon was cast out, the mute man spoke. The multitudes marveled, saying, “Nothing like this has ever been seen in Israel!”

kikuyu: Fariisonni garuu, “Inni hangafa hafuurota hamootiin hafuurota hamoo baasa” jedhan.
english: But the Pharisees said, “By the prince of the demons, he casts out demons.”

kikuyu: Yesuus manneen sagadaa isaanii keessatti barsiisaa, wangeela mootummaa lallabaa, akkasumas dhibee fi dhukkuba hunda irraa namoota fayyisaa magaalaawwanii fi gandoota hunda keessa deeme.
english: Jesus went about all the cities and the villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the Good News of the Kingdom, and healing every disease and every sickness among the people.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu tuuta namootaa argetti garaa laafeef; isaan akkuma hoolota tiksee hin qabneetti dhiphatanii, gatamaniis turaniitii.
english: But when he saw the multitudes, he was moved with compassion for them because they were harassed and scattered, like sheep without a shepherd.

kikuyu: Barattoota isaatiinis akkana jedhe; “Midhaan walitti qabamu baayʼee dha; hojjettoonni garuu muraasa.
english: Then he said to his disciples, “The harvest indeed is plentiful, but the laborers are few.

kikuyu: Kanaaf akka Gooftaan midhaan sanaa gara lafa qotiisaa midhaan isaatti hojjettoota erguuf isa kadhadhaa.”
english: Pray therefore that the Lord of the harvest will send out laborers into his harvest.”

kikuyu: Yesuus barattoota isaa kudha lamaan ofitti waamee akka isaan hafuurota xuraaʼoo baasaniif, dhibee fi dhukkuba hundumaa akka fayyisaniif taayitaa kenneef.
english: He called to himself his twelve disciples, and gave them authority over unclean spirits, to cast them out, and to heal every disease and every sickness.

kikuyu: Maqaan ergamoota kudha lamaaniis kana: Jalqabatti Simoon isa Phexros jedhamuu fi obboleessa isaa Indiriiyaas, Yaaqoob ilma Zabdewoosii fi obboleessa isaa Yohannis,
english: Now the names of the twelve apostles are these. The first, Simon, who is called Peter; Andrew, his brother; James the son of Zebedee; John, his brother;

kikuyu: Fiiliphoos, Bartaloomewoos, Toomaas, Maatewos isa qaraxa walitti qabu, Yaaqoob ilma Alfewoosii fi Taadewoos,
english: Philip; Bartholomew; Thomas; Matthew the tax collector; James the son of Alphaeus; Lebbaeus, who was also called Thaddaeus;

kikuyu: Simoon Hinaafticha, Yihuudaa Keeriyoticha isa Yesuusin dabarsee kenne.
english: Simon the Zealot; and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis warra kudha lamaan kanneen erge; akkanas jedhee isaan ajaje; “Gara Namoota Ormaa hin dhaqinaa; magaalaawwan Samaariyaa tokko illee hin seeninaa.
english: Jesus sent these twelve out and commanded them, saying, “Don’t go among the Gentiles, and don’t enter into any city of the Samaritans.

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa gara hoolota mana Israaʼel kanneen badan sanaa dhaqaa.
english: Rather, go to the lost sheep of the house of Israel.

kikuyu: Yommuu dhaqxanittis, ‘mootummaan samii dhiʼaateera’ jedhaa lallabaa.
english: As you go, preach, saying, ‘The Kingdom of Heaven is at hand!’

kikuyu: Dhukkubsattoota fayyisaa; warra duʼan kaasaa; warra lamxaaʼan qulqulleessaa; hafuurota hamoo baasaa. Tola waan argattaniif toluma kennaa.
english: Heal the sick, cleanse the lepers, and cast out demons. Freely you received, so freely give.

kikuyu: “Sabbata keessanitti warqee yookaan meetii yookaan sibiila diimaa hin qabatinaa;
english: Don’t take any gold, silver, or brass in your money belts.

kikuyu: karaa keessaniif korojoo yookaan kittaa lama yookaan kophee yookaan ulee hin qabatinaa; hojjetaaf waan isa barbaachisu argachuun ni malaatii.
english: Take no bag for your journey, neither two coats, nor sandals, nor staff: for the laborer is worthy of his food.

kikuyu: Magaalaa yookaan ganda seentan kam iyyuu keessa nama malu barbaadaa; hamma achii baatanittis manuma isaa turaa.
english: Into whatever city or village you enter, find out who in it is worthy, and stay there until you go on.

kikuyu: Yommuu mana sana seentanittis nagaa gaafadhaa.
english: As you enter into the household, greet it.

kikuyu: Nagaan keessan yoo mana sanaaf male, mana sanaaf haa taʼu; yoo isaaf hin malin garuu nagaan keessan isiniif haa deebiʼu.
english: If the household is worthy, let your peace come on it, but if it isn’t worthy, let your peace return to you.

kikuyu: Yoo namni tokko illee isin simachuu baate yookaan dubbii keessan dhagaʼuu baate, yeroo mana yookaan magaalaa sanaa baatanitti awwaara miilla keessanii dhadhaʼadhaa.
english: Whoever doesn’t receive you or hear your words, as you go out of that house or that city, shake the dust off your feet.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; guyyaa murtiitti magaalaa sana irra Sodoomii fi Gomoraaf ni salphata.
english: Most certainly I tell you, it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city.

kikuyu: “Kunoo, ani akka hoolotaa gara gidduu yeeyyiittin isin erga. Kanaafuu akka bofaa ogeeyyii, akka gugee garraamii taʼaa.
english: “Behold, I send you out as sheep among wolves. Therefore be wise as serpents and harmless as doves.

kikuyu: Namoota irraa of eeggadhaa; isin dabarfamtanii yaaʼiitti ni kennamtu; manneen sagadaa keessattis ni garafamtu.
english: But beware of men, for they will deliver you up to councils, and in their synagogues they will scourge you.

kikuyu: Isinis akka isaanii fi Namoota Ormaatti dhuga baatota taataniif anaaf jettanii fuula bulchitootaatii fi moototaa duratti ni dhiʼeeffamtu.
english: Yes, and you will be brought before governors and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them and to the nations.

kikuyu: Yommuu dabarsanii isin kennanis akkamitti akka dubbattan yookaan maal akka dubbattan hin yaaddaʼinaa. Wanni isin dubbattan yeruma sanatti isiniif kennama;
english: But when they deliver you up, don’t be anxious how or what you will say, for it will be given you in that hour what you will say.

kikuyu: Hafuura Abbaa keessaniitu isin keessaa dubbata malee isintu dubbata mitii.
english: For it is not you who speak, but the Spirit of your Father who speaks in you.

kikuyu: “Obboleessi dabarsee obboleessa duʼatti kenna; abbaan dabarsee ijoollee isaa duʼatti kenna; ijoolleenis warra isaaniitti kaʼanii isaan ajjeesu.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

kikuyu: Namni hundinuu sababii kootiif isin jibba; kan hamma dhumaatti jabaatee dhaabatu garuu ni fayya.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

kikuyu: Yommuu magaalaa tokko keessatti isin ariʼatanitti, gara magaalaa kaaniitti baqadhaa; ani dhuguma isinittin hima; hamma Ilmi Namaa dhufutti magaalaawwan Israaʼel hundumaa keessa naannoftanii waliin hin geessan.
english: But when they persecute you in this city, flee into the next, for most certainly I tell you, you will not have gone through the cities of Israel until the Son of Man has come.

kikuyu: “Barataan barsiisaa isaatii ol miti; garbichis gooftaa isaatii ol miti.
english: “A disciple is not above his teacher, nor a servant above his lord.

kikuyu: Barataan tokko akka barsiisaa isaa taʼuun, garbichi tokko immoo akka gooftaa isaa taʼuun ni gaʼa. Erga abbaa manaatiin ‘Biʼeelzebuul’ jedhanii, warra mana isaa jiraataniin immoo hammam kana caalaa haa jedhan ree!
english: It is enough for the disciple that he be like his teacher, and the servant like his lord. If they have called the master of the house Beelzebul, how much more those of his household!

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu isaan hin sodaatinaa. Wanni haguugamee utuu hin mulʼifamin hafu yookaan wanni dhokfamee utuu hin beekamin hafu tokko iyyuu hin jiruutii.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid of them, for there is nothing covered that will not be revealed, or hidden that will not be known.

kikuyu: Waan ani dukkana keessatti isinitti himu guyyaa adiin odeessaa; waan gurratti isinitti hasaasan, bantii manaa irraa labsaa.
english: What I tell you in the darkness, speak in the light; and what you hear whispered in the ear, proclaim on the housetops.

kikuyu: Warra foon malee lubbuu ajjeesuu hin dandeenye hin sodaatinaa. Qooda kanaa Isa gahaannam keessatti foonii fi lubbuu balleessuu dandaʼu sana sodaadhaa.
english: Don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, but are not able to kill the soul. Rather, fear him who is able to destroy both soul and body in Gehenna.

kikuyu: Daaloteen lama saantima tokkotti gurguramu mitii? Isaan keessaa garuu tokko iyyuu fedhii Abbaa keessanii malee lafa hin buutu.
english: “Aren’t two sparrows sold for an assarion coin? Not one of them falls to the ground apart from your Father’s will.

kikuyu: Rifeensi mataa keessanii hundis lakkaaʼameera.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all numbered.

kikuyu: Kanaaf hin sodaatinaa; isin daalotee hedduu caalaa gatii qabduutii.
english: Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu nama fuula namootaa duratti dhugaa naa baʼu kamiif iyyuu, anis fuula Abbaa koo isa samii irraa duratti dhugaa nan baʼa.
english: Everyone therefore who confesses me before men, I will also confess him before my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Nama fuula namootaa duratti na ganu kam iyyuu garuu anis fuula Abbaa koo isa samii irraa duratti nan gana.
english: But whoever denies me before men, I will also deny him before my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: “Isin waan ani lafa irratti nagaa buusuuf dhufe hin seʼinaa. Ani goraadee fiduuf malee nagaa buusuuf hin dhufne.
english: “Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.

kikuyu: Ani, “ ‘Nama abbaa isaatti, intala immoo haadha isheetti, niitii ilmaas amaatii isheetti kaasuuf dhufeeraatii;
english: For I came to set a man at odds against his father, and a daughter against her mother, and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.

kikuyu: diinonni namaa, miseensotuma mana isaatii.’
english: A man’s foes will be those of his own household.

kikuyu: “Namni abbaa isaa yookaan haadha isaa na caalchisee jaallatu kam iyyuu naaf hin malu; namni ilma isaa yookaan intala isaa na caalchisee jaallatu kam iyyuu naaf hin malu.
english: He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t worthy of me.

kikuyu: Namni fannoo ofii isaa baadhatee na duukaa hin buune kam iyyuu naaf hin malu.
english: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me isn’t worthy of me.

kikuyu: Namni lubbuu isaa oolfatu kam iyyuu lubbuu isaa ni dhaba; garuu namni naaf jedhee lubbuu isaa dhabu kam iyyuu lubbuu isaa ni argata.
english: He who seeks his life will lose it; and he who loses his life for my sake will find it.

kikuyu: “Namni isin simatu na simata; namni na simatu immoo isa na erge sana simata.
english: “He who receives you receives me, and he who receives me receives him who sent me.

kikuyu: Namni raajii tokko sababii inni raajii taʼeef simatu kam iyyuu gatii raajii ni argata; namni nama qajeelaa tokko sababii inni nama qajeelaa taʼeef simatu gatii nama qajeelaa tokkoo ni argata.
english: He who receives a prophet in the name of a prophet will receive a prophet’s reward. He who receives a righteous man in the name of a righteous man will receive a righteous man’s reward.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; namni kam iyyuu yoo warra xixinnaa kanneen keessaa isa tokkoof sababii inni barataa koo taʼeef bishaan qabbanaaʼaa budduuqsaa tokkoo illee kenne, inni dhugumaan gatii isaa hin dhabu.”
english: Whoever gives one of these little ones just a cup of cold water to drink in the name of a disciple, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.”

kikuyu: Yesuus erga barattoota isaa kudha lamaaniif ajaja kennuu raawwatee booddee magaalaawwan Galiilaa keessatti barsiisuu fi lallabuuf jedhee achii kaʼee karaa isaa itti fufe.
english: When Jesus had finished directing his twelve disciples, he departed from there to teach and preach in their cities.

kikuyu: Yohannis mana hidhaa taaʼee yommuu waan Kiristoos hojjechaa ture dhagaʼetti barattoota isaa ergee,
english: Now when John heard in the prison the works of Christ, he sent two of his disciples

kikuyu: “Inni dhufuuf jiru sun siʼi moo yookaan kan biraa eegganna?” jedhee isa gaafate.
english: and said to him, “Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Deebiʼaatii waan dhageessanii fi waan argitan Yohannisitti himaa;
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you hear and see:

kikuyu: jaamonni ni argu; warri naafatan ni deemu; warri lamxaaʼan ni qulqullaaʼu; warri duudan ni dhagaʼu; warri duʼan ni kaʼu; hiyyeeyyiifis wangeelli ni lallabama.
english: the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

kikuyu: Namni natti hin gufanne kam iyyuu eebbifamaa dha.”
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

kikuyu: Akkuma barattoonni Yohannis baʼanii qajeelaniin, Yesuus akkana jedhee waaʼee Yohannis namootatti himuu jalqabe; “Isin maal arguuf gammoojjiitti gad baatan? Shambaqqoo qilleensi raasu moo?
english: As these went their way, Jesus began to say to the multitudes concerning John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

kikuyu: Yoos maal arguu baatan ree? Nama uffata miidhagaa uffate moo? Lakki, warri uffata miidhagaa uffatan masaraa moototaa jiru.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man in soft clothing? Behold, those who wear soft clothing are in kings’ houses.

kikuyu: Yoos maal arguu baatan ree? Raajii moo? Eeyyee; ani isinittin hima; kan raajii iyyuu caalu.
english: But why did you go out? To see a prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

kikuyu: Kunis isa waaʼeen isaa akkana jedhamee barreeffamee dha. “ ‘Kunoo, ani ergamaa koo isa fuula kee duraan karaa kee qopheessu, si dura nan erga.’
english: For this is he, of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

kikuyu: Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; namoota dubartoota irraa dhalatan keessaa namni Yohannis Cuuphaa caalu tokko iyyuu hin kaane; namni mootummaa samii keessatti nama hundumaa gad taʼe kam iyyuu garuu isa ni caala.
english: Most certainly I tell you, among those who are born of women there has not arisen anyone greater than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in the Kingdom of Heaven is greater than he.

kikuyu: Mootummaan samii bara Yohannis Cuuphaatii jalqabee hamma ammaatti humnaan dhiibbachaa jira; namoonni dhiibbatanis humnaan mootummaa sana argatu.
english: From the days of John the Baptizer until now, the Kingdom of Heaven suffers violence, and the violent take it by force.

kikuyu: Raajonni hundinuu, Seerris hamma Yohannis Cuuphaatti raajii dubbataniiruutii.
english: For all the prophets and the law prophesied until John.

kikuyu: Isinis kana fudhachuuf yoo fedhii qabaattan, inni Eeliyaas isa dhufuuf jiruu dha.
english: If you are willing to receive it, this is Elijah, who is to come.

kikuyu: Namni gurra dhagaʼu qabu haa dhagaʼu.
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

kikuyu: “Ani dhaloota kana maaliinan wal fakkeessuu dandaʼa? Isaan akkuma ijoollee iddoo gabaa taaʼanii warra kaan waamanii akkana jedhanii ti:
english: “But to what shall I compare this generation? It is like children sitting in the marketplaces, who call to their companions

kikuyu: “ ‘Nu ulullee isinii afuufne; isin garuu hin sirbine; faaruu booʼichaas faarsine; isin garuu hin boonye.’
english: and say, ‘We played the flute for you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned for you, and you didn’t lament.’

kikuyu: Yohannis yeroo dhufetti hin nyaatu, hin dhugus tureetii; isaan immoo, ‘Inni hafuura hamaa qaba’ jedhu.
english: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa nyaachaa, dhugaas dhufe; isaan immoo, ‘Kunoo albaadhessaa fi machaaʼaa, michuu qaraxxootaatii fi cubbamootaa’ jedhu. Ogummaan garuu hojii isheetiin mirkaneeffamti.”
english: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Behold, a gluttonous man and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’ But wisdom is justified by her children.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Yesuus sababii magaalaawwan inni itti hojii dinqii isaa gara caalu hojjete sun qalbii hin jijjiirratiniif akkana jedhee isaan balaaleffachuu jalqabe.
english: Then he began to denounce the cities in which most of his mighty works had been done, because they didn’t repent.

kikuyu: “Yaa Koraaziin siif wayyoo! Yaa Beetisayidaa siif wayyoo! Hojiin dinqii isin keessatti hojjetame sun utuu Xiiroosii fi Siidoonaa keessatti hojjetamee jiraatee, isaan silaa yeroo dheeraan dura uffata gaddaa uffatanii, daaraas ofitti firfirsanii qalbii jijjiirratu turan.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.

kikuyu: Ani garuu isinittin hima; guyyaa murtiitti isin irra Xiiroosii fi Siidoonaaf ni salphata.
english: But I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.

kikuyu: Atis yaa Qifirnaahom, hamma samiitti ol kaafamtaa? Lakki, siiʼoolitti gad buuta. Hojiin dinqii kan si keessatti hojjetame sun utuu Sodoom keessatti hojjetamee jiraatee, isheen silaa hamma harʼaatti ni jiraatti turte.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, you will go down to Hades. For if the mighty works had been done in Sodom which were done in you, it would have remained until today.

kikuyu: Ani garuu sittin hima; guyyaa murtiitti sirra Sodoomiif ni salphata.”
english: But I tell you that it will be more tolerable for the land of Sodom on the day of judgment, than for you.”

kikuyu: Yesuus yeroo sana akkana jedhe; “Yaa Abbaa, Gooftaa samiitii fi lafaa, sababii ati wantoota kanneen ogeeyyii fi hubattoota jalaa dhoksitee daaʼimmanitti mulʼifteef ani sin galateeffadha.
english: At that time, Jesus answered, “I thank you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you hid these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to infants.

kikuyu: Eeyyee yaa Abbaa, ati waan kana gochuutti gammaddeertaatii.
english: Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.

kikuyu: “Abbaan koo waan hunda dabarsee natti kenneera. Abbaa malee namni tokko iyyuu Ilma hin beeku; Ilmaa fi nama Ilmi isa itti mulʼisuu fedhu malee namni tokko iyyuu Abbaa hin beeku.
english: All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows the Son, except the Father; neither does anyone know the Father, except the Son and he to whom the Son desires to reveal him.

kikuyu: “Isin dadhabdoonni, warri baʼaan isinitti ulfaate hundinuu gara koo kottaa; ani isinan boqochiisa.
english: “Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.

kikuyu: Waanjoo koo baadhaa; narraas baradhaa; waan ani garraamii fi gad of qabeessa taʼeef isin lubbuu keessaniif boqonnaa ni argattu.
english: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart; and you will find rest for your souls.

kikuyu: Waanjoon koo laafaa dha; baʼaan koos salphaa dha.”
english: For my yoke is easy, and my burden is light.”

kikuyu: Yesuus yeroo sana guyyaa Sanbataatiin lafa qotiisaa midhaanii keessa darbe. Barattoonni isaas beelaʼanii asheetii midhaanii ciratanii nyaachuu jalqaban.
english: At that time, Jesus went on the Sabbath day through the grain fields. His disciples were hungry and began to pluck heads of grain and to eat.

kikuyu: Fariisonni yommuu waan kana arganitti, “Ilaa! Barattoonni kee waan guyyaa Sanbataatiin hojjechuun seeraan hin eeyyamamne hojjetu” jedhaniin.
english: But the Pharisees, when they saw it, said to him, “Behold, your disciples do what is not lawful to do on the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebise; “Yeroo Daawitii fi warri isa wajjin turan beelaʼanitti waan Daawit godhe isin hin dubbifnee?
english: But he said to them, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, and those who were with him:

kikuyu: Inni mana Waaqaa seene; innii fi warri isa wajjin turanis buddeena kennaa nyaatan; buddeenni sun immoo luboota qofaaf malee isaaniif hin eeyyamamu ture.
english: how he entered into God’s house and ate the show bread, which was not lawful for him to eat, nor for those who were with him, but only for the priests?

kikuyu: Yookaan akka luboonni mana qulqullummaa keessaa guyyaa Sanbataatiin Sanbata xureessan, taʼus akka yakka taʼee isaanitti hin hedamne isin Seera keessatti hin dubbifnee?
english: Or have you not read in the law that on the Sabbath day the priests in the temple profane the Sabbath and are guiltless?

kikuyu: Ani isinitti nan hima; kan mana qulqullummaa caalu as jira.
english: But I tell you that one greater than the temple is here.

kikuyu: Isin, utuu dubbiin, ‘Ani araaran fedha malee aarsaa hin fedhu’jedhu sun maal jechuu akka taʼe beektanii jiraattanii silaa warra yakka hin qabnetti hin murtan ture.
english: But if you had known what this means, ‘I desire mercy, and not sacrifice,’ you wouldn’t have condemned the guiltless.

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa Gooftaa Sanbataatii.”
english: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Innis achii kaʼee mana sagadaa isaanii seene;
english: He departed from there and went into their synagogue.

kikuyu: kunoo, namichi harki irratti goge tokkos achi ture. Isaanis sababii ittiin Yesuusin himatan barbaadaa waan turaniif, “Guyyaa Sanbataatiin nama fayyisuun seeraa?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: And behold, there was a man with a withered hand. They asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath day?” so that they might accuse him.

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isin keessaa namni hoolaa tokko qabu, yoo hoolaan sun guyyaa Sanbataatiin boolla keessa buʼe, kan harkisee hin baafanne jiraa?
english: He said to them, “What man is there among you who has one sheep, and if this one falls into a pit on the Sabbath day, won’t he grab on to it and lift it out?

kikuyu: Namni immoo hammam hoolaa caalaa gatii guddaa haa qabaatu ree! Kanaafuu Sanbataan waan gaarii hojjechuun eeyyamamaa dha.”
english: Of how much more value then is a man than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath day.”

kikuyu: Namichaanis, “Harka kee diriirfadhu” jedhe. Namichis harka diriirfate; harki isaas guutummaatti fayyee akkuma isa kaanii taʼe.
english: Then he told the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out; and it was restored whole, just like the other.

kikuyu: Fariisonni garuu gad baʼanii akka ittiin Yesuusin ajjeesan mariʼatan.
english: But the Pharisees went out and conspired against him, how they might destroy him.

kikuyu: Yesuus waan kana beekee iddoo sanaa kaʼee deeme. Namoonni baayʼeenis isa duukaa buʼan; innis dhukkubsattoota isaanii hunda fayyise;
english: Jesus, perceiving that, withdrew from there. Great multitudes followed him; and he healed them all,

kikuyu: akka isaan akka inni beekamu hin goones isaan ajaje.
english: and commanded them that they should not make him known,

kikuyu: Kunis akka wanni Isaayyaas raajichi dubbate sun raawwatamuuf taʼe; innis akkana jedha:
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through Isaiah the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: “Tajaajilaan koo inni ani filadhe, inni ani jaalladhuu fi inni ani itti gammadu isa kana; ani Hafuura koo isa irra nan kaaʼa; innis sabootatti murtii qajeelaa ni labsa.
english: “Behold, my servant whom I have chosen, my beloved in whom my soul is well pleased. I will put my Spirit on him. He will proclaim justice to the nations.

kikuyu: Inni hin wacu yookaan hin iyyu; namni tokko illee sagalee isaa karaa irratti hin dhagaʼu.
english: He will not strive, nor shout, neither will anyone hear his voice in the streets.

kikuyu: Inni hamma akka murtiin qajeelaan moʼu godhutti, shambaqqoo buruqe hin cabsu; foʼaa ibsaa kan seequs hin dhaamsu.
english: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.

kikuyu: Saboonnis maqaa isaa ni abdatu.”
english: In his name, the nations will hope.”

kikuyu: Yeroo sanatti namicha hafuura hamaan qabame, kan iji isaa jaamee arrabni isaas dubbachuu dide tokko gara isaa fidan; Yesuusis namicha sana fayyise; namichis dubbachuu fi arguu dandaʼe.
english: Then one possessed by a demon, blind and mute, was brought to him; and he healed him, so that the blind and mute man both spoke and saw.

kikuyu: Namoonni hundinuus dinqifatanii, “Kun Ilma Daawit taʼinnaa?” jedhan.
english: All the multitudes were amazed, and said, “Can this be the son of David?”

kikuyu: Fariisonni garuu yommuu kana dhagaʼanitti, “Namichi kun Biʼeelzebuul, hangafa hafuurota hamoo qofaan hafuurota hamoo baasa” jedhan.
english: But when the Pharisees heard it, they said, “This man does not cast out demons except by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis yaada isaanii beekee akkana jedheen; “Mootummaan gargar of qoodu hundinuu ni diigama; magaalaan yookaan maatiin gargar of qoodu hundinuus hin dhaabatu.
english: Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.

kikuyu: Seexannis Seexana baafnaan, inni gargar of qooda. Yoos mootummaan isaa akkamitti dhaabachuu dandaʼa ree?
english: If Satan casts out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then will his kingdom stand?

kikuyu: Erga ani Biʼeelzebuuliin hafuurota hamoo baasee, ijoolleen keessan immoo maaliin baasu ree? Kanaafuu isaan abbootii murtii isinitti taʼu.
english: If I by Beelzebul cast out demons, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

kikuyu: Garuu ani Hafuura Waaqaatiin hafuurota hamoo baasa taanaan, yoos mootummaan Waaqaa isinitti dhufeera.
english: But if I by the Spirit of God cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come upon you.

kikuyu: “Yookaan namni kam iyyuu yoo duraan dursee nama jabaa tokko hidhe malee akkamitti mana nama jabaa sanaa seenee qabeenya isaa saamuu dandaʼa? Ergasii inni mana isaa saamuu dandaʼa.
english: Or how can one enter into the house of the strong man and plunder his goods, unless he first bind the strong man? Then he will plunder his house.

kikuyu: “Namni na wajjin hin jirre kam iyyuu naan morma; namni na wajjin walitti hin qabne kam iyyuus ni bittinneessa.
english: “He who is not with me is against me, and he who doesn’t gather with me, scatters.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani isinittin hima; cubbuu fi arrabsoon hundinuu namaaf ni dhiifama; Hafuura Qulqulluu arrabsuun garuu hin dhiifamu.
english: Therefore I tell you, every sin and blasphemy will be forgiven men, but the blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven men.

kikuyu: Nama Ilma Namaatiin mormee jecha tokko dubbatu kamiif iyyuu ni dhiifama; nama Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan mormee dubbatu kamiif iyyuu garuu, addunyaa kana irratti yookaan addunyaa dhufuuf jiru irratti hin dhiifamu.
english: Whoever speaks a word against the Son of Man, it will be forgiven him; but whoever speaks against the Holy Spirit, it will not be forgiven him, either in this age, or in that which is to come.

kikuyu: “Muka gaarii qabaadhaa; iji isaa gaarii taʼaa; muka gadhee qabaadhaa; iji isaa gadhee taʼaa; mukni ija isaatiin beekamaatii.
english: “Either make the tree good and its fruit good, or make the tree corrupt and its fruit corrupt; for the tree is known by its fruit.

kikuyu: Isin yaa ijoollee buutii nana, isin warri hamoon akkamitti waan gaarii dubbachuu dandeessu? Waan garaa guute afaan dubbataatii.
english: You offspring of vipers, how can you, being evil, speak good things? For out of the abundance of the heart, the mouth speaks.

kikuyu: Namni gaariin waan gaarii garaa isaa keessa jiru keessaa waan gaarii baasa; namni hamaan immoo waan hamaa garaa isaa keessa jiru keessaa waan hamaa baasa.
english: The good man out of his good treasure brings out good things, and the evil man out of his evil treasure brings out evil things.

kikuyu: Ani garuu isinittin hima; guyyaa murtiitti namoonni dubbii akkuma argan dubbatan hundumatti ni gaafatamu.
english: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.

kikuyu: Dubbii keetiin qajeelaa taasifamtaatii; dubbii keetiinis sitti murama.”
english: For by your words you will be justified, and by your words you will be condemned.”

kikuyu: Ergasii barsiistonni seeraatii fi Fariisonni tokko tokko, “Yaa barsiisaa, nu mallattoo sirraa arguu barbaanna” jedhaniin.
english: Then certain of the scribes and Pharisees answered, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”

kikuyu: Innis deebisee akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Dhaloonni hamaa fi ejjaan mallattoo barbaada! Garuu mallattoo Yoonaas raajichaa sana malee mallattoon tokko iyyuu hin kennamuuf.
english: But he answered them, “An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, but no sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

kikuyu: Akkuma Yoonaas guyyaa sadii fi halkan sadii garaa qurxummii guddaa tokkoo keessa ture sana, Ilmi Namaas guyyaa sadii fi halkan sadii garaa lafaa keessa ni turaatii.
english: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of the huge fish, so will the Son of Man be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.

kikuyu: Namoonni Nanawwee guyyaa murtiitti dhaloota kana wajjin kaʼanii itti muru;isaan lallaba Yoonaasiin qalbii jijjiirrataniitii; kunoo, kan Yoonaasin caalu as jira.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, someone greater than Jonah is here.

kikuyu: Mootittiin kibbaa guyyaa murtiitti dhaloota kana wajjin kaatee itti murti; isheen ogummaa Solomoon dhagaʼuuf jettee daarii lafaatii dhufteetii; kunoo, kan Solomoonin caalu as jira.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with this generation and will condemn it, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, someone greater than Solomon is here.

kikuyu: “Hafuurri xuraaʼaan yommuu nama keessaa baʼutti, boqonnaa barbaacha lafa gogaa keessa joora; garuu hin argatu.
english: “When an unclean spirit has gone out of a man, he passes through waterless places seeking rest, and doesn’t find it.

kikuyu: Innis, ‘Mana koo isa ani keessaa baʼe sanatti nan deebiʼa’ jedha. Yommuu achi gaʼuttis manicha duwwaa taʼee, haramee qulqulleeffamee, qopheeffames argata.
english: Then he says, ‘I will return into my house from which I came;’ and when he has come back, he finds it empty, swept, and put in order.

kikuyu: Ergasiis dhaqee hafuurota biraa torba kanneen isa caalaa hamoo taʼan fudhatee dhufa; isaanis itti galanii achi jiraatu. Haalli namicha sanaa kan dhumaa isa jalqabaa caalaa hammaata. Dhaloonni hamaan kunis akkasuma taʼa.”
english: Then he goes and takes with himself seven other spirits more evil than he is, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first. Even so will it be also to this evil generation.”

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuus amma iyyuu namootatti dubbachaa jiruu kunoo, haatii fi obboloonni isaa isa wajjin haasaʼuu barbaadanii ala dhadhaabachaa turan.
english: While he was yet speaking to the multitudes, behold, his mother and his brothers stood outside, seeking to speak to him.

kikuyu: Namni tokkos, “Haati keetii fi obboloonni kee si wajjin haasaʼuu barbaadanii ala dhadhaabatu” jedhee isatti hime.
english: One said to him, “Behold, your mother and your brothers stand outside, seeking to speak to you.”

kikuyu: Innis deebiseefii, “Haati koo eenyu? Obboloonni koos eenyu faʼi?” jedheen.
english: But he answered him who spoke to him, “Who is my mother? Who are my brothers?”

kikuyu: Harka isaas gara barattoota isaatti qabee akkana jedhe; “Haati kootii fi obboloonni koo kunoo ti.
english: He stretched out his hand toward his disciples, and said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

kikuyu: Namni fedhii Abbaa koo isa samii irraa guutu kam iyyuu obboleessa koo ti; obboleettii koo ti; haadha kootis.”
english: For whoever does the will of my Father who is in heaven, he is my brother, and sister, and mother.”

kikuyu: Guyyuma sana Yesuus manaa baʼee galaana bira taaʼe.
english: On that day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the seaside.

kikuyu: Tuunni namootaa guddaan naannoo isaatti walitti qabame; utuu namoonni hundi qarqara galaanichaa dhadhaabachaa jiranuu, inni bidiruu yaabbatee taaʼe.
english: Great multitudes gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat and sat; and all the multitude stood on the beach.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee waan baayʼee fakkeenyaan isaanitti hime; “Kunoo, namichi sanyii facaasu tokko sanyii facaafachuu baʼe.
english: He spoke to them many things in parables, saying, “Behold, a farmer went out to sow.

kikuyu: Utuu inni facaasaa jiruus sanyiin tokko tokko karaa irra buʼe; simbirroonnis dhufanii nyaatanii fixan.
english: As he sowed, some seeds fell by the roadside, and the birds came and devoured them.

kikuyu: Kaan immoo lafa kattaa, iddoo biyyoo baayʼee hin qabne irra buʼe. Sanyiin sunis sababii biyyoon sun gad fageenya hin qabaatiniif dafee biqile.
english: Others fell on rocky ground, where they didn’t have much soil, and immediately they sprang up, because they had no depth of earth.

kikuyu: Yommuu aduun baatetti garuu biqiltuun sun ni coollage; waan hidda hin qabaatiniifis ni goge.
english: When the sun had risen, they were scorched. Because they had no root, they withered away.

kikuyu: Sanyiin biraas qoraattii keessa buʼe; qoraattiin sunis guddatee biqiltuu sana hudhe.
english: Others fell among thorns. The thorns grew up and choked them.

kikuyu: Ammas sanyiin kaan biyyoo gaarii irra buʼee achitti ija naqate; garri tokko dachaa dhibba, kaan dachaa jaatama, kaan immoo dachaa soddoma naqate.
english: Others fell on good soil and yielded fruit: some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.

kikuyu: Namni gurra qabu kam iyyuu haa dhagaʼu.”
english: He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Barattoonnis gara isaa dhufanii, “Ati maaliif fakkeenyaan namootatti dubbatta?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: The disciples came, and said to him, “Why do you speak to them in parables?”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Icciitii mootummaa samii beekuun isiniif kennameera; isaaniif garuu hin kennamne.
english: He answered them, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of the Kingdom of Heaven, but it is not given to them.

kikuyu: Kan qabu kamiif iyyuu itti dabalamee ni kennama; irraa hafaas ni qabaata. Kan hin qabne garuu wanni inni qabu iyyuu irraa fudhatama.
english: For whoever has, to him will be given, and he will have abundance; but whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he has.

kikuyu: Wanni ani akkana jedhee fakkeenyaan isaanitti dubbadhuufis kana: “Isaan utuma ilaalanuu hin argan; utuma dhaggeeffatanuus hin dhagaʼan yookaan hin hubatan.
english: Therefore I speak to them in parables, because seeing they don’t see, and hearing, they don’t hear, neither do they understand.

kikuyu: Raajiin Isaayyaas dubbate sun isaan irratti raawwatameera; innis akkana jedha: “ ‘Dhagaʼuu inuma dhageessu; garuu hin hubattan; ilaaluus inuma ilaaltu; garuu hin qalbeeffattan.
english: In them the prophecy of Isaiah is fulfilled, which says, ‘By hearing you will hear, and will in no way understand; Seeing you will see, and will in no way perceive;

kikuyu: Qalbiin saba kanaa doomeeraatii; gurri isaanii sirriitti hin dhagaʼu; ija isaaniis dunuunfataniiru. Utuu akkas taʼuu baatee silaa ija isaaniitiin arganii, gurra isaaniitiin dhagaʼanii, qalbii isaaniitiinis hubatanii ni deebiʼu turan; anis isaan nan fayyisa ture.’
english: for this people’s heart has grown callous, their ears are dull of hearing, and they have closed their eyes; or else perhaps they might perceive with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, and I would heal them.’

kikuyu: Iji keessan garuu waan arguuf eebbifamaa dha; gurri keessanis waan dhagaʼuuf eebbifamaa dha.
english: “But blessed are your eyes, for they see; and your ears, for they hear.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguma isinittin himaatii; raajonnii fi qajeeltonni baayʼeen waan isin argitan kana arguu hawwan; garuu hin argine; waan isin dhageessan kanas dhagaʼuu hawwan; garuu hin dhageenye.
english: For most certainly I tell you that many prophets and righteous men desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them; and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.

kikuyu: “Egaa fakkeenyi namicha sanyii facaasuu maal akka taʼe dhagaʼaa:
english: “Hear, then, the parable of the farmer.

kikuyu: Yoo namni kam iyyuu dubbii mootummichaa dhagaʼee hubachuu baate, inni hamaan sun dhufee waan garaa isaa keessatti facaafame sana butata. Kun sanyii karaa irratti facaafamee dha.
english: When anyone hears the word of the Kingdom and doesn’t understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away that which has been sown in his heart. This is what was sown by the roadside.

kikuyu: Sanyiin lafa kattaa irratti facaafame, nama dubbicha dhagaʼee yommusuma gammachuun fudhatuu dha.
english: What was sown on the rocky places, this is he who hears the word and immediately with joy receives it;

kikuyu: Garuu inni waan hidda hin qabneef yeroo gabaabaa qofa tura. Yeroo rakkinni yookaan ariʼatamni sababii dubbichaatiif dhufutti inni dafee gufata.
english: yet he has no root in himself, but endures for a while. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately he stumbles.

kikuyu: Sanyiin qoraattii keessatti facaafame sunis nama dubbicha dhagaʼu argisiisa; garuu yaaddoon addunyaa kanaatii fi gowwoomsaan qabeenyaa dubbicha hudhee ija naqachuu dhowwa.
english: What was sown among the thorns, this is he who hears the word, but the cares of this age and the deceitfulness of riches choke the word, and he becomes unfruitful.

kikuyu: Sanyiin biyyoo gaarii irratti facaafame garuu nama dubbicha dhagaʼee hubatu argisiisa. Innis ija kenna; garri tokko dhibba, kaan jaatama, kaan immoo soddoma naqata.”
english: What was sown on the good ground, this is he who hears the word and understands it, who most certainly bears fruit and produces, some one hundred times as much, some sixty, and some thirty.”

kikuyu: Yesuus akkana jedhee fakkeenya biraa isaanitti hime; “Mootummaan samii nama lafa qotiisaa isaa keessatti sanyii gaarii facaafate tokko fakkaata.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field,

kikuyu: Garuu utuu namoonni rafanuu diinni isaa dhufee qamadii keessatti inkirdaada facaasee deeme.
english: but while people slept, his enemy came and sowed darnel weeds also among the wheat, and went away.

kikuyu: Yeroo qamadiin sun guddatee ija naqatetti inkirdaadnis ni mulʼate.
english: But when the blade sprang up and produced grain, then the darnel weeds appeared also.

kikuyu: “Garboonni abbaa lafa qotiisaa sanaas gara isaa dhufanii, ‘Gooftaa, ati lafa qotiisaa kee keessatti sanyii gaarii hin facaafnee? Yoos inkirdaadni eessaa dhufe ree?’ jedhaniin.
english: The servants of the householder came and said to him, ‘Sir, didn’t you sow good seed in your field? Where did these darnel weeds come from?’

kikuyu: “Innis deebisee, ‘Diinatu kana hojjete’ jedhe. “Garboonnis, ‘Akka nu dhaqnee buqqifnu ni barbaaddaa?’ jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: “He said to them, ‘An enemy has done this.’ “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and gather them up?’

kikuyu: “Namichi garuu akkana jedhee deebiseef; ‘Lakki, utuu inkirdaada buqqiftanuu, akka isa wajjin qamadii hin buqqifneef dhiisaa.
english: “But he said, ‘No, lest perhaps while you gather up the darnel weeds, you root up the wheat with them.

kikuyu: Hamma yeroo haamaatti lachanuu walumaan haa guddatan. Anis yeroo sana warra midhaan haamaniin, “Jalqabatti inkirdaada sana buqqisaa; akka gubamuufis bissii bissiidhaan hidhaa; qamadii garuu walitti qabaatii gombisaa kootti naa naqaa” jedhee isaanitti nan hima.’ ”
english: Let both grow together until the harvest, and in the harvest time I will tell the reapers, “First, gather up the darnel weeds, and bind them in bundles to burn them; but gather the wheat into my barn.”’”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee fakkeenya biraa isaanitti hime; “Mootummaan samii sanyii sanaaficaa kan namni fuudhee lafa qotiisaa isaa keessatti facaase tokko fakkaata.
english: He set another parable before them, saying, “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took, and sowed in his field,

kikuyu: Inni dhugumaan sanyii hunda irra xinnaa dha; erga guddatee garuu biqiltuu hunda caalee muka taʼa; simbirroonnis dhufanii dameewwan isaa irra jiraatu.”
english: which indeed is smaller than all seeds. But when it is grown, it is greater than the herbs and becomes a tree, so that the birds of the air come and lodge in its branches.”

kikuyu: Amma illee akkana jedhee fakkeenya biraa isaanitti hime; “Mootummaan samii raacitii dubartiin tokko fuutee hamma inni guutummaatti bukeessutti daakuu safartuu sadiitti makte fakkaata.”
english: He spoke another parable to them. “The Kingdom of Heaven is like yeast which a woman took and hid in three measures of meal, until it was all leavened.”

kikuyu: Yesuus waan kana hundumaa fakkeenyaan namootatti dubbate; innis fakkeenyaan malee waan tokko illee isaanitti hin dubbanne.
english: Jesus spoke all these things in parables to the multitudes; and without a parable, he didn’t speak to them,

kikuyu: Kunis akka wanni raajichi, “Ani fakkeenyaan afaan koo nan banadha; waan gaafa addunyaan uumamee jalqabee dhokfames nan dubbadha” jedhe sun raawwatamuuf taʼe.
english: that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying, “I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things hidden from the foundation of the world.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis tuuta namootaa achumatti dhiisee mana ol seene. Barattoonni isaas gara isaa dhufanii, “Hiikkaa fakkeenya inkirdaada lafa qotiisaa keessaa sana nutti himi” jedhaniin.
english: Then Jesus sent the multitudes away, and went into the house. His disciples came to him, saying, “Explain to us the parable of the darnel weeds of the field.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebise; “Namichi sanyii gaarii facaase sun Ilma Namaa ti.
english: He answered them, “He who sows the good seed is the Son of Man,

kikuyu: Lafti qotiisaa sun addunyaa dha; sanyiin gaariinis ijoollee mootummichaa ti. Inkirdaadni sun ijoollee isa hamaa sanaa ti;
english: the field is the world, the good seeds are the children of the Kingdom, and the darnel weeds are the children of the evil one.

kikuyu: diinni inkirdaada facaase immoo diiyaabiloos dha. Haamaan dhuma addunyaa ti; warri haaman immoo ergamoota Waaqaa ti.
english: The enemy who sowed them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the reapers are angels.

kikuyu: “Akkuma inkirdaadni walitti qabamee ibiddaan gubamu sana, dhuma addunyaattis akkasuma taʼa.
english: As therefore the darnel weeds are gathered up and burned with fire; so will it be at the end of this age.

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa ergamoota isaa ni erga; isaanis waan cubbuutti nama geessu hundaa fi warra waan hamaa hojjetan hunda mootummaa isaa keessaa baasanii walitti qabu.
english: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will gather out of his Kingdom all things that cause stumbling and those who do iniquity,

kikuyu: Boolla ibiddaattis isaan darbatu; achittis wawwaannaa fi ilkaan qaruutu taʼa.
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana qajeeltonni mootummaa Abbaa isaanii keessatti akka aduu ni ifu. Namni gurra qabu haa dhagaʼu.
english: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the Kingdom of their Father. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.

kikuyu: “Mootummaan samii qabeenya lafa qotiisaa keessa dhokfame fakkaata. Namni tokkos qabeenya kana argatee deebisee dhokse; innis waan gammadeef dhaqee waan qabu hunda gurguree lafa qotiisaa sana bitate.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like treasure hidden in the field, which a man found and hid. In his joy, he goes and sells all that he has and buys that field.

kikuyu: “Akkasumas mootummaan samii daldalaa lula gaarii barbaadu tokko fakkaata.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a merchant seeking fine pearls,

kikuyu: Daldalaan sunis lula gatii guddaa tokko argate; innis dhaqee waan qabu hundumaa gurguree lula sana bitate.
english: who having found one pearl of great price, he went and sold all that he had and bought it.

kikuyu: “Akkasumas mootummaan samii kiyyoo galaanatti darbatamee qurxummii gosa hundaa walitti qabe fakkaata.
english: “Again, the Kingdom of Heaven is like a dragnet that was cast into the sea and gathered some fish of every kind,

kikuyu: Yeroo kiyyoon sun guutamettis qurxummii qabdoonni gara qarqara galaanaatti isa harkisan. Ergasiis tataaʼanii qurxummii gaarii filanii qodaa isaaniitti naqatan; qurxummii gadhee immoo ni gatan.
english: which, when it was filled, fishermen drew up on the beach. They sat down and gathered the good into containers, but the bad they threw away.

kikuyu: Dhuma addunyaattis akkasuma taʼa. Ergamoonni dhufanii warra hamoo warra qajeeltota irraa gargar baasu;
english: So it will be in the end of the world. The angels will come and separate the wicked from among the righteous,

kikuyu: boolla ibiddaattis isaan darbatu; achittis wawwaannaa fi ilkaan qaruutu taʼa.”
english: and will cast them into the furnace of fire. There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Waan kana hunda hubattaniirtuu?” jedhee isaan gaafate. Isaanis, “Eeyyee” jedhanii deebisan.
english: Jesus said to them, “Have you understood all these things?” They answered him, “Yes, Lord.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Kanaafuu barsiisaan seeraa kan barataa mootummaa samii taʼe kam iyyuu abbaa manaa kan qabeenya haaraa fi moofaa mana miʼa isaa keessaa gad baasu tokko fakkaata” jedheen.
english: He said to them, “Therefore every scribe who has been made a disciple in the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who is a householder, who brings out of his treasure new and old things.”

kikuyu: Yesuus erga fakkeenya kana dubbatee raawwatee booddee achii kaʼee deeme.
english: When Jesus had finished these parables, he departed from there.

kikuyu: Innis gara magaalaa itti dhalatee dhaqee mana sagadaa isaanii keessatti namoota barsiisuu jalqabe; isaanis ni dinqisiifatan. Akkana jedhaniis gaafatan; “Namichi kun ogummaa kanaa fi hojiiwwan dinqii kanneen eessaa argate?
english: Coming into his own country, he taught them in their synagogue, so that they were astonished and said, “Where did this man get this wisdom and these mighty works?

kikuyu: Inni ilma namicha muka soofu sanaati mitii? Maqaan haadha isaas Maariyaam mitii? Obboloonni isaas Yaaqoob, Yoosef, Simoonii fi Yihuudaa mitii?
english: Isn’t this the carpenter’s son? Isn’t his mother called Mary, and his brothers James, Joses, Simon, and Judas?

kikuyu: Obboleettonni isaa hundinuu nu bira jiru mitii? Yoos namichi kun waan kana hundumaa eessaa argate?”
english: Aren’t all of his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all of these things?”

kikuyu: Isaanis isatti gufatan. Yesuus garuu, “Raajiin magaalaa itti dhalatee fi mana isaatti malee kabaja hin dhabu” jedheen.
english: They were offended by him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country and in his own house.”

kikuyu: Innis sababii amantii dhabuu isaaniitiif hojii dinqii hedduu achitti hin hojjenne.
english: He didn’t do many mighty works there because of their unbelief.

kikuyu: Bara sana Heroodis bulchaan oduu waaʼee Yesuus dhagaʼe;
english: At that time, Herod the tetrarch heard the report concerning Jesus,

kikuyu: innis tajaajiltoota isaatiin, “Kun Yohannis Cuuphaa dha; inni warra duʼan keessaa kaafameera! Sababiin hojiin dinqii isaan hojjetamuufis kanuma” jedhe.
english: and said to his servants, “This is John the Baptizer. He is risen from the dead. That is why these powers work in him.”

kikuyu: Heroodis sababii niitii obboleessa isaa Fiiliphoos, sababii Heroodiyaasiitiif jedhee Yohannisin qabee, hidhee mana hidhaatti galchee tureetii.
english: For Herod had arrested John, bound him, and put him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife.

kikuyu: Kunis sababii Yohannis Heroodisiin, “Ati ishee fuudhuun kee seera miti” jechaa tureef.
english: For John said to him, “It is not lawful for you to have her.”

kikuyu: Inni immoo Yohannisin ajjeesuu barbaade; garuu sababii namoonni Yohannisin akka raajiitti ilaalaa turaniif isaan sodaate.
english: When he would have put him to death, he feared the multitude, because they counted him as a prophet.

kikuyu: Intalli Heroodiyaas guyyaa dhaloota Heroodisitti keessummoota duratti sirbitee Heroodisin gammachiifte;
english: But when Herod’s birthday came, the daughter of Herodias danced among them and pleased Herod.

kikuyu: kanaafuu inni waan isheen gaafatte kam iyyuu isheef kennuuf kakuudhaan waadaa gale.
english: Therefore he promised with an oath to give her whatever she should ask.

kikuyu: Isheenis haadha isheetiin gorfamtee, “Mataa Yohannis Cuuphaa gabatee irra kaaʼii naa kenni” jette.
english: She, being prompted by her mother, said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptizer.”

kikuyu: Mootichis ni gadde; garuu sababii kakuu isaatii fi sababii warra isa wajjin maaddiitti dhiʼaataniitiif jedhee akka wanni isheen barbaadde sun isheef kennamu ajaje;
english: The king was grieved, but for the sake of his oaths and of those who sat at the table with him, he commanded it to be given,

kikuyu: innis nama ergee mana hidhaa keessatti mataa Yohannis isa irraa kute.
english: and he sent and beheaded John in the prison.

kikuyu: Mataan isaas gabatee irra kaaʼamee fidamee intalattiitti kenname; isheenis haadha isheetti geessite.
english: His head was brought on a platter and given to the young lady; and she brought it to her mother.

kikuyu: Barattoonni Yohannisis dhufanii reeffa isaa fuudhanii awwaalan. Isaanis dhaqanii Yesuusitti himan.
english: His disciples came, took the body, and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti achii kaʼee kophaa isaa bidiruudhaan iddoo namni hin jirre tokko dhaqe. Namoonnis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti magaalaawwanii baʼanii miillaan isa duukaa buʼan.
english: Now when Jesus heard this, he withdrew from there in a boat to a deserted place apart. When the multitudes heard it, they followed him on foot from the cities.

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu bidiruu irraa buʼetti tuuta guddaa tokko arge; innis garaa laafeefii dhukkubsattoota isaanii fayyiseef.
english: Jesus went out, and he saw a great multitude. He had compassion on them and healed their sick.

kikuyu: Yommuu galgalaaʼetti barattoonni gara isaa dhufanii, “Iddoon kun gammoojjii dha; aduunis dhiiteerti. Namoonni kunneen gara gandootaa dhaqanii akka nyaata bitataniif isaan gad dhiisi” jedhaniin.
english: When evening had come, his disciples came to him, saying, “This place is deserted, and the hour is already late. Send the multitudes away, that they may go into the villages, and buy themselves food.”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu, “Deemuun isaan hin barbaachisu. Isinuu waan isaan nyaatan kennaafii” jedhee deebise.
english: But Jesus said to them, “They don’t need to go away. You give them something to eat.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Nu buddeena shanii fi qurxummii lama qofa asii qabna” jedhanii deebisan.
english: They told him, “We only have here five loaves and two fish.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Isuma natti fidaa” jedhe.
english: He said, “Bring them here to me.”

kikuyu: Innis akka namoonni marga irra tataaʼan ajajee buddeena shananii fi qurxummii lamaan sana fuudhee, gara samii ol ilaalee galata galchee buddeena sana caccabsees barattootatti kenne; barattoonni immoo namootaaf kennan.
english: He commanded the multitudes to sit down on the grass; and he took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to heaven, he blessed, broke and gave the loaves to the disciples; and the disciples gave to the multitudes.

kikuyu: Isaan hundi nyaatanii quufan; barattoonnis hurraaʼaa hambifame gundoo kudha lama guutuu walitti qaban.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up twelve baskets full of that which remained left over from the broken pieces.

kikuyu: Warri nyaatanis dubartootaa fi ijoollee malee gara dhiira kuma shanii turan.
english: Those who ate were about five thousand men, in addition to women and children.

kikuyu: Yesuus yommusuma akka barattoonni bidiruu yaabbatanii hamma inni tuuta sana of irraa geggeessutti isa dura gamatti darbaniif isaan dirqisiise.
english: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go ahead of him to the other side, while he sent the multitudes away.

kikuyu: Innis erga namoota of irraa geggeessee booddee kadhachuuf kophaa isaa gaaratti ol baʼe. Yommuu galgalaaʼettis kophaa isaa achi ture;
english: After he had sent the multitudes away, he went up into the mountain by himself to pray. When evening had come, he was there alone.

kikuyu: yeroo kanatti immoo bidiruun sun lafa irraa xinnoo achi hiiqxee turte; sababii bubbeen fuula duraan itti bubbiseef bidiruun sun dambaliidhaan asii fi achi raafamaa turte.
english: But the boat was now in the middle of the sea, distressed by the waves, for the wind was contrary.

kikuyu: Yesuusis halkan keessaa kutaa afuraffaatti galaana irra deemaa gara isaanii dhufe.
english: In the fourth watch of the night, Jesus came to them, walking on the sea.

kikuyu: Barattoonnis yommuu galaana irra deemuu isaa arganitti akka malee rifatan. Sodaataniis, “Kun ekeraa dha” jedhanii iyyan.
english: When the disciples saw him walking on the sea, they were troubled, saying, “It’s a ghost!” and they cried out for fear.

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu yommusuma, “Jabaadhaa! Anumaatii hin sodaatinaa” jedhee isaanitti dubbate.
english: But immediately Jesus spoke to them, saying, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Phexros immoo, “Yaa Gooftaa! Egaa si taanaan, akka ani bishaan irra deemee gara kee dhufu na ajaji” jedhee deebiseef.
english: Peter answered him and said, “Lord, if it is you, command me to come to you on the waters.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Kottu” jedheen. Phexros immoo bidiruu sana irraa buʼee bishaan irra deemaa gara Yesuus dhufe.
english: He said, “Come!” Peter stepped down from the boat and walked on the waters to come to Jesus.

kikuyu: Yommuu bubbee jabaa sana argetti garuu ni sodaate; liqimfamuu jalqabnaanis, “Yaa Gooftaa na oolchi!” jedhee iyye.
english: But when he saw that the wind was strong, he was afraid, and beginning to sink, he cried out, saying, “Lord, save me!”

kikuyu: Yesuus yommusuma harka isaa hiixatee isa qabee, “Yaa namicha amantii xinnoo nana, ati maaliif mamte?” jedheen.
english: Immediately Jesus stretched out his hand, took hold of him, and said to him, “You of little faith, why did you doubt?”

kikuyu: Yommuu isaan bidiruu yaabbatanittis bubbeen sun gab jedhe.
english: When they got up into the boat, the wind ceased.

kikuyu: Warri bidiruu sana keessa turanis, “Ati dhuguma Ilma Waaqaa ti!” jedhanii isaaf sagadan.
english: Those who were in the boat came and worshiped him, saying, “You are truly the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu gama ceʼanitti Geensereexitti bidiruu irraa buʼan.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to the land of Gennesaret.

kikuyu: Namoonni iddoo sanaas yommuu Yesuusin beekanitti biyya naannoo sanaa hundatti dhaamsa ergan. Namoonnis dhukkubsattoota isaanii hunda isatti fidan;
english: When the people of that place recognized him, they sent into all that surrounding region and brought to him all who were sick;

kikuyu: akka dhukkubsattoonni sun handaara wayyaa isaa illee tuqaniif isa kadhatan; warri handaara wayyaa isaa tuqan hundinuus ni fayyan.
english: and they begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment. As many as touched it were made whole.

kikuyu: Ergasii Fariisonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa tokko tokko Yerusaalemii gara Yesuus dhufanii,
english: Then Pharisees and scribes came to Jesus from Jerusalem, saying,

kikuyu: “Barattoonni kee maaliif duudhaa maanguddootaa cabsu? Isaan yommuu buddeena nyaatanitti harka hin dhiqataniitii!” jedhan.
english: “Why do your disciples disobey the tradition of the elders? For they don’t wash their hands when they eat bread.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Isinis maaliif duudhaa keessaniif jettanii ajaja Waaqaa cabsitu?
english: He answered them, “Why do you also disobey the commandment of God because of your tradition?

kikuyu: Waaqni, ‘Abbaa keetii fi haadha keetiif ulfina kenni;namni abbaa isaa yookaan haadha isaa arrabsu kam iyyuu haa ajjeefamu’jedheeraatii.
english: For God commanded, ‘Honor your father and your mother,’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

kikuyu: Isin garuu yoo namni kam iyyuu akka wanni silaa abbaa isaatiif yookaan haadha isaatiif kennamuu malu ‘Waaqaaf kennameera’ jedhee dubbate,
english: But you say, ‘Whoever may tell his father or his mother, “Whatever help you might otherwise have gotten from me is a gift devoted to God,”

kikuyu: inni waan sanaan abbaa isaatiif yookaan haadha isaatiif ulfina kennuu hin qabu jettu. Akkanaanis isin duudhaa keessaniif jettanii dubbii Waaqaa busheessitu.
english: he shall not honor his father or mother.’ You have made the commandment of God void because of your tradition.

kikuyu: Yaa fakkeessitoota! Isaayyaas yommuu waaʼee keessan raajii dubbatetti sirrii ture; innis akkana jedhe:
english: You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,

kikuyu: “ ‘Uumanni kun hidhii isaatiin na kabaja; garaan isaa garuu narraa fagoo jira.
english: ‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.

kikuyu: Isaan akkanumaan na waaqeffatu; barsiisni isaaniis sirnuma namaa ti.’”
english: And they worship me in vain, teaching as doctrine rules made by men.’”

kikuyu: Yesuusis tuuta sana ofitti waamee akkana jedheen; “Dhagaʼaa; hubadhaas.
english: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.

kikuyu: Waan afaan namaa keessaa baʼutu nama xureessa malee wanni afaan namaa seenu nama hin xureessu.”
english: That which enters into the mouth doesn’t defile the man; but that which proceeds out of the mouth, this defiles the man.”

kikuyu: Ergasii barattoonni gara isaa dhufanii, “Ati akka Fariisonni dubbii kana dhagaʼanii mufatan beektaa?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: Then the disciples came and said to him, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this saying?”

kikuyu: Innis deebisee akkana jedhe; “Biqiltuun abbaan koo inni samii irraa hin dhaabin hundinuu ni buqqifama.
english: But he answered, “Every plant which my heavenly Father didn’t plant will be uprooted.

kikuyu: Isaan dhiisaa; isaan qajeelchitoota jaamota. Jaamaan yoo jaamaa qajeelche, isaan lachuu boolla keessa buʼu.”
english: Leave them alone. They are blind guides of the blind. If the blind guide the blind, both will fall into a pit.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis, “Mee hiikkaa fakkeenya kanaa nuu ibsi” jedheen.
english: Peter answered him, “Explain the parable to us.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee isaan gaafate; “Isinis hamma ammaatti hin hubattanii?
english: So Jesus said, “Do you also still not understand?

kikuyu: Akka wanni afaan seenu kam iyyuu garaa seenee achumaan darbee dhagna keessaa baʼu hin argitanii?
english: Don’t you understand that whatever goes into the mouth passes into the belly and then out of the body?

kikuyu: Wanni afaan namaatii baʼu garuu nama keessaa baʼa; namichas ni xureessa.
english: But the things which proceed out of the mouth come out of the heart, and they defile the man.

kikuyu: Sababiin isaas yaadni hamaan jechuunis ajjeesuun, ejjummaan, halalummaan, hanni, sobaan dhugaa baʼuun, maqaa nama balleessuun garaa namaa keessaa baʼaatii.
english: For out of the heart come evil thoughts, murders, adulteries, sexual sins, thefts, false testimony, and blasphemies.

kikuyu: Wantoota kanneentu nama ‘xureessa’ malee utuu harka hin dhiqatin nyaachuun nama hin xureessu.”
english: These are the things which defile the man; but to eat with unwashed hands doesn’t defile the man.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis iddoo sanaa kaʼee gara biyya Xiiroosii fi Siidoonaatti qajeele.
english: Jesus went out from there and withdrew into the region of Tyre and Sidon.

kikuyu: Kunoo, dubartiin Kanaʼaan tokko naannoo sanaa gara isaa dhuftee iyyaa, “Yaa Gooftaa, yaa Ilma Daawit, intalli koo hafuura hamaadhaan qabamtee akka malee dhiphachaa jirti; na maari!” jette.
english: Behold, a Canaanite woman came out from those borders and cried, saying, “Have mercy on me, Lord, you son of David! My daughter is severely possessed by a demon!”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu deebii tokko illee hin kennineef. Barattoonni isaas gara isaa dhufanii, “Kunoo isheen iyyaa nu faana deemtiitii achi deebisi” jedhanii isa kadhatan.
english: But he answered her not a word. His disciples came and begged him, saying, “Send her away; for she cries after us.”

kikuyu: Inni immoo, “Ani hoolota mana Israaʼel kanneen badan sana qofaafan ergame” jedhee deebise.
english: But he answered, “I wasn’t sent to anyone but the lost sheep of the house of Israel.”

kikuyu: Dubartiin sunis dhuftee sagaddeefii, “Yaa Gooftaa na gargaari!” jette.
english: But she came and worshiped him, saying, “Lord, help me.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Buddeena ijoollee fuudhanii saroota dura buusuun sirrii miti” jedhee deebise.
english: But he answered, “It is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

kikuyu: Isheenis, “Eeyyee yaa Gooftaa, saroonni iyyuu hambaa maaddii gooftota isaanii irraa harcaʼu nyaatu” jettee deebifteef.
english: But she said, “Yes, Lord, but even the dogs eat the crumbs which fall from their masters’ table.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Dubartii nana, amantiin kee guddaa dha! Akkuma fedhii keetii siif haa taʼu” jedhee deebise. Intalli ishees saʼaatiidhuma sana fayyite.
english: Then Jesus answered her, “Woman, great is your faith! Be it done to you even as you desire.” And her daughter was healed from that hour.

kikuyu: Yesuus achii kaʼee gara Galaana Galiilaa dhaqe. Gaarattis ol baʼee taaʼe.
english: Jesus departed from there and came near to the sea of Galilee; and he went up on the mountain and sat there.

kikuyu: Namoonni hedduunis warra okkolan, warra jaaman, warra naafatan, warra arrabni isaanii dubbachuu didee fi kanneen biraa hedduu fidanii miilla Yesuus jala kaaʼan; innis isaan fayyise.
english: Great multitudes came to him, having with them the lame, blind, mute, maimed, and many others, and they put them down at his feet. He healed them,

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis yommuu akka warri arrabni hin dubbanne dubbatan, warri naafatan fayyan, warri okkolan deeman, warra jaamaniif immoo akka iji isaanii baname arganitti ni dinqifatan. Waaqa Israaʼeliifis ulfina kennan.
english: so that the multitude wondered when they saw the mute speaking, the injured healed, the lame walking, and the blind seeing—and they glorified the God of Israel.

kikuyu: Yesuus barattoota isaa ofitti waamee, “Ani namoota kanneeniif garaa nan laafa; isaan guyyaa sadii na bira turan; waan nyaatan tokko illee hin qaban. Akka isaan karaa irratti hin gaggabneefis ani agabuu isaanii gad isaan dhiisuu hin barbaadu” jedhe.
english: Jesus summoned his disciples and said, “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have continued with me now three days and have nothing to eat. I don’t want to send them away fasting, or they might faint on the way.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaas deebisanii, “Buddeena tuuta guddaa akkanaa gaʼu gammoojjii kana keessatti eessaa argachuu dandeenya?” jedhan.
english: The disciples said to him, “Where could we get so many loaves in a deserted place as to satisfy so great a multitude?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Isin buddeena meeqa qabdu?” jedhee gaafate. Isaanis deebisanii, “Buddeena torbaa fi qurxummii xixinnoo muraasa qabna” jedhan.
english: Jesus said to them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven, and a few small fish.”

kikuyu: Innis akka namoonni sun lafa tataaʼan itti hime.
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground;
