kikuyu: Ergasii buddeena torbanii fi qurxummii sana fuudhee erga galateeffatee booddee kukkutee barattootatti kenne; isaanis namootaaf kennan.
english: and he took the seven loaves and the fish. He gave thanks and broke them, and gave to the disciples, and the disciples to the multitudes.

kikuyu: Isaan hundi nyaatanii quufan. Ergasiis barattoonni hambaa gundoo torba guutuu walitti qaban.
english: They all ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets full of the broken pieces that were left over.

kikuyu: Baayʼinni warra nyaataniis ijoollee fi dubartoota malee dhiira kuma afur ture.
english: Those who ate were four thousand men, in addition to women and children.

kikuyu: Yesuus erga tuuta sana of irraa geggeessee booddee bidiruu yaabbatee naannoo Magadaan dhaqe.
english: Then he sent away the multitudes, got into the boat, and came into the borders of Magdala.

kikuyu: Fariisonnii fi Saduuqonni gara Yesuus dhufanii akka inni samii irraa mallattoo isaan argisiisu gaafachuudhaan isa qoran.
english: The Pharisees and Sadducees came, and testing him, asked him to show them a sign from heaven.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebise; “Isin yeroo galgalaaʼutti, ‘Samiin diimateera; caama taʼa’ jettu;
english: But he answered them, “When it is evening, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red.’

kikuyu: ganama immoo, ‘Samiin diimatee duumessaaʼeeraatii harʼa bokkaan jabaan ni rooba’ jettu. Isin bifa samii addaan baasuu ni beektu; garuu mallattoo baraa addaan baasuu hin dandeessan.
english: In the morning, ‘It will be foul weather today, for the sky is red and threatening.’ Hypocrites! You know how to discern the appearance of the sky, but you can’t discern the signs of the times!

kikuyu: Dhaloonni hamaa fi ejjaan mallattoo barbaada; garuu mallattoo Yoonaas malee mallattoon hin kennamuuf.” Yesuusis isaan dhiisee deeme.
english: An evil and adulterous generation seeks after a sign, and there will be no sign given to it, except the sign of the prophet Jonah.” He left them and departed.

kikuyu: Barattoonni yommuu galaanicha ceʼanitti buddeena fudhachuu irraanfatan.
english: The disciples came to the other side and had forgotten to take bread.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Beekkadhaa; raacitii Fariisotaatii fi Saduuqotaa irraa of eeggadhaa” isaaniin jedhe.
english: Jesus said to them, “Take heed and beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Kun sababii nu buddeena hin fidatiniif” jedhanii waan kana walii wajjin haasaʼan.
english: They reasoned among themselves, saying, “We brought no bread.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis waan isaan haasaʼan beekee akkana jedhee gaafate; “Yaa warra amantii xinnoo nana, isin maaliif waaʼee buddeena dhabuu keessanii walii wajjin dudubbattu?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said, “Why do you reason among yourselves, you of little faith, because you have brought no bread?

kikuyu: Isin amma iyyuu hin hubattanii? Buddeenni shan nama kuma shaniif dhiʼeeffamee gundoo hammam guutuu akka walitti qabdan hin yaadattanii?
english: Don’t you yet perceive or remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many baskets you took up,

kikuyu: Yookaan buddeenni torba nama kuma afuriif dhiʼeeffamee hambaa gundoo hammam guutuu akka walitti qabdan hin yaadattanii?
english: or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many baskets you took up?

kikuyu: Akka ani waaʼee buddeenaa isinitti dubbachaa hin turin isin akkamitti hin hubanne? Garuu raacitii Fariisotaatii fi Saduuqotaa irraa of eeggadhaa.”
english: How is it that you don’t perceive that I didn’t speak to you concerning bread? But beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”

kikuyu: Isaanis ergasii akka inni akka isaan raacitii buddeenaa irraa of eeggataniif utuu hin taʼin akka barsiisa Fariisotaatii fi Saduuqotaa irraa of eeggataniif isaanitti himaa ture hubatan.
english: Then they understood that he didn’t tell them to beware of the yeast of bread, but of the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.

kikuyu: Yesuus yeroo gara biyya Fiiliphoos Qiisaariyaa dhufetti, “Namoonni Ilma Namaatiin eenyu jedhu?” jedhee barattoota isaa gaafate.
english: Now when Jesus came into the parts of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, saying, “Who do men say that I, the Son of Man, am?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Namoonni tokko tokko inni Yohannis Cuuphaa dha jedhu; warri kaan inni Eeliyaas jedhu; kaan immoo inni Ermiyaas yookaan raajota keessaa isa tokko dha jedhu” jedhanii deebisan.
english: They said, “Some say John the Baptizer, some, Elijah, and others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Isin hoo? Eenyu anaan jettu?” jedhee gaafate.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?”

kikuyu: Simoon Phexrosis, “Ati Kiristoos, Ilma Waaqa jiraataa ti” jedhee deebise.
english: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Yaa Simoon ilma Yoonaa, ati eebbifamaa dha; kana abbaa koo isa samii irraatu siif ibse malee nama miti.
english: Jesus answered him, “Blessed are you, Simon Bar Jonah, for flesh and blood has not revealed this to you, but my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Ani sittin hima; ati Phexrosii dha; kattaa kana irratti waldaa kiristaanaa koo nan ijaara; karri gahaannamis ishee hin moʼatu.
english: I also tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my assembly, and the gates of Hades will not prevail against it.

kikuyu: Ani furtuu mootummaa samii siifin kenna; wanni ati lafa irratti hiitu kam iyyuu samii irratti ni hidhama; wanni ati lafa irratti hiiktu kam iyyuu samii irrattis ni hiikama.”
english: I will give to you the keys of the Kingdom of Heaven, and whatever you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven; and whatever you release on earth will have been released in heaven.”

kikuyu: Ergasiis akka isaan akka inni Kiristoos taʼe nama tokkotti illee hin himneef barattoota isaa akeekkachiise.
english: Then he commanded the disciples that they should tell no one that he was Jesus the Christ.

kikuyu: Yesuus yeroo sanaa jalqabee akka Yerusaalem dhaqee harka maanguddootaatti, harka luboota hangafootaattii fi harka barsiistota seeraatti waan hedduun dhiphachuu qabu, akka ajjeefamuu qabuu fi akka guyyaa sadaffaatti immoo duʼaa kaafamu barattoota isaatiif ibsuu jalqabe.
english: From that time, Jesus began to show his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things from the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.

kikuyu: Phexrosis kophaatti baasee, “Yaa Gooftaa, kun gonkumaa hin taʼin! Kun sirraa haa fagaatu!” jedhee isa ifachuu jalqabe.
english: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him, saying, “Far be it from you, Lord! This will never be done to you.”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu of irra garagalee Phexrosiin, “Yaa Seexana nana! Na duubatti deebiʼi! Ati gufuu natti taateerta; ati kan namaa yaadda malee kan Waaqaa hin yaadduutii” jedhe.
english: But he turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me, for you are not setting your mind on the things of God, but on the things of men.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Yesuus barattoota isaatiin akkana jedhe; “Namni kam iyyuu yoo na faana dhufuu barbaade, inni of haa ganu. Fannoo ofii isaa baadhatees na duukaa haa buʼu.
english: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

kikuyu: Namni lubbuu isaa oolfachuu barbaadu kam iyyuu lubbuu isaa ni dhabaatii; garuu namni naaf jedhee lubbuu isaa dhabu kam iyyuu lubbuu isaa ni argata.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, and whoever will lose his life for my sake will find it.

kikuyu: Namni yoo addunyaa guutuu argatee lubbuu isaa immoo dhabe, buʼaan isaa maali? Yookaan namni qooda lubbuu isaa maal kennuu dandaʼa?
english: For what will it profit a man if he gains the whole world and forfeits his life? Or what will a man give in exchange for his life?

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa ulfina Abbaa isaatiin ergamoota isaa wajjin dhufuuf jiraatii; innis yeroo sana tokkoo tokkoo namaatiif akkuma hojii isaatti gatii isaa ni kenna.
english: For the Son of Man will come in the glory of his Father with his angels, and then he will give to everyone according to his deeds.

kikuyu: “Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; warra as dhadhaabachaa jiran keessaa namoonni tokko tokko hamma utuu Ilmi Namaa mootummaa isaatiin dhufuu arganitti duʼa hin dhandhaman.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste of death until they see the Son of Man coming in his Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Yesuus guyyaa jaʼa booddee Phexrosin, Yaaqoobii fi Yohannis obboleessa Yaaqoob fudhatee kophaa isaanii tulluu dheeraa tokkotti ol baase.
english: After six days, Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John his brother, and brought them up into a high mountain by themselves.

kikuyu: Innis achitti fuula isaanii duratti geeddarame. Fuulli isaa akka aduu ife; uffanni isaas akkuma ifaa addaate.
english: He was changed before them. His face shone like the sun, and his garments became as white as the light.

kikuyu: Kunoo Musee fi Eeliyaas utuu Yesuus wajjin haasaʼanuu isaanitti mulʼatan.
english: Behold, Moses and Elijah appeared to them talking with him.

kikuyu: Phexrosis Yesuusiin, “Yaa Gooftaa, as jiraachuun nuuf gaarii dha. Yoo fedhii kee taʼe, ani daasii sadii jechuunis tokko siif, tokko Museef, tokko immoo Eeliyaasiif asitti nan ijaara” jedhe.
english: Peter answered and said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you want, let’s make three tents here: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

kikuyu: Utuma inni dubbachaa jiruu kunoo, duumessi ifaan tokko isaan haguuge; duumessicha keessaas sagaleen tokko, “Kun Ilma koo isa ani jaalladhuu dha; ani isatti baayʼee nan gammada. Isinis isa dhagaʼaa!” jedhe.
english: While he was still speaking, behold, a bright cloud overshadowed them. Behold, a voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. Listen to him.”

kikuyu: Barattoonnis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti akka malee sodaatanii adda isaaniitiin lafatti gombifaman.
english: When the disciples heard it, they fell on their faces, and were very afraid.

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu itti dhiʼaatee isaan tuqee, “Kaʼaa! Hin sodaatinaa” jedheen.
english: Jesus came and touched them and said, “Get up, and don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu ol jedhanii ilaalanitti Yesuusin malee nama tokko illee hin argine.
english: Lifting up their eyes, they saw no one, except Jesus alone.

kikuyu: Utuu tulluu sana irraa buʼuutti jiranuus Yesuus, “Hamma Ilmi Namaa warra duʼan keessaa kaafamutti waan argitan sana nama tokkotti illee hin himinaa” jedhee isaan seerrate.
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, Jesus commanded them, saying, “Don’t tell anyone what you saw, until the Son of Man has risen from the dead.”

kikuyu: Barattoonnis, “Yoos barsiistonni seeraa maaliif Eeliyaas akka duraan dursee dhufuu qabu dubbatu ree?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: His disciples asked him, saying, “Then why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

kikuyu: Yesuus akkana jedhee deebise; “Dhugumaan, Eeliyaas waan hunda iddootti deebisuuf jedhee duraan dursee ni dhufa.
english: Jesus answered them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and will restore all things;

kikuyu: Ani garuu isinittin hima; Eeliyaas amma iyyuu dhufeera; isaanis isa hin hubanne; garuu waanuma fedhan hunda isatti hojjetan. Ilmi Namaas akkasuma harka isaaniitti dhiphachuuf jira.”
english: but I tell you that Elijah has come already, and they didn’t recognize him, but did to him whatever they wanted to. Even so the Son of Man will also suffer by them.”

kikuyu: Barattoonnis ergasii akka wanni inni isaanitti dubbachaa ture sun waaʼee Yohannis Cuuphaa taʼe hubatan.
english: Then the disciples understood that he spoke to them of John the Baptizer.

kikuyu: Yommuu isaan gara tuuta sanaa dhufanittis namichi tokko Yesuusitti dhiʼaatee fuula isaa duratti jilbeenfate;
english: When they came to the multitude, a man came to him, kneeling down to him and saying,

kikuyu: akkanas jedhe; “Yaa Gooftaa, ilmi koo gaggabdoodhaan qabamee akka malee rakkachaa jiraatii naaf maari. Yeroo hedduu ibidda keessatti yookaan bishaan keessatti kufa.
english: “Lord, have mercy on my son, for he is epileptic and suffers grievously; for he often falls into the fire, and often into the water.

kikuyu: Ani barattoota keetti isa nan fide; isaan garuu isa fayyisuu hin dandeenye.”
english: So I brought him to your disciples, and they could not cure him.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Isin dhaloota hin amannee fi jalʼaa nana; ani hamma yoomiittin isin wajjin jiraadha? Hamma yoomiittis ani isinii obsa? Mee gurbicha as natti fidaa!” jedhe.
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation! How long will I be with you? How long will I bear with you? Bring him here to me.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis hafuura hamaa sana ifate; hafuurri hamaan sunis gurbaa sana keessaa baʼe; gurbichis yommusuma fayye.
english: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it went out of him, and the boy was cured from that hour.

kikuyu: Ergasiis barattoonni kophaa isaanii gara Yesuus dhufanii, “Nu maaliif hafuura hamaa sana baasuu dadhabne?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: Then the disciples came to Jesus privately, and said, “Why weren’t we able to cast it out?”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebise; “Sababii amantiin keessan xinnaateefii dha. Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; isin utuu amantii xinnoo hamma sanyii sanaaficaa qabaattanii silaa tulluu kanaan, ‘Asii kaʼii achi darbi’ jechuu ni dandeessu; innis ni darba. Wanni isiniif hin dandaʼamne tokko iyyuu hin jiru. [
english: He said to them, “Because of your unbelief. For most certainly I tell you, if you have faith as a grain of mustard seed, you will tell this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move; and nothing will be impossible for you.

kikuyu: Hafuurri hamaan akkanaa garuu soomaa fi kadhannaadhaan malee hin baʼu.”]
english: But this kind doesn’t go out except by prayer and fasting.”

kikuyu: Yeroo isaan Galiilaatti walitti qabamanitti inni akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Ilmi Namaa dabarfamee harka namootaatti ni kennama.
english: While they were staying in Galilee, Jesus said to them, “The Son of Man is about to be delivered up into the hands of men,

kikuyu: Isaanis isa ni ajjeesu; inni immoo guyyaa sadaffaatti ni kaafama.” Barattoonnis akka malee gaddan.
english: and they will kill him, and the third day he will be raised up.” They were exceedingly sorry.

kikuyu: Yommuu Yesuusii fi barattoonni isaa Qifirnaahom gaʼanitti qaraxxoonni gara Phexros dhufanii, “Barsiisaan keessan gibira hin kaffaluu?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: When they had come to Capernaum, those who collected the didrachma coins came to Peter, and said, “Doesn’t your teacher pay the didrachma?”

kikuyu: Innis deebisee, “Ni kaffala” jedheen. Yesuus yommuu Phexros mana seenetti duraan dursee, “Yaa Simoon ati maal yaadda? Mootonni lafaa eenyu irraa qaraxaa fi gibira walitti qabu? Ijoollee isaanii irraa moo keessummoota irraa walitti qabu?” jedhee gaafate.
english: He said, “Yes.” When he came into the house, Jesus anticipated him, saying, “What do you think, Simon? From whom do the kings of the earth receive toll or tribute? From their children, or from strangers?”

kikuyu: Phexrosis deebisee, “Keessummoota irraa walitti qabu” jedhe. Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Yoos ijoolleen isaanii bilisa.
english: Peter said to him, “From strangers.” Jesus said to him, “Therefore the children are exempt.

kikuyu: Garuu nu akka isaan hin mufachiifneef dhaqiitii okkoo galaanatti darbadhu. Qurxummii jalqabatti qabdus fuudhi; yommuu afaan isaa bantuttis maallaqa argatta. Maallaqa sanas geessiitii anaa fi ofii keetiif isaanitti kenni.”
english: But, lest we cause them to stumble, go to the sea, cast a hook, and take up the first fish that comes up. When you have opened its mouth, you will find a stater coin. Take that, and give it to them for me and you.”

kikuyu: Yeruma sana barattoonni gara Yesuus dhufanii, “Yoos mootummaa samii keessatti kan hundumaa caalu eenyu?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: In that hour the disciples came to Jesus, saying, “Who then is greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven?”

kikuyu: Innis mucaa xinnaa tokko ofitti waamee isaan gidduu dhaabe.
english: Jesus called a little child to himself, and set him in the middle of them

kikuyu: Akkanas jedhe: “Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; isin yoo deebitanii akkuma ijoollee taatan malee gonkumaa mootummaa samiitti hin galtan.
english: and said, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you turn and become as little children, you will in no way enter into the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Kanaaf namni akka daaʼima kanaa gad of qabu kam iyyuu mootummaa samii keessatti nama hunda caala.
english: Whoever therefore humbles himself as this little child is the greatest in the Kingdom of Heaven.

kikuyu: Namni daaʼima akkanaa tokko maqaa kootiin simatu kam iyyuu na simata.
english: Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me,

kikuyu: “Namni kam iyyuu warra natti amanan xixinnaa kanneen keessaa tokko illee yoo gufachiise, dhagaan daakuu guddaan morma isaatti hidhamee tuujuba galaanaa keessa dhidhimuu isaaf wayya ture.
english: but whoever causes one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if a huge millstone were hung around his neck and that he were sunk in the depths of the sea.

kikuyu: Sababii wantoota akka namoonni gufatan godhan sanaatiif addunyaaf wayyoo! Wantoonni akkanaa dhufuu qabu; garuu nama wantoonni kunneen karaa isaatiin dhufan sanaaf wayyoo!
english: “Woe to the world because of occasions of stumbling! For it must be that the occasions come, but woe to that person through whom the occasion comes!

kikuyu: Yoo harki kee yookaan miilli kee si gufachiise, of irraa kutii gati. Harka lama yookaan miilla lama qabaattee ibidda bara baraatti darbatamuu irra, dooluu taatee yookaan laamshoftee jireenyatti galuu siif wayya.
english: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life maimed or crippled, rather than having two hands or two feet to be cast into the eternal fire.

kikuyu: Yoo iji kee si gufachiise of keessaa baasii gati. Ija lama qabaattee ibidda gahaannamiitti darbatamuu irra ija tokko qabaattee jireenyatti galuu siif wayya.
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out and cast it from you. It is better for you to enter into life with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire.

kikuyu: “Warra xixinnaa kanneen keessaa tokko illee akka hin tuffanneef of eeggadhaa. Ani isinitti nan hima; ergamoonni isaanii samii irratti yeroo hunda fuula Abbaa koo isa samii irraa ni arguutii. [
english: See that you don’t despise one of these little ones, for I tell you that in heaven their angels always see the face of my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa isa bade oolchuudhaaf dhufeetii.]
english: For the Son of Man came to save that which was lost.

kikuyu: “Isin maal seetu? Namni tokko yoo hoolota dhibba qabaatee hoolota sana keessaas tokko bade, namichi sun sagaltamii sagallan hafan kaan tulluuwwan irratti dhiisee tokkicha bade sana barbaaduu hin dhaquu?
english: “What do you think? If a man has one hundred sheep, and one of them goes astray, doesn’t he leave the ninety-nine, go to the mountains, and seek that which has gone astray?

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; inni yoo hoolaa sana argate, hoolota sagaltamii sagallan hin badin irra hoolaa tokkicha sanatti caalaa ni gammada.
english: If he finds it, most certainly I tell you, he rejoices over it more than over the ninety-nine which have not gone astray.

kikuyu: Akkasuma immoo isaan xixinnoo kanneen keessaa tokko iyyuu akka badu fedhii Abbaa keessan isa samii irraa miti.
english: Even so it is not the will of your Father who is in heaven that one of these little ones should perish.

kikuyu: “Yoo obboleessi kee cubbuu sitti hojjete, dhaqiitii iddoo isin lamaan qofti jirtanitti balleessaa isaa itti himi. Yoo inni si dhagaʼe ati obboleessa kee deebifatteerta.
english: “If your brother sins against you, go, show him his fault between you and him alone. If he listens to you, you have gained back your brother.

kikuyu: Yoo si dhagaʼuu baate garuu ‘dubbiin hundinuu dhuga baatota lamaan yookaan sadiin waan mirkaneeffamuuf’ nama biraa tokko yookaan nama lama fudhadhuu dhaqi.
english: But if he doesn’t listen, take one or two more with you, that at the mouth of two or three witnesses every word may be established.

kikuyu: Yoo inni jara dhagaʼuu dide waldaa kiristaanaatti himi; yoo inni waldaa kiristaanaa iyyuu dhagaʼuu dide akka nama ormaattii fi akka qaraxxuutti isa fudhadhu.
english: If he refuses to listen to them, tell it to the assembly. If he refuses to hear the assembly also, let him be to you as a Gentile or a tax collector.

kikuyu: “Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; wanni isin lafa irratti hiitan kam iyyuu samii irratti ni hidhama; wanni isin lafa irratti hiiktan kam iyyuu samii irrattis ni hiikama.
english: Most certainly I tell you, whatever things you bind on earth will have been bound in heaven, and whatever things you release on earth will have been released in heaven.

kikuyu: “Ammas ani isinitti nan hima; isin keessaa yoo namoonni lama lafa irratti waaʼee waan kadhatan kamii iyyuu walii galan Abbaan koo inni samii irraa isaaniif taasisa.
english: Again, assuredly I tell you, that if two of you will agree on earth concerning anything that they will ask, it will be done for them by my Father who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Iddoo itti namoonni lama yookaan sadii maqaa kootiin walitti qabamanitti ani gidduu isaaniitti nan argamaatii.”
english: For where two or three are gathered together in my name, there I am in the middle of them.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Phexros gara Yesuus dhufee, “Yaa Gooftaa, yoo obboleessi koo cubbuu natti hojjete ani yeroo hammam dhiisaaf? Hamma yeroo torbaattii?” jedhee gaafate.
english: Then Peter came and said to him, “Lord, how often shall my brother sin against me, and I forgive him? Until seven times?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Ani sitti nan hima; yeroo torbaatamii torba malee yeroo torba miti.
english: Jesus said to him, “I don’t tell you until seven times, but, until seventy times seven.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu mootummaan samii mootii herrega garboota isaa harka jiru toʼachuu barbaade tokko fakkaata.
english: Therefore the Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.

kikuyu: Akkuma inni herrega isaa toʼachuu jalqabeenis nama mootichi taalaantii kuma kudhan irraa qabu tokko itti fidan.
english: When he had begun to settle, one was brought to him who owed him ten thousand talents.

kikuyu: Namichi sun waan baasu dhabnaan gooftaan isaa akka inni, niitiin isaa, ijoolleen isaatii fi wanni inni qabu hundinuu gurguramanii gatiin sun kaffalamu ajaje.
english: But because he couldn’t pay, his lord commanded him to be sold, with his wife, his children, and all that he had, and payment to be made.

kikuyu: “Garbichi sunis miilla isaatti kufee, ‘Yaa gooftaa, naaf obsi; hunduma isaa iyyuu siif nan kaffalaa’ jedhee isa kadhate.
english: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’

kikuyu: Gooftaan garbicha sanaas garaa laafeef; gatii isa irraa qabus dhiiseefii gad isa lakkise.
english: The lord of that servant, being moved with compassion, released him and forgave him the debt.

kikuyu: “Garbichi sun garuu akkuma achii baʼeen garbicha akka isaa kan gatii diinaariidhibbaa irraa qabu tokko arge. Innis morma namichaa hudhee qabee, ‘Waan ani sirraa qabu naa kaffali’ jedheen.
english: “But that servant went out and found one of his fellow servants who owed him one hundred denarii, and he grabbed him and took him by the throat, saying, ‘Pay me what you owe!’

kikuyu: “Garbichi akka isaa sunis miilla isaatti kufee, ‘Naaf obsi; waan narra jiru siif nan kaffalaa’ jedhee isa kadhate.
english: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’

kikuyu: “Inni garuu ni dide; qooda kanaa hamma inni gatii isaa kaffalutti mana hidhaatti isa galchisiise.
english: He would not, but went and cast him into prison until he should pay back that which was due.

kikuyu: Garboonni kaan yommuu waan taʼe sana arganitti akka malee gaddan; dhaqaniis waan taʼe hundumaa gooftaa isaaniitti himan.
english: So when his fellow servants saw what was done, they were exceedingly sorry, and came and told their lord all that was done.

kikuyu: “Gooftichis garbicha sana ofitti waamee akkana jedheen; ‘Yaa garbicha hamaa! Ani sababii ati na kadhatteef gatii sirra ture hunda siif dhiise.
english: Then his lord called him in and said to him, ‘You wicked servant! I forgave you all that debt because you begged me.

kikuyu: Akkuma ani garaa siif laafe sana atis garbicha akka keetiitiif garaa laafuu hin qabduu?’
english: Shouldn’t you also have had mercy on your fellow servant, even as I had mercy on you?’

kikuyu: Gooftaan isaas aariidhaan hamma inni gatii sana hunda kaffalutti warra isa dhiphisanitti dabarsee isa kenne.
english: His lord was angry, and delivered him to the tormentors until he should pay all that was due to him.

kikuyu: “Isinis yoo garaa keessan guutuudhaan obboleessa keessaniif dhiisuu baattan Abbaan koo inni samii irraa tokkoo tokkoo keessan akkanuma godha.”
english: So my heavenly Father will also do to you, if you don’t each forgive your brother from your hearts for his misdeeds.”

kikuyu: Yesuus erga dubbii kana dubbatee fixatee booddee, Galiilaadhaa kaʼee gama Yordaanos gara biyya Yihuudaa dhaqe.
english: When Jesus had finished these words, he departed from Galilee and came into the borders of Judea beyond the Jordan.

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeenis isa duukaa buʼan; innis achitti isaan fayyise.
english: Great multitudes followed him, and he healed them there.

kikuyu: Fariisonni tokko tokkos isa qoruuf gara isaa dhufanii, “Namni tokko waanuma argeen niitii isaa hiikuun ni eeyyamamaa?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: Pharisees came to him, testing him and saying, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any reason?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Isin akka inni jalqabatti isaan uume sun, ‘dhiiraa fi dubartii taasisee isaan uume’hin dubbifnee?
english: He answered, “Haven’t you read that he who made them from the beginning made them male and female,

kikuyu: Inni akkana jedhe; ‘Sababii kanaaf namni abbaa fi haadha isaa dhiisee niitii isaatti maxxana; lamaan isaanii iyyuu foon tokko taʼu.’
english: and said, ‘For this cause a man shall leave his father and mother, and shall be joined to his wife; and the two shall become one flesh’?

kikuyu: Egaa isaan siʼachi foon tokko malee lama miti. Kanaafuu waan Waaqni tokko taasise namni gargar hin baasin.”
english: So that they are no more two, but one flesh. What therefore God has joined together, don’t let man tear apart.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Yoos Museen maaliif akka namni tokko waraqaa ragaa hiikkaa kenneefii niitii isaa of irraa geggeessu ajaje ree?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: They asked him, “Why then did Moses command us to give her a certificate of divorce and divorce her?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Museen sababii mata jabina keessaniitiif jedhee akka isin niitota keessan hiiktan isiniif eeyyame. Jalqabatti garuu akkana hin turre.
english: He said to them, “Moses, because of the hardness of your hearts, allowed you to divorce your wives, but from the beginning it has not been so.

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; namni utuu isheen halalummaa hin hojjetin niitii isaa hiikee dubartii biraa fuudhu kam iyyuu ejja raawwata.”
english: I tell you that whoever divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another, commits adultery; and he who marries her when she is divorced commits adultery.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaas, “Haalli dhirsaa fi niitii akkana taanaan fuudhuu dhiisuu wayya” jedhaniin.
english: His disciples said to him, “If this is the case of the man with his wife, it is not expedient to marry.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedheen; “Waan kana warra isaaniif kenname qofa malee namni hundi fudhachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: But he said to them, “Not all men can receive this saying, but those to whom it is given.

kikuyu: Warri xuʼaashii taʼanii gadameessa haadha isaaniitii dhalatan jiruutii; warri harka namaatiin xuʼaashii taʼanis jiru; kanneen mootummaa samiitiif jedhanii xuʼaashii of taasisanis jiru; namni kana fudhachuu dandaʼu haa fudhatu.”
english: For there are eunuchs who were born that way from their mother’s womb, and there are eunuchs who were made eunuchs by men; and there are eunuchs who made themselves eunuchs for the Kingdom of Heaven’s sake. He who is able to receive it, let him receive it.”

kikuyu: Ergasii akka inni harka isaan irra kaaʼee isaaniif kadhatuuf ijoollee xixinnoo Yesuusitti fidan. Barattoonni garuu isaan ifatan.
english: Then little children were brought to him that he should lay his hands on them and pray; and the disciples rebuked them.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Ijoolleen xixinnoon gara koo haa dhufaniitii hin dhowwinaa; mootummaan samii kan warra akkanaatii” jedhe.
english: But Jesus said, “Allow the little children, and don’t forbid them to come to me; for the Kingdom of Heaven belongs to ones like these.”

kikuyu: Innis erga harka isaa isaan irra kaaʼee booddee achii deeme.
english: He laid his hands on them, and departed from there.

kikuyu: Kunoo namichi tokko gara Yesuus dhufee, “Yaa barsiisaa, jireenya bara baraa argachuuf wanni gaariin ani gochuu qabu maali?” jedhee gaafate.
english: Behold, one came to him and said, “Good teacher, what good thing shall I do, that I may have eternal life?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Ati maaliif waaʼee waan gaarii na gaafatta? Gaariin Isa Tokkicha qofatu jira. Ati yoo jireenyatti galuu barbaadde ajajawwan eegi” jedhee deebise.
english: He said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good but one, that is, God. But if you want to enter into life, keep the commandments.”

kikuyu: Namichis, “Ajajawwan kami?” jedhee gaafate. Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “ ‘Hin ajjeesin; hin ejjin; hin hatin; sobaan dhugaa hin baʼin;
english: He said to him, “Which ones?” Jesus said, “‘You shall not murder.’ ‘You shall not commit adultery.’ ‘You shall not steal.’ ‘You shall not offer false testimony.’

kikuyu: abbaa keetii fi haadha kee kabaji;ollaa kee akkuma ofii keetiitti jaalladhu.’”
english: ‘Honor your father and your mother.’ And, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’”

kikuyu: Dargaggeessi sunis, “Ani ajajawwan kanneen hunda eegeera. Yoos maaltu amma iyyuu na duraa hirʼata ree?” jedheen.
english: The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Ati yoo nama hirʼina hin qabne taʼuu barbaadde, dhaqiitii waan qabdu gurgurii hiyyeeyyiif kenni; samii keessatti badhaadhummaa ni qabaattaa. Ergasii kottuu na duukaa buʼi” jedhee deebiseef.
english: Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me.”

kikuyu: Dargaggeessi sunis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti gaddee achii deeme; inni qabeenya guddaa qaba tureetii.
english: But when the young man heard this, he went away sad, for he was one who had great possessions.

kikuyu: Yesuusis barattoota isaatiin akkana jedhe; “Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; mootummaa samiitti galuun nama sooressaaf rakkisaa dha.
english: Jesus said to his disciples, “Most certainly I say to you, a rich man will enter into the Kingdom of Heaven with difficulty.

kikuyu: Ammas isinittin hima; namni sooressi mootummaa Waaqaatti galuu irra qaawwa lilmoo keessa baʼuutu gaalaaf salphata.”
english: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti akka malee raajeffatanii, “Yoos eenyutu fayyuu dandaʼa ree?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: When the disciples heard it, they were exceedingly astonished, saying, “Who then can be saved?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis isaan ilaalee, “Kun namaaf hin dandaʼamu; Waaqaaf garuu wanni hundinuu ni dandaʼama” jedhe.
english: Looking at them, Jesus said, “With men this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Phexros, “Kunoo, nu waan hunda dhiifnee si duukaa buuneerra! Egaa maal arganna ree?” jedhee deebise.
english: Then Peter answered, “Behold, we have left everything and followed you. What then will we have?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; addunyaa haaraa keessatti, yeroo Ilmi Namaa teessoo isaa ulfina qabeessa sana irra taaʼutti, isin warri na duukaa buutanis akkasuma teessoowwan kudha lama irra teessanii gosoota Israaʼel kudha lamaanitti murtu.
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that you who have followed me, in the regeneration when the Son of Man will sit on the throne of his glory, you also will sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.

kikuyu: Namni maqaa kootiif jedhee manneen yookaan obboloota yookaan obboleettota yookaan abbaa yookaan haadha yookaan niitii yookaan ijoollee yookaan lafa qotiisaa dhiise hundi dachaa dhibba ni argata; jireenya bara baraas ni dhaala.
english: Everyone who has left houses, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or lands, for my name’s sake, will receive one hundred times, and will inherit eternal life.

kikuyu: Garuu warri jalqabaa hedduun warra dhumaa ni taʼu; warri dhumaa hedduun immoo warra jalqabaa ni taʼu.
english: But many will be last who are first, and first who are last.

kikuyu: “Mootummaan samiis abbaa lafaa kan iddoo dhaabaa wayinii isaatti hojjettoota qacarachuuf jedhee barii obboroo manaa baʼe tokko fakkaata.
english: “For the Kingdom of Heaven is like a man who was the master of a household, who went out early in the morning to hire laborers for his vineyard.

kikuyu: Innis guyyaatti diinaariitokko tokko isaanii kaffaluuf hojjettoota sanaan walii galee gara iddoo dhaabaa wayinii isaatti isaan erge.
english: When he had agreed with the laborers for a denarius a day, he sent them into his vineyard.

kikuyu: “Namichi sunis gara saʼaatii sadiitti gad baʼee namoota hojii malee iddoo gabaa dhadhaabatan kanneen biraa arge.
english: He went out about the third hour, and saw others standing idle in the marketplace.

kikuyu: ‘Isinis dhaqaatii iddoo dhaabaa wayinii kootii keessa hojjedhaa; anis waan isiniif malu isiniifin kaffalaa’ jedheen.
english: He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and whatever is right I will give you.’ So they went their way.

kikuyu: Isaanis ni dhaqan. “Ammas gara saʼaatii jaʼaa fi gara saʼaatii sagaliitti gad baʼee akkasuma godhe.
english: Again he went out about the sixth and the ninth hour, and did likewise.

kikuyu: Naannoo saʼaatii kudha tokkoottis gad baʼee namoota hojii malee dhadhaabatan biraa argee, ‘Isin maaliif guyyaa guutuu hojii malee as dhadhaabattu?’ jedhee isaan gaafate.
english: About the eleventh hour he went out and found others standing idle. He said to them, ‘Why do you stand here all day idle?’

kikuyu: “Isaanis, ‘Sababii namni tokko illee nu hin qacaratiniif’ jedhanii deebisan. “Inni immoo, ‘Isinis dhaqaatii iddoo dhaabaa wayinii kootii keessa hojjedhaa’ jedheen.
english: “They said to him, ‘Because no one has hired us.’ “He said to them, ‘You also go into the vineyard, and you will receive whatever is right.’

kikuyu: “Yommuu galgalaaʼetti abbaan iddoo dhaabaa wayinii sanaa hoogganaa hojii isaatiin, ‘Hojjettoota waami; warra gara dhumaatti qacaramanii jalqabii hamma warra dura qacaramaniitti mindaa isaanii kaffaliif’ jedheen.
english: “When evening had come, the lord of the vineyard said to his manager, ‘Call the laborers and pay them their wages, beginning from the last to the first.’

kikuyu: “Warri gara saʼaatii kudha tokkootti qacaraman sunis dhufanii tokkoon tokkoon isaanii diinaarii tokko tokko fudhatan.
english: “When those who were hired at about the eleventh hour came, they each received a denarius.

kikuyu: Warri jalqabatti qacaraman yommuu dhufanitti waan warra kaan caalaa argatan seʼan. Garuu tokkoon tokkoon isaanii diinaarii tokko tokko fudhatan.
english: When the first came, they supposed that they would receive more; and they likewise each received a denarius.

kikuyu: Isaan yommuu diinaarii sana fudhatanitti abbaa lafaa sanatti guunguman.
english: When they received it, they murmured against the master of the household,

kikuyu: Isaanis, ‘Warri gara dhumaatti qacaraman kunneen saʼaatii tokko qofa hojjetan; ati garuu nu warra dadhabbii hojichaatii fi hoʼa guyyaa obsine isaaniin wal qixxeessite’ jedhaniin.
english: saying, ‘These last have spent one hour, and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the day and the scorching heat!’

kikuyu: “Inni garuu hojjettoota sana keessaa isa tokkoon, ‘Yaa michuu ko, ani waan tokkoon illee si hin miine. Ati diinaarii tokkoon naan walii hin gallee?
english: “But he answered one of them, ‘Friend, I am doing you no wrong. Didn’t you agree with me for a denarius?

kikuyu: Qooda kee fudhadhuu deemi; ani namicha isa gara dhumaa kanaafis hammuma siif kenne sana kennuufii nan barbaada.
english: Take that which is yours, and go your way. It is my desire to give to this last just as much as to you.

kikuyu: Ani qarshii kootiin waan barbaade gochuuf mirga hin qabuu? Yookaan sababii ani arjaa taʼeef hinaaftaa?’ jedhe.
english: Isn’t it lawful for me to do what I want to with what I own? Or is your eye evil, because I am good?’

kikuyu: “Akkasuma warri dhumaa warra jalqabaa ni taʼu; warri jalqabaa immoo warra dhumaa ni taʼu.”
english: So the last will be first, and the first last. For many are called, but few are chosen.”

kikuyu: Yesuus utuu Yerusaalemitti ol baʼaa jiruu barattoota kudha lamaan kophaatti baasee akkana jedheen:
english: As Jesus was going up to Jerusalem, he took the twelve disciples aside, and on the way he said to them,

kikuyu: “Kunoo nu Yerusaalemitti ol baʼaa jirra; Ilmi Namaas dabarfamee luboota hangafootattii fi barsiistota seeraatti ni kennama. Isaanis duʼa itti muru;
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and scribes, and they will condemn him to death,

kikuyu: akka isaan itti qoosaniif, isa garafanii fi isa fannisaniifis dabarsanii Namoota Ormaatti isa kennu. Innis guyyaa sadaffaatti duʼaa ni kaafama!”
english: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to mock, to scourge, and to crucify; and the third day he will be raised up.”

kikuyu: Ergasiis haati ilmaan Zabdewoos ilmaan ishee wajjin gara Yesuus dhuftee jilbeenfattee waa isa kadhatte.
english: Then the mother of the sons of Zebedee came to him with her sons, kneeling and asking a certain thing of him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Ati maal barbaadda?” jedheen. Isheenis, “Akka ilmaan koo kunneen lamaan mootummaa kee keessatti inni tokko mirga keetiin, inni kaan immoo bitaa keetiin taaʼu naa godhi” jetteen.
english: He said to her, “What do you want?” She said to him, “Command that these, my two sons, may sit, one on your right hand and one on your left hand, in your Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Isin waan kadhattan hin beektan; xoofoo ani dhuguuf jiru dhuguu ni dandeessuu?” jedheen. Isaanis, “Ni dandeenya” jedhanii deebisan.
english: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?” They said to him, “We are able.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Dhugumaan xoofoo koo irraa illee ni dhugdu; garuu mirga kootii fi bitaa kootiin taaʼuu kan kennu ana miti. Iddoon kun kan warra Abbaan koo isaaniif qopheesse sanaa ti” jedheen.
english: He said to them, “You will indeed drink my cup, and be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with; but to sit on my right hand and on my left hand is not mine to give, but it is for whom it has been prepared by my Father.”

kikuyu: Warri kurnan yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti obboloota lamaanitti aaran.
english: When the ten heard it, they were indignant with the two brothers.

kikuyu: Yesuusis walitti isaan waamee akkana jedhe; “Isin akka bulchitoonni Namoota Ormaa isaan irratti gooftummaa mulʼisan, gurguddoonni isaaniis akka isaan irratti taayitaa argisiisan ni beektu.
english: But Jesus summoned them, and said, “You know that the rulers of the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

kikuyu: Isin biratti akkas miti. Qooda kanaa namni isin keessaa nama guddaa taʼuu barbaadu kam iyyuu tajaajilaa keessan taʼuu qaba;
english: It shall not be so among you; but whoever desires to become great among you shall be your servant.

kikuyu: namni nama jalqabaa taʼuu barbaadu kam iyyuu garbicha keessan taʼuu qaba;
english: Whoever desires to be first among you shall be your bondservant,

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa iyyuu tajaajiluu fi lubbuu isaa immoo namoota baayʼeedhaaf furii godhee kennuuf dhufe malee tajaajilamuuf hin dhufneetii.”
english: even as the Son of Man came not to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuusii fi barattoonni isaa Yerikoodhaa baʼaa jiranuu, tuunni namootaa guddaan isa duukaa buʼe.
english: As they went out from Jericho, a great multitude followed him.

kikuyu: Kunoo, jaamonni lama qarqara karaa tataaʼaa turan; isaanis yommuu akka Yesuus achiin darbaa jiru dhagaʼanitti iyyanii, “Gooftaa, yaa Ilma Daawit nu maari!” jedhan.
english: Behold, two blind men sitting by the road, when they heard that Jesus was passing by, cried out, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

kikuyu: Tuunni sunis akka isaan calʼisaniif isaan ifate; isaan garuu, “Yaa Gooftaa, yaa Ilma Daawit nu maari!” jedhanii ittuma caalchisanii iyyan.
english: The multitude rebuked them, telling them that they should be quiet, but they cried out even more, “Lord, have mercy on us, you son of David!”

kikuyu: Yesuusis dhaabatee isaan waamee, “Akka ani maal isinii godhu barbaaddu?” jedhee isaan gaafate.
english: Jesus stood still and called them, and asked, “What do you want me to do for you?”

kikuyu: Isaan immoo, “Yaa Gooftaa, akka iji keenya nuuf banamu barbaanna” jedhanii deebisan.
english: They told him, “Lord, that our eyes may be opened.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis garaa laafeefii ija isaanii qaqqabe. Isaanis yeruma sana arganii isa duukaa buʼan.
english: Jesus, being moved with compassion, touched their eyes; and immediately their eyes received their sight, and they followed him.

kikuyu: Akkuma isaan Yerusaalemitti dhiʼaatanii Beetfaagee ishee Gaara Ejersaa irraa sana gaʼaniin Yesuus barattoota lama erge;
english: When they came near to Jerusalem and came to Bethsphage, to the Mount of Olives, then Jesus sent two disciples,

kikuyu: akkanas isaaniin jedhe; “Gara ganda fuula keessan dura jiru sanaa dhaqaa; yommusuma harree hidhamte tokko ilmoo ishee wajjin ni argattu. Lachan isaanii hiikaatii naa fidaa.
english: saying to them, “Go into the village that is opposite you, and immediately you will find a donkey tied, and a colt with her. Untie them and bring them to me.

kikuyu: Yoo namni tokko iyyuu waan tokko isiniin jedhe, ‘Gooftaatu isaan barbaada’ jedhaa; innis yommusuma erga.”
english: If anyone says anything to you, you shall say, ‘The Lord needs them,’ and immediately he will send them.”

kikuyu: Kunis akka wanni karaa raajichaatiin dubbatame sun raawwatamuuf taʼe; innis akkana jedha:
english: All this was done that it might be fulfilled which was spoken through the prophet, saying,

kikuyu: “Akkana jedhaa Intala Xiyoonitti himaa; ‘Kunoo, mootiin kee gad of qabee, harree yaabbatee, ilmoo harree jechuunis harree xinnoo yaabbatee, gara kee dhufa.’ ”
english: “Tell the daughter of Zion, behold, your King comes to you, humble, and riding on a donkey, on a colt, the foal of a donkey.”

kikuyu: Barattoonnis dhaqanii akkuma Yesuus isaan ajaje godhan.
english: The disciples went and did just as Jesus commanded them,

kikuyu: Isaanis harree fi ilmoo harree sana fidan; uffata isaaniis isaan irra buusan; Yesuusis isaan irra taaʼe.
english: and brought the donkey and the colt and laid their clothes on them; and he sat on them.

kikuyu: Namoonni akka malee baayʼeen uffata isaanii karaa irra afan; warri kaan immoo dameewwan mukaa kukkutanii karaa irra bubuusan.
english: A very great multitude spread their clothes on the road. Others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.

kikuyu: Namoonni isa dura deemaa turanii fi warri isa duukaa buʼaa turan iyyanii, “Hoosaaʼinaa Ilma Daawitiif!” “Inni maqaa Gooftaatiin dhufu eebbifamaa dha!” “Hoosaaʼinaa ol gubbaatti!” jedhan.
english: The multitudes who went in front of him, and those who followed, kept shouting, “Hosanna to the son of David! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

kikuyu: Yommuu Yesuus Yerusaalem seenetti, magaalaan sun guutummaatti raafamtee, “Kun eenyu?” jette.
english: When he had come into Jerusalem, all the city was stirred up, saying, “Who is this?”

kikuyu: Tuunni sun immoo, “Kun Yesuus, raajicha Naazreeti Galiilaati” jedhee deebise.
english: The multitudes said, “This is the prophet, Jesus, from Nazareth of Galilee.”

kikuyu: Yesuus mana qulqullummaa seenee warra mana qulqullummaa keessatti bitatanii fi gurguratan hundumaa ariʼe. Minjaala warra maallaqa geeddarataniitii fi barcuma warra gugee gurguratanii garagalche.
english: Jesus entered into the temple of God and drove out all of those who sold and bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

kikuyu: Innis, “ ‘Manni koo mana kadhannaa jedhama’jedhamee barreeffameera; isin garuu holqa saamtotaa gootaniirtu” isaaniin jedhe.
english: He said to them, “It is written, ‘My house shall be called a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a den of robbers!”

kikuyu: Jaamonnii fi warri naafatan mana qulqullummaa keessatti gara isaa dhufan; innis isaan fayyise.
english: The lame and the blind came to him in the temple, and he healed them.

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa yommuu hojii dinqisiisaa inni hojjete arganii ijoollee mana qulqullummaa keessatti, “Hoosaaʼinaa ilma Daawitiif” jedhanii iyyan dhagaʼanitti ni aaran.
english: But when the chief priests and the scribes saw the wonderful things that he did, and the children who were crying in the temple and saying, “Hosanna to the son of David!” they were indignant,

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Ati waan ijoolleen kunneen jedhan dhageessaa?” jedhanii isa gaafatan. Yesuus immoo, “Eeyyee;” isin waan, “ ‘Yaa Gooftaa, ati afaan daaʼimmaniitii fi mucoolii harma hodhanii irraa, galata qopheessiteerta’ jedhu sana takkumaa hin dubbifnee?” jedhee deebise.
english: and said to him, “Do you hear what these are saying?” Jesus said to them, “Yes. Did you never read, ‘Out of the mouth of children and nursing babies, you have perfected praise’?”

kikuyu: Innis isaan biraa deemee magaalaa sanaa baʼe; Biitaaniyaa dhaqee achi bule.
english: He left them and went out of the city to Bethany, and camped there.

kikuyu: Yesuus ganama barii utuu gara magaalattiitti deebiʼuu beelaʼe.
english: Now in the morning, as he returned to the city, he was hungry.

kikuyu: Muka harbuu tokkos karaa biratti argee itti gore; garuu baala malee waa tokko illee hin arganne. Innis, “Iji bara baraan sirratti hin argamin!” jedheen. Mukni sunis yeruma sana goge.
english: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he came to it and found nothing on it but leaves. He said to it, “Let there be no fruit from you forever!” Immediately the fig tree withered away.

kikuyu: Barattoonnis yommuu waan kana arganitti ni dinqisiifatan. Isaanis, “Harbuun sun akkamitti yommusuma goge?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: When the disciples saw it, they marveled, saying, “How did the fig tree immediately wither away?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; yoo amantii qabaattan, yoo mamuu baattanis, waan muka harbuu sana irratti taʼe qofa utuu hin taʼin, tulluu kanaan illee, ‘Kaʼi! Galaanatti darbatami!’ yoo jettan ni taʼa.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, if you have faith and don’t doubt, you will not only do what was done to the fig tree, but even if you told this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ it would be done.

kikuyu: Isin yoo amantii qabaattan waan kadhannaadhaan gaafattan hunda ni argattu.”
english: All things, whatever you ask in prayer, believing, you will receive.”

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuus mana qulqullummaa seenee barsiisaa jiruu luboonni hangafoonnii fi maanguddoonni sabaa gara isaa dhufanii, “Ati taayitaa maaliitiin wantoota kanneen hojjetta? Eenyutu taayitaa kana siif kenne?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: When he had come into the temple, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him as he was teaching, and said, “By what authority do you do these things? Who gave you this authority?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Anis gaaffii tokkon isin gaafadha; yoo isin naaf deebiftan, anis taayitaa maaliitiin wantoota kanneen akkan hojjedhu isinittin hima.
english: Jesus answered them, “I also will ask you one question, which if you tell me, I likewise will tell you by what authority I do these things.

kikuyu: Cuuphaan Yohannis eessaa dhufe? Samii irraa moo nama biraa dhufe?” Isaanis waliin mariʼatanii akkana jedhan; “Yoo nu, ‘Samii irraa dhufe’ jenne, inni immoo, ‘Yoos isin maaliif isa hin amanin ree?’ nuun jedha.
english: The baptism of John, where was it from? From heaven or from men?” They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask us, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

kikuyu: Yoo nu, ‘Nama biraa dhufe’ jenne garuu namoota sodaanna; isaan hundinuu Yohannisin akka raajiitti ilaaluutii.”
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ we fear the multitude, for all hold John as a prophet.”

kikuyu: Kanaaf isaan, “Hin beeknu!” jedhanii Yesuusiif deebisan. Inni immoo akkana jedhe; “Anis taayitaa maaliitiin akkan wantoota kanneen hojjedhu isinitti hin himu.”
english: They answered Jesus, and said, “We don’t know.” He also said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.

kikuyu: “Maal seetu? Nama ilmaan lama qabu tokkotu ture; innis gara ilma isaa hangafaa dhaqee, ‘Yaa ilma ko, harʼa dhaqiitii iddoo dhaabaa wayinii keessa hojjedhu’ jedheen.
english: But what do you think? A man had two sons, and he came to the first, and said, ‘Son, go work today in my vineyard.’

kikuyu: “Ilmi sunis deebisee, ‘Ani hin dhaqu’ jedhe; ergasii garuu gaabbee dhaqe.
english: He answered, ‘I will not,’ but afterward he changed his mind, and went.

kikuyu: “Namichis gara ilma isaa isa kaanii dhaqee akkasuma jedheen. Ilmi isaa sunis, ‘Yaa gooftaa nan dhaqa’ jedhee deebiseef; garuu hin dhaqne.
english: He came to the second, and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I’m going, sir,’ but he didn’t go.

kikuyu: “Ilmaan lamaan keessaa isa kamtu fedhii abbaa isaa guute?” Isaanis, “Isa jalqabaa ti” jedhan. Yesuusis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; qaraxxoonnii fi sagaagaltoonni isin dura mootummaa Waaqaatti ni galu.
english: Which of the two did the will of his father?” They said to him, “The first.” Jesus said to them, “Most certainly I tell you that the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering into God’s Kingdom before you.

kikuyu: Yohannis karaa qajeelummaa isinitti argisiisuu dhufeetii; isin immoo isa hin amanne. Qaraxxoonnii fi sagaagaltoonni garuu isa amanan; isin erguma waan kana argitan illee qalbii jijjiirrattanii isatti hin amanne.
english: For John came to you in the way of righteousness, and you didn’t believe him; but the tax collectors and the prostitutes believed him. When you saw it, you didn’t even repent afterward, that you might believe him.

kikuyu: “Fakkeenya biraa tokko dhagaʼaa; abbaa lafaa kan iddoo dhaabaa wayinii irra wayinii dhaabbate tokkotu ture. Innis naannoo isaatti dallaa ijaaree, achi keessatti boolla itti wayinii cuunfan qotee qooxii eegumsaa ijaare. Ergasiis lafa wayinii sana qonnaan bultootatti kiraa kennatee biyya fagoo dhaqe.
english: “Hear another parable. There was a man who was a master of a household who planted a vineyard, set a hedge about it, dug a wine press in it, built a tower, leased it out to farmers, and went into another country.

kikuyu: Innis yeroon itti midhaan walitti qaban geenyaan akka isaan ija isaa fidaniifiif garboota isaa qottuuwwan sanatti ergate.
english: When the season for the fruit came near, he sent his servants to the farmers to receive his fruit.

kikuyu: “Qottuuwwan sunis garboota namichaa qabanii, isa tokko ni dhaanan; isa kaan ni ajjeesan; isa sadaffaa immoo dhagaan tuman.
english: The farmers took his servants, beat one, killed another, and stoned another.

kikuyu: Ammas garboota warra duraa caalaa baayʼatan biraa ergate; qonnaan bultoonni sunis akkuma sana isaan godhan.
english: Again, he sent other servants more than the first; and they treated them the same way.

kikuyu: Dhuma irrattis inni, ‘Ilma koo ni kabaju’ jedhee ilma isaa isaanitti ergate.
english: But afterward he sent to them his son, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

kikuyu: “Qottoonni sun garuu yommuu ilma sana arganitti, ‘Dhaaltuun isa kana. Kottaa isa ajjeefnee dhaala isaa fudhannaa!’ waliin jedhan.
english: But the farmers, when they saw the son, said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him and seize his inheritance.’

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isaan fuudhanii iddoo dhaabaa wayinii keessaa gad baasanii isa ajjeesan.
english: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard, then killed him.

kikuyu: “Egaa abbaan iddoo dhaabaa wayinii sanaa yommuu dhufutti qottuuwwan sana maal godhinna laata?”
english: When therefore the lord of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those farmers?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Inni namoota hamoo sana haala hamaadhaan ni balleessa; iddoo dhaabaa wayinii sanas qottuuwwan yeroo midhaan walitti qabamutti qooda midhaan isaa kennaniif kanneen biraatti dabarsee ni kenna” jedhanii deebisan.
english: They told him, “He will miserably destroy those miserable men, and will lease out the vineyard to other farmers who will give him the fruit in its season.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isin dubbii Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluu keessatti, “ ‘Dhagaan ijaartonni tuffatan, dhagaa golee taʼeera; kanas Gooftaatu godhe; kun immoo ija keenyatti dinqii dha’jedhu sana gonkumaa hin dubbifnee?
english: Jesus said to them, “Did you never read in the Scriptures, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner. This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu ani isinittin hima; mootummaan Waaqaa isin irraa fudhatamee saba ija isaa godhatutti ni kennama.
english: “Therefore I tell you, God’s Kingdom will be taken away from you and will be given to a nation producing its fruit.

kikuyu: Namni dhagaa kana irratti kufu kam iyyuu caccabee bututa; namni dhagichi irratti kufu kam iyyuu ni daakama.”
english: He who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces, but on whomever it will fall, it will scatter him as dust.”

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonnii fi Fariisonni yommuu fakkeenyawwan Yesuus dhagaʼanitti akka inni waaʼee isaanii dubbate beekan.
english: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard his parables, they perceived that he spoke about them.

kikuyu: Isaanis isa qabuu barbaadan; garuu sababii namoonni Yesuusin akka raajiitti ilaalaa turaniif namoota sana sodaatan.
english: When they sought to seize him, they feared the multitudes, because they considered him to be a prophet.

kikuyu: Yesuus ammas akkana jedhee fakkeenyaan deebii kenneef:
english: Jesus answered and spoke to them again in parables, saying,

kikuyu: “Mootummaan samii mootii ilma isaatiif cidha fuudhaa qopheesse tokko fakkaata.
english: “The Kingdom of Heaven is like a certain king, who made a wedding feast for his son,

kikuyu: Innis akka isaan warra cidha sanatti affeeraman waamaniif garboota isaa erge; warri waamaman sun garuu dhufuu hin barbaanne.
english: and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding feast, but they would not come.

kikuyu: “Ammas akkana jedhee garboota biraa erge; ‘Kunoo ani irbaata koo qopheesseera: Sangoonni koo, horiin koo coccoomoonis qalamanii wanni hundinuu qopheeffameera. Gara cidha fuudhaa fi heerumaa kottaa jedhaatii warra affeeraman sanatti himaa.’
english: Again he sent out other servants, saying, ‘Tell those who are invited, “Behold, I have prepared my dinner. My cattle and my fatlings are killed, and all things are ready. Come to the wedding feast!”’

kikuyu: “Isaan garuu tuffatanii, inni tokko gara lafa qotiisaa isaa, kaan immoo gara daldala isaa dhaqe.
english: But they made light of it, and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his merchandise;

kikuyu: Warri hafan immoo garboota isaa qabanii salphisan; ni ajjeesanis.
english: and the rest grabbed his servants, treated them shamefully, and killed them.

kikuyu: Mootichis ni aare. Loltoota isaas ergee warra garboota isaa ajjeesan sana balleesse; magaalaa isaaniis ni gube.
english: When the king heard that, he was angry, and sent his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned their city.

kikuyu: “Ergasii inni garboota isaatiin akkana jedhe; ‘Dhangaan cidha fuudhaa qopheeffameera; warri affeeraman garuu cidha kanaaf hin malle.
english: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding is ready, but those who were invited weren’t worthy.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu gara qaxxaamura karaatti baʼaatii nama argitan hunda gara cidhaatti affeeraa.’
english: Go therefore to the intersections of the highways, and as many as you may find, invite to the wedding feast.’

kikuyu: Garboonni sunis karaatti baʼanii nama argan hunda, hamaas gaariis walitti qaban; galmi cidhaa sunis keessummootaan guutame.
english: Those servants went out into the highways and gathered together as many as they found, both bad and good. The wedding was filled with guests.

kikuyu: “Mootichi yommuu keessummoota ilaaluuf ol seenetti, nama uffata cidhaa hin uffatin tokko achitti arge.
english: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw there a man who didn’t have on wedding clothing,

kikuyu: Innis, ‘Yaa michuu ko, ati akkamitti utuu uffata cidhaa hin uffatin as seente?’ jedhee isa gaafate. Namichi garuu waan dubbatu dhabe.
english: and he said to him, ‘Friend, how did you come in here not wearing wedding clothing?’ He was speechless.

kikuyu: “Mootichis tajaajiltoota isaatiin, ‘Namicha kana harkaa fi miilla hidhaatii dukkana alaatti gad darbadhaa; achittis booʼuu fi ilkaan qaruutu taʼa’ jedhe.
english: Then the king said to the servants, ‘Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and throw him into the outer darkness. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.’

kikuyu: “Warri affeeraman baayʼeedhaatii; warri filataman garuu muraasa.”
english: For many are called, but few chosen.”

kikuyu: Ergasiis Fariisonni waanuma inni dubbatuun isa qabuuf gad baʼanii Yesuusitti mariʼatan.
english: Then the Pharisees went and took counsel how they might entrap him in his talk.

kikuyu: Isaanis barattoota isaanii garee Heroodis wajjin isatti ergan. Akkanas jedhan; “Yaa barsiisaa, akka ati nama dhugaa taate, akka ati dhugaadhaan karaa Waaqaa barsiiftu beekna. Ati nama wal hin caalchiftu; fuula namaas hin ilaaltu.
english: They sent their disciples to him, along with the Herodians, saying, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and teach the way of God in truth, no matter whom you teach; for you aren’t partial to anyone.

kikuyu: Egaa mee nutti himi; yaadni kee maali? Qeesaariif gibira kaffaluun eeyyamameera moo hin eeyyamamne?”
english: Tell us therefore, what do you think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu hammina isaanii beekee akkana jedhe; “Yaa fakkeessitoota nana, isin maaliif na qortu?
english: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, “Why do you test me, you hypocrites?

kikuyu: Mee maallaqa gibira kaffaltan natti argisiisaa.” Isaanis diinaarii tokko isatti fidan;
english: Show me the tax money.” They brought to him a denarius.

kikuyu: inni immoo, “Fakkiin kun kan eenyuu ti? Katabbiin kunis kan eenyuu ti?” jedhee isaan gaafate.
english: He asked them, “Whose is this image and inscription?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Kan Qeesaari” jedhanii deebisan. Kana irratti inni, “Yoos kan Qeesaar Qeesaariif, kan Waaqaa immoo Waaqaaf kennaa” jedheen.
english: They said to him, “Caesar’s.” Then he said to them, “Give therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti ni dinqifatan. Kanaaf isa dhiisanii qajeelan.
english: When they heard it, they marveled, and left him and went away.

kikuyu: Guyyuma sana Saduuqonni warri duʼaa kaʼuun hin jiru jedhan tokko tokko gara isaa dhufanii gaaffii isa gaafatan.
english: On that day Sadducees (those who say that there is no resurrection) came to him. They asked him,

kikuyu: Akkanas jedhan; “Yaa barsiisaa, Museen, ‘Namni tokko niitii fuudhee utuu ijoollee hin dhalchin yoo duʼe obboleessi isaa niitii sana dhaalee obboleessa isaatiif sanyii haa dhaabu’ jedhee nutti himeera.
english: saying, “Teacher, Moses said, ‘If a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

kikuyu: Kunoo obboloota torbatu nu bira ture. Inni jalqabaa niitii fuudhee utuu ijoollee hin qabaatin niitii isaa obboleessa isaatti dhiisee duʼe.
english: Now there were with us seven brothers. The first married and died, and having no offspring left his wife to his brother.

kikuyu: Obboleessa lammaffaa fi sadaffaa irratti, hamma isa torbaffaattis waanuma sanatu taʼe.
english: In the same way, the second also, and the third, to the seventh.

kikuyu: Dhuma irratti dubartittiinis ni duute.
english: After them all, the woman died.

kikuyu: Egaa guyyaa duʼaa kaʼuutti, torban isaanii keessaa isheen niitii isa kamii taati? Hundi isaanii iyyuu ishee fuudhaniiruutii.”
english: In the resurrection therefore, whose wife will she be of the seven? For they all had her.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Isin waan Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluu yookaan humna Waaqaa hin beekneef dogoggortu.
english: But Jesus answered them, “You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures, nor the power of God.

kikuyu: Guyyaa duʼaa kaʼuutti namoonni akka ergamoota samii taʼu malee hin fuudhan; hin heerumanis.
english: For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like God’s angels in heaven.

kikuyu: Garuu isin waan Waaqni waaʼee duʼaa kaʼuu warra duʼanii isiniin jedhe hin dubbifnee? Innis akkana jedha;
english: But concerning the resurrection of the dead, haven’t you read that which was spoken to you by God, saying,

kikuyu: ‘Ani Waaqa Abrahaam, Waaqa Yisihaaqii fi Waaqa Yaaqoob.’Inni Waaqa warra jiraataniiti malee Waaqa warra duʼanii miti.”
english: ‘I am the God of Abraham, and the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living.”

kikuyu: Namoonni yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti, barsiisa isaa dinqifatan.
english: When the multitudes heard it, they were astonished at his teaching.

kikuyu: Fariisonni yommuu akka Yesuus Saduuqota afaan qabachiise dhagaʼanitti walitti qabaman.
english: But the Pharisees, when they heard that he had silenced the Sadducees, gathered themselves together.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaas hayyuun seeraa tokko akkana jedhee gaaffii kanaan isa qore:
english: One of them, a lawyer, asked him a question, testing him.

kikuyu: “Yaa barsiisaa, seera keessaa ajajni guddaan isa kami?”
english: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the law?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedheen; “Waaqa kee Goofticha garaa kee guutuudhaan, lubbuu kee guutuudhaan, yaada kee guutuudhaan jaalladhu.
english: Jesus said to him, “‘You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.’

kikuyu: Kunis ajaja jalqabaatii fi guddicha.
english: This is the first and great commandment.

kikuyu: Ajajni lammaffaanis isuma fakkaata: ‘Ollaa kee akkuma ofii keetiitti jaalladhu’jedha.
english: A second likewise is this, ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’

kikuyu: Seerrii fi Raajonni hundinuu ajajawwan kanneen lamaan irratti hundeeffamu.”
english: The whole law and the prophets depend on these two commandments.”

kikuyu: Utuu Fariisonni walitti qabamanii jiranuu Yesuus gaaffii tokko isaan gaafate;
english: Now while the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them a question,

kikuyu: innis, “Isin waaʼee Kiristoos maal yaaddu? Inni ilma eenyuu ti?” jedhe. Isaanis, “Inni Ilma Daawit” jedhanii deebisan.
english: saying, “What do you think of the Christ? Whose son is he?” They said to him, “Of David.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Yoos Daawit akkamitti Hafuuraan geggeeffamee, ‘Gooftaa’ isaan jedha ree? Inni akkana jedhaatii:
english: He said to them, “How then does David in the Spirit call him Lord, saying,

kikuyu: “ ‘Gooftaan Gooftaa kootiin: “Hamma ani diinota kee miilla kee jala siif galchutti gara mirga koo taaʼi”jedhe.’
english: ‘The Lord said to my Lord, sit on my right hand, until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet’?

kikuyu: Erga Daawit, ‘Gooftaa’ jedhee isa waame, yoos inni akkamitti ilma isaa taʼuu dandaʼa ree?”
english: “If then David calls him Lord, how is he his son?”

kikuyu: Namni tokko iyyuu waan tokko isaaf deebisuu hin dandeenye; gaafasii jalqabee namni tokko iyyuu deebiʼee gaaffii isa gaafachuuf ija hin jabaanne.
english: No one was able to answer him a word, neither did any man dare ask him any more questions from that day forward.

kikuyu: Yesuusis ergasii uummataa fi barattoota isaatiin akkana jedhe:
english: Then Jesus spoke to the multitudes and to his disciples,

kikuyu: “Barsiistonni seeraatii fi Fariisonni barcuma Musee irra taaʼaniiru.
english: saying, “The scribes and the Pharisees sit on Moses’ seat.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu waan isaan isinitti himan hundumaa godhaa; eegaas. Garuu waan isaan hojjetan hin hojjetinaa; isaan ni dubbatu malee waan dubbatan sana hin hojjetaniitii.
english: All things therefore whatever they tell you to observe, observe and do, but don’t do their works; for they say, and don’t do.

kikuyu: Isaan baʼaa ulfaataa hidhanii gatiittii namaa irra kaaʼu; ofii isaaniitii garuu baʼaa sana sochoosuuf qubaan illee tuquu hin barbaadan.
english: For they bind heavy burdens that are grievous to be borne, and lay them on men’s shoulders; but they themselves will not lift a finger to help them.

kikuyu: “Isaan waan hojjetan hundumaa namootatti of argisiisuuf hojjetu: Kudhaama isaanii ni balʼifatuutii; handaara uffata isaaniis ni dheereffatu.
english: But they do all their works to be seen by men. They make their phylacteries broad and enlarge the fringes of their garments,

kikuyu: Iddoo cidhaatti iddoo ulfinaa, manneen sagadaa keessatti immoo taaʼumsa ulfinaa jaallatu.
english: and love the place of honor at feasts, the best seats in the synagogues,

kikuyu: Gabaa keessattis akka namoonni nagaa isaan gaafatanii fi akka ‘Yaa barsiisaa’ jedhanii isaan waaman jaallatu.
english: the salutations in the marketplaces, and to be called ‘Rabbi, Rabbi’ by men.

kikuyu: “Isin garuu, ‘Barsiisaa’ jedhamtanii hin waamaminaa; Barsiisaa tokko qofa qabduutii. Isin hundis obboloota walii keessanii ti.
english: But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi’, for one is your teacher, the Christ, and all of you are brothers.

kikuyu: Lafa irratti nama tokkoon illee ‘Abbaa’ hin jedhinaa; isin Abbaa tokko qofa qabduutii; innis isa samii irraa ti.
english: Call no man on the earth your father, for one is your Father, he who is in heaven.

kikuyu: ‘Gooftota’ jedhamtanii hin waamaminaa; isin Gooftaa tokko qofa qabduutii; innis Kiristoos.
english: Neither be called masters, for one is your master, the Christ.

kikuyu: Isin keessaa namni hunda keessan caalu tajaajilaa keessan haa taʼu.
english: But he who is greatest among you will be your servant.

kikuyu: Namni ol of qabu kam iyyuu gad qabamaatii; namni gad of qabu kam iyyuu garuu ol qabama.
english: Whoever exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.

kikuyu: “Yaa barsiistota seeraatii fi Fariisota fakkeessitoota nana, isiniif wayyoo! Isin mootummaa samii namoota duraa cuftuutii. Ofii keessanii hin seentan; warra seenuu yaalanis akka isaan seenan hin gootan. [
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you devour widows’ houses, and as a pretense you make long prayers. Therefore you will receive greater condemnation.

kikuyu: Yaa barsiistota seeraatii fi Fariisota fakkeessitoota nana, isiniif wayyoo! Mana haadha hiyyeessaa saamtanii onsituutii; itti fakkeessuuf kadhannaa ni dheeressitu; kanaafuu murtii caalutu isinitti murama.]
english: “But woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! Because you shut up the Kingdom of Heaven against men; for you don’t enter in yourselves, neither do you allow those who are entering in to enter.

kikuyu: “Yaa barsiistota seeraatii fi Fariisota fakkeessitoota nana, isiniif wayyoo! Nama tokko amantii keessanitti galfachuuf jettanii lafaa fi galaana irra joortu; yommuu inni amanuttis akka inni isin caalaa dachaa lama ilma gahaannam taʼu isa gootu.
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you travel around by sea and land to make one proselyte; and when he becomes one, you make him twice as much a son of Gehenna as yourselves.

kikuyu: “Qajeelchitoota jaamota nana, isiniif wayyoo! Isin, ‘Namni kam iyyuu yoo mana qulqullummaatiin kakate, kun homaa miti; namni kam iyyuu yoo warqee mana qulqullummaatiin kakate garuu kakuun sun isa qaba’ jettu.
english: “Woe to you, you blind guides, who say, ‘Whoever swears by the temple, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gold of the temple, he is obligated.’

kikuyu: Isin gowwootaa fi jaamota nana, warqee moo mana qulqullummaa kan warqee sana qulqulleessutu caala?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gold or the temple that sanctifies the gold?

kikuyu: Akkasumas isin, ‘Namni kam iyyuu yoo iddoo aarsaatiin kakate, kun homaa miti; yoo kennaa iddoo aarsaa irra jiru sanaan kakate garuu kakuun sun isa qaba’ jettu.
english: And, ‘Whoever swears by the altar, it is nothing; but whoever swears by the gift that is on it, he is obligated.’

kikuyu: Isin jaamota nana, kennaa sana moo iddoo aarsaa isa kennaa sana qulqulleessutu caala?
english: You blind fools! For which is greater, the gift, or the altar that sanctifies the gift?

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namni iddoo aarsaatiin kakatu, iddoo aarsaatii fi waan isa irra jiru hundumaan ni kakata.
english: He therefore who swears by the altar, swears by it and by everything on it.

kikuyu: Namni mana qulqullummaatiin kakatu, mana qulqullummaatii fi isa mana qulqullummaa keessa jiraatuun kakata.
english: He who swears by the temple, swears by it and by him who has been living in it.

kikuyu: Namni samiidhaan kakatu, teessoo Waaqaatii fi isa teessoo sana irra taaʼuun kakata.
english: He who swears by heaven, swears by the throne of God and by him who sits on it.

kikuyu: “Yaa barsiistota seeraatii fi Fariisota fakkeessitoota nana, isiniif wayyoo! Isin abasuuda, insilaalaa fi kamuunii kudhan keessaa tokko ni kennitu. Garuu seera keessaa waan caalaatti barbaachisaa taʼe jechuunis murtii qajeelaa, araaraa fi amanamummaa dhiiftaniirtu. Silaa utuu isa duraa hin dhiisin isa duubaa hojii irra oolchuu qabdu ture.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you tithe mint, dill, and cumin, and have left undone the weightier matters of the law: justice, mercy, and faith. But you ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

kikuyu: Isin qajeelchitoota jaamota nana! Bookee ni calaltu; gaala immoo ni liqimsitu.
english: You blind guides, who strain out a gnat, and swallow a camel!

kikuyu: “Yaa barsiistota seeraatii fi Fariisota fakkeessitoota nana, isiniif wayyoo! Duuba xoofootii fi caabii ni qulqulleessitu; keessi isaanii garuu saamichaa fi ofittummaadhaan guutameera.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you clean the outside of the cup and of the platter, but within they are full of extortion and unrighteousness.

kikuyu: Yaa Fariisicha jaamaa nana! Jalqabatti keessa xoofootii fi caabii qulqulleessi; ergasii duubni isaas ni qulqullaaʼaa.
english: You blind Pharisee, first clean the inside of the cup and of the platter, that its outside may become clean also.

kikuyu: “Yaa barsiistota seeraatii fi Fariisota fakkeessitoota nana, isiniif wayyoo! Isin akkuma awwaala nooraa dibame kan duubni isaa bareedaa fakkaatee keessi isaa immoo lafee namoota duʼaniitiin, xuraaʼummaa hundaanis guutamee ti.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like whitened tombs, which outwardly appear beautiful, but inwardly are full of dead men’s bones and of all uncleanness.

kikuyu: Isinis akkasuma duubaan qajeeltota fakkaattanii namootatti mulʼattu; keessi keessan garuu fakkeessuu fi hamminaan guutameera.
english: Even so you also outwardly appear righteous to men, but inwardly you are full of hypocrisy and iniquity.

kikuyu: “Yaa barsiistota seeraatii fi Fariisota fakkeessitoota nana, isiniif wayyoo! Isin raajotaaf awwaala ijaartuutii; soodduu qajeeltotaas ni bareechitu.
english: “Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you build the tombs of the prophets and decorate the tombs of the righteous,

kikuyu: Isin, ‘Nu utuu bara abbootii keenyaa sana jiraannee silaa dhiiga raajotaa dhangalaasuu keessatti isaan wajjin hin hirmaannu ture’ jettu.
english: and say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our fathers, we wouldn’t have been partakers with them in the blood of the prophets.’

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isin akka sanyii warra raajota ajjeesan sanaa taatan ofuma keessanitti dhugaa baatu.
english: Therefore you testify to yourselves that you are children of those who killed the prophets.

kikuyu: Egaa safartuu cubbuu abbootii keessanii guutaa!
english: Fill up, then, the measure of your fathers.

kikuyu: “Bofoota nana! Ijoollee buutii nana! Isin akkamitti murtii gahaannam jalaa baʼuu dandeessu?
english: You serpents, you offspring of vipers, how will you escape the judgment of Gehenna?

kikuyu: Kanaafuu, kunoo ani raajotaa fi ogeeyyii, barsiistotas gara keessanitti nan erga. Isinis isaan keessaa gartokko ni ajjeeftu; ni fanniftu; warra kaan immoo manneen sagadaa keessan keessatti garaftu; magaalaa tokko irraa gara magaalaa biraattis isaan ariitu.
english: Therefore, behold, I send to you prophets, wise men, and scribes. Some of them you will kill and crucify; and some of them you will scourge in your synagogues and persecute from city to city,

kikuyu: Kanaaf dhiiga Abeel nama qajeelaa sanaatii jalqabee hamma dhiiga Zakkaariyaas ilma Baraakiyuu isa isin mana qulqullummaatii fi iddoo aarsaa gidduutti ajjeeftaniitti, dhiiga qulqulluu lafatti dhangalaafame hundumatti ni gaafatamtu.
english: that on you may come all the righteous blood shed on the earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zachariah son of Barachiah, whom you killed between the sanctuary and the altar.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; kun hundinuu dhaloota kanatti ni dhufa.
english: Most certainly I tell you, all these things will come upon this generation.

kikuyu: “Yaa Yerusaalem, yaa Yerusaalem, ati kan raajota ajjeeftu, warra gara keetti ergamanis kan dhagaadhaan tumtu, akkuma indaanqoon cuucii ishee qoochoo ishee jalatti walitti qabattu sana anis ijoollee kee walitti qabuuf yeroo meeqan hawwe! Isin garuu hin barbaanne.
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I would have gathered your children together, even as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you would not!

kikuyu: Kunoo, manni keessan onee isinii hafa.
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate.

kikuyu: Ani isinittin himaatii; isin hamma, ‘Inni maqaa Gooftaatiin dhufu sun eebbifamaa dha’ jettanitti lammata na hin argitan.”
english: For I tell you, you will not see me from now on, until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuus mana qulqullummaatii baʼee deemaa jiruu barattoonni isaa gamoowwan mana qulqullummaa isatti argisiisuuf gara isaa dhufan.
english: Jesus went out from the temple, and was going on his way. His disciples came to him to show him the buildings of the temple.

kikuyu: Innis, “Waan kana hunda argituu? Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; asitti dhagaan dhagaa irratti hafu tokko hin jiru; hundi isaa iyyuu ni diigama” jedhee deebiseef.
english: But he answered them, “You see all of these things, don’t you? Most certainly I tell you, there will not be left here one stone on another, that will not be thrown down.”

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuus Tulluu Ejersaa irra taaʼee jiruu, barattoonni isaa kophaa isaanii gara isaa dhufanii, “Mee nutti himi; wanni kun yoom taʼa? Mallattoon dhufa keetii fi mallattoon dhuma barichaa maali?” jedhan.
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately, saying, “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign of your coming, and of the end of the age?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Akka namni tokko iyyuu isin hin gowwoomsineef of eeggadhaa.
english: Jesus answered them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

kikuyu: Namoonni hedduun, ‘Ani Kiristoos’ jedhanii maqaa kootiin ni dhufuutii; nama hedduus ni gowwoomsu.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am the Christ,’ and will lead many astray.

kikuyu: Isin waaʼee waraanaatii fi oduu waraanaa ni dhageessu; garuu akka hin rifanne of eeggadhaa. Wanni akkanaa taʼuu qabaatii; dhumni garuu amma iyyuu hin geenye.
english: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars. See that you aren’t troubled, for all this must happen, but the end is not yet.

kikuyu: Sabni sabatti, mootummaanis mootummaatti ni kaʼa. Beellii fi sochiin lafaa iddoo garaa garaatti ni taʼa.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes in various places.

kikuyu: Garuu kun hundinuu jalqaba ciniinsuu daʼumsaa ti.
english: But all these things are the beginning of birth pains.

kikuyu: “Isaan dabarsanii dhiphinatti isin kennu; isin ajjeesus; sababii maqaa kootiifis saba hundaan ni jibbamtu.
english: “Then they will deliver you up to oppression and will kill you. You will be hated by all of the nations for my name’s sake.

kikuyu: Yeroo sanatti namoonni baayʼeen ni gufatu; dabarsanii wal kennu; wal jibbus;
english: Then many will stumble, and will deliver up one another, and will hate one another.

kikuyu: raajonni sobaa hedduun ni dhufu; nama hedduus ni gowwoomsu.
english: Many false prophets will arise and will lead many astray.

kikuyu: Sababii baayʼina hamminaatiif jaalalli namoota baayʼee ni qabbanaaʼa;
english: Because iniquity will be multiplied, the love of many will grow cold.

kikuyu: namni hamma dhumaatti jabaatee dhaabatu garuu ni fayya.
english: But he who endures to the end will be saved.

kikuyu: Wangeelli mootummaa kunis akka saba hundaaf dhuga baʼumsa taʼuuf addunyaa hunda keessatti ni lallabama; ergasiis dhumni sun ni dhufa.
english: This Good News of the Kingdom will be preached in the whole world for a testimony to all the nations, and then the end will come.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu, ‘Isin yommuu wanni jibbisiisaan badiisa fidu’kan Daaniʼel raajichi waaʼee isaa dubbate sun iddoo qulqulluu dhaabatee argitanitti, namni dubbisu haa hubatu;
