english: “When, therefore, you see the abomination of desolation, which was spoken of through Daniel the prophet, standing in the holy place (let the reader understand),

kikuyu: yommus warri Yihuudaa keessa jiran tulluuwwanitti haa baqatan.
english: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.

kikuyu: Namni bantii manaa irra jiru tokko iyyuu waan tokko illee mana isaatii fudhachuuf gad hin buʼin.
english: Let him who is on the housetop not go down to take out the things that are in his house.

kikuyu: Namni lafa qotiisaa keessa jiru tokko iyyuu uffata isaa fudhachuuf duubatti hin deebiʼin.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to get his clothes.

kikuyu: Bara sana keessa dubartoota ulfaatii fi haadhota hoosisaniif wayyoo!
english: But woe to those who are with child and to nursing mothers in those days!

kikuyu: Garuu akka baqachuun keessan ganna keessa yookaan Guyyaa Sanbataatiin hin taaneef kadhadhaa.
english: Pray that your flight will not be in the winter nor on a Sabbath,

kikuyu: Yeroo sanatti dhiphinni guddaan isaa ni dhufaatii; dhiphinni akkasiis uumama addunyaatii jalqabee hamma ammaatti hin dhufne; siʼachis gonkumaa hin dhufu.
english: for then there will be great suffering, such as has not been from the beginning of the world until now, no, nor ever will be.

kikuyu: “Utuu guyyoonni sun gabaabbachuu baatanii silaa namni tokko iyyuu hin hafu ture; garuu sababii filatamtootaatiif guyyoonni sun ni gabaabbatu.
english: Unless those days had been shortened, no flesh would have been saved. But for the sake of the chosen ones, those days will be shortened.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana yoo namni kam iyyuu, ‘Ilaa, Kiristoos as jira!’ yookaan ‘Achi jira!’ isiniin jedhe, hin amaninaa.
english: “Then if any man tells you, ‘Behold, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘There!’ don’t believe it.

kikuyu: Kiristoosonni sobaatii fi raajonni sobaa ni kaʼuutii; isaanis yoo dandaʼameef filatamtoota illee gowwoomsuuf jedhanii mallattoo gurguddaa fi dinqii ni hojjetu.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise, and they will show great signs and wonders, so as to lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

kikuyu: Kunoo ani duraan dursee isinitti himeera.
english: “Behold, I have told you beforehand.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu yoo isaan, ‘Kuunnoo, inni gammoojjii keessa jira’ isiniin jedhan achi hin dhaqinaa; yookaan yoo isaan, ‘Kunoo, mana keessa gola jira’ isiniin jedhan hin amaninaa.
english: “If therefore they tell you, ‘Behold, he is in the wilderness,’ don’t go out; or ‘Behold, he is in the inner rooms,’ don’t believe it.

kikuyu: Akkuma bakakkaan baʼa biiftuutii buʼee hamma lixa biiftuutti mulʼatu sana dhufaatiin Ilma Namaas akkasuma taʼa.
english: For as the lightning flashes from the east, and is seen even to the west, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

kikuyu: Iddoo raqni jiru kamitti iyyuu gogocorroowwan walitti qabamu.
english: For wherever the carcass is, that is where the vultures gather together.

kikuyu: “Akkuma dhiphinni bara sanaa darbeen, “ ‘Aduun ni dukkanoofti; jiʼis ifa ishee hin kennitu; urjiiwwan samii irraa ni harcaʼu; humnoonni samiis ni raafamu.’
english: “But immediately after the suffering of those days, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light, the stars will fall from the sky, and the powers of the heavens will be shaken;

kikuyu: “Ergasii mallattoon Ilma Namaa samii irratti ni mulʼata; saboonni addunyaa hundinuus ni booʼu. Isaanis utuu Ilmi Namaa duumessa samiitiin humnaa fi ulfina guddaadhaan dhufuu ni argu.
english: and then the sign of the Son of Man will appear in the sky. Then all the tribes of the earth will mourn, and they will see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of the sky with power and great glory.

kikuyu: Innis ergamoota isaa sagalee malakataa guddaa isaatiin erga; isaanis filatamtoota isaa kanneen handaara samiiwwanii tokko irraa hamma isa kaaniitti jiran bubbeewwan afran irraa walitti qabu.
english: He will send out his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from one end of the sky to the other.

kikuyu: “Fakkeenya kana muka harbuu irraa baradhaa; yommuu dameen isaa latee baala baafatutti akka bonni dhiʼaate ni beektu.
english: “Now from the fig tree learn this parable: When its branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near.

kikuyu: Akkasuma isinis yommuu waan kana hunda argitanitti akka inni dhiʼaate, akka balbala irras gaʼe ni beektu.
english: Even so you also, when you see all these things, know that he is near, even at the doors.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; hamma wanni kun hundi taʼutti dhaloonni kun hin darbu.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all these things are accomplished.

kikuyu: Samii fi lafti ni darbu; dubbiin koo garuu gonkumaa hin darbu.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

kikuyu: “Waaʼee guyyaa sanaa yookaan waaʼee saʼaatii sanaa garuu Abbaa qofatu beeka malee namni tokko iyyuu hin beeku; ergamoonni samii irraa iyyuu hin beekan; yookaan Ilmi iyyuu hin beeku.
english: “But no one knows of that day and hour, not even the angels of heaven, but my Father only.

kikuyu: Akkuma bara Nohi taʼe sana yeroo dhufaatii Ilma Namaattis akkasuma ni taʼa.
english: As the days of Noah were, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

kikuyu: Bara bishaan badiisaatiin dura ture sana, hamma gaafa Nohi doonii seeneetti namoonni nyaachaa, dhugaa, fuudhaa, heerumaas turaniitii.
english: For as in those days which were before the flood they were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, until the day that Noah entered into the ship,

kikuyu: Isaanis hamma bishaan badiisaa dhufee hunda isaanii fudhatetti waan dhufuuf jiru hin beekne. Yeroo Ilmi Namaa dhufuttis akkasuma taʼa.
english: and they didn’t know until the flood came and took them all away, so will the coming of the Son of Man be.

kikuyu: Gaafas namoonni lama lafa qotiisaa keessa hojjetu; inni tokko ni fudhatama; kaan immoo ni hafa.
english: Then two men will be in the field: one will be taken and one will be left.

kikuyu: Dubartoonni lama dhagaa daakuutiin daaku; tokko ni fudhatamti; kaan immoo ni hafti.
english: Two women will be grinding at the mill: one will be taken and one will be left.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu isin dammaqaa; Gooftaan keessan guyyaa kam akka dhufu hin beektaniitii.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know in what hour your Lord comes.

kikuyu: Garuu waan kana hubadhaa: Abbichi manaa utuu yeroo kamitti akka hattuun dhuftu beekee silaa dammaqee eeggata malee akka manni isaa cabsamee seenamu itti hin dhiisu ture.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what watch of the night the thief was coming, he would have watched, and would not have allowed his house to be broken into.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isinis akkasuma qophaaʼuu qabdu; Ilmi Namaa saʼaatii isin hin eegnetti dhufaatii.
english: Therefore also be ready, for in an hour that you don’t expect, the Son of Man will come.

kikuyu: “Egaa garbichi amanamaa fi ogeessi kan gooftaan isaa akka inni nyaata isaanii yeroo malutti isaanii kennuuf jedhee garboota mana isaa jiraatan irratti isa muudu eenyu?
english: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom his lord has set over his household, to give them their food in due season?

kikuyu: Garbichi gooftaan isaa yommuu deebiʼutti utuu inni akkasuma hojjetuu isa argu sun eebbifamaa dha.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord finds doing so when he comes.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguma isinitti nan hima; inni qabeenya isaa hunda irratti isa muuda.
english: Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

kikuyu: Garbichi sun garuu yoo hamaa taʼe, ‘Gooftaan koo yeroo dheeraa tura’ ofiin jedhee
english: But if that evil servant should say in his heart, ‘My lord is delaying his coming,’

kikuyu: garboota isa wajjin tajaajilan tumuu, machooftota wajjin immoo nyaachuu fi dhuguu jalqaba.
english: and begins to beat his fellow servants, and eat and drink with the drunkards,

kikuyu: Gooftaan garbicha sanaa guyyaa inni isa hin eegnee fi saʼaatii inni hin beeknetti ni dhufa.
english: the lord of that servant will come in a day when he doesn’t expect it and in an hour when he doesn’t know it,

kikuyu: Innis isa kukkuta; fakkeessitoota keessattis isa ramada; achittis booʼichaa fi ilkaan qaruutu taʼa.
english: and will cut him in pieces and appoint his portion with the hypocrites. That is where the weeping and grinding of teeth will be.

kikuyu: “Yeroo sanatti mootummaan samii dubarran kudhan kanneen ibsaa isaanii fudhatanii misirricha simachuudhaaf gad baʼan fakkaata.
english: “Then the Kingdom of Heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaas shan gowwoota, shan immoo ogeeyyii turan.
english: Five of them were foolish, and five were wise.

kikuyu: Warri gowwoonni ibsaa isaanii fudhatan malee zayitii hin fudhanne.
english: Those who were foolish, when they took their lamps, took no oil with them,

kikuyu: Warri ogeeyyiin garuu ibsaa isaanii wajjin zayitii qodaatti qabatanii turan.
english: but the wise took oil in their vessels with their lamps.

kikuyu: Misirrichi sun turraan hundumti isaanii mugan; ni rafanis.
english: Now while the bridegroom delayed, they all slumbered and slept.

kikuyu: “Halkan walakkaattis sagaleen guddaan, ‘Kunoo, misirrichi dhufeera! Baʼaatii isa simadhaa!’ jedhu tokko dhagaʼame.
english: But at midnight there was a cry, ‘Behold! The bridegroom is coming! Come out to meet him!’

kikuyu: “Dubarri sun hundinuus kaʼanii ibsaa isaanii qopheeffatan.
english: Then all those virgins arose, and trimmed their lamps.

kikuyu: Warri gowwoonni sun warra ogeeyyiidhaan, ‘Ibsaan keenya nu duraa dhaamuutti jiraatii zayitii keessan irraa xinnoo nuu kennaa’ jedhan.
english: The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’

kikuyu: “Warri ogeeyyiinis deebisanii, ‘Hin kenninu; tarii wanni nuu fi isin gaʼu hin jiru taʼaatii. Qooda kanaa warra gurguran bira dhaqaatii ofii keessaniif bitadhaa’ jedhaniin.
english: But the wise answered, saying, ‘What if there isn’t enough for us and you? You go rather to those who sell, and buy for yourselves.’

kikuyu: “Garuu utuma isaan zayitii bitachuu dhaquutti jiranuu misirrichi dhufe. Dubarri qophaaʼanis isa wajjin galma cidha fuudhaatti ol galan. Balballis ni cufame.
english: While they went away to buy, the bridegroom came, and those who were ready went in with him to the wedding feast, and the door was shut.

kikuyu: “Ergasii dubarran kaanis dhufanii, ‘Yaa Gooftaa, yaa Gooftaa, balbala nuuf bani!’ jedhaniin.
english: Afterward the other virgins also came, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us.’

kikuyu: “Inni garuu deebisee, ‘Dhuguman isinitti hima; ani isin hin beeku’ jedheen.
english: But he answered, ‘Most certainly I tell you, I don’t know you.’

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu isin sababii guyyaa sana yookaan saʼaatii sana hin beekneef dammaqaa.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know the day nor the hour in which the Son of Man is coming.

kikuyu: “Ammas mootummaan samii nama biyya fagoo dhaqu tokko fakkaata; namichis garboota isaa waamee qabeenya isaa imaanaa itti kennate.
english: “For it is like a man going into another country, who called his own servants and entrusted his goods to them.

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo isaaniittis akkuma dandeettii isaaniitti, isa tokkotti taalaantii shan, isa kaanitti taalaantii lama, isa kaanitti immoo taalaantii tokko kennee kaʼee deeme.
english: To one he gave five talents, to another two, to another one, to each according to his own ability. Then he went on his journey.

kikuyu: Namichi taalaantii shan fudhate sun, yeroodhuma sana dhaqee ittiin daldalee taalaantii biraa shan irraa buufate.
english: Immediately he who received the five talents went and traded with them, and made another five talents.

kikuyu: Inni taalaantii lama fudhates akkasuma taalaantii biraa lama irraa buufate.
english: In the same way, he also who got the two gained another two.

kikuyu: Namichi taalaantii tokko fudhate garuu dhaqee lafa qotee maallaqa gooftaa isaa dhokse.
english: But he who received the one talent went away and dug in the earth and hid his lord’s money.

kikuyu: “Yeroo dheeraa booddee gooftaan garboota sanaa deebiʼee herrega isaan bira jiru herregate.
english: “Now after a long time the lord of those servants came, and settled accounts with them.

kikuyu: Namichi taalaantii shan fudhatee ture sun taalaantii biraa shan fidee, ‘Yaa gooftaa, ati taalaantii shan imaanaa natti kennitee turte. Ani immoo kunoo, taalaantii shan irraa buufadheera’ jedheen.
english: He who received the five talents came and brought another five talents, saying, ‘Lord, you delivered to me five talents. Behold, I have gained another five talents in addition to them.’

kikuyu: “Gooftaan isaas deebisee, ‘Yaa garbicha gaarii fi amanamaa, waan gaarii hojjette! Ati waan akka malee xinnoo irratti amanamaa taateerta; ani immoo waan baayʼee irratti sin muuda. Kottuutii gammachuu gooftaa keetiitti gali!’ jedheen.
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things, I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

kikuyu: “Namichi taalaantii lama fudhatee tures dhufee, ‘Yaa gooftaa, ati taalaantii lama imaanaa natti kennitee turte; ani immoo kunoo, taalaantii biraa lama irraa buufadheera’ jedheen.
english: “He also who got the two talents came and said, ‘Lord, you delivered to me two talents. Behold, I have gained another two talents in addition to them.’

kikuyu: “Gooftaan isaas deebisee, ‘Yaa garbicha gaarii fi amanamaa, waan gaarii hojjette! Ati waan xinnoo irratti amanamaa taateerta; ani immoo waan baayʼee irratti sin muuda. Kottuutii gammachuu gooftaa keetiitti gali!’ jedheen.
english: “His lord said to him, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant. You have been faithful over a few things. I will set you over many things. Enter into the joy of your lord.’

kikuyu: “Namichi taalaantii tokkicha fudhatee tures dhufee akkana jedhe; ‘Yaa gooftaa, ati nama gara jabeessa iddoo itti hin facaasinii galfattu, iddoo itti hin bittinneessiniis walitti qabattu akka taate nan beeka.
english: “He also who had received the one talent came and said, ‘Lord, I knew you that you are a hard man, reaping where you didn’t sow, and gathering where you didn’t scatter.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani sodaadhee dhaqeen taalaantii kee lafa keessa dhokse. Taalaantiin kee kunoo ti.’
english: I was afraid, and went away and hid your talent in the earth. Behold, you have what is yours.’

kikuyu: “Gooftaan isaas deebisee akkana jedhe; ‘Yaa garbicha hamaa dhibaaʼaa! Ati akka ani iddoon itti hin facaasinii galfadhu, iddoon itti hin bittinneessiniis walitti qabadhu beektaa?
english: “But his lord answered him, ‘You wicked and slothful servant. You knew that I reap where I didn’t sow, and gather where I didn’t scatter.

kikuyu: Yoos akka ani yommuun deebiʼutti dhala isaa wajjin fudhadhuuf silaa maallaqa koo warra baankii bira naa kaaʼuu qabda ture.
english: You ought therefore to have deposited my money with the bankers, and at my coming I should have received back my own with interest.

kikuyu: “ ‘Kanaaf taalaanticha isa harkaa fuudhaatii namicha taalaantii kudhan qabuuf kennaa.
english: Take away therefore the talent from him and give it to him who has the ten talents.

kikuyu: Kan qabu kamiif iyyuu itti dabalamee ni kennama; irraa hafaas ni qabaataatii. Kan hin qabne garuu wanni inni qabu iyyuu irraa fudhatama.
english: For to everyone who has will be given, and he will have abundance, but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away.

kikuyu: Garbicha faayidaa hin qabne kana dukkana alaatti gad darbadhaa; achittis booʼichaa fi ilkaan qaruutu taʼa.’
english: Throw out the unprofitable servant into the outer darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’

kikuyu: “Ilmi Namaa yommuu ulfina isaatiin ergamoota Waaqaa hunda wajjin dhufutti, teessoo isaa kan ulfinaa irra ni taaʼa.
english: “But when the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then he will sit on the throne of his glory.

kikuyu: Saboonni hundinuu fuula isaa duratti walitti qabamu; innis akkuma tikseen tokko hoolotaa fi reʼoota gargar footu sana namoota gargar ni foʼa.
english: Before him all the nations will be gathered, and he will separate them one from another, as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.

kikuyu: Inni hoolota karaa mirga isaa, reʼoota immoo karaa bitaa isaa ni dhaabachiisa.
english: He will set the sheep on his right hand, but the goats on the left.

kikuyu: “Yeroo sana Mootichi warra mirga isaa jiraniin akkana jedha; ‘Isin warri Abbaan koo eebbise kottaa mootumicha uumamuu addunyaatii jalqabee isinii qopheeffame sana dhaalaa.
english: Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from the foundation of the world;

kikuyu: Sababiin isaas ani beelofnaan isin nyaata naaf kennitan; dheebonnaan waan ani dhugu naaf kennitan; ani keessummaan ture; isin immoo na simattan;
english: for I was hungry and you gave me food to eat. I was thirsty and you gave me drink. I was a stranger and you took me in.

kikuyu: ani daarraan daara na baaftan; dhukkubsannaan na gaafattan; hidhamnaan dhuftanii na ilaaltan.’
english: I was naked and you clothed me. I was sick and you visited me. I was in prison and you came to me.’

kikuyu: “Qajeeltonni sunis deebisanii akkana jedhaniin; ‘Yaa Gooftaa, yoom beeloftee si arginee waan ati nyaattu siif kennine? Yookaan yoom dheebottee si arginee waan ati dhugdu siif kennine?
english: “Then the righteous will answer him, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you a drink?

kikuyu: Yoom keessummaa taʼuu kee arginee si simanne? Yookaan yoom daartee si arginee daara si baafne?
english: When did we see you as a stranger and take you in, or naked and clothe you?

kikuyu: Yoom dhukkubsattee yookaan hidhamtee si arginee dhufnee si ilaalle?’
english: When did we see you sick or in prison and come to you?’

kikuyu: “Mootiin sunis deebisee, ‘Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; waan obboloota koo warra nama hundumaa gad taʼan kanneen keessaa isa tokkoof gootan kam iyyuu naaf gootan’ jedhaan.
english: “The King will answer them, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you did it to one of the least of these my brothers, you did it to me.’

kikuyu: “Ergasiis warra bitaa isaa jiraniin akkana jedha; ‘Isin yaa abaaramoo, na duraa badaatii ibidda bara baraa isa diiyaabiloosii fi ergamoota isaatiif qopheeffametti galaa.
english: Then he will say also to those on the left hand, ‘Depart from me, you cursed, into the eternal fire which is prepared for the devil and his angels;

kikuyu: Ani beelofnaan isin waan ani nyaadhu naaf hin kennineetii; ani dheebonnaan waan ani dhugu naaf hin kennineetii;
english: for I was hungry, and you didn’t give me food to eat; I was thirsty, and you gave me no drink;

kikuyu: ani keessummaan ture; isin na hin simanne; ani daarraan isin daara na hin baafne; dhukkubsannaan yookaan hidhamnaan dhuftanii na hin ilaalle.’
english: I was a stranger, and you didn’t take me in; naked, and you didn’t clothe me; sick, and in prison, and you didn’t visit me.’

kikuyu: “Isaanis, ‘Yaa Gooftaa, ati yoom beeloftee yookaan dheebottee yookaan keessummaa taatee yookaan daartee yookaan dhukkubsattee yookaan hidhamtee si arginee si gargaaruu didne?’ jedhanii deebisu.
english: “Then they will also answer, saying, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry, or thirsty, or a stranger, or naked, or sick, or in prison, and didn’t help you?’

kikuyu: “Innis deebisee, ‘Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; waan obboloota koo warra nama hundaa gad taʼan kanneen keessaa isa tokkoof hin godhin naafis hin goone’ jedha.
english: “Then he will answer them, saying, ‘Most certainly I tell you, because you didn’t do it to one of the least of these, you didn’t do it to me.’

kikuyu: “Isaan kunneen adabbii bara baraatti, qajeeltonni immoo jireenya bara baraatti galu.”
english: These will go away into eternal punishment, but the righteous into eternal life.”

kikuyu: Yesuus erga waan kana hunda dubbatee raawwatee booddee barattoota isaatiin akkana jedhe;
english: When Jesus had finished all these words, he said to his disciples,

kikuyu: “Akkuma isin beektan Faasiikaaf guyyaa lamatu hafa; Ilmi Namaas fannifamuuf dabarfamee ni kennama.”
english: “You know that after two days the Passover is coming, and the Son of Man will be delivered up to be crucified.”

kikuyu: Ergasii luboonni hangafoonnii fi maanguddoonni uummataa dallaa luba ol aanaa isa Qayyaaffaa jedhamuu keessatti walitti qabaman.
english: Then the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders of the people were gathered together in the court of the high priest, who was called Caiaphas.

kikuyu: Isaanis haxxummaadhaan Yesuusin qabuu fi ajjeesuuf mariʼatan.
english: They took counsel together that they might take Jesus by deceit and kill him.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Garuu akka namoota gidduutti gooliin hin kaaneef yeroo ayyaanaatti hin taʼin” jedhan.
english: But they said, “Not during the feast, lest a riot occur among the people.”

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuus Biitaaniyaa keessa mana Simoon isa lamxaaʼaa sanaa jiruu,
english: Now when Jesus was in Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper,

kikuyu: dubartiin tokko shittoo gatiin isaa akka malee guddaa taʼe bilqaaxxii albaasxiroositti qabattee gara isaa dhufte; akkuma inni maaddiitti dhiʼaateenis shittoo sana mataa isaatti dhangalaafte.
english: a woman came to him having an alabaster jar of very expensive ointment, and she poured it on his head as he sat at the table.

kikuyu: Barattoonnis yommuu waan kana arganitti aaranii akkana jedhan; “Waan kana balleessuun maaliif?
english: But when his disciples saw this, they were indignant, saying, “Why this waste?

kikuyu: Silaa shittoon kun gatii guddaatti gurguramee maallaqa isaa hiyyeeyyiif kennuun ni dandaʼama tureetii.”
english: For this ointment might have been sold for much and given to the poor.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis kana hubatee akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isin maaliif dubartii kana rakkiftu? Isheen waan gaarii naaf gooteerti.
english: However, knowing this, Jesus said to them, “Why do you trouble the woman? She has done a good work for me.

kikuyu: Hiyyeeyyii yeroo hunda of biraa qabdu; ana garuu yeroo hunda of biraa hin qabdan.
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.

kikuyu: Dubartiin kun yommuu shittoo kana dhagna koo irrati dhangalaaftetti awwaalaaf na qopheessuudhaaf waan kana goote.
english: For in pouring this ointment on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; addunyaa hunda irratti, iddoo wangeelli kun itti lallabamu kamitti iyyuu wanni isheen gootes yaadannoo isheetiif ni odeeffama.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News is preached in the whole world, what this woman has done will also be spoken of as a memorial of her.”

kikuyu: Ergasiis warra Kudha Lamaan keessaa namichi Yihuudaa Keeriyotii jedhamu tokko gara luboota hangafootaa dhaqee,
english: Then one of the twelve, who was called Judas Iscariot, went to the chief priests

kikuyu: “Yoo ani isa dabarsee isinitti kenne isin maal naaf kennitu?” jedhee gaafate. Isaanis meetii soddomaan walii galan.
english: and said, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him to you?” So they weighed out for him thirty pieces of silver.

kikuyu: Yihuudaanis yeroo sanaa jalqabee Yesuusin dabarsee kennuuf haala mijaaʼaa eeggachaa ture.
english: From that time he sought opportunity to betray him.

kikuyu: Guyyaa jalqaba Ayyaana Maxinootti barattoonni gara Yesuus dhufanii, “Akka ati Faasiikaa nyaattuuf eessatti akka siif qopheessinu barbaadda?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: Now on the first day of unleavened bread, the disciples came to Jesus, saying to him, “Where do you want us to prepare for you to eat the Passover?”

kikuyu: Innis deebisee akkana jedhe; “Magaalaa seenaatii nama wayiitiin, ‘Barsiisaan, yeroon koo gaʼeera; ani barattoota koo wajjin Ayyaana Faasiikaa mana keetti nan kabaja siin jedha’ jedhaa.”
english: He said, “Go into the city to a certain person, and tell him, ‘The Teacher says, “My time is at hand. I will keep the Passover at your house with my disciples.”’”

kikuyu: Barattoonnis akkuma Yesuus isaan ajaje sana godhan; Faasiikaas ni qopheessan.
english: The disciples did as Jesus commanded them, and they prepared the Passover.

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu galgalaaʼetti warra Kudha Lamaan wajjin maaddiitti dhiʼaate.
english: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.

kikuyu: Innis utuma nyaachaa jiranuu, “Ani dhuguma isinitti nan hima; isin keessaa tokko dabarsee na kenna” jedhe.
english: As they were eating, he said, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

kikuyu: Isaanis akka malee gaddanii tokko tokkoon, “Yaa Gooftaa, na taʼinnaa laata?” jedhanii gaafachuu jalqaban.
english: They were exceedingly sorrowful, and each began to ask him, “It isn’t me, is it, Lord?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Namichi na wajjin gabatee keessa harka kaaʼee cuuphate dabarsee na kenna.
english: He answered, “He who dipped his hand with me in the dish will betray me.

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa akkuma waaʼeen isaa barreeffame sanatti ni deema. Garuu namicha dabarsee Ilma Namaa kennu sanaaf wayyoo! Inni utuu dhalachuu baatee isaaf wayya ture.”
english: The Son of Man goes even as it is written of him, but woe to that man through whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

kikuyu: Yihuudaan inni dabarsee isa kennuuf jiru sunis, “Yaa Barsiisaa, na taʼinnaa laata?” jedhe. Yesuusis, “Atuu jette kaa!” jedhee deebise.
english: Judas, who betrayed him, answered, “It isn’t me, is it, Rabbi?” He said to him, “You said it.”

kikuyu: Utuu nyaachaa jiranuus Yesuus buddeena fuudhee eebbise; caccabsees, “Fudhadhaa nyaadhaa; kun foon koo ti” jedhee barattoota isaatiif kenne.
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, gave thanks for it, and broke it. He gave to the disciples and said, “Take, eat; this is my body.”

kikuyu: Xoofoos fuudhee galata galchee isaaniif kenne; akkanas jedhe; “Hundi keessan kana irraa dhugaa.
english: He took the cup, gave thanks, and gave to them, saying, “All of you drink it,

kikuyu: Kun dhiiga koo, dhiiga kakuu haaraa kan dhiifama cubbuu namoota baayʼeetiif dhangalaafamuu dha.
english: for this is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many for the remission of sins.

kikuyu: Ani isinitti nan hima; ani hamman guyyaa isin wajjin mootummaa Abbaa koo keessatti deebiʼee dhugutti ammaa jalqabee ija wayinii kana irraa hin dhugu.”
english: But I tell you that I will not drink of this fruit of the vine from now on, until that day when I drink it anew with you in my Father’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Isaanis erga faarfannaa faarfatanii booddee Tulluu Ejersaatti qajeelan.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

kikuyu: Ergasii Yesuus akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Hundi keessan edana sababii kootiif ni gufattu; akkana jedhamee barreeffameeraatii: “ ‘Ani tiksee nan rukuta; hoolonni karra sanaas ni bittinneeffamu.’
english: Then Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’

kikuyu: Ani garuu ergan duʼaa kaʼee booddee isin dura Galiilaa nan dhaqa.”
english: But after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

kikuyu: Phexros immoo deebisee, “Yoo namni hundinuu sababii keetiif gufate iyyuu ani gonkumaa hin gufadhu” jedheen.
english: But Peter answered him, “Even if all will be made to stumble because of you, I will never be made to stumble.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo deebisee, “Ani dhuguma sitti nan hima; ati edana utuu indaanqoon hin iyyin yeroo sadii na ganta” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that tonight, before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.”

kikuyu: Phexros garuu, “Ani yoon si wajjin duʼuu qabaadhe illee gonkumaa si hin ganu” jedheen. Barattoonni hundinuus akkasuma jedhan.
english: Peter said to him, “Even if I must die with you, I will not deny you.” All of the disciples also said likewise.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Yesuus barattoota isaa wajjin iddoo Geetesemaanee jedhamu tokko dhaqe; innis, “Hamma ani achi dhaqee kadhadhutti isin as taaʼaa” jedheen.
english: Then Jesus came with them to a place called Gethsemane, and said to his disciples, “Sit here, while I go there and pray.”

kikuyu: Innis Phexrosii fi ilmaan Zabdewoos lamaan of faana fudhatee deeme; gadduu fi yaaddaʼuus jalqabe.
english: He took with him Peter and the two sons of Zebedee, and began to be sorrowful and severely troubled.

kikuyu: Ergasiis inni, “Lubbuun koo akka malee gadditee duʼuu geesseerti. Isin asuma turaatii na wajjin dammaqaa” jedheen.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch with me.”

kikuyu: Innis xinnoo achi hiiqee adda isaatiin lafatti gombifamee, “Yaa Abbaa ko, yoo dandaʼame xoofoon kun narra haa darbu. Garuu akka fedhii keetii malee akka fedhii kootii hin taʼin” jedhee kadhate.
english: He went forward a little, fell on his face, and prayed, saying, “My Father, if it is possible, let this cup pass away from me; nevertheless, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

kikuyu: Innis gara barattoota isaatti deebiʼee utuu rafanuu isaan arge. Phexrosiinis akkana jedhe; “Jarana, isin saʼaatii tokkitti illee dammaqxanii na wajjin turuu hin dandeenyee?
english: He came to the disciples and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “What, couldn’t you watch with me for one hour?

kikuyu: Isin akka qorumsatti hin galleef dammaqaa kadhadhaa. Hafuurri qophaaʼaa dha; foon garuu dadhabaa dha.”
english: Watch and pray, that you don’t enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

kikuyu: Ammas yeroo lammaffaa achi hiiqee, “Yaa Abbaa ko, xoofoon kun utuu ani hin dhugin yoo narra darbuu hin dandeenye akkuma fedhii keetii haa taʼu” jedhee kadhate.
english: Again, a second time he went away and prayed, saying, “My Father, if this cup can’t pass away from me unless I drink it, your desire be done.”

kikuyu: Inni yommuu deebiʼee dhufetti, ammas utuu rafanuu isaan arge; iji isaanii itti ulfaatee tureetii.
english: He came again and found them sleeping, for their eyes were heavy.

kikuyu: Ammas isaan dhiisee achi hiiqee waanuma kanaan dura kadhate sana irra deebiʼee yeroo sadaffaa kadhate.
english: He left them again, went away, and prayed a third time, saying the same words.

kikuyu: Innis gara barattootaatti deebiʼee akkana jedheen; “Isin amma iyyuu raftanii boqochaa jirtuu? Kunoo, saʼaatiin sun gaʼeera; Ilmi Namaas dabarfamee harka cubbamootaatti ni kennama.
english: Then he came to his disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Behold, the hour is at hand, and the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

kikuyu: Kaʼaa ni deemnaa! Kunoo, namichi dabarsee na kennu sun dhufaa jira.”
english: Arise, let’s be going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

kikuyu: Utuma inni amma iyyuu dubbachaa jiruu, Yihuudaan namichi warra Kudha Lamaan keessaa tokko taʼe sun dhufe. Tuunni luboota hangafootaa fi maanguddoota uummataa biraa ergame guddaanis goraadee fi bokkuu qabatee isa wajjin dhufe.
english: While he was still speaking, behold, Judas, one of the twelve, came, and with him a great multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests and elders of the people.

kikuyu: Inni dabarsee Yesuusin kennu sunis, “Namichi ani dhungadhu isa; isinis isa qabaa” jedhee mallattoo kenneefii ture.
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whoever I kiss, he is the one. Seize him.”

kikuyu: Yihuudaanis yommusuma Yesuusitti dhiʼaatee, “Nagumaa yaa barsiisaa!” jedhee isa dhungate.
english: Immediately he came to Jesus, and said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Yaa michuu ko, waan dhufteef sana raawwadhu kaa!” jedhe. Namoonni sun itti dhiʼaatanii Yesuusin qabanii hidhan.
english: Jesus said to him, “Friend, why are you here?” Then they came and laid hands on Jesus, and took him.

kikuyu: Kunoo, warra Yesuus wajjin turan keessaa inni tokko goraadee isaa luqqifatee garbicha luba ol aanaa dhaʼee gurra isaa irraa kute.
english: Behold, one of those who were with Jesus stretched out his hand and drew his sword, and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedheen; “Goraadee kee iddoo isaatti deebisi; warri goraadee luqqifatan hundinuu goraadeedhaan balleeffamuutii.
english: Then Jesus said to him, “Put your sword back into its place, for all those who take the sword will die by the sword.

kikuyu: Ati waan ani Abbaa kootti iyyachuu hin dandeenye, waan innis yeruma sana ergamoota Waaqaa LeegewooniiKudha Lamaa olii naa hin ergine seetaa?
english: Or do you think that I couldn’t ask my Father, and he would even now send me more than twelve legions of angels?

kikuyu: Utuu akkas taʼee immoo wanni Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluun karaa kanaan taʼuu qaba jedhan sun silaa akkamitti raawwatama ree?”
english: How then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that it must be so?”

kikuyu: Saʼaatii sanatti Yesuus tuuta sanaan akkana jedhe; “Isin goraadee fi bokkuu qabattanii akka nama hattuu qabuutti na qabuu dhuftanii? Ani guyyuma guyyaan mana qulqullummaa keessa taaʼee barsiisaan ture; isinis na hin qabne.
english: In that hour Jesus said to the multitudes, “Have you come out as against a robber with swords and clubs to seize me? I sat daily in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me.

kikuyu: Kun hundinuu garuu akka Katabbiiwwan raajotaa Qulqulluun raawwatamaniif taʼe.” Barattoonni hundinuus isa dhiisanii baqatan.
english: But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and fled.

kikuyu: Warri Yesuusin qaban sunis gara mana luba ol aanaa isa Qayyaaffaa jedhamuu iddoo barsiistonni seeraatii fi maanguddoonni itti walitti qabamaniitti isa geessan.
english: Those who had taken Jesus led him away to Caiaphas the high priest, where the scribes and the elders were gathered together.

kikuyu: Phexros garuu hamma dallaa mana lubicha ol aanaatti fagootti isa duukaa buʼe. Innis waan taʼuuf jiru arguuf jedhee ol lixee waardiyyoota wajjin taaʼe.
english: But Peter followed him from a distance to the court of the high priest, and entered in and sat with the officers, to see the end.

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonnii fi yaaʼiin Yihuudootaa guutuun Yesuusin ajjeesuuf jedhanii ragaa sobaa isatti barbaadaa turan.
english: Now the chief priests, the elders, and the whole council sought false testimony against Jesus, that they might put him to death,

kikuyu: Isaan garuu yoo dhuga baatonni sobaa hedduun dhiʼaatan illee homaa hin arganne. Dhuma irratti dhuga baatonni lama dhufanii,
english: and they found none. Even though many false witnesses came forward, they found none. But at last two false witnesses came forward

kikuyu: “Namichi kun, ‘Ani mana qulqullummaa Waaqaa diiguu, guyyaa sadii keessatti deebisee ijaaruu nan dandaʼa’ jedheera” jedhan.
english: and said, “This man said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God, and to build it in three days.’”

kikuyu: Lubichi ol aanaanis kaʼee dhaabatee, “Ati deebii tokko illee hin kennituu? Wanni namoonni kunneen dhugaa sitti baʼan kun maali?” jedhee Yesuusin gaafate.
english: The high priest stood up and said to him, “Have you no answer? What is this that these testify against you?”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu inuma calʼise. Lubichi ol aanaan, “Ani Waaqa jiraataadhaan sin kakachiisa: Ati yoo Kiristoos Ilma Waaqaa taate mee nutti himi” jedheen.
english: But Jesus stayed silent. The high priest answered him, “I adjure you by the living God that you tell us whether you are the Christ, the Son of God.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Atuu jetteerta. Ani garuu isinitti nan hima; isin siʼachi utuu Ilmi Namaa mirga isa Humna qabeessa sanaatiin taaʼee, duumessa samiitiin dhufuu ni argitu” jedhe.
english: Jesus said to him, “You have said so. Nevertheless, I tell you, after this you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming on the clouds of the sky.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti lubichi ol aanaan uffata isaa tarsaasee akkana jedhe; “Inni Waaqa arrabseera! Kana caalaa dhuga baatota maalii nu barbaachisa? Kunoo, Waaqa arrabsuu isaa isin iyyuu amma dhageessaniirtu.
english: Then the high priest tore his clothing, saying, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Behold, now you have heard his blasphemy.

kikuyu: Maal isinitti fakkaata?” Isaanis, “Duʼatu isaaf mala” jedhanii deebisan.
english: What do you think?” They answered, “He is worthy of death!”

kikuyu: Ergasii isaan fuula isaatti tufan; abootteenis isa rukutan. Warri kaan immoo isa kabalanii,
english: Then they spat in his face and beat him with their fists, and some slapped him,

kikuyu: “Yaa Kiristoos! Eenyutu si rukute? Mee raajii nutti dubbadhu” jedhaniin.
english: saying, “Prophesy to us, you Christ! Who hit you?”

kikuyu: Phexrosis dallaa keessa ala taaʼaa ture; xomboreen tokko isatti dhiʼaattee, “Atis Yesuus namicha Galiilaa sana wajjin turte!” jetteen.
english: Now Peter was sitting outside in the court, and a maid came to him, saying, “You were also with Jesus, the Galilean!”

kikuyu: Inni garuu, “Ani waan ati dubbachuutti jirtu hin beeku” jedhee hunduma isaanii duratti gane.
english: But he denied it before them all, saying, “I don’t know what you are talking about.”

kikuyu: Utuu inni gara karra dallaa sanaatti deemaa jiruus xomboreen biraa tokko isa argitee, “Namichi kun Yesuus nama Naazreeti wajjin ture” jettee warra achi turanitti himte.
english: When he had gone out onto the porch, someone else saw him and said to those who were there, “This man also was with Jesus of Nazareth.”

kikuyu: Innis kakatee, “Ani namicha kana hin beeku!” jedhee ammas gane.
english: Again he denied it with an oath, “I don’t know the man.”

kikuyu: Yeroo xinnoo booddee warri achi dhadhaabachaa turan Phexrositti dhiʼaatanii, “Atis dhuguma iyyuu jara keessaa tokkoo dha; loqodni kee si saaxilaatii” jedhan.
english: After a little while those who stood by came and said to Peter, “Surely you are also one of them, for your speech makes you known.”

kikuyu: Yommus inni, “Ani namicha kana hin beeku” jedhee of abaaruu fi kakachuu jalqabe. Yommusuma indaanqoon iyye.
english: Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Phexrosis dubbii Yesuus, “Ati utuu indaanqoon hin iyyin yeroo sadii na ganta” jedhee ture sana yaadate. Gad baʼees hiqqifatee booʼe.
english: Peter remembered the word which Jesus had said to him, “Before the rooster crows, you will deny me three times.” Then he went out and wept bitterly.

kikuyu: Ganama barii luboonni hangafoonnii fi maanguddoonni sabaa hundinuu Yesuusin ajjeesuuf walii wajjin mariʼatan.
english: Now when morning had come, all the chief priests and the elders of the people took counsel against Jesus to put him to death.

kikuyu: Isaanis isa hidhanii geessanii Phiilaaxoos bulchaatti dabarsanii kennan.
english: They bound him, led him away, and delivered him up to Pontius Pilate, the governor.

kikuyu: Yihuudaan inni Yesuusin dabarsee kenne sun yommuu akka Yesuusitti murame argetti ni gaabbe; meetii soddoma sanas luboota hangafootattii fi maanguddootatti deebise.
english: Then Judas, who betrayed him, when he saw that Jesus was condemned, felt remorse, and brought back the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and elders,

kikuyu: Innis, “Ani dhiiga qulqulluu dabarsee kennuudhaan cubbuu hojjedheera” jedhe. Isaanis deebisanii, “Maaltu nu dhibe ree? Situ itti gaafatama!” jedhaniin.
english: saying, “I have sinned in that I betrayed innocent blood.” But they said, “What is that to us? You see to it.”

kikuyu: Yihuudaanis meetii sana mana qulqullummaa keessatti gatee gad baʼe; dhaqees of fannise.
english: He threw down the pieces of silver in the sanctuary and departed. Then he went away and hanged himself.

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonnis meetii sana fuudhanii, “Meetiin kun waan gatii dhiigaa taʼeef meetii mana qulqullummaatti dabaluun seera miti” jedhan.
english: The chief priests took the pieces of silver and said, “It’s not lawful to put them into the treasury, since it is the price of blood.”

kikuyu: Isaanis walii wajjin mariʼatanii akka namoota biyya ormaatiif iddoo awwaalaa taʼuuf meetii sanaan lafa namicha suphee dhaʼu tokkoo bitan.
english: They took counsel, and bought the potter’s field with them to bury strangers in.

kikuyu: Kanaaf lafti sun hamma harʼaatti, “Lafa Dhiigaa” jedhamee waamama.
english: Therefore that field has been called “The Field of Blood” to this day.

kikuyu: Kanaanis wanni Ermiyaas raajichi dubbate sun ni raawwatame: Innis akkana jedha; “Isaan meetii soddomman, gatii isaa kan ijoolleen Israaʼel isatti shallagan sana fuudhanii,
english: Then that which was spoken through Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled, saying, “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price of him upon whom a price had been set, whom some of the children of Israel priced,

kikuyu: akkuma Gooftaan na ajajetti lafa namicha suphee dhaʼu sanaa ittiin bitan.”
english: and they gave them for the potter’s field, as the Lord commanded me.”

kikuyu: Yeroo sanatti Yesuus fuula bulchaa dura dhaabate; bulchaan sunis, “Ati mootii Yihuudootaatii?” jedhee isa gaafate. Yesuus immoo, “Atuu jette kaa!” jedhee deebise.
english: Now Jesus stood before the governor; and the governor asked him, saying, “Are you the King of the Jews?” Jesus said to him, “So you say.”

kikuyu: Inni yeroo luboonni hangafoonnii fi maanguddoonni isa himatanittis deebii tokko illee hin kennine.
english: When he was accused by the chief priests and elders, he answered nothing.

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis, “Ati akka isaan waan meeqa sirratti dhugaa baʼan hin dhageessuu?” jedhee isa gaafate.
english: Then Pilate said to him, “Don’t you hear how many things they testify against you?”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu himata tokkoof illee deebii tokko iyyuu hin kennine; bulchaan sunis akka malee waan kana dinqisiifate.
english: He gave him no answer, not even one word, so that the governor marveled greatly.

kikuyu: Bulchaan sun nama hidhame tokko ayyaanaan akkuma fedhii sabaatti gad dhiisuu bartee godhatee ture.
english: Now at the feast the governor was accustomed to release to the multitude one prisoner whom they desired.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana namichi Barabbaas jedhamu beekamaan tokko hidhamee ture.
english: They had then a notable prisoner called Barabbas.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yommuu isaan walitti qabamanitti Phiilaaxoos, “Akka ani isa kam gad isinii dhiisu barbaaddu? Barabbaas moo Yesuus isa Kiristoos jedhamu sana?” jedhee isaan gaafate.
english: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or Jesus who is called Christ?”

kikuyu: Akka isaan hinaaffaadhaan Yesuusin dabarsanii isatti kennan ni beeka tureetii.
english: For he knew that because of envy they had delivered him up.

kikuyu: Utuu Phiilaaxoos barcuma murtii irra taaʼuu niitiin isaa, “Namicha qajeelaa sana hin tuqin; ani eda sababii isaatiif abjuudhaan akka malee dhiphadheeraatii” jettee itti dhaamte.
english: While he was sitting on the judgment seat, his wife sent to him, saying, “Have nothing to do with that righteous man, for I have suffered many things today in a dream because of him.”

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonnii fi maanguddoonni garuu akka Barabbaas gad dhiifamee, Yesuus immoo ajjeefamu akka isa kadhataniif namoota sossoban.
english: Now the chief priests and the elders persuaded the multitudes to ask for Barabbas and destroy Jesus.

kikuyu: Bulchaan sun, “Isaan lamaan kanneen keessaa akka ani isa kam gad isinii dhiisu barbaaddu?” jedhee ammas gaafate. Isaanis, “Barabbaasin” jedhanii deebisan.
english: But the governor answered them, “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” They said, “Barabbas!”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis, “Yesuus isa Kiristoos jedhamu immoo ani maal godhu ree?” jedhee gaafate. Hundi isaaniis, “Isa fannisi!” jedhanii deebisan.
english: Pilate said to them, “What then shall I do to Jesus who is called Christ?” They all said to him, “Let him be crucified!”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoos immoo, “Maaliif? Inni yakka maalii hojjete?” jedhee gaafate. Isaan garuu ittuma caalchisanii, “Isa fannisi!” jedhanii iyyan.
english: But the governor said, “Why? What evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, saying, “Let him be crucified!”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoos yommuu akka wanni kun goolii kaasuu malee faayidaa tokko illee hin qabne argetti, “Ani dhiiga nama kanaa irraa qulqulluu dha; isintu itti gaafatama!” jedhee bishaan fudhatee fuula namootaa duratti harka isaa dhiqate.
english: So when Pilate saw that nothing was being gained, but rather that a disturbance was starting, he took water and washed his hands before the multitude, saying, “I am innocent of the blood of this righteous person. You see to it.”

kikuyu: Namoonni hundinuus, “Dhiigni isaa nuu fi ijoollee keenya irra haa gaʼu!” jedhanii deebisan.
english: All the people answered, “May his blood be on us and on our children!”

kikuyu: Ergasii inni Barabbaasin gad isaaniif dhiise. Yesuusin garuu garafsiisee akka inni fannifamuuf dabarsee kenne.
english: Then he released Barabbas to them, but Jesus he flogged and delivered to be crucified.

kikuyu: Ergasii loltoonni bulchaa sanaa Yesuusin mana bulchaatti ol galchan; raayyaa loltootaa hundas naannoo Yesuusitti walitti qaban.
english: Then the governor’s soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium, and gathered the whole garrison together against him.

kikuyu: Isaanis uffata isaa irraa baasanii uffata bildiimaa itti uffisan;
english: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him.

kikuyu: gonfoo qoraattii micciiranii dhaʼanii mataa isaa irra kaaʼan. Harka isaa mirgaa keessas ulee kaaʼan. Fuula isaa durattis jilbeenfatanii, “Akkam ree, yaa mootii Yihuudootaa!” jedhanii isatti qoosan.
english: They braided a crown of thorns and put it on his head, and a reed in his right hand; and they kneeled down before him and mocked him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

kikuyu: Isaanis isatti tufan; ulee sanas fuudhanii mataa isaa rukutan.
english: They spat on him, and took the reed and struck him on the head.

kikuyu: Erga itti qoosanii booddee uffata sana irraa baasanii wayyaa isaa deebisanii isatti uffisan. Fannisuufis isa fuudhanii deeman.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the robe off him, and put his clothes on him, and led him away to crucify him.

kikuyu: Utuu gad baʼanuus namicha Qareenaa kan Simoon jedhamu tokko arganii akka inni fannoo sana baatuuf isa dirqisiisan.
english: As they came out, they found a man of Cyrene, Simon by name, and they compelled him to go with them, that he might carry his cross.

kikuyu: Isaanis iddoo Golgootaa jedhamu gaʼan; Golgootaa jechuun “Iddoo buqqee mataa” jechuu dha.
english: When they came to a place called “Golgotha”, that is to say, “The place of a skull,”

kikuyu: Achittis akka inni dhuguuf daadhii wayinii kan hadhooftuun itti makame kennaniif; inni garuu afaaniin qabee dhuguu dide.
english: they gave him sour wine to drink mixed with gall. When he had tasted it, he would not drink.

kikuyu: Isaanis erga isa fannisanii booddee ixaa buufatanii uffata isaa gargar qooddatan.
english: When they had crucified him, they divided his clothing among them, casting lots,

kikuyu: Isaanis achi taaʼanii isa eegaa turan.
english: and they sat and watched him there.

kikuyu: Katabbiin waan inni ittiin himatamees mataa isaatii ol kaaʼamee ture; katabbiin sunis, Kun Yesuus Mooticha Yihuudootaa ti, jedha.
english: They set up over his head the accusation against him written, “THIS IS JESUS, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Hattoonni lamas, inni tokko mirga isaatiin, kaan immoo bitaa isaatiin isa wajjin fannifaman.
english: Then there were two robbers crucified with him, one on his right hand and one on the left.

kikuyu: Warri achiin darbanis isa arrabsan; mataa isaaniis raasanii,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads

kikuyu: “Ati kan mana qulqullummaa diigdee guyyaa sadiitti ijaartu, mee of oolchi! Ati yoo Ilma Waaqaa taate fannoo irraa gad buʼi!” jedhan.
english: and saying, “You who destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! If you are the Son of God, come down from the cross!”

kikuyu: Akkasumas luboonni hangafoonni, barsiistonni seeraatii fi maanguddoonni isatti qoosan. Akkanas jedhan;
english: Likewise the chief priests also mocking with the scribes, the Pharisees, and the elders, said,

kikuyu: “Inni warra kaan oolcheera; ofii isaa garuu oolchuu hin dandaʼu! Inni yoo mootii Israaʼel taʼe amma fannoo irraa gad haa buʼu; nuus isatti ni amannaatii.
english: “He saved others, but he can’t save himself. If he is the King of Israel, let him come down from the cross now, and we will believe in him.

kikuyu: Inni Waaqa amanata; Waaqni yoo isa jaallate, mee amma isa haa oolchu; inni, ‘Ani Ilma Waaqaa ti’ jedheeraatii.”
english: He trusts in God. Let God deliver him now, if he wants him; for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’”

kikuyu: Akkasuma hattoonni isa wajjin fannifamanis isa arrabsan.
english: The robbers also who were crucified with him cast on him the same reproach.

kikuyu: Saʼaatii jaʼaa jalqabee hamma saʼaatii sagaliitti dukkanni lafa hunda irra buʼe.
english: Now from the sixth hour there was darkness over all the land until the ninth hour.

kikuyu: Gara Saʼaatii sagaliitti Yesuus sagalee guddaadhaan, “Eloohee, Eloohee,laamaa sabaqtaanii?” jedhee iyye; hiikkaan isaas, “Yaa Waaqa ko, yaa Waaqa ko, ati maaliif na dhiifte?” jechuu dha.
english: About the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eli, Eli, lima sabachthani?” That is, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

kikuyu: Warra achi dhadhaabatan keessaa tokko tokko yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti, “Namichi kun Eeliyaasin waama” jedhan.
english: Some of them who stood there, when they heard it, said, “This man is calling Elijah.”

kikuyu: Yommusuma isaan keessaa namichi tokko fiigee dhaqee ispoonjii daadhii wayinii dhangaggaaʼaadhaan guutee, uleetti kaaʼe; akka inni dhuguufis Yesuusiif kenne.
english: Immediately one of them ran and took a sponge, filled it with vinegar, put it on a reed, and gave him a drink.

kikuyu: Warri kaan garuu, “Mee isa dhiisaa. Akka Eeliyaas dhufee isa oolchu arginaatii” jedhan.
english: The rest said, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to save him.”

kikuyu: Yesuus ammas sagalee guddaadhaan iyyee hafuura isaa kenne.
english: Jesus cried again with a loud voice, and yielded up his spirit.

kikuyu: Yeruma sana golgaan mana qulqullummaa olii hamma gadiitti iddoo lamatti tarsaʼe. Lafti ni sochoote; kattaawwanis ni babbaqaqan.
english: Behold, the veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom. The earth quaked and the rocks were split.

kikuyu: Awwaalonnis banamanii dhagnawwan qulqullootaa kanneen duʼanii turan hedduun duʼaa kaafaman.
english: The tombs were opened, and many bodies of the saints who had fallen asleep were raised;

kikuyu: Isaanis duʼaa kaʼuu Yesuus booddee awwaala keessaa baʼanii magaalattii qulqulluu seenan. Namoota hedduuttis mulʼatan.
english: and coming out of the tombs after his resurrection, they entered into the holy city and appeared to many.

kikuyu: Ajajaan dhibbaa sunii fi warri isa wajjin Yesuusin eegaa turan yommuu sochii lafaatii fi waan achitti taʼe hunda arganitti akka malee sodaatanii, “Dhugumaanuu inni Ilma Waaqaa ture!” jedhan.
english: Now the centurion and those who were with him watching Jesus, when they saw the earthquake and the things that were done, were terrified, saying, “Truly this was the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Dubartoonni Yesuusin tajaajiluuf jedhanii Galiilaadhaa isa duukaa buʼan baayʼeenis fagoo dhaabatanii ilaalaa turan.
english: Many women were there watching from afar, who had followed Jesus from Galilee, serving him.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaas Maariyaam ishee Magdalaa, Maariyaam haadha Yaaqoobii fi Yoosef, akkasumas haadha ilmaan Zabdewoos turan.
english: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joses, and the mother of the sons of Zebedee.

kikuyu: Yommuu galgalaaʼettis namichi sooressi Yoosef jedhamu tokko Armaatiyaa dhufe; inni mataan isaas barataa Yesuus ture.
english: When evening had come, a rich man from Arimathaea named Joseph, who himself was also Jesus’ disciple, came.

kikuyu: Innis gara Phiilaaxoos dhaqee reeffa Yesuus kadhate; Phiilaaxoosis akka reeffi sun isaaf kennamu ajaje.
english: This man went to Pilate and asked for Jesus’ body. Then Pilate commanded the body to be given up.

kikuyu: Yoosefis reeffa sana fudhatee huccuu quncee talbaa irraa hojjetame qulqulluudhaan kafane;
english: Joseph took the body and wrapped it in a clean linen cloth

kikuyu: innis awwaala ofii isaa kan garaa kattaa keessatti qotate haaraa tokko keessa kaaʼe. Dhagaa guddaa tokkos balbala awwaala sanaatti gangalchee biraa deeme.
english: and laid it in his own new tomb, which he had cut out in the rock. Then he rolled a large stone against the door of the tomb, and departed.

kikuyu: Maariyaam isheen Magdalaatii fi Maariyaam isheen kaan fuullee awwaala sanaa tataaʼaa turan.
english: Mary Magdalene was there, and the other Mary, sitting opposite the tomb.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti jechuunis guyyaa qophii booddee luboonni hangafoonnii fi Fariisonni fuula Phiilaaxoos duratti walitti qabaman.
english: Now on the next day, which was the day after the Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees were gathered together to Pilate,

kikuyu: Isaanis akkana jedhan; “Gooftaa! Akka namichi gowwoomsaan sun utuu lubbuudhaan jiruu, ‘Ani guyyaa sadii booddee duʼaa nan kaʼa’ jedhe nu ni yaadanna.
english: saying, “Sir, we remember what that deceiver said while he was still alive: ‘After three days I will rise again.’

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka awwaalli sun hamma guyyaa sadaffaatti eegamu ajaji. Yoo kun taʼuu baate barattoonni isaa dhaqanii reeffa isaa hatanii, ‘Inni warra duʼan keessaa kaʼeera’ jedhanii namatti odeessu. Gowwoomsaan dhumaa kun immoo isa duraa caalaa ni hammaata.”
english: Command therefore that the tomb be made secure until the third day, lest perhaps his disciples come at night and steal him away, and tell the people, ‘He is risen from the dead;’ and the last deception will be worse than the first.”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis deebisee, “Waardiyyaa fudhadhaa dhaqaatii akkuma beektanitti awwaalicha eegsifadhaa” jedheen.
english: Pilate said to them, “You have a guard. Go, make it as secure as you can.”

kikuyu: Kanaaf isaan dhaqanii dhagicha irratti mallattoo godhan; waardiyyaas ramadanii awwaala sana eegsisan.
english: So they went with the guard and made the tomb secure, sealing the stone.

kikuyu: Sanbata booddee, guyyaa jalqaba torban sanaa Maariyaam isheen Magdalaatii fi Maariyaam isheen kaan barii barraaqaan awwaala ilaaluu dhaqan.
english: Now after the Sabbath, as it began to dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary came to see the tomb.

kikuyu: Kunoo, sababii ergamaan Gooftaa samii irraa gad buʼee gara awwaalaa dhaqee balbala awwaalaa irraa dhagaa sana garagalchee irra taaʼeef, sochiin lafaa guddaan taʼe.
english: Behold, there was a great earthquake, for an angel of the Lord descended from the sky and came and rolled away the stone from the door and sat on it.

kikuyu: Bifti isaa ifaa akka bakakkaa, uffanni isaa immoo adii akka cabbii ture.
english: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothing white as snow.

kikuyu: Waardiyyoonni sunis sababii isa sodaataniif hollatanii akkuma nama duʼee taʼan.
english: For fear of him, the guards shook, and became like dead men.

kikuyu: Ergamaan sunis dubartoota sanaan akkana jedhe; “Hin sodaatinaa! Akka isin Yesuus isa fannifamee ture sana barbaaddan anuu beeka.
english: The angel answered the women, “Don’t be afraid, for I know that you seek Jesus, who has been crucified.

kikuyu: Inni as hin jiru; akkuma jedhe sana duʼaa kaʼeeraatii. Kottaatii iddoo inni ciisaa ture ilaalaa.
english: He is not here, for he has risen, just like he said. Come, see the place where the Lord was lying.

kikuyu: Egaa dafaa dhaqaatii akkana jedhaa barattoota isaatti himaa; ‘Inni warra duʼan keessaa kaʼeera; kunoo, inni isin dursee Galiilaa ni dhaqa. Achittis isa ni argitu.’ Kunoo ani isinitti himeera.”
english: Go quickly and tell his disciples, ‘He has risen from the dead, and behold, he goes before you into Galilee; there you will see him.’ Behold, I have told you.”

kikuyu: Dubartoonni sunis sodaatanii, taʼus gammachuu guddaan guutamanii ariitiidhaan awwaala sana biraa deeman; barattoota isaatti himuufis fiigan.
english: They departed quickly from the tomb with fear and great joy, and ran to bring his disciples word.

kikuyu: Yeruma sana kunoo Yesuus isaanitti dhufee, nagaa isaan gaafate. Isaanis isatti dhiʼaatanii miilla isaa qabatanii sagadaniif.
english: As they went to tell his disciples, behold, Jesus met them, saying, “Rejoice!” They came and took hold of his feet, and worshiped him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Hin sodaatinaa! Dhaqaatii akka isaan gara Galiilaa deemaniif obboloota kootti himaa; isaanis achitti na argu” jedheen.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “Don’t be afraid. Go tell my brothers that they should go into Galilee, and there they will see me.”

kikuyu: Utuu dubartoonni sun karaa jiranuu waardiyyoota sana keessaa tokko tokko magaalaa seenanii waan taʼe hunda luboota hangafootatti himan.
english: Now while they were going, behold, some of the guards came into the city and told the chief priests all the things that had happened.

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonnis erga maanguddoota wajjin walitti qabamanii mariʼatanii booddee loltootaaf maallaqa hedduu kennan.
english: When they were assembled with the elders and had taken counsel, they gave a large amount of silver to the soldiers,

kikuyu: Akkanas jedhaniin; “ ‘Utuu nu rafnuu barattoonni isaa halkaniin dhufanii isa hatan’ jedhaatii namootatti himaa.
english: saying, “Say that his disciples came by night and stole him away while we slept.

kikuyu: Yoo wanni kun gurra bulchaa seene nu isa amansiifnee rakkina jalaa isin baafnaa.”
english: If this comes to the governor’s ears, we will persuade him and make you free of worry.”

kikuyu: Loltoonnis maallaqa sana fudhatanii akkuma ajajaman godhan. Oduun kunis hamma harʼaatti Yihuudoota biratti odeeffamaa jira.
english: So they took the money and did as they were told. This saying was spread abroad among the Jews, and continues until today.

kikuyu: Barattoonni kudha tokkoon sun gara biyya Galiilaa, gara tulluu Yesuus dhaqaa isaaniin jedhee ture sanaa dhaqan.
english: But the eleven disciples went into Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had sent them.

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu isa arganitti ni sagadaniif; isaan keessaa tokko tokko garuu ni maman.
english: When they saw him, they bowed down to him; but some doubted.

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo isaanitti dhiʼaatee akkana jedhe; “Taayitaan hundinuu samii fi lafa irratti naa kennameera.
english: Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.

kikuyu: Kanaaf dhaqaatii saba hundumaa maqaa Abbaatti, maqaa Ilmaatti, maqaa Hafuura Qulqulluuttis cuuphaatii barattoota taasisaa;
english: Go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: akka waan ani isin ajaje hunda eeganiifis isaan barsiisaa. Kunoo, ani hamma dhuma addunyaatti guyyaa hunda isin wajjinan jira.”
english: teaching them to observe all things that I commanded you. Behold, I am with you always, even to the end of the age.” Amen.

kikuyu: Jalqaba wangeela Yesuus Kiristoos Ilma Waaqaa.
english: The beginning of the Good News of Jesus Christ, the Son of God.

kikuyu: Kitaaba Isaayyaas raajichaa keessatti akkana jedhamee barreeffameera: “Kunoo, ani ergamaa koo isa karaa kee qopheessu, si dura nan erga;”
english: As it is written in the prophets, “Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you:

kikuyu: “Sagalee nama, ‘Gooftaaf karaa qopheessaa; daandii qajeelaas isaaf hojjedhaa’ jedhee gammoojjii keessaa iyyu tokkoo.”
english: the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord! Make his paths straight!’”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yohannis gammoojjii keessatti nama cuuphaa, dhiifama cubbuutiif immoo cuuphaa qalbii jijjiirrannaa lallabaa dhufe.
english: John came baptizing in the wilderness and preaching the baptism of repentance for forgiveness of sins.

kikuyu: Biyyi Yihuudaa guutuunii fi namoonni Yerusaalem hundinuus gara isaa dhaqanii cubbuu isaanii himachaa, Laga Yordaanos keessatti isaan cuuphamaa turan.
english: All the country of Judea and all those of Jerusalem went out to him. They were baptized by him in the Jordan river, confessing their sins.

kikuyu: Yohannis uffata rifeensa gaalaa irraa hojjetame uffatee, mudhii isaas sabbata teephaatiin hidhata ture; inni hawwaannisaa fi damma bosonaa nyaata ture.
english: John was clothed with camel’s hair and a leather belt around his waist. He ate locusts and wild honey.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee lallabaa ture; “Kan na caalaa jabaa taʼe, hidhaa kophee isaa illee gad jedhee hiikuun kan naaf hin malle tokko na duubaan ni dhufa.
english: He preached, saying, “After me comes he who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and loosen.

kikuyu: Ani bishaaniinan isin cuupha; inni garuu Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan isin cuupha.”
english: I baptized you in water, but he will baptize you in the Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Yeroo sana Yesuus Naazreeti ishee Galiilaatii dhufee Laga Yordaanos keessatti Yohannisiin cuuphame.
english: In those days, Jesus came from Nazareth of Galilee, and was baptized by John in the Jordan.

kikuyu: Yesuus utuma bishaan keessaa ol baʼaa jiruu, samiin banamee utuu Hafuurri akkuma gugeetti isa irratti gad buʼuu arge.
english: Immediately coming up from the water, he saw the heavens parting and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.

kikuyu: Sagaleen, “Ati Ilma koo isa ani jaalladhuu dha; ani baayʼee sitti nan gammada” jedhu tokkos samii irraa dhufe.
english: A voice came out of the sky, “You are my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Yeruma sana Hafuurri gammoojjiitti isa baase;
english: Immediately the Spirit drove him out into the wilderness.

kikuyu: inni guyyaa afurtama Seexanaan qoramaa gammoojjii keessa ture. Inni bineensota wajjin ture; ergamoonnis isa tajaajilan.
english: He was there in the wilderness forty days, tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals; and the angels were serving him.

kikuyu: Erga Yohannis mana hidhaatti galfamee booddee, Yesuus wangeela Waaqaa lallabaa Galiilaa seene.
english: Now after John was taken into custody, Jesus came into Galilee, preaching the Good News of God’s Kingdom,

kikuyu: Innis, “Barri sun gaʼeera; mootummaan Waaqaas dhiʼaateera; qalbii jijjiirradhaatii wangeelatti amanaa!” jedhe.
english: and saying, “The time is fulfilled, and God’s Kingdom is at hand! Repent, and believe in the Good News.”

kikuyu: Yesuus utuu qarqara Galaana Galiilaa irra deemaa jiruu Simoonii fi obboleessa isaa Indiriiyaas utuu isaan kiyyoo galaanatti darbachaa jiranuu arge; isaan qurxummii qabdoota turaniitii.
english: Passing along by the sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and Andrew, the brother of Simon, casting a net into the sea, for they were fishermen.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Kottaa, na duukaa buʼaa; anis akka isin qabduu namootaa taataniif isin nan erga” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to them, “Come after me, and I will make you into fishers for men.”

kikuyu: Isaanis yommusuma kiyyoo isaanii dhiisanii isa duukaa buʼan.
english: Immediately they left their nets, and followed him.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu xinnoo achi hiiqetti Yaaqoob ilma Zabdewoosii fi obboleessa isaa Yohannis utuu isaan bidiruu keessatti kiyyoowwan isaanii qopheeffatanuu arge.
english: Going on a little further from there, he saw James the son of Zebedee, and John his brother, who were also in the boat mending the nets.

kikuyu: Innis yommusuma isaan waame; isaanis abbaa isaanii Zabdewoosin hojjettoota qacaraman wajjin bidiruu sana keessatti dhiisanii isa duukaa buʼan.
english: Immediately he called them, and they left their father, Zebedee, in the boat with the hired servants, and went after him.

kikuyu: Isaan gara Qifirnaahom dhaqan; innis yommusuma Sanbataan mana sagadaa seenee barsiise.
english: They went into Capernaum, and immediately on the Sabbath day he entered into the synagogue and taught.

kikuyu: Inni akka barsiistota seeraatti utuu hin taʼin akka nama taayitaa qabu tokkootti waan barsiisaa tureef namoonni barsiisa isaa ni dinqisiifatan.
english: They were astonished at his teaching, for he taught them as having authority, and not as the scribes.

kikuyu: Yeruma sana namichi mana sagadaa isaanii keessaa kan hafuura xuraaʼaan qabame tokko iyyee
english: Immediately there was in their synagogue a man with an unclean spirit, and he cried out,

kikuyu: akkana jedhe; “Yaa Yesuus nama Naazreeti, ati maal nurraa qabda? Nu balleessuu dhufte moo? Ati eenyu akka taate ani nan beeka, yaa Qulqullicha Waaqaa!”
english: saying, “Ha! What do we have to do with you, Jesus, you Nazarene? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Calʼisii isa keessaa baʼi!” jedhee ifate.
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be quiet, and come out of him!”

kikuyu: Hafuurri xuraaʼaan sunis namicha dhidhiitachiisee, sagalee guddaadhaan iyyee keessaa baʼe.
english: The unclean spirit, convulsing him and crying with a loud voice, came out of him.

kikuyu: Namoonni hundinuu baayʼee dinqifatanii, “Kun maalii? Inni taayitaadhaan barsiisa haaraa barsiisa! Hafuurota xuraaʼoo illee ni ajaja; isaanis ni ajajamuuf” waliin jedhan.
english: They were all amazed, so that they questioned among themselves, saying, “What is this? What can this new doctrine be? For with authority he commands even the unclean spirits, and they obey him!”

kikuyu: Oduun waaʼee isaas dafee biyya Galiilaa guutuu keessa faffacaʼe.
english: The report of him went out immediately into all the region of Galilee and its surrounding area.

kikuyu: Isaanis akkuma mana sagadaatii baʼaniin Yaaqoobii fi Yohannis wajjin mana Simoonii fi Indiriiyaas dhaqan.
english: Immediately, when they had come out of the synagogue, they came into the house of Simon and Andrew, with James and John.

kikuyu: Haati niitii Simoonis dhukkuba dhagna gubaadhaan qabamtee ciifti turte; isaanis yommusuma waaʼee ishee Yesuusitti himan.
english: Now Simon’s wife’s mother lay sick with a fever, and immediately they told him about her.

kikuyu: Innis dhaqee harka qabee ishee kaase. Dhagna gubaan sunis ishee dhiise; isheenis isaan tajaajiluu jalqabde.
english: He came and took her by the hand and raised her up. The fever left her immediately, and she served them.

kikuyu: Namoonnis galgala sana erga biiftuun lixxee booddee, dhukkubsattootaa fi warra hafuurota hamoon qabaman hunda Yesuusitti fidan.
english: At evening, when the sun had set, they brought to him all who were sick and those who were possessed by demons.

kikuyu: Magaalaan sun guutuunis balbala duratti walitti qabame.
english: All the city was gathered together at the door.

kikuyu: Yesuusis namoota dhibee garaa garaa qaban hedduu fayyise; hafuurota hamoo baayʼees ni baase; garuu inni sababii hafuuronni hamoon sun eenyummaa isaa beekaniif akka isaan dubbatan hin eeyyamneef.
english: He healed many who were sick with various diseases and cast out many demons. He didn’t allow the demons to speak, because they knew him.

kikuyu: Yesuus ganama barii dimimmisaan kaʼee manaa baʼee iddoo namni hin jirre tokko dhaqee achitti kadhate.
english: Early in the morning, while it was still dark, he rose up and went out, and departed into a deserted place, and prayed there.

kikuyu: Simoonii fi warri isa wajjin turan isa barbaaduu deeman;
english: Simon and those who were with him searched for him.

kikuyu: isaanis yommuu isa argatanitti, “Namni hundinuu si barbaadaa jira!” jedhaniin.
english: They found him and told him, “Everyone is looking for you.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo deebisee, “Akka ani achittis lallabuuf kottaa gara magaalaawwan dhiʼoo jiran kaanii dhaqnaa. Sababiin ani dhufeefis kanuma” jedhe.
english: He said to them, “Let’s go elsewhere into the next towns, that I may preach there also, because I came out for this reason.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu inni manneen sagadaa isaanii keessatti lallabaa, hafuurota hamoos baasaa, Galiilaa guutuu keessa deeme.
english: He went into their synagogues throughout all Galilee, preaching and casting out demons.

kikuyu: Namichi lamxaaʼaan tokko gara isaa dhufee jilbeenfatee, “Yoo fedhii kee taʼe, ati na qulqulleessuu ni dandeessa” jedhee isa kadhate.
english: A leper came to him, begging him, kneeling down to him, and saying to him, “If you want to, you can make me clean.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis garaa laafeefii, harka isaa hiixatee namicha qaqqabee, “Fedhii koo ti; qulqullaaʼi!” jedheen.
english: Being moved with compassion, he stretched out his hand, and touched him, and said to him, “I want to. Be made clean.”

kikuyu: Yeruma sana lamxiin sun namicha irraa bade; namichis ni qulqullaaʼe.
english: When he had said this, immediately the leprosy departed from him and he was made clean.

kikuyu: Yesuusis of eeggannoo jabaa kenneefii yommusuma gad isa dhiise.
english: He strictly warned him and immediately sent him out,

kikuyu: Akkanas jedheen; “Ati waan kana nama tokkotti illee akka hin himne beekkadhu; garuu dhaqiitii akka isaaniif ragaa taʼuuf lubatti of argisiisi; qulqullaaʼuu keetiifis aarsaawwan Museen ajaje sana dhiʼeessi.”
english: and said to him, “See that you say nothing to anybody, but go show yourself to the priest and offer for your cleansing the things which Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Namichi garuu achii baʼee baayʼisee odeessuu jalqabe. Kanaafis Yesuus ergasii magaalaan ala, lafa namni hin jirre ture malee ifaan ifatti magaalattii seenuu hin dandeenye. Namoonni garuu iddoo hundatti isa bira dhufaa turan.
english: But he went out, and began to proclaim it much, and to spread about the matter, so that Jesus could no more openly enter into a city, but was outside in desert places. People came to him from everywhere.

kikuyu: Yesuus guyyaa muraasa booddee Qifirnaahomitti deebiʼe; namoonnis akka inni mana jiru dhagaʼan.
english: When he entered again into Capernaum after some days, it was heard that he was at home.

kikuyu: Namoonni akka malee baayʼatan walitti qabamnaan iddoon dhabamee balballi durris dhiphate; innis dubbicha isaanitti lallabaa ture.
english: Immediately many were gathered together, so that there was no more room, not even around the door; and he spoke the word to them.

kikuyu: Jarri tokko nama dhagni irratti duʼe kan namoota afuriin baatame tokko gara isaa fidan.
english: Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.

kikuyu: Isaanis sababii baayʼina namaatiif namicha sana Yesuusitti dhiʼeessuu dadhabanii qixa Yesuus tureen bantii manaa saaqanii siree namichi dhagni irratti duʼe irra ciise sana gad buusan.
english: When they could not come near to him for the crowd, they removed the roof where he was. When they had broken it up, they let down the mat that the paralytic was lying on.

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu amantii isaanii argetti namicha dhagni irratti duʼe sanaan, “Gurbaa, cubbuun kee siif dhiifameera” jedhe.
english: Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic, “Son, your sins are forgiven you.”

kikuyu: Barsiistota seeraa keessaa tokko tokko achi tataaʼanii garaa isaanii keessatti,
english: But there were some of the scribes sitting there and reasoning in their hearts,

kikuyu: “Namichi kun maaliif akkana dubbata? Inni Waaqa arrabsa! Waaqa tokkicha malee eenyutu cubbuu namaaf dhiisuu dandaʼa?” jedhanii yaadan.
english: “Why does this man speak blasphemies like that? Who can forgive sins but God alone?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis yeruma sana akka wanni isaan garaa isaanii keessatti yaadaa turan kana taʼe hafuuraan beekee akkana jedheen; “Isin maaliif waan kana yaaddu?
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in his spirit that they so reasoned within themselves, said to them, “Why do you reason these things in your hearts?

kikuyu: Namicha dhagni irratti duʼe kanaan, ‘Cubbuun kee siif dhiifameera’ jechuu moo ‘Kaʼii siree kee fudhadhuu deemi’ jechuutu salphaa dha?
english: Which is easier, to tell the paralytic, ‘Your sins are forgiven;’ or to say, ‘Arise, and take up your bed, and walk’?

kikuyu: Ani garuu akka Ilmi Namaa cubbuu namaaf dhiisuudhaaf lafa irratti taayitaa qabu akka beektan nan barbaada.” Kanaafuu inni namicha sanaan,
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins”—he said to the paralytic—

kikuyu: “Ani sitti nan hima; kaʼi; siree kee fudhadhuutii mana keetti gali” jedhe.
english: “I tell you, arise, take up your mat, and go to your house.”

kikuyu: Innis kaʼee, yommusuma siree isaa fudhatee utuma isaan hundinuu arganuu baʼe deeme. Kunis hunda isaanii dinqisiise; isaanis, “Nu takkumaa waan akkanaa arginee hin beeknu!” jedhanii Waaqa jajan.
english: He arose, and immediately took up the mat and went out in front of them all, so that they were all amazed and glorified God, saying, “We never saw anything like this!”

kikuyu: Yesuus amma illee gara qarqara galaanichaatti gad baʼe. Namoonni baayʼeenis isa biratti walitti qabaman; innis isaan barsiisuu jalqabe.
english: He went out again by the seaside. All the multitude came to him, and he taught them.

kikuyu: Innis utuu achiin darbaa jiruu, Lewwii ilma Alfewoos utuu inni iddoo itti qaraxa walitti qaban taaʼuu argee, “Na duukaa buʼi” jedheen. Lewwiinis kaʼee isa duukaa buʼe.
english: As he passed by, he saw Levi the son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax office. He said to him, “Follow me.” And he arose and followed him.

kikuyu: Yeroo Yesuus mana Lewwiitti irbaata nyaachaa turetti, qaraxxoonnii fi cubbamoonni baayʼeen isaa fi barattoota isaa wajjin nyaachaa turan; namoonni isa duukaa buʼan baayʼee turaniitii.
english: He was reclining at the table in his house, and many tax collectors and sinners sat down with Jesus and his disciples, for there were many, and they followed him.

kikuyu: Barsiistonni seeraa warri Fariisota turan yommuu isaa cubbamootaa fi qaraxxoota wajjin nyaatu arganitti, “Inni maaliif qaraxxootaa fi cubbamoota wajjin nyaata?” jedhanii barattoota isaa gaafatan.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees, when they saw that he was eating with the sinners and tax collectors, said to his disciples, “Why is it that he eats and drinks with tax collectors and sinners?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo waan kana dhageenyaan, “Ogeessi fayyaa tokko warra dhukkubsataniif malee warra fayyaa qabaniif hin barbaachisu. Ani cubbamoota waamuufin dhufe malee qajeeltota waamuuf hin dhufne” jedheen.
english: When Jesus heard it, he said to them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick. I came not to call the righteous, but sinners to repentance.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni Yohannisii fi Fariisonni ni soomu turan. Namoonni tokko tokko dhufanii, “Barattoonni Yohannisii fi barattoonni Fariisotaa ni soomu; barattoonni kee garuu maaliif hin soomne?” jedhanii Yesuusin gaafatan.
english: John’s disciples and the Pharisees were fasting, and they came and asked him, “Why do John’s disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees fast, but your disciples don’t fast?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Keessummoonni misirrichaa akkamiin utuu inni isaan wajjin jiruu soomuu dandaʼu? Isaan hamma isa of biraa qabanitti soomuu hin dandaʼan.
english: Jesus said to them, “Can the groomsmen fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them, they can’t fast.

kikuyu: Garuu yeroon itti misirrichi isaan biraa fudhatamu ni dhufa; isaanis gaafas ni soomu.
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them, and then they will fast in that day.

kikuyu: “Namni uffata moofaa irratti erbee haaraa erbu tokko iyyuu hin jiru. Yoo kun godhame, erbeen haaraan sun uffata sana irraa tarsaasa; tarsaʼaan sunis isa duraa ni caala.
english: No one sews a piece of unshrunk cloth on an old garment, or else the patch shrinks and the new tears away from the old, and a worse hole is made.

kikuyu: Namni daadhii wayinii haaraa qalqalloo moofaatti naqu tokko iyyuu hin jiru. Yoo itti naqe immoo daadhiin sun qalqalloo sana dhoosa; daadhichii fi qalqallichi horoomaa baʼu. Qooda kanaa daadhiin wayinii haaraan qalqalloo haaraatti naqamuu qaba.”
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins; or else the new wine will burst the skins, and the wine pours out, and the skins will be destroyed; but they put new wine into fresh wineskins.”

kikuyu: Guyyaa Sanbataa tokko Yesuus lafa qotiisaa midhaanii keessa darbaa ture; barattoonni isaas utuu isa wajjin deemaa jiranuu asheetii midhaanii cirachuu jalqaban.
english: He was going on the Sabbath day through the grain fields; and his disciples began, as they went, to pluck the ears of grain.

kikuyu: Fariisonnis, “Ilaa, isaan maaliif waan Sanbataan hojjechuun hin eeyyamamne hojjetu?” jedhaniin.
english: The Pharisees said to him, “Behold, why do they do that which is not lawful on the Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebise; “Isin waan Daawit yeroo innii fi miiltonni isaa beelaʼanii fi rakkatanitti godhe sana takkumaa hin dubbifnee?
english: He said to them, “Did you never read what David did when he had need and was hungry—he, and those who were with him?

kikuyu: Bara Abiyaataar luba ol aanaa ture keessa, inni mana Waaqaa seenee buddeena qulqulleeffame kan akka luboonni qofti nyaataniif eeyyamame sana nyaate. Warra isa wajjin jiraniifis ni kenne.”
english: How he entered into God’s house at the time of Abiathar the high priest, and ate the show bread, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests, and gave also to those who were with him?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedheen; “Sanbatatu namaaf uumame malee namni Sanbataaf hin uumamne.
english: He said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Ilmi Namaa Sanbataaf illee Gooftaa dha.”
english: Therefore the Son of Man is lord even of the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Ammas Yesuus mana sagadaa seene; namichi harki irratti goge tokkos achi ture.
english: He entered again into the synagogue, and there was a man there whose hand was withered.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaas namoonni tokko tokko Yesuusin himachuuf jedhanii sababa barbaadaa turan; kanaafuu akka inni Sanbataan namicha fayyisu ilaaluuf isa gaadan.
english: They watched him, whether he would heal him on the Sabbath day, that they might accuse him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis namicha harki irratti goge sanaan, “Kaʼii fuula nama hundaa dura dhaabadhu” jedhe.
english: He said to the man whose hand was withered, “Stand up.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Sanbataan isa kamtu eeyyamamaa dha? Waan gaarii hojjechuu moo waan hamaa hojjechuu? Lubbuu oolchuu moo ajjeesuu?” jedhee isaan gaafate. Isaan garuu ni calʼisan.
english: He said to them, “Is it lawful on the Sabbath day to do good or to do harm? To save a life or to kill?” But they were silent.
