kikuyu: Innis mata jabina isaaniitti akka malee gaddee, aariidhaan garagalee isaan ilaale; namicha sanaanis, “Harka kee diriirfadhu!” jedhe. Namichis harka diriirfate; harki isaas guutumaan guutuutti fayye.
english: When he had looked around at them with anger, being grieved at the hardening of their hearts, he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was restored as healthy as the other.

kikuyu: Fariisonnis gad baʼanii akka ittiin Yesuusin ajjeesuu dandaʼan garee Heroodis wajjin mariʼachuu jalqaban.
english: The Pharisees went out, and immediately conspired with the Herodians against him, how they might destroy him.

kikuyu: Yesuus barattoota isaa wajjin achii kaʼee gara galaanichaatti qajeele; tuunni namoota baayʼees Galiilaadhaa isa duukaa buʼe.
english: Jesus withdrew to the sea with his disciples; and a great multitude followed him from Galilee, from Judea,

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeenis yommuu waan inni hojjechaa ture hunda dhagaʼanitti Yihuudaadhaa, Yerusaalemii, Edoomiyaasii, biyya Yordaanos gamaatii, naannoo Xiiroosiitii fi Siidoonaatii gara isaa dhufan.
english: from Jerusalem, from Idumaea, beyond the Jordan, and those from around Tyre and Sidon. A great multitude, hearing what great things he did, came to him.

kikuyu: Innis akka baayʼina namaatiin hin dhiibamneef akka isaan bidiruu xinnoo tokko isaaf qopheessan barattoota isaatti hime.
english: He spoke to his disciples that a little boat should stay near him because of the crowd, so that they wouldn’t press on him.

kikuyu: Sababii inni nama baayʼee fayyisee tureef, warri dhukkubsatan hundinuu isa tuquuf jedhanii irratti wal cabsaa turan.
english: For he had healed many, so that as many as had diseases pressed on him that they might touch him.

kikuyu: Hafuuronni xuraaʼoonis yeroo isa argan fuula isaa duratti kufanii, “Ati Ilma Waaqaa ti!” jedhanii iyyu turan.
english: The unclean spirits, whenever they saw him, fell down before him and cried, “You are the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Inni garuu akka isaan akka inni beekamu hin goone jabeessee isaan ajaje.
english: He sternly warned them that they should not make him known.

kikuyu: Yesuusis tulluutti ol baʼee warra ofii isaatii barbaade ofitti waame; isaanis gara isaa dhufan.
english: He went up into the mountain and called to himself those whom he wanted, and they went to him.

kikuyu: Innis akka isaan isa wajjin jiraatanii fi akka lallabaaf isaan erguuf namoota kudha lama muudee barattoota jedhee moggaase;
english: He appointed twelve, that they might be with him, and that he might send them out to preach

kikuyu: akka isaan hafuurota hamoo baasaniifis taayitaa kenneef.
english: and to have authority to heal sicknesses and to cast out demons:

kikuyu: Warri kudha lamaan inni muudes isaan kana: Simoon isa inni “Phexros” jedhee moggaase,
english: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter);

kikuyu: Yaaqoob ilma Zabdewoosii fi obboleessa isaa Yohannis warra inni “Boʼanergees” jedhee moggaase; Boʼanergees jechuun ilmaan “Kakawwee” jechuu dha;
english: James the son of Zebedee; and John, the brother of James, (whom he called Boanerges, which means, Sons of Thunder);

kikuyu: Indiriiyaas, Fiiliphoos, Bartaloomewoos, Maatewos, Toomaas, Yaaqoob ilma Alfewoos, Taadewoos, Simoon Hinaafticha,
english: Andrew; Philip; Bartholomew; Matthew; Thomas; James, the son of Alphaeus; Thaddaeus; Simon the Zealot;

kikuyu: Yihuudaa Keeriyoticha isa Yesuusin dabarsee kenne.
english: and Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him. Then he came into a house.

kikuyu: Yesuusis mana tokko seene; sababii namoonni akka malee baayʼatan ammas walitti qabamaniif innii fi barattoonni isaa waa nyaachuu illee hin dandeenye.
english: The multitude came together again, so that they could not so much as eat bread.

kikuyu: Firoonni isaas yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti isa qabuu dhaqan; namoonni, “Inni qalbii dabarseera” jechaa turaniitii.
english: When his friends heard it, they went out to seize him; for they said, “He is insane.”

kikuyu: Barsiistonni seeraa warri Yerusaalemii gad buʼan, “Inni Biʼeelzebuuliin qabameera! Hangafa hafuurota hamootiin hafuurota hamoo baasaa jira” jedhan.
english: The scribes who came down from Jerusalem said, “He has Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons he casts out the demons.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo ofitti isaan waamee akkana jedhee fakkeenyaan isaanitti dubbate: “Seexanni akkamitti Seexana baasuu dandaʼa?
english: He summoned them and said to them in parables, “How can Satan cast out Satan?

kikuyu: Mootummaan tokko yoo gargar of qoode, mootummaan sun dhaabachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.

kikuyu: Manni tokko yoo gargar of qoode, manni sun dhaabachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.

kikuyu: Seexannis yoo gargar of qoode, inni dhaabachuu hin dandaʼu; dhumni isaa gaʼeeraatii.
english: If Satan has risen up against himself, and is divided, he can’t stand, but has an end.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan namni kam iyyuu utuu duraan dursee nama jabaa tokko hin hidhin, mana nama jabaa sanaa seenee qabeenya isaa saamuu hin dandaʼu. Ergasii inni mana namicha jabaa sanaa saamuu dandaʼa.
english: But no one can enter into the house of the strong man to plunder unless he first binds the strong man; then he will plunder his house.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; cubbuun isaanii hundii fi arrabsoon isaan dubbatan hundi namootaaf dhiifamuu ni dandaʼa;
english: “Most certainly I tell you, all sins of the descendants of man will be forgiven, including their blasphemies with which they may blaspheme;

kikuyu: namni Hafuura Qulqulluu arrabsu kam iyyuu garuu gonkumaa dhiifama hin argatu; inni itti gaafatamaa cubbuu bara baraa ti.”
english: but whoever may blaspheme against the Holy Spirit never has forgiveness, but is subject to eternal condemnation.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis sababii isaan, “Inni hafuura xuraaʼaa qaba” jechaa turaniif waan kana dubbate.
english: —because they said, “He has an unclean spirit.”

kikuyu: Haatii fi obboloonni isaa dhufanii, ala dhaabatanii nama itti erganii isa waamsisan.
english: His mother and his brothers came, and standing outside, they sent to him, calling him.

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeenis isatti naannaʼanii taaʼaa turan; isaanis, “Haati keetii fi obboloonni kee ala dhadhaabatanii si iyyaafachaa jiru” jedhanii isatti himan.
english: A multitude was sitting around him, and they told him, “Behold, your mother, your brothers, and your sisters are outside looking for you.”

kikuyu: Inni immoo, “Haati kootii fi obboloonni koo eenyu?” jedhee gaafate.
english: He answered them, “Who are my mother and my brothers?”

kikuyu: Innis warra naannoo isaa marsanii tataaʼan ilaalee akkana jedhe; “Haati kootii fi obboloonni koo kunoo ti!
english: Looking around at those who sat around him, he said, “Behold, my mother and my brothers!

kikuyu: Namni fedhii Waaqaa raawwatu kam iyyuu obboleessa koo ti; obboleettii koo ti; haadha kootis.”
english: For whoever does the will of God is my brother, my sister, and mother.”

kikuyu: Yesuus ammas qarqara galaanichaatti barsiisuu jalqabe. Tuunni naannoo isaatti walitti qabame akka malee guddaa ture; utuu namoonni hundi qarqara galaanichaa irra afaan bishaanii jiranuu, inni bidiruu yaabbatee galaanicha irra achi hiiqee taaʼe.
english: Again he began to teach by the seaside. A great multitude was gathered to him, so that he entered into a boat in the sea and sat down. All the multitude were on the land by the sea.

kikuyu: Fakkeenyaanis waan baayʼee isaan barsiise; barsiisa isaa keessattis akkana jedhe:
english: He taught them many things in parables, and told them in his teaching,

kikuyu: “Mee dhagaʼaa! Kunoo, namichi sanyii facaasu tokko sanyii facaafachuu baʼe.
english: “Listen! Behold, the farmer went out to sow.

kikuyu: Utuu inni facaasaa jiruus sanyiin tokko tokko karaa irra buʼe; simbirroonnis dhufanii nyaatanii fixan.
english: As he sowed, some seed fell by the road, and the birds came and devoured it.

kikuyu: Kaan immoo lafa kattaa, iddoo biyyoo baayʼee hin qabne irra buʼe. Sanyiin sunis sababii biyyoon sun gad fageenya hin qabaatiniif dafee biqile.
english: Others fell on the rocky ground, where it had little soil, and immediately it sprang up, because it had no depth of soil.

kikuyu: Yommuu aduun baatetti garuu biqiltuun sun ni coollage; waan hidda hin qabaatiniifis ni goge.
english: When the sun had risen, it was scorched; and because it had no root, it withered away.

kikuyu: Sanyiin biraas qoraattii keessa buʼe; qoraattiin sunis guddatee biqiltuu sana hudhe; biqiltuun sunis ija hin naqanne.
english: Others fell among the thorns, and the thorns grew up and choked it, and it yielded no fruit.

kikuyu: Ammas sanyiin kaan biyyoo gaarii irra buʼe. Ni biqile; ni guddate; ijas ni naqate. Inni tokko soddoma, kaan jaatama, kaan immoo dhibba naqate.”
english: Others fell into the good ground and yielded fruit, growing up and increasing. Some produced thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times as much.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Namni gurra dhagaʼu qabu kam iyyuu haa dhagaʼu” jedhe.
english: He said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Yeroo inni kophaa turettis warri Kudha Lamaanii fi namoonni naannoo isaa turan biraa waaʼee fakkeenya sanaa isa gaafatan.
english: When he was alone, those who were around him with the twelve asked him about the parables.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedheen; “Icciitiin mootummaa Waaqaa isiniif kennameera. Warra ala jiranitti garuu wanni hundinuu fakkeenyaan himama;
english: He said to them, “To you is given the mystery of God’s Kingdom, but to those who are outside, all things are done in parables,

kikuyu: kunis, “ ‘Isaan akka hin deebinee fi akka dhiifama hin arganneef, arguu inuma argu, garuu hin qalbeeffatan; dhagaʼuus inuma dhagaʼu, garuu hin hubatan.’”
english: that ‘seeing they may see and not perceive, and hearing they may hear and not understand, lest perhaps they should turn again, and their sins should be forgiven them.’”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isin fakkeenya kana hin hubattanii? Yoos isin akkamitti fakkeenya hunda hubattu ree?
english: He said to them, “Don’t you understand this parable? How will you understand all of the parables?

kikuyu: Namichi sanyii facaasu sun dubbicha facaasa.
english: The farmer sows the word.

kikuyu: Namoonni tokko tokko sanyii karaa irraa, lafa dubbichi itti facaafame sana fakkaatu. Akkuma isaan dubbicha dhagaʼaniin Seexanni dhufee dubbicha isaan keessatti facaafame sana fudhata.
english: The ones by the road are the ones where the word is sown; and when they have heard, immediately Satan comes and takes away the word which has been sown in them.

kikuyu: Warri kaan akkuma sanyii lafa kattaa irratti facaafamee ti; isaan yommuu dubbicha dhagaʼanitti yommusuma gammachuun fudhatu.
english: These in the same way are those who are sown on the rocky places, who, when they have heard the word, immediately receive it with joy.

kikuyu: Garuu isaan waan hidda hin qabneef yeroo gabaabaa qofa turu. Yeroo rakkinni yookaan ariʼatamni sababii dubbichaatiif dhufutti isaan dafanii gufatu.
english: They have no root in themselves, but are short-lived. When oppression or persecution arises because of the word, immediately they stumble.

kikuyu: Ammas warri kaan sanyii qoraattii keessatti facaafame fakkaatu; isaanis warra dubbicha dhagaʼanii dha;
english: Others are those who are sown among the thorns. These are those who have heard the word,

kikuyu: garuu yaaddoon addunyaa kanaa, gowwoomsaan qabeenyaatii fi hawwiin waan garaa garaa isaan seenee dubbicha hudhee ija naqachuu dhowwa.
english: and the cares of this age, and the deceitfulness of riches, and the lusts of other things entering in choke the word, and it becomes unfruitful.

kikuyu: Warri kaanis sanyii biyyoo gaarii irratti facaafame fakkaatu; isaanis dubbicha ni dhagaʼu; ni fudhatu; ijas ni naqatu; inni tokko soddoma, kaan jaatama, kaan immoo dhibba naqata.”
english: Those which were sown on the good ground are those who hear the word, accept it, and bear fruit, some thirty times, some sixty times, and some one hundred times.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isin ibsaa gombisaa jala yookaan siree jala kaaʼuuf fidduu? Qooda kanaa baattuu isaa irra keessu mitii?
english: He said to them, “Is a lamp brought to be put under a basket or under a bed? Isn’t it put on a stand?

kikuyu: Wanni dhokfame kam iyyuu mulʼifamuuf jiraatii; wanni haguugame kam iyyuus ifatti baafamuuf jiraatii.
english: For there is nothing hidden except that it should be made known, neither was anything made secret but that it should come to light.

kikuyu: Namni kam iyyuu yoo gurra dhagaʼu qabaate haa dhagaʼu.”
english: If any man has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Innis itti fufee akkana jedheen; “Waan dhageessan qalbeeffadhaa. Safartuu ittiin safartaniinis, hammas caalaa iyyuu isiniif safarama.
english: He said to them, “Take heed what you hear. With whatever measure you measure, it will be measured to you; and more will be given to you who hear.

kikuyu: Kan qabu kamiif iyyuu itti dabalamee ni kennama; kan hin qabne garuu wanni inni qabu iyyuu irraa fudhatama.”
english: For whoever has, to him more will be given; and he who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.”

kikuyu: Ammas akkana jedhe; “Mootummaan Waaqaa nama lafa isaa irratti sanyii facaasu tokko fakkaata.
english: He said, “God’s Kingdom is as if a man should cast seed on the earth,

kikuyu: Akkamitti akka taʼe namichi beekuu baatu illee, inni rafus yookaan dammaqus, sanyiin sun halkanii guyyaa ni biqila; ni guddatas.
english: and should sleep and rise night and day, and the seed should spring up and grow, though he doesn’t know how.

kikuyu: Lafti ofuma isheetiin midhaan baafti; jalqabatti biqila, itti aansee hudhaa midhaanii, ergasii immoo midhaan guutuu baafti.
english: For the earth bears fruit by itself: first the blade, then the ear, then the full grain in the ear.

kikuyu: Namichis akkuma midhaanichi bilchaateen haamuu jalqaba; yeroon haamaa gaʼeeraatii.”
english: But when the fruit is ripe, immediately he puts in the sickle, because the harvest has come.”

kikuyu: Ammas inni akkana jedhe; “Mootummaan Waaqaa maal fakkaata jechuu dandeenya? Yookaan fakkeenya maaliitiin isa ibsina?
english: He said, “How will we liken God’s Kingdom? Or with what parable will we illustrate it?

kikuyu: Inni sanyii sanaaficaa kan sanyiiwwan lafa irra jiran hunda irra xinnaa taʼe fakkaata.
english: It’s like a grain of mustard seed, which, when it is sown in the earth, though it is less than all the seeds that are on the earth,

kikuyu: Erga facaafamee booddee garuu guddatee biqiltuu hunda caala; dameewwan gurguddaa simbirroonnis gaaddisa isaa jala jiraachuu dandaʼanis qabaata.”
english: yet when it is sown, grows up and becomes greater than all the herbs, and puts out great branches, so that the birds of the sky can lodge under its shadow.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis fakkeenyawwan akkanaa baayʼeedhaan hamma isaan dhagaʼuu dandaʼan dubbicha isaanitti dubbate.
english: With many such parables he spoke the word to them, as they were able to hear it.

kikuyu: Innis fakkeenyaan malee waan tokko illee isaanitti hin dubbanne. Yeroo kophaa turanitti garuu waan hunda barattoota isaatiif ni ibse.
english: Without a parable he didn’t speak to them; but privately to his own disciples he explained everything.

kikuyu: Inni gaafas, yeroo galgalaaʼetti, “Kottaa gama ceenaa” isaaniin jedhe.
english: On that day, when evening had come, he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side.”

kikuyu: Isaanis tuuta namootaa sana achitti dhiisanii Yesuusin akkuma inni bidiruu keessa jirutti fuudhanii deeman. Bidiruuwwan biraas isa wajjin turan.
english: Leaving the multitude, they took him with them, even as he was, in the boat. Other small boats were also with him.

kikuyu: Bubbeen hamaan tokko ni kaʼe; dambaliinis bidiruu sana dhaʼee bidiruun sun bishaaniin guutamuu gaʼe.
english: A big wind storm arose, and the waves beat into the boat, so much that the boat was already filled.

kikuyu: Yesuusis bidiruu sana keessa karaa duubaa boraatii tokko irra rafaa ture. Barattoonnis isa dammaqsanii, “Yaa barsiisaa, dhumuun keenya homaa si hin dhibuu?” jedhaniin.
english: He himself was in the stern, asleep on the cushion; and they woke him up and asked him, “Teacher, don’t you care that we are dying?”

kikuyu: Innis kaʼee bubbee sana ifate; dambalii sanaanis, “Calʼisi! Gab jedhis!” jedhe. Bubbeen sunis ni calʼise; tasgabbiin guddaanis ni taʼe.
english: He awoke and rebuked the wind, and said to the sea, “Peace! Be still!” The wind ceased and there was a great calm.

kikuyu: Innis barattoota isaatiin, “Isin maaliif akkana sodaattu? Isin amma iyyuu amantii hin qabdanii?” jedhe.
english: He said to them, “Why are you so afraid? How is it that you have no faith?”

kikuyu: Isaanis akka malee sodaatanii, “Namichi bubbee fi dambaliin iyyuu ajajamaniif kun eenyu?” jedhanii wal gaafatan.
english: They were greatly afraid and said to one another, “Who then is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?”

kikuyu: Isaanis galaanicha ceʼanii biyya Gergeesenoon dhaqan.
english: They came to the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes.

kikuyu: Yommuu Yesuus bidiruu irraa buʼetti, yommusuma namichi hafuura xuraaʼaadhaan qabame tokko iddoo awwaalaatii baʼee isatti dhufe.
english: When he had come out of the boat, immediately a man with an unclean spirit met him out of the tombs.

kikuyu: Namichi kun iddoo awwaalaa jiraata ture; namni tokko iyyuu foncaan illee lammata isa hidhuu hin dandeenye.
english: He lived in the tombs. Nobody could bind him any more, not even with chains,

kikuyu: Inni yeroo baayʼee funyoo sibiilaatii fi foncaadhaan hidhama ture; garuu foncaa sana kukkutee funyoo sibiilaa sanas caccabsa tureetii. Namni gad isa qabuu dandaʼu tokko iyyuu hin turre.
english: because he had been often bound with fetters and chains, and the chains had been torn apart by him, and the fetters broken in pieces. Nobody had the strength to tame him.

kikuyu: Innis yeroo hundumaa, halkanii guyyaa iddoo awwaalaa keessattii fi gaarran gubbaatti iyyaa, dhagna isaas dhagaadhaan murmuraa ture.
english: Always, night and day, in the tombs and in the mountains, he was crying out, and cutting himself with stones.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu Yesuusin fagootti argetti itti fiigee, fuula isaa duratti jilbeenfate.
english: When he saw Jesus from afar, he ran and bowed down to him,

kikuyu: Sagalee ol fudhatee iyyees, “Yaa Yesuus Ilma Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii, ati maal narraa barbaadda? Maqaa Waaqaatiin sin kadhadhaatii maaloo na hin dhiphisin!” jedheen.
english: and crying out with a loud voice, he said, “What have I to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I adjure you by God, don’t torment me.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Yaa hafuura xuraaʼaa, namicha kana keessaa baʼi!” jedheenii tureetii.
english: For he said to him, “Come out of the man, you unclean spirit!”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Maqaan kee eenyu?” jedhee isa gaafate. Innis, “Nu waan baayʼee taaneef, maqaan koo Leegewoon” jedhee deebise.
english: He asked him, “What is your name?” He said to him, “My name is Legion, for we are many.”

kikuyu: Akka inni biyya sana keessaa isaan hin ariineefis guddisee Yesuusin kadhate.
english: He begged him much that he would not send them away out of the country.

kikuyu: Hoomaan booyyee guddaan isaas gaara bira dheedaa ture.
english: Now on the mountainside there was a great herd of pigs feeding.

kikuyu: Hafuuronni hamoon sunis, “Gara hoomaa booyyee sanaatti nu ergi; akka itti galluufis nuu eeyyami” jedhanii Yesuusin kadhatan.
english: All the demons begged him, saying, “Send us into the pigs, that we may enter into them.”

kikuyu: Innis ni eeyyameef; hafuuronni xuraaʼoon sun baʼanii booyyee sanatti galan. Hoomaan gara booyyee kuma lamaa of keessaa qabu sunis ededa hallayyaa irraa gad furguggifamee galaanatti namʼee liqimfame.
english: At once Jesus gave them permission. The unclean spirits came out and entered into the pigs. The herd of about two thousand rushed down the steep bank into the sea, and they were drowned in the sea.

kikuyu: Warri booyyeewwan tiksan sunis baqatanii magaalaa fi baadiyyaatti waan kana odeessan; namoonnis waan taʼe sana ilaaluu yaaʼan.
english: Those who fed the pigs fled, and told it in the city and in the country. The people came to see what it was that had happened.

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu gara Yesuus dhufanitti namicha Leegewoonii hafuurota hamootiin qabamee ture sana wayyaa uffatee, qalbii isaattis deebiʼee achi taaʼee argan; ni sodaatanis.
english: They came to Jesus, and saw him who had been possessed by demons sitting, clothed, and in his right mind, even him who had the legion; and they were afraid.

kikuyu: Warri waan kana arganii turanis waan namicha hafuurota hamoon qabamee ture sanaaf taʼee fi waaʼee hoomaa booyyees namootatti odeessan.
english: Those who saw it declared to them what happened to him who was possessed by demons, and about the pigs.

kikuyu: Kana irratti jarri akka Yesuus biyya isaanii keessaa baʼuuf isa kadhachuu jalqaban.
english: They began to beg him to depart from their region.

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuus bidiruu yaabbachaa jiruu namichi hafuura hamaan qabamee ture sun isa wajjin deemuuf isa kadhate.
english: As he was entering into the boat, he who had been possessed by demons begged him that he might be with him.

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu, “Gara mana keetii, warra keetti galiitii waan guddaa Gooftaan siif godhee fi akkamitti akka inni si maares isaanitti odeessi!” jedheen malee hin eeyyamneef.
english: He didn’t allow him, but said to him, “Go to your house, to your friends, and tell them what great things the Lord has done for you and how he had mercy on you.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namichi sun dhaqee waan Yesuus isaaf godhe Magaalaa Kurnan keessatti odeessuu jalqabe. Namoonni hundinuus ni dinqifatan.
english: He went his way, and began to proclaim in Decapolis how Jesus had done great things for him, and everyone marveled.

kikuyu: Yommuu Yesuus bidiruudhaan ammas gara gama galaanaatti ceʼetti namoonni hedduun isa biratti walitti qabaman; innis qarqara galaanaa ture.
english: When Jesus had crossed back over in the boat to the other side, a great multitude was gathered to him; and he was by the sea.

kikuyu: Hooggantoota mana sagadaa keessaas namichi Yaaʼiiros jedhamu tokko dhufe; innis yommuu Yesuusin argetti, miilla isaa irratti kufee,
english: Behold, one of the rulers of the synagogue, Jairus by name, came; and seeing him, he fell at his feet

kikuyu: “Intalli koo xinnoon duʼuu geesseerti. Akka isheen fayyitee jiraattuuf, maaloo kottuutii harka kee ishee irra kaʼi” jedhee jabeessee isa kadhate.
english: and begged him much, saying, “My little daughter is at the point of death. Please come and lay your hands on her, that she may be made healthy, and live.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yesuus isa wajjin dhaqe. Namoonni baayʼeenis isa duukaa buʼan; gara isaattis wal dhiibaa turan.
english: He went with him, and a great multitude followed him, and they pressed upon him on all sides.

kikuyu: Dubartiin dhiigni ishee waggaa kudha lama dhangalaʼaa ture tokkos achi turte.
english: A certain woman who had a discharge of blood for twelve years,

kikuyu: Isheenis ogeeyyii fayyaa baayʼee biratti akka malee dhiphatte; waan qabdu hundumas of harkaa fixxe; garuu ittuma hammaachaa deeme malee itti hin wayyoofne.
english: and had suffered many things by many physicians, and had spent all that she had, and was no better, but rather grew worse,

kikuyu: Isheenis yommuu waaʼee Yesuus dhageessetti dugda isaa duubaan namoota gidduudhaan dhuftee uffata isaa tuqxe.
english: having heard the things concerning Jesus, came up behind him in the crowd and touched his clothes.

kikuyu: Isheen, “Ani yoon uffatuma isaa illee tuqe nan fayya” jettee yaaddee turteetii.
english: For she said, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be made well.”

kikuyu: Dhiigni ishees yommusuma cite; isheenis akka dhiphina ishee irraa fayyite dhagna ishee keessatti hubatte.
english: Immediately the flow of her blood was dried up, and she felt in her body that she was healed of her affliction.

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommusuma akka humni isa keessaa baʼe hubate. Innis namoota keessa garagalee, “Eenyutu uffata koo tuqe?” jedhee gaafate.
english: Immediately Jesus, perceiving in himself that the power had gone out from him, turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaas deebisanii, “Akka namoonni si dhiibaa jiran utuma argituu, ‘Eenyutu na tuqe?’ jettee gaafattaa?” jedhan.
english: His disciples said to him, “You see the multitude pressing against you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu namni waan kana godhe eenyuu akka taʼe arguuf jedhee garagalee ilaale.
english: He looked around to see her who had done this thing.

kikuyu: Dubartittiinis waan isheef godhame hubattee sodaadhaan hollachaa dhuftee miilla isaa irratti kufte; dhugaa hundumas isatti himte.
english: But the woman, fearing and trembling, knowing what had been done to her, came and fell down before him, and told him all the truth.

kikuyu: Innis, “Yaa intalaa, amantiin kee si fayyiseera. Nagaan deemi; dhiphina kee irraas fayyi” jedheen.
english: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has made you well. Go in peace, and be cured of your disease.”

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuus dubbachaa jiruus namoonni tokko tokko mana Yaaʼiiroos bulchaa mana sagadaatii dhufanii, “Intalli kee duuteerti; ati siʼachi maaliif barsiisicha rakkifta?” jedhan.
english: While he was still speaking, people came from the synagogue ruler’s house, saying, “Your daughter is dead. Why bother the Teacher any more?”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu waan isaan jedhan jalaa qabuu didee bulchaa mana sagadaa sanaan, “Amani malee hin sodaatin!” jedhe.
english: But Jesus, when he heard the message spoken, immediately said to the ruler of the synagogue, “Don’t be afraid, only believe.”

kikuyu: Innis Phexros, Yaaqoobii fi Yohannis obboleessa Yaaqoob malee akka namni tokko iyyuu isa faana deemu hin eeyyamne.
english: He allowed no one to follow him except Peter, James, and John the brother of James.

kikuyu: Yommuu mana hoogganaa mana sagadaa sanaa bira gaʼanittis Yesuus uummata wacu, namoota booʼanii fi wawwaatan arge.
english: He came to the synagogue ruler’s house, and he saw an uproar, weeping, and great wailing.

kikuyu: Innis ol seenee, “Wacnii fi booʼichi kun hundi maali? Intalattiin ni rafti malee hin duune” jedheen.
english: When he had entered in, he said to them, “Why do you make an uproar and weep? The child is not dead, but is asleep.”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu isatti kolfan. Innis erga hunda isaanii gad baasee booddee, abbaa fi haadha intalattii, barattoota isa wajjin turanis fudhatee iddoo intalattiin jirtu seene.
english: They ridiculed him. But he, having put them all out, took the father of the child, her mother, and those who were with him, and went in where the child was lying.

kikuyu: Innis harka ishee qabee, “Xaaliitaa quumii!” jedheen; kunis, “Yaa mucattii xinnoo, ani siin nan jedha, kaʼi!” jechuu dha.
english: Taking the child by the hand, he said to her, “Talitha cumi!” which means, being interpreted, “Girl, I tell you, get up!”

kikuyu: Mucattiinis yommusuma kaatee dhaabatte; asii fi achis deemuu jalqabde. Umuriin ishee waggaa kudha lama ture. Isaanis yommusuma akka malee dinqifatan.
english: Immediately the girl rose up and walked, for she was twelve years old. They were amazed with great amazement.

kikuyu: Innis akka namni tokko iyyuu waan kana hin beekneef ajaja cimaa kenne; akka isaan waan isheen nyaattu isheef kennan isaanitti hime.
english: He strictly ordered them that no one should know this, and commanded that something should be given to her to eat.

kikuyu: Yesuus achii baʼee gara magaalaa itti dhalatee dhaqe; barattoonni isaas isa wajjin dhaqan.
english: He went out from there. He came into his own country, and his disciples followed him.

kikuyu: Innis guyyaan Sanbataa geenyaan mana sagadaatti barsiisuu jalqabe; warri isa dhagaʼan baayʼeenis ni dinqisiifatan. Isaanis akkana jedhanii gaafatan; “Namichi kun wantoota kanneen eessaa argate? Ogummaan isaaf kenname kun maali? Hojiiwwan dinqisiisoon harka isaatiin hojjetaman kanneen akkanaa maali?
english: When the Sabbath had come, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many hearing him were astonished, saying, “Where did this man get these things?” and, “What is the wisdom that is given to this man, that such mighty works come about by his hands?

kikuyu: Namichi kun sooftuu mukaa mitii? Inni ilma Maariyaam, obboleessa Yaaqoob, kan Yoosaa, kan Yihuudaa fi kan Simoon mitii? Obboleettonni isaa as nu bira jiru mitii?” Isaanis isatti gufatan.
english: Isn’t this the carpenter, the son of Mary and brother of James, Joses, Judah, and Simon? Aren’t his sisters here with us?” So they were offended at him.

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Raajiin magaalaa itti dhalatetii, firoota isaa keessattii fi mana isaatti malee kabaja hin dhabu” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor, except in his own country, and among his own relatives, and in his own house.”

kikuyu: Innis dhukkubsattoota muraasa irra harka isaa kaaʼee fayyisuu malee hojii dinqisiisaa tokko illee achitti hojjechuu hin dandeenye.
english: He could do no mighty work there, except that he laid his hands on a few sick people and healed them.

kikuyu: Innis amantii dhabuu isaaniitiif dinqifate. Yesuusis namoota barsiisaa ganda tokko irraa gara ganda biraatti naannaʼaa ture.
english: He marveled because of their unbelief. He went around the villages teaching.

kikuyu: Warra Kudha Lamaan ofitti waamee lama lamaan isaan erguu jalqabe; hafuurota xuraaʼoo irrattis taayitaa kenneef.
english: He called to himself the twelve, and began to send them out two by two; and he gave them authority over the unclean spirits.

kikuyu: Akkana jedhees isaan ajaje: “Adeemsa keessaniif ulee malee waan tokko illee jechuunis buddeenaa fi korojoo hin qabatinaa; sabbata keessanitti immoo maallaqa hin guduunfatinaa.
english: He commanded them that they should take nothing for their journey, except a staff only: no bread, no wallet, no money in their purse,

kikuyu: Kophee kaaʼadhaa; garuu kittaa lama hin uffatinaa.
english: but to wear sandals, and not put on two tunics.

kikuyu: Yeroo mana tokko seentan kam iyyuu, hamma magaalaa sanaa baatanitti manuma sana turaa.
english: He said to them, “Wherever you enter into a house, stay there until you depart from there.

kikuyu: Yoo iddoon kam iyyuu isin simachuu baate yookaan isin dhagaʼuu baate, iddoo sanaa baʼaatii akka ragaa isaanitti taʼuuf awwaara miilla keessanii dhadhaʼadhaa.”
english: Whoever will not receive you nor hear you, as you depart from there, shake off the dust that is under your feet for a testimony against them. Assuredly, I tell you, it will be more tolerable for Sodom and Gomorrah in the day of judgment than for that city!”

kikuyu: Isaanis achii baʼanii akka namoonni qalbii jijjiirrataniif lallaban.
english: They went out and preached that people should repent.

kikuyu: Hafuurota hamoo baayʼee baasan; dhukkubsattoota baayʼees zayitii dibanii fayyisan.
english: They cast out many demons, and anointed many with oil who were sick and healed them.

kikuyu: Heroodis mootichi waaʼee waan kanaa dhagaʼe; maqaan Yesuus sirriitti beekamee tureetii. Namoonni tokko tokko, “Yohannis cuuphaan warra duʼan keessaa kaafameera; sababiin hojiin dinqii isaan hojjetamuufis kanuma” jedhan.
english: King Herod heard this, for his name had become known, and he said, “John the Baptizer has risen from the dead, and therefore these powers are at work in him.”

kikuyu: Warri kaan, “Inni Eeliyaas” jedhan. Kaan immoo, “Inni raajota durii keessaa akka isa tokkoo ti” jedhan.
english: But others said, “He is Elijah.” Others said, “He is a prophet, or like one of the prophets.”

kikuyu: Heroodis garuu yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti, “Yohannis isa ani mataa isaa irraa kutetu warra duʼan keessaa kaafame!” jedhe.
english: But Herod, when he heard this, said, “This is John, whom I beheaded. He has risen from the dead.”

kikuyu: Heroodis mataan isaa akka Yohannis qabamee, hidhamee mana hidhaatti galfamu ajajee tureetii. Innis sababii niitii obboleessa ofii isaa Fiiliphoos, sababii Heroodiyaas ishee ofii fuudhee ture sanaatiif jedhee waan kana godhe.
english: For Herod himself had sent out and arrested John and bound him in prison for the sake of Herodias, his brother Philip’s wife, for he had married her.

kikuyu: Yohannisis Heroodisiin, “Ati niitii obboleessa keetii fuudhuun kee seera miti” jedhaanii tureetii.
english: For John had said to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brother’s wife.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Heroodiyaas Yohannisitti haaloo qabattee isa ajjeesuu barbaadde. Garuu isheen hin dandeenye;
english: Herodias set herself against him and desired to kill him, but she couldn’t,

kikuyu: Heroodis akka Yohannis nama qajeelaa fi nama qulqulluu taʼe beekee, isa sodaatee, eegumsa isaaf gochaa tureetii. Heroodis yommuu waan Yohannis dubbatu dhagaʼetti akka malee rifate; taʼus gammachuudhaan isa dhaggeeffachuu barbaade.
english: for Herod feared John, knowing that he was a righteous and holy man, and kept him safe. When he heard him, he did many things, and he heard him gladly.

kikuyu: Dhuma irrattis yeroon mijaaʼaan argame. Heroodis guyyaa dhaloota isaatti qondaaltota gurguddootaaf, ajajjoota loltootaatii fi namoota Galiilaa keessatti beekamaniif irbaata qopheesse.
english: Then a convenient day came when Herod on his birthday made a supper for his nobles, the high officers, and the chief men of Galilee.

kikuyu: Intalli Heroodiyaas yommuu ol seentee sirbitetti Heroodisii fi keessummoota isaa warra irbaata affeeraman gammachiifte. Mootichis intalattiidhaan, “Waanuma barbaadde na kadhadhu; ani siif nan kenna!” jedhe.
english: When the daughter of Herodias herself came in and danced, she pleased Herod and those sitting with him. The king said to the young lady, “Ask me whatever you want, and I will give it to you.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Hamma walakkaa mootummaa kootti illee waan ati na kadhattu kam iyyuu siif nan kenna!” jedhee kakuudhaan waadaa galeef.
english: He swore to her, “Whatever you ask of me, I will give you, up to half of my kingdom.”

kikuyu: Isheenis gad baatee haadha isheetiin, “Maal kadhadhu?” jette. Haati immoo, “Mataa Yohannis Cuuphaa” jettee deebifteef.
english: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask?” She said, “The head of John the Baptizer.”

kikuyu: Intalattiinis yommusuma ariitiidhaan gara mootichaatti ol seentee, “Akka ati ammuma mataa Yohannis Cuuphaa gabatee irra keessee naa kennitu nan barbaada” jetteen.
english: She came in immediately with haste to the king and requested, “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptizer on a platter.”

kikuyu: Mootichis akka malee gadde; garuu sababii kakuu isaatii fi sababii warra isa wajjin maaddiitti dhiʼaataniitiif jedhee ishee diduu hin barbaanne.
english: The king was exceedingly sorry, but for the sake of his oaths and of his dinner guests, he didn’t wish to refuse her.

kikuyu: Innis yommusuma loltuu tokko akka inni mataa Yohannis fiduuf ajajee erge. Loltuun sunis dhaqee mana hidhaa keessatti mataa Yohannis isa irraa kute;
english: Immediately the king sent out a soldier of his guard and commanded to bring John’s head; and he went and beheaded him in the prison,

kikuyu: mataa isaas gabatee irra kaaʼee fidee intalattiitti kenne. Isheenis haadha isheetti kennite.
english: and brought his head on a platter, and gave it to the young lady; and the young lady gave it to her mother.

kikuyu: Barattoonni Yohannisis waan kana dhageenyaan dhufanii reeffa isaa fuudhanii awwaala keessa kaaʼan.
english: When his disciples heard this, they came and took up his corpse and laid it in a tomb.

kikuyu: Ergamoonnis Yesuus biratti walitti qabamanii waan hojjetanii turanii fi waan barsiisanii turan hunda isatti himan.
english: The apostles gathered themselves together to Jesus, and they told him all things, whatever they had done, and whatever they had taught.

kikuyu: Innis, “Kophaa keessan gara iddoo namni hin jirre tokkoo kottaatii takka boqodhaa” jedheen; isaan sababii namoonni baayʼeen dhufaa, deemaas turaniif carraa itti waa nyaatan illee hin qaban tureetii.
english: He said to them, “Come away into a deserted place, and rest awhile.” For there were many coming and going, and they had no leisure so much as to eat.

kikuyu: Isaanis kophaa isaanii bidiruudhaan iddoo namni hin jirre tokko dhaqan.
english: They went away in the boat to a deserted place by themselves.

kikuyu: Namoonni deemuu isaanii argan baayʼeen garuu isaan beekan; magaalaawwan hunda keessaa baʼanii miillaan fiiganii isaan dursanii iddoo sana gaʼan.
english: They saw them going, and many recognized him and ran there on foot from all the cities. They arrived before them and came together to him.

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu bidiruu irraa buʼetti tuuta guddaa tokko arge; innis sababii isaan akkuma hoolota tiksee hin qabnee turaniif garaa laafeef. Kanaafuu inni waan baayʼee isaan barsiisuu jalqabe.
english: Jesus came out, saw a great multitude, and he had compassion on them because they were like sheep without a shepherd; and he began to teach them many things.

kikuyu: Yeroo kanatti galgalaaʼee ture; kanaafuu barattoonni isaa gara isaa dhufanii akkana jedhaniin; “Iddoon kun gammoojjii dha; aduunis dhiiteerti.
english: When it was late in the day, his disciples came to him and said, “This place is deserted, and it is late in the day.

kikuyu: Akka isaan gara baadiyyaatii fi gandoota naannoo kana jiranii dhaqanii waan nyaatan bitataniif namoota kanneen gad dhiisi.”
english: Send them away, that they may go into the surrounding country and villages and buy themselves bread, for they have nothing to eat.”

kikuyu: Inni garuu, “Isinuu waan isaan nyaatan kennaafii” jedhee deebise. Isaanis, “Dhaqnee buddeena diinaarii dhibba lamaa binnee akka nyaataniif isaaniif kenninuu ree?” jedhaniin.
english: But he answered them, “You give them something to eat.” They asked him, “Shall we go and buy two hundred denarii worth of bread and give them something to eat?”

kikuyu: Innis, “Buddeena meeqa qabdu? Mee dhaqaa ilaalaa!” jedheen. Isaanis yommuu arganitti, “Buddeena shanii fi qurxummii lama” jedhan.
english: He said to them, “How many loaves do you have? Go see.” When they knew, they said, “Five, and two fish.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akka isaan namoota hundumaa garee gareedhaan marga lalisaa irra teteessisan isaan ajaje.
english: He commanded them that everyone should sit down in groups on the green grass.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namoonni dhibba dhibbaa fi shantama shantamaan garee gareedhaan tataaʼan.
english: They sat down in ranks, by hundreds and by fifties.

kikuyu: Innis buddeena shananii fi qurxummii lamaan sana fuudhee, gara samii ol ilaalee galata galchee buddeena sana caccabse. Akka isaan namootaaf dhiʼeessaniifis barattoota isaatti kenne. Qurxummii lamaanis hunduma isaaniitiif qoqqoode.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish; and looking up to heaven, he blessed and broke the loaves, and he gave to his disciples to set before them, and he divided the two fish among them all.

kikuyu: Isaan hundi nyaatanii quufan;
english: They all ate and were filled.

kikuyu: barattoonnis hurraaʼaa buddeenaatii fi qurxummii gundoo kudha lama guutuu walitti qaban.
english: They took up twelve baskets full of broken pieces and also of the fish.

kikuyu: Warri nyaatanis dhiira kuma shan turan.
english: Those who ate the loaves were five thousand men.

kikuyu: Yesuus yommusuma akka barattoonni isaa bidiruu yaabbatanii hamma inni tuuta sana of irraa geggeessutti isa dura gara Beetisayidaatti darbaniif isaan dirqisiise.
english: Immediately he made his disciples get into the boat and go ahead to the other side, to Bethsaida, while he himself sent the multitude away.

kikuyu: Innis erga namoota of irraa geggeessee booddee kadhachuuf gaaratti ol baʼe.
english: After he had taken leave of them, he went up the mountain to pray.

kikuyu: Yommuu galgalaaʼettis bidiruun sun galaana walakkaa ture; Yesuus immoo kophaa isaa lafa irra ture.
english: When evening had come, the boat was in the middle of the sea, and he was alone on the land.

kikuyu: Innis utuu barattoonni sababii bubbeen fuula isaanii duraan itti dhufeef bishaan mooquudhaan dhiphatanuu arge. Innis halkan keessaa kutaa afuraffaatti galaana irra deemaa gara isaanii dhufe. Innis waan isaan bira darbu fakkaate;
english: Seeing them distressed in rowing, for the wind was contrary to them, about the fourth watch of the night he came to them, walking on the sea; and he would have passed by them,

kikuyu: isaan garuu yommuu galaana irra deemuu isaa arganitti ekeraa seʼanii iyyan;
english: but they, when they saw him walking on the sea, supposed that it was a ghost, and cried out;

kikuyu: isaan hundi isa arganii akka malee naʼaniitii. Inni immoo, “Jabaadhaa! Anumaatii hin sodaatinaa” jedhee yommusuma isaanitti dubbate.
english: for they all saw him and were troubled. But he immediately spoke with them and said to them, “Cheer up! It is I! Don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Innis isaan wajjin bidiruu yaabbate; bubbeen sunis gab jedhe. Isaanis akka malee dinqisiifatan;
english: He got into the boat with them; and the wind ceased, and they were very amazed among themselves, and marveled;

kikuyu: isaan waaʼee buddeennan sanaa hin hubanneetii; mata jabeeyyiis turan.
english: for they hadn’t understood about the loaves, but their hearts were hardened.

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu gama ceʼanitti Geensereexitti bidiruu irraa buʼan; bidiruu sanas achitti hidhan.
english: When they had crossed over, they came to land at Gennesaret and moored to the shore.

kikuyu: Akkuma isaan bidiruu irraa buʼaniinis namoonni Yesuusin beekan.
english: When they had come out of the boat, immediately the people recognized him,

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis biyya sana guutuu keessa asii fi achi fiiganii iddoo Yesuus achi jira jechuu dhagaʼan hundumatti dhukkubsattoota sireedhaan baatanii fiduu jalqaban.
english: and ran around that whole region, and began to bring those who were sick on their mats to where they heard he was.

kikuyu: Iddoo inni dhaqe kam illee jechuunis gandoota, magaalaawwan yookaan baadiyyaa hundatti warra dhukkubsatan fidanii lafa gabaa kaaʼan. Isaanis akka dhukkubsattoonni sun handaara wayyaa isaa illee tuqaniif isa kadhatan; warri handaaruma wayyaa isaa tuqan hundinuus ni fayyan.
english: Wherever he entered—into villages, or into cities, or into the country—they laid the sick in the marketplaces and begged him that they might just touch the fringe of his garment; and as many as touched him were made well.

kikuyu: Fariisotaa fi barsiistota seeraa keessaa warri Yerusaalemii dhufan tokko tokko Yesuus biratti walitti qabamanii
english: Then the Pharisees and some of the scribes gathered together to him, having come from Jerusalem.

kikuyu: barattoota isaa keessaa tokko tokko harka, “Hin qulqulleeffaminiin” jechuunis utuu harka hin dhiqatin buddeena nyaachuu isaanii argan.
english: Now when they saw some of his disciples eating bread with defiled, that is unwashed, hands, they found fault.

kikuyu: Sababiin isaas Fariisonni, Yihuudoonni hundinuus duudhaa maanguddootaa eeguuf jedhanii utuu harka hin dhiqatin hin nyaataniitii.
english: (For the Pharisees and all the Jews don’t eat unless they wash their hands and forearms, holding to the tradition of the elders.

kikuyu: Yommuu gabaadhaa galanittis utuu of hin qulqulleessin hin nyaatan. Dudhaa biraa baayʼees kan akka xoofoo dhiquu, okkotee fi huuroo dhiquu ni eegu.
english: They don’t eat when they come from the marketplace unless they bathe themselves, and there are many other things which they have received to hold to: washings of cups, pitchers, bronze vessels, and couches.)

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Fariisonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa, “Barattoonni kee qooda harka ‘Hin qulqulleeffaminiin’ nyaatan maaliif akkuma duudhaa maanguddootaatti hin jiraanne?” jedhanii Yesuusin gaafatan.
english: The Pharisees and the scribes asked him, “Why don’t your disciples walk according to the tradition of the elders, but eat their bread with unwashed hands?”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebise; “Yaa fakkeessitoota, Isaayyaas yommuu waaʼee keessan raajii dubbatetti sirrii ture; kunis akkuma akkana jedhamee barreeffamee dha: “ ‘Uumanni kun hidhii isaatiin na kabaja; garaan isaa garuu narraa fagoo jira.
english: He answered them, “Well did Isaiah prophesy of you hypocrites, as it is written, ‘This people honors me with their lips, but their heart is far from me.

kikuyu: Isaan akkanumaan na waaqeffatu; barsiisni isaaniis sirnuma namaa ti.’
english: They worship me in vain, teaching as doctrines the commandments of men.’

kikuyu: Isin ajaja Waaqaa dhiiftanii, duudhaa namootaa jabeessitanii eegdu.”
english: “For you set aside the commandment of God, and hold tightly to the tradition of men—the washing of pitchers and cups, and you do many other such things.”

kikuyu: Innis ittuma fufee akkana jedheen; “Isin duudhaa ofii keessanii eeguuf jettanii ajaja Waaqaa tuffachuuf mala gaarii qabdu!
english: He said to them, “Full well do you reject the commandment of God, that you may keep your tradition.

kikuyu: Museen, ‘Abbaa keetii fi haadha keetiif ulfina kenni;namni abbaa isaa yookaan haadha isaa arrabsu kam iyyuu haa ajjeefamu’jedheeraatii.
english: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and your mother;’ and, ‘He who speaks evil of father or mother, let him be put to death.’

kikuyu: Isin garuu yoo namni kam iyyuu akka wanni silaa abbaa isaa yookaan haadha isaa gargaaruuf oolu Qurbaana jechuunis Waaqaaf kennameera jedhee dubbate,
english: But you say, ‘If a man tells his father or his mother, “Whatever profit you might have received from me is Corban,”’” that is to say, given to God,

kikuyu: isin akka inni abbaa isaatiif yookaan haadha isaatiif waan tokko illee godhu siʼachi hin eeyyamtaniif.
english: “then you no longer allow him to do anything for his father or his mother,

kikuyu: Akkanaanis duudhaa keessan isa walitti dabarsitan sanaan dubbii Waaqaa busheessitu. Waan akkanaa baayʼees ni hojjetu.”
english: making void the word of God by your tradition which you have handed down. You do many things like this.”

kikuyu: Yesuus ammas namoota sana ofitti waamee akkana jedheen; “Isin hundi na dhagaʼaa; kanas hubadhaa.
english: He called all the multitude to himself and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.

kikuyu: Waan nama keessaa baʼutu nama ‘xureessa’ malee wanni alaa namatti seenee nama ‘xureessuu’ dandaʼu tokko iyyuu hin jiru. [
english: There is nothing from outside of the man that going into him can defile him; but the things which proceed out of the man are those that defile the man.

kikuyu: Namni kam iyyuu yoo gurra dhagaʼu qabaate haa dhagaʼu.”]
english: If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear!”

kikuyu: Erga inni namoota biraa mana ol seenee booddee barattoonni isaa waaʼee fakkeenya sanaa isa gaafatan.
english: When he had entered into a house away from the multitude, his disciples asked him about the parable.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee gaafate; “Isin hin hubattanii? Akka wanni alaa namatti seenu tokko iyyuu nama ‘xureessuu’ hin dandeenye hin qalbeeffattanii?
english: He said to them, “Are you also without understanding? Don’t you perceive that whatever goes into the man from outside can’t defile him,

kikuyu: Wanni sun garaa isaa seenee ergasii dhagna isaa keessaa gad baʼa malee yaada garaaisaa hin seenuutii.” Yesuusis kana jechuudhaan akka nyaanni hundinuu qulqulluu taʼe labse.
english: because it doesn’t go into his heart, but into his stomach, then into the latrine, making all foods clean?”

kikuyu: Innis itti fufee akkana jedhe: “Wanni nama ‘xureessu’ waan nama keessaa baʼuu dha.
english: He said, “That which proceeds out of the man, that defiles the man.

kikuyu: Yaadni hamaan keessa namaatii, garaa namaa keessaa baʼaatii; innis halalummaa, hanna, nama ajjeesuu, ejja,
english: For from within, out of the hearts of men, proceed evil thoughts, adulteries, sexual sins, murders, thefts,

kikuyu: doqnummaa, hammina, gowwoomsaa, jireenya gad dhiisii, hinaaffaa, maqaa nama balleessuu, of tuulummaa fi gowwummaa.
english: covetings, wickedness, deceit, lustful desires, an evil eye, blasphemy, pride, and foolishness.

kikuyu: Wantoonni hamoon kunneen hundinuu nama keessaa baʼu; namas ‘ni xureessu.’ ”
english: All these evil things come from within and defile the man.”

kikuyu: Yesuus iddoo sanaa kaʼee aanaa Xiiroositti qajeele. Mana tokkos ol seene; innis akka namni tokko iyyuu achi jiraachuu isaa beeku hin barbaanne; garuu dhokachuu hin dandeenye.
english: From there he arose and went away into the borders of Tyre and Sidon. He entered into a house and didn’t want anyone to know it, but he couldn’t escape notice.

kikuyu: Dubartiin intalli ishee hafuura xuraaʼaan qabamte tokko akkuma waaʼee isaa dhageesseen dhuftee miilla isaa irratti kufte.
english: For a woman whose little daughter had an unclean spirit, having heard of him, came and fell down at his feet.

kikuyu: Dubartittiinis nama Giriik, kan biyya Sooriyaa keessatti Finiiqeetti dhalatee dha. Isheen akka inni intala ishee keessaa hafuura hamaa sana baasuuf Yesuusin kadhatte.
english: Now the woman was a Greek, a Syrophoenician by race. She begged him that he would cast the demon out of her daughter.

kikuyu: Innis, “Dura ijoolleen haa quuftu; buddeena ijoollee fuudhanii saroota dura buusuun sirrii miti” jedheen.
english: But Jesus said to her, “Let the children be filled first, for it is not appropriate to take the children’s bread and throw it to the dogs.”

kikuyu: Isheen garuu, “Eeyyee yaa Gooftaa, saroonni iyyuu maaddii jalaa hambaa ijoolleen harcaaftu nyaatuu” jettee deebifteef.
english: But she answered him, “Yes, Lord. Yet even the dogs under the table eat the children’s crumbs.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Jecha kee kanaaf gali; hafuurri hamaan sun intala kee keessaa baʼeera” jedheen.
english: He said to her, “For this saying, go your way. The demon has gone out of your daughter.”

kikuyu: Isheenis yommuu manatti galtetti intalli ishee siree irra ciiftee, hafuurri hamaan sunis keessaa baʼee argatte.
english: She went away to her house, and found the child having been laid on the bed, with the demon gone out.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Yesuus biyya Xiiroosiitii kaʼee Siidoonaa keessa darbee, kutaa Magaalaa Kurnanii keessa baʼee gara galaana Galiilaa dhufe.
english: Again he departed from the borders of Tyre and Sidon, and came to the sea of Galilee through the middle of the region of Decapolis.

kikuyu: Jarri tokkos namicha gurra duudaa fi arrab-didaa tokko isatti fidanii akka inni harka isa irra kaaʼuuf kadhatan.
english: They brought to him one who was deaf and had an impediment in his speech. They begged him to lay his hand on him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis namicha sana tuuta keessaa kophaatti baasee quba isaa gurra namichaa keessa kaaʼe. Hancufa tufees arraba namichaa tuqe.
english: He took him aside from the multitude privately and put his fingers into his ears; and he spat and touched his tongue.

kikuyu: Gara samiis ol ilaalee, hafuura guddaa baafatee, “Eftaah!” jedheen; kana jechuunis “Banami!” jechuu dha.
english: Looking up to heaven, he sighed, and said to him, “Ephphatha!” that is, “Be opened!”

kikuyu: Gurri namichaas yommusuma baname; arrabni isaas hiikamee rakkina tokko malee dubbachuu jalqabe.
english: Immediately his ears were opened, and the impediment of his tongue was released, and he spoke clearly.

kikuyu: Yesuusis akka isaan nama tokkotti illee hin himneef namoota sana ajaje. Hammuma inni cimsee isaan ajaje sana, isaanis ittuma caalchisanii odeessan.
english: He commanded them that they should tell no one, but the more he commanded them, so much the more widely they proclaimed it.

kikuyu: Warri oduu sana dhagaʼanis akka malee dinqifatanii, “Inni waan hunda gaarii godheera; warri duudaanis akka dhagaʼan, warri arrabni isaanii dubbachuu dides akka dubbatan ni godha” jedhan.
english: They were astonished beyond measure, saying, “He has done all things well. He makes even the deaf hear and the mute speak!”

kikuyu: Gidduu sana tuunni biraa guddaan isaa ammas walitti qabame. Yesuusis sababii tuunni sun waan nyaatu hin qabaatiniif barattoota isaa ofitti waamee akkana jedhe;
english: In those days, when there was a very great multitude, and they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to himself and said to them,

kikuyu: “Sababii isaan guyyaa sadii na bira turanii waan nyaatan tokko illee hin qabneef, ani namoota kanneeniif garaa nan laafa.
english: “I have compassion on the multitude, because they have stayed with me now three days and have nothing to eat.

kikuyu: Yoo ani agabuu isaanii gad isaan dhiise, isaan karaa irratti ni gaggabu; isaan keessaa tokko tokko fagoodhaa dhufaniitii.”
english: If I send them away fasting to their home, they will faint on the way, for some of them have come a long way.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaas deebisanii, “Namni kam iyyuu gammoojjii kana keessatti buddeena isaan gaʼu eessaa argachuu dandaʼa?” jedhan.
english: His disciples answered him, “From where could one satisfy these people with bread here in a deserted place?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Isin buddeena meeqa qabdu?” jedhee gaafate. Isaanis, “Torba” jedhan.
english: He asked them, “How many loaves do you have?” They said, “Seven.”

kikuyu: Innis akka namoonni sun lafa tataaʼan itti hime. Buddeena torban fuudhee erga galateeffatee booddee kukkutee akka isaan namootaaf dhiʼeessaniif barattoota isaatti kenne; isaanis namootaaf dhiʼeessan.
english: He commanded the multitude to sit down on the ground, and he took the seven loaves. Having given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to serve, and they served the multitude.

kikuyu: Akkasumas qurxummii xixinnoo muraasa qabu turan; qurxummii sanas eebbisee akka isaan namootaaf hiraniif barattoota isaatti hime.
english: They also had a few small fish. Having blessed them, he said to serve these also.

kikuyu: Namoonnis nyaatanii quufan. Ergasiis barattoonni hambaa gundoo torba guutuu walitti qaban.
english: They ate and were filled. They took up seven baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

kikuyu: Isaanis gara nama kuma afurii turan. Innis erga of irraa isaan geggeessee booddee,
english: Those who had eaten were about four thousand. Then he sent them away.

kikuyu: barattoota isaa wajjin yommusuma bidiruu yaabbatee biyya Daalmaanutaa dhaqe.
english: Immediately he entered into the boat with his disciples and came into the region of Dalmanutha.

kikuyu: Fariisonnis dhufanii Yesuusitti falmuu jalqaban; isa qoruuf jedhaniis mallattoo samii irraa isa irraa barbaadan.
english: The Pharisees came out and began to question him, seeking from him a sign from heaven and testing him.

kikuyu: Innis hafuura dheeraa baafatee, “Dhaloonni kun maaliif mallattoo barbaada? Ani dhuguma isinitti hima; mallattoon tokko iyyuu dhaloota kanaaf hin kennamu” jedheen.
english: He sighed deeply in his spirit and said, “Why does this generation seek a sign? Most certainly I tell you, no sign will be given to this generation.”

kikuyu: Innis isaan dhiisee bidiruutti deebiʼee gama ceʼe.
english: He left them, and again entering into the boat, departed to the other side.

kikuyu: Barattoonnis buddeena tokkicha bidiruu keessaa of biraa qaban sana malee buddeena fudhachuu irraanfatanii turan.
english: They forgot to take bread; and they didn’t have more than one loaf in the boat with them.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Beekkadhaa; raacitii Fariisotaatii fi raacitii Heroodis irraa of eeggadhaa” jedhee isaan akeekkachiise.
english: He warned them, saying, “Take heed: beware of the yeast of the Pharisees and the yeast of Herod.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Kun sababii nu buddeena hin qabneef” jedhanii walii wajjin haasaʼan.
english: They reasoned with one another, saying, “It’s because we have no bread.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis waan isaan haasaʼan beekee akkana jedhee isaan gaafate; “Isin maaliif waaʼee buddeena dhabuu keessanii dudubbattu? Isin amma iyyuu hin argitanii? Yookaan hin hubattanii? Mataa jabaattanii?
english: Jesus, perceiving it, said to them, “Why do you reason that it’s because you have no bread? Don’t you perceive yet or understand? Is your heart still hardened?

kikuyu: Isin utuma ija qabdanuu hin argitanii? Utuma gurra qabdanuus hin dhageessanii? Hin yaadattanii?
english: Having eyes, don’t you see? Having ears, don’t you hear? Don’t you remember?

kikuyu: Yeroo ani buddeena shanan sana nama kuma shaniif caccabsetti isin hurraaʼaa gundoo meeqa guutuu kaaftan?” Isaanis, “Kudha lama” jedhaniin.
english: When I broke the five loaves among the five thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Twelve.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Yeroo ani buddeena torba nama kuma afuriif caccabsetti hambaa gundoo meeqa guutuu walitti qabdan?” jedhee gaafate. Isaanis, “Torba” jedhaniin.
english: “When the seven loaves fed the four thousand, how many baskets full of broken pieces did you take up?” They told him, “Seven.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Isin amma iyyuu hin hubattanii?” jedheen.
english: He asked them, “Don’t you understand yet?”

kikuyu: Isaanis Beetisayidaa dhaqan; jarri tokkos namicha jaamaa tokko fidanii akka inni isa qaqqabuuf Yesuusin kadhatan.
english: He came to Bethsaida. They brought a blind man to him and begged him to touch him.

kikuyu: Innis namicha jaamaa sana harka qabee ganda sana keessaa baase. Ija isaattis tufee, harka isaas irra kaaʼee, “Waa arguu dandeessaa?” jedhee gaafate.
english: He took hold of the blind man by the hand, and brought him out of the village. When he had spat on his eyes, and laid his hands on him, he asked him if he saw anything.

kikuyu: Namichis ol ilaalee, “Namoota nan arga; isaan muka deemu natti fakkaatu” jedhe.
english: He looked up, and said, “I see men, but I see them like walking trees.”

kikuyu: Yesuus amma illee harka isaa ija namichaa irra kaaʼe. Iji namichaas ni baname; agartuun isaa ni deebiʼeef; waan hundas sirriitti arge.
english: Then again he laid his hands on his eyes. He looked intently, and was restored, and saw everyone clearly.

kikuyu: Yesuusis namichaan, “Gara ganda sanaa seentee waan kana nama tokkotti illee hin himin” jedhee gara mana isaatti isa erge.
english: He sent him away to his house, saying, “Don’t enter into the village, nor tell anyone in the village.”

kikuyu: Yesuusii fi barattoonni isaa gara gandoota naannoo Fiiliphoos Qiisaariyaa jiraniitti darban. Innis, “Namoonni anaan eenyu jedhu?” jedhee karaa irratti isaan gaafate.
english: Jesus went out, with his disciples, into the villages of Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked his disciples, “Who do men say that I am?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Namoonni tokko tokko, ‘Inni Yohannis Cuuphaa dha’ jedhu; warri kaan, ‘inni Eeliyaas’ jedhu; kaan immoo, ‘inni raajota keessaa isa tokkoo dha’ jedhu” jedhanii deebisan.
english: They told him, “John the Baptizer, and others say Elijah, but others, one of the prophets.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Isin eenyu anaan jettu?” jedhee gaafate. Phexrosis, “Ati Kiristoos” jedhee deebise.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Christ.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akka isaan waaʼee isaa nama tokkotti illee hin himneef isaan akeekkachiise.
english: He commanded them that they should tell no one about him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis akka Ilmi Namaa waan hedduun dhiphachuu qabu, akka maanguddootaan, luboota hangafootaa fi barsiistota seeraatiin tuffatamuu qabuu fi akka ajjeefamuu qabu, guyyaa sadii booddee immoo akka duʼaa kaʼu isaan barsiisuu jalqabe.
english: He began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests, and the scribes, and be killed, and after three days rise again.

kikuyu: Innis waaʼee kanaa ifatti baasee dubbate; Phexrosis kophaatti baasee isa ifachuu jalqabe.
english: He spoke to them openly. Peter took him and began to rebuke him.

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu of irra garagalee barattoota isaa ilaale; Phexrosiinis, “Seexana nana! Na duubatti deebiʼi! Ati kan namaa yaadda malee kan Waaqaa hin yaadduutii” jedhee ifate.
english: But he, turning around and seeing his disciples, rebuked Peter, and said, “Get behind me, Satan! For you have in mind not the things of God, but the things of men.”

kikuyu: Ergasii inni tuuta sanaa fi barattoota isaa ofitti waamee akkana jedhe; “Namni kam iyyuu yoo na faana dhufuu barbaade, inni of haa ganu; fannoo isaa baadhatees na duukaa haa buʼu.
english: He called the multitude to himself with his disciples and said to them, “Whoever wants to come after me, let him deny himself, and take up his cross, and follow me.

kikuyu: Namni lubbuu isaa oolfachuu barbaadu kam iyyuu lubbuu isaa ni dhabaatii; garuu namni anaa fi wangeelaaf jedhee lubbuu isaa dhabu kam iyyuu lubbuu isaa ni oolfata.
english: For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good News will save it.

kikuyu: Namni yoo addunyaa guutuu argatee lubbuu isaa immoo dhabe buʼaa maalii argata?
english: For what does it profit a man to gain the whole world and forfeit his life?

kikuyu: Yookaan namni qooda lubbuu isaa maal kennuu dandaʼa?
english: For what will a man give in exchange for his life?

kikuyu: Yoo namni kam iyyuu dhaloota ejjaa fi cubbamaa kana keessatti anaa fi dubbii kootti qaanaʼe, Ilmi Namaa yommuu ulfina Abbaa isaatiin ergamoota qulqulluu wajjin dhufutti isatti ni qaanaʼa.”
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man also will be ashamed of him when he comes in his Father’s glory with the holy angels.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; warra as dhadhaabachaa jiran keessaa namoonni tokko tokko hamma mootummaan Waaqaa humnaan dhufee arganitti duʼa hin dhandhaman” isaaniin jedhe.
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there are some standing here who will in no way taste death until they see God’s Kingdom come with power.”

kikuyu: Yesuus guyyaa jaʼa booddee Phexrosin, Yaaqoobii fi Yohannisin fudhatee tulluu dheeraa tokkotti iddoo isaan hundi kophaa turuu dandaʼanitti ol isaan baase. Innis achitti fuula isaanii duratti geeddarame.
english: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James, and John, and brought them up onto a high mountain privately by themselves, and he was changed into another form in front of them.

kikuyu: Uffanni isaas uffata namni addunyaa kanaa kam iyyuu miicee addeessuu dandaʼu caalaa akka malee addaate.
english: His clothing became glistening, exceedingly white, like snow, such as no launderer on earth can whiten them.

kikuyu: Eeliyaasii fi Museenis isaanitti mulʼatan; isaanis Yesuus wajjin haasaʼaa turan.
english: Elijah and Moses appeared to them, and they were talking with Jesus.

kikuyu: Phexrosis Yesuusiin, “Yaa Barsiisaa, as jiraachuun nuuf gaarii dha; daasii sadii, tokko siif, tokko Museef, tokko immoo Eeliyaasiif ni ijaarra” jedhe.
english: Peter answered Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah.”

kikuyu: Inni waan dubbatu hin beeku ture; isaan akka malee sodaatanii turaniitii.
english: For he didn’t know what to say, for they were very afraid.

kikuyu: Duumessis dhufee isaan haguuge; sagaleen, “Kun Ilma koo isa ani jaalladhuu dha. Isinis isa dhagaʼaa!” jedhu tokko duumessicha keessaa dhufe.
english: A cloud came, overshadowing them, and a voice came out of the cloud, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him.”

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu akkuma tasaa naannoo isaanii ilaalanitti Yesuusin malee nama tokko illee of biratti hin argine.
english: Suddenly looking around, they saw no one with them any more, except Jesus only.

kikuyu: Utuu tulluu sana irraa buʼuutti jiranuus Yesuus akka isaan hamma Ilmi Namaa warra duʼan keessaa kaʼutti waan argan sana nama tokkotti illee hin himne isaan ajaje.
english: As they were coming down from the mountain, he commanded them that they should tell no one what things they had seen, until after the Son of Man had risen from the dead.

kikuyu: Isaanis “warra duʼan keessaa kaʼuun” maal akka taʼe wal gaggaafachaa dubbicha garaatti qabatan.
english: They kept this saying to themselves, questioning what the “rising from the dead” meant.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Barsiistonni seeraa maaliif Eeliyaas akka duraan dursee dhufuu qabu dubbatu?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: They asked him, saying, “Why do the scribes say that Elijah must come first?”

kikuyu: Yesuus akkana jedhee deebise; “Dhugumaan Eeliyaas duraan dursee ni dhufa; waan hundas iddootti deebisa. Yoos maaliif Ilmi Namaa akka malee dhiphachuu fi tuffatamuu qaba jedhamee barreeffame ree?
english: He said to them, “Elijah indeed comes first, and restores all things. How is it written about the Son of Man, that he should suffer many things and be despised?

kikuyu: Ani garuu isinittin hima; Eeliyaas dhufeera; isaanis akkuma waaʼee isaa barreeffame sanatti waanuma fedhan hunda isatti hojjetan.”
english: But I tell you that Elijah has come, and they have also done to him whatever they wanted to, even as it is written about him.”

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu gara barattoota kaanii dhufanitti, namoonni hedduun isaanitti naannaʼanii, barsiistonni seeraa immoo utuu isaanitti falmanuu argan.
english: Coming to the disciples, he saw a great multitude around them, and scribes questioning them.

kikuyu: Namoonni hundinuus akkuma Yesuusin arganiin akka malee dinqifatanii isa dubbisuudhaaf itti fiigan.
english: Immediately all the multitude, when they saw him, were greatly amazed, and running to him, greeted him.

kikuyu: Innis, “Isin maal isaanitti falmitu?” jedhee isaan gaafate.
english: He asked the scribes, “What are you asking them?”

kikuyu: Namoota sana keessaas namichi tokko akkana jedhee deebise; “Yaa barsiisaa, ani ilma koo kan hafuura arraba didaadhaan qabame sitti fideera.
english: One of the multitude answered, “Teacher, I brought to you my son, who has a mute spirit;

kikuyu: Hafuurichi yeroo itti kaʼu kam iyyuu, darbatee lafaan isa dhaʼa. Gurbichis hoomacha afaaniin baasa; ilkaan qara; ni kokottaaʼas. Ani akka hafuura sana baasaniif barattoota kee nan gaafadhe; isaan garuu hin dandeenye.”
english: and wherever it seizes him, it throws him down; and he foams at the mouth, grinds his teeth, and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to cast it out, and they weren’t able.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Isin dhaloota hin amanne nana; ani hamma yoomiittin isin wajjin jiraadha? Hamma yoomiittis ani isinii obsa? Mee gurbicha natti fidaa” jedhe.
english: He answered him, “Unbelieving generation, how long shall I be with you? How long shall I bear with you? Bring him to me.”

kikuyu: Isaanis gurbicha isatti fidan. Hafuurichis akkuma Yesuusin argeen gurbicha dhidhiitachiise; gurbichis lafa dhaʼee hoomacha afaaniin baasee gangalate.
english: They brought him to him, and when he saw him, immediately the spirit convulsed him and he fell on the ground, wallowing and foaming at the mouth.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Wanni kun erga isa qabee hammam ture?” jedhee abbaa gurbichaa gaafate. Innis akkana jedhe; “Ijoollummaadhaa jalqabee ti.
english: He asked his father, “How long has it been since this has been happening to him?” He said, “From childhood.

kikuyu: Isa ajjeesuuf jedhees yeroo baayʼee ibidda keessa yookaan bishaan keessa isa buuseera. Ati garuu yoo waanuma tokko illee gochuu dandeesse garaa nuu laafiitii nu gargaari.”
english: Often it has cast him both into the fire and into the water to destroy him. But if you can do anything, have compassion on us and help us.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “ ‘Yoo dandeesse’ jettaa? Nama amanuuf wanni hundi ni dandaʼama” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “If you can believe, all things are possible to him who believes.”

kikuyu: Yommusuma abbaan mucaa sanaa, “Ani nan amana; amantii dhabuu koo na gargaari” jedhee iyye.
english: Immediately the father of the child cried out with tears, “I believe. Help my unbelief!”

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu namoota girrisanii dhufan argetti, “Yaa hafuura duudaa fi arrab-didaa nana, akka ati isa keessaa baatu, deebitees akka isatti hin galle sin ajaja” jedhee hafuura xuraaʼaa sana ifate.
english: When Jesus saw that a multitude came running together, he rebuked the unclean spirit, saying to him, “You mute and deaf spirit, I command you, come out of him, and never enter him again!”

kikuyu: Hafuurri sun iyyee, akka malees isa dhidhiitachiisee keessaa baʼe. Gurbichis akkuma reeffaa taʼe; namoonni baayʼeenis, “Inni duʼeera” jedhan.
english: After crying out and convulsing him greatly, it came out of him. The boy became like one dead, so much that most of them said, “He is dead.”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu harka qabee ol isa kaase; gurbaan sunis kaʼee dhaabate.
english: But Jesus took him by the hand and raised him up; and he arose.

kikuyu: Erga Yesuus manatti ol galee booddee barattoonni isaa, “Nu maaliif hafuura hamaa sana baasuu dadhabne?” jedhanii kophaatti isa gaafatan.
english: When he had come into the house, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldn’t we cast it out?”

kikuyu: Innis deebisee, “Inni akkanaa kun kadhannaa fi sooma qofaan baʼa malee waan biraatiin hin baʼu” jedheen.
english: He said to them, “This kind can come out by nothing but by prayer and fasting.”

kikuyu: Isaan achii kaʼanii Galiilaa keessa darban. Yesuusis akka namni tokko iyyuu kana beeku hin barbaanne;
english: They went out from there and passed through Galilee. He didn’t want anyone to know it,

kikuyu: sababiin isaas, “Ilmi Namaa dabarfamee harka namootaatti ni kennama. Isaanis isa ni ajjeesu; innis guyyaa sadii booddee duʼaa ni kaʼa” jedhee barattoota isaa barsiisaa ture.
english: for he was teaching his disciples, and said to them, “The Son of Man is being handed over to the hands of men, and they will kill him; and when he is killed, on the third day he will rise again.”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu waan inni jedhe hin hubanne; isa gaafachuus ni sodaatan.
english: But they didn’t understand the saying, and were afraid to ask him.

kikuyu: Isaanis Qifirnaahom dhaqan. Innis yeroo mana keessa turetti, “Isin karaatti maal walitti falmaa turtan?” jedhee isaan gaafate.
english: He came to Capernaum, and when he was in the house he asked them, “What were you arguing among yourselves on the way?”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu eenyu akka nama hundumaa caalu karaatti waan walitti falmaa turaniif ni calʼisan.
english: But they were silent, for they had disputed with one another on the way about who was the greatest.

kikuyu: Yesuusis taaʼee warra kudha lamaan waamee, “Namni nama jalqabaa taʼuu barbaadu kam iyyuu nama hundaa gadii fi tajaajilaa nama hundaa taʼuu qaba” jedheen.
english: He sat down and called the twelve; and he said to them, “If any man wants to be first, he shall be last of all, and servant of all.”

kikuyu: Innis mucaa xinnaa tokko fidee isaan gidduu dhaabe. Hammatees akkana isaaniin jedhe;
english: He took a little child and set him in the middle of them. Taking him in his arms, he said to them,

kikuyu: “Namni ijoollee xixinnoo kanneen keessaa tokko maqaa kootiin simatu kam iyyuu na simata; namni na simatu kam iyyuus isa na erge sana simata malee na qofa hin simatu.”
english: “Whoever receives one such little child in my name receives me; and whoever receives me, doesn’t receive me, but him who sent me.”

kikuyu: Yohannisis, “Yaa barsiisaa, nu utuu namni tokko maqaa keetiin hafuurota hamoo baasuu arginee waan inni nu duukaa hin buuneef isa dhowwine” jedhe.
english: John said to him, “Teacher, we saw someone who doesn’t follow us casting out demons in your name; and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow us.”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu akkana jedhe; “Isa hin dhowwinaa; namni maqaa kootiin dinqii hojjetu kan ergasii immoo dafee waaʼee koo waan hamaa dubbachuu dandaʼu tokko iyyuu hin jiruutii.
english: But Jesus said, “Don’t forbid him, for there is no one who will do a mighty work in my name and be able quickly to speak evil of me.

kikuyu: Namni nuun hin mormine kam iyyuu kanuma keenyaatii.
english: For whoever is not against us is on our side.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; namni sababii isin kan Kiristoos taataniif jedhee bishaan budduuqsaa tokkoo isinii kennu kam iyyuu dhugumaan gatii isaa hin dhabu.
english: For whoever will give you a cup of water to drink in my name because you are Christ’s, most certainly I tell you, he will in no way lose his reward.

kikuyu: “Namni kam iyyuu warra natti amanan xixinnaa kanneen keessaa tokko gufachiisuu irra, utuu dhagaan daakuu guddaan isaa morma isaatti hidhamee galaanatti darbatamee isaaf wayya ture.
english: “Whoever will cause one of these little ones who believe in me to stumble, it would be better for him if he were thrown into the sea with a millstone hung around his neck.

kikuyu: Yoo harki kee si gufachiise, of irraa muri. Harka lama qabaattee gahaannamitti, iddoo ibiddi isaa hin dhaamnetti galuu irra, harka dooluudhaan jireenyatti galuu siif wayya. [
english: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life maimed, rather than having your two hands to go into Gehenna, into the unquenchable fire,

kikuyu: Gahaannamis iddoo, “ ‘raammoon isaanii hin duune, ibiddis hin dhaamnee dha.’]
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

kikuyu: Yoo miilli kee si gufachiise of irraa muri. Miilla lama qabaattee gahaannamitti darbatamuu irra, laamshoftee jireenyatti galuu siif wayya. [
english: If your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter into life lame, rather than having your two feet to be cast into Gehenna, into the fire that will never be quenched—

kikuyu: Gahaannamis iddoo, “ ‘raammoon isaanii hin duune, ibiddis hin dhaamnee dha.’]
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

kikuyu: Yoo iji kee si gufachiise, of keessaa baasi. Ija lama qabaattee gahaannamiitti darbatamuu irra ija tokkoon mootummaa Waaqaatti galuu siif wayya.
english: If your eye causes you to stumble, throw it out. It is better for you to enter into God’s Kingdom with one eye, rather than having two eyes to be cast into the Gehenna of fire,

kikuyu: Gahaannamis iddoo, “ ‘raammoon isaanii hin duune, ibiddis hin dhaamnee dha.’
english: ‘where their worm doesn’t die, and the fire is not quenched.’

kikuyu: Namni hundinuu ibiddaan miʼeeffama.
english: For everyone will be salted with fire, and every sacrifice will be seasoned with salt.

kikuyu: “Soogiddi gaarii dha; garuu yoo miʼaa isaa dhabe, miʼaa isaa akkamiin deebisuufii dandeessu? Isinis soogidda of keessaa qabaadhaa; walii wajjinis nagaan jiraadhaa.”
english: Salt is good, but if the salt has lost its saltiness, with what will you season it? Have salt in yourselves, and be at peace with one another.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis achii kaʼee gara biyya Yihuudaatii fi Yordaanos gamaa dhaqe. Amma illee namoonni isa biratti walitti qabaman; innis akkuma bartee isaatti isaan barsiise.
english: He arose from there and came into the borders of Judea and beyond the Jordan. Multitudes came together to him again. As he usually did, he was again teaching them.

kikuyu: Fariisonni dhufanii, “Namni tokko niitii isaa hiikuun ni eeyyamamaa?” jedhanii gaafachuudhaan isa qoran.
english: Pharisees came to him testing him, and asked him, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”

kikuyu: Innis deebisee, “Museen maal isin ajaje?” jedheen.
english: He answered, “What did Moses command you?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Namni tokko akka waraqaa ragaa hiikkaa barreesseefii niitii isaa hiiku Museen eeyyameera” jedhan.
english: They said, “Moses allowed a certificate of divorce to be written, and to divorce her.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Museen sababii mata jabina keessaniitiif jedhee seera kana isiniif barreesse.
english: But Jesus said to them, “For your hardness of heart, he wrote you this commandment.

kikuyu: Jalqaba uumamaatii kaasee garuu Waaqni, ‘Dhiiraa fi dubartii isaan taasise.’
english: But from the beginning of the creation, God made them male and female.

kikuyu: ‘Kanaafis namni abbaa isaatii fi haadha isaa ni dhiisa; niitii isaa wajjinis tokko taʼa;
english: For this cause a man will leave his father and mother, and will join to his wife,

kikuyu: lamaan isaanii iyyuu foon tokko ni taʼu.’Egaa isaan siʼachi foon tokko malee lama miti.
english: and the two will become one flesh, so that they are no longer two, but one flesh.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu waan Waaqni tokko taasise namni gargar hin baasin.”
english: What therefore God has joined together, let no man separate.”

kikuyu: Utuu ammas mana jiranuu barattoonni waaʼee dubbii kanaa Yesuusin gaafatan.
english: In the house, his disciples asked him again about the same matter.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Namni niitii isaa hiikee dubartii biraa fuudhu kam iyyuu ishee irratti ejja raawwata.
english: He said to them, “Whoever divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery against her.

kikuyu: Isheenis yoo dhirsa ishee hiiktee nama biraatti heerumte ejja raawwatti.”
english: If a woman herself divorces her husband and marries another, she commits adultery.”

kikuyu: Namoonni akka inni harka isaan irra kaaʼuuf ijoollee xixinnoo Yesuusitti fidaa turan; barattoonni garuu isaan ifatan.
english: They were bringing to him little children, that he should touch them, but the disciples rebuked those who were bringing them.

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu waan kana argetti aaree akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Ijoolleen xixinnoon gara koo haa dhufaniitii hin dhowwinaa; mootummaan Waaqaa kan warra akkanaatii.
english: But when Jesus saw it, he was moved with indignation and said to them, “Allow the little children to come to me! Don’t forbid them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; namni akkuma ijoolleetti mootummaa Waaqaa hin simanne kam iyyuu gonkumaa itti hin galu.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, whoever will not receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

kikuyu: Innis ijoollee sana fuudhee ofitti qabe; harka isaas isaan irra kaaʼee isaan eebbise.
english: He took them in his arms and blessed them, laying his hands on them.

kikuyu: Akkuma Yesuus deemuuf karaa qabateen namichi tokko fiigaa dhufee fuula isaa duratti jilbeenfatee, “Yaa barsiisaa gaarii, ani jireenya bara baraa dhaaluuf maal gochuun qaba?” jedhee gaafate.
english: As he was going out into the way, one ran to him, knelt before him, and asked him, “Good Teacher, what shall I do that I may inherit eternal life?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Ati maaliif gaarii naan jetta? Waaqa tokkicha malee gaariin hin jiru.
english: Jesus said to him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good except one—God.

kikuyu: Ati ajajawwan ni beekta; ‘Hin ajjeesin; hin ejjin; hin hatin; sobaan dhugaa hin baʼin; hin gowwoomsin; abbaa keetii fi haadha keetiif ulfina kenni.’”
english: You know the commandments: ‘Do not murder,’ ‘Do not commit adultery,’ ‘Do not steal,’ ‘Do not give false testimony,’ ‘Do not defraud,’ ‘Honor your father and mother.’”

kikuyu: Namichis, “Yaa barsiisaa, ani ijoollummaa kootii jalqabee ajajawwan kanneen hunda eegeera” jedhe.
english: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

kikuyu: Yesuus namicha ilaalee isa jaallatee, “Waan tokkotu si duraa hirʼata; dhaqiitii waan qabdu hunda gurgurii hiyyeeyyiif kenni; samii irratti badhaadhummaa ni qabaattaa. Ergasii kottuu na duukaa buʼi” jedheen.
