english: Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven; and come, follow me, taking up the cross.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti fuulli namichaa ni geeddarame. Inni gaddee achii deeme; qabeenya guddaa qaba tureetii.
english: But his face fell at that saying, and he went away sorrowful, for he was one who had great possessions.

kikuyu: Yesuusis naannoo isaa ilaalee barattoota isaatiin, “Mootummaa Waaqaatti galuun sooreyyiif akkam rakkisaa dha!” jedhe.
english: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How difficult it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!”

kikuyu: Barattoonnis dubbii isaa ni dinqisiifatan. Yesuus garuu ammas akkana jedheen; “Ijoolle, mootummaa Waaqaatti galuun akkam rakkisaa dha!
english: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus answered again, “Children, how hard it is for those who trust in riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

kikuyu: Namni sooressi mootummaa Waaqaatti galuu irra qaawwa lilmoo keessa baʼuutu gaalaaf salphata.”
english: It is easier for a camel to go through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Barattoonnis akka malee raajeffatanii, “Yoos eenyutu fayyuu dandaʼa ree?” waliin jedhan.
english: They were exceedingly astonished, saying to him, “Then who can be saved?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis isaan ilaalee, “Kun garuu Waaqaaf malee namaaf hin dandaʼamu; Waaqaaf wanni hundinuu ni dandaʼamaatii” jedhe.
english: Jesus, looking at them, said, “With men it is impossible, but not with God, for all things are possible with God.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Phexros, “Kunoo, nu waan hunda dhiifnee si duukaa buuneerra!” jedhe.
english: Peter began to tell him, “Behold, we have left all and have followed you.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee akkana jedheen; “Ani dhuguma isinitti nan hima; namni anaa fi wangeelaaf jedhee mana yookaan obboloota yookaan obboleettota yookaan haadha yookaan abbaa yookaan ijoollee yookaan lafa qotiisaa dhiise kam iyyuu,
english: Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or brothers, or sisters, or father, or mother, or wife, or children, or land, for my sake, and for the sake of the Good News,

kikuyu: kan bara ammaa kana keessa ariʼatama wajjin manneen, obboloota, obboleettota, haadhota, ijoollee fi lafa qotiisaa dachaa dhibba hin arganne, kan bara dhufuttis jireenya bara baraa hin dhaalle tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: but he will receive one hundred times more now in this time: houses, brothers, sisters, mothers, children, and land, with persecutions; and in the age to come eternal life.

kikuyu: Garuu warri jalqabaa hedduun warra dhumaa, warri dhumaa immoo warra jalqabaa ni taʼu.”
english: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”

kikuyu: Isaanis Yerusaalemitti ol baʼuuf jedhanii karaa irra turan; Yesuus immoo isaan dura deemaa ture; barattoonnis ni dinqisiifatan; warri duukaa buʼaa turan immoo ni sodaatan. Yesuus amma illee warra kudha lamaan kophaatti baasee waan isatti dhufuuf jiru isaanitti hime.
english: They were on the way, going up to Jerusalem; and Jesus was going in front of them, and they were amazed; and those who followed were afraid. He again took the twelve, and began to tell them the things that were going to happen to him.

kikuyu: Akkanas jedhe; “Kunoo, nu Yerusaalemitti ol baʼaa jirra; Ilmi Namaas dabarfamee luboota hangafootattii fi barsiistota seeraatti ni kennama. Isaanis duʼa itti muru; akkasumas dabarsanii Namoota Ormaatti isa kennu;
english: “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem. The Son of Man will be delivered to the chief priests and the scribes. They will condemn him to death, and will deliver him to the Gentiles.

kikuyu: isaanis isatti qoosu; isatti tufu; isa garafu; isa ajjeesus. Inni garuu guyyaa sadii booddee duʼaa ni kaʼa.”
english: They will mock him, spit on him, scourge him, and kill him. On the third day he will rise again.”

kikuyu: Ilmaan Zabdewoos jechuunis Yaaqoobii fi Yohannis gara Yesuus dhufanii, “Yaa Barsiisaa, akka ati waan nu si kadhannu kam iyyuu nuu gootu barbaanna” jedhan.
english: James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came near to him, saying, “Teacher, we want you to do for us whatever we will ask.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Akka ani maal isiniif godhu barbaaddu?” jedheen.
english: He said to them, “What do you want me to do for you?”

kikuyu: Isaanis deebisanii, “Yeroo ulfina keetiitti, tokkoon keenya mirga keetiin, tokkoon keenya immoo bitaa keetiin akka teenyuuf nuuf eeyyami” jedhanii deebisan.
english: They said to him, “Grant to us that we may sit, one at your right hand and one at your left hand, in your glory.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Isin waan kadhattan hin beektan; xoofoo ani dhugu, dhuguu yookaan cuuphaa ani cuuphamu, cuuphamuu ni dandeessuu?” jedheen.
english: But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Ni dandeenya” jedhanii deebisan. Yesuusis akkana jedheen; “Xoofoo ani dhugu ni dhugdu; cuuphaa ani cuuphamus ni cuuphamtu;
english: They said to him, “We are able.” Jesus said to them, “You shall indeed drink the cup that I drink, and you shall be baptized with the baptism that I am baptized with;

kikuyu: garuu mirga koo yookaan bitaa koo taaʼuu kan kennu ana miti. Iddoon kun kan warra isaaniif jedhamee qopheeffame sanaa ti.”
english: but to sit at my right hand and at my left hand is not mine to give, but for whom it has been prepared.”

kikuyu: Warri kurnan yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti Yaaqoobii fi Yohannisitti aaran.
english: When the ten heard it, they began to be indignant toward James and John.

kikuyu: Yesuusis walitti isaan waamee akkana jedhe; “Isin akka warri akka bulchitoota Namoota Ormaatti ilaalaman sun isaan irratti gooftummaa mulʼisan, gurguddoonni isaaniis akka isaan irratti taayitaa argisiisan ni beektu.
english: Jesus summoned them and said to them, “You know that they who are recognized as rulers over the nations lord it over them, and their great ones exercise authority over them.

kikuyu: Isin biratti akkas miti. Qooda kanaa namni isin keessaa nama guddaa taʼuu barbaadu kam iyyuu tajaajilaa keessan taʼuu qaba;
english: But it shall not be so among you, but whoever wants to become great among you shall be your servant.

kikuyu: namni nama jalqabaa taʼuu barbaadu kam iyyuu garbicha nama hundaa taʼuu qaba.
english: Whoever of you wants to become first among you shall be bondservant of all.

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa iyyuu tajaajiluu fi lubbuu isaa immoo namoota baayʼeedhaaf furii godhee kennuuf dhufe malee tajaajilamuuf hin dhufneetii.”
english: For the Son of Man also came not to be served but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”

kikuyu: Isaanis Yerikoo dhufan. Utuu Yesuus barattoota isaatii fi tuuta namootaa guddaa isaa wajjin Yerikoodhaa baʼaa jiruu, namichi jaamaan Barxiimewos jedhamu ilmi Ximeewos karaa irra taaʼee kadhachaa ture.
english: They came to Jericho. As he went out from Jericho with his disciples and a great multitude, the son of Timaeus, Bartimaeus, a blind beggar, was sitting by the road.

kikuyu: Barxiimewosis yommuu akka inni Yesuus isa Naazreeti taʼe dhagaʼetti, “Yesuus, yaa ilma Daawit na maari!” jedhee iyyuu jalqabe.
english: When he heard that it was Jesus the Nazarene, he began to cry out and say, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeen akka inni calʼisuuf ifatan; inni garuu, “Yaa ilma Daawit na maari!” jedhee ittuma caalchisee iyye.
english: Many rebuked him, that he should be quiet, but he cried out much more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Yesuusis dhaabatee, “Isa waamaa” jedhe. Isaanis, “Jabaadhu! Kaʼi inni si waamaatii” jedhanii namicha jaamaa sana waaman.
english: Jesus stood still and said, “Call him.” They called the blind man, saying to him, “Cheer up! Get up. He is calling you!”

kikuyu: Innis wayyaa isaa of irraa darbatee, utaalee kaʼee gara Yesuus dhufe.
english: He, casting away his cloak, sprang up, and came to Jesus.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Akka ani maal siif godhu barbaadda?” jedhee isa gaafate. Namichi jaamaan sunis, “Yaa barsiisaa, ani arguun barbaada” jedheen.
english: Jesus asked him, “What do you want me to do for you?” The blind man said to him, “Rabboni, that I may see again.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Amantiin kee si fayyiseeraa deemi” jedheen. Innis yeruma sana argee karaa irra buʼee Yesuus duukaa buʼe.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your faith has made you well.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus on the way.

kikuyu: Akkuma isaan Yerusaalemitti dhiʼaatanii, Beetfaagee fi Biitaaniyaa kanneen Tulluu Ejersaa biraa sana gaʼaniin Yesuus Barattoota isaa keessaa lama erge;
english: When they came near to Jerusalem, to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the Mount of Olives, he sent two of his disciples

kikuyu: akkanas isaaniin jedhe; “Gara ganda fuula keessan dura jiru sanaa dhaqaa; akkuma achi seentaniinis, ilmoo harree kan namni tokko iyyuu takkumaa hin yaabbatin tokko achitti hidhamee jiru ni argattu; isa hiikaatii as fidaa.
english: and said to them, “Go your way into the village that is opposite you. Immediately as you enter into it, you will find a young donkey tied, on which no one has sat. Untie him and bring him.

kikuyu: Yoo namni tokko iyyuu, ‘Isin maaliif waan kana gootu?’ jedhee isin gaafate, ‘Gooftaatu isa barbaada; dafees deebisee ni erga’ jedhaa.”
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs him;’ and immediately he will send him back here.”

kikuyu: Isaanis dhaqanii ilmoo harree kan balbala duratti, karaa irratti hidhame tokko argan. Akkuma isaan hiikaniinis,
english: They went away, and found a young donkey tied at the door outside in the open street, and they untied him.

kikuyu: namoonni achi dhadhaabachaa turan tokko tokko, “Maal gochuuf ilmoo harree sana hiiktu?” jedhanii isaan gaafatan.
english: Some of those who stood there asked them, “What are you doing, untying the young donkey?”

kikuyu: Isaanis akkuma Yesuus isaaniin jedhe sanatti deebisaniif; namoonni sunis akka isaan deeman isaan dhiisan.
english: They said to them just as Jesus had said, and they let them go.

kikuyu: Ilmoo harree sanas Yesuusitti fidan; uffata isaaniis ilmoo harree irra buusan; innis irra taaʼe.
english: They brought the young donkey to Jesus and threw their garments on it, and Jesus sat on it.

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeen uffata isaanii karaa irra afan; warri kaan immoo dameewwan baala qaban kanneen alaa kukkutan sana karaa irra bubuusan.
english: Many spread their garments on the way, and others were cutting down branches from the trees and spreading them on the road.

kikuyu: Warri dura deemaa turanii fi warri duukaa buʼaa turan iyyanii akkana jedhan; “Hoosaaʼinaa!” “Inni maqaa Gooftaatiin dhufu eebbifamaa dha!”
english: Those who went in front and those who followed cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!

kikuyu: “Mootummaan abbaa keenya Daawit inni dhufu sun eebbifamaa dha!” “Hoosaaʼinaa ol gubbaatti!”
english: Blessed is the kingdom of our father David that is coming in the name of the Lord! Hosanna in the highest!”

kikuyu: Yesuusis Yerusaalem seenee mana qulqullummaatti ol gale. Gara galees waan hundumaa ilaale; sababii galgalaaʼee tureefis warra Kudha Lamaan wajjin baʼee Biitaaniyaa dhaqe.
english: Jesus entered into the temple in Jerusalem. When he had looked around at everything, it being now evening, he went out to Bethany with the twelve.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti utuu Biitaaniyaadhaa baʼanuu Yesuus beelaʼe.
english: The next day, when they had come out from Bethany, he was hungry.

kikuyu: Innis muka harbuu baala qabu tokko fagootti argee ija qabaachuu fi qabaachuu baachuu isaa ilaaluu dhaqe. Garuu waan yeroon sun waqtii harbuu hin taʼiniif inni yommuu muka sana bira gaʼetti baala malee waa tokko illee hin arganne.
english: Seeing a fig tree afar off having leaves, he came to see if perhaps he might find anything on it. When he came to it, he found nothing but leaves, for it was not the season for figs.

kikuyu: Yesuusis muka sanaan, “Namni tokko iyyuu deebiʼee ija sirraa hin nyaatin” jedhe. Barattoonni isaas ni dhagaʼan.
english: Jesus told it, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again!” and his disciples heard it.

kikuyu: Yommuu Yerusaalem gaʼanittis Yesuus mana qulqullummaa seenee warra achitti bitatanii fi gurguratan ariʼuu jalqabe. Minjaala warra maallaqa geeddarataniitii fi barcuma warra gugee gurguratanii garagalche.
english: They came to Jerusalem, and Jesus entered into the temple and began to throw out those who sold and those who bought in the temple, and overthrew the money changers’ tables and the seats of those who sold the doves.

kikuyu: Akka namni tokko iyyuu waan tokko illee baatee mana qulqullummaa keessa darbus hin eeyyamne.
english: He would not allow anyone to carry a container through the temple.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee isaan barsiise; “ ‘Manni koo saba hundumaaf mana kadhannaa ni jedhama’jedhamee hin barreeffamnee? Isin garuu ‘Holqa saamtotaa’gootaniirtu.”
english: He taught, saying to them, “Isn’t it written, ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all the nations’? But you have made it a den of robbers!”

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa waan kana dhagaʼanii karaa ittiin isa ajjeesan barbaaduu jalqaban; isaan sababii namoonni hundinuu barsiisa isaa dinqisiifataniif isa sodaatanii turaniitii.
english: The chief priests and the scribes heard it, and sought how they might destroy him. For they feared him, because all the multitude was astonished at his teaching.

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu galgalaaʼetti magaalaa sana keessaa baʼan.
english: When evening came, he went out of the city.

kikuyu: Isaanis ganamaan utuu karaa sana darbanuu akka mukti harbuu sun hidda isaatii jalqabee goge argan.
english: As they passed by in the morning, they saw the fig tree withered away from the roots.

kikuyu: Phexrosis yaadatee Yesuusiin, “Yaa barsiisaa ilaa! Harbuun ati abaarte sun gogeera!” jedhe.
english: Peter, remembering, said to him, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree which you cursed has withered away.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Waaqatti amanaa.
english: Jesus answered them, “Have faith in God.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; eenyu iyyuu yoo tulluu kanaan ‘Buqqaʼiitii galaanatti darbatami’ jedhe, yoo garaa isaattis mamuu baatee akka wanni inni jedhe sun taʼu amane, wanni sun ni taʼaaf.
english: For most certainly I tell you, whoever may tell this mountain, ‘Be taken up and cast into the sea,’ and doesn’t doubt in his heart, but believes that what he says is happening, he shall have whatever he says.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani isinittin hima; waan kadhannaadhaan gaafattan hunda akka argattan amanaa; innis isiniif ni taʼa.
english: Therefore I tell you, all things whatever you pray and ask for, believe that you have received them, and you shall have them.

kikuyu: Yeroo kadhachuuf dhaabattan, akka Abbaan keessan inni samii irraa cubbuu keessan isiniif dhiisuuf, isinis yoo waanuma tokko illee nama kam iyyuu irraa qabaattan dhiisaafii. [
english: Whenever you stand praying, forgive, if you have anything against anyone; so that your Father, who is in heaven, may also forgive you your transgressions.

kikuyu: Yoo dhiisuufii baattan garuu Abbaan keessan inni samii irraas cubbuu keessan isiniif hin dhiisu.”]
english: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”

kikuyu: Isaanis deebiʼanii gara Yerusaalem dhufan; utuu Yesuus mana qulqullummaa keessa deddeebiʼaa jiruu luboonni hangafoonni, barsiistonni seeraatii fi maanguddoonni gara isaa dhufan.
english: They came again to Jerusalem, and as he was walking in the temple, the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders came to him,

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Ati taayitaa maaliitiin wantoota kanneen hojjetta? Akka wantoota kanneen hojjettuufis eenyutu taayitaa siif kenne?” jedhaniin.
english: and they began saying to him, “By what authority do you do these things? Or who gave you this authority to do these things?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Anis gaaffii tokkon isin gaafadha. Isin immoo deebii naaf kennaa; anis taayitaa maaliitiin wantoota kanneen akkan hojjedhu isinittin hima.
english: Jesus said to them, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I do these things.

kikuyu: Cuuphaan Yohannis samii irraa dhufe moo nama biraa dhufe? Mee natti himaa!”
english: The baptism of John—was it from heaven, or from men? Answer me.”

kikuyu: Isaanis waliin mariʼatanii akkana jedhan; “Yoo nu, ‘Samii irraa dhufe’ jenne inni immoo, ‘Yoos isin maaliif isa hin amanin ree?’ jedhee nu gaafata;
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we should say, ‘From heaven;’ he will say, ‘Why then did you not believe him?’

kikuyu: Yookaan, ‘Nama biraa dhufe’ jennuu?” jedhan. Sababii namni hundinuu dhugumaan Yohannisin akka raajiitti ilaaleef uummata sodaatan.
english: If we should say, ‘From men’”—they feared the people, for all held John to really be a prophet.

kikuyu: Kanaaf isaan, “Hin beeknu” jedhanii Yesuusiif deebisan. Yesuus immoo, “Anis taayitaa maaliitiin akkan wantoota kanneen hojjedhu isinitti hin himu” jedheen.
english: They answered Jesus, “We don’t know.” Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee fakkeenyaan isaanitti dubbachuu jalqabe; “Namichi tokko iddoo dhaabaa wayinii irra wayinii dhaabbate. Innis naannoo isaatti dallaa ijaaree, boolla itti wayinii cuunfan qotee qooxii eegumsaa ijaare. Ergasiis iddoo dhaabaa wayinii sana qonnaan bultootatti kiraa kennatee biyya fagoo dhaqe.
english: He began to speak to them in parables. “A man planted a vineyard, put a hedge around it, dug a pit for the wine press, built a tower, rented it out to a farmer, and went into another country.

kikuyu: Innis yeroo midhaan walitti qabamutti akka inni ija iddoo dhaabaa wayinii irraa waa fiduufiif garbicha tokko qottuuwwan sanatti ergate.
english: When it was time, he sent a servant to the farmer to get from the farmer his share of the fruit of the vineyard.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu qabanii, tumanii harka duwwaa of irraa isa deebisan.
english: They took him, beat him, and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Ammas garbicha biraa isaanitti ergate; isaanis mataa isaa buruqsanii isa qaanessan.
english: Again, he sent another servant to them; and they threw stones at him, wounded him in the head, and sent him away shamefully treated.

kikuyu: Amma illee garbicha biraa ergate; isas ni ajjeesan. Garboota biraa baayʼees ergate; isaanis gartokko ni tuman; kaan immoo ni ajjeesan.
english: Again he sent another, and they killed him, and many others, beating some, and killing some.

kikuyu: “Amma iyyuu inni nama ergu tokko qaba ture; innis ilma isaa jaallatamaa dha. Namichis, ‘Ilma koo ni kabaju’ jedhee dhuma irratti isa ergate.
english: Therefore still having one, his beloved son, he sent him last to them, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’

kikuyu: “Qottoonni sun garuu, ‘Dhaaltuun isa kana. Kottaa isa ajjeefnaa; dhaalli sun keenya taʼaatii’ waliin jedhan.
english: But those farmers said among themselves, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isaan fuudhanii isa ajjeesan; iddoo dhaabaa wayinii keessaas gad baasanii isa gatan.
english: They took him, killed him, and cast him out of the vineyard.

kikuyu: “Egaa abbaan iddoo dhaabaa wayinii sanaa maal godhinna laata? Inni dhufee qottuuwwan sana ni ajjeesa; iddoo dhaabaa wayinii sanas namoota biraatti kennata.
english: What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do? He will come and destroy the farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.

kikuyu: Isin Katabbii Qulqulluu hin dubbifnee? Innis akkana jedha: “ ‘Dhagaan ijaartonni tuffatan, dhagaa golee taʼeera;
english: Haven’t you even read this Scripture: ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the head of the corner.

kikuyu: kanas Gooftaatu godhe; kunis ija keenyatti dinqii dha.’”
english: This was from the Lord. It is marvelous in our eyes’?”

kikuyu: Isaanis akka inni isaaniin mormuudhaan fakkeenya sana dubbate waan beekaniif isa qabuu barbaadan. Garuu namoota sana sodaatan; kanaafuu isa dhiisanii qajeelan.
english: They tried to seize him, but they feared the multitude; for they perceived that he spoke the parable against them. They left him and went away.

kikuyu: Ergasii waan inni dubbatuun isa qabuuf jedhanii Fariisotaa fi garee Heroodis keessaa jara tokko Yesuusitti ergan.
english: They sent some of the Pharisees and the Herodians to him, that they might trap him with words.

kikuyu: Isaanis gara isaa dhufanii akkana jedhaniin; “Yaa barsiisaa, akka ati nama dhugaa taate beekna. Ati waan fuula namaa hin ilaalleef namni kam iyyuu karaa irraa si hin jalʼisuutii; garuu ati dhugaadhaan karaa Waaqaa barsiifta. Qeesaariif gibira baasuun eeyyamameera moo hin eeyyamamne?
english: When they had come, they asked him, “Teacher, we know that you are honest, and don’t defer to anyone; for you aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God. Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?

kikuyu: Haa baasnu moo haa dhiifnuu?” Yesuus garuu fakkeessitummaa isaanii beekee, “Isin maaliif na qortu? Mee diinaariitokko natti fidaa nan ilaalaa” jedheen.
english: Shall we give, or shall we not give?” But he, knowing their hypocrisy, said to them, “Why do you test me? Bring me a denarius, that I may see it.”

kikuyu: Isaanis diinaarii tokko isatti fidan; innis, “Fakkiin kun kan eenyuu ti? Katabbiin kunis kan eenyuu ti?” jedhee isaan gaafate. Isaanis, “Kan Qeesaari” jedhanii deebisan.
english: They brought it. He said to them, “Whose is this image and inscription?” They said to him, “Caesar’s.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Yesuus, “Kan Qeesaar Qeesaariif, kan Waaqaa immoo Waaqaaf kennaa” jedheen. Isaanis isa dinqifatan.
english: Jesus answered them, “Give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.” They marveled greatly at him.

kikuyu: Ergasii Saduuqonni, duʼaa kaʼuun hin jiru jedhan gara Yesuus dhufanii akkana jedhanii gaaffii tokko isa gaafatan;
english: Some Sadducees, who say that there is no resurrection, came to him. They asked him, saying,

kikuyu: “Yaa barsiisaa yoo obboleessi nama tokkoo niitii fuudhee utuu ijoollee hin dhalchin niitii isaa irraa duʼe, obboleessi isaa niitii sana dhaalee obboleessa isaatiif sanyii haa dhaabuu jedhee Museen nuu barreesseera.
english: “Teacher, Moses wrote to us, ‘If a man’s brother dies and leaves a wife behind him, and leaves no children, that his brother should take his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.’

kikuyu: Kunoo obboloota torbatu ture. Inni jalqabaa niitii fuudhee utuu ijoollee hin dhalchin duʼe.
english: There were seven brothers. The first took a wife, and dying left no offspring.

kikuyu: Inni lammaffaanis ishee fuudhee utuu ijoollee hin dhalchin duʼe. Inni sadaffaanis akkasuma taʼe.
english: The second took her, and died, leaving no children behind him. The third likewise;

kikuyu: Torban isaanii iyyuu ijoollee hin dhalchine. Dhuma irratti dubartittiinis ni duute.
english: and the seven took her and left no children. Last of all the woman also died.

kikuyu: Guyyaa duʼaa kaʼuutti isheen niitii isa kamii taati? Torban isaanii iyyuu ishee fuudhaniiruutii.”
english: In the resurrection, when they rise, whose wife will she be of them? For the seven had her as a wife.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Isin waan Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluu yookaan humna Waaqaa hin beekneef dogoggortu mitii?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t this because you are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God?

kikuyu: Warri duʼan yommuu duʼaa kaʼanitti akka ergamoota samii taʼu malee hin fuudhan; hin heerumanis.
english: For when they will rise from the dead, they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels in heaven.

kikuyu: Waaʼee warri duʼan duʼaa kaʼuu garuu akka Waaqni Kitaaba Musee keessatti, daggala bobaʼu biratti, ‘Ani Waaqa Abrahaam, Waaqa Yisihaaqii fi Waaqa Yaaqoob’jedhee isatti dubbate isin hin dubbifnee?
english: But about the dead, that they are raised, haven’t you read in the book of Moses about the Bush, how God spoke to him, saying, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’?

kikuyu: Inni Waaqa warra jiraataniiti malee Waaqa warra duʼanii miti. Isin akka malee dogoggortaniirtu!”
english: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are therefore badly mistaken.”

kikuyu: Barsiistota seeraa keessaa inni tokko dhufee wal falmuu isaanii dhagaʼe. Innis akka Yesuus deebii gaarii isaaniif kenne hubatee, “Ajajni ajajawwan hunda caalu isa kami?” jedhee isa gaafate.
english: One of the scribes came and heard them questioning together, and knowing that he had answered them well, asked him, “Which commandment is the greatest of all?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Ajajni ajajawwan hunda caalu isa kana; ‘Yaa Israaʼel dhagaʼi! Waaqayyo Gooftaan keenya Gooftaa tokkicha.
english: Jesus answered, “The greatest is: ‘Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is one.

kikuyu: Waaqa kee Goofticha garaa kee guutuudhaan, lubbuu kee guutuudhaan, yaada kee guutuudhaan, humna kee guutuudhaan jaalladhu.’
english: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.’ This is the first commandment.

kikuyu: Inni lammaffaan immoo, isa kana; ‘Ollaa kee akkuma ofii keetiitti jaalladhu.’Ajajni ajajawwan kanneen caalu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.”
english: The second is like this: ‘You shall love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no other commandment greater than these.”

kikuyu: Barsiisaan seeraa sunis akkana jedhee deebise; “Yaa barsiisaa, ati dhugaa jette; Waaqa tokkicha malee Waaqni biraa hin jiruutii.
english: The scribe said to him, “Truly, teacher, you have said well that he is one, and there is none other but he;

kikuyu: Garaa kee guutuudhaan, yaada kee guutuudhaan, humna kee guutuudhaan isa jaallachuun, ollaa kees akkuma ofii keetiitti jaallachuun, qalma gubamuu fi aarsaa hunda caala.”
english: and to love him with all the heart, with all the understanding, all the soul, and with all the strength, and to love his neighbor as himself, is more important than all whole burnt offerings and sacrifices.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu akka inni hubannaadhaan deebise argetti, “Ati mootummaa Waaqaa irraa fagoo hin jirtu” jedheen. Ergasii namni tokko iyyuu deebiʼee gaaffii isa gaafachuuf ija hin jabaanne.
english: When Jesus saw that he answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from God’s Kingdom.” No one dared ask him any question after that.

kikuyu: Yesuus utuu mana qulqullummaa keessatti barsiisaa jiruu akkana jedhee gaafate; “Barsiistonni seeraa maaliif Kiristoos ilma Daawit jedhu?
english: Jesus responded, as he taught in the temple, “How is it that the scribes say that the Christ is the son of David?

kikuyu: Daawit mataan isaa iyyuu Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan geggeeffamee akkana jedhe: “ ‘Gooftichi Gooftaa kootiin, “Hamma ani diinota kee, miilla kee jala siif galchutti, gara mirga koo taaʼi.” ’
english: For David himself said in the Holy Spirit, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

kikuyu: Daawit mataan isaa iyyuu ‘Gooftaa’ jedhee isa waama. Yoos inni akkamitti ilma isaa taʼuu dandaʼa ree?” Tuunni guddaan sunis gammachuudhaan isa dhagaʼe.
english: Therefore David himself calls him Lord, so how can he be his son?” The common people heard him gladly.

kikuyu: Yesuusis utuu barsiisuu akkana jedhe; “Barsiistota seeraa irraa of eeggadhaa. Isaan uffata dhedheeraa uffatanii nanaannaʼuu fi gabaa keessattis nagaa gaafatamuu jaallatu;
english: In his teaching he said to them, “Beware of the scribes, who like to walk in long robes, and to get greetings in the marketplaces,

kikuyu: manneen sagadaa keessatti taaʼumsa ulfinaa, lafa cidhaatti immoo iddoo ulfinaa jaallatu.
english: and to get the best seats in the synagogues and the best places at feasts,

kikuyu: Isaanis mana haadha hiyyeessaa saamanii onsu; of argisiisuuf jedhaniis kadhannaa dheeressu. Namoonni kunneen adaba guddaa adabamu.”
english: those who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis fuullee iddoo kennaan kaaʼamuu taaʼee namoota maallaqa isaanii miʼa buusii keessa buusan ilaala ture. Sooreyyiin baayʼeenis maallaqa baayʼee miʼa sana keessa buusaa turan.
english: Jesus sat down opposite the treasury and saw how the multitude cast money into the treasury. Many who were rich cast in much.

kikuyu: Haati hiyyeessaa hiyyeettiin tokko dhuftee saantima sibiila diimaa xixinnoo lama kan gatiin isaa gara saantima tokkoo taʼe miʼa sana keessa buufte.
english: A poor widow came and she cast in two small brass coins, which equal a quadrans coin.

kikuyu: Yesuusis barattoota isaa ofitti waamee akkana jedhe; “Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; haati hiyyeessaa hiyyeettiin kun warra miʼa buusii kana keessa kennaa buusan hunda caalaa buufteerti.
english: He called his disciples to himself and said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, this poor widow gave more than all those who are giving into the treasury,

kikuyu: Isaan hundi qabeenya isaanii irraa kennan; isheen garuu hiyyuma ishee keessaa waan hunda, waan ittiin jiraattu hunda kennite.”
english: for they all gave out of their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, gave all that she had to live on.”

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuus mana qulqullummaatii baʼaa jiruu barattoota isaa keessaa inni tokko, “Yaa Barsiisaa! Dhagaawwan gurguddaa kanneenii fi gamoowwan babbareedoo kanneen mee ilaali!” jedheen.
english: As he went out of the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Teacher, see what kind of stones and what kind of buildings!”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Gamoowwan gurguddaa kanneen argitaa? Ni diigama malee asitti dhagaan dhagaa irratti hin hafu” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “Do you see these great buildings? There will not be left here one stone on another, which will not be thrown down.”

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuus Tulluu Ejersaa irra fuullee mana qulqullummaa taaʼee jiruu Phexros, Yaaqoob, Yohannisii fi Indiriiyaas akkana jedhanii kophaatti isa gaafatan;
english: As he sat on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John, and Andrew asked him privately,

kikuyu: “Mee nutti himi; wantoonni kunneen yoom taʼu? Mallattoon yeroo wantoonni kunneen hundi itti raawwatamanii maali?”
english: “Tell us, when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are all about to be fulfilled?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana isaaniin jechuu jalqabe; “Akka namni tokko iyyuu isin hin gowwoomsineef of eeggadhaa.
english: Jesus, answering, began to tell them, “Be careful that no one leads you astray.

kikuyu: Namoonni hedduun, ‘Ani isa’ jechaa maqaa kootiin ni dhufu; nama hedduus ni gowwoomsu.
english: For many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he!’ and will lead many astray.

kikuyu: Isin yommuu waaʼee waraanaatii fi oduu waraanaa dhageessanitti hin rifatinaa. Wanni akkanaa taʼuu qabaatii; dhumni garuu amma iyyuu hin geenye.
english: “When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, don’t be troubled. For those must happen, but the end is not yet.

kikuyu: Sabni sabatti, mootummaanis mootummaatti ni kaʼa. Sochiin lafaa iddoo garaa garaatti ni taʼa; beellis ni buʼa. Kunis jalqaba ciniinsuu daʼumsaa ti.
english: For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places. There will be famines and troubles. These things are the beginning of birth pains.

kikuyu: “Isin of eeggachuu qabdu. Isin dabarfamtanii yaaʼiitti ni kennamtu; manneen sagadaa keessattis ni garafamtu. Isinis akka isaanitti dhuga baatota taataniif anaaf jettanii fuula bulchitootaatii fi moototaa dura ni dhaabattu.
english: “But watch yourselves, for they will deliver you up to councils. You will be beaten in synagogues. You will stand before rulers and kings for my sake, for a testimony to them.

kikuyu: Duraan dursee wangeelli saba hundatti lallabamuu qaba.
english: The Good News must first be preached to all the nations.

kikuyu: Yommuu qabamtanii qorumsaaf dhiʼeeffamtanitti waaʼee waan dubbattanii duraan dursitanii hin yaaddaʼinaa. Waanuma yeroo sana isinii kennamu dubbadhaa; kan dubbatu Hafuura Qulqulluudha malee isin miti.
english: When they lead you away and deliver you up, don’t be anxious beforehand or premeditate what you will say, but say whatever will be given you in that hour. For it is not you who speak, but the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: “Obboleessi dabarsee obboleessa duʼatti kenna; abbaan dabarsee ijoollee isaa duʼatti kenna. Ijoolleenis warra isaaniitti kaʼanii isaan ajjeesu.
english: “Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents and cause them to be put to death.

kikuyu: Namni hundinuu sababii maqaa kootiif isin jibba; kan hamma dhumaatti jabaatee dhaabatu garuu ni fayya.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.

kikuyu: “ ‘Isin yommuu wanni jibbisiisaan badiisa fidu’sun iddoo isaaf hin malle dhaabatee argitanitti, namni dubbisu haa hubatu; yommus warri Yihuudaa keessa jiran tulluuwwanitti haa baqatan.
english: “But when you see the abomination of desolation, spoken of by Daniel the prophet, standing where it ought not” (let the reader understand), “then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains,

kikuyu: Namni bantii manaa irra jiru tokko iyyuu waan tokko illee fudhachuuf gad hin buʼin yookaan mana hin seenin.
english: and let him who is on the housetop not go down, nor enter in, to take anything out of his house.

kikuyu: Namni lafa qotiisaa jiru tokko iyyuu uffata isaa fudhachuuf duubatti hin deebiʼin.
english: Let him who is in the field not return back to take his cloak.

kikuyu: Bara sana keessa dubartoota ulfaatii fi haadhota hoosisaniif wayyoo!
english: But woe to those who are with child and to those who nurse babies in those days!

kikuyu: Kunis akka gannakeessa hin taaneef kadhadhaa.
english: Pray that your flight won’t be in the winter.

kikuyu: Guyyoota sana keessa dhiphinni jalqaba uumama Waaqni uumee kaasee hamma ammaatti hin dhufin, kan gara fuula duraattis hin dhufne ni dhufaatii.
english: For in those days there will be oppression, such as there has not been the like from the beginning of the creation which God created until now, and never will be.

kikuyu: “Utuu Gooftaan guyyoota sana gabaabsuu baatee silaa namni tokko iyyuu hin hafu ture. Garuu inni sababii filatamtoota filateetiif jedhee guyyoota sana gabaabseera.
english: Unless the Lord had shortened the days, no flesh would have been saved; but for the sake of the chosen ones, whom he picked out, he shortened the days.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana yoo namni kam iyyuu, ‘Ilaa Kiristoos as jira!’ yookaan ‘Ilaa, inni achi jira!’ isiniin jedhe hin amaninaa.
english: Then if anyone tells you, ‘Look, here is the Christ!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ don’t believe it.

kikuyu: Kiristoosonni sobaatii fi raajonni sobaa ni kaʼuutii; isaanis yoo dandaʼameef, filatamtoota illee gowwoomsuuf jedhanii mallattoo fi dinqii ni hojjetu.
english: For false christs and false prophets will arise and will show signs and wonders, that they may lead astray, if possible, even the chosen ones.

kikuyu: Isin garuu of eeggadhaa! Ani waan hunda duraan dursee isinitti himeera.
english: But you watch. “Behold, I have told you all things beforehand.

kikuyu: “Bara sana keessa garuu dhiphina sana booddee, “ ‘Aduun ni dukkanoofti; jiʼis ifa ishee hin kennitu;
english: But in those days, after that oppression, the sun will be darkened, the moon will not give its light,

kikuyu: urjiiwwan samii irraa ni harcaʼu; humnoonni samiis ni raafamu.’
english: the stars will be falling from the sky, and the powers that are in the heavens will be shaken.

kikuyu: “Yeroo sana namoonni utuu Ilmi Namaa humna guddaa fi ulfinaan duumessaan dhufuu ni argu.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.

kikuyu: Innis Ergamoota isaa ergee filatamtoota isaa kanneen handaarawwan lafaa irraa hamma handaarawwan samiiwwaniitti jiran bubbeewwan afran irraa walitti qaba.
english: Then he will send out his angels, and will gather together his chosen ones from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the sky.

kikuyu: “Fakkeenya kana muka harbuu irraa baradhaa; yommuu dameen isaa latee baala baafatutti akka bonni dhiʼaate ni beektu.
english: “Now from the fig tree, learn this parable. When the branch has now become tender and produces its leaves, you know that the summer is near;

kikuyu: Akkasuma isinis yommuu wanni kun raawwatamuu isaa argitanitti akka inni dhiʼaate, akka balbala irras gaʼe ni beektu.
english: even so you also, when you see these things coming to pass, know that it is near, at the doors.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; hamma wanni kun hundi taʼutti dhaloonni kun hin darbu.
english: Most certainly I say to you, this generation will not pass away until all these things happen.

kikuyu: Samii fi lafti ni darbu; dubbiin koo garuu gonkumaa hin darbu.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will not pass away.

kikuyu: “Waaʼee guyyaa sanaa yookaan waaʼee saʼaatii sanaa garuu Abbaa qofatu beeka malee namni tokko iyyuu hin beeku; ergamoonni samii irraa iyyuu hin beekan; yookaan ilmi iyyuu hin beeku.
english: “But of that day or that hour no one knows—not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.

kikuyu: Of eeggadhaa! Dammaqaas! Yeroon sun yoom akka taʼe hin beektaniitii.
english: Watch, keep alert, and pray; for you don’t know when the time is.

kikuyu: Innis nama garboota isaatti taayitaa kennee, tokkoo tokkoo isaaniittis hojii isaa kennee, akka garbichi karra eegu immoo dammaqee eegu ajajee, mana isaa dhiisee karaa dheeraa deeme tokko fakkaata.
english: “It is like a man traveling to another country, having left his house and given authority to his servants, and to each one his work, and also commanded the doorkeeper to keep watch.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu isin dammaqaa; yeroo itti abbaan mana sanaa deebiʼu, jechuunis galgala yookaan halkan walakkaa yookaan iyya indaanqoo yookaan barii obboroo taʼuu isaa hin beektaniitii.
english: Watch therefore, for you don’t know when the lord of the house is coming—whether at evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or in the morning;

kikuyu: Kunis akka inni akkuma tasaa dhufee utuu raftanuus isin hin arganneef.
english: lest, coming suddenly, he might find you sleeping.

kikuyu: Ani waanan isiniin jedhu nama hundumaan nan jedha; ‘dammaqaa!’ ”
english: What I tell you, I tell all: Watch!”

kikuyu: Egaa Faasiikaa fi Ayyaana Maxinootiif guyyaa lama qofatu hafe; luboonni hangafoonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa haxxummaadhaan Yesuusin qabanii ajjeesuuf mariʼachaa turan.
english: It was now two days before the Passover and the Feast of Unleavened Bread, and the chief priests and the scribes sought how they might seize him by deception and kill him.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Garuu akka namoonni goolii hin kaafneef yeroo ayyaanaatti hin taʼin” jedhan.
english: For they said, “Not during the feast, because there might be a riot among the people.”

kikuyu: Utuu inni Biitaaniyaa keessa mana Simoon isa lamxaaʼaa sanaatti maaddiitti dhiʼaatee jiruu, dubartiin tokko shittoo gatiin isaa guddaa taʼe kan naardoos qulqulluu irraa qopheeffame bilqaaxxii albaasxiroositti qabattee dhufte. Isheenis bilqaaxxicha cabsitee shittoo sana mataa isaatti dhangalaafte.
english: While he was at Bethany, in the house of Simon the leper, as he sat at the table, a woman came having an alabaster jar of ointment of pure nard—very costly. She broke the jar and poured it over his head.

kikuyu: Namoota achi turan keessaa tokko tokko aaranii akkana waliin jedhan; “Shittoo kana balleessuun maaliif?
english: But there were some who were indignant among themselves, saying, “Why has this ointment been wasted?

kikuyu: Silaa shittoon kun diinaarii dhibba sadii olitti gurguramee maallaqa isaa hiyyeeyyiif kennuun ni dandaʼama tureetii.” Isaanis isheetti dheekkaman.
english: For this might have been sold for more than three hundred denarii and given to the poor.” So they grumbled against her.

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu akkana jedhe; “Ishee dhiisaa. Maaliif ishee rakkiftu? Isheen waan gaarii naaf gooteerti.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. Why do you trouble her? She has done a good work for me.

kikuyu: Hiyyeeyyii yeroo hunda of biraa qabdu; isin yeroo feetan kamitti iyyuu isaan gargaaruu ni dandeessu. Ana garuu yeroo hunda of biraa hin qabdan.
english: For you always have the poor with you, and whenever you want to, you can do them good; but you will not always have me.

kikuyu: Isheen waan dandeessu hojjette. Isheen duraan dursitee dhagna koo awwaalaaf dibde.
english: She has done what she could. She has anointed my body beforehand for the burying.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; addunyaa hunda irratti, iddoo wangeelli itti lallabamu kamitti iyyuu wanni isheen gootes yaadannoo isheetiif ni odeeffama.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, wherever this Good News may be preached throughout the whole world, that which this woman has done will also be spoken of for a memorial of her.”

kikuyu: Ergasiis warra Kudha Lamaan keessaa tokko, Yihuudaa Keeriyotichi, Yesuusin dabarsee isaanitti kennuuf jedhee gara luboota hangafootaa dhaqe.
english: Judas Iscariot, who was one of the twelve, went away to the chief priests, that he might deliver him to them.

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti gammadanii, maallaqa isaaf kennuuf waadaa galan. Kanaafuu Yihuudaan dabarsee isa kennuuf haala mijaaʼaa eeggachaa ture.
english: They, when they heard it, were glad, and promised to give him money. He sought how he might conveniently deliver him.

kikuyu: Guyyaa jalqaba Ayyaana Maxinoo, yeroo itti hoolaan Faasiikaa qalamutti barattoonni Yesuus, “Akka ati Faasiikaa nyaattuuf nu eessa dhaqnee akka siif qopheessinu barbaadda?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: On the first day of unleavened bread, when they sacrificed the Passover, his disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and prepare that you may eat the Passover?”

kikuyu: Innis barattoota isaa keessaa nama lama erge; akkanas isaaniin jedhe; “Magaalaa seenaa; namichi okkotee bishaanii baatu tokko isinitti dhufa; isa duukaa buʼaa.
english: He sent two of his disciples and said to them, “Go into the city, and there a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him,

kikuyu: Abbaa mana namichi sun seenuutiinis, ‘Barsiisaan, manni keessumaa ko, iddoon ani itti barattoota koo wajjin Faasiikaa nyaadhu eessa? jedhee gaafata’ jedhaa.
english: and wherever he enters in, tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

kikuyu: Abbaan manaa sunis darbii balʼaa miidhagfamee qopheeffame tokko isinitti argisiisa. Isinis achitti nuuf qopheessaa.”
english: He will himself show you a large upper room furnished and ready. Get ready for us there.”

kikuyu: Barattoonnis kaʼanii magaalaa sana seenanii akkuma Yesuus isaanitti hime sanatti argatan. Faasiikaas ni qopheessan.
english: His disciples went out, and came into the city, and found things as he had said to them, and they prepared the Passover.

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu galgalaaʼetti warra Kudha Lamaan wajjin achi gaʼe.
english: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

kikuyu: Utuu isaan maaddiitti dhiʼaatanii jiranuu Yesuus, “Ani dhuguma isinitti nan hima; isin keessaa tokko, kan amma na wajjin nyaachuutti jiru dabarsee na kenna” jedheen.
english: As they sat and were eating, Jesus said, “Most certainly I tell you, one of you will betray me—he who eats with me.”

kikuyu: Isaanis gaddanii, tokko tokkoon, “Na taʼinnaa laata?” jechuu jalqaban.
english: They began to be sorrowful, and to ask him one by one, “Surely not I?” And another said, “Surely not I?”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebise; “Namichi sun warra kudha Lamaan keessaa tokkoo dha. Innis isa na wajjin gabatee keessaa cuuphatuu dha.
english: He answered them, “It is one of the twelve, he who dips with me in the dish.

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa akkuma waaʼeen isaa barreeffame sanatti ni deema. Garuu namicha dabarsee Ilma Namaa kennu sanaaf wayyoo! Inni utuu dhalachuu baatee isaaf wayya ture.”
english: For the Son of Man goes as it is written about him, but woe to that man by whom the Son of Man is betrayed! It would be better for that man if he had not been born.”

kikuyu: Utuu nyaachaa jiranuus Yesuus buddeena fuudhee eebbise; caccabsees, “Fudhadhaa; kun foon koo ti” jedhee isaaniif kenne.
english: As they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had blessed it, he broke it and gave to them, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body.”

kikuyu: Xoofoos fuudhee galata galchee isaaniif kenne; hundi isaaniis xoofoo sana irraa dhugan.
english: He took the cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave to them. They all drank of it.

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Kun dhiiga ko, dhiiga kakuu haaraa kan namoota baayʼeef dhangalaafamuu dha.
english: He said to them, “This is my blood of the new covenant, which is poured out for many.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguma isinitti nan hima; ani hamman guyyaa sana mootummaa Waaqaa keessatti deebiʼee dhugutti ija wayinii kana irraa deebiʼee hin dhugu.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, I will no more drink of the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it anew in God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Isaanis erga faarfannaa faarfatanii booddee Tulluu Ejersaatti qajeelan.
english: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.

kikuyu: Yesuus akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Hundi keessan ni gufattu; akkana jedhamee barreeffameeraatii: “ ‘Ani tiksee nan rukuta; hoolonnis ni bittinneeffamu.’
english: Jesus said to them, “All of you will be made to stumble because of me tonight, for it is written, ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’

kikuyu: Ani garuu ergan duʼaa kaʼee booddee isin dura Galiilaa nan dhaqa.”
english: However, after I am raised up, I will go before you into Galilee.”

kikuyu: Phexros garuu, “Yoo namni hundinuu gufate iyyuu ani hin gufadhu” jedheen.
english: But Peter said to him, “Although all will be offended, yet I will not.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo deebisee, “Ani dhuguma sitti nan hima; ati harʼa, edanuma utuu indaanqoon yeroo lama hin iyyin, yeroo sadii na ganta” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “Most certainly I tell you that you today, even this night, before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.”

kikuyu: Phexros garuu, “Ani yoon si wajjin duʼuu qabaadhe illee gonkumaa si hin ganu” jedhee jabeessee dubbate. Hundi isaaniis akkasuma jedhan.
english: But he spoke all the more, “If I must die with you, I will not deny you.” They all said the same thing.

kikuyu: Isaanis iddoo Geetesemaanee jedhamu tokko dhaqan; Yesuusis barattoota isaatiin, “Hamma ani kadhadhutti isin as taaʼaa” jedhe.
english: They came to a place which was named Gethsemane. He said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”

kikuyu: Innis Phexrosin, Yaaqoobii fi Yohannisin of faana fudhatee, akka malee dhiphachuu fi yaaddaʼuus jalqabe.
english: He took with him Peter, James, and John, and began to be greatly troubled and distressed.

kikuyu: Innis, “Lubbuun koo akka malee gadditee duʼuu geesseerti. Isin asuma turaatii dammaqaa” jedheen.
english: He said to them, “My soul is exceedingly sorrowful, even to death. Stay here and watch.”

kikuyu: Innis xinnoo achi hiiqee lafatti gombifamee, yoo dandaʼame akka saʼaatiin sun isa irra darbituuf kadhate.
english: He went forward a little, and fell on the ground, and prayed that if it were possible, the hour might pass away from him.

kikuyu: Innis, “Aabbaa,yaa Abbaa, wanni hundinuu siif ni dandaʼama. Xoofoo kana narraa fuudhi. Garuu akka fedhii keetii malee akka fedhii kootii hin taʼin” jedhe.
english: He said, “Abba, Father, all things are possible to you. Please remove this cup from me. However, not what I desire, but what you desire.”

kikuyu: Innis gara barattoota isaatti deebiʼee utuu rafanuu isaan arge. Phexrosiinis akkana jedhe; “Simoon, ati amma illee inuma raftaa? Saʼaatii tokkittii illee dammaquu hin dandeenyee?
english: He came and found them sleeping, and said to Peter, “Simon, are you sleeping? Couldn’t you watch one hour?

kikuyu: Isin akka qorumsatti hin galleef dammaqaa kadhadhaa. Hafuurri qophaaʼaa dha; foon garuu dadhabaa dha.”
english: Watch and pray, that you may not enter into temptation. The spirit indeed is willing, but the flesh is weak.”

kikuyu: Ammas achi hiiqee waanuma duraan kadhate sana kadhate.
english: Again he went away and prayed, saying the same words.

kikuyu: Inni yommuu deebiʼee dhufetti, ammas utuu rafanuu isaan arge; iji isaanii itti ulfaatee tureetii. Isaanis akka maal jedhanii deebisaniif hin beekne.
english: Again he returned and found them sleeping, for their eyes were very heavy; and they didn’t know what to answer him.

kikuyu: Yeroo sadaffaas deebiʼee akkana jedheen; “Isin amma iyyuu raftanii boqochaa jirtuu? Ni gaʼa! Saʼaatiin sun gaʼeera. Kunoo, Ilmi Namaa dabarfamee harka cubbamootaatti ni kennama.
english: He came the third time and said to them, “Sleep on now, and take your rest. It is enough. The hour has come. Behold, the Son of Man is betrayed into the hands of sinners.

kikuyu: Kaʼaa ni deemnaa! Kunoo, namichi dabarsee na kennu sun dhufaa jira.”
english: Arise! Let’s get going. Behold, he who betrays me is at hand.”

kikuyu: Utuma inni dubbachaa jiruus, Yihuudaan namichi warra Kudha Lamaan keessaa tokko taʼe sun dhufe. Tuunni luboota hangafoota, barsiistota seeraatii fi maanguddoota biraa ergames goraadee fi bokkuu qabatee isa wajjin dhufe.
english: Immediately, while he was still speaking, Judas, one of the twelve, came—and with him a multitude with swords and clubs, from the chief priests, the scribes, and the elders.

kikuyu: Inni dabarsee Yesuusin kennu sunis, “Namichi ani dhungadhu isa; isinis isa qabaatii eegaa isa fuudhaa deemaa” jedhee mallattoo kenneefii ture.
english: Now he who betrayed him had given them a sign, saying, “Whomever I will kiss, that is he. Seize him, and lead him away safely.”

kikuyu: Yihuudaanis yommusuma Yesuusitti dhiʼaatee, “Yaa Barsiisaa!” jedhee isa dhungate.
english: When he had come, immediately he came to him and said, “Rabbi! Rabbi!” and kissed him.

kikuyu: Namoonni sun Yesuusin qabanii hidhan.
english: They laid their hands on him and seized him.

kikuyu: Warra achi dhadhaabachaa turan keessaa inni tokko garuu goraadee isaa luqqifatee garbicha luba ol aanaa dhaʼee gurra isaa irraa kute.
english: But a certain one of those who stood by drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his ear.

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhe; “Isin goraadee fi bokkuu qabattanii akka nama hattuu qabuutti na qabuu dhuftanii?
english: Jesus answered them, “Have you come out, as against a robber, with swords and clubs to seize me?

kikuyu: Ani guyyuma guyyaan mana qulqullummaa keessatti barsiisaa isin wajjin ture; isinis na hin qabne. Garuu Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluun raawwatamuu qabu.”
english: I was daily with you in the temple teaching, and you didn’t arrest me. But this is so that the Scriptures might be fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Isaan hundinuus isa dhiisanii baqatan.
english: They all left him, and fled.

kikuyu: Dargaggeessi tokkos uffata quncee talbaa irraa hojjetame tokko qullaa isaa irra buufatee Yesuus faana deemaa ture. Yeroo isa qabanittis,
english: A certain young man followed him, having a linen cloth thrown around himself over his naked body. The young men grabbed him,

kikuyu: dargaggeessi sun uffata isaa dhiisee, qullaa isaa harkaa baʼe.
english: but he left the linen cloth and fled from them naked.

kikuyu: Isaanis Yesuusin luba ol aanaatti geessan; luboonni hangafoonni, maanguddoonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa hundinuu walitti qabaman.
english: They led Jesus away to the high priest. All the chief priests, the elders, and the scribes came together with him.

kikuyu: Phexrosis hamma dallaa luba ol aanaa keessaatti fagootti isa duukaa buʼe. Innis waardiyyoota wajjin ibidda bira taaʼee qaqqaammachaa ture.
english: Peter had followed him from a distance, until he came into the court of the high priest. He was sitting with the officers, and warming himself in the light of the fire.

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonnii fi yaaʼiin guutuun Yesuusin ajjeesuuf jedhanii ragaa isatti barbaadaa turan; isaan garuu homaa hin arganne.
english: Now the chief priests and the whole council sought witnesses against Jesus to put him to death, and found none.

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeen sobaan isatti dhugaa baʼan; dhuga baʼumsi isaanii garuu tokko hin taane.
english: For many gave false testimony against him, and their testimony didn’t agree with each other.

kikuyu: Tokko tokko immoo kaʼanii akkana jedhaanii sobaan isatti dhugaa baʼan:
english: Some stood up and gave false testimony against him, saying,

kikuyu: “ ‘Mana qulqullummaa kan harka namaatiin ijaarame kana diigee kan biraa kan harka namaatiin hin ijaaramin guyyaa sadii keessatti deebisee nan ijaara’ jechuu isaa dhageenyeerra.”
english: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple that is made with hands, and in three days I will build another made without hands.’”

kikuyu: Haa taʼuu malee dhuga baʼumsi isaanii amma illee tokko hin taane.
english: Even so, their testimony didn’t agree.

kikuyu: Lubichi ol aanaanis kaʼee fuula isaanii dura dhaabatee, “Ati deebii tokko illee hin kennituu? Wanni namoonni kunneen dhugaa sitti baʼan kun maali?” jedhee Yesuusin gaafate.
english: The high priest stood up in the middle, and asked Jesus, “Have you no answer? What is it which these testify against you?”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu inuma calʼise malee deebii tokko illee hin kennine. Lubichi ol aanaan ammas, “Kiristoos Ilmi isa Eebbifamaa Sanaa sii?” jedhee isa gaafate.
english: But he stayed quiet, and answered nothing. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Christ, the Son of the Blessed?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Eeyyee ana; isin utuu Ilmi Namaa karaa mirga Humna Qabeessa sanaatiin taaʼee, duumessa samiitiin dhufuu ni argitu” jedhe.
english: Jesus said, “I am. You will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of Power, and coming with the clouds of the sky.”

kikuyu: Lubichi ol aanaan uffata isaa tarsaasee akkana jedhe; “Kana caalaa dhuga baatota maalii nu barbaachisa?
english: The high priest tore his clothes and said, “What further need have we of witnesses?

kikuyu: Waaqa arrabsuu isaa isini iyyuu dhageessaniirtu. Maal isinitti fakkaata?” Hundi isaaniis duʼatu isaaf mala jedhanii isatti muran.
english: You have heard the blasphemy! What do you think?” They all condemned him to be worthy of death.

kikuyu: Namoonni tokko tokko isatti tufuu jalqaban; fuula isaas haguuganii abootteen isa rukutanii, “Mee raajii dubbadhu!” jedhan. Eegdonnis fuudhanii isa kakkabalan.
english: Some began to spit on him, and to cover his face, and to beat him with fists, and to tell him, “Prophesy!” The officers struck him with the palms of their hands.

kikuyu: Utuu Phexros dallaa sana keessa gara gadii jiruu xomboreewwan luba ol aanaa keessaa tokko dhufte.
english: As Peter was in the courtyard below, one of the maids of the high priest came,

kikuyu: Isheen utuu Phexros ibidda qaqqaammatuu argite; hubattees isa ilaalte. Isheenis, “Atis Yesuus nama Naazreeti sana wajjin turte” jetteen.
english: and seeing Peter warming himself, she looked at him and said, “You were also with the Nazarene, Jesus!”

kikuyu: Inni garuu, “Ani waan ati jettu hin beeku; naaf hin galus” jedhee gane. Karra dallaatiinis gad baʼe; indaanqoonis ni iyye.
english: But he denied it, saying, “I neither know nor understand what you are saying.” He went out on the porch, and the rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Xomboreen sun ammas isa argitee warra achi dhadhaabataniin, “Namichi kun jara keessaa tokkoo dha” jette.
english: The maid saw him and began again to tell those who stood by, “This is one of them.”

kikuyu: Inni garuu ammas ni gane. Yeroo xinnoo booddee immoo warri achi dhadhaabachaa turan Phexrosiin, “Atis nama Galiilaa waan taateef dhuguma iyyuu jara keessaa tokkoo dha!” jedhaniin.
english: But he again denied it. After a little while again those who stood by said to Peter, “You truly are one of them, for you are a Galilean, and your speech shows it.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Ani namicha isin waaʼee isaa dubbattan kana hin beeku” jedhee of abaaruu fi kakachuu jalqabe.
english: But he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know this man of whom you speak!”

kikuyu: Yommusuma indaanqoon lammata iyye. Phexrosis dubbii Yesuus, “Utuu indaanqoon yeroo lama hin iyyin, ati yeroo sadii na ganta” isaan jedhee ture sana yaadatee booʼe.
english: The rooster crowed the second time. Peter remembered the words that Jesus said to him, “Before the rooster crows twice, you will deny me three times.” When he thought about that, he wept.

kikuyu: Ganama barii luboonni hangafoonni, maanguddoota, barsiistota seeraatii fi guutummaa yaaʼii Yihuudootaa wajjin mariʼatanii Yesuusin hidhanii, geessanii Phiilaaxoositti dabarsanii kennan.
english: Immediately in the morning the chief priests, with the elders, scribes, and the whole council, held a consultation, bound Jesus, carried him away, and delivered him up to Pilate.

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis, “Ati mootii Yihuudootaatii?” jedhee isa gaafate. Yesuus immoo, “Atuu jette kaa!” jedhee deebise.
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered, “So you say.”

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonni waan baayʼeedhaan isa himatan.
english: The chief priests accused him of many things.

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoos amma illee, “Ati deebii hin kennituu? Isaan waan meeqaan akka si himatan mee ilaali” jedhee isa gaafate.
english: Pilate again asked him, “Have you no answer? See how many things they testify against you!”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu amma illee deebii tokko iyyuu hin kennine; Phiilaaxoosis ni dinqisiifate.
english: But Jesus made no further answer, so that Pilate marveled.

kikuyu: Innis nama hidhame kan sabni gaafate tokko Guyyaa Ayyaanaa hunda gad dhiisa ture.
english: Now at the feast he used to release to them one prisoner, whomever they asked of him.

kikuyu: Namichi Barabbaas jedhamu tokko finciltoota goolii kaasanii nama ajjeesan wajjin mana hidhaa keessa ture.
english: There was one called Barabbas, bound with his fellow insurgents, men who in the insurrection had committed murder.

kikuyu: Uummanni sunis Phiilaaxoos bira dhaqee akka inni waan duraan gochaafii ture sana isaanii godhu isa kadhate.
english: The multitude, crying aloud, began to ask him to do as he always did for them.

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoos garuu, “Akka ani mootii Yihuudootaa gad isinii dhiisu barbaadduu?” jedhee gaafate;
english: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: inni akka luboonni hangafoonni hinaaffaadhaan Yesuusin dabarsanii isatti kennan ni beeka tureetii.
english: For he perceived that for envy the chief priests had delivered him up.

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonni garuu akka Phiilaaxoos qooda Yesuus Barabbaasin gad dhiisu akka isa kadhataniif namoota kakaasan.
english: But the chief priests stirred up the multitude, that he should release Barabbas to them instead.

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis, “Yoos namicha isin mootii Yihuudootaa jettaniin kana maal godhu ree?” jedhee amma illee isaan gaafate.
english: Pilate again asked them, “What then should I do to him whom you call the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Isaan amma illee, “Isa fannisi!” jedhanii iyyan.
english: They cried out again, “Crucify him!”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoos immoo, “Maaliif? Inni yakka maalii hojjete?” jedhee gaafate. Isaan garuu ittuma caalchisanii, “Isa fannisi!” jedhanii iyyan.
english: Pilate said to them, “Why, what evil has he done?” But they cried out exceedingly, “Crucify him!”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Phiilaaxoos namoota gammachiisuuf jedhee Barabbaasin gad isaaniif dhiise. Yesuusin garuu garafsiisee akka inni fannifamuuf dabarsee kenne.
english: Pilate, wishing to please the multitude, released Barabbas to them, and handed over Jesus, when he had flogged him, to be crucified.

kikuyu: Ergasii loltoonni Yesuusin mana bulchaatti, jechuunis Piraayitooriyoonitti ol galchan; raayyaa loltootaa hundas walitti waaman.
english: The soldiers led him away within the court, which is the Praetorium; and they called together the whole cohort.

kikuyu: Uffata dhiilgee itti uffisan; gonfoo qoraattiis micciiranii dhaʼanii isa irra kaaʼan.
english: They clothed him with purple; and weaving a crown of thorns, they put it on him.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Akkam ree, yaa mootii Yihuudootaa!” jedhanii nagaa isa gaafachuu jalqaban.
english: They began to salute him, “Hail, King of the Jews!”

kikuyu: Uleedhaanis mataa isaa rukutan; isattis tufan. Jilbeenfataniis sagadaniif.
english: They struck his head with a reed and spat on him, and bowing their knees, did homage to him.

kikuyu: Erga itti qoosanii booddee uffata diimaa dhiilgee sana irraa baasanii wayyaa isaa deebisanii isatti uffisan. Fannisuufis isa fuudhanii deeman.
english: When they had mocked him, they took the purple cloak off him, and put his own garments on him. They led him out to crucify him.

kikuyu: Isaanis namicha Qareenaa kan Simoon jedhamu tokko utuu inni baadiyyaadhaa dhufee achiin darbaa jiruu arganii akka inni fannoo Yesuus baatuuf isa dirqisiisan. Namichi kunis abbaa Iskindiroosii fi Ruufoosii ti.
english: They compelled one passing by, coming from the country, Simon of Cyrene, the father of Alexander and Rufus, to go with them that he might bear his cross.

kikuyu: Isaanis iddoo Golgootaa jedhamutti Yesuusin geessan; Golgootaa jechuun “Iddoo buqqee mataa” jechuu dha.
english: They brought him to the place called Golgotha, which is, being interpreted, “The place of a skull.”

kikuyu: Jarris akka inni daadhii wayinii kan qumbiin walitti makame dhuguuf kennaniif; inni garuu fudhachuu dide.
english: They offered him wine mixed with myrrh to drink, but he didn’t take it.

kikuyu: Isaanis isa fannisan. Uffata isaas gargar qoodatanii tokkoon tokkoon namaa maal akka argatu murteessuuf ixaa buufatan.
english: Crucifying him, they parted his garments among them, casting lots on them, what each should take.

kikuyu: Yeroon isaan itti isa fannisanis ganama saʼaatii sadii ture.
english: It was the third hour when they crucified him.

kikuyu: Katabbiin waan inni ittiin himatamee kan, Mooticha Yihuudootaa, jedhu mataa isaatiin ol ture.
english: The superscription of his accusation was written over him: “THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Hattoota lamas, isa tokko mirga isaatiin, kaan immoo bitaa isaatiin isa wajjin fannisan. [
english: With him they crucified two robbers, one on his right hand, and one on his left.

kikuyu: Kanaanis dubbiin kitaabni, “Inni akka seera cabsitootaatti lakkaaʼame” jedhu sun ni raawwatame.]
english: The Scripture was fulfilled which says, “He was counted with transgressors.”

kikuyu: Warri achiin darbanis isa arrabsan; mataa isaaniis raasanii, “Muu! Ati kan mana qulqullummaa diigdee guyyaa sadiitti ijaartu,
english: Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads and saying, “Ha! You who destroy the temple and build it in three days,

kikuyu: mee fannoo irraa gad buʼiitii of oolchi!” jedhan.
english: save yourself, and come down from the cross!”

kikuyu: Akkasumas luboonni hangafoonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa wajjin itti qoosan. Akkanas jedhan; “Inni warra kaan oolcheera; ofii isaa garuu oolchuu hin dandaʼu!
english: Likewise, also the chief priests mocking among themselves with the scribes said, “He saved others. He can’t save himself.

kikuyu: Akka nu arginee amannuuf Kiristoos mootichi Israaʼel kun mee amma fannoo irraa gad haa buʼu.” Warri isa wajjin fannifamanis isa arrabsan.
english: Let the Christ, the King of Israel, now come down from the cross, that we may see and believe him.” Those who were crucified with him also insulted him.

kikuyu: Saʼaatii jaʼaa jalqabee, hamma saʼaatii sagaliitti dukkanni lafa hunda irra buʼe.
english: When the sixth hour had come, there was darkness over the whole land until the ninth hour.

kikuyu: Saʼaatii sagalittis Yesuus sagalee guddaadhaan, “Eloohee! Eloohee!Laamaa Sabaqtaanii?” jedhee iyye. Hiikkaan isaas, “Yaa Waaqa ko! Yaa Waaqa ko! Ati maaliif na dhiifte?” jechuu dha.
english: At the ninth hour Jesus cried with a loud voice, saying, “Eloi, Eloi, lama sabachthani?” which is, being interpreted, “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”

kikuyu: Warra achi dhadhaabatan keessaa tokko tokko yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti, “Ilaa, inni Eeliyaasin waamaa” jedhan.
english: Some of those who stood by, when they heard it, said, “Behold, he is calling Elijah.”

kikuyu: Namichi tokkos fiigee, ispoonjii dhangaggaaʼaadhaan guutee, uleetti kaaʼe; akka inni dhuguufis Yesuusiif kennee, “Mee isa dhiisaa. Akka Eeliyaas dhufee gad isa buusu arginaatii” jedhe.
english: One ran, and filling a sponge full of vinegar, put it on a reed and gave it to him to drink, saying, “Let him be. Let’s see whether Elijah comes to take him down.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis sagalee guddaadhaan iyyee hafuura dhumaa baafate.
english: Jesus cried out with a loud voice, and gave up the spirit.

kikuyu: Golgaan mana qulqullummaas olii hamma gadiitti iddoo lamatti tarsaʼe.
english: The veil of the temple was torn in two from the top to the bottom.

kikuyu: Ajajaan dhibbaa kan fuula Yesuus dura dhaabachaa tures yommuu iyyuu Yesuus dhagaʼee akka inni itti hafuura dhumaa baafate argetti, “Dhugumaanuu namichi kun Ilma Waaqaa ture!” jedhe.
english: When the centurion, who stood by opposite him, saw that he cried out like this and breathed his last, he said, “Truly this man was the Son of God!”

kikuyu: Dubartoonni tokko tokkos fagoodhaa ilaalaa turan. Isaan keessaas Maariyaam ishee Magdalaa, Maariyaam haadha Yaaqoob isa quxisuutii fi Yoosaa akkasumas Saloomee turan.
english: There were also women watching from afar, among whom were both Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of James the less and of Joses, and Salome;

kikuyu: Isaanis yeroo inni Galiilaa turetti isa duukaa buʼanii isa tajaajilaa turan. Dubartoonni isa wajjin Yerusaalemitti ol baʼan baayʼeen kaanis achi turan.
english: who, when he was in Galilee, followed him and served him; and many other women who came up with him to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Guyyaan sun Guyyaa Qophii jechuunis guyyaa Sanbataan duraa ture. Yommuu galgalaaʼettis,
english: When evening had now come, because it was the Preparation Day, that is, the day before the Sabbath,

kikuyu: Yoosef namni Armaatiyaa, miseensi yaaʼii beekamaan kan mataan isaa mootummaa Waaqaa eeggachaa ture tokko ija jabinaan gara Phiilaaxoos dhaqee reeffa Yesuus kadhate.
english: Joseph of Arimathaea, a prominent council member who also himself was looking for God’s Kingdom, came. He boldly went in to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis yommuu akka inni duʼe dhagaʼetti ni dinqifate. Ajajaa dhibbaa sanas ofitti waamee Yesuus erga duʼee turuu fi turuu baachuu isaa gaafate.
english: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead; and summoning the centurion, he asked him whether he had been dead long.

kikuyu: Akka inni duʼes ajajaa dhibbaa sana irraa erga mirkaneeffatee booddee reeffa sana Yoosefiif kenne.
english: When he found out from the centurion, he granted the body to Joseph.

kikuyu: Yoosefis huccuu quncee talbaa irraa hojjetame bitee, reeffa sana gad buusee, huccuu sanaan kafanee awwaala garaa kattaa keessatti qotate keessa kaaʼe. Dhagaa tokkos balbala awwaala sanaatti gangalchee cufe.
english: He bought a linen cloth, and taking him down, wound him in the linen cloth and laid him in a tomb which had been cut out of a rock. He rolled a stone against the door of the tomb.

kikuyu: Maariyaam isheen Magdalaatii fi Maariyaam haati Yoosaa lafa inni kaaʼame ni argan.
english: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joses, saw where he was laid.

kikuyu: Erga Sanbanni darbee booddee Maariyaam isheen Magdalaa, Maariyaam haati Yaaqoobii fi Saloomeen dhaqanii reeffa Yesuus dibuuf jedhanii urgooftuu bitan.
english: When the Sabbath was past, Mary Magdalene, and Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices, that they might come and anoint him.

kikuyu: Isaanis guyyaa jalqaba torbaan sanaa ganama barii, akkuma biiftuun baateen gara awwaalaa dhaqan;
english: Very early on the first day of the week, they came to the tomb when the sun had risen.

kikuyu: isaanis, “Eenyutu balbala awwaalaa irraa dhagaa sana nuu gangalcha?” waliin jedhan.
english: They were saying among themselves, “Who will roll away the stone from the door of the tomb for us?”

kikuyu: Yommuu milʼatanii ilaalanitti garuu akka dhagaan baayʼee guddaan sun afaan awwaalaa irraa gangalfame argan.
english: for it was very big. Looking up, they saw that the stone was rolled back.

kikuyu: Isaanis awwaala keessa seenanii dargaggeessa uffata adii uffate tokko karaa mirgaatiin taaʼee arganii rifatan.
english: Entering into the tomb, they saw a young man sitting on the right side, dressed in a white robe; and they were amazed.

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Hin rifatinaa! Isin Yesuus Nama Naazreeti isa fannifamee ture barbaaddu. Inni kaʼeera! As hin jiru. Mee iddoo isaan isa kaaʼanii turan ilaalaa.
english: He said to them, “Don’t be amazed. You seek Jesus, the Nazarene, who has been crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him!

kikuyu: Garuu dhaqaatii barattoota isaatii fi Phexrositti, ‘Inni isin dursee Galiilaa ni dhaqa. Akkuma isinitti hime sanas achitti isa ni argitu’ jedhaatii himaa.”
english: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He goes before you into Galilee. There you will see him, as he said to you.’”

kikuyu: Dubartoonni sunis hollachaa fi dinqisiifachaa gad baʼanii awwaalicha biraa baqatan. Sababii sodaataniifis nama tokkotti illee homaa hin himne. [
english: They went out, and fled from the tomb, for trembling and astonishment had come on them. They said nothing to anyone; for they were afraid.

kikuyu: Yesuusis barii guyyaa jalqaba torban sanaa yeroo duʼaa kaʼetti duraan dursee Maariyaam ishee Magdalaatti mulʼate; Maariyaam kunis kan inni hafuurota hamoo torba ishee keessaa baasee turee dha.
english: Now when he had risen early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, from whom he had cast out seven demons.

kikuyu: Isheenis dhaqxee utuu warri isa wajjin turan wawwaachuu fi booʼuutti jiranuu isaanitti himte.
english: She went and told those who had been with him, as they mourned and wept.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu yommuu akka Yesuus jiraataa taʼee fi akka isheen isa argite dhagaʼanitti waan sana hin amanne.
english: When they heard that he was alive and had been seen by her, they disbelieved.

kikuyu: Ergasiis isaan keessaa utuu namoonni lama baadiyyaa dhaqaa jiranuu Yesuus bifa biraatiin isaanitti mulʼate.
english: After these things he was revealed in another form to two of them as they walked, on their way into the country.

kikuyu: Jarris deebiʼanii warra hafanitti himan; isaan garuu warra kanas hin amanne.
english: They went away and told it to the rest. They didn’t believe them, either.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Yesuus utuu isaan maaddiitti dhiʼaatanii jiranuu warra Kudha Tokkotti mulʼate; innis sababii isaan warra erga inni duʼaa kaʼe isa argan sana amanuu didaniif, amantii dhabuu isaaniitii fi mata jabina isaaniitiif isaan ifate.
english: Afterward he was revealed to the eleven themselves as they sat at the table; and he rebuked them for their unbelief and hardness of heart, because they didn’t believe those who had seen him after he had risen.

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Gara addunyaa hundaa dhaqaa; uumama hundumattis wangeela lallabaa.
english: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the Good News to the whole creation.

kikuyu: Namni amanuu fi cuuphamu kam iyyuu ni fayya; nama hin amannetti garuu ni murama.
english: He who believes and is baptized will be saved; but he who disbelieves will be condemned.

kikuyu: Mallattoon kunis warra amanan irraa mulʼata; isaan maqaa kootiin hafuurota hamoo baasu; afaan haaraadhaan dubbatu;
english: These signs will accompany those who believe: in my name they will cast out demons; they will speak with new languages;

kikuyu: harka isaaniitiin bofa ni qabu; yoo summii nama ajjeesu dhugan isaan hin miidhu; harka isaanii namoota dhukkubsatan irra ni kaaʼu; namoonnis ni fayyu.”
english: they will take up serpents; and if they drink any deadly thing, it will in no way hurt them; they will lay hands on the sick, and they will recover.”

kikuyu: Yesuus Gooftaan erga isaanitti dubbatee booddee samiitti ol fudhatamee gara mirga Waaqaatiin taaʼe.
english: So then the Lord, after he had spoken to them, was received up into heaven and sat down at the right hand of God.

kikuyu: Barattoonnis achii baʼanii iddoo hundatti lallaban; Gooftaanis isaan wajjin hojjechaa ture; dubbii isaas dinqiiwwan hojjetamaniin ni mirkaneessa ture.]
english: They went out and preached everywhere, the Lord working with them and confirming the word by the signs that followed. Amen.

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeen seenaa wantoota nu gidduutti raawwatame sanaa barreessuu yaalaniiru;
english: Since many have undertaken to set in order a narrative concerning those matters which have been fulfilled among us,

kikuyu: kunis akka warri jalqabaa kaasanii ijaan arganii fi tajaajiltoota dubbichaa turan sun nutti dabarsanii kennanitti.
english: even as those who from the beginning were eyewitnesses and servants of the word delivered them to us,

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa Tewofilos kabajamaa, anis jalqabumaa kaasee waan hundumaa sirriitti ergan qoradhee booddee seenaa sana wal duraa duubaan siif barreessuun waan gaarii natti fakkaateera.
english: it seemed good to me also, having traced the course of all things accurately from the first, to write to you in order, most excellent Theophilus;

kikuyu: Kunis akka wanni ati baratte sun dhugaa taʼe akka beektuuf.
english: that you might know the certainty concerning the things in which you were instructed.

kikuyu: Bara Heroodis mootii Yihuudaa turetti ramaddii lubummaa Abiyaa keessaa luba Zakkaariyaas jedhamu tokkotu ture; niitiin isaa Elsaabeexis sanyii Aroon.
english: There was in the days of Herod, the king of Judea, a certain priest named Zacharias, of the priestly division of Abijah. He had a wife of the daughters of Aaron, and her name was Elizabeth.

kikuyu: Lamaan isaanii iyyuu ajajaa fi seera Gooftaa hunda mudaa malee eeguudhaan fuula Waaqaa duratti qajeeltota turan.
english: They were both righteous before God, walking blamelessly in all the commandments and ordinances of the Lord.

kikuyu: Garuu Elsaabeex waan dhabduu turteef ijoollee hin qaban ture; lamaan isaanii iyyuu dulloomanii turan.
english: But they had no child, because Elizabeth was barren, and they both were well advanced in years.

kikuyu: Zakkaariyaasis dabareen garee isaa geenyaan utuu fuula Waaqaa duratti tajaajila lubummaa isaa kennaa jiruu,
english: Now while he executed the priest’s office before God in the order of his division

kikuyu: akkuma duudhaa lubummaatti akka mana qulqullummaa Gooftaa seenee ixaana aarsuuf ixaadhaan filatame.
english: according to the custom of the priest’s office, his lot was to enter into the temple of the Lord and burn incense.

kikuyu: Yeroo ixaanni aarfamuttis namoonni baayʼeen alatti kadhachaa turan.
english: The whole multitude of the people were praying outside at the hour of incense.

kikuyu: Ergamaan Gooftaas iddoo aarsaa ixaanaatiin mirga dhaabatee Zakkaariyaasitti mulʼate.
english: An angel of the Lord appeared to him, standing on the right side of the altar of incense.

kikuyu: Zakkaariyaasis yommuu isa argetti ni rifate; sodaanis isa qabate.
english: Zacharias was troubled when he saw him, and fear fell upon him.

kikuyu: Ergamaan sun garuu akkana isaan jedhe; “Yaa Zakkaariyaas, hin sodaatin; kadhannaan kee dhagaʼameera. Niitiin kee Elsaabeex ilma siif deessi; atis maqaa isaa Yohannis jedhii moggaasi.
english: But the angel said to him, “Don’t be afraid, Zacharias, because your request has been heard. Your wife, Elizabeth, will bear you a son, and you shall call his name John.

kikuyu: Ati ilillee fi gammachuu ni qabaatta; namoonni baayʼeenis dhalachuu isaatti ni gammadu;
english: You will have joy and gladness, and many will rejoice at his birth.

kikuyu: inni fuula Gooftaa duratti guddaa taʼaatii. Daadhii wayinii yookaan dhugaatii nama macheessu gonkumaa dhuguu hin qabu; utuma garaa haadha isaa keessa jiruus Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan ni guutama.
english: For he will be great in the sight of the Lord, and he will drink no wine nor strong drink. He will be filled with the Holy Spirit, even from his mother’s womb.

kikuyu: Saba Israaʼel keessaas namoota baayʼee gara Gooftaa, gara Waaqa isaaniitti ni deebisa.
english: He will turn many of the children of Israel to the Lord their God.

kikuyu: Innis saba Gooftaaf qophaaʼe tokko kurfeessuuf jedhee garaa abbootii gara ijoollee isaaniitti, warra hin ajajamne immoo gara ogummaa qajeeltotaatti deebisuuf hafuuraa fi humna Eeliyaasiin fuula Gooftaa dura ni deema.”
english: He will go before him in the spirit and power of Elijah, ‘to turn the hearts of the fathers to the children,’ and the disobedient to the wisdom of the just; to prepare a people prepared for the Lord.”

kikuyu: Zakkaariyaasis, “Ani akkamittin kana beeka? Ani dulloomeera; umuriin niitii kootiis deemee jira” jedhee ergamaa sana gaafate.
english: Zacharias said to the angel, “How can I be sure of this? For I am an old man, and my wife is well advanced in years.”

kikuyu: Ergamaan sunis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Ani Gabriʼeel isa fuula Waaqaa dura dhaabatuu dha; anis sitti dubbachuu fi oduu gammachiisaa kana sitti himuuf ergameera.
english: The angel answered him, “I am Gabriel, who stands in the presence of God. I was sent to speak to you and to bring you this good news.

kikuyu: Kunoo, ati sababii dubbii koo isa yeroo isaatti mirkanaaʼu hin amaniniif hamma gaafa wanni kun taʼuutti ni duudda; dubbachuus hin dandeessu.”
english: Behold, you will be silent and not able to speak until the day that these things will happen, because you didn’t believe my words, which will be fulfilled in their proper time.”

kikuyu: Uummannis yeroo sana sababii Zakkaariyaas yeroo akkas dheeratu mana qulqullummaa keessa tureef dinqifachaa isa eegaa ture.
english: The people were waiting for Zacharias, and they marveled that he delayed in the temple.

kikuyu: Garuu Zakkaariyaas yommuu gad baʼetti waan isaanitti dubbachuu hin dandaʼiiniif isaan akka inni mana qulqullummaa keessatti mulʼata wayii arge hubatan; innis mallattoon isaanitti himaa ture malee dubbachuu hin dandeenye.
english: When he came out, he could not speak to them. They perceived that he had seen a vision in the temple. He continued making signs to them, and remained mute.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu yeroon tajaajila isaa raawwatetti gara mana isaatti deebiʼe.
english: When the days of his service were fulfilled, he departed to his house.

kikuyu: Ergasii niitiin isaa Elsaabeex ulfooftee hamma jiʼa shaniitti manaa hin baane.
english: After these days Elizabeth his wife conceived, and she hid herself five months, saying,

kikuyu: Isheenis, “Gooftaan salphina namoota gidduutti narra ture narraa kaasuuf jedhee guyyaa arjummaan na yaadatetti waan kana naa godhe” jette.
english: “Thus has the Lord done to me in the days in which he looked at me, to take away my reproach among men.”
