kikuyu: Jiʼa jaʼaffaattis Gabriʼeel Ergamichi Waaqa biraa gara magaalaa Naazreeti ishee Galiilaa keessatti argamtuutti ergame;
english: Now in the sixth month, the angel Gabriel was sent from God to a city of Galilee named Nazareth,

kikuyu: innis gara durba namichi sanyii Daawit irraa dhalate kan maqaan isaa Yoosef jedhamu tokkoof kaadhimamtee dhufe. Maqaan durba qulqullittii sanaas Maariyaam ture.
english: to a virgin pledged to be married to a man whose name was Joseph, of David’s house. The virgin’s name was Mary.

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqaa sunis gara ishee dhaqee, “Yaa ishee surraa argatte; nagaan siif haa taʼu! Gooftaan si wajjin jira” jedhe.
english: Having come in, the angel said to her, “Rejoice, you highly favored one! The Lord is with you. Blessed are you among women!”

kikuyu: Maariyaam garuu dubbii ergamaa sanaatiin akka malee jeeqamtee, “Kun nagaa akkamiitii?” jettee yaadde.
english: But when she saw him, she was greatly troubled at the saying, and considered what kind of salutation this might be.

kikuyu: Ergamichi garuu akkana isheedhaan jedhe; “Yaa Maariyaam, hin sodaatin; ati Waaqa biraa surraa argatteertaatii.
english: The angel said to her, “Don’t be afraid, Mary, for you have found favor with God.

kikuyu: Kunoo ni ulfoofta; Ilmas ni deessa; maqaa isaas Yesuus jettee moggaafta.
english: Behold, you will conceive in your womb and give birth to a son, and shall name him ‘Jesus.’

kikuyu: Innis guddaa ni taʼa; Ilma Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii jedhamees ni waamama. Waaqni Gooftaanis teessoo Abbaa isaa Daawit ni kennaaf;
english: He will be great and will be called the Son of the Most High. The Lord God will give him the throne of his father David,

kikuyu: inni mana Yaaqoob irratti bara baraan ni moʼa; mootummaan isaas dhuma hin qabu.”
english: and he will reign over the house of Jacob forever. There will be no end to his Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Maariyaamis, “Ani durba; yoos wanni kun akkamitti taʼuu dandaʼa ree?” jettee ergamaa sana gaafatte.
english: Mary said to the angel, “How can this be, seeing I am a virgin?”

kikuyu: Ergamaan sunis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Hafuurri Qulqulluun sirra buʼa; humni Waaqa Waan Hundaa Oliis si golbooba. Kanaaf inni qulqulluun dhalatu sun Ilma Waaqaa ni jedhama.
english: The angel answered her, “The Holy Spirit will come on you, and the power of the Most High will overshadow you. Therefore also the holy one who is born from you will be called the Son of God.

kikuyu: Kunoo, firri kee Elsaabeexi iyyuu dulluma ishee keessa ilma ulfoofteerti; isheen dhabduu jedhamaa turte sun jiʼa jaʼaffaa qabatteerti.
english: Behold, Elizabeth your relative also has conceived a son in her old age; and this is the sixth month with her who was called barren.

kikuyu: Wanni Waaqaaf hin dandaʼamne hin jiruutii.”
english: For nothing spoken by God is impossible.”

kikuyu: Maariyaamis, “Kunoo, ani garbittii Gooftaa ti. Akkuma ati dubbatte naaf haa taʼu” jetteen. Ergamichis ishee dhiisee deeme.
english: Mary said, “Behold, the servant of the Lord; let it be done to me according to your word.” Then the angel departed from her.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana Maariyaam kaatee ariitiidhaan gara magaalaa baddaa biyya Yihuudaa tokkoo dhaqxe.
english: Mary arose in those days and went into the hill country with haste, into a city of Judah,

kikuyu: Isheenis mana Zakkaariyaas seentee Elsaabeexin nagaa gaafatte.
english: and entered into the house of Zacharias and greeted Elizabeth.

kikuyu: Elsaabeexis yommuu nagaa Maariyaam dhageessetti mucaan sun gadameessa ishee keessa uʼutaale. Elsaabeexis Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan ni guutamte.
english: When Elizabeth heard Mary’s greeting, the baby leaped in her womb; and Elizabeth was filled with the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Isheenis sagalee ishee ol fudhattee iyyitee akkana jette; “Ati dubartoota keessaa eebbifamtuu dha; mucaan ati deessus eebbifamaa dha.
english: She called out with a loud voice and said, “Blessed are you among women, and blessed is the fruit of your womb!

kikuyu: Garuu akka haati Gooftaa koo gara koo dhuftuuf arjummaan akkanaa akkamitti naa godhame?
english: Why am I so favored, that the mother of my Lord should come to me?

kikuyu: Kunoo, akkuma sagaleen nagaa keetii gurra koo seeneen ulfi gadameessa koo keessa jiru gammachuun utaaleera.
english: For behold, when the voice of your greeting came into my ears, the baby leaped in my womb for joy!

kikuyu: Wanni Gooftaan isheetti dubbate akka raawwatamu kan amante isheen eebbifamtuu dha!”
english: Blessed is she who believed, for there will be a fulfillment of the things which have been spoken to her from the Lord!”

kikuyu: Maariyaamis akkana jette: “Lubbuun koo Gooftaadhaaf ulfina kenniti;
english: Mary said, “My soul magnifies the Lord.

kikuyu: hafuurri koos fayyisaa koo Waaqatti ni gammada;
english: My spirit has rejoiced in God my Savior,

kikuyu: inni salphina garbittii isaa argeeraatii. Kunoo ammaa jalqabee dhaloonni hundinuu eebbifamtuu naan jedha;
english: for he has looked at the humble state of his servant. For behold, from now on, all generations will call me blessed.

kikuyu: Inni humna qabeessi sun waan guddaa naa godheeraatii; maqaan isaa qulqulluu dha.
english: For he who is mighty has done great things for me. Holy is his name.

kikuyu: Araarri isaas warra isa sodaataniif dhalootaa hamma dhalootaatti itti fufa.
english: His mercy is for generations and generations on those who fear him.

kikuyu: Inni irree isaatiin hojiiwwan gurguddaa hojjeteera; of tuultotas yaada garaa isaaniitiin bittinneesseera.
english: He has shown strength with his arm. He has scattered the proud in the imagination of their hearts.

kikuyu: Bulchitoota teessoo isaanii irraa buuseera; gad of qabeeyyii garuu ol kaaseera.
english: He has put down princes from their thrones, and has exalted the lowly.

kikuyu: Warra beelaʼan waan gaariidhaan quufseera; sooreyyii garuu harka duwwaa deebiseera.
english: He has filled the hungry with good things. He has sent the rich away empty.

kikuyu: Inni araara qabeessa taʼuu isaa yaadachaa garbicha isaa Israaʼelin gargaareera;
english: He has given help to Israel, his servant, that he might remember mercy,

kikuyu: kunis akkuma inni abbootii keenyaaf, Abrahaamii fi sanyii isaatiif bara baraan waadaa galetti.”
english: as he spoke to our fathers, to Abraham and his offspring forever.”

kikuyu: Maariyaamis gara jiʼa sadii Elsaabeexi bira turtee gara mana ofii isheetti deebite.
english: Mary stayed with her about three months, and then returned to her house.

kikuyu: Elsaabeexi yeroon daʼumsa ishee geenyaan ilma deesse.
english: Now the time that Elizabeth should give birth was fulfilled, and she gave birth to a son.

kikuyu: Olloonni isheetii fi firoonni ishee akka Gooftaan araara guddaa isheef godhe dhagaʼanii ishee wajjin gammadan.
english: Her neighbors and her relatives heard that the Lord had magnified his mercy toward her, and they rejoiced with her.

kikuyu: Isaanis guyyaa saddeettaffaatti daaʼima sana dhagna qabuu dhufan; Zakkaariyaas jedhaniis maqaa abbaa isaatiin isa moggaasuu fedhan.
english: On the eighth day, they came to circumcise the child; and they would have called him Zacharias, after the name of his father.

kikuyu: Haati isaa garuu, “Lakkii! Inni Yohannis jedhamee waamamuu qaba” jette.
english: His mother answered, “Not so; but he will be called John.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Firoota kee keessa namni maqaa akkanaa qabu tokko iyyuu hin jiru” jedhaniin.
english: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis akka Zakkaariyaas eenyu jedhee daaʼima sana waamuu barbaadu beekuuf jedhanii mallattoon isa gaafatan.
english: They made signs to his father, what he would have him called.

kikuyu: Innis gabatee irratti barreessu kadhatee, “Maqaan isaa Yohannis” jedhee barreesse; hundi isaaniis ni dinqifatan.
english: He asked for a writing tablet, and wrote, “His name is John.” They all marveled.

kikuyu: Yommusuma afaan isaa banamee arrabni isaa hiikame; innis Waaqa galateeffachuudhaan dubbachuu jalqabe.
english: His mouth was opened immediately and his tongue freed, and he spoke, blessing God.

kikuyu: Olloonni isaanii hundinuu sodaadhaan guutaman; wanni kunis baddaa biyya Yihuudaa hunda keessatti odeeffame.
english: Fear came on all who lived around them, and all these sayings were talked about throughout all the hill country of Judea.

kikuyu: Warri kana dhagaʼan hundinuus, “Yoos daaʼimni kun nama akkamii taʼinna laata?” jedhanii garaa isaaniitti dinqifatan. Harki Gooftaa isa wajjin tureetii.
english: All who heard them laid them up in their heart, saying, “What then will this child be?” The hand of the Lord was with him.

kikuyu: Zakkaariyaas abbaan Yohannis Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan guutamee akkana jedhees raajii dubbate:
english: His father Zacharias was filled with the Holy Spirit, and prophesied, saying,

kikuyu: “Sababii dhufee saba isaa fureef Gooftaan, Waaqni Israaʼel haa eebbifamu.
english: “Blessed be the Lord, the God of Israel, for he has visited and redeemed his people;

kikuyu: Inni mana garbicha isaa mana Daawit keessatti gaanfa fayyinaa nuuf kaaseera;
english: and has raised up a horn of salvation for us in the house of his servant David

kikuyu: akkuma afaan raajota isaa qulqulloota duriitiin dubbatetti
english: (as he spoke by the mouth of his holy prophets who have been from of old),

kikuyu: diinota keenya jalaa, harka warra nu jibban hundumaa keessaas nu baasuuf jedhee
english: salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;

kikuyu: araara abbootii keenyaaf waadaa gale sana raawwachuudhaaf, kakuu isaa qulqulluu,
english: to show mercy toward our fathers, to remember his holy covenant,

kikuyu: inni abbaa keenya Abrahaamiif kakate yaadachuudhaaf,
english: the oath which he swore to Abraham our father,

kikuyu: harka diinota keenyaa keessaa nu baasuudhaaf, akka nu sodaa malee isa tajaajillu nu dandeessisuudhaaf,
english: to grant to us that we, being delivered out of the hand of our enemies, should serve him without fear,

kikuyu: akka nu bara jireenya keenyaa guutuu qulqullinaa fi qajeelinaan, fuula isaa duratti tajaajilluuf waan kana godhe.
english: in holiness and righteousness before him all the days of our life.

kikuyu: “Yaa mucaa ko, ati raajii Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii ni jedhamta; ati karaa isaa qopheessuuf fuula Gooftaa dura ni deemtaatii;
english: And you, child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways,

kikuyu: kunis akka ati dhiifama cubbuu argachuu isaaniitiin beekumsa fayyinaa saba isaatiif kennituuf;
english: to give knowledge of salvation to his people by the remission of their sins,

kikuyu: sababii araara Waaqa keenyaa kan gara laafinaan guutame kan bariin fayyinaa samii irraa ittiin nuu bariʼuu,
english: because of the tender mercy of our God, by which the dawn from on high will visit us,

kikuyu: warra dukkana keessa, gaaddidduu duʼaa jala jiraniif akka ifa kennuuf; miilla keenyas karaa nagaa irra deemsisuuf.”
english: to shine on those who sit in darkness and the shadow of death; to guide our feet into the way of peace.”

kikuyu: Mucichis guddatee hafuuraan jabaachaa deeme; hamma guyyaa saba Israaʼelitti mulʼateettis gammoojjii keessa jiraate.
english: The child was growing and becoming strong in spirit, and was in the desert until the day of his public appearance to Israel.

kikuyu: Bara sana keessa akka addunyaan Roomaa hundi galmeeffamuuf Awugisxoos Qeesaar biraa labsiin baʼe.
english: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

kikuyu: Lakkoobsi sabaa kunis bara Qereenewoos bulchaa biyya Sooriyaa turetti yeroo jalqabaatiif taasifame.
english: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

kikuyu: Namni hundinuu galmeeffamuuf gara magaalaa itti dhalatee dhaqe.
english: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

kikuyu: Yoosefis manaa fi sanyii Daawit keessaa waan dhalateef magaalaa Naazreeti ishee Galiilaa keessaatii kaʼee gara magaalaa Daawit ishee Yihuudaa keessaa kan Beetlihem jedhamtuutti ol baʼe.
english: Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,

kikuyu: Innis kaadhima isaa Maariyaam ishee ulfa turte sana wajjin galmeeffamuu dhaqe.
english: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

kikuyu: Utuma isaan achi jiranuus yeroon daʼumsa ishee gaʼe.
english: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

kikuyu: Isheenis ilma ishee isa hangafa deesse. Waan mana bultii keessummootaa keessa iddoon hin jiraatiniif huccuudhaan martee bidiruu keessa isa ciibsite.
english: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

kikuyu: Tiksoota halkan halkan ala bulanii bushaayee isaanii tikfatanitu biyya sana ture.
english: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

kikuyu: Ergamaan Gooftaa isaanitti mulʼate; ulfinni Gooftaas naannoo isaaniitti ibse; isaanis akka malee sodaatan.
english: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

kikuyu: Ergamaan sun garuu akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Hin sodaatinaa. Kunoo, ani oduu gaarii baayʼee nama gammachiisu kan saba hundumaaf taʼu isinii fideeraatii.
english: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

kikuyu: Harʼa magaalaa Daawit keessatti fayyisaan isiniif dhalateera; innis Kiristoos Goofticha.
english: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

kikuyu: Kunis mallattoo isiniif taʼa: Daaʼima huccuudhaan maramee bidiruu keessa ciisu tokko ni argitu.”
english: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

kikuyu: Ergamaa sana wajjinis raayyaan samii irraa baayʼeen akkuma tasaa mulʼatanii Waaqa galateeffachaa akkana jedhan;
english: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

kikuyu: “Samii gubbaatti ulfinni Waaqaaf, lafa irrattis nagaan namoota inni itti gammaduuf haa taʼu.”
english: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

kikuyu: Erga Ergamoonni tiksoota dhiisanii gara samiitti ol baʼanii booddee tiksoonni sun, “Kottaa Beetlihemin dhaqnee waan taʼe kan Gooftaan nutti hime kana ilaalaa” waliin jedhan.
english: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

kikuyu: Isaanis dafanii dhaqanii Maariyaamii fi Yoosefin, daaʼima bidiruu keessa ciisus argan.
english: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

kikuyu: Yommuu isa arganitti waan waaʼee mucichaa isaanitti himame sana odeessan;
english: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

kikuyu: warri waan kana dhagaʼan hundinuu waan tiksoonni isaanitti himan sana ni dinqifatan.
english: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

kikuyu: Maariyaam garuu waan kana hunda garaatti qabattee itti yaadaa turte.
english: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

kikuyu: Tiksoonnis sababii waan dhagaʼanii fi arganiitiif Waaqaaf ulfina kennaa, isa jajachaas deebiʼan; wanni hundinuu akkuma isaanitti himame sana tureetii.
english: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

kikuyu: Innis guyyaa saddeettaffaatti, akkuma yeroon dhagna qabaa isaa gaʼeen maqaa utuu haati isaa iyyuu isa hin ulfaaʼiniin dura ergamaan Waaqaa isaaf baaseen Yesuus jedhamee moggaafame.
english: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

kikuyu: Akka Seera Museetti yeroon qulqullaaʼummaa isaanii geenyaan Yoosefii fi Maariyaam daaʼima sana Gooftaa duratti dhiʼeessuuf jedhanii isa fudhatanii Yerusaalemitti ol baʼan.
english: When the days of their purification according to the law of Moses were fulfilled, they brought him up to Jerusalem to present him to the Lord

kikuyu: Akkuma Seera Gooftaa keessatti barreeffametti, “Dhiirri hangafni hundinuu gooftaaf ni qulqulleeffama.”
english: (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

kikuyu: Isaanis akkuma Seerri Gooftaa jedhutti, “Gugee lama yookaan gugee sosookkee lama” aarsaa dhiʼeessuu dhaqan.
english: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”

kikuyu: Kunoo, namichi qajeelaan Waaqa sodaatu kan maqaan isaa Simiʼoon jedhamu tokko Yerusaalem keessa ture. Innis jajjabeeffama Israaʼel eeggachaa ture; Hafuurri Qulqulluunis isa irra ture.
english: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

kikuyu: Hafuurri Qulqulluunis akka inni utuu Kiristoos Goofticha hin argin hin duune isatti mulʼisee ture.
english: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

kikuyu: Innis Hafuuraan qajeelfamee mana qulqullummaa seene. Abbaa fi haati Yesuus yommuu akka duudhaa seerichaatti waan barbaachisu isaaf guutuuf jedhanii Yesuus mucicha baadhatanii ol seenanitti,
english: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

kikuyu: Simiʼoon fuudhee isa hammatee akkana jedhee Waaqa galateeffate:
english: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,

kikuyu: “Yaa Gooftaa, akkuma dubbii keetiitti, ati garbicha kee amma nagaan geggeessis.
english: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

kikuyu: Iji koo fayyina kee isa ati
english: for my eyes have seen your salvation,

kikuyu: saba hundumaa duratti qopheessite argeera;
english: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;

kikuyu: innis mulʼata Namoota Ormaatiif ifa; saba kee Israaʼeliif immoo ulfina.”
english: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

kikuyu: Abbaa fi haati isaas waan waaʼee isaa dubbatame sana ni dinqifatan.
english: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.

kikuyu: Simiʼoonis isaan eebbise; haadha daaʼima sanaa Maariyaamiinis akkana jedhe; “Daaʼimni kun Israaʼel keessatti kufaatiidhaa fi kaʼumsa namoota baayʼeetiif sababii, mormii isa irratti dubbatamuufis mallattoo akka taʼu murteeffameera;
english: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.

kikuyu: kunis akka yaadni garaa namoota baayʼee ifatti baʼuuf. Goraadeen lubbuu kee ni waraana.”
english: Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”

kikuyu: Gosa Aasheer keessaas raajittii Haannaa jedhamtu tokkotu ture. Isheenis intala Faanuʼel turte; baayʼees jaartee turte; dhirsa ishee kan durbummaadhaan itti heerumte wajjin waggaa torba jiraatte;
english: There was one Anna, a prophetess, the daughter of Phanuel, of the tribe of Asher (she was of a great age, having lived with a husband seven years from her virginity,

kikuyu: isheenis hamma umuriin ishee waggaa 84 guuteetti haadha hiyyeessaa taatee jiraatte. Utuu mana qulqullummaatii hin dhabaminis soomaa fi kadhannaadhaan halkanii guyyaa waaqeffachaa turte.
english: and she had been a widow for about eighty-four years), who didn’t depart from the temple, worshiping with fastings and petitions night and day.

kikuyu: Yeruma sanas isaanitti dhiʼaattee Waaqaaf galata galchite; warra furama Yerusaalem eeggachaa turan hundattis waaʼee daaʼima sanaa odeessite.
english: Coming up at that very hour, she gave thanks to the Lord, and spoke of him to all those who were looking for redemption in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yoosefii fi Maariyaamis waan seerri Gooftaa ajaju hunda raawwatanii gara Galiilaatti gara magaalaa isaanii Naazreetitti deebiʼan.
english: When they had accomplished all things that were according to the law of the Lord, they returned into Galilee, to their own city, Nazareth.

kikuyu: Mucichis guddatee jabaachaa deeme; ogummaadhaanis ni guutame; ayyaanni Waaqaas isa irra ture.
english: The child was growing, and was becoming strong in spirit, being filled with wisdom, and the grace of God was upon him.

kikuyu: Abbaa fi haati isaa wagguma waggaan Ayyaana Faasiikaatiif jedhanii Yerusaalem dhaqaa turan.
english: His parents went every year to Jerusalem at the feast of the Passover.

kikuyu: Yommuu umuriin mucaa sanaa waggaa kudha lama guutettis akkuma sirna Ayyaanichaatti Yerusaalemitti ol baʼan.
english: When he was twelve years old, they went up to Jerusalem according to the custom of the feast;

kikuyu: Erga ayyaanichi raawwatee booddee utuu abbaa fi haati isaa gara mana isaaniitti deebiʼaa jiranuu, Yesuus mucichi Yerusaalemitti isaan biraa hafe; isaan garuu waan kana hin hubanne.
english: and when they had fulfilled the days, as they were returning, the boy Jesus stayed behind in Jerusalem. Joseph and his mother didn’t know it,

kikuyu: Isaanis waan inni miiltoo isaanii wajjin jiru seʼanii guyyaa tokko deeman. Ergasiis firoota isaaniitii fi michoota isaanii keessa isa barbaaduu jalqaban.
english: but supposing him to be in the company, they went a day’s journey; and they looked for him among their relatives and acquaintances.

kikuyu: Yommuu isa dhabanittis, isa barbaaduuf Yerusaalemitti deebiʼan.
english: When they didn’t find him, they returned to Jerusalem, looking for him.

kikuyu: Guyyaa sadii booddee utuu inni barsiistota gidduu taaʼee isaan dhaggeeffatuu, gaaffiis isaan gaafatuu mana qulqullummaa keessatti isa argatan.
english: After three days they found him in the temple, sitting in the middle of the teachers, both listening to them and asking them questions.

kikuyu: Warri isa dhagaʼan hundinuus hubannaa isaatii fi deebii inni kennu ni dinqifatan.
english: All who heard him were amazed at his understanding and his answers.

kikuyu: Abbaa fi haati isaas yommuu isa arganitti ni raajeffatan. Haati isaas, “Gurbaa, maaliif akkana nu goote? Kunoo, anii fi abbaan kee yaaddoo guddaadhaan si barbaadaa turree!” jetteen.
english: When they saw him, they were astonished; and his mother said to him, “Son, why have you treated us this way? Behold, your father and I were anxiously looking for you.”

kikuyu: Innis deebisee, “Maaliif na barbaaddan? Akka ani mana Abbaa kootti argamuu qabu hin beekne moo?” isaaniin jedhe.
english: He said to them, “Why were you looking for me? Didn’t you know that I must be in my Father’s house?”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu dubbii inni isaanitti dubbate hin hubanne.
english: They didn’t understand the saying which he spoke to them.

kikuyu: Innis isaan wajjin Naazreetitti gad buʼe; isaaniifis ni ajajama ture. Haati isaa garuu waan kana hunda garaatti qabatte.
english: And he went down with them and came to Nazareth. He was subject to them, and his mother kept all these sayings in her heart.

kikuyu: Yesuusis ogummaadhaan, hojjaa fi surraadhaan fuula Waaqaatii fi fuula namaa duratti guddachaa deeme.
english: And Jesus increased in wisdom and stature, and in favor with God and men.

kikuyu: Xibeeriyoos Qeesaar moʼee waggaa kudha shanaffaatti jechuunis yommuu Phonxoos Phiilaaxoos bulchaa Yihuudaa turetti, Heroodis bulchaa Galiilaa ture; obboleessi isaa Fiiliphoos bulchaa Ixuriyaasii fi Xiraakonitiis, Lisaaniiyaas immoo bulchaa Abileeniis turan;
english: Now in the fifteenth year of the reign of Tiberius Caesar, Pontius Pilate being governor of Judea, and Herod being tetrarch of Galilee, and his brother Philip tetrarch of the region of Ituraea and Trachonitis, and Lysanias tetrarch of Abilene,

kikuyu: yeroo sana Haannaasii fi Qayyaaffaan luboota ol aantota turan. Dubbiin Waaqaa gammoojjii keessatti gara Yohannis ilma Zakkaariyaas dhufe.
english: during the high priesthood of Annas and Caiaphas, the word of God came to John, the son of Zacharias, in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Innis dhiifama cubbuutiif cuuphaa qalbii jijjiirrannaa lallabaa biyya naannoo Yordaanos hunda keessa deeme.
english: He came into all the region around the Jordan, preaching the baptism of repentance for remission of sins.

kikuyu: Kunis isa kitaaba dubbii Isaayyaas raajichaa keessatti akkana jedhamee barreeffamee dha: “Sagalee nama gammoojjii keessaa iyyu tokkoo: ‘Karaa Gooftaa qopheessaa; daandii isaas qajeelchaa.
english: As it is written in the book of the words of Isaiah the prophet, “The voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make ready the way of the Lord. Make his paths straight.

kikuyu: Sululli hundi ni guutama; tulluu fi gaarri hundinuus gad deebifamu. Karaan jalʼaan ni qajeela; daandiin buʼaa baʼiinis wal qixxeeffama.
english: Every valley will be filled. Every mountain and hill will be brought low. The crooked will become straight, and the rough ways smooth.

kikuyu: Sanyiin namaa hundinuus fayyisuu Waaqaa ni arga.’ ”
english: All flesh will see God’s salvation.’”

kikuyu: Yohannisis warra harka isaatti cuuphamuuf dhufaniin akkana jedhe; “Isin ijoollee buutii nana! Dheekkamsa dhufu jalaa akka baqattaniif eenyutu isinitti hime?
english: He said therefore to the multitudes who went out to be baptized by him, “You offspring of vipers, who warned you to flee from the wrath to come?

kikuyu: Egaa ija qalbii jijjiirrannaa mirkaneessu naqadhaa. Isin, ‘Abbaan keenya Abrahaamii dha’ ofiin jechuu hin jalqabinaa. Waaqni dhagoota kanneen irraa Abrahaamiif ijoollee kaasuu akka dandaʼu ani isinittan himaatii.
english: Therefore produce fruits worthy of repentance, and don’t begin to say among yourselves, ‘We have Abraham for our father;’ for I tell you that God is able to raise up children to Abraham from these stones!

kikuyu: Qottoon amma iyyuu hidda mukkeenii irra kaaʼameera; mukti ija gaarii hin naqanne hundinuus muramee ibiddatti darbatama.”
english: Even now the ax also lies at the root of the trees. Every tree therefore that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down and thrown into the fire.”

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis, “Yoos maal haa goonuu ree?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: The multitudes asked him, “What then must we do?”

kikuyu: Yohannisis deebisee, “Namni uffata lama qabu isa homaa hin qabneef haa qoodu; kan nyaata qabus akkasuma haa godhu” jedheen.
english: He answered them, “He who has two coats, let him give to him who has none. He who has food, let him do likewise.”

kikuyu: Qaraxxoonni cuuphamuu dhufanii, “Yaa barsiisaa, nu hoo maal haa goonu?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: Tax collectors also came to be baptized, and they said to him, “Teacher, what must we do?”

kikuyu: Innis, “Waan ajajamtan caalaa walitti hin qabinaa” jedheen.
english: He said to them, “Collect no more than that which is appointed to you.”

kikuyu: Loltoonnis akkasuma, “Nu immoo maal haa goonu ree?” jedhanii isa gaafatan. Innis, “Humnaan nama irraa maallaqa hin fudhatinaa; sobaan nama hin himatinaa; mindaan keessan isin haa gaʼu” jedheen.
english: Soldiers also asked him, saying, “What about us? What must we do?” He said to them, “Extort from no one by violence, neither accuse anyone wrongfully. Be content with your wages.”

kikuyu: Namoonni sun hawwiidhaan eegaa turan; hundi isaaniis, “Yohannis kun inni Kiristoos taʼinnaa laata?” jedhanii garaa isaaniitti yaadaa turan.
english: As the people were in expectation, and all men reasoned in their hearts concerning John, whether perhaps he was the Christ,

kikuyu: Yohannis akkana jedhee isaan hundaaf deebii kenne; “Ani bishaaniin isin cuupha. Garuu kan na caalaa jabaa taʼe tokko ni dhufa; ani hidhaa kophee isaa illee hiikuun naaf hin malu. Inni Hafuura Qulqulluu fi ibiddaan isin cuupha.
english: John answered them all, “I indeed baptize you with water, but he comes who is mightier than I, the strap of whose sandals I am not worthy to loosen. He will baptize you in the Holy Spirit and fire.

kikuyu: Innis oobdii isaa qulqulleessee gombisaa isaatti qamadii galfachuudhaaf afarsaan isaa harka isaa jira; habaqii garuu ibidda hin dhaamneen guba.”
english: His winnowing fan is in his hand, and he will thoroughly cleanse his threshing floor, and will gather the wheat into his barn; but he will burn up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”

kikuyu: Yohannisis dubbii biraa baayʼeedhaan namoota gorsee wangeelas isaanitti lallabe.
english: Then with many other exhortations he preached good news to the people,

kikuyu: Heroodis bulchaan garuu yommuu sababii inni niitii obboleessa isaa Heroodiyaas fuudhee fi sababii hammina inni hojjetee ture kaan hundaatiif Yohannis isa ifate,
english: but Herod the tetrarch, being reproved by him for Herodias, his brother’s wife, and for all the evil things which Herod had done,

kikuyu: hammina isaa hunda irratti dabalee Yohannisin mana hidhaatti galchee itti cufe.
english: added this also to them all, that he shut up John in prison.

kikuyu: Yeroo namoonni hundinuu cuuphamaa turanitti, Yesuusis ni cuuphame. Utuu inni kadhachaa jiruu samiin banamee,
english: Now when all the people were baptized, Jesus also had been baptized and was praying. The sky was opened,

kikuyu: Hafuurri Qulqulluun bifa gugeetiin mulʼatee isa irratti gad buʼe. Sagaleen, “Ati Ilma koo isa ani jaalladhuu dha; ani sitti nan gammada” jedhu tokkos samii irraa ni dhufe.
english: and the Holy Spirit descended in a bodily form like a dove on him; and a voice came out of the sky, saying “You are my beloved Son. In you I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Yesuus yeroo tajaajila isaa jalqabetti umuriin isaa gara waggaa soddomaa ture. Innis akka waan ilma Yoosef tureetti yaadamaa ture: ilma Eelii,
english: Jesus himself, when he began to teach, was about thirty years old, being the son (as was supposed) of Joseph, the son of Heli,

kikuyu: ilma Maataat, ilma Lewwii, ilma Melkii, ilma Yaanaa, ilma Yoosef,
english: the son of Matthat, the son of Levi, the son of Melchi, the son of Jannai, the son of Joseph,

kikuyu: ilma Maataatiyaas, ilma Amoos, ilma Naahoom, ilma Asiiliim, ilma Naagee,
english: the son of Mattathias, the son of Amos, the son of Nahum, the son of Esli, the son of Naggai,

kikuyu: ilma Maaʼat, ilma Maataatiyaas, ilma Semeeʼi, ilma Yoosef, ilma Yoodaa,
english: the son of Maath, the son of Mattathias, the son of Semein, the son of Joseph, the son of Judah,

kikuyu: ilma Yoonaan, ilma Resaa, ilma Zarubaabel, ilma Sheʼaltiiʼeel, ilma Neeri,
english: the son of Joanan, the son of Rhesa, the son of Zerubbabel, the son of Shealtiel, the son of Neri,

kikuyu: ilma Melkii, ilma Hadii, ilma Qoosaam, ilma Elmaadaam, ilma Eer,
english: the son of Melchi, the son of Addi, the son of Cosam, the son of Elmodam, the son of Er,

kikuyu: ilma Iyyaasuu, ilma Eliiʼezer, ilma Yoorim, ilma Maataat, ilma Lewwii,
english: the son of Jose, the son of Eliezer, the son of Jorim, the son of Matthat, the son of Levi,

kikuyu: ilma Simiʼoon, ilma Yihuudaa, ilma Yoosef, ilma Yoonaan, ilma Eliyaaqeem,
english: the son of Simeon, the son of Judah, the son of Joseph, the son of Jonan, the son of Eliakim,

kikuyu: ilma Meeleyaa, ilma Mennaa, ilma Maataataa, ilma Naataan, ilma Daawit,
english: the son of Melea, the son of Menan, the son of Mattatha, the son of Nathan, the son of David,

kikuyu: ilma Isseey, ilma Yoobeed, ilma Boʼeez, ilma Salmoon, ilma Nahishoon,
english: the son of Jesse, the son of Obed, the son of Boaz, the son of Salmon, the son of Nahshon,

kikuyu: ilma Amiinaadaab, ilma Aaraam, ilma Hezroon, ilma Faares, ilma Yihuudaa,
english: the son of Amminadab, the son of Aram, the son of Hezron, the son of Perez, the son of Judah,

kikuyu: ilma Yaaqoob, ilma Yisihaaq, ilma Abrahaam, ilma Taaraa, ilma Naahoor,
english: the son of Jacob, the son of Isaac, the son of Abraham, the son of Terah, the son of Nahor,

kikuyu: ilma Seruug, ilma Reʼuu, ilma Feleg, ilma Eeber, ilma Saalaa,
english: the son of Serug, the son of Reu, the son of Peleg, the son of Eber, the son of Shelah,

kikuyu: ilma Qaayinaam ilma Arfaaksaad, ilma Seem, ilma Nohi, ilma Laamehi,
english: the son of Cainan, the son of Arphaxad, the son of Shem, the son of Noah, the son of Lamech,

kikuyu: ilma Matuuselaa, ilma Henook, ilma Yaared, ilma Mahalaleel, ilma Keenaan,
english: the son of Methuselah, the son of Enoch, the son of Jared, the son of Mahalaleel, the son of Cainan,

kikuyu: ilma Enoos, ilma Seeti, ilma Addaam, ilma Waaqaa.
english: the son of Enos, the son of Seth, the son of Adam, the son of God.

kikuyu: Yesuus Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan guutamee Yordaanosii kaʼee Hafuuruma sanaan gammoojjiitti geeffame;
english: Jesus, full of the Holy Spirit, returned from the Jordan and was led by the Spirit into the wilderness

kikuyu: achittis guyyaa afurtama diiyaabiloosiin qorame. Innis guyyoota sana keessa homaa hin nyaanne; dhuma irrattis ni beelaʼe.
english: for forty days, being tempted by the devil. He ate nothing in those days. Afterward, when they were completed, he was hungry.

kikuyu: Diiyaabiloosis, “Ati yoo Ilma Waaqaa taate, akka dhagaan kun buddeena taʼu ajaji” jedheen.
english: The devil said to him, “If you are the Son of God, command this stone to become bread.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo deebisee, “ ‘Namni buddeena qofaan hin jiraatu’jedhamee barreeffameera” jedheen.
english: Jesus answered him, saying, “It is written, ‘Man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word of God.’”

kikuyu: Diiyaabiloosis gaara dheeraa tokkotti ol isa baasee hamma liphsuu ijaatti mootummoota addunyaa hunda isatti argisiise.
english: The devil, leading him up on a high mountain, showed him all the kingdoms of the world in a moment of time.

kikuyu: Akkanas jedheen; “Ani taayitaa isaaniitii fi ulfina isaanii hundumaa siifin kenna; taayitaa fi ulfinni kun waan naa kennameef ani abbaa kennuufii barbaadeef kennuu nan dandaʼa.
english: The devil said to him, “I will give you all this authority and their glory, for it has been delivered to me, and I give it to whomever I want.

kikuyu: Yoo ati naa sagadde, wanni kun hundinuu kan kee taʼa.”
english: If you therefore will worship before me, it will all be yours.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “ ‘Waaqa kee Gooftichaaf sagadi, isuma qofa tajaajili’jedhamee barreeffameera” jedhee deebiseef.
english: Jesus answered him, “Get behind me, Satan! For it is written, ‘You shall worship the Lord your God, and you shall serve him only.’”

kikuyu: Diiyaabiloosis Yerusaalemitti isa geessee, fiixee mana qulqullummaa irra dhaabachiise. Akkanas jedheen; “Ati yoo Ilma Waaqaa taate, asii gad of darbadhu.
english: He led him to Jerusalem and set him on the pinnacle of the temple, and said to him, “If you are the Son of God, cast yourself down from here,

kikuyu: Akkana jedhamee barreeffameeraatii: “ ‘Inni akka isaan sirriitti si eeganiif, ergamoota isaa siif ni ajaja;
english: for it is written, ‘He will put his angels in charge of you, to guard you;’

kikuyu: isaanis akka ati miilla keetiin dhagaatti hin buuneef, harka isaaniitiin ol si fuudhu.’”
english: and, ‘On their hands they will bear you up, lest perhaps you dash your foot against a stone.’”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo deebisee, “ ‘Waaqa kee Goofticha hin qorin’jedhameera” jedheen.
english: Jesus answering, said to him, “It has been said, ‘You shall not tempt the Lord your God.’”

kikuyu: Diiyaabiloos immoo erga qorumsa kana hunda raawwatee booddee hamma yeroo mijaaʼaa argatutti isa dhiisee deeme.
english: When the devil had completed every temptation, he departed from him until another time.

kikuyu: Yesuus humna Hafuuraatiin Galiilaatti deebiʼe; oduun waaʼee isaas baadiyyaa guutuu keessa faffacaʼe.
english: Jesus returned in the power of the Spirit into Galilee, and news about him spread through all the surrounding area.

kikuyu: Inni manneen sagadaa isaanii keessatti barsiisaa ture; namni hundinuus isa jaje.
english: He taught in their synagogues, being glorified by all.

kikuyu: Innis Naazreeti iddoo itti guddate dhaqe; guyyaa Sanbataas akkuma amala isaa mana sagadaa seene. Kitaaba dubbisuufis kaʼee dhaabate;
english: He came to Nazareth, where he had been brought up. He entered, as was his custom, into the synagogue on the Sabbath day, and stood up to read.

kikuyu: kitaabni raajicha Isaayyaas isatti kenname. Innis kitaabicha banee kutaa akkana jedhamee barreeffame argate:
english: The book of the prophet Isaiah was handed to him. He opened the book, and found the place where it was written,

kikuyu: “Hafuurri Gooftaa narra jira; akka ani hiyyeeyyiitti oduu gaarii lallabuuf, inni na dibeeraatii. Inni akka ani akka warri hidhaman hiikaman, akka warri jaaman argan, akka warri cunqurfamanis bilisa baʼan lallabuuf na ergeera;
english: “The Spirit of the Lord is on me, because he has anointed me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent me to heal the broken hearted, to proclaim release to the captives, recovering of sight to the blind, to deliver those who are crushed,

kikuyu: inni akka ani bara tola Gooftaa labsuufis na ergeera.”
english: and to proclaim the acceptable year of the Lord.”

kikuyu: Innis kitaabicha cufee tajaajiltichatti deebisee kennee taaʼe; warri mana sagadaa sana keessa turan hundinuus xiyyeeffatanii isa ilaalaa turan.
english: He closed the book, gave it back to the attendant, and sat down. The eyes of all in the synagogue were fastened on him.

kikuyu: Innis, “Barreeffamni kun harʼa gurra keessanitti raawwatame” isaaniin jechuu jalqabe.
english: He began to tell them, “Today, this Scripture has been fulfilled in your hearing.”

kikuyu: Hundi isaanii waaʼee isaa waan gaarii dubbachaa turan; dubbii ayyaan qabeessa afaan isaatii baʼus ni dinqisiifatan. Isaanis, “Kun ilma Yoosef mitii?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: All testified about him and wondered at the gracious words which proceeded out of his mouth; and they said, “Isn’t this Joseph’s son?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Akka isin, ‘Yaa abbaa qorichaa, of fayyisi! Waan Qifirnaahomitti hojjechuu kee dhageenye sana as biyya keettis hojjedhu’ jettanii natti mammaaktan ani shakkii hin qabu” isaaniin jedhe.
english: He said to them, “Doubtless you will tell me this proverb, ‘Physician, heal yourself! Whatever we have heard done at Capernaum, do also here in your hometown.’”

kikuyu: Innis itti fufee akkana jedhe; “Ani dhuguma isinitti nan hima; raajiin tokko iyyuu iddoo itti dhalatetti fudhatama hin qabu.
english: He said, “Most certainly I tell you, no prophet is acceptable in his hometown.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman isiniin jedha; bara Eeliyaas yeroo samiin waggaa sadii fi walakkaa cufamee beelli hamaan buʼeetti haadhota hiyyeessaa baayʼeetu Israaʼel keessa ture.
english: But truly I tell you, there were many widows in Israel in the days of Elijah, when the sky was shut up three years and six months, when a great famine came over all the land.

kikuyu: Taʼus Eeliyaas gara haadha hiyyeessaa magaalaa Saraaphtaa biyya Siidoon keessa jiraattu tokkootti ergame malee haadhota hiyyeessaa sana keessaa gara tokkoo isaaniitti illee hin ergamne.
english: Elijah was sent to none of them, except to Zarephath, in the land of Sidon, to a woman who was a widow.

kikuyu: Bara Elsaaʼi raajichaas namoota lamxaaʼan hedduutu Israaʼel keessa ture; garuu Naʼamaan, namicha Sooriyaa tokkicha sana malee warra kaan keessaa namni tokko iyyuu hin qulqulloofne ture.”
english: There were many lepers in Israel in the time of Elisha the prophet, yet not one of them was cleansed, except Naaman, the Syrian.”

kikuyu: Namoonni manicha sagadaa keessa turan hundinuu yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti akka malee aaran.
english: They were all filled with wrath in the synagogue as they heard these things.

kikuyu: Isaanis kaʼanii magaalaa sana keessaa gad isa baasan; gad isa darbachuuf jedhaniis ededa tulluu magaalaan isaanii irratti ijaaramteetti ol isa baasan.
english: They rose up, threw him out of the city, and led him to the brow of the hill that their city was built on, that they might throw him off the cliff.

kikuyu: Inni garuu gidduudhuma isaanii baʼee deeme.
english: But he, passing through the middle of them, went his way.

kikuyu: Innis gara Qifirnaahom, magaalaa Galiilaa keessaatti gad buʼe; guyyaa Sanbataas namoota barsiise.
english: He came down to Capernaum, a city of Galilee. He was teaching them on the Sabbath day,

kikuyu: Isaanis waan dubbiin isaa taayitaa qabuuf barsiisa isaa ni dinqisiifatan.
english: and they were astonished at his teaching, for his word was with authority.

kikuyu: Namichi hafuura hamaa xuraaʼaadhaan qabame tokko mana sagadaa keessa ture. Innis sagalee guddaadhaan iyyee akkana jedhe;
english: In the synagogue there was a man who had a spirit of an unclean demon; and he cried out with a loud voice,

kikuyu: “Uffi! Yaa Yesuus nama Naazreeti, ati maal nurraa qabda? Nu balleessuu dhufte moo? Ati eenyu akka taate ani nan beeka, yaa Qulqullicha Waaqaa!”
english: saying, “Ah! what have we to do with you, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are: the Holy One of God!”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Calʼisii isa keessaa baʼi!” jedhee ifate. Hafuurri hamaan sunis isaan hunda duratti namicha kuffisee utuu hin miidhin isa keessaa baʼe.
english: Jesus rebuked him, saying, “Be silent and come out of him!” When the demon had thrown him down in the middle of them, he came out of him, having done him no harm.

kikuyu: Namoonni hundinuu dinqifatanii, “Maal barsiisni akkanaa! Inni taayitaadhaan, humnaanis hafuurota xuraaʼoo ni ajaja; isaanis ni baʼu” waliin jedhan.
english: Amazement came on all and they spoke together, one with another, saying, “What is this word? For with authority and power he commands the unclean spirits, and they come out!”

kikuyu: Oduun waaʼee isaas biyya naannoo sanaa guutuu keessa faffacaʼe.
english: News about him went out into every place of the surrounding region.

kikuyu: Yesuus mana sagadaatii baʼee mana Simoon dhaqe. Haati niitii Simoonis dhukkuba dhagna gubaa hamaadhaan qabamtee dhiphachaa turte; isaanis akka Yesuus ishee gargaaru isa kadhatan.
english: He rose up from the synagogue and entered into Simon’s house. Simon’s mother-in-law was afflicted with a great fever, and they begged him to help her.

kikuyu: Innis isheetti gad jedhee, dhagna gubaa sana ifate; dhagna gubaan sunis ishee dhiise. Isheenis yeruma sana kaatee isaan tajaajiluu jalqabde.
english: He stood over her and rebuked the fever, and it left her. Immediately she rose up and served them.

kikuyu: Namoonnis yeroo aduun lixxetti namoota dhukkuba gosa garaa garaa qaban hunda gara Yesuus fidan; innis tokkoo tokkoo isaanii irra harka isaa kaaʼee isaan fayyise.
english: When the sun was setting, all those who had any sick with various diseases brought them to him; and he laid his hands on every one of them, and healed them.

kikuyu: Akkasumas hafuuronni hamoon iyyanii, “Ati Ilma Waaqaa ti!” jedhanii namoota baayʼee keessaa baʼan. Inni garuu sababii isaan akka inni Kiristoos taʼe beekaniif isaan ifate; akka isaan dubbatanis hin eeyyamneef.
english: Demons also came out of many, crying out and saying, “You are the Christ, the Son of God!” Rebuking them, he didn’t allow them to speak, because they knew that he was the Christ.

kikuyu: Yommuu bariʼettis Yesuus achii baʼee, iddoo namni hin jirre tokko dhaqe. Namoonnis isa barbaadaa turan; yommuu gara isaa dhufanittis akka inni isaan dhiisee hin deemneef isa dhowwuu yaalan.
english: When it was day, he departed and went into an uninhabited place and the multitudes looked for him, and came to him, and held on to him, so that he wouldn’t go away from them.

kikuyu: Inni garuu, “Ani magaalaawwan kaanittis wangeela mootummaa Waaqaa lallabuun qaba; sababiin ani ergameefis kanuma” jedhe.
english: But he said to them, “I must preach the good news of God’s Kingdom to the other cities also. For this reason I have been sent.”

kikuyu: Innis ittuma fufee manneen sagadaa Yihuudaa keessatti lallabaa ture.
english: He was preaching in the synagogues of Galilee.

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko Yesuus utuu Haroo Geensereex bira dhaabatee jiruu, utuu namoonnis isatti naannaʼanii dubbii Waaqaa dhagaʼaa jiranuu,
english: Now while the multitude pressed on him and heard the word of God, he was standing by the lake of Gennesaret.

kikuyu: bidiruuwwan lama ededa bishaanichaa irratti arge; qurxummii qabdoonni garuu keessaa baʼanii kiyyoo isaanii miicachaa turan.
english: He saw two boats standing by the lake, but the fishermen had gone out of them and were washing their nets.

kikuyu: Innis bidiruuwwan sana gidduudhaa ishee kan Simoon taate tokko yaabbate; akka inni qarqara lafaa irraa gara gidduu bishaaniitti xinnoo achi butus isa kadhate. Yesuusis bidiruu sana irra taaʼee namoota barsiisuu jalqabe.
english: He entered into one of the boats, which was Simon’s, and asked him to put out a little from the land. He sat down and taught the multitudes from the boat.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu dubbatee fixetti Simooniin, “Gara tuujuba bishaaniitti achi siqi; qurxummii qabuufis kiyyoo keessan darbadhaa” jedhe.
english: When he had finished speaking, he said to Simon, “Put out into the deep and let down your nets for a catch.”

kikuyu: Simoonis deebisee, “Yaa barsiisaa, nu halkan guutuu akka malee itti dadhabnee waa tokko illee hin qabne. Ani garuu waan ati jetteef kiyyoo nan darbadha” jedhe.
english: Simon answered him, “Master, we worked all night and caught nothing; but at your word I will let down the net.”

kikuyu: Isaanis kiyyoo isaanii darbatanii hamma kiyyoon isaanii ciccituu jalqabutti qurxummii akka malee baayʼee qabatan.
english: When they had done this, they caught a great multitude of fish, and their net was breaking.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka michoonni isaanii warri bidiruu kaan keessa turan dhufanii isaan gargaaraniif mallattoon waammatan; isaanis dhufanii bidiruu lachuu qurxummiidhaan guutan; bidiruuwwan sunis liqimfamuu jalqaban.
english: They beckoned to their partners in the other boat, that they should come and help them. They came and filled both boats, so that they began to sink.

kikuyu: Simoon Phexrosis yommuu waan kana argetti jilba Yesuusitti kufee, “Yaa Gooftaa, ani nama cubbamaa dha; narraa fagaadhu!” jedhe.
english: But Simon Peter, when he saw it, fell down at Jesus’ knees, saying, “Depart from me, for I am a sinful man, Lord.”

kikuyu: Kunis sababii qurxummiin baayʼeen qabame sun Simʼoonii fi warra isa wajjin turan hunda dinqisiiseef;
english: For he was amazed, and all who were with him, at the catch of fish which they had caught;

kikuyu: ilmaan Zabdewoos warri michoota Simoon turan jechuunis Yaaqoobii fi Yohannis akkasuma dinqisiifatan. Yesuusis Simʼooniin, “Hin sodaatin; ati ammaa jalqabdee qabduu namootaa ni taataa” jedhe.
english: and so also were James and John, sons of Zebedee, who were partners with Simon. Jesus said to Simon, “Don’t be afraid. From now on you will be catching people alive.”

kikuyu: Isaanis bidiruuwwan isaanii gara qarqaraatti ol baasanii waan hunda dhiisanii isa duukaa buʼan.
english: When they had brought their boats to land, they left everything, and followed him.

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuus magaalaawwan sana keessaa isa tokko keessa jiruu namichi dhagni isaa guutuun lamxaaʼe tokko gara isaa dhufe. Innis yommuu Yesuusin argetti adda isaatiin lafatti gombifamee, “Yaa Gooftaa, yoo fedhii kee taʼe, ati na qulqulleessuu ni dandeessa” jedhee isa kadhate.
english: While he was in one of the cities, behold, there was a man full of leprosy. When he saw Jesus, he fell on his face and begged him, saying, “Lord, if you want to, you can make me clean.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis harka isaa hiixatee namicha qaqqabee, “Fedhii koo ti; qulqullaaʼi!” jedheen; lamxiin sunis yeruma sana namicha irraa bade.
english: He stretched out his hand and touched him, saying, “I want to. Be made clean.” Immediately the leprosy left him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Nama tokkotti illee hin himin; garuu dhaqiitii akka isaaniif ragaa taʼuuf lubatti of argisiisi; qulqullaaʼuu keetiifis aarsaawwan Museen ajaje sana dhiʼeessi” jedhee isa ajaje.
english: He commanded him to tell no one, “But go your way and show yourself to the priest, and offer for your cleansing according to what Moses commanded, for a testimony to them.”

kikuyu: Haa taʼuu malee oduun waaʼee isaa ittuma caalee facaʼe; namoonni hedduunis isa dhagaʼuu fi dhukkuba isaanii irraa fayyuuf jedhanii gara isaa dhufaa turan.
english: But the report concerning him spread much more, and great multitudes came together to hear and to be healed by him of their infirmities.

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu yeroo baayʼee lafa namni hin jirre dhaqee kadhachaa ture.
english: But he withdrew himself into the desert and prayed.

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko Yesuus utuu barsiisaa jiruu, Fariisonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa warri gandoota Galiilaatii fi Yihuudaa hunda keessaa akkasumas Yerusaalemii dhufan achi tataaʼaa turan. Akka inni dhukkubsattoota fayyisuufis humni Gooftaa isa wajjin ture.
english: On one of those days, he was teaching; and there were Pharisees and teachers of the law sitting by who had come out of every village of Galilee, Judea, and Jerusalem. The power of the Lord was with him to heal them.

kikuyu: Jarri tokko nama dhagni irratti duʼe tokko sireedhaan baatanii dhufan; isaanis fuula Yesuus dura isa kaaʼuuf jedhanii manatti ol isa galchuu yaalan.
english: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.

kikuyu: Sababii baayʼina namaatiifis karaa ittiin ol isa galchan dhabnaan bantii manaatti ol baʼanii qadaada bantii manaa saaqanii walakkaa namootaatiin fuula Yesuus duratti siree isaatiin gad isa buusan.
english: Not finding a way to bring him in because of the multitude, they went up to the housetop and let him down through the tiles with his cot into the middle before Jesus.

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu amantii isaanii argetti, “Namichoo, cubbuun kee siif dhiifameera” jedhe.
english: Seeing their faith, he said to him, “Man, your sins are forgiven you.”

kikuyu: Fariisonnii fi barsiistonni seeraas, “Namichi Waaqa arrabsu kun eenyu? Waaqa tokkicha malee eenyutu cubbuu namaaf dhiisuu dandaʼa?” jedhanii garaa isaaniitti yaaduu jalqaban.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees began to reason, saying, “Who is this who speaks blasphemies? Who can forgive sins, but God alone?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis waan isaan yaadaa turan beekee akkana jedhee gaafate; “Isin maaliif garaa keessan keessatti waan kana yaaddu?
english: But Jesus, perceiving their thoughts, answered them, “Why are you reasoning so in your hearts?

kikuyu: ‘Cubbuun kee siif dhiifameera’ jechuu moo ‘Kaʼii deemi’ jechuutu salphaa dha?
english: Which is easier to say, ‘Your sins are forgiven you,’ or to say, ‘Arise and walk’?

kikuyu: Ani garuu akka Ilmi Namaa cubbuu namaaf dhiisuudhaaf lafa irratti taayitaa qabu akka beektan nan barbaada.” Kanaafuu inni namicha dhagni irratti duʼe sanaan, “Ani sitti nan hima; kaʼi; siree kee fudhadhuutii mana keetti gali” jedhe.
english: But that you may know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins,” he said to the paralyzed man, “I tell you, arise, take up your cot, and go to your house.”

kikuyu: Innis yeruma sana kaʼee fuula isaanii dura dhaabate; waan irra ciisaa tures fudhatee Waaqa jajachaa mana ofii isaatti qajeele.
english: Immediately he rose up before them, and took up that which he was laying on, and departed to his house, glorifying God.

kikuyu: Hundi isaaniis dinqifatanii Waaqa jajan. Sodaadhaanis guutamanii, “Nu harʼa waan takkumaa hin taʼin argine” jedhan.
english: Amazement took hold on all, and they glorified God. They were filled with fear, saying, “We have seen strange things today.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Yesuus achii baʼee qaraxxuu Lewwii jedhamu tokko utuu inni iddoo itti qaraxa walitti qaban taaʼuu arge. Yesuusis, “Na duukaa buʼi” jedheen.
english: After these things he went out and saw a tax collector named Levi sitting at the tax office, and said to him, “Follow me!”

kikuyu: Lewwiinis waan hunda dhiisee kaʼee isa duukaa buʼe.
english: He left everything, and rose up and followed him.

kikuyu: Lewwiinis mana isaatti cidha guddaa Yesuusiif qopheesse; qaraxxoonnii fi namoonni kaan baayʼeenis isaan wajjin nyaachaa turan.
english: Levi made a great feast for him in his house. There was a great crowd of tax collectors and others who were reclining with them.

kikuyu: Fariisonnii fi Barsiistonni seeraa kanneen garee isaanii taʼan garuu, “Isin maaliif qaraxxootaa fi cubbamoota wajjin nyaattanii dhugdu?” jedhanii barattoota isaatti guunguman.
english: Their scribes and the Pharisees murmured against his disciples, saying, “Why do you eat and drink with the tax collectors and sinners?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo deebisee akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Ogeessi fayyaa tokko warra dhukkubsataniif malee warra fayyaa qabaniif hin barbaachisu.
english: Jesus answered them, “Those who are healthy have no need for a physician, but those who are sick do.

kikuyu: Ani cubbamoota gara qalbii jijjiirrannaatti waamuufin dhufe malee qajeeltota waamuuf hin dhufne.”
english: I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners, to repentance.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Barattoonni Yohannis yeroo baayʼee ni soomu; ni kadhatus; barattoonni Fariisotaas akkasuma godhu; barattoonni kee garuu ni nyaatu; ni dhugus” jedhaniin.
english: They said to him, “Why do John’s disciples often fast and pray, likewise also the disciples of the Pharisees, but yours eat and drink?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Isin utuu inni isaan wajjin jiruu michoota misirrichaa soomsisuu ni dandeessuu?
english: He said to them, “Can you make the friends of the bridegroom fast while the bridegroom is with them?

kikuyu: Garuu yeroon itti misirrichi isaan biraa fudhatamu ni dhufa; isaanis yeroo sana ni soomu.”
english: But the days will come when the bridegroom will be taken away from them. Then they will fast in those days.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee fakkeenya kana isaanitti hime; “Namni uffata moofaa erbuuf jedhee huccuu uffata haaraa tarsaasu tokko iyyuu hin jiru. Yoo kun godhame, isaan uffata haaraa sana tarsaasaniiru; erbeen haaraan sunis uffata moofaa wajjin wal hin fudhatu.
english: He also told a parable to them. “No one puts a piece from a new garment on an old garment, or else he will tear the new, and also the piece from the new will not match the old.

kikuyu: Namni daadhii wayinii haaraaqalqalloo moofaatti naqu tokko iyyuu hin jiru. Yoo itti naqe immoo daadhiin haaraan sun qalqalloo sana ni dhoosa; daadhiin sun ni dhangalaʼa; qalqallichis horoomaa baʼa.
english: No one puts new wine into old wineskins, or else the new wine will burst the skins, and it will be spilled and the skins will be destroyed.

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa daadhiin wayinii haaraan qalqalloo daadhii wayinii haaraatti naqamuu qaba.
english: But new wine must be put into fresh wineskins, and both are preserved.

kikuyu: Namni kam iyyuu erga daadhii wayinii kan goge dhugee booddee daadhii wayinii haaraa hin barbaadu; isaan, ‘Daadhii wayinii kan goge wayya’ jedhuutii.”
english: No man having drunk old wine immediately desires new, for he says, ‘The old is better.’”

kikuyu: Guyyaa Sanbataa tokko Yesuus lafa qotiisaa midhaanii keessa darbaa ture; barattoonni isaas asheetii midhaanii ciratanii harka isaaniitiin sukkuummatanii nyaachuu jalqaban.
english: Now on the second Sabbath after the first, he was going through the grain fields. His disciples plucked the heads of grain and ate, rubbing them in their hands.

kikuyu: Fariisota keessaas tokko tokko, “Isin maaliif waan Sanbataan hojjechuun hin eeyyamamne hojjettu?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: But some of the Pharisees said to them, “Why do you do that which is not lawful to do on the Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Isin waan Daawit yeroo innii fi miiltonni isaa beelaʼanitti godhe sana takkumaa hin dubbifnee?
english: Jesus, answering them, said, “Haven’t you read what David did when he was hungry, he and those who were with him,

kikuyu: Inni mana Waaqaa seenee buddeena qulqulleeffamekan luboota qofaaf eeyyamame fudhatee nyaate. Warra isa wajjin jiraniifis kenne.”
english: how he entered into God’s house, and took and ate the show bread, and gave also to those who were with him, which is not lawful to eat except for the priests alone?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Ilmi Namaa Gooftaa Sanbataa ti” isaaniin jedhe.
english: He said to them, “The Son of Man is lord of the Sabbath.”

kikuyu: Sanbata biraas inni mana sagadaa seenee barsiisaa ture; namichi harki isaa mirgaa irratti goge tokkos achi ture.
english: It also happened on another Sabbath that he entered into the synagogue and taught. There was a man there, and his right hand was withered.

kikuyu: Fariisonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa Yesuusin himachuuf jedhanii sababa barbaadaa turan; kanaafuu akka inni Sanbataan nama fayyisu ilaaluuf isa gaadan.
english: The scribes and the Pharisees watched him, to see whether he would heal on the Sabbath, that they might find an accusation against him.

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu waan isaan yaadan beekee namicha harki irratti goge sanaan, “Kaʼii fuula nama hundaa dura dhaabadhu” jedhe. Innis kaʼee achi dhaabate.
english: But he knew their thoughts; and he said to the man who had the withered hand, “Rise up and stand in the middle.” He arose and stood.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Anis isinan gaafadha; Sanbataan isa kamtu eeyyamamaa dha? Waan gaarii hojjechuu moo waan hamaa hojjechuu? Lubbuu oolchuu moo balleessuu?” isaaniin jedhe.
english: Then Jesus said to them, “I will ask you something: Is it lawful on the Sabbath to do good, or to do harm? To save a life, or to kill?”

kikuyu: Gara galees hunda isaanii ilaalee namichaan, “Harka kee diriirfadhu” jedhe. Innis akkasuma godhe; harki isaas guutumaan guutuutti fayye.
english: He looked around at them all, and said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He did, and his hand was restored as sound as the other.

kikuyu: Fariisonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa garuu akka malee aaranii Yesuusin maal gochuu akka dandaʼan waliin mariʼachuu jalqaban.
english: But they were filled with rage, and talked with one another about what they might do to Jesus.

kikuyu: Yesuusis guyyoota sana keessaa gaaf tokko kadhannaadhaaf tulluutti ol baʼe; halkan guutuus Waaqa kadhachaa bule.
english: In these days, he went out to the mountain to pray, and he continued all night in prayer to God.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu lafti bariʼetti barattoota isaa ofitti waamee nama kudha lama isaan keessaa filate; ergamoota jedhees isaan moggaase.
english: When it was day, he called his disciples, and from them he chose twelve, whom he also named apostles:

kikuyu: Isaanis Simoon isa inni Phexros jedhee moggaase, obboleessa isaa Indiriiyaas, Yaaqoob, Yohannis, Fiiliphoos, Bartaloomewoos,
english: Simon, whom he also named Peter; Andrew, his brother; James; John; Philip; Bartholomew;

kikuyu: Maatewos, Toomaas, Yaaqoob ilma Alfewoos, Simoon isa Hinaafticha jedhamee waamame,
english: Matthew; Thomas; James the son of Alphaeus; Simon who was called the Zealot;

kikuyu: Yihuudaa ilma Yaaqoob, Yihuudaa Keeriyoticha isa Yesuusin dabarsee kenne.
english: Judas the son of James; and Judas Iscariot, who also became a traitor.

kikuyu: Innis isaan wajjin gad buʼee iddoo diriiraa tokko irra dhaabate. Tuunni barattoota isaa guddaanis achi ture; namoonni Yihuudaa hunda keessaa, Yerusaalem keessaa, biyya qarqara galaanaa kan naannoo Xiiroosii fi Siidoonaatii dhufan baayʼeen,
english: He came down with them and stood on a level place, with a crowd of his disciples and a great number of the people from all Judea and Jerusalem and the sea coast of Tyre and Sidon, who came to hear him and to be healed of their diseases,

kikuyu: warri isa dhagaʼuu fi dhukkuba isaanii irraa fayyuuf dhufanis achi turan. Warri hafuurota xuraaʼoon dhiphachaa turanis ni fayyan;
english: as well as those who were troubled by unclean spirits; and they were being healed.

kikuyu: sababii humni isa keessaa baʼee hunduma isaanii fayyisaa tureef, namoonni hundinuu isa tuquuf carraaqaa turan.
english: All the multitude sought to touch him, for power came out of him and healed them all.

kikuyu: Innis barattoota isaa ilaalee akkana jedhe: “Isin warri hiyyeeyyiin eebbifamoo dha; mootummaan Waaqaa kan keessaniitii.
english: He lifted up his eyes to his disciples, and said: “Blessed are you who are poor, for God’s Kingdom is yours.

kikuyu: Isin warri amma beeloftan eebbifamoo dha; ni quuftuutii. Isin warri amma boossan eebbifamoo dha; ni kolfituutii.
english: Blessed are you who hunger now, for you will be filled. Blessed are you who weep now, for you will laugh.

kikuyu: Yommuu namoonni sababii Ilma Namaatiif jedhanii isin jibban, yommuu isaan of keessaa isin baasanii fi isin arrabsan, yommuu isaan maqaa keessan akka waan hamaa tokkootti tuffatan, isin eebbifamoo dha.
english: Blessed are you when men hate you, and when they exclude and mock you, and throw out your name as evil, for the Son of Man’s sake.

kikuyu: “Sababii gatiin keessan samii keessatti guddaa taʼeef gaafa sana ililchaatii gammachuudhaan buburraaqaa. Abbootiin isaanii iyyuu akkasuma raajota godhaniitii.
english: Rejoice in that day and leap for joy, for behold, your reward is great in heaven, for their fathers did the same thing to the prophets.

kikuyu: “Garuu warri sooreyyiin isiniif wayyoo; isin jajjabina keessan argattaniirtuutii.
english: “But woe to you who are rich! For you have received your consolation.

kikuyu: Warri amma quuftan isiniif wayyoo, beelaʼuuf jirtuutii, warri amma kolfitan isiniif wayyoo; wawwaachuu fi booʼuuf jirtuutii.
english: Woe to you, you who are full now, for you will be hungry. Woe to you who laugh now, for you will mourn and weep.

kikuyu: Yommuu namni hundinuu isin saadu isiniif wayyoo; abbootiin isaanii iyyuu akkanuma raajota sobaa saadaa turaniitii.
english: Woe, when men speak well of you, for their fathers did the same thing to the false prophets.

kikuyu: “Ani garuu isin warra na dhageessanitti nan hima; diinota keessan jaalladhaa; warra isin jibbaniif waan gaarii hojjedhaa;
english: “But I tell you who hear: love your enemies, do good to those who hate you,

kikuyu: warra isin abaaran eebbisaa; warra isin miidhaniifis kadhadhaa.
english: bless those who curse you, and pray for those who mistreat you.

kikuyu: Yoo namni tokko maddii tokko si kabale, maddii kaanis itti qabi. Yoo namni tokko kootii kee sirraa baafate immoo, kittaa kee illee hin dhowwatin.
english: To him who strikes you on the cheek, offer also the other; and from him who takes away your cloak, don’t withhold your coat also.

kikuyu: Nama si kadhatu hundumaaf kenni; yoo namni kam iyyuu waan kan kee taʼe fudhate, akka wanni sun siif deebifamu hin gaafatin.
english: Give to everyone who asks you, and don’t ask him who takes away your goods to give them back again.

kikuyu: Isinis akkuma namoonni kaan akka isiniif godhan barbaaddan sana isaaniif godhaa.
english: “As you would like people to do to you, do exactly so to them.

kikuyu: “Isin warra isin jaallatan qofa yoo jaallattan, kun galata maalii isinii qaba? Cubbamoonni iyyuu warra isaan jaallatan ni jaallatuutii.
english: “If you love those who love you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners love those who love them.

kikuyu: Isin yoo warra waan gaarii isinii godhaniif waan gaarii gootan, kun galata maalii isiniif qaba? Kana immoo cubbamoonni iyyuu ni godhuutii.
english: If you do good to those who do good to you, what credit is that to you? For even sinners do the same.

kikuyu: Warruma akka isiniif deebisan abdattaniif yoo liqeessitan galata maalii argattu? ‘Cubbamoonni iyyuu’ hammuma liqeessan sana deebisanii argachuuf jedhanii cubbamootaaf ni liqeessuutii.
english: If you lend to those from whom you hope to receive, what credit is that to you? Even sinners lend to sinners, to receive back as much.

kikuyu: Isin garuu diinota keessan jaalladhaa; waan gaariis isaaniif hojjedhaa; utuu waan isinii deebiʼu tokko illee hin abdatin isaaniif liqeessaa. Yoos gatiin keessan guddaa ni taʼa; isinis ijoollee Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii ni taatu; inni warra hin galateeffannee fi hamootaaf illee arjaadhaatii.
english: But love your enemies, and do good, and lend, expecting nothing back; and your reward will be great, and you will be children of the Most High; for he is kind toward the unthankful and evil.

kikuyu: Akkuma abbaan keessan araara qabeessa taʼe sana, isinis araara qabeeyyii taʼaa.
english: “Therefore be merciful, even as your Father is also merciful.

kikuyu: “Namatti hin murinaa; isinittis hin muramuutii. Nama hin yakkinaa; isinis hin yakkamtanii. Dhiifamas godhaa; dhiifamni isinii godhamaatii.
english: Don’t judge, and you won’t be judged. Don’t condemn, and you won’t be condemned. Set free, and you will be set free.

kikuyu: Kennaa; isiniifis ni kennamaa. Safartuun gaariin itti hudumame, kan sochoofamee fi guutamee irra dhangalaʼe bobaa keessanitti isinii naqama. Safartuu ittiin safartaniinis isiniif safaramaatii.”
english: “Give, and it will be given to you: good measure, pressed down, shaken together, and running over, will be given to you. For with the same measure you measure it will be measured back to you.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee fakkeenya kana isaanitti hime; “Jaamaan tokko jaamaa qajeelchuu ni dandaʼaa? Isaan lachuu boolla keessa hin buʼanii?
english: He spoke a parable to them. “Can the blind guide the blind? Won’t they both fall into a pit?

kikuyu: Barataan barsiisaa isaatii ol miti; namni guutumaan guutuutti leenjifame hundinuu garuu akka barsiisaa isaa ni taʼa.
english: A disciple is not above his teacher, but everyone when he is fully trained will be like his teacher.

kikuyu: “Ati maaliif jirma ija kee keessa jiru arguu dhiiftee huuba ija obboleessa keetii keessa jiru ilaalta?
english: Why do you see the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye, but don’t consider the beam that is in your own eye?

kikuyu: Ati utuu ofii keetii jirma ija kee keessa jiru arguu hin dandaʼin, akkamitti obboleessa keetiin, ‘Obboleessaa, kottu mee ani huuba ija kee keessa jiru siif nan baasa’ jechuu dandeessa? Fakkeessituu nana, duraan dursiitii jirma ija kee keessa jiru baafadhu; ergasiis huuba ija obboleessa keetii keessa jiru baasuudhaaf sirriitti argita.
english: Or how can you tell your brother, ‘Brother, let me remove the speck of chaff that is in your eye,’ when you yourself don’t see the beam that is in your own eye? You hypocrite! First remove the beam from your own eye, and then you can see clearly to remove the speck of chaff that is in your brother’s eye.

kikuyu: “Mukni gaariin ija gadhee naqatu tokko iyyuu hin jiru; mukni gadheenis ija gaarii hin naqatu.
english: “For there is no good tree that produces rotten fruit, nor again a rotten tree that produces good fruit.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon mukaa ija isaatiin beekama. Namoonni muka qoraattii irraa harbuu, yookaan sokorruu irraa wayinii hin ciran.
english: For each tree is known by its own fruit. For people don’t gather figs from thorns, nor do they gather grapes from a bramble bush.

kikuyu: Namni gaariin waan gaarii garaa isaa keessatti kuufate keessaa waan gaarii baasa; namni hamaan immoo waan hamaa garaa isaa keessatti kuufate keessaa waan hamaa baasa. Waan garaa guute afaan dubbataatii.
english: The good man out of the good treasure of his heart brings out that which is good, and the evil man out of the evil treasure of his heart brings out that which is evil, for out of the abundance of the heart, his mouth speaks.

kikuyu: “Isin waan ani jedhu hin hojjettan; yoos maaliif, ‘Yaa Gooftaa, yaa Gooftaa’ naan jettu?
english: “Why do you call me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ and don’t do the things which I say?

kikuyu: Namni gara koo dhufu, kan dubbii koo dhagaʼee hojiidhaan argisiisu hundi maal akka fakkaatu ani isinitti nan argisiisa.
english: Everyone who comes to me, and hears my words and does them, I will show you who he is like.

kikuyu: Isaan nama mana ijaaru, kan boolla gad fageessee qotee hundee mana sanaa kattaa irra dhaabe tokko fakkaatu. Sababii manichi sirriitti ijaarameef, lolaan yeroo lolaʼee humnaan itti buʼetti mana sana sochoosuu hin dandeenye.
english: He is like a man building a house, who dug and went deep and laid a foundation on the rock. When a flood arose, the stream broke against that house, and could not shake it, because it was founded on the rock.

kikuyu: Namni dubbii koo dhagaʼee hojiidhaan hin argisiifne garuu nama lafa irratti mana hundee hin qabne ijaarratu tokko fakkaata. Yeroo lolaan humnaan itti buʼetti manni sun ni jige; guutumaan guutuuttis diigame.”
english: But he who hears and doesn’t do, is like a man who built a house on the earth without a foundation, against which the stream broke, and immediately it fell; and the ruin of that house was great.”

kikuyu: Yesuus yeroo waan kana hundumaa namoota isa dhaggeeffachaa turanitti himee fixatetti, Qifirnaahom seene.
english: After he had finished speaking in the hearing of the people, he entered into Capernaum.

kikuyu: Achis tajaajilaan ajajaa dhibbaa kan gooftaan isaa akka malee isa jaallatu tokko dhukkubsatee duʼuu gaʼee ture.
english: A certain centurion’s servant, who was dear to him, was sick and at the point of death.

kikuyu: Ajajaan dhibbaa sunis waaʼee Yesuus dhagaʼee akka inni dhufee garbicha isaa fayyisuuf maanguddoota Yihuudootaa isatti ergee kadhate.
english: When he heard about Jesus, he sent to him elders of the Jews, asking him to come and save his servant.

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu gara Yesuus dhufanitti akkana jedhanii jabeessanii isa kadhatan; “Ati waan kana isaaf gochuun namicha kanaaf ni mala;
english: When they came to Jesus, they begged him earnestly, saying, “He is worthy for you to do this for him,

kikuyu: inni saba keenya ni jaallataatii; mana sagadaas nuuf ijaareera.”
english: for he loves our nation, and he built our synagogue for us.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yesuus isaan wajjin deeme. Yeroo inni manichatti dhiʼaatetti ajajaan dhibbaa sun akkana jedhee michoota isaa Yesuusitti erge; “Yaa gooftaa of hin rakkisin; ati bantii mana koo jala seenuun naaf hin maluutii.
english: Jesus went with them. When he was now not far from the house, the centurion sent friends to him, saying to him, “Lord, don’t trouble yourself, for I am not worthy for you to come under my roof.

kikuyu: Sababiin ani ofii koo akka nama gara kee dhufuun maluufitti hin ilaaliniif iyyuu kanuma. Garuu dubbicha qofa dubbadhu; tajaajilaan koo ni fayyaatii.
english: Therefore I didn’t even think myself worthy to come to you; but say the word, and my servant will be healed.

kikuyu: Ani mataan koo iyyuu nama taayitaa jala jiruu dha; loltootas of jalaa qaba. Isa tokkoon, ‘Deemi’ nan jedha; innis ni deema; isa kaaniin immoo, ‘Kottu’ nan jedha; innis ni dhufa. Tajaajilaa kootiinis, ‘Waan kana hojjedhu’ nan jedha; innis ni hojjeta.”
english: For I also am a man placed under authority, having under myself soldiers. I tell this one, ‘Go!’ and he goes; and to another, ‘Come!’ and he comes; and to my servant, ‘Do this,’ and he does it.”

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti isa dinqifate; namoota isa duukaa buʼaa turanittis garagalee, “Ani isinittin hima; ani amantii guddaa akkanaa Israaʼel keessatti iyyuu hin arganne” jedhe.
english: When Jesus heard these things, he marveled at him, and turned and said to the multitude who followed him, “I tell you, I have not found such great faith, no, not in Israel.”

kikuyu: Yommuu namoonni ergamanii turan manatti deebiʼanitti garbichi sun fayyee isaan eege.
english: Those who were sent, returning to the house, found that the servant who had been sick was well.

kikuyu: Yesuus ergasii magaalaa Naayin jedhamtu tokko dhaqe; barattoonni isaatii fi namoonni baayʼeenis isa wajjin dhaqan.
english: Soon afterwards, he went to a city called Nain. Many of his disciples, along with a great multitude, went with him.

kikuyu: Yommuu inni karra magaalattiitti dhiʼaatetti jarri tokko nama duʼe tokko baatanii isatti dhufan; namichi duʼe sunis haadha isaatiif ilma tokkicha ture; haati isaas haadha hiyyeessaa turte. Namoonni magaalattii baayʼeenis ishee wajjin turan.
english: Now when he came near to the gate of the city, behold, one who was dead was carried out, the only born son of his mother, and she was a widow. Many people of the city were with her.

kikuyu: Gooftaanis yommuu ishee argetti naʼeefii, “Hin booʼin” jedheen.
english: When the Lord saw her, he had compassion on her and said to her, “Don’t cry.”

kikuyu: Innis itti dhiʼaatee wasaasaa reeffa sanaa tuqe; warri reeffa baatanis ni dhaabatan. Innis, “Gurbayyoo, ani siin nan jedhaa, kaʼi!” jedheen.
english: He came near and touched the coffin, and the bearers stood still. He said, “Young man, I tell you, arise!”

kikuyu: Gurbaan duʼe sunis kaʼee taaʼee dubbachuu jalqabe; Yesuusis deebisee haadha isaatti isa kenne.
english: He who was dead sat up and began to speak. Then he gave him to his mother.

kikuyu: Hundi isaanii ni sodaatan; “Raajiin guddaan nu keessaa argameera. Waaqnis saba isaa gargaaruuf dhufeera” jedhanii Waaqaaf ulfina kennan.
english: Fear took hold of all, and they glorified God, saying, “A great prophet has arisen among us!” and, “God has visited his people!”

kikuyu: Oduun waaʼee Yesuus kunis Yihuudaa guutuu fi biyya naannoo sana jiru hundumaa keessa faffacaʼe.
english: This report went out concerning him in the whole of Judea and in all the surrounding region.

kikuyu: Barattoonni Yohannis waaʼee waan kana hundaa isatti himan. Yohannisis isaan keessaa nama lama ofitti waamee,
english: The disciples of John told him about all these things.

kikuyu: “Inni dhufuuf jiru siʼi moo yookaan kan biraa eegganna?” jedhee gaafachuudhaaf Gooftaatti isaan erge.
english: John, calling to himself two of his disciples, sent them to Jesus, saying, “Are you the one who is coming, or should we look for another?”

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis yommuu gara Yesuus dhufanitti, “Yohannis cuuphaan, ‘Inni dhufuuf jiru sun siʼi moo yookaan kan biraa eegganna?’ jedhee gaafachuudhaaf sitti nu ergeera” jedhaniin.
english: When the men had come to him, they said, “John the Baptizer has sent us to you, saying, ‘Are you he who comes, or should we look for another?’”

kikuyu: Yesuusis yeruma sana namoota dhibee, dhukkubaa fi hafuura hamaa qaban hedduu fayyise; warra jaamaa turan baayʼeedhaafis agartuu deebise.
english: In that hour he cured many of diseases and plagues and evil spirits; and to many who were blind he gave sight.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee ergamoota sanaaf deebii kenne; “Deebiʼaatii waan argitanii fi waan dhageessan Yohannisitti himaa; jaamonni ni argu; warri naafatan ni deemu; warri lamxaaʼan ni qulqullaaʼu; warri duudan ni dhagaʼu; warri duʼan ni kaʼu; hiyyeeyyiifis wangeelli ni lallabama.
english: Jesus answered them, “Go and tell John the things which you have seen and heard: that the blind receive their sight, the lame walk, the lepers are cleansed, the deaf hear, the dead are raised up, and the poor have good news preached to them.

kikuyu: Namni natti hin gufanne kam iyyuu eebbifamaa dha.”
english: Blessed is he who finds no occasion for stumbling in me.”

kikuyu: Erga ergamoonni Yohannis baʼanii qajeelanii booddee Yesuus akkana jedhee waaʼee Yohannis namootatti himuu jalqabe; “Isin maal arguuf gammoojjiitti gad baatan? Shambaqqoo qilleensi raasu moo?
english: When John’s messengers had departed, he began to tell the multitudes about John, “What did you go out into the wilderness to see? A reed shaken by the wind?

kikuyu: Yoos maal arguu baatan ree? Nama uffata miidhagaa uffate moo? Lakki, warri uffata miidhagaa uffatanii qananiidhaan jiraatan masaraawwan keessa jiru.
english: But what did you go out to see? A man clothed in soft clothing? Behold, those who are gorgeously dressed and live delicately are in kings’ courts.

kikuyu: Garuu isin maal arguu baatan? Raajii moo? Eeyyee; ani isinittin hima; kan raajii iyyuu caalu.
english: But what did you go out to see? A prophet? Yes, I tell you, and much more than a prophet.

kikuyu: Kunis isa waaʼeen isaa akkana jedhamee barreeffamee dha: “ ‘Kunoo, ani ergamaa koo isa fuula kee duraan karaa kee qopheessu, fuula kee dura nan erga.’
english: This is he of whom it is written, ‘Behold, I send my messenger before your face, who will prepare your way before you.’

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; namoota dubartoota irraa dhalatan keessaa namni Yohannis cuuphaa caalu tokko iyyuu hin jiru; namni mootummaa Waaqaa keessatti nama hundumaa gad taʼe garuu isa ni caala.”
english: “For I tell you, among those who are born of women there is not a greater prophet than John the Baptizer; yet he who is least in God’s Kingdom is greater than he.”

kikuyu: Namoonni hundi, qaraxxoonni iyyuu waan harka Yohannisitti cuuphamanii turaniif yommuu dubbii Yesuus dhagaʼanitti, karaan Waaqaa qajeelaa taʼuu isaa mirkaneessan.
english: When all the people and the tax collectors heard this, they declared God to be just, having been baptized with John’s baptism.

kikuyu: Fariisonnii fi beektonni seeraa garuu sababii harka Yohannisitti hin cuuphaminiif kaayyoo Waaqni isaaniif qabu fudhachuu didan.
english: But the Pharisees and the lawyers rejected the counsel of God, not being baptized by him themselves.

kikuyu: Yesuus itti fufee akkana jedhe; “Yoos ani namoota dhaloota kanaa maaliinan wal fakkeessuu dandaʼa ree? Isaan maal fakkaatu?
english: “To what then should I compare the people of this generation? What are they like?

kikuyu: Isaan akkuma ijoollee iddoo gabaa taaʼanii wal waamanii akkana jedhanii ti: “ ‘Nu ulullee isinii afuufne; isin garuu hin sirbine; faaruu booʼichaas faarsine; isin garuu hin boonye.’
english: They are like children who sit in the marketplace and call to one another, saying, ‘We piped to you, and you didn’t dance. We mourned, and you didn’t weep.’

kikuyu: Yohannis cuuphaan yeroo dhufetti buddeena hin nyaatu, daadhii wayiniis hin dhugu tureetii; isin immoo, ‘Inni hafuura hamaa qaba’ jettu.
english: For John the Baptizer came neither eating bread nor drinking wine, and you say, ‘He has a demon.’

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa nyaachaa, dhugaas dhufe; isin immoo, ‘Kunoo albaadhessaa fi machaaʼaa, michuu qaraxxootaatii fi cubbamootaa’ jettu.
english: The Son of Man has come eating and drinking, and you say, ‘Behold, a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners!’

kikuyu: Ogummaan garuu ijoollee ishee hundumaan mirkaneeffamti.”
english: Wisdom is justified by all her children.”

kikuyu: Fariisota keessaa namichi tokko akka inni isa wajjin nyaatuuf Yesuusin affeere; innis mana Fariisichaa dhaqee maaddiitti dhiʼaate.
english: One of the Pharisees invited him to eat with him. He entered into the Pharisee’s house and sat at the table.

kikuyu: Dubartiin cubbamtuun magaalaa sanaa tokkos yommuu akka Yesuus mana Fariisichaatti waa nyaachaa jiru bartetti bilqaaxxii albaasxiroositti shittoo qabattee dhufte.
english: Behold, a woman in the city who was a sinner, when she knew that he was reclining in the Pharisee’s house, brought an alabaster jar of ointment.

kikuyu: Isheenis booʼaa dugda isaa duubaan miilla isaa bira dhaabattee imimmaan isheetiin miilla isaa jiisuu jalqabde. Rifeensa mataa isheetiinis miilla isaa haqxee, dhungattees miilla isaa shittoo dibde.
english: Standing behind at his feet weeping, she began to wet his feet with her tears, and she wiped them with the hair of her head, kissed his feet, and anointed them with the ointment.
