kikuyu: Fariisichi isa affeere sunis waan kana argee, “Namichi kun utuu raajii taʼee, dubartiin isa tuqxu kun eenyu akka taate, nama akkamiis akka taate ni beeka ture; isheen cubbamtuudhaatii” jedhee garaa isaa keessatti yaade.
english: Now when the Pharisee who had invited him saw it, he said to himself, “This man, if he were a prophet, would have perceived who and what kind of woman this is who touches him, that she is a sinner.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Yaa Simoon, ani waanan sitti himu tokko qaba” jedheen. Innis, “Yaa barsiisaa natti himi” jedhe.
english: Jesus answered him, “Simon, I have something to tell you.” He said, “Teacher, say on.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedheen; “Namoonni lama nama maallaqa liqeessu tokko irraa maallaqa liqeeffatan. Inni tokko diinaarii dhibba shan liqeeffate; kaan immoo diinaarii shantama liqeeffate.
english: “A certain lender had two debtors. The one owed five hundred denarii, and the other fifty.

kikuyu: Jarri lachuu waan isaaf kaffalan dhabnaan dhiiseef. Egaa jara lamaan keessaa kamtu caalaa isa jaallata?”
english: When they couldn’t pay, he forgave them both. Which of them therefore will love him most?”

kikuyu: Simoonis deebisee, “Isa liqiin guddaan dhiifameef sana natti fakkaata” jedheen. Yesuusis, “Ati dhugaa dubbatte” isaan jedhe.
english: Simon answered, “He, I suppose, to whom he forgave the most.” He said to him, “You have judged correctly.”

kikuyu: Innis gara dubartittiitti garagalee Simooniin akkana jedhe; “Dubartii kana argitaa? Ani mana kee nan dhufe. Ati bishaan miillaa illee naaf hin kennine; isheen garuu imimmaan isheetiin miilla koo dhiqxee rifeensa mataa isheetiin haqxe.
english: Turning to the woman, he said to Simon, “Do you see this woman? I entered into your house, and you gave me no water for my feet, but she has wet my feet with her tears, and wiped them with the hair of her head.

kikuyu: Ati na hin dhunganne; dubartiin kun garuu yeroo ani ol seenee jalqabdee miilla koo dhungachuu hin dhiifne.
english: You gave me no kiss, but she, since the time I came in, has not ceased to kiss my feet.

kikuyu: Ati Zayitii iyyuu mataa koo hin dibne; isheen garuu miilla koo shittoo dibde.
english: You didn’t anoint my head with oil, but she has anointed my feet with ointment.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani sittin hima; sababii jaalalli ishee guddaa taʼeef cubbuun ishee baayʼeen sun isheef dhiifameera. Kan xinnoon dhiifameef garuu jaalalli isaa xinnoo dha.”
english: Therefore I tell you, her sins, which are many, are forgiven, for she loved much. But one to whom little is forgiven, loves little.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis dubartittiidhaan, “Cubbuun kee siif dhiifameera” jedhe.
english: He said to her, “Your sins are forgiven.”

kikuyu: Warri isa wajjin maaddiitti dhiʼaatanii turanis, “Namni cubbuu iyyuu namaa dhiisu kun eenyu?” jedhanii garaa isaaniitti yaaduu jalqaban.
english: Those who sat at the table with him began to say to themselves, “Who is this who even forgives sins?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis dubartittiidhaan, “Amantiin kee si fayyiseera; nagaan deemi” jedhe.
english: He said to the woman, “Your faith has saved you. Go in peace.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis ergasii wangeela mootummaa Waaqaa lallabaa magaalaa tokko irraa gara magaalaa biraatti, ganda tokko irraas gara ganda biraatti naannaʼaa ture. Warri Kudha Lamaanis isa wajjin turan;
english: Soon afterwards, he went about through cities and villages, preaching and bringing the good news of God’s Kingdom. With him were the twelve,

kikuyu: dubartoonni hafuurota hamoo fi dhibee irraa fayyifaman tokko tokkos isa wajjin turan; isaanis Maariyaam ishee Magdalaa kan hafuuronni hamoon torba ishee keessaa baʼan,
english: and certain women who had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities: Mary who was called Magdalene, from whom seven demons had gone out;

kikuyu: Yohaanaa niitii Kuuzaa isa eegduu mana Heroodis turee, Suusanaa fi dubartoota biraa baayʼee turan. Dubartoonni kunneenis waan qabaniin Yesuusii fi barattoota isaa tajaajilaa turan.
english: and Joanna, the wife of Chuzas, Herod’s steward; Susanna; and many others who served them from their possessions.

kikuyu: Yeroo tuunni guddaan walitti qabamee namoonnis magaalaa gara garaatii gara isaa dhufanitti Yesuus akkana jedhee fakkeenya kana isaanitti hime:
english: When a great multitude came together and people from every city were coming to him, he spoke by a parable:

kikuyu: “Namichi sanyii facaasu tokko sanyii facaafachuu baʼe. Utuu inni facaasaa jiruus sanyiin tokko tokko karaa irra buʼee irra ejjetame; simbirroonnis nyaatanii fixan.
english: “The farmer went out to sow his seed. As he sowed, some fell along the road, and it was trampled under foot, and the birds of the sky devoured it.

kikuyu: Kaan immoo lafa kattaa irra buʼe; innis waan jiidha hin qabneef yeroo biqiletti ni goge.
english: Some seed fell on the rock, and as soon as it grew, it withered away, because it had no moisture.

kikuyu: Sanyiin biraas qoraattii keessa buʼe; qoraattiin sunis biqiltuu sana wajjin guddatee isa hudhe.
english: Some fell amid the thorns, and the thorns grew with it and choked it.

kikuyu: Ammas sanyiin kaan biyyoo gaarii irra buʼe. Ni biqile; ijas dachaa dhibba naqate.” Innis yommuu waan kana dubbatetti lallabee, “Namni gurra dhagaʼu qabu haa dhagaʼu” jedhe.
english: Some fell into the good ground and grew and produced one hundred times as much fruit.” As he said these things, he called out, “He who has ears to hear, let him hear!”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaas hiikkaan fakkeenya kanaa maal akka taʼe isa gaafatan.
english: Then his disciples asked him, “What does this parable mean?”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhe; “Icciitii mootummaa Waaqaa beekuun isinii kennameera; warra kaanitti garuu ani fakkeenyaan nan dubbadha; kunis, “ ‘Akka isaan utuma ilaalanuu hin argineef, utuma dhagaʼanuus, hin hubanneef.’
english: He said, “To you it is given to know the mysteries of God’s Kingdom, but to the rest it is given in parables, that ‘seeing they may not see, and hearing they may not understand.’

kikuyu: “Hiikkaan fakkeenyichaa kanaa dha: Sanyiin sun dubbii Waaqaa ti.
english: “Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of God.

kikuyu: Sanyiin karaa irraa sun namoota dubbicha dhagaʼanii garuu akka isaan amananii hin fayyineef diiyaabiloos dhufee dubbicha garaa isaanii keessaa fudhatuu dha.
english: Those along the road are those who hear; then the devil comes and takes away the word from their heart, that they may not believe and be saved.

kikuyu: Sanyiin lafa kattaa irraa sunis warra yommuu dubbicha dhagaʼanitti gammachuudhaan fudhatanii dha; isaan garuu hidda hin qaban. Yeroof amanu malee yeroo qorumsaatti ni ganu.
english: Those on the rock are they who, when they hear, receive the word with joy; but these have no root. They believe for a while, then fall away in time of temptation.

kikuyu: Sanyiin qoraattii keessa buʼes warra dubbicha dhagaʼanii dha; isaanis akkuma karaa isaanii itti fufaniin yaaddoo jireenyaatiin, badhaadhummaa fi qananiidhaan hudhamu; hin bilchaatanis.
english: What fell among the thorns, these are those who have heard, and as they go on their way they are choked with cares, riches, and pleasures of life; and they bring no fruit to maturity.

kikuyu: Sanyiin biyyoo gaarii irraa garuu warra garaa tolaa fi gaariidhaan dubbicha dhagaʼanii jabeessanii qabatanii obsaan ija naqatan argisiisa.
english: Those in the good ground, these are those who with an honest and good heart, having heard the word, hold it tightly, and produce fruit with perseverance.

kikuyu: “Namni kam iyyuu ibsaa qabsiisee okkotee keessa hin dhoksu yookaan siree jala hin kaaʼu. Qooda kanaa akka warri ol seenan ifa arguu dandaʼaniif baattuu ibsaa irra kaaʼu.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, covers it with a container or puts it under a bed; but puts it on a stand, that those who enter in may see the light.

kikuyu: Wanni dhokfamee utuu hin mulʼifamin hafu, wanni haguugamee utuu hin beekamin hafu yookaan utuu ifatti hin baafamin hafu tokko iyyuu hin jiruutii.
english: For nothing is hidden that will not be revealed, nor anything secret that will not be known and come to light.

kikuyu: Kanaaf akkamitti akka dhaggeeffattan qalbeeffadhaa. Kan qabu kamiif iyyuu itti dabalamee ni kennama; kan hin qabne kam iyyuu garuu wanni inni waan qabu of seʼu iyyuu isa irraa fudhatama.”
english: Be careful therefore how you hear. For whoever has, to him will be given; and whoever doesn’t have, from him will be taken away even that which he thinks he has.”

kikuyu: Haatii fi obboloonni Yesuus isa arguu dhufan; garuu sababii baayʼina namaatiif isa bira gaʼuu hin dandeenye.
english: His mother and brothers came to him, and they could not come near him for the crowd.

kikuyu: Namni tokkos, “Haati keetii fi obboloonni kee si arguu barbaadanii ala dhadhaabatanii jiru” jedhee isatti hime.
english: Some people told him, “Your mother and your brothers stand outside, desiring to see you.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Haati kootii fi obboloonni koo warra dubbii Waaqaa dhagaʼanii hojii irra oolchanii dha” jedhee deebise.
english: But he answered them, “My mother and my brothers are these who hear the word of God and do it.”

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko Yesuus barattoota isaatiin, “Kottaa galaana gama ceenaa” jedhe. Kanaafuu isaan bidiruu yaabbatanii qajeelan.
english: Now on one of those days, he entered into a boat, himself and his disciples, and he said to them, “Let’s go over to the other side of the lake.” So they launched out.

kikuyu: Inni utuu isaan bidiruudhaan deemaa jiranuu hirribni qabee rafe. Bubbeen tokkos galaana sana irratti kaʼee, bidiruun sun bishaaniin guutamuu jalqabe; isaanis balaa guddaa keessa seenan.
english: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.

kikuyu: Barattoonnis dhaqanii, “Yaa Gooftaa, yaa Gooftaa, nu dhumuuf jirra!” jedhanii isa dammaqsan. Innis kaʼee bubbee fi bishaan raafamaa ture sana ifate; bubbeen sunis gab jedhe; wanni hundinuus ni tasgabbaaʼe.
english: They came to him and awoke him, saying, “Master, Master, we are dying!” He awoke and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water; then they ceased, and it was calm.

kikuyu: Barattoota isaas, “Amantiin keessan eessa jira?” jedhee gaafate. Isaanis sodaa fi dinqifannaadhaan, “Namichi bubbee fi bishaan illee ajaju kun eenyu? Isaanis ni ajajamuuf” jedhanii wal gaafatan.
english: He said to them, “Where is your faith?” Being afraid, they marveled, saying to one another, “Who is this then, that he commands even the winds and the water, and they obey him?”

kikuyu: Isaanis gara biyya Gergeesenoon ishee galaanaan gama fuullee Galiilaatti argamtuutti bidiruudhaan ceʼan.
english: Then they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is opposite Galilee.

kikuyu: Yommuu Yesuus qarqara galaanaatti buʼettis namichi magaalaa sanaa kan hafuura hamaadhaan qabamee ture tokko isatti dhufe. Namichi kun yeroo dheeraadhaaf uffata hin uffatu ture; awwaala gidduu jiraata malee mana keessa hin jiraatu ture.
english: When Jesus stepped ashore, a certain man out of the city who had demons for a long time met him. He wore no clothes, and didn’t live in a house, but in the tombs.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu Yesuusin argetti iyyee miilla isaa irratti kufe; sagalee ol fudhatee iyyees, “Yaa Yesuus Ilma Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii, ati maal narraa barbaadda? Ani sin kadhadha; na hin dhiphisin!” jedhe.
english: When he saw Jesus, he cried out and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, “What do I have to do with you, Jesus, you Son of the Most High God? I beg you, don’t torment me!”

kikuyu: Yesuus akka hafuurri xuraaʼaan sun namicha keessaa baʼu ajajee tureetii. Hafuurri sunis yeroo baayʼee itti kaʼaa ture; namichi sun yoo harkaa fi miilli isaa foncaan hidhamee eegamaa ture iyyuu, hidhaa isaa of irraa kukkutee, hafuura hamaa sanaan gara lafa namni hin jirreetti geeffamaa ture.
english: For Jesus was commanding the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For the unclean spirit had often seized the man. He was kept under guard and bound with chains and fetters. Breaking the bonds apart, he was driven by the demon into the desert.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Maqaan kee eenyu?” jedhee isa gaafate. Innis sababii hafuuronni hamoon baayʼeen isatti galanii turaniif, “Leegewoon” jedhee deebise.
english: Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” He said, “Legion,” for many demons had entered into him.

kikuyu: Hafuuronni hamoon sunis akka inni akka isaan Qilee keessa buʼan isaan hin ajajneef Yesuusin kadhatan.
english: They begged him that he would not command them to go into the abyss.

kikuyu: Hoomaan booyyee guddaan isaas gaara irra achi dheedaa ture. Hafuuronni hamoon sunis akka inni akka isaan booyyeewwan sanatti galaniif isaanii eeyyamu Yesuusin kadhatan; innis ni eeyyameef.
english: Now there was there a herd of many pigs feeding on the mountain, and they begged him that he would allow them to enter into those. Then he allowed them.

kikuyu: Yommuu hafuuronni hamoon sun namicha keessaa baʼanii booyyeewwanitti galanitti, hoomaan sun ededa hallayyaa irraa gad furguggifamee galaanatti namʼee liqimfame.
english: The demons came out of the man and entered into the pigs, and the herd rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.

kikuyu: Warri booyyeewwan tiksan sunis yommuu waan taʼe sana arganitti, baqatanii magaalaa fi baadiyyaatti waan kana odeessan;
english: When those who fed them saw what had happened, they fled and told it in the city and in the country.

kikuyu: namoonnis waan taʼe sana ilaaluu baʼan. Isaanis yommuu gara Yesuus dhufanitti namicha hafuuronni hamoon keessaa baʼan sana wayyaa uffatee, qalbii isaattis deebiʼee miilla Yesuus jala taaʼee argan; ni sodaatanis.
english: People went out to see what had happened. They came to Jesus and found the man from whom the demons had gone out, sitting at Jesus’ feet, clothed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.

kikuyu: Warri waan kana arganii turanis namichi hafuura hamaan qabame sun akkamitti akka fayye namootatti odeessan.
english: Those who saw it told them how he who had been possessed by demons was healed.

kikuyu: Kana irratti namoonni biyya Gergeesenoon hundinuu waan sodaadhaan guutamaniif akka Yesuus isaan biraa deemu isa kadhatan. Innis bidiruu yaabbatee achii deeme.
english: All the people of the surrounding country of the Gadarenes asked him to depart from them, for they were very much afraid. Then he entered into the boat and returned.

kikuyu: Namichi hafuuronni hamoon keessaa baʼan sun Yesuus wajjin deemuuf isa kadhate; Yesuus garuu akkana jedhee of biraa isa deebise;
english: But the man from whom the demons had gone out begged him that he might go with him, but Jesus sent him away, saying,

kikuyu: “Mana keetti deebiʼiitii wanni Waaqni siif godhe hammam guddaa akka taʼe odeessi.” Namichis dhaqee wanni Yesuus isaaf godhe hammam guddaa akka taʼe magaalaa sana hunda keessatti odeesse.
english: “Return to your house, and declare what great things God has done for you.” He went his way, proclaiming throughout the whole city what great things Jesus had done for him.

kikuyu: Yommuu Yesuus deebiʼetti namoonni baayʼeen isa simatan. Hundi isaanii isa eeggachaa turaniitii.
english: When Jesus returned, the multitude welcomed him, for they were all waiting for him.

kikuyu: Namichi Yaaʼiiros jedhamu, bulchaan mana sagadaa tokko dhufee miilla Yesuus irratti kufee akka inni mana isaa dhaqu isa kadhate;
english: Behold, a man named Jairus came. He was a ruler of the synagogue. He fell down at Jesus’ feet and begged him to come into his house,

kikuyu: sababiin isaas intalli isaa tokkittiin, durbi umuriin ishee gara waggaa kudha lamaa taʼu tokko duʼuu geessee turte. Utuu Yesuus deemaa jiruu namoonni qixa hundaan dhiibanii hafuura isa kutuu gaʼan.
english: for he had an only born daughter, about twelve years of age, and she was dying. But as he went, the multitudes pressed against him.

kikuyu: Dubartiin dhiigni ishee waggaa kudha lama dhangalaʼaa ture tokkos achi turte; garuu namni tokko iyyuu ishee fayyisuu hin dandeenye.
english: A woman who had a flow of blood for twelve years, who had spent all her living on physicians and could not be healed by any,

kikuyu: Isheenis dugda isaa duubaan dhuftee handaara uffata isaa tuqxe; dhiigni ishees yommusuma cite.
english: came behind him and touched the fringe of his cloak. Immediately the flow of her blood stopped.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Eenyutu na tuqe?” jedhee gaafate. Yommuu hundi isaanii haalanitti Phexros, “Yaa barsiisaa namoonni tuuttaʼanii si dhiibaa jiru” jedhe.
english: Jesus said, “Who touched me?” When all denied it, Peter and those with him said, “Master, the multitudes press and jostle you, and you say, ‘Who touched me?’”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu, “Namni wayii na tuqeera; ani akka humni na keessaa baʼe nan beekaa” jedhe.
english: But Jesus said, “Someone did touch me, for I perceived that power has gone out of me.”

kikuyu: Dubartittiinis akka utuu hin beekamin deemuu hin dandeenye hubannaan hollachaa dhuftee miilla isaa irratti kufte. Isheenis maaliif akka isa tuqxee fi akkamittis akka yommusuma fayyite namoota sana hunda duratti dubbate.
english: When the woman saw that she was not hidden, she came trembling; and falling down before him declared to him in the presence of all the people the reason why she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.

kikuyu: Kana irratti inni, “Yaa intalaa, amantiin kee si fayyiseera. Nagaan deemi” jedheen.
english: He said to her, “Daughter, cheer up. Your faith has made you well. Go in peace.”

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuus dubbachaa jiruus namni tokko mana Yaaʼiiroos bulchaa mana sagadaatii dhufee, “Intalli kee duuteerti; ati siʼachi barsiisicha hin rakkisin” jedhe.
english: While he still spoke, one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house came, saying to him, “Your daughter is dead. Don’t trouble the Teacher.”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu yommuu dhagaʼetti Yaaʼiiroosiin, “Amani malee hin sodaatin; isheen ni fayyitii” jedhe.
english: But Jesus hearing it, answered him, “Don’t be afraid. Only believe, and she will be healed.”

kikuyu: Inni yommuu mana Yaaʼiiroos gaʼetti Phexros, Yohannisii fi Yaaqoob akkasumas abbaa fi haadha intalattii malee akka namni tokko iyyuu isa wajjin ol seenu hin eeyyamne.
english: When he came to the house, he didn’t allow anyone to enter in, except Peter, John, James, the father of the child, and her mother.

kikuyu: Kana irratti namoonni hundinuu isheef wawwaachaa, faarsaas turan. Yesuus garuu, “Hin booʼinaa; isheen ni rafti malee hin duuneetii” jedhe.
english: All were weeping and mourning her, but he said, “Don’t weep. She isn’t dead, but sleeping.”

kikuyu: Isaan immoo akka isheen duute waan beekaniif isatti kolfan.
english: They were ridiculing him, knowing that she was dead.

kikuyu: Inni garuu harka ishee qabee, “Intala ko, kaʼi!” jedhe.
english: But he put them all outside, and taking her by the hand, he called, saying, “Child, arise!”

kikuyu: Hafuurri ishees ni deebiʼe; isheenis yommusuma kaatee dhaabatte. Ergasii Yesuus akka isaan waan isheen nyaattu isheef kennan isaanitti hime.
english: Her spirit returned, and she rose up immediately. He commanded that something be given to her to eat.

kikuyu: Abbaa fi haati ishees ni dinqifatan; inni garuu akka isaan waan taʼe sana nama tokkotti illee hin himne isaan ajaje.
english: Her parents were amazed, but he commanded them to tell no one what had been done.

kikuyu: Yesuus warra Kudha Lamaan walitti waamee, akka isaan hafuurota hamoo hunda baasanii fi akka dhibeewwan fayyisaniif humnaa fi taayitaa kenneef;
english: He called the twelve together and gave them power and authority over all demons, and to cure diseases.

kikuyu: inni akka isaan mootummaa Waaqaa labsanii fi akka dhukkubsattoota fayyisaniif isaan erge.
english: He sent them out to preach God’s Kingdom and to heal the sick.

kikuyu: Akkanas isaaniin jedhe; “Adeemsa keessaniif waan tokko illee jechuunis ulee yookaan korojoo yookaan buddeena yookaan maallaqa akkanumas kittaa lama hin qabatinaa.
english: He said to them, “Take nothing for your journey—no staffs, nor wallet, nor bread, nor money. Don’t have two tunics each.

kikuyu: Mana seentan kam iyyuu keessa hamma magaalaa sanaa baatanitti achuma turaa.
english: Into whatever house you enter, stay there, and depart from there.

kikuyu: Yoo namoonni isin simachuu baatan, magaalaa isaaniitii baʼaatii akka ragaa isaanitti taʼuuf awwaara miilla keessanii dhadhaʼadhaa.”
english: As many as don’t receive you, when you depart from that city, shake off even the dust from your feet for a testimony against them.”

kikuyu: Isaanis achii baʼanii iddoo hundatti wangeela lallabaa, namootas fayyisaa ganda tokko irraa gara ganda kaanii deemaa turan.
english: They departed and went throughout the villages, preaching the Good News and healing everywhere.

kikuyu: Heroodis bulchaan waaʼee waan taʼaa ture hundaa dhagaʼe. Innis waan namoonni tokko tokko Yohannis cuuphaan warra duʼan keessaa kaafameera jechaa turaniif,
english: Now Herod the tetrarch heard of all that was done by him; and he was very perplexed, because it was said by some that John had risen from the dead,

kikuyu: warri kaanis Eeliyaas mulʼateera jechaa waan turaniif, warri kaan immoo raajota durii keessaa inni tokko duʼaa kaʼeera jechaa waan turaniif akka malee burjaajaʼe.
english: and by some that Elijah had appeared, and by others that one of the old prophets had risen again.

kikuyu: Heroodis garuu, “Ani Yohannisin mataa isaa kuteen ture. Yoos namichi ani waaʼee isaa waan akkanaa dhagaʼu kun eenyu ree?” jedhe. Yesuusin arguufis ni hawwa ture.
english: Herod said, “I beheaded John, but who is this about whom I hear such things?” He sought to see him.

kikuyu: Ergamoonnis yommuu deebiʼanitti waan hojjetanii turan Yesuusitti himan. Innis ofitti isaan fudhate; isaanis ofumaan gara magaalaa Beetisayidaa jedhamtuu dhaqan;
english: The apostles, when they had returned, told him what things they had done. He took them and withdrew apart to a desert region of a city called Bethsaida.

kikuyu: namoonni baayʼeen garuu waan kana beekanii isa duukaa buʼan. Innis isaan simatee waaʼee mootummaa Waaqaa isaanitti hime; warra fayyuun isaan barbaachises ni fayyise.
english: But the multitudes, perceiving it, followed him. He welcomed them, spoke to them of God’s Kingdom, and he cured those who needed healing.

kikuyu: Gara galgalaatti warri Kudha Lamaan gara isaa dhufanii, “Waan nu as gammoojjii keessa jirruuf, akka namoonni kunneen gara gandootaatii fi baadiyyaa naannoo kana jiranii dhaqanii waan nyaatanii fi iddoo bultii barbaadataniif isaan gad dhiisi” jedhaniin.
english: The day began to wear away; and the twelve came and said to him, “Send the multitude away, that they may go into the surrounding villages and farms and lodge and get food, for we are here in a deserted place.”

kikuyu: Inni immoo, “Isinuu waan isaan nyaatan kennaafii” jedhee deebise. Isaanis, “Nama kana hundaaf nyaata yoo dhaqnee binne malee nu buddeena shanii fi qurxummii lama qofa qabna” jedhanii deebisan.
english: But he said to them, “You give them something to eat.” They said, “We have no more than five loaves and two fish, unless we should go and buy food for all these people.”

kikuyu: Dhiira gara kuma shantu achi ture. Inni garuu barattoota isaatiin, “Garee tokkoon tokkoon isaa gara nama shantama shantamaa qabuun isaan teessisaa” jedhe.
english: For they were about five thousand men. He said to his disciples, “Make them sit down in groups of about fifty each.”

kikuyu: Barattoonnis akkasuma godhan; namni hundis ni taaʼe.
english: They did so, and made them all sit down.

kikuyu: Innis buddeena shananii fi qurxummii lamaan fuudhee, gara samii ol ilaalee galata galchee caccabse. Ergasii akka isaan namootaaf dhiʼeessaniif barattootatti kenne.
english: He took the five loaves and the two fish, and looking up to the sky, he blessed them, broke them, and gave them to the disciples to set before the multitude.

kikuyu: Isaan hundi nyaatanii quufan; barattoonnis hurraaʼaa hambifame gundoo kudha lama guutuu walitti qaban.
english: They ate and were all filled. They gathered up twelve baskets of broken pieces that were left over.

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko Yesuus kophaa isaa kadhannaa irra ture; barattoonni isaas isa wajjin turan. Innis, “Namoonni anaan eenyu jedhu?” jedhee isaan gaafate.
english: As he was praying alone, the disciples were near him, and he asked them, “Who do the multitudes say that I am?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Namoonni tokko tokko inni Yohannis Cuuphaa dha jedhu; warri kaan inni Eeliyaas jedhu; kaan immoo raajota durii keessaa isa tokkotu duʼaa kaʼe jedhu” jedhanii deebisan.
english: They answered, “‘John the Baptizer,’ but others say, ‘Elijah,’ and others, that one of the old prophets has risen again.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Isin hoo? Eenyu anaan jettu?” jedhee gaafate. Phexrosis, “Ati Kiristoos Waaqaa ti” jedhee deebise.
english: He said to them, “But who do you say that I am?” Peter answered, “The Christ of God.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akka isaan waan kana nama tokkotti illee hin himneef jabeessee isaan akeekkachiise.
english: But he warned them and commanded them to tell this to no one,

kikuyu: Innis, “Ilmi Namaa waan hedduun dhiphachuu, maanguddootaan, luboota hangafootaa fi barsiistota seeraatiin tuffatamuu, ajjeefamuu fi guyyaa sadaffaatti immoo duʼaa kaʼuu qaba” jedhe.
english: saying, “The Son of Man must suffer many things, and be rejected by the elders, chief priests, and scribes, and be killed, and the third day be raised up.”

kikuyu: Ergasii inni hunduma isaaniitiin akkana jedhe; “Namni kam iyyuu yoo na faana dhufuu barbaade, inni of haa ganu; fannoo isaa guyyuma guyyaan baadhatees na duukaa haa buʼu.
english: He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.

kikuyu: Namni lubbuu isaa oolfachuu barbaadu kam iyyuu lubbuu isaa ni dhabaatii; garuu namni naaf jedhee lubbuu isaa dhabu kam iyyuu lubbuu isaa ni oolfata.
english: For whoever desires to save his life will lose it, but whoever will lose his life for my sake will save it.

kikuyu: Namni yoo addunyaa guutuu argatee ofii isaa immoo dhabe yookaan yoo gatame inni buʼaa maalii argata?
english: For what does it profit a man if he gains the whole world, and loses or forfeits his own self?

kikuyu: Nama anattii fi dubbii kootti qaanaʼu kam iyyuu Ilmi Namaa yommuu ulfina isaatiin, ulfina Abbaatii fi ulfina ergamoota qulqulluutiin dhufutti isatti ni qaanaʼa.
english: For whoever will be ashamed of me and of my words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed when he comes in his glory, and the glory of the Father, and of the holy angels.

kikuyu: “Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; warra as dhadhaabachaa jiran keessaa namoonni tokko tokko utuu mootummaa Waaqaa hin argin duʼa hin dhandhaman.”
english: But I tell you the truth: There are some of those who stand here who will in no way taste of death until they see God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Yesuus erga waan kana dubbatee gara guyyaa saddeetii booddee Phexros, Yohannisii fi Yaaqoobin fudhatee kadhannaadhaaf tulluu tokkotti ol baʼe.
english: About eight days after these sayings, he took with him Peter, John, and James, and went up onto the mountain to pray.

kikuyu: Utuu inni kadhachaa jiruus bifti fuula isaa geeddarame; uffanni isaas adii calaqqisu taʼe.
english: As he was praying, the appearance of his face was altered, and his clothing became white and dazzling.

kikuyu: Kunoo namoonni lama jechuunis Musee fi Eeliyaas, ulfina guddaadhaan mulʼatanii Yesuus wajjin haasaʼaa turan.
english: Behold, two men were talking with him, who were Moses and Elijah,

kikuyu: Isaanis ulfinaan mulʼatanii waaʼee addunyaa kana irraa deemuu isaa kan inni Yerusaalemitti raawwachuuf jiru sanaa dudubbachaa turan.
english: who appeared in glory and spoke of his departure, which he was about to accomplish at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Phexrosii fi warri isa wajjin turan garuu akka malee mugan; yeroo dammaqanitti immoo ulfina Yesuusii fi namoota Yesuus wajjin dhadhaabachaa turan lamaan argan.
english: Now Peter and those who were with him were heavy with sleep, but when they were fully awake, they saw his glory, and the two men who stood with him.

kikuyu: Phexrosis akkuma namoonni sun Yesuus biraa deemuu jalqabaniin, “Yaa Gooftaa, as jiraachuun nuuf gaarii dha. Daasii sadii jechuunis tokko siif, tokko Museef, tokko immoo Eeliyaasiif ni ijaarra” jedhe. Inni waan dubbatu hin beeku ture.
english: As they were parting from him, Peter said to Jesus, “Master, it is good for us to be here. Let’s make three tents: one for you, one for Moses, and one for Elijah,” not knowing what he said.

kikuyu: Utuma inni dubbachaa jiruu duumessi tokko dhufee isaan haguuge; isaanis yommuu duumessa sana keessa seenanitti ni sodaatan.
english: While he said these things, a cloud came and overshadowed them, and they were afraid as they entered into the cloud.

kikuyu: Sagaleen, “Kun Ilma koo isa ani filadhee dha; isinis isa dhagaʼaa” jedhu tokko duumessicha keessaa dhufe.
english: A voice came out of the cloud, saying, “This is my beloved Son. Listen to him!”

kikuyu: Yommuu sagaleen sun dubbatetti, Yesuus kophaa isaa argame. Barattoonnis ni calʼisan malee waan argan keessaa tokko illee yeroo sanatti nama tokkottuu hin himne.
english: When the voice came, Jesus was found alone. They were silent, and told no one in those days any of the things which they had seen.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanu, yommuu isaan tulluu irraa gad buʼanitti namoonni baayʼeen isatti dhufan.
english: On the next day, when they had come down from the mountain, a great multitude met him.

kikuyu: Namoota sana keessaas namichi tokko iyyee akkana jedhe; “Yaa Barsiisaa akka ati ilma koo naa ilaaltu sin kadhadha; inni anaaf mucaa tokkichaatii.
english: Behold, a man from the crowd called out, saying, “Teacher, I beg you to look at my son, for he is my only born child.

kikuyu: Hafuurri wayii itti kaʼa; gurbichis akkuma tasaa iyya; hafuurri sun lafaan dhaʼee isa dhidhiitachiisa. Gurbichis hoomacha afaaniin baasa; hafuurichi dafee irraa hin galu; yeroo hundas isa miidha.
english: Behold, a spirit takes him, he suddenly cries out, and it convulses him so that he foams; and it hardly departs from him, bruising him severely.

kikuyu: Ani akka hafuura sana baasaniif barattoota kee nan kadhadhe; isaan garuu hin dandeenye.”
english: I begged your disciples to cast it out, and they couldn’t.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Isin dhaloota hin amannee fi jalʼaa nana; ani hamma yoomiitti isin wajjin jiraadha? Hamma yoomiittis isinii obsa?” jedhe. Namichaanis, “Mee ilma kee as fidi” jedhe.
english: Jesus answered, “Faithless and perverse generation, how long shall I be with you and bear with you? Bring your son here.”

kikuyu: Utuma gurbaan sun gara Yesuus dhufaa jiruus, hafuurri hamaan sun lafaan dhaʼee isa dhidhiitachiise. Yesuus garuu hafuura xuraaʼaa sana ifate; gurbichas fayyisee abbaa isaatiif kenne.
english: While he was still coming, the demon threw him down and convulsed him violently. But Jesus rebuked the unclean spirit, healed the boy, and gave him back to his father.

kikuyu: Hundumti isaaniis humna Waaqaa isa jabaa sana ni dinqifatan. Utuu hundi isaanii waan Yesuus hojjete sana dinqisiifachaa jiranuu inni barattoota isaatiin akkana jedhe;
english: They were all astonished at the majesty of God. But while all were marveling at all the things which Jesus did, he said to his disciples,

kikuyu: “Waan ani isinitti himuuf jiru of eeggannaadhaan dhaggeeffadhaa: Ilmi Namaa dabarfamee harka namootaatti ni kennama.”
english: “Let these words sink into your ears, for the Son of Man will be delivered up into the hands of men.”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu dubbii kana hin hubanne. Akka isaaniif hin galleefis isaan jalaa dhokfamee ture; isaan waaʼee waan kanaa isa gaafachuus ni sodaatan.
english: But they didn’t understand this saying. It was concealed from them, that they should not perceive it, and they were afraid to ask him about this saying.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa namni nama hundumaa caalu eenyu akka taʼe barattoota gidduutti wal falmiin kaʼe.
english: An argument arose among them about which of them was the greatest.

kikuyu: Yesuusis waan isaan garaatti yaadan beekee mucaa xinnaa tokko fidee of bira dhaabe;
english: Jesus, perceiving the reasoning of their hearts, took a little child, and set him by his side,

kikuyu: akkanas isaaniin jedhe; “Namni mucaa xinnaa kana maqaa kootiin simatu kam iyyuu na simata; namni na simatus isa na erge sana simata; namni isin hundaa gad taʼe inni hunda caalaatii.”
english: and said to them, “Whoever receives this little child in my name receives me. Whoever receives me receives him who sent me. For whoever is least among you all, this one will be great.”

kikuyu: Yohannisis, “Yaa Barsiisaa, nu utuu namni tokko maqaa keetiin hafuurota hamoo baasuu arginee waan inni nu duukaa hin buuneef isa dhowwine” jedhe.
english: John answered, “Master, we saw someone casting out demons in your name, and we forbade him, because he doesn’t follow with us.”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu, “Isa hin dhowwinaa; namni isiniin hin mormine kam iyyuu gara keessan jiraatii” jedhe.
english: Jesus said to him, “Don’t forbid him, for he who is not against us is for us.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu yeroon inni itti gara samiitti ol fudhatamu gaʼetti Yerusaalem dhaquuf hidhatee kaʼe.
english: It came to pass, when the days were near that he should be taken up, he intently set his face to go to Jerusalem

kikuyu: Innis ergamoota of dura erge; isaanis waan isa barbaachisu qopheessuudhaaf ganda Samaariyaa tokko seenan.
english: and sent messengers before his face. They went and entered into a village of the Samaritans, so as to prepare for him.

kikuyu: Namoonni naannoo sanaa garuu sababii inni fuula isaa Yerusaalemitti deebifatee deemaa tureef isa hin simanne.
english: They didn’t receive him, because he was traveling with his face set toward Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaa jechuunis Yaaqoobii fi Yohannis yommuu waan kana arganitti, “Yaa Gooftaa, akka inni isaan balleessuuf, akka nu samii irraa ibidda gad waamnu barbaaddaa?” jedhan.
english: When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the sky and destroy them, just as Elijah did?”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu garagalee isaan ifate.
english: But he turned and rebuked them, “You don’t know of what kind of spirit you are.

kikuyu: Isaanis darbanii ganda biraa dhaqan.
english: For the Son of Man didn’t come to destroy men’s lives, but to save them.” They went to another village.

kikuyu: Utuu isaan karaa deemaa jiranuus namichi tokko Yesuusiin, “Ani iddoo ati dhaqxu hundatti si duukaa nan buʼa” jedhe.
english: As they went on the way, a certain man said to him, “I want to follow you wherever you go, Lord.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Waangoonni boolla qabu; simbirroonnis manʼee qabu; Ilmi Namaa garuu iddoo itti mataa isaa irkifatu illee hin qabu” jedhe.
english: Jesus said to him, “The foxes have holes and the birds of the sky have nests, but the Son of Man has no place to lay his head.”

kikuyu: Nama biraatiinis, “Na duukaa buʼi!” jedhe. Namichi garuu, “Yaa Gooftaa, dura akka ani dhaqee abbaa koo awwaalladhu naa eeyyami” jedhee deebise.
english: He said to another, “Follow me!” But he said, “Lord, allow me first to go and bury my father.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Warri duʼan duʼaa isaanii haa awwaallatan; ati garuu dhaqiitii mootummaa Waaqaa lallabi” jedheen.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Leave the dead to bury their own dead, but you go and announce God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Ammas namni biraa, “Yaa Gooftaa, anis si duukaa nan buʼa; garuu dura akka ani dhaqee maatii kootti nagaa dhaamadhu naa eeyyami” jedhe.
english: Another also said, “I want to follow you, Lord, but first allow me to say good-bye to those who are at my house.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Namni harkaan hordaa qabatee of duuba ilaalu kam iyyuu mootummaa Waaqaatiif hin malu” jedhe.
english: But Jesus said to him, “No one, having put his hand to the plow and looking back, is fit for God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Kana booddee Gooftaan namoota biraa 72 muudee gara magaalaawwanii fi lafa ofii dhaquuf ture hundaatti lama lamaan of dura isaan erge.
english: Now after these things, the Lord also appointed seventy others, and sent them two by two ahead of him into every city and place where he was about to come.

kikuyu: Akkanas isaaniin jedhe; “Midhaan walitti qabamu baayʼee dha; hojjettoonni garuu muraasa. Kanaaf akka Gooftaan midhaan sanaa gara lafa qotiisaa midhaan isaatti hojjettoota erguuf isa kadhadhaa.
english: Then he said to them, “The harvest is indeed plentiful, but the laborers are few. Pray therefore to the Lord of the harvest, that he may send out laborers into his harvest.

kikuyu: Deemaa! Ani akka ilmoolee hoolaa gara gidduu yeeyyiitti isin erga.
english: Go your ways. Behold, I send you out as lambs among wolves.

kikuyu: Borsaa yookaan korojoo yookaan kophee hin qabatinaa; karaa irrattis nama tokko illee nagaa hin gaafatinaa.
english: Carry no purse, nor wallet, nor sandals. Greet no one on the way.

kikuyu: “Yeroo mana tokko seentanitti dursaatii, ‘Nagaan mana kanaaf haa taʼu’ jedhaa.
english: Into whatever house you enter, first say, ‘Peace be to this house.’

kikuyu: Yoo namni nagaa achi jiraate, nagaan keessan isaaf taʼa; yoo kanaa achii nagaan keessan isiniif deebiʼa.
english: If a son of peace is there, your peace will rest on him; but if not, it will return to you.

kikuyu: Waan isaan isinii kennan hunda nyaachaa, dhugaas achuma turaa; hojjetaaf mindaa isaa argachuun ni malaatii. Manaa gara manaatti hin labinaa.
english: Remain in that same house, eating and drinking the things they give, for the laborer is worthy of his wages. Don’t go from house to house.

kikuyu: “Yeroo magaalaa tokko seentanii simatamtanitti waanuma isinii dhiʼaate nyaadhaa.
english: Into whatever city you enter and they receive you, eat the things that are set before you.

kikuyu: Dhukkubsattoota achi jiran fayyisaatii, ‘Mootummaan Waaqaa isinitti dhiʼaateera’ jedhaa isaanitti himaa.
english: Heal the sick who are there and tell them, ‘God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

kikuyu: Yoo magaalaa tokko seentanii isin simachuu baatan garuu gara daandii magaalaatti baʼaatii akkana jedhaa;
english: But into whatever city you enter and they don’t receive you, go out into its streets and say,

kikuyu: ‘Nu akka akeekkachiisa isinii taʼuuf awwaara magaalaa keessanii illee miilla keenya irraa dhadhaʼanna. Taʼus waan kana beekaa: Mootummaan Waaqaa dhiʼaateera.’
english: ‘Even the dust from your city that clings to us, we wipe off against you. Nevertheless know this, that God’s Kingdom has come near to you.’

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; gaafas magaalaa sana irra Sodoomiif ni salphata.
english: I tell you, it will be more tolerable in that day for Sodom than for that city.

kikuyu: “Yaa Koraaziin siif wayyoo! Yaa Beetisayidaa siif wayyoo! Hojiin dinqii kan isin keessatti hojjetame sun utuu Xiiroosii fi Siidoonaa keessatti hojjetamee jiraatee isaan silaa yeroo dheeraan dura uffata gaddaa uffatanii, daaraa keessas tataaʼanii qalbii jijjiirratu turan.
english: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the mighty works had been done in Tyre and Sidon which were done in you, they would have repented long ago, sitting in sackcloth and ashes.

kikuyu: Garuu guyyaa murtiitti isin irra Xiiroosii fi Siidoonaaf ni salphata.
english: But it will be more tolerable for Tyre and Sidon in the judgment than for you.

kikuyu: Atis yaa Qifirnaahom, hamma samiitti ol kaafamtaa? Lakki, Siiʼoolitti gad buuta.
english: You, Capernaum, who are exalted to heaven, will be brought down to Hades.

kikuyu: “Namni isin dhagaʼu kam iyyuu na dhagaʼa; namni isin dhagaʼuu didu anas dhagaʼuu dida; namni na dhagaʼuu didu immoo isa na erge sana dhagaʼuu dida.”
english: Whoever listens to you listens to me, and whoever rejects you rejects me. Whoever rejects me rejects him who sent me.”

kikuyu: Namoonni torbaatamii lamaan sunis gammachuudhaan deebiʼanii, “Yaa Gooftaa, hafuuronni hamoon iyyuu maqaa keetiin nuu ajajamaniiru” jedhan.
english: The seventy returned with joy, saying, “Lord, even the demons are subject to us in your name!”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee akkana jedhe; “Ani utuu Seexanni akkuma balaqqeetti samii irraa buʼuu nan arge.
english: He said to them, “I saw Satan having fallen like lightning from heaven.

kikuyu: Kunoo, ani akka isin bofaa fi torbaanqabaa lafatti dhidhiittanii fi akka humna diinaa hundas moʼattaniif aangoo isinii kenneera; wanni kam iyyuu isin hin miidhu.
english: Behold, I give you authority to tread on serpents and scorpions, and over all the power of the enemy. Nothing will in any way hurt you.

kikuyu: Garuu sababii maqaan keessan samii keessatti barreeffameef gammadaa malee sababii hafuuronni isinii ajajamaniif hin gammadinaa.”
english: Nevertheless, don’t rejoice in this, that the spirits are subject to you, but rejoice that your names are written in heaven.”

kikuyu: Yesuus yeroo sana Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan gammachuun guutamee akkana jedhe; “Yaa Abbaa, Gooftaa samiitii fi lafaa, sababii ati wantoota kanneen ogeeyyii fi hubattoota jalaa dhoksitee daaʼimmanitti mulʼifteef ani sin galateeffadha. Eeyyee yaa Abbaa, ati waan kana gochuutti gammaddeertaatii.
english: In that same hour, Jesus rejoiced in the Holy Spirit, and said, “I thank you, O Father, Lord of heaven and earth, that you have hidden these things from the wise and understanding, and revealed them to little children. Yes, Father, for so it was well-pleasing in your sight.”

kikuyu: “Abbaan koo waan hunda dabarsee natti kenneera. Abbaa malee namni tokko iyyuu Ilmi eenyu akka taʼe hin beeku; Ilmaa fi nama Ilmi isa itti mulʼisuu fedhu malee namni tokko iyyuu Abbaan eenyu akka taʼe hin beeku.”
english: Turning to the disciples, he said, “All things have been delivered to me by my Father. No one knows who the Son is, except the Father, and who the Father is, except the Son, and he to whomever the Son desires to reveal him.”

kikuyu: Barattoota isaattis garagalee kophaatti akkana jedheen; “Iji waan isin argitan argu eebbifamaa dha.
english: Turning to the disciples, he said privately, “Blessed are the eyes which see the things that you see,

kikuyu: Ani isinittin himaatii raajonnii fi mootonni baayʼeen waan isin argitan kana arguu barbaadan; garuu hin argine. Waan isin dhageessan kanas dhagaʼuu barbaadan; garuu hin dhageenye.”
english: for I tell you that many prophets and kings desired to see the things which you see, and didn’t see them, and to hear the things which you hear, and didn’t hear them.”

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko, hayyuun seeraa tokko Yesuusin qoruuf jedhee kaʼee dhaabate. Innis, “Yaa Barsiisaa, ani jireenya bara baraa dhaaluudhaaf maal gochuun qaba?” jedhee gaafate.
english: Behold, a certain lawyer stood up and tested him, saying, “Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Seera keessatti maaltu barreeffame? Atis akkamitti dubbifta?” jedheen.
english: He said to him, “What is written in the law? How do you read it?”

kikuyu: Namichis, “ ‘Waaqa kee Goofticha garaa kee guutuudhaan, lubbuu kee guutuudhaan, humna kee guutuudhaan, yaada kee guutuudhaan jaalladhu; ollaa kees akkuma ofii keetiitti jaalladhu’” jedhee deebise.
english: He answered, “You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your strength, and with all your mind; and your neighbor as yourself.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Sirriitti deebifteerta; atis kanuma godhi ni jiraattaa” jedheen.
english: He said to him, “You have answered correctly. Do this, and you will live.”

kikuyu: Namichi sun garuu qajeelaa of gochuu barbaadee, “Ollaan koo eenyu?” jedhee Yesuusin gaafate.
english: But he, desiring to justify himself, asked Jesus, “Who is my neighbor?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee akkana jedhe; “Namichi tokko utuu Yerusaalemii baʼee Yerikootti gad buʼaa jiruu harka saamtotaa seene. Isaanis uffata isaa irraa baafatanii, tumanii, duʼaa fi jireenya gidduutti isa dhiisanii deeman.
english: Jesus answered, “A certain man was going down from Jerusalem to Jericho, and he fell among robbers, who both stripped him and beat him, and departed, leaving him half dead.

kikuyu: Lubni tokko utuu akkuma tasaa karaa sanaan gad buʼuu namicha argee irraa goree darbe.
english: By chance a certain priest was going down that way. When he saw him, he passed by on the other side.

kikuyu: Akkasumas namichi gosa Lewwii tokko yommuu iddoo sana gaʼeetti namicha sana argee irraa goree darbe.
english: In the same way a Levite also, when he came to the place and saw him, passed by on the other side.

kikuyu: Namichi Samaariyaa tokko garuu utuu deemaa jiruu iddoo namichi sun jiru gaʼe; yommuu isa argettis garaa laafeef.
english: But a certain Samaritan, as he traveled, came where he was. When he saw him, he was moved with compassion,

kikuyu: Innis itti dhiʼaatee zayitii fi daadhii wayinii madaa isaatti naqee hidheef; harree isaa irras kaaʼee, mana boqonnaa keessummootaatti isa geesse; achittis isa gargaare.
english: came to him, and bound up his wounds, pouring on oil and wine. He set him on his own animal, brought him to an inn, and took care of him.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti diinaarii lama baasee abbaa mana boqonnaa sanaatti kennee, ‘Namicha kana ittiin naa walʼaani; yoo kana caalaa baaftes ani yeroon deebiʼee dhufutti siifin kenna’ jedheen.
english: On the next day, when he departed, he took out two denarii, gave them to the host, and said to him, ‘Take care of him. Whatever you spend beyond that, I will repay you when I return.’

kikuyu: “Egaa jara sadan kanneen keessaa ollaan namicha harka saamtotaa seene sanaa isa kam seeta?”
english: Now which of these three do you think seemed to be a neighbor to him who fell among the robbers?”

kikuyu: Hayyuun seeraa sunis, “Isa garaa laafeef sana” jedheen. Yesuusis, “Atis dhaqiitii akkasuma godhi” jedheen.
english: He said, “He who showed mercy on him.” Then Jesus said to him, “Go and do likewise.”

kikuyu: Utuu karaa deemaa jiranuu Yesuus ganda tokko seene; dubartiin Maartaa jedhamtu tokkos mana isheetti isa simatte.
english: As they went on their way, he entered into a certain village, and a certain woman named Martha received him into her house.

kikuyu: Isheenis obboleettii Maariyaam jedhamtu tokko qabdi turte; Maariyaamis miilla Gooftaa jala teessee waan inni jedhu dhaggeeffachaa turte.
english: She had a sister called Mary, who also sat at Jesus’ feet and heard his word.

kikuyu: Maartaan garuu baayʼina hojiitiin waan dadhabaa turteef gara isaa dhuftee, “Yaa Gooftaa, obboleettiin koo akka ani hojii hunda kophaa koo hojjedhu natti dhiisuun ishee si hin gaddisiisuu? Akka isheen na gargaartu itti himi!” jette.
english: But Martha was distracted with much serving, and she came up to him, and said, “Lord, don’t you care that my sister left me to serve alone? Ask her therefore to help me.”

kikuyu: Gooftaanis deebisee akkana jedheen; “Yaa Maartaa, yaa Maartaa, ati waaʼee waan baayʼee yaaddofta; ni raafamtas.
english: Jesus answered her, “Martha, Martha, you are anxious and troubled about many things,

kikuyu: Wanni barbaachisu garuu waanuma tokko qofa; Maariyaam isa caalu filatteerti; innis ishee irraa hin fudhatamu.”
english: but one thing is needed. Mary has chosen the good part, which will not be taken away from her.”

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko Yesuus iddoo tokkotti kadhachaa ture; yommuu inni fixatettis, barattoota isaa keessaa namni tokko, “Yaa Barsiisaa, akkuma Yohannis barattoota isaa barsiise sana, atis kadhachuu nu barsiisi” jedheen.
english: When he finished praying in a certain place, one of his disciples said to him, “Lord, teach us to pray, just as John also taught his disciples.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isin yommuu kadhattan akkana jedhaa: “ ‘Yaa Abbaa, maqaan kee haa qulqullaaʼu; mootummaan kee haa dhufu.
english: He said to them, “When you pray, say, ‘Our Father in heaven, may your name be kept holy. May your Kingdom come. May your will be done on earth, as it is in heaven.

kikuyu: Buddeena keenya kan guyyuma guyyaa, guyyuma guyyaan nuu kenni.
english: Give us day by day our daily bread.

kikuyu: Akkuma nus warra cubbuu nutti hojjetaniif dhiifnu sana atis cubbuu keenya nuu dhiisi; qoramatti nu hin galchin.’ ”
english: Forgive us our sins, for we ourselves also forgive everyone who is indebted to us. Bring us not into temptation, but deliver us from the evil one.’”

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Mee isin keessaa namni tokko michuu qaba haa jennuu; innis halkan walakkaa michuu isaa sana bira dhaqee, ‘Yaa michuu ko, mee buddeena sadii naa liqeessi;
english: He said to them, “Which of you, if you go to a friend at midnight and tell him, ‘Friend, lend me three loaves of bread,

kikuyu: michuun koo kan karaa deemu tokko natti goreeraatii; anis waanan dhiʼeessuuf tokko illee hin qabu’ haa jedhu.
english: for a friend of mine has come to me from a journey, and I have nothing to set before him,’

kikuyu: Namichi mana keessaa sunis, ‘Na hin rakkisin; balballi cufameera; ijoolleen koos na wajjin siree irra jiru; ani kaʼee waan tokko illee siif kennuu hin dandaʼu’ jedhaanii?
english: and he from within will answer and say, ‘Don’t bother me. The door is now shut, and my children are with me in bed. I can’t get up and give it to you’?

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; sababii inni michuu isaa taʼeef jedhee kaʼee buddeena sana isaaf kennuu baatu illee, sababii ija jabina namicha sanaatiif jedhee kaʼee waan isa barbaachisu hunda ni kennaaf.
english: I tell you, although he will not rise and give it to him because he is his friend, yet because of his persistence, he will get up and give him as many as he needs.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu ani isinittin hima: Kadhadhaa, isiniif ni kennamaa; barbaadaa, ni argattuu; rurrukutaa, balballi isiniif ni banamaa.
english: “I tell you, keep asking, and it will be given you. Keep seeking, and you will find. Keep knocking, and it will be opened to you.

kikuyu: Namni kadhatu hundi ni argataatii; namni barbaadu ni argata; nama rurrukutuufis balballi ni banama.
english: For everyone who asks receives. He who seeks finds. To him who knocks it will be opened.

kikuyu: “Yaa abbootii, isin keessaa namni yoo ilmi isaa qurxummii isa kadhate, qooda qurxummii bofa kennuuf eenyu?
english: “Which of you fathers, if your son asks for bread, will give him a stone? Or if he asks for a fish, he won’t give him a snake instead of a fish, will he?

kikuyu: Yookaan namni yoo ilmi isaa hanqaaquu isa kadhate torbaanqabaa kennuuf eenyu?
english: Or if he asks for an egg, he won’t give him a scorpion, will he?

kikuyu: Erga isin warri hamoon iyyuu kennaa gaarii ijoollee keessaniif kennuu beektanii, Abbaan keessan inni samii irraa immoo hammam caalchisee warra isa kadhataniif Hafuura Qulqulluu haa kennuu ree!”
english: If you then, being evil, know how to give good gifts to your children, how much more will your heavenly Father give the Holy Spirit to those who ask him?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis hafuura hamaa arrab-didaa taʼe tokko baasaa ture. Yommuu hafuurri hamaan sun baʼetti arrab-didaan sun ni dubbate; namoonnis ni dinqifatan.
english: He was casting out a demon, and it was mute. When the demon had gone out, the mute man spoke; and the multitudes marveled.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa namoonni tokko tokko garuu, “Inni Biʼeelzebuuliin, hangafa hafuurota hamootiin hafuurota hamoo baasaa jira” jedhan.
english: But some of them said, “He casts out demons by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons.”

kikuyu: Warri kaan immoo mallattoo samii irraa isa gaafachuudhaan isa qoran.
english: Others, testing him, sought from him a sign from heaven.

kikuyu: Yesuusis yaada isaanii beekee akkana jedheen; “Mootummaan gargar of qoodu kam iyyuu ni diigama; manni gargar of qoodus ni jiga.
english: But he, knowing their thoughts, said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. A house divided against itself falls.

kikuyu: Seexanni yoo gargar of qoode, mootummaan isaa akkamitti dhaabachuu dandaʼa? Wanni ani akkana jedhuuf sababii isin akka waan ani Biʼeelzebuuliin hafuurota hamoo baasuu dubbattaniif.
english: If Satan also is divided against himself, how will his kingdom stand? For you say that I cast out demons by Beelzebul.

kikuyu: Egaa yoo ani Biʼeelzebuuliin hafuurota hamoo baasee, ilmaan keessan immoo maaliin baasu ree? Kanaafuu isaan abbootii murtii isinitti taʼu.
english: But if I cast out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your children cast them out? Therefore they will be your judges.

kikuyu: Garuu ani quba Waaqaatiin hafuurota hamoo baasa taanaan, yoos mootummaan Waaqaa isinitti dhufeera.
english: But if I by God’s finger cast out demons, then God’s Kingdom has come to you.

kikuyu: “Yommuu namni jabaan guutummaatti miʼa lolaa hidhate tokko mana isaa eeggatutti, qabeenyi isaa nagaadhaan taaʼaaf.
english: “When the strong man, fully armed, guards his own dwelling, his goods are safe.

kikuyu: Garuu namni jabinaan isa caalu tokko yoo lolee isa moʼate, miʼa lolaa kan namichi sun amanate sana isa irraa fudhatee boojuu isaas qoqqooda.
english: But when someone stronger attacks him and overcomes him, he takes from him his whole armor in which he trusted, and divides his plunder.

kikuyu: “Namni na wajjin hin jirre kam iyyuu naan morma; namni na wajjin walitti hin qabne kam iyyuus ni bittinneessa.
english: “He who is not with me is against me. He who doesn’t gather with me scatters.

kikuyu: “Hafuurri xuraaʼaan yommuu nama keessaa baʼutti, boqonnaa barbaacha lafa gogaakeessa joora; garuu hin argatu. Innis, ‘Mana koo isa ani keessaa baʼe sanatti nan deebiʼa’ jedha.
english: The unclean spirit, when he has gone out of the man, passes through dry places, seeking rest; and finding none, he says, ‘I will turn back to my house from which I came out.’

kikuyu: Yommuu achi gaʼuttis manicha haramee qulqulleeffamee argata.
english: When he returns, he finds it swept and put in order.

kikuyu: Ergasiis dhaqee hafuurota biraa torba kanneen isa caalaa hamoo taʼan fudhatee dhufa; isaanis itti galanii achi jiraatu. Haalli namicha sanaa kan dhumaa isa jalqabaa caalaa hammaata.”
english: Then he goes and takes seven other spirits more evil than himself, and they enter in and dwell there. The last state of that man becomes worse than the first.”

kikuyu: Utuu Yesuus waan kana dubbachaa jiruu, dubartiin tokko namoota gidduudhaa sagalee ishee ol fudhattee, “Garaan si baate, harmi ati hootes eebbifamaa dha” jette.
english: It came to pass, as he said these things, a certain woman out of the multitude lifted up her voice and said to him, “Blessed is the womb that bore you, and the breasts which nursed you!”

kikuyu: Inni garuu deebisee, “Kana caalaa iyyuu, warri dubbii Waaqaa dhagaʼanii ajajamaniif eebbifamoo dha” jedhe.
english: But he said, “On the contrary, blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.”

kikuyu: Akkuma baayʼinni namootaa dabalameen Yesuus akkana jedhe; “Dhaloonni kun dhaloota hamaa dha. Inni mallattoo barbaada; garuu mallattoo Yoonaas malee mallattoon tokko iyyuu isaaf hin kennamu.
english: When the multitudes were gathering together to him, he began to say, “This is an evil generation. It seeks after a sign. No sign will be given to it but the sign of Jonah the prophet.

kikuyu: Akkuma Yoonaas mallattoo saba Nanawwee ture sana, Ilmi Namaas mallattoo dhaloota kanaa ni taʼaatii.
english: For even as Jonah became a sign to the Ninevites, so the Son of Man will also be to this generation.

kikuyu: Mootittiin kibbaa guyyaa murtiitti namoota dhaloota kanaa wajjin kaatee isaanitti murti; isheen ogummaa Solomoon dhagaʼuuf jettee daarii lafaatii dhufteetii. Kunoo kan Solomoonin caalu as jira.
english: The Queen of the South will rise up in the judgment with the men of this generation and will condemn them, for she came from the ends of the earth to hear the wisdom of Solomon; and behold, one greater than Solomon is here.

kikuyu: Namoonni Nanawwee guyyaa murtiitti dhaloota kana wajjin kaʼanii itti muru; isaan lallaba Yoonaasiin qalbii jijjiirrataniitii; kunoo kan Yoonaasin caalu as jira.
english: The men of Nineveh will stand up in the judgment with this generation, and will condemn it, for they repented at the preaching of Jonah; and behold, one greater than Jonah is here.

kikuyu: “Namni kam iyyuu ibsaa qabsiisee iddoo hin mulʼanne yookaan gombisaa jala hin kaaʼu. Qooda kanaa akka warri ol seenan ifa isaa arganiif baattuu isaa irra kaaʼu.
english: “No one, when he has lit a lamp, puts it in a cellar or under a basket, but on a stand, that those who come in may see the light.

kikuyu: Iji kee ibsaa dhagna keetii ti. Iji kee fayyaa taanaan, dhagni kee guutuun ifaan guutama. Yoo iji kee fayyaa hin taʼin garuu dhagni kees dukkanaan guutama.
english: The lamp of the body is the eye. Therefore when your eye is good, your whole body is also full of light; but when it is evil, your body also is full of darkness.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka ifni si keessaa dukkana hin taaneef of eeggadhu.
english: Therefore see whether the light that is in you isn’t darkness.

kikuyu: Egaa yoo dhagni kee hundinuu ifaan guutame, yoo kutaan tokko iyyuu dukkana hin qabaatin, akkuma waan ifni ibsaa tokkoo ifa isaatiin siif ibsuutti dhagni kee guutummaatti ifa ni qabaata.”
english: If therefore your whole body is full of light, having no part dark, it will be wholly full of light, as when the lamp with its bright shining gives you light.”

kikuyu: Akkuma Yesuus haasaa isaa fixateen Fariisota keessaa namichi tokko akka Yesuus isa wajjin nyaata nyaatuuf mana isaatti isa waame; Yesuusis ol seenee maaddiitti dhiʼaate.
english: Now as he spoke, a certain Pharisee asked him to dine with him. He went in and sat at the table.

kikuyu: Fariisichi garuu akka Yesuus nyaataan dura hin dhiqatin argee dinqisiifate.
english: When the Pharisee saw it, he marveled that he had not first washed himself before dinner.

kikuyu: Gooftaanis akkana isaan jedhe; “Isin Fariisonni duuba xoofootii fi caabii ni qulqulleessitu; keessi keessan garuu saamichaa fi hamminaan guutameera.
english: The Lord said to him, “Now you Pharisees cleanse the outside of the cup and of the platter, but your inward part is full of extortion and wickedness.

kikuyu: Yaa namoota gowwoota! Inni duuba isaa uume sun keessa isaa immoo hin uumnee?
english: You foolish ones, didn’t he who made the outside make the inside also?

kikuyu: Isin garuu waan xoofoo fi caabii keessa jiru hiyyeeyyiif kennaa; yoos wanni hundinuu isinii qulqullaaʼaa.
english: But give for gifts to the needy those things which are within, and behold, all things will be clean to you.

kikuyu: “Fariisota nana isiniif wayyoo! Isin insilaala, cilaaddaamaa fi biqiltuu gosa hundaa kudhan keessaa tokko Waaqaaf ni kennitu; murtii qajeelaa fi jaalala Waaqaa garuu ni tuffattu. Silaa utuu isa duraa hin dhiisin isa booddee hojii irra oolchuu qabdu ture.
english: But woe to you Pharisees! For you tithe mint and rue and every herb, but you bypass justice and God’s love. You ought to have done these, and not to have left the other undone.

kikuyu: “Yaa Fariisota, isiniif wayyoo! Isin manneen sagadaa keessatti taaʼumsa ulfinaa, gabaa keessattis nagaa gaafatamuu jaallattu.
english: Woe to you Pharisees! For you love the best seats in the synagogues and the greetings in the marketplaces.

kikuyu: “Isin sababii awwaala mallattoo hin qabne kan namoonni utuu hin beekin irra deeman fakkaattaniif isinii wayyoo!”
english: Woe to you, scribes and Pharisees, hypocrites! For you are like hidden graves, and the men who walk over them don’t know it.”

kikuyu: Hayyoota seeraa keessaas tokko deebisee, “Yaa Barsiisaa, ati yommuu waan kana jettutti nuus arrabsaa jirta!” jedheen.
english: One of the lawyers answered him, “Teacher, in saying this you insult us also.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Hayyoota seeraa, isiniifis wayyoo! Isin baʼaa namni baachuu hin dandeenye isaanitti feetu; ofii keessanii garuu isaan gargaaruudhaaf qubaan illee hin tuqxan.
english: He said, “Woe to you lawyers also! For you load men with burdens that are difficult to carry, and you yourselves won’t even lift one finger to help carry those burdens.

kikuyu: “Isiniif wayyoo! Isin raajotaaf awwaala ijaartuutii; kan isaan ajjeeses abbootuma keessan.
english: Woe to you! For you build the tombs of the prophets, and your fathers killed them.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isin akka waanuma abbootiin keessan hojjetan sana deeggartan dhugaa baatu; isaan raajota ajjeesan; isin immoo awwaala raajotaa ijaartu.
english: So you testify and consent to the works of your fathers. For they killed them, and you build their tombs.

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf Waaqni ogummaa isaatiin, ‘Ani raajotaa fi ergamoota isaanittin erga; namoonni sunis isaan keessaa tokko tokko ni ajjeesu; kaan immoo ni ariʼatu’ jedhe.
english: Therefore also the wisdom of God said, ‘I will send to them prophets and apostles; and some of them they will kill and persecute,

kikuyu: Kanaaf dhaloonni kun dhiiga raajota hundaa kan uumama addunyaatii jalqabee dhangalaʼetti ni gaafatama;
english: that the blood of all the prophets, which was shed from the foundation of the world, may be required of this generation,

kikuyu: dhiiga Abeel irraa jalqabee hamma dhiiga Zakkaariyaas isa iddoo aarsaatii fi mana qulqullummaa gidduutti ajjeefame sanaatti ni gaafatama. Eeyyee ani isinittin hima; dhaloonni kun waan kana hundumatti ni gaafatama.
english: from the blood of Abel to the blood of Zachariah, who perished between the altar and the sanctuary.’ Yes, I tell you, it will be required of this generation.

kikuyu: “Yaa hayyoota seeraa, isiniif wayyoo! Isin furtuu beekumsaa fudhattaniirtu. Ofii keessanii hin seenne; warra seenaa turanis dhowwitaniirtu.”
english: Woe to you lawyers! For you took away the key of knowledge. You didn’t enter in yourselves, and those who were entering in, you hindered.”

kikuyu: Yommuu Yesuus achii deemetti, Fariisonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa jabeessanii isaan mormuu, akka inni waan baayʼee dubbatuufis isa tuttuquu jalqaban.
english: As he said these things to them, the scribes and the Pharisees began to be terribly angry, and to draw many things out of him,

kikuyu: Waan afaan isaatii baʼuun isa qabuufis eeggachaa turan.
english: lying in wait for him, and seeking to catch him in something he might say, that they might accuse him.

kikuyu: Gidduu sana yommuu tuunni namoota kuma hedduu tokko hamma isaan wal irra ejjetanitti walitti qabametti, Yesuus duraan dursee barattoota isaatiin akkana jechuu jalqabe; “Raacitii Fariisotaa irraa of eeggadhaa; kunis fakkeessitummaa dha.
english: Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he began to tell his disciples first of all, “Beware of the yeast of the Pharisees, which is hypocrisy.

kikuyu: Wanni haguugamee utuu hin mulʼifamin hafu yookaan wanni dhokfamee utuu hin beekamin hafu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: But there is nothing covered up that will not be revealed, nor hidden that will not be known.

kikuyu: Wanni isin dukkana keessatti dubbattan, ifa guyyaatiin dhagaʼama; wanni isin gola keessatti gurratti hasaastanis bantii manaa irraa labsama.
english: Therefore whatever you have said in the darkness will be heard in the light. What you have spoken in the ear in the inner rooms will be proclaimed on the housetops.

kikuyu: “Yaa michoota ko, ani isinittin hima; warra dhagna ajjeesanii ergasii immoo kana caalaa homaa gochuu hin dandeenye hin sodaatinaa.
english: “I tell you, my friends, don’t be afraid of those who kill the body, and after that have no more that they can do.

kikuyu: Ani garuu kan isin sodaachuu qabdan isinittin argisiisa; isa erga ajjeesee booddee gahaannamitti darbachuudhaaf taayitaa qabu sana sodaadhaa; eeyyee, ani isinittin hima; isa sodaadhaa.
english: But I will warn you whom you should fear. Fear him who after he has killed, has power to cast into Gehenna. Yes, I tell you, fear him.

kikuyu: Daaloteen shan saantima lamatti gurguramu mitii? Isaan keessaa garuu tokko iyyuu Waaqni hin irraanfatu.
english: “Aren’t five sparrows sold for two assaria coins? Not one of them is forgotten by God.

kikuyu: Dhugumaanuu rifeensi mataa keessanii hundi lakkaaʼameera. Hin sodaatinaa; isin daalotee hedduu caalaa gatii qabduutii.
english: But the very hairs of your head are all counted. Therefore don’t be afraid. You are of more value than many sparrows.

kikuyu: “Ani isinittin hima; nama fuula namootaa duratti ifaan ifatti dhugaa naa baʼu kamiif iyyuu, Ilmi Namaas fuula ergamoota Waaqaa duratti dhugaa ni baʼa.
english: “I tell you, everyone who confesses me before men, the Son of Man will also confess before the angels of God;

kikuyu: Namni fuula namootaa duratti na ganu kam iyyuu garuu fuula ergamoota Waaqaa duratti ni ganama.
english: but he who denies me in the presence of men will be denied in the presence of God’s angels.

kikuyu: Nama Ilma Namaatiin mormee jecha tokko dubbatu hundaaf ni dhiifama; nama Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan mormee dubbatu kamiif iyyuu garuu hin dhiifamu.
english: Everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but those who blaspheme against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven.

kikuyu: “Yommuu manneen sagadaa, bulchitootaa fi abbootii taayitaa duratti dhiʼeeffamtanitti akkamitti akka falmattan yookaan maal akka jettan hin yaaddaʼinaa.
english: When they bring you before the synagogues, the rulers, and the authorities, don’t be anxious how or what you will answer or what you will say;

kikuyu: Hafuurri Qulqulluun yeruma sana Waan isin jechuu qabdan isin barsiisaatii.”
english: for the Holy Spirit will teach you in that same hour what you must say.”

kikuyu: Tuuta sana keessaa namichi tokko, “Yaa Barsiisaa, akka obboleessi koo dhaala naa hiruuf maaloo itti naa dubbadhu” jedheen.
english: One of the multitude said to him, “Teacher, tell my brother to divide the inheritance with me.”

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu deebisee, “Namana, eenyutu isin gidduutti abbaa murtii yookaan hirtuu dhaalaa na godhe?” jedheen.
english: But he said to him, “Man, who made me a judge or an arbitrator over you?”

kikuyu: Innis, “Ilaalladhaa! Doqnummaa hunda irraas of eegaa; jireenyi nama tokkoo baayʼina qabeenya isaatiin hin murteeffamuutii” jedheen.
english: He said to them, “Beware! Keep yourselves from covetousness, for a man’s life doesn’t consist of the abundance of the things which he possesses.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee fakkeenya kana isaanitti hime; “Lafti qotiisaa namicha sooressa tokkoo midhaan guddaa kenneef.
english: He spoke a parable to them, saying, “The ground of a certain rich man produced abundantly.

kikuyu: Namichi sunis, ‘Ani waan lafan itti midhaan koo galfadhu hin qabneef maal gochuu naa wayya?’ jedhee garaa isaatti yaade.
english: He reasoned within himself, saying, ‘What will I do, because I don’t have room to store my crops?’

kikuyu: “Innis akkana jedhe; ‘Wanni ani godhu kana; gombisaa koo diigee guddaa isaa nan ijaarradha; midhaan koo fi miʼa koo hunda achittin kuufadha.
english: He said, ‘This is what I will do. I will pull down my barns, build bigger ones, and there I will store all my grain and my goods.

kikuyu: Lubbuu kootiinis, “Yaa lubbuu ko, ati waan gaarii hedduu kan waggaa baayʼeef kuufame qabda; boqodhu; nyaadhu; dhugi; gammadis” nan jedha.’
english: I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.”’

kikuyu: “Waaqni garuu, ‘Yaa gowwicha, edanuma lubbuu kee sirraa fudhachuu barbaadu; egaa wanni ati walitti qabatte sun kan eenyuu taʼa?’ jedheen.
english: “But God said to him, ‘You foolish one, tonight your soul is required of you. The things which you have prepared—whose will they be?’

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu namni ofii isaatiif badhaadhummaa kuufatee fuula Waaqaa duratti immoo hin sooromin kam iyyuu akkasuma taʼa.”
english: So is he who lays up treasure for himself, and is not rich toward God.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis barattoota isaatiin akkana jedhe; “Kanaafuu ani isinittin hima; ‘maal nyaanna?’ jettanii waaʼee jireenya keessanii hin yaaddaʼinaa; yookaan ‘maal uffanna?’ jettanii waaʼee dhagna keessanii hin yaaddaʼinaa.
english: He said to his disciples, “Therefore I tell you, don’t be anxious for your life, what you will eat, nor yet for your body, what you will wear.

kikuyu: Jireenyi nyaata caala; dhagnis uffata caalaatii.
english: Life is more than food, and the body is more than clothing.

kikuyu: Mee arraageyyii ilaalaa: Isaan hin facaafatan yookaan hin haammatan; gombisaa yookaan gumbii hin qaban; taʼus Waaqni isaan soora. Isin immoo hammam simbirroota caalaa gatii guddaa qabdu!
english: Consider the ravens: they don’t sow, they don’t reap, they have no warehouse or barn, and God feeds them. How much more valuable are you than birds!

kikuyu: Isin keessaa namni yaaddaʼuudhaan hojjaa isaa irratti dhundhuma tokko dabalachuu dandaʼu eenyu?
english: Which of you by being anxious can add a cubit to his height?

kikuyu: Yoos isin erga waan xinnoo akkasii illee godhachuu hin dandeenye, maaliif waan biraaf yaaddoftu ree?
english: If then you aren’t able to do even the least things, why are you anxious about the rest?

kikuyu: “Daraaraawwan bosonaa akkamitti akka guddatan mee ilaalaa; isaan hin dhamaʼan yookaan hin foʼan. Ani garuu isinittin hima; Solomoon iyyuu ulfina isaa hunda keessatti, akka tokkoo isaaniitti hin uffanne.
english: Consider the lilies, how they grow. They don’t toil, neither do they spin; yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not arrayed like one of these.

kikuyu: Isin yaa warra amantii xinnoo nana! Waaqni erga marga dirree kan harʼa jiruu fi kan bor immoo ibiddatti naqamutti iyyuu akkasitti uffisee, isinitti immoo hammam kana caalaa haa uffisuu ree.
english: But if this is how God clothes the grass in the field, which today exists and tomorrow is cast into the oven, how much more will he clothe you, O you of little faith?

kikuyu: Qalbii keessan waan nyaattan irra yookaan waan dhugdan irra hin kaaʼatinaa; waaʼee isaas hin yaaddaʼinaa.
english: “Don’t seek what you will eat or what you will drink; neither be anxious.

kikuyu: Addunyaan ormootaa waan kana hunda ni barbaaduutii; Abbaan keessan akka wanni kun hundinuu isin barbaachisu ni beeka.
english: For the nations of the world seek after all of these things, but your Father knows that you need these things.

kikuyu: Garuu mootummaa isaa barbaadaa; wanni kun akkasuma isiniif kennama.
english: But seek God’s Kingdom, and all these things will be added to you.

kikuyu: “Isin karra xinnoo nana, hin sodaatinaa; Abbaan keessan mootummaa isinii kennuu jaallateeraatii.
english: “Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.

kikuyu: Waan qabdan gurguraatii hiyyeeyyiif kennaa. Korojoo hin moofofne, qabeenya dhuma hin qabnes samii irratti, iddoo hattuun itti hin dhiʼaannee fi biliinis hin balleessinetti ofii keessaniif kuufadhaa.
english: Sell what you have and give gifts to the needy. Make for yourselves purses which don’t grow old, a treasure in the heavens that doesn’t fail, where no thief approaches and no moth destroys.

kikuyu: Idduma badhaadhummaan keessan jiru sana garaan keessanis jiraatii.
english: For where your treasure is, there will your heart be also.

kikuyu: “Tajaajilaaf hidhadhaatii qophaaʼaa; ibsaa keessanis ibsadhaa;
english: “Let your waist be dressed and your lamps burning.

kikuyu: akkuma namoota yommuu Gooftaan isaanii cidha fuudhaa fi heerumaatii galee balbala dhadhaʼutti dafanii isaaf banuuf jedhanii qophaaʼanii isa eeganii taʼaa.
english: Be like men watching for their lord when he returns from the wedding feast, that when he comes and knocks, they may immediately open to him.

kikuyu: Garboonni gooftaan isaanii yeroo galutti isaanii dammaqanii jiran argu sun eebbifamoo dha; ani dhuguman isinitti hima; inni marxifatee akka isaan nyaataaf taaʼan ni godha; dhufees isaan tajaajila.
english: Blessed are those servants whom the lord will find watching when he comes. Most certainly I tell you that he will dress himself, make them recline, and will come and serve them.

kikuyu: Garboonni gooftaan isaanii halkanicha keessaa kutaa lammaffaatti yookaan kutaa sadaffaatti dhufee akkasuma isaanii dammaqanii jiran isaan argu sun eebbifamoo dha.
english: They will be blessed if he comes in the second or third watch and finds them so.

kikuyu: Garuu waan kana hubadhaa: Abbichi manaa utuu saʼaatii kamitti akka hattuun dhuftu beekee, silaa akka manni isaa cabsamee seenamu itti hin dhiisu ture.
english: But know this, that if the master of the house had known in what hour the thief was coming, he would have watched and not allowed his house to be broken into.

kikuyu: Isinis akkasuma qophaaʼuu qabdu; Ilmi Namaa saʼaatii isin hin eegnetti dhufaatii.”
english: Therefore be ready also, for the Son of Man is coming in an hour that you don’t expect him.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis, “Yaa Gooftaa, ati fakkeenya kana nu qofatti moo nama hundumatti himta?” jedhee gaafate.
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, are you telling this parable to us, or to everybody?”

kikuyu: Gooftaanis akkana jedhee deebise; “Egaa hojii adeemsisaan amanamaa fi ogeessi kan gooftaan isaa akka inni nyaata isaanii yeroo malutti isaanii kennuuf jedhee garboota isaa irratti isa muudu eenyu?
english: The Lord said, “Who then is the faithful and wise steward, whom his lord will set over his household, to give them their portion of food at the right times?

kikuyu: Garbichi gooftaan isaa yommuu deebiʼutti utuu inni akkasuma hojjetuu isa argu sun eebbifamaa dha.
english: Blessed is that servant whom his lord will find doing so when he comes.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguma isinitti nan hima; inni qabeenya isaa hunda irratti isa muuda.
english: Truly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.

kikuyu: Garbichi sun garuu yoo, ‘Gooftaan koo dhufuuf yeroo dheeraa tura’ ofiin jedhee, garboota dhiiraatii fi dubartootaa tumuu jalqabe, yoo nyaatee dhugee machaaʼe,
english: But if that servant says in his heart, ‘My lord delays his coming,’ and begins to beat the menservants and the maidservants, and to eat and drink and to be drunken,

kikuyu: gooftaan garbicha sanaa guyyaa inni isa hin eegnee fi saʼaatii inni hin beeknetti ni dhufa. Innis isa kukkuta; warra hin amanne keessattis isa ramada.
english: then the lord of that servant will come in a day when he isn’t expecting him and in an hour that he doesn’t know, and will cut him in two, and place his portion with the unfaithful.

kikuyu: “Garbichi utuu fedhii gooftaa isaa beekuu hin qophoofne yookaan waan gooftaan isaa barbaadu hin hojjenne sun akka malee tumama.
english: That servant who knew his lord’s will, and didn’t prepare nor do what he wanted, will be beaten with many stripes,

kikuyu: Nama utuu hin beekin waan isa adabamsiisu hojjete garuu adaba salphaatu isa irra gaʼa. Nama wanni baayʼeen itti kenname hunda irraa waan baayʼeetu eegama; nama imaanaan guddaan itti kenname irraa immoo kan caalutu barbaadama.
english: but he who didn’t know, and did things worthy of stripes, will be beaten with few stripes. To whomever much is given, of him will much be required; and to whom much was entrusted, of him more will be asked.

kikuyu: “Ani ibidda lafa irra buusuufin dhufe; utuu inni ammuma iyyuu qabatee ani akkam hawwa!
english: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.

kikuyu: Garuu cuuphaa ani cuuphamu tokkotu jira; hamma inni raawwatamutti ani akka malee nan dhiphadha!
english: But I have a baptism to be baptized with, and how distressed I am until it is accomplished!

kikuyu: Isin waan ani lafa irratti nagaa buusuuf dhufe seetuu? Akkas miti; ani isinittin hima; ani gargar baʼuu fiduufan dhufe malee nagaa buusuuf hin dhufne.
english: Do you think that I have come to give peace on the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.

kikuyu: Siʼachi maatiin nama shan qabu tokko gargar qoodama; namni sadii nama lamatti kaʼa; namni lama immoo nama sadiitti kaʼa.
english: For from now on, there will be five in one house divided, three against two, and two against three.

kikuyu: Abbaan ilmatti, ilmi abbaatti, haati intalatti, intalli haadhatti, amaatiin niitii ilmaatti, niitiin ilmaas amaatii isheetti kaʼuudhaan gargar baʼu.”
english: They will be divided, father against son, and son against father; mother against daughter, and daughter against her mother; mother-in-law against her daughter-in-law, and daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis tuuta sanaan akkana jedhe; “Isin yommuu duumessa karaa lixa biiftuutiin ol baʼu argitanitti yeruma sana, ‘Bokkaan ni rooba’ jettu; innis ni rooba.
english: He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’ and so it happens.

kikuyu: Yommuu bubbeen kibbaa bubbisutti immoo, ‘Ni hoʼa’ jettu; innis ni hoʼa.
english: When a south wind blows, you say, ‘There will be a scorching heat,’ and it happens.

kikuyu: Fakkeessitoota nana! Isin bifa lafaatii fi samiitiif hiikkaa kennuu ni beektu. Bara ammaa kanaaf immoo hiikkaa kennuu akkamitti wallaaltu?
english: You hypocrites! You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and the sky, but how is it that you don’t interpret this time?

kikuyu: “Isin maaliif ofuma keessanii waan qajeelaa hin murteessine?
english: “Why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right?

kikuyu: Ati yommuu amajaajii kee wajjin gara abbaa murtii dhaqxutti, karuma irratti isaan walitti araaramuu cimsii yaali; yoo kanaa achii amajaajiin kee abbaa seeraatti si geessa; abbaan seeraas dabarsee poolisiitti si kenna; poolisiin immoo mana hidhaatti si darbata.
english: For when you are going with your adversary before the magistrate, try diligently on the way to be released from him, lest perhaps he drag you to the judge, and the judge deliver you to the officer, and the officer throw you into prison.

kikuyu: Ani sitti nan hima; ati hamma saantima ishee dhumaa of irraa baaftutti achii hin baatu.”
english: I tell you, you will by no means get out of there until you have paid the very last penny.”

kikuyu: Yeroo sana namoonni waaʼee warra Galiilaa kanneen Phiilaaxoos dhiiga isaanii aarsaa isaaniitti make sanaa Yesuusitti himan tokko tokko achi turan.
english: Now there were some present at the same time who told him about the Galileans whose blood Pilate had mixed with their sacrifices.

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee akkana jedheen; “Sababiin namoonni Galiilaa kunneen akkas dhiphataniif waan isaan saba Galiilaa kaan hunda irra cubbamoota turaniif seetuu?
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you think that these Galileans were worse sinners than all the other Galileans, because they suffered such things?

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; akkas miti; garuu isinis qalbii jijjiirrachuu baannaan hundi keessan akkasuma baddu.
english: I tell you, no, but unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.

kikuyu: Yookaan namoonni kudha saddeettan gamoon Saliihoom isaan irratti jigee isaan fixe sun warra Yerusaalem keessa jiraatan kaan hunda irra waan yakka hojjetan seetuu?
english: Or those eighteen on whom the tower in Siloam fell and killed them—do you think that they were worse offenders than all the men who dwell in Jerusalem?

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; akkas miti. Garuu isinis qalbii jijjiirrachuu baannaan, hundi keessan akkasuma baddu.”
english: I tell you, no, but, unless you repent, you will all perish in the same way.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee fakkeenya kana dubbate; “Namichi tokko muka harbuu kan iddoo dhaabaa wayinii isaa keessa dhaabame tokko qaba ture; innis muka sana irra ija barbaaduu dhaqee waan tokko illee dhabe.
english: He spoke this parable. “A certain man had a fig tree planted in his vineyard, and he came seeking fruit on it and found none.
