kikuyu: Innis hojjetaa iddoo dhaaba wayinichaatiin, ‘Ani waggaa sadan darban kana muka harbuu kana irraa ija barbaadachuuf jedhee marmaaraan ture; garuu waan tokko illee irraa hin arganne; muriitii gati! Inni maaliif lafa balleessa?’ jedhe.
english: He said to the vine dresser, ‘Behold, these three years I have come looking for fruit on this fig tree, and found none. Cut it down! Why does it waste the soil?’

kikuyu: “Namichi sunis deebisee akkana jedheen; ‘Yaa Gooftaa, anuu naannoo isaa qoteen xaaʼoo itti naqaatii mee wagguma tokko haa turu.
english: He answered, ‘Lord, leave it alone this year also, until I dig around it and fertilize it.

kikuyu: Yoo inni waggaa dhufu ija naqate, gaarii dha! Yoo kanaa achii murtee gatuu dandeessa.’ ”
english: If it bears fruit, fine; but if not, after that, you can cut it down.’”

kikuyu: Yesuus guyyaa Sanbataa tokko manneen sagadaa keessaa isa tokkotti barsiisaa ture.
english: He was teaching in one of the synagogues on the Sabbath day.

kikuyu: Dubartiin hafuurri hamaan waggaa kudha saddeeti dugda ishee goophesse tokkos achi turte; isheenis waan gad gogdeef gonkumaa ol jechuu hin dandeessu turte.
english: Behold, there was a woman who had a spirit of infirmity eighteen years. She was bent over and could in no way straighten herself up.

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu ishee argetti ofitti ishee waamee, “Dubartii nana, ati dhukkuba kee irraa fayyiteerta” jedheen,
english: When Jesus saw her, he called her and said to her, “Woman, you are freed from your infirmity.”

kikuyu: Innis harka isaa ishee irra kaaʼe; isheenis yeruma sana ol jettee Waaqa galateeffatte.
english: He laid his hands on her, and immediately she stood up straight and glorified God.

kikuyu: Bulchaan mana sagadaas sababii Yesuus guyyaa Sanbataatiin nama fayyiseef aaree namootaan, “Guyyaan hojii jaʼatu jira; guyyoota sana kottaatii fayyifamaa malee guyyaa Sanbataa hin dhufinaa” jedhe.
english: The ruler of the synagogue, being indignant because Jesus had healed on the Sabbath, said to the multitude, “There are six days in which men ought to work. Therefore come on those days and be healed, and not on the Sabbath day!”

kikuyu: Gooftaan immoo akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Yaa fakkeessitoota! Isin keessaa namni guyyaa Sanbataa qotiyyoo isaa yookaan harree isaa dallaa keessaa hiikee bishaan obaasuu hin geessine jiraa?
english: Therefore the Lord answered him, “You hypocrites! Doesn’t each one of you free his ox or his donkey from the stall on the Sabbath and lead him away to water?

kikuyu: Yoos dubartiin kun intalli Abrahaam kan Seexanni waggaa kudha saddeeti guutuu hidhee ture kun guyyaa Sanbataatiin hidhaa kana irraa hiikamuun isheef hin maluu?”
english: Ought not this woman, being a daughter of Abraham whom Satan had bound eighteen long years, be freed from this bondage on the Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: Yommuu inni waan kana dubbatetti mormitoonni isaa hundi ni qaanaʼan; namoonni garuu hojjiiwwan dinqii kanneen inni hojjechaa ture hundatti ni gammadan.
english: As he said these things, all his adversaries were disappointed; and all the multitude rejoiced for all the glorious things that were done by him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee gaafate; “Mootummaan Waaqaa maal fakkaata? Anis maaliinan wal isa fakkeessa?
english: He said, “What is God’s Kingdom like? To what shall I compare it?

kikuyu: Mootummaan Waaqaa sanyii sanaaficaa kan namni tokko fuudhee lafa qotiisaa isaa keessatti facaase fakkaata. Sanyiin sunis guddatee muka taʼe; simbirroonnis dameewwan isaa irra jiraatan.”
english: It is like a grain of mustard seed which a man took and put in his own garden. It grew and became a large tree, and the birds of the sky live in its branches.”

kikuyu: Amma illee akkana jedhee gaafate; “Ani mootummaa Waaqaa maaliinan wal fakkeessa?
english: Again he said, “To what shall I compare God’s Kingdom?

kikuyu: Inni raacitii dubartiin tokko fuutee hamma inni guutummaatti bukeessutti daakuu safartuu sadiitti makte fakkaata.”
english: It is like yeast, which a woman took and hid in three measures of flour, until it was all leavened.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis utuu gara Yerusaalem deemuu namoota barsiisaa magaalaawwanii fi gandoota keessa darbaa ture.
english: He went on his way through cities and villages, teaching, and traveling on to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Namichi tokkos, “Yaa Gooftaa warri fayyifaman namoota muraasa qofaa?” jedhee isa gaafate. Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe;
english: One said to him, “Lord, are they few who are saved?” He said to them,

kikuyu: “Balbala dhiphaadhaan seenuuf tattaaffadhaa; ani isinittin hima; namoonni baayʼeen seenuu ni yaaluutii; garuu hin dandaʼan.
english: “Strive to enter in by the narrow door, for many, I tell you, will seek to enter in and will not be able.

kikuyu: Abbaan mana sanaa takkaa kaʼee balbalicha cufannaan isin ala dhaabatanii balbala rurrukutaa, ‘Yaa Gooftaa balbala nuu bani’ jettanii kadhattu. “Inni garuu deebisee, ‘Ani isin hin beeku yookaan eessaa akka dhuftan hin beeku’ isiniin jedha.
english: When once the master of the house has risen up and has shut the door, and you begin to stand outside and to knock at the door, saying, ‘Lord, Lord, open to us!’ then he will answer and tell you, ‘I don’t know you or where you come from.’

kikuyu: “Isin immoo, ‘Nu si wajjin nyaannee dhugneerra; atis daandii keenya irratti barsiifteerta’ jettuun.
english: Then you will begin to say, ‘We ate and drank in your presence, and you taught in our streets.’

kikuyu: “Inni garuu deebisee, ‘Ani isin hin beeku yookaan eessaa akka dhuftan hin beeku. Isin warri hammina hojjettan hundinuu na biraa badaa!’ jedha.
english: He will say, ‘I tell you, I don’t know where you come from. Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity.’

kikuyu: “Yommuu Abrahaam, Yisihaaq, Yaaqoobii fi raajota hunda mootummaa Waaqaa keessatti argitanii, ofii keessanii immoo gad darbatamtan, achitti booʼuu fi ilkaan qaruutu taʼa.
english: There will be weeping and gnashing of teeth when you see Abraham, Isaac, Jacob, and all the prophets in God’s Kingdom, and yourselves being thrown outside.

kikuyu: Namoonnis baʼa biiftuutii fi lixa biiftuutii, kaabaa fi kibbaa dhufanii mootummaa Waaqaa keessatti maaddiitti ni dhiʼaatu.
english: They will come from the east, west, north, and south, and will sit down in God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Dhugumaanuu kanneen warra dhumaa taʼan keessaa kanneen warra jalqabaa, kanneen warra jalqabaa taʼan keessaa immoo warra dhumaa taʼan jiru.”
english: Behold, there are some who are last who will be first, and there are some who are first who will be last.”

kikuyu: Yeroo sana Fariisota keessaa namoonni tokko tokko gara Yesuus dhufanii, “Sababii Heroodis si ajjeesuu barbaaduuf asii deemii iddoo biraa dhaqi” jedhaniin.
english: On that same day, some Pharisees came, saying to him, “Get out of here and go away, for Herod wants to kill you.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebise; “Dhaqaatii waangoo sanaan, ‘Kunoo, ani harʼaa fi bori hafuurota hamoo nan baasa; namoota dhukkubsatanis nan fayyisa; guyyaa sadaffaatti immoo hojii koo nan fixadha’ jedhaa.
english: He said to them, “Go and tell that fox, ‘Behold, I cast out demons and perform cures today and tomorrow, and the third day I complete my mission.

kikuyu: Waan fedhe iyyuu taanaan, ani harʼaa fi bori, iftaanis adeemsa koo itti fufuutu naa mala; raajiin Yerusaalemiin alatti duʼuu hin qabuutii!
english: Nevertheless I must go on my way today and tomorrow and the next day, for it can’t be that a prophet would perish outside of Jerusalem.’

kikuyu: “Yaa Yerusaalem, yaa Yerusaalem, ati kan raajota ajjeeftu, warra gara keetti ergamanis kan dhagaadhaan tumtu, akkuma indaanqoon cuucii ishee qoochoo ishee jalatti walitti qabattu sana anis ijoollee kee walitti qabuuf yeroo meeqan hawwe! Isin garuu hin barbaanne.
english: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kills the prophets and stones those who are sent to her! How often I wanted to gather your children together, like a hen gathers her own brood under her wings, and you refused!

kikuyu: Kunoo, manni keessan onee isinii hafa. Ani isinittin hima; isin hamma, ‘Inni maqaa Gooftaatiin dhufu sun eebbifamaa dha’jettanitti lammata na hin argitan.”
english: Behold, your house is left to you desolate. I tell you, you will not see me until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!’”

kikuyu: Guyyaa Sanbataa tokko yommuu Yesuus buddeena nyaachuuf mana Fariisicha beekamaa tokkoo dhaqetti, namoonni xiyyeeffatanii isa ilaalaa turan.
english: When he went into the house of one of the rulers of the Pharisees on a Sabbath to eat bread, they were watching him.

kikuyu: Namichi dhagni isaa dhiitaʼe tokkos fuula isaa dura ture.
english: Behold, a certain man who had dropsy was in front of him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Guyyaa Sanbataatiin nama fayyisuun ni eeyyamama moo hin eeyyamamu?” jedhee Fariisotaa fi hayyoota seeraa gaafate.
english: Jesus, answering, spoke to the lawyers and Pharisees, saying, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu ni calʼisan; innis namicha harkaan qaqqabee fayyisee gad isa lakkise.
english: But they were silent. He took him, and healed him, and let him go.

kikuyu: Innis, “Isin keessaa namni tokko yoo ilma yookaan qotiyyoo guyyaa Sanbataatiin boolla keessa buʼe qabaate, inni yeruma sana harkisee boolla keessaa hin baasuu?” jedhee isaan gaafate.
english: He answered them, “Which of you, if your son or an ox fell into a well, wouldn’t immediately pull him out on a Sabbath day?”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu deebii kennuu hin dandeenye.
english: They couldn’t answer him regarding these things.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu akka keessumoonni sun iddoo ulfinaa filatan hubatetti akkana jedhee fakkeenya kana isaanitti hime;
english: He spoke a parable to those who were invited, when he noticed how they chose the best seats, and said to them,

kikuyu: “Yoo namni tokko cidha fuudhaa fi heerumaatti si waame, iddoo ulfinaa hin taaʼin; tarii namni si caalaa ulfina qabu tokko waamameera taʼaatii.
english: “When you are invited by anyone to a wedding feast, don’t sit in the best seat, since perhaps someone more honorable than you might be invited by him,

kikuyu: Namichi isin lamaanuu waame sun dhufee, ‘Namicha kanaaf kaʼi’ siin jedha; atis qaanoftee dhaqxee lafa iddoo hundumaa gad taʼe teessa.
english: and he who invited both of you would come and tell you, ‘Make room for this person.’ Then you would begin, with shame, to take the lowest place.

kikuyu: Ati garuu yommuu waamamtu akka namichi si waame sun yeroo dhufutti, ‘Yaa michuu koo iddoo ol aanutti hiiqi’ siin jedhuuf dhaqii lafa iddoo hundumaa gad taʼe taaʼi; yoos fuula warra si wajjin maaddiitti dhiʼaatan hundumaa duratti ulfina argattaatii.
english: But when you are invited, go and sit in the lowest place, so that when he who invited you comes, he may tell you, ‘Friend, move up higher.’ Then you will be honored in the presence of all who sit at the table with you.

kikuyu: Namni ol of qabu hundinuu gad qabamaatii; namni gad of qabu hundinuu immoo ol qabama.”
english: For everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, and whoever humbles himself will be exalted.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis namicha isa waame sanaan akkana jedhe; “Ati yommuu laaqana yookaan irbaata qopheessitu michoota kee yookaan obboloota kee, yookaan firoota kee, yookaan olloota kee warra sooreyyii hin waamin; yoo akkas goote isaanis deebisanii si waamu; gatiin kees siif deebifama.
english: He also said to the one who had invited him, “When you make a dinner or a supper, don’t call your friends, nor your brothers, nor your kinsmen, nor rich neighbors, or perhaps they might also return the favor, and pay you back.

kikuyu: Garuu yommuu cidha qopheessitu hiyyeeyyii, naafa, okkolaa fi jaamaa waami.
english: But when you make a feast, ask the poor, the maimed, the lame, or the blind;

kikuyu: Sababii isaan waan siif deebisan hin qabneef ati ni eebbifamta; gatiin kee guyyaa duʼaa kaʼuu qajeeltotaatti siif deebifamaatii.”
english: and you will be blessed, because they don’t have the resources to repay you. For you will be repaid in the resurrection of the righteous.”

kikuyu: Warra isa wajjin maaddiitti dhiʼaatan keessaa namichi tokko yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti Yesuusiin, “Namni mootummaa Waaqaa keessatti maaddiitti dhiʼaatu eebbifamaa dha” jedhe.
english: When one of those who sat at the table with him heard these things, he said to him, “Blessed is he who will feast in God’s Kingdom!”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Namichi tokko cidha guddaa qopheessee keessumoota hedduu affeere.
english: But he said to him, “A certain man made a great supper, and he invited many people.

kikuyu: Namichi sunis saʼaatii nyaataatti akka inni, ‘Kunoo, wanni hundinuu qopheeffameeraatii kottaa’ jedhee warra affeeraman sanatti himuuf garbicha isaa erge.
english: He sent out his servant at supper time to tell those who were invited, ‘Come, for everything is ready now.’

kikuyu: “Garuu isaan hundi bifuma tokkoon sababa dhiʼeeffachuu jalqaban; inni jalqabaa, ‘Ani lafa qotiisaa bitadheera; kanaafuu dhaqeen ilaaluu qabaatii maaloo na hin komatin’ jedheen.
english: They all as one began to make excuses. “The first said to him, ‘I have bought a field, and I must go and see it. Please have me excused.’

kikuyu: “Inni kaan, ‘Ani qotiyyoo cimdii shan bitadheera; isaan leenjisuuf deemuuttin jiraatii, maaloo na hin komatin’ jedheen.
english: “Another said, ‘I have bought five yoke of oxen, and I must go try them out. Please have me excused.’

kikuyu: “Amma illee inni kaan, ‘Ani dhiʼoon niitii fuudhe; kanaafuu dhufuu hin dandaʼu’ jedheen.
english: “Another said, ‘I have married a wife, and therefore I can’t come.’

kikuyu: “Garbichi sunis deebiʼee waan kana gooftaa isaatti hime. Abbaan mana sanaas aaree, ‘Dafii karaa guddaa fi daandii qalʼaa magaalaatti achi baʼiitii hiyyeeyyii, naafa, jaamaa fi okkolaa fidii ol seensis’ jedhee garbicha isaa ajaje.
english: “That servant came, and told his lord these things. Then the master of the house, being angry, said to his servant, ‘Go out quickly into the streets and lanes of the city, and bring in the poor, maimed, blind, and lame.’

kikuyu: “Garbichi sunis, ‘Yaa gooftaa, wanni ati ajajje hundi raawwateera; garuu amma illee iddoon jira’ jedheen.
english: “The servant said, ‘Lord, it is done as you commanded, and there is still room.’

kikuyu: “Gooftichis garbicha isaatiin akkana jedhe; ‘Akka manni koo guutamuuf karaa guddaa fi daandii baadiyyaatti achi baʼiitii akka isaan ol galan dirqisiisi.
english: “The lord said to the servant, ‘Go out into the highways and hedges, and compel them to come in, that my house may be filled.

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; namoota waamaman sana keessaa namni tokko iyyuu maaddii koo irraa afaaniin hin qabu.’ ”
english: For I tell you that none of those men who were invited will taste of my supper. For many are called, but few are chosen.’”

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeen Yesuus wajjin deemaa turan; innis garagalee akkana isaaniin jedhe;
english: Now great multitudes were going with him. He turned and said to them,

kikuyu: “Namni gara koo dhufu kam iyyuu yoo abbaa isaatii fi haadha isaa, niitii isaatii fi ijoollee isaa, obboloota isaatii fi obboleettota isaa akkasumas lubbuu isaa illee hin jibbine inni barataa koo taʼuu hin dandaʼu.
english: “If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and his own life also, he can’t be my disciple.

kikuyu: Namni fannoo ofii isaa baadhatee na duukaa hin buune kam iyyuus barataa koo taʼuu hin dandaʼu.
english: Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross and come after me, can’t be my disciple.

kikuyu: “Mee isin keessaa namni tokko gamoo ijaarrachuu barbaada haa jennuu; namichi sun gamoo sana ijaaree fixuuf horii gaʼaa qabaachuu fi qabaachuu baachuu isaa beekuuf duraan dursee taaʼee gatii isaa hin herregatuu?
english: For which of you, desiring to build a tower, doesn’t first sit down and count the cost, to see if he has enough to complete it?

kikuyu: Yoo kanaa achii yommuu inni hundee kaaʼee fixuu dadhabutti, namoonni argan hundi itti qoosu.
english: Or perhaps, when he has laid a foundation and isn’t able to finish, everyone who sees begins to mock him,

kikuyu: Isaanis, ‘Namichi kun ijaaruu jalqabee fixuu dadhabe’ jedhu.
english: saying, ‘This man began to build and wasn’t able to finish.’

kikuyu: “Yookaan mee mootiin tokko mootii biraa loluu dhaqa haa jennuu; inni mootii loltoota kuma digdamaan isatti dhufu tokko loltoota kuma kudhaniin of irraa loluu dandaʼuu fi dandaʼuu baachuu isaa duraan dursee taaʼee itti hin yaaduu?
english: Or what king, as he goes to encounter another king in war, will not sit down first and consider whether he is able with ten thousand to meet him who comes against him with twenty thousand?

kikuyu: Yoo hin dandeenye immoo utuu mootichi kaan isa irraa fagoo jiruu bakka buʼoota itti ergee akka nagaan buʼu kadhata.
english: Or else, while the other is yet a great way off, he sends an envoy and asks for conditions of peace.

kikuyu: Akkanumas isin keessaa namni waan qabu hunda hin dhiifne kam iyyuu barataa koo taʼuu hin dandaʼu.
english: So therefore, whoever of you who doesn’t renounce all that he has, he can’t be my disciple.

kikuyu: “Soogiddi gaarii dha; garuu yoo inni miʼaa isaa dhabe, miʼaan isaa akkamiin deebifamuu dandaʼa?
english: “Salt is good, but if the salt becomes flat and tasteless, with what do you season it?

kikuyu: Inni biyyoof yookaan tuulaa kosiitiif faayidaa hin qabu; inni gad gatama. “Namni gurra dhagaʼu qabu kam iyyuu haa dhagaʼu.”
english: It is fit neither for the soil nor for the manure pile. It is thrown out. He who has ears to hear, let him hear.”

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko warri qaraxa fuudhanii fi cubbamoonni hundi Yesuusin dhaggeeffachuudhaaf isa biratti walitti qabamaa turan.
english: Now all the tax collectors and sinners were coming close to him to hear him.

kikuyu: Fariisonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa garuu, “Namichi kun cubbamoota simata; isaan wajjinis ni nyaata” jedhanii guunguman.
english: The Pharisees and the scribes murmured, saying, “This man welcomes sinners, and eats with them.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee fakkeenya kana isaanitti hime;
english: He told them this parable:

kikuyu: “Isin keessaa namni hoolota dhibba qabu tokko yoo hoolaan tokko jalaa bade, hoolota sagaltamii sagallan kaan lafa tikaatti dhiisee hamma hoolaa bade sana argatutti kan barbaaduu hin deemne eenyu?
english: “Which of you men, if you had one hundred sheep and lost one of them, wouldn’t leave the ninety-nine in the wilderness and go after the one that was lost, until he found it?

kikuyu: Yommuu argatus gammadee gatiittii isaa irratti baatee,
english: When he has found it, he carries it on his shoulders, rejoicing.

kikuyu: mana isaatti gala. Innis michoota isaatii fi olloota isaa walitti waamee, ‘Ani hoolaa koo kan bade sana argadheeraatii na wajjin gammadaa’ jedha.
english: When he comes home, he calls together his friends and his neighbors, saying to them, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found my sheep which was lost!’

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; sababii qajeeltota qalbii jijjiirrachuun isaan hin barbaachifne sagaltamii sagalii irra sababii cubbamaa qalbii jijjiirratu tokkootiif samii keessatti gammachuun guddaan akkasuma ni taʼa.
english: I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous people who need no repentance.

kikuyu: “Yookaan mee dubartii saantima meetii kudhan qabdu jalaa tokko badeera haa jennuu; isheen ibsaa qabsiifattee, manas hartee hamma saantima sana argatutti jabeessitee hin barbaaddattuu?
english: “Or what woman, if she had ten drachma coins, if she lost one drachma coin, wouldn’t light a lamp, sweep the house, and seek diligently until she found it?

kikuyu: Isheenis yommuu argatutti michoota isheetii fi olloota ishee walitti waamtee, ‘Ani saantima koo kan bade sana argadheeraatii na wajjin gammadaa’ jetti.
english: When she has found it, she calls together her friends and neighbors, saying, ‘Rejoice with me, for I have found the drachma which I had lost!’

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; sababii cubbamaa qalbii jijjiirratu tokkootiif ergamoonni Waaqaa akkasuma ni gammadu.”
english: Even so, I tell you, there is joy in the presence of the angels of God over one sinner repenting.”

kikuyu: Yesuus ittuma fufee akkana jedhe; “Namicha ilmaan lama qabu tokkotu ture.
english: He said, “A certain man had two sons.

kikuyu: Ilmi quxisuun abbaa isaatiin ‘Yaa abbaa ko, qabeenya kee irraa qooda na gaʼu naa kenni’ jedhe. Abbaanis qabeenya isaa lamaan isaaniitiif ni hire.
english: The younger of them said to his father, ‘Father, give me my share of your property.’ So he divided his livelihood between them.

kikuyu: “Ilmi quxisuun sunis utuu hin turin waan qabu hunda walitti qabatee biyya fagoo dhaqe; achittis qabeenya isaa jireenya bashannanuu irratti balleesse.
english: Not many days after, the younger son gathered all of this together and traveled into a far country. There he wasted his property with riotous living.

kikuyu: Erga inni waan hunda fixee booddee beelli hamaan biyya sanatti buʼe; innis rakkachuu jalqabe.
english: When he had spent all of it, there arose a severe famine in that country, and he began to be in need.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu dhaqee lammiiwwan biyyasii keessaa isa tokkotti gale; namichi sunis akka inni booyyee tiksuuf lafa tikaatti isa erge.
english: He went and joined himself to one of the citizens of that country, and he sent him into his fields to feed pigs.

kikuyu: Gurbichis qola booyyeen nyaattu sana nyaatee garaa guutachuu kajeela ture; garuu namni tokko iyyuu waa isatti hin kennu ture.
english: He wanted to fill his belly with the pods that the pigs ate, but no one gave him any.

kikuyu: “Innis yommuu of beeketti akkana jedhe; ‘Tajaajiltoonni mana abbaa kootti qacaraman hammamitu buddeena gaʼee irraa hafu qaba! Ani garuu asitti beelaan nan duʼa.
english: But when he came to himself, he said, ‘How many hired servants of my father’s have bread enough to spare, and I’m dying with hunger!

kikuyu: Ani kaʼeen abbaa kootti deebiʼee akkana jedhaan; “Yaa abbaa ko, ani samii fi sitti cubbuu hojjedheera.
english: I will get up and go to my father, and will tell him, “Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight.

kikuyu: Siʼachi ilma kee jedhamuun naaf hin malu; tajaajiltoota kee keessaa akka isa tokkootti na ilaali.” ’
english: I am no more worthy to be called your son. Make me as one of your hired servants.”’

kikuyu: Innis kaʼee gara abbaa isaa dhaqe. “Garuu utuu inni fagoo jiruu abbaan isaa isa argee akka malee garaa laafeef; gara ilma isaattis fiigee itti marmee dhungate.
english: “He arose and came to his father. But while he was still far off, his father saw him and was moved with compassion, and ran, fell on his neck, and kissed him.

kikuyu: “Gurbichis, ‘Yaa abbaa ko, ani samii fi sitti cubbuu hojjedheera; siʼachi ilma kee jedhamuun naaf hin malu’ jedheen.
english: The son said to him, ‘Father, I have sinned against heaven and in your sight. I am no longer worthy to be called your son.’

kikuyu: “Abbaan isaa garuu garboota isaatiin akkana jedhe; ‘Dafaatii uffata uffata hunda caalu fidaa isatti uffisaa; quba isaatti qubeelaa, miilla isaattis kophee kaaʼaa.
english: “But the father said to his servants, ‘Bring out the best robe and put it on him. Put a ring on his hand and sandals on his feet.

kikuyu: Dibicha gabbataa fidaatii qalaa; haa nyaannuu; haa gammannus.
english: Bring the fattened calf, kill it, and let’s eat and celebrate;

kikuyu: Ilmi koo kun duʼee tureetii; amma immoo jireenyatti deebiʼeeraa. Badees ture; amma immoo argameera.’ Isaanis gammaduu jalqaban.
english: for this, my son, was dead and is alive again. He was lost and is found.’ Then they began to celebrate.

kikuyu: “Yeroo sanatti ilmi inni hangafti lafa qotiisaa ture; innis yeroo dhufee manatti dhiʼaatetti muuziiqaa fi sirba dhagaʼe.
english: “Now his elder son was in the field. As he came near to the house, he heard music and dancing.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu tajaajiltoota keessaa nama tokko waamee waan taʼaa jiru gaafate.
english: He called one of the servants to him and asked what was going on.

kikuyu: Tajaajilaan sunis deebisee, ‘Obboleessi kee galeera; abbaan kees waan ilma isaa nagaa fi fayyaadhaan argateef dibicha gabbataa qale’ jedheen.
english: He said to him, ‘Your brother has come, and your father has killed the fattened calf, because he has received him back safe and healthy.’

kikuyu: “Obboleessi hangafni garuu aaree ol seenuu dide; kanaaf abbaan isaa gad baʼee isa kadhate.
english: But he was angry and would not go in. Therefore his father came out and begged him.

kikuyu: Inni immoo deebisee abbaa isaatiin akkana jedhe; ‘Ilaa ani waggoota kanneen hunda akkuma garbaatti siif hojjechaan ture; ajaja kee illee didee hin beeku. Ati garuu akka ani michoota koo wajjin gammaduuf takkumaa ilmoo reʼee tokko illee naa hin kennine.
english: But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours, but you never gave me a goat, that I might celebrate with my friends.

kikuyu: Garuu ilmi kee inni sagaagaltoota wajjin qabeenya kee balleesse kun deebiʼee manatti gallaan dibicha gabbataa qalteef!’
english: But when this your son came, who has devoured your living with prostitutes, you killed the fattened calf for him.’

kikuyu: “Abbaan isaas akkana jedheen; ‘Yaa ilma koo ati yeroo hunda anuma wajjin jirta; wanni ani qabu hundinuus kanuma kee ti.
english: “He said to him, ‘Son, you are always with me, and all that is mine is yours.

kikuyu: Garuu obboleessi kee inni duʼee ture kun waan jireenyatti deebiʼeef nu gammaduu fi ililchuu qabna. Inni badee ture; amma immoo argameera.’ ”
english: But it was appropriate to celebrate and be glad, for this, your brother, was dead, and is alive again. He was lost, and is found.’”

kikuyu: Yesuus barattoota isaatiin akkana jedhe; “Namicha sooressa nama hojii isaa adeemsisuuf qabu tokkotu ture; akka hojii adeemsisaan sun qabeenya isaa jalaa balleessaa jirus sooressa sanatti himan.
english: He also said to his disciples, “There was a certain rich man who had a manager. An accusation was made to him that this man was wasting his possessions.

kikuyu: Sooressi sunis hojii adeemsisaa sana ofitti waamee, ‘Wanni ani waaʼee kee dhagaʼu kun maalii? Ati siʼachi waan hojii adeemsisaa taʼuu hin dandeenyeef, hojii adeemsisaa turte sana irratti gabaasa naa dhiʼeessi’ jedheen.
english: He called him, and said to him, ‘What is this that I hear about you? Give an accounting of your management, for you can no longer be manager.’

kikuyu: “Hojii adeemsisaan sunis garaa isaa keessatti akkana jedhe; ‘Waan gooftaan koo hojii keessaa na baasuuf, maal naa wayya? Lafa qotuuf humna hin qabu; kadhachuu immoo nan qaanaʼa.
english: “The manager said within himself, ‘What will I do, seeing that my lord is taking away the management position from me? I don’t have strength to dig. I am ashamed to beg.

kikuyu: Akka yeroo ani hojii keessaa ariʼamutti namoonni mana isaaniitti na simataniif waanan godhu anuu beeka.’
english: I know what I will do, so that when I am removed from management, they may receive me into their houses.’

kikuyu: “Innis warra gatiin gooftaa isaa irra jiru tokko tokkoon waamee, isa jalqabaatiin, ‘Idaan gooftaa koo hammamitu sirra jira?’ jedhee gaafate.
english: Calling each one of his lord’s debtors to him, he said to the first, ‘How much do you owe to my lord?’

kikuyu: “Namichis, ‘Zayitii ejersaa hubboo dhibba saddeeti’ jedhee deebise. “Hojii adeemsisaan sunis, ‘Waraqaa walii galtee kee hooʼu; dafii taaʼiitii dhibba afur jedhii barreessi’ jedheen.
english: He said, ‘A hundred batos of oil.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and sit down quickly and write fifty.’

kikuyu: “Isa lammaffaadhaanis, ‘Sirra immoo hammamitu jira?’ jedhee gaafate. “Innis, ‘Qamadii guuboo kuma tokkoo’ jedheen. “Hojii adeemsisaan sunis, ‘Waraqaa walii galtee kee hooʼuutii, 80 jedhii barreessi’ jedheen.
english: Then he said to another, ‘How much do you owe?’ He said, ‘A hundred cors of wheat.’ He said to him, ‘Take your bill, and write eighty.’

kikuyu: “Hojii adeemsisaan hin amanamne sun waan abshaala taʼeef gooftichi isa jaje; namoonni addunyaa kanaa warra akka isaanii wajjin haajaa isaanii guutachuu irratti namoota ifaa caalaa abshaalotaatii.
english: “His lord commended the dishonest manager because he had done wisely, for the children of this world are, in their own generation, wiser than the children of the light.

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; akka isaan yeroo qabeenyi sun dhumutti mana bara baraatti isin simataniif qabeenya addunyaatiin ofii keessaniif michoota horadhaa.
english: I tell you, make for yourselves friends by means of unrighteous mammon, so that when you fail, they may receive you into the eternal tents.

kikuyu: “Namni waan xinnootti amanamu kam iyyuu waan baayʼeettis ni amanama; namni waan xinnootti hin amanamne kam iyyuu immoo waan baayʼeettis hin amanamu.
english: He who is faithful in a very little is faithful also in much. He who is dishonest in a very little is also dishonest in much.

kikuyu: Yoos isin yoo qabeenya addunyaatti hin amanamne, qabeenya dhugaatti immoo eenyutu isin amana ree?
english: If therefore you have not been faithful in the unrighteous mammon, who will commit to your trust the true riches?

kikuyu: Yoo isin qabeenya nama biraa irratti hin amanamne, qabeenya mataa keessanii immoo eenyutu isinii kenna ree?
english: If you have not been faithful in that which is another’s, who will give you that which is your own?

kikuyu: “Namni gooftota lama tajaajiluu dandaʼu tokko iyyuu hin jiru. Isa tokko jibbitee isa kaan jaallattaatii; yookaan isa tokkoof of kennitee isa kaan immoo tuffatta. Isinis Waaqaa fi maallaqa tajaajiluu hin dandeessan.”
english: No servant can serve two masters, for either he will hate the one and love the other; or else he will hold to one and despise the other. You aren’t able to serve God and Mammon.”

kikuyu: Fariisonni warri maallaqa jaallatan waan kana hunda dhagaʼanii Yesuusitti qoosan.
english: The Pharisees, who were lovers of money, also heard all these things, and they scoffed at him.

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isin warra fuula namootaa duratti qajeeltota of gootanii dha; Waaqni garuu garaa keessan beeka. Wanni nama biratti akka malee kabajamu fuula Waaqaa duratti jibbisiisaadhaatii.
english: He said to them, “You are those who justify yourselves in the sight of men, but God knows your hearts. For that which is exalted among men is an abomination in the sight of God.

kikuyu: “Seerrii fi raajonni hamma Yohannisitti labsaman. Yeroo sanaa jalqabee wangeelli mootummaa Waaqaa lallabamaa jira; namni hundinuus itti galuuf wal dhiiba.
english: “The law and the prophets were until John. From that time the Good News of God’s Kingdom is preached, and everyone is forcing his way into it.

kikuyu: Seera keessaa tuqaan hundumaa gadii dhabamuu irra samii fi lafti dhabamuutu salphata.
english: But it is easier for heaven and earth to pass away than for one tiny stroke of a pen in the law to fall.

kikuyu: “Namni niitii isaa hiikee dubartii biraa fuudhu kam iyyuu ejja raawwata; namni dubartii dhirsa ishee hiikte fuudhus ejja raawwata.
english: “Everyone who divorces his wife and marries another commits adultery. He who marries one who is divorced from a husband commits adultery.

kikuyu: “Namicha sooressa uffata dhiilgee haphii kan quncee talbaa irraa hojjetame uffatee, guyyuma guyyaan qananiidhaan jiraatu tokkotu ture.
english: “Now there was a certain rich man, and he was clothed in purple and fine linen, living in luxury every day.

kikuyu: Karra isaa dura immoo namichi hiyyeessi Alʼaazaar jedhamu kan dhagni isaa hundi mammadaaʼe tokko ciisaa ture.
english: A certain beggar, named Lazarus, was taken to his gate, full of sores,

kikuyu: Innis hambaa maaddii sooressa sanaa irraa harcaʼu illee nyaachuu ni kajeela ture; saroonni iyyuu dhufanii madaa isaa arraabu turan.
english: and desiring to be fed with the crumbs that fell from the rich man’s table. Yes, even the dogs came and licked his sores.

kikuyu: “Gaaf tokko namichi hiyyeessi sun duunaan ergamoonni Waaqaa isa baatanii gara bobaa Abrahaamitti isa geessan; sooressichis duʼee awwaalame.
english: The beggar died, and he was carried away by the angels to Abraham’s bosom. The rich man also died and was buried.

kikuyu: Utuu Siiʼool keessatti dhiphachaa jiruus ol milʼatee Abrahaamin fagootti, Alʼaazaarin immoo bobaa Abrahaam keessatti arge.
english: In Hades, he lifted up his eyes, being in torment, and saw Abraham far off, and Lazarus at his bosom.

kikuyu: Innis iyyee, ‘Yaa Abbaa koo Abrahaam, waan ani ibidda kana keessatti dhiphachaa jiruuf maaloo garaa naa laafiitii akka inni fiixee quba isaa bishaan keessa cuuphee arraba koo naa qabbaneessuuf Alʼaazaarin naa ergi’ jedheen.
english: He cried and said, ‘Father Abraham, have mercy on me, and send Lazarus, that he may dip the tip of his finger in water and cool my tongue! For I am in anguish in this flame.’

kikuyu: “Abrahaam garuu akkana jedhee deebise; ‘Yaa ilma ko, ati bara jireenya keetiitti waan gaarii akka argatte, Alʼaazaar immoo waan hamaa akka argate yaadadhu; amma garuu asitti isatti toleera; ati immoo dhiphachaa jirta.
english: “But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way, bad things. But here he is now comforted and you are in anguish.

kikuyu: Waan kana hunda irrattis, akka warri nu biraa gara keessan dhufuu barbaadan dhufuu hin dandeenyeef yookaan akka warri isin biraa gara keenyatti ceʼuu hin dandeenyeef nuu fi isin gidduu boolla guddaatu jira.’
english: Besides all this, between us and you there is a great gulf fixed, that those who want to pass from here to you are not able, and that no one may cross over from there to us.’

kikuyu: “Dureessi sunis akkana jedhee deebise; ‘Yoos yaa Abbaa, akka ati gara mana abbaa kootti Alʼaazaarin naa ergitu sin kadhadha;
english: “He said, ‘I ask you therefore, father, that you would send him to my father’s house—

kikuyu: ani obboloota shan qabaatii; akka isaanis iddoo dhiphinaa kana hin dhufneef inni dhaqee isaan haa akeekkachiisu.’
english: for I have five brothers—that he may testify to them, so they won’t also come into this place of torment.’

kikuyu: “Abrahaam garuu, ‘Isaan Musee fi raajota qabu; isaanuma haa dhagaʼan’ jedhe.
english: “But Abraham said to him, ‘They have Moses and the prophets. Let them listen to them.’

kikuyu: “Dureessichis, ‘Akkas miti; yaa abbaa koo Abrahaam; yoo warra duʼan keessaa namni tokko gara isaanii dhaqe garuu, isaan qalbii ni jijjiirratu’ jedheen.
english: “He said, ‘No, father Abraham, but if one goes to them from the dead, they will repent.’

kikuyu: “Abrahaamis, ‘Isaan yoo Musee fi raajota hin dhageenye, yoo namni tokko warra duʼan keessaa kaʼe illee hin amanan’ jedheen.”
english: “He said to him, ‘If they don’t listen to Moses and the prophets, neither will they be persuaded if one rises from the dead.’”

kikuyu: Yesuus barattoota isaatiin akkana jedhe; “Wantoonni akka namoonni gufatan godhan dhufuun hin oolu; garuu nama wantoonni kunneen karaa isaatiin dhufaniif wayyoo!
english: He said to the disciples, “It is impossible that no occasions of stumbling should come, but woe to him through whom they come!

kikuyu: Inni warra xixinnaa kanneen keessaa tokko illee gufachiisuu mannaa dhagaan daakuu morma isaatti hidhamee galaanatti utuu darbatamee isaa wayya ture.
english: It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck, and he were thrown into the sea, rather than that he should cause one of these little ones to stumble.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu of eeggadhaa. “Yoo obboleessi kee yakka sitti hojjete isa ifadhu; yoo inni qalbii jijjiirrate immoo dhiifama godhiif.
english: Be careful. If your brother sins against you, rebuke him. If he repents, forgive him.

kikuyu: Yoo inni guyyaa tokkotti yeroo torba cubbuu sitti hojjetee yeroo torbanuu sitti deebiʼee, ‘Ani qalbii nan jijjiirradha’ siin jedhe dhiifama godhiif.”
english: If he sins against you seven times in the day, and seven times returns, saying, ‘I repent,’ you shall forgive him.”

kikuyu: Ergamoonnis Gooftaadhaan, “Amantii keenya nuu guddisi” jedhan.
english: The apostles said to the Lord, “Increase our faith.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebise; “Isin amantii xinnoo hamma ija sanaaficaa illee yoo qabaattan, muka qilxuu kanaan, ‘Buqqaʼiitii galaana keessa dhaabami!’ jechuu dandeessu; innis isinii ajajama.
english: The Lord said, “If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you would tell this sycamore tree, ‘Be uprooted and be planted in the sea,’ and it would obey you.

kikuyu: “Isin keessaa namni tokko garbicha lafa qotu yookaan kan hoolota tiksu qaba haa jennu; inni yeroo garbichi sun alaa galutti, ‘Dafii kottuutii taaʼii waa nyaadhu’ jedhaanii?
english: But who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa inni garbicha sanaan, ‘Irbaata naa qopheessi; hamma ani nyaadhee dhugutti marxifadhuutii na tajaajili; sana booddee ati ni nyaattaa; ni dhugdas’ hin jedhuunii?
english: Wouldn’t he rather tell him, ‘Prepare my supper, clothe yourself properly, and serve me while I eat and drink. Afterward you shall eat and drink’?

kikuyu: Namichis sababii garbichi sun waan ajajame sana raawwateef isa ni galateeffataa?
english: Does he thank that servant because he did the things that were commanded? I think not.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isinis yommuu waan ajajamtan hunda raawwattanitti, ‘Nu garboota faayidaa hin qabnee dha; waanuma hojjechuu qabnu qofa hojjenne’ jedhaa.”
english: Even so you also, when you have done all the things that are commanded you, say, ‘We are unworthy servants. We have done our duty.’”

kikuyu: Yesuus utuu Yerusaalem dhaquu Samaariyaa fi Galiilaa gidduu darbaa ture.
english: As he was on his way to Jerusalem, he was passing along the borders of Samaria and Galilee.

kikuyu: Akkuma inni ganda tokko seeneenis, namoonni lamxaaʼan kudhan isatti dhufan. Isaanis fagoo dhadhaabatanii,
english: As he entered into a certain village, ten men who were lepers met him, who stood at a distance.

kikuyu: sagalee isaanii ol fudhatanii, “Yesuus yaa Gooftaa, nuu naʼi!” jedhan.
english: They lifted up their voices, saying, “Jesus, Master, have mercy on us!”

kikuyu: Innis yommuu isaan argetti, “Dhaqaatii lubootatti of argisiisaa!” jedheen; isaanis utuma deemaa jiranuu qulqullaaʼan.
english: When he saw them, he said to them, “Go and show yourselves to the priests.” As they went, they were cleansed.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaas inni tokko yommuu fayyuu isaa argetti sagalee guddaadhaan Waaqaaf ulfina kennaa deebiʼee dhufe.
english: One of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, glorifying God with a loud voice.

kikuyu: Adda isaatiinis miilla Yesuus irratti gombifamee isa galateeffate; innis nama Samaariyaa ture.
english: He fell on his face at Jesus’ feet, giving him thanks; and he was a Samaritan.

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee gaafate; “Kurnanuu qulqullaaʼaniiru mitii? Yoos warri hafan sagallan eessa dhaqan?
english: Jesus answered, “Weren’t the ten cleansed? But where are the nine?

kikuyu: Nama ormaa kana malee namni deebiʼee Waaqaaf galata galchu tokko iyyuu hin argamnee?”
english: Were there none found who returned to give glory to God, except this foreigner?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Kaʼii deemi; amantiin kee si fayyiseeraatii” jedheen.
english: Then he said to him, “Get up, and go your way. Your faith has healed you.”

kikuyu: Fariisonnis mootummaan Waaqaa yoom akka dhufu Yesuusin gaafatan; innis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Mootummaan Waaqaa namatti mulʼachaa hin dhufu;
english: Being asked by the Pharisees when God’s Kingdom would come, he answered them, “God’s Kingdom doesn’t come with observation;

kikuyu: namoonnis, ‘Mootummaan Waaqaa kunoo as jira’ yookaan ‘Kuunnoo achi jira’ hin jedhan; mootummaan Waaqaa isin gidduu jiraatii.”
english: neither will they say, ‘Look, here!’ or, ‘Look, there!’ for behold, God’s Kingdom is within you.”

kikuyu: Innis barattoota isaatiin akkana jedhe; “Yeroon isin itti guyyoota Ilma Namaa keessaa isa tokko arguu hawwitan ni dhufa; garuu hin argitan.
english: He said to the disciples, “The days will come when you will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, and you will not see it.

kikuyu: Namoonni, ‘Inni kuunnoo achi jira!’ yookaan ‘Kunoo as jira’ isiniin jedhu; isin garuu hin dhaqinaa; isaan duukaas hin buʼinaa.
english: They will tell you, ‘Look, here!’ or ‘Look, there!’ Don’t go away or follow after them,

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa guyyaa isaatti akkuma balaqqeessi balaqqeessaʼee gama tokkoo hamma gama kaaniitti samii ibsuu ni taʼaatii.
english: for as the lightning, when it flashes out of one part under the sky, shines to another part under the sky, so will the Son of Man be in his day.

kikuyu: Inni garuu duraan dursee akka malee dhiphachuu fi dhaloota kanaan tuffatamuu qaba.
english: But first, he must suffer many things and be rejected by this generation.

kikuyu: “Akkuma bara Nohi taʼe sana, yeroo Ilma Namaattis akkasuma ni taʼa.
english: As it was in the days of Noah, even so it will also be in the days of the Son of Man.

kikuyu: Hamma gaafa Nohi doonii seeneetti namoonni nyaachaa, dhugaa, fuudhaa, heerumaas turan. Bishaan badiisaas dhufee hunda isaanii balleesse.
english: They ate, they drank, they married, and they were given in marriage until the day that Noah entered into the ship, and the flood came and destroyed them all.

kikuyu: “Bara Looxis akkasuma ture; namoonni nyaachaa, dhugaa, bitachaa, gurgurachaa, biqiltuu dhaabbachaa, manas ijaarrachaa turan.
english: Likewise, even as it was in the days of Lot: they ate, they drank, they bought, they sold, they planted, they built;

kikuyu: Guyyaa Looxi Sodoomii baʼetti garuu ibiddii fi dinyiin samii irraa roobee hunda isaanii balleesse.
english: but in the day that Lot went out from Sodom, it rained fire and sulfur from the sky and destroyed them all.

kikuyu: “Guyyaa Ilmi Namaa mulʼatuttis akkasuma taʼa.
english: It will be the same way in the day that the Son of Man is revealed.

kikuyu: Guyyaa sana namni bantii manaa irra jiru kan mana keessaa miʼa qabu miʼa sana fudhachuuf gad buʼuu hin malu. Akkasuma immoo namni lafa qotiisaa keessa jiru tokko iyyuu waan tokkoof illee manatti hin deebiʼin.
english: In that day, he who will be on the housetop and his goods in the house, let him not go down to take them away. Let him who is in the field likewise not turn back.

kikuyu: Niitii Looxi yaadadhaa!
english: Remember Lot’s wife!

kikuyu: Namni lubbuu isaa eeggachuu yaalu kam iyyuu lubbuu isaa ni dhaba; namni lubbuu isaa dhabu kam iyyuu lubbuu isaa ni turfata.
english: Whoever seeks to save his life loses it, but whoever loses his life preserves it.

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; halkan sana namoonni lama siree tokko irra ni rafu; inni tokko ni fudhatama; kaan immoo ni hafa.
english: I tell you, in that night there will be two people in one bed. One will be taken and the other will be left.

kikuyu: Dubartoonni lama walii wajjin midhaan daaku; isheen tokko ni fudhatamti; kaan immoo ni hafti. [
english: There will be two grinding grain together. One will be taken and the other will be left.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Yaa Gooftaa, eessatti?” jedhanii gaafatan. Innis, “Iddoo raqni jirutti gogocorroowwan walitti qabamu” jedhee deebiseef.
english: They, answering, asked him, “Where, Lord?” He said to them, “Where the body is, there the vultures will also be gathered together.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akka isaan yeroo hunda kadhachuu qabanii fi akka isaan abdii hin kutanne isaan barsiisuuf jedhee fakkeenya tokko barattoota isaatti hime.
english: He also spoke a parable to them that they must always pray and not give up,

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhe; “Magaalaa tokko keessa abbaa murtii kan Waaqa hin sodaanne, namas kan hin kabajne tokkotu ture.
english: saying, “There was a judge in a certain city who didn’t fear God and didn’t respect man.

kikuyu: Haati hiyyeessaa tokkos magaalaa sana keessa turte; isheenis, ‘Diina koo irratti murtii qajeelaa naa kenni’ jettee isatti deddeebiʼaa turte.
english: A widow was in that city, and she often came to him, saying, ‘Defend me from my adversary!’

kikuyu: “Innis yeroo gabaabaaf didee ture; ergasii garuu akkana jedhee garaa isaatti yaade; ‘Ani yoon Waaqa hin sodaanne illee, yoon namas hin kabajne illee,
english: He wouldn’t for a while; but afterward he said to himself, ‘Though I neither fear God nor respect man,

kikuyu: sababii niitiin kun deddeebitee na rakkiftuuf murtii qajeelaa nan kennaaf; yoo kanaa achii deddeebitee na dadhabsiifti.’ ”
english: yet because this widow bothers me, I will defend her, or else she will wear me out by her continual coming.’”

kikuyu: Gooftaanis akkana jedhe; “Egaa waan abbichii murtii dabaan sun jedhu dhagaʼaa;
english: The Lord said, “Listen to what the unrighteous judge says.

kikuyu: Waaqni immoo filatamtoota isaa warra halkanii guyyaa gara isaatti iyyataniif murtii qajeelaa hin kennuu? Isaan duraa tursaa ree?
english: Won’t God avenge his chosen ones who are crying out to him day and night, and yet he exercises patience with them?

kikuyu: Ani isinittin hima; inni dafee murtii qajeelaa kennaaf; garuu Ilmi Namaa gaafa dhufu lafa irratti amantii ni argataa?”
english: I tell you that he will avenge them quickly. Nevertheless, when the Son of Man comes, will he find faith on the earth?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis namoota qajeelummaa ofiitti amananii warra kaan immoo tuffatanitti akkana jedhee fakkeenya kana hime.
english: He also spoke this parable to certain people who were convinced of their own righteousness, and who despised all others:

kikuyu: “Namoonni lama Waaqa kadhachuuf gara mana qulqullummaatti ol baʼan; isaanis Fariisicha tokkoo fi nama qaraxa walitti qabu tokko turan.
english: “Two men went up into the temple to pray; one was a Pharisee, and the other was a tax collector.

kikuyu: Fariisichi kaʼee dhaabatee, waaʼee mataa isaa akkana jedhee kadhate; ‘Yaa Waaqayyo, ani akka namoota kaanii jechuunis akka saamtotaa, jalʼootaa fi sagaagaltootaa keessumattuu waan akka namicha qaraxa walitti qabu kanaa hin taʼiniif sin galateeffadha.
english: The Pharisee stood and prayed by himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men: extortionists, unrighteous, adulterers, or even like this tax collector.

kikuyu: Ani torbanitti yeroo lama nan sooma; waanan argadhu hundumaa irraas harka kudhan keessaa tokko nan kenna.’
english: I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’

kikuyu: “Namichi qaraxa walitti qabu sun garuu fagoo dhaabate, qoma isaa dhadhaʼaa, ‘Yaa Waaqayyo, ani nama cubbamaadhaatii naa naʼi!’ jedhe malee ija isaatiin illee ol jedhee gara samii hin ilaalle.
english: But the tax collector, standing far away, wouldn’t even lift up his eyes to heaven, but beat his chest, saying, ‘God, be merciful to me, a sinner!’

kikuyu: “Ani isinittin hima; namichi kun namicha duraa irra fuula Waaqaa duratti qajeelaa taʼee mana isaatti gale. Namni ol of qabu hundinuu gad qabamaatii; namni gad of qabu garuu ol qabama.”
english: I tell you, this man went down to his house justified rather than the other; for everyone who exalts himself will be humbled, but he who humbles himself will be exalted.”

kikuyu: Namoonni akka inni harka isaan irra kaaʼuuf daaʼimmanis Yesuusitti fidaa turan. Barattoonni garuu yommuu waan kana arganitti isaan ifatan.
english: They were also bringing their babies to him, that he might touch them. But when the disciples saw it, they rebuked them.

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu ijoollee sana ofitti waamee akkana jedhe; “Ijoolleen xixinnoon gara koo haa dhufaniitii hin dhowwinaa; mootummaan Waaqaa kan warra akkanaatii.
english: Jesus summoned them, saying, “Allow the little children to come to me, and don’t hinder them, for God’s Kingdom belongs to such as these.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; namni akkuma ijoolleetti mootummaa Waaqaa hin simanne kam iyyuu gonkumaa itti hin galu.”
english: Most certainly, I tell you, whoever doesn’t receive God’s Kingdom like a little child, he will in no way enter into it.”

kikuyu: Bulchaan tokko, “Yaa Barsiisaa gaarii, ani jireenya bara baraa dhaaluuf maal gochuun qaba?” jedhee isa gaafate.
english: A certain ruler asked him, saying, “Good Teacher, what shall I do to inherit eternal life?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Ati maaliif gaarii naan jetta? Waaqa tokkicha malee gaariin hin jiru.
english: Jesus asked him, “Why do you call me good? No one is good, except one: God.

kikuyu: Ati ajajawwan ni beekta; ‘Hin ejjin; hin ajjeesin; hin hatin; sobaan dhugaa hin baʼin; abbaa keetii fi haadha keetiif ulfina kenni.’”
english: You know the commandments: ‘Don’t commit adultery,’ ‘Don’t murder,’ ‘Don’t steal,’ ‘Don’t give false testimony,’ ‘Honor your father and your mother.’”

kikuyu: Namichis, “Ani ijoollummaa kootii jalqabee ajajawwan kanneen hunda eegeera” jedhe.
english: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti, “Amma illee waan tokkotu si duraa hirʼata; waan qabdu hunda gurgurii hiyyeeyyiif kenni; samii keessatti badhaadhummaa ni qabaattaa. Ergasii kottuu na duukaa buʼi” jedheen.
english: When Jesus heard these things, he said to him, “You still lack one thing. Sell all that you have and distribute it to the poor. Then you will have treasure in heaven; then come, follow me.”

kikuyu: Inni yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti baayʼee gadde; akka malee sooressa tureetii.
english: But when he heard these things, he became very sad, for he was very rich.

kikuyu: Yesuusis isa ilaalee akkana jedhe; “Mootummaa Waaqaatti galuun sooreyyiif akkam rakkisaa dha!
english: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!

kikuyu: Dhugumaan namni sooressi mootummaa Waaqaatti galuu irra qaawwa lilmoo keessa baʼuutu gaalaaf salphata.”
english: For it is easier for a camel to enter in through a needle’s eye than for a rich man to enter into God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Warri waan kana dhagaʼanis, “Yoos eenyutu fayyuu dandaʼa ree?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: Those who heard it said, “Then who can be saved?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Wanni namaaf hin dandaʼamne, Waaqaaf ni dandaʼama” jedhee deebise.
english: But he said, “The things which are impossible with men are possible with God.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis, “Kunoo, nu waan qabnu hunda dhiifnee si duukaa buuneerra” jedheen.
english: Peter said, “Look, we have left everything and followed you.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; namni sababii mootummaa Waaqaatiif jedhee mana yookaan niitii yookaan obboloota yookaan haadhaa fi abbaa yookaan ijoollee dhiisee,
english: He said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, there is no one who has left house, or wife, or brothers, or parents, or children, for God’s Kingdom’s sake,

kikuyu: bara kana keessa dachaa baayʼee, bara dhufuuf jiru keessa immoo jireenya bara baraa utuu hin argatin hafu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.”
english: who will not receive many times more in this time, and in the world to come, eternal life.”

kikuyu: Yesuus warra kudha lamaan kophaatti baasee akkana jedheen; “Kunoo nu Yerusaalemitti ol baʼaa jirra; wanni raajonni waaʼee Ilma Namaa barreessan hundinuus ni raawwatama.
english: He took the twelve aside and said to them, “Behold, we are going up to Jerusalem, and all the things that are written through the prophets concerning the Son of Man will be completed.

kikuyu: Inni dabarfamee Namoota Ormaatti ni kennama. Isaanis isatti qoosu; isa arrabsu; isatti tufu; isa garafu; isa ajjeesus.
english: For he will be delivered up to the Gentiles, will be mocked, treated shamefully, and spit on.

kikuyu: Innis guyyaa sadaffaatti duʼaa ni kaʼa.”
english: They will scourge and kill him. On the third day, he will rise again.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni garuu waan kana hunda keessaa tokko illee hin hubanne; hiikkaan isaas isaan duraa dhokfamee ture. Inni maal akka dubbachaa tures isaaniif hin galle.
english: They understood none of these things. This saying was hidden from them, and they didn’t understand the things that were said.

kikuyu: Yeroo Yesuus Yerikootti dhiʼaatetti, namichi jaamaan tokko qarqara karaa taaʼee kadhachaa ture.
english: As he came near Jericho, a certain blind man sat by the road, begging.

kikuyu: Innis akka tuunni namootaa karaa sana darbaa jiru dhageenyaan, waan taʼaa ture gaafate.
english: Hearing a multitude going by, he asked what this meant.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Yesuus nama Naazreetitu asiin darbaa jira” jedhanii isatti himan.
english: They told him that Jesus of Nazareth was passing by.

kikuyu: Innis, “Yesuus, yaa ilma Daawit, na maari!” jedhee iyye.
english: He cried out, “Jesus, you son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Namoonni fuula dura deemaa turanis akka inni calʼisuuf isa ifatan; inni garuu, “Yaa ilma Daawit na maari!” jedhee ittuma caalchisee iyye.
english: Those who led the way rebuked him, that he should be quiet; but he cried out all the more, “You son of David, have mercy on me!”

kikuyu: Yesuusis dhaabatee akka isaan namicha gara isaa fidan ajaje. Yommuu inni gara isaatti dhiʼaatetti Yesuus akkana jedhee isa gaafate;
english: Standing still, Jesus commanded him to be brought to him. When he had come near, he asked him,

kikuyu: “Akka ani maal siif godhu barbaadda?” Namichis, “Yaa Gooftaa, ani arguun barbaada” jedhee deebise.
english: “What do you want me to do?” He said, “Lord, that I may see again.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Argi; amantiin kee si fayyiseeraa” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “Receive your sight. Your faith has healed you.”

kikuyu: Innis yeruma sana argee Waaqa jajachaa Yesuus duukaa buʼe. Namoonni hundinuus yommuu waan kana arganitti Waaqa jajan.
english: Immediately he received his sight and followed him, glorifying God. All the people, when they saw it, praised God.

kikuyu: Yesuus Yerikoo seenee achi keessa darbaa ture.
english: He entered and was passing through Jericho.

kikuyu: Namichi Zakkewoos jedhamu tokkos achi ture; innis hangafa warra qaraxa walitti qabaniitii fi sooressa ture.
english: There was a man named Zacchaeus. He was a chief tax collector, and he was rich.

kikuyu: Innis Yesuus nama akkamii akka taʼe arguu barbaade; garuu gabaabaa waan tureef, sababii baayʼina namootaatiif isa arguu hin dandeenye.
english: He was trying to see who Jesus was, and couldn’t because of the crowd, because he was short.

kikuyu: Yesuus waan karaa sana irra darbaa tureef, Zakkewoos isa arguuf jedhee fiigee dura darbee muka qilxuu tokko yaabe.
english: He ran on ahead and climbed up into a sycamore tree to see him, for he was going to pass that way.

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu iddoo sana gaʼetti ol milʼatee, “Yaa Zakkewoos, harʼa mana kee ooluun narra jiraatii dafii gad buʼi” jedheen.
english: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and saw him, and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down, for today I must stay at your house.”

kikuyu: Innis yommusuma gad buʼee gammachuudhaan isa simate.
english: He hurried, came down, and received him joyfully.

kikuyu: Namoonni hundinuu yommuu waan kana arganitti, “Inni keessummaa ‘Nama cubbamaa’ taʼuu dhaqe!” jedhanii guungumuu jalqaban.
english: When they saw it, they all murmured, saying, “He has gone in to lodge with a man who is a sinner.”

kikuyu: Zakkewoos garuu kaʼee dhaabatee Gooftaadhaan, “Yaa Gooftaa kunoo, ani walakkaa qabeenya koo hiyyeeyyiif nan kenna; ani yoon nama tokko illee gowwoomsee saamee jiraadhe, waanan fudhadhe sana harka afur godhee nan deebisa” jedhe.
english: Zacchaeus stood and said to the Lord, “Behold, Lord, half of my goods I give to the poor. If I have wrongfully exacted anything of anyone, I restore four times as much.”

kikuyu: Yesuus deebisee akkana jedheen; “Namichi kunis waan ilma Abrahaam taʼeef, harʼa fayyinni mana kanaaf dhufeera.
english: Jesus said to him, “Today, salvation has come to this house, because he also is a son of Abraham.

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa isa bade barbaaduu fi fayyisuudhaaf dhufeetii.”
english: For the Son of Man came to seek and to save that which was lost.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis utuma isaan waan kana dhagaʼaa jiranuu itti fufee, fakkeenya tokko isaanitti hime; kanas sababii inni Yerusaalemitti dhiʼaatee fi sababii namoonni waan mootummaan Waaqaa yeruma sana mulʼatu seʼaniif dubbate.
english: As they heard these things, he went on and told a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and they supposed that God’s Kingdom would be revealed immediately.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhe; “Namichi sanyii mootii tokko muudamee mootii taʼee deebiʼuuf biyya fagoo dhaqe.
english: He said therefore, “A certain nobleman went into a far country to receive for himself a kingdom and to return.

kikuyu: Namichi sunis garboota isaa keessaa nama kudhan waamee, ‘Hamma ani deebiʼutti maallaqa kanaan daldalaa’ jedhee minnaanii kudhan isaanitti kenne.
english: He called ten servants of his and gave them ten mina coins, and told them, ‘Conduct business until I come.’

kikuyu: “Namoonni biyya isaa garuu isa jibbanii, ‘Akka namichi kun nurratti mootii taʼu hin feenu!’ jedhanii bakka buʼoota isaanii isa duubaan ergatan.
english: But his citizens hated him, and sent an envoy after him, saying, ‘We don’t want this man to reign over us.’

kikuyu: “Innis erga muudamee mootii taʼee deebiʼee booddee garboonni inni maallaqa itti kennee ture sun ittiin daldalanii maal akka argatan beekuuf jedhee nama itti ergee isaan waamsise.
english: “When he had come back again, having received the kingdom, he commanded these servants, to whom he had given the money, to be called to him, that he might know what they had gained by conducting business.

kikuyu: “Garbichi jalqabaa dhufee, ‘Yaa Gooftaa, minnaaniin kee minnaanii gara biraa kudhan dhaleera’ jedheen.
english: The first came before him, saying, ‘Lord, your mina has made ten more minas.’

kikuyu: “Gooftaan isaas deebisee, ‘Yaa garbicha gaarii, ati waan gaarii hojjette. Sababii ati waan akka malee xinnoo irratti amanamaa taateef, magaalaa kudhan irratti taayitaa qabaadhu’ jedheen.
english: “He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have authority over ten cities.’

kikuyu: “Garbichi lammaffaanis dhufee, ‘Yaa Gooftaa, minnaaniin kee minnaanii gara biraa shan dhaleera’ jedheen.
english: “The second came, saying, ‘Your mina, Lord, has made five minas.’

kikuyu: “Gooftaan isaas deebisee, ‘Atis magaalaa shan irratti moʼi’ jedheen.
english: “So he said to him, ‘And you are to be over five cities.’

kikuyu: “Inni sadaffaan immoo dhufee akkana jedhe; ‘Yaa Gooftaa, minnaaniin kee kunoo ti; ani huccuudhaan maree dhokseen ture.
english: Another came, saying, ‘Lord, behold, your mina, which I kept laid away in a handkerchief,

kikuyu: Ati gara jabeessa waan taateef ani sin sodaadhe; ati waan hin kaaʼatin fudhatta; waan hin facaasinis haammatta.’
english: for I feared you, because you are an exacting man. You take up that which you didn’t lay down, and reap that which you didn’t sow.’

kikuyu: “Gooftaan isaas deebisee akkana jedhe; ‘Yaa garbicha hamaa nana; ani dubbuma afaan keetiitiin sittin mura; ati akka ani nama dabaa waan hin kaaʼatin fudhatu, waan hin facaasinis haammatu taʼe beekta mitii?
english: “He said to him, ‘Out of your own mouth I will judge you, you wicked servant! You knew that I am an exacting man, taking up that which I didn’t lay down and reaping that which I didn’t sow.

kikuyu: Yoos akka ani yommuun deebiʼutti dhala isaa wajjin fudhadhuuf maaliif maallaqa koo mana baankii naa hin kaaʼin ree?’
english: Then why didn’t you deposit my money in the bank, and at my coming, I might have earned interest on it?’

kikuyu: “Gooftichis warra achi dhadhaabataniin, ‘Minnaanii sana isa harkaa fuudhaatii namicha minnaanii kudhan qabuuf kennaa’ jedhe.
english: He said to those who stood by, ‘Take the mina away from him and give it to him who has the ten minas.’

kikuyu: “Isaanis deebisanii, ‘Yaa Gooftaa, inni duraanuu minnaanii kudhan qaba’ jedhaniin.
english: “They said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten minas!’

kikuyu: “Inni immoo deebisee akkana jedhe; ‘Ani isinittin hima; kan qabu hundaafuu itti dabalamee ni kennama; kan hin qabne garuu wanni inni qabu iyyuu irraa fudhatama;
english: ‘For I tell you that to everyone who has, will more be given; but from him who doesn’t have, even that which he has will be taken away from him.

kikuyu: diinota koo kanneen akka ani isaan irratti mootii taʼu hin barbaadin immoo as fidaatii fuula koo duratti isaan gogorraʼaa.’ ”
english: But bring those enemies of mine who didn’t want me to reign over them here, and kill them before me.’”

kikuyu: Yesuus erga waan kana dubbatee booddee Yerusaalemitti ol baʼuuf isaan dura deemaa ture.
english: Having said these things, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Innis akkuma Beetfaagee fi Biitaaniyaa kanneen tulluu Gaara Ejersaa jedhamu biraa sanatti dhiʼaateen barattoota isaa keessaa lama erge;
english: When he came near to Bethsphage and Bethany, at the mountain that is called Olivet, he sent two of his disciples,

kikuyu: akkanas isaaniin jedhe; “Gara ganda fuula keessan dura jiru sanaa dhaqaa; akkuma achi seentaniinis, ilmoo harree kan namni tokko iyyuu takkumaa hin yaabbatin tokko achitti hidhamee jiru ni argattu. Isa hiikaatii as fidaa.
english: saying, “Go your way into the village on the other side, in which, as you enter, you will find a colt tied, which no man has ever sat upon. Untie it and bring it.

kikuyu: Yoo namni tokko iyyuu, ‘Isin maaliif hiiktu?’ jedhee isin gaafate, ‘Gooftaatu isa barbaada’ jedhaa.”
english: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it?’ say to him: ‘The Lord needs it.’”

kikuyu: Warri ergamanis dhaqanii waan hunda akkuma inni isaanitti himetti argatan.
english: Those who were sent went away and found things just as he had told them.

kikuyu: Utuu isaan ilmoo harree sana hiikaa jiranuus warri harree sanaa, “Ilmoo harree kana maaliif hiiktu?” jedhanii isaan gaafatan.
english: As they were untying the colt, its owners said to them, “Why are you untying the colt?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Gooftaatu isa barbaada” jedhanii deebisan.
english: They said, “The Lord needs it.”

kikuyu: Ilmoo harree sanas Yesuusitti fidan; uffata isaaniis harree sana irra buusan; Yesuusinis irra teessisan.
english: Then they brought it to Jesus. They threw their cloaks on the colt and sat Jesus on them.

kikuyu: Utuu inni deemuus namoonni uffata isaanii karaa irra afan.
english: As he went, they spread their cloaks on the road.

kikuyu: Yeroo inni daandii Tulluu Ejersaa irraa gad buʼutti dhiʼaatettis, barattoonni hundi hojii dinqii arganii turan hundatti gammadanii, sagalee guddaan akkana jedhanii Waaqa galateeffachuu jalqaban.
english: As he was now getting near, at the descent of the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to rejoice and praise God with a loud voice for all the mighty works which they had seen,

kikuyu: “Mootiin maqaa Gooftaatiin dhufu eebbifamaa dha!” “Nagaan samii irratti, ulfinnis ol gubbaatti!”
english: saying, “Blessed is the King who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest!”

kikuyu: Namoota achi turan keessaas Fariisonni tokko tokko Yesuusiin, “Yaa Barsiisaa, barattoota kee ifadhu!” jedhan.
english: Some of the Pharisees from the multitude said to him, “Teacher, rebuke your disciples!”

kikuyu: Innis deebisee, “Ani isinittin hima; yoo isaan calʼisan illee dhagoonni ni iyyu” jedheen.
english: He answered them, “I tell you that if these were silent, the stones would cry out.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu Yerusaalemitti dhiʼaatee magaalattii argetti ni booʼeef;
english: When he came near, he saw the city and wept over it,

kikuyu: akkanas jedhe; “Utuu atumti waan harʼa nagaa siif kennu beektee gaarii ture! Amma garuu ija kee duraa dhokfameera.
english: saying, “If you, even you, had known today the things which belong to your peace! But now, they are hidden from your eyes.

kikuyu: Guyyoonni itti diinonni kee koobii sitti ijaaranii, si marsanii, karaa hundaanis baʼuu si dhowwan sitti ni dhufuutii.
english: For the days will come on you when your enemies will throw up a barricade against you, surround you, hem you in on every side,

kikuyu: Diinonni siʼii fi ijoollee kee warra dallaa kee keessa jiraatan biyyootti maku. Isaan dhagaa tokko dhagaa kaan irratti hin dhiisan; ati yeroo itti Waaqni gara kee dhufu hin beekneetii.”
english: and will dash you and your children within you to the ground. They will not leave in you one stone on another, because you didn’t know the time of your visitation.”

kikuyu: Yesuus mana qulqullummaa seenee warra gurgurachaa turan ariʼuu jalqabe.
english: He entered into the temple and began to drive out those who bought and sold in it,

kikuyu: Innis, “ ‘Manni koo mana kadhannaa taʼa’ jedhamee barreeffameera; isin garuu ‘Holqa saamtotaa’ gootaniirtu” isaaniin jedhe.
english: saying to them, “It is written, ‘My house is a house of prayer,’ but you have made it a ‘den of robbers’!”

kikuyu: Guyyuma guyyaanis mana qulqullummaa keessatti barsiisaa ture; luboonni hangafoonni, barsiistonni seeraatii fi dura buʼoonni sabaa garuu isa ajjeesuudhaaf jabeessanii barbaadaa turan.
english: He was teaching daily in the temple, but the chief priests, the scribes, and the leading men among the people sought to destroy him.

kikuyu: Taʼus isaan karaa ittiin isa ajjeesan hin arganne; namoonni hundinuu yaada tokkoon waan inni dubbate dhaggeeffachaa turaniitii.
english: They couldn’t find what they might do, for all the people hung on to every word that he said.

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko utuu Yesuus mana qulqullummaa keessatti namoota barsiisuu, utuu wangeelas lallabuu luboonni hangafoonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa maanguddoota wajjin gara isaa dhufan.
english: On one of those days, as he was teaching the people in the temple and preaching the Good News, the priests and scribes came to him with the elders.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Ati akka taayitaa maaliitiin waan kana hojjettu nutti himi. Eenyutu taayitaa kana siif kenne” jedhan.
english: They asked him, “Tell us: by what authority do you do these things? Or who is giving you this authority?”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebise; “Anis gaaffii tokkon isin gaafadha. Isin immoo natti himaa:
english: He answered them, “I also will ask you one question. Tell me:

kikuyu: Cuuphaan Yohannis samii irraa dhufe moo nama biraa dhufe?”
english: the baptism of John, was it from heaven, or from men?”

kikuyu: Isaanis waliin mariʼatanii akkana jedhan; “Yoo nu, ‘Samii irraa dhufe’ jenne inni immoo, ‘Isin maaliif isa hin amanin ree?’ jedhee nu gaafata.
english: They reasoned with themselves, saying, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will say, ‘Why didn’t you believe him?’

kikuyu: Yoo nu, ‘Nama biraa dhufe’ jenne garuu namoonni hundinuu akka Yohannis raajii taʼe waan amananiif dhagaadhaan nu tumu.”
english: But if we say, ‘From men,’ all the people will stone us, for they are persuaded that John was a prophet.”

kikuyu: Kanaaf isaan, “Inni eessaa akka dhufe nu hin beeknu” jedhan.
english: They answered that they didn’t know where it was from.

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Anis taayitaa maaliitiin akkan waan kana hojjedhu isinitti hin himu” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to them, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I do these things.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee fakkeenya kana namootatti himuu jalqabe; “Namichi tokko iddoo dhaabaa wayinii irra wayinii dhaabbatee, qonnaan bultootatti kiraa kennatee biyya fagoo dhaqee yeroo dheeraa ture.
english: He began to tell the people this parable: “A man planted a vineyard and rented it out to some farmers, and went into another country for a long time.

kikuyu: Innis yeroo midhaan walitti qabamutti akka isaan ija iddoo dhaabaa wayinii irraa waa kennaniif garbicha tokko qottuuwwan sanatti ergate. Qottuuwwan sun garuu tumanii harka duwwaa of irraa isa deebisan.
english: At the proper season, he sent a servant to the farmers to collect his share of the fruit of the vineyard. But the farmers beat him and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Innis garbicha biraa ergate; isaan garuu isas tumanii, qaanessaniis harka duwwaa of irraa isa deebisan.
english: He sent yet another servant, and they also beat him and treated him shamefully, and sent him away empty.

kikuyu: Amma illee garbicha sadaffaa ergate; isaan immoo isas madeessanii gad isa darbatan.
english: He sent yet a third, and they also wounded him and threw him out.

kikuyu: “Ergasii abbichi iddoo dhaabaa wayinii, ‘Maal gochuu naa wayya? Kaʼeen ilma koo jaallatamaa itti erga; tarii isa ni kabaju taʼaatii’ jedhe.
english: The lord of the vineyard said, ‘What shall I do? I will send my beloved son. It may be that seeing him, they will respect him.’

kikuyu: “Qottoonni sun garuu yommuu isa arganitti, ‘Dhaaltuun isa kana; kottaa isa ajjeefnaa; dhaalli sun kan keenya taʼaatii’ jedhanii walii wajjin dudubbatan.
english: “But when the farmers saw him, they reasoned among themselves, saying, ‘This is the heir. Come, let’s kill him, that the inheritance may be ours.’

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isaan iddoo dhaabaa wayinii keessaa gad baasanii isa ajjeesan. “Egaa abbaan iddoo dhaabaa wayinii sanaa maal isaan godhinna laata?
english: Then they threw him out of the vineyard and killed him. What therefore will the lord of the vineyard do to them?

kikuyu: Inni dhufee qottuuwwan sana ni ajjeesa; iddoo dhaabaa wayinii sanas namoota biraatti kennata.” Namoonnis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti, “Waaqni waan kana hin fidin!” jedhan.
english: He will come and destroy these farmers, and will give the vineyard to others.” When they heard that, they said, “May that never be!”

kikuyu: Yesuusis isaan ilaalee, akkana jedhe; “Egaa inni, “ ‘Dhagaan ijaartonni tuffatan dhagaa golee taʼeera jedhamee barreeffame maal jechuu isaati ree’?
english: But he looked at them and said, “Then what is this that is written, ‘The stone which the builders rejected was made the chief cornerstone’?

kikuyu: Namni dhagaa sana irratti kufu hundinuu caccabee bututa; namni dhagichi irratti kufu kam iyyuu ni daakama.”
english: Everyone who falls on that stone will be broken to pieces, but it will crush whomever it falls on to dust.”

kikuyu: Barsiistonni seeraatii fi luboonni hangafoonni akka inni fakkeenya kana isaaniin mormuun dubbate waan beekaniif yeruma sana isa qabuu barbaadan. Garuu namoota sana sodaatan.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought to lay hands on him that very hour, but they feared the people—for they knew he had spoken this parable against them.

kikuyu: Jarris isa gaadaa, akka isaan waan inni dubbatuun isa qabanii dabarsanii humnaa fi taayitaa bulchaatti isa kennaniif jedhanii basaastota nama nagaa of fakkeessan ergan.
english: They watched him and sent out spies, who pretended to be righteous, that they might trap him in something he said, so as to deliver him up to the power and authority of the governor.

kikuyu: Basaastonni sunis akkana jedhanii isa gaafatan; “Yaa Barsiisaa, nu akka ati waan qajeelaa dubbatuu fi waanuma qajeelaa barsiiftu, akkasumas akka ati dhugaadhaan karaa Waaqaa barsiisuu malee nama wal hin caalchifne beekna.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, we know that you say and teach what is right, and aren’t partial to anyone, but truly teach the way of God.

kikuyu: Qeesaariif gibira kaffaluun eeyyamameera moo hin eeyyamamne?”
english: Is it lawful for us to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?”

kikuyu: Inni garuu haxxummaa isaanii argee akkana isaaniin jedhe;
english: But he perceived their craftiness, and said to them, “Why do you test me?

kikuyu: “Mee diinaarii tokko natti argisiisaa. Fakkii fi katabbii eenyuutu isa irra jira?” Isaanis, “Kan Qeesaar” jedhanii deebisan.
english: Show me a denarius. Whose image and inscription are on it?” They answered, “Caesar’s.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti inni, “Yoos kan Qeesaar Qeesaariif, kan Waaqaa immoo Waaqaaf kennaa” jedheen.
english: He said to them, “Then give to Caesar the things that are Caesar’s, and to God the things that are God’s.”

kikuyu: Isaanis waan inni dubbateen fuula namootaa duratti isa qabuu hin dandeenye. Deebii isaas dinqisiifatanii calʼisan.
english: They weren’t able to trap him in his words before the people. They marveled at his answer and were silent.

kikuyu: Saduuqota duʼaa kaʼuun hin jiru jedhan keessaa tokko tokko waa gaafachuuf jedhanii gara Yesuus dhufan;
english: Some of the Sadducees came to him, those who deny that there is a resurrection.

kikuyu: akkanas jedhan; “Yaa Barsiisaa yoo obboleessi nama tokkoo niitii fuudhee utuu ijoollee hin dhalchin duʼe, akka namichi sun niitii sana dhaalee ijoollee dhalchee obboleessa isaatiif sanyii dabarsu Museen nuu barreesseera.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, Moses wrote to us that if a man’s brother dies having a wife, and he is childless, his brother should take the wife and raise up children for his brother.

kikuyu: Kunoo obboloota torbatu ture. Inni hangafni niitii fuudhee ijoollee malee duʼe.
english: There were therefore seven brothers. The first took a wife, and died childless.

kikuyu: Inni lammaffaan,
english: The second took her as wife, and he died childless.

kikuyu: inni sadaffaanis ishee fuudhan; haaluma wal fakkaatuun isaan torbanuu utuu ijoollee hin dhalchin duʼan.
english: The third took her, and likewise the seven all left no children, and died.

kikuyu: Dhuma irratti dubartittiinis ni duute.
english: Afterward the woman also died.

kikuyu: Egaa guyyaa duʼaa kaʼuutti isheen niitii isa kamii taati? Torban isaanii iyyuu ishee fuudhaniiruutii.”
english: Therefore in the resurrection whose wife of them will she be? For the seven had her as a wife.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Namoonni addunyaa kanaa ni fuudhu; ni heerumus.
english: Jesus said to them, “The children of this age marry and are given in marriage.

kikuyu: Warri addunyaa dhufuuf jiruu fi duʼaa kaʼuu keessatti hirmaachuun isaanii malu garuu hin fuudhan; hin heerumanis.
english: But those who are considered worthy to attain to that age and the resurrection from the dead neither marry nor are given in marriage.

kikuyu: Isaan waan akka ergamootaa taʼaniif deebiʼanii hin duʼan; waan ijoollee duʼaa kaʼuu taʼaniifis isaan ijoollee Waaqaa ti.
english: For they can’t die any more, for they are like the angels and are children of God, being children of the resurrection.

kikuyu: Garuu Museen iyyuu seenaa waaʼee daggalaa keessatti akka warri duʼan duʼaa kaʼan argisiiseera; inni Gooftaadhaan, ‘Waaqa Abrahaam, Waaqa Yisihaaqii fi Waaqa Yaaqoob’jedhee waamaatii.
english: But that the dead are raised, even Moses showed at the bush, when he called the Lord ‘The God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’

kikuyu: Inni Waaqa warra jiraataniiti malee Waaqa warra duʼanii miti; hundinuu isaaf jiraatoodhaatii.”
english: Now he is not the God of the dead, but of the living, for all are alive to him.”

kikuyu: Barsiistota seeraa keessaa tokko tokko, “Yaa Barsiisaa, dhugaa jette!” jedhanii deebisan.
english: Some of the scribes answered, “Teacher, you speak well.”

kikuyu: Namni tokko iyyuu deebiʼee gaaffii isa gaafachuuf ija hin jabaanne.
english: They didn’t dare to ask him any more questions.

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isaan akkamitti Kiristoosilma Daawit jechuu dandaʼu?
english: He said to them, “Why do they say that the Christ is David’s son?

kikuyu: Daawit mataan isaa iyyuu kitaaba faarfannaa keessatti akkana jedha; “ ‘Gooftichi Gooftaa kootiin akkana jedhe; “Karaa mirga koo taaʼi;
english: David himself says in the book of Psalms, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,

kikuyu: hamma ani diinota kee, ejjeta miilla keetii siif godhutti.” ’
english: until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet.”’

kikuyu: Daawit ‘Gooftaa’ jedhee isa waama. Yoos inni akkamitti ilma isaa taʼuu dandaʼa ree?”
english: “David therefore calls him Lord, so how is he his son?”

kikuyu: Utuu namoonni hundinuu isa dhagaʼaa jiranuu, Yesuus barattoota isaatiin akkana jedhe;
english: In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,

kikuyu: “Barsiistota seeraa irraa of eeggadhaa. Isaan uffata dhedheeraa uffatanii nanaannaʼuu fi gabaa keessattis nagaa gaafatamuu, manneen sagadaa keessatti taaʼumsa ulfinaa, lafa cidhaatti immoo iddoo ulfinaa jaallatu.
english: “Beware of those scribes who like to walk in long robes, and love greetings in the marketplaces, the best seats in the synagogues, and the best places at feasts;

kikuyu: Isaanis mana haadha hiyyeessaa saamanii onsu; of argisiisuuf jedhaniis kadhannaa dheeressu. Namoonni kunneen adaba guddaa adabamu.”
english: who devour widows’ houses, and for a pretense make long prayers. These will receive greater condemnation.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis ol milʼatee sooreyyii kennaa isaanii miʼa buusii keessa buusaa jiran arge.
english: He looked up and saw the rich people who were putting their gifts into the treasury.

kikuyu: Akkasumas haadha hiyyeessaa hiyyeettii tokko saantima sibiila diimaa xixinnoo lama buusuu ishee arge.
english: He saw a certain poor widow casting in two small brass coins.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhe; “Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; haati hiyyeessaa hiyyeettiin kun warra kaan hunda caalaa buufteerti.
english: He said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow put in more than all of them,

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen hundi qabeenya isaanii irraa kennan; isheen garuu hiyyuma ishee keessaa waan ittiin jiraattu hunda kennite.”
english: for all these put in gifts for God from their abundance, but she, out of her poverty, put in all that she had to live on.”

kikuyu: Barattoota isaa keessaas tokko tokko waaʼee mana qulqullummaa, haala manni qulqullummaa sun dhagaawwan babbareedanii fi kennaawwan Waaqaaf kennamaniin itti miidhagfame dudubbachaa turan. Yesuus garuu akkana jedhe;
english: As some were talking about the temple and how it was decorated with beautiful stones and gifts, he said,

kikuyu: “Yeroon itti wanni isin ilaaltan kun hundinuu, utuu dhagaan tokko iyyuu wal irratti hin hafin diigamu tokko ni dhufa.”
english: “As for these things which you see, the days will come in which there will not be left here one stone on another that will not be thrown down.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Yaa barsiisaa, wanni kun yoom taʼa? Mallattoon yeroo wanni kun itti fiixaan baʼuu gaʼuu maali?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: They asked him, “Teacher, so when will these things be? What is the sign that these things are about to happen?”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebise; “Isin akka hin gowwoomfamneef of eeggadha. Namoonni hedduun, ‘Ani isa; yeroon sun dhiʼaateera’ jechaa maqaa kootiin ni dhufuutii. Isin garuu isaan duukaa hin buʼinaa.
english: He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is at hand.’ Therefore don’t follow them.

kikuyu: Yommuu waaʼee waraanaatii fi waaʼee fincilaa dhageessanitti, hin sodaatinaa. Wanni kun duraan dursee taʼuu qabaatii; dhumni garuu yeruma sana hin taʼu.”
english: When you hear of wars and disturbances, don’t be terrified, for these things must happen first, but the end won’t come immediately.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Sabni sabatti, mootummaanis mootummaatti ni kaʼa.
english: Then he said to them, “Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom.

kikuyu: Iddoo garaa garaatti sochiin lafaa guddaan, beellii fi golfaan ni taʼa; samii irrattis wanni sodaachisaanii fi mallattoon gurguddaan ni taʼa.
english: There will be great earthquakes, famines, and plagues in various places. There will be terrors and great signs from heaven.
