kikuyu: “Kana hunda dura garuu isaan isin qabu; isin ariʼatus. Dabarsanii manneen sagadaatti isin kennu; mana hidhaa keessas isin buusu; isin maqaa kootiif jettanii fuula moototaatii fi bulchitootaa duratti ni dhiʼeeffamtu.
english: But before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.

kikuyu: Akkasiin isin anaaf dhugaa baatu.
english: It will turn out as a testimony for you.

kikuyu: Isin garuu akkamitti akka falmattan duraan dursitanii akka hin yaaddofne yaadatti qabadhaa.
english: Settle it therefore in your hearts not to meditate beforehand how to answer,

kikuyu: Anuu afaanii fi ogummaa diinonni keessan tokko iyyuu dandaʼanii dura hin dhaabanne yookaan hin mormine isiniif nan kennaatii.
english: for I will give you a mouth and wisdom which all your adversaries will not be able to withstand or to contradict.

kikuyu: Abbaa fi haati, obboloonni, firoonnii fi michoonni dabarsanii isin kennu; isin keessaas tokko tokko ni ajjeesu.
english: You will be handed over even by parents, brothers, relatives, and friends. They will cause some of you to be put to death.

kikuyu: Namni hundinuu sababii maqaa kootiif isin jibba.
english: You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake.

kikuyu: Garuu rifeensi mataa keessanii tokko iyyuu hin badu.
english: And not a hair of your head will perish.

kikuyu: Isin jabaadhaa dhaabadhaa; yoos lubbuu keessan ni oolfattu.
english: “By your endurance you will win your lives.

kikuyu: “Isin yommuu Yerusaalem loltootaan marfamtee argitanitti akka badiin ishee dhiʼaate beekaa.
english: “But when you see Jerusalem surrounded by armies, then know that its desolation is at hand.

kikuyu: Yommus warri Yihuudaa keessa jiran gaarranitti haa baqatan; warri magaalaa keessa jiranis achii haa baʼan; warri baadiyyaa jiran immoo magaalaa hin seenin.
english: Then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains. Let those who are in the middle of her depart. Let those who are in the country not enter therein.

kikuyu: Akka wanni barreeffame hundinuu raawwatamuuf yeroon kun yeroo haaloo baasuutii.
english: For these are days of vengeance, that all things which are written may be fulfilled.

kikuyu: Bara sana keessa dubartoota ulfaatii fi haadhota hoosisaniif wayyoo! Lafa irratti dhiphinni guddaan, saba kanatti immoo dheekkamsi ni dhufaatii.
english: Woe to those who are pregnant and to those who nurse infants in those days! For there will be great distress in the land and wrath to this people.

kikuyu: Isaanis goraadeedhaan ajjeefamu; boojiʼamaniis biyyoota ormaa hundatti ni geeffamu; hamma barri Namoota Ormaa dhumutti Yerusaalem Namoota Ormaatiin dhidhiitamti.
english: They will fall by the edge of the sword, and will be led captive into all the nations. Jerusalem will be trampled down by the Gentiles until the times of the Gentiles are fulfilled.

kikuyu: “Aduu irratti, jiʼa irratti, urjiiwwan irrattis mallattoon ni taʼa. Lafa irrattis sababii huursaatii fi dhaʼaa galaanaatiif saboonni ni muddamu; waan taʼanis ni wallaalu.
english: “There will be signs in the sun, moon, and stars; and on the earth anxiety of nations, in perplexity for the roaring of the sea and the waves;

kikuyu: Namoonnis sababii humnoonni samii irraa raafamaniif, waan addunyaa kanatti dhufuuf jiru yaaddaʼanii sodaadhaan ni gaggabu.
english: men fainting for fear and for expectation of the things which are coming on the world, for the powers of the heavens will be shaken.

kikuyu: Isaanis yeroo sana utuu Ilmi Namaa humnaa fi ulfina guddaadhaan duumessaan dhufuu ni argu.
english: Then they will see the Son of Man coming in a cloud with power and great glory.

kikuyu: Yommuu wanni kun taʼuu jalqabutti mataa keessan ol qabadhaa; olis ilaalaa; furamuun keessan dhiʼaateeraatii.”
english: But when these things begin to happen, look up and lift up your heads, because your redemption is near.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee fakkeenya kana isaanitti hime; “Mee muka harbuutii fi muka hunda ilaalaa.
english: He told them a parable. “See the fig tree and all the trees.

kikuyu: Yommuu isaan baala baafatanitti isin mataan keessan iyyuu ilaaltanii akka bonni dhiʼaate beekuu dandeessu.
english: When they are already budding, you see it and know by your own selves that the summer is already near.

kikuyu: Akkasuma isinis yommuu wanni kun raawwatamuu isaa argitanitti akka mootummaan Waaqaa dhiʼaate ni beektu.
english: Even so you also, when you see these things happening, know that God’s Kingdom is near.

kikuyu: “Ani dhuguma isinittin hima; hamma wanni kun hundi taʼutti dhaloonni kun hin darbu.
english: Most certainly I tell you, this generation will not pass away until all things are accomplished.

kikuyu: Samii fi lafti ni darbu; dubbiin koo garuu gonkumaa hin darbu.
english: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will by no means pass away.

kikuyu: “Isin of eeggadhaa; yoo kanaa achii qalbiin keessan qananiidhaan, machii fi yaaddoo jireenyaatiin fudhatamee guyyaan sunis utuu isin hin beekin akkuma kiyyoo isin qabata.
english: “So be careful, or your hearts will be loaded down with carousing, drunkenness, and cares of this life, and that day will come on you suddenly.

kikuyu: Guyyaan sun warra lafa irra jiraatan hundatti ni dhufaatii.
english: For it will come like a snare on all those who dwell on the surface of all the earth.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka waan dhufuuf jiru hunda jalaa baataniif, akka fuula Ilma Namaa duras dhaabachuu dandeessaniif yeroo hunda dammaqaa; kadhadhaas.”
english: Therefore be watchful all the time, praying that you may be counted worthy to escape all these things that will happen, and to stand before the Son of Man.”

kikuyu: Yesuus guyyuma guyyaan mana qulqullummaa keessatti barsiisaa ture; halkan halkan immoo tulluu Gaara Ejersaa jedhamu irra bula ture.
english: Every day Jesus was teaching in the temple, and every night he would go out and spend the night on the mountain that is called Olivet.

kikuyu: Namoonni hundinuus isa dhaggeeffachuuf jedhanii barii barraaqaan mana qulqullummaa dhufu turan.
english: All the people came early in the morning to him in the temple to hear him.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana Ayyaanni Maxinoo kan Faasiikaa jedhamu dhiʼaate ture;
english: Now the feast of unleavened bread, which is called the Passover, was approaching.

kikuyu: luboonni hangafoonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa waan namoota sodaataniif, mala ittiin Yesuusin ajjeesan barbaadaa turan.
english: The chief priests and the scribes sought how they might put him to death, for they feared the people.

kikuyu: Ergasiis seexanni namicha Yihuudaa Keeriyoticha jedhamu kan jara Kudha Lamaan keessaa tokko ture sanatti gale.
english: Satan entered into Judas, who was also called Iscariot, who was counted with the twelve.

kikuyu: Yihuudaanis gara luboota hangafootaatii fi ajajjoota waardiyyaa mana qulqullummaa dhaqee haala ittiin Yesuusin dabarsee kennu irratti isaan wajjin mariʼate.
english: He went away and talked with the chief priests and captains about how he might deliver him to them.

kikuyu: Isaanis gammadanii maallaqa isaaf kennuuf walii galan.
english: They were glad, and agreed to give him money.

kikuyu: Innis tole jedhee yeroo namoonni hin jirretti Yesuusin dabarsee isaanitti kennuudhaaf haala mijaaʼaa eeggachaa ture.
english: He consented and sought an opportunity to deliver him to them in the absence of the multitude.

kikuyu: Guyyaan Ayyaana Maxinoo kan hoolaan Faasiikaa itti qalamuu qabu gaʼee ture.
english: The day of unleavened bread came, on which the Passover must be sacrificed.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Akka Faasiikaa nyaannuuf dhaqaatii nuu qopheessaa” jedhee Phexrosii fi Yohannisin erge.
english: Jesus sent Peter and John, saying, “Go and prepare the Passover for us, that we may eat.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Akka nu eessatti qopheessinu barbaadda?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: They said to him, “Where do you want us to prepare?”

kikuyu: Inni immoo deebisee akkana jedhe; “Akkuma isin magaalaa seentaniin, namichi okkotee bishaanii baatu tokko isinitti dhufa. Gara mana inni seenuutti isa duukaa buʼaatii,
english: He said to them, “Behold, when you have entered into the city, a man carrying a pitcher of water will meet you. Follow him into the house which he enters.

kikuyu: abbaa mana sanaatiin, ‘Barsiisaan, “Manni keessummaa, iddoon ani itti barattoota koo wajjin Faasiikaa nyaadhu eessaa?” siin jedha’ jedhaa.
english: Tell the master of the house, ‘The Teacher says to you, “Where is the guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?”’

kikuyu: Abbaan manaa sunis darbii balʼaa miʼa manaatiin guutame tokko isinitti argisiisa. Isinis achitti qopheessaa.”
english: He will show you a large, furnished upper room. Make preparations there.”

kikuyu: Isaanis dhaqanii akkuma Yesuus isaanitti hime sanatti argatan. Faasiikaas ni qopheessan.
english: They went, found things as Jesus had told them, and they prepared the Passover.

kikuyu: Yommuu saʼaatiin sun gaʼetti Yesuusii fi ergamoonni isaa maaddiitti dhiʼaatan.
english: When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Ani utuu hin dhiphatiniin dura isin wajjin Faasiikaa kana nyaachuu akka malee hawween ture.
english: He said to them, “I have earnestly desired to eat this Passover with you before I suffer,

kikuyu: Ani isinittin himaatii; hamma Faasiikaan kun mootummaa Waaqaa keessatti raawwatamutti ani deebiʼee isa hin nyaadhu.”
english: for I tell you, I will no longer by any means eat of it until it is fulfilled in God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Innis erga xoofoo fuudhee galata galchee booddee akkana jedhe; “Kana fudhadhaatii gargar qooddadhaa.
english: He received a cup, and when he had given thanks, he said, “Take this and share it among yourselves,

kikuyu: Ani isinitti nan himaatii; ani hamma mootummaan Waaqaa dhufutti ija wayinii kana irraa deebiʼee hin dhugu” jedhe.
english: for I tell you, I will not drink at all again from the fruit of the vine, until God’s Kingdom comes.”

kikuyu: Innis buddeena fuudhee galata galchee, caccabsee isaaniif kennee, “Kun foon koo kan isiniif kennamuu dha; kanas yaadannoo kootiif godhadhaa” jedheen.
english: He took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke and gave it to them, saying, “This is my body which is given for you. Do this in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Akkasumas irbaata booddee xoofoo sana fuudhee akkana jedhe; “Xoofoon kun Kakuu Haaraa dhiiga koo kan isiniif dhangalaafamuun taʼuu dha.
english: Likewise, he took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood, which is poured out for you.

kikuyu: Garuu harki namicha dabarsee na kennu sanaa kunoo harka koo wajjin maaddii irra jira.
english: But behold, the hand of him who betrays me is with me on the table.

kikuyu: Ilmi Namaa akkuma murteeffame sanatti ni deema. Garuu namicha dabarsee isa kennu sanaaf wayyoo!”
english: The Son of Man indeed goes as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”

kikuyu: Isaanis namni isaan keessaa waan kana gochuuf jiru eenyu akka taʼe wal gaggaafachuu jalqaban.
english: They began to question among themselves which of them it was who would do this thing.

kikuyu: Akkasumas isaan keessaa namni akka nama nama hundumaa caaluutti ilaalamu eenyu akka taʼe irratti wal falmiin gidduu isaaniitti kaʼe.
english: A dispute also arose among them, which of them was considered to be greatest.

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Mootonni Namoota Ormaa isaan irratti gooftummaa mulʼisu; warri isaan irratti taayitaa argisiisan immoo Gargaartota ofiin jedhu.
english: He said to them, “The kings of the nations lord it over them, and those who have authority over them are called ‘benefactors.’

kikuyu: Isin garuu akkas taʼuu hin qabdan. Qooda kanaa isin keessaa namni nama hunda caalu, akka quxisuu nama hundaa, bulchaan immoo akka tajaajilaa haa taʼu.
english: But not so with you. Rather, the one who is greater among you, let him become as the younger, and one who is governing, as one who serves.

kikuyu: Eenyutu guddaa dha? Nama maaddiitti dhiʼaatu moo nama tajaajilu? Nama maaddiitti dhiʼaatu mitii? Ani garuu isin gidduutti akka tajaajilaa tokkoo ti.
english: For who is greater, one who sits at the table, or one who serves? Isn’t it he who sits at the table? But I am among you as one who serves.

kikuyu: Isin immoo warra yeroo qorama koo na wajjin turtanii dha.
english: “But you are those who have continued with me in my trials.

kikuyu: Akkuma Abbaan koo mootummaa natti kenne, anis akkasuma isinittin kenna;
english: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,

kikuyu: kunis akka isin mootummaa koo keessatti maaddii koo irraa nyaattanii fi dhugdan, akka teessoowwan irra teessanii gosoota Israaʼel kudha lamaanitti murtaniif.
english: that you may eat and drink at my table in my Kingdom. You will sit on thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.”

kikuyu: “Yaa Simoon, yaa Simoon; kunoo, Seexanni akkuma qamadiitti isin gingilchuuf kadhateera.
english: The Lord said, “Simon, Simon, behold, Satan asked to have all of you, that he might sift you as wheat,

kikuyu: Yaa Simoon, ani garuu akka amantiin kee hin dadhabneef siif kadhadheera; atis yommuu deebitutti, obboloota kee jajjabeessi.”
english: but I prayed for you, that your faith wouldn’t fail. You, when once you have turned again, establish your brothers.”

kikuyu: Simʼoon garuu deebisee, “Yaa Gooftaa, ani si wajjin hidhamuu fi duʼuuf illee qophaaʼeera” jedhe.
english: He said to him, “Lord, I am ready to go with you both to prison and to death!”

kikuyu: Yesuus, “Yaa Phexros, ani sittin hima; ati harʼa utuu indaanqoon hin iyyin akkuma na beektu illee yeroo sadii ni ganta” jedhee deebise.
english: He said, “I tell you, Peter, the rooster will by no means crow today until you deny that you know me three times.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Yeroo ani borsaa, korojoo yookaan kophee malee isin erge sana waa isin duraa hirʼateeraa?” jedhee isaan gaafate. Isaanis deebisanii, “Wanni tokko iyyuu hin hirʼanne” jedhan.
english: He said to them, “When I sent you out without purse, bag, and sandals, did you lack anything?” They said, “Nothing.”

kikuyu: Inni immoo akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Amma garuu yoo borsaa qabaattan fudhadhaa; yoo korojoo qabaattanis fudhadhaa; yoo goraadee hin qabaannes uffata keessan gurguraatii goraadee bitadhaa.
english: Then he said to them, “But now, whoever has a purse, let him take it, and likewise a bag. Whoever has none, let him sell his cloak, and buy a sword.

kikuyu: Wanni, ‘Inni yakkitootatti lakkaaʼame’jedhamee barreeffame sun akka narratti raawwatamuu qabu ani isinitti hima; wanni waaʼee koo barreeffame raawwatamuu gaʼeeraatii.”
english: For I tell you that this which is written must still be fulfilled in me: ‘He was counted with transgressors.’ For that which concerns me is being fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Barattoonnis, “Yaa Gooftaa, kunoo goraadee lamatu as jira” jedhan. Innis, “Ni gaʼa” jedhee deebiseef.
english: They said, “Lord, behold, here are two swords.” He said to them, “That is enough.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis achii baʼee, akkuma amala isaa gara Tulluu Ejersaa dhaqe; barattoonni isaas isa duukaa buʼan.
english: He came out and went, as his custom was, to the Mount of Olives. His disciples also followed him.

kikuyu: Innis akkuma iddoo sana gaʼeen, “Isin akka qorumsatti hin galleef kadhadhaa” isaaniin jedhe.
english: When he was at the place, he said to them, “Pray that you don’t enter into temptation.”

kikuyu: Innis hamma darbata dhagaa tokkoo achi hiiqee, jilbeenfatees akkana jedhee kadhate;
english: He was withdrawn from them about a stone’s throw, and he knelt down and prayed,

kikuyu: “Yaa Abbaa, yoo fedhii kee taʼe, xoofoo kana narraa fuudhi; garuu akka fedhii keetii malee akka fedhii kootii hin taʼin.”
english: saying, “Father, if you are willing, remove this cup from me. Nevertheless, not my will, but yours, be done.”

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqaa tokkos samii irraa isatti mulʼatee isa jajjabeesse.
english: An angel from heaven appeared to him, strengthening him.

kikuyu: Innis lubbamee jabeessee kadhate; dafqi isaas akka coccopha dhiigaa lafatti cophaa ture.
english: Being in agony, he prayed more earnestly. His sweat became like great drops of blood falling down on the ground.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu kadhannaa irraa kaʼee gara barattootaatti deebiʼetti, isaanii gaddaan bututanii rafaa jiran isaan arge.
english: When he rose up from his prayer, he came to the disciples and found them sleeping because of grief,

kikuyu: Innis, “Isin maaliif raftu? Isin akka qorumsatti hin galleef kaʼaatii kadhadhaa” isaaniin jedhe.
english: and said to them, “Why do you sleep? Rise and pray that you may not enter into temptation.”

kikuyu: Utuma inni amma iyyuu dubbachaa jiruus, tuunni namootaa tokko dhufe; namichi Yihuudaa jedhamu kan warra Kudha Lamaan keessaa tokko taʼe sunis isaan dura deemaa ture. Innis Yesuusin dhungachuuf itti dhiʼaate;
english: While he was still speaking, a crowd appeared. He who was called Judas, one of the twelve, was leading them. He came near to Jesus to kiss him.

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu, “Yaa Yihuudaa, ati dhungoodhaan Ilma Namaa dabarsitee kennitaa?” jedhee gaafate.
english: But Jesus said to him, “Judas, do you betray the Son of Man with a kiss?”

kikuyu: Warri isa wajjin turanis yommuu waan taʼuuf jiru arganitti, “Yaa Gooftaa, goraadeedhaan isaan dhoofnuu” jedhan.
english: When those who were around him saw what was about to happen, they said to him, “Lord, shall we strike with the sword?”

kikuyu: Isaan keessaas namni tokko garbicha luba ol aanaa dhaʼee gurra isaa mirgaa irraa kute.
english: A certain one of them struck the servant of the high priest, and cut off his right ear.

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Dhiisaa! Waan akkanaa itti hin deebiʼinaa” jedhe; gurra namichaas tuttuqee fayyise.
english: But Jesus answered, “Let me at least do this”—and he touched his ear and healed him.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Yesuus luboota hangafoota, dura buʼoota mana qulqullummaatii fi maanguddoota isa qabuu dhufaniin akkana jedhe; “Isin goraadee fi bokkuu qabattanii akka nama hattuu qabuutti dhuftanii?
english: Jesus said to the chief priests, captains of the temple, and elders, who had come against him, “Have you come out as against a robber, with swords and clubs?

kikuyu: Ani guyyuma guyyaan mana qulqullummaa keessa isin wajjinan ture; isin harkaanuu na hin tuqne. Garuu saʼaatiin kun saʼaatii keessan; innis yeroo itti dukkanni moʼuu dha.”
english: When I was with you in the temple daily, you didn’t stretch out your hands against me. But this is your hour, and the power of darkness.”

kikuyu: Isaanis isa qabanii fuudhanii deeman; fidaniis mana luba ol aanaa ol isa seensisan. Phexros immoo fagootti duukaa buʼaa ture.
english: They seized him and led him away, and brought him into the high priest’s house. But Peter followed from a distance.

kikuyu: Yommuu isaan walakkaa lafa dallaa keessaatti ibidda qabsiisanii walii wajjin tataaʼanitti Phexrosis isaan wajjin taaʼe.
english: When they had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and had sat down together, Peter sat among them.

kikuyu: Xomboreen tokkos utuu inni ifa ibiddaa keessa taaʼee jiruu isa argite. Isheenis hubattee isa ilaaltee, “Namichi kunis isa wajjin ture” jette.
english: A certain servant girl saw him as he sat in the light, and looking intently at him, said, “This man also was with him.”

kikuyu: Inni garuu, “Dubartii nana, ani isa hin beeku” jedhee gane.
english: He denied Jesus, saying, “Woman, I don’t know him.”

kikuyu: Yeroo xinnoo booddee namni biraa isa argee, “Atis jara keessaa tokkoo dha” jedhe. Phexros garuu, “Namichoo, ana miti” jedhee deebise.
english: After a little while someone else saw him and said, “You also are one of them!” But Peter answered, “Man, I am not!”

kikuyu: Gara Saʼaatii tokkoo booddee namni biraa, “Namichi kunis waan nama Galiilaa taʼeef dhuguma iyyuu isa wajjin ture” jedhee jabeessee dubbate.
english: After about one hour passed, another confidently affirmed, saying, “Truly this man also was with him, for he is a Galilean!”

kikuyu: Phexros immoo deebisee, “Namichoo, ani waan ati jettu kana hin beeku” jedhe. Utuma inni dubbachaa jiruus indaanqoon iyye.
english: But Peter said, “Man, I don’t know what you are talking about!” Immediately, while he was still speaking, a rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Gooftaanis garagalee Phexrosin ilaale. Phexrosis waan Gooftaan, “Ati harʼa utuu indaanqoon hin iyyin yeroo sadii na ganta” isaan jedhee ture sana yaadate.
english: The Lord turned and looked at Peter. Then Peter remembered the Lord’s word, how he said to him, “Before the rooster crows you will deny me three times.”

kikuyu: Innis gad baʼee hiqqifatee booʼe.
english: He went out, and wept bitterly.

kikuyu: Namoonni Yesuusin eegaa turan sun isatti qoosuu fi isa tumuu jalqaban.
english: The men who held Jesus mocked him and beat him.

kikuyu: Isaanis isa haguuganii, “Mee raajii dubbadhu! Eenyutu si rukute?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: Having blindfolded him, they struck him on the face and asked him, “Prophesy! Who is the one who struck you?”

kikuyu: Isaanis isa arrabsaa waan hedduu isaan jedhan.
english: They spoke many other things against him, insulting him.

kikuyu: Yommuu lafti bariʼettis yaaʼiin maanguddoota sabaa akkasumas luboonni hangafoonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa walitti qabaman; yaaʼii isaanii durattis Yesuusin dhiʼeessanii,
english: As soon as it was day, the assembly of the elders of the people were gathered together, both chief priests and scribes, and they led him away into their council, saying,

kikuyu: “Ati yoo Kiristoos taate mee nutti himi” jedhaniin. Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Yoo ani isinitti hime isin na hin amantan;
english: “If you are the Christ, tell us.” But he said to them, “If I tell you, you won’t believe,

kikuyu: yoo ani isin gaafadhes hin deebiftan.
english: and if I ask, you will in no way answer me or let me go.

kikuyu: Garuu siʼachi Ilmi Namaa karaa mirga humna Waaqaatiin ni taaʼa.”
english: From now on, the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God.”

kikuyu: Hundi isaaniis, “Yoos ati Ilma Waaqaatii ree?” jedhanii gaafatan. Innis deebisee, “Akka ana taʼe isinuu ni dubbattu!” jedhe.
english: They all said, “Are you then the Son of God?” He said to them, “You say it, because I am.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti isaan, “Kana caalaa dhuga baʼumsa maalii nu barbaachisa? Nu mataan keenya iyyuu afaanuma isaa irraa dhageenyeerraatii” jedhan.
english: They said, “Why do we need any more witness? For we ourselves have heard from his own mouth!”

kikuyu: Ergasii yaaʼiin sun guutuun kaʼee Yesuusin gara Phiilaaxoositti geesse.
english: The whole company of them rose up and brought him before Pilate.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Nu utuu namichi kun saba keenya karaa irraa jalʼisuu, utuu inni akka Gibirri Qeesaariif hin baafamne godhuu, akkasumas utuu inni akka mataan isaa Kiristoos mooticha taʼe dubbatuu argineerra” jedhanii isa himachuu jalqaban.
english: They began to accuse him, saying, “We found this man perverting the nation, forbidding paying taxes to Caesar, and saying that he himself is Christ, a king.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Phiilaaxoos, “Ati mootii Yihuudootaatii?” jedhee Yesuusin gaafate. Yesuus immoo, “Atuu jette kaa!” jedhee deebise.
english: Pilate asked him, “Are you the King of the Jews?” He answered him, “So you say.”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis luboota hangafootaa fi tuuta namootaatiin, “Ani namicha kana irratti yakka tokko illee hin arganne” jedhe.
english: Pilate said to the chief priests and the multitudes, “I find no basis for a charge against this man.”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu ittuma caalchisanii, “Inni Galiilaa irraa jalqabee Yihuudaa hunda keessatti barsiisa isaatiin saba jeeqaa hamma asiitti illee dhufeera” jedhan.
english: But they insisted, saying, “He stirs up the people, teaching throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee even to this place.”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti, “Namichi kun nama Galiilaatii?” jedhee gaafate.
english: But when Pilate heard Galilee mentioned, he asked if the man was a Galilean.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu akka Yesuus nama kutaa Heroodis bulchuu taʼe beeketti Heroodisitti isa erge; Heroodisis yeroo sana Yerusaalem keessa ture.
english: When he found out that he was in Herod’s jurisdiction, he sent him to Herod, who was also in Jerusalem during those days.

kikuyu: Heroodis yommuu Yesuusin argetti akka malee gammade; inni sababii waaʼee Yesuus dhagaʼaa fi hojii dinqii kan inni hojjetu tokko tokko akka arguu abdachaa tureef yeroo dheeraaf isa arguu barbaadaa ture.
english: Now when Herod saw Jesus, he was exceedingly glad, for he had wanted to see him for a long time, because he had heard many things about him. He hoped to see some miracle done by him.

kikuyu: Innis Gaaffii baayʼee isa gaafate; Yesuus garuu deebii tokko illee hin kennineef.
english: He questioned him with many words, but he gave no answers.

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa achi dhadhaabatanii cimsanii isa himachaa turan.
english: The chief priests and the scribes stood, vehemently accusing him.

kikuyu: Heroodisii fi loltoonni isaa isa tuffatan; isatti qoosanis. Isaanis uffata miidhagaa isatti uffisanii deebisanii Phiilaaxoositti isa ergan.
english: Herod with his soldiers humiliated him and mocked him. Dressing him in luxurious clothing, they sent him back to Pilate.

kikuyu: Guyyuma sana Heroodisii fi Phiilaaxoos walitti michooman; isaan duraan diina walii turaniitii.
english: Herod and Pilate became friends with each other that very day, for before that they were enemies with each other.

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis luboota hangafoota, bulchitootaa fi saba walitti waamee,
english: Pilate called together the chief priests, the rulers, and the people,

kikuyu: akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isin namichi kun, ‘karaa irraa saba jalʼisa’ jettanii isa natti fiddan; anis fuuluma keessan duratti isa qoree akka inni waan isin ittiin isa himattan sana keessaa tokko illee hojjete hin argine.
english: and said to them, “You brought this man to me as one that perverts the people, and behold, having examined him before you, I found no basis for a charge against this man concerning those things of which you accuse him.

kikuyu: Heroodisis waan tokko illee isa irratti hin argine; inni deebisee isa nutti ergeeraatii. Akkuma isin argitan kana namichi kun waan duʼaan isa gaʼu tokko illee hin hojjenne.
english: Neither has Herod, for I sent you to him, and see, nothing worthy of death has been done by him.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani namicha kana adabeen gad isa dhiisa.” [
english: I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis guyyaa ayyaanaatiin nama tokko mana hidhaatii gad isaanii dhiisuun dirqama ture.]
english: Now he had to release one prisoner to them at the feast.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu sagalee tokkoon iyyanii, “Namicha kana balleessi! Barabbaasin gad nuu dhiisi!” jedhan.
english: But they all cried out together, saying, “Away with this man! Release to us Barabbas!”—

kikuyu: Barabbaas sababii fincila magaalaa keessatti kaʼeetii fi ajjeechaa namaatiin mana hidhaa keessa buufamee ture.
english: one who was thrown into prison for a certain revolt in the city, and for murder.

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis Yesuusin gad dhiisuu barbaadee amma illee isaanitti dubbate.
english: Then Pilate spoke to them again, wanting to release Jesus,

kikuyu: Isaan garuu, “Isa fannisi! Isa fannisi!” jedhanii iyyaa turan.
english: but they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify him!”

kikuyu: Innis yeroo sadaffaa, “Maaliif? Namichi kun yakka maalii hojjete? Ani yakka duʼaan isa gaʼu isa irratti hin arganne. Kanaafuu ani isa adabeen gad isa dhiisa” isaaniin jedhe.
english: He said to them the third time, “Why? What evil has this man done? I have found no capital crime in him. I will therefore chastise him and release him.”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu akka inni fannifamuuf sagalee guddaadhaan ittuma cichanii gaafatan; iyyi isaaniis ittuma jabaate.
english: But they were urgent with loud voices, asking that he might be crucified. Their voices and the voices of the chief priests prevailed.

kikuyu: Kanaaf Phiilaaxoos waan isaan kadhatan sana isaaniif kennuu murteesse.
english: Pilate decreed that what they asked for should be done.

kikuyu: Innis namicha sababii fincilaatii fi sababii ajjeechaa namaatiin mana hidhaa keessa buufame kan isaan akka inni hiikamuuf kadhatan sana gad dhiise; Yesuusin immoo dabarsee fedhii isaaniitti kenne.
english: He released him who had been thrown into prison for insurrection and murder, for whom they asked, but he delivered Jesus up to their will.

kikuyu: Isaanis utuu Yesuusin geessaa jiranuu Simoon namicha Qareenaa tokko utuu inni baadiyyaadhaa dhufaa jiruu qaban; fannoo sanas isa irra kaaʼanii akka inni baatee Yesuus duubaan deemu isa dirqisiisan.
english: When they led him away, they grabbed one Simon of Cyrene, coming from the country, and laid the cross on him to carry it after Jesus.

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeen, dubartoota keessaas warri isaaf gaddaa fi booʼaa turan isa duukaa buʼan.
english: A great multitude of the people followed him, including women who also mourned and lamented him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis isaanitti garagalee akkana jedhe; “Yaa durboota Yerusaalem, ofii keessanii fi ijoollee keessaniif booʼaa malee naaf hin booʼinaa.
english: But Jesus, turning to them, said, “Daughters of Jerusalem, don’t weep for me, but weep for yourselves and for your children.

kikuyu: Kunoo guyyoonni itti namoonni, ‘dubartoonni dhabdoonni, garaan takkumaa ulfa hin baatinii fi harmi takkumaa hin hoosisin eebbifamoo dha’ jedhan ni dhufuutii.
english: For behold, the days are coming in which they will say, ‘Blessed are the barren, the wombs that never bore, and the breasts that never nursed.’

kikuyu: Yeroo sana, “ ‘Namoonni gaarraniin, “Nurratti jigaa!” tulluuwwaniin immoo, “Nu dhoksaa!”ni jedhu.’
english: Then they will begin to tell the mountains, ‘Fall on us!’ and tell the hills, ‘Cover us.’

kikuyu: Isaan erga muka jiidhaa akkana godhanii muka gogaa immoo akkam haa godhan?”
english: For if they do these things in the green tree, what will be done in the dry?”

kikuyu: Namoonni biraa kanneen yakkitoota turan lamas isa wajjin ajjeefamuuf geeffaman.
english: There were also others, two criminals, led with him to be put to death.

kikuyu: Yommuu iddoo Buqqee Mataa jedhamu gaʼanitti achitti isa fannisan; yakkitoota sanas, isa tokko mirga isaatiin, kaan immoo bitaa isaatiin fannisan.
english: When they came to the place that is called “The Skull”, they crucified him there with the criminals, one on the right and the other on the left.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Yaa Abbaa, isaan waan hojjetan hin beekaniitii isaaniif dhiisi” jedhe. Isaanis ixaa buufatanii uffata isaa gargar qooddatan.
english: Jesus said, “Father, forgive them, for they don’t know what they are doing.” Dividing his garments among them, they cast lots.

kikuyu: Namoonnis achi dhadhaabatanii ilaalaa turan; bulchitoonni garuu, “Inni warra kaan oolcheera. Inni yoo dhuguma Kiristoos Waaqaa isa Filatamaa sana taʼe mee of haa oolchuu!” jedhanii isatti qoosan.
english: The people stood watching. The rulers with them also scoffed at him, saying, “He saved others. Let him save himself, if this is the Christ of God, his chosen one!”

kikuyu: Loltoonnis isatti dhiʼaatanii itti qoosaa daadhii wayinii dhangaggaaʼaa kennaniifii,
english: The soldiers also mocked him, coming to him and offering him vinegar,

kikuyu: “Ati yoo mootii Yihuudootaa taate mee of oolchi” jedhan.
english: and saying, “If you are the King of the Jews, save yourself!”

kikuyu: Katabbiin, Kun Mooticha Yihuudootaa ti, jedhu tokkos mataa isaatii ol ture.
english: An inscription was also written over him in letters of Greek, Latin, and Hebrew: “THIS IS THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Yakkitoota achitti fannifaman keessaa tokko, “Ati Kiristoos mitii? Mee of oolchi; nu illee oolchi!” jedhee isa arrabse.
english: One of the criminals who was hanged insulted him, saying, “If you are the Christ, save yourself and us!”

kikuyu: Yakkituun kaan garuu akkana jedhee isa ifate; “Atis waan murtii wal fakkaatu jala jirtuuf, Waaqa illee hin sodaattuu?
english: But the other answered, and rebuking him said, “Don’t you even fear God, seeing you are under the same condemnation?

kikuyu: Nu adabbii sirrii adabamaa jirra; gatii hojii keenyaaf malu argachaa jirraatii. Namichi kun garuu yakka tokko illee hin hojjenne.”
english: And we indeed justly, for we receive the due reward for our deeds, but this man has done nothing wrong.”

kikuyu: Yesuusiinis, “Yaa Yesuus, yeroo mootummaa keetiin dhuftutti na yaadadhu” jedhe.
english: He said to Jesus, “Lord, remember me when you come into your Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Ani dhuguman sitti hima; ati harʼa na wajjin jannatatti ni galta” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “Assuredly I tell you, today you will be with me in Paradise.”

kikuyu: Yeroon sun gara saʼaatii jaʼaa ture; hamma saʼaatii sagaliitti dukkanni lafa hunda irra buʼe;
english: It was now about the sixth hour, and darkness came over the whole land until the ninth hour.

kikuyu: aduun ifa dhowwatteetii. Golgaan mana qulqullummaas iddoo lamatti ni tarsaʼe.
english: The sun was darkened, and the veil of the temple was torn in two.

kikuyu: Yesuusis sagalee guddaadhaan iyyee, “Yaa Abbaa, ani hafuura koo dabarsee harka keettin kennadha” jedhe. Kana jedhees hafuura dhumaa baafate.
english: Jesus, crying with a loud voice, said, “Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!” Having said this, he breathed his last.

kikuyu: Ajajaan dhibbaa sunis yommuu waan taʼe sana argetti Waaqaaf ulfina kennee, “Dhugumaanuu namichi kun nama qajeelaa ture” jedhe.
english: When the centurion saw what was done, he glorified God, saying, “Certainly this was a righteous man.”

kikuyu: Namoonni waan kana ilaaluuf iddoo sanatti walitti qabaman hundi yommuu waan taʼe sana arganitti qoma isaanii rurrukutaa achii deeman.
english: All the multitudes that came together to see this, when they saw the things that were done, returned home beating their chests.

kikuyu: Warri isa beekan hundi, dubartoonni Galiilaadhaa isa duukaa buʼanis fagoo dhaabatanii waan kana ilaalaa turan.
english: All his acquaintances and the women who followed with him from Galilee stood at a distance, watching these things.

kikuyu: Kunoo namicha miseensa waldaa Yihuudootaa kan Yoosef jedhamu tokkotu ture; inni nama gaarii fi qajeelaa ture;
english: Behold, there was a man named Joseph, who was a member of the council, a good and righteous man

kikuyu: innis murtii fi hojii isaanii irratti jaraan walii hin galle. Yoosef magaalaa Yihuudaa kan Armaatiyaa jedhamtuu dhufe; innis mootummaa Waaqaa eeggachaa ture.
english: (he had not consented to their counsel and deed), from Arimathaea, a city of the Jews, who was also waiting for God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Namichi kun gara Phiilaaxoos dhaqee reeffa Yesuus kadhate.
english: This man went to Pilate, and asked for Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Reeffa sanas gad buusee huccuu quncee talbaa irraa hojjetameen kafanee awwaala garaa kattaa keessatti qotame kan namni tokko iyyuu duraan itti hin awwaalamin tokko keessa kaaʼe.
english: He took it down and wrapped it in a linen cloth, and laid him in a tomb that was cut in stone, where no one had ever been laid.

kikuyu: Guyyaan sun Guyyaa qophii ture; Sanbannis seenuu gaʼeera.
english: It was the day of the Preparation, and the Sabbath was drawing near.

kikuyu: Dubartoonni Yesuus wajjin Galiilaadhaa dhufanis Yoosef duukaa buʼanii awwaala sanaa fi akka itti reeffi Yesuus awwaala keessa kaaʼame argan.
english: The women who had come with him out of Galilee followed after, and saw the tomb and how his body was laid.

kikuyu: Achii deebiʼaniis qayyaa fi shittoo qopheessan. Guyyaa Sanbataa garuu seeraaf ajajamuuf jedhanii boqotan.
english: They returned and prepared spices and ointments. On the Sabbath they rested according to the commandment.

kikuyu: Guyyaa jalqaba torban sanaa ganama barii, dubartoonni sun urgooftuu qopheessan sana fudhatanii gara awwaalaa dhaqan.
english: But on the first day of the week, at early dawn, they and some others came to the tomb, bringing the spices which they had prepared.

kikuyu: Isaanis dhagaa sana balbala awwaalaa irraa gara galfamee argan;
english: They found the stone rolled away from the tomb.

kikuyu: yommuu seenanitti garuu reeffa Gooftaa Yesuus hin arganne.
english: They entered in, and didn’t find the Lord Jesus’ body.

kikuyu: Utuma isaan waaʼee kanaa dinqisiifachaa jiranuu, namoonni uffata caccalaqqisaa uffatan lama isaan bira dhadhaabatan.
english: While they were greatly perplexed about this, behold, two men stood by them in dazzling clothing.

kikuyu: Dubartoonni sunis sodaatanii mataa buusanii lafa ilaalan; namoonni sun garuu akkana isaaniin jedhan; “Isin maaliif warra duʼan keessa isa jiraataa barbaaddu?
english: Becoming terrified, they bowed their faces down to the earth. The men said to them, “Why do you seek the living among the dead?

kikuyu: Inni as hin jiru; kaʼeera! Waan inni yeroo isin wajjin Galiilaa turetti isinitti hime sana yaadadhaa.
english: He isn’t here, but is risen. Remember what he told you when he was still in Galilee,

kikuyu: ‘Ilmi Namaa dabarfamee harka cubbamootaatti ni kennama; ni fannifama; guyyaa sadaffaatti immoo ni kaafama’ jedhee tureetii.”
english: saying that the Son of Man must be delivered up into the hands of sinful men and be crucified, and the third day rise again?”

kikuyu: Dubartoonnis dubbii isaa yaadatan.
english: They remembered his words,

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu iddoo awwaalaatii deebiʼanitti waan kana hunda barattoota kudha tokkottii fi namoota hafan hundatti himan.
english: returned from the tomb, and told all these things to the eleven and to all the rest.

kikuyu: Warri waan kana ergamootatti himanis Maariyaam ishee Magdalaa, Yohaanaa, Maariyaam haadha Yaaqoobii fi dubartoota biraa warra isaan wajjin turanii dha.
english: Now they were Mary Magdalene, Joanna, and Mary the mother of James. The other women with them told these things to the apostles.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu sababii dubbichi oduu sobaa itti fakkaateef dubartoota sana hin amanne.
english: These words seemed to them to be nonsense, and they didn’t believe them.

kikuyu: Taʼus Phexros kaʼee gara awwaala sanaatti fiige. Yommuu gad jedhee ilaalettis huccuu quncee talbaa irraa hojjetame qofa arge; innis waan arge sana dinqifachaa deebiʼe.
english: But Peter got up and ran to the tomb. Stooping and looking in, he saw the strips of linen lying by themselves, and he departed to his home, wondering what had happened.

kikuyu: Guyyuma sana isaan keessaa namoonni lama ganda Emaaʼuus jedhamu dhaqaa turan; Emaaʼuusis Yerusaalem irraa gara kiiloo meetira kudha tokkoo fagaata.
english: Behold, two of them were going that very day to a village named Emmaus, which was sixty stadia from Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Isaanis waaʼee waan taʼe sana hundaa walitti dudubbachaa turan.
english: They talked with each other about all of these things which had happened.

kikuyu: Utuma isaan walitti dudubbachaa fi wajjin haasaʼaa jiranuus Yesuus mataan isaa itti dhiʼaatee isaan wajjin deemuu jalqabe.
english: While they talked and questioned together, Jesus himself came near, and went with them.

kikuyu: Garuu akka isaan isa hin hubanneef iji isaanii qabamee ture.
english: But their eyes were kept from recognizing him.

kikuyu: Innis, “Wanni isin dudubbachaa deemtan kun maali?” jedhee isaan gaafate. Isaanis gaddanii achuma dhadhaabatan.
english: He said to them, “What are you talking about as you walk, and are sad?”

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa namichi Qileyoophaa jedhamu tokko immoo deebisee, “Waan gidduu kana achitti taʼe kan hin beekne ati Yerusaalemiif keessummaadhaa?” jedheen.
english: One of them, named Cleopas, answered him, “Are you the only stranger in Jerusalem who doesn’t know the things which have happened there in these days?”

kikuyu: Innis, “Maal faatu taʼe?” jedhee gaafate. Isaanis deebisanii akkana jedhan, “Waaʼee Yesuus nama Naazreeti; inni raajii ture; fuula Waaqaatii fi fuula nama hundaa durattis dubbii fi hojiidhaan jabaa ture.
english: He said to them, “What things?” They said to him, “The things concerning Jesus the Nazarene, who was a prophet mighty in deed and word before God and all the people;

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonnii fi bulchitoonni keenya akka duuti itti muramuuf dabarsanii isa kennan; isa fannisanis.
english: and how the chief priests and our rulers delivered him up to be condemned to death, and crucified him.

kikuyu: Nu garuu namni Israaʼelin furu isa jennee abdannee turre. Kana irratti immoo erga wanni kun hundi taʼee harʼa guyyaa sadaffaa dha.
english: But we were hoping that it was he who would redeem Israel. Yes, and besides all this, it is now the third day since these things happened.

kikuyu: Akkasumas dubartoota keenya keessaa tokko tokko nu dinqisiisaniiru; isaanis barii barraaqaan gara awwaala sanaa dhaqanii,
english: Also, certain women of our company amazed us, having arrived early at the tomb;

kikuyu: reeffa isaa achii dhaban. Dubartoonni sunis deebiʼanii akka ergamoonni isaanitti mulʼatanii, Yesuus jiraataa taʼuu isaa isaanitti himan nutti odeessan.
english: and when they didn’t find his body, they came saying that they had also seen a vision of angels, who said that he was alive.

kikuyu: Warra nu wajjin turan keessaas namoonni tokko tokko gara awwaalaa dhaqanii akka wanni sun akkuma dubartoonni nutti odeessan sana taʼe argan; isa garuu hin argine.”
english: Some of us went to the tomb and found it just like the women had said, but they didn’t see him.”

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isin yaa warra hin hubannee fi warra waan raajonni dubbatan hunda amanuuttis mataa jabaattan!
english: He said to them, “Foolish people, and slow of heart to believe in all that the prophets have spoken!

kikuyu: Kiristooswaan kana hundaan dhiphatee ergasii immoo ulfina isaatti galuu hin qabu turee?”
english: Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”

kikuyu: Innis Musee fi raajota hunda irraa jalqabee waan Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluu hunda keessatti waaʼee isaa dubbatame isaaniif ibse.
english: Beginning from Moses and from all the prophets, he explained to them in all the Scriptures the things concerning himself.

kikuyu: Yommuu ganda dhaqaa turan sanatti dhiʼaatanittis Yesuus waan darbee deemu of fakkeesse.
english: They came near to the village where they were going, and he acted like he would go further.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu, “Sababii galgalaaʼuu gaʼee fi dukkanaaʼaa jiruuf, nu bira buli” jedhanii jabeessanii isa kadhatan. Innis isaan bira buluuf gore.
english: They urged him, saying, “Stay with us, for it is almost evening, and the day is almost over.” He went in to stay with them.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu isaan wajjin maaddiitti dhiʼaatetti buddeena fuudhee, eebbisee, caccabsees isaaniif kenne.
english: When he had sat down at the table with them, he took the bread and gave thanks. Breaking it, he gave it to them.

kikuyu: Iji isaanii ni baname; isas ni beekan; innis ija isaanii duraa dhokate.
english: Their eyes were opened and they recognized him; then he vanished out of their sight.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Yeroo inni karaatti nu wajjin dubbachaa turee fi yeroo inni Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluu nuu ibsaa ture sana, garaan keenya nu keessatti bobaʼaa hin turree?” jedhanii wal gaafatan.
english: They said to one another, “Weren’t our hearts burning within us while he spoke to us along the way, and while he opened the Scriptures to us?”

kikuyu: Yeruma sanas kaʼanii Yerusaalemitti deebiʼan; achitti immoo barattoota kudha tokkoo fi namoota isaan wajjin turan sana walitti qabamanii argan.
english: They rose up that very hour, returned to Jerusalem, and found the eleven gathered together, and those who were with them,

kikuyu: Warri walitti qabaman sunis, “Dhugumaan Gooftaan duʼaa kaʼeera; Simoonittis mulʼateera” jechaa turan.
english: saying, “The Lord is risen indeed, and has appeared to Simon!”

kikuyu: Namoonni lamaan sunis waan karaa irratti taʼe hundumaa fi yeroo Yesuus buddeena caccabse sana akkamitti akka isa beekan odeessan.
english: They related the things that happened along the way, and how he was recognized by them in the breaking of the bread.

kikuyu: Utuu isaan waan kana dudubbachaa jiranuu, Yesuus mataan isaa isaan gidduu dhaabatee, “Nagaan isiniif haa taʼu” jedheen.
english: As they said these things, Jesus himself stood among them, and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu waan ekeraa argan seʼanii naʼan; ni sodaatanis.
english: But they were terrified and filled with fear, and supposed that they had seen a spirit.

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Maaliif sodaattu? Mamiinis maaliif garaa keessan keessatti uumama?
english: He said to them, “Why are you troubled? Why do doubts arise in your hearts?

kikuyu: Akka anuma mataa koo taʼe mee harka koo fi miilla koo ilaalaa! Qaqqabadhaatii na ilaalaa; ekeraan foonii fi lafee hin qabu; ani garuu akkuma isin argitan kana foonii fi lafee qaba.”
english: See my hands and my feet, that it is truly me. Touch me and see, for a spirit doesn’t have flesh and bones, as you see that I have.”

kikuyu: Innis waan kana dubbatee harka isaatii fi miilla isaa isaanitti argisiise.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his feet.

kikuyu: Utuma isaan sababii gammachuutii fi sababii dinqifannaatiif amma illee hin amanin, “Isin waan nyaatamu asii qabduu?” jedhee isaan gaafate.
english: While they still didn’t believe for joy, and wondered, he said to them, “Do you have anything here to eat?”

kikuyu: Isaanis qurxummii waadame kennaniif;
english: They gave him a piece of a broiled fish and some honeycomb.

kikuyu: innis fudhatee fuuluma isaanii duratti nyaate.
english: He took them, and ate in front of them.

kikuyu: Innis, “Yeroo ani isin bira turetti, ‘Wanni seera Musee keessatti, kitaabota raajotaatii fi kitaaba faarfannaa keessatti waaʼee koo barreeffame hundi raawwatamuu qaba’ jedhee isinitti hime sun isa kana” jedheen.
english: He said to them, “This is what I told you while I was still with you, that all things which are written in the law of Moses, the prophets, and the psalms concerning me must be fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Innis akka isaan Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluu hubataniif qalbii isaanii baneef.
english: Then he opened their minds, that they might understand the Scriptures.

kikuyu: Akkanas isaaniin jedhe; “Wanni barreeffame akkana jedha; ‘Kiristoos ni dhiphata; guyyaa sadaffaatti immoo warra duʼan keessaa ni kaʼa;
english: He said to them, “Thus it is written, and thus it was necessary for the Christ to suffer and to rise from the dead the third day,

kikuyu: maqaa isaatiinis qalbii jijjiirrachuunii fi dhiifamni cubbuu Yerusaalemii jalqabee saba hundatti ni lallabama.’
english: and that repentance and remission of sins should be preached in his name to all the nations, beginning at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Isinis dhuga baatota waan kanaa ti.
english: You are witnesses of these things.

kikuyu: Kunoo ani waan Abbaan koo waadaa isinii gale sana isiniif nan erga; isin garuu hamma olii humna uffattanitti magaalaa Yerusaalem keessa turaa.”
english: Behold, I send out the promise of my Father on you. But wait in the city of Jerusalem until you are clothed with power from on high.”

kikuyu: Innis achii baasee hamma Biitaaniyaatti isaan geesse; harka isaa lamaanis ol kaafatee isaan eebbise.
english: He led them out as far as Bethany, and he lifted up his hands and blessed them.

kikuyu: Utuma isaan eebbisaa jiruus isaan dhiisee samiitti ol fudhatame.
english: While he blessed them, he withdrew from them and was carried up into heaven.

kikuyu: Isaanis isaaf sagadanii gammachuu guddaadhaan Yerusaalemitti deebiʼan.
english: They worshiped him and returned to Jerusalem with great joy,

kikuyu: Yeroo hundas mana qulqullummaa keessatti Waaqa galateeffachaa turan.
english: and were continually in the temple, praising and blessing God. Amen.

kikuyu: Jalqabatti dubbiitu ture; dubbichis Waaqa wajjin ture; dubbiin sunis Waaqa ture.
english: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.

kikuyu: Innis jalqabatti Waaqa wajjin ture.
english: The same was in the beginning with God.

kikuyu: Wanni hundinuu isaan taʼe; waan taʼe hunda keessaas wanni isa malee taʼe tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: All things were made through him. Without him, nothing was made that has been made.

kikuyu: Jireenyi isa keessa ture; jireenyi sunis ifa namootaa ture.
english: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.

kikuyu: Ifni sun dukkana keessatti ni ibsa; dukkanni garuu isa hin moʼanne.
english: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness hasn’t overcome it.

kikuyu: Nama Waaqa biraa ergame kan maqaan isaa Yohannis jedhamu tokkotu ture.
english: There came a man sent from God, whose name was John.

kikuyu: Innis akka namni hundinuu karaa isaatiin amanuuf dhuga baatuu taʼee waaʼee ifa sanaa dhugaa baʼuuf dhufe.
english: The same came as a witness, that he might testify about the light, that all might believe through him.

kikuyu: Waaʼee ifa sanaa dhugaa baʼuu dhufe malee inni mataan isaa ifa hin turre.
english: He was not the light, but was sent that he might testify about the light.

kikuyu: Ifni dhugaa kan nama hundaaf ifa kennu sun gara addunyaa dhufaa ture.
english: The true light that enlightens everyone was coming into the world.

kikuyu: Inni addunyaa keessa ture; addunyaan isaan uumame; addunyaan garuu isa hin beekne.
english: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, and the world didn’t recognize him.

kikuyu: Innis gara saba isaa dhufe; sabni isaa garuu isa hin fudhanne.
english: He came to his own, and those who were his own didn’t receive him.

kikuyu: Warra isa fudhatanii maqaa isaatti amananiif garuu akka ijoollee Waaqaa taʼaniif mirga kenne.
english: But as many as received him, to them he gave the right to become God’s children, to those who believe in his name:

kikuyu: Isaanis Waaqa irraa dhalatan malee dhiiga irraa yookaan fedhii foonii irraa yookaan fedhii dhiiraa irraa hin dhalanne.
english: who were born, not of blood, nor of the will of the flesh, nor of the will of man, but of God.

kikuyu: Dubbiin foon taʼee nu gidduu jiraate. Nus ulfina isaa, ulfina Ilma Tokkicha ayyaanaa fi dhugaadhaan guutamee Abbaa biraa dhufe sanaa argineerra.
english: The Word became flesh and lived among us. We saw his glory, such glory as of the only born Son of the Father, full of grace and truth.

kikuyu: Yohannisis waaʼee isaa dhugaa baʼe. Sagalee isaas ol fudhatee akkana jedhe; “Inni ani, ‘Inni na duubaan dhufu na caala; inni na dura tureetii’ jedhee waaʼee isaa dubbadhe sun isa kana.”
english: John testified about him. He cried out, saying, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me, for he was before me.’”

kikuyu: Guutama isaa irraas hundi keenya ayyaana irratti ayyaana arganneerra.
english: From his fullness we all received grace upon grace.

kikuyu: Seerri karaa Museetiin kennameetii; ayyaannii fi dhugaan garuu karaa Yesuus Kiristoosiitiin dhufe.
english: For the law was given through Moses. Grace and truth were realized through Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Eenyu iyyuu takkumaa Waaqa hin argine; garuu Ilma Tokkicha Abbaa bira jiru sanatu isa beeksise.
english: No one has seen God at any time. The only born Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, has declared him.

kikuyu: Yommuu Yihuudoonni lubootaa fi Lewwota Yerusaalem Yohannisitti erganii, “Ati eenyu?” jedhanii gaafachiisanitti dhuga baʼumsi Yohannis kenne kana ture.
english: This is John’s testimony, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”

kikuyu: Inni dhugaa baʼe malee hin ganne; “Ani Kiristoos miti” jedhee dhugaa baʼe.
english: He declared, and didn’t deny, but he declared, “I am not the Christ.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Yoos ati eenyu ree? Eeliyaas moo?” jedhanii isa gaafatan. Innis, “Lakki, ani isa miti” jedhee deebiseef. Isaanis, “Yoos ati Raajichaa ree?” jedhaniin. Inni immoo, “Lakki” jedheen.
english: They asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” He answered, “No.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Ati eenyu ree? Akka warra nu erganiif deebii kenninuuf ati eenyu ofiin jetta?” jedhaniin.
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”

kikuyu: Yohannisis dubbii Isaayyaas raajichi dubbate sanaan deebisee, “Ani sagalee gammoojjii keessaa, ‘Gooftaaf karaa qajeelchaa’ jedhee iyyu sanaa dha” jedheen.
english: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as Isaiah the prophet said.”

kikuyu: Fariisonni ergaman tokko tokkos,
english: The ones who had been sent were from the Pharisees.

kikuyu: akkana jedhanii isa gaafatan; “Ati erga Kiristoos yookaan Eeliyaas yookaan raajicha taʼuu baattee maaliif cuuphxa ree?”
english: They asked him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”

kikuyu: Yohannis immoo akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Ani bishaaniin nan cuupha; namni isin isa hin beekne tokko garuu isin gidduu dhaabata.
english: John answered them, “I baptize in water, but among you stands one whom you don’t know.

kikuyu: Innis isa na duubaan dhufu kan ani hidhaa kophee isaa iyyuu hiikuufii hin mallee dha.”
english: He is the one who comes after me, who is preferred before me, whose sandal strap I’m not worthy to loosen.”

kikuyu: Wanni kun hundi Yordaanos gama iddoo Yohannis itti cuuphaa ture Biitaaniyaa keessatti taʼe.
english: These things were done in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti Yohannis utuu Yesuus gara isaa dhufuu argee akkana jedhe; “Ilaa Hoolaa Waaqaa isa cubbuu addunyaa balleessu!
english: The next day, he saw Jesus coming to him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!

kikuyu: Inni ani, ‘Namni na duubaan dhufu na caala; inni na dura tureetii’ jedhee waaʼee isaa dubbadhe sun isa kana.
english: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who is preferred before me, for he was before me.’

kikuyu: Ani mataan koo iyyuu isa hin beekun ture; sababiin ani bishaaniin cuuphaa dhufeef garuu akka inni saba Israaʼelitti mulʼifamuuf.”
english: I didn’t know him, but for this reason I came baptizing in water, that he would be revealed to Israel.”

kikuyu: Yohannis itti fufee akkana jedhee dhugaa baʼe; “Ani utuu Hafuurri akkuma gugeetti samii irraa gad buʼee isa irra jiraatuu nan arge.
english: John testified, saying, “I have seen the Spirit descending like a dove out of heaven, and it remained on him.

kikuyu: Inni akka ani bishaaniin cuuphuuf na erge sun, ‘Namichi ati utuu Hafuurri gad buʼee isa irra jiraatuu argitu sun, isa Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan cuuphu dha’ jedhee utuu natti himuu baatee silaa ani iyyuu isa hin beeku ture.
english: I didn’t recognize him, but he who sent me to baptize in water said to me, ‘On whomever you will see the Spirit descending and remaining on him is he who baptizes in the Holy Spirit.’

kikuyu: Anis argeera; akka inni Ilma Waaqaa taʼes dhugaa baʼeera.”
english: I have seen and have testified that this is the Son of God.”

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti Yohannis ammas barattoota isaa keessaa lama wajjin achi ture.
english: Again, the next day, John was standing with two of his disciples,

kikuyu: Innis utuu Yesuus achi irra darbuu argee, “Ilaa, Hoolaa Waaqaa!” jedhe.
english: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”

kikuyu: Barattoonni lamaanis waan kana dubbachuu isaa dhagaʼanii Yesuus duukaa buʼan.
english: The two disciples heard him speak, and they followed Jesus.

kikuyu: Yesuusis of irra garagalee isa duukaa buʼuu isaanii argee, “Isin maal barbaaddu?” jedheen. Isaanis, “Rabbii, ati eessa jiraatta?” jedhaniin. Rabbii jechuun Barsiisaa jechuu dha.
english: Jesus turned and saw them following, and said to them, “What are you looking for?” They said to him, “Rabbi” (which is to say, being interpreted, Teacher), “where are you staying?”

kikuyu: Innis, “Kottaatii ilaalaa” jedheen. Isaanis dhaqanii akka inni eessa jiraatu argan; gaafa sana isa wajjin oolan. Yeroon sunis gara saʼaatii kurnaffaa ture.
english: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying, and they stayed with him that day. It was about the tenth hour.

kikuyu: Warra waan Yohannis dubbate dhagaʼanii Yesuus duukaa buʼan lamaan keessaa inni tokko Indiriiyaas obboleessa Simoon Phexros ture.
english: One of the two who heard John and followed him was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.

kikuyu: Innis duraan dursee obboleessa isaa Simoonin argatee, “Nu Masiihicha arganneerra” jedheen; Masiihii jechuun Kiristoos jechuu dha.
english: He first found his own brother, Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah!” (which is, being interpreted, Christ).

kikuyu: Indiriiyaasis Simʼoonin gara Yesuusitti fide. Yesuusis isa ilaalee, “Ati Simoon ilma Yohannis, Keefaa jedhamtee ni waamamta” jedheen. Keefaa jechuun Phexros jechuu dha.
english: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon the son of Jonah. You shall be called Cephas” (which is by interpretation, Peter).

kikuyu: Yesuusis guyyaa itti aanutti Galiilaa dhaquu barbaade. Innis Fiiliphoosin argee, “Na duukaa buʼi” jedheen.
english: On the next day, he was determined to go out into Galilee, and he found Philip. Jesus said to him, “Follow me.”

kikuyu: Fiiliphoosis akkuma Indiriiyaasii fi Phexros nama magaalaa Beetisayidaa ture.
english: Now Philip was from Bethsaida, the city of Andrew and Peter.

kikuyu: Fiiliphoos Naatnaaʼelin argee, “Isa Museen kitaaba Seeraa keessatti waaʼee isaa barreessee fi isa raajonnis waaʼee isaa barreessan, ilma Yoosef, Yesuus nama Naazreeti arganneerra” jedheen.
english: Philip found Nathanael, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets, wrote: Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”

kikuyu: Naatnaaʼelis, “Naazreeti keessaa wanni gaariin baʼuu ni dandaʼaa?” jedhee gaafate. Fiiliphoosis, “Kottuutii ilaali” jedheen.
english: Nathanael said to him, “Can any good thing come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis utuu Naatnaaʼel gara isaa dhufuu argee, “Ilaa Israaʼelicha dhugaa kan haxxummaan keessa hin jirre!” jedhee waaʼee isaa dubbate.
english: Jesus saw Nathanael coming to him, and said about him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no deceit!”

kikuyu: Naatnaaʼelis, “Ati eessatti na beekta?” jedheen. Yesuusis, “Utuu Fiiliphoos si hin waamin dura yeroo ati muka harbuu jala turtettin si arge” jedhee deebiseef.
english: Nathanael said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”

kikuyu: Naatnaaʼelis, “Yaa Barsiisaa, ati Ilma Waaqaa ti! Ati Mootii Israaʼel” jedheen.
english: Nathanael answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are King of Israel!”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedheen; “Ati sababii ani muka harbuu jalattan si arge siin jedheef amantee? Waan kana caalu iyyuu arguuf jirta.”
english: Jesus answered him, “Because I told you, ‘I saw you underneath the fig tree,’ do you believe? You will see greater things than these!”

kikuyu: Innis itti dabalee, “Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isiniin jedha; samiin banamee utuu ergamoonni Waaqaa Ilma Namaa irra ol baʼanii gad buʼanuu ni argitu” jedheen.
english: He said to him, “Most certainly, I tell you all, hereafter you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending on the Son of Man.”

kikuyu: Guyyaa sadaffaatti Qaanaa Galiilaa keessa cidha gaaʼelaatu ture. Haati Yesuusiis achi turte;
english: The third day, there was a wedding in Cana of Galilee. Jesus’ mother was there.

kikuyu: Yesuusii fi barattoonni isaa gara cidha sanaatti waamamanii turan.
english: Jesus also was invited, with his disciples, to the wedding.

kikuyu: Yommuu Daadhiin wayinii dhumetti haati Yesuus, “Jarri daadhii wayinii hin qaban” isaan jette.
english: When the wine ran out, Jesus’ mother said to him, “They have no wine.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo deebisee, “Dubartii nana! Maal godhi naan jetta? Yeroon koo amma illee hin geenye” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, what does that have to do with you and me? My hour has not yet come.”

kikuyu: Haati isaas tajaajiltootaan, “Waanuma inni isinitti himu hunda godhaa” jette.
english: His mother said to the servants, “Whatever he says to you, do it.”

kikuyu: Gaaniiwwan dhagaa jaʼa sirna qulqulleessuu Yihuudootaatiif achi dhaabamanii turan; tokkoon tokkoon isaaniis gara liitiroo 75 hamma 115 qabata ture.
english: Now there were six water pots of stone set there after the Jews’ way of purifying, containing two or three metretes apiece.

kikuyu: Yesuus tajaajiltootaan, “Gaaniiwwanitti bishaan guutaa” jedhe; isaanis hamma afaan gaaniiwwaniitti guutan.
english: Jesus said to them, “Fill the water pots with water.” So they filled them up to the brim.

kikuyu: Innis, “Egaa budduuqsaatii abbaa cidhaatti kennaa” jedheen. Isaanis akkasuma godhan;
english: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the ruler of the feast.” So they took it.

kikuyu: abbaan cidhaas bishaan gara daadhii wayiniitti geeddarame sana afaaniin qabee ilaale. Daadhiin wayinii sun eessaa akka dhufe tajaajiltoota bishaan waraabanitu beeka malee abbaan cidhaa sun hin beeku ture. Innis misirricha waamee
english: When the ruler of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and didn’t know where it came from (but the servants who had drawn the water knew), the ruler of the feast called the bridegroom

kikuyu: akkana jedheen; “Namni hundi daadhii wayinii isa gaarii jalqabatti dhiʼeessee, erga keessumoonni machaaʼanii booddee immoo daadhii isa laafaa dhiʼeessa; ati garuu daadhii gaarii hamma ammaatti tursite.”
english: and said to him, “Everyone serves the good wine first, and when the guests have drunk freely, then that which is worse. You have kept the good wine until now!”

kikuyu: Yesuus mallattoowwan isaa keessaa isa jalqabaa kana Qaanaa Galiilaa keessatti hojjete. Ulfina isaas ni mulʼise; barattoonni isaas isatti amanan.
english: This beginning of his signs Jesus did in Cana of Galilee, and revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.

kikuyu: Kana booddees inni haadha isaa, obboloota isaatii fi barattoota isaa wajjin Qifirnaahomitti gad buʼe. Isaanis guyyoota muraasa achi turan.
english: After this, he went down to Capernaum, he, and his mother, his brothers, and his disciples; and they stayed there a few days.

kikuyu: Yesuusis waan Faasiikaan Yihuudootaa dhiʼaateef Yerusaalemitti ol baʼe.
english: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Mana qulqullummaa keessattis warra loon, hoolotaa fi gugee gurguratanii fi warra taaʼanii maallaqa geeddaran arge.
english: He found in the temple those who sold oxen, sheep, and doves, and the changers of money sitting.

kikuyu: Innis quncee irraa qaccee dhaʼatee nama hundumaa hoolotaa fi loon wajjin mana qulqullummaa keessaa ariʼe; saantima warra maallaqa geeddaraniis bittinneesse; minjaala isaaniis garagalche.
english: He made a whip of cords and drove all out of the temple, both the sheep and the oxen; and he poured out the changers’ money and overthrew their tables.

kikuyu: Warra gugee gurguraniinis, “Kana hunda asii baasaa! Mana Abbaa koo mana daldalaa hin godhinaa!” jedhe.
english: To those who sold the doves, he said, “Take these things out of here! Don’t make my Father’s house a marketplace!”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaas, “Hinaaffaan mana keetii na gugguba” jedhamee akka barreeffame yaadatan.
english: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will eat me up.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis deebisanii, “Kana hunda hojjechuuf akka taayitaa qabdu mirkaneessuuf mallattoo maalii nutti argisiisuu dandeessa?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: The Jews therefore answered him, “What sign do you show us, seeing that you do these things?”

kikuyu: Yesuus, “Mana qulqullummaa kana jigsaa; ani immoo guyyaa sadiitti olin dhaabaa” jedhee deebiseef.
english: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis deebisanii, “Mana qulqullummaa kana ijaaruun waggaa afurtamii jaʼa fudhate; ati immoo guyyaa sadii keessatti ol dhaabdaa?” jedhaniin.
english: The Jews therefore said, “It took forty-six years to build this temple! Will you raise it up in three days?”

kikuyu: Manni qulqullummaa kan inni waaʼee isaa dubbate sun garuu dhagna isaa ti.
english: But he spoke of the temple of his body.

kikuyu: Erga inni duʼaa kaʼee booddee barattoonni isaa waan inni dubbatee ture sana yaadatan. Isaanis Katabbii Qulqulluu fi dubbii Yesuus dubbate amanan.
english: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he said this, and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had said.

kikuyu: Yeroo inni Ayyaana Faasiikaatiif jedhee Yerusaalem turetti namoonni baayʼeen mallattoo inni hojjete arganii maqaa isaatti amanan.
english: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover, during the feast, many believed in his name, observing his signs which he did.

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu waan nama hunda beekuuf, amanee isaanitti of hin dhiifne.
english: But Jesus didn’t entrust himself to them, because he knew everyone,

kikuyu: Akka namni tokko iyyuu waaʼee namaa isaaf dhugaa baʼu isa hin barbaachifne; inni waan nama keessa jiru beeka tureetii.
english: and because he didn’t need for anyone to testify concerning man; for he himself knew what was in man.

kikuyu: Fariisicha Niqoodemoos jedhamu bulchaa Yihuudootaa tokkotu ture.
english: Now there was a man of the Pharisees named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.

kikuyu: Innis halkaniin Yesuus bira dhaqee, “Yaa barsiisaa, akka ati barsiisaa Waaqa biraa dhufte taate nu beekna; nama Waaqni isa wajjin jiru malee namni mallattoo ati hojjettu kana hojjechuu dandaʼu tokko iyyuu hin jiruutii” jedheen.
english: He came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God, for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Ani dhuguman, dhuguman sitti hima; namni yoo lammata dhalate malee mootummaa Waaqaa arguu hin dandaʼu” jedheen.
english: Jesus answered him, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born anew, he can’t see God’s Kingdom.”

kikuyu: Niqoodemoos immoo, “Namni erga dulloomee booddee akkamitti dhalachuu dandaʼa? Dhalachuuf jedhee lammata gadameessa haadha isaa keessa seenuu dandaʼaa?” jedhee gaafate.
english: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Ani dhuguman, dhuguman sitti hima; namni yoo bishaanii fi Hafuura irraa dhalate malee mootummaa Waaqaatti galuu hin dandaʼu.
english: Jesus answered, “Most certainly I tell you, unless one is born of water and Spirit, he can’t enter into God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Kan foon irraa dhalate foon; kan Hafuura irraa dhalate garuu hafuura.
english: That which is born of the flesh is flesh. That which is born of the Spirit is spirit.

kikuyu: Jecha ani, ‘Ati lammata dhalachuu si barbaachisa siin jedhe hin dinqifatin.’
english: Don’t marvel that I said to you, ‘You must all be born anew.’

kikuyu: Bubbeen gara fedhetti bubbisa. Atis huursuu isaa dhageessa malee akka inni eessaa dhufee fi akka inni garamitti deemu hin beektu; namni Hafuura irraa dhalate hundinuus akkanuma.”
english: The wind blows where it wants to, and you hear its sound, but don’t know where it comes from and where it is going. So is everyone who is born of the Spirit.”

kikuyu: Niqoodemoosis, “Kun akkamitti taʼuu dandaʼa?” jedhee gaafate.
english: Nicodemus answered him, “How can these things be?”

kikuyu: Yesuus akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Ati utuu barsiisaa Israaʼel taatee jirtuu waan kana hin beektuu?
english: Jesus answered him, “Are you the teacher of Israel, and don’t understand these things?

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman, dhuguman sitti hima; nu waan beeknu dubbanna; waan argines dhugaa ni baana; isin garuu dhugaa baʼumsa keenya hin fudhattan.
english: Most certainly I tell you, we speak that which we know and testify of that which we have seen, and you don’t receive our witness.

kikuyu: Isin yoo ani waan addunyaa isinitti himnaan hin amanin, yoo ani waan samii isinitti hime akkamitti amantu ree?
english: If I told you earthly things and you don’t believe, how will you believe if I tell you heavenly things?

kikuyu: Ilma Namaa isa samii irraa gad buʼe malee eenyu iyyuu samiitti ol hin baane.
english: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended out of heaven, the Son of Man, who is in heaven.

kikuyu: Akkuma Museen gammoojjii keessatti bofa fannisesana Ilmi Namaas fannifamuu qaba.
english: As Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, even so must the Son of Man be lifted up,

kikuyu: Kunis akka namni isatti amanu hundi jireenya bara baraa qabaatuuf.”
english: that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

kikuyu: Kan isatti amanu hundi jireenya bara baraa akka qabaatuuf malee akka hin badneef, Waaqni hamma Ilma isaa tokkicha kennutti addunyaa jaallateeraatii.
english: For God so loved the world, that he gave his only born Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have eternal life.

kikuyu: Waaqni karaa isaatiin addunyaa fayyisuudhaaf malee addunyaatti muruuf Ilma isaa gara addunyaatti hin ergineetii.
english: For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.

kikuyu: Kan isatti amanutti hin muramu; kan isatti hin amanne garuu waan inni maqaa Ilma Waaqaa tokkichaatti hin amaniniif ammuma iyyuu itti murameera.
english: He who believes in him is not judged. He who doesn’t believe has been judged already, because he has not believed in the name of the only born Son of God.

kikuyu: Murtiin sunis isa kana: Ifni gara addunyaa dhufe; namoonni garuu waan hojiin isaanii hamaa tureef ifa caalaa dukkana jaallatan.
english: This is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved the darkness rather than the light, for their works were evil.

kikuyu: Namni waan hamaa hojjetu kam iyyuu ifa jibba; akka hojiin isaa ifatti hin baafamneefis gara ifaa hin dhufu.
english: For everyone who does evil hates the light and doesn’t come to the light, lest his works would be exposed.

kikuyu: Namni dhugaa hojjetu kam iyyuu garuu akka hojiin isaa akka fedhii Waaqaatti hojjetamuun isaa mulʼatuuf gara ifaa dhufa.
english: But he who does the truth comes to the light, that his works may be revealed, that they have been done in God.”

kikuyu: Ergasiis Yesuusii fi barattoonni isaa gara biyya Yihuudaa dhaqan; innis isaan wajjin achi ture; ni cuuphes.
english: After these things, Jesus came with his disciples into the land of Judea. He stayed there with them and baptized.

kikuyu: Yohannisis naannoo Saalem iddoo Enoon jedhamutti ni cuupha ture; bishaan baayʼeen achi tureetii; namoonnis achi dhaqanii cuuphamu turan.
english: John also was baptizing in Enon near Salim, because there was much water there. They came and were baptized;

kikuyu: Kunis utuu Yohannis mana hidhaatti hin galfamin taʼe.
english: for John was not yet thrown into prison.

kikuyu: Yommus barattoota Yohannisii fi Yihuudii tokko gidduutti waaʼee qulqulleeffamuu irratti wal falmiin uumame.
english: Therefore a dispute arose on the part of John’s disciples with some Jews about purification.

kikuyu: Isaanis Yohannis bira dhufanii, “Yaa barsiisaa, namichi si wajjin Yordaanos gama ture, kan ati waaʼee isaa dhugaa baate sun kunoo cuuphuutti jira; namni hundis gara isaa dhaquutti jira” jedhaniin.
english: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you have testified, behold, he baptizes, and everyone is coming to him.”

kikuyu: Yohannisis akkana jedhee deebise; “Namni yoo samii irraa isaaf kenname malee homaa fudhachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: John answered, “A man can receive nothing unless it has been given him from heaven.

kikuyu: Akka ani, ‘Ani Kiristoos miti; garuu isa dura nan ergame’ jedhe isin mataan keessan iyyuu dhugaa naa baatu.
english: You yourselves testify that I said, ‘I am not the Christ,’ but, ‘I have been sent before him.’

kikuyu: Misirrittiin kan misirrichaa ti. Miinjeen misirricha bira dhaabatuu fi isa dhaggeeffatu, yommuu sagalee misirrichaa dhagaʼutti akka malee gammada. Gammachuun sun kan koo ti; gammachuun koos amma guutuu taʼeera.
english: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly because of the bridegroom’s voice. Therefore my joy is made full.

kikuyu: Inni guddaa taʼuu qaba; ani immoo xinnaa taʼuun qaba.
english: He must increase, but I must decrease.

kikuyu: “Kan olii dhufu inni hundumaa oli; inni lafaa immoo kanuma lafaa ti; waanuma lafaa dubbatas. Kan samii irraa dhufu inni hundumaa oli.
english: “He who comes from above is above all. He who is from the earth belongs to the earth and speaks of the earth. He who comes from heaven is above all.

kikuyu: Inni waan argee fi waan dhagaʼe dhugaa baʼa; dhuga baʼumsa isaa garuu eenyu iyyuu hin fudhatu.
english: What he has seen and heard, of that he testifies; and no one receives his witness.

kikuyu: Namni dhuga baʼumsa kana fudhates akka Waaqni dhugaa taʼe mirkaneesse.
english: He who has received his witness has set his seal to this, that God is true.

kikuyu: Inni Waaqni erge dubbii Waaqaa dubbata; Waaqnis safara malee Hafuura isaa ni kennaatii.
english: For he whom God has sent speaks the words of God; for God gives the Spirit without measure.

kikuyu: Abbaan Ilma ni jaallata; waan hundas harka isaatti kenneera.
english: The Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.

kikuyu: Namni Ilmatti amanu jireenya bara baraa qaba; namni Ilmaaf hin ajajamne garuu dheekkamsa Waaqaatu isa irra jiraata malee jireenya hin argu.”
english: One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains on him.”

kikuyu: Egaa Yesuus Yohannis caalaa barattoota akka baayʼifatee fi akka cuuphe Fariisonni dhagaʼuu isaanii Gooftaan ni beeke;
english: Therefore when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John

kikuyu: taʼus barattoota isaatu cuuphaa ture malee Yesuus ofii isaatii hin cuuphine.
english: (although Jesus himself didn’t baptize, but his disciples),

kikuyu: Inni Yihuudaa dhiisee amma illee Galiilaatti deebiʼe.
english: he left Judea and departed into Galilee.

kikuyu: Innis Samaariyaa keessa darbuu qaba ture.
english: He needed to pass through Samaria.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu gara magaalaa Samaariyaa kan Siikaar jedhamu tokkoo dhufe; magaalaan sunis lafa Yaaqoob ilma isaa Yoosefiif kenne sanatti dhiʼoo dha.
english: So he came to a city of Samaria called Sychar, near the parcel of ground that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.

kikuyu: Boolli bishaanii kan Yaaqoob tokko achi ture; Yesuusis waan karaa deemuudhaan dadhabeef boolla bishaanii sana bira taaʼe. Yeroonis gara saʼaatii jaʼaa ture.
english: Jacob’s well was there. Jesus therefore, being tired from his journey, sat down by the well. It was about the sixth hour.

kikuyu: Dubartiin Samaariyaa tokkos bishaan waraabbachuu dhufte; Yesuusis, “Mee na obaasi” jedheen.
english: A woman of Samaria came to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaa nyaata bituuf gara magaalaa dhaqanii turaniitii.
english: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.

kikuyu: Dubartiin Samaariyaa sunis Yesuusiin, “Ati utuu Yihuudii taatee jirtuu akkamitti ‘na obaasi’ jettee ana dubartii Samaariyaa kadhatta?” jetteen. Yihuudoonni warra Samaariyaa wajjin walitti dhufeenya hin qaban tureetii.
english: The Samaritan woman therefore said to him, “How is it that you, being a Jew, ask for a drink from me, a Samaritan woman?” (For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.)

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Kennaa Waaqaatii fi inni, ‘na obaasi’ siin jedhu kun eenyu akka taʼe utuu beektee silaa situ isa kadhata ture; innis bishaan jireenyaa siif kenna ture” jedheen.
english: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is who says to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him, and he would have given you living water.”

kikuyu: Dubartittiinis akkana jetteen; “Yaa gooftaa, ati waan ittiin waraabbattu hin qabdu; boolli bishaanii kunis gad fagoo dha. Yoos bishaan jireenyaa eessaa argatta?
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep. So where do you get that living water?

kikuyu: Ati abbaa keenya Yaaqoob isa boolla bishaanii kana nuu kenne caalta moo? Inni mataan isaa, ijoolleen isaatii fi horiin isaa boolla bishaanii kana keessaa dhugaa turan.”
english: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did his children and his livestock?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Namni bishaan kana dhugu hundinuu deebiʼee ni dheebota;
english: Jesus answered her, “Everyone who drinks of this water will thirst again,

kikuyu: garuu namni bishaan ani isaaf kennu dhugu kam iyyuu gonkumaa hin dheebotu. Bishaan ani isaaf kennu isa keessatti burqaa bishaanii isa jireenya bara baraatiif burqu ni taʼa.”
english: but whoever drinks of the water that I will give him will never thirst again; but the water that I will give him will become in him a well of water springing up to eternal life.”

kikuyu: Dubartittiinis, “Yaa Gooftaa, akka ani hin dheebonneef, bishaan waraabuufis akka ani as hin dhufneef bishaan sana naa kenni” jetteen.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, so that I don’t get thirsty, neither come all the way here to draw.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Dhaqiitii dhirsa kee waamii kottu!” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”

kikuyu: Dubartittiin, “Ani dhirsa hin qabu” jetteen. Yesuusis akkana jedheen; “Dhirsa hin qabu jechuun kee sirrii dha;
english: The woman answered, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You said well, ‘I have no husband,’

kikuyu: ati dhirsoota shan qabda turteetii; namichi amma si wajjin jirus dhirsa kee miti. Wanni ati amma dubbate dhugaa dha.”
english: for you have had five husbands; and he whom you now have is not your husband. This you have said truly.”

kikuyu: Dubartittiinis akkana jette; “Yaa Gooftaa, akka ati raajii taate nan hubadha.
english: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.

kikuyu: Abbootiin keenya tulluu kana irratti sagadaa turan; isin Yihuudoonni garuu iddoon namni itti waaqeffachuu qabu Yerusaalem jettu.”
english: Our fathers worshiped in this mountain, and you Jews say that in Jerusalem is the place where people ought to worship.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedheen; “Dubartii nana, na amani; yeroon isin itti tulluu kana irrattis taʼu yookaan Yerusaalemitti Abbaa hin waaqeffanne tokko ni dhufa.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither in this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.

kikuyu: Isin waan hin beekne waaqeffattu; nu sababii fayyinni Yihuudoota keessaa dhufuuf kan beeknu waaqeffanna.
english: You worship that which you don’t know. We worship that which we know; for salvation is from the Jews.

kikuyu: Warri dhugaan waaqeffatan yeroon isaan itti hafuuraa fi dhugaadhaan Abbaa waaqeffatan tokko ni dhufa; amma iyyuu dhufeera; Abbaan warra akkasitti isa waaqeffatan barbaada.
