english: But the hour comes, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for the Father seeks such to be his worshipers.

kikuyu: Waaqni hafuura; warri isa waaqeffatanis Hafuuraa fi dhugaadhaan waaqeffachuu qabu.”
english: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”

kikuyu: Dubartittiinis, “Ani akka Masiihiin Kiristoos jedhamu dhufu nan beeka. Inni yommuu dhufutti waan hunda nutti hima” jetteen.
english: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming, he who is called Christ. When he has come, he will declare to us all things.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Ani, namni amma sitti dubbachaa jiru kun isuma” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to her, “I am he, the one who speaks to you.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaa yommusuma deebiʼanii utuu inni dubartii tokko wajjin dubbatuu arganii dinqisiifatan. Garuu namni, “Maal barbaadda?” yookaan “Maaliif ishee wajjin haasofta?” jedhee isa gaafatu tokko iyyuu hin turre.
english: Just then, his disciples came. They marveled that he was speaking with a woman; yet no one said, “What are you looking for?” or, “Why do you speak with her?”

kikuyu: Dubartiin sunis okkotee ishee dhiiftee gara magaalaatti deebite; namootaanis akkana jette;
english: So the woman left her water pot, went away into the city, and said to the people,

kikuyu: “Kottaatii nama waan ani hojjedhe hunda natti hime tokko ilaalaa! Tarii inni Kiristoos taʼinnaa?”
english: “Come, see a man who told me everything that I have done. Can this be the Christ?”

kikuyu: Isaanis magaalaa keessaa baʼanii Yesuus bira dhufan.
english: They went out of the city, and were coming to him.

kikuyu: Kana gidduutti barattoonni isaa, “Yaa barsiisaa, mee waa nyaadhu!” jedhanii isa kadhatan.
english: In the meanwhile, the disciples urged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”

kikuyu: Inni garuu, “Ani nyaata isin hin beekne kanan nyaadhu qaba” jedheen.
english: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you don’t know about.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaas, “Namatu nyaata fideefii laata?” jedhanii wal gaafatan.
english: The disciples therefore said to one another, “Has anyone brought him something to eat?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedheen; “Nyaanni koo fedhii isa na ergee guutuu fi hojii isaa raawwachuu dha.
english: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to accomplish his work.

kikuyu: Isin, ‘Jiʼa afurtu hafe; ergasii midhaan walitti qabama’ jettu mitii? Kunoo, ani isinittan hima; akka midhaan bilchaatee walitti qabamuu gaʼe mee ol jedhaatii lafa qotiisaa ilaalaa!
english: Don’t you say, ‘There are yet four months until the harvest’? Behold, I tell you, lift up your eyes and look at the fields, that they are white for harvest already.

kikuyu: Inni midhaan haamu amma iyyuu mindaa ni argata; jireenya bara baraatiif ija walitti ni qaba; kunis akka inni facaasuu fi inni walitti qabu waliin gammadaniif.
english: He who reaps receives wages and gathers fruit to eternal life, that both he who sows and he who reaps may rejoice together.

kikuyu: Haala kanaan mammaaksi, ‘Inni tokko ni facaasa; kaan immoo ni haama’ jedhu sun dhugaa dha.
english: For in this the saying is true, ‘One sows, and another reaps.’

kikuyu: Ani akka isin waan itti hin dadhabin haammattaniifan isin erge. Warri kaan itti dadhabaniiru; isin garuu buʼaa dadhabbii isaanii galfattu.”
english: I sent you to reap that for which you haven’t labored. Others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”

kikuyu: Sababii dubartittiin, “Inni waan ani hojjedhe hunda natti hime” jettee dhugaa baateef namoonni Samaariyaa warri magaalaa sanaa baayʼeen isatti amanan.
english: From that city many of the Samaritans believed in him because of the word of the woman, who testified, “He told me everything that I have done.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namoonni Samaariyaa yommuu gara isaa dhufanitti akka inni isaan wajjin turuuf isa kadhatan; innis guyyaa lama achi ture.
english: So when the Samaritans came to him, they begged him to stay with them. He stayed there two days.

kikuyu: Sababii dubbii isaatiinis namoonni biraa baayʼeen isatti amanan.
english: Many more believed because of his word.

kikuyu: Isaanis dubartittiidhaan, “Siʼachi wanni nu amannuuf sababii dubbii ati nutti himte sanaatiif miti; nu mataan keenya iyyuu isa dhageenyeerraatii; akka inni dhugumaan Fayyisaa addunyaa taʼes beekneerra” jedhan.
english: They said to the woman, “Now we believe, not because of your speaking; for we have heard for ourselves, and know that this is indeed the Christ, the Savior of the world.”

kikuyu: Guyyaa lamaan sana booddee Yesuus Galiilaa dhaqe.
english: After the two days he went out from there and went into Galilee.

kikuyu: Yesuus mataan isaa iyyuu akka raajiin tokko biyya isaa keessatti kabaja hin qabne dubbatee tureetii.
english: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.

kikuyu: Yommuu inni Galiilaa gaʼettis warri Galiilaa isa simatan. Isaanis sababii Yerusaalem turaniif waan inni yeroo Ayyaana Faasiikaatti achitti hojjete hunda arganii turan.
english: So when he came into Galilee, the Galileans received him, having seen all the things that he did in Jerusalem at the feast, for they also went to the feast.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu inni deebiʼee gara Qaanaa ishee Galiilaa keessaa iddoo itti bishaan gara daadhii wayiniitti geeddaree ture sanaa dhaqe. Qondaalli mootii kan ilmi isaa dhukkubsate tokkos Qifirnaahom keessa ture.
english: Jesus came therefore again to Cana of Galilee, where he made the water into wine. There was a certain nobleman whose son was sick at Capernaum.

kikuyu: Namichi kunis yommuu akka Yesuus Yihuudaadhaa kaʼee Galiilaa dhufe dhagaʼetti isa bira dhaqee akka inni dhufee ilma isaa kan duʼuu gaʼe sana fayyisu isa kadhate.
english: When he heard that Jesus had come out of Judea into Galilee, he went to him and begged him that he would come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.

kikuyu: Kana irratti Yesuus, “Isin yoo mallattoo fi dinqii argitan malee hin amantan!” isaan jedhe.
english: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you people see signs and wonders, you will in no way believe.”

kikuyu: Qondaaltichis, “Yaa Gooftaa, maaloo utuu mucaan koo hin duʼin naa qaqqabi” jedheen.
english: The nobleman said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Ilmi kee ni jiraataatii gali!” jedheen. Namichis waan Yesuus isatti dubbate amanee deeme.
english: Jesus said to him, “Go your way. Your son lives.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him, and he went his way.

kikuyu: Utuu inni deemaa jiruus tajaajiltoonni isaa itti dhufanii akka ilmi isaa lubbuun jiru itti himan.
english: As he was going down, his servants met him and reported, saying “Your child lives!”

kikuyu: Innis yeroo itti mucaa isaatti wayyaaʼe gaafate; isaanis, “Kaleessa saʼaatii torbatti dhagna gubaan isa dhiise” jedhaniin.
english: So he inquired of them the hour when he began to get better. They said therefore to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour, the fever left him.”

kikuyu: Abbaan mucichaas akka yeroon sun yeroo Yesuus itti, “Ilmi kee ni jiraata” jedheen taʼe hubate. Kanaafuu innis, warri mana isaa hundinuus ni amanan.
english: So the father knew that it was at that hour in which Jesus said to him, “Your son lives.” He believed, as did his whole house.

kikuyu: Kun mallattoo lammaffaa Yesuus erga Yihuudaadhaa Galiilaa dhufee hojjetee dha.
english: This is again the second sign that Jesus did, having come out of Judea into Galilee.

kikuyu: Yeroo xinnoo booddee ayyaana Yihuudootaa tokkotu ture; Yesuusis Yerusaalemitti ol baʼe.
english: After these things, there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yerusaalem keessa Karra Hoolaa bira haroo afaan Ibraayisxiitiin Beetizaataa jedhamu tokkotu jira; haroon sun gardaafoo shan qaba.
english: Now in Jerusalem by the sheep gate, there is a pool, which is called in Hebrew, “Bethesda”, having five porches.

kikuyu: Gardaafoowwan sana keessas namoonni dhukkubsatan, jechuunis jaamonni, warri naafatanii fi warri dhagni irratti duʼe baayʼeen ciisanii raafama bishaanii eeggachaa turan. [
english: In these lay a great multitude of those who were sick, blind, lame, or paralyzed, waiting for the moving of the water;

kikuyu: Ergamaan Gooftaa yeroo yerootti gad buʼee bishaanicha ni raasa ture; raafama bishaanichaa booddee namni jalqabatti bishaan sana keessa seenu kam iyyuu dhukkuba qabu hunda irraa ni fayya ture.]
english: for an angel went down at certain times into the pool and stirred up the water. Whoever stepped in first after the stirring of the water was healed of whatever disease he had.

kikuyu: Namichi waggaa soddomii saddeeti dhukkubsate tokko achi ture.
english: A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu isaa achi ciisu argee akka inni yeroo dheeraa haala kana keessa ture beeketti, “Ati fayyuu barbaaddaa?” jedhee isa gaafate.
english: When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made well?”

kikuyu: Dhukkubsataan sunis, “Yaa Gooftaa, ani nama na gargaaree yommuu bishaanichi raafamutti haroo sana keessa na buusu hin qabu. Yeroo ani seenuu yaaluttis namni biraa na dursee seena” jedheen.
english: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no one to put me into the pool when the water is stirred up, but while I’m coming, another steps down before me.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Yesuus, “Kaʼi! Siree kee fudhadhuutii deemi” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “Arise, take up your mat, and walk.”

kikuyu: Namichis yeruma sana fayye; siree isaas fudhatee deeme. Guyyaan wanni kun taʼe sunis Sanbata ture;
english: Immediately, the man was made well, and took up his mat and walked. Now that day was a Sabbath.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis namicha fayye sanaan, “Harʼa Sanbata; seerri siree kee baachuu si dhowwa” jedhaniin.
english: So the Jews said to him who was cured, “It is the Sabbath. It is not lawful for you to carry the mat.”

kikuyu: Inni garuu, “Namicha na fayyisetu ‘Siree kee fudhadhuu deemi’ naan jedhe” jedheen.
english: He answered them, “He who made me well said to me, ‘Take up your mat and walk.’ ”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Namichi siree kee fudhadhuu deemi siin jedhe sun eenyu?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: Then they asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your mat and walk’?”

kikuyu: Namichi fayye sun sababii Yesuus achi hiiqee tuuta iddoo sana ture keessa seeneef inni eenyu akka taʼe hin beekne.
english: But he who was healed didn’t know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, a crowd being in the place.

kikuyu: Yesuusis ergasii namicha sana mana qulqullummaa keessatti argee, “Ati kunoo amma fayyiteerta. Wanni kana caalu akka sitti hin dhufneef siʼachi cubbuu hin hojjetin” jedheen.
english: Afterward Jesus found him in the temple and said to him, “Behold, you are made well. Sin no more, so that nothing worse happens to you.”

kikuyu: Namichis dhaqee kan isa fayyise Yesuus akka taʼe Yihuudootatti hime.
english: The man went away, and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had made him well.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu sababii inni Sanbataan waan kana hojjeteef, Yihuudoonni Yesuusin ariʼachuu jalqaban.
english: For this cause the Jews persecuted Jesus and sought to kill him, because he did these things on the Sabbath.

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu, “Abbaan koo hamma ammaatti hojjechaa jira; anis hojjechaan jira” isaaniin jedhe.
english: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is still working, so I am working, too.”

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf Yihuudoonni ittuma caalchisanii isa ajjeesuu barbaadan; inni Waaqaan of qixxeessuudhaan Waaqa iyyuu Abbaa ofii isaa godhee waamaa ture malee Sanbata qofa hin cabsine.
english: For this cause therefore the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the Sabbath, but also called God his own Father, making himself equal with God.

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; Ilmi ofii isaatiin waan tokko illee hojjechuu hin dandaʼu; inni waanuma utuu Abbaan isaa hojjetuu arge qofa hojjechuu dandaʼa; waanuma Abbaan hojjetu Ilmis akkasuma hojjetaatii.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “Most certainly, I tell you, the Son can do nothing of himself, but what he sees the Father doing. For whatever things he does, these the Son also does likewise.

kikuyu: Abbaan Ilma ni jaallataatii; waan hojjetu hundumas isatti ni argisiisa. Akka isin dinqisiifattaniifis inni hojiiwwan hojiiwwan kanneen caalan iyyuu isatti ni argisiisa.
english: For the Father has affection for the Son, and shows him all things that he himself does. He will show him greater works than these, that you may marvel.

kikuyu: Akkuma Abbaan warra duʼan duʼaa kaasee jireenya kennuuf sana, Ilmis akkasuma abbaa fedheef jireenya ni kenna.
english: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son also gives life to whom he desires.

kikuyu: Abbaan eenyutti illee hin muru; murtii hunda garuu Ilmatti kenneera;
english: For the Father judges no one, but he has given all judgment to the Son,

kikuyu: kunis akka namni hundi akkuma Abbaaf ulfina kennutti Ilmaafis ulfina kennuuf. Namni Ilmaaf ulfina hin kennine, Abbaa isa Ilma ergeefis ulfina hin kennu.
english: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who doesn’t honor the Son doesn’t honor the Father who sent him.

kikuyu: “Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; namni dubbii koo dhagaʼu, isa na ergettis kan amanu hundi jireenya bara baraa qaba; murtiittis hin dhiʼaatu; inni duʼa jalaa gara jireenyaatti darbeera.
english: “Most certainly I tell you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life, and doesn’t come into judgment, but has passed out of death into life.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; yeroon warri duʼan itti sagalee Ilma Waaqaa dhagaʼan tokko ni dhufa; ammuma iyyuu dhufeera; warri dhagaʼanis ni jiraatu.
english: Most certainly I tell you, the hour comes, and now is, when the dead will hear the Son of God’s voice; and those who hear will live.

kikuyu: Akkuma Abbaan ofuma isaatiin jireenya qabu sana, Ilmis akkasuma akka ofuma isaatiin jireenya qabaatuuf isaaf kenneeraatii.
english: For as the Father has life in himself, even so he gave to the Son also to have life in himself.

kikuyu: Sababii inni Ilma Namaa taʼeefis Abbaan akka inni murtii kennuuf taayitaa isaaf kenneera.
english: He also gave him authority to execute judgment, because he is a son of man.

kikuyu: “Kana hin dinqisiifatinaa; saʼaatiin itti warri awwaala keessa jiran hundi sagalee isaa dhagaʼan tokko ni dhufaatii.
english: Don’t marvel at this, for the hour comes in which all who are in the tombs will hear his voice

kikuyu: Warri waan gaarii hojjetan duʼaa kaʼuu jireenyaatiif, warri waan hamaa hojjetan immoo duʼaa kaʼuu murtiitiif duʼaa ni kaʼu.
english: and will come out; those who have done good, to the resurrection of life; and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.

kikuyu: Ani ofii kootiin waan tokko illee gochuu hin dandaʼu; ani akkuman dhagaʼutti nan murteessa; ani fedhii isa na ergee malee fedhii mataa kootii waan hin barbaanneef murtiin koo qajeelaa dha.
english: I can of myself do nothing. As I hear, I judge; and my judgment is righteous, because I don’t seek my own will, but the will of my Father who sent me.

kikuyu: “Ani yoon waaʼee ofii kootii dhugaa baʼe, dhuga baʼumsi koo dhugaa miti.
english: “If I testify about myself, my witness is not valid.

kikuyu: Garuu kan waaʼee koo dhugaa baʼu biraa jira; anis akka dhuga baʼumsi inni waaʼee koo kennu sun dhugaa taʼe beeka.
english: It is another who testifies about me. I know that the testimony which he testifies about me is true.

kikuyu: “Isin Yohannisitti ergitaniirtu; innis dhugaa sanaaf, dhugaa baʼeera.
english: You have sent to John, and he has testified to the truth.

kikuyu: Ani dhuga baʼumsa namaa hin fudhadhu; garuu akka isin fayyitaniif wantoota kanneen nan dubbadha.
english: But the testimony which I receive is not from man. However, I say these things that you may be saved.

kikuyu: Yohannis ibsaa bobaʼee ifa kennu ture; isinis yeroo xinnoo ifa isaatti gammaduu barbaaddan.
english: He was the burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.

kikuyu: “Ani garuu dhuga baʼumsa, dhuga baʼumsa Yohannis sana caalu qaba. Hojiin akka ani raawwadhuuf Abbaan natti kenne, kan ani hojjedhu kun iyyuu akka Abbaan na erge mirkaneessaatii.
english: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father gave me to accomplish, the very works that I do, testify about me, that the Father has sent me.

kikuyu: Abbaan inni na erges ofii isaatii waaʼee koo dhugaa baʼeera. Isin takkumaa sagalee isaa hin dhageenye; bifa isaas takkumaa hin argine.
english: The Father himself, who sent me, has testified about me. You have neither heard his voice at any time, nor seen his form.

kikuyu: Isin sababii isa inni erge hin amaniniif dubbiin isaa isin keessa hin jiraatu.
english: You don’t have his word living in you, because you don’t believe him whom he sent.

kikuyu: Isin Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluudhaan jireenya bara baraa arganna jettanii waan yaaddaniif Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluu sana qorattu. Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluun kunneenis waaʼee koo dhugaa baʼu;
english: “You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and these are they which testify about me.

kikuyu: isin garuu jireenya argachuudhaaf gara koo dhufuu hin barbaaddan.
english: Yet you will not come to me, that you may have life.

kikuyu: “Ani nama irraa ulfina hin fudhadhu;
english: I don’t receive glory from men.

kikuyu: garuu akka isin jaalala Waaqaa of keessaa hin qabne nan beeka.
english: But I know you, that you don’t have God’s love in yourselves.

kikuyu: Ani maqaa Abbaa kootiin dhufeera; isin na hin simattan; utuu namni biraa maqaa ofii isaatiin dhufee garuu isa ni simattu.
english: I have come in my Father’s name, and you don’t receive me. If another comes in his own name, you will receive him.

kikuyu: Isin yoo wal irraa ulfina argattanii ulfina Waaqa tokkicha biraa dhufu garuu hin barbaanne akkamitti amanuu dandeessu ree?
english: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another, and you don’t seek the glory that comes from the only God?

kikuyu: “Waan ani Abbaa duratti isin himadhu hin seʼinaa. Kan isin himatu tokko jira; innis Musee isin abdattan sana.
english: “Don’t think that I will accuse you to the Father. There is one who accuses you, even Moses, on whom you have set your hope.

kikuyu: Utuu Musee amantanii silaa anas ni amantu ture; inni waaʼee koo barreesseetii.
english: For if you believed Moses, you would believe me; for he wrote about me.

kikuyu: Isin erga waan inni barreesse hin amannee, dubbii koo immoo akkamitti amantu ree?”
english: But if you don’t believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”

kikuyu: Wantoota kanneen booddee Yesuus Galaana Galiilaa isa Galaana Xibeeriyaas jedhamu gama ceʼe;
english: After these things, Jesus went away to the other side of the sea of Galilee, which is also called the Sea of Tiberias.

kikuyu: namoonni baayʼeenis sababii mallattoo inni warra dhukkubsatan fayyisuudhaan hojjete arganiif isa duukaa buʼan.
english: A great multitude followed him, because they saw his signs which he did on those who were sick.

kikuyu: Yesuusis barattoota isaa wajjin gaaratti ol baʼee taaʼe.
english: Jesus went up into the mountain, and he sat there with his disciples.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana Ayyaanni Yihuudootaa, Faasiikaan dhiʼaatee ture.
english: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu ol ilaaletti tuuta guddaa gara isaa dhufaa jiru tokko arge; Fiiliphoosiinis, “Namoota kanneeniif buddeena isaan nyaatan eessaa bitanna?” jedhe.
english: Jesus therefore, lifting up his eyes and seeing that a great multitude was coming to him, said to Philip, “Where are we to buy bread, that these may eat?”

kikuyu: Kanas Fiiliphoosin qoruudhaaf jedhee gaafate; inni mataan isaa waan gochuu qabu beeka tureetii.
english: He said this to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.

kikuyu: Fiiliphoos immoo, “Akka tokkoon tokkoon isaanii waanuma xinnoo illee argataniif buddeena gaʼu bituuf diinaarii dhibba lama fudhata” jedhee deebiseef.
english: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii worth of bread is not sufficient for them, that every one of them may receive a little.”

kikuyu: Barattoota isaa keessaa tokko Indiriiyaas, obboleessi Simoon Phexros akkana jedheen;
english: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,

kikuyu: “Gurbaan buddeena garbuu shanii fi qurxummii lama qabu tokko kunoo ti; garuu nama akkana baayʼatu kanaaf kun maali?”
english: “There is a boy here who has five barley loaves and two fish, but what are these among so many?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Namoota teessisaa” jedhe. Iddoo sanas marga baayʼeetu ture; namoonnis ni tataaʼan; dhiira gara kuma shantu achi ture.
english: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in that place. So the men sat down, in number about five thousand.

kikuyu: Yesuusis ergasii buddeena fuudhee, galata galchee warra tataaʼaniif hamma isaan barbaadan qoqqoode. Qurxummii sana illee akkasuma godhe.
english: Jesus took the loaves, and having given thanks, he distributed to the disciples, and the disciples to those who were sitting down, likewise also of the fish as much as they desired.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu isaan hundi nyaatanii quufanitti barattoota isaatiin, “Hurraaʼaa hambifame walitti qabaa. Wanni tokko iyyuu hin badin” jedhe.
english: When they were filled, he said to his disciples, “Gather up the broken pieces which are left over, that nothing be lost.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isaan hurraaʼaa buddeena garbuu shananii kan namoonni nyaatanii hambisan walitti qabanii gundoo kudha lama guutan.
english: So they gathered them up, and filled twelve baskets with broken pieces from the five barley loaves, which were left over by those who had eaten.

kikuyu: Namoonnis yommuu mallattoo Yesuus hojjete arganitti, “Kun dhugumaanuu Raajii gara addunyaa dhufuuf jiru” jedhan.
english: When therefore the people saw the sign which Jesus did, they said, “This is truly the prophet who comes into the world.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akka namoonni sun dhufanii humnaan qabanii mootii isa gochuu yaadan hubatee ammas kophaa isaa gara tulluu deeme.
english: Jesus therefore, perceiving that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, withdrew again to the mountain by himself.

kikuyu: Yommuu galgalaaʼetti barattoonni isaa gara galaanaatti gad buʼan;
english: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea.

kikuyu: achittis bidiruu yaabbatanii galaana irra gama Qifirnaahomitti qajeelan. Yeroon sun dukkana ture; Yesuus amma iyyuu gara isaanii hin dhufne ture.
english: They entered into the boat, and were going over the sea to Capernaum. It was now dark, and Jesus had not come to them.

kikuyu: Bubbeen jabaan isaa waan bubbisaa tureef bishaanichi ni raafame.
english: The sea was tossed by a great wind blowing.

kikuyu: Isaanis erga gara kiiloo meetira shanii yookaan jaʼaa mooqanii booddee utuu Yesuus galaana irra deemaa, bidiruu sanattis dhiʼaachaa jiruu argan; ni sodaatanis.
english: When therefore they had rowed about twenty-five or thirty stadia, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat; and they were afraid.

kikuyu: Inni garuu, “Anumaatii hin sodaatinaa” jedheen.
english: But he said to them, “It is I. Don’t be afraid.”

kikuyu: Isaanis bidiruutti ol isa fudhachuu barbaadan; bidiruun sunis yommusuma lafa isaan dhaqaa turan sana gaʼe.
english: They were willing therefore to receive him into the boat. Immediately the boat was at the land where they were going.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti namoonni galaanicha gamatti hafanii turan akka bidiruun tokko qofti achi ture, akka Yesuus barattoota isaa wajjin bidiruu hin yaabbatinii fi akka isaan kophaa isaanii deeman hubatan.
english: On the next day, the multitude that stood on the other side of the sea saw that there was no other boat there, except the one in which his disciples had embarked, and that Jesus hadn’t entered with his disciples into the boat, but his disciples had gone away alone.

kikuyu: Bidiruuwwan biraa Xibeeriyaasii kaʼanii iddoo itti Gooftaan galata galchee isaanis itti buddeena nyaatan sana bira gaʼan.
english: However, boats from Tiberias came near to the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis yommuu akka Yesuusii fi barattoonni isaa achi hin jirre baranitti bidiruuwwan yaabbatanii Yesuusin barbaaduuf Qifirnaahom dhaqan.
english: When the multitude therefore saw that Jesus wasn’t there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and came to Capernaum, seeking Jesus.

kikuyu: Namoonni yommuu galaanicha gamatti isa arganitti, “Yaa Barsiisaa, ati yoom as dhufte?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; isin waan mallattoo argitaniif utuu hin taʼin, waan buddeena nyaattanii quuftaniif na barbaaddu.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate of the loaves and were filled.

kikuyu: Nyaata jireenya bara baraatiif taʼu kan Ilmi Namaa isinii kennuuf dadhabaa malee nyaata baduuf hin dadhabinaa. Waaqni Abbaan chaappaa isaa kan mirkaneessu Ilma irratti rukuteeraatii.”
english: Don’t work for the food which perishes, but for the food which remains to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give to you. For God the Father has sealed him.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Nu akka hojii Waaqaa hojjennuuf maal gochuu qabna?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: They said therefore to him, “What must we do, that we may work the works of God?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Isa inni ergetti amanuun keessan kun hojii Waaqaa ti” jedhee deebiseef.
english: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isaan akkana jedhanii isa gaafatan; “Akka nu isa arginee si amannuuf, mallattoo maalii argisiifta? Maal hojjettas?
english: They said therefore to him, “What then do you do for a sign, that we may see and believe you? What work do you do?

kikuyu: ‘Akka isaan nyaataniif samii irraa buddeena isaaniif kenne’ jedhamee akkuma barreeffame, abbootiin keenya gammoojjii keessatti mannaa nyaatan.”
english: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness. As it is written, ‘He gave them bread out of heaven to eat.’”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedheen; “Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; kan samii irraa buddeena isinii kenne Musee miti; kan samii irraa buddeena dhugaa isiniif kennu garuu Abbaa koo ti.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, it wasn’t Moses who gave you the bread out of heaven, but my Father gives you the true bread out of heaven.

kikuyu: Buddeenni Waaqaa isa samii irraa gad buʼee addunyaaf jireenya kennu sanaatii.”
english: For the bread of God is that which comes down out of heaven and gives life to the world.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Yaa Gooftaa, yeroo hunda buddeena kana nuu kenni” jedhaniin.
english: They said therefore to him, “Lord, always give us this bread.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Buddeenni jireenyaa ana. Namni gara koo dhufu gonkumaa hin beelaʼu; kan anatti amanus gonkumaa hin dheebotu.
english: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will not be hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.

kikuyu: Akkuma ani isinitti hime isin na argitaniirtu; garuu amma iyyuu hin amantan.
english: But I told you that you have seen me, and yet you don’t believe.

kikuyu: Kan Abbaan naa kennu hundi gara koo ni dhufa; anis kan gara koo dhufu gonkumaa alatti hin ariʼu.
english: All those whom the Father gives me will come to me. He who comes to me I will in no way throw out.

kikuyu: Ani fedhii isa na erge sanaa guutuuf malee, fedhii koo guutachuuf samii irraa gad hin buuneetii.
english: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me.

kikuyu: Fedhiin isa na ergees akka ani warra inni natti kenne hunda guyyaa dhumaatti duʼaa kaasuuf malee akka ani isaan keessaa tokko illee balleessuuf miti.
english: This is the will of my Father who sent me, that of all he has given to me I should lose nothing, but should raise him up at the last day.

kikuyu: Fedhiin Abbaa kootiis akka namni Ilma ilaalee isatti amanu hundi jireenya bara baraa qabaatuuf; anis guyyaa dhumaatti duʼaa isa nan kaasa.”
english: This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Yihuudoonni sababii inni, “Ani buddeena samii irraa gad buʼee dha” jedheef isatti guungumuu jalqaban.
english: The Jews therefore murmured concerning him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down out of heaven.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Kun Yesuus ilma Yoosef, isa nu abbaa fi haadha isaa beeknu sana mitii? Yoos inni akkamitti, ‘Ani samii irraa gad buʼeera’ jedha ree?” jedhan.
english: They said, “Isn’t this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How then does he say, ‘I have come down out of heaven’?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Walitti hin guunguminaa.
english: Therefore Jesus answered them, “Don’t murmur among yourselves.

kikuyu: Abbaan na erge sun isa harkisuu baannaan namni kam iyyuu gara koo dhufuu hin dandaʼu; anis guyyaa dhumaatti duʼaa isa nan kaasa.
english: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up in the last day.

kikuyu: Raajota keessatti, ‘Isaan hundi warra Waaqa irraa baratan ni taʼu’jedhamee barreeffameera. Namni Abbaa irraa dhagaʼee fi kan isa irraa barate hundi gara koo ni dhufa.
english: It is written in the prophets, ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Therefore everyone who hears from the Father and has learned, comes to me.

kikuyu: Isa Waaqa biraa dhufe sana malee namni tokko iyyuu Abbaa hin argine; isa qofatu Abbaa arge.
english: Not that anyone has seen the Father, except he who is from God. He has seen the Father.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; kan amanu jireenya bara baraa qaba.
english: Most certainly, I tell you, he who believes in me has eternal life.

kikuyu: Buddeenni jireenyaa ana.
english: I am the bread of life.

kikuyu: Abbootiin keessan gammoojjii keessatti mannaa nyaatan; taʼus ni duʼan.
english: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness and they died.

kikuyu: Buddeenni samii irraa gad buʼe garuu isa kana; namni isa nyaatu gonkumaa hin duʼu.
english: This is the bread which comes down out of heaven, that anyone may eat of it and not die.

kikuyu: Buddeenni jiraataan samii irraa buʼe ana. Namni kam iyyuu yoo buddeena kana irraa nyaate bara baraan ni jiraata. Buddeenni ani jireenya addunyaatiif kennus foon koo ti.”
english: I am the living bread which came down out of heaven. If anyone eats of this bread, he will live forever. Yes, the bread which I will give for the life of the world is my flesh.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis, “Namichi kun akkamitti akka nu nyaannuuf foon isaa nuu kennuu dandaʼa?” jedhanii wal falman.
english: The Jews therefore contended with one another, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedheen; “Ani dhuguman isinitti hima; isin foon Ilma Namaa nyaachuu baannaan, dhiiga isaas dhuguu baannaan ofii keessaniin jireenya hin qabdan.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Most certainly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you don’t have life in yourselves.

kikuyu: Namni foon koo nyaatuu fi dhiiga koo dhugu jireenya bara baraa qaba. Anis guyyaa dhumaatti duʼaa isa nan kaasa.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.

kikuyu: Foon koo nyaata dhugaatii; dhiigni koos dhugaatii dhugaa ti.
english: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.

kikuyu: Namni foon koo nyaatuu fi dhiiga koo dhugu hundi na keessa jiraata; anis isa keessa nan jiraadha.
english: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood lives in me, and I in him.

kikuyu: Akkuma Abbaan jiraataan na ergee anis sababii Abbaatiin jiraadhu sana, namni na nyaatus sababii kootiin ni jiraata.
english: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who feeds on me will also live because of me.

kikuyu: Buddeenni samii irraa buʼe isa kana; innis kan akka mannaa Abbootiin keessan nyaatanii duʼan sanaa miti; namni buddeena kana nyaatu bara baraan ni jiraata.”
english: This is the bread which came down out of heaven—not as our fathers ate the manna and died. He who eats this bread will live forever.”

kikuyu: Innis Qifirnaahomitti utuu mana sagadaa keessatti barsiisaa jiruu waan kana dubbate.
english: He said these things in the synagogue, as he taught in Capernaum.

kikuyu: Barattoota isaa keessaa baayʼeen yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti, “Barsiisni kun cimaa dha; eenyutu fudhachuu dandaʼa?” jedhan.
english: Therefore many of his disciples, when they heard this, said, “This is a hard saying! Who can listen to it?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akka barattoonni isaa waaʼee waan kanaa guunguman hubatee akkana jedheen; “Kun isin gufachiisaa ree?
english: But Jesus knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at this, said to them, “Does this cause you to stumble?

kikuyu: Yoos yoo utuu Ilmi Namaa iddoo dur turetti ol baʼuu argitan akkam taʼinna ree?
english: Then what if you would see the Son of Man ascending to where he was before?

kikuyu: Kan jireenya kennu Hafuura; foon faayidaa hin qabu. Dubbiin ani isinitti dubbadhe Hafuura; jireenyas.
english: It is the spirit who gives life. The flesh profits nothing. The words that I speak to you are spirit, and are life.

kikuyu: Isin keessas warri hin amanne tokko tokko jiru.” Yesuus jalqabumaa kaasee isaan keessaa eenyu akka hin amaninii fi eenyu akka dabarsee isa kennu ni beeka tureetii.
english: But there are some of you who don’t believe.” For Jesus knew from the beginning who they were who didn’t believe, and who it was who would betray him.

kikuyu: Innis ittuma fufee, “Sababiin ani, ‘Yoo Abbaa biraa isaaf kenname malee namni kam iyyuu gara koo dhufuu hin dandaʼu’ isiniin jedheefis kanuma” jedhe.
english: He said, “For this cause I have said to you that no one can come to me, unless it is given to him by my Father.”

kikuyu: Yeroo kanaa jalqabee barattoota isaa keessaa baayʼeen duubatti deebiʼan; ergasiis isa wajjin hin deemne.
english: At this, many of his disciples went back and walked no more with him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis warra Kudha Lamaaniin, “Isinis deemuu barbaadduu?” jedhee gaafate.
english: Jesus said therefore to the twelve, “You don’t also want to go away, do you?”

kikuyu: Simoon Phexrosis akkana jedhee deebise; “Yaa Gooftaa, gara eenyuu deemna? Ati dubbii jireenya bara baraa qabdaa.
english: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.

kikuyu: Nu akka ati Qulqullicha Waaqaa taate amanneerra; beekneerras.”
english: We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Anumatu Kudha Lamaan keessan filate mitii? Taʼus isin keessaa inni tokko diiyaabiloosii dha!” jedhe.
english: Jesus answered them, “Didn’t I choose you, the twelve, and one of you is a devil?”

kikuyu: Innis waaʼee Yihuudaa ilma Simoon Keeriyotichaa dubbate; Yihuudaan warra Kudha Lamaan keessaa tokko taʼus Yesuusin dabarsee kennuuf tureetii!
english: Now he spoke of Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, for it was he who would betray him, being one of the twelve.

kikuyu: Kana booddee Yesuus Galiilaa keessa deddeebiʼaa ture; sababii Yihuudoonni isa ajjeesuu barbaadaniif inni Yihuudaa keessa hin deddeebine.
english: After these things, Jesus was walking in Galilee, for he wouldn’t walk in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.

kikuyu: Ayyaanni Daasii Yihuudootaa dhiʼaatee ture.
english: Now the feast of the Jews, the Feast of Booths, was at hand.

kikuyu: Obboloonni isaas akkana jedhaniin; “Akka barattoonni kee warri achii waan ati hojjettu arganiif kaʼiitii Yihuudaa dhaqi.
english: His brothers therefore said to him, “Depart from here and go into Judea, that your disciples also may see your works which you do.

kikuyu: Namni utuu ifaan ifatti beekamuu barbaaduu dhoksaatti waa hojjetu hin jiruutii. Atis sababii waan kana hojjettuuf addunyaatti of mulʼisi.”
english: For no one does anything in secret while he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, reveal yourself to the world.”

kikuyu: Obboloonni isaa iyyuu isatti hin amanne tureetii.
english: For even his brothers didn’t believe in him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedheen; “Yeroon koo amma illee hin geenye; isiniif garuu yeroon hundi mijaaʼaa dha.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always ready.

kikuyu: Addunyaan isin jibbuu hin dandaʼu; ana garuu akka hojiin isaa hamaa taʼe waanan itti dhugaa baʼuuf na jibba.
english: The world can’t hate you, but it hates me, because I testify about it, that its works are evil.

kikuyu: Isin gara Ayyaana sanaa dhaqaa. Ani garuu waan yeroon koo amma illee hin gaʼiniif gara Ayyaanichaatti ol hin baʼu.”
english: You go up to the feast. I am not yet going up to this feast, because my time is not yet fulfilled.”

kikuyu: Inni waan kana isaanitti dubbatee Galiilaatti hafe.
english: Having said these things to them, he stayed in Galilee.

kikuyu: Garuu erga obboloonni isaa gara Ayyaanichaatti ol baʼanii booddee innis utuu ifaan ifatti hin taʼin dhoksaadhaan ol baʼe.
english: But when his brothers had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly, but as it were in secret.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis Ayyaanicha irratti, “Namichi sun eessa jira?” jedhanii gaafachaa isa barbaadaa turan.
english: The Jews therefore sought him at the feast, and said, “Where is he?”

kikuyu: Namoota gidduuttis waaʼee isaa guungummii guddaatu ture. Namoonni tokko tokko, “Inni nama gaarii dha” jedhan. Warri kaan immoo, “Akkas miti; inni nama dogoggorsa” jedhan.
english: There was much murmuring among the multitudes concerning him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others said, “Not so, but he leads the multitude astray.”

kikuyu: Garuu waan Yihuudoota sodaataniif namni tokko iyyuu ifaan ifatti waaʼee isaa hin dubbanne.
english: Yet no one spoke openly of him for fear of the Jews.

kikuyu: Gara walakkaa Ayyaanichaattis Yesuus mana qulqullummaa seenee barsiisuu jalqabe.
english: But when it was now the middle of the feast, Jesus went up into the temple and taught.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis dinqifatanii, “Namichi kun akkamitti utuu hin baratin beekumsa akkanaa qabaate?” jedhan.
english: The Jews therefore marveled, saying, “How does this man know letters, having never been educated?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Barsiisni koo kan isa na ergeeti malee kan koo miti.
english: Jesus therefore answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me.

kikuyu: Namni fedhii Waaqaa gochuu barbaadu kam iyyuu barsiisni koo Waaqa biraa dhufuu fi dhufuu baachuu isaa yookaan ani ofuma kootiin dubbachuu fi dubbachuu baachuu koo ni beeka.
english: If anyone desires to do his will, he will know about the teaching, whether it is from God or if I am speaking from myself.

kikuyu: Namni ofuma isaatiin dubbatu inni ofuma isaatii ulfina argachuu barbaada; namni ulfina kan isa erge sanaa barbaadu garuu inni nama dhugaa ti; jalʼinnis isa keessa hin jiru.
english: He who speaks from himself seeks his own glory, but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and no unrighteousness is in him.

kikuyu: Museen seera isinii kenneera mitii? Isin keessaa garuu namni tokko iyyuu seera sana hin eegu. Isin maaliif na ajjeesuu barbaaddu?”
english: Didn’t Moses give you the law, and yet none of you keeps the law? Why do you seek to kill me?”

kikuyu: Jarris deebisanii, “Hafuura hamaatu si keessa jira; eenyutu si ajjeesuu barbaada?” jedhaniin.
english: The multitude answered, “You have a demon! Who seeks to kill you?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee akkana jedheen; “Ani hojii tokko hojjennaan hundi keessan dinqifattan.
english: Jesus answered them, “I did one work and you all marvel because of it.

kikuyu: Museen seera dhagna qabaa isinii kenne; dhagna qabaa garuu abbootiitu jalqabe malee Musee miti; isinis Sanbataan nama dhagna qabdu.
english: Moses has given you circumcision (not that it is of Moses, but of the fathers), and on the Sabbath you circumcise a boy.

kikuyu: Akka seerri Musee hin cabneef erga namni tokko Sanbataan dhagna qabachuu dandaʼee, isin maaliif sababii ani Sanbataan dhagna namaa guutuu fayyiseef natti aartu?
english: If a boy receives circumcision on the Sabbath, that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because I made a man completely healthy on the Sabbath?

kikuyu: Murtii qajeelaa kennaa malee, bifa qofa ilaaltanii hin murteessinaa.”
english: Don’t judge according to appearance, but judge righteous judgment.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti namoota Yerusaalem keessaa tokko tokko akkana jedhan; “Inni kun namicha isaan ajjeesuuf barbaadan sana mitii?
english: Therefore some of them of Jerusalem said, “Isn’t this he whom they seek to kill?

kikuyu: Kunoo inni ifatti baʼee dubbata; isaanis homaa isaan hin jenne. Abbootiin taayitaa akka inni Kiristoos taʼe sirriitti beekaniiruu laata?
english: Behold, he speaks openly, and they say nothing to him. Can it be that the rulers indeed know that this is truly the Christ?

kikuyu: Taʼus namichi kun nama eessaa akka taʼe nu beekna. Kiristoos yommuu dhufutti garuu inni eessaa akka dhufu namni tokko iyyuu hin beeku.”
english: However, we know where this man comes from, but when the Christ comes, no one will know where he comes from.”

kikuyu: Yesuus utuu mana qulqullummaa keessatti barsiisuu sagalee isaa ol fudhatee akkana jedhe; “Isin na beektu; akka ani eessaa dhufe illee beektu. Ani ofii kootiin hin dhufne; inni na erge sun dhuga qabeessa. Isin garuu isa hin beektan;
english: Jesus therefore cried out in the temple, teaching and saying, “You both know me, and know where I am from. I have not come of myself, but he who sent me is true, whom you don’t know.

kikuyu: ani garuu sababiin isa biraa dhufee fi sababii inni na ergeef isa nan beeka.”
english: I know him, because I am from him, and he sent me.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti isaan isa qabuu yaalan; garuu waan saʼaatiin isaa hin gaʼiniif namni tokko iyyuu harkaan isa hin tuqne.
english: They sought therefore to take him; but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.

kikuyu: Taʼus namoonni baayʼeen isatti amanan. Isaanis, “Kiristoos yommuu dhufutti namicha kana caalaa mallattoo hojjetaa?” jedhan.
english: But of the multitude, many believed in him. They said, “When the Christ comes, he won’t do more signs than those which this man has done, will he?”

kikuyu: Fariisonnis utuu namoonni waaʼee isaa waan akkanaa guungumanuu dhagaʼan. Luboonni hangafoonnii fi Fariisonni Yesuusin qabsiisuudhaaf eegdota mana qulqullummaa ergan.
english: The Pharisees heard the multitude murmuring these things concerning him, and the chief priests and the Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedheen; “Ani yeroo gabaabaa isin wajjin jira; ergasii gara isa na erge sanaa nan dhaqa.
english: Then Jesus said, “I will be with you a little while longer, then I go to him who sent me.

kikuyu: Isin na barbaaddu; garuu na hin argattan; iddoo ani jirus dhufuu hin dandeessan.”
english: You will seek me and won’t find me. You can’t come where I am.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis akkana waliin jedhan; “Namichi kun akka nu isa hin argineef eessa dhaquu yaade laata? Gara saba keenya warra Giriikota keessa faffacaʼanii dhaqee Giriikota barsiisaa?
english: The Jews therefore said among themselves, “Where will this man go that we won’t find him? Will he go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?

kikuyu: ‘Isin na barbaaddu; garuu na hin argattan; iddoo ani jirus dhufuu hin dandeessan’ jechuun isaas maal jechuu isaatii?”
english: What is this word that he said, ‘You will seek me, and won’t find me;’ and ‘Where I am, you can’t come’?”

kikuyu: Guyyaa Ayyaanichi itti hobbaʼu, guyyaa guddaa sana, Yesuus kaʼee dhaabatee sagalee guddaadhaan akkana jedhe; “Eenyu iyyuu yoo dheebote, gara koo dhufee haa dhugu.
english: Now on the last and greatest day of the feast, Jesus stood and cried out, “If anyone is thirsty, let him come to me and drink!

kikuyu: Akkuma Katabbiin Qulqulluun jedhe nama natti amanu kam iyyuu laga bishaan jireenyaatu garaa isaa keessaa burqa.”
english: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, from within him will flow rivers of living water.”

kikuyu: Kunis waaʼee Hafuura Qulqulluu warri isatti amanan argachuuf jiranii dubbachuu isaa ti. Sababii Yesuus amma illee ulfina hin argatiniif Hafuuri Qulqulluun hamma yeroo sanaatti hin kennamne tureetii.
english: But he said this about the Spirit, which those believing in him were to receive. For the Holy Spirit was not yet given, because Jesus wasn’t yet glorified.

kikuyu: Namoota sana keessaa tokko tokko yommuu dubbii kana dhagaʼanitti, “Kun dhugumaanuu Raajicha” jedhan.
english: Many of the multitude therefore, when they heard these words, said, “This is truly the prophet.”

kikuyu: Warri kaan immoo, “Inni Kiristoosii dha” jedhan. Namoonni kaanis akkana jedhan; “Kiristoos Galiilaadhaa dhufaa?
english: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “What, does the Christ come out of Galilee?

kikuyu: Akka Kiristoos sanyii Daawit keessaa dhalatuu fi akka inni Beetlihemii, ganda Daawitii dhufu Katabbiin Qulqulluun ni dubbata mitii?”
english: Hasn’t the Scripture said that the Christ comes of the offspring of David, and from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”

kikuyu: Akkasiin waaʼee Yesuus irratti garaa garummaan waldaa gidduutti uumame.
english: So a division arose in the multitude because of him.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaas tokko tokko isa qabuu barbaadan; garuu namni tokko iyyuu harkaan isa hin tuqne.
english: Some of them would have arrested him, but no one laid hands on him.

kikuyu: Eegdonni sun gara luboota hangafootaatii fi gara Fariisotaatti deebiʼan; isaanis, “Isin maaliif isa hin fidin?” jedhanii eegdota sana gaafatan.
english: The officers therefore came to the chief priests and Pharisees; and they said to them, “Why didn’t you bring him?”

kikuyu: Eegdonnis, “Takkumaa namni akka namicha kanaatti hin dubbanne” jedhanii deebisan.
english: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”

kikuyu: Fariisonnis deebisanii akkana jedhan, “Isinis gowwoomfamtaniirtuu?
english: The Pharisees therefore answered them, “You aren’t also led astray, are you?

kikuyu: Bulchitoota keessaa yookaan Fariisota keessaa namni tokko iyyuu isatti amaneeraa?
english: Have any of the rulers or any of the Pharisees believed in him?

kikuyu: Sabni seera hin beekne kun garuu abaaramaa dha.”
english: But this multitude that doesn’t know the law is cursed.”

kikuyu: Niqoodemoos inni duraan Yesuus bira dhaqee fi isaan keessaas tokko taʼe sun akkana isaaniin jedhe;
english: Nicodemus (he who came to him by night, being one of them) said to them,

kikuyu: “Seerri keenya utuu isa irraa hin dhagaʼin, waan inni hojjetes utuu hin beekin nama tokkotti ni muraa?”
english: “Does our law judge a man unless it first hears from him personally and knows what he does?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Atis nama Galiilaatii? Akka raajiin Galiilaadhaa hin kaane qoradhuu bira gaʼi” jedhaniin. [
english: They answered him, “Are you also from Galilee? Search and see that no prophet has arisen out of Galilee.”

kikuyu: Ergasii isaan hundinuu gara mana isaaniitti galan.
english: Everyone went to his own house,

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu gara Tulluu Ejersaa dhaqe.
english: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.

kikuyu: Ganama bariis deebiʼee mana qulqullummaa dhufe; innis namni hundumtuu isa biratti walitti qabamnaan taaʼee isaan barsiise.
english: Now very early in the morning, he came again into the temple, and all the people came to him. He sat down and taught them.

kikuyu: Barsiistonni seeraatii fi Fariisonni dubartii ejja irratti qabamte tokko isatti fidan. Gidduu isaaniis dhaabachiisanii,
english: The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman taken in adultery. Having set her in the middle,

kikuyu: Yesuusiin akkana jedhan; “Yaa barsiisaa, dubartiin kun utuu ejja hojjettuu qabamte.
english: they told him, “Teacher, we found this woman in adultery, in the very act.

kikuyu: Museen Seera keessatti akka warri akkanaa dhagaadhaan tumaman nu ajajeera. Ati immoo maal jetta?”
english: Now in our law, Moses commanded us to stone such women. What then do you say about her?”

kikuyu: Isaanis waan ittiin isa himatan argachuuf jedhanii isa qoruudhaaf waan kana gaafatan. Yesuus garuu gad jedhee quba isaatiin lafa irratti barreessuu jalqabe.
english: They said this testing him, that they might have something to accuse him of. But Jesus stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

kikuyu: Isaanis ittuma fufanii isa gaafannaan ol jedhee, “Isin keessaa namni cubbuu hin qabne dursee isheetti dhagaa haa darbatu” jedheen.
english: But when they continued asking him, he looked up and said to them, “He who is without sin among you, let him throw the first stone at her.”

kikuyu: Ammas gad jedhee lafa irratti barreesse.
english: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground with his finger.

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu kana dhagaʼanitti maanguddootaa jalqabanii tokko tokkoon baʼanii sokkan; Yesuus immoo dubartittii achuma dhaabattee jirtu wajjin kophaa hafe.
english: They, when they heard it, being convicted by their conscience, went out one by one, beginning from the oldest, even to the last. Jesus was left alone with the woman where she was, in the middle.

kikuyu: Yesuusis ol jedhee, “Dubartii nana, warri si himatan meerre? Namni tokko iyyuu sitti hin murree?” jedheen.
english: Jesus, standing up, saw her and said, “Woman, where are your accusers? Did no one condemn you?”

kikuyu: Isheenis, “Yaa Gooftaa, namni tokko iyyuu natti hin murre” jetteen. Yesuusis, “Anis sitti hin muruu deemi; garuu siʼachi cubbuu hin hojjetin” jedheen.]
english: She said, “No one, Lord.” Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you. Go your way. From now on, sin no more.”

kikuyu: Yesuus ammas, “Ani ifa addunyaa ti. Namni na duukaa buʼu kam iyyuu ifa jireenyaa qabaata malee dukkana keessa hin deddeebiʼu” jedhee isaanitti dubbate.
english: Again, therefore, Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world. He who follows me will not walk in the darkness, but will have the light of life.”

kikuyu: Fariisonnis, “Ati waaʼee mataa keetii dhugaa baata; dhuga baʼumsi kee immoo dhugaa miti” jedhaniin.
english: The Pharisees therefore said to him, “You testify about yourself. Your testimony is not valid.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Ani yoon ofii kootiif dhugaa baʼe illee ani akkan eessaa dhufee fi akkan garam deemu waanan beekuuf dhuga baʼumsi koo dhugaa dha. Isin garuu akka ani eessaa dhufe yookaan akka ani garam deemu hin beektan.
english: Jesus answered them, “Even if I testify about myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I came from, and where I am going; but you don’t know where I came from, or where I am going.

kikuyu: Isin akka yaada fooniitti murteessitu; ani nama tokkotti illee hin muru.
english: You judge according to the flesh. I judge no one.

kikuyu: Garuu ani yoon mure illee murtiin koo dhugaa dha; kan murus na qofa miti. Ani Abbaa na erge sana wajjinan jiraatii.
english: Even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for I am not alone, but I am with the Father who sent me.

kikuyu: Dhuga baʼumsi nama lamaa akka dhugaa taʼe Seera keessan keessatti barreeffameera.
english: It’s also written in your law that the testimony of two people is valid.

kikuyu: Ani ofii kootiif dhugaa nan baʼa; Abbaan na erges waaʼee koo dhugaa baʼa.”
english: I am one who testifies about myself, and the Father who sent me testifies about me.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Abbaan kee eessa jira?” jedhanii isa gaafatan. Yesuus immoo deebisee, “Isin anas, Abbaa koos hin beektan; utuu na beektanii silaa Abbaa koos ni beektu turtan” jedhe.
english: They said therefore to him, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father. If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”

kikuyu: Yesuus utuu mana qulqullummaa keessatti, kutaa buusiin itti kuufamu keessatti barsiisaa jiruu dubbii kana dubbate. Garuu waan saʼaatiin isaa hin gaʼiniif namni tokko iyyuu isa hin qabne.
english: Jesus spoke these words in the treasury, as he taught in the temple. Yet no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.

kikuyu: Yesuus amma illee, “Ani nan deema; isin na barbaaddu; cubbuu keessaniinis ni duutu. Isin iddoo ani dhaqu dhufuu hin dandeessan” isaaniin jedhe.
english: Jesus said therefore again to them, “I am going away, and you will seek me, and you will die in your sins. Where I go, you can’t come.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis, “ ‘Isin iddoo ani dhaqu dhufuu hin dandeessan’ jechuun isaa of ajjeesuufii laata?” jedhan.
english: The Jews therefore said, “Will he kill himself, because he says, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come’?”

kikuyu: Innis ittuma fufee akkana jedhe; “Isin kan gadii ti; ani kan olii ti. Isin kan addunyaa kanaa ti; ani immoo kan addunyaa kanaa miti.
english: He said to them, “You are from beneath. I am from above. You are of this world. I am not of this world.

kikuyu: Akka isin cubbuu keessaniin duutan ani isinitti himeera; isin yoo akka ani isa taʼe amanuu baattan, cubbuu keessaniin ni duutu.”
english: I said therefore to you that you will die in your sins; for unless you believe that I am he, you will die in your sins.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Ati eenyu?” jedhanii isa gaafatan. Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Ani isuma jalqabaa kaasee isinitti dubbachaa turee dha.
english: They said therefore to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Just what I have been saying to you from the beginning.

kikuyu: Ani waaʼee keessan waanan jedhuu fi waanan murteessu baayʼeen qaba. Garuu inni na erge dhugaa qabeessa; anis waanan isa irraa dhagaʼe addunyaatti nan hima.”
english: I have many things to speak and to judge concerning you. However, he who sent me is true; and the things which I heard from him, these I say to the world.”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu akka inni waaʼee Abbaa isaa isaanitti himaa ture hin hubanne.
english: They didn’t understand that he spoke to them about the Father.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yesuus akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Yommuu Ilma Namaa ol fuutanitti akka ani isa taʼe, waanuma Abbaan na barsiisen dubbadha malee akka ani ofii kootiin homaa hin hojjennees ni beektu.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he, and I do nothing of myself, but as my Father taught me, I say these things.

kikuyu: Inni na erge na wajjin jira; sababii ani yeroo hunda waan isa gammachiisu hojjedhuuf, inni kophaa koo na hin dhiifne.”
english: He who sent me is with me. The Father hasn’t left me alone, for I always do the things that are pleasing to him.”

kikuyu: Utuma inni dubbatuus, namoonni baayʼeen isatti amanan.
english: As he spoke these things, many believed in him.

kikuyu: Yesuus Yihuudoota isatti amananiin akkana jedhe; “Yoo dubbii kootti cichitanii jiraattan isin dhuguma barattoota koo ti.
english: Jesus therefore said to those Jews who had believed him, “If you remain in my word, then you are truly my disciples.

kikuyu: Dhugaas ni beektu; dhugaanis bilisa isin baasa.”
english: You will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Nu sanyii Abrahaam; nu eenyumaafuu takkumaa hin garboomne. Yoos ati akkamitti bilisa baatu nuun jetta ree?” jedhaniin.
english: They answered him, “We are Abraham’s offspring, and have never been in bondage to anyone. How do you say, ‘You will be made free’?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee akkana jedhe; “Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; namni cubbuu hojjetu hundi garbicha cubbuu ti.
english: Jesus answered them, “Most certainly I tell you, everyone who commits sin is the bondservant of sin.

kikuyu: Garbichi bara baraan mana hin jiraatu; ilmi garuu bara baraan ni jiraata.
english: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yoo Ilmi bilisa isin baase, isin dhugumaan bilisa ni baatu.
english: If therefore the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.

kikuyu: Isin sanyii Abrahaam taʼuu keessan anuu beeka. Garuu sababii dubbiin koo isin keessatti iddoo hin qabneef na ajjeesuu barbaaddu.
english: I know that you are Abraham’s offspring, yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.

kikuyu: Ani waanan Abbaa koo biratti argen dubbadha; isinis waanuma abbaa keessan irraa dhageessan hojjettu.”
english: I say the things which I have seen with my Father; and you also do the things which you have seen with your father.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Abbaan keenya Abrahaam” jedhan. Yesuus immoo akkana jedhe; “Isin utuu ijoollee Abrahaam taatanii silaa hojii Abrahaam hojjete ni hojjettu turtan.
english: They answered him, “Our father is Abraham.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do the works of Abraham.

kikuyu: Isin garuu ana nama dhugaa Waaqa irraa dhagaʼe isinitti hime ajjeesuu barbaaddu. Abrahaam waan akkasii hin hojjenne.
english: But now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God. Abraham didn’t do this.

kikuyu: Isin waan abbaan keessan hojjete hojjettu.” Isaanis, “Nu ejjaan hin dhalanne. Abbaa tokkicha qabna; innis Waaqa” jedhaniin.
english: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of sexual immorality. We have one Father, God.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isin utuu Waaqni abbaa keessan taʼee silaa na jaallattu turtan; ani Waaqa biraa baʼeen dhufeetii. Isatu na erge malee ani ofii kootiin hin dhufne.
english: Therefore Jesus said to them, “If God were your father, you would love me, for I came out and have come from God. For I haven’t come of myself, but he sent me.

kikuyu: Wanni ani dubbadhu maaliif isinii hin galu? Sababiin isaas waan isin waan ani jedhu fudhachuu hin feeneef.
english: Why don’t you understand my speech? Because you can’t hear my word.

kikuyu: Isin ijoollee abbaa keessanii ijoollee diiyaabiloos; fedhiin keessanis hawwii abbaa keessanii raawwachuu dha. Inni jalqabumaa kaasee nama ajjeesaa ture; waan dhugaan isa keessa hin jirreef inni dhugaadhaan hin jiraatu. Inni sobduu fi abbaa sobaa waan taʼeef yommuu soba dubbatutti ofuma keessaa fuudhee dubbata.
english: You are of your father the devil, and you want to do the desires of your father. He was a murderer from the beginning, and doesn’t stand in the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he speaks a lie, he speaks on his own; for he is a liar, and the father of lies.

kikuyu: Isin garuu waan ani dhugaa dubbadhuuf na hin amantan!
english: But because I tell the truth, you don’t believe me.

kikuyu: Isin keessaa namni cubbuudhaan na himatu eenyu? Erga ani dhugaa dubbadhee, isin maaliif na hin amanne?
english: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?

kikuyu: Namni kan Waaqaa taʼe kam iyyuu dubbii Waaqaa ni dhagaʼa. Isin waan kan Waaqaa hin taʼiniif hin dhageessan.”
english: He who is of God hears the words of God. For this cause you don’t hear, because you are not of God.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis deebisanii, “Ati nama Samaariyaa ti; hafuura hamaatu si keessa jira jechuun keenya dhugaa mitii?” jedhaniin.
english: Then the Jews answered him, “Don’t we say well that you are a Samaritan, and have a demon?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhe; “Hafuurri hamaan na keessa hin jiru; ani Abbaa koo nan kabaja; isin garuu na hin kabajjan.
english: Jesus answered, “I don’t have a demon, but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.

kikuyu: Ani ulfina mataa koo hin barbaadu; garuu kan isa barbaadu tokkotu jira; innis Abbaa murtii ti.
english: But I don’t seek my own glory. There is one who seeks and judges.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; eenyu iyyuu yoo dubbii koo eege bara baraan duʼa hin argu.”
english: Most certainly, I tell you, if a person keeps my word, he will never see death.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis akkana jedhaniin; “Akka hafuurri hamaan si keessa jiru nu amma barreerra. Abrahaam duʼeera; raajonnis duʼaniiru; ati garuu, ‘Eenyu iyyuu yoo dubbii koo eege bara baraan duʼa hin dhandhamu’ jetta.
english: Then the Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If a man keeps my word, he will never taste of death.’

kikuyu: Ati abbaa keenya Abrahaam caaltaa? Inni duʼeera; raajonnis duʼaniiru. Egaa ati eenyu ofiin jetta ree?”
english: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? The prophets died. Who do you make yourself out to be?”

kikuyu: Yesuus akkana jedhee deebise; “Ani yoon ofii kootiif ulfina kenne, ulfinni koo gatii hin qabu. Kan ulfina naa kennu Abbaa koo isuma isin Waaqa keenya jettaniin sanaa dha.
english: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing. It is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is our God.

kikuyu: Yoo isin isa beekuu baattan illee ani isa beeka. Ani utuu isa hin beeku jedhee silaa akkuma keessan sobduu nan taʼa ture. Ani garuu isa beeka; dubbii isaa illee nan eega.
english: You have not known him, but I know him. If I said, ‘I don’t know him,’ I would be like you, a liar. But I know him and keep his word.

kikuyu: Abbaan keessan Abrahaam guyyaa koo arguuf gammadee ture; innis ni arge; ni gammades.”
english: Your father Abraham rejoiced to see my day. He saw it and was glad.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis, “Umuriin kee waggaa shantama iyyuu hin guunne; yoos Abrahaamin argiteertaa?” jedhaniin.
english: The Jews therefore said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old! Have you seen Abraham?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; utuu Abrahaam hin dhalatin iyyuu ani anuma” isaaniin jedhe.
english: Jesus said to them, “Most certainly, I tell you, before Abraham came into existence, I AM.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti isaan isa dhaʼuuf jedhanii dhagaa guurratan; Yesuus garuu dhokatee mana qulqullummaatii baʼee deeme.
english: Therefore they took up stones to throw at him, but Jesus hid himself and went out of the temple, having gone through the middle of them, and so passed by.

kikuyu: Yesuus utuu darbuu namicha dhalootuma isaatii jalqabee jaamaa ture tokko arge.
english: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from birth.

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaas, “Yaa barsiisaa, akka namichi kun jaamaa taʼee dhalatuuf eenyutu cubbuu hojjete? Isuma moo abbaa fi haadha isaa ti?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebise; “Akka hojiin Waaqaa isaan mulʼatuuf malee inni yookaan abbaa fi haati isaa cubbuu hojjetanii miti.
english: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents, but that the works of God might be revealed in him.

kikuyu: Utuu guyyaa taʼee jiruu hojii isa na ergee hojjechuun qabna. Halkan namni tokko iyyuu itti hojjechuu hin dandeenye ni dhufa.
english: I must work the works of him who sent me while it is day. The night is coming, when no one can work.

kikuyu: Ani yommuun addunyaa irra jiru, ifa addunyaa ti.”
english: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”

kikuyu: Innis erga waan kana dubbatee booddee lafatti tufee dhoqqee tolche; dhoqqee sanas ija namichaatti dibe.
english: When he had said this, he spat on the ground, made mud with the saliva, anointed the blind man’s eyes with the mud,

kikuyu: Innis namicha sanaan, “Dhaqiitii Haroo Saliihoomitti dhiqadhu” jedhe. Saliihoom jechuun kan ergame jechuu dha. Namichis dhaqee dhiqate; argaas deebiʼee dhufe.
english: and said to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means “Sent”). So he went away, washed, and came back seeing.

kikuyu: Olloonni isaatii fi namoonni duraan utuu inni kadhatuu argan, “Namichi kun isuma taaʼee kadhachaa ture sana mitii?” jedhan.
english: Therefore the neighbors and those who saw that he was blind before said, “Isn’t this he who sat and begged?”

kikuyu: Namoonni tokko tokko, “Eeyyee, isa” jedhan. Kaan immoo, “Miti, isa fakkaata malee” jedhan. Inni garuu, “Namichi sun anuma” jedhe.
english: Others were saying, “It is he.” Still others were saying, “He looks like him.” He said, “I am he.”

kikuyu: Jarris, “Iji kee akkamitti baname ree?” jedhaniin.
english: They therefore were asking him, “How were your eyes opened?”

kikuyu: Innis deebisee, “Namicha Yesuus jedhamutu dhoqqee tolchee ija koo dibee, ‘Gara Haroo Saliihoom dhaqiitii dhiqadhu’ naan jedhe; anis dhaqeen dhiqadhe; arguus nan dandaʼe.”
english: He answered, “A man called Jesus made mud, anointed my eyes, and said to me, ‘Go to the pool of Siloam and wash.’ So I went away and washed, and I received sight.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Namichi sun eessa jira?” jedhanii isa gaafatan. Inni immoo, “Ani hin beeku” jedheen.
english: Then they asked him, “Where is he?” He said, “I don’t know.”

kikuyu: Isaanis namicha jaamaa ture sana Fariisotatti geessan.
english: They brought him who had been blind to the Pharisees.

kikuyu: Guyyaan itti Yesuus dhoqqee tolchee ija namichaa bane Sanbata ture.
english: It was a Sabbath when Jesus made the mud and opened his eyes.

kikuyu: Fariisonnis namichi akkamitti akka arguu dandaʼe isa gaafatan; namichis, “Inni dhoqqee tolchee ija koo dibe; anis nan dhiqadhe; nan arges” jedheen.
english: Again therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he received his sight. He said to them, “He put mud on my eyes, I washed, and I see.”

kikuyu: Fariisota keessaas tokko tokko, “Namichi kun waan Sanbata hin eegneef, inni Waaqa biraa hin dhufne” jedhan. Warri kaan garuu, “Cubbamaan tokko akkamitti dinqii akkanaa hojjechuu dandaʼa?” jedhan. Garaa garummaanis isaan gidduutti uumame.
english: Some therefore of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, because he doesn’t keep the Sabbath.” Others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” So there was division among them.

kikuyu: Isaanis amma illee namicha jaamaa ture sanaan, “Waaʼee namicha ija kee siif bane sanaa maal jetta?” jedhan. Namichis deebisee, “Inni raajii dha” jedhe.
english: Therefore they asked the blind man again, “What do you say about him, because he opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis hamma abbaa fi haadha namicha agartuu isaa argate sanaa waamanitti akka inni jaamaa turee fi akka inni agartuu isaa argate amma illee hin amanne.
english: The Jews therefore didn’t believe concerning him, that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of him who had received his sight,

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Inni kun ilma keessan isuma isin jaamaa taʼee dhalate jettan sanaa? Yoos amma immoo akkamitti arguu dandaʼa ree?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: and asked them, “Is this your son, whom you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”

kikuyu: Abbaa fi haati namichaas deebisanii akkana jedhan; “Akka inni ilma keenya taʼee fi akka inni jaamaa taʼee dhalate ni beekna.
english: His parents answered them, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;

kikuyu: Garuu amma akkamitti akka arguu dandaʼe yookaan ija isaa eenyu akka baneef nu hin beeknu. Inni nama gaʼaa dha; waaʼee mataa isaa dubbachuu ni dandaʼa; isuma gaafadhaa.”
english: but how he now sees, we don’t know; or who opened his eyes, we don’t know. He is of age. Ask him. He will speak for himself.”

kikuyu: Abbaa fi haati isaa sababii Yihuudoota sodaataniif waan kana jedhan; namni kam iyyuu yoo Yesuus inni Kiristoos jedhee dhugaa baʼe akka mana sagadaa keessaa ariʼamu Yihuudoonni kanaan dura walii galanii murteessanii turaniitii.
english: His parents said these things because they feared the Jews; for the Jews had already agreed that if any man would confess him as Christ, he would be put out of the synagogue.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu abbaa fi haati isaa, “Inni nama gaʼaa dha; isuma gaafadhaa” jedhan.
english: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age. Ask him.”

kikuyu: Isaanis yeroo lammaffaa namicha jaamaa ture sana waamanii, “Waaqaaf ulfina kenni. Namichi kun cubbamaa taʼuu isaa nu ni beekna” jedhaniin.
english: So they called the man who was blind a second time, and said to him, “Give glory to God. We know that this man is a sinner.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Cubbamaa taʼuu fi taʼuu baachuu isaa ani hin beeku. Ani waan tokkon beeka. Ani jaamaan ture; amma garuu nan arga!” jedhee deebise.
english: He therefore answered, “I don’t know if he is a sinner. One thing I do know: that though I was blind, now I see.”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Inni maal siif godhe? Ija kees akkamitti siif bane?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: They said to him again, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”

kikuyu: Inni immoo, “Ani kanaan dura isinitti himeera; isinis hin dhageenye. Ammas maaliif dhagaʼuu barbaaddu? Isinis barattoota isaa taʼuu barbaadduu?” jedheen.
english: He answered them, “I told you already, and you didn’t listen. Why do you want to hear it again? You don’t also want to become his disciples, do you?”

kikuyu: Isaanis akkana jedhanii isa arrabsan; “Barataan namicha kanaa siʼi! Nu barattoota Musee ti!
english: They insulted him and said, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.

kikuyu: Akka Waaqni Museetti dubbate nu beekna; namichi kun garuu eessaa akka dhufe iyyuu hin beeknu.”
english: We know that God has spoken to Moses. But as for this man, we don’t know where he comes from.”

kikuyu: Namichis deebisee akkana jedhe; “Inni eessaa akka dhufe wallaaluun keessan waan nama dinquu dha; garuu inni ija koo naa bane.
english: The man answered them, “How amazing! You don’t know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.

kikuyu: Akka Waaqni cubbamoota hin dhageenye ni beekna. Inni nama isa waaqeffatuu fi fedhii isaa guutu dhagaʼa.
english: We know that God doesn’t listen to sinners, but if anyone is a worshiper of God and does his will, he listens to him.

kikuyu: Eenyu iyyuu ija nama jaamaa taʼee dhalate tokkoo akka bane uumama addunyaatii jalqabee hin dhagaʼamne.
english: Since the world began it has never been heard of that anyone opened the eyes of someone born blind.

kikuyu: Namichi kun utuu Waaqa biraa taʼuu baatee silaa homaa gochuu hin dandaʼu ture.”
english: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”

kikuyu: Isaanis deebisanii, “Ati kan guutummaatti cubbuun dhalatte, situ nu barsiisaa?” jedhaniin. Alattis gad isa baasan.
english: They answered him, “You were altogether born in sins, and do you teach us?” Then they threw him out.

kikuyu: Yesuusis akka isaan gad isa baasan dhagaʼe; yommuu isa argettis, “Ati Ilma Namaatti ni amantaa?” jedheen.
english: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and finding him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of God?”

kikuyu: Namichis, “Yaa gooftaa, akka ani isatti amanuuf inni eenyu?” jedhe.
english: He answered, “Who is he, Lord, that I may believe in him?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Ati amma isa argiteerta; inni si wajjin haasaʼaa jiru isuma” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “You have both seen him, and it is he who speaks with you.”

kikuyu: Namichi sunis, “Yaa Gooftaa, ani nan amana” jedhe; ni sagadeefis.
english: He said, “Lord, I believe!” and he worshiped him.

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Warri hin argine akka arganiif, warri argan immoo akka jaamaniif ani murtiif gara addunyaa kanaa dhufeera” jedhe.
english: Jesus said, “I came into this world for judgment, that those who don’t see may see; and that those who see may become blind.”

kikuyu: Fariisota isa wajjin turan keessaa tokko tokko waan kana jechuu isaa dhagaʼanii, “Nus jaamota mitii ree?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: Those of the Pharisees who were with him heard these things, and said to him, “Are we also blind?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Utuu jaamota taatanii silaa cubbuu hin qabdan ture; isin garuu, ‘Ni argina’ jettu; cubbuun keessan ni jiraata” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no sin; but now you say, ‘We see.’ Therefore your sin remains.

kikuyu: “Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; namni balbalaan gola hoolotaa hin seennee, garuu karaa biraatiin koree seenu inni hattuu fi saamtuu dha.
english: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

kikuyu: Namni balbalaan seenu immoo tiksee hoolotaa ti.
english: But one who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

kikuyu: Eegduunis balbala isaaf bana; hoolonnis sagalee isaa ni dhagaʼu. Innis hoolota isaa maqaa maqaan waamee gad yaasa.
english: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

kikuyu: Erga warra kan isaa taʼan hunda gad yaasee booddee isaan dura deema; hoolonni isaas waan sagalee isaa beekaniif isa faana buʼu.
english: Whenever he brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

kikuyu: Orma garuu ni baqatu malee faana hin buʼan; sagalee ormaa hin beekaniitii.”
english: They will by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’t know the voice of strangers.”

kikuyu: Yesuus fakkeenya kana isaanitti hime; isaan garuu akka inni maal isaanitti himaa ture hin hubanne.
english: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yesuus ammas akkana jedheen; “Dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; ani balbala hoolotaa ti.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, I tell you, I am the sheep’s door.

kikuyu: Warri na dura dhufan hundi hattootaa fi saamtota; hoolonni garuu isaan hin dhageenye.
english: All who came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’t listen to them.

kikuyu: Balballi ana; namni karaa kootiin ol seenu kam iyyuu ni fayya. Inni ni seena; ni baʼas; lafa dheedaas ni argata.
english: I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

kikuyu: Hattichi hatuuf, ajjeesuu fi balleessuu qofaaf dhufa; ani garuu akka isaan jireenya qabaataniif, jireenya irraa hafaas akka qabaataniif dhufeera.
english: The thief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

kikuyu: “Tikseen gaariin ana. Tikseen gaariin hoolota isaatiif jedhee lubbuu isaa dabarsee kenna.
english: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

kikuyu: Namni qacaramaan kan tiksee hin taʼin garuu waan hoolonni kan isaa hin taʼiniif yommuu dhufaatii yeeyyii argutti hoolota dhiisee baqata. Yeeyyiinis bushaayee ni butata; ni bittinneessas.
english: He who is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

kikuyu: Namichi waan qacaramaa taʼeef ni baqata; dhimma hoolotaas hin qabu.
english: The hired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’t care for the sheep.

kikuyu: “Tikseen gaariin ana; ani hoolota koo beeka; hoolonni koos na beeku;
english: I am the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

kikuyu: kunis akkuma Abbaan na beekuttii fi akkuma ani Abbaa beekutti. Anis lubbuu koo hoolotaaf nan kenna.
english: even as the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

kikuyu: Ani warra gola kanatti galan malees hoolota gara biraan qaba. Isaanis fiduun qaba. Isaanis sagalee koo ni dhagaʼu; karra tokkos ni taʼu; tikseen isaaniis tokko taʼa.
english: I have other sheep which are not of this fold. I must bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Abbaan waan ani deebisee fudhachuuf lubbuu koo dabarsee kennuuf na jaallata.
english: Therefore the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.

kikuyu: Lubbuu koo anumatu ofii kootiin dabarsee kenna malee eenyu iyyuu narraa hin fudhatu. Ani lubbuu koo dabarsee kennuuf taayitaan qaba; deebisee fudhachuufis taayitaan qaba. Ajaja kanas Abbaa koo biraa fudhadheera.”
english: No one takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

kikuyu: Amma illee sababii dubbii kanaatiif Yihuudoota gidduutti garaa garummaan uumame.
english: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

kikuyu: Baayʼeen isaaniis, “Hafuura hamaatu isa keessa jira; inni maraateera. Isin maaliif isa dhageessu?” jedhan.
english: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

kikuyu: Warri kaan immoo, “Kun jecha nama hafuura hamaadhaan qabame miti. Hafuurri hamaan ija nama jaamaa banuu ni dandaʼaa?” jedhan.
english: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

kikuyu: Yeroo sana Ayyaanni mana qulqullummaa haaromsuu Yerusaalemitti ayyaaneffamee ture. Yeroon sunis ganna ture;
english: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yesuusis mana qulqullummaa keessa gardaafoo Solomoon keessa deddeebiʼaa ture.
english: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis isa marsanii, “Hamma yoomiitti qalbii nu rarraaftaa? Ati yoo Kiristoos taate ifatti baasii nutti himi” jedhaniin.
english: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Ani isinitti himeera; isin garuu hin amantan. Hojiin ani maqaa Abbaa kootiitiin hojjedhu waaʼee koo dhugaa baʼa.
english: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you don’t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

kikuyu: Isin garuu waan hoolota koo hin taʼiniif hin amantan.
english: But you don’t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

kikuyu: Hoolonni koo sagalee koo ni dhagaʼu; anis isaan beeka; isaanis na faana buʼu.
english: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

kikuyu: Anis jireenya bara baraa nan kennaaf; isaanis gonkumaa hin badan. Eenyu iyyuu harka koo keessaa isaan hin butatu.
english: I give eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

kikuyu: Abbaan koo kan natti isaan kenne sun hunduma caala; namni tokko iyyuu harka Abbaa kootii keessaa isaan butachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: My Father who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

kikuyu: Anii fi Abbaan tokkuma.”
english: I and the Father are one.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonni isa dhaʼuuf jedhanii ammas dhagaa guurratan.
english: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Ani hojii Abbaa kootii gaarii baayʼee isinitti argisiiseera. Hojii kana keessaa isin sababii isa kamiitiif dhagaadhaan na dhooftu?” jedheen.
english: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis, “Nu hojii gaariif jennee dhagaadhaan si hin dhoofnu; garuu waan ati Waaqa arrabsitee utumaa nama taatee jirtuu Waaqa of gooteef si dhoofna” jedhanii deebisaniif.
english: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”
