kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Seera keessan keessatti, ‘Anuu isin, “waaqota” jedheera’jedhamee barreeffameera mitii?
english: Jesus answered them, “Isn’t it written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

kikuyu: Inni erga warra dubbiin Waaqaa isaaniif dhufeen ‘waaqota’ jedhee, Katabbiin Qulqulluun immoo waan hin diigamneef,
english: If he called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

kikuyu: sababii ani, ‘Ani ilma Waaqaa ti’ jedheef, isin maaliif isa Abbaan qulqulleessee gara addunyaatti erge sanaan ‘Ati Waaqa arrabsita’ jettu?
english: do you say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

kikuyu: Yoo ani hojii Abbaa kootii hojjechuu baadhe na hin amaninaa.
english: If I don’t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

kikuyu: Yoo ani hojii sana hojjedhe garuu yoo na amanuu baattan illee hojicha amanaa; kunis akka Abbaan na keessa jiru, akka anis Abbaa keessa jiru beektanii akka hubattaniif.”
english: But if I do them, though you don’t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

kikuyu: Isaan amma illee isa qabuu barbaadan; inni garuu isaan harkaa miliqe.
english: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

kikuyu: Yesuus ergasii deebiʼee Yordaanos gama iddoo Yohannis jalqabatti itti cuuphaa ture sana dhaqee achis ture.
english: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeenis gara isaa dhufanii, “Yohannis mallattoo tokko illee hin hojjenne; garuu wanni inni waaʼee namicha kanaa dubbate hundinuu dhugaa dha” jedhan.
english: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

kikuyu: Achittis namoonni hedduun Yesuusitti amanan.
english: Many believed in him there.

kikuyu: Namichi Alʼaazaar jedhamu kan Biitaaniyaa keessa jiraatu tokko dhukkubsatee ture. Biitaaniyaan ganda Maariyaamii fi obboleettiin ishee Maartaan keessa jiraatanii dha.
english: Now a certain man was sick, Lazarus from Bethany, of the village of Mary and her sister, Martha.

kikuyu: Maariyaam isheen obboleessi ishee Alʼaazaar dhukkubsate kun, isheedhuma Gooftaa shittoo dibdee rifeensa mataa isheetiin miilla isaa haqxee sanaa dha.
english: It was that Mary who had anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was sick.

kikuyu: Kanaaf obboleettonni isaa, “Yaa Gooftaa, inni ati jaallattu kunoo dhukkubsatee jira” jedhanii Yesuusitti dhaaman.
english: The sisters therefore sent to him, saying, “Lord, behold, he for whom you have great affection is sick.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti, “Dhibeen kun akka Ilmi Waaqaa ittiin ulfaatuuf, ulfina Waaqaatiif dhufe malee duʼaan hin gaʼu” jedhe.
english: But when Jesus heard it, he said, “This sickness is not to death, but for the glory of God, that God’s Son may be glorified by it.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis Maartaa fi obboleettii ishee, Alʼaazaarinis ni jaallata ture.
english: Now Jesus loved Martha, and her sister, and Lazarus.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu akka Alʼaazaar dhukkubsate dhagaʼetti guyyaa lama idduma jiru sana ture.
english: When therefore he heard that he was sick, he stayed two days in the place where he was.

kikuyu: Innis ergasii barattoota isaatiin, “Kottaa Yihuudaatti deebinaa” jedhe.
english: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let’s go into Judea again.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaa immoo, “Yaa Barsiisaa, Yihuudoonni dhiʼeenya kana dhagaadhaan si tumuu barbaadaa turan; ati amma illee deebitee achi dhaqxaa?” jedhaniin.
english: The disciples asked him, “Rabbi, the Jews were just trying to stone you. Are you going there again?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Guyyaan tokko saʼaatii kudha lama qaba mitii? Namni guyyaan deemu waan ifa addunyaa kanaatiin arguuf hin gufatu.
english: Jesus answered, “Aren’t there twelve hours of daylight? If a man walks in the day, he doesn’t stumble, because he sees the light of this world.

kikuyu: Kan halkaniin deemu garuu sababii ifni isa keessa hin jirreef ni gufata.”
english: But if a man walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light isn’t in him.”

kikuyu: Innis erga waan kana dubbatee booddee, “Michuun keenya Alʼaazaar rafeera; ani garuu hirribaa isa kaasuu nan dhaqa” isaaniin jedhe.
english: He said these things, and after that, he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I am going so that I may awake him out of sleep.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaas, “Yaa Gooftaa, yoo rafee jiraate ni fayya” jedhaniin.
english: The disciples therefore said, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”

kikuyu: Yesuus waaʼee duʼa Alʼaazaar dubbate; barattoonni isaa garuu waan inni waaʼee rafiitii hirribaa dubbate seʼan.
english: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he spoke of taking rest in sleep.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yesuus akkana jedhee ifatti baasee isaanitti hime; “Alʼaazaar duʼeera;
english: So Jesus said to them plainly then, “Lazarus is dead.

kikuyu: akka isin amantaniif ani waan achi hin turiniif waaʼee keessaniif nan gammada. Taʼus kottaa gara isaa dhaqnaa.”
english: I am glad for your sakes that I was not there, so that you may believe. Nevertheless, let’s go to him.”

kikuyu: Toomaas inni Didimoos jedhamu immoo barattoota kaaniin, “Nus akka isa wajjin duunuuf kaʼaa ni dhaqnaa” jedhe.
english: Thomas therefore, who is called Didymus, said to his fellow disciples, “Let’s also go, that we may die with him.”

kikuyu: Yesuus yommuu achi gaʼetti Alʼaazaar erga awwaalamee guyyaa afur akka ture beeke.
english: So when Jesus came, he found that he had been in the tomb four days already.

kikuyu: Biitaaniyaan Yerusaalem irraa gara kiiloo meetira sadii fagaatti turte;
english: Now Bethany was near Jerusalem, about fifteen stadia away.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonni baayʼeen Maartaa fi Maariyaamin sababii obboleessa isaaniitiif isaan jajjabeessuu dhaqanii turan.
english: Many of the Jews had joined the women around Martha and Mary, to console them concerning their brother.

kikuyu: Maartaan yommuu dhufaatii Yesuus dhageessetti isa simachuu gad baate; Maariyaam garuu mana teesse.
english: Then when Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, but Mary stayed in the house.

kikuyu: Maartaanis Yesuusiin akkana jette; “Yaa Gooftaa, utuu ati as jiraattee silaa obboleessi koo hin duʼu ture.
english: Therefore Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.

kikuyu: Ammas taanaan akka waan ati Waaqa kadhattu hunda Waaqni siif kennu nan beeka.”
english: Even now I know that whatever you ask of God, God will give you.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Obboleessi kee ni kaʼa” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”

kikuyu: Maartaanis deebiftee, “Akka inni duʼaa kaʼuu guyyaa dhumaa sanatti kaʼu anuu beeka” jetteen.
english: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana isheedhaan jedhe; “Duʼaa kaʼuu fi jireenyi ana. Namni natti amanu yoo duʼe iyyuu ni jiraata;
english: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. He who believes in me will still live, even if he dies.

kikuyu: kan na keessa jiraatuu fi kan natti amanu hundinuu bara baraan hin duʼu. Kana ni amantaa ree?”
english: Whoever lives and believes in me will never die. Do you believe this?”

kikuyu: Isheenis, “Eeyyee yaa Gooftaa, akka ati Kiristoos Ilma Waaqaa kan gara addunyaa dhufu sana taate nan amana” jetteen.
english: She said to him, “Yes, Lord. I have come to believe that you are the Christ, God’s Son, he who comes into the world.”

kikuyu: Isheenis erga akkas jettee dhaqxee obboleettii ishee Maariyaamin kophaatti waamtee, “Barsiisaan dhufeera; si waamas” jetteen.
english: When she had said this, she went away and called Mary, her sister, secretly, saying, “The Teacher is here and is calling you.”

kikuyu: Maariyaamis yommuu waan kana dhageessetti ariitiin kaatee gara isaa dhaqxe.
english: When she heard this, she arose quickly and went to him.

kikuyu: Yesuus yeroo sana iddoo Maartaan itti isa simatte ture malee amma illee ganda sana hin seenne.
english: Now Jesus had not yet come into the village, but was in the place where Martha met him.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonni Maariyaamin jajjabeessaa mana keessa ishee wajjin turanis yommuu akka isheen ariitiidhaan kaatee gad baate arganitti waan isheen achitti booʼuuf jettee gara awwaalaa dhaqxu seʼanii ishee duukaa buʼan.
english: Then the Jews who were with her in the house and were consoling her, when they saw Mary, that she rose up quickly and went out, followed her, saying, “She is going to the tomb to weep there.”

kikuyu: Maariyaamis yommuu iddoo Yesuus ture sana geessee isa argitetti, miilla isaa irratti kuftee, “Yaa Gooftaa utuu ati as jiraattee silaa obboleessi koo hin duʼu ture” jetteen.
english: Therefore when Mary came to where Jesus was and saw him, she fell down at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you would have been here, my brother wouldn’t have died.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu booʼuu ishee, Yihuudoonni ishee wajjin dhufanis booʼuu isaanii argetti hafuuraan akka malee jeeqame; ni dhiphates.
english: When Jesus therefore saw her weeping, and the Jews weeping who came with her, he groaned in the spirit and was troubled,

kikuyu: Innis, “Eessa isa keessan?” jedhee isaan gaafate. Isaanis, “Yaa Gooftaa, kottuu ilaali” jedhaniin.
english: and said, “Where have you laid him?” They told him, “Lord, come and see.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis imimmaan dhangalaase.
english: Jesus wept.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis, “Inni hammam akka isa jaallatu mee ilaalaa!” jedhan.
english: The Jews therefore said, “See how much affection he had for him!”

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa tokko tokko garuu, “Inni kan ija namicha jaamaa sanaa bane, akka namichi kunis hin duune gochuu hin dandaʼu turee?” jedhan.
english: Some of them said, “Couldn’t this man, who opened the eyes of him who was blind, have also kept this man from dying?”

kikuyu: Yesuus ammas akka malee jeeqamee gara awwaala sanaa dhaqe. Awwaalli sunis holqa balballi isaa dhagaadhaan cufame tokko ture.
english: Jesus therefore, again groaning in himself, came to the tomb. Now it was a cave, and a stone lay against it.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Dhagaa kana achi irraa fuudhaa!” jedhe. Maartaan obboleettiin isa duʼe sanaa garuu, “Yaa Gooftaa, inni erga awwaalamee waan guyyaa afur tureef yoona ni ajaaʼa” jetteen.
english: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of him who was dead, said to him, “Lord, by this time there is a stench, for he has been dead four days.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Ati yoo amante akka ulfina Waaqaa argitu ani sitti hin himnee?” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to her, “Didn’t I tell you that if you believed, you would see God’s glory?”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isaan dhagicha irraa kaasan. Yesuusis ol ilaalee akkana jedhe; “Yaa Abbaa, waan ati na dhageesseef sin galateeffadha.
english: So they took away the stone from the place where the dead man was lying. Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you listened to me.

kikuyu: Akka ati yeroo hunda na dhageessu ani beekeera; garuu akka namoonni as dhadhaabatan kunneen akka ati na ergite amananiif ani isaaniif jedheen waan kana dubbadhe.”
english: I know that you always listen to me, but because of the multitude standing around I said this, that they may believe that you sent me.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis waan kana dubbatee, “Alʼaazaar, as baʼi!” jedhee sagalee guddaadhaan iyye.
english: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”

kikuyu: Namichi duʼe sunis akkuma harki isaatii fi miilli isaa huccuudhaan kafanamee, fuulli isaas wayyaadhaan marametti gad baʼe. Yesuusis, “Isa hiikaa, haa deemu” isaaniin jedhe.
english: He who was dead came out, bound hand and foot with wrappings, and his face was wrapped around with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Free him, and let him go.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yihuudoota gara Maariyaam dhufanii waan Yesuus hojjete argan keessaa hedduun isatti amanan.
english: Therefore many of the Jews who came to Mary and saw what Jesus did believed in him.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa tokko tokko garuu Fariisota bira dhaqanii waan Yesuus hojjete itti himan.
english: But some of them went away to the Pharisees and told them the things which Jesus had done.

kikuyu: Kana irratti luboonni hangafoonnii fi Fariisonni yaaʼii Yihuudootaa waaman. Isaanis akkana jedhanii gaafatan; “Namichi kun mallattoo baayʼee argisiisaa jira. Maal haa goonu?
english: The chief priests therefore and the Pharisees gathered a council, and said, “What are we doing? For this man does many signs.

kikuyu: Yoo akkasumatti isa dhiifne namni hundi isatti amana; warri Roomaas dhufanii iddoo keenyaa fi saba keenya nurraa fudhatu.”
english: If we leave him alone like this, everyone will believe in him, and the Romans will come and take away both our place and our nation.”

kikuyu: Isaan keessaas namichi Qayyaaffaa jedhamu kan bara sana luba ol aanaa ture tokko akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isin waan tokko illee hin beektan!
english: But a certain one of them, Caiaphas, being high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all,

kikuyu: Sabni guutummaatti dhumuu irra namni tokko sabaaf duʼuun akka isinii wayyu hin hubattan.”
english: nor do you consider that it is advantageous for us that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation not perish.”

kikuyu: Inni bara sana waan luba ol aanaa tureef, akka Yesuus saba sanaaf duʼu raajii dubbachuu isaati malee dubbii kana of keessaa fuudhee hin dubbanne;
english: Now he didn’t say this of himself, but being high priest that year, he prophesied that Jesus would die for the nation,

kikuyu: kunis ijoollee Waaqaa kanneen bittinnaaʼan walitti qabee tokko gochuuf malee saba sana qofaaf miti.
english: and not for the nation only, but that he might also gather together into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isaan gaafasii jalqabanii isa ajjeesuuf malachaa turan.
english: So from that day forward they took counsel that they might put him to death.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yesuus ifatti baʼee Yihuudoota gidduu hin deddeebine. Achii kaʼee gara magaalaa Efreem jedhamu kan gammoojjiitti dhiʼaatu tokkoo dhaqe; barattoota isaa wajjinis achi ture.
english: Jesus therefore walked no more openly among the Jews, but departed from there into the country near the wilderness, to a city called Ephraim. He stayed there with his disciples.

kikuyu: Faasiikaan Yihuudootaa waan dhiʼaatee tureef, namoonni hedduun utuu Faasiikaan hin gaʼin of qulqulleessuuf jedhanii baadiyyaadhaa Yerusaalemitti ol baʼan.
english: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand. Many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.

kikuyu: Isaanis Yesuusin barbaadaa turan; mana qulqullummaa keessas dhaabatanii, “Isin maal seetu? Inni gara Ayyaana kanaa hin dhufuu laata?” waliin jedhan.
english: Then they sought for Jesus and spoke with one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think—that he isn’t coming to the feast at all?”

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonnii fi Fariisonni garuu Yesuusin qabuuf jedhanii namni iddoo inni jiru beeku yoo jiraate akka isaanitti himuuf ajaja kennanii turan.
english: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had commanded that if anyone knew where he was, he should report it, that they might seize him.

kikuyu: Faasiikaa dura guyyaa jaʼaffaatti Yesuus gara Biitaaniyaa ganda Alʼaazaar, kan Yesuus duʼaa isa kaase sun jiraachaa turee dhaqe.
english: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.

kikuyu: Achitti irbaata qopheessaniif. Maartaanis ni tajaajilti turte; Alʼaazaaris warra isa wajjin irbaatatti dhiʼaatan keessaa tokko ture.
english: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.

kikuyu: Maariyaamis shittoo Naardoos qulqulluu gatiin isaa guddaa kan gara liitirii walakkaa taʼu fiddee miilla Yesuus dibde; rifeensa mataa isheetiinis miilla isaa haqxe. Manichis urgaa shittoo sanaatiin guutame.
english: Therefore Mary took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed Jesus’ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.

kikuyu: Barattoota isaa keessaa tokko kan dabarsee isa kennuuf jiru Yihuudaa Keeriyotichi garuu akkana jedhe;
english: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,

kikuyu: “Shittoon kun maaliif diinaarii dhibba sadiitti gurguramee hiyyeeyyiif hin kennamne?”
english: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”

kikuyu: Akkana jechuun isaa waan hattuu tureef malee hiyyeeyyiif yaade miti. Innis sababii korojoon maallaqaa harka isaa tureef, waan achi keessa buufamu irraa ofii isaatii fudhachaa ture.
english: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee akkana jedhe; “Isheen shittoo kana guyyaa awwaala kootiitiif haa tursituutii ishee dhiisaa.
english: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.

kikuyu: Hiyyeeyyii yeroo hunda of biraa qabdu; ana garuu yeroo hunda of biraa hin qabdan.”
english: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonni baayʼeen akka Yesuus achi jiru beekanii Yesuus qofaaf jedhaanii utuu hin taʼin, Alʼaazaar isa inni duʼaa kaases ilaaluuf dhufan.
english: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there; and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu luboonni hangafoonni Alʼaazaarinis ajjeesuuf mariʼatan;
english: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,

kikuyu: Yihuudoota keessaa namoonni baayʼeen sababii isaatiif dhaqanii Yesuusitti amanaa turaniitii.
english: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti namoonni Ayyaanichaaf dhufanii turan baayʼeen akka Yesuus gara Yerusaalem dhufaa jiru dhagaʼan.
english: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

kikuyu: Isaanis damee meexxii harkatti qabatanii isa simachuu baʼan; iyyaniis akkana jedhan; “Hoosaaʼinaa!” “Inni maqaa Gooftaatiin dhufu eebbifamaa dha!” “Mootiin Israaʼel eebbifamaa dha!”
english: they took the branches of the palm trees and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”

kikuyu: Yesuusis ilmoo harree tokko argatee yaabbate; kunis akkuma akkana jedhamee barreeffamee dha;
english: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,

kikuyu: “Yaa Intala Xiyoon, hin sodaatin; kunoo, mootiin kee, ilmoo harree yaabbatee dhufuutti jira.”
english: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaa jalqabatti waan kana hin hubanne. Erga Yesuus ulfina argatee booddee garuu akka wanni barreeffame kun waaʼee isaa taʼee fi akka isaanis waanuma kana isaaf godhan yaadatan.
english: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeen yommuu inni Alʼaazaarin awwaala keessaa waamee duʼaa kaasetti isa wajjin turanis ittuma fufanii dhugaa baʼan.
english: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead was testifying about it.

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeenis sababii mallattoo kana gochuu isaa dhagaʼaniif isa simachuu baʼan.
english: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Fariisonni, “Isin akka waa tokko illee gochuu hin dandeenye argitanii? Ilaa, addunyaan guutuun akkamitti akka isa duukaa buʼe ilaalaa!” waliin jedhan.
english: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”

kikuyu: Warra yeroo Ayyaanichaatti waaqeffachuuf ol baʼan keessaa tokko tokko Giriikota turan.
english: Now there were certain Greeks among those who went up to worship at the feast.

kikuyu: Isaanis Fiiliphoos namicha Beetisayidaa Galiilaatii dhufe sanatti dhiʼaatanii, “Yaa gooftaa, Yesuusin arguu barbaanna” jedhaniin.
english: Therefore, these came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”

kikuyu: Fiiliphoosis dhaqee Indiriiyaasitti hime; Indiriiyaasii fi Fiiliphoos immoo dhaqanii Yesuusitti himan.
english: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedhee isaaniif deebise; “Saʼaatiin Ilmi Namaa itti ulfina argatu gaʼeera.
english: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; iji qamadii tokko yoo lafa buʼee duʼuu baate kophaa isaa hafa. Yoo duʼe garuu ija baayʼee naqata.
english: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.

kikuyu: Namni lubbuu isaa jaallatu kam iyyuu lubbuu isaa ni dhaba; kan addunyaa kana irratti lubbuu isaa jibbu immoo jireenya bara baraatiif lubbuu isaa kaaʼata.
english: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.

kikuyu: Namni na tajaajilu kam iyyuu na faana haa buʼu; iddoo ani jiru tajaajilaan koos ni jiraata. Abbaan koo nama na tajaajilu kamiif iyyuu ulfina ni kenna.
english: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.

kikuyu: “Amma lubbuun koo dhiphatteerti; egaa ani maal jedhu ree? ‘Yaa Abbaa, saʼaatii kana jalaa na baasi;’ garuu ani sababii kanaafan gara saʼaatii kanaa dhufe.
english: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time’? But I came to this time for this cause.

kikuyu: Yaa Abbaa, maqaa kee ulfeessi!” Ergasii sagaleen, “Ani isa ulfeesseera; ammas nan ulfeessa” jedhu tokko samiidhaa dhufe.
english: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it and will glorify it again.”

kikuyu: Tuunni achi dhaabachaa ture yommuu sagalee kana dhagaʼetti, “Ni kakawwise” jedhe. Warri kaan immoo, “Ergamaa Waaqaatu isatti dubbate” jedhan.
english: Therefore the multitude who stood by and heard it said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”

kikuyu: Yesuus akkana jedhee deebise; “Sagaleen kun sababii keessaniif dhufe malee sababii kootiif miti.
english: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.

kikuyu: Yeroon itti addunyaa kanatti muramu amma; bulchaan addunyaa kanaas amma gad gatama.
english: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.

kikuyu: Ani garuu yeroon lafa irraa ol fuudhamutti nama hunda ofitti nan harkisa.”
english: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”

kikuyu: Innis akka duʼa akkamii duʼuuf jiru argisiisuuf kana jedhe.
english: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

kikuyu: Tuunnis deebisee, “Akka Kiristoos bara baraan jiraatu nu Seera irraa dhageenyeerra; yoos ati akkamitti, ‘Ilmi Namaa ol fuudhamuu qaba’ jetta? ‘Ilmi Namaa’ kunis eenyu?” jedheen.
english: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this Son of Man?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akkana jedheen; “Ifni yeroo gabaabaadhaaf isin bira jira. Akka dukkanni isin hin liqimsineef utuu ifa qabdanuu deddeebiʼaa. Namni dukkana keessa deddeebiʼu eessa akka dhaqu hin beekuutii.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.

kikuyu: Ijoollee ifaa akka taataniif utuu ifa qabdanuu ifa sanatti amanaa.” Yesuusis erga waan kana dubbatee fixee booddee iddoo sanaa kaʼee isaan duraa dhokate.
english: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.

kikuyu: Yesuus fuula isaanii duratti mallattoo hedduu hojjetu iyyuu, isaan isatti hin amanne.
english: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,

kikuyu: Kunis dubbiin Isaayyaas raajichaa kan: “Yaa Gooftaa, ergaa keenya eenyutu amane? Irreen Gooftaas eenyutti mulʼate?” jedhu sun akka raawwatamuuf ture.
english: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke: “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf isaan amanuu hin dandeenye; Isaayyaas iddoo biraatti akkana jedheeraatii;
english: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again:

kikuyu: “Ija isaaniitiin akka hin argineef, qalbii isaaniitiin akka hin hubanneef, akka ani isaan fayyisuufis akka gara kootti hin deebineef, inni ija isaanii jaamseeraatii; garaa isaaniis jabeesseera.”
english: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”

kikuyu: Isaayyaas sababii ulfina isaa argee waaʼee isaas dubbateef waan kana jedhe.
english: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.

kikuyu: Taʼus hooggantoota keessaa iyyuu namoonni baayʼeen isatti amanan. Garuu waan mana sagadaatii nu baasu jedhanii Fariisota sodaataniif amantii isaanii ifatti hin baafne;
english: Nevertheless, even many of the rulers believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,

kikuyu: isaan ulfina Waaqaa irra ulfina namaa jaallataniiruutii.
english: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.

kikuyu: Yesuusis iyyee akkana jedhe; “Namni natti amanu isa na erge sanatti amana malee natti miti.
english: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.

kikuyu: Kan na argus isa na erge sana arga.
english: He who sees me sees him who sent me.

kikuyu: Akka namni natti amanu hundinuu dukkana keessa hin jiraanneef ani ifa taʼee gara addunyaa dhufeera.
english: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.

kikuyu: “Namni yoo dubbii koo dhagaʼee eeguu baate kan isatti muru ana miti; ani addunyaa fayyisuufin dhufe malee itti muruuf hin dhufneetii.
english: If anyone listens to my sayings and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.

kikuyu: Namni na didu kan dubbii koos hin fudhanne abbaa murtii tokko qaba; dubbiin ani dubbadhe sun guyyaa dhumaatti isatti mura.
english: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke will judge him in the last day.

kikuyu: Garuu Abbaa isuma na erge sanatu akka ani waanan dubbadhe sana jedhu na ajaje malee ani ofii kootiin hin dubbanne.
english: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me gave me a commandment, what I should say and what I should speak.

kikuyu: Akka ajajni isaa jireenya bara baraa taʼe nan beeka. Kanaafuu wanni ani dubbadhu kam iyyuu waan akka ani dubbadhuuf Abbaan natti himee dha.”
english: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”

kikuyu: Yeroon sun Ayyaana Faasiikaatiin dura ture. Yesuusis akka addunyaa kana keessaa gara Abbaa dhaquudhaaf saʼaatiin isaa gaʼe ni beeke. Innis warra kan isaa taʼan kanneen addunyaa keessa turan ni jaallate; hamma dhumaattis isaan jaallate.
english: Now before the feast of the Passover, Jesus, knowing that his time had come that he would depart from this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.

kikuyu: Yeroo irbaataatti diiyaabiloos akka inni Yesuusin dabarsee kennuuf Yihuudaa Keeriyoticha ilma Simoon keessa duraan dursee yaada kaaʼe.
english: During supper, the devil having already put into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,

kikuyu: Yesuusis akka Abbaan waan hunda harka isaatti kenne, akka Waaqa biraa dhufee fi akka gara Waaqaatti deebiʼu illee beeka ture;
english: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God and was going to God,

kikuyu: kanaaf irbaata irraa kaʼee, wayyaa isaa kan irraan uffate of irraa fuudhee lafa kaaʼe; fooxaas mudhiitti hidhate.
english: arose from supper, and laid aside his outer garments. He took a towel and wrapped a towel around his waist.

kikuyu: Ergasii gabateetti bishaan naqatee miilla barattootaa dhiquu fi fooxaa mudhiitti hidhate sanaanis haquu jalqabe.
english: Then he poured water into the basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet and to wipe them with the towel that was wrapped around him.

kikuyu: Inni gara Simoon Phexros dhufe; Phexrosis, “Yaa Gooftaa, situ miilla koo naa dhiqaa?” jedheen.
english: Then he came to Simon Peter. He said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo deebisee, “Waan ani hojjechaa jiru ati amma hin beektu; booddee garuu ni hubatta” jedheen.
english: Jesus answered him, “You don’t know what I am doing now, but you will understand later.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis, “Hin taʼu; ati gonkumaa miilla koo naa hin dhiqxu” jedheen. Yesuusis deebisee, “Yoo ani siif dhiquu baadhe ati na biraa qooda hin qabaattu” jedheen.
english: Peter said to him, “You will never wash my feet!” Jesus answered him, “If I don’t wash you, you have no part with me.”

kikuyu: Simoon Phexrosis deebisee, “Yaa Gooftaa, yoos harka koo fi mataa koos malee miilla koo qofa hin taʼin” jedheen.
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only, but also my hands and my head!”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Namni dhagna isaa dhiqate tokko miilla isaa qofa dhiqachuu isa barbaachisa; dhagni isaa guutuun qulqulluu dha. Isin qulqulluu dha; garuu hunda keessan miti” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “Someone who has bathed only needs to have his feet washed, but is completely clean. You are clean, but not all of you.”

kikuyu: Innis nama dabarsee isa kennuuf jiru beeka tureetii; sababiin inni, “Qulqulluun hunda keessan miti” jedheefis kanuma.
english: For he knew him who would betray him; therefore he said, “You are not all clean.”

kikuyu: Innis erga miilla isaanii dhiqee booddee, uffata isaa uffatee iddoo isaatti deebiʼee taaʼe. Akkanas jedheen; “Isin waan ani isiniif godhe hubattanii?
english: So when he had washed their feet, put his outer garment back on, and sat down again, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?

kikuyu: Isin, ‘Barsiisaa’, ‘Gooftaas’ naan jettu; anis waan isuma isin jettan taʼeef isin dhuguma jettan.
english: You call me, ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord.’ You say so correctly, for so I am.

kikuyu: Yoos erga ani Gooftaa fi Barsiisaan keessan miilla keessan isinii dhiqee, isinis akkasuma miilla walii dhiquu qabdu.
english: If I then, the Lord and the Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.

kikuyu: Akkuma ani isinii godhe kana isinis akka gootaniif ani fakkeenya isinii kenneera.
english: For I have given you an example, that you should also do as I have done to you.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; garbichi gooftaa isaa hin caalu; ergamaanis kan isa erge hin caalu.
english: Most certainly I tell you, a servant is not greater than his lord, neither is one who is sent greater than he who sent him.

kikuyu: Egaa isin yoo waan kana beektanii hojii irra oolchitan isin eebbifamoo dha.
english: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.

kikuyu: “Ani waaʼee hunda keessanii dubbachaa hin jiru; ani warran filadhe nan beeka. Kun garuu dubbiin Katabbii Qulqulluu kan, ‘Inni buddeena koo nyaate koomee isaa natti ol fudhate’jedhu sun akka guutamuuf.
english: I don’t speak concerning all of you. I know whom I have chosen; but that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who eats bread with me has lifted up his heel against me.’

kikuyu: “Isin yommuu wanni kun taʼutti akka ani Isa taʼe akka amantaniif utuu inni hin taʼin amma isinitti nan hima.
english: From now on, I tell you before it happens, that when it happens, you may believe that I am he.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; kan nama ani ergu kam iyyuu simatu hundinuu na simata; kan na simatu hundis isa na erge sana simata.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who receives whomever I send, receives me; and he who receives me, receives him who sent me.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis erga kana dubbatee booddee hafuuraan jeeqamee, “Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; isin keessaa tokko dabarsee na kenna” jedhee dhugaa baʼe.
english: When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will betray me.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni akka inni waaʼee eenyuu dubbate wallaalanii wal ilaalan.
english: The disciples looked at one another, perplexed about whom he spoke.

kikuyu: Barattoota keessaas inni Yesuus isa jaallatu tokko Yesuusitti irkatee maaddiitti dhiʼaatee ture.
english: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was at the table, leaning against Jesus’ chest.

kikuyu: Simoon Phexrosis, “Mee eenyuu jechuu isaa akka taʼe isa gaafadhu!” jedhee nyaaraan barataa sanatti hime.
english: Simon Peter therefore beckoned to him, and said to him, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”

kikuyu: Innis qoma Yesuusiitti hirkatee, “Yaa Gooftaa, eenyu innii?” jedhee gaafate.
english: He, leaning back, as he was, on Jesus’ chest, asked him, “Lord, who is it?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Namichi ani buddeena afaan kaaʼata tokkoo caabii keessa cuuphee kennuuf isa” jedhe. Innis buddeena caabii keessa cuuphee Yihuudaa ilma Simoon Keeriyotichaatiif kenne.
english: Jesus therefore answered, “It is he to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.

kikuyu: Yihuudaas akkuma inni buddeenicha fudhateen Seexanni itti gale. Yesuusis, “Waan gochuuf jirtu dafii godhi” isaan jedhe.
english: After the piece of bread, then Satan entered into him. Then Jesus said to him, “What you do, do quickly.”

kikuyu: Warra nyaataaf tataaʼan keessaas namni tokko iyyuu waan inni akkas isaan jedheef hin hubanne.
english: Now nobody at the table knew why he said this to him.

kikuyu: Sababii Yihuudaan korojoo maallaqaa baachaa tureefis isaan keessaa namoonni tokko tokko waan Yesuus, akka inni waan Ayyaanaaf barbaachisu bitu yookaan akka inni hiyyeeyyiif waa kennu isatti hime seʼan.
english: For some thought, because Judas had the money box, that Jesus said to him, “Buy what things we need for the feast,” or that he should give something to the poor.

kikuyu: Yihuudaanis akkuma buddeena sana fudhateen gad baʼe. Yeroon sunis halkan ture.
english: Therefore having received that morsel, he went out immediately. It was night.

kikuyu: Erga Yihuudaan gad baʼee booddee Yesuus akkana jedhe; “Amma Ilmi Namaa ulfaateera; Waaqnis isaan ulfina argateera.
english: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man has been glorified, and God has been glorified in him.

kikuyu: Waaqni erga isaan ulfina argatee, Waaqni ofuma isaatiin Ilma ulfeessa; inni takkumaan isa ulfeessa.
english: If God has been glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and he will glorify him immediately.

kikuyu: “Yaa ijoolle, ani yeroo gabaabaaf isin wajjinan jira. Isin na barbaaddu; ani akkuma Yihuudootaan, ‘Iddoo ani dhaqu isin dhufuu hin dandeessan’ jedhe sana ammas isiniin nan jedha.
english: Little children, I will be with you a little while longer. You will seek me, and as I said to the Jews, ‘Where I am going, you can’t come,’ so now I tell you.

kikuyu: “Akka isin wal jaallattaniif ani ajaja haaraa isiniifin kenna. Akkuma ani isin jaalladhetti isinis akkasuma wal jaalladhaa.
english: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another. Just as I have loved you, you also love one another.

kikuyu: Yoo isin jaalala waliif qabaattan namoonni hundinuu akka isin barattoota koo taatan kanaan ni beeku.”
english: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”

kikuyu: Simoon Phexrosis, “Yaa Gooftaa, eessa dhaqxa?” jedhee isa gaafate. Yesuusis, “Ati amma iddoo ani dhaqu na faana dhaquu hin dandeessu; gara booddeetti garuu na duukaa buuta” jedhee deebiseef.
english: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going, you can’t follow now, but you will follow afterwards.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis, “Yaa Gooftaa, ani maaliifan amma si duukaa buʼuu hin dandeenye? Ani siif jedhee lubbuu koo nan kenna” jedheen.
english: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can’t I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Ati dhuguma naaf jettee lubbuu kee ni kennitaa? Ani dhuguman, dhuguman sitti hima; ati utuu indaanqoon hin iyyin yeroo sadii na ganta” jedheen.
english: Jesus answered him, “Will you lay down your life for me? Most certainly I tell you, the rooster won’t crow until you have denied me three times.

kikuyu: “Garaan keessan hin raafamin. Waaqatti amanaa; nattis amanaa.
english: “Don’t let your heart be troubled. Believe in God. Believe also in me.

kikuyu: Mana Abbaa koo keessa iddoo jireenyaa baayʼeetu jira; utuu akkana taʼuu baatee silaa isinittin hima ture. Ani iddoo isinii qopheessuuf achin dhaqaatii.
english: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.

kikuyu: Anis yoon dhaqee iddoo isinii qopheesse, akka isinis iddoo ani jiru jiraattaniif deebiʼee dhufeen ofitti isin fudhadha.
english: If I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will receive you to myself; that where I am, you may be there also.

kikuyu: Isinis karaa iddoo ani dhaquu ni beektu.”
english: You know where I go, and you know the way.”

kikuyu: Toomaasis, “Yaa Gooftaa, ati eessa akka dhaqxu nu hin beeknu; yoos akkamitti karaa sana beekuu dandeenya ree?” jedheen.
english: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we don’t know where you are going. How can we know the way?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Karaa fi dhugaan, jireenyis anuma. Yoo anaan taʼe malee eenyu iyyuu gara Abbaa hin dhufu.
english: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, the truth, and the life. No one comes to the Father, except through me.

kikuyu: Utuu na beektanii silaa Abbaa koos akkasuma ni beektu turtan; ammaa jalqabdaniis isa beektu; isas argitaniirtu.”
english: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also. From now on, you know him and have seen him.”

kikuyu: Fiiliphoos, “Yaa Gooftaa, Abbaa nutti argisiisi; kun nu gaʼaatii” jedheen.
english: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana isaan jedhe; “Yaa Fiiliphoos, ani yeroo dheeraa akkanaa isin wajjin jiraadhee, ati amma illee na hin beeknee? Namni na arge Abbaas argeera. Yoos ati akkamitti, ‘Abbaa nutti argisiisi’ jechuu dandeessa ree?
english: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you such a long time, and do you not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father. How do you say, ‘Show us the Father’?

kikuyu: Akka ani Abbaa keessa jiru, Abbaanis akka na keessa jiru ati hin amantuu? Ani dubbii isinitti dubbadhu kana ofuma kootiin hin dubbadhu. Garuu Abbaa isa na keessa jiraatutu hojii isaa hojjeta.
english: Don’t you believe that I am in the Father, and the Father in me? The words that I tell you, I speak not from myself; but the Father who lives in me does his works.

kikuyu: Akka ani Abbaa keessa jiru, Abbaanis akka na keessa jiru na amanaa; yookaan sababii hojii sanaatiif na amanaa.
english: Believe me that I am in the Father, and the Father in me; or else believe me for the very works’ sake.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; namni natti amanu hojii ani hojjedhu ni hojjeta. Ani waanan gara Abbaa dhaquuf inni waan kana caalu iyyuu ni hojjeta.
english: Most certainly I tell you, he who believes in me, the works that I do, he will do also; and he will do greater works than these, because I am going to my Father.

kikuyu: Akka Abbaan Ilmaan ulfina argatuuf ani waan isin maqaa kootiin kadhattan kam iyyuu nan raawwadha.
english: Whatever you will ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son.

kikuyu: Yoo isin maqaa kootiin waan kam iyyuu na kadhattan ani nan raawwadha.
english: If you will ask anything in my name, I will do it.

kikuyu: “Isin yoo na jaallattan ajaja koo eegaa.
english: If you love me, keep my commandments.

kikuyu: Ani Abbaa nan kadhadha; innis akka inni bara baraan isin wajjin jiraatuuf Jajjabeessaa biraa isinii kenna;
english: I will pray to the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, that he may be with you forever:

kikuyu: inni Hafuura dhugaa ti. Addunyaan waan isa hin arginee fi waan isa hin beekneef isa fudhachuu hin dandaʼu. Isin garuu waan inni isin wajjin jiraatuuf, isin keessas waan jiruuf isa ni beektu.
english: the Spirit of truth, whom the world can’t receive, for it doesn’t see him and doesn’t know him. You know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.

kikuyu: Ani akka ijoollee haadhaa fi abbaa hin qabneetti isin hin dhiisu; gara keessan nan dhufa.
english: I will not leave you orphans. I will come to you.

kikuyu: Yeroo muraasa booddee addunyaan deebiʼee na hin argu; isin garuu na argitu. Sababii ani jiraadhuuf isinis ni jiraattu.
english: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more; but you will see me. Because I live, you will live also.

kikuyu: Akka ani Abbaa koo keessa jiru, akka isin na keessa jirtan akka anis isin keessa jiru gaafas ni beektu.
english: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.

kikuyu: Namni ajajawwan koo qabu, isaanis kan eegu, inni na jaallata. Nama na jaallatu Abbaan koo ni jaallata; anis isa nan jaalladha; isattis of nan mulʼisa.”
english: One who has my commandments and keeps them, that person is one who loves me. One who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him, and will reveal myself to him.”

kikuyu: Yihuudaa Keeriyoticha utuu hin taʼin inni Yihuudaan kaan, “Yaa Gooftaa, ati maaliif addunyaatti utuu hin taʼin nutti of mulʼisuu barbaadda?” jedheen.
english: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, what has happened that you are about to reveal yourself to us, and not to the world?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Namni na jaallatu kam iyyuu dubbii koo ni eega. Abbaan koo isa ni jaallata; nus gara isaa ni dhufna; iddoo jireenyaas isa wajjin ni godhanna.
english: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word. My Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.

kikuyu: Namni na hin jaallanne dubbii koo hin eegu. Dubbiin isin dhageessan kunis kan Abbaa na erge sanaati malee kan koo miti.
english: He who doesn’t love me doesn’t keep my words. The word which you hear isn’t mine, but the Father’s who sent me.

kikuyu: “Ani utuman isin wajjin jiruu waan kana isinitti dubbadheera.
english: “I have said these things to you while still living with you.

kikuyu: Jajjabeessaan sun, Hafuurri Qulqulluun kan Abbaan maqaa kootiin ergu garuu waan hunda isin barsiisa; waan ani isinitti hime hundas isin yaadachiisa.
english: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things, and will remind you of all that I said to you.

kikuyu: Ani nagaa isin biratti nan hambisa; nagaa koos isiniif nan kenna. Ani akka addunyaan kennutti isiniif hin kennu. Garaan keessan hin raafamin; hin sodaatinis.
english: Peace I leave with you. My peace I give to you; not as the world gives, I give to you. Don’t let your heart be troubled, neither let it be fearful.

kikuyu: “Isin akka ani, ‘Ani nan deema; deebiʼees gara keessan nan dhufa’ jedhe dhageessaniirtu. Utuu na jaallattanii silaa gara Abbaa dhaquu kootti ni gammaddu turtan; Abbaan na caalaatii.
english: You heard how I told you, ‘I am going away, and I will come back to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced because I said ‘I am going to my Father;’ for the Father is greater than I.

kikuyu: Akka yommuu wanni kun taʼutti isin amantaniif utuu wanni kun hin taʼin ani amma duraan dursee isinitti himeera.
english: Now I have told you before it happens so that when it happens, you may believe.

kikuyu: Waan bulchaan addunyaa kanaa dhufuuf, ani siʼachi isin wajjin baayʼee hin dubbadhu; inni narraa homaa hin qabu;
english: I will no more speak much with you, for the prince of the world comes, and he has nothing in me.

kikuyu: garuu akka ani Abbaa jaalladhu addunyaan akka beekuuf, ani akkuma Abbaan na ajajetti nan hojjedha. “Kaʼaa, asii ni deemnaa.
english: But that the world may know that I love the Father, and as the Father commanded me, even so I do. Arise, let’s go from here.

kikuyu: “Ani muka wayinii dhugaa ti; kan dhaabes Abbaa koo ti.
english: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the farmer.

kikuyu: Inni damee koo kan ija hin naqanne hunda muree gata; damee ija naqatu immoo akka inni caalaatti naqatuuf irraa qora.
english: Every branch in me that doesn’t bear fruit, he takes away. Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

kikuyu: Isin dubbii ani isinitti dubbadheen amma qulqulluu dha.
english: You are already pruned clean because of the word which I have spoken to you.

kikuyu: Na keessa jiraadhaa; anis isin keessa nan jiraadhaa. Akkuma dameen yoo muka wayiniitti jiraate malee ofuma isaatiin ija naqachuu hin dandeenye, isinis yoo na keessa jiraattan malee ija naqachuu hin dandeessan.
english: Remain in me, and I in you. As the branch can’t bear fruit by itself unless it remains in the vine, so neither can you, unless you remain in me.

kikuyu: “Ani muka wayinii ti; isini immoo dameewwan. Namni yoo na keessa jiraate, anis yoon isa keessa jiraadhe inni ija baayʼee naqata; isin narraa gargar baatanii homaa gochuu hin dandeessaniitii.
english: I am the vine. You are the branches. He who remains in me and I in him bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.

kikuyu: Namni na keessa hin jiraanne akka damee gad gatamee goguu ti. Dameewwan akkanaa walitti qabamanii ibiddatti naqamu; ni gubamus.
english: If a man doesn’t remain in me, he is thrown out as a branch and is withered; and they gather them, throw them into the fire, and they are burned.

kikuyu: Isin yoo na keessa jiraattan, dubbiin koos yoo isin keessa jiraate, waanuma feetan kadhadhaa; innis isiniif ni kennama.
english: If you remain in me, and my words remain in you, you will ask whatever you desire, and it will be done for you.

kikuyu: Isin yoo ija baayʼee naqattanii fi yoo barattoota koo taatan, kanaan Abbaan koo ulfina argata.
english: “In this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit; and so you will be my disciples.

kikuyu: “Akkuma Abbaan na jaallatetti anis akkasuma isin jaalladheera. Egaa jaalala koo keessa jiraadhaa.
english: Even as the Father has loved me, I also have loved you. Remain in my love.

kikuyu: Akkuma ani ajajawwan Abbaa kootii eegee jaalala isaa keessa jiraadhu, isinis yoo ajajawwan koo eegdan jaalala koo keessa ni jiraattu.
english: If you keep my commandments, you will remain in my love, even as I have kept my Father’s commandments and remain in his love.

kikuyu: Akka gammachuun koo isin keessa jiraatuu fi akka gammachuun keessanis guutuu taʼuuf ani waan kana isinitti himeera.
english: I have spoken these things to you, that my joy may remain in you, and that your joy may be made full.

kikuyu: Ajajni koo isa kana: Akkuma ani isin jaalladhetti isinis wal jaalladhaa.
english: “This is my commandment, that you love one another, even as I have loved you.

kikuyu: Eenyu iyyuu jaalala guddaa kan namni lubbuu isaa dabarsee michoota isaatiif kennu sana irra caalu hin qabu.
english: Greater love has no one than this, that someone lay down his life for his friends.

kikuyu: Waan ani isin ajaje yoo raawwattan isin michoota koo ti.
english: You are my friends if you do whatever I command you.

kikuyu: Garbichi waan gooftaan isaa hojjetu waan hin beekneef, ani siʼachi garboota isiniin hin jedhu. Qooda kanaa ani michoota isiniin jedheera; ani waanan Abbaa koo irraa dhagaʼe hundumaa isin beeksiseeraatii.
english: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant doesn’t know what his lord does. But I have called you friends, for everything that I heard from my Father, I have made known to you.

kikuyu: Isinis akka dhaqxanii ija naqattaniif, iji keessanis akka jiraatuuf anatu isin filatee isin muude malee isin na hin filanne. Kunis akka Abbaan waan isin maqaa kootiin kadhattan kam iyyuu isinii kennuuf.
english: You didn’t choose me, but I chose you and appointed you, that you should go and bear fruit, and that your fruit should remain; that whatever you will ask of the Father in my name, he may give it to you.

kikuyu: Ajajni koo isa kana: Wal jaalladhaa.
english: “I command these things to you, that you may love one another.

kikuyu: “Yoo addunyaan isin jibbe, akka inni isin dura na jibbe beekaa.
english: If the world hates you, you know that it has hated me before it hated you.

kikuyu: Utuu isin kan addunyaa taatanii silaa addunyaan kan ofii isaa ni jaallata ture. Amma garuu waan ani addunyaa keessaa isin filadheef isin kan addunyaa miti. Kanaafuu addunyaan isin jibba.
english: If you were of the world, the world would love its own. But because you are not of the world, since I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.

kikuyu: Dubbii ani, ‘Garbichi gooftaa isaa hin caalu’jedhee isinitti hime sana yaadadhaa. Isaan erga na ariʼatanii, isinis ni ariʼatu. Yoo dubbii kootiif ajajaman, dubbii keessaniifis ni ajajamu.
english: Remember the word that I said to you: ‘A servant is not greater than his lord.’ If they persecuted me, they will also persecute you. If they kept my word, they will also keep yours.

kikuyu: Isaan waan Isa na erge sana hin beekneef, sababii maqaa kootiitiif waan kana hunda isin irratti raawwatu.
english: But they will do all these things to you for my name’s sake, because they don’t know him who sent me.

kikuyu: Utuu ani dhufee isaanitti himuu baadhee silaa cubbuu isaanitti hin taʼu ture. Amma garuu cubbuu isaaniitiif sababii dhiʼeeffatan hin qaban.
english: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have had sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.

kikuyu: Namni na jibbu Abbaa koos ni jibba.
english: He who hates me, hates my Father also.

kikuyu: Utuu ani hojii namni biraa tokko iyyuu hin hojjetin gidduu isaaniitti hojjechuu baadhee silaa cubbuu isaanitti hin taʼu ture. Amma garuu utuma waan ani hojjedhe arganuu anas Abbaa koos jibbaniiru.
english: If I hadn’t done among them the works which no one else did, they wouldn’t have had sin. But now they have seen and also hated both me and my Father.

kikuyu: Kunis akka dubbiin Seera isaanii keessatti, ‘Isaan akkasumaan na jibban’jedhamee barreeffame sun raawwatamuuf taʼe.
english: But this happened so that the word may be fulfilled which was written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’

kikuyu: “Jajjabeessaan ani Abbaa biraa isinii ergu, jechuunis Hafuurri Dhugaa inni Abbaa keessaa baʼu sun yommuu dhufutti waaʼee koo dhugaa baʼa.
english: “When the Counselor has come, whom I will send to you from the Father, the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will testify about me.

kikuyu: Isinis jalqabaa kaaftanii waan na wajjin turtaniif dhugaa baatu.
english: You will also testify, because you have been with me from the beginning.

kikuyu: “Ani akka isin hin gufanneef jedhee wantoota kanneen isinitti himeera.
english: “I have said these things to you so that you wouldn’t be caused to stumble.

kikuyu: Isaan mana sagadaa keessaa isin ariʼu; dhugumaan yeroon itti namni isin ajjeesu kam iyyuu akka waan Waaqa tajaajiluutti yaadu tokko ni dhufa.
english: They will put you out of the synagogues. Yes, the time is coming that whoever kills you will think that he offers service to God.

kikuyu: Isaanis waan Abbaa yookaan na hin beekiniif wantoota kanneen godhu.
english: They will do these things because they have not known the Father nor me.

kikuyu: Anis akka isin yommuu yeroon sun gaʼutti isaan yaadattaniif wantoota kanneen isinitti himeera. Ani waanan isin wajjin tureef jalqabatti wantoota kanneen isinitti hin himne.
english: But I have told you these things so that when the time comes, you may remember that I told you about them. I didn’t tell you these things from the beginning, because I was with you.

kikuyu: “Amma garuu ani gara isa na ergee nan dhaqa; taʼus isin keessaa namni, ‘Ati eessa dhaqxa?’ jedhee na gaafatu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: But now I am going to him who sent me, and none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’

kikuyu: Garuu waan ani wantoota kanneen isinitti himeef garaan keessan gaddaan guutameera.
english: But because I have told you these things, sorrow has filled your heart.

kikuyu: Ani garuu dhuguman isinitti hima; deemuun koo buʼaa isiniif qaba; yoo ani deeme malee Jajjabeessaan sun gara keessan hin dhufu; ani yoon deeme garuu isa isiniif nan erga.
english: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: It is to your advantage that I go away; for if I don’t go away, the Counselor won’t come to you. But if I go, I will send him to you.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu dhufutti akka addunyaan waaʼee cubbuu, waaʼee qajeelummaatii fi waaʼee murtii dogoggoree jiru mirkaneessa;
english: When he has come, he will convict the world about sin, about righteousness, and about judgment;

kikuyu: waaʼee cubbuu, sababii namoonni natti hin amanneef;
english: about sin, because they don’t believe in me;

kikuyu: waaʼee qajeelummaa, sababii ani gara Abbaa dhaquu fi sababii isinis siʼachi na hin argineef;
english: about righteousness, because I am going to my Father, and you won’t see me any more;

kikuyu: waaʼee murtii immoo sababii bulchaa addunyaa kanaatti murameef.
english: about judgment, because the prince of this world has been judged.

kikuyu: “Ani amma iyyuu waanan isinitti himu baayʼee qaba; isin garuu amma baachuu hin dandeessan.
english: “I still have many things to tell you, but you can’t bear them now.

kikuyu: Hafuurri dhugaa sun yommuu dhufutti gara dhugaa hundaatti isin geessa. Inni waan dhagaʼu qofa dubbata malee ofuma isaatiin hin dubbatu; waan dhufuuf jirus isinitti hima.
english: However, when he, the Spirit of truth, has come, he will guide you into all truth, for he will not speak from himself; but whatever he hears, he will speak. He will declare to you things that are coming.

kikuyu: Inni sababii waanuma koo fuudhee isinitti beeksisuuf ulfina naa kenna.
english: He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine and will declare it to you.

kikuyu: Wanni Abbaan qabu hundinuu kan koo ti. Inni waanuma koo fuudhee isinitti beeksisa jechuun koos kanumaaf.
english: All things that the Father has are mine; therefore I said that he takes of mine and will declare it to you.

kikuyu: “Isin yeroo muraasa booddee na hin argitan; yeroo muraasa booddee immoo deebitanii na argitu.”
english: “A little while, and you will not see me. Again a little while, and you will see me.”

kikuyu: Barattoota isaa keessaas tokko tokko, “Inni, ‘Isin yeroo muraasaaf na hin argitan; yeroo muraasaaf immoo deebitanii na argitu’ akkanumas ‘Ani waanan gara Abbaa dhaquuf’ nuun jechuun isaa maal jechuu isaa ti?” waliin jedhan.
english: Some of his disciples therefore said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me;’ and, ‘Because I go to the Father’?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “ ‘Yeroo muraasaaf’ jechuun isaa maal jechuu isaa ti? Maal jechuu isaa akka taʼe nu hin beeknu” jedhan.
english: They said therefore, “What is this that he says, ‘A little while’? We don’t know what he is saying.”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo akka isaan isa gaafachuu barbaadan beekee akkana jedheen; “Wanni ani, ‘Isin yeroo muraasaaf na hin argitan; yeroo muraasaaf immoo deebitanii na argitu’ jedhe sun maal jechuu koo akka taʼe wal gaafachaa jirtuu?
english: Therefore Jesus perceived that they wanted to ask him, and he said to them, “Do you inquire among yourselves concerning this, that I said, ‘A little while, and you won’t see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; isin ni boossu; ni gadittus. Addunyaan garuu ni gammada. Isin ni gadditu; gaddi keessan garuu gammachuutti ni geeddarama.
english: Most certainly I tell you that you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice. You will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will be turned into joy.

kikuyu: Dubartiin yommuu ciniinsifattu, waan yeroon ishee gaʼeef ni gadditi; erga daaʼima deessee booddee garuu waan addunyaa irratti namni dhalateef, isheenis waan gammadduuf dhiphina sana hin yaadattu.
english: A woman, when she gives birth, has sorrow because her time has come. But when she has delivered the child, she doesn’t remember the anguish any more, for the joy that a human being is born into the world.

kikuyu: Isinis akkasuma amma gadditaniirtu; ani garuu deebiʼeen isin ilaala; garaan keessanis ni gammada. Gammachuu keessanis eenyu iyyuu isin irraa hin fudhatu.
english: Therefore you now have sorrow, but I will see you again, and your heart will rejoice, and no one will take your joy away from you.

kikuyu: Gaafas isin homaa na hin kadhattan. Ani dhuguman, dhuguman isinitti hima; Abbaan waan isin maqaa kootiin kadhattan kam iyyuu isinii kenna.
english: “In that day you will ask me no questions. Most certainly I tell you, whatever you may ask of the Father in my name, he will give it to you.

kikuyu: Isin hamma ammaatti maqaa kootiin homaa hin kadhanne. Akka gammachuun keessan guutuu taʼuuf kadhadhaa ni argattu.
english: Until now, you have asked nothing in my name. Ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be made full.

kikuyu: “Ani wantoota kanneen fakkeenyaan isinitti himeera; garuu yeroon ani deebiʼee fakkeenyaan isinitti hin dubbanne ni dhufa; yommus ani waaʼee Abbaa koo ifaan ifatti isinittin hima.
english: “I have spoken these things to you in figures of speech. But the time is coming when I will no more speak to you in figures of speech, but will tell you plainly about the Father.

kikuyu: Isin gaafas maqaa kootiin ni kadhattu. Ani Abbaa isiniif nan kadhadha isiniin hin jedhu.
english: In that day you will ask in my name; and I don’t say to you that I will pray to the Father for you,

kikuyu: Isin waan na jaallattaniif, Waaqa biraa baʼuu koo waan amantaniif Abbaan mataan isaa isin jaallata.
english: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me, and have believed that I came from God.

kikuyu: Ani Abbaa biraa baʼee gara addunyaa dhufeera; ammas addunyaa dhiisee gara Abbaa nan dhaqa.”
english: I came from the Father and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world and go to the Father.”

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaas akkana jedhan; “Kunoo, ati amma iyyuu fakkeenyaan utuu hin taʼin ifaan ifatti dubbachaa jirta.
english: His disciples said to him, “Behold, now you are speaking plainly, and using no figures of speech.

kikuyu: Akka ati waan hunda beektuu fi akka namni tokko iyyuu gaaffii si gaafachuu hin barbaachifne nu amma ni beekna. Kanaanis nu akka ati Waaqa biraa baate ni amanna.”
english: Now we know that you know all things, and don’t need for anyone to question you. By this we believe that you came from God.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee akkana jedheen; “Isin amma ni amantuu?
english: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?

kikuyu: Kunoo yeroon isin itti kophaatti na dhiiftanii tokkoon tokkoon keessan gara feetanitti bittinnooftan tokko ni dhufa. Ammuma iyyuu dhufeera. Garuu waan Abbaan koo na wajjin jiruuf ani kophaa koo miti.
english: Behold, the time is coming, yes, and has now come, that you will be scattered, everyone to his own place, and you will leave me alone. Yet I am not alone, because the Father is with me.

kikuyu: “Akka isin anaan nagaa qabaattaniif ani wantoota kanneen isinitti himeera. Addunyaa kana irratti rakkinni isin argata. Garuu jabaadhaa! Ani addunyaa moʼadheeraa.”
english: I have told you these things, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have trouble; but cheer up! I have overcome the world.”

kikuyu: Yesuus wantoota kanneen dubbatee gara samii ol ilaalee akkana jedhe: “Yaa Abbaa, saʼaatiin sun gaʼeera. Akka Ilmi kees ulfina siif kennuuf, ati Ilma keetiif ulfina kenni.
english: Jesus said these things, then lifting up his eyes to heaven, he said, “Father, the time has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may also glorify you;

kikuyu: Akka inni warra ati isaaf kennite hundaaf jireenya bara baraa kennuuf, nama hunda irratti taayitaa isaaf kenniteertaatii.
english: even as you gave him authority over all flesh, so he will give eternal life to all whom you have given him.

kikuyu: Jireenyi bara baraas kana: innis akka isaan siʼi Waaqa dhugaa tokkichaa fi Yesuus Kiristoos isa ati ergite sana beekaniif.
english: This is eternal life, that they should know you, the only true God, and him whom you sent, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ani hojii ati akka ani hojjedhuuf natti kennite sana raawwachuudhaan lafa irratti ulfina siif kenneera.
english: I glorified you on the earth. I have accomplished the work which you have given me to do.

kikuyu: Yaa Abbaa, amma immoo ati ulfina ani utuu addunyaan hin uumaminiin dura si biratti qabaadhe sanaan of biratti na ulfeessi.
english: Now, Father, glorify me with your own self with the glory which I had with you before the world existed.

kikuyu: “Ani namoota ati addunyaa keessaa naa kennitetti maqaa kee beeksiseera. Isaan kan kee turan; ati isaan naa kennite; isaanis dubbii kee eeganiiru.
english: “I revealed your name to the people whom you have given me out of the world. They were yours, and you have given them to me. They have kept your word.

kikuyu: Isaan akka wanni ati anaaf kennite hundumtuu si biraa dhufe amma beekaniiru.
english: Now they have known that all things whatever you have given me are from you,

kikuyu: Ani dubbii ati anaaf kennite isaaniif kenneeraatii; isaanis fudhataniiru. Akka ani si biraa baʼes dhugumaan beekaniiru; akka ati na ergites amananiiru.
english: for the words which you have given me I have given to them; and they received them, and knew for sure that I came from you. They have believed that you sent me.

kikuyu: Ani isaaniif nan kadhadha. Warri ati naa kennite waan kan kee taʼaniif isaaniifin kadhadha malee addunyaaf hin kadhadhu.
english: I pray for them. I don’t pray for the world, but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours.

kikuyu: Wanni ani qabu hundinuu kan kee ti; wanni ati qabdu hundinuus kan koo ti. Anis kanaan ulfina nan argadha.
english: All things that are mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.

kikuyu: Ani siʼachi addunyaa keessa hin turu; isaan garuu amma iyyuu addunyaa keessa jiru; ani gara kee nan dhufa. Yaa Abbaa Qulqulluu, akkuma nu tokko taane sana isaanis tokko akka taʼaniif maqaa kee kan naa kennite sanaan isaan eegi.
english: I am no more in the world, but these are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them through your name which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are.

kikuyu: Ani yeroo isaan wajjin turetti, maqaa kee kan ati naa kennite sanaan isaan nan eege; isaan eegeeras. Akka Katabbiin Qulqulluun raawwatamuufis ilma badii sana malee isaan keessaa namni tokko iyyuu hin badne.
english: While I was with them in the world, I kept them in your name. I have kept those whom you have given me. None of them is lost except the son of destruction, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.

kikuyu: “Amma garuu ani gara kee nan dhufa; gammachuun koos akka isaan keessatti guutuu taʼuuf, ani amma iyyuu utuman addunyaa keessa jiruu wantoota kanneen nan dubbadha.
english: But now I come to you, and I say these things in the world, that they may have my joy made full in themselves.

kikuyu: Ani dubbii kee isaaniif kenneera; akkuma ani kan addunyaa hin taʼin, isaanis waan kan addunyaa hin taʼiniif, addunyaan isaan jibbeera.
english: I have given them your word. The world hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

kikuyu: Ani akka ati isa hamaa sana isaan irraa eegduuf malee akka ati addunyaa keessaa isaan baaftuuf si hin kadhadhu.
english: I pray not that you would take them from the world, but that you would keep them from the evil one.

kikuyu: Akkuma ani kan addunyaa hin taʼin isaanis akkasuma kan addunyaa miti.
english: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.

kikuyu: Dhugaadhaan isaan qulqulleessi; dubbiin kee dhugaa dha.
english: Sanctify them in your truth. Your word is truth.

kikuyu: Akkuma ati gara addunyaatti na ergite sana anis gara addunyaatti isaan ergeera.
english: As you sent me into the world, even so I have sent them into the world.

kikuyu: Akka isaanis dhugumaan qulqullaaʼaniif, ani isaaniif jedhee of nan qulqulleessa.
english: For their sakes I sanctify myself, that they themselves also may be sanctified in truth.

kikuyu: “Ani warra dubbii isaaniitiin natti amananiifis malee isaan kana qofaaf hin kadhadhu;
english: “Not for these only do I pray, but for those also who will believe in me through their word,

kikuyu: kunis yaa Abbaa, akkuma ati na keessa jirtu, anis si keessa jiru sana, akka hundi isaanii tokko taʼaniif. Akka ati na ergite addunyaan akka amanuuf isaanis nu keessa haa jiraatan.
english: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be one in us; that the world may believe that you sent me.

kikuyu: Akkuma nu tokko taane isaanis tokko akka taʼaniif, ulfina ati naaf kennite sana anis isaaniif kenneera;
english: The glory which you have given me, I have given to them, that they may be one, even as we are one,

kikuyu: kunis akka isaan guutummaatti tokko taʼaniif ani isaan keessa nan jiraadha; ati immoo na keessa jiraatta. Yoos akka ati na ergitee fi akkuma na jaallattetti akka isaanis jaallatte addunyaan ni beeka.
english: I in them, and you in me, that they may be perfected into one, that the world may know that you sent me and loved them, even as you loved me.

kikuyu: “Yaa Abbaa, akka warri ati naa kennite kunneen iddoo ani jiru na wajjin jiraatanii fi akka isaan ulfina koo kan ati utuu addunyaan hin uumaminiin dura waan na jaallatteef naa kennite sana arganis nan barbaada.
english: Father, I desire that they also whom you have given me be with me where I am, that they may see my glory which you have given me, for you loved me before the foundation of the world.

kikuyu: “Yaa Abbaa Qajeelticha, addunyaan si hin beeku; ani garuu sin beeka; isaan kunis akka ati na ergite ni beeku.
english: Righteous Father, the world hasn’t known you, but I knew you; and these knew that you sent me.

kikuyu: Akkan jaalalli ati ittiin na jaallatte sun isaan keessa jiraatuuf, anis akka isaan keessa jiraadhuuf ani akka maqaan kee isaan biratti beekamu godheera; akka beekamus nan godha.”
english: I made known to them your name, and will make it known; that the love with which you loved me may be in them, and I in them.”

kikuyu: Yesuus wantoota kanneen dubbatee barattoota isaa wajjin Sulula Qeediroon gama iddoo biqiltuun ture tokkotti ceʼe; innis, barattoonni isaas achi keessa seenan.
english: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went out with his disciples over the brook Kidron, where there was a garden, into which he and his disciples entered.

kikuyu: Yesuus yeroo baayʼee barattoota isaa wajjin achitti wal argaa waan tureef, Yihuudaan inni Yesuusin dabarsee kennu sunis iddoo sana beeka ture.
english: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yihuudaan tuuta loltootaatii fi qondaaltota luboota hangafootaa fi Fariisota biraa ergaman dura deemaa achi dhufe. Isaanis guca, ibsaa fi miʼa lolaa qabatanii turan.
english: Judas then, having taken a detachment of soldiers and officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, came there with lanterns, torches, and weapons.

kikuyu: Yesuusis waan isa irra gaʼuuf jiru hunda beeknaan gad baʼee, “Isin eenyun barbaaddu?” jedhee isaan gaafate.
english: Jesus therefore, knowing all the things that were happening to him, went out and said to them, “Who are you looking for?”

kikuyu: Isaanis deebisanii, “Yesuus isa Naazreeti” jedhan. Yesuus immoo, “Ani isaa dha” jedhe. Yihuudaan inni dabarsee isa kennu sunis jara wajjin achi dhaabachaa ture.
english: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas also, who betrayed him, was standing with them.

kikuyu: Yommuu Yesuus, “Ani isaa dha” isaaniin jedhetti dugda duubatti deebiʼanii lafatti kukkufan.
english: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward and fell to the ground.

kikuyu: Inni ammas, “Isin eenyun barbaaddu?” jedhee isaan gaafate. Isaanis, “Yesuus isa Naazreeti” jedhan.
english: Again therefore he asked them, “Who are you looking for?” They said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Ani, ‘Ani isaa dha’ isiniin jedheera. Kanaafuu, isin yoo na barbaaddan namoota kanneen dhiisaa haa deemanii!” jedhe.
english: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If therefore you seek me, let these go their way,”

kikuyu: Kunis akka dubbiin inni, “Ani warra ati naa kennite keessaa tokko illee hin ganne” jedhee dubbate sun raawwatamuuf taʼe.
english: that the word might be fulfilled which he spoke, “Of those whom you have given me, I have lost none.”

kikuyu: Simoon Phexros goraadee qabu luqqifatee garbicha luba ol aanaa dhaʼee gurra isaa mirgaa irraa kute. Maqaan garbicha sanaas Maalkoosii dha.
english: Simon Peter therefore, having a sword, drew it, struck the high priest’s servant, and cut off his right ear. The servant’s name was Malchus.

kikuyu: Yesuusis Phexrosiin, “Goraadee kee manʼee isaatti deebisi! Ani xoofoo Abbaan naa kenne hin dhuguu?” jedhe.
english: Jesus therefore said to Peter, “Put the sword into its sheath. The cup which the Father has given me, shall I not surely drink it?”

kikuyu: Tuunni loltootaa, ajajaan isaaniitii fi eegdonni Yihuudootaas Yesuusin qabanii hidhan.
english: So the detachment, the commanding officer, and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him,

kikuyu: Isaanis duraan dursanii Haannaasitti isa geessan; Haannaas abbaa niitii Qayyaaffaa ti; Qayyaaffaan immoo bara sana luba ol aanaa ture.
english: and led him to Annas first, for he was father-in-law to Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.

kikuyu: Qayyaaffaan isa akka namni tokko uummataaf duʼuun wayyu Yihuudoota gorsee turee dha.
english: Now it was Caiaphas who advised the Jews that it was expedient that one man should perish for the people.

kikuyu: Simoon Phexrosii fi barataan biraa Yesuus faana buʼan. Barataan sunis waan luba ol aanaa biratti beekamaa tureef, Yesuus wajjin dallaa luba ol aanaa keessa seene;
english: Simon Peter followed Jesus, as did another disciple. Now that disciple was known to the high priest, and entered in with Jesus into the court of the high priest;

kikuyu: Phexros garuu balbala dura ala dhaabachaa ture. Barataan luba ol aanaa biratti beekamaa ture kaan gad baʼee intala balbala eegdutti himee Phexrosin ol seensise.
english: but Peter was standing at the door outside. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to her who kept the door, and brought in Peter.

kikuyu: Intalli balbala eegdu sunis Phexrosiin, “Atis barattoota namicha kanaa keessaa tokko mitii?” jette. Inni immoo deebisee, “Ana miti” jedhe.
english: Then the maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”

kikuyu: Yeroon isaa waan dhaamocha tureef garboonnii fi eegdonni ibidda qabsiifatanii dhadhaabatanii qaqqaammachaa turan. Phexrosis isaan wajjin dhaabatee qaqqaammachaa ture.
english: Now the servants and the officers were standing there, having made a fire of coals, for it was cold. They were warming themselves. Peter was with them, standing and warming himself.

kikuyu: Yommus lubni ol aanaan Yesuusin waaʼee barattoota isaatii fi waaʼee barsiisa isaa gaafate.
english: The high priest therefore asked Jesus about his disciples and about his teaching.

kikuyu: Yesuusis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Ani ifaan ifatti addunyaatti dubbadheera; iddoo Yihuudoonni hundi itti walitti qabamanitti, manneen sagadaattii fi mana qulqullummaa keessattis ani yeroo hunda barsiisaan ture. Ani waan tokko illee icciitiidhaan hin dubbanne.
english: Jesus answered him, “I spoke openly to the world. I always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where the Jews always meet. I said nothing in secret.

kikuyu: Ati maaliif na gaafatta? Warra waan ani isaaniin jedhe dhagaʼan gaafadhu. Kunoo isaan waan ani jedhe beeku.”
english: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me what I said to them. Behold, they know the things which I said.”

kikuyu: Yommuu Yesuus wantoota kanneen jedhetti qondaaltota achi ijaajjaa turan keessaa tokko, “Luba ol aanaaf akkana deebiftaa?” jedhee isa kabale.
english: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by slapped Jesus with his hand, saying, “Do you answer the high priest like that?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Yoo ani waan hamaa dubbadhee jiraadhe, waan hamaa sana dhugaa baʼi. Yoo ani waan qajeelaa dubbadhee jiraadhe garuu ati maaliif na rukutta?” jedhe.
english: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken evil, testify of the evil; but if well, why do you beat me?”

kikuyu: Haannaasis Yesuusin akkuma inni hidhamee jirutti gara lubicha ol aanaa, gara Qayyaaffaatti erge.
english: Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas, the high priest.

kikuyu: Simoon Phexros dhaabatee ibidda qaqqaammachaa ture. Kanaafuu isaan, “Atis barattoota isaa keessaa tokko mitii?” jedhaniin. Inni immoo, “Ana mitii” jedhee haale.
english: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said therefore to him, “You aren’t also one of his disciples, are you?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”

kikuyu: Garboota luba ol aanaa keessaas firri namicha Phexros gurra isaa irraa kute sanaa tokko, “Ani iddoo biqiltuutti isa wajjin si hin arginee?” jedheen.
english: One of the servants of the high priest, being a relative of him whose ear Peter had cut off, said, “Didn’t I see you in the garden with him?”

kikuyu: Phexros ammas ni gane; yommusuma indaanqoon iyye.
english: Peter therefore denied it again, and immediately the rooster crowed.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis Yesuusin mana Qayyaaffaatii fuudhanii masaraa bulchaa warra Roomaatti geessan. Yeroon sun ganama barii ture; Yihuudoonnis akka hin xuroofneef jedhanii masaraa ol hin seenne; kunis akka Faasiikaa nyaachuu dandaʼaniif.
english: They led Jesus therefore from Caiaphas into the Praetorium. It was early, and they themselves didn’t enter into the Praetorium, that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Phiilaaxoos gara isaaniitti gad baʼee, “Himanni isin namicha kana irratti dhiʼeessitan maali?” jedhee gaafate.
english: Pilate therefore went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Utuu namichi kun yakka hojjechuu baatee nu silaa isa dabarsinee sitti hin kenninu ture” jedhanii deebisaniif.
english: They answered him, “If this man weren’t an evildoer, we wouldn’t have delivered him up to you.”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis, “Isin ofuma keessanii isa fuudhaatii akka seera keessaniitti itti muraa” jedheen. Yihuudoonnis, “Nu garuu nama tokko illee ajjeesuuf mirga hin qabnu” jedhaniin.
english: Pilate therefore said to them, “Take him yourselves, and judge him according to your law.” Therefore the Jews said to him, “It is illegal for us to put anyone to death,”

kikuyu: Kunis wanni Yesuus akka duʼa akkamiitiin duʼuuf jiru argisiisuuf jedhee dubbate sun akka raawwatamuuf taʼe.
english: that the word of Jesus might be fulfilled, which he spoke, signifying by what kind of death he should die.

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoos ammas masaraa mootummaa seene; Yesuusinis ofitti waamee, “Ati mootii Yihuudootaatii?” jedhee isa gaafate.
english: Pilate therefore entered again into the Praetorium, called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Waan kana sumatu jedhe moo namoota biraatu waaʼee koo sitti hime?” jedhee gaafate.
english: Jesus answered him, “Do you say this by yourself, or did others tell you about me?”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis deebisee, “Anatu Yihuudiidhaa ree? Kan dabarsee natti si kenne sabuma keetii fi luboota hangafoota. Garuu ati maali gooteeti?” jedheen.
english: Pilate answered, “I’m not a Jew, am I? Your own nation and the chief priests delivered you to me. What have you done?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Mootummaan koo kan addunyaa kanaati miti. Utuu kan addunyaa kanaa taʼee silaa akka ani dabarfamee Yihuudootatti hin kennamneef tajaajiltoonni koo naa lolu turan. Amma garuu mootummaan koo kan addunyaa kanaa miti” jedhe.
english: Jesus answered, “My Kingdom is not of this world. If my Kingdom were of this world, then my servants would fight, that I wouldn’t be delivered to the Jews. But now my Kingdom is not from here.”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis, “Yoos ati mootii dha kaa!” jedheen. Yesuus immoo, “Akka ani mootii taʼe atuu jette. Dhugumaan wanni ani dhaladhee gara addunyaa dhufeefis dhugaadhaaf dhugaa baʼuuf. Namni dhugaaf dhaabatu hundinuu sagalee koo dhagaʼa” jedhee deebise.
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Are you a king then?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this reason I have been born, and for this reason I have come into the world, that I should testify to the truth. Everyone who is of the truth listens to my voice.”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis, “Dhugaan maal inni?” jedheen. Innis erga waan kana dubbatee booddee amma illee Yihuudootatti gad baʼee akkana jedheen; “Ani balleessaa tokko illee isa irratti hin arganne.
english: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” When he had said this, he went out again to the Jews, and said to them, “I find no basis for a charge against him.

kikuyu: Garuu isin akka ani yeroo Faasiikaatti nama tokko gad isinii dhiisu bartee godhattaniirtu. Kanaafuu akka ani, ‘Mootii Yihuudootaa’ gad isiniif dhiisu barbaadduu?”
english: But you have a custom that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”

kikuyu: Isaan amma illee iyyanii, “Lakki, Barabbaas malee isa miti!” jedhan. Barbaas kun saamtuu ture.
english: Then they all shouted again, saying, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis Yesuusin fuudhee garafsiise.
english: So Pilate then took Jesus and flogged him.

kikuyu: Loltoonnis gonfoo qoraattii micciiranii dhaʼanii mataa isaa irra kaaʼan. Isaanis uffata dhiilgee isatti uffisanii,
english: The soldiers twisted thorns into a crown and put it on his head, and dressed him in a purple garment.

kikuyu: “Akkam ree, yaa Mootii Yihuudootaa!” jechaa gara isaatti deddeebiʼaa turan. Isas ni kabalan.
english: They kept saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and they kept slapping him.
