kikuyu: Phiilaaxoos amma illee gad baʼee Yihuudootaan, “Akka ani balleessaa tokko illee isa irratti hin argatin akka beektaniif kunoo ani isa gad isiniifin baasa” jedhe.
english: Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis gonfoo qoraattii kaaʼatee, wayyaa dhiilgees uffatee gad baʼe; Phiilaaxoosis, “Namichi kunoo ti!” isaaniin jedhe.
english: Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”

kikuyu: Luboonni hangafoonnii fi qondaaltonni isaanii yommuu isa arganitti, “Fannisi! Fannisi!” jedhanii iyyan. Phiilaaxoos immoo deebisee, “Isin ofuma keessanii fuudhaatii isa fannisaa malee ani balleessaa tokko iyyuu isa irratti hin arganne” jedheen.
english: When therefore the chief priests and the officers saw him, they shouted, saying, “Crucify! Crucify!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no basis for a charge against him.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis deebisanii, “Nu seera qabna; namichi kun waan Ilma Waaqaa of godheef akka seera keenyaatti duʼuu qaba” jedhan.
english: The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by our law he ought to die, because he made himself the Son of God.”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis yommuu dubbii kana dhagaʼetti ittuma caalchisee sodaate.
english: When therefore Pilate heard this saying, he was more afraid.

kikuyu: Innis masaraatti ol deebiʼee, “Ati nama eessaati?” jedhee Yesuusin gaafate. Yesuus garuu deebii tokko iyyuu hin kennineef.
english: He entered into the Praetorium again, and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave him no answer.

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis, “Ati na jalaa dubbachuu diddaa? Akka ani gad si dhiisuuf taayitaa qabuu fi akka ani si fannisuuf taayitaa qabu ati hin beektuu?” jedheen.
english: Pilate therefore said to him, “Aren’t you speaking to me? Don’t you know that I have power to release you and have power to crucify you?”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Ati utuu olii siif kennamuu baatee silaa taayitaa tokko illee narratti hin qabdu ture. Kanaaf inni dabarsee sitti na kenne sun cubbuu cubbuu caalu qaba” jedhee deebiseef.
english: Jesus answered, “You would have no power at all against me, unless it were given to you from above. Therefore he who delivered me to you has greater sin.”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis yeroo sanaa jalqabee Yesuusin gad dhiisuu barbaada ture; Yihuudoonni garuu, “Ati yoo namicha kana gad dhiifte michuu Qeesaar miti. Namni mootii of godhu kam iyyuu Qeesaariin morma” jedhanii iyyan.
english: At this, Pilate was seeking to release him, but the Jews cried out, saying, “If you release this man, you aren’t Caesar’s friend! Everyone who makes himself a king speaks against Caesar!”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis yommuu dubbii kana dhagaʼetti Yesuusin gad baasee, iddoo “Dhagaa Afamaa” kan afaan Ibraayisxiitiin “Gabataa” jedhamutti barcuma murtii irra taaʼe.
english: When Pilate therefore heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called “The Pavement”, but in Hebrew, “Gabbatha.”

kikuyu: Guyyaan sunis guyyaa Qophii Faasiikaa ture; yeroon isaas gara saʼaatii jaʼaa ture. Phiilaaxoosis Yihuudootaan, “Mootiin keessan kunoo ti!” jedhe.
english: Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”

kikuyu: Isaan garuu, “Isa balleessi! Isa balleessi! Isa fannisi!” jedhanii iyyan. Phiilaaxoos immoo, “Mootii keessan fannisu moo?” jedhee gaafate. Luboonni hangafoonnis, “Nu Qeesaar malee mootii biraa hin qabnu” jedhanii deebisaniif.
english: They cried out, “Away with him! Away with him! Crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar!”

kikuyu: Kanaaf Phiilaaxoos akka inni fannifamuuf dabarsee isaanitti kenne. Isaanis Yesuusin fuudhanii deeman.
english: So then he delivered him to them to be crucified. So they took Jesus and led him away.

kikuyu: Innis fannoo ofii isaa baadhatee iddoo Buqqee Mataa kan afaan Ibraayisxiitiin Golgootaa jedhamutti ol baʼe.
english: He went out, bearing his cross, to the place called “The Place of a Skull”, which is called in Hebrew, “Golgotha”,

kikuyu: Isaanis achitti isa fannisan; isa wajjinis namoota biraa lama, isa tokko garanaan, kaan immoo garasiin, Yesuusin immoo gidduu isaaniitti fannisan.
english: where they crucified him, and with him two others, on either side one, and Jesus in the middle.

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis Katabbii, Yesuus Isa Naazreeti, Mooticha Yihuudootaa, jedhu tokko barreessee fannoo sanatti maxxanse.
english: Pilate wrote a title also, and put it on the cross. There was written, “JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.”

kikuyu: Iddoon Yesuus itti fannifame waan magaalaatti dhiʼoo tureef Yihuudoonni hedduun katabbii sana dubbisaniiru; katabbiin sunis afaan Ibraayisxiitiin, Laatiinii fi Giriikiin barreeffame.
english: Therefore many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.

kikuyu: Luboonni Yihuudootaa hangafoonni Phiilaaxoosiin, “Namichi kun, ‘ “Ani mootii Yihuudootaa ti” jedheera’ jedhii barreessi malee, ‘Inni Mootii Yihuudootaa ti’ jettee hin barreessin” jedhan.
english: The chief priests of the Jews therefore said to Pilate, “Don’t write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘he said, “I am King of the Jews.”’”

kikuyu: Phiilaaxoosis, “Ani waanan barreesse, barreesseera” jedhee deebise.
english: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”

kikuyu: Loltoonni sunis erga Yesuusin fannisanii booddee kittaa isaa hambisanii wayyaa isaa fuudhanii akka tokko tokko isaan gaʼuuf iddoo afuritti hiratan. Kittaan sun hin hodhamne; olii hamma gadiittis dhaʼaa tokko ture.
english: Then the soldiers, when they had crucified Jesus, took his garments and made four parts, to every soldier a part; and also the tunic. Now the tunic was without seam, woven from the top throughout.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isaan, “Kottaa hin tarsaasnuu; garuu ixaa buufannee akka inni kan eenyuu taʼu ilaallaa” waliin jedhan. Kunis akka Katabbiin Qulqulluun, “Isaan wayyaa koo hiratan; uffata koottis ixaa buufatan” jedhu sun raawwatamuuf taʼe. Wanni loltoonni godhanis kanuma.
english: Then they said to one another, “Let’s not tear it, but cast lots for it to decide whose it will be,” that the Scripture might be fulfilled, which says, “They parted my garments among them. They cast lots for my clothing.” Therefore the soldiers did these things.

kikuyu: Fannoo Yesuus biras haati isaa, obboleettiin haadha isaa, Maariyaam niitiin Qilophaatii fi Maariyaam isheen Magdalaa dhaabatanii turan.
english: But standing by Jesus’ cross were his mother, his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.

kikuyu: Yesuusis yommuu haadha isaatii fi barataa inni jaallatu sana utuu inni ishee cina dhaabatuu argetti haadha isaatiin, “Dubartii nana! Kunoo, ilma kee” jedhe.
english: Therefore when Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing there, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”

kikuyu: Barataa sanaan illee, “Kunoo haadha kee” jedhe; barataan sunis saʼaatii sanaa jalqabee gara mana isaatti ishee fudhate.
english: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” From that hour, the disciple took her to his own home.

kikuyu: Ergasii Yesuus akka wanni hundinuu raawwatame beekee akka Katabbiin Qulqulluun raawwatamuuf, “Nan dheebodhe” jedhe.
english: After this, Jesus, seeing that all things were now finished, that the Scripture might be fulfilled, said, “I am thirsty!”

kikuyu: Qodaan dhangaggaaʼaa qabu tokko achi ture; isaanis dhangaggaaʼaa sana keessa ispoonjii cuuphanii hiisophiitti kaaʼanii afaan isaatti qaban.
english: Now a vessel full of vinegar was set there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop, and held it at his mouth.

kikuyu: Yesuusis dhangaggaaʼaa sana fudhatee, “Raawwateera” jedhe. Mataa buusees hafuura isaa kenne.
english: When Jesus therefore had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished!” Then he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.

kikuyu: Guyyaan sun guyyaa Qophii ture; guyyaan itti aanus Sanbataa addaa ture. Kanaafuu akka reeffi isaanii Sanbataan fannoo irra hin oolle gochuuf jedhanii akka miilli isaanii cabsamee fannoo irraa gad buufamuuf Yihuudoonni Phiilaaxoosin kadhatan.
english: Therefore the Jews, because it was the Preparation Day, so that the bodies wouldn’t remain on the cross on the Sabbath (for that Sabbath was a special one), asked of Pilate that their legs might be broken and that they might be taken away.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu loltoonni dhaqanii miilla namicha jalqabaa, miilla namicha Yesuus wajjin fannifame kaaniis cabsan.
english: Therefore the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first and of the other who was crucified with him;

kikuyu: Yommuu gara Yesuus dhufanitti garuu inni duʼe waan arganiif miilla isaa hin cabsine.
english: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they didn’t break his legs.

kikuyu: Loltoota sana keessaa inni tokko garuu eeboodhaan cinaacha isaa waraane; yeruma sana dhiignii fi bishaan baʼe.
english: However, one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and immediately blood and water came out.

kikuyu: Namni waan kana arge rageesseera; ragaan isaas dhugaa dha. Inni akka dhugaa dubbatu ni beeka; inni akka isinis amantaniif dubbata.
english: He who has seen has testified, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, that you may believe.

kikuyu: Kunis wanni Katabbiin Qulqulluun, “Lafeen isaa tokko iyyuu hin cabsamu” jedhe sun akka raawwatamuuf taʼe.
english: For these things happened that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “A bone of him will not be broken.”

kikuyu: Ammas Katabbiin Qulqulluun biraa, “Isaanis isa waraanan sana ni ilaalu” jedha.
english: Again another Scripture says, “They will look on him whom they pierced.”

kikuyu: Ergasii Yoosef namni Armaatiyaa kan sababii Yihuudoota sodaateef dhoksaan barataa Yesuus ture sun reeffa Yesuus fudhachuuf Phiilaaxoosin kadhate. Phiilaaxoosis isaaf eeyyame; kanaafuu inni dhaqee reeffa Yesuus fudhate.
english: After these things, Joseph of Arimathaea, being a disciple of Jesus, but secretly for fear of the Jews, asked of Pilate that he might take away Jesus’ body. Pilate gave him permission. He came therefore and took away his body.

kikuyu: Niqoodemoos inni duraan halkaniin gara Yesuus dhufee tures walmakaa qumbiitii fi argeessa gara kiiloo giraamii soddomii afur ulfaatu qabatee dhufe.
english: Nicodemus, who at first came to Jesus by night, also came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred Roman pounds.

kikuyu: Isaanis reeffa Yesuus fuudhanii akka duudhaa Yihuudootaatti awwaaluuf urgooftuu wajjin huccuu quncee talbaa irraa hojjetameen kafanan.
english: So they took Jesus’ body, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as the custom of the Jews is to bury.

kikuyu: Iddoo Yesuus itti fannifames lafa biqiltuu tokkotu ture; lafa biqiltuu sana keessas iddoo awwaalaa haaraa kan namni tokko iyyuu duraan itti hin awwaalamin tokkotu ture.
english: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden. In the garden was a new tomb in which no man had ever yet been laid.

kikuyu: Sababii guyyaan sun guyyaa Qophii Yihuudootaa turee fi iddoon awwaalaa sunis waan dhiʼoo tureef Yesuusin achi keessa kaaʼan.
english: Then, because of the Jews’ Preparation Day (for the tomb was near at hand), they laid Jesus there.

kikuyu: Guyyaa jalqaba torban sanaa ganama barii utuma dukkanaaʼee jiruu Maariyaam isheen Magdalaa gara awwaalaa dhaqxee akka dhagaan afaan awwaala sanaa irraa fuudhame argite.
english: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene went early, while it was still dark, to the tomb, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isheen fiigaa gara Simoon Phexrosii fi gara barataa biraa kan Yesuus isa jaallate sanaa dhaqxee, “Gooftaa awwaala keessaa fudhataniiru; eessa akka isa kaaʼanis hin beeknu!” jetteen.
english: Therefore she ran and came to Simon Peter and to the other disciple whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken away the Lord out of the tomb, and we don’t know where they have laid him!”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Phexrosii fi barataan kaan baʼanii gara awwaalichaa dhaqan.
english: Therefore Peter and the other disciple went out, and they went toward the tomb.

kikuyu: Lachan isaanii iyyuu ni fiigu turan; barataan kaan garuu Phexros bira darbee fiiguudhaan dursee iddoo awwaalaa sana gaʼe.
english: They both ran together. The other disciple outran Peter and came to the tomb first.

kikuyu: Innis gad jedhee ilaalee huccuu quncee talbaa irraa hojjetame lafatti arge malee awwaalicha keessa hin seenne.
english: Stooping and looking in, he saw the linen cloths lying there; yet he didn’t enter in.

kikuyu: Simoon Phexros immoo isa duubaan dhufee awwaalicha keessa seene. Huccuu sanas lafatti arge;
english: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and entered into the tomb. He saw the linen cloths lying,

kikuyu: akkanumas huccuu mataa Yesuusitti maramee ture arge. Huccuun sunis kophaa isaa dachaafamee iddoo biraa ture malee huccuu quncee talbaa irraa hojjetame sana bira hin turre.
english: and the cloth that had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths, but rolled up in a place by itself.

kikuyu: Ergasiis barataan biraa inni jalqabatti awwaalicha bira gaʼe sun keessa seene. Innis argee amane.
english: So then the other disciple who came first to the tomb also entered in, and he saw and believed.

kikuyu: Isaan akka Yesuus warra duʼan keessaa kaʼu Katabbii Qulqulluu irraa amma iyyuu hin beekne tureetii.
english: For as yet they didn’t know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.

kikuyu: Barattoonni sunis gara mana isaaniitti deebiʼan.
english: So the disciples went away again to their own homes.

kikuyu: Maariyaam garuu alaan awwaala bira dhaabattee booʼaa turte. Utuma boossuus awwaallatti gad jettee ilaalte;
english: But Mary was standing outside at the tomb weeping. So as she wept, she stooped and looked into the tomb,

kikuyu: isheenis ergamoota lama kanneen uffata adaadii uffatanii iddoo reeffi Yesuus kaaʼamee ture sana, inni tokko mataa duraan, kaan immoo miilla jalaan taaʼan argite.
english: and she saw two angels in white sitting, one at the head and one at the feet, where the body of Jesus had lain.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Dubartii nana, maaliif boossa?” jedhaniin. Isheen immoo, “Gooftaa koo fudhataniiru; eessa akka isa kaaʼanis ani hin beeku” jetteen.
english: They asked her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I don’t know where they have laid him.”

kikuyu: Yommuu waan kana dubbattee of irra gara galtettis Yesuusin isaa achi dhaabatu argite; garuu Yesuus taʼuu isaa hin beekne.
english: When she had said this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing, and didn’t know that it was Jesus.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Dubartii nana, maaliif boossa? Eenyun barbaadda?” jedheen. Isheen immoo, nama iddoo biqiltuu keessa hojjetu seetee, “Yaa gooftaa, ati yoo isa fuutee jiraatte, akka ani dhaqee fudhadhuuf eessa akka isa keesse natti himi” jetteen.
english: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Who are you looking for?” She, supposing him to be the gardener, said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Maariyaam!” jedheen. Isheenis isatti gara galtee afaan Ibraayisxiitiin, “Rabbuunii!” jetteen. Hiikkaan isaas “Barsiisaa” jechuu dha.
english: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him, “Rabboni!” which is to say, “Teacher!”

kikuyu: Yesuus immoo, “Ani amma illee waan gara Abbaatti ol hin baʼiniif na hin tuqin. Garuu obboloota koo bira dhaqiitii, ‘Ani gara Abbaa kootii fi Abbaa keessaniitti, gara Waaqa kootii fi Waaqa keessaniitti ol nan baʼa’ jedheera jedhiitii isaanitti himi” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to her, “Don’t hold me, for I haven’t yet ascended to my Father; but go to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’”

kikuyu: Maariyaam isheen Magdalaas gara barattootaa dhaqxee, “Ani Gooftaa argeera!” jette. Akka inni waan kana isheen jedhes isaanitti himte.
english: Mary Magdalene came and told the disciples that she had seen the Lord, and that he had said these things to her.

kikuyu: Guyyaa jalqaba torban sanaa galgala utuu barattoonni waan Yihuudoota sodaataniif balbala cufatanii walitti qabamanii jiranuu Yesuus dhufee isaan gidduu dhaabatee, “Nagaan isiniif haa taʼu” jedheen.
english: When therefore it was evening on that day, the first day of the week, and when the doors were locked where the disciples were assembled, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood in the middle and said to them, “Peace be to you.”

kikuyu: Innis erga waan kana dubbatee booddee harka isaatii fi cinaacha isaa isaanitti argisiise. Barattoonnis yommuu Gooftaa arganitti akka malee gammadan.
english: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. The disciples therefore were glad when they saw the Lord.

kikuyu: Yesuus amma illee, “Nagaan isiniif haa taʼu! Akkuma Abbaan na erge sana anis isinan erga” jedheen.
english: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Peace be to you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”

kikuyu: Innis erga waan kana jedhee booddee Hafuura isaanitti baafatee akkana jedheen; “Hafuura Qulqulluu fudhadhaa.
english: When he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit!

kikuyu: Yoo isin namootaaf cubbuu isaanii dhiiftan isaaniif ni dhiifama; yoo isaaniif dhiisuu baattan immoo isaaniif hin dhiifamu.”
english: If you forgive anyone’s sins, they have been forgiven them. If you retain anyone’s sins, they have been retained.”

kikuyu: Garuu yeroo Yesuus dhufetti warra Kudha Lamaan keessaa Toomaas inni Didimoos jedhamu tokko barattoota wajjin hin turre.
english: But Thomas, one of the twelve, called Didymus, wasn’t with them when Jesus came.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu barattoonni warri kaan, “Nu Gooftaa argineerra!” jedhanii isatti himan. Inni garuu, “Ani iddoo mismaaraan waraaname harka isaa irratti argu malee, quba koo iddoo mismaaraa sana keessa kaaʼu malee, harka koos cinaacha isaa keessa kaaʼu malee hin amanu” jedheen.
english: The other disciples therefore said to him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, put my finger into the print of the nails, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”

kikuyu: Guyyaa saddeeti booddee barattoonni isaa ammas mana keessa turan; Toomaasis isaan wajjin ture. Utuma balbalichi cufamee jiruus Yesuus ol galee isaan gidduu dhaabatee, “Nagaan isiniif haa taʼu!” jedheen.
english: After eight days, again his disciples were inside and Thomas was with them. Jesus came, the doors being locked, and stood in the middle, and said, “Peace be to you.”

kikuyu: Innis Toomaasiin, “Quba kee as fidi; harka koo ilaali. Harka kee diriirfadhuutii cinaacha koo keessa kaaʼi. Amani malee amantii hin dhabin” jedhe.
english: Then he said to Thomas, “Reach here your finger, and see my hands. Reach here your hand, and put it into my side. Don’t be unbelieving, but believing.”

kikuyu: Toomaas immoo, “Gooftaa koo! Waaqa koo!” jedheen.
english: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Ati waan na argiteef amante; warri utuu hin argin amanan eebbifamoo dha” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed. Blessed are those who have not seen and have believed.”

kikuyu: Yesuus barattoota isaa duratti mallattoowwan biraa kanneen kitaaba kana keessatti hin barreeffamin hedduu hojjete.
english: Therefore Jesus did many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not written in this book;

kikuyu: Wantoonni kunneen garuu akka Yesuus inni Kiristoos Ilma Waaqaa taʼe akka amantaniif, amanuudhaanis akka maqaa isaatiin jireenya qabaattaniif barreeffame.
english: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.

kikuyu: Wantoota kanneen booddee Yesuus ammas galaana Xibeeriyaas biratti barattoota isaatti of mulʼise. Haalli inni ittiin of mulʼises akkana ture:
english: After these things, Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples at the sea of Tiberias. He revealed himself this way.

kikuyu: Simoon Phexros, Toomaas inni Didimoos jedhamu, Naatnaaʼel namichi Qaanaa Galiilaa, ilmaan Zabdewoosii fi barattoonni biraa lama walii wajjin turan.
english: Simon Peter, Thomas called Didymus, Nathanael of Cana in Galilee, and the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.

kikuyu: Simoon Phexrosis, “Ani qurxummii qabuu nan dhaqa” isaaniin jedhe; isaanis, “Nus si wajjin dhaqna” jedhaniin. Gad baʼaniis bidiruu yaabbatan; halkan sana garuu homaa hin qabne.
english: Simon Peter said to them, “I’m going fishing.” They told him, “We are also coming with you.” They immediately went out and entered into the boat. That night, they caught nothing.

kikuyu: Ganama bariidhaanis Yesuus qarqara galaanichaa irra dhaabachaa ture; barattoonni garuu akka inni Yesuus taʼe hin beekne.
english: But when day had already come, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples didn’t know that it was Jesus.

kikuyu: Innis isaan waamee, “Ijoolle, qurxummii tokko illee hin qabdanii?” jedhee gaafate. Isaan immoo, “Hin qabnu” jedhanii deebisan.
english: Jesus therefore said to them, “Children, have you anything to eat?” They answered him, “No.”

kikuyu: Innis, “Karaa mirga bidiruutiin kiyyoo gad darbadhaa; qurxummii ni argattuu” jedheen. Kanaafuu isaan kiyyoo sana gad darbatan; sababii baayʼina qurxummiitiifis kiyyoo sana harkisuu dadhaban.
english: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” They cast it therefore, and now they weren’t able to draw it in for the multitude of fish.

kikuyu: Barataan inni Yesuus isa jaallachaa ture sunis, “Inni Gooftaa dha!” jedhee Phexrositti hime. Kanaafuu Simoon Phexros yommuu “Inni Gooftaa dha” jechuu isaa dhagaʼetti waan marxoo isaa of irraa baasee tureef, marxoo isaa marxifatee bishaanitti gad utaale.
english: That disciple therefore whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It’s the Lord!” So when Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he wrapped his coat around himself (for he was naked), and threw himself into the sea.

kikuyu: Barattoonni kaan garuu waan qarqara galaanaa irraa dhundhuma dhibba lama caalaa hin fagaatiniif kiyyoo qurxummiin keessa guute sana harkisaa bidiruudhaan dhufan.
english: But the other disciples came in the little boat (for they were not far from the land, but about two hundred cubits away), dragging the net full of fish.

kikuyu: Yommuu lafatti baʼanittis ibidda cilee kan qurxummiin irra jiruu fi buddeena achitti argan.
english: So when they got out on the land, they saw a fire of coals there, with fish and bread laid on it.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Mee qurxummii amma qabdan irraa waa fidaa!” isaaniin jedhe.
english: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish which you have just caught.”

kikuyu: Simoon Phexrosis bidiruu sana yaabbatee kiyyoo qurxummiin gurguddaan 153 guute sana gara lafaatti harkise. Kiyyoon sunis qurxummii akkas baayʼattuun guutamu illee hin tarsaane.
english: Simon Peter went up, and drew the net to land, full of one hundred fifty-three great fish. Even though there were so many, the net wasn’t torn.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “Kottaa ciree nyaadhaa!” isaaniin jedhe. Barattoota keessaas namni ija jabaatee, “Ati eenyu?” jedhee isa gaafate tokko iyyuu hin turre. Isaan akka inni Gooftaa taʼe beekaniiruutii.
english: Jesus said to them, “Come and eat breakfast!” None of the disciples dared inquire of him, “Who are you?” knowing that it was the Lord.

kikuyu: Yesuusis dhufee buddeena sana fuudhee isaaniif kenne; qurxummichas akkasuma godhe.
english: Then Jesus came and took the bread, gave it to them, and the fish likewise.

kikuyu: Egaa Yesuus erga duʼaa kaafamee, kana wajjin yeroo sadaffaa barattoota isaatti mulʼate.
english: This is now the third time that Jesus was revealed to his disciples after he had risen from the dead.

kikuyu: Yesuus erga isaan ciree nyaatanii booddee Simʼoon Phexrosiin, “Yaa Simoon ilma Yohannis, ati warra kana caalaa na jaallattaa?” jedhe. Innis, “Eeyyee, yaa Gooftaa; akka ani si jaalladhu atuu ni beekta” jedheen. Yesuusis, “Ilmoolee hoolaa koo soori” jedheen.
english: So when they had eaten their breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”

kikuyu: Yesuus amma illee, “Yaa Simoon ilma Yohannis, ati na jaallattaa?” jedheen. Innis deebisee, “Eeyyee, yaa Gooftaa, akka ani si jaalladhu atuu ni beekta” jedheen. Yesuus immoo, “Hoolota koo tiksi” jedheen.
english: He said to him again a second time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I have affection for you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”

kikuyu: Yeroo sadaffaas, “Yaa Simoon ilma Yohannis, ati na jaallattaa?” jedheen. Phexrosis sababii Yesuus yeroo sadaffaa, “Ati na jaallattaa?” jedhee isa gaafateef gaddee, “Yaa Gooftaa, ati waan hunda beekta; akka ani si jaalladhus ni beekta” jedheen. Yesuusis akkana jedheen; “Hoolota koo soori.
english: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of Jonah, do you have affection for me?” Peter was grieved because he asked him the third time, “Do you have affection for me?” He said to him, “Lord, you know everything. You know that I have affection for you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.

kikuyu: Ani dhuguman, dhuguman sitti hima; ati yeroo dargaggeessa turtetti, ofuma keetiin mudhii kee hidhattee lafa barbaadde dhaqxa turte; yeroo dulloomtutti garuu harka kee ni diriirfatta; namni biraas mudhii kee siif hidhee lafa ati hin barbaannetti si geessa.”
english: Most certainly I tell you, when you were young, you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted to. But when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will dress you and carry you where you don’t want to go.”

kikuyu: Yesuusis akka Phexros duʼa akkamiitiin Waaqa ulfeessu argisiisuuf jedhee waan kana dubbate; ergasii, “Na duukaa buʼi” jedheen.
english: Now he said this, signifying by what kind of death he would glorify God. When he had said this, he said to him, “Follow me.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis garagalee utuu barataan inni Yesuus isa jaallatu sun isaan duukaa buʼuu arge. Barataan kunis isa yeroo irbaataatti qoma Yesuusiitti irkatee, “Yaa Gooftaa, inni dabarsee si kennu eenyu?” jedhe sanaa dha.
english: Then Peter, turning around, saw a disciple following. This was the disciple whom Jesus loved, the one who had also leaned on Jesus’ chest at the supper and asked, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”

kikuyu: Phexrosis yommuu isa argetti, “Yaa Gooftaa, namichi kun hoo?” jedhee Yesuusin gaafate.
english: Peter, seeing him, said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”

kikuyu: Yesuusis deebisee, “Hamma ani dhufutti akka inni jiraatu yoo fedhii koo taʼe, maaltu si dhibe? Ati na duukaa buʼi” jedheen.
english: Jesus said to him, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you? You follow me.”

kikuyu: Kanaaf oduun, “Barataan kun hin duʼu” jedhu obboloota gidduutti odeeffame. Yesuus garuu, “Hamma ani dhufutti akka inni jiraatu yoo fedhii koo taʼe maaltu si dhibe?” jedhe malee, “Inni hin duʼu” hin jenne.
english: This saying therefore went out among the brothers that this disciple wouldn’t die. Yet Jesus didn’t say to him that he wouldn’t die, but, “If I desire that he stay until I come, what is that to you?”

kikuyu: Inni dubbii kana dhugaa baʼu, kan waan kanas barreesse barataadhuma kana. Akka dhuga baʼumsi isaa dhugaa taʼes nu beekna.
english: This is the disciple who testifies about these things, and wrote these things. We know that his witness is true.

kikuyu: Kana malees Yesuus waan biraa baayʼee hojjeteera. Utuu tokkoon tokkoon isaanii barreeffamanii jiraatanii silaa ani waan addunyaan mataan ishee iyyuu kitaabota barreeffaman sanaaf iddoo gaʼu qabdu hin seʼu.
english: There are also many other things which Jesus did, which if they would all be written, I suppose that even the world itself wouldn’t have room for the books that would be written.

kikuyu: Yaa Tewofilos, ani waan Yesuus hojjechuu fi barsiisuu jalqabe hunda kitaaba koo kan jalqabaa keessatti barreesseera.
english: The first book I wrote, Theophilus, concerned all that Jesus began both to do and to teach,

kikuyu: Wanni kunis waan erga Yesuus ergamoota filate sanaaf karaa hafuura qulqulluutiin ajaja kennee booddee hamma gaafa inni Samiitti ol fudhatameetti taʼee dha.
english: until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom he had chosen.

kikuyu: Innis duʼa isaa booddee namoota kanatti of argisiisee waan akka inni jiraataa taʼe mirkaneessu baayʼees dhiʼeesse; bultii afurtama isaanitti mulʼatee waaʼee mootummaa Waaqaa dubbate.
english: To these he also showed himself alive after he suffered, by many proofs, appearing to them over a period of forty days and speaking about God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Utuu isaan wajjin jiruus akkana jedhee isaan ajaje; “Waadaa Abbaa kootii kan waaʼee isaa narraa dhageessan sana eeggadhaa malee Yerusaalemii hin baʼinaa.
english: Being assembled together with them, he commanded them, “Don’t depart from Jerusalem, but wait for the promise of the Father, which you heard from me.

kikuyu: Yohannis bishaaniin cuupheetii; isin garuu bultii xinnoo booddee Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan ni cuuphamtu.”
english: For John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit not many days from now.”

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu walitti qabamanitti, “Yaa Gooftaa, ati yeroo kanatti Israaʼeliif mootummaa ni deebiftaa?” jedhanii isa gaafatan.
english: Therefore, when they had come together, they asked him, “Lord, are you now restoring the kingdom to Israel?”

kikuyu: Inni immoo akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Yeroo yookaan guyyaa Abbaan aangoo isaatiin murteesse beekuun hojii keessan miti.
english: He said to them, “It isn’t for you to know times or seasons which the Father has set within his own authority.

kikuyu: Yeroo hafuurri Qulqulluun isin irra buʼutti garuu humna ni argattu; isinis Yerusaalem keessatti, Yihuudaa hundaa fi Samaariyaa keessatti, hamma qarqara lafaattis dhuga baatota koo ni taatu.”
english: But you will receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you. You will be witnesses to me in Jerusalem, in all Judea and Samaria, and to the uttermost parts of the earth.”

kikuyu: Erga inni waan kana dubbatee booddee utuma isaan ilaalanuu ol fudhatame; duumessis ija isaanii duraa isa dhokse.
english: When he had said these things, as they were looking, he was taken up, and a cloud received him out of their sight.

kikuyu: Yeroo inni ol baʼaa turettis, utuma isaan xiyyeeffatanii gara Samii ilaalaa jiranuu namoonni uffata adaadii uffatan lama isaan bira dhadhaabatan.
english: While they were looking steadfastly into the sky as he went, behold, two men stood by them in white clothing,

kikuyu: Akkanas jedhaniin; “Yaa namoota Galiilaa, isin maaliif as dhadhaabattanii gara Samii ilaaltu? Yesuus innumti isin biraa samiitti ol fudhatame kun, akkuma isin utuu inni samiitti ol baʼuu argitan kana deebiʼee ni dhufa.”
english: who also said, “You men of Galilee, why do you stand looking into the sky? This Jesus, who was received up from you into the sky, will come back in the same way as you saw him going into the sky.”

kikuyu: Isaanis gaara Tulluu Ejersaa jedhamu irraa Yerusaalemitti deebiʼan; gaarri kunis Yerusaalem irraa gara deemsa guyyaa Sanbata tokkoo fagaata.
english: Then they returned to Jerusalem from the mountain called Olivet, which is near Jerusalem, a Sabbath day’s journey away.

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu Yerusaalem gaʼanitti kutaa darbii kan keessa jiraachaa turan sanatti ol baʼan; isaanis: Phexrosii fi Yohannis, Yaaqoobii fi Indiriiyaas, Fiiliphoosii fi Toomaas, Bartaloomewoosii fi Maatewos, Yaaqoob ilma Alfewoos, Simoon isa Hinaafticha jedhamuu fi Yihuudaa ilma Yaaqoob turan.
english: When they had come in, they went up into the upper room where they were staying, that is Peter, John, James, Andrew, Philip, Thomas, Bartholomew, Matthew, James the son of Alphaeus, Simon the Zealot, and Judas the son of James.

kikuyu: Hundi isaaniis dubartootaa fi Maariyaam haadha Yesuus wajjin, obboloota isaa wajjinis utuu gargar hin kutin yaada tokkoon kadhannaatti jabaachaa turan.
english: All these with one accord continued steadfastly in prayer and supplication, along with the women and Mary the mother of Jesus, and with his brothers.

kikuyu: Gidduma sana Phexros kaʼee amantoota gara 120 taʼan gidduu dhaabate.
english: In these days, Peter stood up in the middle of the disciples (and the number of names was about one hundred twenty), and said,

kikuyu: Akkanas jedhe; “Yaa obboloota, dubbiin kitaabaa kan Hafuurri Qulqulluun yeroo dheeraan dura waaʼee Yihuudaa isa warra Yesuusin qaban fide sanaa afaan Daawitiitiin dubbate sun raawwatamuu qaba.
english: “Brothers, it was necessary that this Scripture should be fulfilled, which the Holy Spirit spoke before by the mouth of David concerning Judas, who was guide to those who took Jesus.

kikuyu: Innis miseensa keenyaa fi nama akka tajaajila kana keessatti qooda qabaatuuf filatame ture.”
english: For he was counted with us, and received his portion in this ministry.

kikuyu: Yihuudaan horii hammina hojjetee argate sanaan lafa bitate; innis mataan kufee qixxee lamaanitti tarsaʼe; marʼumaan isaa hundinuus keessaa jige.
english: Now this man obtained a field with the reward for his wickedness; and falling headlong, his body burst open and all his intestines gushed out.

kikuyu: Namoonni Yerusaalem keessa jiraatan hundinuus waan kana dhagaʼan; lafa sanas afaan isaaniitiin Akeldaamaa jedhanii waaman. Akeldaamaa jechuun “Lafa Dhiigaa” jechuu dha.
english: It became known to everyone who lived in Jerusalem that in their language that field was called ‘Akeldama,’ that is, ‘The field of blood.’

kikuyu: Phexrosis akkana jedhe; “Kitaaba faarfannaa keessatti akkana jedhamee barreeffameeraatii: “ ‘Qeʼeen isaa haa onu; namni keessa jiraatu tokko iyyuus hin hafin’ akkasumas “ ‘Aangoo isaa namni biraa haa fudhatu.’
english: For it is written in the book of Psalms, ‘Let his habitation be made desolate. Let no one dwell in it;’ and, ‘Let another take his office.’

kikuyu: Kanaaf warra yeroo gooftaa Yesuus nu gidduu baʼee galaa ture hundumaa nu wajjin turan keessaa nama tokko filachuun barbaachisaa dha;
english: “Of the men therefore who have accompanied us all the time that the Lord Jesus went in and out among us,

kikuyu: namni filatamu kun nama cuuphaa Yohannisii jalqabee hamma gaafa Yesuus nu biraa samiitti ol fudhatameetti nu wajjin ture taʼuu qaba. Namoota kanneen keessaa tokko nu wajjin dhuga baatuu duʼaa kaʼuu Yesuus taʼuu qabaatii.”
english: beginning from the baptism of John to the day that he was received up from us, of these one must become a witness with us of his resurrection.”

kikuyu: Kanaafis namoota lama dhiʼeessan; isaanis Yoosef isa Barsaabaas jedhamu kan Yoosxoos jedhamee beekamu tokkoo fi Maatiyaas.
english: They put forward two: Joseph called Barsabbas, who was also called Justus, and Matthias.

kikuyu: Akkanas jedhanii Waaqa kadhatan; “Yaa Gooftaa garaa nama hundumaa beektu, ati namoota kanneen lamaan keessaa isa kam akka filatte nutti argisiisi;
english: They prayed and said, “You, Lord, who know the hearts of all men, show which one of these two you have chosen

kikuyu: kunis akka inni tajaajilaa fi ergamtummaa Yihuudaan dhiisee gara iddoo ofii isaatti gara gale sana fudhatuuf.”
english: to take part in this ministry and apostleship from which Judas fell away, that he might go to his own place.”

kikuyu: Isaanis ixaa buusan; ixaan sunis Maatiyaasiif baʼe. Kanaafuu inni ergamoota kudha tokkotti dabalame.
english: They drew lots for them, and the lot fell on Matthias; and he was counted with the eleven apostles.

kikuyu: Yeroo guyyaan Pheenxeqoosxee gaʼetti, hundi isaanii iddoo tokkotti walitti qabamanii turan.
english: Now when the day of Pentecost had come, they were all with one accord in one place.

kikuyu: Akkuma tasaas sagaleen akka bubbee jabaa bubbisu tokko samii irraa dhufee mana isaan keessa tataaʼaa turan sana hunda guute.
english: Suddenly there came from the sky a sound like the rushing of a mighty wind, and it filled all the house where they were sitting.

kikuyu: Isaanis waan akka arraba ibiddaa tokko isaa gargar qoodamee dhufee tokkoo tokkoo isaanii irra bubbuʼu argan.
english: Tongues like fire appeared and were distributed to them, and one sat on each of them.

kikuyu: Hundi isaaniis Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan guutamanii akkuma hafuurri sun isaan dandeessisetti afaan gara biraatiin dubbachuu jalqaban.
english: They were all filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak with other languages, as the Spirit gave them the ability to speak.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana Yihuudoonni Waaqa sodaatan saboota samii jala jiran hunda keessaa dhufanii Yerusaalem keessa jiraachaa turan.
english: Now there were dwelling in Jerusalem Jews, devout men, from every nation under the sky.

kikuyu: Yeroo sagaleen sun dhagaʼamettis namoonni hedduun waan jedhan dhabanii walitti qabaman; warri Hafuuraan guutaman sun afaan tokkoo tokkoo namoota sanaatiin dubbachaa turaniitii.
english: When this sound was heard, the multitude came together and were bewildered, because everyone heard them speaking in his own language.

kikuyu: Isaanis akka malee dinqifatanii akkana jedhan; “Namoonni dudubbatan kunneen hundi warra Galiilaati mitii?
english: They were all amazed and marveled, saying to one another, “Behold, aren’t all these who speak Galileans?

kikuyu: Yoos akkamiin tokkoon tokkoon keenya isaanii afaanuma keenya kan nu itti dhalanne dubbatan dhageenya ree?
english: How do we hear, everyone in our own native language?

kikuyu: Nu warri Phartee, warri Meedii fi warri Elaam, jiraattonni Mesophotaamiyaa, warri Yihuudaa fi Qaphadooqiyaa akkasumas jiraattonni Phonxoosii fi Asiyaa,
english: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and people from Mesopotamia, Judea, Cappadocia, Pontus, Asia,

kikuyu: Firiigiyaa fi Phamfiliyaa, Gibxii fi kutaawwan biyya Liibiyaa kanneen naannoo Qareenaatti argaman, nu warri Roomaadhaa dhufne,
english: Phrygia, Pamphylia, Egypt, the parts of Libya around Cyrene, visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,

kikuyu: nu Yihuudoonnii fi warri amantii Yihuudootaa fudhanne lamaan, namoonni Qareexii fi Araboonni kunoo yommuu namoonni kunneen afaanuma keenyaan dinqii Waaqaa dubbatan dhageenya!”
english: Cretans and Arabians—we hear them speaking in our languages the mighty works of God!”

kikuyu: Hundi isaaniis dinqifatanii, waan jedhanis wallaalanii, “Kun maal jechuu dha?” jedhanii wal gaafatan.
english: They were all amazed and were perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean?”

kikuyu: Namoonni tokko tokko garuu, “Isaan daadhii wayinii baayʼee dhuganiiru” jedhanii isaanitti qoosan.
english: Others, mocking, said, “They are filled with new wine.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis ergamoota Kudha Tokkoo sana wajjin kaʼee dhaabate; sagalee isaas ol fudhatee tuuta sanaan akkana jedhe; “Isin yaa namoota Yihuudaatii fi warri Yerusaalem keessa jiraattan hundi, mee waan kana beekaa; waan ani isinitti himu kana hubadhaa dhagaʼaa.
english: But Peter, standing up with the eleven, lifted up his voice and spoke out to them, “You men of Judea and all you who dwell at Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to my words.

kikuyu: Yeroon kun waan guyyaa keessaa saʼaatii sadaffaa taʼeef namoonni kunneen akka isin yaaddan sana hin machoofne!
english: For these aren’t drunken, as you suppose, seeing it is only the third hour of the day.

kikuyu: Kun garuu waan Yooʼeel raajichi dubbatee dha; innis akkana jedha:
english: But this is what has been spoken through the prophet Joel:

kikuyu: “ ‘Bara dhumaa keessa, jedha Waaqayyo, ani Hafuura koo nama hunda irratti nan dhangalaasa; ilmaanii fi intallan keessan raajii dubbatu; dargaggoonni keessan mulʼata argu; jaarsoliin keessan abjuu abjootu.
english: ‘It will be in the last days, says God, that I will pour out my Spirit on all flesh. Your sons and your daughters will prophesy. Your young men will see visions. Your old men will dream dreams.

kikuyu: Bara sana keessa garboota koo warra dhiiraa fi dubartii irratti illee, Hafuura koo nan dhangalaasa; isaanis raajii ni dubbatu.
english: Yes, and on my servants and on my handmaidens in those days, I will pour out my Spirit, and they will prophesy.

kikuyu: Ani ol samii irratti dinqii, gad lafa irrattis mallattoo, dhiiga, ibiddaa fi hurrii aaraa nan argisiisa.
english: I will show wonders in the sky above, and signs on the earth beneath: blood, and fire, and billows of smoke.

kikuyu: Utuu guyyaan Gooftaa inni guddichii fi ulfina qabeessi sun hin dhufin dura, aduun dukkanatti geeddaramti; jiʼi immoo dhiigatti geeddarama.
english: The sun will be turned into darkness, and the moon into blood, before the great and glorious day of the Lord comes.

kikuyu: Namni maqaa Gooftaa waammatu, hundinuu ni fayya.’
english: It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’

kikuyu: “Yaa namoota Israaʼel, dubbii kana dhagaʼaa; akkuma isinuu beektan, Yesuus namni Naazreeti nama Waaqni dinqii, raajii fi mallattoo karaa isaatiin isin gidduutti hojjeteen isinii mirkaneessee dha.
english: “Men of Israel, hear these words! Jesus of Nazareth, a man approved by God to you by mighty works and wonders and signs which God did by him among you, even as you yourselves know,

kikuyu: Namicha kana Waaqatu akkuma dur murteessee fi akkuma duraan dursee beeku sanatti dabarsee isinitti kenne. Isinis namoota hamoo wajjin tokko taatanii fanniftanii isa ajjeeftan.
english: him, being delivered up by the determined counsel and foreknowledge of God, you have taken by the hand of lawless men, crucified and killed;

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu dhiphina keessaa isa baasee, warra duʼan keessaa isa kaase; duuti isa irratti aangoo qabaachuu hin dandeenyeetii.
english: whom God raised up, having freed him from the agony of death, because it was not possible that he should be held by it.

kikuyu: Daawitis akkana jedhee waaʼee isaa dubbate: “ ‘Ani yeroo hunda Gooftaa of duratti nan argan ture. Waan inni mirga koo jiruuf, ani hin raafamu.
english: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before my face, for he is on my right hand, that I should not be moved.

kikuyu: Kanaaf garaan koo ni gammada; arrabni koos ni ililcha; foon koos abdiidhaan jiraata.
english: Therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced. Moreover my flesh also will dwell in hope,

kikuyu: Ati siiʼool keessatti na hin dhiiftuutii; qulqullichi kee akka tortoru hin gootu.
english: because you will not leave my soul in Hades, neither will you allow your Holy One to see decay.

kikuyu: Karaa jireenyaa na barsiifteerta; fuula kee durattis gammachuudhaan na guutta.’
english: You made known to me the ways of life. You will make me full of gladness with your presence.’

kikuyu: “Yaa obboloota, akka Daawit hangafni abbootii durii sun duʼee awwaalame, awwaalli isaas hamma harʼaatti asuma akka jiru ani ija jabaadhee isinitti himuu nan dandaʼa.
english: “Brothers, I may tell you freely of the patriarch David, that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.

kikuyu: Innis waan raajii tureef akka Waaqni sanyii isaa keessaa nama tokko teessoo isaa irra teessisuuf akka kakatee waadaa galeefii ture beeke.
english: Therefore, being a prophet, and knowing that God had sworn with an oath to him that of the fruit of his body, according to the flesh, he would raise up the Christ to sit on his throne,

kikuyu: Innis waaʼee duʼaa kaʼuu Kiristoos, lubbuun isaa siiʼool keessatti akka hin hafin, yookaan foon isaas akka hin tortorin duraan dursee argee dubbate.
english: he foreseeing this, spoke about the resurrection of the Christ, that his soul wasn’t left in Hades, and his flesh didn’t see decay.

kikuyu: Yesuusuma kana Waaqni duʼaa kaaseera; nu hundinuu dhuga baatota waan kanaa ti.
english: This Jesus God raised up, to which we all are witnesses.

kikuyu: Kanaaf inni gara mirga Waaqaatti ol ol jedhee, abdii Hafuura Qulqulluu Abbaa biraa fuudhee waan isin amma argitanii fi dhageessan kana dhangalaase.
english: Being therefore exalted by the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this which you now see and hear.

kikuyu: Daawit gara samiitti ol hin baaneetii; inni mataan isaa garuu akkana jedha: “ ‘Gooftaan Gooftaa kootiin akkana jedhe; “Gara mirga koo taaʼi;
english: For David didn’t ascend into the heavens, but he says himself, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit by my right hand

kikuyu: hamma ani diinota kee ejjeta miilla keetii siif godhutti.” ’
english: until I make your enemies a footstool for your feet.”’

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu Yesuusuma isin fanniftan kana akka Waaqni Gooftaa fi Kiristoos isa godhe manni Israaʼel hundi dhugumaan haa beeku.”
english: “Let all the house of Israel therefore know certainly that God has made him both Lord and Christ, this Jesus whom you crucified.”

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti, garaan isaanii raafamee Phexrosii fi ergamoota kaaniin, “Yaa obboloota, yoos maal haa goonu?” jedhan.
english: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart, and said to Peter and the rest of the apostles, “Brothers, what shall we do?”

kikuyu: Phexrosis akkana jedhee deebise; “Tokkoon tokkoon keessan qalbii jijjiirradhaa; dhiifama cubbuu keessaniitiifis maqaa Yesuus Kiristoosiitiin cuuphamaa; kennaa Hafuura Qulqulluus ni argattu.
english: Peter said to them, “Repent and be baptized, every one of you, in the name of Jesus Christ for the forgiveness of sins, and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Abdiin kunis isinii fi ijoollee keessaniif, akkasumas warra Waaqni Gooftaan keenya ofitti waamu kanneen fagoo jiran hundaaf kenname.”
english: For the promise is to you and to your children, and to all who are far off, even as many as the Lord our God will call to himself.”

kikuyu: Innis dubbii biraa baayʼeedhaan dhugaa baʼee, “Dhaloota jalʼaa kana duraa of oolchaa” jedhee isaan gorse.
english: With many other words he testified and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this crooked generation!”

kikuyu: Warri dubbii isaa fudhatanis ni cuuphaman; gaafas nama gara kuma sadiitu isaanitti dabalame.
english: Then those who gladly received his word were baptized. There were added that day about three thousand souls.

kikuyu: Isaanis barsiisa ergamootaatti, jireenya tokkummaatti, buddeena caccabsuutti, Waaqa kadhachuuttis ni jabaatan.
english: They continued steadfastly in the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, in the breaking of bread, and prayer.

kikuyu: Namni hundinuus sodaan guutame; dinqii fi mallattoon baayʼeen ergamootaan hojjetame.
english: Fear came on every soul, and many wonders and signs were done through the apostles.

kikuyu: Amantoonni hundinuus wajjin turan; waan hundas walumaan qabu turan.
english: All who believed were together, and had all things in common.

kikuyu: Qabeenya isaaniitii fi miʼa isaaniis gurguranii nama rakkina qabu kamiif iyyuu qoodaa turan.
english: They sold their possessions and goods, and distributed them to all, according as anyone had need.

kikuyu: Isaanis guyyuma guyyaan mana qulqullummaatti wal gaʼaa turan; mana tokkoo tokkoo isaaniittis buddeena kukkutanii, gammachuu fi garaa qulqulluudhaan wajjin nyaachaa turan.
english: Day by day, continuing steadfastly with one accord in the temple, and breaking bread at home, they took their food with gladness and singleness of heart,

kikuyu: Waaqas galateeffachaa turan. Namoota hunda durattis ulfina qabu turan. Gooftaanis guyyuma guyyaan warra fayyan waldaa isaaniitti dabalaa ture.
english: praising God and having favor with all the people. The Lord added to the assembly day by day those who were being saved.

kikuyu: Gaaf tokko Phexrosii fi Yohannis yeroo kadhannaatti jechuunis waaree booddee saʼaatii sagalitti mana qulqullummaatti ol baʼaa turan.
english: Peter and John were going up into the temple at the hour of prayer, the ninth hour.

kikuyu: Namoonnis akka inni warra mana qulqullummaa seenan waa kadhatuuf jedhanii namicha dhalootuma isaatii jalqabee naafa ture tokko guyyuma guyyaan baatanii gara karra mana qulqullummaa kan “Miidhagaa” jedhamuutti geessu turan.
english: A certain man who was lame from his mother’s womb was being carried, whom they laid daily at the door of the temple which is called Beautiful, to ask gifts for the needy of those who entered into the temple.

kikuyu: Innis utuu Phexrosii fi Yohannis mana qulqullummaa seenanuu argee horii isaan kadhate.
english: Seeing Peter and John about to go into the temple, he asked to receive gifts for the needy.

kikuyu: Phexrosis Yohannis wajjin namicha hubatee ilaalee, “Mee nu ilaali!” jedheen.
english: Peter, fastening his eyes on him, with John, said, “Look at us.”

kikuyu: Namichis waa isaan irraa argachuu abdatee hubatee isaan ilaale.
english: He listened to them, expecting to receive something from them.

kikuyu: Phexrosis, “Ani meetii yookaan warqee hin qabu; ani garuu waan qabu siifin kenna. Maqaa Yesuus Kiristoos isa Naazreetiin ol kaʼii deemi!” jedhe.
english: But Peter said, “I have no silver or gold, but what I have, that I give you. In the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, get up and walk!”

kikuyu: Phexrosis harka isaa mirgaa qabee ol isa kaase; yeruma sana miillaa fi gulubiin isaa ni jabaate.
english: He took him by the right hand and raised him up. Immediately his feet and his ankle bones received strength.

kikuyu: Innis utaalee kaʼee miillaan deemuu jalqabe; deemaa, utaalaa, Waaqas galateeffachaa isaan wajjin mana qulqullummaa seene.
english: Leaping up, he stood and began to walk. He entered with them into the temple, walking, leaping, and praising God.

kikuyu: Namoonni hundinuu yommuu deemuu isaatii fi Waaqa galateeffachuu isaa arganitti,
english: All the people saw him walking and praising God.

kikuyu: akka inni namicha karra mana qulqullummaa kan, “Miidhagaa” jedhamu sana bira taaʼee kadhachaa ture sana taʼe hubatan; isaanis waan isaaf taʼe sanaaf akka malee raajeffatan; ni dinqifatanis.
english: They recognized him, that it was he who used to sit begging for gifts for the needy at the Beautiful Gate of the temple. They were filled with wonder and amazement at what had happened to him.

kikuyu: Namoonni hundinuu yeroo namichi fayye sun Phexrosii fi Yohannis biraa deebiʼuu didetti dinqisiifatanii utuu isaan iddoo gardaafoo Solomoon jedhamu keessa jiranuu fiigaa isaanitti dhufan.
english: As the lame man who was healed held on to Peter and John, all the people ran together to them in the porch that is called Solomon’s, greatly wondering.

kikuyu: Phexrosis yommuu waan kana argetti akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Yaa namoota Israaʼel wanni kun maaliif isin dinqa? Akka waan nu humna yookaan qulqullummaa mataa keenyaatiin akka namichi kun deemu gooneetti maaliif ija nutti babaaftu?
english: When Peter saw it, he responded to the people, “You men of Israel, why do you marvel at this man? Why do you fasten your eyes on us, as though by our own power or godliness we had made him walk?

kikuyu: Waaqni abbootii keenyaa, Waaqni Abrahaam, Waaqni Yisihaaqii fi Waaqni Yaaqoob tajaajilaa isaa Yesuusin kabajeera. Isin garuu akka inni ajjeefamuuf dabarsitanii isa kennitan; Phiilaaxoos gad isa dhiisuu murteessu iyyuu isin fuuluma Phiilaaxoos duratti isa haaltan.
english: The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up and denied in the presence of Pilate, when he had determined to release him.

kikuyu: Isinis isa qulqulluu fi qajeelaa sana gantanii akka namichi nama ajjeese sun gad isinii dhiifamu kadhattan.
english: But you denied the Holy and Righteous One and asked for a murderer to be granted to you,

kikuyu: Isin burqaa jireenyaa ajjeeftan; Waaqni garuu warra duʼan keessaa isa kaase; nus dhuga baatota waan kanaa ti.
english: and killed the Prince of life, whom God raised from the dead, to which we are witnesses.

kikuyu: Namichi isin argitanii fi isa beektan kun maqaa Yesuusitti amanuudhaan jabaate. Maqaa Yesuusii fi amantii karaa isaatiin dhufutu akkuma isin hundi argitan kana namicha kanaaf fayyaa guutuu kenne.
english: By faith in his name, his name has made this man strong, whom you see and know. Yes, the faith which is through him has given him this perfect soundness in the presence of you all.

kikuyu: “Ammas yaa obboloota, akka isinis utuu hin beekin akkuma bulchitoonni keessan gochaa turan sana gootan ani nan beeka.
english: “Now, brothers, I know that you did this in ignorance, as did also your rulers.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu waan akka Kiristoos dhiphachuuf jiru duraan dursee karaa raajota hundaatiin dubbate sana akkanaan raawwate.
english: But the things which God announced by the mouth of all his prophets, that Christ should suffer, he thus fulfilled.

kikuyu: Egaa akka cubbuun keessan haqamuuf, akka barri haaromfamaa Gooftaa biraa dhufuuf qalbii jijjiirradhaa gara Waaqaatti deebiʼaa;
english: “Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from the presence of the Lord,

kikuyu: kunis akka inni Kiristoos isiniif filatame sana jechuunis Yesuusin erguuf.
english: and that he may send Christ Jesus, who was ordained for you before,

kikuyu: Innis hamma yeroon Waaqni itti waan hunda iddootti deebisu sun gaʼutti samii irra turuu qaba; Waaqnis bara dheeraadhaan dura karaa raajota isaa qulqullootaatiin waan kana dubbatee ture.
english: whom heaven must receive until the times of restoration of all things, which God spoke long ago by the mouth of his holy prophets.

kikuyu: Museen akkana jedheeraatii; ‘Waaqni keessan Gooftaan sabuma keessan keessaa raajii akka kootii tokko isinii kaasa; isinis waan inni isinitti himu hunda dhagaʼaa.
english: For Moses indeed said to the fathers, ‘The Lord God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me. You shall listen to him in all things whatever he says to you.

kikuyu: Namni raajii sana hin dhageenye kam iyyuu saba isaa keessaa baafamee ni balleeffama.’
english: It will be that every soul that will not listen to that prophet will be utterly destroyed from among the people.’

kikuyu: “Saamuʼeel irraa jalqabee raajonni isa duubaan dhufanii waa dubbatan hundi duraan dursanii waaʼee yeroo sanaa labsaniiru.
english: Yes, and all the prophets from Samuel and those who followed after, as many as have spoken, also told of these days.

kikuyu: Isin immoo ilmaan raajotaatii fi ilmaan kakuu Waaqni abbootii keessan wajjin seene sanaa ti. Innis Abrahaamiin, ‘Sabni lafa irraa hundi karaa sanyii keetiitiin ni eebbifama’ jedhe.
english: You are the children of the prophets, and of the covenant which God made with our fathers, saying to Abraham, ‘All the families of the earth will be blessed through your offspring.’

kikuyu: Waaqni yeroo Ilma isaa duʼaa kaasetti, tokkoo tokkoo keessan hammina irraa isin deebisuudhaan isin eebbisuuf jedhee jalqabatti gara keessanitti isa erge.”
english: God, having raised up his servant Jesus, sent him to you first to bless you, in turning away every one of you from your wickedness.”

kikuyu: Utuu Phexrosii fi Yohannis namootatti dubbachaa jiranuu, luboonni, ajajaan eegdota mana qulqullummaatii fi Saduuqonni isaanitti dhufan.
english: As they spoke to the people, the priests and the captain of the temple and the Sadducees came to them,

kikuyu: Sababii ergamoonni sun namoota barsiisanii duʼaa kaʼuu karaa Yesuusiitiin argamu labsaniifis akka malee aaran.
english: being upset because they taught the people and proclaimed in Jesus the resurrection from the dead.

kikuyu: Isaanis Phexrosii fi Yohannisin qabanii hamma guyyaa itti aanuutti mana hidhaatti isaan galchan; galgalaaʼee tureetii.
english: They laid hands on them, and put them in custody until the next day, for it was now evening.

kikuyu: Warra dubbicha dhagaʼan keessaas baayʼeetu amane; baayʼinni warra amanees gara kuma shaniitti ol kaʼe.
english: But many of those who heard the word believed, and the number of the men came to be about five thousand.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanuttis bulchitoonni, maanguddoonnii fi barsiistonni seeraa Yerusaalemitti wal gaʼan.
english: In the morning, their rulers, elders, and scribes were gathered together in Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Haannaas lubichi ol aanaan, isa wajjin immoo Qayyaaffaan, Yohannis, Iskindiroosii fi namoonni maatii lubicha ol aanaa taʼan kaan hundi achi turan.
english: Annas the high priest was there, with Caiaphas, John, Alexander, and as many as were relatives of the high priest.

kikuyu: Isaanis Phexrosii fi Yohannisin gidduu isaanii dhaabanii, “Isin humna maaliitiin yookaan maqaa eenyuutiin waan kana gootan?” jedhanii gaafachuu jalqaban.
english: When they had stood Peter and John in the middle of them, they inquired, “By what power, or in what name, have you done this?”

kikuyu: Phexrosis Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan guutamee akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Isin yaa bulchitootaa fi maanguddoota uummataa!
english: Then Peter, filled with the Holy Spirit, said to them, “You rulers of the people and elders of Israel,

kikuyu: Harʼa waaʼee waan gaarii nama naafa tokkoof godhameetii fi akka inni itti fayyifame yoo nu gaafattan,
english: if we are examined today concerning a good deed done to a crippled man, by what means this man has been healed,

kikuyu: isinii fi namoonni Israaʼel hundinuu waan kana beekaa; namichi kun maqaa Yesuus Kiristoos nama Naazreeti kan isin fanniftanii Waaqni immoo warra duʼan keessaa isa kaase sanaatiin fayyee fuula keessan dura dhaabata.
english: may it be known to you all, and to all the people of Israel, that in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth, whom you crucified, whom God raised from the dead, this man stands here before you whole in him.

kikuyu: Yesuusis, “ ‘Dhagaa isin ijaartonni tuffattan kan dhagaa golee taʼee dha.’
english: He is ‘the stone which was regarded as worthless by you, the builders, which has become the head of the corner.’

kikuyu: Fayyinni nama biraa tokko irraa iyyuu hin argamu; maqaan nu ittiin fayyifamnu kan samii gaditti namootaaf kenname biraa tokko iyyuu hin jiruutii.”
english: There is salvation in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven that is given among men, by which we must be saved!”

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis yommuu ija jabina Phexrosii fi Yohannis arganii akka isaan warra barumsa hin qabnee fi warra hin beekamne taʼan hubatanitti ni dinqisiifatan; akka isaan Yesuus wajjin turanis ni qalbeeffatan.
english: Now when they saw the boldness of Peter and John, and had perceived that they were unlearned and ignorant men, they marveled. They recognized that they had been with Jesus.

kikuyu: Garuu namicha fayyifame sana isaa isaanuma wajjin achi dhaabatu arganii waan dubbatan dhaban.
english: Seeing the man who was healed standing with them, they could say nothing against it.

kikuyu: Kanaaf akka isaan waldaa keessaa gad baʼan ajajanii wajjin mariʼachuu jalqaban.
english: But when they had commanded them to go aside out of the council, they conferred among themselves,

kikuyu: Akkanas jedhan; “Jara kana maal haa goonu? Akka isaan dinqii guddaa hojjetan namni Yerusaalem keessa jiraatu hundi ni beeka; nus waan kana waakkachuu hin dandeenyu.
english: saying, “What shall we do to these men? Because indeed a notable miracle has been done through them, as can be plainly seen by all who dwell in Jerusalem, and we can’t deny it.

kikuyu: Garuu akka wanni kun hammana caalaa uummata keessa hin babalʼanneef nu akka jarri kun siʼachi maqaa kanaan nama tokkotti illee hin dubbanne isaan of eeggachiisuu qabna.”
english: But so that this spreads no further among the people, let’s threaten them, that from now on they don’t speak to anyone in this name.”

kikuyu: Isaanis jara waamanii akka isaan gonkumaa maqaa Yesuusiitiin hin dubbanne yookaan hin barsiifne isaan ajajan.
english: They called them, and commanded them not to speak at all nor teach in the name of Jesus.

kikuyu: Phexrosii fi Yohannis garuu deebisanii akkana jedhan; “Qooda Waaqaa isiniif ajajamuun fuula Waaqaa duratti akka qajeelaa taʼee fi akka hin taʼin mee isinuu ilaalaa!
english: But Peter and John answered them, “Whether it is right in the sight of God to listen to you rather than to God, judge for yourselves,

kikuyu: Nu waan arginee fi waan dhageenye dubbachuu dhiisuu hin dandeenyuutii.”
english: for we can’t help telling the things which we saw and heard.”

kikuyu: Isaanis erga ittuma fufanii doorsisanii booddee jara gad dhiisan. Waan namoonni sababii waan hojjetame sanaatiif Waaqa galateeffachaa turaniifis akka itti jara adaban murteeffachuu hin dandeenye.
english: When they had further threatened them, they let them go, finding no way to punish them, because of the people; for everyone glorified God for that which was done.

kikuyu: Umuriin namicha karaa dinqiitiin fayyifame sanaa waggaa afurtamaa ol tureetii.
english: For the man on whom this miracle of healing was performed was more than forty years old.

kikuyu: Phexrosii fi Yohannis yeroo gad dhiifamanitti gara saba isaanii dhaqanii waan luboonni hangafoonnii fi maanguddoonni jedhaniin hundumaa isaanitti himan.
english: Being let go, they came to their own company and reported all that the chief priests and the elders had said to them.

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti kadhannaadhaan sagalee isaanii tokkummaan Waaqatti ol fuudhanii akkana jedhan; “Yaa Gooftaa Waan Hundaa Olii, situ samii, lafa, galaanaa fi waan isaan keessa jiru hunda uume.
english: When they heard it, they lifted up their voice to God with one accord and said, “O Lord, you are God, who made the sky, the earth, the sea, and all that is in them;

kikuyu: Ati Hafuura Qulqulluun karaa afaan tajaajilaa kee abbaa keenya Daawitiitiin akkana jettee dubbatteerta; “ ‘Namoonni maaliif akkanumaan mariʼatu? Saboonnis maaliif waan faayidaa hin qabne yaadu?
english: who by the mouth of your servant David, said, ‘Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?

kikuyu: Mootonni lafaa kaʼanii, bulchitoonnis Gooftichaa fi dibamaa isaatiin mormuuf walitti qabaman.’
english: The kings of the earth take a stand, and the rulers plot together, against the Lord, and against his Christ.’

kikuyu: Dhugumaan Heroodisii fi Phonxoos Phiilaaxoos Namoota Ormaatii fi uummata Israaʼel wajjin hojjetaa kee isa qulqulluu, Yesuus isa ati dibdetti mariʼachuuf jedhanii magaalaa kana keessatti walitti qabaman.
english: “For truly, both Herod and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles and the people of Israel, were gathered together against your holy servant Jesus, whom you anointed,

kikuyu: Isaanis waanuma humnii fi fedhiin kee akka wanni kun taʼuuf duraan dursanii murteessan sana hojjetan.
english: to do whatever your hand and your counsel foreordained to happen.

kikuyu: Yaa Gooftaa, egaa doorsisa isaanii ilaaliitii akka garboonni kee ija jabinaan dubbii kee dubbataniif dandeettii kenniif.
english: Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,

kikuyu: Nama fayyisuu fi maqaa tajaajilaa kee qulqullichaa, maqaa Yesuusiitiin mallattoo fi dinqii hojjechuuf harka kee diriirfadhu.”
english: while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant Jesus.”

kikuyu: Erga isaan Waaqa kadhatanii booddee lafti isaan itti wal gaʼan sun ni sosochoote; isaan hundinuus hafuura qulqulluudhaan guutamanii ija jabinaan dubbii Waaqaa dubbatan.
english: When they had prayed, the place was shaken where they were gathered together. They were all filled with the Holy Spirit, and they spoke the word of God with boldness.

kikuyu: Amantoonni hundinuus garaa tokkoo fi yaada tokko qabu turan; waan qaban hundas walumaan qoodachaa turan malee namni tokko iyyuu akka waan qabeenyi inni qabu kam iyyuu kan mataa isaa qofa taʼeetti hin lakkoofne.
english: The multitude of those who believed were of one heart and soul. Not one of them claimed that anything of the things which he possessed was his own, but they had all things in common.

kikuyu: Ergamoonnis duʼaa kaʼuu Gooftaa Yesuus humna guddaadhaan dhugaa baʼaa turan; ayyaanni guddaanis hunduma isaanii irra ture.
english: With great power, the apostles gave their testimony of the resurrection of the Lord Jesus. Great grace was on them all.

kikuyu: Rakkataan tokko iyyuu isaan gidduu hin turre. Warri lafa yookaan mana qaban hundinuu gurguranii maallaqa fidanii,
english: For neither was there among them any who lacked, for as many as were owners of lands or houses sold them, and brought the proceeds of the things that were sold,

kikuyu: miilla ergamootaa bira kaaʼu turan; maallaqni sunis nama rakkina qabu kamiif iyyuu ni qoodama ture.
english: and laid them at the apostles’ feet; and distribution was made to each, according as anyone had need.

kikuyu: Yoosef namni gosa Lewwii kan Qophiroositti dhalate, inni ergamoonni Barnaabaas jedhaniin tokkos achi ture. Barnaabaas jechuun “ilma jajjabinaa” jechuu dha.
english: Joses, who by the apostles was also called Barnabas (which is, being interpreted, Son of Encouragement), a Levite, a man of Cyprus by race,

kikuyu: Innis lafa qotiisaa ofii isaa gurguree horii isaa fidee miilla ergamootaa bira kaaʼe.
english: having a field, sold it and brought the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

kikuyu: Namni Anaaniyaas jedhamu tokko niitii isaa Safiiraa wajjin lafa gurgurate.
english: But a certain man named Ananias, with Sapphira his wife, sold a possession,

kikuyu: Innis utuma niitiin isaa beektuu horii sana irraa gartokko ofii isaatii hambifatee kan hafe immoo geessee miilla ergamootaa bira kaaʼe.
english: and kept back part of the price, his wife also being aware of it, then brought a certain part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.

kikuyu: Phexros garuu akkana jedhe; “Yaa Anaaniyaas, akka ati Hafuura Qulqulluu sobdee horii lafa gurgurattee argate irraa gartokko hambifattuuf seexanni maaliif akkas garaa kee guute?
english: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the price of the land?

kikuyu: Lafti sun utuu hin gurguramin iyyuu kan kee ture mitii? Erga gurguramee booddees horiin sun harkuma kee hin turree? Yoos akka ati waan akkasii gootu maalitu si yaachise? Ati Waaqa sobde malee nama hin sobne.”
english: While you kept it, didn’t it remain your own? After it was sold, wasn’t it in your power? How is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You haven’t lied to men, but to God.”

kikuyu: Anaaniyaasis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti kufee duʼe. Warri waan kana dhagaʼan hundinuus sodaa guddaan qabaman.
english: Ananias, hearing these words, fell down and died. Great fear came on all who heard these things.

kikuyu: Dargaggoonnis dhufanii, reeffa isaa kafanan; gad baasaniis isa awwaalan.
english: The young men arose and wrapped him up, and they carried him out and buried him.

kikuyu: Gara saʼaatii sadii booddee niitiin isaa utuu waan taʼe hin beekin dhuftee ol seente.
english: About three hours later, his wife, not knowing what had happened, came in.

kikuyu: Phexrosis, “Gatiin isin Anaaniyaas wajjin lafa gurgurattan sana irraa argattan kanumaa? Mee natti himi!” jedhee ishee gaafate. Isheenis, “Eeyyee kanuma” jette.
english: Peter answered her, “Tell me whether you sold the land for so much.” She said, “Yes, for so much.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis, “Isin akkam Hafuura Gooftaa qoruuf walii galuu dandeessan? Ilaa! miilli warra dhirsa kee awwaalanii balbala dura gaʼeera; sis gad si baasu” jedheen.
english: But Peter asked her, “How is it that you have agreed together to tempt the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”

kikuyu: Isheenis yeruma sana miilla isaa jalatti lafa dhooftee duute; dargaggoonni sunis ol seenanii reeffa ishee argan; gad baasaniis dhirsa ishee biratti ishee awwaalan.
english: She fell down immediately at his feet and died. The young men came in and found her dead, and they carried her out and buried her by her husband.

kikuyu: Waldaan kiristaanaa hundi, warri waan kana dhagaʼan hundinuus sodaa guddaan qabaman.
english: Great fear came on the whole assembly, and on all who heard these things.

kikuyu: Ergamoonnis mallattoo fi dinqii baayʼee uummata gidduutti hojjetan. Amantoonni hundinuus iddoo gardaafoo Solomoon jedhamutti walitti qabamu turan.
english: By the hands of the apostles many signs and wonders were done among the people. They were all with one accord in Solomon’s porch.

kikuyu: Warra hafan keessaa namni tokko iyyuu isaanitti dabalamuuf ija hin jabaanne, uummanni garuu akka malee isaan ulfeessa ture.
english: None of the rest dared to join them; however, the people honored them.

kikuyu: Hamma duraa caalaas dhiironnii fi dubartoonni hedduun Gooftaatti amananii amantootatti dabalaman.
english: More believers were added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women.

kikuyu: Kanaafis akka yommuu Phexros achiin darbutti gaaddiddumti isaa iyyuu isaan keessaa tokko tokko irra buʼuuf jedhanii namoonni dhukkubsattoota karaatti baasanii siree fi itillee irra ciciibsan.
english: They even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on cots and mattresses, so that as Peter came by, at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

kikuyu: Namoonnis magaalaawwan naannoo Yerusaalem jiran keessaa warra dhukkubsatanii fi warra hafuura xuraaʼaan dhiphatan fidanii achitti wal gaʼan; warri geeffaman hundinuus ni fayyifaman.
english: The multitude also came together from the cities around Jerusalem, bringing sick people and those who were tormented by unclean spirits; and they were all healed.

kikuyu: Lubni ol aanaanii fi miseensonni garee Saduuqotaa warri isa wajjin turan hundinuu hinaaffaan guutaman.
english: But the high priest rose up, and all those who were with him (which is the sect of the Sadducees), and they were filled with jealousy

kikuyu: Isaanis ergamoota qabanii mana hidhaa uummataa keessa buusan.
english: and laid hands on the apostles, then put them in public custody.

kikuyu: Garuu ergamaan Gooftaa tokko halkaniin balbala mana hidhaa banee gad isaan baase.
english: But an angel of the Lord opened the prison doors by night, and brought them out and said,

kikuyu: Innis, “Dhaqaa mana qulqullummaa keessa dhadhaabadhaatii, dubbii jireenya haaraa kana hunda isaa uummatatti himaa” jedheen.
english: “Go stand and speak in the temple to the people all the words of this life.”

kikuyu: Isaanis akkuma isaanitti himame sanatti ganama barii mana qulqullummaa seenanii uummata barsiisuu jalqaban. Lubni ol aanaanii fi warri isa wajjin turan yommuu achi gaʼanitti waldaa Yihuudootaatii fi yaaʼii maanguddoota Israaʼel walitti waaman; akka ergamoota sana fidaniifis mana hidhaatti namoota ergan.
english: When they heard this, they entered into the temple about daybreak and taught. But the high priest and those who were with him came and called the council together, with all the senate of the children of Israel, and sent to the prison to have them brought.

kikuyu: Qondaaltonni ergaman sun garuu yommuu mana hidhaa gaʼanitti jara achitti hin arganne; kanaafis deebiʼanii,
english: But the officers who came didn’t find them in the prison. They returned and reported,

kikuyu: “Mana hidhaa sana isaa sirriitti qollofamee jiru, eegdotas, utuu isaan balbala dura dhaabatanii jiranuu argine; yeroo bannetti garuu nama tokko illee achi keessatti hin arganne” jedhan.
english: “We found the prison shut and locked, and the guards standing before the doors, but when we opened them, we found no one inside!”

kikuyu: Ajajaan eegdota mana qulqullummaatii fi luboonni hangafoonni yommuu oduu kana dhagaʼanitti dinqifachuudhaan waan jedhan wallaalanii, “Maaltu dhalate immoo?” jedhan.
english: Now when the high priest, the captain of the temple, and the chief priests heard these words, they were very perplexed about them and what might become of this.

kikuyu: Yommus namichi tokko dhufee, “Jarri isin mana hidhaatti galchitan sun kunoo, mana qulqullummaa keessa dhadhaabatanii uummata barsiisaa jiru!” jedhe.
english: One came and told them, “Behold, the men whom you put in prison are in the temple, standing and teaching the people.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti ajajaan sun qondaaltota wajjin dhaqee ergamoota sana fide; isaanis sababii uummanni dhagaan nu tuma jedhanii sodaataniif humnatti hin fayyadamne.
english: Then the captain went with the officers, and brought them without violence, for they were afraid that the people might stone them.

kikuyu: Ergamootas fidanii, akka lubni ol aanaan isaan qoruuf fuula yaaʼii Yihuudootaa dura isaan dhadhaabachiisan.
english: When they had brought them, they set them before the council. The high priest questioned them,

kikuyu: Lubichi ol aanaanis, “Nu akka isin maqaa kanaan hin barsiisne jabeessinee isin ajajnee turre; isin garuu barsiisa keessaniin Yerusaalem guuttaniirtu; akka nu itti gaafatamtoota dhiiga namicha kanaa taanu nu gochuu barbaaddu” jedhe.
english: saying, “Didn’t we strictly command you not to teach in this name? Behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and intend to bring this man’s blood on us.”

kikuyu: Phexrosii fi ergamoonni kaan garuu akkana jedhanii deebisan; “Nu namaaf ajajamuu irra Waaqaaf ajajamuu qabna!
english: But Peter and the apostles answered, “We must obey God rather than men.

kikuyu: Yesuus isa isin fannoo irratti fanniftanii ajjeeftan sana Waaqni abbootii keenyaa warra duʼan keessaa isa kaaseera.
english: The God of our fathers raised up Jesus, whom you killed, hanging him on a tree.

kikuyu: Waaqni akka inni Israaʼeliif qalbii jijjiirrachuu fi dhiifama cubbuu kennuuf jedhee bulchaa fi Fayyisaa godhee mirga ofiitti ol ol isa qabe.
english: God exalted him with his right hand to be a Prince and a Savior, to give repentance to Israel, and remission of sins.

kikuyu: Nu dhuga baatota waan kanaa ti; akkasumas Hafuurri Qulqulluun Waaqni warra isaaf ajajamaniif kenne sun dhuga baʼaa waan kanaa ti.”
english: We are his witnesses of these things; and so also is the Holy Spirit, whom God has given to those who obey him.”

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti akka malee aariidhaan guggubatanii ergamoota ajjeesuuf mariʼatan.
english: But they, when they heard this, were cut to the heart, and were determined to kill them.

kikuyu: Fariisichi Gamaaliyaal jedhamu, barsiisaan seeraa kan namni hundi kabaju tokko garuu waldaa Yihuudootaa keessa dhaabatee akka ergamoonni sun yeroof gad baafaman ajaje.
english: But one stood up in the council, a Pharisee named Gamaliel, a teacher of the law, honored by all the people, and commanded to put the apostles out for a little while.

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Yaa namoota Israaʼel, waan jara kana gochuuf deemtan keessatti of eeggadhaa.
english: He said to them, “You men of Israel, be careful concerning these men, what you are about to do.

kikuyu: Bara dheeraan dura Toyidaas akka waan nama guddaa taʼeetti of ilaalee kaanaan namoonni gara dhibba afuriitti hedaman isa faana buʼan; inni ni ajjeefame; duuka buutonni isaa ni bittinneeffaman; akkasumaan badanis.
english: For before these days Theudas rose up, making himself out to be somebody; to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves. He was slain; and all, as many as obeyed him, were dispersed and came to nothing.

kikuyu: Namicha kana booddee immoo Yihuudaan, namni Galiilaa bara lakkoobsa sabaa keessa kaʼee nama baayʼee ofitti kutate; innis ni ajjeefame; warri isa faana buʼanis ni bittinnaaʼan.
english: After this man, Judas of Galilee rose up in the days of the enrollment, and drew away some people after him. He also perished, and all, as many as obeyed him, were scattered abroad.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu dubbii kana keessatti ani isinittin hima; namoota kana gad dhiisaa! Haa deemani! Mariin isaanii yookaan hojiin isaanii kun yoo waan nama irraa dhufe taʼe ni bada.
english: Now I tell you, withdraw from these men and leave them alone. For if this counsel or this work is of men, it will be overthrown.

kikuyu: Yoo waan Waaqa irraa dhufe taʼe garuu jara kana dhowwuu hin dandeessan; isin mataan keessan iyyuu akka utuu Waaqaan wal loltanuu hin argamne of eeggadhaa!”
english: But if it is of God, you will not be able to overthrow it, and you would be found even to be fighting against God!”

kikuyu: Isaanis gorsa isaa fudhatan; ergamoota sanas ol waamanii garafan; akka isaan maqaa Yesuusiitiin waa hin dubbannes ajajanii gad isaan dhiisan.
english: They agreed with him. Summoning the apostles, they beat them and commanded them not to speak in the name of Jesus, and let them go.

kikuyu: Ergamoonnis akka maqaa sanaaf jedhanii qaanaʼaniif waan gaʼumsa argataniif akka malee gammadaa fuula waldaa duraa deeman.
english: They therefore departed from the presence of the council, rejoicing that they were counted worthy to suffer dishonor for Jesus’ name.

kikuyu: Isaanis guyyuma guyyaan mana qulqullummaatti, mana namaattis utuu gargar hin kutin akka Yesuus Kiristoos taʼe barsiisaa, lallabaas turan.
english: Every day, in the temple and at home, they never stopped teaching and preaching Jesus, the Christ.

kikuyu: Bara sana keessa yommuu baayʼinni barattootaa dabalamaa deemetti Yihuudoonni Giriikota keessa jiraatan Ibrootatti guunguman; haadhonni hiyyeessaa Yihuudootaa nyaata guyyaa guyyaan hiramu keessatti hacuucamanii turaniitii.
english: Now in those days, when the number of the disciples was multiplying, a complaint arose from the Hellenists against the Hebrews, because their widows were neglected in the daily service.

kikuyu: Kanaaf ergamoonni kudha lamaan barattoota hunda walitti qabanii akkana jedhaniin; “Maaddii tajaajiluuf jennee dubbii Waaqaa barsiisuu dhiisuun nuuf qajeelaa miti.
english: The twelve summoned the multitude of the disciples and said, “It is not appropriate for us to forsake the word of God and serve tables.

kikuyu: Kanaaf yaa obboloota isin namoota maqaa gaarii qaban kanneen Hafuura Qulqulluu fi ogummaan guutaman torba gidduu keessanii filadhaa. Nus itti gaafatama kana isaanitti kenninee,
english: Therefore, select from among you, brothers, seven men of good report, full of the Holy Spirit and of wisdom, whom we may appoint over this business.

kikuyu: Waaqa kadhachuu fi dubbii isaa barsiisuutti jabaannaa.”
english: But we will continue steadfastly in prayer and in the ministry of the word.”

kikuyu: Wanni isaan jedhanis tuuta sana hunda gammachiise. Isaanis Isxifaanos namicha amantii fi Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan guutame tokko, akkasumas Fiiliphoosii fi Phirookoroosin, Niiqaaroonaa fi Xiimoonaa, Pharmeenaa fi Niqoolaas namicha Anxookiiyaa isa amantii Yihuudootaatti gale sana filatan.
english: These words pleased the whole multitude. They chose Stephen, a man full of faith and of the Holy Spirit, Philip, Prochorus, Nicanor, Timon, Parmenas, and Nicolaus, a proselyte of Antioch,

kikuyu: Isaanis jara kana fuula ergamootaa dura dhaaban; ergamoonnis Waaqa kadhataniifii harka isaan irra kaaʼan.
english: whom they set before the apostles. When they had prayed, they laid their hands on them.

kikuyu: Dubbiin Waaqaa ni babalʼate; baayʼinni barattootaas Yerusaalem keessatti akka malee dabalame; luboonni hedduun amantii kanaaf ajajaman.
