english: The word of God increased and the number of the disciples greatly multiplied in Jerusalem. A great company of the priests were obedient to the faith.

kikuyu: Isxifaanos ayyaanaa fi humna Waaqaatiin guutamee dinqii fi mallattoo gurguddaa namoota gidduutti hojjette.
english: Stephen, full of faith and power, performed great wonders and signs among the people.

kikuyu: Miseensonni mana sagadaa warra, “Namoota bilisooman” jedhamanii, jechuunis Yihuudoonni Qareenaa fi Iskindiriyaadhaa dhufan akkasumas Yihuudoonni Kiilqiyaa fi Asiyaadhaa dhufan tokko tokko Isxifaanosiin mormuu jalqaban.
english: But some of those who were of the synagogue called “The Libertines”, and of the Cyrenians, of the Alexandrians, and of those of Cilicia and Asia arose, disputing with Stephen.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu ogummaa isaa yookaan Hafuura Qulqulluu inni ittiin dubbatu sanaan mormuu hin dandeenye.
english: They weren’t able to withstand the wisdom and the Spirit by which he spoke.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka isaan, “Nu utuu Isxifaanos Musee fi Waaqa irratti dubbii arrabsoo dubbatuu dhageenyeerra” jedhaniif dhoksaan namoota tokko tokko sossobatan.
english: Then they secretly induced men to say, “We have heard him speak blasphemous words against Moses and God.”

kikuyu: Isaanis uummata, maanguddootaa fi barsiistota seeraa kakaasan. Isxifaanosiinis qabanii fuula waldaa Yihuudootaa duratti isa dhiʼeessan.
english: They stirred up the people, the elders, and the scribes, and came against him and seized him, then brought him in to the council,

kikuyu: Dhuga baatota sobduus qopheeffatan; isaanis akkana jedhan; “Namichi kun iddoo qulqulluu kanaa fi seeraan mormuu takkumaa hin dhiifne.
english: and set up false witnesses who said, “This man never stops speaking blasphemous words against this holy place and the law.

kikuyu: Nu isaa, ‘Yesuus namni Naazreeti kun iddoo kana ni diiga; seera Museen nuu kennes ni geeddara’ jedhu dhageenyeerra.”
english: For we have heard him say that this Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this place, and will change the customs which Moses delivered to us.”

kikuyu: Warri waldaa sana keessa turan hundi ija babaasanii Isxifaanosin ilaalanii akka fuuli isaa akkuma fuula ergamaa Waaqaa taʼe argan.
english: All who sat in the council, fastening their eyes on him, saw his face like it was the face of an angel.

kikuyu: Lubni ol aanaanis, “Wanni kun dhugumaa?” jedhee isa gaafate.
english: The high priest said, “Are these things so?”

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee deebise; “Yaa obbolootaa fi yaa abbootii, mee na dhagaʼaa! Waaqni ulfinaa, yeroo abbaan keenya Abrahaam Mesophotaamiyaa turetti, utuu inni biyya Kaaraan hin dhaqin isatti mulʼate.
english: He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia, before he lived in Haran,

kikuyu: Waaqnis, ‘Biyya keetii fi saba kee dhiisiitii gara biyya ani si argisiisuu dhaqi’ jedheen.
english: and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’

kikuyu: “Innis biyya Kaldootaatii baʼee dhaqee Kaaraan keessa jiraate. Erga abbaan isaa duʼe immoo Waaqni achii isa baasee biyya isin amma keessa jiraattan kanatti isa erge.
english: Then he came out of the land of the Chaldaeans and lived in Haran. From there, when his father was dead, God moved him into this land where you are now living.

kikuyu: Taʼus Waaqni dhaala tokko illee, lafa taakkuu tokkittii illee biyya sana keessatti hin kennineef; garuu Waaqni akka Abrahaamii fi sanyii isaa warra isaan booddeetiif biyya sana akkuma qabeenyaatti kennuuf waadaa galeef. Abrahaam yeroo sana ijoollee tokko illee hin qabu ture.
english: He gave him no inheritance in it, no, not so much as to set his foot on. He promised that he would give it to him for a possession, and to his offspring after him, when he still had no child.

kikuyu: Waaqni akkana jedhee karaa kanaan isatti dubbate; ‘Sanyiin kee biyya kan isaa hin taʼin keessatti alagaa taʼa; waggaa dhibba afuris ni garboomfama; ni cunqurfamas.’
english: God spoke in this way: that his offspring would live as aliens in a strange land, and that they would be enslaved and mistreated for four hundred years.

kikuyu: Waaqni akkana jedhe; ‘Ani garuu saba isaan akkuma garbootaatti tajaajilan sana nan adaba; ergasii immoo isaan biyya sanaa baʼanii lafa kanatti na waaqeffatu.’
english: ‘I will judge the nation to which they will be in bondage,’ said God, ‘and after that they will come out and serve me in this place.’

kikuyu: Waaqnis kakuu dhagna qabaa Abrahaamiif kenne; Abrahaamis abbaa Yisihaaq taʼee guyyaa saddeettaffaatti dhagna isa qabe; Yisihaaqis ergasii abbaa Yaaqoob taʼe; Yaaqoob immoo abbaa abbootii gosoota kudha lamaanii taʼe.
english: He gave him the covenant of circumcision. So Abraham became the father of Isaac, and circumcised him the eighth day. Isaac became the father of Jacob, and Jacob became the father of the twelve patriarchs.

kikuyu: “Abbootiin sunis waan Yoosefitti hinaafaniif akka inni biyya Gibxitti garba taʼuuf isa gurguran; Waaqni garuu isa wajjin ture;
english: “The patriarchs, moved with jealousy against Joseph, sold him into Egypt. God was with him

kikuyu: rakkina isaa hunda keessaa isa baase; Waaqnis fuula Faraʼoon mooticha Gibxi duratti ulfinaa fi ogummaa Yoosefiif kenne; Faraʼoonis biyya Gibxii fi mana mootummaa isaa hunda irratti bulchaa isa godhe.
english: and delivered him out of all his afflictions, and gave him favor and wisdom before Pharaoh, king of Egypt. He made him governor over Egypt and all his house.

kikuyu: “Baruma sana biyya Gibxii fi biyya Kanaʼaan hundatti beelli buʼee rakkina guddaa fide; abbootiin keenyas waan nyaatan tokko illee argachuu hin dandeenye.
english: Now a famine came over all the land of Egypt and Canaan, and great affliction. Our fathers found no food.

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis akka Gibxi keessa midhaan jiru dhageenyaan yeroo jalqabaatiif abbootii keenya achi erge.
english: But when Jacob heard that there was grain in Egypt, he sent out our fathers the first time.

kikuyu: Imala isaanii lammaffaa irrattis Yoosef eenyummaa isaa obboloota isaatti hime; Faraʼoonis waaʼee obboloota Yoosef beeke.
english: On the second time Joseph was made known to his brothers, and Joseph’s family was revealed to Pharaoh.

kikuyu: Yoosefis ergasii nama ergee abbaa isaa Yaaqoobii fi maatii isaa hunda jechuunis walumatti qabaatti nama 75 waamsise.
english: Joseph sent and summoned Jacob his father and all his relatives, seventy-five souls.

kikuyu: Yaaqoobis Gibxitti gad buʼe; innis, abbootiin keenyas achitti duʼan.
english: Jacob went down into Egypt and he died, himself and our fathers;

kikuyu: Reeffi isaaniis Sheekemitti geeffamee lafa awwaalaa kan Abrahaam ijoollee Hamoori irraa horii wayiitiin bitee ture sanatti awwaalame.
english: and they were brought back to Shechem and laid in the tomb that Abraham bought for a price in silver from the children of Hamor of Shechem.

kikuyu: “Akkuma yeroon waadaa Waaqni Abrahaamiif gale sun itti raawwatamu dhiʼaachaa dhufeen baayʼinni saba keenyaa Gibxi keessatti akka malee guddate.
english: “But as the time of the promise came close which God had sworn to Abraham, the people grew and multiplied in Egypt,

kikuyu: Ergasii ‘Mootiin waaʼee Yoosef hin beekin haaraan tokko bulchaa Gibxi taʼe.’
english: until there arose a different king who didn’t know Joseph.

kikuyu: Innis akka malee saba keenya cunqurse; abbootii keenyas akka daaʼimman isaanii dhumaniif akka isaan gad gatan dirqisiise.
english: The same took advantage of our race and mistreated our fathers, and forced them to abandon their babies, so that they wouldn’t stay alive.

kikuyu: “Yeroon Museen dhalates yeruma kana ture; innis fuula Waaqaa duratti miidhagaa ture; jiʼa sadiifis mana abbaa isaatti kunuunfamee guddate.
english: At that time Moses was born, and was exceedingly handsome to God. He was nourished three months in his father’s house.

kikuyu: Yommuu inni alatti gatametti intalli Faraʼoon fudhattee akka ilma isheetti isa guddifatte.
english: When he was abandoned, Pharaoh’s daughter took him up and reared him as her own son.

kikuyu: Museen ogummaa warra Gibxi hunda barate; innis dubbii isaatii fi hojii isaatiin jabaa ture.
english: Moses was instructed in all the wisdom of the Egyptians. He was mighty in his words and works.

kikuyu: “Museen yommuu umuriin isaa waggaa 40 guutetti dhaqee obboloota isaa ijoollee Israaʼel ilaaluu murteesse.
english: But when he was forty years old, it came into his heart to visit his brothers, the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Museenis utuu namni Gibxi tokko nama isaanii tokko miidhuu arge. Kanaafis nama isaanii gargaaruu dhaqee namicha Gibxi sana ajjeesuun haaloo baaseef.
english: Seeing one of them suffer wrong, he defended him and avenged him who was oppressed, striking the Egyptian.

kikuyu: Museen waan sabni isaa akka Waaqni karaa isaatiin saba Israaʼel furu hubatu seʼee ture; sabni sun garuu hin hubanne.
english: He supposed that his brothers understood that God, by his hand, was giving them deliverance; but they didn’t understand.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti immoo utuu namoonni Israaʼel lama wal lolanuu itti dhufee, ‘Jarana, isin obboloota walii ti; yoos maaliif wal miitu ree?’ jedhee walitti araarsuu yaale.
english: “The day following, he appeared to them as they fought, and urged them to be at peace again, saying, ‘Sirs, you are brothers. Why do you wrong one another?’

kikuyu: “Namichi hiriyaa isaa miidhaa ture sun garuu Musee achi of irraa darbatee akkana jedhe; ‘Eenyutu nurratti bulchaa fi abbaa murtii si godhe?
english: But he who did his neighbor wrong pushed him away, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge over us?

kikuyu: Akkuma kaleessa namicha Gibxi ajjeefte sana ana illee ajjeesuu barbaaddaa?’
english: Do you want to kill me as you killed the Egyptian yesterday?’

kikuyu: Museenis waan kana dhageenyaan biyya Midiyaanitti baqatee galtuu taʼee achi jiraate; achittis ilmaan lama dhalche.
english: Moses fled at this saying, and became a stranger in the land of Midian, where he became the father of two sons.

kikuyu: “Erga waggaan afurtamni darbee booddees ergamaan Waaqaa tokko gammoojjii naannoo Tulluu Siinaa keessatti daggala bobaʼu keessaa arraba ibiddaa keessaan Museetti mulʼate.
english: “When forty years were fulfilled, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in the wilderness of Mount Sinai, in a flame of fire in a bush.

kikuyu: Innis waan kana arginaan waan arge sana dinqifate. Yommuu ilaaluuf itti dhiʼaatettis sagalee Gooftaa dhagaʼe.
english: When Moses saw it, he wondered at the sight. As he came close to see, the voice of the Lord came to him,

kikuyu: Sagaleen sunis, ‘Ani Waaqa abbootii keetii, Waaqa Abrahaam, kan Yisihaaqii fi kan Yaaqoob’ jedheen. Museenis ni hollate; ilaaluus ni sodaate.
english: ‘I am the God of your fathers: the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob.’ Moses trembled and dared not look.

kikuyu: “Gooftaan immoo akkana jedheen; ‘Sababii iddoon ati dhaabatu kun qulqulluu taʼeef kophee kee baafadhu.
english: The Lord said to him, ‘Take off your sandals, for the place where you stand is holy ground.

kikuyu: Ani akka sabni koo biyya Gibxi keessatti cunqurfamaa jiru dhugumaan argeera; booʼicha isaaniis dhagaʼee isaan bilisoomsuuf jedhee gad buʼeera; egaa kottu Gibxittin deebisee si ergaatii.’
english: I have surely seen the affliction of my people who are in Egypt, and have heard their groaning. I have come down to deliver them. Now come, I will send you into Egypt.’

kikuyu: “Namni isaan, ‘Eenyutu bulchaa fi abbaa murtii si godhe?’ jedhanii tuffatan sun Museedhuma kana. Isas Waaqni akka inni bulchaa fi furaa isaanii taʼuuf harka ergamaa Waaqaa kan daggala keessaan isatti mulʼate sanaatiin erge.
english: “This Moses whom they refused, saying, ‘Who made you a ruler and a judge?’—God has sent him as both a ruler and a deliverer by the hand of the angel who appeared to him in the bush.

kikuyu: Innis Gibxi keessatti, galaana diimaa irratti akkasumas waggaa 40 gammoojjii keessatti dinqii fi mallattoo hojjechaa Gibxi keessaa isaan baase.
english: This man led them out, having worked wonders and signs in Egypt, in the Red Sea, and in the wilderness for forty years.

kikuyu: “Museen kun isuma saba Israaʼeliitiin, ‘Waaqni sabuma keessan keessaa raajii akka kootii tokko isinii kaasa’ jedhe sanaa dha.
english: This is that Moses who said to the children of Israel, ‘The Lord our God will raise up a prophet for you from among your brothers, like me.’

kikuyu: Innis, Ergamaa Waaqaa kan Tulluu Siinaa irratti isatti dubbate sanaa fi abbootii keenya wajjin gammoojjii keessatti waldaa keessa ture; dubbii jiraataas nutti kennuuf fudhate.
english: This is he who was in the assembly in the wilderness with the angel that spoke to him on Mount Sinai, and with our fathers, who received living revelations to give to us,

kikuyu: “Abbootiin keenya garuu isaaf ajajamuu didan; qooda ajajamuu isa tuffatanii garaa isaaniitiinis gara Gibxitti deebiʼan.
english: to whom our fathers wouldn’t be obedient, but rejected him and turned back in their hearts to Egypt,

kikuyu: Arooniinis, ‘Waaqota nu dura deeman nuu tolchi; Museen Gibxii nu baase sun maal akka taʼe hin beeknuutii!’ jedhan.
english: saying to Aaron, ‘Make us gods that will go before us, for as for this Moses who led us out of the land of Egypt, we don’t know what has become of him.’

kikuyu: Yeroon isaan Waaqa tolfamaa bifa jabbiitiin qopheeffatanis baruma sana; isaanis Waaqa sanaaf aarsaa dhiʼeessanii waanuma harka isaaniitiin tolfame sanaaf ayyaana ulfinaa ayyaaneffatan.
english: They made a calf in those days, and brought a sacrifice to the idol, and rejoiced in the works of their hands.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu isaan irraa garagalee akka isaan humnoota samii irraa waaqeffataniif isaan dhiise. Kunis waan kitaaba raajotaa keessatti barreeffame sanaan wal fakkaata; innis akkana jedha; “ ‘Yaa mana Israaʼel isin waggaa afurtama gammoojjii keessatti takkumaa aarsaa fi kennaa naaf fiddaniirtuu?
english: But God turned away and gave them up to serve the army of the sky, as it is written in the book of the prophets, ‘Did you offer to me slain animals and sacrifices forty years in the wilderness, O house of Israel?

kikuyu: Isin fakkii waaqota waaqeffachuuf tolfattanii jechuunis dunkaana Moolekiitii fi urjii waaqa keessan Reefaan ol qabdaniirtu. Kanaafuu ani biyya Baabiloniin gamaattin isin ariʼa.’
english: You took up the tabernacle of Moloch, the star of your god Rephan, the figures which you made to worship, so I will carry you away beyond Babylon.’

kikuyu: “Abbootiin keenya gammoojjii keessatti dunkaana dhuga baʼumsaa of biraa qabu turan. Dunkaanni sunis akkuma Waaqni akka Museen akkuma bifa arge sanaatti hojjetuuf isa qajeelchetti hojjetamee ture.
english: “Our fathers had the tabernacle of the testimony in the wilderness, even as he who spoke to Moses commanded him to make it according to the pattern that he had seen;

kikuyu: Abbootiin keenyas dunkaanicha fudhatanii biyya saba Waaqni isaan duraa ariʼee baase sanaatti Iyyaasuu wajjin galan; dunkaanni sun hamma bara Daawitiitti biyya sana ture.
english: which also our fathers, in their turn, brought in with Joshua when they entered into the possession of the nations whom God drove out before the face of our fathers to the days of David,

kikuyu: Daawitis fuula Waaqaa duratti fudhatama argatee Waaqa Yaaqoobiitiif mana jireenyaa ijaaruuf kadhate.
english: who found favor in the sight of God, and asked to find a habitation for the God of Jacob.

kikuyu: Garuu kan mana sana ijaareef Solomoon ture.
english: But Solomon built him a house.

kikuyu: “Taʼus Waaqni Waan Hundaa Olii mana harki namaa ijaare keessa hin jiraatu; kunis akkuma raajichi akkana jedhee dubbatee dha:
english: However, the Most High doesn’t dwell in temples made with hands, as the prophet says,

kikuyu: “ ‘Samiin teessoo koo ti; laftis ejjeta miilla kootii ti. Yoos isin mana akkamii naaf ijaartu ree? jedha Gooftaan. Yookaan lafti boqonnaa kootii eessa taʼa?
english: ‘heaven is my throne, and the earth a footstool for my feet. What kind of house will you build me?’ says the Lord. ‘Or what is the place of my rest?

kikuyu: Waan kana hunda harki koo hin hojjennee?’
english: Didn’t my hand make all these things?’

kikuyu: “Yaa namoota mata jabeeyyii nana! garaan keessan hin amanu; gurri keessanis hin dhagaʼu! Isin yeroo hunda Hafuura Qulqulluun mormitu; akkuma abbootiin keessan godhan sana isinis gootu.
english: “You stiff-necked and uncircumcised in heart and ears, you always resist the Holy Spirit! As your fathers did, so you do.

kikuyu: Raajiin abbootiin keessan hin ariʼatin tokko iyyuu jiraa? Isaan warra duraan dursanii dhufaatii isa qajeelaa sanaa himan illee ni ajjeesan; isinis amma isa dabarsitanii kennitanii ajjeeftaniirtu;
english: Which of the prophets didn’t your fathers persecute? They killed those who foretold the coming of the Righteous One, of whom you have now become betrayers and murderers.

kikuyu: warri karaa ergamoota Waaqaatiin seera fudhattanii seera sanaaf ajajamuu diddanis isinuma.”
english: You received the law as it was ordained by angels, and didn’t keep it!”

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti aariin guggubatanii isatti ciniinnatan.
english: Now when they heard these things, they were cut to the heart, and they gnashed at him with their teeth.

kikuyu: Isxifaanos garuu Hafuura Qulqulluun guutamee gara samii ol ilaalee ulfina Waaqaatii fi Yesuusinis isaa mirga Waaqaa dhaabatee jiru arge.
english: But he, being full of the Holy Spirit, looked up steadfastly into heaven and saw the glory of God, and Jesus standing on the right hand of God,

kikuyu: Innis, “Ani kunoo samiin banamee, Ilma Namaas isaa mirga Waaqaa dhaabatee jiru nan arga” jedhe.
english: and said, “Behold, I see the heavens opened and the Son of Man standing at the right hand of God!”

kikuyu: Kana irratti isaan hundi gurra isaanii qabatanii sagalee guddaan iyyaa isatti girrisan.
english: But they cried out with a loud voice and stopped their ears, then rushed at him with one accord.

kikuyu: Magaalaa keessaas gad isa baasanii dhagaan isa tumuu jalqaban. Yeroo sana dhuga baatonni uffata isaanii miilla dargaggeessa Saaʼol jedhamu tokkoo jala kaaʼatan.
english: They threw him out of the city and stoned him. The witnesses placed their garments at the feet of a young man named Saul.

kikuyu: Isxifaanosis utuu isaan dhagaan isa tumaa jiranuu, “Yaa Gooftaa Yesuus, hafuura koo fudhadhu” jedhee kadhate.
english: They stoned Stephen as he called out, saying, “Lord Jesus, receive my spirit!”

kikuyu: Jilbeenfatees sagalee guddaadhaan, “Yaa Gooftaa, cubbuu kana isaanitti hin lakkaaʼin!” jedhee iyye; innis erga waan kana dubbatee booddee ni duʼe.
english: He kneeled down and cried with a loud voice, “Lord, don’t hold this sin against them!” When he had said this, he fell asleep.

kikuyu: Saaʼolis ajjeefamuu Isxifaanos irratti namootaan walii galee ture. Guyyuma sana waldaa Kiristaanaa ishee Yerusaalem jirtutti ariʼatamni guddaan kaʼe; ergamoota malee warri kaan hundinuu biyya Yihuudaatii fi Samaariyaa hunda keessa bibittinnaaʼan.
english: Saul was consenting to his death. A great persecution arose against the assembly which was in Jerusalem in that day. They were all scattered abroad throughout the regions of Judea and Samaria, except for the apostles.

kikuyu: Namoonni Waaqa sodaatanis Isxifaanosin awwaalan; booʼicha guddaas booʼaniif.
english: Devout men buried Stephen and lamented greatly over him.

kikuyu: Saaʼol garuu waldaa kiristaanaa balleessuu jalqabe; innis mana tokko irraa gara mana biraa dhaqee dhiiraa fi dubartii lafa irra harkisee mana hidhaatti galchaa ture.
english: But Saul ravaged the assembly, entering into every house and dragged both men and women off to prison.

kikuyu: Warri bittinnaaʼan sun lafa dhaqan hundatti dubbii sana lallaban.
english: Therefore those who were scattered abroad went around preaching the word.

kikuyu: Fiiliphoosis gara magaalaa Samaariyaa tokkootti gad buʼee achitti Kiristoos lallabe.
english: Philip went down to the city of Samaria and proclaimed to them the Christ.

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis yommuu waan Fiiliphoos dubbatu dhagaʼanii dinqii inni hojjetu arganitti hundi isaanii qalbeeffatanii isa dhagaʼan.
english: The multitudes listened with one accord to the things that were spoken by Philip when they heard and saw the signs which he did.

kikuyu: Hafuurri xuraaʼaanis sagalee guddaan iyyee nama hedduu keessaa baʼe; warri laamshaʼanii fi warri naafatan baayʼeenis ni fayyan.
english: For unclean spirits came out of many of those who had them. They came out, crying with a loud voice. Many who had been paralyzed and lame were healed.

kikuyu: Kanaafis gammachuu guddaatu magaalaa sana keessatti taʼe.
english: There was great joy in that city.

kikuyu: Garuu yeroo sanaan dura namichi Simoon jedhamu tokko magaalaa sana keessatti falfala hojjetee namoota Samaariyaa hunda dinqisiisaa ture; innis akka waan nama guddaa taʼeetti of hedaa ture.
english: But there was a certain man, Simon by name, who used to practice sorcery in the city and amazed the people of Samaria, making himself out to be some great one,

kikuyu: Namoonni hundinuu xinnaa guddaan qalbii isaanii gara isaatti deebifatanii, “Namichi kun humna Waaqaa isa ‘humna guddaa’ jedhamu sanaa dha” jedhanii isa saadan.
english: to whom they all listened, from the least to the greatest, saying, “This man is that great power of God.”

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis sababii inni yeroo dheeraa falfala isaatiin isaan dinqisiiseef qalbii isaanii gara isaatti deebifatan.
english: They listened to him because for a long time he had amazed them with his sorceries.

kikuyu: Garuu yommuu Fiiliphoos wangeela waaʼee mootummaa Waaqaatii fi maqaa Yesuus Kiristoos lallabetti amananii dhiiraa dubartiin cuuphaman.
english: But when they believed Philip preaching good news concerning God’s Kingdom and the name of Jesus Christ, they were baptized, both men and women.

kikuyu: Simoon mataan isaa iyyuu amanee cuuphame. Innis mallattoo fi dinqii arge sana dinqifachaa Fiiliphoos wajjin deeme.
english: Simon himself also believed. Being baptized, he continued with Philip. Seeing signs and great miracles occurring, he was amazed.

kikuyu: Ergamoonni Yerusaalem turan akka warri Samaariyaa dubbii Waaqaa fudhatan dhagaʼanii Phexrosii fi Yohannisin isaanitti ergan.
english: Now when the apostles who were at Jerusalem heard that Samaria had received the word of God, they sent Peter and John to them,

kikuyu: Ergamoonni sunis yommuu achi gaʼanitti akka isaan Hafuura Qulqulluu argataniif ni kadhataniif;
english: who, when they had come down, prayed for them, that they might receive the Holy Spirit;

kikuyu: Hafuuri Qulqulluun isaan keessaa nama tokko irra illee hin buune tureetii; isaan maqaa Gooftaa Yesuus qofaan cuuphamanii turan.
english: for as yet he had fallen on none of them. They had only been baptized in the name of Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Phexrosii fi Yohannis harka isaanii jara sana irra kakaaʼan; isaanis Hafuura Qulqulluu argatan.
english: Then they laid their hands on them, and they received the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Simoon falfaltichis akka yeroo ergamoonni harka isaanii nama irra kaaʼan Hafuurri Qulqulluun namaa kennamu arginaan ergamootaaf horii kennee,
english: Now when Simon saw that the Holy Spirit was given through the laying on of the apostles’ hands, he offered them money,

kikuyu: “Akka namni ani harka irra kaaʼu hundi Hafuura Qulqulluu argatuuf dandeettii kana anaaf illee kennaa” jedheen.
english: saying, “Give me also this power, that whomever I lay my hands on may receive the Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Phexros garuu akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Sababii ati kennaa Waaqaa waan horiin bitachuu dandeessu seeteef horiin kee suma wajjin haa badu!
english: But Peter said to him, “May your silver perish with you, because you thought you could obtain the gift of God with money!

kikuyu: Garaan kee fuula Waaqaa duratti waan qajeelaa hin taʼiniif ati tajaajila kana keessatti qooda yookaan carraa hin qabdu.
english: You have neither part nor lot in this matter, for your heart isn’t right before God.

kikuyu: Kanaaf hammina kee kana irraa deebiʼiitii gooftaa kadhadhu; inni yaada garaa keetii kana siif dhiisa taʼaatii.
english: Repent therefore of this, your wickedness, and ask God if perhaps the thought of your heart may be forgiven you.

kikuyu: Ani akka ati yaada hadhaaʼaan guutamtee fi akka ati garbicha cubbuu taate nan arga.”
english: For I see that you are in the poison of bitterness and in the bondage of iniquity.”

kikuyu: Simoonis, “Akka wanni isin jettan kun tokko iyyuu narra hin geenyeef Gooftaa naa kadhadhaa” jedhee deebise.
english: Simon answered, “Pray for me to the Lord, that none of the things which you have spoken happen to me.”

kikuyu: Phexrosii fi Yohannis erga dhugaa baʼanii dubbii Gooftaas labsanii booddee gandoota Samaariyaa hedduu keessatti wangeela lallabaa Yerusaalemitti deebiʼan.
english: They therefore, when they had testified and spoken the word of the Lord, returned to Jerusalem, and preached the Good News to many villages of the Samaritans.

kikuyu: Ergamaan Gooftaa tokko Fiiliphoosiin, “Kaʼiitii karaa Kibbaatiin gara daandii Yerusaalemii baʼee Gaazaatti gad buʼu sanaa dhaqi” jedhe; daandiin sunis daandii gammoojjii ti.
english: Then an angel of the Lord spoke to Philip, saying, “Arise, and go toward the south to the way that goes down from Jerusalem to Gaza. This is a desert.”

kikuyu: Innis kaʼee deeme; karaa isaa irrattis xuʼaashii Itoophiyaa tokko jechuunis qondaalticha Kandakee mootittii saba Itoophiyaa kan qabeenya ishee hunda irratti itti gaafatamaa taʼe arge; qondaalli sun sagaduuf jedhee Yerusaalem dhaqee ture.
english: He arose and went; and behold, there was a man of Ethiopia, a eunuch of great authority under Candace, queen of the Ethiopians, who was over all her treasure, who had come to Jerusalem to worship.

kikuyu: Innis yeroo biyya isaatti deebiʼu gaarii isaa irra taaʼee kitaaba Isaayyaas raajichaa dubbifachaa ture.
english: He was returning and sitting in his chariot, and was reading the prophet Isaiah.

kikuyu: Hafuurri Qulqulluunis Fiiliphoosiin, “Dhaqiitii gaarii sanatti dhiʼaadhu” jedhe.
english: The Spirit said to Philip, “Go near, and join yourself to this chariot.”

kikuyu: Fiiliphoosis gaarii sanatti fiigee utuu namichi sun kitaaba Isaayyaas raajichaa dubbifatuu dhagaʼee, “Ati waan dubbiftu kana ni hubattaa?” jedhee gaafate.
english: Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”

kikuyu: Namichis, “Yoo namni naa hin ibsin ani akkamiin hubachuu dandaʼa?” jedhe. Innis akka Fiiliphoos ol baʼee isa bira taaʼuuf waammate.
english: He said, “How can I, unless someone explains it to me?” He begged Philip to come up and sit with him.

kikuyu: Kutaan kitaabaa kan xuʼaashiin sun dubbisaa ture isa kana: “Inni akkuma hoolaa iddoo qalmaatti geeffamee, yookaan akkuma ilmoo hoolaa kan fuula nama rifeensa irraa murmuruu duratti calʼisuu akkasuma afaan isaa hin saaqqanne.
english: Now the passage of the Scripture which he was reading was this, “He was led as a sheep to the slaughter. As a lamb before his shearer is silent, so he doesn’t open his mouth.

kikuyu: Inni cunqurfamuu isaatiin murtii qajeelaa dhowwatame; eenyutu waaʼee sanyii isaa dubbachuu dandaʼa? Jireenyi isaa lafa irraa fudhatameeraatii.”
english: In his humiliation, his judgment was taken away. Who will declare His generation? For his life is taken from the earth.”

kikuyu: Xuʼaashiin sunis Fiiliphoosiin, “Raajiin sun waaʼee eenyuu dubbata? Waaʼee mataa isaa moo waaʼee nama biraa ti? Maaloo mee natti himi!” jedhee gaafate.
english: The eunuch answered Philip, “Who is the prophet talking about? About himself, or about someone else?”

kikuyu: Fiiliphoosis kutaadhuma kitaabaa sanaan afaan saaqatee oduu gaarii waaʼee Yesuus isatti hime.
english: Philip opened his mouth, and beginning from this Scripture, preached to him about Jesus.

kikuyu: Isaanis utuu karaa deemanuu bishaanitti baʼan; xuʼaashiin sunis, “Kunoo bishaan as jira; yoos maaltu cuuphamuu na dhowwa ree?” jedheen. [
english: As they went on the way, they came to some water; and the eunuch said, “Behold, here is water. What is keeping me from being baptized?”

kikuyu: Innis akka gaariin sun dhaabatu ajaje; isaan lamaanuu dhaqanii bishaan seenan; Fiiliphoosis isa cuuphe.
english: He commanded the chariot to stand still, and they both went down into the water, both Philip and the eunuch, and he baptized him.

kikuyu: Yommuu isaan bishaan keessaa baʼanittis Hafuurri Gooftaa Fiiliphoosin fudhate; xuʼaashiin sunis ergasii isa hin argine; garuu gammadaa karaa isaa itti fufe.
english: When they came up out of the water, the Spirit of the Lord caught Philip away, and the eunuch didn’t see him any more, for he went on his way rejoicing.

kikuyu: Fiiliphoos immoo Azooxoonitti argame; innis hamma Qiisaariyaa gaʼutti magaalaawwan hunda keessatti wangeela lallabaa darbe.
english: But Philip was found at Azotus. Passing through, he preached the Good News to all the cities until he came to Caesarea.

kikuyu: Gidduudhuma sana Saaʼol barattoota Gooftaa ajjeesuuf dhaadachaa gara luba ol aanaa dhaqee,
english: But Saul, still breathing threats and slaughter against the disciples of the Lord, went to the high priest

kikuyu: nama karaa kana irra jiru kam iyyuu dhiiras dubartiis yoo argate akka hidhee Yerusaalemitti geessuuf akka lubni sun gara manneen sagadaa kanneen Damaasqoo jiraniitti xalayaawwan isaaf barreessuuf isa kadhate.
english: and asked for letters from him to the synagogues of Damascus, that if he found any who were of the Way, whether men or women, he might bring them bound to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Utuu inni deemaa jiruu akkuma Damaasqootti dhiʼaateen akkuma tasaa ifni tokko samii irraa naannoo isaatti balaqqise.
english: As he traveled, he got close to Damascus, and suddenly a light from the sky shone around him.

kikuyu: Innis lafatti kufee sagalee, “Yaa Saaʼol, Yaa Saaʼol, ati maaliif na ariʼatta?” isaan jedhu tokko dhagaʼe.
english: He fell on the earth, and heard a voice saying to him, “Saul, Saul, why do you persecute me?”

kikuyu: Saaʼolis, “Yaa Gooftaa, ati eenyu?” jedhee gaafate. Innis akkana jedhee deebiseef; “Ani Yesuus isa ati ariʼattuu dha. Arfii wayii dhiituun suma miidha.
english: He said, “Who are you, Lord?” The Lord said, “I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

kikuyu: Amma kaʼii magaalaa seeni; wanni ati gootu sitti himamaatii” jedheen.
english: But rise up and enter into the city, then you will be told what you must do.”

kikuyu: Namoonni Saaʼol wajjin deemaa turanis waan dubbatan dhabanii dhadhaabatan; isaanis sagalee dhagaʼan malee nama tokko illee hin argine.
english: The men who traveled with him stood speechless, hearing the sound, but seeing no one.

kikuyu: Saaʼolis lafaa kaʼe; innis yommuu iji isaa banametti homaa arguu hin dandeenye; isaanis harka isaa qabanii Damaasqootti isa geessan.
english: Saul arose from the ground, and when his eyes were opened, he saw no one. They led him by the hand and brought him into Damascus.

kikuyu: Iji isaas Guyyaa sadii guutuu arguu hin dandeenye; innis homaa hin nyaanne; homaas hin dhugne.
english: He was without sight for three days, and neither ate nor drank.

kikuyu: Damaasqoo keessa barataa Anaaniyaas jedhamu tokkotu ture. Gooftaanis mulʼataan, “Yaa Anaaniyaas!” jedhee isa waame. Innis, “Yaa Gooftaa, kunoo ani asin jira” jedhee deebise.
english: Now there was a certain disciple at Damascus named Ananias. The Lord said to him in a vision, “Ananias!” He said, “Behold, it’s me, Lord.”

kikuyu: Gooftaanis akkana jedheen; “Kaʼii gara daandii ‘Qajeelaa’ jedhamu sanaa mana Yihuudaa dhaqiitii nama Saaʼol jedhamu kan Xarseesii dhufe tokko iyyaafadhu; inni kadhannaa irra jiraatii.
english: The Lord said to him, “Arise and go to the street which is called Straight, and inquire in the house of Judah for one named Saul, a man of Tarsus. For behold, he is praying,

kikuyu: Saaʼolis nama Anaaniyaas jedhamu tokko isaa dhufee akka agartuun isaa deebiʼuufiif harka isa irra kaaʼu mulʼataan arge.”
english: and in a vision he has seen a man named Ananias coming in and laying his hands on him, that he might receive his sight.”

kikuyu: Anaaniyaasis deebisee akkana jedhe; “Yaa Gooftaa, ani waaʼee namicha kanaa, miidhaa inni qulqulloota kee warra Yerusaalem jiraatan irratti hojjete hundumaa dhagaʼeera.
english: But Ananias answered, “Lord, I have heard from many about this man, how much evil he did to your saints at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Ammas warra maqaa kee waammatan hunda hidhuuf jedhee luboota hangafoota irraa aangoo fudhatee dhufeera.”
english: Here he has authority from the chief priests to bind all who call on your name.”

kikuyu: Gooftaan garuu Anaaniyaasiin akkana jedhe; “Namichi kun miʼa koo kan ani akka inni namoota Ormaatii fi mootota isaanii duratti, saba Israaʼel durattis maqaa koo baatuuf jedhee filadhe waan taʼeef kaʼii dhaqi!
english: But the Lord said to him, “Go your way, for he is my chosen vessel to bear my name before the nations and kings, and the children of Israel.

kikuyu: Ani akka inni maqaa kootiif jedhee rakkachuu qabu isattin argisiisa.”
english: For I will show him how many things he must suffer for my name’s sake.”

kikuyu: Anaaniyaasis dhaqee mana sana seene. Harka isaas Saaʼol irra kaaʼee, “Yaa obboleessa koo Saaʼol, Gooftaa Yesuus inni utuu ati as dhuftuu karaa irratti sitti mulʼate sun akka ati argituu fi akka ati Hafuura Qulqulluun guutamtuuf na ergeera” jedhe.
english: Ananias departed and entered into the house. Laying his hands on him, he said, “Brother Saul, the Lord, who appeared to you on the road by which you came, has sent me that you may receive your sight and be filled with the Holy Spirit.”

kikuyu: Yommusuma wanni akka qolaa ija Saaʼol irraa harcaʼe; inni ammas arguu dandaʼe. Kaʼees cuuphame.
english: Immediately something like scales fell from his eyes, and he received his sight. He arose and was baptized.

kikuyu: Nyaatas nyaatee jajjabaate. Saaʼol bultii gabaabduudhaaf barattoota Damaasqoo jiran bira bubbule.
english: He took food and was strengthened. Saul stayed several days with the disciples who were at Damascus.

kikuyu: Innis akka Yesuus ilma Waaqaa taʼe yeruma sana manneen sagadaa keessatti lallabuu jalqabe.
english: Immediately in the synagogues he proclaimed the Christ, that he is the Son of God.

kikuyu: Warri isa dhagaʼan hundinuus dinqifatanii akkana jedhan; “Namichi kun isuma Yerusaalem keessatti warra maqaa kana waammatan balleesse sana mitii? Ammas hidhee luboota hangafootatti isaan geessuuf dhufe mitii?”
english: All who heard him were amazed, and said, “Isn’t this he who in Jerusalem made havoc of those who called on this name? And he had come here intending to bring them bound before the chief priests!”

kikuyu: Saaʼol garuu ittuma jabaachaa deeme; innis akka Yesuus kun Kiristoos taʼe mirkaneessuudhaan Yihuudoota Damaasqoo keessa jiraatan afaan qabachiise.
english: But Saul increased more in strength, and confounded the Jews who lived at Damascus, proving that this is the Christ.

kikuyu: Erga guyyaan hedduun darbee booddees Yihuudoonni isa ajjeesuuf mariʼatan.
english: When many days were fulfilled, the Jews conspired together to kill him,

kikuyu: Saaʼol garuu marii isaanii kana beeke; isaanis isa ajjeesuuf jedhanii halkanii guyyaa balbala magaalaa sanaa jabeessanii eegaa turan.
english: but their plot became known to Saul. They watched the gates both day and night that they might kill him,

kikuyu: Barattoonni isaa garuu halkaniin fuudhanii guuboodhaan dallaa irraan dabarsanii gad isa buusan.
english: but his disciples took him by night and let him down through the wall, lowering him in a basket.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu gara Yerusaalem dhufetti barattootatti dabalamuu yaale; isaanis waan barataa taʼuu isaa hin amaniniif hundi isaanii isa sodaatan.
english: When Saul had come to Jerusalem, he tried to join himself to the disciples; but they were all afraid of him, not believing that he was a disciple.

kikuyu: Barnaabaas immoo fuudhee ergamootatti isa geesse; akka Saaʼol itti karaatti gooftaa arge, akka itti gooftaan isatti dubbatee fi akka inni sodaa malee Damaasqoo keessatti maqaa Yesuusiitiin lallabe isaanitti hime.
english: But Barnabas took him and brought him to the apostles, and declared to them how he had seen the Lord on the way, and that he had spoken to him, and how at Damascus he had preached boldly in the name of Jesus.

kikuyu: Saaʼolis isaan wajjin jiraatee Yerusaalem keessa sodaa malee baʼee galaa ture; maqaa Gooftaatiinis ija jabinaan lallabe.
english: He was with them entering into Jerusalem,

kikuyu: Yihuudoota Giriikota keessa jiraatan wajjinis dubbachaa isaaniinis morkachaa ture; isaan garuu isa ajjeesuu barbaadan.
english: preaching boldly in the name of the Lord Jesus. He spoke and disputed against the Hellenists, but they were seeking to kill him.

kikuyu: Obboloonnis yommuu waan kana beekanitti fuudhanii Qiisaariyaatti gad isa buusan; gara Xarsees isa ergan.
english: When the brothers knew it, they brought him down to Caesarea and sent him off to Tarsus.

kikuyu: Kanaafis waldaan kiristaanaa Yihuudaa, Galiilaa fi Samaariyaa keessa jirtu guutummaatti nagaa argatte; ni cimtes. Isheenis Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan jajjabaatee sodaa Gooftaatiin jiraachuudhaan baayʼinaan guddachaa deemte.
english: So the assemblies throughout all Judea, Galilee, and Samaria had peace and were built up. They were multiplied, walking in the fear of the Lord and in the comfort of the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Phexros utuu biyya sana keessa naannaʼaa jiruu qulqulloota Liidaa keessa jiraatan ilaaluuf gad buʼe.
english: As Peter went throughout all those parts, he came down also to the saints who lived at Lydda.

kikuyu: Achittis namicha laamshaʼaa Eeniyaa jedhamu kan waggaa saddeeti siree irratti hafee ture tokko arge.
english: There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years because he was paralyzed.

kikuyu: Phexrosis, “Yaa Eeniyaa, Yesuus Kiristoos si fayyisa; kaʼiitii siree kee afadhu” jedheen. Eeniyaanis yommusuma kaʼe.
english: Peter said to him, “Aeneas, Jesus Christ heals you. Get up and make your bed!” Immediately he arose.

kikuyu: Namoonni Liidaa fi Shaaroon keessa jiraatan hundinuu isa arganii Gooftaatti deebiʼan.
english: All who lived at Lydda and in Sharon saw him, and they turned to the Lord.

kikuyu: Yoophee keessas barattuu Xaabiitaa jedhamtu tokkotu ture; Xaabiitaa jechuun Doorqaa jechuu dha. Isheenis yeroo hunda waan gaarii hojjetti; hiyyeeyyiis ni gargaarti turte.
english: Now there was at Joppa a certain disciple named Tabitha, which when translated means Dorcas. This woman was full of good works and acts of mercy which she did.

kikuyu: Isheenis baruma sana keessa dhukkubsattee duute; reeffa ishees dhiqanii kutaa darbii tokko keessa kaaʼan.
english: In those days, she became sick and died. When they had washed her, they laid her in an upper room.

kikuyu: Liidaan kun Yoopheetti dhiʼoo turte; barattoonnis yommuu akka Phexros Liidaa jiru dhagaʼanitti nama lama isatti erganii, “Maaloo dafii nu bira gaʼi!” jedhanii isa kadhatan.
english: As Lydda was near Joppa, the disciples, hearing that Peter was there, sent two men to him, imploring him not to delay in coming to them.

kikuyu: Phexrosis kaʼee isaan wajjin deeme; akkuma inni achi gaʼeenis gara kutaa darbii sanaatti isa geessan. Haadhonni hiyyeessaa hundinuu isa bira dhaabatanii kootii fi wayyaa biraa kan Doorqaan yeroo isaan wajjin turte hojjette sana isatti argisiisanii booʼaa turan.
english: Peter got up and went with them. When he had come, they brought him into the upper room. All the widows stood by him weeping, and showing the tunics and other garments which Dorcas had made while she was with them.

kikuyu: Phexrosis hunda isaanii gad baasee jilbeenfatee Waaqa kadhate; reeffa sanattis garagalee, “Xaabiitaa kaʼi!” jedhe. Isheenis ija ishee banattee Phexrosin argite; kaatees ni teesse.
english: Peter sent them all out, and knelt down and prayed. Turning to the body, he said, “Tabitha, get up!” She opened her eyes, and when she saw Peter, she sat up.

kikuyu: Innis harka qabee ishee kaase; amantootaa fi haadhota hiyyeessaa waamee jiraattuu taatee isaan fuuldura dhaabe.
english: He gave her his hand and raised her up. Calling the saints and widows, he presented her alive.

kikuyu: Kunis Yoophee hunda keessatti beekame; namoonni baayʼeenis Gooftaatti amanan.
english: This became known throughout all Joppa, and many believed in the Lord.

kikuyu: Phexrosis Yoophee keessa gogaa duugduu Simoon jedhamu tokko bira guyyaa hedduu ture.
english: He stayed many days in Joppa with a tanner named Simon.

kikuyu: Namichi Qorneelewoos jedhamu tokko Qiisaariyaa keessa ture; innis kutaa, “Humna waraana Iixaaliyaa” jedhamu keessatti ajajaa dhibbaa ture.
english: Now there was a certain man in Caesarea, Cornelius by name, a centurion of what was called the Italian Regiment,

kikuyu: Qorneelewoosii fi maatiin isaa hundinuu warra Waaqaaf bulanii fi warra Waaqa sodaatan turan; innis warra rakkataniif arjummaadhaan kenna ture; yeroo hundas Waaqa kadhata ture.
english: a devout man, and one who feared God with all his house, who gave gifts for the needy generously to the people, and always prayed to God.

kikuyu: Innis gaafa tokko ergamaa Waaqaa tokko isaa gara isaa dhufee, “Yaa Qorneelewoos!” jedhuun guyyaa keessaa gara saʼaatii sagaliitti ifaan ifatti mulʼataan arge.
english: At about the ninth hour of the day, he clearly saw in a vision an angel of God coming to him and saying to him, “Cornelius!”

kikuyu: Qorneelewoosis sodaan ija babaasee isa ilaalee, “Yaa Gooftaa, maal barbaadda?” jedhee gaafate. Ergamaan Waaqaa sun immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Kadhannaa keetii fi kennaan ati hiyyeeyyiidhaaf kennitu aarsaa yaadachaa taʼee fuula Waaqaa duratti ol baʼeera.
english: He, fastening his eyes on him and being frightened, said, “What is it, Lord?” He said to him, “Your prayers and your gifts to the needy have gone up for a memorial before God.

kikuyu: Amma Yoopheetti nama ergiitii Simoon isa Phexros jedhamu sana as fichisiisi.
english: Now send men to Joppa, and get Simon, who is also called Peter.

kikuyu: Innis namicha gogaa duugu kan Simoon jedhamu kan manni isaa qarqara galaanaatti argamu tokko bira jira.”
english: He is staying with a tanner named Simon, whose house is by the seaside.

kikuyu: Qorneelewoosis yommuu ergamaan Waaqaa kan isatti dubbate sun deemetti tajaajiltoota isaa keessaa nama lama, warra isa eegan keessaa immoo loltuu Waaqaaf bulu tokko waamee,
english: When the angel who spoke to him had departed, Cornelius called two of his household servants and a devout soldier of those who waited on him continually.

kikuyu: waan kana hunda itti himee Yoopheetti isaan erge.
english: Having explained everything to them, he sent them to Joppa.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanuttis utuu warri ergaman sun karaa jiranuu, yeroo isaan magaalaatti dhiʼaatanitti Phexros gara saʼaatii jaʼaatti kadhannaaf bantii manaatti ol baʼe.
english: Now on the next day as they were on their journey and got close to the city, Peter went up on the housetop to pray at about noon.

kikuyu: Innis beelaʼee waan nyaatu barbaade; utuu isaan qopheessaafii jiranuus akka waan yaadaan fudhatamee taʼe.
english: He became hungry and desired to eat, but while they were preparing, he fell into a trance.

kikuyu: Samii banamee fi waan akka wayyaa balʼaa tokkos isaa roga isaa afraniin qabamee lafatti gad buufamu arge.
english: He saw heaven opened and a certain container descending to him, like a great sheet let down by four corners on the earth,

kikuyu: Wayyaan sunis bineensota miilla afurii, uumamawwan lafa irra looʼanii fi simbirroota samii kanneen gosa hundaa of keessaa qaba ture.
english: in which were all kinds of four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, reptiles, and birds of the sky.

kikuyu: Sagaleen tokkos, “Yaa Phexros, kaʼiitii qaladhuu nyaadhu” jedheen.
english: A voice came to him, “Rise, Peter, kill and eat!”

kikuyu: Phexros garuu deebisee, “Yaa Gooftaa, hin taʼu! Ani takkumaa waan balfamaa yookaan waan xuraaʼaa hin nyaanne” jedhe.
english: But Peter said, “Not so, Lord; for I have never eaten anything that is common or unclean.”

kikuyu: Sagaleen sunis yeroo lammaffaa, “Ati waan Waaqni qulqulleesseen xuraaʼaa hin jedhin” jedheen.
english: A voice came to him again the second time, “What God has cleansed, you must not call unclean.”

kikuyu: Wanni kunis yeroo sadii taʼe; wayyaan sunis yommusuma deebiʼee samiitti ol fudhatame.
english: This was done three times, and immediately the thing was received up into heaven.

kikuyu: Utuu Phexros waaʼee hiikkaa mulʼata sanaa dinqisiifachaa jiruus namoonni Qorneelewoos erge sun mana Simoon iyyaafachaa dhufanii karra dura dhaabatan.
english: Now while Peter was very perplexed in himself what the vision which he had seen might mean, behold, the men who were sent by Cornelius, having made inquiry for Simon’s house, stood before the gate,

kikuyu: Isaanis lallabanii, “Simoon inni Phexros jedhamu tokko as jiraa?” jedhanii gaafatan.
english: and called and asked whether Simon, who was also called Peter, was lodging there.

kikuyu: Ammas utuu Phexros waaʼee mulʼata sanaa yaadaa jiruu, Hafuurri Qulqulluun akkana isaan jedhe; “Yaa Simoon, kunoo namoonni sadii si barbaaduutti jiru.
english: While Peter was pondering the vision, the Spirit said to him, “Behold, three men seek you.

kikuyu: Kaʼiitii gad buʼi. Isaan wajjin deemuus hin shakkin; anatu isaan ergeetii.”
english: But arise, get down, and go with them, doubting nothing; for I have sent them.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis gara namoota sanaatti gad buʼee, “Namni isin barbaadaa jirtan ana; maaliif dhuftani?” jedheen.
english: Peter went down to the men, and said, “Behold, I am he whom you seek. Why have you come?”

kikuyu: Jarri sunis akkana jedhanii deebisan; “Nu ajajaa dhibbaa kan Qorneelewoos jedhamu tokko biraa dhufne; inni nama qajeelaa fi nama Waaqa sodaatu kan Yihuudoota hunda birattis kabajamuu dha; ergamaan Waaqaa qulqulluun tokko akka inni mana isaatti si waamsisee waan ati jettu dhagaʼuuf isatti dubbate.”
english: They said, “Cornelius, a centurion, a righteous man and one who fears God, and well spoken of by all the nation of the Jews, was directed by a holy angel to invite you to his house, and to listen to what you say.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis namoota sana manatti ol galchee keessumsiise. Guyyaa itti aanutti Phexros kaʼee isaan wajjin deeme; obboloonni tokko tokkos Yoopheedhaa kaʼanii isa wajjin deeman.
english: So he called them in and provided a place to stay. On the next day Peter arose and went out with them, and some of the brothers from Joppa accompanied him.

kikuyu: Isaanis guyyaa itti aanu Qiisaariyaatti galan; Qorneelewoosis firoota isaatii fi michoota isaa warra isatti dhiʼaatan walitti waamee isaan eegaa ture.
english: On the next day they entered into Caesarea. Cornelius was waiting for them, having called together his relatives and his near friends.

kikuyu: Akkuma Phexros mana seeneen Qorneelewoos isa simatee isaaf sagaduuf jedhee miilla isaa irratti kufe.
english: When Peter entered, Cornelius met him, fell down at his feet, and worshiped him.

kikuyu: Phexros garuu, “Kaʼi! Anis namumaatii” jedhee ol isa qabe.
english: But Peter raised him up, saying, “Stand up! I myself am also a man.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis isa wajjin dudubbachaa mana seenee namoota walitti qabaman hedduu arge.
english: As he talked with him, he went in and found many gathered together.

kikuyu: Innis akkana isaaniin jedhe; “Akka Yihuudiin tokko nama ormaa wajjin tokkummaa qabaachuu fi itti dhiʼaachuun seera keenya hin taʼin isin mataan keessan iyyuu beektu; garuu Waaqni akka ani nama tokkoonuu jibbamaa yookaan xuraaʼaa hin jenne natti argisiiseera.
english: He said to them, “You yourselves know how it is an unlawful thing for a man who is a Jew to join himself or come to one of another nation, but God has shown me that I shouldn’t call any man unholy or unclean.

kikuyu: Kanaaf yommuu isin nama natti ergitanitti ani mormii tokko malee dhufe; egaa waan isin na waamtaniif beekuu nan barbaada.”
english: Therefore I also came without complaint when I was sent for. I ask therefore, why did you send for me?”

kikuyu: Qorneelewoosis akkana jedhee deebise: “Bultii afuriin dura, saʼaatiidhuma kanatti, ani saʼaatii sagalitti mana kootti kadhachaan ture. Akkuma tasaa namichi wayyaa adii qaanqee uffatu tokko na dura dhaabatee
english: Cornelius said, “Four days ago, I was fasting until this hour; and at the ninth hour, I prayed in my house, and behold, a man stood before me in bright clothing

kikuyu: akkana jedhe; ‘Yaa Qorneelewoos, Waaqni kadhannaa kee dhagaʼeera; kennaa ati hiyyeeyyiif kennitus yaadateera.
english: and said, ‘Cornelius, your prayer is heard, and your gifts to the needy are remembered in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Yoopheetti nama ergiitii Simoon isa Phexros jedhamu sana waamsisi. Inni mana Simoon namicha gogaa duugu kan qarqara galaanaa jiraatu sanaa jira.’
english: Send therefore to Joppa and summon Simon, who is also called Peter. He is staying in the house of a tanner named Simon, by the seaside. When he comes, he will speak to you.’

kikuyu: Kanaaf ani yeruma sana nama ergeen si waamsise; atis baga dhufte. Egaa nu hundinuu waan akka ati nutti himtu Gooftaan si ajaje hunda dhagaʼuuf jennee as fuula Waaqaa dura jirra.”
english: Therefore I sent to you at once, and it was good of you to come. Now therefore we are all here present in the sight of God to hear all things that have been commanded you by God.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis akkana jedhee dubbachuu jalqabe; “Ani amma akka Waaqni nama Wal hin caalchifne dhugumaan nan hubadha.
english: Peter opened his mouth and said, “Truly I perceive that God doesn’t show favoritism;

kikuyu: Garuu saba hundumaa keessaa namni isa sodaatuu fi namni waan qajeelaa hojjetu kam iyyuu fuula isaa duratti fudhatamaa dha.
english: but in every nation he who fears him and works righteousness is acceptable to him.

kikuyu: Isin ergaa Waaqni karaa Yesuus Kiristoosiin nagaa labsuudhaan saba Israaʼelitti erge sana beektu; Yesuus Kiristoos kun Gooftaa waan hundaa ti.
english: The word which he sent to the children of Israel, preaching good news of peace by Jesus Christ—he is Lord of all—

kikuyu: Isin waan Cuuphaa Yohannis lallabee booddee Galiilaadhaa jalqabee Yihuudaa hunda keessatti taʼe sana ni beektu.
english: you yourselves know what happened, which was proclaimed throughout all Judea, beginning from Galilee, after the baptism which John preached;

kikuyu: Kunis akka Waaqni Yesuus nama Naazreeti sana Hafuura Qulqulluu fi humnaan dibee fi akka Yesuus waan gaarii hojjechaa fi warra humna diiyaabiloos jala turan fayyisaa biyya hunda keessa nanaannaʼee dha; Waaqni isa wajjin tureetii.
english: how God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Spirit and with power, who went about doing good and healing all who were oppressed by the devil, for God was with him.

kikuyu: “Nus waan inni biyya Yihuudootaatii fi Yerusaalem keessatti hojjete hundaaf dhuga baatota. Isaanis fannoo irratti fannisanii isa ajjeesan.
english: We are witnesses of everything he did both in the country of the Jews and in Jerusalem; whom they also killed, hanging him on a tree.

kikuyu: Waaqni immoo guyyaa sadaffaatti warra duʼan keessaa isa kaase; akka inni namatti mulʼatus godhe.
english: God raised him up the third day and gave him to be revealed,

kikuyu: Inni nama hundatti hin mulʼanne; garuu nu dhuga baatota Waaqni duraan dursee filatettii fi erga inni warra duʼan keessaa kaʼee booddee isa wajjin nyaannee dhugnetti mulʼate.
english: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

kikuyu: Innis akka nu namootatti lallabnuu fi akka inni nama Waaqni warra jiranii fi warra duʼan irratti abbaa murtii godhee muude taʼe akka dhugaa baanuuf nu ajaje.
english: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.

kikuyu: Raajonni hundinuu akka namni isatti amanu hundi maqaa isaatiin dhiifama cubbuu argatu waaʼee isaa dhugaa baʼu.”
english: All the prophets testify about him, that through his name everyone who believes in him will receive remission of sins.”

kikuyu: Utuma Phexros amma illee waan kana dubbachaa jiruu, Hafuurri Qulqulluun warra dubbii sana dhagaʼaa turan hunda irra buʼe.
english: While Peter was still speaking these words, the Holy Spirit fell on all those who heard the word.

kikuyu: Amantoonni dhagna qabatan kanneen Phexros wajjin dhufan sun waan kennaan Hafuura Qulqulluu Namoota Ormaa irrati illee dhangalaʼeef ni dinqifatan;
english: They of the circumcision who believed were amazed, as many as came with Peter, because the gift of the Holy Spirit was also poured out on the Gentiles.

kikuyu: isaan jaraa afaan haaraa dubbatanii fi Waaqas jajatan dhagaʼaniiruutii. Phexrosis akkana jedhe;
english: For they heard them speaking in other languages and magnifying God. Then Peter answered,

kikuyu: “Akka namoonni akkuma keenya Hafuura Qulqulluu argatan kunneen hin cuuphamneef namni bishaan dhowwachuu dandaʼu eenyu?”
english: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

kikuyu: Innis akka isaan maqaa Yesuus Kiristoositti cuuphaman ajaje; isaanis akka Phexros bultii xinnoo isaan bira turuuf isa kadhatan.
english: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.

kikuyu: Ergamoonnii fi obboloonni Yihuudaa keessa jiran akka Namoonni Ormaas dubbii Waaqaa fudhatan dhagaʼan.
english: Now the apostles and the brothers who were in Judea heard that the Gentiles had also received the word of God.

kikuyu: Kanaaf yommuu Phexros Yerusaalemitti ol baʼetti amantoonni dhagna qabatan isaan morman;
english: When Peter had come up to Jerusalem, those who were of the circumcision contended with him,

kikuyu: akkanas jedhan; “Ati maaliif mana namoota dhagna hin qabatinii dhaqxee isaan wajjin nyaatte?”
english: saying, “You went in to uncircumcised men and ate with them!”

kikuyu: Phexrosis akkana jedhee waan taʼe sana tokko tokkoon isaanii ibsuu jalqabe.
english: But Peter began, and explained to them in order, saying,

kikuyu: “Ani magaalaa Yoophee keessatti kadhannaa irran ture; akka waan yaadaan fudhatamuus taʼee waan akka wayyaa balʼaa tokko isaa roga isaa afraniin qabamee samii irraa gad buufamu mulʼataan arge. Innis iddoo ani turetti gad dhufe.
english: “I was in the city of Joppa praying, and in a trance I saw a vision: a certain container descending, like it was a great sheet let down from heaven by four corners. It came as far as me.

kikuyu: Anis xiyyeeffadhee ilaalee bineensota miilla afurii, bineensota bosonaa, uumamawwan lafa irra looʼanii fi simbirroota samii nan arge.
english: When I had looked intently at it, I considered, and saw the four-footed animals of the earth, wild animals, creeping things, and birds of the sky.

kikuyu: Anis sagalee, ‘Yaa Phexros, kaʼiitii qaladhuu nyaadhu’ naan jedhu tokkon dhagaʼe.
english: I also heard a voice saying to me, ‘Rise, Peter, kill and eat!’

kikuyu: “Ani garuu deebisee, ‘Yaa Gooftaa, hin taʼu! Takkumaa wanni balfamaan yookaan wanni xuraaʼaan tokko iyyuu afaan koo hin seenne’ jedhe.
english: But I said, ‘Not so, Lord, for nothing unholy or unclean has ever entered into my mouth.’

kikuyu: “Sagaleen sunis yeroo lammaffaa samii irraa, ‘Ati waan Waaqni qulqulleesseen xuraaʼaa hin jedhin’ jedhe.
english: But a voice answered me the second time out of heaven, ‘What God has cleansed, don’t you call unclean.’

kikuyu: Wanni kunis yeroo sadii taʼe; kana booddees hundumti isaa amma illee samiitti ol fudhatame.
english: This was done three times, and all were drawn up again into heaven.

kikuyu: “Yommusuma namoonni Qiisaariyaadhaa natti ergaman sadii mana ani jiraachaa ture sana dura dhaabatan.
english: Behold, immediately three men stood before the house where I was, having been sent from Caesarea to me.

kikuyu: Hafuurri Qulqulluunis akka ani shakkii tokko malee isaan wajjin deemu natti hime. Obboloonni kunneen jaʼaanis na wajjin deeman; nus mana namichaa ol seenne.
english: The Spirit told me to go with them without discriminating. These six brothers also accompanied me, and we entered into the man’s house.

kikuyu: Innis akka ergamaa Waaqaa kan mana isaa keessatti itti mulʼate tokko arge nutti hime; ergamaan sunis akkana isaan jedhe; ‘Yoopheetti nama ergiitii Simoon isa Phexros jedhamu sana waamsisi;
english: He told us how he had seen the angel standing in his house and saying to him, ‘Send to Joppa and get Simon, who is called Peter,

kikuyu: inni ergaa sii fi namoonni mana keetii hundinuu ittiin fayyitan sitti hima.’
english: who will speak to you words by which you will be saved, you and all your house.’

kikuyu: “Akkuma ani dubbachuu jalqabeen, Hafuurri Qulqulluun akkuma jalqabatti nurra buʼe sana isaan irras buʼe.
english: As I began to speak, the Holy Spirit fell on them, even as on us at the beginning.

kikuyu: Anis waan Gooftaan, ‘Yohannis bishaaniin cuuphe; isin garuu Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan cuuphamtu’ jedhee ture sana nan yaadadhe.
english: I remembered the word of the Lord, how he said, ‘John indeed baptized in water, but you will be baptized in the Holy Spirit.’

kikuyu: Kanaafuu erga Waaqni kennaadhuma yeroo nu gooftaa Yesuus Kiristoositti amanne nuu kenne sana isaaniifis kennee Waaqaan mormuuf ani eenyu?”
english: If then God gave to them the same gift as us when we believed in the Lord Jesus Christ, who was I, that I could withstand God?”

kikuyu: Isaanis waan kana dhagaʼanii calʼisan; “Yoos Waaqni qalbii jijjiirratanii jiraachuu Namoota Ormaatiifis kenneera” jedhanii Waaqa galateeffatan.
english: When they heard these things, they held their peace and glorified God, saying, “Then God has also granted to the Gentiles repentance to life!”

kikuyu: Warri sababii ariʼatama Isxifaanositti kaʼeetiin bittinnaaʼanii turan sun ergaa sana Yihuudoota qofatti himaa hamma Finiiqee, Qophiroosii fi Anxookiiyaatti deeman.
english: They therefore who were scattered abroad by the oppression that arose about Stephen traveled as far as Phoenicia, Cyprus, and Antioch, speaking the word to no one except to Jews only.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa namoonni Qophiroosii fi Qareenaa irraa dhufan tokko tokko garuu Anxookiiyaa dhaqanii oduu gaarii waaʼee Gooftaa Yesuus Giriikotattis himuu jalqaban.
english: But there were some of them, men of Cyprus and Cyrene, who, when they had come to Antioch, spoke to the Hellenists, preaching the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Harki Gooftaa isaan wajjin ture; namoonni hedduunis amananii Gooftaatti deebiʼan.
english: The hand of the Lord was with them, and a great number believed and turned to the Lord.

kikuyu: Oduun kunis gurra waldaa kiristaanaa ishee Yerusaalem jirtuu seene; isaanis Barnaabaasin Anxookiiyaatti ergan.
english: The report concerning them came to the ears of the assembly which was in Jerusalem. They sent out Barnabas to go as far as Antioch,

kikuyu: Innis yommuu achi gaʼee Ayyaana Waaqaa argetti ni gammade; akka isaan garaa tokkoon Gooftaaf amanamanii jiraataniifis isaan hunda jajjabeesse.
english: who, when he had come, and had seen the grace of God, was glad. He exhorted them all, that with purpose of heart they should remain near to the Lord.

kikuyu: Inni nama gaarii Hafuura Qulqulluu fi amantiidhaan guutame ture; namoonni baayʼeenis Gooftaatti dabalaman.
english: For he was a good man, and full of the Holy Spirit and of faith, and many people were added to the Lord.

kikuyu: Barnaabaasis Saaʼolin barbaaduuf jedhee Xarsees dhaqe;
english: Barnabas went out to Tarsus to look for Saul.

kikuyu: Yommuu isa argettis Anxookiiyaatti isa geesse. Isaanis waggaa tokko guutuu waldaa sanaan wal gaʼanii namoota baayʼee barsiisan. Barattoonnis yeroo jalqabaatiif Anxookiiyaatti, “Kiristaana” jedhaman.
english: When he had found him, he brought him to Antioch. For a whole year they were gathered together with the assembly, and taught many people. The disciples were first called Christians in Antioch.

kikuyu: Gidduudhuma sana raajonni tokko tokko Yerusaalemii kaʼanii Anxookiiyaatti gad buʼan.
english: Now in these days, prophets came down from Jerusalem to Antioch.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaas namichi Agaaboos jedhamu tokko kaʼee dhaabatee akka beelli guddaan isaa addunyaa hunda irratti buʼu Hafuuraan dubbate. Wanni kunis bara moʼumsa Qilaawudewoos Qeesaar keessa taʼe.
english: One of them named Agabus stood up and indicated by the Spirit that there should be a great famine all over the world, which also happened in the days of Claudius.

kikuyu: Barattoonnis tokkoon tokkoon isaanii akkuma dandeettii isaaniitti obboloota Yihuudaa keessa jiraatan gargaaruu murteessan.
english: As any of the disciples had plenty, each determined to send relief to the brothers who lived in Judea;

kikuyu: Isaanis harka Barnaabaasii fi harka Saaʼolitti gargaarsa isaanii maanguddootaatti erguun gargaarsa kennan.
english: which they also did, sending it to the elders by the hands of Barnabas and Saul.

kikuyu: Baruma sana keessa Heroodis mootichi isaan ariʼachuuf jedhee miseensota waldaa kiristaanaa tokko tokko qabe.
english: Now about that time, King Herod stretched out his hands to oppress some of the assembly.

kikuyu: Innis Yaaqoob obboleessa Yohannis goraadeen ajjeese.
english: He killed James, the brother of John, with the sword.

kikuyu: Yommuu akka wanni kun Yihuudoota gammachiise argettis, ittuma fufee Phexrosinis qabsiise. Wanni kunis yeroo Ayyaana Maxinoo keessa taʼe.
english: When he saw that it pleased the Jews, he proceeded to seize Peter also. This was during the days of unleavened bread.

kikuyu: Erga isa qabee booddee akka isaan isa eeganiif jedhee gareewwan loltootaa afur kanneen tokkoon tokkoon isaanii loltoota afur afur of keessaa qabanitti dabarsee isa kennuudhaan, mana hidhaa keessa isa buuse; kanas ayyaana Faasiikaa booddee fuula uummataa duratti dhiʼeessee isa qoruuf godhe.
english: When he had arrested him, he put him in prison and delivered him to four squads of four soldiers each to guard him, intending to bring him out to the people after the Passover.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Phexros mana hidhaa keessatti eegamaa ture; waldaan kiristaanaa garuu jabeessitee waaʼee isaatiif Waaqa kadhachaa turte.
english: Peter therefore was kept in the prison, but constant prayer was made by the assembly to God for him.

kikuyu: Edumtii guyyaa Heroodis itti Phexrosin dhiʼeessuuf ture sanaa Phexros foncaa lamaan hidhamee loltoota lama gidduu rafaa ture; loltoonni kaanis balbala dura dhaabatanii mana hidhaa sana eegaa turan.
english: The same night when Herod was about to bring him out, Peter was sleeping between two soldiers, bound with two chains. Guards in front of the door kept the prison.

kikuyu: Akkuma tasaas, ergamaan Gooftaa tokko mulʼate; kutaa mana hidhaa sana keessattis ifni ife; ergamaan sunis cinaacha Phexros tuqee isa dammaqsuudhaan, “Dafii kaʼi!” jedheen. Foncaan sunis harka isaa irraa harcaʼe.
english: And behold, an angel of the Lord stood by him, and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up, saying, “Stand up quickly!” His chains fell off his hands.

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqaa sunis, “Uffata kee uffadhu; kophee kees kaaʼadhu” jedheen. Phexrosis akkasuma godhe. Ergamaan sunis, “Wayyaa kee marxifadhuutii na faana buʼi” jedheen.
english: The angel said to him, “Get dressed and put on your sandals.” He did so. He said to him, “Put on your cloak and follow me.”

kikuyu: Phexrosis isa duukaa buʼee mana hidhaatii baʼe; innis waan mulʼata argu seʼe malee akka wanni ergamaan Waaqaa hojjechaa ture sun dhugaa taʼe hin beekne.
english: And he went out and followed him. He didn’t know that what was being done by the angel was real, but thought he saw a vision.

kikuyu: Isaanis waardiyyaa duraatii fi isa lammaffaa bira darbanii balbala sibiilaa kan magaalaatti gad baasu bira gaʼan; balballi sunis ofumaan banameef; isaanis gad baʼanii utuu daandii tokko irra gad buʼaa jiranuu ergamaan sun isa biraa sokke.
english: When they were past the first and the second guard, they came to the iron gate that leads into the city, which opened to them by itself. They went out and went down one street, and immediately the angel departed from him.

kikuyu: Phexrosis qalbii isaatti deebiʼee, “Ani amma akka Gooftaan ergamaa isaa ergee harka Heroodisii fi waan Yihuudoonni natti yaadaa turan hunda jalaa na baase shakkii malee beekeera” jedhe.
english: When Peter had come to himself, he said, “Now I truly know that the Lord has sent out his angel and delivered me out of the hand of Herod, and from everything the Jewish people were expecting.”

kikuyu: Innis erga waan kana hubatee booddee mana Maariyaam haadha Yohannis isa Maarqos jedhamu sanaa iddoo itti namoonni baayʼeen walitti qabamanii kadhachaa turan dhaqe.
english: Thinking about that, he came to the house of Mary, the mother of John who was called Mark, where many were gathered together and were praying.

kikuyu: Yommuu Phexros balbala alaa rurrukutetti intalli hojjettuun Roodaa jedhamtu tokko ilaaluu dhufte.
english: When Peter knocked at the door of the gate, a servant girl named Rhoda came to answer.

kikuyu: Isheenis yommuu sagalee Phexros hubattetti akka malee gammadde; balbala banuu dhiiftees fiigdee ol deebitee akka Phexros balbala dura dhaabatu himte.
english: When she recognized Peter’s voice, she didn’t open the gate for joy, but ran in and reported that Peter was standing in front of the gate.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Ati maraatteerta!” jedhaniin; isheen garuu cimsitee akka wanni kun akkasuma taʼe dubbatte; isaan immoo, “Yoos ergamaa isaa ti!” jedhan.
english: They said to her, “You are crazy!” But she insisted that it was so. They said, “It is his angel.”

kikuyu: Phexros garuu ittuma fufee balbalicha rurrukute; isaanis yommuu bananitti, isa arganii dinqifatan.
english: But Peter continued knocking. When they had opened, they saw him and were amazed.

kikuyu: Phexrosis akka isaan calʼisaniif harkaan itti hime; akka itti Gooftaan mana hidhaatii isa baases isaanitti odeesse; innis, “Waan kana Yaaqoobii fi obbolootatti himaa” isaaniin jedhe; achii kaʼees lafa biraa dhaqe.
english: But he, beckoning to them with his hand to be silent, declared to them how the Lord had brought him out of the prison. He said, “Tell these things to James and to the brothers.” Then he departed and went to another place.

kikuyu: Yommuu bariʼetti raafamni guddaan isaa loltoota gidduutti uumame; isaanis, “Phexros maal taʼe?” jedhanii wal gaggaafatan.
english: Now as soon as it was day, there was no small stir among the soldiers about what had become of Peter.

kikuyu: Heroodisis cimsee barbaadee isa dhabnaan eegdota sana jabeessee qoree akka isaan ajjeefaman ajaje. Heroodis Yihuudaadhaa kaʼee Qiisaariyaatti gad buʼee xinnoo achi jiraate.
english: When Herod had sought for him and didn’t find him, he examined the guards, then commanded that they should be put to death. He went down from Judea to Caesarea, and stayed there.

kikuyu: Innis warra Xiiroosii fi Siidoonaatti akka malee aare; isaanis tajaajilaa mootichaa amanamaa Bilaasxoos jedhamu tokko michoomfatanii tokkummaan gara mootichaa dhaqanii araara kadhatan; biyyi isaanii biyya mooticha sanaa irraa midhaan nyaataa argachaa jiraatteetii.
english: Now Herod was very angry with the people of Tyre and Sidon. They came with one accord to him and, having made Blastus, the king’s personal aide, their friend, they asked for peace, because their country depended on the king’s country for food.

kikuyu: Guyyaa beellamaattis Heroodis uffata mootii uffatee teessoo isaa irra taaʼe; uummatattis dubbate.
english: On an appointed day, Herod dressed himself in royal clothing, sat on the throne, and gave a speech to them.

kikuyu: Namoonnis, “Kun sagalee Waaqaati malee sagalee namaa miti” jedhanii iyyan.
english: The people shouted, “The voice of a god, and not of a man!”

kikuyu: Heroodisis waan Waaqaaf ulfina hin kenniniif yeruma sana ergamaan Waaqaa tokko isa dhaʼe; innis raammoodhaan nyaatamee duʼe.
english: Immediately an angel of the Lord struck him, because he didn’t give God the glory. Then he was eaten by worms and died.

kikuyu: Dubbiin Waaqaa garuu ittuma fufee guddachaa, babalʼachaas deeme.
english: But the word of God grew and multiplied.

kikuyu: Barnaabaasii fi Saaʼol erga ergama isaanii fixatanii booddee Yohannis isa Maarqos jedhamu sana fudhatanii Yerusaalemii deebiʼan.
english: Barnabas and Saul returned to Jerusalem when they had fulfilled their service, also taking with them John who was called Mark.

kikuyu: Waldaa kiristaanaa Anxookiiyaa keessa Raajotaa fi barsiistotatu ture; isaanis Barnaabaas, Simiʼoon isa Niiger jedhamu, Luukiyoos nama Qareenaa, Maanaaʼen isa Heroodis bulchaa sana wajjin guddatee fi Saaʼol faʼa.
english: Now in the assembly that was at Antioch there were some prophets and teachers: Barnabas, Simeon who was called Niger, Lucius of Cyrene, Manaen the foster brother of Herod the tetrarch, and Saul.

kikuyu: Utuu isaan Gooftaa tajaajilaa, soomaas jiranuu Hafuurri Qulqulluun, “Barnaabaasii fi Saaʼolin hojii ani itti isaan waammadheef naa filaa” jedhe.
english: As they served the Lord and fasted, the Holy Spirit said, “Separate Barnabas and Saul for me, for the work to which I have called them.”

kikuyu: Kanaaf isaan erga soomanii kadhatanii booddee harka isaanii jara irra kaaʼanii isaan ergan.
english: Then, when they had fasted and prayed and laid their hands on them, they sent them away.

kikuyu: Isaan lachuu Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan ergamanii Seluuqiyaatti gad buʼan; achiis kaʼanii dooniin Qophiroos dhaqan.
english: So, being sent out by the Holy Spirit, they went down to Seleucia. From there they sailed to Cyprus.

kikuyu: Yommuu Salaamiis gaʼanittis manneen sagadaa Yihuudootaa keessatti dubbii Waaqaa lallaban; Yohannisis isaan gargaaruuf isaan bira ture.
english: When they were at Salamis, they proclaimed God’s word in the Jewish synagogues. They also had John as their attendant.

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu biyyoota bishaaniin marfaman sana hundumaa keessa baʼanii hamma Phaafoositti dhufanitti, Yihuudii falfaltichaa fi raajii sobaa kan maqaan isaa Baaryesuus jedhamu tokkotti dhufan.
english: When they had gone through the island to Paphos, they found a certain sorcerer, a false prophet, a Jew whose name was Bar Jesus,

kikuyu: Innis namicha hubataa bulchaa biyyaa taʼe kan Sergiyoos Phaawulos jedhamu tokko wajjin ture. Bulchaan sunis waan dubbii Waaqaa dhagaʼuu barbaadeef nama ergee Barnaabaasii fi Saaʼolin waamsifate.
english: who was with the proconsul, Sergius Paulus, a man of understanding. This man summoned Barnabas and Saul, and sought to hear the word of God.

kikuyu: Eliimaas falfaltichi kan hiikkaan maqaa isaa afaan Giriikiin akkasuma taʼe sun garuu bulchaa biyyaa sana amantii irraa deebisuuf jedhee isaaniin morme.
english: But Elymas the sorcerer (for so is his name by interpretation) withstood them, seeking to turn the proconsul away from the faith.

kikuyu: Saaʼol inni Phaawulos jedhamu sun garuu Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan guutamee Eelimaasin hubatee ilaalee akkana jedheen;
english: But Saul, who is also called Paul, filled with the Holy Spirit, fastened his eyes on him

kikuyu: “Ati ilma diiyaabiloosii fi diina qajeelummaa hundaa ti! Sobaa fi gowwoomsaa gosa hundaatiinis guutamteerta. Ati karaa Gooftaa isa qajeelaa sana jalʼisuu hin dhiiftuu?
english: and said, “You son of the devil, full of all deceit and all cunning, you enemy of all righteousness, will you not cease to pervert the right ways of the Lord?

kikuyu: Kunoo amma harki Gooftaa sitti kaʼeera; atis jaamtee yeroof ifa aduu arguu ni dadhabda.” Yeruma sana hurrii fi dukkanni isa irra buʼe; innis nama harka qabee isa qajeelchu barbaaduu jalqabe.
english: Now, behold, the hand of the Lord is on you, and you will be blind, not seeing the sun for a season!” Immediately a mist and darkness fell on him. He went around seeking someone to lead him by the hand.

kikuyu: Bulchaan biyyaa sunis waan kana arginaan amane; barsiisa waaʼee Gooftaa dinqifatee tureetii.
english: Then the proconsul, when he saw what was done, believed, being astonished at the teaching of the Lord.

kikuyu: Phaawulosii fi miiltonni isaa Phaafoosii bidiruudhaan kaʼanii Phergeen ishee Phamfiliyaa sana dhaqan; Yohannisis achitti isaan dhiisee Yerusaalemitti deebiʼe.
english: Now Paul and his company set sail from Paphos and came to Perga in Pamphylia. John departed from them and returned to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu Phergeenii kaʼanii gara Anxookiiyaa ishee Phisiidiyaatti argamtuu dhufan; guyyaa Sanbataas mana sagadaa seenanii tataaʼan.
english: But they, passing on from Perga, came to Antioch of Pisidia. They went into the synagogue on the Sabbath day and sat down.

kikuyu: Bulchitoonni mana sagadaa sanaas erga kitaabonni Seeraatii fi Raajotaa dubbifamanii booddee nama isaanitti erganii, “Yaa obboloota, yoo dubbii gorsaa uummataaf qabaattan mee dubbadhaa” jedhaniin.
english: After the reading of the law and the prophets, the rulers of the synagogue sent to them, saying, “Brothers, if you have any word of exhortation for the people, speak.”

kikuyu: Phaawulos kaʼee dhaabatee harkaan mallattoo argisiisee akkana jedhe; “Yaa namoota Israaʼel, isin warri Waaqa sodaattanis mee na dhagaʼaa!
english: Paul stood up, and gesturing with his hand said, “Men of Israel, and you who fear God, listen.

kikuyu: Waaqni saba Israaʼel abbootii keenya filate; innis yeroo isaan biyya Gibxi jiraachaa turanitti sabicha saba guddaa godhe; irree jabaanis achii isaan baase;
english: The God of this people chose our fathers, and exalted the people when they stayed as aliens in the land of Egypt, and with an uplifted arm, he led them out of it.

kikuyu: gammoojjii keessattis gara waggaa afurtamaa isaanii obse.
english: For a period of about forty years he put up with them in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Biyya Kanaʼaan keessaas saboota torba balleessee lafa isaanii akka dhaalaatti saba isaatiif kenne.
english: When he had destroyed seven nations in the land of Canaan, he gave them their land for an inheritance for about four hundred fifty years.

kikuyu: Wanni kun hundinuu gara waggaa 450 fudhatte. “Kana booddees Waaqni hamma bara Saamuʼeel raajichaatti abbootii murtii isaaniif kenne.
english: After these things, he gave them judges until Samuel the prophet.

kikuyu: Yommuu isaan akka inni mootii kennuufiif isa kadhatanitti Waaqni gosa Beniyaam keessaa Saaʼol ilma Qiishi isaaniif kenne; Saaʼolis waggaa 40 isaan bulche.
english: Afterward they asked for a king, and God gave to them Saul the son of Kish, a man of the tribe of Benjamin, for forty years.

kikuyu: Waaqni Saaʼolin mootummaa irraa buusee Daawitin mootii isaanii godhe; innis, ‘Ani nama akka garaa koo Daawit ilma Isseey argadheera; inni waan ani akka inni hojjetu fedhu hunda ni hojjeta’ jedhee waaʼee Daawit rageesseera.
english: When he had removed him, he raised up David to be their king, to whom he also testified, ‘I have found David the son of Jesse, a man after my heart, who will do all my will.’

kikuyu: “Waaqnis akkuma abdachiise sana, sanyii nama kanaa keessaa Yesuus fayyisaa saba Israaʼeliif fide.
english: From this man’s offspring, God has brought salvation to Israel according to his promise,

kikuyu: Yohannis dhufaatii Yesuus duratti cuuphaa qalbii jijjiirrannaa saba Israaʼel hundumatti lallabee ture.
english: before his coming, when John had first preached the baptism of repentance to Israel.

kikuyu: Yohannisis utuu ergama isaa guutachaa jiruu, ‘Isin eenyu na seetu? Ani isa isin eeggachaa jirtan miti. Garuu namni ani kophee isaa illee hiikuu hin malle tokko na duubaan ni dhufa’ jedhe.
english: As John was fulfilling his course, he said, ‘What do you suppose that I am? I am not he. But behold, one comes after me, the sandals of whose feet I am not worthy to untie.’

kikuyu: “Obboloota, yaa ijoollee Abrahaam, isin warri Waaqa sodaattanis, dubbiin fayyina kanaa nuu ergame.
english: “Brothers, children of the stock of Abraham, and those among you who fear God, the word of this salvation is sent out to you.

kikuyu: Warra Yerusaalem keessa jiraatanii fi bulchitoonni isaanii waan Yesuusin hin beekiniif yookaan dubbii raajotaa isa Sanbata Sanbata dubbifamu waan hin hubatiniif isatti muruudhaan dubbii raajotaa sana guutan.
english: For those who dwell in Jerusalem, and their rulers, because they didn’t know him, nor the voices of the prophets which are read every Sabbath, fulfilled them by condemning him.

kikuyu: Isaanis yoo sababii duʼa isatti mursiisuu dandaʼu argachuu baatan illee akka Yesuus ajjeefamuuf Phiilaaxoosin kadhatan.
english: Though they found no cause for death, they still asked Pilate to have him killed.

kikuyu: Erga waan waaʼee isaa barreeffame hunda guutatanii booddees fannoo irraa gad buusanii awwaala keessa isa kaaʼan.
english: When they had fulfilled all things that were written about him, they took him down from the tree and laid him in a tomb.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu warra duʼan keessaa isa kaase.
english: But God raised him from the dead,

kikuyu: Innis warra isa wajjin Galiilaadhaa gara Yerusaalemitti ol baʼanitti guyyaa hedduu mulʼate; isaanis amma saba keenya duratti dhuga baatota isaa ti.
english: and he was seen for many days by those who came up with him from Galilee to Jerusalem, who are his witnesses to the people.

kikuyu: “Nus oduu nama gammachiisu isinitti odeessina; oduun kunis: Waaqni waan abbootii keenya abdachiise sana,
english: We bring you good news of the promise made to the fathers,

kikuyu: Yesuusin duʼaa kaasuudhaan nuu ijoollee isaaniitiif guuteera. Kunis akkuma faarfannaa lammaffaa keessatti akkana jedhamee barreeffamee dha; “ ‘Ati ilma koo ti; ani harʼa si dhalcheera.’
english: that God has fulfilled this to us, their children, in that he raised up Jesus. As it is also written in the second psalm, ‘You are my Son. Today I have become your father.’

kikuyu: Wanni Waaqni, akka inni gonkumaa hin tortorreef jedhee warra duʼan keessaa isa kaaseef akkana jedhamee dubbii kana keessatti barreeffameera; “ ‘Ani eebba qulqulluu fi mirkanaaʼaa, isa Daawit abdachiifame sana isiniif nan kenna.’
english: “Concerning that he raised him up from the dead, now no more to return to corruption, he has spoken thus: ‘I will give you the holy and sure blessings of David.’

kikuyu: Akkasumas iddoo biraatti akkana jedha: “ ‘Qulqullichi kee akka tortoru hin gootu.’
english: Therefore he says also in another psalm, ‘You will not allow your Holy One to see decay.’

kikuyu: “Daawitis bara isaa keessa fedhii Waaqaa tajaajilee boqote; abbootii isaa biratti awwaalame; dhagni isaas ni tortore.
english: For David, after he had in his own generation served the counsel of God, fell asleep, was laid with his fathers, and saw decay.

kikuyu: Inni Waaqni warra duʼan keessaa isa kaase sun garuu hin tortorre.
english: But he whom God raised up saw no decay.

kikuyu: “Kanaaf yaa obboloota ko, isin akka karaa Yesuusiitiin dhiifamni cubbuu isinitti lallabame akka beektan nan fedha.
english: Be it known to you therefore, brothers, that through this man is proclaimed to you remission of sins;

kikuyu: Namni amanu hundinuu waan seera Museetiin furamuu hin dandaʼin hunda irraa karaa Yesuusiitiin furamuu ni dandaʼa.
english: and by him everyone who believes is justified from all things, from which you could not be justified by the law of Moses.

kikuyu: Isinis akka wanni raajonni dubbatan sun isin irra hin geenyeef of eeggadhaa; innis akkana jedha:
english: Beware therefore, lest that come on you which is spoken in the prophets:
