english: Some of the disciples from Caesarea also went with us, bringing one Mnason of Cyprus, an early disciple, with whom we would stay.

kikuyu: Yommuu nu Yerusaalem geenyetti obboloonni gammachuudhaan nu simatan.
english: When we had come to Jerusalem, the brothers received us gladly.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanuttis Phaawulos nu wajjin Yaaqoob bira dhaqe; jaarsoliin hundinuus achi turan.
english: The day following, Paul went in with us to James; and all the elders were present.

kikuyu: Phaawulosis nagaa isaan gaafatee waan Waaqni tajaajila inni kenneen Namoota Ormaa keessatti hojjete hunda tokko tokkoon isaanii ibse.
english: When he had greeted them, he reported one by one the things which God had worked among the Gentiles through his ministry.

kikuyu: Isaan yommuu waan kana dhagaʼanitti Waaqa galateeffatan. Phaawulosiinis akkana jedhan; “Yaa obboleessa, ati akka Yihuudoonni kuma hedduun amanan ni argita; hundi isaaniis hinaaffaa seeraaf qabu.
english: They, when they heard it, glorified God. They said to him, “You see, brother, how many thousands there are among the Jews of those who have believed, and they are all zealous for the law.

kikuyu: Ati akka Yihuudoonni Namoota Ormaa keessa jiraatan hundinuu ilmaan isaanii dhagna hin qabnee fi akka isaan akka duudhaa keenyaatti hin jiraanne itti himtee akka isaan seera Musee irraa gara galan barsiisuun kee isaanitti himameera.
english: They have been informed about you, that you teach all the Jews who are among the Gentiles to forsake Moses, telling them not to circumcise their children and not to walk after the customs.

kikuyu: Isaan akka ati dhufte dhugumaan ni dhagaʼu; egaa maal gochuu wayya?
english: What then? The assembly must certainly meet, for they will hear that you have come.

kikuyu: Kanaaf ati waan nu sitti himnu godhi; namoonni wareega of irraa qaban afur nu bira jiru.
english: Therefore do what we tell you. We have four men who have taken a vow.

kikuyu: Akka isaan mataa isaanii haaddataniif namoota kanneen ofitti fuudhiitii isaan wajjin of qulqulleessiitii baasii isaanii ati baasi. Kanaanis namoonni hundinuu akka oduun waaʼee kee odeeffame sun dhugaa hin taʼin, akka ati mataan kee iyyuu seeraaf ajajamtee jiraattu ni beeku.
english: Take them and purify yourself with them, and pay their expenses for them, that they may shave their heads. Then all will know that there is no truth in the things that they have been informed about you, but that you yourself also walk keeping the law.

kikuyu: Waaʼee Namoota Ormaa kanneen amananii immoo akka isaan nyaata waaqota tolfamoof aarsaa dhiʼeeffame, dhiiga, foon horii hudhamee duʼeetii fi sagaagalummaa lagataniif nu murtii keenya isaaniif barreessineerra.”
english: But concerning the Gentiles who believe, we have written our decision that they should observe no such thing, except that they should keep themselves from food offered to idols, from blood, from strangled things, and from sexual immorality.”

kikuyu: Phaawulosis guyyaa itti aanutti namoota sana ofitti fuudhee isaan wajjin of qulqulleesse; ergasii immoo gaafa guyyoonni qulqullaaʼummaa sun itti xumuramanii fi yeroo itti aarsaan maqaa tokkoo tokkoo isaaniitiin dhiʼeeffamuu malu beeksisuuf mana qulqullummaa seene.
english: Then Paul took the men, and the next day purified himself and went with them into the temple, declaring the fulfillment of the days of purification, until the offering was offered for every one of them.

kikuyu: Yommuu guyyoonni torban sun xumuramuu gaʼanitti Yihuudoonni biyya Asiyaatii dhufan tokko tokko Phaawulosin mana qulqullummaa keessatti argan. Isaanis nama hundumaa kakaasanii isa qaban.
english: When the seven days were almost completed, the Jews from Asia, when they saw him in the temple, stirred up all the multitude and laid hands on him,

kikuyu: Iyyaniis, “Yaa namoota Israaʼel nu gargaaraa! Namichi kun nama saba keenyaan mormaa, seera keenyaa fi mana qulqullummaa mormaa nama hunda iddoo hundatti barsiisuu dha. Kana malees inni Giriikota mana qulqullummaatti ol galchee iddoo qulqulluu kana xureesseera” jedhan.
english: crying out, “Men of Israel, help! This is the man who teaches all men everywhere against the people, and the law, and this place. Moreover, he also brought Greeks into the temple and has defiled this holy place!”

kikuyu: Isaan waan duraan namicha Efesoon kan maqaan isaa Xiroofiimoos jedhamu tokko Phaawulos biratti magaalaa keessatti arganii turaniif, waan Phaawulos mana qulqullummaatti ol isa galche seʼaniitii.
english: For they had seen Trophimus the Ephesian with him in the city, and they supposed that Paul had brought him into the temple.

kikuyu: Magaalaan sunis guutummaatti ni raafamte; namoonnis karaa hundumaan fiigaa dhufan. Isaanis Phaawulosin qabanii lafa irra harkisaa mana qulqullummaatii gad baasan; yommusuma karroonni cufaman.
english: All the city was moved and the people ran together. They seized Paul and dragged him out of the temple. Immediately the doors were shut.

kikuyu: Utuu isaan isa ajjeesuu yaalanuu akka magaalaan Yerusaalem guutummaatti raafamaa jirtu oduun ajajaa waraana Roomaa gaʼe.
english: As they were trying to kill him, news came up to the commanding officer of the regiment that all Jerusalem was in an uproar.

kikuyu: Innis yeruma sana loltootaa fi ajajjuuwwan dhibbaa tokko tokko fudhatee fiigichaan isaanitti gad buʼe. Isaanis yommuu ajajaa sanaa fi loltoota isaa arganitti Phaawulosin tumuu dhiisan.
english: Immediately he took soldiers and centurions and ran down to them. They, when they saw the chief captain and the soldiers, stopped beating Paul.

kikuyu: Ajajaan sunis dhufee isa qabe; akka inni foncaa lamaan hidhamus ajaje; akka inni eenyu taʼee fi akka inni maal hojjechaa tures isa gaafate.
english: Then the commanding officer came near, arrested him, commanded him to be bound with two chains, and inquired who he was and what he had done.

kikuyu: Tuuta sana keessaas garri tokko waan tokko jedhanii iyyaa, garri kaan immoo waan biraa jedhanii iyyaa turan; ajajaan sunis sababii waca namaatiif waan mirkana taʼe argachuu waan dadhabeef akka Phaawulos gara qubata loltootaatti geeffamu ajaje.
english: Some shouted one thing and some another, among the crowd. When he couldn’t find out the truth because of the noise, he commanded him to be brought into the barracks.

kikuyu: Phaawulos gulantaa ittiin gad baʼan bira geenyaan sababii goolii namootaatiif loltoonni isa baatan.
english: When he came to the stairs, he was carried by the soldiers because of the violence of the crowd;

kikuyu: Namoonni hedduunis, “Isa ajjeesi!” jedhanii iyyaa duukaa buʼan.
english: for the multitude of the people followed after, crying out, “Away with him!”

kikuyu: Phaawulos yommuu loltoonni isa fuudhanii qubata loltootaatti ol isa galchuuf jedhanitti, ajajaa sanaan, “Akka ani waa sitti himu naa eeyyamtaa?” jedhee gaafate. Ajajaan sun immoo deebisee akkana jedhe; “Ati afaan Giriik ni dubbattaa?
english: As Paul was about to be brought into the barracks, he asked the commanding officer, “May I speak to you?” He said, “Do you know Greek?

kikuyu: Ati namicha biyya Gibxi kan dhiʼeenya kana goolii kaasee shororkeessitoota 4,000 fudhatee gammoojjiitti gale sana mitii?”
english: Aren’t you then the Egyptian who before these days stirred up to sedition and led out into the wilderness the four thousand men of the Assassins?”

kikuyu: Phaawulosis, “Ani Yihuudii Xarsees magaalaa beekamtuu Kiilqiyaa keessaa sanaa ti. Maaloo, akka ani namoota kanatti dubbadhu naa eeyyami” jedhee deebise.
english: But Paul said, “I am a Jew from Tarsus in Cilicia, a citizen of no insignificant city. I beg you, allow me to speak to the people.”

kikuyu: Phaawulos akkuma eeyyama ajajaa sanaa argateen gulantaa sana irra dhaabatee akka namoonni calʼisaniif harkaan mallattoo kenne; yommuu isaan hundinuu calʼisanitti immoo afaan Araamaayikiitiin akkana jedheen.
english: When he had given him permission, Paul, standing on the stairs, beckoned with his hand to the people. When there was a great silence, he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, saying,

kikuyu: “Yaa obbolootaa fi abbootii, falmata ani amma isin duratti dhiʼeeffadhu kana mee naa dhagaʼaa.”
english: “Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”

kikuyu: Jarris yommuu isaa afaan Ibraayisxiitiin isaanitti dubbatu dhagaʼanitti kan duraa illee caalaa calʼisan. Phaawulosis akkana jedhe;
english: When they heard that he spoke to them in the Hebrew language, they were even more quiet. He said,

kikuyu: “Ani Yihuudii dha; magaalaa Xarsees ishee biyya Kiilqiyaa keessaa sanattin dhaladhe; garuu Yerusaalemittin guddadhe. Miilla Gamaaliyaal jalattis seera Abbootii keenyaa akka gaariitti baradhee, akkuma isin hundi harʼa hinaaftan kana anis Waaqaaf nan hinaafa ture.
english: “I am indeed a Jew, born in Tarsus of Cilicia, but brought up in this city at the feet of Gamaliel, instructed according to the strict tradition of the law of our fathers, being zealous for God, even as you all are today.

kikuyu: Dhiiraa fi dubartii qabee, mana hidhaa keessa isaan buusuudhaan duuka buutota karaa kanaa hamma duʼaatti ariʼadheera;
english: I persecuted this Way to the death, binding and delivering into prisons both men and women,

kikuyu: waan kanas lubni ol aanaanii fi waldaan jaarsolii guutuun ragaa naa baʼu. Anis xalayoota isaan gara obboloota warra Damaasqoo jiraniitti barreessan fudhadheen akka namoonni kunneen adabamaniif hidhee Yerusaalemitti isaan fiduuf achi nan dhaqe.
english: as also the high priest and all the council of the elders testify, from whom also I received letters to the brothers, and traveled to Damascus to bring them also who were there to Jerusalem in bonds to be punished.

kikuyu: “Gara saafaatti, akkuma ani Damaasqootti dhiʼaadheen ifni guddaan isaa akkuma tasaa samii irraa naannoo kootti balaqqise.
english: “As I made my journey and came close to Damascus, about noon suddenly a great light shone around me from the sky.

kikuyu: Anis lafatti kufeen sagalee, ‘Yaa Saaʼol! Yaa Saaʼol! Ati maaliif na ariʼatta?’ naan jedhu tokkon dhagaʼe.
english: I fell to the ground and heard a voice saying to me, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me?’

kikuyu: “Anis, ‘Yaa Gooftaa ati eenyu?’ jedheen gaafadhe. “Inni immoo deebisee, ‘Ani Yesuus nama Naazreeti isa ati ariʼattuu dha’ naan jedhe.
english: I answered, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ He said to me, ‘I am Jesus of Nazareth, whom you persecute.’

kikuyu: Warri na wajjin turanis ifa sana argan malee sagalee isa natti dubbachaa ture sanaa hin hubanne.
english: “Those who were with me indeed saw the light and were afraid, but they didn’t understand the voice of him who spoke to me.

kikuyu: “Anis, ‘Yaa Gooftaa, ani maal godhu ree?’ jedhee gaafadhe. “Gooftaanis, ‘Kaʼii Damaasqoo seeni. Wanni akka ati hojjettuuf siif kaaʼame hundinuu achitti sitti himamaatii’ naan jedhe.
english: I said, ‘What shall I do, Lord?’ The Lord said to me, ‘Arise, and go into Damascus. There you will be told about all things which are appointed for you to do.’

kikuyu: Anis sababii calaqqisa ifa sanaatiif homaa arguu dadhabnaan, warri na wajjin turan harka qabanii Damaasqootti na geessan.
english: When I couldn’t see for the glory of that light, being led by the hand of those who were with me, I came into Damascus.

kikuyu: “Namichi Anaaniyaas jedhamu kan sirriitti seera eegu tokko Yihuudoota achi jiraatan hunda biratti maqaa gaarii qaba ture.
english: “One Ananias, a devout man according to the law, well reported of by all the Jews who lived in Damascus,

kikuyu: Innis gara koo dhufee na bira dhaabatee, ‘Yaa obboleessa koo Saaʼol, agartuun kee siif haa deebiʼu!’ naan jedhe; agartuun koos yeruma sana naa deebiʼe. Anis isa arguu dandaʼe.
english: came to me, and standing by me said to me, ‘Brother Saul, receive your sight!’ In that very hour I looked up at him.

kikuyu: “Innis akkana jedhe; ‘Waaqni abbootii keenyaa akka ati fedhii isaa beektu, akka ati Isa Qajeelaa sana argituu fi akka afaan isaa irraa dubbii dhageessuuf si filateera.
english: He said, ‘The God of our fathers has appointed you to know his will, and to see the Righteous One, and to hear a voice from his mouth.

kikuyu: Atis waan argitee fi waan dhageesse sana fuula nama hundumaa duratti isaaf dhugaa ni baata.
english: For you will be a witness for him to all men of what you have seen and heard.

kikuyu: Egaa amma maal eegda ree? Kaʼii maqaa isaa waammachaa cuuphamiitii cubbuu kee of irraa dhiqi.’
english: Now why do you wait? Arise, be baptized, and wash away your sins, calling on the name of the Lord.’

kikuyu: “Anis Yerusaalemitti deebiʼee utuu mana qulqullummaa keessatti kadhannaatti jiruu akka waan of wallaaluu nan taʼe.
english: “When I had returned to Jerusalem and while I prayed in the temple, I fell into a trance

kikuyu: Gooftaa illee isaa, ‘Jarri kun waan ati waaʼee koo dhugaa baatu hin fudhataniitii dafii ammuma Yerusaalem keessaa baʼi!’ jedhee natti dubbatu nan arge.
english: and saw him saying to me, ‘Hurry and get out of Jerusalem quickly, because they will not receive testimony concerning me from you.’

kikuyu: “Anis deebiseen akkana jedhe; ‘Yaa Gooftaa jarri kun akka ani warra sitti amanan hidhuu fi tumuuf jedhee mana sagadaa tokko irraa gara isa biraatti darbaa ture beeku.
english: I said, ‘Lord, they themselves know that I imprisoned and beat in every synagogue those who believed in you.

kikuyu: Yeroo dhiigni dhuga baatuu keetii, dhiigni Isxifaanos dhangalaafamettis ani ajjeefamuu isaatti namootaan walii galee achi dhaabadheen uffata warra isa ajjeesanii eegaa ture.’
english: When the blood of Stephen, your witness, was shed, I also was standing by, consenting to his death, and guarding the cloaks of those who killed him.’

kikuyu: “Gooftaanis, ‘Ani fagootti, gara Namoota Ormaatti sin ergaatii deemi’ naan jedhe.”
english: “He said to me, ‘Depart, for I will send you out far from here to the Gentiles.’ ”

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis hamma inni dubbii kana dubbatutti isa dhagaʼaa turan; ergasiis sagalee isaanii ol fudhatanii, “Namni akkanaa jiraachuu hin qabuutii lafa irraa balleessaa!” jedhanii iyyan.
english: They listened to him until he said that; then they lifted up their voice and said, “Rid the earth of this fellow, for he isn’t fit to live!”

kikuyu: Utuu isaan uffata isaanii dadarbatanii, awwaaras qilleensa keessa bibittinneessanii iyyanuu,
english: As they cried out, threw off their cloaks, and threw dust into the air,

kikuyu: ajajaan sun akka Phaawulos qubata loltootaatti ol galfamuu ajaje; innis waan namoonni akkas isatti iyyaniif beekuuf jedhee akka Phaawulos garafamee qoratamu ajaje.
english: the commanding officer commanded him to be brought into the barracks, ordering him to be examined by scourging, that he might know for what crime they shouted against him like that.

kikuyu: Phaawulos immoo yommuu isaan isa garafuuf jedhanii teephaan isa hidhanitti ajajaa dhibbaa kan isa bira dhaabachaa tureen, “Lammii Roomaa tokko murtii malee garafuun isiniif ni eeyyamamaa?” jedhe.
english: When they had tied him up with straps, Paul asked the centurion who stood by, “Is it lawful for you to scourge a man who is a Roman, and not found guilty?”

kikuyu: Ajajaan dhibbaa sunis yommuu waan kana dhagaʼetti gara ajajaa kumaa sanaa dhaqee, “Namichi kunoo lammii Roomaatii ati maal gochuu yaadda?” jedheen.
english: When the centurion heard it, he went to the commanding officer and told him, “Watch what you are about to do, for this man is a Roman!”

kikuyu: Ajajaan kumaa sunis Phaawulos bira dhaqee, “Mee natti himi; ati lammii Roomaatii?” jedhee gaafate. Innis, “Eeyyee” jedhee deebise.
english: The commanding officer came and asked him, “Tell me, are you a Roman?” He said, “Yes.”

kikuyu: Ajajaan kumaa sunis, “Ani lammummaa kana argachuudhaaf gatii guddaa baase” jedhe. Phaawulos immoo deebisee, “Ani garuu ittin dhaladhe” jedhe.
english: The commanding officer answered, “I bought my citizenship for a great price.” Paul said, “But I was born a Roman.”

kikuyu: Warri isa qoruuf yaadanis yommusuma isa irraa deebiʼan; ajajaan kumaa sunis yommuu akka Phaawulos lammii Roomaa taʼee fi akka ofii isaatii immoo Phaawulosin foncaan hidhe hubatetti ni rifate.
english: Immediately those who were about to examine him departed from him, and the commanding officer also was afraid when he realized that he was a Roman, because he had bound him.

kikuyu: Ajajaan kumaa sun sababii Yihuudoonni Phaawulosin himataniif sirriitti beekuu fedhee guyyaa itti aanu isa hiikee akka luboonni hangafoonnii fi waldaan Yihuudootaa hundi walitti qabaman ajaje. Ergasii immoo Phaawulosin fidee akka inni fuula isaanii duratti dhiʼaatu godhe.
english: But on the next day, desiring to know the truth about why he was accused by the Jews, he freed him from the bonds and commanded the chief priests and all the council to come together, and brought Paul down and set him before them.

kikuyu: Phaawulos xiyyeeffatee yaaʼii sana ilaalee, “Yaa obboloota ko, ani hamma guyyaa harʼaatti fuula Waaqaa dura yaada gaariidhaan jiraadheera” jedhe.
english: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti Anaaniyaas lubni ol aanaan akka warri Phaawulos bira dhaabachaa turan sun afaan isaa keessa dhaʼan ajaje.
english: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

kikuyu: Phaawulosis deebisee, “Ati keenyan nooraa dibame, Waaqni si rukuta! Seeraan natti muruuf jettee achi teessee atumti mataan kee immoo akka ani dhaʼamu ajajuudhaan seera cabsitaa?” jedhe.
english: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”

kikuyu: Warri Phaawulos bira dhaabachaa turanis; “Ati akkam luba Waaqaa ol aanaa tokko arrabsita?” jedhaniin.
english: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”

kikuyu: Phaawulos immoo deebisee, “Yaa obboloota, ani akka inni lubicha ol aanaa taʼe hin beekne; ‘Waaʼee bulchaa saba keetii hamaa hin dubbatin’ jedhamee barreeffameeraatii” jedhe.
english: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”

kikuyu: Phaawulos yommuu akka isaan keessaa garri tokko Saduuqota, garri kaan immoo Fariisota taʼan beeketti, “Yaa obboloota ko, ani Fariisicha ilma Fariisii ti. Ani sababii akka warri duʼan duʼaa kaʼan abdadhuuf qoramuuf dhiʼaadheera” jedhe.
english: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”

kikuyu: Yommuu inni waan kana dubbatetti Fariisotaa fi Saduuqota gidduutti falmiin uumame; yaaʼiin sun gargar qoodame.
english: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.

kikuyu: Saduuqonni, “Duʼaa kaʼuun hin jiru, ergamoonnis, hafuuronnis hin jiran” jedhu; Fariisonni garuu akka kunneen hundinuu jiran amanu.
english: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.

kikuyu: Wacni guddaanis uumame; barsiistonni seeraa tokko tokkos garee Fariisotaa keessaa kaʼanii, “Nu balleessaa tokko illee namicha kana irratti hin arganne; Hafuura yookaan ergamaa Waaqaatu isatti dubbate taʼinnaa?” jedhanii cimsanii dubbatan.
english: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”

kikuyu: Ajajaan kumaa sunis yommuu falmiin jabaachaa deemetti jarri kun Phaawulosin cicciru jedhee sodaate. Kanaaf akka loltoonni dhaqanii humnaan achii isa fuudhanii qubata loltootaatti ol galchan ajaje.
english: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.

kikuyu: Gooftaanis halkan itti aanutti Phaawulositti mulʼatee, “Jabaadhu! Akkuma Yerusaalem keessatti waaʼee koo dhugaa baate sana Roomaa keessattis dhugaa baʼuu qabdaatii” jedheen.
english: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonni tokko tokko barii guyyaa itti aanuu mariʼatanii akka hamma Phaawulosin ajjeesanitti waa hin nyaanne yookaan waa hin dhugne walii kakatan.
english: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.

kikuyu: Namoota afurtamaa oltu maree kana irratti hirmaate.
english: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.

kikuyu: Isaanis gara luboota hangafootaatii fi gara maanguddootaa dhaqanii akkana jedhan; “Nu hamma Phaawulosin ajjeefnutti akka homaa afaaniin hin qabne jabeessinee kakanneerra.
english: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isinii fi waldaan Yihuudootaa waan waaʼee Phaawulos sirriitti cimsitanii qorachuu barbaaddan fakkeessaatii akka ajajaan kumaa sun Phaawulosin gara keessanitti gad ergu kadhadhaa; nu utuu inni achi hin gaʼin isa ajjeesuuf qophoofneerraatii.”
english: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”

kikuyu: Garuu ilmi obboleettii Phaawulos yommuu maree kana dhagaʼetti qubata loltootaatti ol galee Phaawulositti hime.
english: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.

kikuyu: Phaawulosis ajajjuuwwan dhibbaa keessaa nama tokko waamee, “Dargaggeessi kun waan isatti himu qabaatii mee ajajaa kumaatti isa geessi” jedheen.
english: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”

kikuyu: Innis ajajaa kumaa sanatti isa geesse. Ajajaan dhibbaa sunis, “Phaawulos inni mana hidhaa jiru sun na waamsisee waan dargaggeessi kun waan sitti himu qabuuf akka ani isa sitti fidu na kadhate” jedheen.
english: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”

kikuyu: Ajajaan kumaas dargaggeessa sana harka qabee kophaatti baasee, “Wanni ati natti himuu barbaaddu maali?” jedhee gaafate.
english: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”

kikuyu: Dargaggeessi sunis akkana jedhe; “Yihuudoonni waan waaʼee isaa sirriitti cimsanii qoruu barbaadan fakkeessanii akka ati Phaawulosin bori gara yaaʼii Yihuudootaatti gad ergitu si kadhachuuf walii galaniiru.
english: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.

kikuyu: Waan isaan keessaa namoonni afurtamaa oli taʼan riphanii isa eeggachaa jiraniif ati isaan jalaa hin qabin. Isaan akka hamma isa ajjeesanitti homaa hin nyaanne yookaan hin dhugne kakataniiru; qophaaʼaniis eeyyama kee eeggachaa jiru.”
english: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”

kikuyu: Ajajaan kumaa sunis, “Ati akka waan kana natti himte nama tokkotti iyyuu hin dubbatin” jedhee dargaggeessa sana akeekkachiisee gad dhiise.
english: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”

kikuyu: Ergasii inni ajajjuuwwan dhibbaa keessaa nama lama waamee akkana jedhee ajaje; “Akka loltoonni dhibbi lama, abbootiin fardaa torbaatamnii fi warri eeboo qabatan dhibbi lama edana saʼaatii sadiitti Qiisaariyaa dhaqaniif qopheessaa.
english: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”

kikuyu: Phaawulosiifis farda inni yaabbatu qopheessaatii gara Feeliksi Bulchaa Biyyaatti nagaan geessaa.”
english: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.

kikuyu: Innis akkana jedhee xalayaa tokko barreesse.
english: He wrote a letter like this:

kikuyu: Qilaawudewoos Liisiiyaas irraa, Gara bulchaa kabajamaa, gara Feeliksi: Nagaa jirtaa.
english: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonni namicha kana qabanii ajjeesuu barbaadaa turan; ani garuu akka inni lammii Roomaa taʼe beekee loltoota koo wajjin dhaqee isa baase.
english: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.

kikuyu: Anis waan isaan isa himataniif beekuu barbaadeen fuula waldaa isaanii duratti isa dhiʼeesse.
english: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.

kikuyu: Ani akka inni waaʼee gaaffii seera isaaniitiin himatame arge malee akka inni waan duʼaan yookaan hidhaan isa gaʼu tokkumaanuu himatame hin argine.
english: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.

kikuyu: Ani yeroo akka isaan namicha sanatti mariʼatan dhagaʼetti dafee isa sitti erge. Warra isa himatanis akka isaan himata isaanii sittan dhiʼeeffatan ajajeera.
english: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you. Farewell.”

kikuyu: Kanaaf loltoonni sun akkuma ajajaman sana Phaawulosin fuudhanii halkaniin Antiiphaaxriisitti geessan.
english: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.

kikuyu: Isaanis guyyaa itti aanutti akka abbootiin fardaa isa wajjin deeman godhanii ofii immoo qubata loltootaatti deebiʼan.
english: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.

kikuyu: Abbootiin fardaa sunis yommuu Qiisaariyaa gaʼanitti xalayaa sana bulchaatti kennan; Phaawulosinis fuula isaa dura dhiʼeessan.
english: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.

kikuyu: Bulchaan sunis erga xalayaa sana dubbifatee booddee, akka inni biyya kamii dhufe isa gaafate. Yommuu akka inni Kiilqiyaadhaa dhufe beekettis,
english: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,

kikuyu: “Ani yeroo himattoonni kee as gaʼanitti dubbii kee nan dhagaʼa” jedhe. Innis ergasii akka Phaawulos masaraa Heroodis keessatti eegamus ajaje.
english: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.

kikuyu: Guyyaa shan booddee Anaaniyaas lubni ol aanaan maanguddoota tokko tokkoo fi abukaattoo Xerxuloos jedhamu tokko wajjin Qiisaariyaatti gad buʼe; isaanis waan ittiin Phaawulosin himatan bulchaa duratti dhiʼeeffatan.
english: After five days, the high priest, Ananias, came down with certain elders and an orator, one Tertullus. They informed the governor against Paul.

kikuyu: Yommuu Phaawulos waamamee ol galetti, Xerxuloos akkana jedhee himata isaa Feeliksi duratti dhiʼeeffate; “Yaa Feeliksi kabajamaa, nu bara kee keessa yeroo dheeraa nagaan jiraanneera; ogummaan kees saba kanaaf geeddarama fideera.
english: When he was called, Tertullus began to accuse him, saying, “Seeing that by you we enjoy much peace, and that prosperity is coming to this nation by your foresight,

kikuyu: Yaa Feeliksi kabajamaa, nu waan kana karaa hundumaa fi iddoo hundatti galata guddaadhaan ni fudhanna.
english: we accept it in all ways and in all places, most excellent Felix, with all thankfulness.

kikuyu: Garuu ani akka hammana irra si hin dadhabsiifneef akka ati gabaabumatti gara laafinaan nu dhageessu sin kadhadha.
english: But that I don’t delay you, I entreat you to bear with us and hear a few words.

kikuyu: “Nu akka namichi kun dhukkuba hamaa taʼee Yihuudoota addunyaa guutuu irra jiran hunda keessatti goolii kaasaa jiru argineerra. Inni hoogganaa garee Naazirootaa ti.
english: For we have found this man to be a plague, an instigator of insurrections among all the Jews throughout the world, and a ringleader of the sect of the Nazarenes.

kikuyu: Inni mana qulqullummaa iyyuu xureessuu yaaleera; nu immoo akka seera keenyaatti itti muruuf jennee isa qabne. [
english: He even tried to profane the temple, and we arrested him.

kikuyu: Ati mataan kee iyyuu isa qoruudhaan waaʼee waan nu isa himannu kanaa hunda beekuu ni dandeessa.”
english: By examining him yourself you may ascertain all these things of which we accuse him.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis akka dubbiin kun dhugaa taʼe mirkaneessanii himata sana deeggaran.
english: The Jews also joined in the attack, affirming that these things were so.

kikuyu: Phaawulosis yommuu bulchaan sun akka inni dubbatuuf harkaan mallattoo kenneefitti akkana jedhee deebii kenne; “Ani waan akka ati waggoota hedduuf abbaa murtii saba kanaa taate beekuuf falmii koo gammachuudhaan nan dhiʼeeffadha.
english: When the governor had beckoned to him to speak, Paul answered, “Because I know that you have been a judge of this nation for many years, I cheerfully make my defense,

kikuyu: Akkuma ati rakkoo malee mirkaneeffachuu dandeessu ani waaqeffachuuf jedhee Yerusaalemitti ol baʼuun koo guyyaa kudha lama hin caalu.
english: seeing that you can verify that it is not more than twelve days since I went up to worship at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Warri na himatan kun anaa mana qulqullummaa keessatti yookaan manneen sagadaa keessatti yookaan magaalaa keessatti nama tokkoon illee falmu yookaan uummata kakaasu na hin arganne.
english: In the temple they didn’t find me disputing with anyone or stirring up a crowd, either in the synagogues or in the city.

kikuyu: Isaan waan amma ittiin na himachaa jiran kanas siif mirkaneessuu hin dandaʼan.
english: Nor can they prove to you the things of which they now accuse me.

kikuyu: Taʼus ani akka nama karaa isaan garee mormitootaa jedhaniin sana duukaa buʼu tokkootti akka Waaqa abbootii keenyaa waaqeffadhu fuula kee duratti nan amana. Waan seera Museetiin walii galuu fi waan kitaabota raajotaa keessatti barreeffame hundas nan amana.
english: But this I confess to you, that according to the Way, which they call a sect, so I serve the God of our fathers, believing all things which are according to the law, and which are written in the prophets;

kikuyu: Anis akkuma jara kanaa akka duʼaa kaʼuun qajeeltotaatii fi hamootaa jiraatu Waaqa nan abdadha.
english: having hope toward God, which these also themselves look for, that there will be a resurrection of the dead, both of the just and unjust.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani akka yeroo hunda Waaqaa fi nama duratti yaada qulqulluu qabaadhu nan tattaaffadha.
english: In this I also practice always having a conscience void of offense toward God and men.

kikuyu: “Anis bara baayʼee hiyyeeyyii saba kootiitiif gargaarsa kennuuf, Waaqaafis aarsaa dhiʼeessuuf jedhee Yerusaalem dhufe.
english: Now after some years, I came to bring gifts for the needy to my nation, and offerings;

kikuyu: Yeroo ani waan kana hojjechaa turettis isaan anaa qulqullaaʼee jiru mana qulqullummaa keessatti na argan. Tuunni tokko iyyuu na bira hin turre; anis goolii keessatti hin hirmaanne.
english: amid which certain Jews from Asia found me purified in the temple, not with a mob, nor with turmoil.

kikuyu: Garuu Yihuudoonni biyya Asiyaa kanneen yoo waan ittiin na himatan tokko illee narraa qabaatan si duratti as dhiʼaatanii na himachuu malan tokko tokko jiru.
english: They ought to have been here before you and to make accusation if they had anything against me.

kikuyu: Yookaan warri as jiran kunneen yakka yeroo ani fuula Waldaa Yihuudootaa dura dhaabadhe sana narratti argan haa himan;
english: Or else let these men themselves say what injustice they found in me when I stood before the council,

kikuyu: waan ani yeroo fuula isaanii dura dhaabadhe sana iyyee, ‘Ani harʼa waaʼee duʼaa kaʼuu warra duʼanii irratti qoramuuf jedhee fuula keessan dura dhaabadheera’ jedhe tokkicha sana malee yoo jiraate haa himan.”
english: unless it is for this one thing that I cried standing among them, ‘Concerning the resurrection of the dead I am being judged before you today!’”

kikuyu: Feeliksi garuu waan waaʼee Karaa sanaa sirriitti beekuuf, “Ani gaafa Liisiiyaas ajajaan kumaa sun dhufutti dubbii keessan nan murteessa” jedhee yeroo biraatti dabarse.
english: But Felix, having more exact knowledge concerning the Way, deferred them, saying, “When Lysias, the commanding officer, comes down, I will decide your case.”

kikuyu: Innis akka ajajaan dhibbaa sun Phaawulosin eegumsa jala tursu, garuu akka haala isaa itti furuu fi akka michoonni isaas waan isa barbaachisu kam iyyuu isaaf dhiʼeessan eeyyamuuf ajaje.
english: He ordered the centurion that Paul should be kept in custody and should have some privileges, and not to forbid any of his friends to serve him or to visit him.

kikuyu: Feeliksis bultii muraasa booddee niitii isaa Diruusiilaa ishee Yihuudii turte wajjin dhufe; innis Phaawulosin waamsisee isaa waaʼee Kiristoos Yesuusitti amanuu dubbatu dhaggeeffate.
english: After some days, Felix came with Drusilla his wife, who was a Jewess, and sent for Paul and heard him concerning the faith in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Yommuu Phaawulos waaʼee qajeelummaa, waaʼee of qabuutii fi waaʼee murtii kan dhufuuf jiru sanaa dubbatetti Feeliksi sodaatee, “Ammaaf ni gaʼaatii deemi! Yommuu naa mijaaʼutti anuu sin waamsisaatii” jedhe.
english: As he reasoned about righteousness, self-control, and the judgment to come, Felix was terrified, and answered, “Go your way for this time, and when it is convenient for me, I will summon you.”

kikuyu: Yeroodhuma sanattis inni akka waan Phaawulos mattaʼaa isaaf kennuutti waan abdachaa tureef ammuma amma waamsisee isa wajjin haasaʼaa ture.
english: Meanwhile, he also hoped that money would be given to him by Paul, that he might release him. Therefore also he sent for him more often and talked with him.

kikuyu: Phoorqiyoos Fesxoos erga waggaan lama darbee booddee iddoo Feeliksi qabate; Feeliksis waan Yihuudoota gammachiisuu barbaadeef Phaawulosin manuma hidhaatti dhiise.
english: But when two years were fulfilled, Felix was succeeded by Porcius Festus, and desiring to gain favor with the Jews, Felix left Paul in bonds.

kikuyu: Fesxoosis biyya sana gaʼee guyyaa sadii booddee Qiisaariyaadhaa Yerusaalemitti ol baʼe;
english: Festus therefore, having come into the province, after three days went up to Jerusalem from Caesarea.

kikuyu: achittis luboonni hangafoonnii fi dura buʼoonni Yihuudootaa fuula isaa duratti dhiʼaatanii himata Phaawulos irraa qaban dhiʼeeffatan.
english: Then the high priest and the principal men of the Jews informed him against Paul, and they begged him,

kikuyu: Isaanis waan karaatti riphanii Phaawulosin ajjeesuuf qophaaʼaa turaniif akka Fesxoos isaan deeggaree nama ergee gara Yerusaalem isa fichisiisu kadhatan.
english: asking a favor against him, that he would summon him to Jerusalem, plotting to kill him on the way.

kikuyu: Fesxoos immoo akkana jedhee deebise; “Phaawulos Qiisaariyaatti eegamaa jira; ani mataan koo iyyuu dhiʼeenyatti achi nan dhaqa.
english: However Festus answered that Paul should be kept in custody at Caesarea, and that he himself was about to depart shortly.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu abbootii taayitaa keessan keessaa tokko tokko na wajjin deemanii yoo namichi sun balleessaa wayii qabaate achitti isa haa himatan.”
english: “Let them therefore”, he said, “that are in power among you go down with me, and if there is anything wrong in the man, let them accuse him.”

kikuyu: Innis erga guyyaa saddeeti yookaan kudhan isaan bira bubbulee booddee Qiisaariyaatti gad buʼe; guyyaa itti aanuttis barcuma murtii irra taaʼee akka Phaawulos fuula isaa duratti dhiʼeeffamu ajaje.
english: When he had stayed among them more than ten days, he went down to Caesarea, and on the next day he sat on the judgment seat, and commanded Paul to be brought.

kikuyu: Yommuu Phaawulos dhiʼaatettis Yihuudoonni Yerusaalemii gad buʼan sun isatti naannaʼanii dhaabachuun himata ciccimaa hedduu isa irratti dhiʼeessan; garuu amansiisuu hin dandeenye.
english: When he had come, the Jews who had come down from Jerusalem stood around him, bringing against him many and grievous charges which they could not prove,

kikuyu: Phaawulosis, “Ani seera Yihuudootaa irratti yookaan mana qulqullummaa irratti yookaan Qeesaar irratti yakka tokko illee hin hojjenne” jedhee falmate.
english: while he said in his defense, “Neither against the law of the Jews, nor against the temple, nor against Caesar, have I sinned at all.”

kikuyu: Fesxoosis Yihuudoota gammachiisuuf jedhee Phaawulosiin, “Ati Yerusaalemitti ol baatee himata kana irratti fuula koo duratti qoratamuu ni feetaa?” jedhe.
english: But Festus, desiring to gain favor with the Jews, answered Paul and said, “Are you willing to go up to Jerusalem and be judged by me there concerning these things?”

kikuyu: Phaawulos garuu akkana jedhee deebise; “Ani amma barcuma murtii Qeesaar dura, iddoo itti qoratamuu qabu dhaabadheen jira; akkuma ati mataan kee iyyuu sirriitti beektu ani yakka tokko illee Yihuudoota irratti hin hojjenne.
english: But Paul said, “I am standing before Caesar’s judgment seat, where I ought to be tried. I have done no wrong to the Jews, as you also know very well.

kikuyu: Taʼus ani utuu balleessaa duʼa natti mursiisu tokko illee hojjedhee silaa duʼa jalaa baʼuuf hin carraaqu; garuu yoo wanni Yihuudoonni kunneen ittiin na himatan dhugaa hin taʼin, namni tokko iyyuu dabarsee harka isaaniitti na kennuuf mirga hin qabu. Ani Qeesaaritti oli nan iyyadha!”
english: For if I have done wrong and have committed anything worthy of death, I don’t refuse to die; but if none of those things is true that they accuse me of, no one can give me up to them. I appeal to Caesar!”

kikuyu: Fesxoosis erga gorsitoota isaa wajjin mariʼatee booddee, “Ati Qeesaaritti ol iyyatteerta; gara Qeesaar ni dhaqxa!” jedhe.
english: Then Festus, when he had conferred with the council, answered, “You have appealed to Caesar. To Caesar you shall go.”

kikuyu: Bultii muraasa booddee Agriiphaa mootichii fi Barniiqeen Fesxoos simachuuf Qiisaariyaa dhaqan.
english: Now when some days had passed, King Agrippa and Bernice arrived at Caesarea and greeted Festus.

kikuyu: Fesxoosis isaan guyyaa hedduu achi bubbullaan akkana jedhee waaʼee himata Phaawulos mooticha wajjin dubbate; “Namichi Feeliksi mana hidhaa keessatti dhiisee deeme tokko as jira.
english: As he stayed there many days, Festus laid Paul’s case before the king, saying, “There is a certain man left a prisoner by Felix;

kikuyu: Yeroo ani Yerusaalem turetti luboonni hangafoonnii fi maanguddoonni Yihuudootaa isa himatanii akka itti muramu kadhatan.
english: about whom, when I was at Jerusalem, the chief priests and the elders of the Jews informed me, asking for a sentence against him.

kikuyu: “Anis akka namni kam iyyuu akka seera biyya Roomaatti utuu fuula himattoota isaa duratti dhiʼaatee himata sana mormachuuf carraa hin argatin dabarfamee kennamuu hin qabne isaanitti himeera.
english: I answered them that it is not the custom of the Romans to give up any man to destruction before the accused has met the accusers face to face and has had opportunity to make his defense concerning the matter laid against him.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani yommuu isaan na wajjin as dhufanitti barcuma murtii irra taaʼeen akka namicha natti fidan ajaje malee dubbii sana lafa irra hin harkifne.
english: When therefore they had come together here, I didn’t delay, but on the next day sat on the judgment seat and commanded the man to be brought.

kikuyu: Himattoonni isaas yommuu dubbachuuf kaʼanitti yakka ani ittiin isa himatu jedhee eege keessaa tokko illee isa irratti hin dhiʼeessine.
english: When the accusers stood up, they brought no charges against him of such things as I supposed;

kikuyu: Garuu isaan waaʼee amantaa isaaniitii fi waaʼee namicha duʼe kan Yesuus jedhamu isa Phaawulos immoo, ‘Inni jiraataa dha’ jedhee falmuu tokkoo irratti wal dhaban.
english: but had certain questions against him about their own religion and about one Jesus, who was dead, whom Paul affirmed to be alive.

kikuyu: Anis akka itti dubbii sana qoradhu wallaale; kanaaf inni Yerusaalem dhaqee himata kana irratti qoratamuuf fedhii qabuu fi akka inni hin qabne isa gaafadhe.
english: Being perplexed how to inquire concerning these things, I asked whether he was willing to go to Jerusalem and there be judged concerning these matters.

kikuyu: Garuu yommuu Phaawulos murtii Awugisxoos Qeesaar argachuuf jedhee turfamuu kadhatetti ani akka inni hamma ani Qeesaaritti isa ergutti eegamu nan ajaje.”
english: But when Paul had appealed to be kept for the decision of the emperor, I commanded him to be kept until I could send him to Caesar.”

kikuyu: Agriiphaanis Fesxoosiin, “Ani mataan koo namicha kana dhagaʼuu nan barbaada” jedhe. Inni immoo deebisee, “Bori isa dhageessa” jedheen.
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “I also would like to hear the man myself.” “Tomorrow,” he said, “you shall hear him.”

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanuttis Agriiphaa fi Barniiqeen ulfina guddaan dhufanii Ajajjuuwwan kumaatii fi gurguddoota magaalaa wajjin galma wal gaʼii seenan. Fesxoos ajajnaan Phaawulosin ol galchan.
english: So on the next day, when Agrippa and Bernice had come with great pomp, and they had entered into the place of hearing with the commanding officers and the principal men of the city, at the command of Festus, Paul was brought in.

kikuyu: Fesxoosis akkana jedhe; “Yaa Agriiphaa mooticha, warri nu wajjin as jirtan hundinuus isin namicha kana ni argitu! Hawaasni Yihuudootaa guutummaatti, ‘Namichi kun siʼachi jiraachuu hin qabu’ jedhanii waaʼee isaa Yerusaalemittii fi as Qiisaariyaatti iyyanii na kadhatan.
english: Festus said, “King Agrippa, and all men who are here present with us, you see this man about whom all the multitude of the Jews petitioned me, both at Jerusalem and here, crying that he ought not to live any longer.

kikuyu: Ani waan duʼaan isa gaʼu kan inni hojjete tokko illee hin argine; ani garuu sababii inni Awugisxoositti ol iyyateef gara Roomaatti isa erguu nan murteesse.
english: But when I found that he had committed nothing worthy of death, and as he himself appealed to the emperor, I determined to send him,

kikuyu: Ani waaʼee namicha kanaa waan ifatti baʼe kan gooftaa kootiif barreessu tokko illee hin qabu; kanaafuu ani erga isa qorannee booddee akka waan barreessu argadhuuf jedhee fuula hunda keessanii duratti, keessumattuu yaa Agriiphaa mooticha, fuula kee duratti isa dhiʼeesseera.
english: of whom I have no certain thing to write to my lord. Therefore I have brought him out before you, and especially before you, King Agrippa, that, after examination I may have something to write.

kikuyu: Ani nama hidhame tokko utuu waan inni ittiin himatame ifatti hin baasin ol dabarsuu qajeela hin seʼuutii.”
english: For it seems to me unreasonable, in sending a prisoner, not to also specify the charges against him.”

kikuyu: Agriiphaan Phaawulosiin, “Akka ati ofii keetiif dubbattu siif eeyyamameera” jedhe. Phaawulosis harkaan mallattoo kennee akkana jedhee falmachuu jalqabe;
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “You may speak for yourself.” Then Paul stretched out his hand, and made his defense.

kikuyu: “Yaa Agriiphaa Mooticha, ani sababii waan Yihuudoonni ittiin na himatan hunda falmachuudhaaf jedhee harʼa fuula kee dura dhaabadhuuf akka ayyaantuu tokkoottin of ilaala.
english: “I think myself happy, King Agrippa, that I am to make my defense before you today concerning all the things the Jews accuse me of,

kikuyu: Kunis waan ati duudhaa fi wal mormii Yihuudootaa hunda keessa beektuufii dha. Kanaafuu ani akka ati obsaan na dhaggeeffattu sin kadhadha.
english: especially because you are expert in all customs and questions which are among the Jews. Therefore I beg you to hear me patiently.

kikuyu: “Ani ijoollummaa kootii jalqabee saba koo keessatti, Yerusaalem keessattis akkamitti akka jiraachaa ture Yihuudoonni hundinuu ni beeku.
english: “Indeed, all the Jews know my way of life from my youth up, which was from the beginning among my own nation and at Jerusalem;

kikuyu: Akka ani akka Fariisicha tokkootti akkuma sirna garee akka malee amantaa keenyatti cichu sanaatti jiraadhe isaanuu bara dheeraa waan na beekaniif, yoo fedhii qabaatan dhugaa baʼuu ni dandaʼu.
english: having known me from the first, if they are willing to testify, that after the strictest sect of our religion I lived a Pharisee.

kikuyu: Ammas ani waadaa Waaqni abbootii keenyaaf gale sana waan abdadhuuf qoratamuuf dhiʼaadheen as jira.
english: Now I stand here to be judged for the hope of the promise made by God to our fathers,

kikuyu: Waadaan kun isuma gosoonni keenya kudha lamaan halkanii guyyaa Waaqa tajaajiluutti jabaatanii raawwatamuu isaa arguu hawwan sanaa dha. Yaa Agriiphaa Mooticha, Yihuudoonnis sababuma abdii kanaatiif na himachaa jiru.
english: which our twelve tribes, earnestly serving night and day, hope to attain. Concerning this hope I am accused by the Jews, King Agrippa!

kikuyu: Akka Waaqni warra duʼan duʼaa kaasu isin maaliif akka waan hin amanamne tokkootti herregdu?
english: Why is it judged incredible with you if God does raise the dead?

kikuyu: “Ani mataan koo iyyuu maqaa Yesuus nama Naazreetiitiin mormuudhaaf akka waan dandaʼamu hunda gochuu qabu nan amana ture.
english: “I myself most certainly thought that I ought to do many things contrary to the name of Jesus of Nazareth.

kikuyu: Wanni ani Yerusaalem keessatti hojjedhes kanuma; ani taayitaa luboota hangafoota irraa argadheen qulqulloota baayʼee mana hidhaatti naquu qofa utuu hin taʼin yeroo isaan ajjeefaman iyyuu dubbicha irratti walii galaan ture.
english: I also did this in Jerusalem. I both shut up many of the saints in prisons, having received authority from the chief priests; and when they were put to death I gave my vote against them.

kikuyu: Anis akka isaan adabamaniif yeroo baayʼee mana sagadaa tokko irraa gara mana sagadaa biraatti darbaa, akka isaan amantii isaanii arrabsaniifis isaan dirqisiisaan ture. Ani waan akka malee isaanitti aaraa tureef hamma magaalaawwan biyya alaatti illee deemee isaan ariʼachaan ture.
english: Punishing them often in all the synagogues, I tried to make them blaspheme. Being exceedingly enraged against them, I persecuted them even to foreign cities.

kikuyu: “Anis gaafa tokko kanumaaf jedhee taayitaa fi ergama luboota hangafoota biraa fudhadhee utuun Damaasqoo deemaa jiruu,
english: “Whereupon as I traveled to Damascus with the authority and commission from the chief priests,

kikuyu: yaa mooticha, ani utuman karaa deemaa jiruu gara saafaatti ifa ifa aduu caalaa ibsu tokko isaa samii irraa naannoo koottii fi naannoo warra na wajjin deemaniitti ibsu arge.
english: at noon, O king, I saw on the way a light from the sky, brighter than the sun, shining around me and those who traveled with me.

kikuyu: Hundi keenya lafatti kukkufne; anis sagalee afaan Ibraayisxiitiin ‘Yaa Saaʼol, yaa Saaʼol, ati maaliif na ariʼatta? Arfii wayii dhiituun suma miidha’ naan jedhu tokkon dhagaʼe.
english: When we had all fallen to the earth, I heard a voice saying to me in the Hebrew language, ‘Saul, Saul, why are you persecuting me? It is hard for you to kick against the goads.’

kikuyu: “Anis, ‘Yaa Gooftaa ati Eenyu?’ jedheen gaafadhe. “Gooftaanis deebisee akkana jedhe; ‘Ani Yesuus isa ati ariʼattuu dha.
english: “I said, ‘Who are you, Lord?’ “He said, ‘I am Jesus, whom you are persecuting.

kikuyu: Amma kaʼii miilla keetiin dhaabadhu. Ani akka ati tajaajilaa koo taatee, waaʼee koos waan argitee fi waan ani sitti mulʼisuuf jiru dhugaa baatuuf si muuduuf jedhee sitti mulʼadheera.
english: But arise, and stand on your feet, for I have appeared to you for this purpose: to appoint you a servant and a witness both of the things which you have seen and of the things which I will reveal to you;

kikuyu: Ani saba keetii fi Namoota Ormaa kanneen gara isaaniitti si ergu jalaa sin baasa.
english: delivering you from the people and from the Gentiles, to whom I send you,

kikuyu: Atis ija isaanii bantee dukkana keessaa gara ifaatti, humna Seexanaa jalaas gara Waaqaatti isaan deebifta; kunis akka isaan dhiifama cubbuu argatanii fi akka isaan warra natti amanuun qulqullaaʼan gidduutti dhaala argataniif.’
english: to open their eyes, that they may turn from darkness to light and from the power of Satan to God, that they may receive remission of sins and an inheritance among those who are sanctified by faith in me.’

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu yaa Agriiphaa Mooticha, ani mulʼata samii irraa dhufe sanaaf ajajamuu hin didne.
english: “Therefore, King Agrippa, I was not disobedient to the heavenly vision,

kikuyu: Anis akka isaan qalbii jijjiirratanii gara Waaqaatti deebiʼaniif, qalbii jijjiirrachuu isaaniis akka hojiidhaan mirkaneessaniif jalqabatti warra Damaasqootti, warra Yerusaalemiitti, warra Yihuudaa guutuutti akkasumas Namoota Ormaatti lallabeera.
english: but declared first to them of Damascus, at Jerusalem, and throughout all the country of Judea, and also to the Gentiles, that they should repent and turn to God, doing works worthy of repentance.

kikuyu: Sababiin Yihuudoonni mana qulqullummaa keessatti na qabanii na ajjeesuu yaalaniifis kanuma.
english: For this reason the Jews seized me in the temple and tried to kill me.

kikuyu: Ani garuu hamma guyyaa harʼaatti gargaarsa Waaqaa qaba; kanaafuu ani dhaabadhee xinnaa guddaaf dhugaa baʼaan jira. Ani waan raajonnii fi Museen ‘Ni taʼa’ jedhanii dubbataniin alatti waan tokko illee hin dubbadhu.
english: Having therefore obtained the help that is from God, I stand to this day testifying both to small and great, saying nothing but what the prophets and Moses said would happen,

kikuyu: Kunis akka Kiristoos dhiphachuu qabu, akka inni warra duʼan keessaa kaʼuudhaan kan jalqabaa taʼee saba isaatii fi Namoota Ormaatiif ifa labsuu dha.”
english: how the Christ must suffer, and how, by the resurrection of the dead, he would be first to proclaim light both to these people and to the Gentiles.”

kikuyu: Utuma Phaawulos akkasitti falmachaa jiruu Fesxoos sagalee guddaan, “Phaawulos, ati maraatteerta! Barumsi kee guddaan sun si maraachisaa jira” jedheen.
english: As he thus made his defense, Festus said with a loud voice, “Paul, you are crazy! Your great learning is driving you insane!”

kikuyu: Phaawulosis akkana jedhee deebise; “Yaa Fesxoos kabajamaa, ani hin maraanne; wanni ani dubbachaa jirus dhugaa dha; sirrii dhas.
english: But he said, “I am not crazy, most excellent Festus, but boldly declare words of truth and reasonableness.

kikuyu: Sababii mootichi waan kana beekuuf, ani ifatti baasee isatti himuu nan dandaʼa. Sababii wanni kun suuqatti hin hojjetaminiif ani akka waan kana keessaa tokko iyyuu isa duraa hin dhokatin nan amana.
english: For the king knows of these things, to whom also I speak freely. For I am persuaded that none of these things is hidden from him, for this has not been done in a corner.

kikuyu: Yaa Agriiphaa Mooticha, ati raajota ni amantaa? Akka ati amantu ani iyyuu beeka.”
english: King Agrippa, do you believe the prophets? I know that you believe.”

kikuyu: Agriiphaanis Phaawulosiin, “Ati yeruma gabaabaa keessatti Kiristaana na gochuu yaaddaa?” jedhe.
english: Agrippa said to Paul, “With a little persuasion are you trying to make me a Christian?”

kikuyu: Phaawulosis deebisee, “Yeroo gabaabaattis taʼu dheeraatti, si qofa utuu hin taʼin akka warri na dhagaʼaa jiran hundinuu foncaa kanaan hidhamuu malee akkuma koo akka taʼan ani Waaqa nan kadhadha” jedhe.
english: Paul said, “I pray to God, that whether with little or with much, not only you, but also all that hear me today, might become such as I am, except for these bonds.”

kikuyu: Kana irratti mootichi, bulchaanii fi Barniiqeen, akkasumas warri isaan wajjin tataaʼaa turan ol kaʼan.
english: The king rose up with the governor and Bernice, and those who sat with them.

kikuyu: Isaanis yeroo gad baʼanitti, “Namichi kun waan duʼaan yookaan hidhaan isa gaʼu tokko illee hin hojjenne” wajjin jedhan.
english: When they had withdrawn, they spoke to one another, saying, “This man does nothing worthy of death or of bonds.”

kikuyu: Agriiphaanis Fesxoosiin, “Namichi kun utuu Qeesaaritti ol iyyachuu baatee silaa ni hiikama ture” jedhe.
english: Agrippa said to Festus, “This man might have been set free if he had not appealed to Caesar.”

kikuyu: Yommuu dooniin Iixaaliyaa dhaquun keenya murteeffametti, Phaawulosii fi warri hidhaman biraa ajajaa dhibbaa kan Yuuliyoos jedhamu tokkotti dabarfamanii kennaman; innis miseensa kutaa waraanaa “Awugisxoos” jedhamu tokkoo ture.
english: When it was determined that we should sail for Italy, they delivered Paul and certain other prisoners to a centurion named Julius, of the Augustan band.

kikuyu: Nus doonii Adraamiixoosii kaʼee gara buufatawwan doonii kanneen qarqara galaana biyya Asiyaa dhaquuf kaʼe tokko yaabbannee deemuu jalqabne. Arisxirokoos namichi Maqedooniyaa kan Tasaloniiqee jiraatu tokkos nu wajjin ture.
english: Embarking in a ship of Adramyttium, which was about to sail to places on the coast of Asia, we put to sea, Aristarchus, a Macedonian of Thessalonica being with us.

kikuyu: Guyyaa itti aanutti Siidoonaatti galle; Yuuliyoosis Phaawulosiif garaa laafee akka inni michoota isaa bira dhaqee waan isa barbaachisu argatu eeyyameef.
english: The next day, we touched at Sidon. Julius treated Paul kindly and gave him permission to go to his friends and refresh himself.

kikuyu: Nus dooniin achii kaanee waan bubbeen fuula keenya duraan nutti bubbisaa tureef Qophiroosiin daʼannee dabarre.
english: Putting to sea from there, we sailed under the lee of Cyprus, because the winds were contrary.

kikuyu: Erga galaana Kiilqiyaa fi Phamfiliyaa irra dooniin darbinee booddee magaalaa Miiraa kan Luuqiiyaa keessatti argamtu geenye.
english: When we had sailed across the sea which is off Cilicia and Pamphylia, we came to Myra, a city of Lycia.

kikuyu: Ajajaan dhibbaa sunis doonii Iskindiriyaa kan Iixaaliyaa dhaquutti jiru tokko achitti argatee nu yaabbachiise.
english: There the centurion found a ship of Alexandria sailing for Italy, and he put us on board.

kikuyu: Nus guyyaa hedduu suuta jennee dooniin deemnee rakkinaan naannoo Kiniidoos geenye; yommuu bubbeen karaa sana irra darbuu nu dhowwettis Salmoonee biraan gara daʼoo Qareexitti qajeelle.
english: When we had sailed slowly many days, and had come with difficulty opposite Cnidus, the wind not allowing us further, we sailed under the lee of Crete, opposite Salmone.

kikuyu: Rakkina guddaadhaanis qarqara galaanichaa irra darbinee iddoo “Buufata doonii gaarii” jedhamu kan magaalaa Laasiyaa biraa tokkotti baane.
english: With difficulty sailing along it we came to a certain place called Fair Havens, near the city of Lasea.

kikuyu: Yeroon dheeraan badeera; sababii yeroon sun erga Soomni darbee taʼeef dooniidhaan karaa deemuun sodaachisaa taʼeera; kanaafuu Phaawulos akkana jedhee isaan akeekkachiise;
english: When much time had passed and the voyage was now dangerous because the Fast had now already gone by, Paul admonished them

kikuyu: “Yaa jarana, ani akka karaan keenya kun badiisa of keessaa qabu, akka inni doonichattii fi miʼa qofatti utuu hin taʼin jireenya keenyatti illee balaa guddaa fiduuf deemu nan arga.”
english: and said to them, “Sirs, I perceive that the voyage will be with injury and much loss, not only of the cargo and the ship, but also of our lives.”

kikuyu: Ajajaan dhibbaa sun garuu qooda waan Phaawulos jedhe dhagaʼu gorsa ooftuu dooniitii fi gorsa abbaa doonii fudhate.
english: But the centurion gave more heed to the master and to the owner of the ship than to those things which were spoken by Paul.

kikuyu: Sababii buufanni doonii sun ganna achi turuuf mijaaʼaa hin taʼiniif baayʼeen isaanii Finiiqeetti galanii ganna achitti dabarsuu abdatanii akka nu ittuma fufnee dooniin deemnu murteessan. Buufanni Qareexi kun fuulli isaa gara kibba dhiʼaattii fi gara kaaba dhiʼaatti deebiʼee ture.
english: Because the haven was not suitable to winter in, the majority advised going to sea from there, if by any means they could reach Phoenix and winter there, which is a port of Crete, looking southwest and northwest.

kikuyu: Yeroo bubbeen kibbaa suuta bubbisuu jalqabetti waan kaayyoo isaanii guutachuu dandaʼan seʼanii hiituu doonii hiikanii Qareexi biraan qarqara galaana irra darban.
english: When the south wind blew softly, supposing that they had obtained their purpose, they weighed anchor and sailed along Crete, close to shore.

kikuyu: Utuu hin turinis bubbeen hamaan, “Awuraaqiis” jedhamu tokko biyya bishaaniin marfamte sana irraa gad bubbise.
english: But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.

kikuyu: Dooniin sunis bubbeedhaan qabamee gara bubbee sanaatti deemuu dadhabe; kanaafuu akka inni bubbeen fudhatamuuf ittuma dhiifne.
english: When the ship was caught and couldn’t face the wind, we gave way to it and were driven along.

kikuyu: Nus biyya bishaaniin marfamte xinnoo Qeedaa jedhamtu tokkoon daʼannee rakkina guddaadhaan bidiruu doonichaa oolchuu dandeenye.
english: Running under the lee of a small island called Clauda, we were able, with difficulty, to secure the boat.

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis bidiruu sana dooniitti ol baasanii akka dooniin sun gargar hin diigamneef funyoon xaxanii walitti hidhan. Isaanis tima cirracha Sirtiisitti buʼuu sodaatanii hiituu doonii galaanatti gad buusanii akka dooniin sun bubbeen oofamtuuf ittuma dhiisan.
english: After they had hoisted it up, they used cables to help reinforce the ship. Fearing that they would run aground on the Syrtis sand bars, they lowered the sea anchor, and so were driven along.

kikuyu: Waan bubbeen sun akka malee nutti jabaachaa deemeef isaan guyyaa itti aanutti doonii sana irraa feʼiisa guuranii bishaanitti dadarbachuu jalqaban.
english: As we labored exceedingly with the storm, the next day they began to throw things overboard.

kikuyu: Guyyaa sadaffaatti immoo miʼa doonii sanaa harkuma ofii isaaniitiin dadarbatan.
english: On the third day, they threw out the ship’s tackle with their own hands.

kikuyu: Nu waan utuu aduu yookaan urjii hin argin guyyaa hedduu turree fi waan bubbeen nutti jabaateef dhuma irratti abdii badiisa ooluuf qabnu hunda ni kutanne.
english: When neither sun nor stars shone on us for many days, and no small storm pressed on us, all hope that we would be saved was now taken away.

kikuyu: Phaawulosis erga namoonni sun agabuu isaanii yeroo dheeraa turanii booddee gidduu isaanii dhaabatee akkana jedhe; “Yaa jarana, isin utuu gorsa koo dhageessanii Qareexii kaʼuu hin qabdan ture; silaa balaa fi badiisa kana hundumaa irraa of oolchitu turtan.
english: When they had been long without food, Paul stood up in the middle of them and said, “Sirs, you should have listened to me, and not have set sail from Crete and have gotten this injury and loss.

kikuyu: Amma garuu ani akka isin jabaattan isinan gorsa; doonicha malee isin keessaa lubbuun nama tokkoo iyyuu hin baduutii.
english: Now I exhort you to cheer up, for there will be no loss of life among you, but only of the ship.

kikuyu: Ergamaan Waaqa ani kan isaa taʼee fi isa tajaajilu sanaa tokko eda dhufee na cina dhaabatee,
english: For there stood by me this night an angel, belonging to the God whose I am and whom I serve,

kikuyu: ‘Yaa Phaawulos, hin sodaatin; ati Qeesaar dura dhaabachuu qabdaatii; kunoo, Waaqni warra si wajjin deemaa jiran hunda gaarummaa isaatiin sitti kenneera’ naan jedhe.
english: saying, ‘Don’t be afraid, Paul. You must stand before Caesar. Behold, God has granted you all those who sail with you.’

kikuyu: Kanaaf yaa jarana jabaadhaa! Ani akka wanni kun akkuma natti himame sana taʼu Waaqa nan amanaatii.
english: Therefore, sirs, cheer up! For I believe God, that it will be just as it has been spoken to me.

kikuyu: Taʼus biyya bishaaniin marfamte tokkotti buʼuun keenya hin oolu.”
english: But we must run aground on a certain island.”

kikuyu: Halkan kudha afuraffaatti utuu galaana Adiriyaa irra asii fi achi oofamaa jirruu gara halkan walakkaatti warri doonii irra hojjetan sun waan gara lafaatti dhiʼaatan seʼan.
english: But when the fourteenth night had come, as we were driven back and forth in the Adriatic Sea, about midnight the sailors surmised that they were drawing near to some land.

kikuyu: Isaan funyoo ittiin gad fageenya galaanaa ilaalan gad buusanii akka galaanni sun meetira soddomii torba gad fagaatu argan; yeroo gabaabaa booddee ammas funyoo sana gad buusanii akka gad fageenyi galaanichaa meetira digdamii saddeet taʼe argan.
english: They took soundings and found twenty fathoms. After a little while, they took soundings again, and found fifteen fathoms.

kikuyu: Isaanis kattaatti buuna jedhanii sodaatanii hiituu doonii afur dugda duubaan doonii irraa gad buusan. Akka lafti bariituufis kadhatan.
english: Fearing that we would run aground on rocky ground, they let go four anchors from the stern, and wished for daylight.

kikuyu: Warri doonii irra hojjetanis bidiruu keessaa baqachuuf jedhanii waan fuula doonii duraan hiituu doonii buusan fakkaatanii bidiruu sana galaana keessa buusan.
english: As the sailors were trying to flee out of the ship and had lowered the boat into the sea, pretending that they would lay out anchors from the bow,

kikuyu: Phaawulos immoo ajajaa dhibbaatii fi loltootaan, “Yoo namoonni kunneen doonii keessatti hafan malee isin badii ooluu hin dandeessan” jedhe.
english: Paul said to the centurion and to the soldiers, “Unless these stay in the ship, you can’t be saved.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu loltoonni sun funyoo bidirichi ittiin hidhamee ture sana irraa kutanii galaanatti gad ishee dhiisan.
english: Then the soldiers cut away the ropes of the boat and let it fall off.

kikuyu: Gara barii lafaattis Phaawulos akka namoonni hundinuu waa nyaataniif isaan kadhate; akkanas jedheen; “Isin bultii kudha afran darban yaaddaʼaa, utuu waa tokko illee hin nyaatin agabuu keessan ooltanii bultaniirtu.
english: While the day was coming on, Paul begged them all to take some food, saying, “Today is the fourteenth day that you wait and continue fasting, having taken nothing.

kikuyu: Kanaaf ani akka isin waa nyaattaniif isin kadhadha. Nyaanni jiraachuuf isin barbaachisaatii. Isin keessaa nama kam iyyuu rifeensa mataa isaa keessaa tokko iyyuu hin baduutii.”
english: Therefore I beg you to take some food, for this is for your safety; for not a hair will perish from any of your heads.”

kikuyu: Innis erga waan kana dubbatee booddee buddeena fuudhee hunduma isaanii duratti Waaqa galateeffate; kutatees nyaachuu jalqabe.
english: When he had said this and had taken bread, he gave thanks to God in the presence of all; then he broke it and began to eat.

kikuyu: Isaan hundinuu jajjabaatanii ofumaan waa nyaatan.
english: Then they all cheered up, and they also took food.

kikuyu: Walumatti nu nama 276 taanee doonii sana keessa ture.
english: In all, we were two hundred seventy-six souls on the ship.

kikuyu: Isaanis erga nyaatanii quufanii booddee qamadii feʼamee ture sana galaanatti naqanii akka dooniin salphatu godhan.
english: When they had eaten enough, they lightened the ship, throwing out the wheat into the sea.

kikuyu: Isaanis yommuu lafti bariitetti galoo galaanaa kan kuufama cirrachaa qabu tokko argan malee biyyi fuula isaanii dura jiru sun eessa akka taʼe hin hubanne; doonii sanas yoo isaanii dandaʼame dhiibanii qarqara galaanaatti baasuu murteessan.
english: When it was day, they didn’t recognize the land, but they noticed a certain bay with a beach, and they decided to try to drive the ship onto it.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu funyoo hiituu doonii kutanii galaana keessatti gad dhiisan; yeruma sana funyoo batoon ittiin hidhame sana hiikan; ergasiis sharaa karaa fuula doonii duraan jiru sana qilleensatti ol fuudhanii gara kuufama cirrachaatti qajeelan.
english: Casting off the anchors, they left them in the sea, at the same time untying the rudder ropes. Hoisting up the foresail to the wind, they made for the beach.

kikuyu: Garuu dooniin sun iddoo itti galaanni lama wal gaʼutti tima cirrachaatti buʼee lafa tuqe. Mataan isaa achitti qabamee sochoʼuu dide; dudga duubni isaa immoo humna dhaʼaa galaanaatiin dhaʼamee caccabe.
english: But coming to a place where two seas met, they ran the vessel aground. The bow struck and remained immovable, but the stern began to break up by the violence of the waves.

kikuyu: Loltoonnis akka warra hidhaman sana keessaa namni tokko iyyuu bishaan daakee baqatee jalaa hin baaneef isaan ajjeesuuf karoorfatan.
english: The soldiers’ counsel was to kill the prisoners, so that none of them would swim out and escape.

kikuyu: Garuu ajajaan dhibbaa sun waan Phaawulosin duʼa oolchuu fedheef akka isaan waan karoorfatan sana hin goone dhowwe; innis akka warri bishaan daakuu dandaʼan duraan dursanii doonii irraa utaalanii gara lafaatti baʼan ajaje.
english: But the centurion, desiring to save Paul, stopped them from their purpose, and commanded that those who could swim should throw themselves overboard first to go toward the land;

kikuyu: Akka warri hafan immoo saanqaa yookaan caccabaa dooniitiin achi gaʼan ajaje; haala kanaan hundi isaanii nagaan lafatti baʼan.
english: and the rest should follow, some on planks and some on other things from the ship. So they all escaped safely to the land.

kikuyu: Nus nagumaan qarqara galaanaatti baanee akka biyyi bishaaniin marfamte sun Malaaxiyaa jedhamtu beekne.
english: When we had escaped, then they learned that the island was called Malta.

kikuyu: Namoonni biyya bishaaniin marfamte sana irra jiraatanis gara laafina dinqisiisaa nu argisiisan. Isaanis sababii roobnii fi dhaamochi tureef ibidda bobeessanii hunda keenya simatan.
english: The natives showed us uncommon kindness; for they kindled a fire and received us all, because of the present rain and because of the cold.

kikuyu: Utuu Phaawulos hanxaxii qoraanii walitti qabee ibiddatti naqaa jiruu buutiin sababii hoʼaatiin gad baate tokko harka isaatti maxxantee gad dhiisuu didde.
english: But when Paul had gathered a bundle of sticks and laid them on the fire, a viper came out because of the heat and fastened on his hand.

kikuyu: Warri biyya bishaaniin marfamte sana irra jiraatan sunis buutii harka isaatti rarraatu arganii, “Namichi kun nama nama ajjeese taʼuu hin oolu; inni yoo balaa galaanaa jalaa baʼe illee Murtiin Qajeelaan akka inni jiraatu hin eeyyamneef” waliin jedhan.
english: When the natives saw the creature hanging from his hand, they said to one another, “No doubt this man is a murderer, whom, though he has escaped from the sea, yet Justice has not allowed to live.”

kikuyu: Phaawulos buutii sana ibidda keessa of irraa buuse; miidhaa tokko malees hafe.
english: However he shook off the creature into the fire, and wasn’t harmed.

kikuyu: Namoonni sunis, “Inni ni dhiitaʼa yookaan akkuma tasaa kufee duʼa” jedhanii eegan; garuu yommuu yeroo dheeraa eeganii akka inni waa tokko illee hin taʼin arganitti yaada geeddaratanii, “Inni waaqa” jedhan.
english: But they expected that he would have swollen or fallen down dead suddenly, but when they watched for a long time and saw nothing bad happen to him, they changed their minds and said that he was a god.

kikuyu: Bulchaan biyya bishaaniin marfamtee kan Phubiliyoos jedhamu tokkos naannoo sanaa lafa qotiisaa qaba ture; innis mana isaatti nu simatee guyyaa sadii jaalalaan nu keessumsiise.
english: Now in the neighborhood of that place were lands belonging to the chief man of the island, named Publius, who received us and courteously entertained us for three days.

kikuyu: Abbaan Phubiliyoos dhukkuba dhagna nama gubuu fi garaa nama kaasuun qabamee ciisaa ture; Phaawulosis isa gaafachuuf ol seenee erga kadhatee booddee harka irra kaaʼee isa fayyise.
english: The father of Publius lay sick of fever and dysentery. Paul entered in to him, prayed, and laying his hands on him, healed him.

kikuyu: Yommuu wanni kun taʼetti dhukkubsattoonni biyya bishaaniin marfamte sana irra jiraatan biraa hundi dhufanii fayyan.
english: Then when this was done, the rest also who had diseases in the island came and were cured.

kikuyu: Isaanis karaa baayʼeedhaan ulfina nuu kennan; yommuu nu dooniin deemuuf kaanettis waan nu barbaachisu hunda nuuf kennan.
english: They also honored us with many honors; and when we sailed, they put on board the things that we needed.

kikuyu: Nus jiʼa sadii booddee doonii Iskindiriyaa kan biyya bishaaniin marfamte sana irratti yeroo gannaa dabarse tokkoon kaanee deemsa jalqabne; dooniin sunis asxaa waaqota lakkuu Kastoorii fi Paaluksi adda isaa irraa qaba ture.
english: After three months, we set sail in a ship of Alexandria which had wintered in the island, whose figurehead was “The Twin Brothers.”

kikuyu: Seraakuus geenyees bultii sadii achi turre.
english: Touching at Syracuse, we stayed there three days.

kikuyu: Achiis kaanee Reegiyuumitti galle; guyyaa tokko booddees waan bubbeen kibbaa bubbiseef guyyaa itti aanutti Putiyooluus geenye.
english: From there we circled around and arrived at Rhegium. After one day, a south wind sprang up, and on the second day we came to Puteoli,

kikuyu: Achitti obboloota tokko tokko arganne; isaanis akka nu bultii torba isaan bira turru nu kadhatan. Nus akkasiin Roomaatti galle.
english: where we found brothers, and were entreated to stay with them for seven days. So we came to Rome.

kikuyu: Obboloonni achi turanis yommuu dhufaatii keenya dhagaʼanitti hamma iddoo gabaa Aphiyuusiittii fi iddoo “Lafa Bultoo Sadii” jedhamuutti nu simachuu dhufan; Phaawulosis isaan argee Waaqa galateeffate; ofii isaatiis ni jajjabaate.
english: From there the brothers, when they heard of us, came to meet us as far as The Market of Appius and The Three Taverns. When Paul saw them, he thanked God and took courage.

kikuyu: Yommuu nu Roomaa geenyetti Phaawulos akka loltuu isa eegu tokko wajjin kophaa isaa jiraatu eeyyamameef.
english: When we entered into Rome, the centurion delivered the prisoners to the captain of the guard, but Paul was allowed to stay by himself with the soldier who guarded him.

kikuyu: Phaawulosis guyyaa sadii booddee dura buʼoota Yihuudootaa walitti waame; yommuu isaan walitti qabamanittis akkana jedheen; “Yaa obboloota ko, ani utuu waan saba keenyaan yookaan duudhaa abbootii keenyaatiin mormu tokko illee hin hojjetin Yerusaalem keessatti qabamee dabarfamee harka warra Roomaatti kennameera.
english: After three days Paul called together those who were the leaders of the Jews. When they had come together, he said to them, “I, brothers, though I had done nothing against the people or the customs of our fathers, still was delivered prisoner from Jerusalem into the hands of the Romans,

kikuyu: Isaanis erga na qoranii booddee sababii ani yakka duʼa namatti mursiisu tokko illee hin qabaatiniif gad na dhiisuu barbaadan.
english: who, when they had examined me, desired to set me free, because there was no cause of death in me.

kikuyu: Ani garuu yoo waan ittiin saba koo himadhu tokko iyyuu hin qabaatin illee yommuu Yihuudoonni mormanitti akka Qeesaaritti ol iyyadhu nan dirqame.
english: But when the Jews spoke against it, I was constrained to appeal to Caesar, not that I had anything about which to accuse my nation.

kikuyu: Wanni ani isin arguu fi isin wajjin haasaʼuu kadhadheefis kanuma. Ani sababuma abdii Israaʼeliif jedhee foncaa kanaan hidhameera.”
english: For this cause therefore I asked to see you and to speak with you. For because of the hope of Israel I am bound with this chain.”

kikuyu: Isaanis akkana jedhanii deebisan; “Nu xalayaa waaʼee kee dubbatu tokko illee biyya Yihuudaatii hin arganne; obboloota achii dhufan keessaas namni tokko iyyuu waaʼee kee waan hamaa hin dubbanne; nuttis hin himne.
english: They said to him, “We neither received letters from Judea concerning you, nor did any of the brothers come here and report or speak any evil of you.

kikuyu: Nu garuu yaadni kee maal akka taʼe sirraa dhagaʼuu barbaanna; nu akka namoonni iddoo hunda jiran garee kanaan morman ni beeknaatii.”
english: But we desire to hear from you what you think. For, as concerning this sect, it is known to us that everywhere it is spoken against.”

kikuyu: Isaanis guyyaa itti Phaawulos wajjin wal argan qabatanii, akka malee baayʼatanii lafa inni jiraachaa ture dhaqan; innis ganamaa jalqabee hamma galgalaatti waaʼee mootummaa Waaqaa isaanii ibsaa, lallabaas ture; waaʼee Yesuusiis Seera Museetii fi Kitaabota Raajotaa keessaa eeree isaan amansiisuu yaalaa ture.
english: When they had appointed him a day, many people came to him at his lodging. He explained to them, testifying about God’s Kingdom, and persuading them concerning Jesus, both from the law of Moses and from the prophets, from morning until evening.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa warri tokko tokko waan inni jedhe ni fudhatan; warri kaan immoo amanuu didan.
english: Some believed the things which were spoken, and some disbelieved.

kikuyu: Isaan gidduutti waldhabiisni uumamnaan kaʼanii deemuu jalqaban; kunis erga Phaawulos akkana jedhee dubbii dhumaa dubbatee booddee; “Hafuurri Qulqulluun yeroo karaa Isaayyaas raajichaatiin abbootii keessanitti dubbate sana dhugaa isaa dubbate; innis akkana jedhe:
english: When they didn’t agree among themselves, they departed after Paul had spoken one message: “The Holy Spirit spoke rightly through Isaiah the prophet to our fathers,

kikuyu: “ ‘Gara saba kanaa dhaqiitii akkana jedhi; “Dhagaʼuu inuma dhageessu; garuu hin hubattan; ilaaluus inuma ilaaltu; garuu hin qalbeeffattan.”
english: saying, ‘Go to this people and say, in hearing, you will hear, but will in no way understand. In seeing, you will see, but will in no way perceive.

kikuyu: Qalbiin saba kanaa doomeeraatii; gurri isaanii sirriitti hin dhagaʼu; ija isaaniis dunuunfataniiru; utuu akkas taʼuu baatee silaa ija isaaniitiin arganii, gurra isaaniitiin dhagaʼanii, qalbii isaaniitiinis hubatanii, ni deebiʼu turan; anis isaan nan fayyisa ture.’
english: For this people’s heart has grown callous. Their ears are dull of hearing. Their eyes they have closed. Lest they should see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their heart, and would turn again, then I would heal them.’

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu ani akka fayyisuun Waaqaa gara Namoota Ormaatti ergame akka isin beektan nan barbaada! Isaanis ni dhagaʼu.” [
english: “Be it known therefore to you that the salvation of God is sent to the nations, and they will listen.”

kikuyu: Yihuudoonnis erga inni waan kana dubbatee booddee jabeessanii waliin mormaa achii deeman.]
english: When he had said these words, the Jews departed, having a great dispute among themselves.

kikuyu: Phaawulosis waggaa lama guutuu mana ofii isaatii kireeffate keessa jiraachaa, warra isa dubbisuu dhufan hundas simachaa ture.
english: Paul stayed two whole years in his own rented house and received all who were coming to him,

kikuyu: Innis ija jabinaan, gufuu tokko malees mootummaa Waaqaa lallabaa, waaʼee Gooftaa Yesuus Kiristoosis barsiisaa ture.
english: preaching God’s Kingdom and teaching the things concerning the Lord Jesus Christ with all boldness, without hindrance.

kikuyu: Phaawulos tajaajilaa Kiristoos Yesuus, kan ergamaa taʼuuf waamamee fi akka wangeela Waaqaa lallabuuf addaan baafame irraa:
english: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

kikuyu: Wangeelli kunis kan Waaqni duraan dursee karaa raajota isaatiin Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluu keessatti waadaa galee dha.
english: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

kikuyu: Wangeelichis waaʼee ilma isaa kan akka namummaatti sanyii Daawit irraa dhalatee,
english: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,

kikuyu: akka Hafuura qulqullummaatti immoo warra duʼan keessaa kaʼuu isaatiin Ilma Waaqaa humna qabeessa taʼuun isaa labsamee dha; innis Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos.
english: who was declared to be the Son of God with power according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

kikuyu: Nus karaa isaatiin, maqaa isaatiif jecha ormoota hunda keessaa akka gara ajajamuu amantii irraa dhufuutti namoota waamnuuf ayyaanaa fi ergamtummaa arganneerra.
english: through whom we received grace and apostleship for obedience of faith among all the nations for his name’s sake;

kikuyu: Isinis warra akka kan Yesuus Kiristoos taʼaniif waamaman sana keessa jirtu.
english: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

kikuyu: Warra Waaqaan jaallatamtanii qulqulloota taʼuuf waamamtan kanneen Roomaa jirtan hundaaf:
english: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Sababii amantiin keessan guutummaa addunyaa irratti odeeffamaa jiruuf, ani duraan dursee waaʼee hunda keessaniitiif karaa Yesuus Kiristoosiin Waaqa koo nan galateeffadha.
english: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

kikuyu: Akka ani kadhannaa koo keessatti utuu wal irraa hin kutin isin yaadadhu Waaqni ani wangeela Ilma isaa lallabuudhaan hafuura kootiin isa tajaajilu sun dhuga baatuu koo ti;
english: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

kikuyu: ani akka ammas dhuma irratti gara keessan dhufuuf fedhii Waaqaatiin karaan naa banamu nan kadhadha.
english: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

kikuyu: Akka isin jabaattaniifis kennaa hafuuraa isinii hiruuf isin arguu baayʼee nan hawwa;
english: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

kikuyu: kunis akka isinii fi ani amantii keenyaan wal jajjabeessinuuf.
english: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota ko, ani akkuma Namoota Ormaa kaan keessatti ija qabaadhe sana isin keessattis akkasuma akkan qabaadhuuf yeroo baayʼee gara keessan dhufuu yaadaa turuu ko, garuu hamma ammaatti dhowwamuu koo akka isin beekuu dhabdan hin barbaadu.
english: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you (and was hindered so far), that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Ani namoota Giriikii fi warra nama Giriik hin taʼiniif, beektotaa fi wallaaltotaaf gatii of irraa nan qaba.
english: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

kikuyu: Sababiin ani isin warra Roomaa jirtanittis wangeela lallabuuf akka malee hawwuuf kanuma.
english: So as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.
