kikuyu: Ani wangeelatti hin qaanaʼu; kunis sababii wangeelli humna Waaqaa kan warra amanan hunda fayyisu taʼeef; innis jalqabatti Yihuudootaaf, itti aansee immoo Giriikotaaf.
english: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes, for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

kikuyu: Wangeela keessatti qajeelummaan Waaqaa amantii irraa gara amantiitti mulʼateeraatii; kunis akkuma, “Namni qajeelaan amantiidhaan jiraata” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”

kikuyu: Dheekkamsi Waaqaa, Waaqa malee jiraachuu fi hammina namootaa hunda irratti samii irraa ni mulʼata; namoonni kunneen hammina isaaniitiin dhugaa ukkaamsu;
english: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

kikuyu: kunis sababii wanni waaʼee Waaqaa beekamuu malu isaaniif ifa taʼeef; Waaqni isaaniif ibseeraatii.
english: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

kikuyu: Amalli Waaqaa kan hin mulʼanne jechuunis humni isaa kan bara baraatii fi waaqummaan isaa uumama addunyaatii jalqabee wantoota uumaman irraa ifaan ifatti mulʼataatii; kanaafuu isaan waan itti qabatan hin qaban.
english: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity, that they may be without excuse.

kikuyu: Isaan yoo Waaqa beekan illee akka waaqummaa isaatti ulfina hin kennineef; galatas hin galchineef. Garuu yaadni isaanii waan faayidaa hin qabne taʼe; qalbiin isaanii kan hin hubannes ni dukkanaaʼe.
english: Because knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, and didn’t give thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

kikuyu: Isaan yoo ogeeyyii ofiin jedhan iyyuu gowwoota taʼan;
english: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

kikuyu: ulfina Waaqa hin duunees nama duʼutti, simbiratti, horii miilla afuriitti akkasumas uumamawwan lafa irra looʼanitti fakkeessuudhaan geeddaran.
english: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, four-footed animals, and creeping things.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqni akka isaan dhagna walii isaanii salphisaniif hawwii garaa isaanii hamaadhaan dabarsee xuraaʼummaatti isaan kenne.
english: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;

kikuyu: Isaanis dhugaa Waaqaa sobatti geeddaran; Uumaa dhiisanii uumama waaqeffatan; ni tajaajilanis. Uumaan bara baraan eebbifamaa dha. Ameen.
english: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf Waaqni dabarsee hawwii jibbisiisaatti isaan kenne. Dubartoonni isaaniis karaa ittiin fedhii fooniitiif dhiira wajjin wal bira gaʼan isa uumamaan kennameef dhiisanii, gara isa uumamaan isaaniif hin kennaminitti geeddaran.
english: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

kikuyu: Warri dhiiraas akkasuma karaa ittiin fedhii fooniitiif dubartoota wajjin wal bira gaʼan isa uumamaan kennameef dhiisanii kajeellaa walii isaaniitiin gubatan. Warri dhiiraa, dhiira biraa wajjin gocha jibbisiisaa raawwatan; dogoggora isaanii kanaafis adaba isaaniif malu ofuma isaaniitiin fudhatan.
english: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

kikuyu: Sababii isaan Waaqa beekuu akka waan faayidaa hin qabneetti fudhataniif, Waaqni immoo akka isaan waan hojjetamuu hin malle hojjetaniif qalbii faayidaa hin qabnetti dabarsee isaan kenne.
english: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

kikuyu: Isaanis hammina gosa hundaatiin, jalʼinaan, sassattummaan, amala baduun, hinaaffaan, nama ajjeesuun, wal loluun, gowwoomsuu fi dabaan guutaman. Isaan hamattoota,
english: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

kikuyu: warra maqaa nama balleessan, warra Waaqa jibban, warra nama arrabsan, warra of jajanii fi warra of tuulanii dha; isaan warra karaa ittiin jalʼina hojjetan yaadan, warra abbaa fi haadha isaaniitiif hin ajajamnee dha;
english: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, arrogant, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

kikuyu: isaan warra hubannaa hin qabne, warra walii galtee diigan, warra jaalala hin qabnee fi warra namaaf garaa hin laafnee dha.
english: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

kikuyu: Isaan seera Waaqaa kan, “Warra waan akkanaa hojjetan duʼuutu isaaniif mala” jedhu sana yoo beekan iyyuu ofii isaaniitiif waan akkanaa hojjechuu qofa utuu hin taʼin warra waan kana hojjetan iyyuu ni jajjabeessu.
english: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa namichoo, ati yoo abbaa fedhe illee taate kan nama kaanitti murtu waan itti qabattu hin qabdu; waan ittiin namatti murtu hundaan ofittis ni murtaatii; ati kan murtii kennitu iyyuu ofii keetiis isuma hojjettaatii.
english: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

kikuyu: Nu akka murtiin Waaqaa kan warra waan akkanaa hojjetan irratti murteeffamu dhugaa irratti hundaaʼe ni beekna.
english: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

kikuyu: Yaa namichoo, ati yommuu warra waan akkanaa hojjetanitti murtee ofii keetii immoo waanuma akkasii hojjettu waan murtii Waaqaa jalaa baatu seetaa?
english: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

kikuyu: Yookaan ati akka gara laafummaan Waaqaa gara qalbii jijjiirrannaatti si geessu utuu hin beekin baayʼina gara laafummaa isaa, gara balʼina isaatii fi obsa isaa ni tuffattaa?
english: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

kikuyu: Ati garuu sababii mata jabina keetiitii fi garaa kee isa qalbii hin jijjiirranne sanaatiif guyyaa dheekkamsa Waaqaa kan murtiin qajeelaan itti mulʼatu sanaaf dheekkamsa of irratti kuusaa jirta.
english: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God,

kikuyu: Waaqni, “Nama hundaaf akkuma hojii isaatti gatii isaa ni kenna.”
english: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”

kikuyu: Inni warra obsaan waan gaarii hojjechaa kabaja, ulfinaa fi jireenya hin dabarre barbaadaniif jireenya bara baraa ni kenna.
english: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

kikuyu: Warra ofittoo kanneen dhugaadhaaf ajajamuu didanii hammina duukaa buʼan garuu dheekkamsaa fi aariitu isaan eeggata.
english: but to those who are self-seeking and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath, indignation,

kikuyu: Nama hammina hojjetu hunda irratti, jalqabatti Yihuudii irratti, ergasii immoo Nama Ormaa irratti dhiphinnii fi rakkinni ni dhufa.
english: oppression, and anguish on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

kikuyu: Garuu nama waan gaarii hojjetu hundaaf, jalqabatti Yihuudiif, ergasii immoo Nama Ormaatiif kabajni, ulfinnii fi nagaan ni taʼa.
english: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

kikuyu: Waaqni nama wal hin caalchisuutii.
english: For there is no partiality with God.

kikuyu: Warri utuu seera hin qabaatin cubbuu hojjetan hundinuu seera malee barbadaaʼu; warra utuu seera qabanuu cubbuu hojjetan hundattis seeruma sanaan murama.
english: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

kikuyu: Sababiin isaas warra seeraaf ajajamanitu fuula Waaqaa duratti qajeeltota taasifama malee warri seera dhagaʼan qajeeltota miti.
english: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

kikuyu: Namoonni Ormaa warri seera hin qabne yoo uumamaan waan seerri ajaju hojjetan, yoo seera qabaachuu baatan illee isaan ofii isaaniitiifuu seera.
english: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

kikuyu: Isaan waan qalbiin isaanii dhugaa baʼuuf, waan yaadni isaaniis yeroo tokko isaan himatee yeroo kaan immoo isaaniif falmuuf, akka ajajni seeraa garaa isaanii keessatti barreeffame ni argisiisu.
english: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

kikuyu: Akka wangeela ani lallabuutti wanni kun gaafa Waaqni icciitii namootaa karaa Yesuus Kiristoosiin murtii itti kennutti taʼa.
english: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ati yoo Yihuudii ofiin jette, yoo seera amanatte, yoo kan Waaqaanis of jajju taate,
english: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, rest on the law, glory in God,

kikuyu: yoo fedhii isaa beekte, yoo seera sanaanis qajeelfamtee waan hunda caalu mirkaneeffatte,
english: know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

kikuyu: warra iji isaanii jaameef dura deemaa, warra dukkana keessa jiraniif immoo ifa taʼuu kee yoo amante,
english: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

kikuyu: karaa seeraatiinis beekumsaa fi dhugaa qabduun yoo wallaaltota gorsite, daaʼimmanis yoo barsiifte,
english: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

kikuyu: egaa ati kan warra kaan barsiiftu, ofii kee immoo hin barsiiftuu? Kan “Hin hatin” jettee barsiiftu ofii keetii immoo ni hattaa?
english: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

kikuyu: Ati kan, “Namni ejjuu hin qabu” jettu ofii keetii ni ejjitaa? Kan waaqota tolfamoo akka malee jibbitu mana qulqullummaa ni saamtaa?
english: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery, do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

kikuyu: Ati kan Seeraan of jajju seera cabsuudhaan Waaqa ni salphiftaa?
english: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?

kikuyu: “Sababii keessaniif maqaan Waaqaa Namoota Ormaa gidduutti arrabsama” jedhamee barreeffameeraatii.
english: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” just as it is written.

kikuyu: Yoo ati seera eegde dhagna qabaan faayidaa qaba; yoo seera cabsite garuu akka waan dhagna hin qabatinii taateerta.
english: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

kikuyu: Warri dhagna hin qabatin yoo waan seerri ajaju eegan, akka waan dhagna qabataniitti hin ilaalamanii ree?
english: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

kikuyu: Namni utuu fooniin dhagna hin qabatin seera eegu tokko si nama seera barreeffame qabaattee dhagnas qabattee seera cabsitutti ni mura.
english: Won’t those who are physically uncircumcised, but fulfill the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

kikuyu: Namni waan alaan mulʼatu qofaan Yihuudii hin taʼu; dhagna qabachuunis waan alaan mulʼatu qofa miti.
english: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

kikuyu: Garuu nama keessa namummaa isaatiin Yihuudii taʼetu Yihuudii dha; dhagna qabaanis dhagna qabaa yaada garaa kan Hafuuraan taʼuudha malee seera barreeffameen miti. Namni akkasii Waaqa biratti malee nama biratti hin jajamu.
english: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

kikuyu: Egaa Yihuudii taʼuun faayidaa maalii qaba? Yookaan buʼaan dhagna qabaa maalii?
english: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

kikuyu: Karaa hundaanuu buʼaa guddaa qaba! Jalqabatti dubbiin Waaqaa Yihuudootatti imaanaa kenname.
english: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

kikuyu: Isaan keessaa tokko tokko yoo hin amanin maal ree? Amantii dhabuun isaanii amanamummaa Waaqaa ni balleessaa?
english: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

kikuyu: Gonkumaa hin taʼu! Namoonni hundinuu sobdoota, Waaqni immoo dhugaa qabeessa haa taʼu. Kunis akkuma, “Akka ati dubbii keetiin dhuga qabeessa taatuuf, yommuu murtiitti dhiʼaattuttis akka moʼattuuf” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “that you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”

kikuyu: Yoo jalʼinni keenya qajeelina Waaqaa ifa baase garuu maal jenna ree? Waaqni dheekkamsa isaa nutti fiduun isaa qajeelina dhabeetii? Kanas ani akka namaattin dubbadha.
english: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

kikuyu: Gonkumaa hin taʼu! Utuu akkas taʼee silaa Waaqni akkamitti addunyaatti muruu dandaʼa ree?
english: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

kikuyu: Namni tokko, “Yoo soba kootiin dhuga qabeessummaan Waaqaa guddatee ulfinni isaas baayʼate maaliif hamma ammaatti akka cubbamaa tokkootti natti murama ree?” jedhee falma taʼa.
english: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

kikuyu: Kunis isa namoonni tokko tokko, “Isaan, ‘Akka wanni gaariin dhufuuf hammina haa hojjennu?’ jedhu” jedhanii nurratti odeessisanii dha. Murtiin isaanitti muramus waanuma maluu dha!
english: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let’s do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

kikuyu: Egaa maal jenna ree? Nu Yihuudoonni warra kaan caallaa? Gonkumaa akkas miti! Akka Yihuudoonnii fi Giriikonni hundinuu cubbuu jala jiran duraan dursinee mirkaneessineerraatii.
english: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks that they are all under sin.

kikuyu: Kunis kan akkana jedhamee barreeffamee dha: “Qajeelaan tokko iyyuu hin jiru; namni tokko iyyuu;
english: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.

kikuyu: namni hubannaa qabu, kan Waaqa barbaadu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

kikuyu: Hundinuu dogoggoraniiru; walumatti warra faayidaa hin qabne taʼaniiru; namni waan gaarii hojjetu tokko iyyuu hin jiru; tokkumti iyyuu hin jiru.”
english: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”

kikuyu: “Laagaan isaanii awwaala banamaa dha; arraba isaaniitiin ni gowwoomsu.” “Hadhaan buutii hidhii isaanii jala jira.”
english: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips.”

kikuyu: “Afaan isaanii abaarsaa fi hadhaaʼummaan guutame.”
english: “Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”

kikuyu: “Miilli isaanii dhiiga dhangalaasuutti ariifata;
english: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

kikuyu: badiisaa fi gadadootu karaa isaanii irra jira;
english: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

kikuyu: karaa nagaas hin beekan.”
english: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”

kikuyu: “Waaqa sodaachuun ija isaanii dura hin jiru.”
english: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

kikuyu: Akka afaan hundi cufamuu fi akka addunyaan hundinuu murtii Waaqaa jala galuuf, wanni seerri jedhu hundinuu akka warra seera jala jiraniif dubbatu ni beekna.
english: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

kikuyu: Kanaafis eenyu iyyuu seera eeguudhaan fuula Waaqaa duratti qajeelaa hin taʼu; seeratu cubbuu nu hubachiisaatii.
english: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight; for through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

kikuyu: Amma garuu qajeelummaan Waaqaan kennamu kan seeraan adda taʼe, kan Seerrii fi Raajonni dhugaa baʼaniif mulʼateera.
english: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

kikuyu: Qajeelummaan Waaqaa kun amantiidhaan warra Yesuus Kiristoositti amanan hundaaf kennama; nama wal caalchisuun hin jiru;
english: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

kikuyu: sababii hundi isaanii iyyuu cubbuu hojjetaniif isaan ulfina Waaqaa irraa citaniiruutii;
english: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

kikuyu: isaanis ayyaana Waaqaa isa furama karaa Kiristoos Yesuusiin toluma kennameefiin qajeeltota taasifamaniiru.
english: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Dhiiga isaatti amantii qabaachuudhaanis akka inni aarsaa araaraa taʼuuf Waaqni isa dhiʼeesse. Waan kana gochuun isaas cubbuu kanaan dura hojjetame utuu hin adabin waan obsaan bira darbeef qajeelina isaa argisiisuuf jedhee ti;
english: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

kikuyu: Waaqni yeroo ammaa qajeelummaa isaa argisiisuu fi akka nama Yesuusitti amanus qajeelaa taʼuu isaa labsuuf waan kana godhe.
english: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time, that he might himself be just and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

kikuyu: Yoos of tuuluun eessa jira ree? Inni hafeera. Seera kamiin? Seera eeguudhaan moo? Miti; seera amantiitiin malee.
english: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

kikuyu: Nu akka namni seera eeguudhaan utuu hin taʼin amantiidhaan qajeelaa taasifamu ni amannaatii.
english: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

kikuyu: Waaqni Waaqa Yihuudootaa qofa moo? Inni Waaqa Namoota Ormaas mitii? Eeyyee, inni Waaqa Namoota Ormaatis;
english: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

kikuyu: egaa kan dhagna qabates amantiin, kan dhagna hin qabatinis amantiidhuma sanaan qajeelaa kan taasisu Waaquma tokkicha.
english: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith and the uncircumcised through faith.

kikuyu: Yoos nu amantii kanaan seera sana cabsinaa ree? Gonkumaa akkas miti! Seericha ni cimsina malee.
english: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

kikuyu: Egaa Abrahaam inni fooniin abbaa keenya taʼe sun haala kanaan maal argate jenna ree?
english: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

kikuyu: Abrahaam utuu hojiin qajeelaa taasifamee jiraatee silaa waan ittiin of jaju qaba ture; fuula Waaqaa duratti garuu akkas miti.
english: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

kikuyu: Katabbiin Qulqulluun maal jedha? “Abrahaam Waaqa amane; kunis qajeelummaatti lakkaaʼameef.”
english: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

kikuyu: Nama hojjetu tokkoof Mindaan gatiidha malee akka kennaa tolaatti hin hedamu.
english: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

kikuyu: Taʼus nama hin hojjenne, kan Waaqa isa nama hamaa qajeelaa taasisu amanatu garuu amantiin isaa qajeelummaatti lakkaaʼamaaf.
english: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

kikuyu: Daawitis akka namni Waaqni qajeelummaa hojii malee argamu lakkaaʼuuf eebbifamaa taʼe yommuu dubbatu akkana jedha:
english: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works:

kikuyu: “Warri yakki isaanii dhiifameef, kanneen cubbuun isaanii haguugameef eebbifamoo dha.
english: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

kikuyu: Namni Gooftaan cubbuu isaa itti hin lakkoofne eebbifamaa dha.”
english: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”

kikuyu: Eebbi kun warra dhagna qabatan qofaaf moo warra dhagna hin qabatiniifis? Abrahaamiif amantiin isaa qajeelummaatti lakkaaʼame jenneerraatii.
english: Is this blessing then pronounced only on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

kikuyu: Kun egaa akkamitti isaaf lakkaaʼame ree? Erga inni dhagna qabatee moo duraanii? Durumaan malee erga dhagna qabate miti!
english: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

kikuyu: Inni mallattoo dhagna qabaa fudhate; kunis chaappaa qajeelummaa inni utuu dhagna hin qabatin dura amantiin argate sanaa ti. Kanaafis inni warra utuu dhagna hin qabatin amanan kanneen amantiin isaanii qajeelummaatti lakkaaʼameef hundaaf abbaa dha.
english: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

kikuyu: Akkasumas inni warra dhagna qabataniif, dhagna qabachuu qofas utuu hin taʼin warra karaa amantii abbaan keenya Abrahaam utuu dhagna hin qabatiniin dura fudhate sana duukaa buʼan hundaaf abbaa dha.
english: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

kikuyu: Abrahaamii fi sanyiin isaa waadaa akka inni dhaaltuu addunyaa taʼu kenname sana karaa qajeelummaa amantiin dhufuutiin argatan malee karaa seeraatiin miti.
english: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he would be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

kikuyu: Yoo warri seeratti bulan dhaaltota taʼan, amantiin gatii hin qabu; waadaanis homaa hin fayyaduutii;
english: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

kikuyu: kunis sababii seerri dheekkamsa fiduuf. Lafa seerri hin jirre yakki hin jiruutii.
english: For the law produces wrath; for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu waadaan kun akka ayyaanaan taʼuu fi akka sanyii isaa hundaaf wabii taʼuuf amantii irratti hundeeffame; innis warra akka Abrahaam amananiif malee warra seeratti bulan qofaaf miti; Abrahaam abbaa hunduma keenyaa ti.
english: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

kikuyu: Kunis akkuma, “Ani abbaa saboota baayʼee si taasiseera” jedhamee barreeffamee dha. Abrahaam Waaqa amanate; innis Waaqa warra duʼaniif jireenya kennuu fi isa waan hin jirre akka waan jiruutti waamu sana duratti abbaa keenya.
english: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

kikuyu: Abrahaamis akkuma, “Sanyiin kee akkas ni taʼa” jedhametti utuu abdiin tokko iyyuu hin jiraatin abdiidhaan amanee abbaa saboota baayʼee taʼe.
english: Against hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”

kikuyu: Innis akka umuriin isaa gara waggaa dhibbaa gaʼee dhagni isaa duʼe, akkasumas akka gadameessi Saaraa duʼe beeku illee amantii isaatti hin laafne.
english: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.

kikuyu: Inni amantii isaatti jabaachuun Waaqaaf ulfina kenne malee amantii dhabuun waadaa Waaqaa hin shakkine;
english: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

kikuyu: akka Waaqni waan waadaa gale raawwachuu dandaʼus guutumaan guutuutti hubateera.
english: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu, “Amantiin isaa qajeelummaatti isaaf lakkaaʼame.”
english: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”

kikuyu: Dubbiin, “Qajeelummaatti isaaf lakkaaʼame” jedhu kun Abrahaam qofaaf hin barreeffamne;
english: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

kikuyu: nuufis, warra Waaqa Gooftaa keenya Yesuusin warra duʼan keessaa kaase sanatti amannuufis, qajeelummaatti ni lakkaaʼama.
english: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,

kikuyu: Yesuus cubbuu keenyaaf dabarfamee duʼatti kenname; qajeeltota nu taasisuuf immoo duʼaa kaafame.
english: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu amantiidhaan qajeeltota erga taasifamnee nu karaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiin Waaqa wajjin nagaa qabna.
english: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

kikuyu: Ayyaana amma jabaannee ittiin dhaabannu kanattis karaa isaatiin amantiin galuuf carraa arganneerra. Abdii ulfina Waaqaattis ni gammanna.
english: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

kikuyu: Kana qofa miti; nu dhiphina keenyattis ni gammanna; akka dhiphinni obsa fidu ni beeknaatii;
english: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

kikuyu: obsi jabaatanii dhaabachuu, jabaatanii dhaabachuun immoo abdii fida.
english: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope;

kikuyu: Jaalalli Waaqaa karaa Hafuura Qulqulluu nuu kennamee sanaatiin garaa keenya keessatti waan dhangalaafameef abdiin nu hin qaanessu.
english: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

kikuyu: Utuu nu amma illee dadhabdoota taanee jirruu yeroo malutti Kiristoos cubbamootaaf jedhee duʼe.
english: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

kikuyu: Yoo namni tokko nama gaariif duʼuuf ija jabaachuu dandaʼe iyyuu, namni nama qajeelaaf duʼu akka malee muraasa.
english: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a good person someone would even dare to die.

kikuyu: Garuu utuma nu cubbamoota taanee jirruu Kiristoos nuuf jedhee duʼe; kunis jaalala Waaqni nuuf qabu argisiisa.
english: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

kikuyu: Egaa nu amma erga dhiiga isaatiin qajeeltota taasifamnee, akkam karuma isaatiin dheekkamsa Waaqaa jalaa hin baane ree!
english: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

kikuyu: Nu utuu diinota Waaqaa taanee jirruu erga duʼa ilma isaatiin isatti araaramnee, erga isatti araaramnee booddee immoo hammam caalaa jireenya isaatiin hin fayyinu ree!
english: For if while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

kikuyu: Kana qofa miti; nu garuu Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos isa ittiin amma araara arganne sanaan Waaqatti ni gammanna.
english: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

kikuyu: Kanaaf akkuma cubbuun karaa nama tokkootiin addunyaa seene, duuti immoo karaa cubbuutiin seene; sababii namni hundinuu cubbuu hojjeteefis duuti nama hundatti dhufe.
english: Therefore, as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin, so death passed to all men because all sinned.

kikuyu: Utuu seerri hin kennaminiin dura iyyuu cubbuun addunyaa keessa tureetii; yeroo seerri hin jirretti garuu cubbuun hin lakkaaʼamu.
english: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

kikuyu: Taʼus duuti bara Addaam irraa jalqabee hamma bara Museetti warra dogoggora akka Addaam hin hojjetin irratti illee moʼee ture; Addaamis Isa dhufuuf jiru sanaaf fakkeenya ture.
english: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

kikuyu: Kennaan tolaa sun garuu akka balleessaa sanaa miti. Erga sababii balleessaa nama tokkootiin namoonni baayʼeen duʼanii, ayyaanni Waaqaatii fi kennaan karaa ayyaana nama tokkootiin jechuunis kennaan karaa Yesuus Kiristoosiitiin dhufe sun immoo hammam caalaa namootaaf haa baayʼatu ree!
english: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

kikuyu: Kennaan Waaqaa miidhaa cubbuun namni tokko hojjete fiduun tokko miti: Murtiin cubbuu tokkichaaf kenname yakkamtummaa fideera; kennaan tolaa kan balleessaa baayʼee irratti kenname garuu qajeelummaa fide.
english: The gift is not as through one who sinned; for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift followed many trespasses to justification.

kikuyu: Erga sababii balleessaa nama tokkootiin karaa namicha sanaatiin duuti moʼee, warri ayyaana baayʼatee irraa hafaa taʼee fi kennaa qajeeltota nama taasisu argatan immoo karaa nama tokkoo karaa Yesuus Kiristoosiitiin hammam caalaa jireenyaan hin moʼan ree!
english: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akkuma balleessaan tokko nama hundatti yakka mursiise, akkasuma immoo hojiin qajeelummaa tokko nama hundaaf qajeelummaa jireenya fidu taʼe.
english: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

kikuyu: Akkuma ajajamuu diduu nama tokkootiin namoonni baayʼeen cubbamoota taʼan, akkasuma immoo ajajamuu nama tokkootiin namoonni baayʼeen qajeeltota ni taasifamu.
english: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

kikuyu: Seerris akka cubbuun baayʼatuuf dhufe. Lafa cubbuun baayʼatetti garuu ayyaanni akka malee baayʼate;
english: The law came in that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly,

kikuyu: kunis akkuma cubbuun karaa duʼaatiin moʼe sana ayyaannis karaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiitiin akka jireenya bara baraa fiduuf karaa qajeelinaatiin akka moʼuuf.
english: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

kikuyu: Egaa maal jenna ree? Akka ayyaanni baayʼatuuf ittuma fufnee cubbuu haa hojjennuu?
english: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

kikuyu: Gonkumaa hin taʼu! Nu warri cubbuuf duune, siʼachi akkamitti cubbuu jala jiraanna?
english: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

kikuyu: Yookaan nu warri Kiristoos Yesuusitti cuuphamne hundi akka duʼa isaattis cuuphamne isin hin beektanii?
english: Or don’t you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akkuma Kiristoos ulfina Abbaatiin warra duʼan keessaa kaafame sana nus akka jireenya haaraa jiraannuuf cuuphaadhaan duʼa isaa keessatti hirmaannee isa wajjin awwaalamne.
english: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

kikuyu: Nu erga duʼa isaatiin akkasitti isa wajjin tokko taane, duʼaa kaʼuu isaatiinis akkasuma isa wajjin tokko ni taana.
english: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

kikuyu: Akka dhagni cubbamaan balleeffamuuf, nus akka siʼachi garboota cubbuu hin taaneef akka namummaan keenya moofaan sun isa wajjin fannifame ni beekna;
english: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

kikuyu: namni duʼe cubbuu irraa bilisoomeeraatii.
english: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

kikuyu: Egaa nu yoo Kiristoos wajjin duune, akka isa wajjin jiraannus ni amanna.
english: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him,

kikuyu: Kiristoos warra duʼan keessaa waan kaʼeef, akka inni deebiʼee hin duune ni beeknaatii; duutis siʼachi isa irratti gooftummaa hin qabu.
english: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no longer has dominion over him!

kikuyu: Inni duʼa duʼe sana siʼa tokko yeroo hundaaf cubbuuf duʼe; jireenya jiraatu sana garuu Waaqaaf jiraata.
english: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

kikuyu: Isinis akkasuma akka cubbuuf duutanitti, Kiristoos Yesuusiin garuu akka Waaqaaf jiraattota taatanitti of hedaa.
english: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isin akka fedhii isaa hamaadhaaf hin ajajamneef dhagna keessan kan duʼa hin oolle irratti cubbuu hin moosisinaa.
english: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

kikuyu: Akka warra duʼa irraa gara jireenyaatti fidamaniitti Waaqaaf of dhiʼeessaa malee kutaa dhagna keessanii miʼa jalʼinaa gootanii cubbuuf hin dhiʼeessinaa; garuu kutaa dhagna keessanii miʼa qajeelinaa godhaatii Waaqaaf dhiʼeessaa.
english: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

kikuyu: Isin ayyaana jala jirtu malee waan seera jala hin jirreef, cubbuun isin irratti gooftummaa hin qabaatu.
english: For sin will not have dominion over you, for you are not under law, but under grace.

kikuyu: Egaa maal haa taʼu ree? Nu sababii ayyaana jala malee seera jala hin jirreef cubbuu haa hojjennuu? Gonkumaa hin taʼu!
english: What then? Shall we sin because we are not under law but under grace? May it never be!

kikuyu: Cubbuu gara duʼaatti nama geessuufis taʼu yookaan ajajamuu gara qajeelummaatti nama geessuuf, yommuu akka garbootaatti nama tokkoof ajajamuuf of kennitanitti, nama ajajamtaniif sanaaf akka garboota taatan hin beektanii?
english: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey, whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

kikuyu: Isin yoo garboota cubbuu turtan illee amma garuu barumsa itti kennamtan sanaaf waan garaa guutuun ajajamtaniif Waaqaaf galanni haa taʼu.
english: But thanks be to God that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

kikuyu: Isin cubbuu irraa bilisoomtanii garboota qajeelummaa taataniirtu.
english: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

kikuyu: Sababii isin uumamaanuu dadhaboo taataniif ani jecha namaa galuun nan dubbadha; akkuma kutaa dhagna keessanii xuraaʼummaa fi hammina guddachaa deemuuf garba gootanii dhiʼeessaa turtan sana ammas kutaa dhagna keessanii qajeelummaa gara qulqullummaatti geessuuf garba godhaatii dhiʼeessaa.
english: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh; for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

kikuyu: Isin yeroo garboota cubbuu turtanitti, qajeelummaa irraa bilisa turtan.
english: For when you were servants of sin, you were free from righteousness.

kikuyu: Waan amma itti qaanoftan kana irraa yeroo sana buʼaa maalii argattan ree? Dhumni waan sanaa duʼaatii!
english: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

kikuyu: Amma garuu waan cubbuu irraa bilisoomtanii garboota Waaqaa taataniif faayidaan isin argattan gara qulqullummaatti isin geessa; dhumni isaas jireenya bara baraa ti.
english: But now, being made free from sin and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification and the result of eternal life.

kikuyu: Mindaan cubbuu duʼaatii; kennaan Waaqaa garuu karaa Gooftaa keenya Kiristoos Yesuusiin jireenya bara baraa ti.
english: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, ani warra seera beekanitti nan dubbadhaatii; seerri nama tokko irratti taayitaa kan qabaatu hamma namichi sun lubbuun jiru qofa akka taʼe isin hin beektanii ree?
english: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

kikuyu: Dubartiin heerumte tokko hamma inni lubbuudhaan jirutti seeraan dhirsa isheetti hidhamteerti; yoo dhirsi ishee duʼe garuu seera fuudhaa fi heerumaa sana irraa hiikamteerti.
english: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu utuu dhirsi ishee lubbuudhaan jiruu yoo nama biraatti heerumte isheen ejjituu jedhamti. Yoo dhirsi ishee duʼe garuu waan seera sana irraa hiikamteef yoo nama biraatti heerumte illee ejjitu miti.
english: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa obboloota ko, isinis akkasuma karaa dhagna Kiristoosiin seeraaf duutaniirtu; kunis akka isin kan biraa, kan isa warra duʼan keessaa kaafame sanaa taataniif; kun immoo akka nu Waaqaaf ija naqannuuf.
english: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.

kikuyu: Yeroo nu akka namummaa cubbamaatti jiraachaa turretti, hawwiin cubbuu kan seeraan kakaafame sun akka nu duʼaaf ija naqannuuf dhagna keenya keessatti hojjechaa ture.
english: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

kikuyu: Amma garuu waan duraan nu hidhee ture sanaaf duʼuudhaan seera irraa hiikamneerra; kunis akka seera moofaa barreeffame sana jalatti tajaajilluuf utuu hin taʼin akka jireenya Hafuuraa haaraa sanaan tajaajilluuf.
english: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

kikuyu: Egaa maal jenna ree? Seerri cubbuudhaa? Gonkumaa akkas miti! Garuu ani utuu seeraan taʼuu baatee cubbuun maal akka taʼe hin beeku ture. Utuu seerri “Hin hawwin” jechuu baatee ani silaa hawwiin maal akka taʼe dhugumaan hin beeku ture.
english: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”

kikuyu: Cubbuun garuu carraa ajajni argamsiiseen hawwii hamaa gosa hundaa na keessatti uume. Lafa seerri hin jirretti cubbuun duʼaadhaatii.
english: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

kikuyu: Ani dur seera malee jiraachaan ture; yommuu ajajni dhufetti garuu cubbuun ni bayyanatte; anis nan duʼe.
english: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived and I died.

kikuyu: Ajajni jireenya fida jedhamee eegame sunis akka duʼa natti fide nan hubadhe.
english: The commandment which was for life, this I found to be for death;

kikuyu: Cubbuun carraa ajajni argamsiiseen na gowwoomse; ajajuma sanaanis na ajjeese.
english: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu seerri qulqulluu dha; ajajni sunis qulqulluu dha; qajeelaa dha; gaarii dhas.
english: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, righteous, and good.

kikuyu: Egaa waan gaarii sanatu duʼa natti taʼee ree? Gonkumaa akkas miti! Cubbuunis akka cubbuutti akka ilaalamuuf, akka karaa ajajaatiin ittuma caalee cubbuu taʼuufis cubbuun karaa waan gaarii sanaatiin duʼa natti fide.
english: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.

kikuyu: Nus akka seerri sun seera hafuuraa taʼe ni beekna; ani garuu nama foonii kan akkuma garbaatti cubbuutti gurguramee dha.
english: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

kikuyu: Ani waanan hojjedhu hin beeku. Ani waanan jibbun hojjedha malee waanan hojjechuu barbaadu hin hojjedhuutii.
english: For I don’t understand what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

kikuyu: Ani erga waanan hojjechuu hin barbaanne hojjedhee, akka seerri sun gaarii taʼe walii nan gala.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

kikuyu: Yoos, siʼachi cubbuu na keessa jiraatutu waan kana hojjeta malee ana miti.
english: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

kikuyu: Na keessa jechuunis namummaa koo cubbamaa keessa akka wanni gaariin tokko iyyuu hin jirre nan beeka. Ani waan gaarii hojjechuu nan hawwa; garuu hojjechuu hin dandaʼu.
english: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

kikuyu: Wanti ani hojjedhu waan hamaa ani hojjechuu hin barbaanne malee waan gaarii ani hojjechuu barbaadu mitiitii.
english: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

kikuyu: Egaa ani waanan hojjechuu hin barbaanne yoon hojjedhe, siʼachi cubbuu na keessa jiraatu sanatu waan kana hojjeta malee ana miti.
english: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka seerri sun hojjechaa jiru nan hubadha; yommuu ani waan gaarii hojjechuu barbaadu hamminni na biratti argama.
english: I find then the law that, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

kikuyu: Ani keessa namummaa kootti seera Waaqaattin nan gammadaatii;
english: For I delight in God’s law after the inward person,

kikuyu: ani garuu utuu seerri biraa seera qalbii koo wajjin kutaa dhagna koo keessatti wal lolee seera cubbuu kan kutaa dhagna koo keessa jiruuf na boojiʼuu nan arga.
english: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

kikuyu: Ani nama gadadamaa akkamii ti! Dhagna duʼu kana jalaa eenyutu na baasa?
english: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

kikuyu: Karaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiin galanni Waaqaaf haa taʼu! Kanaafuu ani mataan koo qalbii kootiin garbicha seera Waaqaa ti; namummaa koo cubbamaadhaan garuu ani garbicha seera cubbuu ti.
english: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, sin’s law.

kikuyu: Egaa amma murtiin warra Kiristoos Yesuus keessa jiraatanitti muramu hin jiru;
english: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

kikuyu: seerri Hafuura jireenyaa karaa Kiristoos Yesuusiin seera cubbuutii fi seera duʼaa jalaa na bilisoomseeraatii.
english: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

kikuyu: Waan seerri sababii fooniitiin dadhabsiifameef hojjechuu hin dandaʼin, Waaqni Ilma ofii isaa bifa foon cubbamaatiin aarsaa cubbuu akka taʼuuf erguun hojjeteeraatii. Kanaanis inni fooniin cubbuutti mure.
english: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh,

kikuyu: Kunis akka qajeelummaan seeraa sun nu warra utuu akka namummaa cubbamaatti hin taʼin akka Hafuuraatti jiraannu keessatti raawwatamuufii dha.
english: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

kikuyu: Warri akka fooniitti jiraatan waan foonii yaadu; warri akka Hafuuraatti jiraatan garuu waan Hafuuraa yaadu.
english: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

kikuyu: Yaadni foonii duʼa; yaadni Hafuuraa garuu jireenyaa fi nagaa dha.
english: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

kikuyu: Yaadni foonii diina Waaqaa ti; seera Waaqaatiifis hin bulu. Buluus hin dandaʼu.
english: because the mind of the flesh is hostile toward God, for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

kikuyu: Warri akka fooniitti jiraatan Waaqa gammachiisuu hin dandaʼan.
english: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

kikuyu: Isin garuu yoo Hafuurri Waaqaa isin keessa jiraate akka Hafuuraatti jiraattu malee akka fooniitti hin jiraattan. Eenyu iyyuu yoo Hafuura Kiristoos qabaachuu baate inni kan Kiristoos miti.
english: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

kikuyu: Yoo Kiristoos isin keessa jiraate garuu dhagni keessan sababii cubbuutiin duʼaa dha; hafuurri keessan immoo sababii qajeelummaatiin jiraataa dha.
english: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

kikuyu: Hafuurri Waaqaa inni Yesuusin warra duʼan keessaa kaase sun yoo isin keessa jiraate garuu, inni Kiristoos Yesuusin warra duʼan keessaa kaase sun karaa Hafuura isaa kan isin keessa jiruutiin dhagna keessan isa duʼuufis jireenya kenna.
english: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

kikuyu: Egaa yaa obboloota, nu gatii of irraa qabna; garuu fooniif miti; akka fooniitti jiraachuufis miti.
english: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

kikuyu: Isin yoo akka fooniitti jiraattan ni duutuutii; yoo Hafuuraan hojii foon keessanii ajjeeftan garuu ni jiraattu.
english: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

kikuyu: Warri Hafuura Waaqaatiin qajeelfaman hundinuu ilmaan Waaqaatii.
english: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

kikuyu: Isin Hafuura ilmummaa isa nu ittiin, “Aabbaa, yaa Abbaa” jennee waammannu sana argattan malee Hafuura garbummaa kan gara sodaatti isin deebisu hin arganne.
english: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

kikuyu: Akka nu ijoollee Waaqaa taane kan hafuura keenya wajjin dhugaa baʼus Hafuuruma sana.
english: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

kikuyu: Yoo ijoollee taane immoo nu dhaaltota; akka hirmaattota ulfina isaa taanuufis yoo hirmaattota dhiphina isaa taane, nu dhaaltota Waaqaa ti; Kiristoos wajjinis ni dhaalla.
english: and if children, then heirs—heirs of God and joint heirs with Christ, if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

kikuyu: Dhiphinni keenya kan ammaa kun ulfina nutti mulʼachuuf jiruun yommuu wal bira qabamu akka waan tokkottuu hin lakkaaʼamne ani nan yaada.
english: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

kikuyu: Uumamni mulʼachuu ijoollee Waaqaa hawwiidhaan eeggachaa jira.
english: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

kikuyu: Uumamni utuu filannoo isaatiin hin taʼin, fedhii isa dabarsee isa kenne sanaatiin abdiidhaan waan faayidaa hin qabnetti saaxilameeraatii;
english: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

kikuyu: kunis akka uumamni mataan isaa garbummaa tortoruu jalaa baʼee bilisummaa ulfina qabeessa ijoollee Waaqaatti galuuf.
english: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

kikuyu: Uumamni hundinuu hamma ammaatti akkuma dhiphina yeroo ciniinsuutti akka aadaa jiru ni beekna.
english: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

kikuyu: Uumama qofa utuu hin taʼin nu mataan keenya warri ija Hafuuraa kan jalqabaa qabnu iyyuu furii dhagna keenyaa ilmummaatti guddifamuu eeggachaa of keessatti ni aadna.
english: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

kikuyu: Nu abdii kanaan fayyineetii. Abdiin argamu garuu abdii miti; namni waan amma iyyuu qabu abdatu eenyu ree?
english: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

kikuyu: Nu yoo waan amma hin qabne abdanne garuu obsaan eegganna.
english: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

kikuyu: Akkasumas Hafuurri dadhabbii keenya irratti nu gargaara. Nu waan kadhachuu qabnu hin beeknuutii; hafuurri mataan isaa garuu aaduu ibsamuu hin dandaʼamneen nuuf kadhata.
english: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

kikuyu: Inni garaa keenya qoru sun yaada Hafuuraas ni beeka; Hafuurri akka fedhii Waaqaatti qulqullootaaf kadhataatii.
english: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

kikuyu: Waaqni warra isa jaallatanii akka kaayyoo isaatti waamamaniif akka wanti hundinuu gaarii taʼuuf hojjetu ni beekna.
english: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, for those who are called according to his purpose.

kikuyu: Akka inni obboloota baayʼee keessatti hangafa taʼuuf Waaqni warra duraan dursee beeke akka bifa ilma isaa fakkaataniif duraan dursee murteesseeraatii.
english: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

kikuyu: Inni warra duraan dursee murteesse sana ni waame; warra waame sanas qajeeltota taasise; warra qajeeltota taasiseef immoo ulfina kenne.
english: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

kikuyu: Egaa kana irratti maal jenna ree? Erga Waaqni nu wajjin taʼee eenyutu nuun mormuu dandaʼa?
english: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

kikuyu: Waaqni Ilma isaa illee utuu hin mararfatin hunduma keenyaaf dabarsee kenne sun akkamitti waan biraa hundumas isa wajjin akkasuma arjummaan nuuf hin kennu ree?
english: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

kikuyu: Warra Waaqni filate eenyutu himata? Kan qajeelaa nama taasisu Waaqa.
english: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

kikuyu: Kan itti muru eenyu? Kiristoos Yesuus isuma nuuf duʼee, kana caalaa immoo warra duʼan keessaa kaʼee mirga Waaqaa jiruu fi nuuf kadhatu sanaa dha.
english: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

kikuyu: Jaalala Kiristoos irraa eenyutu gargar nu baasa? Dhiphina moo rakkina, ariʼatama moo beela, daaruu moo balaa yookaan goraadee?
english: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

kikuyu: Kunis akkuma, “Nu siif jennee guyyaa guutuu ni ajjeefamna; akka hoolota qalamuuf jiraniittis lakkaaʼamneerra” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

kikuyu: Kana hunda keessatti garuu nu isa nu jaallate sanaan moʼattoota ni caalla.
english: No, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

kikuyu: Duuti yookaan jireenyi, ergamoonni yookaan bulchitoonni, hangafoonni, wanni ammaa yookaan wanni dhufuuf jiru yookaan humni tokko iyyuu,
english: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

kikuyu: ol dheerinni yookaan gad fageenyi yookaan uumamni biraa kam iyyuu jaalala Waaqaa kan Kiristoos Yesuus Gooftaa keenyaa irraa akka gargar nu baasuu hin dandeenye ani amaneera.
english: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing will be able to separate us from God’s love which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Ani Kiristoosiin dhugaa nan dubbadha; ani hin sobu; yaadni koos Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan naa mirkaneessa;
english: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit

kikuyu: ani gadda guddaa fi dhiphina wal irraa hin cinne garaa koo keessaa qaba.
english: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

kikuyu: Ani iyyuu obboloota koo warra akka fooniitti sanyii koo taʼaniif jedhee utuun Kiristoos irraa gargar baʼee abaaramee nan hawwa tureetii;
english: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh

kikuyu: isaan saba Israaʼel. Ilmummaan, ulfinni, kakuun, seera fudhachuun, tajaajiluu fi waadaan kan isaanii ti.
english: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

kikuyu: Abbootiin kan isaanii ti; Kiristoosis isaan irraa fooniin dhalate; inni waan hunda irratti Waaqa; inni bara baraan haa eebbifamu! Ameen.
english: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

kikuyu: Kun garuu dubbiin Waaqaa diigameera jechuu miti. Kan Israaʼel irraa dhalate hundi Israaʼel miti.
english: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel that are of Israel.

kikuyu: Yookaan isaan sababii sanyii Abrahaam taʼaniif hundi isaanii ijoollee isaa miti. Garuu, “Sanyiin kee Yisihaaqiin siif waamama” jedhameera.
english: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”

kikuyu: Kana jechuunis ijoollee waadaatu sanyiitti lakkaaʼama malee ijoolleen foon irraa dhalatan ijoollee Waaqaa miti.
english: That is, it is not the children of the flesh who are children of God, but the children of the promise are counted as heirs.

kikuyu: Dubbiin waadaa sunis kan, “Ani yeroo murteeffametti deebiʼee nan dhufa; Saaraanis ilma ni deessi” jedhu tureetii.
english: For this is a word of promise: “At the appointed time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.”

kikuyu: Kana qofa miti; Ribqaan yeroo namuma tokkoof, abbaa keenya Yisihaaqiif ulfooftetti,
english: Not only so, but Rebekah also conceived by one, by our father Isaac.

kikuyu: ijoolleen sun utuu hin dhalatin yookaan utuu waan gaarii yookaan waan hamaa hin hojjetin akka kaayyoon filannoo Waaqaa raawwatamuuf,
english: For being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him who calls,

kikuyu: utuu hojiin hin taʼin isa waamicha Waaqaatiin, “Inni hangafni isa quxisuu tajaajila” jedhamee isheetti himame.
english: it was said to her, “The elder will serve the younger.”

kikuyu: Kunis akkuma, “Yaaqoobin nan jaalladhe; Esaawun garuu nan jibbe” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: Even as it is written, “Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.”

kikuyu: Egaa maal jenna ree? Waaqni jalʼaadhaa? Gonkumaa akkas miti!
english: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? May it never be!

kikuyu: Inni Museedhaan, “Ani kanan maaru nan maara; kanan garaa laafuufiis garaa nan laafa” jedhaatii.
english: For he said to Moses, “I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu wanti kun araara Waaqaatiin malee hawwii yookaan carraaqqii namaatiin miti.
english: So then it is not of him who wills, nor of him who runs, but of God who has mercy.

kikuyu: Katabbiin qulqulluun Faraʼooniin, “Ani humna koo sirratti argisiisuuf, maqaan koos akka lafa hunda irratti labsamuuf kaayyoo kanaaf si kaaseera” jedhaatii.
english: For the Scripture says to Pharaoh, “For this very purpose I caused you to be raised up, that I might show in you my power, and that my name might be proclaimed in all the earth.”

kikuyu: Kanaaf Waaqni kan maaruu barbaadu ni maara; kan mata jabeessa gochuu barbaadu immoo mata jabeessa godha.
english: So then, he has mercy on whom he desires, and he hardens whom he desires.

kikuyu: Isinis, “Yoos Waaqni maaliif amma iyyuu dogoggora nurra barbaada? Fedhii isaas eenyutu mormuu dandaʼa?” naan jettu.
english: You will say then to me, “Why does he still find fault? For who withstands his will?”

kikuyu: Garuu yaa namichoo, Waaqaan mormuuf ati eenyu? “Wanti tolfame tokko kan isa tolcheen, ‘Ati maaliif akkanatti na tolchite?’ ” jedhaa?
english: But indeed, O man, who are you to reply against God? Will the thing formed ask him who formed it, “Why did you make me like this?”

kikuyu: Suphee dhooftuun tokko dhoqqee suphee kan bukaaʼe irraa qodaa ulfinaa fi salphinaaf oolu tolchuuf mirga hin qabuu?
english: Or hasn’t the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel for honor, and another for dishonor?

kikuyu: Waaqni dheekkamsa isaa argisiisuu fi humna isaas beeksisuuf jedhee yoo miʼa dheekkamsaa kanneen badiisaaf qopheeffaman obsa guddaan bira darbe hoo?
english: What if God, willing to show his wrath and to make his power known, endured with much patience vessels of wrath prepared for destruction,

kikuyu: Inni badhaadhummaa ulfina isaa yoo miʼa araara isaa kanneen duraan dursee ulfinaaf qopheessetti beeksisuuf jedhee waan kana godhe hoo?
english: and that he might make known the riches of his glory on vessels of mercy, which he prepared beforehand for glory—

kikuyu: Nus warra waamaman keessaa tokkoo dha; inni Yihuudoota qofa keessaa utuu hin taʼin Namoota Ormaa keessaas waameera.
english: us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

kikuyu: Inni kitaaba Hooseʼaa keessatti akkana jedha: “Ani warra saba koo hin taʼiniin, ‘saba koo’ nan jedha; ishee jaallatamtuu hin taʼiniin immoo, ‘jaallatamtuu’ nan jedha.”
english: As he says also in Hosea, “I will call them ‘my people,’ which were not my people; and her ‘beloved,’ who was not beloved.”

kikuyu: Akkasumas isaan, “Iddoodhuma itti, ‘Isin saba koo miti’ isaaniin jedhame sanatti, ‘ilmaan Waaqa jiraataa’ jedhamanii ni waamamu.”
english: “It will be that in the place where it was said to them, ‘You are not my people,’ there they will be called ‘children of the living God.’”

kikuyu: Isaayyaas akkana jedhee waaʼee Israaʼel iyya: “Baayʼinni ilmaan Israaʼel yoo akkuma cirracha qarqara galaanaa taʼe iyyuu, hambaa qofatu fayya.
english: Isaiah cries concerning Israel, “If the number of the children of Israel are as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant who will be saved;

kikuyu: Gooftaan utuu hin turin, yeroo dhumaatiif lafa irratti ni muraatii.”
english: for he will finish the work and cut it short in righteousness, because the Lord will make a short work upon the earth.”

kikuyu: Kunis akkuma Isaayyaas duraan dursee akkana jedhee dubbatee dha: “Utuu Gooftaan Waan Hunda Dandaʼu, sanyii nuuf hambisuu baatee, nu silaa akkuma Sodoom taanee, Gomoraas fakkaanna turre.”
english: As Isaiah has said before, “Unless the Lord of Armies had left us a seed, we would have become like Sodom, and would have been made like Gomorrah.”

kikuyu: Egaa maal jenna ree? Namoonni Ormaa kan qajeelummaa duukaa hin buʼin qajeelummaa karaa amantiitiin taʼe argataniiru.
english: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who didn’t follow after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith;

kikuyu: Israaʼeloonni seera qajeelummaa duukaa buʼan garuu qajeelummaa hin arganne.
english: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, didn’t arrive at the law of righteousness.

kikuyu: Maaliif dhaban? Kunis sababii isaan utuu karaa amantiitiin hin taʼin hojiidhaan qajeelummaa argachuu barbaadaniif; isaanis dhagaa nama gufachiisuun gufatan.
english: Why? Because they didn’t seek it by faith, but as it were by works of the law. They stumbled over the stumbling stone,

kikuyu: Kunis akkuma, “Kunoo, ani dhagaa nama gufachiisu, kattaa nama kuffisu Xiyoon keessa nan kaaʼa; namni isatti amanu gonkumaa hin qaanaʼu” jedhamee barreeffame sanaa dha.
english: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, hawwiin garaa kootii fi wanni ani Israaʼelootaaf Waaqa kadhadhu akka isaan fayyaniif.
english: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

kikuyu: Ani akka isaan Waaqaaf hinaaffaa qaban dhugaa nan baʼa; hinaaffaan isaanii garuu kan beekumsa irratti hundeeffame miti.
english: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

kikuyu: Isaan waan qajeelummaa Waaqa biraa dhufu hin beekinii fi waan qajeelummaa ofii isaanii uumachuu barbaadaniif qajeelummaa Waaqaatiif hin bulle.
english: For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject themselves to the righteousness of God.

kikuyu: Akka namni amanu hundinuu qajeelummaa argatuuf Kiristoos raawwii seeraatii.
english: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

kikuyu: Museen waaʼee qajeelummaa seeraan argamuu, “Namni waan seerri ajaju godhu ittiin jiraata” jedhee waan kana barreesseeraatii.
english: For Moses writes about the righteousness of the law, “The one who does them will live by them.”

kikuyu: Qajeelummaan amantiidhaan argamu garuu akkana jedha; “Ati garaa kee keessatti, ‘Eenyutu gara samiitti ol baʼa?’ hin jedhin;” Kun Kiristoosin gad buusuuf;
english: But the righteousness which is of faith says this, “Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will ascend into heaven?’ (that is, to bring Christ down);

kikuyu: “Yookaan, ‘Eenyutu qileetti gad buʼa?’ hin jedhin;” kun Kiristoosin warra duʼan keessaa ol baasuuf.
english: or, ‘Who will descend into the abyss?’ (that is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)”

kikuyu: Inni garuu maal jedha? “Dubbichi si bira jira; afaan keetii fi garaa kee keessa jira;” innis dubbii amantii isa nu lallabnuu dha;
english: But what does it say? “The word is near you, in your mouth and in your heart;” that is, the word of faith which we preach:

kikuyu: kunis yoo ati, “Yesuus Gooftaa dha” jettee afaan keetiin dhugaa baatee akka Waaqni warra duʼan keessaa isa kaase garaa keetti amante, ati ni fayyita.
english: that if you will confess with your mouth that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

kikuyu: Namni garaa isaatiin amanee qajeelaa taasifamaatii; afaan isaatiinis dhugaa baʼee fayya.
english: For with the heart one believes resulting in righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made resulting in salvation.

kikuyu: Katabbiin Qulqulluun, “Namni isatti amanu kam iyyuu gonkumaa hin qaanaʼu” jedhaatii.
english: For the Scripture says, “Whoever believes in him will not be disappointed.”

kikuyu: Yihuudii fi Giriikii gidduu garaa garummaan hin jiruutii; Gooftuma tokkicha sanatu Gooftaa hundaa ti; innis warra isa waammatan hunda eebba isaatiin badhaasa.
english: For there is no distinction between Jew and Greek; for the same Lord is Lord of all, and is rich to all who call on him.

kikuyu: “Namni maqaa Gooftaa waammatu hundinuu ni fayyaatii.”
english: For, “Whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.”

kikuyu: Yoos isaan akkamitti isa itti hin amanin waammachuu dandaʼu ree? Isa waaʼee isaa hin dhagaʼinittis akkamitti amanuu dandaʼu ree? Utuu namni isaanitti hin lallabinis akkamitti dhagaʼuu dandaʼu ree?
english: How then will they call on him in whom they have not believed? How will they believe in him whom they have not heard? How will they hear without a preacher?

kikuyu: Isaanis utuu hin ergamin akkamitti lallabuu dandaʼu? Kunis isa, “Miilli warra wangeela fidanii akkam miidhagaa dha!” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: And how will they preach unless they are sent? As it is written: “How beautiful are the feet of those who preach the Good News of peace, who bring glad tidings of good things!”

kikuyu: Oduu gaarii sanas kan fudhate Israaʼeloota hunda miti. Isaayyaas, “Yaa Gooftaa, ergaa keenya eenyutu amane?” jedhaatii.
english: But they didn’t all listen to the glad news. For Isaiah says, “Lord, who has believed our report?”

kikuyu: Egaa amantiin ergaa dhagaʼuudhaan dhufa; ergaan kunis karaa dubbii waaʼee Kiristoosiin dhagaʼama.
english: So faith comes by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

kikuyu: Ani garuu: Isaan hin dhageenye moo? jedhee nan gaafadha; dhugumaanuu isaan dhagaʼaniiru: “Sagaleen isaanii lafa hunda, dubbiin isaaniis handaara addunyaa gaʼe.”
english: But I say, didn’t they hear? Yes, most certainly, “Their sound went out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world.”

kikuyu: Ammas ani: Israaʼel hin hubanne moo? jedheen gaafadha. Museen duraan dursee, “Ani warra saba hin taʼiniin akka isin hinaaftan nan godha; saba hubannaa hin qabneenis isin nan aarsaa” jedha.
english: But I ask, didn’t Israel know? First Moses says, “I will provoke you to jealousy with that which is no nation. I will make you angry with a nation void of understanding.”

kikuyu: Isaayyaasis ija jabinaan, “Warri na hin barbaadin na argatan; warra na hin iyyaafatinittis nan mulʼadhe” jedha.
english: Isaiah is very bold and says, “I was found by those who didn’t seek me. I was revealed to those who didn’t ask for me.”

kikuyu: Waaʼee Israaʼel garuu, “Ani guyyaa guutuu gara uummata hin ajajamnee fi didaa taʼeetti harka koo nan diriirfadhe” jedha.
english: But about Israel he says, “All day long I stretched out my hands to a disobedient and contrary people.”

kikuyu: Anis, “Egaa Waaqni saba isaa ni gatee ree?” jedhee nan gaafadha. Kun gonkumaa akkas miti! Ani iyyuu Israaʼelicha, sanyii Abrahaam keessaa gosa Beniyaam.
english: I ask then, did God reject his people? May it never be! For I also am an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

kikuyu: Waaqni saba isaa warra duraan dursee beeke sana hin ganne; isin waaʼee Eeliyaas, inni akkamitti Waaqa duratti akka Israaʼelin himate Katabbiin Qulqulluun maal akka jedhu hin beektanii? Innis akkana jedha:
english: God didn’t reject his people, whom he foreknew. Or don’t you know what the Scripture says about Elijah? How he pleads with God against Israel:

kikuyu: “Yaa Gooftaa isaan raajota kee ajjeesaniiru; iddoo aarsaa keetii illee diiganiiru; anuma qofatu hafe; anas ajjeesuu barbaadu.”
english: “Lord, they have killed your prophets. They have broken down your altars. I am left alone, and they seek my life.”

kikuyu: Garuu deebiin Waaqni isaaf kenne maal ture? “Ani ofii kootiif namoota Baʼaaliif hin jilbeenfatin 7,000 hambifadheera.”
english: But how does God answer him? “I have reserved for myself seven thousand men who have not bowed the knee to Baal.”

kikuyu: Akkasuma yeroo ammaas hambaawwan ayyaanaan filataman jiru.
english: Even so too at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

kikuyu: Erga ayyaanaan taʼe immoo siʼachi hojiin miti; utuu hojiin taʼee immoo ayyaanni silaa ayyaana hin taʼu ture.
english: And if by grace, then it is no longer of works; otherwise grace is no longer grace. But if it is of works, it is no longer grace; otherwise work is no longer work.

kikuyu: Egaa maali ree? Israaʼel waan jabeessee barbaade sana hin arganne; warri filataman garuu argataniiru. Warri kaan immoo mataa jabaatan.
english: What then? That which Israel seeks for, that he didn’t obtain, but the chosen ones obtained it, and the rest were hardened.

kikuyu: Kunis isa, “Waaqni hamma guyyaa harʼaatti, akka iji isaanii hin argineef, akka gurri isaaniis hin dhageenyeef, hafuura nama dawweessu isaaniif kenne” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: According as it is written, “God gave them a spirit of stupor, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear, to this very day.”

kikuyu: Daawitis akkana jedha; “Maaddiin isaanii iddaa fi kiyyoo, gufuu nama gufachiisuu fi adaba isaanitti haa taʼu.
english: David says, “Let their table be made a snare, a trap, a stumbling block, and a retribution to them.

kikuyu: Akka arguu hin dandeenyeef iji isaanii haa haguuggamu; dugdi isaaniis bara baraan haa goophatu.”
english: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see. Always keep their backs bent.”

kikuyu: Anis deebisee, “Isaan hamma kufanii kaʼuu hin dandeenyetti gufatanii?” jedheen gaafadha. Kun gonkumaa akkas miti! Garuu akka sabni Israaʼel hinaafuuf sababii balleessaa isaaniitiif fayyinni Namoota Ormaatiif dhufe.
english: I ask then, did they stumble that they might fall? May it never be! But by their fall salvation has come to the Gentiles, to provoke them to jealousy.

kikuyu: Yoos erga balleessaan isaanii addunyaaf badhaadhummaa fidee, kufaatiin isaaniis erga Namoota Ormaatiif badhaadhummaa fidee, guutummaan isaanii immoo hammam caalaa badhaadhummaa haa fiduu ree?
english: Now if their fall is the riches of the world, and their loss the riches of the Gentiles, how much more their fullness!

kikuyu: Yaa Namoota Ormaa, ani isinittin dubbadha. Ani waanan ergamaa Namoota Ormaa taʼeef, tajaajila koo nan kabaja.
english: For I speak to you who are Gentiles. Since then as I am an apostle to Gentiles, I glorify my ministry,

kikuyu: Kanaanis ani tarii saba koo hinaaffaaf kakaasee isaan keessaa tokko tokko fayyisuu abdadhee ti.
english: if by any means I may provoke to jealousy those who are my flesh, and may save some of them.

kikuyu: Erga gatamuun isaanii addunyaaf araara fidee, fudhatamuun isaanii immoo warra duʼan keessaa jireenyatti kaafamuu malee maal fida ree?
english: For if the rejection of them is the reconciling of the world, what would their acceptance be, but life from the dead?

kikuyu: Kutaan bukoo kan akka kennaa hangafaatti dhiʼeeffame tokko erga qulqulluu taʼee, bukoon guutuun qulqulluu dha; hiddi erga qulqulluu taʼee, dameewwan isaas akkasuma qulqulloota.
english: If the first fruit is holy, so is the lump. If the root is holy, so are the branches.

kikuyu: Dameewwan sana keessaa tokko tokko caccabsamnaan ati utuma lataa ejersa bosonaa taatee jirtuu iddoo dameewwan caccabaniitti fayyifamtee soora hidda ejersaa irraa argamu kan qooddattu taanaan,
english: But if some of the branches were broken off, and you, being a wild olive, were grafted in among them and became partaker with them of the root and of the richness of the olive tree,

kikuyu: dameewwan sanatti hin koorin. Yoo of jajje garuu hidda sanatu si baata malee akka ati hidda sana hin baanne hubadhu.
english: don’t boast over the branches. But if you boast, remember that it is not you who support the root, but the root supports you.

kikuyu: Atis, “Akka ani itti fayyifamuuf dameewwan sun caccabsaman” ni jetta.
english: You will say then, “Branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.”

kikuyu: Kun dhuguma. Isaan waan amantii hin qabneef caccabsaman; ati garuu amantiidhaan dhaabatteerta. Kanaafuu sodaadhu malee of hin tuulin.
english: True; by their unbelief they were broken off, and you stand by your faith. Don’t be conceited, but fear;

kikuyu: Waaqni yoo dameewwan uumamaatiif hin hilin siifis hin hiluutii.
english: for if God didn’t spare the natural branches, neither will he spare you.

kikuyu: Egaa arjummaa fi gara jabina Waaqaa hubadhu: gara jabinni isaa warra kufan irratti; arjummaan isaa garuu hamma ati arjummaa isaa keessa jiraattutti siif; yoo kanaa achii atis ni kutamta.
english: See then the goodness and severity of God. Toward those who fell, severity; but toward you, goodness, if you continue in his goodness; otherwise you also will be cut off.

kikuyu: Isaanis yoo amantii dhabuutti fufuu baatan itti fayyifamu; Waaqni deebisee itti isaan fayyisuu ni dandaʼaatii.
english: They also, if they don’t continue in their unbelief, will be grafted in, for God is able to graft them in again.

kikuyu: Ati muka uumamaan ejersa bosonaa taʼe irraa muramtee karaa seera uumamaatiin ala taʼeen muka ejersaa kan dhaabame irratti erga fayyifamtee, dameewwan uumamaa kunneen hammam caalaa muka ejersa isaanii irratti deebifamanii hin fayyifaman ree!
english: For if you were cut out of that which is by nature a wild olive tree, and were grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree, how much more will these, which are the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, ani akka isin ogeeyyii of seetanii icciitii kana wallaaltan hin barbaadu; hamma lakkoobsi Namoota Ormaa guutuun seenutti Israaʼel gariin mata jabinaan jiraachaa turan.
english: For I don’t desire you to be ignorant, brothers, of this mystery, so that you won’t be wise in your own conceits, that a partial hardening has happened to Israel, until the fullness of the Gentiles has come in,

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Israaʼel hundi ni fayyu; akkana jedhamee barreeffameeraatii: “Inni furu Xiyoonii ni dhufa; Yaaqoob irraas Waaqa malee jiraachuu ni balleessa.
english: and so all Israel will be saved. Even as it is written, “There will come out of Zion the Deliverer, and he will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.

kikuyu: Yommuu ani cubbuu isaanii isaan irraa fuudhutti, kakuun koo kan ani isaan wajjin qabu kana.”
english: This is my covenant with them, when I will take away their sins.”

kikuyu: Akka wangeelaatti isiniif jecha isaan diinota; akka filannootti garuu abbootiif jecha isaan jaallatamoo dha;
english: Concerning the Good News, they are enemies for your sake. But concerning the election, they are beloved for the fathers’ sake.

kikuyu: kennaan Waaqaatii fi waamichi isaa gaabbii hin qabuutii.
english: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

kikuyu: Akkuma isin kanaan dura Waaqaaf ajajamuu diddanii amma garuu ajajamuu diduu isaaniitiin araara argattan sana
english: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

kikuyu: isaanis akkasuma araara Waaqaa kan isin argattaniin akka araara argataniif amma ajajamuu didan.
english: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

kikuyu: Waaqni hunduma isaaniitiif araara buusuuf jedhee namoota hunda ajajamuu diduu jala galche.
english: For God has bound all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

kikuyu: Badhaadhummaan ogummaatii fi beekumsa Waaqaa hammam gad fagaata! Murtiin isaa qoramee bira hin gaʼamu! Karaan isaas barbaadamee itti hin baʼamu!
english: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

kikuyu: “Eenyutu yaada garaa Gooftaa beeke? Yookaan eenyutu gorsaa isaa ture?”
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

kikuyu: “Yookaan akka Waaqni deebisee isaaf kennuuf jedhee, eenyutu takkumaa Waaqaaf waa kenne?”
english: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”

kikuyu: Wanti hundinuu isa irraa dhufe; isumaan dhufe; isaaf dhufe. Bara baraan ulfinni isaaf haa taʼu! Ameen.
english: For of him and through him and to him are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa obboloota, akka isin dhagna keessan aarsaa jiraataa, qulqullaaʼaa fi kan Waaqa gammachiisu gootanii dhiʼeessitaniif ani gara laafina Waaqaatiin isin kadhadha; kunis waaqeffannaa keessan kan hafuuraa ti.
english: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

kikuyu: Fedhiin Waaqaa gaariin, gammachiisaanii fi kan mudaa hin qabne maal akka taʼe qorattanii akka mirkaneessuu dandeessaniif haaromfamuu qalbii keessaniitiin geeddaramaa malee addunyaa kana hin fakkaatinaa.
english: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

kikuyu: Ani ayyaana naa kennameen tokkoo tokkoo keessan nan gorsaatii: Akka madaalii amantii kan Waaqni isinii kenne sanaatti qalbeeffannaadhaan waaʼee ofii keessanii yaadaa malee hamma yaaduu qabdanii olitti hin yaadinaa.
