english: For I say through the grace that was given me, to everyone who is among you, not to think of yourself more highly than you ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

kikuyu: Akkuma dhagni keenya kutaa baayʼee qabu, akkuma kutaawwan kunneenis hojii wal fakkaatu hin qabaatin sana
english: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

kikuyu: akkasuma immoo nu warri baayʼee taane Kiristoosiin dhagna tokkoo dha; tokkoon tokkoon kutaa dhagnaa kan walii isaanii ti.
english: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members of one another,

kikuyu: Nu akkuma ayyaana nuu kennameetti kennaa garaa garaa qabna. Yoo kennaan nama tokkoo raajii dubbachuu taʼe, inni akkuma amantii isaatitti haa dubbatu.
english: having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us: if prophecy, let’s prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

kikuyu: Yoo tajaajiluu taʼe, haa tajaajilu; yoo barsiisuu taʼe, haa barsiisu;
english: or service, let’s give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

kikuyu: yoo jajjabeessuu taʼe, haa jajjabeessu; yoo warra rakkataniif kennuu taʼe, arjummaadhaan haa kennu; yoo bulchuu taʼe, jabaatee haa bulchu; yoo maaruu taʼe, gammachuun haa maaru.
english: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting; he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

kikuyu: Jaalalli keessan itti fakkeessuudhaan hin taʼin. Waan hamaa jibbaa; waan gaariitti maxxanaa.
english: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

kikuyu: Jaalala obbolummaatiin jabeessaa wal jaalladhaa. Ulfina walii kennuutti wal dorgomaa.
english: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor prefer one another,

kikuyu: Gooftaa tajaajiluu keessatti hafuura gubaa qabaadhaa malee hinaaffaa hin dhabinaa.
english: not lagging in diligence, fervent in spirit, serving the Lord,

kikuyu: Abdiidhaan gammadaa; dhiphina obsaa; kadhannaatti cimaa.
english: rejoicing in hope, enduring in troubles, continuing steadfastly in prayer,

kikuyu: Qulqulloota rakkataniif waa gumaachaa. Keessummoota simadhaa.
english: contributing to the needs of the saints, and given to hospitality.

kikuyu: Warra isin ariʼatan eebbisaa; eebbisaa malee hin abaarinaa.
english: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

kikuyu: Warra gammadan wajjin gammadaa; warra booʼan wajjin booʼaa.
english: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

kikuyu: Walii galteedhaan wajjin jiraadhaa. Warra jireenya gad aanaa jiraatan wajjin jiraadhaa malee hin koorinaa. Of hin tuulinaa.
english: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

kikuyu: Nama kamiif iyyuu hammina hamminaan hin deebisinaa. Nama hunda duratti waan gaarii hojjedhaa.
english: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

kikuyu: Yoo dandaʼame, gama keessaniin nama hunda wajjin nagaan jiraadhaa.
english: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

kikuyu: Yaa jaallatamtoota, dheekkamsa Waaqaatiif iddoo kennaa malee haaloo hin baʼinaa; Gooftaan, “Haaloo baasuun kan koo ti; ani gatii nan deebisa” jedha, jedhamee barreeffameeraatii.
english: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

kikuyu: Garuu, “Yoo diinni kee beelaʼe, beela baasi; yoo inni dheebotes, waan inni dhugu kenniif. Kana gochuu keetiin barbadaa ibiddaa mataa isaa irra tuulta.”
english: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

kikuyu: Gaarummaan hammina moʼi malee hamminaan hin moʼamin.
english: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

kikuyu: Namni kam iyyuu warra taayitaa bulchiinsaa irra jiran jalatti buluu qaba; yoo Waaqa irraa taʼe malee taayitaa qabaachuun hin dandaʼamuutii. Warra taayitaa qaban Waaqatu muude.
english: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namni abbootii taayitaatiin mormu sirna Waaqaatiin morma; warri akkas godhanis murtii ofitti fidu.
english: Therefore he who resists the authority withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

kikuyu: Bulchitoonni warra waan hamaa hojjetan malee warra waan gaarii hojjetan hin sodaachisan. Ati akka nama taayitaa qabu hin sodaanne ni barbaaddaa? Egaa waan gaarii hojjedhu; inni iyyuu si galateeffataatii.
english: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the authority,

kikuyu: Inni waan gaarii siif gochuudhaaf tajaajilaa Waaqaatii. Ati garuu yoo waan hamaa hojjette sodaadhu; inni akkasumaan goraadee hin qabatuutii. Inni tajaajilaa Waaqaa kan warra waan hamaa hojjetan irratti dheekkamsa fiduun haaloo baasuu dha.
english: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu sababii dheekkamsaa qofaaf utuu hin taʼin, yaada qulqulluudhaan warra taayitaa irra jiran jalatti buluun barbaachisaa dha.
english: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

kikuyu: Isinis kanumaaf qaraxa baaftu; abbootiin taayitaa tajaajiltoota Waaqaa warra yeroo isaanii guutuu hojii bulchiinsaatiif kennaniidhaatii.
english: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, continually doing this very thing.

kikuyu: Waan nama hundaaf kennuun isin irra jiru kennaa; yoo qaraxa taʼe qaraxa, yoo gibira taʼe immoo gibira baasaa; yoo sodaachuu taʼe sodaadhaa; yoo ulfina kennuu taʼes, ulfina kennaa.
english: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

kikuyu: Isin wal jaallachuu malee gatii tokko illee of irraa hin qabaatinaa; namni nama biraa jaallatu kam iyyuu seera raawwateeraatii.
english: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

kikuyu: Ajajawwan, “Hin ejjin; hin ajjeesin; hin hatin; hin hawwin” jedhanii fi ajajni biraas seera, “Ollaa kee akkuma ofii keetiitti jaalladhu” jedhu kanaan walitti guduunfamu.
english: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

kikuyu: Jaalalli ollaa isaa hin miidhu. Kanaafuu jaalalli raawwii seeraa ti.
english: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

kikuyu: Yeroon isin hirribaa dammaqxan amma akka taʼe hubadhaa. Yeroo nu itti amanne sana caalaa fayyinni keenya amma nutti dhiʼaateeraatii.
english: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

kikuyu: Halkan bariʼuu gaʼeera; guyyaanis dhiʼaateera. Kanaafuu hojii dukkanaa of irraa gannee miʼa lolaa kan ifaa haa hidhannu.
english: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

kikuyu: Kottaa akka yeroo guyyaatti amala gaariin haa jiraannu; addaggummaa fi machiidhaan miti; jireenya sagaagalummaa fi gad dhiisiitiin miti; wal loluu fi hinaaffaadhaan miti.
english: Let’s walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa Yesuus Kiristoos Goofticha uffadhaa; akka itti hawwii foonii gammachiiftan hin yaadinaa.
english: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

kikuyu: Nama amantiitti dadhabaa taʼe ofitti qabaa; waan wal nama falmisiisu irrattis itti hin murinaa.
english: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

kikuyu: Namni tokko akka waan hunda nyaachuu dandaʼu amana; namni amantiin isaa dadhabaa taʼe kaan garuu biqiltuu qofa nyaata.
english: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

kikuyu: Namni nyaatu kan hin nyaatin hin tuffatin; inni hin nyaatinis kan nyaatutti hin murin; Waaqni isa ofitti qabeeraatii.
english: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

kikuyu: Hojjetaa nama kaaniitti kan murtu ati eenyu? Inni yoo dhaabates yoo kufes gooftaa isaatiif. Waan Gooftaan isa dhaabachiisuu dandaʼuufis ni dhaabata.
english: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

kikuyu: Namni tokko akka waan guyyaan tokko guyyaa kaan caaluutti yaada; namni kaan immoo guyyaan hundi tokkuma jedhee yaada. Namni kam iyyuu yaada ofii isaa guutummaatti amanee haa fudhatu.
english: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

kikuyu: Namni guyyicha kabaju Gooftaaf jedhee kabaja; kan guyyicha hin kabajnes Gooftaaf jedhee hin kabaju. Kan nyaatu Gooftaaf jedhee nyaata; inni Waaqa galateeffataatii; kan hin nyaannes Gooftaaf jedhee hin nyaatu; Waaqas ni galateeffata.
english: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

kikuyu: Nu keessaa namni mataa isaatiif jiraatu, kan mataa isaatiif duʼus hin jiruutii.
english: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

kikuyu: Nu yoo jiraanne Gooftaaf jiraanna; yoo duunes Gooftaaf duuna. Kanaafuu yoo jiraannes yoo duunes nu kan Gooftaa ti.
english: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf Kiristoos Gooftaa duʼaaleyyiitii fi jiraatoo taʼuuf duʼe; deebiʼees jiraataa taʼe.
english: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

kikuyu: Yoos ati maaliif obboleessa keetti murta ree? Yookaan maaliif obboleessa kee tuffatta ree? Nu hundi teessoo murtii Waaqaa dura ni dhaabannaatii.
english: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

kikuyu: Kunis: “ ‘Ani jiraataadhaatii; jilbi hundi anaaf ni jilbeenfata; arrabni hundi Waaqaaf dhugaa baʼa’ jedha Gooftaan” jedhamee barreeffameeraatii.
english: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

kikuyu: Kanaafis tokkoon tokkoon keenya waaʼee mataa keenyaa fuula Waaqaa duratti deebii ni kennina.
english: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu walitti muruu haa dhiifnu. Qooda kanaa akka karaa obboleessa keessanii irra gufuu yookaan waan gufachiisu tokko illee hin keenye murteeffadhaa.
english: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

kikuyu: Akka wanni ofuma isaatiin xuraaʼaa taʼe tokko iyyuu hin jirre ani karaa Gooftaa Yesuus nan beeka; nan amanas. Nama wanni tokko xuraaʼaadha jedhee yaaduuf garuu wanni sun isaaf xuraaʼaa dha.
english: I know and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

kikuyu: Yoo wanni ati nyaattu obboleessa kee miidhe, ati jaalalaan jiraachaa hin jirtu. Ati waan nyaattuun obboleessa kee isa Kiristoos isaaf duʼe hin balleessin.
english: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu wanti isin gaariidha jettan akka arrabsamu hin godhinaa.
english: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

kikuyu: Mootummaan Waaqaa qajeelummaa, nagaa fi gammachuu Hafuura Qulqulluun taʼeedha malee waaʼee nyaataa fi dhugaatii mitiitii.
english: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Namni haala kanaan Kiristoosin tajaajilu Waaqa gammachiisaatii; namoota birattis fudhatama argata.
english: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

kikuyu: Kanaaf waan nagaa fidu gochuu fi wal ijaaruuf haa tattaaffannu.
english: So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

kikuyu: Nyaataaf jettee hojii Waaqaa hin balleessin. Nyaanni hundi qulqulluu dha; garuu waan nama biraa gufachiisu kam iyyuu nyaachuun nama tokkoof dogoggora.
english: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

kikuyu: Akka obboleessi kee hin gufanneef, foon nyaachuu dhiisuun yookaan daadhii wayinii dhuguu dhiisuun yookaan waan biraa kam iyyuu gochuu dhiisuun gaarii dha.
english: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ati amantii waan kana irratti qabdu kam iyyuu fuula Waaqaa duratti ofumaa keetii qabaadhu. Namni waan amanee fudhate irratti ofitti hin murre eebbifamaa dha.
english: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

kikuyu: Namni shakkii qabu garuu nyaachuun isaa waan amantiin hin taʼiniif yoo nyaate isatti murama; wanni amantiin hin taʼin kam iyyuu cubbuudhaatii.
english: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

kikuyu: Nu warri jajjaboo taane, dadhabbii warra dadhaboo baachuu qabna malee ofuma gammachiisuu hin qabnu.
english: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon keenya ollaa keenya ijaaruuf, akka isatti toluuf waan isa gammachiisu gochuu qabna.
english: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

kikuyu: Kiristoos iyyuu ofii isaa hin gammachiifneetii; kun garuu akkuma, “Arrabsoon warra si arrabsanii narra gaʼeera” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”

kikuyu: Nu akka obsaa fi jajjabina Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluun kennaniin abdii qabaannuuf wanti duraan barreeffame hundi barumsa keenyaaf barreeffameetii.
english: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

kikuyu: Waaqni obsaa fi jajjabina namaa kennu sun akka isin yaaduma Kiristoos Yesuus qabaate sana walii qabaattan isin haa gargaaru.
english: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind with one another according to Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Kunis akka isin yaada tokkoo fi afaan tokkoon Waaqaaf, Abbaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiif ulfina kennitaniif.
english: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kanaaf akkuma Kiristoos ulfina Waaqaatiif jedhee isin simatetti isinis wal simadhaa.
english: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

kikuyu: Kiristoos dhugaa Waaqaatiif jedhee waadaa abbootiif kenname mirkaneessuuf akka tajaajilaa warra dhagna qabatanii taʼe ani isinittin himaatii;
english: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

kikuyu: kunis akka Namoonni Ormaa sababii araara isaatiif Waaqa ulfeessaniif. Innis akkuma, “Kanaafuu ani Namoota Ormaa gidduutti sin jajadha; maqaa keetiifis nan faarfadha” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore I will give praise to you among the Gentiles and sing to your name.”

kikuyu: Amma illee, “Yaa Namoota Ormaa, isin saba isaa wajjin gammadaa” jedha.
english: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”

kikuyu: Amma illee, “Yaa Namoota Ormaa, hundi keessan Gooftaa jajadhaa; namoonni hundinuus faarfannaadhaan isa leellisaa” jedha.
english: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”

kikuyu: Akkasumas Isaayyaas, “Hiddi Isseey kan saboota bulchuuf kaʼu tokko ni dhufa; Namoonni Ormaas isa abdatu” jedha.
english: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”

kikuyu: Isinis akka humna Hafuura Qulqulluutiin abdiitti akka malee guddattaniif, Waaqni abdii sun isa amanachuu keessaniin gammachuu fi nagaa hundumaan isin haa guutu.
english: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope in the power of the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota ko, isin ofii keessanii akka gaarummaadhaan guutuu taatan, akka beekumsaan guutamtanii fi akka wal gorsuu dandeessan ani iyyuu hubadheera.
english: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

kikuyu: Ani sababii ayyaana Waaqni naaf kenneetiif waan tokko tokko isin yaadachiisuuf jedhee ija jabinaan isinii barreesseera;
english: But I write the more boldly to you in part as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

kikuyu: kunis akka Namoonni Ormaa Hafuura Qulqulluun Qulqulleeffamanii fuula Waaqaa duratti aarsaa fudhatama qabu taʼanii fi akka ani lubummaa wangeela Waaqaa lallabuutiin Namoota Ormaatiif tajaajilaa Kiristoos Yesuus taʼuuf.
english: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani Waaqa tajaajiluu kootiin Kiristoos Yesuusiin nan boona.
english: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

kikuyu: Ani waan Kiristoos waan ani jedhee fi hojjedheen akka Namoonni Ormaa Waaqaaf ajajaman gochuudhaan karaa kootiin raawwateen alatti homaa dubbachuuf ija hin jabaadhu;
english: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

kikuyu: kunis humna mallattoo fi dinqiitiin, humna Hafuura Qulqulluutiinis raawwatame. Kanaafuu ani Yerusaalemii jalqabee naannaʼuun hamma Ilwaariqoonitti guutummaatti wangeela Kiristoos lallabeera.
english: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

kikuyu: Ani akka hundee namni biraa buuse irratti hin ijaarreef lafa Kiristoos itti hin beekaminitti wangeela lallabuuf yeroo hunda tattaaffadheera.
english: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

kikuyu: Kunis isa, “Warri waaʼeen isaa itti hin himamin ni argu; warri hin dhagaʼinis ni hubatu” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”

kikuyu: Anis kan yeroo baayʼee gara keessan dhufuu dhowwameef kanuma.
english: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

kikuyu: Amma garuu naannoowwan kanneenitti iddoon itti hojjedhu waan hin jirree fi anis waan isin arguuf waggaa baayʼee hawwaa tureef,
english: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

kikuyu: yeroo Isphaaniyaa dhaqu isinitti goruu nan yaada. Anis yeroo achi irra darbu erga isin argee xinnoo isin wajjin gammadee booddee akka imala koo irratti na gargaartan nan abdadha.
english: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

kikuyu: Amma garuu ani qulqulloota tajaajiluuf Yerusaalem dhaquuttin jira.
english: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

kikuyu: Warri Maqedooniyaatii fi Akaayaa qulqulloota Yerusaalem jiraatan keessaa kanneen hiyyeeyyii taʼaniif buusii gochuutti gammadaniiruutii.
english: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Isaan waan kana gochuuf ni gammadan; dhugumaanuu waan kana isaaniif gochuun dirqama isaanii ti. Namoonni Ormaa erga eebba hafuuraa Yihuudoota irraa qooddatanii, eebba isaanii kan foonii immoo Yihuudootaaf qooduun dirqama isaanii ti.
english: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in material things.

kikuyu: Kanaaf ani ergan waan kana raawwadhee, akka isaan buusii kana fudhatan mirkaneeffadhee booddee goree isin ilaalee Isphaaniyaa nan dhaqa.
english: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

kikuyu: Ani yommuu gara keessan dhufu akka eebba Kiristoosiin guutamee dhufu nan beeka.
english: I know that when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, akka isin kadhannaa Waaqa kadhattan keessatti naaf kadhachuudhaan na wajjin dhamaatan Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiin, jaalala Hafuura Qulqulluutiinis isinin kadhadha.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

kikuyu: Akka ani namoota Yihuudaa keessa jiraatan kanneen hin amanin jalaa baʼuu fi akka tajaajilli koos Yerusaalem keessatti qulqulloota achi jiraatan biratti fudhatama argatu naaf kadhadhaa;
english: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints,

kikuyu: kunis akka ani fedhii Waaqaatiin, gammachuudhaan isin bira dhufee isin wajjin boqodhuuf.
english: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

kikuyu: Waaqni nagaa hunduma keessan wajjin haa taʼu. Ameen.
english: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Obboleettii keenya Feebeen tajaajiltuu waldaa kiristaanaa ishee Kanchireʼaa imaanaa isinitti nan kennadha.
english: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

kikuyu: Isheen namoota baayʼeef, anaafis gargaarsa guddaa waan taateef akka isin simannaa qulqullootaaf maluun Gooftaadhaan ishee simattanii fi akka gargaarsa isheen isin irraa barbaaddu kam iyyuu isheef gootan isinin kadhadhaa.
english: that you receive her in the Lord in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

kikuyu: Phirisqilaa fi Aqiilaa, warra Kiristoos Yesuusiin na wajjin tajaajilanitti nagaa naa himaa.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Isaan naa jedhanii lubbuu isaanii balaaf saaxilan. Utuu ana qofa hin taʼin Waldaaleen Kiristaanaa Namoota Ormaa hundinuus isaan galateeffatu.
english: who risked their own necks for my life, to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Waldaa Kiristaanaa kan mana isaaniitti walitti qabamtuttis nagaa naa himaa. Biyya Asiyaa keessaa Kiristoositti amanuutti hangafa kan taʼe michuu koo jaallatamaa Axeenexoonittis nagaa naa himaa.
english: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

kikuyu: Maariyaam ishee baayʼee isinii dhamaatettis nagaa naa himaa.
english: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

kikuyu: Firoota koo warra na wajjin hidhaman Androoniqoosii fi Yuuniyaanittis nagaa naa himaa. Isaan warra ergamoota keessaa maqaa gaarii qaban kanneen na dura Kiristoositti amananii dha.
english: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

kikuyu: Amphiliyaaxos isa ani Gooftaadhaan jaalladhutti nagaa naa himaa.
english: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

kikuyu: Urbaanos isa Kiristoosin nu wajjin tajaajiluu fi michuu koo jaallatamaa Isxaakisittis nagaa naa himaa.
english: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

kikuyu: Apheelees isa Kiristoositti amanamuun isaa qoramee mirkaneeffametti nagaa naa himaa. Warra mana Arisxoobuluu jiraatanittis nagaa naa himaa.
english: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

kikuyu: Fira koo Heroodiyoonaatti, nagaa naa himaa. Warra mana Naarkisoos jiraatan kanneen Gooftaatti amananittis nagaa naa himaa.
english: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

kikuyu: Warra Gooftaatti amananii dhamaʼan Tiriifeenaa fi Tiriifoosaatti nagaa naa himaa. Pharsiis jaallatamtuu hojii Gooftaatti amantee baayʼee dhamaatettis nagaa naa himaa.
english: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

kikuyu: Ruufoos isa Gooftaadhaan filatamee fi haadha isaa ishee anaafis haadha taatetti nagaa naa himaa.
english: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

kikuyu: Asinqiriixoositti, Fileegoonitti, Hermeesitti, Phaaxroobaasitti, Hermaasittii fi obboloota isaan wajjin jiranitti nagaa naa himaa.
english: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

kikuyu: Filologoonitti, Yuuliyaatti, Neeriyoosittii fi obboleettii isaatti, Olimphaasittii fi qulqulloota isaan wajjin jiran hundattis nagaa naa himaa.
english: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

kikuyu: Dhungoo qulqulluudhaan nagaa wal gaafadhaa. Waldaaleen Kiristoos hundinuu nagaa isinii dhaamu.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, ani akka isin warra gargar baʼuu uumanii barumsa isin barattaniinis mormuudhaan karaa keessan irra gufuu kaaʼan irraa of eeggattan isin kadhadha. Isaan irraa fagaadhaa.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

kikuyu: Namoonni akkasii garaa ofii malee Gooftaa keenya Kiristoosin hin tajaajilaniitii. Isaan afaan toluu fi saaduudhaan qalbii namoota garraamii ni hatu.
english: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

kikuyu: Waaʼeen ajajamuu keessanii nama hundumaa biratti dhagaʼameera; anis isinitti nan gammada; garuu akka isin waan gaariif ogeeyyii, waan hamaaf immoo garraamota taatan nan barbaada.
english: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

kikuyu: Waaqni nagaa dafee Seexana miilla keessan jalatti ni burkuteessa. Ayyaanni Gooftaa keenya Yesuus isin wajjin haa taʼu.
english: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

kikuyu: Xiimotewos inni na wajjin tajaajilu, akkasumas firoonni koo Luukiyoos, Yaasonii fi Soosiiphaaxroos nagaa isinii dhaamu.
english: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

kikuyu: Ani Xerxiwoos barreessaan xalayaa kanaa Gooftaadhaan nagaa isinii dhaama.
english: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

kikuyu: Gaayoos inni anaa fi waldaa Kiristaanaa guutuu keessumsiisus nagaa isinii dhaama. Bulchaan maallaqaa kan magaalaa kanaa Erisxoos, akkasumas obboleessi keenya Quʼasxiroos nagaa isinii dhaamu. [
english: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

kikuyu: Ayyaanni Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos isin hunda wajjin haa taʼu.]
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

kikuyu: Phaawulos isa akka ergamaa Kiristoos Yesuus taʼuuf fedhii Waaqaatiin waamamee fi obboleessa keenya Soosteenes irraa,
english: Paul, called to be an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, and our brother Sosthenes,

kikuyu: Gara waldaa Waaqaa ishee Qorontos keessa jirtuutti, gara warra Kiristoos Yesuusiin qulqulleeffamanii fi warra lafa hundaa kanneen maqaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos isa Gooftaa isaaniitii fi Gooftaa keenyas taʼe sanaa waammatan hunda wajjin qulqulloota taʼuuf waamamaniitti:
english: to the assembly of God which is at Corinth—those who are sanctified in Christ Jesus, called saints, with all who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ in every place, both theirs and ours:

kikuyu: Ayyaannii fi nagaan Abbaa keenya Waaqaa fi Yesuus Kiristoos Gooftaa irraa isiniif haa taʼu.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ani yeroo hunda ayyaana Waaqaa isa Kiristoos Yesuusiin isinii kennameef waaʼee keessaniif Waaqa nan galateeffadha.
english: I always thank my God concerning you for the grace of God which was given you in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Isinis karaa hundaan jechuunis dubbii fi beekumsa hundaan isaan badhaataniirtu;
english: that in everything you were enriched in him, in all speech and all knowledge—

kikuyu: wanti nu waaʼee Kiristoos dhugaa baane sun isin gidduutti mirkaneeffameeraatii.
english: even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in you—

kikuyu: Kanaafuu utuu mulʼachuu Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos eeggachaa jirtanuu kennaan hafuuraa tokko iyyuu isin jalaa hin hirʼatu.
english: so that you come behind in no gift, waiting for the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Akka isin guyyaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoositti warra mudaa hin qabne taataniifis inni hamma dhumaatti jabeessee isin eega.
english: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Waaqni gara tokkummaa Ilma isaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoositti isin waame sun amanamaa dha.
english: God is faithful, through whom you were called into the fellowship of his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, ani akka isin gidduu gargar baʼuun hin jiraannee fi akka qalbii fi yaada tokko qabaattanii hundi keessan walii galtaniif maqaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiin isin kadhadha.
english: Now I beg you, brothers, through the name of our Lord, Jesus Christ, that you all speak the same thing, and that there be no divisions among you, but that you be perfected together in the same mind and in the same judgment.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota ko, akka isin gidduu lolli jiru warri mana Kiloʼee jiraatan tokko tokko natti himaniiru.
english: For it has been reported to me concerning you, my brothers, by those who are from Chloe’s household, that there are contentions among you.

kikuyu: Wanti ani jedhus kana: Isin keessaa namni tokko, “Ani kan Phaawulos” jedha; inni kaan, “Ani kan Apholoos” jedha; kaanis, “Ani kan Keefaa ti” jedha; kaan immoo, “Ani kan Kiristoos” jedha.
english: Now I mean this, that each one of you says, “I follow Paul,” “I follow Apollos,” “I follow Cephas,” and, “I follow Christ.”

kikuyu: Kiristoos gargar qoodameeraa? Phaawulositu isinii fannifame ree? Yookaan maqaa Phaawulosiin cuuphamtanii?
english: Is Christ divided? Was Paul crucified for you? Or were you baptized into the name of Paul?

kikuyu: Ani Kiriisphoosii fi Gaayoosin malee isin keessaa nama tokko illee waan hin cuuphiniif Waaqa nan galateeffadha.
english: I thank God that I baptized none of you except Crispus and Gaius,

kikuyu: Kanaaf namni akka isin maqaa kootiin cuuphamtan dubbachuu dandaʼu tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: so that no one should say that I had baptized you into my own name.

kikuyu: Eeyyee, ani warra mana Isxiifaanaas jiraatanis akkasuma cuupheera; sanaan alatti nama biraa tokko illee cuuphuu koo hin yaadadhu.
english: (I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)

kikuyu: Kiristoos akka ani wangeela lallabuuf malee akka ani cuuphuuf na hin ergineetii; anis akka fannoon Kiristoos humna hin dhabneef dubbii ogummaa namaatiin hin lallabu.
english: For Christ sent me not to baptize, but to preach the Good News—not in wisdom of words, so that the cross of Christ wouldn’t be made void.

kikuyu: Dubbiin fannoo warra baduuf jiraniif gowwummaadhaatii; nu warra fayyinuuf garuu humna Waaqaa ti.
english: For the word of the cross is foolishness to those who are dying, but to us who are being saved it is the power of God.

kikuyu: Kunis, “Ani ogummaa ogeeyyii nan balleessa; hubannaa hubattootaas nan fashaleessa” jedhamee barreeffameera.
english: For it is written, “I will destroy the wisdom of the wise. I will bring the discernment of the discerning to nothing.”

kikuyu: Namni ogeessi eessa jira? Hayyuun eessa jira? Falaasamaan bara kanaa eessa jira? Waaqni ogummaa addunyaa kanaa gowwummaa hin goonee ree?
english: Where is the wise? Where is the scribe? Where is the debater of this age? Hasn’t God made foolish the wisdom of this world?

kikuyu: Sababii ogummaa Waaqaatiin addunyaan karaa ogummaa isheetiin Waaqa waan hin beekiniif, Waaqni gowwummaa lallabaatiin warra amanan fayyisuu jaallate.
english: For seeing that in the wisdom of God, the world through its wisdom didn’t know God, it was God’s good pleasure through the foolishness of the preaching to save those who believe.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonni mallattoo fedhu; Giriikonni immoo ogummaa barbaadu;
english: For Jews ask for signs, Greeks seek after wisdom,

kikuyu: nu garuu Kiristoos isa fannifame sana lallabna; innis Yihuudootatti gufuu dha; Namoota Ormaatiif immoo gowwummaa dha;
english: but we preach Christ crucified, a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Greeks,

kikuyu: warra waamamaniif garuu Yihuudootaafis taʼu Giriikotaaf Kiristoos humna Waaqaatii fi ogummaa Waaqaa ti.
english: but to those who are called, both Jews and Greeks, Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God;

kikuyu: Gowwummaan Waaqaa ogummaa namaa caalaa ogeessaatii; dadhabbiin Waaqaas jabina namaa irra jabaa dha.
english: because the foolishness of God is wiser than men, and the weakness of God is stronger than men.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, isin yeroo waamamtanitti maal akka turtan yaadadhaa. Akka ilaalcha namaatti baayʼeen keessan ogeeyyii hin turre; baayʼeen keessanis beekamoo hin turre; baayʼeen keessan immoo sanyii warra gurguddaa irraa hin dhalanne.
english: For you see your calling, brothers, that not many are wise according to the flesh, not many mighty, and not many noble;

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu ogeeyyii qaanessuuf jedhee waan addunyaa irratti gowwaa taʼe filate; Waaqni warra jajjabeeyyii qaanessuuf jedhee waan addunyaa irratti dadhabaa taʼe filate.
english: but God chose the foolish things of the world that he might put to shame those who are wise. God chose the weak things of the world that he might put to shame the things that are strong.

kikuyu: Waaqni waan jiru waan hin jirre gochuuf, waan addunyaa kana irratti gad aanaa fi tuffatamaa taʼe, waan iddoo hin qabnes filate;
english: God chose the lowly things of the world, and the things that are despised, and the things that don’t exist, that he might bring to nothing the things that exist,

kikuyu: kunis akka eenyu iyyuu isa duratti of hin jajneef.
english: that no flesh should boast before God.

kikuyu: Isin sababii isaatiin kan Kiristoos Yesuus taatan; inni ogummaa keenya kan Waaqa biraa dhufe jechuunis qajeelummaa keenya, qulqullummaa fi furii keenyaa dha.
english: Because of him, you are in Christ Jesus, who was made to us wisdom from God, and righteousness and sanctification, and redemption,

kikuyu: Kunis akkuma, “Namni boonu Gooftaadhaan haa boonu” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: that, as it is written, “He who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, ani yeroon gara keessan dhufetti, afaan toluun yookaan ogummaa guddaadhaan dhuga baʼumsa waaʼee Waaqaa lallabaa hin dhufne.
english: When I came to you, brothers, I didn’t come with excellence of speech or of wisdom, proclaiming to you the testimony of God.

kikuyu: Ani yeroon isin bira turetti Yesuus Kiristoos isa fannifame sana malee akka waan tokko illee hin beekne murteesseen tureetii.
english: For I determined not to know anything among you except Jesus Christ and him crucified.

kikuyu: Ani dadhabbiin, sodaa fi hollannaa guddaadhaan gara keessan dhufe.
english: I was with you in weakness, in fear, and in much trembling.

kikuyu: Ergaan koo fi lallabni koo Hafuuraa fi humna argisiisuudhaan malee dubbii ogummaa fi sossobbii of keessaa qabuun hin turre;
english: My speech and my preaching were not in persuasive words of human wisdom, but in demonstration of the Spirit and of power,

kikuyu: kunis akka amantiin keessan humna Waaqaa irratti malee ogummaa namaa irratti hin hundeeffamneef.
english: that your faith wouldn’t stand in the wisdom of men, but in the power of God.

kikuyu: Haa taʼuu malee nu warra bilchaatan gidduutti ogummaa dubbanna; garuu ogummaa addunyaa kanaa yookaan ogummaa bulchitoota addunyaa kanaa kanneen baduuf jiranii miti.
english: We speak wisdom, however, among those who are full grown, yet a wisdom not of this world nor of the rulers of this world who are coming to nothing.

kikuyu: Garuu nu ogummaa Waaqaa, ogummaa dhokfamee ture, isa Waaqni uumama addunyaatiin dura ulfina keenyaaf jedhee murteesse sanaa icciitiidhaan dubbanna.
english: But we speak God’s wisdom in a mystery, the wisdom that has been hidden, which God foreordained before the worlds for our glory,

kikuyu: Bulchitoota addunyaa kanaa keessaa tokko iyyuu ogummaa kana hin hubanne; isaan utuu hubatanii jiraatanii silaa Gooftaa ulfinaa hin fannisan tureetii.
english: which none of the rulers of this world has known. For had they known it, they wouldn’t have crucified the Lord of glory.

kikuyu: Taʼu iyyuu akkuma, “Waan Waaqni warra isa jaallataniif qopheesse iji hin argine, gurri hin dhageenye, garaa namaattis hin yaadamne” jedhamee barreeffame sana,
english: But as it is written, “Things which an eye didn’t see, and an ear didn’t hear, which didn’t enter into the heart of man, these God has prepared for those who love him.”

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu Hafuura isaatiin waan kana nutti mulʼiseera. Hafuurri wantoota hunda, wantoota Waaqaa kanneen gad fagoo taʼan illee ni qora.
english: But to us, God revealed them through the Spirit. For the Spirit searches all things, yes, the deep things of God.

kikuyu: Hafuura isa keessa jiru malee yaada nama tokkoo eenyutu beeka? Akkasuma immoo Hafuura Waaqaa malee kan yaada Waaqaa beeku tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: For who among men knows the things of a man except the spirit of the man which is in him? Even so, no one knows the things of God except God’s Spirit.

kikuyu: Nu akka waan Waaqni toluma nuu kenne hubannuuf Hafuura Waaqa irraa dhufe arganne malee hafuura addunyaa hin arganne.
english: But we received not the spirit of the world, but the Spirit which is from God, that we might know the things that were freely given to us by God.

kikuyu: Wanni nu dubbannus kana; nu dubbii Hafuurri nu barsiisuun malee dubbii ogummaan namaa barsiisuun hin dubbannu; dhugaa Hafuuraas dubbii Hafuuraatiin ibsina.
english: We also speak these things, not in words which man’s wisdom teaches but which the Holy Spirit teaches, comparing spiritual things with spiritual things.

kikuyu: Namni foonii wantoota Hafuura Waaqaa hin fudhatu; kun isaaf gowwummaadhaatii; wantoonni Hafuuraa waan Hafuuraan qoramaniif inni hubachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: Now the natural man doesn’t receive the things of God’s Spirit, for they are foolishness to him; and he can’t know them, because they are spiritually discerned.

kikuyu: Namni Hafuuraa waan hundumaa ni qora; ofii isaatii garuu eenyuun iyyuu hin qoramu.
english: But he who is spiritual discerns all things, and he himself is to be judged by no one.

kikuyu: “Akka isa barsiisuuf, eenyutu yaada garaa Gooftaa beeke?” Nu garuu yaada garaa Kiristoos qabna.
english: “For who has known the mind of the Lord that he should instruct him?” But we have Christ’s mind.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, ani akka namoota foonii warra Kiristoositti daaʼimman taataniitti malee akka namoota Hafuuraatti isinitti dubbachuu hin dandeenye.
english: Brothers, I couldn’t speak to you as to spiritual, but as to fleshly, as to babies in Christ.

kikuyu: Waan isin nyaata jabaa nyaachuu hin gaʼiniif ani aannan isiniif kenne malee nyaata cimaa isinii hin kennine. Dhugumaan isin amma iyyuu nyaachuu hin dandeenye.
english: I fed you with milk, not with solid food, for you weren’t yet ready. Indeed, you aren’t ready even now,

kikuyu: Isin amma iyyuu nama foonii ti. Sababii hinaaffaa fi wal qoccoluun isin gidduu jiruuf isin nama foonii mitii? Akkuma namoota kaaniitti jiraattu mitii?
english: for you are still fleshly. For insofar as there is jealousy, strife, and factions among you, aren’t you fleshly, and don’t you walk in the ways of men?

kikuyu: Namni tokko, “Ani kan Phaawulos” jedhee, inni kaan immoo, “Ani kan Apholoos” yoo jedhe isin namuma qofa mitii ree?
english: For when one says, “I follow Paul,” and another, “I follow Apollos,” aren’t you fleshly?

kikuyu: Egaa Apholoos eenyu? Phaawulosis eenyu? Isaan warra akkuma hojii Gooftaan tokkoo tokkoo isaaniitiif kenneetti tajaajilanii dha; isin immoo karaa isaaniitiin amantan.
english: Who then is Apollos, and who is Paul, but servants through whom you believed, and each as the Lord gave to him?

kikuyu: Ani nan dhaabe; Apholoos bishaan obaase; Waaqni garuu ni guddise.
english: I planted. Apollos watered. But God gave the increase.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqa isa guddisu sana malee namichi dhaabu yookaan inni bishaan obaasu sun homaa miti.
english: So then neither he who plants is anything, nor he who waters, but God who gives the increase.

kikuyu: Inni dhaabus, inni bishaan obaasus tokkuma; tokkoon tokkoon isaaniis akkuma dadhabbii isaaniitti gatii ni argatu.
english: Now he who plants and he who waters are the same, but each will receive his own reward according to his own labor.

kikuyu: Nu warra Waaqa wajjin hojjennuu dha; isin lafa qotiisaa Waaqaa ti; ijaarsa Waaqaatis.
english: For we are God’s fellow workers. You are God’s farming, God’s building.

kikuyu: Anis ayyaana Waaqni naa kenneen akkuma ogeessa ijaarsaa tokkootti hundee buuseera; namni kaan immoo isa irratti ijaaraa jira. Garuu tokkoon tokkoon namaa akkamitti akka ijaaru of eeggachuu qaba.
english: According to the grace of God which was given to me, as a wise master builder I laid a foundation, and another builds on it. But let each man be careful how he builds on it.

kikuyu: Namni tokko iyyuu hundee duraan buufame sana malee kan biraa buusuu hin dandaʼuutii; hundeen sunis Yesuus Kiristoos.
english: For no one can lay any other foundation than that which has been laid, which is Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Namni kam iyyuu yoo hundee sana irratti warqeen, meetiin, dhagaa gatii guddaatiin, mukaan, citaan yookaan hoffaan ijaare,
english: But if anyone builds on the foundation with gold, silver, costly stones, wood, hay, or straw,

kikuyu: guyyaan sun waan ifatti isa baasuuf hojiin isaa maal akka taʼe ni beekama. Innis ibiddaan ifatti baafama; ibiddi sunis qulqullina hojii nama hundaa ni qora.
english: each man’s work will be revealed. For the Day will declare it, because it is revealed in fire; and the fire itself will test what sort of work each man’s work is.

kikuyu: Yoo wanni inni ijaare utuu hin gubatin hafeef inni gatii isaa ni argata.
english: If any man’s work remains which he built on it, he will receive a reward.

kikuyu: Namni hojiin isaa jalaa gubate kam iyyuu gatii isaa ni dhaba; inni mataan isaa garuu ni oolfama; taʼus akka nama ibidda keessa darbeetti oolfama.
english: If any man’s work is burned, he will suffer loss, but he himself will be saved, but as through fire.

kikuyu: Isin akka mana qulqullummaa Waaqaa taatanii fi akka Hafuurri Waaqaa isin keessa jiraatu hin beektanii?
english: Don’t you know that you are God’s temple and that God’s Spirit lives in you?

kikuyu: Eenyu iyyuu yoo mana qulqullummaa Waaqaa balleesse, Waaqni isa ni balleessa; manni qulqullummaa Waaqaa qulqulluudhaatii; manni qulqullummaa sunis isin.
english: If anyone destroys God’s temple, God will destroy him; for God’s temple is holy, which you are.

kikuyu: Eenyu iyyuu of hin gowwoomsin. Isin keessaa namni tokko yoo addunyaa kana irratti ogeessa of seʼe, inni akka ogeessa taʼuuf gowwaa haa taʼu.
english: Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool that he may become wise.

kikuyu: Ogummaan addunyaa kanaa fuula Waaqaa duratti gowwummaadhaatii. Kunis isa, “Inni ogeeyyii haxxummaa isaaniitiin qaba” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: For the wisdom of this world is foolishness with God. For it is written, “He has taken the wise in their craftiness.”

kikuyu: Akkasumas, “Gooftaan akka yaadni ogeeyyii faayidaa hin qabne ni beeka” jedhameera.
english: And again, “The Lord knows the reasoning of the wise, that it is worthless.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu eenyu iyyuu namaan hin booniin! Wanni hundinuu keessaniitii;
english: Therefore let no one boast in men. For all things are yours,

kikuyu: Phaawulosis taʼu Apholoos yookaan Keefaan yookaan addunyaan yookaan jireenyi yookaan duuti yookaan wanti amma jirus taʼu wanti dhufu hundinuu keessan;
english: whether Paul, or Apollos, or Cephas, or the world, or life, or death, or things present, or things to come. All are yours,

kikuyu: isin kan Kiristoos; Kiristoos immoo kan Waaqaa ti.
english: and you are Christ’s, and Christ is God’s.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namni akka tajaajiltoota Kiristoosii fi akka warra icciitiin Waaqaa imaanaa itti kennameetti nu ilaaluu qaba.
english: So let a man think of us as Christ’s servants and stewards of God’s mysteries.

kikuyu: Warra imaanaan itti kenname sanas amanamoo taʼuutu irraa eegama.
english: Here, moreover, it is required of stewards that they be found faithful.

kikuyu: Yoo isiniin yookaan nama kaaniin natti murame ani homaattuu hin lakkaaʼu; dhugumaan anuu ofitti hin muru.
english: But with me it is a very small thing that I should be judged by you, or by a human court. Yes, I don’t even judge my own self.

kikuyu: Yaadni garaa koo qulqulluu dha; kun garuu qulqullina koo hin mirkaneessu. Kan natti muru Gooftaa dha.
english: For I know nothing against myself. Yet I am not justified by this, but he who judges me is the Lord.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isin utuu yeroon murteeffame sun hin gaʼin murtii tokko iyyuu hin kenninaa; hamma Gooftaan dhufutti eegaa. Inni waan dukkana keessatti dhokfame ifatti ni baasa; hawwii garaa namaas ni mulʼisa. Yeroo sana namni hundinuu Waaqa biraa galata ni argata.
english: Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of darkness and reveal the counsels of the hearts. Then each man will get his praise from God.

kikuyu: Egaa yaa obboloota, ani akka isin jechi, “Waan barreeffame irra hin darbin” jedhu sun maal jechuu akka taʼe nurraa barattaniif buʼaa keessaniif jedhee waan kana hunda Apholoosii fi ofii kootti fakkeesseera; kunis akka isin nama tokko isa kaan caalchiftanii hin koorreef.
english: Now these things, brothers, I have in a figure transferred to myself and Apollos for your sakes, that in us you might learn not to think beyond the things which are written, that none of you be puffed up against one another.

kikuyu: Eenyutu akka ati warra kaan caaltu si godhe? Wanni Waaqni siif hin kennin kan ati qabdu maal faatu jira? Erga siif kennamee immoo akka waan kennaa hin taʼiniitti maaliif boonta ree?
english: For who makes you different? And what do you have that you didn’t receive? But if you did receive it, why do you boast as if you had not received it?

kikuyu: Amma isin waan barbaaddan hundumaa argattaniirtu! Sooromtaniirtus! Nurraa gargar baatanii mootota taataniirtu! Nus akka isin wajjin mootota taanuuf utuu isin mootota taatanii ani akkaman hawwa ture!
english: You are already filled. You have already become rich. You have come to reign without us. Yes, and I wish that you did reign, that we also might reign with you!

kikuyu: Waaqni, nu ergamoota akka namoota duuti itti murtaaʼeetti waan dhuma hiriiraa nu taasise natti fakkaataatii. Nu addunyaa duratti, ergamootaa fi namoota durattis waan daawwatamu taaneerra.
english: For I think that God has displayed us, the apostles, last of all, like men sentenced to death. For we are made a spectacle to the world, both to angels and men.

kikuyu: Nu Kiristoosiif jennee gowwoota; isin garuu Kiristoosiin ogeeyyii dha! Nu dadhaboo dha; isin immoo jajjabeeyyii dha! Isin kabajamtoota; nu immoo tuffatamtoota!
english: We are fools for Christ’s sake, but you are wise in Christ. We are weak, but you are strong. You have honor, but we have dishonor.

kikuyu: Hamma saʼaatii ammaatti ni beelofna; ni dheebonna; ni daarra; ni reebamna; mana jireenyaas hin qabnu.
english: Even to this present hour we hunger, thirst, are naked, are beaten, and have no certain dwelling place.

kikuyu: Harkuma keenyaan hojjechuudhaanis ni dadhabna. Yommuu abaaramnu ni eebbifna; yommuu ariʼatamnus ni obsina.
english: We toil, working with our own hands. When people curse us, we bless. Being persecuted, we endure.

kikuyu: Yommuu arrabsamnu, waan gaarii deebifna; hamma yeroo kanaattis xurii lafaatii fi kosii addunyaa taaneerra.
english: Being defamed, we entreat. We are made as the filth of the world, the dirt wiped off by all, even until now.

kikuyu: Kanas isinii barreessuun koo akka ijoollee koo kanneen jaallatamaniitti isin gorsuudhaaf malee isin qaanessuuf miti.
english: I don’t write these things to shame you, but to admonish you as my beloved children.

kikuyu: Isin yoo karaa Kiristoosiin guddiftoota kuma kudhan qabaattan iyyuu, abbootii baayʼee hin qabdan; ani Kiristoos Yesuusiin karaa wangeelaatiin abbaa keessan taʼeeraatii.
english: For though you have ten thousand tutors in Christ, you don’t have many fathers. For in Christ Jesus, I became your father through the Good News.

kikuyu: Kanaaf ani akka isin fakkeenya koo duukaa buutan isinan kadhadha.
english: I beg you therefore, be imitators of me.

kikuyu: Sababii kanaafis ani ilma koo isan jaalladhu, kan Gooftaattis amanamaa taʼe Xiimotewosin gara keessanitti ergeera. Innis haala jireenya koo kan ani Kiristoos Yesuusiin argadhe kan waan ani iddoo hundatti waldaa kiristaanaa hunda keessatti barsiisu wajjin deemu sana isin yaadachiisa.
english: Because of this I have sent Timothy to you, who is my beloved and faithful child in the Lord, who will remind you of my ways which are in Christ, even as I teach everywhere in every assembly.

kikuyu: Isin keessaa namoonni tokko tokko waan ani gara keessan hin dhufne seʼanii of tuulanii jiru.
english: Now some are puffed up, as though I were not coming to you.

kikuyu: Yoo fedhii Waaqaa taʼe garuu ani dafee gara keessan nan dhufa; ergasii waan of tuultonni kunneen dubbatan qofa utuu hin taʼin humna isaan qabanis beekuu nan barbaada.
english: But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but the power.

kikuyu: Mootummaan Waaqaa humnaan malee dubbiidhaan miti.
english: For God’s Kingdom is not in word, but in power.

kikuyu: Isin maal barbaaddu? Ani ulee qabadhee moo jaalalaa fi hafuura gad of qabuutiin gara keessan dhufa?
english: What do you want? Shall I come to you with a rod, or in love and a spirit of gentleness?

kikuyu: Akka halalummaan ormoota keessatti illee hin beekamin isin gidduu jiru odeeffamaa jira: namni niitii abbaa isaa wajjin ciise tokko jiraatii.
english: It is actually reported that there is sexual immorality among you, and such sexual immorality as is not even named among the Gentiles, that one has his father’s wife.

kikuyu: Isinis of tuultaniirtu! Qooda kanaa akka malee gadditanii namicha waan akkasii hojjete sana tokkummaa keessan keessaa baasuun isin irra hin jiruu?
english: You are arrogant, and didn’t mourn instead, that he who had done this deed might be removed from among you.

kikuyu: Ani fooniin isin biratti argamuu baadhu illee hafuuraan isin wajjinan jira. Ani akka waan isin wajjin jiruutti namicha waan akkasii hojjetetti ammuma mureera.
english: For I most certainly, as being absent in body but present in spirit, have already, as though I were present, judged him who has done this thing.

kikuyu: Yommuu isin maqaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuusiin walitti qabamtanitti anis yeroo hafuuraan isin wajjin taʼuuttii fi humna Gooftaa keenya Yesuus arganutti,
english: In the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, when you are gathered together with my spirit with the power of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: akka foon isaa balleeffamuuf, akka hafuurri isaa immoo guyyaa Gooftaatti fayyuuf namicha kana dabarsaatii Seexanatti kennaa.
english: you are to deliver such a one to Satan for the destruction of the flesh, that the spirit may be saved in the day of the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Of tuuluun keessan gaarii miti. Isin akka raacitiin xinnoon bukoo guutuu bukeessitu hin beektanii?
english: Your boasting is not good. Don’t you know that a little yeast leavens the whole lump?

kikuyu: Isin waan bukoo raacitii hin qabne taataniif akka Maxinoo haaraa taataniif raacitii moofaa of keessaa baasaatii gataa; hoolaan Faasiikaa keenya, Kiristoos aarsaa nuuf taʼeeraatii.
english: Purge out the old yeast, that you may be a new lump, even as you are unleavened. For indeed Christ, our Passover, has been sacrificed in our place.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu kottaa raacitii moofaa yookaan raacitii jalʼinaatii fi hamminaatiin utuu hin taʼin Buddeena Hin bukaaʼin kan qulqullinaa fi dhugaa of keessaa qabuun ayyaanicha ayyaaneffannaa.
english: Therefore let’s keep the feast, not with old yeast, neither with the yeast of malice and wickedness, but with the unleavened bread of sincerity and truth.

kikuyu: Ani akka isin namoota halalummaadhaan jiraatan wajjin walitti dhufeenya hin qabaanneef xalayaa koo keessatti isinii barreesseen ture;
english: I wrote to you in my letter to have no company with sexual sinners;

kikuyu: kunis gonkumaa namoota halalummaadhaan addunyaa kana irra jiraatan yookaan doqnootaa fi saamtota yookaan warra Waaqa tolfamaa waaqeffatan jechuu koo miti. Utuu akkas taʼee immoo silaa addunyaa kana keessaa baʼuu qabdu ture.
english: yet not at all meaning with the sexual sinners of this world, or with the covetous and extortionists, or with idolaters, for then you would have to leave the world.

kikuyu: Ani garuu akka isin nama, “Ani obboleessa” ofiin jechaa halalummaan jiraatu yookaan doqna yookaan nama Waaqa tolfamaa waaqeffatu yookaan maqaa nama balleessu yookaan machooftuu yookaan saamtuu wajjin walitti dhufeenya hin qabaanneef amma isinii barreessa. Nama akkasii wajjin nyaata iyyuu hin nyaatinaa!
english: But as it is, I wrote to you not to associate with anyone who is called a brother who is a sexual sinner, or covetous, or an idolater, or a slanderer, or a drunkard, or an extortionist. Don’t even eat with such a person.

kikuyu: Warra ala jiranitti muruun hojii kootii? Isin warra keessa jiranitti muruu hin qabdanii?
english: For what do I have to do with also judging those who are outside? Don’t you judge those who are within?

kikuyu: Waaqni warra ala jiranitti ni mura; “Nama hamaa of keessaa baasaa!”
english: But those who are outside, God judges. “Put away the wicked man from among yourselves.”

kikuyu: Isin keessaa namni kam iyyuu yoo nama biraa irraa falmii qabaate, dhimma isaa qulqulloota duratti dhiʼeeffachuu irra akkamitti warra Waaqatti hin amanin duratti murtiif dhiʼeeffachuuf ija jabaata?
english: Dare any of you, having a matter against his neighbor, go to law before the unrighteous, and not before the saints?

kikuyu: Isin akka qulqulloonni addunyaatti muran hin beektanii? Erga kan addunyaatti murtan taatanii waan xixinnootti muruu hin dandeessanii?
english: Don’t you know that the saints will judge the world? And if the world is judged by you, are you unworthy to judge the smallest matters?

kikuyu: Isin akka nu ergamoota Waaqaatti murru hin beektanii? Yoos hammam caalaa waan jireenya addunyaa kanaatti haa murru ree?
english: Don’t you know that we will judge angels? How much more, things that pertain to this life?

kikuyu: Egaa yoo falmii dhimma akkasii qabaattan maaliif namoota waldaa Kiristaanaa keessatti tuffataman duratti dhiʼeeffattu ree?
english: If then you have to judge things pertaining to this life, do you set them to judge who are of no account in the assembly?

kikuyu: Anis isin qaanessuuf waan kana nan dubbadha. Namni beekaan falmii amantoota gidduu jiruuf murtii kennuu dandaʼu tokko iyyuu hin jiru jechuudhaa?
english: I say this to move you to shame. Isn’t there even one wise man among you who would be able to decide between his brothers?

kikuyu: Obboleessi tokko obboleessa kaan himachuuf jedhee mana murtii dhaqa; kunis fuula warra hin amannee duratti!
english: But brother goes to law with brother, and that before unbelievers!

kikuyu: Wal himachuun keessan amma iyyuu guutumaatti moʼatamuu keessan argisiisa. Qooda kanaa dabni isinitti hojjetamuu hin wayyuu? Gowwoomfamuu isinii hin wayyuu?
english: Therefore it is already altogether a defect in you that you have lawsuits one with another. Why not rather be wronged? Why not rather be defrauded?

kikuyu: Garuu isin mataan keessan iyyuu ni gowwoomsitu; dabas ni hojjettu; kanas obbolootuma keessanitti hojjettu.
english: No, but you yourselves do wrong and defraud, and that against your brothers.

kikuyu: Isin akka jalʼoonni mootummaa Waaqaa hin dhaalle hin beektanii? Hin gowwoominaa: halaleewwan yookaan warri Waaqa tolfamaa waaqeffatan yookaan ejjitoonni yookaan dhiironni sagaagaltoonni yookaan dhiironni dhiira wajjin sagaagalan,
english: Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral, nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor male prostitutes, nor homosexuals,

kikuyu: yookaan hattoonni yookaan doqnoonni yookaan machooftonni yookaan warri maqaa nama balleessan yookaan saamtonni mootummaa Waaqaa hin dhaalan.
english: nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor slanderers, nor extortionists, will inherit God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Gariin keessan akkas turtan. Taʼus isin maqaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosii fi Hafuura Waaqa keenyaatiin dhiqamtaniirtu; qulqullooftaniirtu; qajeeltotas taasifamtaniirtu.
english: Some of you were such, but you were washed. You were sanctified. You were justified in the name of the Lord Jesus, and in the Spirit of our God.

kikuyu: “Wanti hundinuu naaf eeyyamameera;” kan faayidaa qabu garuu hunda isaa miti; “Wanti hundinuu naaf eeyyamameera;” garuu wanti tokko iyyuu na hin moʼatu.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are expedient. “All things are lawful for me,” but I will not be brought under the power of anything.

kikuyu: “Nyaanni garaadhaaf; garaanis nyaataaf;” Waaqni garuu lachan isaanii iyyuu ni balleessa. Dhagni Gooftaa tajaajiluudhaaf malee halalummaaf miti; Gooftaanis dhagnaaf.
english: “Foods for the belly, and the belly for foods,” but God will bring to nothing both it and them. But the body is not for sexual immorality, but for the Lord, and the Lord for the body.

kikuyu: Waaqni humna isaatiin warra duʼan keessaa Gooftaa kaaseera; nus akkasuma ni kaasa.
english: Now God raised up the Lord, and will also raise us up by his power.

kikuyu: Isin akka dhagni keessan kutaa dhagna Kiristoos taʼe hin beektanii? Yoos ani kutaa dhagna Kiristoos fuudhee kutaa dhagna sagaagaltuu godhuu ree? Gonkumaa hin taʼu!
english: Don’t you know that your bodies are members of Christ? Shall I then take the members of Christ and make them members of a prostitute? May it never be!

kikuyu: Isin akka namni sagaagaltuu wajjin wal qunnamtii qabu tokko ishee wajjin dhagna tokko taʼu hin beektanii? “Lamaan isaanii iyyuu foon tokko ni taʼu” jedhameeraatii.
english: Or don’t you know that he who is joined to a prostitute is one body? For, “The two”, he says, “will become one flesh.”

kikuyu: Namni Gooftaa wajjin tokko taʼe garuu Gooftaa wajjin hafuuraan tokko.
english: But he who is joined to the Lord is one spirit.

kikuyu: Halalummaa irraa baqadhaa. Namni cubbuu biraa hunda dhagna isaatii alatti hojjeta; namni halalummaa hojjetu garuu dhagnuma ofii isaatti cubbuu hojjeta.
english: Flee sexual immorality! “Every sin that a man does is outside the body,” but he who commits sexual immorality sins against his own body.

kikuyu: Isin akka dhagni keessan mana qulqullummaa Hafuura Qulqulluu isin keessa jiraatu, kan Waaqa irraa argattan sanaa taʼe hin beektanii? Isin kan ofii keessanii miti;
english: Or don’t you know that your body is a temple of the Holy Spirit who is in you, whom you have from God? You are not your own,

kikuyu: isin gatiin bitamtan; kanaafuu dhagna keessaniin Waaqaaf ulfina kennaa.
english: for you were bought with a price. Therefore glorify God in your body and in your spirit, which are God’s.

kikuyu: Waaʼee waan isin naa barreessitan sanaa, namni tokko utuu fuudhuu baatee isaaf gaarii dha.
english: Now concerning the things about which you wrote to me: it is good for a man not to touch a woman.

kikuyu: Garuu waan halalummaan jiruuf dhiirri hundi niitii ofii isaa haa qabaatu; dubartiin hundis dhirsa ofii ishee haa qabaattu.
english: But, because of sexual immoralities, let each man have his own wife, and let each woman have her own husband.

kikuyu: Dhirsi waan niitii isaatiif malu haa guutuuf; niitiinis akkasuma dhirsa isheetiif haa guuttu.
english: Let the husband give his wife the affection owed her, and likewise also the wife her husband.

kikuyu: Niitiin dhagna ofii ishee irratti aangoo hin qabdu; kan aangoo qabu dhirsa. Akkasuma immoo dhirsi dhagna ofii isaa irratti aangoo hin qabu; kan aangoo qabdu niitii dha.
english: The wife doesn’t have authority over her own body, but the husband does. Likewise also the husband doesn’t have authority over his own body, but the wife does.

kikuyu: Yoo kadhannaatti jabaachuuf jettanii yeroof itti walii galtan malee wal hin didinaa. Ergasiis akka of qabuu dadhabuu keessaniin Seexanni isin hin qorreef deebiʼaa wajjin jiraadhaa.
english: Don’t deprive one another, unless it is by consent for a season, that you may give yourselves to fasting and prayer, and may be together again, that Satan doesn’t tempt you because of your lack of self-control.

kikuyu: Kanas ani eeyyamaan malee ajajaaf hin dubbadhu.
english: But this I say by way of concession, not of commandment.

kikuyu: Ani utuu namni hundumtuu akkuma koo taʼee nan hawwa ture. Garuu namni hundi kennaa ofii isaa kan Waaqni isaaf kenne qaba; inni tokko kennaa tokko, kaan immoo kennaa biraa qaba.
english: Yet I wish that all men were like me. However, each man has his own gift from God, one of this kind, and another of that kind.

kikuyu: Ani warra hin fuudhinii fi warra hin heeruminiin, haadhota hiyyeessaatiin illee akkanan jedha: Isaan yoo akkuma koo fuudhaa fi heeruma malee hafan isaaniif wayya.
english: But I say to the unmarried and to widows, it is good for them if they remain even as I am.

kikuyu: Yoo of qabuu dadhaban garuu haa fuudhan yookaan haa heeruman; hawwiin gubachuu irra fuudhuu yookaan heerumuu wayyaatii.
english: But if they don’t have self-control, let them marry. For it’s better to marry than to burn with passion.

kikuyu: Warra fuudhanii fi warra heerumaniifis ajajni ani kennu kana: Ajaja kanas Gooftaatu kenna malee ana miti; niitiin dhirsa isheetiin gargar hin baʼin.
english: But to the married I command—not I, but the Lord—that the wife not leave her husband

kikuyu: Yoo gargar baate garuu utuu hin heerumin haa jiraattu; yoo kanaa achii dhirsa isheetti haa araaramtu. Dhirsis niitii isaa hin hiikin.
english: (but if she departs, let her remain unmarried, or else be reconciled to her husband), and that the husband not leave his wife.

kikuyu: Warra hafaniinis ani akkanan jedha: Kana immoo anatu jedha malee Gooftaa miti; obboleessi kam iyyuu yoo niitii amantii hin qabne qabaate, yoo isheenis isa wajjin jiraachuuf fedhii qabaatte, inni ishee hin hiikin.
english: But to the rest I—not the Lord—say, if any brother has an unbelieving wife, and she is content to live with him, let him not leave her.

kikuyu: Dubartiin tokkos yoo dhirsa amantii hin qabne qabaatte, yoo innis ishee wajjin jiraachuuf fedhii qabaate, isheen isa hin hiikin.
english: The woman who has an unbelieving husband, and he is content to live with her, let her not leave her husband.

kikuyu: Dhirsi amantii hin qabne karaa niitii isaatiin qulqulleeffameeraatii; niitiin amantii hin qabnes karaa dhirsa isheetiin qulqulleeffamteertii. Yoo kanaa achii ijoolleen keessan xuraaʼoo taʼu; amma garuu qulqulloota.
english: For the unbelieving husband is sanctified in the wife, and the unbelieving wife is sanctified in the husband. Otherwise your children would be unclean, but now they are holy.

kikuyu: Namni amantii hin qabne garuu yoo gargar baʼuu fedhe gargar haa baʼu. Obboleessi tokko yookaan obboleettiin tokko haala akkasii keessatti hin hidhaman; Waaqni akka isin nagaan jiraattaniif isin waameeraatii.
english: Yet if the unbeliever departs, let there be separation. The brother or the sister is not under bondage in such cases, but God has called us in peace.

kikuyu: Yaa niitii, ati dhirsa kee ni fayyifta taʼaatii maal beekta? Yookaan yaa dhirsa, ati niitii kee ni fayyifta taʼaatii maal beekta?
english: For how do you know, wife, whether you will save your husband? Or how do you know, husband, whether you will save your wife?

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon namaa garuu akkuma jireenya Gooftaan kenneefiitti, akkuma Waaqni isa waamettis haa jiraatu. Waldoota Kiristaanaa hunda keessattis ajajni koo kanuma.
english: Only, as the Lord has distributed to each man, as God has called each, so let him walk. So I command in all the assemblies.

kikuyu: Namni tokko waamamuu isaatiin dura dhagna qabatee ture? Inni nama dhagna hin qabatin taʼuu hin qabu. Namni tokko waamamuu isaatiin dura dhagna hin qabannee? Inni dhagna hin qabatin.
english: Was anyone called having been circumcised? Let him not become uncircumcised. Has anyone been called in uncircumcision? Let him not be circumcised.

kikuyu: Ajaja Waaqaa eeguutu faayidaa qaba malee dhagna qabachuun yookaan qabachuu baachuun faayidaa hin qabu.
english: Circumcision is nothing, and uncircumcision is nothing, but what matters is keeping God’s commandments.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon namaa haaluma yeroo Waaqni isa waametti keessa ture keessa haa jiraatu.
english: Let each man stay in that calling in which he was called.

kikuyu: Ati yeroo waamamtetti garba turtee? Yoo akkas taʼe inni si hin yaaddessin; yoo bilisa baʼuu dandeesse garuu itti fayyadami.
english: Were you called being a bondservant? Don’t let that bother you, but if you get an opportunity to become free, use it.

kikuyu: Namni yeroo Gooftaadhaan waamametti garba ture inni gooftaadhaaf bilisa; akkasuma immoo namni yeroo waamametti bilisa ture inni garbicha Kiristoos.
english: For he who was called in the Lord being a bondservant is the Lord’s free man. Likewise he who was called being free is Christ’s bondservant.

kikuyu: Isin gatiidhaan bitamtan; garboota namootaa hin taʼinaa.
english: You were bought with a price. Don’t become bondservants of men.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, tokkoon tokkoon namaa haaluma yeroo itti waamametti keessa tureen fuula Waaqaa dura haa jiraatu.
english: Brothers, let each man, in whatever condition he was called, stay in that condition with God.

kikuyu: Ani waaʼee dubarran qulqulluu ajaja Gooftaan natti kenne hin qabu; garuu akka nama amanamaa taʼuuf araara Gooftaa argate tokkootti yaada koo nan kenna.
english: Now concerning virgins, I have no commandment from the Lord, but I give my judgment as one who has obtained mercy from the Lord to be trustworthy.

kikuyu: Sababii rakkina ammaatiif jettanii akkuma jirtanitti turuun isiniif gaarii natti fakkaata.
english: Therefore I think that because of the distress that is on us, it’s good for a man to remain as he is.

kikuyu: Ati niitiitti hidhamteertaa? Ishee hiikuu hin barbaadin. Ati niitii irraa hiikamteertaa? Niitii hin barbaadin.
english: Are you bound to a wife? Don’t seek to be freed. Are you free from a wife? Don’t seek a wife.

kikuyu: Ati garuu yoo fuute cubbuu hojjechuu kee miti; durbis yoo heerumte cubbuu hojjechuu ishee miti. Taʼus addunyaa kana irratti warra fuudhanii fi warra heeruman rakkinatu argata; ani immoo rakkina kana jalaa isin baasuun barbaada.
english: But if you marry, you have not sinned. If a virgin marries, she has not sinned. Yet such will have oppression in the flesh, and I want to spare you.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, wanti ani jedhu kana; yeroon murteeffame sun gabaabateera; siʼachi warri niitii qaban akka waan hin qabaatiniitti haa jiraatan;
english: But I say this, brothers: the time is short. From now on, both those who have wives may be as though they had none;

kikuyu: warri booʼan akka waan hin booʼiniitti, warri gammadan akka waan hin gammadiniitti, warri waa bitatan akka waan wanni bitatan sun kan isaanii hin taʼiniitti,
english: and those who weep, as though they didn’t weep; and those who rejoice, as though they didn’t rejoice; and those who buy, as though they didn’t possess;

kikuyu: warri waan addunyaa kanaatti fayyadamanis akka waan itti hin fayyadaminiitti haa hedan. Bifti addunyaa kanaa ni badaatii.
english: and those who use the world, as not using it to the fullest. For the mode of this world passes away.

kikuyu: Ani akka isin yaaddoo malee jiraattan nan hawwa. Namni hin fuudhin tokko Gooftaa gammachiisuuf dhimma Gooftaatti dhimma.
english: But I desire to have you to be free from cares. He who is unmarried is concerned for the things of the Lord, how he may please the Lord;

kikuyu: Namni fuudhe garuu niitii isaa gammachiisuuf dhimma addunyaatti dhimma;
english: but he who is married is concerned about the things of the world, how he may please his wife.

kikuyu: fedhiin isaas gargar qoodameera. Dubartiin hin heerumin yookaan durbi qulqulluun dhagnaa fi hafuuraan qulqulluu taʼuuf dhimma Gooftaatti dhimmiti. Dubartiin heerumte garuu dhirsa ishee gammachiisuuf dhimma addunyaatti dhimmiti.
english: There is also a difference between a wife and a virgin. The unmarried woman cares about the things of the Lord, that she may be holy both in body and in spirit. But she who is married cares about the things of the world—how she may please her husband.

kikuyu: Kana jechuun koos isin fayyaduuf malee kiyyootti isin galchuuf miti; qooda kanaa akka isin yaada gargar hin hiraminiin karaa qajeelaa irra Gooftaaf jiraattan nan hawwa.
english: This I say for your own benefit, not that I may ensnare you, but for that which is appropriate, and that you may attend to the Lord without distraction.

kikuyu: Namni kam iyyuu yoo durba kaadhimate sirriitti qabuu baate, yoo umuriin ishee dabalaa deemee innis akka ishee fuudhuu qabu yaade, akkuma fedhii isaa haa godhu. Inni cubbuu hojjechuu isaa miti. Isaan wal fuudhuu qabu.
english: But if any man thinks that he is behaving inappropriately toward his virgin, if she is past the flower of her age, and if need so requires, let him do what he desires. He doesn’t sin. Let them marry.

kikuyu: Garuu namni waan kana yaada ofii isaatiin murteesse, kan dirqama tokko illee jala hin jirree fedhii ofii isaa moʼachuu dandaʼu, kan akka durba sana hin fuune murteeffate, innis waan qajeelaa hojjete.
english: But he who stands steadfast in his heart, having no urgency, but has power over his own will, and has determined in his own heart to keep his own virgin, does well.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namni durba fuudhu waan qajeelaa hojjete; kan ishee fuudhuu dhiise immoo caalaa waan qajeelaa hojjete.
english: So then both he who gives his own virgin in marriage does well, and he who doesn’t give her in marriage does better.

kikuyu: Dubartiin tokko hamma dhirsi ishee jirutti isatti hidhamteerti. Yoo dhirsi ishee duʼe garuu isheen abbaa barbaaddetti heerumuuf bilisa; garuu inni nama Gooftaa taʼuu qaba.
english: A wife is bound by law for as long as her husband lives; but if the husband is dead, she is free to be married to whomever she desires, only in the Lord.

kikuyu: Akka yaada kootti garuu isheen yoo utuu hin heerumin hafte caalaa gammaddi; anis Hafuura Waaqaa of keessaa nan qaba jedheen yaada.
english: But she is happier if she stays as she is, in my judgment, and I think that I also have God’s Spirit.

kikuyu: Waaʼee nyaata waaqota tolfamoof aarsaa dhiʼeeffamee akka nu hundinuu beekumsa qabnu beekna. Beekumsi of nama tuulchisa; jaalalli garuu nama ijaara.
english: Now concerning things sacrificed to idols: We know that we all have knowledge. Knowledge puffs up, but love builds up.

kikuyu: Namni waan waa beeku of seʼu inni amma illee akka beekuun isa irra jirutti hin beeku.
english: But if anyone thinks that he knows anything, he doesn’t yet know as he ought to know.

kikuyu: Namni Waaqa jaallatu garuu Waaqaan beekameera.
english: But anyone who loves God is known by him.

kikuyu: Egaa waaʼee nyaata waaqota tolfamoof aarsaa dhiʼeeffame nyaachuu irratti, “Akka addunyaa kana irratti Waaqni tolfamaan homaa hin fayyadne, Waaqa tokkicha malees akka Waaqni biraa hin jirre” beekna.
english: Therefore concerning the eating of things sacrificed to idols, we know that no idol is anything in the world, and that there is no other God but one.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan akkuma waaqonni baayʼeenii fi gooftonni baayʼeen jiran sana wantoonni waaqota jedhaman samii irra yookaan lafa irra jiraatan iyyuu,
english: For though there are things that are called “gods”, whether in the heavens or on earth—as there are many “gods” and many “lords”—

kikuyu: garuu Waaqa tokkicha, Abbaa, kan wanni hundi isa biraa dhufe, kan nus isaaf jiraannu qabna; akkasumas Gooftaa tokkicha, Yesuus Kiristoos kan wanni hundi karaa isaatiin dhufee fi kan nuus karaa isaatiin jiraannutu jira.
english: yet to us there is one God, the Father, of whom are all things, and we for him; and one Lord, Jesus Christ, through whom are all things, and we live through him.

kikuyu: Garuu namni beekumsa kana qabu nama hunda miti. Namoonni tokko tokko waaqota tolfamoo waan baraniif yommuu nyaata akkanaa nyaatanitti akka waan Waaqa tolfamaaf dhiʼeeffameetti hedu; yaadni garaa isaaniis waan dadhabaa taʼeef ni xuraaʼa.
english: However, that knowledge isn’t in all men. But some, with consciousness of an idol until now, eat as of a thing sacrificed to an idol, and their conscience, being weak, is defiled.

kikuyu: Nyaanni garuu Waaqatti nu hin dhiʼeessu; yoo nyaachuu baanne wanni nutti hammaatu, yoo nyaannes wanni nutti tolu hin jiru.
english: But food will not commend us to God. For neither, if we don’t eat are we the worse, nor if we eat are we the better.

kikuyu: Taʼus akka mirgi keessan kun warra dadhabootti gufuu hin taaneef of eeggadhaa.
english: But be careful that by no means does this liberty of yours become a stumbling block to the weak.

kikuyu: Namni yaada dadhabaa qabu tokko yoo utuu ati iyyuu namni beekumsa qabdu mana qulqullummaa Waaqa tolfamaa keessatti nyaattuu si arge inni waan waaqota tolfamoof dhiʼeeffame sana nyaachuuf ija hin jabaatuu?
english: For if a man sees you who have knowledge sitting in an idol’s temple, won’t his conscience, if he is weak, be emboldened to eat things sacrificed to idols?

kikuyu: Akkasiin obboleessi dadhabaan Kiristoos isaaf jedhee duʼe kun beekumsa keetiin bada.
english: And through your knowledge, he who is weak perishes, the brother for whose sake Christ died.

kikuyu: Isinis yoo karaa kanaan obboloota keessanitti cubbuu hojjettan, yaada isaanii isa dadhabaas yoo madeessitan, isin Kiristoositti cubbuu hojjettu.
english: Thus, sinning against the brothers, and wounding their conscience when it is weak, you sin against Christ.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yoo wanni ani nyaadhu obboleessa koo gufachiise, ani akka obboleessi koo hin gufanneef gonkumaa deebiʼee foon hin nyaadhu.
english: Therefore, if food causes my brother to stumble, I will eat no meat forever more, that I don’t cause my brother to stumble.

kikuyu: Ani bilisa mitii? Ani ergamaa mitii? Ani Gooftaa keenya Yesuusin hin arginee? Isin buʼaa hojii ani Gooftaaf hojjedhee mitii?
english: Am I not free? Am I not an apostle? Haven’t I seen Jesus Christ, our Lord? Aren’t you my work in the Lord?

kikuyu: Ani yoon warra kaaniif ergamaa taʼuu baadhe iyyuu isiniif dhugumaan ergamaa dha! Isin Gooftaadhaan chaappaa ergamtummaa koo ti.
english: If to others I am not an apostle, yet at least I am to you; for you are the seal of my apostleship in the Lord.

kikuyu: Deebiin ani warra na qoraniif kennu kana.
english: My defense to those who examine me is this:

kikuyu: Nu nyaachuu fi dhuguuf mirga hin qabnuu?
english: Have we no right to eat and to drink?

kikuyu: Nu akkuma ergamoota kaanii, akkuma obboloota Gooftaatii fi akkuma Keefaa niitii amantu tokko of faana fudhannee deemuuf mirga hin qabnuu?
english: Have we no right to take along a wife who is a believer, even as the rest of the apostles, and the brothers of the Lord, and Cephas?

kikuyu: Yookaan anaa fi Barnaabaas qofatu hojii dhiisuuf mirga hin qabnee?
english: Or have only Barnabas and I no right to not work?

kikuyu: Namni baasii ofii isaatiin loltuu taʼee tajaajilu eenyu? Namni iddoo dhaabaa wayinii irra wayinii dhaabee ija isaa hin nyaanne eenyu? Namni bushaayee tiksaa aannan hin dhugne eenyu?
english: What soldier ever serves at his own expense? Who plants a vineyard, and doesn’t eat of its fruit? Or who feeds a flock, and doesn’t drink from the flock’s milk?

kikuyu: Kanas ani akka taayitaa namaa qofaanan dubbadhaa? Seerris kanuma dubbata mitii?
english: Do I speak these things according to the ways of men? Or doesn’t the law also say the same thing?

kikuyu: Seera Musee keessatti, “Qotiyyoo midhaan siribsiisuutti jiru afaan hin hidhin” jedhamee barreeffameeraatii. Egaa Waaqni qotiyyoodhaaf yaaduu isaatii ree?
english: For it is written in the law of Moses, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain.” Is it for the oxen that God cares,

kikuyu: Inni guutummaatti sababii keenyaaf dubbachuu isaa mitii? Eeyyee, kun sababii keenyaaf barreeffame; sababiin isaa inni qotu qotuun isaa, inni midhaan siribsiisus siribsiisuun isaa akka midhaan sana keessaa qooddatu abdachaa hojjechuu qaba.
english: or does he say it assuredly for our sake? Yes, it was written for our sake, because he who plows ought to plow in hope, and he who threshes in hope should partake of his hope.
