kikuyu: Nu waan hafuuraa isin keessatti facaafnee yoo waan foonii isin irraa haammanne kun ni guddataa?
english: If we sowed to you spiritual things, is it a great thing if we reap your fleshly things?

kikuyu: Erga warri kaan mirga gargaarsaa kana isin irraa qabaattanii, nu immoo kan caalu hin qabaannuu ree? Nu garuu mirga kanatti hin fayyadamne. Nu wangeela Kiristoositti gufuu taʼuu mannaa waanuma hunda obsuu qabna.
english: If others partake of this right over you, don’t we yet more? Nevertheless we didn’t use this right, but we bear all things, that we may cause no hindrance to the Good News of Christ.

kikuyu: Isin akka warri mana qulqullummaa keessa wantoota qulqulluu irra tajaajilan nyaata isaanii mana qulqullummaa irraa argatan, akka warri iddoo aarsaa tajaajilan immoo waan iddoo aarsaa irratti dhiʼeeffamu irraa qooddatan hin beektanii?
english: Don’t you know that those who serve around sacred things eat from the things of the temple, and those who wait on the altar have their portion with the altar?

kikuyu: Akkasuma immoo akka warri wangeela lallaban waan ittiin jiraatan wangeela irraa argatan Gooftaan ajajeera.
english: Even so the Lord ordained that those who proclaim the Good News should live from the Good News.

kikuyu: Ani garuu mirga kana keessaa tokkotti illee hin fayyadamne. Kanas isiniif barreessuun koo waan akkasii naa gootu jedhee abdadhee miti. Namni tokko waan ani ittiin of jaju kana na jalaa busheessuu mannaa ani duʼuu naa wayya!
english: But I have used none of these things, and I don’t write these things that it may be done so in my case; for I would rather die, than that anyone should make my boasting void.

kikuyu: Ani yoon wangeela lallabe of jajuu hin dandaʼu; lallabuun dirqama kootii. Yoon wangeela lallabuu baadhe anaaf wayyoo!
english: For if I preach the Good News, I have nothing to boast about, for necessity is laid on me; but woe is to me if I don’t preach the Good News.

kikuyu: Ani yoon fedhii kootiin lallabe badhaasa qaba; yoon fedhii kootiin hin taʼin garuu ani imaanaadhuma natti kenname sana raawwachuu koo ti.
english: For if I do this of my own will, I have a reward. But if not of my own will, I have a stewardship entrusted to me.

kikuyu: Yoos badhaasni koo maali ree? Badhaasni koo, lallaba koo keessatti ani mirga wangeelaan qabutti guutuumaan guutuutti utuu hin fayyadamin kaffaltii malee wangeela lallabuu koo ti.
english: What then is my reward? That when I preach the Good News, I may present the Good News of Christ without charge, so as not to abuse my authority in the Good News.

kikuyu: Ani nama hunda irraa bilisa taʼu iyyuu nama gara caaluuf buʼaa buusuuf jedhee nama hundaaf of garboomse.
english: For though I was free from all, I brought myself under bondage to all, that I might gain the more.

kikuyu: Ani Yihuudootaaf buʼaa buusuuf jedhee Yihuudootaaf akka Yihuudii nan taʼe. Yoon ofii kootii seera jala jiraachuu baadhe iyyuu, warra seera jala jiraniif buʼaa buusuuf jedhee akka nama seera jala jiruu nan taʼe.
english: To the Jews I became as a Jew, that I might gain Jews; to those who are under the law, as under the law, that I might gain those who are under the law;

kikuyu: Ani utuun seera Waaqaatiin ala hin taʼin, garuu utuman seera Kiristoos jala jiruu, warra seera hin qabneef buʼaa buusuuf jedhee warra seera hin qabneef akka nama seera hin qabneen taʼe.
english: to those who are without law, as without law (not being without law toward God, but under law toward Christ), that I might win those who are without law.

kikuyu: Ani warra dadhaboof buʼaa buusuuf jedhee warra dadhaboo biratti dadhabaan taʼe. Ani karaa dandaʼamu hundaan namoota tokko tokko fayyisuuf jedhee nama hunda biratti waanuma hunda nan taʼe.
english: To the weak I became as weak, that I might gain the weak. I have become all things to all men, that I may by all means save some.

kikuyu: Akkan wangeela keessatti hirmaadhuufis sababii wangeelaatiif jedhee waan kana hunda nan hojjedha.
english: Now I do this for the sake of the Good News, that I may be a joint partaker of it.

kikuyu: Dorgommii fiigichaa keessatti akka warri fiigan hundinuu dorgoman, garuu akka namni tokko qofti badhaasa argatu hin beektanii? Isinis akkasuma akka badhaasa argattaniif fiigaa!
english: Don’t you know that those who run in a race all run, but one receives the prize? Run like that, so that you may win.

kikuyu: Namni dorgommii keessatti dorgomu hundinuu leenjii cimaa keessa darba. Isaan gonfoo badu argachuuf waan kana godhu; nu garuu gonfoo hin badne argachuuf waan kana goona.
english: Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown, but we an incorruptible.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani akka nama kaayyoo malee fiiguutti hin fiigu; akka nama qilleensa rukutuutti hin lolu.
english: I therefore run like that, not aimlessly. I fight like that, not beating the air,

kikuyu: Ani garuu warra kaaniif lallabee akka ofii kootii immoo nama gatame hin taaneef dhagna koo adabee akka inni naa ajajamu nan godha.
english: but I beat my body and bring it into submission, lest by any means, after I have preached to others, I myself should be disqualified.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, akka abbootiin keenya hundi duumessa jala turan, akka hundi isaaniis galaana keessa darban akka isin utuu hin beekin haftan ani hin barbaadu.
english: Now I would not have you ignorant, brothers, that our fathers were all under the cloud, and all passed through the sea;

kikuyu: Hundi isaaniis kan Musee taʼuuf duumessaa fi galaanaan cuuphaman.
english: and were all baptized into Moses in the cloud and in the sea;

kikuyu: Hundi isaaniis nyaata hafuuraa tokkicha nyaatan.
english: and all ate the same spiritual food;

kikuyu: Hundi isaaniis dhugaatii hafuuraa tokkicha dhugan. Isaan kattaa hafuuraa isa isaan wajjin deemaa ture irraa dhuganiiruutii; kattaan sunis Kiristoos ture.
english: and all drank the same spiritual drink. For they drank of a spiritual rock that followed them, and the rock was Christ.

kikuyu: Taʼu iyyuu waan Waaqni hedduu isaaniitti hin gammadiniif isaan lafa gammoojjii keessatti dhuman.
english: However with most of them, God was not well pleased, for they were overthrown in the wilderness.

kikuyu: Wantoonni kunneen akka nu akkuma isaanii waan hamaa hin hawwineef fakkeenya nuu taʼan.
english: Now these things were our examples, to the intent we should not lust after evil things as they also lusted.

kikuyu: Akka isaan keessaa namoonni tokko tokko godhan sana isin waaqota tolfamoo hin waaqeffatinaa; kunis akkuma, “Namoonni nyaachuu fi dhuguuf tataaʼan; sirbuufis kaʼan” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: Don’t be idolaters, as some of them were. As it is written, “The people sat down to eat and drink, and rose up to play.”

kikuyu: Akka isaan keessaa namoonni tokko tokko halalummaa raawwatanii guyyaa tokkotti namoonni 23,000 dhuman sana, nu halalummaa raawwachuu hin qabnu.
english: Let’s not commit sexual immorality, as some of them committed, and in one day twenty-three thousand fell.

kikuyu: Akka isaan keessaa tokko tokko Gooftaa qoranii bofaan ajjeefaman sana nu Gooftaa qoruu hin qabnu.
english: Let’s not test Christ, as some of them tested, and perished by the serpents.

kikuyu: Isin akka isaan keessaa tokko tokko guungumanii isa nama balleessuun balleeffaman sana hin guunguminaa.
english: Don’t grumble, as some of them also grumbled, and perished by the destroyer.

kikuyu: Kun hundi akka fakkeenya taʼuuf isaan irratti raawwatame; nuu warra dhumni baraa itti dhufeef immoo akka of eeggannaa taʼuuf barreeffame.
english: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namni waan dhaabate of seʼu akka hin kufneef of haa eeggatu.
english: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.

kikuyu: Qorama nama irra gaʼu malee qoramni tokko iyyuu isinitti hin dhufne. Waaqnis amanamaa dha; inni akka isin waan baachuu hin dandeenyeen qoramtan isin hin godhu. Yommuu qoramtanitti garuu inni akka isin obsuu dandeessaniif karaa ittiin keessaa baatan isiniif qopheessa.
english: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa michoota ko, isin waaqota tolfamoo waaqeffachuu irraa baqadhaa.
english: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

kikuyu: Ani namoota hubannaa qabanittin dubbadha; waan ani dubbadhu isinuu murteessaa.
english: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.

kikuyu: Xoofoon eebbaa kan nu eebbifnu sun dhiiga Kiristoos wajjin tokkummaa qaba mitii? Buddeenni nu caccabsinu sunis foon Kiristoos wajjin tokkummaa qaba mitii?
english: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?

kikuyu: Waan buddeenni tokko qofti jiruuf, nu baayʼee taanu iyyuu dhagnuma tokko; hundi keenya buddeenuma tokkicha sana irraa hirmaannaatii.
english: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.

kikuyu: Mee saba Israaʼel ilaalaa: Warri aarsaa irraa nyaatan sun iddoo aarsaa irraa qooda qabu mitii?
english: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?

kikuyu: Egaa maal jechuu koo ti? Nyaanni waaqota tolfamoof aarsaa dhiʼeeffamu wayi moo ree yookaan Waaqni tolfamaan wayi moo ree jechuu kootii?
english: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?

kikuyu: Akkas miti; aarsaan namoonni ormaa dhiʼeessan hafuurota hamoodhaaf malee Waaqaaf miti; ani akka isin hafuurota hamoo wajjin tokkummaa qabaattan hin barbaadu.
english: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.

kikuyu: Isin xoofoo Gooftaatii fi xoofoo hafuurota hamoo dhuguu hin dandeessan; maaddii Gooftaatii fi maaddii hafuurota hamoo irrattis hirmaachuu hin dandeessan.
english: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord and of the table of demons.

kikuyu: Nu Gooftaa hinaaffaaf kakaafnaa? Nu isa caalaas jabaannaa?
english: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?

kikuyu: “Wanni hundinuu anaaf eeyyamamaa dha;” kan faayidaa qabu garuu waan hunda miti. “Wanni hundinuu anaaf eeyyamamaa dha;” kan nama fayyadu garuu waan hunda miti.
english: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.

kikuyu: Namni tokko iyyuu waan warra kaaniif gaarii taʼe barbaaduu qaba malee waan ofii isaatiif gaarii taʼe barbaaduu hin qabu.
english: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.

kikuyu: Utuu gaaffii qalbii keessaa tokko illee hin kaasin waan gabaa fooniitti gurguramu kam iyyuu nyaadhaa;
english: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,

kikuyu: “Laftii fi wanni lafa irra jiru hundinuu kan Gooftaatii.”
english: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”

kikuyu: Warra hin amanin keessaa yoo namni tokko nyaataaf isin affeere, isinis yoo dhaquu barbaaddan dhaqaa; utuu gaaffii qalbii keessaa tokko illee hin kaasin waan isin duratti dhiʼeeffame kam iyyuu nyaadhaa.
english: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo namni tokko, “Kun waaqota tolfamoodhaaf dhiʼeeffame” isiniin jedhe, sababii namicha isinitti hime sanaatii fi sababii qalbiitiif waan sana hin nyaatinaa.
english: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, with all its fullness.”

kikuyu: Kanas qalbii namicha sanaati malee kan keeti jechuu koo miti. Maaliif qalbii nama biraatiin bilisummaa kootti murama ree?
english: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?

kikuyu: Ani ergan galateeffachuudhaan nyaata sana irratti hirmaadhee maaliifan waan ittiin Waaqa galateeffadhuun balaaleffatama ree?
english: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yoo nyaattan yookaan yoo dhugdan yookaan yoo waanuma fedhe illee hojjettan waan hunda ulfina Waaqaatiif hojjedhaa.
english: Whether therefore you eat or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.

kikuyu: Yihuudoota yookaan Giriikota yookaan waldaa kiristaanaa kan Waaqaa hin gufachiisinaa;
english: Give no occasion for stumbling, whether to Jews, to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;

kikuyu: kunis akkuma ani nama hunda karaa hundaan gammachiisuuf yaalii godhutti jechuu dha. Ani akka isaan fayyaniif buʼaa namoota baayʼeetiif malee buʼaa kootiif jedhee waan kana hin godhu.
english: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.

kikuyu: Akkuma ani Kiristoosin fakkaadhu, isinis na fakkaadhaa.
english: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.

kikuyu: Ani sababii isin waan hundaan na yaadattanii fi waan duudhaa ani dabarsee isinitti kennes jabeessitanii qabattaniif isinin galateeffadha.
english: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.

kikuyu: Ani akka mataan dhiira hundumaa Kiristoos taʼe, akka mataan dubartii dhiira taʼe, akka mataan Kiristoos immoo Waaqa taʼe akka beektan nan barbaada.
english: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

kikuyu: Dhiirri mataa isaa haguuggatee kadhatu yookaan raajii dubbatu hundinuu mataa ofii isaa salphisa.
english: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.

kikuyu: Dubartiin utuu mataa ishee hin haguuggatin kadhattu yookaan raajii dubbattu kam iyyuu mataa ofii ishee salphifti; kun akka waan mataan ishee haaddameetti hedamaatii.
english: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.

kikuyu: Dubartiin tokko yoo mataa ishee haguuggachuu baatte rifeensa mataa ishee murachuu qabdi; dubartiin rifeensa mataa ishee murachuun yookaan haaddachuun yoo qaanii itti taʼe immoo mataa ishee haguuggachuu qabdi.
english: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.

kikuyu: Dhiirri fakkaattii fi ulfina Waaqaa waan taʼeef mataa isaa haguuggachuu hin qabu; dubartiin garuu ulfina dhiiraa ti.
english: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.

kikuyu: Dubartiitu dhiira irraa argame malee dhiirri dubartii irraa hin argamneetii;
english: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;

kikuyu: dubartiitu dhiiraaf uumame malee dhiirri dubartiif hin uumamne.
english: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu dubartiin sababii ergamoota Waaqaatiif mallattoo taayitaa mataa ishee irraa qabaachuu qabdi.
english: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.

kikuyu: Taʼus Gooftaa biratti dubartiin dhiira malee yookaan dhiirri dubartii malee hin taʼu.
english: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.

kikuyu: Akkuma dubartiin dhiira irraa argamte akkasuma immoo dhiirri dubartii irraa dhalataatii; wanni hundi garuu Waaqa biraa argama.
english: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.

kikuyu: Mee isinuu murteessaa; dubartiin utuu mataa ishee hin haguuggatin Waaqa kadhachuun sirriidhaa?
english: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?

kikuyu: Akka dhiirri rifeensa mataa dheereffachuun isaaf salphina taʼe uumamni iyyuu isin hin barsiisuu?
english: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?

kikuyu: Dubartiin garuu yoo rifeensa dheeraa qabaatte, inni isheef ulfina mitii? Rifeensi dheeraan akka haguuggiitti isheef kennameeraatii.
english: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo abbaan fedhe iyyuu waaʼee kanaa mormuu barbaade, nu yookaan waldaaleen kiristaanaa Waaqaa duudhaa akkasii hin qabnu.
english: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.

kikuyu: Walitti qabamuun keessan waan waa balleessu malee waa tolchu hin taʼiniif ani ajaja kana keessatti isin hin jaju.
english: But in giving you this command I don’t praise you, because you come together not for the better but for the worse.

kikuyu: Waan hunda dura, yommuu isin akka waldaatti walitti qabamtanitti akka gargar baʼuun gidduu keessan jiru nan dhagaʼa; kanas karaa tokkoon ani nan amana.
english: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.

kikuyu: Warra isin keessaa Waaqa biratti fudhatama qaban ifatti baasuuf, garaa garummaan isin gidduu jiraachuu qaba.
english: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.

kikuyu: Yommuu walitti qabamtanitti wanti isin nyaattan Irbaata Gooftaa miti;
english: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.

kikuyu: yeroo nyaataatti namni hundinuu irbaata ofii isaa nyaata. Inni tokko ni beelaʼa; kaan immoo ni machaaʼa.
english: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.

kikuyu: Isin mana itti nyaattanii fi itti dhugdan hin qabdan moo? Yookaan waldaa Kiristaanaa Waaqaa tuffattanii warra homaa hin qabne qaanessitu? Ani maalan isiniin jedha? Isin jajuu ree? Ani kanaan isin hin jaju!
english: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.

kikuyu: Ani waanan dabarsee isinitti kenne kana Gooftaa irraa fudhadheeraatii; Gooftaa Yesuus halkan dabarfamee kenname sana buddeena fuudhee,
english: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.

kikuyu: galata galche; buddeena sanas caccabsee, “Kun foon koo kan isiniif taʼuu dha; kanas yaadannoo kootiif godhadhaa” jedhe.
english: When he had given thanks, he broke it and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Akkasumas irbaata booddee xoofoo fuudhee, “Xoofoon kun kakuu haaraa dhiiga kootiin taʼuu dha; yeroo isa dhugdan hunda na yaadachuuf godhadhaa” jedhe.
english: In the same way he also took the cup after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”

kikuyu: Isinis hamma Gooftaan dhufutti yeroo buddeena kana nyaattanii xoofoo kana dhugdan hunda duʼa isaa ni labsitu.
english: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namni haala hin malleen buddeena sana nyaatu yookaan xoofoo Gooftaa dhugu kam iyyuu foonii fi dhiiga Gooftaatti ni gaafatama.
english: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.

kikuyu: Namni tokko utuu buddeena sana irraa hin nyaatin, utuu xoofoo sana irraas hin dhugin dura of qoruu qaba.
english: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread and drink of the cup.

kikuyu: Namni utuu foon Gooftaa addaan baasee hin hubatin nyaatee dhugu, inni ofii isaatti murtii nyaatee dhugaatii.
english: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.

kikuyu: Kanaafis isin keessaa hedduun dadhabaniiru; dhukkubsataniirus; hedduunis boqotaniiru.
english: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.

kikuyu: Utuu of qorree garuu nutti hin muramu ture.
english: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.

kikuyu: Gooftaan yommuu nutti muru garuu akka addunyaa wajjin nutti hin muramneef nu adaba.
english: But when we are judged, we are disciplined by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa obboloota ko, isin yommuu nyaachuuf walitti qabamtan wal eegaa.
english: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

kikuyu: Akka walitti qabamuun keessan murtii isinitti hin fidneef eenyu iyyuu yoo beelaʼe mana isaatti haa nyaatu! Waan hafe irratti immoo ani yommuun dhufutti qajeelcha nan kenna.
english: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota ko, egaa ani akka isin waaʼee kennaawwan hafuuraa wallaaltan hin barbaadu.
english: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.

kikuyu: Isin yeroo ormoota turtanitti akka gowwoomfamtanii gara waaqota tolfamoo dubbachuu hin dandeenyeetti geeffamtanii turtan ni beektu.
english: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namni Hafuura Waaqaatiin dubbatu kam iyyuu akka, “Yesuus abaaramaa dha” hin jenne, akka eenyu iyyuu yoo Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan taʼe malee, “Yesuus Gooftaa dha” jechuu hin dandeenye ani isinittin hima.
english: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Kennaawwan gosa garaa garaatu jira; Hafuurri garuu tokkuma.
english: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.

kikuyu: Tajaajila gosa garaa garaatu jira; Gooftaan garuu tokkuma.
english: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.

kikuyu: Hojii gosa garaa garaatu jira; waan hundumaa garuu Waaqa tokkichatu nama hundumaan hojjeta.
english: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God who works all things in all.

kikuyu: Mulʼanni Hafuura Qulqulluu garuu faayidaa waliitiif tokkoo tokkoo namaatiif kennama.
english: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.

kikuyu: Isa tokkoof karaa Hafuuraatiin dubbii ogummaatu kennama; isa kaaniif immoo Hafuuruma sanaan dubbii beekumsaatu kennama;
english: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge according to the same Spirit,

kikuyu: isa kaaniif Hafuuruma sanaan amantiitu kennama; isa kaaniif immoo Hafuuruma tokkicha sanaan kennaawwan warra dhukkubsatan fayyisuutu kennama;
english: to another faith by the same Spirit, and to another gifts of healings by the same Spirit,

kikuyu: isa tokkoof dinqiiwwan hojjechuu, isa kaaniif raajii dubbachuu, isa kaaniif hafuurota addaan baasee beekuu, isa kaaniifis afaan haaraa gosa adda addaa dubbachuu, isa kaaniif immoo afaan haaraa sana hiikuutu kennama.
english: and to another workings of miracles, and to another prophecy, and to another discerning of spirits, to another different kinds of languages, and to another the interpretation of languages.

kikuyu: Waan kana hundas Hafuuruma tokkicha sanatu akkuma fedhii ofii isaatti tokkoo tokkoo namaatiif dhuunfaatti hiruudhaan hojjeta.
english: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.

kikuyu: Dhagni kutaa baayʼee qabaatu illee dhagnuma tokko; kutaawwan dhagnaa yoo baayʼatani illee hundi isaanii dhagnuma tokko taʼu. Kiristoosis akkasuma.
english: For as the body is one and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.

kikuyu: Nu Yihuudoota yookaan Giriikota, garboota yookaan warra bilisooman taanus hundi keenya Hafuura tokkoon dhagna tokkotti cuuphamneerraatii; hundi keenyas, akka dhugnuuf Hafuurri tokkichi sun nuu kennameera.
english: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.

kikuyu: Dhagni kutaa tokko qofa utuu hin taʼin kutaawwan baayʼeedhaatii.
english: For the body is not one member, but many.

kikuyu: Miilli yoo, “Ani waanan harka hin taʼiniif, ani kutaa dhagnaa mitii” jedhe, sababii kanaaf kutaa dhagnaa taʼuun isaa hin hafu.
english: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.

kikuyu: Gurris yoo, “Ani waanan ija hin taʼiniif, ani kutaa dhagnaa miti” jedhe, sababii kanaaf kutaa dhagnaa taʼuun isaa hin hafu.
english: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.

kikuyu: Utuu dhagni guutumaatti ija taʼee jiraatee silaa dhagaʼuun eessa jira? Utuu dhagni guutumaatti gurra taʼee jiraatee silaa fuunfachuun eessa jira?
english: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?

kikuyu: Amma garuu Waaqni akkuma ofii barbaadetti kutaawwan sana adduma addaan dhagna keessa kaaʼeera.
english: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.

kikuyu: Utuu hundi isaanii kutaa dhagnaa tokkicha taʼanii silaa dhagni eessa jira?
english: If they were all one member, where would the body be?

kikuyu: Egaa kutaawwan dhagnaa baayʼee dha; dhagni garuu tokkuma.
english: But now they are many members, but one body.

kikuyu: Iji harkaan, “Ati na hin barbaachiftu!” jechuu hin dandaʼu; yookaan mataan miillaan, “Ati na hin barbaachiftu!” jechuu hin dandaʼu.
english: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”

kikuyu: Dhugumaanuu kutaawwan dhagnaa kanneen dadhaboo fakkaatan akka malee barbaachisoo dha;
english: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.

kikuyu: kutaawwan dhagnaa kanneen tuffatamoo nutti fakkaataniifis ulfina addaa ni kennina. Kutaawwan dhagnaa kanneen nu itti qaanofnuuf immoo ulfinni addaa ni kennama;
english: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant modesty,

kikuyu: kutaawwan dhagna keenyaa kanneen nu itti hin qaanofne waan kana hin barbaadan. Waaqni garuu kutaawwan dhagnaa walitti fayyisee kutaawwan nu itti qaanofnuuf ulfina caalu kenne;
english: while our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,

kikuyu: kunis akka kutaawwan haaluma tokkoon walii yaadanii fi akka dhagna keessa gargar baʼuun hin jiraanneef.
english: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.

kikuyu: Yoo kutaan dhagnaa tokko rakkate kutaawwan hundinuu isa wajjin rakkatu; yoo kutaan tokko ulfina argate kutaawwan hundi isa wajjin gammadu.
english: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. When one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.

kikuyu: Isin amma dhagna Kiristoos; tokkoon tokkoon keessanis kutaa dhagna sanaa ti.
english: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.

kikuyu: Waaqni waldaa Kiristaanaa keessatti tokkoffaa ergamoota, lammaffaa raajota, sadaffaa barsiistota, ergasiis warra hojii dinqii hojjetan, itti aansees warra kennaa dhukkubsattoota fayyisuu qaban, warra namoota gargaaruu dandaʼan, warra kennaa bulchiinsaa qabanii fi warra afaan haaraa gosa addaa addaa dubbatan filateera.
english: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.

kikuyu: Hundumatu ergamootaa? Hundumatu raajotaa? Hundumatu barsiistotaa? Hundinuu hojii dinqii hojjetuu?
english: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?

kikuyu: Hundumatu kennaa dhukkubsattoota fayyisuu qabaa? Hundumatu afaan haaraa dubbataa? Hundumatu afaan sana hiikaa?
english: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?

kikuyu: Isin garuu jabeessaatii kennaa caalu barbaadaa. Amma illee ani karaa karaa hundumaa caalu isinitti nan argisiisa.
english: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.

kikuyu: Ani yoon afaan namootaatii fi afaan ergamoota Waaqaa dubbadhe, garuu jaalala qabaachuu baannaan akkuma sibiila iyyuu yookaan akka kilillee qillisu tokkoo ti.
english: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass or a clanging cymbal.

kikuyu: Ani yoon kennaa raajii dubbachuu qabaadhe, icciitii hundaa fi beekumsa hunda hubachuu yoon dandaʼe, amantii gaara buqqisuu dandaʼus yoon qabaadhe, garuu jaalala qabaachuu baannaan ani homaa miti.
english: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.

kikuyu: Ani yoon waanan qabu hunda hiyyeeyyiif kenne, dhagna koos akka gubamuuf yoon kenne, garuu jaalala qabaachuu baannaan homaa na hin fayyadu.
english: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.

kikuyu: Jaalalli obsa qaba; jaalalli arjaa dha. Inni hin hinaafu; hin kooru; ofis hin tuulu.
english: Love is patient and is kind. Love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,

kikuyu: Jaalalli waan hin malle hin hojjetu; ofittoo miti; dafee hin aaru; hammina namatti hin lakkaaʼu.
english: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;

kikuyu: Jaalalli dhugaatti gammada malee waan hamaatti hin gammadu.
english: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;

kikuyu: Jaalalli waan hunda ni obsa; waan hunda ni amana; waan hunda abdata; waan hunda keessattis jabaatee dhaabata.
english: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, and endures all things.

kikuyu: Jaalalli gonkumaa hin badu. Raajii taanaan ni darba; afaan haaraa taanaan ni hafa; beekumsas taanaan ni bada.
english: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.

kikuyu: Nu beekumsa irraa gara tokko beeknaatii; raajiis gara tokko dubbanna;
english: For we know in part and we prophesy in part;

kikuyu: yommuu inni guutuun dhufutti garuu inni gartokkeen ni bada.
english: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.

kikuyu: Ani yeroon ijoollee turetti, akka ijoolleettin dubbadha ture; akka ijoolleettin yaada ture; akka ijoolleetti nan herrega ture; ani ergan nama guddaa taʼee garuu ijoollummaa dhiiseera.
english: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.

kikuyu: Amma of-ilaalee keessaan bifa dimimmisaaʼaa arginaatii; yeroo sana garuu ifaan ifatti ni argina. Ani amma gartokkon beeka; yeroo sana garuu ani akkuma guutummaatti beekame sana guutummaatti beekuufin jira.
english: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.

kikuyu: Egaa amantiin, abdii fi jaalalli sadan isaanii iyyuu ni jiraatu. Isaan keessaa garuu jaalalatu caala.
english: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.

kikuyu: Karaa jaalalaa duukaa buʼaa; kennaawwan Hafuuraa, keessumattuu kennaa raajii cimsaatii barbaadaa.
english: Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

kikuyu: Namni afaan haaraan dubbatu kam iyyuu Waaqatti malee namootatti hin dubbatuutii. Dhugumaan namni tokko iyyuu isa hin hubatu; inni Hafuuraan icciitii dubbata.
english: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God, for no one understands, but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.

kikuyu: Namni raajii dubbatu garuu isaan ijaaruuf, gorsuu fi jajjabeessuuf jedhee namootatti dubbata.
english: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.

kikuyu: Namni afaan haaraan dubbatu ofuma isaa cimsa; kan raajii dubbatu garuu waldaa kiristaanaa cimsa.
english: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.

kikuyu: Ani akka hundi keessan afaan haaraan dubbattan nan barbaada; caalaatti garuu akka raajii dubbatan nan jaalladha. Namni afaan haaraan dubbatu tokko akka waldaan kiristaanaa ittiin jajjabaattuuf jedhee waan dubbatu sana yoo hiikuu baate isa afaan haaraan dubbatu irra isa raajii dubbatutu caala.
english: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but even more that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.

kikuyu: Egaa yaa obboloota, ani yoon mulʼata yookaan beekumsa yookaan raajii yookaan barsiisa tokko tokko isinitti hime malee yoon afaan haaraa qofa dubbachaa gara keessan dhufe maal isin fayyada?
english: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?

kikuyu: Kunis meeshaa lubbuu hin qabne kan akka ululleetii fi kiraaraa kanneen sagalee kennan biratti illee akkanuma; ululleen afuufamee yookaan kiraarri rukutamee yoo sagaleen isaa gargar baafame malee namni tokko akkamitti addaan baasee beekuu dandaʼa?
english: Even lifeless things that make a sound, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?

kikuyu: Yoo sagaleen malakataa addaan baafamee beekame malees eenyutu lolaaf qophaaʼa?
english: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?

kikuyu: Isinis akkasuma. Yoo afaan keessaniin dubbii hubatamaa dubbattan malee namni tokko akkamitti waan isin jettan sana beekuu dandaʼa? Qilleensatti dubbachuu keessaniitii.
english: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.

kikuyu: Akka afaan gosa garaa garaa addunyaa irra jiran hin shakkamu. Garuu isaan keessaa kan hiikkaa hin qabne tokko iyyuu hin jiru.
english: There are, it may be, so many kinds of languages in the world, and none of them is without meaning.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani yoon hiikkaa waan namni tokko dubbatuu hubachuu baadhe ani namicha dubbatu sanatti alagaa dha. Namichi dubbatu sunis anatti alagaa dha.
english: If then I don’t know the meaning of the language, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.

kikuyu: Isinis akkasuma. Isin waan jabeessitanii kennaawwan Hafuuraa qabaachuu barbaaddaniif, kennaawwan waldaa kiristaanaa cimsan jabeessaatii barbaadaa.
english: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.

kikuyu: Kanaaf namni afaan haaraan dubbatu tokko akka waan dubbatu sana hiikuu dandaʼuuf kadhachuu qaba.
english: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.

kikuyu: Yoo ani afaan haaraan kadhadhe hafuurri koo ni kadhataatii; qalbiin koo garuu hin hirmaatu.
english: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.

kikuyu: Yoos ani maalan godha ree? Hafuura kootiin nan kadhadha; qalbii kootiinis nan kadhadha; hafuura kootiin nan faarfadha; qalbii kootiinis nan faarfadha.
english: What should I do? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.

kikuyu: Yoo kanaa achii utuu ati hafuura keetiin Waaqa galateeffachuutti jirtuu, namni iddoo warra hin baratinii taaʼe tokko waan ati dubbattu waan hin beekiniif akkamitti galata ati dhiʼeessitu sanaaf “Ameen” jechuu dandaʼaa?
english: Otherwise, if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?

kikuyu: Ati dhugumaan sirriitti galateeffata taʼa; namni kaan garuu ittiin hin jajjabeeffamu.
english: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.

kikuyu: Ani waanan hunduma keessan caalaa afaan haaraan dubbadhuuf Waaqa nan galateeffadha.
english: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.

kikuyu: Waldaa kiristaanaa keessatti garuu dubbii kuma kudhan afaan haaraan dubbachuu irra warra kaan barsiisuuf dubbii hubatamaa shan dubbachuu nan barbaada.
english: However, in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, akka ijoolleetti yaaduu dhiisaa; waan hamaaf daaʼimman taʼaa; hubannaadhaan garuu nama guddaa taʼaa.
english: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.

kikuyu: Seera keessatti akkana jedhamee barreeffameera: “Ani afaan biraatiin, afaan alagootaatiinis saba kanatti nan dubbadha; isaan garuu yeroo sanatti illee na hin dhagaʼan, jedha Gooftaan.”
english: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. They won’t even listen to me that way, says the Lord.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu afaan haaraan dubbachuun warra hin amaniniif mallattoo taʼa malee warra amananiif miti; raajii dubbachuun garuu warra amananiif malee warra hin amaniniif miti.
english: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.

kikuyu: Egaa waldaan amantootaa guutuun walitti qabamee yoo hundi isaanii afaan haaraan dubbatan, yoo namoonni hin baratin yookaan namoonni hin amanne ol seenan isin maraattaniirtu isiniin hin jedhanii?
english: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?

kikuyu: Utuu namni hundi raajii dubbachaa jiruu yoo namni hin amanne tokko yookaan namni hin baratin tokko ol seene inni akka cubbamaa taʼe nama hundaan ni amansiifama; nama hundaanis isatti murama;
english: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.

kikuyu: icciitiin garaa isaa keessaas ifatti ni baafama. Innis, “Waaqni dhugumaan isin gidduu jira” jedhee dubbachaa addaan lafatti gombifamee Waaqa waaqeffata.
english: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, egaa maal jenna ree? Yommuu isin walitti qabamtanitti namni hundi faarfannaa yookaan barsiisa yookaan mulʼata yookaan afaan haaraa yookaan hiikkaa afaan haaraa sanaa qaba. Wanni hundinuu waldaa kiristaanaa cimsuuf hojjetamuu qabu.
english: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, or has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.

kikuyu: Namni afaan haaraan dubbatu yoo jiraate lama yookaan yoo baayʼate sadii taʼanii dabaree dabareen haa dubbatan; namni tokko immoo haa hiiku.
english: If any man speaks in another language, let there be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.

kikuyu: Yoo namni hiiku jiraachuu baate garuu namichi dubbatu sun waldaa kiristaanaa keessatti calʼisee ofii isaattii fi Waaqatti haa dubbatu.
english: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself and to God.

kikuyu: Raajonnis lama yookaan sadii taʼanii haa dubbatan; warri kaan immoo waan dubbatamu sana haa madaalan.
english: Let two or three of the prophets speak, and let the others discern.

kikuyu: Yoo warra achi taaʼan keessaa isa tokkoof mulʼanni dhufe, namichi duraan dubbachaa ture sun haa calʼisu.
english: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.

kikuyu: Namni hundi akka baratuuf, hundinuus akka jajjabeeffamuuf dabaree dabareedhaan raajii dubbachuu ni dandeessuutii.
english: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn and all may be exhorted.

kikuyu: Hafuuronni raajotaa raajotaaf ni ajajamu.
english: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,

kikuyu: Waaqni akka waldoota qulqullootaa hundumaa keessatti taʼaa jiru kana Waaqa jeequmsaa utuu hin taʼin Waaqa nagaa ti.
english: for God is not a God of confusion but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.

kikuyu: Dubartoonni waldaa kiristaanaa keessatti haa calʼisan. Akka seerri jedhutti isaan akka ajajaman malee akka dubbatan hin eeyyamamneefiitii.
english: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,

kikuyu: Wanti isaan beekuu barbaadan yoo jiraate manatti dhirsa isaanii haa gaafatan; dubartiin tokko waldaa kiristaanaa keessatti dubbachuun qaaniidhaatii.
english: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”

kikuyu: Dubbiin Waaqaa isin keessaa argamee? Yookaan isinuma qofa bira gaʼee?
english: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?

kikuyu: Eenyu iyyuu yoo raajii yookaan nama Hafuuraa of seʼe akka wanni ani amma isiniif barreessu kun ajaja Gooftaa taʼe haa beeku.
english: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.

kikuyu: Namni kam iyyuu yoo waan kana beekuu baate, inni hin beekin.
english: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.

kikuyu: Kanaaf yaa obboloota ko, raajii dubbachuu jabeessaatii hawwaa; afaan haaraan dubbachuus hin dhowwinaa.
english: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.

kikuyu: Wanti hundinuu garuu karaa qajeelaa fi sirna qabeessa taʼeen hojjetamuu qaba.
english: Let all things be done decently and in order.

kikuyu: Ammas yaa obboloota, ani waaʼee wangeela ani isinitti lallabe, kan isin fudhattanii ittiin dhaabatan sanaa isin yaadachiisuu nan barbaada.
english: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,

kikuyu: Isin yoo dubbii ani isinitti lallabe sana jabeessitanii qabattan wangeeluma kanaan ni fayyitu. Yoo kanaa achii akkasumaan amantan jechuu dha.
english: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.

kikuyu: Anis waanan fudhadhe duraan dursee dabarseen isinitti kenneeraatii; akka Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluun dubbatanitti, Kiristoos cubbuu keenyaaf jedhee duʼe;
english: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

kikuyu: ni awwaalames; akka Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluun dubbatanitti guyyaa sadaffaatti duʼaa kaafame.
english: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

kikuyu: Inni duraan dursee Keefaatti, ergasiis warra Kudha Lamaanitti mulʼate.
english: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.

kikuyu: Sana booddee yeroo tokkotti obboloota dhibba shanii ol taʼanitti mulʼate; isaan keessaas yoo muraasni boqotan iyyuu hedduun isaanii hamma ammaatti ni jiru.
english: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.

kikuyu: Ergasiis Yaaqoobitti, itti aansee ergamoota hundatti mulʼate;
english: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,

kikuyu: dhuma irratti immoo ana kan akka gatataatti dhalateetti lakkaaʼamutti mulʼate.
english: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.

kikuyu: Ani ergamoota hundaa gadi; ergamaa jedhamee waamamuun iyyuu naaf hin malu; ani waldaa kiristaanaa Waaqaa ariʼachaan tureetii.
english: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.

kikuyu: Garuu ani ayyaana Waaqaatiin akkuman jiru kana jira; ayyaanni isaa kan naa kennames akkasumaan hin hafne. Ani hunduma isaanii caalaa jabaadhee hojjedheera; kanas utuu ana hin taʼin ayyaana Waaqaa kan na wajjin jirutu hojjete.
english: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

kikuyu: Egaa anas taʼu yookaan isaan, wanni nu lallabnu, wanni isin amantanis kanuma.
english: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.

kikuyu: Kiristoos warra duʼan keessaa akka kaafame erga lallabamee, isin keessaa namoonni tokko tokko akkamitti duʼaa kaʼuun warra duʼanii hin jiru jechuu dandaʼu ree?
english: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

kikuyu: Erga duʼaa kaʼuun warra duʼanii hin jirre, Kiristoos iyyuu duʼaa hin kaafamne jechuudha kaa!
english: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.

kikuyu: Erga Kiristoos duʼaa hin kaafamin immoo lallabni keenya faayidaa hin qabu; amantiin keessanis faayidaa hin qabu.
english: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain and your faith also is in vain.

kikuyu: Kana malees Waaqni Kiristoosin duʼaa kaaseera jennee waaʼee Waaqaa waan dhugaa baaneef, nu waaʼee Waaqaa dhuga baatota sobaa taanee argamneerra. Garuu erga warri duʼan hin kaafamin inni Kiristoosin hin kaafne jechuu dha.
english: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up if it is true that the dead are not raised.

kikuyu: Yoo warri duʼan kaafamuu baatan, Kiristoosis duʼaa hin kaafamneetii.
english: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.

kikuyu: Erga Kiristoos duʼaa hin kaafamin amantiin keessan faayidaa hin qabu; isinis ammuma iyyuu cubbuu keessa jirtu.
english: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.

kikuyu: Yoos warri utuu Kiristoositti jiranuu boqotan baduu isaanii ti.
english: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

kikuyu: Yoo jireenya ammaa qofaaf Kiristoosin abdanne nu warra namni hundi naʼuuf taʼuu keenya.
english: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.

kikuyu: Amma garuu Kiristoos warra boqotaniif hangafa taʼee dhugumaan warra duʼan keessaa kaafameera.
english: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruit of those who are asleep.

kikuyu: Akkuma duuti karaa nama tokkootiin dhufe, akkasuma immoo duʼaa kaʼuun warra duʼanii karaa nama tokkootiin dhufeetii.
english: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.

kikuyu: Akkuma hundinuu Addaamiin duʼan, hundinuu Kiristoosiin jiraatoo ni taasifamuutii.
english: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.

kikuyu: Kun hundinuus yeroo dabaree isaatti ni taʼa; Kiristoos hangafticha, ergasii immoo yeroo inni deebiʼee dhufutti warra kan Kiristoos taʼan.
english: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s at his coming.

kikuyu: Innis erga bulchiinsa hunda, taayitaa fi humna hunda balleessee booddee, yeroo Waaqa Abbaatti mootummaa dabarsee kennutti dhumni ni taʼa.
english: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God the Father, when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.

kikuyu: Inni hamma diinota isaa hunda miilla isaa jala galfatutti moʼuu qabaatii.
english: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.

kikuyu: Diinni dhumaa kan barbadeeffamuu qabu duʼa.
english: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.

kikuyu: Inni, “Waan hunda miilla isaa jala galcheeraatii.” Garuu “Wanni hundi” isa jala galfameera jechuun akka isa waan hunda isa jala galche sana hin dabalatin beekamaa dha.
english: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.

kikuyu: Erga waan kana godhee booddee akka Waaqni waan hundumaan hundumaa taʼuuf Ilmi mataan isaa iyyuu isa waan hundumaa miilla isaa jala galche sanaaf ni bula.
english: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.

kikuyu: Yoo duʼaa kaʼuun jiraachuu baate namoonni warra duʼaniif jedhanii cuuphaman maal gochuu isaanii ti? Warri duʼanis yoo duʼaa hin kaafamin namoonni maaliif qooda isaanii cuuphamu ree?
english: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?

kikuyu: Nu maaliif saʼaatii hunda balaaf of saaxilla?
english: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, ani guyyuma guyyaan akkan duʼu of jajuu karaa Gooftaa keenya Kiristoos Yesuusiin isin irratti qabuun nan kakadha.
english: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.

kikuyu: Ani akka namaatti Efesoonitti bineensa wajjin wal loluun koo, erga warri duʼan hin kaafamnee, maal na fayyada? “Kottaa ni nyaannaa; ni dhugnas; bor ni duunaatii.”
english: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

kikuyu: Hin gowwoomfaminaa: “Hiriyaan hamaan amala gaarii balleessa.”
english: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”

kikuyu: Gara qalbii keessan isa qajeelaatti deebiʼaa; cubbuu hojjechuus dhiisaa; namoonni Waaqa hin beekne tokko tokko isin gidduu jiruutii. Anis isin qaanessuufin waan kana dubbadha.
english: Wake up righteously and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.

kikuyu: Garuu namni tokko, “Warri duʼan akkamitti kaafamu? Dhagna akkamiitiin dhufu?” jedhee ni gaafata taʼa.
english: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”

kikuyu: Yaa gowwaa! Wanni ati facaaftu yoo duʼe malee jireenya hin argatu.
english: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.

kikuyu: Wanni ati facaaftu sanyiidhuma, jechuunis sanyii qamadii yookaan sanyii midhaan biraati malee dhagna midhaan biqilee guddachuuf jiru sanaa miti.
english: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu akkuma fedhetti dhagna isaaf kenna; tokkoo tokkoo gosa sanyiitiifis dhagna mataa isaa kenna.
english: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.

kikuyu: Foon hundinuu tokko miti; namni foon gosa tokkoo qaba; horiin foon gosa biraa, simbirroon foon gosa biraa, qurxummiinis foon gosa biraa qabu.
english: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.

kikuyu: Akkasuma immoo dhagnawwan samii irraa ni jiru; dhagnawwan lafa irraas ni jiru; garuu ulfinni dhagnawwan samii irraa gosa tokko; ulfinni dhagnawwan lafa irraa immoo gosa biraa ti.
english: There are also celestial bodies and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.

kikuyu: Aduun ulfina gosa tokkoo qabdi; jiʼis ulfina gosa biraa, urjiiwwanis ulfina gosa biraa qabu; urjiin tokko ulfinaan urjii biraatiin addaatii.
english: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.

kikuyu: Duʼaa kaʼuun warra duʼaniis akkasuma. Dhagni facaafamu kan baduu dha; kan hin badne taʼee immoo kaafama.
english: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.

kikuyu: Inni salphinaan facaafama; ulfinaan kaafama; dadhabbiin facaafama; humnaan kaafama;
english: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

kikuyu: dhagna fooniitu facaafama; dhagna hafuuraatu kaafama. Erga dhagni foonii jiraate, dhagni hafuuraas ni jira.
english: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.

kikuyu: Kanaaf, “Addaam namichi jalqabaa lubbuu jiraataa taʼe” jedhamee barreeffameera; Addaam inni dhumaa immoo hafuura jireenya kennu taʼe.
english: So also it is written, “The first man Adam became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.

kikuyu: Inni jalqabatti dhufe garuu isa hafuuraa utuu hin taʼin isa foonii ti; inni hafuuraa immoo ergasii dhufe.
english: However, that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.

kikuyu: Namichi duraa lafa irraa dhufe; inni kan lafaa ti; namichi lammaffaan immoo samii irraa dhufe.
english: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.

kikuyu: Warri kan lafaa taʼan akkuma namicha lafa irraa sanaa ti; warri kan samii taʼan immoo akkuma namicha samii irraa dhufe sanaa ti.
english: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

kikuyu: Nu akkuma bifa namicha lafaa sanaa uffanne, akkasuma immoo bifa namicha samii sanaa ni uffanna.
english: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, akka foonii fi dhiigni mootummaa Waaqaa dhaaluu hin dandeenye yookaan akka inni badu isa hin badne dhaaluu hin dandeenye ani isinitti nan hima.
english: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.

kikuyu: Kunoo, ani icciitii tokko isinittin hima: Hundi keenya hin duunu; nu hundi garuu ni geeddaramna;
english: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

kikuyu: kunis yeroo malakanni dhumaa afuufamu yeruma sanatti hamma liphsuu ijaatti raawwatama. Malakanni ni afuufamaatii; warri duʼanis kanneen hin badne taʼanii ni kaafamu; nus ni geeddaramna.
english: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

kikuyu: Inni badu kun isa hin badne, inni duʼu kun immoo isa hin duune uffachuu qabaatii.
english: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.

kikuyu: Yeroo inni badu isa hin badne uffatee, inni duʼu immoo isa hin duune uffatutti dubbiin akkana jedhamee barreeffame sun ni raawwatama; “Duuti moʼichaan liqimfameera.” Akkasumas,
english: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”

kikuyu: “Yaa duʼa, moʼichi kee meerre? Yaa duʼa, ilkeen kee meerre?”
english: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”

kikuyu: Ilkeen duʼaa cubbuu dha; humni cubbuu immoo seera.
english: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

kikuyu: Waaqa karaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiin moʼicha nuu kennuuf garuu galanni haa taʼu!
english: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa obboloota koo jaallatamoo, jabaadhaa dhaabadhaa. Wanni tokko isin hin sochoosin; akka dadhabbiin keessan Gooftaa biratti faayidaa malee hin hafne waan beektaniif yeroo hunda hojii Gooftaatiif guutummaatti of kennaa.
english: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.

kikuyu: Egaa waaʼee buusii qulqullootaaf walitti qabamuu, isinis akkuma ani waldoota kiristaanaa kanneen Galaatiyaa ajaje sanatti raawwadhaa.
english: Now concerning the collection for the saints: as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.

kikuyu: Akka buusii walitti qabuun yeroo ani dhufutti hin taaneef tokkoon tokkoon keessan akkuma galii keessaniitti torbanuma torbaniin guyyaa jalqabaa waa kophaatti baasaatii kaaʼaa.
english: On the first day of every week, let each one of you save as he may prosper, that no collections are made when I come.

kikuyu: Anis yeroon isin bira dhufutti akka namoonni isin filattan kennaa keessan geessaniif xalayaa ittiin beekaman kenneefii Yerusaalemitti isaan nan erga.
english: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.

kikuyu: Yoo dhaquun koo barbaachisaa taʼe immoo isaan na wajjin dhaqu.
english: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.

kikuyu: Ani waanan Maqedooniyaa keessa darbuuf, yeroon Maqedooniyaa keessa darbutti isin bira nan dhufa.
english: I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.

kikuyu: Akka isin iddoo ani dhaqu hundatti karaa koo irratti na gargaaruu dandeessaniif tarii yeroo xinnoo isin bira nan tura taʼa; yookaan ganna isin bira nan tura taʼa.
english: But with you it may be that I will stay with you, or even winter with you, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.

kikuyu: Yoo Gooftaan jedhe ani waanan yeroo muraasa isin bira turuu abdadhuuf, amma utuun darbuu goree isin arguu hin barbaadu.
english: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.

kikuyu: Hamma guyyaa Pheenxeqoosxeetti garuu Efesoon keessa nan tura.
english: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,

kikuyu: Balballi guddaanii fi buʼaa qabeessi tokko naa banameeraatii; mormitoonnis baayʼee dha.
english: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.

kikuyu: Yoo Xiimotewos gara keessan dhufe waan innis akkuma koo hojii Gooftaa hojjetuuf yeroo inni isin bira turutti akka inni waa tokko iyyuu hin sodaanne godhaa.
english: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.

kikuyu: Kanaaf namni tokko iyyuu isa hin tuffatin; akka inni gara kootti deebiʼuufis nagaadhaan ergaa; ani obboloota wajjin isa eegaan jiraatii.
english: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.

kikuyu: Waaʼee obboleessa keenya Apholoos immoo akka inni obboloota kaan wajjin gara keessan dhufuuf ani jabeessee isa kadhadheen ture. Inni garuu amma dhufuuf gonkumaa fedhii hin qabu; yeroo isaaf mijaaʼutti garuu ni dhufa.
english: Now concerning Apollos the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers, but it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.

kikuyu: Dammaqaa; amantiitti cimaatii dhaabadhaa; jajjabaadhaa; cimaas.
english: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!

kikuyu: Wanni isin hojjettan hundinuu jaalalaan haa taʼu.
english: Let all that you do be done in love.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, akka warri mana Isxiifaanaas jiraatan Akaayaa keessaa warra jalqabatti amanan taʼan isin ni beektu; isaanis qulqulloota tajaajiluuf of kennaniiru.
english: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—

kikuyu: Anis akka isin namoota akkasiitiif, warra isaan wajjin hojjetanii fi dadhaban hundaaf ajajamtan isinin kadhadha.
english: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.

kikuyu: Isxiifaanaas, Fartunaaxoosii fi Akaayiqos na bira dhufuu isaaniitti ani gammadeera; isaan waan asii dhabamuu keessaniin hirʼate guutaniiruutii.
english: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.

kikuyu: Isaan hafuura koo fi hafuura keessan boqochiisaniiruutii. Kanaaf isin namoota akkanaatiif beekamtii kennaa.
english: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.

kikuyu: Waldoonni kiristaanaa kanneen biyya Asiyaa nagaa isiniif dhaamu. Aqiilaa fi Phirisqillaan, waldaan kiristaanaa kan mana isaanii jirtus Gooftaadhaan nagaa guddaa isiniif dhaamu.
english: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you warmly in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.

kikuyu: Obboloonni hundinuu nagaa isinii dhaamu. Dhungoo qulqulluudhaan nagaa wal gaafadhaa.
english: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

kikuyu: Ani Phaawulos, xalayaa nagaa kana harkuma kootiin barreessa.
english: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.

kikuyu: Namni Gooftaa hin jaallanne kam iyyuu haa abaaramu. Yaa Gooftaa kottu.
english: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be cursed. Come, Lord!

kikuyu: Ayyaanni Gooftaa keenya Yesuus isin wajjin haa taʼu.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

kikuyu: Jaalalli koo Kiristoos Yesuusiin hunduma keessan wajjin haa taʼu. Ameen.
english: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.

kikuyu: Phaawulos isa fedhii Waaqaatiin ergamaa Kiristoos Yesuus taʼee fi obboleessa keenya Xiimotewos irraa,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother, to the assembly of God which is at Corinth, with all the saints who are in the whole of Achaia:

kikuyu: Abbaa keenya Waaqaa fi Yesuus Kiristoos Gooftaa irraa ayyaannii fi nagaan isiniif haa taʼu.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Waaqnii fi Abbaan Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos, Abbaan araaraatii fi Waaqni jajjabina hundaa haa eebbifamu;
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of mercies and God of all comfort,

kikuyu: inni akka nu jajjabina Waaqa biraa arganne sanaan warra dhiphina adda addaa keessa jiran jajjabeessuu dandeenyuuf dhiphina keenya hunda keessatti nu jajjabeessa.
english: who comforts us in all our affliction, that we may be able to comfort those who are in any affliction, through the comfort with which we ourselves are comforted by God.

kikuyu: Akkuma nu dhiphina Kiristoos keessatti baayʼee hirmaannu, akkasuma immoo karaa Kiristoosiin jajjabinni nuu baayʼata.
english: For as the sufferings of Christ abound to us, even so our comfort also abounds through Christ.

kikuyu: Nu yoo dhiphanne jajjabinaa fi fayyina keessaniif taʼa; nu yoo jajjabaanne jajjabina keessaniif taʼa; jajjabinni kunis kan isin yeroo dhiphina nu dhiphannu kana keessa dabartanitti obsaan dhaabachuudhaan argattanii dha.
english: But if we are afflicted, it is for your comfort and salvation. If we are comforted, it is for your comfort, which produces in you the patient enduring of the same sufferings which we also suffer.

kikuyu: Abdiin nu waaʼee keessaniif qabnu cimaa dha; isin akkuma dhiphina keenya keessatti hirmaattan amma immoo jajjabina keenya keessatti akka hirmaattan beeknaatii.
english: Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, isin waaʼee dhiphina biyya Asiyaatti nurra gaʼee akka wallaaltan hin barbaannu. Hamma lubbuudhaan jiraachuuf illee abdii kutannutti dhiphinni baachuudhaaf humna keenyaa ol taʼe nurra gaʼee tureetii.
english: For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia: that we were weighed down exceedingly, beyond our power, so much that we despaired even of life.

kikuyu: Dhugumaanuu murtiin duʼaa nutti dhagaʼamee turre. Kun garuu akka nu Waaqa warra duʼan kaasutti malee ofii keenyatti hin amananneef taʼe.
english: Yes, we ourselves have had the sentence of death within ourselves, that we should not trust in ourselves, but in God who raises the dead,

kikuyu: Inni balaa duʼa akkasii jalaa nu baaseera; nu baasas. Inni ittuma fufee akka nu baasu abdii keenya isa irra kaaʼanneerra.
english: who delivered us out of so great a death, and does deliver, on whom we have set our hope that he will also still deliver us,

kikuyu: Akkuma isin kadhannaa keessaniin nu gargaartan, ayyaana kadhannaa namoota baayʼeetiif deebii taʼee nuu kenname sanaaf namoonni baayʼeen nuuf galateeffatu.
english: you also helping together on our behalf by your supplication; that, for the gift given to us by means of many, thanks may be given by many persons on your behalf.

kikuyu: Egaa wanti nu ittiin of jajnu kanaa dha: Akka nu qulqullummaa fi amanamummaa Waaqa biraa argameen fooniin keessumattuu hariiroo isin wajjin qabnuun jiraachaa turre yaadni garaa keenyaa dhugaa nuuf baʼa. Kanas akka ayyaana Waaqaatti goone malee akka ogummaa addunyaatti miti.
english: For our boasting is this: the testimony of our conscience that in holiness and sincerity of God, not in fleshly wisdom but in the grace of God, we behaved ourselves in the world, and more abundantly toward you.

kikuyu: Nu waan isin dubbisuu yookaan hubachuu hin dandeenye tokko illee isinii hin barreessinuutii. Ani akka isin hamma dhumaatti hubattan nan abdadha;
english: For we write no other things to you than what you read or even acknowledge, and I hope you will acknowledge to the end—

kikuyu: innis akkuma isin gara tokko nu hubattan kana, akka guyyaa Gooftaa Yesuusitti akkuma nu isiniin of jajnu sana isinis nuun of jajuu dandeessan guutummaatti hubattanii dha.
english: as also you acknowledged us in part—that we are your boasting, even as you also are ours, in the day of our Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Anis sababiin waan kana amaneef akka isin ayyaana lammaffaa qabaattaniif jedhee jalqabatti gara keessan dhufuu barbaade.
english: In this confidence, I was determined to come first to you, that you might have a second benefit,

kikuyu: Ani yeroon Maqedooniyaa dhaqutti isin ilaaluu fi yeroon Maqedooniyaadhaa deebiʼuttis gara keessan dhufee, akka isin yeroo ani Yihuudaa dhaqutti na ergitan barbaade.
english: and by you to pass into Macedonia, and again from Macedonia to come to you, and to be sent forward by you on my journey to Judea.

kikuyu: Ani yeroon waan kana karoorfadhetti akka salphaattin hojjedhee? Yookaan akka yaada fooniitti yeruma tokkotti, “Eeyyee, eeyyee” fi “Waawuu, waawuu” jechuufan karoora baafadhaa ree?
english: When I therefore planned this, did I show fickleness? Or the things that I plan, do I plan according to the flesh, that with me there should be the “Yes, yes” and the “No, no?”

kikuyu: Akkuma Waaqni amanamaa taʼe dubbiin nu isinitti dubbannus “Eeyyee” fi “Waawuu” miti.
english: But as God is faithful, our word toward you was not “Yes and no.”

kikuyu: Yesuus Kiristoos Ilmi Waaqaa inni nu jechuunis ani, Silwaanosii fi Xiimotewos isin gidduutti lallabne sun, “Eeyyee” fi “Waawuu” hin turreetii; isa keessa “Eeyyeetu” jira.
english: For the Son of God, Jesus Christ, who was preached among you by us—by me, Silvanus, and Timothy—was not “Yes and no,” but in him is “Yes.”

kikuyu: Waadaawwan Waaqaa hundinuu Kiristoosiin “Eeyyeedhaatii”. Kanaafuu nu karaa isaatiin ulfina Waaqaatiif “Ameen” jenna.
english: For however many are the promises of God, in him is the “Yes.” Therefore also through him is the “Amen”, to the glory of God through us.

kikuyu: Egaa kan akka nu isin wajjin Kiristoositti jabaannee dhaabannu godhuu fi kan nu dibe Waaqa;
english: Now he who establishes us with you in Christ and anointed us is God,

kikuyu: innis chaappaa nutti chaappessee, qabdii Hafuura Qulqulluu garaa keenya keessa kaaʼe.
english: who also sealed us and gave us the down payment of the Spirit in our hearts.

kikuyu: Ani garuu isin qusachuudhaaf jecha Qorontositti hin deebine; anis akka inni dhugaa natti baʼuuf Waaqa ofitti nan waama.
english: But I call God for a witness to my soul, that to spare you, I didn’t come to Corinth.

kikuyu: Nu gammachuu keessaniif isin wajjin hojjenna malee amantii keessan irratti gooftummaa hin qabnu; isin amantiin jabaattanii dhaabattaniitii.
english: We don’t control your faith, but are fellow workers with you for your joy. For you stand firm in faith.

kikuyu: Ani akkan lammata gaddaan gara keessan hin dhufne murteeffadheera.
english: But I determined this for myself, that I would not come to you again in sorrow.

kikuyu: Yoo ani isin gaddisiise, isinuma warra ani gaddisiisu sana malee eenyutu na gammachiisa ree?
english: For if I make you grieve, then who will make me glad but he who is made to grieve by me?

kikuyu: Akkasitti barreessuun koo akka yommuu ani dhufutti namoonni na gammachiisuu qaban na hin gaddisiisneefi. Akka gammachuun koo gammachuu hunda keessanii taʼe ani hunda keessan nan amana ture.
english: And I wrote this very thing to you, so that when I came, I wouldn’t have sorrow from them of whom I ought to rejoice; having confidence in you all that my joy would be shared by all of you.

kikuyu: Ani dhiphina guddaa, yaaddoo garaatii fi imimmaan baayʼeedhaan isinii barreesseetii; kunis jaalalli ani isiniif qabu hammam guddaa akka taʼe akka beektaniif malee isin gaddisiisuuf miti.
english: For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve, but that you might know the love that I have so abundantly for you.

kikuyu: Eenyu iyyuu yoo nama gaddisiise utuu dubbii hoʼisuuf hin taʼin inni karaa tokko hunduma keessan gaddisiisuu isaati malee na gaddisiisuu isaa miti.
english: But if any has caused sorrow, he has caused sorrow not to me, but in part (that I not press too heavily) to you all.

kikuyu: Nama akkanaa irratti adabbiin harki caalaan keessan adabdan ni gaʼa.
english: This punishment which was inflicted by the many is sufficient for such a one;

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa akka inni gadda guddaan hin liqimfamneef dhiifama isaaf gochuu fi isa jajjabeessuutu isin irra jira.
english: so that, on the contrary, you should rather forgive him and comfort him, lest by any means such a one should be swallowed up with his excessive sorrow.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani akka isin jaalala isaaf qabdan cimsitan isinan kadhadha.
english: Therefore I beg you to confirm your love toward him.

kikuyu: Anis akka isin waan hunda irratti ajajamtoota taatan mirkaneeffachuufin waan kana isinii barreesse.
english: For to this end I also wrote, that I might know the proof of you, whether you are obedient in all things.

kikuyu: Nama isin dhiifama gootaniif, anis dhiifama nan godha. Yoo wanti ani dhiifama godhe tokko iyyuu jiraates ani isiniif jedhee fuula Kiristoos duratti dhiifama godheera;
english: Now I also forgive whomever you forgive anything. For if indeed I have forgiven anything, I have forgiven that one for your sakes in the presence of Christ,

kikuyu: kunis akka Seexanni nu hin gowwoomsineefi. Nu mala isaa hin wallaalluutii.
english: that no advantage may be gained over us by Satan, for we are not ignorant of his schemes.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani wangeela Kiristoos lallabuuf Xirooʼaas dhaqee Gooftaan balbala naa banetti,
english: Now when I came to Troas for the Good News of Christ, and when a door was opened to me in the Lord,

kikuyu: waan ani obboleessa koo Tiitoo hin argatiniif, hafuurri koo boqonnaa hin arganne. Kanaafuu ani nagaatti isaaniin jedhee Maqedooniyaatti darbe.
english: I had no relief for my spirit, because I didn’t find Titus my brother, but taking my leave of them, I went out into Macedonia.

kikuyu: Waaqa yeroo hunda akka nu Kiristoosiin moʼannoo qabaannu nu taasisee urgaa beekumsa isaa karaa keenyaan iddoo hundatti facaasuuf galanni haa taʼu.
english: Now thanks be to God who always leads us in triumph in Christ, and reveals through us the sweet aroma of his knowledge in every place.

kikuyu: Nu warra fayyifamaa jiranii fi warra baduutti jiran gidduutti Waaqaaf urgaa Kiristoos.
english: For we are a sweet aroma of Christ to God in those who are being saved and in those who perish:

kikuyu: Nu isa tokkoof urgaa duʼaa ti; isa kaaniif immoo urgaa jireenyaa ti. Egaa eenyutu waan kanaaf gaʼaa taʼa?
english: to the one a stench from death to death, to the other a sweet aroma from life to life. Who is sufficient for these things?

kikuyu: Nu garuu akka namoota Waaqa biraa ergamaniitti Kiristoosiin fuula Waaqaa duratti garaa qulqulluudhaan dubbanna malee akka namoota hedduu kanneen buʼaa argachuuf jedhanii dubbii Waaqaa gurguratan sanaa miti.
english: For we are not as so many, peddling the word of God. But as of sincerity, but as of God, in the sight of God, we speak in Christ.

kikuyu: Nu ammas of galateeffachuu jalqabnaa ree? Yookaan akka namoota tokko tokkoo xalayaa deeggarsaa gara keessanitti fiduu yookaan isin biraa argachuu nu barbaachisaa ree?
english: Are we beginning again to commend ourselves? Or do we need, as do some, letters of commendation to you or from you?

kikuyu: Xalayaan keenya kan namni hundinuu beekuu fi dubbisu kan garaa keenya keessatti barreeffame isinuma.
english: You are our letter, written in our hearts, known and read by all men,

kikuyu: Isin akka xalayaa Kiristoos, buʼaa tajaajila keenyaa taatan ifa; xalayaan kunis qalamiidhaan utuu hin taʼin Hafuura Waaqa jiraataatiin, gabatee dhagaa irratti utuu hin taʼin gabatee garaa namaa irratti kan barreeffamee dha.
english: being revealed that you are a letter of Christ, served by us, written not with ink, but with the Spirit of the living God; not in tablets of stone, but in tablets that are hearts of flesh.

kikuyu: Amantiin nu karaa Kiristoosiin fuula Waaqaa duratti qabnus kan akkanaa ti.
english: Such confidence we have through Christ toward God,

kikuyu: Nu waan tokko illee ofii keenyaan hojjechuuf dandeettii qabna jennee miti; dandeettiin keenya garuu Waaqa irraa dhufa.
english: not that we are sufficient of ourselves to account anything as from ourselves; but our sufficiency is from God,

kikuyu: Innis akka nu tajaajiltoota kakuu haaraa taanuuf dandeettii nuu kenneera; kakuun kunis kan qubee utuu hin taʼin kan Hafuuraa ti; qubeen ni ajjeesa; Hafuurri garuu jireenya kenna.
english: who also made us sufficient as servants of a new covenant, not of the letter but of the Spirit. For the letter kills, but the Spirit gives life.

kikuyu: Erga tajaajilli duʼa fide kan qubeedhaan dhagaa irratti qirixame sun hamma Israaʼeloonni sababii ulfina isaa kan irraa badaa deemu sanaatiif xiyyeeffatanii fuula Musee ilaaluu hin dandeenyetti ulfinaan dhufee,
english: But if the service of death, written engraved on stones, came with glory, so that the children of Israel could not look steadfastly on the face of Moses for the glory of his face, which was passing away,

kikuyu: tajaajilli Hafuuraa immoo hammam caalaa ulfina haa qabaatuu ree?
english: won’t service of the Spirit be with much more glory?

kikuyu: Erga tajaajilli murtii namatti fidu ulfina qabaatee, tajaajilli qajeelummaa fidu immoo hammam caalaa ulfina haa qabaatu ree!
english: For if the service of condemnation has glory, the service of righteousness exceeds much more in glory.

kikuyu: Wanni ulfina qabeessa ture sun yommuu ulfina caalu biratti ilaalamu amma ulfina hin qabuutii.
english: For most certainly that which has been made glorious has not been made glorious in this respect, by reason of the glory that surpasses.

kikuyu: Erga wanni yeroodhaaf jiraatu sun ulfinaan dhufee, ulfinni isa bara baraan jiraatuu immoo hammam caalaa guddaa haa taʼu ree!
english: For if that which passes away was with glory, much more that which remains is in glory.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu abdii akkasii waan qabnuuf baayʼee ija jabaanna.
english: Having therefore such a hope, we use great boldness of speech,

kikuyu: Nu warra akka Musee isa akka sabni Israaʼel dhuma waan badaa deemu sanaa hin argineef jedhee haguuggiidhaan fuula isaa haguuggatee miti.
english: and not as Moses, who put a veil on his face so that the children of Israel wouldn’t look steadfastly on the end of that which was passing away.

kikuyu: Yaadni isaanii garuu hadoodeera; isaan hamma harʼaatti iyyuu yommuu kakuu moofaa dubbisanitti haguuggiin sun isaan irraa hin fuudhamne. Inni Kiristoos qofaan irraa fuudhamaatii.
english: But their minds were hardened, for until this very day at the reading of the old covenant the same veil remains, because in Christ it passes away.

kikuyu: Hamma harʼaatti illee yeroo isaan seera Musee dubbisanitti haguuggiin yaada garaa isaanii ni haguuga.
english: But to this day, when Moses is read, a veil lies on their heart.

kikuyu: Yeroo namni kam iyyuu gara Gooftaatti deebiʼutti garuu haguuggiin sun irraa fuudhama.
english: But whenever someone turns to the Lord, the veil is taken away.

kikuyu: Gooftaan Hafuura. Iddoo Hafuurri Gooftaa jiru immoo bilisummaatu jira.
english: Now the Lord is the Spirit; and where the Spirit of the Lord is, there is liberty.

kikuyu: Nu warri utuu fuulli keenya hin haguugamin ulfina Gooftaa calaqqisnu hundi ulfina ittuma caalee guddachaa deemu kan Gooftaa Hafuura taʼe irraa dhufuun gara bifa isaatti geeddaramaa jirra.
english: But we all, with unveiled face seeing the glory of the Lord as in a mirror, are transformed into the same image from glory to glory, even as from the Lord, the Spirit.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu araara Waaqaatiin tajaajila kana waan qabnuuf abdii hin kutannu.
english: Therefore, seeing we have this ministry, even as we obtained mercy, we don’t faint.

kikuyu: Nu waan dhoksaa taʼee fi waan nama qaanessu dhiifneerra; namas hin gowwoomsinu; dubbii Waaqaas hin micciirru. Garuu dhugaa ifatti baafnee dubbachuudhaan fuula Waaqaa duratti qalbii nama hundumaatti of dhiʼeessina.
english: But we have renounced the hidden things of shame, not walking in craftiness nor handling the word of God deceitfully, but by the manifestation of the truth commending ourselves to every man’s conscience in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Wangeelli keenya yoo haguugame illee warra baduutti jiran jalaa haguugama;
english: Even if our Good News is veiled, it is veiled in those who are dying,

kikuyu: Waaqni addunyaa kanaa akka namoonni hin amanin ifa wangeela ulfina Kiristoos isa fakkaattii Waaqaa taʼe sanaa arguu hin dandeenyeef qalbii isaanii jaamseera.
english: in whom the god of this world has blinded the minds of the unbelieving, that the light of the Good News of the glory of Christ, who is the image of God, should not dawn on them.

kikuyu: Nu akka Yesuus Kiristoos Gooftaa taʼe lallabna malee of hin lallabnu; nu mataan keenya Yesuusiif jennee tajaajiltoota keessan.
english: For we don’t preach ourselves, but Christ Jesus as Lord, and ourselves as your servants for Jesus’ sake,
