kikuyu: Waaqni, “Dukkana keessaa ifni haa ifu” jedhe sun akka fuula Kiristoos irraa ifa beekumsa ulfina Waaqaa nuu kennuuf ifa isaa garaa keenya keessatti ibseeraatii.
english: seeing it is God who said, “Light will shine out of darkness,” who has shone in our hearts to give the light of the knowledge of the glory of God in the face of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Garuu akka humni waan hunda caalu kun Waaqa irraa malee nu biraa hin dhufin argisiisuuf nu badhaadhummaa kana qodaa suphee keessaa qabna.
english: But we have this treasure in clay vessels, that the exceeding greatness of the power may be of God and not from ourselves.

kikuyu: Nu karaa hundaan ni dhiibamna; garuu hin caccabnu; ni burjaajofna; garuu abdii hin kutannu;
english: We are pressed on every side, yet not crushed; perplexed, yet not to despair;

kikuyu: ni ariʼatamna, garuu hin gatamnu; lafaan dhaʼamna, garuu hin badnu.
english: pursued, yet not forsaken; struck down, yet not destroyed;

kikuyu: Akka jireenyi Yesuus dhagna keenyaan mulʼifamuuf nu yeroo hunda duʼa Yesuus dhagna keenyatti baannee deemna.
english: always carrying in the body the putting to death of the Lord Jesus, that the life of Jesus may also be revealed in our body.

kikuyu: Nu warri lubbuun jirru akka jireenyi isaa foon keenya kan duʼu keessaan mulʼifamuuf yeroo hunda Yesuusiif jennee duʼatti dabarfamnee kennamnaatii.
english: For we who live are always delivered to death for Jesus’ sake, that the life also of Jesus may be revealed in our mortal flesh.

kikuyu: Egaa duuti nu keessatti hojjeta; jireenyi immoo isin keessatti hojjeta.
english: So then death works in us, but life in you.

kikuyu: “Ani amaneera; kanaafis dubbadheera” jedhamee barreeffameera. Nu immoo sababii hafuura amantii sanaan ni amanna; kanaafis ni dubbanna;
english: But having the same spirit of faith, according to that which is written, “I believed, and therefore I spoke.” We also believe, and therefore we also speak,

kikuyu: inni Gooftaa Yesuusin warra duʼan keessaa kaase sun nuus Yesuus wajjin kaasee isin wajjinis fuula isaa duratti akka nu dhiʼeessu ni beekna.
english: knowing that he who raised the Lord Jesus will raise us also through Jesus, and will present us with you.

kikuyu: Ayyaanni namoota hedduu waliin gaʼaa jiru kun ulfina Waaqaatiif galata guutee dhangalaʼu akka fiduuf wanni kun hundi buʼaa keessaniif taʼe.
english: For all things are for your sakes, that the grace, being multiplied through the many, may cause the thanksgiving to abound to the glory of God.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu abdii hin kutannu. Yoo namummaan keenya inni alaan mulʼatu dhumaa deeme iyyuu, namummaan keenya inni keessaa garuu guyyuma guyyaan haaromfamaa deema.
english: Therefore we don’t faint, but though our outward person is decaying, yet our inward person is renewed day by day.

kikuyu: Dhiphinni keenya inni salphaanii fi yeroodhaaf turu kun ulfina bara baraa kan waan hunda caalu nuuf fida.
english: For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu waan hin mulʼanne ilaalla malee waan mulʼatu hin ilaallu. Wanti mulʼatu waan yeroo ti; wanti hin mulʼanne garuu waan bara baraatii.
english: while we don’t look at the things which are seen, but at the things which are not seen. For the things which are seen are temporal, but the things which are not seen are eternal.

kikuyu: Yoo dunkaanni lafa irraa kan nu keessa jiraannu kun diigame mana Waaqni ijaare, mana bara baraa kan harka namaatiin hin ijaaramin samii irraa akka qabnu beekna.
english: For we know that if the earthly house of our tent is dissolved, we have a building from God, a house not made with hands, eternal, in the heavens.

kikuyu: Hammasitti mana keenya kan samii irraa sana uffachuu hawwuudhaan ni aadna;
english: For most certainly in this we groan, longing to be clothed with our habitation which is from heaven,

kikuyu: nu yommuu isa ufannutti qullaa hin argamnuutii.
english: if indeed being clothed, we will not be found naked.

kikuyu: Nu utuma dunkaana kana keessa jirruu ni aadna; baʼaanis nutti ulfaateera; nu garuu wanni duʼa hin oolle jireenyaan akka liqimfamuuf mana keenya kan samii irraa uffachuu malee akka uffanni nurraa baafamu hin barbaannuutii.
english: For indeed we who are in this tent do groan, being burdened, not that we desire to be unclothed, but that we desire to be clothed, that what is mortal may be swallowed up by life.

kikuyu: Kan kaayyoo kanaaf nu qopheesses Waaqa isa Hafuura Qulqulluu wabii waan dhufuuf jiruu godhee akka qabdiitti nuu kenne sanaa dha.
english: Now he who made us for this very thing is God, who also gave to us the down payment of the Spirit.

kikuyu: Kanaaf nu yeroo hunda ija jabina qabna; hamma dhagna fooniitiin jirrutti Gooftaa irraa fagoo akka jirru beekna.
english: Therefore we are always confident and know that while we are at home in the body, we are absent from the Lord;

kikuyu: Nu amantiidhaan jiraanna malee arguun miti.
english: for we walk by faith, not by sight.

kikuyu: Nu ija jabina qabna; dhagna foonii kana irraa addaan baanee Gooftaa wajjin jiraachuu filanna.
english: We are courageous, I say, and are willing rather to be absent from the body and to be at home with the Lord.

kikuyu: Kanaaf nu dhagna fooniitiin jiraannus, dhagna foonii irraa fagaannus kaayyoon keenya Isa gammachiisuu dha.
english: Therefore also we make it our aim, whether at home or absent, to be well pleasing to him.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon namaa yeroo dhagna fooniitiin jiraachaa turetti akka hojii tolaa yookaan hamaa hojjeteef gatii isaa argatuuf hundi keenya barcuma murtii Kiristoos duratti dhiʼaachuu qabnaatii.
english: For we must all be revealed before the judgment seat of Christ that each one may receive the things in the body according to what he has done, whether good or bad.

kikuyu: Nu Gooftaa sodaachuun maal akka taʼe waan beeknuuf namoota amansiisuuf yaalii goona. Eenyummaan keenya Waaqa biratti beekamaa dha; yaada garaa keessaniitiifis beekamaa akka taʼe nan abdadha.
english: Knowing therefore the fear of the Lord, we persuade men, but we are revealed to God, and I hope that we are revealed also in your consciences.

kikuyu: Nu akka isin nuun boontaniif carraa isinii kennuuf malee amma illee isin biratti of galateeffachuuf miti; kunis isin warra waan garaa keessa jiru caalaa waan ijatti mulʼatuun boonaniif deebii kennuu akka dandeessaniif.
english: For we are not commending ourselves to you again, but speak as giving you occasion of boasting on our behalf, that you may have something to answer those who boast in appearance and not in heart.

kikuyu: Nu yoo akka namoonni tokko tokko jedhan sana “qalbii dabarsine,” Waaqaaf jennee ti; yoo qalbii qabeeyyii taane immoo isiniif jennee ti.
english: For if we are beside ourselves, it is for God. Or if we are of sober mind, it is for you.

kikuyu: Jaalalli Kiristoos nu dirqisiisaatii; sababiin isaas waan namni tokko nama hundaaf duʼeef namni hundi kan duʼe taʼuu isaa amansiifamneerra.
english: For the love of Christ compels us; because we judge thus: that one died for all, therefore all died.

kikuyu: Innis akka warri lubbuun jiran siʼachi isa isaaniif jedhee duʼee duʼaa kaafame sanaaf malee akka ofii isaaniitiif hin jiraanneef nama hundumaaf duʼe.
english: He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose again.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu ammaa jalqabnee nama tokko iyyuu akka ilaalcha fooniitti hin ilaallu. Yoo kanaan dura akka ilaalcha addunyaatti Kiristoosin ilaalaa turre iyyuu, siʼachi akkas hin goonu.
english: Therefore we know no one according to the flesh from now on. Even though we have known Christ according to the flesh, yet now we know him so no more.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu eenyu iyyuu yoo Kiristoositti jiraate inni uumama haaraa dha; wanni moofaan darbeera; kunoo wanni haaraan dhufeera.
english: Therefore if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old things have passed away. Behold, all things have become new.

kikuyu: Kun hundinuus Waaqa Kiristoosiin ofitti nu araarsee fi tajaajila araaraa nuu kenne sana irraa dhufe;
english: But all things are of God, who reconciled us to himself through Jesus Christ, and gave to us the ministry of reconciliation;

kikuyu: kunis, Waaqni cubbuu namootaa isaanitti lakkaaʼuu dhiisuudhaan Kiristoosiin addunyaa ofitti araarsaa ture jechuu dha. Innis ergaa araaraa sana imaanaa nutti kenneera.
english: namely, that God was in Christ reconciling the world to himself, not reckoning to them their trespasses, and having committed to us the word of reconciliation.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu bakka buʼoota Kiristoos; Waaqnis karaa keenyaan isin sossobata; nus akka isin Waaqatti araaramtaniif qooda Kiristoos taanee isin kadhanna.
english: We are therefore ambassadors on behalf of Christ, as though God were entreating by us: we beg you on behalf of Christ, be reconciled to God.

kikuyu: Akka nu isumaan qajeelummaa Waaqaa taanuuf Waaqni nuuf jedhee Kiristoos isa cubbuu hin qabne sana cubbuu godhe.
english: For him who knew no sin he made to be sin on our behalf, so that in him we might become the righteousness of God.

kikuyu: Egaa nu warri Waaqa wajjin hojjennu, akka isin ayyaana Waaqaa akka waan gatii hin qabneetti hin fudhanne isin kadhanna.
english: Working together, we entreat also that you do not receive the grace of God in vain.

kikuyu: Inni, “Ani yeroo fudhatama qabutti si dhagaʼeera; guyyaa fayyinaattis si gargaareera” jedhaatii. Kunoo yeroon fudhatama qabu amma; guyyaan fayyinaas amma.
english: For he says, “At an acceptable time I listened to you. In a day of salvation I helped you.” Behold, now is the acceptable time. Behold, now is the day of salvation.

kikuyu: Nu akka tajaajilli keenya hin tuffatamneef, karaa nama kamii irra iyyuu gufuu hin keenyu.
english: We give no occasion of stumbling in anything, that our service may not be blamed,

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa nu karaa hundaan akka tajaajiltoota Waaqaatti of dhiʼeessina; obsa guddaadhaan, dhiphinaan, gidiraa fi yaaddoon,
english: but in everything commending ourselves as servants of God: in great endurance, in afflictions, in hardships, in distresses,

kikuyu: garafamuun, mana hidhaatti galfamuun, jeequmsaan, hojii dadhabsiisaa hojjechuun, hirriba dhabuun, beelaʼuun,
english: in beatings, in imprisonments, in riots, in labors, in watchings, in fastings,

kikuyu: qulqullaaʼummaan, hubannaan, obsaa fi gara laafinaan, Hafuura Qulqulluu fi jaalala of tuulummaa hin qabneen,
english: in pureness, in knowledge, in perseverance, in kindness, in the Holy Spirit, in sincere love,

kikuyu: dubbii dhugaatii fi humna Waaqaatiin, miʼa waraanaa kan qajeelinaa harka mirgaatii fi harka bitaatti qabachuun,
english: in the word of truth, in the power of God, by the armor of righteousness on the right hand and on the left,

kikuyu: ulfinaa fi salphinaan, maqaa baduu fi maqaa toluun jiraanneerra; akkasumas utuu dhugaa qabeeyyii taanee jirruu, sobduu jedhamneerra;
english: by glory and dishonor, by evil report and good report, as deceivers and yet true,

kikuyu: beekamtoota turre; garuu akka warra hin beekaminiitti hedamne; nu duʼaa jirra; garuu kunoo ni jiraanna; ni tumamna; garuu hin ajjeefamnu;
english: as unknown and yet well known, as dying and behold—we live, as punished and not killed,

kikuyu: ni gaddina; garuu yeroo hunda ni gammanna; hiyyeeyyii dha; garuu namoota hedduu sooromsina; homaa hin qabnu; garuu waan hunda qabna.
english: as sorrowful yet always rejoicing, as poor yet making many rich, as having nothing and yet possessing all things.

kikuyu: Yaa warra Qorontos, nu afaan guunnee isinitti dubbanneerra; garaan keenyas isiniif banamaa dha.
english: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.

kikuyu: Isinitu garaa nu dhokfate malee nu garaa isin hin dhokfanne.
english: You are not restricted by us, but you are restricted by your own affections.

kikuyu: Ani akka waan isin ijoollee koo taataniittin isinitti dubbadha; isinis akkasuma garaa keessan balʼisaa nuu banaa.
english: Now in return—I speak as to my children—you also open your hearts.

kikuyu: Warra hin amanneen walitti hin camadaminaa. Qajeelummaa fi jalʼinni maal wal irraa qabu? Yookaan ifni dukkana wajjin tokkummaa maalii qaba?
english: Don’t be unequally yoked with unbelievers, for what fellowship do righteousness and iniquity have? Or what fellowship does light have with darkness?

kikuyu: Kiristoosii fi Belhor gidduu walii galtee maaliitu jira? Namni amanu tokko nama hin amanne wajjin maal wal irraa qaba?
english: What agreement does Christ have with Belial? Or what portion does a believer have with an unbeliever?

kikuyu: Manni qulqullummaa Waaqaa waaqota tolfamoo wajjin walii galtee maalii qaba? Nu mana qulqullummaa Waaqa jiraataa ti. Waaqnis akkana jedhee dubbateera; “Ani isaan wajjin nan jiraadha; isaan gidduus nan deddeebiʼa. Ani Waaqa isaanii nan taʼa; isaanis saba koo ni taʼu.”
english: What agreement does a temple of God have with idols? For you are a temple of the living God. Even as God said, “I will dwell in them and walk in them. I will be their God and they will be my people.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu, “Isaan keessaa baʼaa; isaan irraas gargar foʼamaa; jedha Gooftaan. Waan xuraaʼaa hin tuqinaa, anis isinan simadha.”
english: Therefore “‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.

kikuyu: Amma illee, “Ani Abbaa isiniif nan taʼa; isinis ilmaanii fi intallan koo ni taatu; jedha Gooftaan Waan Hunda Dandaʼu.”
english: I will be to you a Father. You will be to me sons and daughters,’ says the Lord Almighty.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa jaallatamtoota, nu waan waadaawwan kanneen qabnuuf kottaa Waaqa sodaachaa qulqullina fiixaan baasuudhaan waan foonii fi hafuura xureessu hundumaa irraa of qulqulleessinaa.
english: Having therefore these promises, beloved, let’s cleanse ourselves from all defilement of flesh and spirit, perfecting holiness in the fear of God.

kikuyu: Isin garaa nuu balʼadhaa. Nu nama tokko illee hin yakkine; nama tokko illee amala hin balleessine; nama tokko illee gowwoomsinee waa irraa hin fudhanne.
english: Open your hearts to us. We wronged no one. We corrupted no one. We took advantage of no one.

kikuyu: Kana jechuun koos isinitti muruuf miti; nu isin wajjin duʼuu fi jiraachuuf akka isin garaa keenya keessa jirtan ani duraan dursee himeeraatii.
english: I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.

kikuyu: Ani guddiseen isin amanadha; guddisees isiniin nan boona. Ani baayʼee jajjabeeffameera; rakkina keenya hunda keessattis gammachuun koo hamma hin qabu.
english: Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow with joy in all our affliction.

kikuyu: Yeroo Maqedooniyaa dhufnettis nu qixa hundaan dhiphachaa turre malee foon keenya kun boqonnaa hin arganne; alaan lola, keessaan immoo sodaatu nurra ture.
english: For even when we had come into Macedonia, our flesh had no relief, but we were afflicted on every side. Fightings were outside. Fear was inside.

kikuyu: Waaqni warra gaddan jajjabeessu garuu dhufaatii Tiitootiin nu jajjabeesse;
english: Nevertheless, he who comforts the lowly, God, comforted us by the coming of Titus,

kikuyu: kun immoo isin isa jajjabeessuu keessaniinis malee dhufaatii isaa qofaan miti. Innis na yaaduu keessan, gadduu keessan, hinaaffaa isin naaf qabdan nutti himeera; kanaafuu ani hamma duraa caalaa gammadeera.
english: and not by his coming only, but also by the comfort with which he was comforted in you while he told us of your longing, your mourning, and your zeal for me, so that I rejoiced still more.

kikuyu: Ani yoon xalayaa kootiin isin gaddisiise illee waan kana gochuu kootiif hin gaabbu. Ani yoon gaabbe illee akka xalayaan sun isin gaddisiise nan hubadha; taʼus isin gaddisiisuun isaa yeruma gabaabaaf;
english: For though I grieved you with my letter, I do not regret it, though I did regret it. For I see that my letter made you grieve, though just for a while.

kikuyu: amma garuu sababii isin gadditaniif utuu hin taʼin sababii gaddi keessan gara qalbii jijjiirrachuutti isin geesseef ani nan gammada. Isin akka fedhii Waaqaatti gadditaniitii; kanaafuu isin karaa kamiin iyyuu nuun hin miidhamne.
english: I now rejoice, not that you were grieved, but that you were grieved to repentance. For you were grieved in a godly way, that you might suffer loss by us in nothing.

kikuyu: Gaddi akka fedhii Waaqaatti taʼu qalbii jijjiirrannaa gara fayyinaatti nama geessu fida malee gaabbii hin fidu; gaddi akka fedhii addunyaatti taʼu garuu duʼa fida.
english: For godly sorrow produces repentance leading to salvation, which brings no regret. But the sorrow of the world produces death.

kikuyu: Gaddi akka fedhii Waaqaatti taʼe kun tattaaffii akkamii, dandeettii falmachuu akkamii, dheekkamsa akkamii, sodaa akkamii, namaa yaaduu akkamii, hinaaffaa qajeelaa akkamii, murtii qajeelaa akkamii isin keessatti akka uume mee ilaalaa! Isin waan kana irratti karaa hundaan akka qulqulloota taatan mirkaneeffattaniirtu.
english: For behold, this same thing, that you were grieved in a godly way, what earnest care it worked in you. Yes, what defense, indignation, fear, longing, zeal, and vindication! In everything you demonstrated yourselves to be pure in the matter.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani isinii barreessu iyyuu, isin fuula Waaqaa duratti hammam akka nuuf of kennitan akka ofuma keessaniin argitaniif malee sababii namicha nama miidheetiif yookaan sababii namicha miidhameetiif miti.
english: So although I wrote to you, I wrote not for his cause that did the wrong, nor for his cause that suffered the wrong, but that your earnest care for us might be revealed in you in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Nuus kana hundaanuu ni jajjabaanna. Jajjabina keenyatti dabalees keessumattuu Tiitoon gammaduu isaa arginee gammanneerra; hafuurri isaa isin hundaan haaromfameeraatii.
english: Therefore we have been comforted. In our comfort we rejoiced the more exceedingly for the joy of Titus, because his spirit has been refreshed by you all.

kikuyu: Ani isiniin isatti booneen ture; isinis na hin qaanessine. Garuu akkuma wanni nu isinitti himne sun hundi dhugaa taʼe, waaʼee keessan Tiitootti boonuun keenyas akkasuma dhugaa taʼuun isaa mirkanaaʼeera.
english: For if in anything I have boasted to him on your behalf, I was not disappointed. But as we spoke all things to you in truth, so our glorying also which I made before Titus was found to be truth.

kikuyu: Innis ajajamuu hunda keessanii akkasumas sodaa fi hollannaa isin ittiin isa simattan sana yeroo yaadatutti jaalalli inni isiniif qabu isa durii caalaa dabalama.
english: His affection is more abundantly toward you, while he remembers all of your obedience, how with fear and trembling you received him.

kikuyu: Ani abdii guutuu isin irraa qaba; kanaafuu nan gammada.
english: I rejoice that in everything I am confident concerning you.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, waaʼee ayyaana Waaqni waldoota kiristaanaa Maqedooniyaatiif kennee isin akka beektan ni barbaanna.
english: Moreover, brothers, we make known to you the grace of God which has been given in the assemblies of Macedonia,

kikuyu: Isaanis utuu dhiphina baayʼeen qoramuutti jiranuu, baayʼinni gammachuu isaaniitii fi akka malee deeguun isaanii arjummaa isaanii baayʼiseera.
english: how in a severe ordeal of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.

kikuyu: Ani akka isaan hamma dandeettii isaanii, dandeettii isaaniitii olis fedhii isaaniitiin kennan dhugaa nan baʼaatii. Isaan guutumaan guutuutti ofuma isaaniitiin
english: For according to their power, I testify, yes and beyond their power, they gave of their own accord,

kikuyu: carraa qulqulloota tajaajiluu kana keessatti akka hirmaatan cimsanii nu kadhatan.
english: begging us with much entreaty to receive this grace and the fellowship in the service to the saints.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu duraan dursanii Gooftaaf, ergasii immoo fedhii Waaqaatiin nuuf of kennan malee akka nu eegne hin goone.
english: This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Tiitoon akkuma duraan jalqabe sana hojii arjummaa kana gama keessaniin akka fiixaan baasuuf isa kadhanne.
english: So we urged Titus, that as he had made a beginning before, so he would also complete in you this grace.

kikuyu: Isin garuu akkuma waan hundaan jechuunis amantiin, dubbiin, beekumsaan, tattaaffii guutuu fi jaalala nuuf qabdaniin caaltan sana, kennaa arjummaa kaaniinis akka caaltan mirkaneessaa.
english: But as you abound in everything—in faith, utterance, knowledge, all earnestness, and in your love to us—see that you also abound in this grace.

kikuyu: Ani tattaaffii namoota kaaniitiin wal bira qabee jaalalli keessan dhugaa taʼuu isaa qoruu barbaadeeti malee isin ajajaa hin jiru.
english: I speak not by way of commandment, but as proving through the earnestness of others the sincerity also of your love.

kikuyu: Isin ayyaana Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos ni beektuutii; inni utuu sooressa taʼee jiruu akka isin hiyyummaa isaatiin sooromtaniif isiniif jedhee hiyyoome.
english: For you know the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, that though he was rich, yet for your sakes he became poor, that you through his poverty might become rich.

kikuyu: Waan kana irratti gorsi ani waaʼee waan hunda caalaa isiniif wayyuu irratti kennu kanaa dha. Isin waggaa darbe kennuu qofaan utuu hin taʼin fedhii kennuuf qabdaniinis kanneen jalqabaa turtan.
english: I give advice in this: it is expedient for you who were the first to start a year ago, not only to do, but also to be willing.

kikuyu: Ammas fedhiin cimaan isin hojii sanaaf qabdan isa fiixa baasuu keessaniin akka mirkanaaʼuuf waanuma qabdaniin hojii sana fiixaan baasaa.
english: But now complete the doing also, that as there was the readiness to be willing, so there may be the completion also out of your ability.

kikuyu: Erga fedhiin jiraate kennaan sun akkuma waan namni qabuutti fudhatama malee akka waan namni hin qabneetti miti.
english: For if the readiness is there, it is acceptable according to what you have, not according to what you don’t have.

kikuyu: Fedhiin keenya akka isin rakkattanii warra kaanitti immoo toluuf utuu hin taʼin akka wal qixxummaan jiraatuuf.
english: For this is not that others may be eased and you distressed,

kikuyu: Akka wanti isaan irraa hafu hirʼina keessan guutuuf, yeroo ammaa wanti isin irraa hafu hirʼina isaanii ni guuta. Yoos wal qixxummaan ni jiraata;
english: but for equality. Your abundance at this present time supplies their lack, that their abundance also may become a supply for your lack, that there may be equality.

kikuyu: kunis akkuma, “Isa baayʼee walitti qabateef baayʼeen hin hafne; isa xinnoo walitti qabatettis wanni tokko iyyuu hin hirʼanne” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: As it is written, “He who gathered much had nothing left over, and he who gathered little had no lack.”

kikuyu: Waaqa yaaduma ani isiniif qabu garaa Tiitoo keessa kaaʼe sana nan galateeffadha.
english: But thanks be to God, who puts the same earnest care for you into the heart of Titus.

kikuyu: Tiitoon gorsa keenya fudhachuu qofaan utuu hin taʼin fedhii guddaan ofuma isaatiin kaʼee gara keessan dhufaa jiraatii.
english: For he indeed accepted our exhortation, but being himself very earnest, he went out to you of his own accord.

kikuyu: Nus obboleessa tajaajila wangeelaatiin waldoota kiristaanaa hundaan jajame sana isa wajjin ni ergina.
english: We have sent together with him the brother whose praise in the Good News is known throughout all the assemblies.

kikuyu: Kana malees inni hojii nu ulfina Gooftaatii fi fedhii gaarii qabnu mulʼisuuf hojjennu keessatti akka nu wajjin deemuuf waldoota kiristaanaatiin filatameera.
english: Not only so, but he was also appointed by the assemblies to travel with us in this grace, which is served by us to the glory of the Lord himself, and to show our readiness.

kikuyu: Nu kennaa arjummaa kana hojii irra oolchuu keessatti akka namni kam iyyuu maqaa nu hin balleessine of eegganna.
english: We are avoiding this, that any man should blame us concerning this abundance which is administered by us.

kikuyu: Nu utuu fuula Gooftaa qofa duratti hin taʼin fuula namootaa durattis waan qajeelaa hojjechuuf tattaaffanna.
english: Having regard for honorable things, not only in the sight of the Lord, but also in the sight of men.

kikuyu: Kana malees obboleessa keenya isa nu yeroo baayʼee waan hedduun qorree nama hisataa taʼuu isaa mirkaneeffanne sana isaan wajjin ergineerra; innis waan amantii guddaa isin irraa qabuuf kan duraa caalaa ni yaada.
english: We have sent with them our brother whom we have many times proved earnest in many things, but now much more earnest, by reason of the great confidence which he has in you.

kikuyu: Waaʼee Tiitoo irratti, inni garee koo kan na wajjin isin gidduu hojjetuu dha; waaʼee obboloota keenyaa immoo isaan bakka buʼoota waldoota kiristaanaatii fi ulfina Kiristoos.
english: As for Titus, he is my partner and fellow worker for you. As for our brothers, they are the apostles of the assemblies, the glory of Christ.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka waldoonni kiristaanaa arguu dandaʼaniif dhugaa jaalala keessaniitii fi sababii nu isiniin of jajnuuf namoota kanneenitti argisiisaa.
english: Therefore show the proof of your love to them before the assemblies, and of our boasting on your behalf.

kikuyu: Waaʼee tajaajila qulqullootaaf kennamu kanaa isinii barreessuu na hin barbaachisu.
english: It is indeed unnecessary for me to write to you concerning the service to the saints,

kikuyu: Ani akka isin gargaaruuf hinaaftan nan beekaatii; anis, “Warri Akaayaa bara darbee jalqabanii gargaarsa kennuuf qophaaʼaniiru” jedhee namoota Maqedooniyaa biratti of jajeen ture; fedhiin keessanis isaan keessaa namoota baayʼee hojiif kakaaseera.
english: for I know your readiness, of which I boast on your behalf to those of Macedonia, that Achaia has been prepared for the past year. Your zeal has stirred up very many of them.

kikuyu: Egaa ani akkuman “Isaan qophaaʼaniiru” jedhee dubbadhe sanatti, akka isin qophooftanii argamtaniif malee waaʼee kanaatiif isiniin of jajuun keenya waan akkasumaan dubbatame akka hin taane ani obboloota ergeera.
english: But I have sent the brothers so that our boasting on your behalf may not be in vain in this respect, that, just as I said, you may be prepared,

kikuyu: Yoo namoonni Maqedooniyaa kam iyyuu na wajjin dhufanii akka isin hin qophaaʼin argan, nu warri akkas isin amananne iyyuu waaʼee keessan waan jennu dhabnee ni qaanofna.
english: lest by any means, if anyone from Macedonia comes there with me and finds you unprepared, we (to say nothing of you) would be disappointed in this confident boasting.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka obboloonni kunneen duraan dursanii gara keessan dhufanii kennaa arjummaa kan isin waadaa galtan sana qopheessaniif isaan gorsuun barbaachisaa natti fakkaate. Yoos kennaan sun akka dirqamaatti utuu hin taʼin akka kennaa arjummaatti qopheeffama.
english: I thought it necessary therefore to entreat the brothers that they would go before to you and arrange ahead of time the generous gift that you promised before, that the same might be ready as a matter of generosity, and not of greediness.

kikuyu: Waan kana yaadadhaa: Namni harka isaa utuu hin guutin facaasu utuu harka isaa hin guutin galfata; namni harka isaa guutee facaasu immoo harka isaa guutee galfata.
english: Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon namaa utuu sassataan yookaan dirqamaan hin taʼin waan kennuuf garaa keessatti yaade haa kennu; Waaqni nama gammachuun kennu jaallataatii.
english: Let each man give according as he has determined in his heart, not grudgingly or under compulsion, for God loves a cheerful giver.

kikuyu: Isin yeroo hundumaa waan hundumaan waan isin barbaachisu hunda qabaattanii hojii gaarii hundumaan akka guutamtaniifis Waaqni ayyaana hunda isinii baayʼisuu ni dandaʼa.
english: And God is able to make all grace abound to you, that you, always having all sufficiency in everything, may abound to every good work.

kikuyu: Kunis akkuma, “Inni ni bittinneesse; hiyyeeyyiif ni kenne; qajeelummaan isaa bara baraan ni jiraata” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: As it is written, “He has scattered abroad. He has given to the poor. His righteousness remains forever.”

kikuyu: Inni namicha facaasuuf sanyii, kan nyaatuuf immoo buddeena kennu sun isinis akka facaafattaniif sanyii isinii kenna; isinii baayʼisas; ija qajeelummaa keessaniis ni baayʼisa.
english: Now may he who supplies seed to the sower and bread for food, supply and multiply your seed for sowing, and increase the fruits of your righteousness,

kikuyu: Isinis yeroo hunda akka arjoomtaniif karaa hundaan ni sooromfamtu; arjummaan keessanis karaa keenyaan Waaqaaf galata fida.
english: you being enriched in everything for all generosity, which produces thanksgiving to God through us.

kikuyu: Tajaajilli isin kennitan kun waan qulqullootaaf barbaachisu guutuu qofa utuu hin taʼin, akka galanni baayʼeen guutee Waaqaaf irra dhangalaʼu taasisa.
english: For this service of giving that you perform not only makes up for lack among the saints, but abounds also through much giving of thanks to God,

kikuyu: Sababii tajaajila isin ittiin of mirkaneessitan sanaatiin, wangeela Kiristoos lallabuun ajajamuu keessanii fi arjummaan keessan kan isin isaanii fi warra kaan hundaaf arjoomtan sanaaf namoonni Waaqa jajatu.
english: seeing that through the proof given by this service, they glorify God for the obedience of your confession to the Good News of Christ and for the generosity of your contribution to them and to all,

kikuyu: Isaanis kadhannaa isiniif kadhatan keessatti sababii ayyaana guddaa kan Waaqni isinii kenne sanaatiif isin yaadu.
english: while they themselves also, with supplication on your behalf, yearn for you by reason of the exceeding grace of God in you.

kikuyu: Kennaa isaa kan ibsamuu hin dandeenye sanaaf galanni Waaqaaf haa taʼu!
english: Now thanks be to God for his unspeakable gift!

kikuyu: Ani Phaawulos kan yeroon isin bira jiru “Ija laafessa” yeroon isin irraa fagaadhu immoo “Ija jabeessa” taʼe garraamummaa fi gara laafina Kiristoosiin isinan kadhadha!
english: Now I Paul, myself, entreat you by the humility and gentleness of Christ, I who in your presence am lowly among you, but being absent am bold toward you.

kikuyu: Ani yeroon gara keessan dhufutti akka isin ija jabina ani warra waan nu akka yaada fooniitti jiraannu seʼan sana irratti nan qabaadha jedhee yaadu sana qabaadhu akka isin na hin goone isin kadhadha.
english: Yes, I beg you that I may not, when present, show courage with the confidence with which I intend to be bold against some, who consider us to be walking according to the flesh.

kikuyu: Nu yoo fooniin jiraanne iyyuu akka yaada fooniitti hin lollu.
english: For though we walk in the flesh, we don’t wage war according to the flesh;

kikuyu: Miʼi waraanaa kan nu ittiin lollu kan daʼannoo jigsuudhaaf humna Waaqaa qabuudha malee miʼa waraana foonii miti.
english: for the weapons of our warfare are not of the flesh, but mighty before God to the throwing down of strongholds,

kikuyu: Mormii fi of tuulummaa beekumsa Waaqaa irratti kaʼu hunda ni diigna; yaada hundas boojinee Kiristoosiif akka ajajamu ni goona.
english: throwing down imaginations and every high thing that is exalted against the knowledge of God and bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ,

kikuyu: Yommuu isin guutummaatti ajajamuu keessan raawwattanitti, nu immoo ajajamuu diduu hunda haaloo baʼuuf ni qophoofna.
english: and being in readiness to avenge all disobedience when your obedience is made full.

kikuyu: Isin waanuma isinitti mulʼatu qofa ilaaltu. Eenyu iyyuu yoo kan Kiristoos taʼuu isaatti amane akkuma inni kan Kiristoos taʼe, nus kan Kiristoos taʼuu keenya haa hubatu.
english: Do you look at things only as they appear in front of your face? If anyone trusts in himself that he is Christ’s, let him consider this again with himself, that even as he is Christ’s, so we also are Christ’s.

kikuyu: Ani taayitaa keenya kan Gooftaan akka ittiin isin diignuuf utuu hin taʼin akka ittiin isin ijaarruuf nuu kenne sanaan caalaatti yoon boone iyyuu itti hin qaanaʼu.
english: For even if I boast somewhat abundantly concerning our authority, which the Lord gave for building you up and not for casting you down, I will not be ashamed,

kikuyu: Ani waanan ergaa kootiin isin sodaachisuu yaalu fakkaachuu hin barbaadu.
english: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.

kikuyu: Namoonni tokko tokko, “Ergaan isaa ulfaataa fi cimaa dha; inni yeroo qaamaan argamutti garuu dadhabaa dha; dubbiin isaas tuffatamaa dha” jedhu.
english: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”

kikuyu: Warri akkasii akka wanni nu fagoo jiraannee barreessinuu fi wanni nu yeroo isaan wajjin jirrutti hojjennu tokkuma taʼe haa hubatan.
english: Let such a person consider this, that what we are in word by letters when we are absent, such are we also in deed when we are present.

kikuyu: Nu warra of saadan tokko tokkotti of ramaduuf yookaan isaaniin of qixxeessuuf ija hin jabaannu. Isaan yeroo walii isaaniitti of madaalanii fi walii isaaniitti of qixxeessan hin hubatan.
english: For we are not bold to number or compare ourselves with some of those who commend themselves. But they themselves, measuring themselves by themselves, and comparing themselves with themselves, are without understanding.

kikuyu: Nu garuu hamma daangaa Waaqni nuu ramade kan isin bira gaʼuutti malee dandeettii keenyaa olitti of hin jajnu.
english: But we will not boast beyond proper limits, but within the boundaries with which God appointed to us, which reach even to you.

kikuyu: Nu waan wangeela Kiristoos lallabaa gara keessan dhufneef, akka waan isin bira hin gaʼiniitti baayʼee hin hiixannuutii.
english: For we don’t stretch ourselves too much, as though we didn’t reach to you. For we came even as far as to you with the Good News of Christ,

kikuyu: Nu hojii warra kaaniin hojjetameen baayʼee of hin jajnu. Akkuma amantiin keessan guddachaa deemuun akka iddoon hojii keenyaa kan isin gidduutti argamu akka malee babalʼatu ni abdanna;
english: not boasting beyond proper limits in other men’s labors, but having hope that as your faith grows, we will be abundantly enlarged by you in our sphere of influence,

kikuyu: kunis akka nu hojii duraan dursee biyya nama biraa keessatti hojjetameen utuu of hin jajin biyyoota isinii achi jiran keessatti wangeela lallabuu dandeenyuuf.
english: so as to preach the Good News even to the parts beyond you, not to boast in what someone else has already done.

kikuyu: Garuu, “Namni boonu Gooftaadhaan haa boonu.”
english: But “he who boasts, let him boast in the Lord.”

kikuyu: Nama Gooftaan galateessutu fudhatama argata malee namni of galateessu fudhatama hin argatuutii.
english: For it isn’t he who commends himself who is approved, but whom the Lord commends.

kikuyu: Ani gowwummaa koo ishee xinnoo naa obsitu jedheen abdadha; duraanuu naa obsitaniirtu.
english: I wish that you would bear with me in a little foolishness, but indeed you do bear with me.

kikuyu: Ani hinaaffaa Waaqaatiin isiniif nan hinaafa. Ani akka durba tokkootti fuula isaa duratti isin dhiʼeessuuf dhirsa tokko jechuunis Kiristoosiif isin kaadhimeeraatii.
english: For I am jealous over you with a godly jealousy. For I promised you in marriage to one husband, that I might present you as a pure virgin to Christ.

kikuyu: Garuu akkuma bofti haxxummaa isaatiin Hewaanin gowwoomse sana yaadni keessanis akkasuma dhugaa fi qulqullina ittiin Kiristoosiif of kennitan sana irraa ni dogoggorfama jedheen sodaadha.
english: But I am afraid that somehow, as the serpent deceived Eve in his craftiness, so your minds might be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.

kikuyu: Namni tokko gara keessan dhufee yoo Yesuus nu isinii lallabne malee Yesuus kan biraa isinii lallabe, yookaan Hafuura nu isinii lallabne malee hafuura kan biraa yoo fudhattan, yookaan wangeela nu isinii lallabne malee wangeela kan biraa yoo fudhattan ni obsitu.
english: For if he who comes preaches another Jesus whom we didn’t preach, or if you receive a different spirit which you didn’t receive, or a different “good news” which you didn’t accept, you put up with that well enough.

kikuyu: Ani, “Ergamoota hangafoota” sanaa gaditti of hin ilaalu.
english: For I reckon that I am not at all behind the very best apostles.

kikuyu: Ani dubbiitti leenjii hin qabu; garuu beekumsa qaba. Kanas karaa hundaan sirriitti isinii ibsineerra.
english: But though I am unskilled in speech, yet I am not unskilled in knowledge. No, in every way we have been revealed to you in all things.

kikuyu: Wangeela Waaqaa gatii malee isinitti lallabuudhaan akka isin ol ol jettaniif ani gad of qabuun koo cubbuu turee?
english: Or did I commit a sin in humbling myself that you might be exalted, because I preached to you God’s Good News free of charge?

kikuyu: Ani isin tajaajiluuf jedhee gargaarsa isaan irraa fudhachuudhaan waldoota kiristaanaa kaan saameera.
english: I robbed other assemblies, taking wages from them that I might serve you.

kikuyu: Ani yeroon isin bira turee fi yeroo waa na barbaachisetti eenyutti illee baʼaa hin taane; obboloonni Maqedooniyaa irraa dhufan waan na barbaachisuun na gargaaraa turaniitii. Anis waanuma tokkoon illee akka baʼaa isinitti hin taaneef of eeggachaan ture; amma illee ittuma fufee ofin eeggadha.
english: When I was present with you and was in need, I wasn’t a burden on anyone, for the brothers, when they came from Macedonia, supplied the measure of my need. In everything I kept myself from being burdensome to you, and I will continue to do so.

kikuyu: Hamma dhugaan Kiristoos na keessa jirutti boonuu koo kana kutaalee biyya Akaayaa keessatti eenyu iyyuu na dhowwuu hin dandaʼu.
english: As the truth of Christ is in me, no one will stop me from this boasting in the regions of Achaia.

kikuyu: Maaliif? Ani waan isin hin jaallanneef moo? Isin jaallachuu koo Waaqni ni beeka!
english: Why? Because I don’t love you? God knows.

kikuyu: Warra waan ittiin boonaniin nuun qixxaachuuf jedhanii carraa barbaaddatan carraa dhowwachuuf ani waanan amma hojjedhu ittuma fufee nan hojjedha.
english: But what I do, that I will continue to do, that I may cut off opportunity from those who desire an opportunity, that in which they boast, they may be recognized just like us.

kikuyu: Namoonni akkanaa ergamoota sobaa, hojjettoota nama gowwoomsan, warra ergamoota Kiristoos fakkaachuuf of geeddaranii dha.
english: For such men are false apostles, deceitful workers, masquerading as Christ’s apostles.

kikuyu: Seexanni mataan isaa ergamaa ifaa fakkaachuuf waan of geeddaruuf kun nama hin dinqu.
english: And no wonder, for even Satan masquerades as an angel of light.

kikuyu: Egaa tajaajiltoonni isaas yoo tajaajiltoota qajeelummaa fakkaachuuf of geeddaran kun waan nama dinqu miti. Dhumni isaaniis akkuma hojii isaanii taʼa.
english: It is no great thing therefore if his servants also masquerade as servants of righteousness, whose end will be according to their works.

kikuyu: Ani ammas irra deebiʼee nan dubbadha: Namni tokko iyyuu gowwaa na hin seʼin. Isin yoo gowwaa na seetan ani xinnoo akkan boonuuf akkuma gowwaa tokkootti na fudhadhaa.
english: I say again, let no one think me foolish. But if so, yet receive me as foolish, that I also may boast a little.

kikuyu: Ani of amanadhee boonuu kana keessatti akka gowwaa tokkoottin dubbadha malee akka Gooftaan dubbatutti hin dubbadhu.
english: That which I speak, I don’t speak according to the Lord, but as in foolishness, in this confidence of boasting.

kikuyu: Waan namoonni hedduun akkuma yaada fooniitti boonaniif, anis nan boona.
english: Seeing that many boast after the flesh, I will also boast.

kikuyu: Isin ogeeyyii waan taataniif gammachuudhaan gowwootaaf obsitu!
english: For you bear with the foolish gladly, being wise.

kikuyu: Yoo eenyu iyyuu isin garboomfate yookaan yoo isin irraa nyaate yookaan yoo faayidaa ofiitiif isinitti fayyadame yookaan yoo koore yookaan yoo isin kabale ni obsituutii.
english: For you bear with a man if he brings you into bondage, if he devours you, if he takes you captive, if he exalts himself, or if he strikes you on the face.

kikuyu: Akka nu waan akkasii irratti dadhaboo turre ani qaanaʼaa nan dubbadha. Ani akka gowwaa tokkoottin dubbadha; waan namni kam iyyuu ittiin of jajuu fi ija jabaatu sana anis ittiin of jajuuf ija nan jabaa dha.
english: To my shame, I speak as though we had been weak. Yet in whatever way anyone is bold (I speak in foolishness), I am bold also.

kikuyu: Isaan Ibrootaa? Anis akkasuma. Isaan Israaʼelootaa? Anis akkasuma. Isaan sanyii Abrahaamii? Anis akkasuma.
english: Are they Hebrews? So am I. Are they Israelites? So am I. Are they the offspring of Abraham? So am I.

kikuyu: Isaan tajaajiltoota Kiristoosii? Ani akka nama qalbii dabarseettin dubbadhaatii ani nan caala. Ani caalchisee baayʼee itti dadhabeera; caalchisee yeroo baayʼee hidhameera; caalchisee akka malee garafameera; ammumaa ammas duʼaaf saaxilameera.
english: Are they servants of Christ? (I speak as one beside himself.) I am more so: in labors more abundantly, in prisons more abundantly, in stripes above measure, and in deaths often.

kikuyu: Harka Yihuudootaattis siʼa shan afurtama jechuu tokko hanquu garafameera.
english: Five times I received forty stripes minus one from the Jews.

kikuyu: Siʼa sadii uleen dhaanameera; siʼa tokko dhagaadhaan tumameera; siʼa sadii dooniin na jalaa caccabeera; halkan tokkoo fi guyyaa tokko galaana keessa tureera;
english: Three times I was beaten with rods. Once I was stoned. Three times I suffered shipwreck. I have been a night and a day in the deep.

kikuyu: ani utuun wal irraa hin kutin deemsa irra ture. Balaan lagaa, balaan saamtotaa, balaan saba kootii, balaan Namoota Ormaa, magaalaa keessatti balaan, gammoojjii keessatti balaan, galaana irratti balaan, obboloota sobaa irraas balaan na mudatee ture.
english: I have been in travels often, perils of rivers, perils of robbers, perils from my countrymen, perils from the Gentiles, perils in the city, perils in the wilderness, perils in the sea, perils among false brothers;

kikuyu: Ani baayʼee hojjedhee bututeera; halkan baayʼee hirriba dhabeera; beelaʼeera; dheebodheera; yeroo baayʼee soomeera; dhaamodheera; daareeras.
english: in labor and travail, in watchings often, in hunger and thirst, in fastings often, and in cold and nakedness.

kikuyu: Kana hundumaa caalaa yaaddoo ani waldoota kiristaanaa hundumaaf qabutu guyyaa guyyaan natti ulfaata.
english: Besides those things that are outside, there is that which presses on me daily: anxiety for all the assemblies.

kikuyu: Eenyutu dadhabaa dha? Ani hin dadhabuu ree? Eenyutu hin gufanne? Ani aaree hin gubadhuu ree?
english: Who is weak, and I am not weak? Who is caused to stumble, and I don’t burn with indignation?

kikuyu: Ani yoon of jajuu qabaadhe waan dadhabbii koo mulʼisuun of nan jaja.
english: If I must boast, I will boast of the things that concern my weakness.

kikuyu: Waaqaa fi Abbaan Gooftaa Yesuus inni bara baraan eebbifamu sun akka ani hin sobne ni beeka.
english: The God and Father of the Lord Jesus Christ, he who is blessed forever more, knows that I don’t lie.

kikuyu: Damaasqoo keessatti namichi mooticha Areexaas jalatti bulchaa biyyaa ture na qabsiisuuf jedhee magaalaa namoota Damaasqoo eegsisaa ture.
english: In Damascus the governor under King Aretas guarded the Damascenes’ city, desiring to arrest me.

kikuyu: Ani garuu foddaa dallaa keessaan guuboodhaan gad buufamee harka isaa jalaa baʼe.
english: I was let down in a basket through a window by the wall, and escaped his hands.

kikuyu: Yoo buʼaa qabaachuu baate iyyuu ani nan boona. Ani gara waan Gooftaan na argisiiseetii fi mulʼata isa biraa dhufeetti nan qajeela.
english: It is doubtless not profitable for me to boast, but I will come to visions and revelations of the Lord.

kikuyu: Namichi Kiristoositti jiru tokko waggaa kudha afur dura gara samii sadaffaatti ol fudhatamuu isaa nan beeka. Innis dhagna fooniitiin taʼuu fi taʼuu baachuu isaa Waaqatu beeka malee ani hin beeku.
english: I know a man in Christ who was caught up into the third heaven fourteen years ago—whether in the body, I don’t know, or whether out of the body, I don’t know; God knows.

kikuyu: Ani nama akkanaa nan beeka; dhagna fooniitiin taʼuu fi taʼuu baachuu isaa ani hin beeku; Waaqatu beeka;
english: I know such a man (whether in the body, or outside of the body, I don’t know; God knows),

kikuyu: innis gara jannataatti ol fudhatamee waan hin dubbatamne kan akka namni himuuf hin eeyyamamne dhagaʼe.
english: how he was caught up into Paradise and heard unspeakable words, which it is not lawful for a man to utter.

kikuyu: Ani waaʼee nama akkasiitiif nan boona; garuu waaʼee dadhabbii kootii malee waaʼee ofii kootii hin boonu.
english: On behalf of such a one I will boast, but on my own behalf I will not boast, except in my weaknesses.

kikuyu: Ani waanan dhugaa dubbachaa jiruuf yoon boonuu filadhe iyyuu hin gowwoomu. Garuu namni tokko iyyuu waan narratti arguu fi waan narraa dhagaʼu caalaa akka waaʼee koo hin yaadneef ani waan akkasii irraa ofin qusadha;
english: For if I would desire to boast, I will not be foolish; for I will speak the truth. But I refrain, so that no man may think more of me than that which he sees in me or hears from me.

kikuyu: akka ani mulʼata akka malee guddaa kanaan of hin tuulleef qoraattiin foon koo waraanu tokko, ergamaan Seexanaa akka na dhiphisuuf naa kenname.
english: By reason of the exceeding greatness of the revelations, that I should not be exalted excessively, a thorn in the flesh was given to me: a messenger of Satan to torment me, that I should not be exalted excessively.

kikuyu: Wanni kun akka narraa fagaatuuf siʼa sadii Gooftaa nan kadhadhe.
english: Concerning this thing, I begged the Lord three times that it might depart from me.

kikuyu: Inni garuu, “Ayyaanni koo si gaʼa; humni koo dadhabbii keessatti guutuu taʼaatii” naan jedhe. Kanaafuu humni Kiristoos akka narra boqotuuf waaʼee dadhabbii kootii caalchisee gammaduudhaan akka malee nan boona.
english: He has said to me, “My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness.” Most gladly therefore I will rather glory in my weaknesses, that the power of Christ may rest on me.

kikuyu: Ani waaʼee Kiristoosiif jedhee dadhabbii keessatti, arrabsoo keessatti, gidiraa keessatti, ariʼatama keessatti, rakkina keessattis gammaduun koo kanumaaf. Yoos ani yeroon dadhabutti nan jabaadhaatii.
english: Therefore I take pleasure in weaknesses, in injuries, in necessities, in persecutions, and in distresses, for Christ’s sake. For when I am weak, then am I strong.

kikuyu: Ani of gowwoomseera; waan kanatti garuu isinitu na dhiibe. Ani yoon waanuma tokkotti illee hedamuu baadhe, waan “Ergamoota hangafoota” sanaa gad hin taaneef silaa isin naa dubbachuu qabdu turtan.
english: I have become foolish in boasting. You compelled me, for I ought to have been commended by you, for I am in no way inferior to the very best apostles, though I am nothing.

kikuyu: Mallattoowwan ergamaa dhugaa tokko jechuunis mallattoon, hojiin dinqiitii fi raajiin isin gidduutti obsa guddaadhaan hojjetamaniiru.
english: Truly the signs of an apostle were worked among you in all perseverance, in signs and wonders and mighty works.

kikuyu: Ani utuu baʼaa isinitti hin taʼin hafuu kootiin alatti wanti isin ittiin waldoota kiristaanaa kaanii gad taatan maali? Yakka kana naa dhiisaa!
english: For what is there in which you were made inferior to the rest of the assemblies, unless it is that I myself was not a burden to you? Forgive me this wrong!

kikuyu: Ani siʼa sadaffaaf gara keessan dhufuuf qophaaʼeera; ani isinuma malee qabeenya keessan waan hin barbaanneef baʼaa isinitti hin taʼu. Warratu ijoollee isaaniitiif qabeenya kuusuu qaba malee ijoolleen warra isaaniitiif kuusuu hin qaban.
english: Behold, this is the third time I am ready to come to you, and I will not be a burden to you; for I seek not your possessions, but you. For the children ought not to save up for the parents, but the parents for the children.

kikuyu: Ani waanan qabu hunda gammachuun isiniif nan kenna; ofii koo illee isiniif nan kenna. Sababii ani baayʼisee isin jaalladhuuf isin immoo xinneessitanii na jaallattuu ree?
english: I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?

kikuyu: Haa taʼuu malee ani baʼaa isinitti hin taane. Ani garuu waanan abshaala taʼeef malaan isin qabadhe.
english: Even so, I myself didn’t burden you. But you might say that being crafty, I caught you with deception.

kikuyu: Ani namoota isinitti erge keessaa karaa isa tokkootiin illee waa isin irraa nyaadheeraa?
english: Did I take advantage of you by anyone of those whom I have sent to you?

kikuyu: Ani akka Tiitoon gara keessan dhufuuf isa kadhadhe; obboleessa tokkos isa wajjin ergeera. Tiitoon waa isin irraa nyaateeraa? Nu hafuura tokkoon, karuma tokko irra deddeebiʼaa hin turree?
english: I exhorted Titus, and I sent the brother with him. Did Titus take any advantage of you? Didn’t we walk in the same spirit? Didn’t we walk in the same steps?

kikuyu: Isin waan nu hamma ammaatti fuula keessan duratti ofii keenyaaf falmannu seetanii? Nu akka warra Kiristoositti jiraataniitti fuula Waaqaa duratti dubbanna; yaa michoota, waan kana hunda hojjechuun keenya isinuma jajjabeessuuf.
english: Again, do you think that we are excusing ourselves to you? In the sight of God we speak in Christ. But all things, beloved, are for your edifying.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani gara keessan dhufutti isin akka ani fedhu taatanii hin argamtan taʼa. Yookaan ani akka isin feetan taʼee hin argamu taʼa jedheen sodaadhaatii. Wal loluun, hinaaffaan, aariin bobaʼuun, wal qooduun, maqaa nama balleessuun, hamiin, of tuulummaanii fi jeequmsi isin gidduu jiraata jedheen sodaadha.
english: For I am afraid that perhaps when I come, I might find you not the way I want to, and that I might be found by you as you don’t desire, that perhaps there would be strife, jealousy, outbursts of anger, factions, slander, whisperings, proud thoughts, or riots,

kikuyu: Yeroo ani deebiʼee gara keessan dhufutti Waaqni koo fuula keessan duratti gad na deebisa; anis waaʼee namoota baayʼee kanneen kanaan dura cubbuu hojjetanii fi xuraaʼummaa irraa, halalummaa fi jireenya gad dhiisii hamaa irraa hin deebiʼiniif nan gadda jedheen sodaadha.
english: that again when I come my God would humble me before you, and I would mourn for many of those who have sinned before now, and not repented of the uncleanness, sexual immorality, and lustfulness which they committed.

kikuyu: Ani kanaan walitti siʼa sadaffaa gara keessan dhufuu koo ti. “Dubbiin hundinuu dhuga baatota lamaan yookaan sadiin mirkaneeffamuu qaba.”
english: This is the third time I am coming to you. “At the mouth of two or three witnesses shall every word be established.”

kikuyu: Ani duraanuu yommuun siʼa lammaffaa isin bira turetti isin akeekkachiiseera. Amma illee fagoo taaʼee isuma irra nan deebiʼa; ani yeroon deebiʼee dhufutti warra kanaan dura cubbuu hojjetaniifis taʼu warra kaan hundaaf garaa hin laafu;
english: I have warned previously, and I warn again, as when I was present the second time, so now, being absent, I write to those who have sinned before now and to all the rest that if I come again, I will not spare,

kikuyu: kunis isin akka Kiristoos karaa kootiin dubbatu ragaa waan barbaaddaniif. Inni isin gidduutti cimaadha malee waaʼee keessan irratti dadhabaa miti.
english: seeing that you seek a proof of Christ who speaks in me who is not weak, but is powerful in you.

kikuyu: Inni dadhabbiidhaan fannifamu iyyuu, humna Waaqaatiin garuu ni jiraata. Nus akkasuma isatti dadhabdoota; taʼus isin tajaajiluuf humna Waaqaatiin isa wajjin ni jiraanna.
english: For he was crucified through weakness, yet he lives through the power of God. For we also are weak in him, but we will live with him through the power of God toward you.

kikuyu: Isin amantiidhaan jiraachuu fi jiraachuu baachuu keessan beekuuf of qoraa; of ilaalaas. Dhugumaan isin yoo qormaaticha kuftan malee akka Yesuus Kiristoos isin keessa jiru hin beektanii?
english: Examine your own selves, whether you are in the faith. Test your own selves. Or don’t you know about your own selves, that Jesus Christ is in you?—unless indeed you are disqualified.

kikuyu: Anis akka nu qormaaticha hin kufin isin akka hubattan nan amana.
english: But I hope that you will know that we aren’t disqualified.

kikuyu: Nu ammas akka isin waan hamaa tokko illee hin hojjenneef Waaqa kadhanna. Kunis nu yoo waan qormaata kufne fakkaanne illee akka isin waan qajeelaa hojjettaniif malee akka namoonni qormaaticha keessatti cimnee dhaabachuu keenya arganiif miti.
english: Now I pray to God that you do no evil; not that we may appear approved, but that you may do that which is honorable, though we may seem to have failed.

kikuyu: Nu dhugaaf hojjenna malee, dhugaa mormuudhaan homaa hojjechuu hin dandeenyuutii.
english: For we can do nothing against the truth, but for the truth.

kikuyu: Yommuu nu dadhabnee isin immoo jabaattanitti ni gammanna; kadhannaan keenyas akka isin warra hirʼina hin qabne taataniif.
english: For we rejoice when we are weak and you are strong. We also pray for this: your becoming perfect.

kikuyu: Wanni ani yeroo fagoo jirutti barreessuuf kanaa dha; kunis akka ani yeroon gara keessan dhufutti taayitaa Gooftaan akka ani ittiin isin diiguuf utuu hin taʼin, akka ani ittiin isin ijaaruuf naa kennetti fayyadamee isinitti hin jabaanneef.
english: For this cause I write these things while absent, that I may not deal sharply when present, according to the authority which the Lord gave me for building up and not for tearing down.

kikuyu: Egaa yaa obboloota nagaatti. Haaromfamaa; wal jajjabeessaa; yaada tokko qabaadhaa; nagaadhaan jiraadhaa. Waaqni jaalalaatii fi nagaa isin wajjin ni taʼa.
english: Finally, brothers, rejoice! Be perfected. Be comforted. Be of the same mind. Live in peace, and the God of love and peace will be with you.

kikuyu: Dhungoo qulqulluudhaan nagaa wal gaafadhaa.
english: Greet one another with a holy kiss.

kikuyu: Sabni Waaqaa hundinuu nagaa isinii dhaamu.
english: All the saints greet you.

kikuyu: Ayyaanni Gooftaa Yesuus Kiristoos, jaalalli Waaqaa, tokkummaan Hafuura Qulqulluus hunda keessan wajjin haa taʼu.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, God’s love, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Phaawulos ergamticha isa utuu namoota biraa yookaan namaan hin taʼin garuu Yesuus Kiristoosii fi Waaqa Abbaa isa Yesuusin warra duʼan keessaa kaaseen ergamee fi
english: Paul, an apostle—not from men, nor through man, but through Jesus Christ, and God the Father, who raised him from the dead—

kikuyu: obboloota na wajjin jiran hundumaa irraa,
english: and all the brothers who are with me, to the assemblies of Galatia:

kikuyu: Abbaa keenya Waaqaa fi Yesuus Kiristoos Gooftaa irraa ayyaannii fi nagaan isiniif haa taʼu;
english: Grace to you and peace from God the Father and our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: inni akka fedhii Abbaa keenyaa fi Waaqa keenyaatti bara hamaa kana jalaa nu oolchuuf jedhee cubbuu keenyaaf of kenne;
english: who gave himself for our sins, that he might deliver us out of this present evil age, according to the will of our God and Father—

kikuyu: ulfinni bara baraa hamma bara baraatti isaaf haa taʼu. Ameen.
english: to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Akkana ariifattanii isa karaa ayyaana Kiristoosiin isin waame sana dhiisuudhaan wangeela biraa duukaa buʼuun keessan baayʼee na dinqeera;
english: I marvel that you are so quickly deserting him who called you in the grace of Christ to a different “good news”,

kikuyu: wangeelli biraa illee hin jiru. Garuu namoonni isin dogoggorsanii wangeela Kiristoos jalʼisuu yaalan tokko tokko jiru.
english: but there isn’t another “good news.” Only there are some who trouble you and want to pervert the Good News of Christ.

kikuyu: Nus taanaan yookaan yoo ergamaan Waaqaa samii irraa dhufe tokko wangeela nu kanaan dura isinitti lallabne sana irraa adda taʼe isinitti lallabe, inni bara baraan haa abaaramu!
english: But even though we, or an angel from heaven, should preach to you any “good news” other than that which we preached to you, let him be cursed.

kikuyu: Akkuma nu kanaan dura jenne ani ammas irra deebiʼee nan dubbadha; yoo eenyu iyyuu wangeela isin kanaan dura fudhattan sana irraa adda taʼe isinitti lallabe inni abaaramaa haa taʼu!
english: As we have said before, so I now say again: if any man preaches to you any “good news” other than that which you received, let him be cursed.

kikuyu: Ani amma nama biratti moo Waaqa biratti fudhatama argachuu yaalaan jira? Yookaan nama gammachiisuu nan yaalaa? Ani utuun hamma ammaatti nama gammachiisuu yaalee silaa tajaajilaa Kiristoos hin taʼu ture.
english: For am I now seeking the favor of men, or of God? Or am I striving to please men? For if I were still pleasing men, I wouldn’t be a servant of Christ.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, wangeelli ani lallabe sun nama irraa akka hin dhufin isin akka beektan nan barbaada.
english: But I make known to you, brothers, concerning the Good News which was preached by me, that it is not according to man.

kikuyu: Ani wangeelicha mulʼataan Yesuus Kiristoos irraa fudhadhe malee nama tokko irraa illee hin fudhanne; yookaan namni na hin barsiifne.
english: For I didn’t receive it from man, nor was I taught it, but it came to me through revelation of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Akka ani yeroon amantii Yihuudootaa duukaa buʼaa turetti waldaa kiristaanaa Waaqaa akka malee ariʼachaa fi balleessuufis yaalaa ture dhageessaniirtu.
english: For you have heard of my way of living in time past in the Jews’ religion, how that beyond measure I persecuted the assembly of God and ravaged it.

kikuyu: Ani amantii Yihuudootaatiin warra saba koo keessaa hiriyoota koo taʼan baayʼee nan caala ture; duudhaa abbootii kootiifis akka malee nan hinaafa ture.
english: I advanced in the Jews’ religion beyond many of my own age among my countrymen, being more exceedingly zealous for the traditions of my fathers.

kikuyu: Garuu yommuu Waaqni gadameessa haadha kootii jalqabee na filatee fi ayyaana isaatiin na waame sun,
english: But when it was the good pleasure of God, who separated me from my mother’s womb and called me through his grace,

kikuyu: akka ani Namoota Ormaa gidduutti waaʼee Ilma isaa lallabuuf isa natti mulʼisuu jaallatetti ani nama tokkoon iyyuu hin mariʼanne.
english: to reveal his Son in me, that I might preach him among the Gentiles, I didn’t immediately confer with flesh and blood,

kikuyu: Ani warra anaan dura ergamoota turan arguuf Yerusaalemitti ol hin baane; garuu yeruma sana biyya Arabaan dhaqe. Ergasiis Damaasqoottin deebiʼe.
english: nor did I go up to Jerusalem to those who were apostles before me, but I went away into Arabia. Then I returned to Damascus.

kikuyu: Ergasiis anis waggaa sadii booddee Keefaan wal baruuf jedhee Yerusaalemitti ol baʼe; guyyaa kudha shanis isa biran ture.
english: Then after three years I went up to Jerusalem to visit Peter, and stayed with him fifteen days.

kikuyu: Ani garuu Yaaqoob obboleessa Gooftaa malee ergamoota kaan keessaa tokko illee hin argine.
english: But of the other apostles I saw no one except James, the Lord’s brother.

kikuyu: Wanti ani isinii barreessu akka soba hin taʼin kunoo fuula Waaqaa duratti isiniifin mirkaneessa.
english: Now about the things which I write to you, behold, before God, I’m not lying.

kikuyu: Ergasiis ani gara Sooriyaa fi biyya Kiilqiyaan dhaqe.
english: Then I came to the regions of Syria and Cilicia.

kikuyu: Waldoonni Kiristaanaa Yihuudaa kanneen Kiristoositti jiranis fuula koo arganii hin beekan.
english: I was still unknown by face to the assemblies of Judea which were in Christ,

kikuyu: Isaanis oduu, “Namichi duraan nu ariʼachaa ture sun amma immoo amantiidhuma dur balleessuuf yaalaa ture sana lallabaa jira” jedhu qofa dhagaʼan.
english: but they only heard, “He who once persecuted us now preaches the faith that he once tried to destroy.”

kikuyu: Isaanis sababii kootiif Waaqaaf ulfina kennan.
english: So they glorified God in me.

kikuyu: Ani waggaa kudha afur booddee deebiʼee Yerusaalemitti ol baʼe; ani yeroo kana Barnaabaas wajjinin ture. Tiitoo illee of duukaa fudhadhee dhaqe.
english: Then after a period of fourteen years I went up again to Jerusalem with Barnabas, taking Titus also with me.

kikuyu: Ani mulʼataanin ol baʼe; wangeela Namoota Ormaa gidduutti lallabus isaaniif nan ibse. Kanas akka fiigichi koo kan duraa, kan ammaas akkasumaan hin hafne waan sodaadheef kophaatti warra dura buʼoota fakkaatanittin hime.
english: I went up by revelation, and I laid before them the Good News which I preach among the Gentiles, but privately before those who were respected, for fear that I might be running, or had run, in vain.

kikuyu: Garuu Tiitoon inni ana wajjin ture iyyuu utuma nama Giriik taʼee jiruu akka dhagna qabatu hin dirqisiifamne.
english: But not even Titus, who was with me, being a Greek, was compelled to be circumcised.

kikuyu: Kunis sababii obboloota sobaa tokko tokko bilisummaa nu karaa Kiristoos Yesuusiin arganne basaasuu fi nu garboomfachuuf dhokatanii nu gidduu galaniif taʼe.
english: This was because of the false brothers secretly brought in, who stole in to spy out our liberty which we have in Christ Jesus, that they might bring us into bondage,

kikuyu: Nus akka dhugaan wangeelaa isin bira jiraatuuf jennee battala tokkoof illee isaaniif hin ajajamne.
english: to whom we gave no place in the way of subjection, not for an hour, that the truth of the Good News might continue with you.

kikuyu: Waaʼeen warra gurguddaa fakkaatan sanaa yoo isaan waanuma fedhan taʼan iyyuu anaaf homaa miti; Waaqni fuula namaa ilaalee nama wal hin caalchisu; namoonni kunneen ergaa koo irratti waan tokko hin daballe.
english: But from those who were reputed to be important—whatever they were, it makes no difference to me; God doesn’t show partiality to man—they, I say, who were respected imparted nothing to me,

kikuyu: Karaa kaaniin immoo isaan akkuma Phexros warra dhagna qabatanitti wangeela lallabuuf imaanaan itti kenname sana, anis akka warra dhagna hin qabannetti wangeela lallabuuf imaanaan natti kenname argan.
english: but to the contrary, when they saw that I had been entrusted with the Good News for the uncircumcised, even as Peter with the Good News for the circumcised—

kikuyu: Waaqni akka Phexros ergamaa taʼee warra dhagna qabatan tajaajilu hojjete sun akka anis ergamaa taʼee Namoota Ormaa tajaajilu hojjeteeraatii.
english: for he who worked through Peter in the apostleship with the circumcised also worked through me with the Gentiles—

kikuyu: Yaaqoob, Keefaa fi Yohannis warri akka “Utubaatti” ilaalaman sun yommuu ayyaana naa kenname hubatanitti anaa fi Barnaabaasiif harka mirgaa kan tokkummaa kennanii akka nu gara Namoota Ormaa deemnu, isaan immoo akka gara warra dhagna qabatanii dhaqan walii galan.
english: and when they perceived the grace that was given to me, James and Cephas and John, those who were reputed to be pillars, gave to Barnabas and me the right hand of fellowship, that we should go to the Gentiles, and they to the circumcision.

kikuyu: Wanni isaan nu kadhatanis akka nu hiyyeeyyii yaadannu qofa ture; kun immoo waanuma ani gochuuf hawwaa turee dha.
english: They only asked us to remember the poor—which very thing I was also zealous to do.

kikuyu: Keefaan waan dogoggoree tureef yeroo inni Anxookiiyaa dhufetti ani ifaan ifattin isaan morme.
english: But when Peter came to Antioch, I resisted him to his face, because he stood condemned.

kikuyu: Utuu jarri tokko Yaaqoob biraa hin dhufin dura inni Namoota Ormaa wajjin nyaachaa ture. Yommuu isaan achi gaʼanitti garuu waan garee warra dhagna qabatanii sodaateef dugda duubatti deebiʼee Namoota Ormaa irraa gargar baʼe.
english: For before some people came from James, he ate with the Gentiles. But when they came, he drew back and separated himself, fearing those who were of the circumcision.

kikuyu: Yihuudoonni kaanis itti fakkeessummaa isaa duukaa buʼan; Barnaabaas iyyuu itti fakkeessummaa isaaniitiin dogoggorfamee ture.
english: And the rest of the Jews joined him in his hypocrisy, so that even Barnabas was carried away with their hypocrisy.

kikuyu: Anis yommuu akka isaan daandii dhugaa wangeelaa irra hin deemne argetti hunda isaanii duratti Keefaan akkana jedhe; “Ati Yihuudii dha; garuu utuu akka Yihuudiitti hin taʼin akka Nama Ormaatti jiraatta; yoos ati akkamitti akka Namoonni Ormaa bartee Yihuudootaa duukaa buʼan dirqisiifta ree?
english: But when I saw that they didn’t walk uprightly according to the truth of the Good News, I said to Peter before them all, “If you, being a Jew, live as the Gentiles do, and not as the Jews do, why do you compel the Gentiles to live as the Jews do?

kikuyu: “Nu dhalootaan Yihuudoota malee Namoota Ormaa cubbamoota miti;
english: “We, being Jews by nature and not Gentile sinners,

kikuyu: namni Yesuus Kiristoositti amanuun malee akka seera eeguun qajeelaa hin taasifamne beekna. Kanaafuu seera eeguudhaan utuu hin taʼin amantii Kiristoos irratti qabnuun qajeeltota akka taanuuf Kiristoos Yesuusitti amanneerra; eenyu iyyuu seera eeguudhaan qajeelaa hin taʼuutii.
english: yet knowing that a man is not justified by the works of the law but through faith in Jesus Christ, even we believed in Christ Jesus, that we might be justified by faith in Christ and not by the works of the law, because no flesh will be justified by the works of the law.

kikuyu: “Egaa nu utuu karaa Kiristoosiin qajeeltota taasifamuu barbaannuu nu mataan keenya iyyuu cubbamoota taanee yoo argamnee Kiristoos tajaajilaa cubbuuti jechuudhaa ree? Kun gonkumaa akkas miti!
english: But if while we sought to be justified in Christ, we ourselves also were found sinners, is Christ a servant of sin? Certainly not!

kikuyu: Ani yoon waanan diige deebisee ijaare akkan seera cabsituu taʼen mirkaneessa.
english: For if I build up again those things which I destroyed, I prove myself a law-breaker.

kikuyu: “Ani akkan Waaqaaf jiraadhuuf, karaa seeraatiin seeraaf duʼeeraatii.
english: For I through the law died to the law, that I might live to God.

kikuyu: Ani Kiristoos wajjin fannifameera; siʼachi Kiristoositu na keessa jiraata malee kan jiraatu ana miti. Ani jireenya amma fooniin jiraadhu kana amantii Ilma Waaqaa isa na jaallatee naaf jedhee of kennetti qabuun nan jiraadha.
english: I have been crucified with Christ, and it is no longer I who live, but Christ lives in me. That life which I now live in the flesh, I live by faith in the Son of God, who loved me and gave himself up for me.

kikuyu: Ani ayyaana Waaqaa gatii hin dhabsiisu; utuu qajeelummaan karaa seeraatiin argamee Kiristoos akkanumaan duʼe jechuu dha kaa!”
english: I don’t reject the grace of God. For if righteousness is through the law, then Christ died for nothing!”

kikuyu: Yaa warra Galaatiyaa gowwoota! Eenyutu falfala isinitti hojjete? Yesuus Kiristoos akka waan ijuma keessan duratti fannifameetti mulʼifamee hin turree?
english: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed among you as crucified?

kikuyu: Ani waan tokko qofa isin irraa barachuu nan barbaada: Isin seera eeguun moo waan dhageessan amanuun Hafuura Qulqulluu argattan?
english: I just want to learn this from you: Did you receive the Spirit by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

kikuyu: Isin akkas gowwaadhaa? Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan jalqabdanii amma immoo fooniin fixxuu ree?
english: Are you so foolish? Having begun in the Spirit, are you now completed in the flesh?

kikuyu: Kun dhugumaan iyyuu waan hin fayyadne taanaan isin waanuma hin fayyadneef hammana dhiphattanii ree?
english: Did you suffer so many things in vain, if it is indeed in vain?

kikuyu: Wanni Waaqni Hafuura isaa isinii kennee hojii dinqii gidduu keessanitti hojjetuuf sababii isin seera eegdaniif moo sababii isin waan dhageessan amantaniif?
english: He therefore who supplies the Spirit to you and does miracles among you, does he do it by the works of the law, or by hearing of faith?

kikuyu: Akkasumas Abrahaam, “Waaqa amane; kunis qajeelummaatti lakkaaʼameef.”
english: Even so, Abraham “believed God, and it was counted to him for righteousness.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu warri amanan ijoollee Abrahaam akka taʼan hubadhaa.
english: Know therefore that those who are of faith are children of Abraham.

kikuyu: Katabbiin Qulqulluun akka Waaqni amantiin Namoota Ormaa qajeeltota taasisu duraan dursee argee, “Sabni hundinuu karaa keetiin eebbifama” jedhee duraan dursee Abrahaamitti wangeela lallabe.
english: The Scripture, foreseeing that God would justify the Gentiles by faith, preached the Good News beforehand to Abraham, saying, “In you all the nations will be blessed.”

kikuyu: Kanaaf warri amantii qaban, Abrahaam nama amantii sana wajjin eebbifaman.
english: So then, those who are of faith are blessed with the faithful Abraham.

kikuyu: Warri seera eeguu isaanii abdatan hundinuu abaarsa jala jiru; “Namni waan Kitaaba Seeraa keessatti barreeffame hundaaf itti fufee hin ajajamne kam iyyuu abaaramaa dha” jedhamee barreeffameeraatii.
english: For as many as are of the works of the law are under a curse. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who doesn’t continue in all things that are written in the book of the law, to do them.”

kikuyu: Waan, “Namni qajeelaan amantiidhaan jiraatuuf” akka eenyu iyyuu fuula Waaqaa duratti seeraan qajeelaa hin taasifamne ifa.
english: Now that no man is justified by the law before God is evident, for, “The righteous will live by faith.”

kikuyu: Seerri amantii irratti hin hundeeffamne; inni garuu, “Namni waan seerri ajaju godhu ittiin jiraata” jedha.
english: The law is not of faith, but, “The man who does them will live by them.”

kikuyu: Waan, “Namni muka irratti fannifamu kam iyyuu abaaramaa dha” jedhamee barreeffameef, Kiristoos nuuf jedhee abaarsa taʼuudhaan abaarsa seeraa irraa nu fure.
english: Christ redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. For it is written, “Cursed is everyone who hangs on a tree,”

kikuyu: Inni akka nu amantiin Hafuura Qulqulluu waadaa kenname sana argannuuf, akka eebbi Abrahaamiif kenname sun karaa Kiristoos Yesuusiin gara Namoota Ormaa dhufuuf nu fure.
english: that the blessing of Abraham might come on the Gentiles through Christ Jesus, that we might receive the promise of the Spirit through faith.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, ani akka namaattin dubbadha. Kakuun namaa iyyuu erga yeroo tokko mirkaneeffamee booddee eenyu iyyuu hin tuffatu yookaan itti hin dabalu.
english: Brothers, speaking of human terms, though it is only a man’s covenant, yet when it has been confirmed, no one makes it void or adds to it.

kikuyu: Egaa Abrahaamii fi sanyii isaatiif waadaan galameera. Katabbiin Qulqulluun, akka waan nama hedduuf dubbatameetti, “Sanyiiwwan” hin jedhu; garuu akka waan nama tokkoof dubbatameetti, “Sanyii keetiif” jedha; innis Kiristoos.
english: Now the promises were spoken to Abraham and to his offspring. He doesn’t say, “To descendants”, as of many, but as of one, “To your offspring”, which is Christ.

kikuyu: Wanni ani jedhus kana: Seerri waggaa 430 booddee dhufe sun kakuu Waaqni duraan dursee gale diigee akkasiin waadaa sana hin balleessu.
english: Now I say this: A covenant confirmed beforehand by God in Christ, the law, which came four hundred thirty years after, does not annul, so as to make the promise of no effect.

kikuyu: Dhaalli utuu karaa seeraatiin taʼee siʼachi waadaadhaan hin taʼu ture; Waaqni garuu ayyaana isaatiin waadaadhaan Abrahaamiif dhaala kenne.
english: For if the inheritance is of the law, it is no more of promise; but God has granted it to Abraham by promise.

kikuyu: Yoos seerri maaliif kenname ree? Seerri sababii yakka hamma Sanyiin waadaan kennameef sun dhufutti tureetiif kenname. Seerri sunis karaa ergamootaatiin harka araarsaa gidduu galeessa tokkootiin hojii irra oolfame.
english: Then why is there the law? It was added because of transgressions, until the offspring should come to whom the promise has been made. It was ordained through angels by the hand of a mediator.

kikuyu: Taʼus araarsaan gidduu galeessi tokko garee tokko qofaaf hin dhaabatu; Waaqni garuu tokkichuma.
english: Now a mediator is not between one, but God is one.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu seerri waadaa Waaqaatiin mormaa ree? Gonkumaa akkas miti! Utuu seerri jireenya kennuu dandaʼu kennamee jiraatee silaa qajeelummaan dhugumaan seeraan argama tureetii.
english: Is the law then against the promises of God? Certainly not! For if there had been a law given which could make alive, most certainly righteousness would have been of the law.

kikuyu: Katabbiin Qulqulluun garuu akka wanni karaa Yesuus Kiristoositti amanuutiin waadaa galame sun warra amananiif kennamuuf waan hundumaa cubbuu akka hidhamaa godhe labsa.
english: But the Scripture imprisoned all things under sin, that the promise by faith in Jesus Christ might be given to those who believe.

kikuyu: Utuu amantiin hin dhufiniin dura hamma amantiin mulʼifamutti seera jalatti hidhamnee nutti cufamee turre.
english: But before faith came, we were kept in custody under the law, confined for the faith which should afterwards be revealed.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka nu amantiin qajeeltota taasifamnuuf Kiristoositti nu geessuuf seerri guddiftuu keenya ture.
english: So that the law has become our tutor to bring us to Christ, that we might be justified by faith.

kikuyu: Amma garuu waan amantiin dhufeef nu siʼachi guddiftuu jala hin jiraannu.
english: But now that faith has come, we are no longer under a tutor.

kikuyu: Hundi keessan amantii Kiristoos Yesuusitti qabdaniin ijoollee Waaqaa ti;
english: For you are all children of God, through faith in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: isin warri Kiristoositti cuuphamtan hundi Kiristoosin uffattaniirtuutii.
english: For as many of you as were baptized into Christ have put on Christ.

kikuyu: Yihuudii yookaan Giriik, garba yookaan birmaduu, dhiira yookaan dubartii jechuun hin jiru; hundi keessan Kiristoos Yesuusiin tokkumaatii.
english: There is neither Jew nor Greek, there is neither slave nor free man, there is neither male nor female; for you are all one in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Erga kan Kiristoos taatanii yoos isin sanyii Abrahaam; akka waadaattis dhaaltota.
english: If you are Christ’s, then you are Abraham’s offspring and heirs according to promise.

kikuyu: Wanni ani jedhu kana; dhaaltuun yoo qabeenyi hundi kan isaa taʼe iyyuu inni hamma daaʼima taʼee jirutti garba irraa adda miti.
english: But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all,

kikuyu: Inni hamma guyyaan abbaan isaa murteesse sun gaʼutti warra isa eeganii fi warra isa guddisan jala jira.
english: but is under guardians and stewards until the day appointed by the father.

kikuyu: Nus akkasuma bara daaʼimman turretti garbummaa sirna addunyaa jala turre.
english: So we also, when we were children, were held in bondage under the elemental principles of the world.

kikuyu: Yommuu yeroon murteeffame sun gaʼetti garuu Waaqni Ilma isaa isa dubartii irraa dhalate, kan seera jalatti dhalate sana erge;
english: But when the fullness of the time came, God sent out his Son, born to a woman, born under the law,

kikuyu: kunis akka nu mirga ilmummaa argannuuf warra seera jala jiran furuuf.
english: that he might redeem those who were under the law, that we might receive the adoption as children.

kikuyu: Sababii isin ilmaan taataniifis Waaqni Hafuura Ilma isaa kan, “Aabbaa, yaa Abbaa” jedhee waamu sana gara keessa garaa keenyaatti erge.
english: And because you are children, God sent out the Spirit of his Son into your hearts, crying, “Abba, Father!”

kikuyu: Kanaaf ati siʼachi ilma malee garba miti; erga ilma taatee immoo Waaqni dhaaltuu si taasiseera.
english: So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

kikuyu: Isin utuu Waaqa hin beekiniin dura, waaqota uumama isaaniitiin waaqota hin taʼiniif garboomtanii turtan.
english: However at that time, not knowing God, you were in bondage to those who by nature are not gods.

kikuyu: Amma garuu isin erga Waaqa beektanii, keessumattuu erga Waaqa biratti beekamtanii booddee akkamitti gara sirnoota dadhaboo fi sirnoota faayidaa hin qabneetti deebitu ree? Isin ammas isaaniif garboomuu barbaadduu?
english: But now that you have come to know God, or rather to be known by God, why do you turn back again to the weak and miserable elemental principles, to which you desire to be in bondage all over again?

kikuyu: Isin guyyoota, jiʼoota, waqtiilee fi waggoota addaa kabajju!
english: You observe days, months, seasons, and years.

kikuyu: Ani akkasumaan isinitti dadhabe jedheen isiniif sodaadha.
english: I am afraid for you, that I might have wasted my labor for you.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, akkuma ani isin fakkaadhe, isinis akka na fakkaattan isin kadhadha. Isin balleessaa tokko illee natti hin hojjenne.
english: I beg you, brothers, become as I am, for I also have become as you are. You did me no wrong,

kikuyu: Yeroo jalqabaatti akka ani sababii dhukkubaatiin wangeela isinitti lallabe ni beektu;
english: but you know that because of weakness in the flesh I preached the Good News to you the first time.

kikuyu: yoo dhukkubni koo qoramsa isinitti taʼe iyyuu, isin akka waan ani ergamaa Waaqaa taʼeetti, akka waan ani Kiristoos Yesuus matuma isaa taʼeetti na simattan malee na hin tuffanne yookaan na hin balfine.
english: That which was a temptation to you in my flesh, you didn’t despise nor reject; but you received me as an angel of God, even as Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Eebbi keessan sun hundi eessa jira? Utuu dandaʼamee ija keessan illee akka of keessaa baaftanii naa kennuun fedhii keessan ture ani dhugaa baʼuu nan dandaʼa.
english: What was the blessing you enjoyed? For I testify to you that, if possible, you would have plucked out your eyes and given them to me.

kikuyu: Egaa ani waan dhugaa isinitti himeef diina keessan taʼee ree?
english: So then, have I become your enemy by telling you the truth?

kikuyu: Namoonni sun ofitti isin deebisuuf hinaafu; garuu waan gaariif miti. Isaan akka isin isaaniif hinaaftaniif nurraa gargar isin baasuu barbaadu.
english: They zealously seek you in no good way. No, they desire to alienate you, that you may seek them.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani isin bira jiru qofa utuu hin taʼin yeroo hundumaa kaayyoo gaariif hinaaffaa qabaachuun gaarii dha.
english: But it is always good to be zealous in a good cause, and not only when I am present with you.

kikuyu: Yaa ijoollee ko, ani hamma Kiristoos isin keessatti mulʼatutti ammas isiniif jedhee nan ciniinsifadha;
english: My little children, of whom I am again in travail until Christ is formed in you—

kikuyu: ani waaʼee keessaniif waan shakkii keessa jiruuf utuu isin biratti argamee sagalee koo geeddaradhee akkam hawwan ture!
english: but I could wish to be present with you now, and to change my tone, for I am perplexed about you.
