kikuyu: Warri seera jala jiraachuu barbaaddan mee natti himaa; isin waan seerri jedhu hin dhageenyee?
english: Tell me, you that desire to be under the law, don’t you listen to the law?

kikuyu: “Abrahaam ilmaan lama qaba ture; tokko dubartii garbittii irraa, kaan immoo dubartii birmaduu irraa dhalate” jedhamee barreeffameeraatii.
english: For it is written that Abraham had two sons, one by the servant, and one by the free woman.

kikuyu: Ilmi isaa inni dubartii garbittii irraa dhalate akka fedhii fooniitti dhalate; inni dubartii birmaduu irraa dhalate immoo akka waadaatti dhalate.
english: However, the son by the servant was born according to the flesh, but the son by the free woman was born through promise.

kikuyu: Kunis akka fakkeenyaatti fudhatamuu dandaʼa; dubartoonni kunneen kakuuwwan lamaan argisiisu. Kakuun tokko kan Tulluu Siinaa ti; kunis garbummaaf ijoollee horti; isheenis Aggaar.
english: These things contain an allegory, for these are two covenants. One is from Mount Sinai, bearing children to bondage, which is Hagar.

kikuyu: Egaa Aggaar akka Tulluu Siinaa isa biyya Arabaa keessaa ti; isheenis magaalaa Yerusaalem ishee yeroo ammaatti fakkeeffamti; magaalaan kun ijoollee ishee wajjin garbummaa keessa jirtiitii.
english: For this Hagar is Mount Sinai in Arabia, and answers to the Jerusalem that exists now, for she is in bondage with her children.

kikuyu: Yerusaalem isheen samii irraa garuu birmaduu dha; isheenis haadha keenya.
english: But the Jerusalem that is above is free, which is the mother of us all.

kikuyu: Akkana jedhamee barreeffameeraatii: “Yaa dubartii dhabduu kan ijoollee tokko illee hin daʼin ati gammadi; atis kan ciniinsifattee hin beekne guddisiitii ililchi; ijoollee dubartii dhirsa qabduu caalaa, ijoolleen dubartii gatamtee ni baayʼatu.”
english: For it is written, “Rejoice, you barren who don’t bear. Break out and shout, you who don’t travail. For the desolate women have more children than her who has a husband.”

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, isinis akkuma Yisihaaq ijoollee waadaa ti.
english: Now we, brothers, as Isaac was, are children of promise.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana ilmi akka fedhii fooniitti dhalate sun ilma humna Hafuuraatiin dhalate ariʼate. Amma illee akkasuma.
english: But as then, he who was born according to the flesh persecuted him who was born according to the Spirit, so also it is now.

kikuyu: Garuu Katabbiin Qulqulluun maal jedha? “Garbittii sanaa fi ilma ishee ariʼi; ilmi garbittii sun ilma dubartittii birmaduu wajjin hin dhaaluutii” jedha.
english: However, what does the Scripture say? “Throw out the servant and her son, for the son of the servant will not inherit with the son of the free woman.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa obboloota, nu ilmaan dubartii birmaduu sanaati malee ilmaan garbittii miti.
english: So then, brothers, we are not children of a servant, but of the free woman.

kikuyu: Akka bilisummaan jiraannuuf Kiristoos bilisa nu baase. Kanaafuu jabaadhaa dhaabadhaa! Deebitaniis waanjoo garbummaatiin hin qabaminaa.
english: Stand firm therefore in the liberty by which Christ has made us free, and don’t be entangled again with a yoke of bondage.

kikuyu: Kunoo, dhagna yoo qabattan Kiristoos waan tokko akka isin hin fayyadne ani Phaawulos isinitti nan hima.
english: Behold, I, Paul, tell you that if you receive circumcision, Christ will profit you nothing.

kikuyu: Namni dhagna qabatu hundinuu akka guutummaatti seera eeguun dirqama isaa taʼe ani amma illee nan mirkaneessaaf.
english: Yes, I testify again to every man who receives circumcision that he is a debtor to do the whole law.

kikuyu: Isin warri seeraan qajeeltota taasifamuu barbaaddan Kiristoos irraa gargar baataniirtu; ayyaana irraas kuftaniirtu.
english: You are alienated from Christ, you who desire to be justified by the law. You have fallen away from grace.

kikuyu: Nu garuu qajeelummaa abdannu sana karaa Hafuuraatiin hawwiidhaan amantiin eegganna.
english: For we through the Spirit, by faith wait for the hope of righteousness.

kikuyu: Kiristoos Yesuusitti jiraannaan dhagna qabachuun yookaan qabachuu baachuun faayidaa tokko illee hin qabuutii. Wanni gatii qabu amantii jaalalaan of mulʼisu qofa.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision amounts to anything, but faith working through love.

kikuyu: Isin fiigicha gaarii fiigaa turtan. Eenyutu gufuu isinitti taʼee dhugaadhaaf ajajamuu isin dhowwe ree?
english: You were running well! Who interfered with you that you should not obey the truth?

kikuyu: Sossobbiin akkasii isa isin waame sana biraa hin dhufu.
english: This persuasion is not from him who calls you.

kikuyu: “Raacitiin xinnoon bukoo guutuu ni bukeessa.”
english: A little yeast grows through the whole lump.

kikuyu: Ani akka isin yaada biraa hin qabaanne karaa Gooftaatiin isin amanadha. Abbaa fedhe illee taanaan namni isin jeequu murtii ni argata.
english: I have confidence toward you in the Lord that you will think no other way. But he who troubles you will bear his judgment, whoever he is.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, ani amma iyyuu yoon dhagna qabaa lallabaa jiraadhee ani amma iyyuu maaliifin ariʼatama ree? Yoo akkas taʼee immoo fannoon gufuu taʼuun isaa ni hafa ture!
english: But I, brothers, if I still preach circumcision, why am I still persecuted? Then the stumbling block of the cross has been removed.

kikuyu: Warri isin jeeqan sun dhagna qabachuu qofa utuu hin taʼin utuu of irraa muranii iyyuu nan hawwa!
english: I wish that those who disturb you would cut themselves off.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota ko, isin akka bilisa taataniif waamamtan. Jaalalaan wal tajaajilaa malee bilisummaa keessan fedhii foonii guutuuf hin oolchinaa.
english: For you, brothers, were called for freedom. Only don’t use your freedom as an opportunity for the flesh, but through love be servants to one another.

kikuyu: Seerri guutuun ajaja tokkicha, “Ollaa kee akka ofii keetiitti jaalladhu” jedhuun xumurameeraatii.
english: For the whole law is fulfilled in one word, in this: “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

kikuyu: Garuu isin yoo wal ciniinuu fi wal nyaachuutti fuftan akka wal hin balleessineef of eeggadhaa.
english: But if you bite and devour one another, be careful that you don’t consume one another.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani, “Hafuuraan jiraadhaa; yoos hawwii foonii hin guuttaniitii” jedha.
english: But I say, walk by the Spirit, and you won’t fulfill the lust of the flesh.

kikuyu: Foon Hafuuraan ni mormaatii; Hafuurris fooniin ni morma. Isaan akka isin waan hojjechuu barbaaddan hin hojjenneef wal mormu.
english: For the flesh lusts against the Spirit, and the Spirit against the flesh; and these are contrary to one another, that you may not do the things that you desire.

kikuyu: Isin garuu Hafuuraan yoo geggeeffamtan seera jala hin jirtan.
english: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not under the law.

kikuyu: Hojiiwwan fooniis beekamoo dha; isaanis halalummaa, xuraaʼummaa fi jireenya gad dhiisii,
english: Now the deeds of the flesh are obvious, which are: adultery, sexual immorality, uncleanness, lustfulness,

kikuyu: waaqota tolfamoo waaqeffachuu, falfala hojjechuu, jibba, aarii, hinaaffaa, dheekkamsa, ofittummaa, wal loluu, gargar baʼuu,
english: idolatry, sorcery, hatred, strife, jealousies, outbursts of anger, rivalries, divisions, heresies,

kikuyu: weennoo, machii, addaggummaa fi kanneen kana fakkaatan. Ani akkuman kanaan dura godhe sana akka warri waan akkanaa hojjetan mootummaa Waaqaa hin dhaalle isinin akeekkachiisa.
english: envy, murders, drunkenness, orgies, and things like these; of which I forewarn you, even as I also forewarned you, that those who practice such things will not inherit God’s Kingdom.

kikuyu: Iji Hafuuraa garuu jaalala, gammachuu, nagaa, obsa, arjummaa, gaarummaa, amanamummaa,
english: But the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faith,

kikuyu: garraamummaa fi of qabuu dha. Seerri waan akkanaa mormus hin jiru.
english: gentleness, and self-control. Against such things there is no law.

kikuyu: Warri kan Kiristoos Yesuus taʼan immoo foon fedhii isaatii fi hawwii isaa wajjin fannisaniiru.
english: Those who belong to Christ have crucified the flesh with its passions and lusts.

kikuyu: Nu erga Hafuuraan jiraannee kottaa Hafuuraan haa deddeebinu.
english: If we live by the Spirit, let’s also walk by the Spirit.

kikuyu: Kottaa of hin tuulluu; wal hin aarsinuu; walittis hin hinaafnuu.
english: Let’s not become conceited, provoking one another, and envying one another.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, yoo namni tokko cubbuu keessa seene, isin warri hafuuraan jiraattan garraamummaan isa deebisuu qabdu. Garuu atis akka hin qoramneef of eeggadhu.
english: Brothers, even if a man is caught in some fault, you who are spiritual must restore such a one in a spirit of gentleness, looking to yourself so that you also aren’t tempted.

kikuyu: Isin baʼaa walii baadhaa; akkasiin isin seera Kiristoos ni eegdu.
english: Bear one another’s burdens, and so fulfill the law of Christ.

kikuyu: Namni tokko utuu waan tokko iyyuu hin taʼin, waan waa tokko taʼe yoo of seʼe, inni of gowwoomsa.
english: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon namaa hojii mataa isaa haa qoru. Ergasiis utuu nama kaanitti of hin madaalin of qofa jajuu ni dandaʼa;
english: But let each man examine his own work, and then he will have reason to boast in himself, and not in someone else.

kikuyu: tokkoon tokkoon namaa baʼaa ofii isaa baadhachuu qabaatii.
english: For each man will bear his own burden.

kikuyu: Namni dubbicha baratu kam iyyuu waan gaarii hundumaa barsiisaa isaa wajjin haa qoodatu.
english: But let him who is taught in the word share all good things with him who teaches.

kikuyu: Hin gowwoominaa; Waaqaatti qoosuun hin dandaʼamu. Namni waanuma facaafate haammataatii.
english: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.

kikuyu: Namni foonitti facaasu foon irraa badiisa galfata; namni Hafuuratti facaasu immoo Hafuura irraa jireenya bara baraa haammata.
english: For he who sows to his own flesh will from the flesh reap corruption. But he who sows to the Spirit will from the Spirit reap eternal life.

kikuyu: Kottaa waan gaarii hojjechuu hin dadhabnu; yoo abdii kutachuu baanne gaafa yeroon isaa gaʼe midhaan isaa ni haammannaatii.
english: Let’s not be weary in doing good, for we will reap in due season if we don’t give up.

kikuyu: Kanaaf kottaa, carraa qabnuun nama hundaaf, keessumattuu warra maatii amantootaa taʼaniif waan gaarii goonaa.
english: So then, as we have opportunity, let’s do what is good toward all men, and especially toward those who are of the household of the faith.

kikuyu: Akka ani harkuma kootiin qubee gurguddaa hammam gaʼuun isinii barreesse mee ilaalaa!
english: See with what large letters I write to you with my own hand.

kikuyu: Warri fooniin gaarii taʼanii mulʼachuu barbaadan akka isin dhagna qabattan isin dirqisiisuu yaalu. Isaanis fannoo Kiristoosiif jedhanii akka hin ariʼatamne qofaaf waan kana godhu.
english: As many as desire to make a good impression in the flesh compel you to be circumcised, just so they may not be persecuted for the cross of Christ.

kikuyu: Warri dhagna qabatan mataan isaanii iyyuu seera hin eegan; taʼus isaan dhagna qabaa keessan kan fooniitiin boonuuf jedhanii akka isin dhagna qabattan barbaadu.
english: For even they who receive circumcision don’t keep the law themselves, but they desire to have you circumcised, so that they may boast in your flesh.

kikuyu: Fannoo Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos kan ittiin addunyaan naaf fannifame, kan anis ittiin addunyaaf fannifame sana malee waan biraatiin of jajuun narraa haa fagaatu.
english: But far be it from me to boast except in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ, through which the world has been crucified to me, and I to the world.

kikuyu: Uumama haaraa taʼuutu faayidaa qaba malee dhagna qabachuun yookaan qabachuu baachuun faayidaa hin qabu.
english: For in Christ Jesus neither is circumcision anything, nor uncircumcision, but a new creation.

kikuyu: Nagaa fi araarri warra seera kana duukaa buʼan hundaaf, Israaʼel Waaqaatiifis haa taʼu.
english: As many as walk by this rule, peace and mercy be on them, and on God’s Israel.

kikuyu: Ani dhagna koo irraa godaannisa Yesuus qabaatii siʼachi namni tokko iyyuu na hin rakkisin.
english: From now on, let no one cause me any trouble, for I bear the marks of the Lord Jesus branded on my body.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, ayyaanni Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos hafuura keessan wajjin haa taʼu. Ameen.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit, brothers. Amen.

kikuyu: Phaawulos isa fedhii Waaqaatiin ergamaa Kiristoos Yesuus taʼe irraa,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, to the saints who are at Ephesus, and the faithful in Christ Jesus:

kikuyu: Abbaa keenya Waaqaa fi Yesuus Kiristoos Gooftaa irraa ayyaannii fi nagaan isiniif haa taʼu.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Waaqnii fi Abbaan Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos inni Kiristoosiin eebba hafuuraa hundumaan samii irratti nu eebbise sun haa eebbifamu.
english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who has blessed us with every spiritual blessing in the heavenly places in Christ,

kikuyu: Inni nu fuula isaa duratti qulqullootaa fi warra mudaa hin qabne akka taanuuf utuu addunyaan hin uumaminiin dura isaan nu filateeraatii. Jaalalaanis
english: even as he chose us in him before the foundation of the world, that we would be holy and without defect before him in love,

kikuyu: akka kaayyoo fedhii isaatti akka nu karaa Yesuus Kiristoosiin ilmaan isaa taanuuf duraan dursee nu murteesse;
english: having predestined us for adoption as children through Jesus Christ to himself, according to the good pleasure of his desire,

kikuyu: kunis akka ulfinni ayyaana isaa kan inni Ilma isaa jaallatamaa sanaan toluma nuu kenne sun jajamuuf.
english: to the praise of the glory of his grace, by which he freely gave us favor in the Beloved.

kikuyu: Nus isumaan akkuma badhaadhummaa ayyaana Waaqaatti dhiiga isaatiin furama jechuunis, dhiifama cubbuu arganneerra;
english: In him we have our redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of our trespasses, according to the riches of his grace

kikuyu: ayyaana isaas ogummaa fi hubannaa hunda wajjin nuu baayʼise.
english: which he made to abound toward us in all wisdom and prudence,

kikuyu: Innis akka nu icciitii fedhii isaa kan akka yaada isaa isa gaarii inni karaa Kiristoosiin karoorfate sana beeknu godhe;
english: making known to us the mystery of his will, according to his good pleasure which he purposed in him

kikuyu: yaadni isaas yeroo barri murtaaʼe sun guutuutti wantoota samii keessaa fi lafa irra jiran hunda Kiristoos jalatti walitti qabuuf jedhee ti.
english: to an administration of the fullness of the times, to sum up all things in Christ, the things in the heavens and the things on the earth, in him.

kikuyu: Nus akkuma karoora isa waan hundumaa akka kaayyoo fedhii isaatti hojjetu sanaatti duraan dursee waan murteeffamneef Kiristoosiin dhaala arganneerra;
english: We were also assigned an inheritance in him, having been foreordained according to the purpose of him who does all things after the counsel of his will,

kikuyu: kunis akka nu warri Kiristoosin abdachuutti kanneen jalqabaa taane galata ulfina isaa taanuuf.
english: to the end that we should be to the praise of his glory, we who had before hoped in Christ.

kikuyu: Isinis dubbii dhugaa jechuunis wangeela fayyina keessanii dhageessanii Kiristoositti amantanii, Hafuura Qulqulluu waadaa galame sanaan chaappeffamtan;
english: In him you also, having heard the word of the truth, the Good News of your salvation—in whom, having also believed, you were sealed with the promised Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: innis warri kan Waaqayyoo taʼan galata ulfina isaatiif yeroo furamanitti wanta nu argachuuf jirruuf qabdii keenya.
english: who is a pledge of our inheritance, to the redemption of God’s own possession, to the praise of his glory.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani waaʼee amantii isin Gooftaa Yesuusitti qabdanii fi jaalala isin qulqulloota hundaaf qabdanii dhagaʼee
english: For this cause I also, having heard of the faith in the Lord Jesus which is among you and the love which you have toward all the saints,

kikuyu: kadhannaa koo keessatti isin yaadachaa waaʼee keessaniif galateeffachuu hin dhiifne.
english: don’t cease to give thanks for you, making mention of you in my prayers,

kikuyu: Waaqni Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos, Abbaan ulfinaa, akka isin guutummaatti isa beektaniif Hafuura ogummaa fi mulʼataa akka isinii kennu nan kadhadha.
english: that the God of our Lord Jesus Christ, the Father of glory, may give to you a spirit of wisdom and revelation in the knowledge of him,

kikuyu: Abdiin inni itti isin waame maal akka taʼe, badhaadhummaan dhaala qulqullootaa ulfina qabeessi maal akka taʼe akka beektaniif iji qalbii keessanii akka isinii banamu Waaqa nan kadhadha;
english: having the eyes of your hearts enlightened, that you may know what is the hope of his calling, and what are the riches of the glory of his inheritance in the saints,

kikuyu: akkasumas humni isaa inni nu warra amannu keessatti hojjetu hammam guddaa akka taʼe akka beektaniifis nan kadhadha. Humni sunis akkuma jabina guddaa
english: and what is the exceeding greatness of his power toward us who believe, according to that working of the strength of his might

kikuyu: kan inni ittiin Kiristoosin warra duʼan keessaa kaasee samii irratti mirga ofii teessise sana mulʼisee dha;
english: which he worked in Christ when he raised him from the dead and made him to sit at his right hand in the heavenly places,

kikuyu: isas ol aantummaa, taayitaa, humna, gooftummaa hundaa fi bara ammaa qofa utuu hin taʼin bara dhufuuf jiru keessa illee maqaa kennamu hundaa olitti mirga ofii teessise.
english: far above all rule, authority, power, dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age, but also in that which is to come.

kikuyu: Waaqnis waan hunda miilla isaa jala galche; waldaa kiristaanaatiifis mataa waan hundaa godhee isa kenne;
english: He put all things in subjection under his feet, and gave him to be head over all things for the assembly,

kikuyu: waldaan kiristaanaa dhagna isaa ti; isheenis guutama isaa kan inni waan hunda karaa hundaan guutuu dha.
english: which is his body, the fullness of him who fills all in all.

kikuyu: Isin irra daddarbaa keessanii fi cubbuu keessaniin duutanii turtan;
english: You were made alive when you were dead in transgressions and sins,

kikuyu: kunis isuma isin yeroo jireenya addunyaa kanaatii fi bulchaa mootummaa qilleensaa jechuunis hafuura amma iyyuu warra hin ajajamne keessatti hojjetu duukaa buutanitti keessa jiraachaa turtanii dha.
english: in which you once walked according to the course of this world, according to the prince of the power of the air, the spirit who now works in the children of disobedience.

kikuyu: Hundi keenyas yeroo tokko dharraa foon keenyaa guutaa, hawwii fi yaada isaa duukaa buʼaa isaan gidduu jiraanne. Uumama keenyaanis akkuma warra kaanii dheekkamsa jala turre.
english: We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were by nature children of wrath, even as the rest.

kikuyu: Garuu Waaqni araaraan guutame sun sababii jaalala guddaa nuu qabuuf,
english: But God, being rich in mercy, for his great love with which he loved us,

kikuyu: yeroo nu irra daddarbaa keenyaan duunee turretti illee Kiristoos wajjin jiraattota nu taasise; isinis ayyaanaan fayyina argattan.
english: even when we were dead through our trespasses, made us alive together with Christ—by grace you have been saved—

kikuyu: Waaqnis Kiristoos wajjin duʼaa nu kaase; karaa Kiristoos Yesuusiinis isa wajjin iddoo samii irra nu teessise;
english: and raised us up with him, and made us to sit with him in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: innis bara dhufuuf jiru keessa badhaadhummaa ayyaana isaa kan gita hin qabne sana arjummaa karaa Kiristoos Yesuusiin nuuf qabu argisiisuuf jedhee waan kana godhe.
english: that in the ages to come he might show the exceeding riches of his grace in kindness toward us in Christ Jesus;

kikuyu: Isinis ayyaanaan karaa amantiitiin fayyitaniirtuutii; kunis kennaa Waaqaati malee hojii ofii keessanii miti;
english: for by grace you have been saved through faith, and that not of yourselves; it is the gift of God,

kikuyu: akka namni tokko iyyuu of hin jajneefis kun hojiidhaan miti.
english: not of works, that no one would boast.

kikuyu: Nu hojii harka isaatii; hojii gaarii Waaqni duraan dursee akka nu hojjennuuf qopheesse sana akka hojjennuufis karaa Kiristoos Yesuusiin uumamne.
english: For we are his workmanship, created in Christ Jesus for good works, which God prepared before that we would walk in them.

kikuyu: Kanaaf isin warri durumaa dhalootaan Namoota Ormaa taatan akka warra dhagna qabaa harka namaatiin dhagna namaa irratti hojjetamuun, “Nu warra dhagna qabatee dha” ofiin jedhan biratti “Warra dhagna hin qabatin” jedhamtanii waamamtan sana yaadadhaa;
english: Therefore remember that once you, the Gentiles in the flesh, who are called “uncircumcision” by that which is called “circumcision” (in the flesh, made by hands),

kikuyu: isin akka yeroo sana Kiristoos irraa cittanii, lammummaa Israaʼel keessaa baafamtanii, kakuu waadaatiifis keessumoota taatanii, abdii malee, Waaqa malees addunyaa keessa turtan yaadadhaa.
english: that you were at that time separate from Christ, alienated from the commonwealth of Israel, and strangers from the covenants of the promise, having no hope and without God in the world.

kikuyu: Amma garuu isin warri yeroo tokko fagoo turtan Kiristoos Yesuusiin dhiiga Kiristoosiin dhiʼeeffamtaniirtu.
english: But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.

kikuyu: Kiristoos nagaa keenyaatii; innis dallaa diinummaa kan gargar baasu sana diigee jara lamaanuu tokko godheera;
english: For he is our peace, who made both one, and broke down the middle wall of separation,

kikuyu: inni foon ofiitiin seera ajajaa fi sirna isaa wajjin diigeera. Kaayyoon isaas jara lamaan keessaa ofuma isaatiin nama haaraa tokko uumee akkasiin nagaa buusuudhaan
english: having abolished in his flesh the hostility, the law of commandments contained in ordinances, that he might create in himself one new man of the two, making peace,

kikuyu: fannoo ittiin diinummaa isaanii ajjeese sanaan lamaan isaanii iyyuu dhagna tokko godhee Waaqatti araarse.
english: and might reconcile them both in one body to God through the cross, having killed the hostility through it.

kikuyu: Innis dhufee isin warra fagoo turtanitti nagaa, warra dhiʼoo turanittis nagaa lallabe.
english: He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

kikuyu: Nu lamaanuu karaa isaatiin Hafuura tokkicha sanaan akka itti Abbaa bira geenyu qabnaatii.
english: For through him we both have our access in one Spirit to the Father.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isin siʼachi saba Waaqaa wajjin lammii fi miseensota warra mana Waaqaa jiraataniiti malee ormaa fi alagoota miti;
english: So then you are no longer strangers and foreigners, but you are fellow citizens with the saints and of the household of God,

kikuyu: isin hundee ergamootaa fi raajotaa irratti ijaaramtaniirtu; Kiristoos Yesuus ofii isaatii mataa dhagaa golee ti.
english: being built on the foundation of the apostles and prophets, Christ Jesus himself being the chief cornerstone;

kikuyu: Karaa isaas ijaarsi sun guutuun tokkummaan wal qabatee mana qulqullummaa qulqulluu taʼuuf Gooftaadhaan guddata.
english: in whom the whole building, fitted together, grows into a holy temple in the Lord;

kikuyu: Isinis isumaan mana Waaqni Hafuura isaatiin keessa jiraatu taatanii tokkummaadhaan ijaaramaa jirtu.
english: in whom you also are built together for a habitation of God in the Spirit.

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf ani Phaawulos isin Namoota Ormaatiif jedhee hidhamaa Kiristoos Yesuus taʼeera.
english: For this cause I, Paul, am the prisoner of Christ Jesus on behalf of you Gentiles,

kikuyu: Isin dhugumaan waaʼee hojii ayyaana Waaqaa kan isiniif jedhamee natti kenname sanaa dhageessaniirtu;
english: if it is so that you have heard of the administration of that grace of God which was given me toward you,

kikuyu: kunis akkuma ani kanaan dura gabaabsee isinii barreessetti icciitii mulʼataatiin natti beeksifame.
english: how that by revelation the mystery was made known to me, as I wrote before in few words,

kikuyu: Isin yommuu waan kana dubbiftanitti akka ani waaʼee icciitii Kiristoos beekumsa qabu hubachuu ni dandeessu;
english: by which, when you read, you can perceive my understanding in the mystery of Christ,

kikuyu: icciitiin kunis akka amma Hafuuraan ergamootaa fi raajota qulqulloota Waaqaatti mulʼifametti dhaloota kaanitti hin beeksifamne.
english: which in other generations was not made known to the children of men, as it has now been revealed to his holy apostles and prophets in the Spirit,

kikuyu: Icciitiin kunis Namoonni Ormaa karaa wangeelaatiin saba Israaʼel wajjin dhaaltota, isaanuma wajjin dhagna tokko, waadaa Kiristoos Yesuusiin kenname keessatti immoo hirmaattota taʼuu isaanii ti.
english: that the Gentiles are fellow heirs and fellow members of the body, and fellow partakers of his promise in Christ Jesus through the Good News,

kikuyu: Anis kennaa ayyaana Waaqaa kan karaa hojii humna isaatiin naa kennameen tajaajilaa wangeela kanaa taʼeera.
english: of which I was made a servant according to the gift of that grace of God which was given me according to the working of his power.

kikuyu: Ani qulqulloota hundaa gad taʼu iyyuu akka badhaadhummaa Kiristoos kan qoramee bira hin gaʼamne sana Namoota Ormaatti lallabuuf ayyaanni kun naa kennameera;
english: To me, the very least of all saints, was this grace given, to preach to the Gentiles the unsearchable riches of Christ,

kikuyu: akkasumas icciitiin bara dheeraaf Waaqa waan hunda uumeen dhokfamee ture kun maal akka taʼe ani namoota hundaaf akka ibsuuf.
english: and to make all men see what is the administration of the mystery which for ages has been hidden in God, who created all things through Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Kaayyoon isaas akka ogummaan Waaqaa inni dachaa hedduu qabu sun amma karaa waldaa kiristaanaatiin bulchitootaa fi abbootii taayitaa kanneen samii irra jiranitti beeksifamuuf;
english: to the intent that now through the assembly the manifold wisdom of God might be made known to the principalities and the powers in the heavenly places,

kikuyu: kunis akkuma kaayyoo isaa kan bara baraa kan inni karaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiin raawwate sanaatti ture.
english: according to the eternal purpose which he accomplished in Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Nus isaan, amantii isa irratti qabnuun, ija jabinaa fi amanachuudhaan Waaqatti dhiʼaachuu dandeenya.
english: In him we have boldness and access in confidence through our faith in him.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu sababii ani isiniif dhiphachaa jiruuf jettanii akka abdii hin kutanne isin kadhadha; dhiphachuun koo ulfinuma keessan.
english: Therefore I ask that you may not lose heart at my troubles for you, which are your glory.

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf ani fuula Abbaa duratti nan jilbeenfadha;
english: For this cause, I bow my knees to the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: maatiin isaa warri samii irraa fi warri lafa irraa hundinuu maqaa isaanii isa irraa argatu.
english: from whom every family in heaven and on earth is named,

kikuyu: Inni akkuma badhaadhummaa ulfina isaatti karaa Hafuura isaatiin namummaa keessan kan keessaa humnaan akka cimsuuf nan kadhadha;
english: that he would grant you, according to the riches of his glory, that you may be strengthened with power through his Spirit in the inner person,

kikuyu: akka Kiristoosis karaa amantiitiin garaa keessan keessa jiraatuuf nan kadhadha. Akka isin hidda gad fageeffattanii jaalalaan dhaabattaniifis nan kadhadha;
english: that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,

kikuyu: isinis jaalalli Kiristoos hammam akka balʼatu, hammam akka dheeratu, hammam akka ol fagaatuu fi hammam akka gad fagaatu qulqulloota hunda wajjin hubachuudhaaf akka humna qabaattaniif,
english: may be strengthened to comprehend with all the saints what is the width and length and height and depth,

kikuyu: akka guutama Waaqaa hundaan guutamtaniifis jaalala Kiristoos kan beekumsaa ol taʼe sana akka beektaniif nan kadhadha.
english: and to know Christ’s love which surpasses knowledge, that you may be filled with all the fullness of God.

kikuyu: Waaqa isa humna isaa kan nu keessatti hojjetu sanaan hamma nu kadhannu yookaan hamma nu yaadnu hundumaa olitti akka malee hojjechuu dandaʼu sanaaf,
english: Now to him who is able to do exceedingly abundantly above all that we ask or think, according to the power that works in us,

kikuyu: waldaa kiristaanaa keessatti, dhaloota hunda keessattis karaa Kiristoos Yesuusiin bara baraa hamma bara baraatti ulfinni isaaf haa taʼu! Ameen.
english: to him be the glory in the assembly and in Christ Jesus to all generations, forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani kan Gooftaaf jedhee hidhame, isin waamicha itti waamamtan sanaaf akka malutti akka jiraattan isin nan kadhadha.
english: I therefore, the prisoner in the Lord, beg you to walk worthily of the calling with which you were called,

kikuyu: Guutumaan guutuutti gad of qabaa; garraamota taʼaa; obsa qabaadhaa; jaalalaanis wal dandaʼaa.
english: with all lowliness and humility, with patience, bearing with one another in love,

kikuyu: Hidhaa nagaatiin tokkummaa Hafuuraa eeguuf carraaqaa.
english: being eager to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace.

kikuyu: Akkuma yeroo waamamtanitti gara abdii tokkootti waamamtan sana, dhagna tokkoo fi Hafuura tokkotu jira;
english: There is one body and one Spirit, even as you also were called in one hope of your calling,

kikuyu: Gooftaa tokko, amantii tokkoo fi cuuphaa tokkotu jira;
english: one Lord, one faith, one baptism,

kikuyu: Waaqaa fi Abbaan waan hundaa, inni waan hundaa ol taʼe, kan waan hunda keessatti hojjetuu fi kan waan hunda keessa jiru tokkichatu jira.
english: one God and Father of all, who is over all and through all and in us all.

kikuyu: Garuu akkuma safara kennaa Kiristoositti tokkoo tokkoo keenyaaf ayyaanni kennameera.
english: But to each one of us, the grace was given according to the measure of the gift of Christ.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu, “Inni yommuu ol gubbaa baʼetti, boojuu boojiʼe; namootaafis kennaa kenne” jedha.
english: Therefore he says, “When he ascended on high, he led captivity captive, and gave gifts to people.”

kikuyu: Egaa, “Inni ol baʼe” jechuun isaa dhidhima lafaatti gad buʼe jechuu malee maal jechuu isaa ti?
english: Now this, “He ascended”, what is it but that he also first descended into the lower parts of the earth?

kikuyu: Inni gad buʼe sun isuma waan hunda guutuuf jedhee samiiwwan hundaa olitti ol baʼee dha.
english: He who descended is the one who also ascended far above all the heavens, that he might fill all things.

kikuyu: Innis namoota tokko tokko ergamoota, kaan raajota, kaan lallabdoota wangeelaa, kaan immoo tiksootaa fi barsiistota taasisee kenne;
english: He gave some to be apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, shepherds and teachers;

kikuyu: waan kanas akka dhagni Kiristoos ijaaramuuf qulqulloota hojii tajaajilaatiif qopheessuuf jedhee godhe;
english: for the perfecting of the saints, to the work of serving, to the building up of the body of Christ,

kikuyu: kunis waan hamma hundi keenya tokkummaa amantiitii fi tokkummaa Ilma Waaqaa beekuu bira geenyutti, akka guddannee sadarkaa guutama Kiristoos bira gaʼuudhaan namoota bilchaatoo taanuuf.
english: until we all attain to the unity of the faith and of the knowledge of the Son of God, to a full grown man, to the measure of the stature of the fullness of Christ,

kikuyu: Egaa nu siʼachi duraa duubatti dadarbatamaa bubbee barsiisa gosa hundaatiin, haxxummaa fi jalʼina marii gowwoomsitootaatiin asii fi achi oofamaa daaʼimman hin taanu.
english: that we may no longer be children, tossed back and forth and carried about with every wind of doctrine, by the trickery of men, in craftiness, after the wiles of error;

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa jaalalaan dhugaa dubbachaa gara isa mataa taʼe sanaatti waan hundaan ni guddanna; innis Kiristoos.
english: but speaking truth in love, we may grow up in all things into him who is the head, Christ,

kikuyu: Isumaanis kutaaleen dhagnaa guutuun ribuu walitti isaan qabuun hidhamaniiru; yommuu kutaaleen dhagnaa sun hundi hojii isaanii hojjetanittis dhagni sun jaalalaan guddatee of ijaara.
english: from whom all the body, being fitted and knit together through that which every joint supplies, according to the working in measure of each individual part, makes the body increase to the building up of itself in love.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani waan kana isinitti nan hima; maqaa Gooftaatiinis jabeessee isinitti nan dubbadha; isin siʼachi akka Namoonni Ormaa warri yaadni isaanii faayidaa hin qabne sun jiraatanitti hin jiraatinaa.
english: This I say therefore, and testify in the Lord, that you no longer walk as the rest of the Gentiles also walk, in the futility of their mind,

kikuyu: Sababii mata jabina isaaniitiinis waan wallaalummaan isaan keessa jiruuf hubannaan isaanii dukkaneeffameera; jireenya Waaqaa keessaas baʼaniiru.
english: being darkened in their understanding, alienated from the life of God because of the ignorance that is in them, because of the hardening of their hearts.

kikuyu: Isaanis waan qalbiin isaanii hadoodeef hamma xuraaʼummaa gosa hundaa keessa galanitti sassattummaan guutaman.
english: They, having become callous, gave themselves up to lust, to work all uncleanness with greediness.

kikuyu: Isin garuu akkasitti Kiristoosin hin barre;
english: But you didn’t learn Christ that way,

kikuyu: isin dhugumaan akkuma dhugaa Yesuus keessa jiru sanaatti waaʼee Kiristoos dhageessanii isumaanis barsiifamtaniirtu.
english: if indeed you heard him and were taught in him, even as truth is in Jesus:

kikuyu: Haala jireenya keessan kan durii, eenyummaa keessan moofaa hawwii gowwoomsaa isaatiin xuraaʼe sana dhabamsiisaa;
english: that you put away, as concerning your former way of life, the old man that grows corrupt after the lusts of deceit,

kikuyu: hafuura yaada keessaniitiinis haaromfamaa;
english: and that you be renewed in the spirit of your mind,

kikuyu: namummaa haaraa isa qajeelummaa fi qulqullina dhugaatiin fakkeenya Waaqaatiin uumame sana uffadhaa.
english: and put on the new man, who in the likeness of God has been created in righteousness and holiness of truth.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu waan nu hundi miseensa walii taaneef tokkoon tokkoon keessan soba of keessaa baastanii ollaa keessanitti dhugaa dubbachuu qabdu.
english: Therefore, putting away falsehood, speak truth each one with his neighbor, for we are members of one another.

kikuyu: “Aaraa malee cubbuu hin hojjetinaa;” utuma aartanii jirtaniis aduun hin lixin;
english: “Be angry, and don’t sin.” Don’t let the sun go down on your wrath,

kikuyu: diiyaabiloosiifis carraa hin kenninaa.
english: and don’t give place to the devil.

kikuyu: Namni kanaan dura hataa ture siʼachi hin hatin; qooda kanaa akka warra rakkatan gargaaruu dandaʼuuf harkuma ofii isaatiin waan faayidaa qabu haa hojjetu.
english: Let him who stole steal no more; but rather let him labor, producing with his hands something that is good, that he may have something to give to him who has need.

kikuyu: Waan nama ijaaruuf gargaaru, akkuma barbaachisaa taʼettis waan warra dhaggeeffataniif ayyaana kennu malee dubbiin hamaan tokko iyyuu afaan keessanii hin baʼin.
english: Let no corrupt speech proceed out of your mouth, but only what is good for building others up as the need may be, that it may give grace to those who hear.

kikuyu: Hafuura Qulqulluu Waaqaa kan guyyaa furamaatiif ittiin chaappeffamtan sana hin gaddisiisinaa.
english: Don’t grieve the Holy Spirit of God, in whom you were sealed for the day of redemption.

kikuyu: Hadhaaʼummaan, dheekkamsii fi aariin, wacnii fi maqaa nama balleessuun hundinuu hammina hundumaa wajjin isin irraa haa fagaatu.
english: Let all bitterness, wrath, anger, outcry, and slander be put away from you, with all malice.

kikuyu: Akkuma Waaqni karaa Kiristoosiin dhiifama isinii godhe sana, isinis dhiifama walii godhaa; walii naʼaa; garaas walii laafaa.
english: And be kind to one another, tender hearted, forgiving each other, just as God also in Christ forgave you.

kikuyu: Kanaaf akkuma ijoollee jaallatamootti fakkeenya Waaqaa duukaa buʼaa;
english: Be therefore imitators of God, as beloved children.

kikuyu: akkuma Kiristoos nu jaallatee nuufis jedhee akka aarsaa fi qalma urgaaʼuutti Waaqaaf of kenne sana isinis jaalalaan deddeebiʼaa.
english: Walk in love, even as Christ also loved us and gave himself up for us, an offering and a sacrifice to God for a sweet-smelling fragrance.

kikuyu: Garuu waaʼeen halalummaa yookaan xuraaʼummaa gosa kamii iyyuu yookaan waaʼeen doqnummaa gidduu keessanitti hin dhagaʼamin; wanni akkasii qulqulloota Waaqaa biratti hin barbaachisuutii.
english: But sexual immorality, and all uncleanness or covetousness, let it not even be mentioned among you, as becomes saints;

kikuyu: Galateeffachuu malee haasaan qaanii yookaan dubbiin gowwummaa kan faayidaa hin qabne yookaan qoosaan namatti hin tolle isin gidduu hin jiraatin.
english: nor filthiness, nor foolish talking, nor jesting, which are not appropriate, but rather giving of thanks.

kikuyu: Halaleen yookaan xuraaʼaan yookaan sassattuun jechuunis kan Waaqa tolfamaa waaqeffatu mootummaa Kiristoosii fi kan Waaqaa keessaa akka dhaala tokko illee hin qabne beekaa.
english: Know this for sure, that no sexually immoral person, nor unclean person, nor covetous man (who is an idolater), has any inheritance in the Kingdom of Christ and God.

kikuyu: Namni tokko iyyuu dubbii faayidaa hin qabneen isin hin gowwoomsin; sababii waan akkanaatiif dheekkamsi Waaqaa warra hin ajajamnetti ni dhufaatii.
english: Let no one deceive you with empty words, for because of these things the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isin waan isaan hojjetan keessatti hin hirmaatinaa.
english: Therefore don’t be partakers with them.

kikuyu: Isin dur dukkana turtaniitii; amma garuu Gooftaadhaan ifa taataniirtu. Akka ijoollee ifaatti jiraadhaa;
english: For you were once darkness, but are now light in the Lord. Walk as children of light,

kikuyu: iji ifaa gaarummaa, qajeelummaa fi dhugaa hunda keessatti argamaatii;
english: for the fruit of the Spirit is in all goodness and righteousness and truth,

kikuyu: waan Gooftaa gammachiisu qoradhaa bira gaʼaa.
english: proving what is well pleasing to the Lord.

kikuyu: Hojii dukkanaa kan ija hin qabne saaxilaa malee irratti hin hirmaatinaa.
english: Have no fellowship with the unfruitful deeds of darkness, but rather even reprove them.

kikuyu: Waan isaan icciitiin hojjetan dubbachuun iyyuu qaaniidhaatii.
english: For it is a shame even to speak of the things which are done by them in secret.

kikuyu: Wanni ifni sun saaxilu hundinuu garuu ni mulʼata;
english: But all things, when they are reproved, are revealed by the light, for everything that reveals is light.

kikuyu: kanaafis, “Ati yaa isa raftu, dammaqi; warra duʼan keessaas kaʼi; Kiristoos siif ibsaatii” jedhameera.
english: Therefore he says, “Awake, you who sleep, and arise from the dead, and Christ will shine on you.”

kikuyu: Egaa isin akkamitti akka jiraattan jabeessaa of eeggadhaa! Akka ogeeyyiitti jiraadhaa malee akka warra ogeeyyii hin taʼiniitti hin jiraatinaa;
english: Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,

kikuyu: waan guyyoonni kunneen hamoo taʼaniif baricha furaa.
english: redeeming the time, because the days are evil.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu fedhiin Gooftaa maal akka taʼe hubadhaa malee gowwaa hin taʼinaa.
english: Therefore, don’t be foolish, but understand what the will of the Lord is.

kikuyu: Daadhii wayiniitiin hin machaaʼinaa; kun jireenya gad dhiisiitti geessaatii. Qooda kanaa Hafuuraan guutamaa;
english: Don’t be drunken with wine, in which is dissipation, but be filled with the Spirit,

kikuyu: faarfannaadhaan, weedduu galataatii fi faarfannaa Hafuuraatiin wal jalaa qabaa. Garaa keessan keessatti Gooftaaf faarfadhaatii muuziiqaa dhageessisaa;
english: speaking to one another in psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs; singing and making melody in your heart to the Lord;

kikuyu: yeroo hundas waan hundaaf maqaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiin Waaqa Abbaa galateeffadhaa.
english: giving thanks always concerning all things in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ to God, even the Father;

kikuyu: Sodaa Kiristoosiif qabdaniin waliif ajajamaa.
english: subjecting yourselves to one another in the fear of Christ.

kikuyu: Yaa niitota, akkuma Gooftaaf ajajamtanitti dhirsoota keessaniif ajajamaa.
english: Wives, be subject to your own husbands, as to the Lord.

kikuyu: Akkuma Kiristoos waldaa kiristaanaatiif mataa taʼe sana dhirsi niitiif mataadhaatii; Kiristoos Fayyisaa waldaa kiristaanaa ti; waldaan kiristaanaa immoo dhagna isaa ti.
english: For the husband is the head of the wife, as Christ also is the head of the assembly, being himself the savior of the body.

kikuyu: Egaa akkuma waldaan kiristaanaa Kiristoosiif ajajamtu, niitonnis waan hundaan dhirsoota isaaniitiif haa ajajaman.
english: But as the assembly is subject to Christ, so let the wives also be to their own husbands in everything.

kikuyu: Yaa dhirsoota, akkuma Kiristoos waldaa kiristaanaa jaallatee isheef of kenne sana isinis niitota keessan jaalladhaa;
english: Husbands, love your wives, even as Christ also loved the assembly and gave himself up for her,

kikuyu: innis karaa dubbii isaatiin bishaaniin ishee dhiqee qulleessee akka isheen qulqulluu taatuuf,
english: that he might sanctify her, having cleansed her by the washing of water with the word,

kikuyu: waldaa kiristaanaa ulfina qabeettii, mudaa yookaan suntuura yookaan waan akkanaa tokko illee hin qabnee garuu qulqullooftuu mudaa hin qabne godhee ofitti ishee dhiʼeessuuf waan kana godhe.
english: that he might present the assembly to himself gloriously, not having spot or wrinkle or any such thing, but that she should be holy and without defect.

kikuyu: Akkasuma immoo dhirsoonni niitota isaanii akkuma dhagna ofii isaaniitti jaallachuu qabu. Namni niitii ofii jaallatu of jaallata.
english: Even so husbands also ought to love their own wives as their own bodies. He who loves his own wife loves himself.

kikuyu: Akkuma Kiristoos waldaa kiristaanaatiif godhu sana namni kam iyyuu foon ofii ni soora; ni kunuunsas malee foon ofii hin jibbu;
english: For no man ever hated his own flesh, but nourishes and cherishes it, even as the Lord also does the assembly,

kikuyu: nu kutaalee dhagna isaatii.
english: because we are members of his body, of his flesh and bones.

kikuyu: “Sababii kanaaf namni abbaa fi haadha isaa dhiisee niitii isaatti ni maxxana; lamaan isaanii iyyuu foon tokko ni taʼu.”
english: “For this cause a man will leave his father and mother and will be joined to his wife. Then the two will become one flesh.”

kikuyu: Kun icciitii guddaa dha; ani garuu waaʼee Kiristoosii fi waaʼee waldaa kiristaanaa dubbadha.
english: This mystery is great, but I speak concerning Christ and the assembly.

kikuyu: Taʼus isin keessaa tokkoon tokkoon namaa akkuma of jaallatutti niitii ofii haa jaallatu; niitiinis dhirsa ofii haa kabajju.
english: Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her husband.

kikuyu: Yaa ijoolle, Gooftaaf jedhaatii abbootii fi haadhota keessaniif ajajamaa; kun qajeelaadhaatii.
english: Children, obey your parents in the Lord, for this is right.

kikuyu: Ajajni jalqabaa kan waadaa qabu, “Abbaa keetii fi haadha keetiif ulfina kenni” jedha;
english: “Honor your father and mother,” which is the first commandment with a promise:

kikuyu: kunis, “Akka sitti toluu fi akka lafa irra bara dheeraa jiraattuuf.”
english: “that it may be well with you, and you may live long on the earth.”

kikuyu: Yaa abbootii, isinis ijoollee keessan barsiisaa fi gorsa Gooftaatiin guddisaa malee hin aarsinaa.
english: You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.

kikuyu: Yaa garboota, akkuma Kiristoosiif ajajamtanitti kabajaa fi sodaadhaan, garaa qulqulluunis gooftota keessan warra addunyaa kanaatiif ajajamaa.
english: Servants, be obedient to those who according to the flesh are your masters, with fear and trembling, in singleness of your heart, as to Christ,

kikuyu: Yeroo iji isaanii isin argutti isaan biratti fudhatama argachuu qofaaf utuu hin taʼin garaa guutuun fedhii Waaqaa raawwachaa akka garboota Kiristoositti isaaniif ajajamaa.
english: not in the way of service only when eyes are on you, as men pleasers, but as servants of Christ, doing the will of God from the heart,

kikuyu: Akka waan nama tajaajiltaniitti utuu hin taʼin akka waan Gooftaa tajaajiltaniitti garaa guutuun hojjedhaa;
english: with good will doing service as to the Lord and not to men,

kikuyu: sababiin isaas isin akka Gooftaan tokkoo tokkoo namaatiif garbas taʼu yookaan birmaduu, waan gaarii inni hojjetu kamiif iyyuu gatii kennu ni beektu.
english: knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound or free.

kikuyu: Yaa gooftota, isinis garboota keessaniif akkasuma godhaa. Isin akka inni isaanii fi isiniif Gooftaa taʼe sun samii irra jiruu fi akka nama wal caalchisuunis isa bira hin jirre waan beektaniif isaan hin doorsisinaa.
english: You masters, do the same things to them, and give up threatening, knowing that he who is both their Master and yours is in heaven, and there is no partiality with him.

kikuyu: Kanaa achi Gooftaa fi humna isaa jabaa sanaan cimaa.
english: Finally, be strong in the Lord and in the strength of his might.

kikuyu: Haxxummaa diiyaabiloosiin akka mormuu dandeessaniif miʼa lolaa kan Waaqaa guutuu hidhadhaa.
english: Put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil.

kikuyu: Walʼaansoon keenya bulchitoota wajjin, abbootii taayitaa wajjin, humnoota addunyaa dukkanaa kanaa fi humnoota hafuura hamaa iddoo samii keessa jiruu wajjin malee foonii fi dhiiga wajjin mitii.
english: For our wrestling is not against flesh and blood, but against the principalities, against the powers, against the world’s rulers of the darkness of this age, and against the spiritual forces of wickedness in the heavenly places.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka yommuu guyyaan hamaan sun dhufutti obsaan dhaabachuu dandeessaniif, waan kana hunda gochuunis akka jabaattanii dhaabattaniif miʼa lolaa kan Waaqaa guutuu hidhadhaa.
english: Therefore put on the whole armor of God, that you may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.

kikuyu: Egaa mudhii keessan dhugaan hidhadhaatii, qomee sibiilaa kan qajeelummaas uffadhaatii jabaadhaa dhaabadhaa;
english: Stand therefore, having the utility belt of truth buckled around your waist, and having put on the breastplate of righteousness,

kikuyu: qophaaʼummaa wangeela nagaa akka kopheetti miilla keessanitti kaaʼadhaa dhaabadhaa.
english: and having fitted your feet with the preparation of the Good News of peace,

kikuyu: Kana hundumaa irrattis gaachana amantii kan xiyya bobaʼaa hamaa sanaa hunda ittiin dhaamsuu dandeessan qabadhaa.
english: above all, taking up the shield of faith, with which you will be able to quench all the fiery darts of the evil one.

kikuyu: Qoobii sibiilaa kan fayyinaa kaaʼadhaa; goraadee Hafuuraas qabadhaa; innis dubbii Waaqaa ti.
english: And take the helmet of salvation, and the sword of the Spirit, which is the word of God;

kikuyu: Kadhannaa fi waammata gosa hundaa keessatti yeroo hunda Hafuuraan kadhadhaa. Kanas yaadatti qabachaa yeroo hunda dammaqaatii qulqulloota hundaaf jabaadhaa kadhadhaa.
english: with all prayer and requests, praying at all times in the Spirit, and being watchful to this end in all perseverance and requests for all the saints.

kikuyu: Yommuun afaan saaqqadhu hunda ija jabinaan icciitii wangeelaa akkan beeksisuuf dubbiin akka naa kennamu anaafis kadhadhaa;
english: Pray for me, that utterance may be given to me in opening my mouth, to make known with boldness the mystery of the Good News,

kikuyu: wangeelli kunis isuma ani isaaf jedhee ergamaa taʼee foncaan hidhamee dha. Isinis akka ani akkuma narraa eegamutti sodaa malee isa lallabuu dandaʼuuf naa kadhadhaa.
english: for which I am an ambassador in chains; that in it I may speak boldly, as I ought to speak.

kikuyu: Xikiqoos obboleessi jaallatamaan, Gooftaattis tajaajilaan amanamaan haala ani keessa jiruu fi maal akka ani hojjechaa jiru akka beektaniif waan hundumaa isinitti hima.
english: But that you also may know my affairs, how I am doing, Tychicus, the beloved brother and faithful servant in the Lord, will make known to you all things.

kikuyu: Anis akka isin haala nu keessa jirru beektanii fi akka inni isin jajjabeessuuf, waanuma kanaaf jedhee ani gara keessanitti isa ergeera.
english: I have sent him to you for this very purpose, that you may know our state and that he may comfort your hearts.

kikuyu: Waaqa Abbaa fi Yesuus Kiristoos Gooftaa irraa nagaan, jaalallis amantii wajjin obboloota hundaaf haa taʼu.
english: Peace be to the brothers, and love with faith, from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Warra jaalala hin badneen Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosin jaallatan hundaaf ayyaanni haa taʼu.
english: Grace be with all those who love our Lord Jesus Christ with incorruptible love. Amen.

kikuyu: Phaawulosii fi Xiimotewos tajaajiltoota Kiristoos Yesuus irraa,
english: Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus who are at Philippi, with the overseers and servants:

kikuyu: Abbaa keenya Waaqaa fi Yesuus Kiristoos Gooftaa biraa ayyaannii fi nagaan isiniif haa taʼu.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ani yeroo isin yaadadhu hunda Waaqa koo nan galateeffadha.
english: I thank my God whenever I remember you,

kikuyu: Ani kadhannaa hunda keessaniif kadhadhu keessatti yeroo hunda gammachuun nan kadhadha;
english: always in every request of mine on behalf of you all, making my requests with joy,

kikuyu: isin guyyaa jalqabaatii hamma ammaatti wangeela lallabuu keessatti hirmaattaniirtuutii;
english: for your partnership in furtherance of the Good News from the first day until now;

kikuyu: inni hojii gaarii isin keessatti jalqabe sun hamma guyyaa Kiristoos Yesuusitti akka raawwatu nan amana.
english: being confident of this very thing, that he who began a good work in you will complete it until the day of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Waan isin garaa koo keessa jirtaniif ani waaʼee hunda keessanii akkanatti yaaduun koo anaaf sirrii dha; hidhamuu koo keessattis taʼu yookaan wangeelaaf falmuu kootii fi akka wangeelli cimee dhaabatu gochuu koo keessatti hundi keessan na wajjin ayyaana Waaqaa keessatti hirmaatuutii.
english: It is even right for me to think this way on behalf of all of you, because I have you in my heart, because both in my bonds and in the defense and confirmation of the Good News, you all are partakers with me of grace.

kikuyu: Akka ani jaalala Kiristoos Yesuusiin hammam hunda keessan yaadu Waaqayyo dhuga baatu koo ti.
english: For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Kadhannaan koo kanaa dha: kunis akka jaalalli keessan beekumsaa fi hubannaa hundaan ittuma fufee baayʼatu,
english: This I pray, that your love may abound yet more and more in knowledge and all discernment,

kikuyu: akka isin isa waan hundumaa caalu addaan baaftanii beekuu dandeessanii fi akka isin hamma guyyaa Kiristoosittis qulqullootaa fi warra mudaa hin qabne taataniif,
english: so that you may approve the things that are excellent, that you may be sincere and without offense to the day of Christ,

kikuyu: akka ulfinaa fi galata Waaqaatiifis iji qajeelinaa kan karaa Yesuus Kiristoosiin argamuun guutamtaniif.
english: being filled with the fruits of righteousness which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, wanti narra gaʼe kun dhugumaan wangeela babalʼisuuf gargaaruu isaa akka beektan nan barbaada.
english: Now I desire to have you know, brothers, that the things which happened to me have turned out rather to the progress of the Good News,

kikuyu: Kanaanis Kiristoosiif jedhee hidhamuun koo guutummaa masaraatii fi namoota kaan hunda biratti beekameera.
english: so that it became evident to the whole palace guard, and to all the rest, that my bonds are in Christ,

kikuyu: Sababii ani hidhameefis obboloota keessaa garri caalaan Gooftaa amanatanii, dubbii Waaqaa sodaa malee dubbachuuf ija jabina guddaa argataniiru.
english: and that most of the brothers in the Lord, being confident through my bonds, are more abundantly bold to speak the word of God without fear.

kikuyu: Namoonni tokko tokko dhugumaan weennoo fi morkiidhaan Kiristoosin lallabu; warri kaan garuu yaada gaariidhaan lallabu.
english: Some indeed preach Christ even out of envy and strife, and some also out of good will.

kikuyu: Warri yaada gaariidhaan lallaban kunneen, akka ani wangeelaaf falmuuf jedhee as kaaʼame beekanii jaalalaan lallabu.
english: The former insincerely preach Christ from selfish ambition, thinking that they add affliction to my chains;

kikuyu: Warri weennoo fi morkiidhaan lallaban immoo utuu garaa qulqulluun hin taʼin, mana hidhaa keessatti rakkina natti cimsuuf jedhanii fedhii ofittummaatiin Kiristoosin lallabu.
english: but the latter out of love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the Good News.

kikuyu: Yoos wanni kun maal qaba ree? Wanni barbaachisaan fakkeessuunis taʼu yookaan dhugaan karaa kam iyyuu Kiristoos lallabamuu isaa ti. Sababii kanaaf ani akka malee nan gammada. Eeyyee ani ittuma fufee nan gammada;
english: What does it matter? Only that in every way, whether in pretense or in truth, Christ is proclaimed. I rejoice in this, yes, and will rejoice.

kikuyu: akka wanni narra gaʼe kun karaa kadhannaa keessaniitii fi karaa gargaarsa Hafuura Yesuus Kiristoosiin gara furamaatti naa geeddaramu nan beekaatii.
english: For I know that this will turn out to my salvation through your prayers and the supply of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Ani akkuma yeroo kaanii ammas jireenyaanis taʼu yookaan duʼaan ija jabinaan dubbachuun koo akka Kiristoos dhagna koo keessatti ulfina argatuuf malee karaa kamiin iyyuu akka hin qaanofneef baayʼisee nan hawwa; nan abdadhas.
english: according to my earnest expectation and hope, that I will in no way be disappointed, but with all boldness, as always, now also Christ will be magnified in my body, whether by life or by death.

kikuyu: Anaaf jiraachuun Kiristoos; duʼuunis buʼaa dha.
english: For to me to live is Christ, and to die is gain.

kikuyu: Ani yoo fooniin jiraadhe kun anaaf hojii buʼa qabeessa; garuu maalan filadha? Ani hin beeku!
english: But if I live on in the flesh, this will bring fruit from my work; yet I don’t know what I will choose.

kikuyu: Ani yaada kana lamaan gidduutti rarraʼeera; ani deemee Kiristoos wajjin jiraachuu nan hawwa; kun waan hunda caalaatii;
english: But I am hard pressed between the two, having the desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better.

kikuyu: isiniif garuu fooniin turuun koo caalaa barbaachisaa dha.
english: Yet to remain in the flesh is more needful for your sake.

kikuyu: Anis kana amanadhee akka isin amantiin guddattanii fi akka isin gammaddaniif hunda keessan bira akka turu, isin wajjinis akka jiraadhun beeka.
english: Having this confidence, I know that I will remain, yes, and remain with you all for your progress and joy in the faith,

kikuyu: Kunis ani ammas isin biratti argamuu kootiin of jajuun isin Kiristoos Yesuusitti qabdan sababii kootiin akka baayʼatuuf.
english: that your boasting may abound in Christ Jesus in me through my presence with you again.

kikuyu: Waan fedhe iyyuu taʼu akka wangeela Kiristoosiif malutti jiraadhaa. Yoos ani dhufee isin arguunis taʼu yookaan fagoo taaʼee waaʼee keessan dhagaʼuu qofaan, akka isin amantii wangeelaatiif jettanii akkuma nama tokkootti tattaaffachuun hafuura tokkoon jabaattanii dhaabattan nan beeka.
english: Only let your way of life be worthy of the Good News of Christ, that whether I come and see you or am absent, I may hear of your state, that you stand firm in one spirit, with one soul striving for the faith of the Good News;

kikuyu: Isin waanuma tokkoon illee mormitoota keessaniin hin raafaminaa. Kun isaaniif mallattoo badiisaa ti; isiniif immoo mallattoo fayyinaa ti; kunis hojii Waaqaa ti.
english: and in nothing frightened by the adversaries, which is for them a proof of destruction, but to you of salvation, and that from God.

kikuyu: Isin akka Kiristoositti amantan qofa utuu hin taʼin akka isaaf jettanii dhiphattaniifis kun isaaf jechaa isinii kennameeraatii;
english: Because it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ, not only to believe in him, but also to suffer on his behalf,

kikuyu: kunis walʼaansoo ani keessa ture isa argitan sanaa fi isa ani amma iyyuu keessa jiru kan dhageessan kana keessa darbuutti waan jirtaniifii dha.
english: having the same conflict which you saw in me and now hear is in me.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu gorsa Kiristoosiin qabdan kam iyyuu taanaan, jaalalaan wal jajjabeessuu kam iyyuu taanaan, tokkummaa Hafuuraa kam iyyuu taanaan, araaraa fi gara laafina kam iyyuu taanaan,
english: If therefore there is any exhortation in Christ, if any consolation of love, if any fellowship of the Spirit, if any tender mercies and compassion,

kikuyu: gammachuu koo naa guutaa; yaadaan tokko taʼaa; jaalala tokko qabaadhaa; hafuuraa fi kaayyoon tokko taʼaa.
english: make my joy full by being like-minded, having the same love, being of one accord, of one mind;

kikuyu: Isin gad of qabuudhaan akka waan warri kaan isin caalaniitti ilaalaa malee fedhii ofittummaatiin yookaan of tuulummaatiin waanuma tokko illee hin hojjetinaa.
english: doing nothing through rivalry or through conceit, but in humility, each counting others better than himself;

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon keessan waan warra kaaniifis taʼu malee waan isin qofaaf taʼu hin ilaalinaa.
english: each of you not just looking to his own things, but each of you also to the things of others.

kikuyu: Yaadni Kiristoos Yesuus keessa ture sun, isin keessas haa jiraatu.
english: Have this in your mind, which was also in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Inni utuma bifa Waaqaatiin jiruu, wal qixxummaa Waaqa wajjin qabu akka waan irraa fudhatameetti hin lakkoofne;
english: who, existing in the form of God, didn’t consider equality with God a thing to be grasped,

kikuyu: qooda kanaa inni bifa garbaa uffatee fakkaattii namaa fudhachuudhaan duwwaa of godhe.
english: but emptied himself, taking the form of a servant, being made in the likeness of men.

kikuyu: Bifa namaa uffatee argamuudhaanis, gad of deebise; duʼaaf jechuunis duʼa fannoo irraatiif iyyuu ni ajajame!
english: And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqni akka malee ol isa qabe; maqaa maqaa hunda caalus isaaf kenne.
english: Therefore God also highly exalted him, and gave to him the name which is above every name,

kikuyu: Kunis akka jilbi hundinuu samii fi lafa irratti, lafa jalattis, maqaa Yesuusiif jilbeenfatuuf.
english: that at the name of Jesus every knee should bow, of those in heaven, those on earth, and those under the earth,

kikuyu: Akka arrabni hundinuus ulfina Waaqa Abbaatiif jedhee Yesuus Kiristoos Gooftaa taʼuu isaa dhugaa baʼuuf.
english: and that every tongue should confess that Jesus Christ is Lord, to the glory of God the Father.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa jaallatamoo, akkuma yeroo hunda ajajamtan sana, yeroo ani isin bira jiru qofa utuu hin taʼin amma yeroo ani isin bira hin jirretti caalchisaatii sodaa fi hollannaan fayyina keessan fiixaan baasuuf itti fufaa;
english: So then, my beloved, even as you have always obeyed, not only in my presence, but now much more in my absence, work out your own salvation with fear and trembling.

kikuyu: akkuma kaayyoo isaa gaarii sanaatti fedhuu fi hojjechuu isin keessatti kan raawwatu Waaqaatii.
english: For it is God who works in you both to will and to work for his good pleasure.

kikuyu: Waan hunda guungummii fi falmii malee hojjedhaa;
english: Do all things without complaining and arguing,

kikuyu: kunis akka isin dhaloota micciiramaa fi jalʼaa kana gidduutti akkuma ifaa addunyaa keessatti ibsitaniif, akka warra mudaa hin qabnee fi qulqullaaʼoo, ijoollee Waaqaa warra yakka hin qabnes taataniif,
english: that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse generation, among whom you are seen as lights in the world,

kikuyu: yoo isin dubbii jireenyaa jabeessitanii qabattan ani akkasumaan akka hin fiigin yookaan akkasumaan akka hin dadhabin guyyaa Kiristoositti of jajuu nan dandaʼa.
english: holding up the word of life, that I may have something to boast in the day of Christ that I didn’t run in vain nor labor in vain.

kikuyu: Ani utuu aarsaa fi tajaajila amantii keessanii irratti akka dhibaayyuutti dhangalaafamee iyyuu nan gammada; hunda keessan wajjinis nan gammada.
english: Yes, and if I am poured out on the sacrifice and service of your faith, I am glad and rejoice with you all.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isinis na wajjin gammaduu fi ililchuu qabdu.
english: In the same way, you also should be glad and rejoice with me.

kikuyu: Ani oduu waaʼee keessanii dhagaʼee gammaduuf, akka ani dafee Xiimotewosin gara keessanitti erguu dandaʼu Gooftaa Yesuusin nan abdadha.
english: But I hope in the Lord Jesus to send Timothy to you soon, that I also may be cheered up when I know how you are doing.

kikuyu: Ani nama biraa kan akka isaa waaʼee keessan garaa qulqulluun yaadu tokko illee hin qabu.
english: For I have no one else like-minded, who will truly care about you.

kikuyu: Sababiin isaas warri kaan hundi utuu fedhii Yesuus Kiristoosiif hin taʼin fedhii mataa isaaniitiif yaaduutii.
english: For they all seek their own, not the things of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Xiimotewos garuu akkuma ilmi abbaa isaa tajaajilutti hojii wangeelaa keessatti na wajjin tajaajiluu isaa akka of mirkaneesse isinuu beektu.
english: But you know that he has proved himself. As a child serves a father, so he served with me in furtherance of the Good News.

kikuyu: Kanaaf ani akkuma haala koo hubadheen isa erguuf nan abdadha.
english: Therefore I hope to send him at once, as soon as I see how it will go with me.

kikuyu: Ani mataan koo iyyuu dafee dhufuuf Gooftaa nan amanadha.
english: But I trust in the Lord that I myself also will come shortly.

kikuyu: Ani garuu obboleessa koo Ephafroodiixuu hojjetaa hidhata koo taʼee fi loltuu hidhata koo taʼe, ergamaa keessan kan isin akka inni waan na barbaachisuun na tajaajiluuf ergitan sana deebisee gara keessan erguun barbaachisaa natti fakkaata.
english: But I thought it necessary to send to you Epaphroditus, my brother, fellow worker, fellow soldier, and your apostle and servant of my need,

kikuyu: Inni hunda keessan yaadaatii; isin akka inni dhukkubsatee ture waan dhageessaniifis dhiphachaa jira.
english: since he longed for you all, and was very troubled because you had heard that he was sick.

kikuyu: Inni dhugumaan dhukkubsatee duʼuu gaʼee ture. Waaqni garuu isa maareera; utuu isa qofa hin taʼin akka gaddi gadda irratti natti hin dabalamneef anas baraareera.
english: For indeed he was sick nearly to death, but God had mercy on him, and not on him only, but on me also, that I might not have sorrow on sorrow.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isin akka yommuu lammata isa argitanitti gammaddanii fi akka yaaddoon koos naa salphatuuf dafee gara keessanitti isa erguu guddaa nan hawwa.
english: I have sent him therefore the more diligently, that when you see him again, you may rejoice, and that I may be the less sorrowful.

kikuyu: Isinis Gooftaadhaan gammachuu guddaan isa simadhaa; namoota akkasiis kabajaa;
english: Receive him therefore in the Lord with all joy, and hold such people in honor,

kikuyu: inni gargaarsa isin naa kennuu hin dandaʼin naa kennuuf, jireenya isaa illee dabarsee kennuun, hojii Kiristoosiif jedhee duʼuu iyyuu gaʼee tureetii.
english: because for the work of Christ he came near to death, risking his life to supply that which was lacking in your service toward me.

kikuyu: Dhuma irrattis yaa obboloota ko, Gooftaatti gammadaa! Ani waanuma kanaan duraa irra deebiʼee isinii barreessuun na hin dhibu; kun isiniif eegumsa.
english: Finally, my brothers, rejoice in the Lord! To write the same things to you, to me indeed is not tiresome, but for you it is safe.

kikuyu: Saroota irraa of eeggadhaa; namoota hammina hojjetan irraa of eeggadhaa; dhagna qabaa sobaa irraas of eeggadhaa.
english: Beware of the dogs; beware of the evil workers; beware of the false circumcision.

kikuyu: Sababiin isaa nu warri Hafuura Waaqaatiin waaqeffannu, warri Kiristoos Yesuusiin of jajnuu fi warri foon hin amananne dhagna qabanneerraatii;
english: For we are the circumcision, who worship God in the Spirit, and rejoice in Christ Jesus, and have no confidence in the flesh;

kikuyu: taʼus ani mataan koo amanachuu akkanaatiif sababii qaba. Namni biraa kam iyyuu foon amanachuuf waan sababii qabu yoo of seʼe, ani immoo isa caalaa qaba:
english: though I myself might have confidence even in the flesh. If any other man thinks that he has confidence in the flesh, I yet more:

kikuyu: Ani dhaladhee guyyaa saddeettaffaattin dhagna qabadhe; sanyii Israaʼel keessaas gosa Beniyaam irraa dhaladhe; warra Ibrootaa keessaas Ibricha tokkoo dha; akka seeraattis ani Fariisota keessaa tokko dha;
english: circumcised the eighth day, of the stock of Israel, of the tribe of Benjamin, a Hebrew of Hebrews; concerning the law, a Pharisee;

kikuyu: waaʼee hinaaffaa, ani waldaa kiristaanaa ariʼachaan ture; waaʼee qajeelummaa seera eeguun argamuus ani mudaa hin qabu ture.
english: concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

kikuyu: Garuu waan na fayyadaa ture amma Kiristoosiif jedhee akka waan gatii hin qabneetti nan ilaala.
english: However, I consider those things that were gain to me as a loss for Christ.

kikuyu: Dhugumaanuu sababii Gooftaa koo Kiristoos Yesuus isa waan hundumaa caalu sana beekuutiif ani waan hundumaa akka waan gatii hin qabneetti nan ilaala. Ani isaaf jedhee waan hundumaa dhabeera; Kiristoosin argachuufis waan hundumaa akka kosiitti nan ilaala;
english: Yes most certainly, and I count all things to be a loss for the excellency of the knowledge of Christ Jesus, my Lord, for whom I suffered the loss of all things, and count them nothing but refuse, that I may gain Christ

kikuyu: kunis qajeelummaa mataa koo kan seera eeguun argamu utuu hin taʼin qajeelummaa Kiristoositti amanuun argamu jechuunis akka ani qajeelummaa Waaqa biraa amantiidhaan dhufu qabaadhee isa keessa jiraadhuuf.
english: and be found in him, not having a righteousness of my own, that which is of the law, but that which is through faith in Christ, the righteousness which is from God by faith,

kikuyu: Ani Kiristoosii fi humna duʼaa kaʼuu isaa beekuu, dhiphina isaa keessatti hirmaachuu fi duʼa isaatiinis isa fakkaachuu nan barbaada;
english: that I may know him and the power of his resurrection, and the fellowship of his sufferings, becoming conformed to his death,

kikuyu: akkasiinis ani duʼaa kaʼuu warra duʼanii argachuu nan dandaʼa.
english: if by any means I may attain to the resurrection from the dead.

kikuyu: Kiristoos Yesuus waan kan ofii isaa na godhateef anis waan kana harkatti galfachuuf nan fiiga jechuudha malee waan kana hunda argadheera yookaan nama hirʼina hin qabne taʼeera jechuu miti.
english: Not that I have already obtained, or am already made perfect; but I press on, that I may take hold of that for which also I was taken hold of by Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, ani akka waan harkatti isa galfadheetti hin ilaalu. Waan tokko garuu nan godha: Waan na duuba jiru irraanfadhee gara waan fuula koo dura jiruutti nan hiixadha;
english: Brothers, I don’t regard myself as yet having taken hold, but one thing I do: forgetting the things which are behind and stretching forward to the things which are before,

kikuyu: badhaasa Waaqni Kiristoos Yesuusiin ol samiitti itti na waame sana argachuuf gara kaayyoo sanaatti nan fiiga.
english: I press on toward the goal for the prize of the high calling of God in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Nu warri bilchaatoon hundinuu waan akkanaa haa yaadnu. Yoo waan tokko tokko irratti yaada garaa garaa qabaattan garuu kanas Waaqni isinii ibsa.
english: Let us therefore, as many as are perfect, think this way. If in anything you think otherwise, God will also reveal that to you.

kikuyu: Taʼus waanuma kanaan dura irra geenye sanaan haa jiraannu.
english: Nevertheless, to the extent that we have already attained, let’s walk by the same rule. Let’s be of the same mind.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, fakkeenya koo duukaa buʼuudhaan warra kaaniin tokko taʼaa; warra fakkeenya nu isinii kennineen jiraatanis hubadhaa.
english: Brothers, be imitators together of me, and note those who walk this way, even as you have us for an example.

kikuyu: Akkuma ani yeroo hedduu isinitti himee fi akkuma ani amma illee imimmaaniin iyyuu isinitti himu, namoonni baayʼeen diinota fannoo Kiristoos taʼanii jiraatuutii.
english: For many walk, of whom I told you often, and now tell you even weeping, as the enemies of the cross of Christ,

kikuyu: Dhumni isaanii badiisa; Waaqni isaanii garaa isaanii ti; ulfinni isaanii salphina isaaniitiin. Yaadni isaaniis waanuma lafaa irratti hundeeffama.
english: whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.

kikuyu: Nu garuu biyyi keenya samii irra. Fayyisaa achii dhufu, Gooftaa Yesuus Kiristoos eegganna;
english: For our citizenship is in heaven, from where we also wait for a Savior, the Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: innis humna waan hunda of jala galfachuu isa dandeessisu sanaan akka dhagni keenya inni dadhabaan dhagna isaa ulfina qabeessa sana fakkaatuuf dhagna keenya ni geeddara.
english: who will change the body of our humiliation to be conformed to the body of his glory, according to the working by which he is able even to subject all things to himself.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa obboloota ko, isin warri ani jaalladhuu fi warri ani yaadu, warri gammachuu kootii fi gonfoo koos taatan, yaa michoota ko, akkanatti Gooftaatti jabaadhaa dhaabadhaa!
english: Therefore, my brothers, beloved and longed for, my joy and crown, stand firm in the Lord in this way, my beloved.

kikuyu: Ani akka isaan Gooftaadhaan yaada tokko qabaataniif Ewoodiyaanin nan kadhadha; Sinxiikeenis nan kadhadha.
english: I exhort Euodia, and I exhort Syntyche, to think the same way in the Lord.

kikuyu: Yaa hidhata dhugaa, dubartoonni kunneen Qaleeminxoosii fi warra na wajjin hojjetan kanneen maqaan isaanii kitaaba jireenyaa keessatti barreeffame kaan wajjin waan hojii wangeelaa keessatti na wajjin dadhabaniif akka ati isaan gargaartuuf sin kadhadha.
english: Yes, I beg you also, true partner, help these women, for they labored with me in the Good News with Clement also, and the rest of my fellow workers, whose names are in the book of life.

kikuyu: Isin yeroo hunda Gooftaatti gammadaa. Ammas ani irra deebiʼee nan jedha, gammadaa!
english: Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

kikuyu: Garraamummaan keessan nama hundumaa biratti haa beekamu. Gooftaan dhiʼoo jira.
english: Let your gentleness be known to all men. The Lord is at hand.

kikuyu: Waan hundumaa keessatti Waaqa kadhachuu fi waammataan, galata wajjinis gaaffii keessan Waaqatti dhiʼeeffadhaa malee waan tokko illee hin yaaddaʼinaa.
english: In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God.

kikuyu: Nagaan Waaqaa kan hubannaa hundaa ol taʼe sun karaa Kiristoos Yesuusiin qalbii fi yaada keessan ni eega.
english: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Dhuma irrattis yaa obboloota, wanni dhugaa taʼe kam iyyuu, wanni ulfina qabeessa taʼe kam iyyuu, wanni qajeelaa taʼe kam iyyuu, wanni qulqulluu taʼe kam iyyuu, wanni jaallatamaa taʼe kam iyyuu, wanni gurra namaatti tolu kam iyyuu, wanni gaarii taʼe yookaan galateeffamaa taʼe kam iyyuu yoo jiraate isin waan akkanaa yaadaa.
english: Finally, brothers, whatever things are true, whatever things are honorable, whatever things are just, whatever things are pure, whatever things are lovely, whatever things are of good report: if there is any virtue and if there is anything worthy of praise, think about these things.

kikuyu: Isin waan narraa barattan yookaan narraa argattan yookaan narraa dhageessan yookaan narratti argitan hunda isinis akkasuma godhaa. Waaqni nagaa isin wajjin ni taʼa.
english: Do the things which you learned, received, heard, and saw in me, and the God of peace will be with you.

kikuyu: Sababii isin dhuma irratti deebitanii naa yaaduu jalqabdaniif ani Gooftaatti baayʼee nan gammada. Dhugumaanuu carraa ittiin argisiiftan dhabdaniiti malee isin durumaanuu naa yaadaa turtan.
english: But I rejoice in the Lord greatly that now at length you have revived your thought for me; in which you did indeed take thought, but you lacked opportunity.

kikuyu: Ani waan waa dhabeef akkana jechaa hin jiru; haala kam iyyuu keessatti na gaʼa jechuu baradheeraatii.
english: Not that I speak because of lack, for I have learned in whatever state I am, to be content in it.

kikuyu: Ani dhabuun maal akka taʼe beeka; baayʼee qabaachuunis maal akka taʼe nan beeka. Haala kam iyyuu keessatti, waan hunda keessattis icciitii quufuutii fi beelaʼuu, baayʼee qabaachuutii fi dhabuu baradheera.
english: I know how to be humbled, and I also know how to abound. In any and all circumstances I have learned the secret both to be filled and to be hungry, both to abound and to be in need.

kikuyu: Ani isa humna naa kennu sanaan waan hunda gochuu nan dandaʼa.
english: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me.

kikuyu: Haa taʼuu malee rakkina koo keessatti hirmaachuun keessan waan gaarii gochuu keessan ture.
english: However you did well that you shared in my affliction.

kikuyu: Kana malees isin warri Fiiliphisiyuus akkuma beektan, jalqabatti yeroo ani wangeela isinitti lallabetti, yeroo ani Maqedooniyaadhaa kaʼetti isin qofa malee waldaan kiristaanaa tokko iyyuu waaʼee kennuu fi fudhachuu keessatti na wajjin hin hirmaanne.
english: You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no assembly shared with me in the matter of giving and receiving but you only.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani Tasaloniiqee turetti illee yommuu ani rakkadhetti isin yeroo tokkoo ol gargaarsa naaf ergitaniituutii.
english: For even in Thessalonica you sent once and again to my need.

kikuyu: Kunis akka buʼaan isiniif baayʼatu barbaadeen malee ani kennaa keessan barbaadee miti.
english: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.

kikuyu: Ani kaffaltii guutuu argadhee caalaa iyyuu qabaadheera; kennaa isin ergitanis Ephafroodiixuu harkaa fudhadhee hamma na gaʼu argadheera. Kunis kennaa urgaaʼaa fi qalma fudhatamaa Waaqa gammachiisuu dha.
english: But I have all things and abound. I am filled, having received from Epaphroditus the things that came from you, a sweet-smelling fragrance, an acceptable and well-pleasing sacrifice to God.

kikuyu: Waaqni koos akkuma badhaadhummaa isaa ulfina qabeessa sanaatti waan isin barbaachisu hunda Kiristoos Yesuusiin isiniif guuta.
english: My God will supply every need of yours according to his riches in glory in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Waaqa keenyaa fi Abbaa keenyaaf bara baraa hamma bara baraatti ulfinni haa taʼu. Ameen.
english: Now to our God and Father be the glory forever and ever! Amen.

kikuyu: Kiristoos Yesuusiin qulqulloota hundatti nagaa naa himaa. Obboloonni na wajjin jiranis nagaa isinii dhaamu.
english: Greet every saint in Christ Jesus. The brothers who are with me greet you.

kikuyu: Qulqulloonni hundinuu, keessumattuu warri mana Qeesaarii jiraatan nagaa isinii dhaamu.
english: All the saints greet you, especially those who are of Caesar’s household.

kikuyu: Ayyaanni Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos hafuura keessan wajjin haa taʼu. Ameen.
english: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Phaawulos isa fedhii Waaqaatiin ergamaa Kiristoos Yesuus taʼee fi obboleessa keenya Xiimotewos irraa,
english: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus through the will of God, and Timothy our brother,

kikuyu: Gara qulqulloota, obboloota Kiristoosiin amanamoo taʼan kanneen Qolosaayis jiraataniitti:
english: to the saints and faithful brothers in Christ at Colossae: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Nu yommuu isiniif kadhannutti Waaqa, Abbaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos yeroo hunda ni galateeffanna;
english: We give thanks to God the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, praying always for you,

kikuyu: amantii isin Kiristoos Yesuusitti qabdanii fi jaalala isin qulqulloota hundaaf qabdan sana dhageenyeerraatii;
english: having heard of your faith in Christ Jesus and of the love which you have toward all the saints,

kikuyu: kunis sababii abdii samii keessatti isinii kuufame sanaatiif; isin waaʼee abdii kanaa duraanuu dubbii dhugaa, wangeela keessatti dhageessaniirtu;
english: because of the hope which is laid up for you in the heavens, of which you heard before in the word of the truth of the Good News

kikuyu: wangeelli kunis isin bira gaʼeera. Wangeelli kunis gaafa isin isa dhageessanii dhugumaan ayyaana Waaqaa hubattanii jalqabee akkuma isin gidduutti hojjechaa ture sana addunyaa guutuu keessattis ija naqachaa fi guddachaa jira.
english: which has come to you, even as it is in all the world and is bearing fruit and growing, as it does in you also, since the day you heard and knew the grace of God in truth,

kikuyu: Kanas tajaajilaa jaallatamaa hidhata keenya taʼe Ephaafiraa irraa barattaniirtu; innis Kiristoosiif tajaajilaa amanamaa taʼee iddoo keenya kan buʼee dha;
english: even as you learned from Epaphras our beloved fellow servant, who is a faithful servant of Christ on your behalf,

kikuyu: inni waaʼee jaalala keessan kan Hafuurri isinii kenne sanaas nutti himeera.
english: who also declared to us your love in the Spirit.

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf nu gaafa waaʼee keessan dhageenyee jalqabnee isinii kadhachuu fi akka Waaqni karaa ogummaatii fi hubannaa hafuuraa hundaan beekumsa fedhii isaatiin isin guutu kadhachuu hin dhiifne.
english: For this cause, we also, since the day we heard this, don’t cease praying and making requests for you, that you may be filled with the knowledge of his will in all spiritual wisdom and understanding,
