kikuyu: Kunis akka isin hojii gaarii hundaan ija naqachaa, Waaqa beekuudhaanis guddachaa, jireenya Gooftaaf maluu fi kan karaa hundaan isa gammachiisu jiraattaniif;
english: that you may walk worthily of the Lord, to please him in all respects, bearing fruit in every good work and increasing in the knowledge of God,

kikuyu: isinis jajjabinaa fi obsa guddaa akka qabaattaniif, akkuma aangoo isaa ulfina qabeessa sanaatti humna hundaan jabaachaa, gammadaas
english: strengthened with all power, according to the might of his glory, for all endurance and perseverance with joy,

kikuyu: Waaqa Abbaa kan akka isin mootummaa ifaa keessatti qulqulloota wajjin dhaala keessatti hirmaattan isin dandeessise sana galateeffadhaa.
english: giving thanks to the Father, who made us fit to be partakers of the inheritance of the saints in light,

kikuyu: Inni taayitaa dukkanaa jalaa nu baasee gara mootummaa Ilma inni jaallatuutti nu dabarseeraatii;
english: who delivered us out of the power of darkness, and translated us into the Kingdom of the Son of his love,

kikuyu: nus isumaan furama, jechuunis dhiifama cubbuu arganneerra.
english: in whom we have our redemption, the forgiveness of our sins.

kikuyu: Inni fakkaattii Waaqa hin mulʼanne sanaa ti; uumama hundaafis hangafa.
english: He is the image of the invisible God, the firstborn of all creation.

kikuyu: Wanni hundinuu isumaan uumameetii: Wanni samii keessaa fi lafa irraa, wanni mulʼatuu fi hin mulʼanne, teessoowwan yookaan humnoonni yookaan bulchitoonni yookaan taayitaawwan, wanni hundinuu isumaan, isumaaf uumaman.
english: For by him all things were created in the heavens and on the earth, visible things and invisible things, whether thrones or dominions or principalities or powers. All things have been created through him and for him.

kikuyu: Inni waan hunda dura jira; wanni hundinuu isumaan wal qabatee dhaabata.
english: He is before all things, and in him all things are held together.

kikuyu: Inni mataa dhagna isaa, mataa waldaa kiristaanaa ti; waan hunda irratti ol aantummaa akka qabaatuufis inni kan jalqabaa ti; warra duʼan keessaa kaafamuudhaanis hangafa.
english: He is the head of the body, the assembly, who is the beginning, the firstborn from the dead, that in all things he might have the preeminence.

kikuyu: Waaqni guutummaan isaa hundi isa keessa jiraachuu isaatti gammadeeraatii;
english: For all the fullness was pleased to dwell in him,

kikuyu: dhiiga isaa kan fannoo irratti dhangalaʼe sanaanis nagaa buusuudhaan waan lafa irra jiru yookaan waan samii keessa jiru hunda karaa isaatiin ofitti araarseeraatii.
english: and through him to reconcile all things to himself by him, whether things on the earth or things in the heavens, having made peace through the blood of his cross.

kikuyu: Isinis dur amala keessan hamaa sanaan Waaqatti orma taatanii yaada keessaniinis diinota turtan.
english: You, being in past times alienated and enemies in your mind in your evil deeds,

kikuyu: Amma garuu qulqulloota mudaa hin qabnee fi warra hirʼina hin qabne godhee fuula isaa duratti isin dhiʼeessuuf dhagna foon Kiristoosiin, karaa duʼa isaatiin isin araarseera;
english: yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,

kikuyu: kunis yoo isin amantii keessaniin itti fuftan, yoo jabaattanii dhaabattanii fi yoo isin abdii wangeelaa irraa hin sochoone taʼa. Wangeelli kunis isuma isin dhageessanii fi isuma samii gaditti uumama hundatti lallabamee dha; ani Phaawulosis wangeeluma kanaaf tajaajilaa taʼeera.
english: if it is so that you continue in the faith, grounded and steadfast, and not moved away from the hope of the Good News which you heard, which was proclaimed in all creation under heaven, of which I, Paul, was made a servant.

kikuyu: Ani amma isiniif dhiphachuu kootti nan gammada; waan dhiphina Kiristoos dhagna isaatiif jechuunis waldaa kiristaanaatiif jedhee dhiphate sana keessaa hirʼates ani foon kootiin nan guuta.
english: Now I rejoice in my sufferings for your sake, and fill up on my part that which is lacking of the afflictions of Christ in my flesh for his body’s sake, which is the assembly,

kikuyu: Ergama Waaqni natti kenneen ani akka dubbii Waaqaa guutummaatti isinii dhiʼeessuuf tajaajilaa waldaa kiristaanaa taʼeera;
english: of which I was made a servant according to the stewardship of God which was given me toward you to fulfill the word of God,

kikuyu: dubbiin kunis icciitii barootaa fi dhaloota jalaa dhokfamee turee dha; amma garuu qulqulloota isaatti mulʼifameera.
english: the mystery which has been hidden for ages and generations. But now it has been revealed to his saints,

kikuyu: Waaqni badhaadhummaan ulfina icciitii kanaa hammam guddaa akka taʼe Namoota Ormaa gidduutti qulqulloota isaatti beeksisuu filateera; icciitiin kunis Kiristoos, abdii ulfinaa isa isin keessa jiruu dha.
english: to whom God was pleased to make known what are the riches of the glory of this mystery among the Gentiles, which is Christ in you, the hope of glory.

kikuyu: Nus isuma lallabna; nama hunda kan guutumaan guutuutti Kiristoositti bilchaataa taʼe akka dhiʼeessinuuf, tokkoo tokkoo namaa ogummaa hundaan gorsaa barsiisna.
english: We proclaim him, admonishing every man and teaching every man in all wisdom, that we may present every man perfect in Christ Jesus;

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani akkuma hojii humna isaa kan ciminaan na keessatti hojjetu sanaatti carraaqaa nan dhimma.
english: for which I also labor, striving according to his working, which works in me mightily.

kikuyu: Akka ani isiniif, warra Lodooqiyaa jiranii fi warra fooniin fuula koo hin argin hundaafis jedhee hammam carraaqaa jiru isin akka beektan nan barbaada.
english: For I desire to have you know how greatly I struggle for you and for those at Laodicea, and for as many as have not seen my face in the flesh;

kikuyu: Kunis akka isaan jaalalaan tokko taʼanii garaan isaanii jajjabeeffamuuf, akka isaan badhaadhummaa hubannaa guutuu qabaatanii icciitii Waaqaa jechuunis Kiristoosin beekaniif;
english: that their hearts may be comforted, they being knit together in love, and gaining all riches of the full assurance of understanding, that they may know the mystery of God, both of the Father and of Christ,

kikuyu: badhaadhummaan ogummaa fi beekumsaa hundinuus isuma keessa dhokfameera.
english: in whom all the treasures of wisdom and knowledge are hidden.

kikuyu: Anis akka namni tokko iyyuu afaan tolee isin hin gowwoomsineef waan kana isinittin hima.
english: Now I say this that no one may delude you with persuasiveness of speech.

kikuyu: Ani yoon fooniin isin irraa fagaadhe illee hafuuraan isin wajjin waanan jiruuf, isin hammam naamusa qabeeyyii akka taatanii fi amantiin isin Kiristoositti qabdanis hammam cimaa akka taʼe arguu kootiif nan gammada.
english: For though I am absent in the flesh, yet I am with you in the spirit, rejoicing and seeing your order, and the steadfastness of your faith in Christ.

kikuyu: Yoos akkuma Kiristoos Yesuus Goofticha fudhattanitti isatti jiraadhaa;
english: As therefore you received Christ Jesus the Lord, walk in him,

kikuyu: akkuma barattan sanatti hidda keessan isa keessatti gad fageeffadhaatii isa irratti ijaaramaa; amantiittis jabaadhaa; galata guutee dhangalaʼus dhiʼeessaa.
english: rooted and built up in him and established in the faith, even as you were taught, abounding in it in thanksgiving.

kikuyu: Eenyu iyyuu barsiisa waaʼee Kiristoos irratti hundeeffameen utuu hin taʼin falaasama faayidaa hin qabnee fi gowwoomsaa, kan bartee namaatii fi qajeelfama addunyaa kanaa irratti hundeeffameen akka isin hin boojine of eeggadhaa.
english: Be careful that you don’t let anyone rob you through his philosophy and vain deceit, after the tradition of men, after the elemental spirits of the world, and not after Christ.

kikuyu: Guutummaan Waaqummaa hundinuu fooniin Kiristoos keessa jiraataatii;
english: For in him all the fullness of the Deity dwells bodily,

kikuyu: isinis Kiristoos isa humnaa fi taayitaa hunda irratti mataa taʼe sanaan guutamtaniirtu.
english: and in him you are made full, who is the head of all principality and power.

kikuyu: Isumaanis foon cubbamaa taʼe sana of irraa gattanii dhagna qabattaniirtu; dhagna qabaan kunis dhagna qabaa harka namaatiin taʼe utuu hin taʼin kan Kiristoosiin taʼee dha;
english: In him you were also circumcised with a circumcision not made with hands, in the putting off of the body of the sins of the flesh, in the circumcision of Christ,

kikuyu: isinis cuuphaadhaan isa wajjin awwaalamtanii humna Waaqaa kan Kiristoosin warra duʼan keessaa isa kaasetti amanuu keessaniin cuuphaadhuma sanaan isa wajjin kaafamtaniirtu.
english: having been buried with him in baptism, in which you were also raised with him through faith in the working of God, who raised him from the dead.

kikuyu: Yeroo isin cubbuu keessanii fi foon keessan kan dhagna hin qabamin sanaan duutanii turtanitti Waaqni Kiristoos wajjin jiraattota isin taasise. Cubbuu keenya hundas nuu dhiise;
english: You were dead through your trespasses and the uncircumcision of your flesh. He made you alive together with him, having forgiven us all our trespasses,

kikuyu: innis himata idaa keenya kan seeraa kan nuun mormuu fi nutti muru sana haqee mismaaraan fannootti diree dhabamsiise.
english: wiping out the handwriting in ordinances which was against us. He has taken it out of the way, nailing it to the cross.

kikuyu: Innis humnootaa fi taayitaawwan fannoodhaan moʼate hidhannoo hiikkachiisuudhaan ifa baasee uummatatti isaan argisiise.
english: Having stripped the principalities and the powers, he made a show of them openly, triumphing over them in it.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu eenyu iyyuu waan nyaattanii fi waan dhugdaniin yookaan waaʼee ayyaanaatiin yookaan waaʼee Baatii Haaraatiin yookaan waaʼee Sanbataatiin isinitti hin murin.
english: Let no one therefore judge you in eating or drinking, or with respect to a feast day or a new moon or a Sabbath day,

kikuyu: Isaan kunneen gaaddidduu waan dhufuuf jiruu ti; dhugaan isaa garuu Kiristoos keessa jira.
english: which are a shadow of the things to come; but the body is Christ’s.

kikuyu: Namni sobee gad of qabuu fi ergamoota waaqeffachuu jaallatu kam iyyuu badhaasa isin hin dhabsiisin. Namni akkasii waan arge hunda baayʼisee odeessa; sababii malee yaada foon isaatiin of tuula.
english: Let no one rob you of your prize by self-abasement and worshiping of the angels, dwelling in the things which he has not seen, vainly puffed up by his fleshly mind,

kikuyu: Innis mataa isa dhagni guutuun ittiin soorame, hiddaa fi ribuu isaatiinis walitti hidhamee guddina Waaqni kennuufiin guddatu sana irraa citeera.
english: and not holding firmly to the Head, from whom all the body, being supplied and knit together through the joints and ligaments, grows with God’s growth.

kikuyu: Isin erga Kiristoos wajjin qajeelfama hundee kan addunyaa kanaatiif duutanii maaliif akka waan amma iyyuu kan addunyaa taataniitti sirna isaatiif bultu ree?
english: If you died with Christ from the elemental spirits of the world, why, as though living in the world, do you subject yourselves to ordinances,

kikuyu: Innis, “Harkaan hin qabatin! Hin dhandhamin! Hin tuqin!” jedha.
english: “Don’t handle, nor taste, nor touch”

kikuyu: Isaanis waan ajajaa fi barsiisa namaa irratti hundeeffamaniif yeroo hojii irra oolanitti baduuf murteeffamaniiru.
english: (all of which perish with use), according to the precepts and doctrines of men?

kikuyu: Sirni kunis dhugumaan of dirqisiisuun waaqeffachuu isaanii, gad of qabuu sobaatii fi foon isaanii miidhuu isaaniitiin bifa ogummaa qaba; hawwii foonii dhowwuuf garuu faayidaa tokko illee hin qabu.
english: These things indeed appear like wisdom in self-imposed worship, humility, and severity to the body, but aren’t of any value against the indulgence of the flesh.

kikuyu: Egaa isin erga Kiristoos wajjin kaafamtanii waan ol gubbaa, mirga Waaqaa iddoo Kiristoos taaʼu sana jiru barbaadaa.
english: If then you were raised together with Christ, seek the things that are above, where Christ is, seated on the right hand of God.

kikuyu: Waan ol gubbaa yaadaa malee waan lafa irraa hin yaadinaa.
english: Set your mind on the things that are above, not on the things that are on the earth.

kikuyu: Duutaniirtuutii; jireenyi keessanis Kiristoos wajjin Waaqa keessa dhokfameera.
english: For you died, and your life is hidden with Christ in God.

kikuyu: Yommuu Kiristoos inni jireenya keessan taʼe sun mulʼatutti isinis isa wajjin ulfinaan ni mulʼattu.
english: When Christ, our life, is revealed, then you will also be revealed with him in glory.

kikuyu: Kanaaf hawwii addunyaa isa isin keessatti hojjechaa jiru hundumaa ajjeesaa; kunis halalummaa, xuraaʼummaa, dharraa foonii, hawwii hamaa fi sassattummaa isa waaqa tolfamaa waaqeffachuu taʼe sanaa dha.
english: Put to death therefore your members which are on the earth: sexual immorality, uncleanness, depraved passion, evil desire, and covetousness, which is idolatry.

kikuyu: Sababii kanaafis dheekkamsi Waaqaa warra hin ajajamnetti ni dhufa.
english: For these things’ sake the wrath of God comes on the children of disobedience.

kikuyu: Isinis jireenya dur jiraattan keessatti karuma akkasii irra deddeebiʼaa turtan.
english: You also once walked in those, when you lived in them,

kikuyu: Amma garuu waan akkasii hunda: aarii, dheekkamsa, hamminaa fi maqaa nama balleessuu of irraa fageessaa; dubbiin gadheenis afaan keessanii hin baʼin.
english: but now you must put them all away: anger, wrath, malice, slander, and shameful speaking out of your mouth.

kikuyu: Wal hin sobinaa; isin eenyummaa keessan isa moofaa sana hojii isaa wajjin of irraa baaftanii
english: Don’t lie to one another, seeing that you have put off the old man with his doings,

kikuyu: eenyummaa haaraa kan beekumsa fakkaattii Uumaa isaatiin haaromfamaa jirus uffattaniirtu.
english: and have put on the new man, who is being renewed in knowledge after the image of his Creator,

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf, nama Giriik yookaan Yihuudii, nama dhagna qabate yookaan kan dhagna hin qabatin, nama wallaalaa, nama jireenya isaa hin qajeelfatin, garba yookaan birmaduu jechuun hin jiru; Kiristoos garuu hunduma; hunduma keessas jira.
english: where there can’t be Greek and Jew, circumcision and uncircumcision, barbarian, Scythian, bondservant, or free person; but Christ is all, and in all.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isin akkuma warra Waaqaaf filatamanii qulqullaaʼanii fi jaallatamaniitti, gara laafummaa, arjummaa, gad of qabiisa, garraamummaa fi obsa qabaadhaa.
english: Put on therefore, as God’s chosen ones, holy and beloved, a heart of compassion, kindness, lowliness, humility, and perseverance;

kikuyu: Wal dandaʼaa; yoo eenyu iyyuu nama tokko illee irraa komii qabaate walii dhiisaa. Akkuma Gooftaan isinii dhiise sana isinis walii dhiisaa.
english: bearing with one another, and forgiving each other, if any man has a complaint against any; even as Christ forgave you, so you also do.

kikuyu: Kana hundumaa irrattis jaalala waan hundumaa tokkummaa hirʼina hin qabneen walitti hidhu qabaadhaa.
english: Above all these things, walk in love, which is the bond of perfection.

kikuyu: Nagaan Kiristoos kan isin akkuma kutaa dhagna tokkootti itti waamamtan sun garaa keessan keessatti haa moʼu. Warra galateeffattanis taʼaa.
english: And let the peace of God rule in your hearts, to which also you were called in one body, and be thankful.

kikuyu: Dubbiin Kiristoos baayʼinaan isin keessa haa jiraatu; ogummaa hundaan wal barsiisaa; wal gorsaas; faarfannaadhaan, weedduu galataatii fi faarfannaa Hafuuraatiin garaa keessan keessatti Waaqa galateeffadhaa.
english: Let the word of Christ dwell in you richly; in all wisdom teaching and admonishing one another with psalms, hymns, and spiritual songs, singing with grace in your heart to the Lord.

kikuyu: Dubbiinis taʼu hojiidhaan, waan hojjettan kam iyyuu maqaa Gooftaa Yesuusiin hojjedhaa; isumaanis Waaqa Abbaa galateeffadhaa.
english: Whatever you do, in word or in deed, do all in the name of the Lord Jesus, giving thanks to God the Father through him.

kikuyu: Yaa niitota, akka Gooftaaf taʼutti dhirsoota keessaniif ajajamaa.
english: Wives, be in subjection to your husbands, as is fitting in the Lord.

kikuyu: Yaa dhirsoota, isinis niitota keessan jaalladhaa; isaanittis hin hammaatinaa.
english: Husbands, love your wives, and don’t be bitter against them.

kikuyu: Yaa ijoolle, waan hundumaan abbootii fi haadhota keessaniif ajajamaa; kun Gooftaa gammachiisaatii.
english: Children, obey your parents in all things, for this pleases the Lord.

kikuyu: Yaa abbootii, isinis akka ijoolleen keessan abdii hin kutanneef tuttuqxanii isaan hin aarsinaa.
english: Fathers, don’t provoke your children, so that they won’t be discouraged.

kikuyu: Yaa garboota, isinis warra fooniin gooftota keessan taʼaniif waan hundaan ajajamaa; kanas yeroo isaan isin ilaalan qofa isaan gammachiisuuf utuu hin taʼin garaa qulqulluu fi Gooftaa sodaachuudhaan godhaa.
english: Servants, obey in all things those who are your masters according to the flesh, not just when they are looking, as men pleasers, but in singleness of heart, fearing God.

kikuyu: Waan hojjettan hunda akka waan namaaf hojjettaniitti utuu hin taʼin akka waan Gooftaaf hojjettaniitti garaa guutuudhaan hojjedhaa;
english: And whatever you do, work heartily, as for the Lord and not for men,

kikuyu: kunis sababii isin akka Gooftaa biraa badhaasa dhaalaa argattan beektaniif. Kan isin tajaajilaa jirtan Kiristoos Goofticha.
english: knowing that from the Lord you will receive the reward of the inheritance; for you serve the Lord Christ.

kikuyu: Namni balleessaa hojjetu kam iyyuu gatii balleessaa isaa ni argataatii; nama wal caalchisuunis hin jiru.
english: But he who does wrong will receive again for the wrong that he has done, and there is no partiality.

kikuyu: Yaa gooftota, isinis akka samii irraa Gooftaa qabdan waan beektaniif, garboota keessan qajeelummaa fi wal qixxummaadhaan bulchaa.
english: Masters, give to your servants that which is just and equal, knowing that you also have a Master in heaven.

kikuyu: Warra dammaqanii galateeffatan taʼuudhaan kadhannaatti jabaadhaa.
english: Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving,

kikuyu: Nu icciitii Kiristoos kan ani isaaf jedhee hidhamee jiru sana akka lallabnuuf Waaqni balbala dubbichaa akka nuu banu nuufis kadhadhaa.
english: praying together for us also, that God may open to us a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which I am also in bonds,

kikuyu: Anis akka narraa eegamutti ibsee akkan lallabuuf naa kadhadhaa.
english: that I may reveal it as I ought to speak.

kikuyu: Baricha furuudhaan warra alaa wajjin hubannaadhaan jiraadhaa.
english: Walk in wisdom toward those who are outside, redeeming the time.

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo namaatiif akkamitti akka deebii kennitan akka beektaniif dubbiin keessan yeroo hunda ayyaanaan kan guutame, soogiddaanis kan miʼeeffame haa taʼu.
english: Let your speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that you may know how you ought to answer each one.

kikuyu: Xikiqoos oduu waaʼee kootii hunda isinitti ni hima. Inni obboleessa jaallatamaa, tajaajilaa amanamaa fi Gooftaatti garbicha hidhata koo taʼee dha.
english: All my affairs will be made known to you by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

kikuyu: Anis akka isin haala nu keessa jirru beektanii fi akka inni garaa keessan jajjabeessuuf gara keessanitti isa ergeera.
english: I am sending him to you for this very purpose, that he may know your circumstances and comfort your hearts,

kikuyu: Innis obboleessa keenya amanamaa fi jaallatamaa isa garee keessan keessaa tokko taʼe Oneesimoos wajjin dhufa. Isaanis waan asitti taʼaa jiru hundumaa isinitti himu.
english: together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of you. They will make known to you everything that is going on here.

kikuyu: Arisxirokoos inni na wajjin hidhamee jiru nagaa isinii dhaama; Maarqos durbiin Barnaabaasis akkanuma nagaa isinii dhaama. Waaʼee isaas ajajni, “Yoo inni gara keessan dhufe isa simadhaa” jedhu isin gaʼeera.
english: Aristarchus, my fellow prisoner, greets you, and Mark the cousin of Barnabas (concerning whom you received instructions, “if he comes to you, receive him”),

kikuyu: Yesuus inni Yoosxoos jedhamus akkasuma nagaa isinii dhaama. Warra dhagna qabatan keessaas kanneen na wajjin mootummaa Waaqaatiif hojjetan isaanuma qofa; isaanis jajjabina guddaa naa taʼaniiru.
english: and Jesus who is called Justus. These are my only fellow workers for God’s Kingdom who are of the circumcision, men who have been a comfort to me.

kikuyu: Ephaafiraan inni isin keessaa tokko taʼee fi tajaajilaan Kiristoos Yesuus nagaa isinii dhaama. Innis akka isin fedhii Waaqaa hundaan bilchaatoo fi guutuu taatanii jabaattanii dhaabattaniif yeroo hunda kadhannaadhaan isinii dadhabaa jira.
english: Epaphras, who is one of you, a servant of Christ, salutes you, always striving for you in his prayers, that you may stand perfect and complete in all the will of God.

kikuyu: Ani akka inni isiniif, warra Lodooqiyaa fi magaalaa Heraapoolis jiraniifis hinaaffaa gaarii qabu dhugaa nan baʼaaf.
english: For I testify about him that he has great zeal for you, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

kikuyu: Luqaas ogeessi fayyaa michuun keenya jaallatamaanii fi Deemaas nagaa isinii dhaamu.
english: Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you.

kikuyu: Obboloota Lodooqiyaa jiranitti, akkasumas Niimfaa fi waldaa kiristaanaa kan mana ishee jirtutti nagaa naa himaa.
english: Greet the brothers who are in Laodicea, with Nymphas and the assembly that is in his house.

kikuyu: Erga xalayaan kun isinii dubbifamee booddee waldaa Kiristaanaa Lodooqiyaatti akka dubbifamu godhaa; isinis xalayaa Lodooqiyaadhaa dhufu dubbifadhaa.
english: When this letter has been read among you, cause it to be read also in the assembly of the Laodiceans, and that you also read the letter from Laodicea.

kikuyu: Arkiphaadhaanis, “Hojii Gooftaadhaan sitti kenname sana akka xumurtu mirkaneeffadhu” jedhaa.
english: Tell Archippus, “Take heed to the ministry which you have received in the Lord, that you fulfill it.”

kikuyu: Ani Phaawulos, xalayaa nagaa kana harkuma kootiin barreessa. Hidhamuu koo yaadadhaa. Ayyaanni isin wajjin haa taʼu.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand. Remember my chains. Grace be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Phaawulos, Silwaanosii fi Xiimotewos irraa,
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Nu kadhannaa keenya keessatti maqaa keessan dhoofnee yeroo hunda waaʼee hunda keessaniitiif Waaqa ni galateeffanna.
english: We always give thanks to God for all of you, mentioning you in our prayers,

kikuyu: Nu hojii amantii keessanii, dadhabbii jaalala keessanii fi obsa abdii keessanii kan Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoositti qabdan sana Waaqa keenyaa fi Abbaa keenya duratti ittuma fufnee ni yaadanna.
english: remembering without ceasing your work of faith and labor of love and perseverance of hope in our Lord Jesus Christ, before our God and Father.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota Waaqaan jaallatamtan, nu akka inni isin filate beeknaatii;
english: We know, brothers loved by God, that you are chosen,

kikuyu: wangeelli keenya humnaan, Hafuura Qulqulluu fi amansiisa guddaan malee dubbii afaanii qofaan gara keessan hin dhufneetii. Nu isiniif jennee akkamitti akka isin gidduu jiraanne ni beektu.
english: and that our Good News came to you not in word only, but also in power, and in the Holy Spirit and with much assurance. You know what kind of men we showed ourselves to be among you for your sake.

kikuyu: Isinis fakkeenya keenyaa fi fakkeenya Gooftaa duukaa buutaniirtu; utuma dhiphina guddaa keessa jirtanuus gammachuu Hafuurri Qulqulluun isinii kennuun dubbicha fudhattaniirtu.
english: You became imitators of us and of the Lord, having received the word in much affliction, with joy of the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: Kanaanis amantoota Maqedooniyaa fi Akaayaa jiran hundaaf fakkeenya taatanii jirtan.
english: so that you became an example to all who believe in Macedonia and in Achaia.

kikuyu: Dubbiin Gooftaa isin biraa baʼee Maqedooniyaa fi Akaayaa qofatti hin dhagaʼamne; amantiin isin Waaqatti qabdanis lafa hunda gaʼeera. Kanaafuu waaʼee isaa homaa dubbachuu nu hin barbaachisu;
english: For from you the word of the Lord has been declared, not only in Macedonia and Achaia, but also in every place your faith toward God has gone out, so that we need not say anything.

kikuyu: isin simannaa akkamii akka nuu gootan isaanuu ni dubbatuutii. Isaan akkamitti akka isin Waaqa jiraataa fi Waaqa dhugaa tajaajiluuf jettanii waaqota tolfamoo irraa gara Waaqaatti deebitanis ni himu;
english: For they themselves report concerning us what kind of a reception we had from you, and how you turned to God from idols to serve a living and true God,

kikuyu: akkasumas Ilma isaa isa inni warra duʼan keessaa kaase jechuunis Yesuus isa dheekkamsa dhufu jalaa nu baasu sana akka samii irraa eeggattan ni himu.
english: and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, isin bira dhufuun keenya sun akkasumaan akka hin taʼin isinuu ni beektu.
english: For you yourselves know, brothers, our visit to you wasn’t in vain,

kikuyu: Akkuma isin beektan nu kanaan dura Fiiliphisiyuusitti dhiphanneerra; akka malees qaaneffamneerra. Garuu yoo mormiin cimaan nu qunname illee gargaarsa Waaqa keenyaatiin wangeela isaa isinitti himuudhaaf ija jabina arganneerra.
english: but having suffered before and been shamefully treated, as you know, at Philippi, we grew bold in our God to tell you the Good News of God in much conflict.

kikuyu: Gorsi nu kenninus kan dogoggora yookaan xuraaʼummaa yookaan gowwoomsaa irraa dhufe miti.
english: For our exhortation is not of error, nor of uncleanness, nor in deception.

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa nu akka warra Waaqni wangeela imaanaa itti kennuuf qoratee fudhateetti dubbanna. Yaaliin keenyas Waaqa garaa keenya qoru sana gammachiisuuf malee nama gammachiisuuf miti.
english: But even as we have been approved by God to be entrusted with the Good News, so we speak—not as pleasing men, but God, who tests our hearts.

kikuyu: Akkuma isin beektanii fi akkuma Waaqnis dhugaa baʼu sana nu dubbii sossobbiitti hin fayyadamne; doqnummaa dhokfachuufis haguuggannee gara keessan hin dhufne.
english: For neither were we at any time found using words of flattery, as you know, nor a cloak of covetousness (God is witness),

kikuyu: Nu namoota irraa, isin irraas taʼu yookaan warra kaan irraa ulfina hin barbaanne. Nu akka ergamoota Kiristoosiitti baʼaa isinitti taʼuu ni dandeenya ture;
english: nor seeking glory from men (neither from you nor from others), when we might have claimed authority as apostles of Christ.

kikuyu: nu garuu akkuma haadha daaʼimman ishee kunuunfattu tokkoo taane. Garraamummaadhaan gidduu keessan jiraanne.
english: But we were gentle among you, like a nursing mother cherishes her own children.

kikuyu: Nu waan akka malee isin jaallanneef wangeela Waaqaa qofa utuu hin taʼin lubbuu keenya illee isinii kennuun fedhii keenya ture; isin nu biratti akka malee jaallatamoo turtaniitii.
english: Even so, affectionately longing for you, we were well pleased to impart to you not the Good News of God only, but also our own souls, because you had become very dear to us.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, isin dadhabbii fi dhiphina keenya ni yaadattuutii; nu yeroo wangeela Waaqaa isinii lallabnetti nama tokkotti illee akka baʼaa hin taaneef halkanii guyyaa hojjechaa turre.
english: For you remember, brothers, our labor and travail; for working night and day, that we might not burden any of you, we preached to you the Good News of God.

kikuyu: Nu hammam qulqullummaan, qajeelummaa fi mudaa malee isin warra amantan gidduu akka jiraanne isin dhugaa ni baatu; Waaqnis dhugaa baʼa.
english: You are witnesses with God how holy, righteously, and blamelessly we behaved ourselves toward you who believe.

kikuyu: Isin akka nu akkuma abbaan ijoollee isaa gorsee jajjabeessutti tokkoo tokkoo keessaniif taane ni beektuutii;
english: As you know, we exhorted, comforted, and implored every one of you, as a father does his own children,

kikuyu: kunis akka isin jireenya Waaqa isa mootummaa isaattii fi ulfina isaatti isin waamu sanaaf malu jiraattaniif.
english: to the end that you should walk worthily of God, who calls you into his own Kingdom and glory.

kikuyu: Isinis yommuu dubbii Waaqaa kan nurraa dhageessan sana fudhattanitti akkuma inni jirutti, akka dubbii Waaqaa kan isin warra amantan keessatti hojjetuutti fudhattan malee akka dubbii namaatti waan hin fudhatiniif nu utuu gargar hin kutin Waaqa galateeffanna.
english: For this cause we also thank God without ceasing that when you received from us the word of the message of God, you accepted it not as the word of men, but as it is in truth, God’s word, which also works in you who believe.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, isin fakkeenya waldoota kiristaanaa Waaqaa warra Kiristoos Yesuusitti jiran kanneen biyya Yihuudaa jiranii duukaa buutaniirtu; akkuma waldoonni kunneen harka Yihuudootaatti dhiphatan sana isinis harka namoota biyya keessaniitti dhiphattaniirtu;
english: For you, brothers, became imitators of the assemblies of God which are in Judea in Christ Jesus; for you also suffered the same things from your own countrymen, even as they did from the Jews

kikuyu: Yihuudoonni kunneen warra Gooftaa Yesuusii fi raajota ajjeesanii nu illee ariʼatanii dha. Isaan Waaqa hin gammachiisan; nama hundattis diina taʼu;
english: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets, and drove us out, and don’t please God, and are contrary to all men,

kikuyu: isaanis cubbuu isaanii guuttachuuf jedhanii akka nu akka Namoonni Ormaa fayyifamaniif itti hin dubbanne nu dhowwu. Dhuma irratti garuu dheekkamsi Waaqaa isaanitti dhufeera.
english: forbidding us to speak to the Gentiles that they may be saved, to fill up their sins always. But wrath has come on them to the uttermost.

kikuyu: Garuu yaa obboloota, erga yaadaan utuu hin taʼin fooniin yeroo gabaabaaf isin irraa gargar baanee jalqabnee fuula keessan arguuf hawwii guddaan caalchifnee dhamaane.
english: But we, brothers, being bereaved of you for a short season in presence, not in heart, tried even harder to see your face with great desire,

kikuyu: Nu gara keessan dhufuu barbaannee turreetii; dhugumaanuu ani Phaawulos yeroo baayʼee gara keessan dhufuu yaaleera; garuu Seexanatu nu dhowwe.
english: because we wanted to come to you—indeed, I, Paul, once and again—but Satan hindered us.

kikuyu: Yommuu Gooftaan keenya Yesuus Kiristoos dhufutti fuula isaa duratti abdiin keenya yookaan gammachuun keenya yookaan gonfoon nu ittiin of jajnu eenyu? Isinuma mitii?
english: For what is our hope, or joy, or crown of rejoicing? Isn’t it even you, before our Lord Jesus at his coming?

kikuyu: Isin ulfinaa fi gammachuu keenyaatii.
english: For you are our glory and our joy.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu waan hammana caalaa obsuu dadhabneef kophaa keenya Ateenaatti hafuun gaarii nutti fakkaate.
english: Therefore when we couldn’t stand it any longer, we thought it good to be left behind at Athens alone,

kikuyu: Nus obboleessa keenya Xiimotewos, tajaajilaa Waaqaa isa wangeela Kiristoosiitti hojjetaa hidhata keenya taʼe sana, akka inni amantii keessanitti isin cimsuu fi isin jajjabeessuuf ergineerra;
english: and sent Timothy, our brother and God’s servant in the Good News of Christ, to establish you and to comfort you concerning your faith,

kikuyu: kunis akka namni tokko iyyuu dhiphina kanaan hin jeeqamneef. Isinis akka nu waan kanaaf filatamne sirriitti beektu.
english: that no one would be moved by these afflictions. For you know that we are appointed to this task.

kikuyu: Yeroo isin bira turretti akka dhiphinni nurra gaʼu isinitti himaa turreetii. Innis akkuma isin beektan sana taʼe.
english: For most certainly, when we were with you, we told you beforehand that we are to suffer affliction, even as it happened, and you know.

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf ani yommuun kana caalaa obsuu dadhabetti waaʼee amantii keessanii baruuf jedheen isa erge. Tarii inni nama qoru sun isin qoree dadhabbiin keenyas faayidaa malee hafeera jedheen sodaadhe.
english: For this cause I also, when I couldn’t stand it any longer, sent that I might know your faith, for fear that by any means the tempter had tempted you, and our labor would have been in vain.

kikuyu: Amma garuu Xiimotewos isin biraa gara keenya dhufee waaʼee amantii keessaniitii fi waaʼee jaalala keessanii oduu gaarii nutti himeera. Akkasumas akka isin yeroo hunda yaada gaariidhaan nu yaaddanii fi akkuma nu isin arguu hawwinu sana akka isinis nu arguu hawwitan nutti himeera.
english: But Timothy has just now come to us from you, and brought us glad news of your faith and love, and that you have good memories of us always, longing to see us, even as we also long to see you.

kikuyu: Kanaaf yaa obboloota, nu dhiphinaa fi ariʼatama keenya hunda keessatti amantii keessaniin waaʼee keessan jajjabaanneerra.
english: For this cause, brothers, we were comforted over you in all our distress and affliction through your faith.

kikuyu: Yoo isin Gooftaatti cimtanii dhaabatan nu dhugumaan ni jiraannaatii.
english: For now we live, if you stand fast in the Lord.

kikuyu: Gammachuu sababii keessaniin fuula Waaqa keenyaa duratti qabnu hundaaf waaʼee keessaniif hammam Waaqa galateeffachuu dandeenya?
english: For what thanksgiving can we give again to God for you, for all the joy with which we rejoice for your sakes before our God,

kikuyu: Nu akka deebinee isin arginuu fi waan amantii keessan keessaa hirʼates akka isinii guutuu dandeenyuuf halkanii guyyaa cimsinee kadhanna.
english: night and day praying exceedingly that we may see your face and may perfect that which is lacking in your faith?

kikuyu: Ammas Waaqni keenyaa fi Abbaan keenya mataan isaa, Gooftaan keenya Yesuusis akka nu gara keessan dhufnu karaa nuuf haa qajeelchu.
english: Now may our God and Father himself, and our Lord Jesus Christ, direct our way to you.

kikuyu: Akkuma jaalalli nu isinii qabnu dabalaa deemu sana Gooftaan jaalala isin walii keessanii fi nama hundaaf qabdan isinii haa guddisuu; haa baayʼisus.
english: May the Lord make you to increase and abound in love toward one another and toward all men, even as we also do toward you,

kikuyu: Akka isin yommuu Gooftaan keenya Yesuus qulqulloota isaa hunda wajjin dhufutti fuula Waaqa keenyaatii fi Abbaa keenyaa duratti warra mudaa hin qabnee fi qulqulloota taataniifis inni garaa keessan haa jajjabeessu.
english: to the end he may establish your hearts blameless in holiness before our God and Father at the coming of our Lord Jesus with all his saints.

kikuyu: Kana malees yaa obboloota, Waaqa gammachiisuuf akkamitti akka jiraachuu qabdan nu isin barsiifneerra; isinis akkuma sanatti jiraachaa jirtu. Ammas akka ittuma caalchiftanii waan kana gootan Gooftaa Yesuusiin isin kadhanna; isin gorsinas.
english: Finally then, brothers, we beg and exhort you in the Lord Jesus, that as you received from us how you ought to walk and to please God, that you abound more and more.

kikuyu: Nu taayitaa Gooftaa Yesuusiin ajaja maalii akka isinii kennine beektuutii.
english: For you know what instructions we gave you through the Lord Jesus.

kikuyu: Fedhiin Waaqaa akka isin qulqullooftanii dha; kunis akka isin halalummaa irraa fagaattaniif;
english: For this is the will of God: your sanctification, that you abstain from sexual immorality,

kikuyu: tokkoon tokkoon keessan akkamitti akka karaa qulqulluu fi ulfina qabeessa taʼeen dhagna keessan eeggattan beekuu qabdu;
english: that each one of you know how to control his own body in sanctification and honor,

kikuyu: kunis akka ormoota Waaqa hin beekneetti hawwii fooniitiin hin taʼin;
english: not in the passion of lust, even as the Gentiles who don’t know God,

kikuyu: waan kanaanis namni tokko iyyuu obboleessa isaa hin miidhin yookaan hin gowwoomsin. Akkuma nu kanaan dura isinitti himnee isin akeekkachiifne sana, Gooftaan warra cubbuu akkasii hojjetan hunda haaloo baʼa.
english: that no one should take advantage of and wrong a brother or sister in this matter; because the Lord is an avenger in all these things, as also we forewarned you and testified.

kikuyu: Waaqni akka nu jireenya qulqulluu jiraannuuf malee akka xuroofnuuf nu hin waamneetii.
english: For God called us not for uncleanness, but in sanctification.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu namni gorsa kana tuffatu Waaqa Hafuura isaa Qulqulluu isinii kennu sana tuffata malee nama hin tuffatu.
english: Therefore he who rejects this doesn’t reject man, but God, who has also given his Holy Spirit to you.

kikuyu: Egaa waan Waaqni akka isin wal jaallattan isin barsiiseef waaʼee jaalala obbolummaa isinii barreessuu nu hin barbaachisu.
english: But concerning brotherly love, you have no need that one write to you. For you yourselves are taught by God to love one another,

kikuyu: Dhugumaan isin obboloota guutummaa Maqedooniyaa keessa jiran hunda ni jaallattu. Yaa obboloota, nu garuu akka kana caalaa isaan jaallattan isin gorsina;
english: for indeed you do it toward all the brothers who are in all Macedonia. But we exhort you, brothers, that you abound more and more;

kikuyu: akkuma nu kanaan dura isin ajajnetti tasgabbiin jiraachuuf tattaaffadhaa; harkuma keessaniin hojii keessan hojjetadhaa;
english: and that you make it your ambition to lead a quiet life, and to do your own business, and to work with your own hands, even as we instructed you,

kikuyu: kunis akka isin warra alaa biratti ulfina argattanii fi akka harka nama tokko illee hin eegganneef.
english: that you may walk properly toward those who are outside, and may have need of nothing.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, nu akka isin waaʼee warra rafan sanaa wallaaltan yookaan akka namoota abdii hin qabne kaaniitti gadditan hin barbaannu.
english: But we don’t want you to be ignorant, brothers, concerning those who have fallen asleep, so that you don’t grieve like the rest, who have no hope.

kikuyu: Nu erga akka Yesuus duʼee duʼaa kaʼe amannee akkasuma immoo Waaqni warra Yesuusitti amananii rafan sana akka isuma wajjin kaasu ni amanna.
english: For if we believe that Jesus died and rose again, even so God will bring with him those who have fallen asleep in Jesus.

kikuyu: Wanni nu akka dubbii Gooftaatti isinitti himnu kana; nu warri lubbuun jirru kanneen hamma dhufaatii Gooftaatti jiraannu gonkumaa warra rafan sana hin dursinu.
english: For this we tell you by the word of the Lord, that we who are alive, who are left until the coming of the Lord, will in no way precede those who have fallen asleep.

kikuyu: Gooftaan mataan isaa ajajaan, sagalee ergamaa hangafaatii fi sagalee malakata Waaqaatiin samii irraa ni buʼa; warri Kiristoositti amananii duʼanis jalqabatti ni kaʼu.
english: For the Lord himself will descend from heaven with a shout, with the voice of the archangel and with God’s trumpet. The dead in Christ will rise first,

kikuyu: Ergasii immoo nu warri hafnee lubbuun jirru qilleensa irratti Gooftaa simachuuf isaan wajjin duumessaan ol fudhatamna. Akkasumas bara baraan Gooftaa wajjin ni jiraanna.
english: then we who are alive, who are left, will be caught up together with them in the clouds to meet the Lord in the air. So we will be with the Lord forever.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu dubbii kanaan wal jajjabeessaa.
english: Therefore comfort one another with these words.

kikuyu: Egaa yaa obboloota, waaʼee barootaatii fi waaʼee waqtiilee waan tokko iyyuu isinii barreessuu nu hin barbaachisu;
english: But concerning the times and the seasons, brothers, you have no need that anything be written to you.

kikuyu: akka guyyaan Gooftaa akkuma hattuutti halkaniin dhufu isinuu sirriitti beektuutii.
english: For you yourselves know well that the day of the Lord comes like a thief in the night.

kikuyu: Utuma namoonni, “Nagaa dha; qabbanas” jedhanuu akkuma ciniinsuun dubartii ulfaatti dhufu badiisni akka tasaa isaanitti dhufa; jalaas hin baʼan.
english: For when they are saying, “Peace and safety,” then sudden destruction will come on them, like birth pains on a pregnant woman. Then they will in no way escape.

kikuyu: Isin garuu yaa obboloota, akka guyyaan sun akkuma hattuutti isinitti hin dhufneef isin warra dukkana keessa jirtan miti.
english: But you, brothers, aren’t in darkness, that the day should overtake you like a thief.

kikuyu: Isin hundi ijoollee ifaa ti; ijoollee guyyaatis. Nu warra halkanii yookaan warra dukkanaa miti.
english: You are all children of light and children of the day. We don’t belong to the night, nor to darkness,

kikuyu: Egaa kottaa nu akka warra kaanii hin rafnuu; qooda kanaa kottaa ni dammaqnaa; of qabnas.
english: so then let’s not sleep, as the rest do, but let’s watch and be sober.

kikuyu: Warri rafan halkaniin rafuutii; warri machaaʼanis halkaniin machaaʼu.
english: For those who sleep, sleep in the night; and those who are drunk are drunk in the night.

kikuyu: Nu garuu waan warra guyyaa taaneef kottaa amantii fi jaalala akka qomee sibiilaatti uffannee, abdii fayyinaa immoo akka qoobii sibiilaatti kaaʼannee of qabnaa.
english: But since we belong to the day, let’s be sober, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and for a helmet, the hope of salvation.

kikuyu: Waaqni akka nu karaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiin fayyina argannuuf malee dheekkamsaaf nu hin filanneetii.
english: For God didn’t appoint us to wrath, but to the obtaining of salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Nu yoo dammaqne yookaan yoo rafne akka isa wajjin tokkummaan jiraannuuf inni nuuf duʼe.
english: who died for us, that, whether we wake or sleep, we should live together with him.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akkuma amma gochaa jirtan kana wal jajjabeessaa; wal ijaaraas.
english: Therefore exhort one another, and build each other up, even as you also do.

kikuyu: Egaa yaa obboloota, nu akka isin warra gidduu keessanitti cimanii hojjetan, kanneen karaa Gooftaatiin isin hooggananii fi isin gorsan sana kabajjan isin kadhanna.
english: But we beg you, brothers, to know those who labor among you, and are over you in the Lord and admonish you,

kikuyu: Sababii hojii isaaniitiifis jaalalaan ulfina guddaa isaaniif kennaa. Nagaadhaanis walii wajjin jiraadhaa.
english: and to respect and honor them in love for their work’s sake. Be at peace among yourselves.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, nu akka isin warra hojii hojjechuu hin jaallanne akeekkachiiftan, sodaattota jajjabeessitan, dadhaboo gargaartan, akka nama hundumaafis obsitan isin gorsina.
english: We exhort you, brothers: Admonish the disorderly; encourage the faint-hearted; support the weak; be patient toward all.

kikuyu: Akka namni tokko iyyuu waan hamaaf deebii hamaa hin deebifne of eeggadhaa; qooda kanaa yeroo hunda waliif, nama hundaafis waan gaarii gochuuf carraaqaa.
english: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.

kikuyu: Yeroo hunda gammadaa;
english: Always rejoice.

kikuyu: utuu gargar hin kutin kadhadhaa.
english: Pray without ceasing.

kikuyu: Haala hundumaa keessatti Waaqa galateeffadhaa; fedhiin Waaqni Kiristoos Yesuusitti isiniif qabu kanaatii.
english: In everything give thanks, for this is the will of God in Christ Jesus toward you.

kikuyu: Hafuura hin dhaamsinaa;
english: Don’t quench the Spirit.

kikuyu: raajii hin tuffatinaa;
english: Don’t despise prophecies.

kikuyu: waan hunda qoraa. Isa gaarii jabeessaatii qabadhaa.
english: Test all things, and hold firmly that which is good.

kikuyu: Hammina gosa hundumaa irraa fagaadhaa.
english: Abstain from every form of evil.

kikuyu: Waaqni mataan isaa, Waaqni nagaa guutumaan guutuutti isin haa qulqulleessu. Hafuurri keessan, lubbuun keessanii fi dhagni keessan guutuun guyyaa Gooftaan keenya Yesuus Kiristoos dhufutti mudaa irraa haa eegaman.
english: May the God of peace himself sanctify you completely. May your whole spirit, soul, and body be preserved blameless at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Inni isin waamu sun amanamaa dha; waan kanas ni godha.
english: He who calls you is faithful, who will also do it.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, nuufis kadhadhaa.
english: Brothers, pray for us.

kikuyu: Dhungoo qulqulluudhaanis obboloota hunda nagaa gaafadhaa.
english: Greet all the brothers with a holy kiss.

kikuyu: Ani akka xalayaan kun obboloota hundaaf dubbifamu fuula Gooftaa duratti isin ajaja.
english: I solemnly command you by the Lord that this letter be read to all the holy brothers.

kikuyu: Ayyaanni Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos isin wajjin haa taʼu.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Phaawulos, Silwaanosii fi Xiimotewos irraa,
english: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ:

kikuyu: Ayyaannii fi nagaan Waaqa Abbaa fi Gooftaa Yesuus Kiristoos irraa isiniif haa taʼu.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, sababii amantiin keessan baayʼee guddachaa, jaalalli hundi keessan walii keessaniif qabdanis ittuma dabalaa jiruuf nu yeroo hunda waaʼee keessaniif akka malutti Waaqa galateeffachuu qabna.
english: We are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers, even as it is appropriate, because your faith grows exceedingly, and the love of each and every one of you toward one another abounds,

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu qorumsa isin obsitan sanaaf, ariʼatama hunda keessatti jabaattanii dhaabachuu keessanii fi amantii keessaniin waldoota Kiristaanaa Waaqaa keessatti sababii keessaniin of jajna.
english: so that we ourselves boast about you in the assemblies of God for your perseverance and faith in all your persecutions and in the afflictions which you endure.

kikuyu: Kun hundinuu akka murtiin Waaqaa qajeelaa taʼe mulʼisa; sababii kanaafis isin warra mootummaa isaa kan dhiphachaafii jirtan sanaaf maltan ni taatu.
english: This is an obvious sign of the righteous judgment of God, to the end that you may be counted worthy of God’s Kingdom, for which you also suffer.

kikuyu: Waaqni qajeelaa dha: Inni warra isin rakkisan ni rakkisa;
english: For it is a righteous thing with God to repay affliction to those who afflict you,

kikuyu: isin warra rakkattaniif, nuufis boqonnaa ni kenna. Kunis yommuu Gooftaan Yesuus ibidda balaliʼuun ergamoota isaa humna qabeeyyii wajjin samii irraa mulʼatutti taʼa.
english: and to give relief to you who are afflicted with us when the Lord Jesus is revealed from heaven with his mighty angels in flaming fire,

kikuyu: Inni warra Waaqa hin beeknee fi warra wangeela Gooftaa keenya Yesuusiif hin ajajamne ni adaba.
english: punishing those who don’t know God, and to those who don’t obey the Good News of our Lord Jesus,

kikuyu: Isaanis fuula Gooftaa duraa fi ulfina humna isaa irraa fageeffamanii badiisa bara baraatiin ni adabamu;
english: who will pay the penalty: eternal destruction from the face of the Lord and from the glory of his might,

kikuyu: kunis guyyaa inni qulqulloota isaatiin kabajamuu fi warra amanan hundumaa gidduutti dinqisiifatamuuf dhufutti taʼa. Isinis waan dhuga baʼumsa keenya amantaniif isaanitti lakkaaʼamtu.
english: when he comes in that day to be glorified in his saints and to be admired among all those who have believed, because our testimony to you was believed.

kikuyu: Nus waan kana yaadatti qabachaa, akka Waaqni keenya warra waamicha isaatiif malan isin godhuuf, humna isaatiinis kaayyoo keessan gaarii hundaa fi akka hojii amantii keessanii hunda fiixaan isinii baasuuf utuu gargar hin kutin isinii kadhanna.
english: To this end we also pray always for you that our God may count you worthy of your calling, and fulfill every desire of goodness and work of faith with power,

kikuyu: Nus akkuma ayyaana Waaqa keenyaattii fi Gooftaa Yesuus Kiristoosiitti akka maqaan Gooftaa keenya Yesuus isiniin kabajamuu fi akka isinis isaan kabajamtaniif waan kana kadhanna.
english: that the name of our Lord Jesus may be glorified in you, and you in him, according to the grace of our God and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, waaʼee dhufaatii Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosii fi waaʼee isa biratti walitti qabamuu keenyaa wanni nu isin kadhannu kana;
english: Now, brothers, concerning the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ and our gathering together to him, we ask you

kikuyu: kunis raajii yookaan dubbii yookaan xalayaa akka waan nu biraa dhufeetti hedamuun akka isin guyyaan Gooftaa ammuma iyyuu dhufeera jettanii daftanii hin raafamneef yookaan hin jeeqamneef.
english: not to be quickly shaken in your mind or troubled, either by spirit or by word or by letter as if from us, saying that the day of Christ has already come.

kikuyu: Namni tokko iyyuu karaa kamiin iyyuu isin hin gowwoomsin; utuu fincilli dursee hin dhufin, namni cubbuu, ilmi badiisaa sun utuu hin mulʼatin guyyaan sun hin dhufuutii.
english: Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is revealed, the son of destruction.

kikuyu: Innis waan Waaqa jedhamu yookaan waan waaqeffatamu hundumaan mormee isaan irratti ol ol of qaba; “Ani Waaqa” ofiin jechuudhaanis mana qulqullummaa Waaqaa keessa taaʼa.
english: He opposes and exalts himself against all that is called God or that is worshiped, so that he sits as God in the temple of God, setting himself up as God.

kikuyu: Isin akka ani yeroo isin bira turetti waan kana isinitti himaa ture hin yaadattanii?
english: Don’t you remember that when I was still with you, I told you these things?

kikuyu: Akka inni yeroo murteeffame sanatti mulʼatuufis waan amma isa dhowwu ni beektu.
english: Now you know what is restraining him, to the end that he may be revealed in his own season.

kikuyu: Icciitiin humna fincila sanaa amma iyyuu hojiitti jiraatii; garuu inni amma humna sana duubatti deebisu sun hamma karaa irraa fuudhamutti ittuma fufee isa dhowwa.
english: For the mystery of lawlessness already works. Only there is one who restrains now, until he is taken out of the way.

kikuyu: Inni Hamaan sun ni mulʼata; Yesuus Gooftaan immoo hafuuruma afaan ofii isaatiin isa galaafata; ifa dhufaatii isaatiinis isa barbadeessa.
english: Then the lawless one will be revealed, whom the Lord will kill with the breath of his mouth and destroy by the manifestation of his coming;

kikuyu: Dhufaatiin namicha isa hamaa sanaa akkuma hojii Seexanaatti humna hundaa fi mallattoon, dinqii sobaatiinis ni taʼa;
english: even he whose coming is according to the working of Satan with all power and signs and lying wonders,

kikuyu: innis gowwoomsaa gosa hundaa kan warra badan sana ittiin gowwoomsuun mulʼata. Warri badan sunis sababii dhugaa silaa ittiin fayyan sana jaallachuu didaniif badu.
english: and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth, that they might be saved.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqni akka isaan soba amananiif waan nama wallaalchisu isaanitti erga;
english: Because of this, God sends them a powerful delusion, that they should believe a lie,

kikuyu: kunis akka warra dhugaatti amanuu didanii jalʼinatti gammadan hundatti murtaaʼuuf.
english: that they all might be judged who didn’t believe the truth, but had pleasure in unrighteousness.

kikuyu: Nu garuu yaa obboloota Gooftaan jaallatamtan, sababii Waaqni warra jalqabaa godhee akka isin karaa Hafuuraan qulqulleeffamuutii fi karaa dhugaatti amanuutiin fayyitaniif isin filateef yeroo hunda Waaqa galateeffachuu qabna.
english: But we are bound to always give thanks to God for you, brothers loved by the Lord, because God chose you from the beginning for salvation through sanctification of the Spirit and belief in the truth,

kikuyu: Innis akka isin ulfina Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos keessatti hirmaattaniif karaa wangeela keenyaatiin kaayyoo kanaaf isin waame.
english: to which he called you through our Good News, for the obtaining of the glory of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Egaa yaa obboloota, jabaadhaatii dhaabadhaa; barsiisa nu karaa dubbii afaaniitiin yookaan xalayaan isin barsiifne sana jabeessaatii qabadhaa.
english: So then, brothers, stand firm and hold the traditions which you were taught by us, whether by word or by letter.

kikuyu: Gooftaan keenya Yesuus Kiristoos mataan isaa, Waaqni Abbaan keenya inni nu jaallatee karaa ayyaana isaatiin jajjabina bara baraatii fi abdii gaarii nuu kenne sun,
english: Now our Lord Jesus Christ himself, and God our Father, who loved us and gave us eternal comfort and good hope through grace,

kikuyu: hojii fi dubbii gaarii hunda keessatti garaa keessan haa jajjabeessu; isin haa cimsus.
english: comfort your hearts and establish you in every good work and word.

kikuyu: Egaa yaa obboloota, akka dubbiin Gooftaa akkuma isin biratti taʼe sana dafee iddoo hunda gaʼuu fi akka ulfinas qabaatu nuuf kadhadhaa.
english: Finally, brothers, pray for us, that the word of the Lord may spread rapidly and be glorified, even as also with you,

kikuyu: Akka nu harka namoota hamootii fi jalʼootaa jalaa baanuufis nuuf kadhadhaa; amantii kan qabu nama hunda mitii.
english: and that we may be delivered from unreasonable and evil men; for not all have faith.

kikuyu: Gooftaan garuu amanamaa dha; inni isin cimsa; isa hamaa irraas isin eega.
english: But the Lord is faithful, who will establish you and guard you from the evil one.

kikuyu: Nu akka isin waan nu isin ajajne sana hojjechaa jirtan, akka ittuma fuftaniis hojjetan Gooftaa ni amananna.
english: We have confidence in the Lord concerning you, that you both do and will do the things we command.

kikuyu: Gooftaan garaa keessan gara jaalala Waaqaatii fi gara obsa Kiristoositti haa qajeelchu.
english: May the Lord direct your hearts into God’s love and into the perseverance of Christ.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, isin obboleessa dhibaaʼaa fi kan akka bartee isin nurraa argattan sanaattis hin jiraanne hunda irraa akka fagaattaniif maqaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiin isin ajajna.
english: Now we command you, brothers, in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ, that you withdraw yourselves from every brother who walks in rebellion and not after the tradition which they received from us.

kikuyu: Isin mataan keessan akkamitti akka fakkeenya keenya duukaa buʼuu qabdan ni beektuutii. Nu yeroo isin bira turretti dhibaaʼota hin turre;
english: For you know how you ought to imitate us. For we didn’t behave ourselves rebelliously among you,

kikuyu: nus akka isin keessaa nama tokkotti illee baʼaa hin taaneef jennee, dadhabbii fi tattaaffii guddaan halkanii guyyaa hojjechaa turre malee buddeena nama tokkoo illee tola hin nyaanne.
english: neither did we eat bread from anyone’s hand without paying for it, but in labor and travail worked night and day, that we might not burden any of you.

kikuyu: Nu fakkeenya isinii taʼuuf waan kana goone malee waan aangoo hin qabneef miti.
english: This was not because we don’t have the right, but to make ourselves an example to you, that you should imitate us.

kikuyu: Nu yommuu isin bira turretti ajaja, “Namni hojjechuu hin barbaanne kam iyyuu hin nyaatin” jedhu isinii kenninee turreetii.
english: For even when we were with you, we commanded you this: “If anyone is not willing to work, don’t let him eat.”

kikuyu: Akka isin keessaa namoonni tokko tokko dhibaaʼota taʼanii jiraatan dhageenyeerraatii. Isaan dhimma nama biraa keessa galuu malee ofii isaaniitii waan tokko illee hin hojjetan.
english: For we hear of some who walk among you in rebellion, who don’t work at all, but are busybodies.

kikuyu: Namoonni akkanaa akka gab jedhanii hojii hojjetanii fi akka buddeena ofii isaanii nyaataniif Gooftaa Yesuus Kiristoosiin isaan ajajna; ni gorsinas.
english: Now those who are that way, we command and exhort in the Lord Jesus Christ, that they work with quietness and eat their own bread.

kikuyu: Isin garuu yaa obboloota, waan gaarii hojjechuutti hin laafinaa.
english: But you, brothers, don’t be weary in doing what is right.

kikuyu: Yoo namni kam iyyuu dubbii keenya kan xalayaa kana keessaatiif hin ajajamne, nama kana yaadatti qabadhaa. Akka inni qaanaʼuufis isa wajjin tokkummaa hin qabaatinaa.
english: If any man doesn’t obey our word in this letter, note that man and have no company with him, to the end that he may be ashamed.

kikuyu: Taʼus akka obboleessaatti isa gorsaa malee akka diinaatti isa hin ilaalinaa.
english: Don’t count him as an enemy, but admonish him as a brother.

kikuyu: Gooftaan nagaa mataan isaas yeroo hunda, karaa hundaan nagaa isinii haa kennu. Gooftaan hunduma keessan wajjin haa taʼu.
english: Now may the Lord of peace himself give you peace at all times in all ways. The Lord be with you all.

kikuyu: Ani Phaawulos xalayaa kana harkuma kootiin barreessa; kunis mallattoo xalayoota koo hundaa ti. Akki ani itti barreessus kanuma.
english: I, Paul, write this greeting with my own hand, which is the sign in every letter. This is how I write.

kikuyu: Ayyaanni Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos isin hunda wajjin haa taʼu.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Phaawulos isa ajaja fayyisaa keenya Waaqaatii fi abdii keenya Kiristoos Yesuusiin ergamaa Kiristoos Yesuus taʼe irraa,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ according to the commandment of God our Savior and the Lord Jesus Christ our hope,

kikuyu: Gara Xiimotewos isa amantiidhaan ilma koo dhugaa taʼeetti:
english: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God our Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Akkuma ani yeroo Maqedooniyaa dhaqetti si gorse sana ati akka namoonni tokko tokko barsiisa addaa hin barsiifne akka ajajjuuf achuma Efesoon turi;
english: As I urged you when I was going into Macedonia, stay at Ephesus that you might command certain men not to teach a different doctrine,

kikuyu: akkasumas akka isaan oduu hundee hin qabnee fi hidda dhalootaa kan dhuma hin qabne sanaan hin fudhatamne isaan ajaji. Wanni kun hojii Waaqaa kan amantiin taʼu guddisuu irra mormii kakaasaatii.
english: and not to pay attention to myths and endless genealogies, which cause disputes rather than God’s stewardship, which is in faith.

kikuyu: Kaayyoon ajaja kanaas jaalala garaa qulqulluu, qalbii gaarii fi amantii itti fakkeessuu hin qabne keessaa baʼuu dha.
english: But the goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere faith,

kikuyu: Namoonni tokko tokko karaa kana irraa badanii gara dubbii faayidaa hin qabneetti gara galaniiru.
english: from which things some, having missed the mark, have turned away to vain talking,

kikuyu: Isaanis maal akka jedhan yookaan akka waaʼee maalii cimsanii dubbatan utuu hin hubatin barsiistota seeraa taʼuu barbaadu.
english: desiring to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor about what they strongly affirm.

kikuyu: Yoo namni sirriitti itti fayyadame seerri gaarii akka taʼe ni beekna.
english: But we know that the law is good if a person uses it lawfully,

kikuyu: Seerri warra seera cabsanii fi finciltootaaf, warra Waaqa malee jiraatanii fi cubbamootaaf, warra qulqulluu hin taʼinii fi xuraaʼotaaf, warra abbaa isaaniitii fi haadha isaanii ajjeesanii fi warra nama ajjeesaniif malee akka qajeeltotaaf hin tumamin ni beekna;
english: as knowing this, that law is not made for a righteous person, but for the lawless and insubordinate, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

kikuyu: akkanumas seerri ejjitootaa fi dhiirota dhiira wajjin sagaagalaniif, warra garba daldalanii fi warra soba dubbataniif, warra sobaan dhugaa baʼanii fi warra barsiisa dhugaatiin morman hundumaaf akka tumame ni beekna;
english: for the sexually immoral, for homosexuals, for slave-traders, for liars, for perjurers, and for any other thing contrary to the sound doctrine,

kikuyu: kunis wangeela ulfina qabeessa kan Waaqa eebbifamaa irraa imaanaa natti kenname sana wajjin walii gala.
english: according to the Good News of the glory of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

kikuyu: Waan inni tajaajila isaatiif na filatee akka nama amanamaatti na lakkaaʼeef, ani Gooftaa keenya Kiristoos Yesuus isa jabina naa kenne sana nan galateeffadha.
english: I thank him who enabled me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he counted me faithful, appointing me to service,

kikuyu: Ani kanaan dura nama nama arrabsu, kan nama ariʼatuu fi kan nama miidhu taʼu iyyuu sababii ani wallaalummaa fi amantii dhabuun waan kana hojjedheef araara argadhe.
english: although I used to be a blasphemer, a persecutor, and insolent. However, I obtained mercy because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

kikuyu: Ayyaanni Gooftaa keenyaas amantii fi jaalala Kiristoos Yesuusiin argamu wajjin baayʼinaan narratti dhangalaafame.
english: The grace of our Lord abounded exceedingly with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Dubbiin, “Kiristoos Yesuus cubbamoota fayyisuudhaaf gara addunyaa dhufe” jedhu sun amanamaa dha; namni hundinuus kana fudhachuu qaba; cubbamoota sana keessaas cubbamaan cubbamoota hunda caalu ana.
english: The saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am chief.

kikuyu: Taʼus sababuma kanaaf Yesuus Kiristoos akka ani warra jireenya bara baraa argachuuf isatti amananiif fakkeenya taʼuuf ana nama cubbamoota hunda caalaa cubbamaa taʼeen obsa isaa kan dhuma hin qabne sana mulʼisuuf jedhee naa araarame.
english: However, for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first, Jesus Christ might display all his patience for an example of those who were going to believe in him for eternal life.

kikuyu: Egaa Mootii bara baraa, isa hin duune, isa ijatti hin mulʼanne Waaqa tokkicha sanaaf bara baraa hamma bara baraatti ulfinnii fi galanni haa taʼu. Ameen.
english: Now to the King eternal, immortal, invisible, to God who alone is wise, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Yaa ilma koo Xiimotewos, akkuma raajii kanaan dura waaʼee kee dubbatame sanaatti, akka ati lola gaarii loltuuf ani ajaja kana siifin kenna;
english: I commit this instruction to you, my child Timothy, according to the prophecies which were given to you before, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

kikuyu: waan kanas amantii fi qalbii qajeelaa qabaachuudhaan godhi. Namoonni tokko tokko waan kana gochuu didanii amantii isaanii balleessaniiru.
english: holding faith and a good conscience, which some having thrust away made a shipwreck concerning the faith,

kikuyu: Himenewoosii fi Iskindiroos warri ani akka isaan Waaqa arrabsuu dhiisuu barataniif dabarsee Seexanatti kenne sun isaan keessatti argamu.
english: of whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I delivered to Satan that they might be taught not to blaspheme.

kikuyu: Egaa ani akka waammachuun, kadhannaan, namaaf kadhachuu fi galanni maqaa nama hundaatiin dhiʼeeffamu duraan dursee nan gorsa;
english: I exhort therefore, first of all, that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and givings of thanks be made for all men,

kikuyu: nus akka Waaqa sodaachuu hundumaan, ulfinaanis jireenya nagaatii fi tasgabbiin jiraannuuf moototaa fi warra taayitaa qaban hundumaafis akkasuma haa godhamu.
english: for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.

kikuyu: Kunis gaarii dha; fuula Fayyisaa keenya Waaqaa durattis fudhatamaa dha;
english: For this is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

kikuyu: Waaqni akka namni hundinuu fayyuu fi akka dhugaa beekuu biras gaʼu barbaada.
english: who desires all people to be saved and come to full knowledge of the truth.

kikuyu: Waaqni tokkicha; Waaqaa fi nama gidduu immoo gidduu galeessa tokkotu jira; innis Kiristoos Yesuus isa nama taʼee dha;
english: For there is one God and one mediator between God and men, the man Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Yesuus kunis isa furii taʼee nama hundaaf dabarsee of kennee dha; kunis yeroo isaatti mirkaneeffameera.
english: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony at the proper time,

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf ani lallabaa fi ergamaa, Namoota Ormaatiif immoo barsiisaa amantii dhugaa taʼee muudameen jira. Ani dhugaa dubbadha; hin sobu.
english: to which I was appointed a preacher and an apostle—I am telling the truth in Christ, not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani akka dhiironni iddoo hundatti dheekkamsaa fi wal mormii malee harka qulqullaaʼaa ol fudhatanii kadhatan nan barbaada.
english: I desire therefore that the men in every place pray, lifting up holy hands without anger and doubting.

kikuyu: Akkasumas dubartoonni akka hin malletti mataa dhaʼachuun, warqee yookaan lula naqachuun yookaan uffata gatii guddaa uffachuun utuu hin taʼin akka of qabuu fi naamusaaf taʼutti uffatanii akka of miidhagsan nan barbaada;
english: In the same way, that women also adorn themselves in decent clothing, with modesty and propriety, not with braided hair, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,

kikuyu: isaanis akkuma dubartoota, “Nu Waaqa sodaanna” jedhaniitti waan gaarii haa hojjetan.
english: but with good works, which is appropriate for women professing godliness.

kikuyu: Dubartiin waan hundaan ajajamuun calʼistee haa barattu.
english: Let a woman learn in quietness with full submission.

kikuyu: Ani akka dubartiin calʼistu malee akka barsiiftu yookaan akka dhiira irratti taayitaa qabaattu hin eeyyamu.
english: But I don’t permit a woman to teach, nor to exercise authority over a man, but to be in quietness.

kikuyu: Sababiin isaas Addaam jalqabatti uumame; Hewaan immoo ergasii uumamte.
english: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.

kikuyu: Addaam hin gowwoomfamne; dubartittiin garuu gowwoomfamtee seera cabsite.
english: Adam wasn’t deceived, but the woman, being deceived, has fallen into disobedience;

kikuyu: Taʼus dubartoonni yoo amantiin, jaalalaa fi qulqullinaan, naamusaan jiraatan ijoollee daʼuudhaan ni fayyu.
english: but she will be saved through her childbearing, if they continue in faith, love, and holiness with sobriety.

kikuyu: Jechi, “Eenyu iyyuu yoo Phaaphaasii taʼuu hawwe, hojii gaarii hawwa” jedhu kun amanamaa dha.
english: This is a faithful saying: someone who seeks to be an overseer desires a good work.

kikuyu: Egaa Phaaphaasiin kan mudaa hin qabne, kan niitii tokkittii qabu, amala qabeessa, kan of qabu, kabajamaa, kan keessummaa simatu, kan barsiisuu dandaʼu,
english: The overseer therefore must be without reproach, the husband of one wife, temperate, sensible, modest, hospitable, good at teaching;

kikuyu: kan hin machoofne, kan goolii kaasu utuu hin taʼin obsa qabeessa, kan lola hin jaallannee fi kan maallaqa hin jaallanne taʼuu qaba.
english: not a drinker, not violent, not greedy for money, but gentle, not quarrelsome, not covetous;

kikuyu: Innis maatii ofii isaa sirriitti bulfatee akka ijoolleen isaa kabaja maluun isaaf ajajaman mirkaneessuu qaba.
english: one who rules his own house well, having children in subjection with all reverence;

kikuyu: Namni tokko yoo maatii ofii isaa akka itti bulfatu hin beekne inni akkamitti waldaa kiristaanaa Waaqaa eeguu dandaʼaa?
english: (for how could someone who doesn’t know how to rule his own house take care of God’s assembly?)

kikuyu: Inni akka of jajuudhaan afuufamee murtii diiyaabiloos keessatti hin kufneef nama dhiʼoo amane hin taʼin.
english: not a new convert, lest being puffed up he fall into the same condemnation as the devil.

kikuyu: Innis akka hin tuffatamnee fi akka kiyyoo diiyaabiloos keessattis hin kufneef warra alaa biratti maqaa gaarii haa qabaatu.
english: Moreover he must have good testimony from those who are outside, to avoid falling into reproach and the snare of the devil.

kikuyu: Daaqonoonnis akkasuma namoota kabajaman, warra afaan lama hin dubbanne, warra dhugaatii daadhii wayiniitiin hin fudhatamnee fi warra buʼaa hin malle argachuuf hin tattaaffanne taʼuu qabu.
english: Servants, in the same way, must be reverent, not double-tongued, not addicted to much wine, not greedy for money,

kikuyu: Yaada qulqulluunis icciitii amantii jabeessanii qabachuu qabu.
english: holding the mystery of the faith in a pure conscience.

kikuyu: Isaanis duraan dursanii haa qorataman; ergasiis yoo mudaan tokko iyyuu isaan irratti hin argamin daaqonoota taʼanii haa tajaajilan.
english: Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.

kikuyu: Akkasumas dubartoonni isaanii kabajamoo, kanneen maqaa nama hin balleessine, amala qabeeyyii fi waan hundaan amanamoo taʼuu qabu.
english: Their wives in the same way must be reverent, not slanderers, temperate, and faithful in all things.

kikuyu: Daaqoniin tokko dhirsa niitii tokkittii, kan ijoollee isaatii fi warra mana isaa jiraatan sirriitti bulchu taʼuu qaba.
english: Let servants be husbands of one wife, ruling their children and their own houses well.

kikuyu: Warri daaqonummaan sirriitti tajaajilan ulfina guddaa, amantii Kiristoos Yesuusitti qabaniin immoo ija jabina guddaa argatu.
english: For those who have served well gain for themselves a good standing and great boldness in the faith which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Ani akkan dafee gara kee dhufu abdadhee qajeelfama kana siif nan barreessa;
english: These things I write to you, hoping to come to you shortly,

kikuyu: kanas tarii yoo ani ture, namni tokko akkamitti akka mana Waaqaa keessa jiraachuu qabu akka beektuufin siif barreessa; manni Waaqaa kunis waldaa Waaqa jiraataa isa utubaa fi hundee dhugaa taʼee dha.
english: but if I wait long, that you may know how men ought to behave themselves in God’s house, which is the assembly of the living God, the pillar and ground of the truth.

kikuyu: Waaqatti buluun shakkii tokko malee icciitii guddaa of keessaa qaba; kunis, Inni fooniin mulʼate; Hafuuraan mirkaneeffame; ergamoota Waaqaatu isa arge; saboota keessatti lallabame; addunyaa irratti itti amaname; ulfinaan ol fudhatame.
english: Without controversy, the mystery of godliness is great: God was revealed in the flesh, justified in the spirit, seen by angels, preached among the nations, believed on in the world, and received up in glory.

kikuyu: Akka bara dhufuuf jiru keessa namoonni tokko tokko hafuurota sobaatii fi barsiisa hafuurota hamoo duukaa buʼuudhaan amantii dhiisan Hafuurri Qulqulluun ifa baasee dubbata.
english: But the Spirit says expressly that in later times some will fall away from the faith, paying attention to seducing spirits and doctrines of demons,

kikuyu: Barsiisni akkasiis karaa namoota fakkeessuudhaan sobanii warra qalbiin isaanii akka waan gubaan gubameetti hadoodeetiin dhufa.
english: through the hypocrisy of men who speak lies, branded in their own conscience as with a hot iron,

kikuyu: Isaanis fuudhaa fi heeruma dhowwu; nyaata Waaqni akka warri amananii fi warri dhugaa beekan galataan fudhatanii nyaataniif jedhee uume sanas akka namoonni lagatan ajaju.
english: forbidding marriage and commanding to abstain from foods which God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

kikuyu: Wanni Waaqni uume hundinuu waan gaarii taʼeef yoo galataan fudhatame wanni gatamu tokko iyyuu hin jiru;
english: For every creature of God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving.

kikuyu: inni dubbii Waaqaatii fi kadhannaadhaan qulqulleeffameeraatii.
english: For it is sanctified through the word of God and prayer.

kikuyu: Atis yoo wantoota kanneen obbolootatti himte, dubbii amantiitii fi barsiisa gaarii duukaa buʼaa turte sanaan bilchaattee tajaajilaa gaarii kan Kiristoos Yesuus taata.
english: If you instruct the brothers of these things, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished in the words of the faith and of the good doctrine which you have followed.

kikuyu: Oduu xuraaʼaa fi mammaaksa beeraa irraa fagaadhu; qooda kanaa nama Waaqaa taʼuuf of leenjisi.
english: But refuse profane and old wives’ fables. Exercise yourself toward godliness.

kikuyu: Leenjiin dhagnaa faayidaa xinnaa qabaatii; Waaqatti buluun garuu jireenya ammaatiifis jireenya dhufuuf jiruufis waan waadaa of keessaa qabuuf waan hundaaf fayyada.
english: For bodily exercise has some value, but godliness has value in all things, having the promise of the life which is now and of that which is to come.

kikuyu: Jechi kun amanamaa fi kan guutumaan guutuutti fudhatamuu maluu dha.
english: This saying is faithful and worthy of all acceptance.

kikuyu: Sababii abdii keenya Waaqa jiraataa isa Fayyisaa nama hundaa keessumattuu kan warra isatti amananii taʼe sana irra kaaʼanneef nuus kanaaf jennee ni dadhabna; ni tattaaffannas.
english: For to this end we both labor and suffer reproach, because we have set our trust in the living God, who is the Savior of all men, especially of those who believe.

kikuyu: Wantoota kanneen ajaji; barsiisis.
english: Command and teach these things.

kikuyu: Ati dubbiidhaan, amalaan, jaalalaan, amantii fi qulqullinaan warra amananiif fakkeenya taʼi malee namni tokko iyyuu dargaggummaa kee hin tuffatin.
english: Let no man despise your youth; but be an example to those who believe, in word, in your way of life, in love, in spirit, in faith, and in purity.

kikuyu: Hamma ani dhufutti Katabbii Qulqulluu namootaaf dubbisuutti, gorsuu fi barsiisuutti jabaadhu.
english: Until I come, pay attention to reading, to exhortation, and to teaching.

kikuyu: Kennaa kee isa yommuu jaarsoliin harka isaanii sirra kaaʼanitti karaa raajiitiin siif kenname sana hin dagatin.
english: Don’t neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you by prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the elders.

kikuyu: Waan kanattis jabaadhu; akka namni hundinuu guddachuu kee arguufis guutumaan guututti itti of kenni.
english: Be diligent in these things. Give yourself wholly to them, that your progress may be revealed to all.

kikuyu: Jireenya keetii fi barsiisa kee eeggadhu. Ittis jabaadhu; waan kana gochuu keetiinis ofii keetii fi warra si dhagaʼan ni fayyiftaatii.
english: Pay attention to yourself and to your teaching. Continue in these things, for in doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

kikuyu: Nama dulloome tokko akka waan inni abbaa kee taʼeetti gorsi malee hin ifatin. Dargaggootas akka obbolootaatti ilaali;
english: Don’t rebuke an older man, but exhort him as a father; the younger men as brothers;

kikuyu: dubartoota dullooman akka haadhotiitti, dubartoota shamarran akka obboleettotaatti qulqullummaa guutuun ilaali.
english: the elder women as mothers; the younger as sisters, in all purity.

kikuyu: Haadhota hiyyeessaa kanneen dhugumaan rakkattoota taʼan kabaji.
english: Honor widows who are widows indeed.

kikuyu: Garuu haati hiyyeessaa tokko yoo ijoollee yookaan akkoowwan qabaatte ijoolleen kunneen maatii isaanii gargaaruu fi warra isaaniitiif gatii deebisuudhaan amantii isaanii hojiin mulʼisuuf duraan dursanii barachuu qabu; kun Waaqa gammachiisaatii.
english: But if any widow has children or grandchildren, let them learn first to show piety toward their own family and to repay their parents, for this is acceptable in the sight of God.

kikuyu: Haati hiyyeessaa kan dhugumaan rakkattuu taatee kophaa ishee hafte abdii ishee Waaqa irra kaaʼattee halkanii guyyaa kadhannaa fi gargaarsa Waaqaa gaafachuu itti fufti.
english: Now she who is a widow indeed and desolate, has her hope set on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.

kikuyu: Haati hiyyeessaa kan jireenya gammachuutti of gattu garuu utuma jirtuu iyyuu duuteerti.
english: But she who gives herself to pleasure is dead while she lives.

kikuyu: Akka namni tokko iyyuu mudaa hin qabaanneef ajaja kana kenni.
english: Also command these things, that they may be without reproach.

kikuyu: Namni firoota isaa keessumattuu miseensota maatii isaa warra isatti aannan hin gargaarre kam iyyuu amantii ganeera; inni nama hin amanne caalaattis hamaa dha.
english: But if anyone doesn’t provide for his own, and especially his own household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

kikuyu: Haati hiyyeessaa tokko yoo umuriin ishee waggaa jaatamaa ol taʼee akkasumas niitii dhirsa tokkichaa turte taate malee maqaan ishee galmee haadhota hiyyeessaa irratti hin galmeeffamin;
english: Let no one be enrolled as a widow under sixty years old, having been the wife of one man,

kikuyu: akkasumas isheen hojii gaarii hojjechuudhaan jechuunis ijoollee guddisuudhaan, keessummaa simachuudhaan, miilla qulqullootaa dhiquudhaan, warra rakkatan gargaaruudhaan, karaa hundumaanis hojii gaarii hojjechuu keessatti of kennuudhaan kan beekamte taʼuu qabdi.
english: being approved by good works, if she has brought up children, if she has been hospitable to strangers, if she has washed the saints’ feet, if she has relieved the afflicted, and if she has diligently followed every good work.

kikuyu: Haadhota hiyyeessaa kanneen shamarran taʼan garuu hin galmeessin. Isaan yommuu hawwiin foonii Kiristoos irraa gargar isaan baasutti deebiʼanii heerumuu barbaaduutii.
english: But refuse younger widows, for when they have grown wanton against Christ, they desire to marry,

kikuyu: Kanaanis isaan waan kakuu isaanii kan jalqabaa cabsaniif murtii ofitti fidu.
english: having condemnation, because they have rejected their first pledge.

kikuyu: Kana malees manaa gara manaatti labanii dhibaaʼummaa baratu. Dhibaaʼummaa qofa utuu hin taʼin waan dubbachuun isaaniif hin malle dubbachuudhaan nama hamatu; dhimma namaa keessas galu.
english: Besides, they also learn to be idle, going about from house to house. Not only idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things which they ought not.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu haadhonni hiyyeessaa kanneen ijoollummaa qaban akka carraa maqaa nu balleessuu diinaaf hin kennineef ani akka isaan heeruman, akka ijoollee daʼanii fi akka mana isaanii bulfatan nan gorsa.
english: I desire therefore that the younger widows marry, bear children, rule the household, and give no occasion to the adversary for insulting.

kikuyu: Namoonni tokko tokko Seexana duukaa buʼuuf jedhanii duraanuu karaa irraa goraniiru.
english: For already some have turned away after Satan.

kikuyu: Dubartiin amantu kam iyyuu yoo haadhota hiyyeessaa maatii ishee keessaa qabaatte, akka waldaan kiristaanaa haadhota hiyyeessaa kanneen dhugumaan rakkattoota taʼan gargaartuuf isheen isaan haa gargaartuu malee akka waldaa kiristaanaatti baʼaa taʼan hin godhin.
english: If any man or woman who believes has widows, let them relieve them, and don’t let the assembly be burdened, that it might relieve those who are widows indeed.

kikuyu: Jaarsoliin sirriitti waldaa kiristaanaa bulchan keessumattuu warri hojiin isaanii lallabuu fi barsiisuu taʼe ulfina dachaa argachuu qabu.
english: Let the elders who rule well be counted worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in the word and in teaching.

kikuyu: Katabbiin Qulqulluun, “Qotiyyoo midhaan siribsiisuutti jiru afaan hin hidhin;” akkasumas, “Hojjetaaf mindaa isaa argachuun ni mala” jedhaatii.
english: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle the ox when it treads out the grain.” And, “The laborer is worthy of his wages.”

kikuyu: Yoo dhuga baatota lamaan yookaan sadiin mirkaneeffame malee himata jaarsa tokko mormuun dhiʼeeffamu kam iyyuu hin fudhatin.
english: Don’t receive an accusation against an elder except at the word of two or three witnesses.
