kikuyu: Akka warri kaan sodaataniif namoota cubbuu hojjetan fuula namoota hundaa duratti itti dheekkami.
english: Those who sin, reprove in the sight of all, that the rest also may be in fear.

kikuyu: Ani akka ati waan tokko iyyuu loogiidhaan hin goonee fi akka wal caalchisuu malee ajajawwan kanneen eegduuf fuula Waaqaatii fi fuula Kiristoos Yesuus duratti, fuula ergamoota filatamanii durattis sin gorsa.
english: I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

kikuyu: Eenyu irra iyyuu harka kaaʼuuf hin ariifatin; cubbuu nama biraa keessatti hin hirmaatin. Qulqullummaadhaanis of eeggadhu.
english: Lay hands hastily on no one. Don’t be a participant in other people’s sins. Keep yourself pure.

kikuyu: Sababii garaa keetiitii fi dhukkuba ammumaa amma sitti kaʼu sanaatiif daadhii wayinii xinnoo ishee dhugi malee bishaan qofa hin dhugin.
english: Be no longer a drinker of water only, but use a little wine for your stomach’s sake and your frequent infirmities.

kikuyu: Cubbuun namoota tokko tokkoo duraan dursee ifatti mulʼata; isaan dura darbees lafa murtii gaʼa; cubbuun warra kaanii garuu duuba irratti beekama.
english: Some men’s sins are evident, preceding them to judgment, and some also follow later.

kikuyu: Hojiin gaariinis akkasuma ifatti mulʼata; kan ifatti hin mulʼannes dhokfamee hafuu hin dandaʼu.
english: In the same way also there are good works that are obvious, and those that are otherwise can’t be hidden.

kikuyu: Akka maqaan Waaqaatii fi barsiisni keenya hin arrabsamneef warri waanjoo garbummaa jala jiran hundinuu akka ulfinni guutuun gooftota isaaniitiif malutti haa ilaalan.
english: Let as many as are bondservants under the yoke count their own masters worthy of all honor, that the name of God and the doctrine not be blasphemed.

kikuyu: Warri gooftota amanan qabanis sababii isaan obboloota taʼaniif isaan hin tuffatin. Qooda kanaa warri tajaajila isaaniitiin fayyadaman sun waan isaan amantootaa fi jaallatamtoota taʼaniif ittuma cimsanii isaan haa tajaajilan. Atis waan kana barsiisi; gorsis.
english: Those who have believing masters, let them not despise them because they are brothers, but rather let them serve them, because those who partake of the benefit are believing and beloved. Teach and exhort these things.

kikuyu: Eenyu iyyuu yoo barsiisa addaa barsiise, yoo dubbii dhugaa kan Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosii fi barsiisa nama Waaqaa taʼuuf fayyaduun walii hin galle,
english: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and doesn’t consent to sound words, the words of our Lord Jesus Christ, and to the doctrine which is according to godliness,

kikuyu: inni of tuulummaan guutameera; waan tokko iyyuus hin hubatu. Inni waaʼee jechootaa irratti morkii fi lolaaf fedhii hamaa qaba; kunis hinaaffaa, wal dhabuu, arrabsoo fi shakkii hamaa fida;
english: he is conceited, knowing nothing, but obsessed with arguments, disputes, and word battles, from which come envy, strife, insulting, evil suspicions,

kikuyu: namoota qalbiin isaanii badee dhugaanis irraa fudhatame kanneen Waaqatti buluu karaa ittiin maallaqni argamu seʼan gidduuttis walitti buʼiisa dhuma hin qabnetu uumama.
english: constant friction of people of corrupt minds and destitute of the truth, who suppose that godliness is a means of gain. Withdraw yourself from such.

kikuyu: Waaqatti buluun, “Wanni ani qabu na gaʼa” jechuu of keessaa qabaannaan kun dhugumaan faayidaa guddaa qaba.
english: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

kikuyu: Nu waan tokko illee gara addunyaatti waan hin fidiniif, waan tokko illee addunyaa keessaa fudhachuu hin dandeenyu.
english: For we brought nothing into the world, and we certainly can’t carry anything out.

kikuyu: Garuu waan nyaannuu fi waan uffannu qabaannaan nu gaʼa.
english: But having food and clothing, we will be content with that.

kikuyu: Warri sooromuu barbaadan garuu qorumsaa fi kiyyoo, hawwii gowwummaa fi miidhaa baayʼee fidu kan diigamaa fi badiisatti nama dhidhimsu keessatti kufu.
english: But those who are determined to be rich fall into a temptation, a snare, and many foolish and harmful lusts, such as drown men in ruin and destruction.

kikuyu: Maallaqa jaallachuun hidda hammina gosa hundumaatii. Namoonni tokko tokko akka malee maallaqa jaallachuun amantii irraa badanii dhiphina baayʼeen of waraananiiru.
english: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. Some have been led astray from the faith in their greed, and have pierced themselves through with many sorrows.

kikuyu: Ati garuu yaa nama Waaqaa, waan kana hunda irraa baqadhu; qajeelummaa, Waaqatti buluu, amantii, jaalala, obsaa fi garraamummaa duukaa buʼi.
english: But you, man of God, flee these things, and follow after righteousness, godliness, faith, love, perseverance, and gentleness.

kikuyu: Walʼaansoo amantii gaarii sana qabi. Jireenya bara baraa kan yeroo fuula dhuga baatota baayʼee duratti akka gaarii beeksiftetti itti waamamte sana jabeessii qabadhu.
english: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of the eternal life to which you were called, and you confessed the good confession in the sight of many witnesses.

kikuyu: Ani fuula Waaqa waan hundaaf jireenya kennuu duratti, fuula Kiristoos Yesuus kan yommuu Phonxoos Phiilaaxoos duratti dhugaa baʼetti akka gaarii beeksise sanaa durattis,
english: I command you before God who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus who before Pontius Pilate testified the good confession,

kikuyu: akka ati hamma dhufaatii Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoositti ajaja kana xurii fi mudaa malee eegdus sin gorsa.
english: that you keep the commandment without spot, blameless until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Waaqni eebbifamaanii fi Bulchaan tokkichi, Mootiin moototaa fi Gooftaan gooftotaa yeroo isaatti waan kana ni mulʼisa;
english: which at the right time he will show, who is the blessed and only Ruler, the King of kings and Lord of lords.

kikuyu: kan hin duune isa qofa; innis ifa namni tokko iyyuu itti dhiʼaachuu hin dandeenye keessa jiraata; eenyu iyyuu isa hin argine; isa arguus hin dandaʼu. Ulfinii fi humni bara baraan isaaf haa taʼu. Ameen.
english: He alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no man has seen nor can see, to whom be honor and eternal power. Amen.

kikuyu: Ati akka sooreyyiin addunyaa kanaa of tuuluu yookaan qabeenya badu abdachuu dhiisanii Waaqa akka nu itti gammannuuf jedhee waan hunda baayʼisee nuu kennu sana abdataniif isaan ajaji.
english: Charge those who are rich in this present age that they not be arrogant, nor have their hope set on the uncertainty of riches, but on the living God, who richly provides us with everything to enjoy;

kikuyu: Akka isaan waan gaarii hojjetan, akka badhaadhummaan isaanii hojii gaarii taʼu, akka arjooman, akka waan qabanis qooduuf fedhii qabaatan isaan ajaji.
english: that they do good, that they be rich in good works, that they be ready to distribute, willing to share;

kikuyu: Isaanis karaa kanaan jireenya dhugumaan jireenya taʼe qabaachuuf jedhanii badhaadhummaa hundee jabaa taʼu bara dhufuuf jiruuf ofii isaaniitii kuufatu.
english: laying up in store for themselves a good foundation against the time to come, that they may lay hold of eternal life.

kikuyu: Yaa Xiimotewos, waan imaanaa sitti kenname jabeessii eegi. Oduu Waaqni hin jaallannee fi yaada mormii kan sobaan “Beekumsa” jedhamu irraa fagaadhu;
english: Timothy, guard that which is committed to you, turning away from the empty chatter and oppositions of what is falsely called knowledge,

kikuyu: namoonni tokko tokko, “Nu beekumsa akkasii qabna” jechuun amantii irraa badaniiruutii. Ayyaanni isin wajjin haa taʼu.
english: which some profess, and thus have wandered from the faith. Grace be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Phaawulos isa akkuma waadaa jireenya karaa Kiristoos Yesuusiin galame sanaatti fedhii Waaqaatiin ergamaa Kiristoos Yesuus taʼe irraa,
english: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,

kikuyu: Gara Xiimotewos, ilma koo jaallatamaatti:
english: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

kikuyu: Ani yommuu utuu gargar hin kutin halkanii guyyaa kadhannaa koo keessatti si yaadadhutti Waaqa akkuma abbootii kootii anis yaada qulqulluun isa waaqeffadhu sana nan galateeffadha.
english: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day

kikuyu: Ani yommuun imimmaan kee yaadadhutti akka gammachuudhaan guutamuuf guddisee si arguu nan hawwa.
english: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;

kikuyu: Ani amantii kee isa dhugaa sana nan yaadadha; amantiin kunis jalqabatti akkoo kee Looʼisii fi haadha kee Ewuunqee keessa ture; amma immoo akka si keessa jiru nan amana.
english: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you, which lived first in your grandmother Lois and your mother Eunice and, I am persuaded, in you also.

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf ani akka ati kennaa Waaqaa kan yeroo ani harka koo sirra kaaʼetti siif kenname sana akka ibiddaatti akka qabsiiftuuf sin yaadachiisa.
english: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.

kikuyu: Waaqni hafuura humnaa, kan jaalalaatii fi kan of dhowwuu nuu kenne malee hafuura sodaa nuuf hin kennineetii.
english: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu waaʼee Gooftaa keenyaa dhugaa baʼuutti yookaan ana nama isaaf jedhee hidhametti hin qaanaʼin. Wangeelaaf dhiphachuu keessatti garuu humna Waaqaatiin na wajjin hirmaadhu;
english: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,

kikuyu: Waaqni sababii kaayyoo isaatii fi sababii ayyaana isaatiif nu fayyisee gara jireenya qulqulluutti nu waame malee sababii hojii nu hojjenne kamiif iyyuu miti. Ayyaanni kunis uumama addunyaatiin dura karaa Kiristoos Yesuusiin nuu kenname;
english: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,

kikuyu: amma garuu ayyaanni sun dhufaatii Fayyisaa keenya Kiristoos Yesuus isa karaa wangeelaatiin duʼa balleessee jireenyaa fi badiisa ooluu ifatti baase sanaatiin mulʼifameera.
english: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.

kikuyu: Anis wangeela kanaaf lallabaa, ergamaa fi barsiisaa taʼee muudameera.
english: For this I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Anis akka amma jiru kanatti dhiphachuun koo kanumaaf. Ani garuu eenyun akka amane waan beekuuf hin qaanaʼu; akka inni waan ani imaanaa itti kennadhe hamma guyyaa sanaatti eeguu dandaʼus nan amana.
english: For this cause I also suffer these things. Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.

kikuyu: Waan narraa dhageesse sana akka fakkeenya barsiisa dhugaatti amantii fi jaalala Kiristoos Yesuusiin qabdu jabeessii qabadhu.
english: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Waan gaarii imaanaa sitti kenname sana gargaarsa Hafuura Qulqulluu nu keessa jiraatu sanaatiin eegi.
english: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.

kikuyu: Namoonni biyya Asiyaa keessa jiraatan hundinuu akka narraa gara galan ni beekta; Fiigeloosii fi Hermoogenees isaan keessa jiru.
english: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me, of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.

kikuyu: Oneesifooros yeroo baayʼee waan na boqochiiseef Gooftaan warra mana isaa jiraataniif araara haa buusu; inni hidhamuu kootti illee hin qaanofneetii.
english: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,

kikuyu: Akkasumas inni yeroo Roomaa dhufetti hamma na argutti dhimmee na barbaadaa ture.
english: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently and found me

kikuyu: Akka inni guyyaa sanatti Gooftaa irraa araara argatuuf fedhii Gooftaa haa taʼu! Inni Efesoon keessatti karaa baayʼeen akka na tajaajile ati iyyuu sirriitti beekta.
english: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa ilma ko, ayyaana Kiristoos Yesuusiin jabaadhu.
english: You therefore, my child, be strengthened in the grace that is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Waan fuula dhuga baatota baayʼee duratti narraa dhageesse sana namoota amanamoo kanneen warra kaan barsiisuu dandaʼanitti imaanaa kenni.
english: The things which you have heard from me among many witnesses, commit the same things to faithful men who will be able to teach others also.

kikuyu: Atis akkuma loltuu jabaa kan Kiristoos Yesuusiitti nu wajjin dhiphadhu.
english: You therefore must endure hardship as a good soldier of Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Namni loltummaan tajaajilu kam iyyuu ajajaa isaa gammachiisuu yaala malee dhimma jireenyaatiin of hin xaxu.
english: No soldier on duty entangles himself in the affairs of life, that he may please him who enrolled him as a soldier.

kikuyu: Akkasumas dorgomaan tokko yoo akka malutti dorgome malee gonfoo hin argatu.
english: Also, if anyone competes in athletics, he isn’t crowned unless he has competed by the rules.

kikuyu: Qonnaan bulaan jabaatee hojjetus ija qooddachuutti nama jalqabaa taʼuu qaba.
english: The farmer who labors must be the first to get a share of the crops.

kikuyu: Waan ani sitti himu kana qalbeeffadhu; Gooftaan waan hunda keessatti hubannaa siif kennaatii.
english: Consider what I say, and may the Lord give you understanding in all things.

kikuyu: Yesuus Kiristoos isa warra duʼan keessaa kaafame, isa sanyii Daawit irraa dhalate yaadadhu. Kun wangeela koo
english: Remember Jesus Christ, risen from the dead, of the offspring of David, according to my Good News,

kikuyu: kan ani isaaf jedhee akka nama yakka hojjete tokkootti hamma foncaan hidhamuutti dhiphachaafii jiruu dha. Dubbiin Waaqaa garuu hin hidhamu.
english: in which I suffer hardship to the point of chains as a criminal. But God’s word isn’t chained.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka warri filataman fayyina Kiristoos Yesuusiin taʼe sana ulfina bara baraa wajjin argataniif ani isaaniif jedhee waan hundumaa nan obsa.
english: Therefore I endure all things for the chosen ones’ sake, that they also may obtain the salvation which is in Christ Jesus with eternal glory.

kikuyu: Dubbichi amanamaan akkana jedha: Nu isa wajjin yoo duune, isa wajjin ni jiraanna;
english: This saying is trustworthy: “For if we died with him, we will also live with him.

kikuyu: nu yoo obsine, isa wajjin ni moona. Nu yoo isa ganne, innis nu gana.
english: If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.

kikuyu: Nu yoo amanamoo taʼuu baanne, inni amanamaa taʼee jiraata; inni of ganuu hin dandaʼuutii.
english: If we are faithless, he remains faithful; for he can’t deny himself.”

kikuyu: Wantoota kanneen isaan yaadachiisi; waaʼee jechootaatiinis akka wal hin lolleef fuula Waaqaa duratti isaan akeekkachiisi; wanni akkasii warra dhagaʼan ni diiga malee waa tokko illee hin fayyaduutii.
english: Remind them of these things, charging them in the sight of the Lord that they don’t argue about words to no profit, to the subverting of those who hear.

kikuyu: Atis dubbii dhugaa sana sirriitti qabachuudhaan hojjetaa qoratamee fudhatame kan itti hin qaanofne taʼiitii fuula Waaqaa duratti of dhiʼeessuuf tattaaffadhu.
english: Give diligence to present yourself approved by God, a workman who doesn’t need to be ashamed, properly handling the Word of Truth.

kikuyu: Garuu dubbii faayidaa hin qabne irraa fagaadhu; dubbiin akkasii ittuma caalchisee nama Waaqaa taʼuu irraa nama fageessaatii.
english: But shun empty chatter, for it will go further in ungodliness,

kikuyu: Barsiisni isaaniis akka dhukkuba gaangiriinii babalʼachaa deema. Himenewoosii fi Filexoosis isaan keessatti argamu;
english: and those words will consume like gangrene, of whom is Hymenaeus and Philetus:

kikuyu: isaanis duʼaa kaʼuun taʼee darbeera jechuudhaan dhugaa irraa fagaataniiru. Amantii namoota tokko tokkoos ni balleessu.
english: men who have erred concerning the truth, saying that the resurrection is already past, and overthrowing the faith of some.

kikuyu: Garuu hundeen Waaqaa hin sochoofamne kan chaappaa, “Gooftaan warra kan isaa taʼan ni beeka,” akkanumas “Namni maqaa Gooftaa waammatu hundi hammina irraa haa deebiʼu” jedhuun chaappeffame jabaatee dhaabateera.
english: However, God’s firm foundation stands, having this seal: “The Lord knows those who are his,” and, “Let every one who names the name of the Lord depart from unrighteousness.”

kikuyu: Mana guddaa tokko keessa miʼa warqeetii fi meetii qofa utuu hin taʼin, miʼi mukaatii fi suphees jira; kana keessaas tokko tokko ulfinaaf, kaan immoo salphinaaf oola.
english: Now in a large house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of clay. Some are for honor and some for dishonor.

kikuyu: Namni tokko yoo salphina kana irraa of qulqulleesse, inni miʼa ulfinaa kan qulqulleeffame, kan Gooftaa isaa fayyaduu fi kan hojii gaarii kam iyyuu hojjechuuf qopheeffame taʼa.
english: If anyone therefore purges himself from these, he will be a vessel for honor, sanctified, and suitable for the master’s use, prepared for every good work.

kikuyu: Atis hawwii hamaa yeroo dargaggummaa irraa baqadhu; warra garaa qulqulluun Gooftaa waammatan wajjin qajeelummaa, amantii, jaalalaa fi nagaa duukaa buʼi.
english: Flee from youthful lusts; but pursue righteousness, faith, love, and peace with those who call on the Lord out of a pure heart.

kikuyu: Falmii faayidaa hin qabnee fi gowwummaa keessa hin seenin; kun akka lola fidu atuu ni beektaatii.
english: But refuse foolish and ignorant questionings, knowing that they generate strife.

kikuyu: Garbichi Gooftaa kan nama hundumaaf garaa laafu, kan barsiisuu dandaʼuu fi obsa qabeessa taʼuu qaba malee kan namaan wal lolu taʼuu hin qabu.
english: The Lord’s servant must not quarrel, but be gentle toward all, able to teach, patient,

kikuyu: Innis akka Waaqni qalbii jijjiirrannaa gara dhugaa beekuutti isaan geessu isaaniif kennu abdachaa warra isaan morman garraamummaan sirreessuu qaba;
english: in gentleness correcting those who oppose him. Perhaps God may give them repentance leading to a full knowledge of the truth,

kikuyu: akkasiinis isaan qalbii horatanii kiyyoo diiyaabiloos kan akka isaan fedhii isaa guutaniif isaan boojiʼe sana jalaa baʼu.
english: and they may recover themselves out of the devil’s snare, having been taken captive by him to do his will.

kikuyu: Garuu guyyoota dhumaa keessa yeroon rakkinaa akka dhufu hubadhu.
english: But know this: that in the last days, grievous times will come.

kikuyu: Namoonni of jaallattoota, jaallattoota maallaqaa, of jajjoota, of tuultota, warra Waaqa arrabsan, warra abbaa fi haadha isaaniitiif hin ajajamne, warra hin galateeffanne, warra qulqullummaa hin qabne,
english: For men will be lovers of self, lovers of money, boastful, arrogant, blasphemers, disobedient to parents, unthankful, unholy,

kikuyu: warra jaalala hin qabne, warra dhiifama hin goone, warra maqaa nama balleessan, warra of hin qabne, gara jabeeyyii, warra waan gaarii hin jaallanne,
english: without natural affection, unforgiving, slanderers, without self-control, fierce, not lovers of good,

kikuyu: gantoota, warra akka malee jarjaran, warra of bokoksan, warra Waaqa jaallachuu irra waan isaan gammachiisu jaallatan ni taʼu;
english: traitors, headstrong, conceited, lovers of pleasure rather than lovers of God,

kikuyu: warra Waaqaaf bulan ni fakkaatu; garuu humna isaa ni ganu. Ati warra akkasii irraa fagaadhu.
english: holding a form of godliness but having denied its power. Turn away from these, also.

kikuyu: Isaan warra manneen seenuudhaan dubartoota dadhaboo warra cubbuun isaan irra tuulamee fi warra hawwii gosa hundaatiin asii fi achi raafaman boojiʼanii dha;
english: For some of these are people who creep into houses and take captive gullible women loaded down with sins, led away by various lusts,

kikuyu: dubartoonni kunneen yeroo hunda ni baratu; garuu gonkumaa dhugaa beekuutti dhufuu hin dandaʼan.
english: always learning and never able to come to the knowledge of the truth.

kikuyu: Akkuma Yaaneesii fi Yaambirees Museen morman sana namoonni qalbiin isaanii badee waaʼee amantiitti fudhatama dhaban kunneenis dhugaadhaan ni mormu.
english: Even as Jannes and Jambres opposed Moses, so these also oppose the truth, men corrupted in mind, who concerning the faith are rejected.

kikuyu: Taʼus gowwummaan isaanii waan akkuma namoota sanaa nama hunda biratti ifatti baʼuuf isaan fagoo hin deeman.
english: But they will proceed no further. For their folly will be evident to all men, as theirs also came to be.

kikuyu: Ati garuu barsiisa ko, haala jireenya koo, kaayyoo koo, amantii koo, obsa koo, jaalala koo, jabaadhee dhaabachuu koo hundumaa duukaa buuteerta;
english: But you followed my teaching, conduct, purpose, faith, patience, love, steadfastness,

kikuyu: ariʼatamuu koo, rakkina kootii fi waan Anxookiiyaatti, Iqooniyoonii fi Lisxiraanitti narra gaʼe, ariʼatama garaa garaa kan ani obsaan keessa darbes duukaa buuteerta. Gooftaan garuu waan kana hunda jalaa na baase.
english: persecutions, and sufferings—those things that happened to me at Antioch, Iconium, and Lystra. I endured those persecutions. The Lord delivered me out of them all.

kikuyu: Dhugumaanuu namni Kiristoos Yesuusiin nama Waaqaa taʼee jiraachuu barbaadu kam iyyuu ni ariʼatama;
english: Yes, and all who desire to live godly in Christ Jesus will suffer persecution.

kikuyu: namoonni hamoonii fi gowwoomsitoonni garuu nama gowwoomsaa, of illee gowwoomfamaa hamminaan ittuma caalaa deemu.
english: But evil men and impostors will grow worse and worse, deceiving and being deceived.

kikuyu: Ati garuu waan barattee fi waan hubatte sanatti jabaadhu; eenyu irraa akka baratte beektaatii;
english: But you remain in the things which you have learned and have been assured of, knowing from whom you have learned them.

kikuyu: akkasumas ati ijoollummaa keetii jalqabdee Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluu kanneen waaʼee fayyina karaa Kiristoos Yesuusitti amanuutiin argamu sanaaf ogeessa si taasisuu dandaʼan akkamitti akka baratte ni beekta.
english: From infancy, you have known the holy Scriptures which are able to make you wise for salvation through faith which is in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Katabbiin Qulqulluun hundi hafuura afaan Waaqaatii baʼeen kennaman; isaanis barsiisuuf, akeekkachiisuuf, sirreessuu fi qajeelummaan leenjisuuf ni fayyadu;
english: Every Scripture is God-breathed and profitable for teaching, for reproof, for correction, and for instruction in righteousness,

kikuyu: kunis akka namni Waaqaa hojii gaarii hundumaaf guutummaatti hidhatee qophaaʼuuf.
english: that each person who belongs to God may be complete, thoroughly equipped for every good work.

kikuyu: Ani fuula Waaqaa duratti, fuula Kiristoos Yesuus isa warra jiraatanii fi warra duʼanitti muruuf jiruu durattis mulʼachuu isaatii fi mootummaa isaatiin sin gorsa.
english: I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing and his Kingdom:

kikuyu: Dubbicha lallabi; yeroo mijaaʼaattis taʼu yeroo hin mijoofnetti qophaaʼi; obsa guddaa fi barsiisa of eeggannaatiin sirreessi; ifadhu; jajjabeessis.
english: preach the word; be urgent in season and out of season; reprove, rebuke, and exhort with all patience and teaching.

kikuyu: Yeroon itti namoonni barsiisa dhugaa dhagaʼuuf obsa hin qabaanne ni dhufaatii. Qooda kanaa akka waan gurri isaanii inni hooqsisu sun dhagaʼuu barbaadu itti himaniif hawwii isaanii guutachuuf barsiistota baayʼee ofii isaaniitiif walitti qabatu.
english: For the time will come when they will not listen to the sound doctrine, but having itching ears, will heap up for themselves teachers after their own lusts,

kikuyu: Gurra isaaniis dhugaa dhagaʼuu irraa garagalchanii gara oduu hundee hin qabneetti deebisu.
english: and will turn away their ears from the truth, and turn away to fables.

kikuyu: Ati garuu waan hunda keessatti ilaallachaa deemi; rakkina obsi; hojii tajaajilaan wangeelaa tokko hojjetu hojjedhu; tajaajila kees fiixaan baasi.
english: But you be sober in all things, suffer hardship, do the work of an evangelist, and fulfill your ministry.

kikuyu: Ani ammuma iyyuu akka dhibaayyuutti dhangalaafamuuf qophaaʼeera; yeroon deemsa koos gaʼeera.
english: For I am already being offered, and the time of my departure has come.

kikuyu: Ani lola gaarii loleera; dorgommii xumureera; amantiis eegeera.
english: I have fought the good fight. I have finished the course. I have kept the faith.

kikuyu: Amma gonfoon qajeelummaa na eeggata; isas Abbaa Murtii qajeelaa, Gooftichatu guyyaa sana naa kenna; kanas warra mulʼachuu isaa jaallatan hundaaf kenna malee ana qofaaf miti.
english: From now on, the crown of righteousness is stored up for me, which the Lord, the righteous judge, will give to me on that day; and not to me only, but also to all those who have loved his appearing.

kikuyu: Dafii gara koo kottu;
english: Be diligent to come to me soon,

kikuyu: Deemaas addunyaa kana jaallatee na dhiisee gara Tasaloniiqee deemeeraatii. Qeerqis gara Galaatiyaa, Tiitoon immoo gara Dilmaaxiyaa deemaniiru.
english: for Demas left me, having loved this present world, and went to Thessalonica; Crescens to Galatia; and Titus to Dalmatia.

kikuyu: Luqaas qofatu na bira jira. Maarqos waan tajaajila koo keessatti na gargaaruuf isa of duukaa fidii kottu.
english: Only Luke is with me. Take Mark and bring him with you, for he is useful to me for service.

kikuyu: Ani Xikiqoosin Efesoonitti ergeera.
english: But I sent Tychicus to Ephesus.

kikuyu: Ati yommuu dhuftutti waaroo ani Xirooʼaasitti Kaariphoos biratti dhiisee fi kitaabota maramoo, keessumattuu kitaabota gogaa duugamaa sana naa fidi.
english: Bring the cloak that I left at Troas with Carpus when you come—and the books, especially the parchments.

kikuyu: Iskindiroos tumtuun naasii sun akka malee natti hammaate. Gooftaan akka hojii isaatti ni deebisaaf.
english: Alexander the coppersmith did much evil to me. The Lord will repay him according to his deeds.

kikuyu: Namichi kun waan akka malee ergaa keenya mormeef atis isa irraa of eeggachuu qabda.
english: Beware of him, for he greatly opposed our words.

kikuyu: Yeroo ani falmata koo kan jalqabaa dhiʼeeffadhetti hundi isaanii iyyuu na dhiisanii deeman malee namni tokko iyyuu na hin gargaarre. Anis akka wanni kun isaanitti hin lakkaaʼamneef Waaqa nan kadhadha.
english: At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

kikuyu: Garuu akka karaa kootiin ergaan guutummaatti lallabamuu fi akka Namoonni Ormaa hundi dhagaʼaniif Gooftaan na bira dhaabatee na jajjabeesse. Anis afaan leencaa jalaa nan baafame.
english: But the Lord stood by me and strengthened me, that through me the message might be fully proclaimed, and that all the Gentiles might hear. So I was delivered out of the mouth of the lion.

kikuyu: Gooftaan waan hamaa hunda jalaa na baasee mootummaa isaa kan samiiti nagumaan na galcha. Bara baraa hamma bara baraatti ulfinni isaaf haa taʼu. Ameen.
english: And the Lord will deliver me from every evil work and will preserve me for his heavenly Kingdom. To him be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Phirisqilaa fi Aqiilaatti, warra mana Oneesifooros jiraatanittis nagaa naa himi.
english: Greet Prisca and Aquila, and the house of Onesiphorus.

kikuyu: Erisxoos Qorontositti hafe; Xiroofiimoos immoo dhukkubsannaan ani Miilexoositti isa dhiise.
english: Erastus remained at Corinth, but I left Trophimus at Miletus sick.

kikuyu: Gannaan dura dafii kottu. Ewugiloos nagaa siif dhaama; Phuudeniis, Liinoos, Qilaawudiyaa fi obboloonni hundinuus akkasuma nagaa siif dhaamu.
english: Be diligent to come before winter. Eubulus salutes you, as do Pudens, Linus, Claudia, and all the brothers.

kikuyu: Gooftaan hafuura kee wajjin haa taʼu. Ayyaanni si wajjin haa taʼu.
english: The Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Grace be with you. Amen.

kikuyu: Phaawulos isa amantii filatamtoota Waaqaatii fi dhugaa beekuu gara Waaqaaf buluutti nama geessuuf garbicha Waaqaatii fi ergamaa Yesuus Kiristoos taʼe irraa;
english: Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God’s chosen ones and the knowledge of the truth which is according to godliness,

kikuyu: kunis abdii jireenya bara baraa isa Waaqni hin sobne sun jalqaba addunyaatiin dura waadaa gale irratti kan hundeeffamee dha;
english: in hope of eternal life, which God, who can’t lie, promised before time began;

kikuyu: innis yommuu yeroon murteeffame sun gaʼetti karaa lallaba isa ajaja Fayyisaa keenya Waaqaatiin imaanaa natti kennameetiin dubbii isaa ifatti baaseera,
english: but in his own time revealed his word in the message with which I was entrusted according to the commandment of God our Savior,

kikuyu: Gara Tiitoo isa amantii walii wajjin qabnuun ilma koo dhugaa taʼeetti:
english: to Titus, my true child according to a common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.

kikuyu: Sababiin ani Qareexitti si hambiseef akka ati waan utuu hin xumuramin hafe toora qabsiiftuu fi akkuma ani si ajajettis magaalaawwan hunda keessatti jaarsolii muudduuf ture.
english: I left you in Crete for this reason, that you would set in order the things that were lacking and appoint elders in every city, as I directed you—

kikuyu: Jaarsi tokko kan mudaa hin qabne, dhirsa niitii tokkittii, kan ijoolleen isaa amananii jireenya gad dhiisiitii fi ajajamuu diduun maqaan isaanii hin badin taʼuu qaba.
english: if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.

kikuyu: Phaaphaasiin tokko sababii hojiin Waaqaa imaanaa isatti kennameef inni nama mudaa hin qabne taʼuu qaba malee kan of tuulu, kan dafee aaru, kan machaaʼu, kan lola jaallatuu fi kan karaa hin malleen buʼaa argachuuf tattaaffatu taʼuu hin qabu.
english: For the overseer must be blameless, as God’s steward, not self-pleasing, not easily angered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for dishonest gain;

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa inni nama keessumaa simatu, nama waan gaarii jaallatu, kan of qabu, qajeelaa, qulqulluu fi nama naamusa qabu taʼuu qaba.
english: but given to hospitality, a lover of good, sober minded, fair, holy, self-controlled,

kikuyu: Inni akka barsiisa dhugaatiin warra kaan gorsuu, warra barsiisa sanaan morman immoo akka dogoggora isaanii itti himee amansiisuu dandaʼuuf akkuma barsiifametti dubbii amanamaa sana jabeessee qabachuu qaba.
english: holding to the faithful word which is according to the teaching, that he may be able to exhort in the sound doctrine, and to convict those who contradict him.

kikuyu: Finciltoonni baayʼeen, warri dubbii faayidaa hin qabne dubbatanii fi gowwoomsitoonni keessumattuu miseensonni garee warra dhagna qabatanii hedduutu jiraatii.
english: For there are also many unruly men, vain talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,

kikuyu: Isaan buʼaa hin malle argachuuf jedhanii waan barsiisuun isaan irra hin jirre barsiisuudhaan waan maatii guutuu diiganiif afaan qabachiifamuu qabu.
english: whose mouths must be stopped: men who overthrow whole houses, teaching things which they ought not, for dishonest gain’s sake.

kikuyu: Raajota isaanii keessaa tokko, “Warri Qareexi yeroo hunda sobdoota; bineensota hamoo dha; albaadheyyii dhibaaʼoo dha” jedheera.
english: One of them, a prophet of their own, said, “Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, and idle gluttons.”

kikuyu: Dhuga baʼumsi kun dhugaa dha. Kanaafuu akka isaan amantii dhugaa qabaataniif jabeessii isaan ifadhu.
english: This testimony is true. For this cause, reprove them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,

kikuyu: Akka isaan mammaaksa Yihuudootaa kan hundee hin qabne yookaan ajaja warra dhugaadhaan mormanii duukaa hin buuneefis jabeessii isaan ifadhu.
english: not paying attention to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn away from the truth.

kikuyu: Warra qulqullaaʼoof wanni hundinuu qulqulluu dha; warra xuraaʼoo fi warra hin amanneef garuu wanni tokko iyyuu qulqulluu miti. Dhugumaanuu yaadni isaaniitii fi qalbiin isaanii xuraaʼeera.
english: To the pure, all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving, nothing is pure; but both their mind and their conscience are defiled.

kikuyu: Isaan nu Waaqa beekna jedhu; hojii isaaniitiin garuu isa ganu. Isaan jibbamoo dha; warra hin ajajamnee fi warra waan gaarii tokko iyyuu hojjechuuf gaʼumsa hin qabnee dha.
english: They profess that they know God, but by their deeds they deny him, being abominable, disobedient, and unfit for any good work.

kikuyu: Ati garuu waan barsiisa dhugaa wajjin deemu barsiisi.
english: But say the things which fit sound doctrine,

kikuyu: Jaarsoliin akka amala qabeeyyii, kabajamoo fi warra of qaban taʼaniif, akkasumas akka warra amantii dhugaa, jaalalaa fi obsa qabaatan barsiisi.
english: that older men should be temperate, sensible, sober minded, sound in faith, in love, and in perseverance,

kikuyu: Akkasuma immoo jaartoliin akka jireenya isaaniitiin kabajamoo taʼan, akka waan gaariis barsiisan malee akka maqaa nama hin balleessine yookaan akka dhugaatii daadhii wayinii baayʼeetiin hin fudhatamne isaan barsiisi.
english: and that older women likewise be reverent in behavior, not slanderers nor enslaved to much wine, teachers of that which is good,

kikuyu: Yoos isaan akka dubartoonni shamarran dhirsoota isaanii fi ijoollee isaanii jaallatan barsiisuu ni dandaʼu;
english: that they may train the young wives to love their husbands, to love their children,

kikuyu: akka dubbiin Waaqaa hin tuffatamneefis akka of qaban, akka qulqullaaʼan, akka hojii mana keessaatiin qabaman, akka arjoota taʼan, akka dhirsoota isaaniitiif ajajaman ni barsiisu.
english: to be sober minded, chaste, workers at home, kind, being in subjection to their own husbands, that God’s word may not be blasphemed.

kikuyu: Akkasumas dargaggoonni akka of qabaniif gorsi.
english: Likewise, exhort the younger men to be sober minded.

kikuyu: Waan hunda keessatti waan gaarii hojjechuun fakkeenya isaaniif taʼi. Barsiisa kee keessatti amanamaa, kabajamaa fi nama akka salphaatti hin ilaalamne taʼi;
english: In all things show yourself an example of good works. In your teaching, show integrity, seriousness, incorruptibility,

kikuyu: akka warri siin morman waaʼee keenya waan hamaa dubbatan tokko illee dhabanii qaanaʼaniifis dubbii dhugaa kan tuffatamuu hin dandeenye dubbadhu.
english: and soundness of speech that can’t be condemned, that he who opposes you may be ashamed, having no evil thing to say about us.

kikuyu: Garboonni waan hundaan akka gooftota isaaniitiif ajajaman, akka gooftota isaanii gammachiisuu yaalan, akka waan gooftonni isaanii dubbataniif deebii mormii hin deebifne barsiisi;
english: Exhort servants to be in subjection to their own masters and to be well-pleasing in all things, not contradicting,

kikuyu: akka isaan gooftota isaanii jalaa hin hanne, garuu akka barsiisni Fayyisaa keenya Waaqaa karaa hundumaan hawwataa taʼu gochuuf akka isaan amanamummaa guutuu argisiisan barsiisi.
english: not stealing, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God, our Savior, in all things.

kikuyu: Ayyaanni Waaqaa kan fayyina fidu nama hundatti mulʼifameeraatii.
english: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to all men,

kikuyu: Ayyaanni kunis Waaqa malee jiraachuu fi hawwii addunyaa ganuun bara kana keessa jireenya of qabiisaa, jireenya qajeelummaatii fi jireenya Waaqatti buluu akka jiraannu nu barsiisa;
english: instructing us to the intent that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we would live soberly, righteously, and godly in this present age;

kikuyu: kunis yommuu nu abdii keenya isa eebbifamaa jechuunis mulʼachuu ulfina Waaqa keenya guddichaatii fi Fayyisaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos eeggachaa jirrutti taʼa;
english: looking for the blessed hope and appearing of the glory of our great God and Savior, Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: innis hammina hunda irraa nu furuu fi saba ofii isaa warra waan gaarii hojjechuuf hinaafan ofiif qulqulleeffachuuf jedhee of dabarsee nuuf kenneera.
english: who gave himself for us, that he might redeem us from all iniquity and purify for himself a people for his own possession, zealous for good works.

kikuyu: Egaa wantoonni ati barsiisuu qabdu kanneenii dha. Taayitaa guutuun jajjabeessi; ifadhus. Namni tokko iyyuu si hin tuffatin.
english: Say these things and exhort and reprove with all authority. Let no one despise you.

kikuyu: Ati akka namoonni bulchitootaa fi abbootii taayitaatiif bulan, akka ajajamanii fi akka waan gaarii kam iyyuu hojjechuuf qophaaʼoo taʼan yaadachiisi;
english: Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,

kikuyu: akka isaan maqaa nama tokko illee hin balleessine, akka namoota nagaatii fi obsa qabeeyyii taʼan, akka nama hundaaf garraamummaa argisiisanis yaadachiisi.
english: to speak evil of no one, not to be contentious, to be gentle, showing all humility toward all men.

kikuyu: Nu mataan keenyas duraan warra gowwoota, warra hin ajajamne, warra gowwoomfamnee fi warra dharraa hamaa fi gammachuu gosa hundaatiif garboomfamne turre. Namootaan jibbamaa fi walis jibbaa, hamminaa fi hinaaffaan jiraachaa turre.
english: For we were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful, and hating one another.

kikuyu: Yommuu gaarummaa fi jaalalli Fayyisaa keenya Waaqaa mulʼatetti garuu,
english: But when the kindness of God our Savior and his love toward mankind appeared,

kikuyu: inni sababii qajeelummaa nu hojjenneetiif utuu hin taʼin sababii araara isaatiif jedhee nu fayyise. Inni dhiqannaa lammata dhalachuutii fi haaromsuu Hafuura Qulqulluutiin nu fayyise;
english: not by works of righteousness which we did ourselves, but according to his mercy, he saved us through the washing of regeneration and renewing by the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: hafuurri kunis isa Waaqni karaa Fayyisaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiin arjummaadhaan nurratti dhangalaase sana;
english: whom he poured out on us richly through Jesus Christ our Savior;

kikuyu: kunis akka nu ayyaana isaatiin qajeeltota taasifamnee abdii jireenya bara baraa qabaachuun dhaaltota taanuuf.
english: that being justified by his grace, we might be made heirs according to the hope of eternal life.

kikuyu: Jechi kunis amanamaa dha. Warri Waaqa amanatan akka waan gaarii hojjechuuf of eeggannaan of kennan, akka ati cimsitee waan kana dubbattu nan barbaada. Kunis waan akka malee gaarii fi waan nama hundumaa fayyaduu dha.
english: This saying is faithful, and concerning these things I desire that you insist confidently, so that those who have believed God may be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men;

kikuyu: Ati garuu falmii faayidaa hin qabnee fi hidda dhalootaa lakkaaʼuu irraa, waaʼee seeraa irratti wal mormuu fi wal loluu irraa fagaadhu; kun waan buʼaa hin qabnee fi waan hin fayyadnee dhaatii.
english: but shun foolish questionings, genealogies, strife, and disputes about the law; for they are unprofitable and vain.

kikuyu: Nama gargar baʼuu fidu tokko yeroo tokko akeekkachiisi; yeroo lammaffaas akeekkachiisi. Ergasii immoo isa irraa fagaadhu.
english: Avoid a factious man after a first and second warning,

kikuyu: Namni akkasii akka micciiramaa fi cubbamaa taʼe atuu beekta; inni nama ofuma isaatti muruu dha.
english: knowing that such a one is perverted and sinful, being self-condemned.

kikuyu: Ani waanan yeroo gannaa Niqoophiliyoonitti dabarsuuf murteesseef akkuma ani Arxemaas yookaan Xikiqoosin sitti ergeen dafii kottu.
english: When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me to Nicopolis, for I have determined to winter there.

kikuyu: Zenaas abukaattichaa fi Apholoosin imala isaanii irratti gargaaruuf waan dandeessu hunda godhi; waan isaan barbaachisu hunda qabaachuu isaanii illee mirkaneessi.
english: Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey speedily, that nothing may be lacking for them.

kikuyu: Namoonni keenya akka waan guyyaa guyyaatti isaan barbaachisu hojjetanii argatanii fi akka jireenya buʼaa hin qabne hin jiraanneefis waan gaarii hojjechuuf of kennuu barachuu qabu.
english: Let our people also learn to maintain good works to meet necessary needs, that they may not be unfruitful.

kikuyu: Warri na wajjin jiran hundinuu nagaa siif dhaamu. Warra amantiin nu jaallatanitti nagaa nuuf himi. Ayyaanni hunda keessan wajjin haa taʼu.
english: All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Phaawulos isa Kiristoos Yesuusiif jedhee hidhamee fi obboleessa keenya Xiimotewos irraa,
english: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, to Philemon, our beloved fellow worker,

kikuyu: akkanumas gara obboleettii keenya Aphifiyaatti, gara Arkiphaa isa nu wajjin loltuu taʼeetti, gara waldaa kiristaanaa ishee mana keetti walitti qabamtuuttis:
english: to the beloved Apphia, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the assembly in your house:

kikuyu: Abbaa keenya Waaqaa fi Yesuus Kiristoos Gooftaa irraa ayyaannii fi nagaan isiniif haa taʼu.
english: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Ani yeroo kadhannaa koo keessatti si yaadadhu hunda Waaqa koo nan galateeffadha;
english: I thank my God always, making mention of you in my prayers,

kikuyu: ani waaʼee amantii kee kan ati Gooftaa Yesuusitti qabduu fi waaʼee jaalala kee kan ati qulqulloota isaa hundaaf qabduu nan dhagaʼaatii.
english: hearing of your love and of the faith which you have toward the Lord Jesus and toward all the saints,

kikuyu: Ani akka ati waaʼee waan gaarii nu Kiristoosiin qabnu hundumaa hubannaa guutuu qabaattee amantii kee namaan gaʼuuf jabaattu nan kadhadha.
english: that the fellowship of your faith may become effective in the knowledge of every good thing which is in us in Christ Jesus.

kikuyu: Yaa obboleessa, waan ati garaa qulqullootaa qabbaneessiteef jaalalli kee gammachuu fi jajjabina guddaa naa kenneera.
english: For we have much joy and comfort in your love, because the hearts of the saints have been refreshed through you, brother.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani akka ati waan hojjechuu qabdu hojjetu si ajajuuf yoo Kiristoosiin ija jabina qabaadhe illee,
english: Therefore though I have all boldness in Christ to command you that which is appropriate,

kikuyu: sababii jaalalaatiif cimseen si kadhadha. Egaa ani Phaawulos jaarsichii fi ammas Kiristoos Yesuusiif kanan hidhame,
english: yet for love’s sake I rather appeal to you, being such a one as Paul, the aged, but also a prisoner of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: ilma koo Oneesimoos isa ani hidhamuu kootiin dhalche sanaaf sin kadhadha.
english: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whom I have become the father of in my chains,

kikuyu: Inni kanaan dura nama homaa si hin fayyadne ture; amma garuu siifis anaafis nama faayidaa qabu taʼeera.
english: who once was useless to you, but now is useful to you and to me.

kikuyu: Ani isa, nama akka garaa kootii sana deebisee gara keetti nan erga.
english: I am sending him back. Therefore receive him, that is, my own heart,

kikuyu: Ani yeroon wangeelaaf hidhametti inni iddoo kee buʼee akka na tajaajiluuf of biratti isa hambifachuu barbaadeen ture.
english: whom I desired to keep with me, that on your behalf he might serve me in my chains for the Good News.

kikuyu: Ani garuu gaarummaan kee utuu dirqamaan hin taʼin fedhiidhaan akka taʼuuf waanuma tokko illee eeyyama kee malee gochuu hin barbaanne.
english: But I was willing to do nothing without your consent, that your goodness would not be as of necessity, but of free will.

kikuyu: Tarii inni yeroo gabaabaaf siin gargar baʼuun isaa akka ati deebiftee isa simattee hamma dhumaatti of bira tursituuf taʼa;
english: For perhaps he was therefore separated from you for a while that you would have him forever,

kikuyu: atis siʼachi akka garbichaatti utuu hin taʼin, akka obboleessa jaallatamaa garbicha caalu tokkootti isa simadhu. Inni keessumattuu erga anaaf akkas jaallatamaa taʼe siif immoo fooniinis Gooftaadhaanis hammam caalaa jaallatamaa haa taʼu ree?
english: no longer as a slave, but more than a slave, a beloved brother—especially to me, but how much rather to you, both in the flesh and in the Lord.

kikuyu: Egaa ati yoo akka michuu keetiitti na ilaalte akkuma na simatutti isas simadhu.
english: If then you count me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

kikuyu: Yoo inni waanuma tokkoon illee si yakkee jiraate yookaan ati yoo waanuma tokko illee isa irraa qabaatte natti lakkaaʼi.
english: But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.

kikuyu: Ani Phaawulos siifan kaffala jedhee harkuma kootiin barreesseera. Akka ati mataan kee iyyuu kan koo taate ani homaa sitti hin himu.
english: I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self besides).

kikuyu: Egaa yaa obboleessa, ani Gooftaadhaan faayidaa kana sirraa argachuu nan barbaada; Kiristoositti garaa koo naa qabbaneessi.
english: Yes, brother, let me have joy from you in the Lord. Refresh my heart in the Lord.

kikuyu: Akka ati waan ani si kadhadhu caalaa naa gootu beekuudhaan ajajamuu kee amanadhee siifan barreessa.
english: Having confidence in your obedience, I write to you, knowing that you will do even beyond what I say.

kikuyu: Kana malees ani kadhannaa keessaniin akkan isiniif kennamu waanan abdadhuuf mana boqonnaa naa qopheessi.
english: Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

kikuyu: Ephaafiraan inni Kiristoos Yesuusiif jedhee na wajjin hidhame nagaa siif dhaama.
english: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, greets you,

kikuyu: Akkasumas warri na wajjin hojjetan Maarqos, Arisxirokoos, Deemaasii fi Luqaas nagaa siif dhaamu.
english: as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

kikuyu: Ayyaanni Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos hafuura keessan wajjin haa taʼu.
english: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit. Amen.

kikuyu: Bara durii Waaqni yeroo baayʼee fi karaa adda addaatiin raajotaan abbootii keenyatti dubbatee ture;
english: God, having in the past spoken to the fathers through the prophets at many times and in various ways,

kikuyu: bara dhumaa kana keessa garuu Ilma isaa kan inni dhaaltuu waan hundumaa godhee muudeen nutti dubbate; isumaanis addunyaawwan uume.
english: has at the end of these days spoken to us by his Son, whom he appointed heir of all things, through whom also he made the worlds.

kikuyu: Ilmi calaqqisa ulfina Waaqaa ti; eenyummaa Waaqaas akkuma jirutti mulʼisa; dubbii isaa humna qabeessa sanaanis waan hunda hirkisee baata. Innis erga cubbuu keenya nurraa qulqulleessee booddee samii irra mirga Waaqa ulfina qabeessa sanaa taaʼe.
english: His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his power, who, when he had by himself purified us of our sins, sat down on the right hand of the Majesty on high,

kikuyu: Akkuma maqaan inni dhaale sun kan ergamootaa caalaa guddaa taʼe sana innis ergamoota caalaa guddaa dha.
english: having become as much better than the angels as the more excellent name he has inherited is better than theirs.

kikuyu: Waaqni ergamoota keessaa isa kamiin, “Ati Ilma koo ti; ani harʼa si dhalcheera” Yookaan isa kamiin, “Ani isaaf Abbaa nan taʼa; innis Ilma naa taʼa” jedhee beeka?
english: For to which of the angels did he say at any time, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father?” and again, “I will be to him a Father, and he will be to me a Son?”

kikuyu: Akkasumas Waaqni yommuu Ilma isaa hangafa gara addunyaa kanaatti ergutti, “Ergamoonni Waaqaa hundi isa haa waaqeffatan” jedha.
english: When he again brings in the firstborn into the world he says, “Let all the angels of God worship him.”

kikuyu: Yommuu waaʼee ergamootaa dubbatus, “Inni ergamoota isaa hafuurota, tajaajiltoota isaa immoo arraba ibiddaa godha” jedha.
english: Of the angels he says, “He makes his angels winds, and his servants a flame of fire.”

kikuyu: Waaʼee Ilmaa garuu akkana jedha; “Yaa Waaqayyo, teessoon kee bara baraa hamma bara baraatti ni jiraata; bokkuun qajeelummaas bokkuu mootummaa keetii ni taʼa.
english: But of the Son he says, “Your throne, O God, is forever and ever. The scepter of uprightness is the scepter of your Kingdom.

kikuyu: Ati qajeelummaa jaallatte; jalʼina immoo ni jibbite; kanaafuu Waaqayyo Waaqni kee zayitii gammachuutiin si dibee, hiriyoota kee si caalchise.”
english: You have loved righteousness and hated iniquity; therefore God, your God, has anointed you with the oil of gladness above your fellows.”

kikuyu: Akkasumas inni akkana jedha; “Yaa Gooftaa, ati jalqabatti lafa hundeessite; samiiwwanis hojii harka keetii ti.
english: And, “You, Lord, in the beginning, laid the foundation of the earth. The heavens are the works of your hands.

kikuyu: Isaan ni badu; ati garuu ni jiraatta; hundumti isaanii akkuma uffataa ni moofaʼu;
english: They will perish, but you continue. They all will grow old like a garment does.

kikuyu: ati akkuma wayyaatti isaan marta; isaan akkuma uffataatti geeddaramu; ati garuu sanuma; umuriin kees gonkumaa dhuma hin qabu.”
english: You will roll them up like a mantle, and they will be changed; but you are the same. Your years won’t fail.”

kikuyu: Waaqni ergamoota keessaa isa kamiin, “Hamma ani diinota kee ejjeta miilla keetii godhutti, gara mirga koo taaʼi” jedhe?
english: But which of the angels has he told at any time, “Sit at my right hand, until I make your enemies the footstool of your feet?”

kikuyu: Ergamoonni hundinuu hafuurota tajaajilan kanneen warra fayyina dhaalan tajaajiluuf ergaman mitii?
english: Aren’t they all serving spirits, sent out to do service for the sake of those who will inherit salvation?

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu akka waan dhageenye irraa hin jalʼanneef waan sana irratti xiyyeeffannoo guddaa gochuu qabna.
english: Therefore we ought to pay greater attention to the things that were heard, lest perhaps we drift away.

kikuyu: Sababiin isaas erga dubbiin ergamootaan dubbatame sun eegamuu qabaatee, seera cabsuu fi ajajamuu diduun hundis erga adabbii malu argatanii,
english: For if the word spoken through angels proved steadfast, and every transgression and disobedience received a just penalty,

kikuyu: yoos nu yoo fayyina guddaa akkanaa tuffanne, akkamitti adabbii kana jalaa baana ree? Fayyinni jalqabatti Gooftaadhaan labsame kun warra dhagaʼaniin nuuf mirkaneeffame.
english: how will we escape if we neglect so great a salvation—which at the first having been spoken through the Lord, was confirmed to us by those who heard,

kikuyu: Waaqni mallattoon, raajii fi hojii dinqii adda addaatiin akkasumas kennaawwan Hafuura Qulqulluu kanneen akka fedhii isaatti kennamaniin dhugaa baʼeera.
english: God also testifying with them, both by signs and wonders, by various works of power, and by gifts of the Holy Spirit, according to his own will?

kikuyu: Inni addunyaa dhufuuf jiru, kan nu waaʼee isaa dubbannu sana ergamoota jala hin galchine.
english: For he didn’t subject the world to come, of which we speak, to angels.

kikuyu: Namni tokko garuu iddoo tokkotti akkana jedhee dhugaa baʼeera; “Akka ati isaaf yaadduuf namni maali? Akka isaaf dhimmituuf ilmi namaa maali?
english: But one has somewhere testified, saying, “What is man, that you think of him? Or the son of man, that you care for him?

kikuyu: Ati xinnoo ishee ergamootaa gad isa goote; ulfinaa fi kabajaan isa gonfite; hojii harka keetii irrattis isa muudde.
english: You made him a little lower than the angels. You crowned him with glory and honor.

kikuyu: Waan hundas miilla isaa jala galchite.” Inni yommuu waan hunda isa jala galchetti wanni inni utuu isa jala hin galchin hambise tokko iyyuu hin jiru. Taʼus yeroo ammaa wanni hundinuu isa jala galee hin arginu.
english: You have put all things in subjection under his feet.” For in that he subjected all things to him, he left nothing that is not subject to him. But now we don’t yet see all things subjected to him.

kikuyu: Garuu Yesuus inni ayyaana Waaqaatiin nama hundaaf duʼa dhandhamuuf jedhee xinnoo ishee ergamootaa gad taʼee ture sun dhiphina duʼaa waan dhiphateef amma ulfinaa fi kabajaan gonfamee argina.
english: But we see him who has been made a little lower than the angels, Jesus, because of the suffering of death crowned with glory and honor, that by the grace of God he should taste of death for everyone.

kikuyu: Waaqni wanni hundi isaaf jiraatuu fi isaan jiraatu sun ilmaan baayʼee gara ulfinaatti geessuuf jedhee mataa fayyina isaanii dhiphina kan hirʼina hin qabne gochuun isaaf ni mala ture.
english: For it became him, for whom are all things and through whom are all things, in bringing many children to glory, to make the author of their salvation perfect through sufferings.

kikuyu: Inni namoota qulqulleessuu fi kanneen qulqulleeffaman hundi kanuma abbaa tokkoo ti. Kanaafuu Yesuus obboloota jedhee isaan waamuu hin qaanaʼu.
english: For both he who sanctifies and those who are sanctified are all from one, for which cause he is not ashamed to call them brothers,

kikuyu: Inni, “Maqaa kee obboloota kootti nan labsa; waldaa kiristaanaa keessattis faarfannaadhaan sin jajadha” jedha.
english: saying, “I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the congregation I will sing your praise.”

kikuyu: Akkasumas, “Ani isa nan amanadha” jedha. Ammas inni, “Anii fi ijoolleen Waaqayyo naa kenne kunoo ti” jedha.
english: Again, “I will put my trust in him.” Again, “Behold, here I am with the children whom God has given me.”

kikuyu: Sababii ijoolleen sun foonii fi dhiiga qabaniif, Yesuusis duʼa ofii isaatiin diiyaabiloos isa duʼa irratti humna qabu sana balleessuuf jedhee namummaa isaanii qoodate;
english: Since then the children have shared in flesh and blood, he also himself in the same way partook of the same, that through death he might bring to nothing him who had the power of death, that is, the devil,

kikuyu: innis warra bara jireenya isaanii hunda garbummaa sodaa duʼaatiin hidhamanii turan bilisa baasuuf jedhee waan kana godhe.
english: and might deliver all of them who through fear of death were all their lifetime subject to bondage.

kikuyu: Inni dhugumaanuu sanyii Abrahaam gargaaruuf malee ergamoota Waaqaa gargaaruuf miti.
english: For most certainly, he doesn’t give help to angels, but he gives help to the offspring of Abraham.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu inni Waaqa tajaajiluu keessatti akka luba ol aanaa araara qabeessaa fi amanamaa taʼuuf, akka cubbuu namootaatiif araara buusuuf waan hundaan obboloota isaa fakkaachuutu isa irra ture.
english: Therefore he was obligated in all things to be made like his brothers, that he might become a merciful and faithful high priest in things pertaining to God, to make atonement for the sins of the people.

kikuyu: Inni mataan isaa waan dhiphina keessatti qorameef warra qoramaa jiran gargaaruu ni dandaʼa.
english: For in that he himself has suffered being tempted, he is able to help those who are tempted.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa obboloota qulqulloota, warra waamicha samii keessatti hirmaattan, Yesuus ergamaa fi luba ol aanaa amantii keenyaa sana ilaalaa.
english: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession: Jesus,

kikuyu: Akkuma Museen mana Waaqaa hunda keessatti amanamaa ture sana innis isa isa muudeef amanamaa ture.
english: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also Moses was in all his house.

kikuyu: Akkuma namni mana ijaaru tokko mana sana caalaa kabaja guddaa qabu, innis Musee caalaa kabaja guddaa qaba.
english: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, because he who built the house has more honor than the house.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon manaa namaan ijaaramaatii; kan waan hunda ijaare garuu Waaqa.
english: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

kikuyu: Museen waan fuul duratti dubbatamuuf jiru dhugaa baʼuuf akka tajaajilaa tokkootti mana Waaqaa hunda keessatti amanamaa ture.
english: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

kikuyu: Kiristoos garuu akka Ilmaatti mana Waaqaa irratti amanamaa dha. Nus yoo ija jabina keenyaa fi abdii ittiin boonnu sana jabeessinee qabanne, nu mana isaa ti.
english: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house. We are his house, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akkuma Hafuurri Qulqulluun jedhu: “Isin yoo harʼa sagalee isaa dhageessan,
english: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

kikuyu: akka yeroo qorumsaa gammoojjii keessatti finciluun gootan sana, mataa hin jabaatinaa;
english: don’t harden your hearts as in the rebellion, in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

kikuyu: abbootiin keessan achitti na qoranii na ilaalan; waggaa afurtamas waan ani hojjedhe argan.
english: where your fathers tested me and tried me, and saw my deeds for forty years.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani dhaloota sanatti aaree, ‘Yeroo hunda qalbii isaaniitiin dogoggoru; isaan karaa koo hin beekne’ jedhe.
english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways.’

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani dheekkamsa kootiin, ‘Isaan boqonnaa kootti hin galan’ jedhee kakadhe.”
english: As I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’”

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, akka isin keessaa namni tokko iyyuu garaa hamaa fi hin amanne kan Waaqa jiraataa irraa nama fageessu hin qabaanneef of eeggadhaa.
english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there might be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

kikuyu: Garuu isin keessaa akka namni tokko iyyuu gowwoomsaa cubbuutiin mata jabeessa hin taaneef utuu “Harʼa” jedhamaa jiruu guyyuma guyyaan wal jajjabeessaa.
english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”, lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

kikuyu: Nus yoo amantii keenya isa jalqabaa sana hamma dhumaatti jabeessinee qabanne Kiristoos wajjin hirmaattota ni taanaatii.
english: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold the beginning of our confidence firm to the end,

kikuyu: Kunis akkuma, “Isin yoo harʼa sagalee isaa dhageessan, akka yeroo fincilaa sana, mataa hin jabaatinaa” jedhamee barreeffamee dha.
english: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.”

kikuyu: Warri dhagaʼanii fincilan sun eenyu? Warra Museen qajeelchee Gibxii baase sana hunda mitii?
english: For who, when they heard, rebelled? Wasn’t it all those who came out of Egypt led by Moses?

kikuyu: Waaqni waggaa afurtama eenyu faatti aare? Warruma cubbuu hojjetanii reeffi isaanii gammoojjii keessatti kukkufe sanatti mitii?
english: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

kikuyu: Yoo warruma ajajamuu didan sana taʼe malee Waaqni akka isaan gonkumaa boqonnaa isaatti hin galleef eenyu faatti kakate ree?
english: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka isaan sababii amantii dhabuu isaaniitiif boqonnaa sanatti galuu hin dandaʼin argina.
english: We see that they weren’t able to enter in because of unbelief.

kikuyu: Kanaaf waadaan boqonnaa isaatti galuu sun amma iyyuu waan jiruuf isin keessaa namni kam iyyuu utuu boqonnaa sanatti hin galin akka hin hafne of haa eeggannu.
english: Let’s fear therefore, lest perhaps anyone of you should seem to have come short of a promise of entering into his rest.

kikuyu: Wangeelli isaanitti lallabame nuttis lallabameeraatii; garuu dubbiin lallabame sun waan amantii isaaniitiin wal hin fudhanneef warra dhagaʼan sanaaf faayidaa tokko illee hin kennine.
english: For indeed we have had good news preached to us, even as they also did, but the word they heard didn’t profit them, because it wasn’t mixed with faith by those who heard.

kikuyu: Nu warri amanne boqonnaa sanatti ni galla; kunis akkuma inni, “Kanaafuu ani dheekkamsa kootiin, ‘Isaan boqonnaa kootti hin galan’ jedhee kakadhe” jedhu sanaa dha. Taʼus hojiin isaa uumama addunyaatii jalqabee xumurameera.
english: For we who have believed do enter into that rest, even as he has said, “As I swore in my wrath, they will not enter into my rest;” although the works were finished from the foundation of the world.

kikuyu: Innis iddoo tokkotti waaʼee guyyaa torbaffaa; “Waaqni guyyaa torbaffaatti hojii isaa hundumaa irraa boqote” jedhee dubbate.
english: For he has said this somewhere about the seventh day, “God rested on the seventh day from all his works;”

kikuyu: Ammas inni iddoodhuma kanatti, “Isaan boqonnaa kootti hin galan” jedha.
english: and in this place again, “They will not enter into my rest.”

kikuyu: Amma iyyuu akka namoonni tokko tokko itti galaniif iddoon boqonnaa sun hambifameera; warri duraan wangeelli itti lallabame sun immoo sababii ajajamuu didaniif boqonnaa sanatti hin galle.
english: Seeing therefore it remains that some should enter into it, and they to whom the good news was preached before failed to enter in because of disobedience,

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqni deebisee guyyaa tokko “Harʼa” jedhee waamuudhaan murteesse. Innis akkuma kanaan dura dubbatame sana bara dheeraa booddee karaa Daawitiitiin, “Isin yoo harʼa sagalee isaa dhageessan, mataa hin jabaatinaa” jedha.
english: he again defines a certain day, “today”, saying through David so long a time afterward (just as has been said), “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts.”

kikuyu: Utuu Iyyaasuun boqonnaa sanatti isaan galchee jiraatee, silaa Waaqni ergasii waaʼee guyyaa biraa hin dubbatu tureetii.
english: For if Joshua had given them rest, he would not have spoken afterward of another day.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu boqonnaan Sanbataa saba Waaqaatiif kaaʼameera;
english: There remains therefore a Sabbath rest for the people of God.

kikuyu: namni boqonnaa Waaqaatti galu kam iyyuu akkuma Waaqni hojii isaa irraa boqote sana, innis hojii isaa irraa ni boqota.
english: For he who has entered into his rest has himself also rested from his works, as God did from his.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka namni tokko illee fakkeenya ajajamuu diduu jara sanaa duukaa buʼee boqonnaa sanatti galuu hin dhabneef kottaa boqonnaa sanatti galuuf ni tattaaffannaa.
english: Let’s therefore give diligence to enter into that rest, lest anyone fall after the same example of disobedience.

kikuyu: Dubbiin Waaqaa jiraataa fi kan hojjetuudhaatii. Goraadee qara lama qabu kam iyyuu caalaa qaramaa dha; hamma lubbuu fi hafuura, buusaa fi dhuka gargar baasutti waraanee seena; yaadaa fi fedhii garaa namaas ni qora.
english: For the word of God is living and active, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the dividing of soul and spirit, of both joints and marrow, and is able to discern the thoughts and intentions of the heart.

kikuyu: Uumama hunda keessaa wanti fuula Waaqaa duraa dhokatu tokko illee hin jiru. Wanti hundi ija isaa duratti qullaa fi saaqamaa dha; nus waaʼee mataa keenyaa deebii kennuufii qabna.
english: There is no creature that is hidden from his sight, but all things are naked and laid open before the eyes of him to whom we must give an account.

kikuyu: Egaa luba ol aanaa guddicha isa samiiwwan keessa darbe, Yesuus Ilma Waaqaa waan qabnuuf kottaa amantii keenya jabeessinee qabannaa.
english: Having then a great high priest who has passed through the heavens, Jesus, the Son of God, let’s hold tightly to our confession.

kikuyu: Nu luba ol aanaa dadhabbii keenya keessatti garaa nuu hin laafne hin qabnuutii; garuu kan waan hundaan akkuma keenya qorame qabna; taʼus inni cubbuu hin hojjenne.
english: For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all points tempted like we are, yet without sin.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka araara argannuu fi akka ayyaana yeroo nu barbaachisutti nu gargaaru argannuuf kottaa gara teessoo ayyaanaatti sodaa malee dhiʼaannaa.
english: Let’s therefore draw near with boldness to the throne of grace, that we may receive mercy and may find grace for help in time of need.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon luba ol aanaa namoota gidduudhaa filatamee waan Waaqa ilaallatu irratti namoota iddoo buʼee sababii cubbuutiif kennaa fi aarsaa dhiʼeessuuf muudama.
english: For every high priest, being taken from among men, is appointed for men in things pertaining to God, that he may offer both gifts and sacrifices for sins.

kikuyu: Inni mataan isaa iyyuu waan dadhabbii keessa jiruuf wallaaltotaa fi warra karaa irraa jallataniif garaa laafuu ni dandaʼa.
english: The high priest can deal gently with those who are ignorant and going astray, because he himself is also surrounded with weakness.

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf inni cubbuu ofii isaatiif, akkasumas cubbuu namootaatiif aarsaa dhiʼeessuu qaba.
english: Because of this, he must offer sacrifices for sins for the people, as well as for himself.

kikuyu: Nama akkuma Aroonitti Waaqaan waamame malee, namni kam iyyuu ulfina kana ofii isaatiif hin fudhatu.
english: Nobody takes this honor on himself, but he is called by God, just like Aaron was.

kikuyu: Kiristoosis akkasuma luba ol aanaa taʼuuf of hin ulfeessine. Waaqni garuu, “Ati Ilma koo ti; ani harʼa si dhalcheera” jedheen.
english: So also Christ didn’t glorify himself to be made a high priest, but it was he who said to him, “You are my Son. Today I have become your father.”

kikuyu: Iddoo biraattis, “Akkuma sirna Malkiiseedeqitti, ati luba bara baraa ti” jedha.
english: As he says also in another place, “You are a priest forever, after the order of Melchizedek.”

kikuyu: Yesuus yeroo lafa irra jiraachaa turetti iyya guddaa fi imimmaaniin isa duʼa isa oolchuu dandaʼu sanatti kadhannaa fi waammata dhiʼeeffate; sababii inni sodaa Waaqaa qabuufis kadhannaan isaa ni dhagaʼameef.
english: He, in the days of his flesh, having offered up prayers and petitions with strong crying and tears to him who was able to save him from death, and having been heard for his godly fear,

kikuyu: Inni Ilma taʼu iyyuu dhiphina isaa sana irraa ajajamuu barate;
english: though he was a Son, yet learned obedience by the things which he suffered.

kikuyu: erga kan mudaa hin qabne taasifamee immoo warra isaaf ajajaman hundaaf burqaa fayyina bara baraa taʼe.
english: Having been made perfect, he became to all of those who obey him the author of eternal salvation,

kikuyu: Akka sirna Malkiiseedeqittis luba ol aanaa jedhamee Waaqaan waamame.
english: named by God a high priest after the order of Melchizedek.

kikuyu: Nu waaʼee isaa waan jennu baayʼee qabna; isin garuu waan hubachuutti dadhaboo taataniif isinii ibsuun rakkisaa dha.
english: About him we have many words to say, and hard to interpret, seeing you have become dull of hearing.

kikuyu: Isin yeroo kanatti barsiistota taʼuu qabdu ture; isin immoo nama waaʼee dhugaa dubbii Waaqaa kan jalqabaa irra deebiʼee isin barsiisutu isin barbaachisa. Nyaata jabaataas utuu hin taʼin aannan isin barbaachisa.
english: For although by this time you should be teachers, you again need to have someone teach you the rudiments of the first principles of the revelations of God. You have come to need milk, and not solid food.

kikuyu: Namni aannaniin jiraatu kam iyyuu waan amma illee daaʼima taʼeef dubbii qajeelummaa hin beeku.
english: For everyone who lives on milk is not experienced in the word of righteousness, for he is a baby.

kikuyu: Nyaanni jabaataan garuu namoota bilchaatoo kanneen waan gaarii fi waan hamaa gargar baasanii beekuuf of leenjisaniif taʼa.
english: But solid food is for those who are full grown, who by reason of use have their senses exercised to discern good and evil.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu kottaa barsiisa waaʼee Kiristoos isa jalqabaa sana dhiifnee gara bilchinaatti dabarraa; waaʼee hojii gara duʼaatti nama geessuu irraa deebiʼuu fi waaʼee Waaqatti amanuu lammata hundee hin buufnu;
english: Therefore leaving the teaching of the first principles of Christ, let’s press on to perfection—not laying again a foundation of repentance from dead works, of faith toward God,

kikuyu: akkasumas barsiisa waaʼee cuuphaa, waaʼee harka nama irra kaaʼuu, waaʼee duʼaa kaʼuu warra duʼaniitii fi waaʼee murtii bara baraa ammas hundee hin buufnu.
english: of the teaching of baptisms, of laying on of hands, of resurrection of the dead, and of eternal judgment.

kikuyu: Nus yoo Waaqni jedhe waan kana ni goona.
english: This will we do, if God permits.

kikuyu: Warra yeroo tokko ifni ifeefii kennaa samii dhandhamatan, kanneen Hafuura Qulqulluu irraa qooddatan,
english: For concerning those who were once enlightened and tasted of the heavenly gift, and were made partakers of the Holy Spirit,

kikuyu: warra gaarummaa dubbii Waaqaatii fi humna bara dhufuuf jiru sanaa dhandhamatanii
english: and tasted the good word of God and the powers of the age to come,

kikuyu: ergasii garuu amantii irraa gara galan, gara qalbii jijjiirrannaatti isaan fiduun hin dandaʼamu; sababiin isaas isaan fedhuma isaaniitiin deebisanii Ilma Waaqaa ni fannisu; fuula namootaa durattis salphinatti isa saaxilu.
english: and then fell away, it is impossible to renew them again to repentance; seeing they crucify the Son of God for themselves again, and put him to open shame.

kikuyu: Lafti bokkaa yeroo baayʼee irratti roobu dhugdee warra ishee qotataniif midhaan fayyadu kennitu eebba Waaqaa argatti.
english: For the land which has drunk the rain that comes often on it and produces a crop suitable for them for whose sake it is also tilled, receives blessing from God;

kikuyu: Lafti qoraattii fi sokorruu biqilchitu garuu faayidaa hin qabdu; abaaramuus geesseerti. Dhumni ishees gubamuu dha.
english: but if it bears thorns and thistles, it is rejected and near being cursed, whose end is to be burned.

kikuyu: Yaa michoota jaallatamtoota, nu yoo akkana dubbanne illee waaʼee keessan waan wayyu, waan fayyina wajjin deemus akka qabdan mirkaneeffanneerra.
english: But, beloved, we are persuaded of better things for you, and things that accompany salvation, even though we speak like this.

kikuyu: Waaqni qulqulloota tajaajiluu keessanii fi ammas tajaajiluu keessaniin hojii isin hojjettanii fi jaalala maqaa isaatiif argisiiftan irraanfachuuf jalʼaa mitiitii.
english: For God is not unrighteous, so as to forget your work and the labor of love which you showed toward his name, in that you served the saints, and still do serve them.

kikuyu: Nus akka tokkoon tokkoon keessan abdii keessan mirkaneessitanii hamma dhumaatti tattaaffii akkanaa argisiiftan barbaanna.
english: We desire that each one of you may show the same diligence to the fullness of hope even to the end,

kikuyu: Nu akka isin fakkeenya warra amantii fi obsaan waan waadaa galame sana dhaalanii duukaa buutan barbaanna malee akka isin dhibaaʼoo taatan hin barbaannu.
english: that you won’t be sluggish, but imitators of those who through faith and perseverance inherited the promises.

kikuyu: Waaqni yeroo Abrahaamiif waadaa galetti kan isa caalu kan inni ittiin kakatu tokko iyyuu waan hin jirreef matuma ofiitiin kakate.
english: For when God made a promise to Abraham, since he could swear by no one greater, he swore by himself,

kikuyu: Innis, “Ani dhugumaan eebba, sin eebbisa; baayʼisuus si baayʼisa” jedha.
english: saying, “Surely blessing I will bless you, and multiplying I will multiply you.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Abrahaam obsaan eeggatee waan waadaa galame sana argate.
english: Thus, having patiently endured, he obtained the promise.

kikuyu: Namoonni kan isaan caaluun kakatu; kakuun sunis waan jedhame sana mirkaneessee akka falmiin hundumtuu fiixaan baʼu godha.
english: For men indeed swear by a greater one, and in every dispute of theirs the oath is final for confirmation.

kikuyu: Waaqni haala kaayyoo isaa kan hin geeddaramne sana caalaatti ibsee warra waadaa dhaalanitti argisiisuu waan barbaadeef waadaa sana kakuudhaan cimse.
english: In this way God, being determined to show more abundantly to the heirs of the promise the immutability of his counsel, interposed with an oath,

kikuyu: Egaa waan hin geeddaramne kan Waaqni waaʼee isaanii sobuu hin dandeenye lamatu jira; kanaafuu nu warri isatti baqanne abdii fuula keenya dura kaaʼame sana jabeessinee qabachuuf jajjabina guddaa qabna.
english: that by two immutable things, in which it is impossible for God to lie, we may have a strong encouragement, who have fled for refuge to take hold of the hope set before us.

kikuyu: Nus abdii kana akka hiituu dooniitti lubbuuf qabna. Abdiin kunis iddoo qulqulluu golgaa duuba jiru sana ol seena;
english: This hope we have as an anchor of the soul, a hope both sure and steadfast and entering into that which is within the veil,

kikuyu: iddoon kunis kan Yesuus iddoo keenya buʼee nu dursee itti ol seenee dha. Innis akka sirna Malkiiseedeqitti luba ol aanaa bara baraa taʼeera.
english: where as a forerunner Jesus entered for us, having become a high priest forever after the order of Melchizedek.

kikuyu: Malkiiseedeq mootii Saalemiitii fi luba Waaqa Waan Hundaa Olii ture. Innis utuu Abrahaam mootota moʼatee deebiʼuu itti dhufee isa eebbise;
english: For this Melchizedek, king of Salem, priest of God Most High, who met Abraham returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him,

kikuyu: Abrahaamis waan hundumaa kudhan keessaa tokko isaaf kenne. Jalqabatti maqaan isaa, “Mootii qajeelummaa” jechuu dha; ergasii immoo, “Mootii Saalem” jechuunis, “Mootii nagaa” jechuu dha.
english: to whom also Abraham divided a tenth part of all (being first, by interpretation, “king of righteousness”, and then also “king of Salem”, which means “king of peace”,

kikuyu: Inni abbaa yookaan haadha hin qabu; hidda dhalootaas hin qabu; jalqaba guyyootaa yookaan dhuma jireenyaas hin qabu; inni akkuma Ilma Waaqaatti luba bara baraa taʼee jiraata.
english: without father, without mother, without genealogy, having neither beginning of days nor end of life, but made like the Son of God), remains a priest continually.

kikuyu: Egaa Abrahaam hangafni abbootii iyyuu erga waan boojiʼe irraa kudhan keessaa tokko isaaf kennee, Malkiiseedeq hammam guddaa akka taʼe mee ilaalaa!
english: Now consider how great this man was, to whom even Abraham the patriarch gave a tenth out of the best plunder.

kikuyu: Ilmaan Lewwii warri luboota taʼan yoo obboloonni isaanii sanyii Abrahaam taʼan iyyuu namoota irraa jechuunis obbolootuma isaanii irraa kudhan keessaa tokko akka fudhatan seerri ni ajaja.
english: They indeed of the sons of Levi who receive the priest’s office have a commandment to take tithes from the people according to the law, that is, of their brothers, though these have come out of the body of Abraham,

kikuyu: Namichi sanyii isaanii irraa hin taʼin kun garuu Abrahaam isa waadaan galameef sana irraa kudhan keessaa tokko fudhatee isa eebbise.
english: but he whose genealogy is not counted from them has accepted tithes from Abraham, and has blessed him who has the promises.

kikuyu: Inni xinnaan akka isa guddaadhaan eebbifamu shakkii hin qabu.
english: But without any dispute the lesser is blessed by the greater.

kikuyu: Karaa tokkoon kudhan keessaa tokko namoota duʼa hin oolleen walitti qabama; karaa kaaniin immoo isa jiraataa taʼuun isaa dhugaa baʼameef sanaan walitti qabama.
english: Here people who die receive tithes, but there one receives tithes of whom it is testified that he lives.

kikuyu: Lewwiin inni kudhan keessaa tokko walitti qabu mataan isaa iyyuu kudhan keessaa harka tokko karaa Abrahaamiitiin baaseera jechuun ni dandaʼama;
english: We can say that through Abraham even Levi, who receives tithes, has paid tithes,

kikuyu: Malkiiseedeq yommuu Abrahaamin simatetti Lewwiin mudhii abbaa ofii isaa keessa tureetii.
english: for he was yet in the body of his father when Melchizedek met him.

kikuyu: Utuu sirni lubummaa Lewwii kan hirʼina hin qabne taʼee, silaa lubni biraa kan akka sirna lubummaa Aroonitti utuu hin taʼin lubni akka sirna lubummaa Malkiiseedeqitti filatame dhufuun isaa maaliif barbaachise ree? Seerri sirna lubummaa Lewwii kana irratti hundeeffamee sabaaf kennameetii.
english: Now if perfection was through the Levitical priesthood (for under it the people have received the law), what further need was there for another priest to arise after the order of Melchizedek, and not be called after the order of Aaron?

kikuyu: Yommuu lubummaan geeddaramu seerichis akkasuma geeddaramaatii.
english: For the priesthood being changed, there is of necessity a change made also in the law.

kikuyu: Inni wanni kun waaʼee isaa dubbatame sun gosti isaa kan biraa ti; gosa kana keessaas namni tokko iyyuu takkumaa iddoo aarsaa hin tajaajille.
english: For he of whom these things are said belongs to another tribe, from which no one has officiated at the altar.

kikuyu: Gooftaan keenya akka sanyii Yihuudaa irraa dhalate beekamaadhaatii; Museenis gosa sana ilaalchisee waaʼee lubummaa homaa hin dubbanne.
english: For it is evident that our Lord has sprung out of Judah, about which tribe Moses spoke nothing concerning priesthood.

kikuyu: Yommuu lubni akka Malkiiseedeqi kan biraa kaʼutti, wanni nu dubbanne sun ittuma caalee ifa taʼa;
english: This is yet more abundantly evident, if after the likeness of Melchizedek there arises another priest,

kikuyu: innis utuu ajaja fooniitiin hin taʼin humna jireenya hin badneetiin luba taʼe.
english: who has been made, not after the law of a fleshly commandment, but after the power of an endless life;

kikuyu: Waaʼee isaas, “Akkuma sirna Malkiiseedeqitti, ati luba bara baraa ti” jedhamee dhugaa baʼameeraafiitii.
english: for it is testified, “You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.”

kikuyu: Ajajni duraa sun waan dadhabaa fi kan hin fayyadne tureef diigameera.
english: For there is an annulling of a foregoing commandment because of its weakness and uselessness

kikuyu: Sababii seerri waanuma tokko illee kan mudaa hin qabne hin godhiniif abdiin caalu kan nu ittiin gara Waaqaatti dhiʼaannu tokko dhufeera.
english: (for the law made nothing perfect), and a bringing in of a better hope, through which we draw near to God.

kikuyu: Kunis kakaa malee hin taane! Warri kaan immoo kakaa tokko malee luboota taʼan;
english: Inasmuch as he was not made priest without the taking of an oath

kikuyu: inni garuu yeroo Waaqni, “Gooftaan, ‘Ati luba bara baraa ti’ jedhee kakateera; inni yaada isaa hin geeddaru” isaan jedhetti kakaadhaan luba taʼe.
