english: (for they indeed have been made priests without an oath), but he with an oath by him that says of him, “The Lord swore and will not change his mind, ‘You are a priest forever, according to the order of Melchizedek.’”

kikuyu: Yesuus sababii kakaa kanaatiif kakuu caaluuf wabii taʼeera.
english: By so much, Jesus has become the guarantee of a better covenant.

kikuyu: Luboonni durii sababii duuti akka isaan tajaajila itti hin fufneef isaan dhowweef baayʼee turan;
english: Many, indeed, have been made priests, because they are hindered from continuing by death.

kikuyu: Yesuus garuu waan bara baraan jiraatuuf lubummaa hin geeddaramne qaba.
english: But he, because he lives forever, has his priesthood unchangeable.

kikuyu: Kanaaf inni yeroo hundumaa waan isaaniif kadhachuuf jiraatuuf warra karaa isaatiin gara Waaqaa dhufan guutumaan guutuutti fayyisuu ni dandaʼa.
english: Therefore he is also able to save to the uttermost those who draw near to God through him, seeing that he lives forever to make intercession for them.

kikuyu: Egaa luba ol aanaa qulqulluu, kan mudaa hin qabne, kan xurii hin qabne, kan cubbamoota irraa adda taʼe, samii olittis kan kabajame akkasii qabaachuun nu barbaachisa.
english: For such a high priest was fitting for us: holy, guiltless, undefiled, separated from sinners, and made higher than the heavens;

kikuyu: Inni akka luboota ol aantota kaaniitti guyyuma guyyaan duraan dursee cubbuu ofii isaatiif, ergasii immoo cubbuu namootaatiif aarsaa dhiʼeessuun isa hin barbaachisu. Inni yommuu of kenne sanatti al tokko yeroo hundaaf cubbuu namootaatiif aarsaa dhiʼeesseeraatii.
english: who doesn’t need, like those high priests, to offer up sacrifices daily, first for his own sins, and then for the sins of the people. For he did this once for all, when he offered up himself.

kikuyu: Seerichi namoota dadhaboo, luboota ol aantota godhee muudaatii; dubbiin kakaa kan seera booddee dhufe garuu, Ilma Waaqaa isa bara baraan mudaa hin qabne sana muuda.
english: For the law appoints men as high priests who have weakness, but the word of the oath, which came after the law, appoints a Son forever who has been perfected.

kikuyu: Waan nu dubbannu keessaa ijoon kana: Nu luba ol aanaa samii irra karaa mirga teessoo Isa Ulfina Qabeessa Samii keessaa sanaa taaʼe akkasii qabna.
english: Now in the things which we are saying, the main point is this: we have such a high priest, who sat down on the right hand of the throne of the Majesty in the heavens,

kikuyu: Innis iddoo qulqullummaa fi dunkaana isa dhugaa kan utuu namaan hin taʼin Gooftaadhaan dhaabame keessa tajaajila.
english: a servant of the sanctuary and of the true tabernacle which the Lord pitched, not man.

kikuyu: Lubni ol aanaan kam iyyuu kennaa fi aarsaa dhiʼeessuuf muudama; kanaafuu lubni kun waan dhiʼeessu tokko qabaachuu qaba.
english: For every high priest is appointed to offer both gifts and sacrifices. Therefore it is necessary that this high priest also have something to offer.

kikuyu: Waan luboonni akka seeraatti kennaa dhiʼeessan duraanuu jiraniif, inni utuu lafa irra jiraatee silaa luba hin taʼu ture.
english: For if he were on earth, he would not be a priest at all, seeing there are priests who offer the gifts according to the law,

kikuyu: Isaanis iddoo qulqullummaa kan fakkeenyaa fi gaaddidduu wantoota samii tajaajilu. Waaqnis yommuu Museen dunkaana qulqulluu dhaabuuf kaʼetti, “Waan hunda akkuma fakkeenya tulluu irratti sitti argisiifame sanaatti hojjechuu kee mirkaneeffadhu!” jedhee isa akeekkachiisuun isaa kanumaaf.
english: who serve a copy and shadow of the heavenly things, even as Moses was warned by God when he was about to make the tabernacle, for he said, “See, you shall make everything according to the pattern that was shown to you on the mountain.”

kikuyu: Garuu akkuma kakuun inni Yesuus gidduu galeessa taʼeef sun kakuu moofaa akka malee caalu sana tajaajilli inni fudhates tajaajila isaanii irra guddaa dha; kakuun haaraan waadaa caalu irratti hundeeffameetii.
english: But now he has obtained a more excellent ministry, by as much as he is also the mediator of a better covenant, which on better promises has been given as law.

kikuyu: Utuu kakuun jalqabaa sun mudaa qabaachuu baatee silaa kakuun lammaffaan hin barbaachisu ture.
english: For if that first covenant had been faultless, then no place would have been sought for a second.

kikuyu: Waaqni garuu saba sana irratti balleessaa argee akkana jedha; “Yeroon ani itti mana Israaʼel wajjin, mana Yihuudaa wajjinis, kakuu haaraa galu ni dhufa jedha Gooftaan.
english: For finding fault with them, he said, “Behold, the days are coming”, says the Lord, “that I will make a new covenant with the house of Israel and with the house of Judah;

kikuyu: Kakuun kunis kakuu ani, yeroo biyya Gibxiitii isaan baasuuf jedhee harka isaanii qabe sana abbootii isaanii wajjin gale sanaan tokko miti; isaan kakuu kootti jabaatanii waan hin dhaabatiniif, ani isaan irraa gara galeera, jedha Gooftaan.
english: not according to the covenant that I made with their fathers in the day that I took them by the hand to lead them out of the land of Egypt; for they didn’t continue in my covenant, and I disregarded them,” says the Lord.

kikuyu: Kakuun ani yeroo sana booddee mana Israaʼel wajjin galu kanaa dha, jedha Gooftaan. Ani seera koo qalbii isaanii keessa nan kaaʼa; garaa isaanii keessattis nan barreessa. Ani Waaqa isaanii nan taʼa; isaanis saba koo ni taʼu.
english: “For this is the covenant that I will make with the house of Israel after those days,” says the Lord: “I will put my laws into their mind; I will also write them on their heart. I will be their God, and they will be my people.

kikuyu: Sababii hundi isaanii, xinnaa hamma guddaatti na beekaniif, siʼachi namni kam iyyuu, ‘Gooftaa beeki’ jedhee, ollaa isaa yookaan obboleessa isaa hin barsiisu.
english: They will not teach every man his fellow citizen and every man his brother, saying, ‘Know the Lord,’ for all will know me, from their least to their greatest.

kikuyu: Ani daba isaanii nan dhiisaaf; cubbuu isaaniis siʼachi hin yaadadhu.”
english: For I will be merciful to their unrighteousness. I will remember their sins and lawless deeds no more.”

kikuyu: Innis kakuu kanaan “haaraa” jedhee kakuu jalqabaa sana moofesseera; wanni moofaʼee fi wanni dulloome dafee bada.
english: In that he says, “A new covenant”, he has made the first obsolete. But that which is becoming obsolete and grows aged is near to vanishing away.

kikuyu: Kakuun jalqabaa sun iyyuu sirna waaqeffannaatii fi iddoo qulqulluu isa lafa irraa qaba ture.
english: Now indeed even the first covenant had ordinances of divine service and an earthly sanctuary.

kikuyu: Dunkaanni qulqulluun dhaabamee ture. Kutaan dunkaana sanaa kan jalqabaa, “Iddoo Qulqulluu” jedhama ture; kutaa kana keessas baattuu ibsaatii fi minjaala akkasumas buddeena qulqulleeffametu ture.
english: For a tabernacle was prepared. In the first part were the lamp stand, the table, and the show bread, which is called the Holy Place.

kikuyu: Golgaa lammaffaa duubaan immoo kutaa, “Iddoo Hundumaa Caalaa Qulqulluu” jedhamu tokkotu ture.
english: After the second veil was the tabernacle which is called the Holy of Holies,

kikuyu: Achis iddoo aarsaa ixaanaa kan warqee irraa hojjetamee fi taabota kakuu kan karaa hundaan warqee dibametu ture. Taabota sana keessas okkotee warqee kan mannaa baatu, ulee Aroon inni latee fi gabatee dhagaa kan kakuun sun irratti barreeffametu kaaʼame.
english: having a golden altar of incense and the ark of the covenant overlaid on all sides with gold, in which was a golden pot holding the manna, Aaron’s rod that budded, and the tablets of the covenant;

kikuyu: Taaboticha gubbaadhaanis kiirubeeliin Ulfinaa teessoo araaraa irra golboobanii turan. Amma garuu waaʼee kanaa gad fageenyaan dubbachuu hin dandeenyu.
english: and above it cherubim of glory overshadowing the mercy seat, of which things we can’t speak now in detail.

kikuyu: Luboonni yommuu wanni hundinuu haala kanaan qopheeffametti tajaajila kennuuf jedhanii yeroo hunda dunkaana qulqulluu isa jalqabaa seenu turan.
english: Now these things having been thus prepared, the priests go in continually into the first tabernacle, accomplishing the services,

kikuyu: Dunkaana isa lammaffaa garuu luba ol aanaa qofatu waggaatti yeroo tokko qofa seena; innis dhiiga cubbuu ofii isaatiif dhiʼeessuu fi dhiiga cubbuu namoonni utuu hin beekin hojjetaniif dhiʼeessu qabatu malee hin seenu ture.
english: but into the second the high priest alone, once in the year, not without blood, which he offers for himself and for the errors of the people.

kikuyu: Hafuurri Qulqulluunis hamma dunkaanni jalqabaa sun dhaabatee jirutti akka karaan gara Iddoo Iddoo Hunda Caalaa Qulqulluu taʼeetti geessu sun amma illee hin mulʼifamin haala kanaan argisiisaa ture.
english: The Holy Spirit is indicating this, that the way into the Holy Place wasn’t yet revealed while the first tabernacle was still standing.

kikuyu: Kunis fakkeenya bara ammaa ti; innis akka kennaa fi aarsaan dhiʼeeffamu sun qalbii waaqeffataa tokkoo qulqulleessuu hin dandeenye mulʼisa.
english: This is a symbol of the present age, where gifts and sacrifices are offered that are incapable, concerning the conscience, of making the worshiper perfect,

kikuyu: Innis waaʼee nyaataatii fi dhugaatii, waaʼee sirna dhiqannaa garaa garaa jechuunis sirna foonii isa hamma seerichi haaromfamutti faayidaa kennaa ture qofa.
english: being only (with foods and drinks and various washings) fleshly ordinances, imposed until a time of reformation.

kikuyu: Kiristoos garuu yommuu waan gaarii dhufuuf jiruuf luba ol aanaa taʼee dhufetti, dunkaanicha guddaa mudaa hin qabne, kan harka namaatiin hin hojjetamin jechuunis kan uumama kana irraa hin dhufin sana keessa darbe.
english: But Christ having come as a high priest of the coming good things, through the greater and more perfect tabernacle, not made with hands, that is to say, not of this creation,

kikuyu: Dhiiga reʼootaatii fi dhiiga jabbootaatiin hin seenne; garuu furii bara baraa nuu fiduudhaan dhiiguma ofiitiin yeroo tokko bara baraan gara Iddoo Iddoo Hunda Caalaa Qulqulluu taʼe sanaatti seene.
english: nor yet through the blood of goats and calves, but through his own blood, entered in once for all into the Holy Place, having obtained eternal redemption.

kikuyu: Erga dhiigni reʼootaa, dhiigni korommiitii fi daaraan goromsaa kan warra xuraaʼanitti facaafamu akka isaan fooniin qulqullaaʼan godhee,
english: For if the blood of goats and bulls, and the ashes of a heifer sprinkling those who have been defiled, sanctify to the cleanness of the flesh,

kikuyu: yoos dhiigni Kiristoos isa karaa Hafuura bara baraatiin aarsaa hirʼina hin qabne taʼee Waaqaaf of dhiʼeesse sanaa akka nu Waaqa jiraataa tajaajilluuf hammam caalaa hojii gara duʼaatti nama geessu irraa qalbii keenya haa qulqulleessuu ree!
english: how much more will the blood of Christ, who through the eternal Spirit offered himself without defect to God, cleanse your conscience from dead works to serve the living God?

kikuyu: Sababii kanaaf akka warri waamaman dhaala bara baraa isa abdii kenname sana argataniif Kiristoos araarsaa gidduu galeessa kakuu haaraa ti; inni cubbuu isaan yeroo kakuu jalqabaa jala turanitti hojjetan irraa isaan bilisoomsuuf jedhee furii taʼee duʼeeraatii.
english: For this reason he is the mediator of a new covenant, since a death has occurred for the redemption of the transgressions that were under the first covenant, that those who have been called may receive the promise of the eternal inheritance.

kikuyu: Iddoo dhaamsi dhaalaa jirutti duʼa namicha dhaamate sanaa mirkaneessuun barbaachisaa dha;
english: For where a last will and testament is, there must of necessity be the death of him who made it.

kikuyu: dhaamsi dhaalaa yommuu namni dhaamate sun duʼu qofa hojii irra oola malee utuu inni lubbuun jiruu hin hojjetuutii.
english: For a will is in force where there has been death, for it is never in force while he who made it lives.

kikuyu: Sababiin kakuun jalqabaa iyyuu dhiiga malee hojii irra hin ooliniifis kanuma.
english: Therefore even the first covenant has not been dedicated without blood.

kikuyu: Museen erga ajaja seera sanaa tokko tokkoon saba sana hundatti himee booddeetti, dhiiga jabbootaatii fi dhiiga reʼootaa bishaan wajjin, rifeensa hoolaa bildiimaa fi hiisophii fuudhee kitaaba maramaa fi saba hundatti facaase.
english: For when every commandment had been spoken by Moses to all the people according to the law, he took the blood of the calves and the goats, with water and scarlet wool and hyssop, and sprinkled both the book itself and all the people,

kikuyu: Innis, “Kun dhiiga kakuu kan Waaqni isiniif ajajee dha” jedhe.
english: saying, “This is the blood of the covenant which God has commanded you.”

kikuyu: Haaluma wal fakkaatuunis dunkaanichattii fi miʼa dunkaanicha keessatti sirna waaqeffannaatiif itti fayyadaman hundumatti dhiiga sana facaase.
english: He sprinkled the tabernacle and all the vessels of the ministry in the same way with the blood.

kikuyu: Dhugumaan akka seeraatti wantoota muraasa malee wanni hundinuu dhiigaan qulqulleeffama; dhiigni dhangalaafamu malees dhiifamni cubbuu hin jiru.
english: According to the law, nearly everything is cleansed with blood, and apart from shedding of blood there is no remission.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu fakkeenyawwan waan samii irraa aarsaawwan kanneeniin qulqulleeffamuun barbaachisaa ture; wanni samii irraa mataan isaa garuu aarsaawwan waan kanneen caalaniin qulqulleeffamuu isaan barbaachisa.
english: It was necessary therefore that the copies of the things in the heavens should be cleansed with these, but the heavenly things themselves with better sacrifices than these.

kikuyu: Kiristoos amma iddoo keenya buʼee fuula Waaqaa duratti argamuuf samii seene malee iddoo qulqulluu kan harka namaatiin ijaarame isa fakkeenya iddoo qulqulluu kan dhugaa taʼe hin seenne.
english: For Christ hasn’t entered into holy places made with hands, which are representations of the true, but into heaven itself, now to appear in the presence of God for us;

kikuyu: Yookaan inni akkuma luba ol aanaa wagguma waggaan dhiiga kan isaa hin taʼin qabatee Iddoo Iddoo Hunda Caalaa Qulqulluu taʼe seenu sanaatti yeroo baayʼee of dhiʼeessuuf samii hin seenne.
english: nor yet that he should offer himself often, as the high priest enters into the holy place year by year with blood not his own,

kikuyu: Utuu akkas taʼee silaa Kiristoos uumama addunyaatii jalqabee yeroo baayʼee dhiphachuu qaba ture. Amma garuu inni ofii isaa aarsaa godhee cubbuu balleessuuf dhuma baraatti yeroo tokko bara baraan mulʼateera.
english: or else he must have suffered often since the foundation of the world. But now once at the end of the ages, he has been revealed to put away sin by the sacrifice of himself.

kikuyu: Akkuma yeroo tokko duʼuun ergasii immoo murtiitti dhiʼaachuun namatti murteeffame sana
english: Inasmuch as it is appointed for men to die once, and after this, judgment,

kikuyu: akkasuma immoo Kiristoos cubbuu namoota baayʼee baachuuf jedhee yeroo tokko aarsaa taʼeera; yeroo lammaffaa immoo cubbuu baachuuf utuu hin taʼin warra isa eeggachaa jiraniif fayyina fiduuf ni mulʼata.
english: so Christ also, having been offered once to bear the sins of many, will appear a second time, not to deal with sin, but to save those who are eagerly waiting for him.

kikuyu: Seerri gaaddidduu waan gaarii dhufuuf jiruu qofa malee bifa dhugaa miti. Kanaafuu seerichi aarsaa utuu wal irraa hin citin wagguma waggaan dhiʼeeffamu sanaan gonkumaa namoota waaqeffachuuf dhiʼaatan sana warra mudaa hin qabne gochuu hin dandaʼu.
english: For the law, having a shadow of the good to come, not the very image of the things, can never with the same sacrifices year by year, which they offer continually, make perfect those who draw near.

kikuyu: Utuu isaan waan kana gochuu dandaʼanii silaa aarsaan dhiʼeeffamuun isaa ni hafa ture mitii? Waaqeffattoonnis siʼa tokko yeroo hundaaf ni qulqulleeffamu turaniitii; ergasii sababii cubbuu isaaniitiif yakki isaanitti hin dhagaʼamu ture.
english: Or else wouldn’t they have ceased to be offered, because the worshipers, having been once cleansed, would have had no more consciousness of sins?

kikuyu: Aarsaawwan kunneen garuu wagguma waggaan cubbuu nama yaadachiisu.
english: But in those sacrifices there is a yearly reminder of sins.

kikuyu: Sababiin isaas dhiigni korommiitii fi dhiigni reʼootaa gonkumaa cubbuu dhabamsiisuu hin dandaʼuutii.
english: For it is impossible that the blood of bulls and goats should take away sins.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Kiristoos yommuu gara addunyaa dhufetti akkana jedhe: “Ati aarsaa fi kennaa hin feene; garuu dhagna naa qopheessite;
english: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.

kikuyu: ati aarsaa gubamuu fi kennaa sababii cubbuutiif dhiʼeeffamutti hin gammanne.
english: You had no pleasure in whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin.

kikuyu: Yeroo sana ani, ‘Ani kunoo ti; waaʼeen koo kitaaba maramaa keessatti barreeffameera; yaa Waaqa ko, ani fedhii kee raawwachuuf dhufeera’ nan jedhe.”
english: Then I said, ‘Behold, I have come (in the scroll of the book it is written of me) to do your will, O God.’”

kikuyu: Isaan akka seeraatti dhiʼeeffaman iyyuu inni jalqabatti, “Ati qalmawwanii fi aarsaawwan, aarsaawwan gubamanii fi aarsaawwan cubbuuf dhiʼeeffaman hin feene yookaan itti hin gammanne” jedhe.
english: Previously saying, “Sacrifices and offerings and whole burnt offerings and sacrifices for sin you didn’t desire, neither had pleasure in them” (those which are offered according to the law),

kikuyu: Ergasiis inni, “Ani kunoo fedhii kee raawwachuuf dhufeera” jedhe. Innis isa lammaffaa dhaabuuf jedhee isa jalqabaa dhabamsiise.
english: then he has said, “Behold, I have come to do your will.” He takes away the first, that he may establish the second,

kikuyu: Fedhii sanaanis nu aarsaa dhagna Yesuus Kiristoos isa siʼa tokko yeroo hundaaf dhiʼeeffameen qulqulleeffamneerra.
english: by which will we have been sanctified through the offering of the body of Jesus Christ once for all.

kikuyu: Lubni hundinuu guyyuma guyyaan dhaabatee tajaajila isaa raawwata; aarsaa gonkumaa cubbuu dhabamsiisuu hin dandeenye sanas yeroo hunda dhiʼeessa.
english: Every priest indeed stands day by day serving and offering often the same sacrifices, which can never take away sins,

kikuyu: Lubni kun garuu erga aarsaa tokkicha bara baraan cubbuudhaaf dhiʼeessee booddee gara mirga Waaqaa taaʼe.
english: but he, when he had offered one sacrifice for sins forever, sat down on the right hand of God,

kikuyu: Yeroo sanaa jalqabees hamma diinonni isaa ejjeta miilla isaa taasifamanitti ni eeggata;
english: from that time waiting until his enemies are made the footstool of his feet.

kikuyu: inni aarsaa tokkicha sanaan warra qulqulleeffamuutti jiran kanneen bara baraan mudaa hin qabne godheeraatii.
english: For by one offering he has perfected forever those who are being sanctified.

kikuyu: Hafuurri Qulqulluunis waaʼee kanaa dhugaa nuu baʼa. Innis jalqabatti akkana jedha:
english: The Holy Spirit also testifies to us, for after saying,

kikuyu: “Kakuun ani yeroo sana booddee isaan wajjin galu kanaa dha, jedha Gooftaan. Ani seera koo qalbii isaanii keessa nan kaaʼa; garaa isaanii keessattis nan barreessa.”
english: “This is the covenant that I will make with them after those days,” says the Lord, “I will put my laws on their heart, I will also write them on their mind;” then he says,

kikuyu: Ammas, “Ani cubbuu fi yakka isaanii siʼachi hin yaadadhu” jedha.
english: “I will remember their sins and their iniquities no more.”

kikuyu: Iddoo isaan kunneen itti dhiifama argatanitti siʼachi sababii cubbuutiif aarsaa dhiʼeessuu hin barbaachisu.
english: Now where remission of these is, there is no more offering for sin.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa obboloota, nu dhiiga Yesuusiin gara Iddoo Iddoo Hunda Caalaa Qulqulluu taʼeetti galuuf ija jabina waan qabnuuf
english: Having therefore, brothers, boldness to enter into the holy place by the blood of Jesus,

kikuyu: karaa haaraa fi jiraataa golgaa keessaan jechuunis karaa foon isaatiin nuu baname sanaan
english: by the way which he dedicated for us, a new and living way, through the veil, that is to say, his flesh,

kikuyu: waan luba guddaa mana Waaqaa irratti qabnuuf,
english: and having a great priest over God’s house,

kikuyu: kottaa akka qalbiin keenya yaada yakka qabaachuu irraa qulqulleeffamuuf garaa keenyatti nuu facaafamee, dhagna keenyas bishaan qulqulluun dhiqannee garaa qulqulluu amantii mirkanaaʼaa guutuu qabuun Waaqatti dhiʼaannaa.
english: let’s draw near with a true heart in fullness of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience and having our body washed with pure water,

kikuyu: Inni waadaa gale sun waan amanamaa taʼeef kottaa nu utuu hin raafamin abdii dhugaa baanu sana jabeessinee qabannaa.
english: let’s hold fast the confession of our hope without wavering; for he who promised is faithful.

kikuyu: Kottaa jaalalaa fi hojii gaariif wal kakaasuuf itti yaadnaa.
english: Let’s consider how to provoke one another to love and good works,

kikuyu: Akka namoonni tokko tokko walitti qabamuu dhiisan sana kottaa nu walitti qabamuu hin dhiifnuu; qooda kanaa akka guyyaan sun dhiʼaate waan argitaniif ittuma caalchifnee wal haa jajjabeessinu.
english: not forsaking our own assembling together, as the custom of some is, but exhorting one another, and so much the more as you see the Day approaching.

kikuyu: Nu erga beekumsa dhugaa argannee booddee yoo beekaa ittuma fufnee cubbuu hojjenne, siʼachi aarsaan cubbuuf dhiʼeeffamu hin jiraatu;
english: For if we sin willfully after we have received the knowledge of the truth, there remains no more a sacrifice for sins,

kikuyu: garuu murtii fi ibidda hamaa diinota Waaqaa barbadeessu sodaan eeggachuu qofatu jiraata.
english: but a certain fearful expectation of judgment, and a fierceness of fire which will devour the adversaries.

kikuyu: Namni seera Musee tuffate kam iyyuu dhuga baatota lamaan yookaan sadiin gara laafina malee ajjeefama.
english: A man who disregards Moses’ law dies without compassion on the word of two or three witnesses.

kikuyu: Nama Ilma Waaqaa irra ejjete, nama dhiiga kakuu kan ittiin qulqulleeffame sana akka waan qulqulluu hin taʼiniitti hedee fi nama Hafuura ayyaanaa arrabse tokko adabbii hammam caalaa guddaatu isaaf mala seetu?
english: How much worse punishment do you think he will be judged worthy of who has trodden under foot the Son of God, and has counted the blood of the covenant with which he was sanctified an unholy thing, and has insulted the Spirit of grace?

kikuyu: Nu isa, “Haaloo baasuun kan koo ti; ani gatii nan deebisa” jedhe sana beeknaatii; akkasumas, “Gooftaan saba isaatti ni mura” jedhe.
english: For we know him who said, “Vengeance belongs to me. I will repay,” says the Lord. Again, “The Lord will judge his people.”

kikuyu: Harka Waaqa jiraataatti kufuun sodaachisaa dha.
english: It is a fearful thing to fall into the hands of the living God.

kikuyu: Bara duraa yeroo erga ifni isinii ifee booddee walʼaansoo dhiphinaa guddaa obsitanii keessa dhaabattan sana yaadadhaa.
english: But remember the former days, in which, after you were enlightened, you endured a great struggle with sufferings:

kikuyu: Isin yeroo tokko tokko fuula namootaa duratti arrabsoo fi ariʼatamaaf saaxilamtanii turtan; yeroo kaan immoo namoota rakkinni akkasii irra gaʼe wajjin hirmaachaa turtan.
english: partly, being exposed to both reproaches and oppressions, and partly, becoming partakers with those who were treated so.

kikuyu: Isin mataan keessan akka qabeenya wayyu kan hin dabarre qabdan waan beektaniif warra hidhaman wajjin dhiphattaniirtu; yommuu qabeenyi keessan saamamus gammachuudhaan fudhattaniirtu.
english: For you both had compassion on me in my chains and joyfully accepted the plundering of your possessions, knowing that you have for yourselves a better possession and an enduring one in the heavens.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ija jabina keessan isa gatii guddaa qabu sana hin gatinaa.
english: Therefore don’t throw away your boldness, which has a great reward.

kikuyu: Yommuu fedhii Waaqaa raawwattanittis akka waan inni waadaa gale sana argattaniif obsuu isin barbaachisaatii.
english: For you need endurance so that, having done the will of God, you may receive the promise.

kikuyu: “Yeroo xinnoo keessatti, inni dhufuuf jiru ni dhufa; hin turus.”
english: “In a very little while, he who comes will come and will not wait.

kikuyu: Akkasumas, “Qajeelaan koo garuu amantiidhaan jiraata. Kan duubatti harkifatu immoo ani itti hin gammadu.”
english: But the righteous one will live by faith. If he shrinks back, my soul has no pleasure in him.”

kikuyu: Nu garuu warra amananii lubbuu ofii oolfatan malee warra gara badiisaatti harkifatan miti.
english: But we are not of those who shrink back to destruction, but of those who have faith to the saving of the soul.

kikuyu: Amantiin waan abdannu tokko dhugumaan ni taʼa jennee fudhachuu dha; waan ijaan hin argine tokko immoo qabatamaadha jennee heduu dha.
english: Now faith is assurance of things hoped for, proof of things not seen.

kikuyu: Jaarsoliifis kanaan dhugaa baʼameetii.
english: For by this, the elders obtained approval.

kikuyu: Addunyaawwan akka ajaja Waaqaatiin uumaman, wanni mulʼatus akka waan mulʼatu irraa hin hojjetamin nu amantiidhaan hubanna.
english: By faith we understand that the universe has been framed by the word of God, so that what is seen has not been made out of things which are visible.

kikuyu: Abeel amantiidhaan aarsaa isa Qaayin dhiʼeesse caalu Waaqaaf dhiʼeesse. Inni yommuu Waaqni waaʼee kennaa isaa dhugaa baʼameefitti nama qajeelaa taʼuun isaa amantiidhaan dhugaa baʼameef. Abeel duʼu iyyuu hamma ammaatti amantiidhaan dubbachaa jira.
english: By faith Abel offered to God a more excellent sacrifice than Cain, through which he had testimony given to him that he was righteous, God testifying with respect to his gifts; and through it he, being dead, still speaks.

kikuyu: Henook akka duʼa hin argineef amantiidhaan fudhatame; waan Waaqni isa fudhateef inni hin argamne. Inni utuu hin fudhatamin dura akka nama Waaqa gammachiiseetti dhugaa baʼameefii tureetii.
english: By faith Enoch was taken away, so that he wouldn’t see death, and he was not found, because God translated him. For he has had testimony given to him that before his translation he had been well pleasing to God.

kikuyu: Amantiidhaan malee Waaqa gammachiisuun hin dandaʼamu; sababiin isaas namni gara isaa dhufu kam iyyuu akka inni jiruu fi akka inni warra isa barbaadaniif gatii kennu amanuu qaba.
english: Without faith it is impossible to be well pleasing to him, for he who comes to God must believe that he exists, and that he is a rewarder of those who seek him.

kikuyu: Nohi waaʼee waan amma illee ijaan hin argaminii Waaqni isa akeekkachiifnaan sodaatee warra mana isaa jiraatan oolfachuuf jedhee amantiin doonii tolche. Amantii isaatiinis addunyaatti mure; dhaaltu qajeelummaa amantiin argamuus taʼe.
english: By faith Noah, being warned about things not yet seen, moved with godly fear, prepared a ship for the saving of his house, through which he condemned the world and became heir of the righteousness which is according to faith.

kikuyu: Abrahaam gara iddoo dhaaluuf jiruu akka dhaqu yommuu waamametti, amantiidhaan ajajame; eessa akka dhaqu iyyuu utuu hin beekin kaʼee deeme.
english: By faith Abraham, when he was called, obeyed to go out to the place which he was to receive for an inheritance. He went out, not knowing where he went.

kikuyu: Innis akka keessummaa biyya ormaa jiruutti biyya isaaf waadaa galame sana keessa amantiidhaan qubate; akkuma warra isa wajjin waadaadhuma sana dhaalan, akkuma Yisihaaqii fi Yaaqoob dunkaana keessa jiraate.
english: By faith he lived as an alien in the land of promise, as in a land not his own, dwelling in tents with Isaac and Jacob, the heirs with him of the same promise.

kikuyu: Inni magaalaa hundee qabdu kan Waaqni ijaaree fi tolche eeggachaa tureetii.
english: For he was looking for the city which has foundations, whose builder and maker is God.

kikuyu: Saaraan yoo umurii daʼumsaa dabartee, dhabduu turte illee isheen waan Waaqa waadaa isheef gale sana amanamaa gootee fudhatteef, amantiidhaan mucaa daʼu dandeesse.
english: By faith even Sarah herself received power to conceive, and she bore a child when she was past age, since she counted him faithful who had promised.

kikuyu: Kanaaf namicha akka waan duʼeetti ilaalamu tokkicha kana irraa sanyiin akka urjii samii baayʼattuu fi akka cirracha qarqara galaanaa kan hin lakkaaʼamne dhalate.
english: Therefore as many as the stars of the sky in multitude, and as innumerable as the sand which is by the sea shore, were fathered by one man, and him as good as dead.

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen hundinuu utuu waan waadaa galameef sana hin argatin amantii isaanii immoo utuu hin dhiisin duʼan. Waadaa sanas fagootti ilaalanii simatan. Isaanis lafa irratti akka keessummootaa fi godaantota turan beekaniiru.
english: These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having confessed that they were strangers and pilgrims on the earth.

kikuyu: Warri waan akkasii jedhan kunneen akka biyya ofii isaanii eeggachaa jiran mulʼisu.
english: For those who say such things make it clear that they are seeking a country of their own.

kikuyu: Isaan utuu waaʼee biyya keessaa baʼan sanaa yaadaa turanii silaa, biyya isaaniitti deebiʼuuf carraa ni argatu turan.
english: If indeed they had been thinking of that country from which they went out, they would have had enough time to return.

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa isaan biyya wayyu tokko jechuunis biyya samii irraa sana hawwaa turan. Kanaafuu Waaqayyo Waaqa isaanii jedhamee waamamuutti hin qaanaʼu; inni magaalaa isaaniif qopheesseeraatii.
english: But now they desire a better country, that is, a heavenly one. Therefore God is not ashamed of them, to be called their God, for he has prepared a city for them.

kikuyu: Abrahaam yeroo Waaqni isa qoretti amantiidhaan Yisihaaqin aarsaadhaaf dhiʼeesse. Isuma waadaa argate sanatu ilma isaa tokkicha aarsaa godhee dhiʼeessuuf qophaaʼe;
english: By faith, Abraham, being tested, offered up Isaac. Yes, he who had gladly received the promises was offering up his only born son,

kikuyu: innis isuma Waaqni, “Sanyiin kee Yisihaaqiin siif waamama” jedheen sana.
english: to whom it was said, “Your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac,”

kikuyu: Abrahaam akka Waaqni warra duʼan keessaa nama kaasuu dandaʼu illee hubatee ture; kunis karaa tokkoon inni ilma isaa Yisihaaqin warra duʼan keessaa deebisee argate jechuu dha.
english: concluding that God is able to raise up even from the dead. Figuratively speaking, he also did receive him back from the dead.

kikuyu: Yisihaaq amantiidhaan waan dhufuuf jiru irratti Yaaqoobii fi Esaawun eebbise.
english: By faith Isaac blessed Jacob and Esau, even concerning things to come.

kikuyu: Yaaqoob yeroo duʼetti amantiidhaan ilmaan Yoosef tokko tokkoon eebbise; mataa ulee isaatti irkatees sagade.
english: By faith Jacob, when he was dying, blessed each of the sons of Joseph, and worshiped, leaning on the top of his staff.

kikuyu: Yoosefis yeroo duʼetti amantiidhaan waaʼee Gibxi keessaa baʼuu ijoollee Israaʼel dubbate; waaʼee lafee isaas ajaja kenne.
english: By faith Joseph, when his end was near, made mention of the departure of the children of Israel, and gave instructions concerning his bones.

kikuyu: Yeroo Museen dhalatetti abbaa fi haati isaa mucaa miidhagaa taʼuu isaa arganii utuu labsii mootichaa hin sodaatin amantiidhaan jiʼa sadii isa dhoksan.
english: By faith Moses, when he was born, was hidden for three months by his parents, because they saw that he was a beautiful child; and they were not afraid of the king’s commandment.

kikuyu: Museen yeroo guddatetti ilma intala Faraʼoon jedhamee waamamuu amantiidhaan dide.
english: By faith Moses, when he had grown up, refused to be called the son of Pharaoh’s daughter,

kikuyu: Inni gammachuu cubbuutiin yeroo gabaabaaf gammaduu irra saba Waaqaa wajjin dhiphachuu filate.
english: choosing rather to share ill treatment with God’s people than to enjoy the pleasures of sin for a time,

kikuyu: Inni waan badhaasa isaa of duratti ilaaleef, Kiristoosiif jedhee salphachuu akka qabeenya Gibxi caalaa gatii guddaa qabuutti fudhate.
english: considering the reproach of Christ greater riches than the treasures of Egypt; for he looked to the reward.

kikuyu: Innis utuu dheekkamsa mootichaa hin sodaatin amantiidhaan Gibxi keessaa baʼe; isa hin mulʼanne sana akka waan argeetti obsee eeggate.
english: By faith he left Egypt, not fearing the wrath of the king; for he endured, as seeing him who is invisible.

kikuyu: Akka ergamaan hangafa ajjeesu sun hangafoota saba Israaʼel hin tuqneefis amantiidhaan akka Faasiikaan ayyaaneffamu, dhiignis akka facaafamu godhe.
english: By faith he kept the Passover and the sprinkling of the blood, that the destroyer of the firstborn should not touch them.

kikuyu: Sabni Israaʼel akkuma nama lafa gogaa irra deemuutti amantiin Galaana Diimaa ceʼe; warri Gibxi garuu yommuu akkuma sanatti ceʼuu yaalanitti ni liqimfaman.
english: By faith they passed through the Red Sea as on dry land. When the Egyptians tried to do so, they were swallowed up.

kikuyu: Dallaan Yerikoo erga guyyaa torba marfamee booddee amantiidhaan jige.
english: By faith the walls of Jericho fell down after they had been encircled for seven days.

kikuyu: Sagaagaltuun Rahaab jedhamtu basaastota simachuu isheetiin amantiidhaan hafte malee warra hin amanin wajjin hin ajjeefamne.
english: By faith Rahab the prostitute didn’t perish with those who were disobedient, having received the spies in peace.

kikuyu: Ani egaa kana caalaa maalin jedha ree? Waaʼee Gedewoon, waaʼee Baaraq, waaʼee Saamsoon, waaʼee Yiftaa, waaʼee Daawit, waaʼee Saamuʼeelii fi waaʼee raajotaa odeessuuf ani yeroo hin qabu;
english: What more shall I say? For the time would fail me if I told of Gideon, Barak, Samson, Jephthah, David, Samuel, and the prophets—

kikuyu: isaan amantiidhaan mootummoota moʼatan; murtii qajeelaa kennan; waan waadaa galame argatan; afaan leencotaa cufan;
english: who through faith subdued kingdoms, worked out righteousness, obtained promises, stopped the mouths of lions,

kikuyu: amantiidhaan ibidda jabaa dhaamsan; qara goraadee jalaa baʼan; dadhabbiin isaanii jabinatti geeddarame; waraana keessatti humna argatanii loltoota diinaa ariʼan.
english: quenched the power of fire, escaped the edge of the sword, from weakness were made strong, grew mighty in war, and caused foreign armies to flee.

kikuyu: Dubartoonnis namoonni isaanii kanneen duʼan duʼaa kaafamaniifii deebisanii fudhatan. Warri kaanis duʼaa kaʼuu wayyu argachuuf jedhanii gad dhiifamuu didanii dhiphatan.
english: Women received their dead by resurrection. Others were tortured, not accepting their deliverance, that they might obtain a better resurrection.

kikuyu: Warra kaanitti ni qoosame; ni garafamanis; akkasumas foncaan hidhamanii mana hidhaatti darbataman.
english: Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.

kikuyu: Dhagaadhaanis ni tumaman; iddoo lamatti baqaqfaman; goraadeedhaan ajjeefaman. Deeguudhaan, ariʼatamuu fi dhiphachuudhaan gogaa hoolotaatii fi reʼootaa uffatanii jooran;
english: They were stoned. They were sawn apart. They were tempted. They were slain with the sword. They went around in sheep skins and in goat skins; being destitute, afflicted, ill-treated—

kikuyu: addunyaan isaaniif hin maleetii. Isaanis gammoojjii fi gaara irra, holqaa fi boolla keessa jooraa turan.
english: of whom the world was not worthy—wandering in deserts, mountains, caves, and the holes of the earth.

kikuyu: Warri kunneen hundinuu yoo sababii amantii isaaniitiif jajaman iyyuu isaan keessaa namni tokko iyyuu waan waadaa galame sana hin arganne.
english: These all, having been commended for their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

kikuyu: Waaqni akka isaan nu qofa wajjin warra mudaa hin qabne taʼaniif duraan dursee waan nuuf wayyu argeera.
english: God having provided some better thing concerning us, so that apart from us they should not be made perfect.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu waan dhuga baatota akka duumessa guddaa akkanaatiin marfamneef kottaa baʼaa hunda, cubbuu xaxee nu qabates of irraa baafnee gannaa; dorgommii fuula keenya dura jirus obsaan jabaannee fiignaa;
english: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,

kikuyu: kottaa Yesuus isa jalqabaa fi fiixaan baasaa amantii keenyaa taʼe sana irra ija keenya kaaʼannaa. Innis gammachuu fuula isaa dura jiruuf jedhee qaanii fannoo tuffachuun fannoo obsee mirga teessoo Waaqaa taaʼe.
english: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

kikuyu: Isin akka dadhabdanii abdii hin kutanneef isa mormii cubbamoota isa irra gaʼe akkasii obse sana yaadatti qabadhaa.
english: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.

kikuyu: Isin amma iyyuu walʼaansoo cubbuu wajjin gootan keessatti hamma dhiiga dhangalaasuutti jabaattanii hin mormine.
english: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.

kikuyu: Dubbii jajjabinaa kan akkuma ilmaaniitti isinitti dubbatu sana irraanfattaniirtu; innis akkana jedha: “Yaa ilma ko, adabbii Gooftaa hin tuffatin; yommuu inni si ifatus abdii hin kutatin;
english: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children, “My son, don’t take lightly the chastening of the Lord, nor faint when you are reproved by him;

kikuyu: Gooftaan warra jaallatu ni adabaatii; inni nama akka ilmaatti ilaalu kam iyyuu ni adaba.”
english: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines, and chastises every son whom he receives.”

kikuyu: Rakkina akkuma adabbiitti obsaa; Waaqni akka ilmaan isaatti isin adabaatii. Ilmi abbaan isaa hin adabne ilma akkamii ti?
english: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?

kikuyu: Isin yoo adabbii ijoolleen hundinuu ittiin adabaman keessatti hin hirmaanne isin diqaalota malee ijoollee dhugaa miti.
english: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.

kikuyu: Kana malees nu hundinuu abbootii foonii kanneen nu adaban qabna turre; isaan kabajnas turre. Yoos Abbaa hafuurotaatiif immoo hammam caalaa ajajamnee jiraachuu qabna ree!
english: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?

kikuyu: Abbootiin keenya akkuma isaanitti gaarii fakkaatetti yeroo gabaabaaf nu adabaa turan; Waaqni garuu akka nu qulqullummaa isaa keessatti hirmaannuuf faayidaa keenyaaf jedhee nu adaba.
english: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

kikuyu: Adabbiin hundinuu yeroo sana waan nama gaddisiisu malee waan nama gammachiisu hin fakkaatu. Ergasii garuu warra adabbii sanaan leenjifamaniif ija qajeelummaa fi nagaa kenna.
english: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu irree laafee fi jilba dadhabe jabeessaa.
english: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,

kikuyu: Naafti akka fayyuuf malee akka karaa irraa hin jalʼanneef, “Miilla keessaniif daandii qajeelaa baafadhaa.”
english: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.

kikuyu: Nama hunda wajjin nagaadhaan jiraachuu fi qulqulluu taʼuuf tattaaffadhaa; qulqullummaan malee namni kam iyyuu Gooftaa arguu hin dandaʼuutii.
english: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,

kikuyu: Nama kamitti iyyuu ayyaanni Waaqaa akka hin hirʼanne of eeggadhaa; hiddi hadhaaʼaan biqilee rakkina akka hin uumnee fi namoota baayʼees hin xureessineef of eeggadhaa.
english: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,

kikuyu: Namni kam iyyuu akka Esaawu isa mirga hangafummaa isaa nyaata tokkittiitti gurgurate sanaa sagaagaltuu yookaan nama Waaqatti hin bulle hin taaneef of eeggadhaa.
english: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.

kikuyu: Inni ergasii yeroo eebba sana dhaaluu barbaadetti akka didame isin ni beektu. Inni yoo eebba sana imimmaaniin barbaade illee geeddarama tokko illee fiduu hin dandeenye.
english: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.

kikuyu: Isin gara tulluu tuqamuu dandaʼuu fi ibiddi irraa bobaʼu, gara dukkanaa, gara dimimmisaa fi bubbee hin geenye;
english: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,

kikuyu: gara sagalee malakataatii fi gara sagalee dubbii dubbatuu hin geenye; warri isa dhagaʼanis akka dubbiin biraa dabalamee isaanitti hin dubbatamne kadhatan.
english: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,

kikuyu: Isaan waan, “Bineensi iyyuu yoo tulluu sana tuqe dhagaadhaan tumamee haa ajjeefamu” jedhamee ajajame sana obsuu hin dandeenyeetii.
english: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.

kikuyu: Wanti achitti mulʼates waan sodaachisaa taʼeef Museen, “Ani sodaadhaan hollachaan jira” jedhe.
english: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”

kikuyu: Isin garuu gara Tulluu Xiyoon, gara magaalaa Waaqa jiraataa jechuunis Yerusaalem ishee samii keessaa dhuftaniirtu. Gara ergamoota kumaatama gammachuun walitti qabamanii dhuftaniirtu;
english: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,

kikuyu: gara waldaa kiristaanaa hangafoota maqaan isaanii samii keessatti barreeffamee dhuftaniirtu. Gara Waaqa Abbaa Murtii waan hundaa, gara hafuurota namoota qajeeltota warra mudaa hin qabne taasifamanii,
english: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,

kikuyu: gara Yesuus araarsaa gidduu galeessa kakuu haaraa, gara dhiiga facaafame kan dubbii dhiigni Abeel dubbatu sana caalaa dubbatuu dhuftaniirtu.
english: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.

kikuyu: Isinis akka isa dubbachaa jiru sana hin didneef of eeggadhaa. Erga isaan yeroo isa lafa irratti isaan akeekkachiise sana didanitti jalaa hin baʼin, nu immoo yoo isa samii irraa nu akeekkachiisu sana irraa gara galle akkamitti jalaa baʼuu dandeenya ree?
english: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,

kikuyu: Yeroo sanatti sagaleen isaa lafa sochoose; amma garuu inni, “Ani ammas yeroo tokko lafa qofa utuu hin taʼin samiiwwanis nan sochoosa” jedhee waadaa galeera.
english: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”

kikuyu: Dubbiin, “Ammas yeroo tokko” jedhu kun akka wanni hin sochoofamne hafee jiraatuuf, wanni sochoofamu jechuunis wanni uumame baduu isaa argisiisa.
english: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu waan mootummaa hin sochoone argannuuf kottaa haa galateeffannu! Kabajaa fi sodaadhaanis karaa fudhatamaa taʼeen Waaqa haa waaqeffannu;
english: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,

kikuyu: Waaqni keenya ibidda gubee balleessuudhaatii.
english: for our God is a consuming fire.

kikuyu: Akka obbolootaatti wal jaallachuu itti fufaa.
english: Let brotherly love continue.

kikuyu: Keessumoota simachuu hin irraanfatinaa; namoonni tokko tokko akkasiin utuu hin beekin ergamoota Waaqaa simataniiruutii.
english: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.

kikuyu: Warra mana hidhaa jiran akka waan isaan wajjin hidhamtaniitti, warra dhiphina keessa jiranis akka waan ofii dhiphattaniitti yaadadhaa.
english: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.

kikuyu: Fuudhaa fi heerumni nama hunda biratti haa kabajamu; sireen fuudhaa fi heerumaas qulqulluu haa taʼu; Waaqni ejjitootaa fi sagaagaltootatti ni muraatii.
english: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.

kikuyu: Jireenya keessan jaalala maallaqaa irraa jabeessaa eeggadhaa; wanni qabdan isin haa gaʼu; Waaqni, “Ani gonkumaa si hin dhiisu; gonkumaas si hin gatu” jedheeraatii.
english: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”

kikuyu: Kanaaf nu ija jabinaan, “Gooftaan gargaaraa koo ti; ani hin sodaadhu. Namni maal na gochuu dandaʼa?” jenna.
english: So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”

kikuyu: Hooggantoota keessan warra dubbii Waaqaa isinitti himanii turan sana yaadadhaa. Waan jireenya isaanii irraa argames ilaalaa; amantii isaanii duukaa buʼaa.
english: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.

kikuyu: Yesuus Kiristoos kaleessa, harʼa, bara baraanis sanuma.
english: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.

kikuyu: Barsiisa gosa hundumaa kan keessummaa taʼeen hin fudhataminaa. Garaan keenyas sirna waaʼee nyaataatiin utuu hin taʼin ayyaanaan jabina argachuu qaba; sirni waaʼee nyaataa warra isa kabajan iyyuu hin fayyadu.
english: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.

kikuyu: Nu iddoo aarsaa kan warri dunkaana qulqulluu keessa tajaajilan irraa nyaachuuf mirga hin qabne tokko qabna.
english: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.

kikuyu: Lubni ol aanaan dhiiga horii qabatee sababii cubbuutiif aarsaa dhiʼeessuuf jedhee Iddoo Iddoo Hunda Caalaa Qulqulluu taʼe sana seena; foon horii sanaas qubata keessaa gad baafamee gubama.
english: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Yesuusis dhiiga ofiitiin saba qulqulleessuuf jedhee karra magaalattiitiin alatti dhiphate.
english: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.

kikuyu: Egaa kottaa nus salphina inni baate sana baannee iddoo qubataatiin ala gara isaa haa dhaqnu.
english: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.

kikuyu: Nu magaalaa dhufuuf jirtu eegganna malee magaalaa bara baraa asii hin qabnuutii.
english: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu kottaa utuu gargar hin kutin karaa Yesuusiitiin aarsaa galataa Waaqaaf haa dhiʼeessinu; aarsaan kunis dubbii maqaa isaa beeksisuuf afaan keenya keessaa baʼuu dha.
english: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.

kikuyu: Waan gaarii gochuu fi waan qabdanis namaan gaʼuu hin dhiisinaa; Waaqni aarsaa akkasiitti gammadaatii.
english: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

kikuyu: Hooggantoota keessaniif ajajamaa; isaaniifis bulaa. Isaan waan itti gaafatamtoota lubbuu keessanii taʼaniif isin eegu; kanas utuu gaddaan hin taʼin akka isaan gammachuun hojjetaniif isaaniif ajajamaa; yoo isaan gaddaan hojjetan isin hin fayyaduutii.
english: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.

kikuyu: Isin Waaqa nuu kadhadhaa. Nu akka karaa hundumaan qalbii qulqulluu qabnuu fi akka jireenya kabajamaa jiraachuu hawwinu mirkaneeffanneerra.
english: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

kikuyu: Keessumattuu akka ani dafee deebiʼee gara keessan dhufuuf akka Waaqa kadhattan isin gorsa.
english: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.

kikuyu: Waaqni nagaa inni karaa dhiiga kakuu bara baraatiin Gooftaa keenya Yesuus, Tiksee hoolotaa guddicha sana warra duʼan keessaa kaase sun,
english: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,

kikuyu: akka isin fedhii isaa raawwattaniif waan gaarii hundaan isin haa qopheessu; innis karaa Yesuus Kiristoosiitiin waan isa gammachiisu nu keessatti haa hojjetu; ulfinni bara baraa hamma bara baraatti Yesuus Kiristoosiif haa taʼu. Ameen.
english: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota nana, ani waan xalayaa gabaabaa isinii barreesseef, akka isin ergaa gorsaa kana obsaan fudhattan isin kadhadha.
english: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.

kikuyu: Akka obboleessi keenya Xiimotewos mana hidhaatii hiikame akka beektan nan barbaada. Yoo inni dafee as dhufe ani isin arguuf isa wajjin nan dhufa.
english: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.

kikuyu: Hooggantoota keessan hundaa fi qulqulloota hundatti nagaa naa himaa. Warri Iixaaliyaa irraa dhufanis nagaa isinii dhaamu.
english: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.

kikuyu: Ayyaanni isin hunda wajjin haa taʼu.
english: Grace be with you all. Amen.

kikuyu: Yaaqoob garbicha Waaqaatii fi kan Yesuus Kiristoos Gooftichaa irraa,
english: James, a servant of God and of the Lord Jesus Christ, to the twelve tribes which are in the Dispersion: Greetings.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota ko, yommuu qorumsi adda addaa isin irra gaʼutti akka gammachuu guutuutti fudhadhaa;
english: Count it all joy, my brothers, when you fall into various temptations,

kikuyu: amantiin keessan qoramuun isaa akka obsa isiniif argamsiisu beektuutii.
english: knowing that the testing of your faith produces endurance.

kikuyu: Akka isin bilchaatoo fi guutuu, warra hirʼina tokko iyyuu hin qabne taataniif obsi hojii isaa haa raawwatu.
english: Let endurance have its perfect work, that you may be perfect and complete, lacking in nothing.

kikuyu: Isin keessaa namni tokko iyyuu hanqina ogummaa yoo qabaate, Waaqa utuu hin tuffatin nama hundumaaf arjummaan kennu haa kadhatu; isaafis ni kennama.
english: But if any of you lacks wisdom, let him ask of God, who gives to all liberally and without reproach, and it will be given to him.

kikuyu: Inni garuu yommuu kadhatu amantiin haa kadhatu; hin shakkinis; namni shakku akka dambalii galaanaa kan bubbeen dhaʼamee oofamuu ti.
english: But let him ask in faith, without any doubting, for he who doubts is like a wave of the sea, driven by the wind and tossed.

kikuyu: Namni sun waan tokko illee Gooftaa biraa nan argadha jedhee hin eeggatin;
english: For that man shouldn’t think that he will receive anything from the Lord.

kikuyu: inni nama yaada lamaa ti; iddoo tokkos hin dhaabatu.
english: He is a double-minded man, unstable in all his ways.

kikuyu: Obboleessi gad qabame ol qabamuu isaatiin of haa jaju.
english: Let the brother in humble circumstances glory in his high position;

kikuyu: Sooressi garuu gad qabamuu isaatti of haa jaju; inni akkuma daraaraa margaa ni harcaʼaatii.
english: and the rich, in that he is made humble, because like the flower in the grass, he will pass away.

kikuyu: Aduun hoʼa gubuun baatee marga gogsitiitii; daraaraan biqiltuu sanaas ni harcaʼa; miidhaginni isaas ni bada. Sooressis utuma hojii isaatiif olii gad fiiguu bada.
english: For the sun arises with the scorching wind and withers the grass; and the flower in it falls, and the beauty of its appearance perishes. So the rich man will also fade away in his pursuits.

kikuyu: Namni qorumsa obsu eebbifamaa dha; inni yommuu qorametti jabaatee waan dhaabateef gonfoo jireenyaa kan Waaqni warra isa jaallataniif waadaa gale sana ni argataatii.
english: Blessed is a person who endures temptation, for when he has been approved, he will receive the crown of life which the Lord promised to those who love him.

kikuyu: Namni kam iyyuu yommuu qoramutti, “Waaqatu na qoraa jira” hin jedhin. Waaqni hamaadhaan hin qoramuutii; innis nama tokko illee hin qoru;
english: Let no man say when he is tempted, “I am tempted by God,” for God can’t be tempted by evil, and he himself tempts no one.

kikuyu: tokkoon tokkoon namaa garuu yommuu hawwii ofii isaa hamaa sanaan harkifamee gowwoomfamutti qorama.
english: But each one is tempted when he is drawn away by his own lust and enticed.

kikuyu: Hawwiinis yommuu ulfooftetti cubbuu dhalti; cubbuun immoo yommuu guutumaan guutuutti guddattetti duʼa dhalti.
english: Then the lust, when it has conceived, bears sin. The sin, when it is full grown, produces death.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota koo jaallatamoo, hin dogoggorinaa.
english: Don’t be deceived, my beloved brothers.

kikuyu: Kennaan gaariin hundinuu, kennaan mudaa hin qabne hundinuus Abbaa ifaa isa akka gaaddidduu hin geeddaramne sana biraa gubbaadhaa gad buʼa.
english: Every good gift and every perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of lights, with whom can be no variation nor turning shadow.

kikuyu: Innis akka nu uumama isaa hundumaaf gosa hangafa taanuuf akkuma fedhii isaatti dubbii dhugaatiin nu dhalche.
english: Of his own will he gave birth to us by the word of truth, that we should be a kind of first fruits of his creatures.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota koo jaallatamoo, waan kana hubadhaa: Namni hundinuu dhagaʼuutti haa ariifatu; dubbachuuf suuta haa jedhu; aaruuttis suuta haa jedhu;
english: So, then, my beloved brothers, let every man be swift to hear, slow to speak, and slow to anger;

kikuyu: aariin namaa qajeelummaa Waaqaa hin hojjetuutii.
english: for the anger of man doesn’t produce the righteousness of God.

kikuyu: Kanaaf xuraaʼummaa hundaa fi hammina isin keessa jiraatu hunda of irraa fageessaa; dubbii lubbuu keessan fayyisuu dandaʼu kan isin keessatti facaafame sana garraamummaan fudhadhaa.
english: Therefore, putting away all filthiness and overflowing of wickedness, receive with humility the implanted word, which is able to save your souls.

kikuyu: Isin garuu warra dubbicha hojii irra oolchitan taʼaa malee warra dhagaʼuu qofaan of gowwoomsitan hin taʼinaa.
english: But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.

kikuyu: Namni dubbicha dhagaʼee hojii irra hin oolchine kam iyyuu nama of-ilaalee keessatti fuula isaa ilaallatu fakkaata;
english: For if anyone is a hearer of the word and not a doer, he is like a man looking at his natural face in a mirror;

kikuyu: innis erga of ilaalee booddee ni deema; yommusuma maal akka fakkaatu ni irraanfata.
english: for he sees himself, and goes away, and immediately forgets what kind of man he was.

kikuyu: Garuu namni seera bilisaa kan hirʼina hin qabne sana hubatee ilaalu, kan akka seera sanaattis jiraatu, kan waan dhagaʼes hojii irra oolchuu malee hin irraanfanne sun waan hojjetu keessatti ni eebbifama.
english: But he who looks into the perfect law of freedom and continues, not being a hearer who forgets but a doer of the work, this man will be blessed in what he does.

kikuyu: Namni waan amantaa qabu of seʼu, kan garuu arraba isaa hin luugamanne yoo jiraate inni of gowwoomsa; amantaan isaas faayidaa hin qabu.
english: If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this man’s religion is worthless.

kikuyu: Amantaan Waaqa Abbaa keenya duratti qulqulluu taʼee fi kan mudaa hin qabne isa kana: kunis ijoollee abbaa fi haadha hin qabnee fi haadhota hiyyeessaa rakkina isaanii keessatti kunuunsuu fi xuraaʼummaa addunyaa irraa of eeggachuu dha.
english: Pure religion and undefiled before our God and Father is this: to visit the fatherless and widows in their affliction, and to keep oneself unstained by the world.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota ko, isin waan Gooftaa keenya kan ulfinaa Yesuus Kiristoositti amantaniif nama wal hin caalchisinaa.
english: My brothers, don’t hold the faith of our glorious Lord Jesus Christ with partiality.

kikuyu: Namni qubeelaa warqee kaaʼatee uffata bareedaas uffatu tokko gara wal gaʼii keessanii dhufa haa jennu; akkasumas hiyyeessi darsa uffatu ni dhufa haa jennu.
english: For if a man with a gold ring, in fine clothing, comes into your synagogue, and a poor man in filthy clothing also comes in,

kikuyu: Isinis yoo namicha uffata bareedaa uffatu sanaaf ulfina addaa kennitanii, “Maaloo kottuu iddoo gaarii taaʼi!” jettan, yoo namicha hiyyeessa sanaan immoo, “Ati achi dhaabadhu” yookaan “Kottuutii miilla koo bira taaʼi!” jettan,
english: and you pay special attention to him who wears the fine clothing and say, “Sit here in a good place;” and you tell the poor man, “Stand there,” or “Sit by my footstool”

kikuyu: isin gidduu keessanitti garaa garummaa uumtanii warra yaada hamaan murteessitan hin taanee?
english: haven’t you shown partiality among yourselves, and become judges with evil thoughts?

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota koo jaallatamoo, mee dhagaʼaa! Waaqni akka isaan amantiitti sooreyyii taʼanii fi akka isaan mootummaa inni warra isa jaallataniif waadaa gale sana dhaalaniif hiyyeeyyii addunyaa kanaa filateera mitii?
english: Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith and heirs of the Kingdom which he promised to those who love him?

kikuyu: Isin garuu hiyyeeyyii salphiftaniirtu. Warri isin qisaasuutti jiran warruma sooreyyii sana mitii? Kanneen gara mana murtiitti isin harkisaa jiranis isaanuma mitii?
english: But you have dishonored the poor man. Don’t the rich oppress you and personally drag you before the courts?

kikuyu: Maqaa kabajamaa isin ittiin waamamtan sanas kan arrabsan isaanuma mitii?
english: Don’t they blaspheme the honorable name by which you are called?

kikuyu: Seera mootii kan Katabbii Qulqulluu keessatti, “Ollaa kee garuu akka ofii keetti jaalladhu” jedhu sana yoo dhugumaan eegdan isin waan qajeelaa gochaa jirtu.
english: However, if you fulfill the royal law according to the Scripture, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself,” you do well.

kikuyu: Yoo nama wal caalchiftan garuu isin cubbuu hojjettan; seera durattis akka seera cabsitootaatti isinitti murama.
english: But if you show partiality, you commit sin, being convicted by the law as transgressors.

kikuyu: Sababiin isaas namni seera guutummaatti eegee waan tokko qofa cabse kam iyyuu akka waan seera hunda cabseetti ilaalamaatii.
english: For whoever keeps the whole law, and yet stumbles in one point, he has become guilty of all.

kikuyu: Inni, “Hin ejjin” jedhe sun akkasuma immoo, “Hin ajjeesin” jedheeraatii. Ati yoo ejjuu baatte illee nama ajjeefnaan seera cabsiteerta.
english: For he who said, “Do not commit adultery,” also said, “Do not commit murder.” Now if you do not commit adultery but do murder, you have become a transgressor of the law.

kikuyu: Isin akka warra seera nama bilisoomsuun itti muramuutti dubbadhaa; hojjedhaas;
english: So speak and so do as men who are to be judged by the law of freedom.

kikuyu: nama namaaf hin araaramnetti murtii araara hin qabnetu murama. Araarri murtii moʼa.
english: For judgment is without mercy to him who has shown no mercy. Mercy triumphs over judgment.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota ko, namni tokko yoo, “Ani amantii qaba” jedhee garuu hojiin argisiisuu baate, kun faayidaa maalii qaba? Amantiin akkanaa isa fayyisuu dandaʼaa ree?
english: What good is it, my brothers, if a man says he has faith, but has no works? Can faith save him?

kikuyu: Fakkeenyaaf obboleessi tokko yookaan obboleettiin tokko uffataa fi waan guyyaa guyyaan nyaatan hin qaban haa jennu.
english: And if a brother or sister is naked and in lack of daily food,

kikuyu: Isin keessaa yoo namni tokko, “Nagaan deemaa; isinitti haa hoʼu; quufaas” isaaniin jedhee garuu waan foon isaaniitiif barbaachisu tokko illee hin kenniniif, kun faayidaa maalii qaba ree?
english: and one of you tells them, “Go in peace. Be warmed and filled;” yet you didn’t give them the things the body needs, what good is it?

kikuyu: Akkasumas amantiin hojiin hin mulʼifamne ofiinuu duʼaa dha.
english: Even so faith, if it has no works, is dead in itself.

kikuyu: Namni tokko garuu, “Ati amantii qabda; ani immoo hojii qaba” jedha. Ati amantii kee hojii malee na argisiisi; anis hojii kootiin amantii koo sin argisiisa.
english: Yes, a man will say, “You have faith, and I have works.” Show me your faith without works, and I will show you my faith by my works.

kikuyu: Akka Waaqni tokkichi jiru ati ni amanta. Kun gaarii dha! Hafuuronni hamoon iyyuu waan kana ni amanu; sodaadhaanis ni hollatu.
english: You believe that God is one. You do well. The demons also believe—and shudder.

kikuyu: Yaa namicha gowwaa nana, ati akka amantiin hojii of keessaa hin qabne duʼaa taʼe beekuu barbaaddaa?
english: But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?

kikuyu: Abbaan keenya Abrahaam yommuu ilma isaa Yisihaaqin iddoo aarsaa irratti dhiʼeessetti waan hojjete sanaaf qajeelaa taʼee hin lakkaaʼamnee ree?
english: Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?

kikuyu: Akka amantiin isaatii fi hojiin isaa tokkummaan hojjechaa turan ni argita; waan inni hojjeteenis amantiin isaa guutuu taʼe.
english: You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected.

kikuyu: Kanaanis wanni katabbii qulqulluu keessatti, “Abrahaam Waaqa amane; kunis qajeelummaatti lakkaaʼameef” jedhu ni raawwatame; innis michuu Waaqaa jedhame.
english: So the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness,” and he was called the friend of God.

kikuyu: Egaa akka namni hojiidhaanis malee amantii qofaan qajeelaatti hin lakkaaʼamne ni argitu.
english: You see then that by works a man is justified, and not only by faith.

kikuyu: Akkasuma immoo sagaagaltuun Rahaab jedhamtu yommuu basaastota simattee karaa kaaniin isaan geggeessitetti waan hojjetteen qajeeltuutti hin lakkaaʼamnee ree?
english: In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works when she received the messengers and sent them out another way?

kikuyu: Akkuma dhagni hafuura hin qabne duʼaa taʼe sana, amantiin hojii hin qabnes duʼaa dha.
english: For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota ko, baayʼeen keessan barsiistota hin taʼinaa; nu warra barsiisnutti murtii cimaan akka muramu ni beektuutii.
english: Let not many of you be teachers, my brothers, knowing that we will receive heavier judgment.

kikuyu: Nu hundinuu karaa baayʼeedhaan gufanna. Namni waan dubbatu keessatti hin gufanne kam iyyuu nama hirʼina hin qabnee dha; dhagna isaas guutummaatti toʼachuu dandaʼa.
english: For we all stumble in many things. Anyone who doesn’t stumble in word is a perfect person, able to bridle the whole body also.

kikuyu: Fardi akka nuuf ajajamuuf yoo afaan isaa luugamne dhagna isaa guutuu gara barbaanne geessuu dandeenya.
english: Indeed, we put bits into the horses’ mouths so that they may obey us, and we guide their whole body.

kikuyu: Mee doonii illee ilaalaa! Dooniin yoo akka malee guddaa taʼee bubbee jabaadhaan oofame illee namichi isa oofu batoo xinnoo isheetiin gara barbaadetti geessa.
english: Behold, the ships also, though they are so big and are driven by fierce winds, are yet guided by a very small rudder, wherever the pilot desires.

kikuyu: Akkasuma immoo arrabni kutaa dhagnaa xinnoo dha; waan gurguddaadhaan of jaja. Bosonni hammam guddaa taʼu iyyuu qaanqee ibiddaa xinnaadhaan akka gubatu hubadhaa.
english: So the tongue is also a little member, and boasts great things. See how a small fire can spread to a large forest!

kikuyu: Arrabni ibidda; kutaawwan dhagnaa keessattis addunyaa hamminaa ti. Inni dhagna guutuu xureessa; adeemsa uumamaattis ibidda qabsiisa; ofii isaatii immoo ibidda gahaannamiitiin gubama.
english: And the tongue is a fire. The world of iniquity among our members is the tongue, which defiles the whole body, and sets on fire the course of nature, and is set on fire by Gehenna.

kikuyu: Bineensonni gosa hundaa, simbirroonni, uumamawwan lafa irra looʼanii fi galaana keessa jiraatan hundinuu namaan madaqfamu; madaqfamaniirus;
english: For every kind of animal, bird, creeping thing, and sea creature is tamed, and has been tamed by mankind;

kikuyu: arraba garuu namni tokko iyyuu leenjisuu hin dandaʼu. Arrabni hamaa boqonnaa hin qabnee dha; summii nama ajjeesuunis kan guutamee dha.
english: but nobody can tame the tongue. It is a restless evil, full of deadly poison.

kikuyu: Nu arrabaan Gooftaa fi Abbaa eebbifna; isumaan immoo nama bifa Waaqaatiin uumame abaarra.
english: With it we bless our God and Father, and with it we curse men who are made in the image of God.

kikuyu: Afaanuma tokko keessaa eebbii fi abaarsi baʼa. Yaa obboloota ko, wanni kun akkas taʼuu hin qabu.
english: Out of the same mouth comes blessing and cursing. My brothers, these things ought not to be so.

kikuyu: Bishaan miʼaawaa fi hadhaaʼaan burqaa tokko keessaa ni baʼaa?
english: Does a spring send out from the same opening fresh and bitter water?

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota ko, mukni harbuu ija ejersaa naqachuu yookaan wayiniin ija harbuu naqachuu dandaʼaa? Akkasuma immoo burqaan bishaan soogiddaa bishaan miʼaawaa kennuu hin dandaʼu.
english: Can a fig tree, my brothers, yield olives, or a vine figs? Thus no spring yields both salt water and fresh water.

kikuyu: Isin keessaa ogeessii fi hubataan eenyu? Kanas inni jireenya isaa gaariidhaan, hojii ogummaa kan gad of qabuudhaan hojjetamuun haa argisiisu.
english: Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of wisdom.

kikuyu: Isin garuu yoo hinaaffaa hadhaaʼaa fi hawwii ofittummaa garaa keessan keessaa qabaattan of hin jajinaa; dhugaa irrattis soba hin dubbatinaa.
english: But if you have bitter jealousy and selfish ambition in your heart, don’t boast and don’t lie against the truth.

kikuyu: Ogummaan kun kan lafaa ti; kan foonii ti; kan hafuura hamaati malee kan samii irraa dhufu miti.
english: This wisdom is not that which comes down from above, but is earthly, sensual, and demonic.

kikuyu: Iddoo hinaaffaa fi hawwiin ofittummaa jiru, jeequmsaa fi hojii hamminaa hundumatu jira.
english: For where jealousy and selfish ambition are, there is confusion and every evil deed.

kikuyu: Ogummaan samii irraa dhufu garuu duraan dursee qulqulluu dha; akkasumas nagaa qabeessa; garraamii dha; ajajamaa dha; kan araaraa fi ija gaariin guutamee dha; wal caalchisuu fi itti fakkeessuus of keessaa hin qabu.
english: But the wisdom that is from above is first pure, then peaceful, gentle, reasonable, full of mercy and good fruits, without partiality, and without hypocrisy.

kikuyu: Iji qajeelummaa warra nagaa buusaniin nagaadhaan facaafama.
english: Now the fruit of righteousness is sown in peace by those who make peace.

kikuyu: Wanni lolaa fi walitti buʼuu isin gidduutti kaasu maali? Isaan hawwii isin keessatti wal lolan irraa dhufu mitii?
english: Where do wars and fightings among you come from? Don’t they come from your pleasures that war in your members?

kikuyu: Isin ni hawwitu; garuu hin argattan. Kanaaf ni ajjeeftu; ni hinaaftus. Garuu waan barbaaddan sana argachuu hin dandeessan. Kanaafis walitti buutu; wal loltus. Isin waan Waaqa hin kadhanneef hin qabaattan.
english: You lust, and don’t have. You murder and covet, and can’t obtain. You fight and make war. You don’t have, because you don’t ask.

kikuyu: Isin dharraa keessan hamaa guutachuuf jettanii yaada hamaan waan kadhattaniif yommuu kadhattan hin argattan.
english: You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.

kikuyu: Yaa ejjitoota, addunyaatti michoomuun Waaqatti diina taʼuu akka taʼe hin beektanii? Namni michuu addunyaa taʼu kam iyyuu diina Waaqaa taʼa.
english: You adulterers and adulteresses, don’t you know that friendship with the world is hostility toward God? Whoever therefore wants to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God.

kikuyu: Yookaan wanni Katabbiin Qulqulluun, “Hafuurri nu keessa jiraatu sun hinaaffaadhaan hawwa” jedhu akkasumaan dubbatama seetuu ree?
english: Or do you think that the Scripture says in vain, “The Spirit who lives in us yearns jealously”?

kikuyu: Inni garuu ayyaana caalu nuuf kenna. Sababiin Katabbiin Qulqulluun, “Waaqni of tuultotaan ni morma; warra gad of qabaniif immoo ayyaana kenna” jedhuufis kanuma.
english: But he gives more grace. Therefore it says, “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu Waaqaaf bulaa. Diiyaabiloosiin immoo mormaa; innis isin baqataa.
english: Be subject therefore to God. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

kikuyu: Waaqatti dhiʼaadhaa; innis isinitti ni dhiʼaataa. Isin cubbamoonni harka keessan dhiqadhaa; warri yaada lama qabdanis garaa keessan qulqulleeffadhaa.
english: Draw near to God, and he will draw near to you. Cleanse your hands, you sinners. Purify your hearts, you double-minded.

kikuyu: Dhiphadhaa; gaddaa; booʼaas. Kolfi keessan booʼichatti, gammachuun keessan immoo gaddatti haa geeddaramu.
english: Lament, mourn, and weep. Let your laughter be turned to mourning and your joy to gloom.

kikuyu: Fuula Gooftaa duratti gad of qabaa; inni immoo ol isin qabaa.
english: Humble yourselves in the sight of the Lord, and he will exalt you.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, wal hin hammeessinaa. Namni obboleessa isaa hammeessu yookaan obboleessa isaatti muru kam iyyuu seera hammeessa; seerattis ni mura. Garuu ati yoo seeratti murte seera sanatti muraa jirta malee isaaf ajajamaa hin jirtu.
english: Don’t speak against one another, brothers. He who speaks against a brother and judges his brother, speaks against the law and judges the law. But if you judge the law, you are not a doer of the law but a judge.

kikuyu: Inni seera tumuu fi Abbaan Murtii tokkichuma; innis isa fayyisuu fi balleessuu dandaʼuu dha. Garuu nama kaanitti muruuf ati eenyu?
english: Only one is the lawgiver, who is able to save and to destroy. But who are you to judge another?

kikuyu: Egaa isin warri, “Harʼa yookaan bor magaalaa kana yookaan magaalaa sana dhaqnee waggaa tokko achi turra; daldallees buʼaa arganna” jettan mee dhagaʼaa.
english: Come now, you who say, “Today or tomorrow let’s go into this city and spend a year there, trade, and make a profit.”

kikuyu: Isin waan bor taʼuuf jiru iyyuu hin beektan. Jireenyi keessan maal innii? Isin hurrii yeroo xinnoof mulʼattee ergasii immoo badduu dha.
english: Yet you don’t know what your life will be like tomorrow. For what is your life? For you are a vapor that appears for a little time and then vanishes away.

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa isin, “Yoo Gooftaan jedhe, nu ni jiraanna; waan kana yookaan waan sana ni hojjenna” jechuu qabdu.
english: For you ought to say, “If the Lord wills, we will both live, and do this or that.”

kikuyu: Amma garuu isin of jajuu keessanitti gammaddu. Gammachuun akkasii hundi hamaa dha.
english: But now you glory in your boasting. All such boasting is evil.

kikuyu: Egaa namni kam iyyuu waan gaarii hojjechuu qabu utuma beekuu yoo hojjechuu baate kun cubbuu isatti taʼa.
english: To him therefore who knows to do good and doesn’t do it, to him it is sin.

kikuyu: Isin yaa sooreyyii, sababii dhiphinni isinitti dhufuuf jiruutiif booʼaa; wawwaadhaas.
english: Come now, you rich, weep and howl for your miseries that are coming on you.

kikuyu: Qabeenyi keessan tortoreera; biliinis uffata keessan nyaateera.
english: Your riches are corrupted and your garments are moth-eaten.

kikuyu: Warqee fi meetiin keessan sameera. Dandaaʼuun isaaniis isinitti dhugaa baʼa; akkuma ibiddaattis foon keessan nyaata. Isin bara dhumaatiif qabeenya walitti qabattaniirtu.
english: Your gold and your silver are corroded, and their corrosion will be for a testimony against you and will eat your flesh like fire. You have laid up your treasure in the last days.

kikuyu: Kunoo, mindaan isin warra midhaan keessan haaman dhowwattan sun ni iyya. Iyyi warra midhaan keessan walitti qabaniis gurra Gooftaa Waan Hunda Dandaʼu sanaa seeneera.
english: Behold, the wages of the laborers who mowed your fields, which you have kept back by fraud, cry out; and the cries of those who reaped have entered into the ears of the Lord of Armies.

kikuyu: Isin qananii fi gammachuun lafa irra jiraattaniirtu. Guyyaa qalmaatiifis of gabbiftaniirtu.
english: You have lived in luxury on the earth, and taken your pleasure. You have nourished your hearts as in a day of slaughter.

kikuyu: Nama qajeelaa isiniin hin morminetti murtanii ajjeeftu.
english: You have condemned and you have murdered the righteous one. He doesn’t resist you.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa obboloota, hamma dhufaatii Gooftaatti obsaa. Qonnaan bulaan tokko lafa irraa midhaan gaarii argachuuf hammam akka eeggatu, bokkaa duraatii fi kan dhumaa hamma argattuttis hammam akka obsu hubadhaa.
english: Be patient therefore, brothers, until the coming of the Lord. Behold, the farmer waits for the precious fruit of the earth, being patient over it, until it receives the early and late rain.

kikuyu: Isinis akkasuma obsaa; jabaadhaa dhaabadhaas; dhufaatiin Gooftaa dhiʼaateeraatii.
english: You also be patient. Establish your hearts, for the coming of the Lord is at hand.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, akka isinitti hin muramneef walitti hin guunguminaa. Kunoo, Abbaan Murtii balbala dura dhaabateera.
english: Don’t grumble, brothers, against one another, so that you won’t be judged. Behold, the judge stands at the door.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, raajota maqaa Gooftaatiin dubbachaa turan sana akka fakkeenya dhiphinaa fi obsaatti fudhadhaa.
english: Take, brothers, for an example of suffering and of perseverance, the prophets who spoke in the name of the Lord.

kikuyu: Kunoo, nu warra obsaan jabaattanii dhaabatan sanaan eebbifamoo jenna; Iyyoob obsuu isaa dhageessaniirtu; waan Gooftaan dhuma irratti isaaf godhes argitaniirtu. Gooftaan gara laafinaa fi araaraan kan guutamee dha.
english: Behold, we call them blessed who endured. You have heard of the perseverance of Job and have seen the Lord in the outcome, and how the Lord is full of compassion and mercy.

kikuyu: Hundumaa caalaa immoo yaa obboloota ko, hin kakatinaa; samiin yookaan lafaan yookaan waan biraa tokkoon illee hin kakatinaa. Wanni isin jechuu qabdan, “Eeyyee” yookaan “waawuu” haa taʼu. Yoo kanaa achii isinitti murama.
english: But above all things, my brothers, don’t swear—not by heaven, or by the earth, or by any other oath; but let your “yes” be “yes”, and your “no”, “no”, so that you don’t fall into hypocrisy.

kikuyu: Isin keessaa namni dhiphachaa jiru jiraa? Inni haa kadhatu. Namni gammadu jiraa? Inni faarfannaa galataa haa faarfatu.
english: Is any among you suffering? Let him pray. Is any cheerful? Let him sing praises.

kikuyu: Isin keessaa namni dhukkubsatu jiraa? Inni jaarsolii waldaa kiristaanaa haa waamsifatu; isaanis maqaa Gooftaatiin zayitii isa dibanii haa kadhataniif.
english: Is any among you sick? Let him call for the elders of the assembly, and let them pray over him, anointing him with oil in the name of the Lord;

kikuyu: Kadhannaan amantiin godhamu nama dhukkubsatu ni fayyisa; Gooftaanis isa ni kaasa. Yoo inni cubbuu hojjetee jiraates ni dhiifamaaf.
english: and the prayer of faith will heal him who is sick, and the Lord will raise him up. If he has committed sins, he will be forgiven.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka fayyitaniif cubbuu keessan walitti himadhaatii walii kadhadhaa. Kadhannaan nama qajeelaa humna qaba; waan guddaas ni hojjeta.
english: Confess your sins to one another and pray for one another, that you may be healed. The insistent prayer of a righteous person is powerfully effective.

kikuyu: Eeliyaas namuma akka keenyaa ture. Innis akka bokkaan hin roobneef jabeessee kadhate; bokkaanis waggaa sadii fi jiʼa jaʼa lafa irratti hin roobne.
english: Elijah was a man with a nature like ours, and he prayed earnestly that it might not rain, and it didn’t rain on the earth for three years and six months.

kikuyu: Ammas deebiʼee kadhate; samiin bokkaa kenne; laftis midhaan baafte.
english: He prayed again, and the sky gave rain, and the earth produced its fruit.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota ko, isin keessaa namni tokko yoo dhugaa irraa fagaate, namni biraa immoo yoo isa deebise,
english: Brothers, if any among you wanders from the truth and someone turns him back,

kikuyu: inni nama cubbamaa karaa jalʼaa irraa deebisu lubbuu namicha sanaa akka duʼa jalaa baasu, cubbuu baayʼees akka dhoksu haa beeku.
english: let him know that he who turns a sinner from the error of his way will save a soul from death and will cover a multitude of sins.

kikuyu: Phexros ergamaa Yesuus Kiristoos irraa,
english: Peter, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to the chosen ones who are living as foreigners in the Dispersion in Pontus, Galatia, Cappadocia, Asia, and Bithynia,

kikuyu: kanneen akka beekumsa Waaqa Abbaatti, karaa hojii qulqulleessuu Hafuuraatiin, akka Yesuus Kiristoosiif ajajamanii fi akka dhiigni isaa isaanitti facaafamuuf filatamaniitti:
english: according to the foreknowledge of God the Father, in sanctification of the Spirit, that you may obey Jesus Christ and be sprinkled with his blood: Grace to you and peace be multiplied.

kikuyu: Waaqaa fi Abbaan Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos haa eebbifamu! Inni araara isaa guddaa sanaan, warra duʼan keessaa kaʼuu Yesuus Kiristoosiin abdii jiraataadhaaf lammata nu dhalche;
