english: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, who according to his great mercy caused us to be born again to a living hope through the resurrection of Jesus Christ from the dead,

kikuyu: akkasumas dhaala hin badne, kan hin xuroofne yookaan hin geeddaramnetti nu galche; dhaalli kunis samii keessa isinii kaaʼameera;
english: to an incorruptible and undefiled inheritance that doesn’t fade away, reserved in Heaven for you,

kikuyu: isin warra karaa amantiitiin hamma fayyina bara dhumaatti mulʼachuudhaaf qophaaʼe sanaatti humna Waaqaatiin eegamtanii dha.
english: who by the power of God are guarded through faith for a salvation ready to be revealed in the last time.

kikuyu: Isinis yoo amma yeroo gabaabaaf qorumsa gosa garaa garaa keessa darbuu qabaattan iyyuu waan kanaan akka malee gammaddan.
english: In this you greatly rejoice, though now for a little while, if need be, you have been grieved in various trials,

kikuyu: Wanni kunis akka amantiin keessan kan warqee yoo ibiddaan qulqulleeffame iyyuu badu sana caalu sun dhugaa taʼuun isaa mirkaneeffamee, yeroo itti Yesuus Kiristoos mulʼatutti galata, ulfinaa fi kabaja fiduuf taʼe.
english: that the proof of your faith, which is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire, may be found to result in praise, glory, and honor at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

kikuyu: Isin utuu isa hin argin isa jaallattu; amma yoo isa arguu baattan iyyuu isatti amantu; gammachuu ibsamuu hin dandeenyee fi ulfina qabeessaanis guutamtaniirtu;
english: whom, not having known, you love. In him, though now you don’t see him, yet believing, you rejoice greatly with joy that is unspeakable and full of glory,

kikuyu: isin buʼaa amantii keessanii jechuunis fayyina lubbuu keessanii argachaa jirtuutii.
english: receiving the result of your faith, the salvation of your souls.

kikuyu: Raajonni waaʼee ayyaana isinii kennamuuf jiru sanaa dubbatan sun itti jabaatanii waaʼee fayyina kanaa qorachaa, iyyaafachaas turan;
english: Concerning this salvation, the prophets sought and searched diligently. They prophesied of the grace that would come to you,

kikuyu: isaanis yommuu Hafuurri Kiristoos inni isaan keessa ture sun waaʼee dhiphina Kiristoosiitii fi waaʼee ulfina itti aanu sanaa duraan dursee dubbatetti yoomii fi haala akkamii keessa akka taʼu beekuuf yaalaa turan.
english: searching for who or what kind of time the Spirit of Christ which was in them pointed to when he predicted the sufferings of Christ and the glories that would follow them.

kikuyu: Namoonni Hafuura Qulqulluu isa samiidhaa ergameen wangeela isinitti lallaban sun waan amma isinitti himan keessatti utuu ofii isaanii hin taʼin isin akka tajaajilan ifa ni taʼeef; waan kana ergamoonni iyyuu gad fageenyaan arguu hawwu.
english: To them it was revealed that they served not themselves, but you, in these things, which now have been announced to you through those who preached the Good News to you by the Holy Spirit sent out from heaven; which things angels desire to look into.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu mudhii qalbii keessanii hidhadhaa; warra of qaban taʼaa; abdii keessanis guutumaan guutuutti ayyaana yeroo Yesuus Kiristoos mulʼatutti isinii kennamu sana irra kaaʼadhaa.
english: Therefore prepare your minds for action. Be sober, and set your hope fully on the grace that will be brought to you at the revelation of Jesus Christ—

kikuyu: Akka ijoollee ajajamanii taʼaa malee hawwii hamaa bara wallaalummaa keessanii sana duukaa hin buʼinaa.
english: as children of obedience, not conforming yourselves according to your former lusts as in your ignorance,

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa akkuma inni isin waame sun qulqulluu taʼe, isinis waan hojjetan hundumaan qulqulloota taʼaa;
english: but just as he who called you is holy, you yourselves also be holy in all of your behavior,

kikuyu: “Ani qulqulluudhaatii isinis qulqulloota taʼaa” jedhamee barreeffameeraatii.
english: because it is written, “You shall be holy, for I am holy.”

kikuyu: Isin erga isa utuu wal hin caalchisin nama hunda akkuma hojii isaatti itti muru sana “Abbaa” jettanii waammattanii bara keessummummaa keessan isa sodaachaa jiraadhaa.
english: If you call on him as Father, who without respect of persons judges according to each man’s work, pass the time of your living as foreigners here in reverent fear,

kikuyu: Isin akka jireenya faayidaa hin qabne kan abbootii keessan irraa dhaaltan irraa waan baduu dandaʼu kan akka meetiitii fi warqeetiin hin furamin beektuutii.
english: knowing that you were redeemed, not with corruptible things like silver or gold, from the useless way of life handed down from your fathers,

kikuyu: Garuu dhiiga gatii guddaa qabu, dhiiga Kiristoos jechuunis hoolaa mudaa yookaan hanqina hin qabne sanaatiin furamtaniirtu.
english: but with precious blood, as of a lamb without blemish or spot, the blood of Christ,

kikuyu: Inni utuu addunyaan hin uumamin duraan dursee beekame; garuu isiniif jedhee bara dhumaa kana keessa mulʼate.
english: who was foreknown indeed before the foundation of the world, but was revealed in this last age for your sake,

kikuyu: Isinis karaa isaatiin Waaqa warra duʼan keessaa isa kaasee ulfina isaaf kenne sanatti amantu; kunis akka amantii fi abdiin keessan Waaqayyo taʼuuf.
english: who through him are believers in God, who raised him from the dead and gave him glory, so that your faith and hope might be in God.

kikuyu: Egaa isin waan akka obboloota keessaniif jaalala dhugaa qabaattaniif jettanii dhugaadhaaf ajajamuun of qulqulleessitaniif, cimsaatii garaa qulqulluudhaan wal jaalladhaa.
english: Seeing you have purified your souls in your obedience to the truth through the Spirit in sincere brotherly affection, love one another from the heart fervently,

kikuyu: Isin karaa dubbii Waaqaa isa jiraatuu fi cimee dhaabatu sanaatiin sanyii hin badne irraa lammata dhalattan malee sanyii badu irraa miti.
english: having been born again, not of corruptible seed, but of incorruptible, through the word of God, which lives and remains forever.

kikuyu: “Foon hundi akkuma margaa ti; ulfinni isaa hundis akkuma daraaraa margaa ti; margi ni coollaga; daraaraanis ni harcaʼa;
english: For, “All flesh is like grass, and all of man’s glory like the flower in the grass. The grass withers, and its flower falls;

kikuyu: dubbiin Gooftaa garuu bara baraan ni jiraata.” Dubbiin kunis wangeela isinitti lallabame sana.
english: but the Lord’s word endures forever.” This is the word of Good News which was preached to you.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu hammina hunda, gowwoomsaa hunda, itti fakkeessummaa, weennoo fi maqaa nama balleessuu hunda of irraa fageessaa.
english: Putting away therefore all wickedness, all deceit, hypocrisies, envies, and all evil speaking,

kikuyu: Akka ittiin fayyina keessaniin guddattaniifis akkuma daaʼimman reefuu dhalataniitti aannan hafuuraa qulqullaaʼaa sana jabeessaa dharraʼaa;
english: as newborn babies, long for the pure spiritual milk, that with it you may grow,

kikuyu: isin gaarummaa Gooftaa dhandhamattaniirtuutii.
english: if indeed you have tasted that the Lord is gracious.

kikuyu: Isin erga gara isaa, gara Dhagaa jiraataa namoonni tuffatanii Waaqni garuu filate gati jabeessa sanaa dhuftanii,
english: Come to him, a living stone, rejected indeed by men, but chosen by God, precious.

kikuyu: isinis akkuma aarsaa hafuuraa kan karaa Yesuus Kiristoosiin Waaqa biratti fudhatamaa taʼe dhiʼeessuudhaan luboota qulqullaaʼoo taʼuuf akkuma dhagaawwan jiraatootti mana hafuuraa taatanii ijaaramaa jirtu.
english: You also as living stones are built up as a spiritual house, to be a holy priesthood, to offer up spiritual sacrifices, acceptable to God through Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Katabbiin Qulqulluun, “Kunoo, ani Xiyoon keessa, dhagaa tokko, dhagaa golee filatamaa gati jabeessa nan kaaʼa; namni isa amanatu kam iyyuu hin qaanaʼu” jedhaatii.
english: Because it is contained in Scripture, “Behold, I lay in Zion a chief cornerstone, chosen and precious. He who believes in him will not be disappointed.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu dhagaan kun isin warra amantaniif dhagaa gati jabeessaa dha. Warra hin amanneef garuu, “Dhagaan ijaartonni tuffatan, dhagaa golee taʼeera.”
english: For you who believe therefore is the honor, but for those who are disobedient, “The stone which the builders rejected has become the chief cornerstone,”

kikuyu: Akkasumas, “Dhagaa nama gufachiisu, kattaa nama kuffisu taʼe” jedhameera. Isaanis waan dubbii sanaaf ajajamuu didaniif gufatan; dhugumaanuu isaan kanumaaf ramadaman.
english: and, “a stumbling stone and a rock of offense.” For they stumble at the word, being disobedient, to which also they were appointed.

kikuyu: Isin garuu akka galata isa dukkana keessaa gara ifa isaa dinqisiisaatti isin waame sanaa labsitaniif dhaloota filatame, luboota mootii, saba qulqulluu, saba Waaqaa kan addaa taataniirtu.
english: But you are a chosen race, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, a people for God’s own possession, that you may proclaim the excellence of him who called you out of darkness into his marvelous light.

kikuyu: Isin dur saba Waaqaa hin turre; amma garuu saba Waaqaa ti; isin dur araara hin arganne; amma garuu araara argattaniirtu.
english: In the past, you were not a people, but now are God’s people, who had not obtained mercy, but now have obtained mercy.

kikuyu: Yaa michoota jaallatamoo, isin waan addunyaa keessatti alagootaa fi keessummoota taataniif akka hawwii foonii kan lubbuu keessan lolu irraa fagaattan ani isinin gorsa.
english: Beloved, I beg you as foreigners and pilgrims to abstain from fleshly lusts which war against the soul,

kikuyu: Akka ormoonni akka waan isin hammina hojjetaniitti maqaa isin balleessan sun, hojii keessan isa gaarii arganii guyyaa Waaqni nu ilaaluu dhufutti ulfina isaaf kennaniif isaan gidduutti amala gaarii qabaadhaa.
english: having good behavior among the nations, so in that of which they speak against you as evildoers, they may see your good works and glorify God in the day of visitation.

kikuyu: Gooftaadhaaf jedhaatii taayitaa namaa hunda jalatti bulaa; mootii taayitaa ol aanaa qabu
english: Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme,

kikuyu: yookaan bulchitoota inni akka isaan namoota balleessaa hojjetan adabanii warra waan qajeelaa hojjetan immoo galateeffataniif erge hundumaa jalattis bulaa.
english: or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

kikuyu: Waaqni akka isin waan gaarii hojjechuudhaan haasaa wallaalummaa namoota gowwaa afaan qabachiiftan fedhaatii.
english: For this is the will of God, that by well-doing you should put to silence the ignorance of foolish men.

kikuyu: Akka warra bilisummaa qabaniitti jiraadhaa; bilisummaa keessan immoo hammina dhoksuuf itti hin fayyadaminaa; garuu akka tajaajiltoota Waaqaatti jiraadhaa.
english: Live as free people, yet not using your freedom for a cloak of wickedness, but as bondservants of God.

kikuyu: Nama hunda kabajaa; obbolummaa amantootaa jaalladhaa; Waaqa sodaadhaa; mootiifis ulfina kennaa.
english: Honor all men. Love the brotherhood. Fear God. Honor the king.

kikuyu: Yaa garboota, isinis gooftota keessan warra gaarii fi toloota qofa utuu hin taʼin warra jalʼootas sodaa hundaan jalatti bulaa.
english: Servants, be in subjection to your masters with all respect, not only to the good and gentle, but also to the wicked.

kikuyu: Namni tokko yoo Waaqaaf jedhee dhiphina dabaan isatti dhufe obse galata qaba.
english: For it is commendable if someone endures pain, suffering unjustly, because of conscience toward God.

kikuyu: Isin yoo sababii balleessaa hojjettaniif dhaanamtanii obsitan galata maalii argattu? Garuu yoo sababii waan qajeelaa hojjettaniif dhiphattanii obsitan kun fuula Waaqaa duratti galata qaba.
english: For what glory is it if, when you sin, you patiently endure beating? But if when you do well, you patiently endure suffering, this is commendable with God.

kikuyu: Wanni isin waamamtaniifis kanuma. Kiristoos akka isin faana isaa duukaa buutaniif jedhee isiniif dhiphachuudhaan fakkeenya isinii kenneeraatii.
english: For you were called to this, because Christ also suffered for us, leaving you an example, that you should follow his steps,

kikuyu: “Inni cubbuu hin hojjenne; sobni afaan isaatii hin baane.”
english: who didn’t sin, “neither was deceit found in his mouth.”

kikuyu: Yeroo isaan isa arrabsanitti inni isaan hin arrabsine; yeroo dhiphatettis nama hin doorsifne. Garuu isa qajeelummaan muru sanatti imaanaa of kenne.
english: When he was cursed, he didn’t curse back. When he suffered, he didn’t threaten, but committed himself to him who judges righteously.

kikuyu: Inni mataan isaa akka nu cubbuuf duunee qajeelummaaf immoo jiraannuuf jedhee dhagna isaatiin cubbuu keenya fannoo irratti baate; isinis madaa isaatiin fayyitaniirtu.
english: He himself bore our sins in his body on the tree, that we, having died to sins, might live to righteousness. You were healed by his wounds.

kikuyu: Isin dur akkuma hoolota karaa irraa badanii turtan; amma garuu gara Tiksee fi Phaaphaasii lubbuu keessaniitti deebitaniirtu.
english: For you were going astray like sheep; but now you have returned to the Shepherd and Overseer of your souls.

kikuyu: Yaa niitota, yoo dhirsoonni dubbicha hin amanne tokko tokko jiraatan akka isaan dubbii tokko malee amaluma niitota isaaniitiin boojiʼamaniif isinis akkasuma dhirsoota keessaniif ajajamaa;
english: In the same way, wives, be in subjection to your own husbands, so that, even if any don’t obey the Word, they may be won by the behavior of their wives without a word,

kikuyu: isaanis yommuu qulqullinaa fi sodaa isin jireenya keessan keessatti qabdan arganitti ni boojiʼamu.
english: seeing your pure behavior in fear.

kikuyu: Miidhaginni keessan faaya alaan mulʼatuun jechuunis shurrubbaa dhaʼachuu, warqee kaaʼachuu fi uffata bareedaa uffachuun hin taʼin;
english: Let your beauty come not from the outward adorning of braiding your hair, and of wearing gold ornaments or of putting on fine clothing,

kikuyu: qooda kanaa miidhaginni keessan miidhagina keessa namummaa keessanii haa taʼu; innis miidhagina hafuura garraamii fi tasgabbaaʼaa, kan hin badne, kan fuula Waaqaa duratti gatii guddaa qabu haa taʼu.
english: but from the hidden person of the heart, in the incorruptible adornment of a gentle and quiet spirit, which is very precious in God’s sight.

kikuyu: Dubartoonni qulqulloonni durii warri Waaqa abdatanis akkasuma dhirsoota isaaniitiif ajajamuudhaan of miidhagsan;
english: For this is how in the past the holy women who hoped in God also adorned themselves, being in subjection to their own husbands.

kikuyu: Saaraanis Abrahaamiin “Gooftaa” jettee waamaa isaaf ajajamaa turte. Isinis yoo waan qajeelaa hojjettanii fi sodaachuu baattan intallan ishee ti.
english: So Sarah obeyed Abraham, calling him lord, whose children you now are if you do well and are not put in fear by any terror.

kikuyu: Yaa dhirsoota, isinis akkasuma akka isaan dadhaboo taʼan hubadhaatii ulfina isaaniif kennuudhaan niitota keessan wajjin jiraadhaa; kanas sababii isaanis isin wajjin ayyaana jireenyaa dhaalaniif akka wanni tokko iyyuu kadhaa keessan hin gufachiifneef jedhaatii godhaa.
english: You husbands, in the same way, live with your wives according to knowledge, giving honor to the woman as to the weaker vessel, as also being joint heirs of the grace of life, that your prayers may not be hindered.

kikuyu: Dhuma irratti hundi keessan yaada tokko qabaadhaa; walii naʼaa; akka obbolootaatti wal jaalladhaa; garaa laafotaa fi warra gad of qabanis taʼaa.
english: Finally, all of you be like-minded, compassionate, loving as brothers, tenderhearted, courteous,

kikuyu: Hamaa, hamaadhaan hin deebisinaa; yookaan arrabsoo, arrabsoodhaan hin deebisinaa; qooda kanaa eebbisaa. Isinis akka eebba dhaaltaniif kanumaaf waamamtaniitii.
english: not rendering evil for evil or insult for insult; but instead blessing, knowing that you were called to this, that you may inherit a blessing.

kikuyu: “Namni jireenya jaallatu, kan bara gaariis arguu hawwu kam iyyuu, arraba isaa hammina irraa, hidhii isaa immoo soba dubbachuu irraa haa eeggatu.
english: For, “He who would love life and see good days, let him keep his tongue from evil and his lips from speaking deceit.

kikuyu: Inni hammina irraa deebiʼee gaarii haa hojjetu; nagaa haa barbaadu; duukaa haa buʼus.
english: Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

kikuyu: Iji Gooftaa qajeeltota irra jiraatii; gurri isaas kadhata isaaniitiif banamaa dha; garuu fuulli Gooftaa warra hamaa hojjetanitti ni hammaata.”
english: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous, and his ears open to their prayer; but the face of the Lord is against those who do evil.”

kikuyu: Isin gaarii hojjechuuf yoo hinaaftan, eenyutu isin miidha?
english: Now who will harm you if you become imitators of that which is good?

kikuyu: Garuu yoo qajeelummaaf jettanii dhiphattan isin eebbifamoo dha. “Sodaachisuu isaanii hin sodaatinaa; hin jeeqaminaas.”
english: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”

kikuyu: Garuu garaa keessan keessatti Kiristoos Gooftichaaf ulfina guddaa kennaa. Nama sababii abdii isin qabdan sanaa isin gaafatu kamiif iyyuu deebii kennuuf yeroo hunda qophaaʼaa. Waan kana immoo garraamummaa fi sodaan godhaa;
english: But sanctify the Lord God in your hearts. Always be ready to give an answer to everyone who asks you a reason concerning the hope that is in you, with humility and fear,

kikuyu: isinis yommuu namoonni waaʼee keessan waan hamaa dubbatanitti akka warri amala gaarii isin Kiristoos keessatti qabdan sana arrabsan qaanaʼaniif yaada gaarii qabaadhaa.
english: having a good conscience. Thus, while you are spoken against as evildoers, they may be disappointed who curse your good way of life in Christ.

kikuyu: Dhiphachuun keessan fedhii Waaqaa yoo taʼe, hamaa hojjettanii dhiphachuu irra gaarii hojjettanii dhiphachuu wayya.
english: For it is better, if it is God’s will, that you suffer for doing what is right than for doing evil.

kikuyu: Kiristoosis Waaqatti isin fiduuf jedhee inni qajeelaan, warra qajeeltota hin taʼiniif siʼa tokko cubbuuf dhiphateeraatii. Inni fooniin ni ajjeefame; Hafuuraan garuu jiraataa taasifame;
english: Because Christ also suffered for sins once, the righteous for the unrighteous, that he might bring you to God, being put to death in the flesh, but made alive in the Spirit,

kikuyu: erga jiraataa taasifamee immoo dhaqee hafuurota mana hidhaa jiranitti lallabe;
english: in whom he also went and preached to the spirits in prison,

kikuyu: isaanis bara Nohi keessa utuu dooniin ijaaramaa jiruu, yeroo Waaqni obsaan eegetti warra hin ajajaminii dha. Doonii kanaanis nama muraasa, walumatti nama saddeeti qofatu badiisa bishaanii jalaa baʼe;
english: who before were disobedient when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ship was being built. In it, few, that is, eight souls, were saved through water.

kikuyu: bishaan kun fakkeenya cuuphaa amma iyyuu isin fayyisuu ti; kunis dhagna irraa xurii baasuu utuu hin taʼin qalbii qulqulluun Waaqaaf waadaa galuu dha. Innis duʼaa kaʼuu Yesuus Kiristoosiin isin fayyisa;
english: This is a symbol of baptism, which now saves you—not the putting away of the filth of the flesh, but the answer of a good conscience toward God—through the resurrection of Jesus Christ,

kikuyu: Kiristoos samiitti ol baʼee mirga Waaqaa jira; ergamoonni Waaqaa, aangoowwanii fi humnoonni hundinuu isa jalatti bulu.
english: who is at the right hand of God, having gone into heaven, angels and authorities and powers being made subject to him.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu waan Kiristoos foon isaatiin dhiphateef isinis yaaduma akkasiitiin hidhadhaa; sababiin isaas inni fooniin dhiphate cubbuu dhiiseera.
english: Therefore, since Christ suffered for us in the flesh, arm yourselves also with the same mind; for he who has suffered in the flesh has ceased from sin,

kikuyu: Kanaafuu inni bara jireenya isaa kan foonii isa hafe sana akka fedhii Waaqaatti jiraata malee akka hawwii namaatti hin jiraatu.
english: that you no longer should live the rest of your time in the flesh for the lusts of men, but for the will of God.

kikuyu: Yeroon isin duraan waan ormoonni hojjechuu jaallatan sana jechuunis jireenya gad dhiisii irratti, hawwii foonii irratti, machii irratti, addaggummaa irratti, gar malee dhuguu fi waaqeffannaa waaqota tolfamoo kan jibbisiisaa taʼe irratti balleessitan sun haa gaʼu.
english: For we have spent enough of our past time doing the desire of the Gentiles, and having walked in lewdness, lusts, drunken binges, orgies, carousings, and abominable idolatries.

kikuyu: Isaanis sababii isin gara jireenya gad dhiisii akkasiitti isaan wajjin hin fiigneef ni dinqisiifatu; isin arrabsus.
english: They think it is strange that you don’t run with them into the same excess of riot, speaking evil of you.

kikuyu: Garuu isaan Waaqa warra jiranii fi warra duʼanitti muruuf qophaaʼe sana duratti deebii ni kennu.
english: They will give account to him who is ready to judge the living and the dead.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu karaa fooniitiin akkuma namaatti akka isaanitti muramuuf, karaa hafuuraatiin immoo akka Waaqaatti akka jiraataniif wangeelli warra duʼanii jiranitti iyyuu lallabameera.
english: For to this end the Good News was preached even to the dead, that they might be judged indeed as men in the flesh, but live as to God in the spirit.

kikuyu: Dhumni waan hundaa dhiʼaateera. Kanaaf akka Waaqa kadhachuu dandeessaniif dammaqaa; warra of qabanis taʼaa.
english: But the end of all things is near. Therefore be of sound mind, self-controlled, and sober in prayer.

kikuyu: Waan hunda caalaatti jaalala hoʼaa waliif qabaadhaa; jaalalli cubbuu baayʼee dhoksaatii.
english: And above all things be earnest in your love among yourselves, for love covers a multitude of sins.

kikuyu: Guungummii malee wal keessumsiisaa.
english: Be hospitable to one another without grumbling.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon namaa kennaa warra kaan tajaajiluuf argate kam iyyuu akkuma abbaa imaanaa amanamaa kan ayyaana Waaqaa bifa garaa gaaraatiin jiru sanaa tokkootti itti fayyadamuu qaba.
english: As each has received a gift, employ it in serving one another, as good managers of the grace of God in its various forms.

kikuyu: Namni dubbatu kam iyyuu akka nama dubbii Waaqaa dubbatuutti haa dubbatu. Namni tajaajilu kam iyyuu akka Waaqni waan hunda keessatti karaa Yesuus Kiristoosiin galateeffamuuf jedhee jabina Waaqni isaaf kenneen haa tajaajilu. Ulfinnii fi humni bara baraa hamma bara baraatti isaaf haa taʼu. Ameen.
english: If anyone speaks, let it be as it were the very words of God. If anyone serves, let it be as of the strength which God supplies, that in all things God may be glorified through Jesus Christ, to whom belong the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Yaa michoota jaallatamoo, qorama akka ibiddaa kan amma ittiin dhiphachaa jirtan kana akka waan wanni haaraan isinitti dhufeetti hin dinqisiifatinaa.
english: Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened to you.

kikuyu: Garuu isin yeroo ulfinni isaa mulʼatutti akka baayʼee gammaddaniif waan dhiphina Kiristoos keessatti qooda fudhattaniif gammadaa.
english: But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice with exceeding joy.

kikuyu: Yoo maqaa Kiristoosiitiif jettanii arrabsamtan isin eebbifamoo dha; Hafuurri ulfinaatii fi Hafuurri Waaqaa isin irra boqotaatii.
english: If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed, because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On their part he is blasphemed, but on your part he is glorified.

kikuyu: Isin keessaa namni kam iyyuu akka nama nama ajjeesuutti yookaan akka hattuutti yookaan akka nama yakka hojjetuutti yookaan akka nama dubbii namaa keessa seenuutti hin dhiphatin.
english: But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or a thief, or an evil doer, or a meddler in other men’s matters.

kikuyu: Garuu namni tokko yoo sababii Kiristaana taʼeef dhiphate maqaa sanaan Waaqa haa galateeffatu malee hin qaanaʼin.
english: But if one of you suffers for being a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God in this matter.

kikuyu: Yeroon itti murtiin mana Waaqaatii jalqabu dhiʼaateeraatii; murtiin kun yoo nurratti jalqaba taʼe dhumni warra wangeela Waaqaatiif hin ajajamnee akkam haa taʼu ree?
english: For the time has come for judgment to begin with the household of God. If it begins first with us, what will happen to those who don’t obey the Good News of God?

kikuyu: “Erga qajeeltonni fayyuun rakkisaa taʼe, namni Waaqatti hin bullee fi cubbamaan maal haa taʼu ree?”
english: “If it is hard for the righteous to be saved, what will happen to the ungodly and the sinner?”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu warri akka fedhii Waaqaatti dhiphatan lubbuu isaanii Uumaa isaanii amanamaa sanatti imaanaa kennatanii waan gaarii hojjechuutti haa fufan.
english: Therefore let them also who suffer according to the will of God in doing good entrust their souls to him, as to a faithful Creator.

kikuyu: Ani akka maanguddoo akkuma isaanii tokkootti, akka dhuga baatuu dhiphina Kiristoosii fi akka nama ulfina mulʼachuuf jiru sana keessatti qooda qabu tokkootti akkana jedhee maanguddoota isin gidduu jiran sana nan gorsa;
english: Therefore I exhort the elders among you, as a fellow elder and a witness of the sufferings of Christ, and who will also share in the glory that will be revealed:

kikuyu: karra hoolotaa Waaqaa kan tika keessan jala jiru eeguudhaan tiksoota taʼaa; kanas sababii dirqamtaniif utuu hin taʼin fedhiidhuma keessaniin akka Waaqni akka isin taatan barbaadutti, buʼaa nama qaanessu argachuuf utuu hin taʼin hawwii guddaa tajaajilaaf qabdaniin godhaa;
english: shepherd the flock of God which is among you, exercising the oversight, not under compulsion, but voluntarily; not for dishonest gain, but willingly;

kikuyu: karra hoolotaatiif fakkeenya taʼaa malee warra imaanaa isinitti kennaman sana humnaan hin bulchinaa.
english: not as lording it over those entrusted to you, but making yourselves examples to the flock.

kikuyu: Isinis yommuu hangafni tiksootaa mulʼatutti gonfoo ulfinaa kan miidhaginni isaa irraa hin badne argattu.
english: When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.

kikuyu: Yaa dargaggoota, isinis akkasuma maanguddoota jalatti bulaa. Hundi keessanis tokkoo tokkoo keessaniif gad of qabiisa akka wayyaatti uffadhaa; “Waaqni of tuultotaan ni morma; warra gad of qabaniif immoo ayyaana kennaatii.”
english: Likewise, you younger ones, be subject to the elder. Yes, all of you clothe yourselves with humility and subject yourselves to one another; for “God resists the proud, but gives grace to the humble.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu akka Waaqni yeroo malutti ol isin qabuuf, harka isaa humna qabeessa sana jalatti gad of qabaa.
english: Humble yourselves therefore under the mighty hand of God, that he may exalt you in due time,

kikuyu: Inni isiniif waan yaaduuf, yaaddoo keessan hunda isa irra kaaʼadhaa.
english: casting all your worries on him, because he cares for you.

kikuyu: Warra of qaban taʼa; dammaqaas. Diiyaabiloos diinni keessan nama liqimsu barbaadee akkuma leenca aaduu nanaannaʼaatii.
english: Be sober and self-controlled. Be watchful. Your adversary, the devil, walks around like a roaring lion, seeking whom he may devour.

kikuyu: Sababii akka obboloonni keessan warri addunyaa guutuu keessa jiraatan dhiphina akkasii dhiphachaa jiran beektaniif amantiitti jabaadhaatii isaan mormaa.
english: Withstand him steadfast in your faith, knowing that your brothers who are in the world are undergoing the same sufferings.

kikuyu: Waaqni ayyaana hundaa karaa Kiristoosiin gara ulfina isaa kan bara baraatti isin waame sun erga isin yeroo gabaabaaf dhiphattanii booddee inni mataan isaa guutuu isin taasisa; isin dhaaba; isin jabeessas.
english: But may the God of all grace, who called you to his eternal glory by Christ Jesus, after you have suffered a little while, perfect, establish, strengthen, and settle you.

kikuyu: Bara baraa hamma bara baraatti humni isaaf haa taʼu. Ameen.
english: To him be the glory and the power forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: Anis isin jajjabeessuudhaaf, akka wanni kun ayyaana Waaqaa isa dhugaa taʼe sana dhugaa baʼuuf harka Silwaanos isa ani akka obboleessa amanamaatti hedu sanaatiin gabaabumatti barreessee isinii ergeera. Ayyaana kanaan jabaadhaa dhaabadhaa.
english: Through Silvanus, our faithful brother, as I consider him, I have written to you briefly, exhorting and testifying that this is the true grace of God in which you stand.

kikuyu: Waldaan kiristaanaa isheen isin wajjin filatamtee Baabilon keessa jirtu sun nagaa isinii dhaamti; ilmi koo Maarqosis akkasuma nagaa isinii dhaama.
english: She who is in Babylon, chosen together with you, greets you. So does Mark, my son.

kikuyu: Dhungoo jaalalaatiin nagaa wal gaafadhaa. Isin warra kan Kiristoos taatan hundaaf nagaan haa taʼu.
english: Greet one another with a kiss of love. Peace be to all of you who are in Christ Jesus. Amen.

kikuyu: Simoon Phexros garbichaa fi ergamaa Yesuus Kiristoos irraa,
english: Simon Peter, a servant and apostle of Jesus Christ, to those who have obtained a like precious faith with us in the righteousness of our God and Savior, Jesus Christ:

kikuyu: Beekumsa Waaqaatii fi beekumsa Gooftaa keenya Yesuusiin ayyaannii fi nagaan isiniif haa baayʼatu.
english: Grace to you and peace be multiplied in the knowledge of God and of Jesus our Lord,

kikuyu: Humni waaqummaa isaa karaa isa ulfina isaatii fi gaarummaa isaatiin nu waame sana beekuu keenyaatiin waan jireenyaa fi Waaqatti buluuf nu barbaachisu hundumaa nuuf kenneera.
english: seeing that his divine power has granted to us all things that pertain to life and godliness, through the knowledge of him who called us by his own glory and virtue,

kikuyu: Kennaa kanaanis isin badiisa sababii hawwii hamaatiin addunyaa keessa jiru jalaa baatanii akka amala waaqummaa isaa sana keessatti hirmaattaniif jedhee karaa kennaa kanaatiin waadaa isaa guddaa fi kan gatii guddaa qabu nuuf galeera.
english: by which he has granted to us his precious and exceedingly great promises; that through these you may become partakers of the divine nature, having escaped from the corruption that is in the world by lust.

kikuyu: Sababuma kanaaf amantii keessan irratti gaarummaa, gaarummaa irrattis beekumsa dabalachuuf waan isinii dandaʼame hunda godhaa;
english: Yes, and for this very cause adding on your part all diligence, in your faith supply moral excellence; and in moral excellence, knowledge;

kikuyu: akkasuma beekumsa irratti of qabuu, of qabuu irratti obsaan dhaabachuu, obsaan dhaabachuu irratti Waaqatti buluu,
english: and in knowledge, self-control; and in self-control, perseverance; and in perseverance, godliness;

kikuyu: Waaqatti buluu irratti jaalala obbolummaa, jaalala obbolummaa irratti immoo jaalala dhugaa dabaladhaa.
english: and in godliness, brotherly affection; and in brotherly affection, love.

kikuyu: Yoo isin waan kana hunda qabaattanii ittuma isinii baayʼachaa deeme, wanni kun akka isin Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos beekuu keessatti dadhaboo fi buʼaa dhabeeyyii hin taane isin godha.
english: For if these things are yours and abound, they make you to not be idle or unfruitful in the knowledge of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Garuu namni waan kana hin qabne kam iyyuu jaamaa dha; fagoottis arguu hin dandaʼu; cubbuu isaa durii sana irraa qulqulleeffamuu isaa irraanfateera.
english: For he who lacks these things is blind, seeing only what is near, having forgotten the cleansing from his old sins.

kikuyu: Kanaaf yaa obboloota ko, waamamuu fi filatamuu keessan mirkaneeffachuuf caalaatti hinaaffaa qabaadhaa. Yoo waan kana gootan isin hin gufattan;
english: Therefore, brothers, be more diligent to make your calling and election sure. For if you do these things, you will never stumble.

kikuyu: akkasiin gara mootummaa bara baraa kan Gooftaa keenyaa fi Fayyisaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoositti galuun guutummaatti isiniif kennama.
english: For thus you will be richly supplied with the entrance into the eternal Kingdom of our Lord and Savior, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu isin wantoota kanneen beektanii, dhugaa amma qabdan kanatti jabaatanii dhaabattanii iyyuu ani yeroo hunda wantoota kanneen isin yaadachiisuu nan barbaada.
english: Therefore I will not be negligent to remind you of these things, though you know them and are established in the present truth.

kikuyu: Ani hamman dunkaana kana keessa jirutti waan kana isin yaadachiisuudhaan isin dammaqsuu koo qajeelaa nan seʼa;
english: I think it right, as long as I am in this tent, to stir you up by reminding you,

kikuyu: ani akka Gooftaan keenya Yesuus Kiristoos naaf ibsetti, dunkaana koo kana akkan dafee of irraa baasu beekaatii.
english: knowing that the putting off of my tent comes swiftly, even as our Lord Jesus Christ made clear to me.

kikuyu: Ani akka isin erguma ani isin biraa godaanee booddee yeroo hunda waan kana yaadachuu dandeessan gochuuf nan carraaqa.
english: Yes, I will make every effort that you may always be able to remember these things even after my departure.

kikuyu: Nu yommuu waaʼee humnaa fi dhufaatii Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos isinitti himnetti, surraa isaa ijuma keenyaan argineeti malee oduu haxxummaadhaan uumame duukaa buunee miti.
english: For we didn’t follow cunningly devised fables when we made known to you the power and coming of our Lord Jesus Christ, but we were eyewitnesses of his majesty.

kikuyu: Innis yommuu sagaleen, “Kun Ilma koo isa ani jaalladhuu dha; ani isatti baayʼee nan gammada” jedhu sun Ulfina Surra qabeessa sana biraa dhufeefitti, Waaqa Abbaa biraa kabajaa fi ulfina argateeraatii.
english: For he received from God the Father honor and glory when the voice came to him from the Majestic Glory, “This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased.”

kikuyu: Nu mataan keenya iyyuu yeroo isa wajjin tulluu qulqulluu irra turretti, utuu sagaleen kun samii irraa dhufuu dhageenye.
english: We heard this voice come out of heaven when we were with him on the holy mountain.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu dubbiin raajonni dubbatan sun ittuma caalee nuuf mirkaneeffame; isinis hamma boruun baqaqee bakkalchi barii garaa keessan keessatti baʼutti yoo akkuma ibsaa dukkana keessatti ibsuutti dubbii kanaaf xiyyeeffannoo kennitan waan gaarii gochuu keessan.
english: We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until the day dawns and the morning star arises in your hearts,

kikuyu: Raajiin Katabbii Qulqulluu kam iyyuu hiikkaa raajichaa kan mataa isaatiin akka hin dhufin duraan dursitanii beekuu qabdu.
english: knowing this first, that no prophecy of Scripture is of private interpretation.

kikuyu: Raajiin takkumaa fedhii namaatiin hin dhufneetii; garuu namoota Waaqaatu Hafuura Qulqulluudhaan geggeeffamee dubbate.
english: For no prophecy ever came by the will of man, but holy men of God spoke, being moved by the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Akkuma raajonni sobduun saba gidduu turan sana, barsiistonni sobduun isin gidduu ni jiraatu. Isaan Goofticha isaan fure sana gananii, barsiisa sobaa kan nama balleessu dhoksanii galchu; kanaanis badiisa ariifatu ofitti fidu.
english: But false prophets also arose among the people, as false teachers will also be among you, who will secretly bring in destructive heresies, denying even the Master who bought them, bringing on themselves swift destruction.

kikuyu: Namoonni baayʼeenis amala isaanii isa qaanessaa sana duukaa buʼu; sababii isaaniitiinis karaan dhugaa ni arrabsama.
english: Many will follow their immoral ways, and as a result, the way of the truth will be maligned.

kikuyu: Barsiistonni kunneen doqnummaa isaaniitiin oduu ofumaan uumanii odeessaniin isin qisaasu. Murtiin bara dheeraan dura isaanitti murame sun amma illee hojjechaa jira; badiisni isaaniis hin mugu.
english: In covetousness they will exploit you with deceptive words: whose sentence now from of old doesn’t linger, and their destruction will not slumber.

kikuyu: Waaqni yeroo ergamoonni cubbuu hojjetanitti utuu isaanii hin hilin akka isaan guyyaa murtiitiif turfamaniif foncaadhaan dukkana keessatti hidhee gahaannamitti erga isaan darbatee,
english: For if God didn’t spare angels when they sinned, but cast them down to Tartarus, and committed them to pits of darkness to be reserved for judgment;

kikuyu: utuu addunyaa duriitiif hin hilin Nohi isa qajeelummaa lallabu namoota biraa torba wajjin oolchee warra Waaqatti hin bulletti bishaan badiisaa erga fidee,
english: and didn’t spare the ancient world, but preserved Noah with seven others, a preacher of righteousness, when he brought a flood on the world of the ungodly,

kikuyu: magaalaawwan Sodoomii fi Gomoraas hamma isaan daaraa taʼanitti gubuudhaan itti muree, fakkeenya waan warra Waaqaaf hin bulletti dhufuuf jiruu erga isaan godhee,
english: and turning the cities of Sodom and Gomorrah into ashes, condemned them to destruction, having made them an example to those who would live in an ungodly way,

kikuyu: namicha qajeelaa jechuunis Looxi isa jireenya xuraaʼaa finciltootaatiin dhiphachaa ture sana erga badiisa oolchee,
english: and delivered righteous Lot, who was very distressed by the lustful life of the wicked

kikuyu: namichi qajeelaan sun yeroo gidduu isaanii jiraachaa turetti guyyuma guyyaan fincila isaanii sana arguu fi dhagaʼuudhaan lubbuun isaa qajeeltuun sun isa keessatti dhiphachaa turtee,
english: (for that righteous man dwelling among them was tormented in his righteous soul from day to day with seeing and hearing lawless deeds),

kikuyu: wanni kun akkas taʼee Gooftaan akkamitti akka warra Waaqaaf bulan qorumsa keessaa baasuu fi akka itti warra jalʼaa hamma guyyaa murtiitti adabbiif tursu beeka.
english: then the Lord knows how to deliver the godly out of temptation and to keep the unrighteous under punishment for the day of judgment,

kikuyu: Wanni kun keessumattuu warra hawwii foonii xuraaʼaa sana duukaa buʼanii fi warra abbootii taayitaa tuffatanitti ni cima. Namoonni kunneen ija jabeeyyii fi of tuultota; isaan ulfina qabeeyyii samii arrabsuu hin sodaatan;
english: but chiefly those who walk after the flesh in the lust of defilement and despise authority. Daring, self-willed, they are not afraid to speak evil of dignitaries,

kikuyu: ergamoonni iyyuu yoo isaan caalaa jajjaboo fi humna qabeeyyii taʼan iyyuu fuula Gooftaa duratti uumamawwan akkasii arrabsanii hin himatan.
english: whereas angels, though greater in might and power, don’t bring a slanderous judgment against them before the Lord.

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen garuu waanuma hin hubanne arrabsu. Isaan akkuma bineensota qalbii hin qabnee ti; akkuma uumamawwan miira isaaniitiin qajeelfaman kanneen qabamuu fi ajjeefamuu qofaaf dhalatanii ti; akkuma bineensonni sun badanitti jarris ni badu.
english: But these, as unreasoning creatures, born natural animals to be taken and destroyed, speaking evil in matters about which they are ignorant, will in their destroying surely be destroyed,

kikuyu: Miidhaa isaan hojjetaniif miidhaatu deebiʼaaf. Isaan guyyaa adiidhaan gara malee machaaʼuu akka gammachuutti fudhatu. Yeroo isin wajjin nyaataa fi dhugaatiitti dhiʼaatanittis isaan gowwoomsaa isaaniitiin gidduu keessanitti xurii fi waan fafaa taʼu.
english: receiving the wages of unrighteousness; people who count it pleasure to revel in the daytime, spots and defects, reveling in their deceit while they feast with you;

kikuyu: Waan iji isaanii ejjaan guutameef isaan cubbuu hojjechuu hin dhiisan; warra hin jabaatin gowwoomsu; garaan isaanii doqnummaa barateera; isaan ijoollee abaaramanii dha!
english: having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin, enticing unsettled souls, having a heart trained in greed, accursed children!

kikuyu: Karaa qajeelaa dhiisanii karaa Balaʼaam ilma Bosoor isa gatii jalʼinaa jaallate sanaa duukaa buʼuuf karaa irraa badan.
english: Forsaking the right way, they went astray, having followed the way of Balaam the son of Beor, who loved the wages of wrongdoing;

kikuyu: Balaʼaam garuu sababii dogoggora isaatiif harreen isa ifatte; horiin duudaan afaan namaa dubbattee maraatummaa raajii sanaa ittifte.
english: but he was rebuked for his own disobedience. A speechless donkey spoke with a man’s voice and stopped the madness of the prophet.

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen burqaa bishaan hin qabnee fi hurrii bubbeen oofamuu dha. Dukkanni limixiin isaaniif kaaʼameera.
english: These are wells without water, clouds driven by a storm, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

kikuyu: Isaan dubbii faayidaa hin qabnee fi dubbii of tuulummaa odeessu; warra namoota jireenya dogoggoraa keessa jiraatan keessaa baqatanii baʼan hawwii foonii hamaadhaan gowwoomsu.
english: For, uttering great swelling words of emptiness, they entice in the lusts of the flesh, by licentiousness, those who are indeed escaping from those who live in error;

kikuyu: Isaan utuma ofii isaaniitii iyyuu garboota badiisaa taʼanii jiranuu birmadummaa isaan abdachiisu; namni tokko waan isa moʼate kamiifuu ni garboomaatii.
english: promising them liberty, while they themselves are bondservants of corruption; for a man is brought into bondage by whoever overcomes him.

kikuyu: Isaan erga Gooftaa keenyaa fi Fayyisaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos beekuudhaan xuraaʼummaa addunyaa keessaa baʼanii booddee yoo amma illee deebiʼanii xuraaʼummaa sanaan qabamanii fudhataman haalli isaanii kan dhumaa isa jalqabaa sana caalaa hammaata.
english: For if, after they have escaped the defilement of the world through the knowledge of the Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, they are again entangled in it and overcome, the last state has become worse for them than the first.

kikuyu: Isaan karaa qajeelinaa beekanii ajaja qulqulluu isaanii kenname sanatti dugda galuu irra utuu duraanuu karaa qajeelinaa sana beekuu baatanii isaaniif wayya ture.
english: For it would be better for them not to have known the way of righteousness, than after knowing it, to turn back from the holy commandment delivered to them.

kikuyu: Mammaaksi, “Sareen diddiga isheetti deebiti” akkasumas, “Booyyeen dhiqamte dhoqqee keessa gangalachuu isheetti deebiti” jedhu sun isaan irratti mirkaneeffame.
english: But it has happened to them according to the true proverb, “The dog turns to his own vomit again,” and “the sow that has washed to wallowing in the mire.”

kikuyu: Yaa michoota jaallatamoo, ani amma xalayaa lammaffaa isiniif barreessuu koo ti. Lamaan isaanii iyyuu keessatti isin yaadachiisuudhaan qalbii keessan qulqulluu sana nan kakaasa.
english: This is now, beloved, the second letter that I have written to you; and in both of them I stir up your sincere mind by reminding you

kikuyu: Isin dubbii dur raajota qulqulluudhaan dubbatamee fi ajaja Gooftaa keenyaa fi Fayyisaa keenyaa kan karaa ergamoota keessaniitiin dubbatame sana akka yaadattan nan barbaada.
english: that you should remember the words which were spoken before by the holy prophets and the commandment of us, the apostles of the Lord and Savior,

kikuyu: Akka bara dhumaa keessa gaʼistoonni gaʼisaa hawwii hamaa kan ofii isaanii duukaa buʼaa dhufan duraan dursaatii beekaa.
english: knowing this first, that in the last days mockers will come, walking after their own lusts

kikuyu: Isaanis, “ ‘dhufaatiin’ inni waadaa gale kun meerre? Wanni hundinuu erga abbootiin keenya duʼanii jalqabee akkuma yeroo jalqaba uumamaatti itti fufeeraatii” jedhu.
english: and saying, “Where is the promise of his coming? For, from the day that the fathers fell asleep, all things continue as they were from the beginning of the creation.”

kikuyu: Garuu isaan akka samiiwwan bara baayʼeen dura dubbii Waaqaatiin uumaman, akka laftis bishaan irraa fi bishaaniin tolfamte utuma beekanuu didan.
english: For they willfully forget that there were heavens from of old, and an earth formed out of water and amid water by the word of God,

kikuyu: Addunyaan yeroo sanaas bishaanuma kanaan liqimfamee bade.
english: by which means the world that existed then, being overflowed with water, perished.

kikuyu: Dubbiidhuma kanaanis samiiwwanii fi lafti yeroo ammaa jiran kunneen guyyaa murtii, kan badiisa namoota Waaqaaf hin bulleetiif kaaʼamanii ibiddaaf turfamaniiru.
english: But the heavens that exist now and the earth, by the same word have been stored up for fire, being reserved against the day of judgment and destruction of ungodly men.

kikuyu: Yaa michoota jaallatamoo, isin garuu waan tokkicha kana hin irraanfatinaa. Gooftaa biratti guyyaan tokko akka waggaa kumaa, waggaan kumnis akka guyyaa tokkoo ti.
english: But don’t forget this one thing, beloved, that one day is with the Lord as a thousand years, and a thousand years as one day.

kikuyu: Gooftaan akka namoonni tokko tokko lafa irra harkifata jedhanii yaadan sana, waadaa isaa guutuu irratti lafa irra hin harkifatu. Inni akka namni hundinuu qalbii jijjiirrachuuf jedhee isinii obsa malee akka namni tokko iyyuu badu barbaadee miti.
english: The Lord is not slow concerning his promise, as some count slowness; but he is patient with us, not wishing that anyone should perish, but that all should come to repentance.

kikuyu: Guyyaan Gooftaa garuu akkuma hattuutti dhufa. Samiiwwan sagalee guddaadhaan dhabamu; wanni samiiwwan keessa jiru hundinuus hoʼa guddaadhaan baqa; laftii fi wanni ishee irra jiru hundinuus ni gubata.
english: But the day of the Lord will come as a thief in the night, in which the heavens will pass away with a great noise, and the elements will be dissolved with fervent heat; and the earth and the works that are in it will be burned up.

kikuyu: Wanni hundinuu akkasitti bada erga taʼee, isin nama akkamii taʼuu qabdu ree? Jireenya qulqulluu fi Waaqaaf bulu jiraachuu qabdu;
english: Therefore, since all these things will be destroyed like this, what kind of people ought you to be in holy living and godliness,

kikuyu: kanas guyyaa Waaqaa eeggachaa, dhufaatii isaas ariifachiisaa gochuu qabdu. Guyyaa sana samiiwwan ibiddaan badu; wanni samiiwwan keessa jirus hoʼaan baqa.
english: looking for and earnestly desiring the coming of the day of God, which will cause the burning heavens to be dissolved, and the elements will melt with fervent heat?

kikuyu: Nu garuu akkuma waadaa isaatti samiiwwan haaraa fi lafa haaraa qajeelinni keessa jiraatu eegganna.
english: But, according to his promise, we look for new heavens and a new earth, in which righteousness dwells.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu yaa michoota jaallatamoo, isinis sababii waanuma kana eeggataniif akka warra xurii fi hirʼina hin qabne, warra nagaan isa wajjin jiraatan taataniif yaalii isinii dandaʼame hunda godhaa.
english: Therefore, beloved, seeing that you look for these things, be diligent to be found in peace, without defect and blameless in his sight.

kikuyu: Akkuma Phaawulos obboleessi keenya jaallatamaan sun ogummaa Waaqni kenneefiin isinii barreesse sana akka obsi Gooftaa keenyaa fayyina taʼe yaadatti qabadhaa.
english: Regard the patience of our Lord as salvation; even as our beloved brother Paul also, according to the wisdom given to him, wrote to you,

kikuyu: Innis waaʼee waan kanaa dubbatee xalayoota isaa hunda keessatti haaluma kanaan barreessa. Xalayoota isaa keessas waan hubachuun nama rakkisu tokko tokkotu jira; wallaaltonnii fi warri jabaatanii hin dhaabanne akkuma Katabbiiwwan Qulqulluu kaan jalʼisan sana kanas badiidhuma ofii isaaniitiif ni jalʼisu.
english: as also in all of his letters, speaking in them of these things. In those, there are some things that are hard to understand, which the ignorant and unsettled twist, as they also do to the other Scriptures, to their own destruction.

kikuyu: Kanaaf yaa michoota jaallatamoo, isin sababii duraan dursitanii waan kana beektaniif akka dogoggora finciltootaatiin fudhatamnii hundee jabaattanii irra dhaabattan irraa hin kufneef of eeggadhaa.
english: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.

kikuyu: Garuu ayyaanaa fi beekumsa Gooftaa keenyaa fi Fayyisaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiin guddadhaa. Ammas, bara baraanis ulfinni isaaf haa taʼu! Ameen.
english: But grow in the grace and knowledge of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ. To him be the glory both now and forever. Amen.

kikuyu: Nu waaʼee Dubbii jireenyaa kan jalqabaa kaasee ture, kan dhageenye, kan ija keenyaan argine, kan ilaallee fi kan harki keenyas qaqqabe kana labsina.
english: That which was from the beginning, that which we have heard, that which we have seen with our eyes, that which we saw, and our hands touched, concerning the Word of life

kikuyu: Jireenyi mulʼateera; nus isa argineerra; dhugaas ni baanaaf; nu jireenya bara baraa isa Abbaa wajjin turee fi isa nutti mulʼate sana isinitti labsina.
english: (and the life was revealed, and we have seen, and testify, and declare to you the life, the eternal life, which was with the Father, and was revealed to us);

kikuyu: Akka isinis nu wajjin tokkummaa qabaattaniif waan arginee fi waan dhageenye isinitti labsina. Tokkummaan keenyas Abbaa fi Ilma isaa Yesuus Kiristoos wajjin.
english: that which we have seen and heard we declare to you, that you also may have fellowship with us. Yes, and our fellowship is with the Father and with his Son, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Nus akka gammachuun keenya guutuu taʼuuf waan kana barreessina.
english: And we write these things to you, that our joy may be fulfilled.

kikuyu: Ergaan nu isa irraa dhageenye, kan isinittis labsinu isa kana: Kunis akka Waaqni ifa taʼee fi akka dukkanni gonkumaa isa keessa hin jirree dha.
english: This is the message which we have heard from him and announce to you, that God is light, and in him is no darkness at all.

kikuyu: Nu isa wajjin tokkummaa qabna jennee yoo dukkana keessa deddeebine ni sobna; dhugaa sanaanis hin jiraannu.
english: If we say that we have fellowship with him and walk in the darkness, we lie and don’t tell the truth.

kikuyu: Garuu akkuma inni ifa keessa jiru sana, nus yoo ifa keessa deddeebine walii wajjin tokkummaa qabna; dhiigni Ilma isaa Yesuus cubbuu hundumaa irraa nu qulqulleessa.
english: But if we walk in the light as he is in the light, we have fellowship with one another, and the blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanses us from all sin.

kikuyu: Nu yoo cubbuu hin qabnu jenne of gowwoomsina; dhugaanis nu keessa hin jiru.
english: If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.

kikuyu: Yoo cubbuu keenya himanne, inni cubbuu keenya nuu dhiisuuf amanamaa fi qajeelaa dha; jalʼina hunda irraas nu qulqulleessa.
english: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and righteous to forgive us the sins and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness.

kikuyu: Nu yoo cubbuu hin hojjennee jenne immoo sobduu isa goona; dubbiin isaas nu keessa hin jiru.
english: If we say that we haven’t sinned, we make him a liar, and his word is not in us.

kikuyu: Yaa ijoollee ko, ani akka isin cubbuu hin hojjenneef kana isiniifan barreessa. Garuu yoo namni kam iyyuu cubbuu hojjete nu Abbaa biraa abukaattoo qabna; innis Yesuus Kiristoos Isa Qajeelaa sana.
english: My little children, I write these things to you so that you may not sin. If anyone sins, we have a Counselor with the Father, Jesus Christ, the righteous.

kikuyu: Inni aarsaa cubbuu keenyaaf araara buusuu dha; cubbuu addunyaa hundaatiifis malee cubbuu keenya qofaaf miti.
english: And he is the atoning sacrifice for our sins, and not for ours only, but also for the whole world.

kikuyu: Nu yoo ajaja isaa eegne, kanaan akka isa beekne ni beekna.
english: This is how we know that we know him: if we keep his commandments.

kikuyu: Namni, “Ani isa nan beeka” jedhu kan garuu ajaja isaa hin eegne kam iyyuu sobduu dha; dhugaanis isa keessa hin jiru.
english: One who says, “I know him,” and doesn’t keep his commandments, is a liar, and the truth isn’t in him.

kikuyu: Garuu yoo namni kam iyyuu dubbii isaatiif ajajame, jaalalli Waaqaa dhugumaan isa keessatti guutuu taʼa. Kanaanis nu akka isa keessa jirru ni beekna;
english: But God’s love has most certainly been perfected in whoever keeps his word. This is how we know that we are in him:

kikuyu: namni ani isaanan jiraadha ofiin jedhu kam iyyuu akkuma Yesuus jiraate sanatti jiraachuu qaba.
english: he who says he remains in him ought himself also to walk just like he walked.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota, ani ajaja moofaa isuma jalqabaa kaasee isin bira ture sana malee ajaja haaraa isinii hin barreessu. Ajajni moofaan kunis ergaadhuma isin dhageessan sana.
english: Brothers, I write no new commandment to you, but an old commandment which you had from the beginning. The old commandment is the word which you heard from the beginning.

kikuyu: Taʼus ani ajaja haaraa tokko isiniif nan barreessa; sababiin isaas dukkanichi darbaa, ifni dhugaa immoo waan amma iyyuu ifaa jiruuf dhugaan isaa isa keessattii fi isin keessatti ni mulʼata.
english: Again, I write a new commandment to you, which is true in him and in you, because the darkness is passing away and the true light already shines.

kikuyu: Namni ani ifa keessa jira ofiin jechaa obboleessa isaa immoo jibbu kam iyyuu amma illee dukkana keessa jira.
english: He who says he is in the light and hates his brother is in the darkness even until now.

kikuyu: Namni obboleessa isaa jaallatu hundinuu ifa keessa jiraata; wanni isa gufachiisu tokko iyyuu isa keessa hin jiru.
english: He who loves his brother remains in the light, and there is no occasion for stumbling in him.

kikuyu: Namni obboleessa isaa jibbu garuu dukkana keessa jira; dukkanuma keessa jiraatas; inni waan dukkanni sun isa jaamseef gara itti adeemu hin beeku.
english: But he who hates his brother is in the darkness, and walks in the darkness, and doesn’t know where he is going, because the darkness has blinded his eyes.

kikuyu: Yaa ijoolle, cubbuun keessan sababii maqaa isaatiif waan isinii dhiifameef ani isiniifin barreessa.
english: I write to you, little children, because your sins are forgiven you for his name’s sake.

kikuyu: Yaa abbootii, isin waan isa jalqabumaa kaasee jiru sana beektaniif ani isiniifin barreessa. Yaa dargaggoota, isin waan isa hamaa sana moʼattaniif, ani isiniifin barreessa.
english: I write to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I write to you, young men, because you have overcome the evil one. I write to you, little children, because you know the Father.

kikuyu: Yaa ijoolle, isin waan Abbaa beektaniif, ani isiniifin barreessa. Yaa abbootii, isin waan isa jalqabumaa kaasee jiru sana beektaniif, ani isiniifin barreessa. Yaa dargaggoota, isin waan jajjaboo taataniif, waan dubbiin Waaqaa isin keessa jiraatuuf, waan isa hamaa sanas moʼattaniif, ani isiniifin barreessa.
english: I have written to you, fathers, because you know him who is from the beginning. I have written to you, young men, because you are strong, and the word of God remains in you, and you have overcome the evil one.

kikuyu: Addunyaa yookaan waan addunyaa keessa jiru tokko illee hin jaallatinaa. Eenyu iyyuu yoo addunyaa jaallate, jaalalli Abbaa isa keessa hin jiru.
english: Don’t love the world or the things that are in the world. If anyone loves the world, the Father’s love isn’t in him.

kikuyu: Wanni addunyaa keessa jiru hundinuu jechuunis hawwiin foonii, hawwiin ijaa, akkasumas waan qabaniin kooruun kan addunyaati malee kan Abbaa miti.
english: For all that is in the world—the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life—isn’t the Father’s, but is the world’s.

kikuyu: Addunyaa fi hawwiin ishee ni badu; namni fedhii Waaqaa raawwatu garuu bara baraan jiraata.
english: The world is passing away with its lusts, but he who does God’s will remains forever.

kikuyu: Yaa ijoolle, saʼaatiin kun saʼaatii dhumaa ti; akka farri Kiristoos sun dhufu akkuma dhageessan sana ammuma iyyuu farroonni Kiristoos baayʼeen dhufaniiru. Kanaanis nu akka saʼaatiin kun saʼaatii dhumaa taʼe beekna.
english: Little children, these are the end times, and as you heard that the Antichrist is coming, even now many antichrists have arisen. By this we know that it is the final hour.

kikuyu: Isaan nu keessaa baʼan malee dhugumaan kan keenya hin turre. Utuu kan keenya taʼanii silaa nu biratti hafu turan; nu biraa deemuun isaanii garuu akka tokkoon isaanii iyyuu keenya hin taʼin mulʼise.
english: They went out from us, but they didn’t belong to us; for if they had belonged to us, they would have continued with us. But they left, that they might be revealed that none of them belong to us.

kikuyu: Isin garuu Isa Qulqulluu sanaan dibamtaniirtu; isin hundis dhugaa ni beektu.
english: You have an anointing from the Holy One, and you all have knowledge.

kikuyu: Sababiin ani isinii barreessuuf waan isin dhugaa beektanii fi akka sobni tokko iyyuu dhugaa keessa hin jirres beektaniif malee waan isin dhugaa hin beekneef miti.
english: I have not written to you because you don’t know the truth, but because you know it, and because no lie is of the truth.

kikuyu: Nama Yesuus kun Kiristoos miti jedhee ganu malee sobduun eenyu ree? Namni akkasii farra Kiristoos; inni Abbaa fi Ilma ni gana.
english: Who is the liar but he who denies that Jesus is the Christ? This is the Antichrist, he who denies the Father and the Son.

kikuyu: Namni Ilma ganu kam iyyuu Abbaa illee hin qabu; namni waaʼee Ilmaa dhugaa baʼu hundinuu Abbaas qaba.
english: Whoever denies the Son doesn’t have the Father. He who confesses the Son has the Father also.

kikuyu: Wanni isin jalqabaa kaaftanii dhageessan sun isin keessa haa jiraatu. Yoo wanni jalqabaa kaaftanii dhageessan isin keessa jiraate, isinis Ilmaa fi Abbaadhaan ni jiraattu.
english: Therefore, as for you, let that remain in you which you heard from the beginning. If that which you heard from the beginning remains in you, you also will remain in the Son, and in the Father.

kikuyu: Wanni inni waadaa nuu gale kanaa dha; kunis jireenya bara baraa ti.
english: This is the promise which he promised us, the eternal life.

kikuyu: Ani waaʼee warra karaa irraa isin jalʼisuu yaalan sanaatiif waan kana isiniifin barreessa.
english: These things I have written to you concerning those who would lead you astray.

kikuyu: Garuu dibanni isin isa irraa argattan sun waan isin keessa jiraatuuf namni tokko iyyuu isin barsiisuu hin barbaachisu; dibanni isaa sun garuu waan waaʼee hundumaa isin barsiisuuf, dibanni sun waan dhugaa malee soba hin taʼiniif akkuma inni isin barsiise sanatti isumaan jiraadhaa.
english: As for you, the anointing which you received from him remains in you, and you don’t need for anyone to teach you. But as his anointing teaches you concerning all things, and is true, and is no lie, and even as it taught you, you will remain in him.

kikuyu: Ammas yaa ijoolle, akka yommuu inni mulʼatutti ija jabina qabaannuuf, akka nu guyyaa dhufaatii isaattis fuula isaa duratti hin qaanofneef isaan jiraadhaa.
english: Now, little children, remain in him, that when he appears, we may have boldness and not be ashamed before him at his coming.

kikuyu: Isin yoo akka inni qajeelaa taʼe beektan, akka namni waan qajeelaa hojjetu hundinuu isa irraa dhalate ni beektu.
english: If you know that he is righteous, you know that everyone who practices righteousness has been born of him.

kikuyu: Nu akka ijoollee Waaqaa jedhamnee waamamnuuf jaalalli Abbaan nurratti dhangalaase akkam guddaa dha! Nus akkasuma ijoollee isaa ti! Addunyaan waan isa hin beekiniif nu hin beeku.
english: See how great a love the Father has given to us, that we should be called children of God! For this cause the world doesn’t know us, because it didn’t know him.

kikuyu: Yaa michoota jaallatamoo, nu amma ijoollee Waaqaa ti; gara fuula duraatti immoo maal akka taanu amma hin ibsamne. Garuu yommuu inni mulʼatutti sababii akkuma inni jirutti isa arginuuf nu akkuma isaa akka taanu ni beekna.
english: Beloved, now we are children of God. It is not yet revealed what we will be; but we know that when he is revealed, we will be like him, for we will see him just as he is.

kikuyu: Namni akkasitti isa abdatu hundinuu akkuma inni qulqulluu taʼe sana of qulqulleessa.
english: Everyone who has this hope set on him purifies himself, even as he is pure.

kikuyu: Namni cubbuu hojjetu kam iyyuu seeratti ni fincila; cubbuun finciluudhaatii.
english: Everyone who sins also commits lawlessness. Sin is lawlessness.

kikuyu: Isin garuu akka inni cubbuu keenya balleessuudhaaf mulʼate ni beektu. Isa keessa cubbuun hin jiru.
english: You know that he was revealed to take away our sins, and no sin is in him.

kikuyu: Namni isaan jiraatu kam iyyuu cubbuu hin hojjetu. Namni cubbuu hojjetu kam iyyuu isa hin argine yookaan isa hin beekne.
english: Whoever remains in him doesn’t sin. Whoever sins hasn’t seen him and doesn’t know him.

kikuyu: Yaa ijoolle, namni tokko iyyuu isin hin gowwoomsin. Akkuma inni qajeelaa taʼe sana namni waan qajeelaa hojjetus qajeelaa dha.
english: Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.

kikuyu: Namni cubbuu hojjetu kan diiyaabiloos; diiyaabiloos jalqabumaa kaasee cubbuu hojjetaatii. Ilmi Waaqaa hojii diiyaabiloos diiguudhaaf mulʼateetii.
english: He who sins is of the devil, for the devil has been sinning from the beginning. To this end the Son of God was revealed: that he might destroy the works of the devil.

kikuyu: Namni Waaqa irraa dhalate kam iyyuu waan sanyiin Waaqaa isa keessa jiraatuuf cubbuu hojjechuutti hin fufu; inni waan Waaqa irraa dhalateef cubbuu hojjechuu hin dandaʼu.
english: Whoever is born of God doesn’t commit sin, because his seed remains in him, and he can’t sin, because he is born of God.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen Waaqaatii fi ijoolleen diiyaabiloos kanaan gargar baafamanii beekamu: Namni waan qajeelaa hin hojjenne yookaan obboleessa isaa hin jaallanne kam iyyuu kan Waaqaa miti.
english: In this the children of God are revealed, and the children of the devil. Whoever doesn’t do righteousness is not of God, neither is he who doesn’t love his brother.

kikuyu: Ergaan isin jalqabaa kaaftanii dhageessan isa, “Nu wal jaallachuu qabna” jedhuu dha.
english: For this is the message which you heard from the beginning, that we should love one another—

kikuyu: Isin akka Qaayin isa kan isa hamaa sanaa taʼee obboleessa isaa ajjeese sanaa hin taʼinaa; inni maaliif obboleessa isaa ajjeese? Sababii hojiin isaa jalʼaa taʼee, kan obboleessa isaa immoo qajeelaa taʼeef.
english: unlike Cain, who was of the evil one and killed his brother. Why did he kill him? Because his deeds were evil, and his brother’s righteous.

kikuyu: Yaa obboloota ko, yoo addunyaan isin jibbe isin hin dinqin.
english: Don’t be surprised, my brothers, if the world hates you.

kikuyu: Nu sababii obboloota jaallannuuf duʼa keessaa gara jireenyaatti akka ceene ni beekna. Namni obboleessa isaa hin jaallanne duʼa keessa jiraata.
english: We know that we have passed out of death into life, because we love the brothers. He who doesn’t love his brother remains in death.

kikuyu: Namni obboleessa isaa jibbu kam iyyuu nama nama ajjeesuu dha; isinis akka namni nama ajjeesu jireenya bara baraa of keessaa hin qabne beektu.
english: Whoever hates his brother is a murderer, and you know that no murderer has eternal life remaining in him.

kikuyu: Yesuus Kiristoos lubbuu isaa dabarsee nuuf kenneera: Jaalalli maal akka taʼes kanaan beekna; nus akkasuma lubbuu keenya dabarsinee obboloota keenyaaf kennuu qabna.
english: By this we know love, because he laid down his life for us. And we ought to lay down our lives for the brothers.

kikuyu: Namni qabeenya addunyaa qabu kam iyyuu yoo obboleessa isaa rakkataa argee garaa itti jabaate jaalalli Waaqaa akkamitti isa keessa jiraachuu dandaʼa?
english: But whoever has the world’s goods and sees his brother in need, then closes his heart of compassion against him, how does God’s love remain in him?

kikuyu: Yaa ijoollee jaallatamoo, kottaa dubbiin yookaan afaan qofaan utuu hin taʼin hojii fi dhugaadhaan jaallannaa.
english: My little children, let’s not love in word only, or with the tongue only, but in deed and truth.

kikuyu: Nus kan dhugaa taʼuu keenya kanaan beekna; fuula isaa durattis garaa keenya boqochiifna.
english: And by this we know that we are of the truth and persuade our hearts before him,

kikuyu: Yeroo garaan keenya nutti murutti Waaqni garaa keenya caalaa guddaa akka taʼe ni beeknaatii; inni waan hunda ni beeka.
english: because if our heart condemns us, God is greater than our heart, and knows all things.

kikuyu: Yaa michoota, yoo garaan keenya nutti muruu baate nu fuula Waaqaa duratti ija jabina qabna.
english: Beloved, if our hearts don’t condemn us, we have boldness toward God;

kikuyu: Nus sababii ajaja isaa eegnuu fi sababii waan isa gammachiisu hojjennuuf waan kadhannu hunda isa irraa ni arganna.
english: so whatever we ask, we receive from him, because we keep his commandments and do the things that are pleasing in his sight.

kikuyu: Ajajni isaas kana: kunis nu maqaa Ilma isaa Yesuus Kiristoositti akka amannuu fi akkuma inni nu ajajetti akka wal jaallannuuf.
english: This is his commandment, that we should believe in the name of his Son, Jesus Christ, and love one another, even as he commanded.

kikuyu: Namni ajaja isaa eegu isa keessa jiraata; innis isa keessa jiraata. Kanaanis akka inni nu keessa jiraatu nu Hafuura inni nuu kenneen ni beekna.
english: He who keeps his commandments remains in him, and he in him. By this we know that he remains in us, by the Spirit which he gave us.

kikuyu: Yaa michoota, hafuuronni kan Waaqaa taʼuu fi taʼuu baachuu isaanii ilaaluuf qoradhaa malee hafuurota hunda hin amaninaa; raajonni sobduun hedduun addunyaa seenaniiru.
english: Beloved, don’t believe every spirit, but test the spirits, whether they are of God, because many false prophets have gone out into the world.

kikuyu: Haalli isin ittiin Hafuura Waaqaa beektanis kanuma: Hafuurri akka Yesuus Kiristoos fooniin dhufe dhugaa baʼu hundi kan Waaqaa ti;
english: By this you know the Spirit of God: every spirit who confesses that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is of God,

kikuyu: hafuurri akka Yesuus Kiristoos fooniin dhufe dhugaa hin baane hundi kan Waaqaa miti. Inni hafuura farra Kiristoos, kan isin akka inni dhufu dhageessan sanaa ti; innis ammuma iyyuu addunyaa keessa jira.
english: and every spirit who doesn’t confess that Jesus Christ has come in the flesh is not of God; and this is the spirit of the Antichrist, of whom you have heard that it comes. Now it is in the world already.

kikuyu: Yaa ijoolle, isin kan Waaqaa ti; jaras moʼattaniirtu; inni isin keessa jiru kan addunyaa keessa jiru sana caalaa guddaadhaatii.
english: You are of God, little children, and have overcome them, because greater is he who is in you than he who is in the world.

kikuyu: Isaan kan addunyaa ti; kanaaf wanni isaan dubbatanis kanuma addunyaa ti; addunyaanis isaan dhaggeeffata.
english: They are of the world. Therefore they speak of the world, and the world hears them.

kikuyu: Nu kan Waaqaa ti; namni Waaqa beeku hundinuus nu dhaggeeffata; namni kan Waaqaa hin taʼin garuu nu hin dhaggeeffatu. Kanaanis Hafuura dhugaatii fi hafuura sobaa addaan baafnee ni beekna.
english: We are of God. He who knows God listens to us. He who is not of God doesn’t listen to us. By this we know the spirit of truth, and the spirit of error.

kikuyu: Yaa michoota, jaalalli kan Waaqaa waan taʼeef kottaa wal jaallannaa. Namni jaallatu hundi Waaqa irraa dhalate; Waaqas ni beeka.
english: Beloved, let’s love one another, for love is of God; and everyone who loves has been born of God and knows God.

kikuyu: Sababii Waaqni jaalala taʼeef, namni hin jaallanne hundi Waaqa hin beeku.
english: He who doesn’t love doesn’t know God, for God is love.

kikuyu: Waaqni akka nu karaa isaatiin jireenya argannuuf jedhee Ilma isaa tokkicha sana gara addunyaatti erge. Kanaanis jaalalli Waaqaa nu gidduutti mulʼateera.
english: By this God’s love was revealed in us, that God has sent his only born Son into the world that we might live through him.

kikuyu: Jaalalli isa kana: Kunis nu Waaqa jaallannee miti; garuu Waaqatu nu jaallatee akka inni aarsaa cubbuu keenyaaf araara buusu taʼuuf Ilma isaa erge.
english: In this is love, not that we loved God, but that he loved us, and sent his Son as the atoning sacrifice for our sins.

kikuyu: Yaa michoota, erga Waaqni akkana nu jaallatee nus wal jaallachuu qabna.
english: Beloved, if God loved us in this way, we also ought to love one another.

kikuyu: Namni tokko iyyuu takkumaa Waaqa hin argine; yoo wal jaallanne garuu Waaqni nu keessa jiraata; jaalalli isaas nu keessatti guutuu taʼa.
english: No one has seen God at any time. If we love one another, God remains in us, and his love has been perfected in us.

kikuyu: Inni waan Hafuura isaa irraa nuu kenneef nu akka isa keessa jiraannuu fi akka innis nu keessa jiraatu kanaan ni beekna.
english: By this we know that we remain in him and he in us, because he has given us of his Spirit.

kikuyu: Akka inni Fayyisaa addunyaa taʼuuf jedhee Abbaan Ilma isaa akka erge argineerra; dhugaa baanas.
english: We have seen and testify that the Father has sent the Son as the Savior of the world.

kikuyu: Yoo namni kam iyyuu Yesuus Ilma Waaqaa akka taʼe dhugaa baʼe, Waaqni isa keessa jiraata; innis Waaqa keessa jiraata.
english: Whoever confesses that Jesus is the Son of God, God remains in him, and he in God.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu jaalala Waaqni nuuf qabu beekneerra; amanneerras. Waaqni jaalala. Namni jaalalaan jiraatu Waaqa keessa jiraata; Waaqnis isa keessa jiraata.
english: We know and have believed the love which God has for us. God is love, and he who remains in love remains in God, and God remains in him.

kikuyu: Nus akka guyyaa murtiitti ija jabina qabaannuuf karaa kanaan jaalalli nu gidduutti guutuu taʼeera; nu addunyaa kana irratti Yesuusin fakkaannaatii.
english: In this, love has been made perfect among us, that we may have boldness in the day of judgment, because as he is, even so we are in this world.

kikuyu: Jaalala keessa sodaan hin jiru. Sodaan waan adabbii wajjin wal qabatee jiruuf jaalalli mudaa hin qabne sodaa of keessaa baasee gata. Namni sodaatu tokko jaalalli isaa guutuu miti.
english: There is no fear in love; but perfect love casts out fear, because fear has punishment. He who fears is not made perfect in love.

kikuyu: Nu sababii inni duraan dursee nu jaallateef isa jaallanna.
english: We love him, because he first loved us.

kikuyu: Namni, “Ani Waaqa nan jaalladha” jechaa obboleessa isaa immoo jibbu kam iyyuu sobduu dha. Namni obboleessa isaa kan arge sana hin jaallanne kam iyyuu Waaqa hin argin sana jaallachuu hin dandaʼu.
english: If a man says, “I love God,” and hates his brother, he is a liar; for he who doesn’t love his brother whom he has seen, how can he love God whom he has not seen?

kikuyu: Inni ajaja kana nuu kenneera: Namni Waaqa jaallatu kam iyyuu obboleessa ofii isaa jaallachuu qaba.
english: This commandment we have from him, that he who loves God should also love his brother.

kikuyu: Yesuus kun Kiristoos akka taʼe namni amanu hundinuu Waaqa irraa dhalate; namni Abbaa jaallatu hundinuus kan Abbaa irraa dhalates ni jaallata.
english: Whoever believes that Jesus is the Christ has been born of God. Whoever loves the Father also loves the child who is born of him.

kikuyu: Nu yommuu Waaqa jaallannuu fi yommuu ajaja isaa eegnutti akka ijoollee Waaqaa jaallannu kanaan beekna.
english: By this we know that we love the children of God, when we love God and keep his commandments.

kikuyu: Waaqa jaallachuun ajaja isaa eeguu dha. Ajajni isaas hin ulfaatu.
english: For this is loving God, that we keep his commandments. His commandments are not grievous.

kikuyu: Namni Waaqa irraa dhalatu hundinuu addunyaa ni moʼataatii. Kan addunyaa moʼatus amantii keenya.
english: For whatever is born of God overcomes the world. This is the victory that has overcome the world: your faith.

kikuyu: Yesuus Ilma Waaqaa taʼuu isaa nama amanu malee eenyutu addunyaa moʼata?
english: Who is he who overcomes the world, but he who believes that Jesus is the Son of God?

kikuyu: Inni bishaanii fi dhiigaan dhufe isa kana; innis Yesuus Kiristoos. Inni bishaanii fi dhiigaan dhufe malee bishaan qofaan hin dhufne. Kanas Hafuuratu dhugaa baʼa; Hafuurri dhugaadhaatii.
english: This is he who came by water and blood, Jesus Christ; not with the water only, but with the water and the blood. It is the Spirit who testifies, because the Spirit is the truth.

kikuyu: Dhuga baatota sadiitu jira:
english: For there are three who testify:

kikuyu: Isaanis Hafuura, bishaanii fi dhiiga; sadanuus walii galu.
english: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and the three agree as one.

kikuyu: Dhuga baʼumsa namaa ni fudhanna; dhuga baʼumsi Waaqaa garuu kana caalaa guddaa dha; dhuga baʼumsi kun isa Waaqni waaʼee Ilma isaa dhugaa baʼe sana.
english: If we receive the witness of men, the witness of God is greater; for this is God’s testimony which he has testified concerning his Son.

kikuyu: Namni Ilma Waaqaatti amanu kam iyyuu dhuga baʼumsa kana garaa isaa keessaa qaba. Namni Waaqa hin amanne garuu waan isa Waaqni waaʼee Ilma isaa dhugaa baʼe sana hin amaniniif inni Waaqa sobduu godheera.
english: He who believes in the Son of God has the testimony in himself. He who doesn’t believe God has made him a liar, because he has not believed in the testimony that God has given concerning his Son.

kikuyu: Dhuga baʼumsi sunis isa kana: Waaqni jireenya bara baraa nuu kenneera; jireenyi sunis Ilma isaa keessa jira.
english: The testimony is this: that God gave to us eternal life, and this life is in his Son.

kikuyu: Namni Ilma sana qabu jireenya qaba; namni Ilma Waaqaa hin qabne immoo jireenya hin qabu.
english: He who has the Son has the life. He who doesn’t have God’s Son doesn’t have the life.

kikuyu: Isin warri maqaa Ilma Waaqaatti amantan jireenya bara baraa qabaachuu keessan akka beektaniif ani waan kana isinii barreessa.
english: These things I have written to you who believe in the name of the Son of God, that you may know that you have eternal life, and that you may continue to believe in the name of the Son of God.

kikuyu: Ija jabinni nu fuula Waaqaa duratti qabnu isa kana: yoo nu akka fedhii isaatti waan hunda isa kadhanne inni nuuf dhagaʼa.
english: This is the boldness which we have toward him, that if we ask anything according to his will, he listens to us.

kikuyu: Nu yoo akka inni waan nu kadhannu hunda nuuf dhagaʼu beekne, akka waan isa kadhannes argannu ni beekna.
english: And if we know that he listens to us, whatever we ask, we know that we have the petitions which we have asked of him.

kikuyu: Namni kam iyyuu utuu obboleessi isaa cubbuu gara duʼaatti hin geessine hojjetuu yoo arge Waaqa kadhachufii qaba; Waaqnis warra cubbuun isaanii gara duʼaatti isaan hin geessineef jireenya ni kenna. Cubbuun gara duʼaatti nama geessu jira; anis waan akkasiitiif inni haa kadhatu jechuu koo miti.
english: If anyone sees his brother sinning a sin not leading to death, he shall ask, and God will give him life for those who sin not leading to death. There is sin leading to death. I don’t say that he should make a request concerning this.

kikuyu: Jalʼinni hundinuu cubbuu dha; cubbuun gara duʼaatti nama hin geessines jira.
english: All unrighteousness is sin, and there is sin not leading to death.

kikuyu: Namni Waaqa irraa dhalate kam iyyuu akka cubbuu hojjechuutti hin fufne ni beekna; Inni Waaqa irraa dhalate sun isa eega; inni hamaan isa tuquu hin dandaʼu.
english: We know that whoever is born of God doesn’t sin, but he who was born of God keeps himself, and the evil one doesn’t touch him.

kikuyu: Nu ijoollee Waaqaa akka taane, addunyaan guutuunis toʼannaa isa hamaa sanaa jala akka jiru ni beekna.
english: We know that we are of God, and the whole world lies in the power of the evil one.

kikuyu: Akkasumas akka Ilmi Waaqaa dhufee akka isa dhugaa taʼe sanas beeknuuf hubannaa nuu kenne ni beekna. Nus Ilma isaa isa dhugaa sana, jechuunis Yesuus Kiristoositti jirra. Inni Waaqa dhugaa ti; jireenya bara baraatis.
english: We know that the Son of God has come and has given us an understanding, that we know him who is true; and we are in him who is true, in his Son Jesus Christ. This is the true God and eternal life.

kikuyu: Yaa ijoolle, waaqota tolfamoo irraa of eegaa.
english: Little children, keep yourselves from idols.

kikuyu: Jaarsicha irraa,
english: The elder, to the chosen lady and her children, whom I love in truth, and not I only, but also all those who know the truth,

kikuyu: kunis sababii dhugaa nu keessa jiraatuu fi isa bara baraan nu wajjin jiraatu sanaatiif:
english: for the truth’s sake, which remains in us, and it will be with us forever:

kikuyu: Ayyaanni, araarrii fi nagaan Waaqa Abbaa biraa, Yesuus Kiristoos Ilma Abbaa biraas, dhugaa fi jaalalaan nu wajjin ni taʼa.
english: Grace, mercy, and peace will be with us, from God the Father and from the Lord Jesus Christ, the Son of the Father, in truth and love.

kikuyu: Ani waan ijoollee kee keessaa tokko tokko akka isaan akkuma Abbaan nu ajajetti dhugaan jiraatan argeef baayʼee gammadeera.
english: I rejoice greatly that I have found some of your children walking in truth, even as we have been commanded by the Father.

kikuyu: Ammas yaa giiftii jaallatamtuu, ani ajaja durumaa jalqabee nuuf kenname sana malee ajaja haaraa siif barreessuutti hin jiru. Akka wal jaallannuufis sin kadhadha.
english: Now I beg you, dear lady, not as though I wrote to you a new commandment, but that which we had from the beginning, that we love one another.

kikuyu: Jaalallis kana: kunis ajaja isaa eegnee jiraachuu dha. Akkuma isin durumaa jalqabdanii dhageessan sana ajajni isaa akka isin jaalalaan jiraattanii dha.
english: This is love, that we should walk according to his commandments. This is the commandment, even as you heard from the beginning, that you should walk in it.

kikuyu: Gowwoomsitoonni akka Yesuus Kiristoos fooniin dhufe hin amanne hedduun addunyaa seenaniiru. Namni akkanaa kam iyyuu gowwoomsituu fi farra Kiristoos.
english: For many deceivers have gone out into the world, those who don’t confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh. This is the deceiver and the Antichrist.

kikuyu: Isin akka gatii guutuu argattan malee akka waan hojjettan sana hin dhabneef of eeggadhaa.
english: Watch yourselves, that we don’t lose the things which we have accomplished, but that we receive a full reward.

kikuyu: Namni barsiisa Kiristoosiin hin jiraanne kan barsiisa sana keessaa baʼu kam iyyuu Waaqa hin qabu; namni barsiisa Kiristoosiin jiraatu hundinuu immoo Abbaas Ilmas qaba.
english: Whoever transgresses and doesn’t remain in the teaching of Christ doesn’t have God. He who remains in the teaching has both the Father and the Son.

kikuyu: Isin yoo namni kam iyyuu gara keessan dhufee garuu barsiisa kana hin fidin, mana keessanitti ol isa hin galchinaa yookaan isa hin simatinaa.
english: If anyone comes to you and doesn’t bring this teaching, don’t receive him into your house, and don’t welcome him,

kikuyu: Namni isa simatu kam iyyuu hojii isaa hamaa sana keessatti qooda qabaataatii.
english: for he who welcomes him participates in his evil deeds.
