kikuyu: Ani waanan isiniif barreessu baayʼee qaba; taʼus waraqaa fi qalamiitti fayyadamuu hin barbaadu. Qooda kanaa akka gammachuun keenya guutuu taʼuuf ani gara keessan dhufee ifaan ifatti haasofnu abdiin qaba.
english: Having many things to write to you, I don’t want to do so with paper and ink, but I hope to come to you and to speak face to face, that our joy may be made full.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen obboleettii kee kan filatamte sanaas nagaa siif dhaamu.
english: The children of your chosen sister greet you. Amen.

kikuyu: Jaarsicha irraa,
english: The elder to Gaius the beloved, whom I love in truth.

kikuyu: Yaa michuu ko, akkuma lubbuu keetti tole sana akka wanni hundinuu sitti toluu fi akka ati fayyaa qabaattuuf nan kadhadha.
english: Beloved, I pray that you may prosper in all things and be healthy, even as your soul prospers.

kikuyu: Obboloonni tokko tokko dhufanii akka ati dhugaaf amanamaa taatee fi akka ati dhugaadhaan jiraattu natti himnaan ani akka malee gammade.
english: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.

kikuyu: Ijoolleen koo dhugaadhaan jiraachuu isaanii dhagaʼuu caalaa ani gammachuu guddaa hin qabu.
english: I have no greater joy than this: to hear about my children walking in truth.

kikuyu: Yaa michuu ko, yoo isaan keessummoota sitti taʼan illee ati waan obbolootaaf gootu keessatti amanamaa dha.
english: Beloved, you do a faithful work in whatever you accomplish for those who are brothers and strangers.

kikuyu: Isaan waaʼee jaalala keetii waldaa kiristaanaatti himaniiru. Maaloo haala Waaqatti toluun karaan isaanii irratti isaan gargaari.
english: They have testified about your love before the assembly. You will do well to send them forward on their journey in a way worthy of God,

kikuyu: Isaan Maqaa isaatiif jedhanii utuu ormoota irraa gargaarsa tokko illee hin argatin baʼaniiruutii.
english: because for the sake of the Name they went out, taking nothing from the Gentiles.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu nu akka isaan wajjin dhugaaf hojjennuuf namoota akkasii simannee gargaaruu qabna.
english: We therefore ought to receive such, that we may be fellow workers for the truth.

kikuyu: Ani waldaa kiristaanaatiif barreesseera; garuu isaan keessaa Diiyoxiraaxiis inni duree taʼuu barbaadu nu hin simatu.
english: I wrote to the assembly, but Diotrephes, who loves to be first among them, doesn’t accept what we say.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani yoon dhufe waan inni maqaa keenya balleessuudhaan hojjechaa jiru ifatti nan baasa. Akka waan wanni kun isa hanqateetti inni obboloota simachuu dida. Warra isaan simachuu barbaadanis ni dhowwa; waldaa kiristaanaa keessaas isaan ariʼa.
english: Therefore, if I come, I will call attention to his deeds which he does, unjustly accusing us with wicked words. Not content with this, he doesn’t receive the brothers himself, and those who would, he forbids and throws out of the assembly.

kikuyu: Yaa michuu ko, waan gaarii duukaa buʼi malee waan hamaa duukaa hin buʼin. Namni waan gaarii hojjetu kam iyyuu kan Waaqaa ti. Namni waan hamaa hojjetu garuu takkumaa Waaqa hin argine.
english: Beloved, don’t imitate that which is evil, but that which is good. He who does good is of God. He who does evil hasn’t seen God.

kikuyu: Namni hundi Dimeexiroosiif dhugaa baʼa; dhugaan mataan ishee iyyuu dhugaa baati. Nus dhugaa baanaaf; isinis akka dhuga baʼumsi keenya dhugaa taʼe ni beektu.
english: Demetrius has the testimony of all, and of the truth itself; yes, we also testify, and you know that our testimony is true.

kikuyu: Ani waanan siif barreessu baayʼee qaba; garuu biirii fi qalamiidhaan barreessuu hin barbaadu.
english: I had many things to write to you, but I am unwilling to write to you with ink and pen;

kikuyu: Qooda kanaa ani dhiʼootti si arguuf abdii qaba; nus ifaan ifatti ni haasofna.
english: but I hope to see you soon. Then we will speak face to face. Peace be to you. The friends greet you. Greet the friends by name.

kikuyu: Yihuudaa obboleessa Yaaqoob garbicha Yesuus Kiristoos irraa,
english: Jude, a servant of Jesus Christ, and brother of James, to those who are called, sanctified by God the Father, and kept for Jesus Christ:

kikuyu: Araarri, nagaanii fi jaalalli isiniif haa baayʼatu.
english: May mercy, peace, and love be multiplied to you.

kikuyu: Yaa michoota, ani waaʼee fayyina nu walii wajjin qooddannu kanaa isiniif barreessuuf guddisee nan hawwan ture; garuu akka isin amantii yeroo tokko bara baraan qulqulloota Waaqaatti imaanaa kenname sanaaf jabaattanii loltaniif isiniif barreessee isin gorsuun barbaachisaa natti fakkaate.
english: Beloved, while I was very eager to write to you about our common salvation, I was constrained to write to you exhorting you to contend earnestly for the faith which was once for all delivered to the saints.

kikuyu: Namoonni bara dheeraan dura murtii kanaaf murteeffaman tokko tokko looʼanii gidduu keessan seenaniiruutii. Isaanis namoota Waaqaaf hin bulle, warra ayyaana Waaqa keenyaa gara halalummaatti geeddaran kanneen Gooftaa Ol aanaa tokkicha jechuunis Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosin gananii dha.
english: For there are certain men who crept in secretly, even those who were long ago written about for this condemnation: ungodly men, turning the grace of our God into indecency, and denying our only Master, God, and Lord, Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Yoo isin duraanuu waan kana hunda beektan illee, ani akka Gooftaan yeroo tokko saba isaa Gibxii baasee ergasii immoo warra hin amanin balleesse isin yaadachiisuu nan barbaada.
english: Now I desire to remind you, though you already know this, that the Lord, having saved a people out of the land of Egypt, afterward destroyed those who didn’t believe.

kikuyu: Innis ergamoota sadarkaa taayitaa isaanii irra hin turin, kanneen lafa jireenya isaanii dhiisan sana foncaa bara baraatiin hidhee hamma murtii Guyyaa guddaa sanaatti dukkana keessa turseera.
english: Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds under darkness for the judgment of the great day.

kikuyu: Sodoomii fi Gomoraan, magaalaawwan naannoo isaanii jiranis akkasuma halalummaa fi hawwii foonii kan haala uumamaatiin ala taʼetti dabarsanii of kennaniiru. Isaanis warra adaba ibidda bara baraatiin adabamaniif fakkeenya taʼaniiru.
english: Even as Sodom and Gomorrah and the cities around them, having in the same way as these given themselves over to sexual immorality and gone after strange flesh, are shown as an example, suffering the punishment of eternal fire.

kikuyu: Haaluma wal fakkaatuunis namoonni abjootan kunneen foon ofii isaanii xureessu; gooftummaa ni tuffatu; ulfina qabeeyyii illee ni arrabsu.
english: Yet in the same way, these also in their dreaming defile the flesh, despise authority, and slander celestial beings.

kikuyu: Garuu Miikaaʼel hangafni ergamoota Waaqaa iyyuu yeroo waaʼee reeffa Musee irratti diiyaabiloosiin walitti falmanitti, “Gooftaan si haa ifatu!” jedhe malee isa arrabsuudhaan itti muruuf ija hin jabaanne.
english: But Michael, the archangel, when contending with the devil and arguing about the body of Moses, dared not bring against him an abusive condemnation, but said, “May the Lord rebuke you!”

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen garuu waanuma hin hubanne arrabsu; waan isaan akkuma bineensota waa yaaduu hin dandeenyeetti miiraan hubatantu isaan balleessa.
english: But these speak evil of whatever things they don’t know. They are destroyed in these things that they understand naturally, like the creatures without reason.

kikuyu: Isaaniif wayyoo! Isaan karaa Qaayin irra deeman; faayidaa argachuuf jedhanii dogoggora Balaʼaam keessa of buusan; fincila Qooraahiitiinis ni barbadaaʼan.
english: Woe to them! For they went in the way of Cain, and ran riotously in the error of Balaam for hire, and perished in Korah’s rebellion.

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen utuma xuraaʼoo taʼanii jiranuu qaanii tokko malee cidha jaalalaa isin wajjin nyaatu; isaan tiksoota ofuma isaanii qofa sooranii dha. Isaan akkuma duumessa bokkaa hin qabne kan bubbeen asii fi achi oofuu ti; akkuma muka yeroo itti ija naqachuu qabutti ija dhabee buqqifamee dachaa lama duʼee ti.
english: These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves; clouds without water, carried along by winds; autumn trees without fruit, twice dead, plucked up by the roots;

kikuyu: Isaan warra akka dambalii galaanaa hoomacha qaanii isaanii baasanii dha; akkuma urjiiwwan asii fi achi jooran kanneen dukkanni limixiin hamma bara baraatti isaanii kaaʼamee ti.
english: wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been reserved forever.

kikuyu: Henook inni Addaam irraa jalqabee torbaffaa ture sun akkana jedhee waaʼee namoota kanaa raajii dubbateera: “Kunoo, Gooftaan qulqulloota isaa kumaatama wajjin ni dhufa;
english: About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his holy ones,

kikuyu: innis nama hundatti muruuf, warra Waaqaaf hin bulle kanneen karaa Waaqni hin jaallanneen waan Waaqni hin jaallanne hojjetan hundaa fi dubbii hamaa cubbamoonni Waaqaaf hin bulle hundinuu isa irratti dubbatan hundatti isaan gaafachuuf ni dhufa.”
english: to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an ungodly way, and of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against him.”

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen yeroo hunda ni guungumu; komiis ni qabaatu; hawwii isaanii isa hamaa duukaa buʼu; of jaju; faayidaa argachuuf jedhaniis nama saadu.
english: These are murmurers and complainers, walking after their lusts—and their mouth speaks proud things—showing respect of persons to gain advantage.

kikuyu: Yaa michoota, isin garuu waan ergamoonni Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos duraan dursanii himan sana yaadadhaa.
english: But you, beloved, remember the words which have been spoken before by the apostles of our Lord Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Isaanis, “Qoostonni hawwii fedhii Waaqaatiin ala taʼe duukaa buʼan bara dhumaa keessa ni dhufu” isiniin jedhan.
english: They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”

kikuyu: Namoonni kunneen warra gargar baʼuu uuman, warra hawwii foonii duukaa buʼanii fi warra Hafuura Qulqulluu hin qabnee dha.
english: These are those who cause divisions and are sensual, not having the Spirit.

kikuyu: Isin garuu yaa michoota, amantii keessan kan waan hunda irra qulqulluu taʼe sana irratti of ijaaraa; Hafuura Qulqulluudhaanis kadhadhaa.
english: But you, beloved, keep building up yourselves on your most holy faith, praying in the Holy Spirit.

kikuyu: Araarri Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoos jireenya bara baraatti akka isin geessu eeggachaa jaalala Waaqaatiin of eegaa.
english: Keep yourselves in God’s love, looking for the mercy of our Lord Jesus Christ to eternal life.

kikuyu: Warra shakkii qabaniif garaa laafaa;
english: On some have compassion, making a distinction,

kikuyu: Warra kaan ibidda keessaa butaatii oolchaa; kaan immoo uffata hawwii fooniitiin xureeffame iyyuu balfaatii sodaadhaan isaan maaraa.
english: and some save, snatching them out of the fire with fear, hating even the clothing stained by the flesh.

kikuyu: Isa gufachuu isin oolchuu dandaʼuu fi isa fuula ulfina isaa duratti hirʼina malee, gammachuu guddaadhaan isin dhiʼeessuu dandaʼu sanaaf,
english: Now to him who is able to keep them from stumbling, and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory in great joy,

kikuyu: Fayyisaa keenya Waaqa tokkichaaf ulfinni, surraan, humnii fi taayitaan karaa Gooftaa keenya Yesuus Kiristoosiin bara hundumaan dura, amma, bara baraanis haa taʼu! Ameen.
english: to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.

kikuyu: Kun mulʼata Yesuus Kiristoos, kan akka inni waan dhiʼootti taʼuu qabu garboota isaatti argisiisuuf jedhee Waaqni isaaf kennee dha. Innis ergamaa isaa gara garbicha isaa Yohannisitti ergee akka mulʼanni sun beekamu godhe;
english: This is the Revelation of Jesus Christ, which God gave him to show to his servants the things which must happen soon, which he sent and made known by his angel to his servant, John,

kikuyu: Yohannis isa waan arge hundumaa jechuunis dubbii Waaqaatii fi dhuga baʼumsa Yesuus Kiristoos dhugaa baʼuu dha.
english: who testified to God’s word and of the testimony of Jesus Christ, about everything that he saw.

kikuyu: Namni dubbii raajii kana dubbisu eebbifamaa dha; warri waan raajii sana keessatti barreeffame dhagaʼanii eeganis eebbifamoo dha; barichi dhiʼaateeraatii.
english: Blessed is he who reads and those who hear the words of the prophecy, and keep the things that are written in it, for the time is near.

kikuyu: Yohannis irraa,
english: John, to the seven assemblies that are in Asia: Grace to you and peace from God, who is and who was and who is to come; and from the seven Spirits who are before his throne;

kikuyu: akkasumas Yesuus Kiristoos dhuga baatuu amanamaa, hangafa warra duʼaniitii fi bulchaa mootota lafaa taʼe sana irraa ayyaannii fi nagaan isiniif haa taʼu. Isa nu jaallatuu fi isa dhiiga isaatiin cubbuu keenya irraa bilisa nu baase,
english: and from Jesus Christ, the faithful witness, the firstborn of the dead, and the ruler of the kings of the earth. To him who loves us, and washed us from our sins by his blood—

kikuyu: isa akka nu Waaqa isaatii fi Abbaa isaa tajaajilluuf mootummaa fi luboota nu taasise sanaaf ulfinnii fi humni bara baraa hamma bara baraatti haa taʼu! Ameen.
english: and he made us to be a Kingdom, priests to his God and Father—to him be the glory and the dominion forever and ever. Amen.

kikuyu: “Kunoo, inni duumessa wajjin dhufa; iji hundinuu, warri isa waraanan iyyuu isa ni argu;” saboonni lafaa hundinuus “sababii isaatiif ni wawwaatu.”
english: Behold, he is coming with the clouds, and every eye will see him, including those who pierced him. All the tribes of the earth will mourn over him. Even so, Amen.

kikuyu: Waaqni Gooftaan Waan Hunda Dandaʼu, “Ani Alfaa fi Omeegaa dha; isa jiru, isa turee fi isa dhufuuf jiruu dha” jedha.
english: “I am the Alpha and the Omega,” says the Lord God, “who is and who was and who is to come, the Almighty.”

kikuyu: Ani obboleessi keessan Yohannis dhiphina keessatti, mootummaa fi obsa Yesuus Kiristoos keessattis isin wajjin kan hirmaadhu sababii dubbii Waaqaatii fi sababii dhuga baʼumsa Yesuus Kiristoosiif Phaaximoos biyya bishaaniin marfamte irran ture.
english: I John, your brother and partner with you in the oppression, Kingdom, and perseverance in Christ Jesus, was on the isle that is called Patmos because of God’s Word and the testimony of Jesus Christ.

kikuyu: Anis guyyaa Gooftaatti Hafuuraanin ture; dugda koo duubaanis sagalee guddaa akka malakataa tokko nan dhagaʼe;
english: I was in the Spirit on the Lord’s day, and I heard behind me a loud voice, like a trumpet

kikuyu: sagaleen sunis, “Waan argitu kitaaba maramaa irratti barreessiitii gara waldoota kiristaanaa torbaniitti jechuunis Efesoonitti, Samirnaatti, Phergaamoonitti, Tiyaatiraatti, Sardeesitti, Filaadelfiyaattii fi Lodooqiyaatti ergi” jedhe.
english: saying, “What you see, write in a book and send to the seven assemblies: to Ephesus, Smyrna, Pergamum, Thyatira, Sardis, Philadelphia, and to Laodicea.”

kikuyu: Anis sagalee natti dubbachaa ture sana ilaaluuf jedheen of irra gara gale. Ani yommuun of irra gara galetti baattuuwwan ibsaa kanneen warqee irraa hojjetaman torba nan arge;
english: I turned to see the voice that spoke with me. Having turned, I saw seven golden lamp stands.

kikuyu: baattuuwwan ibsaa sana gidduus kan, “ilma namaa fakkaatu” tokkotu ture; innis uffata dheeraa miilla gaʼu uffatee, naannoo qoma isaatti immoo sabbata warqee hidhatee ture.
english: And among the lamp stands was one like a son of man, clothed with a robe reaching down to his feet, and with a golden sash around his chest.

kikuyu: Mataan isaatii fi rifeensi mataa isaa adii akka rifeensa hoolaa, adii akka cabbii ture; iji isaas akka arraba ibiddaa turte.
english: His head and his hair were white as white wool, like snow. His eyes were like a flame of fire.

kikuyu: Miilli isaas naasii boolla ibiddaa keessatti diimeffame fakkaata ture; sagaleen isaa immoo akkuma sagalee bishaan baayʼee ti.
english: His feet were like burnished brass, as if it had been refined in a furnace. His voice was like the voice of many waters.

kikuyu: Harka isaa mirgaatiin urjiiwwan torba qabatee ture; afaan isaa keessaas goraadee qara lama qabutu baʼaa ture. Fuulli isaas biiftuu humna guutuun iftu fakkaata ture.
english: He had seven stars in his right hand. Out of his mouth proceeded a sharp two-edged sword. His face was like the sun shining at its brightest.

kikuyu: Ani yommuun isa argetti akka nama duʼee miilla isaa jalattin kufe. Inni immoo harka isaa mirgaa narra kaaʼee akkana naan jedhe: “Hin sodaatin. Ani kan Jalqabaatii fi kan Dhumaa ti.
english: When I saw him, I fell at his feet like a dead man. He laid his right hand on me, saying, “Don’t be afraid. I am the first and the last,

kikuyu: Isa jiraataa dhas; ani duʼeen ture; kunoo, bara baraa hamma bara baraatti nan jiraadha! Furtuu duʼaatii fi kan Siiʼoolis qaba.
english: and the Living one. I was dead, and behold, I am alive forever and ever. Amen. I have the keys of Death and of Hades.

kikuyu: “Kanaafuu ati waan argite, waan amma jiruu fi waan gara fuulduraatti taʼu barreessi.
english: Write therefore the things which you have seen, and the things which are, and the things which will happen hereafter.

kikuyu: Icciitiin urjiiwwan torbaa kanneen ati harka koo mirgaa keessatti argiteetii fi baattuuwwan ibsaa kanneen warqee irraa hojjetaman torbanii isa kana: Urjiiwwan torban ergamoota waldaa kiristaanaa torbaa ti; baattuuwwan ibsaa torban immoo waldoota kiristaanaa torbanii dha.
english: The mystery of the seven stars which you saw in my right hand, and the seven golden lamp stands is this: The seven stars are the angels of the seven assemblies. The seven lamp stands are seven assemblies.

kikuyu: “Ergamaa Waaqaa kan waldaa kiristaanaa Efesoonittiakkana jedhii barreessi: Inni urjiiwwan torba harka isaa mirgaatti qabatee baattuuwwan ibsaa kanneen warqee irraa hojjetaman gidduu deddeebiʼu sun akkana jedha.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Ephesus write: “He who holds the seven stars in his right hand, he who walks among the seven golden lamp stands says these things:

kikuyu: Ani hojii kee, dadhabbii keetii fi obsaan dhaabachuu kee beeka. Akka ati calʼiftee namoota hamoo hin dhiifne, warra utuu ergamoota hin taʼin ergamoota ofiin jedhan qortee akka isaan sobduu taʼan mirkaneessites nan beeka.
english: “I know your works, and your toil and perseverance, and that you can’t tolerate evil men, and have tested those who call themselves apostles, and they are not, and found them false.

kikuyu: Ati maqaa kootiif jettee obsaan dhaabatteerta; rakkina obsiteerta; hin dadhabnes.
english: You have perseverance and have endured for my name’s sake, and have not grown weary.

kikuyu: Taʼus jaalala kee isa jalqabaa dhiisuu keetiif ani waan sirraa jibbu xinnoo qaba.
english: But I have this against you, that you left your first love.

kikuyu: Kanaaf ati maal irraa akka kufte yaadadhu! Qalbii jijjiirradhuutii hojii kee kan duraa sana hojjedhu. Yoo ati qalbii jijjiirrachuu baatte immoo ani sittin dhufa; baattuu ibsaa keetiis iddoo isaatii nan fuudha.
english: Remember therefore from where you have fallen, and repent and do the first works; or else I am coming to you swiftly, and will move your lamp stand out of its place, unless you repent.

kikuyu: Garuu waan gaarii tokko qabda: Hojii Niqolaawotaa kan ani jibbu sana atis ni jibbita.
english: But this you have, that you hate the works of the Nicolaitans, which I also hate.

kikuyu: Namni gurra qabu waan Hafuurri waldoota kiristaanaatiin jedhu haa dhagaʼu. Nama moʼatu akka inni muka jireenyaa kan jannata Waaqaa keessa jiru irraa nyaatuuf mirga nan kennaaf.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes I will give to eat from the tree of life, which is in the Paradise of my God.

kikuyu: “Ergamaa Waaqaa kan waldaa kiristaanaa Samirnaattiakkana jedhii barreessi: Inni Jalqabaatii fi inni Dhumaa, inni duʼee turee fi amma immoo jiraataa taʼe sun akkana jedha.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Smyrna write: “The first and the last, who was dead, and has come to life says these things:

kikuyu: Ani rakkinaa fi hiyyummaa kee beeka; taʼus ati sooressa! Arrabsoo warra utuu Yihuudoota hin taʼin Yihuudoota ofiin jedhan sanaas nan beeka; isaan garuu waldaa Seexanaa ti.
english: “I know your works, oppression, and your poverty (but you are rich), and the blasphemy of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but are a synagogue of Satan.

kikuyu: Dhiphina sirra gaʼuuf jiru hin sodaatin. Kunoo, akka qoramtaniif diiyaabiloos isin keessaa namoota tokko tokko mana hidhaatti ni galcha. Guyyaa kudhanis ni dhiphattu. Ati hamma duʼaatti amanamaa taʼi; ani gonfoo jireenyaa siifin kennaatii.
english: Don’t be afraid of the things which you are about to suffer. Behold, the devil is about to throw some of you into prison, that you may be tested; and you will have oppression for ten days. Be faithful to death, and I will give you the crown of life.

kikuyu: Namni gurra qabu waan Hafuurri waldoota kiristaanaatiin jedhu haa dhagaʼu. Namni moʼatu duʼa lammaffaan hin miidhamu.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. He who overcomes won’t be harmed by the second death.

kikuyu: “Ergamaa Waaqaa kan waldaa kiristaanaa Phergaamoonittiakkana jedhii barreessi: Inni goraadee qaramaa afaan lamaa qabu sun akkana jedha.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Pergamum write: “He who has the sharp two-edged sword says these things:

kikuyu: Ani iddoo ati jiraattu beeka; innis iddoo teessoon Seexanaa jiruu dha. Taʼus ati maqaa koo jabeessitee qabatteerta. Bara Antiiphaas dhuga baatuun koo amanamaan magaalaa keessan keessatti iddoo Seexanni jiraatutti ajjeefame illee ati amantii narratti qabdu hin dhiifne.
english: “I know your works and where you dwell, where Satan’s throne is. You hold firmly to my name, and didn’t deny my faith in the days of Antipas my witness, my faithful one, who was killed among you, where Satan dwells.

kikuyu: Haa taʼuu malee sababii ati namoota barsiisa Balaʼaamduukaa buʼan achii qabduuf ani waan sirraa jibbu xinnoo qaba; namni akka inni saba Israaʼel dura gufuu kaaʼee akka isaan nyaata waaqota tolfamoof aarsaa dhiʼeeffame nyaatanii fi akka isaan halalummaadhaan jiraatan godhuuf jedhee Baalaaqin barsiise Balaʼaam tureetii.
english: But I have a few things against you, because you have there some who hold the teaching of Balaam, who taught Balak to throw a stumbling block before the children of Israel, to eat things sacrificed to idols, and to commit sexual immorality.

kikuyu: Akkasumas namoota barsiisa Niqolaawotaa duukaa buʼan tokko tokko of biraa qabda.
english: So also you likewise have some who hold to the teaching of the Nicolaitans.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu qalbii jijjiirradhu! Yoo kanaa achii ani dafeen sitti dhufa; goraadee afaan kootiitiinis jara sana nan lola.
english: Repent therefore, or else I am coming to you quickly and I will make war against them with the sword of my mouth.

kikuyu: Namni gurra qabu waan Hafuurri waldoota kiristaanaatiin jedhu haa dhagaʼu. Nama moʼatuuf mannaa dhokfame irraa nan kenna. Akkasumas dhagaa adii maqaan haaraan irratti barreeffame tokko nan kennaaf; maqaa sanas namicha isa fudhatu sana malee namni tokko iyyuu hin beeku.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies. To him who overcomes, to him I will give of the hidden manna, and I will give him a white stone, and on the stone a new name written which no one knows but he who receives it.

kikuyu: “Ergamaa Waaqaa kan Waaqaa kan waldaa Kiristaanaa Tiyaatiraattiakkana jedhii barreessi: Ilmi Waaqaa inni iji isaa arraba ibiddaa fakkaatu, kan miilli isaa immoo naasii baqfamee qulqulleeffame fakkaatu sun akkana jedha.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Thyatira write: “The Son of God, who has his eyes like a flame of fire, and his feet are like burnished brass, says these things:

kikuyu: Ani hojii kee, jaalalaa fi amantii kee, tajaajilaa fi obsaan dhaabachuu kee beeka; akkasumas akka hojiin kee inni ammaa kun isa duraa caalu nan beeka.
english: “I know your works, your love, faith, service, patient endurance, and that your last works are more than the first.

kikuyu: Haa taʼuu malee sababii ati dubartittii raajii ofiin jettu Iizaabelin calʼiftee ilaaltuuf ani waan sirraa jibbu xinnoo qaba. Isheenis barsiisa isheetiin tajaajiltoota koo gowwoomsitee akka isaan halalummaa hojjetanii fi akka isaan nyaata waaqota tolfamoof aarsaa dhiʼeeffame nyaatan gooti.
english: But I have this against you, that you tolerate your woman Jezebel, who calls herself a prophetess. She teaches and seduces my servants to commit sexual immorality and to eat things sacrificed to idols.

kikuyu: Ani akka isheen halalummaa ishee irraa qalbii jijjiirrattuuf yeroo kenneefiin ture; isheen garuu ni didde.
english: I gave her time to repent, but she refuses to repent of her sexual immorality.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani siree dhiphinaa irratti ishee nan gata; warra ishee wajjin ejjanis yoo isaan karaa ishee irraa qalbii jijjiirrachuu baatan rakkina guddaa keessa isaan nan buusa.
english: Behold, I will throw her and those who commit adultery with her into a bed of great oppression, unless they repent of her works.

kikuyu: Ijoollee ishee immoo dhaʼichaan nan ajjeesa. Waldoonni kiristaanaa hundinuus akka ani kalee fi onnee qoru ni beeku; anis tokkoo tokkoo keessaniif akkuma hojii keessaniitti gatii keessan isinii nan kenna.
english: I will kill her children with Death, and all the assemblies will know that I am he who searches the minds and hearts. I will give to each one of you according to your deeds.

kikuyu: Isin warra Tiyaatiraa keessa jiraattan kanneen barsiisa ishee duukaa hin buʼinii fi warra barsiisa Seexanaa kan dhoksaa gad fagoo jedhamu sana hin baratiniin akkana nan jedha; ‘Ani baʼaa biraa isinitti hin feʼu;
english: But to you I say, to the rest who are in Thyatira—as many as don’t have this teaching, who don’t know what some call ‘the deep things of Satan’—to you I say, I am not putting any other burden on you.

kikuyu: isin garuu hamma ani dhufutti waan qabdan sana jabeessaa qabadhaa.’
english: Nevertheless, hold that which you have firmly until I come.

kikuyu: Ani nama moʼatuuf, kan hamma dhumaattis fedhii koo guutuuf saboota irratti taayitaa nan kenna.
english: He who overcomes, and he who keeps my works to the end, to him I will give authority over the nations.

kikuyu: ‘Inni bokkuu sibiilaatiin isaan bulcha; akkuma qodaa supheettisisaan hurreessa;’ kunis akkuma ani itti Abbaa koo biraa taayitaa argadhe sanaan.
english: He will rule them with a rod of iron, shattering them like clay pots, as I also have received of my Father;

kikuyu: Ani immoo bakkalcha barii nan kennaaf.
english: and I will give him the morning star.

kikuyu: Namni gurra qabu waan Hafuurri waldoota kiristaanaatiin jedhu haa dhagaʼu.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

kikuyu: “Ergamaa Waaqaa kan waldaa kiristaanaa Sardeesittiakkana jedhii barreessi: Inni Hafuurota Waaqaa torbaa fi urjiiwwan torba qabu sun akkana jedha. Ani hojii kee beeka; ati maqumaaf jirta malee duuteerta.
english: “And to the angel of the assembly in Sardis write: “He who has the seven Spirits of God and the seven stars says these things: “I know your works, that you have a reputation of being alive, but you are dead.

kikuyu: Dammaqi! Ani fuula Waaqa kootii duratti hojiin kee guutuu taʼuu isaa hin argineetii waan duʼuu gaʼe sana jajjabeessi.
english: Wake up and strengthen the things that remain, which you were about to throw away, for I have found no works of yours perfected before my God.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu waan fudhattee fi waan dhageesse yaadadhu; waan dhageesse sanaaf ajajami; qalbiis jijjiirradhu. Yoo ati dammaquu baatte garuu ani akkuma hattuutti sitti nan dhufa; saʼaatii kamitti akka ani sitti dhufus ati hin beektu.
english: Remember therefore how you have received and heard. Keep it and repent. If therefore you won’t watch, I will come as a thief, and you won’t know what hour I will come upon you.

kikuyu: Taʼu iyyuu ati namoota uffata isaanii hin xureessin muraasa Sardees keessaa qabda. Isaanis uffata adaadii uffatanii na wajjin ni deemu; isaan kanaaf warra malanii dha.
english: Nevertheless you have a few names in Sardis that didn’t defile their garments. They will walk with me in white, for they are worthy.

kikuyu: Namni moʼu akkuma isaanii uffata adaadii ni uffata. Anis maqaa isaa kitaaba jireenyaa keessaa gonkumaa hin haqu; fuula Abbaa kootii fi ergamoota isaa durattis maqaa isaa nan beeksisa.
english: He who overcomes will be arrayed in white garments, and I will in no way blot his name out of the book of life, and I will confess his name before my Father, and before his angels.

kikuyu: Namni gurra qabu waan Hafuurri waldoota kiristaanaatiin jedhu haa dhagaʼu.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

kikuyu: “Ergamaa Waaqaa kan waldaa kiristaanaa Filaadelfiyaattiakkana jedhii barreessi: Inni qulqulluun, inni dhugaan, inni furtuu Daawit harka isaatii qabu, kan waan inni banu eenyu iyyuu cufuu hin dandeenyee fi waan inni cufus eenyu iyyuu banuu hin dandeenye sun akkana jedha.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Philadelphia write: “He who is holy, he who is true, he who has the key of David, he who opens and no one can shut, and who shuts and no one opens, says these things:

kikuyu: Ani hojii kee beeka. Kunoo, ani balbala banamaa namni cufuu hin dandeenye tokko fuula kee dura kaaʼeera. Akka ati humna xinnoo qabdus beeka; taʼus dubbii koo eegdeerta; maqaa koos hin ganne.
english: “I know your works (behold, I have set before you an open door, which no one can shut), that you have a little power, and kept my word, and didn’t deny my name.

kikuyu: Kunoo, ani warra waldaa Seexanaa taʼan kanneen utuu Yihuudoota hin taʼin Yihuudoota ofiin jedhanii soban keessaa tokko tokko akka isaan dhufanii miilla kee irratti kufanii sagadanii fi akka isaan akka ani si jaalladhe beekan nan godha.
english: Behold, I make some of the synagogue of Satan, of those who say they are Jews, and they are not, but lie—behold, I will make them to come and worship before your feet, and to know that I have loved you.

kikuyu: Ajaja ani akka ati obsaan dhaabattuuf siif kenne sana waan eegdeef, anis saʼaatii qorumsaa kan warra lafa irra jiraatan qoruuf addunyaa guutuutti dhufuuf jiru sana irraa si oolcha.
english: Because you kept my command to endure, I also will keep you from the hour of testing which is to come on the whole world, to test those who dwell on the earth.

kikuyu: Ani dafeen dhufa. Atis akka namni tokko iyyuu gonfoo kee hin fudhanneef waan qabdu jabeessii qabadhu.
english: I am coming quickly! Hold firmly that which you have, so that no one takes your crown.

kikuyu: Nama moʼatus mana qulqullummaa Waaqa koo keessatti utubaa nan godha. Innis achi keessaa gonkumaa hin baʼu. Anis maqaa Waaqa kootii fi maqaa magaalaa Waaqa koo, maqaa Yerusaalem ishee haaraa, ishee Waaqa koo biraa samii irraa gad buutu sanaa isa irratti nan barreessa; maqaa koo haaraas isa irratti nan barreessa.
english: He who overcomes, I will make him a pillar in the temple of my God, and he will go out from there no more. I will write on him the name of my God and the name of the city of my God, the new Jerusalem, which comes down out of heaven from my God, and my own new name.

kikuyu: Namni gurra qabu waan Hafuurri waldoota kiristaanaatiin jedhu haa dhagaʼu.
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.

kikuyu: “Ergamaa Waaqaa kan waldaa kiristaanaa Lodooqiyaattiakkana jedhii barreessi: Ameen, inni amanamaan, dhuga baatuun dhugaatii fi jalqabaan uumama Waaqaa sun akkana jedha.
english: “To the angel of the assembly in Laodicea write: “The Amen, the Faithful and True Witness, the Beginning of God’s creation, says these things:

kikuyu: Akka ati qabbanaaʼaa yookaan hoʼaa hin taʼin ani hojii kee beeka! Ani utuu ati qabbanaaʼaa yookaan hoʼaa taatee silaa nan hawwa ture.
english: “I know your works, that you are neither cold nor hot. I wish you were cold or hot.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ati waan laphiitaateef, hoʼaa yookaan qabbanaaʼaa waan hin taʼiniif ani afaan kootii si tufuu gaʼeera.
english: So, because you are lukewarm, and neither hot nor cold, I will vomit you out of my mouth.

kikuyu: Ati, ‘Ani sooressa; qabeenya argadheera; wanni na barbaachisu tokko iyyuu hin jiru’ jetta. Garuu ati deegaa, rakkataa, hiyyeessa, jaamaa fi qullaa taʼuu kee hin beektu.
english: Because you say, ‘I am rich, and have gotten riches, and have need of nothing,’ and don’t know that you are the wretched one, miserable, poor, blind, and naked;

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ati akka sooromtuuf, warqee ibiddaan qulqulleeffame akka narraa bitattu, akka qullaa kee qaanessaa sana haguuggattuufis uffata adii uffattu akka narraa bitattu, akka arguu dandeessuuf immoo kuulii ijatti naqattu akka narraa bitattu sin gorsa.
english: I counsel you to buy from me gold refined by fire, that you may become rich; and white garments, that you may clothe yourself, and that the shame of your nakedness may not be revealed; and eye salve to anoint your eyes, that you may see.

kikuyu: Ani warran jaalladhu nan ifadha; nan adabas. Kanaafuu jabaadhu; qalbii jijjiirradhus.
english: As many as I love, I reprove and chasten. Be zealous therefore, and repent.

kikuyu: Kunoo, ani balbala dura dhaabadheen balbala rurrukuta. Yoo namni kam iyyuu sagalee koo dhagaʼee balbala naaf bane, ani ol seenee isa wajjin irbaata nan nyaadha; innis na wajjin ni nyaata.
english: Behold, I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, then I will come in to him and will dine with him, and he with me.

kikuyu: Akkuma ani moʼadhee Abbaa koo wajjin teessoo isaa irra taaʼe sana, namni moʼatus akka inni na wajjin teessoo koo irra taaʼuuf mirga nan kennaaf.
english: He who overcomes, I will give to him to sit down with me on my throne, as I also overcame and sat down with my Father on his throne.

kikuyu: Namni gurra qabu waan Hafuurri waldoota kiristaanaatiin jedhu haa dhagaʼu.”
english: He who has an ear, let him hear what the Spirit says to the assemblies.”

kikuyu: Anis ergasii nan ilaale; kunoo balballi banamaan tokko fuula koo dura samii keessa ture. Sagaleen jalqabaa kan ani utuu inni akka malakataatti natti dubbatuu dhagaʼe sun, “As ol kottu; anis waan asiin booddee taʼuu qabu sittin argisiisaa” jedhe.
english: After these things I looked and saw a door opened in heaven; and the first voice that I heard, like a trumpet speaking with me, was one saying, “Come up here, and I will show you the things which must happen after this.”

kikuyu: Anis yommusuma Hafuuraanan ture; kunoo, teessoon namni tokko irra taaʼe tokko samii keessa ture.
english: Immediately I was in the Spirit. Behold, there was a throne set in heaven, and one sitting on the throne

kikuyu: Inni achi taaʼes dhagaa gatii guddaa yaasphiidiitii fi sardiyoon fakkaata ture. Naannoo teessoo sanaas sabbata Waaqaa kan bifti isaa dhagaa maragdi fakkaatutu ture.
english: that looked like a jasper stone and a sardius. There was a rainbow around the throne, like an emerald to look at.

kikuyu: Naannoo teessoo sanaas teessoowwan biraa digdamii afurtu ture. Teessoowwan sana irras maanguddoonni digdamii afur uffata adaadii uffatanii, mataa isaaniitti immoo gonfoo warqee kaaʼatanii tataaʼanii turan.
english: Around the throne were twenty-four thrones. On the thrones were twenty-four elders sitting, dressed in white garments, with crowns of gold on their heads.

kikuyu: Teessoo sana keessaas ifni balaqqee ni mulʼate; kakawwee fi sagaleen ni dhagaʼame. Teessoo sana fuuldurattis guci torba bobaʼaa ture. Isaan kunneenis Hafuurota Waaqaa torbanii dha.
english: Out of the throne proceed lightnings, sounds, and thunders. There were seven lamps of fire burning before his throne, which are the seven Spirits of God.

kikuyu: Akkasumas wanni galaana bilillee fakkaatu kan akka of-ilaalee qulqullaaʼe tokko teessoo sana fuuldura ture. Walakkaa naannoo teessoo sanaas uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyii afurtu ture; isaanis duraa fi duubaan ijaan guutamanii turan.
english: Before the throne was something like a sea of glass, similar to crystal. In the middle of the throne, and around the throne were four living creatures full of eyes before and behind.

kikuyu: Uumamni lubbuu qabeessi jalqabaa leenca, inni lammaffaan sangaa fakkaata ture; inni sadaffaan fuula akka fuula namaa qaba ture; afuraffaan immoo risaa barrisu fakkaata ture.
english: The first creature was like a lion, the second creature like a calf, the third creature had a face like a man, and the fourth was like a flying eagle.

kikuyu: Tokkoon tokkoon uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyii afranii qoochoo jaʼa jaʼa qabu turan; duubni isaaniitii fi keessi isaaniis ijaan guutamee ture. Isaanis utuu aara hin galfatin halkanii guyyaa, “ ‘Waaqni Gooftaan Waan Hunda Dandaʼu’ inni ture, inni jiruu fi inni dhufuuf jiru, ‘Qulqulluu, qulqulluu, qulqulluu dha’ ” jedhanii faarfachuu hin dhiisan.
english: The four living creatures, each one of them having six wings, are full of eyes around and within. They have no rest day and night, saying, “Holy, holy, holy is the Lord God, the Almighty, who was and who is and who is to come!”

kikuyu: Uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyiin sun isa teessoo irra taaʼee jiru kan bara baraa hamma bara baraatti jiraatu sanaaf ulfina, kabajaa fi galata yommuu kennanitti,
english: When the living creatures give glory, honor, and thanks to him who sits on the throne, to him who lives forever and ever,

kikuyu: maanguddoonni digdamii afran sunis fuula isa teessoo irra taaʼee jiru sanaa duratti kufanii isa bara baraa hamma bara baraatti jiraatu sanaaf ni sagadan. Gonfoowwan isaaniis fuula teessoo sanaa dura kakaaʼanii akkana jedhu:
english: the twenty-four elders fall down before him who sits on the throne and worship him who lives forever and ever, and throw their crowns before the throne, saying,

kikuyu: “Yaa Gooftaa fi Waaqa keenya, ati waan hunda waan uumteef, isaan fedhii keetiin waan uumamaniif, waan jiraataniifis, ulfina, kabajaa fi humna fudhachuun siif ni mala.”
english: “Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all things, and because of your desire they existed and were created!”

kikuyu: Anis harka mirga isa teessoo irra taaʼe sanaa irratti kitaaba maramaa keessaa fi duubaan itti barreeffamee chaappaa torbaan cufame tokko nan arge.
english: I saw, in the right hand of him who sat on the throne, a book written inside and outside, sealed shut with seven seals.

kikuyu: Anis ergamaa Waaqaa isa jabaa sagalee guddaadhaan, “Chaappaa hiikuun, kitaaba maramaas banuun kan maluuf eenyu inni?” jedhee labsu tokko nan arge.
english: I saw a mighty angel proclaiming with a loud voice, “Who is worthy to open the book, and to break its seals?”

kikuyu: Garuu namni tokko iyyuu samii keessaa yookaan lafa irraa yookaan lafa jalaa kitaaba maramaa banuu yookaan keessa isaa iyyuu ilaaluu hin dandeenye.
english: No one in heaven above, or on the earth, or under the earth, was able to open the book or to look in it.

kikuyu: Anis waan namni kitaaba maramaa banuun yookaan keessa isaa ilaaluun maluuf tokko iyyuu dhabameef baayʼisee nan booʼe.
english: Then I wept much, because no one was found worthy to open the book or to look in it.

kikuyu: Ergasiis maanguddoota sana keessaa inni tokko, “Hin booʼin! Kunoo, Leenci gosa Yihuudaa, Hiddi Daawit moʼateera. Inni kitaabicha maramaa banuu, chaappaa isaa torbanuus hiikuu ni dandaʼa” naan jedhe.
english: One of the elders said to me, “Don’t weep. Behold, the Lion who is of the tribe of Judah, the Root of David, has overcome: he who opens the book and its seven seals.”

kikuyu: Anis Hoolaa waan qalame fakkaatee teessoo walakkaa uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyii afranii fi maanguddootaan marfamee dhaabatu tokko arge. Hoolichis gaanfa torbaa fi ija torba qaba ture; iji torban kunneenis Hafuurota Waaqaa kanneen gara lafa hundaatti ergaman torbanii dha.
english: I saw in the middle of the throne and of the four living creatures, and in the middle of the elders, a Lamb standing, as though it had been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the seven Spirits of God, sent out into all the earth.

kikuyu: Innis dhufee harka mirgaa isa teessoo irra taaʼee jiru sanaa irraa kitaaba maramaa fudhate.
english: Then he came, and he took it out of the right hand of him who sat on the throne.

kikuyu: Yommuu inni kitaaba maramaa sana fudhatettis uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyii afranii fi maanguddoonni digdamii afran fuula Hoolichaa duratti kufan. Tokkoon tokkoon isaanii baganaa qabu turan; isaanis miʼa ixaanaa kan warqee irraa hojjetamee fi kan ixaanni keessa guute harkaa qabu turan; ixaanni kunis kadhannaa qulqullootaa ti.
english: Now when he had taken the book, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell down before the Lamb, each one having a harp, and golden bowls full of incense, which are the prayers of the saints.

kikuyu: Isaanis akkana jedhanii faarfannaa haaraa faarfatan; “Kitaaba maramaa fuudhuun, chaappaa kitaabicha maramaas hiikuun siif mala; sababiin isaas ati qalamtee, gosa hundumaa keessaa, afaan hunda keessaa, saba hunda keessaa, sanyii hunda keessaa, namoota dhiiga keetiin Waaqaaf bitteertaatii.
english: They sang a new song, saying, “You are worthy to take the book and to open its seals, for you were killed, and bought us for God with your blood out of every tribe, language, people, and nation,

kikuyu: Akka isaan mootummaa fi luboota Waaqa keenyaa taʼanis gooteerta; isaanis lafa irratti ni moʼu.”
english: and made us kings and priests to our God; and we will reign on the earth.”

kikuyu: Anis ilaalee sagalee ergamoota baayʼee dhagaʼe; baayʼinni isaaniis kumaatamaa fi kuma kumaatama ture. Isaanis teessoo sanatti, uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyii fi maanguddootatti naannaʼanii turan.
english: I looked, and I heard something like a voice of many angels around the throne, the living creatures, and the elders. The number of them was ten thousands of ten thousands, and thousands of thousands,

kikuyu: Isaanis akkana jedhanii sagalee guddaadhaan faarfatan; “Hoolaa qalame sanaaf, humnaa fi qabeenya, ogummaa fi jabina, kabajaa fi ulfina, galatas argachuun ni mala!”
english: saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength, honor, glory, and blessing!”

kikuyu: Anis ergasii uumamni samii keessa jiru, kan lafa irra jiru, kan lafa jala jiruu fi kan galaana keessa jiru hundi, uumamni isaan keessa jiru hundinuus, “Isa teessoo irra taaʼu sanaa fi Hoolichaaf, galannii fi kabajni, ulfinnii fi humni, bara baraa hamma bara baraatti haa taʼu!” jedhanii utuu faarfatanuu nan dhagaʼe.
english: I heard every created thing which is in heaven, on the earth, under the earth, on the sea, and everything in them, saying, “To him who sits on the throne and to the Lamb be the blessing, the honor, the glory, and the dominion, forever and ever! Amen!”

kikuyu: Uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyiin afran, “Ameen” jedhan; maanguddoonnis kufanii sagadan.
english: The four living creatures said, “Amen!” Then the elders fell down and worshiped.

kikuyu: Anis yommuu Hoolichi chaappaawwan torban keessaa isa jalqabaa banu nan arge. Ergasiis uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyii keessaa inni tokko sagalee akka kakawweetiin, “Kottu!” jechuu isaa nan dhagaʼe.
english: I saw that the Lamb opened one of the seven seals, and I heard one of the four living creatures saying, as with a voice of thunder, “Come and see!”

kikuyu: Anis nan ilaale; kunoo, fardi adiin tokko fuula koo dura ture! Inni farda sana yaabbates iddaa harkatti qabatee ture; gonfoonis ni kennameef; innis moʼachaa, ammas moʼachuuf baʼe.
english: Then a white horse appeared, and he who sat on it had a bow. A crown was given to him, and he came out conquering, and to conquer.

kikuyu: Yommuu Hoolichi chaappaa lammaffaa banettis uumamni jiraataan inni lammaffaan, “Kottu!” jechuu isaa nan dhagaʼe.
english: When he opened the second seal, I heard the second living creature saying, “Come!”

kikuyu: Fardi biraa daamaan tokkos ni dhufe. Isa fardicha yaabbatuufis akka inni nagaa lafa irraa balleessuu fi akka namoonni wal gorraʼan akka godhuuf humni kennameef; goraadeen guddaan tokkos ni kennameef.
english: Another came out, a red horse. To him who sat on it was given power to take peace from the earth, and that they should kill one another. There was given to him a great sword.

kikuyu: Yommuu Hoolichi chaappaa sadaffaa banettis uumamni jiraataan inni sadaffaan, “Kottu!” jechuu isaa nan dhagaʼe; nan ilaales; kunoo, fardi gurraachi tokko fuula koo dura ture! Inni fardicha yaabbatus madaalii of harkaa qaba ture.
english: When he opened the third seal, I heard the third living creature saying, “Come and see!” And behold, a black horse, and he who sat on it had a balance in his hand.

kikuyu: Anis waan akka sagalee uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyii afran gidduu dubbatame fakkaatu tokko, “Qamadiin safartuu tokkoo mindaa guyyaa tokkootiif, garbuun safartuu sadiis mindaa guyyaa tokkootiif haa taʼu; garuu zayitii fi daadhii wayinii hin miidhin!” jechuu isaa nan dhagaʼe.
english: I heard a voice in the middle of the four living creatures saying, “A choenix of wheat for a denarius, and three choenix of barley for a denarius! Don’t damage the oil and the wine!”

kikuyu: Yommuu Hoolichi chaappaa afuraffaa banetti sagalee uumama jiraataa afuraffaa kan, “Kottu!” jedhu nan dhagaʼe.
english: When he opened the fourth seal, I heard the fourth living creature saying, “Come and see!”

kikuyu: Anis nan ilaale; kunoo, fardi daalachi tokko fuula koo dura ture! Inni fardicha yaabbatus maqaan isaa Duʼa jedhama ture; Siiʼoolis dugda duubaan itti dhiʼaatee isa duukaa buʼaa ture. Isaanis goraadeen, beelaan, balaa fi bineensota lafaatiin akka ajjeesaniif kurmaana lafaa irratti humni ni kennameef.
english: And behold, a pale horse, and the name of he who sat on it was Death. Hades followed with him. Authority over one fourth of the earth, to kill with the sword, with famine, with death, and by the wild animals of the earth was given to him.

kikuyu: Yommuu inni chaappaa shanaffaa banetti ani iddoo aarsaa jalatti lubbuuwwan warra sababii dubbii Waaqaatii fi sababii dhuga baʼumsa eegan sanaatiif gorraʼamanii nan arge.
english: When he opened the fifth seal, I saw underneath the altar the souls of those who had been killed for the Word of God, and for the testimony of the Lamb which they had.

kikuyu: Isaanis sagalee guddaadhaan, “Yaa Gooftaa Waan Hundaa Olii, qulqullichaa fi dhugaa, ati warra lafa irra jiraatanitti utuu hin murin hamma yoomiitti turta? Hamma yoomiittis dhiiga keenyaaf haaloo hin baatu?” jedhanii iyyan.
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “How long, Master, the holy and true, until you judge and avenge our blood on those who dwell on the earth?”

kikuyu: Tokkoo tokkoo isaaniitiifis uffanni adaadiin ni kenname; hamma lakkoobsi warra isaan wajjin tajaajilaniitii fi lakkoobsi obboloota isaanii kanneen akkuma isaaniitti ajjeefamuuf jiran sanaa guutamutti akka yeroo xinnoo obsan isaanitti himame.
english: A long white robe was given to each of them. They were told that they should rest yet for a while, until their fellow servants and their brothers, who would also be killed even as they were, should complete their course.

kikuyu: Yommuu inni chaappaa jaʼaffaa banettis nan arge. Sochii lafaa guddaa tokkotu ture. Aduun akka uffata gaddaa gurraachofte; jiʼis akkuma dhiigaa diimate;
english: I saw when he opened the sixth seal, and there was a great earthquake. The sun became black as sackcloth made of hair, and the whole moon became as blood.

kikuyu: urjiiwwan samiis akkuma iji muka harbuu yommuu qilleensa jabaan raafamutti harcaʼu sana lafatti gad harcaʼan.
english: The stars of the sky fell to the earth, like a fig tree dropping its unripe figs when it is shaken by a great wind.

kikuyu: Samiin akkuma kitaaba maramaatti marame; tulluu fi biyyi bishaaniin marfamtes iddoo isaaniitii buqqifaman.
english: The sky was removed like a scroll when it is rolled up. Every mountain and island was moved out of its place.

kikuyu: Mootonni lafa irraa, bulchitoonnii fi abbootiin duulaa, sooreyyii fi namoonni jajjaboonni, namoonni kaan hundi, garbas taʼu birmaduun holqa keessaa fi kattaawwan tulluuwwanii gidduutti dhokatan.
english: The kings of the earth, the princes, the commanding officers, the rich, the strong, and every slave and free person, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains.

kikuyu: Isaanis tulluuwwanii fi kattaawwan waammatanii akkana jedhu; “Nurratti kufaa; fuula isa teessoo irra taaʼu sanaatii fi dheekkamsa Hoolichaa duraa nu dhoksaa!
english: They told the mountains and the rocks, “Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him who sits on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb,

kikuyu: Guyyaan dheekkamsa isaa guddaan sun gaʼeeraatii; egaa eenyutu guyyaa sana dura dhaabachuu dandaʼa ree?”
english: for the great day of his wrath has come, and who is able to stand?”

kikuyu: Ergasiis ani utuu ergamoonni afur golee lafaa afran irra dhaabatanii akka bubbeen lafatti yookaan galaanatti yookaan muka kamitti iyyuu hin bubbifne bubbee lafaa afran dhowwanuu nan arge.
english: After this, I saw four angels standing at the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, so that no wind would blow on the earth, or on the sea, or on any tree.

kikuyu: Ergamaan chaappaa Waaqa jiraataa qabu kaan immoo utuu karaa baʼa biiftuutiin ol baʼuu nan arge. Innis ergamoota afran akka isaan lafaa fi galaana miidhaniif humni kennameef sana sagalee guddaadhaan waamee,
english: I saw another angel ascend from the sunrise, having the seal of the living God. He cried with a loud voice to the four angels to whom it was given to harm the earth and the sea,

kikuyu: “Hamma nu adda tajaajiltoota Waaqa keenyaa irratti chaappaa goonutti lafa yookaan galaana yookaan muka hin miidhinaa” jedhe.
english: saying, “Don’t harm the earth, the sea, or the trees, until we have sealed the bondservants of our God on their foreheads!”

kikuyu: Anis baayʼina warra chaappeffamanii dhagaʼe: gosa Israaʼel hunda keessaa 144,000 ture.
english: I heard the number of those who were sealed, one hundred forty-four thousand, sealed out of every tribe of the children of Israel:

kikuyu: Gosa Yihuudaa keessaa 12,000, gosa Ruubeen keessaa 12,000, gosa Gaad keessaa 12,000,
english: of the tribe of Judah twelve thousand were sealed, of the tribe of Reuben twelve thousand, of the tribe of Gad twelve thousand,

kikuyu: gosa Aasheer keessaa 12,000, gosa Niftaalem keessaa 12,000, gosa Minaasee keessaa 12,000,
english: of the tribe of Asher twelve thousand, of the tribe of Naphtali twelve thousand, of the tribe of Manasseh twelve thousand,

kikuyu: gosa Simiʼoon keessaa 12,000, gosa Lewwii keessaa 12,000, gosa Yisaakor keessaa 12,000,
english: of the tribe of Simeon twelve thousand, of the tribe of Levi twelve thousand, of the tribe of Issachar twelve thousand,

kikuyu: gosa Zebuuloon keessaa 12,000, gosa Yoosef keessaa 12,000, gosa Beniyaam keessaa 12,000 turan.
english: of the tribe of Zebulun twelve thousand, of the tribe of Joseph twelve thousand, and of the tribe of Benjamin twelve thousand were sealed.

kikuyu: Anis kana booddee nan ilaale; kunoo, tuunni guddaan namni tokko iyyuu lakkaaʼuu hin dandeenye kan saba hundumaa, gosa hundumaa, nama hundumaa fi afaan hundumaa keessaa walitti qabame tokko teessoo sana duraa fi fuula Hoolichaa dura dhaabatee ture. Isaanis uffata adaadii uffatanii, damee meexxiis harkatti qabatanii turan.
english: After these things I looked, and behold, a great multitude which no man could count, out of every nation and of all tribes, peoples, and languages, standing before the throne and before the Lamb, dressed in white robes, with palm branches in their hands.

kikuyu: Isaanis sagalee guddaadhaan, “Fayyinni kan Waaqa keenya isa teessoo irra taaʼuutii fi kan Hoolichaati” jedhanii iyyan.
english: They cried with a loud voice, saying, “Salvation be to our God, who sits on the throne, and to the Lamb!”

kikuyu: Ergamoonni hundinuu teessichatti, maanguddootaa fi uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyii afranitti naannaʼanii dhadhaabachaa turan. Isaanis adda isaaniitiin fuula teessoo sanaa duratti gombifamanii Waaqaaf sagadan;
english: All the angels were standing around the throne, the elders, and the four living creatures; and they fell on their faces before his throne, and worshiped God,

kikuyu: akkanas jedhan: “Ameen! Eebbii fi ulfinni, ogummaan, galanni, kabajni, humnii fi jabinni, bara baraa hamma bara baraatti Waaqa keenyaaf haa taʼu. Ameen!”
english: saying, “Amen! Blessing, glory, wisdom, thanksgiving, honor, power, and might, be to our God forever and ever! Amen.”

kikuyu: Maanguddoota keessaas inni tokko, “Warri uffata adaadii uffatan kunneen eenyu faʼi? Eessaa dhufan?” jedhee na gaafate.
english: One of the elders answered, saying to me, “These who are arrayed in the white robes, who are they, and where did they come from?”

kikuyu: Anis, “Yaa Gooftaa, situ beeka” jedheen deebiseef. Inni immoo akkana naan jedhe; “Isaan kunneen warra dhiphina guddaa keessaa baʼanii dhufanii dha; isaanis dhiiga Hoolichaatiin uffata isaanii miicatanii addeeffataniiru.
english: I told him, “My lord, you know.” He said to me, “These are those who came out of the great suffering. They washed their robes and made them white in the Lamb’s blood.

kikuyu: Kanaafuu, “Isaan teessoo Waaqaa dura jiru; halkanii guyyaas mana qulqullummaa isaa keessatti isa tajaajilu; inni teessicha irra taaʼee jiru sunis isaan gidduu jiraata.
english: Therefore they are before the throne of God, and they serve him day and night in his temple. He who sits on the throne will spread his tabernacle over them.

kikuyu: ‘Isaanis siʼachi gonkumaa hin beelaʼan; siʼachis gonkumaa hin dheebotan. Aduun isaan hin dhaʼu;’ hoʼi finiinaanis isaan hin gubu.
english: They will never be hungry or thirsty any more. The sun won’t beat on them, nor any heat;

kikuyu: Hoolichi walakkaa teessoo sanaa jiru tiksee isaanii ni taʼaatii; ‘inni gara burqaa bishaan jireenyaatti isaan geessa.’ ‘Waaqnis imimmaan hunda ija isaanii irraa ni haqa.’ ”
english: for the Lamb who is in the middle of the throne shepherds them and leads them to springs of life-giving waters. And God will wipe away every tear from their eyes.”

kikuyu: Yommuu Hoolichi chaappaa torbaffaa banetti gara walakkaa saʼaatii tokkoo samii keessa tasgabbiitu ture.
english: When he opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

kikuyu: Anis ergamoota fuula Waaqaa dura dhadhaabatan torban arge; isaaniifis malakanni torba ni kenname.
english: I saw the seven angels who stand before God, and seven trumpets were given to them.

kikuyu: Ergamaan biraa kan girgiraa warqee qabu tokko dhufee iddoo aarsaa bira dhaabate. Innis iddoo aarsaa warqee kan fuula teessichaa dura jiru sana irratti akka kadhannaa qulqulloota hundumaa wajjin dhiʼeessuuf ixaanni baayʼeen isaaf ni kenname.
english: Another angel came and stood over the altar, having a golden censer. Much incense was given to him, that he should add it to the prayers of all the saints on the golden altar which was before the throne.

kikuyu: Aarri ixaana sanaas kadhannaa qulqullootaa wajjin harka ergamaa sanaa keessaa fuula Waaqaa duratti ol baʼe.
english: The smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, went up before God out of the angel’s hand.

kikuyu: Ergamaan sunis girgiraa fuudhee iddoo aarsaa irraa ibidda itti guutee lafatti gad darbate; ergasiis sagaleen kakawwee, balaqqeessaa fi sochii lafaa ni dhagaʼame.
english: The angel took the censer, and he filled it with the fire of the altar, then threw it on the earth. Thunders, sounds, lightnings, and an earthquake followed.

kikuyu: Ergamoonni Waaqaa torban warri malakata torban qabanis malakata afuufuuf ni qophaaʼan.
english: The seven angels who had the seven trumpets prepared themselves to sound.

kikuyu: Ergamaan jalqabaa malakata isaa afuufe; cabbii fi ibiddi dhiigaan makames lafatti gad darbatame. Lafti harka sadii keessaa harki tokko ni gubatte; muktis harka sadii keessaa harki tokko ni gubate; margi lalisaan hundinuus ni gubate.
english: The first sounded, and there followed hail and fire, mixed with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. One third of the earth was burned up, and one third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

kikuyu: Ergamaan lammaffaanis malakata isaa afuufe; wanni tulluu guddaa fakkaatu kan ibiddaan gubachaa jiru tokkos galaanatti gad darbatame. Galaannis harka sadii keessaa harki tokko dhiiga taʼe;
english: The second angel sounded, and something like a great burning mountain was thrown into the sea. One third of the sea became blood,

kikuyu: uumamawwan lubbuu qabeeyyiin galaana keessaa harka sadii keessaa harki tokko ni dhuman; dooniiwwan harka sadii keessaas harki tokko ni barbadaaʼan.
english: and one third of the living creatures which were in the sea died. One third of the ships were destroyed.

kikuyu: Ergamaan sadaffaanis malakata isaa afuufe; urjiin guddaan akka gucaa bobaʼu tokkos samii irraa lafa dhaʼe; innis lageen harka sadii keessaa harka tokko irratti, burqaawwan bishaanii irrattis kufe;
english: The third angel sounded, and a great star fell from the sky, burning like a torch, and it fell on one third of the rivers, and on the springs of water.

kikuyu: maqaan urjii sanaas “Hadheessaa” jedhama. Bishaan sunis harka sadii keessaa harki tokko ni hadhaaʼe; sababii bishaan sun hadheeffameefis namoonni baayʼeen bishaaniin dhuman.
english: The name of the star is “Wormwood.” One third of the waters became wormwood. Many people died from the waters, because they were made bitter.

kikuyu: Ergamaan afuraffaanis malakata isaa afuufe; aduun harka sadii keessaa harki tokko, jiʼi harka sadii keessaa harki tokko, urjiinis harka sadii keessaa harki tokko ni rukutaman; kanaanis ifni isaanii harka sadii keessaa harki tokko ni dukkanaaʼe. Guyyaan harka sadii keessaa harki tokko akkasumas halkan harka sadii keessaa harki tokko ifa malee hafe.
english: The fourth angel sounded, and one third of the sun was struck, and one third of the moon, and one third of the stars, so that one third of them would be darkened; and the day wouldn’t shine for one third of it, and the night in the same way.

kikuyu: Anis ilaalee risaa samii walakkaa barrisaa sagalee guddaadhaan, “Sababii sagalee malakataa kan ergamoota biraa sadaniin dhageessifamuuf jiru sanaatiif warra lafa irra jiraataniif Wayyoo! Wayyoo! Wayyoo!” jedhee iyyu tokko nan dhagaʼe.
english: I saw, and I heard an eagle, flying in mid heaven, saying with a loud voice, “Woe! Woe! Woe to those who dwell on the earth, because of the other blasts of the trumpets of the three angels, who are yet to sound!”

kikuyu: Ergamaan shanaffaan malakata isaa afuufe; anis urjii samii irraa lafa dhaʼe tokko nan arge. Urjii sanaafis furtuun “Boolla Qilee” ni kenname.
english: The fifth angel sounded, and I saw a star from the sky which had fallen to the earth. The key to the pit of the abyss was given to him.

kikuyu: Yommuu inni Boolla Qilee sana banettis aarri tokko akkuma aara boolla ibiddaa guddaa keessaa baʼuutti ol baʼe. Aduu fi samiinis aara Boolla Qilee keessaa baʼu sanaan ni dukkanaaʼan.
english: He opened the pit of the abyss, and smoke went up out of the pit, like the smoke from a burning furnace. The sun and the air were darkened because of the smoke from the pit.

kikuyu: Aara sana keessaas hawwaannisa baayʼeetu lafatti yaaʼe; hawwaannisoota sanaafis taayitaan akka taayitaa torbaanqabaa lafaa ni kenname.
english: Then out of the smoke came locusts on the earth, and power was given to them, as the scorpions of the earth have power.

kikuyu: Isaanis akka marga lafaa yookaan biqiltuu yookaan muka tokko illee miidhan utuu hin taʼin akka namoota adda isaanii irraa chaappaa Waaqaa hin qabaatin qofa miidhan ajajaman.
english: They were told that they should not hurt the grass of the earth, neither any green thing, neither any tree, but only those people who don’t have God’s seal on their foreheads.

kikuyu: Isaanis akka namoota sana jiʼa shan dhiphisaniif eeyyamameef malee akka jara ajjeesaniif miti. Dhiphinni kunis akkuma dhiphina isa yommuu torbaanqabaan nama iddutti dhiphatanii ti.
english: They were given power, not to kill them, but to torment them for five months. Their torment was like the torment of a scorpion when it strikes a person.

kikuyu: Guyyoota sana keessa namoonni duʼa barbaadu; garuu hin argatan. Duʼuus ni hawwu; duuti garuu isaan baqata.
english: In those days people will seek death, and will in no way find it. They will desire to die, and death will flee from them.

kikuyu: Bifti hawwaannisoota sanaas fardeen duulaaf qopheeffaman fakkaata ture. Mataa isaaniittis waan akka gonfoo warqee kaaʼatanii turan; fuulli isaaniis fuula namaa fakkaata ture.
english: The shapes of the locusts were like horses prepared for war. On their heads were something like golden crowns, and their faces were like people’s faces.

kikuyu: Rifeensi isaanii rifeensa mataa dubartootaa fakkaata ture; ilkaan isaaniis ilkaan leencaa fakkaata ture.
english: They had hair like women’s hair, and their teeth were like those of lions.

kikuyu: Isaanis maddaa maddaa sibiilaa fakkaatu qabu turan; sagaleen qoochoo isaaniis sagalee fardeenii fi gaariiwwan baayʼee kanneen gara duulaatti didichanii fakkaata ture.
english: They had breastplates like breastplates of iron. The sound of their wings was like the sound of many chariots and horses rushing to war.

kikuyu: Isaanis akkuma torbaanqabaa eegee fi ilkee qabu turan; eegee isaanii keessaa immoo taayitaa ittiin jiʼa shan nama dhiphisan qabu turan.
english: They have tails like those of scorpions, with stingers. In their tails they have power to harm men for five months.

kikuyu: Isaanis mootii qabu turan; innis ergamaa Boolla Qilee ti; maqaan isaas afaan Ibraayisxiitiin Abadoon, afaan Giriikiin immoo Aphooliyoon jedhama ture.
english: They have over them as king the angel of the abyss. His name in Hebrew is “Abaddon”, but in Greek, he has the name “Apollyon”.

kikuyu: Wayyoon inni duraa darbeera; kunoo, wayyoowwan biraa lamatu dhufuuf jira.
english: The first woe is past. Behold, there are still two woes coming after this.

kikuyu: Ergamaan jaʼaffaanis malakata isaa afuufe; anis gaanfa afran kanneen iddoo aarsaa warqee irraa hojjetamee fuula Waaqaa dura jiru irraa sagalee tokko nan dhagaʼe.
english: The sixth angel sounded. I heard a voice from the horns of the golden altar which is before God,

kikuyu: Sagaleen sunis ergamaa jaʼaffaa malakata qabu sanaan, “Ergamoota afran kanneen laga Efraaxiisi guddicha biratti hidhaman sana gad dhiisi” jedhe.
english: saying to the sixth angel who had the trumpet, “Free the four angels who are bound at the great river Euphrates!”

kikuyu: Ergamoonni afran saʼaatii kanaaf, guyyaa kanaaf, jiʼaa fi waggaa kanaaf qopheeffamanii turanis sanyii namaa harka sadii keessaa harka tokko fixuuf gad dhiifaman.
english: The four angels were freed who had been prepared for that hour and day and month and year, so that they might kill one third of mankind.

kikuyu: Baayʼinni loltoota fardeeniin duulanii miliyoona dhibba lama ture. Anis baayʼina isaaniis nan dhagaʼe.
english: The number of the armies of the horsemen was two hundred million. I heard the number of them.

kikuyu: Anis mulʼata koo keessatti fardeenii fi namoota farda yaabbatan nan arge: Isaanis maddaa diimaa akka ibiddaa, sanpeerii fi keelloo akka dinyii qabu turan. Mataan fardeen sanaas mataa leencaa fakkaata ture; afaan isaanii keessaas ibidda, aaraa fi dinyiitu baʼe.
english: Thus I saw the horses in the vision and those who sat on them, having breastplates of fiery red, hyacinth blue, and sulfur yellow; and the horses’ heads resembled lions’ heads. Out of their mouths proceed fire, smoke, and sulfur.

kikuyu: Dhaʼicha sadan kanaan jechuunis ibidda, aaraa fi dinyii afaan isaaniitii baʼeen sanyiin namaa harka sadii keessaa harki tokko ni ajjeefame.
english: By these three plagues, one third of mankind was killed: by the fire, the smoke, and the sulfur, which proceeded out of their mouths.

kikuyu: Taayitaan fardeen sanaas afaan isaaniitii fi eegee isaanii keessa ture; eegeen isaanii akkuma bofaa mataa qaba tureetii; isaanis mataa sanaan nama miidhu turan.
english: For the power of the horses is in their mouths and in their tails. For their tails are like serpents, and have heads; and with them they harm.

kikuyu: Namoonni dhaʼicha sanaan ajjeefamuu jalaa baʼanis amma iyyuu qalbii jijjiirratanii hojii harka isaanii irraa hin deebine; hafuurota hamoo waaqeffachuu fi waaqota tolfamoo warqee irraa, meetii irraa, naasii irraa, dhagaa fi muka irraa hojjetaman kanneen arguu yookaan dhagaʼuu yookaan deemuu hin dandeenye waaqeffachuu hin dhiifne.
english: The rest of mankind, who were not killed with these plagues, didn’t repent of the works of their hands, that they wouldn’t worship demons, and the idols of gold, and of silver, and of brass, and of stone, and of wood, which can’t see, hear, or walk.

kikuyu: Akkasumas gaabbanii nama ajjeesuu isaanii irraa yookaan falfala hojjechuu isaanii irraa yookaan halalummaa isaanii irraa yookaan hanna isaanii irraa hin deebine.
english: They didn’t repent of their murders, their sorceries, their sexual immorality, or their thefts.

kikuyu: Anis utuu ergamaan Waaqaa inni jabaan biraa tokko samii irraa gad buʼuu nan arge. Innis duumessa uffatee ture; mataa isaa irraan immoo sabbata Waaqaatu ture; fuulli isaa akka aduu, miilli isaas akka utubaa ibiddaa ture.
english: I saw a mighty angel coming down out of the sky, clothed with a cloud. A rainbow was on his head. His face was like the sun, and his feet like pillars of fire.

kikuyu: Innis kitaaba maramaa xinnaa baname tokko harkatti qabatee ture. Miilla isaa mirgaa galaana irra, miilla isaa bitaa immoo lafa irra dhaabee ture;
english: He had in his hand a little open book. He set his right foot on the sea, and his left on the land.

kikuyu: innis akkuma leenca aaduutti sagalee guddaadhaan iyye. Yommuu inni iyyettis bakakkaawwan torban ni dubbatan.
english: He cried with a loud voice, as a lion roars. When he cried, the seven thunders uttered their voices.

kikuyu: Yommuu bakakkaawwan torban dubbatanittis ani barreessuuf qophaaʼeen ture; garuu sagalee, “Waan bakakkaawwan torban jedhan sana chaappaan cufi malee hin barreessin” jedhu tokko samii irraa nan dhagaʼe.
english: When the seven thunders sounded, I was about to write; but I heard a voice from the sky saying, “Seal up the things which the seven thunders said, and don’t write them.”

kikuyu: Ergamaan ani utuu inni galaanaa fi lafa irra dhaabatuu argee ture sunis harka isaa mirgaa samiitti ol qabe.
english: The angel whom I saw standing on the sea and on the land lifted up his right hand to the sky

kikuyu: Innis isa bara baraa hamma bara baraatti jiraatu, isa samiiwwanii fi waan isaan keessa jiru hundumaa, lafaa fi waan isa keessa jiru hundumaa, galaanaa fi waan isa keessa jiru hundumaa uume sanaan kakatee akkana jedhe; “Ammaan achi lafa irra harkisuun hin jiru!
english: and swore by him who lives forever and ever, who created heaven and the things that are in it, the earth and the things that are in it, and the sea and the things that are in it, that there will no longer be delay,

kikuyu: Garuu guyyoota ergamaan torbaffaan malakata isaa afuufutti icciitiin Waaqaa akkuma inni raajota warra hojjettoota isaa taʼanitti labse sanatti ni raawwatama.”
english: but in the days of the voice of the seventh angel, when he is about to sound, then the mystery of God is finished, as he declared to his servants the prophets.

kikuyu: Sagaleen ani samii irraa dhagaʼee ture sun ammas deebiʼee, “Dhaqiitii kitaaba maramaa banamee ergamaa galaanaa fi lafa irra dhaabatu harka jiru sana fudhadhu” naan jedhe.
english: The voice which I heard from heaven, again speaking with me, said, “Go, take the book which is open in the hand of the angel who stands on the sea and on the land.”

kikuyu: Kanaafuu ani gara ergamichaa dhaqee akka inni kitaaba maramaa xinnaa sana naa kennuuf isa gaafadhe. Innis, “Fudhadhuutii nyaadhu; kitaabni kun garaa kee ni hadheessa; ‘afaan kee keessatti garuu akka dammaa miʼaawa’” naan jedhe.
english: I went to the angel, telling him to give me the little book. He said to me, “Take it and eat it. It will make your stomach bitter, but in your mouth it will be as sweet as honey.”

kikuyu: Anis kitaaba maramaa xinnaa sana ergamicha harkaa fudhadhee nan nyaadhe. Innis afaan koo keessatti akkuma dammaa miʼaawe; erga ani nyaadhe garuu garaan koo ni hadheeffame.
english: I took the little book out of the angel’s hand, and ate it. It was as sweet as honey in my mouth. When I had eaten it, my stomach was made bitter.

kikuyu: Ergasii immoo, “Ati waaʼee saba baayʼee, sanyii baayʼee, afaan baayʼeetii fi waaʼee mootota baayʼee ammas raajii dubbachuu qabda” jedhamee natti himame.
english: They told me, “You must prophesy again over many peoples, nations, languages, and kings.”

kikuyu: Shambaqqoon ulee safartuu fakkaatu tokko naa kennamee akkana jedhamee natti himame; “Dhaqiitii mana qulqullummaa Waaqaatii fi iddoo aarsaa safari; warra achitti waaqeffatanis lakkaaʼi.
english: A reed like a rod was given to me. Someone said, “Rise and measure God’s temple, and the altar, and those who worship in it.

kikuyu: Oobdii mana qulqullummaatii ala taʼe garuu hin safarin; oobdiin sun waan Namoota Ormaatiif kennameef isa itti hin dabalin. Isaanis magaalaa qulqulluu sana jiʼa 42 lafatti dhidhiitu.
english: Leave out the court which is outside of the temple, and don’t measure it, for it has been given to the nations. They will tread the holy city under foot for forty-two months.

kikuyu: Anis dhuga baatota koo lamaaniif humna nan kenna; isaanis uffata gaddaa uffatanii guyyaa 1,260 raajii ni dubbatu.”
english: I will give power to my two witnesses, and they will prophesy one thousand two hundred sixty days, clothed in sackcloth.”

kikuyu: Isaan kunneenis mukkeen ejersaa lamaanii fi baattuuwwan ibsaa lamaan fuula Gooftaa lafaa dura dhaabatanii dha.
english: These are the two olive trees and the two lamp stands, standing before the Lord of the earth.

kikuyu: Namni kam iyyuu isaan miidhuu yaallaan ibiddi afaan isaaniitii baʼee diinota isaanii ni balleessa. Kunis haala namni isaan miidhuu barbaadu kam iyyuu ittiin ajjeefamuu qabuu dha.
english: If anyone desires to harm them, fire proceeds out of their mouth and devours their enemies. If anyone desires to harm them, he must be killed in this way.

kikuyu: Isaan yeroo raajii dubbatanitti akka bokkaan hin roobneef humna ittiin samii cufan qabu; akkasumas bishaanota dhiigatti geeddaruudhaa fi yeroo barbaadanitti dhaʼicha gosa hundaatiin lafa rukutuuf taayitaa qabu.
english: These have the power to shut up the sky, that it may not rain during the days of their prophecy. They have power over the waters, to turn them into blood, and to strike the earth with every plague, as often as they desire.

kikuyu: Yommuu isaan dhuga baʼumsa isaanii xumuranittis bineensi Boolla Qilee keessaa ol baʼu sun lola isaanitti kaasa; isaan moʼata; isaan ajjeesas.
english: When they have finished their testimony, the beast that comes up out of the abyss will make war with them, and overcome them, and kill them.

kikuyu: Reeffi isaaniis daandii magaalaa guddoo irra ni ciciisa; magaalattiin kunis ishee hiikkaa hafuuraatiin Sodoomii fi Gibxi jedhamtu kan Gooftaan isaaniis itti fannifamee turee dha.
english: Their dead bodies will be in the street of the great city, which spiritually is called Sodom and Egypt, where also their Lord was crucified.

kikuyu: Namoonni saba hunda keessaa, gosa hunda keessaa, afaanii fi sanyii hunda keessaa dhufanis guyyaa sadii fi walakkaa reeffa isaanii ilaalu; akka hin awwaalamnes ni dhowwu.
english: From among the peoples, tribes, languages, and nations, people will look at their dead bodies for three and a half days, and will not allow their dead bodies to be laid in a tomb.

kikuyu: Raajonni lamaan kunneen waan warra lafa irra jiraatan dhiphisaa turaniif warri lafa irra jiraatan isaanitti gammadu; ni ililchus; kennaas walii ergu.
english: Those who dwell on the earth will rejoice over them, and they will be glad. They will give gifts to one another, because these two prophets tormented those who dwell on the earth.

kikuyu: Guyyaa sadii fi walakkaa booddee garuu hafuurri jireenyaa Waaqa biraa dhufee isaan seene; isaanis kaʼanii miilla isaaniitiin dhaabatan; warri isaan arganis akka malee sodaatan.
english: After the three and a half days, the breath of life from God entered into them, and they stood on their feet. Great fear fell on those who saw them.

kikuyu: Isaanis sagalee guddaa, “As ol kottaa!” isaaniin jedhu tokko samii irraa dhagaʼan. Utuma diinonni isaanii ilaalanuus duumessaan gara samiitti ol baʼan.
english: I heard a loud voice from heaven saying to them, “Come up here!” They went up into heaven in a cloud, and their enemies saw them.

kikuyu: Yeroo sanattis sochii lafaa guddaa isaatu ture; magaalaan sunis kudhan keessaa tokko ni barbadaaʼe. Namoonni kumni torbas sochii lafaa sanaan dhuman; warri hafan immoo sodaatanii Waaqa samiitiif ulfina kennan.
english: In that day there was a great earthquake, and a tenth of the city fell. Seven thousand people were killed in the earthquake, and the rest were terrified and gave glory to the God of heaven.

kikuyu: Wayyoon lammaffaan darbeera; kunoo, wayyoon sadaffaan dafee ni dhufa.
english: The second woe is past. Behold, the third woe comes quickly.

kikuyu: Ergamaan torbaffaanis malakata isaa afuufe; sagaleen guddaan, “Mootummaan addunyaa amma mootummaa Gooftaa keenyaatii fi mootummaa Kiristoos taʼeera; innis bara baraa hamma bara baraatti ni moʼa” jedhu samii keessa ture.
english: The seventh angel sounded, and great voices in heaven followed, saying, “The kingdom of the world has become the Kingdom of our Lord and of his Christ. He will reign forever and ever!”

kikuyu: Maanguddoonni digdamii afran fuula Waaqaa dura teessoo isaanii irra tataaʼanii turan sunis adda isaaniitiin gombifamanii Waaqaaf ni sagadan;
english: The twenty-four elders, who sit on their thrones before God’s throne, fell on their faces and worshiped God,

kikuyu: akkanas jedhan: “Yaa Waaqayyoo Gooftaa Waan Hunda Dandeessu, Kan jirtuu fi kan turte, ati humna kee isa guddaa fudhattee waan moʼuu jalqabdeef galata siif dhiʼeessina.
english: saying: “We give you thanks, Lord God, the Almighty, the one who is and who was, because you have taken your great power and reigned.

kikuyu: Saboonni ni aaran; dheekkamsi kees dhufeera. Yeroon warri duʼan itti murtii argatan gaʼeera; yeroon ati itti raajota tajaajiltoota kee taʼaniif, qulqulloota keetii fi warra maqaa kee sodaatan xinnaafis taʼu guddaaf badhaasa kennitu gaʼeera; yeroon ati itti warra lafa balleessan balleessitus gaʼeera.”
english: The nations were angry, and your wrath came, as did the time for the dead to be judged, and to give your bondservants the prophets, their reward, as well as to the saints and those who fear your name, to the small and the great, and to destroy those who destroy the earth.”

kikuyu: Manni qulqullummaa Waaqaa kan samii keessaas ni baname; taabonni kakuu isaas mana qulqullummaa isaa keessatti mulʼate. Ergasiis ifa balaqqee, sagalee, bakakkaa, sochii lafaatii fi bokkaa cabbii guddaa isaatu ture.
english: God’s temple that is in heaven was opened, and the ark of the Lord’s covenant was seen in his temple. Lightnings, sounds, thunders, an earthquake, and great hail followed.

kikuyu: Mallattoon guddaan tokko samii keessatti mulʼate: dubartii biiftuu uffattee miilla ishee jalaa jiʼa qabdu kan mataa ishee irraa gonfoo urjiiwwan kudha lamaa qabdu tokkotu ture.
english: A great sign was seen in heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and on her head a crown of twelve stars.

kikuyu: Isheenis ulfa turte; yommuu daʼumsi ishee gaʼettis ciniinsuudhaan qabamtee iyyite.
english: She was with child. She cried out in pain, laboring to give birth.

kikuyu: Mallattoon biraas samii keessatti mulʼate; kunoo, bineensa jawwee fakkaatu diimaa guddaa, mataa torbaa fi gaanfa kudhan qabu, kan mataa isaa irraa gonfoo torba qabu tokkotu ture.
english: Another sign was seen in heaven. Behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven crowns.

kikuyu: Eegeen isaas urjiiwwan samii irra jiran harka sadii keessaa harka tokko haxaaʼee lafatti gad darbate. Bineensi jawwee fakkaatu sunis yeroo dubartittiin deessutti mucaa ishee liqimsuuf jedhee fuula dubartii daʼuuf jirtu sanaa dura dhaabate.
english: His tail drew one third of the stars of the sky, and threw them to the earth. The dragon stood before the woman who was about to give birth, so that when she gave birth he might devour her child.

kikuyu: Isheen ilma bokkuu sibiilaatiin saba hundumaa bulchuuf jiru tokko deesse; daaʼimni ishees gara Waaqaatti, gara teessoo isaattis ol butame.
english: She gave birth to a son, a male child, who is to rule all the nations with a rod of iron. Her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

kikuyu: Dubartittiinis gara lafa gammoojjii iddoo akka isheen guyyaa 1,260 achitti gabbifamtuuf jedhee Waaqni isheef qopheesseetti baqatte.
english: The woman fled into the wilderness, where she has a place prepared by God, that there they may nourish her one thousand two hundred sixty days.

kikuyu: Lollis samii keessatti kaʼe. Miikaaʼelii fi ergamoonni isaa bineensa jawwee fakkaatu sana lolan; bineensi jawwee fakkaatu sunii fi ergamoonni isaas of irraa lolan.
english: There was war in the sky. Michael and his angels made war on the dragon. The dragon and his angels made war.

kikuyu: Isaan garuu moʼachuu hin dandeenye; ergasiis iddoo isaanii kan samii keessaa sana ni dhaban.
english: They didn’t prevail. No place was found for them any more in heaven.

kikuyu: Bineensi guddaan jawwee fakkaatu sunis gad darbatame; innis bofa durii isa diiyaabiloos yookaan Seexana jedhamu, isa addunyaa guutuu karaa irraa jalʼisu sanaa dha. Inni lafatti gad darbatame; ergamoonni isaas isa wajjin darbataman.
english: The great dragon was thrown down, the old serpent, he who is called the devil and Satan, the deceiver of the whole world. He was thrown down to the earth, and his angels were thrown down with him.

kikuyu: Anis sagalee guddaa tokko samii keessaa nan dhagaʼe; innis akkana jedha: “Amma fayyinni, humnii fi mootummaan Waaqa keenyaa, taayitaan Kiristoos isaas dhufeera. Himataan obboloota keenyaa inni halkanii guyyaa fuula Waaqaa duratti, isaan himatu sun gad darbatameeraatii.
english: I heard a loud voice in heaven, saying, “Now the salvation, the power, and the Kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ has come; for the accuser of our brothers has been thrown down, who accuses them before our God day and night.

kikuyu: Isaanis dhiiga Hoolichaatiin, dubbii dhuga baʼumsa isaaniitiinis, isa moʼatan; isaan hamma duʼaatti illee taanaan lubbuu isaanii hin mararfanne.
